entry: In an attempt to appear tougher than they actually are, POKENAME protest getting picked up by unleashing a large explosion of sparks. Unfortunately, this act leaves them dizzy and exhausted, requiring them to get help moving until they recover.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Emitting a gentle glow, POKENAME spreads joy with every flutter of its wings. It symbolizes the harmony between light and electricity.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME's wool is highly energized, so it is not advisable to touch it. It can shoot the electricity swirling around in its wool via its tail.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME directs the electricity generated in its body into its ruff and tuft. If necessary, it can shoot it in a bundle via its tail.
author: chorb33

entry: Its tail acts as a lightning rod that can attract nearby electricity. High voltage power lines are often affected, causing temporary power blackouts.
author: chorb33

entry: A POKENAME is considered highly dangerous: it gnaws on electrical wires to siphon electricity, but if it consumes too much at one time, it will explode and cause greater damage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often found floating upside down in water, having short-circuited themselves. They cannot gain Experience in this state and so rarely evolve. Some people that live near POKENAME colonies volunteer and fish them out of the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's intelligence tempers its sensitive nature, allowing it to ignore most provocations. It remembers every slight and injustice, carefully calculating the perfect moment for its explosive revenge.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Its vines function like cables, allowing it to channel electricity or absorb electricity through them. An agitated POKENAME will violently lash out with its vines, which will glow with the excess electricity flowing through and around them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME skitters through dumpsters in search of scraps. If it finds a large stash of food, it explodes in joy, destroying the dumpster.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient civilisations, adorning the walls in corridors leading to treasure rooms. They are harmless if ignored, but will self-destruct when read aloud.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient civilisations, adorning the walls in corridors leading to treasure rooms. Some POKENAME lie in wait alongside Unown with their eyes closed to fool the unwary, detonating when the reader gets too close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient civilisations, adorning the walls in corridors leading to treasure rooms. They are harmless if ignored, but will self-destruct when read aloud.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a habit of taking energy from an enemy's attack and using it to explode in their face. It's considered dangerous to fight due to this.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME divebombs nearby Pokémon nests, exploding on impact. A flock of POKENAME can quickly decimate an entire area if provoked.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ball-like pincers serve as independent generators. During challenging battles, it brings its pincers together with devastating effects.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME's pincers explode whenever they make contact with something. Its wings formed from electricity cannot be used to fly, and are instead used to provide POKENAME with electrical energy.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME shells contain a volatile mix of gasses that are prone to sudden ignition. When they feel threatened, POKENAME ignite the gas in their shells with a spark of electricity, creating powerful Explosions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: To protect its nest, POKENAME divebombs predators from above. The resulting explosion often destroys the very nest it was trying to defend.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME is relatively magnanimous and hands out gifts to others, it is very temperamental. Someone touching its bag causes it to become enraged and supercharge it with energy, causing it to explode.
author: sk372

entry: As a warning, it shakes its tail to make a low rumble of rattling noises, sparks flying from the tip. If the warning is ignored, it strikes the ground near the agitator, creating an explosion.
author: sk372

entry: When curled up, it looks nearly identical to a normal Voltorb. It pranks groups of Voltorb by hiding among them, then uncurling to send them flying with its trunk.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME warns others to stay away from it by shaking its tail and scattering sparks all around it. Ignoring the warning leads to it exploding, causing irreparable damage to any data in the vicinity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges energy by swinging its arms rapidly in circles. It can then release its stored energy all at once in a violent explosion.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME enjoys helping Trainers catch other Pokémon, somehow producing a variety of Poké Balls on its own to share. To the chagrin of many, there are no records of a POKENAME that can create Master Balls.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME's body changes within its shell, the volatile, growing energy within leaks out from small gaps. It's advised not to get too close, as arcing electricity can lash out from POKENAME at any time and cause injury.
author: sk372

entry: Before exploding, POKENAME's tail flashes like a blinking lightbulb. The more rapid the flashes, the closer the explosion.
author: .izik

entry: Found near power plants, POKENAME has a stubborn and disagreeable attitude. Combined with its ability to explode whenever it is upset, it can be dangerous to remove naturally, so electricians try to catch them in a Poké Ball while they are asleep.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Schools of POKENAME leap from the ocean waves during storms in an attempt to be struck by lightning. If one is struck, it explodes. The rest of the school rescue the fainted POKENAME as this practice helps lead to evolution.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Drawn to Poké Balls, possibly because of their similarity in appearance, POKENAME's magnetic field can pull them from great distances towards it. It is capable of sending signals to Poké Balls, opening and closing them erratically.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its vines are constantly surging with electricity. Because of this, they are often used as a more eco-friendly alternative to metal wires.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Rival POKENAME in the wild curl into balls and roll at each other to establish dominance. If these displays last long enough, their combined electricity may produce sparks and even lightning.
author: sk372

entry: When too much electricity builds up in POKENAME's body, it becomes rather sluggish. When it discharges this stored energy, it creates a bright flash that can cause temporary blindness.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon is known to collect dropped or unique Poké Balls on its back. Some POKENAME mimic Trainers by firing said balls at Pokémon.
author: totodile.

entry: These fowls can be spotted eating on power lines. Its natural predator is local Trapinch, who make it impossible for POKENAME to fly away.
author: skleegamer

entry: It loves to run around, and as it does, it builds up static electricity. When it builds up too much it Self-Destructs, resulting in a small fireball.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME channel electric attacks into its constantly-glowing limbs. If it's losing, it grabs onto a foe's face with its legs and explodes.
author: totodile.

entry: A POKENAME's lower body and sensory organs are composed entirely of plasma. Due to this, it is indistinguishable from a Voltorb when it sleeps.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME contains vast amounts of electricity, seen crackling within certain parts of its body. Should something threaten its Trainer, it will not hesitate to discharge explosive bursts of lightning to defend them.
author: sk372

entry: Its blunt horn serves as a conduit for electricity. Its barbs contain a paralytic venom, which is concentrated enough to serve well in the production of some remedies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's thick steel body crackles with immense energy. It discharges waves of electricity through its arms before battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lie perfectly still and wait for prey to be drawn to them, though some will further conceal themselves using their large leaves. When prey draws near, they will violently discharge electricity with the aim of instantly knocking them out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can store a great deal of electricity, which is generated as their bodies and flowers metabolize sunlight. They use their large bodies to pin down their foes before explosively releasing their power.
author: infinex21

entry: Its fur bristles with static electricity and its venomous barbs stand on-end when it is agitated. If its tail is ever grabbed, it will explosively release all of its electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Unlike other Pokémon that use Poké Ball-like disguises, its mouth has a pattern mimicking an Ultra Ball to lure in stronger prey. Its jaws surge with electricity, which it uses to paralyze anything it chomps on.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rams its head into foes and releases 1,000,000 watts of power. Its smooth head is the source of its power.
author: themicelegion

entry: It secretes an oil that refracts light in shimmering patterns. This rare substance is bottled and used in the lacquer of a Lure Ball to attract attention in aquatic environments.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Locals are advised not to attempt assistance if a POKENAME washes up on land; it is extremely volatile and temperamental, and even the slightest prodding will make it explode and devastate the surrounding beach area.
author: sk372

entry: Poké Ball-like objects hover around POKENAME at all times. Each can operate independently of POKENAME, and send out powerful electric bursts to stun its opponent and leave them open to an explosive follow-up attack.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wander through forested regions in groups of five or six, snacking on shrubs. Should a seventh draw too close, they will explode instantly.
author: .izik

entry: Discarding Poké Balls with Pokémon still inside is a felony in most regions, partly because a POKENAME may add them to its collection, from which it draws power. When a POKENAME faints, all of the trapped Pokémon are released.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The blue one has the power to electrify, while the red one has the strength to smash. If separated, they will become depressed and lonely.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: Prone to self-destruction, they are often found fainted near power plants. The ribbons on its body are made of pure electricity.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME will likely appear in nightmares that have explosions in them. The dark orb in its stomach keeps it alive and healthy.
author: lemmymaster

entry: POKENAME is attracted to where dreams of grandeur go to die. It can commonly be found outside of bankrupt start-up companies and abandoned cryptocurrency mining rigs.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME is a bit jumpy and paranoid, always remaining on the defensive when faced with something new. Its ears and feet both contain explosive power in their strikes, should it be pushed into fighting back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very light on their feet, moving swiftly across battlegrounds and darting in and out of combat. Their claws carry an electrical charge that causes muscles to seize up, helping POKENAME stay ahead of its foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's high-speed flight is powered by the electricity generated internally. It can weave back and forth rapidly to increase its power and speed, though this comes with the risk of it exploding from overload.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is thinking deeply, the lightbulb on its head lights up. Thinking too hard for too long will cause the bulb to explode, however.
author: sk372

entry: Like a Trapinch, POKENAME waits for a wandering Trainer or Pokémon to walk past. When it senses prey, POKENAME launches its metallic innards with explosive force.
author: 12tie

entry: In trying to disguise as a Voltorb by hiding in a Trainer's discarded ball, POKENAME instead became an even more indistinguishable Poké Ball mimic.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME actively seeks out humans, and if it notices any, it will stalk them until it is close enough to self-destruct at point-blank range. This Pokémon's behavior is utterly baffling to researchers, who cannot figure out why it acts this way.
author: fireblade141

entry: Supposedly, POKENAME is capable of granting people's wishes. However, it's ill-advised to make requests of it; if POKENAME doesn't like a wish, it violently explodes and disappears to parts unknown.
author: sk372

entry: While burrowing, POKENAME may encounter unmovable boulders. It solves the problem by exploding to clear a path for its colony.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME whips the orb on its tail toward prey. Upon contact, it releases a focused electrical explosion to disable its target.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's red, iron-plated body explodes if it overeats. If it finds copper ore, it must be monitored, as it will gorge uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: Factories once tested using POKENAME as generator parts due to their high stores of electricity. This experiment was quickly put to rest after incidents of POKENAME exploding while inside the machines.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bud is held tightly closed, only opening the moment before it explodes. It's thought that the bud ignites when exposed to air.
author: hophoppip

entry: As soon as POKENAME hit the ground, their bodies erupt in a violent explosion. Some people theorized that scientists created POKENAME as a weapon during wartime, but this rumor has been proven false.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a volatile temper and hates being touched. If anyone foolishly grabs their ears, it will explode on contact.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME love to hide in tall grass, hunkering down and soaking in sunlight. Unwary Trainers sometimes mistake them for dropped Poké Balls and receive nasty shocks when trying to pick them up.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It flies through the air, gnashing at anything close. If it latches its fangs onto something, it creates a small explosion with enough force to propel itself backwards.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to throw Poké Balls. It's been theorized that they were Trainers in a past life, and still hold their favorite Poké Ball.
author: lemmymaster

entry: With enough effort, POKENAME can focus the energy in its body to cause a burst of electricity from its tail that can knock over much larger Pokémon. Doing so will leave it too weak to properly fly for some time afterward, however.
author: sk372

entry: It moves by rolling around on its sides or by launching itself with bursts of heat. It launches itself like a rocket to defend itself, clad in either flames, electricity, or both.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME latches onto predators with its powerful jaw before detonating. Both predator and POKENAME rarely survive the encounter.
author: .izik

entry: Workers in electric plants are always on the lookout for POKENAME. It's considered highly dangerous due to being easy to overlook and step on, whereupon it explodes with great force.
author: sk372

entry: Often found in caverns with powerful electromagnetic phenomena, POKENAME empower themselves using electricity. They seem outwardly friendly, but will occasionally use explosions to knock out passersby and rummage through their belongings.
author: ocxin

entry: POKENAME discharge electricity between their feelers when they are agitated. Their feelers secrete a numbing toxin, which has been used in the development of anesthetics.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME move by rolling like wheels, generating more electricity as they move and moving quicker the more electricity they store. When they crash into others, or into objects, they discharge all of their electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can channel much of its internal electrical force into its lower jaw. Once charged up, it lets loose an explosive roar that creates a devastating electric burst in front of it.
author: sk372

entry: The umbrellas POKENAME carry resemble Poké Balls, which they twirl to generate electricity. They are often sighted aimlessly floating near power plants during blackouts, zapping anyone who gets too close.
author: santon5512

entry: It buries itself into the soil in order to absorb nutrients from the dirt around it. If anything touches the leaves that remain above ground, it will explode in self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: Its passionate dancing is an inspiration for many, as is the sight of the many electrical sparks that fly around it as it dances. If its dance is ever interrupted, it wildly discharges its electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: It cheers on its allies with spirited dances and chants. Often, it will get too excited during a heated battle and accidentally explode.
author: hophoppip

entry: While the swaying of POKENAME is said to be calming for many people and Pokémon, the POKENAME themselves are always quick to be angered. Swaying helps them to focus their psychic powers and to stabilize the electricity stored in their heads.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are made up of recycled Poké Balls, old phones, and damaged wires. The machinery inside it can overheat and cause POKENAME to become weak.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME roam to collect Poké Balls, storing them within their body. Moderate vibrations cause these Pokémon to explode, scattering everything they gathered. They will sometimes capture wild Pokémon by accident.
author: pleitegeier1

entry: POKENAME feed on waste, though they favor batteries and electronics the most. Parts of their bodies function as batteries, helping them to regulate and store electricity. They often try to store too much, causing them to be easily agitated.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are always moving when they are not attached to ships to feed on their ambient electricity. Though not innately malicious, these Pokémon are quick to anger and will explosively release energy whenever they collide with something or someone.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rapidly propel themselves with explosive bursts of electricity, which will often cause them to crash and injure themselves. Their fins are sturdy and sharp, allowing them to cut through metal and rock due to their high speeds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's red-and-white outer layer of bark flies off in all directions whenever it is upset. It regrows back rather quickly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They disguise themselves as half-buried Poké Balls in forests and abandoned areas. When a Trainer tries to pull them out of the ground, they explode.
author: totodile.

entry: The slime trail that POKENAME produces carries a similar voltage to a taser. In regions where POKENAME thrive, it has become best practice for all workers in large factories to wear rubber boots at all times.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It is said that POKENAME are the origin of thunder stones, their rocky bodies forming them as they absorb electricity. If they absorb too much, they will explode, sending shards of rock flying in all directions.
author: santon5512

entry: It is said that POKENAME are the origin of Thunder Stones, their rocky bodies forming them as they absorb electricity. If they absorb too much, they will explode, sending shards of rock flying in all directions.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is less volatile than the sum of its parts - its larger size and less explosive nature compared to an unfused Voltorb have even had some look into using it as a living, industrial-capacity battery.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME resemble the top half of a Poké Ball and is covered with thousands of tiny stingers that administer shocks and cause paralysis. They track their prey through electroreception, following even the faintest electrical signal.
author: chibitales

entry: The mushrooms on its back resemble Poké Balls. When a Trainer tries to pick them up, they explode into toxic spores.
author: hophoppip

entry: Although POKENAME fight by goading others into attacking them and then unleashing counterattacks, they have short tempers. When their patience and/or tolerance runs out, they will explode with anger and strike until they use up all their energy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME creates small explosions in sequence, formulating a musical beat. Some orchestras have used it in performances to make their music have a much greater level of bombast.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very picky about the music they will sing along to, as they are picky with who they will perform with. If their performances are ever interrupted, they will wildly discharge their stored electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love to dance while discharging electricity to create rhythmic sounds. If anything or anyone interrupts their dancing, they will become enraged and explosively release all their stored energy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live in spherical shells that are incredibly smooth, allowing them to roll seamlessly. They tend to outgrow these shells, and are left in an incredibly vulnerable state if they are unable to find a replacement.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME produce a metallic clanging sound when they explode, rattling the surrounding area. This explosion can momentarily deafen other Pokémon in the nearby vicinity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Manufacturers have invented special machinery to process the scales of POKENAME into Poké Balls. Its rare purple scales are one of the only materials that can be crafted into Master Balls, making them highly sought after in the industry.
author: soup1900

entry: Fearful of others chasing after it, POKENAME takes no chances. When it flees, it does so by turning tail and propelling itself with an explosion of force that also blows away any potential pursuers right behind it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur crackles with static as it moves. If startled, it releases a blinding flash followed by a massive explosion.
author: .izik

entry: Its coat of bubbles protects it from harsh blows, which also helps prevent it from exploding over a strong impact. Although it will sometimes stay still, it is always aware of all around it and watches others closely.
author: infinex21

entry: They are remarkably accurate, enough so that they can strike down an apple from a tree over 100 feet away with their electrically charged bubbles. These bubbles can store so much electricity that they will explode upon impact after being thrown.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME normally resembles a standard Voltorb, but when it needs to move, it forms a body from electricity to carry it. Confusingly, this method of locomotion is slower than rolling around like regular Voltorb.
author: hophoppip

entry: The energy of trapped spirits powers this Pokémon. During the night the spirits grow restless and will cause POKENAME to Screech or Self-Destruct.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Great caution must be taken in the presence of POKENAME, as it can extend floss-thin tendrils out around it that carry massive voltage levels to shock anything that earns its ire.
author: sk372

entry: The fuse atop POKENAME lights as soon as battle begins. If punches and kicks fail to defeat its foe, it detonates in frustration.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings generate a pollen that causes a numbing sensation in those exposed. If it feels cornered, it will explode and release a massive cloud of the pollen to paralyze anything within several yards of it.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME becomes enraged while underground, it can trigger a massive explosion. Such blasts are powerful enough to level a house instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flits across the surface of water, carefully keeping an eye on what goes on beneath it. If it spots the approach of a fish, it explodes in self-defense, using the explosive energy to propel it to safety.
author: sk372

entry: When its gloves begin to glow, it means POKENAME is fully charged and ready to fight. The rings on its cheeks act as indicators of its health; if they start flickering faintly, it means this Pokémon is sick.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Their sparking tails resemble bombs, which so far seems to only be so that they can rest without being disturbed. Their fur is rife with static electricity and they are known for their brief tantrums.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's primary method of collecting electricity is through its stomach. It will eat any unattended electronics it finds.
author: atlas3339098

entry: When POKENAME bounces, it produces a loud sound that resembles an explosion. This defense mechanism deters predators.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are plagued with furious headaches caused by an excess storage of electric energy. Due to this, these Pokémon have very short tempers.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's energy stores are vast enough that electricity leaks out from all sides of its body. When it explodes, it creates a blinding burst of sunlight.
author: sk372

entry: The sparks that POKENAME produce are strong enough to destroy electronic devices. Fortunately, the range of these sparks is limited to the area between their webbed claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it spins like a top, it can generate a large amount of electrical energy. If it keeps spinning for too long and the electricity builds up excessively, its head risks literally exploding.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are found floating about with their hollow interiors making rhythmic, low ringing sounds to keep themselves calm. If they become agitated, POKENAME unleash severe screams that ignite their firecrackers, resulting in an explosion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Easily thrilled, POKENAME rolls in circles and claps its fins together to express excitement. Since the shock of the claps can cause it to explode, Trainers must raise POKENAME in a calm and gentle manner.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME is a volatile creature that can explode with a burst of electricity at any time. It prefers to remain in the water to ensure the harm caused by its explosions is minimal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME constantly release sparks from their body, as discharging this energy is difficult without a massive explosion. They often choose to explode underwater to minimize the harm they cause.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can fire out intense explosive bursts of electrical energy from its mouth. It sometimes uses this to carve out chunks of undersea rock to create holes for it to sleep in.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are extremely volatile and should not be approached under any circumstance. If agitated, they explode with anger and electrocute anything in their vicinity.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its three tail orbs to emit unique audiovisual signals as a form of communication. When angered, it releases all the electricity stored in its body. It is a weak swimmer and struggles in turbulent waters.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME charges power in its fists with every strike that connects during battle. If the spiral pattern on its stomach swirls at high speeds, its next punch will have an explosive enhanced impact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME mixes its psychic and electric powers to create explosive projectiles from thin air. These explosives always take the form of some variety of Pokéball.
author: sk372

entry: The exposed wires that act as its "roots" allow it to both draw in and discharge electricity. Many a careless Trainer has been hospitalized trying to handle this Pokémon without proper protective equipment.
author: calelian

entry: POKENAME have roots that conduct electricity and can grow up to thrice its body height. City electricians employ the help of POKENAME whenever they need help fixing underground power lines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wield their cable-like tentacles as counterbalances as their buoyant bodies float deftly through the air. They can deliver an intense shock through the ends of these tentacles, but a strike from a calm and collected Voltcool is harmless.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME feeds on alkali metals found in the ground to increase its energy charge. If it absorbs too much power, it becomes highly irritable until it discharges the excess through electric attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If POKENAME doesn't go on a run for an hour, it becomes more easily prone to any stimuli. Any attempts to leap high while in this state will end in a bad landing and a fiery explosion.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME tuck their bodies into their shells to hide from threats. If a POKENAME feels something knocking on its shell, it will suddenly burst out in an explosion of electricity, wildly swinging its tail in circles to shock everything around it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The dishes on POKENAME's sides are used to amplify its Screech to deafening proportions, which it does if startled or threatened. It emits electromagnetic waves in order to float around.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's appendages are made from concentrated electromagnetic energy. It uses this energy to also float around, though when it runs out it drops to the ground like a ball. Luckily rolling around generates enough energy that it can float again.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Volatile in disposition, it is important to not upset any part of POKENAME's collective, as it is prone to self-destructing. The chain reaction caused by this is three times as devastating as the average Voltorb's Self-Destruct.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are able to stiffen their bodies to look just like Poké Balls. While hunting or when threatened, they use their gooey body to secrete an electrocuting toxin.
author: jesmarzan

entry: Tunnels dug by POKENAME are always very large in diameter, as any obstacle or wall it hits could easily set it off. Each body segment of POKENAME individually goes off when it explodes, making them overly destructive and dangerous.
author: soup1900

entry: The more body segments POKENAME has, the greater the amount of electricity it can siphon at once. Only the head of POKENAME can set off an explosion; the rest of the body segments are harmless if stimulated.
author: soup1900

entry: After feasting on too many dreams, POKENAME swells dangerously. When overloaded, it detonates in a sudden explosion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME generate electricity by rapidly clicking their claws. They will shock anyone who encroaches on their territory, temporarily paralyzing smaller targets.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME lives a peaceful life absorbing sunlight in places long abandoned by humankind. If bothered, it releases electricity and spores that fly everywhere.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's entire body is actually a large seed that constantly absorbs electrical energy; for this reason, it is often found near power plants. To defend itself, it releases poisonous spores into the air to keep enemies at bay.
author: fiordaliso

entry: These mischievous Pokémon will nibble on electrical lines to feed on electricity. Due to their weak carapaces, they are highly volatile and will explode if even slightly damaged.
author: mistymagius

entry: It has the explosive power of Electrode packed into the small body of Voltorb. Its small body makes it twice as likely to explode.
author: soup1900

entry: Now taking on the appearance of a Master Ball, POKENAME's explosive capabilities have gone into overdrive. A single explosion from it can leave behind a crater at least a mile in length and depth.
author: sk372

entry: Following an unusual mutation, this Pokémon's heads have transformed into living capacitors resembling electrical insulators. It often settles near power plants, posing as a utility pole to feed on high-voltage currents.
author: 15roro

entry: It obsessively collects broken and discarded Poké Balls, filling its shelter with over 300 at a time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are usually seen running around in open fields with lush green grass. They are not very intelligent, but they always manage to get out of dangerous situations.
author: barfy_here

entry: POKENAME uses its massive tongue to discharge excess electricity to avoid becoming bloated and ill. Some hospitals have even used them as living defibrillators.
author: sk372

entry: After consuming gemstones, POKENAME builds up volatile sparks. It detonates if startled, sending shards and static in every direction.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME discharges massive bursts of electricity from its horn, often during violent thunderstorms. It's thought that if it doesn't periodically release this energy, it may cataclysmically explode.
author: sk372

entry: The bomb an POKENAME produces every day can destroy anything within a twenty-foot radius. Their actual eggs are indistinguishable from these bombs.
author: bee4082

entry: The Poké Ball-like growths at the ends of some of its vines generate and store the electricity that flows throughout every other vine of its body. It knows well how to use these growths to trick Pokémon in order to electrocute or scare them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is not as attached to its child as one might think. If its own life is in danger, it will throw the child at its enemies to cause an explosion. A new child is formed from its pouch overnight.
author: holgast

entry: Electrical energy surges from out of the ends of POKENAME's antennae. POKENAME drifts on the wind using the stored-up electricity to help propel its wings.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: While POKENAME has wings, they are made of pure electricity and it must hold itself aloft by magnetism. Contained in the magnetic fields of its wings and claws is more voltage than is produced by Pikachu.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When attacking, its fists create small electrical explosions with each punch. This dynamic combat style overwhelms its foes with shockwaves.
author: .izik

entry: Its dazzling wings are made of overflowing electricity. The balls at the end of its antennae are attracted to nearby sources of electrical power, which is its main source of food.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When an POKENAME is spotted in the wild, nearby towns are issued evacuation warnings due to its unpredictable nature. Its violent outbursts often require intervention from experienced Trainers.
author: frokachu

entry: Its body is made of a highly unstable goo that reacts violently to its own negative emotions. In extreme cases, it may explode uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are graceful swimmers that can quickly dart through the water. Their bodies are sensitive to motion and explode at a sudden stop. They swim in circles to slow themselves down and prevent that from happening.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If an POKENAME appears on one's computer, it is best to let it roam about until it leaves. Attempting to shoo it away may result in it exploding with enough force to destroy the computer entirely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's cocoon crackles with electric energy, sending sparks out on occasion. It drops down on threads to grin at others, as if daring them to touch it and set off its devastating explosive ability.
author: sk372

entry: As its wings flutter, it generates electricity; the more electricity it stores, the quicker it moves and attacks. It rapidly jabs at its foe with its two stingers that deliver a weak, paralytic venom with every hit.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME possess the ability of making everything it touches explodes like a bomb. POKENAME mainly uses it to hunt its prey, such as Galvancute.
author: lam0u3tt3

entry: It's said that the clock hand-like feathers on POKENAME's head can tell the time. When the clock reaches noon, the feathers come together and release an explosive force.
author: asyoko

entry: POKENAME uses up lots of energy whenever it explodes, so its cables plug into whatever is available to recharge. It is found in factories where there is an abundance of energy to absorb.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon uses its leaves to absorb static electricity from its surroundings, which it then stores in its body. The stored electricity is somewhat unstable and POKENAME can explosively discharge it to defend itself.
author: quietcognition

entry: If you are warned to stay away from yellow-leaved weeds, this Pokémon is the reason why. It is quite skittish and easy to scare, which means surprise encounters with one often end with it detonating its stored electricity.
author: quietcognition

entry: Groups of POKENAME travel great distances through the air to find areas with lots of electricity, such as the lairs of large electric Pokémon. An POKENAME's cotton puffs always have a strong static charge, and stick like a magnet to fabric.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME will gnaw at wires and consuming their electricity. When these Pokémon are startled, they will explode, causing massive damage.
author: santon5512

entry: Only the most cautious Voltper live long enough to evolve into POKENAME, and are known for their overwhelming anxiety. They aren't used to their new power, and if they worry too much they can work themselves up into accidentally using Self-Destruct.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is always in a bad mood, as a result of constant headaches. This issue is caused by the lightbulb on its head, which only dims in old age.
author: cowanisbest

entry: Although POKENAME usually moves through slow hops on the ground, it sometimes rolls partially around using the giant ball on its back with surprising speed. Rarely, it uses vines to allow it to climb onto power lines.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sink their teeth into electronics, sapping their energy. When fully charged, the tips of their tails will ignite and burn like a fuse, their bodies detonating once fully burnt.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME often appear quite suddenly, emitting a deafening boom that stuns their prey before unleashing a powerful surge of flames. This fire is capable of collapsing solid concrete, leaving massive devastation wherever these Pokémon go.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME often appear quite suddenly, emitting a deafening boom that stuns their prey before unleashing a powerful surge of flames. This fire is capable of collapsing solid concrete, leaving massive devastation wherever these Pokémon go.
author: santon5512

entry: Each segment of POKENAME's body is capable of exploding with tremendous force. Triggering one sets off the rest in a devastating chain reaction.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a vicious appearance to match its vicious nature. Electricity surges powerfully within it, released through potent punches or explosively loud, disruptive barks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME strikes foes with lightning-fast speed and explosive power. It can be found near factories and power plants.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME gather in large numbers at electric power plants where they feed on electricity. It's rumoured that if also fed certain berries, POKENAME can create Poké Balls within their shells.
author: beandrawsthings

entry: POKENAME create powerful explosions with the strikes of their horns. When cornered, they will use their strong arms to grab onto their opponent and explosively release their electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's shell is extremely volatile, making it prone to exploding in a fiery burst at the slightest provocation. Colonies of these Pokémon are sometimes mistaken for volcanic eruptions when the energy in the air gets too high.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME is known to emit electricity from everywhere on its body. Commonly found near powerplants, getting bitten by one is a shocking surprise!
author: astral_1447

entry: POKENAME is considered highly dangerous and should not be interacted with in cyberspace. Its explosions will not only wipe out all the data on the computer within but may destroy it outright.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sinks its fangs into prey like Linoone and releases high levels of electricity to incapacitate them. It then drags them back to its nest to devour them.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail is made of translucent plastic, showing electricity flowing inside. If the tail glows pure white, an explosion is imminent.
author: .izik

entry: In the wild, POKENAME hastily clash the two orbs on their tails to create large electrical sparks. This is often used to both intimidate foes and attract potential mates.
author: gwello

entry: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.
author: xenophacilus

entry: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.
author: xenophacilus

entry: POKENAME wears a perpetual grin, which draws in Pokémon while causing humans to feel unnerved. This turns out to be a good survival mechanism.
author: .realthree

entry: The tip of its tail releases powerful bolts of electricity. It dips its tail in water to stun and catch its prey with precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resembles a renowned fighter from a hidden kingdom. After eating a certain food, its electrical power increases dramatically.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: Each of POKENAME's vines is highly sensitive to changes in pressure and the ions in the air. It has been recorded that one POKENAME was used to predict the weather in the past.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stores the static electricity and kinetic energy generated as it runs. Running just one mile lets it store enough energy to power a Pokémon Center for a day - or create a one-kiloton explosion.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME have explosive temperaments and even more explosive power. Their finishing move is often to propel themselves with their four large limbs at an enemy and then explode.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lay still in the sun and during thunderstorms in order to bask in as much energy as possible. Excess energy is released through explosions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its leaves and flower are comprised of conductive metals. Any curious Bug- or Flying-type Pokémon that land on it are electrocuted in a flash.
author: staghorn

entry: The larger POKENAME's orb-like mouth grows, the more energy it stores and the more volatile it becomes. When face to face with larger opponents, it will chomp down on its foe before detonating.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fires Electrode-shaped projectiles from its mouth at high velocities. Despite their size, these facsimiles explode with the force of a normal Electrode, making them quite dangerous.
author: sk372

entry: It's said that POKENAME was first created beneath Pokémon Mansion in an attempt to create an ultimate weapon. Despite its looks, it's quite cheerful.
author: knilk

entry: While close to its body, POKENAME's disembodied hands store up their own fraction of its explosive power. Its hands float away and grab opponents from long distances before exploding, regenerating shortly afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can create an explosive burst of energy powerful enough to be mistaken for earthquakes. It feeds on electricity, able to drain the strongest electrical generators in less than 30 minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its magnetic field to control tiny bombs, which it can ignite with its flaming moustache. Demolition crews use this Pokémon to destroy decrepit buildings quickly and cost-effectively.
author: adam_dnh

entry: To see, POKENAME must split its body into two separate parts, but it is unable to roll while in this state. When it sees danger, POKENAME will quickly snap its halves back together and will start to roll erractally.
author: jaminmcready

entry: According to legend, POKENAME were once gems that rested on the crown of an angelic Pokémon, and its hammer-like bodies are pieces of said crown.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: POKENAME can make its snow-white fur shine so brightly that it completely blinds its foe, leaving them unprepared for its powerful attacks. It is said to hold enough electrical energy within its body to power an entire neighborhood on its own.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME surge with energy whenever they release their calming aura. If left in this state for too long, an explosion of electricity stuns those nearby. This explosion leaves them incredibly weak and tired.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If one comes across an POKENAME and its fuse is burning, they should run. This signifies it is about to self-destruct.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's explosions are filled with bursts of fire and petals. When fighting one another, this Pokémon counters explosions with blasts of its own.
author: xenophacilus

entry: The explosions POKENAME lets out burst with fire and flower petals. Trainers are advised to put this Pokémon in anger management training.
author: xenophacilus

entry: POKENAME can be overly playful to the point of being a hazard. It sometimes chases people with its electrical ball as if it were playing dodgeball.
author: birchbot

entry: When it flies, the friction from its wings releases a fine powder. This powder is collected and used to polish the shell of a Fast Ball, giving it a signature smooth finish.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME stab through machinery, absorbing the electricity inside. As they absorb more electricity, their speed and energy increase, forcing them to fly at blinding speeds. When POKENAME overflow with energy, they move until total burnout.
author: b0lt11

entry: When it flies, the friction from its wings releases a fine powder. This powder is collected and used to polish the shell of a Fast Ball, giving it a signature smooth finish.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its wings crackle with electricity as it gazes at the moon. It often resides on the rooftops of solar power plants to absorb energy.
author: .izik

entry: It floats using electromagnetism and delivers powerful shocks with its taser-like claws. As a last resort, it can detonate, firing spiked shrapnel everywhere, though this leaves it exhausted.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME lies motionless on the sea floor, releasing pulses of electricity that attract small marine creatures. If disturbed, it discharges a powerful surge before drifting away with the current.
author: .izik

entry: The Pokémon inside has unlocked the full potential of its shell, bursting at the seams to ambush the next unsuspecting Trainer looking to loot it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME creates compacted orbs of stardust and flings them downward like meteorites crackling with electricity. The sparkly rocks left behind after they land and fizzle out are a popular accessory in some regions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's voice is shrill and often causes sharp feedback when singing into its microphone. If it feels listeners don't appreciate its voice, it's prone to exploding in an angry huff.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to curl up to hide in such a way that they resemble a Poké Ball. They are also able to manipulate their innate electrical energy into extremely elaborate patterns as a means of both intimidation and communication.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME lay still in the sun and during thunderstorms in order to bask in as much energy as possible. Any excess energy they absorb is released through channeling explosive power.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It sings for hours without stopping, enjoying its melodic rituals. If interrupted mid-verse, it throws a tantrum that often results in an explosive reaction.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rely on echolocation to navigate their surroundings because they are blind. They avoid bumping into other Pokémon because a sudden shock can cause them to explode.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are notably mischievous and considered a pest, as they destroy and use wires to build their nest. When threatened, they deliver a painful shock.
author: mepp.

entry: Groups of POKENAME inhabit abandoned quarries, where they consume unmonitored dynamite. This dangerous habit adds to their volatile reputation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an extremely irritable glacier-dwelling species. Any slightest trigger is just cause for POKENAME to breathe cold lightning from its mouth, freezing and frying anything in its path.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is an extremely irritable glacier-dwelling species. Any slightest trigger is just cause for POKENAME to breathe cold lightning from its mouth, freezing and frying anything in its path.
author: beatdoof

entry: Although its body can't explode, POKENAME's round pom-poms tend to blow up mid-performance. POKENAME doesn't seem to mind, though, and continues on with its performance using a spare set of less explosive pom-poms.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME has an internal lock-on system that targets Wailord, its primary prey. When POKENAME locks onto a Wailord, it propels itself violently and explodes on impact.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are vicious and cruel fighters that will not show mercy to any foe or prey, no matter how small or weak they may be. It is rare to ever see a scarless one, for they will throw their all into every battle no matter the self-harm endured.
author: infinex21

entry: During the daytime, POKENAME absorbs solar energy, storing it in its flowers. After sunset, it releases the energy in the form of fireworks.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME produces a viscous goo that acts as an electrical conductor. Once launched by POKENAME, the goo conducts electricity across an opponent's entire body.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME's metal exterior contracts when it is about to release a powerful explosion. Unfortunately, being close enough to see this means you will be unable to escape the blast radius in time.
author: bacondlx

entry: This Pokémon can channel electrical currents into its fists. The bigger the smile, the more electricity is stored.
author: lgreat

entry: The Premier Ball-like growths on POKENAME's head are fragile and tend to explode on the lightest touch, spraying a dense cloud of spores into the air. These spores conduct electricity, causing major short-circuits on the machinery they land on.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME will scatter its sand around itself, then camouflage itself as a sandcastle knocked over by an Electrode. When an unsuspecting victim steps on the sand, POKENAME causes the grains of sand to explode, then drains its prey of their vitality.
author: darkweavile428

entry: This Pokémon is believed to have gone extinct long ago. Its defense mechanism of exploding into a frigid blizzard seems to be the reason why.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It goads any of its foes into attacking it, willingly enduring even the harshest of strikes. Every strike absorbed helps it to generate more electricity until it can counterattack with an explosively powerful headbutt.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME seems to take an odd joy in using self destruct moves. It has been known to explode and reappear miraculously unharmed.
author: dylonk25

entry: When POKENAME uses its psychic powers and detects something approaching in the vicinity, it buries itself in the sand, with only the Poké Ball-shaped protuberance hanging out. Those who approach it out of curiosity are shocked with explosive energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The mushroom on its body resembles a Poké Ball. When startled, it releases a cloud of spores that cause mild electrical burns upon contact.
author: .izik

entry: The different types of scales of POKENAME discharge a different amount of electricity, with the Master Ball-looking scales giving the greatest zap. Many people have been obliterated trying to harvest these scales from its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses the large amount of energy stored in its wand to summon massive explosions. It will blow up anything it can find with terrifying glee.
author: mistymagius

entry: Within its shell broils electricity and flame in equal measure. POKENAME are extremely easy to agitate, and they will release their energy from their shells like an explosive eruption to scare off would-be threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love nothing more than exploding violently. The unique sound of their detonation has led some to refer to this fusion as “Pumpkaboom”.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME drifts through power plants, watching silently from the ceiling. If approached, each segment explodes in a brilliant flash.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will prowl the streets at night during a new moon, searching for people to drag into the afterlife. Street lamps have an eerie knack of blinking out as POKENAME passes by, as it drains their electricity.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: During the new moon, POKENAME will wander the streets emitting a discordant screeching static noise from its lower head and eerie singing from its upper head. The sounds are thought to be from spirits in the afterlife.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Overexertion while digging causes POKENAME to destabilize and explode. It must carefully manage its activity to avoid this destructive outcome.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME run in direct lines to build up electricity, gaining momentum as their voltage rises. If they want to turn, they release bursts of electricity into the ground, launching forward and curling their bodies in mid-air to turn before they land.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It loves attention, but POKENAME worries the natural buildup of static electricity from petting will electrocute its Trainer one day.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Before fighting, it charges as much electricity as possible into its gloves to perform electric techniques capable of paralyzing its opponents. If POKENAME overcharges, it literally risks exploding, so it must always be very careful.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It swings its tail in a counter-clockwise motion to generate electricity. It often explodes as a diversion while an ally steals from unsuspecting prey.
author: .izik

entry: The acid within POKENAME's body is extremely unstable. If shaken too much, it can trigger powerful explosions that spray acid in all directions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME experiences headaches when it builds up too much electrical energy, causing it to experience mood swings. The stronger the electrical charge, the more intense the emotional outbursts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are temperamental and chase both Pokémon and people away from their nests with loud yelps and frantic gestures. They are prone to exploding if they grow too agitated.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Due to the high explosive potential of POKENAME, some of the excess energy from its dynamite-like core is expelled as sparks of electricity. POKENAME can be kept from detonating through feeding it copious Sitrus Berries and giving it head scratches.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are temperamental and chase both Pokémon and people away from their nests with loud yelps and frantic gestures. They are prone to exploding if they grow too agitated.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly energetic creature, and its body can absorb electricity to strengthen its muscles. It uses its tail to propel itself from tree branches, allowing it to make longer jumps to reach its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its whiskers gather static from the atmosphere and weaponize it as electricity. POKENAME is a poor swimmer, but can roll and flop surprisingly fast on land.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are prone to literal explosive fits of rage that last until they tire themselves out or completely knock themselves out. Keeping them fed with electricity seems to keep them calm more than anything else.
author: infinex21

entry: When facing a powerful opponent, its tail emits crackling sparks. POKENAME flies at incredible speeds thanks to electricity flowing through its wide wings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The orb it charges with electricity resembles a discarded Poké Ball. It hurls the orb at enemies after charging it over an extended period to shock them.
author: .izik

entry: It psychically carries three orbs charged with electricity, lobbing them at enemies during battle. These orbs explode in dazzling sparks upon impact.
author: .izik

entry: To impress onlookers, its body charges with electricity before lifting heavy objects. If overexerted, it will explode.
author: .izik

entry: Fusion has granted POKENAME an appearance that seems similar to a mascot in Galar. POKENAME are very enthusiastic about Poké Balls, often startling Trainers when they appear suddenly to give expensive Poké Balls to them for free.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are employed at power plants, acting as backup generators. They enjoy showing off to visitors and will play with electricity between their four hands to hear praise from those watching.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME can be helpful friends for electricians so long as they are not mishandled. If they are treated too harshly, they explode and short circuit anything they are connected to.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can produce a powerful explosion when their fuse is lit. Once the fuse reaches the end, a deafening explosion launches whatever is in their stomach out of their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it explodes, it takes several days to recharge its body. Many underground tunnels and caverns are attributed to its detonation habits.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is charged with searing electrical currents that enhance its performance while galloping. It's extremely competitive, to the point that if it spots a sports car or a racing motorcycle, it will immediately give chase to prove its superiority.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Filled with a continuous rage, the feeble mind of a Slowbro was suppressed by the vigour of Electrode. As such, it continually bursts out in a fit of electrical rage because it has no urge to move, while simultaneously having a need to fight.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: If the Shellder on POKENAME's tail draws too much electricity, the Pokémon becomes unstable and may erupt violently. It is said that the Shellder's poison helps regulate this energy, preventing a total detonation.
author: soup1900

entry: The Shellder must continuously bite down on POKENAME's tail to prevent it from exploding. If it ever stops, POKENAME instantly explodes, and the Shellder will be blown off its tail.
author: soup1900

entry: Its body blinks with a red light if it absorbs too much energy. If the flashing light turns yellow, it is ready to explode.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is self-sufficient, feeding off the electric energy it produces. If it outputs too much, it is prone to explosion.
author: leonian1586

entry: The central head of POKENAME contains all of the electricity in its body, as well as all the aggression. This leaves the other two heads very wary of setting it off in any way.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are employed by demolition crews to aid in destroying old ships. POKENAME ferry bombs across the ocean and into the abandoned vessel, eliminating the risk of human injury.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: When POKENAME consumes many dreams from sleeping Pokémon, energy swells within its body. The expansion causes POKENAME to float away on the wind, but if it still continues to consume dreams, the energy will explode from its body.
author: .realthree

entry: Their pincers resemble Poké Balls. It's theorized that it uses them to draw in surfing Trainers and Pokémon to shock them.
author: manandesz

entry: POKENAME hold a giant seed on their back. After some time, the seed will fall off, and a Bulbator will grow from it.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This Pokémon is rather unusual, as it looks like just a bundle of eggs. What it lacks in appearance, it makes up for with teamwork. Many Poké Marts mistake it for eggs and put it in a carton.
author: firetypestarters_23572

entry: POKENAME wears a thick eggshell over its head for protection. The bone it carries is coated with a sticky yolk-like fluid that POKENAME can sometimes be seen sucking on to comfort itself when nervous.
author: sk372

entry: What looks like a tongue is actually part of the amorphous insides of POKENAME. It can grow, shrink, and reshape this appendage for a variety of purposes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found hiding in trash cans to mask the scent of eggs. They long for the day when their dreams of evolution come to fruition.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The giant egg yolk can be removed from its back to use in cooking. However, POKENAME dies if this is done more than five times.
author: holgast

entry: The egg in its pouch is sentient, controlling the main body using psychic energies. This symbiotic relationship gives it a unique blend of intelligence and power.
author: .izik

entry: Though it resembles an egg, its body is more akin to a seed. When wet, tiny twigs sprout from its surface, hinting at its plant-like nature.
author: .izik

entry: It coats its blades in sticky yellow sap before striking. The sap slows down its opponent, giving it a significant advantage in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Each segment of its body communicates telepathically to execute intricate jujitsu moves. This coordination allows it to overwhelm multiple foes at once.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is a single giant, flexible eggshell. The shell is stronger if POKENAME is in good health.
author: holgast

entry: This Pokémon is a master of mimicry. Its skin is see-through, and POKENAME's innards resemble eggs, salad, and other healthy foods. Unfortunately, this causes predators to attack it more often, sometimes even fooling humans.
author: _pixelar_

entry: A yolk-like ooze surrounds the egg-shaped core of the body. Whenever it morphs, this core is always faintly visible somewhere in its transformed form.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roll around cyberspace searching for images and videos of nests. Once they find a suitable file, they embed themselves into the file to keep their fragile bodies warm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found lurking in images or videos of nests to keep their bodies warm. Any damage on their egg remains until they evolve, so Trainers are advised to leave them in the image or video until they are ready to hatch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The semi-aquatic hatchling of an Exeggutops. The underside of its eggshell carapace and claws are coated in a yolk-like antimicrobial gel that protects it from dehydration and many water-borne illnesses.
author: deltag0n

entry: POKENAME is the neotenic or axolotl-like state of the Exeggutops line. Having stunted its development by choice or through a nutrient-poor environment, it has grown a stronger shell and developed keen eyesight to hunt in the dark sea.
author: deltag0n

entry: POKENAME struggles to fly, but that doesn't deter it. It'll keep up its sunny-side mindset no matter what.
author: ohok3441

entry: By using its psychic abilities it can create illusions of clothing that it sees on humans in an attempt to mimic their fashion. This is primarily seen with POKENAME that live in research facilities.
author: .izik

entry: The sap leaking from its head is harvested to create sleep aids. This supplement is ancient in origin and has been prized for its soothing effects.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME smacks others with its yolk-like leaf when it's in a bad mood. The sticky residue left behind is difficult to remove, and the pungent smell that lingers is even more so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to be very confident. Their spend their energy running around and climbing furniture, making them a challenge to take care of.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME solidify streams of a clear fluid that contains the nutrients of their bodies to fling and redirect themselves through the air. The yellow cores that slide along their tails act as balances and stabilizers to secure their landings.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The base of its body chips away as it flies. Should it ever break entirely, a large amount of sour-smelling fluid will pour out.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates and electrifies a yolk-like fluid from its body as a form of self-defense. If the fluid is extracted and then added to a beverage, the drink will glow in the dark, with no adverse effects otherwise.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys bullying other baby Pokémon. Its favorite prank involves throwing food at someone instead of eating its breakfast.
author: novellavaria

entry: A colossal fried egg with bunny ears, POKENAME's golden surface glimmers, blending seamlessly into sunlit waters.
author: anarchaz

entry: If spotted in the forest, it becomes enraged and chases intruders. Using psychic powers, it tears down trees to block their escape routes.
author: .izik

entry: A strange yellow sap leaks from its seed-like body containing pheromones that attract nearby Pokémon. This sap helps it form symbiotic relationships.
author: .izik

entry: The seeds on either side of its head inflate, allowing it to rise gently into the air. This buoyant movement helps it avoid ground-based threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a sticky, messy nuisance of a creature. It dips the palm at the end of its tail in the yolk of its skull before smearing and flinging the sticky, odorous substance all over anything it can reach.
author: sk372

entry: The fluid that drips out of its bulb is high in nitrogen and potassium. Knowing this, wheat farmers in Kanto frequently employ POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: The segments of its body hover with a millimeter of space between them, held together by telekinesis. This formation gives it unmatched aerial agility.
author: .izik

entry: When sleeping, it covers itself in a slippery yellow sap. This coating makes it difficult for predators to grab hold of it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are dull-minded creatures that often get into trouble. Whether it is being stuck on a cliff or stuck in some river rapid, they almost always find a way to endanger themselves. Despite their reckless nature, they are beloved by many.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are soaked in an eggy substance that clings to their leaves. Despite being exposed to the air for long periods of time, the cracked egg atop their backs always remains fresh.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shell of this Pokémon is surprisingly sturdy and thick. The resin that oozes from its shell gives it extra protection from impacts.
author: caladria

entry: Newborn POKENAME do not have any natural defenses available, so their parents will feed them berries endemic to an area to help them grow faster. One such berry is the Maragna Berry, which makes their shell slightly tougher and harder to chew.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses psychic power to amplify the strength of its horn, launching enemies high into the air with ease. This makes it a formidable opponent.
author: .izik

entry: Being cracked open seems to relieve a lot of stress from a cluster of Exeggcute, as it has a happy interior. It is supposedly delicious.
author: token08

entry: Although POKENAME appears to have only one egg-yolk-esque head, additional "yolks" live within its hard shell.  They bicker each morning about who shall serve as today's primary head.
author: empty_set

entry: The yellow liquid frequently leaking from the crack on its head is highly nutritious but has a foul taste. It is often avoided despite its benefits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is made up of six component sections inside a central chamber, rotating rapidly while forcefully expelling water to propel itself at extreme speeds.
author: joeofthealps

entry: It collects seeds from the forest floor and delivers them as presents to farmers when spring begins. This habit has earned it a reputation as a helpful Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: It awkwardly gallops through the deeper portions of the forest while making an odd cry. It seems to trip over its own legs on a regular basis.
author: .izik

entry: The eggs it produces serve as its own special paint for creating murals. If it runs out of its current batch, it can use the fluid inside its head, though this causes visible discomfort.
author: sk372

entry: An POKENAME will act as the leader and protector for Exeggute while they prepare for Evolution. However, it is very fragile itself.
author: serversizeme

entry: The only way for POKENAME to release the electricity inside its body is through cracks in its shell. To have an POKENAME with no cracks at all is an impressive status symbol in the culinary community.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME has difficulty controlling its time-travel abilities now that its head has cracked. The face on its belly worries incessantly.
author: .realthree

entry: It eats until its body cracks open, spilling any undigested food from inside its stomach. Fortunately, it heals quickly, allowing it to resume feasting.
author: .izik

entry: A renowned restaurant in Eterna City uses this Pokémon's spicy vines to make a signature carbonara dish. The flavor is both unique and highly sought after.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are high in protein and low in fat, making them the perfect candidate for a light Torchic Rice over Omelet. Their abundance in the wild along with farms raising them for consumption means that POKENAME will remain a popular breakfast staple.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Yellow sap oozes from its body, constricting as it dries. It remains near ponds to stay hydrated and prevent the sap from hardening.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically nest together with several other POKENAME until they evolve. They prefer a diet of grass and flowers and tend to avoid conflict.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The nectar leaking from its body blinds foes who are attempting to see it while camouflaged. This clever defense ensures it remains unseen.
author: .izik

entry: The minds of the six seeds, constantly drifting, fusing and eating each other, lay within the stone. The yolk-faces are just a projection of them suspended in a mass of white, constantly falling off and regenerating, and are also quite tasty.
author: epping_forest

entry: A yellow fluid leaks from the ears of an POKENAME. This substance is regularly used in the creation of Gooey Mulch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME place their egg-like mouths in other Pokémon's nests as traps, attempting to eat any Pokémon that tries to steal them. Despite this, they are friendly to the parents and newly hatched babies.
author: mistymagius

entry: It constantly creates more yolk-like fluid within, offering it to others to sample. Those that drink it develop faint psychic powers for a few hours afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appear before Trainers to warn them that one of their eggs is damaged or otherwise needs help. They guide Trainers to a Pokémon Center to get their egg examined and prevent an otherwise unfortunate event.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Seeds planted within POKENAME's body will grow up healthy in short order, nurtured by the liquids inside. The plants can even bear fruit, though the fruit will contain a distinctly egg-like aftertaste.
author: sk372

entry: Seeds planted within POKENAME's body will grow up healthy in short order, nurtured by the liquids inside. The plants can even bear fruit, though the fruit will contain a distinctly egg-like aftertaste.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often made fun of by other Torterra fusions for having an egg head. But POKENAME is just happy that all its six heads are in one piece.
author: funkytomate

entry: Tiny roots grow from its feet and burrow into soil when it remains stationary. These roots absorb moisture to nourish its body.
author: .izik

entry: The largest part of POKENAME's moustache acts as a nest to protect its siblings. Its magnetic field keeps them from being separated.
author: melodydelune

entry: Biologists are perplexed as to why POKENAME tortures its kin. The most popular theory is that it is stunting their growth to prevent usurpation.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The egg and sword are separate entities with a telepathic bond. They attract and rejoin each other after being separated.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The yellow venom that leaks from its horn induces uncontrollable rage in anyone exposed. The effects last for up to eight hours before subsiding.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often mistaken for a tasty meal, using the resemblance to draw in other Pokémon before unleashing a dangerous Barrage. POKENAME hunt for Leaf Stones deep in caves, in an attempt to evolve and change their delicious appearance.
author: npshi

entry: Its siblings bud off the main body of POKENAME. The yolk it produces feeds its siblings until they are able to split off onto their own.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are constantly leaking fluid. While it is dangerous for most living beings to come in contact with, it destroys harmful bacteria and unnatural substances.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME gifts colorful sweet eggs to others, making it especially popular with young children and Pokémon. It often leaves these gifts in secret so as not to be overwhelmed by eager youngsters craving sweets.
author: sk372

entry: Its helmet-like head sizzles in the sunlight due to the oils it secretes. The thick fluid on the tip of its tail is splashed around to distract attackers.
author: .izik

entry: It brings ivy and other foliage while flying back to its home and weaves nests that resemble egg cartons. This behavior helps it create a safe and soft living environment.
author: .izik

entry: It absorbs moonlight into the yolk-like substance coating its hands and wings. This energy enhances its psychic capabilities during the night.
author: .izik

entry: The yolk-looking substance that oozes from POKENAME's body tastes like tree resin. While each one only consist of one unit, an POKENAME tend to live together with others of their kind in the wild, perhaps due to their Exeggcute DNA.
author: bobosmith01

entry: With strong suction capabilities, it attempts to latch onto the feet of swimmers. It creates a hand from its gelatinous insides, refusing to let go as it looks to hitch a ride.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides its small body inside eggshells. It uses this disguise to blend in with clutches of eggs, letting parents tend to it and keep it warm as if it were their own.
author: santon5512

entry: It slashes in circular patterns to intimidate prey and keep predators away. If it senses danger near its nest, it refuses to leave.
author: .izik

entry: It lays its tail in water to absorb liquid, using it to grow stronger and harden its shell. This habit helps it thrive in wetlands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eggs seem tempting to eat, but are very spicy. The eggs are well-seasoned with spices and salts.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME collect eggs laid by other Pokémon and decorate them using berry paste and other organic materials. It is not known why they do this, but this habit is thought to have been the inspiration for a certain spring holiday.
author: chibitales

entry: The gelatinous fluid surrounding POKENAME has an incredibly sweet taste, making it highly sought after by bakers. It is often used in cakes and pastries, adding a unique sugary flavor.
author: .izik

entry: Its yolk-like body jiggles while it launches psychic attacks. A single thought is powerful enough to crush a car.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are unable to float and instead roll about, seeking to gather with others of their species. They are drawn to use their strength in numbers to protect one another from threats, unleashing powerful Fairy-type attacks in unison.
author: vic1312

entry: The liquid seeping from its mouth is a viscous poison that contains many nutrients. This liquid can be boiled to remove the toxins and has a taste reminiscent of eggs. As it ages, the poison becomes deadlier and the toxins become harder to remove.
author: infinex21

entry: The barbs on its body are not solid but a gelatinous yolk-scented material. These have been used in baking due to their unusual properties.
author: .izik

entry: Each of the eggs on POKENAME can specialise many times within its life. What is currently its head will one day become its arm or leg, with POKENAME rotating its entire body. Researchers have yet to determine how this advanced science works.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The shell on its head is actually part of its skull, providing extra protection. It reads the minds of anyone who ventures too close to its nest.
author: .izik

entry: The fluid that seeps from their mouths is a viscous poison that can become acidic as they grow nearer to their evolution. POKENAME tend to live in flocks of six and care for each other greatly.
author: infinex21

entry: The yellow ooze leaking from its shell is incredibly acidic, capable of burning through iron in mere minutes. This substance is dangerous and unpredictable.
author: .izik

entry: Its carapace consists of fast-healing, plant-like shells, while its core body is a slimy yellow substance. This dual composition makes it both durable and adaptive.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME protect their fragile bodies by partially burying their bodies beneath the ground. If their shell cracks, their bodies produce a foul sulfuric smell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sway their internal sense of rhythm and are overall laidback creatures. Even when their shell is damaged, they always find time to continue their soft and slow dance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have the distinct scent of rotten eggs. They dig through garbage cans to dig up eggshells that they crush into tiny pieces before eating.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It condenses its gelatinous body to hide within hollowed-out logs, adapting the color of its outer shell to resemble an extension of the log. The true body slithers away when startled.
author: .izik

entry: The fluid leaking from its mouth has an intensely sweet scent, luring children and prey closer. Once near, it strikes with Stun Spore.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's armor is made of reinforced egg shells coated in a protective layer that gives it a somewhat reflective appearance. Its true body is made up of the yolk contained within.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME may seem cuddly at first, but they inevitably leak out egg whites from their bodies when they get hurt. This often scares children and causes many parents to abandon POKENAME or never adopt one at all.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The thin shell covering its skin cracks if it dries out, forcing it to stay near desert oases. This behavior helps it survive in arid climates.
author: .izik
