entry: All six sections of its body are linked by a translucent line of psychic energy. Small yellow mushrooms grow in areas where it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: The frills on POKENAME's head emit a yolk-like liquid that creates a uniquely yellow, shimmering aura behind it when it runs. While intriguing to view, most don't care for the egg-like scent it also carries.
author: sk372

entry: Its skin flakes off like delicate eggshells. These pieces are highly fertile and sought after by botanists for improving soil.
author: .izik

entry: The mushroom on its back oozes a mustard-colored liquid that contains toxic spores. Cooking out the spores of this liquid creates a popular condiment used for breakfast sandwiches.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is hollow, with a nectar-like slime inside that controls its movements. This unique composition makes it eerily unsettling.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME travels, it keeps its seeds safe inside its carton-like shell. As it can only feed a small number at once, it will shed these seeds which will eventually become new POKENAME.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The six faces on its body allow it to be aware of its surroundings at all times. The yolk-like substance it secretes from its head is said to grant a person a glimpse into the spirit realm when consumed.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME can be shaken vigorously to make them produce a light custard. While this has yet to be proven, many POKENAME end up hurt when their Trainer shakes and drops them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It splashes a poisonous yellow fluid from its wings while flying. Victims often black out, with some claiming to lose control of their bodies afterward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incorporated into recipes around the world, as they are one of the few ways to obtain eggs without hurting Pokémon. They are incorporated into the dough of sweet desserts like Liechi Berry Pie, Salac Berry Cake, and Watmel Berry Cookies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces secretions of custard that diners use to sweeten drinks. The milky, light flavor pairs well with coffee, as well as some tea pairings, making them a versatile partner in the kitchen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Some theorize that Ludicolo's festive nature has been ingrained in its very DNA and causes quirks in fusions' appearance; for instance, POKENAME can come in bright and flamboyant colors. POKENAME can be very social but they dislike physical touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME generates heat when moving at high speeds. This cooks their innards, which in turn strengthens their psychic energy.
author: ohok3441

entry: In battle, POKENAME sheds their shell to increase their power and speed to defeat an opponent. If their fragile core is popped, they will flee and hide until their shell regrows.
author: ohok3441

entry: Many chefs keep an POKENAME by their sides. It can easily predict if a meal is missing heat or flavor.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME releases psychic waves while digging in circular paths. These waves can compel weak-minded creatures to bring food or plant seeds nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME store some of the nutrients from their food in the yellow seed it carries inside its mouth to later feed its offspring with. The seed is protected by a toxic slime that young POKENAME are immune to.
author: milchik

entry: Although POKENAME resemble a freshly cracked egg, their slimy bodies are poisonous and unsafe to eat. They are rumored to speed up the production of Pokémon Eggs, so Pokémon Breeders often keep them around.
author: chibitales

entry: A hatchling who is a bit shy. The Pokémon within refuses to hatch fully, and its shell works as armor of sorts.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME is known to argue with itself, as each head is capable of independent thought. This leads to it getting many headaches, as it is easily overwhelmed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The swirling substance around POKENAME's head smells strongly of egg yolk. When it's burnt by a Fire move in battle, the resulting scent is even more delicious.
author: hophoppip

entry: The slime covering POKENAME's body looks and tastes just like raw eggs. However, if salted, POKENAME would shrivel up and die.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME gets along well with and often adopts Exeggcute clutches it comes across. Its soft fur and warm body keep the group healthy and even seem to make them stronger over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bacon is so tempting to eat that some Trainers actually bite their Pokémon. This usually results in a Flamethrower to their face.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It uses psychic power to trick opponents into believing they are starving. This illusion leaves them vulnerable and distracted.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates egg-like growths which it'll pull off of its body. Using its four arms, it will cook delicious dishes with these growths, which have become a delicacy in several regions.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Young POKENAME don't have limbs, but if its shell is cracks, it uses the viscous liquid inside itself to walk around. Its yellow seeds lure bug Pokémon with a rich scent, and gets them trapped in the sticky liquid and absorbed for nutrients.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Resembling an egg with yolk spilling from it, its arms are actually made out of a hardened sap manipulated internally by roots that mimic a muscular system. It uses these arms to steadily climb up and down mountains.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The many growths on its head each house a separate brain. When angered, it uses telekinesis to fling objects at its foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME control the magnetic field around them, attaching various utensils to themselves for defense. If trained by a chef, these Pokémon can become very talented cooks.
author: santon5512

entry: It stares intently with all its eyes while using a psychic attack, disabling its foes through sheer focus. Its intimidating glare is enough to freeze enemies in place.
author: .izik

entry: Touching its sludge causes shell-like growths to form on one's body within three days. These growths take about a month to fully subside.
author: .izik

entry: Using its multiple brains, it can invade and consume several dreams simultaneously. The speed of consumption depends on the victim's intelligence.
author: .izik

entry: Its pendulum is sentient, controlling the trajectory of the goo dripping from its shell. Contact with this goo induces terrifying visions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys throwing its egg at targets. Sometimes its oversized pincer breaks the egg, causing it to have literal and figurative egg on its face.
author: hellaluyeah

entry: The coconut on POKENAME's back produces very soothing coconut milk. It can put Pokémon to sleep with just one sip.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's 7 heads all coordinate together to create a 360 field of view, but they hate working together, making them ineffective in battle. But only the most caring Trainers can unlock their power by teaching them to coordinate together.
author: duskit___

entry: POKENAME's heads often argue over decisions. It resolves this by striking its spring-loaded gloves with its mounted heads together, forcing them to agree before attacking.
author: shyguy11011

entry: When startled, POKENAME will throw one of the baby Exeggcute in its pouches at the aggressor. The Exeggcute love being thrown around, even if it is dangerous for them.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME are loved for their laid-back attitude towards performance and entertainment, regularly seen in some famous comedy shows on TV. POKENAME do not take kindly to mistreatment, though, being known to snap when they recognize exploitation.
author: jangodiot

entry: As it absorbs more sunlight, POKENAME's secondary heads grow, often leading to back pain. For this reason, it prefers the shade.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME have strong, albeit short, legs that help hold up their hard, spiky leaves which they often flail about to batter foes. Their mouths appear small at first but can frighteningly open wider to allow them to spit Seed Bombs and Bullet Seeds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will compete within their herds. They charge at each other until their heads fall off. These heads regrow in a day with proper sunlight.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: A variety of different berries grows periodically on POKENAME's fronds. If it starts only growing a specific type of berry, it is a sign that POKENAME is close to evolving.
author: sk372

entry: A sprouting seedling or hatchling that has moved ashore to mature after finding sufficient nutrients and sunlight. From this point onward in its development, it can perform a vegetative reproduction by detaching its smaller 'propagule' POKENAME.
author: deltag0n

entry: Frequently found stalking beaches, POKENAME is capable of vegetative cloning through the Exegguto it relies on for sight. If no Exegguto are left to allow it to see and hunt, it buries its lower body to photosynthesize until one regrows.
author: deltag0n

entry: The center-most head is the one in control of its movements. The leaves on its arms can expand to become vast wings to carry its heavy body.
author: infinex21

entry: One head is always awake and eating while the other two heads are asleep. Though they will eat berries and fruits, they can live off sunlight and water alone but simply choose not to.
author: infinex21

entry: Immature leaves on POKENAME's body have a very strong odor that many Pokémon dislike, acting as a natural Repel. Scientists are now looking to add these leaves to existing Repel recipes to strengthen them.
author: chibitales

entry: They spit explosively-flammable seeds at their opponents and will sometimes even throw their side-heads as well. Their side-heads have no brains and regrow quickly.
author: infinex21

entry: It is unknown if the face on the thorax is sentient, however, it has become a subject of debate after one scholar swore the face winked at him.
author: dusknoir64

entry: People who easily get sunburnt often rely on a sturdy POKENAME to give them shade. Because POKENAME tend to space out, they are less likely to wander far, ensuring that shade is close by for their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce scales that smell like cinnamon and are harvested for culinary arts. Each of the heads also drool a sugary sap that bakers collect to produce a glaze over baked goods.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have roots that are covered with tough scales and quickly absorb moisture. Whenever they are dug out of the ground, they have a limited amount of time before both their heads and the base of their bodies explode.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a shell that resembles the fruit of a coconut tree and protects them from the sharp beaks and talons of bird Pokémon. They often hide among other coconuts, which ends up startling Trainers who pick them up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME never lets go of the heads it carries with it. Because this keeps its claws always occupied, the heads compensate by using psychic powers to stun prey and make it easier to hunt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives near the equator, where it can get plenty of sun. The more sunlight it receives, the longer its horn will grow. Rarely, the horn may spawn fruit or flowers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Often spotted around restaurants or bakeries, POKENAME absorbs scrapped eggshells as nutrients for the heads on its back. It takes great care to feed each head equally, as they will become agitated if underfed.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME set up an ambush by hiding among Exeggutor. Their brass-colored wings make the camouflage easy, so they have an easy time surprising their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It grows coconut heads and shoots them out like a bazooka. It can easily fire individually or in spurts.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME territories mostly consist of beaches around populated areas. They are not inherently harmful, but will straighten their trunks to mimic palm trees in hopes of not being spotted when tourists invade their home.
author: chibitales

entry: Each head of POKENAME can process different calculations and strategies, allowing them to create a variety of Special moves at once. It has been documented that some POKENAME use installed software to duplicate the effect of the Berries they hold.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME is a friendly and happy-go-lucky creature that runs up and kisses any new acquaintance it sees. Its kisses leave behind marks that carry the scent and taste of coconut.
author: sk372

entry: Plant milk generates within POKENAME's mostly-hollow body, which will voluntarily leak from its udders when POKENAME is ready. This fluid lacks lactose and is high in vitamins, so those allergic to dairy products may purchase POKENAME milk instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They are found in the warm waters off of tropical islands, hiding in coral reefs. They are widely hunted for their ink, which tastes similar to coconut milk and is used in many Alolan recipes.
author: joeofthealps

entry: They stomp around with enough force to cause localized tremors while hurling around Egg Bombs. Their stomps often turn even hard rock into fertile dirt, so most learn to live with their tantrums.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME makes its home in tropical areas, particularly near coconut groves. It protects the coconut trees fiercely, breathing out three plumes of rainbow fire to burn anyone who threatens them.
author: sk372

entry: The bottom head is considerably less intelligent than the top one. This is because the top head bounces on it all the time.
author: themicelegion

entry: One POKENAME's tail fruits can feed an entire colony of Aipom, earning that colony's protection in the process. However, POKENAME must also defend its tails from hungry bird Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: Found on the shores of frozen over lakes, POKENAME stands out harshly against the wintry environment. It attracts Bug types that over-winter, wraps them in vines and devours them. However, they are completely docile to lost Trainers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its three heads share a complex mental network that allows it to quickly calculate its actions before doing them. It stomps most smaller foes with its massive, heavy feet and deflects most attacks with its hard, coconut-like shell.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME thrives in tropical areas, where it mingles alongside Exeggutor. Its serious attitude often gets it appointed as the leader of the groups, keeping the rest in line and out of trouble.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can only be found in the deepest areas of lush forests. It is said to be related to the Pokémon Rillaboom in the Galar region.
author: theartemis1

entry: Its saliva has the same consistency as Coconut Milk, which it uses to feed its offspring. If there are no babies to feed, the saliva collects inside its mouth until it drools.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love playing catch with children, and they will often use their own bodies to launch their heads across fields. Once its head is found, POKENAME will reward the kids with large berries.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its tail is the only limb that can be severed and regenerate on its own. The bulbous fruit attached to its tail has the same consistency as jack fruit and has a consistency similar to shredded meat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While in flight, POKENAME can extend its neck to an incredible length to strike its heads against an opponent and catch them off guard. The leaves growing on its body can produce a healthy oil known to reduce cholesterol levels in humans.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The head on its tail grows in hot, humid climates. When they drop the head, it will go on to become an Exeggveon.
author: melodydelune

entry: The large, round object at the end of POKENAME's tail is actually a head that grew far too large to become an Exeggcute. It can launch this head from its tail, performing a powerful Egg Bomb that shakes the world upon impact.
author: soup1900

entry: On every night of a full moon, POKENAME will gather to stare longingly towards the sky. Eggs remind them of the moon; gifting an POKENAME an egg is the easiest way to earn one's friendship.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME are most active on the nights of a full moon under a clear night sky. They prefer to be far away from noisy, urban environments. If uncomfortable, its many heads take on a disgruntled expression.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The leaves that make up POKENAME's mass of hair are as soft as fluffy cotton. They maintain this beautiful set of hair by diving into lakes to thoroughly wash themselves before drying their leafy locks in a soft breeze.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can rarely be seen floating near ancient jungle temples, guarding the resting places of fallen leaders. Should a descendant of those leaders approach, it somehow senses this and instinctively offers them any nearby food or drink.
author: .izik

entry: An POKENAME's stretchy legs allow it to avoid most predators within the jungles they live in. They feed on the various fruits that grow in the tops of the tropical trees they walk and hide amongst.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME fires the spikes from the tops of its heads, it also uncorks the egg yolk that fills them. It uses this spraying egg yolk to plaster spikes it has fired so that they keep poking and injuring the foe long after the battle.
author: soup1900

entry: The heads on POKENAME's tail communicate telepathically; in battle, this ability allows them to focus on multiple targets while conversing. There was a tale of a Trainer and POKENAME having a bond so strong that they acted and moved as one unit.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME often dig up ore for sustenance and leave berries in their place, as a reminder of where they have looked. POKENAME often charge recklessly towards anything excavating ore, which leaves them very dizzy afterwards.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME form their dens in beach sand right at the edge of where the tide comes in. They lie in wait until high tide, letting the ocean pull in their prey for them and using their psychic powers to draw in anything out of reach into their mouths.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The leafy fronds on POKENAME's back will grow coconuts over time, relative to the gears' rotation. It takes a few hundred rotations to fully grow a single coconut that immediately falls off so a new one can grow in its place.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is making its nest, it breathes fire out of its many heads to create bedding. While it is sleeping, it releases an aroma that induces drowsiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live among the branches of trees that grow juicy tropical fruits. Once a fruit ripens enough, a small swarm of POKENAME leap onto it, sinking their fangs into it and draining its juices until it's completely dry.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stab their spikes into palm trees, hiding themselves among coconuts. Due to their habit of falling off while asleep, they pose a serious hazard to those walking below.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME can grow so large, if exposed to sunlight, that their wings struggle to carry them. They have become nocturnal as a result.
author: infinex21

entry: Although POKENAME may hide in caves for protection, it matures and grows more powerful in sunlight. Its body smells distinctly like coconut.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flies only during the solar noon, otherwise it prefers to lazily lay on the shores. Smelling like a freshly cut coconut, those around it will find themselves feeling relaxed and calm from the ambient, soothing tune coming from its big ears.
author: beatdoof

entry: The head on POKENAME's back only thinks of safety, while the head on the front of the body only thinks of food. The front head sometimes tries to dissolve the back head for food when really hungry, which is why the back head grows no leaves.
author: soup1900

entry: The three heads of POKENAME each have a sense of smell that's slightly different from the other two. This enables them to triangulate the location of other POKENAME by sensing even minute traces of pollen in the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Heads of Exeggutor that fall into the ocean may become this Pokémon. They scuttle about the shoreline, looking for other stray heads to join it.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME is in a good mood as long as the sun is shining. It lays on the sand to capture as much sunlight as possible.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is usually active and roaming around tropical areas during the dead of night. The fronds on its neck and head emanate a colorful aurora that carries the faint smell of tropical fruits.
author: sk372

entry: Parasect's body has outwardly become very dried out in this Fusion, but its consciousness still remains inside of POKENAME. It is surprisingly kind and mellow. Its brain, filled with fungi, is in the middle of its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a special shell around their body that is made of the same material as coconut shells. When threatened, they strike with the many leafy quills on their head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME defend the jungles they live in at all costs, as they have an indomitable will and attack with precise focus. POKENAME are known to spar with Kommo-o to hone their skills. POKENAME were originally discovered on Alolan Islands.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The lively volcano on its back provides energy and fertile soil for its trunk to grow extra-long. Lumberjacks attempting to harvest wood from POKENAME are met with a nasty Lava Plume from its back.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The fruit that it produces has a tropical cherimoya flavor, but it only produces one fruit a day. It is rare to find one in the wild because Team Rocket has begun monopolizing the market of this rare fruit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends most of its days riding the waves or soaking in the sun. Its head may grow too large and fall off, but it will regrow.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME spends its whole life on the first beach it sees. It defends this beach and its friends viciously.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's body regularly grows large and fresh coconuts, with at least one falling from the tree a day. It happily shares fresh juice from the one upon its head, and is particularly drawn to festivities where it can enjoy both company and music.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME burns shrubs and bushes to create bedding for itself. It hypnotizes scientists and other intruders when disturbed by lulling them to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME ages, its body may grow significantly taller. Rare reports describe individuals reaching the height of a palm tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sips coconut milk to keep its energy up as it trains and fights. Some mixologists use POKENAME as an assistant.
author: hophoppip

entry: Whenever POKENAME utters its cry, the bulb on the tip of its tail will mimic it. No matter how often this happens, POKENAME will always seem surprised and confused by the echo.
author: sk372

entry: The leaves atop the heads of POKENAME are connected to their brains. Whenever anyone damages one of their leaves, the pain causes them to release headache-inducing psychic waves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to knock down coconuts from palm trees and crush them within the claws' jaws. The eyes on the claws glow whenever it uses some of its psychic abilities.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stands tall like a living tree, its green mane glowing under the sun. It is revered as a guardian of the jungle, graceful yet fierce, and once bonded to a Trainer, its loyalty is unwavering.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME shoots flames from its many heads as it flies above a jungle forest. It is rarely seen outside of the jungle because it is sensitive to cold and damp conditions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Parts of POKENAME's body have cracked slightly due to the strength of some of its muscles. It fights very carefully, doing its best to avoid letting an opponent strike at these weak spots.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tend to be jolly creatures that enjoy shaking their maracas to the tune of festive music. Their sheer elation over a simple task inspires many to play music when they are nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its roots have grown into legs strong enough to propel it across vast distances. One growth on it s back bends upwards to carry its young.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: After spending a week of fishing for Shellder, POKENAME enjoys resting beneath the shade of its own palm leaves during the weekend. During this period of rest, POKENAME invites others to take shade and drink coconuts, providing a sense of community.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Parts of this Pokémon resemble duck meat, coconut water, egg yolk and onion. Hunters say this Pokémon alone can make a whole meal, firewood included.
author: naga_sake

entry: An POKENAME's three long necks often become entangled, leading them to fall over until they untangle themselves. Their tails appear to have a fourth head upon them to trick others while they sleep, blending in with the jungle trees they live among.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoy juggling each of their disembodied heads and balance them when they need to remain still. To the surprise of many scientists, they spend more time on land than in water, perhaps because juggling in water is difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Grown from the ground, POKENAME tends to laze about, waiting for prey to come near before chowing down. The heads on the side keep watch at night.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME carries a bone in the center of its bulb. It has a strong attachment to the bone; attempts to touch it result in a vine extending from the bulb and using it like a club to beat up the nuisance.
author: sk372

entry: The "bones" that are oft seen sticking out from their bulbs are actually closer to twigs that are incredibly rich with calcium. The more well-nourished they, and their bulbs, are, the more of these "bones" they can produce in a day.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.
author: mistymagius

entry: If it explodes, it sends sharp bone shards flying in all directions. These fragments serve as both a weapon and a warning to potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hide is vulnerable, so it uses skulls it finds as makeshift armor for protection. Using some of its electric energy, it lifts and flings other discarded bones as projectiles for added defenses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resting upside and showing its soft underbelly is a trap to fool predators. Once they come near expecting an easy meal, they are blown away by the explosive force it generates all at once.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skulls glow in shifting patterns that reflect its emotions. These blinking signals have been studied by botanists for decades.
author: .izik

entry: Fashioning tougher bone clubs to dual-wield and a more solid skull, POKENAME has a strong-willed personality, leaving sorrow behind. It gathers other Cubone in groups to guide them and help them grow stronger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries around a Marowak skull, which it cries quietly to almost every night. It's said that the Marowak's spirit visits POKENAME in its dreams, whispering words of comfort and encouragement.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their lithe bodies to dodge attacks during a Pokémon battle. Once they are in close range, they bludgeon their opponents with a bony club.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fashioned a helmet of bone to protect its head, and bone gauntlets for its fists. It has to regularly replace the gauntlets as they fall apart from constant punching.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces small but thick clouds of toxins from four segments of its body. These clouds cause intense coughing fits and eye irritations, leaving the eyes bloodshot and full of tears.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are clad in a calcium-rich shell as hard as dense bone. They tend to hide within or near piles of bones left behind by predators.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME conceal themselves within the bones of long dead Pokémon to protect themselves while they wait to evolve. They have very limited movement whilst hiding, almost entirely reliant on choosing a sturdy bone cocoon to stay safe.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Interlocking plates of bone and stone give POKENAME's body a highly resilient frame. It's fearful of others, and will charge right through solid stone in a panic to run away.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME disguise themselves as patches of desert grass to lure other Pokémon near them. They often wear the skulls of their prey when they have fed well enough and use other bones to strike their opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME finds the bones of a dead child, it instinctively puts the bones in its pouch and carries them around. Until it finds a good burial spot to lay these bones, it cries endlessly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME wander the world looking for boney carcasses of baby Pokémon. They collect bones until they have enough to make a proper burial, before repeating the process again with another skeleton.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The power of fusion has caused the baby POKENAME to hibernate in its bone shell. The mother fears it may never wake up.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME fires bubbles from its skull with enough force to damage ship hulls. It prefers to dwell within sunken freighters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME create nests of bones that they decorate in such a way that resembles coral. Whenever another Pokémon tries to take their bones, a sharp jab of their horn scares the would-be thief away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear a boney skeleton to cushion bites from other Pokémon. When teeth of a predator inevitably get caught in their boney armor, they strike with their sharp horn to repel the threat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use thin silk threads to attach bones to their cocoon to reinforce their bodies, protecting themselves from physical harm. They have to be careful to avoid hiding in groups in case they attract scavengers looking for food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME flutters around in search of flower gardens to rest and feed from. If it comes across dead flowers during its travels, it lands among the plants and cries over the loss.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is prone to occasional fits of sullen behavior and wishing not to be disturbed. It produces barriers to box itself off from the outside world until it's ready to socialize again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swings its lumbering arms around to generate stronger electricity. Once it's churned up enough energy, it directs it through the bone it carries, letting it more accurately pinpoint the target it wants to zap.
author: sk372

entry: Its bones contain trace amounts of copper. During a thunderstorm, it will stand on tall mountains and hold its club into the sky, attempting to channel lightning.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Lost travelers within caves have occasionally been assisted by wild POKENAME. Igniting the bone it carries and using it as a makeshift torch, it illuminates the area and guides the visitors towards the exit.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's pincers are made of solid bone and have quite the grip strength. It clicks them together rapidly as a warning to others to stay away if they wish not to get crushed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a bitter and combative nature, easily sent into an angry tantrum. Its hard skull makes charges painful, and those who resist that will be struck by the bones held by its three tails.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wears the skulls of strong Pokémon to intimidate predators. If these bony masks are ever knocked away from its face, it quickly swims away in fear.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME wears the skulls of other Pokémon to protect its soft body. If these bony masks are ever knocked away from its face, it quickly swims away in fear.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's bony facial plating protects it from predators. Its weak muscles and fragile fins impede its swimming capabilities.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's bony facial plating protects it from attacks. The appearance of torn fins and black eyes often fool predators into thinking it's already dead.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses thread spilled from its mouth as a tether to swing the bone it carries around. It clubs small Pokémon unconscious, then leaps onto them to deliver a venomous sting with its tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lashes out constantly, and almost exclusively targets traveling families and friend groups. It's thought that it does this due to a constant sense of loneliness leading to intense jealous anger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was once a rare sight in the water, and retreated often due to fear of humans. In recent times, more are seen being adopted by Lapras colonies, and the species is growing more sociable as a result.
author: sk372

entry: It's thought that POKENAME gathers up the bones of other creatures in order to better mimic them. Because of this, however, its transformations usually end up with a few extra bones sticking out of its new form.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very loyal as a pet, but gets lonesome easily. Owners should be prepared to spend a long while cuddling its fluffy body after being separated for only a small span of time.
author: sk372

entry: A swift swimmer with a gentle heart, POKENAME mostly keeps to itself away from people. However, it is quick to rescue humans it sees in trouble at sea, vanishing back into the water once it's sure they're safe.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME has a solitary nature, it never hesitates to rush to the aid of Cubone when a Mandibuzz hunts them down. It uses the skull on its head to store as much electric energy as possible, which it then unleashes to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although POKENAME has a solitary nature, it never hesitates to rush to the aid of Cubone when a Mandibuzz hunts them down. It uses the bones on its back to store as much electric energy as possible, which it then unleashes to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME collect and hide bones in their fluffy fur. Their cries sound similar to a sobbing child, giving rise to legends of haunted volcanic ranges.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is used to monitor certain programs in the virtual world, preventing deadlocks that could cause crashes and malfunctions within software. Due to its gentle nature and strong ethic, it is highly sought after by major digital companies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives inside the vestige of what once was a Cubone. It hides within the skull to protect itself from danger and quivers in fear whenever a predator is nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hides its body within a skull for protection, using its many tentacles to move and hunt prey. Many deep-sea divers have been startled by the sight of the skull scuttling across the seafloor.
author: sk372

entry: Before cocooning itself, POKENAME gathers a few bones. When something gets too close, it shoots out a bone from gaps in its cocoon to bash away the intruder and keep its fragile body safe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use a sticky silk to attach bones to their bodies in an effort to protect themselves from danger. Some POKENAME take the camouflage a step further, their cocoon  taking on a bleached white hue.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME scuttle around near archeological digs hoping to find a bigger skull to move into. When one finds a sufficiently large skull to move into, they start a chain reaction where other POKENAME also upgrade their skulls.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was a scavenger, avoiding direct conflict with other creatures. It trailed behind hunting Kabutops, eating bones and whatever else remained once the former had moved on.
author: sk372

entry: The skull it carries is a tragic keepsake it cannot even wear properly. Its large size and appetite is theorized to be the result of using food as a coping mechanism for its sadness.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME manipulates wind currents to swirl ice-cold dirt around its body. On contact, the frozen debris can immobilize foes.
author: .izik

entry: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME carries the bones of long-departed members of its species within its wings. Some theorize it has a practical benefit for increasing its electrical prowess, while others think the reason is more spiritual.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found in the most inhospitable deserts, circling over any life it sees. While it is usually viewed as an omen of death, it is actually trying to use its shadow to usher the lost creature below it towards safety.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's skull sparkles with many colors after emerging from water. Some legends claim fragments of it can retain mystical energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is usually timid despite its size, but won't stand to see others picking on those smaller than it. Some have been spotted tending to and guarding areas where many Dragon-type Pokémon have passed on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME strikes rapidly and aggressively with its bony limbs. Highly territorial, it seems most likely to reside in areas where destroyed and desecrated Beedrill hives are present.
author: sk372

entry: Some theorize POKENAME is one of the last discarded failed attempts at creating Mewtwo, that managed to cling to life after being rejected. It has a cold, emotionless personality, except in battle, where it releases its boundless rage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very kindhearted, teleporting across the land to bring lonely Pokémon to others who seek companionship. Doing so makes it feel more at peace with its own sense of loneliness.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sprouts a fresh leaf from the bone on its head each spring. In the wild, this leaf naturally falls away by midwinter.
author: .izik

entry: The many leaves on POKENAME's neck grow around a ring of bones. They have a bitter taste and a bitter scent; those who smell or taste them exhibit slight signs of depression afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was originally thought to be a sentient mass of vines inhabiting the bones of another creature. Further research discovered the vines amass around the most fragile parts of POKENAME's bare body as protective covering.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flame capacity is weak, so it can usually only manage to blow smoke from its back to ward off others. When it cries, it emits copious amounts of smoke that smell more acrid.
author: sk372

entry: The flames that shoot up from POKENAME's body glow with an eerie color. It's thought by some that the skull it wears gives it a connection to the afterlife, altering its fire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often seen in the throes of sorrow, crying softly to itself as smoke billows lightly from its back. Its flames are rather weak, only seen when it can push past its sadness and focus on a battle its partaking in.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps the bones left behind from meals to use as tools in battle. Between meals and fights it gnaws on the bone club to keep its teeth maintained as well as to stave off boredom.
author: sk372

entry: The skull Cudile wore appears to have grown even further on evolution. POKENAME continues to collect natural trinkets such as teeth and skulls. If bored, POKENAME bangs on the ground with its bone.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In arid places where materials are scarce, POKENAME crafts a nest out of bones. It struggles to make friends, but deeply cherishes the ones it has.
author: leshii

entry: Researchers are unsure if the bones POKENAME dons are part of its skeleton. Few have gotten close enough to check, let alone report their findings.
author: rihse

entry: POKENAME grows exceptionally soft fur beneath its skull. Some tailors carefully collect it to weave warm, lightweight scarves.
author: .izik

entry: They are solitary and independent Pokémon that make their nests below ground. Many of their feathers have a thin but hard white protective layer over them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME gently taps flowers with its bone while flying, scattering pollen into the air. It playfully snaps up the drifting particles before they reach the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the bones it carries as a way of communicating with other forest denizens. Rapping the bones loudly and repeatedly against a tree trunk serves as a warning that predators are on the move.
author: sk372

entry: When at rest, POKENAME tucks its legs into the skull shell and clings to trees. The eerie image of several POKENAME skulls covering tree trunks has become a popular sight in horror media.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ties webbing to the bone it carries before throwing it, letting it cast threads long distances and increase the size and speed of the webs it makes. It's also effective at knocking out prey once they're ensnared.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scrapes the bony edges of its wings across cave walls to make an unnerving screech to frighten prey. It attacks from above by descending rapidly and striking with a solid headbutt using its solid skull.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wears the skull of a treasured friend, but is outgrowing it. It flies alone, keeping watch and protecting Pokémon within its territory.
author: leshii

entry: Holding bones with its antennae allows POKENAME to make the items glow. It uses the illumination to draw in smaller creatures, before smashing them on both sides with its glowing clubs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the organ on its head to illuminate the deep sea and help it navigate darker areas. Due to the front bulb looking like a glowing skull, it has startled many deep-sea divers caught unawares.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries a bone with it to help it better channel its electric power. Without a bone to focus electricity through, its body would spark at random and risk hurting those close to it.
author: sk372

entry: Its skull is stained with tears due to how easily swayed its emotions are; it notably cries when it accidentally discharges its electricity. When happy, it will use its small bone to drum upon its own skull.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's mood fluctuates depending on the amount of stars in the sky. A night sky filled with lights has it acting joyful, while a sky devoid of any visible stars causes it to sob uncontrollably.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoy babbling into their boney club to practice singing. When night falls, they curl up with the bone still in their arms and fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its own eggshell as armor, keeping as much on it as possible and refusing to remove it. It's very afraid of most of the outside world, instinctively striking with its bone club at anything unfamiliar.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME responds very poorly to conflict. It can barely defend itself even with a bone club, and spends most of the time pleading and crying for combatants to simply stop fighting one another.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries a stern and somewhat morose expression because it frequently experiences feelings of impending doom. It enjoys spending time with its Trainer, even if it's just a walk in the park or a trip to the forest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Imbuing bones with psychic energy, POKENAME uses them to draw symbols in the ground. The shapes it makes have yet to be deciphered, but are believed to have some import related to the future.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels alongside flocks of Mareep in the wild. It generates little electricity on its own, so it rubs against other members of the group to absorb some of their energy and store it within its wool.
author: sk372

entry: Beautiful feathers spill from the cracks of POKENAME's skull helmet. It can spot a predator from miles away, dispensing swift justice without a sound.
author: leshii

entry: As POKENAME wields its bone club, it slowly charges it up with electricity from its body. After enough time, it can make the bone glow with the same level of brightness as its tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gather in small groups to choreograph their dances together. The one who carries the biggest bone is the conductor, directing the movements of the rest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoy collecting bones and storing them in their dens. When they fall asleep, they curl their tail around one of the bones to help themselves fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's buoyant body allows it to easily stay afloat as it swims around in solitary lake areas. It takes great care of the bone club it carries, cleaning it vigorously every day.
author: sk372

entry: A greedy little Pokémon that steals anything it gets, POKENAME will even steal away the bones of others of its kind, for no other reason than it can.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides under a skull when it digs into the dirt to protect itself while it photosynthesizes. It vibrates rapidly to churn up and throw dirt around when predators draw close.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME finds the strongest stick it can to wield as a weapon in battle. After absorbing enough sunlight during the day, the skull it wears starts to emit a warm glow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's quick flying skills let it stay out of danger, fleeing the moment it feels threatened. It perches high up tall tree trunks, tapping out a pattern with its many bony limbs to warn other POKENAME of nearby dangers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to play jazz xylophones. They stand with their back to it, using their bone tail as a mallet, yet many query how they can play without seeing. They excrete a very fine gel onto each key, that their tail can detect.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers let it easily wield bones as flying clubs in battle. It has a gentle heart, often drawn to those who feel lonely so it can help lessen that isolation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mood is highly dependent on the phases of the moon. When it is full, POKENAME is at peace, but the more it wanes, the more sorrowful it behaves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an innate sense for finding bones buried under the ground. Some police forces have used it to locate missing remains, but discipline is needed to keep POKENAME from stealing its findings for itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skull-like headpiece is actually a thick, pale leaf. Its thickness increases depending on how many flowers it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body moves uncontrollably in the air when it hears the beat of drums. This phenomenon often attracts curious onlookers as its sudden dancing soothes its own negative emotions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses a strange power to levitate a bone to use and vengefully lash out at those it comes across. Gazing too long at POKENAME's skull will send visions of lost loved ones searing into a person's mind.
author: sk372

entry: For centuries, POKENAME has been a symbol of loss. The origin of this association is unknown, but theories suspect that since it feeds on strong emotions, it has often been observed near houses with recent deaths.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's skull was once used by Channelers in ancient rituals. They claimed it granted brief psychic visions during ceremonies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's carapace is made of super-strong bone marrow. From the hollow spines in its side, it fires sharpened projectiles made of bones at high speeds, piercing through anything that bothers it.
author: sk372

entry: During winter, POKENAME sleep inside caves until the temperature begins to rise. Sometimes a layer of ice seals them in the cave, so they smash through the ice with their gargantuan tusks, ramming against the ice until it shatters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's exterior bones grow stronger as it burrows through calcite-rich mountains. The vast tunnels it leaves behind are often explored by spelunkers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME take the vestige of what was another Pokémon and wear the remains to protect themselves. They sharpen the bones they find to fling at predators, scaring them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME loses the ability to fully retract its head into its shell once it acquires a suitably sized skull. The POKENAME then seems perpetually distressed by this new limitation, but will fight off any attempt to free its head from its skull.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: The bone horn on POKENAME's head is not a part of its head but rather attached to the bone skull that covers it. This means it can be detached from its body, leaving it defenseless against any predators.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME prefer fighting in numbers when hunting to overwhelm larger prey. Their hooked claws allow them to scale ice-covered slopes with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME seems to always be on the hunt for honey, only pausing to rest. If it goes a week without tasting its favorite food, it will start weeping. Its cry is comparable to a grieving soul.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its body is made of incredibly hot sand. POKENAME uses the bones on its body to break and grind down rocks to sand for consumption.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME turns the sand it crawls upon incandescent, as its body is far too hot to touch. When it grows irate, flames completely coat the skull it wears as a helmet.
author: fiordaliso

entry: To protect its sandy body, POKENAME collects the bones of other Pokémon in the desert to build a sturdy shell. It leads a nomadic life among the dunes, needing hot, arid climates to survive.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When angered, its sandy body ignites, reaching temperatures high enough to burn even the cacti it touches. POKENAME endlessly roams the desert seeking larger, more fearsome skulls to perfect its shell.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME coats its feathers in dirt to clean them, favoring dust baths. Water causes its plumage to clump, making flight difficult.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's strong sense of smell lets it sniff out tasty mushrooms buried beneath the soil. Racing towards them, it uses the upper fangs of the skull it wears to better dig through the dirt and reach the fungi.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's thick furry body and equally thick and sturdy skull make it easy to bowl over smaller Pokémon. It's not overly aggressive, but if hungry, it won't let anything stand between it and a potential meal it's sniffed out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's back has bony growths that resemble coral. It hangs around Corsola colonies in the ocean, using its similar shape to distract predators so the Corsola can safely escape.
author: sk372

entry: Half-skeletal in appearance, POKENAME has an aggressive personality to go along with its fierce looks. An eerie, shrill shriek emits from its mouth whenever it spits out water jets at others.
author: sk372

entry: In the wild, POKENAME cries out as if it is injured to attract other Pokémon. It then viciously attacks them with its sharp, bony talons.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME stick together in packs to stave off loneliness, becoming fiercely loyal with one another. Pack members offer up bones leftover from meals to the one they consider the pack leader.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME reaches adulthood, it releases a howl to alert its pack. Afterward, it leaves to live in deliberate solitude.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slithers through tombs and crypts, curling inside old coffins. If disturbed, it lashes out with its bone to defend its resting place.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps within the hulls of sunken freighters beneath the sea. When threatened, it flings its bone with enough force to create whirlpools that trap foes.
author: .izik

entry: A timid Pokémon that typically runs away at the first sign of danger. When scared, it curls up into a fetal position. To cheer one another up, POKENAME likes to perform tricks with the bone it carries around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's skull hardens the more it rolls across the land. Older individuals are known to possess exceptionally tough skulls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is effective at keeping computers organized, regularly cleaning out junk data and disposing of unused objects. It sometimes stares forlornly at the recycling bins within computers, as if in sorrow.
author: sk372

entry: Old rumors circulate that POKENAME is the remains of poached Stantler reanimated for the sake of vengeance. Its tendency to appear in places where Stantler poaching was high helps perpetuate these rumors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME decorates the skull it wears with splotches of paint from its tail. Each POKENAME carries its own unique personalized artistic decoration.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME are known to create training dummies out of bone to practice their technique. They have yet to decide on what to focus on, so they practice many types of fighting to keep themselves in shape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hunts for prey by swinging a thick, bony club with its tail. It bludgeons its prey with the club to render them unconscious. Once incapacitated, POKENAME swallows and digests its prey whole.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tries to make itself feel braver by lighting the bone it carries with its flame breath. Because breathing too much fire tires it out, it tries to keep its flaming club lit for as long as possible.
author: sk372

entry: The lonely POKENAME usually finds itself being adopted into Miltank herds. In exchange for the kindness, it becomes fiercely protective of the group, charging down perceived threats to whack them with the bone it carries.
author: sk372

entry: Wild Blissey will often adopt orphan Cubone, carrying them in its pouch, feeding them its eggs and raising them tenderly. The joy and love these newly-formed families feel is palpable.
author: sk372

entry: Aggressive sea storms located near cliff-side caverns are usually attributed to POKENAME. It's said the ocean responds to the Pokémon's intense frustration and feelings of loneliness and isolation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges up the bones it carries with lightning from its body, enough to make them glow brightly. It's often seen leading young Pichu around, defending them with deft use of its charged-up weapons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very solitary, aggressive Pokémon that lives deep in underground caverns. The bones of previous trespassers are strewn about its territory as a warning for travelers to delve no further.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fashions a helmet of bone not just for itself, but for its tail as well. When feeling lonely, it will talk to its tail, and make noises to pretend the tail is responding back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly tosses its bone back and forth while fighting, never holding it in one tail for long. If the bone is dropped, it panics and halts combat to retrieve it.
author: .izik

entry: It causes hallucinations in anyone who ventures too close to its swamp. These visions often lead intruders astray, ensuring its home remains undisturbed.
author: .izik

entry: Although POKENAME is a thief and a bit of a brute in combat, it has its own sense of honor. Fallen rivals have their bones gathered and buried by POKENAME as a sign of respect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is always very dry due to always crying out any moisture it gains. Any attempts to stop its excessive crying will end with a big smack from the bone atop its head.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are moody creatures that hide their true feelings behind the skull on their face so that they can continue to perform for others. If POKENAME show a Trainer how they truly feel, it is a sign of great trust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME supercharges the bone held by its tail with electricity, making it glow and crackle with lightning. It can fling the bone as a weapon, cracking through the air like a lightning strike.
author: sk372

entry: The bone clubs POKENAME wields will usually be larger in size and still carrying a sizable amount of meat on them. This makes it effective both as a bludgeoning tool and a portable snack.
author: sk372

entry: Despite initial appearance, POKENAME are skilled hunters who use the bones of their prey as weapons, tools, and for protection. They are often seen holding bone-skewered meat that they will feed on throughout the day.
author: infinex21

entry: A vicious solitary hunter, POKENAME is very skilled at using bones in combat. It keeps one end of the bone blunt while sharpening the other, so it can bludgeon or pierce to suit its needs.
author: sk372

entry: The many bones of its prey are entangled within its overgrown vines, offering protection and myriad makeshift weapons. Its vines are rich with calcium, making them popular with some people as a supplemental ingredient.
author: infinex21

entry: A shy Pokémon that was first discovered in the wild in eastern Kanto, POKENAME uses its skull for defense, as it is much stronger than its comparatively tender skin. It collects and sharpens objects it discovers to use as weapons or tools.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The beat of POKENAME's wings can produce shockwaves powerful enough to shatter bone. It drops bones it carries as a distraction to prey, swooping down on them from a completely different direction.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is deeply in-tune with nature, and cares greatly for the lives of plants. If it finds dying plants near it, it curls up next to them and cries in sorrow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skull becomes intensely cold during the summer months. This keeps its body at a steady 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's claws are encased in serrated bone. It uses them to tear apart tough cacti and other plants for sustenance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's skull and tusks are made of extremely solid bone. It could charge full-speed into a solid glacier of ice and not even chip a piece off of its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's glitchy behavior seems to be a byproduct of emotional instability in its programming. Its sorrow values spike at random, leading to fits of crying and hysterics.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their hefty bone club to wallop other Pokémon. Some POKENAME are clever enough to wrap a vine around their club to create a whip.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME skillfully uses collected bones to etch markings into trees in its territory. It's known to be a solitary Pokémon and is rarely seen.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME takes great care in looking over the plants in its region. It gently digs up the remains of dead plants, planting seeds it collects in the holes left behind so new life can grow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's boney wings are used for bashing opponents. They are not actually bones, they're just compact, white, bone-shaped stones.
author: themicelegion

entry: Multiple bones stick out of POKENAME's back, giving it ample defenses. Rolling allows it to bowl over most enemies with ease, and shed bone-spines can be picked up and used as extra weapons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME conceals its face with the bones of its deceased parent. The piercing cries it emits resonate within the skull, unsettling nearby Pokémon.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME bury themselves in swamps when they rest and hug their boney club to avoid losing it while sleeping. If anyone tries to take their club while they sleep, they awaken and strike with a groggy rage.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME watches travelers while submerged in the mud to appear as little more than discarded bones. If a trespasser starts causing trouble, it leaps from the muck to strike them down with its bony weapons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dig through their swampy homes to find bones. They shake the earth to pick up vibrations from bones that they dig up and collect on their backs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A solitary Pokémon, its mournful cries echo through the night. However, POKENAME have been seen comforting grieving Pokémon and even grieving Trainers, giving them charms of bone before disappearing again.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's dance moves are slow and graceful, with a melancholic edge. It is quite emotionally sensitive, and often seen crying quietly after it finishes a performance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses a psychic connection with the souls of deceased Marowak. It communes with them in the afterlife, attempting to grant their spirits some measure of peace, so they may rest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bone limbs are effective for bludgeoning, but not its most effective technique. It extends pointed bones from its elbows to use for stabbing and slicing particularly tough opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies in total silence, though it always appears to be crying. Some say gazing into the hole in its back will show visions of deceased loved ones, communicating with the viewer from beyond the veil.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prides itself on its immunity to many forms of attack against it and boldly challenges others. However, its hubris often overcomes it, causing it to forget that any foe that can hit it will usually defeat it in a single attack.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's forehead and back are clad in a skeletal armor meant to protect them from physical attacks. The skull-like armor on their heads reinforce their Headbutt attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can change its body color to match whatever it touches with its bone. The coloration persists until it becomes startled.
author: .izik

entry: Some believe POKENAME is the spirits of four deceased Cubone in a singular body. It stomps around on bony limbs, its eyes never opening even as it attacks others with psychic pulses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's teeth are very strong, due to its habit of gnawing on bones. It will reshape larger bones using its teeth until they are custom-fitted to its grip or the shape of its skull.
author: sk372

entry: Its main body only emerges from the skull when it experiences intense happiness or sadness. This fleeting appearance gives it an otherworldly presence.
author: .izik

entry: Tales exist that say POKENAME is an entire generations' worth of Cubone and Marowak spirits tied to the same skeleton. Despite the frightening appearance, POKENAME is surprisingly gentle and kind to those unafraid of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights vigorously in the name of protecting others. It creates small clubs in the shape of bones made from its own aura to wield deftly in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gnaws on bones as a leisure activity. Its powerful jaws regularly crush the bone it chews on, causing it to constantly be on the lookout for more to collect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can leap in and out of the desert sands as if it were water. It's a fierce hunter, cutting down prey with the sharpened bone bits at the edge of its limbs.
author: sk372

entry: On its back, it carries the bones of fallen family passed down through generations. A POKENAME's aroma evokes tender feelings of love and loss.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME uses its bone helmet and weaponry in defense of the Nidoran families it guards. A mild venom leaks from a hole in the tip of the skull, allowing it to poison particularly stubborn foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME burrow into the walls of caves to disguise as fossils, rattling the jaw of their false skull to scare off intruders.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hides itself among undersea rock formations, so it only appears to be a skull on the sea bottom. Unsuspecting prey that swims by is then grabbed by sticky tentacles, dragged down to be eaten.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skull emits a faint glow when deep beneath the sea. If a predator approaches, it fires Rock Blast before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: Its skull is so durable that it can break obsidian into fine powder. This strength makes it a fearsome opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Made of extremely thick and solid bone, POKENAME's cranium is resistant to nearly every sort of physical strike. Young members of the species will playfully bonk each other with bone clubs, barely feeling the impact of the strike.
author: sk372

entry: The skull it wears is so resilient it can deflect lightning bolts. This natural armor keeps it safe even during the fiercest storms.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely vicious, POKENAME gathers bones from successful hunts to use as weapons and armor. The bacteria of decay surrounding them acts as a deadly poison, and any scrape from around their nests needs to be treated immediately.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's skull vibrates rapidly just before terrible storms arrive. The eerie sound it produces serves as a warning to those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to live in gloomy places with significant cultural value, such as temples or graveyards. Whenever a visitor comes to these ancient places, they emerge to greet the visitor before returning to whatever they were doing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A gentle giant of the undersea world, POKENAME is usually seen swimming with a few Wailord bones in its mouth. It deposits them in a single den area, sleeping among the remains and crying softly to itself.
author: sk372

entry: An ancient Pokémon thought extinct for some time, POKENAME has been discovered living deep in deserts with few other Grass-types around. POKENAME has a hardy shell and skull to protect itself from the harsh weather of its environment.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: An unsettling aura emanates from POKENAME's shell, which takes on the appearance of a tombstone. Rumors say that if you spot a wild POKENAME staring at you quietly from the distance, your demise is nigh.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has been observed using the bone club it carries to start fires. When together in small groups, they dance and chant around the flame.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on rudimentary bone tools to survive in the wild by creating fire or making sharp weapons to hunt prey. Their mastery over boney crafts allows their Trainers to sell their crafts at markets around the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME's white horn often grows to cover some of the rest of its head like a second skull. They often fight among themselves using these long horns to see which of them is stronger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a strong intellect, able to use a bone as a club and tool in everyday life in the wild. It throws the club at intruders before beating its chest and screeching to try and scare them off.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very solitary Pokémon. They dig holes in the desert to fish in shifting sands. The skull they wear on their head is essentially used to protect them from the burning sun of the desert.
author: elevn.

entry: Magnets are embedded within its bones, giving them strange magnetic properties. This allows it to attract and manipulate metallic objects with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bones contain a magnetic ore that allows precise control during battle. This lets it strike opponents multiple times before they can recover.
author: .izik

entry: This bone dagger is said by old scholars to be made from the remains of a lonesome beast and haunted by its spirit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Appearing at first to be two swords stuck within a Cubone skull, POKENAME demonstrates its true skill in the heat of combat. Both blades release from their holder and strike with precision, while a faint glow emits from the skull's eye sockets.
author: sk372

entry: The ghostly wail of a Cubone is heard whenever POKENAME's skull-shield is struck, often unnerving opponents. This gives it the perfect opportunity to unsheathe its bone-blade and cut its foe down.
author: sk372

entry: The horn of a POKENAME is harder than solid rock and holds a potent toxin within. POKENAME will challenge others with all their might and mark their territories with the bones of their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: Some say POKENAME are inhabited by the spirits of soldiers who refuse to stop serving their leaders even after death. They dutifully serve their Trainer, using bones sharpened by the blades on their torso.
author: sk372

entry: It appears to have lost its bone and now wields a hastily carved wooden club as a substitute, which it is greatly proud of. However, the wooden sword is a weak weapon that often fails to do meaningful damage in combat.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME inhabits the darkest caverns, its eyes glowing as it perceives others through the dark with perfect clarity. It creates sparks with the bone on its tail as a warning before belting out lightning at intruders.
author: sk372

entry: It appears to be a reanimated Milotic skeleton buried beneath sand and old seaweed. It hunts by pretending to be simple scenery, before leaping out and attacking prey with the sharp ends of its bones.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies around mountain peaks, living a solitary lifestyle. It usually inhabits mountains that have a history of fallen Dragon types, and aggressively targets those who would invade and desecrate the area.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME casts illusions in forests to confuse travelers into getting lost. It appears before them to lead them towards the exit, desperately seeking praise from others even if it has to engineer false heroics to do so.
author: sk372

entry: No one has seen the true face of POKENAME. The skull it wears is theorized to be that of a pack member that passed on.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME uses the biggest and sturdiest bones from fallen creatures as a symbol of its might. It is very protective of younger Pokémon, showing no mercy to those who pick on them in its presence.
author: sk372

entry: Isolated at the bottom of the sea, POKENAME does not want anything else to intrude upon its solitude. Anything that approaches its home is sent all the way back to the ocean's surface via massive churned-up whirlpools.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create cataclysmic earthquakes that center around graveyards and cemeteries, causing bones to rattle with potent energy. Some people describe feeling chills throughout their body as though their bones were vibrating.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a small specimen that appears to be wearing the skull of an ancient deceased Rayquaza. It lands only for a short duration to gather food, disappearing into the ozone layer, fearful of contact with other beings.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that POKENAME would appear before certain humans and send them back in time. The stories all share a common theme of the time-traveler wanting to save a lost loved one.
author: sk372

entry: A single mythical roar from POKENAME can cause seemingly miraculous recovery from disease and injury as they turn back time. Despite their best efforts, they cannot revive those who have already passed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME waves its bone toward the moon during full moons. The slow, circular motions are believed to be part of an ancient ritual.
author: .izik

entry: Images of POKENAME wielding a bone scythe gave rise to rumors depicting it as a reaper of lonely souls. The bony parts of its body are extremely chilling to the touch, and coated with permafrost.
author: sk372

entry: A strange, ghastly sort of aroma emanates from POKENAME's flowers. Most Pokémon are repelled, but Ghost types are attracted to the scent, leading to exorcists using it to help forcefully expel ghosts haunting homes.
author: sk372

entry: In private, POKENAME likes to play with its bone, tossing it in the air and catching it like a baton as it leaps around. It gets extremely embarrassed if someone catches it doing this.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful leaps combined with its lengthy tail to strike opponents from afar. The spores its mushroom cap creates cause watery eyes in those afflicted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME controls the bones it carries with ghostly power, but makes it appear as if it's the other way around. It does this to look more frightening and more effectively scare small children.
author: sk372

entry: It has learned to possess mining equipment, using tools to extract valuable minerals. Its mechanical mischief often leaves miners baffled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bony features turn pitch black during a new moon. If it hurls its bone during this time, the impact can shatter solid stone.
author: .izik

entry: In order to improve its throwing accuracy, POKENAME will practice Bonemerang repeatedly for hours on end. The bones lodged in its hair are from past, failed attempts at catching them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Due to its terrifying appearance, people give it a wide berth, though POKENAME is kind-hearted. To change public perception, a Trainer wrote a children's book about a young POKENAME climbing things to use its superb eyesight to look for its mother.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its body resembles a gravestone, and it projects illusions to catch opponents off-guard. These eerie tricks give it an edge in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bone structure becomes superheated when it lingers near the recently departed. When this occurs, it releases a faint, waxy scent into the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is most often seen in the wild near graveyards. It seems to have a light connection to the spirit world, and some believe the pale flames its tails conjure are the spirits of deceased Pokémon made manifest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lies prone, waiting for a curious onlooker to approach. Once they're within range, it springs to life and rattles the bones it collects creepily before floating away.
author: sk372

entry: Wearing a disguise looking like Cubone and even wielding a bone similarly, POKENAME tries to make friends with the Pokémon. Some appreciate the effort, while others find it disconcerting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in the desert, hiding out in the skeletal remains of other Pokémon. By wrapping themselves around these bones, they can use them as a body, resembling walking corpses in the night.
author: santon5512

entry: At first it was thought that POKENAME's bony helmet obscured its vision before it was discovered it lacks eyes. Its strong sense of smell leads it to prey it knocks out with a single solid headbutt.
author: sk372

entry: No matter how much POKENAME fights with each other, their skulls won't ever fracture or break off. If a head does not get enough attention from its Trainer, it wails wildly until given attention or when the other head attacks it in annoyance.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME flies using rapid flaps of its bonelike wings. If disturbed during nighttime flight, it will retaliate with Bone Club.
author: .izik

entry: First discovered in the vicinity of Lavender Town, POKENAME is an elusive species that avoids human contact. Touching one of its tails is said to curse the perpetrator to be eternally lonely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME may time travel upon touching human bones, sometimes bringing nearby beings along. The journey lasts only minutes, often leaving witnesses brought along deeply confused.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are highly attuned to auras, including their own. They express themselves using their auras and by imbuing their bone clubs with their auras, they can ensure they strike their targets.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME strikes anyone possessing an aura with negative pulsations with its small bone clubs. It is afraid to venture alone into the night desert, so it appears among the dunes during daylight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Extremely slothful, POKENAME rarely moves even in its own self-defense. It is quite attached to its club, but even if it's stolen it won't muster up the energy to take it back, simply crying loudly in response.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has been seen pulling the bones out of its own body to use as weapons. It does this because its body grows new bones so quickly, the old ones would cause it extreme discomfort if not removed for too long.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grow up missing the warmth of their mothers, who leave them to survive alone. This hardship prepares them for dangerous sea life, ensuring their resilience.
author: krune

entry: It uses the bone club it always carries as a lightning rod to absorb the energy of thunderbolts during storms. It needs to live together with the rest of the pack because it is an extremely social creature; when left alone, it is consumed by despair.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sing into their boney club that vibrates and amplifies their voice. Whenever anyone falls asleep listening to their song, they chuck the club at the audience member to wake them up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The skull on its head is surprisingly brittle. If a portion breaks off, it will mourn the loss for multiple days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lays around dry areas, moving so little that small insects often flock to it. It pretends to be deceased as a way to avoid interacting with others; it is quite antisocial.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are desert scavengers that sustain themselves on the remains left by predators or the remains of unfortunate travelers. Their large mouths allow them to store bones for later, which they may also spit out at foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cover their faces with a skull helmet to make themselves seem mysterious. If another Pokémon tries to take off their helmet, they throw their boney club through the water to quell their curiosity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The Salamence skull POKENAME wears fills it with even more determination to one day fly. At the same time, it seems less inclined to leap off tall cliffs, fearful of breaking the helmet that inspires it so.
author: sk372

entry: Its hard bone helmet allows it to jump off cliffs when training to fly. Its brain has shrunk due to repeated attempts.
author: bandedbodypress
