entry: POKENAME was thought to be an undiscovered variant of Toedscool until further research was performed. Its leg-like tentacles are deceptively strong, and deliver a potent dose of poison with every kick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME exercises by rolling down a rocky hillside and then jogging its way all the way back to the top, over and over again. It could flip a small truck with just one kick.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can tuck its multiple feet into its body in order to roll down steep slopes. This also makes it adept at hiding limbs in combat until the right moment to launch surprise kicks at opponents.
author: sk372

entry: The screws at the bottom of POKENAME's body are much longer than they seem, able to extend far outward at high speed as an attack. Though small, these "kicks" carry enough power to send a Golem flying.
author: sk372

entry: Its feet can operate freely from the main body, allowing it to launch kicking attacks from long distances at any angle. They must return to it to recharge periodically, however, or risk falling out of the sky and becoming useless until retrieved.
author: sk372

entry: Above and especially beneath the waters, POKENAME delivers a strong kick with the swing of its tail. After winning a match, it claps its arms and feet together in celebration of victory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires disembodied feet from its cannons to assault foes with powerful kicks from a distance. A few minutes after being fired, the feet dissolve into water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known for their fierce fighting spirits and their incredibly flexible bodies. Despite not having any legs, being kicked by a POKENAME with full force can be extremely painful.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME can move their legs separately from their heads with great ease. They can easily phase through walls and fences but prefer to kick them down for fun.
author: entomoxie

entry: Its technique consists on grabbing the opponent with its claws while throwing a barrage of powerful kicks. POKENAME walks sideways, doing little jumps.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME no longer uses its legs to kick its opponents, but it loves posing as if it did. What it actually does is kick the ground to power up the blows of its heavy claw and perform wrestling shots thanks to its strong grip.
author: epping_forest

entry: Though POKENAME's round body and short limbs limit its mobility, it packs an incredible punch when it lands a hit. A single good punch from its fist carries enough explosive force to send the heaviest of Pokémon careening through the air.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its retractable and stretchy legs to maintain balance while ducking and weaving from an opponent's blows. They also allow it to take positions that let it punch from unorthodox angles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be able to defeat any foe in a single punch. It has a vigorous workout routine, ranging from pushups to running long distances.
author: gamelord64

entry: POKENAME's mastery of martial arts is beyond compare, so much that fights between individuals can last months. The outfit it wears is a symbol of its vanity due its accomplishments. It will protect its outfit by any means necessary.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonuna, which are better at punching. With each hit they take, they get closer to evolution.
author: cataylor_01

entry: This Pokémon will defend its baby with great might. Boxers will train with this Pokémon to hone their skills.
author: themicelegion

entry: When swimming through currents, POKENAME repeatedly fires punches to disturb the water flow and allow easy passage. Its main attack style is to jump several feet above opponents and volley dozens of punches downward in quick succession.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonpod, which are better at defending. With each hit they make, they get closer to evolution.
author: cataylor_01

entry: POKENAME features natural bulk and strength that would make sumo wrestlers jealous, but it prefers boxing. Being slower than Hitmonchan, it sometimes has trouble effectively training for the sport and gets frustrated.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a furious fighter, venting out its pent-up aggression through its fists. If a punch sends its foe flying off, it uses telekinesis to pull them back to it just so it can continue pummeling them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights defensively since its wings limit the range of its fists. It trains by hopping about, throwing punches at dust clouds that it kicks up.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wakes early in the morning to train and only tires late at night. Before falling asleep, it takes a small flight through the night sky. During this time, it gives off a glowing powder that, historically, has been consumed by bodybuilders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It strikes rapidly at its prey with rapid jabs from all six of its legs. One should watch out for its left hooks.
author: missingmilkman

entry: POKENAME remains in constant motion during combat by executing short hops while watching for an opening to strike. Its punches can knock holes in trees, a skill it uses to hunt for bugs.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Every punch that POKENAME throws is packed with electricity. However, it often uses up too much electricity and runs out of energy after only a few punches.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other to train their surprisingly powerful punches. They struggle to hit their opponents due to their short arms.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME primarily uses the gloves on its arms to block attacks due to their limited range. It more often uses the fist on its tail for offense, due to its reach and ability to spring-load a powerful sucker punch.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses the appendages on its head as arms. Though they have a short range, they can extend at incredible speeds, often knocking out opponents before they know what hit them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are ornery Pokémon, prone to picking fights in an effort to prove their own strength. They launch themselves at other Pokémon using the dense flower on their back as though it were a fist.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is a skilled, yet unfair fighter. If it finds that it is losing a match, it will bite its opponent and pummel them while they're restrained.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME are quite aggressive, often getting so worked up that they will punch anyone and anything to get to an enemy they see. Their punches are strong enough to crack through concrete in two hits.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME specializes in quick punching jabs to subdue opponents. If it cannot end a match with a punch, it may use a venomous barb to whittle down the opponent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a refined boxing ability unlike any other Pokémon. With its lithe body and battle-ready stance, its destructive fists can throw 50 punches in a flurry of untraceable speed.
author: violet_zero

entry: Battles involving POKENAME are known to be boring and drawn out. They awkwardly sway back and forth while analyzing a foe and prefer to end a battle with a single strike. Whether this is lazy or decisive behavior is hotly debated.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME is feisty and never gives up in a boxing match. Either POKENAME goes down, or the opponent goes down. POKENAME isn't above cheating, either.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Despite taking a serious beating, POKENAME never forfeits a match. Even on its last leg, it will push on and even cheat to win if it has to.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME has firm protective plating formed around the head, so that its skull is guarded against opponents and other POKENAME it trains with. Humanity may have taken inspiration from it when creating boxing safety gear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are adept in most forms of martial arts, but specialise in boxing. Their punches leave something to be desired in terms of sheer strength, though their skills improve rapidly with practice.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME often checks its reflection in calm waters, ensuring its appearance remains pristine as it trains its punches.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME help boxers train for their matches by allowing boxers to punch their body. The impact of each punch is spread over POKENAME's many scales, protecting them from major injuries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spar with one another to bolster both their physical bodies and their electrical powers. There are often lightning storms in the areas where POKENAME train.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME hone their strength by smashing their hefty tails into trees and rocks. They are deceptively strong, striking with enough force to dent a steel beam.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are so versatile, they can dodge attacks coming from their bare-knuckle rival, Honchmo-o, the fusion between Honchkrow and Kommo-o. With their punching gloves, POKENAME punch the ground to spring into the air, then land on their opponents.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME is often found watching boxing matches on television or from the ringside. It mimics the moves of the combatants, honing its punching skills to perfection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's limbs deliver powerful blows and have a long reach. It uses strong magnetism to quickly maneuver around opponents and strike from the best angles.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME can eat almost anything, it still must get proper nutrients to push its physical performance further. Therefore, although it may eat many odd things, what it chooses to eat is always done with careful consideration.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can short-circuit power generators with a single punch. Its entire body is overflowing with pure electricity and fighting spirit.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It can make small holes in the ground simply by punching it. It likes to bathe in the sand and will punch anyone who interrupts its baths.
author: ichosuzu

entry: It's thought that fusion has somehow caused POKENAME to be stuck between the real world and cyberspace. Its limbs undulate and swap around at random, and few can look at its glitchy form for long without developing headaches.
author: sk372

entry: A prime example of a dance-battler, POKENAME dodges a foe's strikes with ballerina-like grace, and returns with a punishing counter-punch without missing a step in its dance routine.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are lightweight creatures that can continue launching punches on their opponent without getting tired so long as they keep their guard up. If their guard fails, they very likely have lost the match.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roams the jungle camouflaged as it seeks strong opponents. Once POKENAME has found a worthy target, it jumps out from the bushes to reveal itself, ready to fight for as long as it sees necessary.
author: jangodiot

entry: Though it has good fighting spirit and decent offense, POKENAME has something of a glass jaw; even a single hit impacting its tooth will send it scurrying away, the will to fight completely gone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are ornery Pokémon, prone to picking fights in an effort to prove their own strength. They wield multiple fist-like flowers at the end of flexible vines, using them to lash out at anyone getting too close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its hair acts like a punching bag which POKENAME uses to train its punches for most of the day. If it is struggling in a fight, it will swing its hair wildly trying to knock away its opponent with extreme force.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's gloves contain powerful magnets, propelling them forward once they've locked onto a foe. POKENAME floats back and forth as it waits for its opponent to strike, magnetically repelling itself to dodge before delivering a devastating counter.
author: sk372

entry: It's thought to be the remains of armor once worn by a fearsome battle-monk, now possessed by their spirit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME floats around deftly in battle, dodging strikes and countering with strong punches. If desperate to win a fight, its fists can become blades, giving it more power and reach.
author: sk372

entry: Even though they can easily punch through sheet metal, they are just as easily discouraged. Whenever they need a boost, a Punching Glove helps remind them that they inspire people to grow stronger, and to never stop getting better every day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its lightning-fast punches are nearly impossible to see with the naked eye. Professional boxers will practice their guards with this Pokémon.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME loves getting into fist fights and is capable of winning against foes larger than itself. This Pokémon is adored by boxers for its one-hit Focus Punch that can instantly end fights. Each fight won instills great pride in itself.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's right glove has fast-acting poison and the left has slow-acting. By alternating its rapid strikes, it drags out the effect of both toxins, disorienting its opponents.
author: shyguy11011

entry: Despite their short arms, POKENAME's punches are capable of piercing concrete like a small meteor. These Pokémon like to train at night, away from prying eyes, to create new and almost fantastical techniques.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME speedily ejects a large fist from its mouth to batter those that were about to step on it. The force of its punches is powerful enough to launch foes flying far away into the sea.
author: soup1900

entry: A pugilistic pup with a penchant for punches, POKENAME powers up its aura through fisticuffs. In particularly intense training bouts or battles, its fists may even begin emitting aura with each swing.
author: sk372

entry: A common myth is that the first person to discover this fusion suffered a fatal blow to the head immediately on release. POKENAME are extremely aggressive if untrained and usually require their hands tied to prevent incidents.
author: jangodiot

entry: Despite its powerful fighting ability, POKENAME is often underestimated by larger Pokémon. After every victory, it chants its own battle cry.
author: thistleblower

entry: POKENAME is extremely self-conscious about its appearance. If it even thinks a person is looking down on it for its looks, it responds with extreme aggression and numerous fists to the face.
author: sk372

entry: Because their arm muscles are relatively weak, POKENAME prefer to attack with headbutts. The red organ atop their heads provides cushioning to protect their skulls from damage.
author: fancyskunk

entry: Though it still needs to improve its control over its flames, POKENAME is an excellent boxer. It is a tenacious and highly combative Pokémon; its fighting spirit makes it popular among battle enthusiasts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite being lightweight, POKENAME is incredibly strong and loves to spar with others. Because of its rubbery body, blunt-force impacts don't hurt it that much.
author: mistymagius

entry: It trains itself by flying above and striking others with its fist-feet. Because of its small stature, the strikes are viewed more as a considerable nuisance than actually painful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME never uses its fangs while hunting, only its fists. It fights prey one-on-one, and only deigns to sink its teeth and draw blood if it has knocked an opponent out in a straightforward bout.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an intense fighting spirit, swinging its fists wildly at foes. Unfortunately, its stubby arms and slow speed make pursuing opponents quite the task. The harder it tries, the more mucus it sweats out.
author: mochauspocus

entry: Its frozen fists chill the air around it, forming ice whenever it throws a punch. It is said that even the hottest of Fire-Type Pokémon will be frozen solid from getting hit by even a single jab.
author: sk372

entry: With rocket-powered fists, POKENAME mercilessly pummels those it perceives to be causing injustice. It enlists the help of a companion to reach its full potential.
author: coridiant

entry: Despite its plush appearance, a POKENAME's insides are dense and sandbag-like, capable of absorbing even the most devastating impacts without a hitch.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME's boxing style is unrefined, consisting of wild swinging of its arms until it hits something. It hydrates itself often before and after battle, to the point of excess, leaving it bloated and slower-moving for a time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's combat movements are light and limber, akin to dance moves. It incorporates many twirls into its fighting style and specializes in spinning backhanded punches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is peaceful by nature, only fighting when threatened. However, it is a fearsome foe if challenged, as it can propel its massive, rock-hard fists to supersonic speeds when throwing punches.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is a highly strategic fighter who seeks to find openings in its opponents' defenses in order to deliver powerful punches. Its body is covered in thick fur that releases poisonous spores whenever it is struck.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a fierce brawler that loves dueling to prove its punching prowess. When it's close to being knocked out, the flame on its tail burns brighter than ever as it unleashes its full strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME launches rapid punches from fists hidden underground. By focusing strikes on one point, it can pierce steel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME refuse to battle unless a trophy or some other shiny prize is at stake. They rely on swift swipes and agile movements to outmaneuver opponents.
author: santon5512

entry: Every punch swung by POKENAME is accompanied by its bellowing cry. Its voice is so strong that it's not uncommon for a punch to miss, only for the opponent to be damaged by the sound-waves of its deafening roar.
author: sk372

entry: With their large fists, POKENAME's blows can cause heavy damage if well-placed. POKENAME often fight each other in battles that are similar to boxing matches.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME has a strong affinity for fair combat in close quarters, and eagerly takes on any opponent in these conditions. However, it will become very frustrated if a foe attacks from a distance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are clever fighters that train with their feet submerged in water. This allows them to develop lightning-fast footwork to ensure their punches land with maximum effectiveness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Sweat builds up around POKENAME's body as it moves. With each jab, the moisture will boil around its fists until they burst outwards, scalding its opponents.
author: shyguy11011

entry: Whenever it sleeps, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to sense any hostility in the area. If an opponent tries to challenge POKENAME during its slumber, it will punch them before they get the chance, glaring at them before teleporting away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its four arms open up unprecedented striking opportunities, making it deadly in the ring and in battle. It strikes until it faints and not a moment sooner.
author: turbo_gerbil

entry: POKENAME love winning and have extremely fragile egos, so much so that they will intentionally seek out weak opponents to make sure they don't lose. If a POKENAME loses even once, it can give up fighting entirely.
author: bradlybro199

entry: The rock that a POKENAME is made of is much softer than a regular Geodude. In order to continue fighting and getting stronger without crumbling, POKENAME cover their hands with gloves.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME often taunts an opponent by beating its chest, daring a foe to take the first hit. Those that fall for the gambit find themselves hit by a punishing counter from POKENAME's four fists.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has mastered a unique style of defense and offense. It tucks itself into a sphere and rolls at high speeds, its stone body near impervious to damage, before it springs out with quick punches that send opponents flying.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a sturdy shell that allows them to soak up more hits but also slows down their punches. They practice against speed bags to help them improve their reflexes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though its punches are already potent, POKENAME excels in fighting Steel-type opponents. It shifts the polarity of its fists so they magnetize toward the target, increasing the speed and force it can punch metallic foes with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can fire two of its fist-like components outward as long-distance punching attacks. Attached magnets ensure they quickly return, ready to be launched again.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon moves forward by rapidly punching the ground. It does so with enough force to temporarily gain the ability of flight. Its little journey usually ends within a few seconds when it hits the floor face first.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME are constantly seen closed and at rest, their tough shell and sharp spikes deterring most predators. Those who attempt to forcefully pry open the shell will see it open suddenly to launch a devastating punch from within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's gloved fists can pass through solid objects, punching others from a completely different room. It picks fights with other Ghost Pokémon to see who's more worthy of haunting a location.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its powerful grip, POKENAME feels like it would be cheating to use it. Anyway, because of how weak their arms are, they end up using that strength to power up its punches.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME creates deafening shockwaves by snapping its powerful claws. By doing this they usually make their opponents faint without landing a single punch.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME release a sticky saliva from their tongue that is difficult to remove. One lick from a POKENAME can prevent gills from functioning properly, which makes them great aquatic hunters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its tongue is over twice its body length, so it mainly uses it to determine its surroundings. If any bird Pokémon tries to eat it, it will coat their wings in its sticky saliva, making it difficult for them to fly.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's awkward body forces it to hop on its tongue, causing pain that keeps it stationary. It sustains itself by licking Electric-Type Pokémon for energy.
author: matpal6

entry: Thanks to a hive mind, any flavor one egg's tongue comes across, the others will taste as well. Should one of the clutch find something particularly delicious, the entire group will swarm and lick it intensely from all sides.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides a long, thin tongue coiled within its skull. When unleashed, it can lash foes with enough force to break bone.
author: .izik

entry: Between the stone whip it carries and its thick tongue, POKENAME is never lacking a tool to bludgeon opponents. It's quite protective of smaller, younger Pokémon it resides near.
author: sk372

entry: If something piques its interest, it will charge towards it, intent on licking it thoroughly. It will bowl over anything unfortunate enough to get between it and its target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slams its tongue against cave walls to dislodge gravel. It consumes the stones to harden and reinforce its tough body.
author: .izik

entry: Before offering any of its nutritious eggs to others, POKENAME will thoroughly lick them to ensure they are clean. While meant as a gesture of goodwill, this often makes the exchange feel awkward for the other party.
author: sk372

entry: Like its vines, POKENAME's tongue will be replaced by a new one within 24 hours if severed. A severed tongue flops and wriggles for several seconds afterward, a sight many consider unnerving.
author: sk372

entry: With its huge tongue, POKENAME can gather up large amounts of food in a single motion, gathering it for its child. These large portions are necessary, as POKENAME young have a prodigious appetite.
author: sk372

entry: It gulps down pollen with its broad, sticky tongue. The pollen POKENAME eats is secreted through its wings and scattered while it flutters about.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The tongue-like organs on its arms let it poke and prod at things to determine if they are tasty or not. It favors areas where lots of tart-flavored berries grow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME entangles prey with its sticky tongue before finishing them off with a crushing grip from its brutal pincers.
author: .izik

entry: When it tastes something unpleasant, it flies into a blind rage. Each POKENAME has a different favorite food that will calm it down.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME live inside tree bark, creating large hollows to hide in while they wait to evolve. They have very few natural defences, their fat pink bodies making them prime targets for predators.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's transformative accuracy increases if it has licked the object it intends to mimic shortly before changing. Research suggests the lingering taste of what it licked helps it remember finer details.
author: sk372

entry: A bit of a prankster, POKENAME likes to hide among computer towers and wait. When someone goes to interact with the computer, it gives their hand a messy lick before hopping away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to copy data by licking discs and can transfer this data to other blank discs. POKENAME are often used in creating TMs, though POKENAME often enjoy eating the discs whole as a snack.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME's tongue wraps tightly around its body. When it is frightened or excited, the tongue hardens like stone and shields POKENAME from harm.
author: the_lunarian

entry: Its saliva is stickier than glue. If you see a wild POKENAME, run. If it is eating and you get caught by its tongue by accident, there is no escape.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME waves its tongue in the wind to predict the weather. If it senses an incoming storm, it will drive allies away from the area in order to protect them.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME have long tongues and small serrated teeth. They often accidentally bite their tongue when eating, especially when rushed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on their tongues to help them catch prey, as each tongue has microscopic hooks that cling to chitin and scales. After tiring out their prey, a few strikes of a Wing Attack secure their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As it is too heavy to fly, it instead catapaults itself many meters into the air off the ground using its strong and flexible lower body and steers with its wings.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME hold their long tongues above their heads like feathery crests. Many Pokémon flock to POKENAME for grooming sessions, as many Pokémon need help cleaning their shells or scales. In return, POKENAME gets lots of berries from others.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME licks everything it encounters to learn about the world. Rather than endangering this baby Pokémon, this action helps build its immune system.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME feathers almost always remain clean, as they can reach behind their body with their tongue to remove dirt and grime. These powerful tongues also make great hunting tools, as a few slaps of the tongue can knock out Bug-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The impressive eyesight and brilliant lights of POKENAME make them popular lighthouse attendants. If a POKENAME spots a ship about to crash into a rocky shore, it extends its tongue around the rocks to cradle the ship and slow it down.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When POKENAME soaks in a sufficient amount of sunlight, the ring of tongue-like petals around its face drips a type of condensation. Some are disturbed by the idea that morning dew might actually be POKENAME's "saliva".
author: sk372

entry: It follows weather changes by tasting the air with its wings, searching for disoriented prey. If it lands on you, it is also digesting you.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME uses its tongue as an extra limb, leaving a trail of saliva in its wake. Some people have a mild allergic reaction to this saliva though luckily the tonic to this is obtained by gently squeezing POKENAME's gills to release a thin gel.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's tongue is too long to fit in its mouth, so it wraps around its head instead. The horn-like barbs on the tongue make it extra painful to be licked by.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can be found in ruins where they are drawn to the wrappers that Trainers leave behind after eating snacks. They often lick the wrappers clean before continuing to monitor the ruins around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is covered in extremely sensitive taste nerves, which allow it to detect even slight changes in the air from food or predators. When it tastes something it does not like or that frightens it, it explodes in a shower of adhesive saliva.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses four tongue-like pseudopods to travel and adhere itself to trees using their residue. These pseudopods are extremely sensitive, so it will close its nearly impervious shell to protect them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When gliding too fast, POKENAME lashes its tongue around nearby trees to brake. It often leaves long gouges in the bark.
author: .izik

entry: A large group of POKENAME were recently spotted on Pinkan Island, using their long tongues to knock berries from trees. If anyone approaches, they use Scary Face before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful tongue to crack open maple trees. It eagerly laps up the sweet sap that flows from the wounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slides across rough surfaces using its own tongue as a sled. The tongue is searing hot to the touch and leaves a trail of lava behind.
author: chartanon

entry: As POKENAME crawls along surfaces, its tongue melts any organic matter it touches. The nutrients are then absorbed directly into its body.
author: chartanon

entry: Using its thick tongue, POKENAME smashes through ice sheets. It then eats the shards to maintain its frigid internal temperature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a tongue coated in incredibly cold saliva. It can extend up to 8 feet to pluck Pomeg Berries from trees with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME channels electricity through the saliva coating its tongue. A single lick can deliver a painful shock.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its heated body, POKENAME's saliva constantly bubbles. It leaves behind sizzling marks where its tongue touches.
author: .izik

entry: If it starts feeling bored, POKENAME blows wet and loud raspberries to amuse itself. Trainers commonly carry many snacks to keep POKENAME occupied.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME can use lightning coursing from its ears to electrify its tongue in battle to powerful effect. Out of battle, it sometimes "swallows" the electricity on its tongue, apparently enjoying the tingling sensation it brings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love Watmel Berries because of their large size. They wrap their tongue around the Berry before squeezing the sweet juices into their mouth.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME's body to be unable to retract its long tongue, leaving it forever extended. It must regularly find sources of moisture to lick to prevent its tongue drying out.
author: sk372

entry: It mostly navigates by sense of taste; its other senses are quite dull. Once prey is ensnared in its sticky tongues, there is little hope of escape.
author: knilk

entry: POKENAME climbs trees using its sticky paws. It snatches berries from high branches with precise flicks of its long tongue.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's stomach is accessible through the open hole in its back. No matter how much it eats, POKENAME still seems to believe it is empty.
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME licks its own body to coat itself in poisonous saliva. This defense doesn't affect its kin, but harms attackers.
author: .izik

entry: It ensures food that arrives at its nest is safe for its siblings by tasting the food with its tongue. It saves the best snacks for the younger siblings, while it sustains itself with scraps.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its tongue is actually a cleverly hidden set of jaws that drapes over POKENAME's head. The mouth is very sensitive to pain, and it will attack anything that hits it too hard.
author: mistymagius

entry: As POKENAME has a habit of licking things, over time it gained immunity to many poisons. Its saliva has been used for some antidotes to the deadliest of those poisons.
author: notsaying.

entry: Extremely lazy, a lounging POKENAME will gesture at passersby to feed it. Those that do not comply will be seized by its lengthy tongue, then pummeled by its powerful fists for their refusal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a complex digestive system that allows it to eat and dissolve nearly anything in its stomach, so it never has to regurgitate anything, either. Even if it eats something toxic, wild POKENAME tend to sleep it off in order to recover.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have highly sensitive taste buds and love sweet foods most of all. To attract mates, POKENAME decorate their shells with the finest sweets they can locate.
author: hophoppip

entry: When threatened, POKENAME salivates uncontrollably. It lashes at foes with a poison-soaked tongue to drive them away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a habit of licking every new object and living thing it sees to learn about it. Unfortunately, its licks often cause cuts and paralysis.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME seeks out poisonous mushrooms to eat. The toxins it consumes enhance the potency of the venom stored in its horn.
author: .izik

entry: It inspects everything in its environment with its tongue. Its sense of taste is over 100 times more powerful than a human's.
author: melodydelune

entry: While not threatening visually, this fusion causes those around it to have teeth-based nightmares. It otherwise keeps to itself.
author: ohok3441

entry: On nights of a new moon, POKENAME's tongue becomes extra sticky. This often causes it to get embarrassingly stuck to the ground.
author: .izik

entry: Sparks dance across POKENAME's tongue before it spits sticky webbing. It traps prey in electrified strands with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME use their tusks to mark which trees contain their favorite or least favorite nuts and fruits. Their tongues are slathered in a sticky fluid that makes it easy to retrieve any food they may desire.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite poor eyesight, POKENAME navigates easily by sweeping its surroundings with its sensitive tongue. If it locates any fungi while moving it will hastily eat it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have poor eyesight, so they rely on their incredibly sensitive tongue to help them navigate the world. These hypersensitive tongues make them great food tasters, as they can detect subtle changes in a given dish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite having two heads, POKENAME only has one tongue. Its paralyzing tongue is located deep in its torso, so it can only be used by one head at a time.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: If POKENAME senses the aura of a cruel person, its tongue drips with saliva. It spreads the slippery fluid while fleeing to slow pursuers.
author: .izik

entry: When deprived of sleep, POKENAME flies into a rage. It attacks wildly with both sharp claws and powerful slaps of its tongue.
author: .izik

entry: Its elastic tongue can inflate at will. If its tongue is inside its mouth when inflated, POKENAME can fly clumsily by flailing its arms.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: While it moves through magnetism, its skin is actually soft and squishy, with the magnetic material it manipulates actually being inside of POKENAME. If its tongue gets accidentally caught in its own gears, it immediately faints from the pain.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has an impeccable sense of taste and easily navigates through magnetic fields, but POKENAME possesses below-average senses of sight and touch. Even if touched affectionately by a friend, POKENAME can be easily startled if tapped on its back.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon has a cheerful and friendly demeanor and can easily make friends. It is always hungry and will eat almost anything. In fact, it is so hungry that some say its stomach is a black hole.
author: infranscia

entry: Rarely found in sloped areas, POKENAME's body is near-constantly filled with a flammable gas. Thankfully, its body is equipped to handle flames of high temperatures, so an accidental ignition wouldn't hurt POKENAME very much.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It seeks out those suffering negative emotions and licks them. While it clearly enjoys the taste, the surprise shocks people out of their terrible thoughts.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME orients itself using sound waves and flutters through caves. Anything edible that comes within reach of its tongue is lapped up and eaten.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is particularly fond of the juices oozing from Shuckle, using its tongue to latch onto one and suck its juices until satiated. Once considered amusing, pest control has now begun using POKENAME to clear any invasive Shuckle nests.
author: bollocksmen

entry: POKENAME grabs flying prey like Pidgey with its sticky tongue. It then reels them in and strikes with its tough tusks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME do not care for battling, despite what others assume due to their sharp tusks. They use their long tongues to grab hard nuts and hard fruits from trees, then break them open with their tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: It emits many soundwaves via its tongue to locate prey. If it locates prey, it uses its lower body to quickly jump several meters in that direction.
author: chorb33

entry: The clear saliva on POKENAME's tongue is dangerously toxic. Even a light lick can leave lasting burns on its prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tongue is coated in ice-cold saliva. It rapidly devours snow to keep its body temperature low in harsh climates.
author: .izik

entry: Some have theorized that the entirety of POKENAME's body within the outer casing is comprised of tongues, but this is unconfirmed. Anyone licked by one of its tongues will experience severe chills afterward.
author: sk372

entry: The noxious yet sweet honey that POKENAME's flower produces flows outward to become the saliva on its many tongues. Anyone licked by it will have the nasty stench stuck to their body for at least a week.
author: sk372

entry: One can see through its transparent dome that POKENAME has a mass of roiling tongues within it. Should it fire one of its tongue-limbs off or lose it in battle, another from the center mass will replace it shortly.
author: sk372

entry: Always eager for a good fight, POKENAME does not consider a fight truly won until it has pinned its opponent beneath its powerful tongue for a three-count. Unsurprisingly, not many are eager to let it earn this type of victory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires pins at Grepa Berry trees to knock fruit loose. Once fallen, it carefully retrieves them with its sticky tongue.
author: .izik

entry: Explorers are cautioned against picking POKENAME's mushrooms, even in cases of dire hunger. In the majority of people, consumption causes a highly uncomfortable swelling of the tongue.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME moves slowly, but its long tongue can quickly close the distance on prey. Even if the tongue fails to capture its target, the saliva carries propagating infectious spores to spread the parasitic mushroom.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It frequently grooms its entire body with its long tongue. Along with keeping its fur slick, this allows it to cough up toxic hairballs at predators.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME hunt for Bug-type Pokémon by whipping their tongue to stick and wrap around their prey. Once their prey stops struggling, they reel in their tongue to secure their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wrap their tongues around their neck to keep their cold-blooded bodies warm. Whenever the sun is out, they sprawl their bodies atop a Lotad and absorb the hot sunlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME releases clouds of poisonous powder to disorient foes. It then lashes out with its tongue to seize its stunned targets.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, striking with its tongue at anyone who enters. Its saliva can cause full paralysis, making it a dangerous deterrent for those who venture too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tongue and tail are coated in a spicy chemical that makes its fire attacks stronger. The chemical will cause an intense burning sensation even though it doesn't damage the skin.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's tongue can extend to almost three times its body length. Using this, it can reach out and consume leaves from a safe distance and rarely scurry far out of its home inside tree trunks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rubs its elastic tongue along tunnel walls to sense nearby roots. Its tongue can stretch the full length of its body to retrieve food.
author: .izik

entry: Digging as a trio takes a lot of energy, so when POKENAME surfaces to feed, its tongues lash out to gorge on anything nearby. The leader of the group will sometimes smack the others with its tongue to get them to reprimand them.
author: sk372

entry: Be wary of dropping coins on the ground. POKENAME are notorious for licking up money they find and filling their stomachs with lost pocket change.
author: kitarchen

entry: When it particularly likes objects or people, POKENAME constantly licks them with its long tongue. Its very gentle nature makes it a Pokémon that is well-suited to children or novice Trainers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's massive tongue is five times longer than its body. Its saliva contains a strong toxin that paralyzes foes on contact.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is very loyal, but also very gluttonous. When it sees something edible, it likes to forget its duties and chase after its food. It is so focused that it is not uncommon for it to get lost.
author: chorb33

entry: Despite its size, it is playful and cuddly, but also extremely voracious. Rumors that a POKENAME accidentally devoured its Trainer while playing have not yet been confirmed.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME train not only their arm and leg muscles, but also their tongue. They make great construction workers because they can carry additional materials with their tongue.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is commonly used in police investigations due to its strength and strangely sensitive tongue. POKENAME is said to lift cars with all limbs, including its tongue.
author: jojojax164

entry: Breweries rely on their tastebuds to detect abnormalities in mead, as they are sensitive to sugar. This ensures that high quality mead is produced while also sustaining the POKENAME through the consumption of mead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They often drink more than necessary, but breweries tolerate this because POKENAME can taste several barrels of mead and discern if any batch is defective.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It likes to lick the dirt and grime off of its Trainer, making it a handy companion when out on dusty mountain trails.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME wraps its tongue vertically around itself before rolling down mountainsides. Anything that gets stuck to its tongue as it rolls gets slurped up after the downward roll is complete.
author: sk372

entry: The platelets covering POKENAME's body are specialized to taste and detect rocks chock-full of minerals as it rolls down mountains. When it finds one, it uses its serrated tongue to break it into bite-sized pieces for consumption.
author: creaturecore

entry: Its taste buds are very sensitive, so any time food touches POKENAME's tongue, its simple mind is overwhelmed by the flavors. It's so enamored by the feeling of it against its tongue that it often forgets to actually eat the food.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's thick tail helps it stay upright and counter the balance of its long heavy tongue. Its simple mind makes it forget it can retract its tongue back into its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: The sticky tongue shared by both heads moves between them like a conveyor belt: food flows into one head and disappears, then the other. When bored, the heads may play an odd sort of tug-of-war with the tongue.
author: sk372

entry: It loves to lick up anything it can find off the ground to eat and let its goo-like body grow larger. It can even be seen slurping up parts of its own body that have dripped off and puddled on the ground.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon have many enemies, not only because of their overabundance but also due to their off-putting nature. POKENAME's primary method of attack involves repulsing its opponents.
author: the_smirker

entry: As POKENAME roams near urban areas, it uses its tongue to grab and swallow any object it comes across. These items are not digested but are left behind in POKENAME's trail, coated in stinky slime.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell is covered in spikes, and its tongue is constantly in motion, exploring its surroundings.
author: anarchaz

entry: It wards off enemies by emitting a pungent odor from the plant on its back. This scent is also how groups of POKENAME identify and locate each other.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's antennae constantly emits a horrific stench to prevent any predators from eating it. Every POKENAME has a slightly different smell which they use to identify one another.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME cries, it releases thick clouds of yellow smoke. The fumes are highly corrosive to the touch.
author: .izik

entry: The gasses within POKENAME rupture through the vents that would harmlessly disperse them from an unfused Koffing. Trainers are advised to make use of gas masks when training with POKENAME to protect themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Those who encounter POKENAME often speak of time feeling strangely short, as though an ending is fast approaching. Legends say it can only be conquered by a fierce deity.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Those who encounter POKENAME often speak of time feeling strangely short, as though an ending is fast approaching. Legends tell of a time when Regigigas and its original giants stopped it from bringing catastrophe.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME has a sturdy cocoon that vents noxious fumes from its body. Whenever a bird Pokémon pecks at its cocoon, POKENAME sprays acid onto the predator to scare them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though possessing less power than a normal Weezing, this Pokémon carries itself with a more chipper demeanor as well. It's theorized this is because the fusion resulted in less gas within it, causing less internal pressure.
author: sk372

entry: The stench of POKENAME's toxic clouds is particularly abhorred by Rock-type Pokémon. It can fling drill-shaped smog projectiles at foes that seep into their body and leave them badly poisoned.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to thrive in aquatic environments almost entirely independent of the water quality, so it's thought that if many natural regulations weren't already in place, POKENAME would have easily disrupted the natural ecosystem.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME generates toxic storm-clouds from the pores on its body. Due to the lightning and poison, the clouds are untouchable by others, though POKENAME can manipulate them effortlessly.
author: sk372

entry: The gases venting from POKENAME are caused by the metabolic processes needed for it to transform into other Pokémon. Even after it transforms, the smell never completely fades from POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It drifts silently through cyberspace and the real world alike, leaving behind trails of glitchy gas. Scientists struggle to study this Pokémon as most of their technology overheats when it gets too close to the gas.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME digests food, its stomach creates a foul-smelling toxic gas. This gas is vented out of the many large pores on POKENAME's body, creating a thick haze around it after a meal.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME isn't known for its intellect. It often eats things that no reasonable being should eat, causing it to be bloated constantly. While this boosts the potency of its poison, it makes its physique even bulkier and flying nearly impossible.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME's behaves in a carefree and dim manner, floating after anything that catches its curiosity. The clouds it emits all have a different scent, and research has determined each matches the natural odor of various other Pokémon species.
author: sk372

entry: Inside POKENAME's body, poisonous water bubbles with joy when it's happy. This reaction vents yellow smog from its back in short bursts.
author: .izik

entry: As a sign of affection, POKENAME will use its wings to blow the clouds it creates in order to share its scent with others. It doesn't seem to realize most others don't appreciate its uniquely pungent aroma.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce a virulent gas that clings to their wings wherever they fly. It only takes a few specks of this gas to produce a coughing fit, which is enough of a distraction for them to strike their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its pleasant smile, POKENAME is very territorial. The gasses it expels both ward off intruders and aid it in aerial acrobatic maneuvers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Clothes made from POKENAME wool will always have a distinctive odor, even when washed 100 times. However, the wool is still considered highly valuable to many rich folk due to smelling like exotic cheese.
author: reese1017600

entry: POKENAME soars over grasslands, dispensing a gas which disorients prey so it can easily catch them. Its diet can change the properties of the gas, so some farmers feed them Tanga Berries so the gas makes their plants more bug resistant.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME loves to play in water all day long. This causes concerns for environmentalists because the toxins that spew from its tail and body quickly contaminate the areas it plays in.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The gas it produces is a mixture of helium and methane, allowing it to float on its own gas. The mixture is also highly flammable, causing the gas to explode if ignited.
author: mistymagius

entry: Even though POKENAME love to cheer on their teammates, many people in the audience do not enjoy sitting next to them. This is because the gasses they produce to keep themselves airborne smell like rotting wood.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy smelly cheese more than anything. If they get into a cheese supply, they will spray the whole room with poison gas, poisoning the cheese for other species that would try to take it from them, including the people that own it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The weight of POKENAME's tail is the only thing keeping it grounded. If it absorbs too many gases, it can be seen floating with its tail dragging along the ground, seemingly enjoying the sensation.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are easy to identify by their putrid scent. Prolonged exposure to POKENAME gas causes headaches and nausea, which is why many researchers wear masks when dealing with them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Known for its loud, hacking laugh and relentless chewing, it gnaws on sewer pipes to release new smells. Cities have labeled it a public nuisance.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME swarm in polluted areas, feeding off of the toxins in the air. Scientists often use the number of POKENAME in an area to determine its toxicity.
author: mistymagius

entry: It converts tree sap into a noxious, volatile gas to repel predators. If a foe gets past the fumes, POKENAME can ignite the gas and self-destruct.
author: wigglypon

entry: Having been born in a hazardous environment, POKENAME's body produces a vast amount of poisonous gases. They leak out of its body through the rocky vents along its sides.
author: raydrago

entry: POKENAME's yellow fumes darken to pitch black when its body cools. During this time, even a brief inhale of the smoke can be dangerously toxic.
author: .izik

entry: The chemical ooze that makes up its body gives off toxic, odorous fumes. Its shell contains hollow chambers to store these fumes so POKENAME can release them as a defense mechanism when needed.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's body is filled with sulfuric gases that are expelled through its vents without warning. Fortunately, it still has its personality.
author: tuskaninny

entry: When threatened on land or sea, POKENAME will spew a cloud of noxious gas. This gas is often so toxic that it knocks out its target, but by then the Pokémon is long gone.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME protects coral reefs by feeding on ocean pollution, which produces a noxious ink it expels to repel predators. It is curious of new objects and creatures in its habitat, which often leads to divers having a piece of equipment stolen by it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are found in highly polluted areas, most often in areas with high levels of industrial waste runoff. Their bodies metabolise the toxins in their environment and expel them as foul gases.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its pores constantly seep out a noxious gas that smells of expired milk. In Unova, it has become a recent trend to drink its condensed form, despite the serious health risks.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME billows out a hazy rainbow cloud that causes a heavy, lethargic feeling upon inhalation. Many affluent lovers try to bottle POKENAME's clouds, but they turn yellow after a few hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was once thought to be a protector of the forests, but scientists were incorrect. Instead, POKENAME comes from a forest in the future that it has already destroyed using its noxious fumes.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Gases spew out from the end of its tail, causing it to flail wildly. The weight of the flailing tail causes POKENAME to lose control of its footing, and it will go meandering in all sorts of directions as a result.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME eat large quantities of food, resulting in their bodies producing plenty of gas. They have begun to learn to propel themselves by releasing this gas, which tends to smell so horrible it can knock down even an Onix with a single whiff.
author: infinex21

entry: A predator by nature, POKENAME collects toxic gases from volcanoes using vents on its body. When hunting, it releases the gas to weaken its prey.
author: laserchick

entry: Once believed to be nature spirits corrupted with pollution, POKENAME carefully monitor landfill sites, spreading word to other Pokémon when sites grow too large. They feast on buried rubbish and rise to the top by absorbing lighter-than-air gases.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's toxic gas causes space distortions all around it. To protect its Trainer, it'll suddenly leak a massive gas cloud and envelop them inside.
author: leeto64

entry: Every time POKENAME sneezes, it releases poisonous gas from the spouts on its body. Though POKENAME is unable to camouflage as effectively as a unfused Kecleon, the poisonous gas is enough to ward off predators.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is quite mischievous and will often propel itself away from consequences at high speed with jets of pressurised gas.
author: rooboid

entry: The mouth on POKENAME's head constantly belches toxic fumes to incapacitate anyone that breathes the gas in. The more food POKENAME has eaten, the more concentrated the gas becomes.
author: mistymagius

entry: The smog released by POKENAME manipulates perception, leading victims to believe it is a demigod. Prolonged exposure can also numb limbs for months.
author: .izik

entry: Mischievous and jovial, POKENAME are easily amused by childish pranks. They light the gas that they produce to create small explosions, startling everyone in the area.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A set of Koffing create a thick cloud that carries along a battle-hungry Chimchar across the lands, searching for opponents. It is said only the pure of heart can sit upon the cloud; all others fall right through.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can release clouds of toxic gas from its body, which it rides to float in midair. It is a skilled fighter, capable of crushing boulders as if they were fragile pieces of glass with a single punch.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's smog clouds are a reflection of their vitality. The most powerful POKENAME can hardly be seen through the storm.
author: dylonk25

entry: To regulate its body temperature, it constantly releases toxic gas from the vents on its rock-hard armor. POKENAME must continuously feed on rocks to prevent its horns from weakening.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its body is full of gases that are lighter than air, keeping it aloft. These gases are volatile around open flames.
author: melodydelune

entry: Those that inhale POKENAME's fumes will find themselves quickly falling into a deep slumber. The sleep is fraught with nightmares framed around being unable to breathe; victims always wake up gasping for air.
author: sk372

entry: Found deep inside mines, POKENAME is adept at detecting poisonous gases and neutralizing them with its gaseous mane. When trained by miners, it acts as an early warning system, grabbing its Trainer and jumping to the surface.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME travels to areas overrun by air pollution. Despite its friendly demeanor and good intentions, it often makes the problem worse.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME's coat of poisonous cotton is light enough that it can travel on the wind. It tears off chunks of the cotton to hide around homes as a prank since the fluff has an unpleasant odor but becomes hard to track when from multiple sources.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Instead of a flame, it emits a faintly glowing gas that ignites only under rare conditions. The gas is faintly sweet-smelling, luring in curious Pokémon before vanishing into the air.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME expels fumes from behind at a constant rate, its three tails of smog never dissipating in full. If threatened, it can ignite the fumes and use them to sling fireballs at attackers.
author: sk372

entry: It lazily floats along riverbanks, releasing puffs of gas that smell faintly like wet wood. Fishermen steer clear not because of the stench, but because it won't stop giggling at its own bubbles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME will trail cruise ships, eating any refuse that falls off and cleaning the waters as it goes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME move together in small prides, working together to take on threats larger than themselves. They use the gases they produce to create cover for themselves, blinding other Pokémon as they surround them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is an extremely shy Pokémon. If it notices someone listening while it sings, it becomes agitated and releases a highly poisonous gas through its skin pores. This behavior often causes others to avoid it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is timid by nature and prefers solitude. If overheard while singing, it panics and secretes poisonous gas from its skin, a habit that causes other Pokémon to keep their distance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is found in areas with chemically contaminated soil, where it sucks the toxins from the dirt as nutrients. From small spouts on its body it blasts clouds of cotton, which is used to make stain-resistant clothing.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It burrows just below the surface, using gas to inflate the sand and make it easier to tunnel. When startled, it erupts from the ground surrounded by a dirty yellow cloud and will not stop releasing gas for hours.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME flies through factories releasing yellow smog from its mouth. Workers often report sudden coughing fits when it passes overhead.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are disease-ridden creatures that fill the air with noxious fumes and drool thick, sticky saliva onto cavern floors. Many Pokémon that either inhale the fumes or touch the saliva break out in hives.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's vivid markings indicate to predators that it is intensely toxic. If you approach one, prepare to be blasted with noxious gas.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME devours trash from dumpsters, fermenting the waste into toxic gas. The buildup lets it float lazily above alleyways.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are typically found in swamps and are known for the awful stench they produce. When multiple POKENAME gather after sunset, the smell becomes unbearable, keeping predators at bay.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon performs midair somersaults before releasing clouds of gas like dramatic smoke bombs. It considers every battle an audience-worthy performance.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's gas is stored within its main body, filling it to the point of near bursting. In battle, it can quickly vent this gas towards its spikes, sending them shooting out with the excess pressure.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME infect other Pokémon with a myriad of diseases through the spores they expel from their bodies. The infectious fungal spores force many Trainers to wear masks when handling POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are extremely social and loyal, constantly trying to nuzzle into Trainers despite the smog constantly billowing along their bodies. Luckily, giving a POKENAME a healthy diet and proper grooming can help filter the smog into cleaner air.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: As POKENAME sings, it emits clouds of gas in the shapes of musical notes. Though it makes a pleasant sound, these clouds are very pungent and will send those who smell them into fierce coughing fits.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly release spores from their body in the form of a foul miasma. Many Trainers and Pokémon get sick when breathing in a puff of POKENAME spores, often developing a fever and sore throat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to their affinity for low air quality, POKENAME can be trained to alert people of things like smoke, carbon monoxide, and gas leaks. The reliability of their senses is vital for safety in high-risk manufacturing plants.
author: corra_universe

entry: Due to their affinity for low air quality, POKENAME can be trained to alert people of things like smoke, carbon monoxide, and gas leaks. The reliability of their senses is vital for safety in high-risk manufacturing plants.
author: corra_universe

entry: POKENAME enjoy being in places with low air quality. Studies have been unable to determine their ecological effects due to inconsistent data between populations.
author: corra_universe

entry: POKENAME enjoy being in places with low air quality. Studies have been unable to determine their ecological effects due to inconsistent data between populations.
author: corra_universe

entry: To safeguard it against predators, its skin secretes mucus bubbles. These bubbles are inflated with toxic gas, repelling any predators who attempt to bite it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can expel a cloud of noxious fumes to vanish at the first sign of trouble. It leaves behind no trace of where it went, except a nauseating odor.
author: atlas3339098

entry: While sleeping inside volcanoes, POKENAME emits thick smoke that engulfs its entire body. The fumes are highly acidic and unsafe to touch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eat lots of Payapa Berries because their natural environment has lots of Psychic-type Pokémon. Whenever they are struck by psychic waves, they release a burst of smog and kick through obstacles to give themselves a chance of escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME erupt from the ground, they saturate the area full of noxious fumes. The fumes cause dizziness and confusion when inhaled, making escape from POKENAME quite difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Instead of collecting coins, it gathers metallic scraps and small trinkets. It hides them in clouds of gas, daring others to reach into the smog and find them.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Ironically, POKENAME dislikes getting dirty, perhaps due to its porous skin, but it doesn't like others cleaning it, either.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The acidic smoke POKENAME releases burns hot enough to melt copper. Its smoke grows hotter and more volatile the more charcoal it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: If angered, POKENAME will erupt, spewing hot, toxic gas from its back and ears. Since this gas is highly combustible, it always explodes immediately after the eruption.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly try to hold in their gas to make themselves more approachable and develop a headache if they strain too hard. Trainers who help them act as their natural selves will find a reliable lifelong partner.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are confident creatures that are unashamed of the gas they release from their bodies. They release this gas in loud bursts, which causes a ball of concentrated air to form if they are underwater.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME floats along with the breeze, always trailing a tail made of its gases. Those that inhale the gases as it passes by hear a faint ringing in their ears for a few hours afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bodies are much like balloons, filled with toxic gas. When attacked, they release this gas to propel themselves forward, leaving a cloud behind to disorient opponents while they flee to safety in their deflated state.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's bodies are much like balloons, filled with toxic gas. When attacked, they release this gas to propel themselves forward, leaving a cloud behind to disorient opponents while they flee to safety in their deflated state.
author: santon5512

entry: A POKENAME's emissions can be rendered inert if they are fed a specialty diet. Their cheery temperaments make them good, if expensive, pets.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME are small Pokémon that often thrive within dirty freshwater. They seem to absorb and metabolize the pollutants in the water as their means of survival.
author: infinex21

entry: The pores on its body expel noxious gas as well as a thick, oily fluid. This fluid protects POKENAME from drying out and helps attacks slide off its skin.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: With fists made of noxious gas, POKENAME's attacks will land a hefty blow to any foe with a sense of smell. A mixture of sulfur, methane and helium in its body keeps it floating above ground.
author: krune

entry: When POKENAME flexes its muscles, it releases toxic gas. The stronger its muscles are, the more toxic the gas becomes.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME has spread fast in recent years because it prefers polluted waters. The already dirty waters are slowly being contaminated by its presence.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as tasty vegetables and hang from trees while they wait for another Pokémon to attempt to eat them. Once their prey is close, they expel a poisonous powder that immobilizes the target and then they devour the prey whole.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME can temporarily solidify the smog it creates into fists for self-defense. Being punched by these cloudy limbs not only hurts but leaves a lasting poison in those struck.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME dives, it regularly emits bubbles of gas. Anyone who inhales this gas for even a few seconds can expect severe respiratory irritation.
author: chorb33

entry: It floats using erratic bursts of gas rather than magnets. Some say its body stores volatile chemicals that constantly shift, creating unpredictable movement patterns.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME constantly brews a highly explosive gas within its body. Due to its slimy form, it cannot contain the gas well enough, causing it pain.
author: skymaster426

entry: The essence of filth, a POKENAME's scent is said to repel other Pokémon. During the summer, its stench warrants evacuation of nearby towns.
author: symile

entry: POKENAME enjoys haunting houses, filling their rooms with a foul stench using its gas. Inhaling its fumes for too long can cause people to lose consciousness.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's toxins work their way up from the tip of the tail before being exhaled through the segments closer to its head. Its poison works particularly well on Rock-types, so many underground denizens give it a wide berth.
author: sk372

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will cloak themselves in toxic bubbles blown from their mouths. These bubbles often contaminate the water they inhabit.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME enjoys gathering with other members of its kind. Together, they harden their shells, creating dashing displays of fractured sunlight.
author: curerry

entry: It will swing from branch to branch using a sticky string of silk. During the swing, it spins its body clockwise to gain momentum.
author: .izik

entry: When you find POKENAME in the wild, be cautious. It's known to be violent when storing its power to prep for evolution.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME have two shells that protect them until they reach evolution, which they then pass off to their offspring. POKENAME can fire small bones made from their own outer shell up to 50ft away.
author: npshi

entry: Ghost Pokémon seem to follow it as if were a guide for the afterlife. POKENAME appears to be rather oblivious to it, cruising along without a care in the world.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Using their nimble legs, POKENAME are always on the run, fleeing from any potential danger until ready to evolve. If backed into a corner, they can deliver powerful kicks to keep opponents at bay.
author: santon5512

entry: Its hard shell protects POKENAME while it stores the energy it needs to evolve. It hides behind layers of poisonous gas to stay safe from predators.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Fusing two Metapod together makes their carapace as hard as diamond. The energy generated for evolution increases their density to almost star-like levels.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have a tough outer armour that is several centimetres thick, letting them endure significant physical punishment. Their bodies are in a state of metamorphosis beneath their armour and they are very careful if they suffer major injury.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a cocoon made of interlocking sage-colored scales that deflect bites and scratches. They also release a constant stream of ink that obscures the vision of nearby predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drag their fins through seaweed to create the illusion that they are a piece of floating seaweed. This camouflage convinces predators to leave them alone and saves their cocoon from getting damaged.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hide within forests of seaweed to keep themselves safe. Their soft cocoons can grow seaweed to make their camouflage more convincing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hide within seaweed forests to avoid detection from predators. Their soft cocoons allow them to grow seaweed on their bodies to improve their camouflage.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's cube-like shape allows for multiples of this Pokémon to join together in elaborate structures for protection. People sometimes find their paths blocked by walls of POKENAME that have popped up overnight.
author: corra_universe

entry: If POKENAME is frightened, its body becomes extremely hard. It releases a purple powder capable of putting a full grown man to sleep within seconds.
author: .izik

entry: Unlike Staryu, POKENAME's body cannot easily regenerate if damaged. However, its outer shell is more flexible, so POKENAME can more easily fit into places Metapod could not.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its large scythes can slice through solid steel. When it is angry, it loses precision on its attacks and swipes wildly.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its claws to dig into the ground and make a den. Once it gets in the hole, it will cover itself with the soil while preparing for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME ram their bodies into each other, toughening their shells with each hit. This behavior is said to accelerate their evolution, causing them to evolve even stronger.
author: santon5512

entry: The stinger on its head breaks off from time to time. There are apothecaries who gather these stingers for use in creating Ethers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are cordial yet slow creatures that enjoy lounging around observing the world around them. They have little appetite while in their pupal state, so Trainers have to feed them to ensure they remain a healthy weight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even as digital code, POKENAME is protected with secure code. The shell is akin to a firewall, securing it from danger.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: It hardens its shell to protect itself. This shell is filled with a thick liquid. This liquid boils when it is preparing for its coming evolution.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME keep their wings outstretched to scare off Pokémon that enter their territory. Despite their formidable size, they are only capable of short hops because of the chitinous shell around their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME contains two separate layers of cocoon over its body to protect its evolving form. Though this gives it added defenses, it also lengthens the amount of time for evolution to complete.
author: sk372

entry: The stinger on its tail is mostly for show. While it does contain a weak poison, it prefers to use it to scare predators from its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a special cocoon that has leafy plates that flake off as they continue to grow. Herbalists take these pungent plates to create bitter medicinal drinks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a thick sap that lubricates their cocoons. Once they evolve, apothecaries take the cocoon that is left behind to create a supplement that makes bones stronger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carry a bundle of silk on their back that stores hot embers. Whenever they are threatened, the silk pouch momentarily opens to spray hot air and soot to scare away danger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME clings to tree trunks with sticky silk while awaiting evolution. Its feather-like casing can become sturdier than stone.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever a POKENAME gets hurt, they release pheromones that alert other Pokémon to the danger nearby. More predators leave POKENAME alone to avoid scaring away other potential prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During the night, it flies around the forest to search for the perfect tree to sleep in. It uses a peculiar silk to tie itself to a branch and sleep.
author: .izik

entry: The base of its body excretes a silky string that it uses to hang from branches. This is primarily useful when it is waiting to drop onto prey.
author: .izik

entry: It burrows into the dirt of sunflower fields to wait for evolution. It consumes flower roots to gain nutrients for its shell.
author: .izik

entry: By hardening its fist during a punch, it can destroy boulders. POKENAME can only do this a few times each day before it exhausts itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are encased in a thick cocoon that protects them from harm. Whenever they fall out of trees, their legs skitter to bring them back to where they were.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings were once part of its cocoon. They can grow as hard as steel and POKENAME uses them to attack its enemies mercilessly.
author: raydrago

entry: POKENAME secures its nest to branches using silk strands. It sways gently in the breeze, blending into the canopy.
author: .izik

entry: When it is happy, it lets loose a flurry of sparks around its body. It sleeps near electric outlets to charge its body with energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME may seem like an easy snack for predators, but Pokémon that try to carry it away find that it is quite heavy. The tough cocoon around its body also makes it difficult for predators to break.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sit atop branches where they sit until they evolve. If they are knocked down from their branch, the leaves atop their head allow them to float safely to the forest floor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a mostly hollow body. This allows it to float from tree to tree while it waits to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: Although sluggish, POKENAME has confidence in its ability to withstand attacks. Even a Pidgey's peck will barely damage it.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: It swings like a pendulum from tree branches as it prepares for evolution. Its body can become harder than iron when it is startled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often mistake for foliage as they keep completely still, preparing for evolution. They subsist on moisture absorbed through their shell.
author: zagreus8

entry: It can fly even while it sleeps. During a prolonged slumber, it will fly in circles above a body of water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds a cocoon to protect its soft body whilst it grows strong enough to evolve. As it nears evolution, bits of the cocoon start to flake off. This was used in some cultures as a traditional way to make Energy Powder.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are too heavy to hang from branches, so they often lie on the ground with their smooth back exposed to the elements. Depending on where they land, they may shuffle their position so they have a pleasant scene to look at as they daydream.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is quite timid and docile in nature. However, as it approaches evolution, it grows more defensive in protecting the cocoon on its back.
author: curerry

entry: POKENAME can sleep for days at a time while it waits to evolve. The shell on its face is harder than stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cocoons itself in a hard telekinetic shell to prepare for evolution. The stronger its psychic ability, the thicker its shell will be.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Rarely moving through hardships and battles has made POKENAME's body rigid and largely immobile. All it can do now is harden its defenses and prepare for a counterstrike while conserving energy.
author: sontyp

entry: It gallops quickly across grassy landscapes to find a secluded place to rest and prepare for evolution; while this occurs, it remains eerily still. If approached in this state, its antennae glow and let loose blasts of psychic power.
author: bobosmith01
