entry: The gem on its forehead is said to be able to sense rainy weather since POKENAME seems to only appear dancing in the rain. It catches small Pokémon in its umbrella-like mouth where they are left to be digested.
author: mistymagius

entry: It communicates with other Pokémon by making the horn-shaped gem on its forehead flash in rhythmic patterns. Scientists have developed a remedy for seasickness derived from the toxins produced by POKENAME's body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As long as its eye is intact, POKENAME can regenerate its body. On starry nights, it stares and shines its eye at the sky from a seaside cliff.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its beautiful pattern and colors make this Pokémon popular among water specialists. It can regenerate limbs that have been lost in battle.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME rests at the ocean floor and is highly territorial. It flashes the cores of its body once as a warning to intruders, before it rises up to punish them for their trespassing.
author: sk372

entry: It flies high in the skies during starlit nights, a red glow shining in each of its many cores. It's suspected that supposed sightings of "UFO lights" at night were people catching glimpses of POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often seen marking constellations in the sky with its hands. When scientists looked into POKENAME's instincts, it helped them measure the distance between stars.
author: dyanz0

entry: POKENAME can project solid light from the gem on its front, acting as an extra limb to interact with others. It requires a light source to function properly, and can barely use its ability in the dark.
author: sk372

entry: Longing for its place back among celestial bodies, POKENAME restlessly flashes its core at night, hoping the stars will respond.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: It patrols beaches, throwing shurikens at fish Pokémon that jump out of the water. When two POKENAME meet, they compete to catch the most prey.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its body has fully adapted to life in the ocean depths, with algae, anemones, and corals covering its spherical surface. The core embedded within the star on its head glows at night to attract other marine Pokémon, as it fears being left alone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its body has fully adapted to life in the ocean depths, with algae, anemones, and corals covering its spherical surface. The core embedded within the star on its head glows at night to attract other marine Pokémon, as it fears being left alone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME houses itself in tropical waters, typically surrounded by undersea plants or coral reefs. The hollow spot in its center fills with water or stored sunlight to fire in short bursts at potential threats.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's outer membrane is comprised of a mixture of slime and saltwater. The core in its center will glow a different color depending on what type of psychic power it utilizes.
author: sk372

entry: Clusters of POKENAME drill themselves into the ocean floor, causing a resonant whirr to echo through the waves as they drain the sand of minerals. Due to the sharpness of their arms, entire public beaches will close down if one washes ashore.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: Clusters of POKENAME drill themselves into the ocean floor, causing a resonant whirr to echo through the waves as they drain the sand of minerals. Due to the sharpness of their arms, entire public beaches will close down if one washes ashore.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME burrows in shallow ocean sands, beneath which its red gem shines bright on moonlit nights. Sailors hang one over their ship controls for good luck based on the old legends that POKENAME is a lost mermaid coin.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME have bulky exoskeletons that leave them well-suited to life in coral reefs. Even if a piece breaks off, with enough time it will regenerate into a brand new POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's glass body shines brightly when the temperature drops. If its crystalline body shatters, it can take months to regrow.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME live in large schools, able to link with each other telepathically to sync up their attacks. This high level of coordination allows them to take down entire schools of Wailord with very few casualties.
author: mistymagius

entry: An ever faithful ocean companion, POKENAME are often found standing on the prows of ships. During storms, it's common to see a pack of POKENAME lighting the way with their glowing red crystals.
author: campadascleric

entry: When overloaded with toxin, the gem on POKENAME's body becomes clouded. It collapses until the excess poison drains slowly from its limbs.
author: .izik

entry: Some theories claim that POKENAME come from space. They sometimes use their powers to draw ambient moisture from the air and freeze it into strange and complex star-like shapes for no known reason.
author: karagar

entry: POKENAME's dull-colored body can start shifting into a vibrant kaleidoscope of hues during the evening if its gem starts to glow. Why this occurs and why the gem can glow in the first place is not entirely known.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At night, small groups of POKENAME emerge partially from the sand. Their glowing cores pulse in rhythmic patterns admired by observers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME darts about beneath the ocean waves, communicating to others with flickers of light from its core. When in the presence of couples, it observes them with a pattern of shifting colors that seems to indicate curiosity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME retains control of any of its severed limbs. These limbs regenerate into full Staryu which act in tandem with the original, creating a collective with a single mind.
author: afilthycasual

entry: POKENAME looks remarkably similar to a cut starfruit. Bird Pokémon often confuse it for one, forcing it to defend itself with a squirt of stinging juice.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are a popular choice among the rich and people with affluence. They are trained to stand at attention in a pose to accentuate the gem on their head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME may be spotted lazing about on the beach. It is sometimes disobedient to authority and will do whatever it wants instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME adores two things above all else: glittering objects and swimming. It can even be found swimming during the evening, especially if the moon is full.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are able to regrow limbs, but the immense strain on their body draws nutrients away from their head, resulting in a nasty headache. Many avoid wandering too far from their home to avoid getting hurt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Troops of POKENAME bound across coral reefs in search of food, their vivid red gems pulsing in synchrony with one another. They prefer to hunt at night so that they can more easily watch for signals from other members of their troop in the dark.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: These small, aquatic Pokémon have shells harder than some metals. The inner core of a POKENAME is incredibly vulnerable and, thus, they rarely will open their shells.
author: infinex21

entry: Its eye shimmers and fur warms when POKENAME is happy. Due to the heat it generates, some of its crystal fur will shed. This fur is very valuable and is almost identical to stardust.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME have no eyes, so they rely on vibrations in the air and sea to give them a sense of direction. The core on their head can shoot bursts of water with great precision to take down targets from far away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Somehow, POKENAME is able to swim quite fast. Looking deeply into its large gemstone can cause confusion and intense dizziness.
author: robosoup

entry: The massive gem on POKENAME's forehead is said to be the source of its potent telekinetic abilities. Some have tried to hunt it, thinking it would grant them its power, but none have succeeded.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME's muscles tense in anticipation of an attack, the jewels on its stars glow brightly. It responds extremely negatively towards any attempts to touch the star on its face.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their incredible strength to rescue ships that are sinking. Unfortunately they are quite short, so Trainers use toy boats with weights inside to give POKENAME the satisfaction of being heroes.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME floats on ocean currents, influencing its direction with jets of water from its rigid arms. When it communicates, the larger side gems glow brighter than the core and act as decoys should a predator attack.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME floats on the surface of the ocean, catching passing fish in its dangling mass of tentacles. When whole schools gather at night, the glowing jewels light up the sea in beautiful displays.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its fists are made out of the same mineral that forms its power core. Unlike many other Geodude hybrids, POKENAME's glowing core helps distinguish it from its surrounding environment.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When  POKENAME travel in herds together, they communicate with flashing lights from the gems on their body. This lets them seamlessly send messages through the herd while still moving at top speed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME clings to submarines to transport itself through the ocean. Its red gem glows softly in low light conditions, luring other aquatic Pokémon to the submarine.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME starts each morning by sticking itself onto a submarine. It removes itself from the hull once it has traveled far enough from its original home.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME normally fights with water shot from its twin cannons, but if its torso begins to glow brightly its opponent should brace themselves, as its core is feeding energy to the cannons to fire powerful twin beams of light.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME communicates through light signals produced by the large gem on its back. Its shy nature leads it to hide among seaweed and coral reefs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME emits a high-pitched tone that only other POKENAME can hear, creating strange synchronized movements. If disturbed, it vanishes in a flash of light, leaving behind a faint buzzing sound.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME rolls silently down rivers, generating a low hum that unsettles nearby Pokémon. Researchers believe the gem at its center holds data from long-forgotten civilizations.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The clouds produced by POKENAME's body twinkle and shine as if reflecting the night sky. Perfumes made using collected gases from POKENAME give wearers a subtle glimmer while the scent remains.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME shoots beams of water mixed with sand, turning a gentle stream into a pressurized drill. It can be found in factories where it punches holes into steel.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each gem found across its body seemingly functions as an additional brain. Few have proven the ability to outwit this homonymous "Starmie".
author: fixthewifi

entry: POKENAME generates shimmering walls of light from the gem on its face, that it then manipulates with its hands to form defensive walls. It can occasionally be seen using these barriers to float along the surface of the ocean.
author: sk372

entry: Late at night, POKENAME races above the ocean waves, patrolling for something unknown. It often fights off territorial Tentacruel that mistake the light off its wings and blades as rivaling Pokémon.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its radiant body glows during the night; along with its rarity, it makes it the perfect bragging right for aspiring Bug Catchers. It can consume any kind of organic matter; depending on what it eats, the color of its exoskeleton can change slightly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: After being poached into near extinction, POKENAME has learned to flee instantly after spotting humans. They are only found near the shores of large, fresh-water lakes. Their tails whip violently in water like a propeller- allowing for quick escapes.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME's massive gem can shine a powerful light, allowing them to swim in the deepest depths without any trouble. If a predator gives chase, POKENAME will flash its pursuer with a blinding light before swimming away.
author: phantom640

entry: It lives at the deepest point of the ocean. When POKENAME spots prey or intruders, it blinds them using its gem before violently attacking them. Once done, POKENAME drags its victims back down to its lair to feed.
author: phantom640

entry: Known to many sailors as nature's guide upon the open seas, POKENAME have a shell made of solid gemstone that can emit various color lights. They use these lights to communicate as well as to lure prey.
author: infinex21

entry: Due to POKENAME's capacity to function in the deep depths of the ocean and its tendency to flash its crystal brightly while in the presence of technology, it has been invaluable in searching and recovering tech lost at sea.
author: sk372

entry: At first sight many Trainers believe POKENAME is from outer space. Unbeknownst to most, it survives in the deepest portions of the ocean, its armor protecting it from the crushing depths and its diamond-hard scythes lighting the darkness.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Wild POKENAME are typically found lying motionless on the floors of rivers and oceans. They use the gem on their stomach to attract prey.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME roosts in locations near where undersea volcanoes lie. Its flames burn even more vibrantly as it focuses energy into the core on its face, which is capable of firing large beams of scalding-hot light.
author: sk372

entry: Some civilizations in the past believed POKENAME acted as the guardian of the seas. They store energy inside the massive crystal situated on their heads.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is erroneously rumored to be an alien being, drawing energy from the stars. When it lands, it unleashes a flurry of starlight-infused punches with its four arms. Children enjoy watching POKENAME launch glowing punches like a light show.
author: shyguy11011

entry: At night, POKENAME flies across the sky, spreading cosmic dust from its wings. It is said that you should make a wish if you see one.
author: fr34kuency

entry: While flying at high altitudes, it flashes the gem on its face to alert other Flying-type Pokémon of its presence and avoid collisions. POKENAME nests along tropical cliffs to keep its eggs safe.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's lights on its head and face can shine in a myriad of colors independent of each other. It can create truly radiant flickering displays of light that can confuse and stun prey and opponents in battle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME that are naturally hatched in the wild without the involvement of a Trainer can have their habitat determined based on the sheen of its jewel-like upper body. They sleep twice a day, retreating into caverns to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is exceedingly rare to find in the wild. It possesses a particular and odd behavior: it will suddenly stare up at the moon and hop at precise and repetitive intervals for a few minutes every so often at night, its jewel-like ears glowing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite the weight of the crystals on its body, POKENAME freely flies by being carried by the wind. The air flow energizes the gems it holds, letting it shake them about to spread out colorful sparkles or even small bursts of energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME treasure the large pearl they are so often seen with, which serves as a spiritual conduit for them. If one attempts to steal this pearl, they will be afflicted with myriad curses.
author: infinex21

entry: Their overly complicated method of hunting consists of creating delicious juices that give giant kidney stones to those who drink them, so they become easier prey. These kidney stones are highly valued in jewelry.
author: epping_forest

entry: Each POKENAME's hat depicts a different constellation.  When the stars are not visible, they are known to stand upon the clouds, guiding lost Trainers to a safe haven for the night.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME gems glow with a beautiful red energy, pulsing in time with their movements. The glow is strongest when there is a clear night sky above, as though matching the twinkling of the stars.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon mostly lazes in calm ocean tides with its gem encrusted head facing skyward, which absorbs energy from both sunlight and moonlight. Anything foolish enough to disturb a POKENAME will be lashed at by its unusually fast, whip-like tail.
author: ludacriswell

entry: The markings along its body flicker with light as a means of communicating with others. It feeds on sunlight and moonlight through its gem-like parts, which can also emit painfully bright light to disorient predators.
author: infinex21

entry: The crystals that grow along POKENAME's body are often shed before they grow too heavy. It will use its psychic powers to wield some of these crystals as weapons to defend itself, which implies that this Pokémon is rather intelligent.
author: infinex21

entry: Although the gem on the end of its tail is quite heavy, POKENAME's psychic power is strong enough to roll it like a ball. It's often seen bouncing happily with a twinkle in its frontal gem as it rides around on its tail.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME attaches itself to the metallic hulls of submarines, and glows in dark conditions using its gem. When it can no longer hold on, it lets go of the submarine and sinks to the bottom of the sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hoards precious gems in caves, eating them to add to its body. It often gets into fights with Stargron for gems within its hoard of gold.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for a large coral by other Water Pokémon. Once entangled in its tentacles, POKENAME will eat it, regardless of its size.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for a large coral by other Water Pokémon. Once entangled in its tentacles, POKENAME will eat it, regardless of its size.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME uses electricity to get to a high enough speed to run on water. Their wires drag along the water, causing nearby fish Pokémon to be shocked.
author: bigoljax

entry: In the past, despots across various civilizations would order the poaching of POKENAME to claim its jeweled eye as a garish symbol of wealth and power. The species is rarely seen in modern day, and considered endangered.
author: sk372

entry: When the gem on its head glows, it shines like the aurora borealis. It is said POKENAME roams snowy shores at night to rescue shipwreck survivors.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The thick spines on POKENAME's back will grow back if severed or launched off in self-defense. It communicates with others via a series of glowing flashes from the horn on its head.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon drift across night skies, kept aloft by their latent telekinetic powers. When the star-like part of their backs rotates, the core of their bodies will glow brightly and generate a powerful gravitational field.
author: infinex21

entry: Its sighting was considered a good omen among ancient tribes, believed to bring happiness, prosperity, and the resolution of many problems. Hence, it was regarded as "The gem that saved the party" in their texts.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME always keeps the large gem on its body clean and shiny. Despite having no visible eyes, it can still see, leading some to believe this gem is actually the Pokémon's eye.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME love to hide in gold piles, and play pranks on treasure raiders. Fear not, as these pranks aren't harmful.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME mix their pollen into bodies of water to create a gel that cures poison. Scientists speculate that this is because their pollen has regenerative properties that counteract toxic compounds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The get on POKENAME's cranium is where its capacity for psychic powers is stored. It needs to slam its head against something to stimulate its brain and allow it to properly access and utilize its power.
author: sk372

entry: The harder-than-diamond gem on its head is actually a third eye. When it's charging with its head down, POKENAME can still see where it's going. It glows brighter when it's furious.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When it is awake, it gazes into the stars to determine the future. However, when it is asleep it is also looking into space. It is impossible to tell the difference.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Ancient myths described POKENAME as a deity of the night sky. They warned that neglecting its worship would summon devastating ocean typhoons.
author: .izik

entry: Only one ancient POKENAME was known to exist before the advent of fusion technology. It is capable of surviving reentry from space and summoning projectiles from the sky that resemble falling stars.
author: .fedoraman

entry: It hoards gold from caves, eating them to add to its body. It often gets into fights with Starperior for gold within its hoard of gems.
author: pokepower

entry: Whenever POKENAME disguise themselves as another Pokémon, they are never able to completely obscure the gems on their body. When their illusion is inevitably discovered, the gems glow in an array of colors as they revert back to their true form.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The golden parts of its body act as a natural armor for POKENAME, being made of bone. The gems on its body are the conduits for its psychic abilities.
author: melodydelune

entry: This colossal Pokémon lives at the bottom of the largest ocean. The gems along its body provide a faint light that attracts many other aquatic Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: Divers are warned to avoid the darkest sea caves due to POKENAME potentially living within. Hidden along the walls, its presence forces divers into a slumber, dooming them to sleep forever beneath the depths.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known to be an excellent astrologer among Pokémon. However, its pride shatters whenever passing travelers correct its mistakes.
author: xenophacilus

entry: The radiant gem of POKENAME shines brightly in dark ship graveyards, attracting unsuspecting explorers. When they draw near, it swiftly removes their oxygen tanks and traps them in its grasp.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME create laser barriers that instantly send radio signals to them if an object has passed through. This highly advanced laser system has led to museums employing POKENAME as their security systems to protect their valuable artifacts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME skitters around the ceilings of caves, blending in with natural crystal structures. It ambushes its prey by firing powerful jets of water from its mouth. The crystal on its back is sometimes used in laser technology.
author: huh.7

entry: Strange flames burn constantly on its tails. POKENAME communicates with others of its kind by flashing its eyes a vast assortment of colors; when communicating, its fire will change colors to match its eyes.
author: sk372

entry: It lies at the sea floor, bathing in the refracted light of the sun. If enraged, it ascends out of the seas, boiling the waters around it as it rises.
author: togetik

entry: It's said dead stars were fused into this Pokémon. It absorbs starlight at night in order to charge the red gems that destroy everything in its path.
author: alliveir

entry: The body of a POKENAME appears completely solid at first, but it is actually extremely malleable and amorphous. It is often attacked by other underwater Pokémon out of fear of its looks, but will simply regenerate as if nothing had happened.
author: infinex21

entry: Old fairy tales depict POKENAME as a Pokémon born of the stars, capable of granting any lost child's wish to return home.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: Every few rotations, the cores in each of POKENAME's gears will flash a sequence of lights. It is thought this is a form of communication, but what it communicates and to whom is currently unknown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can rarely be seen out of the water when it uses its psychic abilities to envelop itself in seawater. They are more commonly seen floating at night, disappearing underwater at daybreak.
author: mepp.

entry: It is a capable flyer thanks to its electrokinesis. It's theorized that the first sightings of UFOs were POKENAME flying through the night sky.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME emits a bright flash from the crystal in its center that acts as a sensor pulse for it to survey its surroundings. It rolls its way to the nearest body of water to rest at the bottom and wait for its evolutionary process to complete.
author: sk372

entry: Found within coral reefs, POKENAME scuttle across the coral and hunt through the reef for prey. They use the many gems studded along their backs to absorb sunlight and release energy pulses to stun their prey.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Found within coral reefs, POKENAME scuttle across the coral and hunt through the reef for prey. They use the many gems studded along their backs to absorb sunlight and release energy pulses to stun their prey.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The gem-like tip of a POKENAME's nose can often be sighted by its bright glow, even within the dark ocean depths. It spins its rear-most fin at incredible speeds, which propel it through water at frightening speeds.
author: infinex21

entry: Sought out by treasure hunters for its valuable core, POKENAME places a maddening curse on whoever dares touch it. Only its Trainer is spared.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: POKENAME's wings shimmer and twinkle during the night. Gazing too long at its unfurled wingspan will lead to being hypnotized and potentially becoming its prey.
author: sk372

entry: Its body emits a cosmic energy said to be the concentrated essence of the stars. Those who gaze in its crystals are forever entranced by their beauty.
author: volvonovic

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand to absorb sunlight, appearing to be a beached Starmie to most observers. Those that try to touch it get blasted with a spray of stinky multicolored pollen from its core.
author: sk372

entry: Despite having no discernable eyes, POKENAME is able to find prey easily. It's thought that it is able to sense changes in the light with the gem atop its head. The venom it produces has been used to create blood pressure management medications.
author: chibitales

entry: A POKENAME's shell is nigh-impervious to most physical attacks and is lined with poisonous bars that usually deter the very thought of such attacks. It will create blinding flashes with its inner gem-like core to catch its foes off-guard.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will regularly appear before lost travelers in the desert to guide them to water and shelter. However, its sinister appearance often causes it to frighten those it intends to help.
author: griddle

entry: Every time it sees its Trainer, it is so happy that it wags while the gem on its face shines intensely. In the wild, POKENAME spends all its time splashing among the ocean waves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Often found protecting coral reefs, POKENAME are only visible due to their glowing gems. On clear nights, they swim to the surface, challenging any who cross their path.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A running POKENAME leaves lights behind it resembling shooting stars. Its gem-like eye is said to see the future, hence its state of constant panic.
author: pokepower

entry: It flutters over beaches in search of lost travelers. The dust it releases from its wings brings sweet dreams to those who sleep beneath the stars.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: At dusk, the light from POKENAME's gem can be seen from great distances underwater. According to Hoenn folklore, finding one of its shed gems is a sign that one's true love will soon reveal themselves.
author: mepp.

entry: The colorful wings of a POKENAME sparkle with star-like patterns as they flutter about. Some believe that the scales that shed and scatter from their wings are the Stardust that is so often favored by collectors.
author: infinex21

entry: On starlit nights, POKENAME rise from sandy beaches in groups. Their illuminated gems form shifting displays that attract tourists.
author: .izik

entry: Focusing energy through their crystals, POKENAME encase their body in electricity to increase their speed. If they build up enough speed, they launch into the air to fly among the stars.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: What at first appears to be a red pearl within the hard, spiky shells of these Pokémon is, in fact, their sensitive core. They have learned to use their own core to lure in prey and then clamp down on them until they stop struggling.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's internal gem is valued highly amongst jewelers. Its pointy shell is as sharp as a diamond and protects it from anyone who attempts to seize the gem inside.
author: ambrosia04

entry: At low frequencies, laser waves emitted from the core on POKENAME's nose are harmless and are used only for communication. However, at high frequencies, these laser blasts are destructive and can rip through layers of rock.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME styles itself after fictional intergalactic superheroes. On rare occasions, it makes odd and seemingly meaningless poses, looking to the sky.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME keeps a cool head at all times, leaving its emotions almost inscrutable. It's capable of firing powerful beams of light from the core on its shell as well as its sunglasses.
author: sk372

entry: Its bell tolls inaudibly. However, researchers have proven that whenever POKENAME tolls, another bell answers from outer space.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME floats near the seafloor as it searches for prey. When it singles out a target, it uses Flash to disorient them and engulfs the target in its large mouth. The large gem above its mouth clamps down and acts as a stopper to prevent escape.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of water and condensed stardust. At night, it launches from the ocean waves and looks like a shooting star because of its glittering gems and tentacles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME communicates with others of its kind by flashing its gemstone and gel orbs with a variety of different colors and speeds to indicate different messages. Its tentacles sparkle with dots that resemble constellations, but none that are known.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If even a single ember of its flames remains, POKENAME can regenerate its body. When moving at top speed, POKENAME can run across water with ease.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Research suggests a Shellder's consciousness inhabits the dazzling red jewel at the end of POKENAME's tail; it seems the Shellder can telepathically communicate with POKENAME, but POKENAME never seems to listen or respond to it if so.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is known to cling to the outside of submarines, as its magnetic charge pulls it to the metal hull. It is tolerated because its gem glows in the dark depths of the ocean, which helps researchers conserve electricity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are unable to remain in one area for long, as they lose their electrical charge if they remain still. To remedy this, they hitch rides on submarines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in lakes hidden deep underground. Stones taken from its body glow in the seven colors of the rainbow when light hits them just right.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Using Hypnosis, POKENAME shares gorgeous visuals of outer space with others. Researchers believe these depictions are memories of its former home.
author: noel5229

entry: The hand-like appendage on POKENAME's tail concentrates its psychic powers. It will use this hand to grab berries from trees a few feet off the ground. It seems to enjoy juggling these berries for fun.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its bone to form invisible walls around its foe. This confinement gives it time to slip away into nearby cover.
author: .izik

entry: Scientists are baffled by POKENAME's seemingly endless chain of handkerchiefs, which are made of surprisingly high quality fabrics.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME enjoys blowing gasses into a variety of shapes to entertain others. If it is ignored, it may angrily expel all of its contained gas in a silent Explosion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME create invisible walls using their feet. They can crawl up these invisible surfaces, creating the illusion that they are floating in midair.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME shapes its gas clouds into objects, then uses its psychic abilities to animate the cloudy images. It uses this to entertain others and to frighten away predators.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Every one of POKENAME's tentacles ends in a hand made for miming. Should one be severed, it likes to grab the wriggling vine and wave it at others to unnerve them. Removed vines grow back in a few days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are drawn to Pokémon specifically on their birthdays, which they consciously know due to their strange psychic powers. POKENAME will actively care for lost Pokémon until their nests or trainers come to collect them.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME playfully blows bubbles at others to get their attention. Once it does, it attempts to dazzle them with displays of bubbles blown into specific shapes and objects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys putting on performances for its Trainer. One such performance is where it flies in a confined space pretending to be trapped in a box.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Those that suffer from the fear of mirrors can often link it back to an encounter with POKENAME. Rumours abound that POKENAME would trap these people in a hall of Reflects, taunting them through the reflections.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's behavior has become random and chaotic, acting with no rhyme or reason. It seems to operate under the belief that it can do anything.
author: sk372

entry: Its superb skills in pantomime and prestidigitation are appreciated even within royal palaces and castles. Beyond entertainment, POKENAME is also capable of creating psychic barriers through the imposition of hands, which can deflect incoming blows.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME always acts as if it were performing, which gives it an extremely eccentric personality. It's known for its graceful movements that charm its audience, and it also surprises them by creating ice barriers so thin they appear almost invisible.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wants to have a lot of friends; it's a very kind and pleasant Pokémon. However, beware POKENAME when it is hungry: It will not be friendly!
author: mrbapcik

entry: Due to its horrifying appearance, many run from POKENAME in fear of it harming them. In reality however, it only wishes to settle down in a warm home.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME wants to have a lot of friends; it's a very kind and pleasant Pokémon. However, beware POKENAME when it is hungry: It will not be friendly!
author: mrbapcik

entry: It loves to play with children, pretending to get rowdy only to get a laugh out of them when it drops the act. Its balloon tails regrow when detached.
author: mx_wellman

entry: This Pokémon never shows any sign of laughter or joy. Even while playing with others, its face remains completely expressionless.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If it ever senses sadness from its Trainer, POKENAME will perform in an attempt to cheer them up. As a last resort, they will try to hug them.
author: spriter

entry: Cartoons featuring POKENAME were very popular in past generations. It has a manic, zany energy to it that caused many wacky scenarios to occur over its years of televised adventures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shows up on computer screens wanting to play with users, mimicking the movements of their cursor after a delay. Failure to play along results in it putting up barriers around data, leaving it inaccessible until the user plays with it.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME's scythes glow pale blue, it is erecting invisible barriers in its immediate area. It does this to stealthily corner prey without them realizing.
author: .izik

entry: The extended fingers that form POKENAME's wingtips are specialized, releasing a minute psionic field that allows them to stay airborne without flapping their wings.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME is a performer at heart, despite its large frame. Large crowds will gather to watch its seemingly impossible balancing acts, unaware of the invisible support bars it creates for itself.
author: lampent12

entry: This variant of POKENAME mimics the appearance of a portly chef from the middle of nowhere. Said chef was once popular for a short period of time.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME entertains others with amusing acts involving its own clumsiness. After it ends up in some sort of funny debacle, it ends the act by giving a comically bemused shrug to the audience.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to dance, and especially love to mimic street performers. Due to their overeager and impulsive personality, they can be difficult to train for inexperienced Trainers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses it's fake walls to trap prey under the water before clamping down on them with 2 trillion pounds of force.
author: dusknoir64

entry: Colloquially referred to as the “Foolish Weasel”, POKENAME is filled with boundless playful energy. It enjoys playing pretend with children, though its psychic energies often project imaginary objects into reality.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Suffering from insomnia, sleepy POKENAME are often found in the morning having bumped into trees during their nighttime hunts. They never take off their lucky hat when they try to sleep.
author: spagalapof

entry: POKENAME move through the forest in eerie silence. Though harmless, they tend to make hikers deeply uncomfortable.
author: dylonk25

entry: The inside of POKENAME's mouth is lined with tiny beaks. Some explorers hear squawks and think it's a Pidgeotto, only to notice they are entrapped in invisible boxes before it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces a thin psychic barrier to protect itself while flying. This barrier also protects it from any attackers, but a strong gust can weaken its barrier temporarily.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The balloons that POKENAME creates are charged with static electricity. Touching one will cause it to burst and let out a nasty shock.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is constantly dancing. It is claimed that the more people believe its dance is for the sun to come out, the faster it will happen. In a popular fable, an entire village believed it, and the sun came out in the middle of the night.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME constantly performs, whether miming with invisible objects or mimicking trees and statues. When rain threatens to end its show, POKENAME creates an invisible umbrella to protect itself and continues without a care.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME constantly performs, whether miming with invisible objects or mimicking trees and statues. When rain threatens to end its show, POKENAME creates an invisible umbrella to protect itself and continues without a care.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses the hand on its tail to cast Light Screen around trash cans it claims as its own. It does this to stop others of its kind from stealing its food, ensuring its food stash remains protected.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its appearance, POKENAME prefers to live underground. Some people claim it whispers suggestions to them when no one else is around.
author: gp423

entry: Parents are warned not to have POKENAME as a pet for their child due to their mean streak. POKENAME attack by shooting out their petals, taking time to laugh every time they land a successful hit.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME drifts through water as though it were thick mud. Prolonged staring causes onlookers to believe the same, tiring themselves as they swim. Exhausted victims sink, where POKENAME waits to feast.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME drifts through water as though it were thick mud, slowly chasing swimmers. Anyone that meets their eye believes they too are swimming through mud, rapidly tiring themselves as they swim. Exhausted victims sink, where POKENAME waits to feast.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME holds a protective barrier in front of itself at all times. However, it doesn't turn to face potential dangers, making the barrier useless.
author: duskrd

entry: This fusion is perhaps one of the most haughty that this world knows; it considers all Pokémon as its court.
author: elevn.

entry: Sometimes when a Mr. Mime takes acting like a Shellder too far, it leads to unintended consequences. Because of Mr. Mime's acting abilities, POKENAME possesses the same degree of unparalleled intelligence that Slowking does.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The hand on POKENAME's tail erects invisible walls around dumpsters as it feasts. This ability keeps competitors at bay, ensuring it can eat without interruption.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's long arms wrap around pine branches and secure its location by gripping its pink shell. It watches humans intently while hanging from trees, learning their behaviors and using this knowledge to corner them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tunnels are riddled with trap holes for those who try to infiltrate its home. It uses invisible walls to navigate its perilous tunnels, ensuring that only those who know the way can escape unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: Although many make fun of the silly appearance of this Pokémon, POKENAME care little about the laughs at their expense. They encourage the jokes and only strive to make people happy.
author: jangodiot

entry: With its hands, POKENAME can create such robust and invisible barriers that it is used by some companies and even government agencies for security.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is an expert at juggling, using both its hands and horns to toss the figures it carries around. It is quite popular at bug-themed parties due to its appearance and the Bug-Pokémon-shaped items it uses in its acts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses Barrier to wall off its cave before hibernating during the winter months. This stops the cold and others from entering, allowing it to sleep peacefully for many days.
author: .izik

entry: Incredibly lazy and mute, POKENAME pantomime to Trainers and other Pokémon to demand food and drink. If it is not brought quickly enough, they grow angry and strike with surprising ferocity.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME controls the secretion of a slick, transparent slime from its shell. At Pokémon gathering places, it selectively leaves trails of slime, causing others to slip and fall. POKENAME appears to do this solely for amusement.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME is a common Pokémon in the entertainment industry. It is beloved for its humorous noises and dances.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME spews colorful confetti from its mouth as a diversion, giving it an opportunity to flee an enemy or deliver a surprise attack.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is a common Pokémon in the entertainment industry. It is beloved for its humorous noises and dances.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has a fantastic singing voice. It often competes with Jigglypuff in singing competitions across the world.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME uses psychic powers to inflate its horns and spinal trunk. While this may have been a warning behavior in the past, it now serves to cushion impacts made while POKENAME clowns for the entertainment of baby Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME produce invisible walls that act like green screens that obscure anything behind them. Many nefarious organizations harness these walls to hide themselves from CCTV cameras, preventing police from identifying suspects as they rob banks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's additional arms aid them in performing tricks with the psychic orbs they produce. Taking part in their performances helps with bonding.
author: ohok3441

entry: In battle, this POKENAME's drawings can come to life to assist it in battle. Though mostly harmless, the animated drawings can disorient and overwhelm POKENAME's foes, allowing it to attack in the madness.
author: wpb71809

entry: Eager to evolve and become stronger, POKENAME  intensely hones its physical and psychic abilities. It spends nearly 10 hours a day training.
author: mepp.

entry: Able to play a mesmerizing tune, POKENAME is said to even be able to enchant the likes of Seviper and Arbok.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: The dairy industry has repeatedly tried to popularize the farming of POKENAME, However all attempts have ultimately failed due to consumers reporting that POKENAME milk "tastes funny".
author: jacknerik

entry: POKENAME is often used by circus performers to provide vocals for their attractions. The pattern on its face usually delights small children.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Whenever it has an audience, POKENAME dramatically expresses sadness. It seems to cheer up when others are compelled by its performance.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's tongue is so dexterous that it only uses its other limbs on very rare occasions. It sustains itself by synthesizing the happiness of others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Unrivaled in the field of juggling, there is no limit to the number of arms POKENAME can produce. It likes to attract crowds with its performances so it can give out many high-fives.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME dig up sand and then scatter it into the air to act as a distraction and hide the invisible barriers they construct to hold back predators. Once the threat is lost within the sand, the POKENAME scamper away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: With the arms extending from its head, POKENAME mimes invisible walls around its opponent. The opponent becomes trapped, encased in a completely invisible box.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are often found on the street without trainers as street performers, dancing and entertaining in exchange for berries and other materials. These Pokémon are adept at manipulation and can almost always guarantee they get what they want.
author: jangodiot

entry: There is an ongoing debate amongst zoologists about the 'tusks' of hair POKENAME sports: Should they be considered facial hair or armpit hair?
author: kiwiarms

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME has enough psychic potential to be able to telekinetically move a boulder twice its size. Its red horns are sensitive to the emotions of others, allowing it to more easily evade any potential threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are almost always joyful and will happily put on an acrobatic performance for humans or Pokémon. Using their psychic powers, they can form nearly invisible barriers to walk and dance upon.
author: infinex21

entry: Although typically adverse to conflict, even wild POKENAME will form nearly invisible barriers of psychic energy to protect others. Their psychic potential is so great that they can simulatenously maintain at least ten large barriers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's sense of justice and honor are the two main reasons why younger Trainers look up to it. It's why it can often be seen depicted as a hero in films and television shows, setting a good example for kids.
author: cinnamoncreampuff

entry: An eerie shadow puppeteers the discarded shell of a Nincada. Despite their sinister appearance, POKENAME is anything but, performing shadow puppet shows for anyone who will watch. They apparently have a dark sense of humor, though.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It will frequently change its color to either trick its opponent or entertain its Trainer. The number of color combinations POKENAME can take on is said to range in the billions.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is theorized that as many as 108 distinct spirits make up POKENAME's spectral body. How so many souls can fit inside such a tiny car baffles researchers.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The flower on its back is synthetic. It likes to playfully squirt a fluid from the flower at others, but unbeknownst to POKENAME, this fluid rather stings.
author: roscoepcoleslaw

entry: Despite its monstrous appearance, POKENAME tries not to harm others with its jaws. Instead, it uses acrobatic skills to flee danger or distract foes with circus-like routines.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are a common reason of confusion, due to the fact that their name conflicts with their appearance as a jester. This has sparked joke rumors that they were kings in a Pokémon society but was demoted later on.
author: th3randomguy

entry: If POKENAME senses a tornado coming, it will try to wall off the area with Barrier to help others. Unfortunately, this sometimes traps people inside, making the protective measure double-edged.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hands move independently from its body to erect Barriers across the battlefield. This allows it to entrap foes, using psychic manipulation to control the flow of battle.
author: .izik

entry: This ginormous clown has long been one of the most popular circus attractions. POKENAME floats endlessly through the skies, and its enormous size scares off predators.
author: the_smirker

entry: If POKENAME senses disrespect, it traps offenders within invisible barriers. These walls are strong enough to withstand hurricane-force winds.
author: .izik

entry: This deity specializes in comedy and entertainment. It occasionally descends in secret to comedians to evaluate their jokes and offer useful advice.
author: planatical

entry: The sprout ingrained into POKENAME's skull controls its movements, allowing it to use incredibly strong psychic abilities. It uses its telepathy to see the world through others' eyes, gaining insight into their surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is beloved by many children as the huge, jolly juggler in circuses. POKENAME is also a secret guardian for its fellow performers, using its telekinesis to create invisible crushing walls against those who dare hurt anyone in the circus.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is beloved by many children as the huge, jolly juggler in circuses. POKENAME is also a secret guardian for its fellow performers, using its powers to create invisible crushing walls against those who dare hurt anyone in the circus.
author: beatdoof

entry: If its blade ever pops, POKENAME frantically pulls another balloon from its hand, mimes inflating it with a tire pump, and twists up a new one.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME makes its home on the roofs of power plants. Should it see a human nearby, it will study them intently until they are alone. At that time, its fur crackles with electricity, excited to pounce on its prey after entrapping them in Barriers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are happiest when they entertain people and Pokémon. They are excel in sleight of hand and juggling.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME likes to perform various circus acts for large crowds of people. Those who witness its performance are unable to look away.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A master performer and entertainer, POKENAME specializes in pantomime. Despite its desire to entertain, it is keenly aware of danger and will magically disappear into its hat if need be.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It's playful and loves entertaining people, especially children. If it sees someone who is unhappy, it'll try its best to make them smile.
author: imagine1.

entry: Though its specialty is pantomime, POKENAME is also a master at word play. POKENAME can quickly pick up language skills with its sensitive ears and manipulate the words it learns as if it were folding a balloon.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME get violent when their performances are interrupted. Their fighting style alternates between destructive jabs and psychic barriers that are coated in a potent layer of debilitating spores.
author: enemyphase

entry: POKENAME's soft plush body is able to move at surprising speeds during combat. It uses telepathy to predict its opponent's moves, making it a formidable foe in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats near playgrounds, entrancing children with its small balloon and psychic powers. It leads them to nearby forests, never to be seen again, vanishing without a trace.
author: .izik

entry: Common to industrial buildings, POKENAME can be found making its nest. When hunting, it creates an ultrasonic frequency to disorient prey.
author: inksans201x

entry: When POKENAME is scared, it will shoot out a burst of confetti alongside a small popping sound, startling its attacker. POKENAME is quite popular at birthday parties and other celebrations.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lines the beaches feigning injury by vomiting up its organs. It then takes shiny objects from those who approach it.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME has developed an interesting type of mimicry: despite their appearances, every one of its various differently-shaped accessories can function perfectly as a key when POKENAME wishes to lock or unlock something.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once popular entertainment Pokémon. Today, the sight of one often causes young children to cry.
author: bee4082

entry: The tails of a POKENAME are prehensile and move with remarkable precision. The orbs at the end of their tails allow them to create psychic barriers and grant them better control over their flames.
author: infinex21

entry: Although some people say they find these Pokémon to be disturbing, they are often found within cities or towns performing for audiences. They love to juggle multiple objects with their four hands.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are able to use their psychic powers to travel the boundary between the waking and dreaming worlds. They watch their audience with the eye in their stomach, granting a single wish to anyone who realises where they're being watched from.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME actively use barriers made of light to keep water out of their way whilst building their dams. Predators steer clear of a POKENAME due to their unsettling bucktoothed smile alone.
author: xiapher

entry: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for berries, breaching onto land to gorge on them. This messy eating habit leaves its teeth stained with juice, often unnerving those who come across it after its meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME commonly accompanies circuses, where it entertains people through singing and humorous pantomime.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME amuses itself by conjuring tiny flames with its tail while mimicking gestures to confuse foes. Though playful, its fiery illusions can start small blazes if not kept under control.
author: themegatroll

entry: POKENAME has a seemingly endless supply of balloons to give to Trainers. It can flawlessly recreate a Pokémon in balloon animal form.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is very cuddly towards those it meets. However, it is not very bright.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME maintain psychic walls around them at all times. At first this was thought to be a defense mechanism, but researchers found they're actually in place to protect bystanders from their lethal spores.
author: enemyphase

entry: POKENAME's eyes rotate rapidly in its gelatinous body during combat. It uses Reflect to prevent its soft form from being struck, creating a powerful defense against physical attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a seemingly endless supply of balloons to give to Trainers. It can flawlessly recreate a Pokémon in balloon animal form.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's main way of entertaining others is to act as if its swooping in for an attack, before knocking against an invisible wall and hitting the ground. Most specimens are known to have chronic headache issues.
author: sk372

entry: While flapping its wings, POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to toss its foes around the battlefield. Once they are exhausted, it opens its mouth, revealing jagged rows of sharp teeth to bite down on its victim.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an immobile Pokémon, only able to rotate. It never loses sight of anyone that comes near. It fires pink projectiles from its pupils.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME's hands rapidly grip the ground while it rolls down mountain slopes in pursuit of its prey. It uses Barrier to stop its prey from fleeing, cornering them before moving in for the attack.
author: .izik

entry: Trainers should be careful not to follow voices or sounds in dark, moist areas that should otherwise be quiet. POKENAME is widely regarded as clever.
author: gooeygamer69

entry: POKENAME attempts to entertain others with wild gesticulations and funny dances, but its efforts often fall flat, as viewers are too put off by its unnervingly wide and ever-present grin.
author: sk372

entry: While it appears to be a single Pokémon, POKENAME is a hive-like collective of smaller beings. There are more inside than it appears from the outside.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME naturally have great senses of humor, so it's said that you can avoid conflict with one by telling a good joke. If it likes the joke enough, it may even give you a round of applause, which is more dangerous than fighting it.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's body bends and moves in unnatural ways during its cheer. Some say that if you see it dancing alone at night, it will use Reflect to entrap you before it feasts on your fear.
author: .izik

entry: Sought out for its artistic skill, POKENAME is a popular pick amongst circus performers. It can create invisible constructs as part of its act.
author: pory

entry: When on the hunt, schools of POKENAME will swarm around a creature and trap it within invisible barriers. The school waits until the prey exhausts itself trying to escape before deactivating the barriers and descending upon it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is rumored to trap children in psychic boxes and drag them into the deep. However, it actually brings them to shore. People just chase it back into the sea before it can finish.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Eating parts of a POKENAME's body gives many health benefits, though finding one isn't easy, as it's burrowed in the ground most of the time. If it's attacked, it can create a protective, spherical force field around itself for a short while.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The plumes on POKENAME's head are balloons that it picks off and puts on strings for children. These balloons contain noxious gases, so do not pop them.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's prodigious sideburns also function as effective wings, allowing it to flutter about and glide whilst freeing up its hands for the theatrical gesticulation it uses to mesmerize prey.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's flower is made out of a colorful, bouncy material. It allows small Pokémon to play on its flower. If the flower deflates, POKENAME will wilt away.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME feeds on stolen emotional energy, preferring positive feelings due to their preferable taste. To serve this goal, it will put on ethereal puppet shows that bring anyone who watches them incredible joy.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME often sits on the shelves of toy stores, waiting for someone to take it home. Be very careful if you end up with one, because they have a boiling-hot temper.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME can be seen performing for children, showing off marvelous feats of strength. However, it hates its own appearance and will flee in terror if anyone mocks how it looks.
author: mistymagius

entry: Nicknamed "The Fighting Clown" due to its appearance, POKENAME does its best to make a fool of its opponents with unpredictable movements and distracting gestures. The more serious the opponent, the harder it tries to make them look foolish.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are commonly seen in haunted houses and other horror attractions due to their frightening appearance. Despite how they look, these Pokémon are usually harmless, chasing after people and then colliding with invisible barriers when too close.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME brings whimsy wherever it goes. The swirling of the giant mushroom cap lulls foes into a false sense of security.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME lure children to it with the sounds and smells of a circus. Any who attempt to enter it will have their soul drained.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME were once used in traveling circuses, where they would perform feats of strength. Nowadays, they can be spotted at carnivals or fairs, guiding humans to play games.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are recruited by members of villainous organizations to help steal valuable assets from museums. Their ability to create platforms out of thin air and the sticky pads on their hands make them well-suited for the task.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's iconic and familiar appearance resembling the circus is all mere illusions: its true body is actually very similar to Torkoal. Even the fireworks it can fire off are just colorful displays of psychic energy covering smoke and soot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can create invisible walls that float in mid-air, blocking other Pokémon from getting close to them. They sometimes forget where they have created these walls and crash into them, fluttering helplessly against their construct.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's lilypad is made entirely of a modified version of its Light Screen. It uses this to keep its nose dry during rainy days, allowing it to comfortably navigate through wet environments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates powerful fire barriers using precise hand movements and its blazing tail. Its ability to generate thermal illusions makes it a tricky opponent, deceiving enemies with scorching mirages.
author: themegatroll

entry: POKENAME enjoy putting on performances for young children, using their tunnels to appear and disappear seemingly at random. These performances work best with children who are still entertained by games of hide and seek.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Each POKENAME have a different set of jewels adorning their body, depending on their parents' diet. They manipulate the way light refracts through their crystals, giving them a sparkle more brilliant than any natural material.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each POKENAME have a different set of jewels adorning their body, depending on their parents' diet. They manipulate the way light refracts through their crystals, even able to make them appear almost invisible.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME constructs invisible barriers within its tunnels to deter intruders. These walls can persist for hours, greatly frustrating miners.
author: .izik

entry: Some POKENAME make their homes within city sewer systems, making their tunnels directly into the sewer walls. They love to put on performances for passing children, pressing themselves up against storm drains to do so.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy putting on performances for young children, using their tunnels to appear and disappear seemingly at random. These performances work best with children who are still entertained by games of hide and seek.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Primarily found in abandoned buildings, POKENAME projects dread-inducing music into the minds of intruders of its territory. It does not make noise externally, but it will mimic using its detachable crest as a flute while dancing a jig.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's name is commonly misspelled as "Mr. dread." This is thought to arise from the dread it induces in many who see it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME creates walls around its foes to trap them in an enclosed space before releasing a bloodcurdling scream. It typically reserves these screams for foes that bully others, as it has a strong sense of justice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A master of kabuki, POKENAME is known to engage in battles just to force foes to watch its performance.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME meditates to stimulate its imagination and come up with better miming techniques. After enough meditation, it can reshape the barriers it creates by miming into different shapes, often in the body shape of its foe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often found in taverns, entertaining guests with juggling shows. Despite its playful and jocular demeanor, it is also a skilled fighter; it immediately steps in to drive away any troublemakers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is too shy to put itself out there, so it spends its time alone workshopping new routines to one day entertain the masses with. This has earned it a loyal fanbase.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME will do anything to get a laugh, and their malleable bodies make them naturals at slapstick comedy. Their mustaches are actually highly sophisticated sensory organs that detect humor particles.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME resemble a children's toy that has a head attached to the inside of the box. They bounce to wind themselves up and jump in front of children to give them a fright.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME experiences a headache a day at minimum, and Trainers will always be able to tell. It mimes out and exaggerates its movement to seek remedial help.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME makes a quiet oinking noise while erecting invisible walls. It does this to section off portions of its nest from predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hands have short reach, but a powerful grip. Its mouth hangs permanently agape, so whatever food it grabs must be thrown into its mouth and swallowed whole.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are popular during birthdays because they perform tricks for children. One of their most popular tricks involves spinning while making balloon sculptures.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While creating invisible barriers, a low jingling tone can be heard from within POKENAME's body. These barriers are strong enough to withstand a sledgehammer with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are easily angered, especially if their pantomiming is mocked. They often jail the offender in a box made of psychic energy and attack until calmed or removed from the situation.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is friendly and will voluntarily entertain baby Pokémon so their caretakers can do other tasks. It is known to mime an invisible block of ice around opponents before crushing both with its powerful flippers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lures in scavengers by exposing the pearl and fleshy insides of its mouth, and then it clamps down on them to feed itself. Inexperienced pearl hunters often sustain hand injuries after being fooled by this Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It can't see, so it listens for the echo of its own laughter to navigate. This tends to unsettle people who happen upon caves full of POKENAME.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Having adept psychic powers, POKENAME can create invisible objects by miming them. It sleeps upside down and suspended in midair, as if hanging from an invisible surface.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is incredibly intuitive to the emotions of others and has no problem giving them affection or intentionally being a little silly just to make them laugh. Studies have shown that POKENAME especially enjoys upbeat classical music.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME attacks foes with its hammer, unleashing its judgement upon them. While a little flat, it can release devastating power when it gets lucky.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Numerous urban rumours circulate about POKENAME, damaging its reputation and making it an unpopular choice among Trainers. Its chilling smile easily scares away other Pokémon.
author: the_smirker

entry: As a result of a recently famous stage magician having some as their partners, more and more Trainers have tried to raise POKENAME. While they are remarkably intelligent, each one has a very distinct personality.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME use mind-bending displays of power before an audience, even in the wild. They meditate prior to each performance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME use mind-bending displays of power before an audience, even in the wild. They meditate prior to each performance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a master of card tricks, supposedly. Its cards are invisible, so nobody can actually tell if it gets the tricks right or not.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME use their large hands to repel foes with invisible barriers before extending their vine-like tongue, using toxic spores to incapacitate prey.
author: raza

entry: POKENAME swiftly crawls through the darkness using its eighty flexible limbs. It hypnotizes its victims with its pantomime performances, then leads them into the wilderness to devour them.
author: adam_dnh

entry: POKENAME is a hit at puppet shows because the strength of its arms are tireless, allowing it to perform for hours. Though the mouths on its hands open and close, no sound comes out; researchers are still trying to figure out what they are meant for.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: If something steps on POKENAME, its large tongue will stick out. It is unclear whether this is an expression of irritation, mockery or amusement.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME will pantomime climbing via a rope. Somehow, doing this allows it to climb mountains with ease.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are popular at carnivals, happily giving rides to children around colorful tents. It has full control over its flames, allowing for anyone its trusts to touch them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME enjoys fishing lazily by the sea. The hand that protrudes from its tail will mime casting out a fishing line, and surprisingly fish Pokémon will get caught on the invisible fishing lure.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME can extend its back arm to a surprising length, able to grab far away food. As a result of this, it often lazes for hours at a time, occasionally moving to a nicer spot to lounge.
author: evilgammon

entry: Sharing the same body, the Mr. Mime segment of POKENAME is very protective of the Slowpoke portion as it sleeps, often forming invisible barriers to prevent anyone from disturbing its rest.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its tail is permanently attached to a dummy. POKENAME slowly wags its tail in an effort to puppet the dummy, which it presumably does for either entertainment or distraction.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME has the ability to create invisible walls out of thin air. The two heads are constantly at odds with each other, so they will often create walls to hinder the other head. Most damage done to opponents in battle is merely collateral damage.
author: huh.7

entry: POKENAME can make invisible walls out of thin air. These walls are also known to poison people who come in contact with them and leave behind a foul odor.
author: lordenzo

entry: No longer able to blend in, POKENAME leave their old caves in search of new homes when they evolve. Legally they cannot be within 100 feet of schools.
author: snookerron

entry: POKENAME construct invisible psychic barriers along the beach, scuttling sideways whilst constantly creating a longer and longer wall. Beachgoers are advised to remain aware of POKENAME populations as they can be a trip hazard.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept combatants, conjuring invisible barriers in front of themselves whilst scuttling around them to launch psychic blasts. They keep their distance whilst battling, their constitutions too frail to risk direct combat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept combatants, conjuring invisible barriers in front of themselves whilst scuttling around them to launch psychic blasts. They keep their distance whilst battling, their constitutions too frail to risk direct combat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: To prepare for parties, POKENAME cram confetti into their cannons, condensing the material into the cramped space. Once the party starts, a forceful jet of water breaks up the confetti and spreads it around the room.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME doesn't absorb enough solar energy, it stays hungry and becomes aggressive. It sharpens its scythes on hard stones found in its jungle habitat.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It uses its wings to slowly descend to the water's surface to drink. Occasionally, its wings flap too quickly and send it under the surface.
author: .izik

entry: All of POKENAME's heads work together to build their nest, cutting off small tree branches and organizing them into a sturdy structure. Once they are done, they don't move from their nest until they are ready to evolve.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wields parts of Scizor's exoskeleton in battle, the partial pincer it uses being effective at cutting and bludgeoning. It maintains the pincer by sharpening it against rocks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends all day practicing with its twin blades. Eventually, it clears an entire section of forest down to the dirt, causing dust storms.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses its tongue like a lasso, reeling in Pokémon before attacking with its blades. This tongue is surprisingly strong, even allowing it to grapple onto high places with help from its wings.
author: evilgammon

entry: Its shell gets harder if it panics. If it encounters an enemy, it will fly for a short period of time before colliding its hard body with its foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sharpens its scythe-like horn against stones. At maximum sharpness, its horn can cleanly cut through a thick tree trunk with a single swing of its head.
author: sk372

entry: The fierce appearance of POKENAME is enough to frighten predators away from its egg. This is fortunate for the POKENAME because its scythe arms are too short to be used effectively as weapons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME obsesses over the height of the tall grass surrounding its home, cutting it down whenever it grows too long. It even prunes its own vines with its scythes if they grow too lengthy and unruly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's belly is the most durable part of its body, which is good as its baby is not yet aware of the damage its claws can deal. POKENAME is violently defensive of its baby, so the Safari Zone has Rangers monitor it closely.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is pacifistic and prefers using its scythes to pierce into berries to eat them. Though gentle, it is rather selfish and will swat at anyone approaching it while it eats.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was first discovered in the middle of Kanto, deep in the woods, just after a strong thunderstorm. It protects its territory with intense ferocity, but it is not disagreeable outside of those circumstances.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME slices trees just deep enough to release sap. It then clamps onto the opening and drinks until satisfied.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's scything tail is coated with the same poison as its horn, resulting in wounds from it stinging quite badly. However, a simple antidote causes this stinging poison to wear off almost immediately.
author: evilgammon

entry: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon uses its massive scythes to defend itself from predators. It grows restless as it awaits evolution.
author: volvonovic

entry: Small enough to be carried in a fish tank, POKENAME depends on its menacing false eyes to keep predators away. Its facade melts when petted, as it enjoys snuggling up to its Trainer.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Strikingly fast, POKENAME darts through tall grass and across water with grace akin to a ninja. It scythes prey apart with its hardened blades in order to drink the bodily fluids that lie within.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its wings help launch it out from the water where it lies in wait to ambush prey. Though mostly adapted to land living, it still possesses gills that let it breathe underwater.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are highly temperamental Pokémon, becoming aggressive at the slightest provocation. Their wing membranes and crests shine a brilliant emerald when in light. Swarms of these Pokémon can devour a field of crops in mere hours.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are highly temperamental Pokémon, becoming aggressive at the slightest provocation. As they channel Electric-type attacks, their bodies shine bright turquoise. They discharge wild Thunder Bolts from their tails.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME despises others of its own kind and will often get in heated battles over territory. It impales its prey with its sharp stinger before slicing them to pieces while they are still pinned.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can wait for several days at a time to find the right moment to ambush prey, remaining motionless the entire time. Once it finds the right moment, it pounces atop its prey to deliver a swift death with its sharp scythes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is recommended that people steer clear of POKENAME while they're dancing. They will blissfully twirl and dance in the sun, their dress slicing through anything that gets in their path.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME ferociously clear-cut forests for reasons scientists don't understand. Impromptu lumberyards are set up to make use of the sudden windfall of wood when a POKENAME enters the region.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME are serious creatures that want to deliver perfection, whether it is a haircut or a Pokémon battle. They go into a primitive rage whenever they make a mistake, and it takes a firm yet reassuring Trainer to calm them down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possesses sharp bladed limbs but has a gentle and dim-witted demeanor. It mostly uses its blades to chop down branches or entire trees that grow its favorite berries.
author: sk372

entry: Should you encounter a wild POKENAME, run. Its scythes are sharp enough to cut through skin with ease, and its shell can deflect most attacks.
author: krune

entry: Unlike regular Dunsparce, POKENAME tails do not allow them to burrow underground. They instead use sharp appendages to climb trees and are sometimes seen hunting small POKENAME by leaping down.
author: notmax22

entry: POKENAME's physical defenses are unmatched as its hard metal exoskeleton protects it. Its blinding speed and sharp scythe-like forearms make it a threatening Pokémon.
author: mepp.
