entry: POKENAME can level an entire forest's worth of trees with its scythes if it puts its mind to it. However, it mainly uses them in combat, mostly to spar with other POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME helps carpenters cut wood into parts used for making cabinets, tables, chairs, and other furniture. Its razor-sharp claws ensure that its cuts are precise and accurate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon's wings are attached to its forearm scythes, granting it considerable flexibility in how it moves in the air. Each blade along its wings is as sharp as its scythes, allowing it to slice most foes to shreds with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: Though not particularly aggressive, POKENAME has an irritable disposition and gets agitated easily. If provoked too much, it disorients a target with a strange buzz from its antlers before striking with its bladed arms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their tails to both paint and slice through dense forests. They are skilled topiary artists, using their blades to create intricate sculptures out of shrubbery.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is an extraordinary fighter, able to maintain perfect balance even when upside down. By spinning its body at tremendous speeds, it wields its scythes to generate a deadly tornado of blades that leaves no foe unscathed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The scythe-like blade at the end of POKENAME's tail is strong enough to clash evenly with a Seviper's blade. The toxins that lace its blade cause intense, yet swift, pain and serve to impair its prey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME make up for their lack of range with their incredibly tough armor. This armor lets them charge headfirst through attacks, slicing through even the toughest opponents.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's large, scythe-like limbs are strong enough to cut through at least six trees with relative ease. It leaps and glides to fly, though its small wings can hold it aloft for at least ten minutes before it must land.
author: infinex21

entry: By infusing its scythe-like tail with electricity, POKENAME can make it float briefly and ride it with flawless balance, darting between the trees. It devotes much of its time to consuming berries, boosting its strength and restoring its vitality.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Groups of POKENAME are often recruited for assistance in clearing areas of dense vegetation. With their flawless coordination and razor-sharp forearm blades, they slash through any obstacles with ease.
author: sirg44

entry: POKENAME lives in thick jungles, cutting down thick vines using its scythes to wrap around itself. While not strong enough to fly, POKENAME will rapidly beat its wings to cool itself down during the summer.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME works together with barbers to cut hair for patrons while also developing the dexterity needed to win Pokémon battles. It practices every day to improve its technique so that it can fight with style.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lies in wait on the underside of thick tree branches. Once it sees its prey, it attacks with blindingly quick slashes.
author: stephanyx

entry: POKENAME help loggers cut down trees with the scythes on their hands. When they are not chopping down trees, they curl into a ball of spikes and take a nap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a bit cocky and rambunctious, trying to intimidate others with the size and sharpness of the scythe on its head. It keeps the area around its swamp home trimmed by cutting tall grass with the blade.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have the uncanny ability to sense danger, and flee fast enough to leave afterimages. During their escape, they are known to headbutt obstacles and even Trainers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are experts at fighting up close and can parry an attack with a flick of their bladed hands. Once their opponent is staggered, they can quickly maneuver into a counterattack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It floats around motionlessly without appearing to acknowledge any of its surroundings. Yet if something threatens it, the aggressor falls to unseen cuts slashing away at their body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's blades are sharp but precise, marking their territory with their own individual signature. Because of this, artisans will use their own POKENAME to sign their pottery.
author: mistymagius

entry: While slashing, POKENAME's blades shimmer with changing hues. Sunlight makes its attacks a dazzling display.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's blades are coated with poison, making it quite a dangerous Pokémon. However, outside of hunting, POKENAME will only attack those who threaten it or its children.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME flies low, searching for insect nests in trees. It uses the scythe on its head to slice the tree cleanly in half.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME charge forward before taking wide turns to deliver sweeping slashes with the blades on their heads. Their concentrated strength and momentum within their blades is strong enough to cleave through stone.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME silently wanders graveyards in the dead of night. It has inspired many haunting tales, often being referred to as the “Nemesis of Life”.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME wields its large ears like sabers, leaping across the battlefield with its tiny legs. If properly trained, it can cleave a tractor clean in half.
author: .izik

entry: Swift and deadly, this flying scythe has been the reaper of many bug Pokémon, endangering some species.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME often gets into fights with one another, beating their wings vigorously as a show of aggression. Its bladed horns are sharp enough to cut thick tree branches in a single slice.
author: mistymagius

entry: Their scythes can be moved very precisely; they can cut a single blade of grass in a single slash without disturbing the surrounding blades.
author: melodydelune

entry: Their muscular bodies allow them to swing their scythes with enough force to cleave through metal. They fight to their last breath to defend their packs and families.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are incredibly intelligent, ambushing their prey in packs before slicing them to pieces. While their arms might look short, they are able to extend them up to 15 feet to reach their target.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME cuts ivy from trees to feed on, then naps on high branches. It prefers to rest in groups with others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME sharpens its blades on landfill debris. Once honed, they can slice through tungsten with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME traps prey in thick rope-like webbing before finishing them with Fury Cutter. Some researchers believe this is an act of mercy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's blades grow hotter than a kiln during battle. Even a near miss causes burns from the radiating heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found in kelp forests, cutting through the thick kelp with its extendable blade. It is quite protective of its kelp and will try to chase away anyone that tries to take it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have fake claws that they raise high above their head to intimidate perceived threats. They are incapable of a slice larger than a papercut.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME are exceedingly energetic and train together in the mountains to sharpen their blades. They use mysterious waves called auras to determine whether to engage with opponents.
author: stephanyx

entry: POKENAME has an overwhelming amount of energy. To expend it, it slashes at tree branches nonstop with its razor-sharp scythes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings are too small to lift it from the ground, so it will jump from tall trees to attempt to get some air. It can often be seen falling headfirst into the ground, getting its sharp horns stuck in the earth.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME assists Rangers in clearing forests of sick trees, using its heated scythes to cut them down. It loves being rewarded with ripe berries, of which it is very fond.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can shape its membrane into a large blade, hardening it into a sturdy weapon. This weapon can be launched off its body and carried through the air by its telekinesis, then easily recalled.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME spins like a top with blades outstretched to slice foes. If this fails, its body blinks white rapidly before self-detonating.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will only use its scythes in combat, as it wants to keep its tusks nice and sharp. To make its den, it will cut down a thick enough tree and then hollow it out from the inside.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses jolts of electricity to paralyze its opponent before springing into action, slashing with its razor-sharp blades. Some claim to see it smile when it encounters resilient prey.
author: stephanyx

entry: POKENAME runs at speeds too fast for its small legs to stop safely on their own. When it needs to stop abruptly, it slices into the ground with its scythe tails.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has learned how to control its high rolling speeds. It uses its scythe limbs to aid in quick turns while hunting or retreating.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has learned how to control its high rolling speeds. It uses its scythe limbs to aid in quick turns while hunting or retreating.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Some people use POKENAME instead of a lawnmower. Its wings are razor sharp, and when it hears music, it begins to spin rapidly, slicing grass cleanly in wide circles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's fuzzy arms collect pollen that clumps into pom-poms. When they grow too large, it trims them back using its sharp legs.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Using its sharp arms, POKENAME snips petals from flowers and crafts them into dresses. It wears them proudly when it dances at forest clearings.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The wing flaps of POKENAME end in razor-sharp blades. To keep them honed, it regularly sharpens them against the blade on its tail.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It can spin its blades at incredibly high speeds, shredding through thick logs in a matter of seconds. Lumberjacks will often own a POKENAME as they act as efficient woodchippers.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its scythe-shaped petals are frail like paper, but just like a sharp page from a new book, they can still cause a lot of pain. However, their main use is to rotate as a fan to spread poisonous spores.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is more confident and aggressive than its stature would suggest. It will attack Pokémon far larger than it by spraying them in sleep-inducing spores if the fight takes an unfavorable turn.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It will exhaust its prey by forcing them to defend from its quick movements. It slices opponents with its claws and tail, before following up with its mane.
author: silverscloudy

entry: POKENAME cuts deep gashes into trees to mark its hunting territory, where it uses sleep spores to knock out prey that are too quick to chase. The mushroom's pheromones are used to add woodsy notes to cologne.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Each of POKENAME's scythes is enhanced with light energy, causing each cut to leave behind a glowing impression that lasts a few seconds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though not very physically strong, POKENAME is easy to aggravate and will pursue anything that enrages it. Its teeth are incredibly sharp, able to slice cleanly through tree branches.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hops atop the trees, slicing through thick tree branches with their large scythes. Other POKENAME will use their scythes to cut each other's hair when it gets too long.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME channels flames through the blade at the end of its wand. It can not only produce these flames but also control them freely up to 20 feet from its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been observed using Ariados silk as a scarf to protect against poisonous assaults. Its special hooked scythes allow this Pokémon to ambush targets around obstacles.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME can fly up to 90mph, cutting through oncoming trees with its sharp wings. It feeds on thick tree bark, often stripping the trees bare before it is satisfied.
author: mistymagius

entry: Although incredibly rare to find naturally in the wild, it seems POKENAME's natural habitat is deep in tropical jungles. Its fiery tail can safely be extinguished with no ill effects, but it lights right back up whenever POKENAME gets excited.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During combat, POKENAME extends sharp blades from beneath the ground. The strikes follow fluid, dance-like patterns that overwhelm opponents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in tall groups of seaweed on the ocean floor, closely stalking any prey that swims by. When it spots a chance to attack, it aggressively lunges.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is an expert at navigating the thick rainforest, using its sharp claws to both climb trees and clear away foliage. Its green skin allows it to blend into the canopy while stalking its prey.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can be seen swimming down the river, cutting through the reeds and kelp with its sharp blades. While its wings are too small to fly, they do help it propel through the water at high speeds.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME keep their bladed hand close to their chest, since the force they need to cut through foes is weakened if they stretch out their arm. They zip through water at blinding speed to ram their blade into foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME quickly track down any prey, even if said prey tries to flee. They are quick to anger and will lash out with slashes from their forearm scythes, so their territories are easy to find by the myriad scars left on the surrounding terrain.
author: infinex21

entry: The spiral on POKENAME's belly spins to lull foes into drowsiness. Once they fall asleep, it strikes with a flurry of sharp slashes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp implements, including its moustache-shaped mandibles, for productive and creative pursuits, such as sewing or shearing carpets. Both its physical agility and mental acuity are seldom matched.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME will root themselves into the ground, soaking up water from the soil. They will use their razor sharp scythes to slice up anything that gets too close.
author: santon5512

entry: Despite how sharp POKENAME's scythes are, it mainly uses them like hooks to climb up trees. However, if the blades are ever cut off, POKENAME will be stuck until they grow back.
author: mistymagius

entry: It primarily moves by swiftly and suddenly rolling around. Supposedly, if angered enough, the wings on its back begin to beat so loudly that the rocks covering its body explode.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spins its scythe like a baton to ward off pests, which helps protect crops. It spends idle time cleaning and sharpening its scythe until the next invasion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings are incredibly sharp, allowing it to slice its prey while running at top speed. However, POKENAME does need to be careful, as it could easily cut off one of its heads if it isn't paying attention.
author: mistymagius

entry: The amorphous bodies of POKENAME can harden or soften at will, which allows them to move through porous objects. These mean-spirited Pokémon often cut anyone who comes too close.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a territorial Pokémon found deep in the jungle. It can make itself appear numerous through otherworldly powers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME faces off against others of its kind in duels, clashing their scythes together until the opposing Pokémon gives up. These duels last from dusk to dawn, because they are more alert at night.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will use their scythes to slice up small clams and fish, ready for an easy meal. If their blades break off, they will regrow even sharper.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's lips are so cold they freeze anything they touch. Despite living in icy environments, POKENAME enjoys basking in the sun to keep its hair bright and lustrous.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its strong lips to stick to trees. It sheds its hair as a decoy, tricking predators into grabbing it without causing harm.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have multiple heads that are quick to disparage each other, but just as quick to make amends. They constantly gossip and prattle on about other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With a wave of its weapon, POKENAME generates auroras in the night sky. If it concentrates the energy into a single beam, it summons a stream of light strong enough to penetrate solid bone.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It dances as it fights, leading to its opponents becoming entranced by its movement. With its stretchy legs and swaying steps, this Pokémon crushes its foes with devastating kicks.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME is often underestimated in battle due to its feminine appearance. However, this is a big mistake, as it will take the chance to attack with a flurry of ice-cold punches and finish off their opponent with a kiss.
author: banjosaurus.

entry: POKENAME shivers within its cocoon and prepares to burst from its shell once its transformation is complete. It is known to rock back and forth to music and shakes with excitement whenever people dance alongside it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's young dances along with it from its pouch. Ever protective of its child, it will assault anyone who gets too close with bone-chilling breaths.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME produce scales that are ground into a bonding agent for specialty paint. Some villainous organizations have begun to produce cheap cosmetics made from their scales, causing police forces to investigate sources of cosmetics.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are active even during the wintertime. While they tend to be elusive and gather in places far away from human civilization, it is known a group of them will habitually flutter and move together in a synchronized dance daily.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sings a beautiful song as it spins around. Nobody has ever been able to precisely replicate the sounds it makes.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME work alongside stage magicians to perform tricks for audiences. They specialize in creating invisible barriers and leaving behind dummies made of ice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion becomes addicted to having a very strict routine, and they'll become violent at anything that attempts to break it. Some of them in the wild have been found to develop a sense of property, and even take care of other Pokémon as pets.
author: epping_forest

entry: Though you might not expect it given the way their mouths look, POKENAME are excellent singers. Historians believe they may have helped humanity invent the opera.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The most notable aspect of POKENAME is their voice, which sings a melodic tune that works as a form of communication with other Pokémon. Whenever they are threatened, they sing a song that instills a sense of dread in others around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Research into how POKENAME living in the wild are able to achieve such voluminous hair without using any product has been of great interest to the haircare industry.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME enjoys dancing while eating food. It has a variety of dances that vary depending on the type of food it is holding.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME's feathers are renowned for their softness and the unique ability to stay perpetually cold. Luxury pillows stuffed with these ruby feathers fetch exorbitant prices.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME darts through the air by lurching some distance at an odd rhythm. Its wingbeats are loud, but its erratic movement patterns still allow it to catch foes off guard and strike with its freezing stingers with incredible precision.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A rare yet demanding little fusion. The few who attempt to train POKENAME are often put off by its entitlement.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME are prim and proper regarding many aspects of their life. They are scared of making mistakes in front of others, so they lean into social etiquette to compensate for this fact.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in waterfall basins, using snares made of freezing silk to trap unsuspecting Trainers and feed them to their brood. Sometimes, a hungry Smoorak will lure people to POKENAME's lair itself, receiving an extra share for its cleverness.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME groom their garnet red feathers with delicate care to draw attention away from their talons. They prefer to be the center of attention and get jealous when attention is drawn away from them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are vain creatures and will fight against other Pokémon to draw the most attention to themselves. They are particularly feisty during the full moon, when they dance off against other POKENAME in a battle of beauty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its flight and singing are a mesmerizing display. Yet, depending on whether you're its prey, it might be the last thing you ever witness.
author: garret95

entry: When the sun is at its highest, POKENAME will gather in circles, wiggling their hips as they dance for the sun. Other Pokémon witnessing this can't help but join in.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME considers itself to be the most beautiful Pokémon, so it lies atop rocks in the ocean to catch the attention of sailors. It has yet to be successful.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME are so eager about dancing that they are considered a nuisance.They will block paths and dance until they are satisfied.
author: birchbot

entry: For as long as records show, POKENAME have lived alongside humans. It is believed that they evolved to consume a similar diet, as anatomical studies have shown similarities to filter feeders that consume mud and silt from rivers.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's mane is made up of silky hairs. It only trusts Trainers that can help it maintain its appearance.
author: ohok3441

entry: The eerie murmuring of a POKENAME causes many children to cry when they hear it. When they kiss people with their bright red lips, they leave behind an ethereal mark that lasts for a day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lurk near the peaks of snowy mountains, staring at Trainers through the fog. Trainers have described their gaze as cold and unnerving, and locking eyes with them for too long has been known to cause unintelligible murmuring.
author: santon5512

entry: This Pokémon has been described by some as alluring and by others as revolting. It dwells in damp underground caverns where it does nothing but continuously birth more of its vicious young.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME always try to stealthily snatch items from Trainers. However, after they secure their loot, they struggle to find use for things such as potions, devices, or money, which frustrates them to the point of having to steal something else.
author: epping_forest

entry: It aggressively dances as a warning when people or Pokémon approach its home. If they don't either leave or dance along in turn, it flies into a rage.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME slowly inch out onto the stage of operas during the closing act, taking centre stage and using their icy shell to create a dramatic mist. Their melodic cries are set to music, often meeting critical acclaim.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME twirls atop snow dunes, leaving delicate patterns in the frost. If approached, it unleashes a flurry of Powder Snow before fleeing into the distance.
author: .izik

entry: The thick fur covering POKENAME is colder than a commercial freezer. It sways rhythmically while singing a hauntingly beautiful tune that echoes through the tundra.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to make contracts with the denizens of the deep, manipulating other Pokémon to put themselves in danger so it doesn't have to fight them itself.
author: mistymagius

entry: Many POKENAME are featured in Castelia City fashion shows, advertising high-end designer purses. If interrupted during a performance, it panics and hurls a Present into the crowd, with unpredictable results.
author: .izik

entry: The territorial POKENAME uses its deafening call to scare intruders away from its mountaintop nest. When that does not work, POKENAME attacks with its steel wings and powerful claws.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: The figureheads of many ships were inspired by POKENAME's appearance. It tries to lure sailors toward large blocks of ice to trap their ships and force their crews to listen to its voice.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves the winter season. It struts into any situation with disturbing confidence and poise.
author: thehatster

entry: POKENAME spends its days repeatedly coating its plump lips with the lipstick secreted from its tail.
author: scotsman

entry: POKENAME are said to be able to sense the sorrow in others. Once they sense this, they begin to perform. Between their graceful dancing and soothing melodies, a wave of serenity crashes through even the most melancholy hearts.
author: noxid

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in its appearance; it can occasionally being spotted unconsciously grooming itself even when it is asleep. When it is not in flight, POKENAME walks with a flamboyant and showy strut.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It polishes its ice-clad tail until it can see its own reflection in the ice. It is at its happiest when it finishes this task and ensures its golden locks are still in order. When happy, it sways about as if dancing.
author: infinex21

entry: Even a single touch of POKENAME's lips can put anyone to sleep for hours. They always make good use of this quality to steal and feast upon the food of anyone passing by their caves.
author: epping_forest

entry: The ice shards that POKENAME blasts have a higher enthalpy of fusion than normal ice, though they're composed of the exact same water. Scientists are still confused, while bartenders use them for luxury cocktails.
author: epping_forest

entry: The ice crystals POKENAME fires from its hands can grow into large ice sculptures once they embed into a surface. POKENAME uses this to furnish its home into a veritable ice palace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are said to live deep inside mountainous volcanoes and only emerge after an eruption. The air around POKENAME quickly alternates between extremely hot and blisteringly cold.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a moody prima-donna of a Pokémon. Giving orders will only result in it turning up its head and flipping its hair, which flings ice crystals in the direction of whoever dares boss it around.
author: sk372

entry: If unmanaged, POKENAME's long fur tends to cause them to trip constantly. For wild POKENAME, it has become a hazard to their survival.
author: ohok3441

entry: The smooth, swaying icy blows of POKENAME's punches and kicks are only matched in potency by the kisses it places on defeated foes' cheeks after it wins.
author: bear_qo.op

entry: It freezes the air with its sensitive hands. Though blind, it can clearly see any object it chills with its telepathy.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME have a natural facial expression that resembles a grimace. That expression combined with their cautious movements make them appear more aloof than they are.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME behaves in a playful manner that borders on being flirtatious. For all but its Trainer, this behavior is a ruse to lull others into a false sense of security before POKENAME freezes them solid for fun.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes its appearance very seriously. If someone dirties it or besmirches its appearance, it takes great offense and lashes out using extending blades of ice from its elbows.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME speaks in an incomprehensible tongue that can drive listeners to madness. Its kiss brings a fitful sleep filled with surreal dreams as its unblinking eyes watch its prey.
author: empathnaga

entry: Glittering pollen called "diamond dust" spouts endlessly from its frigid blossom. When the sun shines on it in the early morning, POKENAME and its surroundings shimmer in a million hues.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME will use its powerful lips to attach itself to the side of ice caves while they sleep. It is said if you are ever kissed by one, you will slowly be drained of your body heat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME performs bashful dances to attract mates. Its golden hair is often used as wigs.
author: themicelegion

entry: Its skull is so thick, there's no room in the skin for the blood vessels that nourish healthy hair, so POKENAME is bald on top.
author: .realthree

entry: Its demeanor is unflinchingly bossy and cold, even towards its own Trainer. Deep down, however, it truly appreciates those who care for it.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Seldom seen, POKENAME is believed to only show itself to couples who are falling out of love. It's sometimes referred to as the Prophet of Heartbreak.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME appears on particularly cold winter nights to lead lost wanderers astray and carry them off to the spirit world.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can create portals with the spirit flames that accompany it, allowing it to travel long distances in a short time.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME lives in castles, ruins, and abandoned houses. It controls other Pokémon in the vicinity, which serve POKENAME apathetically.
author: chorb33

entry: Urban legends say that if a POKENAME attempts to kiss you with its the lips on its head, you should allow it. Otherwise, it will devour your soul with the mouth on its stomach.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: A single kiss from POKENAME can temporarily alter perception, causing victims to believe it divine. The effect consistently fades after roughly one week.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes, singing a cheerful melody. However, if anyone dares to skate alongside it, it shatters the ice beneath them, refusing to share the rink.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to be dramatic Pokémon that strike with flashy attacks. Giving them the discipline to focus on success over appearances will greatly improve their battle prowess.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Living in high mountains, it appears deceptively soft and warm. Don't be fooled; what seems to be fluffy wool is actually sharp, rock-hard crystal.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME are rare, but sought out by members of high society for their ability to grant people immense beauty. Studies into this Pokémon's long-term effects are ongoing, but rumors suggest they feed off their Trainer's life energy.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME rule over small groups of Pawniard with an iron fist, never showing an ounce of warmth to its subjects. It cares deeply about its appearance and will get its Pawniard to tend to it after every battle.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME are graceful in their movements. Their haunting voices can be heard echoing in the mountains.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME are beloved for their beauty and are often written about in nautical poems. The enchanting songs they sing have lured many sailors to their deaths.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME decorates its den with luxurious sculptures made out of ice crystals. If anyone trespasses on its territory, it will freeze them solid without a second thought.
author: mistymagius

entry: Their natural rhythm and delicate singing voices make them a favorite Pokémon among musicians. When they are young, they often trip over their fur.
author: melodydelune

entry: It flies high in the sky, practicing new and exciting belly dances all day. If bad weather gets in the way of its performance, POKENAME enters a rage state that lasts until it clears up.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME appears in people's dreams as a beautiful maiden asking for shelter. If the dreamer falls for this ruse, it drains their life force until they wake up.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The hair on POKENAME's head appears to have unusual protective properties that guard POKENAME from the effects of curses and spells from Pokémon such as Mismagius. If cut, the hair's properties quickly fade away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A daring and flamboyant Pokémon, POKENAME seems to take great pride in its appearance. It can speak in a language that Jynx, Lopunny, and other kinds of Pokémon do not understand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A daring and flamboyant Pokémon, POKENAME seems to take great pride in its appearance. It can speak in a language that Jynx, Lopunny, and other kinds of Pokémon do not understand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A daring and flamboyant Pokémon, POKENAME seems to take great pride in its appearance. It can speak in a language that Jynx, Lopunny, and other kinds of Pokémon do not understand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Some scientists once believed that, with the help of Rotom's ability to possess electronics, POKENAME may have allowed further study into Jynx's mysterious language. Unfortunately, POKENAME still only communicates with verbal gibberish.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The mysteries of POKENAME are many, but what we know is that its suits are made to handle freezing temperatures, it sings and dances on every full and new moon, and POKENAME's unshakeable confidence has led to it being a popular sports mascot.
author: bear_qo.op

entry: It never runs away from difficult duels, like battling for its Trainer or fighting over territory. However, what POKENAME really enjoys is to terrorize smaller and weaker opponents, just to play around, before kissing and putting them to sleep.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME toys with prey by forcing them to dance for their life as it spits out icy webs underneath their feet. When they ultimately fail, it shocks them with electricity and sings to them in a humiliating tone before finally devouring them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME toys with prey by forcing them to dance for their life as it spits out icy webs underneath their feet. When they ultimately fail, it shocks them with electricity and does its own taunting dance on the ice before finally devouring them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has icy cold tusks that are solid and strong enough to tear through steel. It shows these tusks off proudly as it dances.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME have a keen understanding of the need to maintain their appearance. They spend hours grooming their many tails and burn their tail fur to give a clean, glossy finish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it molts, its fur turns black and leathery. It weaves the shed fur into something resembling a purse, which it stores food and treasure in.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME have an opulent presence that comes from their refined posture and clean coat of fur. They spend hours perfecting their movements and appearance to appear as regal as possible.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A sure way to know if one is able to get out of a winding forest is to hear POKENAME's loud, opera-like singing. POKENAME often sings out in an open space, either to a crowd of fellow Pokémon or near any settlements.
author: beatdoof

entry: It cheerfully dances for others, loving having an audience to its bouncy movements. Anyone who watches a performance all the way to the end is rewarded with a big kiss, whether they want it or not.
author: sk372

entry: It is bashful and self-conscious, but extremely affectionate. Shown genuine love and care, it will trust you to the grave.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: A thick shell of crystalized ice covers POKENAME's sensitive body. POKENAME drops the temperature of its shell further as a defense mechanism when touched, causing severe cases of frostbite.
author: sk372

entry: While affectionate, these Pokémon are incredibly shy and protective. When angry they will scream at opponents, but when they are happy they will whistle instead.
author: rockageddon

entry: POKENAME's aggressive demeanor leads it to pick fights against stronger opponents. After the physically and emotionally painful defeat, it seeks to relieve its ego by kissing and defeating weaker Pokémon.
author: epping_forest

entry: Though hideously vain, it is nonetheless popular for its beauty. Wealthy celebrities have been known to own them by the dozen.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME stomps around frozen cavernous areas, particularly those heavy with pristine bodies of water or crystal growths. It prefers these areas as they provide surfaces for it to enjoy gazing at its beautiful reflection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shivers excitedly when it stumbles upon a berry bush. Before eating each berry, it kisses it delicately, as if savoring the moment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is so intensely cold that it rarely leaves its frozen cave. If an intruder enters, it greets them with a Lovely Kiss - right before devouring them whole.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soar through blizzards searching for lost travelers to kidnap. Their eerie song resembles opera music, as though they were singing in front of an audience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leaves are formed of very fine, hair-like strands that require constant maintenance to keep in good condition. They are popular Pokémon with Beauties who will strive to emulate their appearance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can project unusual frequencies from its ears that disorients friends and foes alike. Rarely, those who listen to it fall into a trance. Once alert, the victim only recalls hearing an unintelligible song.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can emit ultrasounds that can make anyone fall into a trance for a few minutes of hearing them. Within a 1km radius, everyone will start to feel as if their bodies and thoughts slowly vanish into nothingness.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its sticky goo isn't cold to the touch, but is so freezing that it's being explored as an alternative to refrigerate car engines and gaming GPUs. It regularly tends to cover its Trainer in gooey kisses and hugs.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's reaction to any living creature it finds is to brutally overload it with hugs and kisses. The only distinction it makes between friend and foe is to check if they're still breathing.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its skin dries out quickly, which is why it is constantly looking for water to moisturize itself. It also freezes some to apply it later as lotion.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can grow its ice spikes to a length of several meters to impale its opponents. It can use its detachable ice hat as a shield in a pinch.
author: chorb33

entry: The thick blonde hair growing from behind POKENAME's neck radiates an intense cold. It twirls gracefully in the snow, singing an unintelligible song that echoes through frozen valleys.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hone their claws by dancing during midnight. They somehow speak in a secretive language that only their Trainer can understand.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME are a common feature with certain musical performance groups due to their delightful singing abilities and their elegant dancing. They are, however, very diva-like and will also refuse to perform until their golden hair is neatly groomed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's dance casts cool snowy gusts around it as it leaps and twirls. Viewers are compelled to join in the dance, unbothered by the cold air as they follow POKENAME's graceful movements.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves behind a shimmering trail of frost as it flies through the air. Those who have seen it in flight report their next sleep being filled with dreams of living in excessive luxury and beauty.
author: sk372

entry: Because of their peculiar pigmentation, many Water-type Pokémon that they face thinks POKENAME is a Fire-type. This makes them act overconfident before realizing too late the truth about POKENAME's Ice/Grass typing.
author: epping_forest

entry: Hyper intelligent, POKENAME walk wintery streets, blending into the crowd with their stave hidden in a pocket dimension. When threatened, the stave reappears instantaneously and it uses Blizzard to cover its escape.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's gait is so quick and light that finding a naturally-made and distinct footprint proves difficult. Acrobatic and adept at maneuvering, it can climb and quickly scale frozen-over cliffsides.
author: bobosmith01

entry: What looks like hair is actually finely shaved ice. If you receive a kiss from POKENAME, the point of contact will be blue and frostbitten.
author: lampent12

entry: It performs rhythmic dances in urban areas, using its baggy skin to mimic the flow of a dress. Its soulful singing is punctuated by sudden, aggressive headbutts to keep unruly crowds at a distance.
author: willowwhisker_98658

entry: POKENAME inhabits icy caverns and bursts from frozen stone to greet intruders. Its sudden kiss can instantly induce deep sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrow through dirt and snow in search for food to eat. Anyone who gives them a bite to eat are peppered with kisses as a sign of gratitude.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dive-bombs out of the air lips-first in order to kiss its target. Its kiss has a mild paralytic effect, so this technique is most often used to stun a person in order to steal their meal and fly off.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make for popular companions to wandering merchants due to their ability to puff out miniature plumes of ice to keep themselves cool as they wander through deserts. They have an eye for valuables and adorn themselves with frosty accessories.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Should POKENAME's headache intensify, the psychic surge around it compels all affected to begin dancing for several minutes. POKENAME always seems confused by this development.
author: sk372

entry: Usually found singing or fighting, POKENAME are highly sought out for their versatility in both combat and everyday skills. Should they come across a Politoed, they will pursue it relentlessly.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The jewel on its forehead gleams and shines as it dances. Should one stare too deeply at it, they will be caught in the rhythm, forced to copy the movements until POKENAME has finished its dance.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME were considered the envoys of a fertility goddess. Their presence was thought to be a good omen for upcoming harvests.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME are known for their self-confidence, seeing every day as a new opportunity to strut their stuff and share their beauty with the world. They have become an icon for all who lack in the same trait.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME can be found making their homes high in mountain caves, their thick golden fur keeping them warm in the cold environment. They are solitary Pokémon and chase intruders away, their expression remaining eerily neutral as they race forward.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: To defend their territory, they perform a unique war dance that incorporates its cries. It is believed that it learned this from ancient cultures.
author: houndrys.

entry: The luscious, golden locks of a POKENAME are highly coveted. It can perfectly keep heat and cold balanced within them.
author: t.i.a.

entry: Champion-level wrestlers, POKENAME are popular with black belts and martial artists both as sparring partners and as a first choice for Pokémon battles. Their low body temperatures help them stay physically active by rapidly dissipating muscle heat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It seems this fusion has eroded Alakazam's intelligence to the point that it stares vapidly into its mirror-like spoon for hours on end.
author: scotsman

entry: POKENAME are very adept and swiftly moving their body to dodge attacks and to confuse predators. POKENAME smells and tastes bitter, so it's often avoided by predators anyway.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME releases a virulent poison through its hands that eats away at living tissue. Sometimes it forgets that its hands are coated with poison and ends up hugging its Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a common ritual for POKENAME, after successfully catching a fish, to dance in celebration of securing a meal. On occasion, it may forget to actually eat the fish after the dance concludes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's long blonde hair flows majestically in the air, even without wind. It uses its psychic abilities to make it billow dramatically, believing it enhances its beauty.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is capable of running over bodies of water by freezing the area underneath its feet. As a result of being unable to brake on ice, POKENAME will only run in straight lines.
author: rockageddon

entry: POKENAME hums a soft tune while performing an elegant dance on the ice. If a sailor approaches, it stops abruptly and attempts to drag them beneath the freezing waters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lounges elegantly on icebergs, humming loudly to lure passing sailors. If a ship comes too close, it fires Ice Shards to sink the vessel, ensuring its next meal.
author: .izik

entry: Being very prideful, POKENAME thinks of its sludgy exterior as truly beautiful, and wishes to share that beauty with others. It flings its goop at others to coat them with it and thus, make them as lovely as it is.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are popular with Beauties; their appearance is dazzling and something that their Trainers strive to emulate. They can create glittering displays with their elemental powers, ice crystals tracing through the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Being quite defensive, they are rarely seen out of their adamantine shell. However, they can be seen swiftly swimming in rhythmic patterns.
author: houndrys.

entry: Feared for its icy demeanor by sailors, it drifts away in cold waters. By speaking to its pearl, it can shoot and control hard, freezing spikes.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME is surrounded by a chilly gas that causes erratic behavior if inhaled. When still, POKENAME undulates back and forth in an odd and repetitive motion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Those kissed by a giggling POKENAME have their body temperature begin to drop. Seeing POKENAME is said to be bad luck.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is often seen scuttling about in a rhythmic fashion, clicking its claws together to make the beat for its dance. Nearby Krabby that witness it feel compelled to join in the chorus.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to steal accessories on beachy areas. They use these as props to entertain other Pokémon.
author: lemmymaster

entry: It sticks its tail into generators or other electronic devices to absorb as much energy as possible. All the electricity it gathers is stored inside the bulb on its back, which POKENAME uses whenever it needs to defend itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It plugs its tail into outlets to charge its body with electricity. If it absorbs too much, it risks causing widespread blackouts.
author: .izik

entry: By rolling continuously, it builds up an immense electrical charge. Once it reaches its limit, it releases the energy in a powerful explosion.
author: .izik

entry: It raises its bone-like clubs high during storms to catch and absorb lightning. When it strikes these clubs together, it can release bolts of electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Historically, POKENAME has been noted for its swift ability to learn and its reliability in all kinds of situations. To give its attacks an extra punch of power, POKENAME rubs its hands together and allows static charge to build up.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Historically, POKENAME has been noted for its swift ability to learn and its reliability in all kinds of situations. To give its attacks an extra punch of power, POKENAME rubs its hands together and allows static charge to build up.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If it concentrates hard enough, POKENAME can generate electricity in the form of limbs such as fists. With an aggressive temperament, it does this often in order to beat others into submission.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rapidly vibrates its body in midair to stoke more electrical energy from within its body. It can temporarily form fists made of lightning to deliver powerful electric punches to its foes.
author: sk372

entry: Herds of POKENAME will gather on mountainsides during thunderstorms. They compete to determine who will be allowed to get struck by lightning.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME moves across the regions searching for something. What it is searching for remains a mystery, but it is said that once it finds it, its electrical capabilities become highly advanced!
author: skleegamer

entry: A highly intelligent Pokémon with an even bigger ego. It can be seen tinkering with electronic devices for its mad plan to hypnotize other Pokémon into being its henchmen.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has an enormous ego that prevents it from ever admitting its own faults. It usually zaps any weaker Pokémon that annoy it, but its spark disappears the moment it faces a stronger opponent.
author: jangodiot

entry: It charges its dual scythes with electricity to execute powerful slashes capable of putting its opponents at a disadvantage. POKENAME leaps from branch to branch at high speed to recharge its body using kinetic energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a wild personality and asserts itself wherever it goes. It will take on any challenge with bravado, from swimming to climbing to battling.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They walk doing frenetic rhythmic movements that are very unnerving to see. Even the most skilled dancers have gotten injured trying to imitate them.
author: epping_forest

entry: An POKENAME's lightning can be as hot as a solar flare when excited. The lightning on POKENAME's body glows as much as ten torches.
author: gento_

entry: With fire in one hand and electricity in the other, POKENAME make formidable opponents indeed. Some Trainers say you can tell what kind of personality it has by which hand favors which element.
author: sk372

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME climbs to the tallest spot it can in order to attract lightning to strike it. If it does, it lets out a booming cry of triumph as loud as thunder.
author: sk372

entry: Electricity constantly crackles through POKENAME's sharp fur when it runs, sparks bursting from its body and leaving trails of static energy in the ground.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Many attempts to research this rare Pokémon have failed due to it shutting all electrical appliances down in a radius of several kilometers. The sheer amount of static electricity POKENAME stores in its body allows it to levitate.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME has complete and perfect control over its own electricity. It uses advanced psychic powers to ensure that every bolt of lightning it fires hits its target.
author: sk372

entry: Groups of POKENAME frenzy at the approach of a thunderstorm, all rushing to find a vantage point. It will even bite its own kin for a prime spot.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME can channel massive amounts of electricity into its claws. Swipes from these electrified limbs are so powerful, the swing itself creates a thunderous boom.
author: sk372

entry: If there's a blackout after a rainy day, there's a good chance that a group of POKENAME have eaten all of the electricity at the nearby power plant. They use the energy gained from the electricity to dance in celebration of the sun's return.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's rubbery body insulates its electric charge to protect others while it swims. Groups of POKENAME are dangerous for fishing villages since they hunt by discharging electricity into the water, devastating ecosystems the fishers rely on.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Due to its swift speed and ability to command lightning, any foe of POKENAME often finds itself unconscious before even knowing POKENAME was around. It has the ability to fire off high-voltage currents.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Electricity crackles on POKENAME's skin and jumps to anything nearby that tries to harm it. Trainers coat it in mud to dampen the charge, which POKENAME seems to enjoy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It sticks its tail into generators or other electronic devices to absorb as much energy as possible. All the electricity it gathers is stored inside the bulb on its back, which POKENAME uses whenever it needs to defend itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon amongst electrical engineers working around generators thanks to their innate ability to create electricity. The bulb on their back lights up as they create electricity and they are invaluable Pokémon for power plants.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME eat electronics to charge their bodies, channeling the electricity into their teeth. With a single bite, they can unleash a devastating Thunder Fang.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's two heads both battle if necessary. They use both Fire and Electric moves to counter many Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME often burrow deep beneath power plants, attracted to their constant energy. They sometimes sever important cables, but POKENAME's own residual charge is so strong, the power plants can remain running long enough to make repairs.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME rotates segments of its body to churn up the electrical energy within itself. Rotating fast enough will create a force field of electricity around itself that automatically zaps anything that draws too close.
author: sk372

entry: Their long horns serve as natural lightning rods and are often clad in electrical currents. A Thunder Punch from an POKENAME is often strong enough to punch through solid rock and char the edges around its fist.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME eats electricity and stores excess energy in its shell, becoming a living battery. Areas prone to blackouts host POKENAME as a portable power station.
author: oddwalls

entry: It perches high up within areas where thunderstorms are common, using its beak as a lightning rod to recharge its internal electricity. Overzealous Trainers often mistake it for being a wild Zapdos.
author: sk372

entry: While galloping, it produces a buzzing noise that grows louder with its speed. It unleashes bolts of lightning from its antlers to ward off threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often spotted around power plants, spinning on its head to feed on the electricity. When it is fully charged, it can power homes during blackouts; however, it is often the cause of them.
author: shyguy11011

entry: They reshape the landscape in singleminded rampages toward nearby power plants. If not stopped before consuming a plant's electricity, POKENAME become roving cataclysms, discharging colossal lightning bolts into anyone too slow to flee the area.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky, conjuring storms in their wake. They periodically unleash electrical energy through super-charged lightning bolts capable of tearing ships apart. Fortunately for most aquatic Pokémon, they avoid smiting those nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is notoriously grumpy and shocks anyone who comes too close. Offering it a Poffin is the easiest way to calm it down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's legs are too small for it to move effectively, so it walks around on its muscular arms. While its arms are preoccupied with movement, it slams its electrically charged tail into the ground in battle, creating stunning shockwaves.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME dwell most populously in the outskirts of major cities, swinging from power lines. They dash away into whatever little nature is around if approached; although generally cheerful, they dislike being scolded.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a massive constant charge within its body, allowing it to move at Mach 20. When cornered, it can produce a giant blast of energy.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME will dig through terrain to reach higher spots during storms in hopes of being struck by lightning. They curl up for defense and when they spin in place, they release electrical bolts around them.
author: infinex21

entry: Its highly developed thigh muscles provide explosive agility. Gangs of POKENAME compete during storms to be struck by lightning to recharge the bolt on their heads.
author: lj_breeze

entry: POKENAME is very feisty and particularly defensive about its reputation. If it feels it or a friend has been slighted, it will angrily rant and threaten the perpetrator with electrified fists until they've atoned for the insult.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ability to camouflage is weak until a thunderstorm is in the area. In that case, these abilities can be arguably more convincing than Kecleon. The color of its electricity varies with the weather.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in groups around lightning rods to gain natural power. They link their jaws together to amplify their electrical power. A group of ten or more POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a large city for a week.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that if an POKENAME starts following you, you are doomed to be struck by lightning in the near future.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME haunts factories at night, siphoning electricity from the machines until they're completely depleted. When fully gorged, a crackling aura of electric energy surrounds it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges its blades with electricity to slice through its opponent's tough defenses. Its metallic body protects it from corrosive acids that the opponent may use.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME creates large thunderstorms in deserts, capturing whatever is there during the mayhem. It often feasts on Sigilyph and Gligar.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Though it looks fierce, this jungle-dwelling Pokémon only eats fruits and loves helping others. Its pleasant personality makes it no less dangerous in battle, however.
author: kiwiarms

entry: They can use their feelers as cables to absorb electricity. POKENAME will often stand on rooftops and act like lightning rods during storms.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME enhance the performance of their muscles by stimulating them with electricity. Some have even been seen jumping into the sky during storms to try and kick lightning bolts as a form of training.
author: zeterzero

entry: Its tails crackle with electricity whenever it breathes flames. It consumes dry grass to fuel the fiery energy in its belly.
author: .izik

entry: The slime POKENAME covers itself with contains high concentrations of copper, causing lightning to be more attracted towards it. Reports have discovered it eating the electricity from underwater cables, disrupting global communications.
author: soup1900

entry: Blasting through stormclouds at blistering speed, POKENAME's feathers crackle with stolen current. It raids power lines mid-flight, snatching up whole cables before vanishing in a blur of sparks.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME balance on their tail to appear more menacing. Both their fur and powerful voice can cause static shocks.
author: ohok3441

entry: This Pokémon is full of energy; the more it runs and hops around, the more and more energy is built up, causing its body to grow hotter and hotter. When it grows too hot, it must release energy by expelling flame or electricity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hops around the undergrowth searching for rotting berries that can strengthen its body. When it gets nervous, it frantically shakes its striped tail and begins to emit electric sparks from its antennae.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME darts through stormy skies, chasing thunderbolts and snatching stray lightning from the air. It's drawn to power lines, where it perches proudly, until it decides to snack on them.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME are a common pest at power plants. Their electric attacks make it difficult for bird Pokémon to keep the population under control.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME loves damp and dark nights. Rarely, many gather and dance whilst emitting a bright light. Due to its cheerful attitude and abilities, some boatmen use POKENAME to help light the way back to shore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hunts its best during stormy nights. It masks its movements between the flashes of lightning, snatching up prey quickly and quietly before vanishing back into the storm clouds above.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME chase storms to collect lightning inside their bodies. Once they've gained enough charge, they produce new storms wherever they travel.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The fluff in its body generates electricity as it rubs together, creating powerful charges. It can fire bolts of lightning directly from its arms.
author: .izik

entry: As it leaps, its cape generates static electricity, releasing crackling sparks. When it lands, the impact echoes like thunder, intimidating its foes.
author: .izik

entry: The faster POKENAME rotate their arms, the more static that builds up along their bodies and the more their fur stands on end. The combination of the gathered electricity and the toxins within their fur makes an POKENAME's punch paralyzing.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME forms small groups with other cunning Pokémon to carry out raids in large cities. When they are not plotting, the group members fight each other for dominance.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is strong-willed and tries to act independently, going wherever it pleases without letting others know. Even a caught POKENAME may wander directly outside during a thunderstorm, which has caused more than one Trainer a lot of stress.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The moment POKENAME emerges from the ground, it can summon lightning strikes. These bolts are powerful enough to fell several targets at once.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often considered pests as they are known to dig and chew up electrical wiring. When full, the horns on their head crackle with sparks.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can channel its electric energies to energize its plus-shaped tail and coat it with sparking electricity. With enough effort, it can even rotate the lightning like a turbine and achieve short bursts of flight.
author: sk372

entry: The black markings on POKENAME's body produce a golden glow whenever it harnesses its powers. With the activation of its pearl, POKENAME can chain lightning strikes between multiple foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rapidly spin their arms to generate electricity; these flowing electrical currents also stimulate their muscles. When POKENAME becomes enraged, its electricity discharges wildly from its body as it swings at everything with its fists.
author: infinex21

entry: It digs up buried power lines to gnaw on the wires, charging its body with electricity. This behavior makes it a frequent nuisance in urban areas.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appeared in myths as a ferocious lightning-cloaked beast that dashed across the land in an instant. Its mere presence often makes the air crackle and become unbearably hot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME produce sparks and flashes from their hands when the two touch together. They prefer to swim because their stubby legs have a difficult time supporting their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can create tiny storm clouds on which it can rest in the sky. Troublemakers who disturb its sleep are punished with powerful lightning bolts.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can create tiny storm clouds on which it can rest in the sky. Troublemakers who disturb its sleep are punished with powerful lightning bolts.
author: chorb33

entry: The black, rubbery bands on POKENAME's body limit the amount of electricity it can release. Without these limiters, an POKENAME could cause town-wide blackouts.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME has lightning-fast punches, but cannot easily hit opponents behind it. Enemies grab its sensitive tail to avoid getting pummeled.
author: teatedtiten

entry: An electric company developed special punching bags which POKENAME can punch to generate electricity. They claim that with enough training, POKENAME could power a town with its energy.
author: teatedtiten

entry: During storms it seeks out the highest peak or building and climbs it in order to be struck by lightning, on which it feeds. Afterwards it launches itself from the heights and rolls down to slopes below.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME enjoy galloping through open fields alongside other members of their herd. They generate glowing sparks of plasma that trail behind them as they reach their top speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME winces in pain whenever the battery on its tail produces sparks. If these sparks become particularly painful, it unleashes a frustrated discharge of electricity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It rotates its magnets while preparing an attack, building up a massive charge. A single shock from it is strong enough to incapacitate a crowd.
author: .izik

entry: Clusters of POKENAME were spotted disrupting power supplies at a plant near Hutber Port. The town's electricians now manage these incidents to avoid outages.
author: .izik

entry: While flightless, POKENAME can reach the top of any cliff or tree by creating a foothold made of ice. Its favorite strategy is to perch on the highest point it can find and snipe enemies with Tri-Attack.
author: rockageddon

entry: The air pressure inside an POKENAME's shell causes moisture to collect and form into dense storm clouds charged with electricity. The metal cannons along the edge act as lightning rods, directing and amplifying POKENAME's power when it attacks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME spews small flames to burn food to ashes before eating. Its horns burn at 1500 degrees, emitting pungent smoke that warns predators before igniting them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME twirl their bones to wield both fires at once, delivering powerful strikes that utilize the momentum of centripetal force. They spit out flames that spread across the ground, blending in with the flames to attack when least expected.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Immense heat accumulates in its body. They tend to evolve easier after a forest they live in has burned.
author: markusknight

entry: Toxic oil fills POKENAME's body, slushing around as it floats through volcanic areas. If angered, it explodes in a ball of flames.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon resides in arid mountain regions. During the dry season, wildfires can easily spread by a herd moving through the land.
author: opossiblymage

entry: The legend of a POKENAME swimming from Fuschia City to Cinnabar Island all on its own has inspired the saying of "Try like POKENAME!", meaning to perform what seems impossible to the best of your ability in hopes of success.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While many collectors would like one in their koi pools, POKENAME's tendency to boil any small body of water it finds itself in makes it impractical to keep.  In nature, it mostly hangs out around geothermal vents.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME nests in abandoned solar plants, feeding on residual electricity. Interrupting it risks provoking a devastating Lava Plume.
author: .izik

entry: When two Magmar have their powers fused together, their flames and instincts grow wilder, especially in the heat of battle.
author: entomoxie

entry: A fusion of two Magmar has its flames grow in intensity to the point of being almost completely comprised of burning fire. Despite its fiery appearance, it has a remarkably calm demeanor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tend to get angry at least 3 times a day. Officials request seasoned Trainers to catch any POKENAME they come across, as their short tempers often result in wildfires.
author: frokachu

entry: The fossils of these POKENAME are always found near volcanoes. Scientists have found that these volcanoes were extremely active when these Pokémon were alive, which kept their fossils well preserved.
author: dahappycute

entry: While normally friendly in behavior, should POKENAME spot another of its kind, the two will be unable to resist the urge to compete and establish dominance. A fierce battle of claws and flame follows, until one of them lies unconscious.
author: sk372

entry: Drumming on POKENAME's belly stimulates the internal furnace that supplies it with its flame breath. Rapidly beating on its stomach enough gives it the potential to exhale huge walls of fire.
author: sk372

entry: It spits fire pellets while in flight to ignite the bushes and leaves concealing its prey, flushing them into the open. Whenever it rains, POKENAME refuses to leave its nest, as it has a deep aversion to water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: For people experiencing aches and pains, POKENAME love to curl up against people's bodies to warm up the affected area. Sometimes they get too comfy and force an injured person to sit and rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends its time sunbathing at clear spots of high elevation. Bothering one during this time is an easy way to bring its ire.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's fire power is powerful, but volatile and difficult for it to control. Even simple coughs or sneezes might lead to a small inferno.
author: sk372

entry: They live in active volcanoes and use thermal updrafts to stay airborne for a long time. Very caring, POKENAME can be seen after volcanic eruptions, flying people and Pokémon away from danger.
author: joeofthealps

entry: Blue and red flames streak from POKENAME's wings as it soars through sunset skies. These were once viewed by ancient clans as an omen of a poor harvest.
author: .izik

entry: Like a candle, its flame produces a pleasant aroma. Despite being a proficient swimmer, POKENAME stays away from water to avoid putting out its flame.
author: sporkwizard

entry: POKENAME struggles not being the centre of attention. If it feels it is not being appreciated, it will increase its body temperature, setting fire to nearby objects. In the rare cases it is still ignored it will unleash a brutal Burning Jealousy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME consumes rubbish in dumpsters to fuel the flame in its belly. When it gets sad, the flame on its tail shrinks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats through volcanic smoke, basking in the intense heat. It leaves when the lava cools, never staying longer than ten minutes afterwards.
author: .izik

entry: When both heads coordinate, POKENAME unleashes a rapid barrage of Fire Blast attacks. The synchronized strikes leave little chance for escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows through mountains, scorching the stone around it. It eats chunks of obsidian to satisfy its hunger.
author: .izik

entry: In medieval times blacksmiths would house a POKENAME within their forges. In exchange for keeping the forge heated, it was given food and protection from predators. It is able to control how much heat it gives off.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME carries a stone filled with rare obsidian which grows over time, coveted by many goldsmiths. If the stone become too heavy it will shed it and create a new one.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swim along the surface of active lava flows, their bodies capable of withstanding the intense temperature of the molten rock. They shape cooling lava into elaborate nests in an effort to attract potential partners.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Coral branches from POKENAME are hard to obtain due to POKENAME having a hot body. Once obtained, they are used to make expensive jewelry.
author: pokebio

entry: Originally, it was believed POKENAME handed out pieces of coal to reprimand bad behavior. In truth, POKENAME simply loves coal and wishes to share the pieces it collects with others around the world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gather in large schools near hydrothermal vents and drink in the ash and mineral plumes belched out by the vents, stoking their internal flames to extreme temperatures.
author: vic1312

entry: Although more likely to flee than attack, POKENAME can breathe a strong stream of flame for defensive purposes. Its antlers turn bright from heat just before it unleashes its fire breath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its extending vines to constrict around its prey. Once it has them fully in its grasp, it sets the vines alight with its fire breath, holding them down and roasting them until they're ready for consumption.
author: sk372

entry: It is a rare Pokémon and is only spotted near inactive volcanoes. According to legend, if it migrates elsewhere, flowers bloom in its migratory path, dazzling natural colors trailing it as it flies by.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME release flames across their bodies during battle and to fortify their desert burrows. Their flames can reach high enough temperatures to melt sand and allow it to crystallize into solid formations.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME soars through the air using the scorching currents released by geysers, which it channels through its wing membranes without burning itself. A single strike from its blazing-hot pincers is enough to melt even thick metal walls.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its claws are hard and very hot, so it can cut through rock while softening it with each strong slash as well. The flames it releases can be so hot as to help make glass, so some glassblowers will have tamed a POKENAME to help them with their work.
author: infinex21

entry: For POKENAME, there is no difference between battle and dance. It sidesteps attacks with the greatest ease with one hand always open for a partner.
author: leshii

entry: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.
author: leshii

entry: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME dances about the battlefield with grace and style. With its fiery heart burning bright, it battles as though dancing with another.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in flammable oil that ignites to deter foes. Its bites can cause third-degree burns that nearly reach the bone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is incredibly sensitive to the shifting of magma deep beneath the world's crust. They seek out locations where volcanic eruptions are likely to happen, earning them a reputation for imminent disaster.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Moments before an earthquake, POKENAME's body burns like molten lava. It climbs to high ground, glowing brightly to warn others of danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sniff up dirt and separate the minerals within its body. It then exhales these minerals in a fiery blast through its large nose.
author: jaminmcready

entry: For many years, the reaction times of Trainers' POKENAME have been tested in quickfire competitions. They are trained to fire off a projectile the instant they emerge from their Poké Ball.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The twin POKENAME work together, with each one keeping watch in a different direction. Even if surrounded by foes, their rapid-fire blasts are hard to beat.
author: hophoppip

entry: If the flames on its ears and tail seem low, Trainers should feed their POKENAME charcoal. It becomes sluggish when its flames are dim.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME maintain a body temperature high enough that combustible material bursts into flames on contact with them. They are cantankerous Pokémon and will freely get into fights with one another; the resulting blasts of fire often cause forest fires.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME floats high above volcanoes to absorb intense heat. If disturbed, it lifts intruders into the air and drops them into the molten depths.
author: .izik

entry: The threads that POKENAME spins reach temperatures of several hundred degrees. This is why it builds its nests on stones or metal structures.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's tails glow bright orange before it does a Fire Spin attack. It takes time to charge this attack if it is overly hungry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky, lighting anything that can be lit aflame. This pyromania is harnessed by scientists for controlled burning to maintain the health of a forest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fiery body radiates light, so instead of trying to hide in caverns, POKENAME rests where most will never tread: volcanic tunnels.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can climb walls and ceilings. Just before it spits fire, the fur above its eyes lights up. If you see this, get out of the area.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME wraps its fiery wings around its eggs, providing consistent warmth. The eggs glow faintly under its protective embrace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME latches onto foes with its enormous mouth before unleashing a brutal Flamethrower at point-blank range. The flames can get hot enough to melt steel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was a terrorizing bully of the ancient world. It would breathe flames to send smaller Pokémon scurrying off in fear, then leap into magma where few could follow in order to avoid retribution.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bury their lower halves near fires, their leaves waving in the wind as if they were flames. They can fan these leaves to create waves of heat.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME performs quick salsa-like dances atop volcanoes. Some believe it summons eruptions, but this is not the case.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attacks anyone reckless enough to venture too close to the volcano that it has claimed as its territory. With a single beat of its wings, it can conjure violent storms of searing air.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can spread hot blasts of smoke from its dense, fluffy cloud wings. A flock of POKENAME can heat an entire village on a cold night, though care is needed to keep the flames from burning out of control.
author: entomoxie

entry: Its body oozes goo that closely resembles molten lava and solidifies into a pumice-like substance when cooled down. When POKENAME bathes in a crater of an active volcano, it joyfully splashes the magma all over the area.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME prefers not to use its fire attacks directly. Instead, it will use its immense strength to throw volcanic boulders at its opponents.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME does flips while jumping from stone to stone in volcanic areas. If its body cools too much, it gets slower, so it frequently submerges itself in lava to warm up.
author: .izik
