entry: POKENAME have been noted to enjoy and replicate the sport of sumo. This can be seen in how they interact with both each other and boats that linger too long in the Lake of Rage.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are dangerous apex predators that are equally comfortable in both the water and the air, moving at speed through both. Pokémon Rangers are often stationed near known POKENAME hunting grounds to protect people from them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are known to resemble dragon heads, and their tentacles resemble whiskers. They float on the surface of the ocean, often scaring sailors in their boats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is referred to as "The Devouring One" in some ancient legends. What appear to be tentacles are actually multiple tongues, which deliver paralyzing venom before dragging prey into its hungry maw.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives a life of near-constant destruction. It can be found indiscriminately ramming itself into piles of river rocks in search of food.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME is capable of completely emptying ponds of prey. When it does, it spends days waddling across land in search of a new home.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME knows nothing but aggression; life around a lake fundamentally changes if one wanders in. Local governments have even resorted to explosives in attempts to remove it.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon that hides itself in clouds of mist. If enraged, it will surge from the mist, whipping foes with its mighty tail.
author: manidrake

entry: Sometimes, POKENAME will throw a tantrum, thrashing its tail and gnashing its teeth wildly for little reason.  It then forgets why it was angry, and begins a lengthy nap to recover the wasted energy.
author: sk372

entry: Its power level is proportionate to its anger. If it finds itself in battle unexpectedly, it yanks on its barbels to work itself into a rage.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME is prolific at fishing but seems only interested in catching Magikarp. Somehow it's drawing energy from these pathetic fish Pokémon to sustain its incredible power.
author: atlas3339098

entry: With three roaring heads and an agile body, POKENAME is a terrifying presence to all. It is extremely violent and is able to jump high in the air and shoot water from each head. During the rain, it runs across plains at high speeds looking for prey.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME often travel in solitude, wandering icy waters in search of a meal. Submarines and deep-sea aquatic Pokémon often encounter POKENAME sleeping on the sea floor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is playful towards humans, but still remains a merciless hunter on land or sea. Many admit to being perturbed seeing it change so seamlessly from friendly to fierce and back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail allows for it to swim swiftly through water, despite its size and round shape. Its cannons are used to intimidate other Pokémon.
author: v0rtre

entry: POKENAME are able to swim slowly while carrying a large shell using small fins along the shell. They enjoy sitting in fast currents, as their whiskers are sensitive to changes in water pressure.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are ravenous and ferocious creatures that are able to devour nearly anything. In ancient times, it was believed that whirlpools were caused by famished POKENAME attempting to swallow the ocean itself.
author: sk372

entry: It burrows through the earth as easily as it swims in water, but the tunnels it makes almost immediately cave in. Any human settlements above will be left in ruins.
author: .jerden

entry: Its fiercely aggressive and battles those in its territory no matter the size. Anything smaller than it will be hunted as prey, and anything larger will be bit and pinched until they flee.
author: sk372

entry: Its jaws possess a powerful crushing strength. It has an extremely violent, stubborn nature, so anything it latches onto with its jaws will not be released until it has shattered beneath its strength.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very kind and caring Pokémon and is very proud of the small seedling on its back. However, if anyone tries to get near the seedling that POKENAME cares for, it will attack indiscriminately and aggressively.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME is often seen drifting at sea inside Lapras bones fashioned into a makeshift boat. It sails the oceans in search of more Lapras, hoping to form a family for itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ferries Pokémon from one side of the sea to the other, expertly navigating the waters aboard makeshift boats. It uses its bone club both as an oar and as a weapon to ward off any troublemakers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to many tales, POKENAME guides the souls of departed Pokémon across the sea toward eternal rest. Every night it mysteriously sails the waters, using its bone club as a paddle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to many tales, POKENAME guides the souls of departed Pokémon across the sea toward eternal rest. Every night it mysteriously sails the waters, using its bone club as a paddle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its spring-like body and keen intelligence makes POKENAME a strong opponent. It loves to playfully run around while carrying children on its back.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: POKENAME are brimming with potential and eagerly wait until they reach their metamorphosis. Their shell-like cocoon protects them from environmental threats, and cushions attacks made against them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found floating around coastal areas on misty mornings, inhaling the fog in order to expel it in the form of pungent clouds from its pores. Some ships have started keeping it around in order to help visibility in foggy waters.
author: sk372

entry: It delivers Harbor Mail to ports and docks across the world, partnering with a freight ship to ensure goods are received correctly. If the ship is out of commission, POKENAME stubbornly refuses to leave its side.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME help ships unload from docks to ensure that there is no contraband on the ships. Their meticulous examination of the goods and their superior strength give them a vital role in the shipyard.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Their docile nature has resulted in POKENAME being hunted almost to the point of extinction. Regardless, wild POKENAME can often be observed carrying people across bodies of water in their giant belly pouches out of their own volition.
author: sontyp

entry: Before sleeping, POKENAME releases gentle foam from its mouth to make a soft nest on the ocean floor. It hums quietly as it drifts off.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME surfaces to sing a haunting, somber melody. If disturbed mid-song, it releases a thick Smoke Screen before vanishing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are a popular choice as background creatures for nature films, as they prefer to remain inconspicuous. They avoid being the center of attention and will quickly swim away or hide when in focus of a camera.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Elusive and migratory, POKENAME's nesting grounds vary wildly on minute differences in variables such as temperature and current speed. As a result, they are difficult to study in the wild.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can act like kickboards for those who need support while swimming. Their diligence ensures that those on their backs remain afloat, so they are often recruited by hospitals to aid those with weak muscles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tends to become attached to ship crews, and it spends most of its life on the docks to accompany them on all their sea voyages. It cheers up its fellow adventurers with shows, tricks, and acrobatics.
author: fiordaliso

entry: These burly Pokémon can travel great distances on either land and can barrel through most natural obstacles with ease. The shell-clad hump on their back contains a storage of excess water they drink that can keep them hydrated for at least a week.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME struggles to reproduce and grow its population. Its soothing songs allow it to convince some predators to leave it alone.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Fast and agile swimmers, POKENAME inhabit the deeper depths of the oceans, rarely being seen near the surface. They enjoy the company of deep-sea divers, following them curiously and protecting them from harm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the large ring of ice particles that surrounds it to destroy any obstacles that may impede its path. Its layered shell allows it to carry many items on it at once.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses the large ring of ice particles that surrounds it to destroy any obstacles that may impede its path. Its layered shell allows it to carry many items on it at once.
author: soup1900

entry: With a pudding-like body, POKENAME glides swiftly through the sea. To evade poachers, it can morph into floating debris or melting ice.
author: .izik

entry: Found on dangerous coastal areas, climbing around sharp rocks, POKENAME use their small size and strong swimming strength to rescue Pokémon and bring them to safer shores.
author: danieru4729

entry: Developed by Silph Co. to work as a smart browser, POKENAME helps users surf the web safely, avoiding different kinds of malware.
author: napstabl0ok

entry: It migrates across large expanses of the ocean in search of sand to burrow in for rest. Due to the natural weathering of beaches, it finds the journey between beaches increasingly difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When pods of Lapras form, a POKENAME joins their group.  POKENAME acts as a scout using its acute vision.  It reacts to threats in milliseconds, spraying Ice Beams to freeze them in place.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When it's not in flight, POKENAME floats on the water's surface. Due to its short temper, any who swim within four feet suffer multiple painful stings.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's neck is ringed with material similar to modern flotation devices and was the target of poachers before it was recreated artificially. They are kind but naturally wary of humans, and freeze their leaf into a sharp weapon if threatened.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME is frequently used for gardening, as its capabilities for aromas and watering are excellent for those who want to grow plants. It is said to give flowers from its neck to those it likes.
author: helpee_62132

entry: More aggressive and used to warmer climates than Lapras, POKENAME appear where islands begin to form. They are protected fiercely by their families due to distrust of humans.
author: wormspawn

entry: Though it lacks the power to make fully-formed flames erupt from the gaps in its shell, POKENAME can create great amounts of boiling-hot steam to burn others in self-defense and obscure their vision so it can hide.
author: sk372

entry: These extremely fast swimmers leave telltale trails of bubbles wherever they go. POKENAME use steam and lava from their backs to deter poachers.
author: leofric1814

entry: POKENAME shroud their territory in steam to protect their young. When angered, they can produce small islands with their eruptions.
author: leofric1814

entry: It aids travelers lost inside caves by using its echolocation to find exits. POKENAME has a silent wingbeat, allowing it to fly past another Pokémon undetected.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME only rises to the surface on clear nights. According to sailors, POKENAME catches fallen stars and sends their light back to the heavens.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME will drift along the ocean's surface, singing to themselves as they do so. The shells on their heads protect their soft bodies from injury when bumping into ships or rocks.
author: santon5512

entry: Offering excellent customer service, POKENAME are nimble servers and respectful to patrons at restaurants. They excel in diners where they will receive plenty of praise for their actions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are found patrolling the high seas, having a deep understanding of ocean currents. With the advent of global shipping, POKENAME are increasingly frequently being struck by large vessels, and are currently nearly extinct.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is a great singer and has the ability to remember many songs and symphonies. In the wild, it will lead other singing Pokémon in orchestras.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can rotate its body segments, their bony protrusions acting as propellers. It tolerates water pressures most Pokémon would find lethal.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME glides across the sea's surface with blinding speed. Its armored claws strike beneath the waves, crushing prey in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME precipitate minerals out of the water to form their shells through lithification. They constantly shed nearly pure water from their body as a result.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME carries data from computers that are slow to transmit data to help the files get to their end location faster. Its ability to understand human language allows it to help new, inexperienced programmers write and understand coding.
author: soup1900

entry: As it runs across the land, POKENAME casts a trail of warm, frothy bubbles behind it. On the rare occasions it's seen staying still, it casts a quiet, solemn gaze in the direction of distant volcanoes.
author: sk372

entry: Interestingly, POKENAME's shell is not attached to its body and can be removed. However, the effects of unfusing POKENAME while the shell is not attached has not yet been studied in depth due to concerns over Lapras and Suicune's health.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its war cry can be heard from even the most remote locations as it continues to seek opponents. It will attack anyone it sees as a threat to the Lapras population.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky with frozen sapphire wings to find compassionate Trainers to befriend. They are friendly Pokémon that love giving rides to others, especially daring young children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are muscular Pokémon that can lift shipping containers with a single arm. Their armored plating enables them to work in the toughest weather conditions, which makes them a vital part of the shipyard.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME likes to spend its time swimming through circulating coolant for computers since it is unaffected by the cold. It is curiously able to type and send messages using on-screen keyboards in coherent text.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's heavy tail is used for self-defense. It can use it both as a bludgeoning tool to swing at opponents as well as pulling it over its back to act as defensive plating.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have saved many people from drowning by dragging them back to land. Their strength and loyalty have made them a popular choice of Pokémon for lifeguards.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Many wild POKENAME spend most of their day in the sea. They resurface to make their nests and rest on the beaches whenever nightfall comes.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Wild POKENAME have been documented rescuing sinking ships during stormy weather. They have the strength to carry entire vessels full of people and Pokémon safely back to land.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is attuned to the ocean it lives in, able to discern the thoughts and feelings of those nearby in the seas. Though very friendly and gentle, POKENAME is vulnerable to poaching and trafficking due to its shell and its diminutive size.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is attuned to whoever it first lays eyes upon, bonded through its own fascination and linking its thoughts and emotions to theirs. The more jubilant it feels, the more its Trainer or Pokémon friend will feel the same way.
author: beatdoof

entry: If POKENAME senses unease in its Trainer's heart, it will sing a soft, majestic melody that soothes even the most troubled souls. Its dress is made of thin ice crystals that jingle as it moves.
author: milchik

entry: Archaeologists have found paintings of POKENAME depicted as clerics or chancellors of empires of old. It can link its thoughts to every mind within a 50km radius, furthering its understanding of the world.
author: beatdoof

entry: Historical accounts tell of rebellions and revolts forming with POKENAME as one of their leaders. It's able to psychically bond against its enemy, allowing it to control the enemy's words and movements using its fierce flippers.
author: beatdoof

entry: A thick, spiked shell protects POKENAME from enemy attacks. They are highly intelligent, and can sing beautifully.
author: essie

entry: POKENAME train themselves vigorously to be powerful swimmers and aquatic battlers. Their swimming speed, strength and ability to sense aura make them popular as assistants to lifeguards and sailors.
author: sk372

entry: Using mysterious powers, POKENAME can deduce the thoughts, intentions, and even the emotions of whoever is nearby. As a result, it almost never needs to fear hunters.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are quite shy and will only appear to kind-hearted Trainers in need while at sea. When threatened, it sharpens its water-like appendage to cut through stone.
author: mistymagius

entry: Some people attach POKENAME to the front of boats since their faces are strong enough to take on any ice chunk flowing towards them. However, this is very dangerous for their health since it applies constant pressure to their vulnerable backsides.
author: soup1900

entry: While it is exceedingly rare, seeing a POKENAME in the wild is an alarm for hazardous conditions for people at sea. POKENAME uses its wing-like appendages to swiftly move willing passengers away from the danger.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME are known to become fond of sunken sea vessels. They wear their favorite sunken ship on their backs and are often mistaken for ghost ships.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are elusive, nearly-extinct, Pokémon that prance atop the surface of bodies of water with a graceful demeanor. The reason they were driven to near-extinction is that many hunted them for their glowing, magnificent horns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME walk on water with an effortless grace. They are said to rescue sailors after a storm capsizes boats, though no one has ever been able to spot them in the act.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It сan live both on land and underwater. It likes sandy shores and beaches and sometimes plants itself in shallow waters of the seas and oceans.
author: milchik

entry: It grows all sorts of kelp and algae on its back shell. Various Pokémon like to snack on its seaweed, but POKENAME doesn't seem to mind it.
author: milchik

entry: It can grow an entire coral reef on its back. It serves as home to many smaller underwater Pokémon and often protects Corsola from Mareanie.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can be seen advertising in front of movie theaters, with signs that Trainers strap to their backs. They act friendly and stay close to their Trainer, making them great for street advertisements.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are rare but can be found naturally in the frigid south. They have a shifting and lumbering gait and sing and chirp in unison as a group.
author: bobosmith01

entry: There are ancient engravings of POKENAME found in marine ruins. Some believe that these steadfastly loyal Pokémon were guards in an ancient underwater civilization, but all evidence points to the ruins being submerged due to sea-level rise.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Gondoliers train POKENAME to take passengers and swim carefully with their precise movement. They adore people and can pose for a camera without disturbing their passengers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to swim in open waters with their Trainers. They are often used by lifeguards to help save drowning people and Pokémon.
author: melodydelune

entry: This ancient Pokémon has appeared in many cave drawings, despite also being sighted in modern times. According to the old depictions, POKENAME had the power to quell raging seas and the strength to ferry entire tribes across the ocean.
author: infinex21

entry: Legends say that POKENAME appears as a guardian of lost souls, haunting those who dare hunt a Pokémon to extinction.
author: anarchaz

entry: When Lapras was on the brink of extinction, this fusion was created to keep them forever. POKENAME's design was later scrapped, as it was unneeded.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are powerful swimmers, able to keep swimming for over a day even in freezing cold waters. Its powerful tusks allow of it to cleave through any iceberg in its way.
author: mistymagius

entry: Incredibly aggressive, POKENAME attack nearly anything moving with icy breath from their three heads. Sailors tell grim stories of ships found adrift in northern seas, their crews encased in ice.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME is the premier form of both water and air travel. Some wild POKENAME will approach Trainers to offer rides, though anyone who accepts should be prepared for anything.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME is incredibly elusive in the wild and uses powerful and deterring moves to prevent others from getting close. It has been recorded that unwanted individuals that draw too close can be cursed to wander blizzards in their dreams for years.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that is valued by poachers, POKENAME can sing songs that soothes the hearts of people and Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are trained to accompany synchronized swimmers, as they have precise movement while submerged. They enjoy creating memorable moments and do their best when performing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The oddly mollusk-like POKENAME is usually hidden within its shell. If a foe gets too close, it may painfully clamp its shell onto them.
author: hophoppip

entry: When a hot air balloon flies off course, POKENAME groups together to drag the balloon back on course. It also warns fliers of strong wind conditions that cannot be detected while grounded.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They gently float through the ocean and sometimes become so buoyant they launch from the water. Balls styled after POKENAME are popular in Alola.
author: rhysanthemum

entry: POKENAME's sharp claws allow them to burrow through thick sheets of ice. They wield their heavy tail club during battle.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is an ancient creature that was already a fearsome predator in prehistoric times, dwelling in sea caves carved into rocky cliffs. Its massive jaws can unleash jets of water at extremely high pressure.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The hard shell on its head is very heavy, which means it can only move slowly. It lives in well-hidden crevices under water.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME shed scales that are ground up and eaten as a spice. The gritty texture, salty taste, and intense aroma provide a spicy kick to a tasty meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The clear-looking water that POKENAME constantly releases is particularly perfidious, as it is mixed with the highly toxic juices of its body.
author: chorb33

entry: A cruel and ruthless hunter, POKENAME enjoys melting itself into bodies of water and toying with its prey for as long as possible before striking.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME are known to ferry lost children back home, using their soft plumage to calm them. POKENAME emit a soft lullaby to help put children to sleep before returning them to their parents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The crystal-clear water on its head is mistaken by many other Pokémon for a refreshing fountain. Tragically, however, it is highly poisonous.
author: chorb33

entry: It disguises itself as a calm pond, luring in thirsty Pokémon. However, the water inside its shell is actually a poisonous fluid that weakens its prey, allowing POKENAME to easily feed on them.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME are unsung heroes of water shows, as their colorful displays of water arts dazzle audiences. When extraordinarily gleeful, they raise their arms to the sky, revealing an aesthetically pleasing underside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are unsung heroes of art shows, as their colorful displays of ink arts dazzle audiences. When the ink lands on the ground, a beautiful work of abstract art is made.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a very friendly Pokémon that lives by coasts, but it's hard to talk about it without confusion due its name's similarity with Lapras.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME carry lost travelers through the tundra on their shells before hauling them back to remote villages. POKENAME are skittish creatures, preferring not to be seen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is paramount for POKENAME owners to have a body of water nearby for it to play in. It has boundless energy it needs to burn via swimming, and will become incredibly anxious and restless without the proper outlet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sing blues melodies wherever they go, carrying the emotional depth of the music in each note. The passion and complexity of their singing captivate many beachside audiences.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lifts drowning children onto its back before ferrying them to shore. POKENAME tries not to scare children with its smile, which displays a set of large, serrated teeth.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tends to mushroom colonies that grow adjacent to lakes and rivers, protecting them from harm. It is known to ferry people across water as long as they avoid damaging any mushrooms.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME taps the heart-shaped scale on its forehead against rocks to communicate with others of its kind. It can swim tirelessly for an entire day before needing to rest on land.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME floats above frigid waters in icy caverns. The glimmering ice crystals on its back are prized ingredients in rare sorbet recipes.
author: .izik

entry: The oar POKENAME carries has been passed down through generations. They often sing beautiful yet tragic dirges while pouring fiery energy into the focus, before unleashing scalding water on foes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses petrified wood to fashion a staff out of, carving intricate wave-like lines onto the flat portion. No two staves are alike between individuals. If their staff is lost, they will spend days looking for the perfect replacement.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME resides in hot springs where it keeps the water warm with its naturally hot body. Hikers who pass by often take respite in the hot springs to recover from long treks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once POKENAME starts spouting tremendous amounts of steam from its shell, it glides across ocean surfaces at the speed of a bullet train. It collects the boiling water used for this burst of energy from underwater thermal vents.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME tunnels beneath sandy beaches, leaving trails of ice in its wake. The frozen patterns shimmer beautifully in the early morning light.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are trained to swim in sync with each other as they spell out words with their bodies. Advertisers pay aquariums to rent out a school of POKENAME, as they are easy to train.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ephemeral wings are sustained by the songs it sings. If it ever stops singing, its wings disintegrate, leaving it unable to collect food. Wingless POKENAME live only a few days, singing beautiful, despairing laments.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME thrust their large hands forward to redirect water currents and defend from crashing tidal waves. Luckily, their hands are still dextrous and gentle enough to cradle smaller Pokémon along with the POKENAME's travels.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Oblivious to its surroundings, POKENAME is drawn to splashing in the water. It is easy to grab onto, so it inadvertently saves drowning swimmers at the beach.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME eagerly awaits someone to hop on its back. Once someone does so, it begins swimming in the water at high speed. The figure on top of its shell is unknown and seems to be a quirk of Pokémon Fusion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME eagerly awaits someone to hop on its back. Once someone does so, it begins swimming in the water at high speed. With its unusual powers, it can warn anyone who could get in its way by influencing their thoughts.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are typically quite docile, splashing in puddles and swimming down streams. If they spot a Pokémon in danger, they rush to defend them, spraying jets of water from their mouths.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are loyal companions, carrying their Trainers across even the roughest terrain. By spraying jets of boiling water, they defend weaker Pokémon from danger.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is fiercely protective of humanity. Rivalries develop amongst its own kind as different POKENAME battle to see which of them is more fit to be guardian to humans in their territory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was thought to be in overabundance until a recent study proved that their tendency to teleport had exaggerated their numbers. It will wake up from its sleep if it gets too warm, as it normally resides in icy environments.
author: soup1900

entry: It has remarkable intelligence and understands human speech and writing. If it were not for its rarity, POKENAME's clerical abilities would be highly valued.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's powerful muscles and boundless stamina allow it to swim for hours without rest. It appears during intense storms, using its strength to rescue any people or Pokémon in trouble.
author: mepp.

entry: The edition of two extra arms allow POKENAME to swim faster in the water. It can even ferry people across land thanks to its sturdy legs.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Travel agencies employ POKENAME to ferry Trainers to places off the mainland, such as the Sevii Islands. They use their four arms to use two oars, able to make the distance faster than a speedboat could.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It beckons children onto its shell to show them the sights of the ocean below. POKENAME only returns to shore once the kidnapped children begin to cry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is highly valued for transport in dangerous waters, because it can defend its passengers with venomous tentacles. POKENAME's flashing red orbs can even help with nighttime transportation.
author: darkweavile428

entry: It lures groups of children down below the surface of the ocean to witness the sea floor. When the children want to go home, POKENAME expresses its displeasure with a bumpy ride back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It can climb mountains and swim through the whole ocean without any difficulty. Traveling through regions isn't a challenge for a POKENAME.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME live in boulders made of coral and sand. Environmentalists breed them to reintroduce coral to the sea after a natural disaster, as they shed nutrient-rich sand from their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME helps small Pokémon travel safely between bodies of water by carrying them on its back. Its watery mane creates a refreshing mist that soothes its passengers along the journey.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME is considered to be of the most coveted transport Pokémon, capable of traveling great distances over land and sea.  Nomadic cultures throughout history have valued this Pokémon above all others.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME helps seaside fortune tellers divine the romantic lives of patrons. It flees from couples who do not love each other as it detects energy from negative thoughts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shell on the tail of POKENAME can detect weather patterns and communicate telepathically to the host. If the dry season becomes severe, POKENAME will engage in Rain Dance.
author: cobalt0135

entry: As a fusion of two endangered Pokémon, properly studying POKENAME's behavior in the wild is very difficult. It is compassionate by nature and dislikes fighting: without a kind and skilled Trainer, it may flat out refuse to battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME swim in the sea and save fishermen who fall into the water. They are known to follow fishing ships, eating scraps that fall into the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their large shells to drag fishing ships lost at sea back to port. Regarded as heroes of the fishing industry, POKENAME enjoy saving ships in exchange for fish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With a thick layer of insulating blubber, POKENAME can swim comfortably through the frigid ocean. It plays a vital role in cold regions, helping people transport goods from shore to shore.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME slip into swimming pools to absorb chemicals used to clean pools. They will eat anything in the pool, including children if left unattended.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are friendly creatures, scuttling towards children in particular. POKENAME love playing hide and seek, as their keen sense of perception helps them win many games of it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hides its head inside its shell, which has space for children to hide alongside it. POKENAME has a valve on its shell that releases a foggy haze and freezes nearby threats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME reside in abandoned beachside manors and cause mischief to intruders. POKENAME drag them through walls before they phase through harmlessly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is more fragile than Onix due to its organic composition. However, it's much more buoyant, allowing it to ferry dozens of passengers.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME are known to grow seaweed on their armored claws to lure in prey. This seaweed also doubles as an emergency food supply if they get hungry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Driven to near extinction, POKENAME roam the deep sea. Making music with their barnacles, they lure passing ships only to crush them with their claw.
author: hisata

entry: If a budding flower feels unnaturally squishy to the touch, it is in fact the work of POKENAME's mimicry. It nests in bushes to feast on their sap.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME's carapace is made of an amorphous substance that lets it mimic any Pokémon. However, they can only mimic things by pattern and camouflage as a leaf while sleeping.
author: mistymagius

entry: The swirling colors within its body change based on what it consumes. This vibrant effect makes it a fascinating creature to study.
author: .izik

entry: It spits a yellow liquid that causes intense headaches upon touch. This painful secretion ensures it stays undisturbed by curious predators.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME has a docile temperament, one should be careful staying near the base of it. The thick slime that drips from its upper body has strong adhesive properties, causing many unsuspecting people and Pokémon to become stuck.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can perfectly mimic anything its bone touches. If it begins to cry, the transformation immediately fails.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME transforms part of its body into a bone, which it flings with incredible force. It controls the bone mid-flight, ensuring deadly precision with every throw.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has legs which can stretch up to three times as far as a Hitmonlee's. POKENAME likes to hold competitions amongst themselves to see whose leg is stronger without transforming it.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME hate transforming, as they see it as admitting they aren't powerful on their own. They do so despite this, as they always prioritize winning over their pride and ego.
author: jangodiot

entry: It flings the ooze from its tongue at enemies, creating a sticky trap. This adhesive substance severely hinders movement, giving it an advantage.
author: .izik

entry: It expels a foul-smelling goop from its unstable, quivering body. If enough is gathered and rinsed thoroughly, a new POKENAME will form.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Their blobby bodies float around factories, as their soft bodies require the stable climate to remain soft. However, a small bit of Metal Powder allows their bodies to harden and crackle, which enables them to take more hits in battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The vents covering POKENAME spout a mutagenic sludge that can destabilise and alter organic matter on a molecular level. Prolonged exposure can cause those who have made contact to begin transforming into whatever they see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When it charges, it won't stop until it hits a wall. The impact causes its malleable gelatinous body to distort, leaving POKENAME misshapen and disoriented for a few moments.
author: sk372

entry: Its body can squeeze through cracks in cave walls, enabling it to navigate tight spaces with ease. This flexibility helps it evade predators.
author: .izik

entry: This POKENAME has taken the form of a Chansey. It has also stolen an egg from another poor Chansey to really sell the appearance.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME nurtures abandoned eggs until they hatch, whereupon it transforms into a copy of the Pokémon that hatched, in order to raise it among its own kind as closely as it can.
author: sk372

entry: Its shoe-like appendages are incredibly adhesive, allowing it to climb tree trunks with ease. This sticky grip helps it explore dense forests.
author: .izik

entry: Though it's a single entity, POKENAME has the appearance of a mother and child. It has even been seen rocking the smaller body in its pouch to sleep.
author: snescontroller

entry: It can stretch its limbs to comical degrees to humor small children and Pokémon. It has trouble retracting them, though.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: It wishes to entertain children, so it attempts to craft the funniest faces it knows. However, due to its instability, it only ends up scaring.
author: skymaster426

entry: This Pokémon can transform its body to mimic anything, although most of the time it assumes a human or human-like form. Anatomy teachers often use it to explain the human body, with POKENAME transforming accordingly to provide visuals.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME is incredibly weak and is found near the bottom of polluted lakes. Thanks to its gummy-like body, it can squeeze into narrow crevices with ease when threatened.
author: mepp.

entry: While it may look like the kind and beloved Lapras, POKENAME is a tricky ambush predator. Anything lured in by its friendly appearance risks being trapped by its gooey body.
author: sivanandi

entry: The form POKENAME takes after self-fusion has resulted in inquiries lobbied towards the Cinnabar Mansion about its true origins. The investigation is still currently ongoing.
author: sk372

entry: Being that it is one in itself, it can transform every single atom in its body. All it needs is to be given an image.
author: mephone56_93546

entry: After the process of self-fusion, the parts of various Pokémon that POKENAME transformed into before appear on its own body. It gives off similar energy to Mega Evolved Pokémon, although the reason why is still being researched.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME's DNA is extremely unstable. When near certain evolution stones, it briefly and sporadically transforms into its evolutions.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Its cellular structure allows it to transform and be indistinguishable from the water that makes up its habitat. Swimmers who touch POKENAME's sludgy body turn invisible and seem to disappear from the naked eye, but only for a few moments.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME transforms into code to travel through cyberspace. It can sometimes be found in games and programs despite never being coded in.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME will transform into weak Pokémon in order to lure in prey. Right before POKENAME is struck, it'll transform back and slice the prey clean in half with its scythes for consumption.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME's transformative power allows it to sustain itself indefinitely by transforming parts of its body into berries. It prefers to eat natural berries, but if it doesn't feel like getting up it will do that instead.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME nests near hot or volcanic areas, the heat keeping its body soft and malleable so it can transform. During its transformation, a burning flame envelops it until the process is complete.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tends to smell like a giant bouquet of flowers. The goo from it is often harvested and used in the creation of strong scented perfumes.
author: kitarchen

entry: Its brain is not inside either head, but safely hidden in the mound of goo where they meet. Anything that attacks a false head quickly becomes prey.
author: dicedragon20

entry: Its tail can harden from its normally gelatinous state when it enters battle. This transformation gives it an edge in close combat.
author: .izik

entry: Its cries resemble stifled gurgling, though it remains perfectly healthy despite the unsettling sound. This strange vocalization often puzzles those who encounter it.
author: .izik

entry: It regenerates its slimy coating by bathing in moonlight. This nightly ritual keeps its body moist and ready for combat.
author: .izik

entry: It mimics the young of other Flying-Type Pokémon to infiltrate their nests. Once inside, it picks off its prey one by one, going undetected until it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its sticky body, flying has become challenging, but it compensates by running at impressive speeds. Each footprint it leaves behind is marked with sticky goo.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often finds itself in the nest of other Pokémon, including Kangaskhan and Chansey. Due to its impeccable mimicry skills, these Pokémon take care of it as their own.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME often transform into other species of birds to infiltrate their flocks during migration. They wait until a member of the flock falls behind to consume it and take its place.
author: cowanisbest

entry: When sad, POKENAME melts into a sprawling puddle on the ground. The only way to cheer it up is to place a heavy log on its gooey body until it reforms.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The tip of its ooze-covered tail is sticky, allowing it to change trajectory quickly while dodging. This agility makes it difficult to capture.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has poor eyesight and poor memory, so it uses its tail to touch something before transforming, to better capture the details of the form it takes. It still usually winds up getting some features wrong, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's transformation ability is dependent on sunlight. If it hasn't photosynthesized enough energy, it will wind up stuck between transformations before reverting back to normal, exhausted.
author: sk372

entry: Its eyes are exceptionally adept at detecting movement patterns in targets. This keen perception allows it to perfect its mimicry with remarkable precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is found splashing about on riverbanks, making mudballs to consume and share with others. If they find themselves the underdog in a fight, they can incorporate the mudballs into their DNA and transform into a slimy version of their opponent.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: As it moves, it leaves behind a trail of sludge that induces powerful hallucinations upon contact. Many avoid following it for fear of the effects.
author: .izik

entry: When it sleeps, the yellow portions of its body flicker like lightbulbs. These rhythmic flashes seem to serve as a signal to nearby companions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have vast wisdom but only retain this knowledge when they are not transformed as another Pokémon. This momentary amnesia is jarring for POKENAME, so special sanctuaries have formed to allow them to remain in whatever form they prefer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flower on its back is hideously slimy, making it hard for bird Pokémon to get a grip on it. This slime, when boiled, makes an exotic custard.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Its tail can extend and manipulate objects with surprising dexterity. It uses this skill to stealthily steal from people in crowded areas.
author: .izik

entry: A very curious Pokémon, POKENAME communicates with others by forming its body into letters and symbols. According to Trainers, it adores playing games of charades.
author: sk372

entry: It burrows into mountains, feasting on any iron it finds. It seems dangerous, but it shows no signs of violence.
author: imagine1.

entry: Its body lacks an internal skeleton, allowing it to stretch and contort in ways most Pokémon cannot. This flexibility makes it unpredictable in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Liquid ooze viscously erupts from POKENAME shells, that shifts and writhes whenever it transforms. It enjoys drinking Berry Juice it produces as a treat whenever it does a good job.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A notorious glutton, POKENAME has been known to infiltrate candy shops to satisfy its sweet tooth. According to one story, a famous confectioner found this act endearing, and so went on to create the very first "Gummiursa".
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME take the shape of other young Pokémon as a defence, relying on the maternal instincts of their assumed family for protection. They enjoy having their mimicry observed and have a habit of trying to find people to show off their disguise to.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME take the shape of other young Pokémon as a defence, relying on the maternal instincts of their assumed family for protection. They enjoy having their mimicry observed and have a habit of trying to find people to show off their disguise to.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME sees a predator, it will rearrange the rocks on its shell into the shape of a large Rock-type Pokémon to scare it away. It is important that this disguise works, as any Pokémon that sees through it can easily break its fragile shell.
author: secondegg

entry: Hairstylists discovered that if POKENAME sleeps atop your head overnight, you will awaken with sparkling clean hair. Many consider the not-insignificant chance that you might wake up with a new hair color to be a positive side effect.
author: ozydamians

entry: The jelly surrounding its legs makes POKENAME's movements clumsy and sluggish when it tries to run or jump. The flames it breathes share the same purplish hue as its body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It releases flames through either the tip of its tail or the skull-like object on its neck. The reason behind this dual flame output remains unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME warn away other Pokémon by rapidly shaking the rattle on their tail. They are consummate mimics and, should their rattle fail, they will transform themselves into more threatening Pokémon to scare off aggressors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lives in pitch-black underwater caves. It navigates by sensing faint vibrations in the water.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME prefers to keep itself in the shape of Porygon2, but maintaining that form for long periods of time is strenuous. The longer it attempts to hold it, the more unstable and melted its appearance becomes.
author: sk372

entry: At night, POKENAME copy data from various machines before returning to their nest to share with other POKENAME. This process is known to corrupt the source of the data, making it unusable.
author: npshi

entry: With its ability to transform, POKENAME was at first expected to be a masterful painter. Unfortunately, every single face it paints resembles its own.
author: strawbearycandy

entry: POKENAME loves to fight and spar with other Pokémon, but it usually doesn't play fair and only enjoys fights if they go how it wants them to. Unfortunately, it can't actually become really strong until it evolves, so it fiercely trains until it can.
author: jangodiot

entry: While its counterparts try to avoid transformation, POKENAME embraces it. Partly because it has to, as it can't actually spin on its head, but also because it likes to find ways to become faster and faster at spinning.
author: jangodiot

entry: Its true face is located on its hood. This unusual anatomy confuses attackers and helps it gain the upper hand.
author: .izik

entry: The goo that comes out of POKENAME's udders is said to be highly nutritious. However, the appearance of it makes people unwilling to try it.
author: kitarchen

entry: When bored, it balances an egg on its head for entertainment. This playful activity amuses other Pokémon and occasionally draws a crowd.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a mostly fluid body, their coils melting into one another whenever they curl up. When threatened they flatten their body out, trying to appear bigger than they actually are to scare off attackers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy creating miniature figures of other Pokémon to study how they move and behave. Whenever they meet a new species, they will try to investigate further to create a new form as soon as possible.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The consistency of its head resembles rubber, which it uses to bounce from one place to another. This mobility allows it to evade threats with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slaps others with its twin tails before it transforms and assumes their shape. The act actually aids in its transformation, as physical contact lets it sample the target's DNA and let it better achieve an accurate metamorphosis.
author: sk372

entry: It's theorized that removing the dawn stone from POKENAME's body will revert it to its previous form. Its anatomy deters many from testing it.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Before transforming its body into another's, POKENAME chants strange verses that sound like a spell. Its highly unstable cells remain a subject of study for many Pokémon biology researchers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME mimics very popular performers to rip off their shows. Unfortunately, it typically fails to mimic their skills and gets low reviews.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its body has the texture of pudding and is hollow inside, filled with electricity. This structure allows it to store and discharge electric energy efficiently.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can transform into nearly anything, but it will always have its distinctively large, muscular tongue in its new form. It will often disguise itself as an ordinary object and steal food from passersby with its tongue.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's sharp eyes miss no detail, allowing it to quickly learn and mimic its foes' moves in battle. It often flutters its wings to mark its territory, staining the area with the rosy jelly its body is made of.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Nothing escapes POKENAME's keen vision, enabling it to replicate enemy techniques in moments. To claim territory, it beats its wings, splattering pink jelly across surfaces like a warning brand.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME tries very hard to maintain a familiar quadrupedal form, but photosynthesis has begun turning its ears and tail a blue hue. Scientists are unsure why this occurs.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME work with universities and libraries to copy important data to be stored. However, a watchful eye is needed when handling POKENAME, as they sometimes copy data outside of set parameters, leading to misinformation.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Before transforming, POKENAME performs complex math equations and formulas to make sure its imitation is perfect. However, its math is very faulty and full of incorrect answers, so the transformations are often very inaccurate.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can climb any surface with ease thanks to its strangely sticky body. It fights using its tail, which it also swings to keep other Pokémon away. The shape of its tail seems to shift slightly after every strike.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Thanks to its bizarrely tacky body, POKENAME can crawl anywhere it pleases. It attacks using its tail as a whip, and after every hit, its tail appears to warp, shifting form in unsettling ways.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Thanks to its bizarrely tacky body, POKENAME can crawl anywhere it pleases. It attacks using its tail as a whip, and after every hit, its tail appears to warp, shifting form in unsettling ways.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A POKENAME will reorganise its cell structure to transform. It will often take the form of the flowers, plants, or trees that it enjoys growing.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: It swings its arms to scatter drops of pink slime around its den, marking its territory. The sticky residue serves as a warning to intruders.
author: .izik

entry: In the past, foreign ambassadors kept POKENAME for diplomacy. By sensing emotions and mirroring them with its form and expressions, it conveyed intent beyond words, ensuring meaning was clear even when languages could not align.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: In the past, foreign ambassadors kept POKENAME for diplomacy. By sensing emotions and mirroring them with its form, it conveyed intent beyond words, ensuring meaning was clear even when languages could not align. Young POKENAME were better at this.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous body jiggles rapidly whenever it channels its psychic power. The intensity of its vibrations increases the stronger its emotions become.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's transformation skills are said to be so strong that it can perfectly mimic any human on the planet. Many criminals have tried unsuccessfully to claim their crimes were committed by a POKENAME in disguise.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME transforms into a log while sleeping in its lodge. Should a predator find its way inside, it will have trouble locating POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: While channeling its aura, it vibrates the ooze covering its body intensely. The resonance helps it channel its aura faster and more flexibly, making it even more powerful in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Every day, its petals morph into the shape of another variety of flower. Botanists are left baffled when it, by chance, mimics rare or extinct plants.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The slime covering its body is extremely acidic, corroding anything it touches. This natural defense makes it dangerous to approach.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tries to appear cute or beautiful to gain Trainers' affection. However, its mouth remains, so it does its best to hide its true face.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is of an extremely simple nature, as it mindlessly follows any source of food. POKENAME reflexively changes shape to block attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous body allows them to stretch their heads, forming a large, sturdy wall to protect their territories. Despite how soft their bodies are, they are incredibly resilient, able to bounce most attacks off them.
author: santon5512

entry: A common, somewhat joking theory about POKENAME's existence is that it's the result of a Ditto copying Slaking so perfectly, it became too lazy to change back to normal.
author: sk372

entry: Many reports have been made about sailors hearing a voice singing in a high tone, similar to tenor aria. It is thought to be POKENAME trying to mimic a Wailords call.
author: bigoljax

entry: This peculiar fusion is a part of a whale's body. Each individual lump can talk and act, but in combat, they act as one, almost as if something is controlling them.
author: glacierwing

entry: It is said POKENAME can transform into anything that has ever existed in the universe. Scientists claim the drops of slime that ooze from its body may become planets, constellations, or even new Pokémon.
author: milchik

entry: Using vague literary imagery and interpretive sketches, POKENAME is the result of imitating the inimitable: an attempt at depicting the deity Arceus.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: A legend in the Sinnoh region goes that a hiker saw the silhouette of this Pokémon and thought it to be an ancient deity from the region's mythos.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Though POKENAME can freely transform, it prefers to start fights in its normal form to gauge an opponent's strength. Its malleable body allows it to nimbly dodge strikes and hit back with stretchy, gelatinous limbs.
author: sk372

entry: The feathers on POKENAME slowly fall off, making it look like it is dripping. As more feathers come off it struggles to deal with the cold and so migrates away from the poles to warmer temperatures. During evolution, it somehow regains its feathers.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME can rearrange its cellular structure to take on the form of various blades. Each transformation comes at the cost of its owner's life force.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: Right before landing a hit, POKENAME likes to change its blade's composition into that of a random material or any object vaguely resembling a weapon.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When a single blade is not enough, POKENAME transforms itself into whichever two blades its owner wishes for. It drains a large amount of life force.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: According to legend, POKENAME will come to aid a despairing hero in need. For the price of the hero's soul, POKENAME will become the perfect sword.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: In its regular state, POKENAME cannot even cut through milk. If wielded by a trusted Trainer, it is able to morph into any kind of metal imaginable.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Its horns drip with bubbling slime that is highly toxic if ingested. This trait adds a lethal edge to its already-formidable attacks.
author: .izik

entry: When it takes on the appearance of another Pokémon, the star on its tail flashes intermittently. The roars produced by POKENAME are very weak, making it difficult for it to intimidate others without first proving its true power.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The goo that drips from its body carries the sweet scent of Pecha Berries. This scent attracts curious Pokémon, which often mistake it for food.
author: .izik

entry: A master of shapeshifting and illusion, POKENAME can create dynamic illusory scenes to trap its foes in their deepest desires or worst nightmares.
author: strawbearycandy

entry: When first discovered, scientists believed this Pokémon was a Ditto mid-transformation into a Sylveon. Its DNA is extremely unstable.
author: melodydelune

entry: It stomps about to mark its territory near lakes and rivers. Its poison turns ones sweat slimy, but is ultimately harmless.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: It appears near the end of nightmares, accompanied by darkness. Its clueless and silly demeanor, however, makes people wake up laughing.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Masters of showmanship, POKENAME morph their excess ooze into a variety of shapes to lure in an audience. As the final act in the performance, POKENAME fling the ooze into the air and catch it all as it rains down, growing larger and taking a bow.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Ditto's changeable nature extends to the spores POKENAME gives off. In places where POKENAME dwells, a variety of never-before-seen mushroom species have been discovered.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME carries every appliance it can think of with it, so it can be ready in any battle situation. However, due to indecisiveness, it uses none.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME beguile other Pokémon into giving them gifts and food by transforming into a Pokémon that they are friendly with. They determine what Pokémon to transform into by reading the mind of their target.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its body begins to vibrate when bathed in the light of the moon. This subtle movement seems to change with each phase of the lunar cycle.
author: .izik

entry: Its webs are made of thick, sticky pink strings that cling tightly to anything they touch. These unusual threads make it an expert trapper of prey.
author: .izik

entry: Clinging to cave ceilings, it imitates stalactites perfectly. When explorers pass beneath, it drops onto them, catching them completely off guard.
author: .izik

entry: The slime that drips from its body flickers like flames, glowing softly in the dark. This eerie effect makes it appear as if it's burning without heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's blades appear as sharp as knives, intimidating opponents into submission. Unfortunately, this is only an illusion, posing no real danger.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME transforms into ancient statues to guard forgotten ruins. It mimics their imposing presence to deter intruders from uncovering the treasures within.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has innards that are highly malleable and can transform into any shape. It uses these both to defend and to disguise itself. When it rests at night, POKENAME wraps itself in its own innards and uses Transform to look like a rock.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is the nightmare of law enforcement and locksmiths everywhere. It can mold its gooey body to fit into and unlock any keyhole.
author: sivanandi

entry: Many regard this Pokémon as the definition of an identity crisis. Many have been reported to have ventured to where POKENAME live, but they all return changed, both physically and mentally.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: Its body boils and bursts with hot slime, making it volatile to handle. This intense heat serves as both a defense mechanism and a warning to predators.
author: .izik

entry: Although usually in sync, POKENAME's three heads possess some autonomy from each other. This results in transformations occasionally having traits of another Pokémon involved as one head tried shifting into a different form than the others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME usually keeps its three heads shifted into different Dragon-type Pokémon, borrowing their abilities and intimidating appearance. It's not uncommon for one head to forget to transform completely, though.
author: sk372

entry: People once ate POKENAME as a delicacy, but in the modern era, many have pushed back against its consumption.
author: clownatosis

entry: The combination of Deoxys and Ditto has resulted in POKENAME, which is capable of transforming itself to replicate other Pokémon with greater ease. It has displayed the capacity to replicate multiple Pokémon at once using its arms, if only briefly.
author: infinex21

entry: Scientists attempted to sequence the DNA structure of Pokémon from other worlds. All attempts resulted in POKENAME.
author: tokenoracle

entry: POKENAME can use their malleable bodies to change shape at will. They change their shape to try to fulfill the wishes of others, though they aren't very successful.
author: santon5512

entry: The fluid dripping from its body contains a chemical used in film development. Many photographers keep several of these Pokémon to save on processing costs.
author: .izik

entry: The tip of its tail glows with electrical energy when it enters a fight. This glowing tail serves as both a warning and a weapon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attempt to replicate different styles of music that they have heard by transforming their vocal cords. Unfortunately, their wobbly bodies cause them to sound more like muffled recordings.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is extremely eager to evolve. It'll often escape its shell in hopes it will transform into a Ditmance, but instead reverts to a normal Ditto.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME transforms into other Pokémon in order to form friendships. Its true form is rarely seen, even by itself.
author: tarastargaze

entry: POKENAME transform their bodies to mimic various jungle plants that they pass, down to the odour those plants produce. They do this to hunt food. Any Pokémon seeking to feed on them gets stuck to their gooey surface and gradually absorbed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME transform their bodies to mimic various jungle plants that they pass, down to the odour those plants produce. They do this to hunt food. Any Pokémon seeking to feed on them gets stuck to their gooey surface and gradually absorbed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The tip of POKENAME's tail glows with a strange warmth. It is thought that POKENAME uses this light to lure prey and communicate with others of its kind.
author: mepp.

entry: The tips of its ears exude a scent reminiscent of sweet cream, which bakers prize as a rare ingredient. This aroma adds a unique touch to delicate pastries.
author: .izik

entry: Its small body requires energy from photosynthesis in order to transform, so POKENAME can only morph while in direct sunlight. When the light is gone, it immediately returns to its normal shape.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys eating composted soil, and can alter its body when it does. It's not exactly a Ditto, but it's Dit-ish.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME have an amorphous body that solidifies whenever they transform into another Pokémon. They are most vulnerable while not transformed because they are slow and soft.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lures other Pokémon away from its nest by transforming into prey they desire to chase. It discovers their preferences by reading their minds.
author: .izik

entry: It struggles to generate electricity, so it absorbs it from other sources. If you find a plug connected to an outlet with no attached cord, it may be a transformed POKENAME.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is quite proud of the shape and size of its tusks, and tends to incorporate the tusks in its transformations. Whether in the new form's mouth or hands or as some type of accessory, the tusks will always be present in its changed state.
author: sk372

entry: It spits embers to burn away debris on the forest floor, clearing the way for new growth. This habit ensures the environment remains healthy and flourishing.
author: .izik

entry: The ooze on its body is deceptively hot, scorching anything it touches. This unexpected heat makes it a dangerous foe in battle.
author: .izik

entry: The antennae-like structures around its body expand and contract as it breathes, mimicking the action of lungs. This strange trait keeps it constantly in motion.
author: .izik

entry: When it flaps its wings, it spreads a viscous slime that coats the surrounding area. This slime hinders the movement of anything caught in its path.
author: .izik

entry: It bounces like a tire across the landscape, leaving sticky residue wherever it lands. This gooey trail makes tracking it both easy and messy.
author: .izik

entry: Researchers have uncovered earlier signs of this Pokémon's existence. The latest report dated its chemical signature to a meteor that landed over 10 million years ago.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME may seem intimidating with its size, but has no real inclination towards aggression. In fact, it often accompanies large aggressive Pokémon, inadvertently curbing their violent tendencies with its incessant want to play with them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rearrange its cell structure to create a terrifying form to scare off predators. However, it didn't quite get the face right.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: A plastic bag contains POKENAME. Its body, by default, is only mildly poisonous. POKENAME's unstable DNA can rearrange its body to become paralytic.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It releases pollen that sticks to anything, making it difficult to remove. This sticky pollen serves both as a defense mechanism and a way to mark territory.
author: .izik

entry: As it floats through the sky, it drips a strange pink liquid that mimics nearby materials. This bizarre secretion puzzles researchers studying its behavior.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will only exercise its transformative abilities in colder areas. Warmer temperatures mess with its cellular structure, making it difficult for it to maintain its transformed states.
author: sk372

entry: It can manipulate its gelatinous body to squeeze through spaces as narrow as three inches. This ability makes it exceptionally hard to capture.
author: .izik

entry: Oddly buoyant, it floats on the ocean's surface, allowing the waves to carry it vast distances. This passive drifting leads it to many strange and remote places.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's slimy, ever-shifting body is laced with an extremely potent toxin. Even the slightest touch can leave an opponent feeling numb for hours.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its amorphous body to execute complex wrestling moves, contorting into surprising forms mid-grapple. This flexibility allows it to overwhelm opponents with unpredictable maneuvers.
author: .izik

entry: It fused into a form resembling neither of its halves. Rather, it appears closer to that of a Pokémon told of in competitive Trainers' rumors.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME frequently goes down to the beach and mimics sand castles children make. When it sees a crying child, it makes a funny face to cheer them up.
author: totodile.

entry: By shaking its body, it spreads ice-cold ooze across the ground. This frosty slime freezes anything it touches, leaving a slick trail behind.
author: .izik

entry: When it looks at the moon, it becomes overly excited, causing its transformation to falter slightly. This excitement leads to subtle but noticeable imperfections.
author: .izik

entry: During fusion, the Parasect's body melted so it can be a suitable host for Ditto. Luckily, thanks to the parasite mushroom, this is painless.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME plods about with a carefree demeanor. On the rare occasion it becomes upset, it expresses its feelings with random, tumultuous transformations.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME are made of a gelatinous, ever-shifting liquid that's only stabilized within their shells. The liquid spills from the shell, constantly looking to expand or move, only to form back into the main body.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The drippings from its wings are used to create an expensive type of lip gloss in Canalave City, renowned for its brilliant sheen. This beauty product is highly coveted across regions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically have sticky, syrupy bodies due to Ditto's unstable genetic makeup combined with Swirlix's sugary strands. Loose bits falling from a POKENAME, dense in simple carbohydrates, are delicious to both humans and Pokémon.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's pudding-like body emits a sweet aroma reminiscent of a freshly baked Pomeg Berry tart. Some Pokémon mistake it for food, only to be surprised when it wiggles away.
author: .izik

entry: Their blobby bodies reside around waste facilities, which causes grime and trash to stick to their bodies. When introduced to a bit of Quick Powder, they become more viscous and aerodynamic, making them faster when running.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its slimy skin is able to change its own structure, even after it's shed. To assist in taking on larger forms, POKENAME wears a large piece of shed skin on its legs.
author: hophoppip

entry: The shed skin POKENAME wears around its neck and legs can transform with the rest of its body. Scientists have succeeded in making a shape-changing glove out of POKENAME skin.
author: hophoppip

entry: As it falls through the atmosphere, POKENAME's gelatinous body partially melts from the intense heat. Upon landing, it clings to cool surfaces in dark caves, avoiding warm areas as it slowly reforms over time.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME produce a cloud of toxic spores that protect them while they transform into another Pokémon. If anything makes contact with their body while they are transformed, tiny scales stand on edge and inject venom at the point of contact.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During heavy rain, when the flame on its tail weakens, POKENAME struggles to keep its gelatinous body together. It enjoys mimicking the Pokémon it encounters, though it often forgets some of their details.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While burrowing, POKENAME imitates nearby large stones to avoid predators. How it selects which stone to mimic remains unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's sticky wings are quite heavy and make flying difficult. Prone to getting stuck after landing in all sorts of strange positions, it relies on humans to help get back on their feet.
author: mepp.

entry: Skating across ponds, POKENAME deftly reconstitutes its DNA to make its scent resemble the nearest predator's least favorite food.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: When it encounters strong Pokémon, POKENAME reconstitutes the cells in its antennae to copy the appearance of the other Pokémon's eyes. It seeks out rare and powerful Pokémon to maximize this borrowed intimidation.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME regular switches which of its three “heads” actually holds its face. It enjoys clinging to the sides of tunnels dug by Diglett and Dugtrio so it can jump up and surprise them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are capable of transforming into another Pokémon, but matching their cry is another story. They either are too quiet or are so loud that they make children cry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sounds POKENAME emits from the speakers on its head are powerful but slightly distorted. It can transform, but since doing so requires great concentration, it can only do it in complete silence.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME analyzes creatures in front of it by shouting, measuring how the sound waves bounce off of its target. It can only transform into something after yelling at it in this manner first.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can transform its oozing cellular mass with the power of thought. It will for hours on end shift through transformations to practice different yoga poses, and perfect the mindset of each form it embodies.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It uses its slimy form to squeeze into safes and vaults, lounging among the money. This behavior makes it a notorious figure among thieves.
author: .izik

entry: To impress Illumise, POKENAME transform themselves into the shapes of big constellations. They sometimes make themselves look like Illumise to trick other Volbeat into giving them a show.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can take on the appearance of anything it swallows, but only while it digests. Once the process is over, POKENAME returns to its original look and begins searching for something, or someone, else to eat.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's diet consists of anything edible it can stretch its malleable body over. While full, it maintains a joyful smile. Should it be left without food for too long, it enters a frenzy state until fed again.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME experience regular migraines that cause them to lose control of the integrity of their bodies. Whenever they reform after recovering they never quite look the same. These changes can add up over time, leaving them looking totally different.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME performs an odd dance not only to confuse opponents but also to distract them long enough to figure out how to transform. Its cellular structure is highly unstable, making it a fascinating subject for scientific study.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are formed of two different kinds of liquids. The purple sort houses their organs, which change position to avoid being hit. The clear blue type stretches to attack.
author: .realthree

entry: To avoid combat, POKENAME regularly transforms into other fish Pokémon and joins their schools. Once they rest, it takes the opportunity to conceal themselves in the mud.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME experience regular migraines that cause them to lose control of the integrity of their bodies. Whenever they reform after recovering they never quite look the same. These changes can add up over time, leaving them looking totally different.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Pokémon historians theorise that POKENAME is responsible for the origin of legends surrounding the Kappa, the transformative properties of the Pokémon letting it appear monstrous at will. Despite their appearance, they are quite amiable.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Whenever POKENAME transforms into another Pokémon, it softens sharp features to appear rounder. While this transformation rarely convinces others, many Trainers enjoy the cute form POKENAME take on.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though it's mimicked a Mankey's form, POKENAME cannot truly mimic its violent temperament. It tries to keep an angry expression, but cannot hold it long before a jovial smile returns to its face.
author: sk372

entry: To keep itself and other POKENAME entertained, it transforms itself into a ball to balance and spin on their nose. It can perfectly memorize a Pokémon to transform into by studying it meticulously with its whiskers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME pretends that part of its body is a shell so that predators will find it less appetizing and leave it alone. The bubbles it produces from its mouth are pink and have a jelly-like consistency.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME transforms into other Pokémon, sometimes its transformation varies starkly from what it should look like. Researchers believe it may be copying what prehistoric versions of its mimicry target looked like.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats near power plants and observes the workers who enter. When they leave, it transforms into one of them and slips inside to find a secluded spot to feed on the electricity within.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are obedient creatures that want nothing more than to please their Trainer. Their ability to transform into other Pokémon gets better as the bond with their Trainer grows stronger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If its gelatinous body becomes wet, it struggles to hold its wings together. When facing a powerful opponent, POKENAME mimics their appearance to fight on equal terms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After failing to transform perfectly, it meditates for hours in frustration. This habit helps it regain focus for future attempts.
author: .izik

entry: While only a passable imitation, POKENAME has also assimilated the psychic powers of Alakazam. With spoons formed from itself, it can unleash confounding waves of psychic energy that can quickly overwhelm a foe.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME transforms into the appearance of a Machop, copying it with almost perfect accuracy. However, its reduced strength and lack of martial arts skills often give it away.
author: shyguy11011

entry: It stands perfectly still in a rigid pose before launching an attack. This behavior creates an unsettling tension that confuses opponents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves showing off its muscular form, flexing in a variety of poses. It often goes too far, overexerting its muscles and causing them to lose shape and temporarily turn to goop.
author: sk372
