entry: POKENAME are often used during romantic holidays as a way for spouses to show affection to one another. POKENAME do not fully understand the sign they are asked to make, but will enthusiastically help their Trainers regardless.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME maintains the solidness of its shell for protection. When transforming, it hides within the shell, popping out in its altered form once the process is complete.
author: sk372

entry: During combat, random sprouts and vines grow from its body. While seemingly unpredictable, the plant growth follows a hidden but consistent pattern.
author: .izik

entry: Its body has the consistency of chewed bubblegum, making it sticky enough to roll up walls. This adhesiveness also helps it trap objects in its path.
author: .izik

entry: As it rolls, it leaves behind a trail of rhubarb-scented slime. This unusual scent confuses pursuers, masking its escape route.
author: .izik

entry: If someone beats it in a race, POKENAME tries to take on their appearance, hoping to become just as skilled. Since its body risks freezing over when exposed to low temperatures, it prefers to inhabit very warm regions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It drinks lava as if it were water, thriving in extreme heat. This unusual ability makes it perfectly suited for volcanic environments.
author: .izik

entry: Few, if any, POKENAME have been observed in the act of transforming. It's theorized by some that their simple minds have caused them to forget they even have the ability.
author: sk372

entry: The ooze that drips from its body is highly magnetic, attracting small metallic objects. This strange property makes it difficult for POKENAME to avoid sticking to metal surfaces.
author: .izik

entry: It mimics the voices of passing humans, often echoing sinister laughter to unnerve travelers at night. These eerie imitations leave those who hear them deeply unsettled.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys absorbing different types of liquid chemicals into its skin. This habit causes its body to change colors depending on the substances it absorbs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a goo-like substance that allows it to move through the tiniest of gaps and rearrange its cell structure to mimic anything. Scientists are unsure why, but 71% of its transformations are into things on the microscopic scale.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME keeps its vulnerable squishy body fused inside a sturdy shell. To blend in, the amorphous goo may rearrange its cells to look like another Pokémon or even a pearl. However, this sometimes makes POKENAME a target to others instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although the cells of POKENAME can alter their structure to take on many different forms, they are, by default, as hard as titanium alloys. POKENAME tends to live by small waterfalls, such as those west of Cianwood City.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME try desperately to scare people in Lavender Town, but usually fail. Although few are intimidated, some act scared to boost their confidence.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It can melt into a puddle, a state it often assumes when sleeping. This form keeps it hidden from predators and prying eyes.
author: .izik

entry: Legends say its drippings were once used by ancient witches to brew elixirs that let them imitate royalty. These potions granted both the appearance and behavior of those in power.
author: .izik

entry: By using its psychic powers, it learns a target's history before transforming into them. This insight ensures its mimicry is disturbingly accurate.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can grow a large claw to incredible sizes using their squishy body. This is rarely effective, however, simply slowing them down and leaving them off-balance.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME can be found virtually everywhere, looking for their ideal spot for evolution. Despite how small they are, POKENAME can survive in even the harshest of environments.
author: mistymagius

entry: Each of the eggs in an POKENAME clutch exhibits a different type of element. Though individually their capabilities are meager, together they can make a formidable confluence of powers.
author: sk372

entry: The eggs in an POKENAME clutch exhibit different personalities and elemental properties. The center one tries to maintain order, but the rest of the group are typically quite rebellious.
author: sk372

entry: Although it has the incredible ability to adapt to any environment, it seems to prefer dark, isolated cave systems. Trainers who stand at the entrances to these caves can sometimes hear its loud, echoing cry of sorrow.
author: sautomagically

entry: Rumors say the bone it carries can change in size or shape depending on the environment, much like its actual body. It masterfully uses the skull it wears to protect its soft body during fights.
author: sautomagically

entry: There are reports of POKENAME emitting gases which caused other Trainer's Pokémon to evolve unexpectedly. These reports have been proven false, but rumors still persist.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME are said to evolve when they choose a climate that they enjoy living in. Regardless of the reason they evolve, their big appetite often delays their evolution until the time is right.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are vulnerable creatures that often hide away from other Pokémon to ensure their safety. Some evolve to adapt to the climates around them and gain new powers to help them make it out of the cocoon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its furry vines build static electricity easily, causing frequent mild shocks. POKENAME that realize they're causing pain to their Trainers will often actively avoid Thunder Stones at all costs to avoid worsening the problem.
author: sivanandi

entry: Though flightless, mighty leaps give its four fluffy tails the illusion of wings fluttering. When POKENAME'S fur is wet, it can't jump as high.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Each POKENAME seems to show an affinity for one of its gems, expressing a natural talent for this type. Upon evolving, the central gem unleashes a devastating beam of light, signaling its true form has awakened.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each POKENAME seems to show an affinity for one of its gems, expressing a natural talent for this type. Upon evolving, the central gem unleashes a devastating beam of light, signaling its true form has awakened.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Often found trying to sneak into parties, POKENAME just loves to dance. Strong music genre preference seems to influence its evolution.
author: rosemagwin

entry: If the genes of all POKENAME in a body of water mutate in the exact same way, that is a sign of heavy pollution. Since the mutations don't hurt POKENAME, scientists release groups of them in waters worldwide to monitor water quality.
author: soup1900

entry: It's thought that the type of vegetation POKENAME eats affects its evolutionary direction, as it has a noticeable shift in appetite, preferring specific types of plants shortly before it evolves.
author: sk372

entry: With the discovery of this bizarre fusion, scientists have debated whether POKENAME is even capable of evolution, or if it simply prefers transforming into Eevee-esque shapes to adapt.
author: lampent12

entry: This particular Eevee has undergone a unique mutation. Its genetic makeup has changed significantly, and now closely resembles all of its known Evolutions'.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Due to Eevee's unstable genetic makeup, fusing two of them caused a wild reaction. It took on elements of all of Eevee's possible mutations at once.
author: kittyluv090

entry: After combining with another Eevee, its latent powers have awoken, and it can control the powers of all of its evolutions. However, this comes at a cost: the huge amount of energy is slowly consuming it, constantly trying to make it evolve.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME's genes have become so unstable that it often randomly mutates. These mutations make it hard for it to unfuse.
author: quasardiamond

entry: Combining an Eevee with another Eevee has resulted in its unstable genes mutating, creating a Pokémon with features of each possible evolution.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: Its body has not fully adapted to its aquatic habitat as it struggles to swim in stronger currents. Due to its fur not being fully hydrophobic, it is constantly saturated with water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's fur is warm to the touch, making it a popular pet in colder areas. If it gets too angry, however, it has a chance to accidentally catch its fur on fire.
author: mistymagius

entry: Developed by Silph Co., it was made to test environments in cyberspace. Once it finishes updating, POKENAME evolves.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Its programming is highly susceptible to alterations. Entire subcommunities center around sharing visually modified copies of it.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME are coated in thick, plush fur that protects their bodies whilst they prepare to evolve. They congregate near areas full of elemental energy, using the ambient energy to help them evolve faster.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Due to its adaptive DNA and the long-lasting naps it takes, it's not uncommon for an POKENAME to evolve while asleep and not even realize its changed for some time after waking.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a rare Pokémon. Legend says it will evolve into different forms when in contact to certain stones.
author: deflador

entry: Within their bodies lies potent energy that is dormant until the moment of their evolution. When they near evolution, the crystal upon their necks will glow with a specific color indicative of their evolution.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are quite affectionate and will often swarm after something to hug and nuzzle it. They seem unaware that their appearance hurtling towards another at high speed could be seen as disconcerting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is able to create constructs resembling evolutionary stones through sheer psychic power. It quietly ponders these facsimiles often, its tail shifting through a myriad of hues as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known for being adaptable to their environments, so it is not uncommon to see them in many different locales. They are quick to make friends and love to play with round objects and toys.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon is a popular house pet for its small size, cute appearance, and its ability to emit pleasant, calming smells from its leaves. It likes curling up in warm, sunny windowsills and soaking up the rays.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Its feathers change hue when in close proximity of most evolution stones. Should it touch one, it will start to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's was initially assumed to be an odd coloration of Furret due to their strong resemblance. It was only after a wild specimen evolved on contact with a Water Stone that researchers realized it was a fusion.
author: sk372

entry: Rare variants of POKENAME that take on coloration similar to Eevee have been spotted in the wild. These versions of POKENAME seem a bit less skittish and more approachable in the wild by comparison.
author: sk372

entry: These highly adaptive Pokémon have unstable DNA that causes them to be effective hunters. Their webbing is used in nests, traps, and nets, and it appears to shine in different colors.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Small flocks of POKENAME migrate all around the world. The reason for this is not entirely known: they simply seem to enjoy doing it. If an POKENAME evolves, it leaves the flock.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has poor eyesight, so it uses the furry tips of its antennae to familiarize itself with its environment. Groups of POKENAME are often seen tickling each other as a greeting.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It will steal batteries from residential areas. Once it has enough gathered, it will fall asleep on top of its horde.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME struggles to get around with its short limbs, so it resorts to rolling. As a result, it picks up lots of small debris in its fur that it can't get out.
author: darxer_

entry: Very curious and gullible, POKENAME needs constant supervision because it is easily distracted and can unknowingly put itself in harm's way.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are able to glean glimpses of the future with their psychic powers. They spend hours trying to predict what is to come. Their own evolutionary potential frequently changes the visions they see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legends say it once watched over traveling caravans, ensuring their safe passage. Its watchful nature is regarded as a sign of good fortune.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is covered in thick, wool-like fur that is highly prized by many breeders. When irritated, it can stiffen its down and charge it with static electricity in the blink of an eye.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is covered in thick, wool-like fur that is highly prized by many breeders. When irritated, it can stiffen its down and charge it with static electricity in the blink of an eye.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its body is completely covered in a fluffy, ultra-soft wool coat. It must be sheared at least twice a year, and its fleece is used to make high-end blankets and pillows for luxury hotels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its body is completely covered in a fluffy, ultra-soft wool coat. POKENAME must be sheared at least twice a year, and its fleece is used to make high-end blankets and pillows for luxury hotels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its somewhat menacing appearance, POKENAME can be very affectionate. It tends to gift its favorite feathers to its Trainer once it has earned their trust.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's soft and fluffy tail has been described by many as pleasant to squeeze. POKENAME itself feels a pleasant tickle from the act, so it happily offers up its tail to anybody who wants to hold it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates its nests near mines for easier access to Evolution stones for itself and its family. While they are definitely a nuisance, they are considered so cute that most miners are happy to tolerate them.
author: sivanandi

entry: A rare plushie collection called Mix Au Lait was based on POKENAME and its evolutions. It only ran for a limited time, and each plushie would make the sound of the Pokémon it was based on if squeezed.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Despite seeming tired and slow, POKENAME are capable of surviving in the wild. They make nests out of mud and fur near the water's edge to rest. Their nightcap-like hair subtly changes color when they are close to evolving.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are vulnerable creatures, usually trying to run away from any buzzards they spot. They must live their lives in hiding, or they'd quickly be eaten.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are popular pets for children. They are known to be docile, however their bite force is surprisingly powerful.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME love to collect evolution stones and will wear them as jewelry. It will even sneak into department stores to steal their collection of stones.
author: mistymagius

entry: Individual POKENAME can have a variety of different appearances. If multiple POKENAME are brought together, they will split into groups, only for the individuals to go to a different group every few seconds. The reason for this behavior is unknown.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Individual POKENAME can have a variety of different appearances. If multiple POKENAME are brought together, they will split into groups, only for the individuals to go to a different group every few seconds. The reason for this behavior is unknown.
author: bobosmith01

author: bobosmith01

entry: The flaps around POKENAME's face can easily and painlessly break off and regrow. Though considered tough and flavorless, some have found a use for them as chew toys for some small Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Demand for POKENAME as a house pet is always extremely high. Cases of Dunsparce being illegally poached for fusion purposes are, regrettably, common.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME can be found across all the regions, its adaptive body letting it function perfectly well in a multitude of climates. The membranes of its wings vary in color depending on its current habitat.
author: sk372

entry: Many of POKENAME's segments resemble evolutionary stones, but so far show no signs of functioning similarly. Supposedly, if one segment begins glowing brighter than the other, it signifies what direction POKENAME's evolution will take.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have luxuriously soft fur that makes them prized Pokémon within the fashion industry. Their fur has a sheen that changes colour when exposed to elemental stones, hinting at the unstable genetics of POKENAME and their evolutionary potential.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to rapidly adapt to their environment through evolution. They are found throughout the world in places as cold as the tundra to places as hot as the tropical rainforest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found in all sorts of environments, such as forests, mountains, tundras, and tropical rainforests. They are capable of rapidly adapting to their environment through evolution, though many prefer to remain unevolved.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shell on POKENAME's back is made of hardened magma. POKENAME has an unstable genetic composition that makes maintaining its molten body extremely difficult. Its lifespan is usually very short without the aid of an attentive Trainer.
author: ludacriswell

entry: Not only do they carry a unique genetic makeup, but they also can be found carrying various evolutionary items in their tail bundle.
author: pankiwi

entry: Although this fusion might look cute and cuddly, in the wild, packs of POKENAME are effective hunters due to their incredible teamwork. Their genetic makeup is highly adaptable, and they evolve to suit whatever environment their territory is in.
author: thatdanguy23

entry: A friendly creature that loves to wrap around and cuddle with others, it's not uncommon to see Trainers with their POKENAME happily draped over their shoulders or around their neck like a fluffy accessory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hide in underwater caves contemplating their limitless potential and keep others away by summoning whirlpools to block the entrance. It is said that POKENAME only come out of their caves once they decide on what to evolve into.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its upgraded form, POKENAME is still extremely vulnerable to evolution from stray data it collides with online. Trainers storing their POKENAME in PCs are advised to check up on them regularly to prevent unwanted evolution.
author: chibitales

entry: When living in an area that would help induce evolution, POKENAME's fur will change hue slightly, and its antlers will gain additional attributes, such as a layer of frost, flames at the tips or electric sparks, among others.
author: sk372

entry: Each of the paint colors POKENAME uses seems to have elemental properties. Red paint is hot to the touch, yellow paint gives an electric shock, and green paint accelerates plant growth.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can master nearly any fighting style if given enough time to train. This immense potential led many Trainers to seek out POKENAME, and over-catching has thinned their numbers in the wild.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME has highly sensitive fur that it uses to identify nearby objects. It hates dirt with a passion.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME store lots of static electricity in their fur and release it when they get excited. They can use any kind of elemental power to recharge.
author: totodile.

entry: The markings on POKENAME's torso resemble evolution stones, though the resemblance appears to be completely superficial. There are rumors that POKENAME with different patterns exist in regions like Johto and Sinnoh.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's milk takes on different flavors and textures depending on its surroundings. Northern Kanto POKENAME milk is particularly popular for its creamy quality and sweet taste.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its electrical attacks are especially strong.
author: .realthree

entry: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its electrical attacks are especially strong.

entry: Due to requiring two relatively rare Pokémon as components, this fusion is rarely seen. Those that exist are often kept as pets.
author: faelocke

entry: Within each of its feathers is said to lie the potential power of each of its many possible evolutions. Remarkably, its feathers all have different cellular structures as well and respectively glow in response to specific evolutionary stones.
author: infinex21

entry: It delights in creating fake tea kettles and hosting imaginary tea parties. This playful behavior brings joy to those who watch it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to collect all kinds of stones, from those with unusual colors to those that are smoothed down by time. It takes a long time to pick out which stone it wants to carry in its pouch on a given day.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A curled-up POKENAME is often so soft and warm that young children and young Pokémon alike love to cuddle up to one. They display an innate ability to adapt well to environments, which also influence their evolutions.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME create protrusions that resemble evolution stones from its body. Despite their looks, they are actually just fake evolution stones meant to lure in lower evolution Pokémon as bait.
author: camtft

entry: It is an uncommon woodland Pokémon whose appearance changes with the seasons and the nearby floral life. It adores all kinds of Berries.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is an uncommon woodland Pokémon whose appearance changes with the seasons and the nearby floral life. It adores all kinds of Berries.

entry: It is an uncommon woodland Pokémon whose appearance changes with the seasons and the nearby floral life. It adores all kinds of Berries.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME only evolve from Eevee raised near severe, sporadic sources of cold. Some Eevee breeders consider deliberately evolving one to be unethical.
author: staghorn

entry: Fusing Eevee with Porygon-Z has caused its genetic makeup to become critically unstable. It glitches every time it tries to adapt to an environment.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME's back is covered with spines resembling the multiple stones related to evolution. Though not effective as replacements for the stones proper, each spine does contain a modicum of the specific stone's energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to be able to harness the power of every known elemental force. It can freely generate and manipulate these elements in order to protect those it holds dear.
author: sk372

entry: Thanks to Eevee's malleable nature, POKENAME is able to adapt its fighting style to nearly any situation.
author: hophoppip

entry: A particularly skilled POKENAME can tap into its Eevee genes and conjure elemental blades with the power of all eight Eeveelutions.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's fur will change color to match its environment. Curiously, the same effect can be produced by exposing it to certain evolution stones.
author: mistymagius

entry: When gnawing on wood, POKENAME has been observed chiseling shapes into the trees it chews on. Though unconfirmed, it's believed the shapes relate to the form that specific POKENAME hopes to one day evolve into.
author: sk372

entry: Early in its life, POKENAME's flower has a multitude of different colors on its petals. As it grows and acclimates to its surroundings, the flower petals will change to all become the same pattern.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its cuteness and friendly nature, POKENAME's three other heads are constantly at war. They spew elemental attacks to prove their evolution is superior to the main body.
author: mistymagius

entry: Each tentacle of POKENAME represents one of the potential paths for it to take evolutionarily. It uses the tentacles that it would most prefer to become.
author: camtft

entry: Beneath the fur on POKENAME's head lies a hardened skull plate, making its headbutt quite potent. It headbutts tree trunks and rocks on a daily basis to maintain the sturdiness of its skull.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an excellent caretaker of young and fussy Pokémon. Any little one throwing a tantrum is picked up and put into a firm, yet gentle hug and won't be let go until they've calmed down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can foresee its own future. It will stubbornly refuse any Evolution stone that would cause it to evolve into a form different from the one it has predicted.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME's unstable genetics make it extremely susceptible to evolution at any time in any environment. The gemstones on its gate glow brightly when it is about to evolve, differing in color depending on what it will evolve into.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can climb very well and lives in tropical forests. Various environmental influences affect its future evolution.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.
author: chorb33

entry: A loyal spear full of potential. There is a slot on the back that seems to be missing a stone.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When near powerful sources of electricity, its fluffy mane puffs up, giving it a more intimidating appearance. When POKENAME is happy, the tip of its tail shines brightly.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is theorized that POKENAME is the result of an Eevee that retained its unstable genetic makeup when evolving into a Sylveon.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are very rarely encountered by Trainers as they live in the stratosphere, winding through clouds far out of view of the ground. They have an unstable genetic makeup, their genetic structure heavily influenced by the weather.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are cute, friendly, and very rare Pokémon that are often in demand by young women. They adore pretty jewels and stones, so it's easy to get them to participate in the Dress-Up portions of Pokémon Contests by giving them something sparkly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME scatters spores from its cap whenever it lands after a jump. The spores grow a random variety of unique mushrooms should they take root within fresh soil.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME reshapes itself and changes color in accordance to its move. As it grows closer to evolution, its default color alters to a different shading, hinting at what it will become.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are highly curious about different elemental powers, keeping samples of different energy types to compare them and educate others. It is believed that an POKENAME will only evolve based on the element it has the most experience with.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME carry several Evolution stones on their back. As they age, these stones gradually fall off. When only one stone remains, POKENAME will evolve according to the type of stone left.
author: _kuke_

entry: POKENAME treasures the stones it carries, treating them like special items meant for other Eevee. Professors say that if an Eevee were to swallow one of the stones, their body would fuse with the stone's energy.
author: ilija09

entry: Much like Mimikyu, POKENAME wears a rag fashioned into an Eevee costume to make it look less scary. This rag reacts strangely to its environment.
author: petermars

entry: Each of POKENAME's heads has a slightly different genetic makeup, causing them to yearn for different elemental evolutions. Its indecisiveness is likely the reason it has never evolved.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME is highly protective of its many colorful tails. According to rumors, pulling on one will cause one to be cursed, with the terrible fate that awaits differing depending on the tail's color.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has full control over its genetic structure. It can change its form and type based on what it needs for its environment.
author: ethewriter

entry: It can sense the aura of Evolution stones, and eagerly seeks them out to become stronger. Because of this, unevolved POKENAME are extremely rare.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME is always on the move, using its aura to gain insights about the people, Pokémon, and environment around it.  Whatever information it gathers affects how it evolves.
author: imaginita

entry: Segments of POKENAME's skull resemble the different evolutionary stones. The segments differ among different members of the species, and emit colored sparks when it strikes its head against a surface.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to create illusions of what it imagines it might look like when it evolves. Actually evolving it can be a challenge, though, because it's often very indecisive.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME's flame starts out being colorless in the early days of its life, but as it develops, the color will change depending on the habitat it resides in. Urban-raised POKENAME typically develop tan-colored flames.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's unstable genetics cause the flowers on its hands to grow a multitude of colors. Each color seems to give off a different, unique aroma.
author: airybeats

entry: Its soft fur is harvested and crafted into highly prized Choice Scarves. Thanks to its sweet and gentle appearance, POKENAME is frequently given to young children as a way to introduce them to Pokémon from an early age.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It stores static electricity in its neck fur. Although POKENAME enjoys affection, anyone who pets it is at risk of an accidental static shock.
author: cait_sith

entry: Because POKENAME's wingspans are disproportionate to their body, they fly in sporadic movements. For assistance, they will find Altaria to help them, usually flying slightly above Altaria's cloud wings.
author: teatedtiten

entry: It lives in the depths of caves, eating rocks and crystals. The shinier the gems POKENAME eats, the more lustrous and soft its fur becomes.
author: larky_

entry: Despite having a natural affinity to fire, many say POKENAME can well and truly be anything it desires. It often imitates the various dances of its evolutions, practicing as it decides what it wants to become.
author: robbery_666

entry: While cheering, it releases invigorating scents that energize everyone nearby. Its lively dance is said to inspire optimism.
author: .izik

entry: It has a fascination with discarded colored glass, collecting pieces to decorate its nest. This hobby gives it a unique and colorful living space.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leaves are sometimes employed in cafés, where their head leaves are used in salads. Their leaves have different flavours depending on how they're prepared and are usually paired with granules of elemental stones.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Due to the instability of its DNA and liquid-based body, it is often seen lying dried out on the ground like a puddle. Trainers colloquially referred to it as “Silly Puddle”.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's slick and gelatinous body lets it slide itself into a variety of tight spaces it enjoys exploring. These explorations leave behind a sticky, furry residue that fortunately dissipates in an hour.
author: sk372

entry: The petals on POKENAME's head symbolizes its evolutionary potential. The more of one type of petal is on its head, the closer it is to evolution.
author: mistymagius

entry: When it finds a pack of Eevee, POKENAME embeds itself into the ground, leaving the evolution stones on its head exposed. After all the stones are used up, its life comes to an end.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME haunts beaches, where it lures unsuspecting victims into petting it by cutely pretending to be an Eevee buried in sand. When they touch it, it takes control of them and forces them to bring it Evolution stones.
author: knilk

entry: POKENAME are capable of spontaneously evolving to adapt to their environment. The spores they produce are a harmless powder that gains new properties once they evolve.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a coat is a mix of rubble and fur. They are known to be intensely loyal to their Trainers.
author: theartemis1

entry: The stones on POKENAME's mane represent what evolution the Pokémon wants to become. They are usually indecisive, so finding one with only a single type of stone is rare.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME is a highly adaptive performer that has yet to find a specific style that suits them. They are incredibly friendly and will gladly sing for any fan, many of whom form parasocial relationships.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME is an extremely versatile vocalist, capable of singing everything from operatic arias to death-metal growls with great skill. It can even match synthetic vocals that are otherwise impossible to physically sing.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME are full of limitless musical potential. They can harmonize with many types of music, each with their own depth and meaning.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of rapidly adapting to their environment through evolution. The mushroom on their backs also goes through significant changes when they evolve.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many different types of Evolution Stones form from POKENAME's rocky bodies. Because of this, they are commonly sought out by miners, making them highly elusive.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME have a sweet scent that draws Eevee towards them. Many Eevee find the scent pleasant and will rest atop the fungal backs of POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although possessing limitless potential, POKENAME tends to lean towards Fire-Type moves. At present, it has yet to fully tap into stronger feats other than simple fires to keep itself warm in the wild. It has more energy the warmer the temperature.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME are often unsure about what they should evolve into. Whenever they are near a stone that can evolve them, the crystal on their staffs changes color. The more intense its hue, the more an POKENAME feels drawn towards that stone.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME are as soft and plush as Fluffy Eevee Pancakes, their pillowy bodies resembling the taste and texture of the delicious dessert. They enjoy working in cafes because they get to act cute and give delicious food to Trainers and Pokémon alike.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is hard to train due to its constant aggression, only mellowed out by headbutting a random surface. The color of its saggy fur changes as it either approaches evolution or comes into proximity with an evolution stone.
author: beatdoof

entry: A Pokémon as energetic as it is genetically unstable, POKENAME is quite popular amongst wealthy Trainers. Colored stones are ground up and fed to it, changing its color or even causing it to evolve.
author: gronkissimo

entry: The clear quartz crystals on POKENAME's head refract light into rainbows. POKENAME eagerly pounces on the rainbows it creates.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's horn is extremely sensitive and changes color if an Evolution stone is nearby. The color it changes is based on the type of stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME deliberately avoids elemental stones while digging to prevent unwanted evolution. When distressed, it will seek one out to force the change.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to travel, often flying great distances in search of new and interesting places. They quickly adapt to the conditions of their destinations, no matter how inhospitable they may be.
author: staghorn

entry: Many accidental evolutions are caused by Trainers not securing their bags while asleep, as POKENAME are notorious for stealing evolution stones. Supposedly, this is because they are attracted to the energy these stones emit.
author: thatdanguy23

entry: Hyperactive, curious, and adored by many around the world, POKENAME are loving felines who have a habit of getting into mischief. There are hundreds of online forums dedicated to this Pokémon and their evolutions, depicting their daily shenanigans.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME have a difficult time choosing what they want to be after evolving, and some doubt they want to evolve at all. This constant worry about the consequences of evolution gives them a chronic migraine.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are superb swimmers that can perform complex maneuvers while underwater. Many POKENAME look for evolution stones so that they can better adapt to their environment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's cries echo inside their hollow body, which are impacted by the instability of their DNA, leading to soundwaves sounding like a cacophony of painful cries. They try many methods to evolve in order to try and ease the concerns of Trainers.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Although it spends most of its time in the water, it can sometimes be seen hopping around on land in search of Berries. Its soft ears are very sensitive, and if it hears even a faint suspicious noise, it immediately runs away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME resembles an aquatic Pokémon, but also has a fur coat to keep it warm as it floats in the air. If it spends enough time out of the water, it may evolve into a form more suited to life on land.
author: .jerden

entry: Paleontologists working in deserts and rocky areas use POKENAME to help them clean fossils. POKENAME produce a mildly sticky slime from their furred tail that dirt and debris sticks to, leaving the area spotless.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME loves to play, especially with stones it heats up with its breath. Don't let it play with evolutionary stones though, unless you are in for a surprise!
author: ayutac

entry: POKENAME are well-mannered pets that always follow social etiquette while out in public. They are popular among wealthy parents because they are easy to train and are gentle with children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's genes become more unstable the more frequently it teleports around. However, with very long naps, its body can slowly work to stabilize its genes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses telekinesis to carry evolutionary stones with it at all times. When it places one over its forehead, it gains an elemental boost to its psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are commonly found carrying various evolution stones in their telekinesis. Scientists believe POKENAME carry these stones around because they are conflicted on what they want to evolve into and are paralyzed by the choices.
author: chibitales

entry: Universities have been using POKENAME more and more to help incoming freshman students. POKENAME ease students' anxiety with their friendly and attentive disposition, and use their bulk to deter any bullying.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME digs through the ground, scavenging for evolutionary stones to feast on. It despises the taste of Moon Stones, Sun Stones, Shiny Stones, Dawn Stones, and Dusk Stones.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its armor is crafted with a layer of various Evolution stones placed atop a layer of solid stone. If the armor cracks, this Pokémon may evolve.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME are rather frail Pokémon that happily trot around open fields. They all react differently to various evolutionary stones, though the most noticeable reaction is to a Fire Stone as their flames will grow larger the closer they are to one.
author: infinex21

entry: Its thick, soft fur grows so long and flows so freely as it trots that many mistake the hair for flames. Certain evolutionary stones cause its fur to change as it draws nearer to them, be it in color, texture, or both.
author: infinex21

entry: It often pretends not to be lonely, gazing off into the distance with a calm demeanor. Despite this act, it seeks companionship quietly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME generates powerful radio waves that seem to greatly upset Pokémon that are on the verge of evolving, or those that have recently evolved. Some have speculated that a powerful POKENAME could force nearby Pokémon to evolve against their will.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The fusion process has mutated some of Eevee's genetic code as a side effect. Due to this, its heads resemble two of Eevee's evolutions.
author: cascadeguy

entry: The heads of POKENAME occasionally display abilities from three of Eevee's evolutions. However, the potency of these abilities is not as impressive.
author: cascadeguy

entry: POKENAME's fur adapts to the water it dives into, keeping it warm and sleek to swim through the depths with ease. It dries out quickly once it breaches back onto land, becoming warm and fluffy once more.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's striped sludge is actually a method of camouflage. Sometimes, it will eat the radiation from an evolution stone instead of evolving.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are made of a sludge that leaves behind a poisonous residue on grass and any plants they trample. This residue is known to cause an itchiness in the throat when consumed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of an array of gases that are heavily altered by their unstable DNA. They flicker many colors and in the wild are frequently confused for other Pokémon.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Depending on the surroundings, POKENAME's aura will develop different elemental features over time. These changes also affect how its ghostly powers manifest as it haunts those living in its chosen home.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its lifestyle of tunneling underground, its body is actually covered in a soft layer of fur. The evolution stones embedded within its skin often become dislodged, making POKENAME nesting grounds a highly sought-after location by gem traders.
author: zephyr.txt

entry: POKENAME create dreams that revolve around evolution. They ease the many worries dreamers have about evolution by showing what life would look like fully evolved.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon around them to lull them asleep before giving them sweet dreams of the future. The dreams often explore the limitless potential every Pokémon has by showing dreamers great feats of heroism.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's legs haven't quite adapted to aquatic conditions so it relies on its powerful tail to propel itself through the water. They are quite friendly to humans and will come to shore just to play with them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are well known to be spotted in rivers or small ponds. This has led to them being used commonly as fishing bait.
author: kitarchen

entry: This Pokémon generates static electricity through its movement as it likes to roll along the bottom of lakes, rivers, and oceans alike. Due to this, POKENAME is often considered a menace to kelp farmers and fishermen.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME no longer has to roll to collect static electricity, instead generating electricity through the movement of water currents over its body. Despite this, they enjoy rolling on sea floors and creating bubbles with a static shock.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME fashions a trident made of bone to accentuate its already potent hunting capabilities. Swimming at high speeds through water, it spears large fish and even the occasional low-flying avian for its meals.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body regularly puts out a copious amount of bubbles from its many pores. Though harmless and even aesthetically pleasing to some, the bubbles release a pungent scent when popped.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a unique adaptation where they can swim underwater to avoid detection from Flying-type predators. Water-type predators also struggle to eat POKENAME because of their sturdy cocoon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon's delicate wings are actually webbed fins that allow it to propel itself through the water. However, it struggles to fly outside of the water because of the weight of these fins.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is found at the beach and often gets mistaken for a mermaid. It is attracted to the soothing melody of the waves.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME can swim at high speeds by twirling its three tails behind it akin to a propeller. It gets extremely aggressive if the jewel on its forehead is touched.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their way into lakes and rivers to eat seaweed beneath the water's surface. They are capable of swimming for short periods of time, which is just enough to drag a piece of seaweed back to shore.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its exceptional swimming ability and tireless patience have made it a reliable assistant to lifeguards rescuing swimmers in distress. When it is about to unleash one of its powerful Water-type attacks, its shell begins to emit a cold, chilling mist.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME developed a body that allows it to swim swiftly through the water, but lacks the gills needed to remain underwater. It can only remain underwater for 30 minutes before requiring air.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a flowing, foam-like mane that ripples even without wind and blends seamlessly with the waves around it. Its sleek, scale-covered body glimmers under moonlight, making it nearly invisible in water as it stalks its prey.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's normally smooth fur bristles out and stiffens when it becomes tense. It soaks aggressors with a stream of spat-out water, before jolting them with electricity shot out from its fur.
author: sk372

entry: The flame sac within its body allows it to super-heat any water it produces and expels. In battle, it can fire boiling hot water or bursts of scalding steam to leave foes badly burnt.
author: sk372

entry: After consuming vast quantities of data, POKENAME produces exceptionally pure water. Some beverage factories rely on it to enhance flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically hang from tree branches but have a cunning alternative if they fall from the branches. They roll around until they find a body of water and sink to the bottom, giving them a good hiding place until they evolve.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Since POKENAME turns invisible when in water, it can only be spotted on clear, sunny days where clouds have fully dissipated. If it sits in a single spot for too long, the large amounts of rain it can summon cause torrential flooding.
author: soup1900

entry: Its gills let it stay underwater indefinitely, and its body is smooth and streamlined for quick swimming. It could swim from one end of the ocean to the other in less than a day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce bubbles that float and act as a deterrent for anyone who wanders into their territory. The bubbles are made of a caustic venom that clings to fur and feathers when popped.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Preferring to remain in solitude, POKENAME surrounds itself with large bubbles. These bubbles are brimming with psychic energy, and reflect all manner of attacks, be they physical or projectile.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME can hide in water by seemingly "melting away," they are too curious to not try and approach others. They will happily approach children and create bubbles to play with them, however.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME create miniature fountains along their backs by expelling the water they absorb while swimming. They have the ability to raise the temperature of the water to the point of being boiling hot.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME produce a caustic venom from their saw-like limbs that eats away at living matter. If their saws get gummed up, they spray water to lubricate the saws so they can keep cutting down foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is common to see wild POKENAME splashing about in puddles after fresh rain. These bird Pokémon dry out if they fly too high, so they typically fly only high enough to pass over trees.
author: infinex21

entry: Remarkable agility and coordination makes POKENAME an expert swimmer. They can be observed resting on their backs, floating atop the water's surface.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME are highly efficient aquatic predators. Their webbing completely vanishes under the water, and these webs are so sensitive they can detect even single water drops. They are used to trap prey.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It builds its nest closest to a source of fresh water and preys on the aquatic Pokémon denizen of that source. It can swim using its wings and tail, so no prey is ever too deep for it to reach.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's antennae can sometimes trigger evolution. It helps wild Water-types who can't seem to find their own Water Stones.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are often found hopping around marshlands, pecking at the ground for nuts or seeds. They socialize with others by splashing in puddles of water and cleaning mud off their talons together.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Unlike most wools, POKENAME wool is not absorbent. Their wool makes them rather buoyant in water. A happy POKENAME will release light from its tail crystal by channeling its electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: By channeling its static charge, POKENAME can expand its neck frill, which lets it float in water with its head above the surface. It can swim quite well, mind you, and will use its electricity to hunt aquatic Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their electricity to emit light from their crystals so they can navigate deep waters and dark caves. They are common partners for Swimmers and ocean explorers alike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's Rain Dance is noted to be highly effective, quickly summoning torrents of clean water to revitalize the plant life around it. Many owners use it to help maintain personal gardens.
author: sk372

entry: There is ongoing debate if POKENAME are bird or fish Pokémon. This debate was born from the fact that POKENAME nest and rest within lakes, yet will fly high in the sky throughout the day. Their feathers and scales glisten beautifully when wet.
author: infinex21

entry: There is a small pouch on POKENAME's stomach that it uses to carry its young. Known for its gentle nature, it forms close bonds with humans. When not caring for offspring, it gladly helps by delivering Harbor Mail tucked safely in its pouch.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME utilize vibrations on the surface of water to predict the future, however they are said to only be able to predict terrible weather changes. They will often dive deep into the water and vanish to hide from the storms they predict.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME are completely invisible under the surface of the water. They frequently use the currents around them to predict future prey, possible predators, and weather patterns if trained properly around fellow psychic types.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Living in the deepest parts of lakes, POKENAME uses its esca to lure in smaller fish. It easily camouflages the rest of its body in the dark waters.
author: crypticanexe

entry: POKENAME are an underwater treasure hunter's best friend, for these Pokémon will dive to the deepest depths in search of anything that sparkles. Despite their small size, they can swim fast even with adult humans holding onto their tails.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have very sharp teeth and mermaid-like fins. They tend to be in large family groups; however, this is very helpful as they can create rain by controlling water from water vapor and fog.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back serves two purposes: it helps it blend in when near the surface, and it provides nutrients through photosynthesis.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, swimming through rivers in search of food. By spinning their tails like a propeller, they can move through the water at high speeds.
author: santon5512

entry: Their small size and large fins make POKENAME excellent swimmers, allowing them to keep up with fishing boats out at sea. POKENAME use bubbles in the shape of letters and symbols to communicate with fishers, asking them for food.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME has long been the partner of mystics and astrologers. On nights with full moons, schools of POKENAME gather in calm bodies of water and watch the starry skies above.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME will dig into loose silt underwater to hide and wait for prey. Because of its cell structure its body becomes translucent when wet.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME dig in search for groundwater to bring back to their nests. In deserts, this activity ends up forming oases for new life to thrive in.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon at saunas, basking in the centre of the room and giving burbling, delighted cries when water is poured over them. Their bodies maintain a high, steady temperature, quickly vaporising any water they make contact with.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a large body but unfortunately small legs. When it perches, its front legs dangle off the edge.
author: hatsune_miko

entry: POKENAME trudges around swamps, not caring how dirty its shaggy coat gets. A voracious eater, POKENAME uses its tusks to dig for food in the mud.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME live on the outskirts of coral reefs, especially in the southern seas. Their bodies tend to vanish under the water, but they can be found easily by searching for large towers of bubbles they produce when happy.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: When POKENAME swim in the water, their bodies become translucent and the seashells and berries they collect in their tail become visible.
author: pankiwi

entry: Sailors often consider a sighting of POKENAME to be an omen of doom. They hunt by boiling ocean water around their prey, and the oil given off their fur is highly combustible. This has caused an increase in shipboard fires in waters they frequent.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its tail is an active Water Stone and can evolve Pokémon without warning. Shellder and Poliwhirl are careful to avoid POKENAME because of this.
author: hatsune_miko

entry: Many aquariums are beginning to staff POKENAME as assistants. It seems to intrinsically know all the habits and needs of a majority of aquatic creatures, making it very helpful in ensuring proper care-taking is observed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are intrigued by human activities. They explore the world around them by nibbling things, often too softly to cause harm to others.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME are dangerous Pokémon that live within lakes and ponds. They can effectively melt away and become invisible in water, thus allowing them to catch any prey or foe off guard if they draw too near to the water's edge.
author: infinex21

entry: This large aquatic Pokémon thrives in stormy seas. When it's angered, it conjures immense waves, so it is feared by sailors.
author: hophoppip

entry: It took years to document this Pokémon due to its ability to turn invisible within water. It revealed itself when waste was thrown into its lake, to which it lashed out at those responsible and proceeded to purify the water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives near waterfalls and enjoys playing in the spray. To attract the opposite gender, they try to blow the biggest bubbles possible.
author: spagalapof

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the mud near riverbeds while sleeping. It releases an aura that causes surrounding plants to grow at an accelerated rate.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is made of water vapour and seagrass. Despite this, it cannot live underwater and migrates to shallow lakes to hunt. It grows flower buds and stones within its body.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: It can freeze or melt surrounding water at will. It's not a great swimmer, so it prefers freezing water under its paws to walk on it instead.
author: milchik

entry: It can turn absorbed sunlight into powerful energy blades that form around the fins upon its arms and head. It stores water in its large tail, which makes its tail heavier and harder-hitting.
author: infinex21

entry: The quills on POKENAME's back are made of water from its body. Kids unknowingly put their hands through the quills without harm.
author: hatsune_miko

entry: POKENAME mixes fire and water in equal measures in battle. It strikes with geysers of water shot from its fists as well as powerful, flaming kicks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's frill is highly sensitive, with it reacting negatively to even an accidental touch. Its long and thick tail can swing with enough force to send an adult human flying back over 30 feet.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient writings depict POKENAME as guardians of sailing ships. It raises enormous storms to swallow any enemies who threaten the sailors under its protection.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: In addition of changing colours to blend in with its surroundings, POKENAME can also render itself completely invisible underwater.  Even the zigzag pattern is concealed, where the fusion differs between other Kecleon fusions and the Pokémon itself.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Disguised as an ordinary fountain, whoever drinks from POKENAME is possessed. Bird Pokémon are their most frequent victims, using them to amass a large flock under POKENAME's collective control.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Its impressive fins have been honed by the crushing depths of the ocean, which allow it to "cut" through water while swimming. It has a horrifying ability to turn nigh invisible in water so long as it moves slowly, so it can ambush nearly any target.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its body's bright coloration, POKENAME is extremely difficult to find in the wild due to its ability to become virtually invisible in water. It is both a photoautotroph and an omnivore, so it can get its energy even when the sun isn't out.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives in marshes, rearing their young in shallow waters. Despite their bulky bodies, POKENAME are adept swimmers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME swims through lakes and rivers, planting seeds in the lakebed to grow new algae. Slapping its tail, it enjoys splashing water at its friends along the shore.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Water flows directly across POKENAME's body, of which it can freely manipulate the length and shape. It enjoys toying with and confounding its opponents with various tricky movements before it strikes a decisive blow.
author: sk372

entry: When pointed at a foe, it shoots a jolt of chilling water. While its opponent is still shocked from the cold, it takes the opportunity to strike.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME's keen vision allows it to see prey in the ocean's darkest depths. Once its eyes gleam gold, there little to no escape.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, rapidly moving in circles to create large whirlpools. These vortices pull smaller Pokémon inside, making them easy prey.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are incredibly rare, living at the bottom of lakes or at pristine shores. They only appear to calm the minds of those who are enraged, using their voice to disarm all who are hostile.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME is not just fast in the air; once it enters the water, it can dart forward like a missile thanks to its tail and the fins on its face. When battling, it rises into the sky before firing its water jets from above.
author: fiordaliso

entry: At home in the rainforests of Hoenn, POKENAME uses the reflections off the water of its body to appear as Wimpod. When Flying- or Psychic-types attempt to attack, it shoots boiling water before morphing into its true form.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When POKENAME have hooked their prey, they are filled with a soothing aura that makes it stop struggling against them.
author: melodydelune

entry: It has the power to erode land and direct the tides to carry the sediments elsewhere. When the sun hits the water it calls home, POKENAME begins to glow and its body temperature rises to become red-hot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: According to at least one myth, a POKENAME lives deep in a sealed underwater cavern and can only be awoken by an ancient artifact. When it awakens, it causes mudslides that destroy nearby civilizations.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Only those with righteous hearts are said to be able to draw POKENAME out from its deep undersea home. Its arm can shoot a massive amount of bubbles at high speeds, each one charged with intense amounts of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Its large, fin-like ears and tail give it an almost kite-like silhouette while swimming. Its beauty makes it quite a popular fusion.
author: faelocke

entry: POKENAME is found in deserts. It is mischievous and likes to play tricks on weary, thirsty travelers by pretending to be a water bottle.
author: acid_pen

entry: When a POKENAME's seed sprouts, it will open and share its water with all, making it a friend to flora and fauna alike.
author: ladan

entry: POKENAME's body is completely waterproof, allowing them to stay in water for a virtually infinite amount of time. They are the perfect partners for swimmers and beachgoers.
author: mistymagius

entry: It builds its nests near rivers and lakes. It can dive up to 40 feet in pursuit of Water-type Pokémon.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME cover their face with their hydrophobic fur while swimming to keep water out of their eyes. They use their sensitive fins to see instead, sensing small changes in the current to navigate.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME can unfurl its tail wide in order to intimidate and ward off potential threats. Those that don't heed the warning will have to contend with its formidable control over fire and water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME glides over rivers in the dead of night, flapping its wings frantically in search of small prey. When threatened, it hides among the river currents, where it swims with agility and blends perfectly with its surroundings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME carries with it a large gem similar to a Water Stone. It is said that looking at the stone for too long will cause a person to feel as if they are drowning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is quite fond of Water Stones, immediately latching onto any it finds and refusing to let go for hours. It seems to draw minute bits of energy from the stone, as it behaves more energetically for a time after releasing it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is filled with purified water that it protects with its spiked tail. It will save this water until it's ready to evolve.
author: ladan

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, using their ability to turn into water to slip through small crevices. They are often found in deep underwater caverns, searching for Water Stones to consume.
author: santon5512

entry: The spines on its back make it quite a poor mount. However, tamed POKENAME insist that people ride them to ferry across the waves. If you can handle its spines, it's a very serene experience.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Known for its ethereal beauty, it dances gracefully over frozen lakes inviting people to join it. Those who follow it are lured to thin ice, where POKENAME silently watches as they fall through and sink into the icy depths.
author: amiel997

entry: Its graceful dancing mimics the motion of waves. Large groups of POKENAME dancing together are able to control the tides.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME use their mighty tentacles to burrow into the sea floor. Once rooted, they begin possessing passing water Pokémon, often leading them straight into the POKENAME's waiting maw.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: POKENAME is a nimble flier and an equally nimble swimmer. It catches fish Pokémon by swooping down into lakes and diving towards the prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: These Pokémon often dwell in caves near lakes and ponds, especially if those caves are damp. They can breathe underwater, allowing them to lie in wait for prey for however long it takes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME secretes a soap-like substance to create bubbly wings. Not only are POKENAME's wings incredibly soft, but they also make the best bubble baths.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time underwater, cooling the temperature of the liquid with its mere presence. In times of danger, it can flash freeze the entire body of water. Even when water is frozen, it can move freely through the ice.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME store spores in the bulbous mushrooms on their back. When they are released and make contact with the air, the spores turn into a viscous gel that makes them very slippery. This makes POKENAME much harder for predators to grab onto.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has been known for inspiring new age music and loves to perform with bubbles to create dramatic displays. The ability to blend in entirely with water allows them to appear and disappear.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME are experts at evoking feelings of sorrow through their laments. Their dreary melodies can bring even the most cold-hearted person to tears.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When moving through the water, POKENAME's body grows transparent and camouflages itself within the depths. Campers who happen to sleep near its lake home are visited by pleasant dreams of swimming alongside it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly release spores in ponds and lakes that they reside in. These spores get stuck in the gills of many Water-type Pokémon, so scientists are trying to find a new habitat for POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim in lakes and rivers spreading their spores wherever they go. These spores cling to the gills of aquatic Pokémon, so scientists are searching for a new home where they can safely release spores without harming local Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It controls water skillfully, yet its new psychic power allows POKENAME to shape water into more complex forms to aid it in combat or personal needs. It was able to restore the Water Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME produces a sweet dye that bakers mix into dessert pastries. It loves to help pastry chefs with the baking process, so some bakeries also have it knead dough.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in the deepest depths of lakes and ponds in packs, pranking trainers who think they could catch them by spraying them with bubbles and streams coming from their posterior. The leader POKENAME is chosen from the one who pranks the most.
author: beatdoof

entry: The more water POKENAME absorbs, the longer it can turn its body translucent and amorphous, making it nearly impossible to hit while it retaliates with fast, explosive bubbles that create temporary downpours. Even Ace Trainers struggle to capture it.
author: beatdoof

entry: The more water POKENAME absorbs, the longer it can turn its body translucent and amorphous, making it nearly impossible to hit and retaliate with fast, explosive bubbles that create temporary downpours. Even Ace Trainers struggle to capture it.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is a superb swimmer that propels itself through even stormy seas with its powerful tail. Within its territory, it drives out rivals using both Fire and Water-type attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's skills in water manipulation and tilling are a great combo for farming. Many use it to grow crops effortlessly.
author: jackjirachi

entry: A bane to all clean floors and nice furniture, POKENAME is an energetic amphibious Pokémon. Often playing hide-and-seek in shallow water, it can easily be spotted when a puddle has a wagging tail.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME is the preferred companion for any young fishermen looking for a loyal hunting companion. This fusion has come to be known as "the epitome of wet dog smell".
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME have been known to frequent beaches traveled to by tourists in order to collect all the shiny trinkets they leave behind. It is said their favorites are pearls and they treasure them forever.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME is a popular Pokémon amongst fans of Water-type Pokémon. Only its face is visible when its body is submerged in water.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME are excellent divers that are known to vanish underwater while searching for pearls. They are proud of these skills and will often show off all treasures they find to trustworthy Trainers.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME experience great distress whenever they are dehydrated, as the first place to lose moisture is their brain. Trainers need to keep them well-hydrated to prevent them from developing a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are prone to painful headaches, bathing themselves in water to try to soothe themselves. If there is no pond nearby when they're struck with a headache, they spray out a stream of water, sticking their head in it as quickly as they can.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are superb swimmers that can effortlessly glide through the water. They live most of their lives underwater where they play chase with each other and eat seaweed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers the dark depths of the ocean, using Acid Armor to camouflage its body with the surrounding water. Should it accidentally strike an obstacle, its rock-hard face keeps it unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: With waterproof fur and a robust body, POKENAME is a powerful and speedy swimmer, and supremely loyal and friendly. It is rapidly becoming the de facto assistant to lifeguards at beaches for its capabilities.
author: sk372

entry: It makes nest in rocky cliffs by the shore. It is both an expert swimmer and flier. It viciously competes for prey with Gyarados.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can redirect the current or route of a river. Calm and playful by nature, POKENAME confuses opponents by slipping through their attacks before striking with punches that launch compressed water.
author: ambrosia04

entry: With the power of its mind, POKENAME can turn the molecules that form its body into water. In its liquid form, POKENAME can absorb information like a sponge by simply flowing through porous objects.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME is always up for a challenge and eagerly seeks out worthy opponents in combat. Its way of challenging others is to shoot a burst of scalding-hot water at their feet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eat Water-type Pokémon by trapping and digesting their prey within their large stomachs. These nutrients are converted into blubber, which helps keep them warm during the winter months.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's burning mane burns hot enough to boil all water that tries to douse it. While running, this effect makes them appear to be sprinting across water, even though they mostly run across the shallow waves on beaches and explore tidepools.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Often thought to be the inspiration of many myths and fables, POKENAME contains searing hot flames within its body. This allows them to leave beaches and dive into deep oceans where they swim with intense speed at upwards of 150 miles per hour.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME's intense magnetism causes its body to evaporate into the clouds like vapor. When it condenses back into its normal form, thunderbolts crack the sky around it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME carry a leek baton that they enjoy twirling around. In the wild, they can often be found swimming and spinning their leeks in a synchronized dance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They live at the bottom of polluted rivers. They absorb toxins until the river is clean, and then disappear to parts unknown.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Residue left behind on plants from POKENAME are known to cause mucus to cling to the throat. POKENAME feel remorseful for leaving behind their poisonous residue but are unable to stop it from sticking to their surroundings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME conjure up dreams of ocean waves for those they hypnotize. Pokémon who are scared of swimming awaken in a terrified panic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is incapable of actually hypnotizing anything. Instead, it finds people who are extremely dehydrated and taunts them with small pouches of water. It only gives these pouches away after a favor is done for them.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's bristle-like hairs gather static electricity, which it uses for sustenance and defense. Despite its small legs, it can move up to 30 miles per hour due to its high energy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's bristle-like hairs gather static electricity which it uses for sustenance and as a defense mechanism. Despite its small legs it can move up to 30mph thanks to its high energy.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its ears move and twitch slightly as it picks up on ambient changes in electricity nearby. On occasion, an arc of electricity passes between them.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that Arceus gifted POKENAME the power of perfect roundness. No Pokémon fusion can be possibly rounder than it.
author: bucklin

entry: Its fur regularly generates small amounts of static electricity, which POKENAME uses to electrify the bone in its hand. During storms, its cries can be heard amongst the sound of rain and thunder.
author: sautomagically

entry: Every so often, POKENAME holds its hand up to the sky and summons a bolt of lightning into its grasp. Using the natural static on its body, POKENAME can maintain this electricity in its hand for up to a month.
author: sautomagically

entry: Flying-type Pokémon that try to peck through a POKENAME cocoon are hit with a violent shock that paralyzes wing muscles. These painful shocks are the reason why many POKENAME are ignored by hungry Flying-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Bursting with thunderous energy, POKENAME carry with them an extremely large Thunder Stone via magnetic force. Simply getting near this Pokémon's thunderclouds can cause severe paralysis.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon that lives in deep waters, where it makes hidden dens among the algae. When it feels threatened, it raises its yellow scales and frantically beats the fins on its back, creating sparks to deter marine predators.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are prized for their playful nature, but they don't make good pets because they discharge electricity when they become excited.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can alter the local weather by tracing thunderbolts in the air. Once it has raised the atmospheric electricity enough, a wild thunderstorm will rage across the battlefield.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME battles, it coats its sharp scythes with electric jolts to paralyze its opponents. The bristly fur around its neck constantly accumulates static energy, making its movements faster.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is drawn to rock concerts. It loves to sit as close as possible to the speakers.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME build up electricity in their bodies as they charge. Touching the stone on their heads will send them into a blind fit of rage, causing them to release all their energy in one large surge.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME love to drink energy drinks and eat snacks left behind by people. The venom that drips from their stinger can be made into a special tea that gives acute clarity to those who drink it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has developed some of Jolteon's electrical output early. Though its voltage is potent, it lacks the full strength and runs out of energy after a few discharges.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can fire off the spiked-up hairs on its body outward in short-range bursts. These hairs shock those hit by them, though due to its still-developing form, the charges within the hairs are rather weak.
author: sk372

entry: The fur of a POKENAME stands rigid like metallic spines, each hair charged with static electricity. Its muscular legs allow it to dig into surfaces for a powerful grip during its lightning-fast sprints.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME tries to help out humans by entering their computers and providing them a performance boost with its electrical energy. This comes at the cost of making them use up much more energy, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a limited amount of electricity in their bodies that they harness to shock predators. Once they are tapped out, they become easy targets for other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are incredibly dangerous when angered, releasing powerful discharges that scorch the surrounding land. When they fly, each flap of their wings disperses a multitude of blue sparks into the air.
author: mepp.

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME raises its massive stingers toward the sky in order to absorb the energy of lightning. It communicates with others of its kind by making the white collar around its neck glow in steady pulses.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its fur is rigid enough that moving through the air causes enough friction to generate a static charge. Though they love to playfully zap others, they are remorseful if they cause harm, even in battle.
author: infinex21

entry: Static constantly pulses around the petals on POKENAME's neck. Should it fall ill, the petals will brown, and the static will slow considerably.
author: .izik

entry: Many of its feathers are rather rigid and sharp, seemingly due to the static electricity coursing through them. It is a common sight just before, during, and immediately after thunderstorms.
author: infinex21

entry: The friction of their feathers with every flap of their wings causes them to almost always carry a static charge. Their shed feathers retain their electricity, making them hazardous but also useful in the right hands.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's habit of bouncing around causes it to build a substantial amount of static electricity in its fur. As a result, POKENAME unintentionally shocks those who touch it.
author: drcew

entry: The wool of these Pokémon is so thick that every move they make generates static electricity. Their tail orbs glow when they build up a strong charge. POKENAME wool is naturally warm, so it is a popular material for winter clothing.
author: infinex21

entry: There are some tales claiming that when a POKENAME releases all of its stored electricity, a thunderstorm will form. They can turn their feathers rigid with electricity and fling them at their opponents. Their feathers, even shed, retain electricity.
author: infinex21
