entry: By channeling the electricity stored within its purple crystal, it can make its wool stand on end like needles that it can tear off and chuck at foes. POKENAME crystals are prized as electrical conductors. Some people use them as batteries, too.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can store and release so much electricity that their crystals emit bright light. Up close, these light flashes can be blinding. These Pokémon have been utilized in power plants and in lighthouses recently.
author: infinex21

entry: Their cells generate weak electricity that courses through their manes of spiky fur. A group of POKENAME crying in unison can imitate a crack of thunder to scare off potential threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a hyperactive creature that often infests attics or abandoned labs with its colony. Before battle, it stiffens the quills covering its body and grinds its sharp teeth to intimidate and discourage its foe.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A very playful Pokémon, POKENAME is often found amongst Pikachu competing to see who can shoot lightning the furthest. If two POKENAME rub gills with each other, the fur across their entire body stands on end.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: While its quills are charged with millions of volts of electricity, POKENAME is completely harmless to touch. It can be seen sleeping near clear rivers while a light crackling sound can be heard from its fur.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME generates sparks whenever it spins, so it's best to handle it with care. Its small size makes it convenient for people to carry around whenever they need electricity.
author: darxer_

entry: Known for its frenetic energy, POKENAME often overruns dusty attics or abandoned research sites. It prepares for battle by raising its quills and clacking its fangs together to intimidate any would-be challenger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME stores its internal electricity in its crystalline bud that resembles a thunder stone. They roam around on stormy days, waiting for lightning to be drawn to their bud.
author: mistymagius

entry: Once POKENAME is charged with electricity, its pincers force open and its wings beat frenziedly. It attacks by tasing foes with its charged pincers, which after discharging can clamp shut and crush the opponent.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tail bundle is always charged with static electricity. Getting near it will give you a light shock.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME uses its uniquely shaped tail to lure unsuspecting prey and even occasionally humans. Once grabbed, it bites, releasing a venom that swiftly numbs the senses.
author: mepp.

entry: A single jolt of electricity from POKENAME's body is enough to make a computer run three times its normal speed. This boost fades several hours later.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME are incredibly docile forest dwellers that were once hunted for their antlers. Their antlers are extremely conductive of electricity, which made them a well sought material until they were nearly driven to extinction.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME repel foes with rapid physical blows by spinning upon their own heads. By spinning like this, they also generate a lot of static electricity that makes their hair stand sharply on end.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is fascinated by electrical sockets. When a blackout is accompanied by faint giggling, POKENAME is the culprit.
author: rosemagwin

entry: By rattling its spiky tail, it can generate great quantities of electricity that will then course through its entire body. It can make the pattern on its chest glow to distract its foe before quickly constricting it and shocking it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's fur has sharpened barbed ends tinged with overflowing power. Even its cells are filled with electrical energy, making study dangerous, and a crack of thunder can be heard when its tail whips around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME showers the area around it with hundreds of tiny electric needles launched from its spiky fur. These little points will shock anybody who dares trespass on the mountain area it claims as home.
author: sk372

entry: Its needle-like feathers flash seven colors before releasing divine thunder. Popular legend tells of a mad scientist who once used POKENAME's lightning to animate their creations.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Their quick movements give way to a potent static charge that builds up within their jagged furs, which they can channel through their claws. POKENAME hunt in groups and will arc electricity between each other's claws as they chase down their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: With the fusion of two powerful Electric-types, POKENAME can unleash electric bursts exceeding over 500,000 volts. This immense energy is capable of powering an entire Pokémon Center during emergencies, making it a vital asset in times of need.
author: xyloldi

entry: POKENAME loves to lounge outdoors, sleeping in the sunshine and photosynthesizing as they rest. They are popular in rural areas where, after a blackout, they can provide temporary power with their stored energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME loves to lounge outdoors, sleeping in the sunshine and photosynthesizing as they rest. They are popular in rural areas where, after a blackout, they can provide temporary power with their stored energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is extremely aggressive. Scientists have concluded that having electric, ice, and ground moves allows it to take on nearly any foe.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME's opposite types cause it some frustration: Its electric attacks are often nullified by the mud it has sprayed.
author: .realthree

entry: It is said that when an Electric-type releases its final spark, POKENAME appears to claim the lingering energy. If ever torn from its conduit, it releases a deafening bolt said to incinerate the sky.
author: eiskitsune

entry: It is said that POKENAME's ghastly face can sometimes be seen swirling within violent storms. Those who spot it are believed to be cursed with endless misfortune until the next rainfall.
author: eiskitsune

entry: It is not uncommon for POKENAME to be struck by lightning out of the blue, even on sunny days. This causes its powers to be supercharged. Simply touching it for too long may cause paralysis.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is a dangerous Pokémon to touch due to the poisonous barbs giving off sparks of electricity. It can emit a cry that can interfere with electrical machinery.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When using Pin Missile, POKENAME releases exactly 1,000 charged spikes. Concentrated volleys are capable of boring tunnels through solid mountains.
author: .izik

entry: The stones on POKENAME's back are hypermagnetic, allowing energy to surge throughout it. Small electric types often gather around it.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME slide around on ice, even if just for their amusement, almost all the time. The friction of them sliding builds a static charge in their bristly fur. If they crash or fall into water, they inadvertently discharge their stored electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME releases a jolt of electricity on impact when thrown. Its wielder can also call down lightning bolts while holding POKENAME to the sky.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME releases a jolt of electricity on impact when thrown. Its wielder can also call down lightning bolts while holding POKENAME to the sky.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME channels its electrical energy through its incredibly hard stone horns, unleashing devastating electromagnetic blasts. Thanks to the resilience of its armored shell, it fears no opponent and faces every battle with unwavering courage.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have massive manes of bristly fur that stand on end during storms and during battle, crackling with static electricity. They wield the ability to create illusions to create false storms that often intimidate would-be enemies.
author: infinex21

entry: Its needle-like feelers are used to pierce their prey and release up to 10,000 volts of electricity.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME generates shadowy electric fields at night, waiting for unwitting travelers to pass through. The fields cause the victim to fall into a nightmare-filled slumber while POKENAME drains bio-electricity from them.
author: sk372

entry: When a Thunder Stone is loaded into the shell on POKENAME's back, POKENAME's movements become lightning-quick. Otherwise, this fusion is content to slowly graze on nectar and fruit.
author: .realthree

entry: Fire and lightning churn together within POKENAME's body, giving it powerful offensive capabilities. Any point struck by the lightning bolts it generates instantly ignites with white-hot flames.
author: sk372

entry: The icy needles that have formed from POKENAME's shoulders conduct electricity in and out of its body. Touching one of the purple spires can result in a shock of over 200,000 volts.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME rubs its furry wings to form a taser with its arms. It uses its high speed to swiftly paralyze the target, ensuring a slow, painful defeat.
author: p0opys0ck123abc

entry: The plasma around a POKENAME's body is highly conductive, acting as both a tool to extend the range of the POKENAME's electricity and a method to help keep it energized. Shaking hands with a POKENAME feels like multiple joy buzzers going off at once.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: This rambunctious yet kind Pokémon loves to cause mischief. Its tongue droops out of its mouth as it uses its snout to complete tasks for its owner.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its coffin-like body and uses it to electrocute graverobbers. It is often found in old power plants, feeding on electrical currents.
author: hereisanimations

entry: Even though POKENAME remains slow, the cables extending from its body make it a lot easier to catch and shock anyone who gets too close.
author: ladan

entry: The stone used to evolve the Eevee half of POKENAME combined with their DNA, intensifying the energy of the blades tenfold. If you look into a cave and see a face lit up by two glowing blades, it is best to back away from the area.
author: rycronicgames

entry: It flies at such a high speed that it regularly breaks the sound barrier. During thunderstorms, POKENAME will draw in lightning bolts to allow it to fly even faster.
author: mistymagius

entry: To prevent anyone from touching its tails, POKENAME coats them with crackling electric discharges as a warning. When it battles, it uses all its strength, skillfully combining Fire- and Electric-type moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME touches its tail to downed power lines to recharge. Sparks dance across its fur as it absorbs the electricity.
author: .izik

entry: To prevent anyone from touching its tails, POKENAME coats them with crackling electric discharges as a warning. When it battles, it uses all its strength, skillfully combining Fire- and Electric-type moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are known to be terrible singers. If one realizes that it's being ignored, they are known to shoot out electricity in anger.
author: kitarchen

entry: Whenever POKENAME discharges electricity, the voltage remains coursing across its metallic skin for some time afterward. Trainers must be careful not to touch it until at least five minutes have passed since a discharge.
author: sk372

entry: It generates constant steady electricity through the turning of its two gears. Ongoing research suggests that POKENAME may be able to recharge depleted Thunder Stones.
author: sk372

entry: The color of the electric sparks on its tail reflects its mood. POKENAME blows small flames onto the ground to create a bed of hot embers where it can spend the night and stay warm.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If POKENAME senses negative feelings, it rushes over to consume them from an uncomfortably close proximity. Luckily for most people, POKENAME prefers to inhabit undeveloped fields and marshes.
author: .realthree

entry: The high contrast of POKENAME's markings warns predators of its dangerous powers. If anything scoops POKENAME out of the sand it is resting in, it delivers a mighty shock to the attacker.
author: .realthree

entry: Though POKENAME is full of energy and motivation, it struggles to follow its aims. It fruitlessly tries to hurl itself toward foes, sparks flying.
author: ladan

entry: The energy of POKENAME's tusks can break boulders with a density of up to 2,000 kilograms. The stone held by POKENAME serves as a reminder of its growth and training.
author: rycronicgames

entry: POKENAME's spiky fur crackles with static, releasing an odor reminiscent of lemon zest. The scent intensifies before it discharges powerful electrical attacks.
author: .izik

entry: The large emerald it wields acts as an excellent conductor, enhancing its electric abilities. POKENAME enjoys playing tricks on humans who get lost in its caves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The gems that form its eyes are composed of a rare form of desert glass. POKENAME electrocutes sand to create glass, which it then consumes.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME stalk Trainers that wander into their territory with mild curiosity. When they are inevitably caught, they escape on a bolt of lightning and hide until the Trainer loses interest to start the process over again.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appears in several ancient myths as a herald of storms. It flies so swiftly and silently that it cannot be detected by radar.
author: dylonk25

entry: These Pokémon are often to blame for sudden thunderstorms. They take delight in playing among the clouds and dodging bolts of lightning.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME runs about constantly. It is really gathering the static electricity out of its surroundings to store for attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a beach-dwelling prankster, pretending to be a sandcastle until something ventures too close, whereupon it shoots out little bits of pointed fur charged with electricity. It dives beneath the sand laughing as its victim gets shocked.
author: sk372

entry: Around its neck are crystals reminiscent of Thunder Stones that are almost always sparking and crackling with electricity. It can move at blinding speeds and loose electrical attacks in tandem with attacks using its rock-solid claws.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has fully embraced the hardcore music genre and now uses their song to produce fast-paced music. When they slow down, they can only produce the sound of static electricity.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME are best suited for dancing alongside galliards, as their light and energetic movement inspires many to join in. Their swift and athletic footwork amazes many audiences.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME store electricity in the many mushroom bulbs on their back. During thunderstorms, many POKENAME are struck by lightning and become charged with electricity, enough to light several homes for a week.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Thunder Stones grow on its stone body, generating the electricity it uses for self-defense. Once a year it sheds the stones to grow new ones, making the once-rare evolutionary stones far more common.
author: sk372

entry: By accident, POKENAME discovered how to turn heat into electricity through friction. It drags its stick along the dirt to build up a strong, static charge that it can wield against foes. The friction from said dragging can leave behind scorch marks.
author: merclipse

entry: Although a zap from POKENAME will hurt, it's actually more defensive with its power, forming barriers of electricity to protect rather than attack. It was able to restore the Thunder Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME's great speed and lightning quick reflexes allow it to easily escape predators. It can also disperse a toxic powder from its wings to temporarily paralyze enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME produces a sweet yet tart cream that is used in baked goods. Bakers make sure the cream is the right level of tartness by ensuring POKENAME is happy and comfortable.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live near rural powerlines, forming small gangs to socialize and share jolts of electricity through their tails. The POKENAME with the puffiest, spikiest tail is the gang's leader.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's white fur comes from it being a conduit of excess electrical energy and negative ions, able to create 20,000-volt thunderstorms. Storm chasers are known to use POKENAME as their symbol and guide, hunting storms together for the thrill.
author: beatdoof

entry: If a predator approaches its burrow, POKENAME releases bursts of electricity. These shocks can cause paralysis lasting several hours.
author: .izik

entry: It can produce electrical charges. It usually remains motionless, but when it needs to escape, it can manipulate static to move its silk-covered body quickly.
author: hophoppip

entry: During lightning storms, POKENAME perches on bamboo to absorb the electrical energy in the air. During this time, its body releases an intense eggplant scent.
author: .izik

entry: Objects often cling to POKENAME's fur due to the static electricity emanating from it. Its fur crackles when POKENAME rubs up on something else.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: When POKENAME purrs, it lets off small discharges of electricity. If it lives indoors, it chews on electrical cables to replenish energy.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It ambushes its prey and paralyzes them with its electrified claws before they have any chance to react. Its fluid and silent movements make it a remarkably captivating and elegant creature, highly admired by judges at Pokémon Contests.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME produce sparks whenever their flippers touch. These sparks can be harnessed to shock their predators and protect them from being prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have long necks that act like a lightning rod during thunderstorms. When they are charged with electricity, they fly into the sky and release that energy with a powerful lightning bolt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sparks constantly coursing through its body enhance the speed of its muscles and its grappling attacks. When enraged, POKENAME stores such vast amounts of electrical energy that it emits a blinding light.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are difficult to find in the depths of the ocean because they often short-circuit electrical devices used to take photos with a powerful zap. When they are inevitably found by divers, they zip away on a bolt of lightning.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has the habit of infesting power plants together with its colony so it can feast on as much electricity as possible. If someone tries to drive it away, it becomes highly aggressive and doesn't hesitate to unleash crackling bolts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Every action it takes causes its rigid fur to generate a static charge that will build up until the electricity bursts out. While charged with electricity, it becomes increasingly agitated until it flies into a rampage.
author: infinex21

entry: Easily trainable and eager to please, POKENAME are popular among police forces when dealing with high-speed pursuits. They fire off Thunder Shocks to slow or disable fleeing vehicles and use Fire Spin attacks to keep suspects from fleeing.
author: chibitales

entry: When POKENAME loses its patience, its body generates vast amounts of electricity, causing the lightning bolt at the tip of its tail to glow intensely. It blinds foes while in flight before finishing them off with powerful electric attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME never tires: the electricity coursing through its body gives it more than enough energy to constantly and courageously swim across the ocean, even amidst powerful thunderstorms. However, it is still vulnerable to freezing temperatures.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its veins pulse with electrical energy that help enhance its muscles. When it gets fired up in battle its quills become charged and draw in lightning strikes to gain more power.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME will hang in trees, absorbing sunlight and converting it into electricity. They fire this electricity in large bursts from their mouth, instantly paralyzing their prey.
author: santon5512

entry: An organ within POKENAME's tail generates and stores electrical energy while it swims. It uses this stored energy to electrify its shell when it retreats into it, giving it added protection.
author: sk372

entry: While levitating, POKENAME attracts magnetic objects and Thunder Stones into its field. It hoards them deep within abandoned power stations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a baton with a Thunder Stone attached to it that draws in many Pokémon who want to evolve. POKENAME tap their baton onto the heads of those who want to evolve in exchange for a few berries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When they clap their paws together, they generate static electricity that clings to their sharp, bristly fur to protect them from aquatic predators. When they slap their bellies with their paws, they release bolts of electricity from their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: By sliding around on slick surfaces, such as ice, they generate static electricity within their bristly fur. By freezing their own fur, they can better store this electricity to better fight, or defend, others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME trudge through the world and leave behind a poisonous residue that create a stinging sensation in the throat whenever the residue is eaten. This debilitating sensation is often experienced by wild Pokémon that do not wash their food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the water in its shell as a hydro-electric charger for the batteries on its back. By charging them, it can release devastating attacks.
author: almanacp

entry: POKENAME live for petty acts of mischief. Lathering their tongues in static electricity from their fur, they lick things within their territory and watch for other Pokémon to touch the paralytic residue with glee.
author: thesilverowls

entry: POKENAME create dreams about thunderstorms in those they hypnotize. These dreams can get so loud that dreamers awaken in a frightening panic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are quite feisty and will tackle other Pokémon while cloaked in flames. Its soft fur burns as hot as a campfire, so these Pokémon are quite popular amongst campers.
author: mistymagius

entry: The fluff on its body is highly flammable and POKENAME can easily ignite it to scare off any predators. Its body is highly resistant to heat and is able to withstand forest fires without issue.
author: mistymagius

entry: When it cries, black smoke puffs out from the skull it wears. Rumors say its fur is the softest thing in the world, but anyone who touches it will end up with a nasty burn.
author: sautomagically

entry: During fights, the bone in its hand erupts into flames. The age of a POKENAME can be determined by the size of its fur, the strength of its fire, and the ferocity of its temper.
author: sautomagically

entry: When POKENAME kicks its legs fast enough its feet can catch fire. When their feet are on fire they are capable of causing third degree burns if they come in contact with another Pokémon for just 1 second.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It will fight any rival that enters its territory. A POKENAME that loses such a fight will leave its territory and wander for the rest of its life.
author: dicedragon20

entry: Its fists can move fast enough to catch on fire. When two fight, the first one to have their flames to go out is the loser.
author: skymaster426

entry: As POKENAME gets closer to evolving, its shell radiates more and more heat from within. The tufts of fur igniting signals the process is nearing completion.
author: sk372

entry: It propels itself through the sky by releasing flames from the holes on its body. These vents allow it to adjust its trajectory with remarkable precision.
author: .izik

entry: The joey is kept warm in the pouch, which is heated by an internal flame sac. The parent uses flame breath too cook food for the child, and cook anybody who gets too close to it.
author: sk372

entry: Its soft fur gives it a dignified look. POKENAME can often been found trying to gain access to the local opera house.
author: rosemagwin

entry: One should never attempt to touch the stone on POKENAME's head, as doing so will send it into an immediate rage. It will coat itself in raging flame before charging into anything and everything nearby until it calms down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME primarily eat raw chilis and other spicy foods that develop their fiery flames. When they are feeling particularly peckish, they roast chilis to make them more delectable than their raw counterparts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a potent flame sac within it that lets it expel flame breath and leaves it very warm to the touch. The fire it breathes may take on different colors over time depending on its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: Steam rises wherever this Pokémon swims, masking its movements and confusing predators. It's known for creating warm, misty environments perfect for nurturing aquatic plants.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's body constantly balances intense heat and cooling moisture. Steam surrounds it during battle, allowing it to vanish in a cloud before striking with scalding flames.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The flames of a POKENAME burn so hot that blacksmiths often use it to forge and temper steel. Its ability to maintain a consistent heat makes it an invaluable partner in crafting durable weapons and tools.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME keep themselves warm during winter by releasing embers from their body. Many evolve when spring comes, so surviving winter is their utmost priority.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its large size, warmth and friendly disposition make POKENAME a popular pet for those who can afford to feed its prodigious appetite. It emits enough heat from its body that many like to use it in lieu of a fireplace for warmth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shed their fur at least thrice a week as their internal flames grow stronger. They are a favorite among young Trainers due to how soft and warm they are.
author: infinex21

entry: Their crystals glow with flames inside of them, which causes their furs to always be warm. Their flames tend to be so strong that, when loosed, they will be blue.
author: infinex21

entry: Perhaps due to its hot body, it prefers to reside in cooler environments. A POKENAME will not hesitate to help another.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are hot-headed creatures that sting anyone that ventures into their territory. When stung by their stingers, their virulent venom creates a burning sensation that sears through living tissue.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are slippery tricksters with some of the softest fur known to exist. They love to play pranks on others with fire, though they never try to do harm. They commonly will appear and ignite candles, then disappear without a trace.
author: infinex21

entry: Embers shed by POKENAME's flame take on the appearance of falling leaves. Its soft mane is warm and carries an herbal, soothing scent, so cuddling up to it is encouraged.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a special venom that mimics the sensation of being burned. People who have been stung by POKENAME have reported painful blisters and a searing heat where they are stung. Antidotes and lots of water are needed to help treat these stings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is often found in the chilly northern swamps, luring unsuspecting Pokémon with its warming aura. If they get too close, they are snatched up in the POKENAME's jaws.
author: elibromax314

entry: It is thought to be the warmest and cuddliest of all Pokémon by many children.  Most can't help but give it a hug when they see it.
author: bostroms

entry: It struggles to retain its own heat, so it always exudes a hot aura that can set dry grass on fire. It has a habit of nuzzling against others and against objects, which causes it to accumulate a lot of static electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME generate heat within their fur as they hop about or leap with their wings. When they build up enough heat, they can breathe fire. They are prone to staring into fire, which some believe helps them to focus their minds.
author: infinex21

entry: The wool of these Pokémon is so thick that every move they make generates static electricity; their tail orbs glow when they build up a strong charge. POKENAME wool is naturally warm, so it is a popular material for winter clothing.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME store electricity and excess heat in their fur, both of which must be routinely released. They will tear off patches of their own fur and rub them together to ignite them and build up a static charge before chucking them at their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Its blue crystals are scorching hot and are brimming with electricity within, making them dangerous to handle. Its fur arcs with electricity during battle and can release enough heat to distort the air surrounding it.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME gather, the air around them grows scorching hot, melting snow and ice in moments. To avoid overheating, they make their homes atop glaciers, where the frigid winds help cool their fiery bodies as they rest in shimmering, steamy pools.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: If one seems steam rising from a muddy pond, it's likely a POKENAME is lounging within the water. It regularly submerges its warm body in cool water and coats itself with mud from the bottom to help regulate its internal temperature.
author: sk372

entry: A unique evolution of Eevee, its poisonous sweat mixes with flames to cause lost-lasting pain. Its red glow can be seen on dark nights.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its pale-red petals give off an intense heat that can cause burns from over 20 feet away. When angered, the tuft of fur on its back ignites like a blowtorch, scorching anything in its path.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME needs to regularly vent the fire its body constantly generates, lest it begin to overheat. Some parts of its metal carapace will even begin melting if it goes too long without letting its flames loose.
author: sk372

entry: A layer of short brown fur, moss-like in texture, covers the stone on its back. This flame-retardant fur regulates the intense heat radiating from its body.
author: .izik

entry: The bundle POKENAME carries is said to be extremely warm and comfortable. Eevee can sometimes be found hiding inside their bundles from the cold.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME are forest-dwelling Pokémon that often appear during colder weather, using their warm bodies to shelter others. When startled or threatened, they will exhale puffs of hot flames from their noses.
author: infinex21

entry: On cold winter days, POKENAME sneaks into homes to lay next to the fireplace. Finding golden hair indicates a nightly visit by a POKENAME.
author: rosemagwin

entry: Somehow, POKENAME can change shape to resemble a trio of actual flans. Even in this form, it retains the ability to produce searing temperatures.
author: hophoppip

entry: When raised with affection, POKENAME can produce a highly nutritious milk useful in many culinary preparations. Its high body temperature eliminates any bacteria present in the milk, making it a safe food for anyone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flame sac inside POKENAME that generates its fire reaches temperatures equal to that of molten magma. A mere touch of its paw could heat a frigid lake into a boiling hot spring in minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skin constantly radiates with heat. It is so hot that touching it can cause severe burns, with the only cool spots being the fur on its neck and tail, where it releases the heat.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME is able to control fire into different shapes, which it uses to entertain smaller Pokémon. Folklore says that the fire at the end of its staff can show a person their future, but only if they do a noble favor for POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME love to perform for crowds. They often create small rings of fire to flip through, though sometimes they misjudge the stunt and singe their beautiful fur coats.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's fluff collar is dangerous to touch, as it could dispel thousands of volts of electricity from the fur at any moment. As it discharges electricity, heat builds inside its body, resulting in it becoming even more aggressive.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves soaking up sunlight with its leaf-like tail and ears. It will stay under the sun until it reaches an internal temperature of at least 55ºC.
author: ambrosia04

entry: When hunting, this Pokémon presents itself in a friendly manner. Once POKENAME's prey let their guard down, it swoops in and traps them in a burning hot hug, releasing heat from its fur until the prey is completely defenseless.
author: te4mst4r.boris

entry: A curled-up POKENAME is so soft and warm that many others, human or Pokémon, love to lay against it. POKENAME spin in place to build up their heat via friction and clad themselves in fire to enhance their attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME looks extremely similar to a human lady, however its skin is scalding hot. When threatened, POKENAME can conjure rings of flames that function as wormholes, so as to escape from its attacker or send it into another dimension.
author: penguinmeowloncatmochi

entry: The gem it possesses closely resembles a Fire Stone, radiating intense heat. It melts soft metals left near it, making it dangerous to approach.
author: .izik

entry: It will eat anything that moves because it needs the caloric energy to maintain its body temperature.
author: 3erlugg

entry: The rough scales along its body vent out body heat as POKENAME fight. When in a challenging battle, these vents cover its body in flames.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: If POKENAME wants others to stay away, it can release a powerful toxic mist. If others continue to grow close, POKENAME radiates terrifyingly powerful heat from its body which can cause severe burns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While POKENAME's mane is considered to be one of the most well-kept out there, it regularly sets it on fire while trying to dry it.
author: kampfzwuggel

entry: POKENAME stores all its heat in its blade to release in battle. Its wielder can control fire through POKENAME while holding it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When POKENAME enters combat, it ignites the blade, burning off the fur coating that acts as a sheath. After the battles end, the fur grows back and covers the blade within an hour.
author: sk372

entry: The fur on POKENAME is extremely soft and warm to the touch. Shed fur from its surroundings is often collected to be used to make hats.
author: moopse

entry: This Pokémon loves to cuddle with its Trainer. It's often said that the feeling of a POKENAME on one's lap feels as toasty as an electric blanket.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is highly protective of those it cares about. A single blazing punch dissuades most threats.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME are a passive species. Its large, fluffy wings and mane help keep smaller Pokémon warm during blizzards.
author: celeste.addict

entry: It dazzles opponents with its fiery petals, which conceal an arsenal of scorching, thorny whips. Graceful yet fierce, it ignites the battlefield with a performance of flames and poison.
author: thepandasharky

entry: When in danger, POKENAME releases a cloud of smoky spores from its tail, burning its enemies' eyes and lungs while obscuring their view before it escapes.
author: hophoppip

entry: On cold nights, when the moon is out, POKENAME visits travelers camping outside to keep their campfires burning while they sleep.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME's innocent face belies its extremely devious intentions. It slips into homes through the smallest of gaps before spreading little embers from its fluff and setting things ablaze for fun.
author: sk372

entry: It shakes its tail to release glowing embers while floating above graves. The embers burn away old, dried flowers, leaving the area refreshed.
author: .izik

entry: Trainers must diligently spend time grooming POKENAME to ensure its fur stays clean and healthy. Its entire body is naturally warm, so doctors suggest cuddling with one to help alleviate body aches.
author: mepp.

entry: If POKENAME gets a bit too heated in battle, it will end up burning its disguise, causing it to have to rebuild it. POKENAME are quite popular companions during the winter season.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's disguise is able to generate a modest amount of heat, similar to Flareon's heat sac. It must be careful not to overuse its fire abilities, or the disguise may ignite due to overheating.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scatters flaming embers from its wings and fur as it runs. It shares some similarities with a Pokémon found in an old book.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME radiates heat, but it also has surprisingly adept temperature control. There are records of individuals using POKENAME's heat to use for cooking, at least until a more suitable replacement was available, as POKENAME sheds quite a lot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It collects clay-rich mud for its dams and lodges. It will radiate an extreme amount of heat from its body, reinforcing its structures by baking them.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME radiates heat, but it also has surprisingly adept temperature control. There are records of individuals using POKENAME's heat to use for cooking, at least until a more suitable replacement was available, as POKENAME sheds quite a lot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A flame sac within POKENAME's body keeps it nice and warm even while sleeping in the soil throughout the winter seasons. It shoots out a series of flaming seeds from its head to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a welcome sight for those traversing frigid mountainsides. It guides them to its home and warms them with its fluffy embrace until they feel ready to tackle the cold once more.
author: sk372

entry: Using sound waves, POKENAME can detect oil deposits deep below ground. In order to access this precious food source, they carve out expansive caverns by carefully melting through the rock.
author: turron_turron

entry: Very affectionate, POKENAME enjoys hugging those it trusts. However, Trainers must beware, as the mucus coating its body can leave nasty burns.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME are employed at rescue centers and are specifically used in the help effort for floods. They hug drenched survivors to warm them up with their fur.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: When wild POKENAME ignite the Fire Stone burning atop their heads, their fur gets singed and releases a toxic smoke. Domestic POKENAME are trained to focus their fires into smaller flares in order to avoid spreading the smoke indoors.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME heavily resembles a plush of Flareon produced by Silph Co. Despite being a fire type, its fur is highly combustible.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME breathe out hot spores that cling to the fur and feathers of wild Pokémon. These spores create a burning sensation that causes inflammation to nerve endings and can only be soothed with a Rawst Berry or a Burn Heal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME inhabits mountainous areas, where temperatures are moderate throughout the year. Its fur has the ability to both heat and cool when needed.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are calm, collected, and loyal creatures who fight fiercely to protect their Trainer, using their blazing speed and the scorching rocks on their mane to sear wounds into any threat that comes their way.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME possesses an aggressive attitude that leads it into multiple fights a day. This behavior releases heat that naturally builds within its body and would otherwise cause it to overheat.
author: badtothebow

entry: POKENAME dance a lively yet simple bolero to stir strong emotions in the audience. Their rapid footwork keeps the energy high as castanets rattle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release a hot mixture of spores and embers to propagate the mushroom on their backs. By searing the ground beneath them, the spores have more resources to work with since their competition has been burnt to a crisp.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a highly energetic personality; its body constantly emits soothing warmth. In battle, it coats its arms with searing flames, making its slashing attacks highly likely to burn foes.
author: fireblade141

entry: Now focused on enhancing it's control over fire, its ability has grown more advanced after learning a deeper understanding of flames. POKENAME stores built up fire within its body and channels it out using its stick as if it was a wand.
author: merclipse

entry: Now achieving the apex of its magic, POKENAME manipulates fire to its whim. Although it can now channel flames through its own claws, most choose to keep their wands to limit output. This is to minimize environmental accidents.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME can endure extreme wildfire temperatures. Though it tries to rescue others, its slow pace often prevents it from arriving in time.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is always piping hot, and its cream can even cause burns if you're not careful. It loves to steal baked goods that have just come out of the oven.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME likes to cloak itself in flames and shoot fireballs from its limbs as hot as 2500 °C, but it very rarely reaches that heat, mostly using them as part of its street performance. It is most often seen as part of a circus or magician's troupe.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME love to put on extravagant light shows with their fire, improvising dances in sync with the embers. They joyously hug anyone who approaches them after a performance.
author: mochauspocus

entry: Their fur constantly generates and releases heat due to the flame sac in their body. Care must be taken to keep POKENAME's fur short so they can release heat more easily. POKENAME that are uncomfortable get aggressive and lash out with sharp claws.
author: chibitales

entry: The fur POKENAME sheds inside its tunnels remains warm for days. Some collectors harvest it to create heat-retaining plush toys.
author: .izik

entry: Should it need to defend itself, POKENAME will remove some of its fur and set it alight. It waves it around like a torch to repel predators long enough to give it a chance to escape.
author: sk372

entry: Its warm, fluffy fur makes this Pokémon very pleasant to hold. People who end up having it on their lap find themselves in that same place for hours.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME are extremely popular among fashionistas and influencers, particularly ones who adopt a fire motif. They will not hesitate to singe the clothes of Trainers that mistreat them.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME controls fire with intense mental focus. Certain metals help to focus psychic powers, so Trainers often adorn POKENAME with metal earrings.
author: hophoppip

entry: Whenever it uses its psychic abilities, the tuft of fur on its head moves and flickers like a real flame. When it soaks its head to relieve its headaches, steam can be seen rising from its cranium.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME store flames inside small bubbles to use them underwater. At night, these flames illuminate the water around them to prevent surprise attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's naturally warm body causes snowfall near it to melt before it touches it. Despite the hot nature of its form, it can breathe out a chillingly cold ice breath to freeze others.
author: sk372

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's body reaches 350°C. It unleashes blazing fiery punches against its opponents, bravely fighting even Pokémon far larger and more powerful than itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its massive size, POKENAME can swim through water at incredible speeds. By focusing, it can heat up its ivory tusks until they glow red-hot, making its physical attacks even more devastating.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is thought the use of multiple Fire Stones on this Pokémon is the reason it is so warm to touch. Even its nose is pleasantly warm. This warmth turns red-hot when in battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is thought the use of multiple Fire Stones on this Pokémon is the reason it is so warm to the touch. Even its nose is pleasantly warm. This warmth turns red-hot when in battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are immensely powerful Pokémon that constantly seek out formidable opponents to test their strength. In contrast, they are deeply affectionate, letting their Trainers cuddle against their warm fur while soaring through the sky.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME quickly build up heat as they repeatedly strike with their four arms, to the point that the surrounding air begins to distort. Their own sweat will sizzle and evaporate when they reach their peak heat.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's fluffy fur exudes heat equivalent to open flames. The more that this Pokémon runs, the hotter its body and fur becomes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's fur channels excess heat into its shell to keep the water it stores from evaporating too quickly. If too much heat builds up inside, the shell may burst with explosive force, so Trainers must handle it with great care.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME evolved after an especially large Fire Stone was attached to its tail. Should its flames fail, it can still swing the stone as a last resort.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME have a flaming leek that gives off the scent of roasted onions. They love to roast berries and are happy to share with Pokémon that are hungry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Eating food that has been touched by POKENAME creates a burning sensation in the throat. This sensation is caused by the residue that is left behind after POKENAME roam through an area.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its fluffy fur is a symbol of wealth and prosperity. POKENAME can shoot water that ranges from scalding hot to pleasingly warm at all different kinds of pressures from its cannons. Through its mouth, it breathes fire.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It lingers near graves, waiting for loved ones to leave candles for the departed. Once they leave, it silently absorbs the flame from the candle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME impart dreams of searing hot flames through hypnosis. Many Pokémon awaken covered in sweat from how hot their dreams get.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is used to help teach youths the proper care of plants since its digital nature allows it to be reset if its health declines. The majority of its encyclopedic knowledge is stored within the core on its back.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Said to have been created as a cheap virus protection, POKENAME can travel in and out of devices and feed on corrupted computer code. Millions of POKENAME live in a computer at a time.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are a danger to tech factories, infiltrating in small swarms that zip across the ground at quick speeds, endangering the workers. Though the explosions it creates when agitated are small, they still cause quite a lot of damage.
author: sk372

entry: The number of eyes on its faces fluctuates based on its mood. The more aggravated it grows, the more eyes per side, up to sixteen at once.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The data comprising POKENAME's six units is shared and stretched thin, resulting in some being more complete than others. They work in tandem, but the various glitches and quirks make their teamwork inefficient at best.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resemble a set of polyhedral dice often used in tabletop roleplaying games. They have become popular online for allowing players across the internet to play these same games without using physical dice.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME resemble a set of polyhedral dice often used in tabletop roleplaying games. They have become popular online for allowing players across the internet to play these same games without using physical dice.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME tries to spread its placid and content feelings onto others. Should it appear on someone's device, it generates pleasing music and visuals that help a person envision a relaxing tropical getaway.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wields a club made of coding that works best within cyberspace. It's effective at destroying low-rank viruses across the internet, deleting them with a single smash of its club.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME acts mischievously when its Trainer is distracted and corrupts data with a single hit of its club. Most of the data POKENAME attacks can be restored easily, but it remains a nuisance for Trainers who do not give it enough attention.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is capable of calculating the path a boomerang takes before being thrown. This allows POKENAME to reliably hit multiple targets with a single toss.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME deletes viruses off of a computer in rapid succession by tossing a well-calculated boomerang toss. Upon contact with its boomerang, viruses are deleted from the system.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leave behind an imprint of code whenever they kick an opponent. This line of code helps them lock onto their foe, as this digital footprint helps them locate their opponent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME downloads cheats and buffs online to boost its boxing skills. Afterwards, it throws out attacks and shows no mercy to its opponents.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It spews corrupted code via memory leaks from its digital body. In the physical world, it is believed that POKENAME's emissions manifest as a form of radiation, which can cause severe sickness.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: In the real world, the emissions of POKENAME become the equivalent of blue light and strain the eyes of anyone who comes into contact with them. In cyberspace, its emissions are toxic to images, causing them to slowly deteriorate over time.
author: soup1900

entry: Due to its pointy shape and coloring, POKENAME is often mistaken for an eraser. However, it can't erase anything at all, especially at the blue end.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME is a great nuisance for buildings full of electronics. It infiltrates the building through computers, exiting cyberspace before using its horn to drill into the machinery and feast on the electronic components inside.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lets out a loud beep of happiness upon spotting an injured Pokémon. It will dispense a nutrition filled egg from its mouth in hopes of aiding their recovery.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats higher in moonlight, sparking internet theories that it originates from the moon. During dire battles, it merges together while floating to unleash a powerful Dizzy Punch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have the ability to materialise program data by entering modern machinery and exiting with physical data. While it is unknown how they do this, POKENAME like to fix data they bring out, before placing it back into the machine it came from.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME's programming causes it to spit ink at anyone who approaches it, regardless of whether they're friendly or not. Since its tail is just a solid square that can't be uncurled, it gets easily pushed away by any current in the water.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's coding dissuades it from trying to break through glass to escape aquariums. Due to how its body has no round edges and is made of many basic shapes, POKENAME's unique beauty is only appreciated by people who love retro-style designs.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is attracted to computer screens that have pictures of nature as their background. Curiously, pollen spread from its wings can cause new digital plants to grow on these pictures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can project holographic images of webpages from the single eye in its center. Trainers often have it help them check on emails and other data while away from conventional PC access.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is occasionally spotted on websites related to oceanic research and the deeper areas of the ocean. It spins the star on its back to charge energy, releasing a shimmering and colorful beam from its eye once fully charged.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME erects invisible fields that prevent programs from communicating properly with one another. It appears to do this as a prank, targeting those it senses are mean spirited through its psychic powers.
author: .izik

entry: With how fast it can slash with its scythes, POKENAME is only ever used in cyberspace when needed to destroy entire programs. If not careful, it can even physically damage the device it is in by slashing through the boundaries of digital space.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME gets irrationally angry at error messages, as it sees those messages as a threat to its safety. If it hears or sees an error message, it charges at the source until it tires itself out, or the message goes away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME frequently forgets it can swim through cyberspace, appearing as a simple animation flopping helplessly on people's desktops. It only remembers its abilities after hours of struggling.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are sensitive to the presence of EM waves, so they are drawn to radio towers and human-made antennae as well. They seem to feed on EM waves, though only a swarm of at least fifty POKENAME will cause noticeable interference.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME thrashes about cyberspace and wreaks havoc and destruction on any computer data it comes across. Only the strongest of firewalls and anti-malware programs have a hope of stopping its assaults.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are rare Pokémon found within Cyberspace. They enjoy surfing the web.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME's transformation capabilities are still in development. While it can change its body to mimic the form of others, the results always appear to be a much blockier version of what it is mimicking.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME downloads every update or piece of code sent to it, even if potentially harmful. If it doesn't like a mutation made to it, it self-updates its own body to fix the changes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body texture shifts depending on the attacks it uses. Electric-Type attacks leave its body covered in a fuzzy texture, while Water-Type attacks make it intensely smooth.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME expends most of its electricity, its spiky body becomes completely smooth. It remains this way until its internal charge fully regenerates.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is always warm to the touch, thanks to a powerfully burning core processor. It's recommended not to let it near personal computers, as its presence could cause them to overheat.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon appears to have encountered a fatal error. It may need to restart and try again.
author: fixthewifi

entry: Whenever POKENAME moves, it leaves a short trail of numerous afterimages behind. This effect can disorient foes in battle, but also seems to be taxing to POKENAME as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is skittish and quick to hide in its shell when cornered or interacted with. The spines contain a toxin that works effectively both in and out of cyberspace to paralyze those pricked by the spikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides itself under many computer files and programs to protect itself from malware. Its body becomes extremely hot when it tries to load multiple of its programs at once.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite having no visible eyes on its back, POKENAME was programmed to be able to see from its shell. However, anything it sees from its shell becomes extremely pixelated, so it tends to avoid doing so.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME flies through cyberspace and attacks any program it finds to feast on. However, it does not have any sharp teeth or claws to attack with, making its attacks futile.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is programmed to eradicate any viruses it can find. If it goes hungry for too long, it'll start eating normal applications to satisfy its hunger.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is most attracted to computers housed within power plants across the regions. It drains the computers, but then supercharges the generators, so workers aren't sure if it should be considered as a helper or a hindrance.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME are able to withstand high temperatures, it is used by researchers to study volcanic environments. The flames on its body never dim.
author: mepp.

entry: When needing to update its capabilities, it hides itself behind many folders and programs as protection from outside influences. Electronics that contain this Pokémon need a lot of storage to contain the data from its frequent sheddings.
author: soup1900

entry: The bits of POKENAME's body made of binary code seem to hold most of its programming power. Touching computers with the tip of its tail causes the machine to gain a temporary boost in specs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was first seen in the vicinity of remote island research centers. It takes a vested interest in protecting scientists within its territory, often standing just near them for hours while work is being done.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's stingers are filled with antivirus software. It flies around and repeatedly jabs these stingers at infected computer systems until they are rid of their malware. However, this does damage the physical hardware in the process.
author: soup1900

entry: One theory suggests that POKENAME zipping through cyberspace is the origin of all mysterious coding failures.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to capture data packets and gather what information is being sent around. If it captures a virus, it becomes sick and injured until it bathes in rays of blue light for a couple of hours.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have a unique scent that smells of old plastic and floppy disks. Pokémon that are often found in cyberspace are drawn to this nostalgic scent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce the scent of old plastic and electronic shavings, a scent that draws in many Pokémon that thrive in cyberspace. Many Trainers amplify this scent by having them bask in the sun, intensifying the scent to draw in more Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can act like a mobile firewall inside of a computer when energized thanks to the data emitted from its back. When tired, this data ceases to emit, making it vulnerable to malware.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can use the strange white flames on their back as propulsion, able to thrust themselves in any direction without slowing down. These thrusters were thought to advance space travel, though the power generated is not enough to lift POKENAME.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME hide in fountains at public parks, waiting for unsuspecting writers to set up their electronics nearby. The moment it sees one typing, it leaps out and bites onto the device, instantly absorbing all of its data.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of adapting their bodies to their environment, although only to some degree. The main constant among their kind is that they maintain aerodynamic forms so they can fly with little issue.
author: infinex21

entry: Though POKENAME technically has a powerful bite force, it lacks teeth entirely within its maw. It crushes seaside prey with its powerful limbs before swallowing them whole.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a friendly but curious sort, poking into different computers across cyberspace. Many have found their files in disarray due to curiosity causing POKENAME to examine them and shuffle them around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits radio wave-like ripples alongside its nightly hooting. Oddly, this appears to be involuntary, as its true communication relies on subtle turning movements with others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: While flying between flowers with its swarm to absorb nectar, POKENAME emits a noise similar to a dial up modem. Each POKENAME's noise is slightly different, allowing for surprisingly complex communication.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME primarily resides on computers displaying flowers in their desktop images. Why it prefers digital flowers over real ones is still being studied.
author: .izik

entry: Upon entering a computer, POKENAME searches the system for malware. Any it finds is ensnared in a digital web before being consumed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resembles a hyper-realistic model of a virus that weaves strands of DNA to create proteins to infect people. It is presented in classrooms throughout the world to help people learn about microbiology.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is usually found in dark caves, but it sometimes ventures outside to hunt. It will pounce on anything smaller than it while in the dark, but is much more passive while exposed to daylight.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME marks its den within caves by scratching into the stone walls with its upper wings, which leave red-and-blue markings. Trespassers get a single distorted digital shriek as a warning before it goes on the attack.
author: sk372

entry: Its rigid and sharp wings allow it to achieve great speeds and to better defend itself. Different radio waves seem to have varying effects on this Pokémon, such as calming it or driving it into a frenzy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's antennae emit a peculiar magnetic field; scientists are unsure whether it serves as a cloaking device, a form of echolocation, or something else entirely. It seems particularly attracted to undersea internet cables.
author: dylonk25

entry: Due to POKENAME's basic programming, its main response to problems it encounters is to shock them with a jolt of electricity. Despite how weak the shock is, it still will damage the computer it's in and the hardware it contained.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME floats through the air, a small trail of sparkling light follows it. Close examination of these emissions reveals it to be made entirely of binary code.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME, despite having no mouth, audibly projects music from within its body. It can only be stopped by placing it inside of a device and muting the volume.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME stuffs its shell with programs of many video games and television shows. It happily gives these programs to any bored kid despite their parent's wishes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is said to bring good luck to a person's endeavors while it resides in their computer. Hardcore online gamblers often seek it out hoping to get an advantage in their betting.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spots someone sad, it beeps loudly near them in hopes of cheering them up. Despite its good intentions, this usually only causes headaches and worsens their mood.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing games with its Trainer, especially abstract strategy games where there are no elements of chance. Its programming gives it glimpses into future states of the game, ensuring that it wins.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are said to give out items to Trainers who offer them unique gems, but no one has been able to locate the correct gems to give them. Many live in small villages with wooden huts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relies on its programming to beat Trainers at various abstract strategy games. Where all information is known and there are no elements of chance, POKENAME can reliably win or force a draw.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to consume hard drives and other equipment. After eating a hard drive, its electrical power increases tenfold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is able to flap its wings hard enough to create wind capable of moving files in a computer away. Some people have created malware specifically for this Pokémon, attempting to target and destroy its beautiful cyber hair out of jealousy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tail-orb is able to glow blindingly bright when used at maximum brightness. Its glow emits a special electromagnetic pulse that interferes with nearby technology when active.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims at incredible speeds toward any ship it spots at sea. It presses its tail to the hull to access naval computing equipment and absorb the data within.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of electricity when it hears music while swimming. Strangely, it ceases this behavior whenever another creature draws near.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being made of data, POKENAME hates data streams and avoids being near them as best as it can. It is unknown why it has this tendency, especially since it will stand in rain or real streams without any issue.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body becomes extremely smooth while swimming to minimize friction. When resting in the sun, it shifts to a sticky and incredibly rough texture within seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatters powder from its body as it drifts above industrial areas. Any computer equipment the powder touches will malfunction and shut down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nibbles on server room cables using the fangs on the underside of its body. If it accidentally bites into a live wire, it pulses with a deep blue glow as electricity surges through it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absorb sunlight and store meteorological data of the nearby area as they charge. Scientists have begun tracking down POKENAME to download this data to research how people have affected the environment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fit the description of a Pokémon carved on ancient clay tablets, leaving many scientists baffled by their presence in the ancient past. Connecting POKENAME to a PC reveals incredibly grainy monochrome photos stored in their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME requires large amounts of sunlight to function, lest it shut down completely if deprived for too long. If it absorbs enough during the day, its body will glow during the night.
author: sk372

entry: The flapping of POKENAME's wings emits a small, weak electromagnetic pulse. Though ultimately harmless, it will cause multiple disruptions in the visuals on any electronics near it.
author: sk372

entry: Usually, a POKENAME takes this appearance after it stumbles upon funny images of Wooper while traveling through the internet.
author: nasho1908

entry: POKENAME will lay at the edge of riverbeds and camouflage themselves to the environment, waiting for prey to stroll into their mouth. POKENAME only use basic movements to conserve energy, though they regularly forget to use the energy stored.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME is quite effective as a digital assistance. It uses pattern recognition as well as mild mind-reading to anticipate its owner's computer needs, opening up documents and pages ahead of time to assist in their tasks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are introduced into the digital world to protect files from viruses during nighttime hours. Because of how incredibly useful they are, companies are willing to pay young Trainers to raise them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are introduced into the digital world to protect files from viruses during nighttime hours. Because of how incredibly useful they are, companies are willing to pay young Trainers to raise them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are very slow going and don't really like to get into fights unless they know they can win them. They instead call upon others to protect and fight attackers for them.
author: fireflower20002

entry: POKENAME are commonly found preying on discarded electronics at night, typically stalking alleyways. They usually follow whoever is the largest of their pack.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME's blocky structure is believed to have formed to better the growing data core flower on its back. The data flower grows more rapidly as POKENAME takes in information in direct sunlight.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has been known to connect to computers to cause chaos online. If its whiskers are cut off, then it will disconnect as the whiskers are key to connection.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME has the power to cast mild digital hexes that cause technical issues in the computers it inhabits. It gleefully delights in a user's vexation at these problems, feasting on the frustration they emanate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME serves as a language to help run scripts in the cyberworld. Researchers and programmers use it to run simulations.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME crop up within social media websites seemingly at random, interjected within unrelated conversation. Those who spot it usually report feeling a sense of loss.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME sleeps, its tail remains alert for danger, which it will lunge at with a reach further than its chain-like appearance would indicate. The tail charges and bites with enough force to shatter steel gates.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It distracts foes by twisting its entire body around. A skilled POKENAME can unscramble itself in just 3 seconds.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is a digital hunter attracted to the movements of mouse cursors. It swoops down on them and attempts to eat them, forcing a user to frantically wiggle their mouse to escape its clutches.
author: sk372

entry: Its code is fully fortified and encrypted. It is studied by programmers, who know it as a "digital strongbox".
author: napstabl0ok

entry: POKENAME are needy creatures that demand lots of attention. If their Trainer ignores them, they find music files and turn the volume up until their Trainer gives them the attention they desire.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was uploaded into the virtual world to detect and neutralize system bugs before they could spread through critical data management software. It requires regular maintenance checks to ensure no virus has corrupted its system integrity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are loyal creatures that protect their Trainer's files from strangers. Without explicit permission from their Trainer, POKENAME ferociously stop others from accessing sensitive files by grabbing onto the cursor and refusing to let go.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Lacking a strong poison of its own, POKENAME's best defense is to hide underwater and camouflage itself among undersea mines. As a last resort, it can fire off its blocky spikes as fast-moving heavy projectiles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings and heavy body leave it only able to fly in straight lines. It rarely ascends high into the sky, keeping low and crushing smaller Pokémon with the powerful grip of its claws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME relies on special sensors within its body to maintain the right conditions needed for high quality Berry Juice. It is protective of its Berry Juice, attacking Trainers and Pokémon who try to take it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relies on a unique set of sensors in its body to concoct the perfect Berry Juice. It almost never shares this special drink with other Pokémon and only offers it to its Trainer after years of trust and respect.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Having only a limited amount of motions, POKENAME can only use its horn to fling objects far away. Despite having wings, it is unable to fly due to not having any program in its body related to the wings.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a tendency to use its claws to dig markings into the sides of computers it claims as its own. Trainers will have a difficult time teaching it to resist this instinct.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's close appearance to Teddiursa allows it to blend in within groups of them almost seamlessly. The best way to tell the difference is to offer it honey; unlike Teddiursa, it can't stand the treat's sweet taste.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sits around and waits in cyberspace until it smells malware come by it. It then suddenly becomes very active and aggressively slashes at the virus until it has been destroyed.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME stays close to Teddiursa to ensure their safety as they grow up. Upon spotting a predator, it lets out a horrifying beeping roar and shifts its body to a rough texture before charging.
author: .izik

entry: It is advised never to let a POKENAME get too close to a computer and attempt to enter cyberspace. Its body temperature is so high that just being within an electronic will cause it to rapidly overheat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME help young bakers maintain the proper temperature for baked goods without the risk of setting their house on fire. Once a set duration has passed, they turn off the heat and chime loudly for someone to check on the food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon is carrying a whole portal made out of obsidian glass on its back. Some rumors say that it leads directly to the spirit world.
author: zerocipher

entry: It is said that POKENAME carries a portal to the underworld on its back. However, no research has been conducted due to its high body temperature.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's wings convert to pure data while traveling through cyberspace. This data is made up of discarded files it consumes along the way.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travels across icy tundras using its nose to sniff out edible plants beneath the ice. It can detect them from up to 50 feet away, letting out happy squeaky beeps upon finding any.
author: .izik

entry: It obsessively analyzes any striped pattern it comes across. It seems to value certain patterns more than others.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME are able to shoot targets with ink from far away, using the data stored in their body to triangulate a shot. POKENAME can change the properties of this ink to produce differing effects to adapt to their opponent.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME was created as an attempt to compete with electronic messaging on the internet through its own cyber delivery system.
author: pankiwi

entry: One should be careful not to anger a POKENAME that appears on one's computer. The flames it breathes when enraged carry bits of malicious data that will infect a system and become impossible to remove.
author: sk372

entry: Their bodies are capable of rapid adaptation, even during battle. What often changes the least are their long beaks that, at most, only get sharper to better attack foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME only eats apples, swallowing them whole and searching for the next one. It has been seen trying to eat Pokémon like Slurpie when they are asleep.
author: epping_forest

entry: After consuming computer equipment, the bubbles POKENAME creates can easily breach the hull of a ship. These bubbles let off loud beeps when they pop.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body grows incredibly rough as it rolls through caverns. It lets out a shrill beep whenever it detects an inevitable collision with a wall.
author: .izik

entry: Though a POKENAME's rolling rampage may be difficult to stop physically, it can instantly be halted by placing an electronic in its path. Unwilling to harm machines, POKENAME will instantly stop and turn to go elsewhere.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon was caught in the middle of a software update. As such, it is in an unstable state. Waiting for the update to complete may fix this.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: This fusion between two different Porygon versions resembles what can be seen during evolution. It behaves as if it suddenly became stronger, though it isn't sure how to use its newfound strength.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is sometimes spotted hanging around web pages dedicated to forests or nature preserves. It sometimes roots around trashed files yet to be fully deleted, consuming them to increase its bulk.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's works are derived from an artistry software from long ago. The pieces it can produce are interactive to an extent.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME can enter computers to consume pixels, using them in their own creations. They are often used by game designers to help create textures.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME can rotate on multiple axes to land devastating punches and kicks. This makes them difficult to hit, as they can snap to the same direction as a punch and maneuver around a fist.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's programming is glitched, causing it to swing wildly between moods. When happy, it is optimistic, kind, and loves to play, but at the smallest upset, it will weep and panic.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME are able to plug themselves into any outlet to charge any device they're connected to. However, their inability to hold a charge makes them useless when in a location with no outlets.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are able to plug themselves into any 3-pronged outlet to charge any device they're connected to. However, their inability to hold a charge makes them useless when in a location with no useable outlets.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can put any image it wants onto the screen on its belly. It will often display a scary image while making a loud sound, though it's unclear if this behavior is for intimidation or POKENAME's own amusement.
author: aggrave

entry: POKENAME plunges into data streams and bathes in them for hours to rest up. Files where a POKENAME was are often missing a few bits of data from when it expelled some flames from its breath.
author: soup1900

entry: Milk sourced from POKENAME has a distinctly artificial flavor to it, making it unpalatable to most. However, this exact taste is highly favored by the Porygon family and most of its fusions, making it a beloved treat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits a beeping cry resembling elation when it senses someone in pain. It approaches the wounded and dispenses dozens of eggs from its mouth, each filled with healing properties.
author: .izik

entry: In cyberspace, POKENAME's cry causes a volcano to digitally form and erupt lava all about. It uses this to burn away data on itself, covering its tracks to avoid being followed as it roams the depths of the digital world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ribbons have the power to clear a computer instantly of all viruses and malware, making it highly sought after. Aggressive hunting tactics towards it have made it quick to flee the moment it spies humans.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME mimics the roughness of any stone within its eyesight. It primarily does this when distressed to ward off potential foes.
author: .izik
