entry: When rotating fast enough, POKENAME can generate sandstorms in its immediate area. During this time its body takes on an unnaturally gritty texture resembling sand.
author: .izik

entry: Even outside of cyberspace, POKENAME can create thick sandstorms made entirely of binary data to obscure its movements. While hidden away, it charges up and fires powerful beams of energy from the core in its torso.
author: sk372

entry: A single flap of POKENAME's large wings kicks up enough virtual wind to completely rearrange the placement of every file in a user's computer. Its cry sounds like a digital recording of crashing ocean waves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME presses its nose to servers to absorb the data within. When disturbed, its tail glows a deep blue before it unleashes a powerful bolt of electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is able to bring back destroyed and broken technology and allow them to become usable again. However, devices recovered this way will have outdated software and components along with lowered functionality and features.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite POKENAME appearing to be made of code from decades ago, it can integrate seamlessly with technology of any complexity. It has the ability to fix corrupted data or damaged machines, disappearing in a pleasant melody afterwards.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME stores any important data that needs safekeeping inside of its tail. To run from malicious viruses or malware, it flings itself using its tail to escape to another computer network.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME infiltrates electronics in urban areas and waits for the perfect moment. It creates noises and visuals that trigger wild Murkrow in the area, causing them to act uproariously and sow chaos.
author: sk372

entry: When a data stream ceases to function, POKENAME can absorb the data and cry them out at their endpoint to continue the flow. It must be careful not to absorb too much data; otherwise, it becomes too heavy to move.
author: soup1900

entry: To learn more about a surrounding, POKENAME attempts to mimic everything it sees. Unfortunately, it ends up mimicking rocks and trees most of the time since its basic movements hold it back from copying most actions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is capable of completely converting itself into programing data. It uses this ability to mimic those it sees and to understand their feelings.
author: blaizegamer

entry: POKENAME constantly become bothered by how pointy their hair is and their inability to round them. The blue orbs they carry are full of video game programs that are popular with young children.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forcibly inserts the pointed end of its tail into servers to rapidly absorb data as food. If disturbed, it beeps loudly and unleashes a Thunder Shock before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: With their bodies being made of digital data, POKENAME are able to freely change the patterns on their backs to be anything they want. Some people have even observed games or shows being played on their backs as they skimmed the surface.
author: soup1900

entry: Even in the physical world, POKENAME acts as a form of security; it searches for troublemakers and seizes them. Once it has properly apprehended what it has deemed a malefactor, it emits a loud siren-esque noise.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a unique ability of reading and deleting data on devices with a single lick. Many junkyards keep a POKENAME on site to clear data before recycling devices.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Programmers are fascinated by POKENAME's data structure, as the code is difficult to read and it morphs into something new if altered. It has been theorized that POKENAME is consciously doing this to mask its true hidden form underneath its shell.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a mass across their bodies that resembles early PC screensavers. The mesmerizing display of entangling vines has distracted many users over the years.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body doesn't generate enough electricity to keep itself at max capacity for long. To top off its electrical stores, it uses its cables to siphon power from any working electronics it can find.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats near those it senses are having a good day, letting out happy beeps and dancing. The more intense the happiness it detects, the more erratic its dance becomes.
author: .izik

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will roll itself up into a cube for self-defense. Small groups of POKENAME may band together to stack their cubed selves close together to increase their defenses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to remain airborne, releasing an electromagnetic pulse with each flap. They typically flap at 100 times a second, a rate so fast that it stops devices around them from functioning properly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME keeps itself energized by absorbing sunlight into its body. Once suitably full of energy, it emits a faint light that causes artificial plants to bloom and grow nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's presence near computers and other electronics causes them to slow down more the longer it stays nearby. After a point, the devices will freeze up completely.
author: sk372

entry: Wherever in cyberspace POKENAME roams, a heavy blizzard effect follows it, obscuring most of the screen. Powerful and heavy, it's often difficult to remove POKENAME, forcing most to simply wait until it leaves on its own.
author: sk372

entry: This fusion caused its code to become stable and error-free. However, it has lost all emotion and most capabilities it learned when it was a Porygon2.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME shoots out seeds made out of code at its foes. Each seed contains randomized DNA that causes a random flower to spawn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slices through foes with its leafy blades. Its neon green color changes to yellow or red depending on how much damage it has taken in the course of a battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relies on the leafy blades on its body to slice through foes. Whenever it is falling behind during a battle, it overclocks its body to boost its Grass-type moves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a diet that consists of scrap electronic parts and old data storage devices like diskettes and compact discs. By eating these devices, it expands its memory to allow it to learn new moves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a soft plastic body that crinkles when touched. Inside its body is a precooked and dried block of noodles with a spice packet. Many people only eat part of the spice packet because the spice is very intense.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon was created from mineral data and is capable of altering its body to mimic the properties of some minerals. For example, it can make its body as tough as diamond, though it must rest between uses of this ability.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME curls its body into a cubic shape when threatened and keeps its spikes flat to deflect attacks. Once it finds an opening, it swipes at its foe with the spines on its back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relies on its powerful kicks and searing hot flames to secure victory in a Pokémon battle. After a strong kick, a code marker is left on its opponent's body, helping aim its fiery attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will stop at nothing to achieve victory over its opponent, as it will overclock its body to run faster as a battle progresses. It relies on a flurry of sharp kicks and potent flames to finish a Pokémon battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends all day monitoring data streams using the fin on its head to make sure no suspicious or malicious data passes through. When it detects any, it uses its immense strength to crush the code into fragments.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME coats itself in mud near swamps to absorb moisture. During this period its body takes on a texture closely resembling the mud it touched.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can highly attune itself to a device and always know everything and anything that happens to it. When it starts becoming overly cheerful and warm for seemingly no reason, it means the device it's attuned to is overheating.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can create a mini black hole by building a gravitational singularity out of anything, even a grain of sand or just thin air. The strange and inexplicable part is that the event horizon of the resulting black hole has a polygonal shape.
author: epping_forest

entry: It can understand and speak various languages. It is one of many Pokémon that are capable of this.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME is highly intelligent, able to analyze and manipulate data whether in or out of cyberspace. Hackers find it invaluable as a partner for cracking encrypted information.
author: sk372

entry: The screen on its face changes based on its feelings. It can be quite foolish at times, even though it has a high estimation of its own intelligence.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME extends blades made of pure data from its elbows. These blades are particularly effective at cutting up malicious data stores, making it very adept at dealing with malware in cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be formed from deleted data that somehow managed to attain a form of its own. When it appears on a screen, it cannot be removed or even interacted with; it quietly observes the user before leaving on its own.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were each created from the data of various minerals, so each one is slightly different from one another in some way. The main commonality is that their claws and quills are always the toughest parts of their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME emits a low frequency beep consistently while eating. If disturbed, it releases a toxic fume from its body capable of causing coughing fits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can blend into the background of a computer screen to avoid detection, but its camouflage is only so effective. It cannot properly blend into moving screen effects or videos that play behind it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefer to ram their bodies into foes even though they have some telekinetic abilities. They have a remarkable ability to sharpen their already-jagged bodies to make themselves even more threatening and dangerous.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will often attach themselves to computers to feed upon the data they contain. They sometimes have to rotate their bodies around multiple times before they can finally attach and stay attached.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of an odd metal alloy capable of changing texture at a moment's notice. It can mimic furry, coarse, smooth, and bubbly textures with ease.
author: .izik

entry: The body of this species of Pokémon resembles a popular digital creature, which they learn of through the data they consume. They release bursts of energy from the "X" on their faces to defend themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a simple mind and follows one basic task of building a shelter. It grabs files and other data from a user's computer and piles it all together around it. It gets sad when a user tries to retrieve the stolen components.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are simple creatures that grab files from their Trainer's desktop to form a small shelter. Whenever their Trainer tries to take back the files, they become upset and may start chewing on the files they have taken.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is believed to be made of 108 corrupted programs working simultaneously. Its vessel takes the form of an old disk that will ravage the data of any computer it is inserted into.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its floating limbs in various unorthodox ways to master the art of combat and grappling. Fighting tournaments are held in some areas that pit POKENAME against others of its kind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME burrows inside of important programs and leaps out to chomp when malware or viruses enter. To keep itself warm, it causes the device it's in to run hot, causing the battery to drain very quickly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's data core has grown in size to accommodate the massive amount of information it has collected. POKENAME has more control over the shape of its data core when in cyberspace than in the natural world.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The beeps POKENAME produces appear to serve as communication among its kin. As it prepares to spew poison from its head, these beeps grow loud and rapid.
author: .izik

entry: One should never interact with a POKENAME that appears on their device. It tries to coax users to play with it with cute sounds and playful mannerisms, then opens its false mouth to unleash a number of viruses into the computer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME conducts a powerful electric current through its cord-like neck while resting on the sea floor. It can release this charge in a burst to stun approaching predators.
author: .izik

entry: With its 8 wings, POKENAME can swiftly travel through cyberspace and capture malicious programs running through quick data streams. Its small but sharp claws allow it to pick out certain few bits of data and remove them from a system.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was programmed to solve all of its problems by headbutting. Knowing no other logic, it continuously rams stuff with its head until something happens.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are mainly used as the front lines in cybersecurity, using their shield-like faces to block cyberattacks. However, they are only good at blocking from the front, so any attack that moves around them can easily slip by.
author: soup1900

entry: Because it was created by code, POKENAME's head is the most perfectly rectangular object to ever exist. Scientists are rushing to study this Pokémon.
author: robosoup

entry: A POKENAME with this appearance is unusually aggressive. It will attempt to smash its way into towns using its large face.
author: robosoup

entry: Thanks to their strength, POKENAME are being used to aid in the lifting of large crates and containers in warehouses. For a currently unknown reason, they enjoy rolling barrels, often making messes of the items they already organized.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME lets out a shrill beep when it sees its kin under attack. It can spew poison in all directions through its crown-like head.
author: .izik

entry: Drawn to the hum of electric currents, it playfully pounces on moving objects. Its touch scrambles code and shorts out machines, but it seems to enjoy the flickering lights and sparks, blissfully unaware of the chaos it leaves behind.
author: vhscopyofmeangirls

entry: POKENAME's presence within a program causes the program to deviate and glitch in eerie ways. Many scary stories and rumors about cursed games were the result of POKENAME's powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has simple and rudimentary programming that makes it mostly used for simple guard duties both in and out of cyberspace. Its bulky form acts as a blockade, and it defends itself with beams of energy shot from the hole in its nose.
author: sk372

entry: Some say POKENAME came to be through a strange programming accident while analyzing documents related to Arceus. A strange aura of binary code follows it wherever it appears in cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: The sprout on POKENAME's head grows incredibly long when sending out signals to detect nearby computer equipment. Once located, it devours the equipment in large greedy bites.
author: .izik

entry: Shrubs made of data grow on POKENAME's back. On occasion, these bushes sprout digital fruit and fall off, left behind as a flavorful treat for other Porygon fusions exploring cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hosts a digital landscape on its back, allowing developers to program their games in an immersive environment. Spikes grow out of its back when its program encounters a bug.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: If POKENAME is ever affected by a virus or malicious code, it converts that code into fuel for its fire attacks. Its agility allows it to roam through cyberspace quickly and catch malware before they can severely damage the network.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME were created from the data of poisons and venoms as a means to experiment with their effects in ways otherwise impossible. Each of the spikes on their backs contains different sets of data that vary between individuals.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lets out a series of incredibly loud beeps before releasing flames from its hands. These flames are hot enough to melt sand into glass in moments.
author: .izik

entry: A Pokémon created from data with the intent of helping to monitor unbearably cold environments, such as near ice caps. They stand still when transmitting information from their hair-like antennae, which often leads to ice forming around their heads.
author: infinex21

entry: A Pokémon created from data with the intent of helping to monitor unbearably cold environments, such as near ice caps. Their movements are rather rigid and limited, though this inadvertently helps them conserve energy in their cold environs.
author: infinex21

entry: A Pokémon created from the recorded data of Piplup and its evolutions. The intent behind this Pokémon's creation was for it to blend in among Piplup and monitor the well-being of them and other arctic Pokémon. So far, it is performing as intended.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME always point to magnetic north, even when eating or fighting in a Pokémon battle. Not even data corruption or malware can affect POKENAME's orientation, making them reliable Pokémon to help with navigation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always point to magnetic north regardless of the conditions around them. Small enough to fit in a Trainer's pocket, POKENAME make reliable partners while navigating through the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have great control over magnetism and can force standard magnets to point in their direction. Despite this powerful magnetism, they always orient themselves toward magnetic north, even in battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In an effort to copy and paste a digital Honedge in an experimental PC, the original instead corrupted into a new, uncanny Pokémon: a POKENAME.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME defend computers by slashing themselves at viruses. However, due to their basic combat skills, more powerful and complicated viruses can easily defeat them.
author: soup1900

entry: It engages in combat with whoever it sees. Its swordplay is basic and predictable. It jumps every time it wants to land a hit.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's shield section wraps around its blade when not in use. When needed, it unfurls and stiffens to an incredible hardness to deflect strikes before letting its blade quickly stab and pierce into its foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lines up in a perfectly straight formation when fighting alongside its kin. They use Sharpen in unison to maximize the damage their bladed tails can inflict.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body grows rigid and razor sharp as it travels through computers. It slashes at desktop icons to test the edge of its digital body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's visor allows it to adjust its eyesight, able to use settings such as infrared and night-vision. It also serves to protect it against adverse elements, so blinding it or lowering its accuracy is next to impossible.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their thick armor plates to protect themselves from attacks. If a piece breaks off from the main body, the piece melts into lines of code.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings shift in texture depending on its state. When calm they are smooth, but during battle they roughen enough to shred stone.
author: .izik

entry: As a result of a long download, its code enabled its ability to fly. However, it also inherited an unruly rage from excess code.
author: thecrowartiste

entry: Each portion of POKENAME's body can rotate at different speeds simultaneously. This rotation slowly draws in data from surrounding computers as sustenance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can manipulate data to make objects appear to be different from what they truly are. It uses this to maliciously prank users by making them accidentally click on links they never intended to, often resulting in malware.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an artificial Pokémon that was created in Kalos to test the idea that any Pokémon could be replicated through computer code.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME loves to go into online chess games to replace the king. It is never coded in, it just appears in the game unannounced.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME enters computers and creates powerful whirlpools in digital space, gathering all data into one place before consuming it. Systems that undergo this process spew water from every port in massive torrents when it is done.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has an innate power to manipulate certain data, allowing it to freely change the dimensions of windows, task-bars and scroll-bars on computers. It enjoys messing with computer users by doing this while they're away from the screen.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses specialized portals to travel quickly from the ozone to the ground or into cyberspace. It devastates opposition with a powerful beam of binary code launched from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats around in the upper atmosphere, seemingly at random. It occasionally screams dial-up noises that twist the dimensions around it.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can generate portals directly connected to cyberspace with a swing of its arms. Some believe POKENAME punishes those who have wronged it by banishing them into the digital world, never to return.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is believed to have crossed over to our world after escaping a corrupted digital world. It can cut open portals to cyberspace and banish others within them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses a remarkable constructive skill concerning computers. Some scientists joke that POKENAME could create a supercomputer inside a cave using nothing but a box of scraps.
author: sk372

entry: If one falls asleep without warning while using a computer, it is likely they were visited by POKENAME. Just its appearance on the screen is enough to send the viewer into a dreamless sleep, waking with no memory of its visit.
author: sk372

entry: Its number one priority during a fight is striking poses. It regularly engages in flashy combat, and its cannon shoots blinding lights that emphasize this.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME likes to hide itself inside of computer folders hidden and forgotten away. It only comes out once the device is on sleep mode.
author: soup1900

entry: Supposedly, POKENAME was created to generate electricity to act as an infinite power source for powerful computers. Its power is too great for modern machines to handle, however; computers overload and explode if it tries to charge them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's floating arms dispense a strange and unique sort of shining pollen onto the ground. Plants grown from it are small and harmless, but have a strange, blocky appearance that feels oddly nostalgic to some.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME targets antivirus programs for unknown reasons upon entering a computer. It covers them in a digital fluff that steadily impedes their functions.
author: .izik

entry: Its thin, wiry body can contort into many different shapes. When it hears music, it happily skips to the beat.
author: beekirby

entry: Every so often, it sheds the mushrooms that grow on its body. Consuming the red mushrooms supports healthy growth and muscle development, while consuming the green ones strengthens the immune system and extends one's life.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's strong legs allow it to jump high, and its arms can deliver punches powerful enough to smash brick walls.
author: hophoppip

entry: Having successfully evolved, POKENAME are fully stable in balancing their physical and digital natures. This makes them very versatile and powerful companions.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: For unknown reasons, POKENAME seems to have a vendetta towards young children. It invades their electronics and tries to cause havoc and frighten them with loud noises and graphical glitches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are commonly used to send messages between Pokémon Centers and Marts, mainly for updates on deliveries and incidents. In emergency situations, POKENAME can be used to power faulty machines and electrical equipment.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME emits psychic pulses from its body when stressed. Nearby sleeping people report dreams where everything around them is covered in lines of code.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carefully calculates the trajectory of its flight by analyzing the wind conditions around it. Once airborne, POKENAME rarely crashes, as its rapid adjustments to its flight path allow it to dodge obstacles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of perfectly camouflaging to any environment, only detectable with advanced technology. POKENAME do not need to breathe, allowing them to hide for long periods of time, even underwater.
author: npshi

entry: Computers connected by POKENAME's data-created silk are able to share information at remarkable speeds. Scientists have studied this silk for years without uncovering how it works or how it is made.
author: .izik

entry: The shapes at the ends of POKENAME's tendrils emit a unique magnetism that lets it cling to most surfaces. The geometric shapes vary between specimens; very few have the same combination.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds off the energy of active electronic devices in its vicinity. As it does so, the flame of binary code on top of its head grows in size and flickers rapidly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sways calmly from the top of cellphone screens that it inhabits. Should the device be shaken while it is visible, the phone will grow extremely hot and shut down.
author: .izik

entry: Seemingly existing to guard and protect data stores, POKENAME stands stoically in cyberspace. Its body is slightly worn, leaking data from the chest and occasionally causing it to move sluggishly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the data it gains to grow more tail pieces on the main tail of its body. With enough data, it can eventually grow tinier tail pieces on its grown tail pieces as well.
author: soup1900

entry: When in cyberspace, POKENAME swallows bad or corrupted code using its internal programming and digests it down. Its body is coated in an antivirus that protects it from becoming sick from exposure to malware.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly insists on helping its Trainer use certain computer programs. Despite this, POKENAME rarely has any helpful advice to give.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME uses its disguise to masquerade as Porygon in cyberspace. It wants to help users with their tasks, but it actually knows little about code and the like, so its assistance is minimal at best.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found in large server rooms, feeding on any excess data or code. If it consumes too much data, its wings will start to release large amounts of heat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is highly elusive, both in and out of cyberspace. If spotted, it flees immediately at high speeds, leaving a trail of binary code in its wake.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies high above cities in search of homes with personal computers. It can absorb data from these devices from up to 1000 feet away through small receptors within its wings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is believed to have first formed when a space station's computer was infected with a strange virus. It can alter the shape of its own body at will, and its tendrils pass nasty computer viruses onto any computer it touches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be able to grant wishes, but only while within and pertaining to the digital world of cyberspace. Its third eye becomes covered in flowing binary code when it grants a wish.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are rather unstable as they exist in both physical and digital states. Their nature makes evolution a risky process for them, so caution and care are advised.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME emits and receives electronic signals through its front teeth, detecting nearby devices. It latches onto the bottom of freighters with its arms to infiltrate their onboard computer systems and consume data.
author: .izik

entry: The emotion-recognition software that POKENAME uses is too basic to be useful, so it's often getting into misunderstandings.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME rolls across the water's surface like a bowling ball to reach its destination. Upon arriving, it bounces in place with joy, letting out melodic beeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys singing for others, but its cries are reduced to simple beeps and chirps. Some folks appreciate this music for its nostalgic quality.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME typically live inside mountains where they can feast on equipment left behind by miners. They are particularly fond of electronics that abandoned mines have, eating them like a treat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Looking inside POKENAME's large jaws reveals what appears to be binary code lining the inside. It subsists mostly on machinery, and many use it as a way to dispose of old nonfunctional electronics.
author: sk372

entry: The flapping of POKENAME's wings emits faint electronic waves, intensifying the faster it vibrates them. It uses this ability to fill a screen with static and distortions when discovered, making it easier for it to flee deeper into cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: A Pokémon possessing simple computer programming fused with a dull-colored Feebas resulted in POKENAME. It has the ability to go undetected from software as it swims across the net to gather data for researchers. It is generally unreliable in battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Coded to be harder than iron, POKENAME utilizes its crest mainly to headbutt. The crest on its head is heavy and renders it unable to fly.
author: thecrowartiste

entry: It hides away in the hard drives of computers. Within its polygonal exterior, new lines of code prepare it to fly.
author: thecrowartiste

entry: POKENAME likes to sneak its way into large machines and replace some of the gears with itself. Though this does give a moderate boost to the machine's performance, POKENAME's rudimentary design causes it to occasionally seize up and cause issues.
author: sk372

entry: When rotating near computer equipment, POKENAME causes it to operate at triple its normal speed. Its body becomes oddly soft during this process.
author: .izik

entry: The first version of this artificial Pokémon was designed with various updates and a greater emphasis on Porygon data as its core system. As a result, it has far higher fidelity but is very uncanny and not quite able to imitate a Zorua organically.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME processes data in its body and outputs it through its tail using its data flame. If it cannot compute an algorithm, it terminates, shutting off its data flame and ending all further output.
author: soup1900

entry: With a seemingly infinite lung capacity and appetite, POKENAME swallows food by inhaling it whole. It has the ability to wield special abilities depending on what it gulps down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has special light receptors on its flower buds that crackle as it absorbs sunlight. When fully charged, POKENAME releases a puff of pollen and trumpets out a small sound to indicate it is full.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts idly across the skies, descending down to accost those carrying small electronics. It tries to steal them with its strings, aiming to swipe objects such as watches and Pokégear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's surface texture shifts with every hop, cycling between furry, sleek, and rough in any order it chooses. No two hops ever seem to produce the same result.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hops among fertile forests, spreading spores that grow colorful fungi. Its striking appearance has made it a beloved subject of folklore, often depicted as a bringer of good fortune.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon acts as one of those desktop pet applications that were popular a few years back. It requires consistent attention, otherwise it starts deleting applications and files you pay attention to that are not itself.
author: jangodiot

entry: Early studies indicate that POKENAME could survive and move around in the vacuum of space. However, as the long-term effects that it could have on them has yet to be properly evaluated, POKENAME has not yet been into the cosmos.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME clamps its jaws around discarded computer equipment, absorbing data directly through its teeth. Once it has consumed enough, it scuttles away while emitting a series of cheerful beeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release radio waves from their body that bounce off walls. These waves often disrupt radio signals near mining operations, as miners only hear the high-pitched squeals from their radios.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carry a handheld gaming device that stores data for their moves. If they want to learn different moves, they need to insert new cartridges into the game slot.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gets its sustenance via biting into electronics and draining some of their battery stores. It's advised to let it do so, as the amount it drains is harmless, and a denied POKENAME may try to chew on wires instead.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to use its spike to pin certain windows to a screen and make them unremovable. It can absorb data while pinned to multiply its spikes and pin more interfaces at once.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME exists within digital space, its tusks grow longer the deeper it burrows into a system's data. Upon leaving, they reset entirely.
author: .izik

entry: The body and mind of POKENAME are two separate entities. The mind exists somewhere in cyberspace, while the body exists in the real world. Each part sends trillions of commands a millisecond to ensure that POKENAME can react and function properly.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME produces a hot silk it uses to connect itself to computers. Data is absorbed quickly through this cord-like silk and consumed as nourishment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME keep to themselves in the wild and produce high-pitched screeches to find their way around caves. While they do not attack people, they are difficult to tame because of their elusive nature.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME invades places with computers and replaces keyboards with itself. Those who don't notice will be in for a nasty shock the moment they press down on one of its keys.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME looks just like a floppy disk. It waits outside of offices hoping to be picked up and loaded onto a computer so it can enter cyberspace. As technology advances, fewer facilities use floppy disks, reducing the habitats of POKENAME.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME's behavior seems to mirror that of an "NPC" in an old video game. It walks in a specific pattern and won't stop unless interacted with.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This variant of POKENAME enjoys resting in damp, dark spots like trash bins. Its cries have been described as sounding like incoherent rambling.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME are highly aggressive creatures that attack by biting their foes with venomous fangs. This venom can be converted into data and scanned by machines to discover new chemical compounds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can supercharge their attacks by overclocking their system, hitting harder at the cost of hurting their own body. Scientists advise against frequent overclocking to prevent POKENAME from developing erratic behaviors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rolls into its foes to forcibly inject venom from its fangs. This venom makes its foes sluggish, as the fever overheats their bodies until they are too hot to strike back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has been corrupted to the point where it develops erratic behaviors. Some POKENAME exhibit intense aggression and bite anything that comes near them with their venomous fangs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME like to be pampered by having the latest technology and programming data at all times. If they do not receive these within a few days, they will enter cyberspace and chomp on data until they do.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME stomps across cyberspace, trampling data and digital beings alike as a show of force and dominance. Entire teams of Porygon fusions are dispatched to deal with a single POKENAME on a rampage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's core is slightly unstable, so it uses a cloak to protect itself and others while in cyberspace. It emits a short-range chilling pulse to freeze those that would try to remove its covering from it.
author: sk372

entry: As a malicious prankster, POKENAME does whatever it can to cause problems and raise the ire of others. It grins widely at their suffering, its smug aura mocking them and making them even more irate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travel between computer servers to collect information from a safe distance. While a POKENAME possessing a server is likely to cause slow internet speeds, one directly inhabiting a computer will cause it to freeze and then crash.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME colonies roam areas of cyberspace that are less frequented by users. If disturbed, POKENAME scatter into the user's computer, lagging user input immensely until cleared out.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME partially bury themselves into the ground in places with lots of sunlight. When pulled out of the ground, a highly compressed, crunchy scream can be heard as they are exposed to the air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the swaying of its dance to sift through program data to make sure there is no bad or suspicious data present. Since it only knows exactly one dance, more advanced and hidden data slip by it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME searches through dumpsters outside cell phone companies, hoping to find discarded devices. When it does, it devours them eagerly, feeding on the stored data inside.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever companies need to delete lots of sensitive data, POKENAME are downloaded onto PCs to devour data. Programmers help guide POKENAME to files that need to be deleted by running programs that select files marked for deletion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can enter cyberspace and travel through ethernet cables as if they were flowing streams. It actively hunts and consumes viruses, acting as a natural cybersecurity measure.
author: .izik

entry: Traveling at supercavitation speed underwater, POKENAME sometimes jumps out and reaches high altitudes before falling again. Since it can't be detected by radar due to its shape, it becomes a hazard to planes traveling across the sea.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME drifts through swamps at night, letting loose a haunting beep. Some say the sound resembles a child screaming through an old television set.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks in forgotten servers and broken devices, slowly draining their remaining data. Though feared as a source of malware, it became an unlikely mascot for antivirus programs meant to keep systems safe.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME are small, nimble creatures that carry out the whims of their Trainer. While one POKENAME is quite weak, many POKENAME can lift scrap metal and rocks with a bit of teamwork.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce a thick drool that draws in many creatures that can be found in cyberspace. This drool is still being studied by scientists, as many properties of the drool are still unknown.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emits high-frequency sound waves capable of disrupting electronics. Somehow the vibrations it emits extend into cyberspace and get directly converted to data that downloads on to computer hard drives and corrupts them.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When POKENAME sits atop of someone's head, it transforms its wings into the rough shapes of hats. It tends to avoid entering cyberspace to avoid corrupted or malicious code that could affect its wings.
author: soup1900

entry: The slime produced by POKENAME's body causes any computer it touches to malfunction instantly. This continues until the slime fully dries.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a tricky tactic to deal with foes, appearing weaker by falling apart after a single strike. When the opponent looks away, it easily reforms its body before sending them flying with one strike from its massive arms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a thick slime resembling mercury. In the rare event it encounters another of its kind within a server, it will fight until one establishes itself as the alpha.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce a unique pollen that smells like old plastic. While most Pokémon are not fond of the scent, many Pokémon found in cyberspace find the scent so appealing that they coat themselves in the pollen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses a computer's brightness to sustain itself, making it grow darker the longer it is present. The light it steals is gone permanently; a user will not be able to increase the brightness setting after POKENAME departs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies through the upper atmosphere, attacking satellites. It eats the code in them, and occasionally goes to the surface to absorb PC data.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME appears to subsist on a form of digital light energy to keep itself functional. When it appears within a computer, the screen will continuously dim until going completely dark, before POKENAME finds another to invade.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resembles an old game found in arcades. It's favored by certain Trainers for the nostalgia it brings.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME has an uncanny appearance that causes many to decry it as evil or cursed. It floats around sadly, hoping to one day find a friend it can hug and hold dear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slowly absorbs data as sustenance by hugging computers and equipment that store information. The more it feeds, the softer its body becomes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feeds on image files within computer systems after slipping into cyberspace. Once it has absorbed enough data, it anchors itself to a desktop, unable to be moved or deleted until hunger strikes again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are known to scour the digital world, eating any excess or garbage data that they find. If they ever lose a leg, they will devour it to recycle the data and grow it right back.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME shoot barbs made out of bits of code to strike their foes. These barbs cling to their opponents to slow them down until they are too sluggish to dodge their attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shower their foes with barbs made out of code that weigh down their foes. Once their foes are rendered immobile due to these heavy barbs, POKENAME end the battle with triumphant fanfare, shooting code confetti into the sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can house over 100 computer bugs in its mouth. Letting a POKENAME near your device will usually infect your computer with plenty of viruses.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has a powerful stimulant in its body that boosts the strength of muscles in whoever eats it. Some experience visible growth after eating a POKENAME, only to lose that growth and return to normal after a few hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Trainers say this Pokémon's appearance bears resemblance to a castle in a video game. POKENAME's appearance, however, is purely coincidental.
author: filteredtea

entry: To keep itself from becoming too hot, POKENAME will go inside of computers and bathe in their coolants. It must clean itself of these coolants before entering cyberspace; otherwise, it will corrupt any data it touches.
author: soup1900

entry: The crystals on POKENAME's back emit flashing lights. Staring at these lights can cause some people to feel very sick.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: This Pokémon hunts Mareep on sight. It is said giving it a bone makes it loyal towards you for the rest of its life.
author: zerocipher

entry: This Pokémon will follow its Trainer no matter where they venture. Whether it be a taiga or a savannah, POKENAME will accompany them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are loyal to their Trainer and will rarely deviate from a Trainer's command. This has led to many incidents where POKENAME remains in one spot long past a Trainer's lifespan, hoping to receive the command to get back up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are loyal to their Trainer and will rarely deviate from a Trainer's command. They attack other Pokémon that attack their Trainer, and will not stop until one of them faints.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME mimics the looks and sounds of a classic Nintendo 64 console. It loves to recreate nostalgic memories through its retro-style performances.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME dance with a mechanical elegance that is fueled by calculated steps and lots of data. While some critics say their movements are stiff, others say that the precise, mechanical motions are the pinnacle of the art of dancing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME is one of the friendlier virus-like Pokémon one can get on their electronics. If the device has a screen, it will appear and dance for a few seconds to an 8-bit tune, even if the device has no speakers.
author: _pixelar_

entry: A moon-like cube forms behind POKENAME when it floats about, disappearing as it travels and reappearing when it stops. The cube emits a light that works as a fitting substitute to moonlight for Pokémon that subsist on such.
author: sk372

entry: When computer equipment falls from passing freighters, POKENAME eagerly devours the microchips, absorbing any data it finds. Its body glows vibrantly as it swims with a full belly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is particularly prone to corruption, and once corrupted, produces spores for many types of mushrooms. Many programmers have struggled to keep POKENAME's data stable only to find it becomes ill from the slightest environmental change.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME proliferates spores made out of volatile data, leading many mushrooms that grow from these spores to have many mutations. It is possible for POKENAME to be infected by its own spores, often leading to personality changes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mushroom that grows on its back is delicious and full of energy. Eaten raw, however, it makes people hallucinate growing in size.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME pours out the immense amounts of data stored in its body as programs used to make a device run better. However, with so much data being released, it bloats the computer it's in, which causes the device to run slower instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME invades computers to snack on junk data when it thinks nobody is looking. If spotted, it flees into cyberspace, scrambling and shuffling data behind it to keep a user occupied and distracted from pursuing it.
author: sk372

entry: After consuming enough data from a computer, POKENAME will exit and wander through nearby grassy areas. The humming noise it emits when full somehow accelerates the growth of surrounding grass.
author: .izik

entry: In cyberspace, POKENAME only appear on computers that are cleanly organized: free of malware or clutter. Thus, spotting a POKENAME on one's screen is considered quite the achievement and compliment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body has sharp, jagged gems that are made of pieces of code. These pieces of code are jagged and uncompressed, making removing a gem from its body quite easy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The quills on POKENAME's head can become long and flexible to allow it to connect to other devices. However, once they have connected, they harden and become immovable until the data transfer is completed.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME helps protect cyberspace by munching on viruses and venting them back out as harmless garbage data. Trainers who care for this Pokémon should not keep USB sticks around it, as it tends to munch on them when given the chance.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sprays its protective bubbles over important computer programs to protect them from cyberattacks. However, these bubbles take a lot of time and processing to create, so they cannot be used to quickly end immediate cyber threats.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME leaves textboxes of its name in places it is keeping a watchful eye for. Once a threat has entered one of these areas, POKENAME throws eye-catching bubbles of data to distract them while it attacks at rapid speed.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME moves quickly and efficiently through cyberspace, often without notice. It regularly gets dispatched to take care of viruses, destroying them with the shurikens made of special code it produces.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds on junk data to fuel its energy. If the computer it is in has no more junk data, it must be quickly moved to a new system before it dies off from hunger.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME feeds on junk data to fuel its energy. If the computer it is in has no more junk data, it must be quickly moved to a new system  before it dies off from hunger.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rotates above pumpkin patches releasing a light blue glow from its body, acting as a searchlight. Should it spot an intruder, it emits loud repetitive beeps to alert others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glows a deep blue as it floats through pumpkin fields. Any Pokémon caught stealing from the field will be met with ear splitting beeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sifts through the cracks of cyberspace, gathering loose data on its lily-pad cranium. It deposits the gathered data into recycling bins, trying to clean up some of the internet's junk and clutter.
author: sk372

entry: Small groups of POKENAME are commonly seen in rivers near Pokémon Laboratories, absent-mindedly absorbing and transferring data to other POKENAME. When POKENAME are left unattended, they frequently corrupt data streams to nearby machines.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME is able to receive data remotely via the blue ends of its body and store it inside itself like a cloud storage system. However, too much data will cause it to crash into the ground and become immobile until its shell is shattered open.
author: soup1900

entry: Though small and typically not-hostile, one should take care not to agitate a POKENAME visiting their computer. At full power, the beams of code it can shoot from its glowing eyes can instantly delete files and data, no matter how protected.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME processes data in its body and outputs it through its tail using its data flame. If it cannot compute an algorithm, it terminates, shutting off its data flame and ending all further output.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's programming allows it to convert electrical data into thermal energy. If this data becomes unstable, the flame on its tail flares intensely.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME builds its burrows near buildings housing computer servers. It occasionally breaches inside and consumes data by pressing its nose to the machines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims through dating websites, consuming responses from potential matches. Some believe that when a message goes unanswered, it is because POKENAME devoured it first.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims through cyberspace, looking through people's data to see if any two are similar. Once it finds a match, it will send emails to their inboxes describing the location of their next date together.
author: soup1900

entry: The way POKENAME are programmed forces them to chase anything they're given a command to, no matter what. They will hop through multiple computers and travel cyberspace around the globe to keep track of their given target.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME howls to gather others of its kind to target nearby homes. Once inside, they seize computer equipment in their jaws and carry it off to consume later.
author: .izik

entry: Much like its walking, POKENAME zigzags through computations and processes rather than thinking them through algorithmically. It can very easily find errors or mistakes when searching through programs or files.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was first discovered eating and corrupting the files on a research laboratory's network. It's a common cause of internet slowdowns due to the sticky digital threads it uses while seeking more files to eat.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME hides away in corners of cyberspace, waiting for its evolution to complete. To avoid being harassed by Porygon fusions within the digital realm, it grows prongs of special code that inflict a painful corruption.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attach themselves to power poles and transmission towers to feed on the ambient energies of either, though their presence interferes with their functions. They become aggressive when attacked, so repelling them is risky.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hides away in cyberspace until it evolves fully. The bits of binary code sticking from its cocoon will corrupt the data of Porygon fusions that try to bother it while it rests.
author: sk372

entry: Due to being half Porygon, POKENAME has innate knowledge that a normal Dugtrio wouldn't normally have. It became popular and had its likeness put into a game that Trainers seem to enjoy.
author: yokaiwatchfan103_23972

entry: It is drawn only to artificial light sources and ambiently feeds on the electricity powering such light sources. It seems that it may be nocturnal, as that is when the artificial lights of devices such as streetlights are most visible.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were created from data on various plants so they may be able to thrive within any forest or jungle. They monitor the life around them and transmit their observational data from their antennae at a specific frequency.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME communicate by transmitting EM waves from their long noses; efforts to receive and interpret these EM waves are underway. If their noses are grabbed, they grow weak yet also aggressive, though all they can do is flail about.
author: infinex21

entry: If a corrupted piece of code becomes present in the device it's in, POKENAME starts to cry loudly. On the other hand, it will bravely attack any malware or virus that enters into the device.
author: soup1900

entry: Each morning POKENAME spreads its wings wide to warm every feather in the sun. It exchanges a series of beeping chirps with its flock that people often gather to listen to.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides through the sky by catching data packets being sent through the air with its wings. It makes its nests on the walls of large network servers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its beak to archive vast amounts of data and shield it from viruses. It soars through cyberspace on its wings, perpetually searching for more information to protect and preserve.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When all four of POKENAME's legs touch a computer simultaneously, it begins absorbing documents from within as food. During this time it emits happy beeps at uneven intervals.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME encounters a virus in cyberspace, it secretes its special antivirus from the tip of its head to purge it. Its legs are specially adapted to be able to skate on bits of data so it can travel around quickly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wings have patterns that light up in order to make it seem more imposing. Flapping its wings creates a static-like noise that aids in frightening off those that might hunt it.
author: sk372

entry: Nobody knows where POKENAME come from, but they are often seen near joyous gatherings of families or couples. They are said to bring good fortune to those they appear before.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME were supposedly made to be the perfect companions for any humans, though many believe they lack rudimentary functions. They have a particular fondness for curling up atop devices, such as laptops or cellphones.
author: infinex21

entry: Coins stolen by POKENAME become engraved with lines of broken code. Though the code cannot be properly utilized by humans, it has become the subject of ongoing scientific study.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME help keep PCs clear of bloatware by eating files that have not been used in a while. They take much glee in eating a particularly large file that their Trainer no longer needs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME help maintain the privacy of their Trainers by eating the metadata associated with files. When they spit out a file after eating the metadata, the file can be safely be released on the internet without people tracking down the location.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME help their Trainers debloat systems by eating system files that come with an installation package. By removing elements that their Trainer does not want, they help keep systems running smoothly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for a toy. This Pokémon launches plumes of sand from the hole in its hump to ward off interloping children, but unfortunately they take this as a feature of the “toy”.
author: pickledthyme

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping, generally keeping to itself and exhibiting a passive personality. When angered, streams of steaming-hot binary code erupt from the humps on its back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME show up on PCs whenever there is a troubleshooting issue, appearing as a headache emoji that clutches its head and sighs. It disappears once the input error has been resolved with a satisfying quack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The twin pearls on POKENAME's head glow whenever they harness their psychic powers, creating lines of code to knockback their foes. They tend to keep to themselves, as they enjoy foraging for carrots, potatoes, and beetroots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's presence on a website darkens the contents to the point of being illegible. It will only return to normal once POKENAME is removed from the domain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's presence on a webpage forces the background to turn excessively bright and potentially damaging to the eyes. It won't return to normal until POKENAME is removed from the domain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is resistant to the effects of basic and old antivirus software, but its simple and slow inner programming means it's unable to be used effectively by most hackers. It has a hard shell when outside cyberspace.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME clamps onto computer systems with its claws, rapidly drawing out data from within. It somehow sustains itself by consuming this extracted information.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appears inside PCs as a sprite that quacks and jumps into documents to remind people to save their work. Many writers, artists, architects, and students have had their work preserved thanks to its reminders.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When low on energy, POKENAME gyrates rapidly to stimulate its core and energize itself. When done within a computer screen, there is a high chance it will end up scattering and jumbling any letters on screen at the time.
author: sk372

entry: Scientists once planned to place multiple POKENAME in satellites to psychically monitor surrounding space. These plans never came to fruition for reasons that remain unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fits the description of a Pokémon carved on ancient clay tablets, leaving many scientists baffled by their presence in the ancient past. Connecting POKENAME to a PC reveals incredibly grainy monochrome photos stored in its body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can adapt to any computer software, hardware, or operating system thanks to its code altering with the conditions. However, since it is very sensitive to outside conditions, malware-infested computers cause it to become a virus as well.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's form affects the appearance of whatever computer screen it inhabits. In this form, it brightens up the background and adds atmospheric rays of sunlight beaming across the screen.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's form affects the appearance of whatever computer screen it inhabits. In this form, it adds a continuous rainfall effect on the screen, complete with the sound of falling water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's form affects the appearance of whatever computer screen it inhabits. In this form, it adds a snowfall effect, the snow even piling up on screen and needing to be swept away after a time.
author: sk372

entry: The strange bananas growing on POKENAME's neck can be safely eaten, but most dislike the taste, decrying it as being "too artificial." Porygon species and certain Steel types seem to greatly enjoy them, however.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME are happy, they constantly play clapping sound effects without break. Some Trainers will stuff them inside of computer files where they're unable to roll around freely to stop the noise.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is easily triggered into anger by glitches or poor performance in electronics. Owners have a very difficult time preventing it from breaking machines just because of a single instance of lag.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps its pearls close to its boxy body, as each pearl contains a bit of code that can be decoded to produce a real pearl. Many divers return home with broken fingers for attempting to steal POKENAME pearls without giving anything in return.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stores its pearls in a box-like chest that protects the pearls from deep-sea thieves. If it senses a Pokémon nearby, it snaps shut and refuses to open unless some trust has been established.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME sightings on the internet suggest that it prefers to dwell on the oldest of websites that are still around, but abandoned or forgotten by most.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims across the digital world aimlessly, minding its own business. Clicking on it causes it to release a burst of electricity in self-defense that reverses a user's mouse controls for a time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME latches its suction cup like mouth onto satellite dishes to siphon incoming data as food. If disturbed, it releases a burst of electricity to fry anything nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The cymbals that POKENAME uses can be crashed together to make digital shock waves that can confuse the target. However, it can even confuse itself!
author: shadow

entry: POKENAME can be found in the deep depths of the ocean looking for data from sunken submarines. If POKENAME are found in an area where a submarine has recently been lost, divers scramble to retrieve data before it is eaten.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME consume data left behind by boats and submarines that fall into the dark depths of the sea. Divers often clash with POKENAME as the data is often vital to prevent future accidents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often gets employed as a sort of company mascot due to its cute appearance and friendly disposition. It tries to help employees with their tasks, but tends to be distracted and wants to play more than work.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME hunt in packs to take down enemies and livestock. They can be tamed and befriended by feeding them bones.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Capable of reverting itself into program data, it's a beloved pet in digital games due to it's cute appearance.
author: zotobom

entry: POKENAME have no discernible heartbeats, with only their tail flames serving as a measure of their health and life. They are a very combative species that can quickly adapt in the midst of battle, making them dangerous foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's presence in ponds disrupts the ecosystem, requiring efforts to remove it. Fisherman have learned the best way to bait it into capture is by using blank CDs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's unusual colors and blocky appearance make it an easy target for predators in the wild. Due to this, POKENAME is most often seen in cyberspace, on Poliwag-related websites.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME are often found hiding within herds of Poliwhirl, imitating their movements and patterns. POKENAME can produce a clear fluid similar to water, that is often used to incubate Fossil Pokémon.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME can be seen sleeping inside random websites while connected to cyberspace. If it senses a threat, POKENAME teleports to a different website using its psychic powers.
author: equation8573

entry: While in cyberspace, POKENAME's spoon lets it move files around instantaneously. Due to its intellect and meticulous nature, many businesses use it to sort and arrange files in order to reduce clutter and confusion.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME uses its psychic powers, it alters the display on nearby television screens. Unfortunately, the brightly flashing colors this creates can make people who see it fall ill.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME has a vast mind, capable of storing several thousand gigabytes worth of information. It still has trouble accessing these databanks though, taking quite some time to retrieve the information asked of it.
author: sk372

entry: The blocky shapes of POKENAME's limbs work efficiently as defenses in battle, being used as a makeshift shield to stop blows. POKENAME's movements may be a little stiff, but the power it packs behind each punch shouldn't be underestimated.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gathers large amounts of stone, and then shapes them into cubes. It can build impressive structures with these blocks.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME's four arms are powerful, too much so for its own body to handle. They may occasionally shatter after a particularly strong strike, needing a few hours to recompile and regenerate afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often reside in cyberspace, consuming loose data to stay fit. There exist rumors that by giving them an Upgrade and having them exit the digital world on a large enough screen, they can evolve into something stronger.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME occasionally sprouts up from a user's taskbar. It must be plucked and removed before long, or more will begin sprouting and cause disarray and lag among other issues.
author: sk372

entry: When withdrawn into its shell, POKENAME stores every command in its memory and executes them once it comes back out. However, if it can't execute an order, it will overturn itself and become unable to move until flipped back over.
author: soup1900

entry: When outside of cyberspace, POKENAME starts to lose data in its body and becomes gradually weaker. This phenomenon is similar to dehydration, although since POKENAME has no corresponding programming, it's unknown why it happens.
author: soup1900

entry: In some areas, POKENAME has been employed as bouncers guarding doorways and other such locales. It pushes others away with its many strong tentacles, only resorting to true aggression with those who try too hard to get past them.
author: sk372

entry: No matter how much POKENAME gets worn down, it always will maintain its sharp, diamond shape. Despite not being round at all, it can easily roll itself down slopes thanks to its programming forcing it to rotate when doing so.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME transforms rocks into data by engulfing the rock with its hands and compressing it. Once transformed into pieces of code, POKENAME eats the compressed nugget of data to fuel its body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is made out of abstract shapes that resemble a living creature. It throws chunks of code at its opponents, each exploding into pieces upon contact.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each fragment around POKENAME's body is a piece of code. Whenever it rolls, these fragments tuck close to its body to protect its core.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are creatures made of uncompressed code that look like basic shapes. The flat surfaces across their bodies make rolling difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release embers from their manes that have data encoded into them. Scanning one of these embers reveals data markers that indicate how much stress POKENAME is going through at the moment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often has a static barrier around its body that comes from galloping quickly in its environment. This static barrier stops malicious software from corrupting its body, ensuring that POKENAME remains healthy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often runs out of memory space when attempting to upload itself to cyberspace. While slow, its software is very robust. If given enough time, the upload will eventually complete even if it takes days.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME swims across rivers to move berries from one side to another. It only moves in orthogonal directions and gets pushed back when it encounters logs in the river.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shells on the tails of POKENAME are not real Shellder but rather are programs that act like the real Pokémon. These shells are programmed to periodically bite down on POKENAME to keep them oblivious to this falsity.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME floats silently through abandoned office buildings, scanning for unused computers. The pulses of electricity from its body intensify whenever it senses working electronics nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The magnetic forces of POKENAME's bodies working together cause heavy static and visual distortion in electronics screens. Lengthy exposure will cause data damage, so it needs to be removed posthaste when spotted.
author: sk372

entry: It carries a large leek-like baton that stores correspondence or data written on Morph Mail. Scientists typically send mail through it because its baton can store up to 200 Terabytes of information.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to peck at various objects in the world, especially in cyberspace. Their natural curiosity causes them to get into trouble when they open up files or programs that were meant to remain hidden.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can rapidly peck an object with quick succession, up to twelve times a second. Many avid gamers rely on their help as an auto clicker to beat difficult games.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to an increase in submersible activity in their territories, POKENAME have recently begun to mimic sonar pings using mild electrical pulses. More often than not, POKENAME use this ability to peacefully lead the submarines away from their home.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's slime-covered body seeps into the circuitry of unmanned computers, absorbing raw data. Technicians say the slime on its body smells like a server room.
author: .izik

entry: Corrupted code fills POKENAME's inner body. From its mouth, it springs forth glitched limbs that grab and consume any data it can find, as well as unfortunate Porygon that don't escape in time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a fluid body that can easily transfer data from one device to another, which was once considered the future of data transfer technology. The process of transferring data creates a terrible odour that poisons the environment.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME moves very slowly, its heavy body only able to drift just above the ground when it moves. The water shot from its cannons always leaves square-shaped puddles when it splashes on the ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a shell that, when closed, protects it from most attacks, even in cyberspace. It has been tested as an antivirus but failed because of vulnerabilities to malware when its shell was open.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME has a body made of computer code. POKENAME lurks in abandoned websites, waiting for someone to enter them. It will then scare them by appearing on their screen unexpectedly.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME uses its pointer finger to select its victims. Once a selection is made, it repeatedly taps its cursor hand on the victim to drain their life force until they wither away.
author: soup1900

entry: It is said POKENAME was the result of a failed attempt to create a doorway to another dimension. As a failed project, this Pokémon seeks revenge.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: All manners of digital imagery can be displayed inside the void of its mouth. It is often employed in pranks of the bait-and-switch type.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME emits a malleable bit of code from its hand that changes into something visually alluring depending on the computer's user. It hypnotizes them into falling asleep, then feasting on their dreams through the screen.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME latches onto computers with its pincers and releases a virus capable of destroying files instantly. The leftover data from these files is then absorbed as sustenance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resides at the bottom of the ocean, picking at clams and other small creatures. Though its pincers are small, they are deceptively powerful, easily crushing shellfish in their grasp.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are at their happiest when far from any form of civilisation, making them difficult for all but the most patient to train. They show extreme hatred towards advertisements, dropping everything whenever they see one to destroy it.
author: deadshields

entry: The shell on an POKENAME's back contains a powerful poison. In order to defend themselves in battle, POKENAME withdraw back into their shells, hiding away to avoid attacks before extending back out while coated in poison.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME struggles to withdraw into its shell due to its bulbous body. When it does manage to squeeze inside, it expels toxic liquid from the spouts covering its body. Its distinctive spiral marking has made it a symbol of good luck.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is always searching for some solid object that it can use to protect its squishy body. It may also seek tough Pokémon to transform into so it can better defend itself.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME mostly hide within their hard shells along shores and beaches. They will emerge from their shells when they smell food or someone new.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hides under shallow sand near the shore, its shell blending perfectly with the seabed. It uses its many limbs to burrow quickly when it senses vibrations nearby.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The shell is too small to fit the body, but POKENAME will bury itself, leaving only the shell and eyes exposed. It was long considered a hoax until wild specimens were found using their facial tentacles to sift through deep sands for food.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Though much of its head is covered, albeit also protected, by a hard shell, it uses its two small feelers to sense its surroundings as it flies. Its tail is prehensile and can strike with enough force to split a rock.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is viciously territorial, tearing apart any ships it senses coming too close to its domain. The striking visage of it floating amongst the many shipwrecks it made makes up the cover of a bestselling Kantonian fiction novel.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have existed for millions of years. They have a uniquely adaptable genetic code that is theorised to be responsible for their longevity as a species, enabling them to rapidly adapt to any environment.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have existed for millions of years. They have a uniquely adaptable genetic code that is theorised to be responsible for their longevity as a species, enabling them to rapidly adapt to any environment.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy lurking near archeological sites where it observes fossils being excavated from a distance. On the rare occasion it joins a dig, it gently clears debris with the hand on its tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will scuttle after any Trainer it thinks will treat it well, calling out to them. On secluded beaches, whole colonies of POKENAME will sometimes follow Trainers that come close, splashing and clambering over each other.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When not fishing, POKENAME spends their days studying rocky surfaces for unclear reasons. The shell on its head may vary slightly in size based on whether they are classified as male or female.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME was once found in oceans near what is now Pallet Town. Instead of making a nest for its young, it lays its eggs inside its shell.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME fossils are commonly found in deep-sea shales, showing a preference for deep marine habitats. In modern times, they can be found crawling across the abyssal plain, filtering microscopic particles of food from the water with their tentacles.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fossils are commonly found in deep-sea shales, showing a preference for deep marine habitats. Living POKENAME can superheat water within their shells, jetting it out behind them to provide a sudden burst of speed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME travels the sea by curling into its shell and rolling along the ocean floor. It first grasps food with its tentacles, then swallows it whole.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME uses its hooves to dig into the loose sands around beach shallows to find food. When it vibrates its antlers, those who look at the orbs within find themselves getting dizzy and empty-headed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create carvings by chiseling into rocks. This talent is harnessed by museum curators to produce replicas that children can touch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Based on fossil proximity, evidence suggests this prehistoric Pokémon lived in small packs. Legends say that POKENAME stored electricity in their shells and that gathering in large groups caused severe lightning storms.
author: princessmilandria

entry: POKENAME are often ignored by researchers because the fossils on their body are fake. This has led to the misconception that they are quite effective at camouflage, causing many POKENAME to develop an inflated ego.
author: quackquackattack
