entry: POKENAME nest high in the mountains within glaciers, their thick downy feathers insulating them against the cold. When flocks of POKENAME descend from the mountains, they bring sleet storms with them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have been seen accidentally freeze-drying their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in ice-cold environments.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Struggling to contain the volatile mixture of ice and electricity stored within its body, POKENAME is an adorable but dangerous hazard. Anyone standing too close risks being struck by a sudden jolt of static or an instant flash of frostbite.
author: beatdoof

entry: One wingbeat from POKENAME can blanket an entire forest in snow. It is so rare that researchers have yet to understand the key elements of this species' behavior.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It only appears during the winter months, bringing a light dusting of snow wherever it flies. Its wings are sensitive to heat and will start to melt if it gets too warm.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sleeps in ponds in wetlands. Whilst asleep, it slowly freezes the surrounding water. Upon waking, it stretches, shattering the ice and sending it flying in every direction, with passersby often mistaking it for hail.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are incredibly haughty and prevent trainers from touching them, keeping the temperature of the air around them below freezing temperatures. The more they grow to respect their trainer, the warmer their aura becomes.
author: thesilverowls

entry: The rings on POKENAME's body and wings glow brightly in the thick hailstorms that surround it. Travelers have been known to become mesmerized by the glow and get hopelessly lost within the storm.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME are often depicted in ancient ruins located in arctic areas rife with blizzards and flurries alike. Based on these depictions, it has been theorized that people once thought these Pokémon would be the harbingers of a new ice age.
author: infinex21

entry: Mountain climbers are often chilled and snowed on by POKENAME flying overhead. When it needs sleep, POKENAME wishes for no disturbances. To achieve this, it uses its drill tail to dig a hole.
author: equation8573

entry: A single flap of its massive wings can summon freezing blizzards. POKENAME is a rare Pokémon said to appear before explorers who reach the peaks of the highest mountains after enduring great hardships.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME descends to the ground to sniff out mushrooms to gather, favoring those that grow in colder areas. Once it has its food, it flies up to higher ground; it seems unwilling to eat meals below a certain altitude.
author: sk372

entry: Some variants of POKENAME have a coloration similar to Articuno from a far-off region. This subspecies is slightly more aggressive concerning food; interrupted meals incite a violent response rather than fleeing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shoots heavy chunks of ice from its beak. Heavy POKENAME fire larger ice chunks.
author: .realthree

entry: Herds of these Pokémon are only occasionally seen on the highest mountain peaks. At the slightest danger, the whole herd takes flight at once.
author: r.isk

entry: POKENAME's wings generate a gentle and cool breeze with calming properties. It uses the chill of its own body to help those suffering from fevers, or to cool eggs that develop better in colder temperatures.
author: sk372

entry: Having an intense fight-or-flight response, it will either fly away at the sight of danger or create a paralyzing snowstorm. POKENAME is, however, very friendly and loves to snuggle with its Trainer, warming them up or cooling them down.
author: beatdoof

entry: Those who see the brilliant splendor of the golden light shining through POKENAME's crystalline ice feathers never forget it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's blue feathers shimmer in shifting colors when exposed to moonlight. Many once believed that witnessing this phenomenon would leave you cursed.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME grows irritable and begins to spark, one must plunge it into an icy lake. However, it's very fond of kids; it will happily exhaust its freezing powers just to weave a glistening, snowy playground for the local children.
author: beatdoof

entry: A unique bioelectricity within POKENAME's body lets it generating freezing gales around it. It decorates its lair with frozen pieces of machinery it has drained of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: It can loose balls of fire and snow from within its arm cannons, both elements somehow working in tandem to create deadly projectiles. Their flames burn so hot that they numb the body, and their ice chills so quickly that it burns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME build their nests along snowy mountain tops within the most secure crags of rock and ice. Every flap of their wings sends out many glittering snowflakes that are a welcome sight to many travelers.
author: infinex21

entry: The very air around an POKENAME will quickly freeze when its friends or family are put in danger. With a single flap of their wings, they can create blizzards in a matter of seconds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a solitary being, allowing very few to venture deep into its frigid territory.  Those who are not welcome will be repelled via a shower of sharp icicles it generates with each flap of its wings.
author: sk372

entry: Spirits that have passed in blizzards gather to form POKENAME. This powerful spirit is bonded to a frozen keystone.
author: melodydelune

entry: Dwelling deep within icy caverns, POKENAME carve out holes in ice to hide in while they sleep. Once fully rested, they launch themselves out of their dens while releasing an icy mist, working to keep their homes from melting or falling apart.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The ice scales on its body are as hard as diamond. If its armor does manage to crack, it explodes with supercooled air, freezing its attacker solid.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Legends are told of POKENAME sending down massive blizzards to ravage mountainsides. However, eyewitness reports from these storms indicate that POKENAME travels through the snow to guide people to safety.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME lives far atop the iciest of mountain peaks, generating powerful snowstorms with only a few flaps of its wings. Legends say it decorates its home with ice statues fashioned in the image of those brave enough to reach it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's extreme quickness allows it to perfectly blend in with the rushing snow of the blizzards it creates. When it gets excited, its crown of ice becomes larger and grander, only melting back down to regular size after a long rest.
author: soup1900

entry: Extremely regal and proud, POKENAME demands great respect from other Pokémon and even its own Trainer. It uses the frozen metallic claws at the ends of its wings as anchors when climbing cliffsides or mountains.
author: c0u51nv1nn7

entry: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around icy summits. It can generate a blizzard with a swing of its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Every swing POKENAME's blades make leaves a freezing trail behind. It can even send crescent-shaped chunks of ice at foes as projectiles, ensuring none can escape its frigid might.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sharp eyesight lets it quickly locate any travelers going through its frigid home. It appears before those lost in snowstorms and guides them to safety, illuminating the path with its glowing eyes.
author: sk372

entry: This legendary Pokémon can create magnificent wings by coating its feelers in a thick coat of ice. Wherever it flies, it snows.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME generates a thick mist of snow around it at all times. Its long tail is often the only part of it ever seen, and this tail can freeze foes upon contact. POKENAME also uses this tail to shatter frozen victims.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME sightings are rare, as it arrives to our world from another via portals, and remains within the most frigid of areas. Strange, shadowy snow falls from its wings as it glides through the air.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient legends describe POKENAME as a harbinger of merciless winters, dragging the cold across the land in its wake. Its silent passage and piercing eyes are often the last signs seen before the land is buried in ice.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME fiercely protects the icy mountains it calls home, yearning for absolute solitude. Those who fall asleep in its territory are doomed to an endless nightmare, left to freeze in the relentless cold.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME flies down from cold mountain peaks to forage for mushrooms to eat. To deal with pests, it coats its claws with ice produced from its wings before extending its arms to deal chilling long-range claw swipes.
author: sk372

entry: Opening the inside of POKENAME can cause frostbite to anyone nearby. It prefers not to have any items inside of it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The interior of POKENAME's body is extremely cold in temperature. One foolish Trainer attempted to store food inside their POKENAME, and was never seen again.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME freeze over entire forests with a blanket of snow at the beginning of the winter season. When necessary, they melt ice with soft embers to thaw out other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that anyone who even brushes against one of its bicolored feathers will be instantly scorched by the cold. Its icy breath can drastically lower the temperature of its surroundings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME zips through the air, it cools the air and creates snow drifts that linger for a short while after. It likes to fly over tropical areas and give the inhabitants a short respite from the hot temperatures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME summons mighty blizzards to hide its presence when hunting, ambushing prey from above with Fire Spin. It lives on some of the tallest mountains in the world, making it difficult to research properly.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME wields legendary icy powers combined with extraterrestrial prowess. It commands the skies with grace and formidable abilities.
author: anarchaz

entry: If you see a small icy comet darting across the sky, it could be an POKENAME. It only arrives in the early winter to bring the first snow of the season.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides itself away on frigid mountains so it may grow into its next form in solitude. Those that disturb its peace will be pelted with frozen winds created through the swing of its tail.
author: sk372

entry: The fluid surrounding POKENAME's core is constantly below 0°C, yet doesn't freeze. They are most often seen during blizzards in cold regions forming small groups. Research is still ongoing pertaining to why they do this.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME makes its home in caverns located in colder regions. A quick and silent hunter, it prefers to swoop at and suck the blood of Ice-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Thriving in icy regions, POKENAME wanders open plains in search of prey. It freezes the ground beneath fleeing Pokémon with a powerful roar, causing them to slip and fall and giving POKENAME time to catch its meal.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: As it dances, POKENAME summons large, deadly blizzards. It creates large tornadoes of both fire and ice to disorient opponents.
author: dodoowner_

entry: In late autumn, flocks of POKENAME descend from mountain peaks as if to usher in the winter season. Their elegant dance movements produce glistening frost wherever they step.
author: mepp.

entry: Its cloud-like wings constantly form light, fluffy snow. Its high-pitched, melodic singing makes nearby clouds snow as well.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its gelatinous horns are so sensitive that they can detect the slightest rise in temperature around it. With a single beat of its wings, POKENAME can summon snowstorms capable of restoring cold regions to their ideal temperature.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Optimists will say that POKENAME rescue those who are lost in blizzards, but the cold reality is that they put them out of their misery by encasing them in ice.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, and those who encounter it are often fearful. To others, it is described as a "beautiful beast," with a long tail that never stops waving.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, and those who encounter it are often fearful. To others, it is described as a "disappointing but pretty beast," with a surprisingly short tail.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME can often be observed dancing upon frozen lakes, moving as if on solid ground. They always end these performances by pirouetting, the motion summoning a strong hailstorm. While all sight is obscured in the storm, the POKENAME will vanish.
author: _pixelar_

entry: With its staff, POKENAME summons blizzards with unimaginable strength. Ancient texts claim that it possesses the power to plunge the world into a never-ending ice age.
author: dodoowner_

entry: With its staff, POKENAME summons blizzards with unimaginable strength. Ancient texts claim that it possesses the power to plunge the world into a never-ending ice age.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It is a master of temperature manipulation, whose shell is made of ice, while its core burns hotter than magma. When the inside of its shell melts and boils, POKENAME erupts with the accumulated steam, which freezes into snow upon being released.
author: milchik

entry: It is a master of temperature manipulation, whose shell is made of ice, while its core burns hotter than magma. When the inside of its shell melts and boils, POKENAME erupts with the accumulated steam, which freezes into snow upon being released.
author: milchik

entry: The quick fluttering of POKENAME's wings casts frost with each flap, making its flight paths look like moving snow flurries. It flash-freezes prey in midair, swooping quickly to snag them before they hit the ground.
author: sk372

entry: Their wings give off chilly, sparkling snowflakes as they fly. These dazzling displays, alongside POKENAME's rarity, make them a once-in-a-lifetime event that Hikers climb some of the tallest mountains in the world to see.
author: chibitales

entry: Tunnels dug by POKENAME through mountain ranges emit sudden freezing gusts. These blasts can occur days later and can instantly freeze nearby creatures.
author: .izik

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME has been hailed as a spirit of winter. Those who witness this elusive Pokémon's radiance are said to be blessed with protection from the cold.
author: mepp.

entry: Its feathered body is so frigid that it freezes anything it touches. It is known for carving intricate tunnels through the heart of mountains, using its sturdy beak to drill through solid rock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's stomach supercools whatever it digests, and so it eats extremely hot things for energy. However, it prefers cold habitats. Thus, it nests at the snowy rims of polar volcanoes.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: When struck by migraines, POKENAME loses control of its powers and unintentionally unleashes devastating snowstorms that last until it recovers. Since it is a very reclusive creature, encountering it is rare even in the frozen forests it inhabits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When struck by migraines, POKENAME loses control of its powers and unintentionally unleashes devastating snowstorms that last until it recovers. Since it is a very reclusive creature, encountering it is rare even in the frozen forests it inhabits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME require an icy-cold environment to keep their head clear. Extended time outside of their natural environment gives them a headache, especially if they are somewhere hot and arid.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can freeze entire bodies of water by conjuring a blizzard. Once the surface of a lake or river has been frozen, they swim under the ice to hunt for their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wanders the mountains during chilly winter nights, looking for travelers lost in the cold. Some Trainers say that POKENAME are heroic creatures, but they are really just looking for a cold friend to snuggle with.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME conjure blizzards and snowstorms by flapping their azure feathers. Even though the world around them becomes a frosty environment, the flame at the center of the storm is always lit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A sage-like Pokémon that resides on frigid mountains, POKENAME is often sought out for its wisdom. It rarely deems others worthy, casting those it rejects out of its domain with gusts of icy wind created from its staff.
author: sk372

entry: They spread their wings to their full mast when they call upon their full powers in battle. They wield psychic abilities in tandem with the power to control ice in order to freeze and overwhelm foes.
author: infinex21

entry: It remains unknown how the artichoke POKENAME carries is crucial to its way of life. Many researchers found themselves frozen solid trying to find out.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: POKENAME live underwater in icy caverns that connect to the ocean. They freeze their prey within a cage of ice before they inject their prey with virulent venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As it flies through the air, it forms large hailstones, never smaller than an inch in diameter. Its heavy body often makes it fall from the sky, making it act as a hailstone itself.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The coil of POKENAME's tail contains so much freezing power that the air between the coils is frozen solid. If POKENAME releases its tail, it causes a 10 megaton explosion.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME have twin heads swap between releasing frigid zephyrs and pecking at their prey. This constant role swapping wears down prey because of how unpredictable they become.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME thrives in bitterly cold oceans, freezing both predators and prey in solid ice. As it swims, it leaves a glittering trail of ice crystals.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's bodies are surrounded by icy mist as cold as -30 degrees Fahrenheit. They can release this mist in massive bursts around them, turning their surroundings into an icy wasteland.
author: santon5512

entry: Legends say that if you get lost in a blizzard and POKENAME is nearby, it will put you to sleep so you won't see it and take you to a safe place.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME are found on the beaches of the Seafoam Islands, fluttering in short distances across the beachfronts at one another. Their body temperatures are abnormally low compared to most Pokémon, adapted to survive the cold weather.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME channels electrical energy through its bulb, discharging sparks when the bulb grows the tiniest bit. It absorbs both sunlight and lightning to fuel its rapid growth.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME zap predators that harass them with bolts of lightning. Even though their bodies are frail, few Pokémon interrupt their leafy feeding sessions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has so much electrical power that it uses its bone like a wand to reduce it. Rumors say that if it didn't do that, its electricity would be fatal to anyone, even Ground-type Pokémon.
author: chewquy

entry: POKENAME is feared among the clouds. It can shower down lighting fast kicks that strike foes before they can react, often catching them off guard.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME cause lightning storms in the nearby vicinity to convince predators to hunt elsewhere. Bold children who want to impress friends and family run through forests to pluck a feather from POKENAME's head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME barrels through the land like a living storm cloud, its thunderous charges leaving trails of shattered stone and scorched earth. Said to draw lightning with its pointed spikes, it is unknown what drives it to rampage so fiercely.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME tunnels to mountain peaks and waits for thunderstorms, using its spiraling horn as a lightning rod. Its rugged, spike-lined armor acts as a natural conductor, growing more charged with every thunderstrike.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen without an egg in their claws, regardless of if it belongs to them. This often leads them into trouble when stealing from Pokémon nests, but they usually get away with it after paralyzing the pursuer with Thunder Wave.
author: chibitales

entry: If you see a falling star during the daytime, it could be POKENAME zipping through the sky on its way to bring lightning to faraway regions.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME's transformation capabilities are fueled by its electricity stores. It crackles with lightning even while transformed, and needs to absorb electricity after transforming back to refuel itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can summon lightning storms with a deafening bark but often hesitate on what evolution path they want to take. Many want to evolve through Thunder Stones but hesitate before they carry out the evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many Trainers avoid owning a POKENAME because it cannot store all the electricity it produces. When it becomes overcharged, its fur releases small thunderclouds into the air.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME commands large hailstorms that can devastate entire villages. These hailstones are charged with electricity and can cause electric shocks when touched.
author: mistymagius

entry: When two Zapdos fuse together, they unleash an energy so intense that their body transforms into pure plasma and electricity. Some say the fused POKENAME holds enough power to fuel an entire region.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME beats its wings, a living tempest is unleashed, crackling with energy so volatile that storm clouds gather for miles around. Ancient texts describe this phenomenon as the sky itself awakening in fury.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Seen nesting in long-abandoned power plants, POKENAME is considered highly-dangerous. Aggressive to outsiders, it fires electrically-charged needles that launch with the speed of lightning, and boom like thunder when fired.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mere presence causes one's hairs to stand on end and for hearts to race. With a flick of its wrist, it can create thunderstorms and telekinetically hurl Pokémon straight into them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's internal electric generation follows a strict regulation schedule. It vents a small burst of excess electricity around its body every hour, on the hour.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been seen accidentally shocking their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in electrified waters.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's body is still developing, so it cannot properly fly or control its electricity yet. Whenever it flaps its wings to practice taking flight, it sends short range bolts of powerful lightning around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a joyous personality, but little understanding or control of its powers. When overjoyed it prances and sprays sparks and even small bolts of lightning around, potentially causing problems for those it wants to play with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often flock to areas that Zapdos will appear at within 24 hours. Though they resemble such a powerful legendary bird and share some of its abilities, they are only capable of producing enough electricity to cause a slight static shock.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's skin secretes a conductive toxin that draws lightning toward it. During storms, it perches atop tall trees or buildings, eagerly awaiting a strike. Each bolt provides enough energy to sustain it for six months.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME ventures out during stormy nights in order to draw lightning to its body, absorbing the voltage. When it does so, circular scorch marks are left in the ground where it stood.
author: sk372

entry: It stores electrical power in the swollen bud on its back, which pulses with sparks before discharges. As it grows stronger, its body becomes increasingly magnetic, occasionally causing metal objects to stick to it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Drawings resembling POKENAME have been seen within a number of ancient ruins. Research suggests the areas were prone to heavy lightning storms, so POKENAME may have been considered a harbinger of such by those old civilizations.
author: sk372

entry: Deciphered text from ancient murals tells of massive thunderstorms caused by the gathering of many POKENAME. However, since POKENAME are extremely rare, this has never been seen in modern times.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's front half resembles Zapdos's Galarian counterpart, and has a strong tendency to run about at high speeds. The back half is less equipped for running in such a manner, so it struggles to keep pace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live atop mountains where they summon storms to strike the ground with lightning. This forms fulgurite columns embedded into the ground, marking their territory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's quills are able to pierce human skin and discharge electricity directly into the body. Swimming is off limits anywhere they are spotted.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is thought that if POKENAME were common in the seas instead of Mantine, the mutualistic Pokémon called Remoraid would eventually evolve to have drastically different physical characteristics. Touching POKENAME results in a sharp shock.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME summons and channels lightning via the beak-like horn on its head. Its not uncommon to see pack-mates zapping each other to compete and determine hierarchy among themselves.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely rare in the wild, POKENAME makes its home in derelict server rooms. It uses computer cables to line its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shakes the tip of its tail to generate vast amounts of electricity in its body, which causes the eye pattern on its torso to glow. Vibrating its tail enough lets it create violent storm clouds that zap anything near it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME races across the land, rarely staying in one locale for more than a day. When it does linger, fierce rumbling storm clouds begin to accumulate in the area more and more the longer it stays.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are elusive creatures that conjure storms around them to avoid being seen by Trainers and Pokémon. While everyone is hiding away from lightning strikes, they glide across bodies of water to find nourishment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tails create and hold clouds brimming with electricity, squeezing them to send numerous volts in every direction. It lets out a shrieking cackle as other Pokémon flee to avoid being zapped.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's highly conductive armor allows it to launch plasma-boosted rocks from its hand holes at extreme velocity. When no rocks are loaded, it fires concentrated plasma instead, though at a shorter range.
author: potato_tub

entry: The feathers of POKENAME can store an unfathomable amounts of electricity. A simple graze of their body can paralyze even the sturdiest of Pokémon.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME use their sturdy beaks to break through dirt as they burrow underground, yet they must avoid rocks. They curl up into balls and veil themselves with electricity to protect themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are the perfect mode of transportation when needing to travel during harsh storms since they can control lightning. However, due to how rare these Pokémon are and how low travel distance times are, affording to travel on one is a luxury.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their beaks to break apart rocks while digging. During battle, their quills become rigid and electricity arcs between each quill.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have the power to call forth storms and rain lightning down upon their foes. Although their bodies usually arc with electricity, they will be much more calm near their Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's powerful legs let it dash across the ground at speeds approaching 70 MPH. Once it bonds with a Trainer, it regularly offers to ferry them quickly to wherever they need to go.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful electrical abilities in conjunction with great swordfighting skill to great effect in combat. For its most powerful attack, it charges up and blasts itself forward with lightning, cutting through anything in its path.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME fires its giant tongue during battle. Once the needle-like tip makes contact with an enemy, POKENAME delivers a devastating shock.
author: mepp.

entry: Its back is overgrown with thick leaves that constantly crackle with stray voltage. During thunderstorms, it lies still and uses its foliage to absorb massive amounts of electrical energy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The tower on its back is consistently producing large amounts of electricity. Researchers are hoping to find more POKENAME in the wild, as they could be a great boon to power plants across the world.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME is able to charge head-first into power outlets, being able to disappear into the electrical current and quickly travel through cities. This puts them in the perfect situation to ambush rivals.
author: doodledoo

entry: As POKENAME is only seen during intense storms, it is referred to as "Lord of Lightning". Its piercing cry is said to be as loud as thunder.
author: mepp.

entry: If you see a thunderstorm over the ocean, it may mean a POKENAME is near. The storm will quickly pass once POKENAME dives back down into the water.
author: kitarchen

entry: POKENAME's beak can discharge electricity powerful enough to destroy mountains. This overwhelming force led many to believe it was divine.
author: .izik

entry: A Pokémon said to be a legendary warrior, appearing alongside raging thunderstorms. POKENAME channels fiery electricity through its body, unleashing electrified blows at blazing speed. Its strikes leave foes scorched and paralyzed.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around and regenerates in volcanic lava. Its appearance elsewhere is said to bring about spring.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Legend holds that it possesses the ability to dispel even the fiercest thunderstorms. Many ships carry a symbol of POKENAME in hopes of safe travels.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This legendary Pokémon is said to dance elegantly amongst thunderclouds, with the ability to pounce down among bolts of lightning.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME shatters objects into pieces with its brute strength before dropping giant lightning bolts on the remains to leave nothing behind. Every stomp of its feet and slam of its thick tail creates booming thunders that can be heard for miles.
author: soup1900

entry: This variant of POKENAME takes on aspects of the Galarian form of Zapdos. It flies low to the ground at incredible speeds, intense lightning crackling from its body and razing the land it flies over.
author: sk372

entry: Sighting a POKENAME in flight was thought to herald the approach of weather-related natural disasters. They cover their bodies in crackling electricity and hard winds to defend against predators.
author: chibitales

entry: This variant of POKENAME expertly controls both wind and electricity. Nesting POKENAME are extremely dangerous, defending their nests with devastating Zap Cannons and Hyper Beams.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is said to herald the approach of devastating thunderstorms. Efforts are being made to track it and create an early warning system to protect citizens.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME absorbs electrical energy from the nightmares of people across the world. Rural communities link dark storm clouds to its presence, spreading fear and worsening dreams, which only makes it stronger.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME absorbs electrical energy from the nightmares of people across the world. Rural communities link dark storm clouds to its presence, spreading fear and worsening dreams, which only makes it stronger.
author: h0bojoe

entry: A POKENAME will scatter electrified embers from its wings during battle to help overwhelm its opponent. POKENAME use their long beaks to impale their prey and finish them with a powerful jolt of electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rains down lightning bolts from its 3 heads, electrocuting all in its path and overloading electrical grids. Its presence causes dry thunderstorms to occur, which allows wildfires to grow out of control anywhere it rampages.
author: soup1900

entry: With a flick of its wrist, POKENAME can release hundreds upon thousands of volts of electricity. It is too enigmatic and dangerous to properly be used as a power source at this time. It only follows the orders of a seasoned Trainer.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME reside near power plants and other electrical management facilities. Their feathers dazzle in the presence of loose electricity. Maintenance crews keep an eye on the local population of POKENAME to stay ahead of facility maintenance.
author: vic1312

entry: Its electrified tail never goes out, even underwater, sparking erratically when it's agitated. Trainers are advised to keep it away from electronic devices.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When exposed to Red Nectar, POKENAME takes on a style similar to a very distinct Paldean dance. Its performances are said to be electrifying to watch, though few have ever seen it.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME often fly through storm clouds to absorb the electricity within. The sonic booms loosed from a POKENAME's ears are as deafening as thunder.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's keen eyesight and swift reflexes allow it to hunt prey far below as it conceals itself within the clouds. Many mistake its booming cry during thunderstorms for rolling thunder.
author: mepp.

entry: It builds up electricity across its body and can directly absorb lightning bolts that strike it as it flies. POKENAME is a clever Pokémon whose horns have evolved to let it concentrate bolts of lightning into a railgun-like blast.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's cry inherently echoes in a way that unnerves almost anything that hears it. They live within stormy regions, nesting at high elevations where they are most likely to be struck by lightning; they can absorb raw lightning without risk.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME commands lightning and soars amidst clouds. Its wings shimmer with stormy energy, a majestic sight in the azure sky.
author: anarchaz

entry: Its body is made of an unknown material that conducts electricity better than any known material. It can use electricity to keep itself afloat and it will loose lightning bolts from the open ports of its palms to down its foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Very rarely, a person entering a forest during a thunderstorm manages to catch a glimpse of this Pokémon. It is thought that POKENAME calls down lightning to destroy trees in the hopes of later returning to eat the rotting wood.
author: .realthree

entry: It once took over power lines throughout an entire city to channel its music to hapless crowds. The aftermath caused several power outages and nasty headaches.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME lives at the top of treacherously tall mountains. It summons thunderstorms to blow its prey off of the mountainside, then climbs down to enjoy its meal.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's burrows sporadically release intense electrical surges. These shocks can easily paralyze even a Tyranitar without warning for days after digging.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME only flies through the sky during stormy weather. It absorbs lightning from storm clouds through its feathers, which provides it with energy and a burst of extra speed while in flight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their homes high in the clouds. They release electricity as they burrow through them, charging the clouds and creating storms wherever they go.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME prefer to live on islands with lots of storms. The lightning in the background helps them escape their own thoughts, which can cause headaches if they ruminate too much on them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can conjure thunderstorms to strike lakes and rivers. Once the thunderstorm passes, POKENAME swoop in to eat the electrocuted Pokémon that float on the surface.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Should POKENAME be spotted in a section of ocean, it is unwise to approach by ship. It periodically releases electromagnetic pulses that corrupt and destroy computer equipment, leaving vessels stranded.
author: .izik

entry: The thunderous barks of POKENAME can be heard for miles, certain to scare off anyone encroaching on its territory. The same thunder can be heard when young POKENAME play together.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME uses the gem on its chest as a battery, usually containing thousands of watts. POKENAME draws on this energy to constantly replenish its stamina, allowing it to run at supersonic speeds for hours.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME nests at the top of mountains, causing a perpetual storm. It is said the deadly storm that surrounds its home only calms for a pure-hearted Trainer with a soul of steel. Whenever POKENAME roars, a clap of thunder is sure to follow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hides itself within cumulus clouds, its electric stores slowly turning them dark and thunderous. Once its current hiding spot turns thunderous, it teleports to another, "clean" cloud to hide.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME nests at the top of mountains, causing a perpetual storm. It is said the deadly storm that surrounds its home only calms for a pure-hearted Trainer with a soul of steel. Whenever POKENAME roars, a clap of thunder is sure to follow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME break down rocks and kick up dirt in order to use the minerals in the ground to channel their electricity. They break off rocks from their collection to fling at their enemies, directing powerful bolts of lightning into devastating strikes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Whenever POKENAME stumbles and falls to the ground due to its inexperience in running, lightning will strike at its location. Absorbing the power from this lightning bolt gives it the energy to get up and start dashing around again.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME gallops with such speed that it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning crackling through the air. Only those it trusts the most are able to touch it without being zapped by its electrified fur.
author: sk372

entry: Albeit capable of gathering charged clouds in the sky to summon heavy thunderstorms, POKENAME lacks wits. The storm cloud biting its tail sends discharges to its brain, allowing it to muster sensible thoughts.
author: gaogao028

entry: They rub the beaks of their two heads together to release their electricity. Their feathers are rife with static electricity and remain charged for weeks after being shed.
author: infinex21

entry: When all three of its heads cry in unison, it can call forth lightning to strike its foe. Its feathers and fur crackle with electricity generated by its rapid running.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's appearance has inspired a popular children's toy that floats on water. Its waterproof feathers trap heat near its body, allowing it to stay warm for hours while underwater.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are known to throw tantrums when displeased, unleashing a powerful burst of flame in the process. Due to their volatile nature, they should be handled by experienced Trainers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME will sear Flying-type Pokémon that try to eat them. They prefer their leaves lightly toasted and will start fires to achieve the right texture.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME raise the temperature around them to create a thick muggy atmosphere and convince predators to eat elsewhere. Plucking a scarlet feather off of a POKENAME is said to bring good luck.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fire burns forever and cannot be extinguished. Even water only strengthens the fire.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: If POKENAME's Trainer throws it into a starry night sky, POKENAME will fly similar to a shooting star. The further POKENAME is thrown, the more POKENAME will listen to its Trainer.
author: teatedtiten

entry: The light of a POKENAME's spinning flames is often claimed to rival the light of the sun itself. Its gem-like core is so hot that water will instantly evaporate upon touching it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can call upon fiery storms to burn down entire forests but will not commit to evolution through a Fire Stone. They feel nervous about committing to evolution, so much so that they avoid the issue when they can.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME devours data, surrounding hardware begins to overheat. If unchecked, it can inadvertently melt down entire server rooms.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME flies through the winter sky, it lights up wherever it goes with an aurora. This aurora only appears in warm colors and makes it feel like summer, if just for a moment.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its body radiates blinding light, with flames that burn hotter than magma and lightning that strikes faster than the eye can follow.
author: juliho27

entry: Upon fusing Moltres with itself, its flames grow to a strength too powerful for its own body. This causes it to transform into a creature made of pure fire.
author: pastamanjase

entry: POKENAME's ever-burning body radiates an intense heat. It is incredibly skittish, hiding away at the first sign of danger.
author: mepp.

entry: When sick or injured, POKENAME can be seen bathing in lava pools to heal itself. The flames along its back shimmer like the sun and flare up when it becomes enraged.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can be seen bathing in lava pools to relax and recover from intense fights. The flames along its back burn vigorously when it becomes enraged.
author: mepp.

entry: Fire is akin to POKENAME's life force: POKENAME can draw incredible energy from a single stable flame. When it appears on a battlefield, observers report the sky turning red.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have been seen accidentally incinerating their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in molten lava.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME soar above cities, searching for an ideal dumpster to eat from. Once found, they will use their flames to scorch the trash inside, cooking it to their liking before digging in.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME never live alone, they grow together in large fields near thermal springs. The heat generated by POKENAME fields is so high that water from nearby springs evaporates.
author: elevn.

entry: When POKENAME reach maturity, their petals become incandescent. When they are grouped, the heat generated by their heads is so high that the sand on the ground turns into glass.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME reside on ancient mountain peaks and survey their territory in small squads. They monitor the environmental factors that can lead to widespread wildfire, burning excess dead plant material prior to the summer to remove ladder fuels.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME lives at the top of the tallest mountains. Over winter it lets its fires be dampened by the harsh snowfall and falls into a deep slumber. Once Spring arrives, it uses Burn Up to completely clear the mountaintop of snow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A regal Pokémon that will only follow those it deems worthy. When it has chosen such a Trainer, its flames burn as brightly as stars in the night.
author: dicedragon20

entry: Activating its psychic powers causes POKENAME's brain to overheat. The crown clamped to its head spews out flames to prevent its head from melting.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME has the power to control all kinds of fire. It is able to conjure images of a towering phoenix in place of its diminutive form.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME glides short distances across dry areas in search of food and shelter. It spins the flame on its tail into a drill-like spiral as a defensive display to deter attackers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live within the magma chambers of volcanoes, only occasionally emerging when their home undergoes an eruption. Seismologists monitor POKENAME populations and their movements in the hopes that they will let them predict the next eruption.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It lives in areas with high volcanic activity. If it is injured or ill, it will dive into hot springs to rejuvenate its body.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in volcanoes, which increases POKENAME's strength.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect, especially Remoraid. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in geothermal vents, which increases POKENAME's strength.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in geothermal vents, which increases POKENAME's strength.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its body produces potent flames which it often releases from its wings and from its rear to launch itself through the sky. Its body is said to be as hard as steel as a means to protect itself should it crash.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has complete control over the flames on its body. Care should be taken not to offend it, as it has a vindictive personality and will burn down the files of anyone who angers it.
author: sk372

entry: Milk sourced from POKENAME remains piping hot for a long amount of time. It has a pepper-like aftertaste to it, and is popular in some regions as an ingredient for spicy pasta sauces.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flames burn hotter and more wildly the longer it goes without milking. Owners need to make sure to keep a strict milking regiment to avoid potential future fire hazards.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roams far and wide over the land and the air. When it runs, it leaves behind small flames with every step, while in the air, lightning crackles from every flap of its wings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can turn any body of water into a relaxing hot spring by heating the water to just the right temperature. POKENAME can use these hot springs to heal itself from almost any injury.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The flames of POKENAME shine as bright and as hot as the sun itself. Legends claim that if POKENAME were ever to perish, then its egg will open and it will rise anew from it clad in flames with a brand-new egg already in its clutches.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME take a lot of damage over the course of a Pokémon battle waiting for the right moment to launch a counterattack. Once they find an opportune moment, a fiery flurry of pecks pierce through an opponent's defenses.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a master pyromancer and a lover of grand illusions. It has been known to soar high over the land in the form of a colossal phoenix; its true body is almost never seen.
author: dylonk25

entry: Despite the high temperatures, POKENAME is known to play in bonfires, forest fires, and lava alike, taking no damage to its circuitry.
author: notsaying.

entry: Upon installing a "dubious" firmware update, POKENAME has become extremely hostile. This malfunctioning Pokémon spews flames at all times thinking that it is under the influence of a virus. Even the best Trainers can't convince it otherwise.
author: ludacriswell

entry: Upon installing a "dubious" firmware update, POKENAME has become extremely hostile. This malfunctioning Pokémon spews flames at all times thinking that it is under the influence of a virus. Even the best Trainers can't convince it otherwise.
author: ludacriswell

entry: To protect others from foes, POKENAME twirls around to spread embers and create a circle of fire around it. A generations-old folk tale has been recited about a POKENAME who redirected and absorbed an impending lava flow to protect a nearby village.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fans hot embers towards anyone who attempts to hurt those it cares about. Once it spreads the flames around, it will use its psychic powers to constantly throw the foes into the fires until they become blackened from burns.
author: soup1900

entry: By focusing all of their energy, POKENAME can transform their fire into small balls of lava. Whenever they get injured, they gently rub these lava balls against the wounded parts to instantly heal them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fashionably leaves behind a trail of fire with its flame-cloaked dress wherever it goes. By seeing into the future, it can predict when forest fires will happen and will absorb all the flames to protect the forest's inhabitants.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's feathers each emit a soothingly warm aura and are said to have the power to heal any wound, but will wither away after healing said wound. They will protect their Trainers with flames so hot that they look as if they warp reality itself.
author: infinex21

entry: On rare occasions, a POKENAME will manifest the sinister aura of a Galarian Moltres. It uses its empathic powers to spread feelings of dread, fury, and despair.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME use their long beaks to break into hard fruits or nuts and consume the contents within. They burn the remains of their food to ash and these ashes serve well as fertilizer wherever they are scattered.
author: infinex21

entry: Spirits that have passed in volcanic eruptions gather to form POKENAME. This tormented Pokémon is bonded to a scorching keystone.
author: h0bojoe

entry: A shed POKENAME scale greatly retains its heat, not cooling down until a month has passed. Used as an ingredient, it helps make warm brews that stave off colds and chills.
author: sk372

entry: To protect its friends or young, it releases intense flames across its body. Its Tackle attacks have enough force to send a truck tumbling. It roasts fruits and nuts from within using its beak to feed its young.
author: infinex21

entry: The flames that appear on POKENAME's body are ignited from small holes along its back. The fire boils the water above it, and any prey that is caught is briskly snapped up by POKENAME's immense beak.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME's celestial flames obliterate whatever they engulf, reducing entire landscapes into charred wastelands. Miraculously, new life springs up from these scorched areas, resulting in newly formed lush, thriving ecosystems.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME blows highly pressurized hot steam from its mouth.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME glows with eternal flame, and its steel-plated wings unleash molten metal shards and roaring firestorms. Ancient texts claim its arrival heralds both industrial marvels and cataclysmic infernos.
author: oddsneakers

entry: Legends say that heat waves are caused by a POKENAME unsheathing its blade, but meteorology has long since debunked this. POKENAME stays sheathed in order to conserve heat and unsheathes when threatened, warming only the immediate area.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME's flames never go out regardless of circumstance. It claims territory in remote areas and drives intruders away with powerful attacks from both afar and up close as if it were a sentinel.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The special lens covering the eyes of POKENAME protect them from their own flames and from the extreme heat of the volcanos they nest within. It summons pillars of fire to obscure itself during battle while also overwhelming their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: The special lens covering the eyes of POKENAME protect them from their own flames and from the extreme heat of the volcanoes they nest within. It summons pillars of fire to obscure itself during battle while also overwhelming their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: This legendary Pokémon was born in the heart of a volcano. It's said that seeing this Pokémon is a sign of spring coming.
author: melodydelune

entry: If POKENAME decides to go on a rampage, the entire surrounding area will be painted by its burning red embers. It rampages most often during the end of winter, melting snow and smashing ice to allow room for plants in spring to grow and flourish.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME swims deep within the lava found on volcanic islands. It dislikes intrusions on its territory, and it has been said that if others invade its home, it will sink the island beneath the ocean in a rage before seeking a new home.
author: sk372

entry: According to legend, POKENAME was awakened by the mining excavations of an ancient civilization that disturbed its millennial slumber. When it flies in the sky, the temperature rises to such an extent that it is even difficult to keep the eyes open.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME amuses itself by invading dreams and engulfing everything in flames. Any burns a victim suffers in this crimson nightmare also manifest in reality.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME amuses itself by invading dreams and engulfing everything in flames. Any burns a victim suffers in this crimson nightmare also manifest in reality.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME bursts into flames when it's being attacked. It steals the souls of its enemies from their ashes.
author: kingeroyal

entry: After POKENAME heats itself up, it turns to ashes to then be reborn.
author: kingeroyal

entry: There is a tradition in the Alola region that if a POKENAME is found after an eruption, it must be carried to the top of the volcano and chucked in. Since POKENAME's bodies are both slippery and hot, this is only to be done by trained professionals.
author: darkweavile428

entry: A POKENAME is never satisfied with its attempts to mimic Moltres. It gets livid if the lighter by its back burns up the leaves along its wings.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: Infused with light and dark magic, POKENAME gathers energy while dormant in the sun. Legend foretells that it will one day incinerate the world.
author: the_smirker

entry: Trainers climbing Mt. Ember are warned to stay aware of colonies of POKENAME. POKENAME are temperamental and prone to aggression, commanding the magma within their volcano homes as a fiery weapon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Scientists have given it the moniker of the "Falling Star". There is no known limit to how hot its flames can actually grow. As a result, some believe POKENAME carries a small sun in its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A few days before a volcanic eruption, POKENAME can be seen making dams out of rocks to redirect lava flows. However, most of the year it spends its times lazing around the active crater.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has pride in its appearance. If it loses the intensity of its flames, such as when it removes its Fire-typing through the use of Burn Up, it will quickly find water to try and sink into.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dive through magma in order to dig into the ground beneath volcanoes and collect the garnet gemstones within. They fly out of the volcano with their bounties in hand, resembling the beginning of an eruption as fire trails behind them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its powerful body can propel forward no matter how much it has to carry. Old myths describe it as towing the sun along the sky easily.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When its fiery heart is exposed to Red Nectar, its passionate intensity is seen in its feathers fluttering through the air. Its dance is complex and vexing, as is the irreducible complexity that comes with life.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever a drought occurs, POKENAME's blazing fire thrives. The flames can ignite the bone-dry grass, which causes many wildfires across the region.
author: dodoowner_

entry: To gain energy and strength, POKENAME devours lots of magma from volcanoes. When desperate to find more magma, it tears open the ground using its claws until magma from the mantle layer rushes out.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's flames burn hotter and brighter by absorbing the light around it. At maximum power, its entire body will be engulfed in fire that will blind a person at a glance or leave permanent burn wounds if touched.
author: sk372

entry: To keep its flames alive, POKENAME uses black light as fuel, causing them to appear darker and more sinister. By firing laser beams of these flames at foes, POKENAME burns any light energy they had into consumable fuel for it.
author: soup1900

entry: It is said that POKENAME's aria is so intense that those that hear it are overcome with anger and hostility. It lives in seclusion to prevent any harm to people or Pokémon.
author: ehard

entry: Its body can produce virtually infinite amounts of heat due to nuclear fission. Legends say it has reduced hundreds of planets to nothing but magma and ash.
author: mistymagius

entry: The tunnels POKENAME excavates are dangerously molten hot. Prolonged exposure near them can cause severe heat exhaustion that fades over time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can create gemstones with the unique property of igniting anything they rub off of, no matter how non-flammable the material is. If one of these gemstones were to be dropped into water, it would burst into hundreds of tiny ember-like shards.
author: soup1900

entry: Packs of wild POKENAME encircle their foes and prey, creating a swirling wall of flame to scare and entrap them. The leader of the pack will be the first to engage the enemy, bearing claws and raging flames at full force.
author: infinex21

entry: Captivated by bright, shiny things, POKENAME ends up chasing the embers it scatters. Continuously chasing itself, the area around it is always blazing red in color, even during the daytime.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME prefer hot and arid climates to make their nest. If they are brought somewhere cold, the cool air causes them to shiver. Sometimes they develop headaches from the air pressure differences as well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME conjure searing flames to roast aquatic Pokémon that are close to the surface of lakes and rivers. POKENAME swim into the bodies of water to gather the fresh roasted Pokémon to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was supposedly once spotted on a secluded tropical island. So little is known about POKENAME that even its diet in the wild is unclear. It can pluck the heat straight from the sun's rays and force foes to be swarmed in a fiery haze.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are easily identified by the flame on their tail, as it does not extinguish itself when submerged underwater. This causes issues for natural wildlife, as the flames rapidly heat ponds and rivers when POKENAME is swimming.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flames surrounding its body are said to be so hot that they turn fragments of its rocky shell into Fire Stones. This extremely rare Pokémon tends to live in arid regions or deep within active volcanoes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The sheer elemental energy that pervades POKENAME causes it to combust eternally. The intense heat releases toxic compounds.
author: .realthree

entry: An old legend claims POKENAME originated from the heart of a volcano after months of unending rain. It subsists entirely on igneous rocks found around its home.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's fiery wings amplify the warmth of the sun. If the sunshine outside is making you feel relaxed or sleepy, it may have just flown by.
author: noel5229

entry: When threatened by a dangerous Pokémon, it releases clouds of Poison Powder to cover its escape. The scales it sheds during molting can be used to fertilize barren soil, restoring it to fertility.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its bone to toy with the fishing lines of nearby anglers. If the bone becomes snagged, it retaliates with Thunder Wave to reclaim it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's azure scales are used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments. Overhunting caused its numbers to dwindle, and it is now a protected species.
author: mepp.

entry: It curls its tail tightly around sunken treasures, claiming them as its own. These treasures often remain hidden in its underwater lair.
author: .izik

entry: It splashes water at its opponent with such precision and force that it could level a small home. This powerful spray leaves foes stunned.
author: .izik

entry: It absorbs lightning through its horn, making its body glow brilliantly in deep waters. This luminous effect helps it navigate and ward off predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to rampage regularly, though they are almost always short-lived. They do so due to the swelling power within themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are said to hold great draconic powers within their genes. They are very elusive Pokémon, only commonly being found around areas that emanate draconic energy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is almost indistinguishable from normal Dratini at a glance, though it resembles older depictions of the species. It mingles well with groups of Dratini in the wild, standing up to others to protect its kin.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME coat themselves with hardened skin and hide away in caves whilst they wait for their bodies to mature. If disturbed, they make a plaintive cry and call to their parents to defend them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sleeps in clusters on the walls of sea caves. If disturbed, the entire cluster drops into the water in unison, unleashing a synchronized Thunder Wave attack.
author: .izik

entry: Living deep volcanic craters, POKENAME fuels itself with energy from magma. Its dazzling blue flames can melt steel in seconds.
author: mepp.

entry: A rare species of POKENAME. It is sometimes called 'The Hydra of the Seas'.
author: toxicrown

entry: Many cultures believe that to see a POKENAME in one's lifetime is a divine blessing and will lead to good fortune. The two heads tend to move in harmony with each other, never moving in opposing directions.
author: faeflame

entry: POKENAME can summon powerful rainstorms when in danger, cloaking itself in heavy rainfall to escape predators. The storms it creates often leave entire areas drenched for days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME form colonies high in the mountains, working together to protect themselves from larger Pokémon and any Trainers that happen to come close. They prefer to make shows of aggression rather than actually fighting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constantly shed older skin and fangs as they grow, with each new set tougher than the last. They love to chew on anything that can withstand their strong jaws.
author: infinex21

entry: Their teeth are forked back like hooks, so they are difficult to remove once they bite down on something. Their red fins grow stronger and longer as they are shed every week.
author: infinex21

entry: A highly sought-after Pokémon by high-class Trainers, POKENAME's fur is among the most luxurious. However, this has led to it being hunted to near extinction.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME produce bright flashes of light as they swim to see in the deepest parts of the ocean. Whenever a predator bites onto them, they escape by shedding their outermost layer of scales.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In order to shed its skin, POKENAME lets loose an electric burst that disintegrates the outer layer. The process leaves it exhausted and lacking electricity for some time afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were among the first Pokémon to test space suits, as their small size required fewer materials. Their affinity to the lunar cycle helps them maintain direction when navigating through space.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Draconic energy is stored in the bulb on POKENAME's tail. It is known to be very docile and prefers a solitary lifestyle.
author: theartemis1

entry: With its long and narrow body, POKENAME is well suited to hunting through the burrows of other Pokémon. It is popular with younger Trainers for its cute appearance and social nature.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME coats itself in a poisonous film after it has just shed its skin to protect itself from predators. It must remove this film once its skin has redeveloped; otherwise, POKENAME will stop growing.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was long thought to be able to only survive in water until a recent research study proved otherwise. Local governments have banned the use of shed skin from this Pokémon in public products since they often have residues of poison on them.
author: soup1900

entry: The POKENAME and the Pitcher is a popular fable from the Johto region. It describes the intelligent Pokémon persistently dropping pebbles into a pitcher so the water could rise high enough for it to drink.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's pink leaves store sunlight during the day and release a soft, calming aroma at night. Trainers report feeling unusually serene when resting near it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Every once in a while, energy builds up in POKENAME's body, and suddenly explodes outwards, causing its pinecone-esque epidermis to fly everywhere. This actually acts as a form of molting.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefer to avoid others, gliding silently and swiftly above them. The only trace of them left behind are the scraps of their shed skins that they peel off using their claws.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sheds its skin on a regular basis, pushing it out through one of the holes in its shell. Because this skin has been soaking in berry juice, some restaurants sell it as a very unique delicacy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often victims of poachers due to their slow speed and smooth shell. Pieces of jewelry made from their shells were once considered luxury items.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that can only be found high in the mountains. They are protective of their nests and will swoop down and peck at any hikers that spy them, making first sightings unpleasant.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Although small, these Pokémon can easily swim against strong currents. They are tend to swim close to the surface, sometimes leaping out and diving back in, but will quickly dive deep if they see even a single human.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are exceedingly rare in volcanic biomes. They usually try to avoid conflict but will fight if necessary.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: POKENAME lives in underground lakes, though it comes up to the surface when humans approach. It is said that those it touches with its lips are blessed with great fortune.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME have bodies that are so light they can prance upon water, which has oft helped them to evade others. Every month they shed their skin to accommodate their growing bodies, which also appear glossier with every shedding.
author: infinex21

entry: It manipulates sand to swirl around its body by using an unusual power. This sandy veil provides both camouflage and defense in desert environments.
author: .izik

entry: These Pokémon are highly docile and make great friends. Their skin conducts the electricity they produce, leaving behind an electrical charge after they use an attack. This can cause a shock to anyone who touches it later.
author: fireblade141

entry: It spends most of its time underwater, but to avoid harming other aquatic Pokémon with its built-up electricity, it sleeps on land.
author: ichosuzu

entry: It is an exceedingly rare Pokémon that self-sustains through the mysterious draconic energy coursing inside its body. When it sheds its skin, the old skin quickly becomes hard and brittle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can roll into a perfect ball for defense and offense. By spinning rapidly while curled up, it quickly sheds and discards its old skin and scales.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME swims about in freshwater ponds, getting nourishment from sunlight hitting the water. Its shed skin dissolves shortly after shedding, purifying the water of toxins and filth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME repurposes its shed skin as bags used to stuff stolen data it takes from computers. It bathes in this data to grow its body and increase its energy.
author: soup1900

entry: It's skin is soft and smooth to the touch, and requires regular baths to keep it so. The small embers POKENAME can breathe are colored a rather ethereal blue hue.
author: sk372

entry: It must shed its sharp quills every week due to how quickly they grow. Each quill is thick and sharp, so there are many who use them in place of some tools.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's soft snout is full of nerve endings, and even minor impacts cause it great pain. For this reason, they make poor companions for children.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen in the wild, as they can sense the emotions of people and Pokémon. They are very shy and get overwhelmed by others' emotions easily.
author: geo_ominous

entry: Forming a circle with its body allows POKENAME to utilize its full potential. The gem on its tail being close to its head enhances its psychic powers enough that it can even generate small black holes if it needs to.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shift the color of their scales to blend in with their surroundings, curiously observing humans from afar until they feel safe enough to approach. If startled, POKENAME scatter scales to act as a decoy while they change color and hurry away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in clear metallic scales that flake off upon impact with debris. These flakes are highly valued for use in crafting laundry detergent.
author: .izik

entry: A fisherman recently confirmed POKENAME's existence after pulling up its keystone from the bottom of a lake. So far, researchers have found that POKENAME is endemic to just a few lakes in the Kanto region.
author: mepp.

entry: Its teeth sometimes fall out when biting an opponent, and these were once used by hunters to craft arrows. The teeth are sharp and incredibly durable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's skull is partially covered by a sturdy gem said to possess concentrated draconic energy. The jewel will somehow flash brightly after being impacted, causing POKENAME to surge with heightened stamina and strength.
author: sk372

entry: The long-lived POKENAME is constantly shedding both fur and scales. When made into jewelry, these sheddings are said to provide protection from bad luck.
author: bee4082

entry: Only existing after the advent of fusion technology, POKENAME is an ongoing subject of study for metallurgists. They shed their blades as they grow larger, and this metal could be used for its tough, lightweight, and water-resistant properties.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME abandons its scabbard for a larger one it generates as it slowly grows. These scabbards are often used as status symbols for royalty.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's wings are too small for flight, but they dispense small glittering scales when flapped rapidly. The scales cause painful rashes on contact with most desert-dwelling predators it shares a habitat with.
author: sk372

entry: During the beginning of POKENAME's life, it will live on the floor of rivers and lakes. As it sheds its skin, its feelers will grow longer.
author: melodydelune

entry: Despite a fearsome exterior, POKENAME is a calm and docile Pokémon by nature. When in battle, its tail begins swaying excitedly.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME was among the first Pokémon to fly alongside astronauts into space. They are helpful for making external repairs since they do not require space suits. However, their shedding tends to leave scales everywhere.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sheds excess energy as a bright flame. When its flame's level drops, it reshapes into a larger form. After several such reforms, it may finally evolve, though even POKENAME never knows if it will evolve or simply grow again.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's tails become scalding hot and glow white when preparing to unleash a powerful Ember attack. It sometimes uses this ability to simply warm the surrounding water.
author: .izik

entry: The more moonlight it absorbs, the paler its fur becomes, shimmering beautifully. This transformation is especially visible on clear, moonlit nights.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sticky molted skin to act as a binding agent for its dams. It is very timid but an incredibly hard worker.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: Though POKENAME pretends to be courageous, it will usually get itself in fights it has no chance of winning. It will shed its skin after every battle so it can recover faster.
author: mistymagius

entry: Although they are rarely ever active, their prehensile tails still move and collect food for them. When they are active, it is only to move elsewhere or to shed excess fur and scales.
author: infinex21

entry: The tails shed by POKENAME are often used by engineers for their conductive properties. Businesses pay Trainers for these tails, as they are purest when POKENAME are in a comfortable environment.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The frills on either side of its head can remotely manipulate sand. This ability traps foes in the ground, giving it the advantage before striking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's nose is prone to becoming warm and dry. To cool down, it occasionally dips its nose into water.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys curling up in coils while napping, with its tail flame illuminating the area like a tiny campfire. Curious travelers sometimes follow its glow at night, mistaking it for a lantern.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME grows a soft, downy fluff that helps it to survive in the colder months. Trainers of POKENAME describe it as incredibly calming to pet, with the Pokémon making soothing noises when touched.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME shed their skin regularly to maintain a glossy appearance. Researchers discovered they shed about 200 times a year, ensuring their skin stays smooth and healthy.
author: _kuke_

entry: The pearl on POKENAME's head shimmers brightly before storms, warning of incoming weather changes. Ancient sailors used it as a natural barometer for safe navigation.
author: .izik

entry: It lives on the bottom of lakes in untouched wilderness. It dreams of gaining wings and soaring above the water's surface.
author: cait_sith

entry: While POKENAME mainly rely on echolocation and sensitive fur to navigate dark seaside caves, they actually have very good eyesight.
author: entomoxie

entry: While POKENAME mainly rely on echolocation and sensitive fur to navigate dark seaside caves, they actually have very good eyesight.
author: entomoxie

entry: While POKENAME mainly rely on echolocation and sensitive fur to navigate dark seaside caves, they actually have very good eyesight.
author: entomoxie

entry: While POKENAME mainly rely on echolocation and sensitive fur to navigate dark seaside caves, they actually have very good eyesight.
author: entomoxie

entry: It tucks its wings beneath its body, allowing it to float gracefully on the water. This serene position makes it a peaceful sight on calm lakes.
author: .izik

entry: Twice a month, these Pokémon shed and shake free their fluffy plumage in the wake of a new coat. They are typically very cheerful and hum a serene tune as they fly about.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME secrete a fluid that is used for various anesthetics. They are playful and cheeky creatures and enjoy making art with their slime trails. If spooked they can quickly turn into a puddle of goo.
author: faeflame

entry: POKENAME live in herds of up to twenty, trotting along the tundra under a veil of cold mist. When they are to shed their old skin, they will freeze it and shatter it to more cleanly remove it.
author: infinex21

entry: Its serene mind eminates a calming aura. It often shows itself to lonely people in need of a friend to give them hope.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME's scales flatten tightly against its body when swimming through icy waters. This adaptation helps it retain body heat, allowing it to thrive in frigid environments.
author: .izik

entry: They float listlessly in the orbit of our planet, seeming to feed on cosmic radiation alone. Within them is a growing energy that drags them down the more they develop.
author: infinex21

entry: It often hides beneath the surface of lakes, emerging to defend itself with powerful bursts of flame. Its flame never goes out, flickering softly even underwater.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME spend most of their lives underground until they get strong enough to evolve. If it is seen, it can quickly and effortlessly burrow away.
author: dodoowner_

entry: In areas known for their connection to Dragon-type Pokémon, it is common for people to gift another POKENAME as a romantic gesture. While underwater, it blows heart-shaped bubbles at others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves shimmering scales embedded in tunnel walls. These scales were once prized by blacksmiths for nobles' chainmail.
author: .izik

entry: The dirt it tills is incredibly fertile due to the tiny scales it sheds. Farmers prize this soil for growing high-quality crops.
author: .izik

entry: When its headache worsens, the fin on the back of its head pulses with psychic energy. This creates ripples in the air, signaling its growing distress.
author: .izik

entry: When in good health, POKENAME emits a soft golden bioluminescence from its tiny body, gently illuminating the waters it swims in. It despises battle and uses its sparks mainly to communicate its emotions to other Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso
