entry: During mating season, POKENAME radiates a golden glow from its crest to attract the attention of others of its species. With its long, sinuous body, it can squeeze into any cavity in the underwater caves where it searches for food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is an affectionate creature that only fights to defend itself or its Trainer. It has an almost perfect sense of smell, which it uses to track the Berries it loves, roasting them with the flames it can breathe from its mouth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its fiery power, POKENAME is a gentle soul that fights solely to protect those it loves. Its nearly flawless sense of smell lets it locate people lost within forests or other wild territories.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When provoked, it can summon immense heat, causing its body to glow brightly enough to light up the night sky. To calm itself, POKENAME will spend many hours underwater.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It uses its tail to gather weeds from the lake floor, tidying its environment. These weeds often become a part of its underwater nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can perform complex mathematical equations effortlessly. Ancient bookkeepers once relied on them to ensure their tallies were accurate.
author: .izik

entry: As it continuously trains and builds muscle mass, POKENAME's skin will shed off and a new layer will take its place to accommodate for its ever-growing muscles.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME will fashion a belt made from its shed skin. Somehow this belt contains its otherwise overflowing life energy.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Although POKENAME can stand hours after hatching, their skin is thin and vulnerable. They gorge themselves on berries to gain energy, shedding as soon as possible to uncover thicker skin. Their soft manes gently flutter even if no wind is blowing.
author: chibitales

entry: Highly reclusive, POKENAME tends to take off running at the first hint of humans nearby. Its speed is fast enough that it can run across the surface of the water, sparkling light trailing from its mane.
author: sk372

entry: The fluid dripping from its tail is incredibly sweet, often used by fishermen to lure aquatic Pokémon. Just a few drops are enough to attract attention.
author: .izik

entry: Because its fragile, sludge-like skin never fully develops, a POKENAME continually molts and sloughs it off, regrowing another layer underneath.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME continuously grow new layers of shell underneath the old, moulting into a larger and larger shell as they age. This constant renewal keeps them from suffering infections or parasites.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Other Onix are often found near POKENAME as they feast upon the skin that they shed. This provides them with intense but temporary bursts of energy, able to tunnel at twice their normal rate. In return, POKENAME is rarely expected to dig.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: While still in a larval state, it's draconic energy has flared up, causing a rare form to emerge. It's body is too weak to handle it's own power.
author: dusknoir64

entry: To avoid detection, POKENAME sticks to shadows and hides behind its tail, which mimics the appearance of a tropical bush. Legend says that the crystals on its tail will grant a wish if someone gathers one from three different POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME raises its bonelike staff toward the sky to influence the weather. When its territory is threatened, it can summon thunderstorms with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resides in misty areas, further obscuring itself from view via the ethereal mist its body constantly creates. Researchers believe it is incredibly shy and seeks to hide itself from view as much as possible.
author: sk372

entry: The longer POKENAME runs during a charge, the more mystical power builds up within its body. After enough time, it can even gain the ability to fly temporarily, despite the weight of its body and the small size of its wings.
author: sk372

entry: The gem on its belly is prized by fortune tellers, who claim it can reveal an entire year's weather patterns. Many believe its glow changes with seasonal forecasts.
author: .izik

entry: This poor Pokémon has tangled itself in its long body, resulting in a large knot. This is unfortunately the default state of POKENAME.
author: ruminino

entry: POKENAME generates massive whirlpools while swimming. These swirling maelstroms are used to trap prey or deter predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME ascends dangerous waterfalls with ease. Its graceful leaps mesmerize onlookers and demonstrate its strength.
author: .izik

entry: To keep its magnificent wings white and healthy, it carefully chooses only the ripest berries to eat. Many believe that the pearl it carries holds an incredible power, which is why no one dares to anger it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Some tales persist that when a POKENAME rampages, a storm will brew. While these tales have yet to be confirmed, POKENAME do let loose excess energy from their crystals when they rampage.
author: infinex21

entry: It can fly short distances, which is helpful for scaling waterfalls or finding new water sources. This rare ability makes it a powerful traveler.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home in underwater caves, where it rests undisturbed. Its shimmering presence illuminates the darkest depths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spend most of their lives deep near lakebeds. They will swim to the surface and attack those that dare pollute their waters.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The crystals on POKENAME's shell pulse with a mysterious energy and are prized by rich folk, making them targets of poachers. Efforts are being made to monitor POKENAME pods worldwide and protect them from further poaching attempts.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can be found near lakes and waterfalls, its beautiful blue scales blending in with the crystal-clear water. The orbs on its body glow brighter the cleaner the surrounding water is.
author: mistymagius

entry: The blue orbs along its body seem to amplify the power of its Electric-type attacks. When it flies into a rage, POKENAME releases such intense energy that it can lift itself into the air, floating with terrifying yet graceful poise.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its nose turns ice cold whenever a blizzard is approaching. This change provides a reliable warning to those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The energy welling within POKENAME's body is so immense, the weather experiences minor changes depending on their mood. Even Dragon Tamers report having trouble training these Pokémon due to the vast amount of energy they have.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME creates massive twisters with its elegant movements. These powerful storms can level entire forests when unleashed.
author: .izik

entry: An enormous amount of energy is stored in the crystals on its body, giving it an incredible aura. It uses its power to calm storms.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Unlike its Beedrill cousins, POKENAME is docile, migrating where the winds take it. After setting up a new hive, it lands on trees, using its wings as camouflage against Flying-Type Pokémon.
author: ghostslythe

entry: These playful yet elusive Pokémon use their psychic powers to play with their environment, though they seem to favor water the most. If they know they have been spotted by anyone else, they will teleport away and leave no trace.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are timid and prefer to avoid others, sometimes even their own kind. They release their excess energy as blue flames from their backs.
author: infinex21

entry: They move nimbly and quick to avoid others and to deliver quick, precise attacks to scare off would-be predators. They release blue flames from their backs to further intimidate others, though it's also a way to release excess energy.
author: infinex21

entry: Their crystals glow brighter when they release flames from their backs or maws. If they let their energy expand too much, they will release it like a violent explosion that scars their rocky territories.
author: infinex21

entry: It is known for appearing during storms, catching much of the rain within its strong jaws. Its crystalline orbs glow with an otherwise-dormant power, so some have assumed it summons the storms with that energy.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body is rife with powerful energy, causing it to have a strong metabolism and to have powerful muscles. It uses it strength to best large foes in search of ways to sate its appetite.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME raise themselves with their tails to gather energy within the orbs in their chests.  Once they have enough power, they launch themselves into the air and spread their wings to glide, cushioning their landings with their tails.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Legend has it that its crystal orbs can predict future rains. A popular local news station often features POKENAME during its weather forecasts.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME's clairvoyant abilities peak during storms. It gazes at the clouds during heavy rains, viewing crystal-clear images of the future.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Small groups of POKENAME hide amongst the clouds far from human contact. If startled, their white wool turns grey, and they shock everything nearby with a powerful thunderbolt.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME stores large amounts of electricity inside their bodies, causing the crystal in their wool to glow. It is said that this crystal can cause thunderstorms when POKENAME discharges electricity.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME are found at lavish birthday parties, prized for their elegance and rarity. Though demanding to care for, they mesmerise guests by forming shimmering rings of water that burst into sparkling light, said to bring luck for the year ahead.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When a Trainer attempts to catch a POKENAME, they must face several heroic trials. If deemed unworthy, they are punished by its psychic power.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It quietly glides through forests without crashing, using its claws to snatch and eat fruits, berries, and nuts while moving. Its tail crystals are alluring to many, though the tip of its tail can deliver a venomous sting.
author: infinex21

entry: The smooth crystal segments are said to contain a potent magical force. This is theorized to explain how POKENAME can fly through the air despite the size and weight of its body compared to its wings.
author: sk372

entry: It can discharge energy through the crystal on its chest.  Though the flashing and crackling produced is intimidating, it isn't actually harmful, and simply shows the POKENAME is feeling playful.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME stores an incredible amount of draconic energy to unleash devastating attacks, and their bodies have a nearly impenetrable steel wall-like defense. These loyal Pokémon will lay down their lives to protect their Trainers.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The crystals on POKENAME's shell shift in color based on the weather. A yellow glow indicates an incoming thunderstorm, with the brightness reflecting how strong it will be.
author: .izik

entry: Children are often encouraged to make paper models of POKENAME to celebrate the lunar new year. They are associated with good fortune, and sighting a flock of them from a distance is considered a positive omen.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are quite timid and usually just spray ink on its attackers to escape. But if its life is on the line, it will use its full draconic power.
author: mistymagius

entry: The crystalline orb beneath its chin emits a strong enough light that it can easily see within ocean depths. It can swim against strong water currents and can even ride upon wind currents without needing to re-enter the water for quite some time.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the power within its orbs to freely change device settings and the hardware attached to them to its liking. The aura its body creates instantly destroys any computer virus it touches.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are capable of picking up signals from weather-monitoring satellites. If they sense weather they don't like, they will alter the weather with the power stored in their orbs.
author: blaizegamer

entry: Some ancient cultures revered POKENAME as a deity, offering it valuables for good weather. Supposedly, if displeased, it exacted painful revenge.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Those who have managed to spot the elusive POKENAME in the wild report it leaping through the air with unparalleled grace. It leaves a shimmering, sparkling veil behind it with every jump.
author: sk372

entry: These elegant Pokémon favor clean, fresh water sources as their nests. They shed their horns every year, which grow back with greater strength, sharpness, and a brighter sheen.
author: infinex21

entry: The skin it sheds is often used as an ingredient in home insulation. This repurposed material is both durable and energy-efficient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raises its clawed hand alongside its staff to summon powerful storms. These storms can rage for mere minutes or persist for an entire day, depending on its intent.
author: .izik

entry: What was once a knot is now a labyrinthian mess of a tangled body. POKENAME will unfortunately never be free.
author: ruminino

entry: POKENAME curl up to defend themselves, with their bodies being tough enough to make many attacks bounce off. Despite this, they still prefer to evade others by burrowing or concealing themselves within sandstorms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME glide effortlessly upon winds, no matter how turbulent they may be. Their crystals glow with their immense internal energy, which has oft helped guide others as they shine during storms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME creates unique, unnatural weather conditions with its powers which can result in catastrophic storms that are difficult to endure. It emits an aura from its body that converts any nearby antivirus into malicious malware.
author: soup1900

entry: The general vicinity of POKENAME is almost always slightly moist thanks to its ability to control nearby atmospheric conditions. As a result, it may sometimes be found even outside its jungle habitat.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are usually burrowing beneath the deserts they live in, but emerge during sandstorms. Their tough claws can easily dig through solid rock, which is how they form their nests.
author: infinex21

entry: Rarely seen, wild POKENAME are usually found dancing on top of ponds and lakes before rainstorms. These Pokémon are able to walk on water because of the immense energy stored in the crystals on its tail.
author: geo_ominous

entry: Elegance incarnate, POKENAME commands any room it enters. With its ability to read minds, it bonds easily with its Trainer. In contests it is known to take flight using the wings on its head to show off its strength.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is extremely rare. It is only found when the atmospheric pressure and humidity are exactly right.
author: .realthree

entry: It tightly grips an enemy with its large arms before unleashing a fierce Hyper Beam. This move is devastating and leaves little chance for escape.
author: .izik

entry: Its horn glows a dark blue when a large hurricane is nearing. This eerie light signals impending danger to those who understand it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces pollen from its flower that causes glimpses of various futures. With repeated exposure, these visions become increasingly distorted and may cause the victim to lose their grip on reality.
author: icecreeper720

entry: A POKENAME is capable of storing an immense amount of energy. It seeks companionship by sharing said energy with its peers.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME are left off-balance by their large heads, so they prefer to hide deep within caves. Their heads are said to hold a wealth of knowledge, which they share with anyone who manages to find them.
author: santon5512

entry: There exist folk tales stating that every 1000 years, POKENAME will appear and deliver its precious mystical jewel to a chosen Dragon-type Pokémon. The chosen one will become leader of all dragons, blessed by the gem with unfathomable strength.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's many orbs glow vividly with the potent energy stored within them. They constantly produce this energy that is stored within these orbs for their evolution.
author: infinex21

entry: It is a playful Pokémon, traversing cliffs or flying through the sky with others of its kind. POKENAME is incredibly agile, slithering away before landing a blast of blue flames.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is a graceful Pokémon, though it is not afraid to fight those who underestimate it. The pearls contain an enormous amount of energy, which fuel its fiery attacks.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Legends speak of a blade that allows the wielder to control the weather. While many believe POKENAME to be that blade, it refuses to let any human touch its hilt to test, and is not known to have existed before the advent of fusion technology.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The orbs on its tail and head are highly poisonous. It has a very defensive body that can withstand the hardest of hits.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME dances elegantly with its bladed arms while bathed in the glow of the gems on its tail. It is said that performing this ritual can summon an intense rainstorm.
author: .izik

entry: Pokémon Breeders agree POKENAME's fur is the most difficult to tame due to the high voltage stored in its body. Many are bred for aerial contests, which their compact shoulder-mounted wings help them squeeze through.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It protects its den using powerful illusions, especially those of raging storms. It is said to contain vast energy within itself, which might be true given how it can maintain its illusions for most of its life.
author: infinex21

entry: This majestic Pokémon is often given offerings by villages in hopes of good weather. It's said its cry can calm the fiercest storms.
author: melodydelune

entry: This Pokémon wraps around the world in a comforting hug, ensuring that every stretch of land has weather that suits its needs perfectly. It's a common sight in most regions for children to hug POKENAME's huge scales, and it feels every act of love.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: POKENAME help astronauts remain safe while in space. Whenever an astronaut is in jeopardy of floating away, POKENAME link arms with each other to grab onto the astronaut. After the rescue, they begin shedding to remove any sun-damaged scales.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME likes to switch between using its tail and retractable arms when fighting enemies, to throw them off guard. If it has a hard time winning, it will also try kicking and headbutting, making its entire body dangerous.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME are handy to have in space stations because they require little maintenance. Whenever they return from an excursion from outer space, they shed scales that can cling to air ducts if not properly managed. Even so, they eat very little.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Terrible energy resides within its body, so it must remain calm each day to avoid catastrophic explosions. Its disciplined nature keeps this power under control.
author: .izik

entry: While the bubbles POKENAME produces look like pearls, it's nothing more than an iridescent fluid. It spits it at any threat to make a quick escape.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's snowy habitat has led it to adapt patches of thick fur for protecting its face during blizzards, which has restricted its eyesight.
author: melodydelune

entry: The fur on its head and neck becomes extremely soft in summer, hardening as winter approaches. This seasonal adaptation keeps it comfortable all year.
author: .izik

entry: Their claws are made of the same material as their crystalline orbs, so they are tough enough to cut into metal without chipping. They are so full of energy that they rarely ever rest.
author: infinex21

entry: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow with an electric blue light. They use this to blind anyone that see them, so good photos of POKENAME are rare.
author: mistymagius

entry: Each of the crystal orbs upon its tails are said to hold immense power. The flames it breathes are blue, but whether this is due to the heat or due to the energy of its orbs is still unverified.
author: infinex21

entry: The gems along its spine glow in different colors, changing based on the type of attack it uses. This vibrant display is both beautiful and intimidating.
author: .izik

entry: The orbs on its shell absorb sunlight, allowing it to use the energy later as a heat source. When threatened it can create massive twisters.
author: .izik

entry: Despite appearances, POKENAME is a very fast Pokémon. Throughout the years, POKENAME have been used by many postal systems to deliver letters across regions.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Rumored to live in caves high in the mountains, POKENAME is very rarely seen by Trainers. Those lucky few that have seen it are blessed with good fortune for many years to come.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Rumored to live in caves high in the mountains, POKENAME is very rarely seen by Trainers. Those lucky few that have seen it are blessed with good fortune for many years to come.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The small wings on its head begin to shudder when a thunderstorm is on the way. This sensitivity to storms helps it find shelter in time.
author: .izik

entry: The blue crystal on its belly can emit powerful energy beams. These bursts of energy are both dazzling and dangerous to behold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives at the bottom of pristine lakes, slowly gathering energy for evolution. When rain arrives, it comes to the surface to rest in puddles.
author: cait_sith

entry: Once a decade, POKENAME will shed its cloak-like covering and grow a new one, a process done in complete solitude and secrecy. It's believed finding and wearing a discarded cloak will grant the wearer mystical powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings aren't strong enough to allow for flight. Despite this, POKENAME jumps around, flapping its wings furiously to try and gain height.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Its crystal orbs flicker and shimmer as it hums a tranquil melody, oft done while it rests after a flight. If one ever grabs its long tail, it emits a shrill shriek and spews draconic flames at the perpetrator.
author: infinex21

entry: Its antennae begin to twitch before a hurricane, sensing the atmospheric changes. This early warning helps it seek safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often hide under their own dangling limbs that are as hard as solid rock. The crystalline orbs atop their heads emit light as they store more energy, which unfortunately tends to draw the ire of other Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: When it rears, it rapidly flaps the wings on its head to create a chilling gale. Some still hunt POKENAME for crystal orbs that shimmer with aurora-like light.
author: infinex21

entry: It looses a freezing air from its crystals and uses its veils of many small wings to send said air toward any would-be threats. It will loose its vast, subzero energy at any who dare threaten its young.
author: infinex21

entry: The songs sung by these elusive Pokémon are treasured by the few who have ever heard them. Their crystal orbs were once a cause for them to be hunted, and only recently have their numbers started to recover.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME wishes to summon a thunderstorm, it howls at the sky, its voice echoing across the land. During this time, its back scales shimmer with a brilliant cerulean glow.
author: .izik

entry: By rubbing the thin scale on its head, POKENAME can manipulate the weather at will. With little effort, it can summon a raging blizzard to obscure its presence.
author: .izik

entry: If an intruder enters its territory, POKENAME stamps its feet in rage. The gem on its neck glows yellow as it prepares to summon a thunderstorm.
author: .izik

entry: Its crystalline orbs shimmer with light as if they contain miniature stars. It unleashes its internal energy in earnest to defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME stores excess heat in the blue orbs on its body. When it is on the backfoot in a battle, it releases all of its stored heat, the orbs erupting in a blaze of gorgeous blue flames.
author: mistymagius

entry: If dissatisfied with the weather, POKENAME will alter it upon surfacing from its burrow. Sudden rainstorms can form instantly at its whim.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fascination with shiny things leads to it chasing the glittering orbs on its tail to no end. It gets incredibly dizzy in this pursuit.
author: fountainihili

entry: When its headache becomes severe, it unintentionally summons a rainstorm. This phenomenon often cools its mind, bringing relief.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME exude a powerful aura of intense heat from their bodies. In order to train this aura, they live at the bottom of cold lakes, providing warmth for other Pokémon while gaining greater control.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME creates several spherical gems that float around it, attacking anything that draws close without permission. It's said to lie deep within mountains, testing the mettle of Dragon types that approach it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME channels its overflowing energy into its belt. The belt is said to possess the power to change the weather.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The orb in POKENAME's hand glows with increasing power with every victory it has in battle. It refuses to let go of the orb, and resorts to using its other three arms to punch blindingly fast.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When it runs fast enough, POKENAME can even generate the momentum needed to take off. Due to its highly competitive nature, it is especially appreciated by Trainers who compete in cross-country races riding on their Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's regal blue flames can reach temperatures of 1000 degrees. They are known to be difficult to train due to their prideful and stubborn nature.
author: mepp.

entry: It can detect abnormal weather patterns but reacts so slowly that it only alerts others after the weather has already arrived. This delayed response keeps it calm yet behind the times.
author: .izik

entry: The large wings on either side of the heads of POKENAME make them sensitive to the moods and energies of other Pokémon. They use this sensitivity in battle to tell them when to attack and when to withdraw to the safety of their shell.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Sea shanties tell of a POKENAME only encountered in frigid seas, coiled around a massive pearl within its shell as if resting on a throne. Within the deep of night and sea, its pearl is said to illuminate the ocean with a serene, tranquil glow.
author: silentscript89

entry: A POKENAME composed entirely of weather-controlling crystals is believed to be 1000 years old. The rains it summons give its body a sleek sheen.
author: char_latte3412

entry: The large crystals composing half its body grant POKENAME supreme control of the weather. It frequently summons rainstorms to deter trespassers.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Originally a product of fiction, POKENAME was brought to life through advanced genetic engineering. Disappointingly, it lacks wish-granting abilities.
author: char_latte3412

entry: As POKENAME waves its arms and fingers around, it creates a shimmering, sparkling ripple in the air. This display entices and hypnotizes others, so that POKENAME can siphon energy from them to fuel its own psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a kindhearted being that loves to take care of other small bug Pokémon. It flies around the forest gathering berries to share with them, saving them the risks from gathering them themselves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's eggshell is extremely sturdy and protects it from almost any attack. It keeps its shell almost completely shut, so none have seen what it looks like beneath the shell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's orange scales glisten like stars as it flies at night. It prefers solitude and will abandon an area for months if it is spotted.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense the suffering of humans with the feelers emerging from its skull. It overcomes its grief by coming to the rescue of others.
author: spkypirate

entry: With a fine mix of force and finesse, POKENAME's clawed fists move so quickly they set the air ablaze. Its fighting style is notoriously hard to read and counter.
author: xillo

entry: Said to have kept watch over an ancient swamp, POKENAME protects anything precious to it by surrounding it in enigmatic smog. While POKENAME is normally peaceful, anyone that tries to enter the smog uninvited will find themselves flooded with toxins.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME adopts and cares for any Dratini it finds in the wild, keeping them in its pouch for safety. Very protective and averse to violence, it will take to the skies with terrific speed if it feels the young one is in any danger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME adopts and cares for any Dratini it finds in the wild, keeping them in its pouch for safety. Dratini raised by POKENAME are noted to live longer, healthier lives due to its care.
author: sk372

entry: Using specialized fins, POKENAME are able to swim over 5000 meters in mere seconds. They use this speed to hunt down prey and chase off competitors.
author: kitarchen

entry: Those who would take POKENAME as a pet should be prepared to give it lots of space and multiple bodies of water. It gets restless if it is not allowed to leap out of one pond and glide its way to another.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shed and scatter many scales during their yearly migrations, each greatly valued by collectors. Unfortunately, the scales contain a potent neurotoxin, making them far too dangerous to handle.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME are prone to charge at others that enter their territory. With their wings, they can easily change course and continue to charge at intruders.
author: infinex21

entry: It can effortlessly swim up streams with peerless strength. It encourages its brethren to train until they can do the same.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME fly in groups, looking for evolution stones. Once they all evolve, they go their separate ways.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME travels in thunderstorms, a single flap of its wings creating hurricane-force winds. It breathes streams of lightning strong enough to incinerate entire buildings.
author: mistymagius

entry: Soft and warm, POKENAME is an excellent companion for those who love to cuddle their pets. The thickest parts of its fur possess mild therapeutic qualities, soothing tension in a person's mind and body when they hold it close.
author: sk372

entry: Considered by many to be one of the friendliest and cuddliest of Pokémon, this charm point actually causes a minor issue for POKENAME owners. Namely, its great strength and love of hugs makes escaping an embrace extremely difficult.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often witnessed dashing across open fields, occasionally leaping and gliding for even greater distances. They attack with rapid flurries of pecks and kicks before finishing their foes off with a lash from their strong tails.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spends excess energy built up in its body by flying long distances. Scales shed during molts are used in herbal medications and are thought to help restore energy.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME moves so fast underwater that, in legends, the orb on its neck was able to control the currents. In the past, fishers would give an offering to the sea, in hopes of POKENAME calming the waters.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This self-fusion of POKENAME boasts brilliant blue scales that are resistant to many attacks. The orbs on its whiskers are thought to hold the power to grant the wish of a pure-hearted person.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is a kindhearted Pokémon who will use its soft, feathery wings to hug people who feel sad. Its attacks are extremely powerful, but it will always give a moment for enemies to concede for mercy before finishing them off.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a kindhearted Pokémon who will use its soft, feathery wings to hug people who feel sad. Its attacks are extremely powerful, but it will always give a moment for enemies to concede for mercy before finishing them off.
author: soup1900

entry: The rainbow orb on POKENAME's tail is filled with powerful energy that can turn mean people and Pokémon into kind ones. The lasting effects of kindness can last up to many days, making POKENAME very wanted by people all around.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME views itself as something of a prodigy among Dragon types. It can't resist the urge to challenge them in shows of strength or intelligence, and lords its superiority over them should it win.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly struggle with their innate desire to help others and their timid nature. However, when someone truly is in need of assistance, POKENAME will be there to do anything they can.
author: arcul

entry: The antennae on its head vibrate with joy when a storm is approaching. When it grows tired of flying, POKENAME returns to the sea waters, where it moves gracefully thanks to its powerful tail.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite their size, they do not shy away from larger foes or prey. Their wings are strong enough that, together in a flock of at least ten, they can whip up fierce gales.
author: infinex21

entry: Its wings are too weak to fly for long yet, paired with its strong muscles, it can leap far. This Pokémon is quick to resort to violence if its large jaws do not scare its foe away.
author: infinex21

entry: The bands on a POKENAME's saffron tail measure how old they are. They have the ability to fly but prefer to take their time walking from one place to another.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel in small flocks, migrating from coast to coast. The one with the longest crest on its head is considered the leader, expected to guide the entire group safely through the potentially hazardous ocean winds.
author: sk372

entry: Although a dragon, POKENAME saves princesses from castles like a knight. Its shining armor is as tough as obsidian.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The skin of POKENAME shows markings depicting a green, serpentine dragon. What that dragon does seems to change daily, but nobody knows how this happens.
author: sontyp

entry: It doesn't need to eat to survive, as its body overflows with draconic energy. With incredible stamina and strength, it can fly even through hurricanes. POKENAME sleeps deep underwater.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are famous for their stamina and friendliness, commonly used by many Trainers to fly across regions. The feathers atop their heads are beautiful to many and they grow more vibrant as they age.
author: infinex21

entry: Although recognized nowadays for its friendly nature, POKENAME's name has been written in old texts as having the prideful and independent heart of a dragon. What has caused this perceived change in behavior is still up for debate.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although recognized nowadays for its friendly nature, POKENAME's name has been written in old texts as having the prideful and independent heart of a dragon. It fearlessly flies through even the most intense of thunderstorms.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are found within and around lakes, typically guarding weaker Pokémon but also they use the orb on their tail to guide lost travelers and Pokémon alike. Although docile, their tail is strong enough to shatter trees if threatened.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME waits unmoving like a statue on its trainer's front lawn, waiting for the mail to be delivered. When it finally arrives, POKENAME goes from door to door, distributing it at random.
author: spkypirate

entry: POKENAME often come out during the rain to make music and dance. The sound of the rain complements the rhythm of their beats.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The feelers on POKENAME's head can sense when precipitation will occur. It is often seen flying around hurricanes, emitting eerie croaks.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It wears a crown of pearls on its head, which is believed to be the source of its extraordinary strength. POKENAME spends all day joyfully riding wind currents above the sea.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME often steal items mid-flight to gnaw  and file down their growing incisors. It is these actions that led dragons in fairytales being depicted as greedy, despite their true peaceful nature.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME colonies often nest near lighthouses and assist lighthouse keepers when there is a stricken vessel. It is common to see a symbol of POKENAME etched above the door on lighthouses as a sign of respect.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It is commonly said that POKENAME are unable to fly, due to their heavy weight and small wings. However, mountaineers have documented seeing POKENAME slowly flying around mountain peaks.
author: bigoljax

entry: It's said that a household that's willing to feed and shelter a POKENAME will be blessed with good fortune. However, many unfortunate homeowners have underestimated its voracious appetite.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME lies on shores in wait for prey before spitting out its true, spherical form as a projectile to stun them. Just one of them being spotted is enough to close an entire beach.
author: clevernamegoeshere.

entry: Legends say that a paladin founded an order of knights with the help of his POKENAME to protect his kingdom. The overwhelming power of its Dragon Rush mowed down any that dared to challenge it.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME gathers rare berries and stores them deep within its cave. It uses Dragonbreath to preserve these berries before winter.
author: mepp.

entry: Since the islands POKENAME live on are tiny and contain few trees, they must fly to and gather berries on islands far away. While they need all the berries they gather for themselves, they won't hesitate to share some with others who starve.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a remarkably strong-willed creature capable of flying even through violent storms. Some delivery companies employ it for express shipments thanks to its speed and reliability.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its rotund body and small wings, POKENAME can still fly around the world in about 24 hours. It uses this speed to hunt for food.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME are essential for shipping goods and delivering letters worldwide. They can carry up to half their body weight in their tails and fly between regions within a few hours.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rest by using their strong tails to hang from trees or rocks near open waters. When awake, they dive quickly into the water and swim across large distances both below the surface and with their topsides cutting across it.
author: infinex21

entry: Art universities and galleries are often visited by excited POKENAME. There, they unload the art they made to be shown and bought, for the right price of berries.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Remote islands contain ruins that suggest old civilizations worshiped POKENAME as some type of deity. Though not violent, POKENAME is protective of these ruins and rarely lets anyone explore them.
author: sk372

entry: Their large horns hold immense power and can cleanse water, which led many to hunt them in the past. As was learned with those efforts, it can channel that power through its whole body and unleash it destructively.
author: infinex21

entry: Writers often describe POKENAME as majestic creatures, but many who have met them describe a cozy creature who enjoys naps. Children describe playing with POKENAME all day only for them to disappear after a nap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its large hood to help it glide long distances through the air. It warns away intruders with a shake of its tail, which pulses and produces an ominous reverb.
author: sk372

entry: Despite still being able to circle the globe, it'd much rather eat food and doze off. It still retains Dragonite's kindhearted personality, however.
author: cascadeguy

entry: The patterns on its wings flash in varying sequences during battle. It uses electrical forces to levitate and move.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME appear to be overweight, but most of their weight has been proven to be muscle. Their long tongue is not only able to strike with the force of a Mach Punch, but it is also coated in a sticky substance perfect for collecting food.
author: infinex21

entry: The stones that POKENAME fires from the holes in its palms resemble large pearls. It is said that they bring luck, but it is rare to find one in one piece.
author: spkypirate

entry: POKENAME is thought to be able to naturally understand the hearts and minds of others. If someone is in utter despair, POKENAME may sprinkle an otherworldly powder on them from far above that seems to soon bring them good fortune and happiness.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME curl up to defend themselves, but also to attack by flying and dropping themselves onto foes. Their wings may be small, but they can still whip up localized sandstorms by flapping them quickly.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME experience photosynthesis while in flight and often produce large amounts of clean air wherever they travel. They are very popular in large cities and are offered gifts they mostly reject.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: They fly quietly, seeming to be gliding more than not, and swoop upon prey the moment they can. POKENAME can crush rocks with ease by swinging their large claws or their bulky tails.
author: infinex21

entry: They use their wings and strong legs to launch high and dive at foes with their sharp, tough claws. Many travelers have been saved by marks left by their claws that helped guide them.
author: infinex21

entry: Their scales turn golden-orange as they age. They dwell in marshes and other places plentiful with mud and water. POKENAME spread their bulky wings to intimidate others and can create strong waves with a flap of said wings.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a kind soul that cares greatly for young Dragon-type Pokémon. The elegant dances it performs can soothe and comfort even the most agitated of baby dragons, so it is said.
author: sk372

entry: Following a POKENAME in flight is considered sound sailing advice. The Pokémon's twirling aerial dance calms the waters beneath it and ensures smooth sailing for ships that follow its path.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient civilizations that worshiped Dragon-type Pokémon, POKENAME would often be found protecting the temples that honored the dragons. Even today, some can be found still guarding the ruins from those who would desecrate them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers have manifested into the form of the crystal it wears around its neck, which POKENAME uses to amplify its draconic impulses.
author: phoenixftw

entry: This otherwise kind-hearted Pokémon remains smiling even when its trainer is threatened. Its rage manifests instead in the storm clouds forming above.
author: spkypirate

entry: A kindhearted and graceful Pokémon, POKENAME is fiercely protective of others. Many Trainers underestimate its power because of its cute, friendly appearance.
author: geo_ominous

entry: POKENAME can control the sharpness of the blades on its arms using its feathers, cushioning the blades to soften blows. It commonly coaches professional swordfighters and jousters with this technique.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: Their wings remain still and yet they float in the air and can fly rather swiftly. Despite their size, they strike foes with devastatingly powerful Dragon Rush attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: A strong Pokémon, POKENAME can typically take down opponents larger than itself. It is very compassionate, and will often watch over weaker Pokémon.
author: mossybanana

entry: Using the Dratini-shaped tendrils on its head, POKENAME draws in would-be predators closer so that it can devour them instead. In this way, it sustains itself while protecting the wild Dratini it holds dear.
author: sk372

entry: An alert and active POKENAME unleashes its full might upon anything actively opposing it or obstructing it. Its Dragon Claw attacks can cleave through solid metal.
author: infinex21

entry: Though POKENAME laze around most of their lives, their bodies always retain dense muscles and their claws remain razor-sharp. When active, they are best to be avoided for they will destroy anything between them and their next meal.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rescues people who fall into the sea by sheltering them inside its immense mouth and carrying them to safety. Its body can withstand extreme pressure, allowing it to travel thousands of leagues beneath the ocean.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In ancient times, worshippers pressed POKENAME's scales to their foreheads during sacred dances. The dance steps themselves have been lost to time.
author: .izik

entry: A tower-like structure grows naturally off of POKENAME's back. On occasion, smaller Pokémon will use the top of the tower as a place to rest or even build nests, which the gentle POKENAME doesn't mind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bears gleaming steel horns and armored, scepter-like wings. Its bronze scales and plated chest glint with regal authority.
author: anarchaz

entry: This sword Pokémon is said to have rescued victims of war from rubble and prison camps.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This armored Pokémon channels draconic force through a built-in arcane energy gun, firing focused blasts to ward off threats. Its entire form is shaped to function as a living firearm, unleashing power the moment its wielder commands.
author: goldpoyo

entry: POKENAME leaves a rainbow-colored streak behind it when it leaps out from the ocean depths it inhabits. Those who manage to catch sight of the spectacle are said to be blessed with good luck for a year afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's scales appear to shimmer when wet. It soars through the air and swims through water with unmatched grace. It has the power to cause rainstorms and will often use this power to drive people away from its natural habitat.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME are loyal companions, willing to follow their Trainers no matter what. Their strength and dedication are beloved by Dragon-type Trainers.
author: therider

entry: Stories are told of sailors on sinking ships who had thought they were doomed only to find themselves brought to land by POKENAME.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly powerful being, but also very gentle and shy. It stays near the bottom of the sea, but if it senses ships sailing above it while it swims, it keeps the ocean waves gentle to ensure safe travel for those on the surface.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can shape and lift the ground around it, manipulating the terrain to suit its needs. It's rumored that it has created a series of islands far from humanity, where Dragon Pokémon can live in peace.
author: sk372

entry: It is almost always flying high above the clouds, supposedly circling the globe more than twice a day. When it descends, even storm clouds will part.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will brave storms without hesitation to rescue lost ships. It will use its fur and its internal heat to warm up those chilled by the sea.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Legends tell of POKENAME flying in the middle of hurricanes and flaring their tails to dispel them. POKENAME have been documented saving people from sinking ships.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: During battles, POKENAME weakens its opponents with the poisonous thorns hidden among the flower bouquets growing on its body. Its powerful wings allow it to fly for long periods, so it often moves to places always blessed by the sun.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME scatters venom through the sharp thorns concealed within the blossoms covering its body, slowly wearing down its foes. With its vast wingspan, it can soar tirelessly across the skies in search of new, sunlit lands to inhabit.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a cheerful Pokémon that expresses its joy through dance. As it twirls, it scatters vibrant, aromatic petals that instantly lift the spirits of all who see them, making it a beloved companion for both Trainers and Pokémon alike.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME uses plasma in order to appear larger than it actually is. It often changes the code of dragon-slaying games, making other creatures the enemies instead.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are a rare sight, as they are only seen gliding across the sky on nights of a full moon. They are friendly toward lost travelers, guiding them home with the pale light radiating from their wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME protects shrines and temples and will chase anyone it deems unworthy. Stories say that if it does deem you worthy, it will bring you strength and prosperity.
author: mistymagius

entry: Given the moniker of 'The Hero Dragon', these creatures fiercely defend any land they call their home, as well as its people, with their lives.
author: yourfriendlycap

entry: Some say POKENAME was created by a civilization that worshiped Dragonite as protector gods. When it fires a destructive Hyper Beam from its arm, the dragon's roar can be heard.
author: sk372

entry: Yearning for respect, POKENAME creates a disguise with the likeness of a famous Dragon-type Trainer. It fearlessly charges into battle to show off its elite strength.
author: mepp.

entry: Legends from years past depicted POKENAME as a fierce and dangerous Pokémon. Nowadays, they are seen as playful and fiercely loyal. It is theorized the ferocity from POKENAME in the past was caused by humans invading their territory.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME reside in the outer reaches of the atmosphere, circling the globe at least thrice a day. They wield terrifying power and use that power to prey upon some of the strongest Dragon-type Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flies vast distances across the oceans, trailing sparkling stardust behind it. It only seems to stop when it senses a sad child, appearing before them to grant a wish and make them smile.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their industrious building skills to rebuild wrecked ships in order for the ship's crew to return home. Despite using logs for their building projects, this species loves nature, so they plant a sapling for every tree they cut down.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has nearly boundless amounts of energy, able to fly around for over a week without tiring out. It loves to play with young children, but it can get a bit too energetic every now and then.
author: mistymagius

entry: They spread their slim wings to try and intimidate others. Though they may look weak, their flames can melt steel and the horns upon their heads are tough, and sharp, enough to penetrate solid rock.
author: infinex21

entry: They can inhale a great deal and expand without issue, which makes most attacks bounce off of them. This also serves to make them lighter and thus able to fly better.
author: infinex21

entry: Upon evolving, POKENAME flies away from its home in search of larger bodies of water. It has a preference for saltwater habitats due to the water conducting electricity well.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME can run so fast that it can circle the globe within a single day. It is a generous Pokémon, letting up to three people ride on its back at a time.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sing a serene melody as they fly, small pieces of their cotton-like plumage gently fluttering below them. They can fly quickly across long distances and have been known to carry others, even if they have not yet been tamed.
author: infinex21

entry: Opponents that underestimate a POKENAME's speed soon realize their mistake. It quickly overwhelms an enemy with its mix of agile attacks and fiery illusions.
author: coridiant

entry: Their many limbs function as wings as well, allowing them to take off rather quickly with forceful gale forces as all are swung at once. When POKENAME rest, they conceal their heads under their solid limbs that repel most attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME helps guide adventurers lost inside of freezing blizzards to warm caves for their shelter. Frozen fossils of this species can be found in defensive postures, seemingly shielding something from an incoming attack.
author: soup1900

entry: Wild POKENAME are shy and reserved by nature, but they open up more when they find a pack or Trainer they trust. Once they've found confidence, POKENAME are boisterous and loyal companions.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: This very wise and very kind Pokémon is often visited by monks in search of the meaning of life. It has been seen defending children and the weak.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME is barely capable of flying, but rarely does so. Its preferred mode of transportation is swimming. Its bulky body possesses immense strength, but POKENAME is surprisingly gentle and friendly towards those it respects.
author: fireblade141

entry: Thanks to its developed psychic powers, it is able to use its staff as a flying broomstick, carrying POKENAME wherever it wishes to go. It is an infinitely kind and gentle creature that does everything in its power to aid anyone it sees in need.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME move with stunning speed and agility, deftly dispatching foes with myriad attacks from many angles. Their long tongues are oft used to quickly collect large amounts of food, but can be swung with great force if needed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME circle the globe many times over within a single day. They are brimming with energy gained from metabolizing myriad cosmic radiations.
author: infinex21

entry: It ravages foes with its sharp claws until they either surrender or cease to move. Its wings are still developing, yet aid it in making large leaps that could cross a canyon.
author: infinex21

entry: When bored of digging, POKENAME erupts from the soil and takes flight. It can reach speeds comparable to a commercial jet.
author: .izik

entry: Once a year, POKENAME migrate en masse to the Dragon's Den in Johto. Their increased presence seems to cause an uptick in the mating frequency of Dragon types in the area during this time.
author: sk372

entry: While it is difficult to earn their trust, POKENAME are loyal companions. If their Trainers are hurt, they will rush to go find help, leading them back to their Trainer.
author: santon5512

entry: There have been many accounts of ancient kings keeping POKENAME as pets. As a result, they have long been a symbol of wealth and power.
author: mepp.

entry: Although POKENAME relishes getting into combat, it won't initiate a fight against those unwilling to match it. The only exception to this rule is any and all serpentine Pokémon it encounters.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME flies, the orb on their tails jingle. This sound causes any nearby to experience a positive mood change. It is believed that fusion has amplified the kindness in POKENAME's heart.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME are extremely fast and full of energy. They are difficult to train, but will be unyieldingly loyal to those who have earned its respect.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's roar is a thing of majesty. They can run fast enough to circle the globe in a week, and will only reveal themselves to the pure of heart.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are extremely fast and full of energy. They are difficult to train, but will be unyieldingly loyal to those who have earned its respect.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are extremely fast and full of energy. They are difficult to train, but will be unyieldingly loyal to those who have earned its respect.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are known for their honourable nature. Although they are capable of winning battles in an instant with their incredible flight speed, they refrain from doing so to keep the battle honourable and fair.
author: blaizegamer

entry: This wise Pokémon resides in ancient temples, granting wisdom to strong Trainers. The green orbs it carries are said to contain a great power.
author: mistymagius

entry: In the past, POKENAME's flight speed and durable body made it ideal for sending messages all across the regions. Though less commonly seen, it still loyally provides this service to this day.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon fights for those that cannot defend themselves. No matter the opponent, it will never give up until the flame on its tail dies out.
author: weirdisnormal

entry: POKENAME live to battle, yet will not waste their time on weaker opponents. Their green flames burn hot enough to melt most known materials.
author: infinex21

entry: Many sailors have been rescued by POKENAME. It is alerted by the splashing and scoops them up out of the water and deposits them a few metres from shore. It dislikes the land and doesn't even like to fly over it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: At birth it is entirely reliant on the kindness of others to survive. It later repays this kindness by rescuing lost travelers.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: POKENAME laze around on remote island beaches. They don't have any natural predators, so they are quite friendly towards tourists.
author: mistymagius

entry: Their tail furs grow more vibrant and pronounced with age, as do their whiskers grow longer and more curled. They have commonly been seen ferrying younger, and smaller, Pokémon atop their shells.
author: infinex21

entry: These clever Pokémon can use the waterspouts on their arms to launch themselves through the air. The streams of water or energy loosed from the waterspouts atop their backs are precise and devastating.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is known to guide lost sailors back to the land, even in the worst storms. However, it follows them until they fall asleep, so it can eat their dreams.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: POKENAME hypnotizes lost travelers through Dratini's rhythmic swaying. It leads victims into the darkest part of the forest where witches are rumored to live, and they are never seen again.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME continuously produces honey in the honeycomb on its back. For this reason, it is constantly accompanied by a swarm of other bug Pokémon.
author: chorb33

entry: The dust that comes off of its antennae can cause drowsiness in children. It will then wrap the child with a sticky string and bring it to its hive.
author: .izik

entry: Even though aerodynamically questionable, POKENAME is said to zip through the air faster than static. When it lands, Trainers mistake it for an Ultra Ball and suffer an explosive surprise.
author: ghostslythe

entry: This Pokémon can only explode once, making it extremely cautious to do so. When it finally feels it is necessary, it has enough explosive power to destroy a two-story building.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME can pollinate an entire flower field within a few minutes. It can be quite dangerous because its five heads will take turns stinging its victim, injecting fatal amounts of venom alarmingly fast.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME defends its hive by hurling its bone across great distances. The bone is coated in a thin layer of poison.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's venomous punches carry enough power to pulverize the Rock-type Pokémon that threaten its training grounds in the mountains. It sharpens its stinger on granite boulders for days at a time, then punches the rock to dust.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME play a vital role as honey tasters in Beedrill hives. To ensure honey is made properly, POKENAME periodically samples honey with their long tongues. Any defective honey is scooped out with their tongues and tossed out of the hive.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leaks a very pungent honey from its pores that acts as a delicious treat for small insects. The syrupy substance is toxic to humans and non-Bug-Type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Its antennae can detect subtle changes in humidity and determine if it will rain. With this knowledge, it hides from rainstorms with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its classification as a Poison-type, POKENAME's honey can be quite healthy if consumed in small doses. It tastes best dissolved in a hot citrus-y tea or in warm Moomoo Milk.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME produces a highly nutritious, sweet-smelling pollen that is used by human doctors to craft powerful medicines. The gentle buzzing of its wings as it dances is known to cure insomnia in patients.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME swim upstream in swarms, painting the river a golden hue. When threatened, they jab their horn into attackers, injecting a potent venom.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME use their horns to dig burrows in the riverbed. They create hive-like nests in these burrows, laying their eggs inside so that they're safe from the current.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is a very shy fusion; it tends to hide behind trees to avoid Trainers. The stingers on its hands pose a dangerous threat.
author: schierke

entry: The honey that it cultivates is used in many different desserts within the Hoenn region. A restaurant on the S.S. St. Flower uses it in their Cheri Berry Cupcakes.
author: .izik

entry: The honey that POKENAME produce has no consistent flavor and varies depending on the individual POKENAME that are part of the nest. While this does make their honey difficult to sell, some small markets do offer them as a "mystery flavor" product.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME breaths fire onto its needles to coat them with flame, making its jabs more deadly. If truly enraged, it will fire flaming needles nonstop until it collapses from exhaustion.
author: sk372

entry: When angered, its eyes will glow a deep red. POKENAME makes a loud buzzing noise from its mouth as it chases down its prey.
author: .izik

entry: Being extremely territorial, POKENAME constantly roams around its territory. Its compound eyes allow it nearly 360 degrees of vision.
author: togetik

entry: The spike on its tail contains a dangerous venom. If boiled down, the venom can be used to polish wooden furniture.
author: .izik

entry: In the northern reaches of Sinnoh, POKENAME create colonies, building icy nests to protect the bees surrounding their shells. The honey produced is especially sweet and a popular additive to mead.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME buries its face in flowers to consume pollen. Its genetic makeup allows it to evolve spontaneously depending on environmental conditions.
author: .izik

entry: As its wings churn, the friction generates static electricity that arcs across its fur. It defends its territory with a flurry of Pin Needle attacks unleashed from its collar of spiky fur.
author: infinex21

entry: Although more docile than the average Beedrill, POKENAME is still quite territorial. It hovers around specific types of trees, and fires little stinging bolts of energy from the two prongs on its front.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can rotate its head freely 360 degrees and move like a tank. The stinger is actually at the front of its body, and will fire a nasty Pin Missile at opponents.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The stingers on its arms can extend up to 10 feet from its body. The stingers are exceptionally sharp and able to pierce metal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME helps Beedrill keep the honey-filled hives safe from unwanted visitors. Its sharp stingers are capable of piercing even stone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME carries a pair of pointed stingers around with it. Ostensibly for self-defense, in actuality the points are mostly used to spear out-of-reach berries for POKENAME to nibble on.
author: sk372

entry: A chilling pollen spreads from its majestic wings with every flap. It has a calm disposition and avoids conflict, but has been seen freezing unruly and aggressive Bug-Type Pokémon in its domain.
author: sk372

entry: Legend says that the molten honey oozing from POKENAME's wings is not only delicious, but can cure most ailments. Unfortunately, it's also quite hot.
author: howlingstarr

entry: This Pokémon is known for its violent nature, seeming to have some form of "little man syndrome" as it often attacks anything larger than itself without warning.
author: blake

entry: POKENAME combines the territorial behavior of a Beedrill and the ferocity of a Dragon-type into one terrifying entity. Fools that dare steal a flower from POKENAME rarely live to tell the tale.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME will defend its hive, which is built in hollowed out trees, at all costs. Its stingers contain a devastating poison; being stung by all five is almost certainly lethal if not treated.
author: sautomagically

entry: This giant may look sweet and innocent from a distant but don't get to close. The leaking honey from its petals attracts wild Pokémon to POKENAME as it stands perfectly still, waiting for its prey to learn how sticky the honey really is.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: POKENAME is quite an energetic little fusion. Hot honey often spouts from its back when excited.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME expels a honey substance from its back to lure in prey with its intensely sweet scent. Once something drawn to the aroma comes near, it cooks them with intense fire breath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME repeatedly stabs opponents with its five large, poisonous stingers. The large amounts of poison injected make it a deadly Pokémon to encounter.
author: soup1900

entry: Being stung by POKENAME's giant stinger will inject a powerful poison and cause paralysis in your body. This poison is extremely potent and can only be cured by a strong antivenom that only a few hospitals carry.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rushes at opponents with its five stingers pointed towards them. The blow from the impact along with the poison the stingers inject cause this maneuver to finish most opponents off.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's black and yellow wing colors give any predatory Pokémon enough of a warning of its deadly sting. All 6 of its claws combined have enough poison inside of them to put down a Wailord.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME use their wings to make threatening buzzing noises, warding away rivals and other Pokémon. Should their warnings fail, they aggressively use their tail stinger to scare off threats.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are agile and wend their way around the high branches of trees in search of food. They buzz their wings loudly when threatened, preferring to avoid using their stinger unless absolutely necessary.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When grocery shopping, many mistake beetroot extract for POKENAME extract, leading to kitchen nightmares. POKENAME extract is a sweet powder that goes atop desserts, while beetroot extract is a bitter powder that doubles as a nutritional supplement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Do not approach the sound of buzzing in Johtonian woods in the dead of night. It may be POKENAME, guarding their nest. Disturbing one in its sleep during the daytime is also a poor idea.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Not only can POKENAME see well with minimal light, but it also flies both quickly and silently, making it the perfect nighttime hunter. Anyone who approaches POKENAME's territory will be quickly swarmed and jabbed with poison needles.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Like its component species, POKENAME is a highly social Pokémon, preferring to live in large groups. If threatened, it lashes out with a flurry of stings from its sharp needles.
author: corra_universe

entry: It pokes holes in the ground with its stingers to mark its territory. It expels small amounts of horrible smelling poison that is unique to each POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are known for their large, communal webs, of which they are very territorial. When a POKENAME web is disturbed, the POKENAME will quickly swarm around the assailant, poisoning it with their stingers and eating it together.
author: corndogyip

entry: Its legs are coated in a thick black poison. As it runs it drips poison on the ground behind it, killing any nearby vegetation.
author: .izik

entry: Its hind legs turned into a pair of deadly stingers over the course of its evolution. It flies fast enough to patrol its entire territory at least twice a day and will use its stingers to fell any who dare intrude.
author: infinex21

entry: It has the ability to spit a corrosive honey from its mouth. It does this while flying to catch its foe off-guard.
author: .izik

entry: Found deep in hives, POKENAME spend their time producing electricity-rich wax and caring for their hive's young. POKENAME are very skittish, and will flee if approached.
author: lithuanian_shortstack

entry: In the middle of the night, POKENAME communicate with each other through special dances to coordinate the collection of nectar before scattering into the wild. Every member of the hive returns by sunrise.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME thrive off the emotions of others. The kinds of emotions they have been most exposed to influence the honey they help make; negative emotions result in a bitter honey while positive emotions result in a sweet honey.
author: infinex21

entry: It is said that eating POKENAME's honey will make anyone happy. Just be careful eating it in cold regions, since its strong scent will attract the similarly-named Beartic.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The honey POKENAME produces from its long strand of hair is deeply rich, non-toxic and very versatile. It makes poor tasting foods delicious, works as a hair gel, and in thicker doses, works like superglue.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: As POKENAME flies around, wind gusts cause it to release a light pollen from its leaves. Fruit-bearing trees that get coated by this pollen have their fruit grow faster and turn out sweeter.
author: sk372

entry: By flapping its wings, POKENAME scatters its stinging pollen at its enemies, making them sneeze and forcing them to lower their guard. When they least expect it, it charges at them with its sharp stingers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp stingers to defeat any opponent that stands in its way. Its pollen gives off a strong honey scent during the warmer months of the year.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME grab onto small Pokémon with their venomous talons and whisk them away towards their nest. The stinger on their back is rarely used because it requires them to turn around.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known to have a strong sweet tooth and prefer a high-sugar diet. They rummage through garbage cans to look for half-eaten candy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its eyes can recognize heat signatures from afar. It uses this ability to identify friends and family.
author: .izik

entry: An Ultra Rare Soda brand once ran a limited promotion of POKENAME's honey flavoured drinks, using real honey. This was very expensive, as POKENAME cannot be easily farmed. This is used as a case study for business students.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its wings are purely decorative, as POKENAME cannot fly. This is not because of the size of its wings, but instead because it is too lazy to learn how to fly.
author: cowanisbest

entry: POKENAME appear to be able to reproduce or otherwise grow their numbers quickly, but are only active during specific times of the year. The tips of their claws are poisonous.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The hive on its back attracts other bug Pokémon over several kilometers. This makes POKENAME a popular companion for bug catchers.
author: chorb33

entry: Although POKENAME otherwise peacefully consume nectar from flowers as a meadow-dwelling Pokémon, they are territorial and do not like being encroached upon. If one is angered, other POKENAME nearby will join it in fury.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flies at incredible speeds, absorbing nutrients from the victims it stings. Its venom can give a victim weeks of nightmares.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's body resembles a honeycomb structure, with delicate antennae sensing the environment. Its antennae pick up on subtle shifts in the air, allowing it to predict the weather.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This Pokémon hangs from trees using thin strands of honey. The honey itself contains a very mild toxin, but it does not affect humans.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are made out of thick steel, which allows it to pierce through the carapaces of other Bug Pokémon. However, it will quickly retract into its shell when confronted by other Steel-types.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME make their hives deep in the planet's crust. Normally isolated in most regions, they've become a growing concern in the Sinnoh underground.
author: lordkai1

entry: POKENAME live in hives connected by various tunnels under the planet's surface; these hives typically span out for miles. They are extremely territorial, even battling other POKENAME that are not a part of their colony.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Although POKENAME otherwise peacefully consume nectar from flowers as a meadow-dwelling Pokémon, they are territorial and do not like being encroached upon. If one is angered, other POKENAME nearby will join it in fury.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are territorial creatures that often pick fights they cannot win. This hyperaggressive behavior can be mellowed out if they are exposed to smoke, which masks the scent of any intruders in their territory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a distinct growl that sounds like buzzing. The stinger on its tail is almost vestigial and useless for defense, so it uses the stinger-like fangs on its jaw to deliver venomous bites to invaders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known for its aggressive nature and bulky frame. Its cone-shaped pincers allow for greater piercing and gripping strength.
author: alexanderenjoyer1

entry: The needles on the end of its limbs cannot retract into its shell. POKENAME often shoots the needles out like a harpoon, injecting prey that are hit with fermented berry juice.
author: clawshdi

entry: It uses the stingers on its arms to drill into trees. Once it has a tree cut open, it will drink the sap inside.
author: .izik

entry: It rapidly jabs at foes with its twin stingers while agilely moving all around them. It moves through its forest territory by leaping across tree branches and attacks any invaders.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a strong sweet tooth and tries to gather as much honey as possible. It struggles to get along with others due to its greed, but still tries to be friendly despite the conflicts it causes.
author: jangodiot

entry: It's reported that POKENAME eats more honey in four hours than most hives can produce in a week. Whenever it isn't sleeping, fighting, or fainted, it is always eating honey.
author: jangodiot

entry: The bubbling-hot bodies of POKENAME are made of sweet honey that oozes from hive-like structures on their backs. Anything that survives the burning honey often falls to their thrusting stingers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is highly feared for its aggressive and cruel nature. If it finds any intruder in its territory, it pursues them mercilessly.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell, which they utilize to find particular tree saps to use to make honey. Though small, their stingers contain a venom that causes numbing, which will spread if untreated.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME primarily use the stingers on their hands to attack and poison their enemies, but also to dig out openings in their hive for their young.
author: pankiwi

entry: Wild POKENAME communicate with one another with various cries, coordinating both offense and defense with ease. They do not tolerate intruders, but will not chase them down if they leave their territory.
author: infinex21

entry: It injects a burning venom using its tail stinger, which can cause permanent damage if left untreated. Its long and curled horns identify it as the leader of its pack.
author: infinex21

entry: Be warned: when one POKENAME is spotted, dozens more are certainly nearby. If needed, it will sacrifice itself for the sake of its swarm.
author: sautomagically

entry: POKENAME is highly territorial, defending its nest by unleashing a barrage of ferocious strikes with its quills. Once a year it sheds its scales, and it's not uncommon to find Dragon Scales scattered near its lair.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A violent guardian, POKENAME strikes intruders with a storm of quills from its arms. After molting season, the ground near its nest shimmers with scales as bright as gemstones.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its small trunk to dig a storage chamber underground where it hides honey reserves produced by Beedrill. If intruders get too close, it threatens them with the large stinger on its tail, warning them to leave.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A POKENAME defends its burrowed nest by rolling into intruders with its hardened body. When one is angered, others can be expected to quickly join the assault.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME are clever hunters that can adapt in millisecond intervals, even during combat. Though they will ram foes with their deadly stingers, they can also channel and fire precise beams of energy from the tips of these stingers.
author: infinex21

entry: It prefers to eat roses and daisies over all other plants. Its stinger holds a powerful toxin that causes blurred vision and high fevers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is aggressive and throws tantrums almost daily. It loves physical contact and will demand to touch anything: nearby flowers, its Trainer, colorful pieces of art, rushing water, and so on.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME bewilders prey with its belly pattern and buzzing. It then constricts its prey and stings it until it can be safely swallowed whole.
author: pokepower

entry: It transfixes prey with its patterned belly before fully paralyzing its victim with the venom in its barbs. Although its poison is harmful, its shed skin has many valuable medicinal properties.
author: sautomagically

entry: Harvesting honey from a POKENAME is a difficult task reserved for beekeepers. POKENAME are easygoing Pokémon but can become violent due to the uncomfortable experience of honey harvesting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it flutters its wings, this Pokémon sends out sound waves capable of cutting through trees. Its tusks are equipped with a paralyzing venom.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: With a mane made out of honey, POKENAME helps local Beedrill colonies protect their stores of honey. Searing hot honey wards off the likes of Ursaring and Teddiursa, ensuring the hive has enough honey to last through winter.
