author: quackquackattack

entry: It drills through mountains to build the catacombs it calls home. The honey it produces is as tough as diamonds.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME can put enough power into every jab of their stingers that they can decimate an entire tree trunk in one stab. Due to how territorially aggressive they are, the honey they make is heavily desired yet rarely ever acquired.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spread out their hood when they feel threatened, buzzing the attached wings to scare off their aggressors. If the threat display fails, they lash out with the venomous stinger on their tail.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When a POKENAME spots suitable prey, it will use the single scythe on its tail to attack. When threatened, this Pokémon will attempt to scare off enemies using the patterns on its wings to avoid a battle.
author: finch_dane

entry: POKENAME spread out their hood when they feel threatened, buzzing the attached wings to scare off their aggressors. If the threat display fails, they lash out with the venomous stinger on their tail.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It builds hives in places with high amounts of electricity. Most exterminators consider removing a swarm of POKENAME to be an impossible task.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's small stature and amiable expression cleverly distract from its venomous stingers and penchant for aggression.
author: rihse

entry: POKENAME is a good-natured, kind-hearted Pokémon that loves to help people. Unfortunately, its idea of "help" is summoning large swarms of Beedrill from nowhere. As a result, it is not very popular.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME amasses flocks of Murkrow and commands them to raid Beedrill nests to claim the honey within. This has led to the two species becoming much more aggressive towards each other in the wild.
author: sk372

entry: Though generally kind and well-behaved, POKENAME is quite possessive of the stone it carries, refusing to share. It finds sweets such as honey or berry juice to coat the stone in and lick off of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges their body with electricity by rubbing their stingers together. Once they have stored enough power, they shoot lightning from their stingers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses its large stingers to skewer food and foes alike. The honey made by its species is extremely nutritious compared to most others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME mimics the appearance of Beedrill to ward off predators. Though not venomous, it will defend itself with its sharp stinger if threatened.
author: howlingstarr

entry: These territorial Pokémon live in groups of ten, with half patrolling their territory at alternating times. Any foe they encounter will be met with many quick jabs of their venomous stingers.
author: infinex21

entry: The honey created by POKENAME has a different flavor depending on its feelings. Negative feelings result in rotten honey, while feelings of joy result in sweet honey.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Its lack of stingers results in POKENAME taking on a different form of defense. Rather than making honey, POKENAME creates a corrosive, yet sweet substance to attack opponents.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME form social colonies to mutually protect one another, buzzing angrily at anyone that gets too close and delivering sharp shocks with their stingers. They are drawn to electrical stations, to the annoyance of engineers just wanting to work.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its eyes are covered in a special film that protects them as it digs through sand, dirt, or rock. It can curl up to defend itself, its tensed hide being tough enough to repel some attacks, and uses its tail stinger to strongly jab at foes.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon are the bane of many woodland explorers due to how quickly they can patrol an entire forest in a single day. POKENAME's frontal stingers are often held at the ready as they fly around, ready to impale any threats at a moment's notice.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wildly swings its large stingers when attempting to jab foes, which sometimes causes it to hit itself in the flurry. The self-injected poison from striking itself makes it act even wilder and more furious towards enemies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are extremely territorial and will spit fire at anything that draws too close. As expected of such small Pokémon, however, they are quick to flee when faced with a strong foe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME make their nests underground, using their sharp claws to dig at amazing speeds. It will swarm anyone that disturbs its nest and will pursue them until they are 100 feet away.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its threateningly large stingers, POKENAME primarily attacks with rapid kicks. When dealing with bird Pokémon or if it is cornered, it will spit out fireballs to defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: If one of POKENAME's drills breaks, it grows back twice as strong. It will defend its brood of Torchuna with its life.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Despite being largely amphibious, POKENAME venture far from their marsh habitats in search of flowers, their skin kept moist by the honey they secrete.
author: spkypirate

entry: Although physically weak, POKENAME can effectively dance during battle while delivering painful jabs with their venomous stingers. POKENAME venom is mentally disorienting and has reportedly caused sudden, sometimes violent, mood swings.
author: infinex21

entry: The needle-like weapon wielded by POKENAME is indeed venomous. Though one sting won't cause significant harm, this Pokémon attacks by rapidly darting around, jabbing its foes repeatedly. If they swarm, even larger Pokémon can be felled.
author: fireblade141

entry: The needle-like weapon wielded by POKENAME is indeed venomous. Although one sting won't cause significant harm, this Pokémon fights by rapidly darting around and jabbing its foes repeatedly. If they swam, even larger Pokémon can be felled.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME actively seeks out Beedrill hives, and takes control using pheromones.  Once established as the leader, this Pokémon will brutally chase off all perceived threats.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME seemingly rules over hives of Beedrill and other similar Pokémon; a POKENAME will not tolerate the appearance of another POKENAME, however. Their stingers are brimming with an amnestic poison that can take down a raging Gyarados.
author: infinex21

entry: In exchange for honey, POKENAME will defend the hives of Combee. They attack with blinding agility, cutting down foes with their stingers.
author: santon5512

entry: Its wings never flap and stay on its back, unmoving. It uses an unknown power to float in the air, causing the air around it to ripple.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have two pairs of claws that function like stingers as well, delivering a potent venom with every jab or cut. Their claws are strong enough to dig through solid rock.
author: infinex21

entry: Whenever POKENAME create honey, a few blobs of the honey often end up clinging to their wings, making it difficult to fly. They rely on their den mates to help lick their wings clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME work in prefect sync with each other, weaving honeycomb and scrap metal into their large hive. Their venom as an odd effect on the victims' mind, causing mild hallucinations.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in communal swarms around tall trees. They use their sharp incisors to cut through bark and branches and reshape the trees into elaborate hives for the entire swarm to live in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in communal swarms around tall trees. They use their sharp incisors to cut through bark and branches and reshape the trees into elaborate hives for the entire swarm to live in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its body is a saccharine amalgam of honey and bug guts. It lures Beedrill with its tempting fragrance, then ensnares them, cyclically churning their body and spirit without end.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME offers its pre-evolutions protection in the large hive on its back. It can shoot honey to restrict opponents' movement with its viscous bulk.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME punishes intruders with precise strikes from its extremely hard stingers. Its honey contains toxins and bacteria that disappear once it is boiled.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body is covered with durable, pointed stingers that deliver a painful toxin on contact. Its tail spreads a honey-like substance that slows enemies, making them easier to chase down.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its porous exterior, POKENAME's head is outstandingly tough, forming a perfect indestructible honeycomb. It protects itself with strong headbutts, bees, and poison-laced honey around its tail.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's legs are covered in perforated, honeycomb-like armor, the Combee living in its head making use of the new nests. With poisonous honey on its tail and a truly durable, honeycombed armored head, this Pokémon is near-indestructible.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME acts as a form of defense for a hive. It acts with single-minded purpose, making it a destructive last resort.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME offer sanctuary to baby Nidoran whenever it rains. Once the rain subsides, they give the Nidoran a blob of honey as a gesture of kindness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While POKENAME are extremely territorial, their awkward body shape makes it difficult for them to sting. Their stingers occasionally wash up on the beach and are used in many traditional medicines.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: The buzzing of POKENAME's wings was once thought to command legions of insect Pokémon to their side much like Vespiquen. In more recent times, however, it has been found that POKENAME are simply efficient hive leaders.
author: chibitales

entry: Beedrill flock to the trees on POKENAME's back due to the sweetness of its fruits and honey. POKENAME keeps the territorial Beedrill from becoming violent, restraining them with vines when they act aggressive towards outsiders.
author: sk372

entry: Once a POKENAME considers its hive under threat, it overwhelms its opponent with blindingly fast poison stabs. However, the honey POKENAME excretes out of its head is a delicacy and very healthy - should one survive harvesting it.
author: frink202

entry: Although it will swing around its stingers to threaten others, it is too weak to do anything other than flail them around. Its stingers do contain and secrete a potent venom, should they ever manage to cut into one's flesh.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are strong enough that even just swinging their wings is enough to break a tree in two, yet there are also venomous stingers at the tips of their wings. They are territorial to all, even others of their species.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME secrete deadly venom along the silver edges of their wings, which can fell any foe that survives the initial slash. Those with the longest horns command others of their swarms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will use its drills to break open rocks and trees to find amber to feed on. Although it can flap its wings at high velocity, it cannot fly due to its heavy weight.
author: fireflower20002

entry: A knife fight with a POKENAME is easily fatal. An encounter with a swarm of POKENAME is a sure way to become unrecognizable.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: According to legends, POKENAME was used to challenge knights who wished to seek deep truths. Those who wield POKENAME find it to be as sharp and nimble as a Beedrill, with silk strong enough to hold the weight of an adult human.
author: .fedoraman

entry: As a telepathic hivemind, they execute more advanced techniques. They can strike from different directions or rub blades to create a pacifying buzz.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's shield is made of a highly durable type of honeycomb made specially for it, able to withstand moves from even Legendary Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME produce a liter of venom daily that constantly oozes from their stingers. Despite their high levels of aggression, scientists have tapped into their high venom production to make mass quantities of Antidotes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They use their wings to make agile movements during battle. Their twin stingers are as hard as iron and contain traces of a poison that will oft ensure their foes inevitably fall.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a fierce warrior, nobly defending itself and others of its kind using its high agility to zip around and wear foes down with many quick slashes of its stinger-like weapon.
author: fireblade141

entry: It is the oft-seen leader of Beeiards, effortlessly giving them commands while fighting the strongest foe present. Its twin stingers are as strong as steel and can cleanly punch holes through solid rock.
author: infinex21

entry: Older depictions refer to it by a codename of "Tiger," supposedly due to its large sharp blades and how skilled it is in combat. They are often seen serving as silent defenders of the hives of certain bug Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: If anyone dares to invade its territory, it immediately lunges forward to strike with its terrifying electrified stinger. By flapping its wings, it produces buzzing sounds that allow it to communicate over long distances with others of its pack.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME secrete a viscous honey in place of normal saliva. The caverns in which they have made their homes are covered with traces of honey from them feeding on the minerals and ores around them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME builds its hive deep under the sand. It's a cruel predator that hunts for smaller Pokémon by stinging them from the cover of the sandstorms.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are the surveyors of hives of Beeink and Beeang, using their red cores to signal orders to them. The spikes along their central ring are actually homing stingers that track intruders until they have been defeated.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were only recently discovered in part because they would disguise themselves as other Pokémon researchers. They seem fixated on using honey to replicate the appearance of Hisuian Zoroark, though the reason is unknown.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME uses its ears and feelers to communicate with its colony mates. While normally docile in nature, if their hive is attacked, a swarm will attack whoever damaged it.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: By humming softly, POKENAME are able to calm even the most vicious of Beedrill hives, making them beloved by beekeepers all over the world. The honey dripping from their ribbons is used in many popular sweets.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME produce a liter of venom daily, and must use this venom or it will harden and cause pressure to build up. Many go berserk trying to find ways to release venom, and some resort to stinging their own kin for a release.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME aggressively guard the entrances to their hives, buzzing their wings in loud warning and charging forward with their sharp stingers. Aspiring Trainers are advised to stay clear of POKENAME hives due to the danger they can pose.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases sweet, sticky honey from every part of its body, creating blobs of suspended honey as it swims. It nourishes deep-sea Pokémon with this honey in exchange for subservience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wanders through the forest, gathering beehives in order to bathe in their honey. It often gets attacked by bee Pokémon in retaliation, but they usually flee due to POKENAME's enormous size.
author: over9001

entry: Some POKENAME are flightless and work within the confines of their hive, aggressively attacking anyone foolish enough to try to break into their nest. Aspiring Trainers are advised to stay clear of POKENAME hives due to the danger they can pose.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On full moons, swarms of POKENAME will leave their nest to hunt for prey. After a hunt, they'll sleep the entire day, closely nestled with each other.
author: starmanmatt

entry: While incredibly rare, scientists have noticed that when a POKENAME moves into an area, many bee Pokémon will follow its orders without question. With the help of its followers, it constructs massive hives to live in.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME produces a pale yellow nectar from its stingers. Despite being poisonous, it can be safely consumed as a honey substitute in dishes when sufficiently heated.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its arms being weak, POKENAME is quite adept in combat, using its stinger-tipped tail like a spear. The mushroom on its head releases a honey-like substance when hit by an attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: A very agile and social Bug-type Pokémon, POKENAME is a popular Pokémon amongst thieves. Its high speed and agility make it very capable of getting in and out of buildings, while its social nature makes it very easy to train.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though it has an enticing aroma, the honey-like liquid that surrounds POKENAME is incredibly toxic. With the aid of its psychic abilities, POKENAME can stretch its arms up to 15ft to sting enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: A rare fusion that is akin to a fairy, rarely seen and often sought after by Trainers. However, it is unwise to provoke it for it will defend itself.
author: chocouniversa

entry: The fluff on POKENAME's back is soaked in sweet nectar. Smaller Pokémon can accidentally get stuck in the fluff without POKENAME noticing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wield poisonous stingers for arms that they can thrust almost as rapidly as their wings can flutter. But their real weapons are the axe-like tusks that can cleave through steel like they were mere trees.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a passion for battling with others of its kind. It is usually spotted drilling into the sides of mountains, causing small landslides.
author: schierke

entry: Despite the playful way POKENAME flits about with its own kind, it is highly dangerous and territorial. One should not, under any circumstances, venture close to POKENAME territory when the moon is full.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces a sticky honey that constantly drips from its head, often making it difficult for POKENAME to see. This honey is only secreted during its waking hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is popular among keepers of Bug-type Pokémon due to its territorial nature. It will spit a honey-like substance at foes, sticking them in place before setting the substance ablaze and jabbing them with its many tail stingers.
author: chibitales

entry: After spending many months underground, adult POKENAME emerge simultaneously in a swarm. These emergences occur regularly at specific times of year, requiring rural communities to prepare in advance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constructs sticky honeycomb within its riverside lodges. The sweet scent of honey in the air makes its home easy to locate.
author: .izik

entry: It cultivates honey that is extremely high in protein. Bodybuilders use this ingredient in supplements to increase their muscle mass.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enters a frenzy, wildly swinging its stingers if anything approaches its hive. The honey produced inside is highly nutritious and sought after.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its territory, distracting wayward travelers with flashes of light before attacking.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME feed on berries and minerals, which allow them to produce a rich honey inside their bodies. They are happy to share this honey with others, but those who try to take it by force are met with their steel stingers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feed on meadow flowers, living in colonies of around twenty individuals. They metabolise the nectar they feed on into honey, carrying the sticky liquid around in the hollows of their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The honey it secretes from openings in its body is incredibly rich, yet laced with traces of the metals it feeds on. Chefs and metalworkers are still discovering ways to use this honey in their respective works.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME covers its head with pieces of rival hives it vandalizes to assert dominance over its neighbors. Due to its irritable temperament, it doesn't hesitate to fight with all its might using the two stingers it has in place of arms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other by flashing signals from their red cores. Many POKENAME will gather together and connect to form hives.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are the workers of a hive made of Beeink, communicating by flashing their red cores. When they spin their bodies, they produce a a very sweet and sticky honey from the spots surrounding their red cores.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon roasts berries with its fiery breath before skewering them on its sharp stingers. Its favorite treat is honey-glazed fruit, which it gathers from hives it carefully guards.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are surrounded in a bubble of honey and often stay in Beedrill nests to protect their reserves. If a hungry Pokémon approaches their nest, POKENAME release psychic waves to scare off the intruder.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If under attack, colonies of POKENAME use echolocation to line up their strikes. They fly through the dark before injecting venom with their barbed stingers when provoked.
author: xenodactyl

entry: The honey from the honeycomb of a POKENAME is potently bittersweet. Consuming it causes deep slumber filled with vivid, existential nightmares.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME bravely defends its hive from enemies even when outnumbered. With its stingers, it marks trees that are sick so Rangers can locate them more easily.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The sound waves that burst from its mouth sound like billions of buzzing insects. This can cause nausea and dizziness.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME use honey as a main food source. However, sourcing the honey is up to each POKENAME; some make it from scratch, some conquer hives, and some steal from other POKENAME.
author: jojojax164

entry: The scourge of apiarists all across Kanto, POKENAME will target rival hives and steal their honey.
author: volvonovic

entry: Its stinger is extremely heavy, making it uncomfortable to fly for long periods. It will roll on its back to show respect to the leader of its swarm.
author: .izik

entry: A swarm of POKENAME will gather to form a nest out of their own bodies. Should the nest be approached by a predator, they will roll away in unison.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are aggressive Pokémon that are very keen on taking over territories of other Pokémon. They have a great sense of smell.
author: mystora

entry: Some believe this is what today's Beedrill looked like over 150 million years ago. It wards off threats from its nest with its ear-splitting roars.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its hive, using its hard, spherical body to form hexagonal walls around the hive.
author: rakunk

entry: Despite its gentle appearance, POKENAME is fiercely territorial. It will protect the flower field where its swarm gathers pollen at all costs, using its large venomous stingers to drive away intruders.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It does an odd dance while collecting pollen from flowerbeds. Once it has enough, it will spin and spread the pollen to other flowers.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon will gladly cheer atop its hive for hours. Should POKENAME spin during the cheer, small amounts of crystallized honey will be scattered from its feathers.
author: .izik

entry: It swings its stingers in circular patterns while dancing. It emits a fragrance that smells like honey from its crown.
author: .izik

entry: A skilled dancer, POKENAME dances to warn off would-be intruders to their territory. Its stingers make it a difficult opponent to deal with.
author: pory

entry: POKENAME often get mistaken for a plastic bag by people who pick up garbage. They can be particularly dangerous to approach when they are eating, as they become aggressive and sting whoever approaches them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are best known for producing exceptionally delicious honey. If they receive improper care, however, their honey will become highly toxic.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME fly about forests at surprising speeds given how small their wings are. These highly territorial Pokémon will jab at prey and intruders alike with their Twineedle attacks until they succumb from the physical injuries or from their poison.
author: infinex21

entry: The fin-like wings of a POKENAME and their dorsal fins allow them to quickly soar through the air, bobbing and weaving through the trees. They will fire their poison-laced stingers from their wings like missiles at any territorial intruders.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's territory can be known through the trails of honey it leaves as it moves. In exchange for being a hive, the Beedrill within serve its will.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME spreads its majestic wings to patrol above its hive, even in the dead of night. It repels intruders with sonic waves released from the ears atop its head.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When threatened, POKENAME retreat into their hive-like shells, encouraging the swarm they house within to attack. The honey-like goo that their bodies consist of is high in sugar and protein, prized by people who exercise frequently.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME spends its entire life burrowing massive holes into the ground for Bug Pokémon to nest in. These Pokémon repay its kindness by binding its stones together with silk and honey.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Fueled by honey, POKENAME guard nests of Beedrill with a mighty shell that is harder than diamond. The only way to deal with a nest with a POKENAME is to burn the nest with scorching flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's once hollow body is now a hive of swarming Beedrill. Despite weighing over several tons, it's wings still allow it to fly.
author: serversizeme

entry: Its furry body is filled with highly-pressurized honey. The honey leaks from its paws, leaving a trail while it walks.
author: .izik

entry: Its prey gets stuck in its sticky body, allowing POKENAME to slowly consume them. Its sweet aroma ends up attracting all sorts of bug Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: The mushrooms that grow on its body smell like honey. If boiled, they can create a tea that can help eliminate a sour stomach.
author: .izik

entry: By frantically flapping its wings above its head, POKENAME can create gusts of icy wind. The sharp spines on its tail serve as a deterrent to prevent predators from hunting it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Tended to by farmers, POKENAME serves a dual purpose. While it pollinates crops, its territorial nature drives it to protect the field from any intruders.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are territorial, and are ferociously loyal to their Trainers. Both its stinger and the rocks in its mane carry dangerous poison.
author: skinstealers

entry: POKENAME attacks the hives of other Bug-type Pokémon and usurps their leaders. After taking over a hive, it forces its new underlings to gather honey while it sleeps.
author: mourge40k

entry: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME are superb dancers that are light on their feet. One of their signature performances involves dancing to a famous orchestral interlude called "Flight of the Beedrill".
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME usually travel in colonies, attacking any dangerous foe. Its stingers actually come from its mushroom as a way to fend off predators.
author: imagine1.

entry: Wild POKENAME are the worker Pokémon of their local hives, capable of carrying almost three times their bodyweight atop their backs. They will use their tail stinger to defend themselves, but the poison within is the only real threat.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME are the frontline fighters and defenders of their hives. They attack with combinations of thrusting attacks using the stinger upon their tails and forceful punches.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME will clash their scales together to signal to the other members of their hive when an intruder is present. The massive stinger upon its tail is capable of cleanly penetrating steel.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lounges on logs to bask in the sunlight when no one is around. If it spots an intruder, it panics and emits a frantic buzzing noise while fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their sensitive antennae to detect weaker Bug-types, luring them with the scents from the foamy jelly on the head. POKENAME also use these antennae to detect predators and avoid attracting them.
author: entomoxie

entry: Each POKENAME stakes out a claim to a section of jungle. In its territory, it lies dormant, waiting patiently for other Bug-types to enter, then strikes faster than the eye can see. Attacked Pokémon are left paralyzed by venom, ready to be consumed.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The gems on its body are made of crystallized honey, used as a portable snack by POKENAME. Many have tried to harvest this honey, but POKENAME's stingers tend to have other plans.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite its friendly appearance, POKENAME is extremely territorial and will not hesitate to fight off intruders. Its stingers are poisonous, but it usually only attacks with headbutts.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: This Pokémon uses its stingers to drill into mountain walls. This Pokémon's honey is used by a bakery in Riyado Town that creates delicious Salac Berry Tarts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases pheromones to psychically control other nearby Bug-type Pokémon. With a flick of its drill-like appendages, its hidden army suddenly erupts to attack its foe.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Though not terribly mobile, POKENAME can strike with its stingers at an incredibly rapid and accurate pace. Some have trained their POKENAME to carve intricate jack o' lanterns from pumpkins for autumn celebrations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body pattern looks very similar to other Beedrill, which it uses to scare off other Pokémon while flying at night. It will even use it to raid Beedrill hives for their honey, with varying levels of success.
author: mistymagius

entry: Spirits congregate in POKENAME's body like insects in a hive. To obtain new souls, POKENAME stings an unsuspecting victim, then absorbs its soul into its honey-like limbs.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's bodies are incredibly light, allowing them to fly surprisingly quickly. The honey they secrete is considered a delicacy in many regions, often added to teas for its uniquely rich and sweet flavor.
author: santon5512

entry: Rather than create their own hives, POKENAME instead offer protection to the hives of weaker Beedrill fusions. They use their lances to dispatch any threats to the nest they serve.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME fiercely defends its territory, striking intruders with powerful attacks from the spines at the tips of its limbs. It can produce a honey-like substance that, being highly flammable, enhances the power of its Fire-type moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After long periods underground, POKENAME emerges to buzz its wings violently. This shakes off clinging dirt, which it finds deeply unpleasant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are highly affectionate, flying directly at anyone they set their sights on. Unfortunately, they don't seem to realize how sharp their stingers are.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon in aquariums and large fish tanks. They have a striking colouration, but their venomous stinger means they require specialist handling.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME rubs the two spikes on its tail, a loud buzzing sound is produced. This sound is known to scare off potential predators.
author: mepp.

entry: Subterranean hives created by POKENAME can exceed 300 feet in length. Even minor disturbances trigger violent swarm responses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME keep hives of Combee in their beaks, giving them shelter in exchange for some of their honey. When provoked, they will open their mouths to let these swarms fight for them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME glide across ponds and lakes at high speeds, using their stingers to jab predators. Their heads secrete an exceptionally sweet honey that is considered a delicacy in many regions.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are popular with thieves as they have an aggressive nature and are drawn to valuable objects. Large swarms can be uncontrollable, however, resulting in thieves being driven out of their own hideouts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The barb on its tail is highly poisonous. It is territorial, so anyone looking to catch one should wait at the edge of its home and wait for POKENAME to come to them, rather than moving closer.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body is similar in consistency and smell to honey. It squeezes into Beedrill hives and disguises itself as part of the comb so it will be fed honey. POKENAME consumes Beedrill that are suspicious of its presence at night.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can survive up to a year in the desert without food once it is full of honey. This is because of its slow metabolism, along with its ability to store ten liters' worth of honey inside its body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's honey is sweet and medicinal, effective at helping headaches in people and Pokémon. Because it suffers from constant headaches itself, POKENAME is usually seen eating or bathing in the stuff.
author: sk372

entry: Its constant migraines make it highly aggressive, so POKENAME attacks intruders with its stings at sight. It is very protective of the nourishing honey it produces and rarely shares it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME builds its hive near clear water to improve the quality of its honey. Its migraines can become so intense that it crashes into trees while taking flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can inject venom through the stingers on its head and arms. In battle, it spins rapidly to protect itself from all angles.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is the target of attacks due to the sweet honey around its head. It assaults would-be thieves with storms of extra-sticky honey, granting their wish while leaving them stuck and unable to steal any more.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are largely timid and tend to hide from people and Pokémon alike. They are most active in spring, helping Combee gather pollen and protecting them from Beedrill.
author: thordemidgard

entry: It is advised that Trainers never try to pet POKENAME. Despite their cute appearance, they are extremely ill-tempered; touching one is likely to result in a painful sting or a fierce bite.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME is a particularly dangerous Pokémon because of its aggressive nature. It frequently throws tantrums and will sting its Trainer until it receives what it wants.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME create hive-like tunnel systems underwater, spanning many miles under the sand. In the hierarchy of the colonies they live in, their evolved forms are often seen as the rulers.
author: adsfw11

entry: Highly aggressive towards anyone within its territory, POKENAME uses its powerful stinger to pierce foes. It then consumes them, leaving no trace behind.
author: canada

entry: POKENAME become enraged when other Pokémon enter their territory and will hunt trespassers relentlessly. The giant stingers POKENAME wield secrete a venom that puts their target into a crazed fury, which was once used to create a Berserk Gene.
author: npshi

entry: A POKENAME's combination of intense loyalty and territorial nature usually leads to it being used to guard places such as hospitals or daycares. It has a habit of shaking off pollen when excited.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Wild POKENAME are very hostile and competitive towards people and other Pokémon. They are known to be difficult to tame.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME defends its hive by hypnotizing intruders with the spiral on its belly, then hit them with its sharp stinger once they fall asleep. Since its body needs to stay hydrated, it prefers to live near rivers or small lakes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME, with its vicious temper, is one of the most dangerous bugs to encounter. Even if it loses its prey, it can locate it using psychic power.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Successful bakers use POKENAME to gather only the best honey for them in the forest. Due to its immense muscular structure, POKENAME can carry large amounts, as well as scaring any potential thieves away.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME mimic jungle flowers, entire hives sitting together in the grass and drooling sweet honey. They aggressively attack anything attracted to their trap, working together to try and bring down whatever disturbs them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME typically stays near its nest where it eats honey and practices stabbing with its stingers. Whenever a predator arrives at the nest, it springs into action and attacks the threat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leaks a thick, candy-scented honey from its mouth. If a Pokémon enters its mouth to eat the honey, it swiftly inhales and traps them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their strong stingers to carve ocean rocks into their nests. They will emit bright lights from the red parts of their bodies to disorient and mesmerize those who draw too near before attacking them with flurries of stinging attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: The tentacles of a POKENAME can reach further than they first appear, often being used to constrict and restrain foes. Once they are certain of their victory, they will jab at their foe with stingers until exhausted.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a grumpy Pokêmon that tends to lash out at those nearby. As it gets older, its rough edges smooth out, its body becoming more slick, and its personality becomes more agreeable.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A courageous omnivore, POKENAME explores other areas of the forest in which it dwells in that other Pokémon may not to hunt and gather food. Each POKENAME has slightly unique hair patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME attacks with its electrically charged stingers. It swarms with others of its kind to overwhelm larger Pokémon.
author: mepp.

entry: Each season, POKENAME migrate to areas that most often experience stormy weather. Even during these storms, their affinity with the planet's magnetic field allows for easy navigation.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It fashions a spear using its own shed stinger and a sturdy stick. The stinger still retains enough venom to fell a foe if the wounds do not fell the foe first.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME do not tolerate others entering their territory and will strike them down using their stinger-like proboscises. They communicate with their own kind by striking their proboscises together in varying patterns.
author: infinex21

entry: It swiftly chases after prey and invaders of its territory. With its three heads, it can deliver a barrage of venomous strikes with its stinger-like proboscises.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a monstrous pile of honey. It tricks Bug Catchers into mistaking it for Beedrill. When it sees prey, it traps them in their sticky honey.
author: .thewaffles.

entry: A courageous omnivore, POKENAME explores other areas of the forest in which it dwells in that other Pokémon may not to hunt and gather food. Each POKENAME has slightly unique hair patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can flap their ears rapidly enough to create a loud buzzing noise that they use to signal their rising anger. Lacking any real restraint, POKENAME doesn't give the target of their ire long before they attack once they start buzzing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fires bursts of water from its back cannons to knock foes off their feet. It also jabs its stingers into opponents when they are too close to fire its water cannons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is surrounded by a corrosive honey corona which it uses to burrow through the walls of abandoned buildings where it makes its hive. Drips of the honey remain behind, making urban explorers mistake it for ghostly ectoplasm.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME silently stalks through its habitat of an empty building, seeking out unsuspecting people. When it finds a victim, it chases them, cackling maliciously and trying to poke them with its stingers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME congregate in abandoned buildings to plot how to best torment nearby towns. They swarm in a cacophony of buzzing giggles and steal items to construct and expand their hive.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are extremely territorial of their burrows, attacking anything that gets too close. They pounce on their prey at high speeds, restraining them with their smaller claw before injecting them with a toxic poison.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME rely on psychic energy to detect the presence of people and Pokémon around them, as they do not have eyes. Their long tail delicately takes care of the bulb on their back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Most POKENAME grow up without a parent, forcing them to fend for themselves and grow cold and standoffish. Some have been observed at night, drawing an image similar to Mew in the air with psychic energy.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME kicks, it uses its overwhelming psychic power to contract space around its legs. This causes these kicks to be able to reach across massive distances at a speed nearing the speed of light.
author: fenragon

entry: It contains immense psychic powers within its shell. POKENAME resembles a fabled Pokémon from a faraway land.
author: toad900

entry: First discovered on Cinnabar Island, POKENAME is theorized to be left over from failed cloning attempts during Mewtwo's creation. Being incomplete, it can only partially mimic the form of the being it was supposed to be.
author: sk372

entry: Its firepower matches its fiery temperament, as it holds a grudge against all of humanity. It will show no mercy to anyone, incinerating anything that dares stand in its way with its psionic flames.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its mind is said to be so powerful that it can freeze objects at the molecular level without physical contact.
author: juliho27

entry: Brimming with ego and power alike, POKENAME isolates itself from those it deems unworthy, claiming entire islands for itself. It uses psychic powers to force those who invade its territory to kneel before it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly circles the globe in search of opponents worthy of its strength. Despite how viciously it battles, it will rush to the aid of those it finds in trouble.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME create psychic waves as their wings beat together, producing a low humming noise that clouds opponents' minds. They compress their psychic energy into spikes, firing them at anyone brave enough to face them.
author: santon5512

entry: Its power has increased greatly, but it has also become a little unstable since its body is struggling to contain all that energy. The strange, orange growths or discolorations on some parts of its body are a result of this.
author: fireblade141

entry: Its power has increased greatly, but it has also become a little unstable since its body is struggling to contain all that energy. The strange, orange growths or discolorations on some parts of its body are a result of this.
author: fireblade141

entry: Although it would be assumed this fusion would bring the genetic framework of POKENAME closer to that of Mew's, it has achieved the opposite effect. This Pokémon is considered dangerous and it is encouraged that a report be made if one is spotted.
author: jangodiot

entry: After fusion, POKENAME resembles one of its Mega Forms. Its mental power is unleashed further, allowing it to float through the air with ease and create massive orbs of pure psychic energy to blow away opponents.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has resulted in POKENAME taking an appearance closer to its DNA source Mew. Its psychic potential is even more vast, but its personality has become much gentler, so it rarely uses its full power.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to develop a highly aggressive personality. It teleports around, flinging psychic projectiles indiscriminately at others. It searches for powerful rivals who can compete against its mental might and give it a proper fight.
author: sk372

entry: The fangs of POKENAME are imbued with the power to confuse anyone unlucky enough to be bitten. The only way to break out of this confusion is with ice-cold water.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME entangles prey in mysterious webs that drain their energy. The more energy that is drained, the bigger POKENAME becomes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME constantly battles conflicting personalities, gentle one moment, destructive the next. It may help others selflessly, then lash out in fury. Some say a Trainer who helps it master its emotions will form a bond beyond ordinary understanding.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It is a very antisocial Pokémon and hates being told what to do. Its immense psychic abilities allow for it to command anyone in its vicinity to do its bidding.
author: mistymagius

entry: There have been many rumors about POKENAME being a failed replication of Mewtwo but there is not enough evidence to prove this theory. Touching its body seems to drain its victims of their intelligence.
author: mistymagius

entry: Foes feel incredible pressure from just a single glare from POKENAME; weaker wild Pokémon sometimes faint from that look alone. When it strikes, its overwhelming ambient psychic power makes the target feel as though the entire world has gone quiet.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is rumored to have been created using data and notes left over from the creation of Mewtwo. It is extremely antisocial and will often wipe the minds of any users who encounter it in cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains relentlessly, honing its developing body with fierce and rigorous regimens. It uses its powerful psychic abilities to compensate when its budding body falls short.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels in thick fog and walks across lakes. It uses psychic powers to purify bodies of water. Anyone interrupting it will be transformed into pure water.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's immense psychic power allows them to create brilliant violet auroras that stretch across the night sky. Researching the Pokémon further has proven difficult, as they live atop high mountain peaks and aggressively defend their territory.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a master of psychic projectiles in battle. It generates powerful orbs of mental energy from holes in its palms, and quick-moving psychic drill projectiles from the horn on its head.
author: sk372

entry: Possessed of a potent psychic power, POKENAME will use their vines and telekinesis to ensnare their victims with crushing strength. They have a vengeful streak and may hold grudges against those who violate their territory for an extremely long time.
author: vic1312

entry: Purple flames fueled by psychic energy launch from the holes in POKENAME's hands. It has clear control over the fire it shoots, mentally directing its path so that opponents cannot escape its attacks.
author: sk372

entry: As a result of a poorly decontaminated laboratory, sand slipped into a machine and combined with Mew's DNA, thus creating POKENAME.
author: mystora

entry: Upgrades to POKENAME have made its psychic powers stronger than what was believed to be possible. Some people believe that online users who are overly offensive and rude are actually POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: Although POKENAME is very antisocial, it has an intensely strong attachment to its Trainer. This tends to make it almost violently protective and rather selfish in regards to the Trainer's attention.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are almost without peer, to the point some theorize that at full power it could warp reality. It staunchly protects its Trainer, showing almost no emotion as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses untapped psychic powers that researchers theorize could make it unstoppable. Instead, it uses its abilities to create hypnotic body colors to influence Trainers around it.
author: shyguy11011

entry: As the first of the cloned starters, it remains more docile and protective. It lives deep in jungle caves to watch over the forest life.
author: toad900

entry: It uses its mouth to extract and absorb pieces of living flesh from anything it encounters. It's theorized that the reason for this is that POKENAME looks to absorb the DNA of every Pokémon to finally become the perfect upgrade of Mew.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME shuffles around at the sea-bottom in moderately-deep waters. It keeps to itself mostly, and anything that bothers it is seized by powerful telekinesis and flung above the water and into the distance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has enough power to crush a building with its psychic power. Thankfully, POKENAME is too lazy to do much other than eat.
author: themicelegion

entry: Many online forums depict POKENAME as a wrathful psychic force. These websites believe disasters strike nations that fail to show it proper reverence.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was genetically engineered in an attempt to create the ultimate weapon, but it refuses to be wielded.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is a vicious, merciless Pokémon, as it thinks only of defeating its foes and maintaining its status at the head of a pack. Its cold, glinting blades strike fear into its enemy and ensure no one even thinks of double-crossing it.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME treats the skies as an ocean, using its psychic power to stay hidden from Trainers. Despite this, strange sightings by Sailors of figures swimming in the night sky were widely reported.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's complex body structures are derivative of their genetic makeup, making no two look the same. Their bodies are powered by powerful psychic energy, which they produce by spinning their gears.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to manipulate its target's senses, further enhancing its illusions with false touch and smell and making them nearly indistinguishable from reality.
author: phoenixftw

entry: Created by humans to be the ultimate weapon, POKENAME has left its past behind to forge its own path. Those who come near it find they can't fight it.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME maintains a deep psychic bond with all sea-dwelling Pokémon. When angered by the actions of humans, it commands its underlings to destroy anything man-made.
author: adam_dnh

entry: POKENAME flies through the atmosphere while telepathically scanning the ground below for any building hostility. If it senses a conflict that could lead to disaster, it descends from the sky and repels both combatants until they tire themselves out.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME was engineered and genetically altered to create the perfect Pokémon. It can turn its arm into a cannon able to penetrate the hardest steel.
author: jona_hehe

entry: POKENAME uses psychic powers to enhance its fire-related abilities. It can control the weather with incredible dexterity, often bringing about highly localized extreme weather conditions to destroy places it doesn't like.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME can fire concentrated psychic blasts from the cannon on its arms. No one knows what this Pokémon looks like under its armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sneaks up on other creatures, creating strings made from its own powerful psychic energy that latch onto others. Once snared, it can manipulate its victim to do its bidding.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME weave psychically charged webs deep within dark caves. They rely on the psychic charge on these webs to sense their prey, the strands picking up on the panic of those caught within them and transmitting them back to POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are immensely powerful psychics, capable of manipulating anything they can see. Specialist rangers need to be brought in to deal with POKENAME colonies as soon as they're discovered in case of danger to locals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are immensely powerful psychics, capable of manipulating anything they can see. Specialist rangers need to be bought in to deal with POKENAME colonies as soon as they're discovered in case of danger to locals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The middle head controls the other two with its psychic powers. However, if all three heads are in perfect sync, they can turn a whole city to ashes.
author: mistymagius

entry: An alien virus and a man-made Pokémon capable of incredible destruction fused into POKENAME. Those in POKENAME's presence feel increasingly nauseous and eventually begin behaving erratically. Even studying POKENAME from afar proves dangerous.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping in deep caves to conserve psychic power. The psychic energy it accumulates causes it to illuminate in the darkness.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is still developing, using its psychic power to maintain the amniotic bubble it sleeps in. Even like this, it boasts incredible mental abilities.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's sharp screech messes with the mind of those who hear it, leaving them disoriented and easier to attack. It requires the drinking of other's blood to keep its body and its psychic powers strong.
author: sk372

entry: The frill around POKENAME's neck glows with energy when using telekinesis. Its roar sends out a shockwave of psychic energy that overloads the senses of those in front of it, leaving them immobile and helpless.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is viciously violent and intelligent, and should be avoided at all costs if spotted. Rumors circulate that it was created in a lab to be entertainment at an island zoo resort before escaping.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME unleashes waves of psychically charged sound waves to disorient and overwhelm its foes. While they are reeling from the psionic attack, it swoops down and viciously claws and bites its target before unleashing more sonic bursts.
author: evilgammon

entry: An alien parasite from another universe and a man-made experiment fused to become this Pokémon. It brings forth an eclipse, striking fear in foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A rogue team of geneticists combined samples from Cresselia's feathers with research from a laboratory involved in Mewtwo's creation. The resulting POKENAME proved far too powerful for these mad scientists to control.
author: entomoxie

entry: A rogue team of geneticists combined samples from Cresselia's feathers with research from a laboratory involved in Mewtwo's creation. The resulting POKENAME proved far too powerful for these mad scientists to control.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME is very protective of others, but gets overzealous in its efforts. It fends off attackers so viciously that it often ends up scaring the one it attempts to protect.
author: sk372

entry: If it is angered, then it burns its opponents to their very soul. Then, it uses its psychic powers to leave no trace behind.
author: skymaster426

entry: In fits of rage, POKENAME releases massive psychic bursts from underground. The force is strong enough to topple skyscrapers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been described as unusually cruel by observers, seen bullying weaker Pokémon. POKENAME's hydrokinetic powers are matched by few, able to lift entire rivers with ease.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME's mood seems to shift with the weather, making its behavior unpredictable. Although it has the power to alter the weather, potentially improving conditions during natural disasters, it rarely does so.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Due to being cloned, the fires it forges are lukewarm. Its psychic knowledge allows it the ability to change toxic viewpoints of people.
author: toad900

entry: Said to be the pinnacle of psychic Pokémon, POKENAME is said to be nine times more powerful than its origin, Mewtwo. It is said to be extremely cruel in battle.
author: thistleblower

entry: POKENAME was created from the DNA of various great fighters and fighting-type Pokémon. It still needs to undergo some training, however.
author: milchik

entry: It has trained in solitude for many years in order to defeat its former masters. Strikes from its fists stun opponents with psychic energy.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME trains nonstop and learns to fight from the recordings of the most skillful fighters in history. Fighting without rest is in its DNA.
author: milchik

entry: Being created from DNA of the strongest fighters combined, POKENAME embodied the very aspect of fighting type. It can't be defeated in a fair combat.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME wields both immense psychic power and blazing fire, allowing it to bend reality and scorch the skies in a single breath. It is said to only appear during intense solar flares, warping the air around it with heat and telekinetic force.
author: corkedjupiter63

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to pull rocks toward them, forming a sturdy shell around their bodies. When provoked, they release their built-up energy to launch these rocks in all directions.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's mane and feathering are created from excess psychic energy pooling in their body and are hot to the touch. Despite their small size, they can manipulate objects and fire with ease and can kick a hole through solid steel.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME flees at the sight of humans, wishing to avoid them at all costs. Pursuers are dispelled by the flames it leaves behind as it gallops, manipulated by psychic energy to hone in on aggressors.
author: sk372

entry: Visually very similar to Slowpoke, mentally POKENAME is its complete opposite, intelligent and scheming. It uses this intellect and unassuming form to take advantage and manipulate other Pokémon to do its bidding.
author: sk372

entry: Mew often pranks POKENAME by grabbing and nibbling its tail suddenly. POKENAME's angry reaction ruins its ruse as a dim, placid Pokémon, which Mew uses to teach POKENAME a lesson.
author: sk372

entry: The three heads exhibit features and behavior from Mewtwo and its two Mega forms. POKENAME's stance and fighting style changes depending on which head is currently most in control.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges its cannon with psychic energy. The water it shoots contains many bacteria that can manipulate the brain of a person nearby.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME gather psychic energy as they sleep, storing it within the stones they carry. When released, this energy will put anyone within range to sleep.
author: santon5512

entry: A POKENAME's bulb contains seeds of every type of plant that it has encountered, creating sprouts around it as it travels. If a POKENAME notices an invasive species or weed popping up, it will clear it out with a small dose of poison.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME have been so elusive because of their ability to turn invisible, a trait that is often associated with Ghost-type Pokémon. Over many years, POKENAME have adapted to become nearly undetectable, except when eating leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME forms a protective bubble of psychic energy while it sleeps. If disturbed, the barrier bursts and it retaliates with psychic blasts channeled through its bone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME holds the genes of all Pokémon in its bulbous hands. It punches with the power of an ancient species that has been long forgotten.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME holds the genes of all Pokémon in its bulbous hands. It punches with the power of an ancient species that has been long forgotten.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is highly respected for its cute nature and the pattern on its torso. When its Trainer is sad, it tries everything it can to cheer them up.
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal

entry: POKENAME possesses the ability to rewrite the cellular structure of its cocoon. It does this in response to the presence of other Pokémon, morphing its outer layer into a defense tailor-made for whatever predator tries to hunt it.
author: sk372

entry: The orbs this Pokémon produces contains the essence of all Pokémon. Many believe the smaller head is the dominant one.
author: themicelegion

entry: The embryo within the orb is the true POKENAME. The larger creature is actually a psionic construct made from the Pokémon's psychic powers.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME is renowned for its friendly attitude and playful dances, which it's always willing to show off. It takes great pride in its hair as well, grooming it thoroughly after any performance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known to have a voracious appetite for sweets, always on the lookout for treats. Some say it will turn others into candy if it's hungry enough, though this is unconfirmed and unlikely.
author: sk372

entry: Though weak, POKENAME is extremely friendly to people and Pokémon alike. It gives its beautiful pink scales to those it likes.
author: mepp.

entry: It secretes a harmless liquid from its furry tail, which it uses to playfully paint on anything around it. This liquid can change color due to many reasons, the most surprising being that emotions and evolutionary stones affect its color.
author: infinex21

entry: A few people believe POKENAME is the ancestor of many Electric-type Pokémon that roam across the regions. The Mew DNA of this Pokémon makes POKENAME very fond of bubbles.
author: rycronicgames

entry: POKENAME's warm body soothes those who touch it, emptying their mind of troubled thoughts for a time. In battle, it can psychically manipulate the fire it breathes, making it move in unique arcs and chase after evasive foes.
author: sk372

entry: It is said to hold every possible line of computer code within its genes. Scientists have spent decades trying to see if its genome could be replicated with modern technology.
author: mistymagius

entry: The wings on POKENAME's arms are thought to have become vestigial after learning to levitate with their psychic power. Despite their cute appearance, Trainers are advised to leave POKENAME colonies alone, lest they be pelted with Rock Blast attacks.
author: chibitales

entry: The lightning coursing across POKENAME's body appears to be composed of pure psychic energy. Those struck by its bolts have their will to battle completely zapped away.
author: sk372

entry: Kindhearted but incredibly shy, POKENAME tries to make itself as elusive as possible. It helps those in need, but teleports away immediately after the rescue, leaving no trace of its presence behind.
author: sk372

entry: Some have nicknamed this fusion "Mewthree." Fusion has calmed Mewtwo's once-violent heart, perhaps due to Mew's genetic material filling in gaps in Mewtwo's DNA. It has become a being of incredible power, but also incredible kindness.
author: sk372

entry: Violence within Mewtwo has been quenched by Mew's DNA, giving POKENAME a rather playful personality. It creates bubbles to play with other Pokémon, but will flee when it detects the presence of humans.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Researchers speculate that this particular Mew fusion was the result of a rare genetic disorder. POKENAME seems to be perfectly fine, however.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME resembles one of the first ever known depictions of Mew. This has sparked research into whether the depiction may have been Mew's original form many millennia in the past.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body, said to possess the genes of all Pokémon, has become unstable after fusion. Its form will randomly shift into a combination of other Pokémon at any given moment.
author: sk372

entry: A gentle denizen of the most remote forests. POKENAME is rarely seen, said to only come out at night during times of strife, emitting a psychic pulse from its head crest that calms and pacifies those around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a bubbly personality and is often spotted splashing around in the water. If it spots a dying ecosystem, it will use its psychic abilities to try and save it.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have an extraordinary genetic structure that allows the stem atop their heads to grow into many kinds of plants. Their tails are used for playful pranks or to cling tightly to others.
author: infinex21

entry: Young POKENAME are incredibly friendly and inquisitive, constantly exploring and engaging with Pokémon and Trainers. As they age, they withdraw into themselves, and once fully mature, spend most of their time invisible.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is a curious sort, often following along after something passing by has caught its interest. It is rather shy as well, so should the person it follows turn to see their pursuer, it turns invisible so as not to get caught.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems to possess the capability to read and influence the minds of all other species of Pokémon. With a playful and kind nature, it primarily uses the influence to make those it encounters more peaceable.
author: sk372

entry: A playful spirit that seems to appear randomly across the world at night. It's believed the orbs around its neck let it manipulate the DNA of Pokémon and forcibly evolve them should POKENAME will it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is accompanied by two floating claws that it controls through powerful telekinetic powers. Its power appears to originate in its double tails, as the tips glow bright as it directs the claws around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears in the wake of natural disasters. The mutagenic properties of its oozing body allow plants to regrow in damaged soils and develop unique traits.
author: wiz0z

entry: The sight of this Pokémon is a memory that will last forever, as its beauty astounds people and Pokémon alike. It preys on flying Pokémon almost exclusively.
author: notsaying.

entry: With tremendous psychic power, POKENAME seemingly morph the very land with convincing illusions. Because of this, encountering one is extremely rare.
author: t.i.a.

entry: These elusive Pokémon move with such speed that they are oft compared to lightning itself. Those few who have ever witnessed them have said they can disappear at will, though this has yet to be confirmed.
author: infinex21

entry: It is said that the smoke flowing from POKENAME's back contains the hopes and dreams of every Pokémon that came before and after it.
author: vapyr

entry: POKENAME bounces around the regions looking for new people and Pokémon to play with. Shaking the end of its tail emits a psychic wave that calms frazzled nerves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are always seen with at least some kind of snack in their grasp or suspended nearby with psychic power. They are partial to sweet treats and some have been seen sharing pieces with friends.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon's ears and feet have grown larger after fusion. POKENAME's vines have also morphed into additional tails, which it doesn't need or use.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME is very famous in the beauty scene. Many Contest superstars were inspired by this Pokémon.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME possesses a powerful psychic prowess that allows it to manipulate objects with its mind. It has a shy nature, so sightings are rare.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Mew's unique DNA allows POKENAME to change any part of its body into that of any other Pokémon while in combat. These chimeric combinations allow it to create nearly unbeatable offensive and defensive forms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to predate modern life. It holds the DNA of every Pokémon and a single departed spirit from each species, bound together in stone and spirit.
author: lesbian_garlicbread

entry: It's thought that POKENAME can psychically resonate with any nearby Pokémon and pacify them, putting them to sleep so that it can also peacefully slumber without the noise of conflict.
author: sk372

entry: Small villages once viewed POKENAME as a god of childhood and play. When resting, it encases itself in a floating bubble and drifts peacefully.
author: .izik

entry: A psychic, shapeshifting weapon, this Pokémon aspires to become the strongest by learning every move.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Appearing only to those of pure heart, it is a very playful Pokémon. It does not seem to grasp its level of power.
author: melodydelune

entry: Its cells store the information about every landmass in the world. It can create any mineral by just pressing some soil between its powerful hands.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are extraordinarily elusive Pokémon, typically only found high up in the atmosphere and very rarely returning to the ground. Their genetic structure is remarkably adaptable, allowing them to mimic any other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen by humans, and theorized to be constantly dipping through time at its own whims. Some believe it makes itself present for the birth and discovery of every new Pokémon species, past and future.
author: sk372

entry: The fusion between a Darkrai and a Mew caused the unstable DNA within the Mew to go rampant with dark energies and form an outer shell in the shape of a Darkrai. It now wields psychic energy and nightmarish power to manifest nightmares.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is said to intrinsically understand the true nature of every being that was or ever will be. Flames of blue and red will travel along its tail and ignite the symbol at the end, should it be in the presence of those with dishonest hearts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's DNA contains the genetic code of all Pokémon. However, its cellular structure is so unstable that it freezes parts of its body to keep itself from unraveling.
author: h0bojoe

entry: "One day, an unknown force will freeze everyone together to become one single organism." Although this quote from a famous science fiction novelist predates the recorded existence of POKENAME, conspiracy theorists believe POKENAME has this ability.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dart about in lightning-bolt patterns, though they move quicker than lightning if spotted. This has led some to believe they can teleport, though they have only been observed moving extraordinarily quickly.
author: infinex21

entry: This odd Pokémon resembles a Pokédex and, supposedly, it contains records of every Pokémon, even those that may not have been discovered yet. None have been able to access this information, even if they have ever been lucky enough to get near it.
author: infinex21

entry: Each of POKENAME's psychic limbs ends in an orb that emits powerful telekinetic energy. It's believed something incredible lies within its tomb-like body, but POKENAME refuses to let anyone open it to see.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME charges mysterious energy in its wings, bubbles of an unknown substance begin forming in the air.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME charges mysterious energy in its wings. This one has a rare coloration.
author: .realthree

entry: Its crystal core contains the DNA of every known Pokémon. Geneticists theorize that it can transform any Pokémon it touches into any other form, using its vast DNA manipulation skill.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being very elusive, POKENAME are very playful and will chase anything that even somewhat interested it. Sightings of POKENAME have been accompanied by a flurry of pink sparkles.
author: mistymagius

entry: When this fusion tenses its jaws and muscles in a very specific way, its usually soft skin becomes harder than tungsten carbide. Lots of kids have fun imitating its particular expression.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME carries the likeness of a pre-existing ancient tablet, which many scientists have taken to confirm that the creature on the tablet and Mew are indeed one and the same. Some have hypothesized the tablet itself has incredible untapped power.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME teleports onto others to nip them and siphon a tiny amount of mental energy to sustain its minuscule body. The act is harmless and painless, only ever causing people to stop and momentarily forget what they were doing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME delights in harmless pranks, but when angered, it ensnares victims in chilling illusions, tormenting them as their strength and hope slowly fade away.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The psychic powers triggered by POKENAME's dances are so strong they can be witnessed rippling the air around it. Even the most violent and aggressive of Pokémon will be pacified if POKENAME dances near it.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that POKENAME originated from an injured Mew that got stuck in a tree, which came to life and grew around the Mew in order to protect it.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A Mew that figured out how to connect its brain to a Registeel. Its brainpower is unmatched by even the smartest Pokémon.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: Sightings of POKENAME in the wild are so rare, it was thought to be only a rumor until recently. The most common sighting appears to be Vermillion City, and reports always include sighting a Mew accompanying it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spreads a puff of spores around itself once per day. The spores will grow into all manner of different mushrooms; scientists believe POKENAME may potentially be able to produce any kind of fungus, if only at random.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly playful creature that entertains humans and Pokémon alike by creating spheres of psychic energy. When someone is cold, it curls up against them with its ever-warm pink fur, trying to share its warmth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The bubbles POKENAME surrounds itself with are actually made of psychic energy. They're surprisingly durable.
author: atlas3339098

entry: The bubbles POKENAME creates help it channel its psychic power. It can teleport anything it can fit inside one of them.
author: atlas3339098

entry: The many bubbles loosed from the shells of these Pokémon are either warm or hot depending on their mood. Tamed POKENAME are common at carnivals because they can use their psychic powers to manipulate these bubbles.
author: infinex21

entry: The body of POKENAME has the scents of hundreds of different sweets at once. It plays pranks by laying down invisible strands of sticky string for its victims to get stuck to.
author: soup1900

entry: It possesses immense psychic power, but prefers loitering in urban alleyways to show off its swagger. It uses telekinesis to keep its loose, baggy skin from tripping it up during a battle.
author: willowwhisker_98658

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's stone shell matches incredibly closely with a certain ancient artifact depicting Mew.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are extremely rare sights and only fall to the surface every 500 years. They love to play with small stones and meteorite fragments.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME naps peacefully underground in meadow habitats, leaving its tail exposed and wagging. Ancient texts praise its gentle and playful nature.
author: .izik

entry: All three members of POKENAME use psychic powers in tandem to move soil around to dig their tunnels. Sometimes it behaves mischievously and uses the clumps of soil to pelt others nearby when it stops to rest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lies on a membrane-like cloud, blissfully sleeping away and dreaming about things unknown. Scientists have studied the helix patterns attached to POKENAME's tail and its changes while asleep, hoping to glimpse into this Pokémon's thoughts.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME spends almost its entire life asleep, suspended within a resilient bubble of pure psychic energy. While its physical body rests, its consciousness wanders the surrounding area, observing the world.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Friendly and kind-hearted, POKENAME uses its powerful psychic abilities to help others' moods. It amplifies positive emotions within a person, increasing the joy they feel at the moment.
author: sk372

entry: Friendly and kind-hearted, POKENAME uses its powerful psychic abilities to help others' moods. It negates the negative emotions within a person, decreasing the amount of sorrow and letting joy better flourish.
author: sk372
