entry: POKENAME's head aches if it's not in the presence of other Pokémon. The larger the group and the more varied the species of Pokémon within, the more its pain ebbs away.
author: sk372

entry: No matter how dirty the surroundings, the water POKENAME makes its home in remains pristine. The jewel on its forehead emits a psychic energy that constantly removes impurities in the water it swims in.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates swirling patterns made of bubbles in the air whenever it meets someone new. The bubbles are laced with psychic emanations that invoke a feeling of peace in those who gaze at them.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME much prefers friendship to fighting, it won't back down from sparring or combat. It creates extra arms from psychic energy when it battles, making it impressively formidable and difficult to defend against.
author: sk372

entry: Some POKENAME have been reported to help with deliveries, using their invisibility to hide important packages. Fledgling Trainers often mistake the trucks of POKENAME as places to find a Mew.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME forms a mobile shell around itself by compacting heavy stones together via telekinesis. It's very shy by nature, so it's rarely seen outside of the shell, even among its friends and Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates bubbles out of psychic energy to rest on. Those who rest on the bubbles themselves find themselves feeling utterly relaxed and content.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is quite protective of its twisted plant stalk. It will smack those who try to take it, before fleeing in the blink of an eye.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Medical science has achieved great breakthroughs thanks to POKENAME. Because its body contains the DNA of every Pokémon, researchers are slowly developing antivenom for every Poison type and their myriad fusions.
author: sk372

entry: Instead of cannons, bubble wands adorn POKENAME's shell. These bubbles are deceptively powerful, and it can use them as a means to attack or defend itself from threats.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: When Mew and Krabby fused to form POKENAME, analysis of its genome suggested its DNA was more stable than many other fusions. This conclusion led a few scientists to theorize that everything may eventually evolve into a crab.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its body is coated in a poisonous sweat that wards off anything that tries to take a bite out of it. Its leaf gives off a sweet scent that makes others feel happy.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME trains by throwing punches in the air, it scatters pollen in all directions, helping nearby flowers bloom more quickly. Before a battle, it spins the leaf on its head in a threatening display to intimidate its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spins its big leaf as a propeller helping it levitate. The downward wind blows its foul-smelling gas down to fertilize plants.
author: reese1017600

entry: When the leaf on its snout becomes a bright lime, its body produces a mild, slightly musky scent that reminds people of cantaloupes. When its Trainer allows it to bask in the sunlight, it accelerates the growth of potential inside before it evolves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim close to the surface and sunbathe for hours every day. When threatened, it shoots seeds and dangerous powders to drive predators away.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME swim near the surface during daytime. Its body is covered by leaves that secrete poison whenever it gets angry. POKENAME have been seen tumbling ships that come near its nest.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME swims close to the surface of water, letting its leaf poke out to absorb sunlight. The sweet scent wafting from the leaf tends to attract predators, however.
author: sk372

entry: Its powdery leaves are a common ingredient in herbal remedies. Apothecaries will commonly offer fresh honey to POKENAME in exchange for its assistance.
author: griddle

entry: In the early morning, POKENAME dances in the snow. This causes small green sprouts to erupt from the nearby snow-covered dirt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has an insipid taste and a gritty texture that makes it unappetizing to eat. As such, fishermen who catch it usually toss it back into the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Drifting aimlessly among seaweed, POKENAME seems strangely content. It does what little it can to help any Pokémon in need it encounters.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME elegantly swims in icy waters, steering itself with the leaf atop its head. When it naps by the shore, patches of grass sprout wherever its body touches the stones or the icy shores.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Gracefully gliding through frigid seas, POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to guide its strokes. When it dozes along frozen banks, tender grass blooms in its wake, defying the cold.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The plant on its back is said to have existed 100 million years ago. It lives on the seafloor, using its leaf to tether itself to rocks or coral to prevent itself from getting swept away by ocean currents.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME releases a sweet scent from its leaves, which can be harvested to produce tea. Its leaves only take a week to grow, so harvesting the tea leaves does not harm it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME basks in fields to absorb sunlight. It produces a scent that gets stronger on days it absorbs more sunlight. Trainers who enjoy this scent give it hugs so the scent rubs off on them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to gnaw on bones, especially since it relies on eating small shards of bone to give itself a boost of calcium. When it is not chewing on bones, it sprawls across a rock to sunbathe and nourish the leaf on its head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It blends perfectly into treetops thanks to its leaf-shaped wings. When POKENAME is happy, its body releases a natural fragrance that helps soothe symptoms of nausea.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's mood and overall health can be gleaned from its leaf tail: if it is sad or ill, the leaf wilts. In extreme cases, it may even fall off.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME has a mild and agreeable temperament, making it perfect for training. It loves to roll around in flourishing meadows. When happy or determined, it releases a relaxing aroma.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME walks through trails and scales up hills to find the best place to photosynthesize. Their sense of time ensures that they never miss a minute of daylight, even during rainy days.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fold vines into their nest to siphon nutrients from tree branches while they sleep. Perfume manufacturers capture the scent produced by the vines to create a floral perfume that lasts for hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing rosemary scent moments before discharging sparks. The aroma lulls opponents into a false sense of security before the shock hits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide beneath piles of leaves or behind rocks to avoid predators. If a friendly Trainer happens to stumble upon a POKENAME during their adventure, the POKENAME will give them a seed as a sign of its trust.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME possesses a scent that smells vaguely of honeysuckle. During late spring, it rolls around in blooming meadows happily.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon stores all of the oils and oil-based nutrients it needs in its tail leaf. Its body absorbs water, while the floating leaf absorbs light.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME flies around by rapidly spinning the leaf on its head. It naturally produces a sweet aroma that uplifts one's mood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME frolic in flower-filled meadows, prancing around jubilantly. Pollen gets stuck to their body as they do so, and eventually transfers onto other flowers, pollinating them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At night, POKENAME shakes its head back and forth which causes the leaves on its face to release a sweet fragrance that helps it sleep. These leaves grow throughout its life and help generate enough oxygen to help POKENAME breathe underwater.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon releases a subtle scent that puts others to sleep, allowing it to steal from them undisturbed. The effect wears off by morning, leaving no trace, and no memory of what occurred.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a leafy bulb on their back that can be harvested to make soups. These leafy greens have a sweet and refreshing taste.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hide thin vines around each of the leafy buds growing around their neck. The leaf atop their heads produces a pleasant scent that helps people calm down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaf around POKENAME's face is as sturdy as the steel on the rest of its body, giving it added protection. It only pulls back to reveal its face when it breathes out a suffocatingly sweet breath to disorient others.
author: sk372

entry: When it waves its leaf, it lets loose the smell of fresh barley. The leaf itself is extremely soft and is used by POKENAME as a pillow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's razor-sharp claws are prized by chefs, as boiling and chopping them releases a minty aroma. In the wild, it uses these claws to slice herbs for its meals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME climb trees to knock down berries to eat. They are primarily herbivorous and have a disdain for hunting other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces sweet smelling seeds in the leaf atop its head. It eats and composts organic matter to maintain its temperature and keep its skin gooey.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME absorbs lots of sunlight to ignite the flames within its shell and have them bursting with energy. While these flames give it the power to fight predators, they also burn through its grass shell, so it douses them in rivers afterwards.
author: soup1900

entry: Although POKENAME have a thick layer of fur covering its body, it is horrible at dealing with cold temperatures. The leaves that cover POKENAME's eyes are very sensitive and help it locate itself.
author: toniaglitched

entry: It releases an aroma that triggers a sense of panic in those nearby. The scent lingers in the air, unsettling both Pokémon and people alike.
author: .izik

entry: Each successful strike from POKENAME releases a fresh dill-like scent. The stronger the strike, the more potent the aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME extends its vines during lightning storms, absorbing electricity to store in its body. This energy keeps it active and alert even during extended periods of darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME frolics through fields with boundless joy. Its cheerful demeanor and budding potential bring smiles to all who encounter it on sunny days.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME buries itself, only letting the leaf on its head to be shown. Scientists have said that its body has a similar composition to most seeds.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME frequently mimics shopkeepers, matching their gestures and expressions with surprising accuracy. When it perfectly copies someone, it emits a refreshing herbal fragrance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME keeps its leaf above the water as it swims during the day, giving it more energy as it photosynthesizes sunlight. Remoraid are attracted to the sweet scent of the seeds on its underbelly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's burrows are lined with roots that release a faint chive-like aroma. This scent marks its territory and deters unwelcome visitors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will hide itself from predators by holding onto tree branches and sticking out its tail to pretend to be a leaf. Much of its diet consists of tree sap that it extracts with its tongue.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head produces different scents depending on its mood. Each individual of this species has its own small garden of berries it tends to with diligence. Berries it chooses to eat are roasted with an Ember attack.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to interact with its surroundings. It becomes agitated if the leaf is grabbed or pinched.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are often found around rural communities. Their empathic powers lead them to tend to farmland and wilderness alike with equal care.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gives off a scent reminiscent of baked bread, attracting both humans and Pokémon. This aroma makes it a comforting presence in forests and fields.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME's body can shift hues to blend in with any territory, its leaf can only become the natural colors that foliage takes with the seasons. As such, it hides away among leafy tree branches where it can camouflage properly.
author: sk372

entry: The sap flowing through POKENAME's body contains magnetized iron particles, allowing it to hover by repelling the world's magnetic field. When attacked, it floats as high as possible, releasing a sweet scent in hopes of pacifying the foe below.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME does its best to help take care of plants. It trims spare branches with it teeth so that shorter plants can receive more sunlight.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME gains most of its energy from photosynthesis thanks to the leaf on its head. To obtain the nutrients it can't synthesize, the small mouth on the back of its head snaps at flying insects that pass by.
author: hophoppip

entry: If POKENAME senses an approaching tornado, it releases an intense basil-like scent. This aroma spreads far, acting as a warning signal to Pokémon nearby.
author: .izik

entry: An extremely rare meadow-dwelling Pokémon known for its pleasant nature and smell. Its wide leaves make for better shade and photosynthetic ability compared to its unfused components, but makes them more clumsy, too.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its leaf exudes a spicy aroma akin to a Tamato Berry. It scales tall trees to find and eat nuts, then throws the nut shells at those below.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon consumes rotten vegetation, using it to nourish the plants on its back. Its ability to recycle decay makes it a vital part of the ecosystem.
author: .izik

entry: It uses Bubble Beam and Razor Leaf attacks to knock down fruits and berries that are too high for it to reach. It is too proud to ask for or accept help and will turn down perfectly good food if offered to it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME would rather calm its opponent with its blade's sweet aroma than fight. Unlike steel, the blade regenerates in sunlight and moisture.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's leafy tassels emit a pleasant scent as it swings its blades through the air. The aroma weakens a foe's fighting spirit the longer a battle goes on, giving POKENAME the advantage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's leaf-blade can slice through titanium with ease. As it swings, it emits a pleasant sugary scent that confuses predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that have become close to their Trainers will give them their petals. These petals can be used to brew a tea that has a rich, calming flavor.
author: melodydelune

entry: A pleasant aroma wafts from the barbs on the end of POKENAME's vines. The aroma is a byproduct of the nutrients POKENAME gets from both the sun and the dirt it eats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are masters of camouflage and extremely elusive, hiding from people as best they can. During a full moon, groups may gather and stare in the sky, performing dances and songs. This phenomenon has rarely ever been observed.
author: santon5512

entry: This Pokémon sleeps near pools of lava, using the heat to keep its body warm. This habit ensures POKENAME stays active even in the coldest environments.
author: .izik

entry: It stinks to adults, but children describe its aroma as a flower garden that makes them want to play with it. Oily roots shift just beneath its rag.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon to keep in small apartments, their presence adding a lush feel to the interior whilst their ability to produce fire helps to keep heating bills low. Student rented flats are an especially common home for them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can sense the aura of those nearby. If it detects a strong opponent, it emits a basil-like scent, signaling both caution and respect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME survives exclusively on sunlight, allowing it to lie stationary for most of the day. Due to rarely ever moving around, thick layers of moss will start to grow on its back.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives exclusively in clean waters. When the sun is shining, they can be seen rolling around in the sun on the shore.
author: chorb33

entry: When POKENAME grows frustrated, it hops in place while releasing a thyme-like scent. This is a warning sign, as it is about to unleash a powerful electrical discharge.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's body help it camouflage amongst the jungle leaves while hunting for prey. If it has an abundance of energy in its body, its leaves will glow with a vibrant green light.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME whistle out songs through the leaf on their head. The sharp sound of the whistle makes other Pokémon drowsy, some falling asleep during the performance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as toddlers in parks, hoping to be taken home. A strong turmeric scent clings to it, making it possible to identify a fake.
author: .izik

entry: The flame on its tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: The bud on POKENAME's head helps modulate the air pressure inside its body. The leaves can tighten to help POKENAME swell like a balloon, or the air can exit through the bud, carrying a sweet smell as it leaves.
author: .realthree

entry: Each flap of POKENAME's wings releases a delicate hibiscus fragrance. This floral scent distracts foes just before it stuns them with Supersonic.
author: .izik

entry: It is most active just before dusk. When it rests, it burrows into the ground, sucking the fluids and nutrients from nearby plants. POKENAME's leaves are most healthy when it feeds off of a wide variety of plants.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its small stature, POKENAME can become a threat if given an ounce of power. Its laughter can be heard echoing in dark places.
author: inksans201x

entry: Somewhat slothful by necessity, POKENAME must photosynthesize for most of the day in order to stay healthy. Although it tries to stay relaxed, if it spots something it likes, it will hop up and down and yip and roar.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME eat Enigma Berries to help them survive in the wild because they are fragile creatures that get exposed to many threats. They sprout vines from their back to push predators away before sliding away on a sheet of ice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While dancing, this Pokémon hums a rhythmic cadence that captivates any onlookers. The longer POKENAME dances, the more difficult it becomes for those watching to look away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits a pleasant floral scent as it dances and cheers on its allies. The plants on its arms can spray batches of paralyzing pollen in the faces of those that come too near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances beside bushes, releasing pollen from its leaves to aid their growth. It trims overgrown shrubs with elegant swings of its sharp leaf.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are commonly seen eating seaweed and other underwater plants. POKENAME become aggressive while eating and attack anything they think might try to steal their food.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME's flower emits paradoxical scents based on its mood: when happy it emits a noxious scent that repels others, but when sad it releases a pleasant scent that entices others closer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys engaging with both Trainers and wild Pokémon, showcasing its friendly nature. It releases a sweet scent when happy, especially during rainy or sunny days.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME usually lives along the edges of forests, seeking clearings where it can photosynthesize undisturbed. The flower on its head releases toxic pollen that, when properly refined, can be brewed into invigorating infusions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a cheery Pokémon that loves playing in fallen leaves. When fall comes around, POKENAME can be seen almost everywhere.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is a cheery Pokémon that loves playing in fallen leaves. When fall comes around, POKENAME can be seen almost everywhere.
author: themicelegion

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head spreads spores that grow mushrooms on the bark of trees. The leaf-shaped fungi on its back are used in some restaurants as a mildly flavorful garnish for foods.
author: sk372

entry: Genetic testing of POKENAME's leaves has revealed matches with fossilized plants. Scientists theorize that the gentle scent released by the leaves is older than human history.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It expels a verdant powder that paralyzes foes on contact. The powder spreads easily through the air, creating a natural defense against predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rapidly spin the leaves on their head to spray sweet puffy spores around them. These spores are very sweet, but can cause allergic reactions in heavy doses.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The flame on its tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It uses its tough claws to till soil and to break open hard nuts. The flame upon its tail flicks wildly when it feels threatened. To keep foes at bay, it waves about its leaf that exudes a sharp, yet rich, scent.
author: infinex21

entry: While sleeping underground, POKENAME leaves a single leaf exposed at the surface. This leaf emits a foul odor that deters most predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a particularly lazy creature that loves to spend the day napping. Once it's full of sunlight, it uses the large leaf at the end of its tail to shade itself so it can keep sleeping for hours.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME is tired, it can sleep the entire day under the sun to recharge its energy. In the rare moments it is awake, it tries to snatch anything that glitters—but since that activity quickly tires it out, it soon collapses back to sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the large leaf on its tail to absorb sunlight and shield its eyes from glare, helping it keep track of its opponent. Though very lazy and eager to sleep, its claws can deliver surprisingly powerful blows.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Wild POKENAME hoard berries that they love the taste of. They swing the leaves upon their heads to knock berries free, though this also casts about a pleasant aroma that oft attracts other Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: It feeds on grass at great speeds and is preferred by many over conventional lawnmowers. But when there's no grass to eat, it gets antsy.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: Every time POKENAME spins, it releases a fresh-cut grass scent from its body. Deeply curious about humans, it tends to settle in woodlands close to towns and other inhabited areas.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its leaves are warm to the touch, even after they've been shed. Healers in ages past would use these leaves to line blankets and make poultices.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME search for reservoirs of mineral water to quickly absorb the nutrients they need to nourish their body. Once they finish drinking the mineral water, they fall asleep in a sunny patch of grass to soak up the sun's rays.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's leaf acts similarly to a sweat gland. As it trains and exerts itself, dew gathers along the leaf's petal, and a floral aroma grows more and more potent as the training continues.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wafts a sweet scent in the areas around it by swinging around its thin, flexible body to wave its leaves. It detests foul odors and tries its best to freshen the air in stinky areas.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are patient creatures that wait until their opponent is staggered before striking. By tripping their opponent with vines and spraying water from their mouths, they can achieve victory over their peers in a few minutes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It enjoys lazing around in moist areas, watching the water droplets drift down off of its leaf. The faint scent wafting from said leaf invokes a feeling of listlessness in others.
author: sk372

entry: Due to a quirk in Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME's favorite meal consists of brothy food that does not require the need to chew. It especially loves soups made with all-natural ingredients.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME floats in the air using a combination of electromagnetism and the flapping of its leaves. Research indicates that the electromagnetic waves it produces make plants close to it healthier.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME have a sweet succulent meat that makes them perfect for hearty stews. When combined with their leek baton and the large leaf on their head, POKENAME are a delicious meal in difficult times.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers to swim in cold water. It dips its long leaf into the water to test the temperature, hesitating heavily before entering warmer seas.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME goes around touching flowers yet to bloom, smearing its slimy form across the plant. Those plants touched by it are notably more vibrant in coloration when they bloom.
author: sk372

entry: The stems around its neck are actually seed bundles that help it grow new plants. When attacked, it tries to ward off foes with its sharp leaf.
author: mistymagius

entry: It sheds layers of its cocoon to ensure a smooth metamorphosis upon evolution. It then consumes the recently shed layer, which is said to taste like parsnips or carrots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its vines are a staple in the restaurant industry because it is a fast-growing substitute for lemongrass. Whether it gets paired with seafood like a Klawf Stick or a spoonful of Slowpoke stew, its vines will always be in demand.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Restaurant and bakery owners will frequently leave out flowers to draw in wild POKENAME thanks to its appetizing fragrance. This has also led to a rise of their natural predators in urban areas.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME makes its den in leafy underbrush where it can perfectly blend in. Every six months, the leaf on its head dries up and falls, only to regrow even stronger than before.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A special seasoning made with dried POKENAME leaves is said to make any meal taste delicious, so it is highly sought after by master chefs.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Trainers are split on whether POKENAME's scent makes them feel cozy or peppy. Some speculate it depends on how strong the POKENAME is.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: Trainers debate over how POKENAME produces its trademark scent, which offers a mixture of calm and excitement. Scientists claim that the scent is similar to coffee, but further study is required.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burrows itself under grassy knolls during the day to sleep. The leaf on its head will poke above ground and absorb the sun's rays.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is almost always seen carrying a number of leaves and seeds within its mouth. It trades these with other Grass-type Pokémon in exchange for other foods, protection, or simply to share particularly tasty greens.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME get older, they bury themselves in muddy, fertile soil and become dormant. From the shoots on the side of their head two Chikoper grow, genetically identical to each other. POKENAME then emerges from the mud and promptly evolves.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME care deeply about their Trainers. If a POKENAME's Trainer is feeling incapable, the POKENAME will release an invigorating scent from the buds on its neck.
author: hophoppip

entry: A small orifice on POKENAME's head and its leaf allows it to breathe and gather energy even if its body is submerged in mud. The smell of POKENAME varies by region.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME feathers exude a tasty, savoury scent thanks to the compounds they absorb from their food. Their aromatic odour makes them popular companions of chefs, their feathers being used to help bring flavour to broths.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is usually spotted hanging around websites based on the subjects of floral upkeep. It's quite helpful in guiding users towards sites that will give them even more details on how to properly care for their gardens.
author: sk372

entry: The buds on POKENAME's neck have a distinct spicy aroma. As it ages, this fragrance becomes much milder.
author: mepp.

entry: A lounge of wild POKENAME has recently been discovered within a forest up north in the Orre region. The buds on their arms will bloom into flowery blades that can slash through even the toughest of boulders whenever they're in battle.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME are valuable resources for any gardener given how quickly they can till the soil, though they can often be caught nibbling on the crops that result from their labor if their Trainer doesn't keep a close eye on them.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: POKENAME's body is constantly emitting a spicy aroma that seems to energize the life around it. Some farmers use POKENAME as a garden tender to make their peppers grow faster and spicier!
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME swings the leaf on its head to lull potential predators to sleep. Each POKENAME has a unique leaf atop its head.
author: northkira

entry: It twirls and dances around flower gardens as a form of meditation. When groups of POKENAME dance together, the flowers grow bigger and more vibrant.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Most commonly encountered at the height of Summer, plants flourish and flowers bloom in the path left behind as POKENAME dances through the warm evenings. Seeing a POKENAME pass by is said to be a portent of good fortune.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are often viewed as heralds of summer, their invigorating auras breathing life into plants and Pokémon alike. They are also highly prized by aristocratic Trainers, their elegant appearances lending a dignified air to summer balls.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The blades on POKENAME's arms are so sharp that they can cut through even the toughest metal. The edge of the blade is only 0.05 mm thick and possesses extreme durability. No one in history has ever observed them breaking.
author: huh.7

entry: When POKENAME is in danger, the spicy scent of its leaves intensifies. POKENAME uses the scent's stimulating effects to clear and focus its mind, raising its psychic powers to formidable heights.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly strong for such a small Pokémon. When it is not trying to bite anything that moves, it enjoys keeping warm in a nice sunny spot.
author: opossiblymage

entry: It has reverted to an ancestral form once thought to be lost. POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, with a false eye on the lookout.
author: barthandelus_real

entry: POKENAME's precognitive abilities alert it to disasters that will take a heavy emotional toll on people. Though it can do nothing to divert the disasters themselves, its leaf emits a calming scent that can help soothe the victims after the fact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's buds produce a particular aroma that helps keep people energized. Its caring nature makes it a useful partner for those in physical therapy, happily guiding others through stretches and other exercises.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's scent subtly influences others to want to fight it, much to the joy to POKENAME, as it likes to duel.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Despite the fragrant smell, the leaves that grow from POKENAME are bitter to taste. Tea brewed with their leaves is said to focus the mind ahead of negotiations, with some CEOs drinking POKENAME tea before meetings with rival companies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When chasing prey, POKENAME's fur releases a sour aroma that acts as a stimulant for them and their prey. Both are filled with adrenaline and run faster, but POKENAME's prey will likely run out of stamina much sooner.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The buds around its neck emit a spicy aroma that acts as a stimulant for humans. POKENAME are often used in rescues during landslides.
author: melodydelune

entry: Each curled leaf around POKENAME's tail is packed full of spicy flavors. There is an annual event where spice connoisseurs gather to sample delicious foods made with these leaves.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in garden centres to help tend the plants that grow there. They provide sunlight to greenhouses and shade with their many leafed tails to the plants under their care, carefully keeping everything in a perfect balance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME remains by the seashore frequently during the summer season, as it loves to play with others. When beached, they roll around and forcefully emit a gas that includes dirt and chemicals found in various peppers to propel themselves forward.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rely on their natural camouflage to sneak up on other Pokémon. With a flurry of razor-sharp leaves and potent lightning strikes, they can quickly incapacitate their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is incredibly energetic, especially on sunny days when the light gives it the spirit to perform greatly in battle. When it rains, its priority is to protect the flame on its tail, using the large leaf on its head until it can find safer shelter.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The edges of its leaves are razor-sharp, so by shaking them POKENAME can defend itself from predators that get too close. Its saliva contains toxins that are harmful to humans but useful for improving the soil's pH balance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME combines the lush greenery of Bayleef with the aquatic adaptability of Mareanie. It dwells in coastal regions, where it uses its leafy tentacles to ensnare prey and absorb sunlight for nourishment.
author: nightwingjay

entry: Its limbs can be safely severed with a clean cut due to its regenerative abilities. The limbs themselves have a mild and grassy okra flavor that helps bring herbal and spicy notes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's burrow is filled with a soothing scent released from its leaf. This aroma keeps its young calm and prevents panic underground.
author: .izik

entry: Although the berries they collect are those they love to eat, POKENAME will not hesitate to share them with others. Each of the curled-up leaves around their neck exudes a different scent.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME produce an antiseptic sap from the leaf on their head. Whenever they get their hands dirty, they squeeze the leaf and rub their hands together to get their hands clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME swing their leafy arm wildly with little tact or precision. By feeding them a Micle Berry, they develop the insight to land lacerations with great precision.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The spicy aroma of the leaves around POKENAME's neck boosts energy. To avoid being constantly sniffed, POKENAME withdraws into its shell before lashing out with vines and jets of water.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: The curled leaves on POKENAME's head contain a poisonous substance that, while slightly dangerous to small Pokémon and children, is safe to eat for adults. The substance causes a moderate burning sensation and is used in many spicy dishes.
author: chibitales

entry: A POKENAME's body sprouts more buds when it chows down on mossy bark. Large rock walls draped with large, curled leaves are a telltale sign that a POKENAME lives there.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME emit a fragrant, soothing aroma from their leaves that spreads when they shoot water from their cannons. Experienced chefs train POKENAME to help them create the base of soup broths or add flavor while steaming meals.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The flower on its back has not fully developed yet, so it produces a sweet scent from its antennae to lure in certain Bug-type Pokémon for pollination.
author: mistymagius

entry: The sweet aroma that is produced by POKENAME's antennae helps soothe feelings of anxiety. Many therapists use the Pokémon to foster a comfortable environment for their clients.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fashion tools from the bones of wild Pokémon that die of natural causes and collect seeds and berries from wherever they roam. They use these to revitalize forests that have been ravaged by fire or blight.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME is a pacifist, preferring to calm opponents with its soothing aura. As a last resort, it will deliver a flurry of precise punches to bring them down.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME has the ability to photosynthesize. As it must do this in the open sun, it relies on another Pokémon to protect it from predators. The larger its flower is, the closer it is to evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It consumes flowers to convert them into a sweet-smelling gas that makes its opponents feel at ease. The gas also helps plants grow at record speed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses the horn on its snout to drill through even the hardest ground, carving furrows for farmers to sow their seeds. In spring, the flower around its neck releases a soothing fragrance that calms troubled hearts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME serves as a healer to plants and Pokémon alike. It can revive dead plants with its breath, and its eggs can bestow healing powers from a myriad of herbs and medicine.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: POKENAME uses the sweet scent of its flower to prevent predators from harming its eggs. The aroma will calm the predators down to the point of no longer attacking.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's petals are known for their pleasant scent, akin to tropical fruit. Its core absorbs sunlight over time, which it shares in low amounts with plant life in need of a little boost.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is easily able to quell even the most enraged and aggressive Pokémon thanks to its relaxing aroma and, seemingly, its ability to expertly mediate between disputes. It is thought its psychic powers may be the cause for this adeptness.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses the soothing scent from its petals to calm those around it. Once its prey has let its guard down, POKENAME brutally goes for the kill.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: The scent of their petals changes based on their diets. Supposedly the hue of their petals may change based on their environment. The most consistent factor between their species is that their presence seems to be calming for most individuals.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will sleep beside any source of water with the tips of their tails dipped in the water so they may passively absorb it. They can safely absorb any type of water, though oddly their petals always exude a sea breeze scent.
author: infinex21

entry: Though the brightly-coloured claw-like structures on POKENAME's forearms look dangerous, they are actually blunt and soft, used for complex courtship displays.
author: occulusmalus

entry: The flowers of POKENAME give off a lethargic aroma, causing nearby Trainers and Pokémon to become tired. It is not uncommon to find several Pokémon sleeping around one.
author: elibromax314

entry: The aroma of its flower can soothe most others so much that they may fall asleep. The Oran Berries growing upon its body are richer and larger than average Oran Berries, which it happily shares with its friends.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME seems to have unlocked some prehistoric DNA through Pokémon fusion. Its long neck is suited for catching sunrays above the tops of trees. This allows it to better channel a powerful Solar Beam attack.
author: lupa

entry: Unlike Meganium's normal scent, this form's flower emits an odor meant to stoke the fighting spirit in others. Because this form brings out POKENAME's own latent battle instincts, it uses the odor to entice others into giving it a challenge.
author: sk372

entry: The leaves extending from its body capture sunlight to create powerful flame blasts. Oftentimes, the fragrances it creates are smoky and pleasant.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: The rapid beating of its wings leaves a flowery aroma in its wake. This aroma calms those who smell it, especially POKENAME's Bug type prey.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME live in mineral water reservoirs and infuse the water with their pollen to create a powerful disinfectant. They are always willing to help injured Pokémon that show up to their reservoirs by cleaning wounds with the mineral water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A wild POKENAME gets all of its energy from the sun. As it does not need to eat while basking in the sun, it resorts to grinding its own quick-growing teeth down by rubbing them up against one another. As a result, dental trauma is common.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in cold areas where few flowers bloom. Small colonies of pollinators establish where POKENAME live as they produce pollen which emits a sweet fragrance. Honey made from POKENAME pollen is slimier than normal but considered a delicacy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME absorb and metabolize moonlight through their petals, which glow softly during the process. Though they may appear during daylight, they will become much more sluggish if they don't rest to conserve their energy.
author: infinex21

entry: Although it most frequently walks on all fours, POKENAME can be found in shallow rivers walking on its hind legs; POKENAME's feet easily navigate through mud. It roams around eating organic plant material; whatever it eats quickly regrows.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Young members of POKENAME herds are encircled by the adults as they travel between feeding areas. POKENAME are rarely caught off guard, as if their feelers serve as eyes on the backs of their heads.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME tend to seclude themselves in barren areas where they churn the ground and make it ripe for plant life to grow as they feed off the hard rocks and minerals. Once the area is completely green though, they move on to the next barren land.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: POKENAME drops its feathers near withered flowers, restoring them to full bloom. It communicates with its kind through cheerful chirps, especially on bright, sunny days.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME clings to the trunks of giant trees, gorging on the sap it digs up from beneath the bark. As it feasts, its leaves emit a pleasantly sweet aroma that soothes and calms the creatures nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be seen soaring over the skies of Johto in the summer, their vibrant petals visible even from the ground. Their flowers give off a unique scent based on the time of year, with the most floral smell coming during warmer months.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lures potential prey toward it by releasing a sweet fragrance of honey and resin from its pink petals. It takes tremendous pride in its long beak, often challenging other members of its species to see whose is the mightiest.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME live in herds that tend to be a large mix of other Pokémon. Their large size but docile nature make them perfect to hide around, and the calming aroma coming from their petals ensures the area around them is the safest place to be.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: The milk POKENAME gives is very rich with a floral aroma and taste. It is highly sought after for luxury teas, coffees, cheese, and pastries.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Each petal on POKENAME's body can be pressed into an oil that heals scrapes and cuts. They enjoy taking care of other Pokémon in the wild and are often spotted with a Chikorita in their front pouch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The aroma from POKENAME's flowers agitates volcanoes and causes them to erupt. When it roars, it unleashes a powerful Petal Blizzard that completely coats the entire battlefield in petals within seconds.
author: soup1900

entry: The plant parts of its body never wither, even in the extreme cold. Wherever POKENAME steps, the flowers grow.
author: milchik

entry: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will punch enemies with the pollen-filled flowers on its tails. It uses its delicate antennae to locate its allies.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its sweet-smelling saliva attracts small Bug Pokémon. When enough crawl on its tongue, POKENAME will swallow them whole.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The fragrance of a POKENAME revitalizes the mind and body, fueling one with determination. POKENAME often challenge each other in duels to determine who has ownership over territory.
author: greaterjagras

entry: POKENAME is mega-fast and mega-agile thanks to its mega-colorful wings, despite how mega-bulky it looks. Unfortunately, it can't Mega Evolve.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is said to purify soil that has become too acidic with the powder released from its pink petals. It is a benevolent creature that helps humans who have lost their way in the forest find the path home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While Mamoswine were pushed further poleward after the Ice Age, POKENAME took their place in the growing temperate climates. They knock over trees to reach the highest leaves, inadvertently carving paths through the forest.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Once every spring, POKENAME will leave their forest and migrate across the wasteland to plant seeds. They have been seen as nature's way to reforest barren lands.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is highly coveted by gardeners for its ability to both till soil and enrich it with nutrients. Soil that has been worked by one of these Pokémon yields at least ten times the crops it would otherwise.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: POKENAME is a powerful martial artist, though it prefers to avoid excess battling. When it doesn't want to fight, it ignites the petals on its wrists, spreading a pollen-filled smoke that weakens the fighting spirit of those that inhale it.
author: sk372

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If a POKENAME shares its umbrella with you, it's a sign of sincere and genuine trust. It will never forgive those who betray it.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's hollow exoskeleton and tattered, motionless petals give no evidence of life as it hovers through the air. Even so, as POKENAME passes over dead flowers, they spring back into bloom. Because of this, many associate POKENAME with rebirth.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME are popular among experienced Pokémon Rangers, as they can ensnare targets with their long tongue and use their petals' calming aroma to pacify aggressive wild Pokémon. POKENAME can use these petals to revive flora and shroud themselves.
author: npshi

entry: When it is comfortable with those around it, POKENAME emits gentle aromas from its flower bulb, using its psychic power to analyze responses. It continually adapts the scents based on this feedback, searching for fragrances that evoke happy memories.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME occasionally molts, shedding its bulb of petals and growing a fresh one. Though prized for their size and scent, the petals are difficult to acquire, as POKENAME greedily devours the old bulb shortly after molting.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: When POKENAME senses an aggressive aura, it will release a soothing aroma from the flowers on its arms. Trainers of POKENAME are known to often be calm and relaxed.
author: darkweavile428

entry: If it existed millions of years ago, it's thought POKENAME hid itself among the beautiful plant life found in now-ancient lakes. Recent studies suggest that POKENAME is heterothermic, exhibiting traits of both warm- and cold-blooded beings.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's bright coloration and plant-like appearance allows it to disguise itself among flowers and foliage. Despite its fierce countenance, it cares deeply for the plants around it and having one in your garden is considered a good omen.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: Attacking POKENAME's front is very risky. Its steel face is very durable, and it can counter with an explosive Pollen Puff. Its pollen causes allergies for weeks.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Attacking the families of Pokémon that live on POKENAME's back will result in the POKENAME becoming furious. The younger Pokémon have become wise to this, and some such as Sewaddle intentionally use themselves as bait in battle.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: This fusion sees itself as a proud ruler over other Pokémon. It is particularly proud of its antennae that resemble a mustache.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME's blade emits an odor that calms opponents, making them easy victims to slay.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: An eight-pack of these Pokémon follows their leader obediently as their master. They train their petal-blades diligently by carving out a visage of their leader on tree bark.
author: beatdoof

entry: An eight-pack of these Pokémon follows their leader obediently as their master. They train their petal-blades diligently by carving out a visage of their leader on tree bark.
author: beatdoof

entry: This solitary Pokémon constantly seeks battle against other Grass Pokémon. Should the sharp-edged leaves on its body grow dull, it will eat them to regrow them at full strength.
author: beatdoof

entry: This solitary Pokémon constantly seeks battle against other Grass Pokémon. Should the sharp-edged leaves on its body grow dull, it will eat them to regrow them at full strength.
author: beatdoof

entry: This solitary Pokémon constantly seeks battle against other Grass Pokémon. Should the sharp-edged leaves on its body grow dull, it will eat them to regrow them at full strength.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME tends to rock moss gardens in the mountains, the fragrance of which attracts lost Pokémon they adopt as family. If threatened, they will Body Slam foes off the mountainside.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Known by farmers as a symbol of the harvest, POKENAME are said to roam the countryside, reviving crops and plants that have withered.
author: melodydelune

entry: Some say POKENAME came from another world containing almost exclusively plant-life. It takes great care around vegetation, but rarely even acknowledges the presence of people or Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Those who have met a POKENAME often report a joyful blur of color, bright petals flapping too fast to track as they release a soothing scent that washes worries away. It appears most often to those dealing with grief, helping to ease their burdens.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: A popular fairy tale tells the story of a flower turning into POKENAME through love and care. POKENAME are kind by nature, lending aid to any that need it.
author: deadshields

entry: Flowers bloom brilliantly at the end of POKENAME's vines. The vines themselves, however, are only partially organic: metal coils through each of them, their structure akin to wires. This makes the vines surprisingly sturdy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME burns wandering souls using their life force to feed the flower on its back. Once all of the flower petals fall off, POKENAME can finally move on to the afterlife.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lift their heads high, spreading their petals open to meet the midday sun. They absorb as much energy as they can to store for nighttime, using their innate powers to intensify the sun's rays if they feel it is too dark.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though POKENAME is well-suited to digging tunnels and absorbing nutrients from tree roots, it is too proud of its bright petals to dirty them with soil. Instead, it clings to tree branches, hoping to disguise itself as a flowering bud.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME lift their heads high, spreading their petals open to meet the midday sun. They absorb as much energy as they can to store for nighttime, using their innate powers to intensify the sun's rays if they feel it is too dark.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have recently gained popularity as therapy Pokémon. They provide a calming sensory experience through their light scent, their soft singing, and their gentle demeanor.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME will appear in front of nature-lovers, spreading its pollen that allows for plants to grow big and strong. However, people with hay fever consider this Pokémon to be a serious health hazard.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its beautiful voice to subdue hostile emotions and encourage plant growth. Opera singers often drink a special tea brewed from this Pokémon's flowers to relax their vocal cords after a performance.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME hums beautiful songs to subdue hostile emotions and heal sick plants. Many singers enjoy a sweet herbal tea brewed from this Pokémon's flowers, as it is known to relax one's vocal cords.
author: mepp.

entry: The scent coming from the center of POKENAME's flower is sweet and alluring, dulling the senses, emptying the mind. By the time one realizes what is happening, it is already to late and the vines have already begun to grow.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: Any dead plants touched by its freezing breath return to life, though often with dramatic changes. Matches with ancient fossils have led to theories that the plants are revived in the form of their prehistoric ancestors.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME is known for its gentle and calm demeanor. Its breath can revive withered plants, so park rangers often use these Pokémon to help promote new growth after natural disasters.
author: mepp.

entry: Their songs have a calming effect and seem to promote plant growth. The forests and plains they live in and near are verdant and rife with life.
author: infinex21

entry: They sing as they dance within verdant areas, favoring flower fields to spread pollen and seeds through movement. They fiercely defend these fields, even if only a few flowers are trampled.
author: infinex21

entry: If a Pokémon is kissed by POKENAME, it will be cured of any sickness or have all its vitality drained, depending on POKENAME's mood.
author: peachnanas_3435

entry: POKENAME rubs its flower petals together to create a becalming fragrance to stop prey from running from it. After beating up the prey with its fists, it uses its breath to heal any damaged petals from the brawl.
author: soup1900

entry: With just a touch of its antennae, POKENAME can revive seaweed that has died due to pollution. It uses its extremely strong arms to move obstacles in its path rather than for battling.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The petals that make up POKENAME's mane are as sharp as knives. They thrash around violently, spreading around its pollen to the surrounding forest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME tend to abandoned gardens in deserted castles by rejuvenating the soil and helping seedlings grow. They can see into the future by peering into balls of green fire that are fueled by pollen from their gardens.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The petals on its body are very sharp; it can throw them like kunai. POKENAME are often used to guard gardens, where they camouflage easily with the flora.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Though normally passive, POKENAME won't hesitate to defend its friends and family with powerful kicks. It takes great pride in maintaining the large flower on its neck.
author: mepp.

entry: As POKENAME digs, nearby soil briefly supports rapid plant growth. Small saplings sprout and bloom within a day, but wither within a week.
author: .izik

entry: As it basks in the sunlight, POKENAME stores energy in the orb at the end of its tail. Whenever it finds a wilted flower, it will release the energy and light to revitalize the flower.
author: alestrius

entry: Near impossible to catch by surprise, this berry thief can tell when danger is near by feeling the vibrations in the air through its petals. Each has their preferred berry and will stop at nothing to acquire it.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: POKENAME uses its long petals to soar through the sky. As the petals move, a delectable aroma wafts through the air, making those below crave fruit.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME are very gentle and docile Pokémon that live near water sources within verdant areas. They dunk their bushy manes into water at least twice a day to keep their bodies nourished and their floral aspects vibrant.
author: infinex21

entry: In the spring, it swims upstream in search of hydroelectric power plants where it can stock up on energy. When POKENAME moves with its school, it releases a delightful floral scent that can be detected even from miles away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its antennae collect energy particles from the air to generate electromagnetic waves through its serpentine body. POKENAME's flowers are highly prized for luxury perfumes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME coils its sinuous body around the trees it claims as its own, defending them to its last breath. Its magnificent pink flowers act as electrical conductors, amplifying the energy of its discharge attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its beauty rivals that of Milotic. Though gentle in nature, it will not hesitate to attack with draconic ferocity. Its petal-like tendrils produce a fragrance that is highly sought after by perfumers.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Fusing seems to have brought out latent traits from Meganium's Mega-Evolution. Though they resemble flowers, the blooms around POKENAME's neck are actually its gills.
author: hophoppip

entry: In summer, POKENAME's floral mane radiates a sweet scent with relaxing properties. It is very rare for POKENAME to lose its composure, but when it does, its breath becomes incandescent.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME release clouds of spores from their flowers to disorient and confuse their opponents, punching with enough force to clear the pollen after the effects set in. They sway while they fight to prepare for attacks and further confuse their foes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Successful gardens are often tended to by POKENAME, who use their arms to accomplish more work in half the time. Research has shown that the pollen from POKENAME's flower increases plant growth.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is a favorite in Contests for its ability to make dazzling displays with its petals and tentacles. The origin of its shades is unknown.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: Flowers bloom where POKENAME gallop. The ashes their fire spreads give nutrients to all kinds of flora.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A symbol of longevity, POKENAME revives any deceased coral it stumbles upon. It is thought to be a major reason why Corsola have not gone fully extinct.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Herds of POKENAME migrate across the world, using their energy to breathe life back into destroyed ecosystems. They bring good fortune to gardeners.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The water that shoots from POKENAME's cannons is rich with nutrients. Forests where POKENAME dwell are said to always be in everlasting bloom.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is commonly spotted among blooming flowers in the springtime. It exudes an aroma from its pendulum that can revitalize even withered plants.
author: noel5229

entry: In ancient times, this Pokémon was deified as an almighty protector because of the illuminated markings on its shell.  When POKENAME sleeps in empty fields, vibrant gardens grow around it.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Although small and weak when it first hatches, POKENAME continues to undergo some physical development during its early years, even before it evolves. POKENAME sleep curled up as tightly as possible.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The intensity of POKENAME's flames is directly tied to the level of harmony between its heads. When all three get along and agree on a course of action, the fire becomes a white-hot inferno.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME wave around large bones to scare off would-be threats while their flames burn bright. They are very meek, however, and will cry and run away if their intimidation fails.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feeds on the methane released from geothermal vents and can often be found clustered around newly-forming volcanoes. Their flames burn a bright blue, using the methane they consume as a means of propulsion.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It propels itself at speed using the thrust generated by the flames it can blast from the vents at the back of its shell. It only emerges when it needs to feed, as it lives in constant fear of the predators lurking in its territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When preparing to charge an opponent, powerful bursts of flame shoot from POKENAME's back. POKENAME's horn, which is harder than stone, can become red-hot and burn anyone who touches it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When preparing to charge an opponent, powerful bursts of flame shoot from POKENAME's back. POKENAME's horn, which is harder than stone, can become red-hot and burn anyone who touches it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It peacefully crawls along tree bark, averaging 20 feet a day. If any Pokémon try to pick on POKENAME, it will erupt in flames to deter them.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Though normally it keeps its shell coated in flame for self-defense, POKENAME can easily retract the fires to allow others to ride on its back. Land-based POKENAME are often seen carrying young children to school.
author: sk372

entry: Though normally it keeps its shell coated in flame for self-defense, POKENAME can easily retract the fires to allow others to ride on its back. Water-based POKENAME are most often seen carrying people across small lakes.
author: sk372

entry: When inhabiting areas with lots of fast predators, POKENAME adapt by using their rear flames to rocket themselves away from danger. On the other hand, POKENAME in areas with large foes adapt by creating a large puff of flames for intimidation.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME's processing systems are under stress, it vents excess energy as powerful bursts of flame. Researchers and Trainers alike must take great care in monitoring the needs of this Pokémon as a result.
author: mepp.

entry: It is shy and unable to completely control its fiery powers, so giving physical affection to POKENAME is generally not advised. Several Pokémon Breeders have suggested that playing games with it is a much better way to build up its trust.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is metamorphosing within its hardened chrysalis. The fluid within it is the same temperature as molten lava.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It propels itself through the air using combustions on its back. It needs to drink a gallon of honey a day, or it will lose flight capability.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can be found at the sites of forest fires, eating the leftover seeds. When it expels flames, it scatters the seeds to grow again.
author: skymaster426

entry: Despite their cute appearance and friendly nature, POKENAME bite to signify affection. Their flames flare constantly due to their joyful energy, making them a handful for most Trainers.
author: sk372

entry: The small flames flickering on its feathers allow the rest of its flock to spot it even while it flies at night. POKENAME is an extremely timid creature that avoids fighting at all costs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Rival POKENAME get into light shoving matches over food. Should one be toppled over backwards, the flames it shoots from its back propel it back to its feet to continue the fight.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is the perfect partner for cuddles, as its wool is very soft and plesantly warm. Although its wool can't be dyed, it is a popular material for making clothes for cold weather because it constantly emits an enjoyable heat.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME protects itself by igniting flames from its tail, fueled by the toxic film it secretes for defense.
author: anarchaz

entry: When it flaps its wings, it releases bursts of hot air, creating gusts that disorient foes. These waves of heat also give it an advantage in aerial battles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constantly sniff at the air to find food, their sense of smell being keen enough to find anything edible even if it's buried underground. They use their paws to dig toward their meals and their flames to cook it to perfection.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's wings are made out of flames that grow stronger as it matures. Its favorite activity revolves around flying incredibly close to people's heads, barely avoiding contact.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An armory of POKENAME is enough to keep a small village warm. Hugging one can cure hypothermia.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME does not produce enough flame to fly. Instead, it uses its fiery wings for defense.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME brings a warming glow to those that encounter it. It is said that POKENAME shimmers in vivid colors before those able to find love in anyone.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: To defend itself from being smacked by packets while traveling through data streams, it summons floating fireballs to revolve around it like guardians. When it curls up into a ball, it releases a signal that causes computers to switch to safe mode.
author: soup1900

entry: Wild POKENAME have learned to avoid predators and people by hiding among torches and imitating them with the flames on their head. They will spit fire at any who approach them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME uses the flames on its back to propel itself forward in wild jump kicks. It can also use this ability to run faster.
author: robosoup

entry: It is an incredibly rare Pokémon that lives far away from humankind. It can sense others without the need of the five senses thanks to the horn on its head. It is extremely timid and often refuses to battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME enjoy poking at their peers with their flaming snout but feel dejected when this playfulness is not reciprocated. Developing their sense of confidence is of utmost importance if a Trainer wants them to become a reliable partner.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If an angry Cyndaquil goes beyond its limits and perishes, POKENAME bursts out of its body. These are highly uncontrollable Pokémon.
author: mrbapcik

entry: Some stories claim that a POKENAME is born from the joining of souls of children lost to flames and infernos. This spectral POKENAME is bound to a volcanic rock with an oddly-familiar shape.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has an easygoing and upbeat personality. It often flares up the flames on its tail when happy, though typically without thinking about whether any other creature might be nearby when it does.
author: sk372

entry: A singular warm twig grows on POKENAME's back, a sign of the potential for strong growth in its future. It ignites its back in self-defense if anything draws too close, but the flames do not harm the plant itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are playfully aggressive creatures that enjoy roughhousing with their peers. If they are excluded from games because they are too aggressive, they pout and remain upset until they find an alternate activity to partake in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its blade's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its guard's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The flames on its tail burn brightly when threatened. When fighting, they will enflame their ribbons and lash them out against their foes.
author: melodydelune

entry: It is veiled in superheated plasma that can instantly incinerate grass and flowers on contact. It is very timid and shy, darting away to avoid others after startling them with flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoy trips to the salon because they enjoy clean, spotless fur. After they are done with their grooming session, they enjoy sitting idle with their flaming tails curled around their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will spew molten sand from its mouth onto its attacker. It lives in harsh desert climates, radiating its heat through the flames on its back.
author: mistymagius

entry: Flocks of POKENAME sleep on fruit trees and sometimes doze off right in the middle of a meal. These Pokémon live in large families.
author: mrbapcik

entry: As it rolls, it leaves a burning path in its wake, scorching anything it touches. This blazing trail makes it a formidable foe during battles.
author: .izik

entry: Its flames blaze intensely whenever it cries, making it difficult to comfort. This emotional outburst often forces others to keep their distance.
author: .izik

entry: A swirling vortex of flames surrounds its den, deterring would-be intruders. Only the bravest Pokémon dare approach its blazing lair.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's coloration varies based on its diet; it builds its nest to best camouflage its body. Wild POKENAME hibernate during the winter, and their fiery pom-poms are lit only for battle to conserve energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It emits flames from its sides to fly and protect itself. The flames serve as propulsion to keep it aloft.
author: abhatu

entry: While POKENAME can use Fire-Type moves, it must be careful not to overexert itself: if its moist body dries out, it becomes deeply unhealthy. As a result, POKENAME tend to dwell near peaceful rivers and streams.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If submerged in a pond, it causes the water to boil instantly. This strange ability makes it a dangerous companion around water.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is threatened, the parasitic mushrooms on its back burst into flames, releasing clouds of spore-filled smoke. The mushrooms have great health benefits and can be boiled to make a spicy herbal tea.
author: sadfroghours

entry: It resides on islands made of cooled magma, finding warmth in the volcanic rock. This environment ensures it stays comfortable despite any changes in weather.
author: .izik

entry: It only opens its eyes during a solar eclipse. When it flies through the night sky, it resembles a shooting star.
author: cait_sith

entry: Called “skittish firecrackers” in Aloha, POKENAME are timid Pokémon that travel in groups of up to 20 during hatching season. When frightened, their backs erupt in flames and they scuttle away at high speed, incinerating anything in their path.
author: oddly.abnormal

entry: When threatened, POKENAME's entire body bursts into flames. If the fire doesn't scare off its foe, the smell of burning fur certainly will.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME ignites its entire body at once using a specialized gland in its lower back. It isn't known how POKENAME is able to put itself out on command, however.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME are curious creatures that love to explore the world around them. When they are particularly excited about something, the flame on their tails gets incredibly hot.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If pursued while tunneling, POKENAME superheats the surrounding soil. The sizzling dirt slows predators long enough for escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their flames to soften the soil and rocks around them, making them easier to dig through in their search for food. Large populations can cause issues for the stability of buildings, as their tunnels sometimes cut through foundations.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As a pet, POKENAME is affectionate, but finicky. It enjoys being pet, but only for a certain amount of time; once it's done receiving affectionate, it flares fire on its back to let others know it no longer wishes to be touched.
author: sk372

entry: Its speed increases significantly when it consumes spicy peppers. These fiery treats fuel both its flame and its agility.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can set the spoon it carries on fire with a mere flick of the wrist. While alight, the fire helps it focus, increasing the potency of its telekinetic capabilities.
author: sk372

entry: It channels embers into its punches, delivering fiery blows to opponents. Each strike leaves a smoldering mark on whatever it hits.
author: .izik

entry: The flames on POKENAME come out when it is battling, when it is excited, or whenever it sneezes. As a result, it is not considered suitable for riding.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A largely sedentary Pokémon, POKENAME will happily—if somewhat obliviously—provide wandering Trainers with a warm fire. Some campers roast marshmallows by skewering them on its tail, producing an ultra-sweet flavor.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Unlike other Slowbro fusions, POKENAME achieves evolution by having the flame engulfing its sweet-tasting tail reach a critical temperature. Only the bravest of Pokémon will ever attempt to latch on and endure the intense heat.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Despite its hydrodynamic form, it does not enjoy swimming. As it chooses to move sluggishly on land, it is left vulnerable to predators.
author: vaporvenator

entry: The flames that make up its body burn more vigorously when POKENAME is startled, releasing toxic fumes that wilt any plant it passes by. Touching it causes severe burns and poisoning that require extensive hospitalization.
author: skyrvr

entry: It controls its flames with psychic powers, shaping them into precise forms. This unique skill makes its fire-based attacks highly unpredictable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are mainly nocturnal and possess a wide, varied diet of both physical matter and dreams. They hunt and scavenge with their flames unlit, but young POKENAME have trouble controlling their embers when happy and full.
author: bobosmith01

entry: There is a thin but dense layer of fat over its powerful muscles that protects its body from the elements. POKENAME is said to have a courageous fighting spirit, no matter its own strength or size.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spits fireballs and throws its club during battle. If it ever loses its club, it will cry without end, and its flames will uncontrollably flare up.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's hide is as tough as rock, supposedly because it lives deep within volcanic areas for most of its life. Its bone has been treated with clay and a yet-unknown means that have made it both flame resistant and incredibly tough.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are popular aquarium Pokémon thanks to the beauty of the flames they produce. They need to be kept in specialised tanks, however, as very few other Water-Type Pokémon can tolerate the same tank as POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In lieu of ventral and dorsal fins, POKENAME sprouts intense plumes of flame. While they're unable to be extinguished by water, it means POKENAME boils the rivers it calls home, leaving itself and other Water-types helpless in the resulting canyons.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: The intense heat that radiates from POKENAME's flames causes powerful updrafts that allow it to glide high in the sky. These updrafts even affect other Pokémon, such as Hoppip, causing them to travel in different directions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The fur around POKENAME's neck is always warm to the touch. Fashion designers sometimes collect its shed fur to create scarves that are both warm and soft.
author: kilo_forte

entry: It steals honey from Beedrill by smoking out their nests. Its superheated drills pierce right through their hives, allowing honey to flow out.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's fire is both incredibly strong and superheated, yet it miraculously doesn't harm any plant it spreads over. This is because the fire is filled with the power to revitalize plants, so any damage done by the fire is ironically burned away.
author: soup1900

entry: It has a timid disposition, but watch out! If POKENAME turns away from you, it's likely to blast you with fire from its back.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: The fires erupting from POKENAME are well above 10,000 ℉. Trainers often find it difficult to manage this Pokémon due to the immense heat it radiates.
author: theartemis1

entry: The fires erupting from POKENAME are well above 10,000 ℉. Trainers often find it difficult to manage this Pokémon due to the immense heat it radiates.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME love sandy beaches. They can be found playing with each other in the sand before diving into the water to cool off. It is clear when a group has passed, as they superheat some of the sand into smooth glass.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME enjoy spending time near volcanoes, as the arid climate reduces the amount of moisture they come across. Frequent naps make people question how they find time for gathering food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are surprisingly aggressive and hostile when approached. They can heat their fangs to be hot enough to melt through even the toughest steel.
author: evilgammon
