entry: POKENAME's white exoskeleton is covered in red and blue patterns. Every time it sheds its exterior, the fresh undercoat soon hardens to become even stronger than before.
author: richardcareylol

entry: POKENAME throws absolute tantrums any time it doesn't get what it wants. To make things worse, POKENAME is also never satisfied with what it gets.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME does not know how to defend itself and will just sit there and cry for its mother. Despite being a hassle to take care of, it brings happiness and tranquility to those who raise it well.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME shells often bear superficial damage, the thin rocky crust prone to breaking apart under force. Mildly toxic gas escapes their shell through these cracks, inducing feelings of euphoria in those that breath it in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's sense of smell is so acute that it can detect fluctuations in emotions by scent alone. It sidles up to those that are feeling sad and nuzzles them to bring them some comfort.
author: sk372

entry: As soon as they hatch, POKENAME are swift predators capable of shooting jets of water up to fifteen meters away. Their bodies are soft and they have no scales for protection, as they use their old egg shells to help protect themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a leathery shell around their bodies that slowly hardens over time. As they grow, this shell hardens into small, uniform scales.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are enthusiastic practitioners of many different kinds of martial arts. In their youthful exuberance, they often overreach and try to fight foes that are far beyond their skill levels.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME feels a compulsion to follow after anything it senses exuding joy or excitement. POKENAME parents and Trainers alike find themselves working hard to keep it from running off constantly.
author: sk372

entry: When its Trainer is feeling down, POKENAME will shock them with a small jolt of electricity to get them energized. However, it can't control its electricity that well, often discharging more energy than is necessary.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME senses laughter or nearby happiness, its internal flames surge in strength. Flickers of fire can be seen dancing around it as if echoing its emotion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in small burrows just underground from popular hiking trails. It thrives off the feelings of pleasure and calmness that radiates off of nearby adventurers. Despite this, they are incredibly shy and refuse to show themselves to others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's shell fists hit with surprising force, knocking even strong defensive Pokémon back with each pummelling strike. It is extremely frail however, with only a few decent strikes being enough to make it faint.
author: evilgammon

entry: Expecting parents will often receive a POKENAME at their baby shower to give to their child. The POKENAME is said to bring happiness and good fortune to the child it grows up with.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME are friendly and cheerful Pokémon who love to gather and share food with others. If given food, they will not rest until they can gift food in return. If one denies their offering of food, they will loudly cry.
author: infinex21

entry: Rarely seen and with few verified records of it in history, POKENAME is said to be the embodiment of joy and innocence itself. Those who gaze upon its form will feel all aggression and negative emotions drain from their minds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are born curled up in a ball, a posture they assume to defend themselves and when they feel anxious. They thrive when exposed to the feelings of compassion and joy from others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sheds the pale leafy parts of its body monthly. Insects and other small creatures will gather the shed leaves to help make nests, which seem to foster better health in young reared within said nests.
author: sk372

entry: A friendly forest denizen, POKENAME is innocent and always trying to make new friends. It gathers up pretty-looking leaves to collect, and shares them with those it hopes to befriend.
author: sk372

entry: A cheerful Pokémon that's hard not to smile at. If housed with newly hatched baby Pokémon, POKENAME will help them feel calmer and less timid.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are usually seen with their parents, as this Pokémon has a hard time being independent. When left or alone or can't find its parents, POKENAME will cry out loudly and throw a kicking temper tantrum.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is said to bestow a minor blessing of luck to anyone it meets with a kind heart. It saves the best blessing for its Trainer, however; owners are said to never have bad luck as long as POKENAME is near.
author: sk372

entry: At first glance, the hole in POKENAME's back reveals only an empty shell. However, those close to it know the shell is filled with concentrated joy. POKENAME shares its stock of joy freely, giving extra-pure portions to those suffering from loss.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME hatch from eggs laid in dams, hatching in hidden chambers within the structures. They keep their eggshell around their bodies to help protect them against danger whilst they grow up.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a scent from the giant flower on their back that induces feelings of generalised positivity and friendliness in those that smell it. They are peaceful Pokémon and tend to enjoy the company of others.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body is extremely flexible. When threatened, it will curl up and hide in its egg shell for protection.
author: typhloquil

entry: It won't leave its eggshell unless it feels completely safe. It is an incredibly picky eater and tends to dislike sour foods.
author: cait_sith

entry: It doesn't know it has hatched from its egg yet, and keeps within its shell for protection. When it is surrounded by smells it enjoys, it evolves.
author: skymaster426

entry: Though the blade is many times larger than the body, POKENAME wields it with surprising ease and agility. A popular children's show starring POKENAME is currently entering its fourth season.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an innocent and joyful soul that seeks to bless any kind person it comes across. A brush from its ribbons not only fills one with joyous feelings, but is believed to grant good luck for the next week.
author: sk372

entry: It grows immensely attached to the first person it sees. It is immensely durable, and will scooch after them through rain and snow until they reunite.
author: skymaster426

entry: This young Pokémon seems to have gotten its head stuck in its egg, rendering it unable to see. It headbutts anything it bumps into when walking.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: Said to only grant wishes to pure-hearted children, POKENAME is a popular figure in nursery rhymes. A child that gazes into its third eye will know nothing but happiness for the rest of their days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers to live away from other Pokémon and instead only associates with its family. As it matures, the shell around its midsection becomes harder and more colorful.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME emanates an aura of joy and positivity. POKENAME uses its empathetic nature to find others who feel similarly.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME emits high-speed melodies that seem to alter moods on a cellular level. It gathers in gloomy town squares where its songs stir smiles from even the most despondent.
author: .izik

entry: While outgoing and social, POKENAME also gets upset very easily. It is only when POKENAME learns to regulate their own emotions can its Togepi DNA evolve further.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite looking similar to an eggshell, POKENAME's body is highly sturdy and resistant to blows. It has no natural predators, so it has a very curious personality and approaches strangers without a care.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces fire that twinkles in all different colors, usually red and blue. It's beloved at special occasions as a result, with it lighting anything from bonfires to small candles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's bud only opens when it is exposed to positive emotions. Its bud produces small bursts of pollen whenever POKENAME gets excited.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a popular gift presented to game winners at carnivals. It's said that no child is unhappy if they're holding a POKENAME's strings, and vice-versa.
author: sk372

entry: A beacon of hope for those lost in the forest, POKENAME produces spores that can help clear and ease the mind. It is very friendly and helpful by nature, guiding people and POKENAME through the woods it calls home.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often appears floating around the cribs of newborns at night. Unlike many other ghostly Pokémon, its presence is welcomed; many believe it only haunts near children destined to grow up happy and healthy.
author: sk372

entry: Though blind, POKENAME can sense the hearts of others nearby, whether wicked or kind. It only bites and draws blood from those it deems as possessing a wicked heart.
author: sk372

entry: It attaches itself to people with hearts of compassion and joy. Being young and inexperienced, it sometimes bites off more than it can chew, though.
author: togetik

entry: If a flock of POKENAME hears the sound of a melodious singing voice, they will be overwhelmed with joy and spend the day helping with daily chores. Observed tasks include dishwashing, hanging clothes to dry, and dusting with their tail feathers.
author: lampent12

entry: At first, Trainers remark on how aloof a POKENAME can be. With some patience, it will come out of its shell, after which, Trainers come to miss when it would keep its poison barbs to itself.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME spends most of their time sleeping to conserve the energy that they need to grow. Waking a POKENAME is a very bad idea; it will run down the first person it sees until it tires itself out again.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME are controversial due to their violent outbursts, but their Trainers insist that POKENAME can read people's intentions, only targeting those who wish to do harm. Their alleged powers are not admissible in Kantonian nor Johtonian courts.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Newly hatched POKENAME carry pieces of their eggshell for added protection. Though fragile, these shells are a source of comfort and security when startled.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME is quite protective of young Pokémon in the wild. If it spots danger, it hides the young in its egg-like lower jaw and runs off with great haste, releasing them once they've made it to safety.
author: sk372

entry: When confronted with negative emotions, POKENAME tightens its cloak around it and hides itself from the world. The cloak emanates a faint calming aura during this time that alleviates stress and aggression in those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found prancing through blooming flower fields, chirping happy little tunes. It flicks pollen from its leaves at those it deems good souls; inhaling it brings calm and joy for hours.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is reclusive and shy, but can be seen quietly approaching wakes for the deceased. Its slow and careful dance moves are said to soothe the minds of the grieving, as well as the soul of the recently-departed.
author: sk372

entry: Although many stories claim these Pokémon are born from the spirits of unhatched Pokémon, POKENAME are extraordinarily joyful and outgoing. They go wherever they feel positive emotions, basking in them and passively feeding on them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are either too weak to fully break free of their eggs after having hatched or they keep part of their eggs to defend themselves with. They will, quite literally, attach themselves to those they grow fond of.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have trouble standing on their own and rely on their parents or Trainers for assistance until their legs are strong enough. They develop a strong emotional bond with those who raise them.
author: chibitales

entry: It is said that melting ice from POKENAME's body results in a sweet liquid with a flavor reminiscent of vanilla. However, the extremely cold eggshell on its lower half keeps POKENAME's body from becoming warm enough to melt.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's mood is easily influenced by those around it. If influenced by negative feelings, it will throw a tantrum and flail its arms wildly, causing destruction until calmed.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME loves hugs but often forgets about its sharp spines until it's too late. As its tentacles grow longer, the brittle shell that protects them will slowly begin to break apart.
author: mistymagius

entry: Because of its spiky body, POKENAME wears its eggshell so it can touch people without causing harm. It is almost always happy, hugging anything that gives it joy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing with young children at the beach, forming shapes together with its sandy body. Touching the shell-like top of its head will cause it to instinctively fling sand and run away, however.
author: sk372

entry: The eggshell stuck on POKENAME's neck and tail is hard as rock. It seeks affection from anyone that smiles at it.
author: .realthree

entry: Idolizing packs of wild Scraggy, POKENAME has taken to using the little they are born with to emulate the fashion that they so adore. POKENAME does not seem to understand the difference between a cap and a hood.
author: wilmervr

entry: POKENAME has a simple mind that equates money with joy. To spread that joy around, it collects any and all shiny coins it finds and gifts them to others.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME's tail glows, it shares the feelings of happiness that it has stored. POKENAME is too weak to defend itself, so it can't stop wild Pokémon from following it to feed off of these good feelings.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's body shudders with excitement when floating near happy people. Unfortunately, this also causes the surrounding area to drop to freezing temperatures instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carries soil in its eggshell to help it collect water and nutrients as it journeys. However, the cracks in the shell for its feet leak soil, so it must refill often with dirt from all over the region.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME drops an egg-shaped lure from the treetops to trick egg-hunting creatures into taking the bait. Once it's grabbed, it drags them up into its mouth and swallows them whole.
author: sk372

entry: Even though POKENAME have an exhausted expression, they love to play with Pokémon around them. They are cautious creatures that hold back whenever they play with baby Pokémon to avoid crushing anyone beneath them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy taking care of eggs that are abandoned in caves, keeping them warm in their rocky den. It is said that giving them shiny stones fills them with so much glee that they evolve shortly thereafter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A baby Pokémon freshly hatched from its egg, POKENAME has not yet shed its egg fully and uses the remaining shell to protect its body. Its hind legs are far more well-developed than the rest of its body and are used for escape.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has the ability to subtly influence the emotions and reactions of others. If it wants to play, others will feel a slight urge to interact; if it wants to eat, others may feel hungry. There is no evidence it uses this ability intentionally.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME only approaches those it senses kind and positive energy from. Tapping those it comes near with its stick causes them to feel a warm and joyous sensation filling them.
author: sk372

entry: Some segments of POKENAME's body are brittle and chip away to reveal the flesh underneath. These parts are very sensitive, and POKENAME will cry and thrash about if they are touched.
author: sk372

entry: It is considered good luck to fall asleep under the influence of a POKENAME's hypnosis. After eating their target's dreams, POKENAME breaks a sliver of their shell to leave behind as a calling card.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME innocently pokes and prods at any litter it comes across while roaming the beach shores. It seems particularly intrigued by egg shell shards from the occasional abandoned nest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are jovial creatures that love to spend quality time with their Trainer, especially hikes in the forest. They release a sweet pollen from the bulb on their back whenever they are happy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fishermen believe that using POKENAME as bait leads to better catches because they bring good luck. In reality, their gooey bodies are incredibly sticky and cause aquatic Pokémon that take the bait to stick to the hook.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear skull helmets atop their heads to ensure that they do not receive concussions while they play games. As soon as they're done with their fun, the skulls come off their heads to allow fresh air to pass by their heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are light on their feet, their footwork immaculate as they dance in and out of a fight with their boxing. Watching a match between two POKENAME invariably thrills those watching as the joy of the fight radiates off of them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Anthropologists note an odd division in opinion on the colorful plumes of smoke POKENAME exudes from its body. Warm, tropical cultures often use its vapors as laughing gas, while northern cultures judge them garish and overbright.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: Apothecaries believe that the cocoons of POKENAME prevent illness because of the good luck they bestow. In reality, the empty cocoons of POKENAME are high in antioxidants, leading to a boosted immune system.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swims in gentle arcs near kindhearted people. It releases glimmering bubbles as a form of quiet affection and trust.
author: .izik

entry: Artists believe that POKENAME scales contain good luck and coat their paintings with a varnish made out of these scales. In reality, POKENAME scales contain a sealant that protects the painting from humidity, increasing the value of the artwork.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It can usually be found floating around in tall grass, singing to injured Pokémon in an effort to help them. It is said that traveling with this Pokémon can bring the Trainer good luck.
author: curvingapollo

entry: POKENAME stings others to cause intense feelings of joy. It believes it is spreading happiness, unaware that its toxins can have harmful effects if overexposed.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen in the wild, supposedly only appearing before people with kind and pure hearts. It's noted for singing while it swims, a soft melody that soothes the hearts of those who manage to hear it.
author: sk372

entry: It always uses its transformations for the benefit of others.  If its Trainer is upset, it will use its ability to sense what will make them happy, then turn into it.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME emits a gentle aura through keyboards that calms those typing nearby. The soothing effect strengthens as it consumes more data.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can gracefully glide downwards towards the ground when it falls out of trees, making it much less of a danger to itself and those around it.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME makes burrows in clouds. Its body is soft to the touch, but cannot be pierced.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that make their nests far from human civilization. They are drawn to strong positive emotions and are most commonly seen by Hikers that are enjoying their travels.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that make their nests far from human civilization. They are drawn to strong positive emotions and are most commonly seen by Hikers that are enjoying their travels.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME wend their way around mountainous terrain, their serpentine bodies perfect for moving around the treacherous environment. When they encounter people they will flap their tiny wings in delight and try to protect the person from the elements.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The red stinger contains a lethal neurotoxin. The blue stinger contains the antidote. Mean people get stung with the red stinger and don't get the blue stinger until they change their ways.
author: musicsheep.

entry: By spinning the leaf above its head, POKENAME can create an aroma capable of easing anxiety and tension. Its calm and gentle nature makes it an excellent emotional-support Pokémon, and many therapists recommend it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The warmth and joy from the fusion between Togetic and Typhlosion resulted in POKENAME. Despite being a ferocious battler, it's also a great friend.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its massive jaw is always smiling with its 48 pristine teeth. It smiles to try to bring joy to people, because it cannot process negativity very well.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Most POKENAME are very physically oriented towards physical contact, both in affection and in fights. It synthesizes nearby feelings of happiness and usually attempts to help others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The songs of POKENAME have been shown to bring listeners pleasant dreams and restful sleep. They delight in the feelings of a good dream and can often be found around campsites.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Kind people who enter forests are often followed by a flock of POKENAME. If anyone tries to attack the person whom they follow, the offender will be pelted with twigs or anything else nearby that POKENAME can carry.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME stalk those who enter their forest, keeping a close eye on strangers. Counting the number of POKENAME in the nearby trees is said to predict events in the near future, which is influenced by the good luck POKENAME bestow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gather together on starry nights to fly together and bask in the beauty of the stars above. Seeing them flying en masse is said to be a blessing that bestows fantastic luck on one fortunate enough to witness it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies over groups of people, intent on spreading joy to others however it can. This usually takes the form of fluttering over to someone and clinging to them in a friendly hug.
author: sk372

entry: Driven by memories of when it was itself weak, this Pokémon fancies itself a protector of the defenseless. It patrols the sky and swoops down to ground level when it espies predation. It relishes bringing happiness to underdogs.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: POKENAME are able to fly in perfect formation with other members of their flock even without being able to see them. They do this by sensing the emotions of other POKENAME, adjusting their flight patterns based on whether they still sense the flock.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will only evolve with a Trainer if it believes they are pure of heart. If they don't, when they level up, they harness the power of evolution to throw a large ball of goo at their Trainer, which causes mild rashes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is a social Pokémon that feeds off the negative emotions of those nearby, causing them to lose feelings of stress and feel refreshed. However, it sometimes means that they lose motivation to fix the problems in their life.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's pristine exterior is the result of it shedding its exoskeleton many times before it evolved, hardening it further each time. It will continue to shed its outer shell multiple times in order to reach its final evolution.
author: gloomymort

entry: Its smile belies its mischievous nature. It bears gifts of coins and shiny objects to Trainers, only to steal the Trainer's own valuables while they're occupied. It freezes pursuers in place with an Icy Wind.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are known for their simultaneously caring yet teasing personalities, earning them a reputation as equal parts heavenly and hellish. Despite this, they are believed to be incredibly purehearted, risking life and limb when needed.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME's egg-like shells are rumoured to bring good fortune to those who are able to make them hatch. In reality, they are simple rocky shells, though POKENAME enjoy the pampering they receive from those attempting to hatch them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can sniff out people's emotions and will gravitate toward those feeling sad or lonely. They will snuggle up to these people and make soothing noises, staying with them to offer comfort in their low moments.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can sniff out people's emotions and will gravitate toward those feeling sad or lonely. They will snuggle up to these people and make soothing noises, staying with them to offer comfort in their low moments.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can sniff out people's emotions and will gravitate toward those feeling sad or lonely. They will snuggle up to these people and make soothing noises, staying with them to offer comfort in their low moments.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME use their wing-like fins to propel themselves rapidly through the water, darting about faster than the Pokémon that would try to catch it. Successfully catching one while fishing is said to be a true test of skill.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME make collections of items on the sea floor, creating a small hoard of items that bring them joy. They give these items away to visitors if they bring a gift in turn, the value of the object mattering far less than the emotional significance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some POKENAME have better developed wings and snouts than others of their species. They use the better mobility granted to them by these differences to cover great distances in search of objects to collect that bring them joy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When it meets a kindhearted person, POKENAME rolls around them in ecstatic circles. Sometimes it builds up too much speed and crashes into buildings, then sheepishly offers a blessing of good luck.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Whenever POKENAME feel sad, they run a short line of code that instantly restores their mood. This simple program does wonders for POKENAME's emotional wellbeing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME run two lines of code that allow them to quickly change their mood. This is especially important when they need to cheer up at parties to make it through the night.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even though they can't truly fly, POKENAME use their small wings to improve their agility while fighting. They take great joy from combat and will seek out any opponent willing to face them, regardless of how strong they are.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME playfully blow kisses at anyone they notice feeling down, the adorable display helping to cheer up anyone who sees it. If the first attempt doesn't work, POKENAME will fly about on their tiny wings and strike poses to play up their cuteness.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME communicates with a series of bellowing roars that form a unique song. Mountain villages celebrate POKENAME's singing as a joyous event.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The elusive POKENAME were discovered by a ranger surveying a misty forest. They can detect the presence of others and even read emotions through the electric field.
author: cobalt0135

entry: In the past, POKENAME was hunted for its tail, which was believed to grant a life of good fortune when consumed. The species is rarely seen in the wild and considered critically endangered as a result.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wraps its twin tails around Trainers it likes, filling them with joy and serenity. It loves to collect eggs, but it's best to give it a sterile one, as it is not the best parent.
author: mistymagius

entry: Whenever it gets hungry, it dines on a healthy array of fruits to satisfy its sweet tooth. Apricots are traditionally fed to it when traded, to indicate a fresh start.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts through the sky on wind currents, constantly searching for sad people to cheer up. The triangular patterns on its white coat are different for each individual.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It shoots a kind of molten yolk that is peculiar to its species in chemical composition, and stays hot for far longer than normal lava. The yolk is stored in a super-compressed form in its body, giving the impression POKENAME has an endless supply.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: POKENAME's lightweight body lets it glide with ease, spreading joy throughout the world. It can sense when others are in need and can swiftly fly over to heal them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its wings remain too weak to stay in the air for long for a good portion of its life. Instead, it mostly digs underground to better train its body.
author: infinex21

entry: It's said that POKENAME bring good fortune and share their happiness with others, this leaves them with little good fortune for themselves. Due to a glitch, POKENAME's head stays detached from its body.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME will only appear before forest travelers if they are not deemed a threat to it or its home. Rarely, it will offer one of the colored leaves from its limbs, which many believe are charmed to bring good luck to the wearer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems to love chirping happily and hopping around in an attempt to spread its joy to others. When it witnesses an individual smile, overjoyed, POKENAME will flutter its wings, begin floating, and kick its feet.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Its sharp quills rise when it is exposed to negative emotions and lay flat when it is exposed to positive emotions. It uses its strong claws to dig up rocks and carve them into gifts for friends.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are used as mascots to sell fitness plans because of their aura of good luck and gleeful personality. Keeping POKENAME fit and motivated brings joy to everyone nearby.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The scales on POKENAME's body can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible. It emits a sparkling dust that promotes feelings of bliss to those that come in contact with it.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has a unique ability, possessing both blue and red aura in equal balance. It shares these with others in differing amounts, believed to be helping others balance their own aura and feel more at peace.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, POKENAME uses the love it has for its friends to persevere. It can feel every feeling its opponents feel.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Watching a POKENAME's flower blossom is said to bring good fortune to the observers due to the rarity of the event, their flowers opening just once in their lifetime. Their flowers remain in full bloom at all times of day, the sight inspiring joy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In moments of peril, a POKENAME may suddenly appear to shield good-hearted people from harm. It then vanishes without a trace.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME can be found relaxing in beautiful places. They're said to bring good fortune to whomever brings them an offering of sweet fruits.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME's energy intensifies during natural disasters, radiating waves of joy to those nearby. This misplaced happiness often leads people to underestimate the danger around them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits a powerful aura that enforces happiness on all nearby beings. Records claim this effect can influence up to 1,000 individuals at once.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's beak glows pink as it flies near those with pure hearts. It often perches on their shoulders, chirping softly in happiness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME offers itself to be held by kindhearted Trainers, who it fills with joy. However, the sword is disheartened by being used to draw blood.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Many legends claim POKENAME preys on the happiness of others, absorbing the most joy while people are mid-wish. Because of this, many shy away from being near it despite its adorable appearance.
author: .izik

entry: They say that this Pokémon brings good fortune to those who are pure of heart. Despite its kind-hearted nature, it is nearly impossible to soothe it once angered.
author: robbery_666

entry: Wild POKENAME can be heard singing deep within dense mist-shrouded forests. Following their voices through the mist is nearly impossible due to the reverberation of the dense forest.
author: cobalt0135

entry: It often floats over blooming fields, spreading joy wherever it goes. Its dance is said to heal broken hearts.
author: dammaskk

entry: POKENAME is full of felicity and expresses that joy wherever it goes. It shares tufts of fur from its tail with Trainers who reciprocate its happiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME is rarely seen, it is mostly known through folklore. These legends call it the “Joybringer”, as it invites those pure of heart to hold its tails to bless them with happiness for 1,000 years.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has a pure heart and a strong sense of justice, so much so that it often avoids those who hold dishonesty or cruelty in their hearts.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It is so lightweight that it may float in the air even without using its wings. To soothe and relax others, it plays an instrument and sings along. Those who listen to POKENAME's performance are said to feel exuberant the day after.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The multicolored fire POKENAME produces brings a sense of relief and joy in all who see or even smell it. For some reason, domesticated POKENAME love watching fireworks, but wild ones avoid the loud sounds.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It exudes joy and is almost constantly skipping and hopping around. POKENAME is said to bring good financial fortune to those around it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The pollen from POKENAME's flowers is said to bring pure happiness. Its flowers bloom largest when it lives around kindhearted people.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: POKENAME float freely through the air as fibrous string trails close behind them. There is a particular ritual of tying POKENAME to bridges after a major festival to help children transition back to normal life.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It's said that POKENAME has an innate ability to sense good fortune. If one sees it perk its ears up before running off somewhere, following it seems to inevitably lead to something fortuitous.
author: sk372

entry: A single POKENAME will lead a flock of their pre-evolutions from town to town. Under POKENAME's orders, they pick up trash and clean the neighborhood before flying off.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME flies through towns and cities, using their fire to burn loose trash. If they catch you littering, they will peck at you in a burning fury.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME escorts Togepi through caves by carrying them in its mouth and flying through caverns. In exchange for this aid, Togepi bestow good luck and positive feelings to POKENAME, which it happily accepts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Affectionate towards its Trainer, a POKENAME will seem to hold a grudge against certain people even before meeting them. Once POKENAME decides it doesn't like someone, it's very hard to change its mind.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME spends most of their time sleeping to conserve the energy that they need to grow. They can only rest if they are in the presence of people they trust.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME are valiant defenders of the peace. They staunchly oppose collaborating with those who wish to cause strife instead.
author: .fedoraman

entry: After shedding its fragile eggshell, POKENAME is much more curious of the outside world compared to its pre-evolution. It often allies with other young Pokémon for comfort.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME are very kind creatures, healing many targeted by predators. It swims at high speeds, finding any Pokémon in need of help.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's feathers are so soft that if you touch them, all of your negative emotions will magically disappear. It adores young children and will even allow them to ride on its back while it flies.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME typically take a protective role in their social network as a form of repayment to their community, whether it be other wild Pokémon or their Trainer's team. Their slime is said to have a great calming effect when the scent is inhaled.
author: gdottb

entry: POKENAME shares its happiness with those it finds pure of heart, wrapping its arms around the person in a tight hug. Unfortunately, POKENAME does not know its own strength and often injures those it tries to make happy.
author: chibitales

entry: If it finds someone in need of cheering up, it will hug them with its many tentacles to 'magically' make them feel better. These tentacles are very lightweight, allowing them to act as extra pairs of wings.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's shovel twitches when it detects kindhearted prey. With a silent swoop, it drops from above to drain joy into its white wings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are used as emotional therapy Pokémon as they bring great joy to those around them. Wild POKENAME will fly around, seeking people who need love and compassion.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME is unfailingly loyal to those with a kind heart. As a result, spiteful Trainers may find that it betrays them.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME is happy, it strikes the scales on its back with its tail. The resulting sound has been described as similar to that of a small metal xylophone.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a kind and gentle creature that thrives in the presence of positive emotions. Its friendly demeanor and vibrant coloring see it often employed as assistants and guides at circuses, fairs and other attractions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love collecting shiny trinkets. If they offer one of these baubles to their Trainer, it is a sign that great fortune will soon occur.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This cheerful Pokémon loves making others smile. When it's especially happy, a flurry of joy dust erupts from its back, bringing happiness to all surrounding it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are seen patrolling the tops of mountains, inspecting rocks to prevent rockslides. Rumors say POKENAME will help struggling mountaineers in exchange for shiny rocks and stones, which they like to eat.
author: npshi

entry: The red and blue pattern on the bodies of POKENAME are painstakingly painted onto their bodies by other POKENAME. It is said that helping POKENAME paint their bodies with these patterns will bring good luck.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A tail-shaped trail of sparkles follows behind the serene POKENAME. Standing in these sparkles will make one feel exuberant, although POKENAME does not seem to enjoy another doing so very much.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have formed a link between one another through their mutual desire to bring blessings to weary travelers through the use of bright electrical charges. Frequently, they have been confused with kindhearted pixies from folklore.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME have two heads that always seem to act contrary to each other. Through good fortune and compromise, POKENAME can overcome their differences to secure victory for their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is loved all around the world, with its infectious smile and adorable eyes making it difficult to hate. Due to being rare in the wild, thousands of people will come to wildlife parks just to see it.
author: mistymagius

entry: Because of POKENAME's appearance and its cheery personality, it became the mascot for a best-selling breakfast cereal. Lawsuits soon followed, when children tried licking its highly toxic body.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME freely give out their pearls to any divers they see. These pearls are exceptionally shiny and seem to bring good luck to those who hold them.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME seeks out the kind-hearted and bestows happiness to them. It is said that just one hug from this Pokémon can ward off nightmares for years.
author: noel5229

entry: At sun-warmed shores, POKENAME trails kind souls, scuttling close to guard them. Its claws snap fiercely at predators that wander too near.
author: .izik

entry: Despite is friendly nature, POKENAME is quite dangerous to train. It has a tendency to grab anyone it likes with its powerful pincers as a show of affection.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME use their thin beaks to pierce the pits of berries before replanting their seeds in the ground. They then eat the remaining berry while watching visions of the beautiful tree that will eventually grow where they planted it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its bone to glimpse five minutes into the future with perfect clarity. During these visions, it emits soft, rhythmic chirps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides among foliage and stares at passing humans. Its never been photographed, as it teleports away the moment it sees a camera.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME goes around the forest floor looking for seeds to eat. Its beak secretes a mild poison that weakens predators just enough to allow it to flee back into its home beneath tree trunks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very knowledgeable on the process and advantages of evolution, seeking out the evolution that they predict will benefit them the most. Domestic POKENAME can even predict which evolution will suit their Trainers or future teams best.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A chaotic creature indeed, POKENAME causes glitches aplenty when it appears on a person's computer. It will only fix the problems it causes if the user makes a deal with it, but the price is always steep.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME can stare through their eyelids even when they are asleep. In remote forests, POKENAME are often found staring at any kind of food nearby.
author: reese1017600

entry: It turns itself invisible in order to observe others. If you have a creeping feeling of something watching you, it is nearly always a POKENAME.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME hop about with their fiery feathers trailing behind them. They hold berries in their beaks and turn to cook them with the embers from their tails.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME refuses to make a nest in a dangerous place. It uses its ability to foresee the future to be aware of flooding or rock slides, ensuring that it always stays in a safe, secure location.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME has a vision of a terrible future, its head will spin in circles rapidly. If it is a particularly awful vision, the head will spin faster than normal, a sign of the intensity of its foreseeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its ability to foretell events to hunt. It will only go to a waterfall if it knows a Magikarp will soon ascend, ensuring it doesn't waste energy on unnecessary trips.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are known among enthusiasts for their shy and quirky personality. Many are easily frightened over random objects, while other phenomena, such as claps of thunder, leave them completely unfazed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are most often found at dusk, although they are still difficult to find due to their shyness and tendency to get overwhelmed. When the moon is full, they can jump thrice as high as normal.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has the power to see the future while it chirps in a melody. If it sees something awful, it will chirp louder than normal, its tune growing more frantic to signal impending trouble.
author: .izik

entry: Upon sensing bad luck or impure intentions, POKENAME will hop away as fast as it can. Unfortunately, it is not very speedy due to its short legs.
author: b_e_n_jamin_

entry: Wild POKENAME use their extendable necks to harvest berries that Natu normally cannot reach. If it sees happiness in a Trainer's future, it will begin to dance with joy.
author: b_e_n_jamin_

entry: POKENAME bears resemblance to old records of a supposedly now-extinct middle form between Natu and Xatu. It's quite intelligent and curious and can even use tools to draw and communicate with others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to determine if a dumpster has any edible food in it before it jumps in. Its powers are more flawed based on how hungry it is, sometimes leading to inaccurate predictions when starving.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to steal items from passing Trainers using its clawed tail. Due to its amazing sense of foresight, it is almost impossible to ambush, and most people never get their stuff back.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME secretes a gel from its feet that it can use to walk up any surface. Although unable to fly, they can dive into water from any height without injury, by contorting their body as they enter and using their head crest to break the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: At night, POKENAME stands motionless while gazing up at the moon. It's said to divine the future from this action, its wings spreading wide and its rings glowing bright when it receives a vision.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make popular messengers due to their ability to sense the best routes on their travels. It is advised not to ask them to deliver anything too shiny, as they may get distracted and try to keep the objects for themselves.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME weave complex nests of whatever materials they can find, from sticks, cotton, and even loose hair and fur. Those who disturb their nest suffer a terrible curse.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have hazy visions of the future that they rely on to avoid serious injury. When they are forced to fight another Pokémon, they observe their opponent to find the right moment and launch a counterattack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever there is a branching path for the future, the two heads of a POKENAME will see opposite outcomes and telepathically debate with each other. Folk tales tell of adventurers trying to interpret which head is seeing the truth to find their goal.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Due to its awkward body shape, POKENAME is unable to properly walk. It uses its wings and psychic power to propel itself in any direction.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME use their beaks to rapidly push dirt aside while they burrow into the ground. If they face any opposition, they will propel themselves backwards with psychic powers and start tunneling through dirt with their tails instead.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to predict where their prey will be before it can even move. Unfortunately, they tend to read too far into the future and dive before their visions can come true.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses its telepathy to communicate with others from its flock. If one sees any type of danger, they will coordinate flight patterns, avoiding threats by working together in perfect harmony.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME peers into a tree's past to see if others of its kind have fed there. It prefers its own chosen tree but will eat from a shared tree if starving.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a calm and calculating sort, spending a good chunk of its time meditating. It possesses mild precognition, able to anticipate predators trying to attack it while it meditates, and counter the attacks accordingly.
author: sk372

entry: The bubbling green goo on POKENAME's body becomes intensely hot while it is gazing into the future. It does this to protect itself during its visions, ensuring that no one can get too close during these moments of intense focus.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's long beak functions as a blowgun that can fire high-pressure water darts. However, the beak's awkward shape prevents it from swimming well.
author: chartanon

entry: POKENAME sway their heads from side to side and taste the air, seemingly at random , before they make any significant movement. Pokémon Researchers believe they are sensing different probabilities and determining what the future may hold.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other through a mix of stomping and telepathy. Herds of POKENAME roam open plains in search of tasty roots and shoots.
author: cait_sith

entry: It's speculated that about 10 percent of murals found on ancient Hoenn ruins were painted by POKENAME. Whether the art has deeper meaning or is simply ancient graffiti has yet to be determined.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are revered in some regions for their light footwork and nice crests. Many drink its milk seeking enlightenment, as it causes unique visions.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME lives in the trees in secluded forest areas and eat leaves and berries. It is a surprisingly powerful jumper and can clear distances several times its body size with ease.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's intense gaze draws the attention of passersby, when it will then begin to entertain and imitate them. When it grows bored, it performs a final grand trick before quickly fleeing.
author: arcul

entry: Although it is nearly nonexistent in the wild, there are rumors that POKENAME show up to signify a big event- a step towards destiny. However, this event can be good or bad, so if you see one it is best to brace yourself.
author: b_e_n_jamin_

entry: POKENAME are naturally curious Pokémon, which many attribute to their well-developed brains and potent psychic energies. Though still quick to startle, they will resort to spewing flames if they feel threatened.
author: infinex21

entry: Standing perfectly still when it enters battle, POKENAME will not strike until it senses hostility. If it has fought an opponent once before, it will be able to read the patterns of their strategy effortlessly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME scales short trees to peck at new shoots and replenish its vital fluids. After a meal, it enjoys playful mud baths.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME stand perfectly still in order to try and become one with their surroundings. They are able to hide in plain sight well enough to seemingly disappear despite the vibrant colors along their bodies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME frequently experience visions of approaching future distaters, but have trouble narrowing down the locations where they will take place. They rush to warn people as soon as possible, but often have to wait and see where they're needed most.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME drifts silently through the night, its small body cloaked in shadows. With glowing markings around its eyes and a mischievous nature, it plays tricks on unsuspecting travelers while using its psychic powers to create eerie illusions.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME are able to sense hostility from a single glance, rushing to defend themselves from any incoming threats. However, they occasionally sense the future hostility in response to their own attacks, causing their battles to start for no reason.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When flapping its wings, POKENAME releases a calming scent resembling a blend of apricots and mint. Many perfumers have attempted to replicate this aroma but have yet to do so perfectly.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME stands stock-still, it is believed to be peering into a world different from our own. It doesn't respond to interactions during this time, though its shadowy wings instinctively brush away anything trying to bother it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME predicts when keys go missing in order to find them and return them to their owners. What POKENAME doesn't realize is that its moving of the keys is often what leads them to go missing in the first place.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Due to its sharp eyesight and psychic powers, it never loses track of its prey. These qualities also make it an excellent partner for search and rescue missions.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME will frequently get visions of the past while it digs. During this time, its body will come to an abrupt stop until the vision ends, leaving it temporarily frozen in place as it experiences flashes of history.
author: .izik

entry: Since POKENAME cannot fly, it bounces using its round body to reach the Berries it loves. If it overeats, it sinks straight to the bottom the moment it steps into the water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Should POKENAME foresee a bad event, it will inhale air through its beak and drift into the sky, attempting to distance itself from the negative future it envisions and retreating until the danger passes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shell is just heavy enough to counterbalance its massive head. If it tips over, it must dig a hole with its feet and fall into it to recover its center of gravity.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Once a week, POKENAME gathers sticks together to light up with its flames and gaze into the smoke it creates. Some say it's attempting to discern future events through the smoke's shapes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sit in forests watching the sun through the dappled leaves. If they get hungry during their viewing, they will use their psychic powers to drop berries from the trees above them, the berries bouncing harmlessly off of their rubbery skin.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Despite the apparent bulk of their bodies, POKENAME are very light due to being mostly fluff. They can float long enough after a jump for the wind to catch them and propel them forwards on their travels.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME basks in the sun for long periods of time, being able to predict where food will be in advance. It can jump up to 10 feet and scale trees.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME are completely blind, but they can use their psychic powers to sense the area aound them with impressive accuracy. While they use their wings to steer, they mainly fly through levitation.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME cling onto Trainers or larger Pokémon that they predict will be good travel companions. While the initial meetings may not always be ideal, POKENAME never fail to find true friends.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The hats found on POKENAME are extremely flammable. When ready to evolve, groups of POKENAME gather their gemstones into a single pile and perform a ritual dance beneath the harsh sun of their natural habitat until their hats burn away.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME's feathers form a protective thermal layer as it scampers around its arctic habitat. It can foresee minor good fortune, so ice fishers will follow one to find a good spot to catch a lot of food.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME experience transient glimpses into the future, though the events they see are typically lackluster. The singular feather on their head is said to be the source of their visions, though the evidence is inconclusive.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings are underdeveloped, so it cannot use them to dance or fly. However, it still sways and turns to fascinate its enemies into inaction.
author: ziggaway

entry: Each spherical petal on a POKENAME's head is uniquely patterned, though these patterns can seem similar to untrained eyes. In addition to looking nice, they can amplify psychic powers.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME typically enjoy relaxing in fluffy clouds. Timid when around new Trainers or Pokémon, they can warm up to those whom they deem good at heart.
author: entomoxie

entry: Each spherical petal on a POKENAME's head is uniquely patterned, though these patterns can seem similar to untrained eyes. In addition to looking nice, they can amplify psychic powers.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME perches on tree limbs and observes fights from afar with its strong eyesight, cataloging the moves of different Pokémon. Pokémon often come to seek its advice on how to counter the techniques it has witnessed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can spend hours basking in the warm sand and observing the sun, enjoying this most as the sun sets. They seem to relax when doing this.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME peers into its opponent's mind and thoroughly judges them based on their actions. If it deems its opponent unworthy, it exits the battle.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME peers into its opponent's mind and thoroughly judges them based on their actions. If it deems its opponent unworthy, it exits the battle.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME can foresee events up to ten minutes ahead. If it predicts someone entering its feeding ground, it avoids the area for weeks.
author: .izik

entry: Being unable to fly due to its small wings, POKENAME hops in a zig-zag fashion to get around. Its bristly appearance allows it able to disguise itself as a cactus branch.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME skims across puddles of water in forest areas. It sometimes stops and rhythmically taps upon the water, casting ripples that some believe are an attempt to communicate a message to others.
author: sk372

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME feathers have been popular accessories for jewelry as they were believed to be symbols of a prosperous future. POKENAME often purposefully scatter feathers on their travels to try and keep the tradition and hopes going.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Once, it glimpsed sidereal portents, but a gluttonous life has dulled its spiritual senses. Now, it feeds like there's no tomorrow, while its brain works overtime to repress visions of the consequences of its own bad habits.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: Even if POKENAME sees a foe charging at it, POKENAME will fail to react in any reasonable amount of time. Scientists believe that POKENAME is so preoccupied trying to ease its constant headaches that it often fails to process the physical world.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME change their form to conform to the weather around them. Their glimpses into the future help people plan important events and avoid rain or snow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's mental capacity is at its greatest when its basking in the summer sunlight. Its cranium glows brightly and spreads a warmth that is said to increase the intellect of those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: When a POKENAME's red clouds form a whirlwind around its body, it's gazing into the future. Wild POKENAME use their future vision to predict snowy weather, their favorite kind, so they know when to emerge.
author: hophoppip

entry: Should POKENAME see in the future that something bad is going to happen, its fur will become incredibly hot. Its fur can get hot enough to cause fires in dry foliage, making it a harbinger of danger when its heat increases.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps while standing upright, sometimes even while keeping its eyes open. The flame on its tail may change into a variety of different colors as it dreams.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spends much of the day staying still with its arms crossed in contemplation. Occasionally it stares into its reflection in its spoon, but what it ascertains from this is unknown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly works to improve its mind and body, training by cooperating with humans. Miners enjoy working with it due to its enthusiasm, and because its foresight leads it to start an evacuation if it foresees disaster.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to speedily comprehend any language spoken to it. It uses this knowledge to understand commands of combatants from all regions as it perfects its physical abilities.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are very curious by nature, but their habit of waddling up close to people and staring them in the eyes silently puts them somewhere between cute and unnerving.
author: banquoviaquo

entry: POKENAME has sharp eyesight and even sharper reflexes. If it spots something approaching while out gathering food, it flings itself off the ground with its strong arms and hurtles its entire body towards the interloper.
author: sk372

entry: The flame on POKENAME's head turns a deep blue while it is looking into the future. During this time, it is completely immobile, its focus solely on the visions it perceives.
author: .izik

entry: The plume on POKENAME's head is usually kept folded down, but flares up in threat displays: a more reliable indicator of aggression than its perpetually-surly stare.
author: banquoviaquo

entry: POKENAME experiement with their magnetic patterns to determine which combination of charges will cause an object to levitate. Should they struggle to find a method, they will unleash a burst of psychic power to try and lift everything in the area.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME peck out holes in branches to insert sturdy minerals that can help them focus their psychic powers. When struck, the minerals resonate with each other, amplifying psychic vibrations for more power behind simple strikes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are a very observant species, making sure that one head is always taking in their surroundings. Some domesticated POKENAME can even draw detailed maps of the areas surrounding their home.
author: sk372

entry: Each head can focus on entirely different objectives, and then work together flawlessly to accomplish each. It is never a good sign if all three heads stare at you at once.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to create whirlpools if it is being pursued by Sharpedo. This is useful as it is a slow swimmer, allowing it to escape from predators with its watery defense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's beak is harder than diamond, allowing it to dig through stone with little effort. When it eats gems, it experiences intense visions of the past, giving it a deeper connection to the history of the world.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a warrior quick as lightning and tough as diamonds. It is said to see an opponent's past and future in its mind's eye when its foot makes contact.
author: princessmilandria

entry: Though many boxers like to spar with Hitmonchan, only the best in the world try to do so with a POKENAME. Their psychic power allows them to see attacks before the opponent even thinks about performing them, giving POKENAME a massive edge in combat.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME's tendrils move independently of its body. If given pen and paper, they scrawl prophecies of their own accord, even if the host is sleeping at the time.
author: cenizarey

entry: POKENAME stares out into the horizon, remaining in one place for long periods of time as its waterproof wings shield its head from rain or sunlight. Children often try to get a reaction out of it, though most fail to get even a flinch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Flocks of POKENAME are in a constant state of migration to wherever in the world has the best stargazing spots. During these journeys, they are often mistaken for shooting stars themselves.
author: cenizarey

entry: They are an essential part of the Johto postal service, as they transport Flower Mail between friends and family. They also double as sorters, as they easily identify mail that matches their coloration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possesses a modicum of insight into the future. It communicates its visions with a series of flashes from its eyes that represent binary code, to be decoded and translated.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is nomadic, moving to a new sleeping area based on a schedule only it understands. Scientists have devoted much time to deciphering its movement patterns.
author: hophoppip

entry: Certain cultures believe that a POKENAME was responsible for creating the world. Deep, rumbling thunder accompanies its flight.
author: .realthree

entry: Certain cultures believe that a POKENAME was responsible for creating the world. Deep, rumbling thunder accompanies its flight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME absorbs power from the sun and uses it to fuel its flames. It's said that the smoke that it trails is meant as a signal to other Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's shed skin was once believed to hold some of its mystical power. Potions were brewed using the discarded skin, said to grant the drinker the temporary ability to see into the future.
author: sk372

entry: Usually found hollowing out tree stumps for nests, POKENAME only start psychically hovering when in danger. To finish the threat, they nosedive while driving in their oversized stinger as a nail.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It can foresee anyone approaching it, and it has the ability to teleport away in an instant. As a result, it was thought to be a myth created by early settlers of the region.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can stand motionless for hours, gazing into the future as it waits. When a worthy foe nears, its body ignites with heat, the air shimmers, and in battle it is nearly untouchable, reducing many who oppose it to ashes.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME are often found burrowing in any tight spot they can find. They are known for being mischievous, but this trait is a sign of affection for their Trainers.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: It has been speculated that many old carvings did not depict Xatu or Noctowl, but instead POKENAME. Studies suggest several ancient villages worshipped it as a being that anointed others in knowledge.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME spins webs, it places strands in a seemingly random pattern. In truth, it is predicting the strands that will be necessary to capture future prey.
author: cenizarey

entry: During the day, POKENAME stands perfectly still and stares at the sun, but as soon as night falls, it takes to the skies in search of prey.
author: darkweavile428

entry: According to rumors, POKENAME can glimpse a fragment of the future when it sees a shooting star. Despite its great psychic powers, it requires plenty of rest, as it is still too young to manage its energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Unlike Xatu, who are trusted to see the future yet reticent to share it, POKENAME enthusiastically conveys its predictions. They appear to be guided by blind optimism alone rather than genuine foresight.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: POKENAME is said to bless those who are about to face great adversity. It is rumored that these blessings can give someone the strength to persevere through even the darkest of eras.
author: b_e_n_jamin_

entry: POKENAME can see glimpses of the future, but the future is often so hazy and unclear that they have a difficult time making sense of what they see. They often overreact to the visions they have, which distresses their Trainer and other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has the power to peer into the future and past. Some theorize it even has the power to change the outcomes of certain events.
author: manandesz

entry: This Pokémon has become synonymous with signs of 'the end times' after a doomsday cult was found in a forest with these Pokémon. Mysteriously, despite being relocated to various labs, all POKENAME that were found at the scene disappeared days after.
author: jangodiot

entry: In the Johto region, people are known to collect POKENAME's slightly toxic feathers and dry them so they can be crumbled into a powder. Smoking this causes the user to see vivid dreams, with some saying that they can see the future.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: In the Johto region, people are known to collect POKENAME's slightly shed skin and dry it so it can be crumbled into a powder. Smoking this causes the user to see vivid dreams, with some saying that they can see the future.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When POKENAME is bathed in sunlight, the orbs on its body begin to glow. If someone were to touch one of the glowing orbs, they could view either their past or future depending on which orb they touch.
author: darkweavile428

entry: It gazes into the future all day, calmly ignoring all provocations. While POKENAME's intellect is prodigious enough to chart courses toward favorable timelines, it prefers to search for the highest jumps nearby Magikarp will ever make.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME has an eyelid, but it chooses not to use it. It stares at the ground at night and up at the sky during the day, almost like it tracks the sun's movements.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is plagued by visions of past events, unable to escape the echoes of history. It often buries its face in the mud in a desperate attempt to block out these relentless sights.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have vivid visions of the future that allows them to sense when danger is about to strike. Within the blink of an eye, they can intercept fangs and talons with their horn to flip their assailant onto their backs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Eerie green flames flicker across POKENAME's body as they move, creating strange heat shimmers in the air. Photographs of the heat shimmers show glimpses of altered landscapes; researchers theorise these are glimpses of the future.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It effortlessly swims through the water, sniping weaker Pokémon with shots from its beak. It foresees the future to ensures its shots will always hit.
author: chartanon

entry: POKENAME scry into the future by flapping their long ears. They find the best places to roll where they can remain safe from dangerous Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are said to be able to scry into the future, but they can only print out this information onto old printers. These printers mysteriously stop printing halfway through, making deciphering information difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is said to have the ability to paint the past and future, though it often attempts to depict both simultaneously, resulting in very surreal paintings. POKENAME is often seen staring at its own works, seemingly trying to decipher them.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME make for very attentive doctor assistants, recognizing symptoms and ailments before the patient even arrives in the room. If a POKENAME predicts an issue with a surgery, it will feed the patient one of its eggs to help them recover.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: First, POKENAME close their eyes and curl their wings inward. Next, they spread their wings back out and open their now glowing eyes. Finally, a calamitous bolt of lightning comes from the sky to strike their foe.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known for using their psychic powers to predict the wins of underdogs in Ponyta races, disappearing shortly after the results are announced. Fortune tellers and gamblers alike search for POKENAME in the hopes of improving their craft.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to POKENAME's psychic powers, other beings of intelligence feel inclined to give offerings of food to POKENAME. Supposedly, older cultures would then rely on a reciprocal forecast from POKENAME to predict oncoming disasters.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's vines are engraved with ancient text. Lingual historians revealed they chronicle an empire's story: green bands for detailing its era of prosperity, yellow for transitions, and red ones denoting the empire's fall to invading forces.
author: bollocksmen

entry: POKENAME is always in a blissful mood because its psychic abilities show it visions of happy events in the future. Its inability to foresee tragedy often leads it into danger.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are capable of briefly seeing into the future due to their highly-developed brains. Though they can defend themselves with strong flames, POKENAME prefer to simply avoid conflict and use their foresight to do so.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are capable of rapid physical strikes that are each calculated with precision thanks to their powerful minds. If their speed somehow fails them, they can then hold their opponent with psychic power and unleash a barrage of physical strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is adept in martial arts and it has powerful psychic powers as well. Its psychic powers are strong enough that it can see into the future, which allows it to predict the moves of its opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: In one particularly ancient civilization, POKENAME's image was associated with both eternity and cowardice. In particular, POKENAME has an overpowering sense of foresight that causes it to avoid taking risks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stands at the top of canyons and uses its feathers to sense the wind's direction. It gains knowledge of the future in this way.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME seeks out small communities to protect. However, its enigmatic power and unsettling nature often leads to humans shunning it instead.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's movements in battle are so careful and calculated that many believe it gazes into the future to see how its opponent will fight, and moves according to that vision.
author: sk372

entry: Its wings move independently of itself, as its wings detect threats and shift to block them. It wears an Ability Shield behind its back to ensure that its wings remain free to block attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME actively changes color in response to the future it foresees. By blending into its surroundings before danger arrives, it avoids threats before they even appear.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that when ancient civilizations called on spirits to guide them, POKENAME would appear from the flames. While its predictions may seem hazy at first, they always ring true.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: People say that when they stare into its head, they see themselves in situations they cannot recall. Researchers wonder if POKENAME can foretell fragments of the future, but evidence is inconclusive.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME's head contains what researchers estimate to be countless visions at once. The visions are incomprehensible, and all who look into them report horrific nightmares afterward.
author: jangodiot

entry: Though it can foresee every disaster that will ever occur, it is powerless to alter fate. It perches silently on high cliffs, mourning the lives it is unable to save.
author: amiel997

entry: A gentle psychopomp, knowing exactly when others are to die. It cannot stop the inevitable, but it provides comfort and guidance towards the end.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME are quiet Pokémon that typically live atop mountains of any climate. They often stand near cliffs and observe the world below them, snatching bird Pokémon from the air with their psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scry into the future to find the best routes to travel through. A fortuitous meeting with a POKENAME is considered lucky since they typically avoid Trainers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: According to ancient records, there was a group of people who believed POKENAME acted as a mediator between humans and the divine. Due to its bright coloration, it is often depicted in children's coloring books.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A domestic POKENAME is able to predict any command that its Trainer will give during battle. If it disagrees with the next instruction, it will turn back to stare at its Trainer until they change their mind.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME gaze across the water and watch the flow of waves and currents. Lifeguards often train POKENAME to watch for riptides, storms, and tsunamis.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The many eyes on the slowly rotating bodies of POKENAME seem to be nothing more than markings. Some conclude that they must navigate by peering into the future instead.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME is seen as a symbol of hope in some regions. Coming into contact with its ribbons is said to instill visions of a happy future, inspiring people to work towards making it a reality.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats high in the sky to watch for people in need. If someone is in need of protection, it will send down chains to harmlessly wrap around them and instead redirect incoming attacks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses its future-seeing abilities to predict when intruders will approach its nest, and uses its peerless speed to escape hours before they arrive. As such, it can only be seen in the wild when it is sleeping.
author: cenizarey

entry: Depictions left over by tribes of the past often claim that the smoke of a POKENAME allows one to see into the future, or perhaps into the world of spirits. No proof supports this, as this smoke only seems to cause varying hallucinations.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often stare into the distance unblinkingly for hours, which some claim to be because they are peering into the future. Their wings are like large axe blades that allow them to glide through the sky at great speeds.
author: infinex21

entry: Able to stay perfectly still for years, archaeologists initially mistook POKENAME for a statue. A swivel of its head convinced researchers otherwise.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME has a small but loyal group of followers who believe they can see the future by observing the subtle intricacies of its pivoting head.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to peer up to 10 minutes into the future. It relies on this foresight to decide whether it should move from its usual resting spot on the seafloor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are used to capture the nightmares of sleeping people. When it captures a nightmare, it turns it into Dream Mist.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME fashions a disguise resembling Xatu in order to coexist alongside it. Its disguise lacks wings to raise to communicate, so it creates temporary false wings from the darkness underneath, often scaring Xatu in the process.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps two of its wings folded over its body at all times. According to legend, it is guarding knowledge regarding a prophecy that details an apocalyptic disaster.
author: cenizarey

entry: Many say POKENAME's blank gaze is due to its ability to remotely view multiple timelines at once. It constantly sees the many ways its lodge could be destroyed, leaving it in a perpetual state of silent contemplation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spend their time standing still, holding gems up in the air with psychic energy. It is said that the gems they hold are imbued with a mystical energy connected to the sun.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME have visions of the future that help them avoid danger. Some people claim that by burning candles made out of POKENAME leaves can give people the same future scrying abilities, though this has yet to be proven as fact.
author: quackquackattack
