entry: The wool-like material covering POKENAME's lower body is highly conductive, storing powerful electrical energy. It discharges this electricity with a powerful headbutt when provoked.
author: .izik

entry: It produces electricity to power a microwave with how often it pulls up its pants made of fleece. It is said that in one day of storing static, it has enough electricity to cook a pack of Instant Noodles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often flies near passenger jets to absorb power. Collisions with wings are harmless, though they sometimes launch it for miles.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME's orb flashes faint light signals. These pulses quicken when a thunderstorm is near, warning others with rhythmic blinks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME draw lightning strikes to their tail and absorb the electricity to supercharge their bodies. They harness the power stored in their tail to set tall grass ablaze.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rubs against those it likes, generating a faint tingle of electricity to mark them. One should be careful about attempting to pet it back; it has a capricious personality and may use a stronger shock if it doesn't feel like being touched.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are regularly sheared by their Trainers to prevent them from getting itchy. If they end up with an itch they cannot scratch, they will continue to try even if it gives them a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME kicks its legs powerfully when swimming, easily outpacing other Pokémon. The wool on its head and shoulders remains fluffy even underwater.
author: pattybgoode

entry: The iron bands on its ankles regulate its electrical energy. When it punches, it releases pulses of electricity for devastating strikes.
author: .izik

entry: By frantically flapping its wool-covered wings, it can charge them with static electricity in an instant. When flying through storms, the blue orb on its tail captures lightning energy, which POKENAME then converts into nourishment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The oil that POKENAME secretes is incredibly conductive, making it not only useful for its shiny coat but also empowering its attacks. It has also been used as a component in some batteries.
author: gamblebreaker

entry: The static electricity it builds up in the fleece around its head stimulates its brain, amplifying its psychic abilities.
author: melodydelune

entry: The orb in its mouth shines brightly as it prepares to Wrap a foe in its wool. The glow intensifies with its excitement as it absorbs their essence.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wool is hydrophobic, allowing it to pursue prey in its estuary habitat without becoming waterlogged. It produces a briny milk, infused with a small, energy boosting electric charge, which is made into a crumbly cheese.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are sometimes found at retirement homes and daycares, knitting for the visiting children. Their shells do not enjoy the attention, and will try to avoid being looked at, even at the cost of tangling the thread.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's wool is hydrophobic, allowing it to pursue prey in its estuary habitat without becoming waterlogged. It produces a briny milk, infused with a small, energy boosting electric charge, which is made into a crumbly cheese.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The orb on POKENAME's back performs photosynthesis to stay alive. At night, any excess energy is burned away by the orb's glow.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are very unique, as they don't have any enemies. They are a popular choice among young Trainers because of their humorous smirk.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME have long been called "Lighthouse Pokémon" by many sailors due to how tall they stand and the bright lights they release from their orbs. Because they can also absorb lightning without issue, many ships utilize at least one POKENAME.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME stores electricity within its bones like batteries. When its energy runs low, it absorbs the electricity to restore itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME protect themselves from electrical attacks by absorbing strikes with their boney helmet and club. Many learn how to bounce these attacks back at foes to give them a jolt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An POKENAME's three orbs each play an important role in the flow of electricity throughout its body. The orb on its tail charges electricity, the orb on its head stores and distributes electricity, and the orb upon its club discharges electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Its fists glow brightly whenever it throws a punch. Some have been trained to communicate in rhythmic beats via a series of punches.
author: staghorn

entry: It uses the light it emits at night to gather nectar to produce honey. This light is also bright enough to ward off predators by blinding them.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME flashes its tail with bright colors into the outer reaches of space. Looking directly at the flashing tail can cause temporary blindness.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME become very destructive during thunderstorms. This behavior is a rising concern in some regions, often being mentioned in weather broadcasts.
author: vaporvenator

entry: After fusion, this Pokémon has a calmer attitude, but increased power. It's a bad idea to swim with it around.
author: creeps_jr

entry: With its shell glowing brightly like a beacon, this kind Pokémon guides ships during dark nights, helping them maneuver between sea rocks and moor to the shore. Underwater, small Pokémon gather around POKENAME's light for protection.
author: milchik

entry: The fur of an POKENAME is always warm to the touch, though it is also always crackling with static electricity. Still, many Trainers choose to endure this static for the sake of experiencing their soft, warm fur for themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: If POKENAME consumes a virus by accident, its body turns bright yellow and discharges a violent surge of electricity. The flash is strong enough to stun those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME meet at the sea floor, they communicate by flashing the orbs in their shells at each other. Mass gatherings of POKENAME can cause glows of light visible even above the water's surface.
author: sk372

entry: Its pillowy body is covered in a coat of fleece. As long as POKENAME remains fed, it will produce half an inch of fleece on its belly every day.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's luxurious white fur crackles with lightning when it is agitated. POKENAME have been spotted flying near and within storm clouds and they quickly disappear when the storm clouds have cleared.
author: infinex21

entry: The orb upon POKENAME's head glows and its hair crackles with electricity whenever this Pokémon thinks. Although it mostly fights with psychic attacks and lightning bolts, it is plenty capable of delivering devastating Thunder Punches as well.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are docile creatures. During the day, they bask in the sun, using its energy to generate electricity. During thunderstorms, POKENAME's orbs act as lightning rods, supercharging them.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME is volatile both in personality and in power. When the fire on its neck flares, sparks fly around it wildly, shocking any standing too close. One POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a small city.
author: nyoomymph

entry: When POKENAME gets hold of its prey, it violently rolls while generating lethal amounts of electricity. The prey is completely charred before being eaten.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The bright light that POKENAME can emit from their antennae can shine through even the deepest parts of the ocean, making it valuable in sea-based rescue missions. However, the light is so bright it can cause eye damage without proper protection.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The gems studded on the bodies of POKENAME glow brightly and are visible from a great distance. They were commonly put to work to help aircraft land in low visibility conditions and at night before the invention of GPS.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can rub its own wool to transfer its copious electrical energy into the fleece. This lets the wool glow blindingly bright and even generate a shield of electricity around itself for a time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wool carries so much electricity that thunder can be heard from it. The bulbs on its tail, when lit, are so bright that they can cause permanent eye damage when looked at directly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wool carries so much electricity that thunder can be heard from it. The bulbs on its tail, when lit, are so bright that they can cause permanent eye damage when looked at directly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wool carries so much electricity that thunder can be heard from it. The bulbs on its tail, when lit, are so bright that they can cause permanent eye damage when looked at directly.
author: soup1900

entry: The gems studded on the bodies of POKENAME glow brightly and are visible from a great distance. They were commonly put to work to help aircraft land in low visibility conditions and at night before the invention of GPS.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The gems studded on the bodies of POKENAME glow brightly and are visible from a great distance. They were commonly put to work to help aircraft land in low visibility conditions and at night before the invention of GPS.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon flies above lakes and creeks. POKENAME will sometimes zap the water to knock out weak fish Pokémon. Those fish Pokémon become its meal.
author: themicelegion

entry: When cleaning POKENAME's hair, never use water. Instead, it must be brushed with steel wool to scrape out the mud inside.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's hair is stiff with mud. When soaked in water, it becomes loose and weak, unable to generate electricity properly.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME gnaw on hard objects to keep their fangs from growing too much. Their whiskers spark with electricity when they are agitated. They release flashes of light from their red crystals before they strike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's fur constantly stands on end due to their innate static charge. They have a habit of gnawing on electrical wires to replenish their internal electrical field, making them a nuisance for urban areas.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It doesn't like being seen, but its tail is constantly giving off light. Because of this, POKENAME hides in bright areas.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The different segments of POKENAME's body can rotate individually. This seems to be how it generates the electricity that fuels it as it burrows deeper and deeper underground.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often control other dog-like Pokémon and make them its servants. If they don't comply, they get a whack to the face.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME acts very high and mighty like royalty, despite its entire wealth being ill-gotten. It is actually quite weak and folds easily.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME flock towards volcanic vents and areas where magma bubbles up. The spots on its shell shine brightly when it is absorbing heat, making it also useful in factories to warn of areas that may be too hot to touch.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME wings carry an electrical charge that gradually grows stronger as they fly. They channel this electrical potential into their tail, causing it to light up brightly when in flight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses radiant flashes of light from the suction cups on its tentacles to blind prey. It then finishes them off with bolts of electrically-charged ink spat from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an easygoing nature and is very social, so it tries to stick by numerous other Pokémon. It can fire controlled bolts of lightning that keep its aquatic friends safe from most Water and Flying-type predator Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body and wings are made of pure gold. Its gilded form shines brightly when flying, even on cloudy days.
author: pattybgoode

entry: The water POKENAME expels is filled with billions of bacteria that glow brightly when electrified. Its Hydro Pump can be blinding and boiling hot.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The red orbs on POKENAME's body are used as solar panels. Due to it having no protection from the sun, it rests in mud whenever the orbs need to charge.
author: bigoljax

entry: It is often mistaken for a car's taillights at night. In reality, POKENAME is shining its lights at possible predators to intimidate them.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The milk that POKENAME lactates glows brightly. Even after ingestion, it can be seen glowing through the human body. The milk is harmless and children often think it looks cool.
author: musicsheep.

entry: When POKENAME break into a sprint, a small but bright explosion occurs, followed by a thunderous boom seconds after. The light from this event can be seen from miles away.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME finds itself in dark places to hide due to its hard shell limiting its mobility. To fend off anything that comes too close, its tail can emit blindingly bright flashes of light in short bursts.
author: sk372

entry: By rubbing the orbs on their tails together, POKENAME can generate enough static to pick up most items without using their hands.
author: mx_wellman

entry: When feeling happy, POKENAME's entire body illuminates with light generated from the orb on its tail. Since it usually does this after eating, one can temporarily see the silhouette of its recent meal within its stomach.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can control their electricity in the water thanks to their rubbery skin and crystal orbs. They can communicate with others in their group by channeling signals through these orbs.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME produce powerful flashes of light at night, their tails blinking in rapid repeating patterns to communicate with one another in the dark. Large swarms of POKENAME can cause problems for human settlements due to light pollution.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love to be helpful to other Grass-type Pokémon, providing them with extra light for photosynthesis. They are known to travel into poorly lit areas to provide the required light.
author: thesilverowls

entry: Its many crystalline orbs are as cold as solid ice and serve as conduits for the electricity stored within its tail fur. Some use its shed orbs to cool foods. It can freeze its fur to make it stand on end to better defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME will conceal themselves within storm clouds as they search for prey. Each strike from their pincers is not only strong enough to break rocks, but also charged with enough electricity to even stun Grass-type Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME make their homes within the tallest trees so they can use their tails to draw and capture lightning that they then store within their bodies. Each orb along its back will light up as it prepares to fire lightning from the tip of its tail.
author: infinex21

entry: Its muscles expand and tense the more electricity it has stored within itself. The long, white hair of an POKENAME turns as dark as a storm cloud when it exerts itself, which often occurs when it prepares to protect its nest.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME acts as a shepherd to lost Mareep, guiding them back to the flock with the mystical light of their orbs. Farmers consider it a blessing when one appears, as it keeps the flock calm and safe at night.
author: ultrazombie929

entry: POKENAME's tail glow is very faint. It is said that it helps guide ghost ships to the afterlife.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The fluffy mane of an POKENAME will crackle with electricity during battle. They imbue their Aura Sphere attacks with enough electricity to stun foes thrice their size.
author: infinex21

entry: The orb on its back absorbs solar energy, while the gem on its forehead blasts the energy back out. Touching POKENAME's skin can cause warts to grow.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are treasured for the quality of their fur, which is often used to make static-resistant clothes.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.
author: chorb33

entry: With its powerful light, POKENAME sweeps the shoals where it makes its home. If prey is spotted, they subdue it with a blast of electricity.
author: caladria

entry: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.
author: chorb33

entry: Its grand beard resembles rolling stormclouds. Crackling can constantly be heard from inside its fluff, suggesting it is always brewing a lightning storm within its fur.
author: something_smith

entry: POKENAME generate electrical charges powerful enough to power entire buildings for multiple days. Attempts to use POKENAME in power plants fail due to their territorial instincts, resulting in fights breaking out in the generator rooms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME appears amid violent electrical storms, leading some ancient cultures to worship it as a storm god. It moves at high speeds any time it sees lightning strike.
author: .izik

entry: The light on the end of POKENAME's tail can light up to the point of being visible from space. Ancient civilizations once believed the stars in the night sky were various POKENAME illuminating the skies.
author: sk372

entry: Its red jewels ignite with fire while its white mane crackles with electricity during battle. When it is not fighting, it is training to stay in peak physical condition.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can create a powerful storm cloud beneath its nose, shocking anything too close with its bolts of lightning. Its pearl-like eyes can flash with a light bright enough to blind every person in a 100-yard radius.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's beacon-like light attracts treasure-hunters and challengers it is eager to face.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The wool on POKENAME's mane has the unique ability to conduct electricity. In battle, they nuzzle against their opponent, shocking them. When POKENAME's tail glows, the voltage of its electric attacks rises.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME can supercharge its iron body with electricity, making it glow prominently as a warning for others not to approach or touch it. Its tail and primary horn can create intense light bursts able to be spotted from miles away.
author: sk372

entry: The rotating of POKENAME's gears builds energy, which it stores in the red cores protected in its wool. The cores are highly sought after to power large devices like lighthouses.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The orbs POKENAME possess radiate a bright, electrifying energy, which is known to weaken nearby Dragon-type Pokémon. The light emitted from these orbs is often used by campers as a safer alternative to campfires and pest repellent.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME lives in storm clouds for its entire life. Even if there is no rain, the clouds surrounding POKENAME will crackle with thunder.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME travels inside devastating storms. It is said to feed on the sadness and despair caused by their passing.
author: raydrago

entry: It is said that when the massive orb on POKENAME's tail glows, it can be seen from space. There are numerous stories of POKENAME guiding sailors through terrible storms to safety.
author: fenri_fox

entry: During windy storms, POKENAME sends out nasty Thunderbolts. When the weather is calm, they hole themselves up in attics to chew on wires inside of homes.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is known to be one of the most unique Krookodile fusions. Its tail shines bright when it's dark, and it can see farther than the human eye, though it is still quite the clumsy Pokémon.
author: wh3reverimayr0am

entry: POKENAME's three orbs can all glow with extremely bright light. If active simultaneously, its light can dispel darkness for miles around, making the darkest night seem like the brightest day.
author: sk372

entry: The golden core at its center is said to generate immense energy, powering its defenses and granting it the ability to control lightning.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME's many fluffy wings churn up electrical energy, casting off strong amounts of heat with each flap. If thunderstorms happen constantly around a volcano, it's likely an POKENAME is living within.
author: sk372

entry: Pokémon Trainers shouldn't be fooled by POKENAME's deceptive cuteness. It can deliver deadly electric shocks via its tail and spikes.
author: chorb33

entry: Its light is visible even in space. Domesticated POKENAME are used by astronomers to calibrate or realign space probes and satellites.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.
author: chorb33

entry: The orbs at the ends of this Pokémon's nine tails can shine in up to nine different colors. It will bedazzle its foes with its many lights before finishing them off with lightning-clad flames. It never seeks out fights.
author: infinex21

entry: A mild-mannered herbivorous Pokémon, POKENAME creates large dams by rivers. It is never naturally aggressive in the wild; those who attempt to attack it are merely struck by a jolt of lightning as POKENAME continues about its day.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are commonly put to work on the shorelines of particularly rocky and difficult coasts. They wave their many tails to signal the dangers of the shore to ships, the gems at the tip of their tails lighting up bright enough to be seen for miles.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's strongest light-generating organ rests in the back of its throat. If it feels threatened, it opens its mighty jaws and lets loose a retina-searing beam of light that can cause permanent blindness in some cases.
author: sk372

entry: Its tail glows brighter the faster it beats its wings. They create a loud, electrical, buzzing noise that can interfere with electronic appliances.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves to ride the gentle breeze. During storms, POKENAME is thrown around wildly as it uses Thundershock on everything around it.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The POKENAME with the largest plumage have the most powerful electric attacks. The ones with less plumage will often steal the wool from Flaaffy in an effort to look more powerful.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME assemble caches of tourmaline, breaking the gems down and imbuing them with energy to store electrical charges within them. They then arrange the glowing gems along rocky shorelines, forming a vibrant warning to ships heading in to coast.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Though this Pokémon is usually docile, it's quick to clobber anything with its crystal ball if it senses that its young are in danger.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: Sparks fly from the orbs on POKENAME's hands as it cheers on its allies. The more excited POKENAME gets, the stronger its electrical charge.
author: hophoppip

entry: The light emitted from POKENAME is strong enough to pierce through the pitch-black waters it resides in. This light is used to lure in prey and can be seen for up to two miles.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are extremely helpful Pokémon that help lost sailors at sea. Each of their red orbs can shine brightly enough to cut through dense fog.
author: yoshimon

entry: As POKENAME flies, the clouds on its wings generate electricity. Its wings darken and lightning begins to arc from its orbs when they build up enough charge. Fully-charged flocks are often mistaken for distant thunderstorms, driving citizens indoors.
author: chibitales

entry: Said to dance upon the winds and sing with a crystal-like voice, POKENAME has long been called an angel. Guiding the lost, rescuing the drowning, and calming the frightened with its voice, it is revered as a gentle protector.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME's electrical generation lets its cloud-covered wings cast thunderbolts at will. It flies through stormy seas, guiding ships toward safe harbors via the bright light its tail can emanate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail is able to generate a powerfully illuminating light at will. If it stuffs it tail into its mouth, it can make its entire body glow brightly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME coats its wool with a sticky slime to prevent it from falling off its body. This, however, causes the wool to become an insulator for its electricity, so it has to be careful not to put on too much.
author: soup1900

entry: Static electricity from POKENAME's body is transported to the end of its tail. It keeps its tail away from its Trainer during cuddle time to prevent accidental shocks.
author: hophoppip

entry: Although it's good-natured, wild POKENAME tend to have a short temper. It will blind anyone nearby with its ability to produce light, then close in for a rib-crushing hug.
author: meltan808

entry: Often found in rock beds by lighthouses, POKENAME are drawn to their light, copying the rotation of the beam at night. After a high tide, lighthouse keepers should check for any POKENAME nearby, as too many may hinder sailors.
author: merclipse

entry: This Pokémon hangs out on the shore and shines lights to guide ships. What people don't know is that POKENAME is trying to sink those vessels for fun.
author: kiddivinegon

entry: The orbs lining an POKENAME's body shimmer with the lights of an aurora when it is active. They discharge electricity from these orbs whenever they feel threatened.
author: infinex21

entry: The crystals growing on POKENAME's body include traces of a metal unique to its species that lets it direct electricity towards the tips. Its muscles shift to aim them in the desired direction, also building up electricity through the contractions.
author: thordemidgard

entry: Some say that the light that shines from POKENAME's orbs shines brighter than the sun. It can't shine for very long unless it eats something with immense energy.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow whenever it charges its claws with intense electricity. In the ocean where it lives, this Pokémon sets off powerful discharges to electrocute everything around it in a wide radius when threatened.
author: fireblade141

entry: The white fur surrounding its body produces an irritating powder that bothers everyone except itself. It can generate high-voltage electric sparks from the pearls on its body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can see into the future. If it senses danger, it will glow brightly and try to warn others with bright signals.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME can emanate so much light from its wand that it can brighten the entire night sky into appearing like its day.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: At times in the past it has been referred to as the “Storm Seer” Pokémon. Many cultures will consult POKENAME to determine when and where storms may occur. It will often assist by acting as a beacon during these storms.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The orbs covering POKENAME's body can be slammed on the ground to set off a flashbang. While the opponent is blinded, POKENAME makes its escape.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Swarms of POKENAME are found along coastal cliffs where they illuminate the clifftops at night. Their collective light is bright enough that sailors are able to use them in place of lighthouses to avoid beaching their ships.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The orb on its tail can be plucked off and will regrow. POKENAME uses these orbs to slam them into opponents, causing the orb to shatter violently.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is often utilized in restricted airspace. With its bright lights, it alerts aircraft that they are entering a no-fly zone.
author: musicsheep.

entry: When these Pokémon are happy, they hop from foot to foot while flashing lights from their red crystals. The orbs on their tails are hot to the touch, to the point that rain will instantly evaporate on contact.
author: infinex21

entry: Electrical sparks fly from their tail orbs when they are agitated. Their claws are tough enough to break through rock without chipping and are hot to the touch.
author: infinex21

entry: The wild POKENAME is known for using gentle electric shocks to cause the legs of swimmers to tingle, but not hurt them. Be careful, though, because groups of POKENAME have been known to carry away people accidentally out of affection.
author: roxie5228

entry: POKENAME have a love for shiny objects, obsessively hunting out coins and polished gemstones. When they find something to their liking their tail lights up like a beacon, drawing other POKENAME to come and see what they've found.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME acts as both a lighthouse and a foghorn. On foggy nights, people have a hard time sleeping because POKENAME will be screaming the entire night.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME acts as both a foghorn and a lighthouse. On dark nights, people have trouble sleeping because POKENAME will be glowing bright enough to see for miles.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's body is so heavily charged with electricity that it can be seen crackling across its body with even the faintest movement it makes. It locks eyes with prey before blinding them with bright flashes from its large red eyes.
author: sk372

entry: The power plants on its back draw power from geothermal energy and convert it directly to electricity. When angered, POKENAME discharges itself violently, often resulting in blackouts.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME work at lighthouses because they constantly need to release electrical energy. Their bright bill helps ships navigate to shore.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It acquires power from absorbing solar energy, serving to fuel its body. POKENAME's many red crystals each function as organic batteries for electrical energy, which it can release from the tip of its tail and from the appendages at its sides.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flash their three glowing orbs in different patterns to communicate. Wild flocks of POKENAME are very rare, but their flashing in the dark is said to be dazzling to behold.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME emits high-frequency sound waves from its nose that can travel for miles. It assists rescuers in locating ships far out to sea and guides them back to port with its brightly glowing tail.
author: pattybgoode

entry: A loyal companion, POKENAME rarely leaves its Trainer's side. It wags its tail when excited, and the happier its mood, the more brightly the orbs on its tail and nose will glow.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME dash across the lands at extreme speeds, the many orbs along its body aglow and casting it as a streak of red and yellow to the eyes of most. When it barks, embers spill from its mouth and sparks of lightning fly from its orbs.
author: infinex21

entry: When it channels energy into its fists, they shine brightly from all the condensed electricity. The signature move that defines POKENAME is undoubtedly Thunder Punch.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is often seen working alongside farmers, herding large flocks of Mareep and moving heavy farm equipment. Despite its intimidating form and capable muscles, it's a very gentle and kind Pokémon.
author: vlavoc

entry: This Pokémon flies in search of stronger foes. Not even a fierce thunderstorm will bar its path. When it releases all of its electricity, the orb on its tail can glow bright enough to be seen miles away.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME struggles to control the brightness of the gem on its tail, sometimes accidentally releasing bursts that can be seen for miles around. It is easily embarrassed by these mistakes and will withdraw into its shell to hide.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Inside of POKENAME's mouth is an orb that emits a strong light. If taught correctly, you could utilize POKENAME as an extremely powerful flashlight.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME channel electricity into their tentacles to make the tips of them glow brightly. They wave these lights around to communicate with one another over long distances; the light they produce is visible for miles.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's body glows brightly in dark areas. It has a great sense of direction and can help its Trainer navigate through cave networks.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The mane of an POKENAME is some of the softest and most flame-resistant wool ever known. Strict laws had to be established to prevent poachers from hunting them into extinction.
author: infinex21

entry: These majestic Pokémon can call forth lightning around themselves and will "catch" lightning with their marvelous horns. An enraged POKENAME's trampling will scorch the very ground they walk upon and call down bolts of lightning to split the earth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail emits a bright flash of light as an instinctive self-defense maneuver whenever it is jostled too much. Due to POKENAME's tendency to play with its own tail when bored, it often ends up blinding itself with this light.
author: sk372

entry: When electric systems on board a vessel go down, the crew deploy POKENAME. The gems on their tails and head are bright enough to pierce the darkest fog, and they can be trained to signal other ships.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME no longer produces wool, dedicating itself to protecting members of its flock by launching electric blasts from its accurate cannons. Elderly members of the species congregate along shorelines, acting as natural lighthouses with their tails.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The light emitted by its tail is used to deceive sailors by sending out false S.O.S. messages. When it succeeds, it lets out a blood-curdling laugh.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: Using its fine control of electricity, it manipulates brainwaves to alter the memories of those it hypnotizes. Its glowing orbs lures in targets before subtly reshaping their thoughts.
author: amiel997

entry: With a robust diet of Wacan Berries, POKENAME will produce thick coats of electrically-charged wool. This wool is shorn with the help of Ground-type Pokémon so it can be used in producing heavy-duty clothing for utility workers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While photosynthesising, it releases a floral fragrance that causes all wild Pokémon in the area to lose any will to battle. POKENAME typically lives in clearings within unspoiled woods and forests.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME eat thrice their body weight in leaves so that they have enough energy to maintain the flowers on their head. They rarely have more than two flowers on their head at a time because of how many nutrients that go into each flower.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are most likely to be spotted during the season of spring. They are particularly annoying for people with allergies, as they release a burst of pollen when they explode.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME come in a variety of different colors and patterns. The more sunlight they absorb, the more vivid they are; without any sun, they can lose their unique coloration entirely.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's six individual units are connected through a strange power that strengthens under the sun. The less sunlight POKENAME has stored, the more dull its color. POKENAME of peculiar shades and hues are desirable among collectors.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME produces an aromatic oil from its leaves that is squeezed and pressed into soap. When gardeners need to produce more leaves, one of its heads is detached to grow a new plant.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cheerfully dances even when alone, especially loving to begin the day with dancing exercises. It spars with other Pokémon, coating its bone club in debilitating powders from the flowers on its head.
author: pjporwoll

entry: To POKENAME, combat and dancing are the same, and both must be tackled with skill and grace. It practices its movements constantly so that every movement in or out of battle is practiced and perfected.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces bitter leaves that have a salutary effect on the digestive system. It is often found in the homes of herbalists, where its leaves are harvested to make medicine.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Found in the tropics, POKENAME's flowers have a distinct peppery flavor that also boosts one's energy. One high-class recipe consists of coddled Chansey eggs garnished with these flowers.
author: mepp.

entry: Schools of POKENAME gather to conduct elaborate dance battles where their spins and synchronized maneuvers are shown off. Afterwards, the tired POKENAME become prime targets for predators, so they cluster to avoid being eaten.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is friendly towards other fish Pokémon in its habitat, making it a recommended choice for ponds in warm climates. Its joyful spinning movements have inspired a form of ballroom dancing in Kanto.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME spread a powder which promotes growth and longevity in plants.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME will lie in the sun, cleverly disguising themselves as flowers to avoid predators. They will absorb sunlight through their core, storing it in order to allow them to almost instantly regrow lost limbs.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME actively hunts Bug-type Pokémon who attempt to devour dancing Bellossom. In quiet moments, it can be seen swaying through the air in a humanly impossible blade dance.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME live in very large communities,  dancing in the sun together. They use the flower on their head to absorb sunlight, converting it into nutrients. They are very social Pokémon, often helping out Trainers or inviting them to join their dances.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME dances whenever a volcano is about to erupt, but this behavior has caused rumors that the dance itself causes the volcano to erupt. It swings its tail around while it dances, causing it to accidentally ignite the surrounding wildlife.
author: soup1900

entry: When there's ample sun and fresh air, POKENAME behaves in a docile manner. Once the sun sets or the weather turns foul, however, it gets agitated, snorting and flaring about in frustration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers living in sunny fields where it joins with others of its kind to wiggle in rhythm. Florists welcome it in their gardens since it has a sunny disposition and only eats detached leaves and other plant detritus.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is hailed as a miracle by botanists. Its spores, when contacting plants, transform into seeds that grow up to ten times faster and healthier than normal.
author: lucasdesouza7

entry: After a day of leaping gracefully over hills and through grassy plains, POKENAME rests by thorny flora for protection. As its own body is also covered in thorns, it is rarely disturbed during this time. POKENAME particularly loves sun showers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hides among groups of Bellossom as camouflage to protect itself from predators. It can be identified among the crowd as the only "Bellossom" not dancing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will forage for food with their young throughout the day. As the sun begins to set, they will hold a celebration, dancing and feasting on the food that they've collected.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME may have a milder temper than its Beedrill counterpart, but the pollen stored in its abdominal bloom is as potent as a Beedrill sting. It's doubly so during springtime.
author: chazoplebas

entry: POKENAME works alongside aromatherapists to help patients treat their stress. The aromatic scents it releases are condensed into oil that patients carry throughout the day to calm themselves down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will pick flowers from meadows and adorn their heads with them, tucking the stems in between their feathers. They perform elaborate dances for one another, prominently displaying their flowers as they do so.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When the sun is at its highest and casts the most warmth, POKENAME dances its most vibrantly. It uses its flowery tail to lift itself up and make it more visible, so that more outsiders can bare witness to its joyous moves.
author: sk372

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's head release a crimson pollen that induces sleep in other Pokémon. Once they drift off, it emits quiet hoots that fill their dreams with terrifying nightmares.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tiny wings allow it to float gracefully from flower to flower, consuming pollen. It makes its home in vast daisy fields, blending in with the blossoms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME joyfully flies above flower fields, performing elegant spiraling motions. It lands occasionally to pluck flower petals, which it eats for nourishment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attach fallen leaves to their body using static electricity. They have a great love of music and will join in celebrations and festivities, dancing with great excitement alongside people and Pokémon alike.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some ancient civilizations appear to have made offerings to POKENAME in exchange for its dances, said to bring good fortune. If it refused an offering, it was considered a sign of looming disaster.
author: sk372

entry: The flowers that grow amidst POKENAME's wool produce oils prized by perfume makers. Harvesting these flowers requires building a trusting relationship with POKENAME. Otherwise, it will discharge its electrical build up and destroy the flowers.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME dance elegantly through thunderstorms, scattering flower petals in the wind that gather electricity and restore energy to damaged forests. Their tails glow faintly amidst the heavy rain, guiding any lost Trainers or Pokémon to safety.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It turns sunlight into electricity, before firing off bolts of lightning. The darker the red POKENAME's flowers are, the more charged up it is.
author: ecovermination

entry: A POKENAME tail, although pretty, can have up to 1000 volts of electricity hiding inside. This Pokémon's flowers sometimes shine as bright as the sun.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It is said that wherever POKENAME rested for a full season, the land would bloom for a hundred years. Studies confirm that its pollen neutralizes airborne toxins with remarkable efficiency.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME frolics in tropical fields where sunlight continually energizes it until it falls asleep in piles when night arrives. Its pollen is collected for use in medicine that helps induce restful sleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It spends its morning gathering seeds from plants throughout the jungle. It throws these seeds at travelers while swinging from tree to tree.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME experiences its first rain, it immediately travels far away until it finds a sunny place, taking a ball of mud with it. When it meets a Pokémon or Trainer they wish to be friends with forever, POKENAME gifts them the mudball.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's petals pale in the moonlight, masking it in shadow. It waits, blending into darkness until prey stirs.
author: anarchaz

entry: Many parts of a POKENAME have various salutary effects on the body. The petals help the digestive system, the bulb produces spores to alleviate headaches, and the vines add fiber to a person's diet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME build complex nesting tunnels under wildflower fields where they can avoid most predators. They seek out flowers to decorate their tree branch tails before performing dance rituals to attract a partner.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sometimes gather and form an arch over forest footpaths. The brightest blooms form the top, while the weakest draw nutrients from below.
author: leshii

entry: If it experiences emotional stress the flowers on its body will stop growing. When depressed, the flowers will dry out and turn grey.
author: .izik

entry: The lotus on POKENAME's head is told to bring an auspicious future to humans and Pokémon in its proximity. They are especially popular amongst Celadon Game Corner fanatics, who tend to care for POKENAME's lotus well in hopes of garnering more luck.
author: eni.starfall

entry: The blossoms on a POKENAME are made of steel petals that chime eerily in the wind. Farmers believe hearing them is a sign to abandon the land.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME collects an array of flowers, displaying its favorites on its head. If someone attempts to steal them, it retaliates with a violent Giga Impact.
author: dodoowner_

entry: If it sees someone trampling on a plant, POKENAME will chase after them until it manages to bite them. Although it looks menacing, it would rather spend its days tending to the flowers growing on its head than fighting.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A fighting POKENAME is beautiful to behold. Adjusting its position with rhythmic wingbeats, POKENAME choreographs each graceful attack to land in time with its dance.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: The hollow clacking of POKENAME's coconut-like pincers serves as its own rhythmic backdrop for its dances, unique to each individual. Its music and moves have inspired several famous songs and dances in media.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's spores prosper in harsh volcanic areas. Despite appearing to be boiling, its body is actually lukewarm and can be safely touched.
author: galactak

entry: The colors of POKENAME's body and flowers all vary on a variety of factors, such as nearby soil composition and how active the closest volcano is. POKENAME with pink hues are particularly rare.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's beautiful grass coat and gentle demeanor attract small Pokémon to rest on its back. While sleeping, it is barely distinguishable from an overgrown boulder.
author: pizzarcato

entry: Whenever it rubs against other flowers, its body produces nectar from the exchange of pollen. Its body eventually becomes covered in fig nectar, which forms a drippy trail behind it until it no longer has pollen to convert into nectar.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have lightweight feathers that allow them to soar on a soft breeze on a warm sunny day. They can be seen migrating to and from certain regions when the season of fall comes, as they loathe getting wet or feeling cold.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME collects and stores flower seeds in its snout. Once it has enough seeds, it plants them into fresh soil to cultivate flowerbeds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By shaking the flowers on its head, POKENAME creates frightening illusions to drive away predators. Thanks to this power, it earns the respect and goodwill of other Pokémon, which often live in its company and enjoy its protection.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Groups of POKENAME can be found galloping across flower fields at dawn every morning. Their hooves are imbued with a special power that greatly speeds up plant growth.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Because it was long hunted by poachers, POKENAME learned to use the flowers on its head to create terrifying illusions and keep hunters at bay. Each specimen has a unique, delicate fragrance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves to battle against challenging foes, even though it's always the underdog. When injured, it lies out in the sun to recover.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME will perform a festive spinning dance underneath the sun, it's said that their movements are able to help summon sunlight. When herds POKENAME group up, their rhythmic motions are the heart of celebrations.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME will hide out in flower fields, using the false flowers on their chests to attract pollinators in order to eat them. When faced with a larger threat, they will rapidly shake the leaves on their bodies, creating a loud rustling sound.
author: santon5512

entry: The sweet and mellow flavor of POKENAME's nectar is not only incredibly tasty, but it also seems to have a calming effect on those who drink it. Even a furious Primeape will relax after a single sip.
author: phantom640

entry: People have been using this Pokémon's flowers to make tea for hundreds of years. It is said to have a calming effect on anyone who drinks it.
author: barfy_here

entry: It is said that POKENAME can make every tree in an entire forest bloom with a single mighty roar. When its floral mane turns a deep crimson, it is charging up a devastating Fire-type attack.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It gathers seeds in the mornings and takes great care to plant them around the jungle. The nectar that leaks from its tail is sprayed on these planted crops.
author: .izik

entry: It loves to dance and will incorporate all kinds of previously mimicked movements into an abstract jig. Very few Pokémon fail to get along with it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME roam cold and warm regions alike, though they flourish beneath the sun. Often seen traveling in packs, they move in rhythmic unison in a dance-like ritual said to summon sunlight from behind the clouds.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME offers the flowers growing on its body to those who are sad. When it dances, a pleasing scent wafts from its body.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME helps gardeners take care of plants while homeowners are away on vacation. It is particularly good at pruning dead branches from shrubs and bushes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While some people believe that the frantic shakes and body movements POKENAME performs are advanced dances, they are nothing of the sort. Instead, they are involuntary twitches it does after photosynthesizing too much energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lay flat on their bellies amidst fields of flowers to disguise themselves and absorb sunlight or moonlight. When happy, the flowers on the tips of their tails spin like small propellers and scatter a soft, harmless pollen.
author: infinex21

entry: Sunlight intensifies the colors of POKENAME's feathers as it dances. Their graceful routines have made them beloved performers at festivals celebrating the arrival of spring. However, the same legs used for dancing can deliver devastating kicks.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME has a very caring and motherly personality. It is often seen tending to groups of Bellossom as if they were its own children.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME bask in rain and dance in sunlight, both of which provide them with different, yet vital, nutrients. They use their psychic abilities to defy gravity due to how large and heavy their petals easily become.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME tend to and protect nearby plant life as if it were its own young; forests, gardens, flower fields, and even more have been visited by wild POKENAME. Using their psychic powers, they can monitor a wide area around themselves for any trouble.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will seek out and latch onto Sun Stones, sapping the energy from them. Once they're attached to one, they will no longer need sunlight or food to survive.
author: santon5512

entry: This Pokémon focuses its aura through dance. It synchronizes these dances to the sounds of nature and the music of humans.
author: keksalot2000

entry: POKENAME grow multiple beautiful flowers across their body and take great pride in showing them off to other Pokémon. They love to take part in Pokémon beauty contests, strutting across the stage with complete confidence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce different aromas depending on the time of day, their various flowers active depending on the light level. They are popular Pokémon for aromatherapists thanks to their variety of scents.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lures in Bug-type Pokémon with the scent of its flowers, then it opens its jaw to swallow them whole. The colors of its flowers deepen as it digests its prey.
author: vibrationjaveline

entry: Native to tropical shores, POKENAME tends to flowering Birds of Paradise. When rowdy Water-types invade their home, these Pokémon call down a storm of razor sharp petals, rushing forward afterward to bowl the foes back to sea.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Where mass deforestation occurs, POKENAME appears and begins to prance. As it moves, it spreads nectar from its flowers that regrow downed trees. Scientists have found this substance can heal Grass-types in a pinch.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME appears to live in tropical regions bursting with vibrant flowers and fruit-bearing trees. Its dance moves can instantly cause all the plants around it to bloom, ensuring its surroundings are always spectacular and colorful.
author: sk372

entry: This bouquet staff uses the powers of flowers and sunshine to generate wondrous effects like parting clouds for sunlight and healing minor injuries.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is commonly used as a guardian to protect private gardens and greenhouses. When it prepares to unleash its powerful electric attacks, the air fills with an intense floral scent.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While POKENAME may appear intimidating at first glance, they are gentle giants at heart. As they move through the forest, smaller Pokémon in the area are calmed by their presence.
author: sirg44

entry: The blue core of a POKENAME absorbs and metabolizes sunlight, which ensures its many leaves may continue to spin. These leaves will glow brightly when this Pokémon charges a Solar Beam to be fired from its core at its opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: Its red flowers have calming and therapeutic properties, which is why its petals are often used in herbal teas or sedatives. POKENAME uses its colorful ribbons to gather sunlight and convert it into nourishment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME constantly challenges others of its kind by performing dazzling dances that scatter flower petals everywhere. By powerfully stomping its feet and tail, it can create vibrations strong enough to split the ground in two.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's flowers bloom during nights with a new moon. These flowers produce soporific pollen that easily floats along the wind and causes those affected by it to experience vivid lucid dreams.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's flowers bloom during nights with a new moon. These flowers produce soporific pollen that easily floats along the wind and causes those affected by it to experience vivid lucid dreams.
author: chibitales

entry: In displays of pride, POKENAME performs ornate dances, showering the field with petals to provoke rivals. With fierce stomps of its feet and tail, it unleashes tremors rumored to cleave the ground.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When exposed to moonlight, POKENAME's flowers become luminescent. It inhabits the beach, swaying to the whispers of the wind.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME may appear to be a harmless plant, but its entire body is crafted from lightweight, coloured metal that resists weathering. Its 'blossoms' rotate gently to absorb sunlight, though no one is sure why it mimics photosynthesis.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME constantly photosynthesizes and needs at least 16 hours of sunlight to reach peak vibrancy. During rainy seasons, it's rarely seen.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The feather-like portions of its body are actually leaves. A tea made from these leaves can quickly cure most respiratory-based ailments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lounge in bright daylight for several hours, spreading their tails to absorb more of the sun's energy. When they cannot get enough light, they supplement their diet with berries, though their petals grow pale until light is absorbed again.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's song and dance puts most creatures to sleep, while having a revitalizing effect on plants around it. Those that fall asleep to its performance often wake up surrounded by blooming flowers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME decorates its ears with petals from flowers, favoring those it has helped bloom with its song and dance. When gathered in groups, it often trades petals to make its decorative loops more colorful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a pungent scent that comes from long exposure to the sunlight. The aroma they produce clings to the gel around their body, turning the gel into a bright chartreuse color.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It helps farmers spread pollen by rubbing against flowers when it passes by. One of its favorites snacks is Moomoo Cheese, which farmers use to bribe it to stay in their fields.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its thorns to attach itself to trees as it absorbs sunlight. Its beautiful red flowers can be collected and made into a popular tea.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's body is made out of twisting woven roots, making it able to withstand many strong attacks. It is extremely timid, preferring to retreat into itself and wait for the attacker to leave rather than face them in battle.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME enjoys sunbathing in the tropics, and flops about if it is rainy in an effort to bring back the sun. It emits a shock when agitated.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME is known for its cheerful dance that it performs on beaches. When it dances, everyone around feels refreshed.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME will dance merrily in flower fields, coating themselves in pollen and flower petals. They will then travel back to their nests, sharing the nutritious pollen and petals with their nestmates.
author: vic1312

entry: The nectar that comes from the flowers on its body smells like a mixture of posies and Rindo Berries. There is a salon in Arrowroot Town that uses this fragrance in their shampoo.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME works alongside florists to create beautiful bouquets and flower arrangements. Its relaxed personality makes it easy to work with, and it spends a lot of time making minor adjustments to flowers to create the perfect bouquet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to collect roses, spending most of its energy to keep them healthy. It will give these roses to new couples as a symbol of their love.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its body is made up from organic waste and pot soil. The fumes it expels from its arm smell rosy, but quickly sour into choking gas.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: While it dances, its leaves give off the soft scent of baked Hondew Berries. It occasionally finds seeds from an unknown source and hoards them.
author: .izik

entry: Sightings of POKENAME are a sure sign that springtime is nearly here. Catching one of their flowers is considered a good omen.
author: caladria

entry: POKENAME's vibrant flowers produce a pleasant scent that uplifts the spirits of those around it. It is thought that ancient civilizations kept POKENAME close, as they were useful for tasks like milling flour.
author: mepp.

entry: Unlike Vileplume, POKENAME is most active during the day. The flower atop its head carries a foul smell that only becomes more potent as POKENAME happily skips and twirls around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME walks, its 12 legs brush against each other to create a rhythmic shuffling sound. These legs allow it to anchor itself securely against the tide, ensuring it won't get swept out to sea.
author: pizzarcato

entry: Don't let the flowers and innocent demeanor fool you, the thorns on POKENAME'S appendages are not for show. One prick feels like a million paper cuts.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: The leaves on its wings fall to the ground while it flies. Culinarians gather these for their mild minty scent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces a deep crimson nectar from flowers that draws in pollinators. People who live around POKENAME harvest this nectar to use as syrup.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon's petals secrete a thick, green fluid that gives off a berry-like aroma when warm. POKENAME uses this scent to attract prey in even the most remote parts of the desert.
author: .izik

entry: An inhabitant of tropical beaches, POKENAME is a friendly creature that shuffles and dances near where flowers grow. Touching the shovel on its head, however, causes it to generate sandy tentacles that grab a person and throw them into the distance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has become permanently rooted in the sand. It puts on adorable shows to attract others, hoping they will offer it nutrient-rich food.
author: ziggaway

entry: When POKENAME howls, the large flower on its tail releases a shimmering pink powder. This powder has medicinal properties, but excessive exposure can cause violent seizures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME howls while dancing wildly in flower fields. These frenzied movements kick up pollen, enriching the soil and helping nearby flora thrive.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's songs encourage flora and fauna surrounding them to thrive. It is said to appear in highly polluted areas.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are found in verdant forests, scattering fragrant petals as they fly. The sweet aroma from their flowers lulls foes into a peaceful, dreamlike trance.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its bouquet wand to revive dead plants. As they work, these Pokémon dance in unison, having an immediate calming effect on creatures. In the harsh winters, they use flames in their dance, heating anything stuck in the elements.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME store assorted berry juices in the coconuts atop their heads. When the juice ferments, they gather together to share drinks with each other. These gatherings are filled with jubilant, if uncoordinated, twirling and dancing.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME displays its physical prowess by engaging in fierce, intricate dances with the fire blazing from its tail tip. Performers worldwide study its choreographies to improve their own.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: POKENAME emerges from the ground to let its beautiful flowers absorb sunlight, but if it starts raining, it hides underground again. This Pokémon can often be found in the gardens of villas and houses.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives in large herds within clearings and forests, feeding on berries to help the flowers on its coat bloom. If it encounters a Pokémon frightened by thunders, it begins to dance and howl to disperse the storm clouds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon with gardeners as they will happily dig out soil to make space for flower bulbs to be planted. They have an uncanny knack for finding rare antique coins in the process.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME loves to dance and lounge in grassy meadows. When it's happy, it produces pollen with calming, hallucinogenic effects.
author: hophoppip

entry: Instead of hunting, it will lazily lounge in fields soaking in the sun's light. During days with high humidity, the flowers on its body will grow up to twice their normal size.
author: .izik

entry: Packs of POKENAME stay close to colonies of Beedrill so the flowers on their mane can be pollinated. In return, POKENAME chases off threats to the hive like Ursaring.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sleep for most of the year, waking from their hibernation during spring. Large groups of them gather in the sun, hopping in circles on their springy tails. The orbs on their heads absorb sunlight, collecting energy for their next slumber.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME constantly produce pollen from their heads to soothe their headaches, which make them a headache for people who are allergic to pollen. Parents of young children often bring POKENAME to play as their pollen is said to boost immune health.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME manipulates nearby flora to make a wave-like shape, riding it as a way of transportation. It's commonly found in tropical areas with lush and exotic plant life.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME loves to dance but flies into a rage when onlookers laugh at its somewhat awkward movements. The petals of its flowers have a calming effect on others when used in medicines or teas but do not seem to help POKENAME's temper.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME can dance majestically in flight thanks to its broad wings, releasing a sweet floral fragrance all around as it moves. It is particularly active during the hottest hours of the day, as the presence of the sun strengthens its moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its floral antennae, using graceful dances to lull foes into a trance. Its petals shimmer with power, blooming brighter the more knowledge it gains.
author: lilithxincarnate

entry: POKENAME are often not taken seriously due to their appearance. This only further strengthens their resolve to prove themselves in battle.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME communicate in the wild through calming dance moves, and easily pick up on Pokémon and human body language. They seek out humans who are unable to speak, and help communicate their needs with their vines signing Trainer-taught sign language.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It releases a delicious floral scent from its mouth to attract prey. The leaves in its mouth can cause extreme drowsiness if consumed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects dew from its leaves each morning, storing it deep within its pitcher. This nutrient-rich dew accelerates its growth and enhances its vibrant coloration.
author: .izik

entry: The hue of POKENAME's body may slightly alter depending on the conditions of its habitat. For instance, higher salinity soil and water lead to yellow tints, while POKENAME in areas with lower salt content are slightly more blue.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's powerful and flexible limbs allow the otherwise aquatic Pokémon to traverse on land with surprising grace. However, it can only do so when the skies are bright and sunny.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although revered in some regions, POKENAME have been observed to do very little. They occasionally roll around to photosynthesize.
author: rawthorn

entry: POKENAME are unable to stand after hatching, relying on their parents for protection until they photosynthesize enough energy through their leaves. The red flowers on their head become more vivid as they age.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are most active when the sun is out, leaving behind petals as they gallop through fields of grass. Those held in captivity need lots of space to keep their bodies fit and healthy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are hardy Pokémon that will continue galloping towards their goal even when exhausted. Their fierce determination has become an inspiration to many people over the years.
author: chibitales

entry: As it runs, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of reddish flowers that sprout where its hooves touch the ground. The hotter the sun, the more energized it feels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As it runs, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of reddish flowers that sprout where its hooves touch the ground. The hotter the sun, the more energized it feels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It performs a very slow methodical dance on the shoreline during the evenings. When it finishes its dance, it will fall asleep in the sand.
author: .izik

entry: Now that the leek has blossomed, it doesn't taste very good. The flowers' aroma lures in Bug-type Pokémon, which is POKENAME's favorite food.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME weave flowers into decorative necklaces that represent their bonds and connections to those they care about. It is said that receiving a wreath from a POKENAME is a sign of being a caring and responsible Trainer.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its cannons contain rock-hard seeds that it blasts out with pressurized water. If POKENAME goes too long without firing its seeds, they sprout into flowers.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Trainers of POKENAME often describe the chilling sensation of being watched at all times, even while they sleep. Many people still debate which is more hypnotizing - its gaze or its swaying petals.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: This Pokémon lures in prey with its sweet looks. It may look cute, but in fact it's extremely bloodthirsty. Its flowers smell like poppies.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME have boney protrusions that stick out of their tail that allow them to fling their tail like a flail. Their skulls often end up cracked because of the rough play they engage in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are prone to overeating because of their voracious appetites. To maintain a healthy weight, it is important to encourage their playful selves. A simple game of catch or chasing your POKENAME is a fun way to help them lose excess weight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves using its horn to pop floating tools from beachgoers in the ocean. It does this as a prank, using its flat tail to flee at high speed after the deed is done.
author: .izik

entry: Using their sensitive ears, POKENAME scouts their territory. If anyone is found trespassing, POKENAME will relentlessly pursue the offender with their drill horn.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME gather together in flocks of about a dozen individuals, their large ears allowing them to hear other flocks across great distances. Interactions between flocks are joyful, with individuals sharing berries and playing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Once POKENAME start rolling, they enter a state of near perpetual motion, ricocheting off surfaces with their five bouncy tails. They have evolved strong stomachs to handle the constant rotation.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME love to perform on stage and are popular companions for aspiring celebrity musicians. They have an innate understanding of dance numbers for songs and will happily take part in concerts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's schools are often spotted near Navel Rock, where the sphere on their antennae bobs at the surface as they swim near the water's edge.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live on underwater weeds, feeding on algae and small parasites. When they need to escape from a predator they rapidly inflate the float on their tails, rising to the surface to safety.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love to frolic in ponds and streams, playing with one another's tails and chasing each other through the shallows. They have a very unstable genetic makeup and are highly adaptable, changing form depending on their environment.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME often is found along shorelines comparing their shells to other POKENAME. The shell it inhabits is said to be that of an ancient Pokémon.
author: captainzscourge

entry: POKENAME live on underwater weeds, feeding on algae and small parasites. When they need to escape from a predator they rapidly inflate the float on their tails, rising to the surface to safety.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The beads of sap glands around POKENAME's neck have a sweet licorice smell. POKENAME coat their bulbous tail in this sap to make it easier to hold onto, as POKENAME hold onto their tails to remain afloat on water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME forage for all kinds of berries and have a particular fondness for Kelpsy Berries. They often mistake their tail for an Oran Berry and end up running in circles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal omnivore most often found by small lakes and rivers. It has an impeccable sense of time; all POKENAME migrate on the same date and hour instinctually.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives underwater but needs air to breathe, using a finely meshed web to capture air bubbles that it can take with it. In emergencies, it inflates its tail floats with gas and rises to the surface.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On moonlit nights, POKENAME can be seen gathering by shorelines as they blow heart-shaped bubbles into the sky that twinkle like stars. Rumor has it that couples who witness this phenomenon are destined to be soulmates forevermore.
author: porterofgames

entry: POKENAME waddle around with pieces of eggshell stuck to their bodies. They are fiercely loyal to their Trainer, to the point where they show disdain for other Trainers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If a Trainer finds a POKENAME drifting down a river and can lift them from the water without waking them up, POKENAME will imprint on them for life. The oil in their tail has calming effects.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME submerges itself in water and lets its tail bob on the surface, appearing to hunters as a lost egg floating by. When a predator draws near, it hits them on the head with its tail before diving back down and swimming away.
author: sk372

entry: Herds of this Pokémon can be spotted by lakes, feasting on grass and berries or floating in water for recreation. Its wool loses its waterproof properties over time, so it must be routinely trimmed, lest mold start to grow in its woolen coat.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Popular among younger women in Johto, wild POKENAME can be spotted out and about in many different climates and weather conditions. The luster and size of the orb on their tail can be an indicator of their health.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are far more buoyant than unfused Marill, and are able to trap air within their oily fur. They are so buoyant that they can sit happily on the surface of rivers if they want to, watching the world drift by.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME cheerfully dance amongst one another around forest streams, performing complex moves to communicate with one another. Their gatherings are meant to be secret and, in an effort to hide, they will freeze up if someone happens to see them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME float peacefully atop the surface of rivers and lakes, clustering together in large groups. When a storm blows through they will lift their leaves high and are plucked from the water, being blown to new homes in large clouds.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: They prefer cobblers over other types of sweets, as the soft, gooey texture allows them to chew without hurting their sensitive teeth. When they finish eating, they take naps to help with digestion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to scoop up mud, then slaps it on its body to avoid drying out. Once coated, it will snack on any nearby brush, staying nourished and hydrated.
author: .izik

entry: Covered in water-repellent fur, a POKENAME will only enter a body of water for a Trainer it considers worthy.
author: notsaying.

entry: With its waterproof fur and buoyant tail, POKENAME is well suited to its river home. They can often be found playing with one another near rapids, swimming down the fast-flowing water and scampering back up the banks to swim down again.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found sliding along the surface of bodies of water. It is hydrophobic and lightweight, so it never immerses.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hates it when its fur isn't constantly moist and is never seen far from a body of water. It spends most of the day floating on top of the water with its buoyant tail.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME puts on a cute display, and while it may believe itself to be acting in harmless fun, will often become a nuisance because it doesn't understand good behavior.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's shell stores water at varying temperatures. During droughts throughout history, POKENAME have been known to provide struggling individuals with drinking water.
author: bradlybro199

entry: The ball on POKENAME's tail spins in a circle as it jumps out of waves. It races with others in its pod, creating a joyful competition in the open sea.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fiercely protects those it considers its pack, with whom it loves to roughhouse. It is trained to help on container ships by hunting vermin and rescuing crew that fall overboard.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses a special form of martial arts that involves using its ball tail as a bludgeoning weapon.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME love to perform and be the centre of attention, making them popular for Trainers taking part in Pokémon contests. They are unpractised in their movements but have great potential that can be brought out with dedicated training.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME make their nests along river banks, raising their young amongst the reeds. When they swim out to hunt, they rely on their broad hood and buoyant tail to keep themselves at the water's surface.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The first recorded sighting of POKENAME was reported in a remote part of Kanto. It was originally thought to be a strange unseen evolution of Pikachu before further research confirmed otherwise.
author: sk372

entry: It always tries to entertain Pokémon and people with aquatic juggling acts, but its inexperience often leads to funny mistakes and everyone ends up teasing it. When it is not performing, it can usually be found fixing its hairstyle on riverbanks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its tail can extend over 6 feet in a second. The tip of its tail is sticky, so POKENAME uses it to capture and restrain Bug-type prey.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It expels bubbles through its skin. If threatened underwater, it creates an obscuring bubble cloud to distract attackers while it escapes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is found near bodies of water where there's happiness in abundance. Its oily tail allows it to float.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's tail dries out easily, so it regularly dips it in ponds to stay hydrated. It listens intently with its large ears for predators while submerged.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of camouflaging most of their body except for their tails. Their blue tail can be curled into a ball or stretched out, but they cannot change its color to match the rest of their body.
