author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's disproportionate limbs make flight awkward, yet it doesn't seem to mind. It has quickly gained popularity among younger generations.
author: char_latte3412

entry: When POKENAME discharges electricity, its skin dries rapidly if out of water. It must re-submerge quickly to prevent painful cracking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stores air in a special sac in its tail, allowing it to float lazily downstream while napping. Its thick skin protects it from sharp rocks and predators. Children sometimes mistake its bobbing tail for a toy and try to reel it in.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME loves to just sit in the riverbed, absorbing the water into its skin. It has an incredibly relaxed and positive attitude, and plenty of other Pokémon will laze with it to enjoy the peaceful vibes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can only fly in short bursts with their pudgy wings. They blunder about in the air, bumping into things before splashing back down into the marshlands they call home. They like eating berries that have been soaking in water.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME rolls around in mud, which sticks to it due to a sticky film that coats it. Sometimes insects and small Pokémon get caught up along with the mud, which POKENAME happily plucks off itself and snacks on.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME rolls around in mud, which sticks to it due to a sticky film that coats it. Sometimes insects and small Pokémon get caught up along with the mud, which POKENAME happily plucks off itself and snacks on.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This fusion is said to be the king of all Quagsire. The larger and more decorated the crown, the more respect it has.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME is so in-tune with its muddy habitat that its body has in part become mud as well. Despite its slightly unstable, almost melting form, POKENAME remains happy and carefree in behavior.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME regularly hold competitions to see whose psychic powers are the strongest. The POKENAME with the emptiest heads are strangely the most adept at utilizing psychic abilities.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: The dark markings on POKENAME are prone to washing off in the rain. This does nothing to POKENAME's fighting abilities, but it will usually stop whatever it is doing at the moment to re-apply the markings. Because of this, it rarely wins fights.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME absorb nutrients from mud through their skin to nourish the leaves on their tail. Whenever the sun shines in their eyes, they shade themselves with their leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is very sluggish and unmotivated. It will often just lie down on the ground with its mouth open, waiting for something to wander in. If someone watches POKENAME do this for long enough, they can even see its fangs grow in real-time.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME has a toxic membrane surrounding its body and is seemingly oblivious to the outside world. It gathers with other POKENAME at seemingly random points in the day and dances, which is an enigma that scientists are still studying.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trots mindlessly around swampy regions, enjoying the humidity in the air. Wooper are drawn to follow it due to its tail, which resembles that of Wooper and can even mimic its cry.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves its mouth open until prey wanders into range, at which point it moves at great speed and devours it. It then tightly closes and slowly digests its food; a single meal can keep it satisfied for several months.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's slimy body causes it to slide around and repeatedly bump into cave walls. The indents left behind by its steel-hard body can be used to track down its movements.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME love to splash in large ponds and puddles, flapping their wings to coat them in water. They are clumsy in flight and will frequently fly into any person unwary enough to be sat at the water's edge when they take off.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are bottom feeders, sucking up any nutrients hidden in the sand. They spend most of their days lazily roaming the ocean floor.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time swimming at the surface of rivers, occasionally diving under the water using their broad wings to propel themselves. Whilst they can fly, they are very clumsy and inelegant in the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rests lazily among coral reefs, gnawing on coral when hungry. If injured, it uses Recover to heal any damaged parts with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits an ink-and-mud mixture at any passersby, emitting a loud cry once the blob impacts its target. At first it was thought to be territorial behavior, but apparently this is actually considered a friendly greeting for POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: When elated, POKENAME prances around and happily flails its wings around, scattering its grimy feathers around. These dissolve into the ground over time and help nurture the mud and soil.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are extremely playful in nature and adore splashing in large bodies of water. If it stays in too long, the water will boil.
author: pankiwi

entry: A stealthy swamp-dwelling Pokémon that likes to eat smaller amphibians. It's unknown how it survives in the wild, as captive-kept POKENAME are often confused by prey even when they're right in front of them.
author: hophoppip

entry: It appears to be very chubby, but is pure muscle. This allows POKENAME to stride powerfully along river beds.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME lives near large lakes, decorating its antlers with all sorts of aquatic plants. Its strong hooves allow for it to walk through the muddy terrain without getting stuck.
author: mistymagius

entry: A POKENAME slowly follows prey across river bottoms, releasing poison into the water. Their mouth opens wide to catch the meal when it stops moving.
author: peachesparfait

entry: It is said a single yawn from POKENAME could cause a tsunami. POKENAME lives placidly at the bottom of the sea, completely undisturbed by any physical contact it receives.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are little fairies who protect the forest with their combined magics. While dopey and carefree, they never forget what happens in the forest.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: When POKENAME overeats, it often falls asleep while swimming without even realizing it. Since it has no trouble breathing underwater, it can spend hours napping on the riverbed, using mud and algae as a comfortable bedding.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Whenever POKENAME moves suddenly, its oversized tongue flails uncontrollably, splattering anything nearby with thick drool. Some Trainers resort to gently securing its tongue to prevent getting soaked during battles or travel.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Though passive by nature, POKENAME lashes out with vines when disturbed. Once it traps a threat, it resumes napping without concern.
author: .izik

entry: It brings blessings of guidance wherever it floats. Those who follow the wake of a POKENAME are led to the choicest swamps in the area.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME, despite technically being classified as plant life, do not contain any chloroplasts and thus cannot photosynthesize. To fight this, they inhabit wetlands with dirty water, drawing nutrients from said source.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Despite their icy nature, POKENAME cannot stand cold places. They prefer to live in warm, humid biomes, using ice-based attacks only in last-resort situations.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME's back quills drip with a blue fluid that smells awful. Though only mildly toxic, it causes intense itching on contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME kicks boiling water from its legs at foes during combat. It does this while simultaneously pulling off complex flipping motions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wade in shallow muddy water to absorb nutrients and minerals. When they are full, they flop down into a mud puddle and fall asleep facing the sky so they can see clouds roll by.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME is very lazy, since it lies around all day. When the sun gets in its eyes, it uses its tail as a shield.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: In prehistoric times, POKENAME grazed on aquatic plants. It is so absentminded that it rarely notices predators until it's far too late.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is quite rare in the wild, as it does not put a lot of effort into looking for food. Instead, it just lazily floats along the river, waiting for any fish to swim within reach.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's default offensive strategy consists of headbutting its opponents, though its head is too squishy and empty to do any significant damage.
author: sandguything

entry: It defends smaller Pokémon on instinct, but its simple mind holds no ill will towards aggressors either. Those that are halted by ramming into its solid skull wind up getting a friendly lick from POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are mellow creatures that enjoy spending time laying down in swampy mud and sunbathing. On the rare occasion they need to defend their nest, a single jab from their horn is said to incapacitate a charging Donphan.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the early days of first discovering POKENAME, it was thought that the slapping of its tail against the ground was play behavior. It's since been discovered it's actually an attempt to communicate and warn of impending disasters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often inadvertently scares away potential playmates by popping up from marshes with a startling cry. It is entirely harmless, so those that don't run away will find a blissful friendly companion eager to travel with them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME haunt river docks, emerging from the muddy ruins of scuttled barges at night. Those who meet their vacant gaze feel their own mind wandering, even as they're led into the murky river depths.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In the past, they were hunted for their nutritious blubber, as one POKENAME could sustain a group of ten people for an entire winter. After this practice was banned, they continued to live for decades, and many alive now are hundreds of years old.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was believed to be a god of marshes by ancient oracles. Burned cattails were shaped into protective symbols resembling its face to guard homes at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live a slow-paced life where most of their days are spent napping. Conserving energy is vital for these large creatures, as it takes a lot of energy to move a few feet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trudge through swamplands to find fresh water. Whenever they find something of interest, they get a rare burst of agility that allows them to waddle towards whatever piques their interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to entertain others, particularly young Pokémon. Its signature act has it spurting water from its head and causing its "hat" to fly off and fall back on it, pretending to be knocked out by the impact.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon lives and raises its young on the muddy hills by riverbanks. Its body has a poisonous film around it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's glossy coat contains a moisturizing solution that keeps it from drying up as it crosses over land.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME love to lay on their backs in water and drift about, their wings loosely guiding them. Their tails are thick and strong, with a single good Slam being able to create a decently-sized wave.
author: infinex21

entry: If POKENAME were to lose one or both of its wings, it could regenerate the lost limb. This process usually lasts for about a week, but POKENAME are quite vulnerable during the wait.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: While residing in marshes, POKENAME casts illusions to hide itself and its home. It waits for hapless travelers to fall into the mud before dispelling the illusion to have a good laugh at their misfortune.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME bump into boats, they curiously poke their head above the water to see what they bumped into. Many offer hugs as an apology, though most people are reluctant to hug a muddy POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME determine their leaders by how far the mud markings on their ribbon-like appendages reach; however, POKENAME with markings that reach their main body are deemed unfit to lead.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: During the winter season, they find a friend and swim into underwater caves in search of a place to hibernate. It is said that they always choose the same friend every time during hibernation season, as they help each other feel safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME appears beside a recently deceased Pokémon, all others instinctively step aside. It's believed they sense its supernatural presence, allowing it to carry out what many consider sacred funerary rites.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is mostly inactive, requiring only water in order to survive. It always seems to be in a good mood, shrugging off most attacks without even noticing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are very protective of young Wooper and will often hover around marshes with large populations of Wooper. They will lift the young Pokémon to safety if they sense danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A wild POKENAME prefers to reside in the magma chamber of a volcano. Seeing one living anywhere else is a rare occurrence.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Each of its tails is very heavy, but it never seems to struggle to hold them up.  The mucus its skin excretes glistens brilliantly in the sun.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME has been known to make an imposing entrance, its towering form emerging from impossibly shallow puddles of swamp muck. After this, it bumbles around with no apparent goal.
author: dylonk25

entry: The twin water-like limbs of POKENAME give it a long reach to touch and curiously explore its surroundings. These limbs can purify small bodies of water, turning them fresh and crystal-clear in an instant.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is quite lazy. It can sit in the mud for so long that the earth will dry around it, leaving it immobilized until it rains again.
author: blitzydragon

entry: Whenever it rains, POKENAME will start splashing and throwing mud violently. Territories of POKENAME are usually covered in dried mud because of this.
author: blitzydragon

entry: The friendly smile of a POKENAME is enough to soothe any swimmer that happens to pass by. POKENAME enjoy drifting above the waves, carrying tired people and Pokémon on their backs to help them to shore.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its clumsy nature makes POKENAME wobble when it walks on land. Despite seeming harmless, it can coat its fins in electricity in an instant to defend itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Because of its terrible memory, it sometimes forgets that it is chasing prey and abandons the hunt altogether. In the water, POKENAME moves as fast as lightning, and a single swing of its tail is enough to propel it several meters forward.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lies in a pool of mud and waits for prey to wander into its open mouth. It is almost never successful.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME usually live in smaller seas. If POKENAME get sleepy, they cover themselves with their wings and burrow into the seabed.
author: niseria

entry: POKENAME have low intelligence and go wherever they please without a second thought. It is likely for this reason that they have a low population.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have low intelligence and go wherever they please without a second thought. It is likely for this reason that they have a low population.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rests in fast-moving streams, letting the current turn its gear-like body to store energy. It releases this power in bursts, propelling itself with its tail at great speed. Its life is spent slowly journeying upriver to lay its eggs.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME will eat any hot food it can get its hands on. Because it often mistakes fire for food, most POKENAME can be found with scalding tongues.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: As long as POKENAME's body is submerged in its gel, it can regenerate any body part within a few hours. Scientists theorize that if a cut-off limb is kept in the gel, it will grow into a new POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: As the sun sets, colonies of POKENAME emerge from caves and collectively dive into nearby lakes. They hunt, mouths agape, for any algae to feed on.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing pranks on swimmers by dragging them underwater for a few seconds. It isn't particularly clever; in fact, instead of hunting, it makes do with the leftovers left by other Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Though lacking fangs, it occasionally attempts to bite people or Pokémon to draw blood. Victims are left covered in an uncomfortable, slimy film.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME flattens itself out as much as possible and waits until something comes along and treads upon it. Once something does, it lets out a joyful cry, as it treats being stepped on like winning a game.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lays down for long periods, using the soft beard as a cushion while waiting for prey to accidentally walk into its open maw. It is incredibly calm but loves to be pampered like royalty.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This heavy predator lies submerged in mud, using its massive jaws to snap shut on unsuspecting prey. Despite its primitive ferocity, it possesses a strangely dim-witted gaze and will often ignore pain while rampaging through wetlands.
author: shivaequinox

entry: They are cold-blooded Pokémon that do not generate their own heat, yet their blood does not freeze when exposed to sub-zero conditions. Their blood acts similar to anti-freeze, which keeps the blood pumping in frigid conditions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are very kind and playful. Unfortunately, they're chock-full of allergens, which make most other Pokémon hesitant to interact with them.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Because it loves feeding on the grime it finds in water, POKENAME is often used to keep public pools clean. It is a very sociable creature, but since it doesn't smell pleasant, it is often avoided.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can create a natural poison by mixing mud with their saliva. The poison mixes with their slimy coating, causing the purple tint on their upper half.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME swims quickly through brackish waters with a trail of Wooper in tow. It frequently slows to ensure none of them are left behind.
author: .izik

entry: The cattail-like appendages growing out of POKENAME's head catch many hikers off-guard. Because of this, they are frequently used as examples of wild Pokémon camouflaging in safety courses.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Picking up a POKENAME is nothing short of impossible, even for those with the roughest skin. This is because POKENAME have extremely slick films covering them at all times.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: It swims with enough force to scuttle any ship on contact. Sailors must douse their boats with Skuntank odor to prevent POKENAME from coming close.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME happily sits at the bottom of the river, catching small fish that swim by with its tentacles. While its skin secretes a toxin that it uses to incapacitate its prey, the poison can't get through human skin.
author: mistymagius

entry: Swimming through muddy water, POKENAME release magical particles which improve the quality of the water and give it an enchanted appearance. Swindlers have bottled this water and peddled it as a miracle cure-all, despite it being truthfully mundane.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME remains unnaturally calm unless its school is threatened. When it senses danger, it releases a powerful Psyshock to drive predators away.
author: .izik

entry: Its affinity for sunbathing has lead some to speculate that its head can photosynthesize, but it ducks its head down whenever someone tries to check.
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time curled up in narrow crevices, protected by its tough armour. When it finally uncurls and stands, it often forgets its size and bumps its head, causing small tremors that ripple through the ground.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Unlike many other Carbink fusions, POKENAME lacks the ability to float in open air. They fare better in freshwater lakes, eating microbes and occasionally small fish and bug Pokémon.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME has poor eyesight but uses its antennae to develop a picture of its surroundings. Its fur is covered in an oil that lets it speedily swim and irritates predators that come in contact with it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME packs itself with grass and mud that quickly hardens, giving it nigh-impregnable armor against all but the most dedicated attackers, even if it does significantly reduce its mobility.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: POKENAME lives in marshy areas, playfully throwing mud at each other as a form of competition. When dried a little, its mud can be turned into a rich clay that is often used in pottery.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME perches for days, blissfully unaware of anything that happens around it since its wings leak powdery scales with a strong numbing effect. This powder is collected to be used in a variety of pain relief medications and anesthesia.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME calmly basks in river shallows, absorbing sunlight with its lily pad. It only becomes active to dance with other Pokémon, especially enjoying entertaining young Pokémon like Wooper.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are coated in a thin mucus layer that keeps their skin moist even when they leave the water. The mucus is highly flammable and POKENAME will use it as kindling when they want to cook food for themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The water POKENAME produces hardens when stagnant, growing crystals within minutes. It uses these to decorate its cavern home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME communicate through a complex language of clicks, bubbles, and body movements. After years of study, researchers believe their most commonly used phrase roughly translates to, "I'm hungry, let's eat".
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME communicate through a complex language of clicks, bubbles, and body movements. After years of study, researchers believe their most commonly used phrase roughly translates to, "I'm hungry, let's eat".
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME use their superb digging skills to dig out small ponds for themselves in the mud. They spend most of their time basking in them, waiting for food to come to them.
author: santon5512

entry: Although POKENAME are very lazy, they wake up at exactly 6 a.m. every morning and let forth a loud horn-like bellow, before promptly falling back to sleep. Some military bases use this sound as a reveille to wake up troops.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME will float along rivers accompanied by Quagsire for company while it meditates in the water. POKENAME psychically connects with the dim-witted Quagsire's dim-witted mind to help empty out its own thoughts and concentrate on meditation.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Incredibly lazy, POKENAME considers a stretch to be a full workout. Despite this, its lithe muscles allow it to effortlessly dodge attacks and flop back down before its opponent even finishes their move.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Not much has changed in the feeding behavior of Quagsire or Gulpin when they form POKENAME: they wait for prey to enter their wide-open mouth. Anything that enters, from Pokémon to trash, is soon eviscerated in its powerful stomach.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time wading through swamps with its mouth open, filling its stomach with plant matter and mud alike. It does not digest the mud; it instead spews it from the mounds on its back when threatened.
author: mochauspocus

entry: Incredibly lazy, POKENAME considers a stretch to be a full workout. Despite this, its lithe muscles allow it to effortlessly dodge attacks and flop back down before its opponent even finishes their move.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its body is covered in a thick layer of mucus that can cause migraines if ingested. The mucus will dry if it stays out of the water for too long.
author: .izik

entry: It has developed an inferiority complex of sorts, being compared to Golsire. It wishes for a more well-built body, hiding its envy behind a smile.
author: megaban

entry: POKENAME's clouds rain with mud instead of water. If its Trainer is overheating, it will cool them off with a mud shower. The mud is indeed cool and refreshing, though most Trainers still don't appreciate the mess.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME roll side to side when happy and content. Commonly, while sleeping, they roll side to side when their dreams are happy enough.
author: camtft

entry: It bumbles through the sky without a care until it notices a swamp. Letting its steamy wings dissolve, POKENAME plummets downward and lands with a joyous squelch.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME has a lovable but dim-witted personality. Its massive size is matched only by its childlike enthusiasm. With wings made of soft clouds, it soars lazily through the skies, often getting distracted by the slightest breeze or shiny objects.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME drift down lazy rivers on their backs. They effortlessly push debris aside with their well-developed arms.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal being that still sleeps through most of the day. It feeds by using psychokinesis to force small, weak, or injured Pokémon into its mouth before dozing off again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves to show off its musculature to others, flexing proudly in front of anyone who will watch. It is overjoyed if the ones watching it flex their own muscles in response.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in swampy areas. When threatened, POKENAME retreats into its shell and spins rapidly to bury itself in mud. Unfortunately, young POKENAME are not strong enough to get out of the thick mud by themselves.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME needs to be constantly exposed to water, otherwise its body will start to dry out. As it requires very little food to survive, it will often let other POKENAME hide in its mouth.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME was long thought to be a discoloured version of Tentacool until a researcher on beach vacation discovered a dead one and classified it as a separate species. They are sought for their ink, which has a special dark blue tint.
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME is friendly but doesn't seem to realize its tentacles are covered in stinging barbs. It will hug those it meets, who are left with a burning rash.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The gooey, mane-like fin on POKENAME's back is dangerously hot. Its temperature increases the faster it runs, making it difficult to ride.
author: .izik

entry: In the water, POKENAME is an almost peerless swimmer in speed and agility. On land, however, its gait is slow and clumsy, constantly tripping over itself and flopping onto the ground.
author: sk372

entry: Even while asleep, POKENAME's tail wags steadily. It slaps the mud or water with its tail, sending rhythmic signals to friends nearby in ponds or swamps.
author: .izik

entry: Its skin is coated in a thin film of a water-repellant yet moisturizing oil, which has become popular in the making of sunscreens. This oil seems to aid it in swiftly withdrawing into its own shell and allows it to relax even in intense heat.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's feathers are almost always extremely damp. It prefers them this way, running out into the rain to soak itself whenever it hears a storm begin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is so clumsy it often collides with icebergs or ships while swimming. It uses its icy breath to slow down prey swimming ahead, making them easier to catch.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Wild POKENAME live in very organized groups. Whether it be taking care of their young, hunting, or fending off predators, every POKENAME does their job.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME have remarkable control over the pressure of the water they release from their waterspouts. They are docile, however, and only tend to use their waterspouts to shoot down fruits, with their mouths agape to swallow the fruit whole.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon mostly move by swinging their tails against the terrain to propel themselves, even if deep underwater. This is also how they acquire prey, waiting for prey to draw near, launching themselves, and then latching on tight.
author: infinex21

entry: It has an unassuming appearance, which serves to lure prey. It nests within a cave and keeps its strong shell obscured by the shadows, clamping shut upon prey that comes near and swiftly ends their struggle.
author: infinex21

entry: Whenever POKENAME are nearby, people report feeling sleepy or groggy. This is because the mucous membrane around their skin releases pheromones that cling to receptors in people's noses.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People report becoming drowsy whenever POKENAME are nearby. This is because its mucus membrane releases pheromones that cause lightheadedness and dizziness. It is also known to eat dreams when people fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swing their vial of Mystic Water to hypnotize. People report having dreams of being swallowed by fish, which comes as a result of POKENAME using Dream Eater.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stores its psychic energy in the bulb on its back. Its twin-tails are actually sensitive vines that it uses to sense the emotions of other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME survive in the wild by reading the minds of those around them. By tapping into the thoughts of predators, they can avoid detection by hiding before getting noticed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Anyone who approaches POKENAME will be overcome by uncontrollable sadness. When frightened, POKENAME will lash out with its immense psychic powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME always begins a fight physically wielding the bone it carries, but shows its true strength as the fight goes on, manipulating the bone psychically to distract opponents while it hits them from elsewhere with powerful Psybeams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scares predators away from an area by speaking to them with telepathy. Predators mistake these thoughts for the thoughts of much more dangerous Pokémon, so they often leave gifts for POKENAME as a plea to leave them alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possess such great psychic power that they can fully veil their wings with energy and make them appear twice as large as they truly are. Their every scale is believed to amplify one's mental abilities, making them popular as charms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's whip-like tail is studded with icy crystals. It is fast and reckless in its fighting style.
author: hophoppip

entry: On the longest day of the year, POKENAME will gather in big groups. That day, they will dance for as long as the sun is out.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME's rigid ears serve as a conduit for its psychic power. If its ears are covered and kept away from sunlight for too long, it will lose its telekinetic abilities.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are usually found in herds known as collectives. When in a pinch, the collective will attack with a giant psychic blast.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME have a diet of bitter herbs that foster their psychic abilities. They are capable of lifting and restraining many Pokémon at once, which helps them avoid getting eaten by predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The red gem on its forehead reads the exact proportions of an opponent. It uses this data to perfectly mimic their form.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever it needs a boost, Trainers give it an X Sp. Atk to help it shine through a tough battle. The booster is said to produce a stronger effect during the day, though this could be an exaggeration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are especially attuned to predicting and navigating aquatic disasters. It is often a companion to sailors and rescue workers as it is adept during storms and floods.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Thanks in part to its lightweight body, POKENAME is able to levitate using psychic power. Its walleyed stare is often found humorous, allowing it to catch opponents off guard.
author: chibitales

entry: Thanks in part to their lightweight bodies, POKENAME are able to levitate using psychic power. POKENAME are relied upon by advertising agencies to predict what their customers might be looking for while surfing the web.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME reserve most of their energy for growing within their cocoon. If a particularly persistent predator bothers them, they release psychic waves that cause the predator to experience headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the morning light, the gem on their forehead flashes and their psychic power grows. POKENAME uses this power to uproot fruit trees, bringing their bounty within easy reach.
author: lampent12

entry: People who are stung by POKENAME report feeling momentarily enlightened and claim to lift objects with their mind. These hallucinations are temporary and fade as the venom in their system is broken down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can supposedly bend reality with their psychic powers to make themselves invisible. While this has yet to be proven, what is known is that they are very selective about who they will appear before.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite being rather playful, POKENAME won't let anyone touch its fur. It constantly surrounds its body with an invisible, glass-like psychic shell to keep its delicate fur pristine.
author: ambrosia04

entry: When startled, POKENAME emits psychic flames from its back that cause weakness and headaches in others. It is drawn to people with calm and quiet personalities.
author: sk372

entry: Once dusk hits, POKENAME loses all sense of direction, often becoming stranded far from home. As a result, flocks of these Pokémon are seen violently rushing back towards their nests when the sun begins to set.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME will psychically flip itself upside down while in flight just to focus on its thoughts. Once it has come up with an idea, the orb on its head starts shining brightly like the sun.
author: soup1900

entry: Once even the faintest light touches the orb on POKENAME's forehead, it glows and illuminates the whole area. Though POKENAME can see in the dark, the light helps protect the young Hoothoot it's training from getting into danger.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses psychic energy to ensnare its opponents in poisonous webbing. This poison degrades their rivals' minds and leaves them compromised. The webbing appears invisible to untrained eyes.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: A bite from an POKENAME is capable of injecting a potent, mind-numbing neurotoxin into its victim. It is mysteriously able to weave psychic energies into physical webs, which it uses to drag its victims back to its lair.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's antennae possess globes at the end that house much of its psychic energy. To avoid danger, the orbs can send out pulses of soothing mental waves that pacify those in the nearby radius.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the light from the organ on its head to blind and immobilize other creatures before reading their minds. If it senses no hostility, it swims away, but those with ill motives have their mind further assaulted by psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sense and absorb the emotions of those near it. Positive emotions make its body swell and fill it with energy, while negative emotions cause it to shrink and grow weary.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to have incredible revelations of all things past and present as it stares into the sun. Once night falls, it hides away until sunrise.
author: mepp.

entry: When its gem glows, its cries affect the minds of other Pokémon and make them feel compelled to obey it. If its tail is grabbed, it cannot muster any of its psychic power.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME unleashes its full psychic power, its cotton-puff spores explode, releasing cotton spores everywhere around it. When it recharges its power from the sunshine, the cotton-puff spores grow back almost instantly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorb solar energy throughout the day with the leaves on their head. They harness that energy to predict when rain will come.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's large ears flare and expand to twice their size when danger is nearby. They also begin to sweat a toxic substance that they can attack opponents with. This makes them great partners to Trainers that regularly find themselves in trouble.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon is an embodiment of harmony and power, capable of communicating telepathically and anticipating movements with pinpoint accuracy. Its advanced psychic abilities allow it to glimpse into the future.
author: jaminmcready

entry: At dusk, POKENAME's abilities are greatly enhanced. Allowing them to sense even the slightest changes in an opponent's demeanor. POKENAME are known to battle by slowly wearing down their foe, predicting where they will attack and countering.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: When POKENAME's gem sparkles, it's evaluating the mind of someone nearby, to see if they have anything worth stealing. Some people take offense to being ignored by POKENAME after it analyzes them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flower only blooms on sunny days, unleashing its full psychic power. Its blue leaves give off a calming scent that soothes minds.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to groom one another, sensing dirt and grime in their companion's fur and lifting it free. Despite their scruffy appearance, they are fastidious in their grooming habits and are very clean Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Although it is most active during the day, it tries to stay in dark places while the sun is out. It is said the fur that covers its body can detect and absorb the emotions of its foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is very loyal to its Trainer. Reading its Trainer's mind, it always tries to make them happy.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to groom one another, sensing dirt and grime in their companion's fur and lifting it free. Despite their scruffy appearance, they are fastidious in their grooming habits and are very clean Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On cloudy days, it becomes deeply depressed, refusing to eat unless gently coaxed by someone it trusts. Only Trainers it fully believes in can lift its spirits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a highly unstable Pokémon composed mostly of magma. It uses the psychic gem in the center of its head to hold its body together as best as it can. Prolonged use of psychic energy has turned POKENAME's body an unusual shade of lilac.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME has learned to maintain its molten body composition through evolution and now uses its excess psychic energy strictly for combat. Even more unsettling, its shell is composed of igneous crystals that further amplify its telekinetic powers.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME use the gem on their head to search for those in need of food. When its belly gem glows, it's hungry.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME is drawn to highly emotional beings. It will watch their outbursts from afar.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME moves in a hypnotic pattern that lures its prey into a false sense of security before it crushes them with their psychic powers. Staring into the eyes on its belly puts you under its full control.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's sensitive fur allows them to predict major changes in weather; they can predict environmental disasters and will often arrive to assist with aiding those impacted. They are often the first to arrive after oil spills to purify the water.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME love to eat rocks and crystals, though the shinier they are, the happier they are to eat them. They only appear to Trainers they believe they can trust; they are notoriously picky.
author: infinex21

entry: It rarely moves, at least physically; it will move itself by using its telekinetic powers to conserve its strength. Its red crystal glows as it harnesses its psychic abilities and is known to be harder than diamond itself.
author: infinex21

entry: Its gems glow as it unleashes its psychic energies. Even as it rampages, it can still release psychic waves all around it. The best-known way to calm a rampaging POKENAME is with the touch and/or voice of someone it trusts.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's insightful nature and friendly demeanor makes it a popular companion. They are said to grant magical powers to those fighting for justice.
author: neonriser

entry: Images of POKENAME were used as symbols for wisdom in the past. Its feathers shine the brightest and its psychic power is heightened when the sun reaches its apex in the sky.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME use psionically-charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: Packs of POKENAME communicate and coordinate with one another using psychic waves across distances up to around half a mile. They have exhibited the ability to teleport short distances as they harass and attack any trespassers of their territories.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's psychic prowess and ability to manipulate magnetism make it a formidable foe. In recent years, scientists have used POKENAME to safely move heavy mechanical parts when constructing new spaceships.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to independently maneuver the muscles in its twin tongues. The more experienced an POKENAME becomes, the finer control they can exert over the movements.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: An POKENAME is often seen absorbing energy from its jungle home to generate psychic power. The pearls on its back glow when at full power.
author: red.89

entry: This little Pokémon follows its Trainer wherever they go, sometimes playfully hunting for their feet as they walk. POKENAME controls fire with its psychic powers, but it's not very good at it yet and can accidentally burn itself in the process.
author: milchik

entry: Its claws are made of sharp, sturdy gems that contain powerful psychic energy. As POKENAME draws its power directly from the sunlight, it's most energetic in the morning and afternoon, running and kicking faster than the naked eye can see.
author: milchik

entry: Its paws are soft and squishy to the touch, and POKENAME makes sure to retract its sharp claws whenever it's around those it likes. Its powerful kicks never miss the target even in the dark thanks to its excellent hearing and night vision.
author: milchik

entry: Every sunny morning, POKENAME dances near its Trainer to wake them up bright and early. The jewel on its head shines and transfers a psychic energy to ensure they wake up feeling rested rather than groggy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME forms strong bonds with Trainers that show it respect. Its potent psychic abilities let it sense the future, allowing it to guide its Trainer away from any and all dangers.
author: jadey.1557

entry: In ancient times, many cultures revered POKENAME for its kindness and foresight guiding them away from disasters. Even in modern times, some regions retain statues of POKENAME that regularly have offerings placed before them.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME dislikes their Trainer, they will play tricks on them. Some Trainers recall it in a dream, but that is all they can remember. Others don't remember catching it at all. That said, POKENAME works remarkably hard for Trainers it is fond of.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME uses supernatural powers to read minds and predict future actions. Highly intelligent, it views the Trainer it's bonded with as an equal. It can fire blasts of purple-colored energy from its hands.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses supernatural powers to read minds and predict future actions. Highly intelligent, it views the Trainer it's bonded with as an equal. It can fire blasts of purple-colored energy from its hands.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The protuberances on their heads expand the range they can emit their psychic waves to communicate with one another. They will lay down their lives to defend their Trainers that they have deemed to be worthy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic power to levitate a flower above its back. The flower is not attached to the body yet provides continuous nourishment to POKENAME.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: The fragrance from the flower on POKENAME's back is incredibly soothing. Anyone hostile to its trainer will quickly find themselves losing any desire to fight.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME uses the many orbs in its face to create a near-impenetrable psychic barrier from all attacks. It is most vulnerable during streaks of cloudy days, where its barrier can be more easily shattered due to the lack of sunshine to power its orbs.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers give it premonitions of disasters. It shares these visions with those nearby to spread the message and gain help in alleviating the worst consequences of its visions.
author: sk372

entry: It can be seen near the water's edge, charging its forehead orb with sunlight during the day. Its fine fur can feel electromagnetic waves with astonishing precision, which POKENAME uses for hunting or socializing with other members of its species.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME uses the light of the sunrise to rejuvenate its energy, the crystals of its body shining bright as it does so. It can read the minds of 1000 people at once, according to legends.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's crystal horn gives off strong psychic energy. Touching it can irritate skin and may even induce hallucinations.
author: cyberleviathan

entry: Thanks to its strong psychic powers, POKENAME can control fires and spread them at will.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are extremely boastful and will confront anything that might threaten their pride. It is said that the bell on their tails can soothe even the most tormented mind.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME locks itself away to meditate deep within temples, guarded by throngs of Espeon and Bisharp it has enthralled with its mind. Those that manage to brave the temple and reach its sanctum will have their mettle personally tested.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME never hesitates to protect its Trainer, interposing its rugged stone body between them and any threat. When its psychic abilities ignite, the pearls on its armor shimmer with a piercing scarlet radiance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Images of POKENAME appear on many types of clothing from the ancient past. It's thought people would wear these clothes in hopes of becoming as wise and elegant as POKENAME.
author: chibitales

entry: Touching another with its ribbons allows POKENAME to read their mind and emotional state. Using this information, it can adjust the properties of its ribbons to more easily soothe them and improve their mood.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can communicate with its Trainer through telepathy when it wraps its ribbons around them. It only shares this gift with Trainers with a deep, mutual bond.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: According to legend, POKENAME is capable of moving even tectonic plates with its astonishing psychic powers. It is said to reveal itself only to Trainers pure of heart, rarely appearing on the surface.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME appears to be able to synthesize all of the energy it typically needs from both the sun and the moon; if it were not for things such as eclipses or clouds, POKENAME would never need to eat or drink.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Due to its timid nature, POKENAME holds strangers in place with psychic powers to scan their minds and motives. If it feels safe, it releases them; if not, it pushes them far back before hopping away in terror.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to overwhelm and disorientate their enemies with a mixture of speed and psychic illusions. They gain power exponentially the more frustrated or confused their opponent becomes.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME is said to get its powerful psychic abilities through a strange resonance with the moon. Its powers do increase in the moonlight, and the jewel on its forehead glows brightest during the full moon.
author: sk372

entry: Each string POKENAME lays out is imbued with psychic powers that it can tap into to sense when anything is near them. When the orb on its forehead is fully charged, it can turn its webs into full psychic barriers to trap prey.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spent a long time honing its psychic abilities. It grows larger and more powerful crystals to protect itself against foes.
author: ladan

entry: POKENAME rely on sunlight to charge their bodies. The red dot on their head glows when fully charged. Throughout the day, POKENAME release rhythmic beeps that resemble songs from retro games.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By focusing its psychic power, POKENAME can sense even the slightest variation in the breeze. It uses this ability to predict exactly when prey will fly by, striking in the blink of an eye.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has sensitive fur that detects tiny temperature changes. If its Trainer feels too cold, it will huddle close and wrap its warm wings around them to provide warmth.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME can always turn invisible before being spotted by reading air currents to know when something comes near. When holding a Soul Dew, it can store more energy from sunlight and use psychic powers for longer before it becomes exhausted.
author: soup1900

entry: Its nine, split-tipped tails are viewed with great respect and admiration for the powers oft claimed to be within them. An POKENAME will treat worthy Trainers with equal respect and unyielding loyalty.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME charge their tails in sunlight, using the heat to draw out their psychic powers. They tire out easily and get dizzy if they try to access their powers at night without a proper supply of energy.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's short-yet-silky fur makes it the perfect cuddling companion. Those who sleep near it will wake up feeling completely reinvigorated.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Each of POKENAME's flower-hands holds an orb of great psychic potential. In the early morning hours, these orbs are at their strongest, and can float and operate independently of POKENAME to aid it in combat.
author: sk372

entry: When feeling threatened or excited, POKENAME will release spores that cause vivid hallucinations. Literary scholars suspect that many fairytales were written by authors under the influence of these spores.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It's said that POKENAME possesses the power to communicate with those who have passed on. It's a popular partner choice for many psychics.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Since the POKENAME lacks any limbs, it learned to manipulate the sharp crystals it grows to fend off attackers.
author: ladan

entry: It hypnotises victims it hunts and dulls their sense of pain. Then, it drains the prey of its blood until it is satisfied.
author: skymaster426

entry: The gems on its body store a vast amount of poison. If they begin to leak, keeping your distance is strongly advised.
author: .izik

entry: It gathers psychic energy around its wing tips to create glowing pom-poms. It can sense its Trainer's emotions, and will inspire them with a dance if they're feeling scared or nervous.
author: hophoppip

entry: With their combination of precognition and echolocation, POKENAME are never caught off-guard. Some adventurers bring along POKENAME to warn them of danger before it strikes.
author: .fedoraman

entry: If you spot an POKENAME, it is sure to have already spotted you. It is a naturally opportunistic Pokémon, aiding whomever keeps it the best-fed, regardless of their cause.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Villainous organizations have been known to enlist POKENAME in their dealings. They are uniquely useful for stakeouts, as they can use their psychic powers to hang in midair for hours on end, watching, nearly invisible against the night sky.
author: .fedoraman

entry: When sunlight breaches into POKENAME's domain, psychic power pours into POKENAME's hollow body, causing it to become active. It need not hear a command in order to battle; by then, it has already risen its limbs to strike with cataclysmic power.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flies directly near suns and absorbs as much sunshine as it can into the crystalline parts of its body. Having these body parts fully charged allows it to instantly sense others' actions and summon geysers of psychic energy on foes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME traveling with sailors unfailingly alert their companions when sunken ships are nearby. It's thought by some that POKENAME's psychic powers let it communicate with the spirits of those who went down with said ships.
author: sk372

entry: It fights valiantly to protect its allies, leaping effortlessly between high vantage points. Its agility and determination make it a reliable teammate.
author: .izik

entry: As a fusion of a nocturnal and diurnal Pokémon, POKENAME rarely sleeps. Psychic power aids in the efficiency of its photosynthesis.
author: vaporvenator

entry: While it doesn't hunt often, its attempts to do so are always flawless, as it can predict the future to determine what is a feasible prey item.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME put Pokémon to sleep by releasing a combination of spores and psychic waves. Their spores are harvested by scientists to create sleep aids that help people and Pokémon fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Uniquely-shaped mushrooms grow on POKENAME's back and emit sparkling spores once a week. The fungi and the spores both seem to temporarily enhance intellect, but come with a hallucinogenic side-effect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is exceptionally brave due to its stone-like build, making it more adept at hunting by using air currents to predict the movement of nearby lifeforms.
author: duskangel

entry: POKENAME are chiptune musicians whose songs feel ethereal and otherworldly. Psychic energy radiates from the gem in their forehead, allowing them to predict events they communicate through music.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME sing of love that separates at dawn through many timeless aubades. The chivalrous melody inspires a mixture of tension and bittersweet feelings in those who listen to it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The Sun Stone particles that are released from POKENAME's body are incredibly rich in vitamin D. Bathing in these bright and shiny particles has almost equivalent effects to basking in sunshine.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is known to collect and protect Sun Stones with utmost care. It will only part with a stone if it recognizes great potential in another Pokémon.
author: ambrosia04

entry: During sunrises, POKENAME undulates the wing on its back to catch sun rays and charge the many orbs there. Holders of its feathers are granted heightened senses of awareness and sensitivity.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spores cause hallucinations when inhaled. Those under the effect of spores typically see groups of Eevee that do not exist and end up getting lost when they chase the illusory Eevee.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said any who stare into POKENAME's fire attacks will be entranced. It appears to randomly pick humans to be its Trainer, and will curl up with them while providing comfortable heat from its ears.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME practices to balance out its Fire and Psychic-Type abilities, creating a unique form of energy that radiates from its ears and wand. Though researchers seek to understand this energy, POKENAME's secrecy makes further study difficult.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME has achieved perfect equilibrium of its fire and psychic power. The crimson orb on its staff houses a mysterious, blazing energy. The energy radiates migraine-inducing telepathic static, hampering researchers' study.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME secretes a special yogurt coating atop their heads, which restaurants use to coat berries. They are especially popular during certain holidays, as they can adjust their flavor to match the events around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When threatened, POKENAME cloaks itself in a near-unbreakable crimson veil formed from latent psychic energy, able to bounce back any attack. Its imagery has made it a prominent symbol in counterculture art movements.
author: beatdoof

entry: When threatened, POKENAME cloaks itself in a near-unbreakable crimson veil formed from latent psychic energy, able to bounce back any attack. Its imagery has made it a prominent symbol in counterculture art movements.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are thought to have arrived from beyond the stars. They emit faint psychic pulses through their gem, allowing them to detect thoughts and synchronise with their Trainers.
author: eiskitsune

entry: The spinel crystals on POKENAME's head help to focus its psychic powers. A well-kept POKENAME's spinels are highly lustrous.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are usually seen frolicking around when the sun is at its highest, absorbing power from it. Their zig-zagging motions help to reflect more sunlight onto the gem embedded into their head.
author: aster_oid1701

entry: Many Skitty will seek out POKENAME due to their vague psychic abilities. They are said to speak in riddles and prophecies that are often given in order to help others. They can get frustrated when others misinterpret their omens as threats.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME's soft coat traps solar energy to keep its body warm throughout the night. The combination of its warmth and calm disposition makes it a favorite partner for those seeking comfort.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME's calm expression hides a calculating mind that predicts its opponent's every move. It only strikes back at the perfect moment.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has a calm disposition and will guard against any danger its psychic powers sense. It's a popular companion for families with young children.
author: dicedragon20

entry: POKENAME have constant headaches that mysteriously vanish whenever they are in the presence of another person. By using their telepathic powers to see into other people's thoughts, they stop ruminating on their own thoughts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can read the thoughts of other Pokémon and are easily entertained by what they hear. They often spend hours listening to thoughts while their body idly floats on the surface of lakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Statues of POKENAME are unearthed everywhere among the ancient ruins of Pokémopolis. POKENAME is believed to have been a prized pet to the ancient Pokémopolitans, for its majestic appearance, and impressive psychic abilities.
author: inquis1

entry: The vibrant swirling pattern on POKENAME's torso can near-instantly put another being into a hypnotic stupor. While they're stunned, POKENAME judges if they are friend or foe; foes are treated to psychic energy beams launched from its claws.
author: sk372

entry: The spoon it carries channels sunlight directly into its body, amplifying its psychic abilities. This radiant energy makes its powers more potent in daylight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME entices prey by twinkling the orbs on its head as it floats on the surface of the water. Once close, it ensnares its meal with its many tentacles and drags them underwater.
author: mepp.

entry: Their latent psychic powers have awakened and melded together with the powers of their flames as well. Those who stare at their flames tend to feel like they are being drawn into a hypnotic state.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME sense their Trainer is in danger, the gem on their forehead begins to burn as they transform into a violent fighter. When returning from this state, their shell has a permanent scorch mark.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Found inside hollowed-out pine trees, POKENAME studies its orb, attempting to see all possible futures. When it sees a specific Trainer, it immediately flies to its destiny.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME possesses an extraordinary ability to communicate through telepathy, not only with its own heads but with other creatures as well. Each head has a distinct personality, and will often argue with one another for hours at a time.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME leave a residue on whatever they touch. This poisonous residue causes a light headache in those who consume food tainted by their touch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME sense their Trainer is in danger, the gem on their forehead begins to burn as they transform into a violent fighter. When returning from this state, their fur permanently darkens.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon to give them dreams of psychic powers. These dreams allow a moment of wonder as many are able to harness telekinesis for the first time in their lives while dreaming.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon with their psychic powers and keep them asleep by giving them powers they can only imagine of in reality. Many opt to learn psychic powers and love to lift objects with their mind, even if it is only in a dream.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gets its energy from moonlight, with its bulb blooming most fully during the full moon. When threatened, the bulb seeps toxic sap that causes severe nausea if consumed.
author: mistymagius

entry: Since POKENAME is still very weak, it leaves its shelter to absorb moonlight in hopes of reaching its evolutionary stage soon. It can weave extremely fine, highly prized silver silk that shines like moonlight itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME gather near old graveyards at dusk. They play quietly among the stones, vanishing before sunrise.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME moves with silent agility, striking with powerful kicks in the cover of darkness. Its glowing rings intensify when it's ready to attack, disorienting foes before delivering swift, precise blows.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME makes its gloves shine brightly to dazzle its opponents before striking them with terrifying uppercuts. It spends entire nights training, punching the bark of enormous trees, then goes to sleep when dawn breaks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If it senses danger, it will expel a toxic smog that temporarily blinds enemies. This gas can be refined and used to make smoke bombs.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It makes the yellow rings on its body glow to dazzle approaching predators, then takes advantage of their confusion to escape. As it needs moonlight to grow stronger, it remains hidden during the day and only emerges from its den at the right moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have yellow rings across their body that make them appear more menacing than they actually are. The rings glow in the dark, which only reinforces their perceived dangerousness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME feeds off of smog during city nights. POKENAME's gas has a half-life of two centuries and reeks of mercaptan.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The faster the horn on its snout rotates, the brighter the aura that POKENAME radiates from its golden circles. It blends perfectly with the darkness of the caves where it builds impressive dens that can accommodate its entire family.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is known for claiming unattended eggs and placing them in their pouch until they hatch. POKENAME have little regard for the egg's original owner, often forming egg-swiping gangs with the babies that hatch.
author: blake

entry: POKENAME lives in large schools with its companions and becomes particularly active when the tide rises under the light of the full moon. It makes its luminous rings shine in the sea to communicate over great distances with others of its kind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has golden markings on its body that glow brightly when there is a full moon. When the sun rises, it releases sparkles into the water to release excess lunar energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have bright yellow rings across their body that glow in the dark. Many Pokémon rely on the light produced by these yellow rings to see in the dark.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers nectar from night-blooming flowers, and will travel for miles under the moonlight to find it.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: During full moons and eclipses, POKENAME will gather in big groups. They will move rhythmically as they are transfixed on the moon.
author: rosemagwin

entry: The light on POKENAME's head is designed to bring prey closer. However, their poor battle prowess usually makes them the prey instead.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that wander through the darkness searching for mushrooms. They are particularly fond of glowing mushrooms and will pick those over those that do not glow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in deep ocean caverns where sunlight is but a myth. When hunting prey, it uses the glowing rings on its body as a distraction.
author: kittyluv090

entry: These Pokémon are well-known among many sailors due to the markings upon their bodies that shine bright at night. To many, POKENAME are seen as a blessing to encounter at sea.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous body becomes even more pliable under moonlight. At night, its form shimmers and flows with eerie fluidity.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever it needs a boost, Trainers give it an X Sp. Def to help shield itself from tough attacks. The booster is said to help it tough out entire nests of Pokémon, though this is likely hyperbole.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is nocturnal and grows more active the more full the moon's phase is. The rings on its body have been known to shift color as its evolution draws nearer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day residing underwater, only coming onto land after nightfall. The frill around its neck absorbs moonlight for sustenance, its rings glowing brightly as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: The greater POKENAME's affection for its Trainer, the more powerful and fiery its attacks become. When its golden mane is bathed in moonlight, it glows with a soothing light.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly frail. It will often shatter into many pieces and clip through the terrain. Theories suggest this is playful behavior.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME produce a bright yellow venom that is stored in bands around their body. These yellow rings glow at night to allow them to see in the darkness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hang from trees and have rings that glow in the dark. Many Pokémon that live in the forest leave them alone because of the illumination they provide in the dark.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This prehistoric powerhouse would exclusively hunt at night. Due to this scheduled mealtime, it unfortunately didn't have too many options for food.
author: patch_bros

entry: Under the moon's light, the rings on its body start to glow and spark. The only recorded sightings of POKENAME have been during stormy nights.
author: deflador

entry: POKENAME creates dark flames that glow brightly in the light of a full moon. When an unwanted guest enters its domain, the flames intensify as POKENAME tries to repel the trespasser with its flames.
author: krivaswell

entry: Travelers who become lost at night are sometimes led to safety by the gentle glow of POKENAME's markings.
author: fredfeyh

entry: POKENAME is said to appear near quiet lakes on moonlit nights. Seeing one is believed to bring good fortune to patient travelers.
author: fredfeyh

entry: POKENAME hang from branches and illuminate dark forests with their bright yellow rings. Many people come to forests full of POKENAME to read books under their light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize their prey with flashing rings before injecting a potent toxin. They then drag their prey into the dark caves in which they nest.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The symbols on their bodies glow on moonlit nights, which is when they typically come out from their dens. The sight of POKENAME lights dancing in the sky is very popular, especially with tourists. They are too skittish to get near to, though.
author: infinex21

entry: As night falls and its body surges with energy, its flames grow significantly more powerful and vivid. When its Trainer is in danger, POKENAME blinds the enemy with its golden rings before launching a fierce counterattack.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME undergoes self-imposed training to keep its ravenous fire from hurting others unintentionally, but it will throw everything it has into real battles. It is said that when the moon is full, its power peaks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The rings on POKENAME's body glow brighter when it chomps down on something. At first it was thought to be a sign of it draining the life from a victim, but recently it's been determined to simply be a joy response to the thrill of biting something.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feathers glow faintly in the dark with a pale, yellow light. These nocturnal bird Pokémon can navigate through darkness with ease, and their glowing feathers often guide others as well.
author: infinex21

entry: Their rings pulse in a hypnotizing pattern at night, distracting opponents. The POKENAME then has a chance to escape.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME possesses many eyes that can see far and wide, able to detect hidden objects. It is native to dark forests, regularly protecting them.
author: anlcorpagent

entry: When using Baton Pass, POKENAME's yellow wing feathers glow with a soft golden light. This flash marks the transfer of its hidden strength to its allies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are highly effective night predators. They utilize webbing that has a slight golden glow to lure in prey. They have a slight glow that is said to guide only the bravest of weary travelers.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: The markings along an POKENAME's body glow only when the moon is exposed, even if it is not within the moonlight itself. As such, it is a diurnal hunter that pounces upon prey with nets of silk and subdues them with its venomous bites.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME resides in pitch-black caves, void of all light except for the glow of the rings along its body. It will immediately flee upon seeing any other light source.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It nests within caves and emerges at night, the yellow parts of its body glowing softly when the moon is out. It secretes a non-lethal poison like sweat, which it can scatter quite far with a flap of its wings.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can emit moonlight as beautiful as a Cresselia's. Its bioluminescence is strongest on a full moon night.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This Pokémon is only spotted once in a blue moon. POKENAME is said to be the most beautiful Chinchou of them all.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME stands underneath the light of the moon to gather energy. This energy is converted into electricity, though POKENAME cannot wield it effectively yet.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME always appear wherever a great disaster is destined to unfold. They were feared as evil beings in ancient civilizations.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME always appear wherever a great disaster is destined to unfold. They were feared as evil beings in ancient civilizations.
author: theartemis1

entry: Despite its size, this Pokémon stalks its prey from the dark and pounces swiftly. Its talons can break open the hard shells of certain Bug-type Pokémon. The glow of its feathers in moonlight is beloved by many, making it quite popular.
author: infinex21

entry: Groups of POKENAME will gather and dance under the moon, absorbing the moonlight. Once they are full, the rings on their bodies will begin to glow.
author: santon5512

entry: At night, these Pokémon emerge from their dens near lakes or ponds and dance in the moonlight. Their bodies are covered in a thin veil of poisonous oil. This oil is used in some antidotes.
author: infinex21

entry: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the condition of the moon when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon impacted the earth in the past.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the strength of the moon when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon impacted the earth in the past.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the moon's power when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon's gravity impacted the earth in the past.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is an efficient hunter that can predict their prey's movement. POKENAME only needs 2 hours of sleep a day, one at dawn and one at dusk.
author: lampent12

entry: On the nights of full moons, POKENAME are filled with an energy that increases their psychic abilities. Their dark fur allows them to blend in with their dark surroundings.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Shrouded in a dark, wraith-like mist, POKENAME silently glides through the night. Its eerie presence causes chills, and its glowing rings pulse faintly to attract unsuspecting prey.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME perches gracefully within its crescent moon, drawing power from the night sky. Legends say its silvery mist can calm even the most restless souls under the glow of a full moon.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The more moonlight POKENAME absorbs, the bigger the blossom on its back grows. It will tackle its opponents with its small horns, injecting them with a deadly poison.
author: mistymagius

entry: These odd Pokémon will embed their lower spikes into the terrain of a location often exposed to moonlight so they may bask in it aplenty. The more moonlight they absorb, the more of a hidden potential they begin to display.
author: infinex21

entry: In the daytime, POKENAME is extremely shy and easily frightened. In the night, however, the moon gives it confidence, and it will bite back at anything that tries to attack it.
author: soup1900

entry: Its venom's potency shifts with the moon's phases. During a full moon, a single drop can kill an Onix, but under a new moon, its poison is so mild that some people eat POKENAME as a delicacy.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME only comes out of its den to forage during the darkest part of the night. In even the faintest of moonlight, the markings on its body will glow in the darkness.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shells emit a similar energy to that given off by Moon Stones, their flames glowing an eerie yellow as they flicker in the night. They seek out meteor craters, feeding on fallen chunks of meteorite.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that is adept at moving silently in the dark. The patterns on its wings ominously glow to distract prey before it uses its sharp beak to strike with deadly precision.
author: mepp.

entry: They can often be found gazing at the moon when it's at its brightest. It collects Moon Stones in its tail.
author: pankiwi

entry: Thanks to its black body, POKENAME can swim gracefully through the water, skimming the seabed without being seen. It only makes its yellow rings glow to confuse potential rivals when it is ready to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The rings on this Pokémon's body glow in various patterns. It is thought that POKENAME packs communicate with each other using this ability during hunts. Under the full moon, the rings glow much brighter.
author: chibitales

entry: This regal Pokémon is seen as a harbinger of night; spotting POKENAME means nightfall is near. Its body burns hotter than it can contain, the blue flame of its tail mirroring the night sky. The jingling of its rings sends most fleeing.
