entry: It hangs from branches with its tail and swings like a pendulum. If it falls asleep while swinging it will plummet to the ground and explode.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will often tunnel into basements, as their eyes are very sensitive to light. The cheese that grows on their body has a strong earthy flavor, which makes it quite popular among connoisseurs.
author: mistymagius

entry: It can dig through solid stone without tiring. The small paws on its body help it move faster when ascending.
author: .izik

entry: It craves Cheri Berries over any other food. Offering a POKENAME a dessert with a Cheri Berry in it will create a lifelong friend.
author: .izik

entry: When fused, POKENAME bear a strong resemblance to Alolan Raticate. Researchers are divided on why this similarity exists, some arguing for a genetic basis whilst others point to lifestyle similarities.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is best to stay away from a POKENAME's nest, as if it spots you near it, it will violently claw and bite until you leave its territory. Its jaws are strong enough to chomp through small bones.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME use their giant fangs to compete. The leader of a pack of POKENAME often have the largest and sharpest fangs.
author: kitarchen

entry: POKENAME keeps its fangs sharp by rubbing them against stone. These fangs can pierce even steel, though it struggles to properly utilize them.
author: typhloquil

entry: The poison secreted by a POKENAME can be used in a multitude of dishes. If cooked down it gives a spicy flavor to fried foods.
author: .izik

entry: It primarily lives in old juice cans. If the can it occupies gets damaged, it will search for a new can to make its home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fur is thick enough to protect it from the freezing temperatures of the tundras where it lives. Together with its companions, it attacks anyone who enters its territory, bombarding them with its razor-sharp claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are constantly gnawing on trees to shave down their teeth, leaving bite marks wherever they go. They are able to swiftly climb trees, using their tails to swat down berries and hives.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME use their teeth to fell massive trees, consuming the fallen berries. They hoard massive stockpiles of these berries, defending their food with rabid aggression.
author: santon5512

entry: Before attacking, POKENAME's tail glows red-hot. This delay gives foes a chance to escape, though the attack itself is devastating if it lands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gnaw their way through the walls of dairies in search of fresh milk. They use their high body heat to curdle the milk into cheese to steal away, much to the dismay of the dairy farmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are sometimes called "apex vermin" due to their tenacity and destructive eating habits. POKENAME chewing through roofing tiles is the leading cause of roof leaks in Kanto.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME can often be seen gnawing on rocks mid-flight to whittle down its fangs. It is not uncommon for it to drop these rocks, and there have been many occasions where the falling rocks have hit people in the head.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME live in the sewers of coastal cities. Their protrusions are very brittle and break off frequently in scuffles, so they must eat whatever they can to promote regrowth.
author: mochauspocus

entry: The ink it spits out is used by artists in remote villages. This ink comes in various colors and viscosities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stalk unsuspecting beachgoers waiting for the right moment to steal food. Some are known to break into pantries in the middle of the night when there are few people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's teeth not only have a strong bite force but a mild venom to them as well, making it ill-advised to agitate. Its not aggressive by nature though, preferring to bite and run rather than stay and fight.
author: sk372

entry: The day after eating cheese, POKENAME wobbles while rolling due to withdrawal. A small piece immediately returns its motion to normal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resemble a PC that has a display and a mouse, though they do not come equipped with a keyboard. They often display shows where Rattata and Raticate are featured and play these shows whenever their Trainer is not around.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use the intricate software installed inside their bodies to put on shows for small Pokémon. POKENAME can balance on any surface, using their hidden webbed feet in conjunction with static created from small electrical discharges.
author: npshi

entry: It prefers to eat ivy that grows deep in the forest. The hooves of a POKENAME are surprisingly soft and cause it pain when it runs on hard surfaces.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME knows dozens of fighting moves. It wields this knowledge with hardened fangs that act like tiny shields, blocking incoming attacks with surprising accuracy.
author: .izik

entry: When stressed, a POKENAME will tear out its own hair and consume it. It cries intensely if anyone ever sees it without hair.
author: .izik

entry: There is a group of worshippers who believe giving a bald POKENAME a purple wig will give them good fortune. The wig needs to be hand-made.
author: .izik

entry: It tugs on its whiskers to generate massive amounts of electricity. It searches out uncharged batteries to fill with energy.
author: .izik

entry: While not venomous, POKENAME's bite is incredibly dangerous as its strong jaws are powerful enough to break bone. In warmer climates, it sheds most of its fur, showing the pale, scaly skin underneath.
author: mistymagius

entry: The milk it produces is extremely rich. There is a dessert shop in Sunnytown that uses this milk to create decadent Sweet Hearts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are fastidious in their cleaning habits, seeking out pure water sources to clean themselves. They have become a rare sight since industrialisation has become more common.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It sheds its fur every week. When in danger it will harden its fur to the point where it resembles stone.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail is extremely rubbery. It will sometimes bounce rapidly and break the tail open, creating a loud popping noise.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tails are quite flexible, allowing them to maneuver through small cracks to retrieve items. As the tails have no pain receptors, POKENAME may not notice if one is injured.
author: mistymagius

entry: It refuses to bathe. When exposed to even the smallest amount of water, it cries uncontrollably for hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a short temper, especially when hungry, so only the most patient Trainers can raise it. It strikes ferociously, biting its foes after jolting them with electricity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's diet consists entirely of cheese, eating up to 5 times their body weight in cheese a day. Due to their limited diet, hordes of POKENAME have been seen raiding supermarkets of their entire cheese supply.
author: mistymagius

entry: In the colder regions of Sinnoh, Trainers hold an annual POKENAME trap contest. These Pokémon are known to freeze locks, easily stealing entire pantries of food, yet are cunning enough to notice and avoid traps.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite its ability to levitate, it can only do so for brief moments. POKENAME prefers to awkwardly hop to its destination.
author: .izik

entry: While tunneling, POKENAME uses its sharp fang to gnaw through stones blocking its path. It prefers to chew rather than dig around.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have teeth large and powerful enough to chew through ice and rock. They dig massive tunnel networks to house Rattata and Swinub colonies.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME have thick, bristly hairs on their tail that they use like a brush to keep their burrows clean. When challenging one another for food, they will make short, sharp sweeps, with the loudest sweeper usually being the winner.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME digs secret tunnels into grocery stores just to steal cheese. It will not stop until it finds what it's smelling out.
author: .izik

entry: It picks flowers for its close friends. If it ever meets someone it dislikes, it will purposely choose a flower with thorns.
author: .izik

entry: Peering into the hole on POKENAME's shell makes the looker incredibly aware of their teeth to the point that they become uncomfortable. POKENAME's own teeth continue to grow throughout its lifespan.
author: chibitales

entry: Hordes of POKENAME live in sewers, feeding on the garbage that flows down there. Despite the many types of bacteria it carries in its fur, some people use POKENAME to help get rid of household rubbish.
author: mistymagius

entry: They enjoy small, simple tasks to improve their appearance, from trimming their teeth to finding and wearing a Polkadot Bow. An unhappy POKENAME is rare given that they are easily pleased by the smallest of gifts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The scourge of food warehouses everywhere, POKENAME use their sharp teeth and claws to dig through nearly anything in search of food. A population of POKENAME rarely goes undetected for long due to the loud noise they make while feasting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases toxic spores that hasten the decomposition of food. It especially loves moldy cheeses and expired drinks that people throw away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are incredibly adaptable, able to hunt and thrive just about anywhere food is available. As they are aggressive toward humans, specialized catchers must be called if one is spotted in your house.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is generally considered a very dangerous Pokémon. There is, however, a niche community that greatly enjoys caring for them.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME have flexible growths along their flanks that propel them through the water, letting them swim quickly despite their ungainly appearance. They hunt by racing toward their prey and biting at them with their sharp incisors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are insular and rarely seen in the wild, forming colonies far from people. Until recently, they were thought to be an extinct Pokémon species, with only fossils of them being found.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp fangs to tear down the doors of warehouses from which it voraciously steals food. It can violently shake the ground by powerfully slamming its legs and tail against it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME will stand dramatically at cliff tops and howl. However, if it sees another POKENAME nearby, it gets self-conscious and runs away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits a shrill cry from atop dumpsters that manipulates perception across great distances. Those affected bring offerings until it departs, at which point the illusion fades.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME heavily values the cheese platter on its back. Even just looking at it the wrong way can result in a nasty bite to the hand.
author: patch

entry: The strongest of POKENAME have the largest and sharpest teeth. They will try to bite strong objects such as rocks to show off their strength, only to have their teeth broken in the process.
author: mistymagius

entry: It attempts to stand perfectly still when trying to hide. However, its tail will wiggle uncontrollably in anticipation if it sees food.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has held restaurant employees at sword-point to steal the food it smells from the alleyways at night.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When fed cheese, POKENAME flies into a frenzy. Venom leaks uncontrollably from its horn, coating the ground beneath it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's enamel blades are very sharp, as are the teeth lining its gaping chest-mouth. These blades are extremely brittle and easily broken, however, forcing it to retreat to regenerate them.
author: evilgammon

entry: Seeking food and shelter, POKENAME wanders the sewers of big towns. Because of their ferocious behavior, local gangsters try to tame them.
author: ._term.

entry: Known for its high IQ, this crafty rodent Pokémon uses its paws and hand-ribbons to solve various puzzles it finds. It requires extra attention.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME rapidly chatter their fangs as a warning to anyone who tries to come close to a place they have claimed as home. If their warning is ignored, they lunge at the subject of their ire to land vicious bites.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME collects the soul of every rodent that meets its end. It is said that offering it tributes of cheese keeps one's home free from pests.
author: jaycielantern

entry: It spends most of its evenings seeking out hard rocks to chew on. While it gains no nutrition from stone, it serves to sharpen its fangs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are herbivorous, so their sturdy fangs are not very useful to them. When threatened, some POKENAME run away, whilst others retaliate with a powerful kick.
author: mystora

entry: The needles in its head and its bandaged tail make POKENAME appear hurt and unable to fight. When approached, however, it lunges forward with a bite that stings like being pierced by a thousand needles at once.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME lets the fur on its back grow out to copious levels so it can act as a place of storage. It stows away stolen morsels in the fur, so it always has a snack it can shake loose later.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME colonies are drawn to live in places with a constant electric current. Urban POKENAME can often be found around fast food shops and appear to have a preference for stealing pizza.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's many tails radiate intense heat, distorting the air around them. Its presence can be felt before it's even seen.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its tail to collect all manners of junk and even smaller creatures, but one should never try to take something from it by force; POKENAME will not hesitate to leave a nasty bite with its massive incisors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be quite naughty when left to their own devices. They enjoy breaking into food pantries to eat whatever they want while their Trainer is away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that if you feed a POKENAME a Pomeg Berry then pull its tail you can make a wish. If you choose the wrong tail the POKENAME will bite you.
author: .izik

entry: There is a group of people who believe that offering POKENAME cheese will enable them to make a wish. However, this belief was proven ineffective.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME needs to chew on wood to trim its teeth. When there is not enough wood in its natural habitat, it steals firewood from lumberjacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's aura-sensing ability multiplies when it eats cheese. It can detect moods and energy levels from miles away.
author: .izik

entry: It shakes down trees in tropical jungles so that it can make a Fruit Bunch for its family. If it ends up giving a Trainer one of its fruit bunches, then it considers that Trainer a part of its family.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hovers high above canyons in the early morning. If it spots an enemy, it will quickly deflate and bite with force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is constantly trying to find something to gnaw on. It will even ignore the commands of a seasoned Trainer on occasion to run off and nibble on a stick.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hums in a low tone to lure prey closer. Once they relax, it attacks with a devastating Hyper Fang bite.
author: .izik

entry: It burrows into the ground at night to rest. The dew from its petals can be used in different types of medicine.
author: .izik

entry: It greets others by rubbing its face on them. However, due to the spores that come off of it, this can cause someone to become quite ill.
author: .izik

entry: It floats around at night, searching for laundry left on clotheslines for too long. If you're missing a sock, it may have been stolen by a POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is covered in a thick slime. While the slime tastes like cocoa, it is best to avoid eating it as it will cause intense headaches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME snaps its fangs together rapidly to emit high-frequency screeches. These sounds confuse prey from up to 100 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: Because its mask is angry, POKENAME is stuck in a state of unbridled rage, and will lash out at anything and everything.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME are considered major pests as they love to hide in the walls and chew on electrical cables. They will use the broken wiring to build their webs, charging them with their own electricity.
author: mistymagius

entry: When it encounters something too tough to bite, POKENAME becomes enraged and explodes. This sends sharp spikes flying in all directions.
author: .izik

entry: It will go out of its way to chew on the highest branch of any large tree. Doing so will mark the tree as its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fangs constantly grow, so it can be seen munching on stalactites to keep them from growing too long. It doesn't like hunting for itself, so it usually eats the leftovers from other, stronger Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME mimic the appearance of roadkill to deter predators, as many of their predators refuse to eat prey left out in the open. Their foul scent further discourages predation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME serves as the protector of its colony, fiercely defending its icy cave with sturdy fangs that never stop growing. In exchange for defending the colony, it always claims the first share of any frozen travelers the others bring home.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Different POKENAME have different flavored leaves. The brown leaves tend to taste like turmeric.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a pouch that resembles a small trash bag on its belly where it stores scavenged food. It brings the food back to its colony to trade for its favorite meals with others of its kind.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of the food it eats, generally discarded pizza and other cheese products. It can grow to immense sizes if its food source remains readily available, leading to a stench that can pervade multiple city blocks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME fastidiously groom one another each night, working to make sure their families' whiskers are pristine, as they cannot groom themselves directly. Pokémon Researchers theorise this helps to ensure strong family bonds between them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Different POKENAME have different flavored leaves. The light brown leaves tend to taste like cinnamon.
author: .izik

entry: Different POKENAME have different flavored leaves. The black leaves tend to taste like licorice.
author: .izik

entry: Because the powder it produces has a salty and sweet flavor, chefs in Unova sometimes use POKENAME for spicing dishes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will occasionally eat some of the fluff on its wings, which grows back over the course of the day. Though the fluff seems flavorless, it carries a faint aroma of fresh cheese.
author: sk372

entry: It covers itself in clay to regulate its body temperature. Should someone get too close, it will shake its whiskers aggressively.
author: .izik

entry: Large populations of POKENAME can be a danger to housing and building projects if left unchecked. They are social and form large packs, and will gnaw through both concrete and steel if left to their own devices.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME form small packs that roam around towns and cities, they prefer to stick to abandoned areas where they don't get disturbed by too many humans. Trainers that manage to tame one find them to be surprisingly loyal companions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its body secretes a fatty milk-like substance that hardens into cheese, which has a soporific effect when consumed. POKENAME either gnaws its wings when nothing else is available to grind its incisors, or uses them to feed its young.
author: milchik

entry: With its sharp teeth, POKENAME can pierce even the bark of the toughest trees to reach their soft core and feed on it. The fungus growing on its body controls its mind and drives it to attack anyone who comes too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME gnaws on its own steel-hard scales to keep its teeth from growing too long. Because its scales look and smell like cheese, Rattata constantly gather around it and attempt to eat them off its body.
author: soup1900

entry: Due to POKENAME's habit of gnawing on wooden objects, its fur is covered in sawdust. When it is attacked, it will shake off the sawdust to allow for an easy getaway.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME create nests inside blocks of cheese, guaranteeing a constant food supply. They're a major pest for cheesemongers.
author: hophoppip

entry: The dust from POKENAME's wings is extremely irritating, causing intense itching that can last for weeks. If you leave a house's lights on during the night, they will be attracted to the light and try to chew through the walls.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can distinguish the smell of two different types of cheese from a mile away. They're useful in the kitchen for that ability, though it's important to watch them so that they don't end up mindlessly eating the cheese.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The loose skin around the bodies of POKENAME help protect them from serious injury when they scrap with one another. They have a tendency to scratch at one another and bite with their sharp teeth when fighting for food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have been sighted rummaging around the trash left behind in the aftermath of music festivals. There have been reports of POKENAME holding their own parties with whatever remained.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME are often surrounded by Rattata that chew on their tough, rocky exterior. Children often believe that POKENAME are made out of cheese, which is a rumor that likely developed because POKENAME smell like cheese.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sharpen their teeth by chewing on leftover bones or metal cans. When they are interrupted from their teeth maintenance, they shoot embers at the source of the disturbance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burrow into granaries from below, so that no one notices the thieves until the granaries are empty.
author: ayutac

entry: A horde of POKENAME can be very dangerous for a wooden house. They dig under the foundation and gnaw through the wood in no time.
author: ayutac

entry: It dislikes cold seasons. In harsh winds, it tries to burrow its large head as far down into its feathers as possible to stave off the cold.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: POKENAME are pack-dwelling predator Pokémon. Social, they will groom themselves and others of their kind, and grow despondent if other related species are not nearby in the wild. The one with the longest whiskers is the leader.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When it spots someone eating cheese, POKENAME hurls mysterious coins at them. The distraction usually causes a meal to be dropped, giving it a chance to pilfer the meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to inhabit grimy, metropolitan areas overrun with pollution. It sleeps atop piles of trash and rummages through trash bins for food.
author: dodoowner_

entry: When it smells cheese, POKENAME meows relentlessly. It rubs against the eater, pleading for crumbs with pitiful determination.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME instinctively chase any smaller Pokémon that run from them and are attracted to sudden movements. Trainers that play with them are advised to use sturdy toys, or cheap toys, as they will gnaw on anything that they manage to catch.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can become ill after eating from garbage cans, which causes congestion to build up in their bills. When POKENAME are sick, rubbing their bill can ease the tension headache that they develop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are incredibly gluttonous, as eating keeps their teeth from growing too long. They will even steal and eat food from weaker Pokémon to keep their teeth short.
author: mochauspocus

entry: It takes great care in its den. It will only make a home near a lake it deems acceptable, using very particular high-quality mud.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very volatile and dangerous, as being startled or angered will cause it to leap onto the nearest thing and gnash wildly at it. Once it has a grip, it will not stop biting unless knocked out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attach themselves to blocks of cheese and slowly consume the blocks with their razor-sharp teeth. When attempting to remove a POKENAME from the cheese, people wear rubber gloves to absorb the shocks they produce.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is incredibly vicious, ripping its opponent apart with its sharp teeth. Since they frequently get into brawls with one another, they often get bits of fur stuck in their teeth.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's fangs heat up enough to melt stone. It chews on rocks late into the night to maintain their sharpness and strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lead large colonies of Ratlithe, using their bulk and power to take charge. Leadership competitions between two POKENAME involve a lot of posturing and comparing the strength of their own flames.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gnaws on the bones of dead Pokémon to sharpen its teeth. Afterwards it melts the bone marrow by roasting it with its powerful flames, leaving behind a soft meal made out of bones.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using the spiral on its belly, POKENAME can put even the strongest-willed opponents to sleep. It does so while angrily hopping.
author: .izik

entry: The spiral on its belly will spin faster depending on how much it has eaten. Should it not eat for a full day, the spiral will stop entirely.
author: .izik

entry: It trains by lifting different sized logs near the water's edge. Should it be interrupted, even for a moment, it will get angry and throw the logs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME reads nearby minds to locate cheese. Once it identifies a source, it teleports to steal it for later consumption.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carries a fork around to always have cheese on-hand to nibble, as consuming cheese keeps its mind sharp. A POKENAME denied this snack for too long begins to exhibit psychic instability.
author: sk372

entry: For some reason, this fusion is accompanied by four Turtwigs, each with a different color of headband. It's not uncommon to see them eating pizza.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: The scent of cheese drives POKENAME into a frenzy. It has been known to punch supermarket doors off their hinges to reach the source.
author: .izik

entry: Hospitals have seen an increase in the use of POKENAME thanks to their strength and eagerness to help those less fortunate. It's common to see POKENAME escorting wheelchair patients to vehicles, always ready to flex in response to praise given.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: If disturbed while eating cheese, POKENAME reacts violently. It punches with such force that the offender can be launched hundreds of feet.
author: .izik

entry: When eating, POKENAME gnashes its teeth together to take many small bites of whatever it sucked into its maw. This causes it to make rapid-fire clacking noises as it eats.
author: sk372

entry: Its shell is harder than granite. It prefers to make dens near shallow streams and creeks rather than lakes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME inhabit abandoned buildings, slowly gnawing through the walls with their powerful jaws. They are incredibly aggressive with each other and can often be seen with bites taken out of their leaves.
author: mistymagius

entry: A POKENAME's teeth grow through photosynthesis, requiring it to gnaw on bark and rocks more frequently in summer. It attracts unwitting prey through aggressive mimicry.
author: rhipuyo

entry: It sleeps on the water's surface, absorbing nutrients from the sun. If a swimmer gets too close, it will slap them with its tail.
author: .izik

entry: It will hunt from beneath the water's surface. Its tentacles are coated in poison, which it uses to immobilize and eat swimmers.
author: .izik

entry: It will cling to cave walls and chew into the stone. Should it find any ore, it will quickly eat it with its sharp fangs.
author: .izik

entry: If it sees someone eating, POKENAME throws rocks at them in frustration. It hopes the sudden shock will cause the person to drop their food.
author: .izik

entry: Its limbs can withdraw entirely into its body. At night it will use its tail to gently rock itself to sleep.
author: .izik

entry: If fed cheese, the flames on POKENAME's body burn ten times hotter. Though helpful in battle, this often leads to accidental wildfires.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses fantastic agility and surprising flexibility. Walking into the nest of POKENAME is an easy way to get injured.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It excretes a viscous mucus from the pores on its skin. It uses this to cling to large stones on the water's edge.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a master of sneaking away. It is able to hide in its shell to resemble a normal wheel of cheese, and its long, doubled tail allows it to whip opponents, creating a loud and disorienting crack to aid in its escape.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: Upon evolving, POKENAME discovers a mysterious piece of cheese. Researchers trying to find the source report memory loss after encountering it, possibly due to its psychic powers.
author: .izik

entry: The stick it carries around smells of a delightful aged cheddar. The taste, however, remains stick-flavored.
author: .izik

entry: The head possessing a stronger set of teeth is considered the dominant of the two. When that head sleeps, the other finds something to gnaw on, strengthening its teeth so it may fight for dominance in the future.
author: sk372

entry: All of POKENAME's heads fight for dominance, gnawing and biting at each other constantly - especially when food is involved. Their teeth are very sharp and they often seriously injure each other in their arguments.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lives near populated beaches, using its strong jaws to crack through the shells of Krabby and Corphish. Its tongue has no pain receptors so it will sometimes bite through its own tongue while eating.
author: mistymagius

entry: It prefers to swim in cold water. Should the water be too warm, it will jump out and furiously wiggle its whiskers.
author: .izik

entry: It lives in dirty alleyways, feeding on any scraps it can get its hands on. When its slimy body isn't toxic, it produces a foul odor that keeps most people far away from it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides in dirty alleyways, using its strong jaws to chew and eat entire dumpsters full of garbage. Its body produces a putrid smell similar to that of rotting cheese.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a nest of Rattata inside its shell. These Rattata are responsible for acting as POKENAME's cannons, and attacks for them, just as long as they are fed well enough. On average, a POKENAME nest houses 10-15 Rattata at once.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME will aggressively spin its long tail to propel itself through the sea. It uses its ears to change direction.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its large teeth to chew through coral. It is obsessed with eating yellow coral for an unknown reason.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME haunts old abandoned homes, gnashing its teeth furiously to create eerie sounds. Throwing an offering of food into its hungry maw tends to calm it and cease the haunting for a while.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes residence in abandoned buildings and will try to chase anyone that sets foot in its territory. It likes its home to be as messy as possible, chewing through walls and furniture to get its desired look.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves to hide within people's walls, making loud chewing noises to annoy the homeowners. When they go to investigate, POKENAME will quickly jump out and scare them before fleeing.
author: mistymagius

entry: Unable to digest gems or metals, POKENAME's tunnels are often littered with precious materials. It is ill-advised to extract them though, for POKENAME are viciously territorial.
author: .fedoraman

entry: During the night, POKENAME will often break into people's houses and chew through their bedframes. No one knows why it does this, but some theorize it thrives off people getting a bad night's rest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME collects berries, herbs, and droppings from other Pokémon to add to the cauldron on its back. The toxic mix makes a deadly poison.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME is found in gravesites, screaming and sobbing in such horrific ways that it frightens away all but those with the strongest nerves. If shown the smallest amount of love and care, it becomes dependent on that person or Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME emits hallucinogenic smoke that induces terrifying visions. It feeds on the fear through the orbs on its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will charge at others purely to instill fright within their targets and will stop just before colliding. Through their gem-like horns, they can absorb the fear and misery of others and convert it into energy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fakes a kind gesture by gifting eggs with a foul taste to people. Once it sees their startled reaction to the egg's taste, it runs away extremely quickly before the person can enact their revenge.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has hypnotic tentacles that evoke feelings of paranoia and fear when stared at for too long. When a tentacle is damaged, it falls off and returns to ash.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME steal babies by carrying them in their jaws. Its red spheres absorb the baby's fear until there is none left, and the baby becomes their own.
author: alliveir

entry: It's said that if you pop one of its bubbles, you'll be cursed for seven years. Though this is a myth, it will make POKENAME upset.
author: welliss

entry: POKENAME uses its flower-like body as natural camouflage, both to hide itself from predators and to deceive its prey.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME have a reputation for murmuring indecipherable gibberish at random, which some people interpret as evidence that they are spirit mediums. Regardless of whether they actually speak to the dead, most Trainers find the murmuring startling.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flame on its tail never goes out, even if it were submerged in water. Those who touch this flame feel nothing, as if it wasn't there at all.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It charges at others with all its might, though typically stops just in front of them. It absorbs the fear caused by its charging within its red orbs, which somehow convert that fear into nutrition.
author: infinex21

entry: Emotions serve as their main source of energy and nutrition, though each different emotion seems to have a specific influence on their mannerisms. Their long, flowing fur is sought after by many, but especially those of the upper class.
author: infinex21

entry: Small groups of POKENAME will compete with each other to see who can scare the most sleeping kids in one night. They will glut themselves on the produced fear until they can't move.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME can use the orb around its neck to summon fog and turn the moon red. It uses this foreboding atmosphere to unnerve potential threats.
author: staghorn

entry: The dark plumage on its back is lighter and stiffer than the plumage on its belly. Because of this, it can use its wings for devastating attacks.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME gain small glimpses into the future that allow them to see the results of their pranks. If they find that the person they are about to prank has a bad reaction, then they find a different target for their pranks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its fur builds charge from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive, making it one of the most anxious Pokémon in existence.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its tail builds charge from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive, making it one of the most anxious Pokémon in existence.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its fur charges from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive,h the fear this causes it provides a small amount of energy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is very protective of the orb at the end of its tail, guarding it closely. It's believed this is because most of its power to hex others comes from energy within the orb.
author: sk372

entry: It drifts on the wind, landing near a human settlement in the dark of night. Where it lands, it causes trouble with its strange powers and absorbs the fright of reacting humans.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are quite mischievous, feeding on fear. They create illusions of Rattata scurrying out of walls and crevices to startle people, rarely ever being seen themselves.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are known to carry misfortune wherever they go. If this Pokémon's light fur stands on end, it is said to be communicating with the afterlife.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME tend to be sly creatures that stop at nothing to get what they want. They often torment their Trainers with malicious compliance that derails many of their Trainer's plans.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful teeth to chew through walls and scare people. Its fangs grow in length and durability when it absorbs fear.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME frightens people by baring its oversized fangs. It then draws the fear in and absorbs it through the glowing orbs on its neck.
author: .izik

entry: They resemble a ghostly creature called Flutter Mane, whose existence is debated to this day. They seem to mostly appear in areas with people that are hard to scare, making primal screeches in an attempt to cause mass panic.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: In the past, POKENAME's haunting cries were assumed to be signs of a witch lurking nearby. While its main head guides travelers through the forest, the pearl on its tail tries to lead them astray instead.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME lets out metallic screeches as it floats across the sky. The fear it spreads is drawn into its body's orbs.
author: .izik

entry: During full moons, POKENAME emerges to frighten nearby humans. The fear it collects feeds the crystal orbs on its chest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide themselves within basalt deposits. Their gems stand out against the dark grey of the volcanic deposits, drawing people in close. They delight in surprising those who fall for their ruse, cackling as they leap out to shock the person.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can keep itself in the air for an indefinite period of time, supplementing its flight with levitation when its wings grow tired.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense for facial recognition, allowing it to accurately hold grudges and annoy those who have wronged it. One of its favorite small inconveniences is to pick locks with its beak and let in drafts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME clings to dark corners of haunted locales, hiding away from sight. When others draw near, it spits out a dark ink that splatters across the victim and leaves them with chills and a feeling of ghastly dread for quite some time after.
author: sk372

entry: Many consider POKENAME as a bad omen. It puts curses on anyone who hears its loud, screeching cry.
author: themicelegion

entry: The snakes that make up POKENAME's arms only appear to be alive due to a series of illusions. In reality, they hide tendrils of poison that paralyze on contact.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's tusks are made of solid ruby. There are jewelers on Chrysanthemum Island that use these tusks in making wedding rings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneaks into computers and reads the data of a user to find out information about them. Using this, it knows exactly the kind of hexes to afflict a computer with and cause the most duress for them.
author: sk372

entry: Using its antlers, POKENAME can cast illusions from up to 50 meters away. Once its foe has been terrified, POKENAME absorbs the fear into its orbs.
author: .izik

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's hood was replicated by many ancient tribes in talismans meant to curse a target with misfortune.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's milk improves in nutrition and flavor if it is in the presence of intense fear. The milk can only be safely used to feed baby Ghost-type Pokémon and must be contained in specialized glass.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME absorbs rot and filth from bodies of water, forming it into a chain of gems. It weeps for days if the chain is broken or stolen.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME dreams of growing enormous to cause fear through chaos and destruction on a large scale. For the time being, it uses shadows to appear larger and echoes for its screeches to be amplified to enhance its ability to frighten.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its body can pass through just about any solid object with little effort. For some reason, POKENAME lacks the ability to move through iron.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can exhale a thick mist that snuffs out the light of the surrounding area, plunging it into darkness. It uses this shadowy cover to hunt and terrorize those who wander into its territory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores magical power in its gems and cheek pouches. When multiple gather together, they can create powerful illusions over vast areas.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME floats through the night sky, muttering unrecognizable words. Many believe it's reciting an ancient curse.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raids pantries in the night, devouring as many sweet treats as it can find. If the food is not up to its liking, it throws the cooking utensils around the kitchen and stacks all of the chairs in an inconvenient pile.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Incredibly pompous by nature, POKENAME enjoy surrounding themselves with people and Pokémon who will shower them with compliments. If someone insults a POKENAME, it will glare at them and mutter incantations and curses until they apologize.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hide inside the walls of old homes, skittering and tunneling within those walls. They have driven many people delirious from the persistent noise they cause, only to be vindicated once they are revealed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME may prank others by suddenly dropping the ambient temperature around someone to shock them. While it does genuinely enjoy the prank, the victim's negative thoughts afterwards also physically sustains POKENAME too.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME may prank others by suddenly dropping the ambient temperature around someone to shock them. While it does genuinely enjoy the prank, the victim's negative thoughts afterwards also physically sustains POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME appears to be searching for a specific being, popping up randomly in cyberspace, its mere presence causing glitches. Some believe once it finds who it searches for, it will drag them to its home deep within the digital realm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME becomes nervous when it cannot see its caretaker and will begin to screech, quiet as a whisper at first but growing in strength until it is cuddled. It spits out will-o-wisps to light up areas because it hates being in the dark.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A POKENAME's claws can sap a victim's will to fight. When threatened, POKENAME will create illusions to help them run away.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME will bond with its Trainer, and, in an act of kindness, use its psychic powers to absorb its Trainer's fears and worries.
author: nelluc27

entry: It's said POKENAME is formed from a conglomeration of the most malicious spirits of the afterlife. With its vast ghostly powers, it spends most of its time unceasingly haunting and pranking as many people as possible.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient POKENAME once terrorised primordial forests, feeding on the terror of lesser creatures. It grows stronger by absorbing fear, its ghastly horns growing larger with every pulse of dread.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Herds of POKENAME wander through fields at night, illuminated only by the eerie glow of their gems. It is said that the patterns they travel in help to guide lost spirits, the position of their gems along the pack forming runes from lost languages.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When the moon is full, the red orbs on POKENAME's head glow a bright crimson. POKENAME is often found near cemeteries, appearing to shield wandering souls from paranormal danger.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME drifts silently through night skies at a steady pace. Many spiritual mediums once believed it to be a god of the dead.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's crystals are formed from negative emotions, gathering more as they are stabbed into a target and draining away their negativity. The healthiest POKENAME are those that exclusively hunt evildoers and those owned by acupuncture clinics.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME are dangerous creatures, which are able to see and control your future actions. Making it mad causes it to place a bad luck curse on you for seven years.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME uses its ribbons to brush against others to drain bits of joy from them. The absorbed emotions serve as energy for it to use to cast hexes on others, as it delights in causing misfortune and distress.
author: sk372

entry: The cannon that POKENAME wields fires bolts that can pierce through nearly any defenses. They are described in folklore as devilish reapers who collect the souls of their targets.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has fun picking fights against other Fighting-type Pokémon, acting as if their punches hurt them. Then, they surprise their foes by effortlessly going through all of their punches before delivering the final blow.
author: epping_forest

entry: The timid POKENAME uses its spectral powers to scare off intruders, though it quickly becomes terrified of those who resist its illusions.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME uses its thick hair to grab and ensnare its victims while it slowly drains away their life force. If it is threatened, it will let out a deafening wail which inflicts its attacker with an overwhelming sense of fear.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its ghostly flames to siphon the light from already dim areas, spooking those traveling through. It feeds on the increase in fear caused by the darkening surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: Skittish and easily frightened, POKENAME use illusions to hide themselves from people. It's said that hugging one will bring you six years of good fortune.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Elegant and impish, POKENAME only reveal themselves to those they believe are worthy. Making one displeased is said to bring a thousand-year curse.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME possesses a mischievous personality, but lacks the energy to pull off pranks. Even just conjuring a slight ghostly breeze requires a seven-hour nap afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a highly mischievous little creature. Its favorite pastime is to startle others by discharging lightning at random and making them jump to avoid getting shocked; it delights in the fear and surprise people emanate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is popular among spiritual people because of rumors that it can communicate with the dead. Mediums hold onto it like a planchette and guide it across spirit boards.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is found in places associated with the dead, hoping to help families move on from grief. It drags its planchette across its spirit board to deliver supposed messages from the dead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its haunting cries and ghastly flame to scare those who wander through its territory. Its flame brightens when it succeeds.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME uses a false air of kindness and cuteness, offering them to smell from its roses. Those that fall for the ruse get blasted with a large cloud of pollen that inflicts a week-long curse of bad luck.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME pops out from behind trees to startle people, then absorbs their fear for nourishment. It thrives on the emotions of others, using the fear to sustain itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats flowers as they wither on gravestones. This eerie habit is often witnessed near secluded graves, where it silently feasts on the dying blooms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatter bundles of cotton through forests to shelter lost spirits. Once a spirit has settled within a bundle, it will ignite with a spectral flame, burning away the cotton to let the spirit pass on.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME usually live in small groups inside caves. They can scream at an incredibly high pitch to drive off unwanted visitors.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME draws naive and curious travelers close with displays of false innocence in order to get them to gaze into its orb. A vision of terror appears within, spooking the victim so POKENAME can feed on their fear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in cemeteries, seeking shelter among the tombstones. During nights with thunderstorms, it sits on mausoleums to absorb lightning strikes, using the energy to strengthen itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collect precious stones to add to their necklace. If their collection grows large enough, they might trip over their necklaces while trying to walk.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's fangs absorb chemicals produced by fear, so it scares its prey by stalking them and screaming before finally biting. It hides in caves and abandoned buildings when the sun is out.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are cruel creatures that love to cause mischief. They steal valuable trinkets from Trainers and scatter them to force Trainers to wander through unpleasant conditions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emits a screeching cry as it accelerates around obstacles in its old-growth forest habitat. When multiple congregate, they will race each other, joining their shrieks in a cacophony sounding like a choir of ghosts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A Ghost-type Pokémon found deep in ancient forests, POKENAME has a cruel sense of humor. They delight in misleading Trainers with the sounds of other people, leaving them lost and confused with little hope of getting home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It appears in swarms at night to frighten sailors, often pulling out their hair. POKENAME becomes timid when confronted by those who are not easily frightened.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME mimics a dead tree as it stalks intruders in the forest it protects. It usually only scares travelers with creepy shrieks, feeding on their fear, but if anyone harms the forest, POKENAME will curse them so they are lost forever.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME mimics a dead tree as it stalks intruders in the forest it protects. It usually only scares travelers with creepy shrieks, feeding on their fear, but if anyone harms the forest, POKENAME will curse them so they are lost forever.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME makes a blood-curdling scream to scare people. It absorbs their fear into its orbs for nourishment, feeding off the energy that fear provides.
author: .izik

entry: On days when dark clouds hang heavy in the sky but no rain falls, the sobbing cry of POKENAME can be heard high above. The jewels it carries are said to contain the forgotten dreams of those who passed too young.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME loves to possess stuffed toys, as it gets joy out of scaring young children. While POKENAME is inside the doll, it is abnormally strong for its size.
author: mistymagius

entry: It can move the sands of its body at will to form new structures. When a small Pokémon walks through its door, it takes delight in scaring the Pokémon by transforming into a terrifying room.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME lives in boggy moors and forests where it sings eerie, echoing ballads, but erupts with paralyzing screeches if interrupted. Historically, its singing was mistaken for a recently deceased spirit and people left gifts out for the ghost.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's large eyes give it an unsettling quality. The gemstone beads on its head glow when people feel nervous around it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME diligently polishes the large gem they possess, ensuring that it is in pristine condition at all times. Those who stare into this gem are said to see their greatest fears, much to POKENAME's amusement.
author: santon5512

entry: This ball of fur is incapable of moving without the aid of its otherworldly powers. The bulbs on its antennae resonate with each other to amplify this power.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME is very particular, so owners who do not meet its desires immediately will be inundated with sassy shrieks and howls. When sleeping, it becomes mostly transparent except for the beads around its throat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon that enjoys distracting Trainers and causing them to get lost. Its desire to create excitement is often mistaken for malevolence, so Trainers take different routes to avoid it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's brightly colored scales reflect light to lure in potential prey. A single hair or scale from this Pokémon can cause debilitating paralysis on contact.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME makes creepy noises in pumpkin patches to keep people away. Its unsettling presence and eerie sounds create a haunting atmosphere, driving off any intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vestigial legs can be used for attacks, but it only moves by levitating. When excited, flames trail behind it as it moves.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME dart from the shadows to startle those who pass by. They feed on the small amounts of fear they induce, constantly trying to scare those around them to nourish themselves.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME dive from the sky at anyone passing below, letting out a deafening wail as they do so. Despite their solitary nature, victims always perceive these Pokémon as flocks due to the illusions they produce.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME scoops up water and fish in its mouth to carry off towards civilization. Once there, it uses ghostly magic to move its spit-up contents and harass the locals, reveling in the chaos it creates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings resembles the eyes of a large predator to those it wishes to intimidate. If the display of these crimson wings fails to scare others away, its eerie humming is likely to do so.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to hang around shrines and graveyards. It's believed that a POKENAME stealing an offering left there is a bad omen.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME are constantly flowing and billowing as if propelled forward by spectral winds. Many people believe that items stolen by POKENAME are forever cursed.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Very assertive and focused, POKENAME follow a strong moral code. They are known to cause headaches for those with evil within their hearts.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME floats among the trees of gravesites, monitoring the weather. Should a rainstorm occur during a burial, it releases an aura that deepens the grief of those present so it can feed on their sorrow.
author: .izik

entry: Light, agile, and impish, POKENAME spends its time vandalizing things. Its ability to leap through walls makes it difficult to stop.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: When thick fog gathers over the waves, POKENAME can be heard eerily wailing to frighten sailors. Ships that sail into this dense fog are said to never be seen again.
author: mepp.

entry: It is said that POKENAME trains both body and mind to their absolute limits, achieving strength and focus beyond imagination. Groups of these Pokémon can often be found meditating atop mountains of all kinds.
author: naivetotoro

entry: POKENAME uses its terrifying screech to freeze its prey in fear before consuming them. Its flames burn from the drained energy of its victims.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME crawls up to campsites in the night making spooky screams and wails, but pretends to be a rock if anyone investigates. As the campers become more fearful, it glows bright with pink energy as it feeds on their fear.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The magnets on either side of POKENAME contain powerful ghostly energies. If the three orbs circle around one of them, it is preparing to cast a particularly powerful hex from that magnet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appear at night and swim next to ships, hoping to lure sailors into the water. They cast spells that cause hallucinations and headaches, which can only be purged by traveling far from the POKENAME that cast them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME floats through people to cause them to see visions, smell horrible scents, and feel strong chills, giggling at their discomfort. It is incredibly light, so it clings to eaves or tree branches with its hair during strong winds.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME cries in corners, pretending to be a lost child, until someone helps it and POKENAME can screech in their face. It also finds it hilarious to distract people with antics while moving a hand behind to tap them on the back.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is employed in haunted houses as it enjoys terrifying patrons by leaping from their shadows and pulling faces to cheer up children who got too scared. It becomes upset and begins screaming if ignored for long.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Every segment of POKENAME's body is said to hold a large amount of dark magic within. Those obsessed with the occult attempted to poach the orbs in the distant past, but rarely succeeded and instead incited disastrous retaliation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's harmonic moaning lulls those who hear it into a fitful sleep. It then feeds on their fear as their dreams are filled with nightmares. Those wishing to avoid it sprinkle pepper around their pillows as POKENAME's nose is sensitive.
author: pjporwoll

entry: After POKENAME eats a dream, it forms a new bead on its pendulum string. It wards off evil spirits using the dream essence contained within its beads.
author: noel5229

entry: An odd rune grows from the back of an POKENAME. Attempts to determine the meaning has led to the discovery that it resembles a form of Unown, but for now, scientists are unsure of the connection.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Rather than releasing foul odors when threatened, it sends flashing images of mysterious characters into its opponent's head. It doesn't seem to eat.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME consider themselves protectors of ancient ruins. Tragically, their tendency to explode on intruders means they often cause greater harm.
author: griddle

entry: The eye is its true body. When threatened, it will eject itself from its protective shell. If it can't get away, it explodes.
author: griddle

entry: An ancient being that has a strange sense of protection. When it senses someone in its home, it locks onto them with its eyes and attacks.
author: theheroict

entry: Unown allows itself to be wielded as a weapon by a Cubone, its body making a surprisingly efficient club. At night, the Unown has Cubone draw mysterious symbols in the dirt, the meaning of which is not yet known.
author: sk372

entry: In all recorded cases, looking directly into the eye of POKENAME causes a profound sense of discomfort. It seems to relish in this, however, staring into the eyes of anybody it can see.
author: hiimhdere

entry: People and Pokémon think POKENAME is weak because of its poor eyesight, but POKENAME's eyeball contains a lot of psychic energy. It can easily crush a car with its powers, and people who try to catch it often meet a terrible fate.
author: sottiwotti

entry: Thousands of eyes can be seen in the smoke emitted by POKENAME. No one knows who the eyes belong to, or what they're looking for.
author: griddle

entry: The clouds POKENAME emits have their own eyes that look around and blink on their own. It's believed that until they dissipate completely, POKENAME can see through these additional eyes as well.
author: sk372

entry: In a process similar to photosynthesis, POKENAME will take in sunlight through its massive eye, converting it into nutrients to aid in its evolution. Its other eyes watch the treetops for potential danger.
author: santon5512

entry: Those who inhale POKENAME's gas witness startling visions. Victims of it always describe a vast grey sky, filled with as many eyes as there are stars.
author: griddle

entry: The pupil can shift around to any part of the giant unblinking eye that is its head. Even should the child wander off beyond normal sight, POKENAME will always see where its child is.
author: sk372

entry: Honey-sweet powder shaped like symbols in myriad ancient languages falls from its wings. Soothsayers divine the future from the words spelled in the specks they sprinkle across their morning cereal.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME's limbs have all the flexibility of a rubber hose. It uses these limbs to entertain children and adults alike.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME is a mysterious creature that typically guards ruins and ancient temples, driving away intruders with its sturdy horns. The eyes on its tails are perpetually watchful, allowing it to spot anyone attempting to strike it from behind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Weedle's nose has been replaced with an eye that seems to track threats exceptionally well. Its often found in groups making mysterious messages.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME fly through the skies in intricate patterns, it is believed that these patterns are the symbols of a long forgotten language. In tales POKENAME destroyed cities in fits of rage, it was believed that this was divine punishment from Arceus.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: It possesses shapeshifting abilities just like Ditto, but is unable to change a certain part of itself. Thus, no matter the form it takes, the result will inevitably retain a giant cycloptic eye somewhere.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to carry darkness and despair everywhere they go. Together, they invade and infest planets with their darkness.
author: the_smirker

entry: When inside a computer, POKENAME's eye will follow the movements of the cursor, when not staring at the user directly. It sometimes opens text documents and attempts to communicate, but the messages always appear to be gibberish.
author: sk372

entry: Immobile POKENAME will often sit high in trees, staring at any potential danger as it waits for its inevitable evolution.
author: bombboyxd

entry: It drifts in absolute silence, its eyes never blinking and never aligned. Attempts to document its movements often result in corrupted footage or endless loops of moments observers swear never happened.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's eyestalks constantly writhe and thrash in its endless search for worthy prey; they're only at rest after a successful hunt.
author: griddle

entry: At night, POKENAME will stare into the sky, not moving a muscle, and on occasion, Unown will gather in the air above them, making mysterious patterns. What they say and what it means to POKENAME is still a mystery.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME rests high up on mountain peaks, gazing down and surveying its territory. Travelers that catch its gaze report feeling an unnatural chill completely separate from their cold surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: There are rumors that the shed skin left behind by POKENAME still contains a fraction of its mind within. Despite being hollow, some swear to have seen an eye staring back at them from within.
author: sk372

entry: While less territorial than Beedrill, it will often spend its time defending ruined temples from intruders. It's not known why it does this.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Unown gather around POKENAME, defending them with well-coordinated attacks. Theories suggest that POKENAME communicate with them using telepathy.
author: santon5512

entry: Its eyelike patterns glow faintly as it focuses its psychic powers; these are merely patterns, not eyes. Despite having no visible eyes, this Pokémon can use its psychic powers to perceive everything around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body seems to be covered with countless symbols resembling the genes of the very first Pokémon in existence. Archaeologists also note that these symbols resemble the first written words in human history.
author: entomoxie

entry: It is docile like its unfused counterparts. If threatened, it will send strange visions or throw sand at its opponent before retreating.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's body bends into strange shapes that resemble ancient writing. It's said that when it forms a complete word, nearby Pokémon grow restless as if hearing distant voices.
author: trenbologne

entry: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to tell the time down to the second. The feathers on their head spin around along the ticks that float around them to calculate various events before returning to the present time.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's main eye can detect even the slightest mechanical malfunctions. Many were used to monitor test flights for the ZERO-ONE during its early stages.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found in caverns within lush jungle ruins. Due to their high photosensitivity, these Pokémon will avoid sunlight at all costs.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The large, open eye upon the back of an POKENAME's abdomen is not a mere marking as many once believed. This discovery has led some researchers to wonder if this part of its body is the actual head, rather than the abdomen.
author: infinex21

entry: It's unknown how this fusion eats, but scientists have noted its cruelty when it ambushes its prey before taking them out of sight. It often leaves strange symbols around its nest.
author: bombboyxd

entry: The eyes at the ends of their antennae are decoys to intimidate others by staring at them without blinking. Their actual eye has yet to be witnessed blinking, even when exposed to a bright flash of light.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gather together in places where the most stars are visible in the night sky. Their positioning suggests an attempt to relay a message of some kind, but what and to whom is still unknown.
author: sk372

entry: Fittingly for a fusion named POKENAME, it is quite physically weak, even compared to its components. It sometimes struggles to lift objects as small and light as a marshmallow.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME always stares at the sun and only seems to notice others if they block its view. At night, it cries when the sun is gone from sight.
author: jangodiot

entry: It stares at the sun until it sets. At night, it looks at the ground, as if detecting the sun through the planet.
author: busilisk

entry: Priests have noted its divine-looking form. While it doesn't eat, it often approaches Pokémon at Mach 2 before stopping to stare at them.
author: bombboyxd

entry: When resting, the eye on POKENAME's tail remains alert. If approached, it fires a Hidden Power, while its black wool crackles with stored electricity.
author: .izik

entry: It was believed for a long time to possess the ability to read human writing. However, formal studies have shown that it likely cannot read and is instead trying to eat the books, confused by its lack of a mouth.
author: hophoppip

entry: It doesn't seem to sleep. Instead, POKENAME uses its eyes to find sufficient materials to make both strange markings and its nests in its vicinity.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME fly at incredibly fast speeds, darting through the air in the shape of various letters as it scans the tall grass for food. It's theorized that these movements spell out words, though its unpredictable nature makes them hard to study.
author: santon5512

entry: A young POKENAME carries the eye-like eggs of Unsire on its head stalks. Scientists theorize this behavior increases its odds of survival.
author: filteredtea

entry: POKENAME are mostly made of slightly toxic goo, allowing them to morph into almost any shape. Their organs adapt to their new shape, and researchers are looking into how this may increase the success of human organ transplants.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are mostly made of slightly toxic goo, allowing them to morph into almost any shape. Groups of POKENAME sometimes morph into words or even short sentences.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME have been seen terraforming lakes and ponds with their psychic powers to make their nests. They defend their young with fierce hostility.
author: filteredtea

entry: POKENAME was thought to be a rare mutation of Umbreon upon initial discovery. After a short time studying it, eyes protruded from its markings.
author: jokerswild

entry: An POKENAME's apparent body can often be seen ambulating as normal Pokémon do, but there are times when it hangs slack from the headpiece, as if a puppet of the floating crown.
author: banquoviaquo

entry: This variation of POKENAME seems more human-like than others of its species. Periodically, it silently acts out unknown plays; the reason is debated.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME was said to have come from an artist's dreams. Since then it has been found throughout the artist's paintings, seemingly waving to the viewers.
author: inksans201x

entry: It often spends its time in the sunlight. Some interpret the fluttering of its black leaf as an attempt to communicate, but its meaning is unknown.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Many are put off by POKENAME's large eye. While it has no teeth, its natural instinct to gnaw often leaves it with ocular injuries.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME chant in an ancient susurration to scare people away from ancient tombs. If intruders persist, then POKENAME assault them with blinding beams of light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A collection of Unown appear to have gathered together in an attempt to communicate with humans. Unfortunately, what they are trying to say remains unknown.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: This self fusion of Unown seems to try to arrange itself to form words in cross-like patterns.  However, it only only seems to form actual words out of sheer luck.
author: infranscia

entry: This self fusion of Unown has morphed to resemble a different form of writing.  Researchers speculate that it did so because has synced with the mental energies of another place and/or time.
author: infranscia

entry: This self fusion of Unown is made of many parts.  These parts are synchronized with each-other's energies, allowing them to work together to create intricate glyphs.
author: infranscia

entry: An POKENAME's only working pair of eyes is on the stalks on its head. The illusion of the other eyes is created by color markings on its fur and tail. This illusion has been observed to intimidate and frighten away some of its predators.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Around the nests of POKENAME are the remains of the prey it has hunted and defeated, each surrounded by mysterious symbols. Strangely, none appear to be eaten.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME swim in ancient caverns, protecting treasures of the past. Using their central eye, POKENAME shoot waves of psychic energy towards intruders, causing headaches and anxiety.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is considered to be one of the strongest forms of Unown. Its appearance is reminiscent of an old legend known as "The Unown King".
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME will fly from forests to nearby ruins, wander about while hovering their horn above objects of interest before flying back home in silence. What they are apparently scanning for is still unknown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often found amongst the ruins of ancient peoples, crawling their way toward writings etched into walls. They consume rocks that have been written on, absorbing energy from the ancient words, and are considered a pest by archaeologists.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME soars quietly across forests located near old ruins, almost never landing. If attacked, it separates the myriad parts of its body before reassembling itself to counterattack.
author: sk372

entry: Though it resembles an eye, POKENAME's nose has no vision at all. It can sniff out buried berries even beneath layers of snow.
author: .izik

entry: The eyes on the ends of its branches stare ominously at anyone that passes by. Some POKENAME branches grow into shapes resembling letters of the alphabet.
author: hophoppip

entry: Schools of POKENAME are always found swimming in perfect unison, almost as if they were all one Pokémon.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its eye can see when anyone in the world is sleeping. Its psychic power lets it know when someone is awake. POKENAME uses both to judge people's morality.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME collect assorted letters from magazines, toys, and objects that spell out odd words and phrases. Their chirps sound like giggling children.
author: pankiwi

entry: Some of its bladed feathers are detachable and possess working eyes, floating around and letting POKENAME view across wide distances. Its rarely seen with all its feathers attached, as it's always curiously observing its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large eye allows it to effectively search the grasslands of its habitat for food. However, it is often seen to be physically malnourished.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME was first spotted in the vicinity of a research center near the Ruins of Alph. Computers in its vicinity begin to display text characters, but the messages do not belong to any known language.
author: sk372

entry: It has traded its vibrant colour palette for striking black ink. Unown spring from its calligraphy, bringing POKENAME's words to life with their power.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME will mark ruin walls with abstract graffiti. Patterns have been discovered in its paintings, which some insist include strange codes.
author: leshii

entry: Anyone who locks eyes with POKENAME is struck by a chilling sensation. The cold is described as being as deep as a tundra storm.
author: .izik

entry: The tracks and burns created by its electrical discharges form patterns that resemble text characters.
author: staghorn

entry: This fusion is brutally vicious. Strangely, the eyes of its neck flap are functional, and if POKENAME is threatened, they will glare at the foe.
author: bombboyxd

entry: While asleep, POKENAME's smooth body radiates intense heat. If disturbed, it awakens and releases a Hidden Power in defense.
author: .izik

entry: A researcher once mistook this fusion for a wall mural of Suicune. Nobody has actually seen POKENAME move; it runs and attacks only when you blink.
author: griddle

entry: Originally thought to be a rumor cooked up by archeologists, POKENAME tends to pretend to be part of ancient drawings. It hides in ancient ruins.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: It spends its time in ruins that are regularly near thunderstorms. The psychic messages it sends shows that it holds lightning in a fanatical regard.
author: bombboyxd

entry: It has a strange decrepit appearance, as if it were partially burnt away. As it floats through the forest night, it sings a haunting song; those that hear it are said to see grim visions of their future.
author: sk372

entry: Its gaze transmits its thoughts directly into the minds of others. Those who have committed evil deeds hear nothing but the question, "Why?".
author: reflecbeat

entry: POKENAME constantly scans its surroundings with its large eyes, making it impossible to escape its gaze. It playfully skips through ruins, leaving those who have seen its eyes smiling uncontrollably for hours afterwards.
author: shyguy11011

entry: One can identify an POKENAME's den by the ritual circles it carves into the ground. The purpose of these circles is a mystery to all.
author: griddle

entry: This Pokémon is said to possess vast, ancient knowledge. If it feels insulted, it may temporarily blind the offending person with a spell.
author: busilisk

entry: It loves a mystery, and can frequently be found in the company of novelists. Many writers regard POKENAME as their biggest fan and harshest critic.
author: griddle

entry: The smoke POKENAME exhales while resting is filtered and used in creating Pester Balls. The faint psychic energy in the smoke causes brief disorientation in anyone it hits.
author: .izik

entry: All three of POKENAME's eye stalks can rotate around and give it a full 360 degree range of vision. Those who stare into all four of its eyes at once begin crying uncontrollably, stopping only when POKENAME looks away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is frequently found in the company of other baby Pokémon. Its psychic powers are strengthened by laughter and joy.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME is created when an Unchu is struck by incredibly strong lightning. If fully charged, the pupils on its eyes glow a harsh yellow.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME use their claws to carve symbols and words into wood, though their purpose is unknown. They are incredibly elusive, often leaving these markings on the sides of houses in the dead of night.
author: santon5512

entry: It sends out bizarre psychokinetic waves. Its body is hard as steel, and touching it for too long induces headaches in most Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's eye gives it flawless night vision, but makes it uniquely vulnerable to snow blindness. It lives in fear of the sun as a result.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME holds an extraordinary amount of power within its eye, and some say it has a sixth sense within it. POKENAME can leave their eye behind and still track it down from miles away.
author: jangodiot

entry: The eyes on its tail are capable of firing electricity at foes from a large distance. It can focus all of its eyes on a single target for a massive electric attack.
author: elekboy88
