entry: It shoots Unown from its cannons, spelling its attacks. Strong POKENAME have been known to fire sentences; the strongest will actually fire rhymes.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME appears attracted to those with gentle hearts, flying over them and observing them quietly. However, when the chosen being notices it, it quickly flies off and hides.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's burrows are as deep as Sandshrew's are, but it was discovered that the walls of these burrows contain strange, unreadable markings.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME are known to carve hieroglyphs in ice with their tusks, marking their territory. When POKENAME gather, they are filled with a mysterious power.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME can track other beings at far distances thanks to its powerful eye. It can harness sunlight and its internal energy around its tail like thin blades that can deeply gouge thick trees.
author: infinex21

entry: The blades on its forearms resemble certain ancient text characters a bit. It will often stare down prey and predators with its singular eye to try and intimidate them.
author: infinex21

entry: An POKENAME's many eyes can absorb sunlight or release energy as concentrated beams when faced with many enemies. It can release its hidden power as vibrant blades of pure, condensed energy along its arms.
author: infinex21

entry: The spikes on POKENAME's back aren't hide, though they appear to be connected to the markings in their burrows. They almost seem to be a message.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME are fascinated by books and enjoy reading. Whenever they find something interesting to tell their Trainer, they will try to spell out a word that describes the object of interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As it dances, it strikes poses that seem to correspond to letters of the alphabet. Whatever sort of message it is trying to convey has yet to be deciphered.
author: sk372

entry: It uses advanced psychic powers to keep aware of its surroundings while watching over its Trainer. It can rotate its head 360 degrees; it will always keep its eye on its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: Some say all POKENAME are avatars of the same being projected into our reality from somewhere beyond. The shifting mound of limbs behind the body grasps and gazes gently at those near, seemingly searching for something important.
author: sk372

entry: This POKENAME is more metallic than others of its species. The black limbs on its rear can reach to impale unlucky others onto its hard back.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's horn has been displaced by its eye, depriving it of its main defence against aggressors. In return, it seems to have incredible senses.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Wild POKENAME are often found around ruins, standing upright like pitch-black obelisks as they watch others with their singular, large eyes resting at the tops of their bodies. They can direct their internal energy into beams loosed from their eyes.
author: infinex21

entry: It's said POKENAME are created when a written work with exactly 108 spelling errors is published. It's commonly used to scare inattentive students.
author: griddle

entry: Its eerie, shifting body is said to distort perception the longer it is watched. Those who meet its gaze claim to see a vast darkness that not even the glow of a Lantern can pierce.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Scientists have noted that POKENAME's black characters convey a message when it relaxes in the sun. What it means remains a mystery.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Surprisingly, the unique shape of POKENAME's head does not appear to affect its daily life. Its body seems to resemble an odd symbol.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Its body is a hollow shell. People will give POKENAME items for safekeeping and then gently shake it to retrieve them. It doesn't seem to mind this.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME are known to live at the remains of ancient ruins. They draw hieroglyphs by faceplanting into the ground and using their tentacles to write. Many instances of POKENAME are curious about modern technology.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: This fusion makes its home in the petrified remains of Cradily littering the seafloor. Contrary to popular belief, it's not malevolent; it's just shy.
author: griddle

entry: They adorn themselves with smashed Unown parts; scientists refer to these trophies as 'text breaks'. The POKENAME with the biggest text break leads.
author: griddle

entry: Little is known about this Pokémon's behavior except that it is compulsively drawn toward perfect circles. Otherwise, its movements seem slow, but erratic—almost random.
author: banquoviaquo

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in ruins, blocking passageways with their circular heads. They will only move for those who prove themselves able to read the language of their native ruins.
author: staghorn

entry: It lounges silently in abandoned ruins, its single eye never blinking. Though it appears lazy, its presence disrupts compasses and clocks, as if time itself grows sluggish around it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME lounge around ruins, they typically carve lazy hieroglyphs into the sand. When provoked, POKENAME unleash a burst of devastating psychic power.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This fusion sees everything happening in all dimensions and timelines at once. Its depictions can often be found on the walls of ancient temples.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is said to see everything with its many eyes. Humans should steer clear of this Pokémon, as looking at it for too long causes distress and nausea. "Never odd or even, its endless eyes are always changing," witnesses have described.
author: _pixelar_

entry: When it was fused, a mysterious structure appeared on its back, and other Unown started to appear out of nowhere.
author: funkytomate

entry: Other Unown have begun to merge with this fusion. It seems like they are naturally drawn to the structures on its back.
author: funkytomate

entry: Many Unown have fused with Torterra and took on the form of a structure. Some believe it can tell us something about Unown's homeworld.
author: funkytomate

entry: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like a rudimentary sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like an over-complicated sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The direction and motion of how their bodies fly aid in their communication. If they see something they don't like, the two bodies will cross into an X-shaped formation and repel it with their psychic powers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The venom injected by POKENAME's horn is black and inky. It's a neurotoxin that targets the language center of the brain, causing victims to spout gibberish or become unable to speak.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME were ancient guards, protecting important pieces of writing. They would use their strong psychic powers to telepathically alert the monarch if a thief was caught.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It spells out words of affections with its long, flexible tendrils. It's said that with its extra eyes it keeps careful watch over those it loves.
author: r.isk

entry: Each segment of its body appears to be shaped like a letter from the alphabet. The body appears to spell something as it flies, but strangely, those who witness it each report a completely different set of letters.
author: sk372

entry: Each of the eyes spread across its body are thought to stare across space into different dimensions. Should one meet an eye's gaze, they too may catch a glimpse of these unknown worlds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is considered one of the most elusive Pokémon due to its aversion to being seen, going as far as tearing space to hide until its many eyes cannot see anyone in its surroundings. It was only recorded with the help of a very brave Kecleon.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: Its eyes typically wander and focus on separate things, but those who attract the gaze of all six claim to be struck with intense mental anguish.
author: bukie

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: During waxing moons, POKENAME's lone eye occasionally flashes blue. The reason for this glow remains completely unknown.
author: .izik

entry: According to legend, POKENAME flies through the skies of the world, observing people's actions with its many eyes in order to judge them. It is also believed to punish injustice by raining down violent lightning bolts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's unblinking eyes survey its territory constantly as it floats, making it impossible to sneak up on. Small groups occasionally gather around radio towers, their presence causing heavy disruption in the radio waves.
author: sk372

entry: During the day, POKENAME slowly drift through the air. However, when night falls, POKENAME hunts for prey. There are stories of POKENAME taking people away in groups, and victims say they were taken to ancient ruins depicting Legendary Pokémon.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: On nights of a full moon, POKENAME stands silently atop still pond waters. Its single eye gazes unblinking at the moon until dawn.
author: .izik

entry: This mysterious Pokémon can be found rarely in temple ruins deep in rainforests. It hardly moves, constantly staring with its unblinking eye.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME is convinced that it possesses the power to fulfil all of humanity's desires, and it shows unbelievable confidence in its abilities.
author: the_smirker

entry: As the wax melts, POKENAME's ghostly fire casts faint shadows of forgotten runes. A book read by the light of POKENAME may have words not found in other editions.
author: ozydamians

entry: It stares unblinking at any potential threats to deter them or to at least unnerve them. In battle, it wreathes the sides of its head with psychic energy to form sharp blades that can cut through solid stone.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is an intimidating Pokémon at first, but once it trusts you, it becomes very kind. Each eye it has once belonged to an Unown.
author: planatical

entry: Once thought to be a mythical ruler, POKENAME acts as a guardian of cemeteries. It is not very fond of trespassers.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME's legs are too small to hold up its body for long periods of time, so they levitate. They are known to guard ancient structures so well that there are rumors about POKENAME being bound there by a spirit.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Unlike Vulpix, this Pokémon's tails instill fear in many. Some say that even POKENAME's flames leave you cold from fear.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: Its multiple eyes are always focused on different things. When all of them focus on a single target, that target will instantly combust.
author: infinex21

entry: Researchers are split on whether POKENAME are able to see out of all the eyes on their body or through just the ones on their head. Gazing too long into their eyes provokes feelings of being watched at all times, even after moving away from them.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's core is said to contain a hidden power that may not even be known to it. Its limbs sometime writhe into the shapes of ancient text characters found within ruins.
author: infinex21

entry: Some ancient cultures believed POKENAME act as translators for Jiown. The symbols on its head shift accordingly based on the viewer's own language.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Its singular eye will never blink, even when attacked directly. It stares with deranged intensity, gazing beyond the veil into something past visible reality.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sear the ground with their mystical flames, making intricate hieroglyphs. While this behavior is done for an unknown reason, it is said that any ill-intended person who sets foot in POKENAME's territory is cursed for a thousand years.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: It enjoys singing in the evening, though the warped notes it lets out tend to disorient those who listen to it. Some have reported that the note-shaped part of its body changes depending on the song.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that an ancient POKENAME once rammed into the walls of a cave in attempts to write down the story of the beginning of the universe. Researchers have searched for the right cave, and believe it to be Union Cave, though no evidence remains.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The eyes on POKENAME head are merely decoys, with its real eye residing in its mouth. It lies at the bottom of sand pits, staring into the sky as it waits for its prey.
author: santon5512

entry: This Pokémon is a slow swimmer that is most often found in shallow reefs. Due to its large eyes, it is very good at noticing incoming threats. However, due to the rest of its body being so small, it's terrible at avoiding those threats.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME have been recorded invading research labs and replacing the gears in machinery, typically those that print or visualize information. Machines with POKENAME in them constantly produce indecipherable combinations of numbers and letters.
author: sk372

entry: The eye on its tail grants near-perfect sight behind itself. Sensationalist sources often hyperbolise that POKENAME can see both the past and future.
author: fixthewifi

entry: Despite their unnerving appearance, these Pokémon do not usually mean harm. POKENAME enjoy scaring other Pokémon for fun.
author: the_smirker

entry: It sings in eerie, almost rhythmic tones, with its single eye glowing faintly in the dark. Those who hear its song often experience strange visions, as if the very fabric of reality bends to its melody.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Researchers claim POKENAME nests near botanical textbooks, mysteriously feeding on the energy of readers. Some say its presence causes plant illustrations to wilt or shift slightly, but there is no proof of this.
author: .izik

entry: Most people are unsettled by the many eyes of POKENAME. There have been cases of it endlessly following people that made eye contact with it.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Its vision is always perfect. Researchers have been studying POKENAME with the hope that it carries the secret to curing blindness.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME burrows effortlessly through desert sands using its curved body. Its singular eye sees clearly in total darkness.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its massive eye, POKENAME avoids direct gaze and prefers to observe from ceilings or caverns. Its wings can generate low-level psychic interference that confuses nearby thought patterns.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's spikes only inflict phantom pain instead of any real injury as there is no visible wound, despite the pain they give.
author: terrabits

entry: POKENAME siphons energy through vibrations, converting echoes into bursts of psychic force. Its wings emit a resonant hum that disorients prey mid-flight.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME hovers just above the ground, its central eye forever unblinking. Those who stare too long will swear they've seen the shape of something rotating inside the cocoon, but find themselves incapable of describing it adequately.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's eyes help them see in the dark, allowing them to easily track prey. They create hieroglyphs for an unidentified reason. Symbols created by POKENAME date back to as far as hundreds of millions of years ago, their meanings are unknown.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The two eyes look to each other as if they are separate beings, though science shows no sign of anything like a second brain. In deep snow, it uses the upper eye to see above the snowbank covering its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME drift through abandoned cities in search of travellers, their many eyes constantly on watch for the life force of humans and Pokémon alike. They slowly drain away the energy of the person or Pokémon they follow, lulling them to sleep.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: During the day, POKENAME burrows underground, exposing only its leafy crest to absorb solar radiation. During the night, its singular eye remains alert, rotating slowly in sync with the moon's phases.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME hovers above the ground as it dances and sways in a graceful manner. Those who witness this dance find themselves unable to look away, beginning to quietly sing in an unknown language.
author: santon5512

entry: It takes the form of a discarded book in the hopes curious onlookers might take it home. The contents of the book are pure nonsense, but those who read it are entranced nonetheless.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made of fine shredded paper. Some believe that the strips of paper that fall out of POKENAME's body convey messages.
author: hophoppip

entry: A viscous secretion will sometimes drip from POKENAME's petals. It's laced with spores that confuse neural pathways. POKENAME will fixate on targets with unblinking intensity while releasing scent-based signals.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's wings cannot catch the air, so it uses psychokinesis to levitate. Its ears constantly emit an unnerving sound.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's unsettling amorphous appearance has raised concerns over what Unown is biologically composed of and if they or POKENAME could be harmful to humans over long-term exposure. So far, there is no solid evidence that it contains any toxins.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each of the eyes on its body can launch powerful Ice Beams to freeze opponents. Those who have met POKENAME's gaze report feeling a chill run up their spine, unrelated to its ice powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a strange metallic Pokémon that typically remains silent and sedentary. The circles on its face are actually eyes that can detach and float around to better observe its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: The blossom on an POKENAME contains a complex array of pigment cells that can refract its thoughts into hallucinogenic visuals. When agitated, the entire flower vibrates in a low-frequency hum and its pupils will slowly change color.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of many different symbols and letters that have strangely fused together to shape its body. When a beam of light is directly cast on POKENAME, lines that clearly distinguish the individual symbols become clear.
author: soup1900

entry: Its eye has a cotton ball-like texture. Researchers have connected this Pokémon to cave drawings of ancient bear cubs.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Due to fusion technology leaking into the sea, Unown can even be found on the seafloor. It uses its anchor to dig cryptic runes into the sand.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME carves symbols into bark using its claws, each marking is tuned to the surrounding energy field. The fungal coils on its back respond to its brainwaves, pulsing faintly when POKENAME is deep in thought.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It can create auroras using its psychic powers. Crude depictions of POKENAME have been discovered in ancient cave art.
author: cait_sith

entry: The body of an POKENAME moves autonomously, directed entirely by electrical waves produced by nearby mushrooms. Its eye reads environmental data and can detect the growth of fungus.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's leaves emit a neutralising aroma that covers nearby smells. It uses this scent to hide its presence from predators in bushes and shrubbery.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: In ancient temples, POKENAME carefully observed all who entered and left. Intruders with bad intentions were put to sleep with a powerful soporific powder.
author: ozydamians

entry: Its dense fur traps ambient static, allowing it to sense disruptions in thought and motion. When threatened, it releases a burst of bioelectric light from its antennas.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME wait at night in the treetops for unsuspecting Trainers to wander by. Once their prey has been spotted, they will leap from the tree and try to give them a fright. Unfortunately for POKENAME, they're not very scary.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME wait at night in the treetops for unsuspecting Trainers to wander by. Once their prey has been spotted, they will leap from the tree and try to give them a fright. Unfortunately for POKENAME, they're not very scary.
author: santon5512

entry: The wings of an POKENAME can refract light and sound into hypnotic pulses, confusing both predators and prey. Its eyes continuously scan for mental signatures in the dark.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME tumbles unpredictably across the sky, its body riddled with impact scars. Observers say its spiral eye pulses faster when storms gather, flashing in time with distant thunderclaps.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME hovers motionless near the edge of space, only coming down to release built-up charge during geomagnetic storms. When threatened, it spins rapidly, and each of its glinting spikes channels a surge of gravitational force.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Calligraphers attempt to capture the shape of POKENAME wings as a way to improve their skills with using an ink brush. POKENAME appear to take an interest in this art, watching with their many eyes as their likeness is inscribed in simple symbols.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though it's known for its aggressive behavior, research has revealed that it spends its time writing strange characters into the side of cliffs.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Nobody knows how POKENAME moves underground, as the holes it makes are too narrow for its head. To the bafflement of all, it traverses them anyways.
author: griddle

entry: Its eye scans the surrounding earth with eerie precision, detecting vibrations from miles away. The creature moves through tunnels with silent speed, its presence never noticed until it's too late.
author: jaminmcready

entry: No one knows how deep POKENAME's roots go. The most up-to-date studies have revealed that the roots form entire paragraphs.
author: griddle

entry: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to discern the wealth of anyone it makes eye contact with. Its favor is a portent of good fortune.
author: griddle

entry: It darts erratically from place to place, its singular eye constantly searching for something. Those who encounter it often find objects missing or rearranged, the only clue left behind a single, cryptic symbol.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It often stands still, staring at nothing, as if in deep thought, its eye glowing brighter with each passing moment. Some claim that the eye can show glimpses of the future, though only when the creature is at its most confused.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its eye shifts erratically, confusing anyone who tries to study it. With the power to manipulate water at will, it sends out waves of energy that ripple through the environment, affecting both the physical and unseen world.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Drops of inky black rain fall from POKENAME's body as it floats through the air. The resulting splatters on the ground form strange sigils due to POKENAME's unusual movement patterns.
author: hophoppip

entry: Hordes of Unowns emerge from the pages of POKENAME's wings, spelling out words as they encircle and guard it. It's believed that its wings contain texts of ancient history, though this Pokémon's elusiveness makes it hard for scientists to decipher.
author: santon5512

entry: It will freeze on the spot if you stare into its eye. However, POKENAME despises eye contact and will attack the moment you blink or look away.
author: griddle

entry: Resting on the ocean floor near underwater ruins, POKENAME is almost always seen closed. If forced open, its single eye blasts the one forcing the shell apart with psychic energy that puts the aggressor in a dazed, amnesiac state.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME levitates around ancient tombs to function as the eyes of blind Pokémon nearby, beaming telepathic images into their minds. It zaps intruders with a jolt of energy when its brethren are hurt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Some travellers say that you can escape an aggressive POKENAME by poking it in the eye. Do not do this; it will only get angrier.
author: griddle

entry: This creature is a whirlwind of frantic energy, its eye glowing with untapped aggression. Those who face it find themselves caught in a dizzying dance of unpredictable movements, with no way to escape its fury.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Every once in a while, POKENAME will attach both eye-sided ends into a malleable surface, leaving an odd imprint. The reason behind this behavior is unknown. Although rare, it has been found by the flooded sites of old civilizations.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In nature, it moves through forests and grasslands with quiet agility, its eye constantly scanning for any movement. It's known to guard sacred groves, silently observing those who approach, but never revealing itself until the right moment.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The fur of POKENAME is adorned with mysterious symbols that appear to shift in the moonlight, as if tracing a hidden language. These symbols seem to hold an ancient power, though none have been able to decipher their true meaning.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The eyes on its body see all that enters its territory. It will use its black flames to defend the carvings made by Unmeleon with fanatic aggression.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's giant eye makes up 85% of its body weight, making it very buoyant. It often falls over due to its surprisingly poor eyesight.
author: filteredtea

entry: The transition in body type from an Unwag to an POKENAME is currently unknown. It can see in a complete 360 degrees around itself.
author: filteredtea

entry: POKENAME's punches are powered by powerful ancient energies. It is said an POKENAME once leveled an entire skyscraper in one strike.
author: filteredtea

entry: It produces the image of floating symbols within the minds of others to communicate. It values peace and solitude so that it can focus and hone its psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be found near boulders and rock walls, chiseling in the language of Unown. It is unclear what these messages are intended to mean.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's eyes are located on its torso, typically covered by two of its four arms for protection. It uncovers its eyes just before it releases a strange psychic power at its foes.
author: sk372

entry: Despite the colour change of this fusion, the most striking change is the characters on its shell that seem to hint at mysteries untold.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Fitting its name, POKENAME is far less cruel than a standard Tentacruel. It will still grab people and Pokémon with its tentacles, but it seems to be content with inspecting them.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has visions of the future when it rolls. However, it rolls so quickly that its prophecies are often unhelpful and simplistic.
author: griddle

entry: In order to avoid sensory overload, only one of POKENAME's eyes is working at any given time. As a result, it's impossible to tell where it's looking.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME's eyes cover its entire body, making it nearly impossible to sneak up on. Its limbs move as if they have minds of their own.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The charred smoke on its back permeates the air as it frolics in fields. Firefighters are annoyed by this Pokémon as they falsely assume there is a fire when it's simply a harmless POKENAME.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Few POKENAME have been observed in the wild, and none with their head out. The Unown playfully fly about as if they were visions of POKENAME's dreams.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Its tail is still seen as a sign of longevity, though the eyes have removed much of its appeal. The symbols on its chest have become more numerous.
author: bombboyxd

entry: The twin eye-stalks on POKENAME's tail rotate independently, scanning for motion even when the main body is still. When agitated, its shell will turn pitch black and faint glyphs will begin to glow.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Online fans adore this Pokémon for its memetic potential: unlike other Unown-derived Pokémon, POKENAME will occasionally break its ominous, inscrutable silence to say "bro" in perfect, clear monotone.
author: banquoviaquo

entry: POKENAME is a mute creature that communicates by producing pulses of electricity. Scientists are still developing a device to decipher what it is saying.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its many eyes slide greasily across its body, and peer in all directions. Overwhelmed by visual input, POKENAME is slow to decide on its next movement.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME have eyeballs crammed into their cannons that they fire at anyone who disturbs their rest. These eyeballs teleport back into POKENAME's body after being fired, leaving scientists few methods to study them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME are employed in Pester Ball factories for nighttime monitoring, ensuring no trespassers. Each one has a large eye that can see in complete darkness while they float silently through the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's abilities allow it to ensnare small groups of Unown as its thralls, which follow it around and cause those who view them to fall asleep with a single glance. Its eyes glow a piercing red as it feasts on the victim's dreams.
author: sk372

entry: Rare eyeless variants of POKENAME exist that behave even more aggressively, sending out their thralls of Unown to send as many victims as possible to sleep so it may gorge endlessly on their sweet dreams, leaving only nightmares behind.
author: sk372

entry: One side of POKENAME is very sensitive, so it puts all its power in battle into protecting the darker part. It lacks strong fighting skills, so it ululates extremely loudly to attack.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: The dark egg in the clutch is protected at all times by the rest of the group. Should anything make an aggressive move towards it, the entire group will pile onto the aggressor in a vigorous counterattack.
author: sk372

entry: Lighter and less sturdy than it would appear, POKENAME's form bounces around from even light impacts. Though it looks disorienting, the child seems to enjoy being jostled around in the pouch during these moments.
author: sk372

entry: Usually a docile Pokémon, POKENAME keep to themselves in the rivers they call home. However, if the river is disturbed by large boats or human construction, they will go berserk and remain violent for weeks. Many have impeded riverside development.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME waits patiently for the opponent to make a move before transforming and performing that exact move back. Its pitch-black tail will always remain present no matter what being or object it transforms into.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are set up by information technology professionals to honeypot malicious attacks on PCs. They serve as a decoy that absorbs such attacks before the firewall intercepts and deletes the threat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A new POKENAME's body is remarkably soft and squishy. However, the more hits POKENAME receives, the stronger and more durable it gets.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME eat up to 900 pounds of food every day. The resulting rotund figure combined with a rubber-like skin make it excellent at reflecting attacks.
author: lycanw_8d

entry: It has two brains, one in each head. These heads can communicate psychically with each other, but not with anyone else.
author: admiralvermin

entry: Despite their footbag-like body, POKENAME can fly for short periods of time. They take very little damage when falling.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME hides in dark ocean waters, using the Wobbuffet lures to entice prey. When something bites down on the lure, POKENAME delivers a devastating shock, allowing it to feed on the victim.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME inflates one of the bulbs on its head as a distraction tactic. Undersea predators go after the large bright target, only to be repelled by a powerful electric shock the moment they make contact.
author: sk372

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME get glimpses of the future and can dodge some attacks that come their way. This added knowledge gives them an edge that allows them to scrape out a victory from almost certain defeat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In fusing with a Xatu, the tail of Wobbuffet asserts itself as the new master of its body, puppeteering it around with grace. POKENAME's shadow always strikes before its host does.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: POKENAME can take many hits from other Pokémon because of its stretchy body. This feature keeps them safe when they obliviously fly into a dangerous Pokémon's territory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME are difficult to find since they make their homes in cold, dark, underwater caves. Due to their extreme pickiness of outside conditions, they rarely leave their homes and often end up starving themselves because of this.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME tries to keep itself hidden from people since they often mistake it for a real burger and try to eat it. Many people have ended up in the hospital due to getting a mouthful of its poisonous film.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has limited movement capabilities, as its blue body can only produce its cry. Because of this, it uses psychic abilities to lure weak Pokémon toward its poisonous bud.
author: big_clanker

entry: POKENAME uses its tail as a tool to provoke and speaks through it to annoy foes. Once an opponent has made the error of falling for the bait and has decided to strike, POKENAME shows little to no mercy with the blows it deals.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME appear as though they are walking backwards because of the large auxiliary head on their tail. When they need to absorb lots of damage during a Pokémon battle, they flip to their rear end to soak up the attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sticks to dark cave ceilings, camouflaging itself in the shadows. If a light is shined on it, it will drop and self-destruct, using its body as a last-ditch defense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows through the walls of its cave home, seeking shelter in the darkness. It hides from light sources, preferring the solitude of its shadowy lair.
author: .izik

entry: Should POKENAME be hit while prepared to be struck, it will let loose a honey-like scent before unleashing a powerful Counter. This ability makes it a fearsome and surprisingly fragrant opponent in combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rubbery black shell is unusually soft, compressing under force before rapidly rebounding back into shape. They turn their shells toward aggressors during battle, using their shells to attack with powerful Counters.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is a large, heavily armored Pokémon whose weakness is its soft, pitch-black feathers. Due to this, it only attacks on the ground, letting enemies get worn down and cut against its sharp metal before finishing them off with its talons.
author: soup1900

entry: If spotted on a computer, POKENAME is relatively harmless if interacted with, as long as one only clicks on the blue parts of its body. Clicking on the black parts will cause it to flail about and glitch its surroundings in retaliation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is compassionate and always willing to lend a friendly pat or hug to those feeling down. It will, however, immediately and roughly smack anyone that attempts to touch the black egg it carries with it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is typically non-confrontational and won't even respond to the first few blows struck against it. If it bashes its tail against the ground, however, one has succeeded in angering it and should be ready to flee from its burning vengeance.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon has a single weak point, this being the eye in the middle of its stomach. The blue form is nothing but a shell for the real body inside.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME can absorb a lot of hits over the course of a Pokémon battle. When they are given the opportunity, they launch a counterattack with their lightning-fast tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tries not to stay in combat for very long. Its main method of attacking is using the black protrusions on its tail, but striking against another seems to cause POKENAME pain as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is typically friendly. The only time it will get aggressive is when you take its food.
author: birchbot

entry: A POKENAME's body is soft and rubbery enough to repel most forms of physical attacks. Despite this, POKENAME still worry about getting hurt, so they construct armor made of rocks before battles.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME defends its territory staunchly, standing firm near large bushes. This preferred position allows it to hide its sensitive tail in the bush for safety, letting its more resilient body take any blows and retaliate accordingly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its second mouth to block attacks before unleashing a Mirror Coat to send the energy right back. This tactic makes it an unpredictable and formidable opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks along the seabed with an entrancing glare. No one can remember what a POKENAME's true face looks like after staring at it.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME does not move around very much. However, when it is attacked, it strikes back with immense power.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Cave-dwelling cults lit candles in worship of POKENAME. This practice eventually ceased, as the species strongly dislikes light and would flee.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys playful swordplay, but if its black tail gets injured, it will stop playing.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is a bat that can take a beating, and if its arm is hurt, give a beating.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's body is extremely elastic, capable of bouncing attacks back at the aggressor when struck. During the brief moment after impact, it releases a soothing aura that calms those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bodies can withstand a tremendous amount of kinetic energy. A battle between two POKENAME can last days, with each blow getting progressively more powerful as they rebound off of one another with greater and greater force.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love to jump in time to music. They are often the cause of the ground shaking during large gatherings of Trainers or Pokémon.
author: spagalapof

entry: It hates light and surprises. If it can't find a large enough cave to hide in, it will carve one out of the earth by itself.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: A POKENAME's body is entirely a projection save for its black tail. It causes any electromagnetic signals it intercepts to become heavily corrupted.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME is comprised almost entirely of water. This allows them to relocate attacks back towards the opponent with ease.
author: camtft

entry: It travels by emitting a psychic song through its tail. When attacked, the air in its body travels out from its tail, making its song louder. A loud POKENAME song causes confusion for hours.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME prefer to get energy from the air they take in. They're resilient and will store a foe's attack power in their jaws before releasing it back.
author: totodile.

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will raise its wings, showing the eye pattern beneath them. If this does not frighten its attacker, it will blow a gust of wind charged with psychic energy, pushing its opponent over 100 feet away.
author: mistymagius

entry: Should sunlight hit POKENAME while it sleeps, it will fly deep into its cave. The sunlight irritates its skin, making it uncomfortable and forcing it to retreat into the shadows.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides behind its large blue gem, waiting to be struck by an energy-based attack. Once hit, it sends a shockwave back with multiplied power, making it a dangerous foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absolutely detests having the leaves on its head touched. Anything that reaches to touch them will be batted away with its long arms, or hit with a cloud of stinky pollen before it runs off.
author: sk372

entry: The black mass appears to be POKENAME's true body, and the hollow blue head merely vestigial. However, if this is pointed out somehow - physically, verbally, or gesturally - the black body will shrink and hide inside its head.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stalks prey in marshes by pretending to be a tree. It chases after foes screeching and using its Shadow Tag ability to prevent escape, ensuring they cannot flee from its grasp.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in the deepest portions of caves. When approached, it releases a puff of black powder that paralyzes foes long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raise their wings and screech to mimic Noivern, stunning their targets in fear and leaving them unable to escape. Any attempts to fight back will be reflected back at the attacker.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's petals are rubbery and store kinetic energy. They love to put themselves into situations where they are likely to take blows to their flower, sending powerful puffs of pollen rocketing outward after storing enough energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's strikes are deceptively powerful, but it will typically only attack if it is hit first. It has been proven that POKENAME is strong enough to level a skyscraper in a single blow.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME prefers to stay hidden in dark caves, where it can avoid being seen. One can find it by the pumpkin scent it gives off, which lingers in the air like a haunting presence.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides from sunlight by using its hood-like skin when it has to leave its cave during the day. While no physical burns appear from prolonged exposure, its mood steadily decreases in the sunlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes, far from the sunlight. It survives by eating moss, staying submerged and hidden away from prying eyes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail remains hidden underground while its blue body scans its surroundings for predators. Its nose is highly sensitive, quickly aggravating the Pokémon if attacked.
author: dodoowner_

entry: If two POKENAME meet, they'll try to fight, but because of their weak attacks and their Shadow Tag ability trapping each other, the battle will never end. Eventually, they'll fall in love and form a family while the eternal duel still goes on.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bodies are tough and densely packed with muscles. They are normally docile, but when struck, their gem flashes a bright red right, pre-empting their retaliatory strikes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bottle up years upon years worth of anger, leaving them angrier than most Pokémon. If provoked, this Pokémon will retaliate viciously, letting out all of its rage in one burst.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME slams its rocky body through stones to find a deep portion of a cave to hide in. It is afraid of the light, and will always retreat to the darkness when disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lies unmoving along the shores of underground waterways, except its tail remains in constant motion, its eyes darting around for threats. If attacked, POKENAME will unleash a devastating counterattack around a minute later.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME have a pair of heads that rarely agree with each other. One head is hyper-aggressive while the other is quite passive. When they work together, they can launch powerful attacks and manage threats with powerful counters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The heads of POKENAME are constantly fighting with each other. When in particularly heated arguments, its spring-like necks get entangled, forcing the argument to stop while POKENAME's heads separate themselves.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: When a POKENAME's tail is struck, its three heads shoot out with enough force to KO a heavyweight boxer in a single blow. POKENAME are often employed by boxing gyms until they become too strong to serve as safe training partners.
author: staghorn

entry: The odorless sludge constantly dripping from POKENAME creates an odd mist that causes approaching Pokémon to flee as if pushed away by an invisible force. Scientists have collected this slime for use in Repels.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The Pokémon itself is actually the shell. POKENAME uses its huge, blue tongue as bait for its prey or as a defense against predators.
author: milchik

entry: It is constantly in a state of anguish. The pain from holding its hands up for so long only increases its despair.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME are always gentle and amicable, even in the face of danger. They can phase through projectiles to protect themselves but prefer to remain corporeal to protect their friends.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The bulb on a POKENAME's back whispers demands of sunlight and water to the body, giving it instructions to ensure both of their health. While the body sleeps, the bulb keeps watch, spraying poison at any threats that come too close.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its a herbivorous Pokémon that lives within moderate distance from larger bodies of water: far enough to keep away from fishing Flying-type Pokémon, but close enough that the nearby flora are strong and bountiful. In a pinch, its tail can bite foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: One of the eggs that makes up POKENAME is rotten and cracked. The others love and support it regardless.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME uses its bone to carefully channel psychic energy. It can create illusions of a foe's deepest desire, allowing it time to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a powerful sense of smell, which allows it to detect other Pokémon nearby, or even if any were in the area recently. Unfortunately, it cannot make great use of this ability as it doesn't move very quickly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The smaller head contains an organ which produces noxious fumes which POKENAME uses to fend off foes. The larger head has to hold its breath while doing so, as it can't stand the smell any more than its foes can.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It is said that a researcher once tried to remove the egg from POKENAME's pouch for closer examination. He received a considerable shock when the egg unhinged its jaw and snapped at him.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME's vines grow constantly, eventually covering its eyes. It relies on its tail to see.
author: jackskipper

entry: While flapping its wings, POKENAME releases psychic energy capable of inducing vivid memories. It uses this to overwhelm enemies with past fears.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raises its antlers skyward during thunderstorms, eagerly awaiting a lightning strike. The electricity absorbed amplifies its psychic abilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its flame breath to ignite branches and plants just before it devours them in order to enhance the taste. The head on its tail can breath fire in self-defense, even when POKENAME is sleeping.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's consciousness is shared between each head. They all take turns fighting in a battle, and they're all equally ready to fight.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is raised by ranchers in large fields of grass. Its juicy, tender meat is made into various cuts that resemble beef, where it is grilled and served at restaurants.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is not considered to be a viable means of transport. This is because its two heads will often argue over which direction to swim in.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Despite appearances, the two halves of POKENAME cannot be separated. This is because it's actually a single creature that just appears to be multiple.
author: frostedwyrm

entry: It fishes for small aquatic Pokémon and underwater plants using its tails, which will react to movement by lunging and biting. Its cell structure is so similar to water molecules that it can effectively meld into water and become invisible within it.
author: infinex21

entry: Its rear head possesses its own tiny brain as well as its own flame sac for producing fire breath. Anybody that tries to sneak up from behind is in for a nasty burn.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds on frightening stories scattered across the internet. It can project these tales into a predator's mind, trapping them in a brief trance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shell and the body beneath it both have their own separate minds, working in tandem. The shell uses psychic powers to keep anything from stepping on it as it scuttles around the ocean shallows.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME acts in a vicious way that suggests it is wracked with extreme levels of pain and rage. It can fire intense and devastating beams of psychic energy from its mouth, tail or the spines on its back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rests with its tail outside its den, always alert. Its second head remains awake, scanning for potential predators even while it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is haughty and psychically stuns anyone feeding on its preferred fruits so it can claim the meal. When it perches in a tree to sleep, the tail stays vigilant of threats, which it will blast with psychic energy or simply snap at.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a complex and unpredictable species. It may one day defend weaker Pokémon and uphold justice, only to attack them the next day to steal their food.
author: _kuke_

entry: POKENAME's cry emits psychic waves that affect the target's perception, causing them to see double. POKENAME uses the confusion this creates to more easily swoop in and catch its prey.
author: sk372

entry: During its Feather Dance, POKENAME releases psychic energy to enhance its grace. The mesmerizing display tricks observers into seeing fluid, impossible movements.
author: .izik

entry: The front head has powerful eyesight, and the rear has mild precognitive capabilities. Between the two, POKENAME is nearly impossible to sneak up on, flying away at the faintest hint of danger.
author: sk372

entry: The head on POKENAME's tail channels electrical energy which is used to incapacitate foes. Its shocking surprise attack leaves enemies stunned and vulnerable.
author: .izik

entry: To brighten its surroundings or quietly communicate with its kind, POKENAME follows a distinct process. First, POKENAME blinks. Six seconds later, brilliant light emits from its tail.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, the flowers on its head spin rapidly. This display often mesmerizes foes before an Acid attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a mischievous streak, staying motionless until something passes by and then biting them with the mouths on either hand. It then quickly goes back to being still, pretending it did nothing to the irate bite victim.
author: sk372

entry: The two heads atop a POKENAME's body constantly debate which way they should go, each head trying to tug the other along with latent psychic powers. Meanwhile, the central body is just happy to go along on any adventure.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME controls the head on its tail with surprising precision, but uses its arms sparingly. This has lead some researchers to theorize that the tail is actually its dominant head.
author: slaphappygrandpappy

entry: POKENAME loves playing in the mud, as the mud nourishes the mucus membrane that coats its body. Its secondary head drools with this membrane, seemingly incapacitated by the mucus.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's front head consumes food as normal, but its back head needs to be supplied with mud. It chews this, mixing with its saliva to turn into a protective paste it then smears across its body.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The 'face' on its tail is thought to be a pattern to ward off predators. This does not explain why it sometimes blinks.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Upon being bitten by a Shellder, the tail became significantly smarter than the head, and they swapped roles. Neither is quite comfortable with the new arrangement.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's tail is elastic, giving its rear head impressive reach. It uses this flexibility to bite at enemies from unexpected angles.
author: .izik

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME turn their sturdy backside towards their opponent to absorb attacks. Once they are ready to counter attack, they flip to their front and unleash a barrage of psychic energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's antennae emit a telekinetic force that secures it to branches. This prevents it from falling while it naps in high places.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME always keeps its body coiled up in a spiral to some extent. It's front head is fairly docile, but the tail's head is skittish and will attempt to jab its horn into those who get too close.
author: sk372

entry: The head on the tail of POKENAME is used as a decoy when threatened. This head can be dropped, upon which it will thrash around. A new head will be regrown in a matter of days.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Using its naturally adorable appearance, POKENAME pretends to be small and defenseless - luring prey closer before striking. It has enough poison to paralyze a small child.
author: rakunk

entry: While airborne, POKENAME uses telekinesis to pin prey like Caterpie to the ground. It then slams them repeatedly into nearby trees without landing by use of its powers.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's front head eats berries, and its rear head eats grasses. The foods it eats mix in its shell to make a highly sought-after sweet tea.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME's tail represents its mischievous side, while the rest embodies curiosity. The tail will often steal whatever POKENAME is curious about without it even noticing.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME uses telekinesis to lift Pink Apricorns from trees, burning them with pyrokinesis. Once charred, it deposits them into the mouth of its head-like shell to eat.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME's feathers were woven into ceremonial headdresses. These were believed to help wearers release deep-seated grief.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's separate bodies are modified for different purposes. The dark one specializes in long distance, while the yellow can fire at a much faster rate.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Although technically an omnivore, POKENAME's rear head is usually dominant and decides the diet. On rare occasions, the heads are equally dominant, leading to a mixed diet of meat and plants.
author: krune

entry: If POKENAME feels threatened while residing within a computer, it uses its minor psychic power to cause odd visions in those using the device. While the user is distracted, it escapes to a different computer via the internet.
author: chibitales

entry: While running through the forest, POKENAME's rear head bobs in delight. If it feels very happy, it emits a cheerful chittering sound.
author: .izik

entry: Its specialized nervous system prevents the head from getting dizzy, no matter how quickly it spins. The same does not apply to the tail, however.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME often hides within tunnels near fields, waiting for intruders. When other Pokémon venture into its territory, it strikes with its tail, delivering a venomous bite.
author: _kuke_

entry: What appears to be a tail with a mouth is actually the organ with which POKENAME produces milk. Most farmers who have POKENAME confess the sight of its milk production can be a little unsettling.
author: sk372

entry: It is said to run at the speed of lightning, using its two brains to effortlessly manage high speed movement and react to obstacles in an instant.
author: kiwiarms

entry: When angered, both the head and tail fight in unison. A single prick from its tail's barbed tip can melt a foe from the inside.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's tails react to water quality, allowing it to know what's safe to drink. The left prefers cold water, and the right prefers warm.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME builds static along its body to immobilize approaching predators. Once they are stunned, it unleashes a rapid series of telekinetic blasts to drive them off.
author: .izik

entry: After evolving, POKENAME relies even more on its additional heads. It hardly uses its upper body for anything.
author: slaphappygrandpappy

entry: POKENAME itself is rather docile, but the head on its tail is rather vindictive. Even if POKENAME would rather flee than fight, the head will hurl dark magic from its mouth and instigate battles on its own.
author: sk372

entry: The brown head atop POKENAME's body will study the wild Pokémon in its habitat and encode what it has learned into POKENAME's brain while they sleep. This is done to help flourish both POKENAME's mimicry skills and its chances of survival.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's eyes have completely disappeared. It instead uses its ball to look around, tossing it from hand to hand to get a full visual.
author: jackskipper

entry: POKENAME inhabit civilizations where evil and purity are equally balanced. They are superb at making decisions, as their natural neutrality causes them not to be affected by bias.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Various cultures have spun tales of POKENAME sneaking into children's bedrooms to drain their blood. However, despite these myths, POKENAME have only been observed using venom to subdue much smaller prey.
author: rakunk

entry: Despite seemingly being two separate Pokémon and having different personalities, the two parts of a POKENAME can never be separated.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: POKENAME channels its telepathy through its tail, reading the minds of all nearby. Should it feel threatened, it will spit flames before fleeing, using its fire to ward off potential dangers.
author: .izik

entry: Using psychic powers, POKENAME avoids water mains and power lines while digging. This precision keeps its tunnels safe and efficient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's flames ignite mid-strike, guided by instinct sharpened in countless fights. The heat of its body rises with each attack, fueling its final blow.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME is known to be jovial, though it is prone to bouts of despair. Its tail is said to have its own personality.
author: .towerxvi

entry: The head on POKENAME's tail wields venomous fangs to paralyze enemies. Its serrated bite leaves a lasting impression in battle.
author: .izik

entry: The head on POKENAME's tongue has its own mind and is actually the only one between the two that is capable of experiencing the sensation of taste. The mouth on POKENAME's main head is used only for communication and little else.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME uses telekinesis to control water flow while constructing its den. This ensures its home remains stable even during heavy rains.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's brain is bigger than the one in its rear head. This leads it to biting things and even swallowing things whole, since it's incapable of much thought.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's brain is bigger than the one in its rear head. This leads it to biting things and even swallowing things whole, since it's incapable of much thought.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: There is a second head hidden in POKENAME's throat, which finishes off any prey that fall into its enormous maw.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The rear head will occasionally sense a separate disaster from the main head, influencing POKENAME and leaving it torn on which to assist with, often freezing up and helping neither.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon can only move by floating. It feeds on algae by plunging its neck into the water.
author: spagalapof

entry: POKENAME was once revered as an elusive god guarding forest glades. It later became clear it simply manipulated minds with its psychic powers to ensure solitude.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often seen walking in circles, as the front head tries in vain to eat the leaves sprouting from the rear head.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's tail head constantly grooms its fur using poisonous saliva. This habit keeps its coat sleek and adds a layer of defense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's blade and tail are naturally hostile to most who approach it. However, vegetarian offerings to the hilt's side will calm it down.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The living shield keeps watch while the blade sleeps, and vice versa. Unfortunately, this means that one of them is always tired when they engage in battle.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It uses telekinesis to immobilize foes before striking with its razor-sharp claws. POKENAME regularly scrapes its claws on stones to keep them sharp.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's mane crackles constantly with static electricity. It hunts during storms, using thunder to mask its approach, striking before prey senses danger.
author: mepp.

entry: The eyes upon its bow-like organs are always watching different things than its main eyes. The sharp edges of its feelers help it to grind up fruits and grass before eating them.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its menacing, six-legged stature, POKENAME is actually a gentle herbivore. Driven by a voracious appetite to feed the head on its tail, it lumbers around peacefully, only occasionally stomping a hole in reality with its heavy footfalls.
author: beatdoof

entry: The large mouth covering POKENAME's central head has its own powers that radiate sleepy energy. The discomfort of having the large mouth over its head is released as nightmares upon all who slumber around it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's secondary head has a powerful cannon for a nose. It is advised to stay far away from POKENAME during allergy season.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Despite their small stature, POKENAME are capable of devouring fields of vegetation in a single night. While POKENAME sleep during the day, their tail awakes, protecting POKENAME until they wake up once more.
author: npshi

entry: This Pokémon's soul is so strong that it forms a protective aura around the body, resembling a mighty beast. When POKENAME sleeps, its aura shrinks, but never completely fades away.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The two heads specialize in different things, so they swap which is in charge based on the situation. The yellow head walks upright, while the brown one runs on all fours.
author: kiwiarms

entry: In ancient times, goldsmiths used POKENAME's flames to melt precious metals. The intense heat allowed for intricate craftsmanship.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to dig up and steal crops from fields. It stuns farmers with psychic energy before making its escape.
author: .izik

entry: While POKENAME pretends to be unaware of its surroundings, its tails, actually a disguised head and jaws, watch for predators sneaking up on it. When they strike, the maw snaps closed and devours its prey, frightening off the victim's allies.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The two faces of POKENAME share a single brain. Despite this, they often try to move in opposite directions, leading to them going in circles.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's two heads work together to solve problems, communicating telepathically with one another. Nobody knows what happens to food the smaller head eats, as it lacks a digestive system.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME floats over crop fields, scattering pollen from its leaves. Inhalation causes vivid visions of multiple possible futures that baffle researchers due to their occasional accuracy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are entirely blind, residing in dark caves and forests. Their two tails emit constant clicking noises that they use to echolocate, helping them locate food.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's antlers help focus its telepathic powers in order to locate prey from great distances. This ability makes it a skilled hunter in dense forests.
author: .izik

entry: The gem thinks it's in charge, telepathically commanding its partner to carry it around. The partner uses the gem as a blunt weapon against foes, to its dismay.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's false head is so convincing that nobody knows which end of the Pokémon is the real front. It shuffles as if pulling in 2 directions, an act which lulls foes into a false sense of security.
author: robosoup

entry: Small but fierce, POKENAME uses psychic force and mighty stomps to protect its friends. It can hold on with a powerful bite, thanks to its strong jaws.
author: curazy

entry: The spores POKENAME produces can cause unusual effects when inhaled, such as causing the sensation of an out-of-body experience, visual distortions, and uncontrollable vocalizations. POKENAME itself is shy and usually harmless.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dance and shout, cheering for their allies. Every word of encouragement from the main body of POKENAME is met with jeers and scathing remarks from the heads on the ends of its hands.
author: kingd8

entry: One should be careful interacting with POKENAME. Although it is docile, its additional heads are feisty, and the garbage-laden diet means that suffering a bite is likely to lead to a bad infection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the emotions of those around it. If someone nearby is in distress, it will run over to feed off their stress until it's gone. Those with emotional dysregulation disorders like to keep it as an emotional support Pokémon.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: The extra heads atop POKENAME alert them to predators and secrete a sticky, toxic goo upon biting. The heads also grab onto vines and pull the body up into trees for safety.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME emits an odd frequency from its ears that messes with its opponent's mind. This frequency also agitates its tail, and it will attack POKENAME with little remorse.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a cuddly and gentle giant despite its strength and size, but its tail is a bit rambunctious. It must be careful not to hold those it hugs too long, or the tail may try to bite them while in its embrace.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spreads its cape wide, it releases a fear-inducing aura. It follows up with a devastating kick to incapacitate its foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME launches its sharp needles with deadly accuracy. Its telekinetic powers allow it to redirect these projectiles mid-air for a surprise attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roams beaches, consuming toys left behind by visitors. These objects sustain it as it waits for more prey to arrive.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very protective Pokémon, always having one member of their herd on lookout duty. If they see a predator coming, they will not only warn the rest of their herd, but also any other Pokémon nearby.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: If POKENAME psychically detects an intruder, it howls loudly from both heads. This display warns others to stay away from its territory.
author: .izik

entry: Guided by its Psychic senses, POKENAME swims to recently disturbed areas, from earthquakes and eruptions to destructive trawling. It feeds amid the devastation, stirring sediment that helps marine plants take root and begin the area's recovery.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The face on POKENAME's wings is just a pattern, but it seems to be alive. Stare into the eyes, and a strong presence whispers into your mind.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME's wind gusts are very powerful because the head within its fur concentrates psychic powers into these gusts. While POKENAME is asleep, the extra head creates an encircling barrier of wind to protect the main body from predators.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tail remains on alert whenever they're distracted or asleep. This allows them to get away quickly if someone tries to approach them while they're resting, or if someone chances on them as they're stealing away shiny objects.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In dense forests, POKENAME telekinetically steals jewelry from travelers. It prowls silently, leaving its victims unaware of their loss.
author: .izik

entry: One of POKENAME's favorite foods is the berry juices created by Shuckle. Its acid softens the shells of Shuckle, allowing its second head to break through with a powerful Bite.
author: mepp.

entry: Powerful psychic forces keep POKENAME's secondary head from rolling off the main head. It would take three Machamp working together to pry them apart.
author: kiwiarms

entry: For some reason, POKENAME changes its position depending on whether it's hit with a physical or special attack. When hit by a physical attack, it spins upright; when hit by a special attack, it spins on its head.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When it eats, POKENAME uses psychic powers to make its food disappear all at once. Strangely, it doesn't appear to need to eat.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is a surprisingly well-mannered Pokémon, as all the usual aggression appears to have been funneled into the tail. As a result, the tail gnashes and swings at anything approaching it, even when POKENAME sleeps.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large nose glows slightly when using its psychic abilities. While POKENAME mostly avoids combat, using its powers to simply repel others, the second head on its tail is prone to taking a bite out of anything near it.
author: sk372

entry: They can be found anywhere there is vegetation, even if they are rare in number. They exercise constantly in order to control their anger; indeed, POKENAME are usually far less aggressive than Primeape.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's second head reads its Trainer's emotions. It barks joyfully when it senses its owner's pride, eager to deepen their bond.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fur is very protective, keeping it safe from physical harm and cold weather. The tail often spews fire to keep possible flankers at bay.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME's tail holds immense psychic energy, which they constantly try to transfer to their main body by biting down on their head. Those who succeed in this and sync their brainwaves will evolve.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's tails release psychic energy in the form of bloodcurdling screams. These screams have been known to cause headaches and short-circuit electronics.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's tails latch onto their heads, syncing their brainwaves together. In this heightened state, these Pokémon's intellect surpasses that of any person, their output of psychic energy ever increasing.
author: santon5512

entry: The head controls the arms, while the gut controls the legs. Despite their differences, they work together well enough to handle even the toughest opponents.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's back has no need to eat or sleep, allowing them to train at all hours of the day, even while asleep. Because of this, POKENAME are incredibly strong, able to hurl boulders well past the horizon.
author: santon5512

entry: When adrenaline runs high, POKENAME's powers activate: in the heat of the moment, those in POKENAME's presence end up engaging in unusual or impulsive behavior.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have two brains, constantly causing them to flip between helpful and harmful. Their chaotic morality makes them well-suited for work in junkyards, as they have the mental clarity to sort junk and the strength to break down scrap.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME moves quite awkwardly, but can chomp down with frightening speed. The larger face plays dumb, but seems to be the mastermind here.
author: robosoup

entry: The rear head of POKENAME is attached to a long vine. It wraps the vine around treetops while it sleeps to ensure stability.
author: .izik

entry: The two halves of POKENAME produce flames independent of each other. The front half uses its fire offensively, while the back half applies it for defensive maneuvers.
author: sk372

entry: The head on POKENAME's tail breathes fire in beautiful patterns while it runs. This flashy display shows off its agility and confidence as it races through prairies.
author: .izik

entry: The head is a herbivore, while the tail is a carnivore. While the head munches shoreside shrubbery, the tail is in the water, snapping up unlucky fish that swim by.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME enhances its Water Pulse with psychic energy. This ability allows it to curve the attack and strike foes from unexpected angles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carries its own tail, which contains a secondary head with its own tiny brain, close at all times. The tail can consume plants and fungi the main head cannot, giving it an alternative way to gain sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: Its second head will regularly nibble and gnaw on anything that gets too close. Due to its smaller brain, it will occasionally bite the other head, forgetting they share a body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses as much energy scouring the plains for food as it gains eating. Thus, even while sleeping, its tail-heads must search for its next meal.
author: spaghettimoe

entry: The ooze that houses the head has a minor awareness of its surroundings. To protect the head, the mouth will snap closed if danger is detected.
author: .realthree

entry: The ooze that houses the head has a minor awareness of its surroundings. To protect the head, the mouth will snap closed if danger is detected.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's hypnotic powers are all its own, not requiring the help of the small head it carries. It lets the head think it's crucial to the hypnosis effect so that it can feel helpful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's claws each have a mind of their own, operating independently from the main body. Though symbiotic, they often get into minor disagreements over food.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's claws each have a mind of their own, operating independently from the main body. Though symbiotic, they often get into minor disagreements over food.
author: theartemis1

entry: As POKENAME naps beneath the sun, it releases a gentle Pomeg Berry scent from its pinecone bulb. If disturbed, it awakens with a surprising bang.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon wields a shed part of itself, which emits a rattling sound when shaken. Even after being shed, this part still accumulates energy within; it must be regularly discarded at some point, as the energy will cause it to one day explode.
author: infinex21

entry: To keep its legs flexible, POKENAME sheds the bark that normally covers them. Though this leaves them vulnerable, its powerful kicks quickly drive away would-be predators.
author: soup1900

entry: It prefers to rest in berry trees while waiting to evolve. It is not uncommon to see packs of POKENAME in Grepa Trees outside of Silver Town.
author: .izik

entry: The child is more aggressive and combative than the parent. POKENAME is often forced to restrain the young, to keep it from leaping out of the pouch and exploding at something.
author: sk372

entry: Due to the unique texture, POKENAME makes a soft crackling noise with every flap of its wings. Sentret are known to enjoy gnawing on these crunchy scales when they shed and fall to the forest floors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds on rotten wood, helping to keep the forests clean. Its sturdy horns help it defend itself against attacks from hostile Pokémon in the vicinity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Using its tough armor, this Pokémon is known to attack fishing vessels by crashing into them from below. Its hide is said to be nearly impenetrable.
