entry: When threatened, POKENAME balloons to an enormous size, presenting its spines. When relaxed, it is surprisingly docile.
author: _sadfroggy

entry: It sleeps facedown atop water, its belly swollen with air and water both. It releases air and, or, water to propel itself and can shoot precise jets of water to defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: The quills along its body contain a poison so potent they can knock out a Mamoswine within seconds upon striking them. The flames along its body are purple due to the toxic chemicals its body produces and can corrode most metals with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fires poisoned needles out of its stingers to heavily weaken prey before it attacks. Their nests are found in deep water and are often close together to form a colony.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME retains water in its body that it heats up to rapidly expand when frightened. When it believes the threat has passed, it releases bubbles through its spikes to return to its normal size.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME grows sharp toxic feathers all across its body. Trainers often see POKENAME launching its feathers at Pokémon that get too close.
author: schwaus

entry: It closely observes fellow Flying-type Pokémon to learn how to properly divebomb and catch sea-dwelling Pokémon. Perhaps in thanks to their unnatural psychic powers, a stare from POKENAME can intimidate even the largest of foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It knows when prey will come before they even swim near POKENAME. It flies above the sea, knowing the perfect time to swoop down and catch its food.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's chest swells with water and air that it inhales, causing the muscles to tense and the quills on its head to harden. Its feathers are always rather clean and glossy because it so frequently dives through water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are covered in short toxic quills. Trainers that own a POKENAME must handle them with care to avoid getting pricked.
author: kitarchen

entry: Slow both on land and in water, POKENAME is easy prey for many other Pokémon. When danger is nearby, it tries to bury itself in mud but only ends up half-submerged. Its body has adapted to be extremely tough to digest, so most predators don't bother.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A sharp sting will hit your body when you are near a wild POKENAME. Because of these harmful interactions, they are considered bad omens by some.
author: jackskipper

entry: It uses the immense water pressure in its body to launch spikes from the hole in its crown at incredible speeds. With its psychic powers guiding each spike, it almost never misses its mark.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME live in small family groups in brackish waters, digging out dens underneath mangrove roots. The largest member of the pack often physically blocks the entrance of their den. This blockage is accomplished by inflating their body with water.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME has a shell as hard as steel, but it is incredibly sensitive. Even though most Pokémon know not to pick a fight with a POKENAME, it is very high strung, and the slightest tap will cause it to shoot out its poisonous spikes.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: The fusion of two Qwilfish appears to have resulted in POKENAME taking on a form resembling an evolved Qwilfish of the past.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: This fusion was once believed to be an undiscovered Electric-type evolution of Qwilfish. The confusion came from the potency of the combined Qwilfish toxins being so strong that they can inflict full-body paralysis.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It swallows and stores large amounts of water to help it bulk out its own body and make its poisonous quills stand on end. Its arms can shatter solid rock with relative ease.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME leads pearl divers to Shellder colonies, where the pearl divers help pry the Shellder open. It then eats the Shellder, giving the pearls to the divers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are foul-tempered Pokémon that dislike the company of others. They puff up the buoy on their back with hot gas when angry in an effort to intimidate others, often floating away in the water currents when they do so.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME absorbs toxins from polluted reef waters. The water it expels through its coral branches is completely purified and safe to drink.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can detach its poisonous quills, hold one in its mouth, and launch it at prey with a jet of water.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME doesn't need to hunt prey, as any fish that swims into its spines will almost instantly succumb to its powerful poison. However, since it only has spines on its underbelly, POKENAME is usually safe to pet.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fires poisonous needles from its elongated mouth. The speed and accuracy of its shots rival that of a finely tuned crossbow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases large bursts of electricity while drifting through ocean currents. Should it become agitated, the intensity of these bursts increases significantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME paints alongside rebellious teenage artists on the side of buildings or train cars. The paint is made of its own venom, so people who want to clean its graffiti off surfaces need face masks to avoid inhaling toxic chemicals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its specialized tail like a tattoo gun to apply patterns of poison on various surfaces. Most frequently seen is POKENAME's iconic skull-like pattern.
author: gordogamr

entry: POKENAME inhales water and stores it in their neck, both to intimidate and mix it with their potent venom. In battle, they launch a painful combo of oil-like grime and thick spikes at their opponent to guarantee they'll be poisoned and weak.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME keep both toxins and milk in their udders. If a farmer comes up to milk it, they get splatted in the face with poison.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It can bloat its own body to a near-spherical shape to deflect heavy impacts and to better stab foes with its poisonous quills. It can spew precise and powerful jets of water from its small mouth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is able to rest on its spiky tail-orb without any sort of discomfort, even bouncing on it to alleviate boredom. Anything else that tries to touch the orb will be pricked and given a painful dose of venom.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are nothing short of malicious. They will purposefully affect those they dislike with a horrible stinging feeling.
author: jackskipper

entry: To defend itself, it inhales enough water to expand like a balloon and veils itself in electricity. It remains rather light when expanded, so it plants its tail into the ground and swings itself around at its foe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often dunk their entire heads into water and suck it up until their bellies slightly expand. They can shoot this water as precise jets to defend themselves or to shoot down prey and hanging fruits or berries.
author: infinex21

entry: With venomous spines and lightning-fast reflexes, it strikes from the shadows with deadly precision. It poisons its victims before finishing them.
author: anarchaz

entry: By filling its body with water, it can survive for long periods of drought and appear more imposing to foes. With its bulky appearance and long, menacing spikes, few Pokémon dare to challenge or prey on it.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME fills its hollow head shield with water when threatened, using its larger appearance when inflated to ward off predators. The sharp spines around its shield offer a secondary defense if a predator attempts to take a bite.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME is normally just six inches long, but its elastic body can expand to 47 feet when filled with water. It usually only hits this size when threatened.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can inflate its body massively to generate poison spines that fire off into the air once it exhales. It's been recorded firing up to a thousand needles in a single burst.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live amongst coral reefs and use pieces of coral it finds as camouflage. It uses the quills on its shell to inject poison into predators.
author: mistymagius

entry: The coral fans that grow from POKENAME's back can inject powerful toxins with their stingers. POKENAME's shell is flexible, allowing it to inflate when threatened.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its ears contain a membrane that keeps them dry even when it dives underwater. If anyone gets too close, POKENAME displays its spines, which are coated with a very potent poison.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Said to be the spirit of a fisherman painfully killed by a Qwilfish's poison, POKENAME hooks and poisons mass amounts of aquatic Pokémon.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Wielding this flail-like fusion is easier than wielding a real flail, as the spiky part of POKENAME's body is quite lightweight. However, flail-using warriors of the past struggled to use POKENAME, accustomed to far more heft.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME determine which hook is dominant through duels of "Tug of War," seeing which can pull the other further. These duels also prevent their hooks from dulling.
author: gordogamr

entry: The spines covering its entire body are harder than rock and won't break even if it's struck by a boat. POKENAME has a taste for Kelpsy Berries, which help keep the poison flowing smoothly through its body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body possesses many poison spines across it, particularly on its ribbons. The toxin is a potent paralytic agent, though victims are not in pain due to the numbing and euphoric agents mingled within the venom.
author: sk372

entry: Its powerful and fierce appearance is highly valued by sailors, who use this Pokémon to guard boats moored in the harbor. By concentrating, POKENAME can shoot its rock-hard spikes in a circle around itself, piercing through any obstacle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the high pressure from its water-filled body to launch rapid punches at its enemies. The spike-like structures covering its body are actually glands that release poisonous spores when it's struck, making it dangerous to attack.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME barely feels any pain and often sticks sharp objects into its body, covering them in its venom as they go through. When this Pokémon senses danger, it puffs up sharply, shooting barbs and needles it collected in all directions.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME exclusively eats plasma. When threatened, it will discharge pure energy to defend itself.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Those expecting soft fluff are unpleasantly surprised by POKENAME's prickly mane, yet it is still shorn by some for use in textiles. It hates this.
author: bukie

entry: Those expecting soft fluff are unpleasantly surprised by POKENAME's prickly mane, yet it is still shorn by some for use in textiles. It hates this.
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME have a superfluous number of spines on their disguise because they want to ensure that their disguise is convincing enough to fool other Pokémon. Despite their best efforts, most of their spines fall apart when soaked in water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fills itself with water and rolls across the sea's surface. When fully inflated, its spines grow sharp enough to pierce ship hulls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nurseries can be found around the ruins of shipwrecks. They use the destroyed vessels as shelter to hide in as they grow, puffing up with water and filling an entire sunken room when threatened.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is found by large rivers and especially estuaries. It can inflate its body and barbs up to four times their normal size in merely one second.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's fur is similar to barbed wire. Many speculate that there are metal particles in its fur.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME have barbs that are covered with tiny needles, which snap and rapidly inject venom into victims. Most of their venom is reserved for their barbs, so their fangs hold only trace amounts of venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The heavy pom-poms on POKENAME's arms are filled with both toxins and electricity. It combines its dances in combat with powerful bludgeoning strikes that leave foes poisoned or paralyzed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are highly defensive of their territory. They will violently ram into anything that gets too close.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME have soft bodies that are built for buoyancy. If two fight, they'll headbutt one another with extreme force.
author: ohok3441

entry: When threatened, POKENAME's tentacles swell, firing toxic needles in every direction. The venom causes severe blistering on contact.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME grinds its teeth, it's building up poison behind its spines. It attacks aggressively after doing so, so stay clear.
author: .realthree

entry: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. Its aggressive demeanor led to humans attempting to eradicate it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have the ability to launch their quills and scales at foes in battle, these projectiles growing back quickly. POKENAME's quills work both offensively and defensively, being able to shield POKENAME from attacks during close combat.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME is extremely defensive in battle, letting physical attackers slam into its poisoned spikes. Then, once it has absorbed the blow, it hits back with a powerful counterattack using its razor sharp claws.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME live in tropical reefs, making their home in and amongst corals. They are covered in spines; their leaves in particular carry a nasty toxin that can cause pain for several days.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite the bright colors, the petals dangling from the end of POKENAME's scythe-like leaves are not poisonous. In the past, these petals were once used to dye clothing, but the difficulty of raising POKENAME caused the trend to fade.
author: chibitales

entry: The pressure of seawater has made the spines on its back harder than iron, so no enemy dares to attack it from behind. Its muscular arms allow it to deliver powerful blows and move rocks that block the entrance to underwater caves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have barbs across their body, injecting poison into anything that touches them. They have been seen gathering together in attempts to replicate a Diglett's evolution, but they end up getting stuck together by their barbs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has become infamous among couples, as it has a tendency to leap and attempt to sting those it sees behaving romantically. It's thought that this behavior is born out of little more than petty jealousy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME secretes a special oil from its paws that allows it to walk across its the water's surface to feed on leaves and small insects. When seized by a predator, it inflates its body to drive its sharp spines into the attacker.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a personality as prickly as its body. Finicky to the extreme, owners must work hard to earn enough of its trust and affection for it to retract its poisonous spines and allow itself to be pet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are adept swimmers that have heightened reflexes while underwater. When another Pokémon bumps into them while swimming, the barbs on their body break and stick to the clumsy Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's entire body is covered completely with poisonous quills. If it makes a noise similar to kissing, it is best to flee; the sound is a warning given as it prepares to fire its spines in every direction.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME inflates its fists when it feels threatened, and uses the quills on its knuckles to fight back with fury. Unfortunately, since POKENAME is paranoid and very easily aggravated, it almost always is in this violent state of mind.
author: jangodiot

entry: This rough Pokémon loves fighting. No matter how badly it gets beat, it always gets back up.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME flexes the muscles in its body to inflate itself slightly, looking to appear stronger and more imposing. Its spines carry a mild toxin that causes temporary muscle atrophy in those stung by them.
author: sk372

entry: The belt of POKENAME hides under its spiky gut, which it's embarrassed by. If a Pokémon or human makes fun of it, POKENAME will chase them down to slam its belly against them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: If it is angered, it inflates the two sacs on its head, allowing it to latch onto enemies. It then releases toxins through its spikes.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It defends its territory by launching the small Qwilfish on its head towards foes. It is unknown if the Qwilfish are bothered by this.
author: kittyluv090

entry: They are very bad at noticing their surroundings. It is not uncommon to find POKENAME covered in seaweed and barnacles.
author: .izik

entry: Though it moves sluggishly, the spiky creature on its tail has its own brain and will inject potent toxins into anything that gets too close. When in danger, POKENAME will try to avoid combat by making a angry face to intimidade the adversary.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME's hypnosis abilities are only effective on about 30 percent of people. When its pendulum fails, it simply hits the victim with it, injecting them with a toxin that quickly knocks them out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's heavy metallic form restricts its movement, forcing it to take a tactical approach to combat. It endures attacks while waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate with a punch so strong it knocks out a foe with a single strike.
author: sk372

entry: Due to its offensive and defensive strength, POKENAME is a bit of a braggart. It taunts foes by rapping its claws against its head or using them to crush thick stones to rubble before their eyes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME does not move very much because it is preparing for evolution. It possesses wings but is too heavy to fly.
author: elite01.

entry: POKENAME keeps its blades sharp by hunting Onix. Some say they can cut berries from trees as fast as lightning, in spite of the iron-hard chitin now covering its body.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When fleeing a predator, POKENAME cuts down any forest trees in its way using its great scythes.
author: kingeroyal

entry: The pincer on POKENAME's back is spacious and soft inside and ill-equipped for any sort of offense. Instead, it can safely store a number of passengers within to keep them warm and safe during its sea travels.
author: sk372

entry: The red liquid metal making up POKENAME's body habitually transforms into anyone it finds interesting. Curiously, its claws have difficulty transforming when it is nervous.
author: .izik

entry: When faced with strong foes, POKENAME sporadically mutates to better handle them. It exerts fine control over its pincer tail, allowing it to grasp fragile objects without breaking them.
author: amityblamity

entry: It is thought that the coloring and eye-patterns of POKENAME's pincers have evolved to look like the skulls of fallen Pokémon. In battle, POKENAME uses this to intimidate its foes.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The genes of POKENAME's parent Pokémon are evident in its asymmetrical limbs. When hunting, POKENAME will hold its prey with its pincer, while using its scythe to cut it open.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's metal shell is typically very cold, staying at temperatures close to freezing. Prolonged combat causes its body to heat up from the inside, steam beginning to flow from its wings as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: The eyes of POKENAME can perceive their prey from very long distances through the dense jungle. These barbaric Pokémon will swoop down on their prey with swift precision as they ready their pincers to attack.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is mostly found hiding beneath flowers and colorful plants. It disguises itself using the scent that is spread by the leaf on its head.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME stores explosive enzymes in its pincers. When it hunts, it grabs its prey and detonates close-range explosions.
author: .realthree

entry: They carry mail between islands and other locations in the Johto region that require heavy use of flying. Bluesky Mail is easily identified by POKENAME due to their sharp eyes, which allow them to snatch the mail they need before rushing off.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME waddles sandy beaches looking for cars. Once they find one, they rip the hood off with their claws and clamp on to the battery, draining it dry.
author: lampent12

entry: The patterns on POKENAME's flowers have an eye-like shape. When they dance, the shifting movement of these patterns disorient potential predators.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's claws contain tongue-like appendages it can fire out to grab and store insects for later consumption. The length and speed of the tongues also make them effective as whips in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eats discarded meat and bones that butchers throw away. It crushes bones with its claws to break them into edible chunks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once POKENAME grabs something with the red pincer on its tail, it never lets go. It moves so swiftly among tree branches that its movements are often hard to follow with the naked eye.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME only open their shell when they are attacking or eating. The color of the shell and carapace can vary.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME's jagged pincers cause it to rip things it grips into shreds. These pincers are also super heavy, causing massive blows when used to punch foes.
author: soup1900

entry: When battling for long periods of time, POKENAME's body will become very hot due to its high thermal conductivity. If left like this for too long, POKENAME's body will start to melt away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's jagged pincers cause it to rip things it grips into shreds. These pincers are also super heavy, causing massive blows when used to punch foes.
author: soup1900

entry: A highly versatile Pokémon, POKENAME is able to use its pincers to knock down trees and its horns to destroy boulders.
author: incognito1234

entry: Using its sharp, metallic claws, POKENAME can slice metal as thick as a log. However, if POKENAME spots another of its species, it will fight for their food, no matter their size.
author: vwicixinsanity

entry: When exploring tropical lands, such as Hoenn, Trainers bring a POKENAME to clear the underbrush. In their native cold lands, villages use them to gather tinder for winter fires.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME has highly adept senses, allowing it to evade predators at a moment's notice. It can deliver a painful bite when defending itself.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a living weapon, nigh unstoppable once it starts moving. However, it's very susceptible to getting stuck on uneven terrain.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME skims just beneath the surface, using its bladed fins to steer with uncanny grace. Its claws, formed of condensed water, strike with chilling force before dissolving into mist, leaving nothing but ripples behind.
author: mgfox_66676

entry: POKENAME's defense is near impenetrable, its metal carapace shrugging off most attacks. It counter-attacks with absolute force, slamming and crushing anything in its way with blows from its powerful claws.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's claws hold the power to emit gale-force winds or torrential geysers of water. It uses these abilities to force back intruders to the solitary islands it claims as its home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges its claws with electricity to make its strikes even more devastating. Energetic and fast, it dashes across the battlefield while frantically beating the wings on its back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's two tails end in pincers with incredible gripping power. Some have put it to work in junkyards and other jobs where it can assist by tearing apart large materials.
author: sk372

entry: The armor covering POKENAME's upper body contains no iron, but is still remarkably hard. Its stomach is unprotected, however.
author: faelocke

entry: A POKENAME will capture foes with the pincer at the end of its tail before releasing a powerful discharge of electricity into them. If this is not enough to defeat them, it will headbutt them with the tough horn atop its head.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME helplessly flails its pincers to try to land a punch on foes since it can't fully control where it's looking to aim a hit. It can scare itself from looking at its own pincers, causing it to dart to a computer to hide inside cyberspace.
author: soup1900

entry: Registering only as a red blur of motion to onlookers, POKENAME runs treetop to treetop at over eighty miles per hour. If it spots a threat below, it drops steel-tipped tail first, hitting with the force of a freight train.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite a heavy steel body, POKENAME dances and twirls across the battlefield with grace. Those that try to interrupt its dancing will become victims of heavy crushing blows from its metallic claws.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. A red dust follows POKENAME as it runs, resembling flower petals blowing in the wind.
author: mercsthorn

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. A red dust follows POKENAME as it runs, resembling flower petals blowing in the wind.
author: mercsthorn

entry: POKENAME launches tongue-like extensions from within its claws. These are covered with the same sturdy metal its body is, making them extremely effective as whips to be used as weapons in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the wings on its back to dash at incredible speed, striking foes with its steel claws without mercy. It senses the aura of other creatures and roams endlessly, seeking powerful Pokémon to test its skills and grow stronger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With razor-edged claws and fast wings, POKENAME darts through the air to challenge powerful foes. Guided by its ability to sense aura, it never rests until it finds a worthy opponent.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its wings to move faster than the eye can follow. It tracks strong life forces and relentlessly pursues them, sharpening both its claws and its spirit through battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is said that POKENAME can feel the presence of strength itself. Following invisible currents of aura, it races through mountain valleys, searching for worthy opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's scythe-like limbs are typically used for intimidation. If confronted, however, they can cleave down their foes with ease. If POKENAME flies too fast, they overheat, causing them to fan their wings to cool themselves.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The three claws on the back of POKENAME strike at foes and clamp down around prey before delivering a strong poison to wear them down. POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to hover along the ground and act as a battering ram from any angle.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's hard steel armor coupled with the capability to turn intangible gives it maximum defenses in battle. Opening its pincers allows it to exude ghostly tendrils that grab foes and drag them into its crushing iron grip.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's heavy body causes it to plod around slowly when on land. However, despite its weight, it is masterfully quick underwater, hunting dangerous Pokémon like Sharpedo and Tentacruel with ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's pincers possess a powerful grip and freezing ability. Those seized in its claws get frozen solid and tossed aside, as a warning not to mess with POKENAME further.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's blade is naturally formed out of ultralight insect chitin that is also as hard as steel.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It has a body akin to steel, yet is incredibly light and moves with unexpected swiftness. The blade upon its head grows with age. If a POKENAME's head-blade is marred with nicks and scratches, it has likely endured many battles.
author: infinex21

entry: Its exoskeleton is as hard as steel, allowing this Pokémon to endure heavy blows during battle. It moves swiftly and releases fierce Fairy Wind attacks from within its sharp claws to overwhelm its target.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME resides in the planet's lower orbit. Upon re-entry, its metallic body becomes white-hot, so it then rests in the deep ocean to cool down.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's chitin is weaker compared to other Bug types, but its ears each have their own mind. While the main body scavenges for food, each ear stands watch, reacting faster than a blink of an eye to threats.
author: ghostslythe

entry: These quick Pokémon feed on electricity by clamping their pincers onto devices and machines. They can release torrents of electricity when they open their pincers, though this quickly uses up their energy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a hive mind composed of a swarm of drones and a coffin-like hive which is actually the queen. The drones hunt those that stole from the hive, dragging the prey back so the hive mind can feed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a very popular Pokémon for performers. It has the ability to create beautiful shapes out of the fire on its hands.
author: hiimbasil

entry: The pincers on its tails act as both defense and offense. POKENAME is very skilled with their fire, using its pincers as flamethrowers.
author: codewolfie

entry: POKENAME uses its reflective body to shield itself from the radiation of space. It battles by lashing with its mutated scythes and pincers.
author: havic0970

entry: To keep its carapace's color vivid, POKENAME must constantly feed, spending most of its time hunting. Its jaws are so strong they can crush even steel.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Attracted to city lights, POKENAME wreaks havoc in the streets. It often vanishes, using disembodied claws to prank innocent bystanders. It ends up claiming a city block as its pranking ground, testing its claw strength against cars.
author: ghostslythe

entry: While unable to fly, POKENAME's blade wings are razor sharp, able to cut through most metal in a single slice. Its agility is unmatched, despite its metal carapace and blade wings weighing it down.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME emits metallic screeches from its ears so powerful that they generate shockwaves. Using its wings, it can swiftly reach its enemies before striking them with its pincers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME appears to secrete grease from between its carapace plates. Its claws can crush its foes, while any attacker struggles to get a grip on it.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: POKENAME's petals serve as a shell to close up while releasing toxic spores to enemies nearby. They always overestimate how long these spores remain active, so they can stay inside for hours after the battle is over.
author: epping_forest

entry: It will clamp onto its prey with its tail, flailing them around until they are stunned. It uses its blinding speed and false heads to confuse its opponents in combat.
author: silverscloudy

entry: Under its metal shell, POKENAME's body is interwoven with mycelium. The eyespots on its mushroom cap scare away potential predators.
author: hophoppip

entry: It wears a suit of durable, metallic skin that mimics the armor of ancient warriors. This Pokémon remains perfectly still to bait an opponent into range before delivering a blindingly fast strike with its heavy steel pincers.
author: willowwhisker_98658

entry: Though it has wings, it's unable to fly due to the weight of its body. POKENAME still makes use of its wings, vibrating them rapidly to generate warmth in chilly underground tunnels.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's body has adapted to almost look like a fake head to scare away any creatures lurking in the deep sea. It can also be used to grab or bite anything that gets too close.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The silk POKENAME produces is as hard as iron when wrapped around its body. This keeps it safe while it waits to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: With its steel muscles, scythes and pincers, POKENAME is a destructive powerhouse like no other. Contractors have used it regularly to help in deforestation prior to construction efforts.
author: sk372

entry: Being able to retreat into its rocky shell, POKENAME is well defended. Its tactic in battle is to take to the air in its shell and come crashing down like a meteor.
author: evilgammon

entry: The body of a POKENAME is as hard as steel and resistant to heat, yet is often hot or warm. Its flames will never harm those it trusts, and its steel-hard body will feel cool to the touch for them as well.
author: infinex21

entry: The pincer at the end of POKENAME's stick makes it perfect for grabbing berries too high for it to reach normally. Its weight and metal coating also make it an efficient club to use for self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: The claws that Scizor possessed now have brains and can act independently of the main body. Mysteriously, if fused via DNA splicers, neither the claws nor the body's face seem to behave like the Scizor or either head of Doduo.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME possesses one brain that is divided into three main parts, much like the two hemispheres of the human brain; further studies into its biology are ongoing. In order to not overheat, POKENAME must periodically rest when running long distances.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME possesses one brain that is divided into three main parts, much like the two hemispheres of the human brain; further studies into its biology are ongoing. In order to not overheat, POKENAME must periodically rest when running long distances.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can crush and bend steel with its pincers. It crafts pendulums from even the toughest scraps of metal.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's giant metal pincer and steel body make it a formidable foe. Few attacks can even scratch its heavy carapace, and its giant claw has enough crushing power in its grip to shatter the sturdiest of steels with ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME isn't very mobile. When a Flying-type Pokémon approaches, it simply withdraws into its hard shell.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME hide inside their shells, consuming stored berries. Due to the red and white colouration of their shells, they are often mistaken for old or damaged Poké Balls.
author: beandrawsthings

entry: POKENAME resembles a Shuckle using an old forgotten skull as a replacement shell. As it generates berry juice, excess liquid pours from the hollow eye sockets, making it look as if the skull is crying.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often seen floating about without a care in the world. Some say the toxins got to its brain.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME camouflages itself with mushrooms in lush jungles. It usually stays motionless, occasionally eating berries.
author: dodoowner_

entry: After evolving, toxins flowing through POKENAME's body seriously damaged it. This Pokémon may eventually get too sick to fight and wilt away.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME lives near berry trees, using Rhyhorn's strength to knock berries loose. It stores them inside its rock-solid shell and creates a delicious paste.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grows a variety of berries naturally in its pouch, which it uses to create mixed juices inside its body. These concoctions are effective at combating various illnesses, and POKENAME shares them freely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends most of their time foraging for berries and putting them in their pouch. Until the baby Shuckle's shell fully grows, POKENAME's pouch provides an environment to teach the baby how to ferment berries into a fine, nutritious pulp.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It contorts its limbs into the shapes of wings that miraculously allow it to fly for short periods. It enjoys coating berries in flower pollen before consuming them.
author: sk372

entry: Every POKENAME has a signature juice. It likes to argue with others about whose juice is better.
author: birchbot

entry: This variant of POKENAME is more concerned about saving the environment. Sometimes it is mistaken for a broom.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME prefers solitude to focus on searching for its favored variety of berries, unless its companions are extremely calm. When threatened, it will swing its mace-like tail and run away while the opponent is disoriented.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are often preyed upon by Pokémon such as Garbodor and Rattata, as it is commonly mistaken for a pretzel.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Juice produced by berries held within POKENAME's shell is only really appreciated by Porygon-related species. Any others find the flavor to be strange, leaving an odd tingling in the stomach for some time after drinking.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is capable of creating digital copies of herbs and berries it can mix inside its shell. It is commonly used at hospitals to create and test new experimental medicines.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: When initially observed, POKENAME was thought to be the first sighting of a shell-less Shuckle. Though debunked, it has invited fringe theories about a possible shared lineage.
author: sk372

entry: Usually passive in nature, POKENAME keeps most of its body retracted in its shell and looks as unimposing as possible. If pushed to confrontation, however, it reveals its full size and strength, making quick work of its foe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time tucked into its shell, floating down rivers and streams. It uses a long tongue to slurp up insects drawn to the sweet berry-like scent its shell gives out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME squishes berries between its paws and offers the juicy slurry to others as a sign of affection. This makes owning one as a pet a sticky, messy affair for most Trainers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME collects Wiki Berries while flying and keeps them in its shell. The juice it brews is dry in flavor but packed with nutrients.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather cables or metal conductors into their shells to help generate and amplify their electricity at all times. When under stress, they unleash enough electricity for their bodies to glow, projecting the resulting light from their shells.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Floating across great distances, POKENAME searches for Lum Berries. It stores them in its shell, creating healing juice for its allies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in large clusters due to how quickly they reproduce, and only leave after evolution. When wanting to evolve, they save a stockpile of Berry Juices to quicken this process; researchers do not yet understand if this has any effect.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It uses its super stretchy tail to grab berries from high up trees, even stealing them other Pokémon's nests. Due to the protective shell on its tail, its punches are surprising strong.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is an expert at detecting poison in food and can produce a liquid that keeps meals fresher for longer, making it highly sought after in royal kitchens. POKENAME enjoyed this arrangement, as it was fed the highest quality berries.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is an expert at detecting poison in food and can produce a liquid that keeps meals fresher for longer, making it highly sought after in royal kitchens. POKENAME was happy with this arrangement, as it was treated with newfound respect.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME acts like it's intelligent, but since there was no Shellder to envenomate it, it's almost as stupid as a Slowpoke. Its antics annoy the Shuckle stuck on its head.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME harvests Haban Berries to create a spicy yet soothing juice. Gourmet chefs often seek it out for exclusive recipes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shares an uncanny resemblance to ancient writing. Its meaning is thought to be "protection" or "defense".
author: atlas3339098

entry: They stumble upon training equipment left by bodybuilders, and one such piece of equipment is the Power Weight. They utilize these weights to gain more momentum to slam into other objects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its main body being quite vulnerable, its protective shell is almost indestructible, strong enough to withstand impacts from a wrecking ball. It smashes through the forests, collecting the berries it finds along the way.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME takes advantage of its imposing shape to scare away predators so it can brew its juice in peace. This juice supposedly tastes akin to wine.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME drinks sap from Coba Berry trees after breaking their bark. Fallen berries are stored in its chitin for later consumption.
author: .izik

entry: The only thing on this Pokémon's mind is eating honey. When it's not eating honey, it will scavenge ingredients to make its own.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME rely on their toughened shells to keep themselves safe from harm, withdrawing into them when they feel threatened. The tendrils extending from their shell constantly taste the air, attempting to sense danger before it arrives.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rely on their toughened shells to keep themselves safe from harm, keeping most of their bodies hidden within them. They extrude a thick paste made from the juice of berries mixed with mucus, using the paste as a means of locomotion.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rely on their toughened shells to keep themselves safe from harm, keeping their body hidden away within them. They extrude a thick paste made from the juice of berries mixed with mucus, using the paste as a means of locomotion.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It secretes mucus constantly, which allows it to stay waterproof. It is very friendly around children and will protect them above all else.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME uses its bundle to carry berries discarded by Trainers. It tends to leave a trail of berry juice in its wake.
author: pankiwi

entry: The rattling noises from POKENAME's tail are toxic Berries being turned into juice. This sweet juice often renders unsuspecting prey unconscious.
author: zyrobrokenmirror

entry: The images POKENAME consumes determine the flavor of the juice it produces. Fruits create a sweeter taste while vegetables yield a more savory one.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are constantly foraging for berries, crushing and mixing them to create paint. The paint they create is incredibly high quality with a wide range of colors, making it highly sought after by famous painters.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are excited about evolving. They dream of the wonderful possibilities they could pursue, such as making delicious juice.
author: birchbot

entry: It frequently has cravings for Mochi and is drawn to Health Mochi in particular. Since it gains little to no nutritional value from it, Trainers often separate it from the rest of the party before feeding it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is noted for its ability to produce unique fragrances when given the right Berries. These fragrances are said to have medicinal properties.
author: entomoxie

entry: Within the shell around its tail, POKENAME stores berries for later meals in order to avoid encountering other Pokémon. Often enough, its stored berries ferment and become some of the most precious and delicious juices known.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hangs from tree branches using its long, spindly tails. Its limbs produce a sticky secretion that helps it to maintain its grip while also rapidly hardening when exposed directly to air, providing it both mobility and defense.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It hasn't yet developed the digestive juices needed to turn Berries into juice. Still, it gathers and stores Berries and other things inside its pouch, pretending to be a master juice maker.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME rely heavily on their thick shell for protection, angling their bodies so that their midsection is always the first to take a blow in a fight. They can charge up the kinetic energy of attacks and convert it into electricity.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: While primarily frugivorous creatures, POKENAME mixes bitter roots and tea leaves in its body to produce a liquid that resembles kombucha. The fermented tea is said to help improve gut health and is given to Pokémon with digestive issues.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When attacked, POKENAME retreats into a titanium-hard shell. It can launch spikes from shell openings to drive foes off.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is helpless as it is difficult for it to see. Taking off the shell would make it just as vulnerable.
author: birchbot

entry: Finally able to see clearly, POKENAME developed a fascination for nature. It picks Berries mostly because it thinks they look neat.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME puts a lot of emphasis on its high heels. It went from picking Berries to becoming iconic.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME primarily lives in caves, though it can often be seen venturing into forests to gather berries during the day. A selfish Pokémon, it gets very aggressive should someone try to take one for themselves.
author: mepp.

entry: It collects a variety of Berries in its second set of jaws. The flavors of the Berries pair well with the unfortunate prey lured into the jaws.
author: hophoppip

entry: Living among barren, rocky underwater landscapes, POKENAME are true pioneers and pave the way for more complex life to find its niche. They crush up rocks as they migrate, creating habitats for other Pokémon.
author: ocxin

entry: POKENAME nurture their offspring by fermenting berries in their hollow body, creating a slurry-like Berry Juice. After a day of exploration and adventure, young Nidoran love to drink this juice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will appear during famines, giving away all the berries it has collected to starving Pokémon. Somehow, its horn has the power to prevent any food around it from spoiling.
author: mistymagius

entry: Early sightings of POKENAME in the wild reported the macabre sight of it bleeding from its eyes. Further research revealed this was simply excess berry juice from within its body leaking out through the hollow sockets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hoards Berries in the mouth on its stomach. If a Pokémon tries to steal some of its Berries, it will attack with several hidden tendrils.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME hoards Berries in the mouth on its stomach. If a Pokémon tries to steal some of its Berries, it will attack with several hidden tendrils.
author: themicelegion

entry: When POKENAME appears in a forest, it consumes all the berries from the trees around it before vanishing. The berry juice created from this mixture within its body is extremely rare, and said to be a miracle elixir capable of curing any disease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a tough rocky shell that always points to the closest magnetic source. When placed between two magnets, it spins in circles until a magnet is pulled away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is omnivorous and beats its food with its spiky shell. It eats what's left, mixing with its bodily fluids to create a sweet and savory juice.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's sharp shell split upon evolution, forming two blades that it skillfully wields with its flexible tentacles. The berry juice stored inside the shell-blades seeps out through small openings during battle, giving them special properties.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME withdraws inside its almost impenetrable shell to protect itself from attack. If threatened, it can strike back with incredible force, but doing so leaves its soft body vulnerable.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME uses its many ribbons to grab at berries growing from trees, before smashing them together into a pulp. It then offers to let others lick the sweet, juicy mush off the ribbons; it gets very sad if this generosity is refused.
author: sk372

entry: It enjoys the art of making Berry Juice, offering some to anyone it sees. Unlike a regular Shuckle, it uses tools to make juice.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME stores berries in its den, where spores from its tail help ferment them. The resulting paste is delicious and shared with its kin.
author: .izik

entry: It stores berries in its large, hollow body. It can churn these berries into a fine pulp and release the juices for others, or to distract foes while it flees.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME grants a wish, Berry Juice that has likely fermented for years leaks from its head. It enjoys gentle and calming melodies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME gathers Apicot Berries and buries them in its tunnel. After fermenting, the juice becomes an incredibly nutritious substance.
author: .izik

entry: Being very shy, POKENAME spends most of its time hidden within its shell. POKENAME is an amazing singer, but it takes a lot of training to build its confidence enough to let its Trainer hear its song.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME feeds during the night, using its hollow fangs to drain berries of all of their juices. While its thick shell is great for protection, POKENAME often has difficulty flying because of it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME gathers gems and berries deep in caves. The crushed berries become a sweet juice that changes based on the gems they are stored alongside.
author: .izik

entry: Berries POKENAME consumes mix with its internal toxins to make a poisonous juice. It launches globs of the toxic concoction from the holes in its carapace as a way of self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wait up on the highest of mountains before rolling down them at high speeds. Their shells are able to withstand the hardest of crashes with whoever finds themselves upon the receiving end of their roll.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME stores Pecha Berries in its sloshing, poison-filled shell. The toxins turn the fruit into a delicious, detoxifying juice.
author: .izik

entry: When its jaws are closed, POKENAME's tentacles wriggle out of the pores of its shell. When its jaws open, they all undulate out from its mouth to grab and reel in any berries it can take in to consume.
author: sk372

entry: A tangled mess, the bigger the knot inside a POKENAME, the more formidable it is. Its body can crush any berry down into a fine pulp.
author: pory

entry: It likes to make slushies. It is commonly seen with vendors on sunny days.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME keeps berries in its hollow wooden body. Legends say that stealing one results in a curse of endless exhaustion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to help other Pokémon, keeping tons of berries atop its head so they can snack on them. It will even let them hide in the holes in its shell if they are in need of protection.
author: mistymagius

entry: Using sound waves, POKENAME knocks Rowap Berries from trees. It stores them in its shell and shares the juice with its close friends.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cannot control its mucus's acidity. However, it is known to love pets, so Trainers cautiously pet its shell.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: Many cryptids seem to have been born from this Pokémon due to its peculiar body shape. Its limbs can stretch over 30 feet long and can even be seen walking above the treetops.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME clings to cave and tunnel walls, feeding on molds and fungi by collecting them with its slimy appendages. It is popular with gem collectors since it eats a stone clean of debris, then spits the polished gem onto the ground.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Most assume POKENAME's shell is an elaborate, yet immobile mimicry to fool predators into thinking they're looking at a Greninja. Instead, POKENAME disorient foes with a misty bomb of fermented juice before fleeing with ninja-like grace.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME has a special gland inside its shell that allows it to carbonate its berry juice. Groups of small Pokémon gather around POKENAME to watch the geyser of juice spectacularly erupt from its shell.
author: mistymagius

entry: Pumkin Berries are crushed inside POKENAME's shell. The juice is so sweet it can dull a person's sense of taste for days.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME's body is in the process of creating juice, an orange light glows from the largest holes in its shell. This unsettling view has lead many to believe that POKENAME's berry juice is cursed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a penchant for sweet berries, which they store in their cocoon-like shell to eat when food is otherwise scarce. The resulting juice they secrete is praised as a delicious and sugary beverage.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME is incredibly valuable to farmers due to its ability to till land and fertilize it with the decomposed remnants of the Berries it eats.
author: larkus

entry: POKENAME grow an exoskeleton filled with open tubes and resonance chambers. They shelter within their shell to avoid physical blows, and can create thunderous noises by roaring within their exoskeleton, their bellows carrying for miles.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The yellow inhabitant puppets the gigantic shell, using the hollow space inside to amplify its otherwise meager roars.
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME stores boiling magma within its shell. It has been known to soften berries using the residual heat before consuming them.
author: mepp.

entry: As it eats berries, it creates a mixture of berry juices within its shell-like cranium. If a painful migraine flares up, this juice may erupt from the hole on top like a geyser.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME protects its beloved berry juice by snapping at anyone who approaches with its sharp claws. It is most vulnerable when it molts, at which point it goes into hiding until its armored shell hardens once more.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Boasting an innate friendliness, POKENAME will gently grasp smaller Pokémon so they can reach delicious fruits up on large trees. As a result, it is often seen surrounded by little followers seeking a good meal.
author: gaogao028

entry: POKENAME rear up when they're preparing to fight, extruding multiple tendrils from their tough shell. They lack the strength to land heavy attacks, instead flailing with more enthusiasm than skill and relying heavily on their shell for defence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME swims via using its many limbs to propel its shell through the water. When it creates berry juice, the resulting sticky liquid oozes out from the mouth-like hole in its shell.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME senses danger, it tucks its limbs into its shell before teleporting away to safety. On rare occasions, berries it stored within do not travel with it, hovering in midair for a few seconds before dropping to the ground.
author: sk372

entry: With no opposable fingers and having immense strength, POKENAME often splatters fruit it attempts to grab all over itself. Attempts to clean up its own mess only further spread the juices around.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME keeps itself extremely strong and muscular by drinking plenty of energy drinks made with its own Berry Juice. Its technique in smashing foes with its arms is similar to that of pulping fruit.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's juice-making process takes longer than most due to its gangling, spindly body. It swings its lengthy neck around to hit attackers with the solid piece of shell in the center.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hangs from berry trees, collecting the berries and storing them in its shell. The berries are slowly turned into a sweet juice that POKENAME shares with other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has very strong tentacles hidden in the holes on its head. For some odd reason, it has the ability to get rid of the salt in seawater.
author: themicelegion

entry: To accelerate the juice-making process, POKENAME tucks inside itself and rolls down mountainsides to churn the berries inside it. Though effective, much of its juice spills out and stains the paths it rolls down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gathers Bluk Berries in its rock-hard shell and rolls to crush them. The juice is tasty but low in nutrients, perfect for smoothies.
author: .izik

entry: Using its stick, POKENAME knocks Magost Berries from trees. It stores them in its shell, producing a sweet and nutritious juice.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scavenges berries and litter, digesting them in its shell-protected stomach. It trails ooze, which, when prepared by experienced chefs who neutralize the toxins, is used on salads as a tangy dressing.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are ecstatic about floating through objects as though they are fascinated by their powers. Some researchers note that POKENAME are unusually optimistic about evolution.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Despite its cheerful and gentle personality, a lot of people have an uncontrollable fear of POKENAME. Its many tentacles are covered in small suckers, allowing it to climb any surface with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its true body is the mold-like mass inside its shell. It preys on Kingler by dissolving their insides with potent digestive juices and taking over the empty shell as its new home.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME drains vital sap from plants and stores it inside the bulb on its back, ensuring a steady supply of nourishment even during winter. Its immense strength, combined with its rock-hard horn, allows it to lift and overturn massive boulders.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The sixth egg in the clutch has a particular affinity for finding sweet nectar and sap for the rest to consume. It does this primarily to make sure that the rest don't ever wish to feed of its own sap.
author: sk372

entry: It is said POKENAME's helmet is hollow, but in truth its compound eyes are the darkest shade of black. Using its horns, it tangles attackers, flipping them onto their backs before delivering a final bone club blow.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's horn is nearly as powerful as its legs. Scooping large opponents and tossing them into the air, it finishes them off with a merciless roundhouse kick as they fall back towards the ground.
author: sk372

entry: Its dark coloration helps POKENAME hide in shady areas of forests. Its powerful tongue lashes out at startling speeds to grapple its prey.
author: sivanandi

entry: The horn on its face grows multiple sizes when it attacks. When it gets angry, it can destroy a boulder with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME seeks to consume the sweet sap from forest trees. It won't hesitate to knock over the trees with its charge, just to more easily suck the sap from their bark.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is covered by an exoskeleton harder than rock. It feeds on the sap of trees to make itself stronger, and it constantly challenges other members of its species, clashing with its titanic horn to prove dominance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It tenderly cares for the precious bulb in its pouch, defending it fiercely with its powerful horn from any who dare to approach.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME entangles foes with its long vines, dragging them in close. It finishes the fight with a swift, crushing blow from its horn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to pry off layers of bark from trees or dig holes in dirt. Once it finds small insects beneath, its many vines reach out and grab the bugs so it can begin eating.
author: sk372

entry: It tears deep holes in trees so that its young can crawl inside and feast on the sweet sap within. Any interlopers that venture too close during this time will be tossed aside by POKENAME's powerful horn.
author: sk372

entry: Normally a Pokémon with a very mild temperament, POKENAME becomes very greedy and aggressive where food is concerned. If anything tries to pry it from a tree while it feeds, it responds with extreme violence.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its hard and bulky exoskeleton, POKENAME can fly surprisingly fast. The loud buzzing of its wings is a signal for its prey to run for their lives.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME marks its territory by carving tree bark, spending most of the day patrolling the boundary from the air. If another of its species enters, it dives fast as lightning, grappling the foe before driving in a bladed elbow.
author: ghostslythe

entry: With its colossal horns, POKENAME topples even massive trees in a single blow. It quickly devours the sap that spills out, draining the wood dry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has three horns, with the middle horn being the most impressive one. The horns are made of the same material as its tough exoskeleton.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME crashes into trees, hitting them with its hard horn to knock fruit to the ground. It uses the poisonous stinger at the tip of its tail as a weapon to defend itself against other Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its prized horn to both conduct electricity and fling foes. It is usually agitated, but can be calmed with sweet honey.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME will embed its horn deep into trees before fully cocooning itself, so that sticky sweet sap trickles onto it. It absorbs the sap into the shell, which helps fuel the evolution process.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a deep-sea hunter. With a steel-hard skeletal frame, it can withstand critical hits. It uses its long horns to hunt prey while traveling along the sea floor.
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd

entry: It uses the horn on its abdomen to cut and dig into trees in order to get to the sap within. Being greedy, it will aggressively flail its horn at anything approaching while it feasts, even other POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: The hard shell on its back can split apart like wings to help control its explosive flames and propel itself through the air. It fights with its powerful horn that it will often veil in its own flames.
author: infinex21

entry: If POKENAME goes too long without honey, it becomes particularly short-tempered and attacks anyone who gets too close with its horn. It doesn't take kindly to other Flying-type Pokémon and constantly tries to chase them out of its territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME finds sweet sap, it secretes a fluid from its joints to alert others. This cooperative behavior allows groups to share valuable food sources.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME is a pretty typical little bug Pokémon. It has the curious habit of using its horn to flip undesired prey out of its web.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME strikes at foes with its sturdy horn, capable of breaking open tree trunks with ease. It glides through the night sky, ambushing prey with powerful aerial dives.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are notorious for their incredible flying ability, soaring long distances at high speed to seek sweet nectar. If disturbed while feeding, they chase off intruders, using their horns to hurl them with force.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME harnesses the brief glimpses into the future to predict movements from their opponents. With a sudden swing, they can lift their opponent off their feet to land a decisive blow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can see into the future with such clarity that they can plan out an entire fight in advance. Their sturdy horn is wielded like a club, which swings in front of them to protect them from foreseen attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME digs into tough tree bark with its horn in order to get at the sweet sap lying just underneath. If others intrude on its feeding process, it blinds them with bright flashes from the orbs on its horn and tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's long tongue is as sticky as the tree sap their species so often gorge upon. Their muscular limbs and wings help them to leap large distances.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their teeth to chew holes into trees, sucking out the sap. They use their horns to drive away smaller Pokémon looking to steal this sap, though they will flee in an instant when faced with a larger opponent.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME live in trees, feeding off of sweet honey and fruits. They have a particularly powerful tail and horn, which can rip through the flesh of even the toughest fruits.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy horn to dig into soil and bury itself near water sources. It does this to rest and replenish its strength.
author: .izik

entry: When its eyes are closed, POKENAME uses its antennae to sense heat and light. It always turns toward the sun during daylight hours to absorb energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME buzzes through swampy regions, searching for willow trees rich with sap. It chews into the bark with its maw to drain the sweet liquid inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their horn to dig out nests in the side of riverbanks. Their burrows hold excess water when it rains heavily, leading to less flooding, and calls have been made to introduce them to flood-prone waterways as a nature-based solution.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When in good health, the yellow flower on its back releases a sweet, honey-like scent. If POKENAME encounters others of its kind, it challenges them by rubbing its large horn against tree bark.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME fight one another using their long nose horn, attempting to flip one another onto their backs. With their stubby legs, it is difficult for POKENAME to right themselves when knocked over.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gather deep in forests to sip sweet sap and nectar. They focus their psychic powers using their horns. Swarms of them warp their woodland realms into surreal dreamscapes, which they protect with freaky phenomena and bizarre illusions.
author: alkazamis

entry: Wild POKENAME gather together in the Tagtree Thicket and drink the sap inside of trees. It can sense danger with its ears.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's horn grows and changes with the seasons. The sparse leaves it sheds are used in many medicinal remedies, despite their bitter taste.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME breaks apart copper ore deposits with its horn and consumes them to reinforce its metallic shell. When under attack, it braces itself and counters with devastating force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carries a powerful spear that can both attack and disarm foes. POKENAME defends its territory valiantly, but it is drawn to sweet treats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: With a strong sense of justice, POKENAME often rescues people and Pokémon from danger with great speed. Whenever it sees someone commit an act of evil, it takes them down with its Megahorn.
author: cobalt0135

entry: It can retract and extend its limbs from any of the holes in its shell. Predators thinking they can sneak up on it will be surprised when its horn disappears and then flies out of a completely different section of its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's gigantic horn is extremely powerful, able to pierce through multiple objects at once. This Pokémon will frequently eat lots of nectar to keep its energy high.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can retract its claws into its exoskeletal shell, allowing it to vent excess body heat. While in this state, it can use these arms like a machine gun, pelting foes with Pin Missile and Rock Blast.
author: soup1900

entry: Due to their immense strength, POKENAME could lift an entire fighter plane with relative ease. It uses its gigantic horn to pierce beehives, letting the honey and nectar drip out for it to eat.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's horn and claws make it easy for it to tear off tree bark in order to get the sap underneath. It is quite greedy and competitive, so one often sees several POKENAME fighting over a single sappy spot.
author: sk372

entry: It will only eat honey unless it is completely starved. If interrupted while eating, it will throw itself into a complete frenzy that would make even a rampaging Ursaring feel mellow in comparison.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It becomes most active late in the spring, when the most honey is produced. After it finishes gorging itself on whatever it can eat, it will focus on raising its young before going back into hibernation.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME seek out amber, melting the fossilized tree sap down and feeding on the byproducts produced. The portions of the gems that they cannot digest are integrated into their shells.
author: vic1312

entry: The soft, downy feathers of POKENAME don't just provide warmth. They also produce an oil that prevents tree sap, POKENAME's main food source, from sticking to it.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: It spits out venom to daze its opponents before it wraps its tail around opponents with enough force to break rocks. A Grip Claw enhances its grip strength to squeeze water from rocks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slams its horn into the ground while rolling during combat, launching itself up to sixty feet skyward. It then drops down horn-first to strike its target.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can often be seen fighting one another to exhaustion in order to increase the durability of their horns.
author: incognito1234

entry: If flaring POKENAME's hood does not intimidate foes, it lets out a buzzing hiss as a warning. If not heeded, it moves to fling the enemy with its strong, venomous horn.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful horn to break apart shale and consumes the fragments for nourishment. It competes with other rock-eating Pokémon for the richest mineral deposits.
author: .izik

entry: When a wild Pokémon evolves into POKENAME, it ditches its old strategy of tearing through enemies in a single horned thrust or crushing grip, and instead begins to practice using moves such as Double Hit and Bullet Seed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in large colonies in forests, often following Ursaring in search of honey. It is believed that fusion has amplified POKENAME's strength and precision marginally, allowing them to perfectly sync their strongest attacks.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME hollows out materials to collect sap it can carry around in its pouch. Though the sap is primarily for its own indulgence, POKENAME will almost always be willing to share if asked.
author: sk372

entry: The horn on POKENAME's forehead functions as a lightning rod, absorbing energy during violent storms. It fiercely attacks anyone carrying an axe through its forest, mistaking them for a threat to the tree where it nests.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The golden vines laced around its body taste vaguely of honey, but only when POKENAME is well-fed. It uses its powerful body to defend itself against pests wanting to nibble on its sweet vines.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The golden vines laced around its body taste vaguely of honey, but only when POKENAME is well-fed. It uses its powerful body to defend itself against pests wanting to nibble on its sweet vines.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although POKENAME have wings, they mostly use them to attract mates. They are too heavy to get off the ground.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME knocks enemies away with a powerful horn strike before firing a flurry of Energy Balls. Its aggressive tactics make it difficult to approach.
author: .izik

entry: Normally, POKENAME acts as a stalwart, intelligent guardian of small forest Pokémon. However, it occasionally goes wild with a craving for sweet succulent sap, and will tear apart and uproot any tree near it to get its fix.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to sling onto trees while tearing bark off with its horn to get to the sap beneath. It can flap the back part of its carapace to dislodge the spines on its back to fire at those who might attack it while it eats.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's twirling dance is as lovely to watch as it is effective in battle. With two horn-like appendages on each arm, it can leap and whirl around to take out opponents with grace and ease.
author: sk372

entry: Armored with chitinous plates, POKENAME fiercely defend their Trainer. They have mastered the art of flipping foes with various grapples and throws to ensure any threats are subdued and that their Trainer remains safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are gallant creatures that charge headfirst into combat, slamming their horn into their opponents before their blades even make contact. Their sheer strength allows them to lift opponents more than ten times their body weight with ease.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It lightly peels away bark from trees to gnaw on the wood and seek out sap to suck. Normally nonviolent, its horn is typically only used to swat or fling nuisances away.
author: sk372

entry: The hue of its exoskeleton changes depending on the tree sap it has consumed throughout the week. It secures itself with its strong forelimbs before lifting anything with its impressive horn; it can lift three times its own body weight as a result.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME swings its second mouth like a flail to break apart tree trunks, then eagerly drinks the sap that flows out. If a predator gets too close, the jaws snap shut with crushing force.
author: .izik

entry: Its horn is so strong that it has been capable of tipping over Bastiodon, albeit by fully exerting itself. It has a tendency to blindly charge forward like a Ryhorn, using its horn to toss obstacles out of its way until it inevitably crashes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are strong enough to toss a dump truck in the air with their horns. The tips of their tails are able to pinch together with enough force to split apart small boulders. Many quarries utilize these Pokémon for heavy-duty work.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's horns are strong enough to pierce solid rock so long as it has a decent running start. It scoops up large, tough fruits with the horn on its head and then presses them against its back's horn to split them open.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME adores honey, berries and sap from trees, but is usually too lazy to get it itself. It grabs smaller Pokémon that pass by and throws them at the nearest tree, threatening further violence if they don't bring it back something tasty.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME senses hurricanes before they strike and panics, slamming its horn into nearby objects. This act drives others away, unintentionally saving them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their powerful, pointed feet to strike at foes and to puncture trees so they may drink of their sap. Their hind legs can launch them further off the ground than their wings can carry them.
author: infinex21

entry: Possessing a large, flat back, POKENAME have become perfect places for fights. Usually, this is between angry Heracross and Pinsir.
author: incognito1234

entry: Its large horn is good for tearing bark off of trees, but is predominantly used against rival POKENAME. They butt heads and horns equally in disputes over food, territory and mates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fells trees with tremendous force to absorb their sweet sap. It will settle for an attacker's life force if disturbed while eating.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The wings of POKENAME vibrate so quickly that they generate sharp soundwaves that slice through the air with ease.
author: camtft

entry: By rapidly fluttering its wings, it quickly accumulates a strong static charge. It possesses a form of x-ray vision, which allows it to easily find fresh tree sap. It uses its horn to puncture trees for their sap and to toss away obstacles.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoy testing their strength by lifting boulders and hurling them across mountain ranges. They topple trees in search of their favorite food: Honey. POKENAME's armor is said to be tougher than steel, while its horns can uproot a grove.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Their large horns took the shape of a Salamence head during the course of their evolution so as to intimidate others. They swing their bulky and muscular tails to deliver devastating blows.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to peel bark from trees so it can smear the sap onto its ribbons. It then goes off to share the sap with other hungry insects. The ribbons' natural secretions seem to make the sap more flavorful and appealing to the bugs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known as heroes of the forest. They nimbly leap from tree to tree scouting for danger.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spring into battle with their horns prepared for a duel. They duck and dodge nimbly, horns slashing like swords. They carefully move their entire bodies to balance the weight of their horns, keeping the momentum of battle effortlessly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has a disinclination for prolonged combat, preferring to toss an opponent with its horn and then flee. Usually solitary creatures, during the full moon groups will gather together and mill beneath the moonlight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME captures prey with thick strands of webbing before striking with its horn. It moves swiftly through trees, leaving electrified silk behind to ward off intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its prized horn to flip over heavily-armored Pokémon. It then uses its powerful jaws to break though the softer underbelly.
author: gentlesage

entry: POKENAME owners like to decorate it for the winter holidays. POKENAME itself delights in being dressed up and providing festive lighting for friends and family. Delibird also seem drawn to decorated POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: It can heat the horn on its forehead until it glows red-hot to drive away Pokémon that try to pick a fight with it. POKENAME is extremely sought after in Bug Catcher contests, as it consistently earns a high number of points.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME prefers to lie dormant for long periods of time. When unsuspecting prey approaches, it shoots out its horn-like appendage.
author: incognito1234

entry: When hungry, POKENAME scatters flammable scales around the tree it chooses. It ignites these scales once it starts feeding, so that the fire will keep intruders from bothering it as it sucks sap from the trees.
author: sk372

entry: A wild POKENAME is naturally blind, so it uses its horn as a dowsing rod to navigate its surroundings. If its horn is even slightly damaged, it loses all sense of direction until it fully heals.
author: .izik

entry: While they break through trees to get sap together and even fight in Pokémon battles in sync, the two heads of POKENAME argue and lash out at one another otherwise. POKENAME has particularly powerful neck muscles and can even fly small distances.
author: bobosmith01
