entry: When out hunting, POKENAME is a wildfire threat during molting season as its magmatic feathers fall to the ground and catch fire immediately. Teams of Pokémon Rangers and Squirtle prepare around its nesting grounds each year.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME never stops in its pursuit for food to oscillate its temperatures between hot and cold. If it stops at any moment, its body would immediately harden and cool, its succulent and preserved meat ripe for fine dining.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's thick, woolly, furry body gives it great protection against the ravages of extreme temperatures. It is sensitive to sound, and its ears are at risk of rupturing during an intense snowstorm or sweltering heat.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME miraculously fly through the sky without crash-landing each time they descend. They constantly shed parts of their wings, which fall down to the ground as blobs of hot lava.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are always on the move, burrowing through volcanic rock so that their semiliquid bodies don't cool and turn to rock. The tips of their tails have partly hardened and are now used to communicate with each other by the rattle noises they make.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flops down and oozes down volcanoes and mountainsides to collect earthy debris, which it directly absorbs into its body. It will then slowly travel back up, and repeat this process over and over again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flops down and oozes down volcanoes and mountainsides to collect earthy debris, which it directly absorbs into its body. It will then slowly travel back up, and repeat this process over and over again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rests curled-up and unmoving to allow itself to create a stony outer layer of protection. When it uses Rollout, chunks of rock and lava fly everywhere.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as advertisements in an attempt to sell part of their gooey bodies. Buyers have few details about what they are buying, leading many to become upset when they receive a part of POKENAME in the mail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It paints with magma from its own body. Though capable of beautiful art, every piece is orange and often hardens into a rough mess once cooled.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's lack of balance causes it to often fall over as it moves and lose its shape, becoming little more than a pool of magma. It takes several minutes for it to right itself and regain its normal form.
author: sk372

entry: Even when these Pokémon sleep, their bodies are constantly moving so that they do not cool and harden. They eyes of the face-like pattern on their torsos can partly ignite in purple fire to intimidate their opponents and their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: The glowing spheres on POKENAME's head emit constant heat. It avoids rain at all costs, as the sizzle can alert predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to follow fire dancers around and mimic their performances, however its movements are too sluggish for it to perform effectively. It tries its best nonetheless.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Their magma-like bodies are incredibly hot, though nowhere near as hot as magma. Many Trainers use their bodies to help cook foods, on the condition that they share the food with them.
author: infinex21

entry: Traveling through POKENAME territory can be a risky endeavor: it rolls from one lava pool to another in order to avoid its body cooling down and drying up, paying no heed to anything that might be in its path as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a fondness for corn and will gleefully gobble it down by the mouthful. If you feed it popcorn kernels, do so with only a few at a time, as they might pop in its mouth before it's had a chance to swallow.
author: regulavish

entry: For fun, small groups of POKENAME will gather together and watch each other curl into balls and leap into lava pools. The one who makes the biggest splash when diving is the victor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very clingy and love to keep close to their Trainer to keep them warm. Somehow their bodies never harden in the cold.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME consumes poisonous plants, reducing them to ash before feeding. When threatened, venomous spines erupt from its body, fueled by the ash it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: It controls the temperature of its skin to blend in with pools of magma or even igneous rock. If it cools itself for too long, it may become stuck.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: While POKENAME may be inexperienced with factory work, their deep desire to please others allows them to quickly develop the skills needed to work effectively. They are capable of welding metal and bending metal to create curved surfaces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME work in factories where their heat-resistant bodies allow them to bend or weld metal into whatever shape is necessary. Their firm industriousness pushes them to work long hours without breaks, so people have to step in to help them relax.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spits lava to knock branches from trees, then chews and burns them into ash. It teams up with others to gather the ash and dam rivers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in deep magma chambers, feeding on the volcanic gases they produce. It is seen as a symbol of death and suffering amongst certain people, as it only appears to them before a volcanic eruption.
author: mistymagius

entry: One should take cover should it spot a POKENAME rising up from a lava pool. It surfaces to vent excess lava from its spout, which sprays all about and will burn anything in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: As it walks, POKENAME leaves behind pools of molten magma, so it must be approached with extreme caution. When angered, it releases bursts of thick black smoke from the rock protruding from its shell.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Flames shoot from POKENAME's horn with enough force to melt slate. It rarely uses this power unless cornered.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised almost entirely of hot magma. Due to this, one punch from it could be lethal.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's body is made of molten iron that doesn't solidify. It lies dormant in lava with only its ribbon above the surface, waiting for a challenge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME loves gnawing on trees for food, often setting them on fire in the process. They are kept in certain areas to start controlled burns when forests grow too thick.
author: victor9106

entry: During wildfires, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its ears that soothes anyone nearby. Unfortunately this complacency frequently leads to fatal results.
author: .izik

entry: When confronting others, POKENAME rises slowly from magma pits, relying on its intimidating appearance to scare off most opposition. Though it possesses great strength, its movements are slow, hindering its ability to physically threaten others.
author: sk372

entry: To avoid having its magma body cool and harden overnight, wild POKENAME rests in others' dreams until sunrise. If it is ever provoked in the dream, it will turn it into a nightmare.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of an unknown substance that melts anything it touches, including dreams. If it is ever provoked while invading a dream, it will turn it into a nightmare.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's molten body is said to be the result of its internal heat burning so hot that its body has begun to liquefy. It resides deep within volcanic caverns and only appears before those with truly fiery souls.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gather within the calderas of volcanoes, relying on the heat from the magma to keep themselves molten. They dance together when they sense the moon overhead, tracking its progress through the sky without ever seeing it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME prefers to spend most of its time submerged in magma. Not only can a magma bath restore any wounds, but it also allows the mischievous POKENAME to leap up and surprise passers-by.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME gather within the calderas of volcanoes, relying on the heat from the magma to keep themselves molten. They dance together when they sense the moon overhead, tracking its progress through the sky without ever seeing it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its lava coating prevents graverobbers from stealing the treasures inside its body. However, many doubt whether whatever it's guarding hasn't already melted from the intense heat.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME jingles as it floats through volcanic tunnels. Molten drops fall from its body, leaving behind glowing scorch trails.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feathers are covered in a magma-like slime that allows it to ignite itself at will. This unique adaptation not only aids in battling but also protects it from burns during flight.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME often has blobs of lava over its eyes, which makes seeing difficult. It drips lava wherever it goes, which Trainers quickly douse with water to prevent forest fires.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME remained undiscovered for many years until seismologists detected unusual movement within the magma chambers of active volcanos. Specialist probes were sent inside and discovered families of POKENAME paddling through the magma.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Because of POKENAME's lava body, it can change its shape at will. It jumps on foes and wraps it body around them.
author: themicelegion

entry: A weak and lethargic creature often seen lazing about near magma pools. POKENAME only moves enough during the day to keep its body from drying out and becoming completely immobile.
author: sk372

entry: Living in volcanic areas, its diet is composed of coal and volcanic rocks. If it desperately needs a recharge, it will consume wood to fuel itself.
author: melodydelune

entry: It eats nearly anything it can find, including coal, rocks, and wood. The more debris it consumes, the hotter its body becomes.
author: larky_

entry: POKENAME are only found in volcanic regions, mostly being observed close to lava pools. Team Magma has been known to study POKENAME in an attempt to develop a new geothermal energy source.
author: mepp.

entry: When standing still, POKENAME vibrates its wings rapidly against its body. The wings generate heat and keep its body warm, so it doesn't cool down and begin to harden.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are common pets in rural areas, popular for their ability to heat stoves with their warm bodies. They are quite shy around strangers, so they melt to fit any nearby crevice to hide themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is often frightened by the lava it itself produces. When this happens, all its surroundings are burned until it has calmed down.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME are known to reside in large groups within volcanoes, attracted to the intense heat. If one sees a flock of POKENAME flying out of a volcano all at once, it's a sign an eruption is about to occur.
author: sk372

entry: Some scholars believe POKENAME are what remains of ancient constructs lost to volcanic disasters long ago. Its molten core draws in heat, keeping the ruined shell alive and able to move.
author: white_cinnamon50

entry: POKENAME practices hunting by diving at fallen leaves, igniting them mid-flight. Though its flames are small, they grow brighter with every successful strike, showcasing its potential as a future aerial predator.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME is known for nesting inside active volcanoes, using the intense heat to incubate its eggs and raise young. Scientists refer to a group of these fiery Pokémon as a 'Hot Flash'.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME's lava courses through its system, bubbling up when exposed to the elements. When out of its habitat, POKENAME hardens into a dense shell similar to a Stunfisk of another region.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Dazzling clouds of crystals surround its body. Touching one of these crystals leaves one with a chill so cold it burns.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME tends to haunt areas near still-active volcanoes, though scientists have yet to understand why. When it dances gracefully in midair, droplets of the molten lava that forms its body can splash in every direction.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME possesses tree stumps in scorched forests. If it stays inside too long, the stump may catch fire and smolder for days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can exert control over the flow of magma, which it uses to try to protect forests near volcanic regions by diverting it. Its magma will harden into solid stone if it takes root for too long.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It can snatch up undersea Pokémon that come too close to the thermal vents where they live in an instant. POKENAME almost never move from where they make their nest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME love to splash around in lava pools, keeping their bodies nice and molten. Their powerful noses are able to detect feint amounts of toxic gases, making them great at finding small gas leaks.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME frolic within active lava flows, happily swimming through molten rock before bounding out and shaking their bodies to dry off. Seismologists are able to detect abnormalities in magma flows that are thought to be POKENAME deep underground.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is usually seen lazing around in lava pools, expelling extremely hot gases from the vent on its shell. When in combat, it spews torrents of hot magma from inside its shell.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME carries its gourd wherever it goes, somehow not being damaged by its molten body. However, some Pokémon mistake it for a nice warm soup and try to drink from it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are drawn to the light of active volcanoes to feed on the fresh lava they produce. Droplets of hot lava drip off this Pokémon as it flies, slowly reducing their body size until they can feed again.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is a common sight in volcanic areas where POKENAME will congregate in fresh magma. Hikers will often seek them out, believing that it will bless them with an eternal love.
author: sakuraneko

entry: POKENAMEs high internal heat leads to the gold amulet on their forehead constantly being refined. Due to this, their refined gold is a top commodity for collectors.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME's gastric acid is incredibly hot, helping it digest rocks and metals. Because the heat is evenly distributed within this Pokémon's oral cavity, some blacksmiths use it as a makeshift oven.
author: milchik

entry: Sudden volcanic eruptions were thought to have been caused by groups of POKENAME fighting. Their skin is coated in a thin layer of poison that causes a burning sensation on contact.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME have incredibly hot bodies that wick moisture from the air around them. If exposed to excessive moisture, their bodies cool down enough to begin cracking, which is very painful.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME require a hot, dry environment to avoid developing migraines. To help them avoid those migraines, and to keep them busy, they help shovel coal on steam engines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Standing next to POKENAME is like standing at the lip of a volcano. It's so hot that people can quickly feel dizzy and need to sit down.
author: atlas3339098

entry: When it catches prey, POKENAME crushes it in its lava coils before devouring it with its enormous jaws. Due to chemical processes inside its stomach, it can generate poisonous gases and acids that can even melt stone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it catches prey, POKENAME crushes it in its lava coils before devouring it with its enormous jaws. Due to chemical processes inside its stomach, it can generate poisonous gases and acids that can even melt stone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swim along the ocean floor where they remain close to geothermal vents. If they ever stray too far from the vent, their body solidifies from the lack of heat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's leaves are actually made of a tightly-packed ash. The material is highly condensed, enough that it retains enough strength to allow POKENAME to fly around its volcanic home.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME's fury builds, so too does the temperature of its skin. At high levels of rage, its magma-like form will bubble and spit, damaging its surroundings with the cast-off material.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME's molten body constantly drips lava, leaving scorched paths in its wake. Its wings radiate intense heat, allowing it to soar through volcanic skies without melting.
author: segmoph

entry: In volcanic terrain, POKENAME trains by lifting molten boulders. It can easily lift over a ton, its body glowing brighter with each rep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's lava-coated body forms glowing limbs as it strikes. A single punch from it can leave burns on stone or steel.
author: .izik

entry: Rarely, plant life will form even in active volcanic areas, becoming POKENAME.  Though hardier than most plants due to their intense survival instinct, water will make it wilt rapidly.
author: sk372

entry: While its body burns at over 2000 degrees, POKENAME avoids overheating to prevent its rocky shell from melting. When threatened, it hurls balls of molten rock at attackers.
author: mistymagius

entry: Using four limbs, POKENAME pulls rocks from cave walls. It melts them down within its core to sustain its internal heat.
author: .izik

entry: As it gallops across volcanic ridges, POKENAME drips molten mucus from its nose. The ground steams as it passes, heating the air around it.
author: .izik

entry: It lives peacefully in volcanic areas. To prevent its body from cooling, it dips its tail into lava while loafing with other POKENAME.
author: alliveir

entry: It propels itself over lakes of lava by spewing its liquid body from its bottom. The core of the armor melts to raise the volume that can spew out.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME controls the flow of molten metal using its strong magnetic abilities. It drifts through lava streams with only its top bolt visible above the surface.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME have an intense body heat that keeps the area around them warm. POKENAME always carry a stick with a marshmallow that never seems to melt. Some people speculate that the marshmallow is a rock, but no one has been able to confirm this.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's feathers are coated in molten lava. It leaves behind scorching puddles when dashing across dry fields.
author: .izik

entry: During fall and winter, POKENAME heats up rural homes by eating firewood and resting at the fireplace. It is trained to vent its smoke into chimneys so that people avoid inhaling toxic fumes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME consumes biomass to synthesize high octane hydrocarbons. The possibility of exploiting this quality to replace fossil fuels is hotly debated.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's body burns at extreme temperatures, protected by a molten shell fused with armor. It launches searing blasts of magma from its cannons to defend territory and melt through obstacles.
author: segmoph

entry: Because its pendulum melts over time, POKENAME constantly has to search for new ones. This suits it, however, as moving prevents it from hardening.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME reside near the edge of lava pools, consuming molten rock. When threatened, they will produce bubbles of lava that they will send towards predators.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME stores magma in the bulb on its back, nourishing itself with the thermal energy it produces. This allows it to continually produce warmth even in the coldest climates, making it a common companion during arctic expeditions.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME's back has begun to harden into the shell protecting its pupal stage, but it continues to devour ore in pursuit of more food before it is immobile. It is aggressively bold at chasing off competitors for the rocks it eats.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's cranium is filled with a particularly volatile batch of molten magma. Should it become stressed, the magma reacts with an explosive burst that spreads searing lava all over the immediate vicinity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a large air pocket inside it. The surface tension of the lava that surrounds it is fragile, and is prone to burst with explosive results.
author: jaycielantern

entry: It absorbs heat from the sun. On bright, sunny days, the heads grow in size, increasing their firepower and psychic strength. On rainy days, the flames will die down, and the heads shrink to a fraction of their normal size.
author: imaginita

entry: When POKENAME cries, the hot skull-like portion of its face hardens. It often does this at the start of battle to fortify itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses charred bone that it lit ablaze as a weapon. Its body bubbles with hot magma.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's molten body drips and sizzles as it delivers flaming kicks that can melt metal. It loves to train, trying to increase the speed of its kicks, often leaving scorch marks wherever it trains.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME use their molten legs to duck and weave around attacks and flare up the fire on their shoulders when cornered. They rapidly cool their fists when they punch, creating additional layers of stone to increase their power.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The flammable gases POKENAME produces are constantly being lit, producing seemingly endless plumes of flame and toxic smoke. If agitated, it releases all of its gas at once; the ensuing explosion creates enough smoke to temporarily block out the sun.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME is covered in a protective outer coating of volcanic rock, allowing its body to safely undergo the metamorphosis process. Once it is nearly ready to evolve, cracks appear and it leaks lava and flames.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The smoke rising from POKENAME's body is dangerously hot. Prolonged exposure can blister skin and melt metal.
author: .izik

entry: Their shells are so dense that they often struggle to move, instead churning their bodies of magma inside to keep it from fully hardening. They defend themselves by releasing Lava Plumes from the many cracks along their shells.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME roam in deep volcanic caves, feeding from lava flows. They often fight with Magmar due to territorial claims.
author: bigoljax

entry: Despite its exterior being made of hardened volcanic rock, POKENAME is incredibly gentle. It is often employed in snowy regions to act as a living heater for workers.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Much of POKENAME's body is comprised of vines made from cooled lava that hardened. It sheds many of these vines weekly to prevent its body from becoming too heavy to move.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's stony pouch is full of high-nutrient lava meant to feed their young. Using shavings from their cooled magma has become a popular and expensive health trend.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME makes its home in small lava pools, using its flame breath to roast small insects that fly too close. If it spots a predator, it spews smoke instead, concealing it for long enough to dive back into its pool.
author: secondegg

entry: Within its shell is a special water-like liquid that is always boiling but can never evaporate, which helps produce steam to keep the rest of its body hot. It can shoot globs of magma and strong fireballs at others with extreme precision.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME resemble some aquatic Pokémon. They swim within rivers of magma or lava and leap out to skewer bird Pokémon with their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: It closely resembles a Paldean Legendary Pokémon. Though this resemblance is purely coincidental, POKENAME's niche is quite similar to said Legendary, as it also swims through pools of lava made from the stone and sand it melts.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is covered in a protective outer coating of volcanic rock, allowing its body to safely undergo the metamorphosis process. Once it is nearly ready to evolve, cracks appear and it leaks lava and flames.
author: pjporwoll

entry: After breaking free from its chrysalis, POKENAME's wings take mere moments to warm enough for flight. It lives on volcanic mountains and prefers to feed from lava pools it has not visited recently, exchanging some of its magma in the process.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are found stuck to the insides of active volcanoes, for that is the only heat enough to keep their bodies from completely hardening. If a volcano begins to go dormant, they will propel themselves with bursts of steam to find a new home.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are typically found stuck to the walls of volcano craters, just below the magma's surface. When out of lava, they must constantly spin the flaming arms on their backs to prevent themselves from hardening.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME can deftly manipulate the lava composing their hands. By hardening the lava into complex shapes, POKENAME perform intricate shadow puppetry, using their bright bodies as a backlight.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME's lava-body has solidified into a protective armor that shields it from the elements. With its wings, it maneuvers swiftly through its hunting grounds, ambushing prey and finishing them with decisive strikes from its molten scythes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME act as surrogate mothers to abandoned eggs, incubating them and raising them. The Pokémon that hatch from these eggs return to visit these POKENAME with gifts of appreciation.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME exhibit very fine control over their temperature. By transferring all the heat from one arm to the other, they create a powerful thermoelectric current and unleash a flurry of blows, both hot and electric.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME makes its home in deep volcanic tunnels. Its molten body keeps the narrow caves perpetually glowing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME patiently waits for creatures to draw near before grabbing them with its stone pincers. Once ensnared, the prey is cooked by lava that comes out from small holes in the pincers' tips.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME has a volatile and aggressive temperament, its slow movement speed makes chasing down targets difficult. It adapted three long tails of pure flame in order to better lash out at those who have gained its ire.
author: sk372

entry: The rhyolitic lava POKENAME's body is full of bubbles, making it slightly buoyant in the water. It occasionally jumps from the sea to vent out the explosive gases inside its body.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME shells are pieces of volcanic rock they've used their magmatic bodies to shape and then wear. They use their acute sense of smell to navigate the tunnels they form in volcanic areas in search of food and to avoid predators.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME often thrash about within the pools of lava they swim within, casting globs of the superhot material all around. The angrier they are, the more flames that erupt across their shells of volcanic rock.
author: infinex21

entry: It has great control over its body temperature and can even cool itself enough to be comfortably ridden by humans. An old folktale tells of a group of POKENAME saving an entire town from a volcanic eruption by ferrying them across the flowing lava.
author: secondegg

entry: While the orange portion of POKENAME's goo can easily transform to mimic opponents, the stone portions require far more concentration. Should it laugh, these stone portions revert, giving away its disguise.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's black stone tail will cease flaming when it comes within 3 feet of any Evolution stone. Unfortunately it walks incredibly slowly, making searches involving one extremely exasperating for anyone involved.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME live near the oceanic coastlines of volcanic areas. The fin-like ends of their tails are actually an ever-flowing stream of fire that only dulls a little when they sleep.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's mane is made up of several spines of cooled and hardened lava. Using electricity, it can fire these off in bursts as paralyzing pointed projectiles, though it requires at least a day to reform a new mane afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME exclusively lives near lava beds, as anything below extreme heat will make it weak and fatigued. Because of its unsafe habitat, studying it is difficult, but researchers have found its hardened skin is very brittle.
author: darxer_

entry: When hiding in its shell, POKENAME appears as little more than a charred cube of stone. Many unsuspecting creatures have gotten burned by being too close when POKENAME decides to emerge from within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stride through lava pools, which provide them with warmth. If they're in cold environments, they will soon perish.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME tucks into the shell on its back at the slightest inconvenience. It likes to soak deep in popular hot springs, which can cause problems when humans accidentally step on it and incite angry retaliation.
author: sk372

entry: Steam from within POKENAME's shell regularly emanates from the spines on said shell. It can increase the pressure within to cause those spikes to fire off at high speeds as a defense mechanism.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cools part of its body into a rocky shell to protect itself while it undergoes metamorphosis. If it is threatened, it releases flames from the cracks in its shell.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME's magma body can fully retreat into its stony shell for protection. It also does so to avoid harming its surroundings.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: POKENAME retreats into its hardened shell to appear innocuous, waiting for something to draw near. Once it does, it springs out from hiding and strikes with its liquid magma arm-scythes.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME mostly live in underground lakes of magma, feeding on either minerals or on weaker Pokémon. By crossing their blades together, they can ignite them both to better fight off foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live on the peaks of extinct volcanoes that have not erupted for centuries. Their presence can sometimes give geologists a fright, as their glowing bodies in sufficient numbers give the summit the appearance of an eruption.
author: vic1312

entry: Their shells are hollow and large, so they can fully withdraw into them if they need to. POKENAME can defend themselves with intense streams of fire and by flinging globs of molten rock.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME draw magma from volcanoes and cool the surrounding air to create magma rock. They tend to craft esoteric sculptures depicting themselves and other Pokémon. Artists will sometimes make pilgrimages to their nesting grounds for inspiration.
author: vic1312

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME's orange body can sometimes be spotted gliding between the clouds. Small drops of lava fall from its body each time it flaps its wings, causing burns to anyone they strike below.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was said to be born of the world's crust, emerging from the first volcano that formed millions of years ago. The flapping of its wings scatters fire and ash, thawing out any stubborn frost at the turn of spring.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME lives within volcanoes, swimming through magma at surprising speeds. It is said to have the power to cause volcanic eruptions, and some have been seen flying into the sky during these events.
author: secondegg

entry: The shell of a POKENAME has a composition similar to sulfur and volcanic rock. Their shells are remarkably hard to the touch and they can release some of their internal heat to further protect themselves as needed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wings often burn at the same rate they regenerate, making any damage to their wings permanent. This makes it all the more important that their stingers are full of hot venom, as they cannot fly away from danger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME seeks isolation from people and Pokémon. Using its psychic powers and volcanic body, POKENAME creates islands to the far north where travel is infrequent and dangerous. It abandons these islands whenever they are discovered.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME lives deep within active volcanoes, resting within a bubble formed of psychically-manipulated magma. When it does venture out, it likes to play with others by blowing lava bubbles from the tip of its tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME whip the flame that issues from their head to defend themselves. POKENAME seek out fragrant vegetation to consume, cutting down the stalks and drying them out. Healthy POKENAME emit a sweet, aromatic smoke thanks to this diet.
author: vic1312

entry: When dead trees begin to rot, POKENAME are among the Pokémon brought in to help. Their favorite food and fuel source involves rotting stumps, which they pry out of the soil and promptly eat.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The sharp stone quills on POKENAME's back burst into flames while it is awake and gradually dim the longer it sleeps. Only during deep slumber can one see them clearly on its back.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls into enemies with its molten lava shell. POKENAME have been found to live in the Earth's core.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME rapidly expel their own heat with explosive force.  Many other wild Pokémon are often agitated by these Pokémon and will attempt to battle them if only to cease their noise.
author: infinex21

entry: It superheats its jaws, allowing it to easily bite through rock and steel alike. Roads passing through POKENAME habitats are often closed due to it destroying vehicles while playing.
author: secondegg

entry: It sits in magma pools, looking for prey to attack. If its prey escapes into water, it will continue to chase, even if its body rapidly cools and hardens.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is a lava-like bird native to volcanic areas; its diet includes rocks, gems, and minerals. Hikers should be careful since it can drop lava from its body when flying high in the sky.
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande

entry: Wild POKENAME conceal themselves alongside rivers of magma and lava, their dorsal rocks helping them to blend in. When prey draws near enough, they will pounce upon them and bite into them with their scalding maws.
author: infinex21

entry: Due to not having legs, POKENAME use their tails as a way to get around. Lava splashes out with each bounce, causing nearby objects to get burnt.
author: bigoljax

entry: A POKENAME moves by withdrawing into its round shell and rolling around. These Pokémon always live in groups, where at least one remains awake while the others sleep.
author: infinex21

entry: It is affectionate and loves to wrap around its Trainer's neck like a scarf.  Unfortunately, because its skin is so blisteringly hot, this only hurts people.
author: bostroms

entry: It is affectionate and loves to wrap around its Trainer's neck like a scarf.  Unfortunately, because its skin is so blisteringly hot, this only hurts people.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME gets so lost in thought that it gets caught in lava flows from the volcanoes it lives in. This does not harm it, but it must wait for the magma to cool into rock before breaking free.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME have an incredibly warm personality, helping those who need to cheer up. They're very useful as temporary therapists for troubled kids.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME leave scalding-hot webs at inconspicuous places to trap and bake prey. The silk from these webs can be spun into clothing that never lose warmth, which is very useful for mountaineers and artic explorers.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME roost in caves near active volcanoes, where they can easily feed on magma. They fly almost silently, the sizzle of their blazing wings serving as the only warning of their approach.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME is known to make nests close to lava pools and often dives into them in search of food. As a result, it is always warm. Its body temperature can melt rocks with one touch, so Trainers are advised to be careful while petting it.
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande

entry: POKENAME are found deep in the ocean, inside underwater volcanoes. They hunt by luring prey in and shocking them with their lure.
author: bigoljax

entry: Its lava-like body contains molten metals that conduct electricity. When excited, it may accidentally erupt, startling it into crying.
author: hophoppip

entry: As their sense of celestial objects has been dulled due to their connection to fire, many POKENAME confuse rocks exploding from volcanoes for falling meteors. POKENAME will dance as the falling rocks hurtle towards them.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME gather together to dive deep into magma chambers within the earth. They do this for fun, as the building pressure leads to erupting lava fountains. This launches the lightweight Pokémon into the air, where they merrily fall to the earth.
author: vic1312

entry: These small Pokémon roll about like eggs with their lower halves made of solid rock. They can vent flames from their lower half to help them roll even faster.
author: infinex21

entry: Because its wings are too small, POKENAME cannot fly long distances. Instead, it can leap high into the air to unleash scorching flames from above. When the fiery plume on its forehead weakens, it returns to the magma to restore its strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although its wool is incredibly hot to the touch, it will cool down if it is sheared. Even when cool, this wool is a very effective insulator, and many use it to make winter clothing.
author: secondegg

entry: Their magmatic bodies are always bubbling as they move. They wear caps made of volcanic rock to protect their otherwise-exposed brains.
author: infinex21

entry: Within their bodies are ever-roaring flames and heat intense enough to melt some metals. Parts of their own bodies have solidified to protect themselves, though they have shown to be able to shed pieces of these cooled parts and fling them at others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have internal magma that bubbles around their necks and pools at their feet. They carry a heat-resistant gem within their rolled-up tail that occasionally crackles with electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have flowing manes of magma that can tear free and be hurled at opponents. The orb atop their heads is highly heat-resistant and electrically conductive.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found in regions with volcanoes, dancing around the crater rims. Studies have found that their leaves have the same consistency as volcanic ash.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The bubbles POKENAME make are warm to the touch, but not as hot as its body is. Some parents use POKENAME as bubble machines in the cold months, entertaining their children while keeping them warm.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME use their large ears to listen to noises deep underground, guiding them towards water. POKENAME sometimes mistakenly follow the sound of rock melting into magma, causing many POKENAME to gather at a volcano just before it erupts.
author: npshi

entry: It tries to maintain the appearance of a dangerous spout of lava, but in reality, its body has a more rubber-like consistency, and it is mostly harmless. It despises getting its shell wet, as it risks getting the flames it stores there extinguished.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME can use their cooled down magma as temporary lilypads to get across rivers. These ingneous rocks give nutrients to the water they're left in.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME aimlessly glides with the wind, scattering seeds encased in volcanic rock across the region. If caught in a downdraft, its landing ignites nearby flora, often sparking wildfires in drought-stricken areas.
author: dodoowner_

entry: As it gets hotter, POKENAME floats higher towards the sun. Coincidentally as this happens the bubbling lava plume from its stony petals expands as well, creating a cycle causing it to get even warmer and float even higher.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It fills its rocky arms with hot air, allowing it to lift off the ground. If one of its arms is damaged, it will spit hot lava on it, then patiently wait for it to cool back into rock.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME scurries around volcanic regions, searching for food during the day, while hiding in small cracks at night. It gnaws on rocks to whittle down its teeth, occasionally melting right through them in the process.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME viciously slaps people and Pokémon with its molten rock tail when threatened. Normally, it is a very playful creature.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME lies in shallow lava pools, absorbing energy from the heat. It stays perfectly still in the process, leading many to mistake it for a rock.
author: secondegg

entry: It absorbs energy from sunlight, storing it in the shell on its back and releasing it as warmth. It is said that on even the coldest nights, standing near a POKENAME feels like a warm, sunny day.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME produces a burning hot slime over its body. Historically, people have collected this as when it cools it becomes an antibacterial gel. A much cheaper, vegan version is now produced synthetically, though many bottles use POKENAME imagery.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are incredibly clumsy, tripping over their own feet and causing their lava to fling everywhere. Though due to their lava cooling down more quickly than normal, they don't cause harm to those around it.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME rests near lava pools, using psychic energy to lift globs of lava and drop them onto itself when it feels it is cooling down. Oddly, the lava forming its body is cool to the touch if it respects the Trainer making contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are oddly enthralled with the moon, causing them to stay so still that their lava-like bodies cool and harden by the next morning. They rapidly expel their internal heat to break their own shells until they repeat the process the next night.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME obsesses over the trinkets of others, but the heavy weight of its stone parts limits its ability to pilfer. Incensed by this limitation, it settles for spitting globs of lava at the trinkets and melting them so nobody can have them.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's lava expands with every new fact it learns, which then hardens and becomes its shell. Specific pieces of shell contain specific bits of information, which can be damaged, lost, or even traded between POKENAME.
author: staghorn

entry: These small Pokémon are common near volcanic areas, ash-clad plains, and even some mines. They expel flames from their rear to propel themselves at greater speeds as they search for coal and other flammable materials to feed on.
author: infinex21

entry: The gray leaves that poke out from beneath POKENAME's shell are always covered with a fine layer of ash. It is quite protective of them, often lashing out at those too close with vines made of lava.
author: sk372

entry: The upper pair of POKENAME's stone teeth grows much quicker than its bottom pair since they are closer to its dripping magma. Due to this, it awkwardly chews on objects using only its top pair to keep them in size with its bottom pair.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME like to spook people who explore caves by mimicking a babies cry. They then come out of nowhere, blowing fire at the explorers and causing them to run off.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME levitate above lava pools in circles with others of their kind, occasionally spelling words seemingly by coincidence. Some Mediums believe they serve as spiritual conduits for those who perished in the flames long ago.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consider themselves untouchable, due to their bodies almost being made entirely of lava. However, they never take water into consideration as a threat.
author: bigoljax

entry: Although its front half reaches temperatures of up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit, its back half is surprisingly cool, even able to be touched without protective gear. To keep both halves happy, it dips its head into lava, while the tail stays clear.
author: secondegg

entry: This Pokémon is most famous for its use as exploding cannonballs during the war.
author: naga_sake

entry: POKENAME often float upside-down within pools of lava, watching for any prey to walk by. When they spot prey, they launch themselves with flames from the top of their heads and crash down on them with explosive power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hide within large shells made of solid, volcanic rock with ports of cooled, molten ores extending along their sides. They let loose streams of flames or globs of magma from these ports at opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fill in the lower shells of Forretresses that they often prey upon. They must release excess heat from their side ports and from their upper shells to avoid melting their lower, metal shells.
author: infinex21

entry: The stone drill at the end of POKENAME's tail grows white hot when spinning. It uses this to break apart coal deposits for consumption.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's claws are made of thick stone that begins to heat up when it grabs a foe. Once latched on, the claws grow hot enough to cause intense burns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feeds exclusively on volcanic rock. Its powerful jaws crush stone into magma with every bite, heating the stone beyond its melting point.
author: .izik

entry: In nature, POKENAME's constantly billowing skirt serves as a warning not to come near.  As a pet, however, many find the movement mesmerizing.  A well-trained POKENAME will growl to remind the doting trainer not to touch it with bare hands.
author: imaginita

entry: If POKENAME determines the lava pool it is bathing in is cooling down, it throws a tantrum like a child. During this time it splashes in all directions, making its surroundings incredibly hazardous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME propel themselves forward by releasing extremely hot flames from their rears. They puff out their magmatic bodies and use hard quills to overpower larger opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: The ever-dripping bodies of POKENAME are formed from molten metal derived from ore-rich rocks they consume. They release streams of intense heat from their pincers to fend off aggressors.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME stores berries in its shell and boils them as it consumes them, producing a sweet-smelling, jam-like substance that coats its arms. It cautiously gives the jam out to other Pokémon in exchange for helping it find berries in arid climates.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton enables it to camouflage itself in magma. At the right time, it jumps out and attacks prey with its horn.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME has little way to defend itself aside from its body heat, so it steals the shells of Magcargo. It knows these shells are quite brittle, so it breaks them over its opponent's head and escapes in a cloud of dust and smoke.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A small shell of hardened magma has formed on POKENAME earlier than usual. The weight added to its small form makes it more difficult to stay moving and to resist its skin cooling and hardening.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are naturally quite sluggish and don't move very often. Their bodies are scorching hot, so anyone traveling through volcanic areas should avoid stepping on them.
author: fireblade141

entry: The viscosity of POKENAME's body depends entirely upon how rich in silica its diet is. POKENAME with a diet rich in silica have dense shells but move extremely slowly, whilst those with a silica-poor diet are faster but have softer shells.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's shell is a miniature volcano, and it grows as the Pokémon ages. Eventually, it will become too heavy for the POKENAME to move, forcing it to stay in one spot for the rest of its life.
author: kiwiarms

entry: This self fusion of Magcargo is so hot that the ground it travels instantly melts into lava.  The the cooled lava is extremely nutrient-rich.  Some legends say it intentionally destroys old, barren lands so that better things can grow.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME drips lava from its beak into burrows to scare prey to exit the other entrances, where it can snap them up. The hardened rock shell limits its aerial mobility, but does limit the chance of it causing inadvertent wildfires.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's large nose helps them find berries hidden in the dirt. They then rest their noses onto their food, slowly cooking them.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's shell and tusks are very brittle; cracks in them can either spew 2,000°C molten lava from its body or blow unexpectedly cold gusts from trapped winds within. Hikers are often seen accompanied by it, as one of their ace Pokémon.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME lives in deep ocean trenches, feeding on geothermal energy produced by volcanic activity. Entire ecosystems are often centered around POKENAME, as many deep-sea creatures rely on the energy and warmth it produces.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME thrives on volcanic islands, extending its magma body from the stone base to better absorb heat and volcanic ash. It retracts into the stone and flips itself over to hide and protect itself when it senses danger.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME uses the intense pressure inside its shell to shoot lava with impressive accuracy and range.  It simultaneously expels some magma from cracks in the back of its shell, so that the recoil doesn't send the POKENAME flying.
author: imaginita

entry: To avoid predators, POKENAME lives in undersea volcanoes, storing magma in its shell. By expelling the magma from its siphon, it can subdue prey and escape foes.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME has a good heart, but it's very clumsy, so many mistake its goodhearted actions for bad jokes. They genuinely think that giving coal as a gift to nice children on holidays is a good idea and something that will make them happy.
author: epping_forest

entry: Because their rocky bodies weigh them down, POKENAME fly low over the ocean, barely skimming the surface. Drops of lava that fall from their wings into water become flawless black glass.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME spends its whole life learning to fly properly with its molten body. Once it does, it glows with happiness; so bright that the people of Johto occasionally mistake it for Ho-oh.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME coordinate in large packs with varied cries when hunting. They work together to drive prey much larger than themselves off cliffs, relying on the impact to disable their meal. If the fall is not fatal, POKENAME close in to roast the Pokémon.
author: vic1312

entry: The dens of POKENAME are often mistaken for lava tubes by geologists. This is due to their habit of smoothing the stone they sleep upon with their heat. When truly threatened, they can fully retract their magma bodies into their shells.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME are serpentine Pokémon that burrow through volcanic rock, their bodies kept molten hot by the magma they so often come near. The bubbling liquid of their bodies is a corrosive substance that easily melts through obsidian.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often lurk in the depths of the sea, favoring underwater volcanoes. Few prey Pokémon live around these volcanoes, so POKENAME get their nutrients from eating volcanic gas.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME can spit incredibly hot lava from its trunk at great distances. Should this fail to deter a foe, it rolls away leaving burning trails behind it.
author: .izik

entry: Due to POKENAME's intense heat, their tusks have the ability to melt through metal. They've been seen melting through food trucks, eating whatever they carry.
author: bigoljax

entry: It used to be a very popular and protective firewall. Scientists turned it into a Pokémon, and POKENAME was born.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Due to their molten bodies, POKENAME's horns have adapted to have a igneous rock layering. They use these horns to lift fallen trees out the way for young Pokémon during forest fires.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME is a quirky being who will doodle on just about anything. After finishing a piece of art, it sets it on fire, with the flames becoming a variety of different colors in a dazzling display.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spins on its head at ten miles per hour, casting bits of magma around to form a defensive perimeter. It takes hits with its hard, igneous body, then counters with fancy kicks.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME analyzes new objects and people by kissing them. Though not especially dangerous, this can be painful and problematic due to the burns a POKENAME's kiss will leave behind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME typically hold their arms up like torches as flames pour out from the openings at the ends. When they spin their arms, they generate electricity from their two horns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feeds on the eyes of its prey, incorporating each eye into its body as it ages. The last glimpse of sunlight in each eye fuels its fiery glow, casting an eerie light in the dark as it slithers through the forest.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME demonstrate great control over the temperature of their flames. Because of this, they can be trained for many different jobs, ranging from cooking, to metalwork, to even a personal heater.
author: secondegg

entry: Despite having a body comprised mostly of magma, POKENAME is able to be milked using heat-resistant mechanisms. The warm milk produced by POKENAME is perpetually hot, unable to be cooled by any modern means.
author: sk372

entry: The stones that POKENAME keeps in the pouch on its stomach are highly valued by physical therapists. Just by laying the stones on an aching muscle or joint, all pain will go away, and the person will be filled with a deep sense of calm.
author: notadoctor75

entry: These bestial Pokémon trot through volcanic fields with plumes of thick, black smoke bellowing from the ports of volcanic rock atop their backs. Their black smoke crackles with red, "dirty" lightning that often scares away most would-be foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is incredibly skittish, fleeing at the sight of most humans. It bellows out clouds of pitch black smoke to conceal its presence while traveling.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME prowls volcanic ranges, dormant magma chambers will begin to stir. Ancient records spin tales of witnessing its blazing silhouette and earth-shattering roar on the mountainsides whenever the land reshaped itself in ash and fire.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME wields the unique power to turn any water source into a boiling pool of lava. Despite its destructive power, POKENAME is a gentle guardian, creating new habitats for other Fire Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME veil themselves and others with a black smoke that is surprisingly pure of pollutants. Their horns of volcanic rock help them to channel their internal heat and flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use the eye holes carved into their shells as a way of intimidation. But in case it doesn't work, they spit out lava at their predators.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME claim entire volcanos as their territory, due to thinking their strength can fully prove these claims. However, they're often defeated by Magmortar due to their lack of speed.
author: bigoljax

entry: Wild POKENAME live within volcanoes to keep most of their magmatic bodies from ever cooling and hardening. Their internal heat can grow so intense that their mouths will erupt with flames that rival the heat of raw magma.
author: infinex21

entry: The magma in its body, gathered from undersea vents, is a near limitless source of heat energy. With one flap of its wings, it can unleash heat waves and droughts that last for months.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The face-like patterns on the hardened part of their bodies will burst into flames to startle prey and predator alike. The mouths of these faces can spew the bubbling, corrosive material of their bodies to quickly melt their prey and drink them up.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are common in towns near the base of volcanoes, often playing a sport resembling hockey in the streets at night. It seems they do this in part to knock over streetlamps so they can feast on the electricity.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME ingest and melt rocks within their crop, a stomach-like organ located within their throat, allowing them to absorb the minerals necessary for sustaining their flames. POKENAME use the magma byproduct as a nasty, burning projectile in battle.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME is said to not be from this time, as its body seems to be adapted to a prehistoric planet bathed in magma. No one knows how it is still around in the modern day.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its heavy appearance, the shell on POKENAME's tail is actually very light and hollow. Young POKENAME use their tails as boats to safely float down lava flows and rivers.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME love to look for sweet fruits, cooking them with their bodies. This often attracts other POKENAME who bring their own fruits, causing a feast to happen.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME create fists made of hardened magma by cooling their molten appendages in water. POKENAME can use these fists to handle food, fight off threats, and even warm surfaces they touch.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME are rare, typically found in groups of up to three called covens, and inhabit volcanic calderas. Folklore says that it is best to leave them alone as angering them may lead to a fiery curse being laid upon you.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are rare, typically found in groups of up to three called covens, and inhabit volcanic calderas. Folklore says that it is best to leave them alone as angering them may lead to a fiery curse being laid upon you.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME and its grunts hunt and live around hot springs and volcanic calderas. The wind beneath their magma wings reaches 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Landing in trees can result in forest fires.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME sob hot, magma tears that cool slowly and are employed in spa retreats as a result. They are placed in steam rooms to produce sauna stones or paired with a massage therapist to assist with hot stone massages.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME's heavy lower body prevents it from moving too quickly. Sensitive at heart, it cries often, shedding tears of fire that may end up burning some of its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have exceptional skills at fire breathing, making them common in carnivals. The tips of their hats are also used to burn the wicks of cannons.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME carries an egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch, warming the stone with its high body heat. Place a POKENAME stone into a pool to create an instant restorative hot spring.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME can use its tail to absorb thermal energy from lava and electric energy from the atmosphere.  It will discharge excess energy by planting its tail into the ground, so the ground around a POKENAME's nest quickly becomes barren.
author: imaginita

entry: Due to its high body heat, POKENAME's metabolism runs extremely fast. It must eat constantly, even waking during the night, to ensure that it consumes enough calories to grow.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME swims about in magma pools without a care. It often floats on its back, sunning itself and keeping its rocky underside dry and brittle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are incredibly bold creatures, due to the natural protection their magma gives them. Researchers have occasionally found them challenging Garchomp.
author: bigoljax

entry: The fused parts of POKENAME's bodies provide a rich supply of molten, magnetic rock. They generate balls of fire that they launch from their small arms at opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME loves to play the instrument it carries around. People pay to see it perform at a safe distance, so as not to be burned by magma it spits out. Its music is said to sound like a saxophone mixed with a didgeridoo.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME fires heavy chunks of hardened lava from the holes in its palms to deter attackers. It uses its own magma to do this, so repeated firing in a short time causes its body mass to visibly decrease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are giant blobs of moving magma lined with volcanic rock. They live in lava pits and use their stretchable arms to ensnare any prey that wanders too close.
author: infinex21

entry: Because of their high temper, POKENAME can cause mass destruction when aggravated. They mix their magma with their electricity, creating magma balls that explode when they make contact with any surface.
author: bigoljax

entry: A large amount of liquid magma is stored within the shell on POKENAME's back. These stores connect directly to its hands, allowing it to spray magma from its arms to fend off any dangers that it faces.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings constantly spread fire wherever it goes. They can even create a smaller version of a fire whirl if they spin fast enough.
author: bigoljax

entry: Its shell is the toughest part of its body.  The rest of its hide isn't as tough, but in exchange, POKENAME can shoot fire through the cracks.  Its soft underbelly allows it to absorb geothermal energy from volcanoes.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME's stone body chunks weigh it down heavily, so it spends much of the day at rest. When it goes to hunt, wings of flame temporarily erupt and let it take flight and knock out prey with its heavy stone tail.
author: sk372

entry: The plant life on its ears and tail have been severely burned. It still retains a strong connection with nature through the hardened mud on its feet.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be found in arctic environments, staring out at ice structures while enjoying the cold air. To prevent their bodies from hardening in the cold, their tail is kept aflame to keep their body hot.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: From its stone-forged claws, POKENAME can fire boiling lava projectiles capable of melting nearly anything. Its wings allow it to fly in complete silence, catching prey off guard.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The armor in POKENAME's face and tusks is made of molten lava cooled by repeated exposure to blizzards. An extremely rare and powerful Pokémon that has only been spotted during volcanic eruptions, stampeding across the landscape with fiery stomps.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are kept afloat by a weak magnetic force. They dance erratically through volcanic fields, flicking droplets of their molten bodies about.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are shy creatures, usually keeping to themselves. If threatened however, they bash their aggressors with their hardened tails.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME are very rarely spotted in tropical regions such as Alola. They sleep in volcanic tunnels and hunt in the jungle. While typically slow-moving, they may strike with sudden swiftness when necessary.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME practice their kicks by making their own targets out of magma. Some can get strong enough to break these targets in half.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME can curl up into its shell and roll wildly around the battlefield, letting loose jets of lava to disorient its enemies.  Then, when it senses an opening, it will leap at an opponent with intense slashes.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME train as often as they physically can, running around the volcanoes they call home. They also train against fallen logs, loosing multiple kicks per second into the wood. Foragers gather the remains, as the logs become premium charcoal.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME slowly waits for the perfect moment in combat before retaliating with blindingly fast counterattacks. When not in battle, it enjoys meditating within pools of molten magma.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to mindlessly chew on molten rock regularly given to them by their mothers. This gives them something to pass the time while their mothers look for actual food.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME crosses over bodies of water by using its dripping lava to turn the liquids into steaming cobblestone. While this stone is very brittle and shatters easily, which may cause POKENAME to fall, its sure footing makes this trek relatively safe.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME submerges itself almost completely in lava pools, its favorite spot to relax and keep its body coated with fresh magma. Rocky parts of its body that fall off are consumed to regain nutrients.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gains energy from positive emotions.  Especially warm feelings will cause its body to billow with ripples of magma.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME can often be seen dancing around the edges of volcanic craters.  They use their psychokinetic powers to amplify heat mirages and create illusions of idyllic scenery.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME stretches its arms wide before teleporting. It always seems to leave behind a few drops of lava when it does.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is usually covered in a cool, brittle outer layer of hardened magma.  If its Trainer is in danger, however, it will erupt into flame, shattering its carapace with power said to be greater than a hundred volcanoes.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME have expansive bodies made of magma within the mound-like shell they lug around. They rarely emerge from their shells for long, unless around their Trainer or their friends.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are valiant protectors, always on guard near their trainers side. The swords they carry are hot enough to melt through stone.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME leaps to the defense of those in need, reinforcing its body with magma.  It can skillfully direct this magma to quickly fill and repair any cracks in its armor, even in the heat of battle.
author: imaginita

entry: Their magmatic bodies inhabit shells of volcanic rock that resemble the discarded shell of certain Bug-type Pokémon. It is not entirely known how they float, but most assume they exude such raw heat that it keeps them in the air.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flash signals to others of their kind with their glowing-hot ears. They will defend themselves by spitting globs of a hot, corrosive material at threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have extremely cold blood, so they coat themselves in hot lava whenever they leave their volcanic homes to avoid freezing in cooler climates. They communicate with each other by cooling and reheating their magma into rocky patterns.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME can be found in industrial settings where the constant flow of work keeps them busy. They love handling metal because it gives them a sense of purpose while also giving them practice with their fiery powers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the magma in its body like fuel, propelling itself towards others of its kind to combine and evolve. They have been seen soaring across the night sky.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME are difficult to surprise because of their calm disposition. This seriousness makes them a great fit for factory settings where they shape metal into parts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME ever needs more magma, it uses its magnetic powers to shift tectonic plates and forcibly erupt small volcanoes. Their bodies are twice the temperature of boiled steel.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Factory workers are almost never cold when POKENAME are around, as their body heat radiates far from their bodies. They take the task of cutting shapes out of metal seriously, so much so that some POKENAME forget to take breaks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME has four reservoirs of lava inside its body, each containing a separate brain. The process of forming a new POKENAME is so hot that it can disrupt weather satellite readings.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME regularly gnaw on volcanic rocks to wear down their teeth. Trainers that raise them need to supply them with a steady source of rocks. Otherwise, they grow bored and begin gnawing on furniture around the Trainers' home.
author: vic1312

entry: Chunks of stone and magma swirl endlessly above POKENAME's core stone. Should these components retract into the stone, it means somewhere in the world a volcano is about to erupt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emit immense heat, capable of melting rocks with a touch. Despite its fiery exterior, it maintains Lucario's agility and combat prowess.
author: sheogorath

entry: Whenever POKENAME find themselves in a volcano, they eventually become the apex predator due to their strength. However, if Pokémon like Magmortar and Arcanine are in the area, POKENAME will quickly leave before a confrontation.
author: bigoljax

entry: The heat-treated cleavers on POKENAME's arms can rip through steel with ease. Exercise extreme caution when approaching; their hot-tempered disposition is not to be underestimated.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME sleeps within lava pools, the stone shell on its back protruding above the surface. Tiny flowers will sometimes grow from the shell, indicating it is in good health.
author: .izik

entry: The flames that POKENAME release from the ports along their backs emit a sickening scent that makes them less desirable to predators. The tips of their claws carry a poison that causes intense burning sensations.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hides much of its body mass within a stone shell that resembles Mawile. It makes itself seem unimposing before a massive mouth made of lava lunges out from within to swallow up its unwary target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are ambush predators. Living at the bottom of the sea, they allow their upper exterior to harden into stone. When it senses prey nearby, it launches out tentacles of lava, creating steam explosions that stun its prey.
author: wiz0z

entry: Despite their magma bodies, POKENAME enjoy being submerged and are often found residing near hydrothermal vents in the deep sea. Early Trainers would house POKENAME in large, elevated vats near their homes, creating primitive hot water heaters.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME possess hardened magma armor of incredible strength. That, paired with their enormous claws, makes them a powerhouse of defense and offense. They are highly prized by Bug-Type specialists for their strength.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME are always clad in flames due to how hot their magmatic bodies are. They live on land, but dive into magma and lava in search of prey.
author: infinex21

entry: The stone shell on POKENAME's head bursts into flames when it rams into a foe. Sometimes it rams with such force that chunks of the shell break off, taking days to regrow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bash their heads into the sides of rocks, cracking their stone domes open on purpose. This helps them get rid of any built up fire from past battles.
author: bigoljax

entry: The helmets POKENAME wear are tough, but can be prone to cracking. They make their helmets by spitting out lava into water, then carving out a hole to fit onto their heads.
author: bigoljax

entry: The shield of hardened magma on their front absorbs the strength of frontal attacks as a layer of liquid magma distributes the force through their whole body. The forces acting on their bodies pressurize the lava they blast in retaliation.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME's armor is made from hardened magma, allowing them to burn any assailant using physical attacks. They are known to eat flaming berries to increase their temperature.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: These large Pokémon dwell under volcanic areas, where the constant heat is enough to keep their bodies from completely hardening. They have to rest often due to how much heat they produce internally.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are the common protectors of many Pokémon that live within volcanic areas. They use the rocky shells of their bodies to guard against attacks and counterattack with Fire Punches.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love to fly up on magma erupting from volcanoes and spend their life travelling from thrill to thrill. Onix have learned that seeing a POKENAME is a sign to quickly vacate the area, as magma is sometimes diverted into their tunnels.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Despite POKENAME's body being incredibly hot and covered in lava, the surface of its skull-like mask never exceeds 80 degrees. Should the mask fall off, it will panic and drop everything to get it back on as quickly as possible.
author: .izik

entry: Folklore states that POKENAME is cursed, lava that gained malevolent sentience and inhabited a stone body. It hypnotizes those that gaze into its eye, trying to lure them to walk into pools of magma.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spews flames up to 10,000 degrees, incinerating anything it consumes. Despite how dangerous they are to be around, POKENAME are quite helpful in garbage disposal.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon has the ability to melt into flowing lava to move. They are extremely heavy, and should not be touched at all.
author: themicelegion

entry: Each POKENAME's unique mineral composition perfectly matches matter recovered from meteor impact sites. The flames on its body can never be extinguished, even at the bottom of the sea.
author: _pixelar_

entry: During the late autumn season, POKENAME can be found munching on leaves that have fallen from trees. If a leaf crunches loudly, they increase their flame size and bounce in joy.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The shell on its back is made of nutrient-rich volcanic soil. Although the heat of POKENAME's body prevents anything from growing directly on it, it will gladly allow its Trainer to scrape off some soil for their own garden.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will cool its body down while it is sleeping, causing it to resemble a statue. Its awakening with the sunrise is accompanied by a flash of light and loud cracking. Some mountain towns use this as a means of keeping time.
author: wiz0z

entry: The insides of the ears of these Pokémon are the hottest parts of their bodies, often glowing bright. The hardened casing along their backs is difficult to break but will reform within a day's time if somehow broken.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME like to steal fancy looking chairs, mimicking rulers as they sit upon them. They quickly run off as soon as the owners try to get the chair back.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME train their agility relentlessly, working to limber up their magma bodies. Their training makes them dedicated partners for experienced trainers, and their burning hot limbs complement their advanced martial techniques.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME are prone to tripping a lot, causing the slits on their heads to burst out lava. This often makes them burst out in tears until their mothers come to soothe them.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME and their hatchlings live beside lava lakes. Whenever these lakes solidify, POKENAME will march for miles in search of a new home. They are very particular about the makeup of the lava they live in.
author: wiz0z

entry: A stream of lava-like mucus drips from POKENAME's nose. When exposed to cold air, it hardens into glossy black rock.
author: .izik

entry: The lava constantly dripping from its nose replenishes the hard outer shell of POKENAME's body. If it catches a cold, nobody is safe.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME occasionally delves deeper underground to raise its temperature to 18,000 degrees F and strategically cools its back into a hard sheath.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The twin swords of POKENAME coordinate their combat telepathically. When defending, they harden their rocky outer shells, but when attacking, they shed the shells to slash and burn foes with blades of lava.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME are considered sacred in the Alola region. When they descend from their homes in the lava flows, they burn away the old foliage and leave behind fertile soil for new growth. This irregular event is celebrated with a festival.
author: wiz0z

entry: A POKENAME's body is within both the hardened shell and the hammer. Though the mind is split between the two, they work in perfect unison.
author: flagbearer

entry: POKENAME have remarkably hot bodies that are always in a cycle of hardening and melting. They vent excess heat through open-tipped spikes along their backs, which may also propel them forward to jab opponents with their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME reforge their blades using the heat of their magma bodies after each hunt. They are sometimes ambushed by rivals when maintaining their blades. POKENAME who can fend off attacks with dull blades are considered apex specimens in the wild.
author: vic1312
