entry: POKENAME lives in hydrothermal vents, ascending from the seabed only for mating season. A POKENAME never stops growing.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME lie still in coral reefs, gently swaying their heads and wings with the current. When prey swims close, both heads snap with incredible speed.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sits near coral reefs, pretending to be part of it in order to lure in fish Pokémon to eat. It can go several weeks between meals, waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike. Despite its clunky appearance, it is quite fast underwater.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME desires to share the starry sky with the deep-sea Pokémon it grows up with. It uses its immense psychic powers to maintain its friends' habitat.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: It can dive deeper than most humans and Pokémon thanks to its hard, submarine-like shell. These deep-sea explorations help it discover hidden wonders of the ocean floor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sing crooning melodies within coral reefs, gently encouraging the regrowth of damaged habitats. Their presence within a reef is viewed as a good sign that the ecosystem is healthy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The coral on its head rarely grows to full size. Because of its disproportionate body, POKENAME frequently trips and breaks its horns.
author: char_latte3412

entry: The rotation of POKENAME's two halves has an interesting effect on coral populations. As long as POKENAME is rotating near, coral reefs seem to flourish more and show an increase in their growth rate.
author: sk372

entry: When threatened by a predator, POKENAME releases a cloud of foam to obscure its body. While it's hidden, the coral polyps on its body rapidly rearrange into the shape of a scarier Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sing crooning melodies within coral reefs, gently encouraging the regrowth of damaged habitats. Their presence within a reef is viewed as a good sign that the ecosystem is healthy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Wild POKENAME wander along the seabed, the coral atop their backs filtering nutrients from the water to keep them and their host nourished. They can release powerful streams of water from various parts of their bodies to repel enemies.
author: infinex21

entry: After a rainy day, the branches atop POKENAME's head unravel, releasing bubbles into the air. This Pokémon lives by tide pools and loves to bask in the bright sun.
author: pizzarcato

entry: POKENAME often cluster in warm water coral reefs in small groups. The coral flowers on their bodies and horns are able to absorb toxic poisons from the water and release clean water back into oceans.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: The jelly-like membrane on POKENAME's body possesses powerful restorative properties. If injured, it secretes a special fluid that allows it to heal itself instantly with Recover.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found in coastal cave areas, being highly active on sunny days. It hunts for small fish that typically mill near Corsola herds, snatching them from the water to drink their blood.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a tricksy predator that inhabits coral reefs. Smaller Pokémon seeking shelter in the branches on its backside are quickly snapped up by its beak and consumed.
author: hophoppip

entry: As POKENAME rolls across the seafloor, its horns leave deep protrusions in the sand, which are used by some Pokémon as burrows. It releases bubbles filled with a poisonous gas to propel itself forward.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as large masses of coral to lure lesser underwater Pokémon. They seem particularly fond of Mareanie and feast upon them so often that their own bodies have begun to develop toxic elements.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's bright coloring makes it stand out in murkier waters, making it struggle to sneak up on prey in dark areas. In shallow coral reefs, however, it's the perfect ambush predator.
author: sivanandi

entry: It's said POKENAME are children who have died in mishaps around the ocean. People near oceans have reported a voice luring them to jump in the water.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This kind-hearted Pokémon cares for and protects any fish Pokémon, allowing them to hide away in its seaweed from predators.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: POKENAME are only found on secluded shores in the pitch-black of night. Interestingly, they mostly spend time playing on the beach for their own enjoyment.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bubbles that make up POKENAME's wings are filled with an odorless gas that allows it to drift effortlessly through the air. When startled, it releases a burst of this gas to change direction quickly.
author: regulavish

entry: POKENAME spends its days tending to the miniature ecosystem on its back. Its back houses various corals, aquatic plants, and Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Using its sturdy form, POKENAME scavenges the ocean floors for dead coral and abandoned metal from ships. By attaching these things to its body, POKENAME has created a living ecosystem of coral on its body.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME resides in ocean areas that see the largest amounts of sunlight over a single day. Vibrant rainbow-colored beams of light can be fired from the holes at the end of its huge hands.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME plops down in the middle of sunny beaches to soak up the warmth of the sun's rays. It thrashes about if someone tries to move it, with great strength that belies its small stature.
author: sk372

entry: It attaches itself to drifting icebergs, floating across frigid waters. This journey takes it to distant oceans where it establishes new reefs.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME come together in order to mimic coral reefs. Any Pokémon that seek to hide in their reefs are consumed.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The flexible coral of POKENAME's tentacles regenerates even faster than its rigid branches do. When a coral branch grows long enough, POKENAME snaps it off and devours it with apparent delight.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME hides in reefs, blending in among the different colors. It also allows sea life to hide within its bunker if predators are around.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME that live in the desert store water efficiently in their hardened bodies. Their spines have become less sharp and taken on a rock-like sturdiness over time.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME is a rarely seen Pokémon that dwells in warm oceans and sings in a beautiful voice. When marine biologists approach it, it guides them to areas plagued by pollution.
author: hophoppip

entry: It makes its home near piers, weaving through barnacles and pilings. The colorful reefs it maintains attract both tourists and Pokémon alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME form bubbles of water on their backs, keeping the coral on their bodies hydrated while they are out of water. Many smaller Pokémon make their homes in these bubbles, feeding on the coral.
author: santon5512

entry: When tired, POKENAME lies flat on the seafloor, resembling coral. It anchors itself by digging a claw into the sand to resist strong currents.
author: .izik

entry: It soaks up liquids into its body like a sponge, including oils and other biohazards it is not meant to digest. The most common way to cure these ailments is to give them an Antidote mixed with juice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME blows hot steam bubbles at anyone who gets too close to its coral reef. It gets nervous very easily, so it is recommended for particularly patient Trainers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The coral POKENAME holds in its tail is plucked from the reef where it grew up. The bubbles it emits can be used like a crystal ball for POKENAME to scry through.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Using its powerful psychic abilities, POKENAME defends its home by trapping intruders inside the bubbles from its staff and moving them far away. Those who continue to intrude are met with a mighty Bubble Beam barrage until they leave.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are extremely cautious, hopping between tidepools in search of the cleanest and safest waters. Seeing them in fresh water is extremely rare because they swim out to sea to try and avoid human interference or pollution.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The coral on its body can shift in color to match any background. It can remain motionless for hours or even days, kept alive by the energy its coral supplies.
author: hophoppip

entry: When exhausted from swimming, POKENAME perches atop buoys, wrapping itself in seaweed to block the harsh sunlight. If it overheats, it will drop into the water and sink to the seafloor to cool down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can manipulate the calcium carbonate found in seawater to create beautiful coral reefs. Many Pokémon will come to live in these reefs and will revere POKENAME as their queen.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME make their home at the highest point of a coral reef, their rocky growths a combination of living coral and shimmering pearl. Reefs with a healthy POKENAME are said to be among the most beautiful natural wonders in the world.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The delicate coral on POKENAME's body regularly breaks off and regrows. Necklaces made from its coral are said to bring romantic feelings to the wearer.
author: .izik

entry: The coral reefs where POKENAME reside glitter like rainbows under the light, making them a popular scuba-diving spot. Some activists want to make these reefs inaccessible to the public in order to preserve them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is quick and agile, whether it's running or swimming. After being fused by a human, a POKENAME will run around excitedly for hours, likely fulfilling the dreams of the stiff-shelled Corsola.
author: hophoppip

entry: If POKENAME absorb toxic chemicals from pollution, the coral on their head turns white and they get a nasty headache until their body processes the toxin. Without the support of conservationists, many would lose their lives to the toxic chemicals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim around coral reefs to protect coral reefs, attacking ships that release toxic chemicals into the water. Even when equipped with just rocks and jets of water, these rudimentary deterrents are effective at stopping illegal dumping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's head serves as a living biodome for small marine Pokémon. It constantly adjusts the temperature and acidity of the water in its head to keep its inhabitants thriving.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its body is covered in hard scales made from calcium carbonate. Its preferred food is a species of plankton theorized to be the closest relative of common plankton in ancient times.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's beautiful kelp mane is a safe haven for small Pokémon. It guards colonies of Corsola, scaring off predators with its powerful bark.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME lives a peaceful life on sandy beaches across Kanto. When startled, POKENAME dives underwater to hide. It can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: It stores the debris it sucks up while cleaning the corals it inhabits inside its body, keeping them healthy and thriving. Whenever POKENAME spots a human, it immediately flees, as it is an exceptionally elusive and wary creature.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME secrete an alluring scent from their bodies, attracting smaller fish. These fish will make their homes within their mouths, feeding on debris and algae.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME thrives in tropical waters, basking in the sun by raising its tentacles above the surface during the day. This behavior helps it absorb vital sunlight for its coral to grow strong.
author: .izik

entry: Its tentacles secrete acid, dissolving anything unfortunate enough to touch them. This defensive trait makes it a formidable presence in the ocean.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often always rolling along the seabed, even if they crash into formations of coral or underwater rocks. Anything they roll over, or into, often ends up stuck to their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: It gallops across the seafloor alongside its herd, with the fastest among them rising to lead the group. POKENAME nurtures the coral reefs it calls home by warming the surrounding water with its scorching breath.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Using its psychic powers, it splashes itself with water whenever it gets too dry. This curious habit keeps it refreshed even far from the shore.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME decorate their shell-covered tails with coral bits and discarded shells from other Pokémon. Some near-extinct species of coral have been found on POKENAME tails, causing conservationists to consider protecting POKENAME colonies.
author: chibitales

entry: Rotting shipwrecks are its primary food source, as it breaks down the debris over time. This habit ensures the ocean floor stays clear of decaying material.
author: .izik

entry: This POKENAME grew up underwater, nestled within coral reefs. When it was caught, the coral stayed with the POKENAME and now lives on it, relying on it for sustenance.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME produces stunning blue pearls prized by jewelers for their unique matte finish. These pearls are often crafted into elegant earrings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME surrounds itself with a bubble made of a clear, poisonous liquid. This allows it to float out of water and travel alongside its Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It wishes to bring everyone into the ocean within its maw to play. It doesn't realize that anyone who enters will drown within minutes.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME rarely burrows below ground so as to avoid damaging its corals, and often slides along the seabed when moving around.
author: phantom640

entry: It sifts through sand, meticulously picking out food hidden beneath the surface. This habit helps maintain the balance of life along the shoreline.
author: .izik

entry: It crushes boat hulls with ease, viewing them as obstacles to its territory. This destructive behavior has earned it a fearsome reputation among sailors.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its limited terrestrial locomotion, POKENAME loves to explore the land. It stores water for its little adventures in the bulb on its back.
author: jreposo

entry: POKENAME crawls along the ocean floor searching for delicious kelp to consume. Whenever it is in danger, it shoots out bursts of silk to entangle foes before crawling away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although many predator Pokémon initially see POKENAME as an obvious target, POKENAME has incredible speed that allows it to ensure survival. Even if caught, it may simply explode all of its contained energy to prevent itself from becoming prey.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME wields a specially carved gun made of bones to shoot high-pressure water long distances. Science still has not figured out how exactly the makeshift weapon functions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its muscles to throw out water-powered punches. Its blows are said to land like a rapidly flowing river.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is found near pools of sulfuric acid, idly floating above them while feeding off the fumes. Despite its habitat, the bubbles it produces don't contain any harmful chemicals.
author: lithuanian_shortstack

entry: Because of the weight of its cocooned body, POKENAME's swimming speed is rather low. It hides on the sea floor and defends itself with shots of compressed water fired from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: The heads on POKENAME act independently of each other; when it feels threatened, they fill the surrounding area with a toxic black gas to cover its escape.
author: lithuanian_shortstack

entry: POKENAME leaps elegantly from the water before blasting airborne prey with a precise jet of water. Once the target falls into the river, it finishes them off with its sharp horn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often found in shallow tropical waters attached to another Pokémon. They breathe through their pores and eat biological scraps, such as leftover food and flakes of skin. They expel water through their mouth to jet away from predators.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME protects other marine Pokémon such as Mantine from aggressive and out-of-control fusions. Mysterious power is channeled through its mouth and shot out with expert precision.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME pretends to flop helplessly on land to lure in unsuspecting small Pokémon. The moment they get close, it stuns them with a jet of water and knocks them into the river.
author: .izik

entry: In order to move between bodies of water, POKENAME will propel itself with jets of water from its mouth in a fashion reminiscent of rockets. The resulting mist often creates rainbows in its wake.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME have the ability to turn themselves invisible when underwater. They take advantage of this by stunning prey with a powerful shot of water when it's least expected.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME tries to form a mutualistic bond with Flying-type Pokémon where they share their food and clean one another. If the Flying-type refuses, POKENAME blasts them with water. If the Flying-type attacks, POKENAME's family intervenes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While it acts rebellious and hostile with strangers at first, POKENAME quickly warms up to them and becomes very affectionate. It prefers swimming in water over running on land.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While POKENAME itself is fearsome, standoffish, and overall difficult to get along with, it encourages its young to get along with other Pokémon. It eats a carnivorous meal and makes sure to slurp up all the fluids and juices for maximum calories.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in herds and tend to get aggressive over which Pokémon gets the tastiest Magikarp. These fearsome creatures hide a terrifying set of teeth, which can dig into even the hardest of shells.
author: skleegamer

entry: Cautious in the extreme, POKENAME listens for danger even while it is asleep. If it hears even the slightest disturbance, POKENAME will blast water from its mouth at high velocity to scare off potential predators.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME kept the need for water to breathe from Remoraid, but also the need for extreme sunlight from Sunkern. It lives in near constant pain whether above or below water.
author: omelhorthiagofranze

entry: POKENAME can leap out of the water and glide just as far as Mantine before it lands back in. To scare predators, it unleashes high frequencies from its mouth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are abundant in large rivers, where they are an important food source for rare predators. Their affinity to mud keeps sediment flowing, though they are very sensitive to heavy metals and frequently get sick if there are mines upstream.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It can venture inland much farther than its pre-evolved form since the blooming bulb on its back now creates water. Its new pair of legs also helps.
author: jreposo

entry: POKENAME live in the deep ocean, moving slowly with languid sweeps of their long tail to conserve energy. They gulp down anything that will fit in their mouth in the hopes that it's food, gnawing at it if it's too big to swallow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live far from land, hunting for food in the middle of the ocean. Fishermen will follow flocks of POKENAME, waiting for them to dive into the water to know where to cast their nets.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spits water on any fungus it manages to sniff out and dig up. This compulsion is so strong that it will not eat any mushroom it hasn't soaked with water beforehand.
author: sk372

entry: This fusion cannot outcompete preexisting Remoraid and Corsola in the wild, failing to maintain a stable population. Once, they were captured and bred by the Johtonian Navy for use against invading vessels, but they could never remember their orders.
author: .fedoraman

entry: In this form, POKENAME becomes markedly more aggressive, seeking out others to use as target practice. The jets of water it shoots from its mouth or cannon can pierce through steel.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires rapid bursts of ink at flying Pokémon with uncanny precision. It aims directly for their eyes, ensuring they drop into the water where it can strike.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's main form of offense is shooting compacted mud balls. Sometimes, hordes of them will gather on beaches to collect and eat wet sand, leaving a long trench on the shoreline.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME travels in the night, searching for outlaws to snipe with its dual Remoraid. Those who get shot by the Remoraid's water bullets are also afflicted with strange curses.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME curls into a sphere, letting its hardened scales protect it from other small aquatic creatures. It uses water spit from its mouth to propel it around while rolled into a ball.
author: sk372

entry: It's a poor swimmer, so it wraps its gas-filled tail around its body to float on the surface of the ocean.
author: hophoppip

entry: Whenever two groups of POKENAME run into each other, they will engage in a week-long conflict that only ends one side is completely annihilated.
author: falsedoll

entry: POKENAME swallow water and use their abdominal muscles to expel said water to defend themselves. They will use their long tongues to stick to, or hang onto, rocks to avoid being swept away by strong currents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is considered a pest by Bidoof due to its obsession with pranking them. It lies in wait until a colony has completed a dam before blasting a jet of water from its mouth and causing the structure to crumble.
author: sk372

entry: Adult POKENAME can be found lying along river banks ensuring younger POKENAME don't stray. They aren't aggressive, but they are extremely protective.
author: jreposo

entry: POKENAME hides itself in underwater tunnels, appearing only when it pops out to dispel intruders in its territory. It spits out beams of high-pressure water that travel over 100 mph.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims along forest riverbeds, preferring clean, pure water. It can store a lot of water in its stomach, which it sprays at enemies with extreme precision.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its sensitive fins can detect vibrations in both water and air. It keeps its distance from danger, as its water blast attacks can strike accurately from afar.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has a strategy for hunting flying prey: Striking it down with a water jet from its mouth and letting it fall onto its bladed horn.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME displays a surprising amount of aggression when hunting underwater. It swims towards prey and snatches them with its feelers, holding them still before knocking them out with jets of high-pressure water shot from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: This one seems to have an obsession with using its hand cannons to attack any Pokémon that enters its territory. Extreme caution is advised.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME prowl coastlines, seeking to find those that pollute oceans and reefs. SHould they encounter such a person, they will fire a highly pressurized blast of water from their arms.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME clings onto Wailord, surviving on leftover food. If a predator approaches, it strikes with a devastating Sky Uppercut.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Legends have it that POKENAME perceives the last wishes of those who drown at sea. It seems to have grown numb to the unceasing calls for help.
author: jreposo

entry: POKENAME has copious amounts of energy, needing to be constantly moving throughout the day to burn it off before nightfall. It takes on foes to further burn off energy, often easily outmatching them with powerful jets of water shot from its mouth.
author: arcul

entry: Found floating around tropical waters, POKENAME has the ability to voluntarily increase or decrease its density by moderate amounts, allowing it to sink or ascend through both the sea and the skies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Due to POKENAME's gentle and docile nature, it makes an ideal pet. However, it is also hunted often for its fresh, sweet taste.
author: sand_coffin

entry: It is capable of both swimming and flying. Yet, it spends most of its time gliding above the water's surface after making powerful leaps out of it.
author: jreposo

entry: Despite the popular assumption that POKENAME feeds on blood, research has proven it is incapable of harming others with its small fangs.
author: jreposo

entry: A Remoraid floats within the center of POKENAME, the body behaving similarly to its resident's instincts. The cannon on its arm can fire extremely rapid, accurate jets of water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME drifts slowly through seaweed beds. When it spots prey, it fires powerful jets of water to knock them out from a distance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME darts through streams to ambush prey like Magikarp with swift, piercing bites. If it spots flying prey like Pidgey, it will knock them out of the sky with a perfectly timed jet of water.
author: .izik

entry: While preferring close-ranged combat, POKENAME can fire pressurized jets of water from its claws to snipe prey from over 50 feet away. It hunts on the seafloor, mainly preying on small fish Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: When threatened, POKENAME launches the fish cake on its head, which serves as both a projectile and a tasty distraction for predators.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME accurately shoot down prey by expelling pressurized water from their mouths. Even if one of the heads happens to miss, attacks from the others will likely hit the target. They burrow into the ground to avoid retaliation from larger Pokémon.
author: chibitales

entry: It shoot water out of its finger at anything it points to. The range of these blasts have been reported to go as far as 200 meters.
author: gronkissimo

entry: Wild POKENAME tend to avoid fighting. If it knows it is being stalked by a predator, it will fire a powerful and accurate blast of water from its mouth. Only if that fails will POKENAME battle in close quarters.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An amphibious lifeform with the intelligence to craft tools made out of debris. It can hurl a spear from long distances with deadly accuracy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's twin mouths shoot powerful torrents of water at airborne Pokémon like Hoppip, sending them plummeting into the sea. Once submerged, it uses its tentacles to paralyze its prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fires jets of acidic ink at an extreme velocity in battle. While its accuracy hasn't been perfected, the liquid is extremely corrosive, able to melt through even rocks and metals.
author: evilgammon

entry: Many POKENAME have been found far from their natural habitat. This is because they have forgotten where they were going while attached to a Mantine.
author: gp423

entry: Its face is a rather perfect encapsulation of its skittish and timid personality. It steers clear of most anything other than its own kind, panicking and spitting ink at those that approach and startle it.
author: sk372

entry: With the body of this Pokémon being deep inside its shell, POKENAME have a limited field of view. This works to POKENAME's benefit as once it has its sights on a target, it cannot get distracted.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME burrows into mud and sand to hide from predators. It uses its right claw to blast down aerial prey with jets of water, and then drags them into its den with its left claw so it can feed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME contracts muscles in its oversized claw to launch jets of water with enough force to shatter Cloyster shells. It creates a symbiotic relationship with small fish Pokémon who will keep the claw clean and free of parasites.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME resemble a grilled ball-shaped snack made out of a wheat-flour based batter and seafood scraps. The toppings on their heads include mayonnaise and a special sauce.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The eggs shot out of its cannon hit like a tank. The orange star on its trunk symbolizes its allegiance.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME's suction cups on its tail allow it to stick to the sides of coral inside of reefs when sleeping. It lets loose intermittent bubbles from its snout as it snores, creating a peaceful underwater ambiance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wraps its long tentacle-like tail around sunken freighters when it hunts, spitting out a forceful Bubble Beam to incapacitate prey like Magikarp. Its strategic use of the environment ensures a successful hunt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits globs of ink to disorient foes before striking with its sharp horn. The ink cloud can linger for up to an hour in calm waters.
author: .izik

entry: Though it swims at a leisurely pace, POKENAME is not to be trifled with; its many mouth tentacles can crush smaller prey with ease, and create and lob painful globs of ink at anything larger.
author: sk372

entry: On clear nights, POKENAME will beach itself to stare up at the stars for hours. If disturbed, it will do a Rapid Spin to return to the sea, seeking the comfort of its aquatic home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has impressive camouflaging abilities: when it lays still, it can alter its outer color and texture to look nearly indistinguishable from its environment. If a foe passes by unaware, POKENAME ambushes with powerful moves through its snout.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are commonly employed in hydroelectric dams, spraying a constant stream of water onto the turbines should the pressure from the lake drop. Surplus energy is fed to POKENAME in exchange for their services, motivating them to keep working.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's suckers can conduct an immense amount of heat, leaving burns on the skin of those it attacks. When angered, its tail fire glows with a burning intensity and steam pours off of its body.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME wraps its tail around ocean buoys and flops about when disturbed. Though harmless, its sudden movement can scare off smaller Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to follow large ships out of a sense of precaution. Should disaster strike, they use their large body and many tentacles to hold and carry as many survivors to safety as they possibly can.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can use its unstable DNA to charge the projectiles it shoots with varying elemental power. Unfortunately, misfires often happen due to its lack of control over these elements.
author: evilgammon

entry: It uses its suction-cupped tails to catch prey before repeatedly shocking them with electricity. The ink POKENAME produces has a strong, metallic aftertaste, making it extremely unappetizing.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME gathers up materials and squeezes them into cubes to stack together. It sets up its own personal obstacle course to hop across, and small groups may form to compete to see who has the best time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live within ocean waters, but they will spend most of their lives flying in the ocean sky. They will shoot down foes with ink-filled bubble bullets and use their tentacles to snatch prey, which they will drag into water to finish them off.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's serpentine body is mostly made up of muscle, allowing it to constrict and crush its prey with ease. It can be found inhabiting the remnants of shipwrecks.
author: mepp.

entry: The first person to witness POKENAME thought it was the scion of a timeless monster, but it is actually very gentle and curious about humans. It often helps tow grounded ships back to sea before disappearing in a cloud of ink.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME playfully sprays water from its tentacles to send itself flying in random directions, giggling if it bumps into something. When startled, it perfectly camouflages to match its surroundings and escape detection.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Combining its glowing antennae with agile tentacles, POKENAME surveys the ocean's surface. It collects garbage to help keep its territory clean.
author: .izik

entry: The suction cups on POKENAME's tentacles pulse with a yellow light before it unleashes an Ocatazooka. The light helps lure prey close enough for the attack to land with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its suction-cupped ears to cling to sewer grates near the ocean. It picks through discarded trash with its long tentacles, searching for edible scraps.
author: .izik

entry: The red body in the front works to defend the flowering body in the back while it photosynthesizes, sharing the energy between the two of them. It is said that POKENAME used to be stationed outside houses as primitive security systems.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME soup is a popular dish in some areas, its sweet, tender meat often served with parsnips and ginger. It has even made its way onto fast-food menus. POKENAME is known to scream and squirt ink in fright as it is farmed.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Some Octillery will hitch rides on top of Slowking, replacing its crown. Its intelligence diminishes as a result, but it retains enough to function in tandem with its new passenger.
author: sk372

entry: The bulbous growth on the backs of POKENAME are filled with salt water. When POKENAME leave the water to feed, they use this supply to keep themselves hydrated.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The sound made by POKENAME's squirming tentacles is known to make its victims feel uneasy. When threatened, it will spray a dark cloud of ink that stains the attacker's skin for over a week.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME spots a predator, it shoots out ink and swims away. The substance that comes out appears to resemble words, but this may be a coincidence.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The POKENAME population has decreased due to an increased popularity in serving their delicate toxin-laced meat by experienced chefs. When it encounters danger, it sprays a cloud of ink, then puffs up inside the murky hiding spot.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME stores pressurized water in its shell, which it shoots at prey in powerful bursts. However, due to the immense pressure, even the slightest crack in its shell will spring a powerful leak.
author: secondegg

entry: If POKENAME finds styrofoam or other waste on its reef, it gathers the pieces with its tentacles. It then brings it ashore in hopes that someone will dispose of it properly.
author: .izik

entry: It braces itself in the sand or holds onto rocks with its suction cups before firing a jet of water with the power of a cannon.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: After fusing, POKENAME now sports armor plating to help its resilience in standing its ground and firing powerful ink shots at foes. There exist some records that indicate this may have once been POKENAME's natural form.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand, leaving only its tail exposed. It lures prey and enemies in with its rattle and catches them with its suction-cupped tail.
author: princessmilandria

entry: POKENAME uses its large mouth to create a powerful whirlpool that suctions prey in the ocean towards it. Once it has built enough energy by sleeping, it can spit streams of ink with enough force to knock even a Dragonite from the sky.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its extra-large mouth to create a powerful whirlpool that funnels prey in the ocean towards it. While the long mouth narrows the vortex, it also increases the strength of the suction.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is an intelligent Pokémon, capable of communicating to people and Pokémon by drawing or writing with its ink. Individuals have been recorded to either be hostile or friendly towards Smearcruel and Tentagle.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is often farmed for its capability to produce ink instead of milk. The ink can be used for writing, but is also used in some recipes.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME have an odd fascination with ramen and use their long tentacles to cook several bowls at once. They also make their own runny eggs that get added to every bowl of ramen they make.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can use their ink-jet mouths to control water around them and swim efficiently. They also use that ink to mark other Pokémon in the wild and even decorate patterns on their own bodies.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME charges the suction cups on its tentacles with electricity to paralyze prey once captured. Its spongy fur is commonly used to make padding for diving suits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Referred to by many as 'Sea Demons', POKENAME are cold, calculated killers of the water. If a Pokémon encounters one, it is immediately grabbed and devoured in what seems like an instant.
author: jangodiot

entry: Coated over POKENAME's body is dozens of tentacles. It fights by first delivering powerful kicks to knock their opponent down, then finishing the battle with a swift tentacle whip.
author: typhloquil

entry: It uses the suction cups along its tail and back to cling to beach cave ceilings and can change its colors to further hide itself. POKENAME uses its tentacles to ensnare its target before shooting bubble bullets at it until it submits.
author: infinex21

entry: The plants growing on the backs of POKENAME are able to sense the world around them. When threatened, they spit volleys of high-velocity seeds at their aggressors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It uses its flexible neck to take perfect aim, shooting down even high-flying Pokémon. Remoraid flock to it, eager for both food and lessons.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME have a highly nutritious ink that is mixed into noodles and risottos. It is believed that the reason the ink is so delicious is because it activates a primitive part of the brain that craves salt and protein.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME constantly leak ink from their bodies, making them the perfect source of ink for traditional calligraphy. This is especially true because the ancient ink is particularly good at clinging to paper without excessively bleeding.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can store and expel absolutely massive torrents of ink for defense. A single POKENAME could fill multiple swimming pools with ink and still not have depleted half of its stored contents.
author: sk372

entry: Many works of fiction use imagery similar to POKENAME to depict evil deities. There is some historical records that some island civilizations made offerings to it in the past to ensure safe travels across the oceans.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dreams in a deep slumber on the seafloor. When disturbed, it secures itself to surrounding surfaces with its suction cups and ring, following this up with a devastating blast from its snout that can tear through tank armor.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME will anchor itself with its suction cups on the ground underneath. It does this so that it will be steady when it fires torrential barrages of ink or water at its enemies.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: On the rare occasion of large scale territorial disputes between Pokémon, POKENAME will allow others to aim its powerful cannon-like mouth to great effect. Many intelligent Pokémon seek to ally themselves with POKENAME for this very reason.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME can shoot out a single blade made of water. When there is danger, groups of POKENAME will gather together and merge their blades into one massive weapon to stop any foe.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Using their suction cup-clad tentacles, POKENAME ensnare foes and prey to ensure their attacks loosed from their mouths land. To disorient their foes, they may spew ink; some POKENAME have used their ink and tentacles to make crude drawings.
author: infinex21

entry: The earthquakes summoned by wild POKENAME deep underwater have been known to cause tsunamis. These Pokémon are hunted for sport in Kanto and Johto.
author: theartemis1

entry: The earthquakes summoned by wild POKENAME deep underwater have been known to cause tsunamis. These Pokémon are hunted for sport in Kanto and Johto.
author: theartemis1

entry: The ink POKENAME produces shines especially bright on full-moon nights, reflecting the cosmos in its pattern. According to folklore, those who drink large amounts of POKENAME's ink acquire otherworldly beauty.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME sprays powerful jets of ink from the suckers on its arms powerful enough to pierce through thick logs. Each POKENAME has their own unique ink pigment that they use to distinguish each other's territory.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME love to cook a certain grilled ball-shaped snack made out of batter and seafood scraps. Their psychic powers and many tentacles allow them to cook several trays of this snack at a time, making them highly efficient for the task.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a timid and sensitive creature, often residing deep in the ocean far from sunlight. It is believed they feel comfort in darkness due to its similarities to the vastness of space.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Wild POKENAME make their nests within beachside caves. Their tentacles allow them to easily cling to walls and ceilings as they fire electrified bubble-bullets at their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME use their top tentacle to cling to cave ceilings as they watch for prey. When prey draws near, they will shoot at them with burning-hot bubble bullets and then pull their bodies up to them using their other tentacles.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gathers flotsam and jetsam from shoreline trash, looping items that interest it on its tentacles until it finds something more interesting. It occasionally snatches up Remoraid to blast beachgoers holding items it covets.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hides under a rubbery disguise, but cannot find enough material for a full set of tentacles, so its own shadowy appendages complete the ruse. It is intensely curious about new objects and will try to show them to others to become friends.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Utilizing discarded items in the ocean, POKENAME creates a disguise resembling a tiny tank with arms. It tries to garner sympathetic attention by exterminating overly aggressive Pokémon in tidal pools or on beaches.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When bouncing on land, POKENAME uses the large suction cups on its tentacles to drag people and Pokémon along. It will then bounce into the water to drag them below the surface, using the water to assist in its movement.
author: .izik

entry: After luring in a foe with a beautiful song, it uses its tentacles to latch onto its prey. Once attached, it never lets go.
author: mrpeach774

entry: To protect itself, POKENAME will eject ink from its mouth to stun the attacker and launch itself away. Children have been known to get inked after grabbing POKENAME's strings.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are found in the ocean depths, and in high numbers around sunken ships. When attacked, it sprays the predator with a bioluminescent ink that attracts even larger predators while POKENAME escapes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are surrounded by an opaque ink that covers their entire body. Whenever POKENAME are scared, they retreat into the ink to obscure their expression.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can't move, which is why they are in constant fear of predators. However, nothing actually preys on POKENAME because of their spikes.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME rolls down the beach, leaving strange trails in the sand. On warm days, the beach is filled with these tracks.
author: .realthree

entry: The tentacles on POKENAME's wings adversely affect its flight capabilities, making it difficult to pursue prey. To compensate, it spits a debilitating poison ink from its mouth to slow down targets enough for it to catch up and ensnare them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME twists and releases its tentacles, giving it propulsion and allowing it to glide leisurely through the water with little energy expenditure.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into together to build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the force.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into each other and build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the resulting force.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME nests along shoals and near strong currents or whirlpools as defense mechanisms against powerful predators. It blasts gooey ink at prey to blind them before dragging them into these dangerous areas to prevent escape.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hides within its mane of tentacles, which are covered in venomous spikes. It peeks out from this cover to blast targets with water from its snout, including its Trainer if it feels playful.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's tentacles are covered in a toxic mucus, sickening predators that eat them so that they leave it alone in the future. The tiny core body can regenerate its lost limbs, leading to adventurous chefs experimenting with its tentacles in dishes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME bites at driftwood and floating debris, hoping to uncover food hidden among the waste. It has a strong jaw for breaking apart trash.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's physical description resembles a beast that appeared in an old fictional horror tale; some have suggested POKENAME somehow influenced the author's mind. It can fire dazzling lights from its snout that impacts others' mental stability.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME fights using any tactics to win, including coating its claws in ink to blind foes and grappling them in its tentacles and claws until they are crushed. It clouds the water with ink to get the jump on an opponent.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are obsessed with making a grilled ball-shaped snack made out of batter and seafood. On the rare occasion that they run out of ingredients, they happily chop into their own body to serve customers this delicious treat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The water at the tip of POKENAME's tail is boiling hot. When it is angry, the water turns into steam, which may cause third-degree burns if touched.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Tales state that a couple's portrait painted with POKENAME's ink will cement their relationship forever. Tourists clamor to coastal towns to buy vials of this ink for high costs, believing it to be a symbol of lasting love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurk within underwater caves, grabbing at passing prey with their tentacles to drag them underground to feed on. Sailors have many tall tales surrounding POKENAME, with some stories claiming they grow large enough to drag entire ships down.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are a delicacy in some parts of Kanto, their mineral-rich diet adding an earthy flavour to them and enriching seafood dishes. They are difficult for fishermen to catch, requiring specialised tools to get them out of their burrows.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It has been recognized that the strong suckers across POKENAME's body makes it perfect for sumo wrestling, as it is unable to easily be pushed out of the ring. Competitive, it forms strong rivalries with wild Hariyama.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It's advisable to give POKENAME a wide berth for safety; at any moment, it may experience a migraine that causes it to lose control of its bodily functions and spew ink all around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in the ocean but has no control over how it moves, getting taken with the current. Whenever a predator or prey gets too close, it can manipulate psychic energy to push them away or bring them closer, causing its tentacles to throb.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME lives in the ocean but has no control over how it moves, getting taken with the current. Whenever a predator or prey gets too close, it can manipulate psychic energy to push them away or bring them closer, causing its eyes to glow red.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME lives in the ocean but has no control over how it moves, getting taken with the current. Whenever a predator or prey gets too close, it can manipulate psychic energy by blowing into a clarinet to push them away or bring them closer.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are highly valued in fast-paced kitchens, as their strength and dexterity allow them to quickly chop and debone fish into perfect cuts of sashimi. They also love creating new, exotic rolls of sushi for their Trainer to try.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a rather surly personality, preferring to work out and do artistic endeavors away from others, disdaining company. Despite this attitude, it remains popular due to many finding it oddly handsome.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's many tentacles are brutally powerful. With strong suckers scattered across them, escaping POKENAME's grip is extremely difficult. Foes who run are targeted with powerful ranged attacks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can be found underwater, making sure Horsea are protected from threats. If they encounter a foe, POKENAME will restrain them with their tentacles before pulverizing them with their fists.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME lives in the forest and is famous for its powerful Bullet Seed attack. When it senses a threat approaching, it won't stop firing seeds until the threat is knocked out.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME will use its tentacles to travel over land when its habitat becomes unsafe. It spends most of its time squeezed into small discarded items like potion bottles or Shellder shells.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its tentacles to ensnare prey before spraying ink to obscure its escape. Once it has fed, POKENAME squeezes into a tight location covered by its bell to sleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It attacks prey by using odd moves from its facial orifice. POKENAME is sluggish and conserves energy by staying still; in the wild, it only about fires 5 moves a day. If it misses all of them, it goes into slumber to try again another day.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A Shellder is typically attached to a Slowbro's tail; POKENAME seemingly has Octillery override that Shellder's consciousness instead. Fused into Slowbro's arm, its snout acts as a cannon for defense.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sticks to the sides of icebergs with the suction cups on its tentacle-like fins when resting. The cold environment helps it maintain its energy as it awaits its next meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME inhabit the discarded shells of larger Pokémon and use them for protection. They form a symbiotic relationship with Remoraid and will use high-pressure water to launch the smaller Pokémon at their foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If a predator attempts to pry open an POKENAME shell, it will be met with a torrent of ink and water, launching POKENAME far into the distance.
author: .fedoraman

entry: While Octillery loves occupying abandoned shells, this is not one such case. POKENAME can remove its spike and throw it with great dexterity.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The suction cups on POKENAME's claws aid in traversing the steep coastal cliffs and aquatic drop-offs it encounters in the wild. It will expel copious amounts of foam from its snout to disguise the entrance to its den.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's tough, crown-shaped ridge on its head keeps it from being able to squeeze fully through tight spots to escape predators. Instead, it incorporates the shed shells of crustacean Pokémon into armor for offense and defense.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses the bundle on its back to store seeds it uses for nutrients. These seeds are able to grow in the snowy forests where it lives.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sleep at the doorsteps of many homes to feel the heat from under the door. They are overjoyed whenever they are let inside, especially if they can eat pine needles that decorative trees shed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often annoyed due to being constantly picked up by humans mistaking them for ornaments during winter holidays. Each time they're touched, they also explode, launching away any food they were carrying, adding on to their grumpiness.
author: soup1900

entry: People have to be wary of grabbing star-patterned ornaments during winter holidays due to them potentially being a POKENAME instead. It has to be really careful to not explode if this happens; otherwise, it may destroy the food it was carrying.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME hits a bump while rolling, it explodes and scatters the food it was carrying everywhere. It typically hangs off of trees like tree ornaments, but its large size often causes it to slip off and explode upon landing.
author: soup1900

entry: The moment it sees snow, it sings carols for hours, despite the songs being off-key and wordless. Its relentless enthusiasm can either charm or annoy listeners.
author: .izik

entry: When wild POKENAME come of age and are no longer protected by others, they live a self-imposed lonely life away from others deep in mountain caverns. Despite this, they become overjoyed when given a gift and always go above and beyond to reciprocate.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME whacks an object with the bone it always carries around, the object's surface becomes covered in twinkling frost and snow. If it was given love and care as a Delibone, it tends to take in any lost or abandoned Pokémon to raise them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME whacks an object with the bone it always carries around, the object's surface becomes covered in twinkling frost and snow. If it was given love and care as a Delibone, it tends to take in any lost or abandoned Pokémon to raise them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are good at hiding in stockings and will not move until they evolve or are forced out. Many people believe that keeping a POKENAME is good luck, so many of them evolve in people's homes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to give out presents to children. These presents are often covered with a glittery dust that comes from their wings, but many parents still welcome them into their home, even if it means their children need a bath afterwards.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It keeps small ice sculptures hidden in its tail, offering them as gifts. Each sculpture is unique, crafted with surprising detail and care.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can shoot lightning and frost from its fists, which discourages dangerous Pokémon from picking fights with it. During certain holidays, it always has a present for everyone, even Trainers or Pokémon that are mean to it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live on secluded mountain slopes, curiously following visiting explorers. They are fascinated by shiny rocks, collecting them in their tails.
author: mepp.

entry: A gluttonous Pokémon that takes any food it sees. However, it will also give rare Berries to any house it passes. It is beloved by farmers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flies around icy mountains. If it sees someone lost, it will fly them to safety and give them some food. Its feathers are surprisingly soft and warm.
author: crazynaturekitty

entry: POKENAME appears during terrible snowstorms to eat and store the violent weather in their crop. Later it will deliver the weather to its nest to keep its home covered in permafrost.
author: rockageddon

entry: POKENAME love delivering mail. From pen pals to company CEOs, POKENAME reliably transport every piece of mail with love and dedication. Few ever get lost on their way to deliver mail, and even fewer make the mistake of losing mail from their bag.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a festive Pokémon known for controlling candy and amplifying its sweetness. In battle, it launches hardened treats that strike with unexpected power.
author: ilija09

entry: POKENAME's jolly disposition brings a sense of wintry joy to all who meet them. The cane on their head sometimes gets stuck on trees.
author: pankiwi

entry: It enjoys prancing around snowy forest floors, waving its head around with a jolly glee. The plant on its head leaves a fragrance of pine in the air.
author: pankiwi

entry: The buds surrounding its neck will glow when POKENAME is filled with joy. It uses the plant on its head to attract potential mates.
author: pankiwi

entry: The ruffles around its neck depict a snowflake pattern. The aroma it gives off is said to remind people of joyful times with family.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME are ambitious delivery birds used to send small packets to the coldest of regions. POKENAME will try to deliver anything they can lift if they are not stopped.
author: rockageddon

entry: POKENAME delegates the task of giving gifts to other Delibird, but still helps out whenever they can. Some of the presents they offer have bites taken out of them, but children do not seem to mind.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will sit in a tall tree at night, watching for prey. After a long night of hunting, it spends the morning sharing its spoils with other Pokémon.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME wraps its prey in silk to keep it fresh for the future. It's an altruistic Pokémon, often gifting some of its wrapped-up morsels to other hungry Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are even better at flying than unfused Crobat since they always carry a heavy sack everywhere they go. Their silent flying allows them to quickly share food with even the most violent Pokémon before darting away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME gives presents to particularly nice Pokémon and seems to always be in a jovial mood. It rarely stays in one place for long and flies between towns and cities to spread happiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often hand out game cartridges as presents so that children can play on handheld devices. They also charge the devices by rubbing it against their cheeks so that children can jump into their new game right away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are cheerful little fusions. They have a fascination with evergreen trees and are often found hanging from their branches.
author: howlingstarr

entry: Trainers must take care to rein in their POKENAME. Eager to break its delivery record, they will overshoot their delivery, losing time instead of saving it.
author: rockageddon

entry: If someone's holiday isn't going well, POKENAME will attempt to lighten the mood. It will even be in place of the tree if there isn't one.
author: birchbot

entry: It makes its home in pine trees and is said to tell whether someone is "naughty or nice" with a single glance. This ability makes it a fascinating figure in local folklore.
author: .izik

entry: It manipulates icy winds to carry itself across long distances. This ability allows it to travel effortlessly through snowy landscapes.
author: .izik

entry: Because its body naturally drifts upward, POKENAME keeps small stones tucked into its tail to help stay near the ground. As it grows, these stones are gradually replaced.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME spend their days stealing food and trinkets from dumpsters, stuffing them into the bags that they carry. At night, they will drag these bags back to their dens, stockpiling massive amounts of food.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME swing from branch to branch delivering gifts to Pokémon high above the ground. They can easily swap the gift bag between their three hands, making it nearly impossible to steal from them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it plays too much, it can accidentally create snowstorms. These unintentional blizzards make it both endearing and troublesome.
author: .izik

entry: When the moon is full, POKENAME makes a habit of leaving a gift in its Trainer's room. Its body can survive even in sub-zero temperatures.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When the moon is full, POKENAME makes a habit of leaving a gift in its Trainer's room. Its body can survive even in sub-zero temperatures.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME love to collect shiny objects and fill their bags with them. Once a year they fly around the region to distribute them to both young Trainers and Pokémon.
author: ghiragar

entry: POKENAME's bag is filled with such large quantities of Bead Mail, Fab Mail, and Harbor Mail that it struggles to carry them all. It refuses to give any of the mail away, even to its Trainer or closest companions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has a holly plant on its back in order to protect its seeds it carries in its bag from predators. The berries are said to be toxic.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME are foragers with a sweet tooth, sneaking into homes undetected to steal as many baked goods as they can. They have a selfish yet noble spirit, stealing gifts from others for those they have wronged and starting a vicious cycle.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME hangs in trees, dropping in front of passersby to give gifts to them. If the recipient refuses the gift, POKENAME may explode in frustration.
author: lemmymaster

entry: POKENAME is known for its jolly demeanour and the sweet scent it gives off, which lures others in during winter months. Despite its harmless look, it can deliver a surprisingly strong headbutt when startled.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Due to POKENAME's short body, it will be unable to fly if it carries too much food in its tail. Although it lives in cold places, snow will cause it to fly clumsily and even crash into the ground.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are full of small toys that they hand out to children. Sometimes their gifts are covered in Berry Juice, but children are often so excited to get a gift that they do not seem to mind.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It crafts toys from twigs and gives them to others as gifts. These handmade toys are cherished by both Pokémon and people.
author: .izik

entry: It can redirect snow and sharpen the flakes into razor-like edges. This ability makes it both a guardian and a fearsome opponent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are specialized for rescue teams and used for mountain and snow rescues. Inside their sack are roasted berries that are to be given to freezing Pokémon.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: As it crawls about, the snow inside POKENAME's shell swirls around, which keeps its Ice-type power ready to use. Despite its fragile looks, the globe is made from hardened crystals of rock and ice.
author: thordemidgard

entry: Deliveries are sacred to POKENAME. Anyone that tries to steal deliveries will be mercilessly attacked for weeks. Package thieves are never safe, as POKENAME never forgets a face.
author: rockageddon

entry: The snowy-white beard of POKENAME and their red fur have caused multiple incidents where children report an injured Delibird and try to get help. Nowadays children are told that the Delibird are sleeping so they respectfully leave POKENAME alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon has an insatiable love for cinnamon, seeking it out wherever it goes. It is aware that humans keep this spice, which often leads it to human settlements.
author: .izik

entry: It fiercely guards its present, refusing to part with it under any circumstances. This defensive nature makes it difficult to steal from.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often closely entwined in human communities and show great pleasure in joining in festivities. End-of-year celebrations are a special favourite, and they will give gifts to young children that approach the water's edge.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite an unfused Delibird's generous nature, a Delibird double fusion is grumpy and mean. It only delivers coal, not gifts.
author: valtsuri

entry: It uses its sharp wings to carve ice sculptures of those it cares about. These creations keep it company when it feels lonely.
author: .izik

entry: In the wintertime, POKENAME sneakily slithers into houses through vents, stealing trinkets. It will then give these gifts to its young.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME gallop through forests and mountains to ensure that people living in remote places of the world get presents. All they ask for in return is a few snacks and a pat on their antlers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shoots erratic sparks from its palms, still learning how to control its electrical powers. It enjoys giving gifts to other Pokémon, even if the gifts are small.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A wild POKENAME will spend large amounts of time waddling around looking for the perfect place to nest. Researchers believe it prefers cool, slightly damp, and quiet spots near water, preferably in caves.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME is stern but affectionate. Being in the presence of the grateful and the giving causes the star on its chest to glow. The rude and deceitful being near, however, causes POKENAME to rampage.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During the wintertime, POKENAME flies over small villages, deliberately leaving their feathers on civilians' doorsteps. These feathers are said to bring great fortune.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME offers the two bags it carries to passersby, letting them choose which to accept a gift from. In one it carries entertaining trinkets, and in the other only useless junk, so every offering is a gamble.
author: sk372

entry: Those who have been overly cruel to others are said to risk being haunted by POKENAME. It comes in the dead of night, its cold whispering cry said to gift those it haunts with horrendous nightmares, as retribution for the anguish they've caused.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME happily hands out gifts from its bag, but it only allows itself to be the one to handle said bag. Anything that tries to touch it will be in for a nasty zap from its bolt-shaped tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries the food it collects throughout the day in its portable sack. They are seen most often in snowy or mountainous regions.
author: theartemis1

entry: This immature Pokémon tries to give out food to anyone it meets, but it has usually eaten most of the gifts by that time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can unleash lightning storms and blizzards to protect its friends. Every holiday winter season, it gives gifts to everyone it can because it wants to inspire people to be their best selves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is only seen during the holidays, spreading joy. The kinder a person is, the more presents they get from a POKENAME.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: It delights in gathering berries and other fruits to give as presents. These thoughtful offerings make it beloved among both Pokémon and people.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travels through snowy villages, shooting icy water at people so they drop anything they carry. It stores its prizes in its sack-like tail, making it a tricky and resourceful thief.
author: .izik

entry: This generous Pokémon likes to please others with small gifts. It would usually give one a drawing or a colorful clay craft as a present.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME enjoys giving presents to everyone around it. Sometimes it's too enthusiastic and can accidentally shower someone with gifts to death.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can sense negative emotions within the hearts of others. If someone feels sad, POKENAME can find a perfect gift for them in its bag.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME spends around nine or ten months seemingly frozen in ice. When autumn rolls around, POKENAME will begin thawing out and singing.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME will do anything in its power to make its Trainer happy with a gift they wish for. It's strong enough to carry a bag twice as big as itself.
author: milchik

entry: Bound to a festive ornament, POKENAME is thought to be a collection of 108 different wishes made by children. It strives to grant these wishes by performing good deeds.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Tales of the one who delivers gifts at the holidays describe POKENAME as his assistants. As the stories go, this Pokémon can sense the auras of children to determine who is naughty or nice.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores their gifts in frozen cliff sides, handing them out to lost travelers. Gifts taken without permission will explode, causing an avalanche.
author: lampent12

entry: The seeds it carries have now grown into festive snacks which it gives away to smaller Pokémon in the forest. The scent of holly surrounds them.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME enjoys the act of giving and sharing, but has no tolerance for greedy individuals and thieves. Anyone trying to take from another in its vicinity will be sent flying with a swing of its full bag of gifts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME arrive at places that have recently experienced natural disasters to give out gifts of warm clothes. The warm clothes often have a misprint on them, but that is a minor inconvenience compared to the lifesaving utility of the clothes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: On dire winter nights, a POKENAME may appear right before a miracle happens. Believing POKENAME to be a savior, people will shower them with gifts, but POKENAME gives all their gifts to less fortunate and unfairly treated Pokémon like Absol instead.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Urban legend says POKENAME chases down naughty children and Pokémon at night to stuff into its bag, which transports them into the spirit realm. At the end of the night, it empties the entire bag into the maw on its stomach to devour the victims.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a feared reputation of appearing in blizzards and kidnapping people. In truth, it rescues lost travelers in snow storms and provides for them until it is safe to continue their journey.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME celebrates winter holiday festivals in remote towns and villages across the world, spreading joy and goodwill. It never remains in one place for long, making it nearly impossible to study.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is customary after a battle for POKENAME to present a gift to its opponent. The quality and intensity of the battle increases the quality of the gift offered, no matter whether the foe won the fight or not.
author: sk372

entry: Nutmeg is its favorite food, and it hoards as much of it as it can find. The spice seems to enhance its already festive nature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in areas that frequently drop below freezing. When they spot a struggling traveler, they share warm and delicious treats with them. However, how POKENAME produces such desserts is not known.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Snow, wind and fog mean nothing to this Pokémon: it will trek through any condition in order to help someone it knows is in need. POKENAME vanishes into the night with an icy fog after giving assistance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon marches across icy terrain delivering Mech Mail in temperatures that would freeze steel. Its metallic body keeps each parcel insulated and intact during long-distance routes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Wild POKENAME have been observed using their portable sack to steal various items from children. They are regarded as villains in holiday tales.
author: theartemis1

entry: Wild POKENAME have been observed using their portable sack to steal various items from children. They are regarded as villains in holiday tales.
author: theartemis1

entry: Wild POKENAME have been observed stealing various items from children. They are regarded as villains in holiday tales.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's feelers are extremely strong and can extend great distances. They use these feelers to pick fruit from trees and deliver it to their allies.
author: .izik

entry: Parents tell stories of POKENAME stealing away naughty children at night, trapping them in a world of merciless cold. In reality, POKENAME is rather amicable, but will play along to help scare misbehaving children straight.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME scamper through the snow to deliver the gift of warmth. Most of the presents they bring involve warm clothes, such as scarves, jackets, or sweaters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It makes its home on icebergs, drifting across frigid seas. These floating islands serve as both a shelter and playground for it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will return lost keys to their owners, only after it decides if they are nice or not. If not it will promptly throw them into the nearest hole.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME dash through the snow to deliver warm and cozy clothes to children. It is said that if a child pets one of their tails, they are blessed with years of good luck.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Known for its remarkable woodworking talent, POKENAME creates festive wooden statues around the holidays. Many young craftsmen seek its partnership to refine their skills and prosper.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: It carries gifts in its mouth to give out to anyone it meets. If someone tries to reach inside to steal a gift, it will bite down without hesitation.
author: cait_sith

entry: This Pokémon is often found giving food to starving children. Its flame burns with sympathy for the hungry.
author: notsaying.

entry: Trainers that don't pay attention to POKENAME will discover that toys tend to disappear around this Pokémon. Experts are not sure if the Pokémon likes to steal to make children cry or if it is a case of kleptomania.
author: rockageddon

entry: It constantly produces snow-like material inside its bubble that leaves it cold to the touch. POKENAME enjoys being held by others in need of cooling down, cooing softly as it shares its temperature.
author: sk372

entry: It collects gemstones from caves and gives them out to humans that it trusts. People used to sell these stones for astronomically high prices, so ever since, gemstones given out by POKENAME are worth much less than their original value.
author: jangodiot

entry: Once a year, POKENAME looks for children nearby to visit and bring gifts. Well-behaved and pure-hearted kids get glistening gems, while naughty children get coal and, in extreme cases, brimstone.
author: epping_forest

entry: Folklore warns that upsetting this Pokémon may result in an avalanche. The threat ensures it is treated with respect and caution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME freezes objects near its den with icy breath, then offers them to nearby Pokémon. The gifts are often strange, but always cold.
author: .izik

entry: When it shakes its horns, a pleasant scent of pine sap fills the air. This fragrant aroma calms both allies and opponents alike.
author: .izik

entry: It holds out its bag with closed eyes, hoping someone will offer it a gift. If it receives one, it runs away delighted, carrying the present with joy.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is composed of the hundreds of toys and gifts that have been thrown away over the years, along with other substances. It will try to clean off the grime of one of the objects in its body and present it to someone who needs cheering up.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bauble on its horn can hypnotize foes with rhythmic movements. Once mesmerized, enemies are easy to outmaneuver.
author: .izik

entry: Commonly known as the Birthday Bird, this Pokémon loves to surprise people and Pokémon with confetti presents. If it spots a party, it will always try to sneak away with a piece of cake.
author: rockageddon

entry: Urban legend says POKENAME will break off the black stones on its body and gift them to naughty children. The message this conveys to them is unclear.
author: iaobug

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in the wintertime and appear to have a special affinity for the winter solstice. They enjoy being the centre of attention and will hoard gifts, only letting them out of their sight once the morning breaks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME loves its present dearly and will fall into despair if it is damaged or stolen. If you give a grieving POKENAME a new present, however, it will treat you with the same affection as before.
author: mistymagius

entry: It can spit out an icy mist capable of freezing anything it touches. This frosty breath makes it a formidable opponent in cold environments.
author: .izik

entry: It has a curious habit of stealing items from one town only to gift them to another. This behavior leaves both towns confused, yet strangely grateful.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wear their bundle of presents like a mane atop their head. Even with their rugged appearance, children love to play with POKENAME during certain holiday festivals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to sing festival carols while they deliver gifts. Many people and Pokémon sing along whenever they are around, as these carols are full of nostalgic joy from the past.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The nostalgic joy of the past comes through the hymns that POKENAME sing, reminding people to be kind to one another during the holidays. Even soldiers have been known to sing along, as POKENAME have facilitated many ceasefires.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rarely appears during winter season, singing all sorts of tunes that bring to mind holiday cheer and festivity. Rarely, it may sing more melancholic and longing tunes. If one tries to catch it, it may shift in appearance and flee.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rarely appears in secluded places around the world during the late parts of the year, bringing Berries and other small gifts. It seems to draw energy from the happiness of others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is most often spotted during snowy seasons, performing dances and miming ancient folk plays with other Pokémon. Endowed with incredible leadership and charisma, it can easily convince even rival Pokémon to work together to spread cheer to others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are light on their feet and can dance while giving out presents. Their fluid movements inspire many children to pick up dancing as a hobby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME has only ever been seen in the wild by a handful of people, it is largely dismissed as a myth. Nonetheless, it is often featured in holiday decorations.
author: ludacriswell

entry: The snow globe on POKENAME's back contains thousands of poisonous spores. If it breaks, the released spores can cause frostbite and shortness of breath.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: In the coldest reaches of Kalos, POKENAME is revered by small villages. Using a candy cane wand, it ensures heating fires stay lit, while pulling necessary food from its bag. Other regions have taken to using this Pokémon for Search and Rescue.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When water is splashed on POKENAME's shell, hot steam is produced. In cold regions, it is used in traditional saunas.
author: mepp.
