entry: POKENAME blasts water from its trunk with enough force to pierce iron. It fiercely guards its lodge and dam with this attack.
author: .izik

entry: When psyching itself up for battle, small puffs of aura can be seen flaring out from POKENAME's trunk. Its scrappy fighting technique relies heavily on combat rolls for dodging blows.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is as tough as steel. It rolls through mountain paths in search of ore to devour, preferring copper ore above all.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME plays with others of its kind by charging into each other and wrestling with their metallic trunks. Training POKENAME in pairs is advised, as few other Pokémon can keep up with its playful roughhousing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME buries itself at the bottom of a dirt pit and wiggles its trunk in the air, mimicking a worm or snake Pokémon. When another Pokémon comes to investigate for food, POKENAME lunges with its jaws, dragging its quarry beneath the dirt to feed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is learning to control the flame bursts that it produces, both purposefully and accidentally when sneezing, from its trunk. Sometimes it becomes too excited after performing a fire trick and unintentionally starts a wildfire.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It flies through its cavernous home by flapping its ears rapidly. The process is rather exhausting, so POKENAME prefers to move around via hitching rides on large stone Pokémon in the wild, or perched on its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is chasing prey, it will sometimes use its ears as secondary wings to fly faster. It is very loyal, whether it be to other POKENAME or its trainer.
author: bigrichstreamz

entry: POKENAME exhales large jets of flame from its trunk when enraged. Its fire is hot enough to melt iron in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: After striking a foe with its fangs, POKENAME uses its trunk to drain their blood. Its feeding methods are feared by many.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME curl up into balls and roll around rocky craters to clear out soil and expose any crystals at the bottom. They break down crystal compounds to collect the coesite through their trunks before feasting on the quartz deposits.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's outer coat absorbs the cold around it in order to keep its more sensitive body from freezing. To expel the excess coolness it has drawn in, it breathes out a cold mist periodically from its trunk.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME curl into balls and roll off of cliffs for amusement. Just before landing, they can shift their bodies to soften their landing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are stumps possessed by the spirits of artists. Their wooden trunks produce haunting sounds that they use to scare painters looking for a quiet place to work. POKENAME then decorate themselves and their forest with any dropped supplies.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME sprays green, corrosive acid from its trunk. The substance is strong enough to dissolve solid boulders within minutes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stands on guard at the edge of the battlefield, stomping the ground beneath it to knock foes off balance with shockwaves. If a foe gets too close or tries to strike from above, POKENAME will jump and smack its opponents with its trunk.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME stores large amounts of sand inside their bodies and will shoot it out of its trunk if it feels threatened. Due to their short legs, it tends to hop around instead of walking.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its insectoid appearance, POKENAME is completely mammalian. Its body heat allows the elephant ear fungus to grow on it.
author: .realthree

entry: At night, POKENAME howls while blasting trumpet-like sounds from its trunk. These noises help calm others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME populations have declined since the dawn of the industrial age, their thick fuzz making them overheat in the warmer climate. Their populations have retreated to high in the mountains, preferring to live in the cooler air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases a foul stench like rotting gourds while rolling away from predators. The scent lingers in the air for hours afterwards.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME populations have declined since the dawn of the industrial age, their thick fuzz making them overheat in the warmer climate. Their populations have retreated to high in the mountains, preferring to live in the cooler air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME scours mountains for opponents until it is satisfied in victory or has fainted. It is self-conscious of the appearance of its trunk, so it trains to use it as a weapon in battle, either as a bludgeon or a tool to unleash spouts of fire.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its strong trunk as a shovel to dig through the dirt with ease. When threatened, it can launch dirt at potential foes with alarming force.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME is seen as more friendly than most Mankey fusions due to its playful nature, but care must be taken: not playing with it enough will send it into a destructive tantrum.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has calmed down from its previous stage, searching the mountains for Pokémon in need of a fire. It curls its tail around the shivering Pokémon and uses its ears to gently stoke its tail fire so it gives off more heat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live by the few bodies of water in the savannah, meditating, sleeping, and cleansing themselves, neglecting all other activities. They rely on other related fusions to feed them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dislike growing too cold or too hot and especially dislike being bored, so they tend to be on the move and participate in all different kinds of physical activities.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME keep the backs of their herd members clean by squirting water to remove mud from the backs of herd members. This communal ritual of cleaning ensures that everyone remains nice and clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rolls with such force it can climb vertical cliff walls. It uses this to traverse even the roughest mountain terrain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's large head and wobbly legs make it a very clumsy Pokémon while it's young. It often sends itself and others tumbling over accidentally.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: POKENAME create mud by mixing water from their trunk and dirt below their feet. They coat themselves with this mud to prevent parasites from growing on them, while also helping them keep cool during summer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fires arcs of electricity from its trunk to stun enemies. The charge builds while it rolls across rocky canyons.
author: .izik

entry: The second head provides POKENAME with a playmate to help keep it from being lonely. The two heads often trumpet in tandem while playing, and many even develop their own "secret handshakes" with their trunks.
author: sk372

entry: It has a playful nature and responds quickly to cues, making it popular with performers and Trainers alike. It needs to periodically roll in the mud or dive in water to cool down, as it will refuse to do anything if it's too hot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME memorize places where they can find water so that they always have a place to keep cool during the summer. Some of these watering holes have recently dried up, which forces many POKENAME to travel further for essential water baths.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME smashes quartz deposits with its trunk and devours the shards. It's drawn to caves rich in crystal formations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day using the move Rollout. In its periods of rest, it spins its pendulum like a yo-yo to entertain itself.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME begins sobbing uncontrollably if it cannot stop while rolling. The crying ceases immediately once it collides with an object.
author: .izik

entry: Its tusks are as sharp as a Skarmory's talons. Due to the large skull on its head, it cannot see very well.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It rolls over hard stone surfaces to polish the rock coating its body. This rolling motion helps it maintain a smooth, durable exterior.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its small size, a wild POKENAME has remarkable strength and hardened skin. Its small tusks and antennae allow it to detect distant sources of food and danger as it drifts through the air.
author: moga6

entry: Mr. Mime's ability to create invisible objects remains within POKENAME. Interestingly, it likes to create human objects not otherwise found in nature, such as vehicles. This Pokémon is popular among a certain group of bikers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME train their toughness by letting anything attack them at full power before blowing away the attacker in return. They like to hunt in populated places where they can smash through buildings with quick agility to always overtake the prey.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME roll down hills with their rotund bodies to avoid predators. When they inexorably reach the bottom of a slope, they remain hidden in bushes hoping a predator does not find them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is able to terraform the land to its liking using its trunk and fire. If you ever find an odd volcanic area, you're probably near one's den.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME skillfully plucks Blue Apricorns from trees using its trunk. Eating these fruits keeps its thick fur sleek and healthy, allowing it to endure harsh environments.
author: .izik

entry: The tire-like ends of its limbs cannot function as wheels, but they insulate it from electric attacks. This rubbery property makes it resistant to shocks.
author: .izik

entry: Its thick, tire-textured crown stores immense psychic energy. POKENAME senses vibrations in the ground using its trunk and bends earth and stone to its will, serving as a formidable guardian of kings and queens.
author: the_lunarian

entry: POKENAME haunts graveyards by night, rolling silently between headstones. It crashes into graverobbers with such force they're flung from sight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will hang off of stalactites and sleep for days. If it is awakened, it will glare menacingly at its foe before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: Using its claws, it carefully cuts food into smaller pieces before eating. This meticulous approach makes it a surprisingly refined eater.
author: .izik

entry: The material covering its body resembles grey ivory, naturally growing to protect it. This tough exterior adds durability to its already robust frame.
author: .izik

entry: When rolling forward at high speeds, POKENAME's tough, uneven body tears up the landscape around it. It could conceivably destabilize the inside of a small mountain in minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their nests in rocky mountains, often gathering in large groups. By slamming their heads into the mountainside, they can cause large rockslides to drive out predators.
author: santon5512

entry: When underfed, it stomps and trumpets through its trunk in a show of anger. This loud display is enough to shake the ground around it.
author: .izik

entry: This armored beast charges with the momentum of a freight train and the precision of a surgical strike. Once POKENAME locks onto prey, it will not stop until the target is flattened or sliced to pieces.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It performs intricate tricks while rolling down canyons, using its claws for balance. This agility allows it to navigate steep terrain with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Military academies train soldiers alongside POKENAME, as their keen eyes and sturdy physique make them great candidates for specialized operations. Their fearless disposition and strong sense of pride inspire troops during training.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its rubbery ears allow it to hear distant sounds with impressive clarity. This heightened sense helps it detect potential threats before they arrive.
author: .izik

entry: The circle on its stomach is unique to each individual, showing subtle differences. Some circles display microscopic variations that set each apart.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in large groups, staying with most of their extended family. Extremely protective of its young, POKENAME will attack any who draw near its brethren. When one starts to roll at you, there is no escape.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME curls into its shell, it can roll at speeds of up to 75 mph, blazing fire overtaking its body. Wherever one has traveled, it leaves a trail of burnt grass in its wake.
author: secondegg

entry: It performs somersaults midair before diving sharply toward its prey. This acrobatic maneuver allows it to strike from unexpected angles.
author: .izik

entry: Its large, fleshy ears allow it to glide for short periods, catching air currents as it moves. This gives it brief moments of flight when needed.
author: .izik

entry: It can curl its long serpentine body into a tight, tire-like coil. POKENAME will then roll either away or directly into foes at top speeds. A mother POKENAME is particularly territorial and dangerous.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It often loses balance and tumbles when rolling, but it always tries again. Its resilience and determination are evident in every attempt.
author: .izik

entry: When DNA from POKENAME was analyzed, it was found to bear a resemblance to a Pokémon from Galar. Fossil records also suggest that it shares similarities with an ancient subspecies of Donphan.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME harnesses the power of its trunk to vigorously shake trees and eat the berries that drop. It is often a victim of car accidents because its natural habitat lies close to human settlements.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A bizarre example of mimicry, POKENAME's hood patterns resemble automotive warning symbols. The exact symbol changes according to its physical health.
author: capwolfbane

entry: It sucks up tiny stones into its trunk and consumes them as a source of minerals. This steady diet strengthens its rocky exterior.
author: .izik

entry: It suctions onto cave ceilings with its trunk and rocks back and forth while sleeping. This pendulum-like motion calms it as it rests.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME generates electricity by swinging its tail around in a circle. Once it builds up enough energy, it curls its whole body into an electricity-coated sphere to bowl down any opposition in its path.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its trunk to make dents in ice, marking its territory to warn others. This icy signal keeps rivals at bay.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME train soldiers alongside military instructors, their expertise and experience command respect from both people and other Pokémon. They apply a lot of pressure during drills, and their strict yet caring nature is perfect for the role.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's striking appearance has made it a favourite among children. Toy makers often model action figures after it, capturing its dynamic stance.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME is capable of rolling up hills, through snow, and across wet marshes. It is studied by scientists for the automotive industry to improve tire traction.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By collecting air in its cape, it can catch updrafts to glide over long distances. This technique allows it to travel far with minimal effort.
author: .izik

entry: While rolling, it extends its sharp claws, turning itself into a spinning weapon. This defensive maneuver makes it difficult for foes to approach.
author: .izik

entry: The position of POKENAME's trunk conveys its emotions, the trunk rising with its level of anger. In combat, it stuns opponents with its mental powers before grappling and crushing them with its trunk.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its tusks are corporeal, so it uses them to pierce foes. Some rumors claim that the souls of poachers are imprisoned in its keystone.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME repeatedly leap forward while curling their treads in front of them, creating a loop that propels them forward. When they arrive at their destination, they slam their treads down, using their tusks to hook them in place.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: With an extremely sturdy hide and spikes across its body, POKENAME was a powerhouse among the ancient world. A single POKENAME could defend a herd of smaller Pokémon from throngs of would-be predators.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stealthily hunt those who have hunted Donphan, often appearing in the middle of the night. Their tusks are the only corporeal part, making them as deadly as their threatened kin.
author: leandermalurt

entry: With no eyes to see, it relies entirely on touch to navigate its surroundings. Its hands float independently, reaching out to sense everything around it.
author: .izik

entry: No two POKENAME have the same mane. The brighter their mane is, the stronger they are.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: Its wings are incredibly tough, acting as built-in shields that deflect attacks with ease. The edges are very sharp as well, able to cut clean through a boulder with little effort.
author: sk372

entry: The fur around its neck crackles with electric energy as it rolls into a tire shape, charging itself up. This electrifying spin intensifies its power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feelers whip in all directions while it rolls across wastelands to deter others from interrupting its travel. It can reach speeds of up to 85 miles per hour in short bursts.
author: .izik

entry: Legends speak of how POKENAME's very steps would reshape the ground. The discovery of deep, craterous, fossilized footprints has lent modern credence to these ancient tales.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME lives in small herds along mountainous slopes. One swing of POKENAME's powerful tail can reduce boulders to rubble.
author: mepp.

entry: When rolling at top speed, POKENAME's body can pass through stone with ease. During this literally incorporeal period, it becomes incredibly difficult to strike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in small colonies residing in or near mountain ranges. Though reclusive, the packs gather every full moon to trumpet together at the orb, the sound of which echoes for miles.
author: sk372

entry: The trunk-like appendage extending from its mouth is highly elastic, able to stretch up to 50 feet. Despite its reach, the trunk remains soft to the touch.
author: .izik

entry: Its tusks are extremely sensitive to environmental changes, detecting storms like tornados in advance. This sensitivity helps it stay safe from severe weather.
author: .izik

entry: It wraps its tread-like tails around itself and spins its whole body to travel up mountains. The tails are different sizes, and by shifting its weight onto specific treads, it can ensure it travels as smoothly as possible, regardless of terrain.
author: gronkissimo

entry: Its arms and trunk are as hard as rock and protect it from most attacks. It can curl up into the form of a wheel and ram into opponents with great force.
author: infinex21

entry: It emits a loud trumpet noise as it slashes at its foes. This sound can be intimidating and signals its readiness to fight.
author: .izik

entry: Balancing on its trunk, it dances gracefully under full moonlight. This nocturnal performance is a mesmerizing sight in the wilderness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls through its habitat with unstoppable force. It is rumored to be able to roll through entire buildings.
author: anarchaz

entry: Its strong nose can knock down trees, allowing it easy access to fruit. This method not only provides food but also clears paths through dense forests.
author: .izik

entry: It spins clockwise, showering sparks around its body before delivering a powerful strike. This fiery spin intimidates opponents and scorches anything in its path.
author: .izik

entry: Perching atop buildings, it waits until it spots prey, then rolls vertically down the structure in pursuit. This surprising tactic allows it to ambush effectively.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are regularly found on roads and are run over quite often. The deeper the tire marks on its body, the older the POKENAME tends to be.
author: chromaerym

entry: It performs a dazzling samba, kicking up gravel in rhythmic patterns. This dance, especially common when it is feeling down, lifts its spirits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tough hide combined with its tendency to travel in moderate-sized schools makes it quite difficult to prey on. Some ships carry bait to keep the groups swimming close to the boat as a way to guard it from other aggressive undersea life.
author: sk372

entry: As it rolls, it leaks an acidic red liquid that corrodes the ground beneath it. This trail often deters any would-be pursuers.
author: .izik

entry: It secretes a slick mucus as it moves, which is commonly used in haircare products around Johto. This goo adds shine and strength to hair, making it highly sought after.
author: .izik

entry: Its body feels soft to the touch but hardens during combat. Its limbs are incredibly strong, capable of lifting objects as heavy as a bus.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its lack of a mouth, it consumes food and drink exclusively through its trunk. This adaptation keeps it nourished and hydrated in its own unique way.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its trunk as an extra limb in combat, executing moves that would astonish professional wrestlers. This skill makes it a fierce and unpredictable fighter.
author: .izik

entry: While rolling, it shoots needles from its body in all directions. This spinning assault leaves its foes with little chance to escape unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: It can fire needles from its trunk with precision, pinning down prey from a distance. These powerful needles make it a skilled hunter in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: The sand covering its body is as sharp as broken glass, deterring any who might touch it. This rough exterior serves as a powerful defense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME balances on its hard, armored arms to slide down steep slopes. This allows it to travel quickly across mountainous terrain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls on its side across cave floors. Its gems glow brighter the faster it rolls, creating an ethereal, sparkling trail as it moves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body works like a furnace. It is capable of burning coals to generate energy for its powerful rollout attack.
author: gwello

entry: Despite its odd shape, POKENAME charges through coral tunnels with unexpected speed. It uses its tough head to clear debris and make safe paths for schools of smaller Water-types.
author: mgfox_66676

entry: Using its strong tusks, it loosens gems embedded in cave walls with remarkable ease. It collects these treasures and hides them in secret spots.
author: .izik

entry: It uses psychic power to increase its rolling speed and can even roll over water with telekinesis. This ability makes it both agile and surprising to opponents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy trunk to deliver devastating blows to its opponents. Its enormous ears allow it to glide from great heights and even soar briefly over the sandy steppes it inhabits. At the sight of a rival, it charges without hesitation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its trunk filters out toxins, helping it breathe near volcanic smoke. This adaptation lets it roam freely around toxic areas others avoid.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has particularly strong neck and abdominal muscles, which give it both flexibility and strength. POKENAME tend to live together in small groups.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's surprisingly strong intelligence has been the subject of numerous studies. As it turns out, farming, tool usage, and even creating simple structures are all within wild POKENAME's capabilities.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's muscle-laden body could send a moving truck flying with just a single punch. It can create and use tools to help with tasks, such as cutting wood.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's sense of empathy and relatively strong intelligence, along with its extremely powerful body, has allowed it to flourish helping labor workers, with several veterans owning one. However, they are extremely rare in the wild.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy trunk to deliver devastating blows to its opponents. Its enormous ears allow it to glide from great heights and even soar briefly over the sandy steppes it inhabits. At the sight of a rival, it charges without hesitation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It spits a corrosive crimson acid from its trunk to defend itself. This acidic spray can dissolve obstacles and deter foes.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys rolling through rocky landscapes, exploring and finding new, optimal paths. This exploration helps it memorize routes through even the roughest terrain.
author: .izik

entry: This motorcycle-like Pokémon rears and trumpets before taking off. When exhausted, POKENAME emits dark smoke and a stench of burnt rubber.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It absorbs water through the tip of its tail, allowing it to stay hydrated while it sleeps by creeks. This slow, steady intake keeps it comfortable in warm climates.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tusks are a hot commodity on the black market, so poachers often break into nature reserves to hunt and saw off these tusks. Without their tusks, they are often left with few methods to defend themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It sheds its tusks once per year during the winter. The tusks themselves can be ground up and used as an anti-fungal.
author: .izik

entry: Using its trunks, it sucks up massive quantities of water from local streams. It uses this moisture to stay cool from the hot sun.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefer to live in the coldest waters due to how thick their bodies are with fat and muscle alike. They can form glaciers more than twice their size to serve as a den and can move them as effortlessly as they can shatter them.
author: infinex21

entry: By sticking together in herds, POKENAME are able to slowly replenish their numbers while also defending against poachers. This is especially important since they are an endangered species and often face off against poachers daily.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It curls its body into a perfect circle and rolls up mountains, reaching speeds of up to 200 mph. This powerful motion lets it ascend even the steepest slopes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME primarily eat nightmares, especially those of children, allowing them to wake up refreshed. However, if they are not well-fed, they may also eat their dreams and feelings of optimism, resulting in the children feeling awful afterwards.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spray water from their cannons, which resemble heads of their younger kin. They hose down poachers that hunt them for their horns.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Updates to POKENAME have increased its durability against external and internal threats. It can insert its nose into data ports to download new information or to upload itself to cyberspace.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME spits thick strings at travelers to steal their cellphones and other devices. It feeds this equipment to others of its kind in preparation for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: After consuming enough code, POKENAME explodes and scatters data in all directions. Oddly, these explosions cause no damage and instead increase the speed of any programs the scattered code touches.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME consumes more coding, its body grows more vibrant in color. When it explodes, the coding scatters in all directions, sometimes corrupting image links and text nearby.
author: .izik

entry: It is soft to the touch, and quite unarmed in a battle of wits. If it detects the slightest irregularity in its normal day-to-day operations, it will screech in a still-unknown language, permanently breaking any electronic device in a 500m radius.
author: beatdoof

entry: The members of a POKENAME clutch are able to operate independently, to an extent. Their power and intelligence shrink the further the group is spread out, however, so they rarely move far apart.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits a noise resembling a fax machine as it walks along shorelines. Its path appears aimless, but it cycles the same route each day without fail.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense loneliness in those browsing digital spaces it inhabits. It migrates into neglected systems, consuming unused files without resistance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have assumed the image of a harmless internet prank but are in fact a dangerous virus. Other specialist Porygon2 fusions are tasked with cleaning out any system that gets infected.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's extremely hard body allows it to resist both malware and viruses while traveling through cyberspace. The longer it travels, the softer its body becomes.
author: .izik

entry: The smoke POKENAME emits carries antiseptic properties. In virtual environments these properties shift slightly, destroying malware on contact.
author: .izik

entry: If seen on a webpage, POKENAME's leaf-like body generates irritating popup windows on any page a person is browsing. It appears far more frequently on medical websites than anywhere else.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME help people change passwords on their PCs by stretching their writhing tentacles to guide them through menus. Once they have successfully changed a password, the vines retreat to their body for a celebratory dance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Pollen spread by POKENAME's wings causes flowers to grow on taskbars within cyberspace. In the real world, the pollen causes plants dusted by them to glow in the dark.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME impulsively constructs invisible barriers around vulnerable programs to shield them from viruses. It does this any time it spots an unprotected program.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been seen in cyberspace on websites dedicated to circuses. Despite naturally fitting into its surroundings, POKENAME behaves as if it has no memory of how or why it lives there.
author: sk372

entry: Should POKENAME's floating hands make contact with a foe, frost will begin to build up on them. Prolonged exposure can freeze the foe entirely.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME blasts intense flames onto computer equipment before consuming it. Any melted equipment it has no taste for is left behind, rendered entirely unusable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pitiful strength and goofy appearance means that it is almost never taken seriously. Even its cry is comical, being a high-pitched noise that sounds like a digitized trumpet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resides in oak trees, where it feeds on the leaves. Should a predator like Pidgeotto approach, it fires a burst of electricity from its horn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an angry, destructive creature bent on damaging any data it comes across. Its segments can separate and fling about at high speeds, making its indiscriminate rampages quick to decimate its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a unique digitized voice, heard when it sings as it ferries others across the water. As its song continues, digital music notes appear in the air around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's processors let it analyze foes at a glance and quickly assume their form. However, its capabilities are still developing, so it usually can only mimic their shape, while unable to change its coloration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are resilient creatures that can change the properties of their body to resist attacks. This conversion ability protects them from many types of attacks, but a skilled Trainer can easily exploit this ability to create an opening.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy playing in images and videos of lakes and rivers, as they love to swim. Many POKENAME who get to experience real water find themselves baffled at how cold the water is.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are found in long videos of burning fireplaces that are found on video hosting platforms. Many people fail to notice when POKENAME are around because the video is used as background noise for other activities.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion between two different Porygon versions resembles what is seen during evolution. POKENAME always seems uncomfortable, constantly asking to be scratched and massaged.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME seeks out empty corners of the internet to hide itself and wait out evolution. Chips in its cocoon quickly regenerate, but for a short time reveal the flowing binary code beneath its shell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its shell to protect itself from viruses while traveling through cyberspace. It moves at surprising speeds in search of files to consume.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies out each morning in search of computer wires to line its nest. It wraps them around its Eggs in hopes of speeding up their hatch time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME offer free hugs to whoever clicks on them. They wrap their arms around the cursor and rock gently to deliver the hug, giving a moment's respite before returning to their solicitation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME automatically send PCs into hibernation mode after a long duration of inactivity. When their Trainer inevitably tries to turn on the PC, they need some time to wake up before turning on the rest of the PC.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While flying over a home with a computer turned on, deleted documents and programs have a habit of restoring themselves without warning. IT technicians have yet to determine how this occurs.
author: .izik

entry: Should POKENAME come across an undelivered email, it will grab it and do its best to find the recipient. Any spam it encounters along the way is simply eaten.
author: .izik

entry: The honey POKENAME produces is frequently used as a heat sink paste that causes computer equipment to run three times as fast. Scientists have yet to determine how this functions.
author: .izik

entry: A cybernetic marvel infused with psychic might, POKENAME processes data at unfathomable speeds. It embodies the future of artificial intelligence.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME is absolutely perplexed by people playing MMORPGs, following them around invisibly within the game. Some believe it manipulates the odds of rare item drops using its psychic powers.
author: .izik

entry: After consuming computer equipment, POKENAME's leaf emits an intense mustard aroma. This scent is extremely pungent and serves to ward off predators.
author: .izik

entry: While standing in direct sunlight, POKENAME releases a curious minty aroma that increases the speed of nearby computer equipment. An overcast sky stops this effect entirely.
author: .izik

entry: The petals on POKENAME's body light up during the password creation process. If all six petals are lit, it means that the user has chosen a very secure password.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Should POKENAME accidentally consume a virus, its body temporarily loses the ability to produce flames. This effect can last up to a day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a Porygon2 program installed into a polymeric robotic body. Its holographic flames can be just as hot as real fire.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME's furry body can convert to pure code in under a second, allowing it to traverse cyberspace with ease. The processing power of any system it travels through increases while it is present.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is constantly angry, no matter the day. Though it can not fly, it flings itself using vines like a slingshot.
author: themicelegion

entry: It travels into cyberspace when it wants to contemplate its thoughts. If one spots a POKENAME floating upside-down while in the computer, it's in a particularly heavy state of rumination.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often used by Pokémon Rangers and conservationists to monitor their local ecosystems. To record this information, they give off a scent that can be picked up by computers.
author: lynx.mauls

entry: POKENAME takes a long time to spin its webbing because it has to convert binary data into silk webbing. It takes about 6 hours to spin a single web but once made the tough web can catch rocks without breaking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To spin a web, POKENAME has to first convert binary data into silk. This silk is spun into webs that can catch rocks without tearing, giving POKENAME a resilient net to toss over prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses the two mandible-like spikes on its body to grab, pierce, and drain its prey of fluids and energy. The blue spike on its head was once assumed to be a mouth yet is actually a venomous spike that delivers a deadly neurotoxin.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will perch on the borders of computer windows, surveying its territory quietly. It's been known to sometimes attack a user's cursor, likely mistaking it for prey or an intruder.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's two antennae alternate in an azure glow while it hunts. The high pitched beeping they emit while swimming stuns nearby prey.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME inhabits a computer, the monitor intermittently releases large bursts of sparks. It causes sparks uncontrollably, despite its best efforts to stop.
author: .izik

entry: In direct moonlight, POKENAME emits an aura that causes nearby computers to run faster. When multiple gather together, this speed increase grows proportionally.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has an extremely smooth and soft body ideal for bouncing. When caught between two objects, it accelerates so fast that its mental programming must restart before it can stop itself.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME waddle around in a blue digital shell that protects them from viruses. They release a shrill cry for help when they encounter any corrupted data until it is cleaned up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear a corrupted shell of data that protects them from viruses. By wearing the shell, POKENAME are ignored by malicious software attacks, giving them the opportunity to cry for help.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have an incredible sense of hearing that allows them to follow cries of other Pokémon across PCs. They help fight against viruses and malware in the network, flying from PC to PC to remove the unwanted software.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to observe electronic sport tournaments and try to help players by contributing their own inputs. However, their eagerness to help often causes glitches, so they hop over to the next game before they can be caught.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: When near a computer, POKENAME gazes into the future to determine whether the device will fall victim to malware. If it foresees this, it stands sentry near the device with unwavering determination.
author: .izik

entry: The wool POKENAME produces is harvested by factories to insulate cables. Any cables it insulates operate at twice their normal efficiency.
author: .izik

entry: The blue portions around POKENAME's neck are as soft as wool. Should it absorb data about a type of cloth, those portions can mimic the feeling of that fabric within minutes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were once considered for planetary research, as their orb's bright light can be seen from space. While this is no longer the case, POKENAME are often used to guide marine vessels safely when researching deep oceans.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME travels between webpages in search of data about water. Once it finds a page it likes, it devours any nearby data.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys residing on desktops cluttered with icons, attempting to mimic them while standing perfectly still. If clicked multiple times, it beeps furiously before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: The propeller on POKENAME's head gives it a modicum of self-propelled flight capabilities. Its lightweight body means it is easily carried away by a strong breeze, however.
author: sk372

entry: A propeller spinning on POKENAME's head gives it the ability to fly about. It seems to prefer hovering around locations where lots of colorful flowers are in bloom.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's propeller spins at high speeds to keep it constantly aloft. It chases after sunlight, absorbed by the panels on its side to sustain itself with solar energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live near abandoned computers, connecting to them just to consume the data inside for food. It can live near almost any computer, even ones with malware.
author: equation8573

entry: The blue leaves growing from POKENAME's head regrow each month and release a small electric spark when cut. Many chefs prize them for their delightful sunflower seed flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body takes on a texture resembling a real flower when exposed to direct sunlight. It can survive entirely off the sun's rays without eating for years.
author: .izik

entry: The speed at which POKENAME flaps its wings can be increased by overclocking its body. Once it reaches approximately 80 flaps a minute, it flaps so fast that cameras struggle to capture the wing's motion, even in slow motion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: There is a running gag in comedy movies that spilling water over a computer causes a POKENAME to be created, who will then stumble around, glitching out. Although this is false, many people believe it, and several have found out the hard way.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is the mascot of a popular game found on PCs that is hosted in cyberspace. During gameplay, it attempts to determine what fictional or real-life character, object, or animal the player is thinking of by asking a series of questions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a strong aversion for light mode on many websites and will force dark mode whenever possible. If the website does not have a dark mode, POKENAME slow it down to discourage their Trainer from using it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's performance in virtual reality improves if exposed to moonlight before connecting. It monitors dark mode plug-ins for landing pages, forcefully eliminating any malware.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME erroneously displays itself as a level one Pokémon to deceive its opponents, as its display does not update. There are few Trainers that are fooled by its antics, as most children learn from an early age not to believe everything they see.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soar through cyberspace playing tricks on the internet. Sometimes they hide sound files of crowing deep inside nested folders, while other times they may make the PC look like it is restarting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite having malware constantly sucking its data, POKENAME is always calm. It uses this virus as a way to learn more about the dark parts of the internet and gain knowledge on how to defend against these different types of malware.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's increased digital power from its previous form has allowed it to modify its data core into a more realistic flower appearance. It attracts real and digital bugs with this core, absorbing them for nutrients.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME plagues outdated computer systems, as it disrupts proper performance of these systems. It is known to cause these disruptions by mimicking user input.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME mischievously possess PCs to change what appears on screen whenever the user presses a button. Whenever the user tries to demonstrate this phenomenon, POKENAME revert the controls to cause further confusion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have an extensive understanding of each and every language. If a Trainer develops a good relationship with a POKENAME, it will translate ancient texts for them.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME appears rarely within cyberspace, often on sites pertaining to research into the paranormal. It can hijack text boxes to communicate, but despite its apparent intelligence it can only create short, basic sentences.
author: sk372

entry: It resembles a pattern seen often in nature. In battle, it uses the power of rotation to drastically increase the force of its attacks.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: After even brief exposure to a computer virus, POKENAME's body glows and counters it with a solution that safeguards the system it inhabits. Many IT technicians refer to it as the Hard Drive Safeguard.
author: .izik

entry: The Porygon-Z on its tail enjoys bugging the Pokémon it lives on. Just its presence makes this Pokémon's psychic abilities unstable and unpredictable.
author: zeeroooo

entry: POKENAME appears on computer screens when bored, accompanied by a countdown. Should it reach zero before being clicked, it detonates and destroys the device.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's head and tail can extend from its body, loosely tethered to it by streams of data. This allows it to better search its surroundings to make sure it's safe before it digs a hole for itself using its tail-tip.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME glides between webpages in search of images that catch its interest. Upon finding one, it takes bites directly out of the image.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can easily understand data flows in cyberspace and digs out new pathways when it finds a possible improvement. However, in the real world, its extreme roundness makes it much harder for it to plow through dirt and rock easily.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are known to connect themselves into PCs and mimic user input. Though they typically look for videos about cheese and are content with that, some have made expensive purchases of cheese wheels on the internet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's beak carries an electrical charge when attacking prey such as Caterpie. Even a single Peck can stun long enough for it to finish them off.
author: .izik

entry: When present on a desktop, POKENAME tries to project a tough image by throwing punches and making digital growls. Simply clicking on it once shatters the image as it grows fearful and runs off while whimpering.
author: sk372

entry: After clamping onto a program with its pincers, POKENAME runs a diagnostic to locate broken coding inside. This coding is then repaired instantly through its unusual powers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a sentient digital being that made its home in a shell. POKENAME's shell can withstand many hard hits from strong Pokémon.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is a sentient digital being that made its home in a shell. POKENAME's shell can withstand many hard hits from strong Pokémon.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME releases a signal from its horn that causes nearby computers to malfunction. The radius of this signal extends after it consumes pine sap.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to chop malware it finds online into edible code. It then gathers with others of its kind to consume it together.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often fall for honeypot traps and end up blocked from many PCs. This is because POKENAME believe that honeypots have honey, when in reality they are traps to stop hackers from accessing sensitive information.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's bubbling hot body cools significantly after consuming computer equipment. It is not a picky eater but reaches its fill very quickly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hot yet gelatinous body can convert to code in order to enter a computer. Any system it inhabits runs incredibly slowly while it is present.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its long beak to connect to computers and download data at incredible speed. The more data POKENAME carries, the slower its wings move.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has an excellent sense of smell, even said to be capable of smelling fragrances on far-off planets. It stores every scent and location of the scent in its memory, including the foul odors it wants to forget.
author: soup1900

entry: Though POKENAME's tentacles are stubby, it can project digital extensions of each tentacle to give it more reach and take foes by surprise. It mostly inhabits underwater cavern areas, keeping intruders out with its many limbs.
author: sk372

entry: They were given an upgrade to improve the speed of electronic mail delivery. They chirp in 8-bit tones when they deliver mail to Trainers.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME's round and blubbery armor allows it to easily take and repel any attack sent against it. The shed feathers of its wings make for great pool noodles.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME connect themselves to the internet to hunt for malware. Infected files are torn apart until the malware is neutralized, giving POKENAME a free meal and helping protect PCs at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its digital flames to burn files before consuming them. How it selects which files to eat remains a mystery to many.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a soft material that deforms with a slight touch. It can flatten and reshape itself to an extent, making it excellent at hiding away in small spaces; it often prefers being inside computer towers.
author: sk372

entry: The bubbles POKENAME creates shift in shape based on images it has consumed. These can range from simple shapes to incredibly intricate forms.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME rolls across websites, it leaves behind a stream of nonsensical coding. Scientists have studied this coding for years without reaching any conclusions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often used by large companies for cybersecurity due to its immense power and quick reaction speed. It can go from resting to firing a Hyper Beam quickly when something malicious is detected.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME are becoming increasingly favored by digital artists thanks to their versatility on computers across many creative projects.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: POKENAME prefers to train by entering fighting games in arcades. It can learn the moves of virtual opponents in a remarkably short period of time.
author: .izik

entry: The symbol on this Pokémon's stomach represents how much electricity it has eaten. When it gets full, it will transfer the electricity into nearby devices, which fills it with artificial intelligence.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME moves by slithering in perfect 90 degree angles. A foreign tech company uses the pattern on its hood as their logo.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME travels the internet consuming images related to food. Oddly, the milk it produces takes on the flavor of whatever food images it has eaten.
author: .izik

entry: A digital program embedded in POKENAME's body simulates the care and protection of an egg. POKENAME works tirelessly to attend to this virtual egg.
author: hophoppip

entry: The water POKENAME vomits can purge viruses from a system and boost processing power across any connected devices in the network. This appears to be taxing enough that it rarely does so.
author: .izik

entry: The more data POKENAME consumes, the more powerful the Zap Cannon it can unleash. It reserves this only as a last resort when its hard shell fails to deter a predator.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was created as a new form of Porygon2 using the data of a Pikachu that was placed into the Pokémon Storage System. However, it quickly duplicated itself and is now overabundant.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME can enhance nearby devices' auto-recovery systems, enabling them to restore any kind of file. When it connects to a new device, its wings glow in rainbow colors for a few seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME possesses the power to travel through time in cyberspace, visiting previous versions of websites. It seems to find solace in living in the quiet depths of old and defunct sites that no longer see traffic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's CPU is able to process complex emotions, but for unknown reasons, sadness is the emotion most prevalent in its databases. Many a Trainer take pity on it and hope to care for it and replace its sadness with joy over time.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME possess a PC, they mischievously scramble the data on spreadsheets to scare the PC's owner. They revert the changes they have made before the owner can show anyone to cause further confusion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A devious trickster and manipulator, POKENAME hides within a computer's data, finding and hoarding the most important files. Then, it appears before the owner and threatens to delete them, attempting to force users to do its bidding.
author: sk372

entry: The blue rocks on POKENAME's head glow at night and emit low beeps. The rhythm of these beeps shifts in sync with its heartbeat.
author: .izik

entry: Due to a programming error, POKENAME has gotten into the advertising market. However, all of its products are shabby and broken at best.
author: skymaster426

entry: Should POKENAME come across a webpage containing violent or disturbing images while browsing, it will cry uncontrollably. These tears destroy the coding of the webpage before it moves on.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found surfing the internet on a keyboard and wearing a green hat. As long as the PC has a steady supply of electricity, POKENAME can roam freely on the internet and explore to their heart's content.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This species of Pokémon was once infamously utilized by a hacker. As POKENAME is highly magnetic even when inside of an electronic device, it can easily damage both computer software and even the hardware.
author: bobosmith01

entry: As it can eat and later dispose of almost any material, POKENAME is particularly used in cleaning up areas that were damaged due to the side effects of fused Pokémon. When it travels through the internet, it can concoct its own cleanup plans, too.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME serves as an emergency generator for hospitals, as its upgrades allow it to produce excess electricity. With its tails, it can connect to the net in a few milliseconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME help escort Pokémon stuck in virus-ridden PCs to a safe place while their Trainers fight viruses and malware. They are incredibly resilient creatures that shield weaker Pokémon with their large bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME only come out of cyberspace if they find a very dusty system. They build nests out of dust next to a PC, draining data from it. They don't manage to stay in one place long, as the interference they cause often results in spring-cleaning.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME flap their wings so fast that their flying cannot be properly recorded on video. Many tech enthusiasts have learned ways to slow down their flying so that they can be properly captured on video, such as having them open nested folders.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME find pictures of grassy fields to frolic through, hopping around and changing size until they are satisfied. They are particularly fond of a certain background that comes with many older PCs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tail releases a powerful virus that corrupts computers within minutes. Many hard drives become irreparable after it takes hold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its large tusks to seek out and destroy viruses within computers. Due to its size, it unfortunately destroys normal programs in the process as well.
author: .izik

entry: The first version of this Pokémon was the result of using an antivirus on a Porygon-Z. It has the powers of Porygon-Z with the emotions of a Porygon2.
author: valtsuri

entry: Thanks to the fusion, Porygon takes on the shape intended as its final form. Its much more stable behavior feels incredibly relieving to those who have trained the original Porygon-Z.
author: epping_forest

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head and arms grow incredibly long while it consumes corrupted files. It somehow retains whatever information is salvageable from the files it eats.
author: .izik

entry: The seeds POKENAME's body produces contain millions of lines of code. Many Super Nerds study this coding as it holds solutions to numerous errors programs commonly face.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses Ember to singe programs it finds on unmanned computers before consuming them. Even just two files can sustain it for weeks.
author: .izik

entry: The data used to create this Pokémon has been updated and made capable of updating as it comes across minerals it once knew not of. Its claws and quills become hard during battle or when it feels threatened.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spends its time consuming martial arts data from the internet, exhibiting techniques based on what it learns. Each POKENAME develops a slightly different fighting style as a result.
author: .izik

entry: The slightly electrified water POKENAME spits is somehow capable of reprogramming card scanners it touches. It appears to do this purely as a prank.
author: .izik

entry: While spinning in a ballet dance, POKENAME causes nearby computers to operate faster. This unfortunately also puts any people in the vicinity to sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tasks itself with keeping all of its Trainer's personal data absolutely safe. It will go so far as creating digital black holes to completely eradicate even a mildly threatening program it finds near said data.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's headset allows it to simulate battles without sustaining any injuries. Gaining combat experience makes these simulations increasingly accurate; therefore, it actively seeks out stronger opponents in hopes of refining its databases.
author: bollocksmen

entry: The first recorded sighting of POKENAME was on an almost-defunct occult website. This has led to rumors that if POKENAME appears on one's computer, staring at it for more than a brief moment will steal one's soul.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's abilities let it perfectly mimic the computer backdrop behind it. It pranks computer users by staying invisible and grabbing their cursor with its tongue, impeding its movements.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME links its claw with others of its kind to transfer data and share information. It also serves as an effective combat technique, as two POKENAME exhibit exponentially stronger abilities while linked.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can multitask and learn multiple subjects at once due to having two separate AIs. However, having two separate brain networks sometimes causes it to take actions that contradict each other.
author: soup1900

entry: Four core processing units working simultaneously give POKENAME vast intellectual capacity. It is often used to assist in programming, making improvements and fixing coding errors in mere seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sharpen their buck teeth by chewing on files already marked for deletion. If there are no suitable files to chew on, they resort to chewing on their Trainer's documents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lies in wait, pretending to be a discarded and harmless USB stick. Those foolish and curious enough to insert it into their computer will have 108 viruses installed into it within seconds.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME cannot truly fly, it is capable of gliding for extended periods. Its glide paths strangely overlap with active airplane flight paths for reasons unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's experimental programming has allowed it to transform the flowering data core into a nearly real tree. It still stores the majority of the data within this core, so it is fiercely protective against Pokémon attempting to nest in or eat it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME help provide security to login boxes by disabling passwords after too many attempts have been made, clamping down on the login box to indicate that it is unable to be used. Once they disable a password, only their Trainer can reactivate it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are one of the many Pokémon that can be seen on loading screens. Poking at their ball causes their rear head to open its mouth, allowing the user to feed them treats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME ingrain themselves onto abandoned servers in derelict facilities to absorb leftover data. Small clusters travel together and take turns monitoring their surroundings while sharing the same server.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has holographic wings that serve no real use. The display screen that serves as its face runs on an operating system that seems to come from 200 years into the future.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: Lifeguards in rural areas enjoy the company of POKENAME due to their ability to calculate the progression of the tides and when the water is safe. However, beaches with their own radars avoid keeping POKENAME due to the computer bugs they can cause.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The more data POKENAME consumes, the harder its skull becomes. It rams its head into stones to train and test its strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its hardened head to fend off malware attempting to enter computers. It guards any system it inhabits as if it were its own young.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rounded, smooth body makes it more aerodynamic, giving it great speed and mobility for charging. Folding its crest down creates a dome of cyber energy over its skull to enhance its Headbutt attack.
author: sk372

entry: When something collides with POKENAME's solid skull, the colored segments shuffle their pigments into a randomized assortment. If all the colors match, POKENAME exhibits a remarkable boost in power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to masquerade as a balloon animal in the presence of humans. It has been reported appearing on random digital media in the background, drawing attention to itself with random gags regardless of tone.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME can communicate directly with any electronic using the antenna on its head. It learns by accepting any request sent to it and carrying it out before analyzing the events to determine whether it should complete other similar requests.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME swim through cyberspace in pods to collect public data from websites. They open their mouths to scrape up any data they may find so their bodies can organize the data into usable information.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim through cyberspace to scrape data from old websites. This data is aggregated into their bodies as compressed data that many archivists rely on to find old media files.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's mind and data-ring are so immensely powerful that it can code or rewrite intricate programs on the fly. Many Porygon in cyberspace flock to it in the hopes it may one day use its abilities to power them up.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME regularly traverses chat servers in search of bot accounts and spammers. Upon finding them, it compulsively uses Absorb to consume their messages.
author: .izik

entry: A unique moving pattern featuring creatures in a maze forms on POKENAME's shell. Its tree bears blocky fruit periodically, which is only edible for the Porygon species and its fusions.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME can eat solid food, it can survive entirely off heat absorbed from mechanical equipment. It can often be spotted in server rooms pressing its nose against hot equipment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits high-pressure electrified water at anyone who ventures too close to its nest. The force is strong enough to knock over a willow tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME synchronizes beeps with others of its kind near its lakeside den. The tips of its wings blink bright blue throughout these performances.
author: .izik

entry: A strong magnetic force within POKENAME's nose helps keep it upright. Even if forcibly toppled over, it will right itself quickly thanks to the potent magnetism.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large nose can somehow detect files from great distances. After identifying its preferred files, it will consume them greedily.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's twin blades swing through the air with smoothness and grace, but its power seems not entirely stable. Its tassels occasionally flicker into binary code, and some of its swings will trail an arc of code that it did not intend to create.
author: sk372

entry: The longer POKENAME's data-blade is unsheathed, the more it begins to distort and glitch as its power runs wild. As such, it aims to end battles in as quick and decisive a manner as possible.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fiercely protect their Trainer's PC and stand as the first line of defense against malware. Their stinger injects code that causes any malicious program to terminate, effectively neutralizing the threat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's visor gives it excellent eyesight, able to view things in perfect clarity no matter the conditions around it. It can even fire beams of heated energy from the visor to fight off enemies.
author: sk372

entry: Known to mesmerize with graceful movements, POKENAME can distort reality just enough to confuse foes while captivating onlookers, even through digital video formats.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME's wing texture becomes almost featherlike while flying to better capture air currents. Upon spotting a bird Pokémon, it uses Leer before moving in to attack its prey.
author: .izik

entry: While traveling through the internet, POKENAME studies images of humans it encounters. It can emerge at any time and perfectly imitate any human it has observed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are needy creatures that demand lots of attention from their Trainer. If ignored for a long period of time, they grab onto the cursor and restrain further input until they receive praise.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was designed to explore the acid seas of distant planets. However, the researchers have no way to get it there.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's power is so vast that it cannot always contain it within its body. Code spills out from it when it exerts itself, affecting and reshaping files and programs into something completely different.
author: sk372

entry: Now that it has been upgraded, POKENAME can float its cannon freely around itself. It can fire low‑polygon missiles, and it can also double as a shield.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME conceals itself in corners of cyberspace that few ever navigate to. Should a casual browser stumble upon it, it attacks instantly, emerging from their monitor with a readied Fusion Bolt.
author: .izik

entry: Though skittish by nature, POKENAME's programming compels it to be friendly and helpful towards others. It tends to act as a mascot to homepages for businesses, quickly dispensing tips and assistance before hiding just off-screen.
author: sk372

entry: The sesame scented spores POKENAME produces increase the processing power of any computer they touch. This boost lasts only a few hours at most.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an annoying prankster that takes delight in annoying any computer user it comes across. Its favorite method of doing so involves taking control of the user's keyboard and typing out rude messages with it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that hop from PC to PC through the internet. It is incredibly difficult to remove them from a possessed device, as antivirus software and firewalls cannot detect POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gel surrounding POKENAME is actually the code of a firewall that protects it from any cyberattack. Unfortunately, this firewall does not protect it at all against any real-world viruses or diseases.
author: soup1900

entry: The gel surrounding POKENAME is actually the code of a firewall that protects it from any cyberattack. Unfortunately, this firewall does not protect it at all against any real-world viruses or diseases.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have the ability to consume and store data inside their bodies, growing larger the more data they have stored. When POKENAME feel threatened, they fire stored data as a projectile from their mouths that makes their targets drowsy.
author: npshi

entry: While floating through cyberspace, POKENAME shakes a thick powder loose from its body. This powder destroys any viruses it comes into contact with.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME access computer programs by transforming their hands to look like the apps they want to use. They are most often seen using many social media sites at once to post media of cool tombs and to cyberbully grave robbers.
author: soup1900

entry: The seeds POKENAME scatters across webpages grow into vines that siphon data into its body as nourishment. The growth cycle is rapid but the vines fade within a day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME relies on a complex physics engine to produce its drooping appearance. Its body constantly seems to be melting, even though its mass remains the same.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME resemble a special kind of lamp that has a light bulb at the base to melt wax and form blobs of light. Their constantly changing shape makes them important for cybersecurity, as a vault full of POKENAME is used to encrypt data.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This upgraded version of POKENAME can control individual pieces of its body with pinpoint accuracy. It uses this ability in various ways, such as disassembling mid-battle to dodge an attack or separating its arms to fly after its target.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME learns various ways to use its internal organs for fighting by watching media on combat lessons. It can freely shape its ejected organs into any weapon it has learned how to use to fight against foes.
author: soup1900

entry: Similar to Klefki, POKENAME is known to steal people's USB sticks and put them on its keychain for safekeeping.
author: oatmeal42

entry: POKENAME's Porygon2 disguise is almost flawless at a glance, but becomes obvious the moment it receives damage. Rather than being full of programming code, darkness spills out from any cut or gap.
author: sk372

entry: While traversing cyberspace, POKENAME actively searches for hackers. Should it spot one, it infiltrates their PC and melts the components inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's three heads resemble the three stages of Porygon evolution. The conflicting programming in each head causes POKENAME to act erratically and violently, thrashing about and destroying any data it comes across.
author: sk372

entry: The flames POKENAME produces grow more intense when it consumes large computer files. At its peak, the flame can burn hot enough to melt a boulder in minutes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's artificial intelligence is quite robust, letting it store vast amounts of data and knowledge on many subjects. It seems most fascinated by the subject of wishes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a docile creature, but when threatened, a strange yet familiar glitched form appears around it and typically frightens off attackers. It's not known if this is an instinctive ability of POKENAME's or something else entirely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swim through cyberspace looking for films about rivers to download onto their Trainer's PC. Once they have acquired a video, they loop sections showing the river to give themselves a place to build shelter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trains its martial arts by watching videos online. It can learn entirely new techniques from a single viewing.
author: .izik

entry: Though shy, POKENAME is also deeply curious and watches users browse the internet with quiet contentment. If spotted, it sends a brief shock through their mouse before retreating deeper into the internet.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to inhabit cellphones. Should it notice the device's power running low, it will use its own electricity as a supplement to keep it charged.
author: .izik

entry: Although the melodies it creates are highly praised, POKENAME's primitive technology means it can only produce chiptunes with two melody channels and one percussion channel.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME lets out loud beeping noises while eating metal ore. Though many assumed this indicated happiness, scientists have determined it to be an involuntary reaction.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME devours a file with its massive jaws, no trace remains. It can hide within email inboxes, patiently waiting days for spam messages to arrive so it can consume them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of electricity from its wings to incapacitate prey such as Cacnea. It then carries them to distant sand dunes to eat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims across cyberspace until it finds a comfortable desktop screen to inhabit. Curious and easily distracted, it often swims up to investigate anything on the screen, making it a bit of a distracting nuisance for most users.
author: sk372

entry: After consuming a virus, POKENAME converts the data into useful code to reinforce its shell. In the real world this shell is powerful enough to withstand direct lightning strikes.
author: .izik

entry: At first glance POKENAME appears smooth and rounded, but the sides of its gears are made up of numerous tiny ridges that interlock during rotation. This design lets it spin and generate energy much quicker and more effectively.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spots a computer it wants to draw data from, every portion of its body begins rotating rapidly. An electric current runs through its body throughout this process.
author: .izik

entry: It has an obedient personality. No matter what angle it is viewed at, the flame on POKENAME's tail seems to completely cover what is behind it and cloak it in a pink and black pattern that sometimes appears in graphic design tools.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Thanks to its updated audio drivers, it can produce exquisite and detailed music of any kind.  Because of this, it is sometimes used as a living music player - a role which POKENAME actually greatly enjoys.
author: empty_set

entry: The seeds POKENAME produces carry electrical charges. Should they make contact with a computer, it will surge and shut down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a signal while bouncing that increases the processing power of nearby computers. The faster it bounces, the greater the effect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ethereal body passes through solid objects with ease. Computers it passes through malfunction briefly before recovering and operating better than before.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME floats over fields it emits tiny intermittent beeps. It also releases a pleasant lavender scent that relaxes those beneath it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consumes inorganic material to live. It prefers to float in pools to drink the chlorine there.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's body converts to pure code when it dives into computer terminals alongside its swarm. Once inside, it attempts to consume any data it can find.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's skin shifts to match the consistency of whatever sand it burrows through. While burrowing it can reach speeds of up to 60 mph.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks on occult websites waiting for users to connect. When they do, it emerges from their screen and beeps loudly to startle them as a prank.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds its webs within text documents while consuming the information inside. If disturbed, it lets off a small spark before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pink metallic body is extremely hard. When malware is nearby, its body hardens even further as a natural reflex.
author: .izik

entry: When young, POKENAME's chirping sounds like an abhorrent beeping noise. This deters both allies and foes from approaching its nesting grounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME studies the flying styles of other bird Pokémon through videos it consumes online. It can mimic these styles with remarkable ease and little effort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to nestle amongst CD collections, for comfort and safety. If picked up and placed in a computer or music player, it produces nothing but junk data and noise before angrily popping out of the disc slot.
author: sk372

entry: Evolution has blessed POKENAME with a sleeker look and higher intelligence. However, it's become completely paranoid and constantly on high alert.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Programs that POKENAME rolls over in virtual environments have their bugs instantly fixed. Many technicians have taken to calling it the Rolling Solution.
author: .izik

entry: While traveling through cyberspace, POKENAME's venom converts into complex computer viruses. It uses these to mask its presence within systems while feasting on files.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gets quite attached to the computers it inhabits, especially in the case of domesticated individuals. Attempting to upgrade to a new computer results in it freezing the newer device solid in a jealous fit.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases a melting plastic scent from its leaves while standing in sunlight. This aroma tends to speed up computers in the surrounding area.
author: .izik

entry: While dancing on someone's desktop, POKENAME causes all running programs to operate at incredible speeds. This can frustrate gamers as their games become too fast to play effectively.
author: .izik

entry: While dancing on a desktop, POKENAME prevents any programs from opening entirely. The only way to regain access is to repeatedly interrupt it by clicking its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feasts on computer viruses and old junk files. As it consumes more malware, POKENAME becomes better at intercepting hackers, and even gains the ability to fight back with viruses of its own.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME is best kept alone, as its hunger for data grows greater as it gets close to others of its kind. Even a small school of POKENAME could devour every bit of data within a computer in minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grew in popularity with cybersecurity experts after Silph Co. went through a major data breach. They roam the dark web to slice through password files with their serrated teeth, stopping hackers from profiting off of leaked passwords.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can wirelessly connect to devices to amplify sound. Sometimes they store sounds they enjoy hearing into their memory and play them while they fight in Pokémon battles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can connect themselves into the internet to download sounds they enjoy listening to. Whenever they are fighting in a Pokémon battle, they play their own theme song to get into the groove of battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky at the same elevation as airplanes and often perch on those planes as they fly. Their chirps sound like a ringing cellphone, causing confusion for people on planes who were not expecting any calls.
author: quackquackattack
