entry: POKENAME has a special arrow on its fluffy body that always points away from the ground. This arrow is created from the special sensors in its body that detect the planet's gravitational pull, ensuring that POKENAME remains upright while flying.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's gooey, smooth body is coated in a special slime full of antivirus data. Viruses and malware that try to infect it are neutralized instantly, and absorbed into its body to sustain it.
author: sk372

entry: The clear mucus covering POKENAME's body is frequently applied to computer equipment as it causes devices to run more efficiently. Even a small bottle can fetch a considerable price.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy presence is strong enough to immediately freeze a computer it enters. A user visited by POKENAME has no options other than waiting until it leaves of its own accord.
author: sk372

entry: The computer POKENAME inhabits gradually develops a thick layer of metal over its exterior. The longer it stays inside, the thicker these layers become.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often used to transmit signals over long distances, sending vital data between Pokémon Centers and Laboratories. Wild POKENAME release small, toxic spores that cause nearby electronics to malfunction, the reason why is unknown.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME siphons ambient energy from electronics near it, absorbed into the crystal-like growths on its arms. It releases this energy in pulsing waves strong enough to cause computers in its vicinity to explode.
author: sk372

entry: The process of fusion has made POKENAME an unexpectedly good singer. They have been known to gather in bands to perform for up to five nights straight.
author: epolybius

entry: POKENAME's appearance and friendliness towards children have led to it being used as a company mascot in the past. There are sordid rumors that one POKENAME once bit a child, causing severe harm, but these reports are unsubstantiated.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins its disembodied arms around itself rapidly as a method of offense and defense. Its spines contain a bit of special venom that will dizzy Porygon fusions pricked by them.
author: sk372

entry: Small needles begin sprouting from the sides of any server POKENAME inhabits. Oddly, these needles feel and behave just like real cactus needles.
author: .izik

entry: The blue spores POKENAME scatters seem to slow down any computing devices they touch. Once brushed away, however, those devices operate more efficiently than before.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME act like a firewall for their Trainer's PC, as they monitor network traffic to protect the PC from viruses, malware, and phishing emails. They are a reliable source of security for Trainers who use the internet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tail contains a light blue liquid that IT technicians use for cooling computers. Systems using this liquid somehow run twice as fast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lets out loud beeps resembling barks while traveling with its pack. They are most often spotted hunting together in the late evening.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME guide new song composers through digital audio editors and assist with the creation of music. Once a song composer is able to produce music on their own, they hop into cyberspace to help more people create music.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bear a resemblance to a mascot of voice synthesizer software and help composers type in lyrics and a melody to create awe-inspiring songs. These songs can become quite popular and are often shared on social media.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even a brief glimpse of POKENAME on a webpage can trigger lucid dreaming for months. These sightings are so rare that many have taken to calling it the Blue Moon Dream.
author: .izik

entry: While infiltrating a computing system, POKENAME scatters pink spores across files to infect them. These infected files passively siphon coding from nearby programs to feed it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of round leaves. After consuming microchips, these leaves emit a delightful fruity scent.
author: .izik

entry: It has been upgraded to increase its data compression capabilities to astounding levels. Critics have argued that it is so densely packed that retrieving any one piece of information is effectively impossible.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: While traveling through a system, POKENAME releases puffs of purple powder that cause any files they touch to slowly degrade. These degrading files serve as ideal food for others in its swarm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very stubborn about sharing its baked goods. It constantly urges others to accept its offer of cookies and other treats, and won't stop insisting until a person gives in and accepts them.
author: sk372

entry: After absorbing data on martial arts masters found online, POKENAME trains in back alleys with others of its kind. Their training sessions often result in extensive damage to nearby buildings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often appear on webpages whenever a download is taking too long. The misspelt loading icon is meant to be humorous and to ease the wait of a given file.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The more data POKENAME consumes, the more rapidly the colored light on its body shifts as it floats through the air. Staring at it too long can cause seizures.
author: .izik

entry: The power of POKENAME's tail-flame has begun to grow past its capacity to control it properly. Occasionally, it glitches and distorts the area around the fire, especially while in cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: The flame at the end of POKENAME's tail obscures anything behind it. The brightly colored flame has a pink and black pattern around it that can also be found in graphic design tools. Anything burnt by this flame has a burnt plastic smell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travels through air vents to ambush its prey. It's believed to be capable of surviving in space, but scientists worry that it would harm its crewmates.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME monitors online meeting platforms to prevent illegal activity. Recent updates have made it more resistant to viruses and faster at responding whenever issues arise.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Tech companies harvest the fur POKENAME sheds to create wiring. This wiring increases processing speeds at notably high intervals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bury themselves deep within computer code. Computers inhabited by this Pokémon experience massive amounts of pop-up ads, actively slowing down any attempts to remove it.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent though.
author: serversizeme

entry: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent.
author: serversizeme

entry: POKENAME travels the internet in groups of three to learn about the world. When larger groups gather, they use Assist to show off one another's skills in brilliant displays.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consumes the coding of relaxing musical files online to memorize the music. This apparently helps it meditate with greater efficiency.
author: .izik

entry: Banks worldwide maintain special firewalls to keep POKENAME out of their systems. Should it breach one, it consumes any financial data it can find.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is both friendly and rambunctious. If this digital feline Pokémon gets into your hard drive, you may find your files scattered about afterwards.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME leaps from phone to phone, consuming the data inside each one. Anyone who touches an inhabited device will receive a brief electric jolt before it emerges and flees.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rummages through abandoned science facilities in search of computer equipment to consume. Its mouth can expand roughly five times its normal body length to engulf larger pieces of equipment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME work in the background of PCs to occasionally make autosaves. Whenever they are asked to hand over an autosave, they get anxious if the autosave option is off, so much so that they develop a nasty migraine until one is made.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's smooth and streamlined body makes it an excellent swimmer, cutting through rivers and lakes with great speed. It possesses a mild level of telekinesis that lets it manipulate the water near it as well.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME can levitate slightly, it is unable to truly fly. When attacking airborne foes it can unleash Zap Cannons simultaneously from all of its beaks.
author: .izik

entry: The orb that lets POKENAME make its chimes is not attached to its body. Occasionally it cries so hard that the orb flies out, forcing POKENAME to give chase or be forever silent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to eat byte packages from messages sent via the internet, letting out a happy little chime every time it finds a new one. Some message recovery protocols only exist to account for the bites a POKENAME has taken out of the message.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The rings of data around POKENAME's limbs are thought to be limiter programs to keep its power in check. If they were to break, POKENAME's temper and power would go haywire, leading to disaster.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's favorite food is hard drives. After a satisfactory meal, its flame attacks increase in power threefold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is used to protect major companies' data centers all around the world. Obsessed with security, it races through the virtual world at supersonic speed, scraping data to stay constantly updated.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have been upgraded with the intent to traverse space, though they ultimately lack the power to breach the atmosphere. Due to original designs, however, POKENAME are highly adaptable to many situations, especially combat.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME looks almost identical to a normal Poliwag, even able to infiltrate pods of them without issue. The main way to distinguish it is through the bubbles it blows, which are made of binary code.
author: sk372

entry: The screen on POKENAME's belly displays images based on the coding it consumes. When hungry, the screen goes blank and any water it fires becomes extremely weak.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME presses its spoon to computers when no one is nearby, consuming unused files and increasing processing speed. Should it be spotted, it teleports away instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the spoon it holds to focus its mind. As long as nobody distracts it, it is capable of incredible feats of computer programming.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME's mind is powerful enough that it can use its telekinesis to directly influence the digital world around it. It uses spoons to help channel this vast energy; losing them could potentially let its powers run rampant.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can connect to digital devices and download data from them. Its mind functions more like a computer than a brain, and it never forgets anything unless it decides to delete it.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME learns new fighting techniques by consuming data online. Many Trainers report it using maneuvers they never taught it.
author: .izik

entry: The arms of POKENAME double as large fiber-optic cables that can transfer over 10 gigabytes of data per second from one hand to another. POKENAME have software installed inside their powerful bodies, which results in impeccable strikes.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME blows bubbles filled with binary code as a method of self-defense. Though not particularly strong on biological units, digital beings are susceptible to many adverse effects if the bubbles hit them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swim through cyberspace and explore the internet to follow whatever grabs their attention. They gravitate towards videos of beaches, pausing the video so that they can freely swim in the digital sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The acid POKENAME spits is incredibly conductive. It douses foes with it before releasing a Zap Cannon from its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is found in the darkest depths of the sea where it corrupts data from sunken ships. Studying POKENAME is difficult, as its tentacles corrupt equipment used to study its body and force the devices to give inaccurate readings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To communicate with its own kind, POKENAME emits light from the blue organs atop its head. Much of its lower body is pitch black to serve as camouflage, yet it can emit bright green lights along its lower body to intimidate others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body mimics hardness based on the data it consumes. Data related to minerals increases its hardness significantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls through webpages in search of images to consume. If spotted, it shakes violently before exploding and damaging the viewer's screen.
author: .izik

entry: Known as "The Ball of Metal," POKENAME is known for its round shape and hefty legs. When startled, it curls up and rolls in circles at great speeds.
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal

entry: Close inspection reveals small flame jets on the underside of POKENAME's body that help propel it around quickly. It is friendly towards young children, making it a pleasant companion for thrilling rides.
author: sk372

entry: Despite software updates improving the amount of memory this Pokémon has, POKENAME still runs out due to memory leaks. People are frustrated when the loading progress stalls out near the end after its fast initial progress.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME is always lying around because it needs a lot of time to process any new info it learns. It has a hard time understanding what pain is since it never feels any on its tail.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME gather into small groups to host swimming competitions in cyberspace. Once they have selected a suitable photo of the sea, they dive into the photo to race against each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: On the tail of POKENAME is a large piece of malware that is constantly trying to infect POKENAME. When this virus bites down, POKENAME has some of its data sucked off of it, causing it great pain.
author: soup1900

entry: While POKENAME inhabits a computer, icons and windows begin sticking together as if magnetized. This proves incredibly frustrating for anyone trying to use the device.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME inhabits a computer, all cords and wires lock into their slots as if held by magnets. The moment POKENAME leaves, they all pop out of the device at once.
author: .izik

entry: In combat, POKENAME's left head releases low-toned beeps while its right releases high-toned beeps. This allows it to coordinate attacks against its foe with surprising force.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its legs appearing to have joints, POKENAME has never been seen using them. Instead, it just slides around rapidly. The antennae on each head appear to pick up and magnify strange signals from unknown origins.
author: exaltedghost

entry: POKENAME travels through cyberspace alongside others of its pod. It migrates between ocean coastlines by entering and exiting computers located at either end.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats lazily above calm water, barely moving. Should it make any noise at all, it comes as a booming beep loud enough to shatter glass.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an asset to programmers as it feeds on corrupted data, absorbing it into its body. It can still be a threat to digital programs as it may leave behind pieces of junk code while traveling cyberspace.
author: pjporwoll

entry: High-pressure streams of pure data can be fired from POKENAME's two cannons in its shell. It is an effective defense against malware, able to wash away malicious programs with pinpoint accuracy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slow down other Pokémon in cyberspace by shooting targets with raw data from the cannons on their back. This makes POKENAME an ally in cybersecurity, as they can effectively neutralize malicious processes to stop data corruption.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME haunt old PCs by writing and sending emails under the name of the deceased. Many grieving families break old PCs into pieces to prevent POKENAME from taking control.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME haunt old PCs of the deceased to send scary messages to the living. They grab old photos with their ethereal hands and display a distorted image as the background image. Thankfully for families, POKENAME never modify the original photos.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a seemingly odd habit of licking anything and anyone it comes across, much to the chagrin of others. It was eventually discovered that by licking things, it can learn of them and store that information for years as memories.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spread malware on old PCs to cause mischief. Many pieces of vital digital infrastructure have been compromised by POKENAME, causing a worldwide push to upgrade to newer PCs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to a flaw in its programming, POKENAME is unable to approach computers without creating virus programs that attack them.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME corrupts data on old PCs that lack the protection that comes with new PCs. This destructive software has caused much heartache, as precious photos and important tax documents become unrecognizable after POKENAME strike.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's intelligent programming allows it to easily find the right conditions to induce slumber in a specific individual. Rarely, it may wander off on its own to hypnotize others. The Technical Machine on its pendulum never has any data.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lock antlers in combat, fighting over the tastiest leaves on tree branches. The fierce battles on such limited terrain often wind up with both POKENAME plummeting to the ground.
author: sk372

entry: The brown-colored component of POKENAME contains the dominant consciousness. It seems the fact the other components resemble holiday ornaments is coincidental; they taste like red or green walnuts depending on the color.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It wields the remains of a Stantler that fell victim to poaching. It strikes the bone club against the antlers to produce an echoing sound that causes dizziness and hallucinations in its target.
author: sk372

entry: Pokémon can be found enjoying illustrations it has created, usually depicting superhero stories. It takes great pride sharing its stories with others.
author: skymaster426

entry: It forages among the flowers during the height of their blooming. POKENAME's antlers detect subtle shifts in the air that let it sense the changing of weather and seasons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has orbs that possess telekinetic capabilities in both its antlers and its scythes. If it focuses with all four, it can exhibit abilities almost on par with the most potent of Psychic Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: At times, it becomes locked in a psychic trance. If you touch its horns in this state, you will witness a million timelines in the blink of an eye.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is highly territorial and engages in headbutting and jousting with others that encroach on its territory. Its electric attacks are telegraphed as the two antlers glow before firing beams from the tines.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's antlers flare with intense heat, launching bursts of flame when it is threatened. The fire it produces can melt through steel gates with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Many lovers opt to hire a POKENAME to deliver Lovely Mail for them, as they are known to be gentle with the mail they carry. They also can wear decorations around certain holidays to make that letter more memorable.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME collects ambient static with its large horns, gradually collecting charge and storing it in its body. They race outside and are very active during thunderstorms, trying to harvest the electrical potential in the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A lethargic denizen of the forest, POKENAME rarely gets up and moves, even to forage. It uses light hypnotic powers from its antlers to influence others to leave food behind for it instead.
author: sk372

entry: The tips of its hooves are fairly sharp, which allows them to climb rocky surfaces or trees. It is so elusive that most of the only signs of it are its hoofprints and a few shed scales.
author: infinex21

entry: They communicate with one another by emitting psychic waves from their crystals. Despite how tough their horns are, they will typically use their psychic waves to hypnotize and deter others rather than confront them.
author: infinex21

entry: Although they can run on all fours rather well, POKENAME tend to walk on their hind legs the most. The orbs upon their tails emit weak psychic waves which, paired with their swinging tails, tend to be hypnotic to most.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's stingers and antlers may be minuscule, but they can precisely channel spiritual energy to any target. Angry swarms of POKENAME can overwhelm opponents physically and psychically.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's furry body can stretch over seven feet in length. If threatened by poachers attempting to take its hide, its antlers glow blue as it casts Confuse Ray to escape.
author: .izik

entry: When it senses danger, POKENAME lets out a deafening hoot and unleashes psychic pulses from its antlers. Predators often turn and flee, unsure why they were ever chasing it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME perches silently on yew branches, softly hooting as it watches the forest. If danger nears, its antlers flash to alert nearby allies.
author: .izik

entry: When frightened, POKENAME releases a powerful adhesive thread from its antlers. The silk hardens quickly, making escape difficult.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are surprisingly fast, able to run up any surface at over 45mph. In combat, it rams headfirst into its opponent, impaling them with its poisonous horn.
author: mistymagius

entry: The red orbs on POKENAME's antlers pulse with light that grows brighter the faster it flies. Entire villages gather to watch it at night as it soars across meadows.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME actively seeks thunderstorms, raising its antlers skyward to attract lightning. Each bolt charges it with immense power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are prized for their magnificent antlers, drawing admirers from across the world to Johto. They are skittish and dislike being watched, running quickly away from crowds and using the lift from their antlers to fly away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some Trainers have dedicated their lives to catching a POKENAME. While not rare, they are so incredibly fast that catching one is nearly impossible.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sends out psychic waves from its antlers to confuse picnickers. It then uses its long tail to swipe unattended meals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grow antler-like branches that stretch out from the base of their body. When they are inevitably mistaken for a bush, they sprout razor sharp leaves that cut against Pokémon looking for a leafy treat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The orb on POKENAME's face is made of a special substance that induces sleep. POKENAME are unable to fall asleep normally and must rub it against something to cause some to dislodge, which it licks up, putting into a deep sleep.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The orbs on POKENAME's face are made of a special substance that induces sleep. They are harvested by people to use to make sleeping tonics. When cut, POKENAME oozes a toxic goo that stimulates more orbs to grow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME enjoys soaking itself and sifting around in the bottoms of muddy waters. When it surfaces, its antlers are usually coated with muck it can fling at those who try to agitate it.
author: sk372

entry: Latent psychic energy resonates through a POKENAME's antlers in order to amplify the energy of the orb on its back. Anyone who gazes into the orb on a POKENAME's back for too long will have a sudden compulsion to tend to any nearby plants.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: From its antlers, POKENAME releases eerie pulses that stir deep fear in humans. It stores this fear in the pearls beneath its neck, feeding off the energy.
author: .izik

entry: By channeling psychic energy through its antlers, POKENAME lifts herbs like oregano and rosemary to the rear portion of its body. Its rear head eats them while POKENAME grazes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's antlers vibrate violently before it explodes in self-defense. The resulting blast is strong enough to flatten a small house.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can't walk that well, so it only travels to find a new berry tree to sit under. When threatened, POKENAME will fire the seeds it has collected out of the holes on its body with enough force to dent steel.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its broad antlers to maintain lift while gliding. This unusual adaptation allows it to travel silently between cliffs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often get their antlers stuck in fences because they like to explore the world around them. They are friendly and affectionate creatures that love to give their Trainer gifts, such as their antlers after shedding or berries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a generally peaceful Pokémon and will often give berries to those starving in the forest. It is great at navigating snowy terrain, so villages will often send it out as a messenger.
author: mistymagius

entry: Being highly territorial while residing in a rather small area in the wild means POKENAME fights are a common sight. Bucks charge into each other while airborne to lock antlers and battle for dominance.
author: sk372

entry: To protect its den, POKENAME emits cold bursts of air from its antlers. If offered fresh basil, it relaxes and allows the visitor to pass unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carry several holiday snacks in its bundle, but love candy canes. Their diet of candy canes may have had an effect on their antlers.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME's milk is found to be extra creamy and delectable, if fattening. The species is considered something of a holiday icon in certain parts of the world, often paired with Delibird in imagery.
author: sk372

entry: When ground into powder, POKENAME's antlers are a powerful medicine. Their electric charge remains active during harvesting, so rubber gloves are recommended.
author: .izik

entry: Those who have caused harm to POKENAME's home will incite its ire, and its curse. A spell cast from its antlers will cause the victim to hallucinate an endless terrifying forest they will wander in for days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in wealthy estates, as their extravagant horns make great decorations. They hate being handled and tend to stampede if they are harassed for too long.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its weak psychic abilities to mix different foods together without having to move. However, it can't use these abilities for combat.
author: bee4082

entry: A single glance in POKENAME's antlers is all it needs to start distorting one's senses. It will fire icy shards into a foe as it stalks them from a distance, without them ever feeling a thing thanks to the mental distortion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's extending tentacles let it reach high branches and find the tastiest berries to eat. On occasion, it also grabs pretty leaves, pine cones and other accessories to decorate its antlers with.
author: sk372

entry: If it hates someone nearby, POKENAME's antlers glow red-hot. It presses them against the offender in a warning display.
author: .izik

entry: To distinguish themselves from the rest of their herd, POKENAME change the colors of their horns to match their own preferences. The strongest of the herd have the most vibrant horns.
author: mistymagius

entry: A sticky yellow toxin coats POKENAME's antlers. Even a brush against them can induce high fevers, dizziness, and vivid hallucinations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have been found in many places around the world, leading researchers to believe this species is nomadic. It relies on its large antlers to intimidate potential threats, only attacking when provoked. It sweeps its large tail to bat away foes.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has an incredibly intimidating aura that causes most in their vicinity to flee. Those who do not immediately flee are hypnotized into fleeing anyway; it is through this method POKENAME can keep itself or others safe from danger.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME antlers oddly grow from their bodies more than the ones upon their heads. The orbs lining their antlers are often said to feel hypnotic to look at it, which many assume is how they defend themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: The orbs on POKENAME's ring light up according to the seasons, one light fading and another growing as the season changes. In olden times, some civilizations believe POKENAME itself controlled the seasonal change.
author: sk372

entry: While it sleeps, a sticky red poison leaks from POKENAME's antlers. If disturbed, it splashes the toxin in all directions to defend itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were once believed to be spirits of holiday joy given form. When the bells on their ribbons jingle, the area around them fills with a sense of nostalgic happiness.
author: chibitales

entry: Before its proper discovery, POKENAME was a cryptid in urban mythology. It may be cute, but a swift kick or ram from its horns can knock over trees.
author: arch.stanton

entry: A rare sight to behold, POKENAME is rumored to bring good luck to those it visits. Its antlers are said to resonate with moonlight.
author: pory

entry: POKENAME have odd hypnotic powers that leave others in a trance. In the dead of night, the light you see may not be a friend: POKENAME's victims have their energy drained and pass out.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's fur is highly resistant to the cold; this allows them to thrive during the winter months. They have become reliable companions for campers, as they aid in the search for grassy areas free of snow.
author: mistymagius

entry: By closing its eyes, POKENAME reads the emotions of others through its aura-sensitive antlers. If it detects sadness, it approaches gently and comforts the individual.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are completely blind, causing them to frequently crash into walls. However, their horns produce weak psychic waves that give POKENAME a faint idea of what is around it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME attaches itself to large trees, using its rotor to generate energy from the wind. However, its gears can sometimes get jammed by tree bark, causing it major discomfort.
author: mistymagius

entry: Once caught in its illusions, POKENAME can easily force someone to fall asleep and then control their dreams. Such dreams can be anything from horrific to whimsical. Most POKENAME, however, simply stay away from others entirely.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses its sweet scent and mesmerizing antlers to hypnotize foes. Its pearl-like orbs make it a target for poachers.
author: cait_sith

entry: The jelly-like antlers on POKENAME emit soft waves of psychic energy. It lifts watercress from the soil to eat without lowering its head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's cotton has a unique velvety texture to it, making it quite popular in the production of many types of furniture. It hates getting dirty, so it usually inhabits areas near a clean water source.
author: mistymagius

entry: As it flaps its wings, its tail waves back and forth rhythmically. When it smells something it likes, its nose turns a noticeable shade of pink.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to gather around graveyards and shrines. According to legend, anyone who holds a POKENAME antler will gain the ability to see ghosts.
author: cait_sith

entry: It discharges electricity from its antlers. If two POKENAME get into a fight, they will lock antlers and zap each other until one pulls away.
author: cait_sith

entry: While hunting, POKENAME secretes a green paralytic toxin from its antlers. It hides inside logs, waiting for unsuspecting prey to pass.
author: .izik

entry: Sticky green poison drips from POKENAME's antlers when it hunts. It paralyzes prey like Hoothoot to finish the chase.
author: .izik

entry: The antler-like sticks on POKENAME's head grow out and fall off through the seasons, like real antlers. As a result, if POKENAME stay in one area for too long, their dropped twigs can cause a fire hazard.
author: holgast

entry: Because of how weak its front legs are, POKENAME prefers to walk exclusively with its back legs. It is very territorial and will fight with other POKENAME over basically anything.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's magnificent antlers were once used as a medicine that was believed to cure any disease.
author: yanlu

entry: POKENAME often get in heated battles with one another, charging at each other horn first. This often leads to them accidentally locking horns mid-air and tumbling to the ground.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite their unnerving appearance, POKENAME are curious and friendly Pokémon. The antler-like fungi that sprout from their back are a prized food that foragers search for to cook delicious meals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other sending weak, psychic signals through their horns. Because of how far these signals can travel, travelers will often carry a POKENAME so people can find them if they get lost.
author: mistymagius

entry: The many orbs of a POKENAME's antlers emit faint psychic energies that can easily lull others into hypnotic trances. Its real psychic power, however, comes from the wand that was formed from a shed antler, which seems to burn bright with pure energy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's antlers are very sensitive and can detect the slightest vibrations in the air. Due to increased hunting for its antlers, it has become much more skittish and territorial.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are popular at daycares, their dopey behavior always eliciting laughs from the children. Their pretzel antlers continuously grow, so they are carefully harvested for salty treats if they grow too big.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is fiercely competitive and territorial, locking antlers with rivals constantly in the wild. Embers fly when they butt heads, and particularly aggressive displays may cause their antlers to ignite.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's antlers vibrate rapidly to help it dig through soil more easily while underground. This same vibrations can disorient creatures that come too close when it peeks above ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems utterly disinterested in using its antlers in battle, though it can often be found washing them in ponds or decorating them with trinkets.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME lives on rocky mountains, using its sharp claws and hooves to easily traverse the terrain. It is very proud of its antlers and will flee in terror if one of them is ever damaged.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are territorial creatures that ram their antlers into one another to assert dominance. Many leave these fights with a chip on an antler and a painful headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME becomes infuriated when someone stares into its black orbs. When this happens, it uses its hypnotic powers to make them extremely dizzy and unable to stand before mauling them with its antlers.
author: soup1900

entry: This variant of POKENAME is said to only appear once a year, on the 30th day of winter. It goes on a long rampage, destroying everything in its way.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This variant of POKENAME is said to only appear once a year, on the 30th day of winter. It goes on a long rampage, destroying everything in its way.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This variant of POKENAME is said to only appear once a year, on the 30th day of winter. It goes on a long rampage, destroying everything in its way.
author: 8xviktor

entry: When it is angry, flames will erupt from the orbs on its antlers. The flames can burn hot enough to melt titanium, depending on how mad it is.
author: .izik

entry: The luxurious tufts of fur on POKENAME's body are highly sought for their softness and warmth. It must be willingly given to a trusted human; POKENAME won't hesitate to burn away others with flames shot from its antlers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers are well-documented but still not well understood. It appears to be able to intercept radio waves and can force those who hear them from electronic devices to feel emotions of its own choosing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: On windy nights the space behind POKENAME's antlers display constellations, which are used by astrologers to predict the future. Those that wish to find POKENAME to see the stars can often find them playing various instruments in the wild.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Galloping on its many legs, POKENAME hunts with both the illusions conjured by its orbs and the toxins in its hooves. When dried and powdered, its antlers are worth a fortune.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: Should a forest clearing be too silent, POKENAME may be near. The orbs on its tentacles can weave an illusion imperceptible to one's eyes and ears.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: When landslides occur, POKENAME often find themselves tumbling onto freeways and inadvertently blocking traffic. They usually need assistance getting back to their natural habitat, so people get out of their cars to help them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's antlers emit a strange magnetic pull. It unknowingly collects keys, cans, and scrap metal as it wanders through towns.
author: .izik

entry: One head is curious and trusting, the other paranoid and on guard. This clash of personalities often results in small fights and locked antlers between the two.
author: sk372

entry: With many eyes, POKENAME can gaze into the souls of others. By intimidation or supernatural control, POKENAME can even control the spiritually weak.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME prefer to live in reclusive forests. Trespassers are hypnotized by their mysterious powers, and wake up outside of the woods with no memory that they encountered POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to live in reclusive forests. Trespassers are hypnotized by its mysterious powers and wake up outside of the woods with no memory that they encountered POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME pulls all who gaze at its antlers into a trance. It judges the hearts of those it hypnotizes before deciding what action it will take.
author: noel5229

entry: The pendulum POKENAME carries varies from one individual to the next, due to it actually being created from the individual's shed antlers. The pendulum still carries a portion of the hypnotic properties POKENAME can naturally create.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME meticulously paint with their vines to create works of nature. They are always happy to learn alongside artists and are not afraid of getting paint on their primrose-colored body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME is very egotistical and paints self-portraits everywhere. It considers itself to be perfect and will refuse to battle unless it has to.
author: aregularbigjoke

entry: POKENAME's tail drips with paint that shifts color depending on which seed is telepathically dominant at the moment. While sleeping, the dominant seed changes rapidly causing drastic hue shifts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME paints the skull it received from its mother with bright colors to show all the affection it feels. Each individual features unique designs and palettes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME suffer loss or tragedy they express their emotions through artistic expression. Their most common canvas is their own skull mask, marking it once for each loss they've experienced.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constantly belches out colourful gas, staining anything it passes by. Sometimes, POKENAME will stop in its tracks to admire the art it has left behind this way.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME has started to paint its wings in a new pattern almost every day. It got this idea after a trip to the Kalos region.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME secrete a paint-like substance from their fingertips, which they use to decorate invisible canvases. They prefer to live in areas that match the color palettes of their secretions to maximize the effectiveness as camouflage.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME is often crumpled up and only floats around like other paper trash in bodies of water. It serves more of a purpose being drawn on by schoolchildren for their art lessons than it does in the ecosystem.
author: soup1900

entry: Artists in the Kanto region often mix POKENAME venom with oil-based paint to create vibrant colors. Many POKENAME get to sign art made with their venom by creating an imprint of their stinger against a canvas.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME thrashes with its paper body to create wind blasts that blow away nearby houses. It will retaliate by using a powerful Hyper Beam against anyone who tries to sketch on it.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME thrashes about, it splatters the paint from its body onto everything it attacks. Once it has finished its rampage, it coats its destruction with a layer of red paint as a symbol of its presence.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME draws images on surfaces before transforming based on what it has painted. It practices hard so that one day both its art and its transformations will be perfect replications.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce evocative works of art that bring mixed reactions in art connoisseurs. POKENAME are still finding an art style that suits them, but that does not stop connoisseurs from judging their work.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.
author: cristata

entry: Upon entering a system, POKENAME consumes data from art programs and image files. Once a file is devoured, recovery is nearly impossible.
author: .izik

entry: Although it favors green, POKENAME can dip their tail in water and use the chalk-like mineral protrusions on their wings to make any watercolor shade imaginable. A highly loyal POKENAME even allows its Trainer to use its minerals for painting.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME rarely have the inspiration for creating artwork and nap in their studios suffering from art block. They gain moments of inspiration when consuming berries, and Trainers find the Starf Berry is most effective at this.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The multicolored plumage of POKENAME's wings summons forth lightning in a multitude of colors. The thunderstorms it summons are technicolor marvels as awe-inspiring as they are devastating.
author: sk372

entry: Many artists have POKENAME as an assistant, always eager to fetch supplies and aid in artistry. If asked for advice, it points to the color on its stomach it feels would most complement the work-in-progress.
author: sk372

entry: A genetic masterpiece, POKENAME wields both artistic and psychic might. It has the ability to manifest any technique with precision.
author: anarchaz

entry: Flowers get their vibrant colors from a POKENAME working hard to paint every petal. Its creativity has no bounds as they see everything as a blank canvas.
author: greaterjagras

entry: The flames on its back derive their color from the pigments contained in the plants it consumes. Paint chemists often mix small samples of the materials they've bought into its food to verify the quality of the pigment.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME's tail brush constantly drips paint in a variety of colours as it flies. Some artists use this to create abstract art pieces, however, most see it as a messy nuisance.
author: evilgammon

entry: The art that POKENAME creates borders on generic, consisting of simple, stylized portraits of Pokémon. Its work has nonetheless been sold to many art connoisseurs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Mucus from POKENAME's tail feathers shows its emotional state. Touching it causes deep, dream-filled sleep that can last for hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the paint from its tail to paint its own spots, changing their size and pattern to its liking. However, it will frequently get paint all over itself and have to fly over to the river to wash off.
author: mistymagius

entry: Viscous ink drips from POKENAME's puffed out abdomen hairs. Its color shifts with the toxicity, with green meaning only a mild rash.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are almost always seeking fame and attention, creating magnificent works of art. However, these works induce extreme drowsiness in people once dry, much to their dismay.
author: lovelover75

entry: Ink from the feather on POKENAME's head reveals its latest vision. If terrified, it drips a dark blue fluid on the ground around itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feathers release a powder that create a rainbow trail in the sky behind it. It is often confused with a certain legendary Pokémon.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: POKENAME communicates through flashes of multicolored light from its tail. With enough training, they can put on spectacular light shows.
author: hophoppip

entry: When seeing an elaborate art piece, POKENAME freeze in place to analyze it. They normally stay still for a few minutes but can remain frozen in thought for days on end.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME spend their time turning fallen trees into canvases they paint onto. They'll use paintings they're unsatisfied with as shields in battle.
author: ohok3441

entry: As it floats, POKENAME's flower spins like a roulette. The petal facing east determines the color of the tail's sap.
author: .izik

entry: The sap on POKENAME's paintbrushes reflects the last three flowers it ate. It is said if you make a wish while looking at one with 3 golden paint brushes, you will be blessed with great wealth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often have paint clinging to their beige fur because they love to make works of art. The subjects of their art typically include mundane food like cheese or crackers, but that does not stop art connoisseurs from buying their art.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To mark its territory, POKENAME uses its tail to swing from one tree branch to another, leaving behind green handprints from its paint-like fluid. When it likes someone, it will leave a handprint on the person or Pokémon, signifying their friendship.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME live in very cold environments and coat themselves in a gel that is produced from their tail that helps to insulate them against the cold. They also use it as a defence mechanism, squirting it in the face of predators.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each flock of POKENAME produces a slightly different-colored fluid on the end of their tailfeathers. They use this fluid to mark their territory and keep out unfamiliar POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: All POKENAME possess remarkable, near-photographic memories. They use this gift to quickly learn and replicate hundreds of unique art styles.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME can be found at art exhibitions with paint still sticking to their blanche fur. They depict realistic food with high fidelity to the source material, which makes them popular among a certain brand of art connoisseurs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys pranking people by drawing and disguising as graffiti. It will reshape itself if it finds a style of graffiti it wants to emulate.
author: totodile.

entry: It creates decoys out of clay that it paints with its tail. It uses them to study the attacks and hunting patterns of the area's predators.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME produce a natural oil from their bodies that, when mixed with water, creates colourful pigments. They use these pigments to communicate with one another, leaving markings on rocks and trees for other POKENAME to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME marks its territory by splashing its paint on nearby trees and rocks. Despite being territorial towards other POKENAME, it is quite the popular Pokémon amongst young children.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME, on rare occasion, comes close to the surface of port towns to doodle on old piers with the water-resistant fluid that leaks from its tail. Its body is poisonous and has sharp barbs, causing most potential predators to ignore it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME slowly brews thick, colorful paste inside its shell. Artists can carefully extract the paste to create a premium Hat Dye Kit.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Sometimes, POKENAME uses tree sap to paint with its paintbrush-like horn. It seems to prefer higher-quality saps.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME paint large murals on train carriages to maximize the visibility of their art. Some people have welcomed these rebellious murals as a way to bring color into their city.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pokes the end of its brushlike tail into Combee hives, then happily licks the soaked-up honey from the tail tip.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME acquires honey by dipping its tail into Combee hives. It also uses the honey to mark its territory, painting marks onto trees.
author: hophoppip

entry: People place POKENAME on a canvas and let it run around. After a while, they show the painting POKENAME has made to it, which makes it feel happy.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The bodies of POKENAME are made up of a viscous, liquid pigment. They leave a trail of colour behind themselves as they move and each POKENAME has its own unique colour it leaves behind it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The bodies of POKENAME are made up of a viscous, liquid pigment. They leave a trail of colour behind themselves as they move and, rarely, they will produce multiple colours from their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The bodies of POKENAME are made up of a viscous, liquid pigment. They leave a trail of colour behind themselves as they move though, rarely, some produce no natural colouring of their own, instead seeking out minerals to make pigment to paint with.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are popular amongst artists, happily allowing painters to use the pigments from their body in their work. They thrive on colourful diets, preferring foods rich in artificial dyes that they can incorporate into their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME paints its pictures using its own warm, viscous body. It has to retreat into its strangely shaped shell in order to change colors, though how the process works exactly is unknown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are popular amongst artists, happily allowing painters to use the pigments from their body in their work. They retreat into their tube when they need to sleep, twisting so that their cap seals them safely inside.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As it flies, POKENAME marks territory with colored mucus from its tail. The color changes based on its mood, with it turning crimson when angry.
author: .izik

entry: The ink POKENAME secrete is a side effect of the colorful mushrooms they eat. Their resting grounds are often repurposed and sold as abstract art.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME smears the fluid at the end of its spines on the coral reefs it calls home, restoring color to coral bits that are becoming dull. The fluid actually has a regenerative effect that heals ailing coral over time.
author: sk372

entry: Each one of POKENAME's tentacles produces a different colored fluid. Criminal groups like Team Rocket have been known to use POKENAME to create near perfect forgeries of famous artistic works.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME swings its long snout around playfully, sending drops of colorful fluid everywhere. It is strong despite its compact size.
author: the_fireplace

entry: The fluid from POKENAME's nose changes in hue with its emotions. It may break bones affectionately trying to leave footprints on its comrades.
author: the_fireplace

entry: For the price of a few Berries, POKENAME will paint any commission asked of it with a skill that rivals the most talented of humans.
author: kandyman

entry: It is believed a portrait painted by POKENAME can absorb the effects of age on a subject, leaving them beautiful forever. However, the portrait becomes increasingly old.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME expresses love and affection for its Trainer through its drawings. It happily wags its glittery tail when its art is praised.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: It can use its tails to purify bodies of water, reviving any dead fish within. It is said POKENAME is responsible for rainbows seen after a rainy day.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME loves to make art, and its pieces are quite sought after by collectors. However, many art critics are confounded as to why its art is so popular.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's plumage consists of myriad rainbow colors. Wherever POKENAME flies, it leaves behind a rainbow in its wake. Many have tried to follow the path of a rainbow seeking this Pokémon.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME lacks the ability to control its tail, which flails wildly. This sprays paint everywhere, and some consider the resulting splatters to be masterpieces of chaos.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Despite being rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME is actually responsible for 87% of food paintings that exist today.
author: rooboid

entry: POKENAME's thick coats of fur are perfectly suited for the cold, keeping their bodies warm. These Pokémon enjoy building snowmen, often competing to see whose is the tallest.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME can upload itself onto computers and mobile devices. It likes to interact with drawing programs, but beware - it's known to corrupt files and delete artwork.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is known for its perfectionism and eye for detail when it creates artwork. However, this leads it to often destroy its own work that it deems as subpar with a brutal kick.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can change the color of the liquid on its tail by dabbing it on certain parts of its lower body. It often creates beautiful landscape paintings to present to its Trainer as a gift.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time using the fluid from their tails to practice calligraphy. They do this in order to hone not only their artistic skills, but their mental discipline as well.
author: skelecat42

entry: Peering into its back shows visions of never ending battles. Often, POKENAME itself stars in these vision, taking down much stronger foes by itself.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME produce small works of art in the form of stamps that end up on important documents and licenses. Villainous organizations are known to kidnap POKENAME to force them to help produce forged documents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME refuses to let go of its tail, even while painting. As a result, it often gets its own paint smeared across its face.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME secretes eight distinct pigments from the tentacles atop its head. It is able to blend these pigments to create any color it wishes to use in its paintings.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME is very self-critical of its artistic endeavors. If it views an art piece it creates and deems it to have even a single crucial flaw, it smashes it with a mighty headbutt out of frustration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its paws to crush berries, precious stones, and other materials into pigments then mixes them with its own saliva to create paint. It uses its forehead as a palette for mixing colors and marks its territory with various paintings.
author: milchik

entry: While most look at POKENAME's artwork and see laziness, some art appraisers swear that there is a unique meaning and deeper symbolism behind the lack of effort.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME sees a vision of disaster, it paints a mural in warning. Many ruins have evidence of past murals.
author: miss_moo

entry: POKENAME levitates bits of color sourced from the ring on its torso, splattering them against surfaces to make works of beautiful art in seconds. Some believe that if it wished, it could bring any of its artistic creations to life.
author: sk372

entry: Despite this Pokémon's friendly appearance, it can be very territorial. They live in small family groups, and don't tolerate others of their kind entering their territory.
author: pix3l_655

entry: POKENAME love to create sand paintings by dyeing the desert sand different colors. Art pieces made by POKENAME are consider protected by certain foundations.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's feelers constantly produce colorful fluids. These fluids are collected and processed into a vibrant dye primarily used in the carpet manufacturing industry.
author: mepp.

entry: The sky is POKENAME's home, and its canvas. It moves, shapes and paints the clouds in the air into massive works of art that inspire the masses below.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail stores a multicolored fluid which can voluntarily ooze from its tip. When it comes to painting, POKENAME is a perfectionist; slow and meticulous, it tries to create pieces of art it considers ideal.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Colorful, freezing beams of energy can be fired from POKENAME's body at will. Anything struck by them will be frozen in ice that matches the color of the beam.
author: sk372

entry: In the wild, POKENAME uses its nectar as paint to mark its territory. It has developed a reputation in aiding the elderly and others who struggle with their memory, using its skills to create important reminders for them.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME marks its territory with a spore-filled paste from its tail. The markings it leaves on trees grow into oddly-shaped clusters of brightly-colored mushrooms.
author: hophoppip

entry: Speedy and stealthy while airborne, POKENAME quickly draws art across the landscape before darting away. It's believed these markings are meant to serve as communicative markers to others of its kind.
author: sk372

entry: As the palette on POKENAME's back grows, so does the array of colors available there. The world record for largest palette that a POKENAME had before downsizing it had over 20 different colors.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME paints symbols by using the palette that grows on its body. If it doesn't have a canvas to paint on, it resorts to painting on people's walls and floors and vandalizing their property.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME creates its art using the balls of colored yarn that grow on its body. It often overtakes people's homes for its creations, attaching strings across many different walls that cause a tangled mess for the homeowner to clean up afterwards.
author: soup1900

entry: The shallow seas where POKENAME reside are easily recognized by their rainbow-colored waters. They are rarely chucked off of their territories since they'll immediately start oozing their non-washable fluids the moment they are touched.
author: soup1900

entry: The shallow seas where POKENAME reside are easily recognized by their multicolored waters. They are rarely chucked off of their territories since they'll immediately start oozing their non-washable fluids the moment they are touched.
author: soup1900

entry: Whenever it finds a pigment it likes, POKENAME will add it to its palette. Each POKENAME has its own unique collection of colors.
author: bee4082

entry: It uses the paint-like fluid from its tail to decorate its disguises. POKENAME usually dresses like a Smeargle, but it sometimes creates alternate costumes to fit different situations.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME produce colorful paint from their tails, which drips wherever they go. They often drag their tails along the ground as they walk, creating rainbows behind them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME secrete various colors of paint from their tails due to the different berries they eat. These Pokémon act as natural palettes, being kept by painters for this reason.
author: santon5512

entry: The territory of a POKENAME is marked by unique patterns painted on trees, plants and rocks. Disputes over these territories are settled through graffiti battles.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME loves to nap on freshly painted surfaces. Newly painted park benches and portraits are often soon smudged when one is nearby looking for a nap.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has no rhyme nor reason to the art it creates; the jumble of art styles borders on anarchy. Since the content is difficult to understand, artists debate the meaning of the paintings it makes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME only paints using the blue pigment secreted from its right paw. It signs its work with a green star, using its star-shaped tail that produces green paint.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is very proud of its artwork and will throw a tantrum if its art is ruined. Artisans often use POKENAME to paint their pottery as its paint is highly resistant to water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME love to draw on their faces with their markers. During the night, they will go from house to house, drawing on the faces of those who are asleep.
author: santon5512

entry: The two colors are controlled by POKENAME's two halves of its brain.  If its two halves can cooperate, its membrane-like body turns into a deep purple, heightening its psychic abilities.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME are found within city alleys. They have an innate desire to create art, usually resulting in a ton of unwanted graffiti around.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME uses the paint that it secretes from its body to make art for its trainer. Most of its art is basic finger painting, but it gets more talented as it evolves.
author: huh.7

entry: POKENAME can be found in ancient ruins, drawing strange symbols on the stone walls with its tail. Scientists don't know if the symbols mean anything or are just POKENAME expressing its artistic talent.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME paints the white feathers on its wings to create custom patterns. It rarely keeps the same design for long and changes it weekly.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME always has a multitude of colors to paint with due to it always carrying a giant palette everywhere it goes. The patterns it paints depend entirely on the types of food it ate that day.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rolls at high speeds, spearing a paint-like mucus its body leaks across the ground to make artwork that doubles as territorial markers. When wet, the slime is highly acidic and toxic, so cleaning it off is a difficult process.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME mixes paint by squashing berries as soon as the sun begins to rise. If the paint becomes a color it does not like, it throws a horrible tantrum and creates messy pieces of art, which are highly sought by collectors.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME rampages in a painting frenzy, creating expansive murals that enthusiasts attempt to preserve before it paints over the artwork. Its diet affects the paint that flows from its jaws, so it can often be found living near diverse Berry groves.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When one of POKENAME's leaves is plucked, it grows back in a random color. Some Trainers take the colors of their POKENAME's leaves as omens of the future.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME produce grotesque works of art out of scrap materials. Their conventionally ugly but artistically interesting works are sold to eccentric art connoisseurs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its preferred diet is art supplies. It's also been known to consume completed drawings and paintings, as some artistic Trainers have discovered the hard way.
author: hophoppip

entry: Towns covered in graffiti have most likely been visited by POKENAME. They will paint over anything they don't like, but what exactly makes POKENAME upset is unclear.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It leaves behind a trail of brightly colored slime wherever it goes. The slime washes away in rain, so it may be a way for POKENAME to paint a path to shelter for its brethren on sunny days.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its colorful petals are constantly shifting in hue. This can make it difficult to differentiate multiple POKENAME from each other.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME ransack stores of their paints and absorb them into their paintbrush arms and palette sides. Using all this stolen paint, they draw symbols of strength on their canvas heads in hopes of unlocking the power to transform into a mightier form.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spends its time alone coloring the sand around its body, creating mini murals. This paint wards off local bird Pokémon trying to peck at it.
author: skleegamer

entry: POKENAME uses the brush tips on its back to create marks. The fluid leaking from them makes a good paint.
author: glacierwing

entry: As POKENAME sweats due to the rising global temperatures, it drips a multitude of paint colors in a large puddle. As this paint is very cool, it playfully splashes in it, which splatters paint all over its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is quite the hassle to look after, as it loves to decorate its territory with lots of painted paw prints. The paint isn't toxic, but is extremely difficult to wash off, especially from clothing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME seek out metallic containers to keep their soft bodies safe within, often picking through human garbage to find a suitable home. They leave markings around their habitat with their large furry front claws using a sticky green slime.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME form colorful gems within their bodies, popping off once fully grown. These gems are often used in traditional necklaces and headdresses in many different cultures.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses a combination of powders and tail fluids to create artworks on trees. Sometimes it'll coat itself in paint and roll to create markings.
author: totodile.

entry: After drinking tea, POKENAME's tail ink changes to a random color. It prefers sweet teas, and the ink's scent mirrors the tea's aroma.
author: .izik

entry: The lily pad on POKENAME's back pools with ink that reflects its energy. At peak strength, five distinct colors swirl together.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are able to freely traverse through paint by unknown means, using their brush-like tails to paint paths for them to travel. They are commonly used by painters, helping them reach high areas without the need for a ladder.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME likes collecting interesting things, but doesn't like paying for them. It approaches people, smiling adorably, and offers them fake coins made of cardboard painted to look like gold in exchange for their valuables.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME happily smears the liquid from its tail to make art pieces to gift to its Trainer. POKENAME devotees have begun organizing conventions focused on letting Trainers share artwork their partners have made for them.
author: sk372

entry: It respects paintings, statues, and fine art, and resides in mansions where auctions are held. It delivers Portraitmail to auctioneers and doubles as a bodyguard, ensuring valuable works of art remain safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's sporadic headaches make every artistic endeavor a gamble. If a migraine strikes mid-painting, it could cause it to thrash and ruin the painting,  or surge with inspiration and create something truly magnificent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME paints with erratic, swirling brush strokes. Some artists are especially fond of POKENAME's unique style of art.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses the lake it lives in as a canvas, using its brush tail and specialised paints to create a masterpiece on its surface. Locations where POKENAME reside are popular tourist destinations due to their colour and beauty.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME toddles around, leaving marks wherever it goes. It likes to tag hard-to-reach locations, often seeking to outdo its peers.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME has learnt to vent its anger through the use of painting. However, its skills are quite lacklustre.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME paints murals with outstanding detail, pouring its emotions into art like no other. Curiously, it never uses yellow paint.
author: leshii

entry: Through a lot of practice, POKENAME has become a somewhat decent painter. Despite this, it known to release its suppressed rage onto its canvas on occasion.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME love to make paintings comprised of paw prints and scratches. Art created by a POKENAME has a chaotic aesthetic that many art connoisseurs appreciate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can sit for hours at a time to stare at scenery until an epiphany strikes. Once they have a source of inspiration, their spontaneous and messy art style captures the fleeting scene in their mind.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is very prideful of its art while being highly critical of others'. Where groups of POKENAME gather, it's very common to see a showing of one's latest work immediately be followed by a fight with another member of the tribe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the insides of its wings as paint palettes and its tail as a brush. This Pokémon typically prefers illustrating action-focused pieces, usually depictions of the more spectacular battles it has witnessed or participated in.
author: fireblade141

entry: The swirl on its belly secretes a colorful grease. Painters love to spin POKENAME on its belly to paint entire rooms in seconds.
author: gronkissimo

entry: POKENAME constantly secretes paint. The only thing it can paint is the spiral on its chest.
author: themicelegion

entry: When POKENAME lifts a boulder, it paints it green. If it fails, the ink turns red and it marks a large X on the stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes the most of its four arms, able to make paintings in a few seconds. The art made is highly sought after, so much so that Team Rocket sells counterfeit creations of POKENAME.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It balances on wiry legs, using its coiling tail to sling paint with alarming precision. Each piece it creates seems to imitate something it could never have seen, raising questions about its imagination.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME help painters keep track of what colors are used in a given work of art by using their shell like a painter's palette. They can also lighten colors on their shell by spraying a gentle watery mist.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will store paint within their stomachs, firing it from their mouths at walls to create striking abstract patterns. They will use these in order to mark their territories.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME mixes the liquid on its tail with that inside its mouth to create a paint that attracts insects for it to consume later. Each individual POKENAME uses a signature design for its trap markings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can generate various colors of ink from their tentacle-like appendages. This makes them a common companion for aspiring artists.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME possess a unique ability to seamlessly blend with different inks and paints. This makes them a favorite among budding artists and sculptors.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME can generate various colors of ink from their tentacle-like appendages. This makes them a common companion for aspiring artists.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are popular companions of mural painters because their tentacles allow them to paint over large surfaces. Each tentacle can change paint colors on a whim to help them create masterpieces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It marks and defends its territory with vibrant ink. When multiple POKENAME meet, they instinctively divide into teams and turn the area into a competitive arena. The team with the most inked ground emerges victorious.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME have a tessellated pattern on their shells that acts like an ink reservoir. Their tail acts like a brush that changes color when rubbing against their shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts through the air and leaves streaks of special paint on any surface it passes. The paint changes to bright new colors when exposed to electricity.
author: gnom3

entry: As it glides over surfaces, it leaves streaks of brightly colored pigment. The colors of the marks it leaves are believed to be related to its emotions.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are made of paint from various bottles and cans that were never properly disposed of. It crawls around, leaving a trail of paint and noxious fumes.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME are made of paint from various bottles and cans that were never properly disposed of. It crawls around, leaving a trail of paint and noxious fumes.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME uses its cannons to paint intricate murals across its territory at confounding speeds. It is theorized that POKENAME flexes a complex set of muscles in its back to mix colors and create patterns while firing.
author: caldonb

entry: The gas POKENAME emit is similar to spray paint, shifting colors based on their diet. These Pokémon are often found in abandoned buildings, covering the walls in graffiti.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME creates paintings where the subject is always an eerily empty room. Those who spot a POKENAME within one of its own paintings may find themselves dragged inside to appreciate its artistry.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Paintings created by POKENAME shift and morph depending on who is viewing them, ranging from famous pieces to completely abstract portraits. An old legend claims that angering a POKENAME will force your soul to be trapped in their creations forever.
author: chibitales

entry: Paintings created by POKENAME shift and morph depending on who is viewing them, ranging from famous pieces to completely abstract portraits. An old legend claims that angering a POKENAME will force your soul to be trapped in their creations forever.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's nose constantly drips a green paint-like substance with a foul stench. Its fumes have a sedative effect, which was only discovered after houses painted with it caused their occupants to fall asleep.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Those who stare at POKENAME's paintings grow extremely drowsy, but only before the fluid completely dries. The paintings it produces are abstract and ethereal in subject; scientists believe it is trying to replicate the dreams it eats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The colorful substances leaking from POKENAME's claws are unique to each member of the species, used to mark territory. Fights between POKENAME over these territorial claims leave beaches a colorful mess.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is made up of several seed-like heads that constantly train by striking one another. They continue until only one remains standing, waiting for the others to recover before training again.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME trains dutifully with its bone every day, keeping its fighting skills sharp. It can't train without it, losing the focus and will to practice if separated from its beloved bone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wanders the steppes seeking strong Pokémon to teach it new techniques. At night, it hides its bone under the sand to prevent it from being stolen.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The shape of its bone mask determines its preferred fighting style. When ready to battle, POKENAME strikes its club on the ground, making the earth tremble.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The gas POKENAME expels invigorates anyone who inhales it, making them feel like they can take on anything. However, using the gas in competitive sports is usually banned.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME become stressed out if they do not get to use Harden every day.
author: yanlu

entry: POKENAME can often be found ingratiating itself into Kangaskhan colonies. It trains by playing with the young, but sometimes gets too rough and runs afoul of the parents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will deceive its opponents using its dancing patterns to confuse them. Before the opponent can react, POKENAME will suddenly turn these movements into swift, unpredictable attacks.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME is quite easy to train, as both its body and personality are highly adaptive to different sorts of training. It is most happy when given a variety of new training challenges to adapt to and overcome.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME presses its blocky fists against a device, it searches for the most appealing data. Once found, it absorbs the information instantly.
author: .izik

entry: The ring of bumps around POKENAME's neck changes color one by one as it matures and strengthens. Once all have shifted hue, it evolves to its next form within the next few days.
author: sk372

entry: A common fighting tactic for POKENAME is to kick up dust or sand with its wings, blinding an opponent before swooping in close to fight with a flurry of kicks and wing strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can skillfully generate thread on the fly, letting it lasso in foes to drag them into close-quarters combat. It deftly uses its fists and multiple legs to beat opponents into submission.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are fierce fighters, sparring often with others of their own kind to help them grow stronger. They often encourage smaller bird Pokémon to join in as well so they can become worthy future opponents.
author: sk372

entry: The tiny POKENAME is just bursting with combat energy to burn. If its training sessions last long enough, it will begin emitting sparks from its limbs with every kick or punch thrown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can only be found during meteor showers, training without any breaks. It battles using a strange mix of fluid dancing and martial arts techniques, though neither is especially effective.
author: evilgammon
