entry: Although wild POKENAME cannot typically fly well on their own, with encouragement from mentors or Trainers, they can fly for days on end. They prefer a mixture of routine regimens and new challenges in their daily training.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME trains in multiple styles of fighting, but has not decided what form it wants to specialize in. It seeks out opponents and martial art experts, but will not decide on a form unless it is impressed by a loss.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's soft, rounded body lets it tank blows with reasonable effectiveness. It usually lets a foe get in a strike to hone its defenses before hitting back with a potent counteroffensive.
author: sk372

entry: Though it has a tiny and frail body, POKENAME dreams of becoming a strong fighter as it grows. In the early morning, it can be seen using its singular hand on its head to perform push-ups.
author: sk372

entry: Using quick aerial speed and reflexes, POKENAME attempts to grapple and wrestle other airborne Pokémon out of the sky as training. Grappling matches between two POKENAME are said to be particularly thrilling to watch.
author: sk372

entry: After training, POKENAME prefer to take an ice bath. This relaxes their muscles and promotes recovery, and seems to be when they are at their most content. This behaviour prompted researchers to study the benefits it may have for humans.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's body is not very strong, but the Shellder on its head can project spectral limbs that attack with the strength of a trained fighter.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME infiltrates human homes searching for good places to train its body and get stronger. Though it lacks teeth, it still attempts to gnaw on things after a training session, for some unknown reason.
author: sk372

entry: Despite how much it tries to train its biceps, its arms are never as strong as the rest of its body. It can lift up to 500 pounds with its tail alone.
author: mistymagius

entry: Most POKENAME are extremely distraught by their form - specifically, their lack of mobility. When they learn to achieve inner peace and come to understand the defensive properties of their impenetrable shell, evolution is imminent.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day training on thick trees, using the sap they produce as power food. It doesn't usually use its horn in combat, mainly using it to lift heavy objects to train its core strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is regularly known to challenge Pokémon that are ten times its size. It always takes delight in licking the same forepaws it used to defeat its opponents.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME tries to keep to a rigorous and strict training schedule, but it is easily distracted by scents, particularly of food. Trainers recommend specialized nose plugs to help it retain focus during its exercises.
author: sk372

entry: As a pet, POKENAME seeks to constantly play with its owner to hone its strength or stamina, its energy seemingly boundless. Some have theorized the type of game it prefers playing is significant to what form it may take as it grows.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are still developing their fighting technique so they practice many sorts of combat with their tail. They can throw jabs, whip their tail, or even wrestle their opponents to the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME considers its fighting style an art form, and spends hours perfecting its moves. It cares much more about looks than function, however, which often holds it back in battle.
author: leonian1586

entry: When two Tyrogue are fused into a POKENAME they gain the combined combat prowess and techniques of the two Pokémon that form the fusion. They have unbounded potential in this form and are quick studies in all martial arts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When two Tyrogue are fused into a POKENAME they gain the combined combat prowess and techniques of the two Pokémon that form the fusion. They have unbounded potential in this form and are quick studies in all martial arts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When two Tyrogue are fused into a POKENAME they gain the combined combat prowess and techniques of the two Pokémon that form the fusion. They have unbounded potential in this form and are quick studies in all martial arts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME always ends its training sessions with the consumption of milk to keep its body healthy. It will happily share the milk with its sparring partner, as long as they provide it with a good enough workout.
author: sk372

entry: It never backs down from an opportunity to hone its skills. It can be found training at any hour, only stopping to eat sand and gravel.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME can frequently be seen running around forests, eagerly searching for its next opponent. It sometimes accidentally shocks its opponents out of excitement.
author: ichosuzu

entry: Most nutrients, fat, and muscle are stored in POKENAME's tail sac; it typically reaches peak size when it is about to evolve. POKENAME can wind its tail like a spring and release the potential energy to thrust the tail out as an attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The main body works in tandem with its tail to launch a flurry of powerful strikes at its opponent. However, its tail never wants to stop training and will keep the main body awake for days until it thinks it is strong enough.
author: mistymagius

entry: It mimics fighting type Pokémon constantly, hoping to one day be able to master all techniques, and then craft a new one just for itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains its body by lifting small rocks it finds on the ground every day. Trainers must keep a careful eye on it if it tries to pick up a big rock, since oftentimes it will be crushed by the weight and cry in pain.
author: soup1900

entry: Usually, when POKENAME are not eating, they are studying other battling Pokémon to learn their techniques. Wild POKENAME that lack this drive to improve are abandoned by their kind and left to fend on their own.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME constantly gets into scraps with other Pokémon in order to strengthen its muscles as well as harden its hide. It rarely scratches with its claws, preferring to use fisticuffs instead.
author: sk372

entry: Though all POKENAME have a penchant for training, domesticated specimens hone themselves especially hard. The want to protect and show off their strength for their Trainer seems to greatly enhance their dedication.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can form toxic spikes from the acid inside its stomach. Rapid movements help POKENAME produce this acid and build pressure in its body. When danger appears, POKENAME releases the spikes to poison enemies and protect itself.
author: kafoxnothylol_47795

entry: POKENAME train relentlessly, charging at boulders and cave walls with their sturdy bodies. They inadvertently open up small nooks, where smaller Pokémon will nest in during their pursuit of combat excellence.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME lives at the base of tall mountains; to train, it scales them and destroys boulders along the way. Studies indicate that it lacks the ability to reproduce, even upon further evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Pokémon have been observed battling on POKENAME's back in the wild. It is not clear how or why they learned this behavior.
author: theartemis1

entry: Training gave POKENAME a tough body and sharp spikes along its back. When POKENAME feels threatened, it releases spores from these spikes. The spores spread through the air and weaken nearby Pokémon during battle.
author: kafoxnothylol_47795

entry: This Pokémon fighter-in-training wishes to observe and learn by being wielded by its Trainer. POKENAME will evolve according to the style of training.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME seeks to constantly improve its physique, always on the lookout for a sparring partner. It uses its ribbons to stoke the battle vigor in others to help get them in the mood to fight and train with it.
author: sk372

entry: A single thrust of POKENAME's fist is strong enough to punch a hole straight through a thick tree trunk. Its physical strength is great, but it is never satisfied and always seeks to reach a new zenith of power.
author: sk372

entry: Feisty by nature and with a fierce zeal for training, POKENAME shows vast potential in its fighting styles. On star-filled nights, its exuberance for training and battle increases exponentially.
author: sk372

entry: When night falls, POKENAME train fiercely, only taking breaks when the moon goes behind the clouds. Trainers are encouraged to carry something moon-shaped in order to inspire their POKENAME to fight at its full capacity.
author: staghorn

entry: Research shows that POKENAME's large body subtly changes after every battle, adapting to its experiences. It's assumed old civilizations trained it in a myriad of ways to have contingencies for numerous possible scenarios.
author: sk372

entry: Each of POKENAME's different-colored tails produces a different color of fire, though this is purely a cosmetic difference.  When it nears evolution, the colors shift into the same color.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains its body deep underground in caverns and tunnels. As it grows stronger, it begins practicing in areas with higher elevation. Only when it is about to evolve does POKENAME wander the surface.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It hones its fists and legs as well as its capacity to control aura. Though its capability is still developing, it can create small bursts of aura power at the end of every punch or kick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains relentlessly to improve its strength. Though it is adept at headbutts, its weak arms incapable of strong punches provide more motivation to evolve.
author: alestrius

entry: Though inexperienced, POKENAME constantly seeks out scuffles to hone its skills. Each victory makes the flame on its tail blaze brighter, while defeat causes it to flicker weakly.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's cotton is commonly used to make gym clothing, as it is both breathable and sweat absorbent. It will often hide in bushes and ambush anyone it deems a strong enough opponent.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fight completely blindfolded to hone their senses, relying solely on hypersonic sonar to sense their foes. They are tenacious whilst they hone their skills, often picking up scrapes and bruises in their efforts to self-improve.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The seeds inside of POKENAME's body are packed with protein, making them a popular snack for bodybuilders. If it's knocked off from its tree, its muscular shell protects it from any damage from the fall.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fight completely blindfolded to hone their senses, relying solely on hypersonic sonar to sense their foes. They are tenacious whilst they hone their skills, often picking up scrapes and bruises in their efforts to self-improve.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spends months mediating on icy mountains to train their endurance. When fully trained, it can last up to 2 weeks without any food or water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME attacks by spinning rapidly and slapping its opponents. It's just as dangerous on the dance floor, where its slaps often trip up nearby dancers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has a cowardly personality, but dreams of becoming a strong fighter in the future. It constantly trains to enhance its fighting spirit and suppress its urge to flee from battle.
author: sk372

entry: The crystals on POKENAME's body are a unique form of Citrine that cannot be shattered by any known attack. POKENAME spends many months alone in its cave, waiting until its crystals have grown strong enough.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME charges into stone walls repeatedly at different angles in order to toughen its body. It's said that one may be able to discern its evolution path via the shapes of the cracks that form on it during training.
author: sk372

entry: Though it has potent spell-casting abilities, POKENAME prefers to fight in close-quarters. It ignites its surroundings with roiling flames, to ensure its opponent won't try to flee and keep its distance.
author: sk372

entry: Due to the large amounts of sugar in its body, POKENAME is always energized and ready for battle. The sugary fluff on its body is also full of protein, making it a popular snack for professional bodybuilders.
author: mistymagius

entry: While many would expect POKENAME to fight in arenas, many are sent to volunteer at hospitals to stretch alongside patients recovering in physical therapy as a rite of passage. Patients can choose to adopt a POKENAME after they recover.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The rain POKENAME creates is actually more similar in composition to sweat. This may be why it creates heavier storms after a strenuous workout.
author: hophoppip

entry: Studies show that the snowflakes from POKENAME's clouds are made of frozen sweat. The more vigorously POKENAME fights, the more severe its blizzards.
author: hophoppip

entry: As a way of anger management, POKENAME attempts to channel its temper into its strikes, letting loose its rage in punches or kicks during battle. This gives it a relatively calm demeanor than most Mankey fusions.
author: sk372

entry: Some say that one can figure out what POKENAME will evolve into by provoking it and seeing whether it predominantly punches or kicks during the rampage. Due to how destructive it can be, this is advice rarely taken.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a tan spiral on their stomach that other Fighting-type Pokémon enjoy attacking. Whether it is a punch or a kick, POKENAME often ends up as a punching bag for other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are impressionable Pokémon that practice their techniques by copying other Fighting-type Pokémon around them. While most of their matches end in failure, each one is a valuable learning experience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on good technique to fight against opponents, as their leafy fists and soft kicks are quite weak without proper training. Despite their gentle attacks, dedication and loyalty make them reliable partners in battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As training, it will blow bubbles in a random amount and pattern around itself. It then sees how quickly and efficiently it can pop all of them with its punches and kicks.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, POKENAME's lower arms are the ones primarily used for punching; the larger upper arms are used to help it get into positions where it can roll over or launch at foes with forceful kicks.
author: sk372

entry: Each head fights with a different technique, erratically throwing lightning-fast punches, kicks, and spins with no rhyme or reason. It disorients both POKENAME and their opponent significantly.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME attempts to train its fists and feet in equal measure, both in the water and out. Some have even trained to the point where they can stand and fight upright for prolonged periods of time on land.
author: sk372

entry: Though its gaseous body has no arms or legs, wisps imitating them can briefly be seen as POKENAME fights. It strengthens these phantom limbs, preparing for the day it evolves actual physical limbs.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its love for physical combat, its brain bruises very easily, causing it to be constantly dazed and confused. While in this state, POKENAME becomes quite irritable and will throw punches at random.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic ability to sense who is most willing to train and immediately seeks them out. It never misses a day of training.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME unevenly spins underneath the sunlight to absorb energy. The energy is then stored in the seed on its back, causing it to grow. When it reaches a certain size, it's a signal that POKENAME is close to evolving.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME's rotation powers up the volatile energy within its round body. It channels this force into its limbs, which hit opponents with explosive force.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a sphere that likes to spin, which it does very quickly. This Pokémon is known for being relatable.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME lives in the clear waters of pristine rivers, where it usually dwells alone. In battle, it uses the horn on its head as a pivot on the riverbed, spinning rapidly like a top to strike any foes that dare come too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is believed to have inherited ancient defensive techniques passed down through Lapras populations. Its great rotational force allows its projectiles to pierce targets with ease.
author: g_birde

entry: It spins around with ease on its slippery belly. When two POKENAME meet, they fight for territory by ramming into each other at high speeds.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is a dedicated exerciser. It is particularly receptive to yoga and balance-centric workouts.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is said POKENAME has achieved a perfect balance of mental and physical strength. It needs only rotate its body a few times to unleash powerful psychic emanations all around it to blow back multiple opponents with ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends most of its life honing its combat techniques by constantly challenging others in its flock. It fights skillfully in midair, and when upside down, it focuses better, landing even stronger blows with its claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME flies in search of foes to train against, then dive-bombs them to begin its ground-based, spinning fighting style. Because it spins upside-down to battle, it cannot easily retreat by flying away, so it holds nothing back.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME spins at high speeds in the summer sun. When spinning slowly rather than quickly, it releases a delightful lilac scent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances alongside street performers by spinning on its head. By hooking its claws into the ground, it can give itself more leverage for its footwork.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is rather curious and enjoys playing with new Pokémon. It balances well both right-side-up and upside-down, but tends to trip when overly excited as it is still learning to use its ears and tail to balance properly.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can unleash a flurry of stings by spinning rapidly on their head and whipping their opponents with their venomous tail. While each individual sting is mild, the effects stack as they land more stings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Ancient depictions of POKENAME were thought to be hoaxes until the fusion's discovery in recent times. It has a very calm and zen personality, always staying completely balanced, even when in fierce combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spin on their tail to build momentum before whipping their body at opponents. If these powerful lashes fail, they wrap their tail around their opponent, wrestling their foe to the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travels through time searching for ruined forests. By spinning on its head, POKENAME accelerates time, restoring them to their former beautiful state.
author: shyguy11011

entry: For defense, POKENAME spins around rapidly on the top of its head. Its dense tail sac is like a dangerous wrecking ball when it spins with such force; therefore, most foes are intimidated by the display and shy away from it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dislikes using its hands in combat. It prefers to use its sharp tails and legs to unleash powerful spins capable of slicing through metal.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME tries to stay still to mimic a tree, but its spinning often gives it away. When forced to move, it will become wobbly and start to cry.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME mimics the fighting styles of others while spinning on its head. However, it often loses its balance and falls over, confusing both its opponents and itself.
author: shyguy11011

entry: When POKENAME spins on its head like a top, it can generate a veritable storm of leaves with which it overwhelms its opponents. It perfects its combat style by training daily in the heart of the forest.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME balances on its hand, spinning rapidly to defend itself and strike with immense force. Its kicks, amplified by this motion, can snap sturdy trees in one blow.
author: jonclyd

entry: With the jaw on its tail, POKENAME performs well offensively and defensively. Its fighting spirit is appreciated by the most audacious Trainers.
author: fouguri

entry: POKENAME spins habitually whenever it grows bored. These spins become extremely rapid when it senses an incoming tornado.
author: .izik

entry: The lower gears of a POKENAME spin quickly like a top as it moves around. When in battle, these gears spin at their quickest and the ring around them will spin as well to batter foes with physical strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: Although many POKENAME will move on their legs, they fight while spinning atop the horns on their heads. They will strike with rapid, spinning kicks and by using their long feelers to lash out.
author: infinex21

entry: As POKENAME spins, it gives off a soothing aura that nearly mesmerizes those watching it. This aura grows stronger as POKENAME spins faster, sometimes leading it to topple over as it becomes affected by the aura.
author: chibitales

entry: To lure in prey, POKENAME spins around gracefully like a dancer, releasing a sweet aroma. Once its prey draws near, it strikes with its thorny, poison-laced whips.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME attach themselves to cave ceilings, where Trainers often mistake them for stalactites. When a target passes below, they drop down and spin at high speed, drilling their prey into the ground.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME is able to warp, reshape and extend its limbs. When rotating on its head, this allows it to turn its arms and legs into powerful whips with a massive range in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's dances contain lots of spins and twirls, both on the ground and in grand leaping movements. It can easily create tornadoes of fire to menace opponents in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME traverses polar tundra by rapidly spinning while extending its arms to brace against impacts that may harm its icy body. While a poor swimmer, it is very buoyant and can be found bobbing anywhere in the seas if trapped in a strong current.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's swift, high-flying fighting style leaves their opponents seeing stars. They can spin on their head for several minutes at a time without getting dizzy, delivering punches and kicks as they spin.
author: chibitales

entry: A popular Pokémon among street performers, POKENAME uses a unique fighting style mimicking a mix of hip-hop and breakdancing, making it unpredictable in combat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is instinctively drawn to light. Unfortunately, its wobbly flight pattern often causes it to crash into buildings and streetlamps, leaving broken lights in its wake.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME is believed to attack with its legs while spinning on its head, but its legs are stubby and ineffective in combat. Blissfully ignorant, it spins nevertheless, bumping into everything around it as it chirps happily.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME vents its frustrations through breakdancing, as the fluid movements help it manage its emotions. Dancers study how it moves to improve their own performances.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Years ago, a prospective colonel was required to battle a POKENAME as a rite of passage. Only by defeating it in combat could they earn the rank; if they failed, they remained a lieutenant colonel, continuing their training until they proved worthy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are perfectly capable of balancing on their tails and unleashing devastating kicks on their foes. However, they much prefer to lie around.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Tucking its body into its shell and leaving its tail out, POKENAME will rapidly spin and launch itself at an opponent. Even if the foe manages to dodge the main body, the tail whipping around is certain to make contact and damage the opponent.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The odd positioning of the magnets on its body causes it to float upside-down. It rotates at high speeds to produce waves of electricity to shock its enemies.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME spins its entire shell to blast water in a wide circle. Due to the positioning of the cannons, this attack is impractical and ineffective.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME can spin indefinitely without ever getting dizzy. Its dazzling spins are said to have hypnotic properties.
author: noel5229

entry: The first time that a POKENAME is knocked over, it gets desperate, thinking it won't be able to get up. After a couple of minutes, it suddenly discovers its natural talent of spinning over its head.
author: epping_forest

entry: Having one claw heavier than the other really bothered POKENAME at first, but then it adapted. It puts the heavy claw over its abdomen to gain rotation speed, then releases it, combining the weight of the claw and the moment of inertia generated.
author: epping_forest

entry: Extremely affectionate by nature, POKENAME makes a gesture with its vines to express its attachment to others. Doing so is usually followed by using those vines to pull the target of its love closer so it can kiss them as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's main habitat is in far-reaching tundras, but only during the seasons where the days are long. To survive during the dark seasons, it goes dormant underground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of psychic power from its skull when intruders enter its icy caverns. Crying amplifies this energy, so it deliberately agitates itself before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: What POKENAME lack in elbow grease they make up in elegance. Their deliberate fighting style allows them to remain photogenic regardless of the situation they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cares very deeply about its appearance and will use its saliva to keep its hair nice and tidy. It can be seen playfully blowing raspberries at people and Pokémon it doesn't like.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's slimy body leaves streaks of pink pigment wherever it goes. Some companies use POKENAME's slime to make lip gloss.
author: hophoppip

entry: Although the smooching noises it makes with its lips seem cute, it is actually a warning from POKENAME. Ignoring the warning will cause one to be splattered with a spit of ink before POKENAME swims away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are wreathed in burning flames, which give them an imposing cast when flying through the boreal skies they call home. They are not so impressive when they land, as their legs are ill-suited for walking on ice, slipping easily.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME make their nests near clear mountain springs so they can constantly inspect their reflection. Its hair sheds and regrows rapidly.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME kisses the ground to encourage the growth of plants. Its seed-based attacks leave lip-shaped flowers behind once the seeds grow.
author: hophoppip

entry: A threatened POKENAME will emit flames from its back. The heat of its own fire leaves its hair a hopeless mess, much to its dismay.
author: hophoppip

entry: Though considered cute from afar, POKENAME will attempt to crawl onto people to smooch them, which causes a severe reaction from those who have arachnophobia. POKENAME likes to wear its own webs, possibly because it likes the texture.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It uses it's lips to identify unknown objects. When its charged antenna are connected, kisses from POKENAME become shockingly powerful.
author: corn0779

entry: POKENAME are hyperactive Pokémon that love to run around and show off their looks. When they trip and get muck or mere dirt on their faces, they cry and discharge electricity until they grow tired.
author: infinex21

entry: It has a sassy and defiant personality, making it difficult to train. It will even run away from their own Trainers if they upset it. POKENAME prefer physical affection, but only if the affection happens when no one is watching.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Innocent and carefree, POKENAME blows kisses at anyone and everyone it passes by. Those that blow a kiss back are considered a friend for life from that moment on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers cold environments. It's very finicky about maintaining the shine of its vivid pink beak.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hides behind bushes and shakes its hairy hands to lure people to it. Then it jumps out and gives the lured person a kiss.
author: themicelegion

entry: They are found scurrying about happily in caverns when frost forms outside. They tend to be affectionate to those they know. Some Pokémon have allergies to their fluffy fur.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Named for its iconic call, 'smoop smoop', it is often cited as one of the cutest cries amongst all Pokémon. It has no trouble finding friends to play with, running about and splashing around in lakes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME communicates with noises that sound similar to kissing. This makes many assume it has an amiable personality, but in reality it is quite prickly and standoffish, slapping away at those who come too close.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are easily annoyed, reacting poorly to a Trainer's commands. Once you gain one's trust, it'll become very affectionate.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME spend hours keeping their fur neat. They run from battle to avoid ruining their coats.
author: ohok3441

entry: While it resembles a mouth, POKENAME cannot open its lips. It communicates by emanating psychic energy that make others empathize with its feelings.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are shy creatures that crave hugs and kisses from those they care about. They have a difficult time communicating their needs to their Trainer, so they remain by their Trainer's side and pout until they get what they want.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their control over ice to form protective shells for themselves. They are popular Pokémon in Kalos, as with a little training, they can be prompted to create fashionable hats and scarves out of ice as well.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hides in snowdrifts and leaps out to plant a freezing kiss on predators. The shock puts them to sleep just long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: This little fusion is peculiarly known to cause very expensive accidents that everyone ends up laughing at, rather than lamenting them. It may seem to be very exhausting to take care of, but its loyalty and affection are rewarding enough.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME doesn't like its electrical powers because they cause its hair to become messy. It is surprisingly clever and will cheekily shock people who try to shake its hand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME kisses objects to identify them due its extremely bad eyesight. Its lips are hot enough to leave lasting burns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spend much of their mornings looking at their own reflections to ensure their faces are clean and their yellow locks are kempt. They love to dance to express their joy and will release harmless jolts from their cheeks as they dance.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME investigate criminal activities by infiltrating crowds and tailing suspects. If they're caught, they will blow a kiss and disappear in a burst of feathers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Rich families will often provide their children with POKENAME as a companion instead of sending them to socialise at school. POKENAME are patient when being played with but will give out a shock if their companion is too rough with them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's luxurious hair is prone to breakage if it gets too warm. Luckily, the intense cold radiating from its lips prevents that from happening.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME explores its surroundings through kissing. If it's in a group with other Pokémon, it will show its fealty to the dominant one by giving them the most kisses.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's confidence in its speed gives a smug and cocky personality. It teases opponents that it outmaneuvers by planting a quick kiss on them before quickly dodging back and continuing to run circles around them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME thinks of itself as a caretaker for younger Pokémon, believing that a kiss will calm overly rambunctious youths. Given its kiss contains a mild paralytic, the tactic does prove viable in a technical sense.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its kindness towards humans, seeing a POKENAME is not a good sign. It is said it will only appear before Trainers that are destined to never find love.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME appears during snowstorms and slowly approaches disoriented hikers. When it gets close enough, it licks its victim to immobilize them.
author: chorb33

entry: They trudge slowly and willlessly through ruins and fulfill the wishes of Jynoirs, who often have several POKENAME's under their control.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is a cunning Pokémon that can easily wrap others around its finger. Any who resist it will witness its powerful magic.
author: chorb33

entry: If POKENAME sensed irreverence in ancient times, it would repeatedly kiss the offender. These kisses induced a magical sleep that could last for months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carry a versatile staff made out of ice. This staff freezes foes on contact, creating an opening for a barrage of savage strikes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even though POKENAME are still developing their fighting abilities, they have a certain regal disposition that makes them seem more powerful than they are. Teaching them to be gracious losers is an important lesson for them to learn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME brandishes lipstick instead of blades, and will attempt to pretty you up with slashing and jabbing motions. The result looks quite bad.
author: robosoup

entry: During large blizzards, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its lips into the surrounding area. This unfortunately causes many to forget basic survival instincts and succumb to the cold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its powers over ice to send freezing blasts at their opponents. Any ice they create has a cosmic shimmer to it, with stars twinkling in its reflection.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME dance together under the light of the full moon, their powers over ice creating a frosty glaze to the ground they dance across. Their sense of balance is poor; they can end up slipping and crashing into one another as the dance progresses.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's fluffy hair requires lots of maintenance to keep it healthy and neat. It loves to try out new hairstyles.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are very shy creatures. Many opt to hide behind their oversized hair instead of dealing with social interactions.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME are prone to getting upset when their fur is not clean, as the irritants scratch against their sensitive skin. Trainers can help alleviate the itchiness by grooming their fur and tails.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Getting pricked by POKENAME's spines results in a strong bout of paralysis. If afflicted, the most effective cure for the condition is being kissed by POKENAME, which immediately relieves the paralyzing effect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a hard time sitting still when they are getting groomed but have enough sense to understand that it is good for their health. Without these constant grooming sessions, the irritants in their fur scratch their sensitive skin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon whose sleepiness is determined by whatever touched its lips first after it woke up. It only gets fired up if it touches or tastes something spicy.
author: beatdoof

entry: With newfound stamina thanks to its permanent diet of chili pepper and cold water, POKENAME's breath can inflict hypothermia or heatstroke, depending on its mood for the day.
author: beatdoof

entry: A mask of super cold ice protects POKENAME's face. Even a light touch from this mask can result in frostbite.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is very proud of the sheen of its armor, taking great care in keeping it pristine. Those who help clean it are given friendly smooches; those that dirty it receive crushingly painful headbutts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME, when threatened, will chomp up a big bite of soil, sand, etc. The inside of its mouth freezes the small granules, letting it spit out a heap of pointed, frozen projectiles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's lips are highly sensitive and used primarily as a vehicle for its sense of touch and, sometimes, its ability to grab things, so they are always puckered and ready to use. It occasionally sneezes and exhales an icy frost.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME exercises every day, training its body to fly one day. It creates training gear from ice to add weight to its body and build more muscle.
author: hophoppip

entry: A hard shell of ice protects POKENAME's body. Its face is left exposed so it can make use of its powerful kisses.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME give kisses to their Trainer as a sign of affection. Their icy yet warm breath produces a soothing sensation at the spot of each kiss.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME finds something it likes, it will latch onto them with the suckers on its bud. While POKENAME doesn't mean any harm, its suckers are coated in a mild toxin that causes rashes and nausea.
author: mistymagius

entry: Those who struggle to put on clothes due to mobility issues may find POKENAME helpful, especially with socks and shoes. In addition to helping putting clothes on, POKENAME's fashion sense also help Trainers look their best.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possesses a strange mix of curiosity and timidity. It may impulsively hop up to someone to kiss it as a way of analyzing them, before smacking them with its ears and hopping away in fear.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME enters a home during the night and bestows a kiss upon its sleeping occupants, they wake up feeling strangely cold. It seems that inducing drowsiness and surprise in others somehow sustains POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The splotches POKENAME leaves behind after sticking to surfaces resemble kiss marks. This inspired makeup companies to use the fluid around its body in lip gloss.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME burrows under desert sands, frosting its tunnel walls as it moves. It only travels at night, loathing the desert heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneakily climbs onto bigger creatures, attaching itself to the neck or the face hanging from its strong lips. So, this way, they hold their hostage with their icy fangs point blank, ready to snap if they disobey their orders.
author: epping_forest

entry: Light reflects off POKENAME's icy collar and creates beautiful reflections. It is very proud of these and constantly looks around at its Trainer to see if they are admiring them, dazzling them in the process.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME often shows up at winter villages, letting itself into people's homes to get out of the cold. While generally friendly, it hates being told no and will never leave unless the home is destroyed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are constantly admiring their reflections in the ice. With a single kiss, they can freeze anyone solid, using them as mirrors.
author: santon5512

entry: It projects a weird noise from its ears, trying to make others fall into a trance. It will get very happy if its Trainer pretends to fall for it, but ignoring it will make POKENAME sad and force it to improve next time.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME can cast a very high-pitched sound to orient itself in the darkness of a cave, often using flat surfaces as a mirror to tidy up its looks in the dark. This frequency causes no effect on living creatures, but at least it sounds nice.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's hair, while thin and brittle, is razor-sharp. Despite their ice-cold exterior, they are generally friendly and loving.
author: entomoxie

entry: This fusion is very creative when it comes to accidentally breaking things or hurting itself or others. During the day, it behaves as a restless chaotic force, but during the night it becomes a soft and tender little plushie.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its ice-cold arms are popular ice cube alternatives, as they can be dipped in drinks for several minutes and POKENAME enjoys the liquid in return.
author: chorb33

entry: Its icy hat, which it uses to reflect the sun's hot rays, is surprisingly robust. Thanks to its ice powers, it can constantly renew its hat.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME lives atop icy mountainsides, practicing its singing only when alone. The pitch of its voice changes depending on its emotional state.
author: mepp.

entry: Many POKENAME wish they had fire powers. They often swish their mouths and spit fuel, hoping to ignite it and pretend they are spitting fire.
author: epping_forest

entry: The chunks of ice growing out of POKENAME shine like freshly polished crystal. They use these glowing crystals to guide hikers out of particularly dangerous sections of frigid mountain caves.
author: evilgammon

entry: Despite their clumsiness, POKENAME love to help their Trainer bake delicious treats. They tend to leave a huge mess in the kitchen, but Trainers often say they're too adorable to ban.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: Melted ice from POKENAME's tail is used as a powerful ingredient in medicinal lip balms. The substance feels as if it chills and burns to the touch, and POKENAME uses it on its own lips, too.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are vain creatures that focus heavily on their appearance. They often forget how many selfies they have taken, so their electronic devices are full of photos of themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME spins and twirls around enough, snow and bits of ice inexplicably start to slough off it in all directions, even in warm areas. It seems to take pride in its appearance and gets upset whenever it eventually stumbles into dirt or water.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME defends itself with miniature clouds that drizzle freezing rain below. The liquid around its head is effective as a lip balm.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME keeps itself immaculately clean, as it possesses a vain personality and high beauty standards. It is willing to bless those who gift it pretty accessories with a kiss for their efforts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME run around with reckless abandon, frequently tripping over their own feet in their exuberance. Troops of POKENAME that are playing together grab for one another when they trip, often resulting in the entire troop falling to the ground.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is capable of clumsily running at up to 258 mph, yet rarely goes far due to tripping. During blizzards, it has been seen napping like a child.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME are doting creatures that enjoy giving kisses to whoever they consider friends. These icy yet warm kisses soothe weary muscles of anyone who gets a kiss. They also are fans of handmade sweaters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swipe their icy spoons across new things and examine them by taste. Dangerous objects or places are passed down through generations. It is thought that the ice making up POKENAME's spoons heightens their psychic power.
author: chibitales

entry: They look into reflective crystals to touch up on their looks. They're known to blow kisses at passing hikers.
author: jackythewannabe

entry: POKENAME is always found lazing at the beach, using its natural ice affinity to keep itself cool on even the hottest of days. It uses this minor power over ice to create platforms to catch fish in the sea.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's sensitive nose can remember what it likes and dislikes. When entering a new area, it will sniff around to try and find familiar smells.
author: noel5229

entry: Capable of generating electricity from photosynthesis, POKENAME are popular among electricians as back-up generators during repairs. Unfortunately, POKENAME get tired easily, so they can only help during morning shifts.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME does not roll well on account of the prongs on its body. It wiggles its arms to attempt to move forward, though this is very slow.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME can discharge electricity from its skull powerful enough to stun a full-grown adult. This exhausting feat can only be performed once per day.
author: .izik

entry: When angry, POKENAME slams its tongue against the ground to create sparks. One lick from its tongue can leave the licked limb paralyzed for up to an hour.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME relies on the two prongs on its body to produce an arc of electricity. It activates this power whenever Flying-type predators are near, shocking them with its spark.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tries to be in constant movement; if it isn't, it will begin to lose energy and become greatly distressed. It rests in turbulent and rushing waters.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME tries to be in constant movement; if it isn't, it will begin to lose energy and become greatly distressed. It rests in turbulent and rushing waters.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stores static charge within its body, releasing crackling bursts as it moves. When it dances, it rapidly builds electricity, and the longer it keeps rhythm, the more powerful its attacks become.
author: ilija09

entry: Internally, POKENAME constantly generates a mixture of electricity and heat, leaving it warm to the touch. When it shakes its fur after grooming, tiny sparks and embers flake off.
author: sk372

entry: Once POKENAME has cocooned itself completely, it falls to the forest floor head first. The plug-like organs on its head draw energy from the soil to fuel electricity coursing across its cocoon that deters predators.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME are still small and young, they can use the protrusion on their head to siphon energy from devices. They lose this ability as they grow.
author: .realthree

entry: Excitable by nature, POKENAME rapidly generates electricity that must be discharged, often shocking itself and those nearby unintentionally.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Trainers must stay vigilant if they own this Pokémon. POKENAME's play style involves biting others with its sharp, electrified fangs.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It stores electricity in its tail. If ever in danger, POKENAME will slam its tail onto the ground to let out an electrical discharge.
author: holzycookie

entry: POKENAME are capable of spinning their heads 360 degrees, doing so to generate electricity. They create arcs of electricity within their feathers to fire them at prey from the skies.
author: santon5512

entry: As it flaps its wings, it releases bursts of static into the air. This creates a crackling sound that deters nearby predators.
author: .izik

entry: It wiggles its ears to generate static electricity. This motion is both playful and useful for charging small attacks.
author: .izik

entry: It scavenges discarded electronics, taking them back to its nest to consume. This habit keeps it energized and content.
author: .izik

entry: Its egg-like body rocks back and forth while charging electricity. This movement generates a soft hum that calms those around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gnaw on wires and electrical components, feeding off the electricity. When startled, they involuntarily discharge all of their stored energy before quickly fleeing.
author: santon5512

entry: Swarms of POKENAME make nests out of abandoned electronics. They have stingers on the tips of their wings.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is born with only two limbs, but the more electricity they are exposed to, the more they grow. There are reports of POKENAME with 8 limbs that use the extras to confuse opponents in battle.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is born with only two limbs, but the more electricity they are exposed to, the more they grow. Some POKENAME have been seen with 8 limbs, which they use to help their Trainers carry heavy objects.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's back allow it to better convert sunlight into electricity, but they are highly conductive. This conductivity makes them useful for electrical components when it sheds every winter.
author: elekboy88

entry: POKENAME plugs the two prongs on its head to steal electricity, often after stealing food from the homeowner's pantry. Once recharged, it tries to carry out as much food as it can for its kin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME originates from a time before electricity was discovered. Its symbology seems to have been a prediction of modern electrical symbols.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It climbs to the tops of trees during thunderstorms to absorb lightning. This behavior charges it to full power.
author: .izik

entry: As a pet, POKENAME can get very spoiled and needy. When it feels it hasn't gotten enough attention, it barks loudly while flailing its limbs and shedding sparks and lightning from the prongs on its head.
author: sk372

entry: Its horns grow warmer as it stores more electrical energy. This warmth helps it survive blizzards by radiating heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bright yellow pattern makes it highly visible. Despite this, predators stay away, seeing the pattern as an indicator of dangerous electrical power.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME produces a poison with paralyzing properties. It recharges itself by swallowing its tail and rolling around.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME infiltrate devices to sap electricity and fuel themselves. However, they constantly discharge this electricity from their heads, continuously recharging the device and trapping themselves in an endless loop.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME works out its arms through routine exercise, such as push ups, dips, and intense stretches and extensions. It's thought that whatever secondary set of muscles POKENAME works out the most will determine what it evolves into.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses static electricity to change its hairstyle frequently. This quirky habit keeps its look fresh and unpredictable.
author: .izik

entry: It swings its arms wildly while spitting bursts of fire. The combination of electricity and flames makes it an unpredictable fighter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carry batteries in their pouches, keeping them charged using the electricity they produce by spinning their arms. These Pokémon love to help people, presenting these batteries to those who need them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME store electricity in their tails, which bounce faster as more energy is stored. Once they reach max capacity, they aim their tail at foes to shock them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys sleeping under trees. However, it gets startled easily by local Flying-type Pokémon. It is a very dangerous Pokémon to hold as it creates static shocks around its shell.
author: skleegamer

entry: POKENAME plug their tails into outlets, falling into a deep slumber until fully charged. They lose this charge quite quickly, however, leaving them asleep for most of their lives.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME generate electricity as they dig through terrain, specifically because of their moving limbs. When they curl into balls, they can better release their electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: It catches lightning with its prong-like horns and stores the electricity within a sac. Its quills arc with static electricity as it spins its arms to generate or release electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sleeps in creeks and is nearly impossible to wake except by excessive force. During this time, it regularly releases bursts of static into the surrounding water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME harnesses static electricity from its clothes as they drag along the ground, storing the energy in its helmet. It then releases this energy through enchanting, mystical bursts that shock its opponents.
author: nightwingjay

entry: It shoots powerful lightning bolts from the horn on its face. It can reliably hit a target with a Thunder Shock from up to 200 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: The magnetism of POKENAME is thought by scientists to be sourced from the electric charge in its limbs. If it loses this charge, it will spin its arms for days to recover it.
author: notsaying.

entry: The electricity it generates is weak. To absorb more energy and charge its powers, it clamps the jaws on the back of its head onto Electric-type Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME docks its head in power sockets to get energy. Within an hour, it can recharge energy worth over eight hours of sleep.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME swing their arms to build momentum and deliver stone-shattering punches to form their dens. Spinning their arms also generates electricity within them, which can oft be seen sparking between their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spins its body in circles to generate electricity that it stores between its prongs. After a full minute of spinning, it has enough electricity to power a lamp post for an hour.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME functions as a powerful taser, a less-lethal melee weapon. It rotates its ribbon to recharge or plugs into outlets to supercharge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's metal body is always buzzing with electricity. It discharges this electricity in devastating blade attacks.
author: bee4082

entry: Because POKENAME gets most of its energy from the electricity stored in its body, it becomes fatigued when many Joltik latch onto it. In the wild, it relies on Flying-Type Pokémon to pick them off.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are often used as generators, their rotating gears constantly producing electricity. By plugging their tails into an outlet, they can power an entire house.
author: santon5512

entry: After absorbing electricity from an outlet, POKENAME's body releases a pleasant scent similar to a lemon cleaning solution. Many report feeling intense calm when exposed to this aroma.
author: .izik

entry: It constantly tries to impress others with its electric powers, firing bursts of lightning from its cannon rapidly to any who would watch. Its energy constantly runs out as a result of the showboating, leaving it exhausted often.
author: sk372

entry: Many small towns often have an POKENAME handy to quickly charge medical devices. Even though they are small, they do their best to ensure everyone's needs are met, especially if a person needs the device to support daily living.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's dark fur is constantly charged with so much static electricity that it jams signals if it is near electronic devices.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's light slowly saps the electricity from everything around it. These Pokémon are often found in cities, frequently causing blackouts.
author: santon5512

entry: It has very little electrical prowess to generate on its own. POKENAME resorts to plugging itself into outlets and siphoning power from there in order to have enough to produce visible electricity.
author: sk372

entry: The shell of POKENAME is incredibly conductive, shocking those who touch it. This along with POKENAME's high weight result in a particularly dangerous headbutt.
author: mirkinator

entry: POKENAME rapidly vibrate their wings to generate electricity, storing it within their bodies. They fire small bursts of this energy from their antennae, stunning prey.
author: santon5512

entry: It latches onto servers to absorb their electricity, retaining any data within them. This gives it a surprising ability to mimic stored information.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail sparks constantly, sending out small shocks to those nearby. It often shocks its friends by accident while playing.
author: .izik

entry: Shy but adventurous, POKENAME love playing outdoors, rain or shine. When they are particularly overjoyed, they let loose a Stun Spore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Shy but adventurous, POKENAME love playing outdoors, rain or shine. When they are particularly overjoyed, they let loose a Stun Spore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its ears charge energy internally when retracted. In battle, POKENAME uses these extendable ears to quickly strike and shock its opponents from a distance.
author: sk372

entry: It senses nearby electronics by wiggling its sensitive nose. This ability allows it to locate hidden devices effortlessly.
author: .izik

entry: While it isn't yet adept at utilizing Electric-type moves, it nevertheless prowls fearlessly during even the most dangerous thunderstorms. If a storm does not contain thunder or lightning, however, it prefers to hide in its den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The crest on POKENAME's head is where it generates and stores its internal electricity. It can focus the voltage into its mouth and tusks, giving it a more powerful bite.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME beats its wings rapidly to build up charge, making its horns crackle with energy. It loves chasing storms and thunderclouds, darting through the sky and leaving a trail of buzzing sparks behind.
author: potato_tub

entry: It loves curling up inside warm live wiring to sleep. The heat generated by the wires soothes it and charges its body.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail resembles a plug inside an outlet, sparking with power. It swings it wildly, sending out bursts of electricity to protect itself.
author: .izik

entry: It fills itself with any discarded wires and broken electronics it can find. When it discharges its electricity, it emits clouds of putrid smoke.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME flies at high altitudes using its clouds, which match the type of clouds around it. Whenever there is a storm, its storm clouds shoot lightning down to the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It releases sharp jolts of electricity through its needles, paralyzing anything that gets too close. It frequently makes its home near powerlines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME build up static around them that makes their topaz fur stand on edge. At night, they congregate around lamp posts to stare at the bright light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swims through shallow marshes, using rapid electric shocks to paralyze unsuspecting prey. Its body glows faintly in murky waters, letting off an eerie glow at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constantly sparks from its tail to vent its electrical charge. When properly trained, it can work on assembly lines in factories, using both its flames and electricity to weld parts together.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can generate vast amounts of electricity by flapping its powerful wings, which is then processed through the horns atop its head. Once fully charged, it actively seeks out opponents to battle in order to release its stored energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME use their tails like propellers, spinning them to propel themselves through the water while also generating electricity. When their horns bump into something, they discharge all of their built-up energy.
author: santon5512

entry: The lightning bolt on POKENAME's stomach glows when it harnesses the power of electricity. By first soaking opponents with water, it can knock out several at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sleeps near power sources. If it is disturbed, it teleports to safety, leaving behind a dangerous electrical charge at its point of origin.
author: chorb33

entry: If you find a conspicuous piece of dented metal it may have been caused by an POKENAME. During thunderstorms, they punch metal surfaces to store electricity for later consumption.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME is a common pest that siphons electricity from underground cables, leaving many homeowners frustrated when they have to cover the cost. Its glow draws the attention of Venonat and Venomoth at night.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy frolicking in fields of grass. Whenever they are excited, they produce sparks that trail behind them as they have fun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sparks running down POKENAME's back are caused by its natural electrostatic field reacting to airborne particles. It uses its prongs to modulate this field, allowing it to fire off plumes of sparks at potential predators.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME stores up electrical reserves in its tail, which has the appearance of a thundercloud. To intimidate foes and amplify its fighting spirit, it slaps the charged tail against the ground, which creates booming thunder.
author: sk372

entry: When overcharged, it becomes excessively magnetic, sticking to larger metal objects. This state renders it immobile until the charge dissipates.
author: .izik

entry: It looks forward to evolving to further increase the voltage and range of its electromagnetic waves. If anyone tries to touch the ears of POKENAME's three heads, they risk getting an electric shock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Flying through open windows, it steals cords from electronics to build its nest. These nests can hold up to one thousand different cords.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dislike strangers and have a hard time warming up to others. However, they love to play: this is the easiest way to have them bond with another. When excited, the gas surrounding them expands; unfortunately, the gas is a skin irritant.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dislike strangers and have a hard time warming up to others. However, they love to play: this is the easiest way to have them bond with another. When excited, the gas surrounding them expands; unfortunately, the gas is a skin irritant.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An impish creature with a toxic tongue, POKENAME can cause paralysis upon contact thanks to the poisonous fluid and static electricity coating its fur. Although it loves playing pranks, it dislikes being scared and may even cry if startled.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME collect electricity using their horns. They use this energy to make their fur glow faintly, the gentle light helping other Pokémon fall asleep in the harsh weather.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME hide in bushes low to the ground, the patterns on their hoods resembling the face of a Bulbasaur. They lure in prey with the sweet scent of nectar before coiling around them and striking with their poisonous fangs.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME have a hood around their head that protects them from predators. Many Flying-type Pokémon mistake them for a small Arbok, allowing POKENAME to eat leaves in peace.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME'S bone is infused with deadly poison. It beats enemies with great fighting skills.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are naturally wily creatures that prefer to fight pragmatically with wide reach. The limbs are hard to track in combat, with momentum gathered allowing them to thrash and strike like whips.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME have recently become known for their ruthless fighting style. They will sink their fangs into their opponent, envenoming them while delivering dozens of punches per second. Opponents that try to escape are coiled in their large tails.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has a long, sinuous tail that serves as its primary defense mechanism. If threatened, it will whip its tail at the aggressor until they go away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME makes an eerie hissing noise as it expels gases. Recent studies have found a correlation between the differing patterns on the left head and the toxicity of the gases they emit.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Due to its extremely hard body, it is difficult to move. If mud becomes stuck to its body, it will use its long neck to clean itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their long bodies to constrict and crush obstacles and foes with relative ease. Their horns function like stingers, though they are shed after stinging once and take a full day to regrow.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use the faux eyes on its wings to appear intimidating to deter potential predators. Once they are far enough way, they often hiss in enjoyment at their success.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME move swiftly and cut at their opponents with their poison-laced forearm scythes repeatedly with every pass. Their tails have enough constrictive power to crush a small car.
author: infinex21

entry: Its deceptively small body hides twin fangs that inject half a liter of venom in a matter of seconds. Once its venomous payload has been delivered, the fangs retract until it can strike again.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cannot maintain its shape well. Its cognitive processes are primarily for transforming, so its markings end up perplexing, not intimidating.
author: ziggaway

entry: It pretends to be wallets on the side of alleyways to trick kids into getting close. Once they get close, it will bite down on them with sharp fangs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a semi-fluid body composed of toxic acids. They can reshape their body at will and create angry markings and wave them around to dissuade aggressors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The bristles on POKENAME's neck and tail are very sharp. Getting stung by them can send excruciating shocks throughout your entire nervous system.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME slithers around slowly, its cocoon-covered upper body limiting much of its mobility. Its fangs are hard to spot, but packed with a potent venom that leaves potential predators in spasms.
author: sk372

entry: The fossilized remains of POKENAME are found in some of the darkest caves in the world. The wings aren't used to fly, rather, they are used to glide from cave wall to cave wall in particularly large caverns.
author: notsaying.

entry: Staring into its eye-pattern too long causes an insufferable burning sensation in your entire body. It produces flames hot enough to vaporize rock within a matter of minutes.
author: mistymagius

entry: The markings on POKENAME's hood are highly visible on its shed skin. Its territory is often littered with discarded skins, serving as a scare tactic.
author: char_latte3412

entry: The orbs on its tail store a harsh poison; when they glow bright red, POKENAME's venomous bite is at its deadliest.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This POKENAME variant lacks the venomous potency of its relatives. However, its ability to camouflage itself in rugged terrain compensates for this.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is exceedingly rare and can live at both high and low altitudes, on land and at sea. Its ability to see in the dark allows it to hunt at any time when its natural draconic life force requires additional energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is most active by the seaside, particularly on foggy nights. Oral legends among sailors about a monstrous face in the dark at sea may have been about the pattern on POKENAME's wings and chest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Within dense forests, POKENAME use their flowers as camouflage and release an aroma that attracts weak bug Pokémon. Once they get close, POKENAME catch them off guard and attack.
author: greaterjagras

entry: POKENAME flare out their frills in an attempt at intimidation towards opponents. However, they have been observed to use their frills during mating rituals aswell.
author: camtft

entry: It stalks the bottom of swamps for unsuspecting Pokémon. It can use various venoms specialized for different forms of prey.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME spits poisonous acid while flying to weaken its prey, which it then grabs with its claws. If it loses part of its tail during a violent battle, it will grow back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its jaws are strong enough to crush whole tires in a single chomp. The patterns on its stomach are so intimidating it can freeze small Pokémon in their tracks.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME rears up to full size to greet new faces in excitement. Its sudden rise and the pattern on its belly tend to accidentally frighten off these potential new friends, unfortunately.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps its wings close to its body until it comes across prey. The markings on the interior of its wings when unfurled cause paralysis on viewing, giving POKENAME ample time to get closer and inflict poison with its claws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hood-like abdomen frightens enemies with a menacing glare. It lurks in webs, trapping prey in venomous threads and striking them with a sharp horn to inject paralyzing venom before feeding.
author: gekkou.

entry: POKENAME fly behind small prey and sink their fangs into the nape of their prey. After being subdued, POKENAME swallow their prey whole to allow their stomach acids to do most of the work.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a carnivorous predator Pokémon that sheds its feathers throughout each month. It prefers to eat the Eggs of other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its orbs to create bright flashes that blind and immobilize prey such as Goldeen. The orbs also secrete a powerful toxin, making them poisonous to the touch.
author: sk372

entry: Its ears are patterned to resemble large, scary eyes. This helps it scare away predators, as it's quite meek and struggles to produce strong venom.
author: hophoppip

entry: The wool on its body sparks with electricity if it gets too close to a power source. Should a person touch the wool, it can cause burns or paralysis.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME snatch young Pokémon from the forest floor to bring back to their nest. POKENAME inject a virulent venom through the nape to pacify their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It rubs its fluff vigorously to create static electricity within its body. The orb on its tail can store vast amounts of power.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is mostly hollow. It makes a soft hissing noise as it effortlessly glides through the breeze.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases clouds of floating spores with each hiss, spreading them far and wide on the wind. If attacked, it whips its cotton-like tail to create an updraft, allowing it to glide away to safety.
author: .izik

entry: It infests rural crops, devouring all the food it finds along with its entire colony. If anyone tries to chase it away, POKENAME retaliates with terrible bites from its venomous fangs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A common trick that older siblings like to play on their younger siblings is to tell them that the film on POKENAME is Pink Juice as they look and smell almost identical. They get a shock when they taste it, as it is very bitter, though harmless.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The tiny scales that cover its body leak a noxious poison. During hot days, more of this liquid will seep from its body than normal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is incredibly powerful when it comes to constricting things. In addition, its psychic powers allow it to predict its foe's movements. Once POKENAME has you in its sights, there is no escape.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME exudes a sweet scent from its bulb, drawing prey close to it. It then lunges at the unlucky Pokémon, swallowing them whole.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: Its fangs are incredibly sharp and hard. Ancient cultures would use these fangs in the production of weaponry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an intimidating predator with a mesmerizing presence. The glowing mark on its chest is believed to contain ancient knowledge, which it guards fiercely.
author: jaminmcready

entry: By incorporating its telekinetic powers, it can hurl venom from its mouth over 2 miles. The venom itself ranges in effectiveness based on its diet.
author: .izik

entry: The smooth metal that covers its body has the same chemical composition as silver. Portions of it were melted down in ancient times to create coins.
author: .izik

entry: It uses the eye-shaped patterns beneath its wings to freeze its small prey with fear. POKENAME's fangs can inject a potent toxin that weakens muscles within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A natural predator of Fairy Types, POKENAME swiftly wraps prey before administering lethal Bullet Punches. Any who resist find it impossible to break its steel-hard scales.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It is known to show no mercy towards anyone. It scares away foes by lifting its arms up, revealing an ominous pattern.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The yellow liquid that comes from its fangs resembles honey. The scent of the fluid alone entrances prey from up to 200 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: Their semiliquid bodies take the shape of an Arbok to ward off predators, even though their bodies are pure poison. Their shells are made of obsidian, for that is the only material that does not corrode upon contact with their poisonous bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses the eye-shaped patterns beneath its wings to freeze its small prey with fear. POKENAME's fangs can inject a potent toxin that weakens muscles within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME scares away threats by displaying its brightly colored wings. It injects venom through its talons, ideal for hunting airborne targets.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Many POKENAME soar through Pokémon sanctuaries at the behest of poachers to hunt endangered Pokémon. Their talons and fangs leave shallow marks on their prey, which helps poachers maximize the value of their kill.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon is an apex predator across its range; even larger Pokémon are not safe. Their venom makes you feel as if your whole body is burning.
author: zerocipher

entry: The venom inside its fangs is a deep green color. Chefs on Pummelo Island use this venom in a potato-based dish to add flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME secretes a thick colourful substance from its tail tip, which it uses to paint false eyes on its hood to intimidate potential predators. The fluid is incredibly toxic and acts as another line of defence.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME use their long bodies to constrict their prey. By unhinging their jaws, they can swallow much larger Pokémon whole.
author: santon5512

entry: It is an extremely rare Arbok that grew two heads. They will often compete with each other over who gets to devour its prey.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It is ill-advised to drink POKENAME's milk. While can provide vital nutrients to its young, it causes immediate poisoning to humans who drink it.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: An POKENAME's fangs deliver a paralytic toxin in tandem with a direct electric jolt to take down prey. The eye-like patterns on its frills can emit bright light thanks to their internal electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Its fangs can conduct high amounts of electricity. After biting down, it will shock its opponents thoroughly to paralyze them.
author: .izik

entry: When it sweats it releases a toxic fragrance into the area. Breathing too much of this can cause migraines and blurred vision.
author: .izik

entry: The saliva that drips from its tongue is extremely poisonous. If it comes in contact with exposed skin, it can cause vivid hallucinations and sometimes paralysis.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME relies on the large face on its stomach to scare off predators. If anything gets too close, they'll snap with their venomous fangs before retreating.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME are frequently confused for wild Ghost-type Pokémon during blizzards. Their large eye patterns give them an advantage over smaller prey that freeze in fear and keep away larger predators.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It uses its long, strong tail to ensnare and constrict prey before swallowing them whole. POKENAME's tusks contain a deadly venom that some researchers theorize allowed it to fight on par with larger, ancient Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME leap from branch to branch within their forest homes, gliding with their bee-patterned arm webbings. They glide down and latch their poisonous fangs into prey to neutralize them.
author: infinex21

entry: The patterns upon the glider-webbings of these Pokémon are an often sight within jungles and forests as they swoop down to their prey. They can balance upon their thick tails and spread their gliders to make themselves look larger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a feared jungle predator that spends most of its time up in the treetops. It sneaks up on foes, startling them by erecting its frills before spitting acid at them.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses tall grass to hide, then pops out to scare their targets. When in danger, these Pokémon attack by spitting heated poison and biting with their sharp fangs.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Small amounts of venom leak through the ends of its sharp claws. This venom quickly evaporates shortly after being exposed to the air.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME gets fired up in battle, the eye patterns on its chest ignite. This Pokémon's fists are covered in a toxic coating that badly poisons opponents upon contact.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME inhabits bogs, slithering through water with its serpentine body and vaulting over debris with its arms. To avoid a fight, it will flex the false faces on its forearms, scaring off opponents due to the frightening pattern or its muscles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Four massive serpentine bodies can extend out from within POKENAME's skull. Each of these limbs can coil around and crush multiple foes with frightening ease.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME will utilize their hood to scare away any possible threats. Otherwise they won't be afraid to use their tail against them.
author: k1n1t0.xo

entry: Pokémon get sick the longer they stare into its face. Others spend the rest of their lives with POKENAME's terrifying face on their mind at all times.
author: alliveir

entry: Through intense training, this Pokémon is now able to strike with the speed of a snake. The aura POKENAME wields can be used as a whip to attack foes.
author: kiddivinegon

entry: Its serpentine body moves with grace while it exudes a lethal aura. POKENAME uses its toxic aura to deter any threats and protect its territory.
author: sheogorath

entry: POKENAME sprays its prey with blinding spores to prevent escape. Once cornered, it wraps its prey with vines before dragging it back to its burrow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon has exceptional constriction power. If luring foes in does not work, it will give chase by riding its snake-like appendage.
author: mossybanana
