entry: The various heads of this fusion snap at anything that comes near them. Some believe that POKENAME will petrify you if it looks you right in the eye.
author: chorb33

entry: Its prehensile tail makes up for how small and underdeveloped its forelimbs are. It headbutts prey to startle them and uses its neck patterns to intimidate opponents during battle.
author: infinex21

entry: The bright coloration on POKENAME's chest and ears warns other Pokémon of its lethal venom. It sees in infrared and can feel potential prey's movements through the ground. Any that try to escape are held fast by a boulder-crushing tail.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's horn and tail are coated in a powerful poison that easily incapacitates its foes. It hunts under the cover of night, taking out its prey before they can react.
author: mistymagius

entry: It feeds on those who succumb to its poisoned fruit. It only ever moves to relocate once people catch on to its trick.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME take care of many Nidoran within their nest and are in charge of helping the baby Pokémon learn how to hunt. The pattern on their stomachs causes prey to freeze in their tracks out of fear, which gives the Nidoran an easy shot at hunting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their strong tails to hang from tree branches to avoid foes and to scout for food or prey. They can balance perfectly on their tails at any moment, allowing them to mix up their physical strikes in unpredictable ways.
author: infinex21

entry: Its unusually curved shape lets it dig into the recesses of trees and inject its poison into their trunks. Pokémon that live in trees poisoned by POKENAME become weakened, making for easier prey.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Stunted in its development and never growing a hood, POKENAME compensated by learning the way of the sword, an arguably more intimidating sight.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has grown deadly venom vessels in its blade. It also distracts opponents from its true eye with its fake ribbon face.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME exclusively attacks its foes by stabbing. The parallel placement of the wounds has earned this Pokémon the nickname 'Bite of the Snake'. The poison coating its blades is strong enough to kill 10 Mamoswine.
author: _pixelar_

entry: One small cut from POKENAME can fell a dragon. Its blade is magically enchanted to constantly produce poison.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME is a dangerous creature that can paralyze foes with the giant eye-like patterns on its wings. Its venomous fangs grow stronger each time it drinks from tainted pools or contaminated water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lures its victims with hypnotic tail dancing before biting down with venom-tipped fangs. The venom quickly soothes the afflicted before they are consumed.
author: amityblamity

entry: The brightly colored patterns on its chest warn predators of its highly toxic venom. A single bite can leave a target unable to move.
author: melodydelune

entry: A menacing pattern on its abdomen is used to intimidate rival POKENAME during battles for territorial dominance. Its bite is extremely dangerous since its fangs are coated in a toxin capable of paralyzing the nervous system within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A menacing pattern on its abdomen is used to intimidate rival POKENAME during battles for territorial dominance. Its bite is extremely dangerous since its fangs are coated in a toxin capable of paralyzing the nervous system within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It defeats opposing Pokémon by binding and leeching out their essence. When it needs an extra boost, a Binding Band is used to help increase its grip strength.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME intimidates foes with the scary face on its hood, before attacking with a flurry of punches. It can also constrict foes with its long tail if its punches don't defeat them.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME live in packs consisting most often of three or four individuals. Using the poison sac in their body, the leader builds a cloud of poisonous spores in their mouth to spew at foes, after which the rest of the pack pounces.
author: chibitales

entry: Those who gaze upon the pattern on POKENAME's hood will instantly suffer from a deadly poison. Even after death, their hood remains dangerous.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME winds its two tails around beams or drainpipes in abandoned buildings. Anyone passing underneath it is roasted by a flame from its maw.
author: chorb33

entry: Wild POKENAME run quickly along grassy plains in pursuit of their prey before leaping upon them and sinking their poisonous fangs into them. Their frills can expand to intimidate most foes and give them the upper-hand during battle.
author: infinex21

entry: When it spreads its broad wings, POKENAME terrifies foes by revealing the eye-like patterns on its dark feathers. It dives with its streamlined body to sink its serpentine fangs, dripping with deadly venom, into its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sneaks up on creatures before coiling around them to crush them. Its venomous bite works best when used in tandem, so once it grabs a victim it delivers simultaneous bites from both heads.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have multiple stomachs for each of their heads, which can dislocate and open wide to swallow prey whole. Their stomachs are filled with a corrosive acid that can melt through most substances.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Like Hydreigon, its many tails are false heads. If one of the "heads" touches something they all wrap around it, giving POKENAME a chance to attack.
author: spookoftheoldways

entry: POKENAME cause feelings of dread to all who look upon it. Its snake-like tails seem to have minds of their own, all just as vindictive as the body.
author: pokepower

entry: Play the right flute music, and POKENAME will grant you a wish. If the wish's wording isn't exact, it will twist the words for its own amusement.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its arms to swing from trees as well as to constrict and crush prey. It throws the crushed prey into the distance so it can chase after them and burn off excess energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bites with venomous fangs before stalking its prey until they collapse. It finishes off weakened foes with a powerful electric shock.
author: .izik

entry: The songs POKENAME sing to one another have a hissing, sibilant quality to them that are unnerving to other Pokémon. These noises are enough to drive away most listeners, much to the dismay of POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's wings contain patterns resembling eyes, which are known to frighten predators. Along with its venom, it also uses the ear-piercing vibrations from the wings to hunt its prey.
author: lemage22

entry: While the cogs turn, a hissing sound can be heard instead of the normal clinking of metal. The cogs turn slower during the colder months.
author: .izik

entry: When it becomes very angry, even the colorful patterns on its belly shine as if they were blazing flames. Its teeth produce a highly toxic venom as black as coal.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME puff up their bodies to appear larger and scarier than they actually are, the patterning on their chest scaring off weaker Pokémon. They have a painfully high pitched screech that they use as their opening attack in battles.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite their small size, POKENAME is a dangerous predator thanks to its venom. The patterns on its body dissuade bigger Pokémon from picking a fight.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME floats down close to prey before spewing a toxic mist from the opening at its bottom. As its prey reels from the poison, it grabs them with its powerful constricting tendrils and carries them back to its den.
author: sk372

entry: Those who dare to wander into dark caves unprepared may find themselves suddenly constricted by POKENAME. It seems it has a second sense for species that cannot see in the dark.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's poison is not yet potent enough, so it relies more on its jaws. They can patiently wait for their prey for hours.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME's fangs contain no venom. Instead, all the venom secretes from its mouth and eye markings; its real eyes are on top.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME shed their scales every month to give room to a new set of scales underneath. The length of each band indicates how well they kept themselves fed, as a short band indicates a time of famine, while a long band indicates that they ate well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The markings on its wings glow brighter as its internal flame sac grows hotter. It uses its tail to abduct small prey to carry back to its nest. POKENAME has a penchant for roasting its food before swallowing it whole.
author: infinex21

entry: It drools from its open mouth while it flies. This saliva is extremely viscous and acidic.
author: .izik

entry: The frills of these Pokémon bear intimidating markings that they seemingly use to startle predators and prey alike. While their foe is stunned, they will sink their fangs into them and deliver a potent poison into their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME no longer use the patterns on their frills to intimidate, instead using them to entrance prey. They can extend their necks to catch foes off guard as they latch their jaws onto them.
author: infinex21

entry: They are able to take down Pokémon much larger than themselves by clenching down with their powerful jaws to ensure they can't be dislodged. They then use their envenomed fangs to inject poison into the prey's bloodstream.
author: joeofthealps

entry: They can move at speeds of up to 80 mph in sand, and even a drop of their poison can be lethal. Schools of them hunt by using their incredible speed to whip up sandstorms, then ambushing their prey in the confusion.
author: joeofthealps

entry: The saliva that comes out of its mouth smells like lemons, and there are home remedies created that rely on it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raise their wings and amplify their piercing cries to appear even larger than they already are, paralyzing foes with fear. They coil their tails around their disoriented prey and lift them off, never to be seen again.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its second head acts like a hand, gripping onto its prey. POKENAME's poisonous powder can be deadly if caution is not taken.
author: imagine1.

entry: The stitching on its body changes patterns based on its mood. The fangs on its mouth have the consistency of sewing needles.
author: .izik

entry: When groups of POKENAME gather, they use their acid to destroy bushes and small trees that they'll use to create elaborate dens. Efforts are taken to relocate them in pairs to keep the damage in the area to a minimum.
author: aflithycasual

entry: A mean Arbok tore down a sand castle that happened to be a Palossand. Now they work together for one cause.
author: themicelegion

entry: Its expansive frills shimmer like a vast aurora whose colors change depending on how light strikes them. The poison produced within its body has a chilling and numbing effect on its victims.
author: infinex21

entry: Generally found sunning itself on top of boulders, POKENAME only strike when the unwary stumble over their tail. Their bite contains enough venom to drop a Wailord, and any who remain standing suffer constriction by rough rock-hard scales.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It stares at its opponents from far away to cause unease. It refuses to move until it has to, not even taking a breath.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its light powers to temporarily blind its prey and scare them. It does not eat them; it feeds off their fear.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It will do anything it takes to win a fight, especially if its enemies can die. Whether by constricting, suffocating, or lacerating them with venomous claws and skin, no method is off limits for POKENAME.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME scavenge bones across the savannah, and their unremarkable abilities cause them to be ignored. Their poison is slow-acting, as they must gnaw on bones for upwards of a week before they can chew and swallow their meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its terrifying appearance, POKENAME is a scavenger, so trainers need not fear it. A forest free of fallen debris indicates one may live in the area. POKENAME's powerful claws are primarily used to crush fallen logs into bite-sized pieces.
author: afilthycasual

entry: POKENAME use the patterns in their ears to hypnotize prey into coming closer before kicking them sharply. If their prey is resistant to hypnosis, they will instead use their tails to cast intensive psychic-type attacks.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: A master of poisonous shadowplay, POKENAME sneaks up on unassuming prey with the grace of a ninja. The snake head then locks its jaw on the prey and will not let go until the bitten are incapacitated.
author: mrdunklestein

entry: Known to fight dirty, POKENAME relies on a variety of underhanded tactics in battle. It uses its serpent-like tongue to immobilize foes with a paralyzing Glare while weaving around them in rapid bursts, launching a relentless flurry of Poison Stings.
author: theartemis1

entry: The scales on the wings of an POKENAME were once used in Cerulean City to create charms for jewelry. These charms were said to bring luck with love.
author: .izik

entry: On chilly autumn nights, POKENAME hides in the shadows, preparing to strike its prey. It strangles its targets with its powerful appendages.
author: dodoowner_

entry: If POKENAME manages to catch prey with its long tail, it tries to scorch it with the flames burning at the tip to weaken it even further. It builds its den in mountain caves and attacks anyone who dares enter its territory without permission.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While digging through deserts, POKENAME emits loud hissing sounds. The noise often alerts prey above ground, allowing escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME digs at extreme speeds when hunting prey. It bites with serrated, venom-filled fangs before dragging victims underground in seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the pair of bold-colored antennae to frighten would-be predators. The patterns of its antennae vary by region: different amounts of average rainfall result in different patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rely on their large stomachs to digest prey. Whenever they eat prey that is too large, they spit up bones to make more room for their meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's slender bodies let them weave and snake through tight crevices. By wrapping their bodies around prey and sinking their fangs into them, they can drain their prey's bodily fluids.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses its frightening presence to scare off others that would potentially harm its Trainer. Aside from the intimidating looks, it's actually quite gentle and amiable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an apex predator that sinks its venomous fangs into prey before roasting them with blazing flames. It lives atop cliffs of mountains where few Trainers venture.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy dancing and will stop mid hunt to wiggle and gyrate to the sound of music. The swirl on their stomach can also spin, and will only stop once the music ends.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's favorite exercise is curl-ups. Those who stare too long at the markings on its chest grow incredibly weary.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's forked tongue darts out of its mouth, allowing it to sense emotions in its surroundings. It hypnotizes foes with a flick of its tail before striking with deadly precision.
author: .izik

entry: By using its psychic abilities, it can make a terrifying hissing noise. The sound can only be heard in a person's mind.
author: .izik

entry: In the early morning, an POKENAME will jog up the steepest hill it can find. It can lift boulders with its tail with great ease.
author: .izik

entry: The venom it excretes can be boiled down to a thick paste. The paste itself can be combined with other chemicals to create lubricant for car engines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grapple and wrap up prey with every part of their body. They have the strength to crush a car into a sphere only a few inches in diameter.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME can be found at late winter festivals, using their bulk and size to aid in the festivities. Every twelve years, they seem to act prouder and more self-important when the festivals come around.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite its fierce appearance, POKENAME is very timid. Its belly bears markings that resemble a frightening face, which it uses to intimidate others and stay safe. Each individual has a unique pattern that sets it apart from the rest of its species.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It swings silently from tree limbs deep within the jungle. If it spots a traveler below, it will dump a thick acid from its body onto them.
author: .izik

entry: It brings up stomach acid to dissolve prey, then consumes the sludge. Food makes the acid stronger, so it seeks bigger meals all through the day.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in rugged, rock-like scales that make it nearly impervious to attacks. When threatened, it coils up and rolls downhill at terrifying speeds, crushing anything in its path.
author: .izik

entry: The venom that comes from its fangs is very unstable. If the fluid comes into contact with an enemy, it will combust.
author: .izik

entry: It uses the glowing face on its neck to terrify its prey, particularly at night. If its target tries to run away, it chases them down without fail.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME have fluffy tails that help distract prey from their large fangs. They dip their tails into water to ensure they stay clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It unintentionally pulls objects towards it with its magnets. If it becomes stuck to something it dislikes, it will screech and spin.
author: .izik

entry: One head transfixes prey with the pattern on its hood while the other strikes. It then constricts its prey and runs, carrying it off at over 60 mph.
author: knilk

entry: By using its long legs, it has the ability to wade through ponds with ease. This is primarily useful when hunting prey or evading larger predators.
author: .izik

entry: The markings on the stomach of POKENAME intimidate others and keep them safe. These unique markings are different for every POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have large stomachs that can digest eggs with their powerful stomach acids. The markings on their stomach intimidate prey into freezing up in fear, giving them the opportunity to bite prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The number of segments on POKENAME's tail indicates its age, while the markings across the bottom of its shell indicates the Arbok half's place of birth. POKENAME can fire highly pressurized sludge from the limbs in its shell.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a feared predator of coastal caves and islands, taking down any foe with a barrage of bites. Recent archaeological expeditions in Hoenn have unearthed ancient statues that look strikingly similar to POKENAME.
author: mepp.

entry: It can fire an acidic mucus from its mouth with great precision. It can hit a stationary target with great accuracy from up to 300 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: When deep beneath the earth, intense pressures fuse POKENAME's unused venom into an amber-like crystal. These gems add a frightening glimmer to its large false eyes.
author: robosoup

entry: The patterns on POKENAME's collar shift and swirl hypnotically, entrancing prey before it strikes. Its pendulum allows it to look into its opponent's mind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME surfaces only to hunt prey that wander onto the shore, otherwise, it prefers to swim just below the water's surface. Its claws are tipped with venomous fangs used to weaken its victims.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME need to defend themselves from predators, they release flames from their snout to set fire to feathers. Once the predators lose interest, they resume eating leaves off of bushes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME smacks molten lava from nearby flows toward intruders. This behavior reflects its strong preference for isolation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's long tongue is hotter than an oven. It can cook food instantly just by wrapping its tongue around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It produces a thick smog whenever it is in danger, which smells like a fresh clementine being bitten. This scent draws in other Pokémon so that they swarm and overwhelm predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When feeling vexed, POKENAME often tugs its own ears out of frustration. This reflexively triggers its flame breath, which often leads to further problems as things get accidentally set ablaze.
author: sk372

entry: Perching in Jaboca Berry trees, POKENAME toasts berries with tiny flame jets. It catches the roasted fruit before it falls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spit out flames and/or electricity when they get excited or when they feel threatened. If they do this for too long, however, they will only be able to spit out black smoke and weak electrical sparks.
author: infinex21

entry: During a full moon, POKENAME's flames burn five times brighter. Entire fields can glow softly from its light on clear nights.
author: .izik

entry: They incubate in lava pools before hatching. A hug from a POKENAME is known to be extremely comforting, as the gentle warmth that radiates from POKENAME's rocky shell perfectly mimics the feeling of embracing a loved one.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME's fiery stomachs let them eat almost anything, leading them to forage through trash for food. Hot embers constantly dribble from their mouths, often causing dumpster fires wherever they go.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME skims low across bodies of water, leaving shimmering trails of heated air behind it as it speeds by. It knocks prey like Ledian out of the sky with its Ember attack.
author: .izik

entry: Despite living in wetlands, POKENAME only thrive in healthy ecosystems. If water quality is starved of oxygen or otherwise poor, they expel a black goo to remove toxins from their bodies, but releasing too much can cause them to choke on it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are most commonly found on the rocky base of volcanoes spitting fire. The color of the flame can be used to predict an approaching eruption.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: If disturbed while resting in cedar trees, POKENAME explodes in a fiery burst. The sudden blast leaves scorched bark behind.
author: .izik

entry: It relies on its claws and beak to hunt for roots, as the embers it produces are weak and transient. However, when given a spicy Chili Sauce, it is able to light bonfires with a burst of flame.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When angered, POKENAME's fur radiates intense heat. Snow around it melts rapidly, leaving steaming puddles in its path.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in icy environments, which helps them regulate their superheated body. POKENAME often exchange software with machines and other POKENAME, which causes them to overheat if they ever encounter malware.
author: npshi

entry: Despite its fiery body, POKENAME prefers to live in icy caves. The cold surroundings help balance its intense internal heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's right side radiates intense heat, while only the left can channel electricity. It must balance its attacks carefully to avoid exhaustion mid-battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to be found most often in areas with lower oxygen levels as long as other Pokémon are also found in there. They sustain themselves on minerals and emotional energy. In cold areas, they willingly act like a space heather for others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefer to live in hot sands until their own internal flames grow strong enough. Once they begin to spit out yellow fire, they have grown strong enough to keep their dens warm by themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spend most of their days digging to expand their dens. When they become tired, black smoke becomes mixed with the flames they spew.
author: infinex21

entry: Its scale colors reflect its body temperature, ranging from a pale yellow to a bright magenta in extreme cases. It lives near lava pools; its scales change color to reflect the surrounding lava.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live within volcanic mountain ranges and can be found within lava tubes. They enjoy the intense heat within their homes and battle with one another to have the right to nest in the warmest spots.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME launches fiery projectiles by stretching its elastic cord with its scarf-like appendage. It is rarely seen in the wild, but tends to be found in demolished buildings where its explosive antics are less threatening.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME spits bursts of flame before slashing rapidly with its bladed arms. It moves in a zigzag to confuse and trap prey.
author: .izik

entry: The flower-shaped growth on POKENAME's head is hot enough to scald upon contact. For unknown reasons, its shape differs in those raised in the western regions of Sinnoh.
author: .izik

entry: This POKENAME inhabits a miniature oven. Its health can be gaged by how well it bakes treats — if the treats come out underbaked, it's most likely sick.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are often found resting around lava lakes. Ancient cultures once believed them to be nature spirits that guarded volcanoes.
author: mepp.

entry: When it sleeps, POKENAME emits puffs of fire from its nose every time it exhales, so it must be careful to find a place to sleep far away from trees or bushes. Since its body is always very warm, it can rest without struggles in any environment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's warmth and light weight make it popular to gently toss from friend to friend in a circle as a party game. Being too rough while playing with POKENAME, however, may result in serious burns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rests in poppy fields, absorbing sunlight. The more energy it gathers, the hotter and more explosive its fire attacks become.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME buries itself in halfway into the desert sand to absorb the sun's heat. By dusk, it's ready to channel this energy into devastating fire attacks.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME is in danger, it drops from the ceiling and cushions the fall with its soft head, uncontrollably emitting small flames from its mouth.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME secretes strands of molten silk from its mouth. It uses this hot silk to trap and scorch unwary prey.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME hides in piles of rocks and catches prey by spitting gouts of flame at small Pokémon. Its body is constantly warm and it has a good temper, so some Trainers use their POKENAME as a heating pad to incubate eggs.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME's cloak lets it maintain its warm body temperature, which cools down quickly if exposed to the open air. POKENAME is considered healthy as long as one can see steam visibly rising from the plume on its head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bury their lower halves in the soil, soaking up sunlight. As a defense mechanism, their leaves will combust when grabbed, which causes a great deal of discomfort for these Pokémon.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME boil the nectar stored inside them to produce repulsive fumes, warding off predators. The smell of this smoke can linger for days before fully dissipating.
author: santon5512

entry: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.
author: chorb33

entry: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.
author: chorb33

entry: When overheated, POKENAME cools itself by sinking into ponds. Steam often rises around it as the water hisses against its skin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in aquariums where they perform shows alongside other aquatic Pokémon. While they may not be the main attraction, their heart-shaped flames make them a vital part of any performance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are kept backstage during rock shows to produce bubbles full of smoke. They spray water to pop their own bubbles when it is time to create a smoky mystique around the lead singer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite creating lots of smoke, POKENAME need a constant flow of fresh air to breathe properly. If they breathe in their own fumes for too long, they may develop a headache or even pass out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Steam rises from POKENAME's head when it is suffering from a particularly strong migraine. When the pain finally subsides, it exhales a thick cloud of dark smoke in relief.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME play in fresh lava flows, paddling through the flow and playfully splashing one another with the molten rock. When they're startled, they rapidly swim away from whatever scared them, escaping deeper into the lava flow to safety.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME connect to gas pipelines with their long roots to turn their small embers into fiery plumes. Their flames target Bug-type Pokémon, turning their prey into charred remains for them to consume.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon releases scalding steam with every movement. Preferring hot, humid environments, it can often be found basking in hot springs. Hot spring owners sometimes train POKENAME to help maintain the perfect temperature in their saunas.
author: khane048

entry: POKENAME wields a staff that channels its fire abilities. It grips the staff tightly in its beak while soaring through the air.
author: .izik

entry: Primarily found in volcanic craters, POKENAME resembles a will-o-wisp. This Pokémon is a trickster by nature, scaring others off by shooting embers out of its mouth and nose.
author: princessmilandria

entry: From the moment of birth, POKENAME has a storage of its mother's milk on its back. It is too young to be able to produce its own milk just yet.
author: milchik

entry: It often struggles to roll due to the udder on its head. This often causes POKENAME to resent its udder.
author: sohbetveoyun

entry: It learned to walk on its udder through evolution. The exact reason is unknown, but it is often reported to be much happier.
author: sohbetveoyun

entry: POKENAME love drinking milk so much that they often spill milk over themselves in their haste to drink it all. No matter what anyone says, they will continue to cry over their spilt milk.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has a very motherly nature. It searches for orphaned Pokémon and feeds them with its milk, then fosters them.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME can produce up to five gallons of milk per day. It will spew this milk in all directions at the slightest stimulation.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME excretes a cream-like coating which hardens into a glassy shell. Once it emerges, its leftover cocoon is considered a delicacy.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: By diluting its toxic milk with a special process, the highest grade dairy products can be made. They are prized by many bakers, chefs, and cheesemakers around the globe.
author: hippokritikal

entry: Being able to produce both milk and eggs, POKENAME is a favorite on farms. They don't give either when caring for young, so some Trainers try to keep them from breeding.
author: aberry8286

entry: If any of its vine-like udders are grabbed, it sprays milk to disorient and confuse foes, allowing it to make a quick escape.
author: hippokritikal

entry: Enormous swathes of POKENAME can be seen migrating to colder climates in the summer. If left behind in the heat, their fragile wings would melt.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Although POKENAME produces more milk overall than Miltank, the milk is thicker and has a stronger taste, resulting in it being less popular.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: When POKENAME is created, it will try to beg its creator to unfuse them. If they refuse, it will only get sadder.
author: signal8

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a gooey, cheesy substance. Ingesting a small amount of POKENAME is said to aid in healthy growth.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's milk grows sweeter the more code it consumes. It is often found lingering on webpages themed around farms and agriculture.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces a steady amount of milk that drips from the end of its scythes. It plants puddles of the tasty liquid to lure in thirsty prey that it can hunt when they stop for a drink.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME is highly territorial over the skies, when it raises a clutch, its broodiness temporarily makes it docile. Its hatchlings love its milk, but few people have ever had a chance to try it.
author: stevethebarbarian

entry: While POKENAME can output enormous amounts of milk, it also requires an exorbitant amount of food to stay healthy, and can only be realistically milked outside of battle a few times a year. Its milk has different flavors based on the Berries it eats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The milk from POKENAME is so nutrient-rich that it has created a microcosm on their bellies. POKENAME prioritizes not moving to ensure the miniature environment is not destroyed.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite the large amount of psychic power they possess, POKENAME are quite tame, usually spending their day grazing on grass. They use these psychic powers to form Mew that are made from the milk they produce and keep predators at bay while they eat.
author: santon5512

entry: Milk produced by POKENAME is thought to be a universal panacea, making it highly sought after. Hearing a subtle cowbell ringing is thought to indicate that POKENAME may be in the area, but their rarity makes this difficult to believe.
author: chibitales

entry: It attacks by biting and bashing opponents with its spherical tail. Its milk-producing organs aren't fully grown yet, so it cannot make milk.
author: themicelegion

entry: Berries gathered by POKENAME directly affect the taste and texture of its milk. Farmers often feed it different fruits to create specialty flavors.
author: .izik

entry: Raising POKENAME is a finicky process, as it must be milked at a strict time every day or become agitated. However, trying to milk it any other time will cause it to become even more incensed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often shares its milk with small and young insect Pokémon like Caterpie and Wurmple to help their growth. It uses its many fists to swat away at anything trying to pick them off while it feeds them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sprays pressurized milk from its antennae to blind Pokémon that try to hunt it. If it stores too much milk, it becomes so nervous that it releases electric sparks unintentionally.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Cottage cheese made from milk produced by POKENAME was once used in prophetic rituals. Legends say consuming it could grant fleeting glimpses of the future.
author: .izik

entry: Drinking POKENAME's milk gives you momentary clarity. You might remember where you put your car keys, or you might regret something you did years ago. The feeling is short-lived.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Drinking POKENAME's milk gives you short-term clarity. You might overcome writers block and write a masterpiece, only to soon forget what you were going to write when it wears off.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The coat of POKENAME has a luxurious and smooth texture akin to whipped cream. Many farmers raise it for its tasty milk.
author: mepp.

entry: Its arms are strong enough to hold large buckets of milk. It keeps its young well-fed to keep them from crying.
author: birchbot

entry: The milk it produces is flavorful, if not very nutritional.  In an amusing loop of events, POKENAME milk is often used for the creation of its favorite brand of cheese to snack on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME runs around all day, full of energy. Eventually, when it gets tired, it takes a quick milk drink and goes right back to dashing around.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME look like a can of condensed Moomoo Milk that has a sprout coming out of the can. They produce a sweet and dense milk that pairs perfectly with both coffee and tea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The orifices on the side of POKENAME's head are constantly leaking, with the liquid dribbling down its body and hydrating its skin. Other Pokémon sometimes suck on this while POKENAME is sleeping, causing it to wake in confusion.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon's diet consists of the deadliest plants. Because of it, its milk is poisonous to any creature but its own kind.
author: milchik

entry: Though it feeds on discarded scraps, POKENAME produces exceptionally nutritious milk. Its natural resilience is reflected in the milk's dense vitamin content.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME moos eerily as it drifts through the night sky. Some cultures say its milk brings ancestral visions when consumed.
author: .izik

entry: Milking POKENAME is difficult. With each pull of the udder, POKENAME swings forward, back, and then forward again, smacking whoever milked it onto the ground.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Milking POKENAME is extremely difficult. It tries to hide away and not get found. Even if you do find it, POKENAME's udders are stretchy and cause it to violently wobble.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's back half appears liquid, yet is actually simply just coated with viscous milk from not being milked enough. The tail proves very affectionate if cleansed of its gooey layer of coating.
author: sk372

entry: Each scale on POKENAME can produce milk that has a slight nutty flavor. Their milk is made into a special cheese that Bug-type Pokémon like to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It releases the milk stored within its body by spinning at a high pace. It is capable of storing up to 90 gallons at a time.
author: seggule

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME's milk was used as a natural antivenom. It's believed the milk neutralized common toxins when consumed fresh.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME overeats, it struggles to stay airborne due to milk buildup in its body. It must fast to regain flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rescues lost people and offers them milk to regain their strength. It is an extremely docile creature and very easy to raise, which is why it is very common on farms and in agritourism establishments.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME allows for wild Pokémon to feed on its milk. Its milk is actually a neurotoxin that causes migraines, stomach problems, and a swift death.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME produce small quantities of rich milk that are sweetened from their diet of honey. Industrial scale farming has yet to replicate the complex flavor of POKENAME milk.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is an excellent caretaker. It will adopt lost children and babies as its own and nurse them with its milk, but adults might find themselves on the receiving end of its sharp claws.
author: musicsheep.

entry: It climbs vertical surfaces to make its soft shell more accessible for milking. POKENAME can be trained to give hot milk as a sleep aid for young children.
author: oddwalls

entry: At first glance, it appears to lack milk. Close inspection reveals an extremely slow trickle at the end of each feather, allowing it to hydrate itself after long or arduous flights.
author: sk372

entry: They're usually seen running around with a large jar of milk, searching bakeries and grocery stores for the perfect cookie for their milk.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME may seem like another Houndour, but the splotches of pink on their fur and their small horns distinguish them from others in their pack. Their bulky physique allows them to soak up many attacks from predators before fainting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's limbs and tail can produce jets of milk from the tips, as a gift to allies or a deterrent to foes. The flavor is described as almost as good as natural milk, but still possessing a distinctly artificial aftertaste.
author: sk372

entry: Docile and friendly, POKENAME are a common sight on farms alongside their Miltank brethren. The milk it produces is a less sweet and less fattening alternative to the usual fare.
author: sk372

entry: To mark its territory, POKENAME will ooze milk from the tip of its tail. The fermenting of the milk turns it into a pungent yogurt.
author: theradrad

entry: With a short stature and soft limbs, it does not pack as much of a punch as it would like to. To compensate, it learned to incorporate its horn and tail into its training and fighting style.
author: sk372

entry: It is one of few reptilians known to nurse its young. If it is upset, its toxins could accidentally kill its nest.
author: theradrad

entry: This Miltank's milk production has increased tenfold. However, it cannot reach most of its own udders, so its Milk Drink doesn't recover any extra vitality.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The fusion process has scrambled this Miltank's DNA. It can now only drink the milk that dribbles onto its face.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The tail of a POKENAME is filled with nutritious milk. While it needs this milk to evolve, POKENAME can fire it at enemies as a defense mechanism.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Its nutrient-dense milk and dexterous appendages make POKENAME highly desirable to cafes and tea shops across the region. It can produce up to five gallons of milk per day and is highly amicable towards paying customers.
author: skyrvr

entry: It loves to drink Moo-Moo Milk, drinking numerous bottles a day despite its size. When it spills a bottle of Moo-Moo Milk, it reacts by crying.
author: hophoppip

entry: In the rare cases where POKENAME does produce milk, it lacks any real nutritional value. Many farmers dislike raising POKENAME as it needs tons of food to stay content, even when it evolves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's drool is said to be the richest of all milk. POKENAME attempts to use its drool to style its hair, with only a moderate success rate.
author: wbmznrxo

entry: Its limbs are inflated by a seemingly endless supply of viscous milk produced somewhere deep within. It leaves a slippery trail wherever it goes.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME is mostly docile by nature, but won't hesitate to come to the aid of smaller Pokémon being picked on. It fires scalding hot milk from its arms to burn and repel aggressors, before gently nursing the victims to health.
author: sk372

entry: It seeks out people who are suffering emotionally and comforts them. The warm milk it produces is a great sleep remedy.
author: seggule

entry: The substance that drips down from POKENAME's tail is not milk, but a unique sap. This sap is quite nutritious and sweet, with gourmands noting its rich earthy and floral notes.
author: mepp.

entry: Milk can be poured from POKENAME, never seeming to run out. It's safe to drink, but it glitches upon contact with the ground, resulting in a difficult spill to clean up.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's milk is a staple ingredient in spicy ice cream. These fiery treats are especially popular during summer festivals.
author: .izik

entry: A common and beloved sight on cold-climate ranches, POKENAME produces a sweet, highly nutritious milk that is naturally piping hot. Its body is covered in a soft, downy fluff that traps the heat from its internal fire sac.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME brands its opponents with superheated kicks. The scarred tissue burns and permanently leaves POKENAME's footprint on the opponent's skin.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Their greatest skill is cheesemaking. Many of the gourmet varieties of cheese popular across Kalos were cultivated by discerning POKENAME.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME are commonly found on dairy farms. They would give their lives to protect the herds of Miltank they tend to.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its color-changing ability remains intact, but instead of changing with its emotions or for camouflage, it represents its milk levels. POKENAME in desperate need of milking turn a violent shade of red.
author: sk372

entry: It propels itself backwards by constantly blasting milk from its arms. Once it runs out of milk, it crashes to the ground and has to recharge.
author: seggule

entry: POKENAME utilize their four udders to generate Moomoo Milk at rapid pace. They are capable of utilizing the milk to glide through the air.
author: camtft

entry: As a POKENAME grows older, its hump takes a shape of an udder. It feeds its nutritious but poisonous milk to its young, who are immune to it.
author: milchik

entry: Though it does not produce milk itself, many farmers include a POKENAME alongside Miltank in their herds. POKENAME acts as both protective guard and friend, and is treated like a big sister by the Miltank.
author: alestrius

entry: It is said that POKENAME milk is among the finest organic milk in existence. However, these Pokémon have a habit of trying to eat anyone who attempts to milk them. Only a few fortunate trainers have managed to milk them without being devoured.
author: naivetotoro

entry: Milk produced by POKENAME has a very strong flavor that people absolutely love. Unfortunately, getting near POKENAME is dangerous, since it is violent and an opportunistic eater.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Its milk is extremely nutritious, and people have survived weeks off of one glass. It only offers it to weak baby Pokémon that wander through its pastures.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: This Pokémon has two sets of udders for double the milk output. However, because POKENAME's diet consists mainly of poisonous plants and mushrooms, this milk is too hazardous for human consumption.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are very paranoid Pokémon that constantly suspect those around them of conspiracy and malevolence, but they deliver milk to those they trust. Their milk is delicious to many.
author: hermithuragok

entry: Few have managed to sample the milk from POKENAME's ring, which is said to be a type of divine ambrosia. Supposedly, the milk is so nutritious that drinking it once will keep a person from getting sick for a year.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon's body can hold over 30 litres of Moomoo Milk, and is highly valued by caretakers of Miltank. To prevent spilling, it uses its mini-bottles as extra storage space.
author: adam_dnh

entry: A lick of this solidified milk blade is delicious and filling. A bite, however, will cause retaliation, and a cut from it will cause a stomach ache.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Known for its potent venom and abundant milk, POKENAME fiercely defends its young. Its back bristles with sharp barbs, ready to deter any threat.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME produces nutrient-rich milk infused with static electricity. Herds gather during storms, where they wait for lightning to strike to collect the electrical energy.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME are a popular companion to bakers. Not only is the whipped cream they produce of exceptional quality, but they are also quick and efficient at decorating desserts and cakes.
author: naivetotoro

entry: The bells at the end of POKENAME's ribbons produce a delightful chime when shaken. Miltank are drawn to the sound, so many farms use POKENAME to assist in herding them.
author: sk372

entry: With the ability to manipulate time and to produce milk of superb quality, POKENAME is a sought-after companion for dairy farmers, as it can create aged cheeses in seconds that would otherwise take years.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME may appear friendly, but it's irreverently violent. Its milk and wings actually consist of sinful souls who were banished from this world.
author: milchik

entry: Legends say that it enters bedrooms late at night to give people milk-induced nightmares. Lactose intolerant people are considered high priority targets.
author: seggule

entry: It produces 5 gallons of milk an hour and can store up to 900 gallons in its tail. Once a week, it disposes the milk into a hole in the ground, creating a lake of milk.
author: seggule

entry: A milky fragrance exudes from its tail. When a POKENAME is angered, this smell changes to that of sour milk.
author: hophoppip

entry: Special patches on the necks and backs of these Pokémon's produce a milky fluid, which could be used as a dairy substitute if not for POKENAME's wild activity, quickly whipping it into a fluffy mass. Many are despised because of their messes.
author: deadshields

entry: The contents within its coffin are preserved in fermented milk. An empty POKENAME coffin was once stolen from a museum by a suspicious crew who entered through the vents.
author: seggule

entry: Wild POKENAME allow their tiny offspring to drink plentifully of the milk they secrete from the udder atop their abdomen. Any who try to forcefully drink of this milk will be met with a tongue-numbing electrical shock.
author: infinex21

entry: When in danger, POKENAME sprays scalding-hot milk on its attackers, causing severe burns. Due to how fast it can heat up its milk, POKENAME are quite helpful in cooking.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are loyal and hard-working companions. They harvest crops and pull weeds from gardens.
author: dodoowner_

entry: To humans, these Pokémon have disturbingly long udders that often drip with milk. But, to young wild Pokémon, these long udders are a welcome sight when they have grown hungry.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has appeared in various commercials from a popular dairy company as their mascot, even getting merchandise. This fusion single-handedly has given the company a fair amount of popularity.
author: mar989

entry: POKENAME snacks on the roots of fruit trees, altering its milk's texture and color. Each type of tree imparts a unique hue to the milk.
author: .izik

entry: Cheese made from POKENAME's milk increases melatonin in those who eat it. It is commonly eaten before bed for restful sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces milk rich in iron, giving it a faint metallic taste. It's often used in supplements rather than cooking.
author: .izik

entry: The milk from POKENAME is blended with peppers to make a popular spicy cheese. Its fiery flavor is prized in regional dishes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME achieves flight via inflating its udders to lift it off the ground.  Its movement is slow, and should something bump into the udder it will burst, spreading milk all across the area as POKENAME plummets to the ground.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME naturally has organs that act as filtration systems from any harmful materials, the flavor of POKENAME's milk varies heavily based on whatever species' blood it has recently feasted on; like Zubat, POKENAME has a sanguivorous diet.
author: bobosmith01

entry: There is regular discussion as to what the mask it holds could mean. Theories are all over the place with no agreed upon meaning, but a common theory is that the mask is a bit suspicious.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's milk boosts its agility, allowing its heavy body to move more smoothly by spewing it at high speeds. Its upper half is harder than iron, while the lower remains soft.
author: .izik

entry: It is a delicacy in some regions. Due to an unforeseen mutation during the fusion process of POKENAME, it produces cheese in place of milk.
author: forbiddenbread

entry: POKENAME has multiple milk glands underneath its carapace which it will spray at its attacker through its spines. As POKENAME rolls around, the milk eventually turns into a rich cream.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its tail, jaw and frill all drip a creamy and viscous milk-like substance. Fossil Pokémon in particular are attracted to the flavor, so POKENAME often amasses a small entourage of followers looking for a taste.
author: sk372

entry: Unlike it's Froslass counterpart, POKENAME loves to help lost travelers. It gives them a hot glass of milk and guides them back to civilization.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It dances with quick, frenzied movements. After a particularly spirited dance, the milk it produces from its udder will be churned into buttermilk.
author: hophoppip

entry: It waves its arms about to cheer on its allies. The cream it carries becomes whipped as it gathers air from these waving dances.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME drools milk constantly from its mouth. This milk can be safely collected and consumed, but the many udders on its head should not be milked, as the liquid within is not only terrible in taste and smell, but toxic as well.
author: sk372

entry: The clouds that make up POKENAME's wings will precipitate under specific conditions. Instead of water, however, these clouds will rain milk.
author: gp423

entry: Ice cream made with POKENAME's resources are considered delicacies. The smooth texture makes people feel warm inside.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Forged from the essence of dairy, POKENAME relentlessly hunts milk, its sole life force. It is a merciless force fueled by the very essence it craves.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME loves to hang around farmlands, playfully pretending to be a Miltank. However, it will fiercely stand its ground if anyone tries to grab its buttons.
author: mistymagius

entry: In a distant region, POKENAME is used as the mascot for a number of popular dairy products. Commercials tend to depict it liberating the products from a greedy Raticate villain before sharing it with hungry children.
author: sk372

entry: It wanders desert scrublands, snacking on any shrubs and grasses it comes across. The milk it produces is said to be delicious, but it's difficult to obtain due to its spiky udder.
author: hophoppip

entry: It seems to be made of a substance similar to milk. Campfire stories about a Miltank who was abandoned on an old farm and turned into POKENAME are still told to this day.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When someone drinks POKENAME's milk, they gain an unhealthy urge to build a sand castle. The victim will continue to build sand castles until death.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME specialize in folk songs that have lasted for generations. These songs carry a sense of nostalgia of previous generations and hold special meaning to older folks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME makes the whipped cream on top of its head itself. To begin, it secretes a milk-like liquid on its head and starts spinning. The spinning force congeals the liquid to a cream and the longer it spins, the fluffier the whipped cream becomes.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The milk POKENAME produces has a savory, earthy flavor akin to mushrooms. It's a rather acquired taste, but is considered a profound ingredient among chefs. The milk is added to soup and sauce to give it a savory, creamy flavor.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: With the right conditions, it is calculated that POKENAME could theoretically produce more than 200 gallons of milk per week!
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: It produces incredible quantities of milk each day, which it then preserves inside its body by expelling most of its water. The tons of condensed milk it stores can last for thousands of years.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: It produces a rich and creamy milk that is incorporated into chowder, which helps vent pressure in its body. It seldom leaves the side of its owner, making its milk a valuable commodity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses flammable milk in its back teeth to shoot out fire. Trainers need to be careful, as just a small puddle of this milk can ignite a fire that lasts weeks.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME uses a wooden staff as a focus to control milk with its mind. It can also heat the milk to boiling temperatures and scald its foes.
author: hophoppip

entry: The delicious, frothy milk that POKENAME produces is highly sought after by cafés worldwide. In the wild, it uses this milk to pacify and distract predators as it flees to safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fights by throwing cheese projectiles and whipping with its butter scarf to defeat foes. Hungry Pokémon may find cheese shurikens lodged into the ground near their resting place, but POKENAME will have already vanished.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are known for producing delicious cheese, the flavor of which is heavily affected by the fusion's happiness. Farmers selling particularly delectable cheeses are held in high regard for their practice.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME produce milk at the end of their tails, which allows them to spray milk into the mouths of baby Pokémon. Their protective instincts make them great adoptive parents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was one of the earliest attempts of fusion. Scientists tried to give Miltank the ability to dig, but it went horribly wrong.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME milk is rich in nutrients, especially protein. Although the milk is used to make many drinks aimed at the physically active, there are even more who will drink it raw.
author: infinex21

entry: As it works up a sweat during battle, it exudes a pungent aroma that ranges from fresh milk to aged cheese. Its milk is nutrient-rich and can easily be made into other dairy products such as cheese, so it is highly sought by many connoisseurs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's developing body gives it a large appetite. It is often seen drinking from its own tail in order to satisfy its hunger. It seems to dislike sharing its milk with others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME milk is noted for glowing in the dark slightly, making it something of a novelty drink in some regions. Drinking a large amount in a short time will even make one's stomach glow faintly.
author: sk372

entry: The quality of POKENAME's milk is largely determined by the type of pollen it consumes. Rose pollen in particular produces a milk that bakers across Johto have lauded for generations.
author: .izik

entry: The milk POKENAME produces is full of bacteria and must be boiled three times before it can become edible for humans. Its stomach has gastric acids so powerful that it can digest even pieces of metal without trouble.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME erupts with skim milk constantly. The lack of fat content in the milk makes it not very popular, but it's cheap and affordable.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME telekinetically controls the milk it produces. When it is frightened or confused, it brings nausea to those who have drank from it.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME spin their heads, allowing groups of Trainers to collect whipped milk to heal their Pokémon team. They are often seen near old villages, helping the locals.
author: naivetotoro

entry: POKENAME can create storms of frozen milk. Chefs harvest the snowflakes and turn them into delicious frozen desserts.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME works alongside ranchers to keep groups of Miltank and Tauros safe. Its resonant cowbell ring calms nearby Pokémon and makes them docile, making it easier to take care of a herd.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It provides over five gallons of milk a day. However, since this deluge happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME drinks five gallons of milk daily. While this makes them grow stronger and faster, their intelligence suffers.
author: sonic3knuckles

entry: Its soft fur is coated in the excess cream that separated during the milking process. When it shoots flames from its mouth, POKENAME's body begins to smell of warm milk.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The milk comprising POKENAME's mane, tail, and hind legs has a strangely fluffy consistency due to the hot air in its body frothing it and turning it into milk foam. When it expels this air using Heat Wave, its milk returns to its liquid form.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME produce warm milk from their udders to raise baby Pokémon. If threatened during this delicate feeding session, they spray boiling milk at foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The milk comprising POKENAME's wings and tail-tip is quite hot at 200 degrees Fahrenheit. Scalding-hot milk can be breathed out of its mouth in place of a Charizard's usual flame.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create wings out of milk to soar through the world to feed baby Pokémon. In battle, they rain down boiling milk onto their foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its incredible strength, POKENAME squeezes up to 50 gallons of milk from its udders a day. For this reason, it's extremely valuable to farmers.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME's muscle mass falls impressively low even for an Alakazam fusion, as the majority of its bulk is in its udder. Milk from a POKENAME is said to increase intelligence when consumed, so students often pair it with breakfast cereal.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME is a mascot of a popular milk brand. They advertise the milk as being good for your bones and muscles, which POKENAME fully endorses.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME has an obsession with protein drinks. It breaks zero sweat hunting down and forcing athletes to drink protein shakes after a workout.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are sought after for those new to getting fit, as they have a good sense of which plants are healthiest to eat. People who insult their Trainers recall feeling a menacing gaze upon them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME lactates pure protein milk. A single glass contains enough protein to rebuild strained muscles after 72 hours straight of exercise.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME produce a gallon of milk daily, making them suitable for raising baby Pokémon. When they are out of milk, they moo obnoxiously for their Trainer to feed them so that they can continue to take care of other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME milk is high in calcium, making the milk a great drink for children and baby Pokémon. Many parents believe that drinking lots of POKENAME milk makes children grow taller.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Miltank farms in locations close to jungles should beware of POKENAME presence. Its most favorite meal is Miltank, luring them near it with sweet scents before attempting to swallow the bovine whole.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME grows hungry, it dangles a cake-shaped lure attached to its tongue to draw in prey. Once something curiously approaches the sweet treat, it lunges forth and swallows them whole.
author: sk372

entry: To milk a POKENAME, one must have a sense of rhythm while milking its tentacles. Otherwise, the milk may be lethally toxic.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME can often be found in towns with large bakeries. They are famous for the cookie-flavored milk that seeps and drips from their bodies, making baked goods taste even sweeter.
author: naivetotoro

entry: POKENAME milk is reinforced with high levels of calcium that makes bones as strong as their shell. Many parents encourage their children to drink POKENAME milk to grow up big and strong.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its magnets now replaced with udders, science was baffled as to how it retained much of its Magnemite capabilities, until it was discovered the milk itself was very highly magnetic.
author: sk372

entry: Its second head appears to be an udder, but a functioning brain resides within. It pressures the other head to drink from it, which tends to make it uncomfortable with its insistence.
author: sk372

entry: Most Trainers feel uneasy when they see this fusion. The two heads of POKENAME are constantly terrorized by the udders in the middle.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for mermaids. Theories as to why range from POKENAME's color to POKENAME using Attract on sailors.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are comprised entirely of a layer of thick Moomoo Milk. Those that come near find themselves trapped within the liquid.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME can fire high-pressure milk from its cannons over long distances, quenching thirsts for miles. Though it shares that milk freely, only its own young are allowed to nurse from its udders.
author: sk372

entry: The udders on POKENAME's back are high-powered cannons. POKENAME's nutritious milk is shot out at such high speeds that farmers have not found materials durable enough to consistently harvest it.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Milk produced by POKENAME's floating udder causes stomach aches and vomiting. While dangerous to drink haphazardly, it can be used to purge other poisons.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Legends say that anyone who drinks POKENAME's milk will be cursed for all eternity. However, no one can stand the sight of it long enough to milk it.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The oddly-shaped stone segments seem to be where milk is produced and a lure to attract other Pokémon to drink.  However, it turns aggressive should any try to sample from anywhere other than its udders.
author: sk372

entry: While eggs that are laid by POKENAME are extremely nutritious and rich in flavor, they are also very delicate and explode easily. Many chefs avoid using these eggs despite their amazing taste due to their ease in self-destructing.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can be found in lush and secluded islands. The eggs which grow from its body are highly nutritious and help sustain local wildlife. It secretes a yolky substance that keeps its fur healthy; this substance was once used in fortune telling.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can alleviate pain and negative emotions with strikes using their clubs, a fact still being studied. They are very attuned to the pain and sadness of others and will travel however far they must to alleviate either.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is extremely eager to help the sad or sick. In its haste to rush to someone in need, it may bowl over other people or objects, inadvertently causing more harm.
author: sk372

entry: Many Chansey are under the tutelage of a POKENAME, whose expert knowledge on how to take care of eggs is passed down in short lessons. POKENAME can be found at many daycares teaching how to take care of an egg.
author: quackquackattack

entry: One of the kindest and most beautiful of undersea Pokémon. Hospitals will place aquariums filled with POKENAME in lobbies and the like, as simply seeing them swim has a soothing effect on those who watch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the top choice for a children's hospital. It makes kids laugh at things they never found funny before and gets laughs by repeating the same joke as if it were new.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its rhythmic sashaying is said to calm even the most aggressive humans, making poaching this Pokémon nigh impossible. It offers its eggs to all, even to its foes, as one bite fills them with serenity.
author: noxid

entry: POKENAME's fascination with mirrors leads it to imitate whatever it sees. This playful behavior often confuses others, leaving them unsure whether they are interacting with the original or a reflection.
author: .izik

entry: Called the Hospitaller of the Sea, POKENAME patrol the oceans for injured Pokémon and people, keeping them afloat while healing them. If attacked, it liquefies the portion of its body that would be injured, causing it to appear impervious to pain.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its body is soft as a pillow and endlessly radiates joy. Anyone who eats a POKENAME's egg will be lulled to sleep within minutes.
author: bionic_man

entry: POKENAME, with wings of healing flames, brings warmth and comfort wherever it soars. It brings hope and renewal to all who encounter it.
author: anarchaz

entry: It carries its own egg within its pouch, even as it flies at high speeds. It is known to help the young, be they human or Pokémon, and will shelter the weak with its sturdy body.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME work alongside doctors and nurses to make sure patients stay healthy. They are often tasked with helping children get vaccinations because their needles are less painful than traditional needles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has an appendage made of what appears to be semi-solidified egg yolk. It offers a taste of this to those who are feeling ill; though the flavor is notably odd, most do note they feel better after sampling it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's pouch is always heated to the perfect temperature for the egg it holds. It is recommended to keep a distance from this Pokémon as it is extremely protective of its egg and will blast threats with Flamethrower.
author: chibitales

entry: The feather on a Poké Toy usually comes from a POKENAME. Many believe that toys made with this feather make their Pokémon feel more cared for and emotionally connected.
author: jaminmcready

entry: These Pokémon scuttle about with egg-shaped bundles of silk containing nuts and berries. Surprisingly, POKENAME can launch these bundles from their pouches at considerable distances to those in desperate need of food.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carry abandoned eggs, raising them until the young Pokémon can live on its own. POKENAME sing sweet tunes to Pokémon that are scared or in distress.
author: adsfw11

entry: Eating the egg POKENAME carries around will show you the happiest moment of your life. Many people are upset when they realize they've already had their happiest moment.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its body radiates a warm, healing light that comforts anyone in its presence. Its radiant light and ability to sense those in distress make it invaluable in search and rescue operations.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME hangs around nesting grounds, using its egg-shaped tail as a lure to distract egg-hunting predators. Once the predator draws close to what it thinks is a meal, POKENAME swings its tail hard and sends them flying.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME remains still most of the day, letting the energy saved by its lack of movement nurture the egg in its pouch. The eggs on its hands can be detached to use as an Egg Bomb attack if something endangers its precious cargo.
author: sk372

entry: Aquariums use POKENAME as an indicator of the mood of the other fish. If they are hyperactive, the tank is healthy, if they barely move, it needs attention. Children like to watch them dart around, blowing bubbles at the other members of the tank.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The venom Shellder injects into POKENAME's head has not made it smart. Its head has just swollen so large it technically made its brain bigger.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are trustworthy creatures that take good care of the egg on their back. They often rest in the sunlight to ensure that the egg has enough heat to develop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME collect orphaned eggs and carry them on their back. When the eggs hatch, POKENAME help take care of the young Pokémon with love and patience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It fiercely guards its egg, which it holds its tail. It will quickly turn to intercept attacks aimed at the egg, absorbing blows with its bulky body.
author: bukie

entry: There are 59 ways to cook an egg, and POKENAME has mastered every single one. Don't ask for it to share any of it, though. POKENAME is actually selfish and doesn't share.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is always happy. It likes to seek out children with problems and help solve them through a magical light from the heart on its belly.
author: toxicrown

entry: Most of the time, POKENAME are kind and sweet-hearted towards other Pokémon and Trainers. However, they will grow incredibly violent whenever their egg is threatened.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's body is soft to the touch and radiates a calming aura that reduces feelings of stress. The egg-like shell on its back is rock solid and radiates heat, though POKENAME can share pieces of its shell to be crushed and used in calming teas.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME act as a natural caretaker for Mantyke and newly hatched Remoraid. Their limbs are highly nutritious and regrow over time, so there have been rare cases where they have sacrificed a limb to give it to young and starving Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While it may look light and dainty, POKENAME uses its dense plumage as armor. It protects its egg at any cost.
author: havic0970

entry: POKENAME was upgraded with data collected by Pokémon Centers. Its programming allows it to care for Pokémon eggs stored in PC boxes.
author: serversizeme

entry: POKENAME can be found in Pokémon Centers and hospitals aiding doctors. They can sense a patient's heartbeat and will draw the EKG trace on their berets.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME can be found in Pokémon Centers and hospitals aiding doctors. To keep child patients happy, they will draw various images and cartoons on their berets.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: When Pokémon breeding first became popular, it was thought Eggs carried and hatched by POKENAME would become the strongest members of their species. This has since proven false, however POKENAME are extremely efficient and capable caretakers.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is said to present its egg to those who have shown true kindness. If kept safe, this gift brings good health and long life.
author: snescontroller

entry: POKENAME will take in lost hikers into their cave and look after them until they leave. Its stone-like fur is resistant to damage.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are very empathetic, and will sing beautiful, spell-like songs to spread happiness. They also offer eggs to those who are hurt.
author: weedspagon_real

entry: POKENAME's kind and charismatic nature draw many Murkrow to follow its teachings. Rather than steal things, Murkrow under a POKENAME's tutelage find lost items and return them to their owners.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME manages and maintains essential equipment in Pokémon Centers, ensuring all tools are clean and functional. Its gentle nature makes it both a reliable helper and a joy to work with.
author: .izik

entry: A hardened Pokémon that appears at scenes of crisis. It revives the fallen using sharp jolts of electricity from its arms.
author: seaslux

entry: If you suffer a minor injury such as a small scrape or bruise, this variant of POKENAME may show up to provide CPR. It seems a little overeager.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME can be very kind and gentle creatures, but should you try to take its egg, they will get aggressive and use their egg-shaped tail to attack.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME hugs sad people with its many fluffy vines to make them feel warm and loved. This Pokémon regrows its eggs full of happiness so quickly that a large proportion of Blissey eggs on the market are from this species.
author: soup1900

entry: The thick cream on its shoulders and tail tastes very sweet, and it regrows daily. It fires the same substance from its arm cannons at high speeds.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME are popular among large hospitals for their kindhearted nature. When they sense negative emotions, they sing and even offer their egg to patients to make their stay a little less gloomy. The egg itself radiates an aura of happiness.
author: chibitales

entry: Wild POKENAME has a tendency to adopt abandoned eggs it finds in the wild until they hatch. If the newly hatched Pokémon is willing, POKENAME will raise it as its own.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME is a natural prankster, as it will gift its nutritious egg to someone, only to smash it with a powerful kick and cover the victim in white and yolk. It will laugh for weeks about that prank, then repeat it on someone else.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME feels the emotions of its Trainer while it sleeps, so it makes sure to give them one of their eggs during dinnertime, as they are laced in happiness: it is impossible not to grin after taking a bite, just like Blissey's eggs.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It's rumored that in medieval times, before fusion technology, POKENAME was said to visit buildings housing wounded soldiers and bless their wounds.
author: spookoftheoldways

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME has aided humanity by curing ailments with the recuperative magic of its staff. Many hospitals to this day use an icon of the staff as a symbol of dedication to the art of healing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will keep the egg it came out of for its entire life. It stores food or water in it in case of an emergency.
author: gurguro

entry: The massive egg on its back contains such potent happiness that eating it is considered dangerous. As a result, POKENAME keeps it well-protected.
author: pizzarcato

entry: POKENAME plays a vital role during avalanches, using its aura to locate buried Pokémon and lead them to safety. Its unwavering kindness makes it a beacon of hope in harsh winter conditions.
author: .izik

entry: Alongside the young, POKENAME also takes in small injured Pokémon onto its back, often protecting and nurturing them back to health. These selfless acts make it a beloved figure in its habitat.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME are natural healers, preferring to disarm their opposition with kindness. If they come across a Pokémon in immediate peril, they gently scoop them up in their large mouth and carry them to safety.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME will often defend other Pokémon's eggs and nests, using their heads like shields. The armor on their bodies is as sturdy as steel, allowing them to shake off most attacks.
author: santon5512

entry: Despite its hulking stature, POKENAME is very friendly. If it sees a Pokémon getting picked on, it will step in and utterly wallop the attacker.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: A fusion of Slaking and Blissey, embodying strength and nurturing care. A formidable yet compassionate force, it balances power with healing grace.
author: soinetwa

entry: A fusion of Slaking and Blissey, embodying strength and nurturing care. A formidable yet compassionate force, it balances power with healing grace.
author: soinetwa

entry: A fusion of Slaking and Blissey, embodying strength and nurturing care. A formidable yet compassionate force, it balances power with healing grace.
author: soinetwa

entry: This Pokémon looks happy and soft, but the truth is that its body is nearly indestructible and able to withstand anything that might be thrown at it.
author: funkytomate
