entry: POKENAME's eggs are said to contain both extraordinary amounts of nutrients and rejuvenating spiritual energy. The antenna on its head allows it to hear alerts from both the physical world and the spirit world.
author: voiddx01

entry: POKENAME is vast in its kindness and gentle nature. When it appears, it radiates a glowing energy across its body that soothes the aches of all around it as well as neutralizing any violent or aggressive urges nearby wild Pokémon might have.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been well-documented to be incredible mothers. There have been many sightings of POKENAME taking care of orphaned Pokémon, and even human children.
author: bigoljax

entry: The fire POKENAME produces glitters intensely when it feels happy. It especially enjoys spending time with Lasses.
author: ferdirenz

entry: Spirited and proud, POKENAME take great measure to ensure the eggs they carry are large and immaculate. Though a bit haughty, they do have a kind heart, and will share their eggs with those who absolutely need them to recover with.
author: sk372

entry: A gentle touch from this sword not only heals wounds, but also fills opponents with an urge to stop fighting and make up.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's special eyesight allows it to scan another creature's body for abnormalities, akin to an X-ray. Pokémon Centers use it to help speed up diagnoses and better determine what's wrong with a sick Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Their eggs are considered delicacies, so wild POKENAME developed calcium-condensed exoskeletons to help them fight against poachers.
author: yersin1a

entry: It has the ability to sense sadness in children. It spends its day gathering berries to give to others as presents.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Almost nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is often seen around Baby Pokémon, gently singing lullabies as the Baby Pokémon sleep around it. Poké Fans can be seen lining up for them whenever they are available for adoption in Pokémon centers, due to its gentle, cute caregiving nature.
author: beatdoof

entry: While some may expect Blissey's friendliness to negate Giratina's violence, a cauldron of malice boils beneath POKENAME's soft exterior.
author: bukie

entry: If POKENAME approaches while one is sleeping, one's dreams will turn to thoughts of child-rearing. It haunts young couples yet to have children, filling their dreams with happy fantasies to encourage them to start a family.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are called "forest healers" for their tendency to find and heal injured people and Pokémon in the woods. Their "egg" is a specialized fungus.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME can have varying frills, swirls and colors. Fungus grown from POKENAME can cure a variety of ills and soothe pain.
author: totodile.

entry: Egg-shaped fungi from POKENAME has antibacterial properties and can also be used to help with illness and pain. POKENAME feeds by taking harmful things, such as pollution, out of soil.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME has very unique healing properties. One zap from its pink electricity can help cure many different types of wounds and illnesses.
author: Trainerrobo

entry: The egg on its lid is said to give happiness when rubbed, but bestow horrible curses if cracked. In ancient times, it was a symbol of longevity.
author: faelocke

entry: It actively consumes vehicle batteries to absorb their energy. This electricity is stored in what looks like an egg on its abdomen.
author: .izik

entry: The egg on its head is not edible and is filled with a liquid metal. It uses its long arms to cling to the edges of cliffs.
author: .izik

entry: Its gentle glow has been known to help incubate eggs, so it is often used as the main light source in daycares and breeding centers.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME has the power to destroy almost any obstacle in its path with its tail. If someone is in danger, it will stop at nothing until they are safe and healthy.
author: gronkissimo

entry: POKENAME are used in many Pokémon Centers to quickly ship potions and other healing items to Trainers.
author: dodoowner_

entry: If POKENAME ever comes across an egg in the wild, it will attempt to look after it and will use its fire to warm it up. This can cause issues when the egg's parent has only left for a few seconds.
author: dualblades1147

entry: Despite its egg having no medical benefits, POKENAME will give it to passing Trainers for a chance of affection. It dreams of one day working at a Pokémon Center just like other Blissey.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's wings spread a dust which heals people on contact. If you see this Pokémon, it is said good health will be given to you.
author: dodoowner_

entry: When it senses sadness in a person, this Pokémon will leave hiding and race to them to share an egg of happiness, no matter how far it must travel.
author: tomatosalad

entry: Gatherings of Bibarel can be seen surrounding POKENAME during the rainy season, exchanging gifts such as chopped wood, nuts, and fruit. The one that impresses POKENAME the most will be rewarded with a hug and its egg-like stone.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are kind creatures that often adopt abandoned eggs to raise as their own. Even though their bodies are small, they do everything they can to give the egg a good life.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's egg emits a pleasant aroma. However, prolonged exposure to the smell can result in health problems, as it contains trace amounts of poison.
author: jackjirachi

entry: The gelatinous body of POKENAME produces eggs similar to Chansey. The contents, while nutrient-packed, are slimy and unappealing.
author: ohok3441

entry: Driven by a powerful maternal instinct, POKENAME plucks the soft feathers from its head and tail to craft a warm, comfortable nest. It is known to let other Pokémon rest their eggs within its nest for safekeeping.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME use their pouches to snatch eggs from unsuspecting Pokémon. They then proceed to store the egg as a snack for later consumption.
author: celio_0230

entry: This Pokémon stores its valuables in recesses with electric edges. Its precision in taking the contents back out makes POKENAME a top notch surgeon.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME is a docile Pokémon more focused on caring for its children. If it loses the egg it always held in its arms, however, it will fly into a vicious rage in search of its unborn young, with nothing stopping its rampage.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME hide their presence during snowfall. They can be found searching for frozen remains, hoping to fill their egg with lifeforce.
author: houndrys.

entry: It approaches humans and Pokémon who are sick or injured and cheers them on until they're well. POKENAME have become popular in some hospitals for keeping patients in good spirits.
author: hophoppip

entry: It flies low in search of orphaned eggs, descending to keep them warm as if they were its own. This habit has earned it the nickname "Nanny Pokémon".
author: bukie

entry: Too timid to eat anything using its dissolving slime and mucus, POKENAME instead subsists on whatever it crawls over, with grass being its favorite. The egg it carries can instantly restore any Pokémon to its maximum potential.
author: beatdoof

entry: A friendly, nurturing species by nature, POKENAME is well known as a reliable nanny for children. Despite this reputation, many Ace Trainers also rely on it as their ace partner.
author: beatdoof

entry: Its bottomless kindness and sturdy body allow it to rush to the aid of anyone who needs it. However, it's as dumb as a rock and may trample others during its rush.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME gifts its patients little wind-up egg toys after they recover. Each of these toys are hand-made by POKENAME, so the gift has a strong level of sentimental value..
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cares far more for the health of others than its own. It will put makeshift bandages on major injuries only if it ensures it can more quickly respond to the injury of another.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats silently through the water, aiding rescue efforts by guiding lost Pokémon to safety. Its glowing core radiates warmth, providing comfort even in the darkest depths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often accompany lifeguards, assisting in a variety of first-aid care. The egg they carry is known to act as a useful antidote for Tentacool stings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME coats its nest with a special acid that does not harm its egg. If threatened, it sprays highly pressurized water directly at the eyes of intruders before making a swift escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a serene calmness whenever they are taking care of their egg and protect it from the cold by keeping it close to their chest. They love to give out hugs to baby Pokémon who feel anxious.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME decorates its large eggs with breathtaking jewels and patterns as they wait for the many eons needed before hatching. Unfortunately, many have been hunted and sold to royalty for storing gaudy trinkets.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: It is said that its mere presence can bring a smile even to people suffering from deep depression. The egg at the tip of its wand is always warm and is placed on wounds to heal them, as if POKENAME were performing magic.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its high internal temperature means this Pokémon sees lots of use as an egg incubator.  Any egg placed within its shell will hatch within minutes.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME's boiling shell can erupt large amounts of delicious hot scrambled eggs. This quality is very valuable for both chefs and Pokémon centers in cold areas.
author: epping_forest

entry: Popular among Nurse Joys, POKENAME create spores that help heal and soothe people who come in contact with them. They are primarily used in emergencies as prolonged exposure to the scales can cause someone to develop an immunity.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Having formed a strong friendship with another that allowed it to evolve, POKENAME is agreeable and affectionate in personality and almost never lashes out at anyone. It has utmost faith in those around it in this stage of life, even if mistreated.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's fur has a pleasant scent; to keep it that way, POKENAME grooms itself quite often. While unproven, it has been theorized that it may do so as a desire to make sure its paws are clean before attempting to treat and nurse other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefer to carry fertile eggs, often stealing them from others. Once an egg hatches, the infant is carried until it grows too large.
author: sitten1115

entry: POKENAME is often seen living alongside groups of Chansey. Though it abhors violence, it will not hesitate to protect those in its care with all its strength.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its soothing presence to alleviate headaches, calming both Pokémon and Trainers. Its kind demeanor and healing abilities make it a welcome companion for those weighed down by cares.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME give tender and loving care towards abandoned eggs and sometimes bring one home whenever they find one in the wild. Doting on the egg takes lots of effort, so they curl into their shell to rest whenever they are tired.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shell that covers its body is harder than marble. When boiled, the shell releases huge amounts of nutrients and can be used as medicine.
author: .izik

entry: Always smiling, POKENAME carries a mysterious egg on its back. Those who touch it are blessed with good fortune, but POKENAME runs too fast for anyone to easily catch it.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The Shellder attached to POKENAME feels bad for perpetually biting its tail, due to POKENAME's boundless kindness. The Shellder, however, has no plans to let go.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: One of POKENAME's heads will often crack their eggs on accident. The other head will get extremely angry when that happens.
author: themicelegion

entry: When raising young, one of POKENAME's heads tries to be stern, but the other two cannot resist coddling and spoiling the child. POKENAME tries its best to strike a healthy balance to raise its young correctly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can envelop the sick and injured in soothing hugs because the substance that constitutes its gooey body acts as a healing agent. It is loved for its caring nature, but unfortunately it has an incurable, overly-sterile scent.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With a durable body, long range cannons and a shell full of healing water, this Pokémon is often sought out by strong military groups and firefighters.
author: frokachu

entry: To the untrained eye, it may look like a normal Blissey, happily sharing its egg with you. However, POKENAME's eggs are extremely toxic, leaving those who eat them with deadly diseases.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME has the unique ability to soothe migraines through calming touch and subtle psychic waves. Its serene expression belies the depth of its mental powers, which it uses solely to help others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are able to control how permeable their shells are, letting them reduce the density of the shell surface enough to carry eggs within them. They maintain a perfect environment for incubation within their shell.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is often joked that POKENAME embody the essence of storms on account of all the energy they have to run around. If a creature is in their way, they will loudly growl to get them to move.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, only appearing in forests during intense thunderstorms. It absorbs static in the air with its antennae, which hastens its growth as well as its speed.
author: sk372

entry: It fashions a small hammer to bludgeon foes and charge with electricity. The hammer is surprisingly heavy; even Pokémon like Machamp and Slaking strain to move it, yet POKENAME wields it with ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wields its hammer flawlessly, even throwing it as a projectile when needed. It's said only the chosen may lift the hammer, as no one human or Pokémon has been seen able to budge it aside from POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: They use their springy legs to perform quick maneuvers and to deliver quick kicks that overwhelm their foes. The more they move on their legs, the more electricity they generate.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME strive to be champions in physical combat with their lightning-quick boxing techniques. Their signature move is a Thunder Punch that booms like thunder even if it doesn't strike a foe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a non-aggressive undersea denizen, but should not be thought of as harmless. It blows out small bubbles that are charged with stupendous amounts of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights by shooting streaks of lightning from its fingertips. It can also create electrified barriers to protect itself.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME mark their territories using their tough, front claws which also help to slow themselves during a charging attack. Wild POKENAME regularly fight over territory and pack leadership, the sounds of their clashing horns reminiscent of thunder.
author: infinex21

entry: The purple furs of POKENAME are notoriously water-repellant, despite how much time these Pokémon spend within water each day. Their fur is where they store electricity, which they can release through their claws and their fangs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is constantly surrounded by an aura of wild static electricity. As it runs, this static builds up into a raging storm.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME channels its electricity into its singular bladed limb. With one swing it can generate a roiling bolt of lightning that can carve up the land several yards in front of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soars at the center of winter thunderstorms, shrouded in a cloak of snow, and it trails the aurora behind it when it leaves the dissipating storm. Folklorists have begun studying it more since it demonstrates fealty to both Lugia and Ho-oh.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME flies for vast distances, only ever seen roosting at the rim of volcanoes. Should its perch become volatile, it casts down lightning into the volcano that somehow returns it to dormancy.
author: sk372

entry: It fires a lightning orb into the sky, which creates a furious thunderstorm in seconds after bursting. POKENAME controls the lightning within the dark clouds it creates, mercilessly frying its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are full of energy and love to race around with their Trainers, dragging them from town to town. Their footprints carry an electrical charge and can spark for hours after they've passed by, making wild POKENAME easy to track.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bites down on opponents with a Thunder Fang that has the power of a crashing thunderbolt. It can fold its mane over its head to form a massive upper jaw that strikes foes with lightning as if thunder itself were biting down on them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME travels quickly through forests by swinging from threads it produces. Said threads visibly crackle with potent electricity, warning others to avoid touching them and interrupting its swinging lest they get jolted.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being a clumsy infant, its thunderous potential is undeniable. Anyone hoping to live with one should be prepared for stormy weather whenever it becomes startled or upset.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Very little is known about POKENAME, as they quickly flee when approached. They are known to only appear in the mountainous areas in Johto on days when lightning has struck.
author: mepp.

entry: During their migratory season, POKENAME leave a thundering roar behind them as they bolt across the sky. While POKENAME are heard for miles away, they are rarely seen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME wants to travel, it calls down electricity upon it, and using this energy it travels across mud at such speeds it looks almost instantaneous. This gives it nasty electrical burns, which it then must apply a mixture of mud and saliva to.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The berry juice created within is often described as having an "electrifying" taste to it, making a drinker's muscles tingle slightly afterward. Companies now sell energy drinks with POKENAME juice as an ingredient.
author: sk372

entry: The roar of a POKENAME echos louder than thunder, and its claws etch jagged, electricity-scorched scars into the trees of its territory.
author: cristata

entry: The roar of a POKENAME echos louder than thunder, and its claws etch jagged, electricity-scorched scars into the trees of its territory.
author: cristata

entry: Their tusks and manes grow longer and larger with age and crackle with electricity when they are agitated. Even now, some humans still seek their tusks for how grand they are and, or, because they conduct electricity so well.
author: infinex21

entry: The large electric bursts POKENAME periodically releases increase the speed of computing devices within a 10 mile radius. Many Trainers use this information to track its position.
author: .izik

entry: This self fusion of Raikou is sometimes called "The calm before the storm."  It carries itself with such calm elegance that it often seems completely docile, but it may suddenly strike with intense lightning, without any warning.
author: infranscia

entry: It is said that POKENAME embodies the very essence of lightning and can descend from storm clouds to punish humans who endanger Electric-type Pokémon. According to legend, a single roar from it can summon a storm of thunderbolts upon its enemies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are the result of the machinations of Eusine, a legendary Pokémon fanatic who had been chasing the legendary beast Suicune. After first being sighted in Azalea Town, there have since been sightings across Johto and Kanto.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are the result of the machinations of Eusine, a legendary Pokémon fanatic who had been chasing the legendary beast Suicune. After first being sighted in Azalea Town, there have since been sightings across Johto and Kanto.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are the result of the machinations of Eusine, a legendary Pokémon fanatic who had been chasing the legendary beast Suicune. After first being sighted in Azalea Town, there have since been sightings across Johto and Kanto.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As POKENAME flies, it summons massive thunderstorms that can last for over a month. Every flap of its wings causes thunderclaps strong enough to flatten houses.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its large fangs secrete a paralytic agent that could down a Mamoswine in less than an hour. To intimidate others, it can shake its lower body to produce a thunder-like sound.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME relies on the element of surprise to shock its opponents from behind.
author: gayschlatt

entry: A Thunderbolt from POKENAME can split a tall tree clean in two.
author: gayschlatt

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was revered by people as the god of thunder, able to summon thunderbolts over their crop fields with a tap of its drums. Three thundering, swirling hail clouds in the same pattern its drums have signify its hunting grounds.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME can create tremors that some have compared to the rumbling of thunder. During battle, when aboveground, POKENAME are wreathed in arcs of electricity as they dash about and slash at their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME channel and release electricity through their leafy tails when they raise them toward the sky. This stance allows them to seemingly call down lightning bolts. The tips of their purple leaves are green when they are healthiest.
author: infinex21

entry: When it cries out, it releases sparks of electricity and flakes of its freezing energy. By freezing parts of its own fur, it can better defend itself and better regulate its own power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wait for sandstorms before they go on the hunt for prey within the deserts they live in. They ride the winds with their strong wings, pouncing quickly upon prey and finishing them with an electric shock delivered through their fangs.
author: infinex21

entry: The spines on its back generate electricity it can draw onto its claws. It scrapes its claws together to make sparks as a threat display, before firing deadly bolts of lightning at those that don't heed the warning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a thunderous brawler. Fusing Blaziken's fighting prowess with Raikou's power, it is capable of launching attacks at lightning speed.
author: sheogorath

entry: POKENAME's dance routines are known for their dramatic flair. Sparks fly from its hands and tail as it spins and leaps, and every performance ends with a raised hand and a summoned crack of lightning.
author: sk372

entry: Gathering energy from lightning bolts, POKENAME fight alongside their sentient storms to overpower foes. The longer a POKENAME has gone without recharging, the harder it will be for it to hold back its raging storm.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is easy to underestimate due to its flat shape, but don't be fooled. It can conduct enough amps to melt rock.
author: .realthree

entry: Every strike against POKENAME's shield sounds like crashing thunder. Ancient people believe that if you struck its shield too many times, your village would be shrouded in an endless thunderstorm.
author: mistymagius

entry: If struck by lightning, POKENAME emits a lasting influence that convinces others of its divinity. Affected followers may trail it across regions for years.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is quite proud of the fluffy mane around its neck, preening it often. If it gets dirty in any way, POKENAME throws a mild tantrum, angrily flinging little electric orbs from its flippers at random.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME pierces its victims with the electric impact of lightning. It rides on a floating storm cloud.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME live within thunderstorm-ridden badlands, with caves serving as their dens. Their eyesight is strong enough to see far across their badland homes, so they always know when the time to hunt is ripe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME chases storms, using its ribbons as lightning rods to absorb thunderbolts and protect others. It is very shy, so it will run away to return to its den in mountainous forests as soon as it senses the storm start to dissipate.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME stores up vast amounts of electricity within its tail. It funnels the energy into its horn and claws to devastate its foes, and the tail itself is sturdy enough to be a formidable weapon all its own.
author: sk372

entry: A cosmic guardian of the skies, POKENAME flies through the stratosphere, taming tempests and absorbing solar flares. Every roar bends thunder and light into wild, spiraling auroras.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's whiskers extend out and become electrified tendrils for interacting with others. It zips around the world at a fast pace, only taking periodic breaks within the Pokédex of wandering Trainers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys riding on winds, travelling great distances and causing thunderstorms where it appears. It has a mischievous attitude and frequently causes power outages when it is nearby cities.
author: dahappycute

entry: It is said that aggressive thunderstorms during the full moon are due to POKENAME. Small groups gather during these moments, gazing up at the moon longingly and basking in the storm's rainfall.
author: sk372

entry: Highly empathetic, POKENAME resigns itself to secluded mountains, lest it risk unleashing violent thunderstorms in response to nearby hostility.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This elusive Pokémon brings a thunderstorm wherever it goes. Both POKENAME and the storm it brings disappear with a flash of lightning.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body contains a down that allows it to turn its body invisible, with the exception of the rain clouds on its back. Since POKENAME's cries sound like thunder, it's very difficult to tell it apart from a thundercloud when it turns invisible.
author: darkweavile428

entry: With a flick of just one tail can POKENAME call lightning; with a roar it calls calamitous thunder. It is believed to be partially ethereal in nature, as it can easily disappear once out-of-sight.
author: bobosmith01

entry: As POKENAME bound across the land, they leave burned pawprints in their wake, as if the spot had been struck by lightning. Each of their tails is thought to hold the power of a single lightning strike, calling upon such power to decimate foes.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME channels raw electrical currents through the horn on its nose and the fins along its back. Fulgurites discovered near its fossilised remains suggest that its electricity can surge to over 60 million volts.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When its thundering spirit is channeled through Yellow Nectar, a contagious joy and hope elevate it to charge up new enthusiasm in its feathers. Its dance leads the way to a better future, or at least a victory over the horizon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These Pokémon are said to be born of the spirits of trees that were struck down by bolts of lightning, be they split or set aflame. Now they wield lightning itself in the defense of their forest homes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a ruthless hunter. A flash of lightning and a thunderclap is all the warning its prey gets.
author: bacondlx

entry: Notoriously elusive, those who wish to catch a glimpse of POKENAME must venture out in dangerous conditions as they hide within storm clouds. Their shrill cries are said to be louder than thunder itself.
author: mepp.

entry: By charging its fins with electricity, POKENAME produces enough electromagnetic energy to create its own localized auroras. Despite being generated from electricity, these auroras freeze the area around them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's fur and rocky plates are highly conductive, allowing them to charge Electric-type attacks easily. It's thought the howls of these Pokémon can summon lightning bolts capable of levelling a neighborhood.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME charges its leg muscles with electricity, letting it make great leaps to cover vast distances. It strikes pursuers with diving headbutts that impact with the heavy boom of a thunderclap.
author: sk372

entry: Barreling forward with a furious rumbling, POKENAME builds static along the drums on its back before unleashing a massive bolt of lightning with a deafening roar. It strikes its drums to fire off stray bolts while it dances around the battlefield.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The older a POKENAME grows, the taller its mushroom becomes. They are prone to being struck by lightning during storms, which they have grown to absorb with increasing ease.
author: infinex21

entry: Every one of the flossy threads surrounding POKENAME's body carries some of its electric charge. These strings are edible and quite sweet, delivering a harmless jolt to the tongue upon consumption that leaves the body tingling.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME falls from the night sky, it leaves an ephemeral trail, which brightens the night sky. By the time the trail fades, so will the Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME produces thunderclouds from the crystals along its body to hide its reflective form. It supercharges the frills on the back of its head to launch forward like a meteor, creating an explosion of lightning where it lands.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's cry booms with the intensity of the strongest thunderclap. Whenever it roars, lightning courses around its body and bursts outward in a powerful burst when its roar ends.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were initially thought to be extinct until a group was found living on an unexplored mountain range. They are incredibly agile and can leap several feet in a single bound, latching onto prey with venomous fangs.
author: chibitales

entry: Its psychic pulses create a powerful shockwave around it that sounds like booming thunder. It rubs its pained head afterward, emitting short crackles of lightning from it as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is not yet strong enough to intentionally create thunderstorms, but may do so accidentally when its emotions surge. Extreme caution is advised when raising this Pokémon.
author: alestrius

entry: According to myth, POKENAME can run across the span of entire continents, leaving intense thunderstorms in its path. Ancient people used to leave offerings of meat far from their homes to coax the storms elsewhere.
author: alestrius

entry: This Pokémon is said to embody the speed and ferocity of lightning and flame, respectively. The den of a POKENAME is easy to spot due to the charred terrain and large gashes that litter the area around.
author: infinex21

entry: Raw power is everything for this Pokémon, with its fighting style often described as oppressive. It beats prey into the ground with charged palms, and does not stop until they lay still.
author: xillo

entry: Hyperactive and rarely able to stay in a singular spot, POKENAME zips through the ocean waters at breakneck speed. The lightning in its cranium is believed to be proportional to its health.
author: sk372

entry: Some POKENAME specimens possess a darker cranial dome, illuminated only by the lightning within. These variants are notably less hyperactive, but far less friendly in behavior as well.
author: sk372

entry: The cloudy fur upon its back is always quite hot, though it becomes even hotter when they are running. Its fur crackles with electricity that it can channel and release from its singular horn.
author: infinex21

entry: As POKENAME gallops, its hooves emit thunderous rumblings, leaving an electric trail in its wake. When it reaches its maximum speed, its mane bursts into flames, giving its attacks the power to burn anything they touch.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME speeds across the land by retracting into its shell and using lightning to propel it forward large distances. It tends to rest in caverns near the ocean when not roaming the world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are said to form when storms grow wild and unpredictable. This nearly invisible Pokémon drifts in the storm's eye, feeding on lightning as it rides the shifting winds.
author: lesbian_garlicbread

entry: POKENAME finds the homes of those scared by thunderstorms, as they are perfect victims to haunt. It hides in the shadows and terrorizes them with sudden cries that sound like violent, booming thunder.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cooks up berries it finds with small yet intensely hot flames it breathes out. It only eats the berry once it's cooked to a burnt and blackened crisp.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers solitude above all else. If discovered hiding in tall grass, it erupts with bursts of flame from its bone to drive others away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use tufts of their own white fur to pad their bone clubs, which they ignite with their breathed flames. These tufts of fur take almost half a day to fully burn away, which is why they have replaced firewood for some people.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cruelly strike towns recently beset by volcanic eruptions. Ancient scriptures pose POKENAME as a sign of the end times.
author: gurguro

entry: Elusive and rare, POKENAME is only ever found high in the sky over tall mountains and volcanoes. POKENAME passively emits massive amounts of heat, making it difficult to stand close to it.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME has been rarely spotted in areas full of lava or extremely hot waters. Although normally solitary, if it finds stranded humans in its home, it will ferry them safely across the scalding hot waters or magma.
author: sk372

entry: Found living in molten lava, POKENAME is reported to have been alive since ancient times. Despite its rather small appearance, these Pokémon have been linked to causing many volcanic eruptions around the world.
author: dahappycute

entry: Between hunts and long flights, POKENAME perches on the rims of volcanoes and surveys its territory. Legends say its roaring screech will bring a dormant volcano back to life and make it erupt within hours of its cry.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an elusive sort, often taking flight and escaping to parts unknown the minute it is spotted. The footprints it leaves behind smolder and spark for several minutes after being created.
author: sk372

entry: A number of ruins on remote volcanic islands depict imagery of POKENAME. According to translations, the ancient people venerated it as a guardian deity due to its ability to turn active volcanoes dormant.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dominates its battlefields by conjuring countless burning flames made of psychic energy. It has the power to turn even long-dormant volcanoes active and make them violently erupt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's breath emits volcanic ashes that start fires to anything they touch. If its volcanic aroma is especially strong, it means that a nearby volcano is about to erupt.
author: soup1900

entry: When not on the hunt, POKENAME rests within the rims of inactive volcanoes. It captures prey with its super-heated webbing that both ensnares and cooks its unfortunate target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spend their lives journeying to volcanoes. Upon arrival, they lay their eggs in the crater and die soon after. The eggs stay dormant, gaining energy in the magma, until an eruption scatters and cracks them open, starting the next generation.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME makes its home in deserts in western regions, basking in the light of the sunset. Its joyful and melodic howl as the sun vanishes down the horizon can be heard for miles around.
author: sk372

entry: Over time, POKENAME's crown hardens into a volcano-like structure, constantly venting smoke and sparks. It reigns over volcanic lands, its every step leaving smoldering footprints in its wake.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME is able to conjure up powerful roiling flames from its body. When launched at an opponent, the burns it leaves on contact have the same shape as its own symbol-like form.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is incredibly skittish, fleeing the moment it spots anyone approaching. Unfortunately it is quite slow, making its escape speed embarrassing for both itself and those watching.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoy painting various Pokémon, with varying degrees of quality. Should they become frustrated with their artwork, they may bark in anger. Whenever they bark, their paint becomes hot to the touch.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: When the clouds of ash from an erupting volcano become so thick that lightning begins to form, some say POKENAME is near. When POKENAME roars, any nearby ash is vaporized by bolts of electricity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When the clouds of ash from an erupting volcano become so thick that lightning begins to form, some say POKENAME is near. When POKENAME roars, any nearby ash is vaporized by bolts of electricity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is said that a single roar from POKENAME can trigger violent volcanic eruptions. The extreme heat of its body, made of pure fire, constantly turns the moisture in the air into hot steam.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Sightings of POKENAME are always feared since they only appear right before a volcanic eruption. If they are attacked, they spew tons of hot ash that can suffocate anyone in minutes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME inhabits the ashen, rocky wastes around volcanoes, occasionally pawing at the ground. The spots it digs at will eventually grow hardy, heat-resistant foliage that blooms with a fiery red color.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can create large lava flows just by slamming the ground. Its powerful arms allow for it to swim through magma as if it were water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can be found near active volcanoes, participating in ritual blessings in hopes of a volcanic eruption. When they band together, they can control entire lava flows.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME practices ballroom dancing all the time. When POKENAME loses its temper, it attacks as if it were a feral beast.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME requires constant attention or it quickly grows frustrated, producing greater quantities of smoke. If its anger peaks, the smoke will ignite at once, so keeping it happy is crucial.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has been nicknamed "Empress of the Ember" for its pyrokinetic prowess. Even with this intimidating moniker, it is very kindhearted.
author: patch_bros

entry: Regal in both appearance and demeanor, POKENAME takes the protection of its Trainer very seriously. It won't hesitate to conjure eruptions of flame from the ground at even a hint of aggression.
author: sk372

entry: The statue of POKENAME is a vessel for a vengeful spirit of a flame deity. If you listen closely, sounds of crackling fire can be heard from within.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME can sense prey within miles of any volcano in the world. It then flies to a nearby volcano and uses the force of the volcano's eruption to launch itself at sonic speeds towards its target.
author: soup1900

entry: In magma-filled caves deep beneath the earth, the smoke rising from hot pools took on a physical form. POKENAME cannot leave the volcanic or tropical regions where they live, as their smoky bodies would disappear in colder climates.
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME's mane is made of flowing smoke, capable of shifting shape and forming a gaping maw to capture prey. It engulfs foes in its haze before delivering a decisive strike.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME is said to glow like living flame while racing across night skies. Even a brief sighting was believed to grant eternal emotional warmth to witnesses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are strong yet prideful Pokémon and have a hard time dealing with failure. They are known to haphazardly shoot flames when they are stressed, so Trainers need to support them whenever they get temper tantrums.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The first POKENAME was forged in magma. It is said that it's possessed by the spirit of a volcano, and when it unsheathes, another volcano erupts.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This stunningly beautiful Pokémon embodies passion. It is typically found near volcanic hot springs. Legends tell of a creator deity that is a patron of hot springs, where fire and water meet, and some people believe POKENAME is that deity's avatar.
author: alkazamis

entry: Its body heat allows POKENAME to generate clouds of steam, which it uses to create illusions that conceal its hiding spots from humans. When seriously wounded in battle, it retreats inside volcanoes until it has fully recovered.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME releases a scent similar to burnt vegetables while traveling through grasslands, calming everyone within a 100-meter radius. This calmness typically causes enough inactivity in onlookers for it to flee if spotted.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME fires its cannon, the blasts sound like the boom from an active volcano that has just erupted. Having some drives attached to POKENAME can turn its burning fire shots into ground-melting lava rays.
author: soup1900

entry: A mighty Pokémon, it hides itself in volcanoes for most of the year. It has only been seen when it travels to its next home. It is currently unknown if POKENAME has an anger comparable to Zekrom and what will happen if it's provoked.
author: thistleblower

entry: POKENAME were once believed to have been created by volcanic eruptions, as they are occasionally seen blasting into the air along with molten lava. Instead, they breed in empty chambers and are flushed out during eruptions.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Rarely seen, POKENAME is rumored to be the larval form of a mighty legendary Dragon. They burrow through volcanic rocks, leaving a honeycomb of glassy-sided tunnels from their extremely high-temperature bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are said to be the young guardians of distant volcanoes. This is derived from the fact that POKENAME are very aggressive about their territory, injecting any trespassers with a poison that can cause an intense burning feeling under the skin.
author: fireflower20002

entry: POKENAME rolls so fast that it leaves a trail of fire where it goes. Its hardened shell protects it from those flames.
author: terminatphilippe

entry: POKENAME feeds on lava to keep its body in a liquid state. If its body temperature gets too low, its body becomes so viscous that it can no longer move.
author: mistymagius

entry: A Pokémon's spirit, once ensnared in flames, now lingers within the tower where it met its fate, forever bound to the relentless blaze.
author: slowforest

entry: A recently sighted Pokémon that has come through time rifts in Paldea, POKENAME are thought to be from the distant past. Their bodies produce constant plumes of superheated smoke and steam that cling to them like clouds.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will remain relaxed for most of the day, waiting for midday. At noon, POKENAME will howl and form large packs, tracking down their meal for the day. This explosive burst of energy evokes the sudden eruption of a volcano.
author: vic1312

entry: Seeing POKENAME dance is said to be like witnessing volcanic smoke on the wind's current. In this form, its song exudes grace and modesty.
author: pokopish

entry: POKENAME displays flowing moves that are steady and controlled, but wild when one least expects. In this form, its song exhibits an intensity not unlike an erupting volcano.
author: pokopish

entry: The tips of POKENAME's sickles are as hot as lava, giving anything POKENAME slashes a painful, searing burn. It can make itself appear a lot bigger and grander by using smoke to look like more tufts of its big white hair.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's mane fizzes with super-heated steam. Legends say that every hot spring has a guardian POKENAME to protect it.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME's body can transform to reflect the burning tower where the first Entei came to be. Some Johtonian folk treat it with great reverence.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME nest around volcanoes, fluttering in swarms around the lava in the caldera. Vulcanologists use them as a guide on whether or not to expect an eruption, as larger swarms of POKENAME in one place correspond to increased volcanic activity.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are capable of causing volcanic eruptions with enough focus and will. This often results in them holding their breath until the eruption occurs, which causes headaches if they strain too hard.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME's rage burns hotter, so does its body, to the point its fists will become enveloped in flames. The heat of these punches can nearly reach the temperature of molten magma.
author: sk372

entry: With a single bend of the spoon, POKENAME can force volcanoes to erupt on command. Many spend their days holed up in remote caverns, meditating on the destructive nature of volcanoes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be found at festival parades, leading the procession. Whenever they roar, the mask they carry exhales smoke from its nose.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is known to trigger underwater volcanic eruptions. Hiding amongst ash, it uses its many legs to pounce upon any life curious enough to inspect its newly born island. After fed, POKENAME returns to the submarine magma network it emerged from.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME dips its tail into pools of lava to absorb minerals that strengthen its body. It spends hours patiently soaking in the heat, becoming tougher with each session.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Over time, the minerals POKENAME absorbed formed a sentient volcano, which it now cradles with great care. The two share a deep connection, radiating intense heat as they move in perfect harmony.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME carries a strange wispy stick with it at all times. Dragging the stick along the ground causes fire to erupt from the scraped area, which it uses to help cover its quick-footed escape.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is born from volcanic mudpots. When using flame attacks, POKENAME's body temperature increases, and its toxic stench becomes unbearable.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME is difficult to spot in the wild, as it often masks its movements by hiding among plumes of smoke emitted from volcanoes. It has occasionally been observed hiding in a similar fashion near factory smokestacks.
author: sk372

entry: When smoke billows from the top of an active volcano, POKENAME emerge in droves. Their bodies are made of volcanic smoke, which eventually dissolves into pure ash if POKENAME does not evolve.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME steams its own body during battle, causing its shell and claw to brightly glow. Plumes of white-hot steam billow from its claw with every superheated swing.
author: griddle

entry: When POKENAME battles in the wild, it spits inky water at opponents to disorient them before finishing them off. It only evolves in clean water, so POKENAME cleans all water it comes across, including battle sites.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer. It shoots jets of water from its snout to stun foes then freezes them in place.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Its icy claws are so sharp, the edges are a mere three micrometers wide. Despite this, these blades are virtually indestructible.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME live in only the cleanest waters and are typically found in and around mountain springs. They have a purifying effect on the bodies of water they live in, making them a popular addition to aquariums.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME protects large bodies of water from any form of pollution. Despite usually being a calm Pokémon, POKENAME will fly into a frenzy if its water becomes tainted.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is only found in the northern wilds where the water is pure and free of toxins. Its howling song is said to shake the heart of even the most stone-faced of humans.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A trail of fresh clean water will follow POKENAME wherever they swim, however, they can and often will vanish completely under the water's surface. Those that have seen them claim they can often become confused for mermaids from fairytales.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: If POKENAME vomits water onto a device, the system is mysteriously cleansed of corruption rather than short-circuited. The unpleasant retching sound has been reported to startle onlookers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in only the cleanest waters and are typically found in and around mountain springs. They have a purifying effect on the bodies of water they live in, making them a popular addition to aquariums.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: An ancient beast said to be from a land before time. The people of old supposedly dubbed it "Soaring Wake", but nowadays it's referred to as POKENAME.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: Legends say that when dark storms come with the north wind, POKENAME is the one to blame. In reality, they are actually the ones "purifying" these storms by absorbing all the lightning so that the storms don't create any harm.
author: soup1900

entry: Legends say that when dark storms come with the north wind, POKENAME is the one to blame. In reality, they are actually the ones "purifying" these storms by turning them into calm and peaceful clouds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are often responsible for tropical storms, as they can rapidly increase the humidity and temperature with a single flap of the wing. Despite their ability to summon rain, they are scared of lightning and flee if they hear thunder.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An elusive Pokémon said to only appear to Trainers that have just started their journey. If it twirls its ribbon-like appendages around, it can cause waves to start rolling ashore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are famous for their special diet. They only eat leaves that have been touched by sunlight or have hung down into a lake or sea. They use their ribbons to reach these exclusive leaves.
author: leandermalurt

entry: Its small horn is cool to the touch and seems to be what allows it to regulate any of its energy. It throws a fit if it cannot find fresh water for over a day and will discharge electricity from its horn during its fit.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are frequently found in fishing towns, living among docks and small fishing boats to eat leftover bait from fishermen. They will hop across the surface of the water, often leaving small amounts of purified water behind.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME always has a somber look on its face when it views into the future. This is thought to be because it sees no future where the increasing marine plastic pollution and chemical dumping into seas gets rectified.
author: soup1900

entry: It drifts in the upper atmosphere, where the air is coldest. Its presence causes rain and snow clouds to form.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME live in swamps, and to prevent them from getting ill from the water they excrete a gel that absorbs all the toxins around them. This gel slowly breaks down and must be replaced, at which point the toxins are released back into the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its tendrils to purify lake areas, removing filth and pollution in a few moments' time. It does this not for inherent altruism, but simply because it finds clearer water prettier to look at.
author: sk372

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is a sight to behold as they gracefully skate across tranquil lakes. Its skating prowess has inspired many figure skaters.
author: mistymagius

entry: When connected to a device and associated network, POKENAME typically spends its time researching and pulling up webpages on the methods of water purification. When it grows to trust its Trainer, its searches begin to broaden dramatically.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Should POKENAME touch a body of water with its elegant mouth, the creature can cleanse away all pollutants and renew the water to its former transparency. Legend tells that its lavender-colored mane feels smoother than any velvet.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This fusion tends to isolate themselves from other Pokémon. It's thin, paper-like tail is rumored to be a never-ending list of future events.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: Electricity stored inside of POKENAME is emitted from its two electric points. When this electricity is used on water, it shocks away any impurities while somehow becoming harmless to the natural wildlife living inside the water.
author: soup1900

entry: Electricity stored inside of POKENAME is emitted from its two electric points. When this electricity is used on water, it shocks away any impurities while somehow becoming harmless to the natural wildlife living inside the water.
author: soup1900

entry: It is believed that POKENAME embodies the very essence of the aurora, and that its aura alone can calm even the fiercest of storms. According to legend, a single tear from POKENAME could purify an entire water basin from any form of pollution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Beautiful auroras form in the sky as POKENAME fly above, lighting up the night. Their presence is said to signal the beginning and end of winter, bringing good fortune to those who witness them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME travels through time and leaves behind colorful petals from its mane that purify nature and water. It is believed it does this to prevent a polluted future that not even it could fix.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME cares very deeply about its mystical staff. If it were to get lost or broken, POKENAME would let out a piercing cry.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME absorb nutrients from water through their ribbon-like feelers, or they metabolize electricity if there is no freshwater nearby. They display immense compassion for the lost or the injured, be they human or Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have been proven to be able to use their own electric currents to remove pollutants from water. Many POKENAME are still being used in myriad studies to find more effective and clean ways to counter water pollution.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME come at the end of autumn to touch the waters with their frozen chill. When rivers frozen by POKENAME thaw in the spring, they provide pure water for the rest of the year.
author: feykrow

entry: POKENAME skims along the surface of waters with its ribbons trailing behind and purifying them. If it notices anyone harming clean water, it rapidly beats its wings to blast them with sonic waves that leave a trail reminiscent of the aurora borealis.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME always glide with the north winds, correcting their course if they are blown off them. As they race across the sky, they will swoop down and use their long tail to purify any filthy water they come across.
author: soup1900

entry: Perched atop glaciers, POKENAME watches over the tundra. It can solidify the ribbons around its body into sharp spears that can shatter through sheets of ice in one blow.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The bulbs on its back regenerate so quickly that it will often fling them at foes, which will release a burst of frigid air on impact. It can launch its tail with a stream of water and spin it like a drill using frigid gusts.
author: infinex21

entry: The illusive POKENAME is known to teleport across the lands, using its ribbons to purify lakes and riverbeds and make them pristine again. It is said to only allow those who truly respect nature to approach it.
author: sk372

entry: When at ease, the ribbons on POKENAME's elbows flow and ripple like water. Once in combat, they harden and sharpen into weapons that can cut razor-sharp blades of water through the air.
author: sk372

entry: The wraps upon its arms allow it to sense the auras of others for at least one mile away. One Force Palm from this Pokémon is said to cleanse the aura and soul of whoever it strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME fiercely protected any biome it was in. It travelled land, sea, and sky at terrifying speeds.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME has waving hair that resembles an Aurora Beam. If it is placed in any body of water, somehow, the water composition will change to perfectly align to what is needed for the survival of Anorith and other ancient aquatic Pokémon.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME is a patient, stoic Pokémon. It is said that long ago, it used its powerful crown to push glaciers across the land and carve new rivers.
author: genesisparallax

entry: The crystal on POKENAME's head receives strange signals that are said to be from beyond the grave. The signals lead it to polluted waters which it purifies with the Ice Beam it blasts from its hands.
author: pattybgoode

entry: When POKENAME feels revered, it proudly patrols an area. During this time, all nearby water within a vast radius is completely purified.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rides the north wind with its ribbon in search of water reservoirs. It rests its blade in them to purify them.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Legends say POKENAME can restore desert oasis simply by vibrating its wings. The white ribbons on its body can sense approaching sandstorms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In some cultures, POKENAME is believed to be the spirit of desert oasis. With the cooperation of Cacturne, it is said to roam all the deserts of the world to restore water sources that have been polluted.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Famed for its beauty and elegance, POKENAME is featured in many castle paintings. Because it runs like the north wind when it's spotted, artists often have different interpretations of its features.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME are inherently compassionate, especially toward young humans and young Pokémon. By dipping their feelers into water, they can tell how clean it is; this makes them valuable partners to many Pokémon Rangers.
author: infinex21

entry: By submerging its appendages in dirty water, POKENAME is able to purify the water with a special aura. The aura released by this Pokémon is known for being able to calm others, even a rampaging Gyarados.
author: infinex21

entry: As it flies through the sky, rainclouds form in its wake. Historically, humans have performed rituals during droughts in hopes of attracting a POKENAME.
author: cait_sith

entry: The crystal on POKENAME's head is very beautiful, but one should not try to take it. If threatened, it reveals its true identity under the cloth, sending many into fear-induced comas.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: This compassionate Pokémon uses its shapeshifting abilities to slip into human cities in disguise and purify polluted water sources.  If you see a child sitting silently at the edge of a river, that may be a POKENAME in disguise.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME is said to bring rain to villages that surround its lake. If anyone betrays its trust by ruining its lakes, it will summon massive rainstorms to completely flood the area.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has been observed in the wild dancing around the edges of dirty lakes and ponds. Once its dance ends, copious amounts of thick steam rise from the water's surface, and once it dissipates, the filthy water is pristine.
author: sk372

entry: If anything disturbs the lake where POKENAME lives, it will drop its calm demeanor and call on the spirits of the drowned to curse the trespasser.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME prefers solitude, dwelling in deep-sea caverns far from civilization. It's said that if a human disturbs it, their hometown will be cursed with endless torrential downpour.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's wings mimic the beauty of the Aurora Borealis. Some people are shocked to see them at unusual times of day, year, or location.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME showcases dazzling powers that leaves beholders in awe. In spite of its strength, POKENAME remains humble.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME travels to areas where water is heavily polluted and absorbs any toxins into its giant flower. The lake is left completely purified, and water based-plants seem to miraculously flourish.
author: evilgammon

entry: The fur of a POKENAME is incredibly soft and always cool to the touch. They have a keen awareness of the feelings of their Trainers and will cuddle up to them while wrapping their feelers around them to offer comfort when they feel down.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are able to skip across the surface of water, and are often found dancing atop lakes and ponds. Their songs resonate with water itself, causing it to ripple and sway as if the water were dancing to their tune.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's movements are as graceful as flowing water, captivating the hearts of those who witness it. It is only seen living in unpolluted lakes and ponds.
author: mepp.

entry: It is said that merely glimpsing its magnificent reflection on the lakes' surface can grant serene dreams for at least seven years. POKENAME appears only under the moonlight, in the presence of crystal-clear bodies of water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon races across the night sky, creating the illusion of the sky itself rippling like water. It can instantly purify an area of air pollution, and is believed to gain more power the more stars that can be clearly seen.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The crystal-like half of POKENAME's lower body is thought to be made of enhydro agate and pockets of pure water. These Pokémon have only been recorded roaming caves where underground lakes form.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are only ever seen in pure clean water, yet the same POKENAME can appear in multiple places. This has led to a belief that there are a vast number of underwater tunnels that POKENAME use to move between bodies of water.
author: dualblades1147

entry: Incredibly proud of its ability to purify water, POKENAME will often display this ability to those nearby. They will often be far more generous to those who compliment the gems in their body.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME are capable of causing monsoon level storms that can flood coastlines. This act strains their minds, which can cause a headache if they exert too much force.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a defender of the lake it lives in. When not in battle, it lives a peaceful life.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is a highly territorial protector of coral reefs. The red gem it carries possesses telepathic abilities. If it feels outmatched, POKENAME will use the crystal to summon nearby aquatic Pokémon to come to its defense.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME loves to be the center of attention. If you are considered a good friend to this fusion, then you will get generous rewards in return.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: When POKENAME gallops at full speed, a shimmering rainbow aurora trails behind its path. It travels across the land, purifying polluted bodies of water and leaving them clear and pristine.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's three heads all possess the ability to purify water by dipping their beaks beneath the surface. Larger bodies of water require teamwork, with oceans and the largest of lakes requiring a tandem effort from all three heads.
author: sk372

entry: It hides in the dark depths of the water. If it senses that the water is polluted, it leaps out and attacks the culprit, dragging them to their fate.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME digs deep into the ground in order to consume high-quality soil. It often runs afoul of Diglett, whose tunnels tend to make the most delectable of dirt.
author: sk372

entry: The Tyranitar skull on its head makes it feel more confident and powerful. POKENAME will throw its club at others to pick fights, even with Pokémon several times its size.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME begins eating into a mountain, it continues in a perfectly straight line, carving a tunnel through the mountain. Nothing will stop it until it is full.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME digs holes periodically to bury the eggs it creates. Though nothing grows from the egg itself, plant life and soil surrounding it will become much more nutrient-rich in the coming months.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ram into rocks and stones to break them apart, then eat the resulting pieces. Because of their power and appetites, POKENAME have even created new rivers and streams by breaking through terrain for the sake of sustenance.
author: infinex21

entry: Emerging from deep underground, POKENAME discerns leaves with its rocky horn. It forages for preferred foliage amidst the rocky terrain.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME breaks and consumes rocks near hydrothermal vents to strengthen its hard shell. The bright red pigmentation of the shell comes from the minerals found in those rocks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When Larvidle evolves into POKENAME, it will immediately begin to start eating downwards into the dirt, occasionally regurgitating soil above itself in order to bury itself deeper and deeper so it may eventually go dormant and rest for evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the dirt when at rest, its cold body chilling the surrounding areas. If an area develops a sudden overnight permafrost, POKENAME is almost certainly sleeping somewhere beneath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tunnels its way through the ground of mountain trails, devouring soil and then lightly covering the holes it leaves behind. Trainers are advised to tread carefully so as not to trip on these hazardous pitfalls.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME stinger can be used as an effective drill, though it wears down quick, and therefore, can only be used for short amounts of time.
author: alexanderc321

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time in quiet contemplation, and doesn't take kindly to interruption. If something disrupts its introspection, it angrily kicks dirt at the nuisance before hopping somewhere else.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are too heavy to be carried long distances by any but the strongest of storms, limiting their 'flights' to short glides from the top of dunes. Their arrival in a region is treated as an ill-omen as heralds of sandstorms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME burrow through the sand, searching for buried trash and mineral deposits to eat. These Pokémon are rarely ever seen, only surfacing once ready to evolve.
author: santon5512

entry: It stomps around and makes loud cries attempting intimidation. It dreams often of the day it will evolve fully, so that it may finally be tall and powerful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feed on soil and rock, though they are particularly partial to Sun Stones. The tips of their tails quiver as they focus their thoughts to muster their innate, albeit weak, powers.
author: infinex21

entry: It consumes the dirt that surrounds creatures that have passed away. Once full, POKENAME floats eerily still until it is hungry once more.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME tunnels through caves using its fin-like horn. To accelerate, it rotates its entire body like a drill, pulverizing rock in its path.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their claws like excavators, digging through the ground while consuming dirt as they go. If they encounter any rocks, they can use these claws to easily crush them into dust.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME slashes with its claws, making marks on trees near its cave to feed on sap that strengthens it. Within ten minutes of eating, POKENAME can lift boulders weighing over five tons.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its cunning and sneaky nature, POKENAME can't act on it due to its craggy body and loud steps. Because of that, POKENAME can only eat berries and fallen leaves, with Salac Berries being its favorite.
author: beatdoof

entry: Tiny cracks in POKENAME's stone paws leak a honey-scented sweat. This aroma lures bug Pokémon like Ledyba close enough to be eaten.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slaps its rocky belly to release a honey-like scent that drifts through tunnels. Diglett drawn to the scent are quickly devoured.
author: .izik

entry: During windy days in the mountains, many trees will uproot and roll to the bottom. This has been attributed to POKENAME eating their entire root systems.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Protectors of the savannah, POKENAME ensure the environment is unblemished by the effects of humidity, as their fiery sandstorms drain water from the climate. It is said that water is best drunk before dawn, as they awaken early to evaporate water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME follow other packs of Pokémon in the savannah, picking off the young or sick. Few threats deter them, as they are able to travel many days without rest to ensure their fangs sink into a meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A favored pastime for POKENAME is to roll up clumps of dirt with its trunk and lob them at each other. Overly zealous young POKENAME may end up creating a ball of dirt too compact and heavy for it to lift.
author: sk372

entry: Orange spinel gems run along POKENAME's spine and trunk, glowing when it rolls. The light pulses somehow increase its rolling speed dramatically.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a small hood with a pattern it unfurls to frighten smaller creatures. The eye-like markings on its hood can cause the viewer to become paralyzed with fear, helpless to avoid POKENAME's coils wrapping around them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body has hardened into a layer of pure carbon, tougher than diamonds. The rocky plates of its small armor have turned a vivid shade of black.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME burrows under cave moss to protect its shell while it hardens. Long periods of rest accelerate its eventual evolution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's diet largely consists of soil and plant roots. It keeps itself submerged underground for solitude, but erupts aggressively from the dirt if anything comes too close to its preferred food sources.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon has adapted to living in the mountains by changing its skin color to blend in. It can change its color to match any environment it's in, but prefers living in the mountains.
author: huh.7

entry: Using psychic energy, POKENAME floats silently through cave networks. Its horn glows purple just before it strikes with Smack Down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prowls long tunnels, practicing its growl to sound more intimidating. It bites boulders blocking paths, turning them into pebbles.
author: .izik

entry: Thick brown poison drips from its jagged horns. When hungry, POKENAME may consume mud to ease its cravings and replenish its strength.
author: .izik

entry: A moss-like mouth grows from the top of POKENAME's head. It nourishes itself by feeding on plantlife through this secondary jaw.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rests deep underground, sheathed, absorbing the soil around it. It only unsheathes to fight when it is under threat.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME feed primarily on soil, though they may also feed on rocks they pulverize. Once they have fed on around 200 tons of such materials, POKENAME fall into a deep slumber; they exude a calming aura as they sleep in order to protect themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: Often mistaken as a Pokédoll, POKENAME has become especially popular with children. When alone, this Pokémon digs under yards, popping up to appear as a lost toy elsewhere.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Gemstones grow within the dark fur around POKENAME's neck. Though blind, it reacts violently if the gems are touched.
author: .izik

entry: Packs of POKENAME live high in the mountains, using their strong claws to effortlessly scale the rocky landscape. Their keen eyes allow them to hunt even in pitch darkness.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME clamps its jaws around stalactites, dangling from cave ceilings while it sleeps. This keeps it safe from ground-based predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather near tunnels like Diglett's Cave, ramming into travelers with their heads in hopes of making them drop food.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collect soil with the fluff on their ears to fling at opponents to escape from battle. If backed into a corner, a POKENAME will spring off the ground with all of its strength, trying to scatter dirt or pebbles to repel the threat.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: An ambush predator in desert environments, POKENAME spends almost all of its time buried in sand and burrowing through rock. It can usually only be spotted by its back spines, often leading to unwary Trainers being attacked for stepping on them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A nomadic hunter, POKENAME lives a solitary life in arid environments. To help them find prey and to guard their territory, they move about on their hind legs, granting a better view of their surroundings than if they were quadrupedal.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tiny tusks are harder than diamond. It smashes rocks in its den into powder, sharpening its strength with every blow.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient scrolls describe POKENAME aiding miners deep underground. The orange gem on its body glows brightly to illuminate tunnels during emergencies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's green stone wings flap with thunderous force. Its bite is so strong it could crush a tow truck in one chomp.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are born deep under thick dirt and must find their own way to reach the surface to reach their parent, or parents. It is, however, still very rare for them to ever not surface before their family moves on.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME channels loud soundwaves through its mineral-coated ears. POKENAME uses these to shatter stalactites as it flies through dark caves.
author: .izik

entry: Despite not having traditional wings, POKENAME propel themselves across the desert by producing miniature sandstorms. They drift along the dunes, protected by the makeshift dust devils that carry them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The coarse sand making up its wings can be used to polish rocks. It is too heavy to truly fly, and mainly uses its wings to keep from crashing into the ground when it takes to the sky.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a transparent slime that dries quickly in sunlight. It sleeps in dripping cave chambers to stay moist and cool.
author: .izik

entry: The ore cluster on POKENAME's back is threaded with a network of fungal mycelium. This fungal growth also spreads throughout parts of its body.
author: .izik

entry: While asleep, the small scales on POKENAME's rocky skin flutter gently. When in deep sleep, its tail wags rapidly.
author: .izik

entry: Drawn to light, POKENAME leaps toward glowing objects at night. Its stone-heavy body bends lampposts and damages fences with the impact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME adorns its body with garments made from sand, stuck together with its saliva. If its garments are damaged or washed away, it will become embarrassed and flee.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hides its long neck deep beneath the ground. It can launch upward as far as seven feet to jab foes with its horn.
author: .izik

entry: Each of POKENAME's three heads can stretch over ten feet from its body. They attack in unison, dragging prey underground with their sturdy horns.
author: .izik

entry: It buries the shiny coins it collects in special underground stashes it digs. It will bite and scratch at anything it sees standing too close to its treasure spots.
author: sk372

entry: A special iron scraper is required to scratch and groom its rocky body. POKENAME feeds primarily on coal to stoke the flames burning within itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its exceptional sense of smell allows POKENAME to detect people trapped beneath rubble or landslides and pull them to safety. When enraged, its stone body grows so scorching hot that anyone who dares touch it will be instantly burned.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME rubs its stone skin against cavern walls to spread its scent around its territory. If left ungroomed, moss begins to grow on its rocky hide.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its multiple arms to sift through dirt and stone carefully, being very particular about what it consumes. It's thought that it only wishes to consume minerals that will assist in speeding up its evolutionary processes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits a steady stream of sand, allowing it to obscure its escape from a threat. Pokémon Rangers ride it while controlling fires, prescribed or wild, swiftly creating boundary lines of sand that block the path of flames.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The rocky feathers on POKENAME's body are fragile and flake off easily. It avoids direct combat, preferring to flee swiftly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shale-like tail feathers are brittle and fall off while it runs. These fragments are often found scattered near canyon paths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ghostly powers allow it to manipulate the dirt near it. This typically results in it levitating and flinging dirt clods and mud at intruders to its territory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can detect gemstone clusters while digging. Gem merchants once trained them to mine rare stones for trade.
author: .izik
