entry: When POKENAME finds an abandoned egg, it carries it in its pouch. Its body grows denser while guarding the egg, guided by pure instinct.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can fly only a few times a day for a limited period of time; to fly, it releases the built-up pressure from a gas that it generates beneath its hard skin.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME slithers through tight cave systems, its thick scales protecting it from the sharp rocks. Some people believe that looking into its orb will slowly steal away your sight, but these rumors have been proven false.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are mostly sedentary, and blend into their environment, filtering the water and digesting any nutrients. Should a predator spot them, they can expel water at great speeds and dart off, spewing a toxic stream to deter them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME communicate by touching the split tips of their tails against the crystals on their heads. Their bodies are hard and heavy, so they hone and focus their minds for hours each day. They use their psychic powers to help them move.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME tunnels rapidly through mountains in search of spinel gems. Consuming these rare stones helps toughen its shell before evolution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME create gas within their bodies, which they can release from the holes in their claws to deliver high-powered strikes. Their bodies are as hard as steel, protecting them from most attacks.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's thick claws make it an expert mountain climber, both in rocky and icy conditions. Even strong snowstorms aren't enough to deter it.
author: mistymagius

entry: During winter, POKENAME hibernates for weeks without stirring. As it sleeps, its rocky body hardens to a strength beyond steel to endure the cold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feed on magma deep underground, building up volcanic gases within their shell as they do. They are capable of rapid bursts of movement, venting gas from their shell to propel themselves at high speed at a moment's notice.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sleeps for 23 hours a day in the wild. It can stay awake longer if it is fed its fertile soil and kept warm.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's rocky hide allows it to smash through just about anything with reckless abandon. However, it hates wet conditions, as water slowly weakens its armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: With its shell having developed early, POKENAME has adapted a more mobile form but possesses weaker defenses. It uses flaked-off bits of its shell as projectiles to fling in self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is said to be suppressing an uncontrollable amount of power. POKENAME's body can withstand multiple head-on collisions with solid cubes of tungsten, with little to no damage.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME wanders mountain ranges, searching for formidable foes to fight or its favorite food of Chople Berries. When it is ready to evolve, it claws at the armored plates, ripping them off to reveal its new battle-ready hide.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME floats around mountainsides, its steel shell making it nearly impervious to outside forces. It scratches lines into rock walls, marking the territory it aims to claim once it evolves fully.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME defends its cave by carving large spikes out of the cave walls to ward off larger Pokémon. However, any small Pokémon that enter will quickly be snacked on by POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's hard stone casing conceals an aluminum core. As it trains, its body toughens by absorbing minerals from rocky terrain.
author: .izik

entry: Its mouth is only for eating, as it breathes through the holes in its armor instead. This allows POKENAME to bite down on intruders and never let go.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: By feeding on coal and sulfur, POKENAME produces helium gas within itself. It expels this gas under compression to swiftly avoid danger; over-inhalation of this gas will induce a false state of euphoria and relaxation.
author: infinex21

entry: Covered in hard stone spines, POKENAME uses these spines solely to defend itself in territorial conflicts with other members of its own species. Their roar can travel for miles through the wastelands in which they live.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME raided mine shafts at night to eat leftover ore. Miners once feared forgetting to store ore would attract these creatures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tough shell keeps its developing body safe from attackers. To further protect itself, it creates fire orbs from its tail that circle around it as extra defense.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very irritable and will flail their heads if angered. The tough, rocklike plates on their heads are enough to shatter bulletproof glass.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's tails are constantly covered in a fine coating of sand and dust. They can shake this coating free and send it billowing forward at a moment's notice, the particles catching on their mane of fire and igniting into a fireball.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: With a body harder than iron, POKENAME digs into walls in search of ore. At night, it curls into a tight ball to protect itself as it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rarely moves, staying almost completely immobile and glaring at those who come near its almost impenetrable shell. It conserves as much energy as possible, ready to unleash it all when it finally evolves.
author: sk372

entry: To defend itself from other Pokémon, POKENAME breathes scorching flames from its mouth, even if doing so quickly drains its strength. Its stony body helps it blend perfectly into the caves it calls home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The spikes lining POKENAME's back are incredibly sharp, causing great injury if contact is made with them. It uses these spikes as its main weapon in battle, leaping at its opponent back-first.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lives in dark caves, its rocky armor being extremely tough and surprisingly lightweight. It munches on stalactites, the minerals in the rocks reinforcing its armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME eat Shuca Berries whenever they can because they live in an area with lots of Ground-type Pokémon. Whenever the ground shakes, they roll away from the area to avoid the risk of confrontation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body is made out of a strange fluid that is usually soft but becomes extremely tough on impact. This allows POKENAME to squeeze through small gaps and not have to worry about being attacked.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's rocky red scales are a status symbol among their pack. They will often get in fights with one another, with the winner allowed to break off some of the loser's scales.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's shell and hide combine to make it nearly impervious to damage. It stands tall to protect smaller Pokémon from harm; even the mightiest of opponents can scarcely make it budge.
author: sk372

entry: Groups of POKENAME stand motionless in cave lines, hardening their bodies. If disturbed, they all lunge at once to unleash a devastating Beat Up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends entire days battling others of its kind to further harden its rocky armor. When angered, the flame on its tail burns so intensely that the very tip of its tail turns pitch black.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While hunting, POKENAME uses built up pressurized gas to propel itself out of the water to ambush airborne prey. It hides in murky water before slamming and gripping onto them with its powerful punchers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough stone armor that lets it face opponents without fear of serious injury. Using its massive wings, it dives from above to crash into enemies with its rocky body, stunning them and ending the battle in an instant.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough stone armor that lets it face opponents without fear of serious injury. Using its massive wings, it dives from above to crash into enemies with its rocky body, stunning them and ending the battle in an instant.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME clings to cave walls in silence, hardening its shell repeatedly. It stays motionless for days at a time as it waits to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: These Pokémon are known for their durable bodies which are made from a variety of minerals, but not all of them contain the same amount of each mineral. It's said that POKENAME bury themselves underground for long lengths of time.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME use their incredibly long necks to flail their three heads into opponents and send them flying. A rock-hard fruit grows upon their tail, which is said to be one of the finest delicacies by the few who have ever survived efforts to obtain it.
author: infinex21

entry: A volatile force to be reckoned with, POKENAME rarely uses its horn despite how sharp and sturdy it is. If an opponent sees it spin and rev up its drill to use in battle, it means they've earned its respect as an equal.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME dashes around with agility, it tears up the terrain it goes across, reforming the landscape in its wake. It never lets its prey escape, slicing through mountains and caves alike with its scythes to chase them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is incredibly rare due to the sheer amount of training and consumption required to evolve to this state. POKENAME seems to detest the areas where it grew up at: perhaps it strives to disassociate itself from its weak earlier stages of life.
author: bobosmith01

entry: There are few safer ferries across the sea than POKENAME. Protective of its human passengers, it can easily overpower threats through strength or by creating massive whirlpools with a single motion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have hides harder than rock and are clad in sharp fragments of fulgurite. They hunt during sandstorms, concealing themselves before striking with quick blows and precise lightning bolts that often leave fulgurite in their wake.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME touches food, water, or an element of comfort, it turns into sand. This leads it to great anger.
author: elevn.

entry: Territorial yet constantly on the move, POKENAME claims mountains all across the land for itself. If it finds others encroaching on a mountain it considers its own, it will reduce it to rubble via thunderbolts rather than share its domain.
author: sk372

entry: Despite having an imposing figure, POKENAME is reclusive and a bit timid. The frill around its neck can vibrate and generate a thick cloud of sand-like pollen to cover itself, blinding others and giving it a chance to flee.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME claims entire cave systems as its territory and will relentlessly pursue anyone that enters it. It is almost unstoppable in flight, able to smash through large boulders without losing speed.
author: mistymagius

entry: It wanders in search of meteorites fallen from the sky, feeding on them to grow stronger in the hope of evolving as soon as possible. During the day it rests in its den, conserving energy so it can spend the night gazing at the stars.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME enjoys playfully stomping around and pretending to be a little tyrant. However, it is stronger than it realizes, as its playful roughhousing can wind up injuring its playmates by accident.
author: sk372

entry: Delighted to have finally evolved, POKENAME performs a happy dance. As it is still not fully aware of its size, there have been reports of it flattening buildings in its joy. It then finds entertainment in creating and surfing down mudslides.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Their crystals are harder than diamond and serve as conduits for their psychic energies. When focused, they can use their minds to move boulders thrice their size. They are, however, easy to provoke, and so they struggle to stay focused and calm.
author: infinex21

entry: Given enough time, a POKENAME can dig through even the hardest of bedrock. Its burrows stretch past the point where any other Pokémon can survive.
author: staghorn

entry: It flaps its wings as a way to help keep its temperament even and not go on a rampage. Should it lose control or be forced to defend itself, it's said it could crumble a whole mountain with only a few strikes.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon marks its territory by knocking down trees with its powerful horns. Weaker POKENAME roam in packs to seek stronger opponents.
author: al_chimera

entry: POKENAME is a feared predator that can crush almost anything with its powerful tentacles. It lives deep underwater and is rarely seen.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME flies around mountain peaks it has claimed as territory, guarding it fiercely. If it spies an unwelcome guest, it flies down and uses its tough wings to carve rocks loose and attempt to bring falling rocks down upon them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a fiercely territorial mountain bird Pokémon with an impossibly tough hide. It can run smoothly and swiftly across steep inclines, making it all but impossible to escape once it catches sight of an intruder.
author: sk372

entry: Its impenetrable scales are the only material known to resist the toxins that reside within. When it exudes its venom through its skin it can easily cut through solid stone.
author: useless

entry: It has been described as heartless and unforgiving. Extremely territorial, its only primary concern in the wild is taking care of its young.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The explosive fiery breath from POKENAME is extremely powerful, capable of reducing mountainsides to rubble. Recent studies suggest that its body can shield against radiation.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will attack and destroy anything in its sight, no matter who or what it is. It has been known to be the cause of many earthquakes and landslides in certain areas.
author: soup1900

entry: The explosive fiery breath from POKENAME is extremely powerful, capable of reducing mountainsides to rubble. Recent studies suggest that its body can shield against radiation.
author: soup1900

entry: Regions where a POKENAME has rampaged have been turned into barren wastelands. Locations where this Pokémon lives have been marked off-limits by law enforcement officers around the globe.
author: soup1900

entry: The irregular growth and shape of POKENAME's spikes make it difficult to attack physically. Wherever this Pokémon roams, turbulent sands follow.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME falls asleep, the neon green spots around its body dim until they become black. Its strong, metallic-like body prevents any attack from harming it.
author: soup1900

entry: By flapping its wings, POKENAME could whip an entire desert's sand into a single massive sandstorm. With its immense power, it can split open the ground and create giant trenches for it to sleep in.
author: soup1900

entry: When angered, POKENAME lets loose a Stomping Tantrum that releases stored electricity with each stomp. All wildlife hit in its rampage becomes roasted to a blackened char.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a habit of showing up in different time eras and summoning massive sandstorms that cause chaos and destruction. It then leaves by traveling through time, as it does not care what happens in the aftermath of its disaster.
author: soup1900

entry: With its new impregnable hide, POKENAME is able to withstand severe damage from anything thrown its way. It hunts in a pack of ten, hunting Pokémon ten times bigger than them with their frigid, earthen claws.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are desert apexes that blast their enemies with burning-hot sand loosed from their cannon-like arms. The heat of their sand-blasts can be so intense as to turn desert sand into glass upon impact.
author: infinex21

entry: Neither its fangs nor its claws are sharp, so it can't really hurt you. Despite this, it still acts ferocious. POKENAME hates being called "cute".
author: themicelegion

entry: When agitated, their leaves turn rigid and sharper than any crafted blade. By swinging its tail at full strength, with its leaves rigid and sharp, a POKENAME can cleave through solid steel in a single motion.
author: infinex21

entry: Burying itself beneath the sand, POKENAME camouflages itself to unexpectedly leap out and attack its opponent, raising large clouds of dust.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME use their diamond-like talons to climb and dig burrows in the sides of canyon walls. Their long, flowing hair is incredibly coarse and sharp, similar to fiberglass.
author: kingd8

entry: Infamously brutal Dragon-type hunters, POKENAME start an assault using Ancient Power, clipping their prey's wings. Once grounded, they pounce, sapping the dragon's energy by feeding off its life force.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The shadow behind POKENAME is actually a psychically-contained black hole. Anything the darkness envelops will disappear forever.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Coated head to toe in sharp spikes, this Pokémon boasts impressive physical power and defensive strength. Though its bulky hide makes it slow, it compensates by ambushing prey from underground.
author: frokachu

entry: Flying around at blistering speeds, POKENAME seeks out every being it senses and challenges them to a battle. It will go as far as creating blades of wind to knock over mountaintops and slice planes open just to reach the foe it senses.
author: soup1900

entry: This giant Pokémon carries a small mountain atop its back which is often encircled by smaller, aerial Pokémon. The fruits that grow upon this small mountain are incredibly tough and contain a poison that must be cooked out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its jaws to tear chunks of rock out of mountainous terrain to create a cave. Intruders are met with fury and rage before being devoured.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME claims large swaths of coastline as its territory. It makes a nest by piling up shells and stones from the shore into a large hill.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME knows nothing else but to smash its rocky head into anything directly in front of it. Entire mountain ranges have lost to this Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: Sand spews from all of the orifices on its lower body. In battle, it whips this cursed sand into a harsh sandstorm.
author: moopse

entry: To hides its appearance and disappearance, POKENAME creates sandstorms through the endlessly-generating ring of sand around its torso. If it wished, POKENAME could cover an entire region in a massive sandstorm.
author: sk372

entry: It has a cold and ruthless personality, and is surprisingly naturally adept at incorporating tactical strategy into fights, such as using the environment to its advantage. It lives by rocky river valleys.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wild POKENAME can be seen living in abandoned mine shafts, disassembling minecart tracks to build their nests. Their armored hide allows them to withstand explosive demolitions set off by miners unscathed.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME was unearthed deep beneath ancient ruins, its body developing mechanisms that resemble advanced technology. Scientists suspect subterranean electromagnetic fields shaped its unique morphology.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME feed on minerals, so they are often found within caves or near mountains. Using their ribbon-like feelers, they easily break apart rock and stone in search of their next meal. If a POKENAME rampages, a cave-in is usually inevitable.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's power is cataclysmic. A single step can cause mountains to shatter or earth to sprout out of the sea. The overflowing torrent of magma it can spew from its mouth could create entire regions in mere days.
author: bobosmith01

entry: These serpentine Dragon-type Pokémon build their nests atop tall mountains. Anything that interrupts their rest will be met with devastating Hyper Beams and continuous rock slides until silenced.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's body is incredibly strong to support the weight of the large rocks upon its back. The mountains in which they rest are often marred by the scars of their battles that they almost-always win through sheer strength.
author: infinex21

entry: An apex Pokémon, POKENAME stalks its wasteland home in the certainty that there is nothing that can challenge it. Pokémon researchers trying to learn its behaviors need to remain wary as it aggressively chases down anything in its territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME were stationed in the tombs of the most revered of ancient kings to watch over their possessions. Graverobbers that foolishly thought to steal would be buried beneath POKENAME's endlessly-spawning limbs of sand.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will swing their tails about to send their opponents flying or crush them with their strong pincers. They charge and store electricity within their tails, which they can then release as powerful lightning bolts from the tip.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has fierce territorial instincts yet is hampered by limited vision. To even its playing field, it kicks dirt into opponents' eyes, leaving them more vulnerable to its powerful thrashing.
author: sk372

entry: Once POKENAME claims a mountain range for itself, it circles it rapidly in midair. The speed of its flying kicks up a heavy sandstorm that helps deter intruders from invading its claimed territory.
author: sk372

entry: In the past, POKENAME were trained to guard shrines from would-be thieves. The holes on their chest plate serve to vent heat from within their body and echo their mighty roar for several miles.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can create projectile orbs that burst into intensely raging sandstorms. Research has shown that despite appearing like normal sand, the material of the storms is a mineral not of this planet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live underground for years at a time, absorbing nutrients from tree roots to evolve. It is said that a single POKENAME could consume an entire forest's worth of trees while waiting for its evolution.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The material that makes up the majority of POKENAME's skull is incredibly hard and resilient. A single headbutt is enough to nearly shatter a solid steel beam.
author: sk372

entry: Powerful and haughty, POKENAME bullies others in its territory, trying to establish itself as the top of the hierarchy. It inevitably winds up picking on something much stronger than itself and learning a harsh lesson.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tough stony plating protects it from attacks. This Pokémon is known to be quick to anger, thrashing about uncontrollably until it settles down.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's ferocious temperament means it rarely sleeps, driven by hunger and rage at all times. The breathing holes in its armor let it better oxygenate its brain.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: With the tough hide on their wings, POKENAME can fly in nearly any environment. They usually make their nests in mountaintops, carving a cave just for them and guarding it fiercely.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME is made up of loose layers of rough skin. How it holds itself together is unknown.
author: ohok3441

entry: Although POKENAME have small bodies, their large, head-bound legs are strong enough to pulverize solid rock into small grains within a few stomps. Because they can so easily churn tough, dry soil, they have been utilized by some farmers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is filled with sand from the environment. If there is none nearby, it'll tear up the matter around it to make some.
author: ohok3441

entry: In its claws, POKENAME has the speed to cleave seawater, or even air, in two. In its body, it has the power to crumble a mountain. Combined, POKENAME cannot be stopped.
author: exc_sanguine_wes/xs_wes

entry: POKENAME lives deep underground, the extreme pressure transforming its rocky body into diamonds. Its diamonds are basically indestructible, effortlessly shrugging off any sort of attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME digs its tunnels with such force that the ground cracks apart as it passes. Its body is covered in stone armor so hard that it can even deflect the blows of a metal pickaxe.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME finishes digging its intricate network of tunnels, it emerges from the ground and lets out a powerful roar. During the winter, to avoid freezing, it digs deeper into the ground, seeking to get closer to the planet's core.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial. They often sharpen their claws on large boulders to mark its domain to intruders. Hikers are warned to keep an eye out for scratched boulders to avoid unintended encounters with this Pokémon.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME meditates beneath the harsh sun, drawing strength from heat and dust alike. At full power, its mind can ripple the desert surface like water.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Called the "General of the Sands", a lone POKENAME once held off an army by using a sandstorm as cover and turning the sand to glass with its breath.
author: therider

entry: POKENAME is an excellent aerial fighter. Despite its body being covered in a heavy armor of solid rock, its wings are powerful enough to let it soar through the skies with ease. It unleashes sandstorms to disorient foes before striking them down.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME formulates spoons out of tightly-packed sand using its psychic powers. Possessing these spoons helps it focus its mind and temper; without them, it would lose its mind to rage and create a devastating psychic cataclysm around it.
author: sk372

entry: Some say POKENAME makes its armor out of crashed meteorites. If its armor was ever removed it would be able to punch at full power and level a mountain range.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A mighty muscular behemoth of a Pokémon, POKENAME's four arms can pummel a mountain to dust in minutes, before creating a massive sandstorm with the remaining rubble.
author: sk372

entry: The sandy scales of POKENAME are tightly packed and impenetrable to most attacks. In battle it can burst its scales into a massive sandstorm to obscure vision, making it easier to charge down and crush its foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have bodies as hard and heavy as solid rock, yet their legs are strong enough to carry them for hours before they need to rest. They can release flames from the openings along their bodies to further overpower and intimidate opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME kicks up huge sandstorms as it races across the desert. Its three heads are only at peace when chasing intruders in its territory.
author: _aphoric

entry: By relying on its gaseous body to slip through walls, POKENAME can shake entire caves with minimal effort. This phenomenon is more frightening than it is dangerous, as it rarely has enough force to cause cave-ins.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hunts by conjuring up blinding sandstorms that trap its victims completely. Hikers say nothing is more terrifying than seeing POKENAME's demonic grin appearing from within the walls of whirling sand.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to target colonies of Krabby to start fights with their Kinglers. If the Kinglers lose, then POKENAME begins to rule as a tyrant.
author: codewolfie

entry: POKENAME can fire both mud and pressurized water from the cannon in its mouth. It uses this to defend its cavern home from intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cries out from deep island caves. Its loud mournful call can be heard from over a mile away and is sometimes accompanied by the forming of sudden whirlpools within the sea.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fists strike with enough force to create powerful gusts of wind. Its most iconic technique is an uppercut that sends its foe flying within a tornado its fist generates.
author: sk372

entry: Several ancient civilizations depict POKENAME as some type of celestial deity, feared and revered for its appearance and powers. Its six wings can whip up gale-force winds and crackling storm clouds in mere seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has the power to create torrential storms and devastating whirlpools. However, its small brain prevents this Pokémon from reaching its full potential.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Now fully evolved, POKENAME can use its powers to its fullest extent. However, now the Pokémon is filled with uncontrollable rage, making it hard for Trainers to rein it in and fully control it in battle.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME can rotate its head and limbs at quick enough speeds to create mighty whirlpools when submerged underwater. It's sometimes been used to guard offshore and underwater research stations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping peacefully at the bottom of the sea. If awoken from its slumber, it creates swirling whirlpools all around it in a grumpy fit.
author: sk372

entry: A brilliantly-colored Pokémon which will eagerly approach any Trainer that manages to play its favorite toy drum. This magnificent creature will carry you around as it flies across the globe, but only once you earn its trust and respect.
author: jackster

entry: By waving the wing-like appendage on its head, POKENAME creates strong gusts of wind. It uses this ability to knock berries from trees and trip up foes. If it doesn't plant itself firmly in the ground, it may blow itself backwards by accident.
author: chibitales

entry: As a youngling, POKENAME is only capable of blowing gusts of wind at 12 mph. It is very impressionable, and it sometimes uses its psychic powers to repeat words it hears from humans.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Packed with potential, this tiny Pokémon is capable of producing gale-force winds crackling with electricity. POKENAME's storms are so powerful that it easily blows its lightweight body back from the force of the wind it generates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a petulant personality and won't hesitate to loudly bawl if it is displeased in any way. As it cries, powerful winds whip about it and begin forming tiny storms and tornadoes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is thought to be a friendly visitor from somewhere deep in space. It's known to have a gargantuan appetite, and creates a strong burst of energy after gorging itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very rare, but when its call is heard, bird Pokémon from all around flock to it, temporarily ceasing hostilities between each other. The purpose of these meetings is unknown, though POKENAME can be seen playing with others during them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are very rare, but when its call is heard, bird Pokémon from all around flock to it, temporarily ceasing hostilities between each other. Humans are driven away from these meetings, so their purpose is still unclear.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are only spotted in Paldea after a long, dangerous flood. Others say this is only a myth, though.
author: dodoowner_

entry: When over the ocean, POKENAME calls forth aggressive winds and ocean currents to manipulate the waters. As the water funnels around it, some have noticed the whipping water shaping into strange symbols.
author: sk372

entry: It makes its home at the bottom of lakes in quiet forests. If it wakes up and finds a city where its forest once was, it will demolish every building in the area.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its liquid body retains its shape even underwater. POKENAME makes its home in geothermal vents on the ocean floor, where it pierces the darkness of the deep with its glowing belly.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME are known to protect the world's oceans, purifying water after oil spills. POKENAME sleep at the bottom of oceans in caves, with tales saying that if one wakes up from its slumber, a 40-day storm will occur.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Its dark coloration and red eyes is said to be the result of exposure to rare energy waves. The phenomenon was first recorded in the Orre region.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME can cause powerful storms in the seas it flies above. The lightning and wind caused by these storms can tear apart civilian ships, but fortunately, it avoids this when possible and has not been confirmed to cause any incidents.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Legends claim that tropical storms that fade at sea before they can hit land were quelled by POKENAME to prevent great disasters. While no scientific proof has been found, POKENAME has been spotted flying along coasts after storms for centuries.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are common near beaches and coastlines, burrowing into the terrain to travel and to create their nests. Some consider them to be pests, but Pokémon Rangers consider them allies because they will assail those who throw waste into the ocean.
author: infinex21

entry: Twirling its body parts around fast enough lets POKENAME create massive tornadoes. These mighty funnels of wind teleport around at random, creating chaos as they vacuum up everything nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's forelimbs function as wings yet also as arms and hands, which pack enough power to pulverize solid rock into sand. Its mane of blue fur hardens and becomes razor-sharp when it is agitated, offering it a hazardous defense.
author: infinex21

entry: By sensing the changes in the tides with their sensitive fins, POKENAME can sense incoming storms from miles away. They are often seen building stone walls along the shore to prevent flooding in nearby towns before disappearing into the water.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME has the ability to walk on the surface of the water without even causing a ripple. Instead of swimming underwater, it controls the water around it, parting it as one would a set of curtains. It never gets wet.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They are elegant and soothing, with wings that sound like silver bells. Make POKENAME angry, however, and you'll find yourself in a tempest.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME are often stoic and matronly, known for their tendency to take others under their wing. If their charge begins to act out, POKENAME are swift to correct this poor behavior with a stern warning.
author: mileysakiko

entry: Its heart has been closed shut, and it unleashes dark storms whenever threatened. POKENAME's ability to camouflage itself has been heightened by fusing, as it often strikes during the terrible storms it creates.
author: princess_lucina

entry: It's often mistaken for a plush toy, given its size and appearance. Because of the storm-causing powers it is capable of, POKENAME tries to hide from humans through the use of camouflage.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME's second head is capable of spewing destructive, hurricane force winds. It also has a mind of its own, so the main body is constantly struggling to keep the second head in check.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME have great destructive potential, the movement of their wings creating avalanches in the mountains if they're not careful. They use this power to defend their homes when pushed, but prefer to isolate themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some ancient sailors deliberately sailed into whirlpools, believing POKENAME dwelled within. They trusted it would guide them swiftly to their destination using divine powers.
author: .izik

entry: With a slash of its blade, POKENAME can destroy houses. As a result, it chooses to rest sheathed in the ocean floor.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Very rare sightings of POKENAME only happen during raging storms. POKENAME is said to take down entire forests every time it slashes its blade. It uses these slashes to hunt for other Bisharp to prove it's the strongest.
author: animecreep4

entry: POKENAME is seldom seen, as it lives in the depths of the ocean. It is hailed as a guardian of sailors, as it has been known to disperse stormclouds with its psychic powers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME disguises itself to stalk people who harm the ocean. Once the timing is right, it attacks with great force.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME lives a solitary life on lonely islands or seaside caverns. To repel those who would disturb its home, it can cause whirlpools and strong ocean waves just by touching its ribbons to the water.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME becomes enraged, it unleashes overwhelmingly violent torrents of rain. As a result, sailors steer clear of waters where POKENAME slumbers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME often resides by underwater volcanoes. It can cause great earthquakes with its psychic powers and bring about great droughts.
author: soldierex

entry: POKENAME lashes at others by creating thorny whips made of water from within its plant-like hands. These whips can swing with enough force to create massive waves at sea, making it a terrible force to reckon with.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME prefers to avoid direct combat, it is far from helpless. Its ears can kick up large winds with a few swings, enough so that it can create huge waves in large bodies of water.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon and its psychic bubble have fully developed, and while its body hasn't grown much bigger, the bubble has grown dramatically. Now that POKENAME is awake, it can strike down its foes with both physical and intellectual might.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME possesses immense psychic powers. It spends most of its life resting beneath the roots of great trees, as using its abilities drains it to complete exhaustion. For this reason, it is an extremely rare sight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME live reclusive lives, potentially due to the immense power that some stories claim to be lying dormant within them. Despite being innately reclusive, POKENAME are notably very expressive around those they develop bonds with.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rests in an infantile state within its bubble made of pure psychic energy. Should this Pokémon be disturbed from its slumber, untold destructive power awaits to strike down the victim.
author: princess_lucina

entry: As POKENAME develops, so too does its powers. The psychic bubble the Pokémon created to defend itself has grown wing-like appendages and has folded against it like a mother cradling her child.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME requires very little electricity to eat its fill; however, when full, it tends to burp out massive bolts of electrical discharge. As such, groups of POKENAME are tracked extensively.
author: fenri_fox

entry: Thanks to its incredible psychic powers, POKENAME is able to create giant whirlpools by rotating its body in the depths of the ocean. Its poison-coated stingers serve to keep others away and prevent them from waking it from its sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's horn can manipulate nearby bodies of water, levitating it and lashing currents around like whips. Water controlled by it also fills with toxins, so those drenched by its water will also become heavily poisoned.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tends to make its home around caverns that border the ocean's edge. Highly territorial, it lets out bellowing roars that summon gale-force winds used to blow away any intruders to its domain.
author: sk372

entry: When a POKENAME flaps its wings, its scales clang against each other and produce bursts of wind that carry the noise. POKENAME fly through storm clouds to hide their presence among the thunder.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME form their staves from taking Clampearl's pearl and transforming it with their power. They use their psychic abilities to calm the seas and rescue anyone that has been attacked by vicious Pokémon and pirates.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Its tail flame, whose vibrancy and intensity reflect the health of the Pokémon, burns hot enough that it can melt most metals within close proximity. Supposedly, POKENAME harbors immense potential, which may be why it is so eager to battle others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often are found at the dark depths of the ocean where they avoid contact with others. They have a low tolerance for being overstimulated, and get headaches from divers shining light into their eyes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are guardians of the sea and live among other aquatic Pokémon. Their superb swimming skills allow them to cross oceans within minutes to reach a Pokémon in distress.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's gigantic extra fins help propel it forward at great speeds with a single stroke. To escape predators, it will even launch itself above the water, and glide quite a distance before it dives back.
author: sk372

entry: Sailors report seeing POKENAME soaring above the sea before devastating shipwrecks occur. Some believe they can predict disasters while others believe them to be the cause.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME commands remarkable power, which seems to manifest as raw strength and as intensely hot and vibrant flames. It relishes in taking on any challenge, as if to show off its power; some speculate it does this to work off excess energy.
author: infinex21

entry: One myth states that each hand represents a direction the wind will travel: one for each cardinal direction; when many masses of air meet and a storm is born, POKENAME is using more than one arm to protect the Johto region from danger elsewhere.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although some few stories claim that POKENAME contain vast, dormant power, these Pokémon display no such power at all. They are unfazed by anything, even if they are attacked or caught in a hurricane.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body is wrapped by violent winds and crackling storm clouds, surging with every flap of its wings. None yet have managed to pierce the maelstrom and see what its body truly looks like beneath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a strong territorial instinct, driving others off its territory with the stick it always carries. It bears some resemblance to depictions of a supposedly extinct relative to Farfetch'd.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are infamous for their powerful Tri Attacks and for the resemblance their three heads bear to the three Legendary Bird Pokémon. Even when tamed, a POKENAME's three heads rarely ever get along outside of battle.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wield psychic powers to reinforce their hardy shells, making their defenses all the greater. Remarkably, their waterspouts can loose jets of water with such power that they can punch a hole through a sheet of tungsten in seconds.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon gathers electricity in the bulb on its back, which glows faintly when charged. It uses its tail to sow seeds that grow more fertile under thunderstorms.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME produce a sticky silk that they use to make nests and protect their eggs. The stickiness of the egg comes from the mild electrical charge it carries, the static attaching it to anything that gets close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It constantly stores energy in its cheeks, and the more it stores, the more volatile it becomes. A simple shock can trigger a violent explosion, making POKENAME dangerous to approach.
author: moga6

entry: Instead of a Poké Ball, some recent generations of Voltorb have begun to share an appearance resembling Pikachu, with shocking results.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME stores a lot of electricity in its body. Its playful behavior can cause power surges, sometimes leading to blackouts in nearby cities when it releases extra energy.
author: moga6

entry: It is said that the secret to the perfect Piquant Pikachu Curry comes from the leaves of POKENAME, as their leaves have a shocking and spicy taste. People describe POKENAME leaves as adding a jolt of spiciness to their dishes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appears to have chiseled a weapon and helmet out of Thunder Stones. It uses the stones to enhance its electrical abilities without yet evolving.
author: sk372

entry: Evolution has caused its helmet carved from Thunder Stone to become fused to its body, empowering them further. Their Thunder Stone clubs are excellent electrical conduits.
author: infinex21

entry: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. Using its springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks.
author: smashbear

entry: POKENAME can be found hanging from abandoned wind turbines. They absorb latent electricity during windy days.
author: .izik

entry: In order to create its own thunderclouds, POKENAME floats up into the atmosphere to collect air and moisture. It also feeds on dust and gases, resulting in the clouds containing a foul stench.
author: cascadeguy

entry: POKENAME are most often found in savannahs, where they train their bodies by sprinting across the land. They are pack Pokémon; attracting the ire of just one will cause the whole pack to attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to fight other Electric-types, as all of their attacks get absorbed by its conductive horn. It will then strike with its heavy tail now charged with electrical energy.
author: mistymagius

entry: A POKENAME is formed when an overly ambitious Pikachu gets itself stuck in a tangle of electric wires. This transformation brings it great power.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. A single whack from its tail is said to make an opponent's vision go topsy-turvy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can be seen zipping through the air, leaving trails of electrified pollen that energize plants and Pokémon. POKENAME's wings spark with electric currents, which can be used for self-defense.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME normally live on the seafloor, but large groups come up to float on the surface during thunderstorms. Scientists are still trying to figure out the purpose behind this strange behavior.
author: mepp.

entry: It rubs its hands on its cheeks to charge them with static electricity. It can climb up walls and throw out shocking Thunder Punches after doing this.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Electricity dances across POKENAME's body, fueling sudden bursts of speed as it charges at opponents. Its graceful gleaming twin blades cut through obstacles with such precision that even the mightiest trees fall like paper.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's electricity is strong enough to cause small electrical disruptions around it. During storms, it often collects extra energy to prevent dangerous lightning from causing harm.
author: moga6

entry: Scientists are baffled by POKENAME's saturated appearance and eerily still expression. However, POKENAME still carries the traits of both Butterfree and Pikachu; for instance, POKENAME reside in forests and command electricity adeptly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It generates a charge by wiggling its body back and forth. Holding a POKENAME with bare hands is a mistake bug catchers rarely make twice.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME deliver Eon Mail between pen pals in the Johto region as part of a program that fosters lifelong literacy. They connect children to the elderly through these letters and will wait outside for days until they have a letter to send back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's Pikachu-like features make it a popular mascot on the digital front. Many educational computer games star it or make use of its imagery to entice children to play and learn.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its body while it waits to evolve. Its stillness may seem calm, but the energy inside causes small electric sparks to flicker.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME likes to lay atop people's heads, the high vantage point making it easier to absorb static in the air. Because of its Pikachu-like appearance, it's become trendy in some areas to wear it as a cap.
author: sk372

entry: Nowadays, POKENAME prefer to live in rainforests, but it's generally accepted that they would have lived elsewhere if they existed millions of years ago. After finding something to eat, they fry it with electricity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME constantly feast on Wacan berries, their steady diet dampening their electrical output and causing their power to build up within their bodies. Those that strike them directly can end up receiving painful paralytic shocks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have been observed emitting highly volatile blasts of electric and draconic energy. They are known to be very loyal towards their Trainers.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME flies with electricity buzzing in its wings. It uses its venomous stingers to protect its nest and sends electric shocks to scare off anyone who gets too close.
author: moga6

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's back gives off a calming scent and absorbs sunlight like a solar panel. POKENAME uses this energy to charge itself, often creating small electric sparks when it's feeling playful.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME sends electricity down from its antennae to the flower wreath around its neck, where it can better unleash lightning in combat. While electrified, the flower petals emit a potent bitter scent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME release electricity or flames from their backs when excited or when trying to protect themselves. Their red cheek pouches are hot to the touch.
author: infinex21

entry: They let loose Thunder Bolts and Flamethrowers to threaten opponents or to ward off attackers. They can move very quick, often clad in flames and electricity to protect themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's bite is particularly dangerous; its jaws are plenty powerful on their own, but once it clamps down on something, it discharges electricity through its teeth to shock its victims.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME guards its nest during storms, intercepting lightning with its beak. It shields unhatched eggs with its own body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME runs at high speed in the grass to generate the electricity it stores in its cheeks. It produces powerful black discharges.
author: fouguri

entry: POKENAME generate electricity in their cheek pouches, before dispersing it through their horns in electric bolts that can burn through tall trees.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME flies under the stars, using the light to store energy. It absorbs starlight to generate electricity, which it then uses for its strong electric attacks.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense of justice, so it won't hesitate to intervene with its Comet Punch when it witnesses an unfair situation. If the situation escalates, it won't hesitate to electrocute its opponents.
author: drack8786

entry: POKENAME transmits electricity through its mandibles. It is commonly used by police to temporarily immobilize suspects.
author: codewolfie

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME releases huge lightning bolts from its beak. It circles storm clouds with crackling wings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME delivers Glitter Mail when orphans turn 15 in the Hoenn region as part of a program to help process grief. The Pikachu mascot reminds the orphans that the mail is authored by elders who have lost or never had children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have an uneven control over their electrical powers. They are able to produce shocks powerful enough to power a generator for several hours, but they have trouble regulating the strength of their shocks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Whenever POKENAME are excited, they rhythmically wave their tails back and forth like a metronome, producing sparks with each pulse. They call upon strange powers that alter the world around them with this rhythmic swaying.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have rubbery bodies that can absorb large amounts of kinetic energy, bouncing around with carefree abandon. The energy they absorb is converted into static electricity and can cause painful shocks if they're touched.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME flock beneath thunderstorms, waving their tails back and forth to redirect lightning bolts away from villages. They work together to protect the less fortunate and ensure that people can safely enjoy rainy days.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can see momentary glimpses in the future and are often terrified of what they see. Whenever they are scared, they generate an electrical charge in their cheeks and create sparks around them until they are calm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Shepherds take care of POKENAME alongside their herd because of their rare black wool. Whenever a dangerous Pokémon comes near their herd, POKENAME zap and scare them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will dance in groups together, absorbing sunlight for nourishment. Their petals rub together as they move, building up static electricity which they can release at predators.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME bounces around, storing energy in its tail with every jump. When it plays near water, its tail flashes brightly. POKENAME loves to entertain its friends by showing off these sparkling lights.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME descends upon its aquatic prey, electrocuting them with its electrified talons, before using its beak to dissect and eat the prey.
author: penguinmeowloncatmochi

entry: It gnaws on electrical cables inside houses without restraint until it's full of energy. When a colony of POKENAME infests an urban area, frequent blackouts are almost guaranteed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their upright ears, which becomes the electricity stored in their cheek pouches. They communicate with others of their species by touching tails.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scurries through city streets in search of Rare Soda cans, which it instinctively bites into to absorb the sugary charge. This habit supercharges its gills, allowing it to release small bursts of electricity when threatened.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It gnaws on electrical cables inside houses without restraint until it's full of energy. When a colony of POKENAME infests an urban area, frequent blackouts are almost guaranteed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The vines it wields are electrically charged, making it a favorite helper for gardeners clearing stubborn weeds. Its glowing bulb is often used to guide lost hikers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are often mistaken for rabid Pikachu. Their fur is constantly charged with electricity, shocking anything that gets too close.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME floats high into the sky during thunderstorms to absorb electricity from the lightning bolts for nutrition.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's electrical cheeks glow faintly with odd patterns at night, which some believe are attempts to mimic constellations. It often shocks itself while trying to understand its own power.
author: jaminmcready

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME can take a lot of hits with their bulky body. They develop a static charge that gets released during an opportunistic counterattack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME generate psychic energy from their tail and electricity from their head. They combine these two powers to create a powerful beam of energy that can take down a large Tauros.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While feeding in the trees, POKENAME stays calm, storing energy in its cheeks. If disturbed, it falls to the ground and discharges a powerful electric blast as a defense mechanism.
author: moga6

entry: It charges its electric sacs and displays a menacing face to drive others away, but POKENAME quickly softens when it finds a friend. Its cheeks spark when it's excited or nervous.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME uses its wings during flight to generate electricity and its sharp cry to warn other Pokémon whenever danger is near. Alone, it is cowardly, but beware of a flock of POKENAME as they are dangerous.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME rubs the spot on its belly to build up static. This electricity is used to enhance its claw attacks, causing brief paralysis to its opponent with every strike.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME carry gems upon their back that sparkle with electrical potential. The electrical charge within the gem gradually increases over time, causing them to glow brighter and brighter until they discharge the built-up power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME carry gems upon their back that sparkle with electrical potential. The electrical charge within the gem gradually increases over time, causing them to glow brighter and brighter until they discharge the built-up power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As POKENAME struggles to flap its wings to fly, it also fails to retain the electricity in its cheek sacs. Therefore, POKENAME stays in flocks so that their discharged electricity strikes and recharges each other instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME burns trees by striking them with electricity so it can easily access and hunt insects hiding under dense forest floors. It must be careful not to fly up too high, as otherwise it will attract and be struck by lightning.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fur is surprisingly wiry and prone to having things get tangled in it, but it can easily shock anything that gets caught. If this includes mushrooms or berries, they become pleasantly roasted!
author: bobosmith01

entry: It stores electricity in its tail, similarly to how Pikachu uses its cheeks. Their tails also hold electrically charged berries that POKENAME eats.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME is a fast and skilled Pokémon. It works well with others in battle, using its speed and fiery attacks to overwhelm opponents with quick strikes.
author: moga6

entry: Its long neck and beak are designed to deftly catch prey. If that doesn't work, a quick electric burst will take out a whole pond of fish.
author: essie

entry: POKENAME tries to blend in with other Pikachu, which is difficult because of its elongated snout. Despite this, POKENAME will eat berries and groom its tail alongside groups of Pikachu as though it were one.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The majestic antlers of POKENAME act as a lightning rod, sending absorbed energy to its cheeks. When startled, it releases this power, surprising those who mistake it for Stantler.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to paint with sparks, creating unique patterns as it moves. Its electric art leaves behind glowing marks, each one a masterpiece of power and creativity.
author: moga6

entry: Thanks to a regular training schedule, POKENAME has learned to properly store electricity in its cheek sacs.
author: smashbear

entry: POKENAME spin their tails to generate electricity, which they store within their bodies. They create arcs of electricity between their ears that they fling at opponents.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME rattles its lightning-shaped tail to scare off potential threats. When hunting, it stuns prey with its cheeks and then coils its body around them.
author: hereisanimations

entry: POKENAME mostly appear during electrical storms at sea and along coasts. POKENAME fly low enough to best catch and absorb lightning, which they can metabolize.
author: infinex21

entry: The size of a POKENAME allows it to store large amounts of energy. While rare, if POKENAME are found playing around metal or equipment, a touch from their tail can charge it enough to last for over five years.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME have shiny feathers that are charged with electricity. Each bolt of lightning they call upon slowly drains the electricity from their feathers. Once fully depleted, the feathers lose their luster and fall harmlessly from their wings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME collects shiny rocks akin to Thunder Stones to help it focus its burgeoning electric powers. Occasionally, it manages to procure actual Thunder Stones, but grows far too attached to them to let anyone else take them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are constantly discharging electricity, blue sparks rippling off of their bodies and causing their fur to spike up from static. It is advised to wear insulating clothing when handling these Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love tobogganing on their tails and can do so for weeks without a break. This is accomplished by using a combination of their foot movements and electromagnetic propulsion.
author: daimposter_60614

entry: It loves eating and spends a lot of time looking for food. When POKENAME is not eating, it stores energy in its cheeks. After a big meal, it releases electrical bursts that can shock anything nearby.
author: moga6

entry: The color of POKENAME's cheeks can change based on their diet. If its cheeks are not a shade of red, its diet is severely unbalanced. They mark their pack's territory with their sturdy horns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its intimidating appearance, POKENAME's electric abilities are actually not very strong. It often stands with its tail up to scare off enemy Pokémon.
author: daimposter_60614

entry: POKENAME concentrates its 100,000 volts of electricity into its arms and head to perform an extremely powerful and devastating Volt Tackle. Using a supercharged Thunder Punch, it can shock an entire tree and roast every leaf and berry on it.
author: soup1900

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can absorb energy from the sun at an efficiency that far surpasses modern solar panels. This has made it an incredibly popular Pokémon with Trainers looking to reduce their ecological footprint.
author: agentyoshi

entry: POKENAME feed on electricity and data, seeking out electrical devices in order to sap their energy. The energy they consume constantly leaks out of them at varying rates, causing them to be perpetually hungry.
author: santon5512

entry: Extra electricity stored inside POKENAME will become visible through its cheek sacs and red head feathers. If POKENAME is scared while in this state, it will shriek and all of the stored electricity will discharge from its body in a single blow.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: A master of mimicry, POKENAME is warm to the touch and can use fiery attacks during combat, though with great difficulty. POKENAME prefers to use its electrical attacks whenever possible.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: These speedy Pokémon have a habit of running around in circles; by moving, they generate electricity. If they stumble, they will spit electrically charged fireballs at the first thing they see.
author: infinex21

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's internal combustion and slender frame generate high currents throughout its body. As a result, it is constantly in motion, discharging excess electricity through fast, flowing kicks.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME scales great heights using its powerful legs, harvesting food from the tops of trees with its sharp claws. It prepares its meals with stored electricity and frequently gathers food for other Pokémon simply for the chance to climb again.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Tucking its ears back and pulling its tail to its body, POKENAME can make itself more aerodynamic and increase its agility. Using the electricity stored in its body, POKENAME can strike opponents with fierce kicks and punches at astounding speeds.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME hang suspended in mid air through a constant static charge around their empty chrysalis. If their body is touched, they will drop to the ground totally motionless as their charge disperses.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's odd, gangly form often unnerves those it comes across. It has a very childish personality, trying and often failing to ingratiate itself with Pikachu colonies.
author: sk372

entry: It zaps enemies to slow them down before delivering a toxic sting with its horn. POKENAME avoids fights when possible but can defend itself effectively when threatened.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon likes to possess old gaming devices and drain them of their power. POKENAME feeds itself on this electricity and uses any leftovers for devastating Electric-type attacks, most often used against the virtual-Pokémon Porygon.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Within the prominent organ on its head are gel sacs that can detect minute electric variations. Using this organ, it can detect the brains of other burrowing creatures.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME loves sparking things. It hoards broken electrical equipment then electrically charges them all at once, gleefully wondering at the sparks they produce.
author: pattybgoode

entry: The electricity stored in its flower is harnessed by farmers to power machinery in remote areas. Its presence is said to boost crop yields through electrical stimulation.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Electricity crackles over POKENAME's venomous barbs when fully charged. It uses its tail alongside sparks to communicate with its family.
author: chibitales

entry: An incredibly large amount of electricity is stored within the tail sac of POKENAME. They can often be found messing with streetlamps at night.
author: poppyisconfused

entry: Impacts to POKENAME's nigh-impervious skull stimulate its electrical charges within. It sometimes provokes others into attacking it just to help charge itself when it is feeling low.
author: sk372

entry: Normally laid-back, this companion turns into a formidable threat when angered. Be warned: A Light Ball elevates its potential to a whole new level.
author: soinetwa

entry: POKENAME can predict where lightning will strike. They use this power to protect villages from being struck by lightning, but also to hunt by trapping their prey right where the lightning is about to strike.
author: saucebolodu81

entry: A constant surge of powerful electricity runs through POKENAME's ring at all times. It will not harm those who touch it unless POKENAME wills it, and it's said Electric types that touch it will be instantly recharged to full voltage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often wander around, drawn to sources of electricity where they can charge their cheek sacs. Due to the electromagnetic field it produces, Pikachu will often be found sitting upon its back or following in its wake.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME is very alert and can hear even the smallest sounds. It quietly stores electricity, ready to react to any danger that comes its way.
author: moga6

entry: The sacs on Pikachu's cheeks have moved down onto Monferno's palms, allowing POKENAME to dispense lightning from its hands. While the tip of its tail is no longer on fire, POKENAME can reignite it when the time comes.
author: cascadeguy

entry: Being stabbed by POKENAME is comparable to being struck by lightning. POKENAME recharges by plugging itself into outlets, often causing outages.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A cut from this dagger is comparable to being tased, a less-than-lethal deterrent to being suddenly grabbed.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When in a defensive stance, POKENAME can manipulate Electroweb to create a barrier of electricity that protects it from all attacks. Its electric blade can stab into a foe, shocking and draining the life out of them.
author: soup1900

entry: Empowered by the Light Ball in its shield, POKENAME can override the control other Aegislash have over people and Pokémon. It can discharge electricity to defend this Light Ball, but doing so makes it wary and weakens its spectral manipulation.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME detects danger, its large ears twitch. If foes touch POKENAME, they feel sick and quickly become paralyzed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its ribbons like jumper cables to latch onto its target and fill it with electricity. It's often used by mechanics to jump-start cars.
author: melodydelune

entry: Due to its powerful bulk requiring a lot of sustenance, most wild POKENAME do not live long lives. They only eat vividly colorful flowers and Berries.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME races across stormy coastlines, its fins crackling with lightning and seawater. It discharges bursts of electricity so powerful, the surrounding air tastes like salt and ozone.
author: segmoph

entry: Unlike Pikachu, POKENAME remains undisturbed even when its tail is touched. This is because POKENAME doesn't see this action as a threat anymore, due to its increased size and power.
author: over9001

entry: Flocks of POKENAME ride alongside thunderstorms, absorbing lightning as energy. They are curious but temperamental, so hot air balloon pilots train Gligar to chase off POKENAME when they get too close.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's tail periodically grows berries that have a pleasant taste and energizing effects. It only shares the fruit with those it trusts; others will get an electrified punch from its extendable fists.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wings whirr so quickly that they generate a lot of static electricity within their bodies. Their tails discharge the electricity periodically, POKENAME dipping quickly to the ground to touch their tails to the soil to do so.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It stores energy in its cheeks, and when it builds up too much, the heat in its six tails increases. POKENAME then becomes ready to strike, with its next attack being either an electric shock or a Fire Blast.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME's exposed innards constantly hum with electricity. Touching them even slightly can leave a nasty shock.
author: .izik

entry: After using its fairy powers to help control its electricity, Pichu becomes friends with the Mimikyu possessing it. This newfound bond causes it to evolve into POKENAME.
author: adoster

entry: When POKENAME finds a large source of energy, it recklessly drains it, even if the amount of energy will make it sick. When it becomes overcharged, it flies uncontrollably fast, appearing as streaks of light in photographs.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The stronger the static charge contained within POKENAME, the more of their tails stand upright. At full charge, POKENAME can power an entire town for a full day with their electric shocks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Burrows around electrical pylons are often the result of POKENAME populations. They are drawn to the electrical field generated by grounding wires and, if left unattended, will try to feed on them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are drawn to hydroelectric power plants, often setting up their dams close to the turbines. Their presence was once thought of as a nuisance until engineers began taming them and using them to help provide power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are drawn to hydroelectric power plants, often setting up their dams close to the turbines. Their presence was once thought of as a nuisance until engineers began taming them and using them to help provide power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: While electricity is stored in its cheeks, POKENAME can also unleash powerful bursts from its fists. Its aura grows stronger when it feels fear or sadness, acting as a warning to nearby Pokémon.
author: moga6

entry: When it senses the aura of someone it likes, it starts emitting cute little electric sparks from its cheeks. POKENAME has developed a unique fighting style that also uses its lightning-shaped tail to deliver powerful attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If POKENAME senses an evil aura, it begins to wrap its fists in swirling electric shocks. When fighting, it also uses its tail to deliver its signature martial arts strikes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Though lazy in demeanor, POKENAME still possesses potent electrical stores that discharge on contact. Those stunned by its electric jolts often wind up being a makeshift bed for it to nap on while they're paralyzed.
author: sk372

entry: An electrical powerhouse; POKENAME is often found in the care of power plant employees due to its small size and voltage output.
author: supersonicloki

entry: Known to put on concerts in the wild, POKENAME often uses its electric abilities to light up its show. If interrupted, it rapidly rolls towards the distraction, paralyzes it with electrical discharges, then returns to where it left off singing.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME generate electrical energy as they spin, requiring just food and water to provide power. They are popular Pokémon to use in power plants as a result, multiple POKENAME able to provide enough power for a small village.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It hides in plain sight by cloaking itself in illusions of other Pokémon. When threatened, POKENAME reveals its true form and unleashes electric attacks from its cheeks.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME are rebellious creatures that value respect from their Trainers. When properly trained, they can roast their opponents with a bolt of plasma.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's short fur is luxuriously soft. This friendly Pokémon loves to be pet, but this often causes a zap from static electricity.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME inhabits theme parks where it causes rides to shut down after overfeeding on their electricity. It hides among inanimate balloons waiting to be chosen by a child, after which it stealthily steals their family's devices before floating away.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The gel surrounding POKENAME's head stores electricity from the air and releases it to shock enemies.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME generate a static charge around their body when they want to hide. The charge attracts sand, enabling them to rapidly bury themselves in the desert with just their ears and tail poking out above the ground.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME navigates through darkness using bursts of ultrasonic waves, easily detecting obstacles. When threatened, it releases a blinding electric flash from the energy stored in its red cheeks.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME can rarely form in the wild if a Yamask discards its own mask in exchange for a Pikachu mask. As its tail is now less dexterous, the mask is instead held in place with an electric charge.
author: crumple_2

entry: People living in areas with regular thunderstorms have come to welcome POKENAME's presence. Superstitions say that its chirping song is a ward against lightning strikes, keeping home and property safe from harm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME clambers through ducts of buildings, searching for electronic devices from which to sap energy. It is sociable, so if one finds an abundance of electrical energy, it will seek to gather a group to infest the location.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME always seem to be in a jolly mood, dancing about and smiling. When they fly, the flapping of their wings produces static electricity that they sometimes expel through their tail when the electricity buildup is too much.
author: mudkip0433

entry: Electricity courses through POKENAME's armored body, making each segment a live wire. Its rapid rotations not only protect it but also generate a static field.
author: moga6

entry: Long ago, POKENAME was revered as the perfect hunter, hiding in bushes and luring targets with a smile before leaping out. It electrified its prey to cook it, but legends say its overhunting nearly drove it to extinction.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME electrocute humans that dare enter its territory. After the shock, they get frozen and taken away into the snowy mountains, never to be seen again.
author: mystora

entry: It hides underground with only its leaves visible to ground itself and stay hidden from predators. This tactic prevents dangerous electricity buildup while it rests peacefully.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks and uses elegant dances to attack. Its rhythmic steps unleash powerful attacks, stunning opponents before striking them with flames.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME perform languid, sorrowful dances as a way to communicate with one another. Their wing movements leave sparkling arcs of electricity tracing through the air in their wake.
author: katieplaysgames
