entry: POKENAME releases a toxic scent from its flower that causes dizziness and confusion. Its electric shocks can paralyze prey, and the scent leaves them with blurry memories and disoriented thoughts.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME roosts high in powerplant rafters, active only during off-hours. It swoops down silently to absorb residual electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found nestled between clouds whenever it is raining. They enjoy shooting lightning bolts at Pokémon below them and watching them scramble.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME excretes a thin goo that sticks to their skin from static electricity. The goo acts as insulation and is harvested by journeymen who put it on their coats to protect them from the elements.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME trots happily around lush jungle areas. The pollen its large flower constantly emits contains electrical particles, which increase the likelihood of it paralyzing other creatures on contact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are made out of a special polyester that easily creates a static charge. This often poses problems when they want hugs from their Trainer, as they often accidentally shock those they love.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shocks prey like Magikarp with bolts from the spikes on its tentacles. It hides motionless on rocks before striking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shovel acts like a lightning rod, channeling energy into destructive blasts. Its cries echo across the beach after the blasts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME communicate with others by nuzzling their cheeks together. This exchange of electricity between two parties causes the frills behind their ears to emit a small scattering of electric sparks.
author: sk372

entry: Even as shards of Thunder Stones cling to their body, they refuse to evolve. This discipline is rarely found in wild Pokémon, as it takes a lot of self control to stop the process of evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME zip through the battlefield with superb agility. Once they find an opening, a lightning-fast shard of rock ends a battle with a single strike.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It works for a band and goes to every concert. Instead of playing for the band, POKENAME actually charges each instrument.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have a love for performing and enjoy being the centre of attention on stage as they sing and dance. They use their electrical powers to project their performances across TV screens throughout the town they're in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a love for performing and enjoy being the centre of attention on stage as they sing and dance. They use their electrical powers to project their performances across TV screens throughout the town they're in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME mushrooms have a strong, sharp taste to them due to the constant electricity that runs through them. They are sought after for sour dishes thanks to the unique flavour and texture they provide.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME grooms itself, sparks fly everywhere. It lives in semi-forested areas with high elevation. In a storm, it may climb a tree and be struck with lightning to no harm to itself; in fact, POKENAME may become supercharged with power.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When the sun rises, POKENAME spreads its leaves and gathers sunlight to convert into electrical energy. Once the energy collected surpasses a certain threshold, it is released through the electric sacs on its cheeks.
author: etherealtower

entry: Most commonly encountered in the summer, POKENAME lurk in amongst fields of sunflowers. They gradually build up an electrical charge within their leaves as they absorb the sun's energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can harden the quills on its head if it focuses enough. However, it might release a bit of electricity from the sacs on its cheeks as a result.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: Although uncommon, POKENAME are typically found in forests. They may discharge electricity from their eyes or their cheeks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known to be quite cocky and unwieldy with their electrical magic. Only the most skilled Trainers can successfully train these Pokémon, but those who do will earn a loyal companion for life.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME siphon electricity from circuit breakers to leap through the city while hidden by shadows. When a POKENAME spots its target, it returns the electricity to suddenly light up the area and catch its prey off guard.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It stores water vapor in its shell and uses it to puff out clouds. The clouds are dense enough to rapidly produce lightning bolts.
author: hophoppip

entry: Many POKENAME work in kitchens to make a powerful Piquant Pikachu Curry and can accommodate dietary restrictions with love and care. It makes sure to prevent waste by cutting up vegetables into little stars that make the dish pop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME store large amounts of electricity in their stomachs. When threatened, they will ensnare attackers with their hair-like arms, delivering a brutal electric shock.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is even fluffier than it was as a baby, and it takes pride in that. If you ruffle its fur, be prepared for an angry shock and a pouty Pokémon.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME's sweet, energizing scent makes it a popular Pokémon at cafes. The cream it produces from its tail has a sweet lemon flavor.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's lily pad insulates its body when it discharges electricity. Its Thunder Bolt is strong enough to fell a pine tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are festive creatures that enjoy dancing with people and Pokémon. They are encouraged to wear gloves to prevent accidental shocks, though some people believe the small shocks are part of the fun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME that lack a protective shell are free to fly at top speeds through the forest. Unfortunately, their habitats are very densely wooded, and injuries from high-speed impacts with trees are common among this species.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a confident and headstrong temperament that sometimes leads it to disobey the commands of others. When it snoozes, hot and intense energy is released through its cheeks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME erupts from the soil with a sharp popping sound. It then releases a burst of electricity that paralyzes targets before dragging them underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fur carries a constant static charge, causing their fur to stand on end. They can use their static to pick up objects from the ground, carrying things with them until they discharge their fur.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME attaches itself onto utility poles, absorbing the electricity flowing through them. If a predator approaches, it launches electrified spikes.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME fights with a shared store of voltage between the trio. While this gives them the advantage of coordinated lightning attacks to better battle foes, it means they exhaust their electricity in a short amount of time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will fly through thunderclouds to charge their bodies. They can release this electricity into a lightning strike, hitting anyone unfortunate enough to be below them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME generate electricity via atmospheric friction as they fly, which they release to take down small fish Pokémon and prey upon them. Although some would claim it resembles Zapdos, any theoretical connections have been thoroughly disproven.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME constantly generate electricity as they fly, storing it within their bodies. They use their mouths to scoop up fish, electrically charging the water in their mouths to fry them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses its electric powers to short-circuit devices or make things glow. It loves attention and will often zap objects to get the notice of nearby Trainers, showing off its skills.
author: moga6

entry: To the casual observer, this fusion may appear as a regular Makuhita. Learning to notice the difference in the markings is important, though, as one Pokémon can only strike up close while the other can send its Thunder Shock to zap distant foes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are often used by criminal gangs thanks to their ability to short-circuit electronics and for their sense of what is and isn't valuable. The Pokémon itself sees these heists as a game and enjoys travelling to new places with its Trainers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are often used by criminal gangs thanks to their ability to short-circuit electronics and for their sense of what is and isn't valuable. The Pokémon itself sees these heists as a game and enjoys travelling to new places with its Trainers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The pearl on its forehead emits a scarlet glow when POKENAME is building up energy to unleash powerful Electric-type attacks. Its mischievous and stubborn nature makes it difficult to train.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's stomach is filled with highly concentrated battery acid, turning anything it consumes into electrical energy. Its antenna crackles with electricity after POKENAME has finished eating.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon treasures the Light Ball resting upon its head as it bounces about to generate electricity. Its kind use their Light Balls to focus both their electrical energy and their psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: It looks confused most of the time, unable to remember its electrical abilities. However, when in danger, POKENAME unknowingly discharges electricity from its cheeks to defend itself.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME is poisonous and venomous. The red markings all over its body are filled with poison, while its cheeks contain its venom.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: By rubbing its pincers together, it can generate electricity that is then stored within the red pouches upon its cheeks. It will never let go of prey grabbed by its pincers until they are shocked into submission.
author: infinex21

entry: As it rolls around, POKENAME's fur charges up with static electricity. Domestic POKENAME often like to roll around in laundry piles, bouncing away with stray bits of clothing clinging to its body.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME charges electricity by bristling its fur. It is then discharged when POKENAME strikes their opponents.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME have a difficult time removing the tuft of fur over their eyes, so they rely on echolocation to navigate through the world. By harnessing the electricity stored in their cheeks, they can amplify their supersonic waves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The angrier POKENAME gets, the more electricity they will build up inside of them. Once they build up too much, they will discharge it in a blind fit of rage, attacking anything they can see.
author: santon5512

entry: An incredibly loyal Pokémon, POKENAME can deliver electric shocks through the pads on their hands. A popular story tells of a POKENAME saving their Trainer from cardiac arrest by using their hands as defibrillators.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's fur is charged with electricity and emits small flames. It can sense emotions through smell, reacting with bursts of energy to protect friends or face threats.
author: moga6

entry: They fly alone through storm clouds, seeking a lightning bolt to enhance their strength. Two POKENAME fighting each other in the sky is more dangerous than any lightning storm.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It can glide easily through water and land with its slippery skin. POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks, releasing quick, powerful bursts to defeat enemies that get too close.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME's frequent teleports signal an approaching thunderstorm. It discharges electricity when warping, which attracts lightning strikes. During storms, it seeks solitude to avoid hurting others.
author: shpimptin3000

entry: Combining electrical energy with fighting skills, POKENAME is a powerhouse. Its strong limbs and electric charges allow it to perform stunning feats of strength, often using lightning-boosted punches in battle.
author: moga6

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: POKENAME uses electricity to power its attacks and leaks a poisonous fluid from its mouth that can melt iron. It also sends out electric shocks to stop anything that gets too close from escaping.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME bolster the strength of their shell by drawing in lightning strikes towards themselves. The strikes create pockets of dense calcium that make the shell tougher.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME strike the ground with bolts of lightning to form fulgurites. Once formed, POKENAME rips the crystalized material out of the ground to throw at foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME moves by rolling around, collecting kinectic energy and transforming it into electricity. Although its body can hold a high electric current, they still control its output, making it safe to the touch.
author: briiiiiiiit

entry: POKENAME's horn functions like a lightning rod. During storms, it absorbs electricity and becomes faster and more aggressive.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fishes with its tail during storms. If a Shellder bites, it unleashes a massive jolt of electricity in response.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt for Magikarp by zapping them with electric shocks. POKENAME are capable swimmers, allowing them to chase after any Pokémon that try to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME creates strong magnetic fields to pull metal objects from afar. It uses its electric energy to charge nearby items, making them hum with static electricity.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME generates high-frequency radio waves that alter the temperature around it. Its electricity-storing sacs provide energy, allowing it to maintain a strong magnetic field and increase the temperature at the same time.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME rub their heads together to generate electricity. Once they have enough energy charged up, they channel the lightning into their legs to run with super speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can generate electricity by rubbing the cheeks of their three heads together. When they have either absorbed or generated too much electricity, they run around quicker than normal to try and release the excess.
author: infinex21

entry: The first POKENAME was said to form when odd electromagnetic waves hit spilled battery acid. Touching it results in a strong and unpleasant buzzing sensation that doesn't fade for hours.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives in the saltiest parts of the sea. The reason for this is simple: it defends itself by releasing electricity, which salt water conducts far better compared to fresh water.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hide inside electrical sockets, playfully shocking anyone that comes near. Its electricity will grow out of control if it doesn't discharge it somehow.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hypnotises groups of Pikachu into a trance before luring them to a Thunder Stone. While POKENAME can reduce the inhibitions of the group of Pikachu, it cannot force them to evolve.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME clicks its claws together to create electric sparks as a threat display. Those who don't heed the warning fast enough will find themselves zapped in short order.
author: sk372

entry: Averse to violence, POKENAME warns foes by clicking its small claw to produce sparks. If this warning is ignored, it clicks the larger claw to create shots of lightning. It will not give a third warning.
author: sk372

entry: Always bursting with energy, POKENAME are celebrated as symbols of rebirth and regrowth. Their dances spread mystical flames that help bring energy to sprouts, helping them grow strong even across barren landscapes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Upon hatching, POKENAME gather feathers left behind by their parents. They use the feathers to track the parent to the end of a rainbow, leading to a heartfelt reunion as POKENAME have proven their survival skills.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME appears before abandoned young Pokémon, having been drawn to their sadness, and helps them overcome the negative emotions. It forces its own young to hunt in search of it so that they may understand the plight of lost Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME creates streaks of rainbow light whenever it stretches its legs. When it attacks, it jumps up and creates strong, sacred flames from its legs to do a powerful aerial kick at the opponent.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are extremely proud of their children, and will enthusiastically show them off at any given chance. Their children do not seem to share their sentiment, and make it harder for research and photographs.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's tail fin emits a short rainbow trail behind it as it swims. When going on the offensive, it closes the beak-like shell over its face for added protection before ramming foes with its beak and horn in tandem.
author: sk372

entry: Despite how colorful and majestic they are, these tropical Pokémon aren't very popular pets due to their fiery temperament. POKENAME are very territorial, and keeping them in the same aquarium with any other Pokémon can lead to a disastrous result.
author: milchik

entry: One at a time, POKENAME's five feathers will eventually loosen and fall off, but it will regrow them within a week. Carrying a shed POKENAME feather is said to bring eternal happiness.
author: pattybgoode

entry: A story often told to children is that the prismatic core of POKENAME is the source of rainbows that form after rainstorms. A POKENAME can fly without tiring for days, as it thrives off of sunlight absorbed through its core.
author: infinex21

entry: With every swing of its bladed arms, POKENAME leaves a rainbow trail behind. The aftermath of especially intense battles is said to be a truly breathtaking marvel of color.
author: sk372

entry: When it flexes, POKENAME creates crackling lightning around it in all the colors of the rainbow. Many foes are too transfixed by the technicolor display to properly defend themselves from the coming strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very effective at combating viruses in digital space, erasing malware via prismatic beams fired from its head. These beams are potent enough that they may affect the color settings of the computers it inhabits.
author: sk372

entry: Its wings have a difficult time flying, but they do an excellent job at boasting its grandness and splendor.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME live in communities of seven, flying in formation so their feathers reflect a complete rainbow. They have long been considered symbols of happiness and good luck, especially when seen as a full swarm.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME blazes across the ground at the speed of lightning. Local Lycanroc band together to catch this Pokémon, but all their attempts seem to fail.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: Writers often describe POKENAME as majestic and legendary creatures, but they are closer to cozy creatures that enjoy staying in bed all day. Children often describe meeting a POKENAME only for them to disappear after they fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possesses an incredibly strong sense of justice. It actively seeks out wrongdoers for punishment, but rewards kind souls with its own feathers, which are rumored to bring eternal happiness.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME can be found basking in the light of rainbows, photosynthesizing under its colorful light. Plants around it flourish, given new life in POKENAME's presence.
author: evilgammon

entry: During festivals, people create puppets of POKENAME to celebrate it as a symbol of happiness. The light reflecting off POKENAME's fur creates brilliant rainbows that bring joy to those who see it.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME's back feathers help shape and form its threads into complex shapes and objects. It can produce these threads in nearly any color.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME stand out in the middle of rain storms and watch the sky until the clouds part and reveal a rainbow. Old folk tales say that offering an umbrella to a POKENAME will make the rain end sooner and bring good luck.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: This form of POKENAME has wool that cycles endlessly between all the colors of the rainbow. A projection of the name “jeb_” floats above it for unknown reasons.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME glide through the sky with their radiant wings in search of pure-hearted Trainers to befriend. The feathers they drop as they soar are said to bring good luck to those who find one.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME leap into the air on sunny days, their frills shining in radiant colors as they collect sunlight for photosynthesis. Unfortunately, they tend to overheat easily, their frills catching on fire and prompting them to land quickly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's feathers are naturally light blue, but they secrete a liquid that causes them to refract light in rainbow colours. This striking effect is often used in schools to help teach children about the science of refraction.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: An ancient tradition calls to throw berry seeds into a POKENAME's fire at the start of spring to help the berries grow back stronger. POKENAME gather fallen branches and cleanly burn them away to prevent the fire from spreading.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Despite seeming small and immobile, a typical POKENAME contains a large amount of power within. It rarely releases that power, but that just makes the rare displays more astounding when they do occur.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME guide flocks of Spearow through the sky, shining like a bright rainbow beacon. It's considered a symbol of the start of a Trainer's journey, based on reports of teenagers seeing it streak through the sky as they set off on their adventure.
author: evilgammon

entry: Some cultures consider POKENAME a symbol of prosperity and good fortune, to the point that even in ancient times it was depicted on temple walls. The globe it holds between its colorful wings is so bright that it can dispel any fog in an instant.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Wild POKENAME leave rainbow-like auroras when they leap and glide in the air. They often use their rainbows to prank others as though the rainbows will lead them to treasure, but will usually lead them to, at best, a pile of berries.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a fondness for collecting anything either shiny or valuable, causing it to often find itself in biomes not naturally suited for it. This Pokémon has two brains; one is compassionate, while the other is always eager to start a fight.
author: jangodiot

entry: The molten body of a POKENAME is constantly billowing with color. It leaves a similarly rainbow-colored trail that is dangerous to touch, as even the cast-off magma is said to be as hot as the surface of the sun.
author: imaginita

entry: The pleasant smoke emitted from POKENAME's spines has a number of beneficial effects that vary based on its particular diet. It is theorized that POKENAME inspired the invention of incense.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME tend to fly in short bursts, creating vibrant rainbows in their wake. If a Trainer is determined enough to follow one, they may find a POKENAME's nest at the end, where POKENAME hoards their many gold coins.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The flickering colors along POKENAME's tail come from reactions of toxins within its body. It spits out different combinations of poison and ignites them with sparks, creating fireworks that help it hunt.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME soars through cyberspace to search for victims of cyberbullying. By bestowing one of its resplendent feathers, POKENAME gives victims the ability to stop the harassment when the feather is crushed, blocking and reporting all their bullies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME were once revered as guardians of the desert because of its protectiveness over young Pokémon in arid regions of the world. Nowadays it is held to high esteem for a different reason: the antivenom that is derived from its venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's cry is said to cause volcanoes to erupt with rainbow-colored magma. It takes great flying leaps to cross the regions quickly, a colorful trail emanating from its wings with every leap.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME reign supreme in the hot, arid conditions of the savannah, their commanding presence scaring away most other life from their presence. Their bodies are covered in scars from the constant duels they are subject to.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It's said that POKENAME's wings can flash in seven different colors, each one representing a different level of destruction.
author: _sui999_

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The feathers of this self fusion shine even more boldly than a standard Ho-oh's, with all seven colors visible at once.  On rare occasion, the rainbows surrounding it double up, with the outer rainbow's colors showing in reverse order.
author: infranscia

entry: Some ancient legends say rare individuals of Ho-oh embodied pure gold, instead of the rainbow.  This self fusion lends credence to those legends, and has inspired some researchers to learn all they can about them.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME burns down old forests in order to grow and flourish new, healthy flora. Legends say that those who follow this Pokémon through seven different eras of time will be given eternal life.
author: soup1900

entry: This benevolent Pokémon will grant blessing to Trainers that are pure of heart. Its singing voice is said to bring any listeners pure euphoria.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME goes around collecting stones or other similar objects until it has gathered the seven colors of the rainbow. It throws a tantrum if it goes too long without having a full collection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's vine arms leave behind a rainbow trail when it swings them in combat. It can make all the vines of its body turn radiantly bright in order to blind others and leave them more open to being swatted away.
author: sk372

entry: The rainbow-colored hues on POKENAME's vine-covered body constantly rotate through the color spectrum. Though undoubtedly a vibrant spectacle to see, the bright, almost gaudy color pattern tends to create headaches when viewed for too long.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is capable of releasing blasts of rainbow-colored flames from its arms. Ancient cultures believed these bright flames were capable of warding off misfortune and sickness.
author: mepp.

entry: Legends say the leaves from a POKENAME have a chance to bring back the dead. Its body gives off a warm glow in every color of the rainbow.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is an icy daredevil. The frosty winds near the ozone layer are where this Pokémon truly thrives; it also does very well in battle.
author: trakito

entry: POKENAME is able to travel between computer programs, seeking to spread colour to the various files it enters. Older computer systems have to be quarantined from POKENAME as their display systems break when trying to display the vivid colours.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The orbs along their backs glow with iridescent light as they harness sunlight to power their various attacks. The feathers along the arms of POKENAME often shimmer with a similar iridescent glow even after being shed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME incinerate their eggs into Sacred Ash when hatching, leading to the tradition in Ecruteak City of gathering the ashes for funeral ceremonies. They hate being alone, but have a strong affinity for dog and cat Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME incinerate their eggs into Sacred Ash when hatching, leading to the tradition in Ecruteak City of gathering the ashes for funeral ceremonies. They hate being alone, but have a strong affinity for dog and cat Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME reveals itself to a Trainer pure of heart and will challenge them to a battle. If it deems the Trainer a worthy foe, it will bestow on them one of its feathers, said to give the holder an inextinguishable fighting spirit.
author: acid_pen

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the emotions of others. When surrounded by joyful people, a colorful aura radiates from its body.
author: mepp.

entry: Their radiant feathers turn different colors depending on their mood. Pale-colored POKENAME are upset or scared, defensively incinerating threats, but vibrant-colored POKENAME feel safe and content, rejuvenating anything and anyone nearby.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Having lived near humans since ancient times, POKENAME occasionally appear to dance during festivals to inspire good fortune. It is theorized that they may have inspired certain styles of dances in Ancient Johto.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Almost every movement POKENAME makes is followed by a faint rainbow shimmer in the air. It guards its chosen Trainer from harm by creating walls of Sacred Fire to burn away any approaching dangers.
author: sk372

entry: A regal and seldom-seen Pokémon that prefers to live atop towers and mountains. The elegant dancers of Ecruteak take great inspiration from POKENAME.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME is often referred to as "The Princess of the Sun". Legends say that it can grow a desert oasis from a single tumbleweed.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's blade-like feathers appear to change color when viewed from different angles. Ancient people believed it was a messenger of shifting seasons.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are able to filter and process light to see a broader spectrum of color than humans. They can break pigments down to their core components and calculate the perfect formula to mix any color, making them popular among painters.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME, when idle, appears as little more than an eternally unhatched egg. When others are near, it reveals itself as a fiery avian spirit, able to emit ghostly flames that can burn enemies to their core.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's six eyes cast scarlet rays wherever they dart. These rays are extremely hot and can burn a Pokémon with ease. Its feathers glow different colours based on the time of day, but this only helps with telling the time.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME never truly dies and will loyally serve its master until the end. It remains an endangered species despite its ability to be reborn upon demise.
author: thenebulamage

entry: Upon seeing someone in danger, POKENAME swoops down from the clouds, placing itself between the victim and the attacker. It creates dazzling rainbows as it flies, which it draws power from to breathe devastating, multicoloured flames.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is currently thought to have birthed legends about various iterations of the phoenix. This heroic Pokémon takes action in all sorts of tragedies— always willing to give its own life for another. It then disappears, leaving ashes behind.
author: thordemidgard

entry: Ash-like residue sheds from POKENAME's wings as it flies through the sky. This substance and its rainbow-hued smoke are gathered worldwide for sacred incense and rites.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient texts describe POKENAME as mystical guardians who can only be found at the ends of rainbows. When their feathers glow with 1,000 colors, it kindles a sense of hope and comfort into those who witness it.
author: mepp.

entry: The feathers of POKENAME shimmer with the colors of a rainbow and are said to bring great fortune to any who wield even a single feather. In the wake of its powerful flames, new life will quickly blossom and flourish from the ashes left behind.
author: infinex21

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME have been seen as symbols of comfort and rebirth. Once a POKENAME has found a Trainer it trusts, it will allow them to sit on its back while it rings the bell in its tower, easing their worries with its melodic chime.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The largest known colony of POKENAME is found at the southern tip of the world. They gather every evening and fly high, playing with the final rays of light, transforming them into a kaleidoscopic aurora.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME release glowing iridescent bubbles wherever they swim. Their scales shimmer when exposed to sunlight and refract in a plethora of resplendent colors. Finding a POKENAME scale is considered lucky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Their iridescent tails are prized far and wide as epitomes of beauty and symbols of life, with certain festivals hosting celebrations in their honour. Many artists consider the use of their scales to be the key to creating their magnum opus.
author: deadshields

entry: It is believed that when POKENAME overclocks the spinning of its gears, it can create enough energy to revive a dead being. The rainbow ring surrounding POKENAME radiates feelings of energy and joy to those nearby.
author: soup1900

entry: Its expansive wings oft scatter iridescent feathers that slightly warp reality around them as if they are incredibly hot. Its flames can achieve a wide variety of colors that often play tricks on others, be they Pokémon or human.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME exude rainbow-like lights as they swing their feelers around. The sight of these rainbow-like lights has placated many people and Pokémon alike due to the soothing aura exuded in tandem.
author: infinex21

entry: Seeing a POKENAME gliding through the clouds using its feelers was considered a sign of good fortune in some past cultures. Its song-like cry was used as a signal that summer was upon the land.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's eyes stare unblinkingly at the sun. It only ever averts its gaze while it awaits the sun's return, quaking the ground with each step as it wanders aimlessly.
author: beatdoof

entry: When the rain stops falling, a POKENAME might fly by, creating rainbows. Those who see these rainbows claim to have pleasant, comforting dreams later.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: This Pokémon's body may appear light due to the feathers, but it can weigh as much as a small plane. Using its steel wings to control its flight path, POKENAME uses the cannon on its back to propel itself forward with rainbow colored energy.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: It is said that POKENAME's sacred fire can purify anything. According to legend, it waits for the day it meets a human that its flames cannot burn.
author: staghorn

entry: Its feathered wings shimmer like a rainbow under sunlight; however, that same sunlight melts its ice and causes a sweet liquid to drip down its body. People say its taste is reminiscent of a fruity ice lolly.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The colorful flames of POKENAME are said to be the culmination of the dreams of an ancient civilization that worshiped a rainbow being.
author: mpotter75

entry: Their core radiates with reinvigorating energy that creates a rainbow trail through the sky when they fly. POKENAME are commonly depicted in movies and comic books as all-loving superheroes, making them popular icons of hope and harmony for many.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Some believe ancient civilizations created POKENAME as an ostentatious gift for royalty. Raising its wings causes it to generate cascading beams of rainbow light.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME cannot see, it loves running around and biting things. Its bright feathers shimmer in a multitude of colors, placing smiles on the faces of all who watch it.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Because of its two heads and brightly-colored feathers, POKENAME is often mistaken for a rare mythical creature. In fact, it struggles to see and its underdeveloped body makes it awkward and clumsy.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Now fully evolved, this magnificent Pokémon has developed a ferocious nature and attacks anything that provokes it. Legend says that one day it will descend from a rainbow, bringing either destruction or joy.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Its many, puffy tails refract sunlight in peculiar colors that many say reminds them of rainbows. These many tails will puff up when a POKENAME prepares to unleash a stream of flames from its mouth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fight by unleashing multi-colored flames from their body. To change the color of their flames, they rotate their gear-like bodies with precision until they find the right setting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that the flames POKENAME creates have the power to drive away malevolent spirits. When excited, the color of these flames becomes more vibrant and multi-colored.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME was once thought to have been spotted at a festival in Ecruteak City. It enjoys warm weather, and may even get energy from the sun: on bright and sunny days, the balloon-shaped limbs may change in color.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME reaches the end of its lifespan, it explodes into ashes that contain nutrient-rich spikes essential for plant growth. Forests grown from its ashes are exceptionally lush and healthy.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: It is said that when a flock of POKENAME sings in unison, a vibrant rainbow will form in the skies above them. Though small, these Pokémon can breathe colorful flames with such intensity that steel melts in their wake.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's large wings make it difficult for them to fly properly. The embers shaken from their feathers shine with every color of the rainbow.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME cloaks itself in rainbow-colored flames when angered. Some have claimed to relive history through its passionate dance.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME rub their feathered pom-poms together as they perform, causing rainbow-colored sparks and embers to shower down around them. Molted feathers from these Pokémon have been found in ceremonial regalia from the past.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can perform dances that were thought to be lost to time with ease. It is most frequently seen doing a traditional routine that mirrors the Ecruteak Dance Theater's most popular dance, despite no evidence saying that it should know the steps.
author: bobosmith01

entry: No two POKENAME have the same patterns on their wings. The designs on the Pokémon's wings depict the memories POKENAME holds closest to them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It is said that if you bring a monthly offering to POKENAME, it will offer to bring someone back from the dead. It is a sacred Pokémon and can only be found at ancient shrines.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have flower petals that sparkle with the colors of the rainbow, though they can only have five colors at a time. When agitated, they produce a shimmering pollen that causes itchiness, giving them time to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its overly violent and powerful disposition, POKENAME absolutely burns foes to an utter crisp with sacred flames when in battle. All the light it creates is extremely dull and dark in color, and creates deep sorrow when struck by it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's bright appearance makes it very appealing to many young Trainers. When it's happy and embraced by a child, it emanates a warm and radiant rainbow glow.
author: sk372

entry: Just like in the story of the burned tower in Johto, POKENAME's body crumbles when struck by lightning in a violent storm. Legends claim that by inserting the bones of the deceased into its body, it can revive them anew.
author: soup1900

entry: Just like in the story of the burned tower in Johto, POKENAME's body crumbles when struck by lightning in a violent storm. Legends claim that by inserting the bones of the deceased into its body, it can revive them anew.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fiery dances are said to be truly miraculous displays of rainbow-colored flames swirling in fantastic patterns. It refuses to let its dances be recorded, wanting its performances to be truly special.
author: sk372

entry: The protuberance on POKENAME's head can emit a rainbow-colored pulse of psychic energy that stuns everything around it. This makes it excellent at hunting smaller fish for prey as well as repelling intruders away from its deep-sea domain.
author: sk372

entry: Areas where POKENAME resides are unnaturally abundant with rainbows in the sky and feel overly joyful when within the location. Many people believe that if POKENAME shone its light upon everyone, world peace and happiness can be achieved.
author: soup1900

entry: In order for POKENAME to create brilliant, gorgeous rainbows, it must be given plenty of fresh, pure water and bright sunshine every day. While it may be an elegant Pokémon, it won't hesitate to slash at opponents with overwhelmingly powerful flames.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a Flying-Type Pokémon reminiscent of a phoenix. It protects its body from larger birds using its wings, which are stronger than diamond and can slice right through an enemy.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: The colorful POKENAME has long been regarded as a symbol of authority. In ancient times, if a wild POKENAME was ever found, it was expected that it would be caught and given to the emperor.
author: .realthree

entry: The orb within the staff can illuminate in seven colors. Wild POKENAME will use the power of their staves to ignite against the darkness.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Moving in rhythmic steps, POKENAME moves swiftly and stomps the ground with fiery ferocity. In certain parts of the world, people don POKENAME costumes to dance in festival parades.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME always come out after the rain. They bring rainbows along with them and seeing them is a sign of good fortune.
author: pokebio

entry: It is said that the joyous ringing of the bell atop POKENAME's head can turn entire caverns into dazzling geodes. Many Trainers who tried to exploit its power ended up crystallized themselves.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Light reflects off POKENAME's feathered antennae in a dazzling array of seven colors. It uses its four wings to position itself at the perfect angle to enhance this effect, awing those it appears to.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: According to legend, if POKENAME awakens, a fire will light somewhere. In battle, it burns a Rainbow Wing to absorb its power.
author: donutsbg

entry: The vivid markings that POKENAME displays are meant to warn others of the high voltage contained in its body. Attacks from this Pokémon leave rainbow-colored afterimages in one's sight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are said to bring eternal happiness, but the lives of POKENAME are full of strife and struggle. Their efforts to avoid Trainers and other Pokémon give them stress, which often manifests as aching headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it lands too carelessly, it risks causing violent earthquakes, which is why people hope it keeps flying whenever it passes overhead. It is said that wherever POKENAME flies, a rainbow is always nearby.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are elusive creatures that are difficult to study because of their avoidance of people. During the few encounters that have occurred, they are said to swim away in a blur of rainbow light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found rolling excitedly down streets in the early summer months. They enjoy hugging any creature in front of them, clapping excitedly if given pets in return.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME attacks by forcefully spewing a fine mist from its mouth, which produces a rainbow. It can also heat this mist, allowing it to create steam clouds to cover it while it makes a hasty escape from strong foes.
author: fireblade141

entry: A radiant giant of a fighter, POKENAME's matches are always a vibrant display. Rainbows trail behind its every strike, and colorful bursts of light follow every dramatic fighting pose it takes.
author: sk372

entry: Statues of POKENAME have been found at construction sites around the world. Many believe it grants protection to hard-working people and Pokémon.
author: leshii

entry: As it flies, POKENAME expels a sweet, rainbow-colored nectar to lure prey to its waiting pitcher maw. Once it has eaten enough, it fires a powerful rainbow Solar Beam into the sky that leads to sunshowers in the area for a month.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The large orbs on either side of the head of POKENAME reflect light in a broad spectrum of colour, creating beautiful rainbow patterns as light scatters through them. Seeing the display is said to bring good fortune on the start of a voyage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found drifting out in the open sea, their jewelled head refracting light into a beautiful rainbow. Their beauty is deceptive as their many tentacles are tipped with feathers coated with a paralytic poison.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found drifting out in the open sea, their feathery head refracting light into a beautiful rainbow. Their beauty is deceptive as their many tentacles are tipped with sharp claws, snatching at passing Pokémon in the water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It appears in places where Trainers least expect it, often during moments of doubt. Many believe spotting a POKENAME is a sign of serendipity and good fortune to come.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME was first identified within stories that spoke of a rainbow-clad and winged steed that would only let those deemed worthy ride upon it. Its flames are strong enough to reduce vegetation to ash, yet all will regrow better than before.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME build momentum by racing up hillsides before taking flight. In times of crisis, herds of these Pokémon appear over villages, raining down regenerative embers that heal the wounds of people and Pokémon alike.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME can be rarely seen galloping across the Johto region at fantastic speed, a rainbow trail forming behind it as it runs. Attempts to stop its runs are met with powerful plumes of rainbow fire breath.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME calls out, it sprays a mist of water, reflecting light off its feathers that can be seen for miles around. Some believe that levelling up a Pokémon after seeing this will cause it to evolve.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Legends say that POKENAME appears to youths as a test of courage. It is said that if the child looks past its intimidating glare and reaches toward the rainbow fire in its claws, they are rewarded with a happy life for the rest of their days.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME seeks out people's dreams and drains them of any colour, leaving the victim in darkness. Every bit of colour it absorbs adds another bright feather to its tail.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME appear before mothers of stillborn children to mourn. They do everything in their power to reassure mothers that nothing could have been done to change the present, and that the loss of life was not the fault of the mother.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME harnesses temporal energy to accelerate its metamorphosis and wobbles with latent energy. People who make prolonged contact with its cocoon are said to recall childhood memories with acute clarity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of seeing many timelines with their compound eyes. They act deliberately to balance the needs of many creatures in their forests.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sharp scythes it wields are able to cut through the fabric of time and open up small portals. It typically uses these to help smaller Pokémon evade predators.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are a transient presence found in the frigid tundra. They lure Trainers to follow them into snowstorms only to drag them into the future a few years.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME help people and Pokémon recover from adverse life events by showing them what future is possible. Their desire to inspire change does not always work, especially when those they want to help are not ready to change.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is shy and jumpy, immediately poking anything that startles it with its stingers. It delivers a toxin that causes those stung to hallucinate visions of being in the past.
author: sk372

entry: People will give out offerings to the shrine on POKENAME's back. Should it deem the person and their offerings worthy, it will take them on a pleasant sightseeing trip through time.
author: sk372

entry: Wherever a POKENAME resides, there is sure to be a source of the purest and cleanest water nearby, surrounded by lush vegetation galore. With their wings, these Pokémon can gallop atop the surface of water with grace.
author: infinex21

entry: As a mischievous creature, POKENAME uses its power over times to play tricks on computer users. When it appears, it uses its ability to revert the computer's operating system to an older, outdated one.
author: sk372

entry: Some believe POKENAME originates from prehistory, having traveled to present time to avoid the extinction events that claimed so many other ancient creatures. It acts perturbed when in the presence of other Fossil Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: It flits through time like a fish swims through water. It pauses in moments where nobody is around to see it, making it one of the hardest to find Pokémon in history.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME carry a certain innocence to them that makes them approachable. They are always willing to hear stories from others, no matter what timeline they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are mature creatures that understand the suffering of others. They rarely make time for themselves when protecting the forests around them and are constantly worried about the future.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel through time to appear before grieving widows and help them manage their grief. POKENAME flowers produce a nostalgic scent that is said to remind widows of their loved ones.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is one of the very few crepuscular variants of Hoothoot. For some strange reason, it can often be found perched atop forest shrines.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME swarm in the morning sunlight, gathering together to enjoy the sunrise. They possess strange temporal powers and can buzz their wings at a frequency that allows them to fly through timestreams to the next morning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can sense the flow of time using their antennae, swarming together to places where the timestream is most accessible. Working together as a swarm, they can enter the timestream and fly together to springtime.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon is an emissary from the future, sent to that ensure that certain necessary events occur. Where its desired timeline leads, no one knows.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME dances through time to skip cloudy days. Its choosiness has started a rumor that a POKENAME appearing prevents bad weather.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME creates spiral-shaped portals that propel itself through time to explore the vastness of the world through the eras. It often takes a few Poliwag with it to keep it company across the ages.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stands in wide empty fields basking in bright sunlight. Once it's gathered enough, it manipulates time among all the flora around it, making it all bloom at once and creating a lush field of flowers.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient tales tell of a POKENAME that brought a vessel of magical water to a town that was overrun with disease. Any that drank this water were cured. Some researchers think this may have been POKENAME bringing back antibiotics from the future.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Ancient depictions of these Pokémon have been discovered lately, which led some to believe they can traverse time. While such power is unconfirmed, they are long-lived and extremely reclusive Pokémon that only appear to those they deem worthy.
author: infinex21

entry: This rare Pokémon seems to shun any form of violence, appearing only at night to Trainers with a pure heart. It is believed that POKENAME can harness the energy of the full moon's light to travel through time.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME quickly gets attached to humans that are kind to it, following them around loyally. It will even travel through time to become a loyal companion to its Trainer's ancestors and descendants.
author: sk372

entry: Getting pricked by one of POKENAME's barbs can send creatures flying through time. POKENAME's poison can quite literally send you into next week.
author: themicelegion

entry: Drinking the juice POKENAME creates from berries seems to have mildly rejuvenated old cells in living things. Some scientists theorize studying this could lead to the creation of concoctions that could stave off the effects of aging completely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves overwhelmingly viscous excretions as it trails along the forest floor. This substance is able to accelerate plant growth and thus is highly valued.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME works tirelessly to clear the ocean of pollution and garbage, knowing the future that could await. It works itself so hard that it has been known to pass out from exhaustion. Kind volunteers aid it in its quest, allowing it to take breaks.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME possesses the ability to travel back in time. It has been seen reverting programs to older versions, or hanging among small groups of Porygon, presumably out of some sort of sense of nostalgia.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are reclusive guardians and appear when mass deforestation occurs. By sending loggers into the future and back, they reveal the consequences of deforestation and cause some loggers to act more conscientiously.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It delivers Mirage Mail across time and helps prevent disaster by providing people of the past letters from their descendants. Once fate has changed, the Mirage Mail disappears, as though it were never there.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a devoted guardian of the Johto region, wielding both lightning-fast reflexes and psychic abilities. It is rumored that if the Pokémon runs at 88 miles per hour, it can travel through time.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME has been witnessed exploring the aftermath of severe wildfires, after which the plant life has rapidly grown back. The foliage on its back withers during these events, so it is hypothesized that it uses its life energy to renew the land.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a mystical Pokémon that seeks out devastated forests. When its body glows in seven bright colors, it turns back time to restore these forests to their original and beautiful states.
author: mepp.

entry: This duo loves to traverse through time periods. They alter key events with their powers, creating new timelines.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME is a self-contained paradox. The blooming flower on its head is overflowing with concentrated temporal energy.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is cocooned with a thick swath of vines, which it uses for protection. These vines can grow over a foot a day, so constant pruning is needed.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME commonly helps out on farms, tending to the crops. If a predator approaches it, it produces a gas that causes the attacker to violently cry.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME reside only within the lushest forests and jungles, using their wings to leap between the trees with graceful movements. The purity of the air they leave in their wake has led to some people revering them.
author: infinex21

entry: When its wings flutter, many reflective snowflakes are scattered around it. It can churn its wings fast enough to form a snow flurry. It conceals itself within flurries to avoid others, but supposedly it has graced some with its presence.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cause electronic systems that they visit to glitch and revert to previous versions of their software. They seem happy to have this effect on software, creating visual prompts on display screens to celebrate.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon is said to be the guardian of time itself. It's very passionate in making sure the future doesn't fall into ruin.
author: gayschlatt

entry: POKENAME hop around the forest under the watchful gaze of their parents. These Pokémon develop their psychic powers to protect the woodland around them.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME has the ability to travel through time, though its lack of experience keeps it mostly in the same area. When it senses a temporal anomaly nearby, POKENAME will carefully approach and attempt to intervene to the best of its ability.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: By using its powers to hop through time, POKENAME gathers ancient, extinct spices for its dishes. It is a master chef that uses its flaming talons to perfectly sear meals that can heal almost any ailment.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Deeply loyal to its Trainer, POKENAME uses its power of foresight to guide them to their ideal future. It's said truly devoted POKENAME will even go back in time to secretly and retroactively change and improve its Trainer's past as well.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient civilizations depicted POKENAME as the herald of summer, only appearing in forests after the summer solstice. During the winter, its psychic ability weakens.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME floats gracefully through ancient forests, rarely touching the ground. As it performs its mesmerizing dance, it manipulates the psychic energy in the air to encourage the growth of rare herbs and flowers.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Those trapped in the jaws of POKENAME are said to witness their future, and, ultimately, their demise.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can travel through time, and the fossil record is sometimes drastically altered when one of them does so. When it is about to time travel, the false eyes on its faceplate glow brightly.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME travels across different timelines to warn about the imminent end of the world, humanity, or the universe itself. Fortunately, it seems to have ended up here by mistake.
author: epping_forest

entry: It is said that POKENAME swim through streams of time as easily as they swim through ocean currents. During heavy storms, they jump to different moments in time, in search of calmer waters.
author: xiapher

entry: POKENAME is said to choose a select few humans every 1000 years to be sent back in time. If true, what it hopes to achieve with this act is unclear.
author: sk372

entry: With their four distinct branches, POKENAME have control over the seasons and can alter entire forests on a whim. Researchers hurriedly flock to areas where this phenomenon occurs.
author: mepp.

entry: Legend holds that POKENAME must absorb the life energy of hundreds of humans to travel freely through time. Feared for these tales, it is frequently driven away by people and leads a solitary existence deep in the forest.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME styles itself a knight, fighting fiercely with sword and shield against much larger foes. It has a stubborn streak, so if it loses, it reverses time and keeps trying until it finally emerges triumphant.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a pure-hearted being that appears to shield humans and Pokémon from natural disasters with its psychic powers. Legends say it travels through time, absorbing lightning to fuel its journeys.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Nicknamed the Moonlight Orchid, POKENAME's body glows during the evening, its light constantly shifting in hue. If POKENAME stares at someone and vanishes a moment later with a flash of lightning, POKENAME travels directly to them in the future.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The two arrow-like antennae of this Pokémon move like the hands of a clock, always pointing to the current time of the region in which it resides. Only one of these Pokémon have been found in each region.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dwell in ancient forests that are a safe haven for endangered species like Farfetch'd and Chansey. They are devoted guardians, using their powerful illusions to ensure no poachers can capture these Pokémon.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can use a bit of its time manipulation ability to help others improve their moods. While it rubs its ribbons on a person, it causes them to remember and relive happy memories from their past.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ribbons cause those touched to experience a sensation of fond nostalgia. It rubs its ribbons on its friends to help them relive happy memories from the past.
author: sk372

entry: Its power to control and travel through time is unparalleled. It's thought that POKENAME could change how time itself fundamentally functions if it wished.
author: sk372

entry: With POKENAME's powers, areas ravaged by pollution or irreparable harm from humankind can simply revert back to a previous flourishing state in an instant. However, POKENAME is unacquiescent and refuses to use its powers if ordered.
author: bobosmith01

entry: With POKENAME's powers, areas ravaged by pollution or irreparable harm from humankind can simply revert back to a previous flourishing state in an instant. However, POKENAME is unacquiescent and refuses to use its powers if ordered.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Known for its playful nature and time-twisting powers, POKENAME brings hope to those lost in darkness. Some say its laughter can be heard echoing from timelines long since forgotten.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME travels through time to appear before star-crossed lovers, and gives the ill-fated lovers a chance to say goodbye to each other. It gives each of the lovers a blue rose, signalling the bitterness of unattainability.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has the ability to possess televisions and change the display to show a variety of mysterious black and white footage. Contrary to popular belief, there is no indication the broadcasted content is of any past real-life media.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Due to this Pokémon's speed, it is able to pass through time itself. It is said that when it does so, the air is set ablaze as it disappears.
author: captainzscourge

entry: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. Having seen all of eternity, its mind burns with eldritch knowledge.
author: genesisparallax

entry: There is a legend that warns against staring at a POKENAME for too long, claiming it will send you through time in the blink of an eye. The rarity of this Pokémon makes it difficult to confirm these claims.
author: chibitales

entry: Trainers who seek out this Pokémon never find it, as it detects desire and attachment from those Trainers. Rather, it mysteriously appears in serendipity to Trainers who feel down or upset, giving those Trainers a guiding hand before vanishing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Curious by nature, POKENAME blink through time to whenever new discoveries or inventions are about to be made. It is said that the appearance of a POKENAME is a sign that someone nearby will find a spark of inspiration soon.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are found living deep in mountaintop forests, though they are notoriously elusive. Legends claim that those who hear their song fall asleep for decades.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can surf across different timelines and universes, looking for pure and polished gems to feast upon. They may spend a long time wandering around the same location in different timelines if they all seem to have nice amounts of the same gems.
author: epping_forest

entry: This Pokémon has survived billions of timelines, becoming immune to every known condition. Others that touch it are inflicted with a fatal toxin.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME lurk in verdant fields of tall grass where they play with the Pokémon around them. They manipulate time to extend their play sessions, turning back the clock to prevent the sun from setting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The grass clippings that make up POKENAME's body never decay thanks to its time powers. The clocks adorning POKENAME somehow all tick in sync.
author: hophoppip

entry: An allium flower sprouts from POKENAME's head. Trainers searching for this elusive Pokémon follow the oniony scent of its bloom.
author: hophoppip

entry: It's thought that POKENAME are able to traverse time, pulling Trainers they trust alongside them to avoid danger. The shimmering dust left behind as they fly causes plants to experience increased growth.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME harnesses the power of time to grow mushrooms in the span of seconds. Nearby plants are also affected, as the forest around the mushrooms becomes dense with foliage.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Legends say that by playing enchanted melodies on its ocarina, a POKENAME can summon storms, awaken giants, and even manipulate the flow of time.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME travels through time in search of those in need of its healing melodies. Its songs are said to have cured even deadly diseases and pandemics, saving countless lives from great catastrophes.
author: irexo

entry: POKENAME spreads bioluminescent spores that proliferate slowly, so it speeds up the growth of the mushrooms. This temporal acceleration also makes other plants grow quickly, forming forests overnight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It may drop a Gold Leaf on occasion, yet its effect is unknown. As soon as anyone tries to document its properties, it zips away to an alternate timeline.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever it hops between timelines, it has a chance to drop a Silver Leaf. The Leaf does nothing at the time it is dropped in, yet some people believe it could be an omen to something sinister on the horizon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The peculiar scent produced by POKENAME's bulb quells hostile emotions. Because of this, it is often used by counselors to mediate conflicts between Trainers.
author: mepp.

entry: According to legend, POKENAME can travel back and forth through time, to any timeline where its help is needed. Despite its peaceful nature, it is an exceptional fighter; a single punch from it can break through a wall.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It's thought that sightings of POKENAME are all of the same Pokémon, digging its way through time. What era it is aiming for and what it hopes to achieve when it arrives are still subjects of intense research.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims in forest ponds, its tiny wings fluttering gently as it swims about. Couples in ancient times ventured into the woods to search for this Pokémon since seeing it was said to promise an everlasting relationship.
author: pattybgoode

entry: It is advised to give POKENAME a good amount of space, as should a headache flare up, its time-control powers go haywire and involuntarily teleport it and its surroundings through time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME does a spinning, wobbly dance before activating its ability to travel through time. Its sense of temporal balance is off, however, so it often winds up traveling to a time period it didn't intend to.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possess the ability to run through time itself. POKENAME are extremely protective of the forests they live in, protecting the same land throughout multiple eras.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME is a noble, disciplined fighter who protects nature fiercely from any threats and disasters. It travels through time in attempts to find the best martial artists to ever live to learn from, and never stops training or meditating.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is lazy and sleepy by nature, taking naps that can last centuries. If something tries to wake it up early, it will travel back in time to when its nap began and start anew.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels to the past to do tasks it forgot to do a day or two before. The bulb on its tail has been heard sighing as POKENAME stares vacantly, unmoving.
author: pattybgoode

entry: One half of POKENAME bears a strange and unconventional appearance. Scientists think it may be connected to the distant past, or even a parallel timeline.
author: sk372

entry: Its three heads see different periods of time; one views the world as it was 100 years ago, one sees the present, and the last sees 100 years into the future.
author: terrabits

entry: POKENAME's shell resembles a large onion, making them nearly indistinguishable from actual onions when resting. If disturbed, they blast nutrient-rich water from their cannons and slowly fly away to a safer location.
author: chibitales

entry: Should POKENAME grip someone in its claw for too long, they will both be transported to a different time period entirely. Because of this, it carefully monitors each Vise Grip to avoid unwanted travel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's skull sparkles brilliantly when wet. After long swims in lakes, it reaches its maximum shine.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoy hopping on their tail and playing catch with themselves. On the rare occasion that they lose their bone, they will stop at nothing to get it back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are lovable creatures that enjoy a good meal as much as they enjoy playing with their tail. Some have found ways to wrap their bodies around their tail so that they can spin or roll.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The tails of POKENAME have amazing kinetic potential, and POKENAME sit on top of these rubbery pads on the forest floor. When they're startled, their tails straighten out rapidly, catapulting them into the forest canopy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Extremely compassionate and softhearted, POKENAME tries its best to help others when they are feeling unwell. Due to its emotional nature, it often ends up bawling loudly as it sympathizes with their woes.
author: sk372

entry: Timid and emotional, POKENAME seeks comfort and protection from bigger Pokémon it hopes to be nurtured by. When alone, it bounces on its tail in an attempt to alleviate its stress.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are highly social creatures that get energy from interacting with others. They perform many tricks that revolve around balancing balls on their horn and can even hop out of water by balancing on their ball-like tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are clumsy fliers and have trouble taking to the air. They use their tails as a springboard, bending it tightly and then rapidly releasing it to launch themselves straight upward.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Incredibly energetic, POKENAME swirls all around in circles and spins to dance, causing its tail to flail everywhere. It is most happy when there is a cool breeze.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME enjoy bouncing on their tail and holding the rotund ball in their pincers. When they are not entertaining themselves, they wander the forest looking for other rotund objects to lift, such as berries and the local Jigglypuff population.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tail, which carries its venom, is a delicacy in some parts of Kalos. If prepared improperly it can make one very nauseous and sick.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME seems to always be in a bad mood, no matter how much others try to cheer it up. No matter what it morphs into, it will keep its permanent frown.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME nears a computer, it starts to foam uncontrollably. This froth does not conduct electricity and has been studied as a potential heat sink.
author: .izik

entry: Thanks to its small body, POKENAME it is able to withdraw into its large shell as a shelter. Sometimes it is mistaken for a shell when it does so.
author: captainzscourge

entry: POKENAME is incredibly tender and sensitive, prone to shedding tears at the drop of a hat. It grabs and hugs the soft ball at the end of its tail to comfort itself during these crying fits.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often chases or bounces the ball on its tail to keep itself entertained. Despite being part of a hive, it is rarely called upon to defend the hive because of its inexperience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To use the water stored inside its tail, POKENAME must stand on top of it, using its own weight to squeeze the liquid out. Because the tail is so bouncy and slippery, the Pokémon is perpetually terrified of losing its footing and tumbling off.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME regularly gets so caught up with playing with other Pokémon that it follows them back to their nest. Older members of their species are easily able to track them and bring them back home, under much duress from POKENAME.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It will begin to cry at even the slightest inconvenience. POKENAME's tears release a toxin into the air that will cause a person to weep uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: When hungry, this Pokémon will place up to ten berries into a puddle at a time. Once it has enough berries, it will smash them within the puddle to create a delicious paste.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are the quintessential form of rotund cuteness. Their plush bodies make them adorable, cuddly partners for snuggles and hugs. Trainers are advised to give them space when they need it, as they easily get overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are shy and easily scared by passing people, attempting to imitate trees to hide in their forest homes. Their blue skin colouring means they are ineffectual at hiding in this way, though they believe they're doing a good job.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME helicopters through the air, propelled by its tail. It is constantly spinning or swerving and views the whole world upside down; while it does this it is having the time of its life.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: On hot days, POKENAME slowly get increasingly distressed, and excrete a gel that cools them down and collects in their tail. This gel will then leak out overnight and serves as a deterrent to predators.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are considered great companions for small children. Its bouncy tail provides entertainment and its pink rings act as a natural night-light.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME worriedly run around cities in search of their next meals, pleading with Trainers and chefs for spare food. Once they've received an ample supply for a feast, they scamper away before anyone can realize just how many people they asked.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's first instinct when spotted is to hide itself against the nearest surface, even if it doesn't camouflage itself in the slightest. Staring too long at it while it attempts to hide will result in its eye welling up with frightened tears.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's poison-filled tail is spiky, enough to the point where it can hurt its owner. As a result, POKENAME is always seen crying.
author: jss.tv

entry: POKENAME tires itself out easily due to playing all day. While awake, POKENAME runs around and pounces on toys. While asleep, POKENAME purrs cutely while curled up.
author: musicsheep.

entry: If it has no toys to play with, POKENAME makes a sorrowful display until it receives new ones. Its antics have proven surprisingly effective.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is normally a docile Pokémon, but when threatened, it will rapidly bounce its tail off its stony shell, giving the tail enough momentum to slam into its opponent with immense force.
author: imaginita

entry: During times of heavier snowfall, POKENAME perches on its tail to get a better vantage point over the snowbank. Its sharp sense of smell lets it detect predators from long distances, letting it flee to safety quicker.
author: sk372
