entry: POKENAME eats a variety of different plants in order to create pigments within its stomach. Should it shoot water from its mouth, it will alter the color based on what it has consumed.
author: .izik

entry: Shy and incredibly sensitive, POKENAME relies on a caretaker to nurture it. It has been said that POKENAME knows one's intentions from a distance, and by touching it, you share the secrets in your heart with them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses the innocent appearance of the ball on its tail to lure prey and trick them into a false sense of security before striking. However, its real face isn't especially intimidating either.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: POKENAME appears in heavy downpours where its weeping cries are drowned out by the rainfall. Legends say that anyone who can cheer it up enough for it to evolve will be blessed with good luck until their dying day.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The two bodies of this self fusion work in tandem, acting like bolas for both travel and battle.  The bodies aren't always well-coordinated, sometimes moving clumsily, even flinging each-other in directions that may end up harming both halves.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME uses the cluster of spherical growths on its body to mimic the shape of small plants. The growths are buoyant, enabling it to remain upright whilst travelling through the water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses the cluster of spherical growths on its body to mimic the shape of small plants. The growths are buoyant, enabling it to remain upright whilst travelling through the water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are friendly and playful, using their own tails to stand on, jump on, and bounce upon as they perform tricks. If they fall or are knocked off, they will sob uncontrollably until consoled or given food.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rests on its bolt-shaped tail to comfort itself, as it has an anxious nature. Owners should take heed of its large electric capacity but weak self-control; touching it by surprise could lead to a very painful jolt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is physically immature and is still growing. Newborns have the biggest tails, which are full of nutrients. As they grow older, they can bounce higher and, eventually, glide farther. They follow the lead of nearby Water-type Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is quite jumpy and easily startled. When surprised, it curls into a ball and bounces off its own tail, ricocheting around at random due to the following momentum.
author: sk372

entry: When threatened, POKENAME panics and blindly flails at anything in its path. Because it always attacks with its eyes tightly shut, it can't recognize its own strength during battle.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The more it trains, the farther its tail can extend upon POKENAME striking it. The best trained POKENAME can shatter a boulder from 10 feet away.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It can leap high with little effort due to the elasticity of the ball on its tail. There are reports of some POKENAME going over a mile into the air.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail is filled with fine sand and POKENAME will chew on its own tail in order to relieve stress. Some people theorize that its tail inspired modern stress toys.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite being a buoyant floatation aid, the gigantic ball at the end of the tails of POKENAME are extremely bulky and cumbersome. POKENAME carry the ball on their back in an effort to avoid getting caught on roots and vines.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Widely regarded as a gentle giant, POKENAME will whimper at the slightest issue. Any time it uses its fists to strike a foe, it cries uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME never stop crying and are often found perched along the walls of empty ravines. Over many years, their endless tears slowly fill these chasms with clear, pure water.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME never stop crying and are often found perched along the walls of empty ravines. Over many years, their endless tears slowly fill these chasms with clear, pure water.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Often called a crybaby, POKENAME's steps upset it, producing tears that act as fertilizer. The more stress it feels, the more bubbles grow on its back.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME are easily frightened and cling to their tails whenever they feel scared. Before going to sleep, they sneeze out flames that they have stored in their bodies before falling asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are easily spooked and will slap their inflated tail against the ground to make a loud noise if startled. Nearby POKENAME will copy the noise, banding together to try and scare off whatever startled them from their home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME always rushes into fights head first, both figuratively and literally. Victims of its attack are left with an Azurill face-like imprint.
author: spookyb.

entry: POKENAME's bottle keeps it safe from powerful attacks. It'll send out a flurry of bubbles to distract threats.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME offers up its tail to those who are feeling down. Squeezing and hugging the soft orb at the end helps alleviate stress. Helping others feel better lifts POKENAME's often-somber mood as well.
author: sk372

entry: The tail of POKENAME is quite heavy, dragging them down and making flying for long periods difficult. POKENAME often become upset at this, and will angrily pout on top of their tails.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Its arms are too small to balance with. It hugs its tail for safety, waiting anxiously for its Azurill half to evolve.
author: miecreates

entry: When POKENAME cries, its tears mix with the gel that encases its body. When this happens, the gel starts to harden.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME can bounce on land and swim well due to the bouncy coiled tail vines coming from the head. Even though the thorns are smoothed away, their skin remains tough in most situations.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's multiple tails are lightweight, but they make moving around a bit awkward. POKENAME uses them to get better vantage points as it looks for incoming danger, and all six tails work moderately well as striking weapons against pursuers.
author: sk372

entry: If hugged too tightly, this Pokémon's fur will let loose a flurry of sparks. While harmless, this excess static can cause a person's hair to stand on end.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of leaping around 120 yards with ease. Local sports matches have begun using them as a showpiece, jumping over the arena to kick off the match.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME can inflate its head or tail at will, shrinking the other body part. It can inflate its tail and wave it to scare off predators, or inflate its head to blow large bubbles.
author: alindrome

entry: POKENAME is very particular about the state of its luxurious fur. If someone pets it without its permission, it typically responds by turning away, sitting on its tail, and sulking.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME is constantly distraught by the sounds of the world around it. It curls up around its tail, which is filled with a noise-dampening fluid. If startled in this state, its ears viciously lash out, able to fell Pokémon many times its size.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are completely blind and roost in underground caves, using their echolocation to navigate. They often struggle to differentiate water from cave floors, so they have large tail floats to prevent sinking if they crash.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is not very good at flying yet, so it uses its bouncy tail to get off the ground. It tends to freeze up around malicious people and Pokémon.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME are often found crying near riverbeds. Residents who live near these Pokémon often complain about their loud noises over the night.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME rests on other Electric-type Pokémon to absorb the excess electrostatic energy produced by their bodies, preventing them from overcharging. When it feels threatened, it hides behind its tail, making its fur stand on end.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME easily tears up. They cry all day if they get scared by the slightest thing. Due to its size, most large things, including Pokémon Trainers, intimidate it, so they have never been seen without tears in their eyes.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: It pretends to be harmed by its own tail so that its foes underestimate it. It cries just as hard when it pricks itself on accident.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME wildly swing their tails like maces when frightened, causing massive destruction all around them. This frantic flailing often leaves them off balance, sometimes even sending them flying if they spin fast enough.
author: santon5512

entry: It happily bounces on its tail three times before taking flight. This behavior serves no purpose other than as a morale boost for itself.
author: .izik

entry: It hops on its bouncy tail, launching itself high into the air. Despite this, it struggles to fly very far.
author: archserpent

entry: Its oddly-shaped tail acts as a counterweight, giving it momentum to hop forwards in a steady rhythm. Small Pokémon struck by its tail will go flying.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: They bounce as high as they can during the night, looking to absorb the most moonlight. Those with bigger tails have absorbed more moonlight.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its weepy disposition makes it constantly cry whenever stressed, fearful, angry, or sad. Hugging POKENAME makes it feel better, but its tears constantly wet its plushy fur, making it very unpleasant to console.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME makes itself appear to be drowning to gain sympathy. It'll even do it on land.
author: ohok3441

entry: The anchor in POKENAME's tail makes it unable to move freely. However, it is used in battle as a powerful flail.
author: ohok3441

entry: Most of their body is blubbery and squishy, but young children typically don't care for POKENAME as they do for Azurill, as their tails are littered with incredibly sharp and painful spines that are hard to remove once lodged in skin.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME enjoy following groups of Trainers on their adventures, following along and crying out warnings when they believe there's danger. Their usefulness as a lookout is questionable as any unexpected noise or shadow is enough to spook them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lack the confidence to sing on stage and end up in tears if forced to do so. A gentle guide is necessary if their Trainer wants to help them perform successfully.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are terrified of singing in public and would rarely sing on stage if they could help it. Finding the right Trainer to build their confidence is incredibly difficult because they fear being judged.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Jumping from its bouncy tail enables POKENAME to reach great heights to observe its surroundings. The white bubbles have turned pink from the tail's nutrients.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: POKENAME are usually kept around beaches to use as a floatation device. When it sees someone struggling in water, it jumps in the water and swims in a zig-zag fashion towards them before catching them and swimming them to safety.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Many joke that POKENAME's beak is not full of normal water, but the Pokémon's tears. It dislikes confrontation, so it contents itself by scooping up aquatic plants and bits of discarded food around the oceans.
author: sk372

entry: It cries all day, consoling itself with its plushy and firm tail. Drinking its tears allegedly cures bad luck.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The bubbles POKENAME blows through its tail are particularly strong and buoyant. It can use these bubbles to help struggling swimmers rise back to the surface, making it a popular companion for lifeguards.
author: skittytales

entry: The moment POKENAME feels a pang of hunger, it becomes very upset. It raises itself up on its tail and wails for someone, anyone to feed it quickly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are terrified of swimming, even in shallow water. They are known to stand on their tails to avoid even a drop of water from touching their rotund body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though POKENAME possesses a decent grip strength with its claws, it rarely uses them. Instead, its skittish nature causes it to flail its claws about wildly when threatened, a much less effective method of self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cries and howls when it feels lonely. Trainers are advised not to leave it alone for longer than five minutes, as lonesomeness strikes quickly with POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: The fists that POKENAME brandishes are very rubbery, much like its tail. It can leave a nasty welt if one were to be struck full-force.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This variant of POKENAME is able to utilize its rubbery body in battle. It can throw and ricochet itself off objects to catch its opponent off-guard.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME source of power comes from their tail, which holds most of their electrical powers. However, they are unable to control this huge power, so when POKENAME cries, mechanical devices around them will shut down.
author: dahappycute

entry: Even POKENAME itself finds the stench of its oily body to be unbearably repulsive. Unable to clean itself, or retreat from the stink, POKENAME can only cry with a look of pure disgust permanently stuck on its face.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME is very timid, preferring to hide in its shell rather than using its cannons. To fuel its water cannons, it absorbs water through its tail by submerging it underwater.
author: mistymagius

entry: Upon seeing something tiny and cute, it gets teary-eyed and tries to pick it up. Its tears are toxic; if it cries on someone, they'll be weeping too.
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME are poor swimmers, sticking to the shallows along beaches and feeding on detritus that washes ashore. If they're ever swept out to sea, they snap their claws shut and capture air to use as floats, hoping to return to land.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME always wears a smile, even when it feels lonely; its tail reveals its true emotions. It strikes tree trunks with its small bone club to knock down fruit to feed on.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If it loses the skull on its head, it isolates itself out of shame. POKENAME is very fond of ripe fruit and tends to live in forested areas where it can easily find food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's malleable bodies make them the perfect punching bags, letting most attacks bounce off them. At night, groups of these Pokémon will squish themselves into one big ball to sleep.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are clumsy in their flight patterns, having to use their latent psychic powers to help support themselves in the air. When they crash into something, they rebound some of the energy. They're a pest in built-up areas when they hit windows.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are clumsy in their flight patterns, having to use their latent psychic powers to help support themselves in the air. When they crash into something, they rebound some of the energy. They're a pest in built-up areas when they hit windows.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is naive and cheerful, treating almost everything as a game. Even when fighting or being bullied, it continues smiling and giggling even as it retaliates with balls of electric sparks.
author: sk372

entry: Under the moonlight, POKENAME hops joyfully around open fields. If struck while hopping, it retaliates with a powerful Counter.
author: .izik

entry: It sings all day long to train its vocal chords. Anyone who hears a long POKENAME song will have their voice become hoarse in sympathy.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME have eye spots on their jet black feathers that help to confuse aggressive Pokémon as to where they're looking. They use this confusion to draw attacks away from their body before landing powerful counterattacks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to detect species of fungi that grow amongst tree roots, using a keen sense of smell. Many attempts have been made to try and teach POKENAME to use this skill for their Trainer's benefit, but it just splashes them with muddy water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are able to detect species of fungi that grow amongst reeds, using a keen sense of smell. Many attempts have been made to try and teach POKENAME to use this skill for their Trainer's benefit, but it just splashes them with muddy water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The eye on POKENAME's drill-like tail can sense the nature of incoming attacks. This allows it to react instantly with the correct defensive skill.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are curious Pokémon that will follow along behind anybody that catches their interest. Despite their curiosity, they dislike direct attention and have a habit of pecking at anyone that stops to watch them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME oozes around happily around warm areas, seemingly carefree in its attitude. It is incredibly protective of its shell, however, immediately retracting into it and rolling away if something gets too close.
author: sk372

entry: Any time POKENAME uses Counter, the ground around it is covered in a thin frost. This frost can be treacherous for both combatants, creating a slippery surface that increases the risk of losing footing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME monitor a child's activity through a PC to ensure they are focused on homework. While they have a cheery personality, the tail gets angry when the child is not doing homework and may pause games and social media with a slap of the tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While appearing jolly, POKENAME has a very stoic demeanor. Should it notice an attack it cannot dodge with its martial arts prowess, it will stay still to unleash a terrifying Counter, turning the tide of battle in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: Most of the time, POKENAME keeps its udders hidden via a flap of skin on its front. It lifts this up to surprise and spray milk on unsuspecting people, as a prank.
author: sk372

entry: The eyes on POKENAME's face are false markings, as its real eyes rest at the end of wispy tendrils extending from its flowing mane. It hides beneath lake water, extending its eyes just above the surface to see if it's safe to wander out.
author: sk372

entry: The body of POKENAME is exceptionally rubbery. When struck they bounce randomly and chaotically around their environment, sometimes even striking back into whatever hit them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The body of POKENAME is exceptionally rubbery. When struck they bounce randomly and chaotically around their environment, sometimes even striking back into whatever hit them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The body of POKENAME is exceptionally rubbery. When struck they bounce randomly and chaotically around their environment, sometimes even striking back into whatever hit them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The hunger POKENAME has for Liechi berries quadruples due to fusion. It will use its earlike arms to eat groves of Liechi plants if left unchecked.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME always has its mouth turned upright regardless of its current condition. The best way to check its emotional state is in the black tips of its body: they're droopy if POKENAME is sad, wobbly if they're angry, and so on.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's rock-solid body glows bright blue when using Mirror Coat. The sudden flash often startles foes before the counterattack lands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in pairs in old volcanic craters. Together, they bring back Berries to roast and eat. POKENAME will occasionally congregate with other pairs to share different types of food.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME build levees out of boulders to protect their seaside habitats from erosion. Their resilient, squishy bodies come in handy when their constructions inevitably fall on top of them.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME live in packs and try to stay as close to their fellows as possible. If one POKENAME is happy, it starts dancing joyfully, drawing other members of its pack into an energetic choreography.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: POKENAME harvests fruits by cutting stems with its floppy blade and chucking them into its mouth with its ribbon. It bends its blade to toughen it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: After being struck by a physical attack, POKENAME releases a soothing aura. Repeatedly striking it in the face causes this aura to intensify, calming the attacker.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses Safeguard to protect sleeping allies. It prefers to rest beneath the soft glow of moonlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is probably a little distracted. It is capable of spending weeks observing the little hook dangling in front of it.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME increases its electric powers by taking hits, its body perpetually increasing its natural voltage in response to harm. POKENAME that endure lots of damage can release devastating electrical counters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's rubbery skin reflects incoming attacks back at enemies. It spends most of its time snacking on ore-rich rocks.
author: .izik

entry: It hides its face in its wing fluff while it sleeps. The large fake eyes on its wings give predators the illusion that POKENAME is awake and alert.
author: cait_sith

entry: While captivating, the gems on POKENAME's body are highly volatile and will explode at the slightest disturbance. These crystals are a waste product of POKENAME's psychic diet, and often regenerate within seconds.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME's uses its stick and its hexing abilities to make fruits and berries fall from trees for it to eat. It abhors combat, so when in danger it prefers to curse a predator with dizziness and disorientation before fleeing into the woods.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME helps out farmers by inspecting the roots of crops and determining if they are healthy. In exchange, cultivators feed the Pokémon unsellable fruit.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME make their home in caves near vineyards, hiding away underground during the day. At night, they emerge and pop up out of the ground to pull as much fruit as they can into their tunnels to eat later, making them a nuisance to farmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy helping people train their bodies, aiding boxers with their technique in exchange for sweet treats. They sometimes get overenthusiastic and spring one of their three heads back into their partner with enough force to knock them out.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a fondness for sweet treats, making their homes in orchards and persistently following the workers until they're fed fruit. They make a pleased purring noise when fed, knowing people enjoy the noise and hoping it leads to more food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though small, POKENAME can consume up to 50 lbs of fruit a day. Its rubbery body helps protect it from attacks.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME commonly plant themselves upside down and allow their true eyes to watch over them as they sleep. They are the cause of many local ghost stories.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME enjoy hiding amongst rocks and attacking unsuspecting Trainers. However, their bright coloration and quiet snickering tend to give them away beforehand.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME's body is made of compressed smoke of unknown origin. It floats in circles around sweet fruits, which it eats with fervor, savoring the rare and fleeting sustenance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail grows as night falls. It is known to steal fruit from farmers' gardens. If it is caught, it disappears into thin air.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME slams its rock-hard tail on the ground when it is angry. Anyone approaching should beware of its Rock Throw, which can cause massive damage with a single strike.
author: .izik

entry: Its large hands lie dormant in flight, and are used to cling to flowers. If threatened, it flaps rapidly and waves them menacingly.
author: holgast

entry: When agitated, POKENAME slaps the palms on its three tails down onto the ground. The faster the three tails hit the ground, the closer it is to charging at the object of its ire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to use its two tails to slap at buildings, knocking them over. It then slaps at the remaining rubble repeatedly, pulverizing it until nothing is left behind.
author: soup1900

entry: A rare genetic anomaly in this Pokémon species has caused their faces to grow in an irregular way. They tend to go on rampages inside of cities, knocking buildings over with their two tails.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME may appear on a user's computer at random, attempting to be friendly and help it with its daily tasks. Most will find it more annoying than helpful, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME beats its chest and releases a bellowing shout before going on a rampage. Its arms cling to its prey before large jaws bite down to secure victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its fearsome jaws that often intimidate others, POKENAME is actually a gentle and harmless creature that mostly enjoys playing little pranks. It uses its twin tails to snatch unattended objects, which it hoards inside its den.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The hand on its tail moves like a glove filled with water. POKENAME can rapidly swing its tail to slap enemies with that hand.
author: holgast

entry: It gathers discarded trash in a forest, then uses it to decorate its nest. Once it determines the nest is fully decorated, it will search for a mate.
author: .izik

entry: What look like POKENAME's tail feathers are actually dextrous appendages. It uses these to manipulate objects with incredible precision.
author: bee4082

entry: It fires globs of web from its hands with great precision. Should it capture a foe, it will laugh maniacally as it reels the enemy in.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its tails to ensure its balance. When on an icy surface, it will use its tails to stabilize its movement and prevent slipping.
author: .izik

entry: It will dance on the roof of a business once per year. This dance is said to bestow great luck and ensure record profits for the rest of the year.
author: .izik

entry: While dancing, it spins its body clockwise at great speeds. Its hands can be dangerous if they collide with an onlooker.
author: .izik

entry: It has little control over its super-powered tail, which is stronger than its body. The tail moves on its own and swings POKENAME like a ragdoll.
author: holgast

entry: Its two tails are at odds, and it can barely control them while grounded. When climbing and swinging, though, they seemingly share one mind.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME look out for their Trainer and are incredibly dextrous. This makes them ideal partners for those that own a corner shop, they climb around stocking shelves and are able to tell if someone is shoplifting or damaging stock.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME look out for their Trainer and are incredibly dextrous. This makes them ideal partners for those that own a corner shop, they climb around stocking shelves and are able to tell if someone is shoplifting or damaging stock.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When it touches the ground with the hand-like portions of its tail, it can sense vibrations. It can sense an opponent from up to 300 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: It uses the antlers on its head to sense the fears of its prey. Using the mouths on its hands, it mimics its prey's greatest terror.
author: .izik

entry: Warnings get passed around to not be fooled by POKENAME's grin and silly tail claps. One bite from POKENAME is enough to require paramedics, while POKENAME laughs at the injured being taken away in an ambulance.
author: redmagecole

entry: Curious about everything, POKENAME use their large hands to feel objects and deeply study their shape and texture. In cyberspace, they use these hands to physically push computer files around and move them between devices.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's spins are slower due to its tails affecting its balance. However, the impact of them is powerful enough to send a sumo wrestler flying.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME play pranks on hikers at high altitudes with a grin. Unfortunately, these pranks can spell disaster. Whether POKENAME are aware of this is unclear.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its arms wave behind it in flight like kite tails. It is known to harass kite-fliers, mistaking the toys for Pokémon like itself.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME races around its opponent in order to tire it out. Sometimes, it drinks a special soda while doing so, further enhancing its abilities.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME goad their opponents into fighting them by taunting them. When in combat, POKENAME use their tail-hands to sweep the legs of lighter foes, and smack them both against the heads of larger opponents to discombobulate them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME use their tails for movement, defense, and to crush up harder foods for themselves and their young. They are sensitive to the emotions of others, especially positive emotions; when at their happiest, they dance acrobatically.
author: infinex21

entry: It swings between trees using its two hand-like tails while plucking fruits and nuts from trees using its psychic powers. To fend off threats and foes, it will chuck nuts and pebbles using its limbs or its psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful tails to snap limbs off trees. It then collects the branches to build sturdy lodges along riverbanks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the hands that sprout from its head to attack foes with a flurry of punches. It has a playful personality, and enjoys performing for people and Pokémon.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME swing their four arm-like limbs around rapidly to mystify and overwhelm opponents. When they are not battling, they will use their limbs to mess with others and to shovel berries and other fruits into their mouths.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME nimbly swings through the trees with its tassel-like arms. As it travels, it uses its immense blade to slice off entire branches of fruit trees, carrying them as a portable snack.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its two hand-like limbs are highly dexterous, and it can use them to climb trees or similar structures. Some believe POKENAME is capable of telepathy through physical contact, and can even do so with human beings.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: Formidable punching strength is packed into both POKENAME's fists and its tails. To keep its strength honed, it regularly boxes with itself, smashing its fists against each other.
author: sk372

entry: If you suddenly lose your belongings in a forest, an POKENAME could be to blame. If you are lucky enough to catch them in the act though, they will politely return the stolen goods back to you.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME defends itself and others with powerful extending fists that pack a hefty punch. It's often found deep in forests, gorging on bananas and defending colonies of Aipom and Ambipom.
author: sk372

entry: No adult in the children's hospital has witnessed an Aipom or Ambipom in the vents, but some theorize whatever it is is trying to entertain the kids.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Wild POKENAME quickly traverse their jungle, or forest, homes using their four long arms. From atop tree branches, they will pluck and chuck nuts at travelers while giggling.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found residing in the roots of large trees.  When Pokémon come by, POKENAME use their lengthy limbs to pull them underground.
author: teatedtiten

entry: It spins its rear arms in a clockwise motion to propel its body through lakes and rivers. It eats lily pads that it finds to absorb their nutrients.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has two prehensile ears, but it typically only uses one of them to grab things. When it employs both ears at once, it's usually a sign that a battle is about to commence.
author: hophoppip

entry: The protrusions that cover POKENAME's body are actually functional fingers, which it can use to move around and even manipulate objects.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME pickpockets coins or other shiny objects from Trainers. It laughs with both amusement and derision whenever it gets away with theft.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Through its hands, POKENAME can drain the nutrients from other things, such as its favorite nuts and Berries, all without swallowing a thing. It takes the leftover matter and uses it as a deft throwing weapon for foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It cheers when it sees any kind of success. This can become irritating, as the cheers consist of high-pitched screeching.
author: .izik

entry: The plants on its head are very similar to hands. They will fill with pollen over time and grow to exceptionally large sizes.
author: .izik

entry: An agile and tactical mechanical creature, POKENAME prefers to stick to long-range tactics in battle. It can fire homing rocket punches from the twin tail wires protruding from its back.
author: sk372

entry: It is often mistaken for Slaking at night. Even while asleep, its large hands can knock down anyone who approaches it.
author: holgast

entry: The poison that it secretes from its body smells like a mixture of Nanab Berries and Yellow Apricorns. The fluid can cause paralysis if consumed.
author: .izik

entry: It wields its shovel like a trained knight wields a longsword. It laughs maniacally as it swings its weapon at its foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their long, dexterous tail paws to launch themselves into action, quickly repositioning in combat or play. They are often found nesting near collections of rock spires, leaping between them in impressive feats of acrobatics.
author: vic1312

entry: When POKENAME is deep in meditation, it remains sitting in the lotus position, using only its tails to move around.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses its two tails to grab heaps of food to shovel into its almost insatiable gullet. It's become common to depict it in commercials for food products, with POKENAME greedily and gleefully consuming said product.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fight with intuitive techniques that require little planning or forethought. They use all four hands to grapple and swipe at opponents until they achieve victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It mocks travelers who are lost in the forest by whistling and laughing in an uneven tone. It also points and jeers should the person run out of food.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is angered, it will lift itself up using its tails and hurl itself towards enemies.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It sleeps at the bottom of swampy ponds. Its hands float at the surface, reflexively grabbing hold of any moving prey that bump into them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its strong arms to drag and pull itself where it needs to go, letting its body rest while its arms do all the work. Using these arms doesn't seem to tire it at all.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME has a very unique fighting style. It shoots split streams of high-pressure water to quickly disorient foes, then slaps them silly.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: This Pokémon's highly fortified hands can knock out a Tyranitar in one hit. Fortunately, this Pokémon is quite passive.
author: themicelegion

entry: Oddly for a crab, its claws have been swapped for primitive hands. It drags itself along the ground with them instead of scuttling.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME mixes brews with the bones of other Pokémon. They sometimes share beneficial potions with their Trainer.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Popular conjecture theorizes that POKENAME's bones hold many curses and spells. Most people try to stay away from this Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The mist that comes out of POKENAME's body causes hallucinations, distorting the victim's perception. During this time, its eerie, wordless chanting can be heard inside their head, heightening the fear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME brews all sorts of potions, both helpful and harmful in their contents. It makes sure that its healing potions go to those in need.
author: fountainihili

entry: Its child is the spirit of the baby it stole before it evolved. Its incantation-like cries cursed the baby into becoming a vengeful spirit like them.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME cling to the sides of ships where they bask in the glow of the night sky. Sailors say that any voyage accompanied by more than a dozen POKENAME is doomed to fail.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME gathers up ghostly energy in its scythes, causing them to glow purple when active. Those cut by the blades while energized fall victim to a year-long curse of bad luck.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME pull a myriad of pranks on people who enter into their territory. They constantly meddle with Trainers for sheer misanthropic amusement but never leave their targets with lasting injuries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that if you catch a POKENAME, you will be granted a wish. However, these granted wishes usually turn out to be nothing but illusions.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME often haunts old libraries, as it enjoys reading. It is generally harmless and shy, but will deliver a terrible fright to those that make too much noise.
author: occulusmalus

entry: Magic spells grant it new ways to manipulate water, such as phasing it through walls. It taints the drinks of those it dislikes with terrible curses.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME seek to understand humans in pursuit of upgrading their systems with modern technology. Unfortunately, the outdated mechanical whirring that starts up whenever they move often ends up scaring most Trainers away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: While the fur of POKENAME may appear fluffy and inviting, touching a POKENAME against its will may cause intense burns due to the flames it generates.
author: alumed

entry: A Pokémon of malicious deviance, POKENAME aims to cause problems for any user it comes across. It casts hexes on any device it invades, causing them to glitch out and behave wildly, often beyond repair.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME always hunts at night, seeking out packs of Lycanroc. Its movements are filled with bloodlust, and some say its scythe is made from Lycanroc bones.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its snoring sounds like incantations and its powers remain active to repel others even as it sleeps. It is content with spending its time sleeping and eating.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's wings crackle with magical energy. It summons bolts of purple lightning to strike its victim with its sinister curses.
author: hophoppip

entry: The cries of a POKENAME are incantations that call forth various weather phenomena. The orbs along its body glow with an ominous crimson light to deter threats.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses lost, forsaken souls as a source of fuel for its intense heat. POKENAME is feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads.
author: corn0779

entry: When POKENAME begins to chant incantations, its adaptive eyes glow with a malicious aura. It's said that anyone that witnesses this is subjected to unspeakable torment. This Pokémon thrives in the dark.
author: jadey.1557

entry: On midnight purple wings, POKENAME swoops across the nighttime sky. They can sense the emotions of those on the ground below them and will seek out people and Pokémon suffering from bad dreams, perching nearby and feasting upon them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is often seen doing magic tricks to scare people, producing a tree-like figure from under its cape. However, it sometimes finds watchers thrilled rather than terrified.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: POKENAME is believed to have inspired the fairy tale of a frog turning into a prince. It behaves regally, living amongst Politoed and their unevolved forms, where it garners great respect. It curses any that mistreat it, who are quickly driven mad.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME explore murky swamps, looking for adventure despite their inexperience. POKENAME are notoriously clumsy, releasing a ghoulish cry whenever it makes a mistake, which many have mistaken for a much larger threat.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME is kept alive by causing headaches in those nearby, feeding off the discomfort. If there is no one to torment, its form begins to deteriorate, dripping as thick, black goo. Listening carefully to the goo, one can hear eternal screams.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME becomes more active on nights of a full moon. Its wicked cries torment all who hear it, and can even drive one mad.
author: mepp.

entry: While flying, POKENAME uses its broom to knock away tree branches. It is primarily active around 3 AM for an unknown reason, adding to the mystery of its late-night activities.
author: .izik

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME murmur inscrutable incantations whenever they are about to perform an attack. Scientists studying the complex incantations report experiencing headaches and hallucinations.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME locks eyes with its target to induce haunting visions. The longer it holds their gaze, the more fear it draws into its orbs.
author: .izik

entry: The head floating alongside POKENAME acts as its faithful familiar. It floats around cackling and distracting a target, while POKENAME itself prepares a powerful hex to curse the victim with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME consumes lost spirits and then compresses them into gorgeous amethyst crystals. The crystals seem to be able to resonate with other spirits.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a whimsical personality and a hardy temperament. When it waves the wand it is never seen without, all sorts of strange effects happen, from objects levitating to others' appearance temporarily changing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It absorbs the frightened emotions of humans, which combine with the chemicals in its shell to create a strange potion with unpredictable effects.
author: hophoppip

entry: A POKENAME prefers to ferment berries in its cauldron. Its brew has various stimulating properties and causes a slowed perception of time, which it leverages in battle to effectively defend itself.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME live in groups of three in volcanic calderas where they boil potions within their shells. Their shells are highly sought after to coat mixing bowls and baking trays due to the belief this will infuse the food with magic.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses the collected screeches of other Fearow in combat to stun foes. It prefers to fly solo in the night to hunt.
author: awiralonprime

entry: POKENAME's shaggy, purple fur is imbued with ghostly energy. It can float around with ease, absorbing fear and despair from nearby people and Pokémon as an energy source.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Wild POKENAME like sneaking around forests, tossing candy to travelers at night. It doesn't care how stale the candy is; it just likes throwing it.
author: pankiwi

entry: In olden times, POKENAME was poached for its antlers, as some believed they could be used as parts of staffs to wield magic powers. The species still holds a grudge for this, many casting curses on humans on-sight.
author: sk372

entry: Despite the ghostly appearance, POKENAME are quite benevolent. They protect Trainers and young Pokémon from spectral strikes by absorbing the attacks into their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The incantations that this Pokémon may chant can cause sudden and violent storms. It often disappears once the storm has passed.
author: captainzscourge

entry: POKENAME conjures up thunderstorms at will with its roar. It can appear and vanish in the blink of an eye.
author: its_cher_bicth

entry: Trainers who treat POKENAME with love and patience despite its malicious nature are rewarded with undying affection, manifested by its orb. Whenever its Trainer is having negative thoughts, it will gently press its orb against them to bring them joy.
author: beatdoof

entry: It is eerily similar to some scientific drawings that speculate how Flutter Mane would've adapted. They act and screech almost like a dinosaur, but POKENAME will sometimes let their mask slip and mutter curses instead of snarls.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: While flying through the night sky, POKENAME makes human-like noises from its beak. Some say the vocalizations sound like incantations, adding to the mystery of its nocturnal flights.
author: .izik

entry: Encountering a POKENAME in the wild forebodes certain calamity. Captured POKENAME utilize their senses to keep their Trainer out of harm's way.
author: sandguything

entry: POKENAME carries around a sack at all times, demanding others tribute candies and sweets to it. Those that don't comply will by licked, its tongue inflicting all manner of strange curses and hexes on the victim.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has mastered the art of combining dark magic with its body's electricity. When pushed to the limit, its thunder bolts become black as night.
author: maugre

entry: POKENAME incapacitates prey with magic blasts, then swoops in on shadowy wings to suck their blood. If treated with great respect and rare berries, it can be persuaded to use its venom in concoctions that are potent cures.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Swift-thinking and clever, the enigmatic POKENAME may join groups of other wild Pokémon to drive out unwanted intruders. A blast from their magic leaves foes feeling sluggish and any nearby tech disabled. After the threat has passed, they disappear.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is mischievous in personality and gets great enjoyment out of simply poking and tugging on things with its beak. When it sleeps, it emits a strange mist that shifts in color every few moments from its beak.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is quite proud of its hat, to the point that any thoughts insulting it send it into a rage. It often stands in front of the moon to make itself look larger, but most Trainers find it endearing.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When gathered together as a group, POKENAME take flight using their psychic powers, emitting Confuse Rays that can be heard for miles.  Before each attack, they sing incantations to lull their foes into inaction.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Every master of the dark arts has a disciple. POKENAME calls on the power of its fallen allies to unleash powerful waves of dark magic when threatened.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Every master of the dark arts has a disciple. POKENAME calls on the power of its fallen allies to unleash powerful waves of dark magic when threatened.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: POKENAME grows quite attached to its Trainer, and dislikes sharing their company. Those who get too close to the Trainer find themselves beset with misfortune and mishaps, usually followed by the sound of distant and mischievous laughter.
author: sk372

entry: The red crystals lining their arms like blades glimmer with the mystic energies flowing within. Those cut by their blades, however small the cut may be, will be afflicted with misfortune until the cut heals.
author: infinex21

entry: A Mismagius was sealed with 108 other spirits in this book, giving birth to POKENAME. It scares people that open it or find it in a library.
author: awiralonprime

entry: It is said that the stew POKENAME carries on its back is able to dissolve all meat that's thrown into it. With the right ingredients, it's able to conjure ghostly apparitions that carry out its deeds.
author: doodledoo

entry: POKENAME's head plate is engraved with mystical symbols. Before it uses a special move, the symbols will glow in a specific pattern.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its shield-like face protects it while it chants incantations to torment its attacker. A weakness to attacks from behind lead to its extinction.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Often found near grave sites and burial grounds, POKENAME can often be heard singing sorrowfully. It is rumored that those who have listened experience nausea, headaches, and hallucinations for days afterward.
author: thetapemaster

entry: POKENAME comes and goes between this world and the afterlife. Its cries sound like incantations, and those who hear them are said to lose their souls.
author: ._term.

entry: Ancient witches honored POKENAME by carving hexes around their dwellings. They revered it as a divine patron of magic and ritual.
author: .izik

entry: Once evolved, this Pokémon will seek a master to learn from. It uses its blade hands to casts various spells.
author: awiralonprime

entry: Having gone from student to master, POKENAME teaches its brethren. Groups of POKENAME and their apprentices compete for superiority.
author: awiralonprime

entry: POKENAME mysteriously appears in old tents and is rumored to give accurate fortunes. People have been reported to lose consciousness when they see their fortune.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When deep in thought, POKENAME rotates its feelers much like a witch churning a cauldron. Because of this, many have created folklore about it casting curses, calling it the Maiden of the Craft.
author: .izik

entry: Feared by many sailors, POKENAME is commonly referred to as the "Sorceress of Stormy Seas." Its eerie cries can summon massive waves that are capable of capsizing any ship.
author: mepp.

entry: Although the appearance of POKENAME is often considered to be very intimidating, it is actually just a very lonely Pokémon. It seeks companionship and will play with all who are willing, but will send evildoers flying in an instant.
author: infinex21

entry: With eerie incantations, POKENAME commands ancient power with its cannon enchanted with forbidden magic.
author: anarchaz

entry: Fables describe the red wisps as the spirits of those who succumbed to the magic of POKENAME. Research has proven that they are actually just fire that POKENAME uses to light its surroundings.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Old occult records depict POKENAME as a fiendish figure. According to the tales, if summoned it would create a cursed thunderstorm across the region, twisting people's hearts towards malevolence.
author: sk372

entry: The bewitching aroma that wafts from POKENAME's roses weakens any foe's will to fight. Once subdued, POKENAME unleashes a frightening assault with its thorny vines and fatal toxins.
author: mepp.

entry: At night, this Pokémon sails through the sky with hexes that it speaks in murmurs. Its victims are subjected to illnesses that worsen over time, with decaying petals left behind as a calling card.
author: violet_zero

entry: This variant of POKENAME has seemingly lost its power to lose by leaving all the pain. That's according to a certain song, anyway.
author: 8xviktor

entry: With its mocking visage and murmured invectives spoken under its breath, it sends foes into a fury before striking with unseen punches. This Pokémon is deceptive to all except its Trainer.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME eagerly ride gusts of wind, stealing crops from whatever unlucky farmers they come across. During the night, POKENAME brew elaborate potions that, according to some, will induce prophetic visions in those who consume them.
author: turron_turron

entry: Its coat is tougher than steel, automatically reacting to attacks as if alive. The barbs it fires are loaded with curses worse than any poison.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Old texts state that ancient witches once used placed POKENAME around their glyphs, relying on their eerie flames to empower spells or fortify one's soul. The flames were believed to hold mystical properties.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear late at night in front of those interested in dark magic. Their flames are powered by a mystical brew of the souls they've deceived.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME makes its home in abandoned buildings, where eerie whispers come from below its cloth-like body. The whispers sound like incantations, adding to the haunting atmosphere.
author: .izik

entry: The smaller heads of POKENAME are used to chant incantations for the larger middle head to unleash their attacks. Researchers have discovered that only the smaller heads have brains and that they control the central head.
author: cobalt0135

entry: It is said the souls of nine Hex Maniacs combined to make POKENAME. While its gaze paralyzes, this Pokémon's cries sound like incantations summoning its flaming attacks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME creates a focus for its magical powers by carving mystical sigils into wood with its teeth.
author: hophoppip

entry: Before using a strong electric attack, POKENAME moves its tail in an odd pattern while chanting something that sounds almost human. The words make no sense, but they seem to channel strange energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME preys on grieving families, siphoning their energy while they try to communicate with the dead. Despite being a well-known phenomenon, POKENAME is sought after in an attempt to ease broken hearts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drags its planchette across its spirit board without human intervention, leading to rumors that the dead can communicate. There are conflicting messages on whether it is kind or cruel to grieving families.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Mistaken as Hex Maniacs from a distance, POKENAME enjoy causing mischief. Their presence disrupts electrical signals and interrupts cell phone calls. When confronted, they curl their ears before slapping the threat.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's mouth seems to open up to 2 feet wide when it is trying to scare someone. This has recently been proven to be an illusion by scientists, as the mouth's size is a visual trick to intimidate its prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats through abandoned tombs to scare archaeologists. The fear it generates is stored within the large gem it carries, making the gem a source of strange and unsettling energy.
author: .izik

entry: Rumor has it that POKENAME was once a sorceress that froze to death in a snowstorm. Those who venture into its territory rarely return in one piece.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The sound of POKENAME's voice echoes eerily as it wanders moonlit woods. This sound frightens all who hear it.
author: mepp.

entry: It steps into soulless, almost ghostly dances while singing dark incantations. These eerie rituals summon vengeful spirits that spread evil curses.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME rarely appears in person, using the forest itself to launch curses remotely as if they were extensions of itself.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: On moonless nights, lost travelers claim they can hear the distant echoes of bone-chilling incantations from POKENAME's cries.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME floats above city dumps searching for discarded plush toys. When it finds one, it possesses the body and shambles around while chanting softly.
author: .izik

entry: On autumn nights, it is said to disguise itself as a haunted house, giving many a fright. Yet by morning, it vanishes like it were never there.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is quite loyal to its Trainer, to an almost problematic degree. If it thinks someone has insulted or bullied its Trainer, it casts hexes on the perpetrator, regardless of its Trainer's desires.
author: sk372

entry: A loyal Pokémon from budding Hex Maniacs. POKENAME loves to fetch ingredients for a cauldron's brew, but is more than capable of spellcasting for itself.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME's screams sound like otherworldly incantations, with rocks in its mane giving them a harsh, echoed edge that traumatizes its foes. Its array of razor-sharp claws, teeth, and rocks wears the foe down before it finishes them off.
author: kinsgs

entry: POKENAME uses the shiny rocks in its mane to cast curses onto foes, causing them sharp pain whenever they touch their own skin. Any spare stone from its neck that it does not need is gifted to a Trainer it trusts as a protective charm against spells.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME dances for long periods in graveyards, giving off an aura that makes humans instinctively want to stay away. Some describe the feeling as simultaneously smelling and tasting something terrible.
author: .izik

entry: In a flash of black light, it can simultaneously cleave and curse anything with its incisive claws. Rarely, POKENAME are employed by seafarers to ward off disaster and misfortune during their passage under stormy weather.
author: silverscloudy

entry: POKENAME strikes a balance between physical and magical prowess. It can cast disorienting spells on its enemies, but when spellcasting proves ineffective, its strong arms serve as backup.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is still learning how to best approach novel situations in battle. It enjoys predictable fights where it can use the same few tactics to win.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is fastidious in its training and never deviates far from the plans its Trainer sets for it. Sometimes it loses battles because of an unexpected twist that was not accounted for.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many wild POKENAME spend their time practicing their powerful abilities in groups called "schools". They are very studious and curious Pokémon that happen to get themselves into mischief very often.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Generally considered a nuisance, POKENAME lives in the walls of older houses. It sabotages electronic devices and taunts the owners face-to-face before phasing through the floor.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Hot vapor streams from POKENAME's body as it speaks in a haunting, curse-like tongue. The steam regularly takes shapes resembling prey it hunts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a playful guile that it uses whenever it performs a trick on people. The tricks it performs are seldom malicious but may be overwhelming for some people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carries around gemstones that are said to have magical properties. They protect these gems using powerful kicks that can shatter concrete.
author: erod0467

entry: POKENAME are said to have tumbled from the stars in search of a place to weave their strange spells. They practice these enchantments by conjuring disorienting lights to tease travelers before vanishing into the shadows.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Its howl contains primal magic, allowing it strength or the ability to walk on air. Magicians try emulating its howl to replicate its magic. The most skilled magicians only have moderate success.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The liquid in POKENAME's mouth bubbles constantly like a cauldron. Scientists have determined this to be a chemical reaction tied to its diet, though some Mediums insist it is brewing a potion.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is well liked by those in theatre for its famed role in a classic play where one played three witches simultaneously as other actors voiced its lines. Some believe the dark magic cast by POKENAME in that story isn't entirely fictional.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME was once kept as a pet of aristocratic nobles, and still retains many posh mannerisms. It is now found in haunted manors where it still grooms itself for the eventual return of its owner.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's powers are dependent on the combination of foods it eats. It experiments with different foods each day in hopes of discovering useful abilities.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME acts like a living cauldron; it devours various ingredients to brew mystical potions inside its enormous stomach.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's vials are full of strange concoctions, contact with which is highly discouraged. If angered, it heats the vials' contents to a boil until they erupt and splash the liquid tinctures all around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME acts like a living mass within a magical potion; it can imbue its magic into rain clouds to create showers of cursed raindrops.
author: hophoppip

entry: The distant ringing of bells on the wind signals the arrival of a POKENAME. Those who listen to its chimes for too long become entranced, singing along to the melody as the POKENAME merrily dances and leads them into the night.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It unleashes a rage-powered scream before chasing after its dazed victim. POKENAME will coat its fists with an enchantment before attacking.
author: awiralonprime

entry: POKENAME's powerful mind is believed to have memorized over 1000 different curses. The crystal it carries is said to house part of its soul, ensuring that even if its body failed, its mind would live on.
author: sk372

entry: The hat on top of its head is actually part of its body. Highly territorial, it uses telekinesis to throw boulders at anyone getting too close to it.
author: raptorroocool

entry: The trotting of POKENAME's hooves echoes through the night in odd cadences that seem to resemble ancient chants. If a Trainer attempts to ride atop a wild POKENAME, they will be wrapped in ribbons and smog and then carried off into the night.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are said to be spirits that are attracted to misfortune. While not the direct cause, that stigma makes them not very loved by humans.
author: sandguything

entry: Mismites are attracted to larger cases of misfortune, merging together to become POKENAME. The one keeping its hat was the first to the scene.
author: sandguything

entry: POKENAME enchants sailors that enter its territory with delusions and hallucinations. Afflicted sailors often act brash and bullish, but the enchantment fades once they leave its domain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's blasters shoot out small gifts and confetti for small Pokémon to enjoy. The patterns on its shell depict various festive scenes.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME floats near burial sites, mumbling something that sounds like chanting. The words are unintelligible, but their eerie resonance makes the air feel thick with an unsettling energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has enough magical power to force entire towns to fall asleep, allowing it to pick the dreams it wants to devour from a wide spread. It is not careful when it eats dreams, and may take associated memories with the dream.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME can be persuaded to cast protective sleep spells with its gem pendulum by offering it gifts of Berries, especially Kasib or Colbur Berries. When it feeds on dreams, its beard-fur darkens or brightens based on how happy or sad the dream was.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grows black feathers atop its skull that form a hat-like shape. This crest expands with age and can become as large as its own body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to often roam old buildings with a history of great tragedy. When disturbed, it attacks trespassers with bone rapiers.
author: inksans201x

entry: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.
author: chorb33

entry: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.
author: chorb33

entry: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME performs impressive displays of illusions, pantomiming, and other fantastic powers in dim lighting in front of any audience foolish enough to be engrossed. During this time, Murmime are stealing any loose valuables the audience might have.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME performs impressive displays of illusions, pantomiming, and other fantastic powers in dim lighting in front of any audience foolish enough to be engrossed. During this time, Murmime are stealing any loose valuables the audience might have.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is an intelligent fusion with a penchant for emotional manipulation: even unrelated Murkrow cannot help but be swayed by its Fake Tears. It acts as a strict and demanding matriarchal figure.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME amuses flocks of Murkrow with shadow play techniques. They sometimes miss the mark, adding a touch of whimsy to its nightly performances.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME appears on computers offering to hide and encrypt a user's data to protect them, but the offer is a scam. In reality, it plans to hoard the data and make off with anything valuable it can glean from the information.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in the fluff on its chest, as the size and gloss of it is a sign of status among its kind. POKENAME tips its hat as a sign of respect towards proper grooming.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very deceptive and manipulative Pokémon. They often use their psychic abilities to trick Trainers and Pokémon into doing their bidding.
author: chrisryusaki

entry: This Pokémon is sought out for its beautiful feathers, causing it to become distant from humans. If one manages to find POKENAME, it will attack without hesitation to protect itself.
author: gtrwya

entry: POKENAME is commonly found in the lower ranks of Pokémon gangs. Even though they are found in gangs, they can't stand hurting others.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are vigilant creatures that work together with police investigators to track down people who escape from prisons. Their short sleep schedule allows them to remain in the field for long hours following a scent trail until criminals are found.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can't help but be the center of attention of those nearby due to its mysterious powers. It uncontrollably invokes the urges of attentiveness, obedience, and general interest in those nearby.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A small group of researchers have claimed that POKENAME can perform elaborate song and dance routines. These claims remain unsubstantiated, and the researchers who made them have been dismissed as quacks.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME gather into hordes and pick every Chople Berry in the nearby vicinity. Whenever they spot a Fighting-type predator, they chew down the gathered berries and attack the threat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When fighting, POKENAME loves to perform Flying moves, using them to show off to the other Wooper fusions it lives with. Apart from this, it spends most of its time on the ground, trying to order around others.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are known to use their psychic powers to get other Pokémon into trouble while making themselves seem innocent. They often earn the ire of their teammates because of these deceptive ploys.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its small size belies a very ruthless and cutthroat demeanor. It strong-arms its way to becoming a leader of Murkrow gangs, arranging coordinated heists and forcing its peons to forfeit a fraction of their ill-gotten gains to it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roams ancient libraries protecting scrolls and tablets from damage. It is rumored that it once served alongside librarians, but this rumor has yet to be confirmed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These suave Pokémon will steal feathers to build out their coat and hat. The larger the coat, the more power they have over their pack.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME will attack its Murbird goons if they fail to gather enough shiny objects. They distribute their stolen food to their young.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME's impressive antlers act as a roost for the murder of Murkrow that it's in charge of. POKENAME are used as a symbol of wisdom in authority.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME bullies all other Pokémon it deems lesser than itself. It can often be seen poking smaller Pokémon with the horn on its head to annoy them.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME turns its own milk into cheese fondue, which it shares with the flock of Murkrow and Murkrow fusions it rules over. Outsiders will be viciously attacked by the flock if they venture too close.
author: hophoppip

entry: A cry from POKENAME summons savage thunderstorms. Reports claim to see many Murkou within the clouds, flocking to their leader's call. Due to the rarity of these Pokémon, however, the Murkou are thought to be illusions created by rampant electricity.
author: chibitales

entry: The hat POKENAME carries on its tail is very precious to it. If it is dropped or damaged, POKENAME will cry for hours.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's eerie chirps mimic ancient incantations and chants. Prolonged exposure has been known to cause migraines and dizziness in listeners.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a laid-back and jovial personality, often plodding about in urban areas. If it sees Murkrow misbehaving, though, it gives the troublesome bird a disciplinary wallop on the head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are notoriously vain Pokémon. If they find a small shiny object they will braid it into their vines.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, and is known to control massive gangs of species related to it. It is considered a large threat to towns and cities, and usually requires entire groups of trainers to get rid of it.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME from the eastern coasts grow red feather tufts along their long tails. These feathers molt when the creature is under heavy stress.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is thought of as a sign of calamity when it appears in online spaces. It rarely appears on message boards, but if one appears, any active users will experience strange phenomena that may put their lives at risk.
author: mistathefox

entry: POKENAME is often seen spamming inboxes with nonsensical offers and deals. This Pokémon rarely listens to anyone, always causing trouble, but it seemingly makes an exception for its trainer.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME forces the other Pokémon living in its tree to give up part of their food; otherwise, it drives them away with force, aided by its companions. With the claws on its feet, it marks the trees it claims as home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME love shiny things as well as things that glow. When given the chance, POKENAME pick up cigarette butts with their beaks and mock the people who dropped them.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME commonly get into squabbles about loot found in their flocks. The POKENAME with bigger feathers in their hat win these disputes more often than not.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is a fierce fighter, opting to fight its own battles. When it senses that a foe may be too much to handle on its own, it will let out a loud cry to summon a murder of its cronies to aid in battle.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are ruthless leaders. If one of POKENAME's cronies displeases it, it will be met with a powerful strike, literally and figuratively kicking that Pokémon out of the flock.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Spreading its massive wings and letting out a single cry, POKENAME can summon over 100 of its cronies from any part of the forest. POKENAME can jump great heights with its powerful legs, then sore for mass distances with its wings.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME have often been seen leading flocks of Murkrow and other similar Pokémon to steal from people and Pokémon alike. Because some POKENAME use force to keep their flocks in line, they have been popularly portrayed as villains in some media.
author: infinex21

entry: Enticing and cruel, the POKENAME will be seen on dark nights, crying. Any fool who dares try to comfort it will be swallowed by the night.
author: greatrobotmaster

entry: Mysterious and aloof, POKENAME is never seen without a loyal flock of Murkrow ready to follow its whims. If one tips its cap to you, you've earned its respect, and the flock will be obedient to you as well.
author: sk372

entry: Any towns where POKENAME is spotted are advised to keep all doors and windows shut, lest this Pokémon steal anything that glimmers and shines.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: POKENAME take great care of their feathers and even gather their own shed feathers to decorate heavy sticks, which they wield as foci for their powers. Due to their penchant for stealing from the wealthy, they have become popular characters in shows.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are great actors because of their superb athleticism and ability to express certain emotions on command. They are often featured in action films because they love acting in fight scenes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bullies smaller Pokémon, particularly Murkrow, into doing its bidding and gathering food for it. Those who resist its demands find themselves on the receiving end of a nasty bite from its sharp teeth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME forms gangs of disparate Pokémon to help claim territory for itself, enforcing the boundaries of the territory with displays of strength. When forced to fight for itself, POKENAME is wily and formidable, using underhanded strategies to win.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Feathers fallen from POKENAME turn an unnatural void-black. Many cults once wove them into garments, believing the color signified divine origin.
author: .izik

entry: On nights said to be cursed, POKENAME leads an army of Muredge to curse an entire town. They slowly consume their life force and eventually move onto the next.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME attempt to boss around other Pawniard or Murkrow, but POKENAME don't have the same sway over the species the same way Honchkrow or Bisharp have. POKENAME polish their blades to a shining gleam, as reflective of light as the full moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME commands a legion of Dark-types with strict and unforgiving expectations. Other wild Dark-type Pokémon can't help but bend to its will. Those who disobey or greatly disappoint POKENAME are permanently removed from the group.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It's said that when a POKENAME looks at someone, it judges their soul. They usually are pacifistic, but become highly aggressive when threatened.
author: elionagashi

entry: POKENAME are friendly and polite Pokémon who love to find valuables, if only to return them to their rightful owners. Quite a few detectives have POKENAME partners, who can track many things or people and restrain troublemakers with their feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is believed to inhabit places with extremely high Murkrow populations. It uses shadowy tendrils to take control of all of them at once and direct them to cause extreme mischief across the land.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME doesn't often take matters into its own hands, but rather leaves its companions or subordinates to do the job, while cheering or insulting them depending on their efforts. If it gets into a fight, it'll behave as a dangerous and cruel beast.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME crafts disguises from dark feathers gathered off forest floors. It emits a distorted chirping sound as it wanders through the woods.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME discharges powerful bursts of electricity from the hat-shaped feathers atop its head. The sparks grow brighter as night falls.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME does its best to appear cute and approachable to lure humans closer. This is, however, just a devious scheme to gain food, shelter and attentive care for little return.  Once domesticated, this Pokémon becomes lazy and stubborn.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME have a dapper corbeau hat that they wear to beguile Trainers and steal trinkets while they perform cute tricks. If they are caught stealing, they give a cute stare to disarm the tension.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It loves watching other Pokémon battle each other, as it excitedly tweets to encourage its friends. Many Trainers agree that with POKENAME by your side, even a Slowpoke duel becomes a thrilling spectacle to watch.
author: epping_forest

entry: As it evolves, POKENAME becomes very mean towards teammates favored by its Trainer for their beauty, rather than strength and effort. It will do anything to steer the team back on course, even stepping down when feeling unable to keep up.
author: epping_forest

entry: The scruff around the necks of POKENAME are gathered from their nests upon birth. When nesting, they pull from their current scruff to create it.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME is extremely agressive towards everyone, even inside its own clan. It slacks off most of the time, letting its mob do its malicious bidding.
author: galactak

entry: POKENAME attack their foes by dancing gracefully. Their attacks become more powerful if music is playing. POKENAME seem to prefer string instruments like the fiddle or guitar in particular.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Its ears act as acoustic mirrors, granting it incredible hearing and the ability to project back sound waves of its own. It uses this ability to avoid obstacles at night and rally others of its own species.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME are leaders of massive flocks of Noibat and Murkrow, ruling the skies at night. During the day, however, these flocks retreat to caves to hide.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME has the unique ability to turn anything it consumes into a material similar to cotton stuffing. The stuffing is resistant to physical impacts, so POKENAME will eat as much as possible to make its body more durable.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spends the day resting while its numerous Murkrow guard it. Come nightfall, it commands the flock to gather rare objects for its treasure hoard. Such items include Nuggets and even Chansey eggs.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends the day sharpening its spines and claws. Come nightfall, it roams the desert with numerous Murkrow in tow, seeking to gather rare objects for its treasure hoard.
author: mepp.

entry: These Pokémon are nicknamed the "Bare-Knuckle Fighters of the Dark" due to their fist-like talons and their ability to strike quickly. They can fly at roughly 90 mph.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME grows small crystals on its body made out of Fools' Gold. It will often trick lesser-minded Pokémon into working for it for a share of its "gold".
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are usually seen within a murder of Murkrows and act as the group's muscular bodyguard. POKENAME rarely separate from the group and opt to stay by the acting Honchkrow's side.
author: corninin

entry: When colored lighting hits POKENAME, its appearance doesn't ever change from its black-and-white coloring. This Pokémon was very involved in the early stages of filmmaking, and in its honor directors made films that eventually became cult classics.
author: _pixelar_
