entry: POKENAME travels through cities at night, followed by a few Murkrow lackeys to make it feel more important. Any perceived slight against it causes it to swing its cane to bludgeon the insulting party.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a natural air of authority when socializing with other Pokémon. Neglectful or inexperienced Trainers have been known to lose their whole team to a charismatic POKENAME.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: Despite possessing the ability to materialize diamonds out of thin air, most of the jewels in POKENAME's collection are stolen. Its "gang" of Carbinks obey its every order, lest they find themselves frozen eternally in tough crystal.
author: bollocksmen

entry: POKENAME can be found alongside Murkrow in cold places. It carefully watches over the sleeping Murkrow during the day.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME uses the brute force of its fists to make weaker Pokémon collect food to offer it. If they don't obey, it becomes so enraged that it starts blowing steam from its nostrils through its stern beak.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is known to be very sly and mischievous, even towards its beloved Trainer. It fights against Houndoom for territory.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The "cane" POKENAME holds is actually part of its body, and inseperable from its hand.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: It watches Trainers closely during battle, copying their tactics with eerie precision. It would behoove any observer to study its movements for hidden techniques.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Sighting a shadowy bird passing by at night is the first warning sign of a POKENAME being nearby. While the use of these birds has yet to be identified, folk stories describe POKENAME using them to fight their Trainers' nightmares.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's heads operate as a scale, weighing the karma of creatures and delivering a verdict. It resides in dark forests.
author: anlcorpagent

entry: POKENAME rides alongside sailors and pirates because of the powerful cannons on its back. It gives little feedback on how it feels, which many have mistaken for apathy. Despite this misconception, it offers small nods of acknowledgement when praised.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using their Hypnosis, POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon into doing their bidding. This often ends up with POKENAME amassing large gatherings of Pokémon to sleep near them so they may easily feast on dreams.
author: chibitales

entry: This Pokémon appears wherever its lamp senses a disease. If it finds its patient, it already knows how to treat them.
author: zerocipher

entry: POKENAME acts as the charismatic, hypnotic leader of a large, troublesome group of Pokémon. It has been known to take hostages to get what it wants.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon appears wherever its lamp senses a disease. If it finds its patient, it already knows how to treat them.
author: zerocipher

entry: POKENAME refuses to move once it finds a spot that has plenty of sun. It does this even though it is not a plant, simply because it loves playing the part.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: The orbs comprising POKENAME's fists are solid and resilient, leaving it able to punch a target repeatedly without getting sore. It trains and fights hard, but is prone to crying excessively if it loses a match.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME secretes excess fluid out of its wings and tear ducts, which scatters to the ground. It is said to be both mildly sweet and salty.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often dances when nobody is around, strengthening its mind and heightening its intelligence in the process. If POKENAME is caught messing up even the slightest movement, it begins to cry profusely.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME have a cubic shape that resembles a small sapling. Even though they are vaguely plant-shaped, they do not rely on photosynthesis to sustain themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand to improve its plantlike disguise. When it needs to run away, it constantly trips and falls.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME swings on one foot, changing direction every second, never losing its balance. It makes clicking noises as it does so.
author: chorb33

entry: Once a POKENAME finds a suitable place to perch, it can remain perfectly motionless for hundreds of hours at a time.
author: itsmebrewsky

entry: It camouflages itself among the tree branches, remaining perfectly still throughout the day. When night falls, POKENAME takes flight to feed on the nectar of rare flowers that only bloom under the starlight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a sensitive heart that is very attuned to nature. If it comes across a fallen tree while in flight, it clings to the tree and cries softly for several minutes.
author: sk372

entry: The green webbing clumped on its back resembles leaves. It can loose these orbs of silk in multiple directions, catching an opponent with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its heavy rock-like body, it cannot fly for long periods of time. If caught in the rain, a thin film of mud will cover its stony outer layer.
author: .izik

entry: When it is deep in a cave and there is no light, the spheres on its head emit a dim green glow. This light pulsates with its heartbeat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gingerly approach new Pokémon when they are left at daycare. They have a difficult time making friends and often struggle with learning social skills, so Trainers are advised to encourage them to play with other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sheds tiny stone splinters from its bark-like exterior as it moves. These sharp fragments often discourage predators, ensuring it remains undisturbed in its habitat.
author: .izik

entry: Although it is highly frowned upon, many farmhands have secretly attested to bullying local POKENAME until they cry. This is because the tears they shed contain nutrients that make crops grown in the soil flourish much greater.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tears contain nutrients that help crops flourish. However, very few are willing to make it cry on purpose to get the tears.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's tears contain nutrients that help crops flourish. However, very few are willing to make it cry on purpose to get the tears.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: As POKENAME gets older, its body becomes woodier. This is a strong defence mechanism as other Pokémon are unable to digest them, though young POKENAME are tender and taste similar to bamboo shoots. If part of their gill is eaten, they can regrow it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: As POKENAME gets older, its body becomes woodier. This is a strong defence mechanism as other Pokémon are unable to digest them, though young POKENAME are tender and taste similar to bamboo shoots. The ends of their gills always stay tender.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: As POKENAME gets older, its body becomes woodier. If they are abandoned by their mother, POKENAME is unable to stop crying, and uses its toxic tears to attack foes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME clings to cliffsides, using its small size to hide from predators. It is known to carve out crevices where it can rest safely away from the reach of larger Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: Flocks of POKENAME perch along the rooftops of libraries and nearby buildings, pretending to be stone sculptures. Despite their bright coloring, they often fool predators like Talonflame.
author: .izik

entry: It cries to make its enemies feel sympathy for it. While they're distracted, it delivers a sneak attack.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME collect tons of sweet fruit and bring them back to their den to eat. However, if they are approached by a wild Pokémon, they will drop what they are holding except one or two pieces of fruit and try to imitate a tree, standing still.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's rocky body is coated in a thin layer of charcoal dust, which it uses to stay warm in colder environments. When threatened, it releases small puffs of soot to create cover and escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrives in the tundra, where it burrows beneath snowdrifts to avoid the cold. It stores warmth in its rocky frame, allowing it to remain active even in freezing temperatures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys arranging begonias around its nest, using the flowers to mark its territory. It takes great care in maintaining these displays, often rearranging petals to suit its mood.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rely on their natural camouflage to play hide-and-seek with their Trainer. They love to hide in images of tall grass and let out a quiet chirp when found.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it gets upset it will unleash waves of psychic energy. It channels its power through its stone antlers.
author: .izik

entry: If it senses any sadness, POKENAME can't help but break into tears. The antenna on its head senses all emotions in a 10 mile radius.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: In battle, wild POKENAME often stay still, trying to mimic what they have learned from their parents. They are not yet skilled at channeling energy back at the foe, however.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In battle, wild POKENAME often stay still, trying to mimic what they have learned from their parents. They are not yet skilled at channeling energy back at the foe, however.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In dense jungles, POKENAME mimics plants to avoid danger. It will stay motionless for hours if it sees a predator.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon prefers solitude, disguising itself as greenery in swampy terrain. It remains motionless for days to avoid detection.
author: leonian1586

entry: Those who gaze into the hole in POKENAME's back begin crying uncontrollably. The effect goes away quickly after looking away, and most regard the experience as strangely cathartic in a way.
author: sk372

entry: Its body is as hard as marble. During the evenings it digs at the base of bushes to consume the nutritious roots.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME seeks out rock gardens and stands motionless, mimicking a statue. At night, it gnaws on the surrounding rocks to keep its teeth sharp.
author: .izik

entry: The slow amble POKENAME takes throughout the day makes it a reliable partner for people who have trouble walking. The elderly often hold onto its branches to keep themselves steady.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The spike on its head secretes a potent acid. It uses this corrosive liquid to make holes in cavern walls and create its nest.
author: .izik

entry: Researchers have yet to confirm whether POKENAME was wood that petrified after it was carved or always stone, but they agree that it is possessed.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME loves to play with other Pokémon but struggles to be noticed because of its natural camouflage. Many Pokémon have been comforted by its feelers without knowing it was ever there.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wanders through canyons, gathering small stones to decorate its body. Its playful nature often leads to surprise encounters with travelers exploring the winding paths.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME will shed sorrowful tears, but they are rarely genuine. It is usually either deceiving people or putting on a show.
author: birchbot

entry: It reminisces about its babyhood. It sometimes cries because of the nostalgic memories.
author: birchbot

entry: Charming and mild mannered, POKENAME seek out lavish mansions to call home. It quietly feeds on the life force of its housemates.
author: .towerxvi

entry: It lounges on mountaintops for long periods to absorb the sun's heat. It will channel this warmth into its fire-based attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lie on the banks of riverbeds, pretending to be a log or rock. They absorb moisture until it becomes bloated. They then excrete this moisture from their eyes, which they drink for nutrients.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME regulates moisture by storing excess fluid in its green orbs. These spheres often grow too large to manage after heavy rain.
author: lynx.mauls

entry: POKENAME are in the paradoxical of wanting to make friends while also needing to blend into their environment. This leads to the stalking behaviour that they are known for, as they are too shy for direct confrontations.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME would often be found bobbing on the water's surface if it were not for other Wailord fusions insisting it try to protect itself while migrating underwater. Incredibly shy, it may break out into tears if approached.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are diffident singers that lack the confidence to recover from mistakes. They are perfectionists to a fault and get upset whenever anyone interrupts their singing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME thrives in rocky mountains, where it absorbs minerals to harden its body. It camouflages itself among boulders, remaining motionless until disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often gets mistaken for driftwood since it is often seen lazily drifting down rivers. It rarely ever expresses any sort of emotion.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is both stubborn and easily frightened. This often lands it into troublesome situations. If overwhelmed, it will let out a loud cry to call its family.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME inflates its soft, stretchy body to increase its size to look more imposing, hoping to scare off intruders. If this fails, its only recourse is to cry and run away.
author: sk372

entry: Some POKENAME like to sleep inside of terracotta pots. Some say that it makes them feel safe; others believe that it improves their growth.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME is a very frightened Pokémon. It takes time and dedication to get a POKENAME to trust someone.
author: birchbot

entry: It sheds excess moisture through its eyes. This has led people to believe that it is the spirit of a lost child, crying in despair.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's saliva contains minerals that strengthen its body, making it resilient against harsh weather. It frequently licks its own body, ensuring that it remains tough and durable.
author: .izik

entry: The emeralds on POKENAME's body glow softly before rainfall. When this happens, it hides quickly to avoid even a single drop of water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide amongst fields of freshly planted crops, sheltering from larger Pokémon and relying on their plant-like appearance to camouflage them. They grow upset when their hiding place is harvested, crying uncontrollably for a full day.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hide amongst fields of freshly planted crops, sheltering from larger Pokémon and relying on their plant-like appearance to camouflage them. Their colours change to a bright red when the crops around them bear fruit.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hide amongst fields of freshly planted crops, sheltering from larger Pokémon and relying on their plant-like appearance to camouflage them. The tunnels they dig through fields help to mix nutrients into the soil, improving harvest yields.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is very skilled in manipulating humans into giving it extra treats. It sadly looks at them with tears in its eyes, and if that doesn't work, it gives demanding, noisy yowls.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME are often picked on by other Pokémon for their small size. The social anxiety that develops leaves them with headaches from overanalyzing every situation they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often found deep in the forest, typically near ancient ruins. Despite being made of stone, they can soak up water from the ground by planting themselves in the ground. On especially hot days, they sweat this water to cool their bodies.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME reside in desert caves and can be found by their continuous crying. These tears are actually bait for prey to come closer, allowing POKENAME the perfect opportunity to fly up and dive bomb.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite looking like branches, the limbs coming off of its body act as antennae. The limbs can sense heat and predict weather patterns in its immediate area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a russet body that helps them blend into swampy environments. They move slowly through swamps to avoid drawing attention to themselves and can swim without disturbing the water's surface with their specialized tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a singular tawny head at the base and two green fake heads. They tend to scare away bug Pokémon because of their resemblance to another bird Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME silently follows those feeling down, using some of its ghostly gaseous form to cause them to cry. It does this not out of malice, but to try and give the person a measure of catharsis and relief through the crying.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds on rich ore deposits, slowly incorporating these minerals into its rocky exterior. Over time, its body becomes a dense, glittering structure that reflects the materials it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stand perfectly still, channeling their psychic powers through their orbs to prevent passing people or Pokémon from noticing them. They only move late at night, storing people's dreams in their orbs to feast on later.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME sits still in dry environments with a clear mind. It befriends Pokémon that mistake it for plant life and soothes them with its incense.
author: noel5229

entry: The plants that grow on POKENAME's back float just like helium balloons. POKENAME loves to gives them out to children.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are popular companions for Jugglers who regularly perform at children's parties. POKENAME are soft and make a fun squeaking noise when hugged, helping calm upset children whilst the Juggler entertains the rest of the party.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will often steal one of their Trainer's Poké Balls and hide it among three to seven fakes, depending on its mood. It expects the Trainer to guess the real one - though the joke turns dangerous, as the fakes explode when opened.
author: dzygomer

entry: When startled, POKENAME expels toxin-laced confetti from spouts across its body to distract and dissuade threats. The poison is neutralized after an hour outside of POKENAME, leading to the confetti being used as a tart sprinkle on desserts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The cocoon of a POKENAME is made of a stiff yet brittle material that makes them vulnerable to predators. They conjure invisible walls that are made out of psychic energy to block beaks and talons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME expels a hallucinogenic gas, which causes those who inhale it to perceive objects around them that are not really present. The color of the gas is affected by the Berries in POKENAME's diet.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is very shy. However, it loves to make what little friends it does have happy. It uses its vines to do dances for its friends.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME stop predators from eating them by creating solid invisible barriers. These barriers momentarily confuse wild predators and give them enough time to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To entertain itself and others, POKENAME juggles spheres it gathers using its electricity as a tethering cable. It puts more effort into these shows of entertainment than it does into battle.
author: sk372

entry: A prankster that preys on the curious, POKENAME hides in its box until something comes near to check out the strange cube, before springing forth from within and using its horn to deliver a paralyzing venom, then cackling as it hops away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME traps foes inside invisible walls, then transforms into their Trainer. It uses the confusion to escape unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: When concentrating, POKENAME's head pom tugs faintly toward nearby evolutionary stones. Finding one empowers it greatly, allowing evolution to take place.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME delights in pranks, erecting clever Barriers that prevent users from clicking desired links. If it senses mounting frustration, it will quietly remove them.
author: .izik

entry: The ball on the tip of POKENAME's stinger is to prevent it from accidentally poisoning itself. In combat, this ball gets shot off at speeds of up to 50 MPH which POKENAME then follows up with a corrosive poison sting.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: While sleeping, POKENAME releases a sweet Occa Berry scent from the pom on its head. The aroma calms others nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The shimmering heat haze that POKENAME can conjure forms impassable barriers. The barriers eventually collapse as the heat diffuses in the air. Circuses often employ POKENAME to create near-invisible barriers underneath acrobat performers.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME can mimic the cries of several kinds of bird Pokémon. It screeches like a Fearow or Dodrio to scare away predators.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME delivers jokes with excellent comedic timing. They are so funny that they can make other Pokémon faint from laughter.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME suddenly drops from tree canopies to land in front of startled creatures, observing their reaction quietly. It then climbs back up its tree and spins a web designed to depict their fearful expression.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly changes the rhythm of its wing fluttering so that anything chasing it gets confused. However, this results in it being a very poor flier.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME frequently loses control of its psychic powers. It unintentionally erects invisible walls nearby when startled or excited.
author: .izik

entry: During full moon nights, POKENAME showcases the movements it copied during the day. It performs for friends in secret gatherings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME habitually sings the same song over and over. The first piece of music it hears is what it repeats until it evolves.
author: .realthree

entry: The curls of POKENAME's wool seem to swirl endlessly. Staring at it is hypnotic, which works to POKENAME's advantage.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME floats high above parks during the day, spying on people. At night, it mimics their actions with others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mimics the facial expressions of Trainers and Pokémon it goes up against to confuse them. If that doesn't work, it quickly runs away.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME wraps its tail around its gills to preen itself, using a special gel it secretes to keep itself looking glossy. It doesn't like to be seen in public before it has done this and enjoys participating in Pokémon Contests.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Some POKENAME fashion their own hats and use a special gel they secrete to keep it looking glossy. These Pokémon compete to see who has the most impressive hat, and only the winners are allowed to participate in Pokémon Contests.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When it senses sadness in others, POKENAME is quick to start dancing to entertain them. It can even use its psychic powers to create little showers of confetti around it to make its dance seem more amusing.
author: sk372

entry: Because of its incredible intuition, POKENAME has the ability to predict the actions of others. It preemptively mimics these actions, confusing and perplexing its foes, sometimes making them believe that they are the ones actually copying POKENAME.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are zany creatures that love to entertain others. They grow balloons from their back that they give out to children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever POKENAME arrives at a bustling, lively location, it creates an underground maze with its tail for the others to have fun in. It rewards those who successfully complete its maze by putting on a show of mimicking their actions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME erects psychic walls around its nest to guard it. If intruders get too close, it strikes with a furious barrage of pecks.
author: .izik

entry: This POKENAME will panic and attempt to cheer sad individuals up, aggressively. With awkward party tricks and uncomfortable hugs, it won't stop until everyone is laughing or least pretending to.
author: curazy

entry: The puppets on the claws of POKENAME are often used in an intimidation tactic. Researchers are still not entirely sure that the psychic energy POKENAME emits hasn't given them consciousness.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME hides in its incredibly robust box and plays music so that it can prank approaching people and then disappear again.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME tends to try to mimic Combee to gain free access to their honey. While the Combee aren't fooled by this mimicry, they often let POKENAME have some honey anyways due to it hurling other rivals who want honey away with its horn.
author: soup1900

entry: Before attacking, POKENAME releases a burst of honey-scented aroma. It then unleashes a powerful psychic strike against its foe.
author: .izik

entry: Often used by children's entertainers, POKENAME has lost the heat of other Slugma fusions. Instead, it has a warm, candy floss feel.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: It seeks out gatherings of people to show off its mimicry skills, but it moves so slowly that an event often ends before POKENAME arrives. In front of an audience, it may become nervous and hide in its shell.
author: oddwalls

entry: The long hair of POKENAME is incredibly dense, making it impossible for this Pokémon to see. Because of this, POKENAME are often found bumping into their environment.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME gathers trinkets in its tail. It may give you one if it enjoys your reaction to its mimicry.
author: the_fireplace

entry: At night, POKENAME howls into the darkness while the pom on its head glows red-hot, creating an eerie, flickering sight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an elusive but intelligent Pokémon that loves to perform tricks for onlookers. However, it will never emit a sound; if POKENAME growls or barks, something is very wrong and it is greatly upset.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME juggles objects skillfully with its nose. If spotted mid-act, it grows shy and pushes the onlooker away with psychic force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hack into closed circuit television footage and insert themselves into the video. They copy the movements of people inside the footage to entertain themselves but often obscure important events in the video with their antics.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME jumps off invisible walls it creates mid-air. This lets it perform complex and graceful martial arts maneuvers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves showing off its juggling abilities. While it seems skilled in martial arts, it mostly mimics other Pokémon's fighting styles.
author: mahrtist

entry: POKENAME is nocturnal and does most of its hunting at night. This is due to its slightly fluorescent frill pattern, and due to the fact that it struggles to keep excitement from its true face.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Touching its nose startles it, even if it sees you reaching toward it, and causes it to discharge electricity from its cheeks. These Pokémon seem to be innately curious about humans and other Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: This fusion is extremely bouncy, as if it were made of bubblegum and springs. It loves to play hopscotch with children and Pokémon alike.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME has mastered its juggling abilities and can use its psychic and magnetic abilities to keep the balls it has floating indefinitely. On occasion, Trainers have seen wild POKENAME practicing juggling routines.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME fires large rubber balls from the holes in its hands with enough force to destroy a brick wall. It's often seen at stunt shows as its thick, rubber armor protects it from most physical damage.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is known as an active partygoer; it often shows up in places where many people or Pokémon are gathered. This Pokémon will often entertain the people or Pokémon at said party.
author: soup1900

entry: If it senses a cave-in while digging, POKENAME creates an invisible wall above its immediate area. This allows its kin time to escape safely.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME hops around, the ball attached to its hat-like feathers will bounce and jingle like a bell. POKENAME is very fond of other Pokémon, following them with a bounce in its step and chirping happily.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are notoriously sensitive to the thoughts and emotions of others and typically evade people. Noteably, they are more willing to appear before human children and will attempt to mimic their movements and mannerisms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love to collect and play with round objects, though red, round objects are the most alluring to them. Using their latent, albeit weak, psychic powers, they will often raise such objects aloft and pretend to juggle them.
author: infinex21

entry: To befriend humans and other Pokémon, POKENAME will use its psychic powers to perform tricks for them and will playfully mimic their movements and expressions. Their popularity with children has seen some media adapt caricatures of POKENAME.
author: infinex21

entry: Thanks to its friendly appearance, POKENAME are often found in daycares performing for young children and Pokémon alike.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME are described as embodiments of tragedy in the performing arts, never failing to convey the dark and heart-wrenching scenes of their portrayals. They have high standards when accepting roles, only taking lead parts that peak their interest.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME are described as embodiments of comedy in the performing arts, never failing to make the audience laugh with their wholehearted efforts. They mostly aren't fussy about what roles they're cast in, but they prefer to avoid satirical comedies.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME are described as embodiments of comedy in the performing arts, never failing to make the audience laugh with their wholehearted efforts. They mostly aren't fussy about what roles they're cast in, but they prefer to avoid satirical comedies.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME studies humans near busy streets to imitate them. If caught, it will try to bite the intruder with toxic fangs before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds cozy lodges and erects invisible walls around them. These psychic barriers keep predators and intruders away.
author: .izik

entry: Hiding in jack-in-the-boxes, POKENAME loves playing pranks on unsuspecting people. It seems to pity captured Pokémon, but it itself is lonely.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME mimics others to attract playmates, though its antics occasionally enrage other Pokémon. When this happens, it defends itself with its toxic barbs. These attacks help it to perfect its mimicry.
author: afilthycasual

entry: POKENAME can produce balloons from under the hat on their back and freely gives these balloons out to children. Sometimes they give out too many balloons and have to grab a child with their vines before they float away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME inflate the rubbery material around their faces to repel attacks before flailing back and forth to swat away foes. The orbs at the end of their ribbons jingle faintly as they bounce around.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The orbs on POKENAME's body jingle like bells when its sturdy skull is struck. Groups of POKENAME headbutt each other to strengthen their skulls, creating a cacophony of bell-ringing.
author: sk372

entry: Its head is so heavy that it often trips and falls over. Bald comedians sometimes dress as POKENAME while performing, and hilarity often ensues.
author: antomelon

entry: POKENAME is naturally quite small, but it has the ability to inflate to an enormous size, mimicking the form of a blimp. It prefers being in the sea, but appears content when being carried into the sky on strong winds.
author: evilgammon

entry: A curious creature, POKENAME will create copies of those it interacts with, using them to mimic their words or actions. When it's done playing around, the mimicries vanish in a burst of colorful sparkles.
author: sk372

entry: Shrubs covered in juicy seeds grow on POKENAME's back. When it unleashes its psychic power, the energy causes these seeds to burst like popcorn.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful ears to find targets to mime. Once it hears you, it is nearly impossible to avoid being mimicked.
author: astral_1447

entry: Powerful magnetism and masterful balance keeps the rocks POKENAME stacks on its head from falling over. The more impressive the stack, the more respect an individual POKENAME will receive from its peers.
author: kiwiarms

entry: This sword is as effective a cutter as a standard sword. If its blade ever pops, POKENAME uses to expelling air to fly away and regenerate elsewhere.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The more successive bounces it achieves, the more powerful the blade and the more excited the POKENAME becomes. It happily lets kids play with it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: To impress and surprise others, POKENAME balance extremely sharp and dangerous weapons on their hands, feet, and nose. Despite their shakiness, they put their honor at stake in completing the challenge so that they don't cower away.
author: soup1900

entry: When extending its feelers, POKENAME can create large barriers that trap pursuing predators. Once a safe distance is established, it turns to mock them from afar.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hold secret gatherings on nights of the full moon. At these gatherings, they dance using the actions they copied from others in the past month.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A very wary Pokémon, POKENAME carefully observes movements from others. It can easily mimic them, which it does to distract them as it bounds away.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Although its feet appear floppy and uncoordinated, POKENAME can mimic the grace and agility of other Pokémon. Since it is skittish, it will usually do this in order to run away.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME traps its opponent within invisible walls before using Fire Spin. This prevents the flames from spreading uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can expel its innards and reshape them once expelled. It mimics human hand gestures in a rudimentary attempt at communication.
author: sk372

entry: Unlike other Zwelious fusions, POKENAME's two heads mostly co-operate with each other and love to perform together. They work in tandem to juggle different objects with their psychic abilities.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME acts overly friendly to all who it meets. It loves to entertain children despite both kids and adults alike often being terrified of it.
author: hummusishome

entry: These Pokémon are often called "Nature's Harlequin" by travelers due to their mimicry of court jesters in paintings and books. They are often seen juggling nuts and berries with their four hands.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are able to manifest inside the dreams of sleeping people and Pokémon. They delight in playing pranks and making jokes within those dreams, blessing those who meet their humour in kind with good fortune.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME traps foes inside invisible walls before releasing a sudden Discharge. The combined attack leaves most enemies stunned.
author: .izik

entry: The hat on POKENAME's head wobbles when it walks. The white sphere at the tip acts as a microphone to help POKENAME mimic songs it hears.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME jumps off cliffs every day in the hopes of one day soaring through the sky. If they survive the fall, they will run away and hide in shame.
author: laughing_dan

entry: With its childlike nature, POKENAME combines harmless mimicry with flickering sparks from its tail. It often entertains others with fiery tricks, but its illusions sometimes end up startling those around it.
author: themegatroll

entry: POKENAME's poison is not deadly, only slightly sickening. However, it does cause intense hallucinations.
author: themicelegion

entry: The balls on POKENAME's hands can be detached at will. It can often be found juggling, much to the delight of children and other Pokémon.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME do their best to mimic others, despite their lack of appendages. It's best to encourage this behavior, as when POKENAME get upset they can't help but release toxic spores.
author: enemyphase

entry: It's increasingly common to find a POKENAME at children's hospitals helping around. With their soft tufts and juggling act, they bring joy and comfort to the children that need it.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are commonly used Pokémon during circus performances, their sonar allowing them to constantly sense what's happening around them. A troupe of POKENAME create elaborate mid-air performances to the delight of children.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's voice changes based on its environment and the observations it makes. It has a foul habit of imitating the cries of a Pokémon's worst enemy to scare them into leaving their food behind.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: The confetti that comes off of POKENAME's wings are often often used at birthday parties. POKENAME is popular among entertainers as a result of this.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME hide in dark crevices learning to mimic other creatures before they reach adulthood. They rely on food from their parents, but never go hungry.
author: gooeygamer69

entry: POKENAME waves its arms in dances learned by spying on dance studios. Its performances unsettle those who watch due to its oddly smooth movements.
author: .izik

entry: It haunts forests and mimics the screams of children to scare people. It only does this for its own amusement. The mimicked screams are unique to each POKENAME.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: If it finds a person unappreciative of its dances and mimicry, POKENAME squeezes its nose. This causes the flower on its head to squirt a noxious liquid at the victim, leaving them tainted with the foul smell for days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME mimics the movements and expressions of foes, absorbing their surprised and captivated emotions for energy. It sometimes confuses itself about which body part to move in its mimicry, as it's not in its original Ultra Necrozma form.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has the ability to naturally dye the sand around it with an assortment of bright colors. A popular attraction at festivals involves layering this sand into bottles.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's multicolored frill is a point of pride for it. It is always happy to show off its vibrant coloration, vibrating the frill to create a beautiful colored aurora behind it to impress others.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME senses that its Trainer is in danger, it lets out a sharp bark and instantly erects invisible walls to protect them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are popular choices for Pokémon Contests. Once it's showtime, they launch from their patient, alert pose into a bewildering series of acrobatic tricks.
author: .realthree

entry: It is a fun-loving and silly Pokémon that can emit smoke in all kinds of colors thanks to its varied diet of organic and inorganic matter. It may be a bit too happy-go-lucky; it occasionally puts itself into dangerous situations completely unaware.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME plays tricks on little kids to try and entertain them. When the kids are not impressed with what it does, POKENAME curses them until the next October.
author: dyanz0

entry: POKENAME are drawn to the sound of laughter, and are a common sight at children's birthday parties. Swarms of them can be drawn in from up to a mile away by particularly exuberant parties, though their arrival often kills the mood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME prepare circus treats such as large lollipops or cotton candy. They are known to give couples and children plenty of treats, and hope people leave happy and full of memories.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to perform silly tricks, and one of their favorite tricks is where they pretend to roast a marshmallow over their tail. After a performance, they allow children to safely play with the flame on their tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME make their burrows around circus grounds, drawn to the sounds of cheer and lively performances. They can sometimes be seen popping up from the ground within the big top to watch the clown performances.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME blends in with groups of Wurmple for protection. While it does not have venomous spikes, it can momentarily hold predators in place with its psychic powers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy juggling balls atop their head and are so good at it that jugglers watch them to develop juggling skills. Their many tricks fascinate audiences around the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of producing walls made out of psychic energy but lack the tact to use them in performances. Sometimes they bump into their own walls because they forget where they place them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy copying the motions of other Pokémon and engaging in clownish behavior. They often get dizzy from being too excited, but easily pick themselves back up for more fun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found at circuses and birthday parties performing on large balls. Whenever they succeed in a trick, they balance on their noses and clap.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Often seen at circuses, POKENAME are particularly skilled jugglers and trapeze artists. On the rare occasions that they make a mistake during a performance, they fly into an uncontrollable rage.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME are often used by jesters and clowns to enhance their performances. Not only are POKENAME naturally skilled at feats of balancing, they also possess a comically mustachioed face with an endearingly bulbous nose.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's nose honks when squeezed. When it flies at night, the honking caused by hitting obstacles often wakes other Pokémon.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME makes a loud honking sound as it unfurls its brightly colored tongue. This is believed to be a startle display to scare off potential predators.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is obedient and loyal and overall easy to train, learning and following commands and gestures with surprising speed. Some have suggested that it may be able to read minds.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This mime has a highly aggressive disposition. Trainers should be careful training it, as it is likely to lash out with no warning.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: It has been said that only when POKENAME have been given tender love and care and have experienced dozens of unique performances will they fully evolve. They mimic their Trainers' sleep patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has been said that only when POKENAME have been given tender love and care and have experienced dozens of unique performances will they fully evolve. They mimic their Trainers' sleep patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The muscles in POKENAME's arms are much weaker than they look. In order to keep up their mood, they carry around objects that, while labelled as extremely heavy, are not actually as heavy as they seem.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's attempts at mimicry go further than just physical movements. It can often be seen practicing miming by blowing bubbles that take the shape of those near it.
author: sk372

entry: With only limited control of its psychic power, POKENAME rely heavily on mimicking its parents, lest it unknowingly release fatal levels of venom.
author: char_latte3412

entry: An artificially-created variant of POKENAME, this Pokémon is prominently featured in many horror flicks as a trivial jump scare.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME's newly awakened third eye gives it strong psychic powers. It uses this power to assist its juggling.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME distracts its opponents with tricks before delivering a swift strike. Its nose lets out a honking noise wherever it goes.
author: blue_mythic

entry: POKENAME dips its tail in water and wags it around like it is trying to mime a fish swimming. When something bites its tail, it will let out a reactionary honk sound after about 5 seconds.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: A very silly Pokémon, it enjoys mimicking the actions of others but does it so slowly that it often forgets what it is trying to do mid-routine. When it forgets, it will try to copy something else, usually achieving the same result.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME uses both its psychic energy and the magnetic field from its magnets to keep its juggling balls in the air. However, these powers can be quite weak, especially in younger POKENAME, so it often will drop balls.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Upon its evolution, the extra magnetic power that POKENAME gets from its multiple heads allows for more control over its juggling. It isn't uncommon to see POKENAME floating miscellaneous metallic items around itself.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Its life goal was to be a world-renowned performer at the circus. Unfortunately, its sharp horn has burst this dream.
author: volvonovic

entry: The cannons on POKENAME's back fire apparently harmless confetti. However, when it is hunting, POKENAME infuses scalding water into its shots, causing intense burns.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME love to cause trouble and drive many Trainers crazy with their pranks and tricks. They are unrelenting with their mischief and only stop when the Trainers cry out in pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are easy to spot due to their distinctive markings. They can often be found imitating graffitied walls due to the clown make-up acquired during their fusion.
author: snookerron

entry: POKENAME loves to spread joy through performance. It will dance for those who are sad until they feel better.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME perform elaborate dances to attract the attention of other POKENAME on the beach. They are popular Pokémon for beachside attractions, their performances being particularly entertaining to children.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME perform elaborate dances to attract the attention of other POKENAME on the beach. They are popular Pokémon for beachside attractions, their performances being particularly entertaining to children.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On POKENAME's back holds a bulb containing an egg-shaped stone. When POKENAME likes a person enough, it opens up said bulb and lets them take the stone.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME wraps injured people and Pokémon in sticky silk drawn from its mouth. The thread holds healing properties that help wounds close faster.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon was discovered on April Fool's day. It tends to prank other baby Pokémon in order to cheer them up during hard times.
author: barthandelus_real

entry: POKENAME are always pining for attention and will throw tantrums if they go long enough without receiving any. Their tantrums are at their worst if anything should happen to their egg-like stones or their clubs.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite resembling eggshells, POKENAME's fists are as hard as stone. When cracks form in its fists, its evolution is imminent.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME crawls along the tree branches, leaving behind the egg-like tip of its tail and growing new ones in its wake. These tail-tips are a healthy snack for growing young Bug-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Inhaling the gases produced by POKENAME gives a person a light feeling of giddiness. One should be careful, however, as the gases are still mildly toxic and will cause illness if breathed in too much in a short time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores eggs in its belly, keeping them warm until they hatch. After breeding season, males congregate and care for the eggs together.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME are often found amongst other species of Water-type Pokémon. They school around the nurseries of other species, taking care of the eggs left behind and carrying them to safety in case of predator attacks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is shy and easily intimidated, so it tends to stay away from unfamiliar people and Pokémon. If surprised, smoke and embers spurt out of every orifice of its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This bug Pokémon constantly guards a large white stone in its pincers, thinking it to be an egg. If it allows a Trainer to touch the stone, it has an extreme bond of trust with them.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME have a parental instinct so strong that they will claim any unattended egg as their own, using their specialised tail to carry and care for it. They have no natural defences, making their speed their only means of protecting their charge.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is pacifistic in nature, and lacks major defenses. If a predator draws near, it attempts to offer the detachable orb on its tail instead, which sates most appetites for a day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have powerful parental instincts and will take over any nest where the eggs have been left alone for more than a few hours. They collect the eggs and carry them in a specialised pouch, using their giant bodies to protect them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a habit of collecting stones and making nests out of them to sleep in. It's said that the type and shape of the stones hints what its future evolution will be.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME appears on a computer's screen, it gifts the user a small, egg-shaped token before leaving. While they have no real value, many online communities enjoy comparing how many POKENAME tokens they've collected.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rests itself on the sands, its pale exterior often being mistaken for an abandoned egg. If something tries to pick it up, it quickly rolls over and nips at them before making a hasty retreat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gives off pleasant, calming scents to help its beloved egg grow. It also uses these scents to pacify those who try to steal its egg.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.
author: cristata

entry: Very early in life, POKENAME practices carrying a Magost Berry, as their round shape helps them mimic the shape of an egg. This period of time lasts approximately one year, after which it grows big enough to hold an egg properly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME finds egg-shaped rocks in the wild and creates nests around them, then sits on and nurtures them as practice for future real eggs. It has a strict schedule of checking the status of its charge every five minutes on the dot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME individually have their preferred nut or berry that they will insist upon eating as their sole food until they evolve. They will shoot long strands of their silk to collect their favored food and will wrap it up and store it for later, too.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon that often wrap berries and nuts up in their webs to save for later. Forests where POKENAME live are often littered with these self-same bundles that these Pokémon leave for others to enjoy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have special, stiffened feathers across their back that enable them to carry large eggs. They work in flocks to relocate abandoned Pokémon nests so that they can take care of them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It charges the stone it carries with small amounts of electricity before rubbing the stone against weary people and Pokémon. This electric massage helps to soothe and stimulate sore muscles.
author: sk372

entry: In exchange for a few treats from a teacher, POKENAME sit in classrooms where they set a good example for children to follow. Many teachers also incorporate lessons about stars to keep the attention of POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to mimic Chansey and Jigglypuff by playing pretend: it will give perfectly healthy Pokémon smooth, egg-like stones to 'heal' them, and will sing lullabies to help them rest. It does, however, possess a genuinely relaxing aroma.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves to mimic Chansey and Jigglypuff by playing pretend: it will give perfectly healthy Pokémon smooth, egg-like stones to 'heal' them, and will sing lullabies to help them rest. It does, however, possess a genuinely relaxing aroma.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although occasionally found floating in the air and riding on the breeze, POKENAME that manage to land will sometimes pick up stones to keep themselves grounded. They have a gentle disposition and do not like fighting.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME gathers up small white stones and places them together in small nests. Though normally docile, it will staunchly protect these nests, biting and scratching those coming too close.
author: sk372

entry: They are very energetic and mischievous Pokémon. They like to throw eggs at anything and everyone, which is why they are banned from many places.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME uses the small stones it carries to practice taking care of actual plant seeds in the future. It will even bury them in fresh soil with plenty of sunlight and water provided, even singing to the stones to promote their growth.
author: sk372

entry: When it flies, the rapid flapping of its wings emits a low-frequency hum. It has a calming, soothing effect on those nearby, helping to relieve tension in mind and body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its antennae to sense the emotions of other Pokémon, becoming highly sensitive to even the slightest negative feelings. When overwhelmed, it lets out a loud screech, often startling other baby Pokémon in nearby nurseries.
author: rakunk

entry: It gathers egg-shaped stones and carries them away to create makeshift nests. These nests are always in the vicinity of ruins, suggesting a significance to their placement.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores egg-shaped stones inside holes dug into trees. The reasoning for doing this is twofold: practice for safeguarding actual eggs in the future, and to lick and clean tasty sap off the stones.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are highly compassionate Pokémon that often tend to injured members of their habitat. They practice parenting by carrying carefully selected stones in their shells, rarely letting them out of their sight.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME live in mountain ranges, making their homes at the moraines of glaciers. They spend their time hunting for abandoned nesting sites of other Pokémon, adopting any lost eggs as their own.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME only wants exactly one thing: to see other people and Pokémon be happy; it strives to achieve this through attempting to play with others. However, it inadvertently pushes people away due to being too cheerful, to a bothersome extent.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is young and inexperienced, but hardy enough to survive mistakes. When learning to fly, it can fall from tall, mature trees without injury.
author: havic0970

entry: POKENAME have a strong sense of empathy and will not eat if they are given more than their peers. They tote around their egg by carrying it with their snout and get upset whenever they lose their egg.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME try to emulate the rolling of other Donphan but often find that they bump into objects. Despite their frequent mistakes, they are cheerful Pokémon that enjoy spending time with their peers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME were first discovered after several computers were slowed to a halt by an image of a Pokémon Egg taking up the screens. Once the image disappeared, the computers ran much more efficiently and POKENAME were seen fleeing.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME were first discovered after several computers were slowed to a halt by an image of a Pokémon Egg taking up the screens. Once the image disappeared, the computers ran much more efficiently and POKENAME were seen fleeing.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME loves the egg-shaped stone it carries. If it gets taken away, it will become upset and will fiercely challenge anyone to get it back.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME is a very empathetic Pokémon that has been employed as a nursing assistant in many hospitals. It always provides emotional support to any injured person or Pokémon.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The egg in its mouth is actually an egg-shaped stone. It is quite protective of the stone, and will violently lash out at people or Pokémon who try to steal it.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME's fur traps warmth very well and it can also easily handle scalding heat, so it is most often found in areas of extreme temperature. Although clumsy at first, it can become an expert caretaker of Pokémon Eggs with just a little training.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's fur traps warmth very well and it can also easily handle scalding heat, so it is most often found in areas of extreme temperature. Although they have moments of immaturity and naivety, they want nothing more than to help other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a pouch in their stomach that enables them to hold small objects. They are drawn to holding magnetic and elemental stones, the energies contained in them bringing them joy to carry.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legends say that the round, white stones POKENAME gives to others grant eternal happiness to the holder. While proven scientifically false, this act of kindness does boost the happiness of both the Pokémon and the person receiving the gift.
author: soup1900

entry: It finds comfort in the small white stone it holds. If it notices someone injured, it will channel psychic energy through the stone, sending soothing waves of pain relief until they can be properly treated.
author: porterofgames

entry: It habitually hides a small stone somewhere in its bushy fur and feathers. Although it often throws tantrums and cries when it doesn't get what it wants, it is overall very affectionate and even outgoing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a pouch in their stomach that enables them to hold small objects. They are drawn to holding magnetic and elemental stones, the energies contained in them bringing them joy to carry.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a pouch in their stomach that enables them to hold small objects. They are drawn to holding magnetic and elemental stones, the energies contained in them bringing them joy to carry.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a fascination with Pokémon eggs, hanging around the nests of other Pokémon and watching over the eggs in the absence of their parents. They stand protectively over the eggs, shocking anyone other than the parents that try to come close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has an incubator apparatus on its top, used to nurture eggs until hatching. It uses powerful magnetic waves to repel away anything that could possibly harm the eggs it cares for.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can fire off what appear to be eggs from its arm cannons. These eggs are actually rocks; a newly evolved POKENAME unaware of this may think it is giving an ally a nutritious Soft-Boiled egg for healing only to knock them out instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The egg-like organ at the end of POKENAME's tail is actually a poison sac. It uses it as a lure to draw out egg-poaching Pokémon, before the bulb bursts and coats the would-be hunter with a debilitating poison, making it easy prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries eggs on its large, soft tail to keep them safe and warm. Its tail perfectly balances the egg while carrying it, and reacts aggressively towards anything that threatens that balance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tends to wander in search of Trainers to help, often searching for sticks to use its fire capabilities to warm or guide a Trainer during the cold night.
author: sk1ttl3z2025

entry: This Pokémon loves collecting small stones, which it imbues with weak psychic power and gives to people it likes. A stone becomes dull if its holder is sad, but shines if they are happy.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME love to play with white stones that resemble eggs but often forget that they need to practice their egg-rearing skills. While balancing an egg on their snout is entertaining, they are often quickly reprimanded by other nest members.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gnaws on wood pieces until they're worn down into the shape of an egg. It then nurtures and protects the wooden egg, in practice for one day nurturing the real deal.
author: sk372

entry: This young POKENAME carries egg-like stones on its back, which are said to assist the Pokémon with capturing more sunlight and provide more warmth for its survival. These stones are also a key source of energy during cold nights.
author: lemage22

entry: The egg POKENAME holds on its head is actually a stone. POKENAME treats it as delicately as it would a real egg, pulling away from anyone who attempts to touch it too roughly.
author: hophoppip

entry: Ancient tales claim POKENAME absorbs reverence from onlookers into the egg-like capsule on its chest. On rare occasions the egg turns jet black, releasing unexplained beams of light.
author: .izik

entry: It plants shiny stones in the ground and patiently waits for them to sprout. Though nothing ever grows, it beams with pride at each new one it buries.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME stashes away small, white objects it finds in a hidden hoard. It guards it by shooing away invaders with its ribbon.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME survives exclusively on a diet of Chansey eggs, and although it is not violent, it often accidentally destroys things in its path. Some towns have been endangered when POKENAME discovered Pokémon Centers with Chansey populations.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It loves pretending to be other Pokémon to be able to take care of their eggs as well as their babies. It will usually hide its eggs as rocks. It gives them to those it deems pure.
author: salt

entry: POKENAME carry around an ivory stone egg to practice taking care of eggs. They envelope the stone with their feelers to keep it warm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roam in search of unattended eggs, ruthlessly crushing them beneath their feet. They absorb these crushed eggs into their wings, where they serve as markings of how many lives they've taken.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME carries around large egg-like stones to practice caring for the real thing. Because this typically leaves it with only one arm to defend itself, they become very adept using a singular thorny whip in battle with devastating precision.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can imbue some of its gentle aura into the stone it carries. When shared with others, those gifted the stone will feel more calm and peaceful while carrying it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME jealously guards the smooth white stone it balances on its head. Anyone who tries to steal it faces its sharp claws in a furious assault. Fond of fruit, it roams the forest in search of ripe delicacies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves physical touch. When its fur is stroked, little sparks fly out of its tail.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are gentle creatures that have a peach-colored blush whenever they are happy. They diligently sing lullabies to the egg that they carry to ensure the child within feels at ease.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its egg-like shell secretes an edible liquid that fills any who consume it with remarkable vigor. The closer it gets to evolving, the more of this fluid it will secrete.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spends all its time next to eggs, which are made from rocks turned into illusions that resemble white eggs. It loves to hang around Chansey to learn from them. However, if it loses its rocks, it will start worrying.
author: salt

entry: POKENAME hold onto pearls close to their warm stomach to practice caring for an egg. Their warm personalities make them doting caretakers for eggs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts through fields in search of rocks to plant seeds around. It tends to the rock in the center of the garden as if it were a patient in need of help, practicing with the medicinal herbs that it grows.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME gather small round things, often pebbles, marbles, or seeds, and bring them back to their nesting sites. They will construct mound-like nests consisting of these items, and will often carry the most prized item they've found in their pouch.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME greatly enjoys resting in the nests of different Pokémon, but its spikes are prone to harm eggs and butts alike.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME will start to throw a tantrum and loudly whine if one of its tusks breaks off. Even though the damage is irreversible, it will hold onto and cherish the tusk forever in hopes it could be repaired.
author: soup1900

entry: Their favorite food is the yolk of fresh eggs, be they abandoned or not. Their claws are sharp enough to burrow through most terrain.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dances and cheers to support its teammates, often preferring it to actually being in battle. After grueling matches, it rushes to its friends' side to deliver a light electric massage with its pom-poms.
author: sk372

entry: Because POKENAME have mostly been found near broken Pokémon Eggs, many thought they were born of the spirits of the unhatched Pokémon. It was later discovered that they are the ones who break these eggs to feast on the yolks within.
author: infinex21

entry: They carry large, abandoned eggs upon their backs with the help of thick, adhesive slime secreted from their bodies. They will temporarily hide these eggs within their hollow bodies to protect them, even if it puts their own lives at risk.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses an acidic slime to deter any threats in order to keep the egg on its back safe. Once the egg hatches, it will find a large, white rock and use its slime to shape it into a new "egg" to carry around.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its strength to help others as much as possible. It is still immature, though, so it often needs help itself in order to execute tasks properly.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME loves to give anyone it can a big hug in order to lift their spirits. While well-meaning, this can be dangerous, as it's strength can only be described as bone-crushing.
author: sk372

entry: The pouch that POKENAME stores egg-like stones in keeps the rocks chilled thanks to its cool body. It occasionally lends these stones to friends on warm days to help them cool down.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's songs are often used in daycare melodies that help placate young. Wild POKENAME are often seen caring for injured, young Pokémon and singing them into a gentle slumber.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hold the eggs of other Pokémon close to their chest, using their thick fuzz to keep them warm. Populations of POKENAME will work together to seek out nests and crowd together to take an egg each.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is friendly and gets along with almost any Pokémon. It is entirely selfless and will placate aggressors with songs and gifts.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's egg is actually a large white boulder, which it will use to bludgeon its opponents. Outside of combat, POKENAME will do anything to keep its boulder as clean as possible.
author: mistymagius

entry: The egg on its tail is believed to hold good fortune. Pokémon who witness one of POKENAME's performances are said to enjoy several days of unusually good luck.
author: aggrotek

entry: The "yolk" that drips from the egg-like ends of their wands is actually a delectable honey. This honey is said to bring mental clarity to any who consume it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME works to protect the nests of other Pokémon from predators. Clinging to tree trunks, it accurately snipes at hunters from above using bubble-coated pebbles thrown at high speeds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hold the eggs of other Pokémon close to their chest, using their thick fuzz to keep them warm. Populations of POKENAME will work together to seek out nests and crowd together to take an egg each.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are optimistic creatures that take care of abandoned eggs. The heat from their body warms up the egg to a comfortable temperature, making them great as a snuggle buddy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found feeding on plankton in calm, shallow waters. Lovers who walk on the beachside often compare its feeding habits to soft kisses.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME love to play: from chasing one another to dancing to music to playing pretend, there are few things that POKENAME will not participate in. This behavior is displayed both when POKENAME are in the wild or under the ownership of a Trainer.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Whenever POKENAME practice harnessing their psychic powers, it is important to keep their egg safe. There have been many cases of POKENAME accidentally breaking their egg by dropping an object on top.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to keep everyone warm and happy, especially the Egg that they carry. When the Egg is close to hatching, POKENAME will bark at their Trainer so they can observe the Egg hatching together.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relies on a special patch of fur on its chest to keep eggs clinging to its body. It lets out a jubilant cry when an egg is about to hatch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME take care of abandoned eggs and store them in their own nest. They can often be found soaring through the sky clutching eggs and hugging them close to their warm bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's eggs are packed with high amounts of protein. It will give out its eggs to weaker Pokémon to encourage them to become the best version of themselves.
author: mistymagius

entry: It becomes very emotionally attached to the egg-shaped stone it carries. It cannot retreat into its shell while holding it, so it often gets hurt protecting its precious cargo.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found along river banks. It uses its prehensile tail to sort through river rocks, collecting any which look like eggs.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME clutch Pokémon eggs to their front when they feel a nest is threatened, nurturing instincts compelling them to protect the young. They will turn their backs to anything they feel is dangerous, relying on their thick shell to protect them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME experience ineffable glee when they are given an opportunity to take care of an egg. They may not always be responsible with their egg, but to be trusted with an egg gives them a feeling of pride.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a special hollow in their shell that is the right size and shape to hold Pokémon eggs. They practice for the responsibility of carrying an egg by picking stones from river beds and carrying them until they go a week without losing them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a special hollow in their shell that is the right size and shape to hold Pokémon eggs. They practice for the responsibility of carrying an egg by picking stones from river beds and carrying them until they go a week without losing them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a special hollow in their shell that is the right size and shape to hold Pokémon eggs. They practice for the responsibility of carrying an egg by picking stones from river beds and carrying them until they go a week without losing it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite their cumbersome size, POKENAME are delicate Pokémon that take great care to not damage anything when moving around. They love to watch over the nests of other Pokémon, protecting the eggs in the nests they guard.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite their cumbersome size, POKENAME are delicate Pokémon that take great care to not damage anything when moving around. They love to watch over the nests of other Pokémon, protecting the eggs in the nests they guard.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon is playful and mischievous, often using static electricity to zap unsuspecting Trainers. Its bulb stores energy, which it uses to power its pranks and playful antics.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's plump body swells with electricity and will discharge violently at the slightest touch. However, it is a cheery and energetic Pokémon and will playfully nuzzle its Trainer for affection.
author: mistymagius

entry: When full of energy, POKENAME starts to roll around recklessly without any care of accidentally blowing up. It often rolls over its own tail when doing this, causing it to release over 100,000 volts of electricity in the explosion from its pain.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME plunges its tail into the ground right when it is about to explode to dispel the excess energy causing it to. When it grounds all of its electricity, it becomes too weak to withstand any stimuli, leaving it easy to knock out.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME travels in groups so that they can eat the electricity that other POKENAME discharge. If separated from the pack, POKENAME become aggressive and will attack anyone who comes near them.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME produce a type of citrus that has an electrifying and bitter taste. It is a popular ingredient in sour candies.
author: dodoowner_

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME stands in the midst of the storm and raises its specially carved bone up to draw lightning to it. The strikes course through its body and supercharge its energy, making it hyperactive for several days.
author: sk372

entry: It electrifies the bone club it carries to enhance its effectiveness in battle. POKENAME can even tether it to itself via sustained lightning and control its midair trajectory to ensure it hits the target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its springy limbs to climb high trees, where it sits and waits for lightning to strike its tail. Some theorize it is trying to protect the forests.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME constantly rubs its tongue to build up a constant supply of electricity. Its paralysing licks are crippling in battle, with one lick sending weaker Pokémon sprawling to the floor.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's body contains volatile electrical energy, which intensifies when POKENAME becomes excited. When the electricity within its body becomes too intense to contain, it is expelled via its vents without any warning.
author: tuskaninny

entry: POKENAME buries its tail to ground its uncontrollable bursts of electricity as well as to use it as an anchor. If a Flying-type snatches POKENAME out of the ground, they are quickly zapped with intense energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME pierces foes with its horn before releasing a surge of electricity. When exhausted, it retreats to caves to recover its energy.
author: .izik

entry: While asleep, POKENAME discharges sparks from its horn. It must sleep cautiously, as it can ignite dry brush if it rests in open fields.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME draws lightning from thunderstorms to give its egg an energizing effect when eaten. Its eggs are very popular amongst sprinters and marathon runners.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. They have a mastery over positive and negative charges, so they can ensure there are no electric-related accidents between whomever it is caring for.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. A single whack from its tail is said to make an opponent's vision go topsy-turvy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. They have a mastery over positive and negative charges, so they can ensure there are no electric-related accidents between whomever it is caring for.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The barbs along POKENAME's body contain a paralytic poison used in anesthetics. Shoals of these Pokémon take over shallow reefs in the summer months, forcing beaches to close until they move on.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME use their sucker lips to attach to foes and prey to better deliver electric shocks into them. They can expel precise jets of water from their mouths and electric bolts from their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: Fully evolved POKENAME are incredibly quick and elusive. Usually they can only be spotted communally herding groups of Pifree that leave their forests during thunderstorms.
author: freakonomicon

entry: POKENAME fiercely defends its territory, gliding among the treetops to monitor intruders. It dives with ruthless precision, striking foes with twin blades crackling with electricity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are a famous sight during the summer season, hula dancing as they float and surf on their tails with psychic power. They are believed to have come from Alola, though researchers continue to speculate this Pokémon's origins.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME's body generates both intense heat and electrical energy. When angered, it releases blasts of searing lightning that can melt rock.
author: ambrosia04

entry: It slices through foes with its three tails as it runs. It uses its horns to fire off lightning bolts.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME use a latent static charge to keep their wing scales attached. They can disperse this charge at a moment's notice, releasing a shower of irritating scales at whatever is aggravating them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME use a latent static charge to keep their wing scales attached. They can disperse this charge at a moment's notice, releasing a shower of irritating scales at whatever is aggravating them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's shell is almost identical to the molecular makeup of Thunder Stones, which means many Electric-type Pokémon gather around POKENAME in an attempt to use its shell to evolve.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: When not transformed, POKENAME maintains a Raichu-like shape, seemingly viewing it as the ideal form for itself. Under close observation, one can see electricity arcing within its gelatinous body.
author: sk372
