entry: POKENAME was first discovered after a tourist developed a photo they took of a wild Mantine: a POKENAME became visible in the background, trying to cuddle with the Mantine.
author: argonborn

entry: POKENAME's ambulatory nature allows it to wade onto land for food, shoveling large amounts of sand into its mouth to eat the tiny creatures within.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Zipping through the water, POKENAME move in groups called squads. Sailors often regard these Pokémon as pests due to their tendency to race boats.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME is a common sight within water parks. Its swimming skills and friendly, gentle nature, particularly with children, make it an excellent lifeguard as well as mascot.
author: sk372

entry: It is extremely friendly and sociable, especially with seafaring humans. It seems unaware that its large size makes it a danger to its smaller playmates.
author: staghorn

entry: This mischievous Pokémon entertains itself by playfully firing bubbles at unsuspecting beach-goers out of its cannon-like arms.
author: regula

entry: POKENAME is known as one of the most beautiful Pokémon in the ocean. It uses its shimmering blue patterns to distract predators and foes while it plans an escape. POKENAME's scales are highly sought by certain coordinators.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME jumps from the sea and playfully extends its ribbon-like feelers in beautiful twirls to distract sailors on fishing vessels. This gives others from its pod time to surface and steal equipment for their nests.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME encounters a threatening Pokémon while moving along the ocean floor, it immediately tries to appear larger by spreading its fins. It mainly uses the hard horn on its forehead for self-defense.
author: fiordaliso

entry: On full moon nights, large numbers of POKENAME are known to swim in beautiful patterns along the surface of the ocean. Many Trainers looking to compete in Pokémon Contests will study these movements in order to replicate them with their Pokémon.
author: agentyoshi

entry: POKENAME can safely let Remoraid inside its body for their shelter and protection and eject them back out unharmed. In return, the Remoraid will help carry it around the ocean and scavenge food for it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME resides cocooned deep below the ocean waves, deep in sleep. It is said POKENAME will arise to the surface once every thousand years to grant a wish to the first sailor to cross its path.
author: maxissaa

entry: POKENAME are commonly found around underwater mangrove trees. They hang from the submerged roots while they await food to float by.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME's large body floats just inches above the sea's surface. It travels at sunrise, appearing like a drifting island.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME uses its melodic voice to control the ocean currents that flow between its antennae. It can use these currents to move much faster.
author: mrpeach774

entry: POKENAME playfully glide out of the waters of their rivers and coast on the air for a time . Curious by nature, they will approach others to play.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME lives in deep-sea trenches, using its sensitive antennae to sense its surroundings. However, it longs to grow wings and fly above the sea. Its hard shell makes it difficult for predators to hunt it.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: It spends its days drifting along wind and ocean currents. It clings to flagpoles and coral so that it doesn't fly into danger when it's asleep.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Many small fish Pokémon hide in the fronds of POKENAME. This creates a symbiotic relationship, where POKENAME provides safety in exchange for the fertilizer created by these other Pokémon.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's body is made almost entirely of seawater, so it can't stay out of the ocean for long or it risks drying out and falling ill. It enjoys blowing bubbles from its mouth to play with humans and Pokémon alike.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves to give out hugs to others, which leaves the hugged person stained with the slime it constantly emits. Though the slime is harmless, the smell of salt water lingers for some time even after cleaning it off.
author: sk372

entry: Child-like and extremely friendly, POKENAME is quick to run to new acquaintances to give them a hug. It leaves a sticky goop behind when it hugs someone, but the slime quickly dissolves in water.
author: sk372

entry: Schools of POKENAME spin in the air like helicopters over the sea. Together, they unleash toxins to devour massive prey like Wailord.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feed on detritus that has fallen to the sea floor, using their two large claws to sift through sand and mud to find edible particles. The twin red antennae growing from their back distract predators and pull attention away from their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME splashes playfully in the sea, inviting attention. Anyone who joins it is rewarded with a sharp, playful bite.
author: .izik

entry: When a POKENAME senses even a minor disturbance in the water flow, its body completely tenses up and hardens. Once this happens, the only way for it to loosen back up is if its Trainer or its group of Remoraid signal that it's safe again.
author: soup1900

entry: The thick coat covering POKENAME's body has the remarkable ability to absorb toxic pollutants from the seawater it swims through. Because it actively purifies the waters it inhabits, it is a creature deeply valued and protected by the Rangers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its long antennae can sense the arrival of sea storms ahead of time, so it always tries to alert humans who may be in danger. To defend itself from other Pokémon, it coats its body in bubbles so they can absorb part of incoming attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Some say the eye-like markings on POKENAME's lily pad will blink if stared at too long. Legends warn this will curse those who witness it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides beneath the sand of the seafloor and emerges only to feed on algae. Its blue antennae sense even the slightest shifts in the water; if a larger Pokémon draws near, it immediately retreats underground.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Extremely friendly, POKENAME is often sought for petting zoos because it is so social and enjoys splashing in the mud with children.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME glides sideways over the ocean waves, leaving a sparkling trail of heart-shaped bubbles in its wake. Many painters use this Pokémon as inspiration for their art.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides beneath the sand of the seafloor, exposing only its head when it needs to feed on algae. Its blue antennae can detect even the faintest movement in the water; if a Pokémon larger than itself approaches, it quickly buries itself again.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swims graceful circles around lakes, gliding across the surface with ease. It eats leaves that float on the lake's surface.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hops around sandy beaches, quickly burying itself underground if it senses danger. Those that try to look into the hole it leaves behind get sprayed with jets of water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME behaves with childish enthusiasm and playfulness, seemingly posessing boundless energy. It's recommended for Trainers to take it to pools often, so it can burn off some energy by swimming, its favorite activity.
author: sk372

entry: The flames POKENAME produces are contained in a bubble-like film that preserves their heat and intensity. This Pokémon's warm body and even warmer personality attracts all kinds of marine life.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although POKENAME's stingers contain large amounts of venom, it is so friendly that it will rarely harm humans. Some POKENAME will even try and come ashore to play with people, even though it quickly dries out on land.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME floats through the ocean in small families using their sticky tentacles to collect plankton before licking them clean. Adolescents enjoy playing games, often found chasing each other around.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME wanders beaches and harbors, seeking out people and Pokémon to play harmless pranks on. Its skin is covered with a stinging film, allowing it to scamper away giggling while its foe is left itching and numb.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME crawl along the ocean floor, where they clip and tear pieces of kelp with their claws into edible chunks. They are curious creatures that investigate divers when they are nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sharpens down bones to an extremely sharp point, fashioning a small dagger. It moves sneakily through cold areas, coming up from behind prey before delivering a fatal stabbing.
author: sk372

entry: Using its sensitivity to distress, POKENAME locates abandoned Pokémon young. It then steals eggs nearby to feed itself later.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slash furiously at trees to leave behind markings signifying their territory; however, they often cut so fast that they accidentally fell the tree. Woodcarvers utilize this Pokémon to help mass-produce intricate patterns on wooden trinkets.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are extremely vain, using shed quills to construct fans for the purpose of resembling human nobles. If someone insults their appearance, they will instead use the fan as a blade and slash repeatedly until they're complimented.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: They use their front claws to scale terrain but are reluctant to use them to defend themselves. Their vibrant, red hair exudes extra warmth which helps groups of them to survive colder environments when they're not hunting together.
author: infinex21

entry: If the claw on its tail fails to defeat an enemy, POKENAME summons a hailstorm to overwhelm them with sheer cold.
author: .izik

entry: Normally, POKENAME makes its nests in cold mountainous regions. Trainers beware: when one is present, two to four more are nearby waiting to swarm.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It hides within fresh water lakes or ponds. When prey is within reach, it attacks viciously with its powerful claws.
author: tank3007

entry: POKENAME gather in small groups to hunt large prey with coordinated diving attacks that wear down even hardy foes like Mamoswine and Ursaring. The one who contributed the most to the hunt gets the most blood, which brightens its feathers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its size and appearance to its advantage, making itself appear demure and nonthreatening. When the target's guard is down, it strikes with calculated cuts from it deceptively sharp claws.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME covets golden coins to the point of occasionally leaving its regular frigid territory to hunt for wild Meowth. Its beak and claws aren't the only danger to humans, as it often attacks with its razor sharp wing feathers.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME has a friendly personality and is quite nimble and intelligent, able to learn tricks quickly. This has led to it being used regularly in entertainment venues such as circuses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are especially active on nights with a blood-red moon. They float on gusts of wind and harass many small bird Pokémon with their sharp frills and claws.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME is a rare sight in the wild, living in inhospitable areas of extreme cold or dangerously territorial Pokémon. It cleverly digs a network of tunnels, which it then can quickly navigate when it senses prey causing vibrations.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME steal items from Trainers and hold them for ransom until they are given a treat. Trainers are advised to keep their belongings secured to avoid theft.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always fly in swarms with their claws out to scare even the largest foes away from their territory. In some regions, they are known to have extirpated prey in their areas by fully crushing boulders and other hiding spots that prey may use.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a solitary hunter inhabiting colder regions. It lures parent Pokémon away from their nests before using the distraction to quickly snatch and eat the unguarded eggs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves scratches on trees with delicious berries. Any Pokémon who steals POKENAME's berries will be surrounded by their pack and consumed.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's population is recovering as it is a protected species after decades of being poached for its gem, tusks, feathers, and fur. It is mischievous, sneaking up on members of its herd and bellowing to startle them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME slashes Apricorns from trees with its claws. It stores the fruit in its tail and delivers them to allies or strangers it favors.
author: .izik

entry: A sly and manipulative Pokémon, POKENAME saves smaller creatures from harm before demanding offerings for its good deed. It makes a show of displaying its many sharp edges to discourage them from refusing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME with the longest and biggest tusks lead their hunting parties. They bring down prey by rolling and slamming into them.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The leader of a pack of Snearogues, POKENAME is never seen without its gang. It barks orders all day, and initiates fights with rival gangs.
author: jackythewannabe

entry: POKENAME territory is recognizable due to its feathers poking from its burrowed body. This is the last stage it works with a pack, using pressurized gas to hunt, as it lives only with a mate after evolving.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are both incredibly mischievous and incredibly social, forming tight-knit packs. Each of its limbs can be deadly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are both incredibly mischievous and incredibly social, forming tight-knit packs. Each of its limbs can be deadly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can only discharge excess electricity through its claws. Because of this, POKENAME gets progressively more vicious the longer it hunts.
author: mimigaagua

entry: It exudes frigid air from the pale blue crystals along its body, which it can control to create sheets of ice on the ground for it to "skate" along. It delivers swift and merciless slashes that leave ice in its wake as it "skates" around its foe.
author: infinex21

entry: They live in volcanic regions, banding together in small groups to hunt prey. When separated, they leave messages for each other using charcoal they create.
author: .jerden

entry: Although sustenance for POKENAME is primarily gathered via photosynthesis, it has hunting urges that need to be regularly sated. Small groups gather to hunt prey together, though once the hunt is finished, few bother to actually eat it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sharpens its claws on frozen lake surfaces. If it accidentally cracks the ice, it uses a breath of cold to freeze it over again.
author: .izik

entry: For an unknown reason, POKENAME will carve lines of code into trees using their claws. They will carve this code into any computers they find, though this usually just ends in the computer's destruction.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME hides in swamp mud, patiently waiting to ambush its prey. Using its overwhelming strength, it drags foes into the mire, finishing them off with crushing bites and powerful strikes from its fins.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME gather on coasts worn away by erosion, pushing dirt, mud, and rocks into the water to repair the damage. However, their efforts often extend the coastline past its original boundaries, creating land where before there had been only ocean.
author: sirg44

entry: Since POKENAME can sense the emotions of others, it easily identifies the ideal victim to steal from. Its sharp claws are capable of cutting through solid rock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is said POKENAME hosts tea parties in forest clearings and any Trainer that speaks their name is bound to it. When battling, it pulls the Scizor scythe from thin air, pirouetting gracefully through savage slashes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME spend countless hours maintaining their pristine appearance. Though they can unleash icy blizzards in battle, they quickly lose their composure whenever they get dirty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Groups of POKENAME gather in the woods to dance and improve their future sight. Afterwards the Pokémon scatter, hunting lone prey and taking them down with vicious Bites.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Sly combatants inhabiting frigid regions, POKENAME band together and form small bandit groups raiding unsuspecting travelers. This tactical coordination ends once it is time to divide up the spoils.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can extend a long singular claw from each of its elbows, no less sharp than the ones on its hands. To keep these blades sharp, it practices by slicing and carving away at large ice chunks for training.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives at high altitudes, usually on snowcapped peaks. It will float ominously near any solitary climbers, aiming to send them tumbling down the mountainside for no obvious reason.
author: fireblade141

entry: The gem on POKENAME's head emits a strong magnetic field, letting it navigate dark areas without effort. This is primarily useful in dense blizzards.
author: .izik

entry: This cunning Pokémon lives in mountainous areas, where it uses its intellect to predict storms so it can hunt Pokémon that are huddled down for shelter. Despite its size, its claw strikes are deceptively fast.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME lives in the icy mountains, scaling the treacherous terrain with ease while hunting its prey. While usually a solitary hunter, it will team up with other POKENAME to take down larger threats.
author: mistymagius

entry: Once a year, POKENAME scale the sides of cliffs to climb as high as they can with their hefty claws. Once in position, POKENAME release pollen into the wind to pollinate each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's thick skulls are made of a sturdy amber, letting them charge through most attacks with ease. They use their heads to fell large trees, marking their territory.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME only targets foes at night. While this mischievous Pokémon possesses sharp fighting instincts, it tends to only go for weaker enemies.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME stuns foes with a chilling Icy Wind before slicing them down with the blades protruding from its torso. It tends to stalk already weakened prey.
author: .izik

entry: In the darkness of the night, the only sign POKENAME are around is the bass thrum of their wings. They are known to play with their prey, buzzing above their heads unseen, before blotting out the moon on their final dive.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are quite brutal. They prefer to bask in the sun and let their Weavbas entourage fight, but they will still use their sharp, clawed fins to shred in defiance.
author: scrapsorra

entry: A sly and manipulative Pokémon, POKENAME approaches others with a falsely innocent appearance. Presenting its feelers as a peace offering, it waits until close before cutting its target down with the edges, which are as sharp as claws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fighting style is a combination of kicking and scratching the opponent with its stretchy arms. The POKENAME with the biggest cap is the leader.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME is an aggressive, devious creature that leaps out from digital screens to slash at others with its large electric claws. Even being grazed by them leaves a victim with a painful wound that turns frostbitten in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dwell in the coldest of regions, forming up to packs of five. POKENAME typically work in groups, hunting during storms; they patiently wait in the snow for days for unsuspecting prey. They then leap out and rip their prey to shreds.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME works exceptionally in a trained group, fighting with coordinated tactics and caring for injured members. Due to its stealth and power, some hypothesize that it is a remnant of an ancient civilization's army, but this has not been proven.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's heads are adept strategists, with one specializing in aggressive tactics and the other in defensive ones. The two rarely agree, making cooperation between multiples of the species nearly impossible.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are mischievous Pokémon, often pickpocketing unsuspecting people or stealing berries from other Pokémon. It is believed that they are the closest living relatives to Sneasler.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME uses bait and switch tactics, as a group deciding to stalk a single person. They will then pose as the same Pokémon, appearing wherever that Trainer goes, highlighting themselves in cold flames. If discovered, they place a hex on the person.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is careful when battling others of its kind for territory or leadership because the pink rock sections of its body can become brittle. If those sections chip, they do not grow back symmetrically, so POKENAME will lose standing in its pack.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It curiously flits around with an innocent look. When it spots potential prey, it buzzes a hunting signal, and other POKENAME in its group suddenly pounce from hiding.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME encases itself in thick ice as it sleeps. The longer the slumber, the tougher its frozen shell becomes.
author: .izik

entry: Groups of POKENAME fly above the snowy tundra in search of large prey like Mamoswine from which to suck blood. After consuming blood, their feathered crest glows brighter, and the POKENAME with the brightest glow leads the next hunt.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's tusks coat themselves in ice during combat. Each strike carries enough force to leave deep dents in solid steel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives high in the mountains, using its sharp claws to cling onto the cliff face. It is vicious hunter, pursuing them at high speeds before slashing them to pieces.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are masters of skulduggery and are hired by evil organizations to commit anything from espionage to stealing sealed documents. They are thrill seekers and commit crimes because of the excitement they get.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sways outside its snowy cave at dusk. It freezes those who come too close, dragging them inside to display as frozen trophies.
author: .izik

entry: Because its eyesight is poor, POKENAME uses its feathered crest and goo whiskers to detect anomalies in its environment. Its gooey body can dissolve most materials, so it is utilized to break into vaults and other high-security areas.
author: pjporwoll

entry: In Ecruteak City, POKENAME may sometimes be spotted dancing along with Kimono Girls. POKENAME can create ice crystals from their fans, which are used either as a spectacle in performances or a deadly attack against foes.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Using a hunting style that looks like innocent dancing, packs of POKENAME can effortlessly hunt down any prey. Ominous sounds linger in the area where POKENAME have sung, allowing them to leave messages for others.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME scales frozen cliffs with ease, its claws gripping ice effortlessly. The heat-retaining scales on its arms help it endure the cold.
author: .izik

entry: Where one POKENAME prowls, an entire gang is hidden. They are adept at pickpocketing and taking berries from Wild Pokémon. However, they are not truly heartless. They ignite their staves at night to guide lost children back home.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Groups of POKENAME claim mountainous lakeside shores as their territory. They soften their footsteps to a whisper by collecting water into their paws, allowing them to sneak up on any would-be intruders.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense of community, and it becomes despondent and reckless if cast out of its pack. Trainers must take care when integrating it with a team as it takes time warming up to new allies.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Tunneling silently through the snow, POKENAME moves astoundingly fast. Small Pokémon beneath the snow are devoured rapidly, and surface-dwellers are ambushed and slashed by POKENAME's sharp claws.
author: hophoppip

entry: Afraid of the Rattata infestation in big cities, many officials released POKENAME as a predator. Unfortunately, these Pokémon are drawn to anything shiny, thus have infested back alleyways in gangs that steal from Trainers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Sly, defensive combatants, POKENAME never make the first move in battle. Their entire combat style revolves around weaving away from every strike, and countering with perfectly-placed claw swipes aimed at weak points.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feign cautiousness during battles to let their opponents underestimate them. In reality, they're patiently waiting for the moment their foe hesitates to rush behind them and finish the battle with one swift strike.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's superior swimming capabilities allow it to catch almost any other Pokémon in the water. Once it has completely cleared a lake of prey, POKENAME will claw a sign into a nearby boulder to let others of its kind know that the lake is empty.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Using trap-filled chambers built below ground, these Pokémon train their bodies in a hostile, controlled environment. Colloquially referred to as the 'Danger Room,' POKENAME super-fans try to replicate this training technique with varying results.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME always sleeps through the night, able to effectively hide from Psychic types. Once the sun rises, it immediately awakens, teleporting to lands where it is still night.
author: ghostslythe

entry: They say POKENAME can detect one's fighting spirit, making it a nearly unstoppable force in battle. However, it is not a cruel Pokémon. It is incredibly gentle and has a profound sense of loyalty towards Trainers who have earned its respect.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME hunt in small groups, usually using tactics that involve flinging one another to quickly gain on potential prey. Raking one's claws through their frills is considered a friendship gesture between POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the perfect Pokémon to run away from a large group of Trainers, such as cops or grunts. They can detect every single one of them in a large radius to trace the best escape route. The presence of Fairy-types seems to blur their senses.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME has a wily and slightly sadistic personality, especially once it enters battle. It enjoys getting its opponents to tire themselves out striking its sturdy shell, before making them run and try to avoid multiple water shots from its cannons.
author: sk372

entry: An extremely toxic gas is constantly building up within POKENAME's body. It expels this gas alongside its attacks to relieve pressure and poison foes.
author: chibitales

entry: Often seen in factories with illegal working conditions, POKENAME's magnetic field is used to trap toxic gas wastes from these factories, then filter it with its internal filtering system. The clear, dewy air it creates is often turned into cologne.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's mouth exposes its inner core, a very sensitive area. If messed with, it could possibly explode with a yield of 10,000 gigatons. As such, very few evolve their Magnezing further to this form.
author: silvertotodile

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in abandoned power plants or landfills. They use their abilities to magnetize garbage, pulling it in before eating it. POKENAME often get into battles with Garbtrum that are in search of food.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Although they look more like a mech than a Pokémon, POKENAME and their desire to protect their Magnemite pilot are both entirely organic. If the two are ever separated, the body's antenna can detect their other half from entire regions away.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Using electricity manipulated via its antennae, it can control magnets in battle.  A pair of drone-like entities follow it at all times, aiding in battle as well as scouting for good feeding spots.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tend to dwell near power plants so they may prey upon other Pokémon drawn to power plants as well. When they have absorbed too much electricity, they will fly into a long rage that generates an expansive magnetic field.
author: infinex21

entry: The more metal POKENAME absorbs into its body, the more powerful the magnetic field it produces becomes. While the field will slowly weaken over time, Trainers should try to restrict POKENAME's metallic diet.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's massive eye doesn't actually have great vision. However, it uses electromagnetic waves like echolocation, so it gets by just fine.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's metallic frame can store data equivalent to an entire server room. Many companies rely on it as a living backup system.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME unfurls wings made of pure electricity to enhance its flight and magnetic capabilities. It has a habit of nesting on the tallest radio towers, which makes it a nuisance due to the strong interference this creates.
author: sk372

entry: Metallic objects are scarce in areas where POKENAME is known to roam since they all get magnetized when it flies by. If a strong opposing magnetic field is directed at it, its wings will lose their stability, causing it to struggle to fly.
author: soup1900

entry: It appears during storms to catch lightning and store the energy within itself. It generates a strong magnetic field that causes most electronics and compasses to fail within a certain range of it.
author: infinex21

entry: They have developed better control over their magnetism, to the point they can concentrate it upon specific targets. They often use their powers to help save and protect others, including saving sinking ships.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME exude a special magnetic field that keeps them afloat and propels them forward at high speeds. Their golden stingers contain a potent toxin that numbs the body in a few minutes, if the body is still in-tact after being impaled.
author: infinex21

entry: According to some rumors, POKENAME has the mission of protecting the planet from extraterrestrial threats and is even capable of flying in space. From its metal gun, it can shoot powerful psychokinetic waves that can easily levitate entire buildings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its uses magnetism and psychic power to dominate battles. Its tail is incredibly thick and dense, which allows it to deliver bone-shattering strikes as well.
author: infinex21

entry: The three sub-units are extensions of itself that allow it to think quicker and to simultaneously track three extra targets. It generates a magnetic field that disrupts most devices when it is near, so tracking it has proven difficult.
author: infinex21

entry: Utilizing magnetic energy, POKENAME can release powerful electrified plasma. They prefer high places, where the sunlight is strongest.
author: zespud

entry: POKENAME uses the peaks of its flame's intensity to warp the fields of magnetism, turning every metallic object into a small explosive. Its heat shimmers release high volumes of radio waves that allow it to hide from radar and other tracking systems.
author: soup1900

entry: It stays aloft and moves at high speeds using the magnetism it generates and controls. Its fangs can penetrate most known metals. It feeds either on electricity drained from machines or on the energy of Steel-type Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are small and sensitive to electrical signals. Mechanics and engineers will employ teams of them to scour engines during and after repairs, seeking electrical faults.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME soar high above power plants, using the antennae on their heads to scan the ground below. Once their prey is located, they swoop from the skies, snagging smaller Steel-type Pokémon with their magnets.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses a mixture of magnetism, electricity and extendable claws to disorient and capture targets. Once seized, it simply observes them closely before releasing them; its motivations for doing so are still unknown.
author: sk372

entry: It emits croaking, buzzing calls that vary widely in tone and frequency. Carrying far across the water bodies POKENAME lives by, the calls contain a wealth of information that other POKENAME decode, allowing them to coordinate against threats.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It builds a constant static electricity that attracts pollen when it floats through the air. POKENAME's eye has glass eyelids so it can protect itself from irritation.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When the moon sits directly overhead, POKENAME's gills glow and tilt upward for a few minutes. In the past, harbour masters kept them nearby to predict high tide and ensure ships remained safely moored.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It is able to reconstruct metal objects and structures using the eye on its head. POKENAME has a commendable interest in supporting disaster relief efforts, using their psychic and magnetic abilities to detect people hidden by rubble.
author: silverscloudy

entry: Though not their primary food source, POKENAME love snacking on batteries and power cells. However, POKENAME's body cannot digest lithium and many trainers are caught off guard when they spit it back up.
author: turron_turron

entry: The body is only used to eat and drink, and the brain and all of the other functionality is within the shell atop this Pokémon's head. POKENAME has intense electromagnetic powers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Radios become unusable when POKENAME draws near. The electromagnetic waves it sends out cannot be defined on the spectrum as we know it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have been seen clumping together to amplify their strength. Researchers believe these clumps to be the origin of modern sentence structures.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME hangs from the trees found within urban areas, looking for prey. The risk of it exploding has led to POKENAME removal being a priority.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME uses magnetism to propel its quills from its body. These quills are barbed, made of pure metal, and contain a powerful acid.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Not only are its magnet-hands strong enough to be used like hammers, but they allow it to project and control a magnetic force. They will use this magnetism to either repel foes or to drag them in and deliver a steel-hard punch.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are notorious thieves around cities and factories. They can activate their magnets at will, grabbing tools or pieces of metal from long range to try and create their own mechanisms. They escape by repelling themselves off of machinery.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: By harnessing its own magnetic field, POKENAME can fire rocks, nuts, and other things from its mouth like a railgun. The heads fused to the sides of its main head help it to stay aware of things around it during battle.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon lures Skarmory by mimicking their shape. It channels magnetic waves through their metal bodies to fly.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: Its venom has magnetic properties, making it particularly effective against Steel-type Pokémon and Electric-type Pokémon. The patterns on its chest shine as it releases electricity from its large antenna.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gets overwhelmed when it catches too many radio signals and overheats in a giant burst of flames as a result. It creates artificial volcanoes by using its strong magnetism to rip molten iron from deep within the magma layer to the surface.
author: soup1900

entry: A powerful supercomputer built by an ancient civilization long ago. Some say it has the power to grant wishes, as well as bend space and time at will.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: A powerful supercomputer built by an ancient civilization long ago. Some say it has the power to grant wishes, as well as bend space and time at will.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: The light atop POKENAME starts to flash when a lot of electricity has built up. This is a warning to those nearby to vacate the area, as when it overloads it unleashes a devastating Discharge, paralysing everything in the blast.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME work together to surround Steel type Pokémon, then they each use their magnetism on their prey. Since their magnetic power is equal, the prey remains in place, allowing the pack to close in and finish it off.
author: darkweavile428

entry: After years of failure trying to improve Magnezone, a scientist had the idea to simply fuse two Magnezone together. The resulting Pokémon has the strange ability to mobilize a swarm of Magnemite and Magneton to its own ends, which remain unknown.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The magnets on POKENAME start to flicker with static when a lot of electricity has built up. This is a warning to those nearby to vacate the area, as when it overloads it unleashes a devastating Discharge, paralysing everything in the blast.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The quicker its wings flutter, the stronger its magnetic field becomes. It uses its magnet-like tail to hang from metal structures, although it often causes interference with its mere presence.
author: infinex21

entry: Both its claws and its many spines can generate powerful electromagnetic fields that help it defend itself from hostile Pokémon. When POKENAME curls up, it is preparing to unleash a devastating Gyro Ball.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME typically hold a stoic demeanor, but is rather affectionate with its Trainer. It also has the ability to manipulate electromagnetic waves, changing the signal to a message of love for its Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prey on other Steel-type Pokémon, as they can wield magnetic forces to keep their prey from fleeing. They attack with their sharp, blade-like forelimbs and with precise electrical bolts fired from their magnet-like claws.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's shoulders contain not just additional eyes to watch enemies carefully but also extra brains that help it to think quicker. Its fingers are each powerful magnets that could disrupt complex machines.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's electromagnets are strong enough to destroy skyscrapers. Trainers should be careful not to carry any electronic devices near a POKENAME.
author: kingd8

entry: A POKENAME's giant horn functions as a massive magnet that ensures Steel-type Pokémon rarely ever escape from it. It can swing its horn to crush rocks and metal to better eat them if it finds no Steel-type Pokémon to prey upon.
author: infinex21

entry: In battle, POKENAME can devastate foes with powerful strikes and searing beams of energy. However, its energy consumption is so vast that it needs to recharge after every action.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME channels electric signals and disperses them through the magnets on its body. This disrupts electronic devices, causing them to malfunction. Once a POKENAME moves into an area, the electric Pokémon there begin to behave erratically.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Using their magnetic appendages, POKENAME are capable of pulling themselves toward metallic objects with surprising speed. An unlucky Steel-Type Pokémon may find itself being pulled toward the POKENAME.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME uses the magnets in its body as a compass, helping it steer in different directions. It charges these magnets to help pull it as it swims, allowing it to glide effortlessly against the tides.
author: epping_forest

entry: Once considered as an alternative to power plants, a POKENAME can generate power for an entire city with the perpetual motion of its gears. However, as city planners learned, the immense magnetic field it generates disrupts most electronics.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Magnetic waves from POKENAME's ribbons disrupt and alter electronics near it. It uses this to make them play visuals and noises meant to soothe those who are near them.
author: sk372

entry: It enjoys wrapping its wire-like feelers around its owner's arms. However, this usually ends up electrocuting the Trainer.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: POKENAME's body emits an incredibly strong magnetic field. Legends say this field is strong enough to warp space itself.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is believed POKENAME inhabits a world with vastly distorted physics from our own. Its very presence near machinery causes magnetic interference that can tear the machines apart in a short amount of time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's magnetic powers are strong enough to move and separate large chunks of the land. It reshapes abandoned factory districts into homes that can house its Magnemite friends.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME controls a magnetic field and the powers of bitter frost. It uses its magnetic field to precisely control formations of ice, turning them into precise weapons that dominate against any foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME track the weather patterns of the world alongside meteorologists. They are made of stainless steel that will endure tropical storms. Senior weather reporters adopt a POKENAME whenever they retire, commemorating their work together.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of getting their cannons to a high enough heat to melt through most metals. They're usually mistaken for aliens in rural areas.
author: bigoljax

entry: The magnetic frequencies POKENAME emits mess with electronics and cause them to be under this Pokémon's control. Waving its magnets around, it makes machines look possessed and have sentience.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their magnet-like claws to siphon electricity from other Pokémon or from human machinery. Their tusks act as magnets that serve them well in conquering the Steel-type Pokémon they oft prey upon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME protect various power plants across the world. They are engineered to be cunning, brilliant, and loyal.
author: imagine1.

entry: Its malleable arms can split apart and collect rocks or other hard objects, which it will later shoot using magnetic force. POKENAME psychic powers are so strong that it can manifest sturdy barriers from pure energy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME communicate over radio waves just outside the frequencies that people utilize. Radio hobbyists often adopt them as a mascot. This is despite the fact that accidentally tuning into their frequency will put the listener to sleep.
author: vic1312

entry: The friction between POKENAME conducts static electricity, holding their two bodies together. Depending on how fast the POKENAME is spinning, it can even generate its own electromagnetic field.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME frequently levitates too high in the sky while sleeping, accidentally getting stuck to aircraft with its magnets. This sometimes ends in terrible accidents.
author: .izik

entry: Herds of POKENAME are commonly spotted near factories or garbage dumps, consuming any scrap metal they find. Its main flower acts as a means of communication, sending signals to other POKENAME.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME steals metal items from people, seeking quality items to enhance its mechanical body. It has no intention of returning anything it takes.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME's very existence is a threat to power grids. If one ends up in the wrong place, it could shut down an entire region in an instant.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: When in battle, POKENAME produces large amounts of poison by absorbing magnetic energy. This magnetic pull often draws Onix from deep underground, confusing them greatly when they emerge above ground.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When stressed, POKENAME produces large amounts of poison by absorbing magnetic energy. This magnetic pull often draws Onix from deep underground, confusing them greatly when they emerge above ground.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is covered in frozen minerals that became solid steel after it was exposed to a special magnetic field. Now, it wields a similar magnetic field of its own that uses to create mixtures of steel and ice to defend itself with.
author: infinex21

entry: There are many stories of POKENAME wandering the roads of mountain settlements during unexplained blackouts. Several items are usually reported stolen afterwards, with people sometimes reported missing as well.
author: novembermagnus

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of various pieces of scrap metal held together by a strong magnetic field. It will use this field to imbue the metal with an electric charge that will produce a nasty shock on contact.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are comprised of a metal far more durable than any materials occurring in nature. They move by manipulating magnetic fields around them, often causing electromagnetic distortions in their vicinity.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can steal electricity from powerlines, causing mass blackouts. They can charge their fists and slam them on the ground, causing shockwaves.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME was created to appeal to children, but it doesn't know the strength of its own hugs. For some reason, its insides are filled with steel wool.
author: robosoup

entry: The tentacles of this Pokémon are made of an extremely durable metal and are protected by a constant stream of electricity emitted from its antenna. There are incidents of this Pokémon accidentally electrocuting and hospitalizing their Trainers.
author: voiddx01

entry: The Paras in POKENAME controls its movements, directing it with precision. It is protected by indestructible alien material.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It relies on a Stretchy Spring to make quick exits out of a battle. If it is locked into battle, it could mean that a part of the spring mechanism is jammed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME generates a self-sustaining electromagnetic field that enables atmospheric flight. Its metallic composition contains trace elements not native to this planet.
author: ven0os

entry: POKENAME floats around in space, emitting strange electromagnetic signals from its body. Scientists believe POKENAME could be used as a natural satellite.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is only found near exceedingly powerful magnetic fields. At full power, its excavating sonic blasts are strong enough to shatter diamond, but it rarely uses that strength, preferring to consume such a durable substance instead.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME searches for highly magnetic mineral deposits, then blasts tunnels with Sonic Boom to uncover its subterranean meal. Quarries use its skills to efficiently bore to their goal.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The antenna on its head attunes POKENAME to both magnetic and psychic fields. It can channel both of these to make itself smarter by firing more neurons.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME make for popular patrols at power plants, as they can flash their siren-like eyes to disorient trespassers at night. They use their magnetic arms to sense metal deposits from over a mile away to reinforce their bodies.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's antenna lets it detect minute magnetic fluctuations in the air related to weather phenomena. It changes form in advance in anticipation of the incoming weather changes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME always operates in compliance with the will of its Trainer, even if it hurts itself or other people. Some dangerous organizations exploit this blind loyalty to cause crime.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pummels its opponents with its large extendable magnet-fists. Its antenna emits subtle radio waves that mess with a foe's concentration, making it harder for them to evade its strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's monstrous appearance makes it a popular antagonist in numerous comic book series. Its mechanical arms are extremely durable.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME keeps a ratchet tucked into its belt at all times, using it to fine-tune broken-down engines with uncanny skill. Many mechanics trust it more than their own apprentices.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Many UFO sightings are actually POKENAME flying in the night sky. They use the ends of their tentacles as lights to guide their path.
author: bigoljax

entry: The rocky shell around the center of POKENAME is formed of ore, held there by an electromagnetic field. The ore can be shot as a projectile in combat.
author: therider

entry: If an excess of Magnemite gather while trying to form Magneton, they may accidentally collapse into one body. With all of their brains combined into one, POKENAME is far more efficient and focused than it was previously.
author: .fedoraman

entry: In the rare event of several Magnemite conjoining and evolving at once, this Pokémon can evolve. Its true eyes orbit around it, scanning the environment for information.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME is made of three heads, two of which are ancillary to the main body. Having detached heads allows it to quickly repair parts of itself without exposing delicate electronics.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shoots its magnetic slime at opponents. The slime is nearly impossible to get off, and leaves them unable to get away from POKENAME.
author: chorb33

entry: It blasts enemies with jets of water before zapping them with electricity, the two elements working in tandem. Random metal objects are often stuck to its shell thanks to its magnetic pull.
author: ilazerheart

entry: It stores excess energy within its shell during periods of inactivity, emitting a faint glow. It will defensively hide in its shell when threatened.
author: lynkinator

entry: POKENAME uses magnetism to hold a hypnotic metal orb resembling Magnemite. The orb radiates a special magnetic wave that is extremely effective at hypnotizing Steel-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are found among beaches and shores, searching for anything metallic. Most POKENAME tend to accidentally wander into large cities because of the abundance of factories, causing a ruckus everytime they do so.
author: imagine1.

entry: It is slightly more mobile due to its reduced weight and size. Its saliva now contains a paralyzing effect, shocking anything that touches its tongue.
author: cascadeguy

entry: When fully unfurled, POKENAME's tongue is long enough to wrap around a minivan multiple times. It uses this to capture multiple prey at once, reeling them in with impressive dexterity.
author: .izik

entry: To show affection, POKENAME runs towards its Trainer at worrying speeds, bracing the landing by curling them up in its long tongue. It even does this to other Pokémon, which are not always aware of this behaviour and try to fight back.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its vines to pull down Occa Berries from trees. Dropped fruit is quickly scooped up by its ever-waiting tongue.
author: .izik

entry: Its many tongues act as extra limbs, leaving it constantly thirsty and desensitized to taste. It will greedily lap up entire lakes to stay hydrated.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Its tongue is large and stretchy and its saliva is very thick and sticky. It often uses its tongue to gather foods in a large clump and pull them into its mouth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a long tongue that it keeps coiled inside its body, though a part of it remains sticking out even when coiled. This tongue can reach a meter in length, perfect for sticking into burrows to pull out Bug-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It flies quickly through caves and licks the ground with its long tongue to pick up as much food as possible. It spits out stones and similar items.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME lick their Trainers all the time. Instead of it being cute, like with Lillipup, it just seems creepy.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME uses its long tongue to pluck Nanab Berries from high branches, favoring their sweet flavor. Consuming them causes its wool to take on a soft pink hue, which intensifies as it eats more.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have sensitive tongues that cannot stand the taste of aged foods, so many refuse to eat common non-perishable goods like dried fruit, jerky, or cheese. Sending them to hunt for their own food is the only certain way to ensure they eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME channels electricity through its saliva, creating tiny sparks that crackle along its tongue. It uses this ability to shock fruit from trees before eagerly lapping them up.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME wraps its tongue around pine branches to anchor itself. This prevents it from being blown away by strong winds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sticky tongue to anchor itself to birch trees during strong windstorms. It enjoys swaying in the breeze, inhaling airborne spores as a snack.
author: .izik

entry: Once POKENAME has tasted a flavor, it is able to excrete a gel that tastes exactly the same and is safe to eat. Some novelty confectionery is made in conjunction with POKENAME, focusing on unpleasant flavors.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME floats face-down on lakes, using its long tongue to snatch unsuspecting prey like Goldeen from beneath the water's surface.
author: .izik

entry: Many Trainers have noted how difficult it is to read an approaching POKENAME's intentions thanks to its calm movements. Sometimes, it merely wants food and will politely wait. Other times, it uses its sticky tongue to pull at the Trainer's hair.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has an exceptional sense of taste, navigating the oceans by sensing the differences in water chemistry that tell it if there's food or a predator around. Their saliva has a toxic element, letting them defend themselves with their tongues.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have quite the sweet tooth, usually seen raiding candy stores. They're easily disposed of, just by lifting them up by the cones on their backs.
author: bigoljax

entry: Given enough time, its saliva can dissolve almost any material. Trainers with a POKENAME must keep an eye out for it furtively licking their electronic devices, hoping to get at the tasty data inside.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: The slick saliva coating POKENAME's tongue allows it to slither in a serpentine-like fashion. This saliva is highly toxic, paralyzing prey before it coils around them for an easy meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have sensitive tongues that allow them to detect traces of allergens in a dish. POKENAME can also be trained to administer epinephrine in the event of a medical emergency.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tongue wraps all around its body and holds onto a large sweet brimming with magic. One must never accept if offered a taste, for the object is cursed and will pass a hex onto those foolish enough to lick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME that have licked their magical treat clean are particularly dangerous, as their tongue has now absorbed all the magic. Their tongue now casts all the spells, the candy now reduced to a potent bludgeoning tool.
author: sk372

entry: Their tongue have been recorded to be as long as the tail of an Arbok. POKENAME have also been recorded rolling down hills for fun.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: This fusion's appearance is influenced by the two Lickilicky's strong desires for sweet foods. It is often found raiding confectionary shops.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME uses its thick vines to shake Oran Berry trees while it waits below. If no berries fall out, it angrily slaps the trunk with its long tongue.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its saliva to immobilize its prey before slurping their blood with its front tongue. Its wings are actually the tongues that are on its back.
author: soup1900

entry: Culinarians once revered POKENAME as a patron deity of food. Legends claim preparing a favored dish could bring lasting fortune to one's family.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has one of the most distinguished taste of all beings. If a Trainer creates a dish which pleases its tongue, they will be blessed in having every dish taste spectacular.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Its tongue blade deals damage not through cutting, but the corrosive saliva it produces. It also wraps around opponents and numbs their skin.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is an agile creature that dwells in the trees of vast forests. Its huge prehensile tongue is not only used to swing from branch to branch, but also to deliver powerful blows to its enemies. It can electrify its saliva to paralyze its foes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The white "ribbons" around its neck are actually a special material that exudes a calming and intoxicating aroma. Even this Pokémon is often tempted to chew on this material and will offer pieces of it to others as a token of friendship.
author: infinex21

entry: It bounces on its powerful tongue which can coil up like a spring. It's said a POKENAME ascends to a higher form when it can launch itself into orbit.
author: genesisparallax

entry: Should any of POKENAME's tongues begin to glow, space will distort and warp in the surrounding area. The severity of this distortion depends on the intensity of the glow.
author: .izik

entry: After having tasted absolutely everything in its own plane of existence, POKENAME traveled to our reality in search of new flavors to experience.
author: empty_set

entry: Despite POKENAME's bright colors and simplistic face, the teeth-based nightmares it causes are haunting. The secondary mouth houses an endless void.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is quite a bit of a troublemaker, and will make a mockery out of anyone making even the slightest mistake. Because its tongue constantly generates new cells to extend, it is theorized to be able to wrap around the world multiple times.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME licks cave walls to leave behind a charged, conductive saliva that spreads electrical pulses. If it senses movement nearby, it electrifies the webbing it has laid out between the saliva to act as an alarm system.
author: .izik

entry: When two POKENAME fight, they use their immensely long tongues as whips, moving the tips at supersonic speeds. Their formidable-looking tusks are used to cut down trees rather than for fighting, letting them access food high in the branches.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's wings are very sensitive to every aspect of their surroundings The powder it spreads causes severe itching and rashes.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite their unpleasant appearance, POKENAME are known to be the partners of food connoisseurs due to their very sensitive sense of taste.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its horns are very tough and rubbery. Many companies use POKENAME's armor for products like bouncy balls, slingshots, and erasers.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's oily saliva allows its own gears to move with incredible efficiency. By licking machinery, it prevents rust buildup, making it surprisingly useful in mechanical repairs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tastes the jelly around it to help it think. The flavor changes depending on its mood.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's tongue is too large to fit in its body. It buries itself in dirt to keep it from drying out.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig into Bug-type Pokémon colonies, feeding on the honey within with its long sticky tongue. It usually can't stay long at any colony as its hide is soft, leaving it vulnerable to retaliation from the angry bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful tusks to fight with rivals, its long tongue used to try and grapple the tusks of its opponents and prevent a counter-attack. Fights between the Pokémon are often messy as a result.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is an absolute glutton that eats anything that even comes close. Rumor has it that it is even responsible for the disappearance of hikers.
author: chorb33

entry: Since POKENAME's introduction to the wild, it has become a common pest. It will often grab travellers' legs with its tongue, making them fall over.
author: forbiddenbread

entry: Although they lack jaw strength, POKENAME's lethality is not to be underestimated. They can wrap their tongue around an oil tanker and effortlessly crush it into a ball of scrap metal with only a few drops of their corrosive saliva.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME wraps its long tongue around its body, allowing it to lick up sweet nectar as it dances through the flower fields. However, it is just as content to slurp up small Bug Pokémon if they get too close to its flowers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's lack of sharp teeth may make it look harmless, but those who let their guard down do so at their peril. It can extend its tongue faster than the human eye can see to lasso prey into its maw.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses its flexible tongue to regularly clean out its ears. It may be gross, but its hearing is always on point.
author: dudeasaur

entry: Although the slime from POKENAME's body is relatively harmless, the saliva from its tongue is decidedly less so. A single lick could dissolve clothes in seconds and leave painful acid-like burns on exposed skin.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its massive tongue to reach into insect nests to eat the honey inside. However, it sometimes gets its tongue stuck in the nests and will flail around violently to get it off.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME love to lick whatever they find as a show of affection. They seem to be able to track anything just by tasting its surroundings.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides in shallow seabeds near beaches. Its massive tongue helps it hunt, defend itself, and emit psychic waves that let it sense stronger Pokémon approaching, allowing it to hide and avoid battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lick the toxic dust off its fur to coat its tongue in a sticky goo. It then wraps its tongue around its entire body and rolls into food and prey at high speed, devouring them once it stops.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME's tongue is extremely hot, so it uses it while in combat. Instead of using its ability to see into the future to gain an upper hand in battle, it uses it to find where the best foods are.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are remarkable marksmen and can accurately fling darts with their tongue across a football field. When they are not hunting or practicing their throwing technique, they wrap their tongue around their body to keep warm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: At first glance, it was thought that POKENAME produced large amounts of warm water from its tongue-covered body, until further research revealed it was actually expelling large amounts of excess saliva.
author: sk372

entry: It constantly licks its entire body to keep it moist, but keeps its wings dry. Streetlamps covered in toxic drool in the morning are a sure sign POKENAME were feasting on bugs there the night before.
author: pokepower

entry: It feeds primarily on sweet foods, with a particular preference for ice cream. Owners of ice cream trucks and parlors are plagued by this Pokémon, which will burst through the floor to steal their supply.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its body is incredibly slimy due to its grooming itself with its massive tongue. However, it has been proven that this does nothing to clean itself.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: It hides an extra-long tongue, causing many parents to become surprised when it drools. This tongue has been known to strike so fast and hard that it can knock back cans that have been nailed down.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME that are classified as male can send out ultrasonic waves that increase one's hunger, while POKENAME that are classified as female send out waves that decrease it instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is incredibly loyal and dutiful, but needs to be fed regularly. If it goes hungry, POKENAME can make a big mess with its strong tongue.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME may appear harmless and simple, but it can easily grasp and devour things and creatures several meters in size with its tongue. For this reason, some organizations use it as a guard.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME serves as a popular frosting mascot, delighting children with its cheerful appearance. It scoops icing with its spoons until its arms tire, then uses psychic power to pull more into its mouth, ensuring no icing goes uneaten.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: Using its tongue as a counterweight, POKENAME can lift as much as eighty-nine chili dog carts. Beware, though, as it has an "all the cart" appetite.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME work alongside mead breweries to produce high-quality mead, which they taste to ensure consistency. They are known to celebrate successful batches by drinking alongside brewers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Mead brewers cultivate POKENAME colonies to help them determine whether batches are too bitter. POKENAME are known to prefer mead over honey, unlike other plant species.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's saliva has a sweet scent that draws insects closer to its gaping maw. Once anything flies nearby, its tongue shoots out and grabs up its new meal and drags it back into its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels throughout the far reaches of oceanic waters, seeking new and exotic food. Each of its tongues has a different preference in taste.
author: amityblamity

entry: POKENAME feeds by using its extraordinarily long tongue as a lure at the water's edge, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to bite it so it can reel the food in. Unfortunately, it has incredibly slow reaction times and often lets its food get away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It laps up the toxic film it leaves on the ground and its foes. This Pokémon will eat anything; the stench of POKENAME changes based on what it eats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME digs into soft sand to rest, leaving only its tongue visible. The meat in its claws has a noticeably salty flavor.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME bang their tails against trees to knock down berries and nests. The drills on their backs are well-suited for cracking open hard nuts.
author: santon5512

entry: Its front legs can direct physical force into the ground like jackhammers to churn and shake the ground ahead of it. When its drill horn starts to spin even a little, it is a sign that it is about to charge and attempt to impale whatever is ahead.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME needs minerals and fruit to stay healthy. During the day it drills into the ground for stone, and at night it pulverizes fruit with its tail.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: These playful Pokémon have a habit of trying to chase and attack their own round tails or each other's tails. When they are happy, their two drill-like horns spin quickly. Their horns cannot even puncture a piece of fruit.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME pack enough power within them to wreck heavy machinery with just one swing of their tails. Using their drill horns, they create small tunnels in mountains that are infamously difficult to navigate.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME generate seismic waves by slamming their hands into their tables, the resulting energy resonating along the discs secured to the top. They direct their speakers by rapidly spinning their discs, allowing them to attack from a distance.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME swarms can be found in canyons and cliffs, drilling rocks with their long horns to extract minerals. Easily agitated, they will attack any nearby creature regardless of size.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME marks its territory in a very distinctive way by drilling its 3 horns into rock. Ancient peoples knew that spotting these marks meant that fresh water was nearby, often in aquifers underground.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME rapidly rotate their ears into drills before diving into the ground head-first. If they need to change direction, they extend their front paws to stop themselves before rotating their tails instead.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME dig their heads beneath rocks, hurling them in the air before catching them on their spinning drill, sending shrapnel in all directions. They do so to break rocks into edible chunks, though this also works to keep predators at bay.
author: santon5512

entry: This Pokémon is shaped like an ancient symbol meaning "ROCK" or "HARDNESS". POKENAME fanatically use their drill-like horns to carve bizarre glyphs on cave walls. Disturbing them during this process causes POKENAME to become uncontrollably irate.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME digs long tunnels through mountainsides and rolls through them to travel. If it is about to run into something while barrelling down a ramp, it explodes to clear the way.
author: .realthree

entry: Records speak of one particularly bold POKENAME who served as a lieutenant during a great territorial clash. Even now, others of its kind mimic its fierce loyalty and unshakable discipline in every fight.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its drill-like beak allows it to effectively create a slipstream for itself; as a result, it can achieve high speeds. POKENAME digs for burrowed prey using its drill beak, though it will also use it to prey upon some Rock-type Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME like to catapult little Georaid at their targets, but the Georaid are of the opinion that it should be throwing little Rhyraid instead.
author: funkytomate

entry: Its body is as tough as tungsten, though its horn is tougher than diamond and can spin fast enough to penetrate most materials. Its talons are strong enough to grip a boulder thrice its size and it can even carry them high into the sky.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's drill-like neck and horn can reach a combined speed of 5,000 rpm when spinning in tandem. It can burrow up to 80 meters through solid stone with a single Drill Peck.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME digs winding tunnels with its large drill-like horn. These tunnels allow for ambushes on unsuspecting targets and lead back to its den.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME uses the drill-horn on its forehead to burrow into the ground near mountains in search of the softest soil to consume. The smaller secondary horn can be fired as a projectile in self-defense, growing back shortly after launching.
author: sk372

entry: With all three of its drills active, POKENAME can reduce an entire mountain to rubble in minutes. Its stony armor is resilient to nearly all attacks, able to endure explosions with nary a scratch.
author: sk372

entry: This fusion stores up to 20,000 volts within its body. POKENAME then uses this electricity to power up the drills on the ends of its tails.
author: milchik

entry: The fire energy stored in its body can be released through the palms of its hands. POKENAME can launch hot explosive rocks at its foes thanks to it.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME always keeps at least one Toxic Orb within the holes in its palms. It launches them from afar at prey it stalks to weaken them while its body converts the toxins the orb creates into healing fluids for itself.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use its muscles to shoot rocks from the holes in its palms. This is to ward off anyone or anything that may be harming its home jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Despite the heavy armor covering its upper body, POKENAME is surprisingly agile. It delivers devastating kicks at speeds of up to 200 mph, using the massive weight of its armored torso as a powerful counterweight to amplify the force of each strike.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Similar to Rhyperior, POKENAME load up rocks into their arms, using them as projectiles against opponents. However, in battle, they use their horns more effectively, folding their arms before flying into opponents, impaling them with their horns.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Though POKENAME is slow and mainly fights defensively, one must not underestimate its strength; its drill-horns can dig through stone with ease, and can be fired from its head at high speeds into distant targets.
author: sk372

entry: It's said that POKENAME gathers and consumes souls so that it may serve to do its bidding in combat. It fires spectral projectiles in combat that curses those hit with overwhelming dread.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create magnificent stone carvings that depict the origins of the universe. Each detail is painstakingly etched with their horn, which is said to never grow dull.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can withstand any sword and is able to drill through diamond, let alone any shield or armor.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It sharpens its drill to prepare for combat with a fellow POKENAME. In a real confrontation, however, the POKENAME with a smaller drill will usually flee.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME's drill is connected to a stacking gear mechanism that, though it is hard to start up, allows the drill to spin at extremely high speeds, perfect for boring through rock with ease.
author: fireblade141

entry: It can use its tendrils to lift huge boulders and crack them like eggs. Even solid bedrock cannot withstand sustained drilling from its mighty horn.
author: wigglypon

entry: Its drill horn can spin so fast that it can cleanly pierce through steel, while its tail packs enough power to topple metal tower in a single swing. A POKENAME can plant its palms against the ground and use its muscles to create localized tremors.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME digs along tough mountain ranges using its oversized arm to search for fallen meteorites. When it finds a promising rock, it drills into the rock with its horn to see if the interior has the chrome-like shine it desires.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is commonly spotted at construction sites, helping the workers carry large loads and moving large mounds of earth. Its rocky hide is tough enough to withstand an entire building falling on it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its drill-shaped horn to dig vast caverns beneath mountain roots. On its back, it has organs that continuously store electrostatic energy generated during its digging activities.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Thanks to its long stone legs, POKENAME can walk on any surface, even climbing cave ceilings to set deadly ambushes for its prey. Beneath its mouth, it has a pair of drill-shaped claws capable of piercing metal walls.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME latch onto the tops of caverns with its drill tendrils to prey upon unaware Rock types. It can easily crack through a Golem's hard carapace.
author: serversizeme

entry: When POKENAME's drill horn rotates, the flames on its body intensify. Its eerie light can be seen glowing from over a mile away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wander deserts to protect travelers from nearby threats. They always move toward danger, so when one appears, wanderers know peril is close behind.
author: rumia_archer

entry: Its body feels rubbery to the touch, but will become hard in response to physical trauma or if it gets detached from its core. The sole existence of this fusion causes earthquakes and heavy sunshine, for it awakens the anger of Groudon.
author: epping_forest

entry: Using their bulky tails and their muscular forelimbs, POKENAME create tremors to knock loose fruits, berries, and nuts in trees. They use their horn drills to access the sap and water within trees, though they can easily puncture solid rock as well.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are able to spin their bodies rapidly in the air to become a piercing drill capable of drilling through some of the toughest materials.
author: camtft

entry: The drills POKENAME have are produced from the minerals they consume. Those with a strictly gemstone diet can develop crystal drills.
author: ohok3441

entry: The gems and stones adorning its body are highly valued. Unfortunately for sellers, POKENAME will never give up its hoard.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME are useful for construction thanks to their drills. Uncontrolled POKENAME have been known to damage towns by tunneling under them.
author: ohok3441

entry: When POKENAME swings its heavy tail, it can demolish anything in its path. Paleontologists theorize that this species was the apex predator in primeval mountains.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME often gathers at construction sites, acting as a wrecking ball for demolitions. Its stone armor resembles personal protective equipment, reflecting its dedication to safety.
author: merclipse

entry: Though slow and heavy, POKENAME is an adept hunter. Hanging near the ocean floors, it vacuums debris into its hands to fire powerful shots at distant targets, knocking them out and leaving them helpless to avoid becoming prey.
author: sk372

entry: This alternative coloration of POKENAME was first discovered in oceans highly populated by Sharpedo. Though first thought to be camouflage, it was later discovered that this variant prefers Sharpedo as its prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are expert miners, using ultrasonic pulses to determine different ores hidden deep within the rocks. While a common Pokémon used in mining operations, they are very particular about their craft.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME soars above deserts and mountains on wings made of coalesced sandstorms. In battle, they disorient their opponent from above with swirling sand, then divebomb with its horn.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME will use its giant drills to shred anyone it comes across during its rampages. By absorbing light energy, these drills become even bigger, faster, and stronger.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME adjust their positions with remarkable speed by releasing jets of air from the holes in their palms. They can quickly down most foes with a dive bomb attack that empowers their Horn Drill attack.
author: infinex21

entry: This fusion is often used for demolition work. However, there have been reports of workers disappearing without a trace once POKENAME was on site.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's powerful horn can drill through even the toughest and thickest of ice blocks with ease. The jewels on its sides can generate immense cold, slowing down or even freezing attackers in place.
author: sk372

entry: Their drill-like claws are so efficient at piercing solid rock that most mining crews will always have at least one on hand. Their extremely durable bodies and wrecking-ball tails also help deal with deep-cave threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are often hunted as trophies, with their horns mounted for display. As a result, their population has plummeted and they are now considered endangered, prompting activists to call for a hunting ban.
author: whatagooddaytodie
