entry: POKENAME dedicates its entire existence to making its life more challenging. For example, when asked to move something, it may carry four extra boulders in its other set of arms to increase the workload; this helps train its strength.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its body is too heavy to comfortably leave magma. It will only leave a volcano if an eruption fires it out. It glides to new volcanoes from the stratosphere.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Instead of water, POKENAME prefer to swim underground, using their large horn to drill through rock and soil. Swimming in water causes their skin to dry out and crack.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME will use their drills to tunnel through the seafloor, creating intricate underwater caves. Many sea creatures make these caves their home.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's vines are terrifyingly powerful. However, they are not as easy to regrow as Tangela's, so POKENAME will attack anyone who grows too close.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is widely believed that this Pokémon's vines comprise the vast majority of its total mass, with the actual body being concealed by the large skull it wears. It subsumes its prey within its mass of vines. Not even their bones are left behind.
author: infinex21

entry: When threatened, POKENAME whips out a vine that resembles a tongue from its mouth. It strikes from up to 10 feet away with surprising force.
author: .izik

entry: With a tough rocky shell and two layers of durable vines, the core of POKENAME is well protected against physical attacks. However, this makes it difficult for POKENAME to eat, so it must dissolve food externally before absorbing nutrients.
author: alumed

entry: Its face resembles an egg, tucked away in the center where it is protected by its many powerful, undulating vines. It tucks away abandoned eggs into its body, keeping them safe and warm beneath the tendrils.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has reduced Tangela's usual coating of vines, instead forming strong clumps of vines as limbs. It uses these mainly to reach fruits and berries atop trees it couldn't normally reach.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys playfully wrapping its vines around its Trainer. In a popular fairy tale, a POKENAME lived atop a lonely tower, lowering these vines to those who called out to it.
author: mepp.

entry: While slashing wildly with its blades, POKENAME sends out vines to bind prey. Its attacks are swift and disorienting in dense terrain.
author: .izik

entry: Stories about roaming POKENAME are often told to keep children from misbehaving. Despite this reputation, POKENAME are remarkably shy and tend to avoid contact with people and Pokémon alike.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME have a mass of tentacles made out of code that they rely on to win battles. They exercise much caution when fighting their opponents, as losing too much data renders them too unstable to continue fighting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Most of POKENAME's vines reside internally within its stomach. When hungry, its writhing vines lurch out from its hidden mouth and grab as much food as possible to drag back to its rumbling belly.
author: sk372

entry: The protruding vines upon a POKENAME's back can extend and expand into functional wings that allow it to fly at surprising speeds. Its arms can extend far and fast to deliver devastating strikes or snatch up food.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wanders swamps and thick brush, desperately thrashing around. It always seems to be trying and failing to free itself from its own tentacles.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME hangs upside-down from trees, disguised as a bundle of vines. If it spots prey, it will silently follow them to their resting grounds so it can feed on them at night over the following weeks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME illuminate the tips of their fingers as they curl to lure in prey. Once the prey is close enough, POKENAME rapidly wrap them up in vines before dragging them into the depths.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME migrates from temperate regions to warmer climates like Alola during cold seasons. The tropics accelerate the growth of its vines, hampering its flight until it preens the excess vines off for the return journey.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME massage the backs and limbs of many people who exercise at the gym, using their long tentacles to soothe muscle pain. The writhing tentacles are soft, firm, and have a pleasant scent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lies around the marsh, absorbing large amounts of water into its vines. Sometimes, it will get smaller Pokémon tangled in its vines and will try in vain to get them free.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wraps itself around a tree it likes with its thick vines, staying tethered there for days at a time. If it is threatened, it will swing from the tree branches and hit its attacker like a wrecking ball.
author: mistymagius

entry: While most vines on a POKENAME are soft and flexible, the horn vine is as tough as granite. The softer vines can restrict and ensnare opponents while the horn strikes them.
author: entomoxie

entry: The vines along their bodies are dense and grow back quickly if damaged. Although this provides POKENAME with decent defenses, they must often tear away their own vines or else they will overgrow and envelop their entire body.
author: infinex21

entry: The bioluminescent parts of its body glow brightly when it becomes enraged. In this state, it will spin and charge at everything that moves with such strength that it can send construction vehicles tumbling.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME roll up into large, wheel-like shapes when they plan to move long distances and when to charge into opponents. Their large ears are clusters of strong vines that can lash at foes and can act as hands.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's antlers glow faintly when it manipulates its vines. It uses them to pluck herbs from the underbrush and pull them to its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: Its overgrown vines have all but consumed its entire form, save for its gaping maw and deadly fangs. Each vine is filled with a deadly poison that will cause it to rot and decay soon after being cut.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's vines constantly grow uncontrollably long since their growth is accelerated by the great inner power it contains. It must blast fire on itself in order to keep the vines at a comfortable and non-hindering length.
author: soup1900

entry: The different-colored spots of POKENAME's vines are where it generates and stores its electricity. Even if not actively sparking, these points are dangerous, and will deliver a nasty shock on instinct if touched.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grows many different types of berries in its tangled mess of vines. However, it tries its best to keep them hidden from other Pokémon so that it can have them all to itself.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses a thick pink vine curled deep within its body to feed. This tongue-like appendage can stretch over 30 feet when fully extended.
author: .izik

entry: The vines along this Pokémon's arms conceal the open ports within its palms that allow it to shoot large Seed Bombs and bundles of writhing vines at foes. It often uses its long drill horn to crack open tough nuts and other fruit.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME vines are remarkably conductive, leading many to use them as cables and wires in some cases. The two vines that serve as their tails can deliver powerful electric shocks into foes until they are rendered immobile.
author: infinex21

entry: Its large tusks are made of dense, rigid vines that regrow in less than a week if ever broken. It charges down invaders of its territory and uses its strong legs to create tremors that knock free the fruit within trees.
author: infinex21

entry: Its many lower vines form a long, flowing skirt that it can control with surprising precision. Each of its vines can grow to encompass a large area, with it being able to control each one individual to acquire prey or to ward off aggressors.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's vine-like bodies allow them to thrive in dense forests, blending in with the shrubbery. As the seasons change, they change the color of these vines to match their environment, often with perfect accuracy.
author: santon5512

entry: The writhing vines around POKENAME's body are coated with color-shifting scales, giving it the ability to blend into its environment. By combining this ability with the soft rubbery texture of its feet, it can silently slip away from predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These large, predatory jungle Pokémon hold the many vines of their bodies together with their psychic powers. Their heavy limbs are actually made entirely of many vines coiled together into dense clusters capable of crushing rock.
author: infinex21

entry: Even without considering their vine-like arms, POKENAME are extremely flexible. They constantly train their bodies to be ready to fend off attacks from any angle.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Using its knotted tentacles, POKENAME wraps up its target and pulls them into its gaping maw. Strands of metal fibre are woven into its vines, making them extremely durable.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME use their many long, thick vines to camouflage themselves and wait for prey to cross by. When they see something they believe they can prey upon, they unveil their large, horrific maws and strike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME typically dwell deep within jungles, especially in areas where they can easily blend in due to the many vines covering their bodies. They can, and will, extend their arms to defend themselves and to secure food.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon is a predator in its native jungle environment and thrives in sunlight. To hunt, it first stalks its prey for hours, until at an opportune moment it hurls the vines on its head with such force that they can cut through almost anything.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME's vine blade functions both as a whip and a snare. It easily regenerates and can grow more than 100 feet long.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This Dragon-type Pokémon's impressive form is clad, and made much larger, by the many vines growing upon it. It can lash out at any enemy with many vines from all over its body or with its thick tail made even stronger by its vines.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body is clad in lush, vibrant colors thanks to the nutrient-rich waters it lives within. POKENAME's vines filter out any pollutants within water and fall off when full of said pollutants.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hunts during foggy nights when the visibility is low. It disguises itself by rearranging the vines on its head into various shapes to mimic branchy trees, small hills, or even the silhouettes of other Pokémon.
author: milchik

entry: The tips of its vine-like feelers, which have formed almost like hands, secrete a soothing fluid that it uses to quell foes, subdue prey, or soothe its young. Its other vines contain a similar soothing compound, so they are used in many remedies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are towering Pokémon clad in many vines and patches of thick moss. The vines seem to help support their large limbs and aid them in moving until they snap, which they will then rest until their vines regrow.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the many vines on its head to hide its cannon so that it may seem harmless towards prey. To make sure a foe stays down after an attack, it draws in prehistoric strength to fire a powerful Ancient Power from its cannon.
author: soup1900

entry: Stumbling along through forests at night, POKENAME grow frustrated when their vines get tangled. They attempt to keep themselves at a safe distance by raising their arms, but their vines only end up getting caught in their flowers instead.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can tear the vines off its body and control them telekinetically to ensnare its prey. The vines regenerate back so quickly that it ends up controlling dozens of vines at once within seconds of a battle.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is very kind and will often carry young Pokémon in its vines for protection. It loves stargazing and can be seen sitting atop trees to get the best view.
author: mistymagius

entry: They lurk within swamps and marshlands, blending in with the tangled greens within ponds and lakes. When prey draws near, they will use their large maws to consume them whole and hold onto them until they cease to resist.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME relentlessly chases its prey during the last few minutes of dusk, carefully corralling them into areas where it has planted many of its quick-growing vines. When darkness finally sets in, it's only a matter of time until its prey trips.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hangs from trees using its vines, slowly draining the life force of nearby creatures. Some say that if one appears near your home, your days are numbered.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has only been spotted protecting an ancient temple that fell under the water long ago. While usually kind, it disposes of its foes in a dazzling vortex of swirling waves and boiling water.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its vine-like tails are always growing quickly to counter the ever-burning flames that continuously consume them. The vines along the rest of its body run warm with a fluid that quickly combusts when exposed to air.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a deadly jungle predator that darts above canopies and through the trees. Its many vines serve as sharp-tipped arms that can skewer prey and other food, even as it moves at extreme speeds.
author: infinex21

entry: When energized, POKENAME's vines lash about uncontrollably. It enters a frenzy, striking everything nearby until its energy fades.
author: .izik

entry: It digs holes in forests to shelter from the elements. When something small enough inspects the hole, it grabs it with its tentacles and consumes it.
author: skymaster426

entry: Their vines eagerly writhe to break free from within their cocoon-like shell, growing toward the open sky. Their thick, albeit small, legs are strong from carrying their incredibly heavy bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's vines were often used as bandages during ancient times as they had amazing healing properties. It sticks itself to tree branches and feeds on nearby plant matter by dissolving them into its gel.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spreads the tips of its wings to expand the webbing for a slow descent without flapping. Its vines are coated with a toxin that exhausts foes on contact, allowing it to easily feed at a leisurely pace.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The vines on POKENAME grow constantly, helping to hide their bodies. They lie flat along the forest floor, blending in with the foliage and ensnaring anyone unfortunate enough to step on them.
author: santon5512

entry: The vines on POKENAME grow constantly, helping to hide their bodies. They lie flat along the forest floor, blending in with the foliage and ensnaring anyone unfortunate enough to step on them.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's vines are incredibly muscular, as it will wrap them around its legs to increase their power. Herds of POKENAME were used by travelling merchants to help tow heavy cargo.
author: mistymagius

entry: The vines growing off of POKENAME's body are bitter and unsuitable to eat. Legends state it will snatch away arsonists and devour them. POKENAME, however, actually gets energy by leeching water and nutrients off the roots of other plants.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The vines growing off of POKENAME's body are bitter and unsuitable to eat. Legends state it will snatch away arsonists and devour them. POKENAME, however, actually gets energy by leeching water and nutrients off the roots of other plants.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are formed of a loose connection of vines and roots that burrow into and hollow out boulders. They bind these boulders together to form a basic frame with which to move and to protect their vulnerable vines.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its steel shell houses an ever-growing mass of vines. The toughness of its body and regenerative capabilities of these vines make it nearly impossible to defeat.
author: bacondlx

entry: What seems to be a passenger inside a heavy metal husk, POKENAME prefers to reach with long vines to strike foes rather than approach them itself.
author: bukie

entry: The vines covering its body are so soft that they resemble a woolen sweater. When POKENAME hugs someone with its strong arms, it never lets go, and even the edges of its sweater stretch to wrap around its poor victims.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It jabs at opponents with the thick spikes at the ends of its fists. When its vines ensnare an opponent, it will not stop lashing at them until they can be dragged in and consumed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME diligently maintains its appearance, fussing when its hair-like tendrils become tangled. Those that wander deep into jungles may catch a rare glimpse of this Pokémon singing.
author: mepp.

entry: Numerous tentacles sprout from beneath the mushroom cap to give POKENAME locomotion. The tips release spores into the ground as it walks, so everywhere it steps, fungi will grow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME inspects anything it encounters, keeping shiny objects in its vines. Its vines contain a poison to deter predators, but careful application of heat can counteract the toxin, allowing them to be eaten for their gritty texture and dry flavor.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is known for its intelligence, creating small bundles from its vines to help carry berries. The vines are thick enough to resist the blades of Scyther.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME keeps most of its prehensile vines tied back while it's meditating. When it feels the need to fight, it lets its vines move freely and unleashes its full strength.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses its knotted tail to restrain its target, wrapping them tightly in its grip. When its opponent is tangled, it unleashes a barrage of vicious claws and bites.
author: evilgammon

entry: The thick vines covering POKENAME's body course with thousands of volts of electricity at all times. Even brief contact carries enough voltage to send someone flying.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME finds a scent it likes or wants to remember, it rubs it onto one of its hundreds of vines. It can mimic this scent perfectly and is sometimes used in detective work. Older POKENAME's scent can be very overpowering.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Whenever POKENAME finds a scent it likes or wants to remember, it rubs it onto one of its hundreds of vines. It can mimic this scent perfectly and is sometimes used in detective work. Older POKENAME's scent can be very overpowering.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Though a Pokémon with a docile demeanor, it whips foes with its strong vines. POKENAME is also a herbivore.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME use their many vines to send psychic signals to different parts of their body, to amplify their psychic power. POKENAME often style their vines into different hairstyles and moustaches to distinguish themselves from other POKENAME.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME lurk in swamps, acting as the guardians of the environment and the Pokémon that reside there. They like to punch holes in the boats of poachers.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Their thick vines reinforce their already-strong arms while also offering a thicker defense. They can stretch their arms enough to continue pummeling prey if they attempt to flee.
author: infinex21

entry: People who are allergic to poison ivy should avoid touching this Pokémon, as they produce similar toxins. They rely on these toxins to deter herbivores in the wild.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From the hollow of a tree log, POKENAME releases a scent that smells like Pecha Berries. It spreads and conceals vines from its body to drag curious prey inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resides in caves and can retract its vines to blend into the surrounding walls. When prey pass by, POKENAME shoots its vines out from its rocky body and drains the energy of whatever it captures.
author: jangodiot

entry: These Pokémon are often seen as pitiful due to how they will try to flap their small arms like wings to fly. Though they struggle to fly, their legs are strong enough to leap above tree canopies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is made of long stinging tentacles that are painful to touch. These Pokémon are shelter for fish Pokémon that can endure its sting.
author: mistymagius

entry: On its back is a coil that converts solar energy into electricity, which POKENAME channels throughout its body to stay always alert. It can store enormous amounts of energy, which it draws upon through its pair of whips.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its head is covered in a bone-like shell that has been charred by the electricity it catches and releases via its antennae. Its kind favors metal pipes as weapons and as tools, especially those that conduct electricity well.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's legs are constantly crackling and sparking, brimming with energy. They can deliver devastating kicks to foes, releasing 20,000 volts of electricity upon contact.
author: santon5512

entry: If POKENAME gets angry enough, it will expel poisonous gas. Most of the time, in battles, it will try to fill the air with a gas similar to the one used in metal inert gas welding, so its electric attacks become more accurate and powerful.
author: epping_forest

entry: This Pokémon is said to be capable of summoning thunderstorms at its command. Touching its battery-like egg causes the Pokémon to become highly aggressive and violent.
author: skleegamer

entry: POKENAME releases pulses of electrical waves from its arms to locate nearby Elekid. Should it find one, it nurtures the Pokémon as if it were its own, unintentionally feeding off its electricity in the process.
author: .izik

entry: By creating electric arcs at different frequencies between its two tails, POKENAME can emit sounds similar to electronic music. It's a very valuable asset for parties and nightclubs that don't have enough budget for loudspeakers.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are brawny Pokémon that defend their herd by channeling electricity through their horns and tails to attack predators. Their impetuous nature causes mass panic within their herd whenever POKENAME are frightened.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is estimated that POKENAME has a biting power of over 4000 PSI, with electrified fangs capable of delivering 15,000 volts of electricity.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Fortune tellers use POKENAME as a way of determining luck. It will fire off five weak thunderbolts in random directions. Only the extremely misfortunate get hit.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME generates large amounts of electricity through photosynthesis and will zap predators with its wire-like vines. The shock is strong enough to paralyze small bug Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME often hunts alongside Arper. It coats its partner in a conductive gel that prevents electrocution, then waits nearby. When a stronger Pokémon bites the bait, POKENAME releases a precise electric surge, instantly knocking the attacker out.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: If its whips vibrate in midair, a lightning storm is on the way. On its back, POKENAME carries a coil that converts solar energy into electricity, which it disperses throughout its body to stay always nimble.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are often observed drawing trails of lightning behind them across stormy skies. Remoraid think twice about hitching a ride on this Pokémon.
author: rooboid

entry: To achieve its full power, it plugs the end of its trunk into a power source. Once fully charged, it can release immense electric shocks from its tusks.
author: brammekuh

entry: POKENAME vents out excess electrical energy through the cable that makes up its tail. It has a volatile temper, and reacts to any surprises by flailing the tail about, shooting lightning in every direction.
author: sk372

entry: During battle, POKENAME presses the tips of its two tails together while spinning on its head, generating immense electric surges. This motion creates a vortex dragging in nearby foes, shocking them along side a barrage of lighting fast kicks.
author: shyguy11011

entry: This very problematic fusion has the habit of running away from its Trainer to look for a speaker so it can turn the music up loud. When they do this, they must be stopped immediately, as they tend to enjoy music over 160 dB.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are kept on farms as a renewable source of electricity. Just one farm of POKENAME are capable powering an entire city.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME have only been spotted during intense thunderstorms. It is said they cause these thunderstorms to strike down competition so they can catch prey more easily.
author: bigoljax

entry: The bolt-shaped tip of POKENAME's tail is removable, and can be flung like a boomerang. Electric sparks copiously spill out of the tail until the tip is replaced, a testament to how much voltage POKENAME stores internally.
author: sk372

entry: Due to its multitude of wires, POKENAME can attach to many foes at once to shock them. It is also protected by the thick wires protecting its face.
author: creeps_jr

entry: POKENAME can fully harness both the power of alternating current and direct current. Such a sheer amount of energy, in the hands of such an ardently violent creature, is a serious hazard to the security of all Trainers and Pokémon nearby.
author: epping_forest

entry: The result a misguided curiosity of what would happen if an Electivire were fused with a Magmortar. Its fists unleash strong Fire Punches and Thunder Punches. The fireballs loosed from its open palms explode with crater-forming might.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its twin tails to shock its Trainers if they become overcome with negative emotion. Trainers who raise POKENAME dutifully are rewarded with a cool head in battle and a partner who fights relentlessly.
author: vic1312

entry: It presses the tips of its two tails against foes and electrocutes them with over 2,000 volts of power. If it runs low on power or is merely exhausted, it will curl into a ball to better defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can release up to 20,000 volts from its tusks. It charges its electricity as it moves, blue sparks crackling from its tusks as it amplifies.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME can release up to 20,000 volts from its tusks. It charges its electricity as it moves, blue sparks crackling from its tusks as it amplifies.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: With its four powerful brains working in unison, it generates four times more electricity than an Electivire. A single POKENAME can produce enough energy to power an entire city with ease.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME can perceive the aura of people and Pokémon through its two long steel tails. With its touch, it transfers the large amount of electrical energy stored in its body into discharged objects, bringing them back to life.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can perceive the aura of people and Pokémon through its two long steel tails. With its touch, it transfers the large amount of electrical energy stored in its body into discharged objects, bringing them back to life.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME reactivates generators and batteries by infusing them with the electrical energy it constantly produces within its body. If it senses a malicious soul, it strikes them with its sparks to keep them at bay.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The electric sphere on POKENAME's head acts as a generator, which can also pass the generated electricity on to its tail to further amplify strikes.
author: chorb33

entry: The electricity seen in POKENAME's tail comes from an endless electrical field within its stomach. It can open up its stomach like a jaw to unleash a devastating burst of lightning bolts capable of downing dozens of foes at once.
author: sk372

entry: Its mane is made of pure plasma, and its brightness changes depending on its mood. POKENAME can deliver punches so powerful that it can shatter even large boulders with a single blow.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its mane is made of pure plasma, and its brightness changes depending on its mood. POKENAME can deliver punches so powerful that it can shatter even large boulders with a single blow.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME expels thousands of volts of electricity at foes during combat through its feelers. After prolonged battles, it requires significant time to recharge its internal battery.
author: .izik

entry: Any area POKENAME swims under is followed by a violent thunderstorm-hurricane, making it extremely dangerous for sailors to be anywhere near it.
author: elekboy88

entry: The lines across POKENAME's body glow bright as electricity courses through its body. Lightning unleashed by POKENAME strikes with enough force to carve deep divots through the planet's crust.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME channels its vast electrical stores inwards to stimulate internal heat stores. When its spines turn red, it's about to unleash torrents of fire from every spike.
author: sk372

entry: Using its high-voltage electricity, POKENAME creates fists made of plasma to smash opponents to a pulp. It can only safely enter electronics that have 2 or more plugs; any less, and the device will be fried due to the overload of electricity.
author: soup1900

entry: It lives atop tall mountains where storms are frequent, catching lightning bolts upon the tip of its tail. In battle, over 20,000 volts of electricity surge across both of its axe-like tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: It grabs its prey in its talons before delivering powerful electric shocks from its tails. It can sense thunderstorms from over 50 miles away.
author: snescontroller

entry: It is said that POKENAME's wingbeats sound like thunder from afar. Its feathered coat crackles with high-voltage energy as it divebombs prey in a blinding flash, leaving only scorched ground in its wake.
author: potato_tub

entry: A shower of sparks arcs over the site of its battles when POKENAME uses its six wires to attack foes with over 20,000 volts of electricity. Many believe it is an incarnation of lightning.
author: takopus

entry: Each of POKENAME's heads are capable of discharging lightning at near-incalculable levels of voltage. The tendrils on its back absorb latent energies in the air to keep it constantly charged with electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Each one of its tails can produce 20,000 volts of electricity. Nobody has touched one of its tails and survived the resulting shock.
author: xtjs2018x

entry: POKENAME can drain an entire city of its electricity in a single night. Its electrical attacks contain enough power to cause mutations.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME slaps its twin tails on the ground to shed sparks about as a warning sign to people getting too close. The tails toss lightning to its horns that then shoot out in all directions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their massive arms to traverse their environments. By touching the tips of their tails to their tusks, they can channel and direct over 2,000 volts of pure electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME will clash with one another using destructive Thunder Punches and their sharp tusks. Most foes cannot escape the grip of their large forearms.
author: infinex21

entry: Within an POKENAME's wings lie extendable feelers that can easily direct powerful electricity into whatever they touch. The sonic waves loosed from its ears are reminiscent of thunder and can split apart storm clouds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME runs faster than lightning, allowing it to intercept lightning bolts mid-strike. It uses this electricity to power its flight.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME build up a powerful electric charge within their bodies as they fight, absorbing impacts with their thick fur and converting it into charge. They can unleash this energy in lightning-fast movements or devastating punches.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's two cable-like tails can pack a wallop of power. It amplifies the sound of its barks to stun its opponents by pressing them to its chest.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME creates shuriken composed entirely of electricity to hurl at its foes. Should it have been struck by lightning within the past week, these shuriken will grow to ten times their normal size.
author: .izik

entry: An POKENAME has the same explosive power as 30 Electrodes. If it does explode, it would result in a shower of meteorite and electricity.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME's powers and bodily activity increases proportionally to its current physical activity. By dancing around, POKENAME can control and puppeteer nearby electronics, and even force them to discharge electricity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can charge their claws and tail ends with electricity, releasing it in a sudden jolt whenever charging forward. They bristle their fur whenever angry or threatened.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME help electricians deal with underwater cables with their superb swimming ability and resistance to electricity. They can remain submerged for long periods of time while they fix damaged cables that can reach 500 kilovolts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When angered, POKENAME can channel its potent rage into increased attack power. In this state, it can produce many thousands of watts of electricity.
author: lemmymaster

entry: It is rumored that POKENAME's electric strikes are so powerful they can scorch forest trees in moments. Its wide wings allow it to soar through stormy skies, recharging its body by absorbing lightning with its twin tails.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When charging up electricity, POKENAME will grind its teeth against each other, amplifying the charge. Each tooth carries a large amount of electricity within, making its Thunder Fang move particularly potent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME holds the two tips of its tails to its head to shock itself. This procedure stimulates its brain waves and unleashes its full potential.
author: chorb33

entry: It might seem to be standing still, but in reality POKENAME punches faster than the eye can see. Stare at it for too long, and the ambient static of its punches can cause permanent blindness.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Electricity thrums through the large muscles of POKENAME, singeing any stranger who touches it. In combat, they use their four arms to pin foes down, then electrocute them with enough voltage to power fifty cars.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME takes flight during storms to capture lightning with its long tails and replenish its energy. When it meets others of its kind, it tests their strength by challenging them to fierce, all-out duels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sheds its shell yearly just like Golem. The stones from its molted shells contain nearly 20,000 watts of electricity, which are used to manufacture batteries.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When POKENAME lowers its horn, lightning strikes wildly and without warning. Entire grasslands have been scorched after this Pokémon was seen running amok.
author: mepp.

entry: Joltik latch onto POKENAME's wires to feed on its electricity. This would bother POKENAME if the Joltik weren't so tasty.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's shell is covered in iron filings from rolling in sand, giving the shell its spiky look. The iron filings help make its electricity more potent.
author: bigoljax

entry: It channels volcanic energy through its limbs which builds up immense internal pressure. When the pressure reaches a tipping point, POKENAME launches forward in explosive bursts of flame, leaving behind scorched craters and a sulfuric haze.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Being too close to a POKENAME will cause anyone to melt. Its body is constantly dripping flames of over 7000 degrees.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can shoot violent jets of fire from the cannons positioned above its shoulders. When bored, it bangs its horns against the walls of the volcanoes where it lives until they erupt.
author: fiordaliso

entry: To defend itself properly, POKENAME lets loose an overwhelming swathe of flame. To make sure its prey stays delectable, when hunting, it uses Wrap, slowly tiring out their meal until the prey can no longer move.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It finds its home within narrow volcanic vents. If disturbed, it will launch fireballs from its tail.
author: busilisk

entry: The large lips of these Pokémon are almost always turned up in a grin, even as they loose scorching flames from their arms. They nest within pools of lava and eat volcanic rocks, which seem to act like coal to their inner flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can use its blazing arm cannons like a Jetpack, rocketing through the air with explosive force. Its takeoffs leave scorched trails and shattered terrain behind.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME works alongside pest control companies to eradicate fungi from a given location. It prevents fungal growth by charring mycelium networks, stopping the spread of spores.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fiery feathers and flames that trail behind POKENAME mid-flight have caused some to mistake it for a Pokémon found in legends. POKENAME's feathers remain warm for a long time, even after being detached from its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME radiate intense heat as they dance. The hotter their flames, the more beautiful the flowers on their heads become.
author: santon5512

entry: With its immense internal heat, POKENAME boils liquid within itself and releases it as a sweet vapor. Foes who inhale it find their strength sapped.
author: sporkwizard

entry: Using their psychic powers, POKENAME mold their intense flames into fireballs larger than themselves to scare away foes. They can using these powers to hold opponents in place before blasting them with streams of fire.
author: infinex21

entry: Though POKENAME has great intellect, it also has a fiery temper and is easily annoyed by others. Fire begins leaking from the shell on its head as it gets more agitated, until the entire cap is aflame.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires twin blasts of flame from the two points on either side. The burning flames on its upper half signify its fire stores; once they smolder out, it can no longer shoot fire and must recharge for several hours.
author: sk372

entry: To make a Lone Earring, it is often recommended to use a POKENAME to melt the gold due to its ability to generate controlled high temperatures. It can maintain heat long enough to shape metal with precision, making it popular with artisans.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME were held in high esteem as elite soldiers. During a Pokémon battle, they flip over their opponents with their flaming horn before setting them aflame.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can fire a stream of white-hot lava from the cannonlike extension on its shell. When traveling between volcanoes, it uses this ability to form land bridges for crossing bodies of water.
author: oddwalls

entry: Thought to be extremely rare in the wild, POKENAME has only been found near the hot waters of a seaside volcano. Its tail can be used for both battle and propulsion; able to launch fire, gas, and smog, POKENAME protects the tail while it sleeps.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME will infiltrate a community of weaker Pokémon and take leadership through intimidation. It protects its underlings with its tail cannon.
author: pokopish

entry: POKENAME are brutal fighters that will grab the heads of their opponents with their strong, open-ended arms and blast them with intense flames. The angrier they are, the hotter their flames will become.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME expels hot air below to remain afloat in mid-air, usually content idly drifting about. Young predators seeing it as a free meal are in for a shock, however, as it can blast a great jet of flame downwards to take off like a rocket in a pinch.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME ride their tails like rockets and release flaming bolts of lightning to propel themselves forward. Their bright markings make them popular during lunar new year events where they help ignite fireworks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME remain active even in the coldest of weather. They take down prey using sudden blasts of intense heat.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME's tongue can endure extreme heat, reaching 4000°F; Being near its heated tongue can notably raise your body temperature.
author: xyloldi

entry: Born from the curiosity of what would happen if one were to fuse a Magmortar with and Electivire. Its fireballs can shatter solid rock and its lightning bolts can melt metal. Its body is hot to the touch and its fur bristles with numbing jolts.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can spew scorching flames that can reach temperatures believed to be up to 4,750°F. This Pokémon is usually deemed too unstable to train due to its short temper and is thus rarely seen due to extreme safety concerns.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME hates bickering and fighting, even if it's a trivial argument. If it senses there's a quarrel, it will find burn both parties to a complete crisp and fly away.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME live in large groups composing of one or several families, making complex burrows that can span several miles of volcanic ranges. When threatened, POKENAME launch fireballs from their tails.
author: chibitales

entry: If the flames surrounding its body begin to weaken, POKENAME dives into volcanic lava to restore its strength. During battle, it always seeks a favorable position in the air to get a clearer line of fire for its deadly blasts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME enjoys shooting large lasers randomly with strange, guttural sound effects. Oddly, it likes to loudly announce that it is firing the laser immediately before attacking with it, ruining any surprise factor.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME's body temperature rises with each won battle. It seeks a rival that can match its strength, lest it grows too hot to touch.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME are masters of courtesy, swordsmanship, and marksmanship. True to their honor, they fight only in defense and aid those in need. They are often found near volcanoes, honing their skills to perfection.
author: jonclyd

entry: An undefeated POKENAME will use its powerful cannons to blast apart barren land, forming a molten arena in which it will wait for a worthy challenger.
author: leshii

entry: It is a large Pokémon that walks within volcanos, absorbing the heat and sometimes the very magma itself through its large legs. It can retract its claws to use its own legs as powerful cannons that spew flames and magma and its foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Rather than relying on strategy, POKENAME overwhelms opponents with relentless charges and volcanic firepower. The land surrounding its fossils suggest POKENAME once reshaped entire landscapes through sheer force and heat.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The black material that makes up POKENAME's body is made up entirely of graphite, which makes them extremely resistant to attacks. The oldest POKENAME are said to have a body consisting of diamonds.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME rarely emerges from its home deep within volcanoes. It uses the cannon on its tail to adjust its course mid-flight.
author: drip_capybara

entry: A single POKENAME can conjure walls of intense flames and illusions of even more flame walls to confuse and overwhelm its opponent. ITs claws are sharp and hot enough to easily slice through solid rock.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body generates so much fire internally that it regularly needs to expel it from its mouth and tail. It can create ribbon-like whips of flame reaching great lengths to swing at and singe any foes in combat.
author: sk372

entry: The giant mortar on its head fires powerful fireballs that can melt even diamonds. This means its fire is over 8,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are in constant territorial disputes with other Pokémon. Their searing hot flames scorch the earth beneath them whenever they fight an intruder.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The cannons POKENAME has in place of hands fire vicious plumes of flame. The fumes it emits smell like a spring breeze.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME contain gas and fire within themselves, causing them to function and move like balloons. They release flames from their four arms both for battle and to control their movements with remarkable accuracy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME strikes at others with extending flaming fists. When truly enraged or backed into a corner, it shoots out intense flames from the flat mushroom cap on its head.
author: sk372

entry: Its armor can withstand temperatures of over 4000 degrees Celsius. POKENAME has already scorched entire regions with its powerful flamethrower.
author: chorb33

entry: These Pokémon soar across the skies over volcanic areas, feathers falling from their wings like dripping magma. A single POKENAME can breathe rock-melting flames with remarkable precision.
author: infinex21

entry: With flames hotter than lava, POKENAME can propel themselves through the air like fighter jets. Using their psychic powers, they can shape their own flames in various ways to overwhelm foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Their amorphous arms can meld together and form a cannon on each side that can channel their internal flames into powerful fireballs. They can suck up magma with these cannon-like arms and metabolize it to keep their internal flame burning.
author: infinex21

entry: The cannon on its arm only shoots a large amount of harmless pollen. This pollen is very explosive, and POKENAME will ignite it with just an Ember from its mouth.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME grabs pebbles with its cannon-hands, covers them in cotton and launches them that are set on fire. Watching too many cartoons may cause this fusion to become worryingly temerarious and sadistic.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are wandering, spectral Pokémon that roam volcanic regions. Their spectral powers can chill their foes before they blast them with fireballs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's leaves are intensely spicy, so much so that most chefs refuse to use them in any dish. They lose much of their heat during the winter months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live and swim within magma, propelled by precise and intense flames. They will brutally rip into prey with their sharp fangs before incinerating them with intense flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have flame sacs within their wings that let them expel powerful fire in order to launch themselves at quicker speeds. Their sonic attacks can pulverize whatever their flames cannot char or melt.
author: infinex21

entry: Once known as living volcanoes, POKENAME slowly trudge through volcanic mountain ranges looking for food. The molten rock used in their attacks exceeds temperatures of 2,000°F.
author: chibitales

entry: The flames around POKENAME's petals constantly burn hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit. Many Trainers use these Pokémon as natural stovetops.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are sly rascals who wander through deserts and rob travelers of their belongings. They can fire explosive seeds from their arms.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are sly rascals who wander through deserts and rob travelers of their belongings. They can fire explosive seeds from their arms.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME makes its home on volcanic islands. Its tough claws are uniquely retractable, instantly converting its arms into cannons from which it blasts its incredibly hot flames.
author: fireblade141

entry: The intimidating black colour of their armour is formed by repeatedly scorching themselves to toughen their hide. Within their shell, a slow-burning flame crackles, ready to burst into a great blaze when combat begins.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME are agile Pokémon that conceal their movements with the black smoke left by their fireballs and the steam from their scalding-hot Water Shuriken. Their right arms are like cannons that help them to compress and release their flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dwells inside volcanoes. It cooks its prey with volcanic heat and flavors it with a specially concocted hot sauce, the recipe for which is unknown.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can produce and release such intense heat that they can propel themselves through the air. The peppers that grow from their bodies are often claimed to be the hottest peppers ever.
author: infinex21

entry: When enraged, blazing flames surround its arms, making it even more intimidating. POKENAME has a fiery temper and loves to brawl, even with its own teammates.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When enraged, blazing flames surround its arms, making it even more intimidating. POKENAME has a fiery temper and loves to brawl, even with its own teammates.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When enraged, blazing flames surround its arms, making it even more intimidating. POKENAME has a fiery temper and loves to brawl, even with its own teammates.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's primary defense mechanism is belching fireballs. This is well-suited for fending off predators, but it can be dangerous when it sneezes.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME lures unsuspecting prey by radiating a gentle, comforting warmth from its head. When they draw close, it ensnares them with its scorching vine, burning them before they are devoured.
author: m.a.dd.

entry: POKENAME are almost-always shedding their hides that ooze a magma-hot fluid. A POKENAME will commonly stock pieces of its own hide in its cannon-like arms to shoot at foes later.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives in volcanic areas, submerging itself in magma to keep its body temperature up. It drinks lava in large amounts, storing it internally until it needs to battle, whereupon the molten liquid is fired from its cannons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wield brightly colored clubs wherever they go. These clubs help divide them into teams whenever they begin to play games with each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although POKENAME's naturally long and lanky limbs and odd fighting stance has been criticized by some Poké Fans, these same traits allow POKENAME to strike first and cover its weak points simultaneously.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the most peaceful Pokémon in the ocean. It glides gracefully underwater and brings a calm feeling to any fish who sees it.
author: hoppygolucky

entry: POKENAME only inhabits deep rivers that have little to no pollution in them. It leaps from the river when happy, trailing sparkles behind it. Witnessing the sparkling trail invokes a feeling of placidity in viewers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME regularly seeks out areas where there is strife. It can convince others that an unseeable deity is watching over them.
author: gentlesage

entry: As this fusion's name would imply, POKENAME loves being with another Pokémon. If it is alone for too long, it slowly gets angrier and starts attacking objects nearby. This is strange behaviour, as it often stops fights but gets into many itself.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: It flies through the sky gracefully and blissfully. It resembles a shooting star when soaring through the starry night.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME are incredibly rare and are said to bring great fortune to anyone who catches one. Some fishermen have dedicated their entire careers to catching one of these Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hates arguments. It stings whoever is upset, causing intense elation. The feelings get more intense until the victim suffers a heart attack from excitement.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are peaceful creatures that foster small grottos that act as a safe space for other Pokémon. To ease the worries of the weary, POKENAME transform into a form that other Pokémon find comforting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Only found in peaceful waterfront regions, POKENAME is said to bring gentle rainstorms and form unique water bubbles as sweet blessings to the lands they do visit.  Rare sightings have reported no two have the same exact pattern.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME replaces negative words in online discussions with positive ones. Though well intentioned, this often renders the sentences incoherent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies around at a slow pace, as its shell weighs it down. During prehistoric times, it acted as a caretaker for injured Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has full flight capability, but only in short bursts. If POKENAME detects nearby bickering, it simply flitters to a different area.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Though these Pokémon display no malice, they are considered dangerous due to how they feed on emotions. Some theories persist that they cannot control this ability, which is why they passively drain emotions from all around them.
author: infinex21

entry: Nicknamed "The Dragon of Blessed Fortune," POKENAME is an extremely rare sight to behold in the wild. Catching a glimpse of it in flight is said to bless the witness with a year's worth of good luck.
author: sk372

entry: The plants around POKENAME's neck give off a potent and sweet aroma. Smelling them reduces aggression and creates an urge to do kind gestures to those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a gentle giant that nurtures flowers and young Pokémon alike. The wreath of petals around its neck emits a gentle, soothing scent that eliminates any feelings of violence in those who catch the scent.
author: sk372

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's body give off a calming aroma, because of this they wander into places of great panic; helping people stay calm. In recent times, POKENAME have been spotted reviving dead plants after forest fires.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME's flames are said to be able to harmlessly burn away the impurities of the soul of whoever they touch. These flames will only harm those who POKENAME deems to be beyond salvation.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp teeth and sudden movements to scare foes away from violence. It resolves conflicts by pretending to bite down on aggressors, giving just enough room for the trapped victim to escape its grasps and scurry away.
author: soup1900

entry: Known as "The Sea's Joy", POKENAME spreads happiness wherever it swims. By gently shaking its egg-like appendages, it releases soothing waves that calm and delight nearby Pokémon.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME have a halo on their head that never leaves their side. To power this halo with electricity, they perform good deeds and help other Pokémon around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Having sprouted its wings early, POKENAME can be seen jumping from trees and rocks in an attempt to fly. It struggles to take off because of its eggshell weighing it down.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME avoids intense strife at all costs. It gravitates to those whom it deems pure of heart, seeking mutual joy and comfort.
author: entomoxie

entry: Being whole-heartedly good, POKENAME are often kept by fortune-tellers to ensure only good fortunes are read. These readings are quite expensive.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME camouflages among white, fluffy clouds. There have been instances of entire clouds suddenly splitting apart; those clouds were actually herds of POKENAME.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: When the orbs on its head glow brightly, it calms anyone in its vicinity. Its electricity can power an entire house.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Wild POKENAME are often seen dancing within fields of flowers, even if sad or angry. Their emotions influence their dancing and the scents exuded from their many petals.
author: infinex21

entry: This joyous Pokémon flies through the sky, leaving trails of blue and red petals behind it. These petals can be brewed into a calming and naturally healing tea, used in Pokémon centres region-wide.
author: evilgammon

entry: Casinos have banned Trainers from carrying POKENAME on their property. This is due to the widespread belief that holding a POKENAME increases luck. This comes with the unfortunate side effect of having to put up with POKENAME's mildly toxic gel.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its fur to sense enemy actions; however, it will simply avoid the move rather than counter with an attack. If it senses an action that doesn't create conflict or battling, it bestows psychic power onto them as a gift and blessing.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rarely ever battle, though they often appear at scenes of conflict or violence. Their presence has a mysterious calming effect on those around them, allowing them to de-escalate most situations quite quickly.
author: santon5512

entry: Despite its large size, POKENAME is very gentle with people and Pokémon. When pressed, POKENAME would rather use its wings to flee into the air than fight. But when it absolutely must, POKENAME uses devastating force to crush its opponents.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME will only use their strong jaws to bite those with wicked hearts and malicious intent. As such, they are favored by police to help identify and detain criminals.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's final evolved state marks it perfecting its exoskeleton through endlessly shedding. The result is a pristine, solid exterior. To compensate for the extra weight of its shell, it has developed much stronger wings in order to fly smoothly.
author: richardcareylol

entry: Its wings hide two sickle-like claws that are coated in ice when attacking. It swoops down to steal eggs from bird Pokémon, but often ends up dropping them into the arms of Trainers as it flies away.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME carry a brightly glowing gem upon their back, shining through both day and night. Rumours persist that being bathed in their gem's light will bring good fortune.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lives in tree canopies, gliding down to forest floors to sniff out fungi to eat. It is very wary around humans, but earning its trust allows one to share in the mushrooms it finds, which are always of the highest quality.
author: sk372

entry: In some regions, people cut off locks of POKENAME hair to keep as a good luck charm. It has a kind disposition, rubbing up against others to share its warmth with them.
author: sk372

entry: A wild POKENAME can appear rolling only where peace endures, and its arrival is a rare sight. Though immensely strong physically, it instinctively uses its power to grant good fortune to kindhearted travelers.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME consume spam texts and convert them into encouraging messages and affirmations. Many children are connected to POKENAME to prevent scammers from stealing personal information.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A fighter endowed with bliss and the ability to never give up, wild POKENAME typically do not stay in this evolutionary stage very long, if at all, due to their positively hardworking nature.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's sweet kiss is said to tame the hearts of the fiercest Dragon Pokémon. A popular fairy tale features a POKENAME soothing a Salamence's anger through its kindness.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: Very few have ever heard a POKENAME bark. It is said that its cry brings everlasting happiness and peace to all nearby.
author: vlavoc

entry: This is an extremely elusive Pokémon that is said to only appear before those who are pure of heart. According to myth, POKENAME can transform the nearby landscape into one that reflects their closest companion's soul.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A defender of happiness and joy, POKENAME will attack bullies and tyrants with ferocity. The armor covering its body protects itself from feelings of negativity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A defender of happiness and joy, POKENAME will attack bullies and tyrants with ferocity. The armor covering its body protects itself from feelings of negativity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The gentle light shed from POKENAME's feathers is believed to subdue bitter emotions. Some legends claim that many wars ended soon after this Pokémon was seen flying overhead.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME loves to give gifts and will grab any item it thinks its Trainer will love. It has become a great help for postal services, as it gives out parcels and letters with such enthusiasm.
author: mistymagius

entry: It uses mystical powers to soothe the hearts of others or to punish evildoers. Whether it does this due to a sense of morality is unclear, because it also seems to thrive off positive emotions.
author: infinex21

entry: Fables state that in war times, this Pokémon appears as a warning for civilizations to make peace. Some say if no peace can be achieved, it will discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 200,000 volts, destroying civilizations it deems unworthy.
author: beatdoof

entry: Wild POKENAME are known to appear to pure-hearted Trainers who have formed very close bonds with their Pokémon. If they witness Pokémon being mistreated by their Trainers, they will zap them with 100,000 volts.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can blast physical manifestations of love and joy from its cannons. The more affection it feels toward its opponent, the stronger the blast's impact becomes.
author: musicsheep.

entry: These Pokémon have adopted a slightly more relaxed demeanour, with fewer sporadic movements. POKENAME are difficult to spot in the wild, as they fly high into the atmosphere to release any built-up energy or emotions.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dig underground and use the momentum when they surface to take off into the sky. They will use their sharp claws to protect others, but they prefer to avoid fighting.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME wander some forests, searching for any strife to quell. These Pokémon seem to have the power to quell anger and soothe misery, making them fond companions for many.
author: infinex21

entry: During times of war, POKENAME are deployed on the battlefield as healers, flying overhead in search of injured soldiers. They use their psychic powers to relieve pain from their patients.
author: sanguinenebula

entry: Many believe that POKENAME are heavenly beings that watch over the world. They will always attempt to end strife wherever they go.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Due to the spectral nature of POKENAME, its life-force is tied to the egg it once hatched from. Legends say this Pokémon contains 108 spirits within, all of which are from virtuous individuals who perished before their time.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME can use its wings to travel at incredible speeds across different regions. It watches over people and Pokémon and protects them if needed. It is referred to as the 'Protector of Peace' in certain regions.
author: tserii

entry: POKENAME soars in the sky at high altitudes. Though normally very friendly towards people and Pokémon, seeing or experiencing unjust cruelty can drive it into a violent rage.
author: fireblade141

entry: In ancient depictions, POKENAME were celebrated as uniters of peace that put an end to countless wars. Today, they watch over unstable lands, waiting to intervene wherever a dispute breaks out.
author: bitoboy.

entry: Parts of the seafloor that POKENAME inhabits are said to be the most peaceful places in the ocean. It breathes out a sparkling mist from its face that eliminates any feelings of strike or aggression in those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say this Pokémon appeared high in the sky to shield a peaceful village from a meteor strike. To meet one is a lucky thing indeed.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME was worshipped as a deity of joy in ancient cultures. Legends say it descends from the clouds when an entire town feels happiness at once.
author: .izik

entry: Each POKENAME hosts a unique diorama on its shell, each corresponding to an innocent child's dream. In many cases, these scenes correspond to popular fairy tales.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME were said to be protectors of peace in the past, using their swift movement to stop troublemakers. Their ability to use all their limbs at once in a fight allowed them to take out multiple soldiers at once and end any war.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is protective of any Pokémon smaller than it. It herds them under its wings for safety, deflecting the attacks of others with its bulk and solid frame.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gives blessings to Pokémon it encounters that instill a surge of confidence. These blessings also unintentionally impart a strong magnetic charge that attracts metallic objects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME usually seen near kind people. POKENAME uses its nose to determine whether a person is good or bad.
author: snivi

entry: It feels constant conflict between peace and hostility. It brutally fights enemies but still offers mercy at the end.
author: creeps_jr

entry: When a POKENAME's eyes gleam, it can see what's in a person's heart. If POKENAME deems you to be kind, it will bless you with good luck.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When a POKENAME senses incredible malice, it will awaken its full power and descend from the clouds above to smite the source. They often lack precision at this point and will eradicate everything around the source to ensure it can never return.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon supposedly observe the world below from beyond the very clouds in the sky. Some stories claim that if the general alignment of the world's people were to turn toward evil, then POKENAME will descend and smite away wickedness.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is primarily seen flying through mountainous regions, releasing an aura that calms those nearby. Sightings are very rare, though many nests have been documented by Pokémon Rangers for monitoring.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME go on rampages only to battle and stop other Pokémon who are also rampaging. They bless those who are in danger of getting injured with strength powerful enough to snap metal poles in one blow.
author: soup1900

entry: Due to an extreme aversion to sensing even a hint of hostilities nearby, POKENAME rarely surfaces from the depths of the ocean. When it does, the waters around it appear to grow still and peaceful until it descends once more.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleep peacefully in magma, avoiding strife. Legends tell of their awakening causing volcanic eruptions.
author: anarchaz

entry: While POKENAME's strength is powerful enough to topple multiple buildings in a single Moonblast, it does not use its powers to destroy things. Instead, it remains peaceful and only shows off its might to drive away harmful and malicious threats.
author: soup1900

entry: While good-natured, wild POKENAME like to play pranks on travelers that pass by their territory. Their playful personality has made them popular among Fairy-type Trainers.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is said to only appear before those who have the most selfless and lofty of ideals held in their heart. It empowers these chosen few, giving them a blessing of luck to assist with achieving their righteous goals.
author: sk372

entry: Rumored to be manifested from strong feelings of hatred in past lives, POKENAME are never seen where there is conflict. Folk tales speak of them unzipping their mouths as the ultimate symbol of forgiveness.
author: femaledog

entry: Wild POKENAME sleep on the tops of clouds, descending to the surface when the skies clear up. Because of this behavior and their appearance, they are sometimes called 'falling angels'.
author: origamiskies

entry: POKENAME is a very elusive Pokémon that hides within the mists of dense forests. The feathers of POKENAME that people find in these forests are imbued with the essence of fairies.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME craves absolute happiness. If it senses strife, it uses the power of the sun to fire an aureate gleam to end the conflict, even ruinously.
author: miistical

entry: POKENAME shows love through gently biting their Trainers and other Pokémon. However, anyone who hurts the target of their affection is met with a fury that will put Primeape to shame.
author: jesterwanted

entry: POKENAME flies around at sonic speeds in order to avoid any and all possible conflict. It creates illusions for those that may stir trouble so they stay pacified and do not cause harm.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME appears to kind and respectful Trainers, often offering gifts of its feathers or bundles of fur. It is said these gifts are blessings of long life from this Pokémon in hopes the Trainers continue to do good.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is often considered an embodiment of pure joy and innocence that can detect, and will avoid, strife. It is capable of granting wishes, though typically only does so for children as they are usually just as pure and innocent as POKENAME is.
author: infinex21

entry: The rapid vibration of POKENAME's wings creates ultrasonic waves that cause a feeling of calm to wash over those nearby. Colorful scales flake off its wings while flapping, causing a prismatic shimmer in the air around it.
author: sk372

entry: Festivals of all kinds can be host to groups of POKENAME, as the positive emotions attract them. Their delicate wings are susceptible to being waterlogged and thusly will weigh them down, so they tend to hide away during rainy weather.
author: chibitales

entry: The membrane around POKENAME's eyes illuminates those in need of blessings in a ring of sparkles. Malefactors who intrude upon a den of POKENAME will be swarmed en masse and smothered in the warmth of love and acceptance until they succumb.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon of pure happiness, seeking and spinning peaceful bliss. It therefore attaches itself only to those it deems of a good heart.
author: togetik

entry: A POKENAME has a staunch sense of righteousness. If its Trainer chooses strife over peace, they can rest assured that their POKENAME will hold them accountable.
author: .fedoraman

entry: When a POKENAME senses that someone intends to cause strife, it does not hesitate to roll headlong into them. Its judge of character is uncanny.
author: .fedoraman

entry: If its Trainer abandons their moral principles, a POKENAME will abandon its Trainer. A stray POKENAME has never been recaptured, but continues its mission to protect peace around the world.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME are known for huddling baby Pokémon underneath their large wings. They have a unique ability to sense sadness and will stay close to anyone in need, offering comfort and support.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME often plays with children and smaller Pokémon, using its strength not to intimidate, but to protect and support. It is said that its presence brings harmony to the land, always ensuring that no one is left behind.
author: rakunk

entry: Without proper talons, POKENAME specializes in aerial choreography. Because of this, a flock of POKENAME are not only family, but a well-balanced performance troupe.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME travel the lands, cheering on strangers to do their best. If their target is gloomy, their cheers are wilder, to the point of exhaustion.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Visiting from tropical areas, POKENAME teach Baby Pokémon its gentle and serene style of dance. Those Pokémon grow up with a calm temperament.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Its slow and methodical dancing often comes with an audience. POKENAME sometimes visits rainy places for a change in venue.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen in the wild, but commonly gather in places of great community. It is said that the embraces of POKENAME are as warm as the community behind it.
author: elibromax314

entry: Despite its dense composition, POKENAME soars faster than a fighter jet. They often form a partnership with humans and allow them to direct their flight.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME feeds on the joy of other Pokémon and will give them nice warm hugs to make them feel happy. Its tentacles are as soft as silk, so tourists will try to seek them out while at the beach.
author: mistymagius

entry: It does not mind lending out its shovels to those who wish to play. It will often seek out bickering children and encourage them to work together to build a sand castle.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME races across the land. Just like Togekiss, it's known as a bringer of blessings, but POKENAME visits those enduring turmoil.
author: .realthree

entry: Within each letter written by POKENAME exists a fortune for the reader. Though no link between the fortunes and the future has been proven, some stand by their fortune.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME abhors senseless violence, preferring only to fight in friendly sparring matches with other altruistic beings. It will gift an opponent it respects one of its feathers, which are said to relieve tension for the carrier.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives deep in secluded and peaceful forests. It enjoys the company of kind-hearted Pokémon such as Chansey and Sylveon.
author: mepp.

entry: Singing joyfully, POKENAME wanders through towns at night, blessing seasonal festivals. It is known as the Spirit of Jubilation.
author: alkazamis

entry: POKENAME like to travel in groups of five, flying high above the ground. The pack leader is determined by whichever one has the longest wings. If POKENAME encounters a foe deemed too powerful, they will scatter like the wind.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME can emit faint electric pulses that ease the symptoms of heart ailments. For this reason, it is often seen in hospitals, assisting medical staff.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME roam the land, seeking to alleviate sorrow wherever they travel. It is said that when a herd of POKENAME appears, good times and happiness are sure to follow.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME love to fly freely through the air and nestle between clouds high up in the atmosphere. POKENAME are known for having strong immune systems and are rarely caught getting sick out in the wild.
author: ruben2309295

entry: Giving into its rage makes POKENAME fight any opponent it sees, even ones weaker than it. It subdues its rage by constantly preening and petting itself.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The ornaments that hang from POKENAME's body are said to provide good luck to those who hold them. Stealing them is difficult, as they shock thieves with bolts of electricity to protect their trinkets.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once mistakenly believed to be mythical Pokémon, POKENAME's howls are said to guarantee a life of longevity and good luck. There are tales of POKENAME helping the injured during forest fires, moving with serene grace and fluidity.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: This kind dragon-like fusion represents peace and good luck. The fire it produces is warm and cozy, able to melt even the coldest of hearts.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is quite sociable and optimistic. It uses its wings to swiftly glide across the water's surface as if it were ice.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME takes an unorthodox approach to solving strife and disputes: It pummels those causing trouble until they are too bruised and weakened to continue their troublesome ways.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon dwells restlessly in the tall grass, searching ambitiously to create new rivals. Unlike most Pokémon, POKENAME seems not to live off of any earthly food, but instead craves the pure energy that radiates from the petty fights it starts.
author: ashnanodesu

entry: This kind dragon-like fusion represents peace and good luck. The fire it produces is warm and cozy, able to melt even the coldest of hearts.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can only be found on the coasts of peaceful regions that are devoid of strife. Unfortunately, their many tentacles are extremely venomous, and so their appearance is rarely welcomed.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME often help other Pokémon cover up miscolored blotches with red or blue paint. This paint clings to the hands of POKENAME, giving them their messy appearance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on the help of those around them to paint their bodies red and blue, as their bodies are naturally white. In exchange for helping them maintain their appearance, those who help are blessed with good luck.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are whimsical creatures that enjoy carrying Trainers and Pokémon on their back. The soft flames they produce are warm to the touch and give a fuzzy feeling of comfort.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME moves by gliding just above the ground, lifted by its positive emotions. Scientists theorize that its easygoing attitude is an evolutionary response to this method of locomotion.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME eagerly showers blessings on anyone it senses is kindhearted. Even if someone manages to get on its bad side, it will quickly forget why it was mad in the first place.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME will run off of cliffs and glide through the air across long distances. They are rarely ever sad or angry, and even if they fail at something they will never be discouraged from trying again.
author: infinex21
