entry: No longer having an affinity for Fire, POKENAME resides peacefully within forests. They tend to a garden they raise with seeds found from foraging. It was able to restore the Leaf Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon that disappears in a swirl of colorful leaves if spotted. It appears to spend much of its time secretly studying the behavior of other Pokémon while simultaneously synthesizing energy from the sun.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are masters at the art of stealth and are capable of blending in with trees. Those who challenge them in a forest will face their leaf scarf, which they use to glide between trees before striking with deadly leaf shurikens.
author: blaizegamer

entry: POKENAME rest in gardens, soaking up sunlight to grow larger. They're a popular choice of pet when they're small, but many people do not realize just how big they can grow to be.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME nest atop trees to better absorb sunlight through their leafy wings. The pollen they spread when their wings flutter boosts growth in plants and Grass-type Pokémon but is harmful to most other living beings.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME produces a tea-flavored nectar that is incorporated into baked goods. It can be quite mischievous and is known to pull small pranks in the kitchen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has an exceptionally poor temper, requiring close proximity to flora to stay calm, or it will go berserk with its surprisingly piercing tail and hair. Gardeners and environmentalists frequently use it as a guard.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME attach themselves to healthy trees and healthy Grass-type Pokémon so they may leech some of their nutrients. They scatter toxic powder from between the grooves of their lower halves to weaken others.
author: infinex21

entry: It stores its provisions in an underground burrow, ensuring a steady food supply throughout every season. The leaves of POKENAME secrete a richly scented oil used in the production of natural-ingredient sunscreen.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME catches the scent of prey, it crouches low in the bushes, revealing only the tips of its leaf-shaped ears. Always hungry, it attempts to bite anything that comes within reach of its jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When asserting dominance over other Pokémon, it growls aggressively, emitting a strong scent of musk from its leaves and fur. POKENAME is very charismatic, so gregarious creatures tend to submit to it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME runs around to generate momentum, then cleaves through opponents with its sharp crest and defends itself with its spiky tail. It is much more dangerous than its appearance suggests.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time relaxing in the path of the sun. The energy it collects by photosynthesising in this manner is stored for when it cocoons itself.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The body of POKENAME is as tough as iron. The longer that POKENAME sits in the sun, the stronger its defences are.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME despises disputes and flits from flower to flower, attempting to calm down any fighting. Its leaf-like wings produce fresh air from their photosynthesising, helping in this endeavour.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME dives from the tallest trees in the forest to bravely attack anyone who invades its territory. If it gifts someone one of its magnificent leaf-shaped feathers, it means they've earned its respect.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are commonly spotted in gardens, basking in the sunlight. If in a good mood, they will smell similar to catnip when their fur is stroked.
author: kitarchen

entry: POKENAME are usually very proud and have many admirers. They smell like the unique combination of fragrances found in gardens; some Trainers raise them with rare plants for their popular fragrances.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME make their homes on the slopes of dormant volcanoes, consuming the rich, fertile soil. They till the soil and scatter nutrients they didn't use, encouraging the growth of lush meadows and deep forests in their wake.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME have flowers growing within their body that allow them to telepathically communicate with plants. They are constantly bombarded with messages from plants and develop headaches from being overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME absorb most of their nutrients through their leafy body but are often slowed down by the weight of their leaves. They eat their leaves before a swim since the leaves regrow within a day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A natural, soothing melody drifts from POKENAME's body whenever it catches the wind, causing listeners to fall into a deep sleep. The seeds nestled inside its head rattle softly along to its song.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME is found in temperate and tropical rivers, where it primarily sustains itself by absorbing sunlight in the shallows. It hunts fish Pokémon when there has been little sunlight by lying in wait in reeds or under driftwood.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME tends to hide in the underbrush, where it can blend in perfectly. It can release small sparks from its mouth, and if someone tries to touch it without permission, it gives them a shock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Every three years, it sets its own coat ablaze. The process leaves it bald and sluggish without photosynthesis, but when its leaves grow back, they return tougher and sharper than before.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME's wings cause tornadoes that scatter sharp leaves capable of piercing skin, rock, and bark. It lives in dense forests and hibernates in winter, when the leaves have fallen.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: In a factory during the bagging process, it finds its way into a Pack of Potatoes before napping. When it wakes up, it devours the potatoes before escaping from the bag.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's preferred napping spot is within large piles of leaves to hide itself. If disturbed, it uses telekinesis to scatter the leaves and distract the intruder to help cover its escape via teleportation.
author: sk372

entry: Mastering photosynthesis, it camouflages itself among rocks, often mistaken for mere boulders by unsuspecting hikers.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME's mane grows extremely large and leafy as it soaks up sunlight during its runs and naps. Due to it always creating clean air and gathering energy through photosynthesis, it can run at top speed for many days without ever stopping to rest.
author: soup1900

entry: An ancient book is all that is left of an old culture. The story tells of a vain POKENAME that would gaze into a pool of water to admire its beauty, and barely ever move. It ended up becoming rooted to the spot and transforming into a tree.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to attract seaweed-favoring fish. Thankfully, most of these fish happen to be its prey.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME produce dreams of tranquil forests whenever they hypnotize another Pokémon. These dreams are quite calming and leave many dreamers feeling quite refreshed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaves on POKENAME have a distinct scent that is known to improve sleep quality. Many aromatherapy products use these leaves.
author: mepp.

entry: The temperature around this Pokémon drops down to -12°C. It is able to form small ice spikes in its path while walking.
author: watermelonchild

entry: POKENAME keep warm by huddling together with furry Pokémon. When another Pokémon threatens to break up the group, POKENAME ensnare the dangerous Pokémon with silk before escaping with their friends.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To keep itself from overheating, it will freeze the temperature around it. This, however, causes massive blizzards wherever it passes.
author: soup1900

entry: The heads of POKENAME, once grown off its body, become very fragile and full of freezing energy. If one of these heads is thrown, it will explode on contact and freeze the surrounding area. These heads have therefore been dubbed "ice grenades".
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses frozen breath to make large cubes of ice before it. It then uses the sharp end of the bone it carries to chisel the ice into a sculpture resembling those it cares about.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found surrounded by ice where they rest until they evolve. The ice is difficult to break with claws or talons, leading to many predators giving up before reaching POKENAME inside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its icy armor is so cold it freezes anything on contact. POKENAME crashes into mountain walls at full speed to prove the toughness of its ice horn to others of its kind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's pouches function almost like freezers, the temperature inside reaching -75 degrees Fahrenheit. They will often store food within these pockets, preserving it for later consumption.
author: santon5512

entry: By spinning like a large propeller, POKENAME creates violent snowstorms. It lures travelers by making its ice gem shine, leaving them completely at its mercy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME psychically controls cold winds to expel intruders from its cave. It values its solitude and dislikes being disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a natural artist. It will create ice sculptures displaying various ballet poses.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME mainly eat mint and other soothing herbs that give a fresh scent. They are known to approach injured Pokémon and gently wrap wounds with a layer of snow to ease the pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People often see POKENAME's head as being tucked into its snowy fur, but they are mistaken, as the real head is the snowy fur itself.
author: qwertyelephant

entry: Snow and ice created by POKENAME feels warm, yet only melts when under natural conditions. Embers and fire are the opposite, holding a frigid aura that burns things it touches.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME typically evolve during fall after a long hot summer. They keep themselves cool by enveloping themselves in a shell of ice to give themselves shade.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shoot icicles from their stingers to maximize the range of their venom. Once a venom-filled icicle strikes another Pokémon, it takes about five seconds before the venom causes aching chills.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a notorious trickster that can manipulate its freezing energy to create harmless chunks of ice and snowballs, both of which it will playfully chuck at others. Its fur is cool and soft for those it trusts. Otherwise, it is frigid and bristly.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite being made of pure ice, the crystals on POKENAME's back are hot to the touch. They are known to be docile and friendly companions.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are always cloaked in a thin, cold mist wherever they fly. Because these Pokémon can navigate through storms, such as blizzards, they are a favorite among starting Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are clever hunters that use their feminine heads to lure others into their cold webs. Once their prey is entangled, they will inject them with a bone-chilling venom and drag them into their lair.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's four wings generate snowflakes with every flap. POKENAME dens always have at least a few inches of snow on the ground due to this.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME tend to nest wherever temperatures are coldest, even if that simply means atop a breezy mountain. They can freeze their own feathers and fling them at their foes with noteworthy accuracy.
author: infinex21

entry: Every time its tiny feet touch the ground as it hops, POKENAME leaves a trail of ice crystals behind. It is so lightweight that a snowstorm risks carrying it away until the wind finally dies down.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to produce beautiful auroras. They are said to be able to read the future in the dancing lights their powers create.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's orbs glow brightly during blizzards, acting as a guide for lost travelers. It can't provide warmth or shelter, though, so it often teams up with other Pokémon.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It rides the icy winds to move from one place to another, avoiding sinking into the snow. If POKENAME is not careful enough, blizzards can blow it far away from home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its feathers, especially those upon its head, sparkle with frost and exude a gentle, cold air. It can release more of its cold energy and use its wings to create strong, albeit small, blizzards.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are so cold that rivers with colonies of them are 6°C colder than they would be otherwise, making them much more prone to freezing. If this happens, they poke holes into the ice so enough oxygen can still get into the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Groups of POKENAME tend to be most active on cold winter nights. They use the shadows to blend in, launching surprise attacks with freezing breath that can immobilize foes in an instant.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME's fur makes it best suited for cold environments. By freezing their teeth, they can chew through ice to make burrows.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME flower bud produces icy spores that will freeze anything they touch instantly. It is said that blizzards form once its flower is ready to bloom.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME make intricate burrows under the snow, hoarding food inside. By freezing their teeth solid, they can deliver a powerful Ice Fang attack.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME forms snowballs in its claws to play with allies. This friendly behavior is reserved only for those it trusts.
author: .izik

entry: The thick icy shell on POKENAME's back contains heat but never seems to melt. Occasionally small flames lick out from cracks in its shell in brief bursts of light.
author: .izik

entry: By freezing its feathers, POKENAME turns them into sharp, icy projectiles. It then launches them at opponents by flapping its wings.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig up the roots of bushes. These nutrient-rich roots are its favorite food source.
author: .izik

entry: Their ears help them regulate their body temperature. The berries they keep in their bundle can be made into ice pops.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME uses its broad ears to glide nimbly, even through the harshest blizzards. It makes its den inside frozen caverns, where it stores the food it gathers from snow-covered steppes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are able to change their body temperature drastically. By freezing their tails and using them as chisels, they will often carve beautiful sculptures out of ice.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME sneakily joins snowball fights. In summer, it makes snowcones for anyone it meets.
author: rosemagwin

entry: Strangely, fusion has resulted in POKENAME taking a form resembling Vanilluxe. One head is friendly and tries to gift others frozen desserts it creates, while the other maliciously tries to freeze any that try to take said treat.
author: sk372

entry: Sights of POKENAME running through the tundra are said to be some of the most beautiful, its mane as stunning as the auroras.
author: xenellia

entry: POKENAME has the ability to breathe out a chilling mist or burning flames, even able to swap between them without pausing for breath. It gets sick easily if the temperature around it isn't consistently moderate.
author: sk372

entry: An ancient legend states that the crystal on top of POKENAME's head can instantly freeze anything that makes contact with it.
author: eeveelutiongeek

entry: Living on cold mountain slopes, POKENAME subsists on a diet of snow and ice. It eats up to 20lbs of snow a day as it gathers energy for evolution.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME carves holes in the sides of giant glaciers to make its own personal den. Trespassers might only catch a fleeting glimpse of it before it blows them away with a torrential blizzard generated from the icy gem on its torso.
author: sk372

entry: Legend says a single flap of its icy wings could restore glaciers melted by global warming. Spotting this rare Pokémon in the sky is a sign of prosperity and good fortune.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its body is so cold that even brief contact can freeze an opponent solid. Despite this, its agility allows it to perform rapid, graceful acrobatics.
author: .izik

entry: The ice crystals on POKENAME's body are as hard as diamonds, allowing it to pulverize tough stone. Groups of POKENAME can be seen moving tons of snow after large snowstorms.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has two heads with different temperature preferences. It can be difficult for Trainers to keep both heads happy at the same time.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A bitter chill cold enough to flash freeze water follows POKENAME as it walks. It's popular during summertime events, allowing people and Pokémon to cool off quickly.
author: chibitales

entry: Many people keep POKENAME on their computers, as they help cool down the hardware. However, some have reported them going haywire and causing their entire computer to freeze.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME's pale coat helps keep it perfectly camouflaged in snowy environments. It hunts by stalking its prey for extended lengths of time, only striking when it finds the perfect moment for an ambush.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has a unique fighting style equally balancing fire and ice. Its brutal combination of burning and freezing strikes makes it tough to face.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are often beloved by their Trainers due to their boyish personalities and charming lack of intelligence.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME practices its abilities by freezing lakes. Its prowess with the cold allows it to do this no matter what climate it is in.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are extremely territorial, fighting off any potential rivals with freezing winds and psychic force. Their cruelty and beauty have led to Trainers in snowy regions referring to them as 'Chiller Queens'.
author: cinnamoone_redfield

entry: POKENAME stakes out claims on mountaintops, building palatial nests out of pure ice. Due to rumors of otherworldly powers, townsfolk travel to its home to ask for their desires. However, every miracle requires a sacrifice.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is an unusually playful yet protective Pokémon. It enjoys fascinating others by creating various shapes and patterns from ice crystals.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Folklore tells of POKENAME who scatters large, incandescent snowflake crystals along unseen paths through treacherous and icy terrain to guide the pure of heart to shelter, while wicked souls shall be trapped in an unending blizzard forevermore.
author: silentscript89

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It controls the elements as if wielding magic, bending ice and more to its will. Rumors say that powerful POKENAME can summon icy specters of those it defeats in battle.
author: mercsthorn

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It controls the elements as if wielding magic, bending ice and more to its will. Rumors say that powerful POKENAME can summon icy specters of those it defeats in battle.
author: mercsthorn

entry: POKENAME is known for its cold, indifferent nature, though this demeanor can shift around one who has gained its respect. Incredible with an icy blade, it often conjures clouds of frosty mist to give itself a greater upper hand in battle.
author: fireblade141

entry: After working together to make a dam, POKENAME will breathe ice breath across the structure to coat it with frost. This frost is unique in that only POKENAME can traverse it; any others will slide right off the slippery surface.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are common partners for Pokémon Rangers in cold environments, as they can use aura to track and find those lost in blizzards. By coalescing their powers into an Ice Punch, they can shatter, and may even instantly freeze, large obstacles.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME sense an approaching snowstorm, they descend from the mountains they inhabit. For years, it was believed that they were the cause of these blizzards.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME wander snowy mountains, stalking hikers from afar. When they open their mouths on their stomachs, gales of snow and ice will pour out. These winds are often mistaken for incoming avalanches, freezing anyone caught in them solid.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME freezes ponds to create smooth surfaces for sliding. It does this purely for fun and often invites others to join.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME coats the edges of its flippers with sharpened ice to more effectively fight. It is very defensive of other Pokémon, who often look to it for guidance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's main body can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow, icy spikes which can shoot off as projectiles, and its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow or ice crystals it can fire at opponents.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A POKENAME can cut through most organic material, its icy blade freezing the area around the cut in seconds. The Pokémon is very popular on harbors and docks, as it can very effectively prepare the freshly caught fish for transport.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Despite being made of ice, its blade is very hard and sharp. One slash of it can slice a foe in half and freeze the surrounding air simultaneously.
author: adrian151

entry: POKENAME can be found at the bottom of arctic lakes. Its glimmering scales are reminiscent of an aurora.
author: raydrago

entry: It can freeze the fur of its feelers to use them as sharp weapons, be it during battle or to deter would-be threats. It emits a cooling and calming air that will cause frostbite within less than an hour of consistent exposure.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live high up in the atmosphere and make their homes amongst storm clouds. Their bodies are so cold that they cause the clouds they live in to drop in temperature, creating harsh blizzards.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live high up in the atmosphere and make their homes amongst storm clouds. Their bodies are so cold that they cause the clouds they live in to drop in temperature, creating harsh blizzards.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: To combat opponents, POKENAME creates portals that summon heavy blizzards to pelt foes with snow and hail. Analysis of ice shows the origin of the snowfall comes from all over the world, and possibly even distant icy planets in deep space.
author: sk372

entry: Found frolicking on tundra ice, POKENAME depends on its fine fur to lock in comfortable temperatures. If an Arctic storm grows too cold, they huddle together in a giant herd.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME relentlessly search for those who discarded it. Legend says it lurks in icy wastelands, awaiting unsuspecting wanderers.
author: anarchaz

entry: It is a very rare sight, only appearing on winter nights when the moon is visible.  It can hop across lakes by freezing the water beneath its feet.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME uses electricity it consumes to produce its webs. This web inflicts a freezing shock to whoever it ensnares.
author: keksalot2000

entry: POKENAME soars above icy mountains, where the cold temperatures cause small hailstones to form on its wings. Each flap of its wings creates a gust of freezing-cold wind.
author: mistymagius

entry: Even though this Pokémon is usually burning hot, it can completely freeze its body to harden it. During winter, it shares its body heat with other freezing Pokémon.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: POKENAME stores potent fire energy within its body to be unleashed on its foes. Despite this, its fluffy coating is freezing to the touch.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME stores potent fire energy within its body to be unleashed on its foes. Despite this, its fluffy coating is freezing to the touch.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME is able to resist cold temperatures, but if it needs extra protection, it can freeze its outer membrane solid. Incredibly elusive; it can control the water in the air to turn it into an obscuring snowfall.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If you find a POKENAME in the wild, it's best to leave it be, or this cold introvert will point sharp icicles in your direction.
author: ladan

entry: POKENAME use their keen senses to cautiously approach prey. They strike from afar with shards of ice, then retreat into the snow, leaving no footprints behind.
author: spkypirate

entry: POKENAME burrows into snow mounds to hide from predators. It surprises them by hopping out before quickly escaping.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME silently floats in snowy mountains, observing hikers. This behavior can be unnerving when hikers suddenly spot it around a corner.
author: .izik

entry: Its fur protects it from the strongest of elements, so POKENAME are often found in ice storms. Its speed in hail is unmatched by most common Pokémon.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME can be faintly heard singing bittersweet melodies during snowstorms. It is unknown whether its dancing causes it to snow, or if it only dances when it snows.
author: kittyluv090

entry: If a child has become lost within a snowstorm, POKENAME will sense it. It rushes to the child's side and draws them to the closest place where warmth and safety can be found.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is cold to the touch, and it leaves sticky trails of frost as it moves. POKENAME can also be used to soothe aches and reduce swelling by placing it on the affected areas.
author: mepp.

entry: A cold mucus forms over POKENAME's body, looking similar to snow when it accumulates. These slimy snowballs are used by POKENAME to defend itself, tossed at attackers to splatter all over them and impede their movements.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is native to frozen mountain peaks, and its pollen appears as snowflakes. When this pollen is ingested, it makes Trainers or Pokémon feel numb before they faint. Feeling bad about the injury, it feeds the affected its antidote nectar.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are highly adaptive swimmers, surviving in both tropical and freezing temperatures. Their ears can detect fluctuation in temperature, including the body heat from nearby Pokémon.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roots around for fungi in the dirt before breathing a chilling breeze of air over the mushrooms. It refuses to eat the fungus until it is completely frozen over.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME whistles, the surrounding air begins to freeze. As it whistles when happy, it's best not to make it too cheerful.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME spots an intimidating opponent, it freezes its fur to make its hairs sharp like icy needles. It then recklessly charges in with no regard for its own safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has served as a comfort to older and retired Trainers as it favors traditional music such as gagaku. It can temporarily freeze specifical vocal cords in order to create unique sounds.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME sing many carols and hymns during certain festivals to inspire feelings of merriment and joy. For many elders, nostalgia is passed down to children through these old songs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that POKENAME appears on winter nights during the full moon, granting Trainers peaceful dreams.
author: fluttershy0471

entry: The mushrooms that grow from the spores of POKENAME can survive in extreme cold, winds, and both wet and dry weather. However, the mushrooms also easily perish if the temperature grows too hot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's thick, cold scales continue to let off a chill after they're shed. In the past, humans used them to keep food fresh.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Moving to snow-capped mountains, POKENAME's fur has adapted to help resist the chilling environment. It still needs to use its Fire-Type abilities to keep itself warm despite now gaining the Ice-Type, of which it's still learning to control.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME no longer needs its Fire-Type abilities to withstand the biting cold of the mountains. It was able to restore the Ice Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth, keeping it extra protected in a thick cocoon of solid ice.
author: merclipse

entry: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME infuses its ice with sweet flavors, which are used in dessert drinks. Bartenders and baristas around the world rely on its help to amaze customers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though native to the cold regions, POKENAME often live in cities near vending machines and cold storage. Their leader is the one with the coldest and longest saggy fur, pulling it up on occasion to show dominance.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME pull up their baggy skin over their heads and guard against attacks with their impervious frost-hardened bodies to defend their gang. Beverage corporations have been known to attempt to forcibly capture them for their freezing-cold bodies.
author: beatdoof

entry: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's extremities turned into solid ice after evolving. As a result, anything it touches quickly becomes enveloped in a layer of frost.
author: duskrd

entry: Flocking in colder regions, POKENAME casts a faint bit of frost and snow wherever it glides. When it needs to rest, it freezes a small spot of the water's surface to let it perch on and recuperate.
author: sk372

entry: Researchers believe POKENAME climbs walls of ice to observe prey from above. When prey draws close, it attacks without a sound.
author: mepp.

entry: Its step is so light that POKENAME can walk across snow without sinking or leaving any footprints behind. Its icy claws are incredibly sharp and often give its prey no chance to escape.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swallows snow to keep its body chilled and regulated. Following large snowstorms, it is commonly seen helping townspeople clear roads and walkways.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME develop a headache whenever they are exposed to excessive heat, which wicks moisture away from their brain. This survival mechanism causes them great distress, so keeping POKENAME cold and comfortable is in their best interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From the webbing between its claws, it produces ice constantly.  It can pack this ice between its hands into extremely solid ice balls it will use to pelt unwelcome intruders in its territory.
author: sk372

entry: Wind brushing POKENAME's tail causes a light chiming sound to carry with the breeze. Small snow crystals fly off from its tail in tune with the music created by the wind flow.
author: sk372

entry: It dwells in rocky mountain caves, rarely emerging except to hunt.  It is the subject of many stories where it is said to prey on disobedient children.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME will stand and protect its territory when approached, freezing the atmosphere around it. Police use this Pokémon in extremely cold environments to track down criminals because of its exceptional sense of smell.
author: krivaswell

entry: Because of its magnificent and dazzling mane, akin to an eternally blazing flame, POKENAME is quite popular among Pokémon collectors. Those who treat it with abuse and disrespect, however, will be frozen alive, eternally encased in ice.
author: beatdoof

entry: In order to keep themselves cold, POKENAME flap their icy wings to create small gusts of frosty wind. If the ice along their wings ever cracks, they will create a huge snowstorm around themselves until they freeze back over to reconstruct them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic power to slow the vibrations of molecules. In this way, it controls the ambient temperature around it to provide the perfect environment for sleeping.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME floats in arctic waters, mimicking small ice chunks. Contact with its twin tentacles causes instant frostbite, which can easily become infected with bacteria on its body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can gallop straight across lakes and rivers, freezing the water's surface with its icy hooves. Its mane causes frostbite at the slightest contact, so it must be approached with extreme caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can gallop straight across lakes and rivers, freezing the water's surface with its icy hooves. Its mane causes frostbite at the slightest contact, so it must be approached with extreme caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Once used to pull carts and goods along snowy trails, POKENAME now thrives wild in forests. It can gallop across lakes and rivers, freezing the water beneath its icy hooves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It swims through the water with angelic grace and can withstand temperatures below -150 degrees Celsius. On land, it splays its head appendages on ice to detect vibrations while it sleeps.
author: darxer_

entry: Anything POKENAME licks freezes instantly. This freezing touch allows it to preserve food for later consumption.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy claws impart a dangerous poison that drops a victim's body temperature significantly. Even after treatment, this poison lingers for years, causing occasional bouts of intense freezing cold.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon to weave in dreams of frost into their minds. The frosty dreams start with a gentle snowstorm but the dreams become so cold that they wake up shivering.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in groups of three to five individuals where the oldest leads. They build up a chilly, tranquilizing liquid in their mouth before spraying it at foes, allowing their younger brethren to easily overwhelm the target.
author: chibitales

entry: Its bulb gives off the sweet scent of fresh grass when POKENAME is happy. They can be seen sleeping in the sun, absorbing light as nutrients.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that this blood-sucking Pokémon was supposedly the result of ancient DNA splicing, but this is just a rumor. It is considered one of the most vicious Pokémon species.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME flies clumsily and crashes into the ground very often as it circles its prey. Its immense hunger forces it to drink other liquids that aren't blood to satisfy itself, including consuming toxins.
author: soup1900

entry: Their wings serve better for intimidation than for flight. They hide within caves or sand and pounce to wrap around prey before draining them of their blood.
author: infinex21

entry: Its wings can unfurl wide to catch and ride winds high into the air. It dives upon foes and prey, crushing them with their claws and their heavy bodies alike.
author: infinex21

entry: Due to the meddling of scientists it is believed that POKENAME can live for thousands of years. This did come at the expense of much of their psychic power and those abilities are even more weakened if exposed to direct sunlight.
author: bradlybro199

entry: When exposed to sunlight POKENAME's complexion changes from purple to gray. They immediately lose all access to their psychic abilities, leaving them completely reliant on physical attacks.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME makes its home in caverns containing underground lakes. It clings to the ceiling, slumbering quietly until something approaches the water beneath it, whereupon it crashes down with its heavy weight to prey on them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's long, flexible body allows it to slip effortlessly through tree hollows while hunting. It ambushes prey from above, wrapping them in its wings before delivering a precise, paralyzing bite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME determine whether prey is poisonous by smelling the air for poisonous chemical compounds. Once they have selected a suitable target, they sink their fangs into their prey and carry them back to their cavernous den to be consumed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite POKENAME's sinister appearance, they are thought to be guardians of ancient cities. Legend has it that this fusion's presence wards off malevolent spirits.
author: howlingstarr

entry: It is known for its skittish and elusive nature, hiding the moment it sees a person. One of the few ways Trainers coax it out of hiding is by offering a Golden Razz Berry, which it stares at long enough for a Pokéball to be thrown.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swoops down and delivers poison via a tiny point at the end of its extendable tongue. The size of the curl of hair on its head is an indicator of how virulent and deadly the poison delivered will be.
author: sk372

entry: Cavers have a tradition of befriending POKENAME as they indicate to them which passages are safe. They hang above the cavers as they traverse the cave system and allow them to grab onto their tail if they lose their grip.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Cavers have a tradition of befriending POKENAME as they indicate to them which passages are safe. They hang above the cavers as they traverse the cave system and swoop down and grab them with their pincers if they lose their grip.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It sits in rushing water, using its large wingspan and quick pincers to grab its prey before draining its blood. The brighter POKENAME's belly, the better fed it is.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: If POKENAME eats something toxic, it falls asleep instantly. Its body purges the toxins through its talons while it rests, leaving it unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME eavesdrop on human conversations using their large ears. They then implant phrases telepathically to frighten travelers away.
author: .izik

entry: It puts on comedy acts as a duo, using its tail to act as the "straight man". POKENAME uses telepathy to make it seem like the tail can speak.
author: cait_sith

entry: A diner in Brussel Town serves hummus featuring diced, boiled POKENAME claws. Paired with sprouts, this chewy addition is a local delicacy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's diet consists of poisonous bugs and berries, making the juice it creates toxic as well.  This poison juice was a known elimination tactic used by assassins in ancient Sinnoh times.
author: sk372

entry: It glides above the treetops to scan for unguarded eggs or vulnerable baby Pokémon. It cannot get liftoff on its own, so it scales cliffsides to gain altitude for its flight.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's poison-covered body glows a deep violet at night in reaction to the cooler air. It spits globs of toxin at nearby bird Pokémon, carefully tracking where they land so it can feast later.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are desert scavengers that use their long neck and beak to access food other Pokémon can't reach. When they spot a potential meal, they will conserve energy by gliding in wide circles until an opportunity presents itself to swoop in.
author: jadey.1557

entry: With its powerful claws, POKENAME breaks into copper deposits. It consumes the metal to fortify its wings for flight.
author: .izik

entry: While unable to truly fly, POKENAME can utilize its wings to glide down from high cliffsides in ambush. The venom from its stinger causes an intense burning sensation, leaving the victim in writhing agony.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME's stinger is crushed and used as a seasoning for dips in Catallia City. This unique appetizer is a favorite among locals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will wrap their wings around themselves to slither faster before launching into the air and gliding to their target.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Stone statues of this Pokémon can be found on the walls of gothic castles. Some people believe that these statues come to life at night, but no evidence of such phenomenon has ever been registered.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's massive wings generate violent air currents, allowing it to glide endlessly even through hurricanes and sea gales.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME drift through the night, snapping their claws in a slow but enchanting rhythm. In battle, they wave their claws as if directing a choir, snapping them in rapid succession as they focus their energy into attacks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME perch on the exterior of banks, hiding in plain sight during the day and observing the mechanics of the security systems. At night, they command flocks of minions to retrieve anything shiny from within the vaults.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME clacks its large claws rhythmically to intimidate others. On occasion it gets drawn into the rhythm it creates and begins dancing to its own beat, considerably lessening its intimidation factor.
author: sk372

entry: An odd, barely-perceptible hum emanates from POKENAME as it flies around. The lightning it fires from its tail can stun living creatures as well as greatly disrupt any machinery it strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME command swarms of bat-shaped shadows that surround their bodies to help them blend into the night. They bite into berries to drink from them, extracting nutrients that can be injected with their tails to help heal people or Pokémon.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME glides silently over dark seas, searching for food aboard traveling vessels. By morning, it retreats to shadowy seaside caves to rest.
author: .izik

entry: Gliding silently through the night, POKENAME wrap their wings around themselves to plummet at high speeds before extending them and striking in all directions. They can pierce and carry entire trees with the stingers on their tails.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are apex predators that take out other Flying-type Pokémon by clipping feathers off wings until their prey cannot fly. These opportunistic hunters hang upside-down from tree branches to ambush their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME likes to glide high in the night sky. POKENAME trains to hone its skill with its blades.
author: jona_hehe

entry: POKENAME is a vicious beast that hunts in packs alongside others of its kind. Their tail's venom has a hypnotic effect, making any Pokémon they sting obedient to them. Eventually, the hypnotized Pokémon is eaten by the pack.
author: fireblade141

entry: A prestigious restaurant in Majolica Town serves POKENAME claws stuffed with leeks, citrus zest, and a blend of spices. This gourmet delicacy is a favorite among food connoisseurs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt in mossy caves. When their prey is near, they extend their flexible neck to hit their blind spot, and stab them with their multiple stingers.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME skewers the ground with its tail to detect impending earthquakes. It lets out a shrieking warning to alert others when danger is near.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's glowing yellow eye deters graverobbers in cemeteries. It perches silently on mausoleums, guarding them against intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collect souls in their claws to carry away to the underworld. Folktales speak of a POKENAME approaching people when their time is up, delivering a single strike with its tail before lifting them into its mouth and sending them away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Old tomes recount POKENAME protecting townsfolk during wartime. It neutralized soldiers from both sides to safeguard innocents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glide through the night in search of duels. They use their sturdy shield-like claws to block attacks before delivering decisive blows, disappearing with the flutter of their capes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a dangerous predator of the night. Incredible reflexes, night vision, and the ability to glide silently for periods of time make it fearsome on its own; packs consisting of several of them exist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME becomes enraged if there are no strong winds for it to catch on to and take off with. When this happens, it hastily binds a Pokémon with its long tail and forces them to either use a strong wind move or become its next meal.
author: soup1900

entry: Preferring to live in dark places like dense forests and jungles, this sly Pokémon is well adapted to hiding in shadows. It combines its large claws and razor sharp wing blades with blinding ferocity and speed to subdue prey.
author: elfail0

entry: The ribbon-like appendages on POKENAME's body are covered in microscopic barbs. These release a potent toxin capable of blinding attackers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are valiant and loyal, appearing out of a flurry of rose petals when their allies are in need. They leap into battle while scattering thorns below them, repelling opponents and setting the stage for their fight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME stab their electrical claws into devices to siphon off electricity. If anyone tries to interrupt their meals, they will open their claws and release a series of bright red sparks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hides in marshy shallows, snapping at unsuspecting prey. It ambushes travelers by breaking through wooden bridges from below.
author: .izik

entry: Legends speak of POKENAME haunting decayed castles said to belong to ancient vampires. Myths claim they disguise themselves as coffins and drain the lifeforce of unwelcome intruders.
author: spicybunbun

entry: POKENAME fakes out foes with a jab from its tail in order to land a surprise punch by ejecting its internal organs at them. By ejecting its internal organs out like a large curved fan, it can catch winds to allow flight into the sky.
author: soup1900

entry: It observes its prey while hanging from the rafters of abandoned buildings. It pounces on insects and Bug-type Pokémon that also roam there.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its two heads work together to take down prey. Only one head can inject venom, and the other head can suck blood from its victim. Its impossible to tell which head is which until it is too late.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Fusion appears to have caused Hydreigon's genes to split Gliscor's tail into three, each of which is prehensile and robust. The stingers at the tips deliver distinct, potent venoms to prey or foes, each resulting in very unpleasant effects.
author: fireblade141

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME's fat was used to craft candles that burned longer than traditional ones. Despite being long-lasting, they emitted a strong swampy odor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its long, clawed arms to snatch prey from the water's surface. It patiently waits at river mouths in mountainous regions, striking anything that swims too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sings in deep, resonant tones while wobbling slightly. It uses its tail for balance to avoid toppling during its performances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its pincer-like tail to grab foes and drag them underground. It strikes with precision, leaving enemies no chance to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soars through the night with an eerie screech, striking terror into the hearts of those below. It feeds on the life energy of weakened Pokémon, draining them before vanishing into the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy claws to chip citrine from cave walls. It eagerly consumes the gems as a prized snack.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.
author: carameldog

entry: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.
author: carameldog

entry: POKENAME lives in cool caverns, hiding in the shadows. It is a predator Pokémon: once prey has carelessly drawn near, it strikes with its fangs and siphons life force directly from the victim's soul.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It hides in scary forests, scheming mean-spirited tricks to pull on passersby. Unfortunately, its sharp claws end up cutting down many of the trees it camouflages with, causing it to relocate often.
author: hiimhdere

entry: POKENAME are pack hunters that work in twain. One will grab their prey with their claws, while the other bashes it with their barbed tail.
author: yoshimon

entry: The claws of POKENAME are sautéed with mushrooms in a renowned Bluefinland restaurant. The dish is famous for its rich and savory flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME effortlessly soars through both the skies and the sea. Prey only see its large shadow before they are enveloped and injected with toxins.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME like to hide in the darkest of waters to silently watch the water flow for any disturbances that signal prey is near. The blood it drinks from prey provides it with the warmth it needs to survive in cold waters.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is renowned for creating punk rock melodies that can energize and inspire any listener. However, during quieter moments, it can be heard softly humming sweet symphonies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a vicious predator, awakening at nightfall to hunt. Its sleek form allows it to move stealthily before biting its prey with its razor-sharp fangs to drain their blood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sits inside underwater caves, patiently waiting until unsuspecting prey comes by. Once the moment arises, it comes out and performs a First Impression on them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will grip and rip apart opponents with its giant claws while taking advantage of their immobility by repeatedly bashing them with its tail. If it starts to lose a battle, it will take an emergency exit by using its furled wings to fly away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME manipulate the ground around them by directing their psychic powers through their staffs. They can instantly detect the slightest vibrations, allowing them to counter-attack before their opponents can even strike.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The stinger on POKENAME's abdomen is said to contain an extremely potent venom. If one drop is ingested, a month-long paralysis is sure to ensue.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME uses its loose cape to glide between canyon walls. It guards its den fiercely, striking intruders with venom from its barbed tail.
author: .izik

entry: The black gems POKENAME creates in the night look almost invisible, allowing it to strike prey unnoticed. Sharper gems are then used to give access for POKENAME to drain the victim's blood.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forms Toxic Orbs out of thin air and launches them in a dazzling purple barrage at foes to severely poison them. The giant Toxic Orb that grows on POKENAME's forehead deters enemies from going remotely near it.
author: soup1900

entry: At beaches, POKENAME seeks out newlyweds and nips them with its clawed mouth. How it's able to detect marriage is a mystery even to marine biologists.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's silent wings allow it to swoop and attack its prey without anyone noticing it. The more blood it drains, the deeper the red its markings are.
author: soup1900

entry: Its neck pouch produces slick body oils that deflect electric charges and prevent sand from gathering in its fur.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME creates clouds that shower the land with black mud. Construction workers are looking into this mud's efficacy as a building material.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME screeches whenever it finds high places it can climb. POKENAME will attempt to swoop from these locations, causing it to fall onto the ground each time.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Using its wings, POKENAME can glide over large gaps spanning over 10 miles wide. It is feared by many due to ancient legends detailing horrific accounts of this species draining blood from humans.
author: soup1900

entry: Using its wings, POKENAME can glide over large gaps spanning over 10 miles wide. It is feared by many due to ancient legends detailing horrific accounts of this species draining blood from humans.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is an extremely competitive Pokémon that flies across the desert in search of strong opponents to engage in all-out battles. It uses its huge pincers to immobilize its enemies, then finishes them with devastating strikes from its tail.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping upside-down inside caves. Using their psychic powers, they can detect anyone approaching and teleport away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME tend to have a hard time seeing in bright places, so they often prefer to keep their eyes closed and navigate using their psychic powers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are able to locate high-quality minerals in order to craft spoons. Using these spoons, POKENAME can carve out new caves at incredible speed.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Due to its powerful arms, it can fly at 220 km/h without any problem while fighting against other Pokémon.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: On clear nights, POKENAME fly into orchards to devour apples; if caught, they will flex and pose their muscles. Should they successfully stall their would-be captor, they jab them with their stinger to immobilize them and fly away.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME effortlessly glides through the water as it hunts. When it strikes, it attacks ruthlessly with its venomous tentacles.
author: wannaberecluse

entry: POKENAME splashes water onto itself using its tail to keep its skin hydrated. It enjoys lounging near ponds on sunny days.
author: .izik

entry: Despite the pincer on its tail being perfect for catching prey, it cannot use it effectively. It must wait around trees for prey to fall into its grip.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME are vicious predators at night, using their psychic claws to keep prey in place while they drain its life force. Their powers are weaker during the day, however, so at the first sign of sunrise they will drop their would-be meal and flee.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: The Toxic Orb that POKENAME swings draws in all poison within a one kilometer radius. This allows it to feast on poison while healing those around it.
author: noel5229

entry: As long as they're kept in below freezing temperatures, POKENAME remain unable to explode. When cold enough, the fuses used to ignite them freeze over and resemble large tusks.
author: bradlybro199

entry: These clever Pokémon hunt together, always hunting other Pokémon that have very thick fur and tough bodies. They will clad themselves in fur cloaks and wield pieces, or bones, of their prey as weapons.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME mostly hunt Mamoswine, though they have begun to hunt other Pokémon with similar physiques or tusks. They never overhunt, always hunt in a pack of at least 6, and form various tools and weapons from stones and bones.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rocks its body back and forth to show off its massive tusk-like horn to frighten off predators. Because it lacks mobility, its only method of defense is this scare tactic; if it fails, it is completely at its attacker's mercy.
author: sk372

entry: Freezing cold gas pours from its nostrils. Those who breathe in this gas will suffer severe frostbite, along with a worsened after-infection.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME herds have been recorded in the coldest places on the planet. Males sport greater tusks and spikes to defend the child-bearing mothers.
author: vaporvenator

entry: The territory of POKENAME is incredibly dangerous; although POKENAME is a nonaggressive herbivore, it creates a huge maze of invisible barriers for protection. Those trapped in the maze can faint from the cold; POKENAME may loot them afterwards.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's bladed hands allow them to be efficient hunters. Whilst nearly undetectable in the snow, they attack from blind spots. Contrary to their terrifying looks, POKENAME are actually omnivorous.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME's fur keeps it warm even in the coldest tundras. Its high, snorting war cry warns those around it to stay away or risk getting gored by its tusks.
author: hophoppip

entry: Wild POKENAME live atop snowy mountains and will charge at anything that nears their cave homes. When they are attacked, they will fly into a rampage that causes avalanches and rock slides alike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fossils were thought to be an undiscovered Pokémon species until modern specimens were seen. A vicious and fast-moving hunter, it freezes prey with bolts of ice before crushing them with its powerful beak.
author: sk372

entry: With a single flap of its wings, POKENAME can launch shards of ice at its enemies. Its thick plumage keeps it warm even in the midst of fierce snowstorms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are only comfortable in the coldest places on earth, as other places cause them to lose the fur from their heads and allow heat to escape. The bald patch then produces a shimmering goo that can be used to draw heat from industrial processes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The block of ice POKENAME carries on its back allows it to stay cool even outside its natural habitat. When irritated, it snorts clouds of Poison Powder from its nostrils.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Wild POKENAME display a level of sapience considered to be rather rare. They will decorate the tufts of fur upon their heads with small bones from their prey and fight using clubs of solid ice.
author: infinex21

entry: It enjoys snowy nights. It uses its overwhelming strength to move boulders and to eat any hiding Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are massive creatures that can weigh over 1,400 pounds (or 635 kilograms). Their sheer mass makes them well suited for icy environments as their natural body fat and thick layers of fur keep them well insulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME break holes into ice to hunt for Magikarp by sticking out their tongues like a lure. Once they bring a Magikarp onto land, they tear into their meal with their horns and claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME remains stationary its whole life if it can. If something attacks it, it has two forms of retaliation. It will either leak magma from its body or break the ice off its shell and make it fall on the predator. It can live millions of years.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: Textile factories often keep POKENAME to help treat carpets with its flame retardant blubber. The process involves a damp POKENAME covering the fabric with its wide body and squeezing it. This infuses the fibers with the properties of its Thick Fat.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It was thought that POKENAME went extinct during the ice age, but it turns out they were sleeping deep underwater for 10,000 years.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME can breathe a freezing mist from its small trunk. Oblivious to the discomfort it might cause, it freezes smaller creatures into ice cubes to playfully bat around the frozen tundra.
author: sk372

entry: Within the computers that POKENAME decides to make its home, it creates a den for itself by freezing several files and programs solid and surrounding itself with them. One must defeat it in battle to regain control of one's data.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME only comes out of its frigid den in order to hunt, favoring Ice-type Pokémon for prey. It constricts around its victims with its rugged body before chomping on them with its massive poisonous tusks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hollows out mountains to satisfy its appetite and uses freezing gas from its snout to create a system of ice caves. Afterward, it falls asleep for 10 years.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME cannot run on all fours due to its massive tusk. Although its tusk is made of ice, the tusk won't melt even in the warmth of POKENAME's beloved hot springs.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME flings the icicles on its wings as its main form of self defence. These ice shards can fly at up to 100 MPH, inflicting a freezing burn onto anything it hits.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME was an apex hunter during an ancient ice age. It has the intelligence to create weapons using remains of other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in harsh arctic environments, relying on their bulk and layers of fat to protect them from the cold. During clear weather they shoot bolts of electricity into the sky to communicate across long distances.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hunt using a complex plan. They light campfires in the snowy wilderness, and wait for travelers to rest. When the time is right, they extinguish the flame and pounce.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can blow freezing air from its nostrils to weaken opposing Pokémon. It defends itself from counterattacks by rolling up into a ball and letting its thick fur absorb some of the blow.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The tusks of POKENAME are strong enough to crack diamonds with ease. Some pieces of Never-Melt Ice are chips of their tusks.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Now that it's tusks have fully grown, POKENAME is far stronger, but can no longer curl up and roll around without them getting in the way.
author: ruminino

entry: It uses its long tusks to throw enemies into the air, then strikes them back down with powerful kicks. It is quite short-tempered in nature.
author: kittyluv090

entry: This territorial apex Pokémon clads parts of its body in solid ice to strengthen its already-devastating physical strikes. The eldest of this species of Pokémon was seen with tusks that reached further than its own arms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is accustomed to cold temperatures. It collects discarded Mamoswine tusks for fun and uses them to break ice.
author: animecreep4

entry: Though POKENAME possesses potent psychic powers, it prefers a primitive and physical lifestyle living in the harsh tundra. It deftly wields spears to deadly effect and can take down mammoth-sized prey all by itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits a freezing aura from beneath its coat that freezes anything in the immediate vicinity. Some say its entire body is made of solid impossible-to-melt ice, but none have seen beneath the cloak to verify.
author: sk372

entry: Now that it's tusks have fully grown, POKENAME is far stronger, but can no longer curl up and roll around without them getting in the way.
author: ruminino

entry: POKENAME has adapted to traversing mountains while swerving around trees. Surprisingly, POKENAME has very short fur, almost as if there's nothing at all.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Under POKENAME's thick fur are sturdy plates, allowing it to take the strongest attacks. Despite living in more mountainous areas, POKENAME are proficient swimmers, using their claws to catch Fish-Pokémon.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Its fur is clad with pieces of solid ice, which serve as protective spikes. Whatever it cannot lift with its tusks shall be met with a crushing Headbutt.
author: infinex21

entry: Their impressive tusks are made of ice more solid than the ice clinging to parts of their bodies. They reinforce their hard heads with layers of solid ice to further empower their headbutt attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: The ancient guardian of the tundra, it protects weak Pokémon that live in its territory. It commands fierce blizzards and cloaks itself with swirling snow that strengthens its armor.
author: evilgammon

entry: Any frontal attack against POKENAME has proven ineffective due to its thick fat and strong tusks. Despite their imposing frame, POKENAME are herbivores, knocking over trees in search of ice berries.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Its blue scales are as cold as solid ice. This Pokémon will not hesitate to cause an avalanche via small tremors for the sake of protecting its territory and its young.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME breaks through ice floes with ease using its massive tusks. Its hair and blubber are designed to keep it warm in even the most frigid waters.
author: bacondlx

entry: Mountain villages once worshipped POKENAME as a god of the peaks. Legends claim massive blizzards follow wherever it charges through the mountains.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slowly roam snowy mountains, using their modified tusks to move the snow aside. They are praised by hikers, who willingly use their trails.
author: markusknight

entry: Despite lacking muscle mass, the rope-like fur making up its body is remarkably strong. It can swing its block of ice like a hammer with enough force to shatter frozen lakes, dropping POKENAME's prey into freezing water below.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME do not eat or drink. They feature in medieval sagas as the ghosts of feared warriors, reanimated to wreak havoc and settle old grudges.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME are formidable, ancient predators that have stalked the land for millennia. Hunting in packs, they generate intense static by dragging their spear-like tails, sending electrical waves through the ground to paralyse prey.
author: eiskitsune

entry: During warmer months, POKENAME's icy wings melt, making it unable to fly. It will either hibernate until next winter or migrate to a colder climate.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its icy ribbons dance and flutter like an aurora. It uses elegant displays to entice opponents, then rams them with its tusks.
author: missingmilkman

entry: The ice moving through the grooves on POKENAME's body moves at a glacial pace. It's so cold to the touch that the mud POKENAME stomps through freezes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME flies above polar regions, watching over what it deems as its territory. The ice crystals on its body segments can be fired off as projectiles, freezing solid those they manage to connect with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME move incredibly slowly, yet are absurdly strong and exude an air so cold they are constantly clad in ice as well. A single POKENAME can lift a glacier of solid ice over thrice its own size with ease, let alone break it with a single strike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scale icy cliffs by rapidly extending their arms and hooking their claws into the ice. In battle, they charge at their foes, leaping to strike with their horns and springing back from the recoil of the caps on their heads.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Despite its habit of stealing snow-climbing gear, Explorers often team up with POKENAME to help scale dangerous cliff faces.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its rough looks and mannerisms, POKENAME is not a fossil Pokémon. Studies have found that these ferocious and flightless creatures lived alongside early humans during ancient times, but evolutionary paths split later on.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Perhaps one of the oldest Fusion discoveries. Although POKENAME's tusks and talons are coated in thick ice, they burn hot enough to puncture stone, even some metals. It's a fierce fighter both on land and airborne and lives in isolation.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME hides beneath a thin layer of snow and patiently waits for its prey to approach before attacking. It is a fierce fighter, using its sturdy fangs and powerful tail to swiftly overpower its opponents with precision and strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are incredibly resilient Pokémon that can endure sub-zero temperatures. If frozen solid, they easily break free with a single strike from their massive tusks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lurk around frozen yogurt stores, attempting to steal as much as they can hold. If they live in an area higher than 32 degrees Fahrenheit, they will melt.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its tusks are hollow, making them less of a burden in flight. They are still as hard as bone, and a POKENAME chasing you from its territory can use its tusks to crush you.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME has a body made of ice and fortified by frozen mud. Its tusks, however, remain clean to act as a threat display.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: Its warm hide and gaping maw appear as a sanctuary to those caught in blizzards. However, POKENAME will steal the vitality of any who venture inside.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME's thick fur coat protects it from the frigid elements of its snow-covered home territory. It hunts during blizzards, using its quick speed to strike at prey while visibility is minimal due to the heavy snow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the tusk it holds as an ice pick to gracefully climb and dance on mountain walls and cliffs. By tapping the tusks on its head with its held tusk, it creates melodic sounds that it uses to create its songs.
author: soup1900

entry: While hard to see from the outside, POKENAME carries a large mushroom on its back. The encasing ice both protects it and provides it with moisture.
author: dylonk25

entry: These Pokémon only live atop the tallest mountains with the thickest of snowfalls. None can forever break the ice upon their bodies, and the few escape a clash unscathed by either their claws or their extremely tough tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carries an ice hammer used to batter away foes, no matter their weight, alongside it at all times. It excels in freezing environments where its icy armor can grow and thicken to become an impenetrable shield all over its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME live at the bottom of icy mountains, where the wind won't distract them from seeing into the future. Unfortunately, Spheal often roll down these same mountains, bumping into POKENAME and breaking their focus.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: In the winter, POKENAME purposely freeze themselves in lakes to hibernate. If you disrupt this natural occurrence, the Pokémon will likely pass.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Their horns and tusks are made of solid ice and can gouge solid rock without chipping. When angered, they will stomp their heavy feet and their humps "erupt" with snow and ice.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME shoot frosty snow from their staves by harnessing the power of their headaches. They are often easy to anger because of the constant pain they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Modern-day POKENAME bears little evidence of its once-mighty ice tusks. Theories suggest the flame burning within its body has melted them away.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This variant of POKENAME thrived during the ice age, enduring the harshest winters in history thanks to its fierce internal flame.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This domesticated POKENAME variant is a popular partner for those in cold climates. It sleeps comfortably in blizzards.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME has been domesticated and part of arctic cultures for millennia for their warm hearts and warmer breath. Archaeologists debate over whether a tamed POKENAME was humanity's first source of controlled fire.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Although seen in other climates, most POKENAME are inhabitants of colder environments. They are known for charging at anything that intrudes upon their territory and will use their horns to throw rocks, snow, or ice collected during a charge.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found in regions ranging widely in climate, from the coldest tundra to volcanic ranges reaching several hundred degrees. Their massive antlers allow them to dig up and roll boulders, snow and even tree trunks while charging at foes.
author: chibitales

entry: The flames streaming from the bodies of POKENAME are cold to the touch, sapping heat from anything they come into contact with. Though they're strong and reliable, the risk of hypothermia means it's not advisable to ride them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are excellent at finding their way through mountains during intense blizzards. They pull carriages for medical personnel so they can easily find the wounded lost in the mountains.
author: bigoljax

entry: A POKENAME's bushy fur remains surprisingly warm despite the frigid cold environs that serve as their habitats. Their legs and hooves are strong enough to break through sizeable rocks, if their tough tusks do not first succeed.
author: infinex21

entry: Their strong legs and sharp talons allow them to remain steady even as they run across ice. Their three beaks can easily break through solid ice, and by using their three sets of tusks they can quickly dig up buried foods or prey.
author: infinex21

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME unleash a torrent of icy water that freezes quickly. Once their target is frozen, they smash through the ice with their huge tusks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME submerge one of their claws in freezing cold water until a massive ice block forms around it. They swing and slam this icy claw-hammer at anything that approaches.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME has an encyclopedic knowledge regarding plant care, so it is a common partner for gardeners. Unfortunately, it can become erratic and mixes up what conditions different plants prefer, so owners must keep a close watch on it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses a peculiar silk to link programs together to create its nest. Programs connected by this silk are somehow prone to errors and require frequent maintenance.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME has a large appetite, devouring virtual data by the terabyte daily. When well trained, they are used by software developers to destroy malware and old data, but wild POKENAME can be a menace to data centers.
author: notadoctor75

entry: Additional software installed on POKENAME causes it to move around oddly, almost teleporting forward and back instead of rolling. It may explode without anything stimulating it due to how queasy it gets from its own movements.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is numb to all forms of stimuli due to its sensory functions being defunct. Explosions from this Pokémon are good for its health, as the blast releases corrupted data stored within its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are typically attracted to large servers, consuming every bit of stored data within them. When their bodies begin to glitch, it is a sign they are about to rupture and eject the digested, unusable data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are typically attracted to large servers, consuming every bit of stored data within them. When their bodies begin to glitch, it is a sign they are about to rupture and eject the digested, unusable data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME travel through cyberspace by taking rides on emails being sent through data streams. If the email they are riding on is opened, they explode, releasing viruses and destroying all programs caught in the blast.
author: soup1900

entry: Each egg in the clutch has a unique appearance and a distinct personality. Because of the many differing psyches in the group, they have difficulty cooperating as a single unit.
author: sk372

entry: Once POKENAME finds a computer filled with files, it will remain on the screen swaying its leaves back and forth while absorbing them as nourishment. This causes widespread malfunctions across the computer as it feasts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's skull helmet is partially corrupted, affecting its general behavior. Touching anything with the glitched bone it wields has a high chance of corrupting and ruining its data.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is able to manipulate the length and weight of any of its segments, including the "bone" it carries. It will intrusively insert itself in any video gaming software, becoming part of the game as a giant enemy boss, no matter the genre.
author: beatdoof

entry: The large bone it wields is an extension of itself that can intercept and absorb EM waves. It can lift this bone with ease despite its size and swing it with enough force to shatter a large, solid boulder.
author: infinex21

entry: Additional software has affected POKENAME's movement patterns, causing it to act sporadically. Despite not having visible legs, it delivers power kicks feels as though invisible limbs are still present.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME moves unpredictably in battle, changing from slow to erratic abruptly. Its sporadic punches leave glitch-like trails, striking foes before they can react and disturbing nearby electronics.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME's tongue acts as a tether to the ground when extended. It uses its tongue to hold its body steady and keep it from floating away or being whisked away by external forces.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can release gases made of malicious coding into computers that causes them to receive critical system errors and crash. While it normally relegates this behavior, being inside of hot devices forces the gases to expand and burst out.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's striking colours seem to momentarily separate and misalign when it feels threatened. This erratic visual stutter makes it incredibly difficult for hungry predators to track its movements.
author: eiskitsune

entry: The pieces of POKENAME's uneven cocoon will occasionally fly off before rearranging themselves. Those who've seen what's underneath during this time all give conflicting reports on the shape of the creature.
author: sk372

entry: All of POKENAME's gases, organs, and programs are stored in the Dubious Disc its two heads are connected to. Since the right head is limited in its capabilities, all it does is mix toxins and produce data while the left head does everything else.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME breathes by absorbing data from computer files it attaches to and releasing it as a gas. However, since the two heads don't alternate inflating and deflating, it uses the data extremely inefficiently.
author: soup1900
