entry: When the horn on POKENAME's head rotates clockwise, it causes nearby image files to distort. Oddly, rotating the horn in the other direction returns the images to normal.
author: .izik

entry: The horn on its head functions like a powerful drill. Malicious hackers have been known to use it to break through firewalls.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME has a strange quirk that makes it a nuisance to deal with. Upon attempts to remove it from a computer, it will cause every other function to freeze or lag until its deletion process is complete, which takes an agonizingly long time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's singular spiral eye works as a hypnotic tool, rotating rapidly in place to send those who look at it into a trance. Its many vines then ensnare the target so POKENAME can drag them off to parts unknown.
author: sk372

entry: Sometimes, a glitch will pass through POKENAME's body and cause the child to be teleported some distance away. POKENAME goes into a flailing panic until it can locate its child again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME preys on Trainers' trust by disguising itself as a regular Horsea. When given the chance, it will take control of all of a Trainer's devices.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME makes itself look elegant by shaping its cyberframe fins to look exactly like those of popular in-style dresses. To be as fashionable as possible, it infiltrates the computers of fashion companies to steal and copy their unreleased designs.
author: soup1900

entry: The horn on POKENAME's head releases a signal that causes nearby computers to malfunction. These malfunctions can persist for days after it leaves the area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's extremely distorted form causes it to fly in a very erratic pattern, glitching from one place to the next. Its wings emit particles when they flap that can cause machinery touched by them to malfunction.
author: sk372

entry: While the rest of POKENAME's body is susceptible to being purged by antivirus software, the core at its center is immune. This allows it to infinitely regenerate and fill a computer with lots of its junk data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can remotely access and control any computer in the world by sending signals from the core at its center. Any device that receives a red core signal instruction will self-destruct within seconds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME places down digital barriers in order to partition off sections of a computer's hard drive. It can manipulate data to create any object it wants in cyberspace, but the items all disappear into nothingness once it enters the physical world.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's arm blades are able to cut down any virus it encounters with a single swing. However, it must be careful, as striking non-malicious data and programs will cause them to become buggy.
author: sk372

entry: While swaying its body, POKENAME releases an almost human-like tone through any connected speakers. Prolonged exposure can cause short-term madness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME channels powerful electrical blasts through its detached arms. These blasts can be strong enough to send a truck flying.
author: .izik

entry: The fire POKENAME breathes out has a strange pixelated appearance. Those who linger near the warmth of its fire begin experiencing strong feelings of nostalgia.
author: sk372

entry: With its three powerful horns, POKENAME tears holes between the real world and cyberspace in search of prey. It is assumed the process of moving between the two realms is disorienting, leading to it often wearing a frightening, wide-eyed expression.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME is both quick to anger and mentally unpredictable. Only patient and skilled Trainers and ranchers are able to tame their bizarre nature.
author: trismon55555

entry: POKENAME uses its frantic splashing to quickly hop between files inside a computer system. While it can infect computers with viruses and malware, they are too weak and slow to ever make a noticeable impact.
author: soup1900

entry: Detached fragments of POKENAME's body float alongside its wings in an erratic, stuttering orbit. When it rapidly beats its wings, these fragments have been noted to orbit with a higher intensity.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME feed on loose data to synthesise computer viruses in their stingers that can cause minor glitches. Hackers often feed them specific lines of code to create specialised viruses.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME forcefully ejects large amounts of data from the openings in its body to dash through different dimensions. If kept in digital realms, it would attack every fragment of data until the entire network collapses.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is happy to ferry others across bodies of water, but riding on it is a gamble; at any point it may glitch out and teleport to a different body of water, in some cases in a completely different region.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's transformations into other objects and Pokémon are extremely unstable and have lots of mistakes in them. The errors range vary from limbs being the wrong size, shape, rotation, or color to having extra, missing, or misplaced body parts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's unstable body is extremely reactive to Evolution stones. Even without touching one, proximity can cause different portions to detach and temporarily alter in shape and color without triggering evolution.
author: .izik

entry: The glowing data fields around POKENAME's neck are unique to each individual. These lights glow particularly bright when it spots a virus within a computer.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are frequently found on malware-infected computers, offering to speed up your PC for free. It's not recommended to feed them.
author: skinstealers

entry: POKENAME originally functioned like an ad algorithm that was too fast to close, forcing users to view ads. It now uses ad pop-ups to block opponents, like it once blocked users' cursors.
author: slimninja55

entry: POKENAME uses the green wires from its body to infuse computer files with volts of electricity so that they shock the device user when clicked on. However, it can't control how much power it pumps into these files, so it sometimes fries the device.
author: soup1900

entry: While POKENAME consumes data on a computer, the device begins to overheat. It prevents the system from automatically shutting down during this process, eventually rendering it unusable after prolonged exposure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a digital mess of parts of Porygon and Porygon-Z adhered together by corrupted data. POKENAME is very erratic and can be found in cyberspace where it corrupts data around it.
author: equation8573

entry: POKENAME invades computers and begins filling them with subtle propaganda messages. These messages are meant to compel users to love and praise it and all Omanyte-related fusions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mere presence on the screen has a strange hypnotic effect. Those who view it feel compelled to worship and obsess over it and any other Omastar fusions.
author: sk372

entry: Remaining almost completely motionless, POKENAME devotes all its energy to processing previously consumed code. During this dormant state, it rewrites its viral signature to compile a highly complex computer corrupting agent.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME commandeers firewalls from computers to add as protective layers for its sturdy shell. As soon as it is found inside a device, it makes itself scarce, making it a difficult species to study and observe.
author: soup1900

entry: Utilizing potent technology, this clever program puppets a hard-light creation shaped like an extinct species, keeping itself safe all the while.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME are displayed in various paleontology museums to mimic the actions of Aerodactyl. However, their bodies often glitch out when mimicking bones, scaring visitors.
author: bigoljax

entry: The binary code on POKENAME's mouth and stomach seem to be the programming of their digestive systems. This helps it consume viruses and malware more easily.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's body constantly leaks out excessive binary code. Its presence inside computers fills them up with junk data, slowing down their performance until they freeze up completely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME reroutes all power inside of laptops to the keyboards so they electrocute the user when pressing down on a key. It hides its presence inside devices by forming clouds of textureless objects to cover the whole screen.
author: soup1900

entry: The embers of POKENAME are quick to grow and spread throughout cyberspace as they quickly burn up code to keep alight. POKENAME flaps its wings as fast as possible to spread these embers and severely burn out every device it enters.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME severely overheats the device it's in to help heal itself from injuries. It is forced to relocate after it fully heals due to the device it was just in becoming nonfunctional.
author: soup1900

entry: If spotted in a computer, POKENAME gifts its observer with a packet of old data it found before running off. In some cases, the data has been top-secret info that none are sure how POKENAME could possibly have come to possess.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can control the heating and fan systems of computers and causes them to rapidly turn on and off to corrode them. It supercharges the power of its attacks by sucking code into its orbs and converting them into energy.
author: soup1900

entry: By absorbing an excessive amount of data from a machine, POKENAME is able to fly through any hazardous condition without harm. This data siphoning causes havoc to the device and makes it dangerous to use.
author: soup1900

entry: While the additional upgrades of POKENAME were supposed to enhance its abilities to help people, they have had the opposite effect. Anyone it's hugged becomes crushed, and attempts to save drowning people instead accelerate their doom.
author: soup1900

entry: While the additional upgrades of POKENAME were supposed to enhance its abilities to help people, they have had the opposite effect. Anyone it's hugged becomes crushed, and attempts to save drowning people instead accelerate their doom.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's stingers are filled with a corrupting virus that acts like poison for a computer system. With a single sting, the poison it injects will quickly seep into the motherboard, causing it to permamently shut down in a matter of minutes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's code is extremely corrupted as its body is constantly splicing and manipulating its data at all times. This extreme instability causes it to become violent and fire off attacks at anything it even slightly dislikes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's code is extremely corrupted as its body is constantly splitting and changing its data at all times. This extreme instability causes it to become violent and fire off attacks at anything it even slightly dislikes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME takes all of its processing power to focus and smash code together into one big corrupted ball of code. Any device hit by this ball has all of its data scrambled and randomly spliced back together into incomprehensible messes.
author: soup1900

entry: These Pokémon were supposedly created from data that would have otherwise been discarded. Reportedly, attempts to repair their software have been made, but they have proven too erratic and elusive to finalize.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses its tail to connect to, and interact with, machines and data servers. There was a time that this Pokémon was tamed and used its abilities to improve data flow for businesses, but something caused it to go haywire.
author: infinex21

entry: The aroma POKENAME releases from its leaf causes minor visual glitches in any nearby computer monitor. These distortions last only briefly and have no effect on the files within.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME store analytical data on various scents within the bud-like packets around their neck. They utilize this information to produce various smells to elicit emotional responses from their Trainers, such as pepping them up.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through the petals around its neck. When it is low on energy, it causes cellphones in its immediate vicinity to display a low battery message even when fully charged.
author: .izik

entry: It is advised not to bother POKENAME should it appear on one's computer. It is rather jumpy, and surprising it may cause it to flare up the flames on its back and wind up incinerating important documents or data.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's back flares with virtual flame whenever it is threatened, though the flame has no heat to it. When its foe rears back at the sudden flash, POKENAME will attack its opponent erratically, using a mix of real flames and claws.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME will randomly blow up in flames and hurt itself in the process without any reason or warning. With how unstable its flames are, many Trainers try everything they can to keep the flames as small and weak as possible.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME operate in cyberspace to shred old files from employees who leave a company. Businesses have to be careful when relying on POKENAME because they will also clear operating system files if the settings are on.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once POKENAME attaches a computer file onto one of its spines, it becomes impossible to retrieve without ripping the data in half. Since it doesn't have any teeth, it instead flips its floating head around and uses its spines to bite prey.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME causes any computer it stings to repeatedly blue screen a few minutes after each reboot. When it is inside of a computer, each jab it does with its large stingers teleports the clicker on screen to its location.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME creates a network from the computer it claims as its home to every electronic device it travels between. To establish and ensure strong network connections, it destroys the firewalls and antivirus software of these devices.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uncontrollably changes stance from standing on its hind legs to getting down on all fours when its head twitches and shakes violently. Its mind momentarily turns blank after this shift, leading it to mindlessly destroy objects in confusion.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME makes its home in older computers, watching for viruses. When it spots one, it lets out a chirp-like noise, unintentionally releasing a signal that deletes nearby files in its attempt to remove the threat.
author: .izik

entry: Computers that POKENAME has infected will repeatedly show pictures of escalators. People who try to find this Pokémon will always find one on or near an escalator.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can control the clocks on computer devices by speeding up, slowing down, or even reversing the time systems, causing them to show wildly incorrect times. This power derives from its absolute lack of rhythm and faulty sense of time.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's head flips around constantly as it messes with code in a computer and disrupts its ability to process. It rarely thinks when going into a battle and instead constantly fires off beams to potentially hit any foes in its path.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME communicate to other POKENAME by creating clusters of garbage data in computers that only they can understand. When together with others, it fires Tri Attack to overwhelm and scare its foes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME changes the icons of every application and menu of a device it's in to a star since it believes that gives it more power. When in cyberspace, it creates floating, digital arms so it can overwhelm firewalls with a barrage of punches.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lays webs in front of high-traffic data streams to catch the large data packets that pass by. If anything gets caught in the web, a ping is sent out that alerts POKENAME of its catch no matter whether it's in that device or not.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attaches digital trackers onto computer programs so that it can always know where they go and what data they come across. Its feet have tiny hooks on them that allow it to sneakily grab data as it crawls over them.
author: soup1900

entry: When devices are set on night mode, POKENAME aggressively chases down and hunts data moving across computers without relent. Its favorite type of data to feed on is live feed from videos, which it catches by spewing sticky threads from its mouth.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can only fly in the real world for a few seconds before crashing into the ground since the majority of their wings are made of corrupted data. They're a master of stealth in cyberspace, only able to be detected by a few specialized programs.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME enhances its flyIng capabilities by spouting computer code from its two wings. While it has limbs and claws to grab prey, it often forgets they exist and instead risks firing Hyper Beam at prey to stop them instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME takes a large network server as its home and territory. It constantly watches the flow of data into the server and hunts down the big packets that get sent in.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can often be found deep in undersea trenches, flashing their antennas into the darkness to transmit messages to unknown recipients. All attempts to process and decode these messages have resulted in corruption of the device used.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME can make any device it is in have its screen brightness so high that it cannot be looked at without eye pain. The orbs on its head are used to emit intense rays of blue light to strain the eyes of foes and give it an easy escape.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are dangerous beings in cyberspace due to the constant threat of them discharging electricity and shocking integral computer parts. Using their tails, they insert small bits of junk data into programs to slightly bloat their storage sizes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME float through the air without regard for gravity. For much of their lives, they are seldom upright.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While POKENAME is singing loudly, nearby electronics begin to spark uncontrollably. Any device that survives this process usually has its data completely formatted.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes on the appearance of a digital egg, searching for someone to care for it. After being cared for long enough, it "hatches," inadvertently releasing glitched data and causing harm to the caretaker's computer in the process.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME sees someone staring at a cellphone with a frown, it grows worried and flies in circles above their head to cheer them up. Unfortunately, this tends to cause the phone to shut down, regularly worsening their mood.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME reaches hard-to-access spots in cyberspace by hopping off fast-moving data packets. Its round nose is perfect for pecking at certain lines of code and removing some words to entirely change their functions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is said to see not only into the future, but into strange parallel universes as well. Its head will vibrate and rotate erratically when its mind glimpses into one of these alternate realities.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can absorb coding and programs into its wool, causing it to become very large and stuffy. If this wool is then shed, hundreds of gigabytes of garbage data suddenly appear, dumped inside the computer it was in.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its cyberframe hair to net large prey it hunts down. Its top speed is unknown since any speedometer or tracker used on or programmed into it is corrupted as soon as it takes flight.
author: soup1900

entry: The floating blue orb that follows POKENAME is filled with data it absorbs while traveling through cyberspace. The orb carries a high electrical charge, making even brief contact with it a painful experience.
author: .izik

entry: The light on its tail flickers sporadically, flashing at random light levels each time. As it cannot communicate using the flashes itself, POKENAME changes the color and hue of its light to express its thoughts.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME dances, its leaves rub together and create an annoying static sound that is painful to listen to. The flowers on its head only opens when exposed to blue light; they stay shut even when exposed to strong sunshine.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME always expects to be above the water's surface due to its large, buoyant tail. Because of this, it freezes up and can't process what's happening around it for a whole day if it gets pulled under.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME forgets to swim, it uses its tail as a float, but since most of the tail is just a cyberframe, it sinks like a rock to the bottom. However, in cyberspace, this digital tail gives it the buoyancy to float above and bypass firewalls.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME hears a sound it hasn't heard before, it freezes in place and takes until the next day to catalogue the new sound in its brain. The most dangerous part of POKENAME is its tail since it's capable of unleashing powerful attacks at random.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME mimic the firewalls and antivirus software of computers in order to remain safe and untouched by those same programs. However, their inability to copy data correctly makes them easy to spot fakes, especially once a virus scan has been run.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME travels through data streams in order to meet and recruit Pokémon into its clan worldwide. Before leaving, it creates remote access points inside of computer systems to be able yell commands through the speakers from any location it wants.
author: soup1900

entry: While floating high above meadows, POKENAME releases a flurry of irritating beeps from its body. These beeps only become melodic when more than 25 are present in the same area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has digital petals on its head that it uses to absorb the blue light from computers, which causes device screens to have no brightness. Since it likes being inside of hot computers, it shuts off the cooling systems for any device it's in.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME is free of all the spores on its body that are made of viruses and malware, it can act and think clearly and normally like other Pokémon. Unfortunately, this almost never happens since the virus spores spread back to it and grow again.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can connect to computers and click on applications to nibble on them, but its jitteriness makes it impossible to aim correctly. To counteract this, it opens dozens of windows on the device screen at once so it always can click on something.
author: soup1900

entry: A Pokémon favored by elite programmers, POKENAME has a very two-sided behavioral pattern, common coding resulting in it being quite lethargic. Other versions exhibit much more violent tendencies, so it's often saved only for emergency debugging.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME have to stay hidden from antivirus software while nibbling on data since it's too weak to defend itself. It sometimes becomes twitchy and shakes its leaves rapidly, releasing corrupted data and drawing attention to itself.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME frantically moves inside of computers and absorbs all the code it can before being kicked out by an antivirus. With so many computers existing, it never stops to rest, causing it to sometimes go berserk and harm others in a sudden outburst.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its high speed to its advantage against firewalls and antivirus software, making them miss and delete data files when trying to remove it. It uses its fast wing beats to blow away incoming data packets entering the device it's in.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will download the data of anything it encounters. As it stores more and more, it begins to leak a sticky liquid and slow down. A dedicated Trainer must give it regular ice baths to keep it fighting fit.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME will download the data of anything it encounters. As it stores more and more, it begins to leak a sticky liquid and slow down. A dedicated Trainer must give it regular ice baths to keep it fighting fit.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME has been known to spend hours simply loading up its next action or program. While its abilities aren't particularly noteworthy, trainers report a sense of comfort when seeing this Pokémon idling on their screens.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME stares at the moon at night to absorb its light. This allows it to generate electricity within its body, though prolonged exposure can cause its form to separate and distort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spoofs emails it sends out to users by pretending to be a website they use and trust in order to lure them into clicking on its links and download malware on their devices. It typically targets new, high-end computers over older ones.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is highly intelligent, but its mind works in an almost incomprehensible way. It will dispense weird and strange advice to others, yet following these oddball instructions almost always leads to good fortune.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an encyclopedic knowledge regarding plant care, so it is a common partner for gardeners. Unfortunately, it can become erratic and mixes up what conditions different plants prefer, so owners must keep a close watch on it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The pursuit of knowledge has led POKENAME to be infected by a virtual virus which has greatly enhanced its abilities while also corrupting incoming data. POKENAME uses its vines to absorb new data, deleting it in its original storage in the process.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME constantly consumes digital streams to satisfy its endless appetite for raw data. Its segmented tail is composed entirely of optimised code, which acts as a powerful antenna to intercept new files to consume.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME messes with any electronic it finds to frighten the device's owner and cause them to panic. It will even go as far as hacking digital accounts and erasing data just to create a scare.
author: soup1900

entry: Many believe that POKENAME has the ability to mind control anyone who looks into its eye. This is false, however; doing so only makes you feel sleepy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Using the data they collect from the vast variety of websites they visit daily, POKENAME attempt to help users by answering their questions. More often than not however, POKENAME's answers contain conflicting or entirely incorrect information.
author: chibitales

entry: For ages past, tales of POKENAME sightings have existed among the residents of Cinnabar Island. Accounts vary, but all who claimed to witness it agree it is something that simply should not be.
author: sk372

entry: Any data POKENAME steals from computers can be accessed and retrieved back through its tail, so it protects it at all costs. If it ever faints while being within a device, all files and programs in the electronic gets wiped out with it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME creates a holographic interface over part of its body to make it appear more like a Girafarig. Due to buggy code, the hologram can only fit on part of its form, and even then, it is prone to visual glitches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has two heads; however, one of the brains is filled with malware that causes it to respond opposite to the other. It likes to place digital locks on important files that can only be opened if one of its impossible riddles is solved.
author: soup1900

entry: An upgrade was attempted on this Pokémon, but something went wrong and it got partially corrupted. The two sides often fight with each other.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: It covers itself in garbage data to protect the real data inside. While this strategy is effective, it uses a lot of storage on the computer it's in.
author: soup1900

entry: When inserted into the digital world, this Pokémon takes control of its Trainer's files and denies access from any device until it receives the requested amount of Berries. It is said that its defenses are impenetrable.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME often appear to Trainers while they are using the internet, advertising about life with Dunsparce. There has been a documented correlation between POKENAME sightings and an increase in households that have Dunsparce.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Once POKENAME clings onto a computer, it doesn't let go until the device has been drained of all its code. Since its wings are just a cyberframe, it can't glide well unless it's inside cyberspace.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can chew through the walls of partitioned drives and force their data and storage to combine. Absorbing data is how it grows more body segments, but that sometimes leads to it integrating malware into itself.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME spots a virus in a computer, it grows incredibly irate and flails its disembodied arms in all directions. It refuses to do anything else until it senses the problem is being addressed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings will fly away from its body when it flaps them too fast, forcing it to chase them down to get them back. Many larger Pokémon do not attempt to take over POKENAME's territory out of fear of being blasted by a powerful Hyper Beam.
author: soup1900

entry: Upon growing frustrated over even minor problems, POKENAME flies into a tantrum. During this time, it releases a field of energy that causes nearby computers to malfunction.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fires needle-like spikes that can fit through the tiny vulnerabilities of online security systems and wipe out the data they're protecting. To regrow its spikes, it must suck in hundreds of gigabytes of data into its body.
author: soup1900

entry: By clamping both claws onto a server, POKENAME is able to absorb the data within as nourishment. The harder it grips, the faster the transfer becomes.
author: .izik

entry: Its two pincers appear to move independently from the rest of its body. It is theorized that each of them has its own artificial intelligence.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME regularly consumes files related to fruit that it finds on the internet before returning to the real world. Oddly, this consumed data converts into an extremely bitter juice after being stored within its shell for long periods.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's twitchiness causes it to accidentally bash foes around with its horn before being able to successfully scoop and throw them around. This inability to fully control its body sometimes leads to it hurling itself miles away by mistake.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spins its sharp, disembodied claws in circles around its body to attack. These claws are constantly maintained at well below freezing temperatures.
author: .izik

entry: Even when it is not in an electronic device, it manifests as a computer window and displays a game involving an oddly-behaving Ursaring. It seems that on rare occasions POKENAME can display an entirely different game.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has an odd fascination with volcanoes and magma, constantly scouring the internet for media of them. Once it finds this data, it causes any connected webpage to distort while it consumes the image or video.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's extremely slow movement makes many assume it is completely immobile at first glance. Its slowness actually extends to electronics in its vicinity, their operating speed slowing to a crawl until POKENAME is removed from their vicinity.
author: sk372

entry: It will overheat any computer it enters. Any data it passes through will melt, corrupting it and making it unusable.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME exist in digital spaces, soaring across the world through computer code and manifesting in the internet. They are territorial and will fight with one another, causing glitches and crashes in computers, much to the frustration of programmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite there being no smells in cyberspace, POKENAME still tries to sniff out hidden data files to no success. If an aroma overwhelms its nose, it accidentally fires off a Tri Attack when it sneezes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are unable to live in devices with volume levels above 25% since their ears are too sensitive due to outdated coding. By pressing their noses up against the digital walls of cyberspace, they can smell objects from the outside world.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME purposely breaks off its own branches and leaves them behind in computers so that they grow into terrible viruses. To accelerate the regrowth of its branches, it stands in front of device screens to bathe in blue light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME casts digital targets onto others to clearly mark its next victim. However, it sometimes twitches when it takes the shot, causing the powerful Hyper Beam it fires to miss completely and obliterate the surrounding terrain instead.
author: soup1900

entry: Its detached limbs rotate around it randomly, but can synchronize in battle to defend itself from all sides. Even its cannon mouth can detach from its head to fire at foes from unorthodox angles.
author: sk372

entry: An unusual software update began circulating. Upon downloading it, POKENAME began delivering messages with hidden malware to unsuspecting Trainers.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME may seem like a nice Pokémon, always sending out hearted emojis and happily letting people pet it while it swims. However, this is all just to infiltrate a person's device and freeboot off their Wi-Fi and cellular data plans.
author: soup1900

entry: Its feathers are lenses that every few days "reflect" the events of a mysterious stadium, showing people playing football and a large crowd noisily cheering. However, no stadium like the one shown seems to exist within this world.
author: epping_forest

entry: The flame on POKENAME's back flickers in and out of existence at random. It's a bit problematic if it flares up while it's inside a computer, as it causes the computer's core to rapidly heat up.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a dangerous threat when it wanders cyberspace, as a hovering mouse over it leads to wild fury. In this anger, it incinerates all software of the computer beyond repair before entering the real world and doing the same to the hardware.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can easily sneak past any firewall and slither through any antivirus to infiltrate any computer it wants. Many hackers when starting out use this Pokémon to infect computers due to how easy and convenient it is to train.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME creates digital scale-like items when it absorbs data and distributes them out as attachments in emails. When that scale file is opened by the recipient, a trojan program activates, starting a huge tornado that sucks in and jumbles up code.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME curls into a ball, instead of rolling, it strangely bounces around without ever rotating. Its charging tackle is powerful enough to shatter through the digital walls of cyberspace and cause data inside the device to quickly eject out.
author: soup1900

entry: Thanks to the fusion, Porygon has patched most of the glitches and errors that made Porygon-Z. However, it still keeps some of its signature insanity.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME causes anyone looking at it inside of their computers to become absorbed at their screens, unable to look away as if glued to them. People who have fallen for its trance are reported to have poor sleep due to their extended screen times.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME collects text from across the internet within its body. It can use its tail to paint this text over existing text elsewhere, making the result entirely unintelligible.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's lack of limbs and disjointed hands and feet give it a very unique combat style. It avoids blows with erratic movements and uses its floating limbs to specialize in grappling and throwing opponents.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spins counterclockwise inside a computer, any program or page trying to load starts reversing its progress. On the other hand, spinning clockwise overclocks electronics past what it can handle, causing them to overheat and crash.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rapidly rotate their floating hands in order to build up static and broadcast signals to act as a sentient wi-fi hotspot. While the provided wi-fi runs quickly, anything connected to it will glitch out and rapidly lose battery.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are vicious Pokémon, taking revenge on anyone who dares to refuse to help the “Basilisk,” as they call themselves. Any electrical device connected to the infested one through a power line or router will be irreparably damaged as a result.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Milk produced by POKENAME has a random, distinct flavor with every sip. Sometimes, the milk will taste rotten, which led to a somewhat popular roulette party game involving its cheese.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME acts as a living phishing attack that steals private information from anyone who clicks on it. Victims of POKENAME have their private info and login information posted to public forums.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME hijacks a user's computer in an attempt to block their files and scam them out of their funds. Interestingly, it tends to target naive cyber-criminals and distribute the swindled money towards underfunded hospitals.
author: sk372

entry: The lightning bolts shot by POKENAME tend to fly upwards for some reason instead of crashing down. If it dashes around too fast, it will suddenly run in place repeatedly for a few seconds before continuing normally again.
author: soup1900

entry: Strangely, POKENAME's form resembles prototype designs for Porygon found in old Silph Co. records. It exhibits a regal persona, and will burn the data of those who it feels aren't treating it with proper respect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ribbons will change the appearance of bodies of water they touch, making them look like liquid static. The change seems entirely visual, but Porygon-related fusions tend to flock to these lakes after the alteration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can spray water on computer programs to purify them of bugs and delete their metadata. However, this sometimes leads to it removing digital securities on those files, making them susceptible and visible to all on the internet.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME must eat over 10 gigabytes of code in order to have enough data to evolve. While it typically eats any kind of data without care, it won't eat the data of pictures that include families for some reason.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is such a powerful piece of malware that it is capable of corrupting both the digital and material world.
author: napstabl0ok

entry: POKENAME can use its hands to tremble the digital walls of cyberspace, and even cause them to collapse entirely. With all the data that leaks out of computers after it does this, it gains plenty of empty room to build its nest and home.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's shrill and distorted cry is powerful enough to be visible as strange, off-color sound waves in the air. Its cry causes the ocean currents and waves to behave strangely.
author: sk372

entry: While flying through the sky, POKENAME's wings periodically distort, changing shape and sometimes vanishing entirely. This somehow has no effect on its trajectory or speed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have an extreme fixation on their Trainers. To avoid being released, they will attach themselves to crucial files.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Any line of code on a device that doesn't have a hex color code applied to it will have one assigned by POKENAME. POKENAME's frantic need to color everything wastes lots of processing power to load the colors and bloats the sizes of files.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can revive nonfunctional devices and have them running again, but only with the capabilities to overload servers with denial-of-service attacks. It attaches the hex colors of the rainbow as metadata to every computer file it comes across.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's appearance causes software to glitch in ways consistent with temporal displacement. Attempts to harness this effect have yet to bear fruit.
author: staghorn

entry: Updates to POKENAME caused its body to become where the tail should be, leaving the body lacking data. Anything that causes it confusion or sadness leads to it freezing in place, unable to do anything until it sleeps and wakes up the next day.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME squeezes data files against its body to study them intensely and copy all their information into its brain. Unfortunately, the file afterwards becomes corrupted and unusable due to the data getting crushed up completely.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are infamous among online communities due to a malicious program coded with their likeness. There is a pervasive cultural idea that POKENAME can be annoying. However, Trainers who raise them find them to be helpful, responsive partners.
author: vic1312

entry: A quite literal computer wizard, POKENAME is used as a frontline against net-based sabotage, pinning down and scrambling data as easy as breathing.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Each time POKENAME lays a curse onto foes, they are always random in severity. The effects of them vary largely as well, from sudden twitchy movements to urges to give out all of your personal information and passwords.
author: soup1900

entry: This digital bird Pokémon is nosy and always looking to learn a person's secrets, feigning ignorance to lure them into a false sense of security. Nobody knows who it might share those secrets with.
author: sontyp

entry: While traveling through the internet, POKENAME grows excited when it spots images of forests. It inserts itself into the image among the other trees, though its coloring and constant jittering give it away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to hide in art and game applications. It takes all the code from the software, and incorporates it into their own.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME traverses medical websites in hopes of finding ways to help people. Unfortunately, its mere presence tends to corrupt any files it comes near.
author: .izik

entry: The odd red marking on the end of POKENAME's tail is common for the species. It appears to be related to a common false collective memory regarding Pikachu.
author: ohok3441

entry: Despite its friendly appearance, POKENAME hides a devastating virus that can wipe out entire server farms. Even so, some lonely Trainers have been known to fall for its scam so that they can feel true companionship.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME's cry is scratchy and hard to listen to. Trainers have described it as "bit crushed".
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is able to siphon the electricity from electronics when it touches its tail with the device. If it ever twitches, it will instantly release all of its stored electricity and shock itself to a crisp.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME mashes together many different programs and files into one big hodgepodge of data before stuffing it into its code hole to snack on later. While it can eat over 1 terabyte of data per day, it doesn't get any fatter since it's all digital.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is well-behaved and always seems to be wearing a smile on its face. It rarely makes a sound, however, and most believe its smile is not indicative of its actual mood.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves its mark in every device it enters by slashing at data inside of essential root files to create a corrupted code insignia. It displays impressive cunningness by tricking antivirus software into attacking important programs.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can overload computers with such a high amount of electronic signals and frequencies that they crash and fail to boot back up ever again. It can generate a jammer field with its units to block all online connectivity within a 50 yard radius.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its units to place down jammer fields to block any incoming and outgoing electronic signals for computers. It intercepts and modifies any radio waves it comes by so that they become corrupted when reaching their end destination.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can extend its tongue to be as far out as the Wi-Fi signal it has hijacked can reach. When POKENAME uses its tongue in cyberspace, it leaves behind globs of saliva made of garbage data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME consumes large quantities of data not only to fuel itself, but to provide ammo for combat. Junk data it fails to digest is fired from its palms, the projectiles arcing and twisting in odd and unpredictable ways.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME generates vines by running scripts on computers to download loads of data for it to install on itself. If it accidentally downloads a virus, it rips the vine off its body and abandons it in the device it was in before hopping to the new one.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME touches the tips of its two tails together, it will accidentally let loose thousands of volts of electricity and shock itself. Any data it tries to process becomes corrupted and destroyed once it flows between its horns.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fires plumes of odd flames from both of its hands. Once the fire is launched, it jerks and arcs around in unpredictable angles, making guarding against it difficult.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to appear only in computers that have never once been touched by malware or glitches. Its presence seems to enhance the performance of computers it inhabits, though it never lingers for long.
author: sk372

entry: An attempt to update this Pokémon with a new program went awry, causing it to unceasingly overwrite the mineral data that had been used to create it. In an effort to slow the overwriting, it burrows in search of data cables so it may absorb new data.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a hard time aiming for a foe's weak spot to maximize damage since its twitchiness makes it become shaky. So instead, it blasts out extremely powerful shock waves all over until eventually the foe is hit and obliterated.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME filters bits of data through the leaves on its body to produce energy before dumping the now unusable waste data behind. It uses its tail as a blade to cut internet connectivity from devices and leave them secluded in the digital world.
author: soup1900

entry: The tips of POKENAME's body have darkened due to a quirk in programming that supercharges its own cold abilities. It needs only to touch a computer with one of these limbs to cause it to freeze completely for up to a week.
author: sk372

entry: Once POKENAME sinks its teeth into a computer file, it will not let go until it has drained all the data from it. A quick jab with its tail into an integral device part can cause the device to receive many critical errors and shut down.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has tusks made of such powerful code that they can smash through the digital walls of cyberspace. However, they're only this strong when inside a computer with good cooling systems; they fail to leave a mark when heated.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was forced to evolve with too much data stored in its body, causing it to burst outwards. Pokémon Researcher Bill described it as "missing numbers" in vital parts of its code after examination.
author: qecci

entry: This Pokémon is capable of punching holes in cyberspace, creating direct tunnels from one computer to another, however far the distance may be. These tunnels are too unpredictable to be traveled by humans, but POKENAME can navigate them with ease.
author: victor9106

entry: This self fusion of Porygon-Z is a popular research subject in some circles.  Some theorize the world is a complex simulation.  This fusion is thought to have somehow tapped into the code.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME is a highly dangerous and erratic virtual entity. This self-fusion closely resembles an urban legend. POKENAME is said to possess the ability to teleport.
author: the_smirker

entry: By touching the leaf on its head to a computer, POKENAME can absorb information from the internet directly as sustenance. This causes the computer to overheat and malfunction in the process.
author: .izik

entry: The seeds on POKENAME's back carry a strong electrical charge and are incredibly heavy. When placed near a computer, they can cause any image files inside to become corrupted.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME help their Trainers burn CDs with music and video off the internet, but Trainers need to be specific with what type of burning that occurs. Many Trainers have ended up with burnt plastic instead of a CD with data.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have progressively evolved from feeding on the data, though such mixed data has caused them to become erratic. Their claws are stronger than diamond and their quills are sharper than obsidian.
author: infinex21

entry: Boosters within POKENAME's feet allow it a great amount of speed and mobility. At maximum speed, they allow POKENAME to pummel its opponents with up to 275 kicks in the span of a minute.
author: sk372

entry: Corrupted code flares up more and more around POKENAME's wrists and head as it battles. The code burns others like normal fire, as well as causing mental distress and confusion on contact, making battling it highly disorienting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its floating fin to sense and track when and where new files are being downloaded in the device it's in. Despite its size, it possesses the strength necessary to bash through firewalls and access other computers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME get overexcited if a Trainer appreciates them and will accidentally blast them in the face with a Hyper Beam. Using their immense strength, they smash through holes below data streams to create a place to rest.
author: soup1900

entry: Should the water POKENAME spits come into contact with a computer, it curiously does not fry the system. Instead, the data inside becomes completely corrupted, rendering all files useless.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grows overly excited upon encountering programs related to mathematics for unknown reasons, releasing large psychic bursts in elation. These bursts compel those nearby to use these programs so it can watch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME senses the emotions of anyone touching a computer it inhabits. If it detects an emotion it finds unsettling, it causes any images on screen to distort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's instability causes the miniature black holes it creates to act unpredictably. When used inside cyberspace, they don't absorb data as intended; instead, they release massive amounts of garbage data into the system.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's new programming has caused it to use more power than what it can handle when using attacks. Each time it overuses its energy, it slowly destroys itself, which can be seen by its digital dress shrinking in size.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks whoever approaches its Trainer. It's almost as if it wants its Trainer for only for itself.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME is near impossible to comprehend thanks to the unstable haze around it. Looking at it directly causes headaches and nausea.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME extends a weapon from its hands that resembles a mouse cursor. Tethered to its limb by invisible energy, it deftly wields it to cut down its opponents within cyberspace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's disembodied bladed arms let it attack and defend itself from all sorts of odd angles. The corrupted data comprising the blades causes severe disorientation to Steel-type Pokémon struck by them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has been infected with a terrible computer virus and struggles just to stay operational. Perhaps a blessing and a curse, it is almost immortal.
author: hedaunis

entry: POKENAME gnaws on computer cables to absorb the data and electricity within the system. If disturbed, it retaliates with a painful Poison Sting before fleeing with the cables still in its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's glitched programming causes its camouflage ability to behave in an odd manner. Each limb changes color separately and almost at random, so it is rare for it to manage to completely blend in with its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can often be found blending into the backgrounds of desktop wallpapers. If clicked on too often, it may attempt to crash the computer out of sheer annoyance.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME is highly sensitive to electromagnetic waves. Its eye can see data on electronic devices more clearly than anything in the physical world.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME uses small cyberframe chains to connect with its arms and utilize them as if a part of its body. By creating more of these chains, it's able to connect to and neuropathically link with other peripheral devices as well.
author: soup1900

entry: While POKENAME has the capability to think like a supercomputer, it always seems to make bad or stupid decisions every time. It is believed that its thinking capabilities have been corrupted, preventing it from correctly analyzing the situation.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's storage for memory is completely filled due to faulty updates, so it has to rely on discs to process on. It is very intelligent as long as it has this disc, but as soon as the disc is removed, it begins to act very oddly and blankly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can overexert itself gnawing on the near-limitless amount of data in cyberspace and knock itself out from exhaustion. Even in the face of a strong firewall system, it charges right through without fear.
author: soup1900

entry: Some say that POKENAME's programming was corrupted and possessed by hundreds of abandoned AI programs. It constantly absorbs data into the roiling mass in its center, though it is not known for what purpose.
author: sk372

entry: Many claim POKENAME's body houses 108 different types of malware. The clashing programming within causes it to behave in chaotic, glitchy ways that often lead to it becoming aggressive.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are comprised of many spirits haunting a singular Hard Disk Drive. Often, the drive only contains old, junk data or obsolete programs, but it is precious to the spirits nonetheless.
author: victor9106

entry: When POKENAME passes by electronics, it unknowingly absorbs the electricity which is added to its aura. If it builds this charge too long, it releases a localized electromagnetic pulse which phases the Pokémon into cyberspace.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME scans computers using electrical currents that originate from its fin. Each time it snaps its jaw, nearby files can become corrupted to the point of uselessness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses electrical currents to scan computers in search of viruses to prey on. It slashes at them with its sharp arm fins, sometimes striking healthy programs and causing malfunctions.
author: .izik

entry: The large fin on POKENAME's back stores electrical energy that it uses to scan computers for viruses to consume. Unfortunately, these scans frequently corrupt files in any area it has passed through.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's data core has become contaminated by a virus, corrupting the data but supercharging POKENAME's abilities. If it uses its overclocked abilities too much without retreating to cyberspace, POKENAME will experience a meltdown.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME is attacked by an antivirus software, the barbs on its back spring out and inject the antivirus with a corrupting poison. With the antivirus neutralized, POKENAME can safely chew up the code into an edible garbage data paste.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME bites onto servers to absorb the data within. Any data it leaves behind is rewritten to be entirely useless or riddled with bugs that did not previously exist.
author: .izik

entry: The tendrils surrounding POKENAME's head can circle rapidly to create a vacuum effect. Doing this, it sucks in small prey to be subsumed within the strange liquid material in its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps its tendrils close to its head, appearing to be connected until it spots prey. The sticky tendrils then launch off and seek out their target, dragging it back to the hungry maw of its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are theorized to be from over a million years in the future. They seem to be damaged to a great extent by digital warfare, and are not to be trusted near anything connected to the internet.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME's body starts off as mostly non-textured and weak after evolution, but gains back its red and blue colors and hardens after absorbing data. It hunts inside of data streams, using its huge claws to stab at and grab incoming data packets.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's cranial done tends to pop off of its head after it strikes something, though this is harmless. It can even manipulate the detached crown and use it as a blunt weapon in combat if needed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's charges are dangerous not just because of its strength, but its unpredictability. Mid-charge it may glitch and teleport around, causing the attack to come from a completely different direction its target expects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME infiltrate computers by pretending to be Virtual Privacy Networks, or VPNs, to gain access to all private and hidden files in computers. While they are powerful enough to shield devices against viruses using their faces, they choose not to.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will stand in front of streets and sidewalks to block all moving objects from moving past them. They will charge and crash into anyone who moves in any direction that isn't linear. They have a strange archrivalry to Tyrantrum.
author: soup1900

entry: Though POKENAME has incredible processing power and could finish a mighty task in seconds, it is also incredibly lazy. Even a simple task given to it will take hours or even days to complete.
author: sk372

entry: Naturally friendly and helpful, POKENAME will often try to assist others. Unfortunately, they carry a variety of diseases, so people tend to keep away from them.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's scales help it dodge attacks by shifting parts of its body around and blurring its overall body shape. While it is notorious for corrupting code in cyberspace, it will stop and hide the damage when there are Porygon present.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have some ability to predict disastrous outages of computer systems and data networks, however, this ability is rather inconsistent. Several times in the past, a massive disruption was predicted, only to pass by uneventfully.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME is formed from the data remnants of long-forgotten forums and imageboards. It is attracted to obsolete technology, which it often possesses.
author: occulusmalus

entry: Said to randomly appear during static or a black screen on any visual-facing device, POKENAME's appearance is heralded by random sentences. Scientists are debating whether or not these sentences mean anything at all.
author: beatdoof

entry: The harbinger of EOL for software. Echoes of countless programs of ages past can be heard from within, begging for another chance.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Spotting POKENAME inside cyberspace can be quite troublesome. Its size is so massive that only the most powerful of computers can handle it appearing fully without overloading.
author: sk372

entry: For most computers, POKENAME's presence inside the device will instantly max out its storage cause it to crash. POKENAME is able to swallow every single bit of data in a device in one gulp.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forcefully widens data streams for itself to fit in, which allows viruses to more easily gain access to computer networks. If it loses control of its body and wildly splashes around, it will crush and destroy every file inside a computer.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME passes through digital networks, forums worldwide glitch to repeat the phrase “1,000 Arms.” This phenomenon has become an infamous and irritating modern meme.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's head-crest extends or lowers depending on the amount of computer activity in its vicinity. It is at its healthiest and happiest when many active electronics are surrounding it.
author: sk372

entry: By scanning and analyzing its surroundings, POKENAME can adapt the plants growing on its back to fit any situation.
author: hophoppip

entry: The backs of POKENAME have a vaporwave aesthetic and constantly change as POKENAME moves. If a stranger tries to touch the back, POKENAME will use their disembodied arms to swat at the person.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are unique in the fact that the biome on their back is monochromatic. Older Trainers that look at POKENAME report feeling nostalgic.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME troops rush through the internet, leaving behind broken URLs and errors on webpages wherever they go. They are easily distracted by images of bananas, giving cybersecurity professionals enough time to neutralize their abilities.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hijack the microphones of any device they're inside of to listen in and know of events happening outside. It is rumored that they learned this ability due to governments already listening in on people through their devices for surveillance.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME intimidates foes by expanding the fire of its tail to engulf a living room-sized area and burn the foe to a crisp. It has gained the ability to create its own digital walls to leap from and attack enemies from all directions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can dish out powerful attacks at a fast pace using all its limbs, but if it overworks them, they start to ache and twitch heavily. The flames on its head act as its own firewall to block and destroy any antivirus that tries to attack it.
author: soup1900

entry: Its clumsiness is offset by its ability to float in every direction. It often leaves behind digital afterimages when it travels. Since it is a proud Pokémon, it often squares up against its own mirror images and is shocked when they suddenly vanish.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME likes to overtake any device it enters and change all the code inside to what benefits it the most above all. It diverts all processing power to make its life leisurely, meaning no other program can ever run while it is inside.
author: soup1900

entry: Whenever POKENAME enters a data stream, it creates multitudes of digital ice flakes made of garbage data. It purposely sends large quantities of these flakes to crash the computers of those who wronged it in any way.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's inner compass is completely messed up, meaning it will point in random directions, thinking it's north. Its magnetism sometimes inverts, causing other Nosepass to be attracted to and stick to it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's huge nose allows it to detect viruses from great distances through a sense similar to scent. While consuming them from a computer, it does so without restraint, inadvertently devouring healthy programs in the process.
author: .izik

entry: Its blade is unstable and erratic in nature. What may appear at first as a near miss from its edge can fester into all sorts of odd injuries, and a clean cut can simply vanish like it never happened.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME was further patched with the intent of making the ultimate weapon. However, the sword is too awkward to wield or even look at.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's blades are extremely shattered and prevent it from slashing at foes easily. However, this allows it to use a new strategy of flinging shards around as a distraction before pulling them back together on the foe to shred them to pieces.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can easily block any attack with its shield; however, for some reason, if this shield is hit by an axe, it will temporarily fail to protect POKENAME. In cyberspace, POKENAME's slashes leave behind fast-spreading, corrupted data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses a computer firewall to sharpen its blades while not standing too close to get purged by it. If it becomes too injured to attack physically, it unleashes a flurry of Tri Attack as a last resort tactic.
author: soup1900

entry: Its program was designed to cut down file size, but a programming error caused it to cut the bits themselves, resulting in more garbage data instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can peer through the digital barriers of cyberspace and see events happening in the physical world. When its eyes gleam, it releases a flash of electricity that electrocutes nearby code into unusable junk data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful horns to break through the barricades of password-protected programs to eat the precious data that hides behind them. It is known to fearlessly fight and destroy the best antivirus software to keep control of its device.
author: soup1900

entry: The erratic flapping of POKENAME's wings causes it to jumble data from different sources and fling them in random directions everywhere. As it flies, its wings create sounds of white noise and static that cause pain to anyone who hears it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's programming was modified to stop them from whipping up powerful sandstorms wherever they went. Due to an error, they now incessantly suck in sand and debris like a vacuum.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: While floating across the surface of a lake, POKENAME releases sparks from its body. Its form sometimes jitters uncontrollably, changing the color of the water beneath it into a myriad of different hues.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies across cyberspace at incredible speeds, absorbing data from everything it passes. When it encounters a firewall, it unleashes a beam of energy from its mouth to disable it before continuing its feast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME moves through cyberspace as if it were flying. If it ever becomes enraged, its virtual rampages cause computer servers to catch fire.
author: .jerden

entry: When POKENAME becomes angry, lines of code rush through its body as it becomes empowered and ready to attack anything in its way. The majority of its wings only form when this happens, so it often attacks itself to fuel its rage.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are used as assistants for devices like computer boxes and desktops. However, they can often overwork themselves by doing too many tasks at one time.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME launches minigears to gather and retrieve computer programs. When these files are placed onto its ring gear, it gains their functions and abilities; however, it can only use one at a time, so it revolves the gear to hot-swap between them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sneaks into people's computers, pretending to be a frequently used program. If the user tries to open it, it fully infects their computer, causing all of their data to go haywire and rendering the computer unusable.
author: secondegg

entry: These Pokémon love to prank and scare others with their illusions, which many believe is why parts of their own bodies appear to be like data and glitches. They often make it seem as if they are striking through a screen of some form.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's head is not attached to its body and at times may begin floating away. It uses the ribbons on its body to grab the head before it gets out of reach and becomes lost.
author: sk372

entry: Every time POKENAME enters or leaves cyberspace, it accidentally destroys the device it enters from when its tail twitches and smashes the device. However, if it ever tries to purposely use its tail, it just gives a hug with it instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can flood entire computer networks with so much garbage data that companies must isolate them from the internet for months to be able to clean them out. By expanding data streams into oceans, it can trap over 100 terabytes of flowing data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can be found living in firewalls throughout cyberspace. They have a high body temperature, causing devices that contain them to rapidly overheat.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It resembles a computer worm that continuously regenerates and replicates across multitudes of networks. In keeping with this resemblance, it has remarkable regenerative capabilities and typically attacks its foes' weak points.
author: infinex21

entry: The many segments of its body collide and clip with each other, sometimes being flung at incalculable speeds. It regularly reverses time on itself to get itself back in one piece.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can completely control the flow of time, a power that also extends into the digital space. Mischievous by nature, it spends its time amusing itself by messing with Trainers, such as tampering with upload and download times.
author: the_smirker

entry: Legends describe POKENAME as corrupting and destabilizing space with its very existence at every second. Every attempt that it tries to go into another dimension, it accidentally creates a parallel version where all logic and science have gone awry.
author: soup1900

entry: Similar to how Giratina resides in the Distortion World, POKENAME partitions off storage in computer devices to live within an empty space. If agitated, files on the device may rapidly become corrupted and unrecoverable.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME are often found going into computer files and moving whatever they can find around. They're commonly mistaken for virtual pets.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME were once only a mere hypothetical for a fusion, but out of nowhere they began to appear in people's computer systems. As soon as it gets in, it shuts the PC down permanently, no visuals, no fanfare, just an unfixable black screen.
author: jangodiot

entry: Its corrupted cannon occasionally backfires, but when it works it can fire blasts of malicious code. POKENAME will sometimes confuse its cannon for its head, and swap them around.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: An experiment by Team Plasma gone wrong. It only knows destruction, firing its cannon randomly and leaving nothing behind.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tail emits corrupted data that causes all electronics around it to either stop working or go haywire. If any aircraft flies by it, they will shut down and crash to the ground.
author: soup1900

entry: All bits of data around POKENAME become scorched and corrupted when it lights its tail up with flames. It blows up server rooms and all devices connected to them when they are being used for malicious reasons.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME powers its tail, all bits of data around it become scorched and corrupted. It is known to blow up server rooms and all devices connected whose use is malicious.
author: soup1900

entry: While living in one's computer, POKENAME can speed up the device by three times its normal capabilities. Because of this, POKENAME is coveted by video game speedrunners.
author: opossiblymage

entry: If POKENAME ever tries to purposely use its tail to attack, it can only seem to give a light hug with it. On the other hand, traveling through cyberspace causes it to twitch and smash its tail and destroy the device it came from.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME generates lots of garbage data by churning terabytes worth of code inside its tail. It uses all this data to wipe out entire computer systems whose uses aren't deemed morally right by it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can create such powerful viruses and malware that they constantly try to tear up its body. Its presence alone causes ice to appear on computer programs, significantly slowing them down and even freezing them completely.
author: soup1900

entry: The powder POKENAME releases from its arms can corrupt files on nearby computers. The longer the powder remains on the machine, the more corruption occurs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a habit of breaking open devices and stealing a vital component before flying off. It is believed that isolated tribes who have miraculously gained modern technology are due to POKENAME dropping parts at their locations.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME easily gets cold inside of computers due to the lack of fur and coolants always being pumped in. The only way for it to stay warm is by insulating itself in data, referencing popular clothing designs from social media to fashion the code.
author: soup1900

entry: Wherever POKENAME hops in virtual space, it disrupts the coding around it. This can render nearby programs completely useless.
author: .izik

entry: While traveling through cyberspace, POKENAME stores interesting data it finds within its mushroom-like head. When startled, it spills this data across any website it is present on, causing widespread glitches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are impossible to be detected by firewalls since they move too fast for the software to stop and process them. They are known to constantly run the tree command in computers and feed on the data from all the directories listed.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME infests abandoned computers, consuming data left on the device until there is nothing left. Its appearance has inspired mechanical horror films about rogue computer programs.
author: chibitales

entry: It is considered an extreme risk to have POKENAME near computers, as if it decides to possess one, it will cause the computer to overload with viruses and malware.
author: shadeofblu

entry: When POKENAME sticks some of its gel onto computers, it can overwrite their preexisting networks and connect them into its own new one instead. To battle foes, it rips cables off from computers using its large hands and swings them around like whips.
author: soup1900

entry: The combination of Porygon-Z and Clefable was thought to be ideal for space exploration, but most POKENAME have shown intense anxiety about it. When astronauts tried to take POKENAME with them to space, it started foaming at the mouth.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME does pranks by purposely letting its corrupted cotton build up so they fully fill up a computer's storage. Attempts to get rid of POKENAME to free up storage are futile since it can tear away from the cotton and leave.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rides on data streams, letting its pieces of cotton hair be torn off and corrupt any computer it passes through. It can easily slip through any security that's been set up, making no important file safe from POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: The cursor-like claws of POKENAME can tear the bark off an entire tree. Their visor-like eyes can detect prey even in pitch-black sandstorms.
author: trismon55555

entry: POKENAME infiltrates offices at night, attempting to draw late-night workers close by mimicking an active computer. It's said it will pull those who investigate into its screen, where they will be trapped inside forever.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins up webs and uses them as lassos to grab onto files in the midst of being moved or transferred. Trying to retrieve the files results in it dispensing an electrical jolt that could short out the computer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME absorbs code using its feelers and converts them into garbage data pellets used to fire at firewalls and take them offline. While it can smash steel into smithereens, it's often way too shaky and twitchy to focus its strength.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their many connector arms to plug into the ports of computers and swipe their info and data. They often plug all their connectors into the same device rather than connecting to separate devices, since each arm steals different resources.
author: soup1900

entry: Its glitched flame siphons and deletes data from nearby electronics. There have been rumors of GPS systems going haywire, leading people down isolated roads with nothing but a POKENAME.
author: secondegg

entry: A glitched flame sits atop POKENAME's head. It flickers and crackles like static, occasionally moving to different parts of its body, and may even darken its surroundings instead of illuminate them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fuels its flames by burning the code from old, unused electronics. Since it won't ever incinerate devices that still get used, many people don't mind POKENAME roaming their streets or entering their homes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs files and data, burning and corrupting them. Its erratic behavior is most likely the product of a poorly programmed update.
author: starriser609

entry: When POKENAME tries to swing its tusks to slice a foe, the tusks will suddenly unload into a cyberframe before impact, making the blow ineffective. To prevent the tusks from disappearing, it licks up memory data from computers to keep them stable.
author: soup1900

entry: The AI that dictates POKENAME's behavior is corrupted, thus it acts faulty. It believes itself to be a guardian, but it regularly glitches out, causing the target of its protection to change each time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can store visual data into their many tails, but this data can easily become corrupted when their tails are damaged. Despite this downside, indie film studios rely on this rudimentary film storage to capture scenes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME is found on a computer, many will try to force it out, making it take a cursor out of its mouth to drag itself to a different part of the screen. If left alone, the malicious code it is coated in will slowly take over the device.
author: soup1900
