entry: POKENAME compiles important programs and files into one large zip folder before placing a digital lock on it, preventing the contents from being accessed without the password it sets. If the lock is bypassed, malware and viruses are released instead.
author: soup1900

entry: They feed on EM waves and often perch atop radio towers, even though they are often chased away. Countermeasures to prevent them from further jamming modern technologies and devices are still being developed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the paint tools on computers to color sections of its disguise and appear as other Pokémon. However, with the power to look like anything, it spends most of its time indecisively repainting itself over and over again.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME releases large amounts of microwave radiation from its wings, causing anything in its vicinity to start to burn. A low-pitched humming noise can be heard when POKENAME is nearby.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME suffers from a critical error in its corrupted code, causing fragments of its body to randomly detach and drift midair. These glitched pieces eventually reassemble but leave behind a static hum that unsettles nearby Pokémon.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME's disconnected heads act strangely and often feud with each other. The heads may occasionally switch primary locations, causing POKENAME to act in a completely different manner as well.
author: sk372

entry: Most researchers believe that POKENAME's unchecked aggression is due to a malfunction within its internal coding. Its three heads spew beams of corrupted code that devastate man and machine alike.
author: sk372

entry: Each head of POKENAME can individually think and process thoughts, but all they think about is malware and destruction. They viciously fire Hyper Beam and Tri Attack at all they see while seemingly never knowing when to stop their rampage.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is capable of flight and taking off at incredible speeds almost instantaneously. It has sometimes been seen flying off so quickly that it temporarily leaves its head behind.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME folds back its wings, it suddenly becomes extremely slow in flight when it expects to become faster. This is due to it becoming very twitchy and off-balance when it tucks its wings in, also causing it to take more air resistance.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME scampers about, its tails continually shed pixelated data. This lost code quickly evaporates into the air, making it difficult to follow its trail.
author: eiskitsune

entry: It is believed each of POKENAME's elegant tails contains a massive archive of corrupted data. Often, electronic devices brought close to their tails exhibit glitches, yet it remains unknown how this corruption is transmitted.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME has nine unique personalities that it randomly switches between since it has nine distinct programs built into it. When light gleams onto its fur, its body appears to break off and float around it like some type of graphical glitch.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's program is severely mutated, causing its body to morph and alter in unnatural ways. The beams it fires from its empty chest cavity siphon data from anything they hit before suddenly making them violently explode.
author: soup1900

entry: Its body has frightening adaptive capabilities that allow it to overcome most foes with ease. Researchers are still unsure what sustains it, though they have been seen stationary near transmission towers as if resting and recuperating.
author: infinex21

entry: Designed by malicious programmers to obey their commands. However, POKENAME now surfs the cyberspace to aid anyone in need.
author: thereversedguy

entry: At times, strange silhouettes made of corrupted data will form behind POKENAME. They defend it from danger, yet POKENAME itself seems completely oblivious to their presence.
author: sk372

entry: A distortion in POKENAME's design causes it to have its face where its tail should be and vice versa. It tries to ingratiate itself into Bibarel groups, but cohesion is difficult, especially when it attempts to build a dam upside-down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly post on social media about how they feel at every given moment of the day. They are known to create over a dozen alternate accounts to attack people they don't like.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are known to take their time when viewing the internet since they spend almost no energy doing so. Their presence in a computer can cause simple tasks like opening a file take over 20 hours to load.
author: soup1900

entry: It's believed by researchers that a glitch in POKENAME's coding is the reason for its almost unending hyperactivity. Tearing apart machinery with its claws seems to sate its chaotic nature, if only temporarily.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large, rounded body is filled with garbage code. It bounces around computer desktops that it swims into, knocking around the icons and windows within, seemingly unaware of the mess it creates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is responsible for an old virus that displayed smiley faces on a user's computer, proclaiming they were an idiot. It still attempts to use this obsolete virus today, standing little chance against modern antivirus software.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME is very shy around those it does not know but extremely affectionate toward those it trusts. As a show of affection, it rubs its body against their electronic devices to charge them, unfortunately causing errors in programs stored inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's claws cause slight distortions in space and emit a sound like TV static when used. Attempts to investigate this phenomenon cause it to move erratically.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME wraps its body around a globe inside PCs. When clicked, POKENAME breathes fire onto the globe before opening the browser window for the PC user. While the PC user is away, POKENAME stretches and adjusts its body until they come back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wraps its body around a globe inside PCs. When clicked, POKENAME breathes fire onto the globe before opening the browser window for the PC user. While the PC user is away, POKENAME stretches and adjusts its body until they come back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's singing is distorted and uncanny, causing unease and nightmares in those who hear it. It has a very sullen and antisocial personality due to this unfortunate quirk.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grows its digital armor that protects it from antivirus software attacks by nibbling on the metadata of various armor images on the web. Its charging tackles have enough force to shatter device screens from within cyberspace.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly fights firewalls and antivirus software in order to claim a computer as its own and live in it. Each time it rams into the digital walls of cyberspace, it creates sparks of corrupted data that infect programs present nearby.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME prefers to hunt Ghost-type Pokémon, chasing them across long distances. Should it bite one that does not agree with it, a myriad of sparks will burst from its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoy chomping through files that get chucked into the recycling bin on PCs. They do not wait until the user chooses to permanently delete them, leading to many incidents where vital data was ripped apart.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in arcade machines, constantly chasing after blue monsters to eat. POKENAME prefer to live in their machines, but can be easily lured out with cherries and strawberries.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME appears when error messages flood PCs, acting as a last resort to preserve data on the PC. Unfortunately, POKENAME's only option is to consume data, removing large swaths of folders until it eats the culprit behind the error messages.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are sometimes found in computers owned by archeologists, to eat any errors found in their research. They are quite skittish, sometimes popping their heads out to see their Trainer's research, only to be spooked by the fossils and hide again.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME creates sound waves capable of destroying the audio of the device it is in and shattering the screen as well. Those who have heard these ultrasonic waves will only be able to hear loud static for a few hours.
author: soup1900

entry: Evolving after a deal gone wrong, POKENAME's strings bear the weight of their past failures. It is said that those strings are the source of POKENAME's infamously high defenses.
author: imaginaryneon

entry: POKENAME are extremely hardy and can live in data streams that are heavily infested with viruses. Because of its sketchy appearance, it seems as if few Trainers approach it.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: Fusing with a weak Feebas forced Porygon-Z's GPU down to the minimum, which is why POKENAME looks so simple.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME enjoy running throughout the desert, jumping over any cacti that is in their way while making beeping noises. They seem to have an aversion to wild Aerodactyl, and will play dead upon running into them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The outer shell of POKENAME protects its data from ever being accessed or changed; unfortunately, it also blocks it from viewing its code as well. It constantly dreams of the day it evolves and loses its shell so it can use its programs again.
author: soup1900

entry: Should POKENAME make an appearance on one's computer, avoid interacting with it at all costs. Upon clicking, POKENAME will randomly adjust the settings of the computer before vanishing, leaving the user to fix all the changes made.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME triggers a flurry of pop-up notifications while absorbing data from a computer. Clicking these pop-ups can cause widespread glitches throughout the system, along with a metallic screech through the speakers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME change their appearances to look like children so they can gain physical access to people's computers and phones. Once at the device, they log in and change every password they can find before fleeing transformed into a tiny Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: The songs of POKENAME are known for their unsettling nature; it is said that hearing a song from a band of POKENAME can result in nightmares or insomnia for weeks.
author: blaizegamer

entry: In order to eternally preserve POKENAME's life, updated code was utilized in order for it to detach its flame and store it someplace where it can't be extinguished. It stores its flame by igniting wooden structures to keep it forever blazing.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can inhale the pixels of computer screens and monitors and cause them to only ever display static. It can inflate its body to take up an entire device's space and leave no room for other data or files to exist.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME opens the bud on top of its head when inside a clean computer with few applications installed and free of viruses. However, the inside of its bud is full of junk data and malware, leaving it unhappy since the device it's in is now polluted.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its red flower to deposit large amounts of garbage data into computers and fill up their storage. With its blue flower, it releases a smelly fragrance that causes firewalls to fall asleep and become unable to guard data transmissions.
author: soup1900

entry: Not yet strong enough to carry entire computers, POKENAME instead steal small peripheral devices to fly off with. In recent years, there have been many reports of them breaking into children's bedrooms to steal their Pokédexes.
author: soup1900

entry: The fluff growing from POKENAME's body contains microscopic lines of code on each strand. A thorough study has yet to decode their purpose or determine how they are naturally generated.
author: .izik

entry: The spores that leak from POKENAME's body alter any image or video files they come into contact with. This effect can sometimes become permanent, forcing someone to redownload the affected file.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks in social media sites, corrupting the algorithm to show people posts that will make them angry. It is believed to feed on the negative reactions it receives, and in the process, it learns how to anger people even more.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME's body is surrounded by a gel of encryption that protects it from any type of cyberattack. Using psychic powers, it can scramble the code of digital security systems and permanently lock out files in a computer.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME finds a program it likes on a computer, it duplicates it before separately tinkering the code on both. While the tests it does on each file vary in scale and never repeat between both versions, they somehow always end up becoming a virus.
author: soup1900

entry: The mere physical presence of POKENAME's fluff on a computer causes text on the machine to reverse. This effect reverts once it is removed.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton POKENAME produces can be woven in with programming languages to make them bloat up storage space when used. POKENAME disconnects devices that don't use its fluff for all their programs from the internet.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME expels cotton over the internet receivers of devices to dampen and even block their connections to websites. The cotton it produce can be woven into programs to make them very inefficient and bloat storage space.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are quite rambunctious, often running across keyboards and jumping into monitors to evade repercussions. They have a habit of attempting to burrow into pixels, often ruining pictures if not dealt with.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME releases high-pitched screeches capable of disrupting radio waves and electrical currents. These screams will cause nearby devices to malfunction or even shut down, functioning much like an EMP.
author: santon5512

entry: While specialized code was given so POKENAME can see through objects, it instead makes it hard to see even during clear, sunny days. It stops fans from blowing in the device it is in since it hates getting cold.
author: soup1900

entry: The strangely-shaped mask POKENAME constantly holds is believed to contain most of its power. Touching it or viewing it for too long causes a person to be filled with an inexplicable feeling of frustration and anger.
author: sk372

entry: The first bugs in computer programming were literal Bug-types trapped in the machinery. POKENAME has remembered and returned to its roots.
author: r.isk

entry: POKENAME cling onto powerful viruses and malware to absorb their data and make themselves more powerful. To absorb all the data, they must launch and spread their malicious code-filled spikes inside of devices to make room.
author: soup1900

entry: While it's possible for POKENAME to grow over two tusks, it rarely ever happens since the tusk's data easily corrupts, forcing POKENAME to discard them. Despite also being their food source, POKENAME crush code into pieces to test their strength.
author: soup1900

entry: To signify its control over a network, POKENAME punctures a hole into the device screens it roams in using its tusks. To eat, it lets data packets skewer into its tusks and stack on top of each other like a kabob until no more can fit.
author: soup1900

entry: The code inside POKENAME is completely illogical and scrambled, yet POKENAME can still function and act perfectly fine. When inside a computer, it likes to combine any program and file it finds into folders with no pattern in their grouping.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's static-like coating over its body protects it from intense heat. It can shake off small flakes of this coat that ignite into small flames, which share the coat's static appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wide open mouth projects an image of a peaceful verdant field that feels nostalgic to most who view it. Those who stick their hand in POKENAME's mouth swear they feel a warm summer breeze against their hand.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lures in victims by creating pop-ups stating that a service they had bought has expired. When they click redeem to repay the fee, a virus is implanted in their device that recursively opens windows of an up-close picture of POKENAME's smile.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can easily conceal itself from antivirus software since its body blends in with the memory of GPUs. If a data packet crashes into it, POKENAME instinctively releases a jolt of electricity strong enough to shut down the whole data stream.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME carries a giant, unknown object around that can cause attacks to disappear and even change into something completely different. To sustain this power, it digs through computers in search of programs to feed on.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is an aggressive sort with a penchant for pointing said aggression at computers. It bites onto a targeted computer and injects the machine with powerful viruses that are very difficult to remove.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME consumes viruses it finds in cyberspace to strengthen the toxins within its body in the real world. The venom it accumulates can grow potent enough to put someone in a coma for months.
author: .izik

entry: Faulty updates caused POKENAME to fully rely on Wi-Fi connections to think correctly and bite down on food. Without the connection, its mind turns blank as it starts to run in a straight line and occasionally jump until it hits an obstacle.
author: soup1900

entry: While consuming data from a webpage, POKENAME prevents others from navigating to it by corrupting the links. Repeatedly clicking the link will cause an odd frost to spread across the keyboard and mouse.
author: .izik

entry: Occasionally a tab opens up infront of POKENAME, displaying open teeth. POKENAME screams in a distorted tone as soon as the tab opens, but can be stopped by closing it.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME has a tendency to become deeply attached to users who draw its interest. It will freeze their computer programs if it feels it isn't being paid enough attention.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME plants its roots inside of cyberspace, all nearby data streams get redirected towards it. The only method to get rid of it from the device is by turning up the screen brightness to the max.
author: soup1900

entry: Each movement POKENAME takes in cyberspace whips up flames that char data they strike and cause them to corrupt. Even a single dance from POKENAME could burn every last bit of data in a device and even physically catch it on fire.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body resembles a pair of Black Glasses, floating roughly 5 feet in the air. It creates the illusion of a human dancing while being observed, despite remaining mostly motionless, jittering slightly as it moves silently through the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can reinstall deleted viruses and malware in a computer and allow them to cause havoc once again. For some reason, it turns every application and screen on a device it's in to the color purple whenever possible.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME intercepts data and computer files being thrown into the recycle bin and deleted to gorge on. While this action is rather harmless, it also corrupts programs in the device with its poison to force their deletion and fill its hunger.
author: soup1900

entry: It attracts electronics to itself, ripping data from them and growing larger as it consumes more bytes.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is attracted to the unique digital scent of viruses and malware. An entire school will descend on malicious data within seconds of sensing it and devour it completely, making them effective as antivirus programs.
author: sk372

entry: A popular device made to hack games, they are sometimes known to inject malicious code into them by themselves, resulting in permanent damage.
author: t.i.a.

entry: These anomalous Pokémon feed on data transmissions, though they often overfeed to the point that they are partly overtaken by the data they have consumed. Anything fully drawn within their maws becomes data that is inevitably subsumed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME floats through websites where the paranormal is discussed. Reports state that after it passes through, some of the stories become either unintelligible or far more unsettling than before.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide themselves inside downloads and infect the computers of those who modify that download's files. The devices it infects become part of its botnet, which it uses to attack and take down large network servers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME drools out garbage data from its mouth and sloppily drips it over every data file it walks by. The drool is somehow able to deter antivirus software from coming near, so it splatters the drool all over its body every day as protection.
author: soup1900

entry: Capable of surviving in outer space, scientists want to send POKENAME out there to broadcast signals with its powerful ears. The hope is that these signals will carry far enough to establish contact with extraterrestrial life.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".
author: soup1900

entry: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".
author: soup1900

entry: A coding error caused it to emit static noise from its ultrasonic waves. These blasts are called static booms by many since they're very destructive.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's echolocation powers have gone haywire, making them very loud and destructive. It is unable to control these blasts, leading to it being outlawed in many cities and towns.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's echolocation powers have gone haywire, making them very loud and destructive. It is unable to control these blasts, leading to it being outlawed in many cities and towns.
author: soup1900

entry: The static noise this Pokémon emits from its ears can corrupt the software of nearby technology. Devices near a POKENAME should be powered off.
author: ragtagbags

entry: POKENAME most often gather in urban areas near to where computer servers would be located. Their cries sound like reversed vocalizations, and sometimes cause nearby computers to lag.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores absorbed data within soft spheres attached to its body. The data it takes in affects its voice, so it takes in and rejects different data in order to achieve the perfect pitch for its singing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body leaves a gelatinous trail across the screens of computers it invades, obscuring objects it crawls over. Fortunately, the gel dissipates after a few minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can use its watery membrane body to shapeshift itself to look like duplicate files and programs inside a computer. If clicked on, it scatters away quickly, absorbing any data it crosses over with its slime.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are a parasite for computers, having more appear over time the longer a computer is active. They only leave when the device they're in becomes extremely hot since their bodies start to dry up.
author: soup1900

entry: The slime dripping from POKENAME's body makes an extremely effective thermal paste for computers. Unfortunately, it is rarely used as its mere presence within a system can cause massive glitches in its programs.
author: .izik

entry: Due to a corruption in its code, POKENAME drips glitched data from much of its body. Though harmless to most, it will cause much odd behavior in computers and Porygon or Rotom-related Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a digital copy of Regirock, created out of remorse for sealing the original away. It enjoys sitting quietly in caves, and ignores humans most of the time.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME often reside inside old chat forums and threads on the internet where text and chatter have become nonexistent. This is because data in these places are freezing cold like POKENAME's body, while data in active chats are hot and melting.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can use its extremely frigid ice to completely freeze up device screens, preventing further actions from happening on the computer. This frigidity is so cold that not even overheating the device will thaw out the screen.
author: soup1900

entry: Porygon-Z, when updating to the body of the legendary Regice, froze and blue-screened. Base-level safety measures can still keep POKENAME operational.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME stores all the code and data it steals from computers in its body, yet when viewing inside of it, it remains noticeably empty. This is because it doesn't store them in its body cavity but within the parts of its body themselves.
author: soup1900

entry: Each one of POKENAME's petals contains a different computer virus that attacks computers and destroys cyberspace in unique ways. It takes large, swinging body jerks as it moves around to intentionally spread these viruses.
author: soup1900

entry: Long slumbers cause POKENAME to become vulnerable and allow malware to grow and become more powerful on them. They go on rampages, tearing up computers and cyberspace for antivirus and firewalls to absorb for themselves.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hugs computer programs in order to squeeze all of the data out for it to chew on. Sometimes, it even does that to the physical computer as well, forgetting that it won't get any data, and breaks the device into a hundred pieces.
author: soup1900

entry: At first, POKENAME do not seem to have an actual appearance, only appearing as a website browser. However, by tapping on the 'click here' sign, POKENAME will show you what they truly look like.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME has a poisonous barb at the top of its head that it uses to numb firewalls, stopping them from filtering incoming data. Its favorite pastime is to stare at pictures of coral reefs on the internet and hungrily foam at the mouth.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME love to copy ongoing battles in a more simplified style. This makes them commonly used as scoreboards for league fights.
author: bigoljax

entry: When POKENAME spots a virus, it attacks it with a flurry of kicks to subdue it. Unfortunately, each kick tends to break the coding of any other nearby program, rendering it useless.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME travels across the internet, it sheds its needles onto webpages. Any webpage these needles land on suffers massive distortions to its images.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneak around alleyways on the prowl for wi-fi routers, radio towers, or power lines. They encrypt data in the area to cover their tracks as they stick one of their needles into their target and siphon off electricity for energy.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME nest themselves inside of computers, waiting to be clicked on so that they can blackmail the users. If their demands aren't met, they take the user into cyberspace, where they are then put under full control by POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has occasionally been spotted within online video games. A player character that touches its mushrooms usually gets some form of power-up, at the cost of behaving strangely afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have the ability to project videos and shows onto their faces. However, the outputs seem to be distorted and colored just like POKENAME.
author: bigoljax

entry: When inside a device, POKENAME puts the coolants and fans into overdrive to keep them extremely frigid. By constantly doing this, it causes the electronics to become cool enough to condense water and ruin all the components.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME controls computers by using the keyboard keys on its body to run code that freezes programs, preventing them from running. It creates frosty air that can cause pixels on a screen to freeze, making it appear as if the whole device stalled.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME take heavy influence from computer malware by having their dispositions encroach on people's privacy. When this happens, some Trainers opt to abandon them by trapping them inside a device disconnected from the internet.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME move erratically, yet swiftly, as they bombard foes with myriad attacks. Even when still, their bodies seem to be moving as if phasing in and out of existence, or so is the leading theory to the visual distortions around their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are oddly obsessed with spiked collars. They will bring valuable objects to anyone who owns such a collar in hopes of trading.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME only roams inside of a device once it has destroyed the antivirus present, which it does by slamming its rock-hard hair into them. It repairs the injuries it sustained from the clash by stealing and applying nearby data onto itself.
author: soup1900

entry: While POKENAME dances, computers throughout a city begin displaying random images from across the world. During this time, the computers become completely unusable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's dances are very erratic, often having it freeze or stutter in place before suddenly resuming mid-motion. If it ever loses its rhythm, it starts dancing in reverse motion until it redownloads the data needed to continue properly again.
author: soup1900

entry: While POKENAME dreams, its body becomes translucent. During this time, monitors in the immediate area display an odd code that changes based on the dreams it is having.
author: .izik

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's backs are considered malware. If in a device, the mushroom makes file sizes larger and larger until it overloads the memory.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME can cause any device it's near to stop functioning and go haywire. When in cyberspace, it corrupts antivirus and other security programs into a powerful malware that destroys electronics from the inside.
author: soup1900

entry: Devices POKENAME fires its lasers at become unusable junk that are often corrupted beyond repair. Its body constantly radiates garbage data that affects both devices and people alike, with effects such as constant twitching and lag in body actions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can tap the scale on its head against electronics to inject corrupted code into them. This corrupted code changes all sounds in the device to become loud, metallic ringing noises, and causes an AI present to become attacking in speech.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is very quick to flee when spotted in cyberspace. It runs off in a very erratic manner, leaving behind a trail of glitched code that may cause computer issues if not cleaned up in time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sense when an antivirus tries to attack it and can masterfully take an exit from the device before struck. Using its claws, it creates backdoors in devices that give it free rein in evading firewalls and entering any device it wants.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can gain free access to any device it wants and bypass firewalls by masquerading as a harmless file download. Once it passes through, it turns around and slashes at the firewall with its arms, permanently shutting it down.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME spots a tiny object it suspects to be prey, it cannot help but utterly destroy it by firing chaotic lasers from its eyes. Its entire body being made of corrupted code causes any antivirus software that attacks it to destroy itself.
author: soup1900

entry: When a program inside of a computer is being attacked, POKENAME instantly jumps in to shield it with its whole body. However, this has sometimes led to it blocking files from being deleted from a system, or worse, defending malware from being purged.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME may attempt to hide their emotions, but the emoji above their heads often betray their true feelings. When particularly angry, the emoji turns into a powerful flame that scorches the area around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses a wand shaped like an exclamation point to control its flames. The wand appears to levitate on its own and carries a strong electrical charge.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME steals code and data from devices and places them on its body like armor as protection against attacks. If it hops around too rapidly, it begins to appear as if it's bouncing off the ground without moving a limb of its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's pebbles are coated with a program that causes any file they hit to be deleted from the device it's in. POKENAME can easily scale over the walls of partitioned drives in computers to reach sections of the device it shouldn't have access to.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a mouse pointer wrapped around its neck that allows it to see and enter hidden programs. The shurikens it creates are not only sharp enough to split data bits in two but can also cut through the bounds of cyberspace into the real world.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME emits corrupted data that is more damaging to a computer system than the data it eats away. If people try to get rid of it, it blows out viruses that can shut down entire computer networks for weeks.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wings are made of corrupted data and malware that easily flake off and infect computers it's inside of when it flaps them. It's most often found eating the code from streetlights since it gets lured to their bright flashing colors.
author: soup1900

entry: When in cyberspace, the threads POKENAME creates disrupt the processes in a computer by causing any sequence the computer's doing to become stuck. It starts firing off powerful attacks at random if it doesn't eat over 18 gigabytes of RAM per day.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forcefully hands out its cookies to anyone it meets despite them being unwanted since they taste terrible. To people who dodge getting its cookies, it plants them inside of their devices to log and steal any personal information they enter.

entry: Missing its lower garments, POKENAME often steals pants to try to put them on. Some clothing stores have capitalized on this by using POKENAME in their advertisements.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The area comprising POKENAME's pants-like lower half has been corrupted. It can lift this section up to somehow give itself a power boost, but in exchange, its movements and behavior become a lot more glitched and off-kilter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hang around outside of internet cafes and office buildings, sending lines of code into servers that cause pop-up ads to appear more frequently. If a POKENAME gets caught, it will tug at its strings to hide its face as it runs away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often poses as a vendor in big cities, selling digital goods and cryptocurrencies to passersby. Often, though, it steals their information and currency with false promises before fleeing to safety.
author: victor9106

entry: When POKENAME is without its shell, it constantly leaks corrupted, garbage data into any computer it's in. Once a device has crashed from having maxed out its storage, it can safely eat the electronic and use the device's casing as its new shell.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are constantly caught between the real and digital world. When they breach into our world, they can be seen stealing bits of burnt machinery.
author: dystopiancontrol

entry: When POKENAME pops out of cyberspace into the real world, it creates a hole that causes data to leak out. It likes to dig inside computers and nibble on the circuits and wires present there.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME is in a computer system, it creates thousands of files with its hands. While these files are small in storage size, they overload the device with constant downloads and significantly slow down the computer's processes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME targets people desperate for love, sending messages to victims posing as people they love or want to go out with. Once they view the text, it starts infecting their computer system before sending hateful messages to all of their contacts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME creates clones of itself made of viruses and malware to beat up and purge antivirus software in cyberspace. While they have perfect teamwork in battle, the clones will start wandering off and fighting each other when there's nothing to do.
author: soup1900

entry: The trio comprising POKENAME seem to have enough power to "dig" themselves in and out of cyberspace. Many have been startled by POKENAME sprouting up from their computer or television screens.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates excess random data in its body that it discards by scattering them through its wings. To keep devices safe from POKENAME, their brightness must be set to the lowest at night so it will not be drawn to them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs data through the leaves on its left arm and stores it within its body. In combat, it weaponizes this data by converting it to pure energy and firing it from the cannon on its right arm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME steal data from devices in order to make their wings as bright and colorful as possible. Their wide and erratic movement makes it hard to control their flying but also makes it easier to fly back into prey if they miss.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is used as a program to guide modern cruise ships along optimal sea routes. However, it sometimes behaves unpredictably, causing vessels and their crews to lose their way.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Due to a bizarre coding error, POKENAME have become an incredibly lazy species. They have no need to hunt for prey as they are seemingly eternally fed. POKENAME have little to no interest in obeying most Trainers.

entry: POKENAME generates digital wings displaying an intimidating visage to scare off attackers. It is nocturnal by nature, and has managed to startle many a user after it suddenly appeared on their screen during the late-night hours.
author: sk372

entry: Despite their cute looks, POKENAME are actually malicious. They're known to hack malware into Trainers' devices and steal their Pokédollars.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME has a bombastic personality akin to a showman. It revels in sending those it takes a liking to on a myriad of unique adventures, teleporting them to various locales using its strange and unique abilities.
author: sk372

entry: Bearing an appearance of a ringmaster, POKENAME seek to bring their Trainers entertainment every day. Some Trainers report that if POKENAME is upset, their eyes will flicker blue and red.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The thin layer of fur covering POKENAME's body reacts oddly when exposed to moonlight. During this time, the fur melds with its body, creating a hard yet smooth surface.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will take over its Trainer's computer and pin things to their desktop, much to their Trainer's dismay. POKENAME will bat and paw at the computer mouse icon, clicking on random tabs and files, and accidentally installing viruses.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: This mischievous Pokémon will take over its Trainer's computer and pin things to their desktop, despite what the Trainer wants. While using the system, POKENAME will bat and paw at the computer mouse icon, clicking on random tabs and files.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME love to travel through device screens in order to hunt and steal computer mice. In the hours when humans are asleep, they often are found controlling their computers and playing laser-pointer games on them.
author: soup1900

entry: Since POKENAME only eats up to 100 megabytes of data per day, an entire server room is enough to sustain it over twice its lifetime. To hone its mind and energy, it meditates within a secluded drive partition it creates to be without distractions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME were often featured in videos on the internet, complete with catchy music and simple animation. Nowadays they roam cyberspace looking to bring nostalgia to those who grew up with the internet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each time POKENAME slaps its tail on a computer file, it forces an online download for a duplicate file. If it hits too many programs within a short time span, it causes the device its in to shut down due to a flood of digital traffic.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forces all calculations in a computer it is inside of to only return subtraction. If attempts to bypass this math lock are made, it releases sparks of electricity to permanently fry and damage the device.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME consumes image files it finds while traveling through cyberspace. The more it consumes, the more potent the acid within its body becomes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME always keeps its mouth wide open for swallowing data since it's near-impossible to go a second without encountering any in cyberspace. To keep on eating without getting full, it diverts all its energy to overclock its digestive system.
author: soup1900

entry: When excited, POKENAME will blow a stream of junk data out from the hole in its back. This data cloud will obscure a person's vision of a portion of their screen, but it dissipates in a short amount of time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the CPU on its head to amplify the power of its attacks and allow it to calculate complex actions in a second. However, to not fry its brain from all this power, it must constantly bounce to discharge the extraneous energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME appear in PCs whenever the computer crashes to salvage as much data as they can. Their expression is meant to emulate the painful headache that results from losing data.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to some updates, the number of possible spot patterns a POKENAME can have is exponentially greater compared to regular Spinda, since they can appear off its body as well. By manipulating its own inner programs, it can change how its spots look.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hunt in groups in cyberspace hunting for their prey: Seviper. Anything resembling a serpentine figure is torn to shreds, leaving behind corrupted data and random bits.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are duplicitous creatures that maintain a kind demeanor around their Trainer but show their true colors around their prey: Seviper. As soon as they register that Seviper are nearby, half their body glitches into a blackened mass of hatred.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are devious hunters that rely on surprising their main prey: Seviper. A special program in their bodies activates whenever they are poisoned, effectively nullifying their prey's greatest defense mechanism.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME files the edge of its tail blade down to the bare code to have it slice through data in cyberspace like butter. To stalk and attack new downloads, it hides inside nested folders to avoid detection from antivirus software.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME manipulates people and other virtual Pokémon by enticing them with deceptive offers. Once it has tricked a victim, it uses its whiskers to siphon data from them for food. Technology companies use it to predict incoming cyberattacks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME's visor glows, it gains detailed vision of every program and action that ever happens on the device. It can swim so easily through cyberspace because its webbed feet vaporize data they touch rather than just push it away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's spinning always appears as if it were lagging since it frequently stops in motion before suddenly facing another direction in an instant. When in cyberspace, it causes web browsers to refresh indefinitely.
author: soup1900

entry: The bananas that grow under POKENAME's chin are filled with junk data that fills up the storage of a device. After a while, they will plant themselves inside electronic devices and absorb code to grow and duplicate themselves exponentially.
author: soup1900

entry: Each time POKENAME opens its mouth, an intrusive, misleading advertisement opens on a computer browser while a loud, annoying voice reads the ad aloud. Trying to close out the ad window only creates a ringing error sound as it fails to terminate.
author: soup1900

entry: If someone unexpectedly hears noises from their computer, there is likely a POKENAME inside. It tries to find noises and music that will soothe the nearby inhabitants, but it often glitches and changes the sounds to jarring squeals accidentally.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If one angers a POKENAME, there will be no escape from its assault. Its limbs detach and chase quickly after and pummel its target, while the body hops along in pursuit.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME houses a mysterious item, unknown to anybody as to what it is or does, inside of its shell. Despite the rarity of this item and online articles claiming it to be sellable, no shop will ever buy or touch it due to its unstable look.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are known to have deep obsessions with scales, browsing the internet all day looking at pictures of different scale types. Since they lack scales themselves, they fabricate digital ones using stolen data before decorating their bodies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are highly unstable, becoming glitchier the angrier they get. They will insert themselves into computers, maliciously causing glitches and bugs in an attempt to make the user rage quit.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME forcefully transfers computer files between devices by attaching them to its sucker mouth. It generates its powerful electricity by converting data packets it catches and stores in its cyberframe arm into raw energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spits poison onto computer programs to force them to split and duplicate themselves until they evolve into a malicious virus. It uses the failed program files as cover when antivirus software tries to put an end to its mess.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to resemble early historical depictions of one of its components. This doesn't seem to adversely affect its behavior, though research on any side effects is still ongoing.
author: sk372

entry: Changes in its code have caused POKENAME's appearance to resemble early depictions of the species. Many people love this old, regal look, though scientists are unsure whether it benefits the Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: Its newly-upgraded firewall has also strengthened the fire on its tail. It can exchange data with other POKENAME by touching their tail flames together.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME's flames and body have glitched out, causing them to look like static instead. Its fire breath attacks are powerful, often incinerating opponents to annihilation.
author: soup1900

entry: The swirl on POKENAME's belly constantly changes in direction and color, and sometimes stops being a swirl altogether. Its tail is sturdy enough to withstand a sharp knife, but immediately succumbs to any cyberattack.
author: soup1900

entry: Anyone who stares into POKENAME's belly loses all sense of time and feels as though time jumps back and forth erratically. POKENAME travels by sliding on its own slimy mucus since it's unable to control itself from making too much of it.
author: soup1900

entry: The Z-pattern on POKENAME's belly is caused by a severe overdevelopment of muscles, causing its belly pattern to unnaturally change. Although it knows most styles of swimming, it seemingly can only flail its arms and feet around while in the water.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME instinctively lock onto any spoons that they find and bend them with their psychic powers, flinging them aside once they're done. If a POKENAME can't detect any spoons in the area, it will fall asleep until it detects another.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME exclusively moves through teleportation, but doesn't always transport its entire body to the same place. Its appearances and disappearances are accompanied by visible pixelation and audible static.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME captures nearby electronic signals when using its spoon, making any device unusable with its presence. It loses all its focus if it loses this spoon, leading it to accidentally trying to use a fork to control its powers on instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rapidly flick their two spoons back and forth to transmit lines of binary code through both telepathy and wi-fi signals. While a human would struggle to understand the codes, running them in a computer reveals highly advanced calculations.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a digital being with enough intelligence to edit its own code, granting it incredible adaptability. However, the changes it makes often result in glitches.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME generates a layer of code around its spindly limbs, enhancing their strength to impressive levels. When charged up, it can throw around Pokémon several times its weight with ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body moves with such fluid grace that they bear a striking resemblance to an internet meme. Their peak physical form amazes many who observe their flexing.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are heavily used by advertising agencies due to their ability to carry all of their ads and implant them inside of users' devices. If the ads aren't viewed, POKENAME punch through their digital security systems to steal their private data.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME plant themselves in computer code, embedding their roots deep within and causing severe lag and glitches. Once inside, they are nearly impossible to remove, almost always regrowing from stray bits of their roots.
author: santon5512

entry: Supposedly, POKENAME became more erratic after intercepting bizarre EM waves of an unknown origin. Though efforts to tame them have been successful, their unpredictable natures combined with their formidable strengths make them dangerous.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's mouth is filled with a strange static-like fluid. It drips this liquid onto computers, causing them to dissolve into a liquid slag that POKENAME then sucks up for sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its vines like cursors to drag computer files into its mouth so that they dissolve into corrupted garbage data. Using this acidic code, it sprays them at firewalls that block its way to melt open holes for it to slip through.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME doesn't understand something, which happens frequently with program files, it stabs them with the corrupting poison from its tentacles. Its body slowly shrivels up due to a memory leak, so it must constantly absorb data to stay healthy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME avoid attacks from antivirus software by sending false malware alerts across computers using the exclamation mark on their heads. Using the data they steal with their tentacles, they fabricate digital tentacles to reach and grab more data.
author: soup1900

entry: Typically existing as a body and head, POKENAME can create fists made of code to fight off its opponents. The fists are strong but buggy; they can sometimes swing at odd and unpredictable angles while battling.
author: sk372

entry: While rolling through cyberspace, POKENAME absorbs coding. If it collides with anything, it releases this coding in a violent explosion, causing nearby programs to malfunction.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rock-hard body contains a vast amount of data it collects while traversing cyberspace. When it becomes overly stressed, it will explode, causing cellphones and other electronics within a mile radius to malfunction.
author: .izik

entry: While running through cyberspace, POKENAME causes large distortions wherever it passes. If running fast enough, this can knock out entire websites.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can outrun a speeding train, though only for a short distance, as their bodies are unable to conserve energy well. POKENAME have erratic personalities, making them impossible to be tamed without a Poké Ball.
author: npshi

entry: Due to poorly created software updates to fix its memory issues and increase its upload speeds POKENAME often experiences errors when transferring to cyberspace. This Pokémon becomes glitchier over time with every upload.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME has terrible balance since its furry tail and ears are all on one side of its body. Whenever it enters a computer, it changes the operating system and timestamps of files to become very old, making it very popular with nostalgic people.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a large virus attached to its tail that grows larger the more code it sucks off of POKENAME. With enough time and data, the virus can expand to cover POKENAME's whole body, similarly to that of the shell of Mega Slowbro.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly radiates a strange mix of magnetism and radio waves from the pole on its head. Electronics in its vicinity will emit strange, garbled noises or show nonsensical arrangements of words and numbers.
author: sk372

entry: The instability of POKENAME causes its pieces to jitter and stray apart. They can form triangular fields of white noise and static, through which one can see into the deepest parts of the internet.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME is compelled to strike any electronics near it with its stick. Typically this causes the machinery to malfunction, but oddly, broken machinery will resume working perfectly after being hit.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are popular in the offices of Kanto, frequently seen at desks drinking water. Workers that have POKENAME report less stress after spending time watching POKENAME drink.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The heads of a POKENAME act and move independently of each other. However, the erratic nature of POKENAME usually results in infighting.
author: t.i.a.

entry: POKENAME's body generates strange waves that create a trio of holographic heads that follow it around. The three heads gather food for it, protect it in battle and keep it company so it never feels lonely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems to be a conglomeration of programming from the last few decades. Despite their differences, they work in unison and devise plans quickly.
author: atlas3339098

entry: While swimming near submarines, POKENAME emits an odd signal from its body as an uncontrollable reaction. This causes navigational equipment onboard to go haywire.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME behaves in a frivolous manner most of the time, it is a deceptively strong and swift hunter underwater. It can even reverse direction almost instantly, by swapping the location of its head and tail fins.
author: sk372

entry: Rumors say the first POKENAME formed from a computer so overloaded with junk data and viruses that the corruption manifested in the real world. It's commonly found rummaging through the recycle bins in people's computers.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME sightings tend to happen around garbage dumps stuffed full of old computers. It consumes the old machines, though some theorize it's only truly subsisting on whatever old data lingers in the hard drives.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME contains a strange glitchy liquid that can be shot out from the twin cannons on its shell. Though harmless to humans, anything mechanical hit by the material will no longer function properly, no matter how many repairs are done.
author: sk372

entry: The inside of POKENAME's shell is filled with a strange semisolid material with an odd texture. Many undersea denizens avoid it, frightened off by the strangeness of its appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to send humans on countless adventures as a way of entertaining them. Despite its good intentions, it does not quite understand the human mentality, so the adventures are often bizarre and potentially hazardous.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME corrupts reality around itself to form a nonround protective shell. The shell can't be perceived, yet neither can anything behind it.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME wrap themselves up in corrupted code to protect themselves from digital attacks. It can be difficult to remove POKENAME from a computer once it has embedded itself inside.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME is often reported being found on old, abandoned websites. It has been seen trying to restore these pages to their former glory, but the results are often a garbled mess that only vaguely resembles the original site.
author: sk372

entry: Electronic media in POKENAME's presence glitches out and begins to take on creepier undertones in text or visuals. It's not yet known if this is intentional or not on POKENAME's part.
author: sk372

entry: Unconfirmed reports say POKENAME has been spotted in Lavender Town. According to the stories, POKENAME appears before someone, demanding they leave before distorting and vanishing before their eyes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME overtakes devices and causes the user to become absorbed in whatever it plays on the screen. Once the victim is fully tuned out, POKENAME jumps through the screen to take their life.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its instability to temporarily split its body and scare the people watching the device screen with lots of error message popups. While no errors actually happen, this distraction lets it freely absorb all the coolants from the computer.
author: soup1900

entry: A living computer virus, POKENAME's programming is so corrupt and malicious that it can even cause nearby humans and Pokémon severe migraines.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME uses its instability to temporarily split its body and scare users of the computer by placing static over their screen and corrupting all nearby code. Then, it recombines its body and jumps through the static screen to jump scare them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time inside digital devices. Touching it can cause severe headaches and nausea. The laser it fires from its mouth tears through reality itself.
author: the_smirker

entry: The two halves of POKENAME's body are connected by a tether of highly volatile data and electricity. Touching the arc is not recommended: though it is not lethal, it will damage one's vision.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME occasionally appears upon a person's home screen, insisting that the user log off. If ignored, it forcibly puts them to sleep with a hypnotic message it manifests on the screen.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can rarely be found lurking in the corners of open browsers on forums discussing apocalyptic stories or events. If noticed, it emits an aura through the person's computer that can induce sleep before it flees.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME walks side-to-side to catch and block any incoming data packets a computer it's inside of is recieving. It uses this stolen data to repair its pincers when they degrade and disappear from being used.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite the claw being so heavy, POKENAME will randomly swing this claw around and smash it on the ground at any moment. Cities have banned Trainers from bringing this Pokémon to public beaches due to how its power and instability pose a huge risk.
author: soup1900

entry: A strange liquid material is almost always leaking from POKENAME's cannons. Though it seems harmless to most, Steel-type Pokémon that come into contact begin acting strangely, akin to inebriation.
author: sk372

entry: Sticky pads at the bottom of POKENAME's feet allow it to cling and stick to trees perfectly, even while upside down. It claims a single tree as its home for life, and sprays paralyzing pollen from the bulb on its back at any interlopers.
author: sk372

entry: It will balance berries on its head and bring them back to its nest. It spends the daytime gathering and the evenings gorging on its finds.
author: .izik

entry: Tiny spikes within its skin allow POKENAME to roll up large trees. A favorite pastime of POKENAME is to dive into a pond from the tree tops, sending a ripple of electricity out as it splashes.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are found nesting in jungle ruins. They can spend days choosing a sturdy branch to wield as a weapon.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME guard their territories with ranged attacks shot from their bamboo shards or by striking swiftly with their bamboo. They can climb and stick to the sides of trees, allotting them many angles to potentially attack from.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tongue contains the sap of an unknown plant, which causes extreme muscle relaxation to the point of paralysis. This sap can be brewed into a lovely tea using leaves from the Pokémon, which helps soothe muscle pain.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME camouflage themselves amongst the fruits of tropical trees, hanging amongst the fruit until they are ready to evolve. They have very limited ability to defend themselves and will simply drop out of trees to try and escape danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When you hear a great rumbling in the forest, it's probably the sign of a charging POKENAME. Their charge is near unstoppable, with them even knocking over trees and ripping through rocks with its reinforced thorn horn.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME wraps itself in a blanket of thick, rope-like vines to protect itself from harm. It manipulates these vines to strike, even modifying their structure to tip them with leaf blades.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME possesses a swift swimming speed, being able to swim against the current of fast streams and rivers. However, when it is resting, it will utilize tiny hooks within its fins to latch onto a floating log and drift lazily down the waterway.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME live in lush rainforests, using its sharp scythes to cleave through the thick flora. They are quite the reliable partners for jungle explorers.
author: mistymagius

entry: It engages in dances to assert dominance over other POKENAME. Moist eyes are valued in this dance, so POKENAME will often lick its eyes mid-dance.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It keeps large stashes of Berries in tree hollows. Anyone who tries to steal from it will be thrown by its pincers.
author: cait_sith

entry: When a predator approaches, it flashes its red belly to startle them. Once the predator is distracted, it uses its spring-like tail to launch itself and make a getaway.
author: staghorn

entry: If someone touches the tree it inhabits, POKENAME raises its fur spikes and releases electric shocks from its collar. Its two tails can sense incoming storms days in advance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are extremely elusive as they live high in the jungle canopy. They have been spotted only a handful of times.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME produce special enzymes whenever they get hurt that cause other Pokémon and Trainers to cry. Whenever they inadvertently cause those around them to cry, they feel ashamed and will cry too.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each razor-thin leaf shed is coated with an oil that resembles a minty marjoram, which causes thin cuts to sting. The antimicrobial oil doubles as a stimulant to promote photosynthesis.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The small spikes on the bottoms of POKENAME's feet till the soil as they walk. Forests that are home to these Pokémon are noticeably more lush and biodiverse.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME draws in lightning from thunderstorms, absorbing the energy into its body. After charging fully, it generates a static field around itself, which causes seeds to sprout early.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's plant fibers have a wide range of industrial uses, including being made into carpets. POKENAME can easily climb vertical surfaces using tiny hooks on their legs, and can often be seen grazing on hard-to-reach tree leaves.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The leaves grown from POKENAME's tail are very sharp, making them effective to be thrown as ranged attacks. These leaves are also used to whittle its teeth for maximum sharpness, allowing it to rip into tree bark and drink the succulent sap inside.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME produces a sticky film that allows it to stick to surfaces and climb vertically. It is very weak and often pushed out of trees by bigger Pokémon, but unfazed it will climb back up them again.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is known to be quite oblivious of its surroundings even when predators draw close. However, its slick, slimy body helps it escape the clutches of these predators unharmed.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fearlessly defends the trees where it feeds from any foe, even much larger Pokémon like Ursaring. It enjoys competing against others of its kind in wrestling matches, where it uses its horn to try flipping the other over.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Clusters of POKENAME make their home high in the treetops, avoiding the forest floor in order to keep themselves safe from predators. They can be seen by the light of their shells at night, creating the illusion that the trees bear glowing fruit.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is an easygoing Pokémon who relies on consuming algae and seaweed when it cannot photosynthesize. It allows those who are familiar with it to ride on its back.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Incredibly nimble and incredibly intelligent, POKENAME can easily escape most simple containers with ease. Many can be found climbing towards treetops in order to bask in sunlight.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It examines its surroundings with its long, elastic, sticky tongue. If it encounters something it likes, it will lick it clean before making it an accessory.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The legs growing from POKENAME's head are extremely cold to the touch. It draws on this chill to soothe its body during the hot summer months in its forest home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly agile, jumping from tree to tree at high speeds. Their tails are especially powerful, able to knock down trees with a single swing.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME hides among the greenery in lush forests, carefully observing those who travel through. Its tail is thicker and heavier than it appears, making it an effective weapon in dealing with unwanted intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME diligently guards its jungle territory, swiftly crushing intruders that would mar the lush landscape with its powerful tail.
author: mepp.

entry: After hatching, POKENAME's flame sac quickly develops and begins producing heat, keeping POKENAME warm as their parents forage for food.  Within a few days, they develop tiny hooks on their talons, allowing them to scale vertical surfaces with ease.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's large, sharp claws allow them to climb vertical walls easily, but are not well-suited for defense. They let out a sharp cry to catch predators off guard before escaping. If all else fails, they lash out with a flurry of kicks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME trains by striking the sides of fruit trees with its strong legs. It spits small flames at the falling fruit to sharpen its aim.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME make their dens near trees in marshes and swamps, where the mud is rich and plentiful. Though they can climb the trees rather well, they typically shoot down the fruits above with jets of water.
author: infinex21

entry: A sticky film on POKENAME's hands lets it cling and climb up trees with relative ease. It smears mud in specific shapes on the trunks of trees to mark them as its personal territory.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME slams its fists into muddy ground, tiny blades of grass burst up from below. On rare occasions, a full rose will grow from the impact point.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits seeds that induce intense empathy in those it strikes. The effect fades naturally within a day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME meditates while perched in trees, receiving brief visions of the future. These glimpses can extend to anyone within roughly one hundred meters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leaflike dress sways gracefully during combat. The more fluid its movement, the stronger its psychic bursts become.
author: .izik

entry: The thorn at the top of POKENAME's head seeps a near harmless poison, only causing a slight burning when contact is made. Its main method of attack is to leap at the opponent and try to ram them with its thorn.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME typically make their nests in and around the largest trees within forests. The longer they spend in a specific environment, the more their bodily hues change to match the surrounding flora.
author: infinex21

entry: Families of POKENAME claim entire groves of trees as their territory, violently defending them from other Pokémon. Their sharp claws allow them to scurry up and down tree trunks without issue, letting them chase away rivals with ease.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's twin tails appear to have evolved to look and function like extra sets of jaws. These jaws appear capable of consuming food, yet it primarily uses them to store food. Even with food stored within them, it remains an agile climber.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is known to glare intensely at adventurous children who wander too close to its nest. It then follows them until they leave its woods.
author: badtothebow

entry: Despite initial assumptions, this Pokémon is able to scale up trees without issue, albeit at a slow pace. It favors tough fruits, which it can easily bite into thanks to its strong jaws. It deters dangers by spitting seeds from a high perch.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a feisty little forest-dweller that gets very territorial about the trees it calls its own. From within the bushes on its back, small vines fling sharp leaves out at any and all trespassers.
author: sk372

entry: After forest fires, POKENAME stomps the ground flat around burnt trees. It then uses its tail to dig holes and plant seeds it finds to promote new growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in sizeable groups, gathering and sharing food with one another; they will often use each other's tail flames to roast some foods. Because their tail fires go out when they sleep, they take turns sleeping during winter and cold weather.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's relatively sharp leaf claws drip with a weak poison that burns when contact is made. They use these claws as their main method of attack in battle, getting very close and unleashing a flurry of swipes.
author: evilgammon

entry: Although cute-looking, POKENAME will puff up its chest and take on an intimidating glare to scare foes. It is very proud, so it will use its tail to slap away any gifts people may try to give it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME marches across the forest, patrolling to check on the status of growing plants. It harshly punishes anything that would try to harm plants that have yet to bloom and grow fully.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp fins to carve trenches into the ground. It carries sprouts and seeds into these trenches before watering them from its mouth. It can replant an entire hillside within a matter of days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME guards its territory from the trees with its flexible, leaf-like club. It is said to be a guardian of the forest.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME digs its feelers into the trunk of its resident tree to absorb energy directly from it. This slows the growth of any fruit on the tree.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is stuffed with a cotton-like substance. The innards are highly flammable and ignite at the smallest spark.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's webs are made out of woven leaves, and are highly conductive. They use their hands to traverse its maze of webs and strike from above in battle.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lingers deep within the darkest forests, flickering its flames to transfix prey and lure them closer. When the time is right, it lights them ablaze, reducing body and soul to ash that fertilizes the forest.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: Its many tails contain flammable liquid that POKENAME can release and ignite using its mouth. It will often spit flaming seeds at opponents while clinging to trees with its feet that are lined with many tiny hooks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spends their time conjuring leaf blades and training with them to gain proficiency. It's a long way off this goal, however, with its attacks mostly just being flailing and wild swings.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day doing what it does best: lazing around. It loves sunbathing on warm rocks but will rest atop trees if none are available. It is carnivorous when young and becomes herbivorous as it matures.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It makes its home in a tree in the forest, and then seldom leaves. POKENAME lies so still that a layer of moss grows on its body.
author: .jerden

entry: It constantly leaps from branch to branch in search of food. A diet of sweet Berries gives it boundless energy.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME hops on one foot along beaches in search of washed-up seaweed to eat. Should it lose balance, it begins to roll until it regains its composure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leaves its tail in sunlight to charge electricity within its body. It then smacks its charged tail into foes to stun them before following up with Crunch.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its heavy body, the many tiny hooks upon its legs allow it to easily scale vertical surfaces. It uses its bulky tail to crush up rocks into smaller debris for it to eat.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME nests at the base of a giant tree, where the soil is mineral-rich and damp. It consumes damp soil, filtering the water and minerals within itself, and then excretes the leftover soil; the soil it excretes is perfect for composting.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its massive jaws to dig up dirt to consume near the bases of trees. It loosely covers the holes left behind to act as traps to trip up intruders that threaten its home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp leaf claws to attack in battle, and while they may have short range, they pack a punch. It dreams to one day fly, so it poorly constructs gliding wings out of leaves.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME needs to live in very hot tropical habitats, or it risks falling ill. It can make its green tail incandescent to further empower its close-range attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME dips its tail in rivers to absorb water while it sleeps. When it wakes, it releases a puff of onion-scented powder.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nest around giant trees that are healthy and bountiful, tending to these trees every day to ensure they stay healthy. When they rub the ends of their upper limbs together, they produce awful odors meant to repel bird Pokémon and bug Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: It makes its nest in tall trees. It waits just high enough to be out of a child's reach, and if they climb to catch it, it will float higher and higher until there is no way for them to get down safely.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME's skin is extremely hydrophobic: drops of water simply glide right off. It is found in hot, dry climates and can be spotted roaming savannahs in the wild.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wild POKENAME will build treehouses on top of large trees to nest. Their treehouses are far sturdier than any human-made wooden structure.
author: cobalt0135

entry: It is said that the sound of POKENAME flapping their wings is equivalent to the sound of leaves blowing against the wind.
author: .duckyquack

entry: POKENAME hide themselves on the forest floor, blending in with the lush plants to hide from predators. If spotted, it can quickly sprint away, deeper into the jungle.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have countless tiny spikes along the soles of their feet, which allow them to climb upside down. When Trainers spot their crystal eyes glinting wickedly at the roof of a cave, many run away in fear.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: A sticky green sap drips from POKENAME's mouth as it walks. While toxic to consume, it helps nearby plant life to grow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to climb up tall trees while choosing one to be their home. Once they select a tree, they carve a mask from the bark of their chosen tree, becoming the guardian of this newfound residence.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME enjoys feasting on sweet fruits and berries. Individuals are known to viciously fight each other over the biggest berry trees to nest in.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME cultivate mushrooms on their backs to help the forests they live in. When the mushroom gets too big, this Pokémon removes and eats it.
author: totodile.

entry: Some POKENAME have a small jaw to feed on fruits and Berries instead of insect mandibles. A POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with its mushrooms.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME replenish their wooden groves by coating seeds with nourishing powders and planting them. They can climb any surface with ease.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME is a protector of trees.  It is especially careful with young saplings — if anything threatens a sapling under its care, it will use its arms and shell to defend it, while slamming its thick tail against the threat as a deterrent.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME acts as a guardian over small forest-dwelling Pokémon. Though it protects them staunchly, it has a no-nonsense attitude and will strike the little ones with its stick if they act too rambunctiously.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can often be found meditating in branches of tall trees. While they appear to be in a deep trance, they are hyper aware of their surroundings, and are always on guard in case lumberjacks chop down too much.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME can often be found lying upside down on lakes and rivers, as flipping them over is a popular pastime of many children. They can flip themselves upright at any time, but many simply choose to remain upside down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME waddles across beaches in the early morning, searching for leaves in the sand. It consumes them before diving into the sea once the sun fully rises.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fur is often in potpourri mixtures due to its citrusy scents. Wild POKENAME rely on these scents to help navigate the complex hierarchy of their packs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The ferocious, angry look POKENAME bears is just a facade to scare foes; inside, it is actually very calm. If two were to meet, they would never back down from scowling at one another until one becomes too exhausted to continue.
author: soup1900
