entry: POKENAME dart back and forth along branches, shooting seeds at berries to knock them down for food. They hurriedly gather fallen berries with their tails before running back up into the trees for shelter while they eat.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME live in large swarms that all nest within the largest tree they can find; these swarms can be as large as at least 25 POKENAME. Though they feed on leaves and fruits, they tend to leave their nesting tree alone to try and preserve it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME anchors itself to trees with an unusual green silk that is covered in small hooks. Though it cannot move, it never panics under any situation and will stare down foes many times its size.
author: torterrable

entry: POKENAME gather in large numbers within a massive tree in the forest, covering the canopy in green silk. They inadvertently cut off nearly all sunlight from reaching their tree, weakening it over time.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME scatters a musty dust from its wings while flying over turnip fields at night. This prevents a multitude of plant-based diseases and promotes growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leaps onto travelers from the branches of its tree home. On impact, it explodes, sending seeds in all directions like shrapnel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits seeds angrily at anyone who ventures close to its jungle home. Should they draw too near, it strikes at them with its fan-like leaves.
author: .izik

entry: Flocks of POKENAME are commonly found in forests preying on a variety of bug Pokémon. Their green bodies allow them to easily blend in with the foliage.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME  make nests on cliffs near sea level and use their wings to push back any water trying to enter their home. They have hooks at the bottom of their feet that prevent them from being pushed around by these waves.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME often find themselves in danger but are just as likely to escape. Whether they climb a tree or slide across water, they almost always find a way to flee from predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: After POKENAME punches the ground, nearby trees sprout fruit more abundantly. Unfortunately, the fruit produced is much less flavorful as a result.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME wave their tails around, they cast a grassy scent around; this scent is also subtly influenced by their diet. POKENAME have a habit of collecting round objects and playing with them, even nuts and berries.
author: infinex21

entry: With a certain degree of control over plants, POKENAME twists vines into its body to allow it to have a set of controllable hands. This makes traversal and gathering much easier, as it can extend its reach to far-off places.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME eats the buds off tree branches to power its internal electrical battery. It unleashes large bursts of electricity from its tail to strike predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in large tree nests shared by others of their kind. As they grow older, they seek out partners with positive electrical charges. When a pair finally connects, sparks burst from their bodies as their currents balance.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Using the many tiny barbs on its nubby arms, POKENAME can cling to vertical surfaces, like trees. Opening its mouth and waiting, this Pokémon uses natural cover and gravity to its advantage to catch food.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The nectar leaking from POKENAME's tail is always close to boiling. It splashes this at foes who venture too close to its favorite berry trees.
author: .izik

entry: When walking on tree branches, POKENAME often stumbles due to its clumsy gait and falls to the ground. If its tail appears faded, it means there is not enough humidity in the air.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME digs out burrows in the dirt near its favorite trees. It warns those that draw near by clicking its claws rapidly; if the warning it ignored, it starts pelting them with seeds and sharp leaves used as projectiles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emit loud screeches to disorient predators, knock loose fruits and nuts, and soften up hard foods. They nest within tree hollows and small burrows at the bases of trees.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live in tall seagrass, using their bodies' natural color to blend into the surrounding flora. When a potential target swims close to the grass, a school of POKENAME will dart forward and attack it with a barrage of electrical attacks.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's unmatched dexterity allows it to easily maneuver in dense jungles. When it sees a strong opponent, it engages with reckless abandon.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can leap out of the water at sudden and surprising speed, able to clear up to 150 feet from the water in a single bound. While technically amphibious, they typically live underwater.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Carpenters use POKENAME to chop down thick branches from tall trees. POKENAME use the small hooks on their feet to hang upside down while they work; this is done purely to show off.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME fires seeds rapidly from its tentacles at prey above the ocean's surface. It uses this to knock Pokémon like Wingull from the sky so it can feed.
author: .izik

entry: Once POKENAME picks out a tree to live in, it goes about meticulously searching for large rocks to surround the trunk with. A POKENAME den isn't truly a home until it's a proper mix of plant and stone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME watches over groups of Caterpie in the wild to insure their safety. It uses the long leaf on its forehead like a whip to lash out at anything that would harm them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sets up elaborate traps around its territory to deter intruders. If it encounters a trespasser, POKENAME strongly thwacks them with its stick.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME use their many leaves and deep green colors to conceal themselves as they leap between trees and clusters of bamboo culms. They wield pieces of bamboo to launch projectiles at foes and to deliver swift, hard blows.
author: infinex21

entry: It carries Joltik in its hair to clean it of other bug Pokémon and give it a silky appearance. It will remove its Joltik before it performs its songs.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME lives in vast rivers deep within tangled forests. It acts as a vessel and ferries small Pokémon on its back, carrying them across the river. The tall grass hides the passengers, and the berries they drop in exchange fertilize the grass.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's flat body glides through jungles at remarkable speed. If detected, it emits rapid beeps before firing a Psybeam.
author: .izik

entry: The sharp leaf-blades on POKENAME's limbs make it a very efficient combatant. Though typically eating only fruits and berries, in times of dwindling food supplies it will hunt smaller forest denizens.
author: sk372

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's behavior is not well understood. It will rarely steal carried objects from passersby, even more rarely under the guise of invisibility.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's cellular composition is not well understood. Its appearance morphs depending on its habitat; it dons a bluer hue during the rain, for example.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's behavior is not well understood. It will rarely steal carried objects from passersby, even more rarely under the guise of invisibility.
author: bobosmith01

entry: To grow stronger, POKENAME practices its Leaf Blade strikes against the force of rushing waterfalls. It is a voracious Pokémon that devours anything it catches in its powerful jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME hides amongst the trees until its prey wanders close, then charges. When swimming, its crest is easily mistaken for a cattail.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It's rarely seen in the wild because its coat of foliage blends in so well. POKENAME requires lots of water to keep its leaves healthy.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's small body overheats easily, so it almost never ventures far from cool water to soak itself in. Water POKENAME dips itself into constantly develops a very aromatic floral scent.
author: sk372

entry: The long frond on POKENAME's head floats on top of the water whilst they remain submerged beneath. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is scared of everything and hides submerged underwater. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water, so it can make a quick getaway.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Using the leaves that grow out of their body, POKENAME gather sunlight to charge their precognitive powers.
author: glacierwing

entry: They hunt in groups at night, using dense foliage for cover. They've been observed stalking single targets for hours before they finally strike.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME shells ooze a thick amber-like substance that, when dried out and purified, is a popular ingredient in many cosmetic products. Beauties in Hoenn are particularly fond of POKENAME infused bath salts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are popular amongst arborists thanks to their habit of keeping trees clear of dead growth and parasitic fungi, whilst also roosting within them. The bright red tips of their wings add a nice accent to compliment the green of the tree.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It swings through treetops with its prehensile leaf on its head and its long, sticky tongue. It will dance through the air while doing this very ungraceful movement.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME usually guards abandoned ruins in jungles and rainforests. It paralyzes its victims with its poisonous teeth and then finishes them off with the sharp leaf on top of its head.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the long solid curl on its head to help dig holes in soil to place its round tail into. The tail produces an enzyme that, when absorbed into soil, helps plant life in the vicinity to be more thoroughly nourished.
author: sk372

entry: The leafy blades on POKENAME's arms double as digging tools, able to slice through rocks with ease. After securing a meal of plant roots, they return to their burrows for a nice nap underground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can swing the long leaf on its head with enough force to crack a log; despite this, it primarily uses the sharp leaves on its arms to fight. It prefers to stay high atop trees and move between them rather than be on the ground.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's extra vibrant coloration gives it a high standing amongst its peers. It has a bit of a superficial ego, and does not respond well should anything cause it to become dirty.
author: sk372

entry: For lumberjacks or anyone doing lawn care, POKENAME are a reliable partner for clearing wood and grass. With their leafy blades, they can cut down the area around them with ease.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's deep green feathers allow them to camouflage in jungle thickets while foraging. They can easily leap into tree canopies to escape predators or launch fireballs as a counterattack.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME sometimes thrash their arms and legs when sleeping. It's thought they may be training or fighting opponents in their dreams when this happens. Their Leaf Blade attacks are strong enough to cut through thick tree trunks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME sometimes thrash their arms and legs when sleeping. It's thought they may be training or fighting opponents in their dreams when this happens. Their Leaf Blade attacks are strong enough to cut through thick tree trunks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can be found by mountain lakes. It will often change its sleeping habits, sometimes dozing in the lake and other times at the tops of trees.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Due to a diet of soil and seeds, POKENAME's water is quite high in mineral content and vitamins. Some regions prefer POKENAME water to make healthier batches of tea and other beverages.
author: sk372

entry: The sticky vines growing around POKENAME's pond animate at its will. They ensnare prey that draws too close before it finishes them with torrents of water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a scent from the leaves on its arms that overwhelms nearby creatures with empathy. The feeling vanishes the moment the scent dissipates.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME channels telekinetic energy into the leaf on its head. This allows it to strike foes well beyond the leaf's physical reach.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME draws psychic energy through its ponytail, channeling power from nearby plants. In arid regions, it struggles to access this strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leaflike dress thickens during winter months. It wraps this foliage around its kin, using psychic energy to soothe them against the cold.
author: .izik

entry: It is able to change the color of its leaves to match its surroundings. It hunts for small bug Pokémon to eat by nimbly jumping through the treetops.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sheds the leaves on its arms once per week. These leaves can be used to brew a beverage that is supposedly good for enhancing muscle strength, but the drink's flavor is incredibly bitter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in dense jungles, blending into foliage thanks to their chlorophyll-rich hide. They are territorial and will ambush rival Pokémon that get too close, trying to strike at them with toxic spurs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME makes its home inside dense jungles. It hunts by remaining motionless for hours, using its cleverly disguised maw to snap at prey that wander too close.
author: mepp.

entry: What at first appears to be leaves and branches is actually a set of large jaws with enough power to bite fresh logs in two. Despite this power, they only seek to care for their forest homes and to gorge themselves on their favored fruits.
author: infinex21

entry: It is a swift jungle-dwelling Pokémon known to cut down trees and steal objects from others, but only on rare occasions. The explanation for these behaviors is not known. The leaf on its head is sharp enough to cut through wood in a single strike.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although typically good-natured, POKENAME is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve its goals and, as a result, can become combative and stubborn. It likes to watch the sunrise, perhaps due to the energy it receives.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although typically good-natured, POKENAME is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve its goals and, as a result, can become combative and stubborn. It likes to watch the sunrise, perhaps due to the energy it receives.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The long leaf growing from POKENAME's head smells of pistachios and strawberries when it is near those it is fond of. Should it spot someone it dislikes, it slams the leaf into them like a maul to send them flying.
author: .izik

entry: The bright red coloration on parts of POKENAME's shell serves as a warning to attackers. Those parts of its body are highly poisonous, causing severe rashes and swelling if direct contact is made.
author: sk372

entry: A tower-like tree grows from the patch of dirt floating near POKENAME's body. The leaves that wave in the wind like miasma are primarily used in tea for their sweet flavor.
author: .izik

entry: While hunting prey, it ignites gas produced in its belly to launch itself between branches in rapid succession, though it's very careful to not set any trees alight.
author: catsquatch_geography

entry: The long leaf on POKENAME's head bursts into flames when it begins losing a fight. This somehow increases its energy reserves and reaction times.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leg muscles are strong and well-developed, but their stocky body makes leaping difficult. This does not stop them from trying, even if their pride suffers for it.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME voluntarily leaves some of its leaves in the lakes where it lives to purify the water. It is an extremely agile creature both underwater and in the forest it usually roams.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The leaves that grow from POKENAME's body have a razor-sharp edge. POKENAME use their leaf-bladed flippers to chop their way through the undergrowth, allowing them to navigate the dense jungles they call home.
author: vic1312

entry: With a leaf blade and additional leaves used for camouflage, POKENAME brutally protects the forest's trees with cover of the underbrush.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The leaves growing out of POKENAME's body help them camouflage in dense forests. A pack will sneak up on large prey before pouncing with poisoned claws. They will only stick together for a meal before splitting off again.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses its long ribbon-like leaves to cling to branches and move swiftly through the jungles it inhabits. If it sees Pokémon fighting, it releases a calming herbal scent.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME prefers damp environments with plenty of sunshine. As it photosynthesizes, the mushroom on its head and the leaves on its tail steadily grow larger and fuller.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon is covered in tiny hairs that can refract light. Combined with the leaves that grow from its body as camouflage, it becomes virtually invisible to both enemies and allies alike.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: POKENAME lives deep in the thickest jungles. It is said that those who touch its leafy tails will be cursed and stolen away.
author: .realthree

entry: It can scale up and swing through the jungle with incredible speed thanks to its powerful muscles. It is too spirited and hyperactive to be stealthy, so it quickly and effortlessly gathers the most delicious fruit instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The leaves on its body provide camouflage in the jungle. However, POKENAME is incapable of remaining still, and chases after prey rather than waiting in ambush.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME follows boats to play with those on board. It regularly splashes them with water using the long leaf on its head.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves that grow out of a POKENAME's body are as hard and sharp as small blades. Their leaves get dull and wilt before being shed; POKENAME typically eat their own shed leaves, as they are still rich with nutrients.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spins on its gear, turning faster and faster until it finally lets go, propelling it over swaths of trees. POKENAME can travel miles this way, though doing it too much can be tiring.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME whips its largest leaf against trees as it travels through the jungle. This leaves behind a subtle Green Apricorn aroma that communicates its territory to others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are found in areas with sweltering heat and lots of sun. It uses sudden and incredible bursts of speed to capture prey. Hiding in dirt or sand is pointless: it can dig extremely quickly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are most populous in tropical forests where there is not too much nor too little rain. They may suddenly drop down from the tops of trees to ambush prey.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live most of their lives hopping from tree branch to tree branch. They rarely ever touch the ground.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME have a chirp that sounds like a whistling blade of grass, allowing their parents to know when to come back to the nest with food. While many coexist with their kin, it is not unheard of for POKENAME to abandon a nest once they get big.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in lush caves full of flora, where they blend in perfectly. They crawl along the wall unseen and search for crystals embedded in the cave walls.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME consumes poisonous plant life to store poison within its body. It sprays this at foes to cause nausea and seizures.
author: .izik

entry: Despite their bulkiness, POKENAME are surprisingly agile. These Pokémon are often raised for the leaves and scales that shed from their body, which are collected for use in herbal medications. The pampering brings out their vain attitudes.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has been puzzling scientists for years. While leaves keep growing out of it's body, POKENAME seems to be hollow.
author: astral_1447

entry: By releasing bursts of sonar from its ears, POKENAME can manipulate nearby plant life. It uses this to ensnare foes with thick vines.
author: .izik

entry: The long leaf on POKENAME's head is highly sensitive to changes in air pressure. It lets it sense changing temperatures early, migrating over the seasons to remain in cooler areas year-round.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME crafts its wand from branches found on jungle trees. It uses this to control nearby vines and flora, striking foes from a distance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can harness the nature around it and grows grass wherever it steps. It travels to badlands, turning them into lush meadows in under a week and sustains itself on the vegetables it grows.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME use their agility and leafy appearance to pick off opponents in forests while remaining camouflaged. They have enough skill to blindside Greninjas.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME uses its arms and head to hide as a lily pad and leaves in water. Unfortunately, the stalk that sprouts from its top often gives it away.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME skitters across sandy beaches using the leaf on its head to cut open fallen coconuts. It drinks the liquid inside but leaves the flesh untouched for others of its kind to consume.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their leafy tails to fight and to cut down fruits and nuts. They are inherently timid, so they quickly forage for food, gather it within their bushy fur, and then flee back to their dens to eat and rest.
author: infinex21

entry: Curly vines grow from any soil that POKENAME's wing dust falls on the moment moonlight touches it. The vines grow longer the more moonlight remains in contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can create nests for its flock by digging its talons into the dirt and growing thin vines. This provides comfortable homes during their autumn and spring migrations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soars above beaches where the leafy fronds on its body whistle with each dive. This whistle often confuses other bird Pokémon, causing them to fly into trees trying to follow the sound.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's agility makes them a tricky opponent in battle. They deftly climb trees and skate along the surface of water to attack and dodge, making the most of their surroundings.
author: chibitales

entry: Each punch POKENAME connects releases a pleasant blueberry scent into the air. This makes sparring matches between two of its kind a delightful experience to witness.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail is strong enough to knock loose fruits in a tree with just a few strikes. When the leaf on its head is caressed, a verdant aroma is released; it only lets those it trusts touch this leaf.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME perches comfortably on tree branches while keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings. When prey draws close, it swiftly pounces to take them down.
author: mepp.

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head stays extremely warm even in winter. It wraps this leaf around smaller Pokémon to help keep them warm during blizzards.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fakes a playful and foolish personality, causing prey to underestimate the Pokémon's abilities. When prey gets close, POKENAME will use a harsh Leaf Blade.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The edges of POKENAME's bodies are razor sharp. When attacking a target in a school, a single POKENAME can rush past the foe, slashing them with their body, and electrocute them as a group. They hide amongst kelp and seagrass to naturally blend in.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME wraps its body around mangrove branches like a vine, waiting for prey to draw close. When they do, it unleashes bolts of electricity to stun them before feeding.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can run from one end of the forest to the other in a flash thanks to its powerful legs. When it blows flames from its mouth, its mane of leaves vibrates, spreading the scent of freshly cut grass through the air.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME basks in the sun, the fire on its tail grows hotter and hotter. It has incredible climbing ability and is usually found at a somewhat higher altitude than most Pokémon in a given area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME soars high above the forests, keeping a vigilant watch over its territory, and dives swiftly the moment it detects a threat. The leaves along its forearms harden into razor-sharp blades, which it wields with precision to strike its foes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite their bulky muscles, POKENAME are quite nimble and can leap from tree to tree with ease. A kick from one is strong enough to split logs.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME runs through the jungle undergrowth, searching for food. The berry it grows on its back is highly valuable for its medical properties.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME wield pieces of bamboo to shoot small stones, hard nuts, and fruit seeds at threats to themselves and their homes. The leaves on their arms are sharp enough to cut through bamboo in a single stroke.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's blades are made of sturdy leaves and the helmet it wears is made of layered plant stems. Those who fell trees have reported being attacked by this Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME tears through the jungle at breakneck speed. When it encounters a tree too thick to knock down, it tears its way through with powerful claws and hind legs.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME's skilled dance disperses its seeds into its dancefloor. At the finale of its dance, gorgeous flowers emerge from these seeds.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its pincers' bristles give it a secure grip on whatever it holds. When two POKENAME fight, their bristles may interlock, causing the POKENAME to be stuck together.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME is a hot tempered wild Pokémon of the jungle. It searches for opponents to fight, and will instead attack thick trees if it cannot find one.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its frills serve both as gills and a means to efficiently absorb sunlight. The yellow bulbs lining its body store both water and sunlight, resulting in them being nutrient-rich. It can launch its regenerative tail with a strong jet of water.
author: infinex21

entry: The red parts of its body glow when it channels its internal electricity. It uses its sharper leaves to quickly slash at foes before releasing a powerful bolt of Thunder from the tip of its bushy tail.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME absorbs sunlight to become stronger. The leaves on its neck and tail help regulate its body temperature.
author: escollari

entry: POKENAME travels cyberspace consuming information about herbs and plants. If it identifies a potential cure for a patient, it may display helpful images on nearby hospital systems.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is thought to be an ancient ancestor of Aerodactyl and Sceptile. Its powerful wings let it fly at high speeds, even through dense trees.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly strong, able to swing around the small tree attached to it with relative ease. This tree is used to great effect as a powerful club, slamming into opponents with crushing force.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME live in swarms in the jungle and are extremely territorial. If their nest is approached, they will fiercely attack, using their large tree-like stingers to inflict venom onto their perceived threat.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME fiercely protects the jungles it dwells in. Through this self-appointed, guardian-like duty, compassion has bloomed in its once-savage heart.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: It is a powerful forest-dwelling predator that uses its flames and incredible agility to prey on other Pokémon. The seeds on its back can combust into flames on POKENAME's command. They regrow within several sunlit days.
author: bobosmith01

entry: What was once a lush bush on its back soon began burning. The sticks on its back burn forever; it has to be careful not to burn down its jungle home.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME acts as a scout for Sceptile, scoping out its territory and relaying messages of danger or intruders. Sometimes it acts too foolhardy and tries to take on these dangers itself, to varying levels of effectiveness.
author: sk372

entry: It ardently watches over ancient jungle temples, even when they have been uninhabited for millennia. The seeds on its back are said to have been used by ancient oracles to inspire visions, but the details of the ritual have been lost to history.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME forage for berries in the jungle, hoarding them in their dens. The leaves along their tails are razor-sharp, which they swing wildly at anyone who gets too close to their food.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is a parasitic Pokémon. It digs its sharp root feet into the sides of trees and saps away their energy so that it can grow powerful enough to evolve.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME's skin is sensitive to sunlight and dries out quickly when out of water. To counter this, it raises its large tail to shade itself. The tip is very sharp, so when in the water, it uses it like a spear to hunt.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: While it lives in the tropical forests, it is usually found above the treetops. It enjoys the sun so much that one may hear POKENAME chirp while they explore the jungle. It uses its ability to predict the future to keep itself safe.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The patterns on POKENAME's body are used for camouflage in the jungle. However, its bright yellow flower is quite visible, and as such, POKENAME is also skilled at defending itself.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the rainforest soil, staying close to the roots of trees. It uses vibrations sensed through said roots to locate intruders, tunneling up from beneath them to attack.
author: sk372

entry: It carefully harvests rare berries from the jungle, using them to create a delightfully tasty juice. They are often found in cafés making this drink.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME will often begin their battles by launching their regenerative tails at their opponent. With this weight gone, they can move much quicker and deliver flurries of strong punches.
author: infinex21

entry: The ooze from POKENAME's shell causes nearby plant life to burn away into ash. However, it is also mixed with extremely powerful nutrients; in time, the areas POKENAME previously eviscerated will grow back more lush than before.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME roost at the tops of trees, sleeping with their tail feathers raised and wings splayed out around them. The leafy texture of their feathers help to disguise them amongst the trees as they sleep, making them hard to spot.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are the terrors of the skies with seed-like feathers sharp enough to pierce thick tree bark. The orbs upon their backs harness sunlight that they will release as potent Solarbeams with frightening precision.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are silent hunters, the rattle of their tails blending in with the sound of leaves rustling in the wind. They expertly navigate the underbrush, only being seen when they strike their prey.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It is very adept at moving through any wooded area. It has cling pads which allow it to dance all around rainforests.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME primarily consumes amphibious waterside Pokémon such as Wooper; anything it cannot quickly gulp down can easily be crushed in its powerful coiling tail instead. Found deep in the jungle, it makes its nest under the roots of towering trees.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sprint through dense forests in the dead of night. The only thing rarer than seeing them in person is seeing them stop their relentless trek through the wilderness. Despite their unreal speed, they travel while staying perfectly silent.
author: hummusishome

entry: A local caretaker within the jungle, POKENAME takes pride in the upkeep of its habitat. Its incantation-like cries aim to keep away any loggers threatening the peace.
author: poppyisconfused

entry: POKENAME are brought inside during the winter months because of their festive appearance. Once spring comes and they lose their festive colors, they are returned to the outside world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It gathers shiny objects to decorate the evergreen frond on its head, taking great pride in this process of adornment. If a decoration falls off its frond and shatters, it may cry over the loss.
author: hophoppip

entry: The baubles on the body of POKENAME jingle with a certain festive ring. Many families bring them inside during the winter months out of a jolly spirit, keeping them warm while they celebrate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many families keep POKENAME in lieu of a tree inside their homes to make cleanup easier. The baubles on their body have a festive jingle that is pleasant to listen to.
author: quackquackattack

entry: At home in humid Hoenn jungles, POKENAME flares its head crest to appear larger to foes and to cool off. When threatened, it runs fast enough to skim on top of water. If cornered, it shocks the enemy with an icy cold punch.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are incredibly stealthy Pokémon; being able to blend in with the jungles they reside in, POKENAME zip around at incredible speeds, piercing prey with their tails.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The yellow bulbs along a POKENAME's body store condensed sunlight within them that it can harness to sharpen its leaves into sharp blades. These bulbs grow quickly if they fall off and are a delicacy in certain regions.
author: infinex21

entry: It stalks prey by gliding from tree to tree, waiting for a perfect time to swoop and strike. POKENAME pins its prey with its expansive body and siphons fluids from them through its fangs when its prey has been secured.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME plants its floating seeds inside devices to cultivate and spread viruses and malware. If a computer fights back and tries to destroy the seed, POKENAME detonates it, blowing the device up into smithereens.
author: soup1900

entry: Though small, POKENAME are quite powerful and have exceptional dexterity. Their boundless energy leads them to often recklessly charge into battle.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's protectiveness of its forest makes it overly aggressive, often instigating fights and causing greater problems. The many sharp leaves on its large tail can be fired off in bursts, growing back by the next day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bright and ostentatious markings strike a powerful figure, and most Grass-type Pokémon look to it as a leader. Those who cause trouble in its forests not only face its ferocious might, but that of all its followers as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME protects jungles from lightning by letting itself get struck. This doesn't hurt the Pokémon, however; instead, it stores this energy in the seeds on its back. It can use this energy to launch its tail at blindingly fast speeds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME protects jungles from lightning by letting itself get struck. This doesn't hurt the Pokémon, however; instead, it stores this energy in the seeds on its back. It can use this energy to launch its tail at blindingly fast speeds.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite their short legs, POKENAME are surprisingly agile. The berries growing on their shoulders are sought for their sweet and spicy flavor as well as the massive amount of nutrients stored within. POKENAME raised with care produce bigger berries.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME have a reputation for training their kicks on anything they can find. They have been seen taking down large trees with only one kick.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME gets very territorial when strangers approach the muddy swamp it calls home. It shakes the large leafy plume on its head violently, emitting a sharp screech in order to scare off intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp arm blades to cut down bushes and twigs for nesting material. It is agile both on land and in the water.
author: mepp.

entry: While sleeping in mud, POKENAME causes clovers to grow from the ground around it. These wither the moment it wakes up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrive in lush swamps, their eyes able to see well even in murky water. They cut down prey with the sharp leaves on their arms, their tails able to sense prey from afar.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME acts as a forest guardian, attempting to deflect intruders with psychic manipulation of plants, vines and leaves around it. If something breaches these defenses, however, POKENAME is quick to flee in terror.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME channels psychic power through its tail when attacking. Legends claim this energy is drawn directly from the surrounding forest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bushy skirt is the perfect place for small woodland Pokémon to hide beneath when seeking safe shelter. It fiercely protects those that take refuge beneath it, repelling predators with powerful leaf storms and psychic blasts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's leaflike dress flutters rapidly while it channels telekinesis. During autumn months, the foliage darkens in color.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hardens the leaflike blades on its arms until they are razor sharp. It is renowned for acrobatic combat and flawless precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME primarily inhabits northern Hoenn forests and is fiercely territorial. It trains most intensely during summer, severing limbs from trees as practice.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wields a blade formed from compressed leaves. It trains by carefully cutting away dying or decayed branches from trees.
author: .izik

entry: The color of its leafy tail is an indicator of its health; if the leaves take on various colors, it is critically ill. It conceals itself within foliage and pounces at its prey, slashing at them with the sharp leaves on its forelimbs.
author: infinex21

entry: Its immense weight means POKENAME accidentally tramples the forests and jungles it travels through. Treedums come along to reseed the trampled lands.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME prevents Bidoof from cutting down more trees than they actually need for their dams, and it often ends up arguing with them. Since it loves Peach Berries, it stores a huge supply of them in its den.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It battles with blade-like arms that can cleave through solid rock and its bulky tail that can topple even petrified trees. It will use its arm-blades to secure itself to the ground and launch its large tail into foes. Its tail will regrow overnight.
author: infinex21

entry: The seed pod on its back grows throughout its life. Upon death, the seed pod will burst, creating an incredibly lush area of flora.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The green spot upon its large jaws exudes a fresh scent influenced by its diet, which is primarily various berries and nuts. It swings its bushy tail with immense force, often to knock loose fruits from trees or to quickly defeat opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME travel through the surface of rainforests. They await prey to step on them before swiftly slicing them.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME hunts in the jungle's rivers, where its seedpods allow the growth of lush aquatic flora. It can be tracked by following the path of plants it leaves behind.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME uses its brightly colored feathers to confuse and disorient foes. Ancient people often used POKENAME's feathers in ceremonial clothing.
author: kokoria_

entry: The fur upon these large Pokémon is actually many small leaves and patches of moss accrued from how often they rest. Every part of their bodies is densely packed with muscle, and a single punch could shatter a large boulder.
author: infinex21

entry: Smaller Pokémon often seek refuge within the canopies of the trees that grow from the backs of these Pokémon. While they do not seem to mind this, they will not tolerate troublemakers and shall go so far as to shed their trees to be rid of them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME consumes the leaves on its tail to keep it from growing out of control. If it neglects this grooming for even a single week, its tail becomes too heavy for it to drag.
author: jaminmcready

entry: High-quality berries grow on the shrubs on POKENAME's back. It is very particular about who it shares these with, typically only allowing them to be plucked by those who have bested it in combat.
author: sk372

entry: The thick ferns growing from POKENAME's shell turn a sickly brown when it falls ill. They fall off its body entirely if it remains sick for too long.
author: .izik

entry: The beautiful tiny red flowers growing from POKENAME's head wave in the wind like flames. It periodically strikes poses mid-combat, brushing its flowers back like a fashion model on a runway.
author: .izik

entry: The sweet yellow fruit POKENAME produces is praised for its deep flavor. If not submerged in water after being picked, it will rot within minutes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME jams its wings into the soil, causing large thorny vines to burst out and grab its foes. Once ensnared, it pecks at them furiously.
author: .izik

entry: In the deepest jungles, POKENAME is seen as an arbiter of justice. Its denizens will drag those who cause harm to the forest before POKENAME, who will judge them accordingly and deliver their punishment personally.
author: sk372

entry: With its ability to grow seeds and prune plants, POKENAME cares for the forest's flora. With its additional blades, it is its vicious defender.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME generate electricity via the friction of their leafy fur as they run across their territories, which is stored within their yellow fruits. POKENAME fruit is excruciatingly sour, to the point that it can debilitate prey that consumes it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's leaf-like plating is a durable as steel. They are also sharp enough to cut large trees, which they destroy to mark their territory.
author: mistymagius

entry: It flies swiftly over hot deserts in search of food. POKENAME have special lenses covering their eyes to protect them from sandstorms.
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv

entry: POKENAME live at the bottom of jungle rivers, quietly slinking along the riverbed. It very rarely emerges to the surface where its body and leaves shimmer, which is why it has been dubbed as one of the most beautiful Pokémon of the jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's green fur and soft paw pads allow them to sneakily stalk prey through the jungle. When POKENAME's prey lets down their guard, they leap in with razor-sharp claws. When enraged, they become ferocious and reckless.
author: chibitales

entry: The soles of its feet are lined with tiny, hooked barbs that allow it to adhere to trees, even as it leaps between them. Its yellow vines can extend to ensnare prey so it may deal a finishing blow.
author: infinex21

entry: Miles below the ocean surface, POKENAME seeds lush undersea vegetation. Its home is the center of a deep-water forest so vast that none but it have managed to navigate through.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to fly endlessly in the ozone layer. It has only been seen descending when humans have attempted to fell an ancient jungle tree.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME uses its power to control time to grow large trees and plants in a matter of minutes. Entire forests have sprouted overnight due to this Pokémon.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The leaves on its arms can grow and extend in seconds to become blades sharp enough to fell trees. Its roar is so intense that the very sound waves emitted seem to warp space around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rides whirlwinds high above the jungle. If they come across the campsite of an explorer, they will relish in causing mischief there.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME ambushes prey from the treetops, sinking its teeth in to inflict harsh wounds. If one of its targets tries to escape, it will relentlessly pursue them with astonishing speed.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME keep forests healthy by chopping down trees they deem necessary and nurturing young saplings. They are highly praised by rangers for their forest management skills.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The longer POKENAME stays in its jungle home, the more vegetation it grows across its body. It mostly lives a sedentary lifestyle, but intruders with ill intent will face a barrage of leaves and vines for their transgressions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can spit out its sharp insides with great speed, impaling anything it hits. Unfortunate Pokémon hit by this will then be consumed.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME is the apex predator of the jungle. With its astounding speed, it soars across the treetops and swoops down on unsuspecting prey.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME takes great care of all the trees in its territory. It shows no remorse to those who despoil nature, burning them with vengeful flames.
author: mepp.

entry: After an asteroid landed in the jungle, POKENAME emerged. It is able to alter its genetic structure to adapt to the harsh climate and catch prey.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen outside of winter. When it is spotted, Delibird and Stantler are often found in its wake, attracted by the rich nectar that forms on its leaves.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: Periodically throughout the summer, POKENAME grows sweet yellow fruit on its body. It is remarkably kind to nearby water Pokémon, freely offering the fruit to them.
author: .izik

entry: When the electricity in POKENAME's body begins to overload, it releases a pleasant aroma resembling Sitrus Berries and tulips. It is important to stay clear during this time as the sparks it emits can be dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves of its bushy tail are hard and sharp enough that it can scrape away scraps off metal and ores. Rough, multi-lined marks on trees and rocks indicate its territory.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's age can be determined by its tail. The flame will gradually burn down like a candle, the Pokémon passing once it's completely gone.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: While sleeping, POKENAME automatically extends its vines up to 15 feet in search of water. Once it finds some, its bud releases a strong corn and raspberry-scented aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME climbs up to tree canopies every week to find the sharpest leaves it can hold in its mouth, which it uses to hunt weaker prey. POKENAME is also known to use its bulky tail to defend itself from predators while fleeing.
author: aurange

entry: POKENAME will cut branches off strong, healthy trees and graft branches from other trees onto them. This practice of grafting allows the trees to produce larger and tastier fruits.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME store sunlight within the citrine crystals of their eyes to help them light the way through caves as they search for gemstones. They practice their dexterity by juggling their hauls on the way back, working up an appetite before they feast.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Only found in dense tropical rainforests, it seeds and grows poisonous flora so its territory better suits itself. The yellow balls on its body can be detached and dropped in an emergency, releasing a cloud of highly concentrated poisonous gas.
author: snileaf

entry: POKENAME lived in primeval jungles over 100 million years ago. Its powerful jaws are capable of ripping through steel plates with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: Known as the King of the Jungle, POKENAME stomp around their territories, roaring loudly to assert their presence. Their strong jaws can split a thick tree in two.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME performs energetic cheer routines to distract its foes with contagious enthusiasm. Once the enemy's guard is down, it swiftly strikes with its razor-sharp leaf blades and tail.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's leaf possesses a fir-like smell. It is often harvested and used to make air fresheners.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is a very territorial Pokémon. Using its ears, POKENAME can detect an intruder on the other side of its forest and hunt them down in seconds.
author: alphamerican

entry: POKENAME leaves behind a thick slimy substance wherever it goes, which often grows moss within the jungle. It gets picked on for seeming soft and squishy, but in reality POKENAME has sharp claws and a powerful tail in which to defend itself.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The diamonds along their bodies that produce a freezing air are also seeds that store, and can release, sunlight. POKENAME protect their boreal forest homes with their thick tails and with constructs of ice.
author: infinex21

entry: The seeds on its back gradually grow before bursting with pollen. This pollen will sap nutrients away from any flora it lands on, all feeding back to POKENAME.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: All the light POKENAME has absorbed led to a rapid rate of photosynthesis. This caused its body to sprout lush vegetation, able to be used as leaf blades in battle or expand into large, verdant wings to fly with.
author: evilgammon

entry: Once it finds a tree with delicious fruit, POKENAME claims it as its own. It drives off those who would steal from its tree via a terribly grating noise made from rubbing its tail across the scale on its head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grows chains of seed pods, which it will regularly shed and grow flora wherever it goes. These plants are often very rigid and sturdy, and were harvested in the past to create weapons.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME gathers specific berries and sticks from the forest it works to protect. These serve as the ingredients used to cast hexes that strike anyone who dares to intrude upon its hallowed ground.
author: sk372

entry: By waving their wands, POKENAME command flora to bend to their whim and ensnare foes. Nests made by POKENAME are often densely packed with vegetation to keep them hidden and their young warm.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's tail is covered in razor-sharp leaves that loosely resemble kunai. Through relentless target practice, it can hurl them at opponents with near-perfect accuracy.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME dances with forceful thrusts, causing flowers and vines to erupt erratically in a perfect circle around its body. The flora disintegrates the moment it stops.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is quite aggressive and fights off potential threats with its razor-sharp claws. The flame on its tail burns brighter the angrier it gets.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME slams trees with its thick tail to knock coconuts loose for others of its kind. It prefers to consume only the shell after others have eaten the inside.
author: .izik

entry: The vibrancy of POKENAME's fur patterns serves to indicate their health. They defend themselves with their large, bushy tails and by firing the yellow seeds on their backs; they also fire their seeds to knock down fruits and nuts.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's sharp claws are adapted for gripping roots and taking down prey swiftly. It makes its nest in the dense undergrowth of jungles.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spins mid-flight to dislodge the fruit growing on its back, sending it falling onto foes. When the fruit splatters, it releases a sticky juice that slows the target's movement.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fills its pouch with water as a safe, fun space to care for baby Pokémon while others of its colony hunt for food. If a predator approaches, POKENAME shields the young and fires sharp leaves from its tail to drive away the threat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME burrows endlessly throughout the jungles, its three heads working as one. Trees may suddenly fall into the ground as it passes underneath.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The yellow seeds on its back and on the tips of its tails are shed daily and regrow overnight; these seeds grow into trees but can also be eaten like fruit. Whenever it finds a flat surface that is warm and sunlit, it will take a nap.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME marks trees it claims as its territory with its sharp claws. The seeds growing along its back can release pheromones that lure unsuspecting prey into its domain.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME attract lightning, which often sets the trees it resides in on fire. It can often be found searching for a new tree in frustration.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The amount of leaves POKENAME consumes each day directly affects the brightness of its tail at night. During courtship rituals, it dances high in the sky, its tail glowing brilliantly above.
author: .izik

entry: The herbal leaves around POKENAME's head create soothing scents that are popular ingredients in various teas. These leaves are very bitter when they're raw, but take on a tangy sweetness when they're cooked properly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The juice inside the fruit that grows on POKENAME's back in winter is very hot and retains its heat for up to a week unless broken open. Some prefer to add it to coffee in place of sugar.
author: .izik

entry: It lives in extinct volcanos where no magma is left, but still causes them to erupt in a unique way. Instead of lava, the volcanos it resides in will spew out large yellow seedpods, which split on impact with the ground and grow lush areas of flora.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The orb atop POKENAME's head glows as it absorbs sunlight and moisture in the morning. Once sufficiently charged, it uses its power over time to accelerate flower growth in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: The seed that it carries causes irreversible nausea if consumed. If this seed is planted, it will grow in a spiral shape.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME slithers between trees using its vine-like body while searching for prey. It flicks its tongue to sample the air for targets like Fomantis.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cloaks its body in leaves to shield itself from the cold. By freezing them solid, it launches them with enough power to slice through solid rock.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The fruit that grows on POKENAME's body has a bitter taste. They are used in traditional medicine as a remedy for stomach aches.
author: mepp.

entry: A completely relaxed POKENAME will pose with its head and tail raised. This allows it to photosynthesize with its leafy tail and whiskers.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME flutters about woodland areas, sticking primarily to the upper canopy. Heart-shaped divots in tree trunks are a sign of POKENAME marking the tree as its territory.
author: sk372

entry: The oil extracted from POKENAME's seeds is primarily used for cooking, noted for its delicate fruity undertones. Long ago, this delicious oil was used in supposed “love potions”.
author: mepp.

entry: To attack an opponent, POKENAME's schools coordinate their strikes in waves. They use their bulbous tails to slam into their target, sending shockwaves through it and leaving it disoriented.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME latches its round mouth onto the trunks of maple trees to drain their sap. After feeding, the fruit on its body becomes extremely sweet.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sucker mouth to stick to the side of trees. When prey walks below, it will release its grip and fall on top of it, sinking in its fangs to deliver a fatal shock.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its poison is extremely potent, and it'll spit it at anything that enters its territory. The territory of a POKENAME can easily be found by searching for areas of thick kelp and seaweed, courtesy of its seeds that it grows and drops.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME flies high in the sky, looking for vulnerable prey on the ground. When it spots something, it dives at incredible speed and snatches it up with its claws. It's quite skilled at using its bushy tail in combat.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME can be spotted training by uprooting and moving trees. It relaxes by flexing in the sun, much to the annoyance of several Pokémon.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME loses a lot of the agility it could have had as an unfused Sceptile in exchange for unrivaled strength and a much larger body. They are often found defending small Pokémon against all manner of threats.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME can often be found in cafés serving as efficient waiters, able to carry double the amount of drinks as a human. Forgetting to tip this Pokémon may flare up its fighting spirit and result in a hard punch to the face.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME is fast, nimble, and impossible to catch. It can often be seen sprinting through the undergrowth of the jungle, usually being mistaken for just a small twig being caught in some wind.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME are near-impossible to spot in their jungle habitat. If one is stepped on, it will leap to attack and pursue the offender through the forest by agilely swinging from tree to tree.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME suspends seedpods within its gaseous body. When caught in the wind, these seedpods are blown away, spreading flora wherever they land.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME live relatively close to the surface compared to many other burrowing Pokémon of its size. At night, they rest underground, but during the day, they can often be found wandering in forested areas, with berries as their main food source.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is able to control the flame on its back and create flaming vines to attack opponents. During rainstorms, POKENAME will seek shelter to avoid spending extra energy to keep its flame going.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is constantly seen setting fire to random things it comes across in the woods. Fortunately, POKENAME's flames are too weak to cause anything but slight discomfort.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: POKENAME likes to decorate the tuft of fluff on its head with bone accessories. It's quite protective of the accoutrement; a POKENAME acts the most aggressive when it thinks its decoration is in danger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a common target for bird Pokémon due to its bright color palette. When attacked, POKENAME will spit fireballs at the predator using its internal fire, then flee.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is a very resourceful species of Bug-type Pokémon. It uses the crest on the tip of its head to absorb sunlight to boost its otherwise mediocre Fire-type moves.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: POKENAME are stubborn creatures that are known for having attitudes, igniting the feathers on their backs and legs to ward off strangers. Spending time with trainers helps POKENAME to back down from attacking and put more trust in people.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When POKENAME senses danger, it spits out boiling black ink and flees. It has a core temperature of 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME can rarely be seen buzzing about warm areas, eagerly awaiting evolution as they con tourists out of their food with their adorable antics.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: POKENAME have a fiery venom that is caustic to the touch. They prefer not to weaponise it except when genuinely threatened, instead hiding themselves away in tree canopies and within hollows in the trunk.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME transforms into other objects or creatures, its body retains its warmth and orange color. Even while transformed, POKENAME speaks with cheeps and chirps.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is popular with young women due to its affectionate nature, warm body, and bright colors. When it evolves, its fighting style changes dramatically depending on who raised it and how they raised it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: As POKENAME travels through computer cables, the cords grow intensely hot. Direct contact can result in painful burns.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's head are covered in a sticky substance that helps it cling to tree branches as it awaits evolution. When attacked, POKENAME spits fireballs at the attacker. If touched, the poison on its shell will harm its foe.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME can sleep through even a mighty blizzard thanks to it always being warm. To cool off, POKENAME shakes its feathers until they fall off; POKENAME is naturally so warm that it doesn't even need them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME enjoys making and eating all types of fried white meat. Ember cooked, Fire Spin fried, Flamethrower hot tossed, POKENAME enjoys any and every style. After finishing its large bucket of food, it takes a long nap.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's shed skin retains a strong warmth, and a spicy taste to it. While the spice is too strong for most, several strains of Fire-type Pokémon enjoy it as a treat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves following around Trainers for amusement. Many who have witnessed the presence of POKENAME claim that the air around them grows unexpectedly warmer. It can control its fire using psychic energy.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME enjoy sitting in the sun during the day. They snuggle into their nest at night with their inner flame keeping them warm. These Pokémon make excellent pets for the elderly as they enjoy the constant companionship.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's thick fur radiates warmth in cold months. It lines its nest with the shed fluff to insulate and protect its Eggs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME only have a weak poison and rely primarily on mimicry to protect themselves from predators. Their abdomen mimics the appearance of Torchic, relying on the resemblance to the fiery Pokémon to ward away danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in trees near farmlands. During the mornings and evenings, POKENAME will quietly fly towards the farm crops and feast upon the Bug Pokémon that threaten the produce. Some farmers are grateful enough to build POKENAME box homes.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME love to snuggle and will rub their cheeks against their trainers to show affection. While warm to the touch, if the person holding POKENAME is not grounded, they risk being shocked by the uncontrolled static electricity.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Despite its condescending gaze, POKENAME is quick to flee if confronted. To cover its escape, it will wildly discharge its electricity and spit out weak fireballs.
author: infinex21

entry: Being clumsy doesn't stop POKENAME from bouncing and dancing while overjoyed. This small Pokémon is loved by small children who are afraid of the dark due to POKENAME's love of the moon and warm body to comfort them.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are notoriously clumsy walkers. When these Pokémon trip over their feet, their elastic bodies will bounce off the ground and continue bouncing in the direction they were heading. POKENAME flap their stubby wings and chirp loudly for help.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME uses the shell from its egg as an insulator to keep heat around its core, as well as an extra layer of protection. POKENAME has been seen nibbling on the edges of its shell when hungry.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Having clumsy feet, POKENAME prefers to float in the air to avoid tripping. When this Pokémon is around stressful situations, it will land and try to find a place to hide or a trusted individual to confide in.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME chirps loudly at sunrise to wake up its Trainer. If its cries are ignored, it becomes frustrated and spits small embers into its Trainer's face instead.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: The keratin that makes up POKENAME's beak grows quickly. Due to this, POKENAME will rub its beak against rocks and tree bark to whittle down the excess material. If it goes too long without maintaining its beak, POKENAME will struggle to eat.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME toasts seeds as it eats them, but some become trapped in its gizzard, where they react with a gel it produces, creating a rich smoky flavour. These “ember pearls” are prized delicacies, leading to overhunting of wild POKENAME.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Young POKENAME remain in the nest while their parents gather berries for them. Once the adults stop returning with food, hunger drives the fledglings to leave the nest and begin foraging on their own.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Soaring the skies, POKENAME search for shiny objects for their collection. If these Pokémon find something they want, POKENAME will spit fire at the foe before swooping down and taking their shiny treasure.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Skittish by nature, POKENAME find security in their large groups. When the group is attacked, the bravest of the POKENAME will create a protective wall around their scared friends and spit fireballs at attackers to drive them away.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The bulb on POKENAME's back holds the flame it uses for its fire attacks. Basking in the sun allows the bulb to produce energy for the fire on its own and gives POKENAME time to rest.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When startled, POKENAME will shake the leafy feathers on its back, causing poisonous pollen to cloud around opponents. On cold nights, POKENAME will sleep in groups to keep each other warm.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in caring for the egg in the nest on its back. Sensing that something is threatening it or the egg, POKENAME spits fiery poison to disable the attacker and before fleeing.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in caring for the egg in the nest on its back. POKENAME will shake the feathers on its head and release scorching pollen to disable any attackers before fleeing.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in caring for the eggs in the nest on its back. When it feels that something is threatening it or the eggs, POKENAME will light the leaves surrounding the nest to protect them.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: It playfully pranks people by floating by while invisible and rubbing its body against others, startling them when they suddenly feel something unnaturally warm and feathery rubbing against them.
author: sk372

entry: The rear head of POKENAME spews fire far hotter than the front. It occasionally unleashes these flames behind itself to boost its speed.
author: .izik

entry: Very protective of its territory, POKENAME flies around with others to find insects to eat. Multiple POKENAME will unleash a loud cry before using their internal flame sacs to launch fireballs if threatened.
author: sakuraneko

entry: It gathers Berries, corn, and spices to store inside its shell. The heat and acid within the shell simmer the mixture into a warm drink perfect for winter.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME dislikes staying still, no matter the environment, and they especially love the outdoors. Incredibly intelligent, they will light small fires to keep themselves warm on chilly nights.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME molts copious amounts of feathers during summertime. These feathers stay eternally warm, so companies have profited from them by making pillows stuffed with POKENAME feathers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores its tepid body heat beneath a layer of fur to keep warm in winter. If it smells something delicious, it trudges through the snow to find the source.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Some history books speculate that the circus act of jumping through rings of fire was inspired by a POKENAME. When this Pokémon leaps out of the water, it leaves a ring of fire behind where it exited the water, though the fire quickly goes out.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Its metallic armor heats up whenever it gets excited, reaching a maximum temperature of over 500 degrees Fahrenheit. Because of this, it lives in badlands without plant matter that it could accidentally ignite.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME keeps their eggs warm by gently breathing fire over the shells. When a predator approaches their nest, POKENAME will hiss as a warning before attacking if the foe does not leave.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The heat generated by POKENAME is capable of completely melting computer cables it travels through. Even though it hasn't yet learned to control their flames, it is not a foe to be messed with.
author: blaizegamer

entry: Its entire body radiates warmth, causing many smaller Pokémon to flock close to it during cold seasons. It flicks embers from the orbs in its antlers to protect it and the little ones it shelters.
author: sk372

entry: Using the superheated feathers on its tail, POKENAME creates intricate woodburning art. By precisely controlling its heat output, this Pokémon can produce anything from faint brown etchings to deep charcoal-black engravings.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The fire it makes is blazingly hot. POKENAME has trouble expelling it with enough speed, however, so it will wrap opponents in its coils before torching them with a concentrated blast.
author: glacierwing

entry: If threatened, POKENAME will spit fire at its foes. If it does this for long enough, however, it will tire out and begin coughing smoke instead.
author: phantom640

entry: Though unable to produce milk of its own, many farms in colder regions import a few POKENAME. Due to their constant warmth, the farms' Miltank flock to it and stay comfortable during the frigid seasons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's eggs are highly praised for their nutritional value, making them the perfect choice for a hearty breakfast. It gives off a gentle warmth from its feathers to help incubate its eggs.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon loves to fly, even though it is still learning how to control its wings. When a POKENAME successfully lands after a flight, it will hop around and chirp loudly in joy over its accomplishment.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Using a combination of fire and electricity, POKENAME roasts berries brought to the nest by its parents. This makes the food easier to eat and allows younger siblings with poor control over their electricity the chance to feed safely.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When in direct sunlight, POKENAME's feathers reflect in a rainbow of colors. It will fly around and follow people it finds interesting; these same people have reported having increased life satisfaction when interviewed later by researchers.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME has a nurturing instinct that compels it to sit on and warm up any Pokémon eggs it comes across. It breathes rainbow-colored fireballs at any who bother it during this, including the egg's actual parents.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon hates water and hides in caves with its flock to wait out any rain. Bored POKENAME play with their fire while waiting, but their lack of experience sometimes causes a large fireball, setting themselves and their kin ablaze.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Skittish by nature, POKENAME lower their bodies to the ground and raise their tails to check their surroundings. After a thorough check of the area, these Pokémon will create their nests in this safe environment. They enjoy areas with lots of sun.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Swinging its tail around and rubbing its fluffy feathers together helps POKENAME conduct electricity for it to store. This Pokémon enjoys sleeping next to its Trainer, but has been known to accidentally shock them during the night.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME has a powerful digestive system that can easily incinerate anything it cannot digest. Although POKENAME will eat almost anything, a diverse diet is needed to keep their plumage looking bright.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a powerful digestive system that can easily incinerate anything it cannot digest. Although POKENAME will eat almost anything, a diverse diet is needed to keep their plumage looking bright.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in small packs for protection in their freezing mountainous home. As they mature, their feathers may take on a variety of different shades and tints.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME love anything that sparkles. By blasting desert sands with their fiery breath, these Pokémon create glass trinkets that they hoard in their burrows. Abandoned pieces are bought in local towns and prized as souvenirs by tourists.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's temperature frequently changes from being scorching hot to becoming icy cold at any random moment. To prevent itself from being in the dark, it launches fire all around until everything is lit and being consumed by pillars of fire.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day resting atop large trees to bask in the sun. The energy it gathers helps make its Fire-type attacks more potent.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful beak to crack open seeds and berries with thick skin. Basking in the sun helps it gather the energy for battle.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day resting atop large trees to bask in the sun. It will often fearlessly confront larger foes, scorching them with a barrage of embers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME loves to eat eggs and will raid other Pokémon's nests to steal them. However, it only likes cooked eggs, so it will roast them with its fire breath before consumption.
author: mistymagius

entry: Before POKENAME plants the seeds on its back, it sets them ablaze to burn off the protective shells. In the weeks before new seeds grow from its back, POKENAME's resplendent tail becomes even more golden and fluffy.
author: .realthree

entry: The excessive energy from fusion has burned off most of its feathers. However, its three remaining feathers now burn as hot as an industrial blowtorch.
author: mistymagius

entry: To make up for their lack of arms, POKENAME constantly train their legs. By honing the flames in their stomachs, they can unleash devastating flaming kicks capable of cracking concrete.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME  use the flames in their bodies to create silhouettes of Blaziken, warding off predators. If a larger Pokémon approaches, they will break this illusion, firing these flames in one large burst before fleeing.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME draws creek water into its beak to boil in a pouch within its torso. When in peril, it spits this boiling water at its foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fluffy down feathers are water repellant, allowing this species to maintain its internal fire while in water. On land, any water left on POKENAME's body will turn to steam as its body heat increases.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: This Pokémon's down feathers are coated in a thin, sticky film that prevents them from becoming coated in mud. While unsteady on their two legs on solid ground, POKENAME excel in movement when battling in the hot mud they call home.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Sensing emotions with the horn on its head, POKENAME uses its body heat to show its level of trust with a person. When this Pokémon feels comfortable with its Trainer, it will let out small flames from its beak with joy.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The longer the feathers on POKENAME's skirt, the more positive energy POKENAME has been exposed to. While unsteady on their feet, POKENAME will still spin around happily, occasionally falling, when its Trainer feels joyful.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's down feathers make up most of this Pokémon's dress-like body. POKENAME rely on their appearance to lower an opponent's guard, due to their clumsy walk, before scorching them with a fireball.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The yolk that seeps from POKENAME's shell smells of rot. POKENAME cheep happily when approached and given attention.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are affectionate and curious, their warm personalities making them ideal companions in cold climates. The heat radiating from their small bodies helps ward off the chill, bringing comfort to those around them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tongue is perpetually warm, able to cook berries it grabs just by holding them for a few minutes. It entertains itself by using its long tongue to juggle multiple fireballs it coughs up.
author: sk372

entry: Aside from the zigzag on its belly, POKENAME can change colors to match its surroundings. If touched by a living being or by water while hue-shifted, it will drop its disguise, lash out by spitting fireballs, and flee.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoys its days sunbathing, taking in nutrients it needs to keep the plant on its back healthy. When POKENAME is startled, an eruptions of blazing hot spores are released from the flower's stem in self-defense.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's small body is covered in soft down feathers, while its massive beak is comprised mainly of tough keratin. The body houses the main source of POKENAME's fire, and the beak expels these flames to attack.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: What looks like an egg is really a rock POKENAME carries within its water-filled blossom for unknown reasons. If you replace the rock with an egg, it's hard boiled within seconds.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME strive to be like their mothers and protect a family of their own. Using shed feathers and soft organic materials, they create large nests suitable for protecting future offspring.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Before fusions became a well-studied subject, some villages attributed the emergence of POKENAME to witchcraft and other dark powers. Most of a POKENAME's body is incorporeal with only its mask, its beak and its bird-like feet as exceptions.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The shell on its back is actually the one it hatched from, melted onto its back from the heat of its warm belly. POKENAME emits enough heat to make most things it touches melt. It uses this molten material to strengthen its shell.
author: foolish_weasel
