entry: POKENAME lives in poisonous swamps and polluted rivers, consuming toxic waste to improve the potency of its own poison. It often lies in the sun, waiting for the day its flower will bloom.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME dig out extensive burrow networks in the banks of lakes and large rivers, entire family units living within a single burrow. They are adept swimmers and will travel great distances through the water in search of food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's thick arms can store large amounts of water that strengthen its punches or be released as powerful streams. Its mighty horn is strong enough to lift and hurl boulders.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME trawl through the mud in deep lakes, stirring up sediment in their search for food. Their presence helps prevent the lake from stagnating, and the bubbles that escape from their shell re-oxygenate the water above them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME packs lurk in swamps, carefully watching anything they spot in their territory. During hunts, a small group of POKENAME will break off and burrow into the ground, only to ambush the prey as it's chased into them by the others.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME covers itself in plants from the lake floor when it grows sleepy. If disturbed, it retaliates with an Energy Ball and chases the offender throughout the lake until they leave.
author: .izik

entry: Heavily swampy forests are POKENAME's chosen region to inhabit. It will roll in muck, then cover itself with foliage and branches to look more monstrous and imposing in order to scare off troublemakers.
author: sk372

entry: More mature than their unevolved counterparts, POKENAME use their strength to move rocks and debris to help their parents create sturdy nests. Younger Pokémon look up to POKENAME and are driven to help as well.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME burrow through muddy shores, creating large dens beneath the swamp. Their claws are incredibly tough, able to punch through boulders with a single swing.
author: santon5512

entry: The fins of POKENAME are sensitive enough to detect environmental changes long before a storm arrives. After reinforcing its nest with rocks, it uses its distinctive cry to alert nearby Pokémon of the storm's approach.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Its fiery spirit boils the water within its body, increasing the force of its strikes. If it can't close the gap between it and its opponent, it will spray jets of boiling water from its wrists as a long-ranged attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly strong. When they sense an approaching storm, they use their heads to push boulders, creating barriers to protect their dens from flooding.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME love to play in the mud together, especially on hot days. Groups will often throw boulders into pools of mud, seeing who can make the biggest splash.
author: santon5512

entry: Rapid growth in its genes has caused its muscles to become even bigger and stronger. POKENAME could tow up to four cruise ships at once without much effort.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lives in muddy areas, typically at the bottom of swamps. On the occasions it comes out from the water, it uses psychic powers to keep a shield of mud around itself at all time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soaks itself in muddy water to meditate. The more mud it coats on its body, the stronger its telekinesis becomes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoy spending time near swamps, bringing their beloved Trainer to these places to relax. Their ethereal command of fireflies allows them to put on dazzling displays.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME camouflages itself within tufts of crown daisy near water sources. When prey draws close, it leaps out in a surprise attack and hurls the foe into the water with its tongue.
author: .izik

entry: The brighter the orange of their bodies, the healthier they are said to be. Their tails are dense with muscle and can lift large boulders. They change their bodily colors enough to blend in with the water, even while swimming.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME nest inside coastal caves and are highly territorial. They hunt a variety of prey along beaches during low tide.
author: mepp.

entry: A fully-grown POKENAME possesses immense physical strength, but seldom uses it to fight. Instead, this kind Pokémon helps young Pokémon survive in the wild. POKENAME often adopts orphans of any species as its own.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME's two massive jaws work as water filters, scooping up murky or polluted water. They will dig out holes to fill with this water, creating crystal clear ponds to lay their eggs in.
author: santon5512

entry: Using their sensitive gills, POKENAME easily locates food to hunt in deep, dark waters. They can control mud from the seabed to ensnare their prey in vortexes of dirt.
author: dahappycute

entry: POKENAME stomps through swamps and marshes in search of old, rotten tree stumps that are full of dense cellulose. It tenses its legs to build up energy before ramming into these tree stumps, breaking the wood into edible chunks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are extremely territorial creatures, claiming entire shorelines as their nests; they will viciously attack anyone who enters their domain. Their tails are capable of smashing entire boulders, and their strong arms allow them to swiftly swim.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME gather in droves within mangrove swamps to loaf about in the muddy, brackish water. When disturbed, they erupt into a violent frenzy, using branches to beat off their opponents.
author: vic1312

entry: It preserves energy by only moving to eat. However, it can be spurred into action by threatening it or anyone weaker than it.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME gathers rocks around its home to make a circle surrounding a garden for it to tend to. It's quite adept at planting and growing hardy plants that flourish in the muddy areas it calls home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can temporarily rear up onto its hind legs to appear taller and more intimidating. It cannot truly battle in this state, but rivals in the wild may engage in short bouts while upright to fight over territory, food or mates.
author: sk372

entry: The majority of POKENAME's shell consists of water. Docile by nature, smaller Pokémon have been found to safely inhabit it.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME are expert swimmers due to their strong arms and fins. Its combat style seems to be a mix of flowing strikes and crashing impacts.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its slender appearance, POKENAME is able to lift boulders larger than itself with relative ease. Its fighting style has been compared to flowing water, as it never seems to waste a single movement.
author: infinex21

entry: The frills on POKENAME's head are filled with liquid that grants it a remarkable sense of balance. It maintains its footing with ease even after spinning repeatedly while ice skating.
author: .izik

entry: Many compare their frills to one another to show off their shape. While each set differs, every POKENAME considers its own frills the finest and most important.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME swims through rivers, it causes reeds on the shoreline to grow rapidly. This effect disappears entirely during the winter season.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are averse to water exposure, instead preferring to roll around and lie in fresh mud to stay hydrated. They seem to be aware of impending storms, as they will head for clearings and look to the sky with mouths agape to drink up the rain.
author: infinex21

entry: Due to how high it has built its nest, it rarely leaves so as to not dry itself out. It can sense when a storm is nigh and will take to the sky, the rain keeping it hydrated enough to travel far.
author: infinex21

entry: Its fur smells of rich mud and seawater, even if it goes days without exposure to either. Its ribbon-like feelers are strong enough to lift large rocks; it seals these rocks together with mud to create its nest.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME live near underwater volcanos, their bodies tempered by the steam and hot waters. Their bodies have such fast-burning metabolisms that they often prey on larger aquatic Pokémon, and often with a vicious ferocity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is said to have sprung into existence when a divine lightning bolt struck a lotus flower pond. It has a resilient mind and body, known to move entire cities out of the path of hurricanes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Swampy, mist-covered bogs are the typical area where POKENAME inhabits. If provoked, POKENAME's mouth unzips to belch forth a wave of mucky muddy water to wash away unwanted guests.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME struggles to swim as the mud coating its body disperses in water. To compensate, it uses psychic energy to propel itself at high speeds. The mud on its arms is rich, making it fertile soil that attracts Grass-type Pokémon seeking nutrition.
author: xyloldi

entry: It submerges itself in beach sand, ambushing crustacean Pokémon whenever they get too close. Its skin will dry out, so POKENAME takes morning and evening swims in the sea.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its powerful body and disposition ward off all would-be threats to it. When it does fight, it fights so ferociously that it builds up a lot of heat in its body. It uses its sail to cool off during combat.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The appendages on POKENAME's face are advanced feelers that detect movement and temperature around it. Its tail is a sharp blade, and it uses explosive movement to swipe.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are golems from an ancient civilization that depict a god of floods. The divine properties of the mud created by its floodwater have brought POKENAME to life.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME soars above swamps, searching for prey in the water. Once it spots its target, it will dive down at them, clawing and sending cascades of muddy water to bring its opponent down.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME can walk on either all fours or bipedally. It has overwhelming strength and could easily level a forest if it wanted to. For some reason, it resembles a creature found in an old publication that was written off as a hoax.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME shoot jets of water from their wings, allowing them to swim through the water faster than a jet ski. Their keen eyesight let them navigate through murky waters even at high speeds.
author: santon5512

entry: Wild POKENAME will train themselves daily in their efforts to ascend powerful waterfalls. It is said that when they finally breach the top of the waterfall they will then evolve.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME plant their stout legs into riverbeds and let the rushing currents hydrate them and clean off their shells of any debris. If they ever get swept away, their large tail fins are strong enough to fight against the current.
author: infinex21

entry: The large frill-like leaves on POKENAME are extremely fragrant. Many florists use them to help water their greenhouses, prizing both their scent and water production.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fins contain its two actual brains, which occasionally swell under stress. The so-called "third brain" on the bottom is just extra moist skin with no real function. It often lounges around swamps to calm itself and relieve the pressure.
author: xyloldi

entry: POKENAME are passionate and dedicated workers, clearing debris after storms and aiding stray Pokémon that washed ashore. The eerie glow from their orange calcite eyes allows them to keep working through torrential downpours or deep underwater.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a mucous that liquefies solid rock on contact. Thanks to this, POKENAME spend their lives swimming through the ground, gleefully gobbling up whatever mushrooms they can find.
author: turron_turron

entry: The gaping jaw of POKENAME is filled with baby Remoraid for safekeeping before they grow old enough to leave. They clean its teeth and power up its Crunch by cutting through prey with sharp Water Guns.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME causes silt and mud beneath lakes to quake, disrupting the ability for many aquatic Pokémon to see underwater. Once it creates this seismic activity, it darts through the slurry of mud to sink its teeth into a fresh meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have incredibly powerful jaws, able to break any metal in half. They've been seen biting massive holes into large yachts, mistaking them for Wailord.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's body dries out and cracks if it remains out of water for too long. To combat this, it secretes a thick mucus from its body, though sustaining this takes considerable energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often sleeps covered in mud during very hot days. The mud acts as natural sunscreen and keeps its skin from dehydrating.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The muddy sludge coating POKENAME's structure-like body smells of onions. There are multiple layers of mud, each carrying the scent of a different variety of onion.
author: .izik

entry: The ridges on POKENAME's skull are highly sensitive to changes in air pressure. If it senses a cold front coming, it fashions a den made of mud to hide itself in to stay warm.
author: sk372

entry: The powerful fins covering its round body allow it to take very powerful blows without faltering. POKENAME feeds mainly on nutrients found in mud, which is why it is easy to find near small ponds or on riverbanks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If it senses a powerful storm on the way, POKENAME will move to protect itself and any other vulnerable creatures nearby.  It will pile up boulders to create shelter, and defend itself and smaller Pokémon by covering them with its rock-hard limbs.
author: imaginita

entry: Traveling Trainers learn to always appoint POKENAME on campfire-making duty. It excels at finding good twigs for burning, piling them into a perfect formation and delighting in setting them ablaze.
author: sk372

entry: A wild POKENAME constantly swaps out its twig whenever it spots one it finds prettier. It uses this twig to control and lash water at foes like a whip.
author: .izik

entry: A constant spout of water erupts from POKENAME's wand. Gazing into its reflection reveals how you will look in years to come. It is said that those who see emptiness in the water will not experience that future.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME often work with Pokémon Rangers to maintain peace in marshes. POKENAME will attack vehicles that dump waste in a marsh by throwing mud balls with enough force to significantly dent the truck.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The shed skin along its body is extremely absorbent. Because POKENAME needs to remain moist to be in peak fighting condition, it soaks its skin in water before battle.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME waits perfectly still in murky water for its prey to swim near. It remains in place even when other Pokémon step on its head.
author: corra_universe

entry: The water held at the end of POKENAME's tail is always sullied by minerals from the local soil. When battling, the heating elements on its arms and legs glow with internal fire.
author: .realthree

entry: Using their bulky arms, POKENAME will dig through mud at high speeds. They often haul boulders underground, constructing sturdy dens beneath the surface.
author: santon5512

entry: The bacteria in the muddy water POKENAME spits can cause high-grade fevers if accidentally swallowed. Oddly, during these fevers, the afflicted will feel intense infatuation toward anyone nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates whirlpools with its howls to capture prey like Magikarp. It then pounces on them with a furious Bite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's muscles are surprisingly dense for its size, to the point it can lift sizeable boulders with its forelimbs. It is inherently curious, to the point that it will effectively rearrange terrain so that it may explore.
author: infinex21

entry: Communities that experience extreme flooding often employ a small team of POKENAME who assist engineers in constructing levees. Their ability to measure out straight lines with their large tail fin is invaluable in their task.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME surround their waterside nests with large boulders, packing them down with mud to create a sturdy wall. This wall also serves as minor protection against predators, as POKENAME are able to skitter away before being spotted.
author: chibitales

entry: The frills on POKENAME's head vibrate rapidly during combat, releasing a high-pitched noise intended to unsettle its opponent. The noise is difficult to hear for those with damaged hearing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their large hands as temporary dams while their young grab materials. Their bodies are bulky enough to withstand even the harshest currents.
author: bigoljax

entry: The fins on this Pokémon's body can sense oncoming weather. If the weather is going to get bad, POKENAME will find its partner and use electrical signals together to warn other Pokémon in the area to seek shelter before the storm.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME makes its lair in marshy swamps where it can keep its long coils wet at all times. It has the ability to swallow its victims whole, using its teeth only to secrete a paralyzing venom that helps it hunt.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME train themselves by battling one another on tidal flats, fighting to keep their footing on the treacherous muddy sands. They seemingly enjoy being exposed to the elements and angrily tear down any flood barriers that people try to put up.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases pulses of electricity into the mud of its swampy habitat, stunning buried prey that it can then gobble up. It burrows a complex tunnel system through the muck to protect its young when it is away to hunt.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its dense body sinks quickly underwater, allowing it to walk along river beds. It can easily swim back to the surface through sheer muscle strength.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME have the ability to heat up their giant hands by rubbing them together quickly. In a short time window, they can form massive spheres of scalding water and throw them at foes.
author: bigoljax

entry: With their large muscles, POKENAME can be found playfully wrestling each other and Pokémon that are larger than them. To maintain their strength, POKENAME will lift boulders or swim laps around islands. Some establishments use them as bodyguards.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are extremely strong and incredible swimmers thanks to their four arms. They are often kept at shipyards, helping to pull cargo ships ashore and unload shipping containers.
author: santon5512

entry: This Pokémon moves with ease through the mudflats of its home, burying itself during low tide to keep its skin moist, only its rocky shell visible from above ground. If disturbed, POKENAME won't hesitate to show its immense strength.
author: picses_the_fish

entry: POKENAME is most often found in lakes. Its body can withstand intense conditions; if swarmed by parasites, it can raise its body temperature to 1000 degrees Fahrenheit. It's theorized that a single precise kick from it could cause a landslide.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME sprays its opponents with freezing cold water to slow down its opponents. The water saps heat from the opposing Pokémon, leaving their peripheral body parts with frostbite.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The swamps that POKENAME calls its home make its nose drip mucus. This mucus is vile and simply seeing it causes a hypnotic effect.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are shy yet humble creatures that enjoy living simple lives where they eat leaves off bushes and tree branches. They are keenly aware of their Trainer's perceptions of them and are surprised whenever they are chosen for training.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME senses someone grieving, it will offer them its bone. It's said that this gesture signifies brighter days ahead.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have poor eyesight and rely on their empathic powers to sense where their opponents are. They lash out from a distance with their long, stretchy legs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to sense the emotions of those they headbutt, this sense becoming clearer the harder they hit. Because of this, they frequently headbutt their Trainers in order to check up on them.
author: santon5512

entry: A POKENAME's vines are used in the production of Stable Mulch. When the vines are trimmed, the tips become a darker green before growing again.
author: .izik

entry: Said to bring good luck to anyone who sees it, POKENAME is a rare sight on the surface. It lives in the deep ocean, using its psychic powers to swim instead of its fins.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME senses hostility in others through its horns, and quickly goes on the defensive with its scythes. Being cut weakens the aggression in those struck, allowing POKENAME to flee once their fighting spirit is depleted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a powerful empath who struggles to control their power. When it detects feelings of strong rage or passion, their flaming tail bursts into a raging inferno.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is always looking to impress others with its pyrotechnic proficiency. Using its psychic powers, it transforms the flames it breathes into fantastic shapes and colors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often knocked from the water by other fish Pokémon. It will flop around the riverbank for a moment before teleporting itself to a different river or lake.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's soft horn lets it sense the emotions of those near it. It will only transform into others if it senses positive energy emanating from them.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME have a keen sense of the feelings of others, which they utilize to avoid most others. They often choose their own Trainers and only will appear before someone they are considering to be trustworthy enough.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has immense potential due to its psychic energy. It is said that this Pokémon's eyes are intensely beautiful, but must remain closed as it navigates strictly through psychic vibrations until its power is stabilized.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: When POKENAME inhabits a computer, it generates streams of complex mathematical equations on the screen. If ignored, it projects these problems telepathically until the user moves several feet away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is sheepish yet energetic, which leads it to stalk Trainers or Pokémon it enjoys spending time with. It wants to be around others but becomes overwhelmed when interacting with them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While in the presence of a supportive Trainer, the ordinarily self-conscious POKENAME will happily eat their weight in food to build up their Psychic power.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME is curious yet nervous, rarely venturing far from its burrow. It's said that if it chooses to approach someone in the wild to play, it is because that person possesses a kind heart.
author: sk372

entry: Timid by nature and with poor eyesight, POKENAME rarely pokes itself out of its home high up in trees. It waits until its psychic senses detect no others in the vicinity before it deigns to go out to forage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME senses sorrow with ease. Instead of eating nearby flowers, it picks them and gifts them to sad individuals to make them feel better.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a timid but kindhearted denizen of the forest. Should it sense sadness in the heart of another being, it spins webs in the shape of cute or funny imagery to try and lighten their mood.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emit bright lights and psychic waves from the special organs at the tips of their antennae to deter and disorient threats. These organs are as hard as diamonds and have been praised as foci for human psychics.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are nosy creatures that love to eavesdrop on private conversation. Whenever they are caught, they release a burst of sparks and a loud yelp. They can tell how angry their Trainer is by reading their minds and respond accordingly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are innocent little creatures that enjoy silly games and lots of fun. They can sense when their Trainer is upset and will do their best to cheer them up so that they can keep playing games.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ability to sense emotions increases with the amount of wool it has grown. Too much will cause it to become too sensitive and emotionally unstable, so regular shearing is necessary for its mental health.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spots another, it freezes in place like a Sudowoodo, though its bright colors often betray it. It learns to express emotion through mimicry, sometimes leading to odd or unpredictable behavior.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses its psychic powers and the wind to drift into towns. When it does, it feeds off positive emotions.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME often migrates south. However, it can keep itself warm through the winter if it feeds on enough positive emotions.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are often seen clumsily tripping into things. While this does not hurt them, POKENAME still find it annoying.
author: weirdtux

entry: The horn on its head senses thoughts and emotions. If it senses a hostile thought from within a certain radius around it, it explodes in self-defense before teleporting away.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME is known to drive off much larger Flying types who enter its territory by scaring them with psychically enhanced screeching. When confronted, it teleports a short distance above and dive bombs back with a hasty Peck.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Born with forehead horns that heighten empathy, POKENAME siphons strong feelings from people and Pokémon alike. It nests in hospital walls, haunts festivals and graveyards, and leaves victims drained — its rattling tail can amplify or mute emotion.
author: oddly.abnormal

entry: While inside a computer, POKENAME reads the emotions of any user on the system. Should it sense sadness, it will force the computer to run faster.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tends to live in snowy forests, where its mostly white coat helps it blend into the landscape. Its horns channel its psychic powers, allowing it to create faint environmental illusions and sense the emotions of those around it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME enjoy spending time watching professional fighting matches of all kinds, from Pokémon battles to boxing to wrestling. They get easily swept up in the emotion of such fights and will try to mimic the moves they see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Using the fins on top of their bodies, packs of POKENAME can locate vulnerable targets for their next ambush. They communicate silently through subtle fin movements before striking as one.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME enjoy spending time watching professional fighting matches of all kinds, from Pokémon battles to boxing to wrestling. They get easily swept up in the emotion of such fights and will try to mimic the moves they see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is a cheeky, playful Pokémon that often plays tricks on people. Despite its size, its bites are quite deadly and its grip is hard to escape.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME can channel the emotions of others through the various horns on its body. If it becomes overwhelmed by particularly strong emotions, it starts to sob.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Through telepathy and mimicry, POKENAME ensure their Trainer's feelings are understood. Many nonverbal Trainers find them especially helpful at conveying emotions, especially when they become overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can taste the emotions of surrounding Pokémon by feebly licking the air. If it tastes an emotion it likes, it bounces about with glee.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's body allow it to sense the emotions of nearby humans and Pokémon while hiding in the bushes. Whenever it uses its psychic powers, its body emits a strong scent of fresh mint.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It feeds mainly on morning dew to keep its leaves lush, which it uses to sense the emotions of others. POKENAME is an extremely shy creature, but it is capable of forming a very deep bond with its Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is highly attuned to human emotions. If it senses any hostility, POKENAME uses its clawed toes to climb to high places and hide until the tension fades.
author: larky_

entry: Even though it can teleport, it prefers to flee from enemies by leaping through the treetops. The horns on its head make it highly aware of danger.
author: larky_

entry: Shy by nature, POKENAME rarely reveals itself to humans. If a POKENAME senses good intentions with the horn on its head, it will quietly begin to follow that individual around. POKENAME are prone to tripping and will heat up with embarrassment.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Using the feathers on its head, POKENAME is highly attuned to the emotions of the people and Pokémon around it. If POKENAME's Trainer is happy, this Pokémon will puff up its feathers and celebrate with small psychic embers.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME does not exhibit psychic powers around those it distrusts. Once it trusts its Trainer, seeing it practice lifting and kicking boulders with psychic energy to improve its technique becomes commonplace.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's red horn allows it to sense emotions and vibrations around it. This enables it to be incredibly aware of its surroundings and can even predict its opponents' movements before they happen.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden in the mud, with only the fin on its head visible. Through that fin, it can sense the emotions of others, and will only reveal itself if it senses positive feelings.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME constantly monitors the emotions of those nearby. Should it sense sadness near its pond, it leaps out and sprays the person with water as a prank in hopes of making them laugh.
author: .izik

entry: This self fusion has horns on its head that resemble a crown.  Interestingly, while even more sensitive to emotions than a standard Ralts, its actually drawn to, instead of repelled by gloomy people, and will attempt to soothe their pain.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME are clever creatures that can manipulate how their Trainers feel to get what they want. By reading the minds of their Trainers, they can accurately determine how they react to a given stimulus.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While they lack the confidence, these charming Pokémon are said to have the sweetest smile of any fusion. They only smile for Trainers they trust.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME will hide away quickly via camouflage if it feels threatened by a stranger and the emotions it senses. If a POKENAME lightly licks you with its long tongue, it is a sign of growing trust.
author: sk372

entry: Every POKENAME eventually develops a strong attachment to a stick it finds, and carries it with it always. If the two are separated, POKENAME becomes emotionally distraught and inconsolable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through their pink horns and utilize this ability to avoid trouble. The saliva of their large jaws has a soothing effect on the mind, which helps them to elude predators and is very useful in medicine.
author: infinex21

entry: In the wild, POKENAME, despite being blind, are quite resilient. Stories have been passed around of one particularly tough POKENAME being hit by multiple Psyshock, yet surviving relatively unscathed.
author: retrodox

entry: POKENAME appear next to grieving families when they visit graveyards but will hide when someone focuses on them. They are said to ward off more malevolent spirits, protecting the family from harm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is generally quite shy and tends to hide when it sees others approaching. It is drawn to brightly-colored flowers, and can be coaxed out of hiding by presenting it with some as a peace offering.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME quickly forms strong bonds with Trainers it trusts. Able to sense a person's emotions, it clings to their arm or leg whenever it detects distress. The warmth of its fiery tail is said to have a calming effect.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME uses the horns on its head to sense people with food. It will hide from anyone who gives it food, but will come back and steal it later.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME can sense the self-importance of people and Pokémon. If it senses that something nearby thinks it is better than it, then POKENAME will show off with feats of strength to prove that it is superior.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME senses hostility with its guard and goes out of its way to avoid conflict. It even avoids being used offensively by people it trusts.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: By placing its feelers to someone's temples, POKENAME can read their emotions perfectly. It unfortunately loses this ability when it falls ill.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is incredibly timid and will cling to its Trainer for safety. If it is abandoned by its Trainer, it will become malicious and unstable, lashing out at anything that approaches it.
author: mistymagius

entry: It fuels its flame with the emotional energy of others. It will hang around those with warm feelings because those help the flame burn the brightest.
author: cybr_flame

entry: POKENAME have incredibly soft and warm bodies that make them perfect buddies for snuggles when the weather gets gloomy. They are keenly aware of how their Trainer feels and always offer snuggles whenever their Trainer feels down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a high sensitivity to surrounding emotions. If it senses panic, someone must throw it into the ocean as quickly as possible to calm it.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME appears to feed off strong emotions. It digs tunnels beneath the homes of people facing hardships so it can feed remotely while waiting for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: Its aura-reading abilities can identify even the tiniest hints of negative emotion. Its attempts to telepathically share these experiences are often mistaken for psychic attacks.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities manifest through its connection to aura. Due to its small body, it has difficulty controlling these powers.
author: melodydelune

entry: Capable of sensing nearby emotions, POKENAME prefer calm and peaceful environments. Although they appear placid, they escape with surprising alacrity if they detect strong negative feelings.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME are very popular. Many people consider them an ideal Pokémon to raise around a family for their soft coat and ability to recognize emotions.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME are being increasingly used for emotional support. Despite being timid when it comes to confrontation, they won't hesitate to shock whatever is causing their Trainer stress.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: If a POKENAME detects its Trainer is anxious or upset, it sings lullabies to help them fall asleep and ease their stress. It monitors its Trainer's breathing to ensure a peaceful rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can sense and read the emotions of others through their pink spikes, which are also strong enough to break through stone. They are inherently shy of others, so they typically stay deep within caves and may even burrow underground.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME tend to unknowingly project their own envy and sadness in regards to their longing for wings. Though they prefer to avoid fights, they will lunge with strong headbutts if they feel cornered.
author: infinex21

entry: If POKENAME is scared, it lets out an ear-piercing scream and fills its body with air, causing it to float away on the winds. It can rarely be found in grassy areas with moderate levels of elevation.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is sensitive to the emotions of others. When it is stressed, a poisonous fluid leaks from the horn on its head.
author: mepp.

entry: Should POKENAME sense someone nearby with a sad disposition, its petals begin to dry out rapidly. It will either attempt to relocate or try to cheer the person up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves making children feel better. It will search for bullied and unpopular children and play with them to brighten their day.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME can sense danger and will release calming pheromones when it feels threatened or perceives heightened tension in its surroundings.
author: greathead69

entry: POKENAME navigates by projecting out psychic waves into its environment. It senses the returning signals with a trio of sensitive structures on its head. It can differentiate between living things by feeling their thoughts, letting it avoid danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Using its empathetic powers, POKENAME detects sadness in others. It flies near windows and chirps cheerfully in hopes of lifting their mood.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collect shards of amethyst and other gemstones to try and amplify their psychic power. Unfortunately, they often have trouble controlling their hunger and eat away at their scraps before they can make any progress.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When POKENAME senses an angry foe, the normally harmless slime in its body becomes intensely toxic. Brief contact can cause nausea and migraines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stick together in small groups for safety and comfort. Their horns and cloaks are highly sensitive to the emotions of those around them, so even a hint of aggression in the air will send the entire pack into hiding.
author: sk372

entry: Groups of POKENAME can be found on frozen lakes, hitting ice chunks to each other. Despite being amateurs at the moment, POKENAME desire to become expert hockey players someday.
author: mistymagius

entry: These Pokémon are rather attuned to emotions and will flee rapidly if they sense malice. This is not just out of direct fear, but because their leaves flourish due to positive emotions and wilt if exposed to too much negativity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of the last person who touched the trash it consumes. Due to this, it sometimes needs to take breaks if overcome by strong feelings left behind by the previous handler.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME become agitated when they sense fear or excitement and will bite when they experience this energy for prolonged periods of time. Calming those around them before escalation ensures both POKENAME and bystanders remain safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME senses the fear of one lost in the forest, it floats its way towards them to be by their side. It comforts them with soft cries and gently leads them back out of the forest.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME senses someone nearby in low spirits, it releases loud noises from its horn to cheer them up. This rarely works and usually just causes them to leave the area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others with its horns from miles away. By vibrating its horn, it creates ultrasonic waves that pacify any aggressors nearby as a defense mechanism.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: When detecting others' emotions, the colour of POKENAME's clouds changes. They are usually pink and filled with stars, but turn grey and stormy when sensing negativity.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are popular companions for children without siblings, staying loyal to them for life. Its soft, cuddly fur helps quell negative emotions.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME absorbs and erratically disperses emotions through the sand connected to its body. If someone experiences intensely shifting emotions at the beach, odds are a POKENAME is nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's many horns let it sense the emotions of others around it in a wide vicinity. The horns glow brighter just before it uses its psychic powers, typically to teleport away due to its timid nature.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's horn lets it sense the emotional state of those nearby. Attracted to positive emotions, it likes to rub up against those positive people and give them friendly headbutts.
author: sk372

entry: Its enormous bowl cut acts as a focusing chamber for its psychic abilities. Eager to train both its mind and body, POKENAME with Trainers can often be seen working out at the library.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME senses emotions with the horn on its head.  The energy from these emotions can then be directed through POKENAME's twig, which will change color, and can even burst into flame in the presence of powerful emotions.
author: imaginita

entry: When POKENAME senses intense emotions nearby, its fire attacks grow twice as strong. The flames are produced directly from the wand it carries.
author: .izik

entry: While being blind, POKENAME can easily see its surroundings by emitting powerful psychic waves from the holes on its belly. It is very timid, quickly teleporting away when it senses the presence of another Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: When bored of its pond, POKENAME teleports to a different one nearby. It may repeat this multiple times in a night just to explore new places.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is attuned to human emotions, particularly those of affection. Small groups of POKENAME will gather near couples that emanate a particularly powerful aura of love.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hair has grown over its eyes, so it relies more on its psychic abilities to perceive its surroundings. When startled, it Teleports to its safe haven, such as a den in the wild or bed if domesticated.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wanders throughout forests in search of berries and friends. It is able to sense impending danger and will lead its friends away to safety.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a skittish nature, rarely peeking out from its home inside tree stumps. Sensitive to the emotions of others, it will come out and cling to those it senses have kind, caring natures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of those within 100 feet. It tends to fly closer to those with happy feelings, moving away from anyone who is sad.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME senses someone nearby who is angry, it involuntarily releases large bursts of green dust from its wings. This usually causes sneezing fits for anyone within ten feet, sometimes including itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME senses emotions with its psychic abilities to detect malice. If danger is too close, it flees or detonates to protect itself and its allies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME courageously stand between dangerous Pokémon and their Trainer, ensuring that minimal harm comes about. While not very intimidating, they can sense whether their foe is scared and can easily exploit the feelings of a moody Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The green feathers on POKENAME's wings glow when it senses happiness in someone below while flying overhead. This creates a dazzling display when a flock passes through the sky after nightfall.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often found in areas of beaches where there is plenty of happiness and contentment. They can be seen circling the sky during beach festivals.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME uses telekinetic force to push food out of beachgoers' hands, causing them to drop it to the ground. Entire picnics have been scooped up by its massive bill.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's antennae are sensitive to even the slightest emotional change in its Trainer. When sensing overwhelming negative emotions, it releases a sweet-smelling honey from its head, which researchers theorize is a placative gesture.
author: chibitales

entry: Its coin-shaped horn is infamously known to scramble data storage and measuring devices around it. Many dex entries had to be rewritten due to incorrect measurements caused by it, such as Magcargo's body temperature.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are rarely used in therapy. They will box against a human until they sense a sharp change in their emotions.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are rather sensitive to the emotions of others, though they display a keener awareness in regard to their Trainers. When they sense someone is feeling down, they will attempt to cuddle up with them and play in front of them to cheer them up.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are affectionate pets who love curling up with their owners on the couch while they watch TV. Unfortunately, they interfere with the signals that remotes produce, making it impossible to change the channel or volume while they're nearby.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME match the excitement around them whenever they cheer on their teammates. The greater the audience's enthusiasm, the louder their cheers become.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME senses someone who is angry, its body fills with a sweet-smelling acid. Should the angry person draw too close, it will spit the acid at them.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME senses irritability in someone nearby, the fin on its back grows scaldingly hot. Touching it during this time can cause third-degree burns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a hardy vitality, but a soft disposition. It goes up to people with positive feelings, hoping that the claws don't drive them away.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME senses the emotions and motives of others through the horns on its head. Easily frightened, the moment it senses hostility or aggression it hops away to find the nearest spot it can drill into to hide.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's will emit a bell-like cry whenever it senses strong emotion. The exact sound of this cry depends on the emotion felt; the happier the emotion, the higher the pitch.
author: dualblades1147

entry: It despises anger, due to its empathy causing physical pain when it experiences said emotion. It will only approach those it sees as calm.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME's senses alert it to the emotions and intents of others. Faced with aggression, it breathes out a misty substance that numbs and pacifies those that come in contact with it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are incredibly smart Pokémon but act credulously shocked whenever its Trainer shows them something boring. They want to keep their Trainer happy, so they are willing to tolerate being presented something that does not interest them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is impossible to determine when POKENAME is sleeping, though some say it must rest eighteen hours a day. Even while dreaming, it senses Trainers' intentions through its segmented tail.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When POKENAME senses its Trainer is worried about it, its strength tends to triple. If its Trainer feels overly confident, it senses this as well, causing its attacks to exert less effort.
author: .izik

entry: The organ on POKENAME's head is capable of sensing the emotions of those nearby. If its Trainer is ever upset or angry at somebody, it will not hesitate to suplex the offender.
author: craigprime

entry: If POKENAME senses someone with hostile emotions, it quickly retracts into its shell. It is said that the bubbles blown by this Pokémon can influence one's mood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are commonly found residing on dangerous hiking trails. With their strength and empathic abilities, they are known to find and rescue injured hikers.
author: thetapemaster

entry: POKENAME will tune into the emotions of those nearby due to the horn on its head. It is difficult to train as it can easily become upset and overwhelmed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are inquisitive creatures that enjoy exploring the area around lakes. If they sense that their Trainer is bored, they return with a small gift in an effort to extend their time out in the wild.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The bones wielded by POKENAME serve as conduits for them to channel their psychic powers. They seem to find these bones when they are young, from the remains scattered across vast deserts.
author: infinex21

entry: Moody and impulsive, it often stomps the ground in fury when it misses a kick. In the wild, POKENAME's tantrums split large boulders and down trees, but a patient Trainer can help it find inner peace.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME enjoys dancing along to music, but its simple mind leaves it unable to follow a beat for long. Many have seen a small group of POKENAME dancing to the same song, each with completely different dance moves.
author: sk372

entry: They are known to share eggs with each other, as each egg has a unique feeling. However, when they pick up a Lucky Egg, they are known to hide the egg so they can hog all the time with it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a rare sight for most people, as these Pokémon lurk and nest deep within the ocean. They use psychic powers to propel themselves and protect their fins; the symbol on a POKENAME's chest dimly glows as it uses psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the world around it and uses the appendages on its head to sense potential danger. Trainers are often impressed by its thoughtfulness when it brings them gifts.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME enjoys prancing around open fields and cavorting amongst the flowers peacefully. Interrupting these moments of calm indulgence is a quick way to wind up on the receiving end of its horns.
author: sk372

entry: It seeks to enrage its opponents in combat. The stronger their rage, the stronger POKENAME's psychic power becomes. It knows the best way to anger its opponents by peering into the future.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It enjoys entertaining others with interpretive dance routines that involve shapeshifting into various other Pokémon. No matter the sequence, the dance ends with a flourish done in the shape of a Kirlia.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are loyal pets, always sticking by their Trainer's side and guiding them away from any danger it senses. POKENAME's ears will often change colors when evolution draws near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are skittish Pokémon that rarely come out of their shells when others are nearby. They can perceive their surroundings with their psychic abilities and propel themselves with jets of water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME throbs and vibrates with a patient enthusiasm, eager to burst from its cocoon. Its excitement for the future is manifested in its constant movement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME will press against each other with psychic powers to fight for territory, trying to push the other out. They will let trusted Trainers use their stout bodies as pillows.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME has accumulated so much draconic energy that the energy has formed additional spikes all over its body. Being poked by one of these spikes can allow people to see glimpses of the future.
author: geo_ominous

entry: They were once a living thesaurus, as their linguistic knowledge rivaled that of university professors. They once served as scribes to nobility because of such knowledge, and helped pen important correspondences between nobles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dances while flying, spinning through the sky. With a flick of its mind, it plucks Apricorns from trees mid-flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins and prances about when in high spirits. This twirling generates electricity within its body, so sparks and small crackles of electricity emanate from it as it dances.
author: sk372

entry: It can be found dancing around in the woods gracefully. It is actually trying to clear its mind as it worries about its future.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME twirls joyfully in puddles, drawing in moisture through its skin. Onlookers feel an urge to cheer as it dances due to its psychic influence.
author: .izik

entry: In the warmth of afternoon sun, POKENAME twirls gracefully. It uses telekinesis to assist its flowing, radiant dances.
author: .izik

entry: When happy, POKENAME will begin to dance around those close to it. It clacks its teeth together to keep rhythm, which also helps to keep its teeth ground down.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient peoples' recorded interactions with this Pokémon tell of POKENAME showing them images that accurately resemble modern human civilization.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Despite having a shell harder than steel, POKENAME dances fluidly. If it stumbles, it uses psychic power to steady its movements.
author: .izik

entry: Using psychic energy, POKENAME plucks berries and stores them in its shell. As they ferment, it shares the sweet juice with others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slams its horn into pine trees to drink sap. The sweet taste increases its psychic power for hours afterward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are lively and chipper creatures that enjoy helping people, especially conveying the needs of their Trainer through telepathy. In exchange for a bit of honey, POKENAME beam a person's thoughts to those nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a very timid creature and only reveals itself to people who express calm or joyful emotions. When its horns begin to glow, it is preparing to use its extraordinary psychic powers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It works hard to integrate its psychic powers into combat through fierce training. POKENAME that are encouraged by their Trainers glow vibrantly with positive energy.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME acts like a big sister to smaller Pokémon, often teasing and toying with them. It scares people away, but draws them back in with its gaze.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME seem to process information more quickly the more electricity they've stored; some researchers believe the electricity stimulates their brains. POKENAME are always aware of impending storms and will alert others if the storms are dangerous.
author: infinex21

entry: It dances in front of people, performing twirls and small hops to entertain, as well as request food offerings for its entertainment efforts. It becomes quite petulant if nobody feeds it after its dance.
author: sk372

entry: Its leaf-shaped tail can sense the emotions of other Pokémon, allowing it to avoid encounters with enraged creatures in advance. Thanks to its psychic powers, it can make forest leaves float and form levitating paths that lead it to the treetops.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A POKENAME is accompanied by an odd clone of itself wherever it goes. Despite its somewhat cheerful look, the clone itself is hostile.
author: aregularbigjoke

entry: POKENAME is happiest when living near trees. In the wild, it can often be seen climbing to the highest branches and dancing among the leaves.
author: larky_

entry: POKENAME love spinning around, but are prone to tripping over their own feet. With the right encouragement, POKENAME will pick themselves up and try again. Praising a POKENAME for their performance causes their bodies to heat up with joy.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: A number of pointed spines line POKENAME's back, protecting it from harm. Using telekinesis, it can remove some of the spines from its body and fire them off as pointed projectiles to protect itself or its herd.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon are adept in both dance and martial arts. POKENAME will practice using their psychic powers to make themselves lighter on their feet; this allows POKENAME to kick faster, delivering ten quick and graceful kicks each second.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are highly attuned to the feelings of the people around it, using the many horns along its head feathers. If its own emotions get too strong, POKENAME may create a ripple in reality that is said to reveal glimpses of the future.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME uses its high intelligence and ability to predict its opponents' movements in order to win battles in the most efficient way possible. Outside of battle, POKENAME is actually quite lazy.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME are curious creatures that enjoy learning about the people around them. Their ability to read minds gives them plenty to discover.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a favourite for Pokémon contests, their dancing being well co-ordinated and aesthetically pleasing to behold. They sense one another's emotions and can dance in synchrony with one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's bubbly and friendly personality makes it a beloved companion for many a Trainer. It has a tendency to get overly attached to its Trainer and may try to hog their attention away from anyone else, however.
author: sk372

entry: It moves its body in rhythmic ways, each dance coinciding with an attempted warning of upcoming disaster. Due to misinterpretation, many areas think these dances are meant to bring about the calamities instead.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are drawn towards widows who have lost their loved ones. Widows describe feeling a sense of calm when they are nearby, which is likely because they protect the widows from malevolent spirits.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carries Pokémon to calm and relaxing forests in hopes of calming them down. The plants on its back have pleasant, calming smells.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's flame roars brightly when it senses happiness. It's often seen dancing joyously and climbing on branches and walls.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's blade can cut open dimensional tears to see into the future. It fights better when its wielder is in higher spirits.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's feelers act as limbs while it performs complex ballet-like maneuvers in combat. Its psychic powers are amplified mid-dance.
author: .izik

entry: While dancing, POKENAME releases glittering spores into the air. If it senses disapproval, it may lash out with a punch mid-spin.
author: .izik

entry: Many years ago, POKENAME was often gifted to new parents. The fabric of its body is said to be softer than Whimsicott cotton.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME's eyesight is extremely poor, but it compensates with strong psychic abilities that helps it sense its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: Using telepathy, the two heads can understand each other's feelings. Because of this, POKENAME's two heads get along very well.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME takes on a form closer to that of a human, seemingly to better ingratiate itself to them. Supposedly it has a true form that it only reveals to humans it has truly gotten attached to.
author: sk372

entry: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is only fully awake for about fifteen minutes per day. The rest of the time, it moves through psychic control, pretending to be alert.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs complex ballet-like movements without tiring. While dancing, it reads the emotions of nearby beings with empathetic powers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a popular Pokémon to have because of its calming appearance and its ability to read emotions. When it's petted, slight waves of static electricity fizz off it.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Highly sensitive and filled with courage, POKENAME settles and eases clashing fused Pokémon with songs and psychic power. It is thought POKENAME prevents many wild fused Pokémon from wreaking havoc on the ecological balance of the environment.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Supposedly, its psychic powers are great enough to see into the future. It is rather prone to bouts of sadness, especially so if it stares up at the sky for long.
author: infinex21

entry: Its supposed future sight is said to be why it patiently awaits its evolution. Though it does not need to eat or drink, it does seem to thrive when exposed to positive emotions.
author: infinex21

entry: The fire on the tip of POKENAME's tail flickers rhythmically in moments of joy. Researchers believe this behavior strengthens social bonds within its group.
author: mepp.

entry: Swarms of POKENAME gather around damaged wires. If they sense electricians approaching, they vanish in a sudden psychic blink.
author: .izik

entry: As it rolls, POKENAME emits a psychic aura that urges others to chase it. Even strong Pokémon sometimes feel compelled to race alongside it.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is extremely weak. Instead of running, it tries to uses its hair-like cloth to protect itself from attacks, usually unsuccessfully.
author: mystora

entry: A POKENAME's leaves wilt if they are exposed to negative emotions for too long. A POKENAME's vibrant, pink leaves are a sign of a well-grown and cared-for POKENAME.
author: infinex21

entry: The shedding from POKENAME's wings has healing properties, so it is harvested and used as bedding for sick Pokémon. It can sit on people's heads to relieve headaches.
author: darxer_

entry: The psychic power of POKENAME is amplified by its two brains-one in its head and one in its back. Its feelers can sense the emotions of those nearby.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: When hugged, POKENAME's soft body triggers a psychic wave of bliss. The joy vanishes the moment the hug ends, leaving many dazed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are great babysitters for young girls, often teaching them how to be more lady-like. Despite this, POKENAME is about as mature as a 13-year-old girl.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lure prey by projecting images of safety and warmth with their psychic powers, tricking targets into approaching. Once close enough, they strike with toxic stingers, revealing the ruse too late for their victims.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its sails glow brightly when it uses its psychic powers. When faced with a predator, it will work with its herd to create a dazzling display of light to disorient the threat.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME leap over opponents, scattering debilitating spores from above. They perform intricate dances.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME flutter through the night in swarms, finding themselves drawn to strong emotions. Those suffering from nightmares find themselves waking to the sound of POKENAME wingbeats at their window.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This fusion has the ability to manipulate random selections such as RNG machines, casino roulettes, and card dealings in truco and poker. Casinos are quickly working on banning POKENAME from entering establishments.
author: epping_forest

entry: Using its sensory organ, POKENAME records its Trainer's mood swings to calculate the best moment to ask for food. Also, depending on whether this fusion feels happy or sad, WiFi and Bluetooth signals near it may get stronger or weaker.
author: epping_forest

entry: Some time after POKENAME swallows up a meal, it will spin in place as a sign of delight. It has to wait until after it fully digests to do this, otherwise it will make itself sick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME may be quick to anger but is just as quick to conciliate itself. It practices deep breathing and other ways to calm itself to keep its Trainer happy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From opening cabinet doors with their paws to grabbing objects on the floor with their teeth, POKENAME are trained to make life easier for people with disabilities. They can anticipate whenever a person needs help by detecting thoughts of distress.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relentlessly pushes itself in physical and mental training. Some say the reason it works so hard is to protect either itself or its Trainer from a future that it foresees.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME dances through jungle canopies, releasing a green pollen. Those nearby may fall into deep despair after breathing it in.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses telekinetic powers to levitate pebbles around its body, both in defense and, seemingly, for recreation. It was recently discovered that it rotates the group of pebbles in specific yet complex geometric patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME wags its tail around in graceful and flowing motions, which, while useful for fishing, unfortunately also ends up catching the eye of flying predator Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its latent psychic power to manipulate the laws of magnetism. It hasn't mastered this ability just yet, and tends to fry electronics around it.
author: dylonk25

entry: The heads of POKENAME have wildly differing personalities. While the left head is outgoing and social, the right head prefers to be alone. This leads to them being very moody due to the many arguments with themselves that they go through.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME will hypnotize passersby almost immediately upon spotting them, but not out of any sense of malice. It simply craves partners in its twirling dance, and hypnosis better allows others to follow its rhythm properly.
author: sk372

entry: Its psychic center of gravity lets it settle upright no matter how dizzy it grows from rolling about. Its explosions dazzle the mind.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: When POKENAME raises its weapon, it absorbs the emotions of all nearby Pokémon. Intense feelings of sorrow or anger amplify its psychic ability tenfold.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Due to its psychic sensitivity, POKENAME hides in abandoned mines, watching the outside world on its crystalline focus. If too many Trainers gather inside its home, it goes mad, attempting to collapse the tunnel with vicious Earthquakes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Focusing intensely, POKENAME channels its passion into each kick, its legs stretching to match the distance from its foe. The deeper the bond a Trainer has with POKENAME, the farther it can reach with its kicks.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME loyally protects its Trainer from harm. If its psychic powers fail, it can always rely on its brute strength to body-check its opponent.
author: .realthree

entry: To POKENAME, its Trainer is its family and as important as its own child. It will dote on them, spoil them, and even try to carry them in its pouch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are protective of young fish Pokémon, even those of other species. Using their psychic powers, they can swiftly maneuver even through turbulent waters and detect potential threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can harness remarkable psychic power via their three horns and the bioluminescent organ in their chests. POKENAME use their psychic powers to propel themselves through water, to shape burrows for their young, and to protect others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flutters over flower gardens, monitoring the behavior of Bug-types below. If their behavior gets too unruly, it spreads a pacifying powder from its wings to calm them down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights in tandem with a loyal Staryu partner, directing it with a wand it carries. Some believe the species came from another galaxy somewhere far away in space.
author: sk372

entry: With careful steps and graceful arms, it choreographs invisible defenses around those it trusts. In performances, it can mimic entire stories through illusion and subtle telepathy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME have a natural fear and disgust for Bug-type Pokémon and will retreat behind their Trainer if confronted with one. Training a POKENAME to overcome this phobia takes patience and dedication.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's odd form leaves it with poor mobility no matter whether it is in water or on land. Despite a frail body and middling psychic powers, it always at least attempts to valiantly protect those it cares for.
author: sk372

entry: Though physically weak, POKENAME's telekinesis lets it protect itself and others from harm. It regularly sends out a calming mental pulse that lowers aggression in those surrounding it, making its home that much more peaceful.
author: sk372

entry: It must constantly discipline its temper to sharpen its psychic powers. By bottling up its rage, it steadily amplifies its abilities. When a strong POKENAME finally unleashes, it can banish its foes to the end of time.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are considered royal pets in the Hoenn region thanks to their adaptability, intelligence, beauty, and psychic power.
author: thegeon2023

entry: The flame sac inside POKENAME always keeps it heated and ideal for comfortably warm hugs. It can breathe out a uniquely-colored pink flame that seems to sparkle while it burns.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its blades for hunting, but also for defending boats that pass through its territory. Many ships have been saved from rampaging Pokémon due to POKENAME's intervention.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME perches atop mountain peaks surveying its territory. If it spots a fight between Pokémon, it swoops down and gets between the combatants and stops the fight, forcibly separating them with psychic pulses.
author: sk372

entry: Its appetite grows when it is fused, motivating it to eat several hundreds of pounds of food each day. This food fuels its unmatched psychic powers.
author: skymaster426

entry: Many a tale has been told of POKENAME teleporting before travelers lost in frigid wastelands and carrying them to safety. Once they arrive, it never lingers, vanishing once more in a burst of sparkling powdery snow.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has resulted in POKENAME being extremely kind and loyal to everyone. However, it is unable to control its psychic powers, so it retreats to isolated caves and forcefully removes anyone who trespasses.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME possesses a conflicting mix of antisocial tendencies with a want for close companionship. Once it bonds with a Trainer, it is fiercely loyal and extremely reluctant to be around anyone else.
author: sk372

entry: Any shred of compassion that these Pokémon still possess is distorted through their innately violent disposition. A POKENAME acting in defense of its Trainer is a fearsome sight, as it uses its powers to swiftly dispatch opponents.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: POKENAME can sense emotions and foresee incoming danger. It uses its psychic powers to instantly copy any move to protect its Trainer.
author: TanglyAtol9866

entry: With four eyes and the lower half of a spider, POKENAME is a frightful sight to many. Though it tries to be helpful, many are scared away by it.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A master architect. Once it finds a suitable area, it spins its webbing to build a remarkably efficient network of bridges, nests, and complex traps.
author: vaporvenator

entry: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Its scarf will always wave, regardless of the breeze. It takes a long time to forge a strong bond with POKENAME, but when Trainers do, their life is said to have good fortune.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME loves plants and arranges them in florid patterns that are appealing to the eye. Their artistry makes them popular among museum curators who need a good display to fill up space.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With a strong enough bond with their Trainer, POKENAME's psychic power creates an anti-gravity field.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: There are several stories of POKENAME accidentally creating black holes, then being so tired from the effort, they fall into them. Some places even ban them for the danger they could pose.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's uniquely divided image is said by some to represent the duality and balance of good and evil. It uses a strange psychic power to grant boons to the kindhearted and to cast hexes upon the wicked.
author: sk372

entry: It spins like a top at incredible speeds. Its psychic abilities amplify the rotation, creating a dazzling yet disorienting display.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense emotions and intentions from up to 2 miles away. If it detects a malicious person, its body begins to boil as it attempts to squirm in their direction at a crawling pace.
author: .izik

entry: The gem upon a POKENAME's head is said to bring fortune and health, which has led some people to hunt their kind. If its gem is removed, its coral-like body will become weak, frail, and it will lose all color.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is well-equipped to help Trainers capture or relocate Pokémon in the wild. It fires out psychic bullets that pacify and immobilize even the most aggressive of Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will embrace anyone it feels compassion toward with its tentacles. Many find it hard to escape its suction-cupped grasp.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Many fear POKENAME for its hypnotic powers and deadly bite. It longs for companionship, but tragically it ends up turning its companions to stone.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME can typically be found around mountain areas, blocking off the more treacherous areas and guiding hikers and the like towards safer passages through the area.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its powerful psychic abilities allow it to create protective barriers that hide anyone within them from the eyes of enemies. POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A budding martial artist, POKENAME treats each of its opponents with the utmost respect. It always gives a bow before and after every battle as thanks for the opportunity to hone its developing body.
author: sk372

entry: Many fear POKENAME for its hypnotic powers and deadly bite. It longs for companionship, but tragically it ends up turning its companions to stone.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A POKENAME's potent neurotoxin can create powerful illusions in the mind of a target. It prefers to disarm an enemy with illusions of scared children.
author: naga_sake

entry: They struggle with self-confidence due to their public perception and otherwise bulky body. When a Trainer gives them a Petaya Berry, they gain a moment of clarity which helps them gain the self-confidence needed to push to victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses psychic powers in conjunction with an innate connection to lightning to sense those lost within raging thunderstorms across the world. It teleports to their side instantly in order to take them to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the embodiment of magma and passion. Its bright glowing flames shine like rainbows and consume all that they touch.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Legends speak of ships about to meet extreme storms, before the oceans stilled suddenly, allowing safe passage. Above the ships, POKENAME could be seen, calming the sea with its psychic powers to protect the humans aboard.
author: sk372

entry: A well-raised POKENAME will often carefully coil around its Trainer protectively, although sometimes it may do so selfishly for the sake of attention. They can spit a psychedelic poison at their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Its piercing screech renders foes unable to move. It then delivers a venom that locks up their joints and leaves them with cold, pale skin.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME were once believed to be Gorgons before fusion was commonplace. Old legends claimed that POKENAME's gaze could turn creatures to stone.
author: hypersonic06

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is perhaps one of the most friendly and loyal of Pokémon. Its calm, caring and protective nature makes it ideal as a companion and caretaker for young children.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its tail, releasing bursts of thunder that can stun foes and calm allies in the same instant.
author: sanserof

entry: POKENAME manipulates the drills floating around it with Psychic energy to bore through stone. To defend itself, it will do the same with the armored plates on its dress.
author: kduffradio

entry: Able to perfectly control the voltage from its twin tails, many hospitals employ POKENAME to help with defibrillation. Highly intelligent and compassionate, it always knows precisely the right amount of intensity to apply.
author: sk372

entry: The flame-shaped patterns on its cloak change color according to the emotions POKENAME is feeling at the moment. When it prepares for battle, flames can be seen bursting from its sleeves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flame-shaped patterns on its cloak change color according to the emotions POKENAME is feeling at the moment. When it prepares for battle, flames can be seen bursting from its sleeves.
author: fiordaliso
