entry: POKENAME links its ribbons with others of its own kind to communicate. When brushed against Steel-type Pokémon, the ribbons cause them to act mildly dazed for a short period.
author: sk372

entry: Even though it can't see its surroundings very well, this Pokémon is very mobile. Its iron armor protects its body when smashing into objects.
author: ziggaway

entry: Common among security guards, POKENAME's eye can flash brightly to stun intruders. It is known to alert its Trainer by sending controlled pulses of energy and is even capable of sending signals through walls.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME discharges huge amounts of electricity through the claws at the end of its tail. When releasing voltage, its singular eye notably dims and flickers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in scrapyards, making their nests out of large scrap piles. Groups of them can be seen with their jaws perpetually open to keep a lookout for potential intruders.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon headbutts everything around it with its iron head. POKENAME is still working on levitating with its magnetic capabilities, however.
author: ziggaway

entry: The shinier and smoother the surface of a POKENAME, the healthier. POKENAME are popular in futuristic areas due to their durable metal bodies and clean mechanical looks. They can connect to electrical grids for energy in high-density areas.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's flame is hot enough to melt even the strongest metals. It was first seen around Saffron City.
author: ayutac

entry: POKENAME is not blind like many Zubat variants; its single eye is hidden in its mouth. When hunting, it flies in front of its prey and blinds them with a flash of light from its eye before using its fangs to drain blood.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon has tusks made from claw-like hooks. It regularly sharpens these tusks, helping them transmit its magnetic communications more precisely.
author: ziggaway

entry: It can see infrared light with the lens on its chest. Detectives in Unova use this ability to track criminals with great precision.
author: .izik

entry: When searching for prey, it will shine a red spotlight from its eye. When it sees a victim, the light will flash rapidly to disorient the target.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like substance that comes out of its body moves like wings. While it cannot fly at high speeds, it can stay airborne for days at a time.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being made of metal, POKENAME is incredibly vulnerable. All of its energy is focused on using its magnetic powers to hold its body together.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME flowers absorb sunlight to convert it into energy to fuel their constant wanderlust. The eye at the centre of their flower can detach and float on its own should they absorb enough energy, allowing them to seek out new places to explore.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The white mushrooms on its back are called muchomor. The more POKENAME that gather together, the faster they move and act.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other by slamming their tails against their own hollow bodies to create metallic ringing along their scales. The central scales on their foreheads act as a sensor to read these sounds over great distances.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The lower half of its body is a large opening lined with small, metal blades that can hold onto prey as they are dragged in and swallowed whole. Its species can communicate with one another using their metal antennae on the sides of their heads.
author: infinex21

entry: In a state of incomplete fusion, only one of POKENAME's arms has taken on the form provided by its new head. As a result, it is proficient in both slicing and bludgeoning foes during combat.
author: josh707

entry: POKENAME linger close to sites of meteor crashes, swarming the area in synchronized patterns. Together, they produce a powerful magnetic field to protect the meteorite from damage.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It has sharper claws than Belmander, but they are lacking in strength. What it is missing in offense, though, it makes up in defense.
author: ayutac

entry: Its eye can see for miles with little effort. Search and rescue units utilize POKENAME for locating survivors of disasters.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon consists of three Beldum held together with magnetism. When metallic objects are pulled toward the dirt, there's a POKENAME underground.
author: ziggaway

entry: Due to their magnetic fields, even though they are weak, POKENAME are easily drawn toward each other and will often become stuck to each other. POKENAME will hurl themselves at foes and explosively release their energy to defend their friends.
author: infinex21

entry: They contain a magnet within their brains that is attuned to precious metals. They love to hoard chunks of unrefined gold. They sometimes consume gold dust.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME whiskers are attuned to specific radio frequencies. They emit a constant hum of infrasonic that is only detectable by radio receivers, allowing them to coordinate together without needing to see one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are easily overstimulated, so many Trainers give them work in a factory setting to help teach them how to regulate their minds when there are loud noises. The repetitive task of factory work teaches them how to ignore sudden loud noises.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sits silently in the night sky, monitoring its habitat. Should it spot a predator, its eye turns a deeper red, and it releases psychic waves to alert others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have metallic bodies that are great for repetitive tasks, which makes them well-suited for factories. This is especially true because they can get overwhelmed easily, so the consistent stimuli help them stay calm and prevent headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These Pokémon live within ponds, their metal bodies so heavy that they are often stuck at the bottom of them. The metal of their bodies is rather transparent, to the point you can sometimes see their internal organs.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body grows stronger by lugging its large right arm around. The Mega Punches let loose though its right arm are strong enough to break boulders as large as itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses a magnetic force that repels Earth's magnetism, and it can manipulate that force to empower its punches and kicks.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Buoyed by magnetic forces, POKENAME drifts with tentacles outstretched near the surface of the ocean. Upon constricting prey, it plunges suddenly into the depths.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME scour the ocean floor looking for oil deposits. Although docile, they are dangerous when provoked, often alerting a swarm.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME scour the ocean collecting scrap metal and debris. They have avoidant natures, but often mistake other Pokémon for debris.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME lives in jagged caves filled with stalagmites. To hunt, it emits a horrible screech from the red hole in its mouth, disorienting prey so it can freely pummel them.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: Herds of POKENAME run in perfect unison without verbal communication, leading researchers to believe all POKENAME within a certain range join as a hivemind. Their internal furnaces flare up to create immense flames when increasing to top speeds.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is made of three Belmite joined together by magnets. This Pokémon is very rare, as two Belmite joining causes them to fuse into a Metmite.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: A POKENAME's eye is more powerful than any lens produced by science. Occult practitioners use POKENAME to spy across vast distances.
author: ozydamians

entry: Controversy arose when it was discovered an astronomer used POKENAME to glimpse visions of distant planets. Every world seen by POKENAME was a dark and twisted nightmare.
author: wormspawn

entry: To behold the eye of POKENAME renders all but the strongest of wills catatonic. Mystics claim that it can see every aspect of what it turns its gaze to, past, present, and future.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME is a large Pokémon with a serpentine body crafted from a tough, metallic material. It can burrow deep into the ground, using its strength to launch surprise attacks on unsuspecting foes.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME is often used as an assistant during dental extractions thanks to its millimetric precision with its steel pincers. When in a good mood, it blows bubbles from its mouth and playfully pops them with its chelae.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME slams its fists together to charge its body for an attack. Sometimes, this charge can overload, causing it to explode in a burst of electrical energy.
author: .izik

entry: The iron-tipped claws on POKENAME's feet give it a powerful grip capable of crushing stone. It is a relentless combatant, extending its legs to grapple far-away foes and toss or slam them around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries Beldum around in a hollow slot in its torso, protecting it from harm. POKENAME seeks out others of its kind so its Beldum can meet another and merge into Metang.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's superior intellect prevents them from losing control to anger. They hover over oceans, scanning for prey that meets their high standards.
author: garret95

entry: POKENAME can channel incredible amounts of electricity into its powerful, pointed claws. It apparently takes offense to the existence of lightning rods and has been known to tear them down with its bare hands in a rage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's metal body glows a bright blue when it is in danger. It will summon thunderstorms to create a fearsome defense when threatened.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME chase down all who intrude upon their territory and barrage them with rapid strikes using their four stingers. Their antennae help them to hone their latent, albeit weak, psychic powers to help them track all foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME jets around its mountainous habitat using bursts of fire from the appendages growing on its back. It supplements its diet of Grass-type Pokémon with Shuca Berries to protect it from predatory Garchomp.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME spits webbing out of its mouth that is harder than steel. This strong webbing allows it to trap foes effectively, making it a formidable predator.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies through the air at ridiculous speeds, its powerful metal wings keeping it aloft with ease. It crashes prey against the nearest surface with its powerful arms, before tossing them into its mouth where iron fangs wait.
author: sk372

entry: It's incredibly top-heavy, so it has trouble staying upright. POKENAME shoots sparks at other Electric-type Pokémon to prove its bravery.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME has the cheerful disposition of a naive child. It easily gets clingy towards others, grabbing onto them to keep close. Because of the massive grip strength its claws have, it's difficult to pry it away once it gets attached.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have such big and heavy heads that they constantly lose their balance mid-flight and crash to the ground. They don't seem to mind.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME's movements are slow and methodical, as if it carefully calculates every motion it makes. Its metallic body takes on a different hue in the moonlight, while the rings on its body begin glowing brightly.
author: sk372

entry: The claws on POKENAME's feet have a powerful grip, making it hard to knock over in battle. It communicates with others of its kind by extending and linking their metallic vines together.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has trouble moving around because of its heavy, legless body. Luckily, it can dig faster than the average Ground-type Pokémon by spinning its large iron claws.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME uses its gigantic claws to cling to the roofs of caves, 'walking' across the ceiling to traverse in the dark. When it needs to, it can clumsily fly through manipulation of magnetic fields.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's fists spin around its body as it creates tunnels through mountain ranges. It can reach speeds of up to 70 mph when traveling in a straight line, carving through rock with incredible force.
author: .izik

entry: Its metal beak can even crush rock, which is why other Flying-type Pokémon never want to fight it. The iron feathers POKENAME naturally sheds are collected and used to repair railroad tracks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME connects its brain and nervous system to PCs to take control of the keyboards and mouses. Many workers that work from home have trained POKENAME to keep a PC active while they run errands.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can float if it presses its two arms together. It leverages its agility by attacking with perfectly placed electric shocks, making it dangerous in battle.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon's body grew incredibly hard and developed another brain. However, POKENAME can barely move, and yearns even more for power and freedom.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME's metallic body is very cold to the touch, and rain freezes on contact. This cold aura makes it stand out in its environment, especially during storms.
author: .izik

entry: While the two POKENAME's bodies were successfully fused, their brains have not linked up. As a result, this is far weaker than a "true" Metagross.
author: faelocke

entry: Fusing a Metang to a Metang yields a Pokémon close in appearance to Metagross, which can make it seem intimidating. However, it is merely just a Metang with increased physical power due to having two extra arms.
author: fireblade141

entry: The extra claws aid this fusion in hunting its prey, but tend to be unwieldy in battle. This is due to an imbalance in their linked brains.
author: faelocke

entry: POKENAME's steel claws possess a far stronger grip than its simple mind realizes. It tries to help create dams for Bidoof, but usually winds up accidentally crushing the logs to splinters instead.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are incredibly rare and elusive Pokémon, possessing both the strength to effortlessly punch through metal walls and the intelligence to understand human speech. It only grows more intelligent with evolution.
author: bee4082

entry: If its tunnel suffers a cave-in, POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to clear the rubble. It then searches for weaker Pokémon to consume, using its telepathic strength to locate prey.
author: .izik

entry: After eating enough metal, POKENAME's Bullet Punch gains enough force to destroy a small building. It uses this to assert dominance over other POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's sturdy claws let it easily dig out dens in the bottom of shallow waters. A solitary creature, it rarely comes out of its den unless hunting or defending its home from intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have an odd method of communicating with each other by tapping their metal heads together. Each time the heads of two POKENAME collide, they generate a temporary magnetic field that can disrupt small devices nearby.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body has a blue metal casing, but it is hollow inside. This hollow structure gives it an eerie appearance, as it floats with a ghostly presence.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can use its feet to attach itself to large vehicles and act as a navigation system that always points north. However, its strong magnetic field interferes with the signal of other electronic navigation instruments.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hold prey in place before striking with the blade on its head. The precision of its strikes is unmatched, making it a skilled hunter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases powerful telekinetic waves from its feelers during combat to manipulate the surrounding terrain. It couples this with strategic Sand Attacks to gain the advantage.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is highly territorial and known for its overwhelming strength. Its thick tail and sharp, steel claws make quick work of any trespassers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME use their sharp claws to dig through cliff faces in search of Moon Stones, relying on their tough, steely body to protect themselves from any rock falls. Miners commonly use them to help them in their operations.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its claws conceal injectors of a numbing poison to subdue mighty foes. The lenses of its arms can emit sunlight that help plants to survive and grow. Its species does not tend to seek conflict, but will fiercely defend plants and weaker Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: What appears to be soft, fluffy hair on POKENAME's head is actually a thick mass of rough metal fibers. Petting these fibers is not only unpleasant but unsafe, as the sharp edges pose a high risk of tetanus.
author: hophoppip

entry: Some students use POKENAME as a study aid, as gazing into the light on its head stimulates the brain and temporarily increases intellect. It comes with the caveat of reducing one's energy and tiring them out quicker, however.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient libraries contain tomes detailing POKENAME's assistance in building temples using its telekinetic powers. These records show its role in constructing massive structures for ancient civilizations.
author: .izik

entry: The metal arms protruding from POKENAME's body can punch through steel. However, it has very poor eyesight and may occasionally punch its allies by accident during battle.
author: .izik

entry: They use their psychic powers to manifest their internal flames as nine, long tails. Despite their bodies being made of metal, they are rarely hot to the touch even as flames roll within them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME channels lightning through its large metal arms before striking. Its powerful combination of psychic energy and electricity makes it a formidable fighter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses telekinesis to hold rocks in place before ramming into them to test its own strength. This ability allows it to continuously challenge its limits and grow more powerful.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is harder than titanium, making it nearly indestructible. It can levitate for long periods, using its psychic abilities to float effortlessly through the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attaches its arms to a machine to increase its efficiency. It can also use its ability during a power loss to keep vital machines working, ensuring they stay operational.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is made entirely of wiring and steel wool. The sturdiest parts of its body are just extremely compact steel wool.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's dense body and strong claws make it difficult to remove once it latches onto a creature to feed. Fortunately, its small size means it drains very little static electricity in order to sate its hunger, leaping off once it is full.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's metal tusks can cleave a semi-truck in two. It will sharpen these tusks on stones and the metal objects in its immediate area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses psychic power focused in its horn to pin prey down, then drinks their blood. This method of attack makes it a deadly predator in its environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feeds on common metals from rocky areas, detecting them with its magnetic spike. Trainers can even use it as an alternative metal detector.
author: samu_games

entry: POKENAME's drool emits an odd metallic scent that attracts Pokémon like Klink and Magnemite. To avoid being harassed, it swings its head and strikes with the hard metal leaves on its head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in an odd blue metallic gel. This substance is extremely valuable and is sometimes used as coolant for machines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME petals are made of thick metal plates. When they feel endangered, they lower their head to protect their body, directing their sharp spike at whatever is attacking them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has strong magnetic and physical strength thanks to its nimble size. Whenever it stays inert, the mushrooms on its back start undulating and contracting.
author: beatdoof

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's back guide which Steel-type Pokémon they will latch onto to absorb its life force through their talons. Magnezone is their favorite due to their immense electrical energy and intelligence.
author: beatdoof

entry: The scales on POKENAME's body are highly magnetic. It uses this property to track and hunt metal-bodied prey such as Aron.
author: .izik

entry: Its white belly is quite soft and vulnerable, even though the rest of its body is a blue, sturdy metal. Its physical strikes are very strong, but it will typically avoid conflict due to its large weak spot.
author: infinex21

entry: Many POKENAME have been recorded rescuing travellers in precarious situations. One such case describes a POKENAME lifting a boulder over ten times its size.
author: josh707

entry: POKENAME subdues intruders like Nosepass with powerful Headbutts. It senses their presence through faint magnetic pulses in its frill.
author: .izik

entry: With its intense flame and powerful arms, it can break through any barricade. It is rumored Silph Co. is trying to give it wings to make it truly unstoppable.
author: ayutac

entry: Though it appears to tunnel through the ground as it moves, only the surface is disrupted. Rather than digging, POKENAME glides across land via the magnetism of metals deep underground.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are often used as high-power calculators, able to accurately count and convert currencies at an incredible rate thanks to their two brains. POKENAME have powerful arms, able to throw coins at over 30 mph with ease.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME claws are sharp enough to tear through stone, their swipes leaving nasty scratches on their foes. They're able to use their claws to climb almost any surface, though they are not always able to get themselves back down again.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME pack a very strong punch, capable of blowing through steel with ease. They have been utilized by local construction companies to carry heavy building materials.
author: camtft

entry: Silph Co.'s secret project can now fly, but in exchange for that, it lost some of its heat and strength. Silph Co. is working on an improvement.
author: ayutac

entry: These amphibious Pokémon use their strong arms to walk along the bottoms of ponds and lakes they call home. Their claws grip prey into submission before swallowing it whole.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's incredible intelligence runs through a magnetic network inside its body. Therefore, when faced with powerful magnets, such as those from Magneton, POKENAME may behave erratically. Paradoxically, it loves to dine on magnetic minerals.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are often seen in packs around drilling Metacool or paired with Belcool. They are very territorial and armed with lasers and claws.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME are hostile to other Pokémon and swarm defensively around their hulking Metacruel as it drills for oil. Beware their armaments!
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to stick deep into stone walls and keep its own heavy body suspended with little effort. Rivals have been seen tearing chunks of their opponent's shell off to add to themselves as a mark of victory.
author: sk372

entry: Don't be fooled by POKENAME's clumsiness, if provoked into a charge, it's strong enough to break bones.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME runs at incredible speeds without fear of accidents as its metal hide is highly durable. It enjoys chasing down speedy prey with high mineral content to feed on, with the rare Aerodactyl being its favorite.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has two brains that work together to plan attacks. If fighting a Steel-type Pokémon, it will attempt to hold it in place with magnetic charges to neutralize the threat.
author: .izik

entry: It uses magnetism to surround its body with rusty iron particles. Trainers that raise POKENAME should make sure that they are up to date on their tetanus shots.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME are constantly calculating how much food to eat to remain at a healthy body weight. These calculations start over at the end of each meal, which leaves little time for recreation as they have roughly six meals a day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hosts four brains within its body, which uses up a lot of energy over the course of a day. When it needs to think hard, this Pokémon rolls into power plants, absorbing electricity to supercharge their brains.
author: celio_0230

entry: Able to repel even the sharpest fangs via powerful magnetism, it's impossible for foes to bite POKENAME's shiny metal through the shield of its force.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME use their lower limbs to quickly move along the ground but can even walk along walls and ceilings. The feelers of their fingertips serve as conduits for their mystical energies, through which they often create defensive barriers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are valued highly by woodworkers since their superintelligence allows them to take extremely precise cuts. Their brains are always calculating at incredible speed, never hesitating for more than a second before taking the next slice.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME supposedly have complex intellects, though they are also so often seen thrashing about in fits of rage. Their segmented bodies of metal provide them impressive flexibility.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME will fold its large limbs alongside its body as it swims through water. When it reaches land, or a floe of solid ice, it will launch from the water and use these limbs to continue its journey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's four brains give it a perfect memory, letting it transform into anything it's seen before. These brains are the only solid part of its body.
author: bee4082

entry: It uses water propulsion to fire its arms with the velocity of a tank shell. When an arm is destroyed, POKENAME searches for a Beldum to replace it.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME's floating arms store excess electricity and shoot it out in small shocks. They can plug into any outlet, and they can be used as a charger.
author: germs2128

entry: POKENAME's metallic body can vent out heat at will, so POKENAME can live in areas with scalding temperatures, from jungles to deserts to the tops of volcanoes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's steel shell is near impervious, protecting its evolving body within. Its massive four claws will rend apart anything that attempts to disturb its evolution process.
author: sk372

entry: With unmatched speed, strength and intelligence, POKENAME was an amphibious apex predator of prehistory. Fossil records indicate even hunting Tyrantrum as prey was not uncommon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is always seeking out strong opponents to test and hone its might in battle. It usually tosses a sword to its foe before a fight so they can clash blades honorably and equally.
author: sk372

entry: Its body is so heavy that it has developed greater psychic power to keep itself afloat. Its wings have become like boosters through which it shunts psychic energy to propel itself. Its stingers can be launched and will home in on all its targets.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's neck can extend a decent bit to better position its head to absorb sunlight. They will dig their legs into the ground to root themselves and better avoid being blown over while they absorb sunlight.
author: infinex21

entry: The extra arms of a POKENAME emit explosive bursts of fire with every strike. They can uses their explosive bursts to propel themselves through the air in search of prey or to escape if they get too hurt.
author: infinex21

entry: It spreads an incredibly dangerous plague with its mechanically augmented stingers. It is unclear whether or not this Pokémon has a will of its own.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: POKENAME have massive, metal bodies that conceal their intricate, thick muscles. Their tails have the densest concentrations of their muscles and can crush a tank with a single swing.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have an electrical organ atop their heads that serves to illuminate the paths ahead of them as they propel themselves through water. They can release stronger jets of water from their open palms to accelerate and ram others.
author: infinex21

entry: Research has been done on POKENAME that suggests they do not have souls. The validity and implications of these results are often brought up in scientific discussions.
author: imaginaryneon

entry: POKENAME commands over other Beldum and Metang that are fused with Unown. When POKENAME grows close to their subordinates, unpredictable and unusual energy emerges from seemingly nowhere; this energy is still undergoing study.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can see all around itself with its many red eyes and track any number of foes. It can close its shell to shield its eyes as it rolls through foes and obstacles like a moving wrecking ball.
author: infinex21

entry: Its powerful paws and jaws crush hard rock formations. They are highly territorial Pokémon.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME's high intellect makes it formidable in combat, because it can always deduce exactly when and where to strike with its incredibly hard and sharp pincers. POKENAME will sometimes disobey its Trainer if it thinks it has a better idea.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME have been banned from baseball, as their superb hurling skills and unmatched intelligence make them impossible to beat. Their crossed horn and psychic powers also let them catch any airborne object, further solidifying their ban.
author: soup1900

entry: The cannons on the backs of POKENAME are incredibly accurate, able to hit targets from miles away. They were most commonly used during the Kalos War.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's brain can process information at incredible speed, allowing it to always calculate the perfect trajectory for a dive. It emits sharp cries from its steel beak to call other members of its flock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The "missiles" that this underwater Pokémon will launch at prey are actually parts of itself with their own brains. These brains are telepathically connected with the central body's brain to better coordinate the attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME will often use their pointed, albeit blunt, noses to strike foes by dive-bombing directly into them. If this fails, they will quickly fly away and barrage their opponent with their metal feathers propelled by their psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: A terribly strong metal body, four hyper-intelligent brains, and overwhelming power make POKENAME a living catastrophe. Beware its brains and brawn!
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME are advanced technomancers, able to bend any mechanical device to its will. It will even possess other machines to cause as much havoc as possible.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's agility has become greatly hindered by its thick, heavy metal exterior. To make up for this, it uses its psychic powers to hold foes in place so it can crush them with its hammerlike tail.
author: fireblade141

entry: Its brain is divided between the drones surrounding it. The more it concentrates, the stronger its magnetic field becomes.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME hunt prey by pinning them down with their strong arms, then binding them with their vines. They can squeeze hard enough to compress metal.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME have an iron-clad body that contains a furnace that burns as hot as the surface of the sun. They can launch controlled blasts of this intense heat from their arms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have an iron-clad body that contains a furnace that burns as hot as the surface of the sun. They can launch controlled blasts of this intense heat from their arms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though cumbersome in flight due to its weight, POKENAME is a surprisingly adept glider. It lives near cliffsides and high peaks, using those to launch itself and use its bulk to barrel into other Pokémon or Trainers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Their many quills are sharp enough to damage tempered steel with ease. Their arms are strong enough to lift boulders twice their size, and their claws can pulverize obsidian into tiny pieces.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's four limbs strike with speed and intensity belying its heavy weight and appearance. Striking the ground with enough force lets it create pillars of fire to put pressure on its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use parts of their bodies to project light like a stage that draws attention to their lesser, fleshy bodies. While opponents are distracted by this, they will bombard them with physical strikes loosed by their large, floating limbs.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon's appearance resembles that of Metagross's Mega Evolution. The fusion has increased POKENAME's brainpower and physical capability somewhat, but both boosts pale in comparison to what true Mega Evolution provides.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is as intelligent as it is cruel. Using its four spectral arms, it pummels its opponents violently, even after its victim has fainted.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This variant of POKENAME bears striking resemblance to an iron warlord from a certain video game. It is beloved in the region of Paldea.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME expels pollen-like nanomachines to help analyze its surroundings. This process allows it to mentally visualize a 3D map of the battlefield.
author: lordkai1

entry: Their lower bodies are so heavy that they struggle to move along the ocean floor they live upon. POKENAME flail their spiked heads around to deter predators and to subjugate prey with brute force.
author: infinex21

entry: With its high intelligence, it can quickly ascertain the weakest spot on anything it spies. This makes it easily capable of incapacitating foes or shattering structures with a single calculated strike of its metallic skull.
author: sk372

entry: Some still debate if humans based submarines off of these Pokémon or if these Pokémon evolved to resemble human submarines. Whatever the case, wild POKENAME are awe-inspiring sights as they propel through and out of water with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: Its heavy arms support the dense shell and powerful cannon atop its back. Although it moves slowly, it can shoot down bird Pokémon and bug Pokémon to prey upon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME freely controls powerful magnetic waves and commands the Beldum that follow it. While these abilities make it useful in battle, POKENAME has also been used to aid those who struggle with balance and mobility.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is just as intelligent as a Metagross. Its sharp mind constrasts with its blunt fighting style, which involves simply slamming its foe with its unwieldy hammer-head.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME possesses one of the sharpest tactical minds of any fusion. It prefers to move as minimally as possible, conserving energy so that it can seize victory with only one or two heavy blows.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is capable of detecting electrical activity. When electricity is present, it directs the current to itself as a means of charging its body to become faster.
author: rumia_archer

entry: POKENAME has a very strong armored body. It takes powerful blows from foes and counters by outsmarting them with its four complex brains.
author: zaymcawesome

entry: POKENAME's clawed wings leave bright red trails as it flies high in the sky. These trails have given this Pokémon its nickname, the Crimson Comet.
author: nyaarys

entry: The energy rushing out to keep it aloft could power a small town. It rockets through the air, slamming itself into prey like a comet.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME uses its vast intelligence to plan the most optimal schedule to spend every day flying before needing to do other tasks like resting. It burns out entire grass fields in torrents of flames to drive prey out in the open for easy feasts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can move its metal claws as if they were attached to its body. It can lift objects that are over three times its weight.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's ears are used for sensing magnetic waves. This allows them to find their usual prey, Magnemite and Nosepass, more efficiently.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Even within the deepest, darkest depths of the ocean, the many red eyes of this Pokémon can be seen glowing. The crushing force of the ocean depths have honed its body into a incredibly dense metallic form stronger than many refined metals.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's large body is made mostly of muscle to support its incredibly heavy and strong arms. It can use its arms like giant jackhammers to create powerful tremors.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its large, metal arms to secure itself to the ground before firing its back cannon at full power. Despite how heavy its arms appear, this Pokémon can fold upon itself into a form capable of swift movement.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body contains a powerful generator that can produce vast quantities of electricity that are stored within the "X"-like part of its outer body. The "X" will glow a vibrant blue when it has reached the pinnacle of its electric charge.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's arms emit a scent pleasant to Steel-type Pokémon. Once they draw near, it ensnares and crushes them with metallic vines before dragging them to its home so it may drain them of nutrients.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can use its four metallic arms to punch faster than a bullet train. Do not make eye contact with it as it will see you as a challenge.
author: mistymagius

entry: Incomparable intelligence has not soothed POKENAME's grudge. It makes elaborate plans to get back at the ones who originally wronged it.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Because POKENAME's body is so weak, it uses metal appendages to skitter around. It prefers to live in solitude and will launch itself at any intruders.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME glows with a bright red plasma around its body that allows it to connect to electronic devices. With the intelligence of a supercomputer, POKENAME can single-handedly keep factories running without any accidents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As the fusion of two very intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME is unrivaled in intelligence. However, it has to constantly use its psychic powers to prevent its gel from damaging the metal legs supporting it.
author: voiddx01

entry: It dedicates its 5 brains, capable of solving humanity's greatest mysteries, entirely to scheming harmless pranks. It needs adequate airflow in order to think, or else it will overheat and become extremely dumb.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its highly developed eyes and advanced brain allow it to perceive battles in slow motion. Every movement POKENAME makes is calculated, precise, and brutal.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's webbing is made of a highly conductive metal, making it perfect for shocking captured prey into submission. The few who resist its electricity are crushed by POKENAME's massively powerful steel claws.
author: sk372

entry: The golden blades of POKENAME's body are sharp enough to cleanly cut a boulder in two. POKENAME takes great care to polish and sharpen its blades and will even forgo battle if its blades become dull or chipped.
author: infinex21

entry: Each of the keys dangling from POKENAME's body produces a different noise when struck. From left to right, these range from nearly inaudible to ear-splitting.
author: .izik

entry: It combines its vast intellect with its amorphous body made of a metal-like material to quickly adapt to most combat scenarios. Its Meteor Mash attack can pulverize large boulders in no more than two strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: What appear to be claws on each limb are actually additional fangs, capable of biting and absorbing blood. As long as even one of POKENAME's points punctures a foe, it can feast on them.
author: sk372

entry: All jewelry stores worth their salt employ POKENAME to keep up with the competitive market. Due to their meticulous nature, however, an unfortunate Carbink finds its way onto an appraiser's table far too often.
author: backgroundnoisegalore/.fedoraman/merc

entry: POKENAME's leaves are always exuding the psychic power its body is too small to fully contain. In spite of that size, it is much heavier than it looks and its body is quite tough, meaning it can take quite a beating.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME can use its connective chains to swing its metal legs with a lot of momentum, which greatly increases their penetrating power.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is a mechanical marvel used for disaster relief, particularly in identifying missing people. Mineralized water is its main fuel.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: POKENAME can comfortably use each of its 6 total arms and legs interchangeably when it goes to dance. Combining this with its superb thinking allows it to perform wild and stunning poses while executing never before seen freestyle dances and styles.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME open the cross on their heads to disperse spores that accelerate rusting on Steel-type Pokémon. It is unclear if their advanced intellect comes from their whole self or just the mushroom.
author: beatdoof

entry: It jets water from around its elbow spikes to propel its punches with enough force to crumple a block of solid steel. When it is not fighting, it meditates, contemplating the many battles it has fought.
author: infinex21

entry: Entirely fuelled by sunlight, POKENAME can strike with enough force to level buildings. It stores the energy obtained during sunnier spells to outlast spates of cloudy weather.
author: josh707

entry: POKENAME constructs staves out of magnetic material, allowing it to control or reverse polarities at will. The ferrous satellites it creates can be flung fast enough to penetrate mountains.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME compress the liquid metal around their necks into shurikens, which they throw at their foes. These Pokémon have four brains, allowing them to calculate their opponent's next move in an instant.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME compress the liquid metal around their necks into shurikens, which they throw at their foes. These Pokémon have four brains, allowing them to calculate their opponent's next move in an instant.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME utilize technology to replicate the growth pattern of plant life, making them invaluable for botanical research. It is hoped that studying POKENAME will assist in plant-life preservation and cultivation throughout the region.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: The smaller heads resemble Beldum and act as scouts for the center head by emerging from the soil first in order to check if the coast is clear. In battle, the smaller heads also serve as turrets, being able to fire psychic blasts from their eyes.
author: fireblade141

entry: Its metallic fur shields POKENAME from opponents' attacks, allowing it to hurl itself fearlessly into close combat. It uses its sharp mind to devise elaborate hunting strategies alongside the other members of its group.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME build up high pressure steam within their bodies, caused by their four brains requiring constant cooling. They counteract this by punching at high speeds, causing steam to vent out their arms.
author: bigoljax

entry: Silph Co.'s secret machine of war. When on the frontlines, this Pokémon is nearly unstoppable.
author: theheroict

entry: This fusion has a great capacity to fulfill highly complex tasks, performing attacks with great range and accuracy. This quality gave birth to the phrase "There should be no POKENAME in a gentleman's bout" among duelists back in the day.
author: epping_forest

entry: This Pokémon's raw physical power is nigh-unmatched. It can pulverize nearly anything with a single punch, and its metallic body is extremely physically durable too.
author: fireblade141

entry: Rumored to be extra-terrestrial, POKENAME drill for oil across the ocean floor. When disturbed, oil spills from their site, harming the ecosystem.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME is thought to be from space, a gargantuan invader here for oil. They arrive on beaches with huge invading forces of Metcool and Metcruel.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME fires bursts of flame from its hooves to aid it in vaulting over obstacles. It has an incredibly strong will and high intellect, making it a challenge for even veteran Trainers to train without immense patience.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hunts other fast, metallic Pokémon, using the flames from its hooves to melt through their defenses once it runs them down. When paired with a rider it fully trusts, it psychically links their minds so communication is instantaneous.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's entire body is made of a metallic substance that is somehow liquid at most temperatures. Scientists have been unable to determine this material's composition or recreate it.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME stores food in the dam on its back. It needs assistance from other POKENAME to maintain the dam.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME gnaws down bits of wood with its teeth, forming it into a handheld weapon. The weapons made differ across the species, from clubs to swords to spears and many other types.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME skillfully uses the sticks it gnaws as weapons, fighting with impressive technique against anyone who dares threaten its dam. Its temperament is fiercely combative, and it won't calm down even if offered food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In a Pokémon battle, POKENAME employs a plethora of kicking techniques to stagger opponents. It practices kicking through wooden boards at various heights to keep its flurry of kicks unpredictable and forceful.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trains its fisticuffs by punching logs, chipping away until only splinters remain. Some have been trained to punch down wood into specific forms, after which the owner can sell the makeshift carvings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found around abandoned natural dams, feeding off the rotted wood. The gases it produces are highly flammable, leading some enterprising Trainers to try and harvest the gas as fuel to sell.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's incisors never stop growing, so it carries a piece of wood in its pouch and gnaws on it throughout the day.
author: hophoppip

entry: When dirty, a POKENAME rolls in a small pond or puddle to get clean. If the vines on its body dry out, they will fall off in clumps.
author: .izik

entry: Though it lacks the digits to help lift wood, POKENAME still helps Bidoof build their dams. It spits out a sticky ink that works as an adhesive, increasing the sturdiness of logs stuck together with it.
author: sk372

entry: Any wooden contraptions found in the forest are actually built by a POKENAME. It is seen monologuing to a Blastfetch'd about its tragic past.
author: aregularbigjoke

entry: This fusion awakened a dormant gene in POKENAME. It uses its axes to cut down trees to build dams for dozens of Bidoof families.
author: catsoup02

entry: POKENAME becomes fascinated with its own reflection in still water, trying to mimic every movement it sees. It often confuses other Pokémon by perfectly copying their behaviors as well.
author: .izik

entry: Although harmless, POKENAME's appearance on a desktop can be a bit of a nuisance. It's compelled to rearrange file locations into a dam of sorts, causing clutter and disarray for the computer's user.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoy carving wood into intricate shapes with their long blades and buck teeth. Woodcarvers study their techniques to improve their own craft.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's long neck lets it hold and place wooden logs high to assist Bidoof in dam-building. The leaves around its neck make a sweet scent that keeps Bidoof happy and tranquil.
author: sk372

entry: A curious pack Pokémon that rarely migrates to areas with only moderate rainfall; complete drought or heavy rain frustrates this Pokémon. It will let out a loud cry if separated from its pack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Even under stressful situations POKENAME remains calm and is adept at reading a situation. Beaches sometimes employ it alongside lifeguards to scan the sea from above, informing those on duty when there is an emergency.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME forage for berries to stock up on winter supplies and store those berries in their dams. During winter, they leave Grepa Berries for last because they hate sour foods.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lines its lodge with soft algae for comfort. It sheds fur from its long tail, layering it over the moss to keep warm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rocks its body back and forth like a metronome at night. At midnight, it suddenly gnaws down every limb from a nearby tree for reasons unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constructs its nest from twigs gnawed off trees. If an enemy gets too close, it puts them to sleep with Hypnosis before carrying them away with its claws.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers fields full of tulips, weaving the flowers into makeshift nests. It gathers petals for comfort, creating cozy places to rest beneath the colorful blooms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gathers orchids in its fists while flying, using them to line its lodge. This habit fills its home with a pleasant aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME secretes a sticky adhesive, which it uses to strengthen its dams and hold together nests. This natural glue makes its structures sturdy, withstanding even harsh weather.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves water-resistant webbing between logs in its dam to reinforce the structure. At night, it lays silk traps near the water's edge to capture unwary prey like Squirtle.
author: .izik

entry: It can flap its wings at high enough speeds to create blades of wind. These air currents are used to chop up trees for its den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can see an hour into the future for every inch its teeth are. If it senses something bad will happen, it will ignore this sign and continue to gnaw on wood.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME stands stock-still on the edge of a lake, awaiting visions of the future on the water's surface. Its plumage looks like a tree, so predators don't notice it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME stores sticks inside of its thick wool coat for later use. The wool is also water-repellent, making it a good material for clothing.
author: hophoppip

entry: While it chews on wood, the static in its fur grows due to the movement. Contact with its body while it eats can cause a mild electrical burn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats along riverbeds in search of ideal dam-building locations. It plants flower seeds nearby to mark its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gnaws off branches above passing travelers to startle them. If they drop anything in surprise, it quickly steals the item and dashes into the woods.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's jagged gills resemble the teeth of a bow saw, which it uses to cut logs for dam building. Fossils suggest that ancient POKENAME had much larger teeth, possibly used for the same purpose before their gills evolved to take over the task.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Although some have described POKENAME as generally dull and unaware, others have stated POKENAME has tons of confidence, taking any situation on with a smile. Its teeth regrow easily, so it nibbles on just about anything in reach of its mouth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME make their homes by the river's edge. During the autumn months, it will gnaw large holes in rocks for shelter.
author: .izik

entry: It sees through both pairs of eyes simultaneously. Because of this, young POKENAME can get motion sickness by just walking.
author: .izik

entry: Large clusters of POKENAME will live in a single tree. Should one be disturbed, it can set off a chain of small explosions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's keen eyesight allows it to spot Apricorn Trees from over 200 feet away. It swoops down, snatches Apricorns with its sharp teeth, and flies them back to its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an expert at cutting down all sorts of trees. Its arms, strangely, resemble chainsaws. It's rumored to be able to cut entire forests down.
author: catsoup02

entry: It can chop cleanly through tree trunks in a single strike. When it sleeps in the wild, it likes to rest its head on a gnawed-on log.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME pretends to be friendly to those who approach its den. If someone gets too close, it bites them with its fangs before snatching one of their belongings and fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: The bubbling mud on POKENAME's body burns hotter than an industrial furnace. It enjoys gnawing on burnt trees near volcanoes, consuming the ash as part of its diet.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constantly chews through trees and wood with its two front teeth, then digests them with the enzymes that cover its body. Its shell is a byproduct of the wood it digests, and large colonies of this Pokémon can be found damming up rivers.
author: notadoctor75

entry: Despite its tiny neck, a POKENAME can swallow an apricorn whole. It can survive on one apricorn for an entire week.
author: .izik

entry: Even when there are few trees in an area, it always finds a way to craft a dam out of what is available. After a day of construction, it sorts out sticks to give to its cohorts for helping out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its strong sense of smell to detect predators before starting construction on a dam. If it senses danger, it rolls away at high speed to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spend much of their time scraping the internet for pictures of wooden logs to stack in front of an image of a river. If they feel particularly tech-savvy, they find and play sounds of flowing water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly brave; nothing can disturb it as it grazes. Gardeners see them as pests since they aren't provoked as easily and feed extensively on their plants.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME leaves stains wherever it goes, dragging its tail through paint and mud. Each mark it creates seems intentional, almost as if it is trying to tell a story through art.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME finds small trees and gnaws on them to carve practice dummies. It trains day and night, determined to become a great fighter.
author: evilgammon

entry: The spikes on the heads of POKENAME are adapted to carving wood for constructing dens. Logs left behind by POKENAME are often collected and sold for high prices due to their interesting grooves.
author: just_a_few_thousand_crows

entry: POKENAME enjoys splashing in shallow creeks, using the flowing water to cool off during hot days. It builds small dams nearby, turning parts of the creek into peaceful pools.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful tails to strip bark from trees with surprising dexterity. It enjoys stacking logs in strange patterns, which researchers believe may be a form of play.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates motionless copies of itself with mud near its lodge at night to confuse predators. If it begins to rain, it quickly retreats inside for shelter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME watches travelers near its den and mimics their mannerisms with excitement. As a thank-you for the entertainment, it offers them bundles of freshly gathered twigs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are most commonly found living with groups of Chansey. It shapes perfectly round white stones with its sharp incisors and gifts them to Happiny.
author: mepp.

entry: With teeth that are constantly growing, POKENAME will gnaw at trees to wear their teeth down. The falling trees will sometimes land on top of them, POKENAME curling up into a ball to endure the collapsing trunk.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME only needs to float in water for 15 minutes a day to get all the nutrients it needs. In battle it is often predicted to be the underdog due to its small size, but it can stand up to quite a lot of hits and keep on fighting.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME rely on their buck teeth to carve into trees, which become their home. They practice their powerful kicks against tree stumps.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cut down trees using their buck teeth and sharp talons to chop down trees. They partner with existing Bidoof dams to create a large nest for themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carries mint leaves in its fur, spreading a refreshing scent wherever it goes. Other Pokémon seek its company, drawing calm and clarity from the aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the wooden blades on its arms for attacking and blocking in battle. It's occasionally seen trying to nibble its own elbows.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME drips a foul-smelling venom from its horn around its lodge to deter predators. If the warning is ignored, it attacks with a ferocious Super Fang.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME may appear quite intimidating and omnipotent, but despite its legendary looks, it is still just two Bidoof.
author: mirby

entry: Many consider POKENAME to be the true god of Pokémon, more powerful than Arceus itself. Its strength is simply unmatched.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME have incisors that grow at a prodigious rate. They try to gnaw through wood as quickly as possible in order to keep them under control. Unfused Bidoof will try and help POKENAME, bringing them plenty of logs to chew on.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has ascended and reached its true form. Trainers that stare too deeply into POKENAME's eyes never act the same afterwards.
author: westerlytrack45

entry: POKENAME have huge teeth capable of gnawing through even steel. Their diet consists mostly of driftwood and wooden shipwrecks. They don't have that much going on in their heads, but they mean no harm.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: Forests with large populations of POKENAME have large open glades within them, the trees that would have grown in the glade having been rammed down by them. The fallen trees are pulled together to make shelters from the weather.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME floats near cemeteries by riverbanks, silently observing the area. It bites off limbs from flowering trees to decorate graves.
author: .izik

entry: When groups of Bidoof have trouble building a dam due to rushing currents, POKENAME swims in to temporarily block the water for them to build. Afterwards, POKENAME enjoys splashing around in the newfound large body of water.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME appears rarely, usually in lakeside regions where Bidoof are common. Using its mighty powers, it reshapes dams that Bidoof have built into a facsimile of its own form, then vanishes mysteriously.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in densely forested regions, gnawing through the bark of fallen trees for sustenance. Their fur is often coated in dense layers of mud, with small sprouts of plant life growing from it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME builds lodges across the river from others of its kind, engaging in a friendly rivalry. This competition drives them to constantly improve their surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME always knows the direction and distance of the nearest tree. It dutifully gnaws on trees and plants to prevent overgrowth.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME obsessively carves wood and stone. It aggressively defends anything it has marked.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME diligently pounds wood and stone to make its nest. It also pounds the ground to scare off invaders, and pounds aquatic Pokémon as their predator.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME like to smash everything they come across. They are able to swing their hammer-shaped bodies so hard against the ground that they often cause landslides and earthquakes.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME's teeth can gnaw through the toughest bark. It uses venomous horns protruding from its fur to ward off threats while building dams with its companions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its hard horn marks diseased trees unusable for dams or dens. Its body secretes toxins that, when synthesized in a laboratory, can be used to create creams to treat skin conditions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are widely regarded as protectors of the forest, helping to build homes for Pokémon that don't have one. During natural disasters, POKENAME will cooperate with humans to ensure the safety of the surrounding Pokémon.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME is often found accompanying Bidoof groups in the process of making dams. It uses its ribbons to help move logs around, as well as helping relax tired Bidoof who need a rest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be easily irritated if it spots other Pokémon desecrating its forest. However, they seem happy to help any struggling Bidoof colonies.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is said to gnaw at space that has been distorted. It is said to create dams in space to close up Ultra Wormholes.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal woodland Pokêmon. When the moon is full, its teeth begin to glow, becoming clean and repairing any damage to them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME carves weapons for itself by gnawing at its wooden hands. The wood regrows regularly, allowing for the creation of new weapon types.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has the power to possess anything made of wood. It devours the wood when it's done, which makes it quite the pest.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's flame emits the light and smoky scent of a campfire. Travelers lost in the woods sometimes follow it, mistaking it for their own campsite, and end up even more lost.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its resilient teeth are its pride and joy. POKENAME gnaws up boulders and steel beams and licks up the shavings to keep its teeth in top condition.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME loves to carry woodcarving tools. It's too small and weak to hold most types of tools, however, so Trainers gift them with miniature tools to keep them away from the full-sized ones.
author: hophoppip

entry: Due to POKENAME's poor eyesight, it finds itself getting stuck in narrow cave passages. It relies on explorers for help and thanks them with an excited bite.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME flies at high speeds, zooming about to gather wood to help Bidoof build their dams. Without realizing, it sometimes steals the wood from other Bidoof to help the current Bidoof it's helping.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slaps mud onto logs to reinforce its lodge. Once its home is complete, it plants flowers on the roof as a finishing touch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME never puts up much of a fight in the wild. Even an unfamiliar human could waltz right into its habitat, pick one up, and carry it away without so much as a flail from POKENAME itself.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME never puts up much of a fight in the wild. Even an unfamiliar human could waltz right into its habitat, pick one up, and carry it away without so much as a flail from POKENAME itself.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a nighttime predator that may either hunt independently or in a group. When it howls, its concentration sharpens, and it may begin employing a variety of unique and uncommon hunting strategies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME collects parsley to line its den, using the herb's scent to ward off pests. Its resourcefulness makes it a helpful companion in any environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hovers near Bidoof building dams, rotating slowly as it analyzes the wood they gather. It fires the front gear to shred and destroy logs it deems structurally unworthy to be a part of the dam.
author: sk372

entry: It has a habit of spacing out from time to time. When it does, its flame slowly dims, and if not snapped out of the trance, it will burn out entirely.
author: skymaster426

entry: Between its cute looks and calming singing voice, POKENAME is a popular Pokémon for families. It has a highly developed drive to help other creatures, and long-term bonding with it has proven to reduce sadness.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME makes its home near posies, enjoying their fragrant scent. If disturbed while basking in the sunlight, it attempts to bite intruders or swat them with its log-like arms.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being blind, POKENAME flies skillfully through forests thanks to its highly sensitive sense of smell, which lets it detect nearby tree trunks. Usually shy and patient, it bites fiercely if threatened.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can carry logs up to 10 times their weight. Because of this, they are often kept as pets in logging villages to help with transporting lumber.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by an ancient civilization, with the intent of being as simple and normal as possible.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME nests among tall sunflowers, using the plants as both shelter and food. Its bright demeanor matches the cheery flowers, making it a beloved sight for passing Trainers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits tiny flames to loosen tree limbs, then uses them to build its nest. If intruders approach, it flaps its wings to whip up strong winds as a warning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constructs a home for itself out of sticks. When in grave danger, it emits enough heat to set its home ablaze, burning its enemies.
author: hophoppip

entry: It will steal lumber from unoccupied construction sites to build its den. Its teeth are as hard as diamonds and can cut through solid steel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely well suited for gliding through water swiftly. Its powerful teeth can shred through steel and prey alike.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME chews through trees in the morning, then possesses the stumps before sleeping. Why it prefers stumps over whole trees remains a mystery to researchers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME kindly watches over all forest dwelling Pokémon. It is so benevolent that it pays no mind when Bidoof gnaw on its bark.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's fur retains moisture, keeping it cool during hot days. It enjoys resting near rivers, where the dampness in its coat helps regulate its body temperature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a thick fur coat that retains warmth during the winter. During the summer, they shed more than a quarter of their weight in fur, as the weather conditions are otherwise too hot for them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It resides in rivers, consuming fish Pokémon that swim into its mouth. If a human touches POKENAME, they will be compelled to pile more sticks on its body.
author: hophoppip

entry: The fungus growing on the body of POKENAME is remarkably high in lignin. This gives it a very wooden texture. In order to fuel the growth of these fungi, POKENAME will seek out tree bark as its primary food source.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME senses when its Trainer is sad and chews off a tree branch to offer as a toy. It wags its stubby tail and requests a game of fetch to cheer them up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is commonly used as a mascot for various wildlife preserves. Its comically placid face is beloved by children.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME floats around lakefront areas, sleeping during the day and being active at night. If one dreams about becoming a Bidoof while they sleep, it's because POKENAME floated past them during their slumber.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feed on dead wood and other plant matter, incorporating the lignin into their body to create a protective skin that doubles as camouflage. Their preference for dead wood leaves them vulnerable to fungal infection.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is incredibly timid and rarely seen since it typically hides within the dams of Bidoof and Bibarel. Sometimes a group of POKENAME will help build dams by ferrying fallen trees on their backs.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME work tirelessly to replant tree groves that have been over-harvested. They gather the nuts and seeds of nearby tree species and plant them haphazardly in open spaces in the hopes of reforesting the area.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: With the flames emitted from its wand, POKENAME marks the trees it plans to cut down to build its dam, so it doesn't forget them later. It has a particularly brave nature and will fight even the strongest foes to defend its home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME choreograph intense dances that incorporate long streams of water issuing from their twigs. These dances serve as a focus for them, facilitating a state of meditation that empowers their potent prophetic abilities.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME plants pumpkin patches around its lodge to mark its territory. At night, it curls up and sleeps among the pumpkins.
author: .izik

entry: There are reports of POKENAME swarming around towns and gnawing at streetlights. Once it severs the base of the pole, it will fly the entire post back to its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are skilled at carving faces into wood with their teeth. Their skills are appreciated by many, though those with wooden houses are not among them.
author: hophoppip

entry: Rumors of floating tree stumps were debunked when it rolls onto the shore to dry off. It is so convincing as a tree stump that Flying-type Pokémon rest on its back to preen its wings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trains with its legs stuck in wooden blocks. The wood serves as a physical challenge, adding extra weight, and a mental one, forcing POKENAME to resist eating the delicious wood.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can be found in taigas, chewing trees down to make dams. Whenever they successfully fell a tree, they all clap excitedly.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME aggressively defends its lodge, knocking out intruders with a powerful Low Kick. It then hurls them into a nearby river to be carried downstream.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stays among others of its kind for protection. In a pinch, it can fire weak electrical shocks to defend itself from predators that lurk by its riverside home.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It punches trees to test its strength. Once the tree falls, it will use its sharp fangs to consume it over the course of days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grow irrationally angry at the sound of running water, seeking to stem the flow of streams and rivers in whatever way they can. This often results in them tearing down trees and creating impromptu dams.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A wild POKENAME likes to live in the woods by mud. Whenever It senses danger it flaps their wings to warn any threats nearby.
author: krsgaming

entry: POKENAME doesn't do much of anything except sleep and occasionally nibble on some sticks whenever it is awake. Its dull behavior and lack of battling skill in the wild have caused many to compare it to Magikarp.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have idyllic lives near rivers where they chew on wood and make dams. On the rare occasion that their tail fishing captures a Shellder, they experience a moment of lucid clarity before evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gnaw at the plants in their environment to create sticks that they can carry with them. They don't use the sticks for fighting, instead waving them about in competition with others to see who has the largest stick.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gnaw at the plants in their environment to create sticks that they can carry with them. They don't use the sticks for fighting, instead waving them about in competition with others to see who has the largest stick.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live simple, halcyon lives in the sea where they hunt Magikarp and take naps on the beach. They chew on driftwood that arrives on shore to sharpen their teeth before returning to hunt in the sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME doesn't seem to realize that its mere presence can fill the room with filthy, dirt-laden gas, even if it is told this directly. Some theorize wild POKENAME were birthed by the spirits of innocent and forgetful children.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME doesn't seem to realize that its mere presence can fill the room with filthy, dirt-laden gas, even if it is told this directly. Some theorize wild POKENAME were birthed by the spirits of innocent and forgetful children.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Dutiful and perhaps a little dumb, POKENAME tirelessly works in a self-assigned manner: patrol an area, gather Berries for friends, or try to create something fun to show off to its forest buddies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A Pokémon that was formed by the spirits of six eggs. The spirits are bound to their cracked shells.
author: fuzzythelion

entry: POKENAME are native to the Alola region, often roaming around popular graveyards. If you eat one of its fruits, you will find yourself ill soon after.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME uses the bones of its predecessors to call upon their spiritual aid in battle, though it's against their will.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is comprised of the spirit of 108 boxers. By combining the strengths of each of the spirits, it can adapt to any style of battle.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME release an aroma similar to Full Incense, a heavy and dense concoction of chemicals that makes people lethargic. Their collective consciousness is formed from the noxious vapors produced by factory workers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sightings have been linked to spiritual locations wracked and ruined by pollution over the years. When the spirits inhabiting the body manifest, anything in close proximity begins slowly losing the ability to breathe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to have taken on a more greasy and narcissistic persona. Despite its failings, it can cook a mean pizza for those it deems friends.
author: lordkai1

entry: When unsuspecting Trainers get too close to the Odd Keystone, POKENAME emerges, trapping them with invisible barriers. Supposedly the last thing they hear is a dark, haunting laugh as their soul becomes absorbed.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME was formed by 108 spirits. While it can transform into anything, it prefers the shape of its former loved ones.
author: dzygomer

entry: POKENAME can fire off tiny electrically-charged needles from its rocky mane. Folklore in some regions says that those who are pierced by the needles will one day join the collective of spirits that inhabits its stone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME inhabits chunks of Fire Stones while resting, leaping out in a blaze of flames if disturbed. Many Trainers have unknowingly picked up an inhabited stone, only to be attacked.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to be Porygon corrupted by over 108 viruses afflicting it at once. It acts in a glitched, distorted fashion, and its presence corrupts and damages electronics it inhabits.
author: sk372

entry: A Pokémon commonly spotted hiding in marine crevices. It patiently waits for the opportune moment to ambush its prey.
author: karma

entry: POKENAME are infamous for being violent tricksters, pretending to be piles of bones or skeletons to deceive others and then attack them. In their most active state, they radiate an eerie energy that flares when they are enraged.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME slithers between kelp growing off sunken vessels in the ocean depths. Should it be spotted, it releases a ghastly wail that many claim is the cries of those who perished during the ship's sinking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tends to zip around in twisted, confusing patterns when excited. Capturing its keystone will keep it from wreaking havoc.
author: ohok3441

entry: The spirits trapped within the Odd Keystone manifest in the form of a Spinarak to startle prey and predators alike. Those caught within their ghostly webs will feel like their very life force is being slowly drained away.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fly about during autumn, possessing other Pokémon who are then compelled to part with a portion of their food stores. The possessed Pokémon transport this portion to POKENAME's cave, where it happily enjoys its food all winter long.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME's shell appears to contain several spirits within. The main spirit that comprises the body is protected by these other spirits, which leak from cracks in the stone to strike out at any threats to the main body.
author: sk372

entry: Spiritual energy swirls around the stone statue that is POKENAME's body. Echoing bleats can be heard from deep within.
author: hophoppip

entry: The spirits inhabiting the stone form limbs to hop around swamps and ponds. POKENAME then extends its face out from the mouth like a tongue to shriek at and scare away potential aggressors.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME are drawn to Rattata or Raticate that are killed with mouse traps. People plagued by these Pokémon will often hear snapping throughout the night, as if dozens of mouse traps were going off.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME feed themselves by leeching nutrients from other plants near them until those other plants wilt and decay. They will move to a new resting place once the ground itself has dried up.
author: infinex21

entry: No spirit ever attempts to escape from POKENAME's body due to POKENAME's 360-degree vision always keeping a watchful eye out. It frequently attempts to generate shock waves to shatter its Odd Keystone, but to no success.
author: soup1900

entry: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.
author: chorb33

entry: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME appears in alleyways at night. It constantly juggles its glowing balls, which it uses to hypnotize its victims before abducting them.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are said to gather souls of the dead into the bulb on their back. Cracking this bulb unleashes a surge of energy that causes hallucinations that look like lost loved ones.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce clusters of pollen that glow in the dark. They are a vengeful creature that attacks those who harm the forest around them.
author: quackquackattack
