entry: It dresses as a remarkable Sinnoh Trainer to leave an imposing presence among other dragon-type Pokémon. It is considered a symbol of strength.
author: nasho1908

entry: It dresses as a remarkable Sinnoh Trainer to leave an imposing presence among other dragon-type Pokémon. It is considered a symbol of strength.
author: nasho1908

entry: When calm, this Pokémon uses great skill in the art of battle. However, when enraged, POKENAME will attack ruthlessly and unpredictably.
author: themicelegion

entry: A Pokémon known for its fighting prowess. It hunts Pokémon of a similar size to it for a challenge.
author: themicelegion

entry: Despite its rotund body, POKENAME is capable of flying at sonic speeds. However, it prefers to scuttle around caves using its wing-like claws.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: POKENAME's wings have sharpened into scythes, making them extremely dangerous weapons. Its extremely coarse skin and sharp spikes lining its body dissuade enemies from physically attacking this Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wings have sharpened into scythes, making them extremely dangerous weapons. Its extremely coarse skin and sharp spikes lining its body dissuade enemies from physically attacking this Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has lost both its wings and the protuberances on its head, giving it no survival tools. It is predicted that this species of Pokémon will go extinct in the near future.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's sharp scythes have an extremely high breaking power. It can slice a tungsten beam into tiny pieces in mere seconds.
author: soup1900

entry: Unlike Mawile, POKENAME is much less deceptive, confidently hunting for prey many times its own size. Its jaws can crush even the toughest of metals.
author: berrivine

entry: POKENAME's headplate is used both for defense and mating displays. Male POKENAME attack rivals by headbutting and shoving, vying to prove themselves the strongest.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Ancient worshippers once painted the star marking of POKENAME across their faces in devotion. The paint used was made with Iapapa Berries and Yellow Apricorns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its thin, rigid scales, combined with its sharp blades, makes POKENAME a being whose entire body is a weapon.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME can be found in the mountains, dueling each other for dominance. It is fast enough to turn a boulder into sand in two seconds.
author: skymaster426

entry: Its body passively absorbs and discharges electricity, even while asleep. It uses this stored energy to detect prey and move at lightning-fast speeds.
author: lemgambino

entry: POKENAME is commonly seen challenging aircraft to races, which it often wins. On the rare occasion it loses, POKENAME will break out into a fit of rage, burning everything in sight.
author: astral_1447

entry: POKENAME likes to attack by using its central body as a buzzsaw. The spinning motion has the added benefit of saturating its body with power, allowing it to fire projectiles and saturate its physical moves with arcane energy.
author: fireblade141

entry: When it gets excited, it bites everything it sees. For this reason, POKENAME should not be trained by fledgling Trainers, despite its loyalty.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME's antennae are sensitive enough to detect changes in people's moods and durable enough to be used as extra scything claws. They are difficult to befriend due to their cautious nature.
author: ghostslythe

entry: This Pokémon is very social and often makes groups with other species. Overhunting has caused POKENAME to be near extinct.
author: yoshimon

entry: A Pokémon with highly abrasive skin and an even more abrasive temper. By rapidly rotating the whip-like appendages on its back, it can take flight and hunt down anything it deems a foe.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: Many compare these Pokémon to jet planes because they often spread their wings out flat to achieve greater speeds. They will vent heat and flames from between their feathers and from their two horns, which further propel them quicker.
author: infinex21

entry: Protective by nature, POKENAME has the heart of a dragon. It hoards costume materials to make itself more aerodynamic. It attempts to pose menacingly to intimidate Trainers, but most find it adorable instead.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It resembles a certain Pokémon champion. It's unknown if this was so more people would like it, or if it was to serve as a way to scare off Trainers.
author: jackythewannabe

entry: It is a rare Pokémon sometimes depicted in legends. As it quickly flutters around the battlefield, draconic flames and pointed scales erupt here and there from its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are encased in a red slime said to taste like strawberry jam. Only Trainers who befriend them can safely harvest it, as POKENAME are highly aggressive.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME's scales have the peculiar quality of being extremely fine in one direction, reducing drag both in and out of the water. However, each scale has microscopic barbs that make it painful to stroke it the other way.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's scales have the peculiar quality of being extremely fine in one direction, reducing drag both in and out of the water. However, each scale has microscopic barbs that make it painful to stroke it the other way.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are quick, dirty fighters that stagger enemies with kicks before finishing them with sharp talons. They are very competitive and hate losing.
author: yoshimon

entry: POKENAME soars through the skies on wings of dense clouds, masking its presence until it strikes. Despite its soft, cotton-like appearance, its jaws and claws are deadly.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Constantly hungry for prey, POKENAME will attack anything it sees, fighting entire flocks of Pokémon at once. Its body is made of scales that reduce the drag from even light particles, letting it fly at extremely high speeds.
author: soup1900

entry: Because its scales are extremely hard and sharp, people tend to avoid petting POKENAME. When neglected for too long, it becomes irritable and aggressive; it might even bite its own Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Through the sheer force of Liquidation, wild POKENAME has destroyed many ships and critically injured countless sailors. It always takes what it deems valuable from the wreckage, as though it were a pirate.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME lives in forests, where it sprints at high speeds. Its arm blades are sharp enough to easily cut through trees, ensuring nothing can block its path while it runs. If it notices prey, it pounces on them to secure its next meal.
author: fireblade141

entry: While it offers to carry small Pokémon on its back like Lotad, it simply travels way too fast and far too rough for other Pokémon to actually hold on for very long. Sometimes, POKENAME can be found in desert oases.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's pincers are covered in tiny, incredibly abrasive scales. While they appear smooth from a distance, even brief contact can cause severe wounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are speedy predators that use their aerodynamic bodies to slice through the air. They tear through dense jungles by heating their hinge-blades to scorching temperatures, incinerating almost any obstacle in their path.
author: zekkenbytheden

entry: POKENAME are very popular in Unova, where they often show off by racing against jet engines. It is theorized that the muscles of POKENAME might be sturdy enough to resist a missile explosion.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Escaping from a hungry POKENAME is not easy. Even if one runs from the tree it hangs from, it can fling itself and extend its leaves in a way that lets it glide through the air in an attempt to swallow fleeing prey whole.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's young holds on tightly to its tail at all times because it feels there is no safer place to be. Few can get past a POKENAME when it's protecting something.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME loves to frighten others by jetting through the air at high speeds and pretending to cut at its target with its floating limbs. Its devious mocking cackle remains in the victim's mind long after it has vanished to find another to scare.
author: sk372

entry: It sinks beneath the ground without shifting a stone wherever a shadow is. Its toothy maw gapes open wide, then swallows its victim whole with supernatural speed.
author: ozydamians

entry: Although the rest of its body has matured, its seed remains as it is. Scientists believe the seed will remain dormant for the entirety of its life.
author: soup1900

entry: While dazzling flowers that require sunlight to live grow on POKENAME's back, POKENAME is still weak and vulnerable to attacks from Flying-type Pokémon. As a result, they are often protected by other Butterfree or Venusaur.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's short legs cannot be used for walking or standing, only for adjusting the rolling direction. Its stamens can spill uncontrollable electric currents at any time, making protective measures essential before approaching one.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME becomes active at night by efficiently absorbing and storing sunlight. Although it hardly sleeps, the three heads seem to do nothing at night except meditate individually.
author: oreee0230

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME wields its massive plant with ease. It swiftly knocks down weak opponents with one swing.
author: mepp.

entry: The thorn-clad flower it wields was once part of the flower upon its back and scatters poisonous spores when waved around. Its body is dense with muscle to help support the weight of its growing flower.
author: infinex21

entry: Instead of a skull, the flower has fused onto POKENAME's head through evolution. It utilizes the flower as a weapon, attacking with bursts of pollen.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME have photosynthetic cells laced throughout their skin that enable them to gain energy directly from the sun. They use this energy to fuel lightning fast kicks, maintaining a speed that is hard to match by their opponents.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gains strength from sunlight and can throw punches continuously. Once away from sunlight, it needs to rest after fighting continuously for 3 minutes.
author: oreee0230

entry: When it is close to evolving, POKENAME's cocoon-like body begins cracking as a giant flower starts to bloom from the new hole. However, this is when POKENAME is most vulnerable to life-threatening injuries.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The gases it expels have become tropical scented, but still remain pungent. People describe the aroma as being like rotten pineapples and papayas.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME gather soil in the crags and crevices between their armour plates. The plants that grow in amongst these crags are tended to by POKENAME. They take their time finding both sun and rain to keep them healthy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The seed carried by POKENAME can grow into the form most needed by the surrounding Pokémon. After the seed is planted, POKENAME can use sunlight to nurture new seeds.
author: oreee0230

entry: When its plants are in full bloom, POKENAME's vines coil up and turn a bright green. It can unleash powerful whips with them and they even grow back with just an hour of sunlight.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME live in tropical estuaries, their brightly coloured fins helping them blend in with leaves and petals floating at the surface of the river. They are aggressive when disturbed, shooting concentrated streams of water at their aggressor.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite seeking only other POKENAME, it avoids humans and all other Pokémon entirely. It sprays an ultra-dense cloud of pollen to defend itself.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: At the start of spring, POKENAME spins like a top to spread pollen from its petals, filling forests with delicately scented flowers. The gem at its center stores sunlight to unleash a powerful Solar Beam.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spends the day gathering energy from the sun and hunts at night. It prefers to hide amongst thick foliage, waiting patiently for the perfect moment to strike.
author: mepp.

entry: Its entire dress is a single petal from the flower crown on its head. It talks to plants, giving them commands.
author: houndrys.

entry: To keep itself from drying out or taking in too much water, POKENAME shields itself from harsh sunlight and torrential rain with a parasol of petals. Even the surrounding flora dances as this Pokémon struts along.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME frequently fights with various Pokémon, including its own kind, to steal food and territory. POKENAME's wooden horns grow very quickly to compensate for wear.
author: oreee0230

entry: Some heavily injured POKENAME use fungi to repair their wounds. These fungi are tougher than the original shell, but the nutrients required to nourish them often force POKENAME to eat around the clock.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME will grow rapidly in size as long as it has sunlight and water. In spring, it is often possible to see POKENAME over ten meters long fighting for the position of leader.
author: oreee0230

entry: The rich nutrients possessed within POKENAME's body makes it the perfect snack for Pidgeotto. When flopping around on land, it can sometimes defend itself with a powerful Solar Beam.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME's flower contains highly toxic poison. Every drastic motion that a POKENAME makes causes poison to spill out, as they often have trouble holding up the large flower on their own.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A Pokémon typically found in tropical regions, POKENAME is known as the herald of the monsoon season. They are normally sighted ahead of or during torrential downpours and floods, and as a result, they have a reputation for violence and destruction.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon typically found in tropical regions, POKENAME is known as the herald of the monsoon season. They are normally sighted ahead of or during torrential downpours and floods, and as a result, they have a reputation for violence and destruction.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fires petals from its gelatinous body at extremely high speeds to attack. The noise it makes when doing this is similar to gunfire.
author: .izik

entry: If you see many flower petals floating on water, it may actually be a POKENAME that has just submerged.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME love to lounge in tepid ponds and lakes with their heads and petals above the surface, ambiently absorbing water and sunlight. They produce a sap-like liquid in place of saliva, which allows them to reinforce the bubbles they spit out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's yellow "crown" is a special plant that acts like an organ to help regulate the electricity stored within its vibrant petals. Its claws are sharp enough that it can climb trees, though it only does this to better ambush prey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME petals are always warm to the touch and contain an oil-like fluid that is flammable and incredibly spicy, making it a popular ingredient in some dishes. Within their tail fur are numerous seeds that they will launch and ignite in battle.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME prefers to rest in deep secluded forests. If disturbed, it emits a loud electronic beep before firing a Zap Cannon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was utilized in early 3D games to propagate grass textures. Unfortunately, an error in its coding made it spread viruses too.
author: rkmaster25367

entry: POKENAME submerges its soft body beneath the mud, leaving its hard tree trunk exposed. It only moves when looking for a suitably wet spot that has not dried up and does not cover the leaves.
author: oreee0230

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back took a tremendous amount of energy to bloom. It has to constantly use Harden to make up for its fragility.
author: porpoisemerchant

entry: At dawn, POKENAME emerge from caves near beaches to fight for the best places to sunbathe. Their legs are used to pinch at other POKENAME who try to take their spot in the sun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fossil records show that POKENAME were apex predators when they were alive, expertly hunting through the lush rainforest where it lives. Its thick tail allows it to swing from trees to increase its speed.
author: mistymagius

entry: Though it can walk on its hind legs, it tends to crawl on all four so that its large flower is better exposed to sunlight. It has been seen laying atop a pile of stockpiled food while sleeping, with its flower exposed to the sky.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is incredibly rare, as it lives deep in the jungle. Trees are leveled when it flaps its massive leafy wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a legendary bird Pokémon that occupies tropical rainforests. After absorbing enough energy from sunlight, it summons fierce thunderstorms to shock and confuse prey.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The flowers along POKENAME's leafy wings are always in full bloom, scattering pollen and seeds across wherever it flies. The area around its nest is said to be one of the lushest and most exotic forests ever known.
author: infinex21

entry: Flower petals swirl around POKENAME, making its figure difficult to detect. It bestows the blessing to bear fruit upon flowers, therefore it is regarded as an omen of good fortune.
author: oreee0230

entry: Despite POKENAME's glyph-like appearance, it isn't related to Unown. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME resembles a mathematical constant. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME resembles a mathematical constant. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.
author: valtsuri

entry: A diurnal Pokémon that defeats encroachers by wrapping them with vines or making them unconscious with spores before skewering them with their stinger. It seems POKENAME's main priority is reproducing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME produce a pungent scent from their flower that calms people down. Many temples rely on this scent to help them meditate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce highly flammable pollen from the plants growing along their body. Their body temperatures are high enough that they will sometimes inadvertently cause the pollen to spontaneously combust.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME make their homes around the fertile soil at the base of volcanoes. They make use of the nutrients in the soil to grow a vivid petal crown to display to one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is unknown why the blazing fire on POKENAME's backs never ignites the leaves on their heads. It's long been wondered if POKENAME's genetics could hold the key to developing more fire-resistant crops.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME have a coating of bark across their stomach to help protect them when they dig underground. When they sleep they do so with their head resting outside of their burrows, letting their petals drape around them and absorb sunlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Even in the depths of winter, the plants surrounding the nape of POKENAME are able to keep growing thanks to their high internal body temperature. They flash their petals to signal at one another and resolve territorial disputes without fighting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Even in the depths of winter, the plants surrounding the nape of POKENAME are able to keep growing thanks to their high internal body temperature. The colouration of the fronds they grow is a good indicator of the Pokémon's health.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emit a constant cloud of nearly invisible pollen from their backs. When they are preparing to fight, they light a small spark from their fur that ignites this pollen cloud and creates an intimidating, fiery display.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emit a constant cloud of nearly invisible pollen from their backs. When they are preparing to fight, they light a small spark from their fur that ignites this pollen cloud and creates an intimidating, fiery display.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy taking naps in bright sunlight to nourish themselves and the flower on their back. Many Pokémon leave them alone during these naps out of a fear of getting bitten.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carry a large flower on its back that passively releases spores around them. They peck at the ground to find poisonous roots to eat, which in turn make its spores poisonous.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although POKENAME move quicker quadrupedally, they spend much of their lives on their hind legs to better intimidate others. When they rest, they lie in tepid waters or in a damp spot where they can absorb plenty of sunlight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were first discovered deep within a lush and humid marsh, first assumed to be a large plant that had grown to the surface of a pond. It was quickly discovered that they hide as such in order to swiftly and mercilessly ambush prey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME provides shelter for bird Pokémon in exchange for their help in luring prey. Normally, POKENAME can breathe using only its leaves, but after hunting, it needs to quickly take in oxygen through its nose.
author: oreee0230

entry: The floral plumage on POKENAME's head fans out when it feels threatened or vulnerable. When it roosts during the day, the patterns on its head pulse along with its heartbeat.
author: silverscloudy

entry: POKENAME sleeps at the top of the forest canopy during the day, allowing the sun to beam down on its flower. When the flower blooms, POKENAME grows lighter, allowing it to glide more gracefully and silently.
author: stevethebarbarian

entry: It clings to tree trunks and branches for hours on end, lying in wait. When insect Pokémon come to drink from the flower on its back, it pounces.
author: calelian

entry: Few get the chance to see a POKENAME in the wild when this nocturnal Pokémon glides through moonlit forests in the deep of night. With its wings trailing tiny buds and pollens, plants bloom and nighttime prey vanishes wherever its shadow passes.
author: silentscript89

entry: When at rest, POKENAME can be easily mistaken for Venusaur. They use this similarity to safely hide from Pokémon that wouldn't attack the large Grass-Type but would be dangerous to them, the deception only being revealed when they take off.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME relies on its tail leaves to perform complex aerial maneuvers. It can quickly dive to snatch a Caterpie or Weedle before bringing the bug Pokémon back to its nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It gathers sunlight as as floats on the surface of ponds, converting it into electricity. It releases Stun Spores from its antennae before attacking.
author: ariamelisma

entry: The pollen that comes from the flowers sprouting out of POKENAME is both hydrophobic and luminescent. POKENAME leave a glowing trail in their wake as they swim thanks to this pollen, creating the illusion that they are swimming through a night sky.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in low visibility rivers that are thick with mud and silt. Their flowers typically trail at the surface to absorb sunlight, but they can react with water to create a potent electrical charge.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's huge flower weighs heavily on its tiny body, limiting its mobility. To compensate, it propels itself short distances by using powerful vines that extend from within its flower.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sprouts bulbs around nests to protect the baby chicks inside. On rare occasions, it uproots the nest and wraps it around its back with vines to find a safer location to nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: No matter how many flower petals POKENAME scatter while they dance, they will grow back almost instantly. POKENAME dance slowly and elegantly, soothed by the fragrance of their flower petals and allowing the wind to guide them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon for stage performances as their vividly coloured flowers and long draping leaves make very eye catching. It takes a lot of coaching for them to perform for larger crowds as they tend to freeze up with too much attention.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This swamp-dwelling Pokémon is remarkably pompous and arrogant, to the point that it acts like a ruler of other Pokémon. Each of its many thin leaves contains a hypnotic agent, which is why it will share them with its "subjects" every day.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can command other sound-sensitive Pokémon through its voice. Usually, it only needs to beat its belly to produce enough sound, but once it roars from its mouth, it cannot control the duration of the echo in its wooden jaw.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME produce thick swirls of pollen that spin the air around them to propel them into the air. Once airborne, they can go several days without food, as they photosynthesize nutrients through sunlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME steals seeds from flowerbeds and hides them in its mouth. It propagates its own seeds instead, which produce a flower that has musky and earthy scents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The crown-like flower blooming atop POKENAME is purely coincidental, as the shape helps prevent the oversized plant unbalancing POKENAME. Despite this, it was a custom for a POKENAME to be present at a coronation.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME slap each other with mud whenever they are trying to impress the opposite gender. They are predisposed to choosing mates that have tough bodies, so their mud-flinging tendencies help them find mates with similar levels of resilience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have become leaders of forests as they use strong fragrances to influence and attract nearby Pokémon. They release spores with strong mind altering properties, especially after they have spent time in the sunlight absorbing energy.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It uses its precognition to predict the weather. This enables it to spend as much time as possible lying in the sun, keeping its flower bright and colorful.
author: .jerden

entry: Plenty of moonlight creates bigger and more vibrant flowers for this species. The scent changes as the moon waxes and wanes.
author: deelee2020

entry: POKENAME live among wild Pokémon even though they have vast knowledge of the world around them. Whenever scientists come close to capturing POKENAME, they produce clouds of pollen that lull their pursuers to sleep and allow them to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's pot has boosted its psychic power to an exponential degree. It selects a garden of flowers and protects it by filling enemies' minds with disorienting visuals.
author: larryloud55

entry: POKENAME have vast knowledge that makes them some of the smartest Pokémon to exist. Despite their encyclopedic wisdom, they prefer to live among wild creatures and lead simple lives.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its flower has grown a lot sooner than expected. The weight of the flower crushes it, as it is not strong enough to carry it yet.
author: soup1900

entry: The bulb on the back of POKENAME releases a foul stench that wards off other Pokémon. It gorges itself on leftover snacks that it can find in garbage bins.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon is often seen resting on the sides of trees or brick walls. To remove these Pokémon from their spots, it is recommended to use a crowbar.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This docile Pokémon does not wander far from the cave it has made its den within and only comes out when sunlight is present; it cannot be tricked with artificial lights. If anything touches its spotted petals, it viciously lashes out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will retaliate equally against all threats. Making eye contact with the hidden eyes under POKENAME's flowers will anger it, but in such a case, its revenge is merely staring at the enemy.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's tough wooden shell shields it from most attacks. It anchors itself near the top of trees to absorb sunlight into the massive flower on its head.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's wings aren't strong enough for it to take off and fly. If it needs to move around quickly, it fires the drill-tip on its tail, connected by an extendable vine, lodging it into surfaces to pull and swing itself around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon amongst some Pokémon Contest Trainers, often dressed up in all sorts of unique outfits. They are patient with their Trainers during this, happy for the attention.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constantly struggles to keep its feathers clean because of the flower on its back. It sprouts vines to help itself scrub away at the spores, but this only causes more spores to fall from the flower.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fluff up their petals and leaves to make themselves look larger and more intimidating than they are. They are good at scaring off smaller Pokémon, but they struggle to convince larger Pokémon that they're a real threat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fluff up their petals and leaves to make themselves look larger and more intimidating than they are. POKENAME with less developed petals end up being more aggressive as compensation for their less threatening appearance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME survives by cooperating with bug Pokémon. The bug Pokémon collect organic matter for POKENAME, which absorbs nutrients through fermentation and produces a large amount of nectar in return.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME secure vines around trees to arrange arenas for duels where they clash horn to horn. The winner of the duel gets first pick of the flowers in the territory, while the loser honors the environment by helping to regrow them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its flower photosynthesizes at rates far exceeding regular flora, granting it harsh solar attacks. However, this leaves its body permanently melting at temperatures equal to lava.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME live on tropical islands that have high levels of volcanic activity. They travel out onto cooling lava flows, a special enzyme from their bodies dissolving the basalt and letting them absorb the rich nutrients to fuel their flower's growth.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Once believed to have existed only in prehistory, POKENAME dominate the marshlands in swathes. Urban legend warns that inhaling the spore-thick air around one will leave you permanently mute.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME slowly shuffle through leaf litter in search of fungi, using their acute sense of smell to do so. They are so slow moving that plants take root in their back, sprouting into full flowers and helping them stay safe through camouflage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keep themselves warm during the colder months by growing a dense coating of leaves from the symbiotic flower growing on their back. These leaves provide a food source in the summer months, but have a habit of obstructing their vision.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to leave the water for prolonged periods of time, their symbiotic plants letting them breathe despite being in the air. They'll use this ability to escape larger Pokémon, pulling themselves into bushes to hide until they feel safe.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to leave the water for prolonged periods of time, their symbiotic plants letting them breathe despite being in the air. They'll use this ability to escape larger Pokémon, pulling themselves into bushes to hide until they feel safe.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are often mistaken for moving islands as they swim along the ocean's surface. The trees on their backs absorb sunlight to constantly fuel them, allowing them to swim for days at a time without a break.
author: santon5512

entry: Its leaves are covered with a waxy substance, giving them a shiny appearance. Groups of POKENAME form flocks led by those with the shiniest wings.
author: busilisk

entry: The flame on a POKENAME's tail never goes out, even in the heaviest of rain. This is because the fire is directly fueled by the highly flammable toxin its flower produces.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME's exterior feathers are red petals that grow more vivid as POKENAME become stronger. They live in groups in the forest, using their bright colors to intimidate enemies.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME naturally blend into the surrounding forest and can lie in wait for hours at a time. When an unsuspecting Pokémon comes near, a flurry of pollen lulls prey to sleep before POKENAME chomp down on their new meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will find a bush to sleep in and are well disguised by their flowers and leaves when resting. When awake, they have a habit of using their incredible strength to topple trees to get to the fruit that would otherwise be out of their reach.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are expressive yet gentle creatures that can communicate with people through trumpeting and rumbling. Whenever they are upset, they shake the flower atop their backs to release a sticky pollen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME thrive in cyberspace and enjoy encouraging children to learn new vocabulary words. Even though POKENAME are programmed to cultivate virtual rice to make a counter go up, their main priority is to help children learn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are benevolent creatures that help wild Pokémon heal from wounds with delicate care. Their pollen acts like an antiseptic while their vines wrap around wounds to prevent infections.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses the fluid secreted from the tip of its tail to mark its territory. This fluid is poisonous to most organic beings, yet plants and plant-based Pokémon thrive if they ingest or absorb it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are resourceful Pokémon, using nearby leaves and flowers to make gorgeous gowns. If a stain gets on one of their dresses, they will throw a tantrum.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The pollen is a powerful irritant and can cause paralytic, soporific, or even poisonous effects when inhaled.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME camouflages itself as a plant with the leaves on its back. Whenever it ambushes its prey, a venomous sac opens and releases a toxic pollen from underneath its hood.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces a very delicate milk from the center of the flower growing on its abdomen; being a plant-based, lactose-free product, it can be consumed by everyone. If the petals on its belly wilt, this Pokémon can no longer produce milk.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is very dedicated to the plant that it carries in its pouch. This is due to the plant's ability to, when properly cared for, dispense a soothing and healing mist of pollen that can cure most any ailment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME disperse clouds of pollen to store their electricity, resembling rolling storm clouds. When they roar, the pollen discharges the stored energy as powerful bolts.
author: oreee0230

entry: With its unique poise, it strolls over the top of the fluids, purifying every liquid upon which it sets its noble feet. The juice secreted by its blossom-lined crest might restore the vigor of rotting trees within one brief stretch of seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Adventurous Trainers are advised to take care when traversing jungles that are home to POKENAME. Their colouration and flowers make them blend in to the undergrowth and it is easy to accidentally step on one, which will always cause them to strike.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME usually keep their petals flush to their neck to make it easier for them to slither around. When they want to scare off a rival they will flash their petals into a full flower, making themselves abruptly look larger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Adventurous Trainers are advised to take care when traversing jungles that are home to POKENAME. Their colouration and flowers make them blend in to the undergrowth and it is easy to accidentally step on one, which will always cause them to strike.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: During the autumn months, small berries sprout from POKENAME's back. Picking them causes a mild electric shock, but the berries are sweet and commonly used as oatmeal toppings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be seen drifting through forests, meadows and gardens at sundown. It sings strange, melancholy songs that some believe make plants grow.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME wears a special cap that connects to its brain, allowing it to gain new and shocking insights into how to harness its powers. This burst of insight is followed by a period of sluggishness that is only resolved by lying in the sun.
author: oreee0230

entry: During battle, POKENAME causes vines to erupt from the ground, which ensnares its foes. Afterwards, it releases a shock through the vines, which electrocutes its opponent until they surrender.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The large flowers upon their backs have partly begun to overtake them, yet this has only caused their muscles to grow. Most of their fat comes from the excess nutrients acquired from the sunlight gathered by their flowers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are widely known to take control of entire forests and cave systems. They can disguise themselves as a mossy rock by digging into the ground, though they can easily be spotted due to the flowers on their backs.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME stores all its electricity in the flower on its back, which it then expels with its vines, producing a paralyzing odor.
author: alexgriller

entry: POKENAME's right arm is specialized into an extended barrel, equipped with a scope made of petals. Although it can fire continuously, the scope will be damaged by the impact of the first shot and cannot aim accurately until repaired.
author: oreee0230

entry: The ends of POKENAME's arms are covered with a wooden shell to reduce moisture loss when firing. POKENAME usually lives near water sources to replenish losses in its water cooling system at any time.
author: oreee0230

entry: They live in lush jungles. Wherever POKENAME flies, flora grows in its wake. The berry growing on its tail is thought to give one everlasting joy if it were to be eaten.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME's tail can attract lightning due to its height. It can survive just by occasionally receiving lightning, yet it still actively collects berries.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME are more skilled at fighting than regular Sandshrew, as they are unable to curl up because of their flower. This forces them to engage in fights more often.
author: mystora

entry: It flies through the jungle at great speeds using its long, yet light, leafy wings. It releases powerful sonic waves to churn the ground so it may sow seeds from the fruits it eats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME purposely freezes its hair-like leaves, swinging them around like blades. When opponents approach, it releases pollen, instantly freezing them in their tracks.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have developed stronger muscles in order to better navigate on the ground. They lure prey in with the flowers on their tails before striking.
author: raza

entry: POKENAME have symbiotic algae living in their skin ensuring that they have a source of food even in the winter. During the summer, they produce an impressive leafy facial display along with growing gigantic flowers on their back.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have symbiotic algae living in their skin ensuring that they have a source of food even in the winter. They grow a fine shaggy coat of moss in the winter, and some grow thick woody tusks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The processing power of a computer is in constant use while POKENAME is inside it since the computer is constantly reading and logging the data it creates from its flower's aromas. Running these logged data files causes the computer to create scents.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME grapple onto trees high above the ground to maximize the amount of sunlight they receive. The flower on their back scatters pollen into the breeze to discourage Flying-type Pokémon from attacking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon converts sunlight into fuel for its fire through the flower on its head. POKENAME's Solar Beam has a comparable force to a flamethrower.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Spotting a POKENAME in the desert is a good sign for weary travelers: since it needs plenty of fresh water to nourish its large flower, it makes its home close to oases where water would be plentiful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME see themselves as leaders of their groups and will challenge those it sees as competition to prove their strength. The size and colors of the flower petals around their waist are symbols of each POKENAME's strength.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME gather energy through the floral pattern that surrounds and hangs off of its head. This energy gives POKENAME the strength and speed it needs to move around, so it is always moving, searching for large sunny areas to train and rest.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME keeps a set of thorny vines wrapped around its fists any time it enters combat. It uses them as whips and lassos to reel in evasive opponents before striking them with massively powerful kicks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are small compared to other forest guardians but the powerful vines that emerge from the flower on their head easily subdue Pokémon larger than themselves. When they are not fighting, they play with other forest Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The nutrients in the mud POKENAME plays in have enlarged its cheek flowers. Because of this, its hind legs have stiffened further to support its head.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: POKENAME spend most of their lives submerged in deep mud, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to draw too close. The symbiotic plants on their backs allow them to photosynthesize when no food is available.
author: kingd8

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in the flower on its back. The more vibrant the flower is, the healthier the POKENAME. It spends a great amount of time lounging in the sun to help the flower grow.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME tend to be shy creatures and hide in thick foliage to avoid contact with Trainers. However, if they sense positive emotions from a wandering Trainer, they stalk that Trainer until they are noticed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a common companion for Beauties intent on winning Pokémon talent contests. They have an innate sense of timing that makes them excellent performers, their petals and leaves flaring out as they pirouette across the stage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers let it manipulate the plant-life around it, growing flowery vines from the ground to protect itself and others. Its large flower can generate a thick protective barrier of pollen and flower petals as well.
author: sk372

entry: This variant of POKENAME lacks the typical enormous flower atop its head, hampering its photosynthesizing capabilities. It needs to spend a larger amount of time basking in sunlight to keep itself energized.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly emits energy that regulates plant growth. POKENAME is quite friendly with humans, and wild POKENAME will frequently challenge Trainers in order to find worthwhile partners.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME have a love of gardening and will spend hours working alongside their Trainer to cultivate beautiful fields of flowers. Their empathic powers enable them to sense when a given flower needs extra care and attention.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have an empathic link to flowering plants and are drawn to areas that are in full bloom. They use their powers to aid them in battle, wielding whirls of petal blossoms as dangerous attacks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are heroic protectors of the jungle that defend other Pokémon from poachers. Their leafy blades slice through nets poachers rely on to ensnare wild Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The way POKENAME's leaf-like wings grow while withering is often misunderstood. This is a normal phenomenon of its body, and Trainers should not intervene in POKENAME's activities because of it.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's body is fully adapted to desert life. The flowers on its back mimic various cacti and only bloom after rain, allowing it to perfectly blend into the desert environment.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME are extremely close to their colony and rely on each other for protection. Their preferred food is seeds, which they reach by using hidden vine-like organs or powerful leaps to pluck fruit and eat the seeds within.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The colors of their petals and leaves change with their environments. POKENAME use their long tongues to reach fruits and berries on tall trees, be they for themselves or for others.
author: infinex21

entry: It camouflages itself in vines to remain hidden in jungle environments, where it waits patiently. Unsuspecting prey is torn apart by its four clawed limbs.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME spreads its four limbs and vertical petals to absorb sunlight while resting. It can use its developed brains to accurately calculate how to move along the shortest path to stay completely under the sunlight.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's small flowerpot cannot accumulate much nutrients, so it needs to eat frequently. It will create a pollen storm, using it to absorb everything from surrounding plants and Pokémon.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME are very adept and proficient hunters in lush environments. The vegetation growing on this Pokémon's back allows it to camouflage among greenery and surprise their prey.
author: ackshewally

entry: POKENAME are Pokémon that have gathered enough energy from sunlight to trigger a partial evolution, most commonly encountered during the winter due to the weaker sunlight. They maintain the confidence and posture of a fully evolved Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. The tree on its back is now fully rooted in POKENAME's nervous system.
author: zoroark73

entry: Despite the sweet smell the flower on POKENAME's back gives off, its sap is actually poisonous. It spends its days walking around to find whichever spot has the most sunlight for its flower to absorb.
author: _._starry_._

entry: Although POKENAME are usually carnivores, they can be seen snacking on berries every so often. Their sharp teeth can chomp through the toughest of skins.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME swims quickly using its leaves, but it tires easily when not in sunlight. POKENAME disguises the tough shell on its back as a bug perched on a plant, which discourages predators that it can't outrun.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME has a flower on its back that is in full bloom. It releases calming pollen to subdue threatening Pokémon, which ensures its nest is left unbothered.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME alive today were first born in the time of fossil Pokémon. They guard their hidden caves with extreme power.
author: veteranadventurer

entry: POKENAME patrol jungle ruins to protect the treasure inside. They often encounter children who want to explore the dangerous ruins, so they are tasked with escorting children back home.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This bad-tempered Pokémon rests near islands, and will evaporate those who enter its territory with massive beams of solar energy. This makes it a vicious and inconvenient roadblock to sailors and pilots alike looking for somewhere to land.
author: ecstaticwoop64556455

entry: From within the plant on its torso, POKENAME can sprout up to a thousand vines to defend itself. It resides deep within verdant forests, surrounded by plant life and Grass-type Pokémon that seek its protection.
author: sk372

entry: The pollen produced by POKENAME's flower ring is collected and used to help make medications that lessen the effects of migraines. The quality of the pollen collected depends on how healthy POKENAME is when collected.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME blend in nearly perfectly with jungle foliage, making them extremely difficult to find in the wild. If a Trainer succeeds in capturing one they will find that they make for exceptionally amiable companions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can become hyperactive after spending long enough in the sun, rushing with a surprising speed through the forest. They are not mindful of their bulk when doing so and often leave a trail of smashed branches and bushes in their wake.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In tropical regions, POKENAME carry giant, vibrant flowers that draw a variety of Bug-Type Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. On small islands they have very low floral diversity, often carrying just a single flowering cycad.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In dense jungles they carry a variety of shrubs and bushes that make them especially hard to find.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In temperate regions they carry a variety of flowers protected by trees and are important for pollinators.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In some rural settlements they are trained and kept as a reliable source of fruit for the community.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In warmer regions they will host flowering trees, searching for well lit areas to help them grow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lay in water on their bellies, both drinking and ambiently absorbing it. When they are happy, water will shoot out from the centers of their lush flowers like small, harmless geysers.
author: infinex21

entry: The prideful heart of Prinplup was overfed by the power and control of Venusaur. Now POKENAME acts as a tyrant lording over the forest.
author: haypile

entry: The petals on POKENAME's neck can not only absorb sunlight but also serve as soft armor due to their toughness. Although POKENAME usually lives alone, it will gladly help to other Pokémon in need.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME takes root in locations suitable for growth and collects nutrients through the development of individual offshoots. It has a very robust physique and nothing can force it to flee except fire.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's ultimate move is absorbing enough sunlight through its blade to release and smite its opponent with the power of the sun.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This legendary scepter, said to have belonged to a wizard, can command plants and with enough absorbed sunlight, release a blast of solar energy.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: After absorbing sunlight, POKENAME's blades become some of the sharpest in the world. While this makes them menacing during the day, at night they diminish into frail leaves.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The more sunlight it absorbs, the stronger and more vividly colorful its blade becomes. Most elder POKENAME have grown so much that they can cleave entire mountains in one swing.
author: h0bojoe

entry: It has begun to take control of the metal that makes up its body, moving it just like its vines. POKENAME's knife-like claws grow as if they're a natural part of its body.
author: ocxin

entry: Found in the most overgrown parts of abandoned buildings, POKENAME blend their plant mass and metallic parts seamlessly. They surround themselves with subordinates to effectively scavenge through their territories.
author: ocxin

entry: By shaking its leafy mane, POKENAME releases a fragrant pollen used to mark its territory. If crackling sparks start to burst from its body, it means it's in a foul mood and could attack at any moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: By shaking its leafy mane, POKENAME releases a fragrant pollen used to mark its territory. If crackling sparks start to burst from its body, it means it's in a foul mood and could attack at any moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The huge flower on its back emits a soothing aroma when it absorbs sunlight. It has a rigid body and can shatter huge boulders with ease using its iron horns.
author: hamperius

entry: The flower on its tail emits a sweet smell that is used to draw in its prey. It then causes vines to erupt from the ground, entangling its chosen meal.
author: flickeredflame

entry: This Pokémon is a jungle apex that roams the skies above to bathe in strong sunlight. If it witnesses any person or any Pokémon attempting to harm the jungle, it will descend and dispatch them with its full might.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME release large clouds of spores from their flowers to hide their presence. Inhaling a POKENAME's spores will cause hallucinations and nausea, giving POKENAME the perfect chance to strike.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The floral parasol of POKENAME acts both as a source of nutrients when conducting photosynthesis and as a way to gather water during rain.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME uses the ribbons on its body to snatch fruit from branches it couldn't otherwise reach. Its floral bows give off a scent so sweet that it calms both humans and Pokémon within a hundred-meter radius of its location.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is incredibly strong, able to pulverize a boulder in one hit. It is frequently tasked with clearing out thick, overgrown areas for construction projects.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME scatters seeds of various amphibious plants in the water. These seeds are modified by it to accelerate terrestrial weathering with their roots as they grow, in order to expand the ocean.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME can feel every organism and motion in its forest. It does so by feeling the vibrations of the roots within the wilderness.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME flies above the clouds, gathering sunlight with the flower on its head. If it is forced to descend from the skies, it devastates opposition with an intense Solar Beam.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bends light and distance to nourish the massive flower on its back. Studies show that any forests it inhabits become unnaturally dense due to space collapsing inward.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME uses vines to secure the ground loosened by geological activity. It protects cherished plant populations from severe loss by stabilizing the ground.
author: oreee0230

entry: It invades sleeping peoples' subconscious to steal all the sunlight from their dreams. This grants it substantial power while giving its victims pitch-black nightmares.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME emits large amounts of pollen from its tail that allow plants to flourish. Areas where POKENAME reside are blanketed in gorgeous flora.
author: mistymagius

entry: The electricity that flows through POKENAME is overwhelmingly strong. If a leaf or petal falls off it, a numbing tingle remains on it for a couple of days until the power fades away.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME's flowers absorb sunlight, emitting an alluring aroma that attracts other Pokémon toward them. They will use their vines to bind smaller prey.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME drifts silently through lush forests, mimicking a beautiful tropical flower to attract unsuspecting prey. Once the prey is close, it unleashes a chilling, toxic mist from its underbelly that instantly numbs its target.
author: naivetotoro

entry: Inhabitants of forest clearings, POKENAME stands in the middle of a giant flower, releasing pheromones to attract Bug types. When one steps onto the petals, the flower snaps shut, providing the Pokémon with a meal.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME grow so many plants that not even they are fully aware of all the possible combinations they can make with their spores. They release spores with every blow, testing out their concoctions on their opponents.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME whir their petals rapidly to enable them to fly. The vines growing from their body act in a similar way to sensory hairs, alerting them to nearby obstacles to be avoided.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Wild POKENAME care for their forest homes and for fields of flowers without fail. They are said to contain a cursed energy within themselves that is loosed only in retaliation against those who harm nature.
author: infinex21

entry: The being seen inside the outer layer of a POKENAME is not independent of the jelly-like substance that coats it. The crown atop its head is actually a catalyst for the being to be mind-controlled by the potent substance that coats it.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: POKENAME has a special flower that only blooms on the night of the full moon. The spores that are released cause Pokémon to fall asleep. This allows it to join together with other POKENAME to dance under the moonlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Tumbling in on summer storms, POKENAME will migrate into tropical habitats where they can take advantage of the ample nutrients and bright sunlight. They are playful and affectionate Pokémon, and will share their soft flower petals with others.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME are crafty Pokémon that hate humans and often attack them. Most people think POKENAME are evil, but they just want to protect nature.
author: zakafraka

entry: All kinds of plants grow around POKENAME's body to the point it may use them for offensive and defensive purposes. Rarely, plants not found in modern times seem to blossom on its limbs.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME weaves traps made of vines and electrified webbing to ward against potential threats. Its lair is characterized by arcing thunder and an eerie silence.
author: evilgammon

entry: As it warms itself and absorbs sunlight, its flame releases a pleasant fragrance. The fragrance becalms those engaged in battle.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME is a shy Pokémon that relies on sunlight to keep its flower alive. When night falls, it becomes dormant, sustaining its flower with the dim light from its flame.
author: imaginaryneon

entry: POKENAME blends in with foliage to lure in prey with the sweet scent of its bouquet. If another Pokémon lands on one of its flowers, POKENAME will ignite a series of flames to drain away their soul.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The plant behind POKENAME helps it store a large amount of water and nutrients. POKENAME grows in size throughout its life, with the smallest recorded height being 5 meters.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME guards overgrown ruins. Its mighty stature strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to trespass in its domain.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME flies high into the sky to better absorb the sun's rays. On days where the sunlight isn't as strong, it feeds on bird Pokémon instead.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's leafy wings absorb and store vast amounts of sunlight. It flies deep into the darkest parts of the rain-forests to cascade the stored light across plants that need it, helping keep the plant-life healthy and verdant.
author: sk372

entry: It absorbs as much solar energy as possible to make the colors of the beautiful flowers that cover its coat more vivid. Its pollen improves air quality, which is why POKENAME is a highly respected creature.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the sun-enriched vines from its tail to spark wildfires in dying forests, scattering fresh seeds among the ashes. It is worshipped as a spirit of rebirth in some tropical regions.
author: brainiax

entry: POKENAME is an alien that has integrated thoroughly with the local biosphere, and it puts everything it has into defending nearby flora and Pokémon. It doesn't seem fond of humans, though, preferring space between itself and its Trainer.
author: haypile

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's head bloom once every thousand years. After the three flowers bloom, the people who pick them can each have one wish granted.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME have bodies that play host to a large variety of parasitic flowering plants. They are constantly forced to seek out tubers and plant roots to provide their bodies with enough nutrition to grow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The flower on the back of POKENAME grows extremely quickly and requires very little water. When there is rain in the desert, POKENAME colonies bloom and fill the desert with colour.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME travel great distances through the desert in search of oases to drink from. When they find one, they will stay nearby for as long as it remains full of water, sunning their petal-like wings to regain energy for their next flight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: After years of searching, POKENAME have given up on finding their treasure. They are prized for their beautiful tails and are often captured to be displayed in fancy homes and restaurants.
author: smashbear

entry: The petals of its flower sometimes seem to flap when it leaps, as if it is trying to use its flower to fly. Potentially because this does not work, it is quickly agitated and will ram others with its head.
author: infinex21

entry: Each plate of its shell grows more vibrant as it nears its evolution. When it evolves, the plates of its shell will spread apart like a blooming flower.
author: infinex21

entry: While POKENAME are resistant to being worn down thanks to their metallic body and lubricating sap, they break down under high heat conditions. If their body temperature gets too high, they break down and are unable to continue working.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flower on its back has grown extra large to soak up all the sunlight. This consequently causes it to shadow over other plants, blocking the sunlight for them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are more active than its unfused counterparts and prefers to hunt for prey rather than absorb sunlight. Its flowers release an alluring fragrance, attracting Bug-type Pokémon.
author: oreee0230

entry: Fusion energy has mutated POKENAME's cell growth, causing it to gain many veins where the energy seeps through. No matter how much rain or sunshine it gathers, the flower on its back will always smell oddly synthetic.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a proud expression. Pokémon fusion has enlarged its fatty tissue, making it more froglike.
author: lupa

entry: The flower on its back has grown extra large to soak up all the sunlight. This consequently causes it to shadow over other plants, blocking the sunlight for them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME erupts numerous amounts of pollen from its flower. Breathing in this pollen causes severe choking and large rashes all over one's body.
author: soup1900

entry: If overexcited, the plant on the end of its tail will combust. It is best to let this fire rage, as POKENAME will sulk if forbidden from burning.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME often scavenge for food rather than hunt because their vines and pollen are not enough to take down other Pokémon. This is especially true for wild POKENAME who live in jungle environments, since they are surrounded by Bug-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are enclosed in a bubble of sap that amplifies their powers. They release psychic vibrations that cause plants nearby to mature quickly, allowing them to control thick, heavy roots to protect themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME live upwards of thirty years. They siphon nectar and pollinate flowers from the same patches of land every year. They become incredibly confused if their favorite flower patches are torn up for construction projects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When fully evolved the flower on a POKENAME's back reaches the size of a large dinner plate. A POKENAME's flower also produces a pollen that elicits an allergic reaction in all people.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME can scatter ailment-inducing spores from their leafy wings to subdue foes. They use their sharp fangs to bite into trees to directly drink the sap within. Supposedly, the sap they drink can affect aspects of their flowers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wields its large flower like a shield both from attacks and direct sunlight, the latter of which overpowers its sensitive eyes. It burrows into trees to hide from predators, blocking the entrance with the flower.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Every rotation POKENAME makes while moving causes its fern-like leaves to slap against the ground. This releases pollen every single time, making them a nightmare for hayfever sufferers.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The more meat it consumes, the more succulent its flower becomes. The rotten scent of its many intense battles mixes with the sweet aroma of its bloom.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME lumbers around the deepest parts of lush forests. It uproots trees with ease thanks to its powerful jaws, clearing out open spots for it to lay down and nap while absorbing copious amounts of sunlight to sustain itself.
author: sk372

entry: If a human dares to embrace POKENAME, it will plant a cursed bulb upon their back. With every selfish thought, the bulb will grow, and when it blossoms, a writhing thicket will erupt from where its host once stood.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME have stout little legs that carry the massive flower on their heads. They entice Bug-type Pokémon to pollinate their flower by releasing a sweet aroma from their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's flower comes in a variety of vibrant colors, though it is most often either red or yellow. Its heavy legs mean it dances slower than its previous evolutions.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time dancing ecstatically in the sunlight and accumulating energy. When there is no sunlight, it uses its energy to create fake sunlight to continue dancing, resting only when it can no longer sustain it.
author: oreee0230

entry: It's believed that POKENAME can calm the most aggressive, restless spirits with a flowery aroma from its fans. Families in the Alola region often leave incense made from POKENAME's Sweet Scent on their loved one's grave.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME have thick fins made of cartilage that keep them upright while they are swimming. These petal-colored fins are also quite sharp and easily cut through kelp or other fins with ease.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME petals are laced with a non-lethal, poisonous pollen that causes lasting rashes and sharp, albeit prickly, pain. Yet these petals also contain a potent medicinal compound, which can even help to heal wounded plants.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives in dense, tropical forests, where its unwithering blooms go unnoticed. Beware its deadly pollen.
author: .realthree

entry: It prefers to live deep within tropical forests, though it spends most of its time in open clearings with its leaves spread to capture more sunlight. It will share its excess nutrients with weak plants by connecting its vines with their roots.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME drool out a thick sap that is incorporated into vitamins to keep people healthy. Bug-type Pokémon are drawn in by the flower on their heads and stay to lick up the sap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The large flower on POKENAME's head serves both as an organ for emitting and receiving ultrasonic waves. Through echolocation, POKENAME is better adapted to darkness than other Grass-type Pokémon.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME uses its wings, which are made from a fungus-like material, to fly at high speeds. It uses the spores it spreads in a form of echolocation.
author: canada

entry: The flowers in POKENAME's plumage slow its flight, so it prefers to stroll. Herbivorous Pokémon often mistake it for shrubbery -- but if they try a bite, they'll be caught off guard by its cottony texture!
author: haypile

entry: This Pokémon takes delicate care of the flower on its back. Despite the foul stench, a POKENAME trusting someone enough to let them smell the flower is said to bring great fortune their way.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME has a calm disposition. It spends 18 hours a day asleep in the sun and allows small Pokémon to nap within its leaves.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: The flower on POKENAME's arm is very strong, housing most of its offensive capabilities. This flower will one day envelop all of POKENAME.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME often swap between  absorbing all the rain they can to make their aromas stronger and hunting down sunshine to grow their flora more. If they don't chase down these resources constantly, their leaves and flowers start to wilt away.
author: soup1900

entry: All POKENAME have an unexplainable incessant parental instinct, resulting in them taking care of almost any helpless Pokémon they find. There have even been several cases of humans that were raised by POKENAME.
author: veechers

entry: POKENAME shields its body with massive flower petals. It fancies itself king of the swamp, and demands tribute from other Pokémon.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME uses the flowers on its cactus body to attract bug Pokémon. It is said that when it becomes large enough, it can reproduce by splitting.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME connect their vines with root systems to steal nutrients from other plants. To protect themselves while rooted, the giant flower on their back releases spores that put other Pokémon to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its flowers, which emit a sweet scent, to attract prey. After it has finished draining its prey, POKENAME uses the remaining bones to fertilize its flowers.
author: mistycloud

entry: It only lets its Trainer touch the lush leaves around its neck. Despite its sharp stone teeth, POKENAME prefers a diet of flowers and berries over preying on other creatures.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It roams the jungles with the rest of its pack to ensure that no poachers are causing trouble in the territory it protects. Its flowers release a fragrant trail that allows other POKENAME to locate it even from several kilometers away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to certain beliefs, if howls are heard at midnight in the woods, it is POKENAME leaving its den to chase down humans who have defiled the forest it inhabits. The large flower growing on its back constantly gathers vast amounts of energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The jungle where POKENAME makes its home has many Pokémon waiting for its song. These different Pokémon come together to protect POKENAME they find, putting aside their differences as they no longer fight each other.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME have a flowery dress and head pin that constantly release pollen, filling the area around them with dense clouds of sparkles. By twirling through these clouds, they create artistic moments of beauty that can be captured by a camera.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME flies through the air at night, the flower on its back releases colorful spores that bloom vibrant plant-life. The resulting plants that grow have fragrant scents that put those that smell them into a deep and pleasant sleep.
author: sk372

entry: Though at first glance they appear healthy, POKENAME carry an aggressive fungus that parasitises their flowers. The fungus leeches the nutrients that would otherwise go to the Pokémon, forcing them to eat more than usual to make up the shortfall.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME, despite their intense power, are regularly seen making homes from pineapples. They then bring these homes down into the sea with them.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's claws are incredibly dangerous, sharp enough to cleave even solid rock in two. Before battling, it makes the petals sprouting from its palm-wood armor tremble, releasing an aroma capable of intimidating weaker Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When a POKENAME chooses to live far from the beach, it stops covering its body with palm bark to move more freely within the jungle. It faces its foes with great tenacity, making skilled use of its razor-sharp claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's extremely vibrant colors aren't just for show; they draw in bug Pokémon that it makes into its prey. In battle, it gathers huge amounts of sunlight to make its bladed arms surge with energy, allowing them to cut through steel.
author: fireblade141

entry: Long ago, it migrated deep underground and endured pressures so intense that it fused with a protective coating of rock. When it returned to the surface, it could grow larger than before.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME love to soak up the sun's rays by napping in the light. When they are startled, they create a cloud of toxic spores hoping to discourage others from bothering them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have the strength to flip entire trees, digging their hands into the ground and pulling from the roots. They do this whenever they can't find any sunlight to bask in.
author: bigoljax

entry: Found nurturing wild lettuce, POKENAME focuses its psychic powers through a branch, keeping pests away. The plants flourish under its care, and it drives away any interlopers with its mystic powers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The fumes POKENAME emits smell like Skuntank and make those who inhale it very hungry. The chemicals in its smoke can linger for years.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Though friendly, POKENAME are unaware of the amount of pollen released as they flutter their wings. Their pollen can cause intense allergic reactions.
author: thekrt

entry: POKENAME's nectar is extremely sweet and easily fills stomachs. Honey made by Beedrill using its nectar is a delicious dessert.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's tough leaves can protect it from various threats, and they can quickly fall off to buy time when it is met with flames. The leaves that POKENAME sheds become food for many small Pokémon in the wild.
author: oreee0230

entry: Wild POKENAME tend to be rambunctious, floating around and slamming into objects in an attempt to play. Once trained, however, they become fiercely loyal to the end.
author: robbery_666

entry: Wild POKENAME spend most of their time asleep in sunlit glades. Be careful not to wake one, or it will start a forest fire with its temper tantrum.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME keeps most of its plantlike body hidden beneath the soil. As it ages, its roots spread vast distances underground.
author: .izik

entry: No two wing-patterns on POKENAME are the same and their stunning looks are famous worldwide. Many Pokémon breeders hold events to judge POKENAME with the most beautiful wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME hang from branches where they can get sunlight while also hiding from predators. If detected, they produce a cloud of pollen to lull predators into a deep sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are easily mistaken for cycads when they're at rest as only their flower is constantly above ground. It becomes far clearer that they're actually Pokémon once the presumed flower begins moving around through the dirt.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME want to get an idea of where to find water, they will poke their heads out of the ground and unfold the leaves they usually keep safe. Their leaves are sensitive to moisture in the air, letting them figure out where to get a drink.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME wraps its rootlike legs around palm tree roots while resting underground. This allows it to siphon nutrients without surfacing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's love of bright lights seems to be its only motivation for action. When faced with a threat, POKENAME scatters various toxic powders from its wings and takes the opportunity to escape.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME lives in high-altitude forests and only occasionally comes down the mountain at night. It can summon winds in the forest that are not blocked by trees, using debris lifted by the wind to cut its enemies.
author: oreee0230

entry: Capable of releasing focused blasts of sunlight from the coin on its head, POKENAME clears overgrown underbrush and dead trees, ensuring the forests where its children grow up are safe.
author: alextheperson

entry: POKENAME can spray a gas that accelerates the ripening of fruits. When it guards its favorite fruit trees from thieving bug Pokémon, it adjusts the frequency of its sound waves to break shells.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's flowering tail smells sweet. Spas often keep them around to create a pleasant, relaxing atmosphere for their guests.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME are beloved by many due to the pleasant aroma emitted by their vibrant flowers. Though they will habitually rest in different spots, they always pick locations with plenty of natural light and nearby water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME communicates telepathically with plants through the flower on its head. It spends a lot of time recovering from headaches because it is flooded with messages from vegetation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will lie on rocks, using the flowers along their bodies to absorb sunlight. They use their powerful jaws to take down predators, their teeth secreting a powerful poison.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME telepathically transfers their thoughts to plants through the flower on its back. It spends lots of time recovering from migraines because it is flooded with messages from plants around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carry a large drum with them that they play with their webbed hands while swimming. When they meet other musical Pokémon, they work together with others to come up with a cool beat.
author: quackquackattack
