entry: This breed of POKENAME was bred for the sole purpose of withstanding using more power. This was sadly ineffective.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are found patrolling the banks of rivers at night. Those who have approached POKENAME are mysteriously found unconsious, washed up downriver.
author: thekrt

entry: POKENAME are sometimes found in odd remote locations, such as deserted islands, mountaintops, in swamps, and so on. Some believe they are controlled by the spirits of those forgotten and abandoned by society.
author: bobosmith01

entry: All of POKENAME's eyes blink at the same moment. It detests sunlight, often shuffling through daylight hours with its eyes tightly shut.
author: .izik

entry: The floating red orb in POKENAME's mouth is what allows it to create noise independent of its environment. All who touch the orb faint.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Though unable to fade, this resourceful hunter uses its glowing eyes and a Hex's help to lure prey to its strange presence. If it's too bright, POKENAME will instead close its eyes and cling to rock walls to hide its body, swinging the hex as bait.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME casts hexes on passing Trainers, though it has been discovered the spells are not malicious in nature. Heart-shaped marks appear on those affected, and their amorous feelings spike for days afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME remain hidden during daytime. Once night falls they use the sinister glow from their flames to attract other wild Pokémon, which they prey upon after hypnotizing them with nothing but their gaze.
author: zekkenbytheden

entry: POKENAME uses its eye to detect a person's taste, in both food and their interests, granting weary travelers shelter and a glimpse of their comforts. If someone invalidates another person's taste, POKENAME will collect its energy to banish them away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: As soon as POKENAME sees someone, it stares at them and follows them slowly but purposefully. Past victims report nightmares in which it watched them.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's giant eye glows brightly in the dark of night, as does its crimson flames. Superstitions say that if you catch one staring at you, it is a sign of impending doom.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be seen moving through desert wadis at night, prowling through the dried-out remains of the riverways as though in search of water. They disappear at the start of the rainy season and are not seen again until the water stops flowing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME patrol ancient tombs spreading their umber silk to slow down trespassers. The silk also leaves a scent on the clothes of grave robbers that attracts insect Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are goofy and playful, though they aren't very smart. They have a strange attachment to Arbok and will follow them around, even when the Arbok finds them annoying. They are so loyal, they won't leave the Arbok, even if it mistreats them.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: A Dusknoir has taken pity on the soul of a dead Cubone yet to avenge its mother. The skeleton walks again, granted a fraction of Dusknoir's power with which to finish its business.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME absorbs spirits of fallen Marowak and Cubone into itself, channelling them into its bone club strikes. With every spirit absorbed, it becomes more bitter and vicious until it is completely consumed with hate.
author: evilgammon

entry: Its singular arm can stretch to vast distances, slamming down on foes with immense force. Those few who survive see their life flash before them.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: A hollow spot in POKENAME's cocoon lets it protect Caterpie within itself. If anything tries to disturb the little ones, POKENAME unleashes a ghastly aura from its shell to defend them.
author: sk372

entry: You will hear the sound of schoolchildren laughing before POKENAME pushes you into its maw.
author: bobosmith01

entry: You will hear the sound of schoolchildren laughing before POKENAME pushes you into its maw.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME command their seven dark will-o'-wisps effortlessly, launching them for attacks or placing others under hypnosis by forcing them to gaze into the flames. They are often called Queens of the Underworld.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME is an extremely vengeful being that takes pleasure in scorching anyone who disturbs its slumber by summoning ghostly flames around itself. According to legend, its fire purifies the souls of the dead as they pass to the afterlife.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon never makes a single sound. Every strike against a foe allows it to gather spirit energy, which it then uses to cast powerful spells. When it is near defeat, a dark smog will start rising from its void-black body.
author: fireblade141

entry: This Pokémon never makes a single sound. Every strike against a foe allows it to gather spirit energy, which it then uses to cast powerful spells. When it is near defeat, a dark smog will start rising from its void-black body.
author: fireblade141

entry: It is thought that POKENAME act as spies for Dusknoir and stronger Dusknoir fusions; specifically, they are on the lookout for those whose soul must be taken to the spirit world. They do not need to eat much to sustain themselves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When another Pokémon upsets it, POKENAME will drag it to the bottom of the ocean and into the spirit world, where they are never seen again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is vengeful and will hunt down those that have wronged it, dragging them underwater and, supposedly, into the spirit world.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The yellow line on POKENAME's tail begins to glow when they feel threatened. If their eye catches your glance while their tail glows, it is said they may influence your mind.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME can sense the life force of other living beings through the golden antennae on its head. It uses this sensitivity as an early warning system, making themselves intangible when potential danger approaches.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A common tale above the polar circle says that right as the sun sets to usher in the polar night, POKENAME can be seen leading the spirits of those who have passed. Despite the extreme conditions, many people come annually to try and catch a glimpse.
author: jacknerik

entry: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME can manifest two extra hands to grapple its opponent. If the opponent is held by these hands for too long, they will begin to feel tired as their life is being sapped away.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Despite its eerie appearance, it has a rather dutiful nature. POKENAME can communicate to spirits with its antennae, unleashing ghostly wrath onto those who hurt its forest home.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME are able to see perfectly, in even pitch-black environments. Rumors say that the spirit world whispers to them about their surroundings when they're in the dark.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME has been observed furiously pecking at seemingly empty air. Many theorize that they are battling lost spirits who have unintentionally wandered into their territory.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The orb on POKENAME's body emits a dim, ghostly glow that lures prey deep into underwater caverns. Once isolated with its prey, it strikes and devours its prey whole.
author: mepp.

entry: While mostly harmless, the twitching and floating organs of POKENAME frighten most who look upon it. The roots and vines wriggle about searching for moonlight and dark energy to absorb.
author: ozydamians

entry: Wild POKENAME are found prowling during the evening, burying dead plants into the soil. They experience intense mood swings if awake during the day.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Dark lagoons are said to be home to POKENAME, as they are covered in a black film that darkens the water around them. This water was traditionally used for dyeing things black.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon carries out the bequest of lost souls, acting with eerie purpose as if guided by voices only it can hear. When its task is fulfilled, it quietly drifts away without explanation.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is said to have emerged from the depths to deliver a fatal judgment to cruel Trainers. It can claim a soul with just a touch.
author: astrael1

entry: POKENAME shows off its massive claws to intimidate other Pokémon. Some believe it uses the mouth on its stomach to consume the souls of its prey.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: POKENAME places its hands on gravestones and sits in quiet contemplation late at night. During this time the goo covering its body begins to boil.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found in old PCs, where it removes bloatware from the system to improve performance. In exchange, POKENAME scares users with a random jump scare by playing a loud sound and flashing a scary image, solely for amusement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the glowing fluid produced by its tail to create elaborate paintings intended to guide lost souls in the night. These art pieces have gained a substantial following online for their haunting beauty.
author: comfortablybrum

entry: POKENAME spins on its antenna in order to attract and contact spirits. The faster this Pokémon spins, the more spirits are attracted to it. When enough spirits are following, POKENAME will walk and guide them to the afterlife.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: At the bidding of spirits in the spirit world, POKENAME goes on destructive rampages and takes the spirits of anyone in its path. It uses the mouth on its belly to swallow the terrain it destroys to construct its home in the spirit world.
author: soup1900

entry: Blasts of wind from a POKENAME are powerful enough to blow the souls out of people and Pokémon. Therefore, they serve solely as transport for souls in the spirit world, letting them ride inside their bodies like buses.
author: soup1900

entry: Holding a POKENAME's tail will cause the mouth to echo with giggles that seem to come from all directions. Despite their threatening appearance, POKENAME only approach Trainers when seeking companions to play with.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME emits a strange magnetic force that affects all electronics in its vicinity. Strange and eerie visuals and sounds appear on the devices, believed by many to be from the afterlife itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends its time sapping the energy of smaller Pokémon. If it doesn't, the flames that it uses to move its hands will vanish.
author: ciellecreator

entry: When passing through canyons at night, a feeling of being watched might be from a stalking wild POKENAME. They are patient hunters, as they attempt to feast on both the spirit and body of their prey.
author: thesilverowls

entry: The antenna on its tail warns it of spirits invading its territory. Trainers are warned against keeping POKENAME near other Ghost Pokémon as it is often confrontational with them.
author: badtothebow

entry: A cunning Pokémon with a passion for life and a long-term outlook on the future. Dusknoir has overtaken Grovyle's limber body; it is often seen contemplating its own appearance. It is willing to put itself in harm's way to achieve its goals.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A cunning Pokémon with a passion for life and a long-term outlook on the future. Dusknoir has overtaken Grovyle's limber body; it is often seen contemplating its own appearance. It is willing to put itself in harm's way to achieve its goals.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live deep below the surface in interconnected burrows and rarely see sunlight. They keep their distance from miners because they are scared of the light from hardhats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fables say that POKENAME escorts souls that lost their lives to the dark waters at the behest of the spirit world, yet it takes the time to carefully assemble a sturdy grave for each soul on the beaches they failed to reach.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: POKENAME is said to be responsible for guiding and protecting the souls of the dead for as long as it can in both the spirit and living worlds. Its antenna can detect any wandering souls that are left in the living world.
author: cinnamoncreampuff

entry: To scare their grandchildren, elders of the Sinnoh region tell tales of the villainous POKENAME who appears to drag others down to a dark place.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: It is said that anyone who meets POKENAME's menacing eyes will go through each stage of grief for as long as they stare into them.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: It is said that POKENAME is tasked with bringing others to the afterlife, but feels honor-bound to give its targets a fair fight for their soul. If defeated, it bows out with grace, never to bother its foe again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME patrols graveyards at night in search of grave robbers. Should it encounter one, it attacks with the prowess of an accomplished knight using the blades on its arms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carries an air of superiority and never makes a fuss. When POKENAME's red eye gleams, it has chosen a target to hunt, despite not needing to eat to sustain itself.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wild POKENAME often dwell in haunted locations, where they try to rule over the spirits in the area by force. If their reign is challenged, they will go into a destructive frenzy.
author: n3cr0_

entry: POKENAME's crescent hair is said to let it communicate with the spirit world. Some say its mind is haunted by the whispers of those who lost their lives to natural disasters.
author: sk372

entry: Staring into POKENAME's glaring red eye can paralyze a victim with fear. Horror stories say that once its prey is immobilized, POKENAME's upper body detaches and sucks the frozen target's soul into its being.
author: sk372

entry: Some legends claim that POKENAME are spectral warriors that arose from the underworld itself. These Pokémon can run through darkness itself as they barrage their foes with Shadow Balls fired from the cores on their chests and powerful Shadow Punches.
author: infinex21

entry: It's said to do the bidding of the dead, slaying those who have wronged them and delivering them straight to the darkest corner of the spirit world.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's ribbon grants it the ability to sense death in its surroundings. It can pinpoint the exact location of deceased humans and Pokémon up to 100 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: On the rare nights POKENAME descends from the skies, the many eyes on its body glow as it flies across the land. Many believe it is searching for doomed souls to absorb and take to the afterlife.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their large bodies and connections with the spirit world to protect their Trainers from malevolent spirits. While loyal, this Pokémon does take some time to get themselves moving.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME wields a scythe made of its own spectral powers combined with dark energies. This scythe is said by many to have the power to harm the very soul without needing to cut the physical form.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are found dutifully tending to neglected graveyards at night. The bright flowers on its body are said to be nourished by lingering emotions of those who have passed on.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME hop forward with their hands outstretched, reaching out to guide souls to rest. The black spores POKENAME produce from their tails put the living to sleep to protect the souls as they drift on.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has the ability to gather the grudges of the dead and convert them into ghostly power. It is often spotted at haunted sites absorbing the negative energies of the area.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is able to pick up on even distant radio signals and clearly output their frequencies when possessing electronic devices. However, in places where no radio signal will reach, odd and inhuman groaning will be heard coming from POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each part of POKENAME's segmented body can bite down on a rival. In battle, it twists and rolls at dizzying speeds, shredding everything in its grasp.
author: leshii

entry: An aggressive and cunning apex predator. It crushes prey and foe alike with its hand-like tail, before dragging them into the maw at its gullet.
author: inf0red

entry: POKENAME are known as "guardians of the afterlife", blocking lost souls from returning to the world. Why Ghost Pokémon are allowed through is unknown.
author: therider

entry: POKENAME emits radio waves via the antenna on its head, allowing it to communicate with all Ghost Pokémon in the vicinity and give them commands.
author: chorb33

entry: It wanders aimlessly in abandoned mineshafts. Some believe that it was once a crew of miners who were crushed by boulders.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A popular superstition states that if a POKENAME is spotted on a grave, it is punishing the one who passed away by feeding on its sinful soul. In truth, POKENAME just likes hanging around gravesites.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: It is believed to be a ghostly invader from beyond the sky. Its immense strength and fortitude have led to people dubbing it "an Angel of Might".
author: theeggoverlord

entry: POKENAME's bud gains nutrients by absorbing starlight and moonlight. In the distant past, people were convinced the black-petaled flower that blooms on its head would steal the souls of those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME acts as a scout, finding Pokémon in need of shepherding to the beyond. Once it finds them, POKENAME guides them to a Dusknoir to take them to worlds unknown.
author: arcul

entry: POKENAME are tasked with transporting Pokémon's spirits to the beyond, specifically those that rest far from underworld entry-points. The stronger the Pokémon's force of will, the more POKENAME needed to transport it.
author: arcul

entry: Some studies have suggested that the floating organ in the middle of POKENAME's body is not actually POKENAME's eye; POKENAME appears to have complete 360 degree vision. A prankster, it throws snowballs at passerby in its wintry habitat.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Appearing at dusk, POKENAME quietly follows passing ships from a distance. Some believe its presence signifies a tragedy that will soon befall the crew.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of headstones and rocks from different graveyards. Witnesses report that the sound of different voices can be heard coming from this Pokémon, but scientists are unsure if this is POKENAME's voice or the spirits within it.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Before gorging on a target, POKENAME first carries the victim away to its home before filling them with lots of cotton and fluff. After consuming their soul, the leftover bodies transform into stuffed toys that children like to play with.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's single eye sees the spirits of people and Pokémon. It uses this power to hunt in packs and take down those with the strongest spirits.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME emerge from the seas at night to prowl the land in search of Ghost-type prey, which they will inhale into their gigantic maw in order to absorb their life force until nothing remains.
author: fireblade141

entry: It can freely summon and devour wisps. It is said that being hit by these wisps will show you exactly how and when you die.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME feeds off the energy emanating from those that harbour hatred. From high above, it casts a shadow over its target, leaving them in permanent darkness. Those it afflicts often open their heart, leaving POKENAME to find a new victim.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME floats several ghostly wisps around itself for self defence. Upon contact with one of these wisps, any aggressor will be dazzled by images of the edge of the universe, allowing POKENAME to make a swift escape.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are slow yet aggressive defenders of river banks at night. Those who POKENAME attack are usually unharmed, yet remember nothing.
author: thekrt

entry: Wild POKENAME are most often found patrolling old ruins and the grounds of ancient civilizations. If they spot someone intruding on the land they protect, they use otherworldly powers to spirit them away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Absorbing rainwater allows POKENAME's body to grow in size and power. With enough absorption, it can manifest disembodied hands that it supposedly uses to drag unfortunate souls to the afterlife.
author: sk372

entry: The chime of a POKENAME's bell induces feelings of dread in any living being who hears it. It is said that ghosts hear a different tone that is beautiful beyond words.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME is able to sense radio waves from the spirit realm. It it seen moving through graveyards, and as it passes, it takes the spirits with it.
author: captainzscourge

entry: This fusion is rarely seen, so information on it is scarce. Some believe it consumes souls in order to steal their knowledge and add to its own.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME is a highly intelligent Pokémon said to be able to travel to the world of spirits. The red heart floating between its hands moves erratically, which some think moves independently of the POKENAME's will.
author: beandrawsthings

entry: POKENAME are clad in spectral flames said to be both chilling and hot to the touch. Their stomping hooves are often said to feel as if they hurt the very soul itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME eerily floats through deep chilling waters, blending into the darkness. If it is said that if it finds the drowned amidst the depths, it will bring their body ashore, but keep their soul within its stomach.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its lack of a face leads people to instead watch its pendulum eye. The fate of any who fall under its control is unknown.
author: houndrys.

entry: Despite being almost 25 feet tall, POKENAME is lighter than air, and can float to an altitude of more than 2000 feet. POKENAME uses the water it can shoot out of its bulb as both a massive cannon attack and a way of controlling itself midair.
author: pestobest

entry: POKENAME enjoys placidly floating around buoys in the ocean, but has little patience for having its leisure time interrupted. Ships or sea creatures that float by risk getting hit by a powerful explosive burst.
author: sk372

entry: Many POKENAME have less volatile tempers than others of their kind, but they suffer a bit from their kin's bad reputation. They often float around looking for companions, but most run off to avoid an explosive altercation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fierce glare is a testament to how temperamental it is. If agitated even slightly while underwater, it explodes with a force equal to the most powerful of depth charges.
author: sk372

entry: Often affectionately referred to as the "pace car of the seas," POKENAME's large size and shape displace so much water that it creates gyres in its wake. Other Water-type Pokémon often use these currents to travel more quickly.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME can inflate its body in order to float to the ocean surface. Fishermen take care to avoid this Pokémon, as it can unleash 10,000 volts of electricity on impact.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: POKENAME traipses through forests, its elongated neck giving it a massive vantage point. If it spies areas lacking hydration, it sprays water from its spout to nourish the surrounding plant life.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found at the ocean floor, where the skulls of Wailord lie. Small groups live together within the massive skeletal remains, working together to defend their home and family.
author: sk372

entry: When it trains by kicking in the ocean depths, it generates enormous whirlpools out at sea. Despite being a skilled fighter, POKENAME prefers using the power of its legs to swim and explore hidden caves in the deep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are found near hydrothermal vents, sucking in gas that is expelled from them. It feeds on the microorganisms found surrounding the vents.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Pods of POKENAME are often seen near Red Rock Isle by local fishermen. They destroy fishing nets by using their reinforced horns.
author: .izik

entry: Spinning the star on its back allows POKENAME to swim swiftly through water and even glide through the air after breaching. Above water, its gem releases bursts of fine misty water to keep itself from drying out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large size and buoyant body allows it to ferry large amounts of people at once. It's often used as a budget alternative to luxury cruises across the ocean.
author: sk372

entry: Their nature allows POKENAME to blend in with water and manipulate it. Scholars hypothesize that their movements generate most oceanic currents.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: POKENAME swim around beaches observing Trainers and Pokémon from a distance. If they manage to connect themselves to a Trainer's device, they consume scam and phishing emails until the inbox is clear of malicious emails.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME patrols coastlines, looking for spots to filter feed. Although its small wings make flying an ordeal, it is an exceptional swimmer.
author: _sadfroggy

entry: Due to its enormous size, swimming requires tremendous effort, so POKENAME usually drifts along ocean currents while asleep to conserve energy. Experts believe POKENAME can sleep for up to an entire year.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spends its time at the bottom of the ocean, allowing food to float into its mouth. It only moves to regain oxygen at the waters surface.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: POKENAME can stretch its neck for many meters, allowing it to use its head as an effective striking weapon.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME resides deep in the ocean, often hidden in the darkest trenches. The lights on its head shine so brightly, they are capable of illuminating entire underwater canyons.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can go several hours without air, allowing them to reach the ocean depths. Their bioluminescent dorsal fin makes these depths as bright as the surface in bright daylight.
author: entomoxie

entry: An ever-present bubble around POKENAME's mouth allows it to traverse on land. It can expand the bubble to contain its entire body and float through the air, drifting along with the breeze.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bounces happily along the shoreline, rolling around like an oversized beach ball. It constantly trips over its own tail, causing it to tumble and flop around, much to the confusion of passing swimmers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME befriends Slowper and they travel the world together. When Slowper gets tired, POKENAME lets it sit on top of it and hums a soothing lullaby. This sound is said to slow down the heartbeat of everything that hears it, relaxing them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Slowking and Wooper are believed to be more likely to fuse when POKENAME is around. They journey together, and it is rare to find a POKENAME without a Slowper by its side, helping it to navigate the high seas.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon can often be found in forests or jungles, resting below the surface of rivers and lakes. It sucks in water through its bulb to eat small fish that go by, then expels the water in a blast of harmless bubbles at any travelers passing by.
author: ecstaticwoop64556455

entry: POKENAME uses its air-filled head to float on water. Only a few divers have seen its true size.
author: spagalapof

entry: Its smile dazzles every living thing on land and sea. No toothpaste has ever matched it.
author: spagalapof

entry: POKENAME floats buoyantly on the sea's surface during the day. Its sharp spikes can pierce ship hulls if vessels drift too close.
author: .izik

entry: On many a stormy night, sailors claim to have spotted mermaid tails. Attempts to pursue these sightings commonly result in finding a POKENAME much to the sailor's dismay.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time in the ocean. They are sometimes seen wandering around coves and beaches.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME live near shipyards and loiter where sailors usually would. They are known for their wicked strength and their penchant for eating spinach.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME are hulking behemoths built for battle. They eat absurd amounts of food and are often raised on ranches purpose-built to sate their appetite.
author: rooboid

entry: POKENAME shells constantly vent mineral-rich gases into the surrounding water. Small communities of Pokémon can often be found on their shells, riding atop migrating POKENAME and feeding on their output.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is often found resting on shorelines, keeping a watchful eye over swimmers. When danger approaches, it uses the blaster in its mouth to fire high-pressure jets of water to ward off predators and ensure the safety of those nearby.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME travel in large pods only through northern oceans. They communicate with one another deep underwater through high pitched beeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME breaches any current with ease, propelling itself forth with powerful jets of water. Its aggressive nature begins to show as it draws closer and closer to evolution.
author: rooboid

entry: A single step from a POKENAME can trigger earthquakes. However, because of its benevolent nature, it moves slowly through the world to avoid causing harm or damage.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is filled with boiling hot water. While flying, it spews out steam that paints rainbows in the sky.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is adored by children for its playful nature and its ability to leap from the water in rhythmic patterns. However, schools of these Pokémon often frustrate adults, as their constant splashing and noise disturb the peace along the shores.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Each of the vines that make up POKENAME's arms end with spouts that can shoot out water. It uses these to create and manipulate whips of water to smack away anything that gets too close or aggressive.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME curls into a ball when it sleeps on the beach, often winding up mistaken for a beach ball and played with by beachgoers. Its hide is soft yet sturdy, so it rarely even notices being used for recreation while it naps.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being a rare, recent discovery, it's a favorite in pseudoscience. POKENAME is commonly incorrectly called 'The First Land-Living Pokémon'.
author: leeto64

entry: Their bodies require high nutritional intake, the largest of which require upwards of five times their body weight in food. They rarely close their mouths while swimming because they require every opportunity to catch a bite.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim peacefully in the deep seas, occasionally coming up to feel the warmth of the sun. They let their young ride on their tails, helping them through the waters until they can swim on their own.
author: bigoljax

entry: This odd-looking Pokémon loses its legs upon evolving, which may leave it trapped on land. Because of this, there is a Pokémon conservation effort dedicated to saving beached POKENAME. Its flower can expel powerful geysers of stored-up water.
author: ecstaticwoop64556455

entry: Despite their incredibly large size, POKENAME are playful and gentle. Though they do accidentally take bites out of boats, assuming they're large fish Pokémon.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME is said to be one of the biggest Pokémon ever physically measured, being as long as a skyscraper. However, POKENAME has a very short lifespan due to how much energy is needed to survive.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a gentle protector of the universe. It is said to eat corruptions in space and time as it floats along, keeping the fabric of the universe in check.
author: antler_zero_

entry: Should your plane crash in the sea, you might be fortunate to come across a POKENAME. Using its powers and incredible strength, it will push the fallen aircraft to the nearest port.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The geomagnetic abilities of POKENAME are sometimes thought to be without equal. Ancient people out at sea used them to navigate through vast oceans.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Weighing in at 200kg, POKENAME can flatten vehicles or entire schools of fish to consume all their life force in one blow.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The force of these animate hammers when crashing down is rivalled only by pneumatic presses. However, wielding them is impossible with their weight.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is highly valued by fishermen and traders, who rely on its ability to carry heavy loads across the water. Its sturdy body can support large amounts of cargo, making it an essential companion for transporting goods over rivers and lakes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME shoots torrents of water from its feelers to propel itself across the ocean's surface at high speeds. It uses this to migrate around the ocean in search of mature kelp beds to consume.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lumber across the sea floor on continental shelves, patrolling vast territories in search of food. When two POKENAME meet they are prone to clashing over control of their territory, battles between them capable of triggering tsunamis.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: They reside near lighthouses, mesmerized by the light that comes from the building. Despite their large size, they are tolerated in the space because they mask the scent of fishing vessels that frequent their harbors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are sometimes much larger than most trees and slowly wander through the wild looking for safe places to rest. They protect themselves by releasing balls of pollen that explode on contact and poison those who inhale the powder.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME resembles a giant blue blimp and is often seen among groups of Drifblim. Legends claim it once served an even bigger Pokémon, though no evidence currently supports this theory.
author: the_smirker

entry: Wild POKENAME use Phantom Force to dive beneath the waves undetected, then resurface onto unsuspecting fishing vessels. Boats invaded by POKENAME often find their entire day's catch has mysteriously vanished.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME chops down enormous trees, then carries them over large distances to make dams that are large enough to appear on maps. Some believe that the largest lakes in the world are in fact artificial lakes made by POKENAME long ago.
author: leandermalurt

entry: People mistake POKENAME for a more saturated Wailmer. However, some people consider this to be a Wailmer with a bigger mouth.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Though it struggles to move on land due to the immense weight of its head, POKENAME is an adept swimmer and can survive in even the deepest depths of the ocean.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME is a prized catch for many fishermen, but its immense weight makes it incredibly difficult to reel in. Often, its tiny body will deceive unsuspecting rookies, who struggle with the surprising heft as they fight to pull it aboard.
author: jaminmcready

entry: These little Pokémon often wander off naively from their parents or Trainers, looking for playmates. If not preyed upon, they can be seen trying to learn their Bubble Beam for self defense, much like a bird Pokémon would learn to fly.
author: ecstaticwoop64556455

entry: POKENAME is rarely disturbed as it roams the sea seemingly without aim. However, it will shoot forward at considerable speed if it spots prey.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME lives on the seabed, half-buried in the sand, where it lies motionless in wait for prey. If it spots any, it lunges and devours them whole.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are normally seen by restless sailors, quietly flying past the moon. It is said they play songs low enough to be almost silent, only able to be heard by their ears.
author: bigoljax

entry: The slime that covers POKENAME's body feels very similar to water. Its slime hardens in the cold, giving protection to its squishy body.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME doesn't seem to be conscious of its immense size. It often tries to hug and cuddle its Trainer, but the size difference makes this a dangerous habit.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is commonly despised by humans and tends to lurk in places where it's not wanted. It frequently bares its teeth, as if perpetually ready to snap at anything that comes too close.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are renowned hunters of the ocean, though they are prone to hunt mostly in colder seas. Though they are capable of easily skewering prey by catching them off-guard, they typically prefer to have an honest fight instead.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is mostly water, allowing for it to float on the surface of the ocean. When startled, POKENAME shoots massive geysers of water powerful enough to topple a tank.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME swims joyfully alongside vacationing couples. If it senses a nearby predator, it ruthlessly drives it off with a devastating Heavy Slam.
author: .izik

entry: These giants create marine trenches as they travel along the seafloor. They have proven useful in construction of tunnels for roads and subway trains.
author: wigglypon

entry: If bumped by flockmates while feeding, POKENAME erupts in anger and fires a Water Spout. The flock responds in kind, making their feeding grounds hazardous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's titanic mouth means it scoops up a truly massive amount of water when it swoops down to hunt fish. Researchers warn that having too many POKENAME in the wild risks depleting the oceans over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eat tiny Pokémon swimming in the sea by filtering water through plates in their mouths. Every few hours, they emerge to the surface to spit out a thick goo before returning to the deep sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are perfectly adapted to master the seas and the skies. They comfortably breathe water and air, with wings that slice through the winds and glide over the ocean surface. The pressurized blasts of water they shoot can destroy ship hulls.
author: ecstaticwoop64556455

entry: POKENAME has incredible stamina: it can swim enormous distances while keeping up with Pokémon such as Poliwrath without feeling tired. It's thought that POKENAME that manage to swim all across the entire world will evolve further.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can fire powerful jets of water from its tentacles using Water Spout. These blasts are strong enough to threaten even large ships.
author: .izik

entry: Despite looking like they are locked in an endless struggle, POKENAME's two parts are symbiotic. The Wailord provides food for the Tentacruel, which in turn protects its host with powerful venoms.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME splashes seawater to confuse and catch Shellder. It often forgets its goal mid-task, distracted by the fun of splashing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts through the ocean, using its tail as a flotation device. It spaces off to the point where it may forget to breathe above the water.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Although POKENAME is immensely powerful, it has a gentle and mild nature. Rather than fighting, it prefers to use its powers, amplified by the large bulb on its back, to revive withered plants in gardens or wild habitats, granting them new life.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The thread that POKENAME generates in self-defense is supernaturally strong, with even the most physically-imposing Pokémon unable to break free when sprayed. The threads dissipate in an hour, turning into a sparkling dust before vanishing.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that every time POKENAME emerges from their egg that another universe is created. Regardless of whether this is true, they partake in eating leaves like many of their kin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People are very fearful of angering POKENAME due to its volatile nature and stores of power. At full force, it's believed its explosion could take out a sizable chunk of a continent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME strongly resembles the Master Ball, though it's not known which one's appearance predates the other. Some Trainers swear Pokéballs more effectively catch Pokémon in its presence, but this is only speculation for now.
author: sk372

entry: A popular folk tale advises against recklessly handling POKENAME. Its explosions are said to annihilate entire regions in the blink of an eye.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Tales state that each egg is supposed to contain an essence of existence itself: time and space, mind, body and soul, matter and antimatter. Old tomes state that creation rests in the center, protected always by the others in the clutch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon with branches for limbs that fruits quickly grow on. They often dance and shake these branches, scattering their fruits around for anyone to enjoy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is able to create bone-like weapons from thin air to help it do battle. Rumors have said it could even form and animate an entire skeleton to assist it if it so chose.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create craters with every step they take, towering over the landscape. They have been known to destroy mountains with a single kick, causing massive tremors through the earth.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME create craters with every step they take, towering over the landscape. They have been known to destroy mountains with a single kick, causing massive tremors through the earth.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is revered in myth. In many boxing communities and official events, a common name for rules and regulations is 'The POKENAME Principles', named after this Pokémon for its honor in fights.
author: jangodiot

entry: Despite its diminutive state, POKENAME protects other wild Pokémon by manipulating time and space to redirect attacks. It is careful not to draw attention to itself because it is vulnerable in its soft cocoon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fill the air of ancient ruins with a mixture of gases that preserves objects by removing moisture and other contaminants. Many old clay tablets and ancient papyrus have made it to the modern era thanks to their gasses.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME takes orphaned eggs and raises them itself because of its maternal instincts. After the eggs hatch, POKENAME helps them integrate back into the wild, so the adopted Pokémon does not feel lonely.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its stare is often described as knowing and wise. Some say the secrets of the universe are hidden beneath its endless vines.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME considers its young sacred, raising them for a divine purpose beyond mortal keen. If one approaches without the parent's approval, POKENAME will attempt to erase them from existence.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME is a powerful ocean denizen, few will run the risk of agitating POKENAME and putting it on the offensive. It can cut through the water at breakneck speeds with a horn that can puncture steel before releasing a burst of light energy.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient cave drawings depict POKENAME as the true king of the sea, with power even greater than the legendary Pokémon Kyogre. Unfortunately, this is not reflected in its battle prowess.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Although the large wings of wild POKENAME are considered a beloved sight during their yearly migrations, their actual bodies are tragically quite small. Their wings scatter countless, faintly-glowing scales with every flap.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME spins rapidly, it generates star-shaped light projectiles all around it as a way of repelling others. If this fails to deter attackers, it follows up with a beam of pure light from its core.
author: sk372

entry: The many eyes upon an POKENAME's rings are rumored to be capable of watching everything that occurs across the planet. While this is still just a theory, what is known is that they can launch devastating rays of light from these eyes if attacked.
author: infinex21

entry: The rings rotating around POKENAME contain eyes it can use to view its surroundings, giving it 360 degree vision. They can also generate a shield of light around it, giving it near impregnable defensive measures.
author: sk372

entry: The gems on POKENAME's body and rings glow white when it prepares to attack. Beams of piercing white light fire from these spots, and arc through the air to home in on its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: The constructs that POKENAME can create through miming are some of the most detailed and intricate among Mr. Mime fusions. It makes elaborate set pieces and shows intense dedication to the solo performances it puts on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bend reality itself to create walls that no one can see. This awe-inspiring power also prevents them from speaking or vocalizing, which has led to much miscommunication whenever they have asked humans for help.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion was said to appear before ancient human civilizations with brutal traditions and, especially, those who started to idolize wild Pokémon. They always disappeared after teaching those humans to have a good heart and amazing dancing skills.
author: epping_forest

entry: This fusion was said to appear before ancient human civilizations with brutal traditions and, especially, those who started to idolize wild Pokémon. They always disappeared after teaching those humans to have a good heart and amazing dancing skills.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's carapace and shell are quite heavy, making it rather sluggish in movement. To compensate, it can extend beams of energy from the pincers on its head to give it a great deal more reach for snagging prey than first glance would suggest.
author: sk372

entry: The oddly-shaped horns of an POKENAME are tougher than iron. Many people will collect their broken, or shed, horns and turn them into long-lasting tools.
author: infinex21

entry: Anyone comparing POKENAME to a Magikarp or even calling it a weakling will be met with divine retribution. This Pokémon is born with the ego and temperament of a divine being. It is nearly impossible to tame or to train it to follow any command.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's wings spread tiny sparkling scales down with every flap. It makes its home on mountain tops, where vibrant flower gardens grow thanks to the properties of the scales it disperses.
author: sk372

entry: It grows much faster than other bug Pokémon. The poison applied by its stinger is rumored to be incurable.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Stories etched into temples near the ocean speak fearfully of POKENAME's temper. Many offerings were made in order to keep it from going on a potentially civilization-ending rampage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's songs are said to freeze anyone who hears them in their tracks. They can summon blizzards that last for over a week.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said POKENAME are leftovers after the world's creation. They supposedly got scattered across the entire universe and still roam the endless cosmos, trying to find and fill the gaps in the matter of reality.
author: milchik

entry: It is said POKENAME are leftovers after the world's creation. They supposedly got scattered across the entire universe and still roam the endless cosmos, trying to find and fill the gaps in the matter of reality.
author: milchik

entry: It shoots across the cosmos at the speed of sound. Its power is vast, but it has no control over it.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is the given name of an entity whose origins are still a mystery to scientists around the world. It is theorized to be a piece of creation.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME is in full control of the marvelous adaptability of its body, able to rewrite its DNA on the fly to adapt to its surroundings. This makes it capable of enduring even the most taxing of conditions with little issue.
author: sk372

entry: First recorded locked in a cabin's basement, POKENAME's form changes based on the perception of those who view it. No matter the form it takes, one thing remains common: POKENAME values its freedom above all else.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to control the tides with its beautiful singing voice. As it plays its lyre, people who hear it are said to feel as calm as water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can fire up to 1000 electrically-charged needles of light from its prickly fur. It's said that these needles will seek out those with wicked hearts, and burn them twice as painfully as divine punishment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stands tall and imposing, always itching for a good fight. It actually detests when fights are too one-sided in either direction, always hoping for an adversary that will give it an equal battle that lasts as long as possible.
author: sk372

entry: The flames born from POKENAME's internal flame sac burn a fantastically bright white. They crackle and undulate in majestic ways while burning, and some say gazing long enough in the fire may bring enlightenment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME absorbs all the data within a computer it inhabits to fuel its appetite and its power. Some believe if it consumes enough data, it will attain a new form with unparalleled power within the digital world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can show up nearly anywhere in cyberspace. It steals anything it deems to be legendary or of significant value, leaving an odd residue in its place before disappearing, much to the annoyance of many users.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has been beloved as a symbol of freedom by many pirates throughout history, with its iconography known as "The Helix" on their sails. This Pokémon swims carefree across the oceans, without fear even in the most dire storms.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME was once referred to as "Lord Helix" by an ancient anarchist civilization that once believed it to be an avatar of their chaos deity. Ancient hieroglyphs depict humans worshipping this Pokémon at the top of Mt. Moon.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is thought to be a cocoon for a being of pure power. Some believe breaking open the cocoon by force will result in a myriad of catastrophes that could destroy the world. Scientists, however, remain unconvinced.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is being sought out by researchers due to its ability to easily detect fossils beneath the ground. Some believe it may even be able to resurrect fossilized creatures without the need of machinery.
author: sk372

entry: Some temples in the Kanto region depict POKENAME as some kind of purification agent. According to the translations, POKENAME's scythes cut to a person's soul and cleave out the darkest parts of them, purifying them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once worshiped as demigods of the mountains, said to rule the skies above high peaks. Annual festivals honored them, where villagers wore crafted wings and performed ceremonial dances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends much of its life sleeping soundly. To ensure its slumber is undisturbed, it radiates a mental pulse that causes anything that gets within 100 feet of it to fall asleep instantly, only waking when it does.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's four frigid wings command ice at an unparalleled level. With a single flap, it can summon a thick blizzard to blind or freeze those who would attempt to interrupt its solitude.
author: sk372

entry: The crossing rings of an POKENAME can absorb lightning that would otherwise put this bird Pokémon in danger. They can absorb stored electricity by grasping a ring with their talons and metabolize it to continue flying.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are highly temperamental and their flames surge when experiencing strong emotions. Ancient records claim entire forests burned in seconds when they became enraged.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is said to only inhabit the purest bodies of water, vanishing the moment a drop of filth contaminates it. Some believe that Dragon types that consume its shed skin will gain some of its supposedly-divine power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once revered as deities of hurricanes and violent storms. Offerings of alcohol were poured into copper bowls in hopes that they would lessen the fury of incoming weather.
author: .izik

entry: Said to be the first dragon Pokémon, POKENAME are powerful enough to scorch the whole world with draconic fire. Despite this, they are benevolent protectors of all living things.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME produces honey said to be the purest known, prized by top culinarians. Many believe it to be of divine origin, offering roses in gratitude for its sweetness.
author: .izik

entry: Rumors circulate that POKENAME is the result of illegal experiments attempting to make the ultimate Pokémon. Those that have ventured out to where it reportedly lives reappear elsewhere in the region with no memory of their travels.
author: sk372

entry: Stories about POKENAME say that its mental abilities are so vast that it could reshape reality to its whims. The sheer scale of its power is said to be the reason it isolates itself from humanity, and few have reported ever seeing it in person.
author: sk372

entry: Those that manage to venture forth and find POKENAME in the wild are judged on sight. It reads their minds to determine their motives, teleporting those that fail away while allowing those that pass to test their mettle against it in combat.
author: sk372

entry: Researchers of all types are constantly wary of POKENAME. These Pokémon seem to enjoy taking on the appearance of ancient art or artifacts to fool researchers into questioning their findings for a currently unknown reason.
author: chibitales

entry: The scent that wafts from POKENAME's leaf is perceived differently by whoever smells it. No matter the specifics of the scent, the aroma is always one that will have a calming effect on the one breathing it in.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grow plants on any soil they step on. The plants that grow change depending on the elemental plate they hold.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: Each column in POKENAME's rings can burst forth with strong pillars of pure-white flame. It's been shown that in the past, this fire was used specifically in the holy rituals of some ancient civilizations.
author: sk372

entry: It blasts anything around it with bolts of searing fire at the slightest provocation. Many who have wished to tame it have been brushed off as insane.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is very proud of its teeth, which always remain pristine and powerful. Bite marks left behind by POKENAME's jaws glow faintly with a white light for the next three days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produced water once consumed during sacred rites. The bacteria within often caused fevers and vivid hallucinations, which were believed to be divine visions.
author: .izik

entry: Because of its warlike nature, some ancient people depicted this Pokémon as a deity of war. In the wild jungles where it lives, POKENAME strives to capture as much territory as possible and will command its hive to attack any trespassers.
author: milchik

entry: Pidgey bring bits of food to POKENAME as offerings, so it rarely moves from its home in holes within trees. Its shed feathers have been made into rare quills worth a fortune.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hide is near impervious to harm, and what injuries it does receive heal up within a day. It's quite territorial, blasting away intruders near its riverside home with roaring torrents of water from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur was said to grow fluffier the more it was worshiped. Legends describe it entering towns and releasing a scent that caused reverence in those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The tail fur of an POKENAME is forever-growing, even if it is damaged. The longest-known tail of an POKENAME spanned nearly twice the length of an Onix's body when laid flat. The trimmed tail fur is often worn by high-class people as scarves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's vision is so sharp that with enough focus it can see the surface of the moon. Some claim this Pokémon can even see through time; if it looks somewhere, it can see what was happening there in the past and what will happen in the future.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME uses the ring behind it to float around, rotating to avoid attacks. From the front, it fires short bursts of light from its fists, while star-shaped projectiles launch from the spots on its back to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's many fists can strike rapidly, sending out little bursts of light energy with each swing. It strikes so many times so quickly that its attacks resemble a miniature meteor shower.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the guardian of ascended Minior. It is said to be friends with the stars themselves, but no one knows if that is true or just a legend.
author: charmingloopy

entry: POKENAME produces silk once reserved for sages and religious leaders. Garments woven from it were believed to grant clarity of thought and strengthen spiritual focus.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that POKENAME appeared when plagues and strife ravaged ancient civilizations. POKENAME's mere presence gave hope to those who previously believed their paradise was lost.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME have no legs to walk on and only rest during the day by hanging from branches using their tail. They have incredible night vision that aids their rapid movements through forests at night while they are hunting.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were thought to be gods of the sea, using their light to guide lost ships home. Paper boats with candles and jam were set afloat as offerings to assist missing sailors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's potential is almost limitless, but it is still learning to control aspects of its power. If it gets too excited, it may release a blinding flash of electric sparks that knocks even itself over from the force expelled.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to sing atop mountains during a new moon. Legends warn that if interrupted, it will retaliate with a devastating Judgement.
author: .izik

entry: Those who are lucky enough to meet POKENAME, which is extremely rare, describe it as a warm presence that eases fear and anxiety. POKENAME is a popular symbol of peace and generosity.
author: mepp.

entry: It is said that POKENAME gazes into the future and works to shape the future to its own ends. It is believed it only partners with Trainers whose actions will affect the future it hopes to create.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME struggle to walk properly due to their heavy gate. This makes it difficult for these Pokémon to survive in the wild and therefore makes them a rare sight.
author: chibitales

entry: These meek Pokémon often appear to be stuck within their own, organic rings due to their fluffy wool. This is actually just a clever ruse used to lure in prey before electrocuting them.
author: infinex21

entry: The silver and gold feathers of an POKENAME are so beautiful that many Trainers favor them at least at one point in their journeys. The ring-like part of its body is a development born of how often they would be used to fly across regions.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were once feared as deities of thunder, blamed for sudden lightning strikes. Villagers painted doorframes yellow each year, believing the color would ward off their wrath.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were once worshiped as the goddesses of forest glades. Each spring, people carried baskets of daisies into the woods to appease them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather energy along the rings on their tails, shining a radiant light that soothes all who see it. They leap across land and sea, their tails resembling earthbound shooting stars when viewed at night.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: While myths claim POKENAME shaped the world's rivers, scientists have invalidated those myths. POKENAME can control water, but only in limited capacity.
author: doctorjazznumber6215

entry: POKENAME are found sitting in forests, tending to the local Pokémon with love and care. It is rumored that they are the creatures that sprouted all the seeds in Kanto.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are found sitting in forests, tending to the local Pokémon with love and care. It is rumored that they are the creatures that sprouted all the seeds in Kanto.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's croaking cries reverberate across the swamps it inhabits, drawing forth members of the Poliwag family. Enthralled and seemingly empowered by its voice, its followers loyally serve it from that point on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is typically content to let the afternoon breeze direct where its lightweight body flows. If it wants to quickly change directions, it summons a contrasting breeze to whip its body the way it wants to go.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings and head decoration are made of densely-packed pollen fluff. It dispenses it carefully as it floats across the land, the pollen helping plants grow into the most vibrant and healthy of specimens.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a tricky household pest to get rid of. Its teeth can cause a lot of damage in a short amount of time, but upon discovery it teleports away and hides until it can return when the owner isn't looking.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to split its handlike tail into 1,000 smaller hands when enraged. Legends claim each hand manipulates a different emotion in its foes, though no complete list has ever been confirmed.
author: .izik

entry: The ring above POKENAME's head adjusts its position to absorb the most sunlight possible at any given time. If in danger, the ring responds instinctively and fires off the stored energy in a blazing Solar Beam attack.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's head can levitate above its body and radiate a light almost exactly the same as the sun itself. The beams of light it generates can completely revitalize flowers that bask in its rays for only a few seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an innocent and playful personality. Quite fond of muddy spots, it can instantly form a small pond or swamp in the nearby terrain so it always has a place to splash around in.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is upset, it cries litres of water, able to form small ponds in mere minutes. It then rests in them, letting the water comfort it. These ponds are especially muddy and can never seem to be cleaned.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When POKENAME is upset, it cries litres of water, able to form small ponds in mere minutes. It then rests in them, letting the water comfort it. These ponds are especially muddy and can never seem to be cleaned, though POKENAME emerge spotless.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is a powerful prankster, though ultimately harmless at heart. It can turn any surface into a mud puddle, using this power to cause passersby to trip into them and get filthy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once thought to be avatars of the sun due to the sun pattern on their back. The gems on their forehead and back glow when channeling their psychic power.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is typically only seen at night, flying through the air while illuminated by the full moon. Sometimes it can be seen casting a small beam of light towards the moon itself, though it is not known for what reason it does this.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME tends to live a solitary existence, it still functions best with a flock. To this end, it creates illusory copies of itself to distract or frighten others so it can make off with food or belongings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses a great intellect and a benevolent personality. However, it requires those who seek its knowledge to pass a rigorous series of trials, and few, if any, have been known to succeed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are said to hold omniscience of the world around them and already know what the future brings. Despite these claims of divine powers, they often appear quite bored and refuse to rely on these powers in a Pokémon battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: No one has ever seen what hides inside POKENAME's bulb. Some theorize that it contains an entire alternative universe still in its development stage.
author: milchik

entry: Strongly defensive of its forest home, POKENAME does not take kindly to intruders. It strikes out with glowing whips of vine and fires shining seed bullets from its bud to repel those who are trespassing.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME gnashes its teeth together, the noise compels all rodent Pokémon nearby to bring it food and trinkets. This power over them causes it to live an indolent lifestyle, lazing in its den while its subjects tend to it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's eye is said to see into a person's soul, and judges them accordingly. Those judged unworthy will be blinded by a flash from its eye, with POKENAME nowhere to be found once sight returns.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes the appearance of a book which contains constantly-changing contents. It is rumored that were it to be translated, the book would depict a complete history of the universe from its origins to the present.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often depicted in ancient murals as the cogs of certain mechanisms. Though most of said mechanisms that have been found have fallen into ruin, there are still some yet intact that POKENAME will often be living nearby.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a benevolent personality, but the being on its tail behaves in a malicious and malevolent fashion. For every good deed POKENAME does with its abilities, its tail casts an equally devilish hex to counter it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hang from cave ceilings and tree branches as they wait for prey to fall upon. They can spin their bodies so fast that the ring around their bodies can cut through trees like sawblades, though they will quickly tire and become dizzy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's dense hide is strong enough to resist the force of a black hole. It compresses its iron core so hard the core is on the verge of nuclear fusion.
author: mistymagius

entry: Wild POKENAME often use their tails to hold onto tree branches and swing themselves around to gain momentum before throwing their iron-hard bodies at prey. Their tails are remarkably powerful as a result, but are too short to be as useful in battle.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME spread their wings wide and bare their drill-tipped tails at their foes to intimidate them. If this fails, they will either use their wings or their tail to escape because they are incredibly weak.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME emits a strange magnetic energy from its body. It's believed this energy gives it the ability to dig through the ground without actually creating holes or disturbing the rock and soil it moves through.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a spoiled personality, and demands that others cower before its immense power. It's debatable whether it's as powerful as it acts, as it can only manage to make flashy light shows in protest when being ignored.
author: sk372

entry: Combative and egotistical, POKENAME is prone to picking fights with the biggest bird in whatever area it flies into. Despite the small size, it has the strength to back up its claim, often ending as the victor of these shows of dominance.
author: sk372

entry: Researchers have found that the poison POKENAME creates can be turned into a powerful fuel. This fuel has been especially vital for spacecraft development.
author: mepp.

entry: Despite POKENAME's ability to rewrite reality, it prefers to shape metal into impenetrable armor. It reaches into the earth, summoning raw ores, pulling them free in its claws, then smiths them into new elemental plates.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The symbol floating above POKENAME's shell emits an energy that draws in all berries nearby, pulping them into juice the moment they reach the Pokémon's aura. POKENAME's juice is said to supercharge the drinker's abilities.
author: sk372

entry: Berry juice sourced from POKENAME was once said to grant those who drink it eternal life. Though debunked in current times, frenzied hunts for the species in the past have led to it being scarcely seen in the wild nowadays.
author: sk372

entry: The shells of POKENAME are reminiscent of an Azure Flute. When wind blows against them, their shells will emit a soothing melody.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's horn pulses with a bright, radiant light. The emission causes sap within trees to glow, making it easy for POKENAME to locate the next place it will indulge its sweet tooth for the substance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is notoriously known for being massively arrogant. It grows stronger as it becomes more prideful.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is said to contain near-limitless potential, but is unable to fully access it. It may perform miracles in order to help those it cares for, without realizing how it even did so.
author: sk372

entry: When pressed into combat, POKENAME will separate the halo on its back and wield the two halves in its claws. As weapons, they carry extraordinary weight and strength, leaving those struck with a feeling of powerlessness.
author: sk372

entry: The belly mark of an POKENAME will glow brighter the more excited it becomes. They live for the thrill of combat and use the peculiar tools crafted from an unknown material to reinforce their punches.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's molten body never cools down, even if it were to be in the most frigid point on the planet. A single drop of its liquid form could supposedly cause a long-dormant volcano to activate and violently erupt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were believed to be demigods of storm-lashed skies. When tempests approached, people performed flapping and squawking rituals, hoping their city would be spared.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME's powerful nose has sensed a high-quality mushroom beneath the soil, its ring separates and spins beneath the ground to dig it up. The ring returns moments later, the mushroom floating safely in the center's gap.
author: sk372

entry: Science is not sure yet whether to classify POKENAME's coat as fur or feathers. Whatever the case, it makes for excellent protection against the cold; even a small handful is said to keep a holder warm in the most freezing of temperatures.
author: sk372

entry: An POKENAME's many eye-like suckers along their tentacles will often help them to frighten prey and catch them off-guard. For tougher foes, they will constrict them with their tentacles and loose a beam of pure energy from their one, large eye.
author: infinex21

entry: The metal on POKENAME's body is sturdy enough to have never been recorded becoming dull, losing its sheen or even dented. It can fire sharp feathers as projectiles, growing them back almost instantly.
author: sk372

entry: Due to its rarity, POKENAME packs are comprised of small numbers, typically no more than five. It shares a psychic link with its pack-mates, leading to extremely well-coordinated hunts that rarely, if ever, fail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME breathes out a burning white flame said to purify the evil in one's soul. The more evil the soul of the victim, the hotter and more painful the fire is said to burn as it cleanses them.
author: sk372

entry: The shaking of the rattle on POKENAME's tell creates a strangely deep and reverberating echo for large distances. While most Pokémon are warded off by the noise, serpent-like Pokémon find themselves compelled to flock near POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slumbers deep at the bottom of the sea, away from those who would disturb it. If awakened, it goes into a wrathful rampage, spinning fierce undersea whirlpools all around it with a single breath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spotted with purple accents on its body is considered more dangerous to encounter. If angered, the whirlpools it conjures beneath the sea are composed of a very virulent poisonous ink it spews.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once worshiped as deities of travel and safe passage. Roads formed by their rolling bodies were believed safer, with vegetables left as roadside offerings.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient legend, a giant POKENAME held up the world with its giant trunk. However, in the modern day, POKENAME enjoy smashing rocks to look for fossils, adding their newly found treasures to their nests.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME will fly across the world, looking to punish pride. When it senses excessive pride, it will roll into a wheel and charge.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Only a few POKENAME have ever been seen roaming cyberspace. They seem to be drawn towards areas of major damage by other roaming cyber Pokémon, attempting to mend the damage. The largest group ever seen fixing an issue at once totaled 3 individuals.
author: chibitales

entry: The oddly-shaped antlers of an POKENAME function like tuning forks for the psychic powers laying dormant within their green orbs. They are a protected species of Pokémon because of how sought-after their antlers are.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME bears a resemblance to an ancient depiction of Stantler. Its large, golden antlers are highly sought after trophies with only a couple of sets having ever been collected. POKENAME's rarity makes collecting the antlers a monumental challenge.
author: chibitales

entry: Every work painted by POKENAME is considered a masterpiece by the artistic communities. Artists beg it to teach them its technique, but there is no record of it ever taking on a protégé.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's artistic abilities aren't limited to surfaces only, as it can draw even in empty space. Its drawings are extremely realistic and often depict the various aspects of the universe, from the tiniest atoms to large cosmic sceneries.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's artistic abilities aren't limited to surfaces only, as it can draw even in empty space. Its drawings are extremely realistic and often depict the various aspects of the universe, from the tiniest atoms to large cosmic sceneries.
author: milchik

entry: Despite it possessing great strength already, POKENAME never stops training and honing itself. It yearns to one day take on a new form that will bring its power to even greater heights.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME maintains a picture-perfect balance on its head, and nothing has been seen able to forcibly cause it to tilt even a tiny fraction. At max speed, its spins can summon great tornadoes centered around itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are so prideful of their looks that they use their meek psychic powers to keep themselves off the ground to avoid the dirt. They will cry loudly if anyone manages to get any form of filth upon their faces.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were worshiped as gods of purification and detoxification. When angered their venom was feared, yet legends say the same substance could cure nearly any toxin when they were calm.
author: .izik

entry: Its existence is spoken of only in culinary legend. Consuming its immensely rich milk is believed to briefly make you one with the universe.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME's eggs are a rare delicacy, and consuming them is said to cure all a person's ails and even extend their life expectancy. It only shares these eggs with those who have proven to be pure of heart and worthy of them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mane wisps about even without a shred of wind in the air, casting a sparkling trail behind its movements. It avoids prolonged human contact, transforming into pure lightning and vanishing with a thunderclap when spotted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to have personally crafted all the volcanoes that exist across the world. Legends say that with one howl, it could cause every volcano to erupt simultaneously and bathe the world in magma.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can purify bodies of water with just a glance. It disdains pollution and has been known to harass factories across the world that generate the most water-affecting pollutants.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is almost completely immobile, but its shell is durable to the point of being able to resist explosions without a scratch. It vibrates intensely to create shockwave pulses to push nuisances back when it must defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME generates massive sandstorms of an unknown sparkling material to blind those who trespass its mountain home. While a traveler is blinded, it grabs them and teleports them back to the entrance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dwells near coastlines where storms are frequent. The sound of thunder is said to follow wherever it flies.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME stores massive amounts of electricity in its body. It is rumored that a single POKENAME could power an entire city for a year.
author: mepp.

entry: Legends state that POKENAME witnessed the genesis of the universe and used their glowing wings to dye the once monochrome world with countless vibrant colors.
author: mepp.

entry: There are some murals from over 1000 years ago that depict these forest-dwelling Pokémon at the exact same size and appearance as seen in modern times. Some once believed they could traverse time but, in actuality, they are just very long-lived.
author: infinex21

entry: The planets POKENAME juggles were created out of Infinity Energy as a joke. It is commonly seen interfering with the creatures living on these astral bodies in the guise of a trickster god.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: An old legend states that once a mighty civilization offended POKENAME with an improper offering. POKENAME cast a single hex in return, and the civilization was in ruins before the month's end.
author: sk372

entry: Avian Pokémon flock before POKENAME, inspired by its powerful appearance and aura. It directs them calmly, teaching them to behave in a calm and just manner.
author: sk372

entry: These young Pokémon often play with their own ring by spinning it around. Their arms often end up surprisingly strong as a result, making them able to spin this ring fast enough to deter predators.
author: infinex21

entry: A ring of orbs floats around POKENAME's tail like planets orbiting a sun. These spheres can fly off at will and go after opponents, each able to generate small but potent fields of shocking electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Due to its impressive power and tendency to throw destructive tantrums when hungry, many ancient civilizations regularly offered food to placate POKENAME. Even now some altars remain for people to leave meals out for it to partake from.
author: sk372
