entry: A sparkling, glimmering trail follows behind POKENAME when it leaps out of the water. It can float through the air under its own power, allowing it to traverse on land and explore it when curiosity overtakes it.
author: sk372

entry: A very cunning and efficient hunter, POKENAME first sends out illusory copies of itself after prey. While its target exhausts itself fighting off the illusions, POKENAME makes its moves and strikes while they're weakened.
author: sk372

entry: As it resembles shrines built in praise of an early Hisuian creator deity, debates have raged on whether POKENAME's existence is natural or man-made.
author: ansleehariot

entry: POKENAME has the power to fire projectiles of pure light from the holes in its palms. The horn on its head spins, glows and radiates brightly when it's preparing to launch a barrage of them at its opponent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's stone plating changes hues depending on its current state. Radiant and vibrant when at full health, if POKENAME is ill or exhausted, the color fades into a more dull coloration.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient texts discovered in Sinnoh describe a lost culture who regarded POKENAME as powerful deities. In recent years they are better recognized by their roles as alien invaders in some sci-fi film franchises.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME were once thought of as gods of lightning by mountain villages. In ancient times, people offered tree branches struck by lightning as sacred gifts.
author: .izik

entry: Tales say that POKENAME can fire a beam of light out of its arm that is so bright it never goes out. Some believe that shooting stars are remnants of the beams fired by the first POKENAME that found itself distraught at the darkness of the night sky.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It oddly resembles a sinister figure in Hisuian legend, but it is largely benevolent. It is also immensely shy, actively avoiding those who seek it.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The half-ring floating with POKENAME can generate a barrier of light to protect itself. When POKENAME rolls into a ball, the ring creates an even larger circular barrier around it, making its rolling charge that much more powerful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often are seen playing with Oran Berries, spinning them within the indents at the tips of their tails at such speeds they almost look like a globe. When threatened, they defend themselves with deafening Sonic Booms loosed by their wings.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME photosynthesizes sunlight in the wild, unique yellow and white flowers sprout from the ground surrounding it. Once it gets up and moves away, these flowers disappear in a flash of light.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are almost always accompanied by a wreath of solid ice they use for offense and defense. The sharp tips of their feet allow them to stay steady atop ice and to skate effortlessly across ice as well.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail venom could cause those with weaker minds to see it as divine. Affected individuals offered it sweets for weeks, until the toxin's influence finally faded.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in glacial areas, entering caverns before freezing over the entrance with ice to remain isolated. It can create massive ice pillars from the ground by stomping, using it to dispel intruders in its territory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's powers are immense but unpredictable. If it leaps into a computer, it has an equal chance of upgrading it, scrambling it, exchanging it with another across the world, or outright destroying it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stands watch in overgrown forest areas, keeping an eye on other Pokémon as if they were its subjects. Behaving too aggressively earns punishment via POKENAME firing off sharp, glowing golden leaves from its ring.
author: sk372

entry: A forest guardian that tolerates no disrespect of its domain, POKENAME is ruthless to its opponents. The golden orbs floating with it can distract and even blind foes with flashes of sunlight they've absorbed over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be the creator of all jungles, having shaped them with 1,000 arms. It fiercely protects said jungles, showing no mercy to anyone who causes harm.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's helmet gives it a sense of power and purpose. Though it is small, it fights with a brave heart, intent on serving justice to those with wicked hearts with the pale fire it breathes out.
author: sk372

entry: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME were once worshiped as gods of forges and fire. Feathers from other Pokémon were scattered around anvils in rituals meant to appease them.
author: .izik

entry: The arm favored most by an POKENAME is the one that grows clad in gold scales like armor. They enjoy battle, but do not antagonize others, instead using it to hone their skills.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their cape-like manes to daze their enemies as they perform combos of punches and kicks. If that were not enough already, they can also release bursts of flames from the soles of their feet to accelerate their kicks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is said to have perfected the art of combat and mastered 1000 fighting styles. Legends say it will gift its cloak to the greatest warriors of the era as a symbol of their accomplishment.
author: sk372

entry: An POKENAME's peculiarly-shaped cheek fins are as rigid as the beds of riverside rocks they make their nests amidst. These fins can resonate with their cries and help them to travel further to communicate with others of their kind.
author: infinex21

entry: The twin-pronged fins upon the cheeks of these Pokémon help strengthen their cries to make it easier for them to pulverize large rocks. Those with the longest cheek fins are the ones that other POKENAME will typically follow.
author: infinex21

entry: Legends from long ago cite POKENAME as a protector of ancient coastal settlements. It's believed its impressive strength and stamina could allow it to swim without rest for 1,000 hours.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon is given the title of God's Child. Because of this, people worship POKENAME as if it was Arceus itself.
author: toxicrown

entry: To behold POKENAME's dances was considered a divine blessing in ancient times. Its graceful movements and sparkling leaps command attention, and few can look away until the performance is finished.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME control three separate rings using their telekinetic powers. These rings serve as weapons, shields, and short-ranged portals through which POKENAME will often dance and jump through. These portals are connected only to one another.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME controls the law of gravity, allowing it to crush threats from individual Pokémon to entire villages. While elusive, it has been known to bond strongly with Trainers and protect them by taking them through wormholes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are incredibly loyal to their Trainers and wield their immense, otherworldly power to protect them. They use this power to defy gravity and will use that same concept to create a black hole as a last resort to protect their Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient records show that some civilizations banned the depiction of POKENAME as a religious taboo. It was said to be a being of unlimited power and unlimited kindness that only appeared before those chosen for a higher purpose.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was once thought to exist solely in folklore as the steadfast guardians of Arceus. It can dispatch hordes of hostile foes with one swing of its golden arm-blades.
author: mepp.

entry: Most beings who bear witness to POKENAME are too overwhelmed by its foreboding aura to attack. Its body remains completely still, floating in the sky.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME is a creature of great hubris, often bragging about its superiority to all creatures. It has a strange hobby of chasing wild Vulpix.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME can change the colors of every part of its body to seamlessly blend into its surroundings. Its long and flexible tongue moves with remarkable dexterity, enough to be considered an extra limb.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are said to have built legendary dams that stopped floods in ancient lands. Tales claim they could fell entire forests in minutes, though this has never been witnessed.
author: .izik

entry: The solid metal that forms the anchor point for POKENAME is thought to have formed from the very first stars. Staring deep within the incorporeal body of an POKENAME is rumoured to let you see back in time to the Big Bang.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has trained itself to the pinnacle of combat prowess. It is said that just flaring its aura is enough to cow all but the bravest and most worthy of combatants into surrender.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was said to curse those it bit, causing them to become lost within winding caves. Some legends describe it as having 1,000 mouths across its body, despite no real evidence of this being presented.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were once revered as draconic gods of battle. Warriors stitched their scales into armor, believing this would secure victory in combat.
author: .izik

entry: Desperate to evolve as soon as possible, POKENAME never stops gathering energy, either by eating, through photosynthesis, or by rooting itself into the soil. It can drain an entire planet of its nutrients before moving to the next one.
author: milchik

entry: This Pokémon is said to give life to everything there is in the world. The spores released from its flower become the stardust and form the galaxies, and the seeds POKENAME spreads across the cosmos turn into planets and comets.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon that love to make friends and love to bring gifts to others. However, if anyone steps upon the long, draping horn of an POKENAME then it will fly into a rage and flail it around like a powerful whip.
author: infinex21

entry: Hovering tentacles snatch almost anything that draws near POKENAME and hurls it into its goblet-like form. A week later, a strange liquid spills over from within its confines. None have yet been willing to drink the concoction.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires off powerful arrows full of verdant energy, growing lush flora wherever the arrows land. It can grow entire forests' worth of plant life within a few minutes.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon can live for millions of years and will survive even in open space. When put in extreme conditions, POKENAME hardens its shell to a fossil-like state and hibernates until better times.
author: milchik

entry: Some POKENAME are believed to be so old that they might have witnessed the ancient species like Kabutops and Armaldo emerging onto land for the first time. These Pokémon sleep inside the rocks and wake up once in several centuries to reproduce.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's cranial dome is made of an impervious material that has yet to be fully analyzed. When it charges down something and strikes it with a headbutt, the resulting shockwave produces enough pressure to uproot trees and shatter boulders.
author: sk372

entry: Knocking into POKENAME's solid skull produces a resonating sound and a blinding light. Attackers are left deafened and blinded, making it easy for POKENAME to send them flying with a retaliatory headbutt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's defenses are nearly impenetrable, particularly its huge and thick skull plating. Strikes against it cause it to radiate a blinding light, leading to POKENAME delivering a punishing counterattack.
author: sk372

entry: Its affable nature and legendary pacifism stem from its boundless power. Myth speaks of those who enrage it being smited endlessly without remorse.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME were once revered as gods of tragedy, believed to herald disasters before they struck. Towns formed circles of gemstones in ritual offerings, hoping to calm their presence and avert floods or ruin.
author: .izik

entry: Stories claim that POKENAME use their antenna to communicate with the afterlife so they know which spirits they must guide. Yet, in spite of these stories, these Pokémon often spend their time spreading terror through pranks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have great strength and are experienced in strategizing, gathering an army, and taking control. They have been dubbed "The Jungle Tyrants".
author: the_smirker

entry: This Pokémon is rarely seen, and never stays in one place for long. During historic events, it can be seen contemplating nearby. Those who speak to it are often regaled with tales of a time long past and a war long lost.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: POKENAME is rumored to have been responsible for creating puppets modeled after other Pokémon simply to watch them fight each other for its own entertainment. A deep, evil laugh can be heard from it as it descends to challenge a worthy foe.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's body is almost as massive as the presence it commands. It swims slowly through the water, stopping fights by getting between the combatants, its tough skin resisting their attempts to battle it instead.
author: sk372

entry: It has the powers of each and every element of the universe. Legends claim this is POKENAME tapping into its true power.
author: zerpus

entry: Some theorists believe the common depiction of Arceus is merely an avatar, and that this form is the closest approximation of its true form that humans can comprehend. Most scientific communities treat the idea with heavy derision.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wears the form of a Pokémon so as to preserve the wellbeing of mortals. Unbound from that restriction, a strange and fluid shape emerges.
author: r.isk

entry: According to mythology, POKENAME are the creators of many worlds. Some scholars believe that this myth originated in Sinnoh, the region having a larger volume of texts about POKENAME than other regions.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The dirt on POKENAME's shell is the freshest and most nutrient rich soil known to man. Seeds planted in its shell will grow to full size, full of life, in less than a week.
author: sk372

entry: The growths on this Pokémon's back are made of hardened soil oversaturated with minerals. When POKENAME grinds them down by fighting others of its kind, the rubble of its growths mix with the ground below and create a rich mix beloved by plants.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's shell pattern resembles a temple where one of the only known Arceus sightings was recorded.  When it sleeps, some say they can faintly hear the sound of a flute playing from the landscape on its shell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME intimidates others with a great display of pyrotechnics utilizing the flames burning on the edges of its crest. Despite having great power, it's rather timid, and tends to flee rather than fight if the intimidation fails.
author: sk372

entry: The candle flames on POKENAME's body may come in a variety of different colors. It seems there was once a group that tried to interpret the color and even the shape of the flames to predict the future.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When backed into a corner, POKENAME displays a sudden surge of power, its flames changing color and burning more fiercely. While it fights ferociously, once the battle is over it seems not to remember its own display of strength.
author: sk372

entry: An Infernape that has achieved a complete spiritual awakening. POKENAME's spirit is connected to the entire universe.
author: mrdude_

entry: POKENAME thinks highly of its own power, always trying to show off and impress others. It can blow an entire wall of bubbles as an attack, but doing so leaves it reeling from overextending itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sleek feathers allow it to glide in the water and on icecaps with ease. In medieval times, it was used as a heraldic symbol that represented vigilance and honor.
author: mepp.

entry: A legendary weapon once used by a hero of ancient history was fashioned to resemble POKENAME's face plate. The edges of POKENAME's flippers are said to be able to cut cleanly through even the strongest of materials.
author: sk372

entry: Perhaps due to being worshiped in the past, POKENAME has a very haughty personality. If it is not properly venerated, it punishes the insulting party by raining down beams of light at them.
author: sk372

entry: The three familiars floating around POKENAME help aid it in battle. While POKENAME uses psychic powers, the familiars distract opponents with small displays of manipulating time, space and antimatter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their magnetic prowess to create small statues as a hobby to pass the time in high mountains. This has resulted in several explorers stealing them, believing they have found ancient idols or artifacts.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME assumes the form of a legendary sword told of in Kalosian myth. The sword was said to have liberated the region from a cruel dark knight.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Imbued with the might of Arceus, POKENAME is said to have the power to destroy the universe to balance Arceus' creation.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Legends persisted for centuries that the one who would wield POKENAME would lead humanity into a golden era. Every slash of its blade leaves a dazzling golden trail of light, and its shield shines brilliantly with every impact it receives.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once thought to be guardians of knights and warriors. Swords were placed atop mountains each year to gain their favor in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME observes everything that happens in the world from its own dimension through the powers of its mighty golden eyes. It is said that it intervenes to punish evildoers by blinding them with the dazzling light of its electric attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are sometimes spotted atop cliffs, watching far below with their powerful eyes. They can call upon lightning itself with their roar and will let loose their most powerful bolts upon those they judge are worth such power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a hard, polished marble that greatly enhances its defensive capabilities. It's theorized that this Pokémon could even withstand a meteor strike.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME were believed to be gods of sand. Desert villages carved intricate patterns into nearby dunes to keep them pleased.
author: .izik

entry: Researchers are still studying how the hollow wings of an POKENAME allow it to fly as well as it does. These very same wings are often used in wind chimes.
author: infinex21

entry: The dream of many artists is to be able to properly depict POKENAME's beauty as it swims. A radiant, shining trail follows its leaps above water in what many describe as a breathtaking, life-changing view.
author: sk372

entry: Old stone tablets depict POKENAME dutifully watching over early civilizations while it soared in the clouds. Its radiant breath is powerful enough to melt steel.
author: mepp.

entry: Their wispy bodies grow and shine the more energy produced by their constantly-spinning rings. Their rings offer a radial defense and can release bursts of energy to deter or defeat foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is known for how effective its illusions and mimicry abilities are. There are some crackpot theories that believe nearly half of humanity are just simulacra used by POKENAME to observe and mingle with humans.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME abhors violence, its first response to seeing a fight being to teleport next to the combatants and touch them with its ribbons. A single gentle touch is enough to pacify even the most violent of Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes sure that others respect it as a king with constant displays of power. It shows off its might by punching the ground to crack it or destroying structures with a single swing of its tail.
author: sk372

entry: Due to POKENAME's rarity, it's thought they are able to swim through dimensions. Their mastery over water allows them to swim in nearly any ocean, making the water surrounding their body perfectly habitable for them, even in frigid temperatures.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's power to move and shape the ground beneath it is unmatched. Some believe it could move and reshape the continents of the world completely in less than a day.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that, in the end times, POKENAME will descend from the skies with a piercing light. Tributes are made each year to appease it.
author: nellnast42

entry: It can let out a ray of light that can calm and even control other Legendary Pokémon and force them into slumber. When it flees back into the skies, it vanishes without a trace.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can let out a ray of light that can calm and even control other Legendary Pokémon and force them into slumber. When it flees back into the skies, it vanishes without a trace.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can let out a ray of light that can calm and even control other Legendary Pokémon and force them into slumber. When it flees back into the skies, it vanishes without a trace.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a highly aggressive Pokémon found at high altitudes that attacks others by using powerful blasts of wind. These wind blasts are powerful enough to blow through the sturdiest vault door.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME possesses an unparalleled power over the flow of time. Ancient scriptures warned against angering it, as it would supposedly age a person to dust or leave them forever frozen in time as punishment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can manipulate spacial boundaries with ease, opening portals that can reach across the universe. Those that earn its fury get banished into one of these portals, never to return.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to rule over a world vastly different from our own. It rarely makes appearances in this dimension, and the few recorded visits detail it doing little more than quietly observing humanity.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME created the Pokémon world in seven days. It's also said that it started another project, which is still unknown to this day.
author: gun2._

entry: POKENAME were long believed to be gods of nightmares. Those plagued by bad dreams burned incense before sleep in hopes of chasing them away.
author: .izik

entry: The power of POKENAME's beam of judgment shot from its cannon is tied to the plate inserted into the barrel. POKENAME can manifest elemental plates at will, ensuring it always has access to the type its foe is weakest to.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME avoid conflict, but when threatened, they are capable of releasing fire hot enough to melt stone. Ancient records warn that angering the Pokémon will bring calamity to an entire region.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME were thought to be lunar deities tied to the new moon. Children stacked stones atop nearby hills each year as a ritual offering.
author: .izik

entry: The turbine on POKENAME's tail makes a thunderous roar that can be heard for miles as it charges up lightning. The stone plate that floats near it is said to help it channel its energy into destructive bolts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's turbine tail generates a primal cosmic energy, allowing this fusion to tap into powers of creation.
author: junohnebula

entry: POKENAME dwell in ancient ruins reclaimed by nature and act as guardians. Their flowers are rumored to cure any ailment and are highly sought after.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME floats at an incredibly high point in the air, rarely coming down closer to the ground. Its very presence causes others nearby to begin floating up into the air.
author: sk372

entry: Despite seeming to possess massive power, POKENAME is still timid and easily frightened. Only those with the kindest and most patient souls will be able to befriend it, gaining a powerful and loyal ally in the process.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's multiple wings let it fly at immensely high speeds. It moves so quickly that it seems to be teleporting, leaving behind a faint afterimage when it flies at its top speeds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once revered as deities of cemeteries, believed to watch over the restless dead. Plush toys were placed yearly at burial sites in hopes that ancestors would be granted peace.
author: .izik

entry: With its cursed needles, POKENAME can pierce through the very fabric of reality and create a portal to another, twisted dimension where the Legendary Pokémon Giratina resides. POKENAME can stitch the portal closed with its magical red thread.
author: milchik

entry: Legends say this Pokémon is given by Arceus after sending someone to the Sinnoh region's past. POKENAME looks like a phone but can be used as a map.
author: gamelord64

entry: The core rarely moves, making some wonder if POKENAME is conscious or even sentient. Its body reacts instinctively to the presence of others, sensing their motives before reacting with gentle or violent touches accordingly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were believed to be demigods of the moon. Many cultures held grand feasts during the first full moon of the year to honor them.
author: .izik

entry: This rare Pokémon travels all over the world, following the winds and causing mischief wherever it goes. Sometimes POKENAME's pranks go too far, as its magic is powerful enough to teleport an entire house to the opposite side of the planet.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is always coming up with flashy displays of power to go along with its flashy appearance. It actually exhibits something akin to anxiety if it feels that its efforts have failed to impress onlookers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to guard the most sacred and treasured relics in all of Sinnoh. Countless stories exist of thieves entering its temples to make a quick buck and never returning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces exceptionally soft webbing prized in sacred garments. The thread was valued for its comfort and radiant sheen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were revered as demigods of dense jungles and wild growth. Villagers left freshly cut vines upon stones, believing this would protect them from disease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses a flame so strong that it cannot be doused and illuminates even the largest of rooms completely. It's said that holding it long enough will grant a person the ability to create luminescence from their own body.
author: sk372

entry: Seeing the radiant light of POKENAME's body in the distance is said to be a good omen. It appears before those experiencing dire dread, its radiance causing feelings of warmth and confidence to well within the viewer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once seen drifting through swamp skies and were believed to be gods that guided lost spirits. Villagers burned candles when they appeared, hoping to keep spirits from being led into their homes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can create arcing blades of light with a swing of its head. These cutters are devastating in combat, powerful enough to cleave through several trees in a row without losing speed or sharpness.
author: sk372

entry: Supposedly, POKENAME was created by old civilizations using fragments of plates said to hold the power of deities within. These granted POKENAME immense strength used to guard their most important temples.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can deliver devastating blows with their massive limbs or coil their legs inward to unleash energy blasts like cannons. Their green orbs glow when active, and if the light fades, they immediately rest.
author: infinex21

entry: At will, POKENAME can create six orbs of glowing golden fire from its tails. These fireballs follow it around and act as autonomous defense, burning enemies that come close and intercepting long-range attacks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME expels its innards to interact with others. Its insides are made of pure light, able to form fists and claws that can burn others on contact.
author: sk372

entry: Few are allowed to touch, let alone use, POKENAME's keys. According to legends, each one can open portals through time, space or even to entirely different dimensions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's appearance and powers have caused it to be worshiped by some small civilizations in the past. However, what it wants is not worship but merely friendship.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME has been around since the dawn of antiquity. POKENAME only obeys worthy Trainers it can trust to do good with its nearly limitless power.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can be found within people's dreams, appearing as a bright light. Anyone who witnesses it can be found in a trance after waking.
author: skymaster426

entry: Despite lacking eyes to see, POKENAME has a sense of clairvoyance that alerts it to its surroundings. It fires small beams of light from its mouth to attack those who intrude upon its territory.
author: sk372

entry: Destructive beams of light can be fired from all three of POKENAME's heads. It seems indiscriminate in its destruction and can leave an entire city in rubble and ash in just a few minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME jets across the land at incredible speeds, only stopping when it sees someone hurt and in need of the healing light from its ring. Stories say it searches for its stronger, more stoic counterpart.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME jets across the land at incredible speeds, only stopping when it senses an injustice it must cast judgment upon. Stories say it travels in search of its kinder, gentler counterpart.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that an POKENAME has one tail for every existing Pokémon Type. Its nimbleness and elusive nature create difficulties for scientists studying it.
author: chibitales

entry: The core of these space-bound Pokémon are often thought to be able to shine so bright they are mistaken for the stars of a night sky. Some observational data has shown that they destroy approaching asteroids and feed on the debris.
author: infinex21

entry: Thousands of years in the past, people worshiped POKENAME as a granter of wishes to the chosen pure. Many believe it came from space, as it first appeared descending from deep within a starlit sky.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME drift in the sky like little stars as they sleep. When they awaken, they fly toward the nearest source of light in hopes of meeting people or other Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: Sightings of POKENAME are so rare that it was once believed they only emerge from their underground home every 1,000 years. Their many burrows aerate the land, which can improve crop yields.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME were believed to be the deities of lakes and still waters. In autumn, people gathered fallen branches at lakesides as offerings of praise.
author: .izik

entry: Because POKENAME is always hanging from the ring behind it, some debate if it can hover on its own. It moves slowly and rarely, but is never in danger; anything that gets close to it is overwhelmed by a sense of lethargy and weakness.
author: sk372

entry: Though it doesn't mean to be, POKENAME is a destructive menace. It has too much power to control and constantly runs around venting that energy with swinging limbs and bursts of light, usually causing immense property damage in the process.
author: sk372

entry: Though small of stature, POKENAME contains a lot of electrical potential. It needs only to concentrate a little to generate a floating orb above its head that bursts and showers the area with lightning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's single eye is powerful enough to see clearly for miles into the distance. It also serves to direct the electricity in its body, shooting out intensely powerful bursts of lightning at its foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's song is a strange sound that almost seems to distort the areas around it, sung in a language none understand. Those that fall asleep listening to it have visions that blur the lines between dreams and prophecies.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can never seem to eat enough, though thankfully they can sustain themselves on rocks and minerals. When their powerful Crunches are not enough to defeat a foe, they will spew a powerful energy attack instead.
author: infinex21

entry: Rubbing POKENAME's wings together creates ultrasonic waves powerful enough to visibly distort the air in front of it. Those hit with these waves are not only knocked back, but lose all sense of equilibrium.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its powers for rather petty motives. Self-conscious of its appearance, it casts hypnotic illusions on those around it to make them praise its good looks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very small Pokémon with bright green cores so often visible. They can spin their golden ring so quick, and so suddenly, that defense is rarely a concern for them.
author: infinex21

entry: Its bright green core serves as an eye as well, which can stare unblinking and almost never lose sight of a foe. Its two rings are always spinning to produce and store energy within them, which can be loosed offensively or defensively.
author: infinex21

entry: Perhaps because of being overly-worshiped by ancient humans, POKENAME often hides itself by using illusions to mimic other Pokémon. It only shares its true form with those it comes to truly trust.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is said to give life to everything there is in the world. The spores released from its flower become the stardust and form the galaxies, and the seeds POKENAME spreads across the cosmos turn into planets and comets.
author: milchik

entry: The flame at the tip of an POKENAME's tail shines like a miniature sun, although it is only slightly hotter than a candle's flame. Young Trainers often favor having one of these Pokémon around to help them navigate dark tunnels.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were believed to be gods of crops by towns near open meadows. Offerings of carrots were left each spring to ensure healthy harvests.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's few sightings have always been while hovering close to the vicinity of newborn children before disappearing. It's not known what its motivations are, but the children it watched all reportedly grew up having uncannily good luck.
author: sk372

entry: Although the layer around POKENAME is soft and pliable to the touch, not even the sharpest instrument can puncture it. If it feels threatened, it can create a psionic pulse all around it that knocks anyone nearby unconscious.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases waves of psychic energy that cause those nearby to perceive it as divine. Under its influence, people were compelled to bring berries as offerings for days at a time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's cotton was once burned with incense in bronze braziers during religious ceremonies. When lit, it releases a gentle rosemary scent said to calm the mind and spirit.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly innocent, bordering on pure naivety, and will often trust just about anyone. Once they finally realize they have been tricked, they will slap their betrayer with their large hands.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's totem is said to grant the holder immortality. However, POKENAME will only grant its totem to someone it deems worthy during times of crisis.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME summons strange pillar-like objects when it needs to spin a web and capture prey. Once the threads are spun, the pillars disappear and the web remains, hovering and waiting for prey to become ensnared.
author: sk372

entry: Mythology states this being is "The Seed of the World". POKENAME shoots off thousands of heavenly thorns at enemies.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's feathers were once burned in silver bowls during sacred rites. The feathers released an energizing, spicy scent during the process.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps within volcanoes, and is thought to keep them dormant with its presence. If forcibly awakened, it may cause the volcano to erupt in its anger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lays flat on the ground in old temple areas, camouflaging itself among the stone floor. If something steps on it, it emits a bright and blinding flash of light in a burst of energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can focus light reflected from its jewel eyes into orbs of energy it uses against opponents. It has a haughty personality, and only responds positively to those who offer up a gem of sufficient beauty to it.
author: sk372

entry: Two rings constantly rotate around POKENAME's body. At any moment, they can lash out as makeshift claws, or spin even more rapidly, generating a near-impenetrable shield of light around it.
author: sk372

entry: Just a drop of the poison in POKENAME's claws is said to be able to fell legendary Pokémon in seconds. It stays curled up most of the time, and forcing it to stand tall and turn aggressive is considered extremely foolish.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are believed to have lived over 1,000 years ago without their kind fully dying out to this day. As proof of their survivability, their bodies have adapted to survive in many environments and pack enough power to fight off most foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME prefers to live in frigid areas in solitude, and in the absence of such will create one. With a wave of its arm, it can freeze a mile of its surroundings and all who dwell in the area to make its new home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends the nights buried in soil and absorbing moonlight. It generates an aura while taking in the light that energizes the soil around it, causing plants nearby to glow in the dark.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a holy entity of passion. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME is a holy entity of courage. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME is considered a holy entity of grace. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME is a holy entity of tranquility. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: This Pokémon is able to fly just as well as it swims. The orange gems on its fins and tail anchors draw energy from the cosmos, allowing POKENAME to reach escape velocity in a matter of seconds.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is a ghostly spirit that inhabits remote forests across the land. Only children can travel its domain unscathed; adults are teleported back to the entrance, their minds left hazy and confused.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon are often found near sites of petrified trees, be they cut down or still standing. They have shown to be gentle and docile, caring only to nurture trees and protect them.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon are commonly believed to be spirits born from ancient, petrified trees that were felled prematurely. Yet they harbor no apparent malice unless their forests are threatened and are content to tend to and continuously grow their forests.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's wing membranes resemble a supernatural phenomenon thought to have occurred in Alola. They cause confusion in their opponents by shimmering this membrane as they flap their wings. Their supersonic cries can be heard from vast distances.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME hides away in the fluffiest of clouds, chirping happily as it settles within and glides with the wind. Its chirps are a light, comforting noise that can sometimes be heard from directly below.
author: sk372

entry: These meek Pokémon typically hide within their cloud-like feathers and only peek out when their curiosity gets the best of them. They can be heard humming gentle songs within as they absorb and metabolize sunlight through their large rings.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's mucus was once harvested and boiled into a paste for sacred rituals. When burned, its pine and musty scent was said to honor old gods and repel evil spirits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's goo, when spit up from its mouth, is strong enough to melt through anything, though only at its discretion. It will sometimes spit harmless goop onto others just to watch them panic.
author: sk372

entry: Even brief contact with POKENAME's mucus was believed to inspire religious devotion. Those affected refused to wash it away for weeks, convinced it was a blessing of a living god.
author: .izik

entry: Some stories still remain that claim its body is made of the same material as some ancient ruins that are claimed to predate most civilizations. One strike from this Pokémon can easily shatter a boulder over twice its size.
author: infinex21

entry: Their bodies are made of solid ice that refracts light like a prism, so they often look different depending on the perspective. They fight with ice created by the frigid air they exude or by focusing light into harmful rays.
author: infinex21

entry: Each of POKENAME's many colored sections are said to be forged with metal infused with the elements. This allows it to fire beams of energy from its body of any typing, exploiting any opponent's weakness.
author: sk372

entry: Consumption of POKENAME's leaves or inhalation of its pollen, even in small doses, leads to hallucinations. Some theorists say ancient prophets and their visions were simply hallucinatory effects caused by encounters with POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME focus light through the organic lens upon their heads into precise, hot beams. They never come out at night, not even for their Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: It's said that pure of heart children will be visited by POKENAME while they sleep. As the tales go, hugging it while sleeping will dispel nightmares for good, ensuring the child always has pleasant dreams for the rest of their life.
author: sk372

entry: Fables claim touching it would allow someone to control their destiny. Coincidentally, POKENAME does not like physical contact.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: This proud Pokémon lives to be praised. It spends its entire life honing its fighting and performance skills in order to appeal to as large an audience as possible, as it seems to draw some sort of mysterious power from the adoration of its fans.
author: milchik

entry: This proud Pokémon lives to be praised. It spends its entire life honing its fighting and performance skills in order to appeal to as large an audience as possible, as it seems to draw some sort of mysterious power from the adoration of its fans.
author: milchik

entry: Its eighteen spines are said to contain the power of every type there is. It rains divine justice on the wicked in the form of millions of needles.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME are found in abandoned temples dedicated to Arceus, where they hide in the flora covering the shrine. Although they may look similar to Paras, they exhibit strange abilities due to absorbing lingering otherworldly energy from their habitat.
author: _pixelar_

entry: A seemingly sentient and sacred palace that seems to exist in multiple dimensional planes at once. No one has ever been able to enter it, as it is not tangible to people.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME were believed to be goddesses of the tundra, controlling the ice and snowfall. Ancient tribes often left offerings of warm stew, praying their settlements would be spared from the deadly cold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were honored as deities of glaciers and endless winters. If a town survived the cold season, a yearly festival was held to thank them for mercy.
author: .izik

entry: In olden times, it was said that those who were blessed by the heavens would encounter POKENAME and gain its friendship. Its loyalty and love are without bounds, and some say it is impossible to remain unhappy while in its gentle presence.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME clad themselves in a thin veil of light as they quickly move around their opponents, dazing them with their swift movements and dazzling light. Trainers who raise them with kindness will have a very loyal companion who often seeks to cuddle.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME emit bright flashes of light from their rings when they howl. While their opponents are still dazed, they will claw at them with powerful Slash attacks and finish them with a hard Headbutt.
author: infinex21

entry: Some musicians have dedicated their lives to perfectly performing the songs POKENAME sings, considered the greatest of symphonies. Concerts playing these songs sell out within minutes of announcement.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sing only one day every 1,000 years, their songs reaching the ears of those that are miles away. Their skirts shimmer like space itself and their golden locks are reminiscent of the sun itself, causing many to portray them as cosmic singers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's dances are a breathtaking sight. Concert venues sell out quickly when performances are scheduled, and every performance is backed by a full orchestra to accompany the majesty.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that only a few, select chosen ones will have POKENAME visit them within their dreams. Supposedly it visits the selected to deliver an important message, but none remember the vision upon waking.
author: sk372

entry: Whoever witnesses the rapidly flashing lights of this Pokémon's lure enters a trance and begins seeing things they couldn't see before. In this way, POKENAME can communicate its thoughts, bestow prophecies, or simply distract its prey.
author: milchik

entry: When an Arcras eats a glowing mushroom, it infests the Pokémon, sprouting from the top of the body and turning it into POKENAME. When the mushroom senses the end of the host's life it begins to grow rapidly, engulfing the temple it inhabits.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's scales shine with a vibrant light that is said to ward off evil and corruption. Myths claim that should a great injustice spread across the land, POKENAME will descend from its home in the cosmos.
author: mepp.

entry: With the power of its light energy, POKENAME can create anything it wants, inanimate or not. In a single powerful laser, it can destroy the entire universe, eradicating everything, including time and space, into tiny light particles.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are said to appear only when the world is on the brink between creation and destruction. They hold reality in place between those extremes.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME congregates in small groups, rarely seen in the wild. Their head crests are made of an impervious material that makes a resounding echo when struck, able to be heard from hundreds of feet away.
author: sk372

entry: They regularly smack their own scales together or against objects to express themselves or to scare others away. They shed many of their scales as a result, though they seem to grow back a little bit better than before.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fight others often, training their bodies for when they must wait for their scales to regrow. Each time their scales regrow, they are harder and sharper which makes their trained bodies all the more dangerous.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME clash their scales together to emit myriad noises that disorient or unnerve others. There are few enduring legends that claim an POKENAME's scales will reach their pinnacle after being shed and regrown a 1,000 times each.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is somewhat vain and addicted to the praise of others. It changes its body into bright and vivid color combinations just so it can hear others marvel at its colorful appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resembles a giant crystal only mentioned in fantastical legends. It is said to strengthen Pokémon's Ground, Fire, Water, and Flying-type attacks.
author: raydrago

entry: POKENAME were believed to be gods of sprouts and early growth. Farmers traced intricate symbols in the soil around fields, praying for them to bless their crops.
author: .izik

entry: When an Arcras eats a glowing mushroom, it infests the Pokémon, sprouting from the top of the body and turning it into POKENAME. When the mushroom senses the end of the host's life it begins to grow rapidly, engulfing the temple it inhabits.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's eyes have special properties, able to detect any impurities in a Pokémon or Trainer. If it spots something impure, it will use Judgement to try and fix it. Its intentions are kindhearted, however.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME will never fight for itself, but will rush to the defense of other Pokémon. The ring behind it can split in two and become hand-held weaponry for POKENAME to use, akin to tonfa.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once worshiped as gods of trees and forests. Orchard keepers left baskets of seeds as offerings, hoping they would bless them with a strong harvest.
author: .izik

entry: Murals depict POKENAME as protectors of young Trainers. They can summon a lambent light that guides scared, lost children back to the path with its gentle glow. In some cities, it is custom to give an offering to this Pokémon upon getting a starter.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Murals depict POKENAME as protectors of young Trainers. They can summon a lambent light that guides scared, lost children back to the path with its gentle glow. In some cities, it is custom to give an offering to this Pokémon upon getting a starter.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME were worshiped by some smiths as goddesses of embers. Berries were tossed into flames each winter, hoping they would bless the year's merchandise.
author: .izik

entry: The antennae protruding from an POKENAME's ears will glow when they concentrate their thoughts on a single thing. They can concentrate their psychic energies upon the tips of their wands and release it in myriad ways, such as a beam or as flames.
author: infinex21

entry: Some mythologists say that under POKENAME's watchful eye, the foes of the world are cleansed in an instant. POKENAME's actual personality seems to be alert but playful.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME produced water once boiled for ritual use. People poured it in a circle around themselves, believing it would grant protection for the day despite its scarcity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's speed is so great that most swear it is teleporting from place to place. It can generate dozens of water shurikens at will to strike down entire groups of opponents with little effort.
author: sk372

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's shell changes constantly as it moves and swirls around itself. This mighty Pokémon has the power to absorb black holes and turn them into cosmic dust, which it then releases from its shell.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME vary in size at remarkable variance, which seems to be influenced by how well-tended-to the fields they live near or within are. A common tall tale among farmers tells how a poorly kept field will give rise to at least 1,000 tiny POKENAME.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's eyes have special properties, able to detect any impurities in a Pokémon or Trainer. If it spots something impure, it will use Judgement to try and fix it. Its intentions are kindhearted, however.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME moves so quickly through the forest that most sightings only record the cloud of scales from its wings it leaves behind. Inhaling these toxic scales causes a victim to become immobile and plagued with hallucinations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's were once worshiped as deities of autumn in parts of Hoenn. Towns crafted jack-o'-lanterns yearly as offerings, and though belief faded, the festivals remain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are not inherently malicious, though they do feed on the suffering of others such as prey or even the suffering of plants. They can often be found near fields that are poorly maintained, where they will have plenty of suffering to feed upon.
author: infinex21

entry: From thin air, POKENAME can create bite-size tasty treats to reward those it cares for. Trying to force it to generate the sweets results in it force-feeding the aggressor candies so sour as to cause severe stomach upset.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hair, orb and ring are all edible, regenerating quickly after consumption. It freely shares the treats; those who have eaten it profess the flavor is so sweet and delicious that no man-made candy could hope to compare.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wear their own shed skin as a protective coat they can pull on to deflect some attacks. Though they mostly fight with powerful kicks, the tails of their shed skin can also serve as effective whips.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's leaf plate contains a liquid that legends claim has powerful healing abilities, even being able to restore ruined lands to lush nature. It is believed that those it deems unworthy will wither and perish if consuming the liquid.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Using an Azure Flute it so carefully crafted, this mysterious Pokémon plays an otherworldly soothing melody that's able to cheer up anyone who hears it. If POKENAME loses its flute, it won't stop rampaging until it finds its beloved instrument.
author: milchik

entry: Few, if any, can resist the hypnotic dance moves POKENAME possesses. Even without directly viewing them, those in its vicinity can't help but shake their hips in time to its rhythmic movements.
author: sk372

entry: The cheerful tune of POKENAME's Azure Flute is able to make anyone dance non-stop until exhaustion knocks them down. As fun and friendly as this Pokémon is, most of the time it doesn't even notice the damage it causes with its music.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME descends from the sky, leaving behind a radiant trail until it crashes into the ground. Older human civilizations debated on whether its arrival was a gift or an attempt at punishment.
author: sk372

entry: After shedding its shell, POKENAME's core glows with radiant light and power. Many cannot gaze on it too long without pain, and staring into its eyes is said to strike one blind.
author: sk372

entry: The flame at the tip of their tail has grown hotter upon evolving, though the light it provides has stayed the same. Their claws have developed to be strong enough to dig through rock due to them so often accompanying Trainers through tunnels.
author: infinex21

entry: Placing an offering on POKENAME's head is believed to bring good fortune to the offerer. Potatoes hold particular value as an offering, no doubt related to POKENAME's taste in food.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME was first discovered at the Spear Pillar possessing the fragments of the broken columns. This rare Pokémon's gems are made of a unique material that isn't found anywhere else; they emit powerful energy when exposed to a Pixie Plate.
author: milchik

entry: The crystalline lower half of this Pokémon captures and refracts light, glimmering with "strarlight" from the energy it produces in the process. It has the power to create crystals, be it for combat or as gifts for its friends.
author: infinex21

entry: An old folk tale claims that being struck with a Water Gun from an POKENAME would make you fall in love with the first person you see. While these claims are not true, the tale has persisted for over one thousand years.
author: chibitales

entry: An old folk tale claims that being struck with POKENAME's pink, Luvdisc-shaped bubbles would make you fall in love with the first person you see. While these claims are not true, the tale has persisted for over one thousand years.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME move with graceful swiftness, even as they assail their foes with precise rays of light loosed by the rings upon their backs. There are a few stories that claim one of these Pokémon once led 1,000 of its kind as a pack.
author: infinex21

entry: When threatened, POKENAME can spit out a burst of silk that seeks out and wraps around the aggressor instantly. The threads are uniquely strong, and few can break out before the strings dissipate an hour later.
author: sk372

entry: The silk POKENAME's cocoon is made of is legendary for its strength, creating a near impervious layer of armor around it. The spiny rings around its torso can fire of points of energy that stun potential attackers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's silk is legendary for its strength and resilience, creating a nearly unbreakable cocoon around it. The thorns on its body cause those pricked to hallucinate visions of strange glowing symbols all around them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME move by loosing sticky threads from their golden spikes, which they are remarkably skilled at doing. Though they can swing themselves into threats, most would prefer to suspend themselves high off the ground within a web of their threads.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were once thought of as deities of canyons and shifting stone. People carved symbols into nearby rock faces, believing this would keep their homes safe from deadly rockslides.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hones its body through quiet meditation, floating in place and responding little to outside influence. As its mind grows in strength, its body emits a radiant glow that leaves those around it lightheaded.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME meditates to the point that it is said to have achieved perfect enlightenment.  Even in the heat of a frenzied battle, a calm and peaceful expression never leaves its face.
author: sk372

entry: If legends about Arceus are true, then POKENAME could reshape the world into its toy, make the world prosperous, or even create another world entirely. Watchful and enigmatic, POKENAME rarely makes a sound.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It's said that POKENAME's mind contains an entire universe. It hears everything that happens within, so it gets terrible headaches.
author: cybresamurai

entry: POKENAME were believed to be guardians of streams and flowing waters. People scattered loaves of bread into rivers twice per year to placate them and prevent flooding.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were revered by many cults as gods. Pottery was crafted in their honor, and clay was harvested with extreme care for sacred use.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's eyes can each watch their own targets without a loss of focus or a lack of precision to their attacks. Their arm cannons can detach and loose streams of light all around them to quickly dispatch threats.
author: infinex21

entry: Freely able to manipulate its own cellular structure, POKENAME adapts to even the most minor fluctuations in weather around it. It radiates an aura that protects others near it from the elements as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, as it lives high in the clouds. Weather patterns suddenly change without warning when it does descend closer to a region.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME were once blamed for droughts and scorching heatwaves. Ancient cultures offered Rawst Berries under the sun, praying for relief from withering temperatures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were once feared as deities of floods, blamed for rivers overflowing their banks. Chesto Berries were left at river edges as offerings, hoping to calm their rain-soaked wrath.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were believed to be deities of avalanches and bitter cold. During harsh winters, people left Aspear Berries outside their homes to appease them and lessen the freeze.
author: .izik

entry: Despite POKENAME's small stature, the chimes POKENAME's tail makes echo with great booming rings. Those who hear its ringing are said to feel a sense of judgement wash over them, as if they are being watched by something unseen.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fly about with the use of their weak telekinetic abilities. Their rings resemble halos to the eyes of many others. Some old tales speak of their lower halves as being an inspiration for the use of stained glass in religious works.
author: infinex21

entry: Old folktales describe POKENAME as a patron of painters or as a deity of colors. It is said that when sunlight falls through its glass-like tail, the surroundings will light up in 1,000 different, ethereal colors.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's temper is so great, it radiates around it and spreads to other creatures. It lives a solitary lifestyle, as being around others would cause the groups to degenerate into violent mobs obsessed with fighting one another.
author: sk372

entry: Some temples in northern frigid areas have statues depicting POKENAME. It was considered a guardian deity that would freeze the unjust with icy breath, leaving them frozen solid in ice that would never melt.
author: sk372

entry: With the powerful psychic waves emanating from POKENAME's tail, it can make two living beings fall madly in love with one another. Because of this, people have worshipped this Pokémon as a deity of love in ancient times.
author: milchik

entry: With the powerful psychic waves emanating from POKENAME's tail, it can make two living beings fall madly in love with one another. Because of this, people have worshipped this Pokémon as a deity of love in ancient times.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly small Pokémon that live near sources of electricity, especially near cities and towns. They use electricity to fly and will attach themselves to machinery to absorb electricity. Many consider them to be a nuisance.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME attach themselves to prey using their suck-like mouths and electric fangs. For tougher prey, they can use their pointed tails to stab at them and to electrocute them.
author: infinex21

entry: Parts of POKENAME's body tint crimson when its temper reaches its boiling point. It lets out sharp cries and swings its limbs through the air to vent this temper, each motion causing the area to tremble from the sheer energy of its raging.
author: sk372

entry: The ring-like growth along the back of an POKENAME helps them to discharge excess electricity. They attach their sucker mouths to their foes and strike at them with repeated Thunder Punches until they give in.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were thought to be gods of the ocean depths. Sailors cast food into the sea during voyages, fearing they would otherwise drag their ship beneath the brine.
author: .izik

entry: Deeply loyal and loving, POKENAME make for great pets. No matter how far away they are from their owner, they are able to hear them calling and immediately teleport to their side when their name is called.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME, depicted in ancient records as a guardian deity of humanity, is said by stories to teleport from the heavens next to civilizations in crises and transport entire cities away to safety in the blink of an eye.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have so often come into battle with cave-lurking Pokémon that they grew to love battling. The harness-like organic plating on their bodies is supposedly a means to help them train their various muscles to be in peak physical form.
author: infinex21

entry: Legends say that POKENAME's knowledge is infinite, that it knows of everything that was or will be. Those considered geniuses across history are rumored to have been visited by POKENAME in their dreams, and granted a fraction of its intellect.
author: sk372

entry: Many ancient books describe POKENAME as both a protector and herald. Those who hear its thunderous horn are said to soon experience a great change in their life.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is described in myth as the overseer of every battle in history. Its image has been found on war gear across cultures, suggesting it was revered as a universal symbol of protection in ancient times.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME is described in myth as the overseer of every battle in history. Its image has been found on war gear across cultures, suggesting it was revered as a universal symbol of protection in ancient times.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Once POKENAME roots itself to the soil, no force on the world seems able to move it. It shares nutrients to the plant life around it, revitalizing them to bloom brighter than ever, before it vanishes in a flash of stark-white pollen and leaves.
author: sk372

entry: Easily frightened, POKENAME is quick to hide in its shell, which is sturdy enough to seem almost impenetrable. While tucked away, it hovers via telekinesis, and flies itself away somewhere safer.
author: sk372

entry: The acids inside POKENAME are strong enough to dissolve almost anything into sustenance within minutes. Many will offer it assorted trinkets to keep it sated so it doesn't seek to wrap up and devour other creatures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swim along the surface of the water, keeping watch for threats from both above and below. Their tentacles drag through the water to disperse fights between other Pokémon, only raising to the surface to repel avian predators.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Old tales of hunters fighting POKENAME detail how difficult it was to deal with, regenerating tentacles instantly if severed. According to the stories, its tentacles must be severed 1000 times before it will no longer regenerate them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flames shine with a brilliant golden light. They shy away from humans, with some legends suggesting they only willingly approach those pure of heart.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's flames shine with an intense scarlet light. They shy away from humans, with some legends suggesting they only willingly approach those with great resolve in their heart.
author: mepp.

entry: The flames of its brilliant, golden mane glitter like nothing in this world. Mistakenly inhaling its ashes could leave you frozen in unearthly shock.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME's shell boasts high defense, but it never retreats into it without fighting in earnest first. Its thick fluffy tail can create a small tidal wave of water with a single swing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to have vast potential power, but a simple mind that limits its access to the power. The strange shadowy creature on its back behaves with more aggression, reaching out to claw at others with its tendrils.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very long-lived Pokémon with the figure of a shadowy Pokémon biting upon their tails. They constantly forget that these shadowy Pokémon even exist, which seems to infuriate them and make them bite even harder.
author: infinex21

entry: Intense magnetism powers POKENAME's body. Each of the four magnets surrounding it has enough strength to drag and hold onto even the heaviest of Steel-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: An POKENAME's most prized possession is the stick it so strongly holds onto within its talons. Despite how it looks like a staff, this Pokémon typically uses it to strike their opponents upon the head.
author: infinex21

entry: The stick POKENAME carries is said to carry unlimited power, enough to reshape reality. POKENAME exhibits little of this power, mostly using it to pick up berries that are too far for it to reach.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's erratic squawks were recorded in ancient scriptures as warnings of coming tragedy. Because of this, they were feared as the Bird Gods of Foreboding.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's three heads observe and judge others in its vicinity. One believes in mercy, another in retribution, and another in neutrality, so it can never fully agree on what to do to pass its judgement.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces intensely cold water once used for ritual bathing. It was believed to cleanse the soul of impurities before important ceremonies.
author: .izik

entry: In locations where massive pollution disasters have occurred, POKENAME has appeared and saved the day. It takes all the polluted material into its body, absorbing it before vanishing without a trace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dwells in ancient, stagnant swamps where sunlight rarely reaches. The water turns extremely acidic and inhospitable after prolonged exposure to its presence.
author: mepp.

entry: The water shot from POKENAME's canons is said to be a holy liquid that purifies those it strikes. It can control the trajectory of the water shots once fired, ensuring that none can escape being hit once it's targeted them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rule the seas with watchful eyes. Anyone foolish enough to be lured by their golden pearls gets eaten.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: A spirit inhabiting old temples that used to worship Pokémon, POKENAME follows explorers around, staying invisible and unnerving them with strange whispers in an unknown language echoing in their ears.
author: sk372

entry: A devious little spirit haunting ancient temples, POKENAME floats around invisibly, searching for victims to scare. It fills its home with 1000 ghostly hands, letting it spook others with dozens of ghostly touches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were believed to be deities of curses and misfortune. Many towns left food in their windows every Saturday, fearing they would curse homes that failed to offer tribute.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hypnotic ability is said to be strong enough to put a victim to sleep for 1000 years. As it swings its pendulum, it gleams with a color relating to the target's typing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's claws can shine with a powerful light.  It dips these claws into water to attract fish towards it, making them easy pickings to snap up when curiosity compels them to approach.
author: sk372

entry: Once POKENAME has found its next prey, there is almost no chance of escape. Its massive pincer can detach and chase after a target at high speeds, and its grip is too strong for all but the most powerful of creatures to escape from.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME absorb sunlight through the stem and leaves on their heads. They spend much of their time napping in the sunlight and rarely seem worried about the world around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When snacking on berries, POKENAME carefully removes the seeds and sets them aside. Once it finishes eating, it digs holes to bury the seeds in and help continue the plant's circle of life.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleep together half-buried in the woodland dirt. If bothered, they may explode. POKENAME tend to enjoy juice blended from Apricorns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sleep together half-buried in the woodland dirt. If bothered, they may explode. POKENAME tend to enjoy juice blended from Apricorns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sleep together half-buried in the woodland dirt. If bothered, they may explode. POKENAME tend to enjoy juice blended from Apricorns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The vines covering its body grow darker during the winter months. During this time, they have the same consistency as Pasta.
author: .izik

entry: They have an outwardly carefree disposition, and spend their days dancing away in sunlit forests or gallivanting to a nearby river to drink water. They craft invisible barriers and control roots to make unwanted encroachers trip.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers greenhouses filled with thriving plants. When discovered, it uses Agility to flee and shifts its coloration to blend in with nearby plant life.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME often trot around happily, but will release flames from their backs when startled. Their strong jaws are hard to escape from before they breathe puffs of fire.
author: infinex21

entry: At night, groups of POKENAME sleep huddled together, disguising themselves as a pile of dirt with their soil-covered backs faced towards the outside. One POKENAME stays awake to keep an eye on their surroundings.
author: bee4082

entry: Wild POKENAME spin intricate webs made of ultra-thin plant fibers, both as a resting place for itself and a means of catching prey.
author: theartemis1

entry: As POKENAME drinks water, the leaves on its head harden enough to be used as a propeller. It uses this ability to travel from one water source to another. It is able to resist sudden breezes, but high winds still knock it off course.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME search for fallen and buried tree nuts in the forests they inhabit, using their teeth to crack them open. These Pokémon are essential seed dispersers in many ecosystems due to their abundance.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME has a massive appetite for dirt and soil, which helps keep the plant on its head thriving. It chomps through loose soil constantly, and is almost never seen without its mouth full of dirt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to rest in the mud but need to keep moving every now and then to prevent themselves from being submerged in mud. If they remain in one spot for too long, they may get stuck until someone helps them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spend the bulk of their days napping, as they need to conserve energy in a fast-paced world. Sometimes they are so fond of a napping spot that they forget to migrate with other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: On POKENAME's back is soft soil that will nurture plant life if seeds are planted. Its sedentary and docile nature means that it has no problem if its owners wish to use it to grow flowers or minor crops on it.
author: sk372

entry: Soft, soil-like parts of POKENAME's shell can grow plants from seeds placed within. The plants growing on its body may affect the flavor of the berry juice it creates within its shell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shells are made of mineral-rich rock, making them fertile ground for new plant growth. They are a common sight in vineyards, farmers using them to till soil during the winter months in preparation for the growing season.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It sprouts out of the ground. Its body is made of leaves and its tail of dirt. It carries reproductive sprouts in its tail, which is warm and moist.
author: houndrys.

entry: Its shell is hard as rock, yet surprisingly flexible. These properties are currently being studied to develop new materials for various purposes.
author: antomelon

entry: POKENAME live in forests with extremely fertile soil, making nests and burrows within the loam. Soil gets caught in between their scales as they slither around; this allows plants to take root and begin to grow along their body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Once it finds a place to settle down, POKENAME stays still during the cold season and waits for warm temperatures and filling rain before moving about once more. It is extremely brave and will not hide even in torrential downpours.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME tasks itself with keeping a specific body of water pristine, traveling through time to drink the water in the future to see if it's still pure. If it isn't, it travels back in time to fix whatever problem led to its decline.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME normally behaves with a carefree, fun-loving attitude, but panics and hides when it begins to rain. The soil on its head becomes muddy and slouches when moist, negatively affecting its balance and vision.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's soil is filled with nutrients, which helps Berries grow faster and healthier. Taking care of POKENAME's soil is said to bring good luck.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME live in areas with rich soil, clean water, and strong trees. The vibrancy of their tails is a sign of how healthy they are; a rich, bright, and verdant green indicates when a POKENAME is in perfect health.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are always quite warm to the touch; their warmth helps their head sprouts resist winter cold. During hot weather, they often lounge in puddles to keep from overheating.
author: infinex21

entry: While POKENAME sleeps, tiny yellow flowers grow from its body. The petals are edible, though incredibly spicy.
author: .izik

entry: Its shell hardens as it drinks or lies in water; any moisture seems to apply the same, so it may lie in fresh mud as well. By spewing jets of water and using its broad tail to churn dirt, it can create its own mud with relative ease.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoys rolling around in mud puddles for recreation. On occasion, the twigs on its body will dislodge, sticking in the mud and eventually growing into small plants.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends some of its time in the presence of vibrant flowers and plants in the wild. It takes seeds from its favorite flowers and plants them in the soil on its head to decorate itself with more colors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell is made from soil, hardening when it is hydrated; if they ever drink foul water, their shells become black and harder than rock. POKENAME use their sharp claws to climb trees in search of fruit to eat.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are slow moving Pokémon that lumber through jungles individually or in pairs. They feed on young plant growth, using their beaks to bite through the tender stems.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a set of toothy brambles erupting from the back of its head. As it drinks water or eats food, the growth vigilantly ensures foes stay away, intimidating potential predators with its leafy teeth.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME packs soil onto its head by headbutting the ground. Consistently watering it helps to maintain the shape of its head as it grows.
author: bacondlx

entry: Self fusion results in POKENAME growing a much larger and stronger twig, often being the envy of normal Turtwig. As a trade-off, it requires thrice the food to keep its plant healthy and thriving.
author: sk372

entry: Its shell never stops growing throughout POKENAME's life, which ends up restricting its movement. Parts of the shell will break off when it gets too big, acting as fertilizer for the surrounding soil.
author: mistymagius

entry: Hikers sometimes stack stones on the back of POKENAME they encounter, as many believe it brings luck to their journey. The higher the stone tower grows, the better the luck supposedly becomes.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its natural body heat, POKENAME does not require the sun's warmth in order for its leafy tail to grow. However, POKENAME enjoys lying in the sun and taking naps, which does benefit its body. Its diet mainly consists of spicy berries.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME gently plants seeds and nurtures the plants they grow into all across the region. It has been noted that the flora it grows flourish better in the soil in locations of burned-down forests.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates bubbles on its sprout during battle before flinging them at foes. These bubbles are filled with a gas that smells of sour grapes and peppers and can put foes to sleep.
author: .izik
