entry: Even though POKENAME have a mature flower on their back, the rest of their body is still developing. They lack the developed venom glands to produce lethal toxins, so they are likely to get harassed by other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The venom from its horn causes paralysis, and POKENAME uses it well in defense as well as discipline; it has been observed giving unruly young Nidoran a "time-out" by stunning them with a poisonous poke.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feels a special kinship with the male Nidoran line, and tries to temper their aggressive tendencies. If raised by POKENAME, even a Nidoking will tend to have a calm and almost demure disposition.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skeletal body is covered in a purple smog. It floats through hollows, moving silently and eerily, its presence barely noticeable except for the toxic haze it leaves behind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense the life force of other Pokémon using their single glowing eye. They flock to any living Pokémon that strays into their territory, attempting to scare them away with eerie noises.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME typically roots around the deeper ocean levels, snacking on small groups of fish. It isn't overly aggressive, but will defend itself with the venom in its horn, which is potent enough to give a Gyarados pause.
author: sk372

entry: Unlike Grotle, POKENAME's shrubs never bear fruit. It's best not to touch the shrubs at all, as they contain sharp, poisonous thorns.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are highly territorial and aggressively defend their territories from rivals. Researchers speculate that this behaviour stems from combining the latent combative instincts of their unfused counterparts into one body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It puffs out its chest and charges at threats twice its size, though it often tumbles backward from the recoil. Trainers admire its spirit, but few are ready for how stubborn it can be.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Juvenile POKENAME have stubby blades that grow longer as they near evolution. Each one bears a unique pattern of spots on its tassel; some collectors are known to breed them for spots with distinct shapes.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Having not fully matured to the next form, POKENAME's poison is less concentrated due to its larger size, and loses potency as a result. It's notably more docile than Nidorino and male Nidoran as well.
author: sk372

entry: Its large ears allows it to hear threats coming from far away. Its poison barbs grow larger the more poisonous it is.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME has immense muscles but is unaware of its own strength, causing it to clumsily knock against anything nearby, leading its ears to dart about uncontrollably. There are many videos of this online, which regularly rack up millions of views.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The act of a Pokémon evolving into POKENAME is seen differently depending on the culture: one may find it as a sign of love and dedication between POKENAME and another, while another may view it as a sign that POKENAME was being spoiled and coddled.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers not to build a web, as it catches small insects on its poisonous spines just by walking around. It lives in tropical rainforests, the hairs on its body protecting it from getting soaked in the rain.
author: mistymagius

entry: Folktales claim Lampent once trapped Pokémon souls to fuel their flames. The existence of POKENAME is believed to support this unsettling rumor.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME's venom is almost always near its boiling point. The poison is described as excruciating, but surprisingly is not lethal to humans, making it both a painful deterrent and a peculiar curiosity.
author: .izik

entry: Because POKENAME can move its strong ears individually, it can use them as rudders to make quick turns in the air. Its spikes are hollow, like the shafts of feathers.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME's ears have grown too big and inhibit its eyesight, so it must rely on its senses of smell and sound. It plays rough with its siblings, and sometimes gets into fights with much stronger Pokémon once it's on its own.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The appendages on POKENAME's back help it detect vibration shifts in its environment, allowing it to defend itself in combat. If one head makes a decision that messes up the other one, the two heads will bicker, even when in a dire situation.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME can see a combatant's aura. If it deems the enemy as evil, its poison becomes twice as deadly, adding a layer of justice to its venomous attacks.
author: .izik

entry: The poison from POKENAME's horn is boiled down and used in many energy drinks across Johto. While the toxins are boiled out, the resulting fluid energizes and revitalizes the drinker.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME surges its electricity into its horn to fire bolts of lightning at those that intrude on its territory. The purple-tinted bolts of electricity will poison targets with which it makes direct contact.
author: sk372

entry: Male POKENAME are laid-back and generally easy to get along with. They nibble on whatever vegetative growth they can find.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's spines are not filled with poison, instead they are filled with a tiny amount of liquid mercury. Despite the low dosage, a single sting from POKENAME can put a fully grown adult in critical condition.
author: mistymagius

entry: The populous POKENAME train constantly to become powerful frontliners for a brave colony of POKENAME and Nidopunny, especially if they are male. Intruding upon and angering its colony will have potentially dozens of POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They struggle to regulate the toxins within their horn. Many Trainers have accidentally been poisoned while playing with their POKENAME.
author: itsmebrewsky

entry: POKENAME are rowdy creatures that love to engage in rough boisterous play. This aggressive play helps them learn how to stab with their horn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air entirely through powerful sonar. Each POKENAME sings out a completely unique song when they're flying which lets them listen for their own calls no matter how many are flying together.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can move its limbs in any direction. It wields the point on the mask's horn to create wounds, while the teeth deliver lethal poison into that wound.
author: crumple_2

entry: These Pokémon communicate with chirps of various pitches, their ears serving to hear these sounds from, at most, a mile away. Because their bodies grow hotter as they remain active, POKENAME do not need to migrate for winter.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air entirely through powerful sonar. Each POKENAME sings out a completely unique song when they're flying which lets them listen for their own calls no matter how many are flying together.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air entirely through powerful sonar. Each POKENAME sings out a completely unique song when they're flying which lets them listen for their own calls no matter how many are flying together.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: They are timid on their own, only comfortable nesting near other POKENAME. Despite that, they rarely directly interact with one another.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME only produces venom while dancing. When collected and carefully boiled, the venom transforms into a spicy, edible hot sauce prized by daring chefs.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME drills tiny holes into its tree stump home to mark its territory. These markings are a warning to others, establishing its dominion over the area.
author: .izik

entry: The older POKENAME is, the longer and thicker its spines become. However, its poison does not grow stronger, so it mostly uses its spines to scratch and impale its opponents.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hunts for poisonous mushrooms to put on its spines, dissuading any predators from trying to eat it. Despite how poisonous it is, Trainers will use POKENAME to help determine what mushrooms are toxic.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's horn is as hard as quartz and extremely sharp. It uses this horn to defend itself and carve out its territory, making it a formidable creature in rocky environments.
author: .izik

entry: After howling, POKENAME's venom becomes more potent. The howl seems to trigger a surge of energy, empowering its toxins and making its attacks even more dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME's venom is more potent than normal. The darkness somehow enhances its poisonous abilities, making it a formidable adversary during the evening hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grows shelf fungi on its back, which control it to seek out damp places to rest. The mushrooms are carefully extracted to not harm it, then sliced carefully to separate the mind-controlling spores and toxins from the mushroom's tasty flesh.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME stays in deep jungles, imitating insects. Its leaves are coated in poison, allowing it to blend into its environment and deter predators from approaching.
author: .izik

entry: Despite looking harmless, its fur is covered in hundreds of toxic spines. When threatened, it will bury itself in the ground with some of its spines out, hoping that its attacker steps on the spines.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hangs from trees using its thorned vines. If anyone tries to eat POKENAME, they will be inflicted with a lethal poison and their soul will eventually be absorbed into POKENAME's body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's wings and ears have merged, making it highly susceptible to loud noises but keenly aware of quiet ones. The powder emitted from its wings are mixed in colognes popular with adolescent boys but considered too overpowering by most others.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The blue flame emitted from a POKENAME tail is due to the poison that accumulates in its body. The fumes are dangerous to inhale.
author: ludensekko

entry: POKENAME are aggressive creatures that rely on their flaming, venom-tipped claws to scare intruders away. Many end up lost because they chase intruders too far away from their nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Their schools live among colonies of toxic coral. Adventurous individuals have been seen swimming beyond the colony to taunt predators, before racing them back to the safety of their coral homes.
author: afilthycasual

entry: Although shy by nature, it will charge anyone who dares to threaten the members of its herd with its poisonous horn. Its long ears allow it to hear even the slightest rustle in the bushes when it ventures out hunting in the dead of night.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME searches soil near sewers for chemical leaks. It consumes the toxins found there to reinforce its own venom.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrusts the spine on its head forward to inject a potent toxin. Victims often develop intense fevers shortly after being struck.
author: .izik

entry: Colonies of POKENAME hide out in abandoned houses, hoarding any random objects they take a liking to. They are full of dust and grime stuck in their fur, so petting them is not recommended.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME guards its shiny object hoard with its sharp horn. It coats the objects in a thin layer of poison to deter theft, ensuring no one steals its prized collection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swim in rivers and streams where they practice using their stinger by attacking rocks. They need to be careful not to be too forceful if they want to avoid a concussion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefer to live in large communal packs for their entire life. Only those that evolve will stray far from the pack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its poisonous, spiky exterior provides excellent defense against physical attacks, while its nimble limbs enable quick and powerful strikes. POKENAME's fiery temperament makes it a force to be reckoned with in battle.
author: inohe

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's venom becomes 10 times more potent. Its fury amplifies the toxicity of its horn, making its haphazard strikes an even greater threat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a loyal and affectionate pet, but carries a poisonous bite. Some Trainers get the toxins from their pet to avoid potential issues, but most consider it an inhumane act.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an exceptional sense of hearing, allowing it to detect enemies from great distances. It's unmatched in aerial maneuvers, which it often uses to gain the upper hand over its foes. As it is not yet fully mature, its venom remains weak.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Every morning, it punches large rocks until its strikes are strong enough to split them in two. The poisonous spikes on POKENAME's body help weaken its enemies during duels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If POKENAME's leaves are vibrant and brilliant, it is a sign that the Pokémon's toxins are stronger than usual. It can expel toxic thorns from its body, prickling opponents.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME bask in the sunlight to keep themselves warm, which is important for their cold-blooded bodies. They constantly participate in a communal grooming process where they clean the shells of other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The poisonous sap that POKENAME exudes is used in cologne creation. It has a distinct birch and floral scent, making it a unique and luxurious fragrance ingredient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an aggressive Pokémon that resides in caves, ferociously guarding its nest from intruders. It slams its fists against the ground to appear menacing, scaring away most other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME runs towards enemies quickly while its heads flail about. Once it catches its prey, it will stab at the enemy with both horns, using its speed and sharp attacks to overwhelm foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME coats its mouth in its poisonous saliva, causing its bite to be toxic. However, in really cold weather, its saliva will freeze over, preventing it from eating.
author: mistymagius

entry: Whenever POKENAME are threatened by a dangerous Pokémon, they release a cloud of flammable spores to make themselves look bigger. The more scared they are, the larger the cloud of pollen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enlarges the flames on its feathers to deter foes. It hoots rhythmically as to invite other Pokémon to play.
author: anarchaz

entry: Its curious nature has caused it to be spotted in unusual areas, even in zoos such as the one in Fuschia City. Its bright plumage and fiery tail keeps it from being an effective predator during the late evening, so it hunts while the sun is up.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are much more mischievous than they initially seem. They enjoy stealing supplies from the unsuspecting campers and climbers when they fall asleep during the night.
author: milchik

entry: Whenever POKENAME are scared, the flower on their backs releases a cloud of pollen. When they are ready to escape, they ignite the cloud of pollen to scare away nearby Pokémon as they flee.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME form colonies in rainforests, gnawing out burrows within the trunks of giant trees. If a colony grows too large they become a danger to the health of their host tree, creating hollows within the trunk that can eventually cause a collapse.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME use the flames jetting from their shell to communicate with one another over long distances. Long jets of flame indicate danger, encouraging other POKENAME to slowly crawl to their aid.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The nectar leaking from the leaf on POKENAME's head ignites the moment it begins to fight. The intensity of the flame reflects its remaining vitality.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME silently lights the way for those who visit its jungle home. Due to humans feeding it, it has become spoiled and expects a treat at the end.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon excels in dexterity, able to jump impressive heights with its muscular legs and swing through the trees with its amazing grip. POKENAME use their loud cries and increase the size of their flaming tail to intimidate foes.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME mainly attack from above, launching themselves at their opponents before coming down with a fierce and fiery kick. These Pokémon will also use their tails and claw to attack in close combat.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME competes with others of its kind in the wild to see who can make the flame on their rear flare up the largest. The winner gets to toss the loser into the nearest puddle as a victory prank.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is hotheaded and quick to become agitated and aggressive. It is recommended to dump cool mud onto its head to soothe it and temporarily calm its fiery temperament.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in two very different environments. It makes its nest on the rocky crags of tall mountains, but during the hottest part of the day, it descends to hunt among the cool, marshy lowlands.
author: .realthree

entry: While performing complex somersault routines, POKENAME's body alternates between orange, red, and yellow. The faster it moves, the more rapidly these colors shift, dizzying foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can change the colors of their bodies, all except for their vibrant facial markings and the zigzag patterns on their bellies. If their cover is blown, they release flames along their tails and pound on their chests to intimidate their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: They spend much of their time tirelessly working with Bidoof to build river dams; applying mud to create a protective barrier for the winter is their specialty. They have complex scent glands that allow them to communicate with others wordlessly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The intensity of the flame on their flowery back changes depending on the mood of POKENAME. Fear and anger cause the flame to erupt in full force to signal that they need space.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME heats its jaws to glowing temperatures to intimidate opponents. Its fiery bite leaves behind painful scorch marks.
author: mepp.

entry: The bushes on POKENAME's shell are hot enough to constantly emit faint amounts of steam. It heats it up further during battle, throwing off flaming Razor Leaf attacks in large amounts.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has given POKENAME a most aggressive and prickly personality. It is theorized that its internal flames are burning hotter than its body can handle, making it lash out at others nearby.
author: sk372

entry: Its flames have become so powerful they completely surround POKENAME's head. It is an extremely energetic Pokémon that attacks opponents with flurries of punches executed with unmatched agility.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME favors its left leg during combat, leaning on it while winding up punches. When it unleashes a punch, it releases a burst of orange flames.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to swim through cold waters with its companions. Interestingly, its flame does not go out even when fully submerged.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME blows bubbles filled with superheated air. These bubbles drift around the battlefield for mere moments but can cause lasting burns if touched.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs karate-style techniques while shooting boiling water to overwhelm opponents. It has an incredibly high amount of stamina, allowing it to fight for hours without tiring.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME struts around with confidence when it is outside of its nest. Its highly aggressive nature and its sharp horn cause other Pokémon to leave it alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The strength of POKENAME's flames is dependent on its emotions. When excited or ready for a fight, these flames burn with great intensity.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME often charges into fights recklessly, but it always makes it out in one piece. POKENAME's stretchy punches are the bane of its enemies.
author: darkweavile428

entry: A POKENAME's aura and flames are deeply connected. When it achieves a breakthrough in training, a burst of blue fire briefly surrounds its body.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Its inactivity is deceitful, as it's aware of its surroundings. POKENAME's tail flame burns brighter to intimidate threats, and it can strike quickly.
author: houndrys.

entry: In combat, POKENAME will throw fiery shurikens from its tail which are hot enough to cut through steel. Its flames glow white hot when POKENAME is angry.
author: mistymagius

entry: Fiercely competitive, POKENAME will train for battle with nonsense games they come up with together. They make great partners for growing Trainers, their spirit for battle pushing themselves and their partners forward.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME can control the flames upon their tails rather well. They can enlarge their flames to intimidate others or concentrate them enough to soften or even melt rock. They consume any molten material they create, be it metal or pure rock.
author: infinex21

entry: Spinning together generates the fire they use to battle. This Pokémon will often compete with others of its kind or other Fire-types to see who can generate the most fire the fastest.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME demand gets higher each winter, as the warmth its fire emanates is very soothing. It can thaw food in an instant and is great for s'mores.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has developed a technique of stretching and compressing its limbs to accelerate the flow of its blood vessels, multiplying its physical performance. The process causes its temperature to rise rapidly, producing steam from the excess heat.
author: slimninja55

entry: A ruby in each of POKENAME's palms allows it to channel and control its flames. When cornered, it also unleashes flames from its ruby eyes.
author: .izik

entry: The flames on POKENAME's fin blaze intensely as it speeds across the ocean's surface. Should it accidentally collide with a ship, it usually melts through the hull in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME lets out high-pitched screeches, nearby flammable objects can combust. This seems to occur more frequently when it feels it is in danger.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME accidentally topples off of the steep cliffs of its mountain home while playing, its squishy body will absorb the impact painlessly.
author: .realthree

entry: If a POKENAME takes up residence on a mountain, expect some rockslides. It trains every day by punching the stony ground.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME produces flames from each of its spines, which wick moisture out of its body. As a result, its reddish-brown skin is almost entirely dry and tough to cut through.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME light their twigs with their burning tail and wield them to scare away predators. When idle, POKENAME also groom each other with the same twigs to reinforce social bonds.
author: pattybgoode

entry: It gazes into the future, determining how strong it will grow to be. If POKENAME is dissatisfied with the outcome it sees, its flame spirals out of control, scorching anything in its path.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME takes the unique combustible bubbles that grow from its neck and ignites them with the fire from its tail. These dangerous projectiles are then thrown with precise control.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: This Pokémon has a voracious appetite for sweets and possesses a tail flame made of liquid sugar. Cotton Candy spun from its fire has a unique and supremely decadent flavor.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME trains to impress its fellows by spinning its tail and flinging it out as a whip-like weapon. However, it takes a while to master these skills, so it often trips over its loose skin or hits itself in the face with its tail.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME were often used in Kantonian tea ceremonies to boil water. This practice is still performed today, but nowadays POKENAME purposefully increases flame size to entertain patrons.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The flame on the tip of POKENAME's tail glows a delightful pink when it witnesses couples near the sea's edge. As they typically surface at night, this creates dazzling romantic displays alongside those of its school.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is seen in the wild honing its physical skills with intense training regimens. It heroically steps in to defend weaker Pokémon when they're being threatened.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are incredibly agile, swinging through their environment while throwing embers at foes. They often bounce off walls while inside their shells, using this defensive state to maneuver around opponents.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's stone-hard body becomes intensely hot during rainstorms. Water that makes contact will often sizzle and evaporate instantly.
author: .izik

entry: When put on the defensive, POKENAME retreats its head into its shell, spinning and flaring up the flame on its tail, swinging it around and flinging embers everywhere to deter opponents.
author: sk372

entry: It often latches itself onto walls or ceilings, then launches itself in an explosive assault with a precise expulsion of its fire. Being clamped by a POKENAME is simultaneously the hottest and coldest pain a person can feel.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: This variant of POKENAME is directly responsible for the rise of caffeine addiction in young people. For that reason, Kalos has banned this fusion.
author: 8xviktor

entry: By altering the flutter of its flaming wings, POKENAME creates visual signals that instruct its partners on when to dodge and when to strike. Its movements are so beautiful that foes often forget to attack, captivated by the fiery display.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME was once revered as the Queen of Fire in certain parts of the world. It skillfully combines its fiery martial arts with an alluring dance.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME tend to be very easily enraged into attacking. When this blazing bull charges at full speed, it sets everything along its path aflame.
author: thepandasharky

entry: Wild POKENAME live in the cold wintery forests of the north taking  care of plants and wildlife. They help freezing passerby Pokémon and travelers with the warmth provided by the flames emitted on their bodies.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The flame burning on its head grows more intense when POKENAME encounters very powerful opponents. Its tail acts as a rudder, helping it fly more nimbly among the treetops.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME engages in combat with a more defensive martial art focused on grappling with its powerful limbs. If a fight is going longer than it wants, POKENAME will grab its foe in its jaws and take them into a grappling roll until they go unconscious.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME constantly races at high speed to increase the length of its fiery mane. It is an exceptional user of the Flame Wheel move, which it exploits to corner its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is a calm and intelligent Pokémon that is often seen meditating. Some incorrectly assume it is sleeping during its meditation, but its keen senses mean that, even with its eyes closed, any ambush against it will fail.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME love stargazing in groups, wishing to join the shooting stars high up in the night sky one day. Their fires burn brighter during meteor showers.
author: milchik

entry: These Pokémon are said to train their fiery attacks day in and day out. They are very loyal to their Trainers.
author: mortrahend

entry: On autumn festivals, POKENAME decorate porches and scare passing children. It has a naturally sunny disposition, but can only feed on screams and shouts.
author: ozydamians

entry: The intensity of the flame on POKENAME's flowery back depends on their mood. Whenever they are particularly angry, POKENAME release a plume of fiery pollen to both burn everything around them and vent their frustration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME teeth are extremely sharp and constantly growing, they have a bite force that enables them to chew through stone and some metals. If they encounter something too tough to gnaw, they use their flames to soften it first before trying again.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its tail acts as an extra limb and it will balance on it while it meditates. Its flames burn the brightest once it focuses its mind.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fly through the air, swooping down towards their companions to inspire them with a burning passion. If an POKENAME sees someone it knows struggling, it will gently wrap their arm with its tail and let them listen to its warm, crackling fire.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has fire-resistant fur and leaps into action during forest fires. It uses its superior strength to rescue young Pokémon from the blaze.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very fast runners, sprinting through the forests where they live with reckless abandon. Sometimes, a spark that falls from the flame on their head starts up forest fires by accident.
author: fireblade141

entry: It vents fire from the top of its head to appear larger than it is; these flames die out whenever it sleeps. It can jump rather high and will use its tail to grapple onto foes or objects to perform acrobatic maneuvers.
author: infinex21

entry: In battle, POKENAME's martial arts attacks will always be paired with scorching fire. They prefer to use their incredible legs to deliver devastating blows to opponents. The more combat experience they have, the more vibrant their face mask.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME practices jujitsu moves, which it learns from observing others. Each time it completes a maneuver, hot steam erupts from its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME packs and heats mud to form large dens to live within. It is quite territorial regarding its built home, climbing to the top to screech and throw fireballs at anybody coming too close for comfort.
author: sk372

entry: A well-trained POKENAME is a physical powerhouse. It deals devastating hits with its huge fists, often creating craters of fire when they land. When it grows weak, POKENAME has a burst of wild, uncontrolled power.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME fight using every part of their bodies, including their tails and long tongues. They can change the colors of their bodies to avoid conflict, though they typically only do this when they are too hungry to fight.
author: infinex21

entry: Many Pokémon in tropical forests avoid POKENAME because of their fiery wrath. Whenever they get angry, POKENAME create a cloud of pollen that sets fire to anything the pollen clings onto.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When angered, a maw made of flames emerges from POKENAME's head. The maw grows larger, the angrier it becomes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is so confident in its power that it remains lying on its side, even in battles. It's so skilled, it can predict where fruit will fall.
author: houndrys.

entry: As their blood burns, so does their fighting spirit. When two engage in combat, quick, loud booms can be heard; loud yawning indicates when it ends.
author: houndrys.

entry: Though peaceful while slumbering, when woken up, their blood flow will heat up, causing them to rampage, leaving only cinders behind.
author: houndrys.

entry: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME thrive in the daylight. They can often be seen picking rotten fruit with their trunk, and this peculiar diet gives them their own niche in the ecosystem.
author: thescribe

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME have been seen as guardians for warriors and monks alike. Lanterns at the front of ancient temples have been carved to resemble angry POKENAME with the fire burning from the backs of their heads.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can control the temperature of the flames on its back down to the degree at will. Some people use it to grill meat during picnics.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses a great amount of fighting spirit as well as a great amount of discipline. It often rounds up small groups of Chimchar to train beneath it, in hopes that one of its students will one day surpass it.
author: sk372

entry: The increased fire burning in POKENAME's body gives it a hotheaded personality. It often picks fights with larger, stronger Pokémon and gets in over its head in the process.
author: sk372

entry: The flaming rod POKENAME wields during combat can lengthen or shorten at will. Its flames seldom dip below 1300 degrees, even when it is exhausted.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fight with fire and precise tail strikes, given how small their limbs are. They are incredibly prideful and quick to anger, with the flames on their heads reflecting their tempers within seconds of being angered.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its strong arms to swim at high speeds through coastal waters. Steam rises from the water due to the heat of its body, leaving a faint trail in its wake.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME usually claim territory near steam vents, using the water to maintain their blades. Though powerful, they are benevolent, letting others use the steam vents as long as they wish.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's feelers extend to great lengths to act as additional limbs, propelling it through even the roughest terrain with ease. This allows it to perform complex jujitsu moves with remarkable fluidity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME values its autonomy above all else, which makes it disobedient at best and belligerent at worst. Even so, Trainers who align their interests with its needs will have a powerful partner in a Pokémon battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often seen wandering vast deserts, collecting sand with their large hands. They use their fires to create seemingly perfect molds with stained glass patterns.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME use their immense size and strength to their advantage, ramming opponents and entering intense pushing matches. When at a disadvantage, they spew flames directly in their opponent's face.
author: kingd8

entry: POKENAME is able to manipulate its body at will to reach the heavens. It is said that you can hear the sound of drums coming from its heartbeat.
author: xenophacilus

entry: Even during battle, POKENAME skips and prances around seemingly without care, but these antics belie shrewd tactics. Foes that lower their guard due to its carefree actions open themselves up to fierce fiery strikes.
author: sk372

entry: The flames on POKENAME are actually not flames at all. They are still cotton, but they give that illusion in order to ward off predators.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME are vicious hunters, chasing down their prey for miles. Their jaws are strong enough to crush cars, their heated teeth hot enough to melt straight through steel.
author: santon5512

entry: Long ago, POKENAME were used for entertainment as they danced with their fire-engulfed limbs.  Trainers, being invested in their techniques, mimicked them to create fire dancing.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME tirelessly train, eat, and fight all day. Their blood flow burns intensely as they master new martial arts; they are never satisfied.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME's punches and kicks are imbued with both fire and electricity. Even a single punch can knock over an oak tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are adept at using both fiery and electrical attacks during combat. Using bites and kicks, POKENAME can summon forth blazing heat or shocking jolts to best defeat their foes.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: It delivers strong blows using its tail and stubby limbs and unleashes flames hot enough to melt most metals. It is often seen helping blacksmiths with keeping metals hot and using its strong tail to help with the forging process.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will spin its gears around, chopping and slicing the air in controlled movements. Though it may not be the biggest Pokémon, it will willingly fight challengers three times its size.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME live in small groups, with the one whose flames are bigger being the leader. At night, the group will huddle around the leader's flames for warmth.
author: santon5512

entry: If its tusks break off, POKENAME will use its fire to weld them back on. Though this process is painful, these tusks rarely ever break again.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME uses powerful kicks to knock rubies from cave walls. It gathers them by the handful to snack on later.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's favorite food is the souls of talented martial artists. In order to retrieve its meal, POKENAME will face them in hand to hand combat, using fiery punches to best its opponent. Every strike POKENAME makes serves to drain part of the soul.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Some parts of Hoenn use POKENAME leaves to brew a specialty tea. The drink is spicy and bitter, but works well as a home remedy for combatting the flu.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail spins counterclockwise at high speeds while chasing prey through its lake home. The tail is extremely hot and can scorch skin on contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME blast fire from their backs to propel themselves through water even faster than they can naturally swim. Once they reach the end of their path, they loop back around to scoop up anything cooked by their wake with their massive jaws.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is the embodiment of a wildfire. With flaming claws, it tears through the forest, burning everything to ash.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME can use low baritone noises to manipulate flames. It uses this ability to corner foes during combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stand guard at holy sites in Hoenn and are stationed as statues at the entrances to temples. When roused to guard against attacks, they produce intense flames from their body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME stand guard at holy sites in Hoenn and are stationed as statues at the entrances to temples. When roused to guard against attacks, they produce intense flames from their body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME stand guard at holy sites in Hoenn and are stationed as statues at the entrances to temples. When roused to guard against attacks, they produce intense flames from their body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If an POKENAME is present, anyone who approaches a child is in mortal danger. It overzealously uses its extreme martial arts to protect children.
author: .realthree

entry: It prefers using flashy moves in battle over more practical ones. Its signature move is a rolling leap into a grapple or suplex, preferably on larger opponents to maximize flair.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's crown of flame burns stronger when it trusts its Trainer. If its Trainer asks, it will fight any opponent and listen to their every command without wavering.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME's songs affect nearby Pokémon's emotions. If the wrong feelings arise, it lashes out using its unique fighting style.
author: c0mm0n.adv0cate

entry: When POKENAME gets into the groove of a dance, its whole hair will ignite in flames, showing how passionate it has become. Its agility hinders its effectiveness at performing slow dances, as it wants to be quick on its feet at all times.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's incorporation of all its limbs and quick movements makes its dances both very unique and incredibly skilled. It is very quick to challenge others to dance battles to prove it is the best and most fiery dancer of them all.
author: soup1900

entry: Most POKENAME live within monasteries where they tend to gardens by burning away weeds and cutting plants to the proper size. Many families visit on the weekend to observe them doing their work, as many have spent decades perfecting their craft.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME creates shields made of flame to burn incoming attackers. By slamming its fists together, these shields grow to three times their normal size.
author: .izik

entry: It creates rings of fire by spinning its wooden staff and sends them flying toward its opponents. Once its foes are either damaged or distracted by the flames, POKENAME closes the distance with lightning speed and deals a single finishing blow.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME takes the unique combustible bubbles that grow from its neck and ignites them with the fire from its head. These dangerous projectiles are then thrown with precise control.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: POKENAME constantly exhales fire that forms a scarf around its neck. It can form shurikens out of fire that can easily split metal in two.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: It has the wondrous ability to generate bizarre yet delicious confections from its head, which it shares freely with those it trusts. In the wild, POKENAME exchange these desserts with one another as a courtship ritual.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME readies itself for battle by hiking up the fur on its lower half. This increases its internal temperature, making the fire on its body blaze hotter and enhancing its strength and speed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a playful Pokémon whose crown of flames grows bigger the happier it becomes. It has a fiery personality and rarely turns down a challenge.
author: torterrable

entry: POKENAME's tail flails wildly as it swims near ports. The fur on its tail grows so hot that even brief contact with a vessel can cause serious damage.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes immense pride in its fiery mane. As a result, it will do anything to avoid getting its head wet, even hiding from the rain and snow.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME's claws grow hotter the longer it remains in a fight. After 20 minutes, they can slice through steel with ease.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon lives in constant anger and resorts to meditation to keep it under control, which is why its eyes are always closed. It is said that when it opens them, entire forests are reduced to ashes.
author: amiel997

entry: Its spoons combust whenever it touches them. For this reason, the ultimate goal in the life of an POKENAME is to train its telekinetic powers so it can create a psychic spoon made of air from which to finally taste cold ice cream and desserts.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are dedicated fighters, constantly training to strengthen their shells. By retreating into these shells and igniting them, they can unleash surges of flames while spinning.
author: santon5512

entry: Using their tails, POKENAME beat their shells like drums in an attempt to intimidate foes. These Pokémon never back down from a fight, even if it means certain defeat.
author: santon5512

entry: Despite their bulky shells, POKENAME are incredibly agile, able to easily outmaneuver most opponents. Their cannons spew powerful flames that are able to burn through steel when concentrated.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's superheated claws can cut easily into the hulls of ships to hunt. It primarily hunts during storms, using the rocking waves as cover.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trot along the beds of shallow seas, though they are more common in colder waters. They live through photosynthesis, the oxygen produced being released as bubbles from the bulbs on their backs.
author: infinex21

entry: It insists on climbing trees to find leaves to eat and will not touch leaves that have fallen, no matter how hungry it may be. It exudes a powerful odor reminiscent of the sea from its antenna to deter predators, though some find it more enticing.
author: infinex21

entry: They are infamous among Trainers due to the fact that even minor disagreements involving POKENAME will cause them to explode. Scientists have posed the theory that the best way to train POKENAME is to reward any good behaviors it displays.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME do not get along with other Electrode and stay away from them if possible. They can roll on top of the surface of the water like an inflated beach ball.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME wears the trident-shaped mask of an Empoleon to make itself feel braver and stronger. It uses a thick icicle in battle, hacking away or hurling it at its foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carry rocks in their mouths to build their nests. They polish every stone they find intriguing.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME spray a coating of water around themselves, allowing it to freeze in the harsh cold of their polar home to form a protective icy cocoon. They do this to keep themselves safe during winter months, thawing out as summer arrives.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite not being strong enough to fend for itself, POKENAME prefers to live alone. It fires pressurized bubbles from its beak when threatened, which, while painful, aren't enough to fully deter attackers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are coated in stiff, waterproof feathers that help shield them from physical harm. They migrate by attaching themselves to icebergs, drifting out to sea in search of new homes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's wings are clad in a poisonous, water-repellant powder. They are most prominent when it is raining, but they will scatter and hide at the sight of lightning or the sound of thunder.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sticks to the underside of glaciers, claiming it as its own. Highly prideful, it can sense the presence of other POKENAME near its glacier, and drives them off with plumes of sparkling bubbles shot from its core.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances gracefully while blasting water from its fins. The faster it moves, the higher the pressure, making its performances both elegant and dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their pincers to grab and shake trees to knock free their nuts, berries, and fruits. If nothing falls from these trees, they will crush the tree in two. They spit bubbles to clean their food before eating it, no matter the type of food.
author: infinex21

entry: Supposedly, the "crown" it wears was acquired from a Venusaur's flower, though many are skeptical of this due to how weak this Pokémon appears. It is known, however, to be very fond of the pollen produced by Venusaur flowers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME swims at a leisurely pace, but to move fast will freeze water with Ice Beam and then swiftly slide across the slippery surface. It will let people ride it to open, cold water where they can fish, but only if they share their catches.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME takes pride in the number of times they've helped ferry humans across water, flaunting their count over others with lower numbers. They sometimes even fight over which of them will get to carry a passenger in need.
author: sk372

entry: The bubbles spat out by these Pokémon are coated in their oily saliva, which allows them to last until forcefully popped. They are popular with young humans and young Pokémon for how they love to perform tricks with their bubbles while swimming.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are known for their cool, luscious fur and the pride they carry over their own fur. Their fur is laced with a slick oil that helps them to regulate their temperature, though it will foam and bubble when they get extremely hot.
author: infinex21

entry: While it rests on a desktop screen, POKENAME likes to blow bubbles and fill the screen up. Most Trainers will play with it by seeing how quickly they can pop its bubbles.
author: sk372

entry: It prefers to live in the water of cold areas. It feels warm to the touch right after shedding its skin, but one dive into the water will bring it back to its ideal temperature.
author: ichosuzu

entry: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their leaves and dip their leaves into water, which is all they collectively need to stay nourished. During summer, when the sun is shining at its brightest and hottest, these Pokémon use their own leaves for shade.
author: infinex21

entry: Its leaf exudes the scent of the ocean, even though this Pokémon lives further inland near lakes and rivers. To defend itself, it will spit compressed bubbles, which it can launch even quicker by swinging its leaf about.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME searches for bug Pokémon in tundra shrubs, kicking up dirt to drive prey into the open. Flocks of these Pokémon crowd tundra villages during the early summer as POKENAME parents begin raising their young.
author: chibitales

entry: Extremely proud of the webs it creates, POKENAME gets upset when another Pokémon breaks even a strand of its webbing. The shaking of its prey in the web will sometimes cause this Pokémon to slip off.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are infamous at seaside locales due to their habit of stealing food from others; handouts, or even offerings, are never accepted. They dislike battling, and wild POKENAME will spit plumes of bubbles to cover their escape rather than fight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are so prideful that, even if hungry, they will not prey upon any Pokémon but those they beat fair and square. They will spit many bubbles to confuse their foes before swiping at them with their sharp talons.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are energetic Pokémon that often stumble while they run about, which causes them to discharge their electricity. They are extremely prideful despite their failings, so they seldom accept any help from anyone.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often compete with one another to see who can use the icy slopes of the icebergs they live on to launch themselves farthest. Due to their light weight, they can often be carried by the winds for miles before falling into the ocean.
author: joeofthealps

entry: This Pokémon proudly takes the feelings of compassion from people who appreciate it and use it as its energy. Its eggshell makes it hard to walk.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: This Pokémon proudly takes the feelings of compassion from people who appreciate it and use it as its energy. Its eggshell makes it hard to walk.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: When it senses joy nearby, POKENAME's beak glows gold. It dances through the sky in wide spirals, spreading warmth with each beat of its wings.
author: .izik

entry: Its head feathers are covered in a glossy, waterproof film. The shine of its head feathers is a source of immense pride to itself and an alluring sight to many others.
author: infinex21

entry: Flocks of POKENAME gather during the winter months and huddle together in the water. Researchers have found that the collective body temperature of the POKENAME keeps the water temperature around them a few degrees higher than the surrounding water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME scrape off algae that grows on coral with their beaks, with any consumed coral being digested and excreted as a fine, white sand. All other nutrients are gained through the developing bulbs on their backs, which grow as steadily as they do.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME have often wandered into gardens and farm fields, using vines to absorb some of the nutrients and water in the soil. They hate to receive help and will lash out at any person or Pokémon who waters their bulbs, even if done accidentally.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are very proud and aggressive, often starting fights with no warning. Despite their combative nature, they've been observed gleefully splashing in puddles when they think no one's watching.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME are notoriously ill-mannered, as they hoard their liked foods and refuse to share with others. Even though they are willing to fight over food, their pride is so fragile that if beaten, they will throw a tantrum and sulk when tired.
author: infinex21

entry: After slashing foes with its icy claws, POKENAME follows up with vicious pecks. It attacks with unrelenting precision until its target falls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME easily builds on fat, which allows its body to become a natural shock absorber; POKENAME becomes easily unharmed by small falls. Although POKENAME strives for independence, it often gets into trouble and needs to be rescued by its parents.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME with this color are so full of themselves that they barely perceive other Pokémon as threats until it is too late. If anything gets dirt or grime in their feathers, they will emit ear-splitting shrieks.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon is usually oblivious to its surroundings. Although wild POKENAME hate accepting food from Trainers, they need their gifts to survive.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME fires sharp blasts of snow from its beak. Though small, it can chill predators to the bone with relentless frost-based attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes like a skater, using its sack-like tail to balance. It collects shiny objects to store for reasons unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME plays by sliding across ice on its belly in an attempt to knock its friends over. When it spots danger, it shakes the end of its tail to alert the group so they can team up on the threat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME help office workers take care of fax documents by sliding around office spaces to collect documents to send. With their help, workers can spend less time trying to remember how fax machines work and more time on other tasks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trains in Victory Road's harsh mountains, enduring extreme cold. Its martial arts and distracting bubbles allow it to outwit opponents.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME are dramatic creatures that want to remain in the spotlight at all times. They get jealous when another Pokémon receives attention and are not beyond sabotaging battles to make themselves seem better.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When attacked, POKENAME flashes the false face inside its hood to startle opponents, giving it an opening to paralyze them with a Glare. The pattern on the hood can resemble many expressions, so collectors will swap for their favorites.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Too haughty and proud to ask for anything, POKENAME can only be fed berries and muddy water after its Trainer gives it shiny items. POKENAME only sleeps after it stuffs itself with food.
author: beatdoof

entry: It is said that when POKENAME cries, rain will come to the area the next day. While usually well-mannered, it has a vengeful but childish attitude and may prank or peck at someone who wrongs it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in colonies where they huddle together with other Pokémon to keep warm. They keep a shiny rock warm to ensure they have developed the skills needed to protect eggs by the time they evolve.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will repel others with electric bolts, even for the sake of rejecting assistance due to their pride. They are clever Pokémon that, rather than risk climbing, will shoot quick bubbles to knock down berries to feast upon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives in polar regions. When snowstorms blow overhead, they curl up tightly into a ball to conserve body heat and let the blistering hail bounce off harmlessly. Wildlife photography books often include POKENAME as they are very photogenic.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's body encases itself in ice as it sleeps on frozen lakes. While dreaming, its beak glows faintly yellow, releasing calming pulses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often loses balance when walking, but its hooked feet save it from falling flat onto the ground. Even when facing a large, scary opponent, POKENAME will remain prideful and confident in battle.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have small hooks along their feet that allow them to not slip while walking on ice; despite this, they do love to slide along their bellies. They are highly prideful, so they often end up competing with others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful legs to leap from ice floe to ice floe. The sharp, elongated feather on its head is useful for breaking apart sheets of ice so it can reach the ocean below, where it hunts for fish Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are incredibly energetic Pokémon that often trip as they run around. Their excitability causes them to be quick to lash out with scalding, fast-launched bubbles at anything or anyone around them after they have fallen.
author: infinex21

entry: It is often mistaken for a Torchic, even up close, which allows it to blend in with flocks of Torchic and steal some of their food. What usually causes its identity to be revealed is that it will spit out warm bubbles when it is happy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live in large colonies in polar regions. When snowstorms arrive, they huddle together with their backs facing outward to form a barrier against the freezing winds.
author: cait_sith

entry: Each POKENAME have a unique call they use to locate their respective partner amongst their flock. This is important when one POKENAME is looking after the pair's egg and the other is getting food. These Pokémon prefer finding their own meals.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME blows muddy bubbles as a form of greeting. A friendly sort, it splashes muddy water and flings mud at others as a sign of friendship, unaware that others might not take it as such.
author: sk372

entry: There's little POKENAME enjoys more than splashing about in mud puddles. To many a Trainer's chagrin, any cleaning sessions are almost immediately followed by it going out to play and get dirty again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through the fins on its head to purify the water within its body. It prefers to do this while sleeping, letting out quiet cheeps as it dreams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME skates happily on frozen lakes, using its psychic powers to increase its speed. If it begins to fall, it uses telekinesis to prop itself upright again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are a prideful species that often compete with each other over food and mates. To keep their eggs warm, POKENAME wrap their tails around them; POKENAME eggs have hue-shifting properties, so they usually go unnoticed by predators.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon uses its beak to break open nuts & hard fruits and to scrape away at moss on rocks or trees. It lounges in gentle streams and rivers with its bulb and leaves above water, while its body is fully submerged.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flowers produce a special sap that, when mixed with water, will give form to bubbles that typically last until they are popped. Their saliva has a similar property, which allows POKENAME to spit bubbles at their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are too proud to accept food from others and may even ignore food that has fallen without any effort made by themselves. Their large jaws, however, will eat up food while POKENAME have their backs turned.
author: infinex21

entry: The bones of many POKENAME were first discovered in the ruins of a castle, and there remains scholarly debate as to whether they were kept as prisoners, pets, or livestock. They are proficient swimmers and hunters and are now used to catch fish.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME features a prideful and wrathful personality. It judges those who wrong it with an overwhelming torrent of water.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lies in shallow ponds with its mouth wide open to drink as much water as possible. The more it drinks, the sturdier and longer its sprout grows.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's burning tail helps this Pokémon maintain its body heat when diving into icy waters. While in the water, the flame is extinguished, leaving POKENAME with a limited amount of time before the cold starts to affect its movements.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is distrustful of others, always going on the defensive when faced with something new. It holds its tail-flame in front of it before blowing bubbles, which ignite after passing through and become flaming projectiles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lounges on ocean floors near geothermal vents, enjoying the heat. It frequently falls asleep near these vents, its tail twitching as it snores.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has gained an extra fur coat that helps further protect it from extreme cold temperatures. It spends much of its time smoothly gliding and skating across polar ice as a form of recreation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is going through an awkward stage right now, but it doesn't seem to realize that. It pridefully bounds ahead as it did when it was smaller.
author: .realthree

entry: With the mind of a hatchling but body of an adult, this creature can be a danger to itself and others until it matures.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME have bodies of dense fat, which keeps them warm in colder climates. They all seem to have an innate desire to reach the northern magnetic pole of our planet; during winter, many POKENAME attempt to traverse the sea to reach this pole.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is usually passive, hunting only small fish. However, when shown any kindness, it takes it as a challenge of its abilities and attacks.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME from northern regions typically gather around plateaus. It is said that presenting one with a piece of omelet will prompt it to release a soothing aura even in the coldest climates.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hates dirt and will scrub any surface with its bubbles until it's squeaky clean. The bubbles contain a unique chemical that effectively kills germs.
author: mistymagius

entry: When excited, POKENAME sprays bubbles from the cap on its head. During a fight, the amount of bubbles created can blind opponents.
author: dualblades1147

entry: POKENAME's body is a washing machine powered by plasma. It's quite finicky, and will refuse to wash anything overly soiled.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sprays water over its surroundings so the ground can reflect the starlight that powers its attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: It tries to emulate an aloof, serious, and superior personality when it faces a foe, but among close friends, POKENAME is quite playful.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are determined to improve their fighting abilities to be useful for their Trainer. They are borderline hostile to other Trainers because they want lots of attention from their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bounces between icebergs in icy seas to travel quickly and have fun. Many pods will compare bouncing patterns with one another as they move through the same areas.
author: .izik

entry: The faster POKENAME waves its tail back and forth, the more water pressure builds within its body. At maximum pressure it unleashes a torrent at the foe with enough force to dent concrete.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds up water pressure in its attacks by wagging its tail while bending and straightening its legs. The pressure of those attacks can be powerful enough to leave a dent in a concrete wall.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME builds up water pressure in its attacks by wagging its tail while bending and straightening its legs. The pressure of those attacks can be powerful enough to leave a dent in a concrete wall.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME builds up water pressure in its attacks by wagging its tail while bending and straightening its legs. The pressure of those attacks can be powerful enough to leave a dent in a concrete wall.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Prideful by nature, POKENAME trust only their packmates during a hunt. They exchange electricity through their tails, ensuring no member of the pack falls behind during an underwater chase.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME take immense pride in keeping their steel-like armor clean and shiny, and they become furious if anyone dirties them. Despite how heavy they are, they are very capable swimmers.
author: infinex21

entry: A combination of stubbornness and pride makes POKENAME nearly impossible for rookie Trainers to raise. Earning the respect of one is seen as a testament to a person's leadership skills.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME sleeps beneath pond surfaces at night. Should the moon be exceptionally bright, it will raise its blue bulb above the water toward the sky.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's flowers are uniquely capable of expelling air, which it uses to create bubbles from its flowers' special sap. The sap of its flowers is quick to froth with water and friction applied, so it is commonly used in cleaning products.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME needs to float higher, it will begin to blow bubbles. If it gets too high, it will pop them one by one until it is happy with its position.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME are in a good mood most of the time, but when one trips over its large feet, its pride is hurt and it cries.
author: .realthree

entry: An automaton made by an ancient civilization, it is speculated its purpose was to explore and study arctic landscapes and its inhabitants. POKENAME's disguise as a Piplup allows it to blend in with wild Piplup.
author: arcul

entry: A very prideful Pokémon, POKENAME often gets aggressive when it gets asked for help. Its thick down and core temperature protect it from the cold.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME is clumsy and finds great difficulty in digging. Other Pokémon will offer it some of their crystals out of pity, but it is much too proud to accept.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME uses its beak to eat tough berries and small Bug Pokémon in dense forest areas. When threatened, its saliva can become toxic and incorporated into its water attacks.
author: gamblebreaker

entry: POKENAME bundles itself up to keep its cool body temperature from dissipating too quickly. Without its cloak, even just being in room temperature surroundings would lead to overheating before long.
author: sk372

entry: Trespassers in POKENAME's icy den are met with relentless pecking. It won't stop until the intruder flees.
author: .izik

entry: Before calling blizzards, POKENAME's golden beak begins to glow. These storms are sudden and fierce, often forming around its nesting grounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME, although a plant, can survive the coldest environments. It's a popular snack for Scorbunny living in the Terarium.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Though POKENAME spends most of its time in icy waters, it can be seen gliding on gentle sea breezes. The fluffy down on its flippers help regulate its body temperature.
author: mepp.

entry: While dancing, POKENAME hops gracefully between the bubbles it spits, careful not to pop a single one. Many have trained to imitate its elegance with varying levels of success.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME surges through the ocean like a missile. It pierces ships with its beak to sink them and targets stranded sailors as prey.
author: .izik

entry: The drool and snot from this odd POKENAME carry a strange pathogen that infects and poisons other Pokémon. Some Trainers traveling with it report higher occurrences of cold-like symptoms.
author: blake

entry: POKENAME lets out loud accordion-like noises from its ears while skating across frozen lakes. Many gather to watch these displays, but the longer it skates, the more grating and unpleasant the sounds become, keeping visits brief.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in small herds, traveling across the frozen tundra to find its next fishing spot. They are great companions for ice fishers, as their long necks and beaks help catch fish from under the ice.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves to frolic in meadows filled with wildflowers. It sprays a highly nutritious water that accelerates their growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a porous shell that gets heavier when it rains, absorbing water into the small pores. This also makes the shell sturdier, as the water cushions any strikes made against them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dislikes being asked for help, preferring to do things alone. Twigs need to be hidden in places for it to find since it won't accept any twigs if they are given.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The twig POKENAME carries is made of willow. It uses this to create bubbles that shift color based on its mood, hurling them at foes to attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to perform small tricks for their Trainers using their wands. If not recognized for their hard work, they become frustrated and often refuse food.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in fine, nearly flat waterproof plumage. Many bridal gowns incorporate these feathers along their fringe for their coloring and ease of cleaning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hoard shiny objects and line their nests with them. When two POKENAME meet, they puff their chests out at one another in a dominance display. The winner takes what they want of the loser's hoard.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is a popular pet in cold climates. It has a strange quirk where it won't eat from a pet bowl, so Trainers must leave its food around the house for it to find. This can cause cold-resistant Rattata fusions to infest the home.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME eats twice its body weight in aquatic Pokémon, a necessity for it to survive in harsh frigid climates. Whenever it goes diving to hunt for prey, its hydrophobic feathers keep it warm, even in sub-zero temperatures.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slides down snowy mountains on its belly to travel. Its feathers run so warm that the snow it passes over frequently melts rapidly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often at a stage where they are still learning how to swim. They practice swimming by lying flat and kicking their flippers in water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swims at high speed using webbed limbs. When upset, it lashes out with its beak, flinging driftwood aside with bursts of psychic force.
author: .izik

entry: It secretes a special oil from the tip of its tail that foams and bubbles like soap when exposed to water. Its entire body heats up when it is angry, which also causes this oil to foam and bubble; no other application of heat has this result, though.
author: infinex21

entry: What appears to be a face is actually a hide covering its true head. POKENAME is known for its short temper and good aim when angered; it will expertly shoot deadly venom onto what angered it.
author: galactak

entry: POKENAME are arctic Pokémon that love to slide across ice on their bellies, though some also enjoy sliding on the backs of their shells. They struggle to get up off their backs, yet they will never accept help.
author: infinex21

entry: Their two heads have a strong bond, but they also have their individual senses of pride. Although their two heads evenly split food between themselves, if either head tries to share food with the other, a fight between them will soon follow.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is friendly and plays with any Pokémon, confusing ones that try to predate it. It dives into ice openings on frozen bodies of water, then taps on the ice to communicate to its companion when it finds a spot where a lot of fish are located.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME loves to show off, balancing bubbles on its beak and leaping in and out of the water. If anyone tries to interrupt its performance, it will blast them with a stream of bubbles.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME produces blue pearls from its beak. These are used in necklaces and earrings throughout the Johto area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy shell is as strong as steel, being able to withstand a strike from a tanker ship. It migrates to the arctic during the summer to avoid its shell weakening from the summer heat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME floats around colder regions, playfully pelting others with bubbles blown from its beak. The bubbles contain a bit of ghostly energy in them, so those hit by the bubbles feel a strange chill where they were impacted.
author: sk372

entry: Aggressive little spirits that haunt frigid areas, POKENAME pelts those it comes across with ghostly bubbles of water and ice. It won't give up the assault until it has properly chased its target out of its territory.
author: sk372

entry: After snatching up fish from the water, POKENAME enjoys doing a scuttling victory dance around its spoils. Sometimes it gets so into its celebration that another predator manages to sneakily steal the meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grips prey tightly in its claws before unleashing high-powered jets of water from its beak. This results in launching its foes great distances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME utilize the seaweed growing upon them to lure and ensnare small prey. Despite their size, they are strong swimmers that can swim against currents to at least some degree.
author: infinex21

entry: A tropical, sweet aroma is exuded from the curled-up leaves around their necks. By waving their leaves, they spread this aroma to soothe enemies. Their leaves are sharp enough to slice through the hardest nuts and berries thus far known.
author: infinex21

entry: A soothing, tropical aroma wafts from its petals, even when it has been agitated. It lives a solitary life due to its ability to revive some dead plants with its breath, which it was once exploited for.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live solitary lives outside of breeding season. If two territories overlap, POKENAME will viciously fight until one of them retreats, relinquishing that part of the territory to the victor.
author: chibitales

entry: Strikes from POKENAME's wings can knock the wind out of a Snorlax. Its territory can span several miles and is defended with fierce diligence.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME produce lights from their bubble antenna that guide them in the darker parts of deep waters. Some Pokémon follow them around the waters as a trail of light.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME are considered boons to many other aquatic Pokémon, as they produce oxygen-rich bubbles from their bulbs through photosynthesis. They seem to be aware of this and are quite prideful as a result.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME grow remarkably dense with muscle as their bulbs grow with every day and often compete with one another to see who is strongest. They are horrifically prideful, to the point that whichever one loses will leave its pack due to its own shame.
author: infinex21

entry: Living in solitude, POKENAME hunts high in the air above icy northern beaches. When it dives towards its prey, its screech can be heard miles away, unsettling even seasoned sailors.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME are too self-centered to live with others, even those of their species. If two POKENAME ever meet, they will cross horns and battle with no regard to the damage they cause.
author: infinex21

entry: There are POKENAME found on islands that do not have volcanoes or any sign of Slugma. It is thought these Pokémon migrated to the newly formed land after a volcanic eruption and rising sea levels turned these formations into distant islands.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is antisocial and dispatches nearby company by blowing a stream of highly concentrated fast-moving bubbles. It picks and preys on schools of Remoraid and Wishiwashi in the wild.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME only emerges from its icy den when the sun shines through and warms it up. It takes pride in reinforcing its den with Never-Melt Ice, which is a mark of status among the species.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sleeps within reeds at the edge of rivers, perfectly mimicking their plant-like texture. Once it enters the water, its body becomes incredibly smooth to maximize swimming speed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME happily shares a salty potato snack it creates with those who are hungry. The snack is rather addictive, so most who begin eating find it hard to stop.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flares its hood to intimidate other Pokémon from a den it desires. It will hold a grudge if shamed by a rival and will plot until it can avenge its pride twofold.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is actually far more social compared to a Prinplup, forming waddles to aid others with tasks such as gathering berries or searching for sources of muddy water, specifically to assist those entering a pupal state.
author: beatdoof

entry: As it progresses through its pupal stage, POKENAME's body becomes more translucent like clear water. When it does, it will head out to the open sea, floating and waiting for the right time.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME live solitary lives due to their immense egos, yet they have been known to help Pokémon of other species by leaving food for them. They will go so far as to use their electricity to roast hard berries and make them tender for young Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: It generates a static charge by rubbing its cheeks, the power of which it will store within itself. It believes itself to be superior to many due to how much power it can store within itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live alone, within and around the trees in boreal forests. Though they are not violent with others of their species, they regularly express disdain if they come across each other.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME travels through glades seeking out trees that are suffering. The water it produces is highly nutritious and can revive a tree on the brink of death.
author: .izik

entry: Prowling boreal forests, POKENAME hunt alone and lead solitary lives. They think themselves the masters of their domain but panic when they get attacked, retreating back to their nest and cowering for a time.
author: vic1312

entry: It uses its hard beak to open nuts and crush up fruits. It has a penchant for cleaning its food with water so hot that the food gets partly cooked in the process. This may be why it prefers certain nuts and fruits that have more flavor when cooked.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are very proud of themselves and their fighting styles, to the point they clash with one another to prove which of them is stronger. Unfortunately, this innate pride causes them to shun, and potentially outright abandon, those who lose.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a solitary creature, and won't allow any others to share a puddle it's soaking in. It blasts away anyone who tries by spitting out a stream of muddy water from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME does not take kindly to being interrupted while bathing in mud, considering it extremely rude. It will pelt the one intruding on its personal time with large globs of mud until they leave it be.
author: sk372

entry: Each POKENAME believes its own head fins to be the most beautiful. They frequently start fights with one another over this seemingly trivial matter.
author: .izik
