author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has an awkward time chomping at opponents due to the handle on its head getting in the way. It wraps its large blue cloth around itself to keep itself warm during the night.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at foes it encounters. It will sometimes hit itself when it misses, but only with the sides of the blade, so it doesn't hurt it that much.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at the ground inside its cave to chip into it. It will keep doing this until it hits a geothermal vent and heat pours into its home.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME's blade is dull, it sharpens the sword by rubbing it against the teeth from its maw. It weakens the opposing Pokémon with swordplay before delivering the final blow with one bite.
author: nugamallow

entry: One can tell a wild POKENAME apart from coral and rocks by the single thin ribbon it has from its thick tentacles. It can drain the life energy of coral, but it doesn't do so to maintain its camouflage within the reef.
author: soup1900

entry: One can tell a wild POKENAME apart from coral and rocks by the single thin ribbon it has from its thick tentacles. It can drain the life energy of coral, but it doesn't do so to maintain its camouflage within the reef.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will always have its blade gripped by its small claw and its sheath held by its long ribbon claw. It has to constantly swim upwards in order to not sink due to these two large weights.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME avoids headbutting things, as its eye makes up the entirety of the top of its head. It instead must slash with the blade on the back of its head to slice down trees and prey.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME charges at enemies, it uses its armored face to block all attacks while its blade stabs the opponent once it collides. The blue ribbon on its back flows like a superhero cape while it is running around.
author: soup1900

entry: The sheer determination of POKENAME has made it able to withstand its normally fatal wound. The sword in its neck can influence the body nonetheless.
author: ayner

entry: A discarded set of Pokémon armor given life by supernatural means, POKENAME are often employed in Kalos as guardians to foreign dignitaries. They have been known to survive attacks that melt Steel types completely unscathed.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The sword on its back is said to react to the soul of a great hero.  Only once someone has successfully pulled the sword from the stone will POKENAME recognize that person as its Trainer.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME forges its own crude blade using the flame on its tail. Its uses include self-defense, skewering small prey, and prying open tree nuts.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME journeys long distances in search of a volcano. Only there can it forge a blade up to its standards.
author: dylonk25

entry: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This POKENAME is in the process of splitting. It is attempting new tactics and its two ribbons give it more dexterity.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Having grown in length, this POKENAME has now adopted longsword rather than shortsword combat techniques.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Kings used to put POKENAME on the walls above their thrones. When the time came, POKENAME would fly off the wall and defend their king.
author: huh.7

entry: If POKENAME's blade dulls out, it will wrap it with its blue cloth to protect it from further damage. It then finds an Aegislash to borrow a shield from and uses it to resharpen its blade.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME wanders the desert in search of worthy opponents to test its fencing skills. It constantly rubs the saber that forms part of its tail in the sand to keep it shiny and polished.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's twin ribbons are as sharp as steel. Its movements are graceful as it unleashes swift slashes aimed at vital points.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is described in myth as an azure-blue warrior who was corrupted into a Dark-type Pokémon while defending its beloved Lycanroc companion. But if this legend is true, its feral fighting style bears no trace of the noble knight it once was.
author: h0bojoe

entry: On full moons, POKENAME comes out in hunt for easy prey to drain life forces from. Using power from the moonlight, it can levitate its blade and control it to effortlessly slash foes down.
author: soup1900

entry: Those who own a POKENAME become emotionally attached to it. It uses this bond to siphon off their energy.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's plasma blade is solar powered, meaning it can fight without rest during the daytime. Even if it runs out of power during the night, it will keep fighting by using its hilt as a blunt instrument.
author: kiwiarms

entry: During a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather to forge their swords out of Moon Stone fragments. They will carry these swords with them at all times.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME have an affinity for sharp objects, preferring to use small knives and daggers. They sharpen their blades under the light of the moon, using lunar energy to hone them to perfection, then play at being medieval knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spend all day practicing their magic act. Though the coffin is able to put itself back together afterwards, being cut in half over and over isn't pleasant, but the show must go on!
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME can fully retract and extend a blade from inside its body. It will stick this blade into the ground to prevent itself from being picked up and chucked away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its hand-shaped ribbons to grab life force out of prey. Once it has snatched their life force, it instantly retracts its ribbon inside its body, swallowing the life energy whole.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can change its key-shaped body to fit the lock it is about to pick. If it fails on the first try, it tries to force its way in with brute force.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME consists of two spirits fighting for control of a single host. You wouldn't want to be caught in the crossfire of their skirmish.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Though it appears to be blind, it actually makes use of the blade-like organ it wields to perceive its surroundings. It saps the life force of anything this blade cuts through.
author: silverscloudy

entry: A departed soul rests inside this Pokémon. It tirelessly seeks to fulfill that soul's dying wish.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME spends entire days practicing its fencing techniques, wielding a small metal sword. When captured by a Trainer, it pledges lifelong loyalty, just like a knight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite being quite scared, POKENAME will courageously trek into dangerous areas in search of lost or hurt Pokémon. They can often be heard humming to themselves to ease their nerves.
author: santon5512

entry: Wild POKENAME lie in wait for prey under the sand for days at a time. Once an unlucky soul steps into its open jaws, they snap shut to quickly begin draining the life force out of the victim's ankle.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME skewers bird Pokémon with its blade and then drains them of their life force using its ribbon. It hopes that by doing this, it will inherit the ability to fly and soar through the skies like its victims.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon is skilled in a variety of sword techniques.  It's said it can raise its sword to draw power from the sky, and use it to attack foes at range.  If knocked to the ground, it can bounce back readily to protect those it cares about.
author: infranscia

entry: It is said that a Honedge once took pity on a lonely Charmander, allowing itself to be wielded. Now, the two adventure valiantly to vanquish all evil.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME's balloon inflates bigger with every fallen foe. If its blade were to be removed from the balloon, it would deflate.
author: abstr

entry: POKENAME brandish their rapiers against those who disturb their slumber. Striking their mask momentarily stuns them, giving a potential thief time to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME embed themselves headfirst in the stone walls of caves to hibernate. Their exposed sash acts as a sensory organ, detecting when conditions are right for the POKENAME to awaken.
author: kiwiarms

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legends say one who can take POKENAME's sword is destined to lead. If anyone tries, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and shocks them.
author: the_fireplace

entry: While POKENAME's sword may seem weak and fragile due to its size, the stone and minerals gathered make up the blade of the sword, allowing for heavy damage. It then uses the blade to dig more sediment, and the cycle continues.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is often spotted slowly patrolling small areas, grabbing and tossing intruders aside with its tassel. Research suggests it guards the buried bones of ancient Scolipede.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to frolic around while also swinging its blade wildly to chop down anything and anyone in its way. Studies have shown that constantly pampering it by polishing its blade will keep this Pokémon placated.
author: soup1900

entry: Some stories say POKENAME are the souls of warriors fallen in battle within icy plains, forever bundling themselves in a vain attempt to stave off the endless cold, and striking vindictively at all who draw near.
author: sk372

entry: While the sharp blade on the top of a POKENAME can slice well, it is also brittle and heat-sensitive. The eye is made of an organic glass-like substance that grants superior eyesight while being more heat-sensitive than the blade.
author: entomoxie

entry: This Pokémon roams ancient ruins, attacking archaeologists without warning. Luckily, it is mostly posturing, and will retreat if whoever it challenges does not back down.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME's blade is too big in proportion to its body, making it rather clumsy at swinging it. Despite that, it will cry out if a Trainer attempts to take or trade it.
author: ferdirenz

entry: These strange Pokémon were first sighted lurking around the homes of village blacksmiths. They feast on scrap metal and other discarded materials during the process of forging weapons.
author: sk372

entry: Several Pokémon resembling Honedge have infested the husk of a Garbodor. Every blade piercing its skin belongs to a unique member hiding inside.
author: duskrd

entry: It is said that the souls of those slain by POKENAME are trapped forever within its blade.
author: norskdaedalus

entry: What appears to be a key-like appendage jutting out of POKENAME's head was actually forced in there by a malevolent spirit. It now wanders in an almost vegetative state, attacking anything that draws near.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME train with sticks as if they were swords. Its training causes them to break frequently, requiring POKENAME to spend most nights in search of another perfect stick.
author: cloudmaker2169

entry: POKENAME's body is entirely comprised of liquid metal. Despite being relatively weak, they often display an incredible amount of courage.
author: theartemis1

entry: The blade trapped within POKENAME's petals is impossible to move. This is because it has taken the soul of the Vileplume, and now controls its husk.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Said to be two spirits inhabiting the same body, POKENAME can strike with long-range sword swings and powerful fisticuffs. The sword sheathes within its body, causing it mild discomfort.
author: sk372

entry: Plunging its blade into a victim and wrapping its ten ribbons around them, POKENAME will extract all their life force within seconds. If any of its ribbons are torn, it can use this life energy to forcefully regenerate it back.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME conceals its blade within a dome made of its ribbons. If anyone approaches it, it opens this bunker, revealing the blade inside and stabbing them in the leg.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME live in desert ruins and temples. They absorb as much water as possible when it rains, as dehydration causes the sword on their heads to wilt as if it were a plant.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Naturally gifted duelists in the art of fencing, POKENAME are worthy of praise but aren't the most humble. They often boast about their superior swordplay to those around them. Despite this flaw, they always duel clean and fair.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen during snowstorms, its scarf billowing with the breeze. Some say the icy wind is pointing it towards its next worthy opponent.
author: sk372

entry: The blade-like scale on POKENAME's head is sharp enough to cut a tree in half with one slash. It is always looking for others to spar with, ignoring weaker Pokémon entirely in its quest for battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sword-like leaf to trim weeds and tend to its nesting area. Its precise movements evoke the appearance of a gardener at work.
author: .izik

entry: This armored Pokémon hunts small prey at night with sword in hand, assisted by its hypersensitive eyes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME wanders through the countryside looking for a sword master to teach it. Its swordplay is amateur, but it can make its opponent's sword hilt burn if the fight lasts long enough.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: While maintaining absolute calmness, POKENAME utilizes a special breathing technique to strike its enemies. It focuses its spirit to unleash a single, powerful water slash that can slice through any defense.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME feasts on coal before patrolling its territory, ensuring it has the strength to take on any opponent it deems worthy. What it deems "worthy" seems to simply mean anything larger than itself.
author: lepidelectric

entry: POKENAME were a common companion to ninjas during feudal times, their light bodies and bladed heads making them perfect companions for stealth missions at night. In modern times, they retain popularity with practitioners of historical martial arts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Honedge has now taken over part of Charmeleon's body. However, this improves their movement in battle, so the Charmeleon does not object.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME surprises its opponents by bursting from the ground with incredible speed. Its swift, precise strikes often leave foes too stunned to fight back.
author: bluhawk997

entry: POKENAME is found in seaside caverns and ruins. According to ancient legend, the sword is accompanied by "guardian spirits".
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME are prideful Pokémon, only listening to commands that benefit them. It is said that they have nine lives, but spend most of them recklessly.
author: kingd8

entry: Legend has it that, if POKENAME ever successfully gets its ball in its cup, its soul can finally pass on.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME wields a blade in self-defense, but its constant headaches hamper its focus in battle. As such, it makes wild, inaccurate swings in hope that one will connect with the foe.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME will mark their territory by marking trees with the sword on its tail. If POKENAME finds an intruder, it will instantly attack.
author: elite01.

entry: POKENAME are chivalrous creatures that always fight fairly. They are capable of defending themselves on land and in water because of their webbed feet, which ensure sturdy footing wherever they go.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The organ inside POKENAME that generates electricity lets it emit a constant charge from its mouth. It thrashes its body to swing the lightning blade around, dispersing it in a shower of sparks when it contacts a foe.
author: sk372

entry: The blades wielded by POKENAME grow sharper the angrier they get. At their most furious, POKENAME can cleave through boulders with a single slash.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its consciousness is split between its sword and its main body. When given a nonsentient blade, its swordsmanship is revealed to be poor.
author: staghorn

entry: Found standing guard over graveyards, POKENAME uses its sword to great effect against would-be grave robbers. Its intense movements flicker as fast as dancing flames, and hits bounce harmlessly off its flanks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Charizard and Honedge are now in perfect sync with one another. Both POKENAME's blade and flames are not to taken lightly on the battlefield.
author: nellnast42

entry: If POKENAME senses someone, it will teleport a knife behind them to stab them in the back. It needs to drain souls for their life energy in order to maintain its psychic powers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME channels their psychic energy into the powerful blade and scabbard attached to their hands. It's said that POKENAME will drain the life force of anyone who thinks about them for too long.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME is a young swordfighter in training. It looks up to its superiors so it may one day match their strength and prowess.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is often hired by wealthy families to guard the halls and wings of mansions, museums, and castles. Wielding its heavy steel sword demands exceptional strength, so it pushes through grueling training sessions that stretch deep into the night.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The blade protruding from POKENAME's rocky body is incredibly sharp. Some believe it cannot be removed without shattering the entire stone.
author: .izik

entry: The body of the Graveler possessed by the spirit of a Honedge makes it a formidable martial fighter and brute.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is thought to be the mount of a departed squire, holding their sword as it awaits their reunion.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is a heroic Pokémon that tries its best to help others, even if it involves challenging highly intimidating foes. Water cascades from its blade as it fights.
author: fireblade141

entry: They are known to search for uncovered screws and unscrew them to bring back to their nests. Most engineers consider POKENAME to be a pest.
author: kiwiarms

entry: After evolving, POKENAME has become a much more formidable opponent. Now, even more water surges forth with its every slash, which are precise and focused enough to cut solid iron.
author: fireblade141

entry: The bladed points on its shell are extremely sensitive to its surroundings. Should something venture too close, its tassel-like tongue lashes out to grab them and drain their life force.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME usually hide their lower body under the ground, only keeping their embedded sword above ground. Those who try to mess with them quickly regret it once POKENAME reveals their true form.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME puts its victims to sleep and feeds by slaying their dream self. Victims are unable to have lucid dreams ever again.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME grows blades from its carapace which it uses like throwing knives. Discarded knives have been used as props to present seafood dishes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are coated in thick metallic armour letting them get in close and fight with their powerful claw safely. They wield their shield to ward against any particularly powerful attacks, taking trophies from their aggressors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The more life energy POKENAME drains, the more its bulb unravels and the longer its ribbons will grow. It will reach the point of evolution once its bulb fully unravels the cloth that covers it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's cloth wings give it such incredible control over its flight that, when fully charged on electricity, it can stop and reverse on a dime. When it starts swinging its blades, it becomes an unstoppable whirlwind of slashes.
author: imaginita

entry: Each egg in the clutch wields blades via psychic powers. Each member is very impulsive, so POKENAME has trouble coordinating attacks as a team.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wields its sharpened bones like a pair of sabers. It performs complex acrobatic maneuvers to gain advantage in nearly any environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME skillfully wields its pair of steel swords to keep intruders at bay who dare to invade its territory within the desert canyons. It gets along only with Cacturne, which share its habitat and willingly serve as training partners.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is an exceptional fighter that overwhelms its opponents using the paired blades it has in place of legs. To keep its steel strong, it feeds on foods rich in iron.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's two heads connect to the third orb via its sash, allowing each to swing its spiky mass like a flail into opponents. It feeds on rusted metal, especially liking sharp objects, which enhance its spikes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The parent typically softens up its opponent with glancing blows before letting the child issue the final winning strike. The youth's movements in battle are still amateurish, but it shows great potential.
author: sk372

entry: The cloth that comprises its wings is surprisingly effective at keeping it airborne. It dives and slashes at foes, using powders to disorient targets.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME typically lies motionless on the seafloor, but if a predator approaches, it will use its ribbons to crawl away in a hurry. It has to absorb the life force from several fish Pokémon to replenish the energy it takes to do so.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can fire off the five points on its front, guiding them through telekinesis generated from its crystal core. Its tassels gracefully move and direct the blades' movements akin to a conductor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be the failed experiment of a mad inventor. It behavior is often errant and unpredictable.
author: theartemis1

entry: Through unknown means, POKENAME quickly converts regular air into xenon gas, juicing up its electricity and lighting its way. Using this process, it creates nets of static electricity, kicks with zapping power, and hovers to dodge ferocious blows.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's bladed arms make it a formidable close-range opponent. Should a foe try to keep their distance, POKENAME charges its swords up with electricity and fires arcs of lightning.
author: sk372

entry: The pointed blade on POKENAME's head is coated with a mild poison, infecting any wounds it creates. The smaller blade it wields can be used in battle in a pinch, but is primarily used to carve the skin off berries before consumption.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims near the shores of ancient battle sites. It will add the weapons of fallen warriors it finds to its arsenal.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME creep along the sea floor, keeping their bodies flat against the sand. They launch ambushes at any Pokémon that swims above them, catching them in their bladed arms before using the blade on the back of their head to end the fight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is well known that POKENAME offers its blades in service to Beedrill and Vespiquen, helping them protect their hive. If a battle becomes particularly difficult, it won't hesitate to poison its foe to remain true to its oath.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is believed to have developed a swordfighting style to counter every other Pokémon in existence. It can use its vast psychic abilities to wield its two swords telekinetically, giving it vastly more range and tactics.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the twin tassel-like tails it possesses to grab onto food, especially fruits growing on trees. Using the sharp blades at the edge of its wings, it carves the skin off the fruit before eating the sweet insides.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, POKENAME has been observed posing with its blades after any victories, pointing both swords in differing directions. Research shows the directions pointed coincide with the exact hour and minute of the battle's end.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swings around its weapon and flings it out to strike from great distances. Sometimes it lets the momentum of its flying weapon sling its own lightweight body towards an opponent as a follow-up strike.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use the eye on their tails to keep their focus on their opponents at all times. They wield both of their swords in perfect unison, slashing back and forth in a flourish of their ribbons.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The eye on its chest is always on the lookout for danger. The blades on its head are too dull to use for combat.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Despite being a Doublade fusion, POKENAME only has one blade sprouting out of its bud. Further examinations with X-rays have shown that the second blade is actually hidden inside its bud, wanting to come out but having no room to do so.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME maintains a strong and sturdy defensive stance at all times. The moment it is struck by an attack, it retaliates with an intense flurry of strikes from the two swords it wields.
author: sk372

entry: Having grown a second horn, it pursues its enemy with devastating precision and power.
author: togetik

entry: It wraps its own head in its purple fur; whether it does this for protection or because it is shy is unknown. Even with its vision obscured, it can strike quite accurately with either of its twin swords.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fights with a unique mix of brutish swings and dexterous slices. The sashes help give it enhanced speed and strength.
author: partypooperrex

entry: During the festive season, POKENAME descend from their nests in the mountains to celebrate. They toss one of their blades to startled travelers and attack with the other, giving the "gift" of swordplay lessons.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME delivers Retro Mail sealed with wax stamps and folded with perfect corners. Between routes, it hones its sword technique, moving with a rhythm that feels oddly nostalgic.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME constantly coats its swords with fire, making their cuts inflict scalding burns on those hit. The sword's metal is extremely heat resistant, allowing it to keep its shape under the extreme temperatures of the flame.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME wields its twin blade tusks with great skill, striking with clean cutting strikes while rolling. The blades can detach as well, and float around attacking as if they possess a will of their own.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attacks foes by swinging the blade attached to its hood. It protects its rear with another small blade, preventing bird Pokémon from picking POKENAME up and flying away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The unique gashes that POKENAME leaves in the ground as it runs make it easy to tell where it's been. However, these footprints are so far apart due to this Pokémon's huge leaps that it's nearly impossible to follow the trail.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are the elite guardians of those who dwell outside the ocean.  With twin blades in hand, they can carve land and sea apart in a furious maelstrom meant to subdue the foulest of deep-sea beasts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attacks foes by swinging the blade attached to its hood. It chases after rodent Pokémon in the wild to secure a fresh meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dual-wields blades made entirely of electricity. Slicing its food to ribbons, the electric blades also roast them to a nice crisp, creating a well-cooked and easy-to-eat meal for it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's two tails deftly wield their twin blades, slashing precisely to take down opponents. It does not have arms or a mouth, so it gains energy by draining its foes' life force.
author: hophoppip

entry: Wielding a blade on each tail, POKENAME discharges excess electricity into them. Its aggressive and complex attack patterns allow it to overwhelm even the strongest opponents.
author: soup1900

entry: The metal on POKENAME's blades constantly grows and sheds, much like its skin. These shavings were melted into ingots and used in the past to develop the flotation tanks for the ZERO-ONE.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME deftly swing their dual swords in battle, the scales along their body acting as armor defending them from attacks. It is said that in ancient times POKENAME were trained to use their swords to protect nobles and royalty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Unlike Gliscor, POKENAME cares little for stealth and flies in plain sight. When it finds a foe it believes to be a worthy opponent, it will slam its blades together as a challenge.
author: sivanandi

entry: With its two blades of grass, even the thickest trees are felled within seconds. It spends hours sharpening its blades before sparring with other POKENAME.
author: schwaus

entry: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will try to act fierce by unsheathing its tiny daggers. It often gets laughed at due to its small stature.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME ambushes its enemies by rolling toward them, swiftly incapacitating them with its two bladed arms once their defenses are broken.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME uses its dual blades in an elegant dance as a distraction from its more dangerous kicks. Despite that, it's often called "the Duelist" based on its swords.
author: starpun.

entry: POKENAME have a second mind in the form of a specter. The specter warns of danger as they elegantly slash with their two swords.
author: t.i.a.

entry: This Pokémon resembles a hero from ancient times. They are used as guardians to protect valuable items.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME fights zealously with a twin-blade fighting style. It moves with quick speed and grace, its two swords acting in harmony to make a near-perfect offense and defense against its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: Connecting together by a single sash, the two halves of POKENAME fight in tandem with the blades on their head. They are still developing coordination, however, and one will occasionally interfere with the other in battle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use the long blades on their arms to navigate large ravines and cave systems in search of gemstones by climbing walls or cutting through them.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: POKENAME's bud has opened now that the cloth covering it has unraveled. It stores its two blades inside this bud to bathe them with life energy and empower them.
author: soup1900

entry: A master of swordsmanship and underhanded tactics alike. Its blades and horns allow it to cover all sides, making ambush impossible.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Often accompanying tradespeople, POKENAME enjoys following its Trainer around and carrying their tools with its many ribbon-like hands. Its grip is so tight that it is impossible to steal an item from POKENAME, unless it willingly hands it over.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its eyes are constantly scanning around for thieves who may attempt to take the items it possesses. Sometimes it will flourish its weapons around in a dazzling display for either show or to ward off potential threats.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME waves its cloth-like fins to slowly swim along the ocean's floor. Anything that falls in front of its blades is chopped up and consumed in short order.
author: .realthree

entry: The swords on its arms make POKENAME the apex predator of the beach. It can slice right through any shell and topple any fruit tree.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The crests of POKENAME are formed of their blade's sheaths. They are almost impervious to physical damage from head-on and will always face toward danger to protect their more vulnerable back half.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The harbinger of battle, POKENAME warns cities of raids. Misunderstanding it as the bringer of conflict has been many cities' last mistake.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is incredibly graceful in combat. Its flowing ribbons and intense flames distract and intimidate opponents.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME has partially split, and attacks primarily by spinning and advancing. Its movements are overwhelming to most fighters.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The complex attack patterns of its three swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This POKENAME has decided its newfound abilities are best contained in its single form, for now.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The four swords of POKENAME travel across the land seeking adventure. Though not always in perfect sync, when they link together properly, their skill and strength is the stuff of legend.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a master of both defense and offense. Trying to land a good hit on it while being swarmed by three whirling blades would frustrate even the strongest opponents.
author: sivanandi

entry: The fiery blades upon its arms burn fiercely, rumored to be fueled by the lingering resentment of many lost souls. In battle, POKENAME cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is a tricky and agile foe in combat. Its tassel-wings kick up dirt and dust to disorient its opponents, leaving them ill-equipped to avoid the blindingly fast strikes from its twin blades.
author: sk372

entry: The tassel-like ribbons on POKENAME's body sap the energy of those they touch. It uses this to weaken opponents and make them easier to hit with its other ribbons, which possess sharp blades at the end.
author: sk372

entry: Beneath the tassels covering its face, POKENAME has no eyes. Despite its blindness, it fights with intense ferocity and tenacity; it seems the blades on its arms allow it to sense its surroundings with great clarity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a swift acrobat who can easily overwhelm foes in battle. With kicks, spins, and slashes with its sword-ears, it is difficult for many Pokémon to best it unscathed. It is constantly polishing the blades on its ears.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has an incredibly curious nature. It will often cut through things using the blades on its arms to see what they look like on the inside.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It is able to sense the emotions of nearby people. It is rumored to stare at people who are hiding secrets.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME are a menace of the desert, emerging from the dunes just to ambush human caravans for their food, if the humans are lucky.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME wields dual blades with unstoppable force, slicing through foes effortlessly. Their formidable armor strikes fear into foes with each swing.
author: anarchaz

entry: Normally found standing guard at the gates of ruined fortresses, POKENAME are passive guardians provided no hostile act is performed in their presence. Their stoic demeanor belies their fierceness, leaping to action at the first hint of violence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Normally found standing guard at the gates of ruined fortresses, POKENAME are passive guardians provided no hostile act is performed in their presence. Their stoic demeanor belies their fierceness, leaping to action at the first hint of violence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can eject two blades from inside its body: one from its mouth, the other from its behind. This second blade always surprises anyone who tries to sneak up to it from behind.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves collecting blades. It is advised not to try to take one from it, as it will wildly thrash around if threatened, cutting at anything that gets too close.
author: footlongdingledong

entry: Its senses are excellent, able to make use of its blade-like organs to remain aware of the surrounding area. Its swordplay is coveted by swordsmen, many of whom imitate its blade dances.
author: silverscloudy

entry: Should POKENAME's many tails brush against a foe in battle, a hex is cast that causes the victim to hallucinate ghostly blades striking at them. The confusion this causes makes it easier for POKENAME to strike with its actual blades.
author: sk372

entry: It is rumored to be immortal. It is also rumored to carry out the dying wish of its Trainer if it was treated well.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME wanders through the forest slicing trees and Grass-type Pokémon with its teeth and blades indiscriminately, as if by instinct.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's dual blades act like stakes, nailing it to the ground to discourage aerial predators. Its jagged mouth is as powerful as a steel bear trap.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME are quite playful, constantly seeking out someone to spar with. Some reportedly transform into children so that they can trick adults into training with them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It is an exceptionally shy Pokémon. If approached, it covers its eye using the ribbons at its sides.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Though effective for self-defense, POKENAME's two short blades are mostly used for digging holes. It uses these holes to sleep in and gain nutrients from the soil, its tassel staying above ground to sense any disturbances nearby.
author: sk372

entry: The blades on its body are sharp enough to cut through steel. It lacks the dexterity to use them effectively, however.
author: b_megamaths

entry: As it grows, the liquid enveloping its body slowly covers the blades. This gives it more control over them as it matures.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It carves patterns into the sand around its den with one of its blades. These markings warn others to stay away from its territory.
author: .izik

entry: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tassels grab hold of prey and draw it closer to its mouth. Its two blade-like tongues swing fast to chop its food into smaller pieces it can slide into the sides of its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon are often employed by royal families or the very wealthy to guard their homes against thieves; in exchange, POKENAME are often gifted gemstones.
author: bradlybro199

entry: The bane of tall grass everywhere, POKENAME cuts down most plants nearby simply by wandering around with its sharpened blades. There have been reports that it can clear 1000 square feet in a single night. Sometimes it races Mow Rotom for sport.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The number of members in the colony has doubled during its evolution. Trainers with scopophobia or aichmophobia should not train this Pokémon.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME constantly emits an unnerving metallic screeching sound, though some speculate that it may cease when none are around to hear it.
author: norskdaedalus

entry: POKENAME are intelligent Pokémon that have developed a way to make their own swords. They sharpen stones and attach them to sticks, using their strong hair to tie them together.
author: cloudmaker2169

entry: It likes to build nests in abandoned castles. Its song resembles a trumpet's fanfare.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME's glassy eye never blinks, so it's commonly used as a guard in households. Though it appears focused, it's doubtful that POKENAME actually remains awake through the night.
author: .realthree

entry: It never attacks an opponent from behind. Its wings are used for armor as well as flight.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Swordsmen in desert regions often seek out POKENAME for training. It can fling the swords in its hands to hit distant foes, but it takes a few days for them to regrow.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Wild POKENAME will often skewer Berries on the blades on their heads to be eaten later. If raised in colder weather, its scarf will grow longer.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It watches for danger from any direction using the eyes on its body. The ends of its scarf are dexterous enough to pluck Berries from trees.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME weaves complex attack patterns with its blades. One is used as a flame focus burning at over five thousand degrees. The other stays sheathed and is used to defend against counter attacks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's striking appearance led to them being used in heraldic crests during medieval times. Whilst their use was mostly as inspiration, they were occasionally used literally, with POKENAME encouraged to rest upon a heraldic shield during the day.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME buries one blade in the ground and wields the other in combat, typically with a defensive style. It becomes particularly aggressive if something breaches its defenses and touches the sword embedded in the ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME comes in the form of a single entity accompanied by a pair of equally sapient blades. It is native to deserts near ancient ruins.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME are known to frequent taverns and pubs where they help escort drunken guests back home. Their sense of honor is greater than their desire for money, as they often protect their client from thieving Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME try desperately to prove themselves in battle against stronger Pokémon. They are highly sought after by soldiers and warriors.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME has finely honed its battle senses through constant combat. Sneak attacks are almost impossible, as it can quickly shift the grip on its blades to strike behind it as fluidly as it would counter an attack from the front.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have sharp blades across their long body that make them menacing creatures to fight against while at sea. Their swordsmanship is only second to their devotion to their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are sometimes employed within kitchens to help with food preparation. They chop through food rapidly with their twin blades, but are prone to angrily charging at customers who are dissatisfied with their meal.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The twin blades POKENAME wield are supercharged with electricity to ensure clean cuts against their opponents. It usually only takes a few strikes before their foes surrender, ensuring their victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wield their twin blades with more fury than grace, whirling their arms rapidly in an effort to slash their foes. They can swing their blades fast enough to create shockwaves, extending the range of their cuts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME wield their twin blades with more fury than grace, whirling their arms rapidly in an effort to slash their foes. They lack the patience to train with their weapons; attempts to do so invariably end in POKENAME slashing at their teacher.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The blades on POKENAME's back hold immense spectral power. However, each time Charizard uses them, Doublade drains its life force.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME plants one of its blades in the ground before battle to fight with a single sword and its fist. Only powerful enough fighters will make it dual-wield its weapons and fight at its fullest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME train endlessly to become stronger. They use both swordplay and physical strength to their advantage.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME train endlessly to become stronger. They use both swordplay and physical strength to their advantage.
author: theartemis1

entry: Its unique swordplay strategy consists of quick swipes and rolling its body into a ball to dodge. With proper strategy, an average swordsman can defeat POKENAME by making it roll into a pit.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's combat strategy consists of wildly flailing its bladed arms. The sword in its head can be removed and wielded through telekinesis, but POKENAME often forgets it has that ability.
author: sk372

entry: When it goes into combat, POKENAME closes its eyes and enters a zen-like state of tranquility. Its battle movements are fierce and fluid, as if the blades themselves guide its hands to victory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME manipulates its sword with the ribbons attached to its body and head, allowing it to change fighting stances with remarkable speed. This Pokémon roams the seas in search of skilled swordsmen to test its abilities against.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The blade of POKENAME is made from its spectral gas, and because of this, it will dissipate after continuous use. As it continues to reforge its blade, it will become stronger and eventually allow POKENAME to evolve to a more solid form.
author: fireflower20002

entry: POKENAME's metal claws are quite sharp and possess a strong grip when clamped. It uses them to stab, slice and crush fish and crustaceans for sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME collect weapons from underwater ruins, using their claws to scrape them clean and maintain them. They scuttle sideways into battle, one sword used for offense and the other for defence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Fast as the wind, bearing an impenetrable King's Shield and indomitable blade, POKENAME is a formidable foe.  If it is somehow pushed to the edge of defeat, POKENAME will explode, taking its opponent down with it.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME are zealous defenders of their loved ones and have a tenacious hypervigilance. Whenever bedtime rolls around, they have difficulty falling asleep and may request to stand guard to protect those they care about.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appear in many murals and tales as honorable knights that fight to protect others, especially the young. Their swords and shields return to them if they are ever lost or thrown during battle and are made of an extraordinarily durable metal.
author: infinex21

entry: While POKENAME may be emotionally mature Pokémon, they hold bitter feelings in the skull on their heads. They harness these emotions when striking foes.
author: slimninja55

entry: Thanks to years of training, POKENAME is able to balance on its sword-like legs perfectly.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: It is said that each POKENAME possesses the soul of royalty. Indomitable in both spirit and armor, this Pokémon never yields, even in assured defeat.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME deny entry to their internal organs by hiding within their cocoon. They flip onto their side whenever they are attacked by bird Pokémon to allow their shield to absorb the force of pecking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Old stories tell of POKENAME targeting great heroes, attacking them relentlessly over the course of their adventures as recurring villains. Other tales suggest these POKENAME were simply training the heroes for even greater threats.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME practices daily against others of its kind, leaving its armor stronger than ever and unintentionally destroying its scarves. It floats with ghostly powers through its Trainer's drying laundry until it finds a replacement to borrow.
author: ghostslythe

entry: There exists a popular fable of a legendary POKENAME that cleaved a mountain in two with a single swipe of its blade. This fable supposedly inspired many knights in training in the distant past.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has mastered a fighting technique using three swords at once. It has strengthened its blades with pure fighting spirit to increase its already immense power.
author: slimninja55

entry: After felling many trees, POKENAME uses its spectral powers to force beings into building huts and wooden houses for it. These buildings serve as shelters during the winter for it and other Pinsir from the freezing environment.
author: soup1900

entry: After felling many trees, POKENAME uses its spectral powers to force beings into building huts and wooden houses for it. These buildings serve as shelters during the winter for it and other Pinsir from the freezing environment.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will clash their swords, fighting in order to see who will lead their herd. The tough shields around their necks help protect them during these duels.
author: santon5512

entry: Wild POKENAME dwell in remote lakes, awaiting those with the qualities of a true leader. In legend, aspiring kings sought to capture one to prove their worth, but those who failed were reduced to cinders.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME collects swords and shields to wield with its long, prehensile tail. So long as this Pokémon carries its arsenal, a thick layer of frost will coat every blade and surface.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME controls its massive steel sword by manipulating the magnetic fields it constantly generates around itself. It absorbs the energy of thunderclaps through its wings, allowing it to unleash electrical strikes of astonishing power.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flames of this Pokémon signify its undying will personified as flames. It is remarkably skilled with its giant sword despite having no hands, but will only unleash it against worthy foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Instead of being eusocial, hives of POKENAME operate similar to a human monarchy. Because of this, some hives have kings, queens, or both working together to defend their hive with their dying breath.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME use the arm on their heads to swing their razor-sharp, leaf-shaped blades as if they were an extension of their own body. The solid metal around their necks keeps all incoming attacks at bay while they deliver decisive blows.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The armor worn by gallant knights is greatly inspired by POKENAME's appearance. The decorative petals on its armor are pure metal, and can become a devastating Razor Leaf.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME usually patrols and defends rivers and waterfalls by wielding its steel weapons. Its swordsmanship skills are incredible, even when fighting underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Before POKENAME uses its powers to control others, it first sees into the future to see how strong their will is and their likelihood of betrayal. To those whose outcomes are not to its liking, it promptly slices them clean with its large blades.
author: soup1900

entry: When pushed to its limits, POKENAME's pearls begin to emit electric shocks that surge through its entire body, further empowering the strikes of its sword. It is an extremely solitary Pokémon that wanders the world in search of creatures to protect.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When pushed to its limits, POKENAME's pearls begin to emit electric shocks that surge through its entire body, further empowering the strikes of its sword. It is an extremely solitary Pokémon that wanders the world in search of creatures to protect.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The energy from fusion has tinted its flowers. It's debated if the jewel on its chest is sentient or assisting in its abilities.
author: noilaedi

entry: A honorous knight, POKENAME will forever protect its royalty. Legends speak of a chosen POKENAME who slayed an evil lord in a great war 400 years ago.
author: leeto64

entry: Always displaying courage and honor, POKENAME are rumored to be time-traveling knights from another world.
author: adoster

entry: A honorous knight, POKENAME will forever protect its royalty. Legends speak of a chosen POKENAME who slayed an evil lord in a great war 400 years ago.
author: leeto64

entry: Rattata look up to POKENAME, as it is a staunch defender of their colonies. As it watches over them, POKENAME tries to teach the other rodents better behavior, so that their reputation as pests may fade in time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to leave their Trainer if they deem them unworthy, but if they stay with them, it is a sign of great honour. Unfortunately, they are not very intelligent and sometimes wander off, so Trainers must remain vigilant.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to deftly wield its blade in combat. It only allies itself with honorable Trainers, and fights valiantly to uphold said honor.
author: sk372

entry: Holding a large blade with its tail and coated with solid armor, POKENAME boasts formidable offense and defense. It can throw the blade at an opponent and manipulate it psychically to throw off a foe's rhythm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is constantly polishing its large steel blade to keep it bright and shiny. It will never give up this blade to anybody, not even to its Honchkrow boss.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon was once widely known in Galar due to its popularity among the royal class. According to myth, the ancient text on its body changes to be read differently by those it is fond of compared to people it has never met.
author: jangodiot

entry: Inside its metallic shell, POKENAME digests berries, transforming them into a fragrant oil. In the past, this oil was used to anoint kings.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME sharpens its beak with its blade between battles. This way, even if a skilled foe were able to disarm the sword it wields, it would never be caught without a sharp weapon to deal with its opponent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will only allow their Trainer to wield them. Its scope can track the souls of its targets no matter where they go.
author: infinex21

entry: With axe-like tusks, a sword in its trunk, and shield-like armor across its body, POKENAME cuts a striking visage. Knights of old carrying an emblem in its image were said to be the most skilled and chivalrous of their era.
author: sk372

entry: Each strike POKENAME makes against a foe generates more internal electricity. Once it charges enough, it transfers the energy to the points on its head, which fire out blades of lightning to cleave its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wields a sword and shield with fiery passion instilled in every motion. Its shield ignites and trails fire around it as it spins, pressuring foes while POKENAME readies its blade for a devastating strike.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is lauded for its noble and regal appearance and mannerisms. The golden color of the flames it wields was heralded in stories as divine justice being delivered by POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME only appears every hundred years to vow its loyalty to a powerful and just leader.
author: togetik

entry: Because POKENAME resides deep underwater in immense pressures, the metallic plating along its body is tougher than current-known metals. Some legends claim that POKENAME only surfaces when it senses a worthy Trainer or to confront a great evil.
author: infinex21

entry: The ultimate guardian of those who dwell beneath the ocean or above, POKENAME has been described as a living maelstrom. A single swing of its colossal blade can whip up a massive typhoon to decimate any opposition.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to be leaders of armies of Pikachu. They force these Pikachu to cause lightning storms that strike their blade, increasing its size to the point where they can slay entire groups of Pokémon in one fell cleave.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rides on its massive blade, which can cut through and travel across time. It leaps through the eras to fight against and alongside the greatest Trainers of the past, present and future.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME overwhelms its foes with various spells and swordplay. It's unable to fight if the Hexblade is lost.
author: awiralonprime

entry: A spellsword beyond compare. One can never tell when it wields its blade whether one will be hit with steel or incomparable magic.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: When an POKENAME finds someone who has innate leadership, it will begin following their orders to the letter, regardless of the effects of its actions.
author: nexkode

entry: POKENAME cleaves opponents with its large blade-tail, discharging its electricity on contact with anything. When in a defensive stance, it can create a static field that blocks incoming attacks while also shocking any attackers back.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME, despite their typing, are known to pick fights with Pokémon that have the type advantage. They feel great pride and honor when they are able to defeat them.
author: koffing_guy1129

entry: POKENAME's shiny armor is completely impenetrable. Thus, rather than using their blades, rival POKENAME shoot rocks at each other to dent the armor.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME silently roams the world, looking for a Trainer to call its master. It is highly loyal and devoted to those it deems worthy. Be sure to buy a sheath or helmet for it at your earliest convenience.
author: modeustheunbound

entry: POKENAME's carapace is used to make iridescent jewelry, but as POKENAME are expert swordsmen and quite hard to catch, the material is very rare.
author: kiwikelly

entry: In premodern history, POKENAME was a highly prized war animal. Only the most powerful and influential kings have been recorded owning an POKENAME.
author: dylonk25

entry: Its headdress is adorned with an ornate shield. POKENAME often slam these shields into tree stumps to create rhythmic beats.
author: schwaus

entry: Legends say that this Pokémon was able to defeat whole armies in a single sweep. Blacksmiths research POKENAME to create better weapons and armor.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME's body and weaponry are made of a special metal that is extremely durable. In battle, POKENAME uses psychic powers to guide its ribbon to restrict the movements of its foes.
author: mepp.

entry: It is said POKENAME's shield is unbreakable, and only their chosen Trainers can get into close proximity. When their Trainer is in trouble, POKENAME's stance changes, it draws its blade telekinetically and drowns the threat in a deluge of attacks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Although POKENAME is blind, it delivers the most righteous judgements. Since its creation, it has been used as a symbol of Pokémon Justice Attorneys.
author: galactakiller

entry: POKENAME fights for truth and justice using its sword and shield, and even a lasso of psychic energy it can create. Legends say there exists an island inhabited solely by POKENAME, where they hone their combat skills to perfection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights for truth and justice using its sword and shield, and even a lasso of psychic energy it can create. Legends say there exists an island inhabited solely by POKENAME, where they hone their combat skills to perfection.
author: sk372

entry: A mysterious Pokémon said to be born from the restless spirit of noble warriors eternally bound to an ancient, sentient sword and shield. Its blade glows with psychic energy, while its shield emits a ghostly chill that freezes even the air around it.
author: vincentblack

entry: POKENAME uses its sharpened arm blades to deflect strikes and deliver swift counterattacks. Any guard attempting to impede this Pokémon's path will be cut down swiftly and without mercy.
author: frl6160

entry: POKENAME possesses incredible skills with its blade. It can take off the shield it wears on its head for extra defense, or throw it at opponents. The glint from its blade has been known to blind foes.
author: huh.7

entry: POKENAME possesses incredible skills with its blade. It can take off the shield it wears on its head for extra defense, or throw it at opponents.
author: huh.7

entry: POKENAME has forsaken its ability to curl up in defense and instead chooses to engage their foes head-on. It can use its tail to pluck and fling the many small daggers growing upon its back even while it is engaging foes with its sword and shield.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME appears in many tales where ancient legends say only the greatest of heroes can brave its defenses and pull the blade from its body. No records, past or present, exist of anyone successfully doing so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to have been formed of the souls of 108 ronin. The tip of its blade has never been seen, for its strikes land faster than lightning.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: A valorous Pokémon said to have the heart of a knight, POKENAME is able to determine the integrity and intentions of whoever is in front of it thanks to its mysterious powers. It is said its sword can cleave through anything, even another's emotions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's aura helps it detect evil in its presence. This helps it do heroic deeds and protect all other Pokémon around it.
author: rigelpogi08

entry: A valorous Pokémon said to have the heart of a knight, POKENAME is able to determine the integrity and intentions of whoever is in front of it thanks to its mysterious powers. Some have speculated that the main body is puppeteered by its sword.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A valorous Pokémon said to have the heart of a knight, POKENAME is able to determine the integrity and intentions of whoever is in front of it thanks to its mysterious powers. It is said its word can cleave through anything, even another's emotions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a vicious fighter. It uses its shielded arms to parry incoming attacks or to simply bash foes. Both give POKENAME an opening to cleave its foe with the large, sharp blade on its head.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is known throughout the lands to appear to heroes in their time of need, arming them to fight great foes.
author: tomatosalad

entry: Honorable combatants, POKENAME uses its twin jaws as lookouts which weigh the strengths of potential opponents. It allows foes to strike first, gauging their abilities before counterattacking with furious slashes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is a highly skilled fighter who expertly wields the blade it carries to cut down any opponent. If it is disarmed, its mane reveals its true appearance, exposing the steel fangs it had kept hidden.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME unites arthropod Pokémon under its banner to take down the mightiest foes. When it falls asleep, its soldiers turn on each other.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME controls opponents into excessive fighting, utilizing its reinforced body to inflict deadly hits.
author: loadedace

entry: POKENAME are found outside Nidroran burrows protecting their young. Their expert swordsmanship and tenacious stamina intimidate predators into avoiding the burrows.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Legends have been passed down speaking of POKENAME that served in royal armies in ancient kingdoms. Every kingdom that staffed POKENAME fell to ruin, leading to the theory that POKENAME destroyed the kingdoms from inside themselves.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME haunt ancient castles and fortifications, acting as custodians and guardians of the ruined structures. They will happily challenge would-be explorers and archaeologists, doing what they can to deny access to their homes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Territories where POKENAME live are often filled with rocks filed down in different shapes due to POKENAME sharpening its bladed gate on them. Images of this Pokémon were used in the past as symbols of power and courage for medieval knights.
author: chibitales

entry: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become a lord.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade, but it was robbed of its other half.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's shield is rarely used in combat, as they prefer to relentlessly attack and overwhelm foes with their quick slashes.
author: kiwikelly

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME served as guards for ancient kings. Its blades made righteous judgements for its master, and it was highly favored.
author: therider

entry: POKENAME is capable of sprouting katanas out of its head and arms, which it uses to perform a quick draw. It holds a vendetta against Bidon.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME is ruthless toward those it deems unworthy. Many legends exist of kings riding into battle on the back of POKENAME, striking terror into ally and foe alike.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME is often used in steel mills to make precision cuts without the use of machines.
author: w1ndowsxp

entry: Every part of its body, aside from the scarf, is razor sharp. In battle, POKENAME attacks by spinning every bladed gear on its body at high speeds and flying towards foes like a living buzzsaw.
author: fireblade141

entry: An extremely talented but underhanded swordfighter. It uses its illusions to misdirect its foes before unleashing a terrifying slash.
author: nellnast42

entry: Its ribbonlike feelers can turn as hard as steel in an instant. It radiates a soothing and charismatic aura, which it can use to manipulate other living beings.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: It is a chivalrous Pokémon that only raises its blade in the defense of others or when faced with a worthy foe. An POKENAME will only wrap even a single feeler around another if they believe that other to be a worthy leader of them and of others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are noted in ancient texts as divine guardians sent from the heavens. Staring into their hollow eyes instills a profound dread in any who oppose them.
author: kingd8

entry: To protect themselves, POKENAME use their spectral power to lull people in its territory to sleep. In battle, POKENAME try to end fights as fast as possible, even using underhanded tactics such as putting their foes to sleep before striking.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Its ideals led it to create a grand order of knights in an age long past. It strikes with the force of a hurricane, seeking to make a better world.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME will protect Trainers as if they were royalty. It lunges forward using impressive legs and delivers a devastating slash.
author: pikachu_2434

entry: POKENAME's exceptional hearing and unblinking gaze makes it a vigilant guardian. While it mainly uses its sword and shield to fight, if the opponent makes it past its guard, it will pummel them with punches and kicks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Despite the weight of its massive sword, POKENAME can attack and move as if it were weightless. It slashes in huge, spinning arcs that are extremely difficult to avoid. POKENAME will sometimes teach techniques to Pokémon it deems worthy.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME silently wanders empty battlefields. It fights in hope that someone will approve of its capability in combat. Should the sword be pulled out from its torso, POKENAME will be unable to move.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: POKENAME serves only those it deems to have the qualities of a king. Intimidating any foe it faces in battles, it cleaves through them with its snout.
author: bunkachunka

entry: A once legendary warrior, interred long ago. But when the kingdom or its successor calls, it will answer it, no matter what.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: It is believed that an POKENAME is an ancient monarch whose soul possessed a lantern so it can continue to guide its people.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are noble defenders, protecting their territory and their Trainers. It uses the blades on its head for defense while wielding its sword to fight those who try to challenge them.
author: thepandasharky

entry: Ancient texts hint that POKENAME was actually first created long ago before fusion, and were the personal guards to the royal houses that built them.
author: phantom640

entry: In the past, giant golems were created at the sites of wars to honor the fallen. The souls of dead soldiers possessed them, becoming POKENAME.
author: skymaster426

entry: In the past POKENAME were used to guard entire kingdoms, art depicting POKENAME using their mighty hammers to fell dragon Pokémon. Hoaxes say that spirits were sealed inside POKENAME, using spectral powers to detect innate leadership and strength.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: A stalwart small fighter, POKENAME mixes sword-and-shield combat with the conjuration of small fireballs. When pushed to its limits, it gathers the flames onto its weapon, striking with flaming sword slashes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can eject a giant blade longer than the entire length of its body from inside its body. It uses its spectral powers to control humans to chuck opposing Pokémon who invade its territory.
author: soup1900

entry: Said to have been entrusted to royalty of ages past, some of the keys it carries are so old that they match designs dating back centuries.
author: footlongdingledong

entry: POKENAME use the tips of broken blades to fashion crown-shaped armor to defend themselves from aerial threats. If they're startled, they will collapse and place their shields over their faces to pass as nothing more than metal scraps.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It can detect those who possess an earnest heart and the qualities of a king, aiding them in a moment of bravery. Each of its heads boasts the skills of a master swordsman.
author: silverscloudy

entry: With its optimized defenses, POKENAME can endure both the cold vacuum of space and superheated atmospheric entry with hardly a scratch.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A depiction of POKENAME was a common badge worn in medieval times. Kingdoms that bore it prided themselves on their superb armies and defenses.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Ancient legends claim POKENAME came to be when a powerful being from beyond the stars merged with a Aegislash. Wild POKENAME can rarely be seen protecting lost trainers.
author: justjackorwhatever

entry: The souls of the departed flock around POKENAME like a heavy mist. It is said to grant the last wishes of these souls.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It's said that once, a Jirachi wanted a way to escape its near-eternal slumber. It found it in a cursed blade, but at the cost of its very will.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME use their singular sharp tooth to carve beautiful statues in honor of anyone they deem to be just leaders.
author: kiwikelly

entry: As a proud swordsman, POKENAME is often seen training alone. If its mask breaks or is removed, it will flee immediately.
author: theemeraldflygon

entry: The two parts of POKENAME's body are so sturdy that they can defend against anything if hit head-on. POKENAME can attack by swinging the spinning teeth of the gears against foes, but getting struck by moves from the side hurts it more.
author: .realthree

entry: Nicknamed 'The Strongest Warrior In the Galaxy', this Pokémon was sealed away due to its immense power.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: Charmander's courage deemed it worthy in Aegislash's eyes. The two fight now together, as Aegislash can keep its tail burning forever.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME will sing while banging its sword against its shield. Hearing this song fills whoever hears it with an honorable fighting spirit.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It hides its face behind its shield if approached. It is rumored to be less shy around those with innate leadership qualities.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME are well-trained soldiers who patrol the desert in small squads. They drive out any intruder they come upon.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME is an extremely powerful Pokémon. It charges its steel blade with electrical energy that it absorbs from its environment, and then releases the power into any Pokémon it touches, completely frying them.
author: jerryandpixie_10897

entry: In ancient arenas, POKENAME fought alongside underdog warriors. In the present, these Pokémon are driven to seek battle with strong opponents.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME lives in luxury, covered in riches. It will hoard its loot from other Pokémon and Trainers. POKENAME will defend the loot with its life.
author: j1miin

entry: A warrior, through and through, yet it cares not for things like honor. But name a good enough price, and it will do whatever you command.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Initially, it may not seem much of a threat due to its small size. However, POKENAME possesses strength enough to wield a massive sword and has exceptional skill in the art. Its body appears to glow whenever it's about to unleash a powerful attack.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME attacks with the blade on its head, which it coats with the poison its body secretes; its flexible neck gives its sweeping strikes a lot of range and power. It becomes a fiercely protective and loyal companion to anyone who can befriend it.
author: fireblade141

entry: Despite their bulk, POKENAME can swing their bladed tails with deadly force and precision. They use their jaws as a whetstone, keeping both their teeth and blades sharp.
author: chibitales

entry: The design of POKENAME's helmet varies from region to region. Its metal is very cold, as it hides a core made of pure ice.
author: kiwikelly

entry: Many look down on POKENAME for the shabby appearance of its body and equipment. It should not be underestimated, however, as in combat it shows surprising amounts of strength and tactical prowess.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being comprised of refuse and adhering to dirty tactics in combat, POKENAME prides itself in the beauty of its equipment. It keeps its weapon, armor and shield as pristine as possible, cleaning and shining them often.
author: sk372

entry: Some POKENAME become obsessed with battling, disregarding any semblance of honor in pursuit of victory. This dirtier outlook on fighting is reflected in their weaponry, dirty and worn out from lack of care.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME protects weaker undersea creatures with its resilient body, shielding them from harm. It is merciless against foes that prey on the weak, attacking swiftly with teeth and fins as sharp as blades.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has the ability to detect royalty from a long distance. It uses this ability to hunt those it deems unworthy to rule.
author: norskdaedalus

entry: POKENAME fights off intruders for the sake of keeping the grasslands it inhabits safe. Despite the tiny size of its body and weaponry, it strikes with a surprising amount of strength and fervor.
author: sk372

entry: The loud clanging of POKENAME's wingblades bring fear to the hearts of its enemies. Moreover, POKENAME can focus the noises to deafen a foe.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The shields on its body grow harder as it gets older. In ancient times, armies would use these shields during large battles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has the power to sense true leaders and will be loyal guardians of those anointed by their true commitment for ages.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME is made up of ancient armor and cloth. The sword on its back will only be unsheathed when the right move is used.
author: ohok3441

entry: An impenetrable bastion said to have held strong against more than ten thousand men. There is nobody who knows siege tactics better than POKENAME.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME are warrior Pokémon clad in armor and wielding weapons often found in the ancient ruins they call home. Supposedly, the armor and weapons they wield are cursed, yet POKENAME show no signs of being afflicted.
author: infinex21

entry: Using water as payment, generations of nobility in desert regions would employ POKENAME for protection. As long as it stays hydrated, its steel blade can cleave almost anything.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Using water as payment, generations of nobility in desert regions would employ POKENAME for protection. It will drink anything to stay hydrated, even the life force of innocent Trainers.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME are vain and try to keep their armor as shiny as possible. Taking care of them is a lot of work, but POKENAME will form incredibly deep bonds with Trainers who can manage it, making the effort well worth it.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME are very loyal to those that show them respect and love, going as far as to protect them at all costs.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME was once a common partner for knightly nobility. It is extremely adept with a blade, which it often receives from its masters.
author: nellnast42

entry: Wild POKENAME reportedly challenge other wild Pokémon like a Trainer Battle. An urban legend says its sword houses the souls of those it has bested.
author: jokerswild

entry: With every swing of POKENAME's weapon, one can hear an ethereal melody playing. POKENAME wields its sword with grace, intent on making every battle a beautiful symphony.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the result of an Aegislash completely overtaking a Golisopod with its spectral powers. POKENAME's golden armor is impenetrable, and few can withstand it's mighty cleave.
author: the_llamas

entry: POKENAME does not actively seek conflict, but when it finds itself in combat its nature as a formidable opponent is revealed. POKENAME is quite noble, often coming to the aid of people and Pokémon in need.
author: fireblade141

entry: Using its spectral powers, POKENAME can manipulate its energy beams into energy swords to slice through enemies. Research has determined that its blade can be separated from the gold ore, though no one has managed to do so yet.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are often seen conducting silent rituals, manipulating energy through intimidating sword stances. The energy they manipulate distorts the air, inducing visual hallucinations in those nearby.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME snap their wings closed over their body when they find themselves under attack, relying on the metallic wings to protect them from harm. Once they've weathered the blows, they fly abdomen-first at their aggressor, aiming to stab at them.
author: katieplaysgames
