entry: A favorite among role-players, POKENAME exudes a childlike sense of chivalry and wonder. Wild POKENAME can often be found leading their friends on make-believe adventures across the wilderness.
author: turron_turron

entry: When someone gets too close, POKENAME defends itself with its sturdy shield before countering with a swift Low Kick. It has a habit of sizing up opponents before striking their weak points.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME views itself as the prince of a kingdom it will soon inherit. Tales of its bravery have spread, and it has amassed a small following.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME can wrap its ribbons around foes to encase them in a large purple gemstone created from thin air. In times past, it was believed that those who encountered one were destined to gain immense fortune and power.
author: soup1900

entry: On POKENAME's body grow gems that are filled with its spectral powers. According to legend, royalty who wore jewelry made with these gemstones became eternally cursed as a puppet to POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: A menacing, territorial Pokémon that will protect its domain by any means. Using its lower half as a weapon, POKENAME is exceptionally skilled in swordplay, but displays this only when its home is threatened.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: A pair of blades that constantly shovel themselves to the ground. They are often accompanied by a shield, who happens to be their leader.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME's blades are sharp enough to cleanly slice through glass. They use their palms to hold barriers, giving themselves enough time to plan a good cut.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME do their best to remember complicated swordsmanship, but often forget what they learn after a day or two. This does not stop them from trying to improve their combat prowess.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When an POKENAME is nearby, it is recommended that you keep your distance. They will spin wildly in circles with their sword, cutting down tall grass in search of hidden treasures.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME have webbed feet that ensure they never end up off balance. They always find time to improve their battle prowess.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These regal Pokémon were once owned by wealthy nobles of the past and utilized as sentinels. In modern times, their stoic yet loyal personalities and relatively short stature make them excellent, devoted companions.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME is completely encased in armor too strong to penetrate, even with the strongest blades. It is highly precise and capable of taking down multiple ships at sea, making escape nearly impossible once it locks onto a target.
author: hereisanimations

entry: POKENAME are extremely loyal to their trainers, even putting themselves in harm's way to protect them. These Pokémon were once used alongside Golurk when defending kingdoms. There is a theory that POKENAME are the souls of Arcanine who died battle.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: With its terrifying spectral flames and mastery of sword and shield, POKENAME appears destined rule as a mighty, yet perhaps despotic, king.
author: nellnast42

entry: Though POKENAME's blade resembles a large spoon, one should not underestimate its combat strength. Its high intellect lets it formulate perfect battle strategies, earning it victories without taking a scratch.
author: sk372

entry: It's said that POKENAME who win enough victories disappear to a far-off land and return with a golden spoon-blade. The new gilded weapon serves as a symbol of their unparalleled skill in battle.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon wanders far and wide in search of the strongest blades. There are legends of an POKENAME whose sword could cut through dimensions.
author: rakanadyo

entry: The sword being larger than it means POKENAME's swings are broad and heavy. Its offense may lack, but if it retreats into its shell, its defenses become almost impregnable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's brain is in its swords; the rest is a mindless puppet. It wishes to rule the world, believing that those capable of choosing the king are themselves actually more deserving of the throne.
author: dzygomer

entry: POKENAME roams ancient ruins, seeking a hero of destiny. If in a tough spot in battle, it will eject the tip of a blade from its mouth.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: If you manage to remove the sword from POKENAME's back, it will fall asleep until you reinsert it. If the sword is removed for too long, POKENAME will grow a new sword.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME wields its sword with great skill to defend the Pokémon living in the bodies of water it inhabits. The shell on its back is actually a steel shield capable of deflecting incoming blows.
author: fiordaliso

entry: At first, these Pokémon were seen as jesters, amusing people. However, intervention from an unknown species caused POKENAME to change.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME chew through the crust of the earth with teeth as sharp as swords. They can parry the attacks of powerful enemies by swinging its entire body like a large whip.
author: frokachu

entry: Despite its bulk, it uses deft swordplay instead of cannons. It fiercely defends the Squirtle and Wartortle it leads, repelling even rival Blastoise.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME use their thorny vines to tear through soil to plant rows of seeds. If an intruder threatens their gardens, they will quickly lash out with their vines, extending the vines in a wide range to protect their bulbs and the field.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are often seen even in harsh environments and near cities. Parents often tell their children not to get too close and get stung by the poisonous stings on their backs.
author: tigerinnenumarmer

entry: The horns on POKENAME can inject the venom stored within the eggshells rapidly. The poison can leak out cracks if the eggs aren't upright.
author: ziggaway

entry: The thick red saliva on POKENAME's tongue has enough poison to knock out a Wailord. Its potent toxin serves as both a weapon and a defense mechanism, allowing it to subdue larger foes with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's intimidating visage is a fairly effective first line of defense. Some people will carefully collect them and place them outside their homes to scare off pests. In exchange, they are provided a safe place to evolve.
author: afilthycasual

entry: POKENAME is territorial, charging with the force of a freight train and smashing obstacles in its path. It is used in quarries to shatter boulders, but its stubborn nature makes it unreliable.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's drill-horn is coated in a corrosive venom, which aids it in drilling into solid rock in search of burrowing prey like Onix. It begins combat by rotating the horn to spray the venom on foes before charging them with devastating force.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The poison POKENAME produces has no effect on the child in its pouch. This ensures the young remain unaffected and safe from venom if accidentally pricked by one of its spikes.
author: .izik

entry: The clear poison coating POKENAME's blades results in a variety of symptoms when entering the bloodstream. Should even a tiny nick occur, it's important to wash the cut thoroughly with water to prevent severe reactions.
author: .izik

entry: If it falls onto its back, it will rotate its arms backwards to pick itself up. Its arms can rotate freely, allowing it a full range of motion.
author: .izik

entry: It will make a bedding of grass and mud to sleep on at night. If its sleep is disturbed, it will completely recreate the bedding.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spews toxic venom everywhere it rampages, turning lush, green nature into dead, barren lands. It likes to rampage at mountains to destroy all rocks in search of Moon Stones.
author: soup1900

entry: The slime covering POKENAME's body takes the potency of the last poisonous thing it touched. Oddly enough, if it never touches anything poisonous in its entire life, the slime stays non-toxic.
author: .izik

entry: Its horn secretes a very dangerous neurotoxin that numbs the nervous system, so it is best to approach it with caution. Although POKENAME is usually a shy and solitary creature, it will not hesitate to attack if it feels threatened.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are hyperaggressive Pokémon that are quick to anger and bite their Trainers when upset. They are also easy to startle and are known to snap at loud sounds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found sitting atop powerlines where they patiently wait for people to spread breadcrumbs before them. Their aggressive nature allows them to push past other Pidgey to reach the breadcrumbs first.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It lurks in the dens of other Pokémon while they are out. When they return, POKENAME will quickly dispatch them with its venomous horn. POKENAME will live in their den once they have been repelled.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its eyes will change to a darker green at night to see in the darkness. When exposed to bright light, it will panic and hop in place.
author: .izik

entry: At night, the poison in POKENAME's horn becomes five times more deadly. It uses this enhanced venom to hunt for prey like Sentret, overpowering its quarry with increased lethality during the dark hours.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's body are coated in a thin toxic oil. It builds its nest with fresh herbs like thyme and sage, as the scent calms its young.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is highly territorial, hiding motionless until it spies an intruder and immediately attacks. It wipes the orbs on its limbs against its horn, smearing poison across them to make its hits more deadly.
author: sk372

entry: The King's Rock atop POKENAME's head gives them a superiority complex. They're lazy, commanding other Pokémon on the riverbank to do menial tasks. Many ignore these orders, but simple-minded Pokémon are easy to manipulate.
author: chinigan

entry: POKENAME spreads a smothering cloud of toxic pollen from its flower as it flies overhead. A wild POKENAME uses this strategy in battle to great effect, however if brought down, has few ways to defend itself other than spraying weak bursts of pollen.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to make shallow burrows near dumpsters, venturing out to gather discarded food in the evening. Its sense of smell is exceptional, allowing it to find food easily, even in the dark.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies at high speeds before jabbing at prey like Sunkern. It injects a potent toxin that causes asthmatic symptoms in humans, making it a dangerous creature to approach.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lies still, half-buried in the ground, waiting for prey to run into its poisonous spikes. This way, it preserves energy while hunting.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME unleash a writhing mass of brambles whenever their friends are in danger. Each thorn injects a caustic toxin that weakens shells and scales so that POKENAME can hopefully help their friends wiggle loose and escape danger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gathers soft materials from dumpsters to line its den. If disturbed during the process, it will jab with its hardened horn, using its venomous attack to protect its home from intruders.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME battles, its central eye glows faintly, as if channeling some forgotten power. Researchers speculate it might be a conduit for cryptic messages that only certain Pokémon can interpret.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It rolls on the forest floor, seeking Berries. When it finds one, it pierces the Berry with a spike and drinks the juice.
author: .izik

entry: Flocks of POKENAME create rivalries with other flocks of bird Pokémon. A loud, unified squawk usually marks the start of a territorial brawl, where they fight for dominance over feeding areas.
author: .izik

entry: Territorial and aggressive, POKENAME needs little justification to puncture and poison others via the horns on its claws. The only exception to this is the Nidoran species, who receive a warning via rapid clicking of its claws first.
author: sk372

entry: The plates that make up POKENAME's horn and shell are extremely tough in some spots and very brittle in others.  This allows the venom inside its body to gush out upon impact, without lowering POKENAME's defense.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME finds rivalries with other Flying-type Pokémon. It will peck at them even when they are not prepared to fight, injecting them with a powerful, numbing venom so it has the upper hand in aerial combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are aggressive by nature and incredibly territorial. However, their attempts at fighting anything larger than themselves tend to end poorly.
author: dusknoir64

entry: POKENAME's fire-breathing capability is a potent offense on its own, but the true danger lies in the smoke it creates, as it is incredibly toxic and will incapacitate a person within seconds of inhalation.
author: sk372

entry: The ear on POKENAME's tail is very sensitive, allowing it to hear predators as they approach, even if it is sleeping. It slithers away very quickly, using its acute hearing to stay one step ahead of danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release a sonorous trumpeting to scare away other Pokémon that approach too close to their nest. If the loud noise fails to dissuade the intruder, then they summon the rest of their nest with a mighty roar.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's horn glows as it uses telepathy to search the surrounding area for threats. If it senses any aggression, it will hide in the brush, using its keen senses to avoid potential danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases thick pollen that spreads like smoke. The cloud scares predators and hides its movement. While enemies are confused, POKENAME moves in and injects venom into the weakened Pokémon.
author: kafoxnothylol_47795

entry: The neurotoxins contained in POKENAME's venom can paralyze the nervous system in just a few minutes. Its coils are covered in spines as hard as diamond, each one laced with potent toxins.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The poison leaking from POKENAME's rocky skin contains a numbing agent. When mixed with other herbs, it becomes a salve for minor aches and pains, making this natural remedy highly valued by those who know how to harvest it.
author: .izik

entry: The territory of a POKENAME encompasses their burrow and any foraging spots nearby. Their monopoly on foraging spots is enforced with a sharp stinger or a zap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it is brimming with energy, the tip of the horn on its forehead shines with a bright yellow glow. POKENAME's venom is used as an ingredient in crafting Paralyze Heals.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Should POKENAME find a hard stone slab while tunneling, it will ram its horn to shatter it. Its tunnels have been observed reaching over 100 ft below the surface of the earth.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely toxic oils are secreted from this Pokémon's leaves. It uses this in combination with its incredible speed to overwhelm its prey.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME appears unassuming to lure in foes to attack it. Shifting its ears towards the attacker, POKENAME tucks its body in and exposes its powerful, toxic horn to pierce the opponent. This Pokémon then scratches at the predator with its claws.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Although its claws are quite strong, it tends to ram foes with its sharp and venomous horn. The venom in its horn is also present in its quills, and just a few drops can cause immense pain that lasts for at least three days.
author: infinex21

entry: Always eager for a fight, POKENAME challenges nearly any Pokémon it encounters. Its taloned limbs are capable of slashing, piercing, and stomping, while the toxic spines covering its body make every charge a dangerous one.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The poison leaking from the spikes on POKENAME's ears is the most potent toxin its body produces. It has a rancid smell akin to rotting vegetables and oil, making it highly effective in warding off threats.
author: .izik

entry: The thin layer of poisonous fluid covering POKENAME's body changes color when it is ready to fight. This visual cue warns others of its heightened aggression and readiness for combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have sensitive flowers on their back that send them into a frenzy over the slightest breeze. They are capable of tearing sheds down with a mighty vine of brambles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The poison POKENAME produces has a numbing effect. Many surgeons use this poison in limited quantities to make procedures more comfortable for the patient, aiding in pain management during operations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME exudes a special, invisible gas from its ear-like appendages to lure in prey; this gas smells intoxicating to almost any individual. When prey comes close enough, it lunges and bites into them with venomous fangs to subdue them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is so lazy that it doesn't even react if attacked by another wild Pokémon. It simply lets its poisonous horns do the work for it. Paradoxically, by synthesizing the toxins from its spines, one can create an invigorating tonic.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME display a heightened aggression in the wild toward anyone that gets too close. The poison their spines are coated in becomes more virulent as their stress levels increase, making stings from them progressively more dangerous over time.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon's mane is made of countless sharp spikes. It is said those spikes puff up when a POKENAME senses danger in the near future.
author: slimmagma

entry: POKENAME exhibits strong aggressive and territorial tendencies, stabbing at unwanted intruders with its horn. It can even puncture the hulls of most ships unfortunate enough to sail through its domain.
author: sk372

entry: The poison leaking from the spikes on POKENAME's ears is the least potent toxin its body produces. It has an incredibly sweet smell, like honey and apples, which serves as a misleading deterrent for predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will constantly fight each other for dominance, ramming into one another repeatedly until one gives up. This practice helps strengthen the armor on their bodies, gradually making them as hard as steel.
author: santon5512

entry: Quick to anger, these Pokémon will latch onto anything it perceives as a threat with its ribbons and jab it with its poisonous horn.
author: melodydelune

entry: An otherwise calm omnivorous Pokémon that fights wildly, POKENAME flails its hefty ears around, jabs with its sturdy horn, and leg sweeps with toxic blows. It collects whatever it can find and brings it back to its colony.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flies at high speeds before ramming its horn into trees. It does this as a show of strength to others of its kin, demonstrating its power and dominance within its group.
author: .izik

entry: Care should be taken to avoid POKENAME possessing one's electronics. Once it has inhabited one, the device will drain more power when in use, with the expenditure rate increasing exponentially every subsequent possession.
author: sk372

entry: The hot venom that comes from POKENAME's horn is hot enough to melt quartz. It uses this ability to melt stone and create its burrow, digging deep into the ground to create a safe home.
author: .izik

entry: It secretes a green toxin across its entire body that is highly flammable. The friction of its feathers is enough to ignite this toxin. This toxin burns quickly but must be smothered when ignited, for water will only cause the flames to spread.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's hearing is amazing, making up for its terrible eyesight. Its ears flit about in every direction should it hear a predator, allowing it to react quickly and evade danger despite its poor vision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's two heads will cooperate to defeat an opponent or secure food, but will immediately begin to fight with each other afterwards. Its acute sense of smell and ability to sense vibrations in the air make up for its lack of sight.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME raises all its tails, it means it's about to launch an attack. By extracting the poison secreted from its horn, it's possible to create highly effective ointments for treating burns.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite being extremely energetic during the day, a single drop of POKENAME's poison can cause extreme fatigue. This paradox makes it an unpredictable adversary, balancing bursts of energy with the power to drain opponents.
author: .izik

entry: Male and female POKENAME sing separate sections when they sing. Male POKENAME sing long, supportive notes, while females carry the melody. The male POKENAME carries a potent poison at tips of their ears.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often struggles to keep itself upright when walking on slopes and will usually choose to roll down inclines. Every tooth and spine are as poisonous as the horn on its head, making rolling POKENAME a common hazard in hilly areas.
author: alestrius

entry: The thin scales covering POKENAME's body sometimes fall off, causing a viscous pink poison to seep out. Once thought to be blood, this poison is distributed by tiny sacs located just below each scale to deter predators.
author: .izik

entry: Male and female POKENAME sing separate parts of a shared song. Males perform long, supportive notes, while females carry the melody. The male POKENAME also carries a potent poison at the tips of its ears.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME constantly produce venom from their tails, as they are always ready to hunt. If the pores that produce venom get clogged up by mud or soaked in water, the resulting blockage makes them sick.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a moody but gentle Pokémon that many wild Poison-Types like the snuggle against for warmth. Whenever it hears music, its ears perk up and down along with the beat.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME usually keep their ears tightly curled, as even small sounds are amplified into cacophonies. They make an exception when fighting, rapidly curling and uncurling them to strike foes from a distance.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Groups of POKENAME form hierarchies based on the size of their horns. The longer the horn, the more authority one has.
author: itsmebrewsky

entry: The fabric-like body of POKENAME is covered in microscopic barbs that scratch the skin of anyone who touches it. These barbs are coated in an unpleasant toxin, something POKENAME weaponise by wafting their bodies against their foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are incredibly loud and use the echoes of their roars and growls to navigate through the air despite their poor eyesight. They can get very territorial and will roar exceptionally loudly at their rivals to disorientate them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If a POKENAME leaves the skull somewhere, it can see through its eyes. Some believe it can even teleport to that skull at any time.
author: crumple_2

entry: When POKENAME explodes, it scatters poisonous barbs that can cause an intense burning sensation. This self-defense mechanism leaves behind a hazardous field of sharp, toxic spikes.
author: .izik

entry: The venom that seeps from POKENAME's tusks can cause hallucinations. This venom is used to confuse and disorient enemies, making it a strategic advantage in battles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME defend their nests, especially their eggs, with their diamond-hard horns. Flocks of POKENAME communicate with myriad chirps and can coordinate their attacks rather well.
author: infinex21

entry: Both their horns and their beaks inject a debilitating, yet non-lethal, venom into their targets. A heat rash will develop around the site of injection, for which there are thankfully many remedies these days.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are diurnal hunters despite their poor vision. They hunt by shouting out powerful bursts of sonic energy and listening for the return calls. The calls of POKENAME can be heard over a mile away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME eats poisonous plants like nightshade to strengthen the sticky venom in its horn. Even a single prick from its horn can spell doom for someone who doesn't take an Antidote immediately after.
author: .izik

entry: It sleeps with its feet buried in mud at the side of rivers. On dry days, it emits a strong peppermint odor from its leaves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME crawls up trees with its thin legs and uses its horn to pierce apples. It brings them back to its kin as gifts, showcasing its resourcefulness in providing for its family.
author: .izik

entry: Its spines and horn are filled with venom, ensuring its survival by keeping predators at bay. When POKENAME exhales icy breath, the crystals on its body emit a faint glow.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is incredibly stubborn, not giving up a fight until it faints. If it senses danger, the rocks on its collar start oozing with poison.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can fire sharp, poison-tipped stones from their mane. Foes hit by these stones will, over time, grow weary until they are unable to battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is an ambush predator, lying motionless before pouncing under a shower of incapacitating powders. The scales on the mushroom, which retain minor Effect Spores, fall off naturally and are harvested by adventurous youths to be eaten in a dare.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hide in dark alleyways, often getting into scuffles with one another. Their fur is actually soft to the touch; however they are able to stiffen their fur into thousands of sharp, poisonous quills.
author: mistymagius

entry: The dark green powder scattered from POKENAME's wings is highly toxic. Even a quick sniff can cause severe exhaustion, leaving its opponents weak and disoriented.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constantly brandish the flame on their tails to intimidate other Pokémon. Even though most Pokémon are not scared of their tail, many end up leaving to avoid conflict with POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This highly aggressive Pokémon spews unique poisonous flames that can cause permanent damage to Pokémon and infrastructure alike.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Incredibly aggressive, POKENAME will challenge any Pokémon it sees and uses a combination of its horn, claws and tail to defeat its opponents. The potency of POKENAME's poison increases when it's agitated.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Soil tilled by POKENAME mysteriously kills only weeds in gardens. How it spares useful plants remains unexplained by botanists.
author: .izik

entry: Male POKENAME compete underground for status and mates. Their prolonged subterranean clashes can shake the earth and trigger small earthquakes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME coats its trove of stolen change in a clear poison. It sleeps on the pile at night to ensure it stays safe, using the venom to protect its valuables from would-be thieves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME expects to be treated like royalty by anyone who crosses its path. If it does not receive said treatment, POKENAME will lash out by stabbing them with its horn and scratching them with its claws, both of which contain poison.
author: darkweavile428

entry: When POKENAME flies into a rage, the horn on its head grows longer and sharper. It wields this horn like a head-mounted rapier, using its heightened aggression to strike fiercely at anyone who threatens it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME toxins induce intense feelings of anger in those unfortunate enough to be afflicted with it. Clinicians have taken an interest in this toxin, attempting to use a dilute version of it as a confidence-boosting drug.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's aggressive tendencies are due to its own body not being completely immune to its own internal poison reserves. It seeks to poison others with its horn to relieve some of the painful pressure it feels.
author: sk372

entry: Those stung by POKENAME's horn will feel a mild burn for a few days. It isn't seen as a pet too often due to its aggressively playful nature, and risk of getting stung by mistake.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME are in constant fear of getting wet, as flames come out from both their horns and their tail. This fear leads to aggression whenever anyone approaches with a liquid substance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release both venom and flames from their tails, resulting in a bluish flame that burns venom. Getting burned by these blue flames causes rashes to linger long after the burn has healed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The horns on POKENAME's body have grown far tougher and more pronounced, and its toxins have become lethal after evolution. With a single beat of its wings, it can glide toward its foe and finish them off within moments.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are coated in a thin layer of toxic mucus that is water-soluble, washing off into the ponds they live in. The toxins make it difficult for other Pokémon to share the water with them, allowing them to ward off rivals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Visible as a dark spiral in their stomach, the intestines of POKENAME produce a toxin that oozes out through their skin, making them dangerous to touch. They aggressively patrol the shore of their ponds, trying to inflict their poison on trespassers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME desires to be immune to even the strongest poisons and will seek out other Poison types to see if they can challenge it. It uses its spoon to mix up all types of poisonous concoctions for it to try.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are bold and confident creatures that love to show off their muscles. During a Pokémon battle, their hefty punches and venomous horns give them the means to secure victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: History speaks of kings and regents who used POKENAME rather than knights as their protectors. POKENAME are said to have armor tougher than steel and enough strength to snap broadswords like twigs, making them the perfect bodyguards.
author: wickedwiccan

entry: The shells of POKENAME are covered in spines that are coated in a painful toxin. They will rush at their foes backward when threatened, using their shell to both protect themselves and harm others.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME feed on mineral-rich veins of rock, tearing out chunks from the mountainside with their powerful hands. The minerals they consume contain toxic heavy metals, which they metabolise and concentrate into a poison within their spines.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME diets are rich in silica, the mineral being a key component in the growth and formation of their toxic spines. Pokémon Trainers are advised to keep either sand or quartz crystals to hand so that they get enough of the mineral in their diet.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In battle, POKENAME forcefully rams its horn into foes to inject venom. This debilitating toxin hinders the victim's mobility, giving POKENAME a great advantage.
author: mepp.

entry: By flapping its ears rapidly, it can hover for a short period of time. It will practice this exercise well into the night, hoping to achieve flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attacks with the toxic horns on its heads to deter predators from its den. These venomous horns cause intense pain, forcing attackers to retreat before they are harmed further.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunts prey swimming in icy waters for days on end, striking them with its terrifying, poisonous horn once it catches up with them. It is extremely protective of its young, fearing humans or other predators may take them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME thrusts its poisonous horn into foes and bites them. It uses spectral energy to attack from afar.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The venom in POKENAME's horn can cause someone to sleep for a full 24 hours. While they slumber, it monitors their dreams and eats any happy ones, drawing power from the joy of others.
author: .izik

entry: Many families pay handsomely to rent POKENAME to trim hedges into topiaries. The swift and precise cuts made with their scythe claws ensure each work of art looks refined and professional.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found in large groups, defending the territory of a Bidrill. Since they are too weak to confront intruders head-on, they prefer to set up ambushes.
author: goober145

entry: POKENAME prefers devouring video game save files. With each feeding, its blade edges grow noticeably sharper.
author: .izik

entry: Led by Bidactyl, a group of POKENAME flying over an area is a warning on itself. These avid hunters may not look like much, but their sharp wings are extremely dangerous. Hunting always in packs, their prey are often quite bigger than themselves.
author: thordemidgard

entry: It often runs its tail blade along the blades on its chest area, which makes a chilling noise and seems to help keep the blades sharp. Its head blade, however, is regularly shed and grows back stronger and sharper each time.
author: infinex21

entry: The collar of metal spikes around POKENAME's neck constantly grows throughout its life. However, they tend to break off the longer they get, so POKENAME will rub against hard rocks to grind them down.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME trims dead branches with the blade on its head to keep its nest tidy. It prefers silent, moonlit groves for roosting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's talons are made of a strong, lightweight steel. When they hunt, the blades on their ribcage lock onto the target, piercing and weakening them.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME admires its caretakers and hopes to impress them, but usually ends up clumsily getting its blade stuck in something. Despite its innocent appearance, it is drawn to aggressive and nefarious guardians, but its cuteness makes them protective.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If someone makes eye contact with POKENAME, it will gaze back with malicious intent. Even a slight movement can trigger it to hop and chase relentlessly in an attempt to attack.
author: beatdoof

entry: The playful ramming of a Mareep becomes a terrifying chase when POKENAME tries to ram into others. There are records of hospital visits following malicious fusing at petting zoos.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Petting POKENAME's wool is not recommended. The wool contains many sharp blades that cut and stab anything that touch it.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME train by swinging their tails at each other as if they were in a serious battle, nimbly dodging and immediately pivoting into their next attack. They only use their blades against serious threats, refusing to harm the innocent.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's gills have razor-sharp edges and can move them faster than the eye can follow, which they use to sink into unsuspecting prey. The gills are colder than the surroundings, which sends prey into shock, stopping it from struggling.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME fling razor-sharp feathers to snag valuable objects right out of people's hands. They scatter their bladed feathers as they fly away with their hauls to repel any potential pursuers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME chews discarded soda cans for nutrients. Its metal body glows faintly after feeding on aluminum and rust.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is so ancient, it is theorized to have inspired the creation of the axe. Some even allow their Trainer to wield them.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's two heads often conflict with each other when it comes to their diet and way of life. The front head prefers to live peacefully and eat grass, while the tail head prefers to goad any other Pokémon to attack it and eat them instead.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is docile and mostly seen in caverns, eating moss or flying around with its nubby wings. When spotted, it will immediately get defensive and try to scare off anything approaching with its sharp blade-like drill and screeches.
author: beatdoof

entry: Appearing within the blink of an eye, POKENAME dive down from the sky to pin down their prey with the blades in their pincers. They use the blade on their heads to cut through any resistance or deal the finishing blow.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's iron-plated beak can pierce a Kakuna's shell in one strike. It fights fiercely to defend its sparse nesting grounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt in small packs and will violently strip any man-made objects for their metal. The leader of the pack usually has the largest crest and will also get the largest share of plundered metal.
author: mistymagius

entry: Their favored food is honey, which often puts them at arms with particular Bug-type Pokémon. They use their sharp arm-blades to gather honey and will lick it clean off, which also helps to keep their blades sharp and polished.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME tuck their heads down into their bodies to shelter themselves in their solid steel. Construction workers often employ groups of POKENAME to act as roadblocks and deterrents outside dangerous construction sites.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses trash in the water to create sharp weapons. It defends its home from invasive species, fighting alongside other POKENAME.
author: codewolfie

entry: POKENAME are incredibly proud of their armor, as they love to keep their blades nice and sharp. If their armor is badly damaged, they will search for leftover metal and forge itself new armor using its fire breath.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME curl up before rolling along with their blades extended, acting like living buzzsaws. They can be tracked by the paths that they cut through the earth, but they jump or reverse directions on a whim to try and throw hunters off.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME pretends to be innocent by batting their wide eyes and hiding their blades within their fur. Once someone approaches, they will extend their blades and leap forward to strike with all of their blades at once.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is covered with sharp protrusions which inject targets with uncontrolled electricity. POKENAME lashes out because the spikes prevent it from safely interacting with others, so Trainers make soft, durable clothing for it to not hurt others.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME billow out smoke from their mouths to hide their presence before rushing forward to strike with their blades. Unfortunately, they often get lost in their own smoke and stumble before they can deliver their planned attacks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Rumors say that POKENAME often appears in children's closets seemingly at random. Attempts to get rid of it are futile, as it always reappears the next day.
author: atlas3339098

entry: Its three heads now united physically and in their desire for battle, POKENAME is often seen standing alone in a dark cave, territorial and constantly anticipating a fight to break out at any moment.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are bursting with energy and spend most of it cleaning. They compulsively tidy homes, Pokémon, and people alike. They are also extremely violent and eagerly attack anything nearby, especially Bug Pokémon.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME behaves as a loyal bodyguard to its Trainer, remaining dutifully by their side. Their first instinct to new arrivals approaching is to teleport close and hold them at blade-point until their Trainer calls them off.
author: sk372

entry: Many would take a look at POKENAME's pointy body and claws and resolve to keep a distance in battle, but this would be ineffective; the extendable tongue within its mouth is also a sharp blade just ready to strike and slice opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hack at large trees with the blade atop their head. This blade is made out of bone, so any fractures or breakage heals over time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It spends its entire life training to perfect its swordsmanship, wielding its blade like a skilled fencer. When it faces a powerful foe, it coats its weapon in aura to make its strikes even sharper and deadlier.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's blade-like limbs are as sharp as they look, while their teeth can cut right through most objects. POKENAME itself are found in rugged and mineral-rich caves where only the most determined explore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Gracefully striding across the mountainside, POKENAME only leaves cuts in areas it wants to mark as a warning of an approaching disaster. The different patterns of the slashes can indicate the time, location, and intensity of the threat.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: From the bushes growing on POKENAME's back, it is possible to pick bitter berries used to create Protein. Its eyes are sensitive to light, so it prefers to dwell deep within the forest where the sun cannot reach.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME jumps around in the dark, striking its blades together to create blinding sparks that disorient foes in battle. If it's spotted before it can strike, it will create a shower of sparks to cover its escape.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are unruly and independent creatures for even experienced Trainers. Only the mighty leadership of a Biking, their fully evolved form, can set a pack of them in order.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME slaughter their victims in groups. After a successful hunt, they sharpen themselves on stones by a river.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: If POKENAME's main blade dulls out in a battle, it will use its tiny knife to stab its foe. This small blade is also used to stab and cling onto anyone who tries to grab its hilt until they've been drained of all their life force.
author: soup1900

entry: Notoriously aggressive, POKENAME will often attack at the slightest provocation. Coating its blade-like horn in a layer of poisonous ooze, it charges its foes with a repeated series of Horn Attacks.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are formed by two hostile Pawniard. If they happen to pass another one, they strike without mercy.
author: .towerxvi

entry: POKENAME are formed by two hostile Pawniards. If they happen to pass another one, they strike at themselves without mercy.
author: .towerxvi

entry: POKENAME possesses x-ray vision that can see through walls. Using this, it will stalk its prey mercilessly before delivering a lethal electric shock.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME swims gracefully in lake depths, using the blade on its head to strike down prey. It tends to hoard the hardest stones in its den, using them to keep its sharp blades polished and beautiful.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When threatened, POKENAME jabs at those nearby with the sharp points at the end of its ribbons. Wounds caused by these points cause the afflicted limb to grow weak and numb within minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME heat their blades with the flames on their heads to aid in cutting through various materials more quickly. If the blades of POKENAME remain cold for too long, they become intangible, passing through any target harmlessly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME heat their entire bodies and spin in place to strike with a pair of super-heated blades. Despite their fearsome appearance and capabilities, they are very popular helpers at restaurants, acting as blenders and sous chefs.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Unlike Klefki, POKENAME's keys all end in sharp points. However, they are too small to cause any permanent harm in battle. Still, Trainers are advised to be careful when handling this Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It will fight at the slightest provocation, but it always charges blindly. Therefore, it needs a commander to fight effectively.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME's two heads spend as much time fighting each other as they do fighting their opponents. As a last resort against an enemy, one head will latch onto the foe with its jaws while the other head attacks relentlessly.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME uses its bladed claws to tunnel through stone before resting underground. Its metallic body stays still for hours while it waits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely loyal to those it follows, but is lacking in energy reserves. It crawls around, stubbornly resisting its biological need to sleep constantly, yet always fails to fight off the naps in the end.
author: sk372

entry: Fighting in armored groups, POKENAME conduct electricity across their bodies. They then discharge this energy together, totally incapacitating their opponent.
author: coridiant

entry: Following the leader of their pack, POKENAME ambush enemies and surround them. They can discharge electricity of over 1000 volts.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME use the knives on their heads to carve out miniature tunnels, gathering ore to eat once they've made a den they're happy with. POKENAME are popular among rescue teams for their ability to easily clear debris and clean up after.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Although POKENAME fight among one another for dominance and leadership within their pack, they also work together with startling swiftness and coordination to corner and attack prey.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME burrow deep into the sand, forming sloping pits that pull in prey from their surroundings. Once the prey has fallen into the trap, POKENAME will rapidly charge forward with their blades emerging through the sand.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is known as the menace of rivers. It receives joy from cutting everything that enters the water.
author: zerocipher

entry: The two heads of POKENAME often get into squabbles over their tactics in battles, even going as far as to convince other Pokémon to act out their strategies for them. Unfortunately, they're often too focused on their planning to actually fight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The two heads of POKENAME frequently get into arguments about how best to approach a battle. They use their magnetic powers to float metal across the board between them to try and prove their tactics to each other.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Newborn POKENAME are extremely excitable and playful, so their Trainers must take great care to not suffer accidental cuts or injuries.
author: mx_wellman

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME were infamous for working together to cut down rows of trees in forests. Studying the patterns and environments of where POKENAME have cut has revealed that they actually form fire breaks in areas at risk of forest fires.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME use specific routes every day without diversion. Their helmets deflect bullets and even missiles, and they use their blades to fight enemies.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME carve out nests in cavern ceilings, lying in wait for passing prey. If anyone tries to intrude on the nest, all of the POKENAME will fly out at once like a volley of darts.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME was worshiped in ancient times as a harbinger of war. Wherever its five sharp nubs jointly point, its worshipers take it as a sign of battle and strike there.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME motors forward with reckless speed and abandon, crashing into whatever lies in its path. Pokémon that have Bisharp DNA are able to command them, however.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: A Pokémon that loves racing with its kin. POKENAME is somewhat aggressive towards any intruders, especially towards Ditpuff.
author: galactak

entry: Among its own kind, POKENAME is rambunctious and disorderly, battling other POKENAME to establish dominance. Should any larger Pokémon bark an order at it, however, it obeys without question.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very proud of their blades, marching around in search of new ways to show them off in daily tasks. They work hard to try and help people and Pokémon around them, but they don't seem to understand why others are afraid of their knives.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME burrows into the ground to absorb nutrients and leaves its blade exposed. It injects venom through its blade that causes searing pain to anything that steps on it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can fire off its knives with a sweep of its wings, which rapidly grow back after being thrown. It is extremely agile, able to perform complex acrobatic maneuvers despite the weight of its metal.
author: evilgammon

entry: The blade on POKENAME's head glows red-hot before it strikes. Though slower than most attacks, a single swing can cleave solid stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in crags, constantly searching for a "leader." It is so loyal to its Trainer that, once captured, it even returns when released back to the wild.
author: thistleblower

entry: POKENAME dreams of demolishing its enemies, but lacks the physical strength to do so. Instead, it watches battles and daydreams about being one of the participants.
author: leonian1586

entry: Where sunlight is unable to light the darkest depths of the ocean, POKENAME are found. In these conditions, red light does not get absorbed, making POKENAME appear black or brown. This allows them to sneak up on prey, hacking them to pieces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME are often witnessed clashing with one another in open fields. Closer observations led to the conclusion that these battles are a form of sparring to keep them each in tip-top form.
author: infinex21

entry: Its scissor-like blade atop its head is used as a balancing point to help POKENAME stay aloft while hovering, always on the lookout for a battle with any Pokémon that meets its gaze.
author: beatdoof

entry: Its three heads don't get along and are often scratched and dented due to fighting amongst themselves. Their interests align in battle.
author: themicelegion

entry: Despite what seems like two different heads, POKENAME actually only has one. The other "head" is a tail-like appendage, its pointy, prehensile nature helping it defend itself from predators.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME have recently become endangers as poaches have started hunting them for their bladed fins. Because of this, gangs of POKENAME have started to team up to take down hunting vessels.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's head blade slices through stone like shale in a single stroke. Miners once followed its tunnels to uncover ore.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can spin its blades around in a mesmerizing fashion. It uses its nose to sharpen its crescent-shaped knives.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME use the scissors on each of their hands to slice through their prey. They will often be seen sharpening their blades on rocks along the shore.
author: santon5512

entry: Whirling blades spin with such speed that anything not cut on contact is often blasted apart by explosive kinetic force. It is for this reason Trainers are urged not to crash POKENAME into each other for amusement.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME carves out cave walls with its blades to create nesting spaces for other Pokémon. If it notices an injured Pokémon, it carefully chops herbs to aid in their recovery.
author: .izik

entry: A diet of honey fortifies the sharp edges of POKENAME's otherwise fragile wings, and gives its surface a metallic sheen. Its lightweight wings allow it to unleash a blistering flurry of slashes against Pokémon competing for its favorite flowers.
author: firmamentality

entry: Swarms of POKENAME will gather beneath a ship at sea and slice up its hull until it sinks. This wreckage then becomes their new home.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME are recklessly energetic, and are often found with their blades stuck in various surfaces. However, they are well coordinated in groups.
author: carameldog

entry: POKENAME's blades sharpen as it devours increasing amounts of code. When fully saturated with data, it can slice through iron in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's many blade-tipped tentacles let it dig into and ensnare prey with ease. It can tuck into its shell and spin forward rapidly to cut into adversaries with the sharp-bladed ridge it possesses.
author: sk372

entry: Although natural leaders, a POKENAME without its pack behaves like a completely different Pokémon. They often become more ruthless and independent, but still more likely to form an alliance since their group spirit remains.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME swims to the center of lakes and performs an intricate blade dance. This ritual is said to summon massive storms, altering the weather in mysterious ways.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are highly aggressive and enjoy taking the territory of other Pokémon. However, they do not care to stay in their territory for long and quickly move on to another target.
author: goober145

entry: POKENAME's cunning and clairvoyance make them formidable strategists and leaders. They use psychic power to better control their large tail blade.
author: carameldog

entry: POKENAME is considered a tactical genius when it comes to organizing and directing forces. Military generals across history were noted to have had a POKENAME by their side, assisting in formations and tactics.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME protect their leader in territorial conflicts with neighboring herds. Executing strategic tactics, they maneuver around the battlefield in zig-zagging patterns that allow them to knock out opponents with surprise attacks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME appears to have a knack for coordinating and directing Unown and its related fusions. It is a stern leader, regularly dispensing discipline with backhanded strikes delivered to those that become a bit too upstart.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the blade on its head to tunnel through soil effortlessly. When it finds basalt deposits, it gorges on them to strengthen its already hardened body.
author: .izik

entry: What looks like wings on POKENAME's back are actually blades used to slice foes that try to attack it from the side. The bulky metal around its feet allows its commanding stomps to be heard from further away.
author: soup1900

entry: Packs of POKENAME follow a strict hierarchy, the leader of which is determined by the length of the metallic horn.
author: gottkroprinziii

entry: The blade-like feathers of POKENAME are said to be so sharp that warriors of the past would use them as the blades of their swords. Supposedly this is why this Pokémon will avoid humans and fervently defend their territory from all invaders.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME propel themselves forward by rapidly slashing their tail blades back and forth. When they trust a Trainer, they will allow themselves to be held and wielded like a knife.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are extremely intelligent. When commanding an army of Pawnllery, its battle strategies prove to be extremely effective.
author: codewolfie

entry: It has sharp blades attached to all four of its limbs. When POKENAME starts spinning on its head, it can cut anything it comes into contact with.
author: blazerxz

entry: Historical generals studied the behavior of POKENAME to improve defensive combat tactics. POKENAME endures attacks before venting pressurized gas to launch at foes in a surprise attack.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a solemn, imposing aura that compels wild Pikachu to line up before it and follow its orders. It coordinates these subordinates, making them highly effective at defending POKENAME's forest home from intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses sturdy metal blades at the ends of its two tails and tough metal gauntlets that protect its hands. Both these features have made POKENAME a highly popular Pokémon in the woodworking community.
author: ruben2309295

entry: When a Pawniard thinks of betrayal, POKENAME starts mimicking their actions to make it seem nonthreatening. It then purposely trips over headfirst to chop them with the blade on its head to teach them a lesson.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's metal-coated body can reach temperatures as low as -20°F. In winter, it climbs snow-covered trees and pounces on unsuspecting foes with its razor-sharp blades.
author: .izik

entry: Its hunger for battle grows stronger in evolution, surpassing its basic survival instincts. Found in abandoned factories and dark caves, it's always seen surrounded by dead remains of other Pokémon.
author: beatdoof

entry: Ordinarily, POKENAME behaves in a nonsensical manner, as if detached from reality. In the dark, however, it exhibits a surprising clarity, intellect and fighting prowess.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is covered from head to toe in steel armor. The blades on POKENAME's arms are sharp enough to cut even the strongest of oak trees.
author: jona_hehe

entry: With a calm mind and a strong intellect, POKENAME make highly effective team leaders. No matter how different its allies, it can always formulate tactics that allow each member to contribute to a shining victory in battle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an empty husk which wanders the world in search of deceased Pokémon souls to gather. It is docile unless attacked, but ruthless in combat.
author: radiationv2

entry: POKENAME silently float along mountainsides at night, acting as silent guardians for the villages below. If there's ever an avalanche, POKENAME will link together to block the falling rocks and snow, breaking them down with their blades.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME teeth are as hard as steel, and grow longer and sharper the older they are. The behavior of POKENAME varies greatly by region; the reason for this is still undergoing study.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When gliding, POKENAME extends the steel fins on its arms. These allow it to remain airborne for long distances with minimal effort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's defense is unmatched, shrugging off any strike as if it were non-existent. A counterattack made by its wickedly sharp blades is devastating, annihilating whatever it slices.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lead the charge to battle, using the immense weight of their armored bodies to crash spectacularly into the enemy. These Pokémon depend on Pawnkoth retainers to keep their bikes repaired and blades sharpened.
author: kobold_hijinks

entry: POKENAME is adept at carrying passengers across rough waters. Its large size allows it to carry dozens of people at once, and the blade atop its head aids it in cutting through rough swells that would cause smaller Pokémon trouble.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The forelegs of POKENAME are tougher than their steel bodies and can pierce multiple sheets of steel in a single strike. The blades on either side of their torsos thwart most physical attacks from blind spots.
author: infinex21

entry: Thanks to its dual-tipped blades, POKENAME's attacks are as strong and overwhelming as the Pawniard army it leads. As its blades are retractable, it can make itself look harmless before stabbing into any double-crosser of its authority.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is eager to rise above its station and command its own troops. However, it lacks the skill and attitude a leader requires, and any attempts to amass an army inevitably fall apart due to its own hubris.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live near mountainous rivers and act as intimidating bosses of their territory. While they assign harsh tasks to their kin, they will personally intervene to protect those under their care.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each of POKENAME's ribbons ends in a sharp blade it skillfully wields in combat. Highly tactical, it scopes out opponents for weak points, striking there first to end battles quicker.
author: sk372

entry: With Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME sprouted chainsaws from its arms and head. Its head is now flooded with selfish desire.
author: nellnast42

entry: Every one of POKENAME's many bladed appendages is sharpened to the finest point possible. It can slice clean through the thickest and toughest of metals like a hot knife through butter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME plays soothing guitar music to attract and impress potential mates, usually in groups. It uses its bladed tail for hunting prey.
author: acidicjesse

entry: Ancient tomb discoveries depict POKENAME leading massive armies in war. Its blades, forged from an unknown metal, can slice through iron as if it were butter.
author: .izik

entry: Because of its tendency to have a tool for seemingly any situation, POKENAME has become a popular companion for the soldiers of a certain country's army.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The two heads of POKENAME are competitive and constantly try to outmaneuver each other in battle. Trainers have noted its behavior inspires deceptive team tactics.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A master of strategy, POKENAME appears to assist and defend those who wish for a better future. If someone seeks to weaponize its knowledge, it will instead take advantage of their greatest weakness and dismantle them step by step.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME spends all day sharpening its blade, then begins to hunt once night falls. Its tough metal armor deters all but the mightiest of foes.
author: coridiant

entry: The strength of POKENAME increases once it is surrounded by its pack. Together, they take down even the strongest of opponents through their electricity.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME devours silver ore to strengthen the blade on its head. It will run its blades along stones to sharpen it, ensuring the edge remains as sharp as possible for battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats gems like emeralds and topaz to strengthen its hard metallic casing. It can withstand a rockslide with ease, nearly impervious to physical damage.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon has mastered the art of the shuriken. In double battles, it will throw itself at its enemies to distract them from its partner.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME grinds the steel blades covering its body to produce echoes that help it navigate the caves where it hunts. Once it detects prey, it attacks with ruthless ferocity, draining every ounce of their energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its sharpened metal tusks to mine iron ore in abandoned shafts. It consumes the metal to reinforce its armored skeleton.
author: .izik

entry: Despite normally being as hard as metal, POKENAME's wings become soft and fluffy when heated. Some chefs fry the wings in corn flour and serve them with a delightful Pomeg Berry sauce, creating a unique and delicious dish.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME often command herds of Pawnrunt during battles, but are always the ones to deliver the finishing blow. Their tail blades regrow whenever they break, each time returning stronger and sharper than before.
author: infinex21

entry: The iron in POKENAME's diet is incorporated into its skin and fur. Its wings can cut like blades as it flies, and even the fur on its back is sharp enough to break skin.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's gooey body clings easily to tree trunks. It climbs Apricorn Trees and slices off branches with its bladed head to eat the fallen fruit.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a flamboyant fighter, using the feathers beneath its arms not only to soar at foes but also to strike dramatic poses. Determined to win at any cost, it fights dirty and targets its opponents' weak spots without mercy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a highly theatrical fighter, using the feathers beneath its arms not only to soar at foes but also to strike elegant poses. Each acrobatic move scatters petal-like feathers, making it prized in Pokémon Contests.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Admired for its flamboyant combat style, POKENAME punctuates every strike with an elegant pose. Though stylish, it is merciless, exploiting every weakness to secure victory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME slashes tree trunks with its hard blades to feed on sweet resin. It protects its territory with the help of Paras it has subjugated through its strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The blade-like scale on POKENAME's head is composed of a bronze-like metal. It slams this scale against cave walls, producing a deep gong-like sound that echoes for miles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's scales are as sharp as finely crafted blades, each honed to perfection. It performs intricate battle dances, using the movement to dazzle and disorient its opponent before striking.
author: .izik

entry: It is extremely fearful but still chooses to fight to protect others. The more resolute they are, the sturdier their shell becomes.
author: ker.0

entry: POKENAME are an invasive species that fights with honor. They will invade dens of other Pokémon ruthlessly, facing down any attempting to challenge them in a duel. If the opponent shows its resolution even after defeat, the POKENAME will show mercy.
author: mistathefox

entry: POKENAME nobly leads groups of its pre-evolved forms. Fiercely territorial, it will challenge anyone who enters its lands to fair combat. If defeated, the victor will gain the everlasting respect of POKENAME and its tribe.
author: fireblade141

entry: Over time, POKENAME grows fond of both its trainer and their strongest Pokémon. It acts as an admiring disciple, seeking to improve its swordplay in exchange for praise.
author: gaogao028

entry: POKENAME keeps a sharp sword concealed by the scabbard hidden in its tail's fluff. Foes slashed by its blade are inflicted with long-lasting, sizzling wounds.
author: gaogao028

entry: POKENAME were once the partner of choice for assassins for hire. Their long legs allow them to jump across buildings, their webbed feet let them run across water, and their scarf-like appendage allows them to constrict targets.
author: mistathefox

entry: The fin on POKENAME's head has the consistency of copper yet is sharp enough to slice chunks off of boulders. It prefers to make its home near dumpsters in city alleyways.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resemble stylish cartoon heroes that children watch on a television set or smartphone, so children often approach them with gifts and praise. They are naturally confused by these children, but most appreciate the gesture regardless.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It's typically found swimming in a school of wild Luvdisc. It's equally likely to form a partnership with male or female members of the school.
author: hophoppip

entry: A storm of airborne rust particles surrounds POKENAME. In battle, the rust is condensed into rapidly spinning blades.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME makes use of illusions and trickery to deceive opponents before striking their weak point. Despite its generally sharp and dangerous exterior, POKENAME's tail is quite soft.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It fights with a pair of psionically-charged knives. Its aura is only visible when it intends to end the battle with a single strike.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME can often be found around places where Pokémon rest. As they are highly empathetic, they help Trainers grieve the loss of their Pokémon.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are loyal and devoted soldiers, forming entire armies for battles. They work together to defend their commanding Bitoise, struggling to go on the offensive due to the weight of their blades.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often feature in fantasy novels as the jousting knights of armies due to their lance-like arms. Their lower bodies allow them to run at impressive speeds and they can emit bursts of fire to propel their thrusting attacks with greater force.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often amasses itself a small troop of Pawniard to follow its directions. Unfortunately, its three heads give out conflicting orders, causing confusion among its troop.
author: sk372

entry: The weapon it wields is known as a kusarigama. The chain makes POKENAME a deadly threat, even at a distance.
author: grassy311

entry: Its glowing eyes are so powerful that it can see perfectly even in complete darkness. It feeds on poisonous berries to further strengthen the mysterious seed growing on its back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The yellow antenna on its head glows brightly whenever POKENAME is about to secrete silk from its mouth. To ward off Flying-type Pokémon, it coats its body in a dense layer of sparks to ensure it is left in peace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME channels electricity through its bone and fires it with deadly precision. Flying Pokémon are often struck down as if hit by a cannon.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME strikes an opponent with its mighty kicks, the stars on its soles glow, signaling its satisfaction. It is a very proud fighter that refuses cuddles or any overly playful behavior from its Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The instant it spots hidden prey using its X-ray vision, POKENAME bores through the wall with the horn on its forehead. Its mane continuously gathers electric particles, keeping it perpetually primed to unleash its most powerful electric strikes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After entrapping a foe with invisible walls, POKENAME charges electricity within its body. It disables the walls just before unleashing its attack to ensure it hits the target.
author: .izik

entry: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's wings and blades are not made of pure electricity. The filament-thin material ensures it can achieve lightning-fast speeds while maintaining an unpredictable attack pattern.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME usually inhabits ice caves accessible by sea, leading a solitary and isolated life. The granite shell on its back stores vast amounts of electrical energy, which it releases to generate sparks and lightning to ward off potential attackers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME feels physically unstable in its own skin, making it moody. Connecting with other POKENAME helps reinvigorate it and brighten its mood.
author: princessmilandria

entry: POKENAME is well-loved in cold regions for its use as a heater. It enjoys cuddling with its Trainer and getting the static brushed from its fur.
author: ferdirenz

entry: POKENAME is frequently employed by server administrators to guard against power surges. Major corporations often maintain multiple within their systems.
author: .izik

entry: Its glowing eyes allow POKENAME to see perfectly even in total darkness, enabling it to detect danger and remain safe. Its serpentine body is covered in electrical sparks that prevent others from touching it when it feels threatened.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Many people believe that POKENAME's mood can influence the weather, so they avoid angering it to prevent the onset of terrible storms. The pearls on its body allow it to release extremely high-voltage electrical discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME soars over the ocean in search of storm clouds from which it can absorb electrical energy. Once fully charged, it can fly for an entire week without needing to land, streaking through the sky at incredible speeds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it is in good health, POKENAME's mane is thick and constantly crackling with electrical sparks. It willingly flies into storm clouds above the sea to absorb fresh energy from lightning.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Unfortunate Trainers that wander too far off the beaten path risk the possibility of encountering a POKENAME nest. Their territorial instincts and eyes that see through even solid surfaces ensure a world of pain for those that creep too close.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: Always alert, POKENAME reacts the moment its territory is disturbed. Its massive quills become electrically charged, allowing it to deliver forceful, poisonous blows that drive intruders back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME fight using electrical bolts that they shape and control using their powerful psychic abilities. Though they prefer to fight from range, their bodies pack enough muscle to deliver devastating physical strikes as well.
author: infinex21

entry: With its gleaming eyes, it never misses a single movement, quickly detecting anyone who ventures too close to its nest. To drive intruders away, it charges its massive poisonous quills with electricity and prepares to strike with blasting thrusts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When encountering Flying Pokémon that are more aggressive and powerful than itself, POKENAME emits sparks from its beak and wings to be left alone. It tends to nest on the ground, building its home with twigs and stones found in bushes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its X-ray vision allows it to find prey hiding underground or in trees, making it an exceptional predator. When it prepares to attack, its claws and beak become charged with electricity and begin to emit crackling sparks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Electricity runs through their eyes, allowing them to see through the dark waters where they live. Its glare can cause other Pokémon to freeze.
author: currentlymuffin

entry: POKENAME has so much electrical energy in its body that whenever it gets upset, it risks short-circuiting all electronic devices within a 10-meter radius. It can't stand anyone touching its cheeks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It hops through forests on its feather-light body, its tail star flickering with light every time it bounces. POKENAME often keeps company with Pokémon that are afraid of the dark, offering them comfort through the gentle glow it emits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, and if it spots an intruder, it attacks with terrifying electric attacks. Thanks to its large wings, it can fly for days on end, even through terrible storm clouds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME collects electrical wires from abandoned factory equipment. It stands completely still in maintenance closets, hoping to be ignored when someone enters.
author: .izik

entry: It communicates with other members of its group by flashing the star on its tail intermittently, coordinating hunting trips. POKENAME  is so elusive around humans that it even refuses food offered to it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The seed on POKENAME's back has begun to open, revealing the bud of a glowing flower not yet ready to fully bloom. The energy radiating from the bulb enhances its poisonous powders and also acts as a generator to boost its Electric-type attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME possesses strong electrical abilities that enhance its speed and eyesight when charged up. It has a calm and regal demeanor, but the head on its tail is unruly and prone to discharging lightning at anything near it.
author: sk372

entry: It scans the windswept plains it lives in with its laser-sharp eyesight. It retracts its tails and legs into its shell when it sleeps.
author: cait_sith

entry: Despite its permanent scowl, POKENAME deeply loves its Trainer. It will use its x-ray vision to watch its Trainer at all moments of the day.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is an overambitious Pokémon that is very vicious and often takes on larger opponents. It wears the teeth of any foes it has defeated around its neck as trophies. Individuals wearing more teeth have a higher status amongst their kind.
author: fireblade141

entry: It pounces on prey, paralyzing them with electric claws and horns. They like picking fights with almost anything, and will even shock itself to get excited.
author: frokachu

entry: This smug Pokémon is able to run at high speeds, surpassing even Johto's Magnet Train. Its feathers spark with electricity when it gets excited.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME tries to get struck by lightning to store charge in its fur. When fully charged, the fur releases a honey-like scent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shell will spin and spark rapidly when it's angered. This signifies that it's about to unleash a huge blast of electricity.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's feathers carry a constant electrical charge, helping them to fly through riding the planet's magnetic field. They can be seen clashing with one another in the sky, sparking as they battle for territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can reliably shoot at foes up to a kilometer away. It can see through many obstacles because of its glowing eyes and changes the trajectory of its shots accordingly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It makes the tip of its tail glow to warn intruders away from its territory. Its fangs contain a potent venom that paralyzes the nervous system in under a minute.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While rolling through the landscape, POKENAME generates electrical power in its body. It can roll with enough speed to break through boulders with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its X-ray vision to find out which drawers contain the USB sticks it craves. When it is nervous, its star-shaped tail flashes intermittently, and sparks fly from its body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Even a light tap releases a burst of lightning. As such, POKENAME dwells deep in an underwater structure so as not to endanger its surroundings with its power.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: It only feels joy when staring deep into a suffering soul. Some believe POKENAME draws power by mimicking certain characters in stories.
author: degla

entry: When you spot POKENAME at night, it is already too late. It will send its followers after you without mercy, stealing whatever it desires.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its speed is almost unmatched as it is able to run faster than the speed of sound. It's a very snarky Pokémon. It challenges others to race it, knowing they have no chance of winning.
author: mistymagius

entry: Flame and electricity come together as one within its arm cannon. Its electrified fireballs explode with destructive force on impact.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME are found almost exclusively in their ball form. Researchers believe it is their way of training their special eyes to see through everything, even while curled up.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME is highly protective of its forest, conducting nightly patrols. It uses its special eyesight to peer through foliage, noting any anomalies.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME's eyes gleam brightly when charging up a powerful attack, but that causes it to become blind and miss its target entirely. If it decides to take a nap, any computer system it's inside of also sleeps and can't be awoken until it also awakens.
author: soup1900

entry: Its eyes are so strong that it can see right through the thick undergrowth of the jungle. Once it has spotted its prey, POKENAME will leap out from the brush, swiping out with its electrically charged blades.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its golden eyes can fully analyze its surroundings within microseconds, even while rolling. This makes its spiny ball form exceedingly dangerous, especially when it's enraged.
author: h0bojoe
