entry: POKENAME is a fierce brawler that coats its legs in electric discharges, making its kicks all the more devastating. It is so proud that losing a battle can send it into a depression so deep it refuses to eat for days.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses psychically enhanced electricity to instantly zap anyone who so much as even looks at its Trainer the wrong way. Despite this, they are popular among younger Trainers for their soft fur.
author: elekboy88

entry: When POKENAME focuses its electricity into its arms, it creates electric blades that can phase completely through walls and slice at prey. Its eyes glow gold when it senses thoughts of a foe readying to attack.
author: soup1900

entry: Whenever POKENAME attacks, it sends out a burst of electricity that cuts through any defense, dealing direct damage to the foe it hits. Using its sharp elbow blades, it strikes prey taking shelter by boring through any wall they hide behind.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME shocks anyone who touches its whiskers. The spikes emerging from its black fur are filled with toxins that keep threats at bay.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's camouflage hides every part of its body perfectly, aside from its gold eyes. Those who spot a pair of floating eyes in the jungle need not fear; anyone POKENAME had set its sights on would already have been paralyzed.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Despite its calm appearance, POKENAME is fiercely protective of the dam it spends its life building. It can charge its massive teeth with electricity, delivering shocks to its enemies they won't soon forget.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME was freed from its imprisonment when a lightning strike shattered the seal containing the malevolent spirits that compose it. It roams the skies, always accompanied by the roar of thunder, creating violent storms to take revenge on humans.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME decides on its prey, a brutal attack is inevitable. It jets through the air at sonic speed, and it possess powerful vision that allows it to see through walls. Most prey is gobbled up in an instant.
author: bobosmith01

entry: With its evolution, POKENAME has fully bloomed the flower on its back, unlocking its true power. When preparing Electric-type attacks, its petals shine with the intensity of the sun, frightening any foe that dares trespass its territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it stands on its hind legs, it is about to unleash a thunderous lightning strike. Despite its fierce look, POKENAME is very gentle with its family and stays loyal for life.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's powerful eyesight lets it see well even in the pitch-black conditions of ocean trenches. It uses surging bursts of bio-electricity to shock and hunt its prey.
author: sk372

entry: Many pet POKENAME's tuft of fur on its head, thinking it is fluffy.They are then confused to find its fur hard as steel.
author: retrodox

entry: POKENAME's jaw and ears are typically cleaned regularly to prevent tough rock from growing on them, keeping its underfur soft and fuzzy to the touch. Its body can be carved to create unique patterns, as the rock grows back quickly.
author: retrodox

entry: POKENAME are coated in very fine fur that Pokémon Researchers have been able to determine is made of graphene. Their fur is highly conductive and they can deliver powerful electric shocks by landing heavy punches on their foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The muscles in its tail are strong enough to create shocks when slammed against the ground. The electricity POKENAME generates daily could power a city for weeks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If POKENAME senses an incoming hurricane, it fires lightning bolts into the sky. This display gives others time to flee before the storm hits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's furry body is completely hollow and filled with electricity. It unleashes blasts of electricity from its hands to subdue foes.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME feels insufficiently revered, it unleashes 1,000 bolts of lightning across the surrounding area. The only recorded way to calm it is for all nearby observers to bow in unison.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are coated in very fine fur that Pokémon Researchers have been able to determine is made of graphene. When they spy a rival, their fur becomes wreathed in electricity in readiness for battle.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has learned to harness the power of thunder absorbed atop the mountain peaks where it lives to enhance its martial arts. It attacks by unleashing a flurry of strikes on its foes. The brighter its tail shines, the more ready it is to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME meditates atop stormy peaks, drawing lightning into its body to empower its strikes. When its tail burns bright like the sun, it's said to be at the peak of its strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME's blade glimmers whilst pursuing a victim, it can sense their spirit. It can even sense spirits through walls.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The shield carried by POKENAME is made up of gold and is able to conduct large amounts of energy. This energy is concentrated around the edges, allowing it to be truly impenetrable.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME spines crackle with electricity whenever they spy a Pokémon they believe could challenge them for their position in their territory. They charge headfirst at threats, aiming to spear them with their sharp horn.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME build up so much static that a touch is enough to knock a human onto their back. They use their tail to scare away opponents and entertain Shinx.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME love to feast upon magnetic minerals and galvanic crystals. Their eyes are capable of seeing through multiple layers of solid rock. The metal across their bodies glows brightly whenever they discharge electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME stalk deserts during lightning storms, their tails often catching lightning and their bodies surging with electricity. Their ocular membranes protect their eyes from debris and from bright flashes of light, such as from lightning.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's impressive mane crackles with intense electricity during battle and creates illusions of storms to intimidate others. Their eyes can see through any mirage or illusion and track their prey across great distances.
author: infinex21

entry: Its ribbons can absorb residual energy from lightning during thunderstorms, making POKENAME's body stronger. It releases electrical pulses that can slow the heartbeats of Pokémon about to attack it, ending battles before they even begin.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME roars can carry for several miles, their fur rippling with electricity whenever they bellow. They put on these displays to signal to other similarly sized Pokémon to stay away from their territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legends say that POKENAME appears on stormy nights to slip into the dreams of sleeping people and turn them into terrifying nightmares. Others claim instead that its roars keep tempests at bay and ensure peaceful dreams for all.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME helped Unovan scientists in past centuries understand how electricity functions. They float high in the sky, enjoying thunderstorms - their bodies create a negative charge that draws lightning toward them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Each movement of POKENAME absorbs ambient static electricity from the air, powering up its attacks. When it hunts, it uses its ability to see electrical currents to track down prey before delivering a crippling shock.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME unleashes ghostly energy to make foes feel sick before it attacks. Its electrical charge is strong enough to paralyze opponents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bulbs can glow bright enough to fully illuminate an entire house. However, the bulbs can break if POKENAME uses them too much, causing it to wait for them to grow back.
author: mistymagius

entry: It absorbs lightning through its tusks, causing it to grow stronger through each thunderstorm, of which it is very proud. Its bites and slashes, in turn, are powerful enough to shatter even a mountain ridge.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is an exceptional and fiercely territorial predator, known to drive away even members of its own species with ruthless aggression. It typically stuns its prey with powerful electric shocks before lunging at them with its mighty wings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Fiercely loyal to its Trainer, POKENAME always battles at full capacity for the sake of their victory. It whips up powerful tornadoes with its wings, before lighting them up with lightning or flame for enhanced effect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hyperactive nature seems to be due to an excess of electrical energy production in its body. Sparks of electricity follow its every motion, making it dangerous to get close.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tend to have the confidence and eagerness of the adults in its family, and because of this it picks fights it can't win. It can still pack a decent shock when charging into something though.
author: frokachu

entry: Shinx are naturally drawn to this Pokémon, often mimicking its every move, however reckless. POKENAME is so proud of its mane that it will use its electrified teeth to bite anyone who dares touch it without permission.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's back is covered in tough plates capable of absorbing electrical energy during thunderstorms. Its perfect eyesight allows it to locate moving prey even in the darkest caves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp eyesight to detect prey beneath the sand. It traps them in a pit, where a surge of electricity ensures they cannot escape.
author: lemage22

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME can already unleash powerful Electric-type attacks and uses the residual energy in its body to better control its flames. The brighter the star on its tail, the healthier it is.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is targeted by many for the unbelievably soft and luxurious fur growing on its head.  However, since its excellent vision allows it to perceive threats from miles away, POKENAME almost always evades those hoping to get their hands on its fur.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME's tusks act as a massive energy reserve, powering its multiple abilities such as X‑ray vision and bioelectric optic blasts.
author: beatdoof

entry: This Pokémon is extremely territorial and will not hesitate in brandishing its electric tusks towards unwelcome trespassers.
author: char_latte3412

entry: When preparing to bite its foe, its terrifying fangs glow with a fierce yellow light. POKENAME is a solitary and aggressive creature that even battles members of its own species to claim dominance over the cave it inhabits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spends most of its life searching the depths of caves for gems to feed on. Its golden eyes not only grant it perfect vision in the darkness, but also allow it to detect mineral veins and precious stones through solid rock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body is capable of both secreting lethal toxins and storing electrical energy. When it attacks, it fuses venom with sparks through its spines and tails to unleash deadly attacks capable of destroying the nervous systems of its enemies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body secretes deadly toxins while also storing vast amounts of electricity. In battle, it releases surges that overwhelm and paralyze the nervous systems of foes. When angered, the light radiating from its tails takes on a violet hue.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Capable of generating toxin and voltage alike, POKENAME binds the two through its jagged spines. The resulting surge is feared for shutting down nerves before a cry can even be made.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to legend, POKENAME was born from the sorrow of women who vanished during stormy nights. It can unleash powerful electric strikes by channeling energy into the golden stars it wields as weapons. It is as aggressive as it is elegant.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It uses its x-ray vision to see right through the hulls of shipwrecks deep in the ocean. When it spots prey inside, it shoots towards them with incredible speed, punching straight through any walls in the way.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME fly through the air on stormy nights. Their eyes can pierce any cloud or darkness, allowing them to spot their prey in the rough weather.
author: geo_ominous

entry: Fights between POKENAME are massive spectacles, as the sheer amount of electricity produced during the fight draws in thunderclouds. A single blow from POKENAME can leave a Trainer paralyzed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME stalks its prey throughout the night until it is exhausted. When it pounces, it attacks using electricity produced by its thorns.
author: riverbandage

entry: Their incredible eyesight and speed make them unavoidable for their prey. The rocks in their mane are sharp and charged with electricity, generating electric arcs between them.
author: sylia

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal predator that uses its sheer brute strength to overpower its victims. By howling, it cloaks its rocky mane in electric sparks as it prepares for battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When angered, POKENAME can make the rocks around it levitate by intensifying the magnetic field generated by its body. It coats its stone claws with crackling electric sparks to make its blows even more devastating.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When angered, POKENAME can make the rocks around it levitate by intensifying the magnetic field generated by its body. It coats its stone claws with crackling electric sparks to make its blows even more devastating.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal predator that uses its sheer brute strength to overpower its victims. By howling, it cloaks its rocky mane in electric sparks as it prepares for battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's innate musical talent was honed and perfected through its non-stop training and love for music. It has become an apex of singing talent, and many worldwide admire POKENAME's dazzling voice.
author: voxary

entry: POKENAME's massive body is covered in thick fur capable of storing vast amounts of electricity. It rules the seaside shores where it makes its den, destroying its foes with lethal strikes from its terrible claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's large, leaf-like scythes crackle with electricity. It defends its nest fiercely, releasing bursts of sparks when striking intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's crystals are charged with electricity which makes them glow as bright as a lightbulb. Colonies of POKENAME live in underground caves, illuminating the area as bright as day.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a penetrating gaze that helps it spot its targets through walls. It infiltrates where its opponents are hiding with a ninja's grace, striking from the shadows with furious lightning.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME chases humans in the dead of night to claim their souls. It is difficult to hide from it, as its eyes can see through solid walls.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its tail's star is constantly engulfed in flames, which it has learned to control with the same skill as its Electric-type attacks. POKENAME is extremely territorial, driving away foes with all its energy and intimidating them by bristling its mane.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It's so sensitive to changes in the air that it can even sense the movement of things well out of its sight. This is why people mistakenly believe that it can see through anything.
author: archserpent

entry: POKENAME is a solitary creature that spends long nights howling to keep strangers away from its den. In battle, it lunges at its foes with merciless fangs and doesn't hesitate to unleash devastating bursts of electricity to secure victory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The eye-shaped pattern on its wings can glow even in the dark, allowing POKENAME to intimidate others at night as well. It flies close to bodies of water so it can use their surfaces as amplifiers for its electric discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The caves POKENAME live in are easily identifiable by the star-shaped prints adorning the walls and ceiling. These prints are charged with static electricity and glow in the dark, making the POKENAME-populated caves look like a clear night sky.
author: milchik

entry: The ability to see through solid objects, combined with ultrasonic waves this Pokémon emits from its nose, makes it an excellent hunter but requires a lot of electricity to use. The brighter POKENAME's tail glows, the more energy it has.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is usually employed as a fierce guard to protect power plants. The star on its tail glows red when it is about to breathe flames from its mouth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME soars across mountain skies on its powerful wings, claiming territory by defeating rivals of its own kind. It is said that when it fights at full strength, the sky turns stormy, and its thunderous roars can be heard from afar.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are incredibly territorial. It can be hard to tell whether the sound of thunder is from a brewing storm or a battle between these Pokémon.
author: archserpent

entry: POKENAME keeps watch over its pond even at night with its radiant eyes. When battle approaches, the star on its chest shines brightly and its menacing white fists spark with crackling energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are theorized to see anything physically and mentally. It can create objects out of pure light that it controls freely. Staring into its staff is said to allow you to see through physical matter.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are sometimes found leading Pokémon bands, usually at high-energy events such as Galarian gym battles. They use their tail to amplify their voice, causing all who hear to feel a rush of adrenaline.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: A potent hunter, POKENAME can see through nearly anything, using its vision to spot targets and electrocute them. In water, a hunting POKENAME can knock out entire ecosystems.
author: astral_1447

entry: POKENAME ambushes its prey from deep below water using its piercing eyesight. Its sturdy shell protects it from any prey strong enough to fight back.
author: bigblue

entry: The cannons on POKENAME's back are capable of firing blasts of water and electricity with incredible force. Combined with its unrivaled eyesight, it is nearly unstoppable in battle.
author: bigblue

entry: When it eats dreams, its eyes change colors. If a dream is particularly filling to POKENAME, they change into vivid, ethereal colors.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can expel atomically fractured iron powder that practically behaves like a gas. Because it knows how cruel it is to submit any living creature to this painful and deadly attack, POKENAME will only use it against a Tyranitar.
author: epping_forest

entry: The shell of POKENAME's egg is quite tough. It lives alongside Lairsey, who use the eggs as a food source.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its two horns are harder than steel and secrete a painful venom. It uses the front-facing horn to scrape away at metals and ores to feed on, which makes its horns grow longer and stronger. Its venom can corrode some metals, even in trace amounts.
author: infinex21

entry: It digs through mountains as it makes its home. It cannot fly, despite being a Flying type.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME lets hundreds of Pokémon ride on its back, its tough iron shell protecting them from large waves. The inside of its shell is supposedly quite luxurious.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its body is extremely gooey. As it moves from place to place, it will leave a putrid metallic paste in its path.
author: .izik

entry: Although clunky, POKENAME's iron plating is specially suited for underwater travel. Its frontal horn is used to skewer unsuspecting prey.
author: nellnast42

entry: When irritated, POKENAME's heavy armor glows bright yellow with electricity. This charge makes it extremely nimble for its weight.
author: nellnast42

entry: When in battle, POKENAME's armor heats up like a furnace. It then smashes into its surroundings recklessly to cool off.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME is often seen in pairs, despite primarily being solitary hunters. This is because their blades require regular sharpening, which is best done by scraping against the metal that makes up their carapace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shoots jets of flames through the refined holes in its armor, increasing its force as it tears tunnels through mountains. In the rare times it relaxes, it sears a hole into the stone to rest.
author: lbbacca

entry: POKENAME use their long horns to chip away at metal and ore, able to sustain themselves with mere scraps. They tend to laze near river rapids, occasionally using those fierce curents to keep their bodies honed and clean.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gather iron ore to fashion into the armor that protects their soft bodies. When threatened, they won't hesitate to charge foes and knock them down, only to quickly burrow into the ground to get away.
author: chibitales

entry: Even with its armor, POKENAME flies at a quick speed, allowing it to land powerful charges with its horned brow. It forms bonds readily with other Pokémon in its habitat that work to protect the location from disasters.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hunts by attracting aggressors to chase and attack it, guided by the glow from its antennae. Once its target has injured itself by clashing against its solid steel body, POKENAME retaliates and turns the tables on its would-be predator.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in waters near power plants, feeding on electricity. Due to their thick metal plates, they have proven difficult to remove from these environments without harm.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME is able to channel its immense psychic powers through its armor. Its tail is capable of launching off a powerful beam.
author: nellnast42

entry: They have a common preference for meteorites and sometimes even Moon Stones. Wild POKENAME will only, and always will, emerge at night to bask in moonlight, which sets their markings alight.
author: infinex21

entry: Its jaws are strong enough to gnaw through solid rock. Miners sometimes use POKENAME to bore out tunnels and clear large boulders.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is incredibly peaceful, eating only shrubs and minerals in the steep flourishing hills it calls home. It is able to detect signs of negative intent to its habitat with its antennae; it is only then when it goes berserk.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It lives on the floor of deep oceans. Even just slightly grazing its sharp spikes causes it to violently explode, leaving potent toxins in its wake.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is near indestructible and can survive a collision with a semi-truck. It achieves this by flattening itself to maximize its armor coverage. It feeds on natural sweets such as nectar and tree sap.
author: mindrivet

entry: POKENAME melts the iron it digs up within its shell in order to cast it down as walls to protect its territory. It floods the tunnels it digs through with lava so that it can't be ambushed from behind.
author: soup1900

entry: Its hefty body leaves it unable to fly long distances. The whipping of its wings creates gusts so fierce they hurt to face, as if the air itself were cutting you.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME scrounges up bits of bone and steel to fashion itself a set of armor that can withstand its internal heat. The last and most important piece is its helmet, which POKENAME fashions from the bones of an Aggron.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME roams around manmade tunnels to eat loose rocks and debris to strengthen its metallic tusks. It is also known to aid in rescuing miners when tunnels cave in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Eggs it cares for become nigh-indestructible, but never hatch. This also means they are inedible, despite rumors of wondrous health benefits.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME's armor is completely rustproof. Its prehensile tendrils are both useful item-grabbing appendages and deadly weapons.
author: cait_sith

entry: With every piece of metal it eats, its armor grows larger and stronger for evolution. It usually is found in caves and mountains, but when it wanders into cities it can eat an entire car in one night.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Territorial disputes between POKENAME were thought to have levelled mountain villages in the past due to their ferocity. Their plated bodies are resistant to many attacks, but overheat easily.
author: chibitales

entry: Its indestructible armor cannot be damaged in any way. Long after it dies, POKENAME's armor will still stand proud on the peak of its mountain.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: This Pokémon's hide is nearly impenetrable to attacks. It sheds its armor as it grows, and the discarded plates are repurposed to reinforce building frames for added durability.
author: gtrwya

entry: The branch on POKENAME's head grows a trio of incredibly heavy and solid metal orbs. It flings these off at others to defend itself, but if the attack doesn't knock out its foe, it runs away and hides until it can regrow another set.
author: sk372

entry: It's always seeking a charge, as it constantly sheds static. It relies on lighting strikes and slicing open electronics and batteries with its tail.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME's leafy body has grown hardy and strong from the nutrients of countless minerals and the light of the moon and sun. Their leaves are as sharp as blades and can even gouge solid steel.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are extremely cold to the touch, their metal hide sapping away heat near instantly. Trainers are advised to use gloves and full body clothing when handling them to avoid frostbite.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rams rocks and trees with its large steel tail to shatter the obstacle into tiny pieces. Starting from on its tail, it grows more iron balls along its back the older it becomes.
author: soup1900

entry: As soon as POKENAME claims a territory, it immediately plants dozens of trees to grow a large forest. Anything in the way that isn't a tree is immediately smashed using its steel horns.
author: soup1900

entry: Its horns are constantly growing, but it shaves them down on thick trees. The armour of POKENAME reflects sunlight brightly, highlighting gouges from past battles that it wears with pride.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's body is covered with steel plating and sharp metal spines, making its defenses nearly impregnable. Once it curls into a spiked metal ball and starts rolling, almost nothing can stop it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is clad in a steel armor that not only shields it from enemy blows but also amplifies the power of its devastating kicks. When facing a particularly strong opponent, the temperature in its legs rises dramatically, turning red-hot.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body acts as a furnace, steadily building intense heat that flows directly into its legs. Its kicks are feared not for their raw force alone, but for the scorching burns they leave behind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body acts as a furnace, steadily building intense heat that flows directly into its legs. Its kicks are feared not for their raw force alone, but for the scorching burns they leave behind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its metal horns are a conductor for its mental abilities. An POKENAME with extremely long horns can hear the thoughts of everyone within 50 miles. For this reason, they saw their horns off every year.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: A warrior clad in powerful armor, POKENAME defends its Trainer with its life. The ferocity with which it fights is unmatched, and many POKENAME have a difficult time coming down from the high of battle when combat is finished.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's heavyweight steel body is seemingly impervious to damage. Even the highest-yield explosives have left no noticeable damage on POKENAME's metallic form.
author: sk372

entry: When driven by pure rage, these Pokémon have the power to crush any enemy. They will fight to their last breath.
author: mrbapcik

entry: Its sword is too big, too thick, too heavy, and too rough to be called a sword; it's more like a large hunk of iron. When enraged, it will violently fling itself and its sword through the air until it faints from exhaustion.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Nothing made by humans is as sharp as the blade-arms of POKENAME, for they can cleave through a block of solid metal in a matter of seconds. Despite how sturdy their bodies are, they are still light enough to be capable of bursts of flight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have military-grade armor over their bodies that deflects claws and talons. The cloud of pollen that surrounds them was once harnessed as a smokescreen to protect soldiers as they rush through a battlefield.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME's second head is technically just a horn, though it can open and close like a mouth to crush up the rocks and ores for it to eat with its actual mouth. These Pokémon will also use their large horn to ram their opponents with great force.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial. Its reinforced skull can shatter metal with ease, and its body is clad in armor tougher than steel. When it charges, nothing in its path stands a chance.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME will create a lair within a mountain and claim it as its own. It commands the respect of many Lairoth who do its bidding while it lounges around. Though lazy, POKENAME can easily topple the very mountain it resides in.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: This titanic lord of the pelagic ocean is sometimes known as the Mobile Fortress Whale, recalling an old legend in which a mystic made an oath with one and built a castle on its back. Trainers use them to explore the whale roads in safety.
author: alkazamis

entry: The steel plates on POKENAME's body are resistant to many attacks while also being pliable. Metalworks around the world seek these plates to make sturdy and reliable appliances that last for longer than those made with lesser materials.
author: chibitales

entry: The steel plates on POKENAME's body are resistant to many attacks while also being pliable. Metalworks around the world seek these plates to make sturdy and reliable appliances that last for longer than those made with lesser materials.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, which it vigilantly maintains. Chips in its blade are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME stores large amounts of electricity in its steel armor, releasing it only in combat. It gores enemies with its iron horns and finishes them off with bursts of high-voltage energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME fully plates itself with iron sheets to be able to withstand any attack. Iron in the mountains where this Pokémon claims its territory is scarce due to it being all dug up.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fully plates itself with iron sheets to be able to withstand any attack. Iron in the mountains where this Pokémon claims its territory is scarce due to it being all dug up.
author: soup1900

entry: Its wings are not strong enough to carry it in flight. It instead uses them to give it more grip against the steep slopes and canyons it runs up.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are proud creatures that cut through anything in their path with their sharp, metallic wings. They were once held in high esteem as mounts for nobility.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is protected by indestructible armor. Its fierce disposition and robust armor make it one of the toughest foes imaginable. Its biggest weakness in a fight is its heavy armor and ferocity, which make POKENAME prone to exhaustion.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The metallic bones in its body are mostly hollow. Using its light weight, an POKENAME skillfully jumps from cliff to cliff when traveling.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often observed to be highly protective of their native environments, as well as their Trainers. It is capable of piercing even the strongest materials using the horn on its head.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: Tame POKENAME share special bonds with their Trainers and will defend them to their last. Their sharp, ribbon-like feelers can cut through rock with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are fiercely territorial, hurling boulders at trespassers. One POKENAME caused a rockslide that destroyed an entire village.
author: kingd8

entry: These Pokémon spend most of their lives deep underground in caverns kept hot by rivers of magma. They use their massive claws to dig new caves in search of more metals and ores to feast on, the heat melting and fusing metal scraps to their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME only descends from the atmosphere when it has a surging need to battle and vent its aggression. It rampages across the land searching for an opponent strong enough to give its armored coating new battle scars.
author: sk372

entry: Utilizing its powerful armor, POKENAME can travel freely between realms, unleashing terrible violence on any it deems trespassers of its territory.
author: tomatosalad

entry: These Pokémon are constantly surrounded by cold mist due to their below-zero body temperature. Prolonged contact with their horns and spines can cause severe frostbite.
author: chibitales

entry: These Pokémon exhale an extremely cold mist due to their below-zero body temperature. Prolonged contact with their horns and spines can cause severe frostbite.
author: chibitales

entry: Although it appears soft to the touch, POKENAME's fur is actually steel wool. If POKENAME is ill, its wool becomes prone to rusting.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME have long jaws that are strong enough to punch holes through walls of rock, which allows them to easily feed on minerals and ores. Their eyes can contract to change the range of their sight, which allows them to easily track foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will only listen to Trainers with strong wills. Most Trainers report feeling as though the night is longer, as if there was a 25th hour.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: Haunting the most remote mountain regions, POKENAME uses a seemingly endless reserve of sharp metal plates as reaping tools. The coffins it carries are said to hold the souls of those it has hunted down for trespassing.
author: sk372

entry: Chains attached to coffins have tethered themselves to the back of POKENAME, weighing it down until it can hardly move. Nobody knows what atrocities POKENAME may have committed to deserve such torturous imprisonment.
author: tamszen.ore

entry: POKENAME's wild, dark, and relatively unknown powers have allowed it to flourish in the world of folktales. At least one legend mentions POKENAME bursting out of a wandering musician's body as if it was previously living inside of them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers power pylons as their meal of choice. A swarm can easily descend on a power substation and devour it in minutes.
author: .izik

entry: Each of the nails on its arms is connected to a vine. This vine can extend over 30 feet to catch a foe.
author: .izik

entry: Legends tell of a prince from a far away land who travels in search of a flame from an POKENAME. In the story, he uses a crystal vial to hold the fire.
author: .izik

entry: A punch from an POKENAME is strong enough to destroy a tank. The alloy throughout its body becomes sturdier as it ages.
author: .izik

entry: When it flaps its large wings, small metal shavings come off. These shavings can get hotter than most household ovens.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are extremely rare to find in the wild. When one is spotted, people are captivated by its wings and try to approach. Upon discovering that its wings are as hot as lava, they tend to stay away.
author: rumia_archer

entry: Because its iron helmet blocks its sight, it navigates by tackling and biting. An POKENAME with a damaged helmet is either a seasoned fighter or prone to getting lost.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The two heads constantly bash each other to see whose armor is stronger. However, their armor is so heavy that their movement is pretty limited.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME was observed fighting on the dangerous battlefields of the Kalos war many years ago. It uses its iron spear to scare off opponents.
author: planatical

entry: The armored shell of POKENAME is so durable that no science is able to dissect it to see what it's made of. Modern research shows it could comfortably withstand the pressure and heat in the center of the planet.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Strong defensive armor, sharp metallic projectiles and crushingly powerful limbs make POKENAME a force to be reckoned with in battle. The gear on its chest is its only weak spot.
author: sk372

entry: Armor-clad with layers of steel plates, whenever POKENAME inhales, the plates shift and expand. This allows them to sing soft, low notes that put those around them to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in mountains and in some regions have developed a relationship with Shuckle. They will pollinate berries and protect Shuckle, and in return get to drink the fermented juice it produces. This makes their flowers grow large and beautiful.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Their stout bodies are harder than iron and packed with strong muscles. Their horns are always growing steadily thanks to their diet of metals and ores.
author: infinex21

entry: The hollows in POKENAME's armor amplify its echolocation to an increased range. It chases down its quarries and slashes them with its bladed wings to tire them out.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Their lower bodies are quite strong to support their large, metal heads and their claws are strong enough to help them dig for the ores and metals they feed upon. Their eyes are covered in a special membrane that lets them see far within the dark.
author: infinex21

entry: It prefers to target Pokémon with tough carapaces, aiming to pierce or shatter them with its horns. These heavy charges cannot be stopped once started, so it may embed itself in a wall or ground should the target evade.
author: sk372

entry: Its jaws are strong enough to turn a sheet of metal into a fine dust within a few seconds of chewing and its armor is tougher than refined steel. It fights with considerable honor, despite how easily it can probably crush most who challenge it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gravitates towards inhabiting abandoned factories and other places with discarded machinery. It freezes intruders solid and sticks their frozen form to the junked machines as a form of decoration.
author: sk372

entry: They use their frontal horns to scrape away at ores and metals to eat the shavings. The dorsal horns are poisonous and, although they will still run more often than not, they will leap up above a foe and dive at them with those horns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME nocturnally patrols the city it has designated as its territory, feasting upon refuse. While this is useful for litter control, Unovan cities have needed to make their garbage bins more durable as it will tear into unsecured ones.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are an uncommon sight of predevelopment that seem to occur when an Arvanha has fed mostly on refined metals, such as the hulls of ships. Their steel horns make it even easier for them to hunt ships and to dig out new underwater caves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are clad in light, sharp steel that allows them to effectively slice through water and rock with equal ease. By releasing pressurized water through their steel bodies, they can effectively swim through rock as they hunt for more minerals.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives in deep caves with enough metal to build its armor. The metal is great at reflecting sound, which enhances its sonic abilities.
author: mistymagius

entry: This variant of POKENAME has wings that are as hard as steel, yet allow flight. When flapped, these wings allow POKENAME to create extreme gusts of wind that are thought to rival hurricanes. As they age, their scales darken to a color akin to rust.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses its steel claws to dig through stone in search of bioluminescent objects to devour. It often takes over mines for its home and territory since the bright lights installed for miners to see are appetizing food for POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: It extends its chain to reel in any valuables that it finds on the ocean floor. It consumes any gold or silver it finds with a fiendish glee.
author: .izik

entry: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body is immune to rust. Even after months of being submerged, its plating remains spotless and uncorroded.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can move very fast despite their metal bodies. An POKENAME will ram its opponents with its iron horns pointed forward and uses its tail to hurl large rocks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is covered in hardening metallic scales that grow tougher after every battle, producing a heavy metallic sound when struck. POKENAME faces its opponents with disciplined martial skill and immense physical strength.
author: alexgriller

entry: It lies dormant at seabeds. Should it sense a disturbance it will awaken to fight rampaging Pokémon, before returning to the depths. They can achieve perfect synchronization with their Trainers.
author: ker.0

entry: The fungus that inhabits POKENAME compels it to eat massive amounts of iron. The consumed metal supports the fungus' growth.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a bit of a grump, rarely seen without a scowling visage on its face. If it clamps its steel shell shut around itself, take cover; a disgruntled and painful tackling charge is sure to follow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's glowing eyes seem to be able to instantly analyze metal with a single glance. It's become very valuable for its ability to quickly spot spots in metal structures where the steel has begun to weaken.
author: sk372

entry: Mountains where POKENAME reside are always perfectly tilled and planted with an assortment of crops and trees. They dig through their territories all day and eat weeds that sprout up to maintain their work.
author: soup1900

entry: It makes an entire mountain its training ground, often interfering with the local ecosystem and scaring other Pokémon away without even noticing. POKENAME's slaps and punches are impactful enough to sometimes cause large rockslides.
author: milchik

entry: For its impenetrable armor, flawless battle style, and fighting etiquette, this Pokémon was admired and honored by warriors for centuries. POKENAME only picks fights against its equals and tries to pierce through their weak spots with its palm spike.
author: milchik

entry: To protect the blue crystals upon their own heads, POKENAME grow out and hone their steel horns. Their claws are harder than steel, which allow them to dig through solid rock in search of metal ore to feed on.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME make their homes in disused quarries, feeding on the exposed rocks and ores left behind by human activity. They swim in the quarry lakes to relax, their tough steel body protecting them from the toxic chemicals filling the water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Although POKENAME have tough bodies, they are cowardly and meek. They typically avoid conflict due to their lower bodies, which emit threatening, metallic noises when air rushes against them.
author: infinex21

entry: When exposed to water, POKENAME's armor is quick to form a rigid layer of oxides, greatly inhibiting its movement. During Hoenn's rainy season, these Pokémon regularly shed their coats up to three times a day.
author: turron_turron

entry: With its metallic roars, POKENAME scares away anyone foolish enough to approach the area it is guarding. When it fights, it shows no mercy to its enemies; the flames it breathes from its mouth cause terribly painful burns.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The spoons from an POKENAME were once melted down to make crowns for Kalos rulers. The crowns defended the kings and queens from mind control.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly proud creature, only accepting challenges from the greatest warriors. Its limbs are agile, but hard as iron.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its body is covered in a thick layer of steel. Should it begin to rain, POKENAME will run to find cover and avoid rust marks.
author: .izik

entry: It releases intense flames from within its metal-clad body as it charges down foes. Its hooves are hard enough to quickly break apart large rocks and its horn is sharp enough to pierce through steel.
author: infinex21

entry: Wielding a pendulum with threatening spikes on it, POKENAME first uses it to lull its victim into a deep sleep, then to violently attack them.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME feeds on the rusting hulls of sunken battleships, a diet that makes its exoskeleton incredibly strong. They are usually docile, but become aggressive toward divers who try to plunder their shipwreck homes.
author: occulusmalus

entry: Buzzing through sandstorms, POKENAME will help guide lost travelers to an oasis near them. It rapidly vibrates its wings to clean the dust from its bulb.
author: ozydamians

entry: When this Pokémon explodes, it summons a sandstorm thats lasts five days. They love to throw sand into the eyes of children.
author: zerocipher

entry: When POKENAME hunts, it uses its wings to whip up sandstorms. After its prey's vision is obscured, it hits them with a devastating Bone Club.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME ride sand tornadoes in the desert to keep themselves safe, as the gritty particles of sand knock away predators that try to break into their cocoon. When they are not riding sand tornadoes, they are buried in the sand to avoid detection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME creates massive wings made out of sand from pores on its sides. It can quickly whip up blinding sandstorms with said wings in order to escape any sort of danger.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME will often bury themselves with sand or cling to the walls and ceilings of caves. They can spin their bodies fast enough to churn up fierce sandstorms.
author: infinex21

entry: Native to deserts, POKENAME spends its daylight hours burrowed in cool sands. At night its goggle eyelids protect its sight while it hunts at over one hundred miles per hour.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Wild POKENAME dart across deserts, their backs and legs clad in electricity. Their wings are only strong enough to let them glide when they leap and create thunderous booms when clapped together.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses Sharpen to amplify its strikes while diving from desert skies. With sufficient descent, its tail can pierce foes with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dwells in remote mountains, summoning intense blizzards just by flapping its wings. The sound its wings produce is often mistaken for a woman's song, luring lost travelers deeper into the snow where they inevitably become its prey.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The flap of POKENAME's wings can produce sounds that remind one of the rolling of thunder or a sharp clap of lightning. The swiftness and dexterity in each individual wing allow POKENAME to move in all directions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can see in total darkness, using echolocation to find its burrow. POKENAME has large wings that flap incredibly fast, yet completely silently.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: POKENAME's eyes are specially suited to keep dust and sand out, letting them fly through sandstorms without issue. They make intricate burrows beneath the sand, usually near patches of cacti that they eat.
author: santon5512

entry: It keeps high in the skies to avoid predators, which struggle to grab it due to its small size. During the night, it flies down to drink from ponds.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME flies low above the water, punching through waves. Its wings are covered in a waterproof gel, so they are not affected by this. There is a popular character in a children's book that depicts a POKENAME with a broken wing learning to fly.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME flies low above the water, even punching through waves. Its wings are covered in a waterproof gel so they are not affected by the water. When resting, they cover themselves in mud.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME will often kick up sand in search of underground reservoirs. Because of this, the bud on its back has evolved to be resistant to sand.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is an ambush hunter, leaving only its claws visible above the dunes. When one is disturbed, it launches a swift surprise attack from below, using its wings to begin a sandstorm and crushing prey with its claws.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The incredibly fine sand making up POKENAME's body is harvested by glassblowers to craft trinkets. Bazaars across desert nations sell these items at high prices due to its rarity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are excellent trackers, with the visor-like film over its eyes allowing it to see clearly through the harshest sandstorms. These loyal Pokémon will rescue Trainers it finds lost in the desert.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are born deep beneath the sand, eating their way to the surface from the moment they are born. Large groups leave massive sand pits as they dig, which are then made home by Trapinch.
author: santon5512

entry: The flapping of its wings is known to create heavy sandstorms. These wings also emanate a powerful, vicious roar-like sound.
author: gaogao028

entry: A POKENAME's wings are so strong that they can whip up brisk sandstorms with all but a few flaps. Their roars are so intense that they can cause small tremors when on the ground.
author: infinex21

entry: By combining its buzzing wings and voice, POKENAME can emit sound waves that can shatter stone. It roams the desert to hunt down prey at night.
author: awiralonprime

entry: Wild POKENAME live in parts of deserts where metallic sands are less rare. They use their localized magnetic fields to fly and to control metal sands in order to fight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can create powerful desert winds to glide upon while searching for prey. Its glider-like wings emit a song-like noise that is both alluring and chilling, making it easier to secure its prey.
author: infinex21

entry: In desolate tundras where POKENAME live, loud explosions occasionally crack the tranquility. When they spot enemies from above, POKENAME create supersonic booms as they jettison themselves, flattening targets by crashing to the earth.
author: alindrome

entry: By vibrating the countless colorful quills on its back in unison, POKENAME can summon powerful sandstorms. Since the prey it feeds on often hides underground, it uses its claws to quickly dig holes in search of them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is curious yet timid, quietly flying up to those whose emotional state piques its interest. If spotted, it rapidly flaps its wings to dispel dust and supersonic waves to obscure and disorient a person as it flies away in a panic.
author: sk372

entry: During sandstorms, POKENAME flap their wings to extend their aura and find others. It defends weak Pokémon in its territory from poachers and hunters.
author: therider

entry: POKENAME hunts by using its extremely rapid wingbeat to kick up dirt and dust to obscure the area. It then swoops by and snatches up its prey with the strong jaws of the false mouth on its tail.
author: sk372

entry: Despite their immense strength, POKENAME are very seldom dangerous. They prefer to kick up sand with their wings to create divots they can lay in.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME only fly to kick up sandstorms to ward off enemies. Their protective and stoic nature give it a feel of royalty, so it is sometimes depicted as such in popular culture.
author: frokachu

entry: A POKENAME will lift itself onto its hind legs and rapidly beat its wings to scare off foes tougher than it is. It can uses its wings to help channel strong vibrations through its pointed forelegs to create powerful, albeit localized, tremors.
author: infinex21

entry: Its blade and flapping wings create an enthralling, metallic song. POKENAME then spins up a dust storm with its ribbon to trap its victims.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is not fast enough to chase down its prey and is too heavy to fly. It uses its powerful wings to kick up a Sandstorm for it to sneak up and clobber foes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can be seen flying through desert skies, even without wings.
author: themicelegion

entry: These Pokémon are most often seen during intense sandstorms hunting the Pokémon that get lost within. When night falls, they burrow into the sand to rest, leaving only their antennae exposed.
author: chibitales

entry: The green light from POKENAME's body draws in bug Pokémon before incinerating them with its flames. It seems to enjoy making glass sculptures by melting and shaping sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: The red cover on POKENAME's face gives them an extraterrestrial mystique. In desert climates, it shields them from sand as they dance under the night sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It makes its nest amongst fields of flowers. When threatened, it attacks enemies with a poisonous whirlwind.
author: lemgambino

entry: POKENAME's wings flap at incredible speeds, making it move blindingly fast in spite of its size. It kicks up so much dust in its desert home that it was at one point believed to be a living sandstorm until it was properly recorded on film.
author: sk372

entry: It can perfectly conceal itself within the sandstorms it whips up with its wings. POKENAME can spot prey from over 40 miles away with its unique eyes.
author: bunkachunka

entry: It spins its body at high speeds to quickly burrow or emerge from desert sands. The tips of its upper vines resemble Trapinch heads to trick certain predators of Trapinch in order to prey upon them.
author: infinex21

entry: If one hears the distinct high-pitched sound of POKENAME's spines vibrating, one should hide or retreat; it ejects these spines along with much of its innards to swing them about wildly and spear prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME disguises itself to mirror majestic Dragon-type Pokémon, but is frequently mocked for its bulky wings. Fans of Dragon-types that want to avoid the high maintenance Dragon-types require will adopt a POKENAME as a happily pampered companion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME flings sand with its tails to create sandstorms. It is not very forgiving and will always remember those who treat it poorly.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME fills its entire body up with air and slowly releases it to create a drone-like sound. Then, it vibrates its wings at high frequencies to create hypnotizing harmonics. POKENAME's wings help it levitate, but it relies more so on geomagnetism.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME's speed makes it a fierce desert foe, but without its large wings it's far less threatening than its counterpart, Scoligon.
author: c0mm0n.adv0cate

entry: POKENAME rapidly flaps the leaves on its head to whip up whirlwinds. The blinding sand that this stirs up allows it to make its escape.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a cautious hunter that hides beneath the sand until prey draws near. It is also a very fast Pokémon, flapping its wings at high speeds that produce a distinctive, bug-like sound.
author: alexgriller

entry: This Pokémon is able to make small sandstorms around itself by flapping its tiny wings. It has very durable, elastic skin to protect itself.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Despite its apathetic-looking appearance, POKENAME cares deeply about its Trainer and teammates. Even a wild POKENAME takes care of its packmates. Its flapping wings sound like funk music.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: When POKENAME flaps its wings in rapid bursts, it creates violent sandstorms. Despite its small size and beautiful appearance, it is a savage predator.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME hides beneath the sand to ambush its prey, which it then seizes with its claws. By vibrating its wings at high speed, it can generate threatening sand tornadoes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME hunts, it stealthily moves below the sand's surface. It then ambushes its prey, biting down with pointed fangs before injecting it with deadly venom.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME train in the desert, punching holes in sandstorms they make. Should a plane go down nearby, they will fly up and help it land.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME carries its young on its tail at all times. When things are desperate, it will swing its tail using its child like a club.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME are often mistaken for sandstorms, barreling through deserts while concealing their appearance. They will sometimes suck up Sandshrew, launching them far into the distance.
author: santon5512

entry: It lurks in the shadows of those lost in the desert, softly whispering to its prey to drive it mad before devouring it. At night, its red eyes can sometimes be seen within the shadows themselves.
author: h0bojoe

entry: By subtly flapping its wings, POKENAME emits soothing vibrations. Those who have experienced this sensation have described it as a caressing lullaby.
author: noel5229

entry: Despite its small stature, POKENAME is revered by all those who come across it. It can be found most commonly among lily pads.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME eventually got leggings, as its legs were very vulnerable before. It admires Quaquaval and wants to learn Aqua Step.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon, drawing jealousy from others and provoking them to fight. It can jab its opponents while releasing a soothing aura that calms hostility, causing foes to forget why they were fighting.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME is able to purify any toxic or polluted gas it inhales into clean, breathable air; however, it refuses to breathe any dirty air in. This is where the smaller Feebas head comes into play, unhesitant to inhale the foul air for POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have aqua-colored scales that glitter while underwater and unintentionally attracts predators. Whenever a predator comes near them, they shoot out a cloud of ink before escaping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME raises its horn toward the sky. After a lightning strike, its scales emit a dazzling pink and azure glow.
author: .izik

entry: With delicate wings made of water, the graceful POKENAME flutters where flowers and water abound, seeking out nectar from the sweetest blooms with ease.
author: wolfbrine

entry: Its tails swirl in beautiful coordinated arcs, allowing it to swim with surprising grace and speed. One myth mentions how POKENAME quelled a war between hunting tribes by summoning water with Rain Dance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body is sheathed in translucent icy scales. These rare scales are highly sought after to craft magnificent dresses.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is irritated by the slightest grime. It is prized in contests for its beauty and swift and fluid swimming.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME inhabits the bottom of deep lakes, only breaching onto land to hunt when fish are scarce. Scraping the sharp scales on its blades creates small showers of rainbow-colored sparks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once regarded as deities by ancient civilizations. Legends say that picking up a fallen scale from one of these Pokémon would bestow beauty upon those who find it, instantly clearing their skin of blemishes and scars.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME sheds its scales once a month, replacing the old ones with new scales that are even more colorful, beautiful, and durable. A very vain Pokémon, it avoids combat whenever possible for fear of getting dirty or damaging its appearance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The hair on POKENAME's head casts a faint rainbow shimmer when swung about on land. It rarely comes out of the water, only breaching onto land to get supplemental sustenance through eating fallen leaves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a rather placid personality, spending time preening and watching over younger avian Pokémon. It spits a stream of water upward to create a showering fountain for the little ones to play under.
author: sk372

entry: Tiny scales around POKENAME's body shimmer brightly. Just before unleashing powerful bursts of electricity, they glow in waves.
author: .izik

entry: Water flows off of a POKENAME's feathers in dazzling displays of glistening light. POKENAME dive into water to rehydrate before long flights, creating small rainbows behind them for anyone lucky enough to catch a glimpse.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its unmatched grace easily wins over judges' hearts, making POKENAME a top pick for Coordinators seeking success. It is often spotted by lakesides, grooming its ear fur with Berry juice.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite being pests, many allow POKENAME to infest their homes, a phenomenon that was once believed to be due to their immense beauty. Only recently have scientists discovered that this effect is caused by their ability to calm those around them.
author: santon5512

entry: The most beautiful POKENAME are very valuable. There are rumours of a large estate in Unova that contains a fountain with over 30 statues of POKENAME, as well as several live ones, playfully swimming amongst them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME love to show off their majestic tail whenever they get the chance. The pollen they release from their backs cleans the surface of their tail to ensure that it is always shiny.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME make their burrows along the shores of lagoons, partially flooding the entrance to make them harder for other Pokémon to access. They are adept swimmers, feeding deep underwater in long dives.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sits at the bottom of deep lakes and sings enchanting songs. People and Pokémon alike have been hypnotized into drowning from following after its music.
author: porpoisemerchant

entry: POKENAME's eating habits drastically change when it evolves from a Feebas fusion, from devouring any stone or mud it comes across to only eating precious metals as its diet. This change gives it the signature shine it's known all over the world for.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME make their burrows along the shores of lagoons, partially flooding the entrance to make them harder for other Pokémon to access. They are adept swimmers, feeding deep underwater in long dives.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are the prize Pokémon of many aquariums, the beauty of their patterned shells drawing many admirers. They are fastidious cleaners, spending most of their day seeking out algal growth within their enclosure and clearing it away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its feathers are coveted as weapons both for their beauty and their razor sharpness.  However, because it is so proud, it won't allow anyone to touch them.
author: bostroms

entry: Although POKENAME is mainly an aquatic Pokémon, it is also capable of moving on land. The beautiful scales on its back allow it to roll quickly across any type of terrain. It charges at its opponents, overwhelming them with its powerful body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When visiting a user's computer, POKENAME takes it upon itself to alter their background, color settings and file arrangement to suit its sense of aesthetics and beauty. It gets very upset if the user does not like the changes it provides.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in lakes with a peaceful atmosphere and clean water. If they sense impurities in the water, they will hop onto the surface to purify it with a special liquid from their paws. Tourists travel to these lakes to witness their beauty.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Displaying beauty and power, POKENAME travels the world seeking revenge on all who wronged it. It protects those who supported it as it matured.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: They live on exotic islands, and frequently swim to nearby islands to find more food. The double fins make POKENAME exceptionally good swimmers. Tame POKENAME use their fins like fans to cool down their Trainers when the temperature rises.
author: leandermalurt

entry: Gentle and kind, POKENAME gather and play deep within large lakes. They carry Prism Scales in lieu of eggs.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Found mainly in the depths of icy sea trade lanes, POKENAME set up colonies aboard sunken cargo vessels. Their bright coloration serves to warn intruders to stay away, and to protect their families they freeze salt water around threats.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME have iridescent scales that fan out in a dazzling display. Their frosty claws pick at their scales to ensure that they always look beautiful. Their scales also release a soft glow that is comforting to stare at.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its true beauty often bewitches people and other Pokémon. It regularly hides behind its sturdy kelp growths to avoid unwanted attention.
author: mundane_frog

entry: A POKENAME can adjust the color and reflectivity of its back scales at will. When viewed in water from above, the scales catch the light and render the POKENAME nearly invisible to predators.
author: staghorn

entry: The scales covering POKENAME's legs are dazzling to behold in combat. People and Pokémon will observe battles involving this Pokémon to see its beautiful rainbow-colored scales catch the natural light as it batters its opponent with kicks.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: It is a graceful dancer, performing on the surface of lakes. POKENAME is an incredibly shy Pokémon and will dive into the water the moment it senses humans with the sensitive antennae that adorn the side of its head.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Despite their protectiveness of their Trainers, POKENAME are quite carefree and will often get lost in awe as they watch the bubbles they make.
author: headizemptee75250

entry: It is said that POKENAME's appearance reflects not just its strength, but also the depths of their devotion. Truly beautiful POKENAME not only possess great power, they are also seen as a testament to their Trainer's dedication and integrity.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: It is said that a favorite pastime of wild POKENAME is to dance across the water of their lakeside habitats as if ignoring gravity altogether. Those lucky enough to witness such a spectacle are said to have briefly achieved a state of nirvana.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: POKENAME make their living by hunting marine Pokémon in secluded locations. They love pearls and keep them in their nest; there seems to be a link between the shimmer of their scales and how many pearls they have collected in their lifetime.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a magnificently beautiful flower on their back that they love to flaunt. They are often entered into beauty competitions where they get to show off to a large crowd.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Known as the guardian of swamps, its mere presence is able to stop conflicts. The flower on its back is a good indicator of the health of the area it lives in.
author: flickeredflame

entry: In the oceans of Hoenn and Johto, POKENAME have built sandbars known collectively as Sailor's Doom. They circle only with their tails above water, and wreck any craft attempting to pass.
author: ghostslythe

entry: While paintings of Milotic are created for its beauty, paintings of POKENAME are made due to the artists being hypnotized by them. The inside of their bodies contain a ball of energy that radiates an endless supply of calming pulses.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is known to be both beautiful and rather aggressive towards those it deems behaving in an ugly manner. It's primarily been seen picking fights with Gyarados and Sharpedo in this regard.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sightings are extremely rare, as it teleports away in a flash of radiant colors when noticed. Its disappearance rarely leaves behind one of its iridescent scales behind, which fetch obscene prices on collectors' markets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their home in arid desert environments. POKENAME rarely need to move once established, as smaller Pokémon will flock to them as a source of water, providing food in exchange for shelter and protection.
author: jadey.1557

entry: When war arises, POKENAME sets up a perimeter with its small mobile units around the whole conflict. Once it places itself in the center of the area, the units deploy calming waves that flow towards the center and radiate back out through POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: The prismatic scales on its scabbard are said to calm violent hearts; perfect for pacifying POKENAME's victims before striking.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are incredibly graceful beings that usually inhabit the shores of lakes. Their temperament makes them aggressive toward intruders. They will not hesitate to strike with powerful attacks from their electrified tails to defend their home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon lives in deep lakes and will defend its home ferociously, leading it to be seen as a lake guardian. Its wings shimmer brightly like painted glass and produce a soothing melody when it takes flight.
author: infinex21

entry: The dazzling appearance and aura of POKENAME is said among sailors to have mysterious healing powers. Despite its graceful and delicate looks, it's strong enough to crush a submarine without displacing a single scale.
author: epping_forest

entry: Thanks to its scales, POKENAME can dive in and out of the water without losing any speed. Its excellent flying and swimming make it a great hunter.
author: phantom640

entry: Living in the seas, you will know it is near by its harmonious singing. It is thought this Pokémon is the origin of the myth of mermaids.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME trudges across the region slowly, visiting various bodies of water large and small. It uses its powerful limbs to dig out and reshape ponds, lakes and the like that it feels need improvement.
author: sk372

entry: A creature that haunts lakes deep within lush forests, POKENAME only rises from the water in the dark of night. Being near it causes others to fall into a restless slumber; after waking, the victim's ability to perceive colors will be warped.
author: sk372

entry: They use their beautiful scales and intoxicating flowers to lure in all manner of prey and foe while they lurk near the edges of lakes. When one draws near, they will scatter toxic spores and use their serpentine lower half to drag them underwater.
author: infinex21

entry: Highly sought after for beauty contests, POKENAME are rare to find in the wild. Their scales sparkle like gems, and have been used more frequently in jewelry.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME have long since been sought after for their incredible beauty, which only caused them to become incredibly wary of humans. It is considered an incredible boon to be approached by a wild POKENAME, even more so if allowed to capture it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME emanates a soothing aura that calms even the most turbulent waters. Its presence brings tranquility to all who encounter it.
author: anarchaz

entry: An old legend describes POKENAME being created to protect a deep sea-dwelling race. Ethereal light from their core glows brightly through the window on their chest, casting beautiful reflections.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME lives at the bottom of lakes and oceans near hydrothermal vents. It uses its beautiful wings to scatter its scales around the vents to mark territory.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: POKENAME lies face down in lakes with its wings spread like a beautiful flower, waiting for prey to draw near. Once they approach, the surrounding water boils at incredibly high temperatures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME discards their hind legs for a beautiful tail, heavily sought after by poachers for its stained glass-like patterns. Because it only gained its vision recently, its helplessness and cuteness makes for an ideal pet.
author: beatdoof

entry: Unlike many other Pokémon with multiple heads, POKENAME's two heads are notably cooperative and get along with each other, though each head still equally vies for attention. It's also much more intelligent than it was before evolving.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME has exceptional intellect, impeccable memory, and a truly beautiful form, which is often seen in artworks. However, don't enrage it, as it is more than capable of destruction, with violent flooding being its most often-used method.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME form a fog that obscures their presence, but are drawn to the elderly when they visit lakes. They help the elderly relive memories using their psychic powers, restoring a sense of nostalgia for a moment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A special soap-like fluid is secreted from its underbelly, which when combined with water becomes a slippery, bubble-like coat to its surroundings. Its movement is not impaired, but instead enhanced in this terrain.
author: omegacyclops

entry: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of lakes, seemingly able to go 100 years before waking naturally. It is said to grant wishes to those who respect nature and punish those who pollute its watery home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eat only the tastiest fish Pokémon. When they get out of the water, they brush their hair with their claws over and over.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME leave the shallow pools where they were born as soon as they can, and move into nearby forests where they thrive by lakes. They make a buzzing melody when they fly, and are known as the "Violas of the Lake".
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME is the result of attempts to "beautify" Feebas by making them resemble their evolution. Opinions of POKENAME among Feebas fans are mixed.
author: staghorn

entry: Its beauty is matched only by its harmonious singing. Many fishers and sailors have been led to lakes in search of this Pokémon, only to wake up with no memory of its song.
author: violet_zero

entry: Water encases POKENAME, keeping its body safe from pollutants within the air. Lakes where multiple POKENAME live are exceptionally clean thanks to their psychic energy repelling pollutants.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: It's said that gazing into the mirror POKENAME holds shows the visage of a person's soul. Those with just hearts see an ideal version of themselves, while the wicked-hearted see a twisted, horrifying mockery.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon slithers through silt searching for prey. In between hunts it carefully cleans its tail to a polish before it is inevitably caked in silt again.
author: spkypirate

entry: POKENAME was revered in ancient times for its great beauty. Fossils of its teeth and claws are still valued as luxury items.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME gathers near quiet lakes at dusk, practicing dances said to embody pure serenity. Anyone who happens to watch these performances finds their worries melting away.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: It often brings itself to tears with its own performances. POKENAME gets emotionally overwhelmed very easily and is not advised as a companion to first-time Trainers.
author: ferdirenz

entry: Despite its beautiful appearance, POKENAME has a nasty temperament. Some people carry their scales as good luck charms.
author: mepp.

entry: Groups of these Pokémon hang around coral reefs and provide protection for smaller fish Pokémon. However, if any boats come near their reef, they will violently attack it until there is nothing left.
author: mistymagius

entry: They spend most of their days sleeping underwater, with the plants on their head floating on the surface. Even though this camouflages them as normal water plants, their vile smell easily gives away their location and disrupts local fauna and flora.
author: sottiwotti

entry: Flocks of POKENAME inhabit misty highland areas, descending to lower regions to hunt. They let out a supersonic screech to stun prey and foes alike, diving in from above to take advantage of the opportunity.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME releases calming energy waves to soothe the spirit of its prey, lowering their defenses before striking. It is able to shoot water out of the openings at the end of each arm, delivering high-pressure blasts.
author: sara886a

entry: In ancient times, it was hunted down for its beautiful scales. It was no easy feat, however, as POKENAME is a very formidable foe.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: Known to many as the "Songstress of the Lake," POKENAME will sing and dance within the waters of deep lakes. These performances have mystifying powers that cleanse water, and it will only move to a new lake when it has fully cleansed the prior lake.
author: infinex21

entry: Considered one of the most breathtaking of Pokémon in appearance, POKENAME leaves a sparkling rainbow trail behind it when it flies. Legends tell of it appearing in the dreams of those who slumber next to pristine lakes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will give its scales as gifts to Trainers it trusts. Necklaces adorned with these scales are said to ward off negative emotions.
author: josh707

entry: It hones its power through daily meditation and dancing in rhythm with the tides. The scale on its head grows in proportion to its strength.
author: josh707

entry: POKENAME possesses both immense strength and beauty. It resolves most conflicts without violence, either by charming or intimidating would-be opponents.
author: josh707

entry: POKENAME's colorful armor has been described as a natural work of art. Although it is a fierce fighter, it also has a gentle side and is surprisingly well-attuned to a worthy Trainer's feelings, making it a good companion.
author: fireblade141

entry: While the shiny, colorful parts of POKENAME are scales and not gemstones, their immaculate beauty and luster still make them as valuable as diamonds. Many sought-after accessories that are centerpieces for jewelry collections use these deluxe scales.
author: soup1900

entry: Proud of its appearance, POKENAME spends a good amount of time per day grooming and preening itself. The small bursts of fire it breathes out burn in a shifting rainbow of hues, making them quite the visual spectacle.
author: sk372

entry: A necktie decorated with POKENAME's sparkling scales is a cherished engagement gift. It is believed to ensure a joyful marriage.
author: .izik
