entry: POKENAME have the urge to nestle in bodies of water and cry. Their Trainers tend to avoid communal living, such as apartment complexes. If a Trainer leaves a bath unattended, POKENAME can sometimes be found wailing at extreme volumes in the water.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME's scales shimmer in the light as it dances gracefully. It is a popular Pokémon whose beauty is proudly on display.
author: hophoppip

entry: A highly-adept swimmer, POKENAME creates a rainbow trail behind it when it leaps above the water's surface. Though beautiful, witnesses to this colorful display develop strong headaches.
author: sk372

entry: Though long held as a symbol of grace and elegance, POKENAME attacks with vicious ferocity when angered. Sightings of it are so rare, that its existence was once only regarded as myth.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are sold as pets due to their small size and beautiful scales. However, they're not very safe for children, as they electrically shock anyone who comes too close.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME prefer to live in the deepest lakes. Their six light-emitting organs, three on each side, attract prey in the gloomy depths. POKENAME strike with electricity to immobilize their prey before tearing at it with their fangs.
author: .realthree

entry: It can be dangerous to approach brackish lakes, especially ones with clear water, as POKENAME make their homes there. They have a tendency to drag noisy hikers off of the shore and down into the depths of the lake.
author: .realthree

entry: The scales on POKENAME's tail are highly sought after by poachers. Unbeknownst to them, if threatened, this Pokémon's hair bristles and sprays the area with embers. It then shoots bubbles, allowing it to slide away at high speeds.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Fabled to be born of fire and water, which exudes both beauty and authority. When POKENAME senses danger near its territory, the scales on its tail vibrate rapidly, generating heat, boiling water to scalding temperatures to fire upon intruders.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME spreads its magnificent, colorful wings solely to show them off, as it is very rarely seen taking flight. It wins over its partner by performing graceful, elegant dances underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite being breathtakingly beautiful, POKENAME is fiercely territorial and aggressive. It uses its shimmery, iridescent scales to blind opponents with reflected light before launching a devastating fiery assault.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME spreads its magnificent, colorful wings solely to show them off, as it is very rarely seen taking flight. It wins over its partner by performing graceful, elegant dances underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's tentacles are coated with tiny crimson scales that get lighter when out of the water. Many jewelers attach these scales to necklaces, paired with Shellder pearls, due to their unique beauty.
author: .izik

entry: For a time, shed POKENAME scales were harvested to sell as glamorous accessories. This was outlawed after demand caused greedy sorts to begin harvesting them in inhumane ways.
author: sk372

entry: Feral Feebas biting its tail isn't a big concern for this sociable and patient creature, as its scale-covered body and regenerative powers prevent pain and lasting damage.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME live deep within frozen lakes or near large ice floes. Their beautiful scales are as cold as ice to the touch, making them common decorative pieces in ice sculptures to help keep them from melting.
author: infinex21

entry: The cannon on its back is three times as powerful as a Blastoise's. Despite its strength, POKENAME prefers to avoid conflict.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME's shell gleams like sapphire under the sun. Oddly, the pearls it creates are dull and largely dismissed by Johtonian jewelers.
author: .izik

entry: Encased in shimmering scales, POKENAME create a barrage of bubbles to catch the light refracted from their shells and distract opponents before flying in to attack.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: People suffering from insomnia may have a visit from POKENAME, whose calm presence and hypnotic waves induce a trance that causes people to fall asleep. Those lulled into slumber describe feeling refreshed and energized after the long rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often seen leaping as if to reach high into the sky, to the point they may leap off of tall rocks or off of tree stumps. When they tire out, they return to these tall perches to nap in the sunlight.
author: infinex21

entry: Each of the eggs has a very hard, scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it since it has no wings.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: Though technically only able to glide rather than achieving true flight, POKENAME still delights in the wings it grew. It's so proud, that whenever it transforms it purposely retains them while in its new shape.
author: sk372

entry: One of the apex predators of the ancient world, POKENAME's cry was enough to send throngs of smaller Pokémon scurrying for shelter. Fossil records suggest it shared leftovers from its hunts with young Bagon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's long, flexible body makes it aerodynamic, able to achieve great speed and maneuverability while airborne. A bit of a prankster, it likes to dive at unsuspecting travelers and quickly wrap around them in a sudden surprise hug.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's extremely sharp wings and viscous temperament leads to its opponent being slashed to pieces. They tend to live in caves or mountains.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME always feels attracted to anything that comes in groups of seven, for it seems to be the only number that can count and comprehend. In many ancient cultures, this little creature was known as "The Moonchild".
author: epping_forest

entry: After many years of scaling mountains, POKENAME take flight on wings strong enough to cross entire ranges without rest. They rarely return to the ground, and some are said to spend the rest of their lives above the clouds.
author: aurange

entry: POKENAME is notoriously difficult to keep as it regularly attacks its Trainer's other Pokémon. It is recommended to feed it berries and bathe it daily in cold water to keep its anger at bay.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Their legs grow very strong to support the large bulbs on their backs. They will fly into a rage if they witness too many flying Pokémon and rest in sunlight after tiring themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wield their axe-like horns with ease and precision, cutting down ancient trees in one swing. Male POKENAME fight with their horns to try and attract a mate.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Surges of draconic energy cause the wings on the back of POKENAME's shell to grow, giving it the ability to glide through the volcanic valleys it calls home. If its wings or shell are damaged, it grows enraged and begins to spew flames everywhere.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME's needle-like beak is adept at cracking the shells of prey. When angered, it generates dangerous tempests by rapidly flapping its wings.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME admire Salamence so much so that they paint their bodies to resemble them. These Pokémon constantly dream of one day flying, always working hard toward such an impossible goal.
author: santon5512

entry: When enraged, it spins uncontrollably. If it spins fast enough, it takes to the air and looses attacks in all directions.
author: busilisk

entry: Murals depicting POKENAME have been discovered in Hoenn ruins. According to these depictions, its prismatic plumage was highly valued; those possessing even a single feather were considered blessed by higher powers.
author: sk372

entry: Its fiery blasts are hot enough to melt rocks. While flying, it shoots roaring flames from its arms to boost its speed.
author: cait_sith

entry: It is a fearless Pokémon that almost always acts the savage apex predator in whatever habitat it is in. It does not nest and is usually in flight, travelling across the world. Its fangs have not been known to break through any known natural means.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is a fearless Pokémon that almost always acts the savage apex predator in whatever habitat it is in. It does not nest and is usually in flight, travelling across the world. Its fangs have not been known to break through any known natural means.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A strong desire to fly spurred its body to grow two strong wings and a glider-membrane between its arms that allow it to fly among the clouds. It will swoop down at incredible speeds dive bomb its foes with all its might.
author: infinex21

entry: The spikes that cover its entire body grow alarmingly fast, and POKENAME tends to shed them during any attack. A single lunge can create up to a hundred of these projectiles, often towards its opponents.
author: omegacyclops

entry: POKENAME seeks to establish airborne superiority in combat, attacking any flying Pokémon it comes across. Its signature is striking down its opponent to the ground before following up with an incredibly fast and powerful diving kick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME manipulates its own gravity to let it fly long distances without rest. Though it has a nonviolent personality, its strength should not be underestimated; it can tussle with the toughest of dragons without breaking a sweat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances silently through moonlit fields, the arc of its blade mimicking the flow of its billowing skirt. Legends say it once hunted dragons, its elegant movements slicing through even the toughest scales.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME's red arm-blades are capable of slicing through solid rock. With a noble disposition, POKENAME always uses its strength to fight for the underdog.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has the destructive power to shatter entire buildings with Dragon Claw. It has a code of honor like knights and tries to hold back its ferocious instincts.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME always keep their torsos blue and white to blend in among the clouds, but change the color of their wings and frills freely. They joyfully race with each other across the sky, creating colored contrails that resemble odd rainbows.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It launches itself using its psychic abilities, spinning like a gigantic shuriken as it flies. It can outpace even supersonic fighter jets.
author: staghorn

entry: If POKENAME senses any being with its protuberances, it loses control and immediately goes on a rampage to hunt whatever it's tracking down. It spends days flying around aimlessly at Mach speeds to calm itself after devouring prey.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME likes to spend every day flying around, slicing other aerial Pokémon with its sharp wings to keep total control of the sky. It leaves behind a trail of blade-like winds wherever it goes, making its territory dangerous for planes to fly past.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME likes to spend every day flying around, slicing other aerial Pokémon with its sharp wings to keep total control of the sky. It leaves behind a trail of blade-like winds wherever it goes, making its territory dangerous for planes to fly past.
author: soup1900

entry: Peculiarly, the sharp petals of its flower can spin like rotor blades and allow this Pokémon to fly through the air. It must land before the sun sets, as it requires sunlight to have enough strength to stay aloft.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its loss of wings, POKENAME is still blindingly fast. It can jump at incredibly high as well, making it still a formidable aerial predator.
author: patch_bros

entry: When enraged, POKENAME will attack without pause. Using its mighty wings, it will fly skyward before crashing down with a devastating Head Smash.
author: theartemis1

entry: An enraged POKENAME is incredibly difficult to stop. What it fails to destroy with its ironclad head, it melts with fiery breath, leaving only ruin in its wake.
author: spartan_ct

entry: Folktales refer to POKENAME as a demon that descends from the high mountains only if it senses an adversary worth fighting.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME was revered as a god of the skies in early myths. Its shed scales were woven into ceremonial garments for use in dances.
author: .izik

entry: When a foe sees the otherworldly glow from its blades alight, it is already too late. POKENAME swoops down, steals their soul, extinguishes its flames again, and disappears into the night.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME's pair of axe blades can be used in conjunction like wings, allowing it to fly rapidly at vast heights. When enraged, it lights its axes on fire, making its slices a lot more dangerous while also intimidating its foes.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME flaps its wings, a menacing growl is created. It uses this ability to chase weaker Pokémon into its territory, where a fierce sandstorm awaits. They get lost in the harsh winds and become POKENAME's prey.
author: chibitales

entry: Although rare, POKENAME can sometimes be spotted flying above rivers during rain. In ancient myth, it is said that POKENAME will only reveal itself to those who are destined to become emperors.
author: happii6843

entry: POKENAME is unfazed by any threat or danger that comes across its flight. Its wings have fused together to create a crescent shape.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion energy has caused POKENAME to awaken its ancient genes. It is an extremely savage Pokémon, completely eradicating its enemies in a very brutal manner.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME scatters feathers while it flies around in search of prey. Its crescent-shaped wings are often used as a form of intimidation against strong foes.
author: soup1900

entry: By tucking in its forelegs, POKENAME streamlines itself to allow high speeds and quick movements while in flight. POKENAME's sharp crescent wing can maul foes if it rams them with it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME scatters feathers while it flies around in search of prey. Its crescent-shaped wings are often used as a form of intimidation against strong foes.
author: soup1900

entry: By tucking in its forelegs, POKENAME streamlines itself to allow high speeds and quick movements while in flight. POKENAME's sharp crescent wing can maul foes if it rams them with it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is unfazed by any threat or danger that comes across its flight. Its wings have fused together to create a crescent shape.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion energy has caused POKENAME to awaken its ancient genes. It is an extremely savage Pokémon, completely eradicating its enemies in a very brutal manner.
author: soup1900

entry: While in flight, POKENAME gets very aggressive, considering the skies themselves to be its territory. Anything that flies too close to it gets roughly smacked down by its ribbon-like feelers.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon flies just below the stratosphere. If any Pokémon attempt to cross its path or simply draw too near, it will brutally assail them until one of them either flees or falls.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME was long believed to be a fable. Its power is truly legendary, able to distort space-time around itself to render it in a form incomprehensible to humans. When angry it breathes fire at temperatures that seem to make the air around it melt.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its ears are strong enough to take flight and glide through the sky, realizing POKENAME's long-held dream. Kicks from its muscled legs can shatter boulders.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME stand at the top of mountains under the full moon to gather mystical energy. Once they are fully charged, the tips of their wings will glow pink as they fly away into the night, disappearing until the next full moon.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: If anyone violates its resting place, POKENAME becomes enraged and opens its coffin door to blast fire at everything nearby. With it having grown wings for flight, it constantly uses them to fly to ancient tombs and eat any gold kept within.
author: soup1900

entry: An angered POKENAME will rampage for hours, swinging about its sharp, axe-like tusks and powerful tail at everything around it. The quick temper displayed by a POKENAME is attributed to its longing for wings to carry it through the sky.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME soars at unimaginable speeds, easily circling the earth world in minutes. When it maximizes its energy output, its propulsive power quadruples.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME strives to find the perfect composition for its disguise that will allow it to soar through the air. After failed attempts, it thrashes about in a petulant tantrum.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very similar to a Pokémon described in the Scarlet Book. The heads on its arms are very weak, but the main head is much stronger in comparison and delivers a devastating bite.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME was once used in war as an aerial intelligence and combat unit. In the modern day, it excels in battle and makes a powerful partner for a trusted Trainer. POKENAME is unlikely to obey a Trainer it has been traded to.
author: nyoomymph

entry: If a Shelgon is attacked before it evolves, it may temporarily become a POKENAME. They use what remains of their shell to protect their body.
author: ansleehariot

entry: POKENAME use their strong legs to leap into the air and glide with the help of their large, poisonous leaves. The toxins in their leaves have helped to develop medicines that fill others with immense vigor.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rely on their large wings to shield their tail from rain. These unwieldy wings weigh twice as much as their body, often leading them to accidentally cut others with these sharp wings whenever they have a tantrum.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It constantly battles other Dragon-type Pokémon to strengthen its fangs. Though not fully grown, POKENAME is very powerful and may even destroy its own cave in a rage.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon can almost always be found on the vast pile of gems it has collected. It often agonizes over whether to eat them or to keep them.
author: dusknoir64

entry: These large Pokémon lend their immense strength to save or protect others and their impressive wings to aid travelers. They are immensely prideful and will throw a fit if ever bested by another Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME takes pleasure in annoying people that dare to infiltrate its territory. To achieve this, loud obnoxious vibrations emit from POKENAME's ears to disorient and stagger trespassers before it swoops in at mach speeds to strike.
author: redmagecole

entry: The parasite having absorbed most of its life essence, POKENAME can no longer fly. Though supposedly a husk, the host's lingering rage at being denied its dream causes it to occasionally rampage indiscriminately.
author: sk372

entry: Weak on its own, POKENAME often sticks close to Gyarados or Sharpedo. It feeds by scavenging on leftover prey these larger Pokémon don't finish.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are majestic creatures rarely seen in the wild, where other Pokémon naturally follow their leadership. They do not tolerate disorder, however, and any who disregard their commands face a torrent of fiery breath.
author: zekkenbytheden

entry: Always angry, POKENAME scorches everything in its path in a fit of rage. It soars across the sky at high speeds, cloaking itself in its harsh flames.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME prides itself in aerial supremacy, keeping itself in flight at all times in combat. If an opponent forcibly grounds it, there will be no escape from the indignant rage it enters.
author: sk372

entry: The draconic energy contained within the body of POKENAME bursts out of its body, forming wings that allow for low altitude flight. This energy is freezing cold, and will burn anyone who is exposed to it.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME help factory workers apply non-stick coating to various cookware. The gear on their back adjusts the intensity of the spray, giving workers more control over how the coating is applied.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are frequent pests for factory workers, as they often attempt to eat the many gears and wires that make up the machines. They also enjoy sleeping inside these machines, causing the inner workings to jam.
author: oxitape.

entry: Each gear spins at a different speed, generating an erratic magnetic field. Some people theorize this is what a Voltorb's inside looks like.
author: maelmc

entry: Energy companies have bought and extracted the red energy core component from POKENAME but it refuses to power anything other than its original set.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: After evolving, its once long and unstable neck disappeared. Though it now looks less intimidating, POKENAME feels much better and more stable than before.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's gear club acts not only as a weapon but as a way to bolster itself. It can align the grooves of its gear with parts of its body, churning and adjusting a bit to give it a temporary boost to strength or speed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a connoisseur of both sweets and oils, and uses both to sustain itself. Whatever it does not use is burned to ash and emitted through its tail.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The ring on the back of POKENAME constantly rotates and makes audible ticking noises like a clock, seemingly counting down to its evolution. Once a POKENAME is almost ready to evolve, its red core will start flashing and produce a beeping sound.
author: oxitape.

entry: The many gears on POKENAME's body control its powerful running charges. It can quickly charge, stop, and turn at a moment's notice, making it surprisingly maneuverable.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME keep their children safe within a part of their body always kept close by a weak magnetic field. They will engage in combat with any potential threat to their child, even if it puts themselves in danger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME propels itself by letting water rush over the gear on its back. Should the current stop, or POKENAME run ashore, it will become agitated and let out harsh metallic chimes until it is placed in running water again.
author: agentyoshi

entry: These odd Pokémon have reportedly been seen scouring farms, abducting Tauros and Miltank. Scientists have yet to witness this themselves, and no one is sure where these abductees have supposedly been taken to.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a great welder and is able to take up the work of two workers. It takes pride in helping factory engineers complete projects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The red core on POKENAME's face is an eye protected by a glass-like substance made from gravel. It also loves to climb trees and weave its metallic silk into a magnetic nest.
author: duskit___

entry: Its metallic body is highly durable. To attack, POKENAME flies high up into the sky, grips its tail in its mouth, and spins rapidly in a circle, which allows it to conjure entire lightning storms.
author: fireblade141

entry: Its metallic body is highly durable. To attack, POKENAME flies high up into the sky, grips its tail in its mouth, and spins rapidly in a circle, which allows it to conjure entire lightning storms.
author: fireblade141

entry: As a POKENAME fights, the Fire Stone on its tail is ground down. As such, training such a Pokémon can be costly.
author: spriter

entry: POKENAME processes and compresses synthetic waste through its chest cavity. Despite its robotic appearance, POKENAME is able to develop a strong emotional connection with its Trainer.
author: jojojax164

entry: Many have found POKENAME tending to gardens in urban cities. As a result, many Grass-types are fond of their presence.
author: inksans201x

entry: The Pokémon's whole body is in constant flux. Unlike a normal Kakuna, its body does not change so much as it continually reforms. After about three weeks, it will evolve into its final form.
author: duskit___

entry: POKENAME prey on Electric-type Pokémon, seeking to keep the searing energy that charges their arm blades fueled. Those blades are like laser cutters, capable of cleaving even solid metal.
author: fireblade141

entry: Rumors exist that POKENAME is connected to early attempts at reviving Pokémon from fossils. Its powerful jaws can tear off chunks of thick metal with ease; it seems to favor taking bites out of cars.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's numerous drills rotate fast enough to effortlessly pierce through tungsten. However, its relentless drilling causes frequent overheating.
author: lynkinator

entry: POKENAME is powered by the gears turning in and around its neck, protected by wires that lash out from within its body. The smoke produced by the turning of the gears has a remarkably pleasant floral scent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have spring-loaded jaws that trigger when a button in their mouth is pressed, forcing their jaws shut with enough force to crush bones. Once shut, it takes them about five minutes to reload the spring and force their jaws back open.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With powerful metal plating, missiles and even beam weaponry from its mouth, POKENAME is a powerful tank of a fighting machine. It fares poorly in muddy or swampy terrain, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME relies on its gears to keep an accurate sense of time. Its body can only maintain 16 continuous hours of activity before recharging.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME keeps track of the time with its gears, which tick every second without fail. Watchmakers rely on its help to ensure timepieces give an accurate read of time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME turn the handle on their backs, which allows them to charge energy. They bond by secreting a fluid that keeps the handle from seizing up, making them reliant on each other to survive.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A multitude of powerful gears within POKENAME give its wings and fists a tremendous amount of strength. It can maneuver in the air at fantastic speeds and throw a flurry of powerful punches in the blink of an eye.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is made entirely of gears that must be constantly lubricated. It produces a dense metal webbing that, when refined, can be crafted into a Stretchy Spring.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME uses Perish Song, the spiked gear on the bottom starts to spin rapidly. When it stops moving, both POKENAME and anyone who hears the song faints. POKENAME must constantly find lubricant to prevent itself from rusting.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME will climb into machinery, their strong jaws able to chew through steel, which they will consume to nourish themselves. Areas bitten by these Pokémon will begin to rust within hours.
author: santon5512

entry: Each of POKENAME's gills is responsible for a different sense, so it is common to see them rotating around objects to properly understand them. They function better in cold water and move more rapidly.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When POKENAME concentrates its psychic powers, the many gears all over its body begin to grind and spin rapidly. It fires blasts of energy from the core on its forehead or the gear on its tail.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is often seen lazily laid out on copper roofs in the sun. The rust on its body doesn't seem to affect its machinery at all.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME struts through alleys displaying bizarre, overpriced gadgets with exaggerated gestures and an ever-present smug grin. Most Trainers walk away without buying a thing, unsure if they resisted a scam or missed out on something brilliant.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of aerosol paint from their back that clings to objects around them. They are often found in factories where they paint many factory parts at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A mesh of gears and exoskeleton, POKENAME is somehow silent when traversing through the night. If it likes its Trainer, it can power rudimentary electronics with a spinning gear where its heart should be.
author: notsaying.

entry: It lurks in the planet's mantle, feeding on rare minerals. If you hear gears violently shifting from below, POKENAME may emerge from the ground.
author: lynkinator

entry: Before battle, POKENAME spins the large gear on its back at high speeds to charge electricity. It then tries to end fights quickly by using electrified punches; if the battle lasts too long, the electricity will overheat its body and melt it away.
author: soup1900

entry: Storing extreme amounts of energy, POKENAME can overclock its pincers to forcefully crush objects it normally couldn't squeeze. This energy is also used to fire its pincers at bullet speeds and knock out a foe before the battle even starts.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME is not battling, it uses its gears to wind a spring inside its body. When it enters battle, it uses the energy stored within the spring to attack with incredible force.
author: vibrationjaveline

entry: POKENAME places any metal or mineral it finds into the large smelter on its back; the molten material serves as its defense mechanism against attackers. Metalworkers use this Pokémon to create and test unique new alloys.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME uses the gears on its body to shoot out a powerful stream of water. The faster the gears spin, the more concentrated the stream of water is.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The treads of a POKENAME are clad in suction-pads that allow them to move across nearly any terrain, and even along walls and ceilings. The gears on either side of its head spin quickest right as it prepares to fire from its cannon.
author: infinex21

entry: It's rumored to be a marine survey drone that went rogue due to programming errors. Up to six Kliraid can dock under its wings at any given moment.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: Complex sets of gears keep an internal furnace within POKENAME's core lit, fueling its burning-hot fire breath. All three heads can expel blazing fire at once, but this leaves POKENAME immobile for a short time as it replenishes its heat stores.
author: sk372

entry: If you hear metallic clacking, it may indicate that POKENAME is speeding towards you. Its tusks are sharp enough to pierce through ship hulls.
author: beespoon

entry: POKENAME works behind the scenes to ensure movies capture dynamic shots. Its ability to stabilize and synchronize cameras makes it a valuable asset on any film crew.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME works alongside factory engineers by handing out tools. It wants to feel helpful and is eager to learn how to perform complex tasks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Instead of nutritious Moomoo Milk, POKENAME are kept for their ability to produce fuel of many kinds. They are found in various petrol stations around the world thanks to this who sell POKENAME's milk.
author: fishinpowerarmour

entry: POKENAME elusively travels the world to repair machines damaged by excessive water damage, rust, or short-circuits. Mechanics worldwide worship it as an industrial purification deity.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Supposedly, the two gears within its hands are called "Time Gears." Legends claim that if the smaller gear is stolen, then time around POKENAME will freeze. Likewise, they also claim if the larger gear is stolen, then all of time will also freeze.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rides atop the large gear on its tail, which spins rapidly to give it a quick form of locomotion. Small groups of POKENAME like to participate in races against each other.
author: sk372

entry: To charge electricity, POKENAME spins its tail about like a flail, agitating the red cores along it to generate power. It then blasts this energy out as powerful lightning bolts from its spike ring.
author: fireblade141

entry: Once its chainsaw limbs are revved up, POKENAME won't rest until it's cut into something with them. Many get employed to help out in lumber yards or as wood carvers.
author: sk372

entry: Capable of consuming food at a rapid rate, the modern day assembly line is based off of the mechanical tongue of the POKENAME.
author: jemeremmazza

entry: POKENAME's body is an incomprehensible mass of tangled gears and wires. Its erratic motions suggest multiple minds vying for control of the amalgam.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: POKENAME is suitable for the most complex feats of engineering. It takes great pride in working alongside engineers to create solutions to modern challenges.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are seemingly drawn to areas filled with strife and conflict, often seeming to try and interfere with any aircraft. The bombs they drop are filled only with restorative and soothing energies meant to encourage peace.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME absorbs energy from the sun and stores it in the various cores throughout its body.  This energy is used to power its tail-pieces, which it can remotely control and send flying with enough force to cleave through a tree.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME plough through snow, asphalt and loose ground with ease. They cool themselves down by releasing lots of steam.
author: lemmymaster

entry: It burns masses of coal and other fuel sources in its hull. POKENAME has the ability to spin its treads, shoot out hot slabs of metal, and even split thick metal walls with its sharp-edged front.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME dominates its forest environment, with few predators able to pierce its steel plating and even fewer able to digest it. It leaves deep gashes in the trees it climbs.
author: dylonk25

entry: The third in a line of man-made Pokémon made for train engines. Its body has managed to maximize fuel efficency.
author: gayschlatt

entry: The gears churning in its back give extra power to the water it can shoot from its mouth. POKENAME applies mud to its body that, strangely, seems to increase the functionality of its  gears as they rotate.
author: sk372

entry: These odd Pokémon often make their nests near bodies of running water, even though their metal bodies can rust. Their bodies are strong enough to lift boulders, which they stack up along their nests to try and block most water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spins and rotates like an elegant, sophisticated machine. Its top half can detach and float independently from its body.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME spins and rotates like an elegant, sophisticated machine. Its top half can detach and float independently from its body.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME channels energy through the ring around its body to create powerful blasts and sturdy barriers. Because of this, it is often seen protecting important locations.
author: alexatheos

entry: POKENAME secures itself to the sides of manmade structures, where it observes anything that passes by. It is often mistaken for a normal security camera, which often causes would-be criminals who attempt to vandalize it to be attacked.
author: fireblade141

entry: The gear at the very center of the energy within its ring-like body never turns unless the POKENAME is agitated. The quicker its gears turn, the stronger its otherworldly powers become.
author: infinex21

entry: Some Trainers of POKENAME like to attach decorations to its upper ring, and there are even full contests in some regions over the best designs.
author: mirby

entry: POKENAME rolls slowly along the ground upon the gears it uses as wheels, seeking to devour any Steel-type Pokémon it can fit into its maw. Its jaws are strong enough to crush most metals.
author: fireblade141

entry: Sometimes referred to as "The Machine Queen," POKENAME has influence over all mechanical Pokémon. The orb on its staff is able to power-up or power-down any technology, a power only POKENAME can activate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, only emerging at night. Factory workers leave spare parts as offerings for it in hopes that it will keep their machines from breaking.
author: hophoppip

entry: The abdominal mouth of a POKENAME is used to collect and devour scrap metal, emitting ominous smoke as it recycles the material. The reclaimed metal becomes new parts to replace old ones, which are discarded as scrap.
author: infinex21

entry: A rotating mechanism embedded in its shell absorbs seismic energy, powering its internal engines and making it move.
author: anarchaz

entry: Well-trained POKENAME can be very useful for their spinning saws, but feral ones wreak havoc on buildings and endanger lives. Most regions require a permit to own or breed them.
author: .fedoraman

entry: It has different gears depending on the type of fighting it wants to do. The most easily identifiable are attack and defense gear, but there are many variations with different power outputs.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are unusually friendly for Luxray fusions. When two pack-leading POKENAME meet, they connect their gear-shaped manes and smile - afterward, their packs merge, and both POKENAME lead as equals.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can rotate its head 360 degrees continuously, which it uses to drill into the sides of mountains. They can endure days of drilling at a time, making them invaluable to miners daring enough to train one.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME is a judgement-class beast, with impervious armor and superb power. While cold and aloof, it's very caring and will protect those it trusts.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: This Pokémon was originally thought to have been a hoax, having been first documented in an disreputable gossip magazine.
author: griddle

entry: Since fusion was discovered, many Trainers have argued that this Pokémon is not a true fusion - just a tightly bound cluster of Klinklangs mistaken for one.
author: starexpizz

entry: The gears around their necks and ears spin even while they sleep, generating energy to fuel their bodies. They are uniquely aware of when components in machines are either faulty or nearing their end, making them valuable assistants to engineers.
author: infinex21

entry: This clockwork monstrosity is well-suited to battle against legendary leviathans. Its powered by a bottomless well of hydrothermal energy that goes haywire during droughts.
author: sk372

entry: This mechanical creature is well-suited to battle against legendary titans. The artificial sun powering its engine glitches out when confronted by heavy rains.
author: sk372

entry: This mechanical Pokémon soars in our planet's orbit, its rings and gears always turning to generate raw power. It will quickly target and destroy any meteors that draw too close to the atmosphere.
author: infinex21

entry: Some say POKENAME was created in the very distant future to maintain the proper flow of time. It has been seen silently observing temples dedicated to Dialga, letting out a mechanical roar towards crumbled statues of the Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: The gears of POKENAME's tail are constantly turning, generating a steady flow of potent electricity. When it discharges excess energy from the ring on its back, it creates thunderstorms in local areas.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses electromagnetic energy between the two gears to levitate off the ground. They use their charming appearance to lure in prey before blasting the opponent with their arm cannon.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: It uses the hoop-like parts of its own body to perform acrobatic maneuvers, even during battle. The more it moves, the more it builds up energy within its own body to further empower its attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME launches an enormous amount of energy through its tail, capable of knocking out foes in one powerful blast. The smoke created afterwards is extremely poisonous, able to irritate the throat for 3 days after the initial inhalation.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can repeatedly fire off the gear on its tail, letting it fire off powerful, relentless blows from afar. If the foe gets near, it repeatedly jabs with the toxin-coated spikes around its waist to knock them out.
author: soup1900

entry: The internal clocks of POKENAME operate on a lunisolar calendar that tracks the movements of both the sun and moon. Many people rely on their help to accurately determine when certain holidays occur.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Twirling rapidly to build up energy, POKENAME defend themselves with the rings that surround their bodies. If they ever need to get out of trouble, they rapidly rotate their rings to propel themselves upwards with the magnetic force.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The Pokémon was rumored to have been used as a criminal punishment by people of the past, but that theory has been widely disproven. Their appearance in ancient castles is apparently a more recent development.
author: fireblade141

entry: An ancient automaton, POKENAME is curiously made with modern mechanical parts. Allegedly, an army of them could be strong enough to conquer the world.
author: blazerxz

entry: An experiment has caused POKENAME to grow exponentially in size. It has also gained new firepower, now being a formidable foe in battle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The colored orbs indicate POKENAME's disposition, glowing red when it becomes aggressive. In combat, fire bursts from every one of its vents, coating its body and wings in roiling flames.
author: sk372

entry: The cage of gears around POKENAME help to control its wild and ancient magic. Each gear carries a unique enchantment.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Legends state that if POKENAME ever stops spinning its gears, any onlookers will be cursed. The Ninetales only moves its lower body to stay on the gears. It doesn't appear to actually be organic: only a faint whirring can be heard inside of it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's gears churn at different speeds to control the pitch and tempo of its singing. Its song has the unique trait of being able to cause machinery nearby to shut down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for metal, attacking factory machinery in a feeding frenzy. It is considered a pest because of the damage it causes in large swarms.
author: daemonkill22

entry: POKENAME is a defective warbot, often ridiculed for being so. It has proven itself with its smart mind and big heart.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its energy core and projectile-emitting teeth allow POKENAME to ground and catch prey flying above it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hides in scrapyards, camouflaging among rusted gears. When disturbed, it releases a magnetic pulse that locks nearby objects in place before clamping down on them with its heavy metal jaws, capturing anything in its path.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME scampers about searching for precious gems that it can make into valuable decorative gears. What purpose this behaviour serves is unknown.
author: phantom640

entry: When POKENAME clamps down with its massive steel jaws, it can crush anything between its fangs. If it needs extra power to bite, the gear with the red core spins rapidly, releasing hissing bursts of steam.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its dances are rigid and robotic. If it attempts to dance too rapidly, its body overheats, which comes in handy for searing its foes in battle.
author: hophoppip

entry: It has learned to twirl the ring around its waist by gyrating its lower body. The sounds of clinking metal as it dances produces a satisfying rhythm.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME is often found in junkyards or abandoned factories. Its body is mostly composed of the metal and machinery it collects.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME is most often seen in scrapyards, consuming any bits of metal it comes across. With its composition being a seemingly-random assortment of junk parts, scientists are still studying how it functions at all.
author: sk372

entry: Some conspiracy theorists believe that POKENAME is a secret government project designed to attack enemy ships from below.
author: chorb33

entry: The time on its dial never matches the actual time. Folk tales believe that POKENAME actually shows the date of death of the person who sees it.
author: chorb33

entry: The metronomic tick-tock of POKENAME's gears echoes through the old growth forests it protects. Those who litter or fell trees within its realm are shown no mercy.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME stands near running sprinkler systems during the hot summer months, enjoying the coolness of the water on its tin body. If disturbed, its head rotates rapidly and releases a metallic scented powder that can paralyze on contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emit constant puffs of smoke as they fly, their internal engine producing a constant stream of pollutants. Their songs have a constant undertone of clicks layered within them, the gears in their throat whirring as they chirp.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's bodies are fueled by oil and electricity, which they constantly seek out and consume. The oil they ingest leaks from their bodies, letting them slide themsves along the ground.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME leave trails of oil wherever they go, constantly leaking from their bodies. They aimlessly seek out machinery, gnawing on and consuming its parts.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are often found hobbling around factories, taking shelter from the rain. Their metal bodies creak and scrape as they move, constantly leaking oil.
author: santon5512

entry: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.
author: chorb33

entry: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME appears rigid and lifeless at rest, but springs to life once it senses nearby activity. Its illuminated eyes can detect heat, allowing it to hunt even in total darkness.
author: ilija09

entry: This Pokémon lives in barren wastelands. For unknown reasons, it seems to despise all forms of plant life, including many Grass-type Pokémon.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME was first found after an expedition into an abandoned mine. Its engine is powered by a mysterious dark matter.
author: anarchaz

entry: The happier it gets, the faster the gears on its body spin. Caution is advised around overexcited POKENAME, as they become dangerous to touch.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The jagged machinery on its body spins ferociously in combat. Despite its cold metal exterior, POKENAME is a very warm, affectionate, and loyal Pokémon.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME use their drills to burrow through cave walls in search of minerals and crystals. They consume these materials as they find them, absorbing them into their bodies to fine-tune their digging skills.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME constantly grows gears across its body and lives on a diet of scrap metal. They have found a niche in manufacturing plants, where they consume any offcuts and offer the gears they grow to be used in machinery.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Due to its large size, POKENAME requires an extremely large amount of coal to be able to move. The many spinning gears inside of POKENAME's body allow it to generate electricity, which it uses to attack its opponents.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME constantly test the quality of factory baked goods to ensure they are consistently delicious. They burp out excess matter as they cannot digest food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME help factories maintain a consistent quality of baked goods. They turn dials and constantly test the quality of their products to ensure people receive the same bite every time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its powerful core and self-defense capabilities from its ring, POKENAME mines more minerals than it needs and easily makes its owner a profit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can easily perform the mining tasks of 3 men and often make their Trainer rich from all the gems and precious metals they dig up. All POKENAME need is a good polish and praise to keep them going for hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When maintained, this trio can perform extremely profitable mining operations. When neglected, they've been known to cause disastrous cave-ins.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its whiskers can detect the presence of valuable items from far away. It regularly polishes its steel body to maintain its shine.
author: lynkinator

entry: It constantly channels electricity into the gear beneath its feet, giving it the magnetic force needed to levitate. When the gear suddenly reverses its rotation, it means POKENAME is charging up a powerful attack.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When the iron gears on its legs begin spinning rapidly, POKENAME's body becomes enveloped in sparks. Its long metal tail acts as a lightning rod, allowing it to absorb electrical energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can only be found at night. Its sneaky and sly, seeking to make sure anything and everything that is still awake goes to sleep, even if it has to get aggressive to do so.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME can only be found during the day. It has a bright, bubbly personality and seeks to help anything and everything have fun.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME is kept operational by constant rotation of its body and the gears within. Keeping a steady rotating tempo allows its psychic powers to operate at peak efficiency.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a sharp iron smell and secrete a thick oily substance instead of slime. This in conjunction with their sharp spines allow them to ward off many would-be predators.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The nozzle on the tail end of POKENAME fills up with steam as they use energy throughout the day. While usually being dispelled slowly during the night, they have been seen using a big release of steam to disguise themselves.
author: camtft

entry: Due to the weight of its metal body, POKENAME is unable to swim. Its intelligence means POKENAME can use its gears and other materials to craft boats for it to cross lakes and oceans.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is always working; its psychic power is fueled by its gear, which rotates at high speeds. It is used a lot at construction sites as a Mechanic.
author: saucebolodu81

entry: Nowadays, it is increasingly common for POKENAME residing in Game Corners to act as a roulette wheel. While the wheel itself is an impressive weapon, POKENAME can detach from it to bring the fight to opponents who are keeping their distance.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME protect the flame at the end of their tail because it is the source of their fiery powers. The gears on their back spin rapidly to launch them into the air, while the ring around their body controls their flight as they glide.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on their metallic shell to shield them from harm. The small gears within their body spin to expel a stream of water, allowing them to put out small fires.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is placed in factories as a method of pest control, luring small vermin into its grinding gears via smell. When necessary, it doubles as a trash can.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME has an affinity for rocky mountainsides. It scales rough summits by rapidly spinning its gears, which boast a surprising amount of grip.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hangs around junkyards and trash heaps, using its extra arms to grab and analyze scrap it finds. It consumes metal that meets its criteria, though the exact criteria it searches for is not yet known.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often used in large industrial forges to transport hot metal, as they do not mind high heat and can trudge through molten material.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME eats coal to fuel the furnace in its body. It ejects the incredibly hot flames from the combustion process through various openings.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME rotates continuously, using self-generated magnetism to accelerate in such a way that it sparks.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can generate an incredible amount of energy, but it also emits powerful magnetic waves that disable most electrical devices in the vicinity.
author: chorb33

entry: By rotating its heads, POKENAME can constantly generate energy and heat, which it can store in its outer ring. It can also use this to release it.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's body rotates continuously, causing its individual heads to change position regularly. The one at the top is in temporary command.
author: chorb33

entry: Its entire life is spent motionless in one spot. It anchors itself to the ocean floor near strong currents. The water passing through its body spins the motor in its body, giving it life.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are often found in burnt factories, as the Klinklang melts and fuses with the Muk. This is a fusion that was found even before DNA Splicers.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Since POKENAME does not rust even in contaminated water, shipping companies often use it for repairs on ships or underwater infrastructure. Most ships nowadays have several POKENAME on board.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are thought to be failed experiments that broke out and now live in the deep ocean. How they reproduce, avoid rusting, and survive the pressure is still unknown.
author: notmax22

entry: Before changing its appearance through illusions, POKENAME surrounds itself with smoke, making those who see it think it fled.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: A masterful trickster, the wild laugh of a POKENAME is a sure sign of trouble. When not playing pranks, POKENAME plays songs, producing organ-like melodies with its three large ears.
author: hophoppip

entry: Wild POKENAME are highly dangerous because of their ability to create an illusion as a distraction while it strikes from behind.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: Its power over illusions and ability to shapeshift its incredibly malleable body means that it can take on nearly any appearance it desires, as long as it has the body mass for it. If it is suddenly surprised, it will revert to its original form.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME scares schools of fish by casting illusions to make itself appear to be a much larger, fearsome Pokémon. As the school scatters, POKENAME takes advantage of the confusion to pick off a few stragglers for its meal.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever it encounters predators, POKENAME creates illusionary flames in an attempt to scare them away. While it's normally wary of Trainers, those it trusts find its fur to be incredibly soft.
author: tmotime

entry: POKENAME tend to natural groves, monitoring the area to ensure that the temperature and humidity are suitable for growth. If a new arrival threatens the safety of their home, they create an illusion of a fearsome apex Pokémon to scare them off.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Their flames allow POKENAME to ensnare their opponents in a mirage formed by the heat haze. Once trapped by the illusion, there is no escape.
author: jordanx27

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as other Pokémon to blend in, but they lose this disguise whenever they bite down on anything. This is rather unfortunate, as one of their favorite things to do is chew on bones.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A Pokémon often associated with vast wisdom and cunning. Its mastery over illusions allows it to appear in many places at once, deceiving both prey and those who hunt it. Even more frighteningly, its illusions can make forests appear endless.
author: elfail0

entry: Wild POKENAME will use illusions to hide their complex webs to better capture prey. They are also mischievous pranksters who will use their webbing and illusions to mess with others, even their own Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: It projects holograms in the deep sea to lure prey and scare predators. When it feels lonely, POKENAME uses that power to create imaginary friends.
author: epping_forest

entry: It makes lifelike illusions to confuse foes and hide from danger. Though initially weak, its illusory power increases with age. Elder POKENAME can be identified by their long, trailing mane.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: There have been many stories of Trainers who are convinced they have caught a POKENAME, only to open the Poké Ball and find it filled with mud, the Trainers having fallen victim to POKENAME's illusionary tactics.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: By mimicking the cries of other bird Pokémon, POKENAME deceives parents and steals eggs from their nests while they're away.
author: .izik

entry: This incredibly shy Pokémon can conjure illusions to mislead potential enemies or cover its escape. Due to its large size, cuddly appearance, and lack of aggression, POKENAME are prized highly as pets for young children.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME are feared due to their appearance; because of this, they hide in caves, using illusions to mask their true form and bond with trainers. When exposed to a full moon's energy, the marking on its head is filled with a mysterious power.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME can be found soaring through the sky disguised as other bird Pokémon, and their migration patterns match the Pokémon around them. They opportunistically steal treats from unattended food left at parks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can draw any scene as if it were real in order to confound its prey. For whatever reason, though, this strategy never seems to actually work.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME is best known for its appearances in spy movies. It can transform into any Pokémon, but tripping breaks the illusion.
author: aberry8286

entry: Despite ominous tales, POKENAME is gentle toward lost toddlers. It imitates their parents to guide wandering children safely back to towns.
author: .izik

entry: Deep within foggy forests, POKENAME studies passing Trainers in an attempt to learn more about humans. If a Trainer remains lost in the woods after its research is complete, it will create an illusion of a stray Pokémon to lead them to safety.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME imitates power plant workers with eerie precision. When left alone, it siphons electricity from machines to fuel itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swoops from tree to tree, casting illusions from the shadows. These perplexing phantasms range from malicious to deadly.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME use their ability to create illusions to take on the visage of bird Pokémon. They do this to avoid predators while soaring through the skies.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME protect their lush territories and the many other Pokémon within using complex illusions and plants grown from the blue seeds upon their shoulders. They fight alongside their illusions to overwhelm their opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME bear a resemblance to a depiction of Pokémon once seen many years ago in another region. They are often found in cold areas, wandering listlessly and frightening others with powerful illusions.
author: infinex21

entry: Wherever corruption lingers, POKENAME are often close by to fight back. Rumor has it that they have the ability to change someone's heart and purify their soul.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: This noble Pokémon can create the most elaborate illusions to lure humans away from its home. It can even make illusory creatures tangible if it sacrifices some of its life force.
author: cheroace

entry: Cloaked in shadows and powered by aura, POKENAME confounds foes with illusions while striking with steel claws. Its power surges with each deception.
author: sheogorath

entry: POKENAME uses its illusions to hide itself from Trainers and Pokémon it considers to be weak. It will only reveal itself to worthy opponents in order to challenge them to a fight.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME move like ghosts in the night. Very few have been seen due to their speed and illusory capabilities. They are fiercely territorial.
author: ishdra

entry: POKENAME loves to prank unfortunate folks lost in the woods. It casts an illusion to disguise itself as a large set of foliage, waiting for a hapless traveler to come close before belting out an unnervingly deep croaking laugh.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's illusory abilities let it perfectly mimic any other creature in the world. There are some fringe groups in certain regions that believe that most of the people in the world are actually POKENAME in disguise.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME pretends its mane is made of flames by creating illusions, frightening many Pokémon that mistake it for real fire. When cornered, it can unleash rapid and highly accurate punches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: To protect their lair, POKENAME work together to trick and swiftly attack at those they deem to be a threat. It has speed and agility like no other Pokémon.
author: dahappycute

entry: Its six ears are said to hear any secret within a thousand miles radius. POKENAME can perfectly impersonate any creature it wants for its own benefit.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME traps multiple victims in illusions at once, storing them for later, when it'll be hungry for their life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are constantly hiding the true shape of their sword, revealing the truth only to those closest to them. They use their illusory blade to weave through attacks unexpectedly.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME roams under the cover of night, challenging worthy foes with lethal surprise attacks and lightning-fast strikes only to vanish into the shadows again before they can strike back. Only those who prove their skill may glimpse it twice.
author: silentscript89

entry: A master of both battle and trickery, POKENAME tend to shy away from combat, instead creating electrical mirages to hide their children from danger. They love to create illusionary thunderstorms to drive away competitors and curious people.
author: cpnquacken

entry: The ultimate nocturnal hunter, POKENAME causes blackouts to terrify its prey. Its X-ray vision and illusion manipulation make it a fearsome foe whose eyes cannot be blinded.
author: merclipse

entry: If miners enter its cave, POKENAME imitates one of them to lure an individual away. It drags the isolated victim deeper into the mine to feed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has fine control over water, using it to refract and reflect light through mists to create visual illusions. These illusions are usually used in an effort to entertain and amuse sailors and other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Texts from ancient Johto describe the use of POKENAME as a spirit medium by taking on the visage of the deceased. POKENAME would do this to deceive humans into giving it offerings of berries.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME transforms into muscular people to deter humans from approaching locations it likes. If the illusion is broken, POKENAME will use its large muscles to physically intimidate whoever thwarted its deception.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's long feelers glow in the dark as it wanders through forests at night. Even a brief glance at them can induce a sense of calm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can create and control illusions with remarkable skill. They use their illusions to protect others and to soothe young Pokémon, even if they are of other species.
author: infinex21

entry: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.
author: jokerswild

entry: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME actively seek out any and all information about themselves and rewrite it. Because of this, many researchers and Trainers believe POKENAME to be much more powerful than they actually are.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a powerplant worker near substations. It absorbs large amounts of electricity unnoticed before slipping away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mimics the form of lost cave travelers. If approached, it lashes out with Power Whip and drags its victim back to its den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks in abandoned chateaus, typically posing as a chandelier. It imitates noble figures waving silently from windows to passing travelers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are both incredibly territorial and incredibly strong. Rangers keep a close eye on their habitat to ensure they don't roam too close to where people live.
author: bee4082

entry: Ancient tablets tell of POKENAME shifting into human forms during great wars. It can briefly fly by expelling bursts of energy from its limbs.
author: .izik

entry: When hunting, it will create illusions of itself and surround the prey. Once it breaks the prey's spirit, it spits flames at them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves through the shadows, its nine ethereal tails flickering like wisps of smoke. A master of deception, it creates illusions that confuse foes, striking with swift, fiery attacks.
author: thepandasharky

entry: A pure soul corrupted by fusion, POKENAME dreams of a world destroyed by a catastrophe. Many people theorize that its dream is a prophecy.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.
author: elfail0

entry: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME uses its small stature and a veneer of false innocence in order to appear less intimidating. The illusions it casts are far more malevolent in nature than a normal Zorua or Zoruark.
author: sk372

entry: It is known to come up with bizarre ideas on how to get more Genius Mochi from its Trainer. Its cunning tricks are seen in Pokémon battles too, especially if it has time to set up a Nasty Plot.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Deep within caves, POKENAME takes the form of explorers. It isolates wanderers from their groups before feeding in the shadows.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME disguises itself in pure light, attracting any Pokémon who think POKENAME is a legendary. It will lead them back to its den for dinner.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a child and plays in parks. If discovered, it releases Sleep Powder and vanishes before anyone can react.
author: .izik

entry: In foggy marshes, POKENAME takes the form of lost children. It waits for rescuers to draw near before attacking with a Hex.
author: .izik

entry: In coastal mists, POKENAME mimics drowned sailors calling for help. Those who approach are silently dragged beneath the waves.
author: .izik

entry: Underwater, POKENAME mimics scuba divers swimming in groups. It isolates victims with charm before poisoning and dragging them into the deep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can create multiple illusions of itself or others that perform together with it as it sings and dances. It will also use these illusions to protect its friends, both by hiding them and by making its attacks harder to predict.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses illusions to disguise itself as a weaker Pokémon. When attacked by predators, it sheds its disguise, revealing its true form, and tears its prey apart before it can react to the sudden transformation.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's ability to create illusions makes it an extremely dangerous ambush predator. It can mask itself as anything, including Pokémon that are normally harmless. When the victim gets too close, they will slash with their sharp forelimbs.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME has the capability to shapeshift into any human or Pokémon. It leads humans into traps that it crafted until none remain. It attacks anyone or anything that sees its true form.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME mimics lone hikers with eerie accuracy. When confronted, it bursts into a cloud of violet powder and escapes into the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are found in farmers' fields after a full moon. They delight in using their illusion powers to disguise themselves as crops and wait for people to come close. They then leap out to surprise their unfortunate target when they get too close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as Pokémon invading its pumpkin patch. Once close enough, it drops the illusion and attacks with a powerful Seed Bomb.
author: .izik

entry: Notoriously gluttonous, POKENAME wanders into farmlands disguised as a regular Diglett. Once the farmers let down their guard, it devours rows of crops before disappearing without a trace.
author: adam_dnh

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen in the wild thanks to their mastery of illusions. Swarms of POKENAME safely feed in flower meadows without worrying about predators, their wings glittering as they make the field appear to be filled with dangerous Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The crystal vents on its back spew a strange fog. POKENAME can manipulate the appearance of this fog to create complex illusions.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's eerie chime brings misfortune. Its ringing distorts the environment, forming wild illusions to confuse those intruding on its territory.
author: mepp.

entry: Those that wander into POKENAME's terrain quickly get lost as it casts illusions to make them lose their way among false surroundings. Once it finishes toying with them, it surprises them with an Ice Beam that leaves them frozen solid.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lure in aquatic prey by projecting illusions of food and safety. They seem to be quite proud of their ponytails.
author: hophoppip

entry: As they are elusive, attacks from wild POKENAME are rare but brutal. Victims report seeing all kinds of strange sights while they were pummeled over and over.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Attacks from elusive wild POKENAME are rare but brutal. Victims report seeing all kinds of strange sights while they were pummeled over and over.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME disguise their voice with special vocal cords. Using this, they hide within larger packs of wild Pokémon to eat their food.
author: camtft

entry: Legends write of POKENAME masquerading as the head of a shrine to steal any donations. Its personality is enigmatic, but it has never been known to attack people.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Legends write of POKENAME masquerading as the head of a shrine to steal any donations. Its personality is enigmatic, but it has never been known to attack people.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Legends write of POKENAME masquerading as the head of a shrine to steal any donations. Its personality is enigmatic, but it has never been known to attack people.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the ultimate master of trickery. It channels its illusory magic through its spoons, enabling it to conjure realistic mirages.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME often create illusions to make it seem as if they are punching with more than just their four arms. In order to defend their friends, they will also create illusory copies of themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's rocky body can morph into surprisingly convincing human shapes. It waits silently until prey draws too close.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME create realistic illusions to protect themselves and their packs. They have been known to create illusions of large glaciers to deter human ships from drawing too near.
author: infinex21

entry: What appears to be POKENAME's body is just an illusion, as its true form is purely gaseous. It launches orbs of concentrated spiritual energy at others to curse them with terrifying hallucinations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes on the form of hospital nurses and walks silently down the halls. While unnoticed, it feeds on the dreams of sleeping patients.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon will try to calm any organism that approaches them with its ribbons and put it to sleep with spores from its back.
author: themadcactus

entry: When threatened by Pidgey, POKENAME will use its cute charm to infatuate the predator.
author: themadcactus

entry: When POKENAME explodes, the energy it releases causes everyone caught in the blast radius to exhibit joyful emotions for several hours. The exhausted POKENAME will be mopey and grumpy for that same amount of time, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known as a protector of love, guiding the hands of couples together with its ribbons. If anyone insults any couple in its pressence, it will wrap them in ribbons and release explosive sparks until they apologize.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are very skittish, hiding in dark  caves or crevices during the night. To help themselves sleep, they will wrap each other up in their ribbons, which emit a soothing aura.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME takes great joy in the morning sun, traveling to beaches with others of its kind to dangle its feelers in a gentle synchronized wave. During cloudy weather, the feelers shrink considerably.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to dwell in remote places where few people visit. Faint clicking sounds can be heard as it moves as its ribbons tap against its bony helmet.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME prefers to dwell in remote places where few people visit. Faint clicking sounds can be heard as it moves as its ribbons tap against its bony helmet.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME harness the power of love, friendship, and the firmness of their bony club to deliver heavy blows to their opponent. Many Pokémon become infatuated with POKENAME after being hit on the head, though this transient effect fades after battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rarely let other Trainers see what is underneath the mask and swat away attempts to do so with their dual clubs. The few Trainers privileged enough to see what is underneath are usually POKENAME's most trusted allies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME vibrates its colorful ribbons to weaken its opponents' will to fight in the ring and gain an advantage. Despite its cute appearance, it can deliver kicks strong enough to break metal.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME slices the air with its punches, it also sends out shockwaves of soothing auras. With how quickly it can throw out punches, it can calm down an entire angry mob of over 500 people in less than a minute.
author: soup1900

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will restrain the attacker with their ribbon-like tongue. Their tongues emit a soothing aura, letting them de-escalate conflicts without injury.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's body constantly produces puffs of thick, soothing perfume clouds. Though the scent and calming nature are pleasant, the high volume it creates can be more than a little stifling.
author: sk372

entry: Some believe this Pokémon is the descendent of a powerful bug-Pokémon, causing POKENAME to sell for a high price.
author: themadcactus

entry: After evolving, this Pokémon will shed its skin. The most expensive makeup is made with its paste.
author: themadcactus

entry: The poisonous gas released by POKENAME induces intense bliss. It also causes dangerous side effects, including suppressing hunger for extended periods.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME only wants to do one thing outside, and it is to play, no matter what. This one-track mind of only wanting to play has made it a very hard Pokémon to train.
author: beatdoof

entry: When POKENAME fights, they will spread pockets of glittering dust whenever it makes a move, especially when they're doing a Drill Run. They still prefer playing than battling, so Trainers have to trick it through various means to battle.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME finds abandoned eggs in the wild and raises them with love and tender care. Due to the soft touch of its ribbons during the egg's development, Pokémon hatched by POKENAME tend to have gentle and loving natures.
author: sk372

entry: Each vine of POKENAME is coated in a sticky sap that induces joy on contact. Prolonged exposure, however, can lead to severe mental instability.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is attracted to happy families, drawn to the positive energy they exude. It's said that if it allows a person to play with its own child, it is because POKENAME senses the qualities of a truly wonderful parent in them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an excitable and nurturing Pokémon who enjoys taking care of several other baby Pokémon in the forest. However, the child in its pouch is very shy, only coming out after it's alone, getting doted and spoiled on by POKENAME.
author: beatdoof

entry: When threatened, POKENAME spits out a cloud of multicolored ink to mask its escape. Anything that swims through the cloud to chase after it quickly finds itself drained of energy and numbed by the ink's effects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ink was used by poets many years ago to write elegant passages. This ink left behind a calming ocean scent that soothed those who read the words.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vibrant colors and elegant appearance make it a popular pet. It can be a bit egotistical and difficult to please, but a properly cared-for POKENAME will make sure its owner never feels sad in its presence.
author: sk372

entry: During stormy nights, POKENAME extends its feelers high above the sea's surface to act as lightning rods. It does this to keep nearby fish Pokémon safe from harm.
author: .izik

entry: With POKENAME's pastel colors and friendly face, most smaller fish Pokémon don't pay attention to it. However, it is an apex predator that thrives in rivers.
author: opossiblymage

entry: The peculiar structure of its ribbon-like wings, while seemingly impractical for flight, lets POKENAME glide freely on wayward fairy winds.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME spins on its side just above the water's surface as it drifts over the sea. It releases an aura that calms nearby predators such as Tentacruel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sends out pulses of soothing aura that always travel in the same direction, but their ultimate destination is unknown. It can untie its ribbon bows to increase its size and gain more speed while spinning.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME encloses prey within invisible walls before repeatedly releasing a soothing aura to lull them into complacency. It performs disturbing dances before its trapped prey, feeding off their fear.
author: .izik

entry: When not in combat, POKENAME's blades become soft and almost ribbon-like. It sheds these blades each spring to make way for new growth.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever a parade is around, POKENAME can be found on its floats. For as long as the event lasts, they will be dancing.
