author: rosemagwin

entry: As POKENAME swings its arms to generate its electricity, colorful sparks can be seen flaking off of its limbs. The lightning it launches is similarly multicolored, making battles a fantastical display of hues.
author: sk372

entry: The ribbon on POKENAME's head grows red hot just before it uses Flamethrower. This happens automatically and without any intention on its part.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME molts, its shedding catches on its carapace to form an ever elongating dress. A long-lived POKENAME can have a dress of over five lengths of its body, signifying an exceptional warrior due to surviving with such an encumbering shedding.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME molts, its shedding catches on its carapace to form an ever elongating dress. A long-lived POKENAME can have a dress of over five lengths of its body, signifying an exceptional warrior due to surviving with such an encumbering shedding.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a very sensitive nature and cannot stand to sense the negative emotions of others. It races towards the source of negativity at breakneck speed in order to brush it away with its three ribbon-like tails.
author: sk372

entry: When happy, small ribbon feelers rise from its tails, filling anyone who touches them with joy. Unfortunately, it is only happy while stampeding, making contact with these feelers often a Trainer's last experience.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Negative emotions put POKENAME in a frustrated state, irritating it to the point of nearing violence. To keep itself in check, it tries to assuage negative feelings with its three tails, so it can remain calm as well.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is happy, small ribbon feelers pop up from its tails that fill whoever touches them with joy. When stampeding, these feelers seem to come alive, wriggling in ecstasy as it charges around.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME mate for life, never venturing far from their chosen mate for long. It's considered unbearably cruel to forcibly separate them from one another.
author: sk372

entry: The intricately patterned wings are POKENAME's most distinct feature, with their bright pattern attracting unsuspecting Pokémon.
author: themadcactus

entry: The legs of this Pokémon are blue only due to a certain toxin. The poison in the legs are extremely volatile, and can even paralyze an Ursaring.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME follows the migratory patterns of wild Gyarados, never trailing too far behind. It seeks to curb the violent mannerisms of its brethren, seizing them with its ribbons to calm them down whenever a rampage seems imminent.
author: sk372

entry: Its bright colors can only hide its vicious, battle-thirsty demeanor so well before others get suspicious. Because of this, POKENAME must use its feelers to lure prey into a false sense of security.
author: opossiblymage

entry: As POKENAME swims across the ocean, it sings a gentle lullaby and carries sleeping Pokémon whenever it sees them. Efforts are made to regulate the hunting of wild POKENAME due to its very sweet and soft meat, sold through illegal channels.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME frequents hospitals, approaching patients who are nearing the end of their lives. It will attempt to recreate the happiest moments of the individual's life by transforming.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is a great pet to have for most, as its ribbons will help soothe stress with just a touch. POKENAME will adapt over time to learn telltale signs of stress in its owner, becoming able to sooner approach them to soothe their woes.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME splashes around in the water, it is able to radiate its calming aura more effectively. It needs to stay submerged for at least eight hours a day; otherwise, its skin risks drying out and becoming susceptible to disease.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME release peaceful energy out in waves, especially in moments when they are highly stressed. They will often put on majestic water shows for anyone willing to watch, despite how often they end up soaking all those around them.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: In response to stress, POKENAME can spike out its fur and fire it off like needles. The fur produces a numbing electricity when it pierces skin, stunning those hit and leaving them with a dazing, pleasant sensation coursing through them.
author: sk372

entry: The constant warmth of POKENAME's body has soothing properties, so owners are advised to regularly embrace it. As a sign of elation, it may produce a beautiful multicolored flame breath into the air.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's many ribbons are especially warm at the tips. Ordinarily these ribbons are used to soothe others with a calming warm touch, but if threatened, they can be ignited and used to sling painful fireballs at POKENAME's opposition.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME affixes its ribbonlike body to a computer, it begins draining stored data at astonishing speed. It can consume multiple terabytes in mere moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has adapted to life with humans and understands them deeply, this lets it comfort humans in times of need.
author: crafter_94443

entry: When frightened, POKENAME wraps the large feeler on the back of its head tightly near its back. During this time its hardness rivals that of granite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sheds the spikes on its shell once each winter to allow new ones to grow. When ground up, they are used as a seasoning that lends a nutty, soothing flavor to soup for the sick.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon uses all its energy in the process of metamorphosis. It defends by warding off any Pokémon with a quick whip of it's ribbons.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME partially buries itself in the sand on beaches and in shallow waters, sleeping during the day. If stepped on, it smacks the offender with its ribbon-tail, which inflicts a numbing, euphoria-inducing toxin before scuttling away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME battles by swinging its flowy arms in large dance-like arcs, swatting opponents away from it or those it safeguards. It often cares for a group of Eeto until they are ready to evolve into one of their many choices.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's wings are made of soft, plush ribbons. They soar through the sky by catching wind currents and gliding gracefully along. When they find someone who is upset, they swoop down to offer a comforting embrace before moving on.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While snoring, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its massive stomach. This keeps it undisturbed while it rests for up to a week at a time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME watches over those who traverse the frigid mountain areas it calls home. It helps guide them through safe travels, letting them warm themselves against its body, soothing them with its ribbon-like tail.
author: sk372

entry: As a POKENAME flies through the sky, it casts a frosty veil of many colors as a trail from its wings and tail. POKENAME have been labeled a protected species due to how hunted they were for their vibrantly colored feathers.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME senses a terrible thunderstorm approaching a town, it flies directly into the clouds to absorb as much electricity as possible. Once the storm subsides, it releases a soothing aura to calm those below.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is seen as a symbol of both peace and power. According to legends, the vividly-colored flames POKENAME breathes can burn away all traces of aggression in others, leaving them forever calm and pacifistic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shed skin is often quickly snatched up by scavengers once left behind. When consumed, it causes a feeling of pleasant numbness and tingling, to an almost intoxicating degree.
author: sk372

entry: A rarer alternate color variant of POKENAME found in some regions, POKENAME's shed skin possesses mild hallucinogenic properties when consumed. Scavengers that eat the skin left behind are often left laying prone and confused for several hours.
author: sk372

entry: Scientists have been able to create gloves using the shed skin of POKENAME that allows the wearer to read the feelings of whoever they touch. Enmity-erasing waves are released when the shed skin is rubbed against each other.
author: soup1900

entry: In areas where Dragon types are common, POKENAME acts as a mediator. When strife arises, it wraps its body around the aggressors and calms them down with its feelers until the situation is properly resolved.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes on a gentle, pink aura and gains the ability to fly when all is peaceful and calm around it. However, once a bitter quarrel starts near it, it loses its aura and summons a dark thunderstorm to signify the mood.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME soars elegantly through the sky and is drawn to positive emotions. It uses its long, ribbon-like feelers to sense the feelings of others from great distances.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Regal and cute, POKENAME is a Fairy Trainer's best friend. It uses its ribbons to create a soothing smell, which makes its opponents lose their eagerness to fight.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME clears out bad weather using its powers to soothe Pokémon panicked or scared from the storms. By wrapping itself around others and taking on a pink glow, it hugs them in a blanket of calming auras.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are often found on remote islands raising Dratini to be as kind and helpful as itself. However, if anyone were to hurt its Dratini, it uncharacteristically loses its temper and savagely attacks while its ribbons bind and gag the foe.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are often seen flying around oceans, sending blasts of their aura into raging waters to restore their calm. They are nicknamed "the ocean's hero" since they very often save entire ships and battle dangerous monsters alike.
author: soup1900

entry: No matter the Pokémon, POKENAME will always try to hug them tight as an extreme act of kindness. The soothing auras that empower these hugs cause the receiver to instantly become kind and helpful.
author: soup1900

entry: If you encounter one of these Pokémon, stay calm. Wild POKENAME detect fear, and will attempt to calm you down by injecting you with poison.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME seeks peace among others around it, to an aggressive degree. If just the touch of its ribbons isn't enough to make someone behave, it will resort to temporarily emptying their mind of negative thoughts with its psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's powerful psychic abilities let it generate orbs of condensed, vibrantly-colored energy. Those hit by these projectiles find themselves feeling numbed and dazed, deprived of all negative thoughts and feelings.
author: sk372

entry: With its radiating tranquility, it resolves conflicts with awe-inspiring psychic prowess. It can befriend any type of Pokémon.
author: rigelpogi08

entry: POKENAME's ribbons allow it to sense the emotions of nearby creatures and mimic their feelings. It usually appears before people who are feeling overjoyed so it can empathize with them.
author: ambrosia04

entry: When the wind picks up, the ribbon-like leaves on POKENAME's head flutter about and spread a faint, minuscule pollen across the air. It evokes pleasant feelings in those that inhale it, and causes plants it lands on to bloom in more vibrant colors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases a calming fruity aroma from the feelers on its head. Under the right conditions, this scent can relax even a Primeape mid-rage.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves around POKENAME's neck emit a savory, mouthwatering aroma that causes hunger pangs in those who smell it. This aroma also causes fruit trees to bear and wild vegetables to sprout.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is a cheerful and affectionate Pokémon known for its brilliant aroma and for appearing in the wild as soon as the first flower blooms in the spring. It is thought to migrate far away in winter, but none have seen this firsthand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The ribbons on POKENAME's body extend to great lengths during combat to restrain foes. This leaves them vulnerable to repeated Ember attacks with little chance to react.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a burnt fruit smell that is surprisingly calming when inhaled. This scent intensifies when it is at play.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME gets exceptionally angry, it releases a calming aroma in an attempt to calm itself down. Witnesses report feeling woozy after breathing the scent in.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The water POKENAME spits carries soothing properties. Many spas collect it to calm their patrons if the normal treatments do not work.
author: .izik

entry: The water POKENAME spits carries a floral scent and can calm on contact. It uses this to lull foes into complacency before biting them.
author: .izik

entry: The bright colors of this Pokémon leads many researchers to wonder it's advantage. Many believe that brighter POKENAME are considered better mates.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME waits just beneath the water's surface for prey to approach the shoreline. When they draw near, its feelers strike out at high speed to ensnare them and drag them beneath the waves.
author: .izik

entry: Its ribbonlike appendages allow it to sense vibrations in the air, keeping it aware of most things around it, even as it rests. Though skittish, it will look after abandoned Pokémon and let them rest upon its soothingly soft and plush tail.
author: infinex21

entry: From its colors to its kind personality to its soft body and soothing ribbons, POKENAME is perfect for easing a person's troubled mind. It is becoming more common to see it in hospitals and therapy sessions to calm the nerves of others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very amorous specimen, always searching for the next partner to hug and shower affection on. Its scent, combined with the overzealous nature of its affections, causes most to try to escape from its adulation, however.
author: sk372

entry: Using its feelers, this Pokémon acts like a metronome, flicking back and forth at even intervals. Soulful musicians enjoy it as a partner Pokémon.
author: opossiblymage

entry: During winter, POKENAME is known to swoop down and wrap shivering travelers in its soft wings. Feathers from one are said to bring warmth and fortune, many still keep them as lucky charms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the ribbons on its head to mark its favorite trees with a faint liquid emanated from the tips. This liquid has pheromones that cause other Pokémon to defend the tree from pests, parasites and even loggers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a genuinely kind Pokémon and will fight to the end to protect the ones it cares about. Its ribbons give off positive vibes, filling those who touch it with an overwhelming feeling of happiness.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are very popular compared to their evolution as they produce a sparkly webbing they are more than happy to share. This webbing radiates positive energy and is used to decorate for parties.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME is a very unloved Pokémon. Due to this, it uses its sticky ribbons to catch humans in an effort to force them to love it.
author: crustyglowstick

entry: POKENAME wraps its ribbon around stalactites while sleeping to steady its body. If woken, it unleashes a series of horrifying screeches.
author: .izik

entry: Most POKENAME have 5 tails ribbons, but some have 6 or 7. The more tail ribbons that a POKENAME has, the more likely it is to find a mate.
author: themadcactus

entry: The tips of POKENAME's ribbons are able to glow, growing bright enough to illuminate the darker parts of the ocean depths. Coming close to the light causes a creature's negative emotions to fade away, replaced by a numb contentment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME communicates with others of its kind via flashing the many lights on its prong in different patterns. These sequences are quite varying and intricate, so research into discerning their exact meanings progresses slowly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME exude calming auras through their feelers, though this is also how they channel their electricity. Some medical facilities train POKENAME to comfort patients and to power equipment during blackouts.
author: infinex21

entry: When in direct moonlight, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its body. This can affect humans up to 20 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME whistles a melodic tune late at night to calm those nearby. The elderly regard it as a soothing melody, though to younger humans it sounds horrendous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances happily near people it finds smiling. This releases a comforting aura to all nearby, allowing them to feel easily at peace.
author: .izik

entry: When flapping rapidly, POKENAME's wings release a soothing aura to anyone within a 20-foot range. This can easily calm a human in a fit of rage.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME foresees a future in which its Trainer is upset, it releases a soothing aura from its feathers to relax them. Prolonged use of this aura causes its feathers to fall out one by one.
author: .izik

entry: When the full moon is directly overhead, POKENAME spreads its wings wide. As it soaks in the moonlight, it exudes a powerful psychic aura that invokes calmness and joy in all creatures in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wool has a similar property to its ribbons, carrying a slightly reduced calming ability. Pillows stuffed with its wool make for a popular item for assisting in granting happy, restful sleeps.
author: sk372

entry: Herds of POKENAME can be found huddled together. They do this to create static energy by rubbing their wool against each other to deter predators or when a herd member is in need of comfort.
author: blaizegamer

entry: While some Pokémon may look for mates, POKENAME are indifferent. Considered stoic, owners of this Pokémon are viewed as wise and accepting.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME is always concerned for others because of its ability to read emotions. When it sees a person in need of comfort, it will try to hug them; however, its wool ends up electrocuting them instead.
author: blaizegamer

entry: POKENAME loves to comfort both humans and Pokémon. Its ribbonlike tail provides a soft embrace while the stone on its head sends out soothing signals.
author: alliveir

entry: While dancing, POKENAME releases a cherry scent that soothes anyone in the vicinity. It will dance more happily at dawn.
author: .izik

entry: In urban areas, POKENAME is known for being an emotional support Pokémon for old and disabled people. With their Sweet Scent or Cute Charm, they calm people down whenever they have a negative emotional outburst, particularly during panic attacks.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME smacks its tail on the ground repeatedly while walking, releasing a sugary scent. This calms those within a 5-meter area around it.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its antennae to stroke and calm people who have fallen into the water, preventing them from panicking and drowning while it rescues them. Its vibrant coat and strong-willed nature make it an excellent partner for many Pokémon Coordinators.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time remaining immobile, but every so often it will do a small dance involving the ribbons on its arms. The ribbons cast a placating aura in the direction they are swung, calming those in the area.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that seeing POKENAME perform a Rain Dance atop a lake with other Pokémon will bless one's romantic endeavors. Their soft, harmonious croaks echo during any rainy weather.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's lightweight body flows along with the breeze, gliding through the air without a care. If it senses an unhappy person, it lands on their head to brush them with its ribbons and brighten their day.
author: sk372

entry: While drifting through breezy meadows with its herd, POKENAME scatters a shimmering powder. This powder tends to relax anyone who breathes it in.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats in groups of five over meadows in the early evening, leaving behind a Pink Apricorn-scented powder. Those who breathe it in are calmed almost instantly.
author: .izik

entry: Unlike other Rattata, POKENAME are quite well-mannered and are commonly kept as regular pets. However, because they are so commonly domesticated, they struggle to survive out in the wild.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are always up to mischief and escape accountability by offering soft hugs to appease angry Trainers. However, whenever a Pokémon or Trainer gets hurt by the pranks, they do everything in their power to remedy the situation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dips its long feeler into streams to absorb water into its body. Despite its small size, it can take in over 10 gallons each day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a calming raspberry scent from its leaves while sleeping in moonlight. This tends to settle any Sunkern in the area as they sleep nearby for safety.
author: .izik

entry: While flying at high speeds over swampy areas, POKENAME releases a bubblegum-like scent that induces calm in those it passes. It does this for no reason other than to be kind.
author: .izik

entry: An organisation that promotes peace and freedom from persecution uses POKENAME as its mascot as it can calm someone's aggressive behaviour by simply touching them. It produces a gel that is being researched by the military to neutralise opponents.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is always ready to give a hug to those in need of one, soothing them with a few touches from its ribbons. It only allows those it truly trusts and loves to adjust the bow-tie on its torso.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's capacity for sensing the mental state of others is almost unparalleled. It will be by its Trainer's side, offering a comforting touch of its ribbons before its Trainer even realizes their own emotional state.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to those they choose, using both air currents and their ribbonlike feelers to anticipate their Trainers' needs. POKENAME are known to fell dragons to see their Trainers smile.
author: stephanyx

entry: The soft pink glow of its rings along with its friendly-looking ribbons allows POKENAME to lure in prey with their guard down. The rings change into a hot pink the moment it uses its ribbons to attack and ensnare the victim.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME only comes out in the darkness to protect other Pokémon. Although almost never seen as it lurks in the shadows, it can radiate beams of happiness-giving energy, causing struck Pokémon to forget they were ever in danger.
author: knews6969

entry: POKENAME are so fascinated by anything that sparkles that they have long since been associated with fortune and wealth. They are keenly aware of evil intent, so they avoid those with wicked hearts, no matter how much sparkling jewelry they may bear.
author: infinex21

entry: Smart and sensitive, POKENAME will attempt to help anyone it comes across who needs it. It works tirelessly to come up with clever solutions to others' problems.
author: hophoppip

entry: When placed in the same biome as a Rattata, its quickly picked on. But when put in a snowy biome its fur keeps it warm and its color camouflages it.
author: themadcactus

entry: Wild POKENAME are extremely skittish, but they're very friendly to their Trainer. It is said that if one approaches you, you are a truly kind soul.
author: themadcactus

entry: Without a seed on its back, many wonder where the poison comes from. One theory says it comes from the ribbons; another says it comes from the fur.
author: themadcactus

entry: The bud on its back is tied in a neat bow. It is said that if it lies in the sun, the bow will grow and untie into two more ribbons.
author: themadcactus

entry: If spotted while scavenging through dumpsters, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its ribbonlike feelers. The effect pacifies witnesses long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: While floating over cemeteries at night, POKENAME releases a soothing cookie-like scent that draws in nearby humans. When they get close it uses Swift to incapacitate them before feasting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its ribbon-like appendages to draw symbols resembling letters on the nearest surfaces. Though they don't appear to be any readable language, those who look at its messages feel a calming sensation wash over them.
author: sk372

entry: Whatever a Trainer does to POKENAME, it will bounce it back. Whether emotionally or physically, positive or negative, it will use its psychic and fairy abilities to do so.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME lives in forests, though they only appear during the brightest of days. In some Pokémon Centers, they are the assistant Pokémon, where their ability to absorb negative emotions and their peppy attitude make them a great listener.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME use their feelers to hang from branches with their spikes embedded into the branch to siphon some of the tree's nutrients. When a POKENAME falls, it will develop a strong attachment to whoever catches it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME ejects its ribbons far out to wrap around and soothe any hostility near it. However, any aggression out of reach from its spot is ignored due to its unwillingness to move.
author: soup1900

entry: When startled, POKENAME's drill-like tail spins clockwise at high speed, releasing a cinnamon scent. This tends to calm predators while it digs away to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time clinging to cavern walls while sleeping. It wakes up instantly if it senses negative emotions, swooping at the offender and latching onto them to deliver a sting that delivers a euphoria-inducing toxin.
author: sk372

entry: As each section of POKENAME's body rotates while digging, it releases a pleasant mossy scent that calms nearby Pokémon. This allows it to tunnel with minimal disturbance from the ground's current occupants.
author: .izik

entry: The ribbon on POKENAME's head turns jet black when it does not get its way. It will fly into a rage, screeching and hurling any nearby objects to the ground like a child.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its tail feathers to calm Caterpie. Once its prey is relaxed, it dives swiftly to hunt with a brutal Peck.
author: .izik

entry: Despite an aggressive appearance, POKENAME has a gentle and meek heart. However, having its ribbons pulled will cause it to fly into an aggravated rage and lash out at anything nearby.
author: sk372

entry: The secretions from POKENAME's quills have a potent numbing effect. Research is currently ongoing on the subject of applying it to improve modern anesthetics.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's cute, fairy-like head attracts unaware Pokémon. It then uses its razor-sharp pincers to threaten them into giving over their food.
author: qwertyelephant

entry: The juice POKENAME makes is so sweet that it's almost inedible. People say that the only ingredient of POKENAME's juice is love.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME's horn-like feeler becomes as hard as steel during combat. With a single strike, it can topple a maple tree with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME work together in pairs, though they live in packs of up to ten individuals. Using their claws, they scale trees to collect food for themselves and for their packs; a POKENAME will worry about feeding its friends and family before itself.
author: infinex21

entry: A honey-like slime oozes from POKENAME's feelers when it is sad. Despite smelling delicious, it is extremely bitter and virtually inedible to most humans.
author: .izik

entry: Pokémon learn quickly not to cause trouble in POKENAME territory. Though not especially aggressive, it abhors conflict and will put troublemakers in especially tight and possibly painful bear-hugs until they stop acting out.
author: sk372

entry: The bizarre cream-like substance making up POKENAME's body grows incredibly hot while it sleeps. During this time, it exudes a relaxing tart scent that soothes nearby predators.
author: .izik

entry: The hot, creamy substance coating POKENAME's body is similar in consistency to pudding. The sweet scent it gives off calms those who draw near.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feathers naturally release a calming influence. Many hospitals stuff pillows with them to help trauma patients sleep peacefully.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME smells a predator nearby, its ears fidget violently and release a strong apricot odor. This calms the predator while POKENAME flees to safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick coat of fur produces a warming and calming aura, making it a valuable partner for venturing through frozen areas. Staying close to it will allow others to stave off the effects of the cold easily.
author: sk372

entry: The tiny, cloudy bubbles POKENAME produces from its body can soothe those they touch. It can generate up to 1,000 of these bubbles per day before needing to rest.
author: .izik

entry: While swimming at high speeds, POKENAME leaves behind tiny bubbles that calm any pursuers. It uses this to flee predators like Carvanha with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shoots out large globs of ink that will, on contact, cause those struck to feel calm and placid. The ink shot can be either blue or pink, depending on the species, with no other apparent distinction in properties.
author: sk372

entry: As a sign of affection for their Trainers, they will frequently make them gifts to show how much they love them.
author: pankiwi

entry: A Johtonian folk tale describes POKENAME flying out of the water in the midst of a heated battle and pacifying all involved. They're always in schools, carrying weaker ocean Pokémon on their backs wherever they need.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is very proud of its colorful wings, boastfully showing them off to other Pokémon. Its feathers are often melted down into jewelry as their blue and pink coloring is quite rare.
author: mistymagius

entry: After a nightly hunt, POKENAME returns to its resting spot with the rest of its pack. While keeping watch, it extends its feelers to calm its sleeping kin.
author: .izik

entry: The ribbons on its body are flexible, extendable, and fireproof. POKENAME uses them to restrain its prey before roasting them with its fire breath.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The tip of POKENAME's tail releases an aura that suppresses fear and aggression. While prey is subdued, it injects a potent venom with a bite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to wrap themselves around other Pokémon to give them hugs. Their lack of fangs makes them appear docile, so many Pokémon happily accept their embrace.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME curls its feelers around coral while sleeping in reefs to avoid drifting. For a few minutes after waking, its scales shimmer in vibrant yellow hues.
author: .izik

entry: At high rolling speeds, POKENAME releases a strong spearmint scent that induces calm in those nearby. Maintaining this speed is extremely exhausting and can only be sustained for a few minutes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly gentle creatures that often allow other Pokémon to ride on their bodies. Eevee are particularly fond of riding on their back and trunk as their leathery skin is comfortable to sleep on.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its special updates, POKENAME is able to understand a lot about human emotions and can study them intensely. This has led to this species being very understanding to how anyone is feeling and supporting them however it can.
author: soup1900

entry: When it feels in danger, POKENAME will use its ribbons to strike its antlers. The vibrations this cause sends out a pulsing energy around it that causes those nearby to feel dizzy and giddy, allowing POKENAME to flee.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can vibrate its antlers to create a small pulse of psychic energy that drains aggression from others around it. Those in the pulse's vicinity feel sluggish, sleepy, and content.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's creations are some of the most vibrantly colored among the Smeargle fusions. People who view its finished artwork report a sense of calm and ease washing over them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains almost tirelessly through the night, balancing on different limbs even while sleeping. Should it grow too exhausted to continue, it releases a calming aura to help its body recuperate faster.
author: .izik

entry: While innocent-looking, POKENAME viciously attacks prey by repeatedly slapping them with its ribbons while spinning. Lots of soothing auras are created from where it spins, making it impossible for foes to close in without being instantly pacified.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves joining parades. Its happiness and positivity is highly contagious.
author: rosemagwin

entry: The heart on its belly glows with electricity as it twirls its arms around; colorful electricity also arcs between its prong-like horns. To express its joy and love, it will touch its claws to its beloved Trainer and release a harmless jolt.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME coils around rowdy Pokémon and uses its ribbons to calm them down. If this proves ineffective, it can deliver a soporific venom through its fangs, though it hates to do so, and only uses it as a last resort.
author: sk372

entry: The feelers on POKENAME's body induce calmness in whoever they touch. They unfortunately grow hotter the longer they remain on skin and can cause burns after prolonged contact.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely kind and generous, POKENAME will offer up its milk to anyone it thinks looks unhappy. The milk is very healthy and calming, so it is certainly effective at combating stress and unease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME milk is unique for being produced in various vibrant shades of pink and blue. The coloration, alongside the sweet flavor, makes it a popular novelty drink sold in most stores.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to adopt and protect any eggs that it finds in the wild. POKENAME will encourage and guide these eggs on their journey towards cracking, and then provide ample love and support once they do.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME generates colorful storm clouds above it that respond to the emotions of others. Aggressive behavior in its presence triggers paralyzing, brightly colored bolts of lightning from the clouds.
author: sk372

entry: The lightning bolts POKENAME can summon from its ribbons are imbued with calming energy. Being struck by one instantly shocks the target into suddenly becoming very energetic and friendly with others.
author: soup1900

entry: If one feels refreshed and gains a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Following the winds, POKENAME chase down hostility and bitterness in order to restore calm and purify the situation. Their elegance as they run into any situation is matched only by their sparkling bodies and graceful ribbons.
author: soup1900

entry: If one feels refreshed and gains a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's ribbons can purify any body of water with a single touch. Drinking the water immediately after it has been purified is believed to extend a person's lifespan.
author: sk372

entry: If one feels refreshed and gains a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known to reward those that revere them with blessings, while showing no mercy to any that show them disrespect.
author: xenellia

entry: POKENAME's horn releases a calming pecan scent throughout its cavern home. This soothes predators before they can draw close to its nest deep in the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its long feelers to secure itself to rock formations high on cave walls. It waits quietly for evolution in this suspended position, sometimes hanging over 50 feet in the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME detests combat within its territory; if it sees others fighting, it creates a massive storm of multicolored sand. The grains of sand blind others and slowly whittle away their combat urges, making continuing to fight impossible.
author: sk372

entry: Those who reside near POKENAME's claimed mountain are under its protection. It treats companions gently, but picking on those it guards will cause it to show the terrible depths of its wrath and strength.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient Johtonian texts call POKENAME 'It That Brings Rapture'. One flap of its wings is enough to create a raging flow of wind, however it's harmless and only causes others swept up in it to be hit with an inexplicable sense of jubilance.
author: beatdoof

entry: Ancient Johtonian texts call POKENAME 'It That Brings Rapture'. One flap of its wings is enough to create a raging flow of wind, however it's harmless and only causes others swept up in it to be hit with an inexplicable sense of jubilance.
author: beatdoof

entry: If electric shocks fail to stop a fight, POKENAME releases a strong calming aura from its chest ribbon. The opponent usually loses the will to battle within moments of being exposed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings leave behind a beautiful rainbow of pink and blue hues as it flies. Feathers shed from it while in flight are considered an almost priceless accessory and status symbol in some circles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's colors are far more vivid and luminous than the eye alone can perceive. It is said that those who have seen POKENAME fly with its feelers fully straight will be blessed with a full realization of the self and eternal fortune.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME hates conflict and releases a soothing aura to calm angry hearts. Records describing it as an “emissary of peace” can be found across many different eras.
author: mepp.

entry: While bouncing on its tail, POKENAME releases a delightful chamomile aroma. It uses this to relax its kin during the stressful winter months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's main diet consists only of berries, with Roseli Berry being its favorite. It likes to charm random Trainers coming across it to feed it, using its funny, empty stares and smile.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are always up to trouble, but their pranks end when someone gets hurt. They pause their antics to offer a soothing hug to ease the pain of those harmed by their pranks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often chants incantations that cause Pokémon to stop fighting. This makes it easier to defeat foes, as they'll no longer try to retaliate.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped tails to resolve arguments in its flock. If the quarrelers fail to calm down, POKENAME will kick them out without mercy.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: Its cries can soothe flocks of agitated bird Pokémon and compel them to obey it for a time. Although some see it as an omen and potential threat, it has yet to use its powers for anything other than ending strife.
author: infinex21

entry: The multicolored stones on POKENAME's head emit a maple aroma when it is stressed. This scent works to calm it down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoy copying the movements of other Pokémon as a gesture of goodwill. If the Pokémon they are copying gets upset, POKENAME swoop in with a hug from their ribbons to apologize.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gifts the small round stones it collects to those it truly cherishes. Having been brushed by its ribbons for so long, the stones carry some of its positive energy, soothing the nerves of one who holds them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME become restless, and their electricity weakens when there is hostility nearby them. They wrap each other in their ribbons to soothe each other and restore their calm again.
author: soup1900

entry: Thousands of volts course through POKENAME's ribbonlike tail. Even brief contact can cause paralysis that may last for months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to eat, but hates doing so alone. Brushing its ribbons against others causes them to feel pangs of hunger, making it easy for POKENAME to share food and have company while eating.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are used to help with swimming lessons and those scared of the ocean. Its ribbon-like feelers helps soothe nerves while it gently carries them along the shallow waters.
author: sk372

entry: The feelers extending from POKENAME's head allow it to maintain balance effortlessly even on icy surfaces. They can also extend further to sense approaching weather changes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their claws to leave marks in the terrain to signal to their packs, but some researchers have developed guides for understanding these marks. Though they gang up to hunt prey, they strike with precision to ensure no suffering occurs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses magnetism to fly and is often found singing to soothe those with negative emotions, which it senses through its ribbonlike feelers. While elegant, this Pokémon is cold and precise in battle.
author: jonclyd

entry: The saliva that drips from POKENAME's ribbon-like tongue can soothe on contact. Chiropractors frequently apply these drippings to pressure points to relieve pent-up stress.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME curls its body into a Rollout, opalescent glitter and sprinkles shoot out of its body, leaving the ground it rolls on shimmering with pink and white. The slobber in its tongue has been used in Kantonian dishes as an umami ingredient.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME fights with precise intent by shooting glitter-filled boulder from its hands or creating a colorful carnation-periwinkle sandstorm that obscures it from view. It doesn't differentiate between playing and battling.
author: beatdoof

entry: A walking mass of countless ribbon tentacles, POKENAME could pacify an entire city with its many limbs. If one comes across a town filled completely with strangely placid, happy citizens, a POKENAME may be affecting the populace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ribbons contain enough voltage that merely touching the tips can create a shower of electric sparks. Despite this, it is gentle and prefers to avoid combat, only using enough power to paralyze those who try to fight it.
author: sk372

entry: The color of POKENAME's fire launched from its arm alternates between pink and blue. The blue flames are more powerful, but the pink fire causes those singed by it to slowly grow weaker as their energy is burned away.
author: sk372

entry: It's egg long forgotten, POKENAME confidently soars through the skies, spreading happiness wherever it goes. It is said that seeing one can give you a newfound understanding of yourself.
author: jemeremmazza

entry: POKENAME's peaceful look causes other Pokémon to let their guard down right before it zaps them with 100,000 volts from its ribbons. When it has stored too much electricity, it slaps its ribbons wildly around until all the energy has been discharged.
author: soup1900

entry: When colliding with another Pokémon while digging, POKENAME emits a soothing aura. This prevents territorial conflict as it retreats further underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very clingy and will try to carry its Trainer everywhere it goes. However, it tries its best to keep its Trainer safe while in flight, wrapping its ribbons around them to keep them secure.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME perform photosynthesis to acquire their needed nutrients for the day, even as they move. The air they produce through this process is not only clean, but it also carries a soothing aroma.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME have scarcely been seen, but every report of them claimed they were protecting or saving others lost in blizzards. Their bodies are cool to the touch; touching their fur seemingly soothes fear and anxiety within minutes.
author: infinex21

entry: Being naturally immune to poison, POKENAME uses its needle-like tail to extract harmful toxins from people and Pokémon alike. This procedure is painless and leaves only a small mark that quickly heals.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME releases a strong cotton candy-like scent from its tusks while traveling through snowy areas. This attracts nearby Snorunt, who find it soothing, which POKENAME then preys upon.
author: .izik

entry: While inside a computer, POKENAME displays images it has collected online to calm upset users viewing the screen. Though its intentions are good, the images chosen are sometimes very odd and fail to have the desired effect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can release soothing waves to forcefully pacify others; however, this causes them to act strangely. They are forced to agree with anything anyone asks and be super nice, as if they are unable to start any disagreement at all.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is often seen used as an emotional support Pokémon for IT companies, radiating joy and happiness through its feelers and glitters during particularly tough breaks. Fairy Tale Girl Trainers like having it as their ace.
author: beatdoof

entry: Wild POKENAME make their nests within, upon, or near the most verdant trees they can find. They care for all life, but they are most serious about caring for these trees.
author: infinex21

entry: Among POKENAME packs, the one with the longest ribbon growing from its head is deemed the leader. It leads the group with a kind heart but won't hesitate to turn stern should any pack member resist its teachings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can traverse dense jungle with ease and haste thanks to their ribbon-like appendages and keen senses. Pokémon Rangers work together with their POKENAME partners to track down poachers and to save others from sudden, severe weather.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME often hang from branches using their long, ribbon-like appendages. They spit small fireballs at others' feet with playful intent, though most take this as an act of aggression.
author: infinex21

entry: In combat, POKENAME's soft ribbonlike back quills harden into razor-sharp edges. It coils into a ball while releasing calming pheromones to confuse predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its long feelers as extra limbs during combat. They extend to great lengths and enable a variety of flipping movements to bring opponents down.
author: .izik

entry: Although POKENAME usually prefer to not fight, they are quite adept at fighting when they deem it necessary. They weave punches and kicks with attacks that utilize their feelers, including using their feelers to immobilize or disrupt their opponent.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their long feelers to keep foes at range or to entangle foes that have drawn near. They can release bursts of energy from their feet to deliver swift and powerful kicking attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: A soothing aura emanates from the fins on its cheeks when it cries out. By planting its feet into the ground, this Pokémon can muster enough strength to lift a human adult or large Pokémon out of deep mud pits.
author: infinex21

entry: Its hind legs are stout, yet strong enough that it can lift large boulders over its head without buckling. It uses its ribbony appendages to reinforce itself as needed, be it for strength or for balance.
author: infinex21

entry: While lounging on the shoreline during hot summer months, POKENAME's tail fin releases a distinct peppercorn scent. Many claim this is enough to soothe someone through the hardest of times, while others find it abhorrent.
author: .izik

entry: Their strong bodies allow them to swim against powerful currents, even if they are carrying or holding others. POKENAME are beloved by beachgoers because even the wild ones will not hesitate to save anyone in danger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's empathic abilities keep it completely in tune with its Trainer. Should its Trainer grow depressed, it releases psychic waves to help soothe their emotions.
author: .izik

entry: Their blue horns are attuned to the emotions of others, allowing them to easily find or avoid humans or Pokémon. They are drawn to those riddled with fear and/or anxiety and offer comfort to those they find.
author: infinex21

entry: The heart POKENAME carries is not its heart, but rather a manifestation of the joy and love it received from its Trainer. When it is overwhelmed with positive emotions from others, its heart and head will glow bright pink.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME captivates audiences with its dances, jumping and twirling about viewers and making sure to brush against each one with its ribbons. There is always a smile on every face in the crowd after a POKENAME performance.
author: sk372

entry: Many wild Pokémon have been seen twirling in open fields at the crack of dawn, their long feelers swirling around themselves. They are unfazed by any signs of aggression and remain compassionate, even when struck.
author: infinex21

entry: The heart wand POKENAME carries can transmit resonant waves of love and joy to nearby humans and Pokémon, pacifying any potential conflict. Therapists have used POKENAME to help them in their care, and it seems to be popular with Fairy Tale Girls.
author: beatdoof

entry: The heart wand POKENAME carries can transmit resonant waves of love and joy to nearby humans and Pokémon, pacifying any potential conflict. Therapists have used POKENAME to help them in their care, and it seems to be popular with Fairy Tale Girls.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME absolutely abhors violence and strife. It creates a small specialized black hole that sucks the negative emotions of all those around it before destroying it, leaving those afflicted feeling placid and content, if also exhausted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their immense psychic abilities to protect their Trainers and weaker Pokémon, even if they themselves have been caught and tamed. Those caught by their feelers quickly lose the drive to fight, even in their own defense.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into magical power. The greater the bond they share, the stronger POKENAME will become.
author: mileysakiko

entry: POKENAME's ribbons being present around its arms is a sign of it being calm and at peace. If angered, it unwraps its arms before unleashing the blades from its elbows, taking swift vengeance on those who forced it to feel such negative emotions.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME often appear to defend other wild Pokémon who are weaker than their aggressors. They fight with their blade-like elbows and restrain unruly foes using their ribbon-like feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: The ribbons extending from POKENAME's elbows can stiffen and sharpen in order to be more formidable in combat. Outside of battle, they flutter gently and can soothe minor aches and pains in those touched by them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into super strength. The more their Trainer is in danger, the stronger POKENAME will become.
author: beatdoof

entry: It floats around quietly, drifting towards those angry or in distress, soothing them with a touch from its ribbon-like wings. It's thought that POKENAME actually feeds on the negative emotions it siphons from others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's princess-like cap is actually a very thick horn. The cloth-like tip is coated with a toxin that can cause horrible fevers after even brief contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys making others feel happy, but is rather shy and reclusive. It blends itself into its surroundings to hide away and brush its ribbons against others in secret, so they never find out where the sudden rush of elation came from.
author: sk372

entry: The aura POKENAME emits from its metallic body causes those nearby to feel calm. It has been used to help people meditate.
author: .izik

entry: A group of POKENAME gathering together is called a unison. Research has shown each different POKENAME seems to be interested in different aspects of human culture, though vexillology seems to be a shared interest among some unison.
author: beatdoof

entry: Should POKENAME sense someone not calmed by the aura of its metallic body, it will pin them down with its heavy arms. It then releases psychic jolts to their mind to ensure they get calm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be seen in libraries and museums guiding Trainers and many others thanks to its ability to store exabytes of information inside. Researchers probed into some POKENAME's heads and found flags to be repeated constantly and prominently.
author: beatdoof

entry: When POKENAME sees someone upset, it releases psychic bursts that bring them to a calm state. Prolonged exposure can induce deep slumber and in some cases even comas.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes its duty seriously as a guardian of knowledge, armed with strong limbs that can crush most anything and a peerless psychic mind. Some POKENAME seem to demonstrate the ability to change their color depending on the flag they hold.
author: beatdoof

entry: The ribbons extending from POKENAME's body are capable of lifting heavy loads with ease. It can carry two logs simultaneously with little effort.
author: .izik

entry: While POKENAME lives around dams, these shy Pokémon only surface when surrounded by other Sylbarel. They've been observed to decorate their dams with pretty leaves and flowers.
author: beatdoof

entry: A conglomerate spirit made of willing, kind individuals. Those souls lost themselves in service to creating something to help future generations.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME's aura powers reach their maximum potential when there is only calm and tranquility around it. When there is conflict, it uses its ribbons to crush the hostile aura and restore calm.
author: soup1900

entry: Although they typically prefer not to fight, they will launch fierce Moonblast and Aura Sphere attacks to protect those they care for. They only let those they trust touch their feelers, which serve to help them sense auras.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cannot resist the urge to bite down on any new acquaintance it comes across. Its teeth are coated with an enzyme that induces a feeling of joy shortly after being bitten.
author: sk372

entry: When cornered in combat, POKENAME can fly into a draconic rage, its feelers extending to great distances to gain the upper hand. It will strike with Moonblast when it feels confident enough to finish the fight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ribbon bow can detect all hostility in an area, acting like a radar. However, it is unable to detect anyone peaceful. To locate its prey, it sends waves of hostile aura all around as it flies around so its prey becomes detectable.
author: soup1900

entry: Its sharp blades can cut through steel beams without chipping or being slowed down. Every cut made into foe or prey by this Pokémon forcefully soothes the victim, causing them to cease resisting long before they succumb to their injuries.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's blades of wind are infused with calming waves that cause its foe to not become agitated despite being violently struck. It uses these same soothing auras to calm competing predators so that it has total dominance of the sky.
author: soup1900

entry: A gentle peacekeeper among Pokémon, POKENAME is particularly effective at calming down rowdy male Nidoran and its related fusions. Just a few touches from its ribbons will cause even a raging Nidoking to become placid and content.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon lives by lakes and rivers where other Pokémon go to drink. They keep the peace and stop any Pokémon from fighting.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME has become known for its habit of bathing in the sun.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its feelers to deter attackers. If that fails, it lashes out with poison-coated feelers to flee.
author: .izik

entry: Its pastel colors belie a cunning battler. Its ribbonlike feelers are soothing to touch, though it may be picky about who it allows to hold them.
author: wigglypon

entry: Any sea creature that swims too close to POKENAME will be wrapped up by its ribbon-like feelers. These numb and paralyze the captured victim, making them easy for POKENAME to swallow up for a quick meal.
author: sk372

entry: The feelers on POKENAME's head can extend up to 100 feet while it roots itself into the seafloor. Should they make contact with prey like Horsea, it drags them in to feast in one swift motion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME extends its feelers to great lengths to locate organic material on the seafloor. It prefers to scavenge rather than hunt.
author: .izik

entry: Deep in the ocean, the ribbon on POKENAME's head emits a soft cerulean glow. This attracts prey to its location before it slashes them with its claws.
author: .izik

entry: When headbutting a foe, POKENAME releases a pink powder from its head that smells of clay. This powder appears to calm its opponent if inhaled.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME often charges headfirst at others, it rarely, if ever, headbutts anything. It runs that way because its ribbons are closer to its cranium, making it easier to wrap around others and pull them into friendly hugs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their steel heads to intercept attacks and protect others. When their heads are struck, a sound is released, and those who hear it will feel a wave of calm wash over them.
author: infinex21

entry: Their heads are tougher than tungsten, and no attacks faze them even if taken head-on. Their heads are equally heavy, so their bodies have evolved to better support their own weight. They can each carry two adult humans on their backs without issue.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME would be full of energy if not for their overpowering, calming auras that keep their emotions in check. Their auras are so strong that they even cause others who are too close to be compelled to lay down their arms and rest.
author: infinex21

entry: While it is devoted to its job to make peace with several Pokémon, POKENAME is not as enthused in calming down male Nidorino and its related fusions. It uses its ribbons to wrap around a Pokémon to nullify any negative emotions, even lingering ones.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME carries itself with a calm and regal demeanor at all times. Gentle by nature, it always tries to deescalate a situation peaceably, but will deftly utilize the blade it carries if a peaceful solution is unattainable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have oft been drawn to impending disasters, offering aid and comfort to those who would be affected by them. Many stories prevail of POKENAME that have saved and protected many others, even at the cost of their very selves.
author: infinex21

entry: When bored at night, POKENAME floats near building windows to check on the humans within. If it finds someone having fitful dreams, it expels a soothing aura from its skull to calm them.
author: .izik

entry: The ribbon-like wrappings that encase the body of POKENAME exude a calming aura. This aura allows it to soothe those it cares for and to lull those it feels hostile towards into a state where it can easily pull them into its void-like body.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its ribbon-like tongue saps those it touches of their will to fight, even as it forcefully restrains them. Its uppermost eye emits calming waves at whoever looks at it, even if it is not directly looking back.
author: infinex21

entry: A large Pokémon that can shrug off most attacks and will remain unfazed by them as well. It is more than happy to ferry others across the sea; many claim that they felt calm upon its back, even as they crossed through storms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's ribbons have the power to instantly calm even the most belligerent rampaging Pokémon. It can form up to a thousand ribbons to soothe entire hordes of people in need of its calming embrace.
author: sk372

entry: The sprout on POKENAME's head grows five more inches each night while it sleeps, releasing an apple scent. This tends to relax anyone who draws near, including predators.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its kind appearance, many call POKENAME the “Bandit of the Glade”. It wanders forests exuding an intense calming aura before snatching fruit from unsuspecting hands with its dexterous feelers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a delightful basil scent from its shell upon sensing someone upset. This tends to calm them within moments.
author: .izik

entry: The burnt charcoal scent POKENAME exudes from the feelers on its body has a surprisingly calming effect. It waves these feelers rapidly to spread the scent faster.
author: .izik

entry: Some POKENAME that have lived with a Trainer or their related family for a long time will show a different pigmentation than most other POKENAME. Galarian history tells of a story of a medieval Galarian lord fighting side by side with POKENAME.
author: beatdoof

entry: It is said that whenever a male Nidoking or its fusion goes berserk, POKENAME will appear to them in a puff of pink mist to subdue them, by words or by tranquil force. It uses its ribbons and warm body to wrap around and calm any crying baby Pokémon.
author: beatdoof

entry: While sleeping, POKENAME's poison-coated feelers emit a steady calming aura. This keeps nearby allies relaxed and prevents panic during severe storms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a playful spirit and often jumps on its Trainer to mess up their hair with its hands or ribbons. When it is time to battle, however, it becomes serious, using its agility to outmaneuver its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A thick burnt cedar fume leaks from the flame on POKENAME's head as it sleeps. Many claim this soothing scent can put a crying infant to sleep in moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs complex movements that resemble dancing to distract opponents before attacking. Trainers who underestimate it often find their teams overwhelmed.
author: gtrwya

entry: POKENAME can't resist trying to one-up others of its kind. If two POKENAME run into each other, they will compete to see who can make the other feel happier with their ribbons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers to live on its own, and disdains having company. Uninvited guests are rubbed by its feelers, which cause them to feel giddy and lightheaded, before being pushed away to wander aimlessly elsewhere.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can breathe through the tips of its feelers, allowing it to remain fully submerged in water while sleeping or hunting. The feelers can extend up to 50 feet to search for fresh air.
author: .izik

entry: The thick white mucus that drips from POKENAME's large nose is used in bath salts. Spas throughout the world rely on it as a relaxation aid for abnormally tense customers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are natural entertainers. Using magnetism, they detach and manipulate various parts of their body to put on dazzling displays.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Each strike against an opponent POKENAME's makes saps their will to fight until they have no choice to capitulate. The two swords link their ribbons together, tying them tightly so as to never be separated.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME battles almost entirely defensively, with its shield creating a calming aura after absorbing blows, draining foes of their fighting spirit. Only once a foe tires out will it draw its blade to knock them out with a glancing strike.
author: sk372

entry: A colorful, sparkling trail follows POKENAME's blade with every swing. The blade is coated with an aura that numbs and calms a foe with every strike, until eventually they no longer feel the urge to fight anymore.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wraps prey in poison-laced feelers that induce complacency. As the victim relaxes, a fever causing vivid hallucinations weakens their body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feelers become incredibly sharp when it faces adversity. During tense battles, they can slice deep grooves into limestone with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leads a battalion comprised of only Sylsharp. But rather than it leading them, it's more like a royal arrangement of it being served and spoiled endlessly by its battalion.
author: beatdoof

entry: When slicing through objects, POKENAME's blades emit a calming chalky aroma. This keeps its own adrenaline in check even during battle.
author: .izik

entry: A battalion of POKENAME forms to serve a Syliard leader. It defeats its enemies by nullifying their minds and souls through their armblades and feelers, temporarily enthralling them under their leader's commands.
author: beatdoof

entry: Despite its grim look, POKENAME is a kind creature, especially toward its Trainer, to whom it shows unconditional affection. The star on the tail emits a light capable of calming nearby Pokémon, while its ribbons allow it to sense their emotions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's metallic body is vibrant, sparkling under even a small amount of light. It spends much of its time collecting shining gems, polishing them until they gleam with the same level of shininess as it does.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spots a quarrel, it uses its wings to blow away the disputers far from each other. When it can't blow them away, it kicks up a Fairy Wind to surround the quarrelers and force soothing auras into them.
author: soup1900

entry: It uses its wings to churn up or dispel sandstorms, either for its own protection or to protect others. It has appeared before weary travelers to protect them from other Pokémon far stronger than itself, earning it a renowned reputation.
author: infinex21

entry: These lake-dwelling Pokémon have been depicted in many artworks as guardians that quell any strife near their dwellings. Most people would agree that these Pokémon, and their shed scales, are some of the most beautiful things to ever be witnessed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME wildly blasts soothing auras all around when there is hostility nearby. Since it hits everything in these uncontrollable blasts, Pokémon and people who were already calm suddenly are unable to become angry for a few days no matter what.
author: soup1900

entry: Its roar has a mystifying power over the emotions of those who hear it, causing them to lose their drive to fight within minutes. It only allows its Trainer to ride upon it, let alone to hold onto its ribbon-like feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the ribbons that make up their bodies as snares, wrapping and enveloping their opponent to disable them. Once a foe is trapped, POKENAME patiently waits until their foe simply gives up.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME observes parents at playgrounds before transforming into them to lure children into nearby forests. It emits a calming aura to ensure its targets remain none the wiser before it feasts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have the remarkable power to create realistic illusions in a wide area around them. They will use their illusions to protect and comfort friends and family.
author: infinex21

entry: When confronted by a powerful foe, its wing-like tail flutters, exuding a peaceful aura that leaves its opponents in a majestic trance.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is a very loving and supportive creature. It is said to help others find their true selves.
author: westerlytrack45

entry: The toxin on POKENAME's feelers causes numbness and intense euphoria. While prey is overwhelmed by bliss, it strikes with a powerful Thrash.
author: .izik

entry: Kalosian mythology calls POKENAME 'Jubilance of the Primordial Waves.' It summons opalescent deluges that wash away all trace of malice or grief, silencing nerves and the instinct of pain.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME possesses the ability to manipulate the ground, trapping those who show negativity near it in a prison of dirt and rock until they improve their mood. It's believed it will one day reshape the world into one of only positivity.
author: sk372

entry: Kalosian mythology states POKENAME as 'The World's Exalted Fury.' It creates an iridescent, incandescent pillar of light that blinds those who see it. The last thing they will feel is boundless joy and happiness as the earth cracks beneath them.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME creates soothing winds and sends them down below the ozone layer to prevent any conflicts between land and sea dwellers. Its ribbonlike feelers sense the wind to track when any object flies high into the sky.
author: soup1900

entry: Kalosian mythology describes POKENAME as 'Firmament of Peace's Sorrow', a Pokémon of order that restores emotional anomalies around the world by sucking out excess emotions and returning lost ones. It keeps an ever-watchful gaze from the ozone layer.
author: beatdoof

entry: Some stories persist that depict this Pokémon as a guardian of life, be it humans, Pokémon, or plants. These stories are supported, to an extent, by the fact that POKENAME will protect those nearby if it feels they are in danger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's feelers dart around constantly without conscious effort. Should they detect something that has been affected by time manipulation, they vibrate aggressively.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has little tolerance for negative emotions in its presence. Those that don't act positively around it are said to be banished through a portal to a dimension of pure positive energy, until they learn to behave better.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that POKENAME was banished from its own world, a dimension of emotionless and unfeeling creatures. It has a lonely personality, growing attached to others quickly and keeping them close with its soothing ribbon-like feelers.
author: sk372

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's feelers become capable of shattering mountains. Due to its naturally calm personality, it takes considerable time for it to reach such anger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lull people to sleep with promises of joy and comfort, only to trap them in their own dreams. It plays within the dreams and nightmares of people, not seeming to understand the difference between the two, or perhaps not caring.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can weaponize its soothing auras into dangerous blasts of energy using the cannon on its back. However, it is only able to fire this cannon when near hostility; otherwise, the cannon will charge a shot only for nothing to come out.
author: soup1900

entry: A prototype of POKENAME that was designed to collect Fairy-type energy. However, the Moon Drive was faulty, so it was scrapped.
author: t.i.a.

entry: POKENAME's tail fur takes on a golden flame-like hue as it flies through the night sky, visible from hundreds of feet below. It releases an intense aura that relaxes any townspeople it passes over, however briefly.
author: .izik

entry: When the moon hangs high and bright in the sky, POKENAME ventures out to dance beneath the moonlight. As it hops about, its ribbons leave a sparkling trail of moonbeam energy.
author: sk372

entry: During battle, POKENAME extends each of its feelers to great lengths and releases high amounts of electricity to incapacitate foes. When out of combat, these feelers become as soft as velvet.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME exudes an aura that chills those around it, freezing them before it bathes them in blue and pink flames. Rather than burn the target, it seems to cleanse them; those attacked say it is as if their negative emotions had been burned away.
author: sk372

entry: During the evening, POKENAME travels to nearby hills and extends its arms wide. It releases a lavender scent from its petals that calms those in the surrounding area.
author: .izik

entry: Its ribbon-like vines are clad in many small thorns that make quick work of most foes. It fights as if it were performing an elegant dance, wreathed in its own soothing aroma while whipping foes with its vines.
author: infinex21

entry: It produces a special gas within itself, which allows it to control the altitude at which it drifts. This gas is soothing enough that someone with a phobia of heights can safely enjoy an aerial ride with a POKENAME.
author: infinex21

entry: Extremely cautious, POKENAME never approaches too closely to someone until it has first touched them with its ribbons. The ribbons emit a calming aura that helps ensure they won't act aggressively towards POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very easy to catch, though studies speculate whether it's because it purposely wants to be captured or takes pity on Trainers catching it. POKENAME uses its High Jump Kick against Dragon-type Pokémon effectively while leaping with grace.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is very easy to catch, though studies speculate whether it's because it purposely wants to be captured or takes pity on Trainers catching it. POKENAME uses its High Jump Kick against Dragon-type Pokémon effectively while leaping with grace.
author: beatdoof

entry: The blue powder POKENAME releases mid-combat can soothe its opponent, putting them off guard. It uses this opening to strike with a furious kick.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies at such high speeds that it leaves colorful afterimages behind. Catching sight of these duplicates disorients opponents, letting POKENAME more easily evade attacks.
author: sk372

entry: While floating through city streets at night, POKENAME's eyes glow as it releases a calming aura from its feelers. This lulls people into complacency before it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: It is said to have grown malicious due to being abandoned by its Trainer. It siphons the very vitality and willpower of others with its ribbons, bringing about a false sense of calmness in its victims.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's bolt-shaped feelers crackle with playful electric energy, sparking harmlessly as it glides around. It enjoys sneaking into electronics, using its charm to cause cheerful and playful chaos. It enjoys bringing smiles to faces.
author: thepandasharky

entry: It has a habit of pulling its Trainer into a pocket of its surrounding fluid when at rest. This feels warm and comfy, not posing any risk of injury.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: During a full moon, the calming aura from POKENAME's feelers expands tenfold. Those nearby experience an unsettling sense of total calm.
author: .izik

entry: The soft cotton of POKENAME's body is reserved for people they trust, as they are known to push people of their body if they do not consent to being a head rest. If necessary, they wrap people with ribbons to teach people a lesson about consent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slip into rooms under door gaps by flattening their bodies into the width of a ribbon. Once they are inside, they toss ribbons everywhere and make a suitable mess before slipping out undetected.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have bodies as light as cotton and must tether themselves using their extendable ribbons, or else strong winds will carry them away. Many claim that their soft tufts will bring comfort to anyone, no matter their ailments or mood.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoy making messes but hesitate to burden their Trainer, so they rarely play with their own ribbons. If their Trainer leads as a role model and acts authentically, POKENAME celebrate with ribbons strewn about everywhere.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While moving through desert sands, POKENAME releases an aura that calms those within 100 feet. It uses this to catch them off guard before dragging them beneath the sand with its powerful jaws.
author: .izik

entry: Pokémon scour their desert habitats searching for victims of the intense heat to carry them to safety upon their backs. Their eyes are covered with a special film that allows them to see far, even through thick sandstorms.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME's body opens, it releases a blinding light capable of soothing anyone it touches. It appears to do this only when in deep distress.
author: .izik

entry: The tombs POKENAME guards is still studied by archaeologists, since the only records of it that survived are the androgynous-named rulers. It is said to disturb its tomb is to have one's mind entirely rewritten to be a pharaoh from millennia ago.
author: beatdoof

entry: It extends its feelers to snag prey at range. This causes a numbness to wash over the ensnared victim; it does not struggle as POKENAME consumes it.
author: wigglypon

entry: Much of its body resembles beloved treats for humans and Pokémon alike, which serves well to attract all manners of prey. It uses its ribbony feelers to ensnare its target and pummel it into submission.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's colorful wax has a consistency and scent similar to frosting. It is a friendly Pokémon, often appearing during special celebrations.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME feed on the positive emotions of humans and Pokémon inhabitants; the stronger the emotions, the stronger their flames. They can carry others using their ribbony appendages and by expelling much of their flames' heat.
author: infinex21

entry: Its hollow head is full of colourful gumball candies. It loves sharing them with others, but be warned: some of these treats are incredibly spicy!
author: wigglypon

entry: Its ribbon-like tusks are rigid, tough, and sharp; these tusks can cut through a steel beam without even chipping. Despite its daunting appearance, POKENAME loves to play with others and will let young Pokémon slide down its back and along its tail.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is able to manipulate powerful energy from its stone body, channeled into its hands. One hand wields blue energy and the other pink; when properly combined and utilized, this goliath of a Pokémon becomes nearly unstoppable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies above well-preserved ancient civilization's ruins, its blinding speed making it hard to see it as anything except a blur. It is said that those who saw it flying will feel a rush of memories from an ancient civilization's glory days.
author: beatdoof
