entry: POKENAME burns wood into fine ash before consuming it. Some believe the ash has calming properties when used in cosmetic treatments.
author: .izik

entry: Curious and friendly, POKENAME wraps the ribbon it extends from its mouth around anything that catches its attention. Pricking oneself on the spines on its back causes one to become numb and deliriously giddy within a few minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resemble objects that bring blissful nostalgia to most people. Their screen-like faces can display various icons to convey their every emotion felt. A well-loved POKENAME will cling to its Trainer using its feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: In ancient folklore, exchanging a POKENAME feather symbolized a bond never broken. These feathers retain their warmth even in blizzards and are passed down through generations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often struggle with uncertainty about how their Trainer would react to seeing their true selves. Trainers who act as a role model and live authentically will find themselves with a devoted partner in POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME struggle to carry themselves with grace and often trip over their own body trying to keep up a convincing disguise. Trainers who help POKENAME act authentically help them move one step closer towards being a confident Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME showers others in affection and love with the hope that some of that love will be reciprocated back. Trainers who are able to meet their needy desire for affection find lifelong partners.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is important to reassure POKENAME's feelings if they decide to show what is underneath their cloth exterior, as they often worry about being rejected by their Trainer. This reveal only occurs when they have utmost trust in their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is known as one of the most elegant Pokémon out there. It rapidly strikes targets with its ribbons.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is widely regarded as a sign of good times and peace, due to their migration pattern that leads it across all regions in the world. Their valuable scales are typically found by those in bad situations, allowing them a chance at better lives.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: With the fur over its eyes blinding it, POKENAME locates others by sensing emotional fluctuations with its ribbons. It only follows those who emanate largely positive emotions and is repelled by the negative.
author: sk372

entry: Its two heads allow it to focus on multiple targets at the same time, which serves it well when protecting weaker Pokémon. Its heads have their own food preferences and will exchange food with each other to ensure they are both happy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses two of its heads to lure in and befriend prey before secretly attacking them with the third. It steals the hostility of others, leaving them unnaturally calm while it poises itself to fight and destroy.
author: soup1900

entry: Only their central heads have brains, yet they are remarkably intelligent; they only think of compassion and joy. POKENAME use their three heads to defend others with fierce powers and to collect plenty of food for everyone around them.
author: infinex21

entry: Fusion has given POKENAME a color scheme resembling Latios. Its personality has gotten a bit more fierce and standoffish, but it still has a kind heart, carrying injured Pokémon it finds to safety.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has given POKENAME a color scheme resembling Latias. Its temperament seems to have become more mellow and amiable, and it seeks out companions to take on rides and adventures across the skyline.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur radiates warmth and comfort. On cold evenings, groups huddle together, generating remarkable heat within their den.
author: .izik

entry: This fusion gains an incredible amount of psychic strength. It also develops a worrying megalomaniac instinct to impose peace and love across the galaxy, annihilating anyone who resists.
author: epping_forest

entry: Legends persist that any heartfelt and unselfish wishes written on the notes on their heads will come true. When asleep, they exude a calming aura in a wide range to protect themselves; these auras are even stronger when they are awake.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME digs beneath homes and rests in clusters underground. During their slumber, they release a soothing aura to anyone in the home above.
author: .izik

entry: Its dams are the height of Pokémon comfort; few nests can compare to their intricacy. This has made POKENAME a popular partner for interior designers.
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME use their feelers to read the auras of others and to channel their own auras, though they are always training to be better at the latter. They have the ability to soothe others graced by the touch of their feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rarely has the energy to use its limbs for anything, so it instead uses its ribbons to move itself or grab things. Others touched by the ribbons will feel extremely sluggish and lethargic for the remainder of the day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tries to vent its excess energy by passing it on to others. It grips them in a tight embrace, its ribbon-like arms passing on its vitality and filling them with bursts of energy.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon love to meet others as much as others enjoy seeing them bounce atop ocean tides. There are many reports of wild Pokémon excitedly leaping onto land to meet others, though they cannot survive long out of the water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME loves to soothe its Trainer by using its ribbonlike feelers. It is known to alert its Trainer of any danger by glowing brightly.
author: bunkachunka

entry: When the tips of its feelers draw close or directly touch, electricity arcs between them. It has such refined control of its flow of electricity that some scientists have experimented with utilizing this Pokémon in some therapies and treatments.
author: infinex21

entry: If its calming aura fails, POKENAME emits a piercing cry. The sound can force predators into sudden sleep almost instantly.
author: .izik

entry: The feelers on POKENAME's body are composed of a thin aluminum-like material. It extends them to great lengths to probe for ore to eat.
author: .izik

entry: It bathes in strong currents, such as under waterfalls, to keep its metallic body smooth, clean, and polished. It commonly gifts its friends and its Trainer stones that it has smoothed and polished using its feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are obsessed with their own appearances and take great care to keep their steel bodies so polished that they shine and sparkle. They use their feelers to polish themselves and to retrieve metals, ores, and smooth stones to feed on.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME buries itself in sand and emits a calming aura that renders those nearby complacent. Once they are sufficiently relaxed, it emerges and bites at their legs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their large, strong jaws to bite through solid rock and form their dens in the resulting holes. Their breath has an unnaturally calming effect that quickly subdues prey they swallow whole.
author: infinex21

entry: Because they can only fly in short bursts, they have a habit of perching atop humans and Pokémon to help them get around. POKENAME exude soothing auras, which help them ride upon others without being attacked.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a welcome addition to any aquarium, as its ribbons brush against other aquatic life and improve their mood with a calming aura. Even underwater plant life thrives more over time with POKENAME's presence.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME flings itself off cliffs in an attempt to fly, its ribbons leave a colorful trail of sparkles behind. The ribbons have a numbing touch to them that POKENAME uses to soothe its head after hitting the ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell is made of a bright, sturdy material that resists most attacks easily. Striking its shell makes it release calming waves, so anything trying to hunt it quickly begins losing the urge to continue attacking it.
author: sk372

entry: Many POKENAME are beloved friends of people who work with fabric. They love to create bows and ribbons on clothes made by their Trainer. They can even fix a broken sewing machine with enough encouragement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME unwinds its long ribbon-like body to catch or pick up objects for its Trainer. If completely unwound, POKENAME can reach more than 100 meters away, though it prefers to remain coiled in its spool.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME studies kids in playgrounds before transforming into them in hopes of being brought home for a free meal. It emits a calming aura to keep parents around it none the wiser.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon who seek attention and friendship with humans and other Pokémon alike. Those who touch their feelers will be granted soothing visions of what their hearts truly desire.
author: infinex21

entry: When Trainers see this Pokémon's floppy ears in the wild, they cannot help but pet it.
author: themadcactus

entry: When distressed, POKENAME's rubbery body produces a high-pitched tone. The sound both soothes and induces widespread sleep in nearby predators.
author: .izik

entry: The pollen released from POKENAME's bud has a calming effect. This unique capability allows it to evade predators with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: The pollen of its flowers has calming effects on most who inhale it. This Pokémon uses its ribbon-like vines to force its prey to inhale the pollen to quickly subdue them.
author: infinex21

entry: Like Drifloon, POKENAME still takes children. Its ribbonlike feelers calm down the children so that they won't scream or fight back.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME's thick cotton fur keeps them warm during winter. When they feel comfortable, they wrap their ribbons around their Trainer, emanating a cozy warmth to convey trust.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's ears are always coiled, only uncoiled when it's near anyone it can trust. A Sinnohan folk tale describes it protecting its Trainer and their family against a rampaging Dragon-type Pokémon.
author: beatdoof

entry: The violet spores POKENAME scatters carry a strong peppermint scent. They tend to soothe anyone within a 10-foot area but can cause intense drowsiness.
author: .izik

entry: Its colorful cap glows in the dark, which has served to help lost travelers many a time. It scatters colorful spores when it feels threatened, which can muddle the mind and make one seem much more calm and peaceful for hours.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME seek out negative emotions to feed on, so there are many who welcome their presence. They become easily attached to those who are prone to such emotions and cling to them using their ribbons.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will often gather with others of its kind to communicate and bond. They do this by tapping their small ribbons against their liquid bodies.
author: jackjirachi

entry: With its cytoplasm becoming more developed and sturdy, POKENAME are able to hug their Trainers affectionately without their bodies breaking apart.
author: jackjirachi

entry: During autumn, POKENAME sheds portions of its cotton body that carry a soothing chemical. Anyone who touches this cotton will feel calm within moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feelers dangle freely as it travels through desert sands. This helps regulate its body temperature during the summer months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its wings as it flies in formation. The swarm calms targets briefly before striking together with Supersonic.
author: .izik

entry: The feelers dangling from POKENAME's body leave intricate patterns in desert sands as it walks through dunes. Each POKENAME traces unique patterns as it moves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shows the unique stone it carries to others feeling stress, which seems to hypnotize them and calm them down once the trance is broken. It's said that during the trance, a person views joyful moments from their past lives.
author: sk372

entry: Despite the imperceptible similarity of the Shiny Stone POKENAME carries to a normal one, it is a more volatile and unstable evolution stone. It is said only the most confident and just Pokémon can touch its Shiny Stone without triggering any change.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME absorbs electricity through its feelers at rapid intervals. When nervous, this electricity leaks out and shocks anyone nearby.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is made of a material with a consistency similar to glue-based slime. Trainers enjoy poking and squishing it, a behavior the Pokémon appears to enjoy despite its grumpy expression.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite initial appearances, its ribbon-like tusks are sharp enough to cut through small rocks. It will charge at foes larger than itself without hesitation, especially if it's to save or protect others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME take meticulous care of their ribbon-like tusks every day. Their tusks regrow overnight if they are broken, but they will be downtrodden for days over the loss of their prior tusk or tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was employed by apothecaries for the calming jasmine scent it exuded. Many succumbing to fevers were eased into slumber by this aroma.
author: .izik

entry: If an ancient ruin has recently been unearthed or continually preserved, POKENAME will appear to comfort and support those who've worked at the site. In the process, it will often lose its limbs due to its somewhat fragile build.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's down takes on a calming jalapeno-like aroma when it is trying to soothe others in its flock. This scent calms its kin with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME communicate with melodious cries that plenty find soothing. So many enjoy their cries that they have been recorded for repeated listening; some of these cries are utilized in select therapies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's thick feathers exude a spicy mustard scent as it flies on foggy days. This helps keep its flock calm during the difficult conditions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grow hotter as they become more excited, which, in turn, makes them want to move quicker. They become excited during battle and while playing with their friends.
author: infinex21

entry: The bow on POKENAME's head grows hot enough to melt iron when it is irritated. Should it become too upset, it will unleash a deluge of flames from its abdomen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their feelers to fling fireballs at their prey and their opponents. Although they are bug Pokémon, many still love to hold them due to how soft and warm their bodies are.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME latches onto sleeping prey and drains their life force with its maw. A calming venom is injected to keep the victim docile while it feeds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lays flat on cave floors beneath a thin layer of dirt, waiting to be disturbed. If stepped on, it wraps its ribbon-like body around the offender with enough force to break bones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is heavily devoted to its Trainer, gifting them with all the gemstones it can find. Its gemstones are enchanted with many different healing and protection spells.
author: mistymagius

entry: One must be careful approaching POKENAME in the wild, as it is skittish and will bite if frightened. Its bite contains a venom that induces numbness and euphoria in those afflicted.
author: sk372

entry: It moves by rolling rapidly. Though the ring around its body looks and smells like a sweet baked dessert, it can make a painful impact.
author: hophoppip

entry: Waiting for its evolution, POKENAME curls itself into a near-impervious ball that can roll at 250 km/h. While curled, it passively feeds on positive emotions it can feel, which seems to make it evolve faster.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME releases a venom from its body that, in small doses, induces calm. It uses this to soothe its young during storms.
author: .izik

entry: By wrapping its body around an enemy, POKENAME can transfer lethal amounts of toxin through its feelers. Some pharmaceutical companies have harvested these toxins from a trained POKENAME, diluting them into effective antidepressants.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are remarkably curious, even so much as to willingly approach strangers to learn about them. They can easily bite through and digest hard foods. Their cries have a noteworthy effect of calming those who hear them.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite a terrifying size and appearance, POKENAME is a gentle giant. Its main method of defense is a sharp roar that produces unique sound waves that sap the aggression in those that hear it.
author: sk372

entry: The feelers on POKENAME's head can stretch up to 25 feet during combat. Even brief contact with them can freeze portions of a foe's body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures travelers into snowy mountain caves with a soothing marshmallow-like scent. Once inside, it wraps them in icy feelers capable of freezing prey instantly.
author: .izik

entry: Travelers are warned against traipsing into POKENAME territory. POKENAME gets attached to visitors quickly, embracing them with its ribbons to pacify them and making them disinclined to leave. POKENAME freezes any who try to rescue the visitors.
author: sk372

entry: Folklore claims that POKENAME uses its ribbons to drag weary travelers deep into snowbanks to freeze to death. In reality, POKENAME creates snow caves in the snowdrifts and tries to bring frostbitten travelers there to warm up.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have mystic powers that make their very breath capable of freezing unruly foes within seconds if they so desire. Wild POKENAME are often found wandering snowy mountains, using their feelers to find the lost and guide them to safety.
author: infinex21

entry: The ribbonlike leaves on POKENAME's head emit a calming scent. Groups of three are said to halt even a rampaging Rhyhorn herd.
author: .izik

entry: The sight of POKENAME's fervent dancing and ribbon twirling is said to calm even the angriest of Gyarados. POKENAME's ribbons are delicate and any sign of damage causes POKENAME to work obsessively to mend them.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME will often cheer for others when they fight, though the harmless sparks that scatter from their pom-poms will inevitably soothe the combatants. If they rub their pom-poms together, they can generate stronger bolts of electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: The ribbons POKENAME dance with emit a soothing aura as they twirl. Many modern ribbon-dancing techniques were inspired by these Pokémon's movements.
author: santon5512

entry: While dancing on gravestones, POKENAME releases a peaceful lilac aroma. This brings calm to grieving humans throughout the cemetery.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects organic waste from trash cans to ferment within its sack-like body. Despite the contents, it releases a soothing lemon-lime scent that calms nearby humans.
author: .izik

entry: Its body mainly consists of glitter, stickers, makeup, and scraps of discarded dolls. It loves giving humans makeovers, even if its cosmetic skills are not very precise.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME responds to the negative feelings of others, moving en masse to swarm around swimmers who are in a bad mood. The school of POKENAME rub their ribbons all over the swimmer, overwhelming them with feelings of euphoria.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME sense a Dragon Pokémon stepping into their water, they swarm the intruder with vicious bites. Large populations of these Pokémon can completely separate flightless Dragon-type species across rivers.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME cuts through the water at incredibly high speeds. It tackles wild Sharpedo on the hunt to protect the prey from being eaten, wrapping its ribbons around the Sharpedo to restrain and neutralize their aggressive tendencies.
author: sk372

entry: Initial discoveries of some POKENAME assumed that it was a new species of unfused Pokémon that had become tangled in a Sylveon's feelers after a battle. Daring new attempts to approach this Pokémon have revealed it is really a new form of POKENAME.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME creates a bright, sparkling effect around it that stuns attackers. This gives POKENAME time to swim away or launch a devastating counterattack.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME create dazzling bursts of colorful light to attack. These lights are fueled by their sugar consumption, so Trainers make sure to feed them candy regularly. The species seems to enjoy sour candy strips the most.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has been described as one of the most terrifying dangers of the sea. To soften the impact of its imposing appearance, Trainers often decorate their POKENAME with cutesy accessories such as ribbons.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME loves to feast on decaying wood, often traveling through swamps in the evening to gather it with its feelers. It can consume up to 20 pounds of wood each day.
author: .izik

entry: On misty mornings, hikers through forests can sometimes distantly spot groups of POKENAME cheerfully playing together. It is said that any child who joins their play becomes spirited away by the mist and transforms into a POKENAME.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME use their ribbon-like tendrils to pull children deeper into the forest. Locals who live around these forests insist that any children who go with them become POKENAME themselves.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME releases an aura that draws calming scents from nearby trees. It can cause up to twenty trees at once to produce this effect.
author: .izik

entry: When a POKENAME takes up residence in a forest, it manipulates the plants there to drive out any Dragon-type Pokémon. This has been found to only have moderate success.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME grows blue berries that taste extremely bitter yet induce bliss. During battle, it tosses them into a predator's mouth to disable them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ears emit soothing, if scratchy sounds in its attempt to calm any negative emotions around it. Poké Fans are known to favor it as the Pokémon companion for their children.
author: beatdoof

entry: It is known to be a guardian of peace, sending out a tranquilizing aura. It is known to aggressively defend its territory if threatened.
author: lyman

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of those around it. It releases a calming wave of sound to settle negative emotions.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME emits sonic Fairy-type energy from its ears with a force strong enough to pulverize cave walls. Strangely, Trainers who stand too close to this don't experience hearing loss, but other side effects have been reported.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's ribbons are filled with Fairy-type energy, and its wings are filled with Dragon-type energy. Though its wings sometimes suffer mild allergic reactions as a result of its wild Fairy-type attacks, it is considered nearly unmatched in battle.
author: .realthree

entry: During the day, POKENAME sleep peacefully in the tops of trees within misty, sylvan environments. Once the sun sets, they fly in large hordes and hunt anything unlucky enough to be caught wandering the woods alone.
author: .realthree

entry: The songs of POKENAME can calm even the stormiest of hearts. Guided by compassion, it roams the forests in search of wounded Pokémon, using the soft touch of its cotton-like wings to bring comfort and aid to those in need.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sweetly sings a soothing song whenever it lands. It's known to perch on others' heads in high altitudes, covering their chilled ears with soft fluff or even bringing a cozy blanket to warm them.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME possesses one of the most beautiful and soothing voices of any Pokémon. Negative emotions seem to vanish completely in the presence of its songs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a translucent tar-like substance that smells of pine needles. When exposed to sunlight, this aroma can soothe those nearby suffering from anxiety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is coated in a viscous goo that calms the emotions of anyone touching it. It uses its ribbon-like feelers to learn more about its environment.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is coated in a viscous goo that calms the emotions of anyone touching it. It uses its ribbon-like feelers to learn more about its environment.
author: .realthree

entry: The more Fairy-type energy that infuses a POKENAME, the more vividly pink its skin becomes. POKENAME typically hide in mud or rotting logs to hide their noticeable coloration from predators.
author: .realthree

entry: The more Fairy-type energy that infuses a POKENAME, the more vividly pink its skin becomes. POKENAME typically hide in mud or rotting logs to hide their noticeable coloration from predators.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's large horns exude a calming aura, which is most potent when they touch another living being. Unfortunately, its entire body is covered in a germ-laden mucous membrane; it is strongly advised never to touch this Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: The clear mucus dripping from POKENAME's body smells of a mix of pineapple and radishes. Despite the odd aroma, it calms anyone who breathes it in.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's exterior is so sticky that nearby flora ends up torn off the ground and stuck to it. While this can make wild POKENAME look rather unkempt, some Trainers enjoy decorating their POKENAME with flowers or ribbons.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's eyes never open. Medical scans have determined that there are eyeballs behind the lids, but they're very small and underdeveloped.
author: .realthree

entry: It uses its horns and forelimbs as a form of radar to better sense all things around it. It thinks of nothing other than protecting others and keeping itself fed and rested.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its ribbons to draw others in close and give them a slimy embrace. The goop left behind after the hug gives the other party a sense of joy and contentment for as long as the slime remains on them.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME have only ever been spotted in thick fogbanks around the edges of wetlands and forests. Local myths usually state this Pokémon to be the protector of Fairy Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's skin excretes a slimy substance that has a calming effect on those around it. When POKENAME swims through its marshy home, this slime leeches into the water to affect nearby fish Pokémon that would normally be hostile.
author: .realthree

entry: Scientists used to believe that POKENAME uses its ribbon-like appendages to grasp objects, but this theory has been called into question recently. Because the appendages are so slimy, POKENAME has a hard time holding onto anything for long.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are covered in a sticky, viscous slime; they are blissfully unaware of how inconvenient this slime is, so they will often hug their Trainers. Their horns exude a soothing aura that grows stronger when they emit loud cries.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lumbers quietly across the land, occasionally gifting one of the stones that comprises its body to others. These rocks contain a special energy that eases a person's stress when held.
author: sk372

entry: Once per year, POKENAME generates a thick chunk of purple ice from its body that exudes a calming aura. It was once used during wartime to ease the worries of entire cities.
author: .izik

entry: Touching any part of POKENAME brings immediate icy relief to any painful inflammation a person may be experiencing. A few arctic explorers tell of fateful encounters with a POKENAME that saved them after they sprained an ankle or broke a leg.
author: .realthree

entry: The more people POKENAME calms with the aura from the bow on its head, the harder its metal body becomes. At peak hardness, it can withstand a direct collision with a freight train.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick steel exterior houses a potent Fairy-type energy that could be used to defeat any Dragon-type Pokémon. Despite advanced sensors being able to detect this energy within the Pokémon, nobody has been able to release its full power.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME produce a soft creamy meringue from the top of their heads, which is used by pastry chefs to top delicious treats. They are especially popular on certain holidays, as eating this meringue is said to prolong a healthy relationship.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It siphons the drive to fight from others through its large forelimbs, forcing them to calm down. It stores these emotions in its large crystals and somehow converts them into energy.
author: infinex21

entry: Because these Pokémon exude soothing auras and have plush bodies, they are popular with kids. They must be treated with care, however, or else they will lash out with enough power to shatter a slab of concrete.
author: infinex21

entry: Plush toys of POKENAME are very popular among children. Despite POKENAME's cuddly appearance, it is a very savage attacker. Curiously, knowledge of this trait has only made toys depicting this Pokémon even more popular with kids.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is almost always happy and will hug anyone it cares for with its ribbons. Despite how strong POKENAME's hugs are, the ribbons help dull the crushing pain.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME likes to use its ribbon-like feelers to hold the hand or arm of any human that approaches it. While POKENAME is usually gentle to its own Trainer, the grip force of the entwined feelers can be tight enough to shatter bone.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its sticky, ribbon-like appendages to collect other objects that resemble ribbons, snagging anything from yarn to power cables. The adhesive on its appendages emits a special aura that attracts Sylveon.
author: .realthree

entry: It uses its anchor to catch large prey, then ensnares them in its feelers and seaweed to drain them of their vitality. If its body is ever damaged, it will scavenge the remains of ships to repair itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their many tentacles to protect themselves and many others. They prey on Mareanie, which has led their bodies to develop strong antitoxins.
author: infinex21

entry: These aquatic Pokémon protect themselves and others using their many bulky appendages. They are especially fond of protecting Corsola from Mareanie and Toxapex; their bodies have potent antibodies as a result.
author: infinex21

entry: Once POKENAME manages to grapple onto a foe, it refuses to let go, letting its ribbons sap the opponent of their will to fight back. Some POKENAME Trainers compare records to see how fast they've gotten opponents to forfeit a bout.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights by wrestling its opponent so all of their limbs are occupied by the battle. Once the foe has no free hands, POKENAME strikes at all openings in their defenses using its ribbon-like appendages.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME use their feelers to immobilize their prey and their foes before finishing them off with a Flying Press. They tend to forget their own strength as they tackle their Trainers and their friends with full force.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME swings its arms around rapidly to build up speed and increase the distance it can throw its own spines at others. These spines inject a special toxin that numbs and induces euphoria in those pierced.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses a playful, dancing gait while it walks to avoid slipping down sand dunes. Because it is covered with thorns, POKENAME uses ribbon-like appendages to touch and manipulate objects rather than its arms.
author: .realthree

entry: It can use its ribbon-like organs to siphon water and other nutrients from plants or from Grass-type Pokémon. It can store enough of both to last nearly a full month before needing to feed again.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are most active at night and search for weary desert travelers to rescue before they may be preyed on. During the day, they become mostly immobile to better retain their stored water.
author: infinex21

entry: During the day, POKENAME motionlessly watch travelers that pass through the desert. At night, they find the wayfarers and stick them with pins while they sleep. These pins cause a stress-relieving effect via acupuncture, helping the wanderer rest.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME scatters particles of sand from its body across beaches. Anyone who steps on this sand grows calm and complacent, which POKENAME patiently waits for before striking.
author: .izik

entry: People who stick their arm through the large opening in POKENAME's body become infused with Fairy-type energy. Though this usually causes a calming sensation, some people have reported other mysterious side effects.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME refuses to let anyone touch its shovel, not even its Trainer. It can feed on positive feelings through its feelers, which oddly calm others rather than harm them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are friendly creatures that love to give hugs to other Pokémon. When they give another Pokémon a hug, they release spores that reduce inhibition while also suppressing violent urges.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's spores induce exhaustion mixed with euphoria. It swarms weakened prey and drains them with Absorb before carrying them back to its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME exude an aura that soothes others and compels others to play with them; they will even let their feelers be used like jump ropes. They feed on positive feelings, with no known negative effects on others by doing so.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME prefer to live on beaches with pink or white sand. Though the reason for this isn't certain, some researchers suggest that POKENAME can use sand that is similarly colored to their bodies to repair small amounts of damage.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are always cold to the touch, even when sick. Many medical facilities keep at least one POKENAME on hand to use their soft, cool feelers to help combat high fevers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their feelers to help manipulate the freezing airs released by their crystals to shape ice formations. They will pelt foes and prey with sharp icicles thrown by their feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: Well-trained and cared-for POKENAME will wrap their feelers around their Trainers' hands as they walk alongside them. They are sensitive to the emotions of their Trainers and stay close to them to offer comfort during hard times.
author: infinex21

entry: Being warm-hearted and energetic, POKENAME brings a sense of joyfulness to wherever it goes. Companies frequently use this Pokémon to raise the morale of their employees.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME's fur causes those who touch it to feel soothed. Because it even retains this effect after being shed, Trainers raising a POKENAME find themselves reluctant to clean the shed fur off of their clothes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are a peculiar species because they will goad agitators into attacking them and withstand the hits in place of others. Even if they withstand hits for hours, they show no aggression toward their attackers.
author: infinex21

entry: Its howls have a calming effect on anyone who hears them. As it ages, POKENAME's rocky mane becomes increasingly brittle and porous.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After a hunt, POKENAME in a pack rub their manes together. Their specialized fur conducts Fairy-type energy between them, spreading good cheer and cementing the POKENAME's bonds further.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are famous for their electronic pop music. They often sway their ribbon in time to the beat of songs from their Trainers. Many new up-and-coming artists perform songs inspired by them.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME dance a simple polka that many adults and children can learn. Their desire to forge bonds through dance is demonstrated by their patience when helping others learn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME releases calming auras to sleeping people in nearby villages. It can suppress nightmares and promote peaceful rest from up to 600 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: People who sleep in flowery meadows under the light of a crescent moon may meet POKENAME in their dreams. It is said some sleepers are so entranced by POKENAME's potent Fairy-type energy that they choose to stay forever, never awakening from sleep.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME releases a calming aura from its lips while swimming to draw prey near. Once close enough, it bites them with teeth capable of crushing ore in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: The sound produced by POKENAME's bruxism has an interesting effect: As it grinds its teeth, the specific frequencies produced help calm agitated people. Recordings of POKENAME's teeth-grinding are sometimes used to help people sleep.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME release spores from the mushrooms on their back that instill feelings of comfort and joy within those that inhale the spores. They are affectionate creatures that love to give hugs to many Trainers and Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It spreads calming emotions through its spores. Overexposure to these spores can result in strange behavior and chronic drowsiness.
author: hophoppip

entry: At night, POKENAME wanders forests releasing an aura that keeps prey asleep. It plants parasitic spores that allow for remote control later.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME give hugs to lonely Pokémon by wrapping ribbons around them. The spores that cling to the lonely Pokémon produce a sweet scent that helps ease their anxiety.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The light pouring out from POKENAME's bodies has a powerful soothing effect on those caught in its glow. Unfortunately, the soothing effect never stops and can cause lasting problems with overexposure; cases of comas have been confirmed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other by striking their head scales together. They never fight together against a singular foe but will butt in to defend one of their own kind if their life is at risk.
author: infinex21

entry: It sheds its scales constantly until its evolution, at which point its scales are said to be tougher than diamond. These vibrant scales are believed to bring luck and good health, so they are used in many crafts.
author: infinex21

entry: The jingling of POKENAME's scales creates a soft, rhythmic sound that pacifies those who hear it. When hunting, it uses this jingle to lull prey into sleep before finishing them with its fists.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME only hunts Dragon-type Pokémon, using its overwhelmingly energetic Fairy-type moves to devastate its prey. Trainers raising a POKENAME have to spray a special flavor onto its food just to get it to eat anything else.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME helps relieve people worried about clutter by eating up all the garbage or junk present. While it can soothe those in arguments, it is too cowardly to go near the squabble.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME feels frightened, it involuntarily emits a special energy from its antennae that cause others nearby to also feel its fear. This usually ends up worsening situations.
author: .realthree

entry: Its tall ears are sensitive enough to hear anything that approaches them. They quickly flee if they sense danger, their scurrying limbs leaving a pristine path in their wake. They frequently bathe to keep their bodies clean and sleek.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME exude a calming aura as they meditate between battles and while they peacefully sleep. They are skillful combatants who utilize every one of their limbs to defend and attack simultaneously.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dances elegantly in tandem with its moving feelers to entrance prey and foe alike. When its target draws close enough, it lashes out with its sharp-edged feelers and quickly fells said target.
author: infinex21

entry: The ribbons wrapped around POKENAME's arms are not only twice as long as POKENAME's body when unraveled but also super sharp. POKENAME elegantly twirls these ribbons to entrance prey before snapping them like whips to strike.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME brightens up caves with its dazzling array of lights, guiding hikers through dark sections and ensuring their safety. At times of great joy and celebration, it emerges from its cave to put on a beautiful display.
author: evilgammon

entry: Although POKENAME prefer to avoid fighting, they use their ribbon-like feelers to strike at their foes' weak points without mercy. Their fur is typically soft, but they can flex their bodies to make each hair stand on end like bristles.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from the ribbons on its antennae to disarm prey. Its eyes then glow as it fires a powerful Psybeam.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME playfight with one another often, which inadvertently trains their bodies to be strong. They do not hesitate to put themselves between foes for the sake of stopping a fight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME inadvertently become incredibly strong by trying to stop other Pokémon from fighting. Even just one POKENAME will typically have enough pure strength to hold down and subdue a raging Gyarados before it causes harm.
author: infinex21

entry: This species is an incredibly popular pet in the Kalos region, due to their fashionable looks and the emotionally soothing warmth they give off. Lately, they're apparently becoming a much more popular choice for new Trainers than regular Fennekin.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The fire that POKENAME expels has the interesting side effect of causing overwhelming joy to those it burns. Researchers believe this effect demotivates POKENAME's prey from seeking shelter, allowing POKENAME to continue the hunt.
author: .realthree

entry: A POKENAME can sense the emotions of any living being from body heat alone. When lit, the stick this Pokémon wields burns a soft pink flame at the tip, giving off a harmless, pleasant aroma with a scent that differs for each individual smelling it.
author: merclipse

entry: Some people believe that the crystal that forms at the end of a POKENAME's wand can mystically transmit joy. Because of that, poachers have started targeting this species to steal their wands and profit off of selling them.
author: .realthree

entry: Often depicted in children's fairy tales, usually as a magical guardian of the pure and kind-hearted. A real POKENAME is quick to resolve conflicts using the aroma from its wand, calming most but knocking out those blinded by rage.
author: merclipse

entry: Often depicted in children's fairy tales, usually as a magical guardian of the pure and kind-hearted. A real POKENAME is quick to resolve conflicts using the aroma from its wand, calming most but knocking out those blinded by rage.
author: merclipse

entry: Its delicate bubbles offer protection for its body and a means to subdue larger foes with minimal injury. It uses its ribbon-like feelers to quickly traverse terrain, scattering some of its bubbles in its wake.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will pluck and fling their own foamy bubbles to subdue others or to minimize harm and damage during fights. Even during battle, they wrap stones in their bubbles before throwing them at their opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: If a POKENAME is discovered while it is sneaking, it throws globs of colorful foam at the ones who spotted it. This foam causes an immediate and strong emotional response, allowing POKENAME the perfect distraction needed to escape.
author: .realthree

entry: Wild POKENAME patrol their territories with the haste and secrecy of ninjas. If they come across any conflicts, they use their long feelers to ensnare the perpetrators and keep them restrained until their fighting spirit is quelled.
author: infinex21

entry: The feelers on POKENAME's body are extremely strong and can withstand the heat of up to 1500 degrees. It uses them to grab at burning trees during forest fires, consuming the charred wood and berries even while they are still ablaze.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME becomes agitated, it emits a special blue smoke from its shell that calms nearby humans. This has little to no effect on Pokémon, though, so POKENAME is unable to calm itself with this method.
author: .realthree

entry: Anyone who inhales the smoke from POKENAME's shell becomes calm and friendly. This defense helps it gather allies, subdue enemies, and even sedate prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: The blue lights emitted from within these Pokémon have a hypnotically soothing effect on those who watch them. Many POKENAME have been seen using their feelers to hang from branches and will shine their lights on those who draw near.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scatters calming pink powder from its wing feelers. Once prey becomes complacent, it follows up with a strong Confusion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wrap their ribbons around the arms of people, bringing them together with melodic songs. Their songs encourage people to fall in love, with many couples having met through POKENAME's gatherings.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME entangle foes and prey using sticky, sweet threads reminiscent of cotton candy. Though considered nuisances to most, these edible threads are prized in many remedies that soothe nerves and dispel anxieties.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME works alongside bakers to produce high quality baked treats. The cream atop its head can be mixed with eggs and sugar to create a delicious meringue.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME helps with preparing any kind of food, the dish inevitably becomes loaded with entirely too much sugar. People who eat this food find their spirits lifted by it, regardless of whether the food would normally be made with sugar.
author: .realthree

entry: While performing complex karate-like movements, POKENAME's sweat exudes a bizarre floral scent. This aroma soothes others of its kind but enrages its foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's habitat is surprisingly diverse and hard to pin down, able to live in most places, though they seem to like hanging out in playgrounds and art supply stores. Their leader can be spotted by the one with wider eyes and a bow.
author: beatdoof

entry: The long sleeves of shed skin on POKENAME's arms direct emotional energy out from POKENAME. Though this energy is soothing while POKENAME is with other members of its horde, it usually becomes stressful and upsetting when POKENAME is caught alone.
author: .realthree

entry: Should anyone remain unaffected by the aura POKENAME emits, it will kick at them repeatedly until they are either calm or unconscious. Its kicks are powerful enough to shatter stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dons any discarded clothes that it comes across, showing a preference for pink and blue items. If anyone appears to laugh at its outfit, it angrily headbutts the offender.
author: .realthree

entry: If POKENAME barks a cheerful greeting to you as you pass by it on the street, go back the other way. It is really calling the other members of its horde to come attack you en masse should you continue forward.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME likes to get into fights with other Pokémon over which of them is the cutest, fighting through dance battles or charming random Trainers they see. Beauty salons and influencers have been using POKENAME as inspiration due to its cuteness.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are gregarious Pokémon that enjoy socializing with other species. It's not uncommon for a horde of Scrafty to have a POKENAME as a member. The POKENAME helps the group stay together without infighting for much longer.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are found in streams floating at the top of the water, letting the current move them around. Their bright coloration helps distract and disorient potential predators.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is obsessed with fashion, wanting to make accessories for everyone it values. Those it is particularly fond of get ribbons or a top hat similar to its own.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: It is innately driven to dance the moment it hears music playing. It will even pull others in with it and expect them to dance with it; using its ribbon-like organs, it can even compel opponents to dance rather than to fight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are widely believed to be omens of a bright future, with their presence said to ease the process of growth and change in all who observe them.
author: turron_turron

entry: On clear, starry nights, POKENAME shed their shells to dance about the sky in a display of flowing colors and joy. People around the world will hold pop-up festivals beneath these POKENAME in celebration of transformation and hope.
author: turron_turron

entry: The fire on a POKENAME's tail emits no heat. If you cook a Berry with their fiery breath, the Berry acquires a cotton candy flavor.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME primarily keeps itself underground, digging tunnels across the land, but pops above ground if it senses negative emotions. It uses its ribbons to soothe the agitated person, then returns to its constant tunnel-digging.
author: sk372

entry: This wary Pokémon will only appear before people it believes it can trust. Those it comes to view as friends and/or family will be gifted a diamond made through its own powers; these diamonds shine with a bright, soothing light even in the dark.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's ribbon-like fins can extend up to 20 feet from its body to gather kelp from the seafloor. They are highly sensitive and cannot extend as far in colder waters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME utilizes disruptive camouflage to confuse its predators. If the lurid markings fail, it can strike out with its feelers as a last resort.
author: .realthree

entry: In some past tales, Trainers gave their lovers POKENAME as a means of proposing marriage to them. Some customs see similar values, though more commonly as a gift to apologize to a lover due to this Pokémon's ability to calm anyone and anything.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME loves to swim around visitors to its ocean bay and impart soothing sensations through its feelers. This can be dangerous to swimmers, as the effect can become so strong that the person affected begins to stop swimming.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are considered meek and timid due to how they will bare their fangs and growl to threaten others. However, they become immensely friendly the moment one pets them, and they emit soothing coos with every pet and scritch.
author: infinex21

entry: It's incredibly friendly and even more curious; it darts in zigzag patterns to interact with or investigate its surroundings. Its feelers emit a calming aura that may soothe most agitated Pokémon, allowing it to avoid most quarrels.
author: infinex21

entry: A herd of POKENAME will interlock feelers as they run so that they may avoid being separated from each other. Their fur is softer than silk and releases calming particles when groomed or stroked.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sleep atop tree branches and use their feelers to hang from them before they descend in search of food. Their spikes secrete a toxic venom most effective on bird Pokémon, which has helped to reduce how often they are preyed upon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their extendable feelers to traverse forests and to suspend themselves between branches. Their bodies become smoother than silk as they near their evolution.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME release multicolored scales as their wings flutter, which induces a sense of calm on whoever they fall onto. They use their long feelers to sense fresh pollen and honey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their feelers to gather piles of leaves to hide within, though they will use them to swing to branches if need be. They will remember every hardship endured, even after having evolved.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME digs concealed pitfalls throughout its territory. It lures prey into them using a calming aura before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME approaches city lights as they first turn on in the pink haze of dusk. People have a hard time chasing it away because the ribbons on its back exude waves that cause a strong feeling of calmness in humans and some Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: A hasty and headstrong fusion. The scar-like markings on its chest have granted it popularity with those who've had a mammectomy.
author: hophoppip

entry: The feelers extending from the sides of POKENAME's body act as wings, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It aggressively competes with others of its flock for berries, even ones that have not yet fully ripened.
author: .izik

entry: Tamed or untamed, POKENAME are notoriously courageous, especially for the sake of others. Their loud yet soothing cries can even subdue Ursaring.
author: infinex21

entry: Twice a year, POKENAME flocks migrate by crossing overseas. Because the sight of a migrating flock is considered a romantic boon, many tourists will swarm locales to view them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's calming aura intensifies when coins are nearby. Each use of Pay Day expands its area of effect significantly.
author: .izik

entry: Despite sounding very soothing and pleasant, POKENAME's roars are ear-piercingly loud. It is unclear whether foes stop their hostility because of the calming auras emitted or from having extreme ear pain.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves to imitate popular music. After listening carefully to the latest hits, it bellows out its own version at maximum volume.
author: .jerden

entry: Despite POKENAME's yells being extremely loud, the sounds are strangely very pleasant and nice to the ear. Some people even choose to go deaf just by not wanting to stop listening to the soothing yet earthshaking roars.
author: soup1900

entry: Although considered adorable by many, these Pokémon often entangle themselves in their own ribbony feelers as they chase them in circles. A domesticated POKENAME will hold its most prized toys and treasures tightly within its feelers' grasps.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enter into deep meditative states to find new ways to make their Trainer happy. They often smile as they meditate because of how much they love their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Through its feelers, it can sense the smallest shifts in the air, and supposedly it can even tell when its foes' muscles tense, which allows it to predict their movements. It delivers devastating kicking attacks when the opportunity presents itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gently coddles distressed feline Pokémon with its long feelers. This contact induces a deep, soothing happiness.
author: .izik

entry: If its teammates win a battle, POKENAME celebrates by emitting a pink electric glow that fills everyone with euphoria. The ribbons on its head can extend to help it reach objects that are too far away for its short legs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If its teammates win a battle, POKENAME celebrates by emitting a pink electric glow that fills everyone with euphoria. The ribbons on its head can extend to help it reach objects that are too far away for its short legs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If its teammates lose a battle, it releases a soft pink glow from its cheeks to comfort them and make them feel important to the team nonetheless. POKENAME uses its ribbons to hug anyone who looks down, as it can't stand seeing others sad.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Because POKENAME prefers cooler temperatures, it only comes out in the evening. Its pink markings help it blend with its rosy surroundings while the sun sets.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is rarely sighted at evenings. When the clouds take on a pink hue, it emerges from the tall grass to flash its brilliantly blue tail. Researchers think it does this to guide Eemise to safe resting spots.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME live in small herds near mountains, though many times their herds have been seen caring for other young Pokémon as well. They can release soothing fumes from the ports on their humps; just one POKENAME's fumes can subdue a Vigoroth.
author: infinex21

entry: Many aromatherapists use POKENAME in their work, as the lovely scents of their blue smoke help the emotional well-being of their clients. In the wild, the Pokémon live in small herds at the base of mountain ranges.
author: mepp.

entry: As POKENAME bounces up and down on its springy tail, it waves the ribbons it holds in a joyful dance. Those who join POKENAME in dancing find that some of their anxieties are suddenly lifted.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME love giving out hugs to other Pokémon with their ribbons. When POKENAME are hugged too tightly, they can momentarily lose circulation to their head, which can cause a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ribbons create a soothing sensation that is effective at combating headaches in others. It constantly rubs its own aching head with them, but the effect is unfortunately far less fruitful on itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slowly draws in ambient energy from the positive emotions of those near it, its pearls glowing once at full strength. In times of sadness, it releases the energy to assuage people's worries and improve their moods.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are always swaying and shimmying as they move, seemingly dancing at all times. Unfortunately, their complicated movements cause them to trip over their own feelers constantly and fall on their faces.
author: infinex21

entry: The aura that POKENAME emits from its ribbon-like body has the power to cure the ill effects of dangerous venom. With the rise in toxin varieties due to the spread of fusion species, this Pokémon is celebrated as a hero.
author: .realthree

entry: So long as direct sunlight is upon it, POKENAME radiates a soothing pulse that calms down anyone within a few meters of it. When night falls, it hides itself underground, refusing to come out until daylight returns.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleep in the mud at the bottoms of lakes and ponds. When they awaken, they violently thrash about to remove the mud from their beloved and vibrant fur. Their feeler-like whiskers are prehensile and strong enough to subdue a Gyarados.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love to give out hugs with their long ribbons and often beckon their friends to jump in the water with them. Sometimes they pull their friends into the water with them as a prank.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When feeling joy, POKENAME rotates in place at a rapid rate. The rotation of its body sends out pulses of energy that induce joy in others, so the happier POKENAME is, the happier people around it will be.
author: sk372

entry: Some POKENAME that were discovered in ancient ruins were found to be over a thousand years old. Ancient POKENAME are just as brightly colored as young POKENAME, so scientists are investigating what keeps their pigments from breaking down over time.
author: .realthree

entry: These cheerful Pokémon emit pleasant tunes when they agitate the orbs within their throats.  They often use their feelers to hang from objects or from other Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: When humid air blows in from a storm, it causes POKENAME's ribbon to wave about and ring its bell-like body, warning other Pokémon of the danger. Strangely, this effect is stronger near other Fairy-type Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME sing as they let winds carry them about, their feelers swaying until used to anchor them elsewhere. They love to use their feelers to hang from their Trainers or their friends, singing their most pleasant and soothing tunes.
author: infinex21

entry: Trainers who own a POKENAME often decorate their Pokémon with stickers. Recently, POKENAME in the wild have been discovered with markings resembling the most popular stickers. The connection between the two is not fully understood yet.
author: .realthree

entry: If POKENAME notices someone who is particularly angry, it tries to calm them down by stroking them with its soft, colorful ribbons. It loves spending time swimming with its Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME dives underwater and slowly waves its ribbon-like feelers to attract fish Pokémon. A POKENAME can eat up to twice its body weight in one day using this method.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME seeks to fight others as a way of venting pent-up aggression. The ribbons it wears cause those touched to become more aggressive, stoking their anger to get them raring to fight POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: Its bright and cheerful colors invoke a sense of calm and trust in others, but this Pokémon is anything but kind. Its entire body is harder than rock to survive deep ocean pressure, and it will viciously rip into any foe or prey with its strong jaws.
author: infinex21

entry: It has been discovered that the calming effect of POKENAME's ribbons is most potent regarding prehistoric Pokémon. Parks specializing in those Pokémon have begun including POKENAME to reduce the risk of rampages and escapes.
author: sk372

entry: Because POKENAME's feelers are just as dexterous as hands, this Pokémon is difficult to keep in an aquarium. Aquarium workers frequently have to deal with machinery that has been pried apart by its feelers or bashed to pieces by its rock-hard head.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur conducts calming energy into anyone who pets it. Though this species has wings for flying, it prefers to be held most of the time.
author: .realthree

entry: The sound waves it emits to court females is strong enough to affect Pokémon of other species. In rare cases, POKENAME's sound waves can affect males as well.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's feelers wiggle rapidly as it floats through the air. If startled, it releases powerful jolts of electricity through them.
author: .izik

entry: Schools of POKENAME tie their feelers together when on the move to prevent separation. They absorb electricity through their mouths and channel it through their feelers; a proper school of POKENAME could power a small city for a few days.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's violent temperament leaves it almost perpetually frothing with rage. It uses the ribbons it wears to incite aggression in large groups of Pokémon just so it can beat them all up to vent some of its endless anger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ribbon-like feelers conduct large amounts of electricity. To immobilize its prey, POKENAME wraps these feelers tightly around its victim.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME use their extendable feelers to hold prey still as they siphon their prey's electricity through their fangs. They can channel electricity through the palms of their forelimbs and through their feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME nest within coral formations or among the branches of Corsola, their bright colors helping them to blend in. Schools of POKENAME wrap their feelers together to avoid being swept away by sudden currents.
author: infinex21

entry: It spits a corrosive fluid to defend others and itself, though it can also spit a fluid that boosts healing and invokes calmness. Using its extendable, ribbonlike feelers, it keeps its young safe from threats and from being swept away by currents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's feelers grow dangerously hot when it becomes upset, yet they emit a calming aura. It uses this warmth to comfort others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dwells near volcanic regions. Just before an eruption, the ribbonlike tuft on its head glows red hot, warning those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: Due to this Pokémon's bright colors and size, they rely on speed when hunting.
author: themadcactus

entry: The water POKENAME spits carries soothing properties. Spas across Hoenn collect and dilute it for relaxation treatments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rubbery hands are coated in a sticky substance. Physical contact induces a sense of calm in those it touches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stands watch over ponds teeming with smaller creatures. Should any dangerous creatures approach, it distracts them with the spiral on its torso, which drains aggression and energy the longer it's gazed upon.
author: sk372

entry: The ribbonlike structures on POKENAME's head detect shifts in humidity. When storms approach, it hides beneath lake surfaces until conditions stabilize.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps during the majority of the day, but its ribbons remain active on instinct. If something approaches it aggressively, the ribbons grasp it tightly, draining it of its aggression, and teleport it away to another random location.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are capable of revealing a persons deepest desires. For this reason, they are often trained by Therapists and Psychologists to assist them with their work.
author: jemeremmazza

entry: If POKENAME encounters someone crying, it reads their thoughts to learn the cause. When it judges the problem trivial, it telekinetically forces their lips into a smile.
author: .izik

entry: If calming a target with its aura fails, POKENAME flashes a cheerful smile. It then attempts to uppercut the foe skyward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs elaborate martial arts displays to ease stressed Pokémon. If the stress remains, it begins striking with punches until calm or unconsciousness follows.
author: .izik

entry: According to folk legend, POKENAME would dance to bring about a bountiful harvest. It is most likely that during the dance, POKENAME would remove the village's negative emotions, leading to an increase in care and cooperation when it came to farming.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: When sensing sadness, POKENAME flexes theatrically to raise morale. If this fails, it restrains targets with ribbonlike limbs and subdues them with powerful punches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prances through flower fields, its lanky vine-like body moving playfully. A forced wave of joy spreads within 20 ft, affecting all nearby whether welcomed or not.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME use their large ears to hear any prey miles away. When mating, larger ears are seen as more admirable.
author: themadcactus

entry: This Pokémon catches its prey with its ribbons and claws. When around an Eeveelution or Eevee, its demeanor becomes much more playful.
author: themadcactus

entry: Its large ribbon wings don't give this Pokémon the ability to fly. Instead, it uses the move Fairy Wind to lift it above the clouds.
author: themadcactus

entry: Like Mantine and Remoraid, POKENAME attracts Magikarp and Goldeen when swimming down rivers.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME releases a sugary scent that draws distressed Bug-type Pokémon seeking comfort. Once close, it drenches them in acid and consumes them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunts at night, the false face on its leafy appendage glowing softly. It calms prey into a joyful sleep before swallowing them whole.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tentacles possess a numbing venom that makes the victim feel calm, pleasant and sluggish. It uses this both to avoid being hunted on, but also to occasionally steal meals for itself from others.
author: sk372

entry: This alternate coloration of POKENAME is rather common in the wild, and noted to be somewhat more aggressive, and more prone to using its numbing venom in its tentacles in order to pacify others and steal their food.
author: sk372

entry: Its ribbons act as tentacles, useful for swimming and hunting. When they aren't being used, they float freely.
author: themadcactus

entry: Pink stones shed from POKENAME's body were once used in rituals to soothe children's nightmares. Later studies revealed they had no real effect.
author: .izik

entry: The pink gravel POKENAME sheds was once eaten in hopes of inducing bliss. Instead, it caused severe digestive distress in those who tried.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME consumes gemstones, its calming aura expands dramatically. The effect mysteriously resets each dawn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an affable Pokémon that loves to race with other Pokémon. Even if it never wins, it always does its best.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many farming families keep POKENAME nearby. Their warm fur comforts others, and they often wrap feelers around companions' hands as they trot alongside them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME coils its long ribbonlike appendages around foes. It then gallops forward, dragging them at high speed to inflict heavy damage.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rarely experiences negative emotions, existing in near-constant bliss. Any brief distress it feels vanishes quickly after a single positive interaction.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon swims against the stream. It still attracts many Water-type Pokémon while swimming, but only the strongest swimmers can keep up.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME's tail exudes a scent that Eevee in particular find incredibly appealing, unable to resist biting down on it. POKENAME does not seem to mind the bites, and in fact seems overjoyed to be making Eevee happy.
author: sk372

entry: The large stone it has for a tail acts as a tanning machine and a light source. When a POKENAME isn't sunbathing, it's resting beneath its shiny tail.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME manipulates a pair of ribbon-like tendrils via its own magnetic fields. It sends them out to constrict around those feeling glum, letting the tendrils' subtle vibrations send comforting sensations pulsing through them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's calming aura affects Steel-type Pokémon far more strongly than others. Some researchers suspect magnetism may be part of the reason, but the true cause remains unknown.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is truly happy, the leek stalk it constantly carries begins to emit soft, shimmering light. It can sense the emotions of those around it and often brings food to anyone who is deeply saddened by something.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME sprints across open fields, its fluffy feathers release a soothing aura. It appears to do this deliberately, spreading smiles to anyone nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The three heads love each other as if they were siblings and wrap their feelers around each other's necks to show their affection. They love to dance, even though their coordination is not that great.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is very playful and energetic. It is often found practicing various tricks so that it can cheer up its Trainer when they are sad.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME rescues shipwrecked sailors and carries them to its iceberg den. Its calming aura keeps them docile as the cold slowly overtakes them.
author: .izik

entry: It seems to be drawn to Trainers whose gender identities are as fluid as POKENAME's body. Those Trainers often claim that POKENAME's presence increases their confidence.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite being made of and subsisting on highly toxic material, POKENAME constantly emits a harmless, soothing scent around it. It's happy to let others enjoy its aroma, but keeps a safe distance to avoid causing others to get sick.
author: sk372

entry: This incredible swimmer beats pros without a sweat and paces with the fastest Water types. Despite this, it has a demeanor similar to that of Lapras.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME stays still on the ocean floor, blending in with rocks surrounding it. When a predator grazes its sensitive feelers, it violently clamps shut.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's spikes, while very sharp and painful, inject calm and soothing feelings directly into the victim. This tranquilization allows it to easily capture escaping prey even inside of rough waves and storms.
author: soup1900

entry: A multitude of ribbons hides POKENAME's lack of a body beyond the floating head and a faint ghostly mist. It haunts people's homes, staying incorporeal to silently brush against the residents and reduce their stress with its ribbons' powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME invades locations haunted by malevolent Ghost Pokémon, trailing behind their victims to soothe their terror with the touch of its hands and ribbons. POKENAME enjoys a nice laugh as the other ghosts pout due to it thwarting their haunting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats near gravesites, watching grieving humans. Should it notice someone in the depths of despair, its eyes glow celadon and a calming aura exudes from its body to soothe them.
author: .izik

entry: Overly friendly to the point of being clingy, POKENAME uses its many ribbons to wrap around other creatures, forcibly soothing them and pulling them close for lengthy amounts of cuddling time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can use its psychic powers to display visions to humans. Its preferred use of this power is showing people the bodies they dream of having, especially if those bodies are of the opposite gender.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME wrap dreams of love and comfort around those they hypnotize. Their dreams give hope to lonely Pokémon that they may find a loving Trainer to grow strong with together.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spin dreams of loving families and cheerful friends for those they hypnotize. These dreams give hope to lonely Pokémon that they may someday find a place they belong.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize people with their heart pendant to lull people into a deep sleep. They replace nightmares with happy dreams so people can sleep soundly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to negative emotions, growing teary-eyed at a hint of negativity. It snaps its claws at the source of the emotions, the pinch of which causes a sense of calm in the victim should POKENAME hold them long enough.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's grip strength with its oversized claw is almost unparalleled. It snaps up rowdy Pokémon, refusing to let them go until its ribbons have forced them to properly calm down and behave.
author: sk372

entry: At first glance, its ears may look misshapen, but they are actually very hydrodynamic.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME is a gentle creature that fights only to protect the Pokémon sharing its territory. The bulb on its back is surrounded by thorns and brambles filled with toxins of extreme potency.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has an attitude as large as its ego. If it feels like even the tiniest bit slighted, it will be extremely incensed, and explode with tremendous force as a show of power.
author: sk372

entry: To keep their bodies strong, they eat everything, including the bones, of their prey. Their long horns are strong enough to cleanly puncture rocks.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly muscular and could crush cars with their tails. Their second skulls are harder than diamond and their long horns can cleanly puncture a solid block of steel.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME recklessly charges intruders to its domain, although few can endure a direct impact from it. Pokémon Rangers keep close tracking systems on the locations of known wild POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's drill can shred even the strongest armor of the hardiest Steel-type Pokémon. A Pokéstar Studios film series about a Tyranitar forming a contentious alliance with a POKENAME is said to be inspired by territorial interactions on Mt. Silver.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are occasionally seen as partner Pokémon in emergency services. Their horns allow them to detect radio waves and respond to calls. As they race to the scene, their crystal core flashes brightly.
author: wiz0z

entry: The mysteries of Jynx carry over into POKENAME. It kisses foes first before biting them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A charging POKENAME is capable of knocking down entire buildings. Once it begins charging, POKENAME struggles to change directions, having to use its heavy tail as a rudder and counterbalance.
author: wiz0z

entry: Despite a monstrous appearance, POKENAME is actually quite gentle and meek. Its thick scales protect it from attacks.
author: mepp.

entry: Highly venomous and equally aggressive, POKENAME uses its horn to throw its weight around the forests it calls home. It stabs with its horn at anything it comes across, and regularly steals food from smaller Bug types.
author: sk372

entry: In its rampages, POKENAME often finds itself buried in the rubble it creates, but by bristling out its fur, it can send the debris flying and escape the predicament. The poison from its horn causes people to feel constant static shocks for days.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME channel and fire electrical bolts from either or all of their three venomous horns. They ground themselves using their tails if they ever accumulate too much electricity, and then discharge the excess.
author: infinex21

entry: Its three venomous horns deliver a potent, paralytic venom that can numb an entire adult human's arm within minutes of affliction. Its spiky fur stands on end when it has accumulated a strong static charge.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME inserts its horn into a port to purge corrupted files almost instantly. It works more efficiently when gently petted during the process.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eat any food, even if it has grown rotten or moldy. Their poisonous sweat is believed to be a byproduct of this and is being studied for any medical applications.
author: infinex21
