entry: POKENAME's venomous horn doubles as a lightning rod. By flying into the center of thunderclouds, it can absorb their electricity, which strengthens its body.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Some ancient ruins depict murals of POKENAME acting as guardians to temples built in worship of draconic deities. Their strength and stoic nature seem perfectly apt to stand guard for as long as they are needed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME puff up their chest as large as they can before they attack, trying to intimidate their opponents into giving up. If the display fails, they will fly horn-first at their foes, trying to inflict their poison to win the fight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its thin body allows POKENAME to weave through narrow cracks and crevices in deep caves expertly. When an opening isn't available, it uses its powerful arms to bust through cave walls.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Despite their small size, POKENAME can be a vicious nocturnal predator. Their silent flights and fast-acting toxins make quick work of any unwary prey. Fortunately, they also have small appetites, limiting their potential for ecological mayhem.
author: corra_universe

entry: POKENAME are vicious predators, swooping down to deliver a poisonous blow then retreating back into the sky until its prey succumbs. It's recommended to exercise extreme caution around them for this reason.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME lacks the ability to use echolocation, so it uses its wing-like ears to listen to the wind in order to get around. While helpful, this makes it hyper-sensitive to other sounds.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME flocks will aggressively chase away rival flocks from prime nesting sites. They have become a problem Pokémon for urban environments and are known to harass office workers simply trying to go to work.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have the ability to shoot feathers from their wings as if they are darts. Their feathers are coated with strong venom that can take down even the largest of Pokémon.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME that have lived long lives are humble, wise, and generous. Their armor is tough and their strength is awe-inspiring, though they typically offer peace over conflict. They serve as role models to nearby young Pokémon.
author: chinigan

entry: POKENAME soar through the skies, keeping an eye out for similarly sized bird Pokémon. They will try to bully out any Pokémon that are in the same skies as them, swiping at them with their tail and pecking at them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will fight other scavengers over trash, almost always coming out on top. Despite their size, their tails are quite powerful, able to knock out larger opponents with a single swing to the head.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME absorb toxins from the soil in their environment, incorporating those toxins into their skin and leaves. They are ill-tempered Pokémon and aggressively defend their territory, their poisons seeping from their skin when angry.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's teeth grow at an incredible rate, so even when domesticated, POKENAME must be able to chew on something to prevent injury from oversized teeth. In the wild, fruits with firm and chewy outer peels are their favorite.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The ground trembles when it charges, leaving intricate fissures resembling maps etched into the ground. These formations vanish within hours, intriguing researchers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can fire poison-tipped darts from every hole in its body. When agitated, it fires these darts faster than the naked eye can comprehend.
author: lemmymaster

entry: POKENAME live within the calderas of active volcanoes, competing with one another for the warmest spots. The fumes they release when they are riled up are noxious, and it is advised to avoid breathing them in at all costs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The rocks that form POKENAME shells are very porous and regularly emit toxic gases that build up within their body. When threatened, they retreat within their shell and rely on their venomous spines to ward off harm.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fur stiffens and bristles when they run into another one of their species. They posture and kick up snow to try and scare off their rival, only coming to blows if neither POKENAME backs down.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME regularly clash to determine who the leader of the pack shall be, typically locking horns until one breaks even a little. To defend themselves, they can spew a burning, corrosive substance from their mouth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are strong enough to topple trees by ramming into them. They use these fallen trees to mark out the boundaries of their territory, marking them with their tusks and periodically checking if any other POKENAME have done the same.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME tusks are hollow and can deliver a nasty venom when they puncture skin. POKENAME will roll into a tight curl and aim to scratch their foes with the tip of their tusks as they roll by to inflict this poison on them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The tail on its back adds to the destructive force of its spin. As long as it's spinning, it can even destroy entire streets.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite its powerful body that is well suited for combat, wild POKENAME do not fight very often. Instead, POKENAME typically paralyze prey with a sudden Glare and then devour them whole.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite POKENAME's low mobility, it is highly aggressive and refuses to hide itself while awaiting full evolution. It leaps from high terrain to divebomb intruders and either crushes them or poisons them with its spines.
author: sk372

entry: A wild POKENAME has once wiped out many villages off the map in the middle of the night many years ago when it went on a rampage. Any Trainer that spots one in the wild must proceed with extreme caution.
author: cobalt0135

entry: As aggressive as it is strong, wild POKENAME will often form large territories that they jealously guard from rivals. Its sharp beak and talons are said to be hard enough to cut through diamond.
author: theunholyhandgrenade

entry: POKENAME move through hopping. Each hop causes the ground to shake, making other nearby Pokémon flee in fear of its might. They only eat flora.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME use their prehensile tails more than they use their arms, especially for securing and eating food. Their horns are incredibly venomous, which some believe is due to how these Pokémon freely devour rotten food.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME tails are prehensile and are used to grab onto anything edible that is within reach. They are insatiable Pokémon and will gorge themselves on any food available, fighting one another to be the first to get to a meal.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME primarily fights with its destructively strong tail since its arms have lost some of their reach and mobility with its increased armor. When it needs to descend in its mountainous habitat, it rolls while protected by its hide.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its tail is incredibly strong, capable of toppling large transmission towers. It will then store the energy from those towers in its tail, ready to release up to 20,000 volts onto its next foe.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its large tail is cumbersome, yet very strong. Its claws are tough enough to cut into metal without chipping or dulling.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are strong enough to be used to haul heavy equipment across ice fields, their bulk and armour making them well-suited to the environment. Their venomous spines mean care needs to be taken to avoid accidentally being poisoned.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful horn to break apart the digital barriers of cyberspace, allowing anyone to freely travel between the physical and digital worlds. Since its tail and body aren't connected, it can still cause destruction even when captured.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful horn to break apart the digital barriers of cyberspace, allowing anyone to freely travel between the physical and digital worlds. Mostly anything can trigger it to rampage, even when it was something nice done to it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's offspring admire it as a powerful protector and provider. This Pokémon's sturdy body has tremendous power that allows it to destroy large stone walls and leap over towering buildings. When enraged, the yellow hairs on its limbs ignite.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The blades on POKENAME's arms and its horn are highly poisonous. It's prone to bursts of anger if its Trainer doesn't make it fight enough.
author: nugamallow

entry: Its horn is harder than diamond, making it much stronger than its claws. Its vibrant quills secrete trace amounts of pain-inducing venom, so most dare not attack when they curl into a ball to defend themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: Though small in stature, POKENAME can cause spectacular damage when angered. Thankfully, given its natural habitat, only trees will suffer its wrath.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp senses to anticipate incoming attacks and counter them with swift and precise strikes. Any attack that does slip through its guard is met by a remarkably tough hide studded with poisonous spikes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp senses to anticipate incoming attacks and counter them with swift and precise strikes. Any attack that does slip through its guard is met by a remarkably tough hide studded with poisonous spikes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME battle using thorny vines, whipping them around with great force. The thorns carry a painful toxin meaning that even a scratch from the vines allows them to win fights against much larger Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The thorns along a POKENAME's vines contain powerful poison. POKENAME gathers energy from the rose on its back, so if anyone disturbs even a single petal, it will swing its vines in a wild rampage until either the impact or poison downs its foe.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME poison grows more virulent and aggressive the higher the levels of cortisol is in their body, this makes their toxins more dangerous the longer a battle goes on. They are highly combative and will seek out any intruder in their territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME poison grows more virulent and aggressive the higher the levels of cortisol is in their body, this makes their toxins more dangerous the longer a battle goes on. They are highly combative and will seek out any intruder in their territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME poison grows more virulent and aggressive the higher the levels of cortisol is in their body, this makes their toxins more dangerous the longer a battle goes on. They are highly combative and will seek out any intruder in their territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's horn oozes a toxin that it uses to mark its territory. If someone gets too close, it will Thrash, attacking with wild, uncontrollable force to protect its domain.
author: .izik

entry: The potency of POKENAME's horn poison plays a key role in its mating rituals. Males compare poisons by exposure, and females select the one whose venom proves most potent.
author: slimmagma

entry: Few Pokémon dare to tread in the deep-sea den of POKENAME due to its strength and aggression. Its tail alone can strike with enough force to send a heavy tanker ship airborne.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known for its extremely hostile disposition, challenging anything that enters its territory. It pummels foes with a flurry of jabs from its horn and fists.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME stand motionless along the boundaries of their territory in family groups, lining the bounds for days on end. They are easily mistaken for statues when they stand guard, the façade only dropping when they abruptly attack trespassers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It was once believed that POKENAME's blade was a tooth that mutated. In truth, the head that has formed around it is a result of drastic metamorphosis of its hilt.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME are suited to being trained by Ace Trainers thanks to their propensity to follow direction from those who are stronger. If they lose a fight, they grow sullen, encouraging their Trainer to rematch the Pokémon they lost to so they can win.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The skeleton of POKENAME is composed of a highly durable metal. They often rally up lesser Pokémon and command them to raid towns for food.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME exudes a powerful fighting spirit; they say it has a fierce determination to achieve victory in battles. Aura emanates from the axe it wields, allowing POKENAME to launch ferocious attacks accompanied by breathy laughter.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Its rock-hard hide helps protect it as it defends its burrows from threats. It is known to treat its Trainers as if they were its children.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME have bodies of thick muscle that afford them immense strength, capable of snapping metal structures. The armor-like chitin of their bodies is extremely durable, making them difficult to dethrone as apex predators of their territory.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its tail as an immensely powerful piercing drill. It's said that the intense durability of the spikes on its head and its back is due to POKENAME's sheer battle spirit and pride.
author: over9001

entry: Using the cannon on its tail, POKENAME blasts deadly poison that has evolved to become immune to known antivenoms. Its tail has been made even more powerful and destructive thanks to the metallic platings that cover it.
author: soup1900

entry: During full moons, POKENAME gather to dance under the light. If disturbed, they rush the intruder with poison-filled horns and strong Moonblast attacks. Only a few gatherings of POKENAME have been successfully recorded.
author: chibitales

entry: A brawny body and a keen sense of hearing allow POKENAME to act as a scout for a colony of Pokémon. Despite its power, it tries to avoid group combat, as it may understand that it is biologically predisposed to be submissive to female Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The power of Moon Stones has made POKENAME completely nocturnal. They are extremely rare, possess incredible hearing and jumping ability, and have hundreds of microscopic poisonous spines across their bodies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its axe-like tusks are slick with a potent toxin that can even affect some Steel-type and Poison-type Pokémon. If neither its toxins nor its tusks can best a foe, it can rely on its powerful tail.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying sky predator that uses its powerful venom to annihilate its prey before finishing them off. Even other Flying Pokémon are terrified of it, retreating to their nests as soon as they see it take flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying sky predator that uses the potent venom in its claws to annihilate its prey before finishing them off. Even other Flying Pokémon are terrified of it, retreating to their nests as soon as they see it take flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME scatter flammable, toxic scales from their wings when they flex and flap them. By clashing its limbs together, it can create sparks to ignite its scales. Its tail is strong enough for it to balance upon without faltering, even during battle.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME charges recklessly whenever it becomes angry or threatened. It stops to sleep in the debris of its rampage. This Pokémon is not advised for inexperienced Trainers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's two heads each have different battle tactics, one preferring offense and the other preferring defense. If the two heads stop arguing to coordinate, it is dangerous in battle.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Researchers believe POKENAME's territorial nature is due to it being attacked often when it did not have sight at previous stages. It uses its wings to conduct surprise attacks, closing the membranes and striking with the venomous spikes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It makes nests in asteroids it has hollowed out. If these asteroids enter the atmosphere, POKENAME rampages for 34 days straight.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME act as the night watch for a colony of Nidoran and Jigglypuff fusions, as well as their relatives. If it spots a potential predator from a distance, it will rapidly tap its foot onto the ground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Male POKENAME are easily wooed into joining other colonies by one colony singing in better harmony than their own. They act as bodyguards for female POKENAME and act as conductors for Nidopuff.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Most male Nidoeary have actually evolved into Nidopunny as they reach maturity, so this stage of POKENAME is particularly rare. Its powerful body but small size allows it to reach other sources of food the colony could otherwise not procure.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They are incredibly aggressive for their size. They are known to go toe to toe with Pokémon four times their size and come out victorious.
author: itsmebrewsky

entry: Its skull is nearly too heavy for it. POKENAME often struggles to wield its power and weight, and can resort to dragging it along the ground.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME was once the apex predator of the ancient world, devouring anything smaller than it. Only after the species went extinct due to natural disasters could any other lifeforms begin to thrive again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's horn oozes a poison that freezes quickly upon contact with the air. It flings this poison at prey, freezing them in place and making them easy to capture.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME feature a selfish and disagreeable personality. In blizzards, it can disappear from the naked eye and reappear to suddenly ram foes with its poisonous body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its tail is extremely strong. Should someone pull it out of the ground while it naps, it will swing its tail with enough force to break bones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roam city streets in a constant search for trash to consume, eating even the smallest morsels. POKENAME that have claimed city dumps as their homes jealously guard it and will fight any challenger trying to wrest it from them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hurls itself at incredible speed to impale and ram its enemies with the long, venomous horn on its head. It voraciously devours anything in its path, crushing even stones, hulls, anchors, and debris with its powerful fangs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME makes its home in dark caves, where it Ingrains into the stone walls. It uses Poison Jab to attack any Golbat that gets too close, defending its cave with lethal precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scream out infrasonic shrieks that are too high-pitched for the human ear to hear. They use these shrieks to navigate and locate other Pokémon, listening for echoes and then diving at Pokémon with their venomous horns.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emits a high-pitched noise from its ears to disorient its foes. It then stabs with its venomous horn, using the confusion to its advantage during attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits a poisonous haze while it flies, leaving behind a toxic cloud that disorients its prey. This ability allows it to create a dangerous environment, weakening anyone who dares to approach.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has no empathy for anyone it deems lesser than itself and will beat them into submission until it is satisfied. It has enough strength to pulverize bones with a single punch.
author: mistymagius

entry: Considering itself a king of the ring, POKENAME is always itching for a change to show its prodigious strength. It can easily lift and even suplex hefty foes like Snorlax or Aggron.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was the fearsome patriarch of its herd. Staying watch over the young and the elderly, Pokémon foolish enough to approach would be flash-frozen by chilling winds gusted from its frills.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME is incredibly dangerous. It will go into a blind rage to protect its Trainer, destroying the surrounding terrain until every threat is defeated.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to topple a transmission tower. The poison it applies to its claws from its mane paralyzes its prey.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME's poison is concentrated entirely in its tail. In a fight, it will use the tail as a bludgeoning tool, sapping their foe's strength as it pummels them relentlessly.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME's mushroom is harvested as an ingredient in the production of X Defense. It uses its powerful arms to topple trees so it can feed on the roots.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Despite its menacing appearance, POKENAME fights only to protect its family, avoiding confrontation with every means at its disposal whenever possible. Its spines and claws secrete a powerful venom capable of corroding both plants and living tissue.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its fur contains ten different types of toxic spores, which scientists eagerly study to find clinical uses for. If anyone enters its territory, POKENAME tries to drive them away by striking them with its horn.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are able to draw out the latent elemental energies found within Moon Stones, wielding the cosmic power within them as both a weapon and a defence. Their sense of where to find the elemental stones makes them popular companions of hikers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME mightily destroys structures and trees as it rampages and uses the rubble remaining as projectiles to attack foes. As it sprints around with utmost agility, it swings its tongue wildly to knock down any obstacle it faces.
author: soup1900

entry: To defeat its enemies, POKENAME dives down to ram them with its very hard, venomous horn. Bothered by daylight, it stays hidden away until dusk arrives.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While its movement speed is quite slow, POKENAME is a relentless foe who will take anything as a challenge. Its thick hide and powerful arms allow it to rip apart those that try to oppose it.
author: mistymagius

entry: Due to its spikes, POKENAME frequently gets stuck in trees if floating too close to the ground. It cannot see well, which makes it prone to accidents as it floats through the environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats smog while floating through the sky to strengthen its own poison. The polluted air serves as a nutrient source, enhancing its toxic capabilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burn through foes with their teal-blue flames that are created by burning venom. Many Pokémon are scared of approaching POKENAME because of their frequent tantrums, especially when their flames are involved.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME feeds on the roots of poisonous plants to enhance its toxins. Even a single horn prick can cause violent fevers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME senses prey and whips its tail violently as a warning. It then tunnels at high speed and stabs targets with its sharp horn.
author: .izik

entry: Although fickle and generally unpredictable, POKENAME always keeps its shiny golden stomach well-polished. It is most active during the evening hours. It seems to show skill in tracking down Moon Stones.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The sharp, blood-red jewel on POKENAME's head often intimidates its enemies. However, most POKENAME refuse to use their prized horns as a weapon.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME troops claim large swathes of forest as their own, hooting and chasing out other Pokémon that try to take fruit from the tree tops. They attack interlopers with a mix of frenzied scratches and powerful tail swipes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME troops claim large swathes of forest as their own, hooting and chasing out other Pokémon that try to take fruit from the tree tops. They swing rapidly through the trees with their long limbs, chasing interlopers for miles.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME troops claim large swathes of forest as their own, hooting and chasing out other Pokémon that try to take fruit from the tree tops. They grapple Pokémon that refuse to run, stabbing with their venomous horn to deter future trespassing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME assert their dominance by sparring with other Pokémon, combining the fury of their venomous horn with their scorching hot tails to put other Pokémon into submission. If they lose, they vent frustration by burning the forest around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite being massive and muscled, POKENAME can fly with agility. It uses brute strength to overpower foes, employing toxins to weaken them. Extremely competitive, it will not hesitate to fight even members of its own species.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME and Nidoking have a strong rivalry, competing to see if brains or brawn is more effective at leading Nidoran families. Scientific observation thus far has yet to indicate which is the superior outcome.
author: sk372

entry: Containing both the physical power of Nidoking and the large intelligence of Alakazam, POKENAME is a force to be reckoned with. When it goes on a rampage, it uses its psychic power to destroy everything in its path.
author: darkweavile428

entry: If it concentrates hard enough, it can shatter rocks with the power of its fists. Since it likes to win duels fairly, POKENAME avoids stinging its opponents with its quills, which are coated with debilitating toxins.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are competitive body builders, comparing themselves against other Pokémon in contests of strength. These contests can sometimes be entirely one sided, POKENAME simply copying whatever activity they see and trying to outdo their 'competitor'.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME possesses enough might that just pounding its fists together creates enough force to knock over smaller creatures. It's said that it only ever considers other POKENAME worth using its full power against.
author: sk372

entry: The combined ferocity of Nidoking and Charizard makes POKENAME a bit of a tyrant. It attempts to beat down the strongest Pokémon it can find and make them bow down to it as a way to stroke its own ego.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its abnormally large tail to propel itself through the water. It will look for large rocks so that it can eat the algae.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME in the wild will climb to the top of the largest boulder it can find and proclaim itself king of its territory. Rival POKENAME will battle each other atop the rocks to see who is truly worthy enough to sit on the throne.
author: sk372

entry: Although stoic at most times, if one even accidentally bumps into POKENAME with enough force, it will go into a frenzy. Its thick tail can be used to fracture even the most sturdy of stones.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to loosen quartz from walls, then eats it. The minerals help to fuel its energy, keeping it strong and resilient in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Its fiery mane produces toxic gases that disorient any Pokémon that tries to chase it while it runs. In the wild, POKENAME lives in large herds and always stands alongside its companions to face predators together.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A Shellder has firmly attached itself to POKENAME's arm, mixing the poisons of the two Pokémon. The former Nidoking has lost most of its bulk in exchange for the new psychic abilities gained from the toxins combining.
author: ilazerheart

entry: While two of its heads are always cautious, one is always ready to go on a destructive rampage. Diamond cutters often use POKENAME to shape diamonds due to their three brains and diamond-piercing beaks, which allow them to perform very precise cuts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is the leader of packs of Dewgong fusions, and its command is absolute. Disobedient members will be banished from their pack by POKENAME.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME can swing their arms like miniature wrecking balls capable of pulverizing solid rock, while their horn can pierce metal. Few prey escape once they clamp their arms down.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal, highly territorial Pokémon. Despite its bulky stature, it can easily blend in with its surroundings during the night.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME's cannons each have a separate purpose. While one cannon is used to shoot pressurized water, the other shoots a dangerous toxin that takes effect shortly after seeping into its opponent's skin, causing fatigue and a burning itch.
author: slimninja55

entry: The coral on its back is constantly growing at a rapid pace. It rubs against rocks to grind it down, but the pieces of coral left behind will keep growing in the cracks and break those rocks open from the inside out.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: Despite a small appearance, POKENAME's powers can be overwhelming due to a lack of full control. POKENAME is said to appear in areas suffering from drought.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME bear resemblance to an ancient artifact from the Hoenn region. When threatened, they surround themselves with a bubble made of electrified water. By using a small explosion, they make this bubble burst and paralyze the foe.
author: chibitales

entry: Extremely protective of the orb it holds dear, POKENAME will rarely let anyone approach it. Those that try to forcefully approach it are battered viciously by the huge clubs made of densely packed water it summons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME drifts silently in the depths of the ocean with a shell capable of supporting extreme pressure. The water around POKENAME is unnaturally calm, as its presence subtly influences the ocean's currents.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME drifts silently in the depths of the ocean with a shell capable of supporting extreme pressure. The water around POKENAME is unnaturally calm, as its presence subtly influences the ocean's currents.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME is said to bring rain wherever it flutters, using its wings to scatter water that revitalizes any soil. Despite its immense strength, POKENAME focuses on nurturing its environment rather than engaging in pointless battles.
author: moga6

entry: It is said that POKENAME's core has the power to control the ocean, leading some to hunt it, attempting to attain that power. By rotating at high speeds, it can create massive water funnels that stretch from the ocean depths into the sky.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has the power of an ocean deity said to control currents all over the world. However, this form limits its power to a small lake.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME live in aquatic cave systems, and are incredibly territorial. Divers should beware when exploring these cave systems as POKENAME are known to attack anyone near their lair.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME was long thought to be extinct, until a living specimen was fished up in Hoenn. Ancient cave paintings suggest that the Pokémon was once revered as a deity of rain.
author: mepp.

entry: Some villages in remote tropical archipelagos warn about the sight of POKENAME in the sky, advising to take immediate shelter if spotted. Heavy rainfall follows POKENAME's flight, but the water that falls from above is boiling hot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives its life on isolated islands far from humans and other Pokémon. It creates vicious sea storms to repel travelers, but respects those who show the fortitude to endure these trials and manage to approach it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often seen "surfing" atop ocean waves using their psychic powers and ability to control water. Some researchers continue to argue that they resemble Kyoew, though no solid proof has been provided yet.
author: infinex21

entry: Legends endure that this Pokémon contains the genetic structure of every aquatic Pokémon within its own DNA. There are few POKENAME that have been witnessed, and when witnessed they have oft been seen floating within large bubbles.
author: infinex21

entry: Within its belly is a potent flame sac that allows it to breathe flames and keep it warm within its ocean home. The fur on its neck flickers like glowing flames and the jets of water it releases are always scalding hot.
author: infinex21

entry: Storms rage around POKENAME constantly, high winds shifting in the directions it desires, giving it immense advantage in its domain.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: They live among large rocks off of isolated shorelines. Many sailors have been led astray by the bright light from a well-meaning POKENAME.
author: currentlymuffin

entry: POKENAME drifts through the sea, directing currents and growing coral reefs to help rebuild damaged ecosystems. If it catches humans threatening the environment, it twirls rapidly to create whirlpools, refusing to let them escape unpunished.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are believed to live for millennia. There has been no record of a POKENAME body ever being found, and it is believed that they can regenerate their cells that get too old in a process that is still not understood.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: An everlasting drizzle of rain occurs where it dozes off. This light shower escalates into a devastating storm when POKENAME is provoked.
author: vaporvenator

entry: The rock on its back acts as a grounded beacon for its attacks to make them more accurate and powerful. The enormous power inside this beacon is capable of turning even a blazing desert into a rainy marsh.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME are very small fish Pokémon that resemble a specific ancient text character. They are often seen in schools of over 20 of their own kind, using small jets of water to propel themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: Hundreds, if not thousands, of smaller aquatic Pokémon flock around the titanic body of POKENAME as it travels through the seas. This Pokémon is rarely challenged due to its size, which allows for smaller Pokémon to seek shelter around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives inside of the deepest treasures of the ocean, from trinkets to ships. It will grow or shrink to fit the size of its newest home.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its thick arms glow brighter as it fights, building energy that quickly surges across its entire body. The large horn of a POKENAME can pierce through steel and serves as a conduit to release its energy after it has built up enough.
author: infinex21

entry: Often mistaken as part of the seafloor, this Pokémon hosts a whole reef atop itself, its denizens helping provide for this slow behemoth.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME sequesters itself in the deepest depths of the ocean to rest. Its awakening is heralded by inky, pitch black rain.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME are feared predators of ocean skies, with bodies harder than iron and feathers as sharp as blades. They will dive and cut through the waves to capture their prey and drag them to the air.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME carry their glowing eggs between their small hands and will shoot any threats with precise bubble bullets using their long mouths. When their dorsal fin glows bright, they are preparing to release pure energy from their mouths.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are often seen as living embodiments of storms, given their great powers of water and lightning. Despite the fact that many fear them at first, these Pokémon have often come to the aid of ships stuck in terrible storms.
author: infinex21

entry: Many oases have been formed by POKENAME throughout a large unforgiving desert in a distant land. People that live in the wasteland have built towns by these oases and honor the Pokémon that made them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can withstand the powerful pressures deep in the ocean's depths. Their Aqua Tail can easily take down Pokémon much larger than them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Wild POKENAME bury themselves in the seafloor and absorb the energy within it to grow as they sleep. They will unleash powerful tremors if they're disturbed.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME's power in the ocean is unmatched. It can devastate cities with Earthquake and unleash large tsunamis with Surf to flood everything in its path.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME live in the deep ocean and can only be discovered by the most determined of Trainers. Though rare, they have been seen above the waves and always are accompanied by powerful storms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In order to defeat Groudon, Kyogre fused itself with Celebi. That way, it gained the ability to travel back in time to fight its rival over and over.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME crashes its large limbs down with mighty force, creating deep craters with a single strike. It fills these ravines with fresh water to revitalize the surrounding ecosystem.
author: sk372

entry: If any of POKENAME's vines were to break off, they would explode into large puddles of water capable of housing one fish Pokémon. The more wavy and faster the movement of these vines are, the choppier and larger the waves in the sea are.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sustain their electrical power by boiling water in a section of their stomach. Many Scientists study POKENAME in hopes of improving the viability of using hydroelectric power as a renewable energy source on a large scale.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Wherever POKENAME soars, life-giving rainfall is soon to follow, quickly rejuvenating the land below. In lands were drought is common, sightings of POKENAME are known as the end of hard times.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME possesses great power over the ocean, but its abilities have a tendency to go haywire. Waves it summons may change direction suddenly, and whirlpools may appear randomly near it, even in midair.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are secluded Pokémon that live in caves near the coast. When these Pokémon wander outside of their homes, rainfall follows. Some people treasure POKENAME as stewards that prevent drought and promote crop growth.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Seen as protectors of the ocean, POKENAME use their dexterous legs to navigate the seas, collecting foreign debris and removing it from the water. When angered, the water around POKENAME will heat and boil as its patterns glow.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Valiant warriors of the ocean, these Pokémon sleep peacefully until they are needed and awaken. POKENAME are only spotted during massive droughts, where they bound across vast land masses, bringing rainstorms wherever they go.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME emerges from the sea to migrate across the land, causing floods wherever it passes. Contemporary research and ancient stories suggest POKENAME created the floodplains where human civilization began.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Rarely seen by humans, POKENAME is a guardian of the ocean that manipulates the waves to protect its denizens. The glowing stone it carries is sometimes referred to as the Soul of the Sea.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME commands the fiercest of ocean waters with the simplest of ease, a power that many have coveted and sought to abuse. To avoid such people, it lives in the deepest underwater cave and rarely leaves.
author: infinex21

entry: The flower on its back can sense when the sea currents around it are being disrupted. POKENAME uses its immense oceanic powers to maintain the sea's temperature and keep this flower blooming.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME is amphibious and darts around palm trees on beaches. If interrupted while headbutting, it will attack without hesitation. Legends say its recklessness nearly wiped out its kind.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME are said to appear whenever a great cataclysmic event is about to occur. Just before a major flood or storm, they emerge from the sea in droves to warn the local population.
author: quackquackattack

entry: One spray from POKENAME's spout summons heavy rain for miles surrounding it. It feeds itself by controlling underwater currents to pull prey into its massive mouth.
author: bacondlx

entry: When POKENAME feels insufficiently revered, massive geysers erupt from the ground. These scalding torrents are powerful enough to destroy mountains.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are strongly feared by fishermen due to the endless storm they drag on their shell. Their movements are so destructive that they are sometimes monitored by televised weather channels.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME are strongly feared by fishermen due to the endless storm they drag on their shell. Their movements are so destructive that they are sometimes monitored by televised weather channels.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME have translucent underbellies that reveal the liquid in them that is always kept bubbling by the electricity generated by their orange organs. They spew jets of water and immediately release powerful electricity along the jets.
author: infinex21

entry: With a flap of its arms, it can summon hurricanes. With a whip of its tail, it can cause tidal waves. As a result of its terrible power, POKENAME prefers to dwell in the darkest depths of the ocean.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The primal energy that fills POKENAME keeps its gears spinning. It is said it will only become still if all the oceans dry up.
author: .realthree

entry: While underwater, POKENAME's ribbons let it control the flow of water. The currents it sends attackers through are charged with emotional energy, causing those tossed around to emerge with a more placid demeanor.
author: sk372

entry: Using the full power of the ocean, POKENAME can summon floating waterways to swim to any location it wants. Its fins are made entirely out of water, which some say can't be evaporated by even a Groudon.
author: soup1900

entry: In myths, POKENAME was formed at the genesis of the primordial sea. With full command of the oceans, it could plunge the world into an endless deluge, leaving no traces of land.
author: mepp.

entry: According to ancient mythology, POKENAME is said to lie within the deepest parts of the ocean. With the full power of the sea, POKENAME could drown the entire world, leaving no land above sea level.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME walks along the ocean floor like a beast roams the land. Pokémon which reside in the ocean follow it to find where land is, as POKENAME tends to visit the coasts of regions and roar in anger from beneath the surface.
author: jangodiot

entry: Historical accounts associate strange weather with sightings of POKENAME. Clashing hurricanes, volcanic lightning, and flooded deserts are attributed to its presence.
author: kingd8

entry: It resembles a Pokémon depicted in mythology as the ruler of the skies and summoner of storms. The latter is the nearest truth, though it only appears when ocean storms occur. It rises from the depths and flies amidst the torrents of rain.
author: infinex21

entry: It slumbers in the deepest oceanic trenches of the world. Legends claim that POKENAME will one day drench the world in endless torrents of rain.
author: mepp.

entry: When Genesect are infused with the DNA of Kyogre, a POKENAME is made. It is the ultimate hunter and dominates air, land, and sea with immense power.
author: spookyscaryoverlord

entry: POKENAME lives in submarine ridges. When used for propulsion, its tail produces large amounts of steam. It's often confused for an underwater volcano.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME lives in submarine ridges. When used for propulsion, its tail produces large amounts of steam. It's often confused for an underwater volcano.
author: chromaerym

entry: Hiding itself inside of massive downpours, POKENAME attacks those who damage the ocean by striking them down with its red lightning. When fully enraged, its tail generates billows of storm clouds that can flood cities in one night.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are often seen dancing atop the surfaces of lakes, ponds, or even the ocean itself. They can use their muscular ears to whip up small tidal waves to defend themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: The mysterious POKENAME has only been seen a handful of times throughout history. Mysterious blinking lights in the sea are sometimes attributed to this Pokémon.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME cannot control the rainclouds it creates. It always extinguishes its own flame and ends up becoming grumpy.
author: ceoofspooks

entry: This deep sea predator emits a glow in the deepest depths that alert all when it is awake and on the hunt. Its tusks are sharp enough to slice open the toughest hulls of ships with but a passing cut.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is very squishy and not at all intimidating, but if provoked, it can expel thousands of gallons of water from its body.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME's water key ring can shrink and expand at will, allowing it to carry as many items as it wants. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the bottom of the ocean.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's special charms are attached to a surging band of water. It decorates itself with pirate treasure sourced from the seafloor.
author: royrw

entry: POKENAME's water key ring can shrink and expand at will, allowing it to carry as many items as it wants. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the bottom of the ocean.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The special orb charm attached to POKENAME's aqua ring bears a striking resemblance to an ancient, historical artifact from the Hoenn region. It is able to channel primal energy through this orb to power its aquatic attacks.
author: royrw

entry: Able to blast tidal waves from the crystalline organ in its chest, POKENAME is believed to have created oceans on foreign planets. The storms it creates change based on its appearance, ranging from harmless rain to catastrophic hurricanes.
author: soup1900

entry: They wander in trenches looking for ore to eat. The bubbles that blow from the holes around its body come out with enough force to pierce through steel.
author: schwaus

entry: Though it is too dense to swim, POKENAME can often be found prowling the deepest floors of the ocean. The red lights on its body illuminate the dark waters and draw its prey to it.
author: alestrius

entry: The droplet on the tip of POKENAME's tail is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Whenever water becomes polluted or trash gets dumped into the sea, the drop shrinks in size, and POKENAME becomes unwell.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME swims through the oceans, seeking out new aquatic Pokémon to play with. It sometimes becomes overzealous in its playing, inadvertently causing monsoons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Wild POKENAME keep their tusks sharp by grating them against the toughest underwater rocks they can find. These crushing depths they wander further hone their entire bodies, allowing them to grow stronger with every day.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live within underwater caves or caves nearest to a large body of water. Their tusks are kept sharp by the fierce currents they will challenge each and every day.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives quite a wild life, not unlike a tsunami. It surfs from wave to wave; discovering treasure on the ocean floor as it flows.
author: trakito

entry: The orange toxin within their bodies is so potent that it can melt most things into a drinkable liquid that they will happily gorge themselves with. Their horns and their tail stingers can inject this toxin directly into their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are rarely found in arctic oceans, gracefully floating along the water. By slamming their hands together, they can freeze the water around them instantly, trapping any ships they encounter. The crews of these ships are never seen again.
author: santon5512

entry: Recent ocean expeditions have discovered POKENAME living 30,000 feet deep underwater. They are scavengers, patiently waiting for leftover scraps to fall from the waters above.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fly around at night with great speed, and dive into the sea so fast that they reach the deepest areas quickly. Down here, they easily catch prey, able to see where others can't.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME live on the seafloor, dutifully protecting marine life. Their tough bodies are made up of an extremely durable metal.
author: mepp.

entry: Don't be fooled by its grin. This Pokémon has been known to sink entire islands.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME inhabits areas with lots of seaweed around for it to consume, providing nutrients for itself and the mushrooms on its back. The fungi contain pores that let it spray streams of water to defend itself and escape predators.
author: sk372

entry: The gentle tune POKENAME hums resonates throughout the ocean. It wishes for everyone to hear its voice by drowning the world in the sea.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME resides at the ocean's abyss, where next to no light reaches. Should it surface and go on a rampage, it is said it can unleash light rays so hot as to cause the oceans to evaporate before the day's end.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hibernates in the deepest watering hole in the savannah and is rumored to suck those who disturb their slumber into its tomb. Only those who successfully defeat a POKENAME in combat are allowed to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was the protector of a city by the sea. When a cataclysmic battle between the Titans of Land and Sea threatened its safety, it hid the city and itself at the bottom of the ocean.
author: strawberry_boicake

entry: POKENAME seeks out worthy opponents in the ocean to train up its skills, but it will go ashore to fight a Groutortle if it spots the rival Pokémon. Once it is satisfied with its battle prowess, it dives to deep ocean trenches to evolve and sleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live deep within the ocean, with their nests made between rocky outcrops, within trenches, and inside of caves. They spit a highly durable thread that becomes sticky when exposed to water to form their nests and to slow foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live within perpetual storm clouds, spending most of their time drifting over fields to water crops. Legends suggest that sunshowers or unexpected rain are signs of a POKENAME gathering.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME skate across the water's surface using their thin legs. When underwater predators approach, they will skate in circles at high speeds, creating large whirlpools to drive them away.
author: santon5512

entry: Legend has it that a rampaging POKENAME had destroyed an entire region with a flood, leaving behind an archipelago in ancient times. The people of these islands had painted murals of this Pokémon as to never forget what happened there.
author: cobalt0135

entry: This Pokémon is always accompanied by storm clouds wherever it floats. Thunder roars and heavy rain pours down from these clouds whenever POKENAME spins and releases its pent-up energy.
author: milchik

entry: Rarely emerging from the depths of the sea, POKENAME are considered protectors of the ocean. They link arms and then rapidly swim in circles to create massive whirlpools.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME glides freely over the ocean's surface, bringing sunny weather wherever it goes. If it encounters ice in its path, it strengthens the intensity of the sunlight's heat until the obstacle is cleared.
author: .realthree

entry: In areas where POKENAME are most often seen, there are stories that say that a POKENAME's chime can be heard up in the clouds. The chime is described as being beautiful enough to make the clouds themselves cry and bring rain down on the land.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME often swim alongside marine apex predators, feeding on scraps of food. While weak individually, if many POKENAME school together, they can generate enough power to create tropical storms.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME slumbers in deep ocean trenches, wrapping its body around hydrothermal vents. It awakens when nearby submarine volcanoes erupt, racing to the surface to find a strong opponent to tire it out with a battle until the volcano calms.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is incredibly protective of the sea. It has been seen using its massive arms to fling entire icebergs and large ocean rocks at oil rigs and fishing trawlers.
author: bigoljax

entry: Legends say that POKENAME flies inside storm clouds, using its spoons to bring rainfall across the entire world.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME commands the tides with crushing strength, wielding its trident to summon whirlpools mid-battle. Ancient carvings depict it as a sea god feared by sailors and rival Pokémon alike.
author: segmoph

entry: Ancient murals depict POKENAME as the slumbering guardian of Pokelantis whose many arms could calm or rage the seas. Texts foretell its awakening when the stars align, triggering colossal floods to resurface the lost civilization.
author: frl6160

entry: Legends describe POKENAME commanding currents to push continents away. When it spreads its upper arms, water flows around it, moving as it commands.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Whenever POKENAME are upset, they release a deluge of brackish water to flood the area around them. This rapid flooding often results in the creation of a new lake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME race along the ocean's surface, their manes flowing behind them like waves. If a Trainer spots them, they will dive into the water in a small, boiling plume.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The rainstorms that groups of POKENAME produce are violent and often wreak havoc upon coastal cities. When the weather becomes colder, they retreat beneath the waters.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME alternates between sleeping in water and on ice. No matter where it goes, its red markings still glow clearly.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME live in the deepest depths of the ocean where they churn through the sand to clean up garbage. Their estranged relationship with humanity leads them to become suspicious whenever kindness is given to them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's pressurized water cannons can blast over an entire region and shatter mountains. This, however, is only possible if the ground beneath it can support all of its weight and force without shattering.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: This Pokémon is constantly in shock from the destruction of its coral reefs. It sometimes haunts the beaches to scare swimmers away.
author: elevn.

entry: It awakens between long periods of inactivity. Never seen in full, its only herald are massive whirlpools, bringing ships right into its endless maw.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is said to sleep at the bottom of the ocean, remaining within its shell unless something threatens its aquatic home. Its cannons possess power enough to create tsunamis with a single blast.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is driven by its rage. The small volcano on its back erupts when it is confronted with danger.
author: over9001

entry: Before being fused into POKENAME, this Pokémon had to release an uncomfortable odor to scare away bird Pokémon. Now, POKENAME is respected by every Pokémon in the forest due to its mighty appearance.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME channels its power to manipulate ground and heat into the bone it carries, waving it around like a wand. With one slow swing, it can dry up an entire lake in just a few seconds.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon fights with fists of fury like no other, burning with volcanic desire for victory. It ignites its fists, and its punches have been compared to being struck by a falling meteor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand in order to prepare its soft innards for evolution. Its shell is incredibly robust and impossible to break open due to Groudon's scales.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME's is said to carry the capacity to shape the landmass around it. Supposedly, a charging tackle from it would, at full power, be enough to reshape an entire continent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings can carry an incredible amount of weight and are capable of contracting themselves in order to freely switch from flying into quickly tunneling through the earth. This makes POKENAME a dangerous predator beneath and above ground.
author: over9001

entry: This extremely dangerous leviathan lives in the dark depths of the sea. POKENAME's presence is announced with a terrifying roar, and it will use its tendril-like appendages to grab its prey. This apex predator should always be avoided.
author: fireblade141

entry: It swims through magma without being burned, protected by the layers of hardened earth covering its body. When it feels threatened by other Pokémon, it drives them away by shooting bursts of scalding water hot enough to burn them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon keeps itself warm and protected until it is able to evolve. Its outer shell reaches up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: over9001

entry: It radiates intense heat from within the cocoon as it creates magma inside that helps induce its evolution. The molten liquid seeps through cracks as the process nears completion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's swimming skills aren't used for swimming in water; they're instead used to swim through magma in the mantle layer of the planet. It slices open the ground with its scythes whenever it wants to return to the surface.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen outside of volcanic regions, building their nests close to craters. Their razor-sharp talons easily pierce through the tough shells of Torkoal, their preferred prey.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has been called the Oracle of Calamity, as weather-related disasters shortly follow its appearance. While it is comparatively most often spotted in the summer, an appearance during the winter season is said to be a sign of imminent danger.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME builds their nest underground. If someone were to approach it, POKENAME would defend it by stinging or piercing the enemy with its cone-shaped hands after building up momentum in the sky.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME has far greater power than it realizes and goes around with a happy-go-lucky personality. It subconsciously reshapes the terrain in its vicinity according to its playful whims.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flaps its wings in order to show its dominance over other bird Pokémon. It can fly at incredible speeds through rough sandstorms due to the scales on its feathers.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME live deep underground within lakes of magma, living off a diet of volcanic rocks. If one were to enrage a POKENAME, the nearest volcano will erupt with clouds of ash that crackle with red lightning.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a cautious Pokémon. It fears that it could be swarmed by other Rattata and steal its food due to its unique appearance that resembles Groudon's. It is a fierce fighter and will not let that happen.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME is a cautious Pokémon. It fears that it could be swarmed by other Rattata and steal its food due to its unique appearance that resembles Groudon's. It is a fierce fighter and will not let that happen.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME is feared by all Rattata and is seen as a violent Pokémon. It has razor-sharp fangs that grow at a steady rate. It can even chew through solid ground.
author: over9001

entry: It is said that POKENAME can dig from one side of the world to the other in under an hour, going straight through the mantle and core.
author: cyprexx

entry: Dwelling in the mouths of active volcanoes, POKENAME's markings burn with incandescent energy. It attacks by swinging its super-heated pincers, swiftly incapacitating any foe.
author: mepp.

entry: The Sneasel following Groudon is loyal enough to fashion clothing matching its color and design elements. It coordinates the larger Pokémon's mighty attacks, only stepping in itself when a battle becomes truly desperate.
author: sk372

entry: Scientists have found traces of POKENAME incredibly deep underground. The shell on its back somehow regulates its body temperature regardless of the extreme heat or cold at such depths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known for its sharp and sturdy beak that it uses to impale its prey. It can be found resting near volcanic ecosystems.
author: over9001

entry: The top layers of this Pokémon's molten-hot feathers are constantly shed off and replaced by fresh layers underneath, which harden when exposed to the cooler air. As a result, a trail of ashes is left in its wake wherever it goes.
author: feykrow

entry: This large Pokémon swims within lakes of magma without issue thanks to its obsidian-hard body. It can release streams of burning hot energy from its long mouth and will often drink whatever it has melted with that energy to sustain itself.
author: infinex21

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's belly is scorching hot and can be easiliy spotted in the dark. It slithers through the ground and lunges out of it to wrap around an opponent.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME only acknowledges the strong and will seek out worthy opponents. It climbs mountains with ease and can cause dormant volcanoes to erupt.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Its, literal, pit of a stomach glows with the magma-hot flames within its body. The spikes lining its body will glow when it prepares a breath attack that could instantly incinerate entire trees.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME immobilizes incoming threats by plugging its tail into the ground, charging the ground with electricity.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through it's veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.
author: over9001

entry: This Pokémon is very well mannered. When two Sandshrew are fighting nearby, it will step between them and make them stop by making them look into its unsettling eyes.
author: over9001

entry: Each one of POKENAME's claws has an extreme biting power thanks to the large white spikes that line them. By reshaping the land around its lair to replicate its prey's home, it tricks prey into walking right into its clutches.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME flies around its prey, it drips hot magma that cools and hardens into land. Once the prey has been completely enclosed in a ring of land with no possible escape route, POKENAME swoops down and sizzles them to a crisp.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hunts by creating sinkholes right underneath the prey's feet to drop them deep below the ground. Once they have dropped, the stone walls surrounding the prey close in on them, crushing them flat.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hunts prey by erupting the ground right beneath their feet with magma. To preserve prey it wants to eat for later, it encases them in obsidian and then buries them underground.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are prideful due to their intense internal heat, often throwing tantrums that rumble the earth when defeated in battle. POKENAME will sleep for 24-hours after being defeated, then awaken, ready to battle once more.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The spikes on POKENAME's back are as sharp as needles. When it curls up into a spiky ball, it rolls at its enemies, piercing into them as a result.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME tend to sleep for most of the year. During the summer months, this Pokémon awakens to train in the mountains near volcanoes. Shaking the earth with its rapid kicks, the land around POKENAME will shift and move.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When awakened by external forces, the spines on POKENAME's head will change colors, signaling a forthcoming drought in the nearby areas. POKENAME will train until tired again, then return to its slumber and end the drought.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: During long summers, POKENAME is said to awaken and roam the lands in search of food. During these periods, no rain falls, and plants wither. Once full, POKENAME will return to its home underground, sleep, and allow rain to fall again.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When in battle, the patterns on POKENAME's body will begin to glow and emit an intense heat. All water within 20 feet of this Pokémon will begin to steam up and evaporate while POKENAME is in combat.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The claws of this Pokémon can reach up to 9000°F. Although, this has an extremely high chance of burning out the remaining flames on its body, leaving it prone to dangerous attacks.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon said to possess the power to potentially reshape the planet. Highly timid, it uses its power to manipulate the ground to raise large barriers to hide and shield itself from others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sizable claws account for almost half of its body weight. Despite this, it fights with awe-inspiring grace and speed.
author: dylonk25

entry: While it normally floats motionless, POKENAME quickly darts away from anything that attempts to touch the arcane symbol floating above it. Some theorize that touching the icon will trigger a horrible cataclysm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dwells deep underground, where its eyes have adapted to pierce the darkness. Though it rarely uses its camouflage, it vanishes out of fear when an Onix approaches. If cornered, it channels a lava plume to escape through the tunnels.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME make their homes in active volcanic craters. Their scythes are made of molten earth and are hot enough to easily cleave through lead.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a volcanic ecosystem on its back. Scientists found out that the lava flowing through its body is a mixture of rocks from Mt. Ember and magma.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon. It dives through the ground with only its white horn sticking out. Once it reaches its foe, it jumps at them with its mouth wide open to bite them with its strong jaw, injecting them with poison.
author: over9001

entry: Ancient tablets warn that if POKENAME enters an unreverent city, it will steadily raise temperatures. Entire water sources are said to evaporate under its displeasure.
author: .izik

entry: According to legend, POKENAME is said to have cleaved the land into continents and islands, and will again as the ages pass.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: There is evidence that POKENAME were a common companion to medieval nobles in Hoenn, the Pokémon being used to create chasms in battle. Legendary accounts of POKENAME point to their true power being unlocked alongside a mysterious ruby gemstone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME were a prized Pokémon in medieval times, often battling alongside highborn knights. They are adept with both offense and defence, their shield and sword each housing an eye and allowing them to react to any attack or opening near instantly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are powered by fiery rubies found in remote locations. Their blades radiate an intense heat, enabling them to combat Water-Type Pokémon by evaporating their attacks with a single swing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME puts itself under the tutelage of powerful Ground and Fire type Pokémon, learning greater strength from them. It seeks to one day surpass all of its teachers in fighting power.
author: sk372

entry: The robust body of a POKENAME can endure direct exposure to magma, which is what they often rest within. Their bodies produce an energy as hot as magma that they can release during battle to empower their every attack.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their wings and their tails to create targeted tremors to overwhelm their opponents. A POKENAME's wings can move so fast that they create powerful vibrations that could pulverize dirt and loose rock into grains of sand.
author: infinex21

entry: Thick limbs are connected to POKENAME's body through ribbon-like tendrils made of sand. These limbs can effortlessly reshape the ground around itself as it sees fit, an ability used to build shelters for weak or tired Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon feared by many mountain climbers. It uses its tail to chuck huge boulders across the valley. Its jaw is so powerful that it is capable of biting through sturdy mountain rocks, creating its own tunnel systems.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME digs through the earth as if it was swimming through water. When aggressive, it can cause earthquakes that split entire regions in half.
author: jangodiot

entry: The temperature within POKENAME's body rose to the point that much of it became liquid magma itself. Heat radiates intensely around it, drying up and setting most anything close to it on fire.
author: sk372

entry: According to ancient mythology, POKENAME is said to live deep within the mantle layer of the planet. With the full power of the land and magma, POKENAME could cover the entire world in a landmass, leaving no traces of water left.
author: soup1900

entry: Very few POKENAME have been found in the wild as of yet, and those that have been discovered were nested with their bodies wrapped around volcanos. Their bodies are brimming with a magma-hot energy that can melt metal instantly.
author: infinex21

entry: Whenever it is hungry, POKENAME causes volcanoes to become active to feed off of the ashes and smoke. Land created by this Pokémon often consists of tall mountains that pierce high above the clouds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its serpentine body to sculpt the magma dripping from it into landmasses. It immediately rips apart the land in a fit of frustration, making this Pokémon a symbol for creative burnout among artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With a single breath, POKENAME can decimate skyscrapers with flaming hot plasma. It is said only those who live true to themselves ever have the chance of capturing POKENAME, as those who fail to live honestly are swallowed into the ground below.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This variant of POKENAME is covered from head to tail in a sticky, tar-like substance. Most of POKENAME's diet consists of sulfur and other volatile materials found in volcanic areas, which they use to fuel their Fire-type attacks.
author: chibitales

entry: A single punch from POKENAME can send seismic shockwaves circling the globe. When enraged, it fires out thunderbolts powerful enough to create large fissures in the ground.
author: mistymagius

entry: Magma flows through POKENAME's body that can burn hotter than the sun, if not for the crystalline layer covering its body that cools it. The aforementioned glaze is pure Never-Melt Ice, thus it withstands such temperatures without evaporating.
author: shikuren

entry: It is said that the magma flowing through POKENAME's body would burn hotter than the sun if not for the ice on its body cooling it constantly. No one is quite sure how the ice never melts.
author: shikuren

entry: POKENAME contains the power of magma and the earth itself. It uses this incredible power to bake food to perfection.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Magma courses through its veins like blood, setting parts of its form aglow with sheer heat. Its tusks are hot enough to melt diamond as they slice through. It rests deep within volcanic land, bathing in the hottest pools of magma it can find.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tungsten key ring is unbreakable, allowing it to carry any item regardless of weight. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the planet's core.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME have been rumored to be sighted around the sites of active volcanoes. It has been said that they fish through molten rock to find new items for their collections. They can occasionally be found nestled beneath active lava flows.
author: royrw

entry: POKENAME's tungsten key ring is unbreakable, allowing it to carry any item regardless of weight. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the planet's core.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Drawing energy from the special orb charm attached to its spiked ring allows POKENAME to create avalanches of molten rock fragments. It can cause great pillars of hot rock to burst violently from the land when it fiercely jingles its collection.
author: royrw

entry: POKENAME is a very agile Pokémon that wears protective scales on each of its tails and its body. It leaves footprints in the ground that can be commonly found around volcanic regions.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME is able to form planets by manipulating the space dust scattered across the cosmos. It is able to travel across space by encapsulating itself inside pieces of landmass and launching itself like a meteor.
author: soup1900

entry: According to ancient myths, POKENAME can form land bridges across planets by manipulating the magma inside the planets. Using the red orb on its chest, it blasts beams of magma with the force of an erupting volcano.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon sings a mysterious soothing melody with its deep voice. It generates a beat by making the ground vibrate.
author: over9001

entry: Despite the fact that POKENAME can screech loud enough to rattle the ground beneath it, it is also capable of singing soft, soothing lullabies. Legends claim that a POKENAME's melody can even quiet a raging volcano.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses its heavy weight and grooved body to sink to the bottom of dunes. They feast on ore deposits found beneath the sands.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.
author: over9001

entry: A colossal titan charged with electricity, POKENAME roams the land with ground-shaking steps. It leaves behind a trail of crackling energy in its wake.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME live underground beneath volcanic areas, feeding on molten rock, sulfur, and rubies. Their tusks are forged in the heat of the magma they rest in, always melting only to be regrown better than before.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rest deep within volcanoes, the sheer heat keeping their bodies and tusks refined into a form fit for any battle. When two POKENAME meet, a vicious battle that scars the land around them will ensue.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is thought to make its home all the way down in the molten heat of the planet's core. It can fire unfathomably hot flames from the symbol on its stone fist.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to create pillars of paradoxically hot ice. In battle, they are able to encase opponents with these pillars, leaving fatal burns. In ancient murals, POKENAME have been depicted creating entire glaciers.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME gets incredibly agitated without enough light sources near it. When natural light is lacking, it creates a fire orb similar to the sun to shine on it and help it calm down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hefty tentacles cause the ground to quake below it. It is said that these Pokémon cannot be moved be any sort of attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dashes forward while leaking magma, often suplexing opponents to the ground. It lives in volcanoes and absorbs magma, spewing it back when the craters begin to dry.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME uses the network of mycelium in the ground to tear the mantle apart as it pleases. Avoid angering this Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME sings with a deep voice, shaping the land with each spoken melody. It forms mountain ranges through its reverberate song.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: This Pokémon can be found crawling inside volcanic caves. Its claws allow it to excavate tunnels in order to find small bugs to feed on.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME dwell in volcanoes, basking in the light of the lava around them. The magma that makes up their bodies glows brighter than the sun, causing sprawling heatwaves when they emerge from their slumber.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME controls the land with a flick of its wand, creating entire mountains ranges within the blink of an eye. It fires powerful beams from its wand hot enough to melt through bedrock.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in volcanic crags, navigating the rocky terrain with nimble steps. Its tongue is covered in a layer of searing hot mucus due to its steady diet of Slugma.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has long been used in land reclamation. When fed specially treated coal, it produces dense rock that settles into stable bedrock. A single POKENAME can form up to an acre each week, and many lakeside cities used them for their foundations.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When POKENAME's body impacts the ground, it releases enough energy to raise pillars out of the ground nearby. A small group of them landing in succession could drastically alter a great distance of the surrounding terrain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.
author: over9001

entry: The flame on its tail is so hot that no amount of water, no matter how cold, will extinguish it. However, the weight of its scales will cause it to sink very quickly when submerged in large bodies of water.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME reside within volcanic regions and nest underground. They feed on flammable materials, ranging from vegetation to minerals like coal and sulfur. Though small, they can spit out powerful flames.
author: infinex21

entry: With the power to manipulate the ground, POKENAME can dig through subterranean areas with ease. Rather aggressive, the trio will summon earthquakes in the vicinity the moment it feels threatened.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tough plated body visibly radiates steam from the extreme heat within its body. Its ear-like organs can generate ultrasonic waves at such levels as to split the ground and cause magma to erupt from the cracks.
author: sk372

entry: Smoke billows out from POKENAME's body, fueled by an internal furnace keeping its body hot at all times. When sufficiently enraged, it can spew liquid magma from the same spots that produce smoke.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's steps leave tiny tremors in its wake, though it often looks confused and even is spooked by the shaking. Its constant headaches sometimes lead to accidental mini earthquakes, much to its own surprise.
author: thepandasharky
