entry: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.
author: over9001

entry: When POKENAME stomps onto the battlefield, its great weight causes massive fissures which often swallow its opponents whole.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Legends tell of POKENAME throwing chunks of land into the sea to create microcontinents. Their control over magma ensures no one interferes with their craft.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME's shell is very resilient and heatproof, which makes it able to swim through lava at high speeds. It emits hot steam when it feels threatened.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME live deep below the ground, but on occasion rise to the surface, creating the same warning signs as an earthquake. Researchers have discovered that Shuckle are able to tell the difference and do not curl up when POKENAME is approaching.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A POKENAME's legs are strong enough to create small tremors when it stomps its hooves against the ground. The flames that sprout from the crevices along its body are as hot as magma.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail is made out of a fairly distinct flame. Even though POKENAME is not a Fire-type Pokémon, it is still capable of maintaining the flame on its tail. Researchers believe the boiling water inside its body is keeping it alive and healthy.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME runs across volcanic lands. Legends say that when it planted its feet, three mountains rose, and it dashes up and down them to grow stronger and faster.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME live in vast desolate wastelands ravaged by pollution because they have nowhere else to call home. They unleash their anger against anyone they come across by unleashing a flaming wave of sludge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body is filled with boiling water. Once it is aggravated, it will spray its opponent with scorching hot liquid. The pigmented color of its skin is likely due to the steam stored in its body.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME makes its home in deep parts of the sea close to volcanic activity. It is said that any time POKENAME's shell opens, an earthquake occurs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rest in hydrothermal vents deep in the ocean, slowly absorbing heat. They awaken once their body has begun to overheat, releasing this heat through their head in a huge eruption that is powerful enough to cause tsunamis.
author: santon5512

entry: Using the massive jaws on their claws, POKENAME will burrow under the earth, consuming the ground as they do so. Their digging has been known to cause earthquakes; the tunnels they leave behind often form sinkholes.
author: santon5512

entry: This rare variant of POKENAME is popular and highly sought after since it bears resemblance to a villain from a classic and beloved video game.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is an artifact from ancient times. It's said if you collect seven special stones, POKENAME will come back to life and grant up to three wishes.
author: ethewriter

entry: POKENAME can unhinge its jaw, ready to swallow prey whole. The strong stomach acid dissolves everything except the longest bone of its last victim, which it keeps wrapped with its tongue until it finds new prey.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME rarely meets other Pokémon while flying in the ozone layer. Few Pokémon desire to risk earning its ire, so it often spends its days without contact with others while it develops in its cocoon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time watching over its rather troublesome children. The two often fight one another if left unmonitored.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: POKENAME flies so high in the sky for such extended periods that its wings have become bathed in powerful sunlight. With every flap of its wings, it scatters many shining scales that fill those who hold them with a gentle warmth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME endlessly orbits the planet, bouncing between satellites. Its single eye is said to be capable of seeing the edges of the universe.
author: .realthree

entry: If a POKENAME desperately needs to escape a predator, it can hurl itself through the atmosphere towards the planet. However, this is a one-way trip.
author: .realthree

entry: The glowing wings on POKENAME's back allow it to stab its opponents at extremely high speeds. It hides high up in the air to ambush unsuspecting prey.
author: raydrago

entry: Stories say a single drop of the poison in POKENAME's stinger is enough to fell the mightiest of dragons. Though unsubstantiated, Dragon-type Pokémon are noticeably wary in its presence.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME unleashes its unquenchable fury against asteroids that come too close to the stratosphere where it dwells. Over the years, its appearance has inspired many works of art.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME hitches a ride on large flying Pokémon. It acts both parasitically and mutualistically, sucking some blood from its living vehicle while also cleaning off other parasites and debris. When it lets go, it can glide in the sky for miles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, as it stays above the ozone layer. By staying above the atmosphere, its abilities of ice have powered up immensely.
author: unknown

entry: Storms intensify wherever POKENAME hunts. Scientists believe it deliberately prolongs bad weather to exhaust prey before delivering a paralyzing strike.
author: mepp.

entry: The flames on POKENAME's wings are thought to be made of pure dragon energy leaking out of its body. Its mastery over wind and fire makes it a challenging opponent for many Trainers.
author: chibitales

entry: Some say POKENAME was secretly created in a lab to manufacture the ultimate Dragon Pokémon. It has extremely powerful physical and psychic capabilities, and responds violently to anyone who disturbs its isolated existence.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon lives so high up in the sky that its existence is practically just a myth. It contains the DNA of all the Mega Pokémon known.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is capable of clearing the highest clouds to chase intruders from its nest. It is said to pursue enemies for hundreds of miles and will not stop until the foe is caught or collapses from exhaustion.
author: frokachu

entry: Gathering sunlight allows POKENAME to achieve flight, going airborne for longer as it absorbs more sunbeams. If it takes in enough energy, it is theorized that it could fly itself up to the ozone layer and back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME moves slowly and relies on smaller Pokémon to bring it food as it circles the world, with an eye constantly on the sky. It communicates with the Pokémon that help it, telling stories about different lands and different times.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME moves slowly and relies on smaller Pokémon to bring it food as it circles the world, with an eye constantly on the sky. When swimming it absorbs water and almost doubles in size.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The rings on POKENAME's body generate a faint energy that affects Dragon-type Pokémon. It weakens their battle tendencies, and during the full moon is strong enough to immobilize them completely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has two tails with small and simple brains; the two tails do not get along. Whenever POKENAME roars, however, the tails settle down for several hours.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has two tails with small and simple brains; the two tails do not get along. Whenever POKENAME roars, however, the tails settle down for several hours.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dwells in the most sinister and desolate abysses. The few divers who have encountered it have never been seen again.
author: astrael1

entry: POKENAME's many rows of extremely hard teeth all rotate rapidly, allowing it to tunnel through solid rock. This also allows it to eat anything it can fit in its maw, as heavily armored prey are hardly a struggle to consume with its serrated teeth.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME despises dragon Pokémon. It has adapted the Dragon typing and moves from its foes' battles into itself to improve its chances against its sworn enemy.
author: thepandasharky

entry: It parasitizes meteorites and meteor-like Pokémon, such as Minior or Solrock, and eats them from the inside, leaving only an empty shell that POKENAME uses for self-protection. Without its armor, this Pokémon's thin body is much more vulnerable.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can fire out bursts of energy projectiles from its mouth that travel at incredible speed and reach miles into the distance. It is believed it could easily snipe something flying in the ozone layer, downing it in a single shot.
author: sk372

entry: As an apex predator, POKENAME considers everything prey. POKENAME drags its catches into underwater volcanoes, where it then boils them alive.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Once a year, POKENAME descends from its home in frosty mountain peaks to deliver gifts to those who have behaved. It specializes in giving gifts to Dragon-type Pokémon and harshly punishing them if they've been badly behaved.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME are filled with potent draconic energy. Its bite is highly venomous to humans and Pokémon.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's quick speed and sharp senses make it difficult to corner as it flees at the first sign of humans. If a pursuer gets too stubborn, it can generate powerful pulsing waves from its antlers to stun them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME runs across the wasteland at breakneck speed, leaving behind the booming sounds of thunder. Many motorcyclists have this Pokémon's image patched onto their jackets.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is capable of causing a mass extinction event by clogging the atmosphere with volcanic ash. Its plates are made of pure obsidian.
author: samulock

entry: POKENAME is said to live on the tallest mountain peaks in the world. Its power is so ridiculously vast that many believe it could crumble an entire mountain range with just a stomp of its foot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's agility and power make it a force to be reckoned with in combat. Although it is egotistical and rarely takes on challengers it deems weak, its hunting instincts cause it to lash out at any and all Dragon types it comes across.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has rarely been seen, as it only descends from the ozone layer to rest in places serene and devoid of any strife. It retreats if spotted, trailing a sparkle of energy; those who view it feel a fleeting sensation of pure tranquility.
author: sk372

entry: While the jungle is its home, POKENAME will make frequent trips to the ozone layer. It was unknown why it does this until a researcher observed one taking prey with it, perhaps to consume it in peace.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: In flight, POKENAME move in irregular patterns as they learn to maneuver through the high altitudes. When panicked while dropping from great heights, POKENAME will spit a fireball towards the ground to slow their momentum to correct themselves.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME will chase after falling meteors to challenge their agility. When close to the rock, POKENAME will use its razor claws to hack into the mineral, creating chunks that are small enough to consume.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME practice their maneuvers while in flight, twisting and turning to continue training their reflexes. When tired, POKENAME find the highest and safest point in the area and rest.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME descends from the skies extremely rarely, appearing only when it senses a foe worthy enough to challenge its might. In combat, it wraps its fists in flames that are said to burn with the intensity of the sun.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have powerful energy-based attacks, as well as incredible physical attacks. At a distance, POKENAME call up vast energy to blast opponents away. At melee range, POKENAME swing their massive bodies to strike down opponents with their tails.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Acting as guardians of the sky, POKENAME rest at the top of mountains and towers until external forces awaken them. These Pokémon have the ability to soar into the atmosphere at blinding speeds and disperse massive clouds with a single heated kick.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Honing in on their extraordinary energy-based attack, POKENAME will focus their energy into one powerful beam and launch it at their opponent. This energy output is so potent that sparks will fly off its body when charging its attack.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When POKENAME hone in an energy attack for extended amounts of time, the excessive energy will radiate off its body. This visual phenomenon has been dubbed POKENAME going “Super POKENAME”.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's dances are described as having a great power and grace to them. As the dance goes on, transparent images of serpents and dragons appear, flying about and accompanying POKENAME in their moves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to hang around the highest mountain point it knows, using psychokinetic energy to feed off water and particles in the atmosphere. It is said to descend from there to stop destructive clashes between other Pokémon.
author: kyonbrace

entry: POKENAME rarely descends from its home in the ozone layer. Its rare documented appearances all involve stopping rampaging Dragon Pokémon from causing massive harm to human civilizations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels across the lands looking for stronger and stronger Dragon-type Pokémon to duel. This preference for opponents has earned it the nickname of "The Dragon Slayer."
author: sk372

entry: Renowned in the past and the present as a gallant warrior Pokémon, POKENAME fights for the sake of others using psychic blades and harsh gales. It can move at incredible speeds by propelling itself with psychic energy and controlled wind currents.
author: infinex21

entry: Renowned in the past and the present as a gallant warrior Pokémon, POKENAME fights for the sake of others, even at a risk to itself. It attacks with psychic blades, every slash churning the air into fierce razor winds all around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are known as one of the smartest and most intimidating Pokémon. It flies endlessly, and when it finds prey, smashes into them at full speed.
author: planatical

entry: Racing through wastelands, POKENAME generate tunnels of wind as they run. If they collide with a solid surface or each other, the force from the headbutt will create winds strong enough to blow away all clouds in the immediate area.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: These Pokémon are heralds of disaster, descending from the sky to warn both people and Pokémon of world-changing events. Their horns are said to hold the power to split the sky in two.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME's resplendent majesty evokes a sense of awe and reverence from any onlookers as it soars above. Many stories hail it as a guardian of the planet, patrolling the heavens for any cosmic threats.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is incredibly sad when it remembers that its tower is in ruins. Sometimes its sadness is so great that it blows the wind harder.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME is a formidable fighter, known for its incredible strength and relentless spirit. With each powerful strike, it dominates the battlefield, leaving opponents trembling in its wake.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME tend to live at or near high elevations, utilizing their powerful eyesight to scour for prey or would-be threats up to one mile away. They strike with terrifying speed and precision, loosing powerful lightning bolts before pouncing.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has earned the nickname "Dragon Tamer" due to the calming properties of its ribbons being particularly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. Even the most aggressive of the species stops in its tracks with just a touch.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its size and lack of wings, this Pokémon can fly through the sky at great heights, seemingly walking or prancing upon the air. It is said that it can quell the storms and strife with its mere presence, so there are some who revere it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is very wary and attentive to climate changes, ensuring they do not deteriorate. If the balance is broken, it can bring down the entirety of the oceans from the sky to restore it.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME has taken on a form similar to its Mega Form. Although it does not exhibit the full extent of that form's power, it still fights with greater strength and ferocity than before.
author: sk372

entry: Empowered by fusion energy, POKENAME can now control and expand the ozone layer. Wherever it flies, it brings a special weather that only it can cause and control, which seemingly benefits Flying-type Pokémon greatly.
author: soup1900

entry: Strangely, fusion has resulted in a smaller, simpler, and more streamlined appearance for POKENAME. This actually makes it more formidable, as its greater power is now within a smaller, quicker body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME patrols the planet's skies, using its space manipulation to teleport instantly across the land. Its roaring cry can open up portals through space to banish those it deems a threat to the world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves a void black trail as it drifts ominously through bright summer skies. Scientists have studied the composition of this trail for decades without reaching any useful conclusion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has only been seen dormant. However when awake has displayed immense power. The laser beams it fires from its arm can rip through mountains.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME has a strong-willed personality, often calmed down by listening to music. It shows an interesting curiosity in rooms filled with computers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's draconid key ring suppresses elemental energy, allowing it to safely carry powerful items. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets above the clouds.
author: h0bojoe

entry: A POKENAME's scales are scalding hot, even months after being shed. They fly at high speeds through the sky and never stop for any form of weather.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's disguise is meant to be imposing and draconic, trying to make itself appear like the most powerful of Dragon types. Those that make fun of its appearance get blasted with a great orb of darkness fired from the disguise's mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's disguise emits a pulse that neutralizes foul weather in a short range around it. It offers solace from poor conditions to others, hoping to make friends while they wait out the storm together.
author: sk372

entry: Shrines to POKENAME still exist in remote parts of Johto and Hoenn. According to nearby residents, if offerings are not regularly made, a vengeful POKENAME will descend from on high and put a curse on the entire region.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is hungry, it uses latent energy to propel itself to mountaintops. It loves to eat ore found at the peak of these mountains.
author: schwaus

entry: The beating of POKENAME's wings is strong enough to induce violent sandstorms. However, it can also quell them at a moment's notice.
author: busilisk

entry: The horns on POKENAME's head drip with a poison highly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. While not normally overtly aggressive, the presence of Dragon types sends it into an angry rage, aiming to poison them almost on sight.
author: sk372

entry: Some have nicknamed POKENAME "The Dragon Slayer," due to its tendency to pick fights with any strong Dragon-types it comes near. The poison its claws generate is extremely effective against them, giving more credence to its moniker.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often make treks into space, returning with meteorites to eat. They use their high-pitched screeches to break them down into easier bites to eat.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME flies extremely high up in the atmosphere at high speeds. To hunt, it will tuck in its wings and dive towards the ground at supersonic speeds. Its hearing is sensitive, causing it to attack aircraft that get too close.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of a metal mixture said to be infused with draconic energy. This is believed to be what gives it its remarkable resilience, as well as a boundless reservoir of energy used for firing energy beam attacks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often reside in the realm unseen where alternate universes connect and devour the energy particles from the gateways that link them. When attacking, they use their stored energy to burst around and slam into enemies like a shooting star.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is able to achieve speeds that put most standard airplanes to shame. It often clashes with other Dragon-type Pokémon and has been seen preying upon some of them after winning. It mostly ignores anything and anyone it deems weak.
author: infinex21

entry: It travels across the planet, only staying in spots where a meteor is about to crash. POKENAME's sandy body absorbs the impact of meteors. After the meteor scatters its body, it pieces itself back together.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's sharp voice pierces through the air as it sings, calming the weather around it in seconds no matter how devastating. Its songs are fierce melodies that compel most Dragon types to pay respects to it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stand atop towers to keep watch for extraterrestrial threats. If they spot even the slightest glimpse of a shooting star, they will rapidly hop up and down while roaring and scattering the fire from around their necks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It has a voracious appetite for leaves, fruits, and vegetables. There are some stories that claim this Pokémon can grow nearly thrice as long before evolving.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carries a superficial resemblance to the Pokémon colloquially known as the Weather Trio. The tallest often has to force the other two members to cooperate instead of quarrel.
author: sk372

entry: Though the red clouds surrounding POKENAME's head may resemble those surrounding dynamaxed Pokémon in the Galar region, they are unrelated. They are instead thought to contain extremely intense electrical charges.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME can eat and digest anything with its powerful stomach, producing an energy yield equivalent to that of rocket engines. Much of that energy is used to rapidly crawl across the lands, after which it exhausts itself and needs to eat again.
author: hipsnake

entry: POKENAME's head rotates constantly, independent of its body. If sufficiently angered, each of its many eyes can fire intensely powerful Hyper Beams to raze the immediate area to the ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases a loud ringing noise audible from many miles away while flying through the sky. The sound was once thought to be a sign of great storms approaching.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME believes it stands at the pinnacle of strength and only accepts challenges from the worthy. It is said that even legendary Pokémon have been denied for not measuring up to POKENAME's standards of strength.
author: sk372

entry: Natural disasters often herald the arrival of POKENAME. Their punches are strong enough to bring an end to storms, as they scatter clouds to cast sunlight on rugged lands below.
author: amityblamity

entry: POKENAME's body is overflowing with energy, which it regulates through exerting itself; it achieves this by seeking out fights and by traveling far and high in the sky. Its flames burn hot enough that rain will sizzle and evaporate on contact.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME streaks through the night sky at blinding speeds, leaving glowing orange trails in its wake. Some say it makes the sky look as though it is tearing in half.
author: .izik

entry: One day, a Geodude left to train for months to master the power of dragons. It returned later, its fists possessed by a spirit.
author: elevn.

entry: A trained Geodude managed to evolve. It is forced to bind the spirit that controls it in order to protect the lands from its wrath.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME's strength is so great that its body cannot fully contain it, surging out from the crags of its body and forming an aura around it. Even the mightiest of Dragon types are said to tremble once this power manifests itself.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon will let none, save for the very few it ever chooses, ride upon its back. It is able to walk upon the air itself, its majestic mane of flames casting an awe-inspiring visage as it trots through and beyond clouds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cuts through the air and sea with the same powerful grace, switching from one to the other seamlessly. The Aurora Beam it fires from its mouth is notably to be particularly dazzling, as well as incredibly powerful.
author: sk372

entry: The energy burning within POKENAME's shell creates a mystical steam when exposed to the air. POKENAME can release this energy to rapidly expel the steam with enough force to blow away an entire cloudbank.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It can accelerate the growth speed of plants around itself. However, farmers report that using POKENAME to mass produce crops robs them of flavor and quality.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME resembles the rare Adamant Orb, but will explode if anyone tries to pick it up. The force of its explosion can send anyone within range up to a minute forward or back in time.
author: hophoppip

entry: Like a standard egg timer, POKENAME will begin to tick after being twisted to set a time. When it reaches that time and rings, it will unleash an explosion of psychic power.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has the unique ability to quite literally punch someone into next week.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: Though POKENAME usually takes the shape of an octahedron, it is capable of reconfiguring its entire crystal structure at will. When threatened, it opens up to a form resembling a star before firing a devastating beam.
author: origamiskies

entry: It is said that when POKENAME appears, it will use a type of time magic to assist those in need. Many stories tell of POKENAME hastening the evolution of Dragon-type Pokémon in particular.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sonorous singing voice can alter the flow of time itself. It's treated with fear and reverence, given the title of the Queen of Time.
author: hophoppip

entry: Mad scientists follow POKENAME around in the hope to discover a phenomenon they call "wet time travel." No one has been able to figure out what that means or if POKENAME even has it.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its poison can heavily alter one's sense of time, making mere seconds feel like years. Vials of POKENAME toxin sell for ludicrous amounts on the black market.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A mysterious cave painting depicts a figure akin to POKENAME transporting Pokémon to a mythical land. Time seems to flow differently for this Pokémon: it never shows physical signs of aging.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Some believe all instances of POKENAME have traveled forward in time from ancient prehistory in order to avoid extinction. POKENAME creates whirlpools in the water that can send others hurtling through the timestream.
author: sk372

entry: While it awaits evolution, it clings to nearby surfaces for hundreds of years. Some POKENAME have even become local attractions due to how long they've stayed motionless.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME are highly territorial and aggressive, which is thought to be due to having been poached in the past for their large, blue crystals. These crystals store and channel immense energy, especially while a POKENAME is agitated.
author: infinex21

entry: When thoroughly enraged, POKENAME are likely to fly into a dangerous and destructive rampage. Though they inevitably tire out due to rapidly exhausting their energy, Pokémon Rangers and Rangers still monitor their territories to avoid such incidents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME secure their food, notably opting to prefer hardy fruits and vegetables, by freezing them solid. The ice they create is remarkably dense even within seconds of forming, though they can control it and make it melt just as quickly.
author: infinex21

entry: Those who peer into this Pokémon's flames will supposedly see their entire life as the flame flick about. The core upon POKENAME's chest contains immense energy that it can emit as a searing-hot ray of light to defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: Those that spend time around POKENAME seem to age slower. The more people and Pokémon around it, the quicker it has to shed its skin, causing scientists to believe that POKENAME is absorbing the time experienced by those around it to grow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Legends say that POKENAME can circle the globe so fast that it will start to turn back time. It has almost never been seen fully; the only remnants of its presence are a trail of blue light as it flies by.
author: mistymagius

entry: It temporarily freezes time before poisoning foes with its toxic needles. If you encounter a wild POKENAME, it has likely already stung you.
author: h0bojoe

entry: When you approach POKENAME, you hear the sound of a cuckoo clock before it disappears. Some believe that it travels through time to escape.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can change the time on the dial of its watch at will, allowing it to travel through time. There are speculations that it is immortal.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's wool is remarkably durable even before being processed and is more electrically conductive than copper. Though they are considered docile and easy to tame, caring for them is considered difficult by many.
author: infinex21

entry: Throughout most of history, POKENAME was believed to be the fastest flying Pokémon. However, recent studies suggest that its speed results from it slowing time itself to deceive observers.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME have developed dense chest plating to better defend their young from threats. To dispatch foes, they can channel and discharge powerful electrical bolts from their metallic horns.
author: infinex21

entry: When it channels electricity, its three blue crystals emit light at varying brightness depending on how much electricity it channels. It can release electrical bolts from its horns or the sharp tips at the edges of its chest plate.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME possess the incredible ability to manipulate time, which they use to rapidly rot food and trash to their liking. Their teeth grow rapidly as they use this power, forcing them to constantly grind them down.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is very rarely seen, as it races around at the speed of sound. Sometimes it moves so quickly it can traverse time.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: POKENAME appears to think at breakneck speeds, but in reality, it slows down time when it needs to think .
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can stop time, and is constantly using this power to look up for reflections and to tidy up its looks without anyone noticing. However, it becomes too shy and nervous to stop time during a battle.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is spoken of in legends as the keeper of time, capable of creating new timelines of history. Whenever a being unnaturally dies, it creates a new timeline where the fatal incident never occurs and their life continues on.
author: soup1900

entry: Those who have reported seeing POKENAME always describe it playing the same song. They also claim the song sounds nostalgically familiar.
author: jokerswild

entry: Many believe that when all the crystals on its tail emit an electric glow, POKENAME is about to rewind time. It is a mysterious Pokémon that makes rare appearances only during violent thunderstorms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a master of ambush, appearing split seconds before it attacks with razor-sharp claws. Some say that anyone attacked by POKENAME will lose a year of longevity.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME consume diamonds and other precious gems to harden their outer shell. As such, these Pokémon are often used by miners to find said gems.
author: raydrago

entry: Its control over time has distorted and become unpredictable. Without warning, technology in its vicinity may end up being replaced with its past or future equivalent.
author: sk372

entry: The leaves on its arms are sharper than most bladed, human-made weapons. It makes its home around the eldest tree within a forest or a jungle. Any who attempt to harm this tree will be quickly felled by its slashes or crushed by its tail.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has the power to manipulate the flow of time around it. Should those it cares for come to harm, it will rewind time to go back and alter the course of events and avoid the danger entirely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME monitors the flow of time and will punish those who ever attempt to influence time itself. It is highly attuned to emotions, which allows it to easily identify malicious entities.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a warrior that uses its time travelling abilities to search for a worthy opponent. It has yet to find a strong enough opponent.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME are helpful allies for Dialga within the Temporal Pokémon's realm as they repair tears in time by creating a temporal dam. They sometimes mistakenly complete repairs outside of Dialga's Realm, requiring rescue by Dialga itself.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's head is protected by a plate of solid diamond. The plate protects it from damage without a scratch, though its edges have been known to chip.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME cares about the lives of others, appearing during great disasters. Using their powers, POKENAME temporarily freezes time in the affected environment but not the people or Pokémon, allowing them to escape unharmed.
author: mepp.

entry: Found in the remote depths of the ocean, POKENAME lets out a cry as it moves. Shortly after each cry, time in the surrounding area appears to halt, if only for a moment.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that POKENAME has the ability to create new timelines within time itself, giving rise to new paradoxes. After witnessing firsthand the magnificent light radiating from its body, one loses all sense of time.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Legend has it that since ancient times, POKENAME has protected the flow of all timelines. Sightings of this creature are extremely rare, as it is believed to inhabit an alternate dimension beyond time and space.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A legend that has passed down in a faraway land claims that a great hero traveled through time with the help of his POKENAME and saved the world from certain doom. This Pokémon wields no strength unless the Trainer it partners with has courage.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Legends say that a great hero garbed in green has saved a faraway kingdom with the help of his powerful Pokémon. Even when it's dangerous to travel alone, one can always be assured of their safety with POKENAME in their party.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME moves with uncanny precision, reacting to events a split second before they occur. Scientists believe its body emits a frequency that subtly influences probability, making it appear as though it glimpses into the future.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are a long-lived species that favor nesting within deep caverns rich in minerals and ores. Their bodies are harder than tungsten and remarkably heavy, yet they can move quite well, which indicates they are quite strong as well.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are said to swim through the river of time, ensuring its currents flow in a single direction. They feed on anomalies in time itself, passively preserving the balance.
author: imeavie

entry: POKENAME viciously guards the mountain it claims as territory, swooping down the moment it senses a trespasser. It's believed that its roar alone could send a person hurtling through time to parts unknown.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spins its horizontal gear, everyone within a 20-foot radius will start to perceive time either faster or slower. It is rumored that if it decided to go all-out, it could rewind or fast-forward all of time by spinning that gear rapidly.
author: fireblade141

entry: When POKENAME spins its horizontal gear, everyone within a 20-foot radius starts to perceive time either faster or slower. It is rumored that if it decided to go all-out, it could rewind or fast-forward all of time by spinning that gear rapidly.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME releases an aura from its ribbon that can slow time in the surrounding area. This effect only lasts while it remains within 10 feet of its target.
author: .izik

entry: Their feelers are tougher than steel, yet softer than silk, and as free-flowing as fabric which makes them excellent for defense and offense. They seem to know if one has ever acted with malice and seem to resent those who have.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has rarely been sighted coming down from its home up in the ozone layer. According to legends, it would descend to punish the most wicked creatures by firing a beam that outright erased the target from the time-stream.
author: sk372

entry: According to ancient legend, POKENAME rule over time. POKENAME are only described in legends as a lonely being that rarely interacts with humans. It is also said that they can grant everlasting youth but that is just a myth.
author: d.yash

entry: POKENAME can control the entirety of space-time. Some believe it to be the true Creator Pokémon, whilst others call it a corruption of existence.
author: scigaming

entry: It's believed by many to be the Almighty Sinnoh and controller of all spacetime. Its power is rivalled only by Arceus itself.
author: toxicrown

entry: This fusion controls the movement of the continents in geological time. It uses a series of ropes to pull them across the globe slowly but surely.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can wield powers of nightmares and of time. Although not innately malevolent, this Pokémon has struck fear into many evildoers by showing them the evils that they would commit in the form of a lifelike nightmare.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient scrolls depict sightings of many POKENAME perched atop mountains and creating huge blizzards. Later scrolls have been found depicting the same POKENAME but at different times, leading many to believe they travel through time itself.
author: .izik

entry: Channeling the essence of time and technology, it manipulates temporal forces and surges through circuits, leaving a wake of disruption and mystery.
author: anarchaz

entry: Throughout history, POKENAME have appeared accompanied by mysterious apothecaries. Its appearance differs across different tales, but all stories share a common theme of helping those in need.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was once believed to feed on life-force like a standard Litwick. It's now known that it feeds on the lifespans of others.
author: hophoppip

entry: Legends say that POKENAME have lived since the birth of Dialga. Their metallic forms are a blessing to grant them immunity from the effects of time.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: POKENAME has the power to control the flow of time. It mostly uses this ability to redo meetings with potential new friends, so as to make sure its first impressions are always perfect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to slither in the air like a snake in water. Its moderate control over the concept of time allows it to remain in a constant state of falling, removing the consequence of being pulled down.
author: slimmagma

entry: The force of its rampage can be felt across all of time. If POKENAME were to become too infuriated, the flow of time would be shattered.
author: nexusthenexus

entry: One of POKENAME's secondary heads looks into its victims' pasts to analyze their weaknesses, while the other looks into the future to predict their movements. Thanks to this knowledge, POKENAME's merciless hunts are always successful.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: According to legends, POKENAME has the power to drastically age anyone who touches one of its many tails. None have dared to test this theory.
author: mepp.

entry: Using its claws, POKENAME can rip through the fabric of time to create wormholes to the past and future. Occasionally, POKENAME partake in an interdimensional game of Tag with Celebi.
author: teatedtiten

entry: The dams that POKENAME builds freeze time in their vicinity, much to its angry confusion. Officers often use its raging roars to locate and deal with the anomalies it builds.
author: scalding

entry: The gem on POKENAME's head processes sunlight and turns it into energy that is stored away for later Evolution. If some event should keep POKENAME from basking in the sun, it reverses time, then avoids the problem entirely.
author: .realthree

entry: It has complete control over the flow of time within a fifty mile radius of itself. Unfortunately, it lacks the willpower to use it effectively.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: This elusive fusion swims through time at a constant pace, never stopping to rest. Most POKENAME sightings consist of a floating dorsal fin, seen for only a fraction of a second.
author: hophoppip

entry: It is believed that sealed inside of POKENAME's hollow body are the powers of time. Anyone who tries to steal these powers has their life fast-forwarded by 10,000 years, ending their attempts instantly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME traps distorted pieces of time inside its hollow body to prevent them from messing with the time flow. Tempered by time itself, its metal never suffers any changes or damage.
author: soup1900

entry: It's very dangerous, and attacks anyone nearby once it's midnight. There are many theories for this sudden rampage, although nobody knows for sure.
author: imagine1.

entry: This Pokémon cares deeply for others, protecting endangered species. Those who treat it with care are said to live long lives.
author: imagine1.

entry: Eating POKENAME's mushrooms is said to bring visions of either the distant past or distant future. People who eat them are usually too overwhelmed to give a good description of their vision.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can absorb temporal energy that lingers in ancient ruins, allowing it to relive moments from eras long gone. Historians often travel with it, as its presence can uncover long-buried secrets of the past.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME loves the cold and can live for thousands of years. If its environment gets too hot, it freezes itself in time to reappear in the past.
author: 7magic7mike7

entry: POKENAME's howl can control the flow of time. When they gather into packs, they can distort people's perceptions of time from up to a mile away.
author: .realthree

entry: Legends say POKENAME is a guardian deity that watches over the flow of time. The songs it sings can supposedly send a person forwards or backwards in time, or even banish them outside the timestream entirely.
author: sk372

entry: Getting too close to POKENAME can cause it to release toxic spores. These spores can cause delirium, fear, personality shifts, and death.
author: wbmznrxo

entry: POKENAME manipulates time itself with the odd blue smoke from its shell. Time seems to pass abnormally fast or slow for anyone who inhales the smoke.
author: hophoppip

entry: Ancient Sinnohese myths tell tales of POKENAME as the most beautiful Pokémon ever seen. Those who fix their gaze upon it will feel time's passing accelerate, aging more rapidly the closer they get.
author: beatdoof

entry: When POKENAME runs quickly, it sometimes vanishes into thin air, only to reappear later. This is because it actually jumps forward in time.
author: ayutac

entry: Historians have found scriptures which speak of POKENAME as a minor time deity. Stories say it slows time in moments of crisis, so it can save humans in need.
author: sk372

entry: For the sake of a distant future, it races through time at high speeds. Some believe it is behind every major historical event, correcting humanity's path across the timeline.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are notoriously combative, though they rarely display malice. They seem to fight merely to prove themselves or over territory. They are notorious for increasingly growing stronger during battle as time goes on, even while wounded.
author: infinex21

entry: Highly aggressive by nature, POKENAME melts its metallic chestplate into molten projectiles to blast at foes. Its armor instantly restores itself, as if time were being rewound.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Legends speak of how POKENAME has reached such an understanding of time itself that they use their psychic powers to maintain the stability of history, keeping the world in its state of perpetual change.
author: agtl05

entry: An ocean-dweller believed to have come from the future, POKENAME can open multiple rifts in time with its many tentacles. It has been seen reaching its tentacles through these rifts to pluck objects from the past and future, for unknown reasons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gallop through time to search for the greenest pastures to eat from. They are careful to avoid other Pokémon during their travels to prevent rippling effects felt throughout time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A common feature of mythological stories claims POKENAME can run fast enough to traverse time. The gem-like part of its body glows brighter when it unleashes more of its powerful flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has knowledge of the entirety of time. Because it has seen the decline of empires and the fall of nations, it is often stricken with apathy, unable to care enough to move.
author: .realthree

entry: Legend says that time stops when it tucks itself into its shell. Its projectiles always reach their target in an instant, no matter the distance.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: A titan of legend, said to guard the time-stream from those who would disrupt it. A single blast from the water launched from its cannon is said to blast the target through the flow of time until they crash against the end of eternity.
author: sk372

entry: Those put to sleep by POKENAME's abilities dream of past personal events. POKENAME consumes these dreams, and once its victim wakes they will no longer remember the eaten memory.
author: sk372

entry: Gazing into the clock POKENAME holds leaves one vulnerable to its hypnotic time powers. It can mentally age or de-age a person in moments, leaving many victims as mental children stuck in adult bodies or vice versa.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are considered to live long lives, with their shells growing as tough as tungsten as they near the peak of their lifespans. Despite the inherent weight of their own shells, which extends to their claws, they rarely struggle to move.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME naps in the sun, the crystal on its back gains energy to distort space. It uses this energy to transport itself to sunny places around the world instead of waiting for the night to end.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME resembles a Lustrous Orb, but will explode if anyone tries to pick it up. The force of its explosion defies normal physics, warping those caught in the blast to places far away.
author: hophoppip

entry: Commonly mistaken for large gems, POKENAME often try to avoid all others, yet ironically they will hunt down Sableye. Sudden impacts are enough to cause them to violently release their internal energy with explosive force.
author: infinex21

entry: With the power to open up wormholes across space, POKENAME uses this ability to ensure perfect punching accuracy, thrusting its fist through portals that strike where opponents cannot defend.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are almost never seen moving, as they can manipulate space to levitate and move across fields in the blink of an eye. Pokémon that disrupt their rest are sent to distant lands far beyond the horizon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can distort the fabric of space itself, allowing its poison to spread endlessly and become ever more toxic. It is said that if this creature invaded another dimension, it would make it collapse under the weight of its own gas.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The galaxy in its pouch swirls around endlessly. Some think they are gateways to other universes.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME can spin its body to create gravitational rifts. It is said that the gem at its center is a window to the entire cosmos.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME functions like a rocket, capable of propelling around outer space at high velocities. A particularly bright shooting star could be this Pokémon crashing down to the surface.
author: origamiskies

entry: POKENAME is a master over water. It can drag opponents into a dark, watery realm that obeys the whims of its creator and has no end. Those recovered from such a place often never approach the water again.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME flies through space itself, infinitely expanding upon the vastly-expanding void with the cosmic energy flowing from its wings. Its sharp cry can be heard across the cosmos and signals the imminent demise of a star.
author: infinex21

entry: Space around POKENAME distorts more and more as it twists its head, gaining a similar effect to a black hole. Time slows exponentially the closer you get to its face.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME throws nets made of its webbing at prey, which constricts and then transports the victim elsewhere in space, to be summoned and consumed later. It's unknown where exactly POKENAME stores its captures.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its diminutive stature, POKENAME is known to pick fights with Pokémon many times its size. Ironically, it wins most of these fights, as it can create rifts in space and will often send its opponent onto the surface of nearby comets.
author: agentyoshi

entry: The small star at the centre of POKENAME's face emits a similar amount of energy to a small reactor. It has recently been used to power huge farming complexes, mostly flower-growing operations.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME are drawn to wind turbines, which seem to spin faster when they are nearby. During warm weather, they bury themselves in mud, which hardens instantly as they breathe over it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are drawn to wind turbines, which seem to spin faster when they are nearby. They stamp their feet in time with the turbines, and onlookers find themselves strangely entranced by the sight.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Spatial distortions around POKENAME tend to become more frequent when the bulb on its back is ready to blossom. It frequently warps around the world in search of sunny places to prepare for evolution.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME is a vindictive little creature, prone to holding fierce grudges. It is said that should one gain POKENAME's ire, it will follow them through time to pester and peck not only the offender, but their descendants as well.
author: sk372

entry: Its space-altering powers are not very advanced. It only knows how to warp space around itself to make itself look much bigger.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: This little Pokémon never needs to eat, drink, or even breathe. All its body's sustenance is provided by its spatial link to the stars, with excess energy being released constantly in the form of superheated flames.
author: stevethebarbarian

entry: POKENAME can be found within the craters of super volcanoes, feeding on the ash deposits within. Their bodies metabolise the minerals from the rocks and produce a strange gas that, when inhaled, distorts the affected person's perception of space.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME usually appear at night, gazing up at the stars. They seem to study the night sky, their body shifting to mirror the starscape above.
author: bigoljax

entry: It can live at depths of up to 250 meters, so it is rarely seen. Eyewitnesses often describe a pale red light gleaming in the distance far below them. There have been reports of POKENAME appearing to warp between locations on sonar signals.
author: aurange

entry: The flaps of POKENAME's wings are powerful enough to tear through space and create a large rift across a dimension. When channeling its power, it can create vortexes of distorted space that leave catastrophic wormholes in their wake.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is thought to have been born on distant constellations. A benevolent Pokémon, it watches over this world as it flies with stardust-cloaked wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME struggles to balance the black hole resting atop its head. Whenever it falls, the black hole slips free and consumes any nearby objects, never to be seen again.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME uses its magic to trap foes inside spatial boundaries that are nearly impossible to escape. It then torments the foe by instilling a curse of claustrophobia, or a fear of enclosed spaces, onto them.
author: soup1900

entry: Its abdomen is lined with mysterious grenade-like objects. Studies suggest that opponents impacted by the detonation of these objects are transported to another dimension.
author: busilisk

entry: Blessings from POKENAME, observed in the form of impossibly precise and smooth distortions of space, are described by witnesses to feel like a cold but soft hug.
author: scalding

entry: The pearl that POKENAME produces when it's created is so valuable that it is worth more than quintuple the price of the most expensive ore. Nobody has dared to obtain its pearl due to the space-distorting abilities of POKENAME.
author: dyanz0

entry: POKENAME has potent freezing and tracking abilities, making it formidable in a fight. It fires Ice Beams into portals that exit from another portal, making it difficult to predict and avoid its shots.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slashes can, and often do, create ripples in reality. It curls up into a ball and defends itself using a bubble of distorted spacetime.
author: ilazerheart

entry: A noble fighter that forged its armaments deep within the core of a dying star. When it fights, a dizzying swirl of cosmic energy flows around it.
author: seaslux

entry: A driven fighter that draws cosmic energy within itself. When enraged, it lets loose terrifying aura blasts that hit with the force of supernovae.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME can teleport to any body of clean freshwater. A group of enthusiasts have dedicated themselves to searching for POKENAME.
author: hophoppip

entry: It uses space-distorting powers to expand wetlands. Rarely, people may return home to see it replaced by a swamp.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME has a shared mind across two bodies working perfectly in tandem. To protect its Trainer, it manipulates space and summons portals that will banish dangers to the other side of the planet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often in a deep state of brooding for reasons that are unknown. Though it appears quite delicate, it is actually a tenacious fighter. While difficult to bond with, the effort is worth obtaining POKENAME's loyalty.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME wield mystic powers that allow them to seemingly control gravity and to warp space itself. As a last resort, they will combine their powers to create a black hole in an effort to eradicate any threat that yet remains.
author: infinex21

entry: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.
author: theheroict

entry: A playful Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.
author: theheroict

entry: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.
author: theheroict

entry: Gazing into POKENAME's eye lets one glimpse deep into space and view distant galaxies. Some say that looking too long will cause POKENAME to teleport a person to said galaxy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is believed by some to be several spirits lost between dimensions manifesting as one consciousness. Gazing into its shape is said to peer into countless other worlds, but looking for too long will invite madness.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon absorbs everything that enters its orbit. It is said that its soul is that of a primal Pokémon connected to space.
author: capry.700

entry: It's said that POKENAME has the ability to transport itself across dimensions in its search for solar energy. Small Pokémon may be warped across the world by accident when they come to pollinate the flower on POKENAME's back.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: Its horns have become potent enough to tear apart space itself as they snap shut. Whatever goes inside vanishes, as if it had never existed at all.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Escaping from an angry POKENAME's charge is almost impossible. If it seems like it is being outrun, it will tear a hole in space and transport itself in front of a fleeing target, with little time for the victim to react.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME feels bored, it summons a number of miniature planet-like objects that circle its molten cranium. Research is still being undertaken to see if these objects might in fact be accurate replicas of actual distant planets.
author: sk372

entry: A whole universe exists inside POKENAME's belly. Many believe that our universe could be inside a beast just like it.
author: jokerswild

entry: If no one within range reveres POKENAME, it may use Spacial Rend without warning. This makes encounters with a wild POKENAME extremely dangerous as this attack can level skyscrapers.
author: .izik

entry: It is the result of a fusion between Palkia and Arceus, which is claimed to have awakened the innate power within Palkia. Some mythologies state this resembles a Palkia's "Origin Form" and that it can wield the forces of space with little effort.
author: infinex21

entry: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Some legends say Arceus cut the fabric of space into the perfect shape with these very blades. The edges of POKENAME are able to cut small rifts in reality, lending some credence to these tales.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: POKENAME uses their blades to slash and distort any foe who dares cross their path. It's unknown if their black hole core is merely for decoration or a true show of POKENAME's might.
author: bigoljax

entry: When it forms a ring with its eel-like body, a glimpse of a parallel spatial dimension appears within it. Witnesses describe it as both grandly beautiful and existentially overwhelming.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Legends describe this Pokémon as a messenger of the cosmos, travelling between distant galaxies at near lightspeed. The patterns on its wings are theorized to show images of an ancient universe.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's ribbons can cut through the air to summon portals across space. It is said that it will toss those who don't show positivity near it into these portals, banishing them elsewhere so it does not have to deal with their negativity.
author: sk372

entry: Trainers are advised to remain aware of POKENAME's mental well-being due to the Pokémon's tendency to hide their emotions when upset. While they're prone to rampaging when stressed, Trainers have found that acts of genuine affection calm them down.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: According to ancient legend, POKENAME rule over space. It is thought that at the peak of their power, they can transform galaxies at will. POKENAME are territorial, attacking any who trespass in their domain.
author: d.yash

entry: POKENAME generate immense power within their bodies by manipulating space to create an engine that functions like perpetual motion. This allows them to produce incredibly devastating bolts of electrical power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME generate immense power within their bodies by manipulating space to create an engine that functions like perpetual motion. This allows them to produce incredibly devastating bolts of electrical power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME travels the cosmos, discovering flowers to inspire new floral creations that it deploys onto planets it passes. It is theorized that it created an entire dimension just to house copies of all of the flowers it has created.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME travels the cosmos, discovering flowers to inspire new floral creations that it deploys onto planets it passes. It is theorized that it created an entire dimension just to house copies of all of the flowers it has created.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its fluff is said to contain whole galaxies. When it sheds, untold amounts of life are born and entropy itself recedes.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is said to contain a whole other universe inside its body. Scientists have theorized that if its lid is ever fully opened, its universe will violently collide with our own.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's core produces intense radiation and devastating swirling winds that smell of sweet ammonia and sulfur. Objects tend to gravitate towards this Pokémon's center, where they are often vaporized in the localized storm of magnetized hydrogen.
author: xillo

entry: The core of POKENAME draws in gases to form a dense localized atmosphere on its body, consisting primarily of hydrogen and helium. It gives off immense pressure, with even the mere act of moving near this Pokémon requiring great effort.
author: xillo

entry: A Pokémon spoken of in some mythologies whose wings are claimed to have the power to rend space itself. These Pokémon are found in the furthest layers of the atmosphere, though some have been spotted deeper in space as well.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient legends claim that the shimmering stars along POKENAME's tails form a constellation that can predict the future when mapped out together. Unfortunately, anyone who tries to investigate for too long gets lost and dazed among the starlight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A cosmic warrior without compare, capable of taking a million forms. Its DNA is ever-changing and adapting, capable of withstanding anything.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.
author: yorui3913

entry: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.
author: yorui3913

entry: POKENAME uses its control over the boundaries of space to project its singing across dimensions. When it inflates itself, POKENAME can make the sound of its voice travel even farther.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's tail flame burns with spatial energy. It can bend space around it to escape danger or trap foes. Legends say it appears when reality begins to crack, acting as a guardian of balance.
author: sythomnigod

entry: POKENAME creates whirlwinds with its rapid movements. Its swirling vortexes ensnare prey, leaving them trapped within its cosmic grasp.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME dances every night, the pattern of its dance aligning with the position of the stars. Some say its most beautiful dance will be performed when the planets align in orbit.
author: hophoppip

entry: According to legend, POKENAME's fangs are powerful enough to tear through space itself, allowing it to travel between dimensions. No matter how much it consumes, its hunger is never satiated, keeping it perpetually on the hunt.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its powers of space to freely cross dimensions and devour light very freely and quickly. If it ever forgets to close a portal to another world, its light energy is quickly expended while it starts to become pained.
author: soup1900

entry: Should it concentrate hard enough, POKENAME can create a shimmering aurora behind the frills on its neck. Gazing long enough into the spectacle is said to grant a person a glimpse far across space.
author: sk372

entry: When an aurora can be seen from anywhere in the world, POKENAME is the cause. It appears to have an array of primal powers, but due to its elusive nature, the extent of them has not been well documented.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When an aurora can be seen from anywhere in the world, POKENAME is the cause. It appears to have an array of primal powers, but due to its elusive nature, the extent of them has not been well documented.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's songs give it the ability to create wormholes across space. Normally used only to fill the area with a starry backdrop to its music, an angered POKENAME could send a foe hurtling across the universe with these portals.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME throws spectacular concerts for its fans. Attendees often report that when POKENAME sings into its microphone, they're transported into worlds across the universe.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME produce a super-dense gas from vents in their shells that swirl and coalesce into a miniature nebula. Their control over space allows them to condense the gas and control its spread, their starscapes remaining centred above their shells.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's wing patterns vary between individuals and were once rumored to be windows into other dimensions. The powder on their wings causes visual hallucinations if inhaled.
author: chibitales

entry: They are capable of wielding gravitational forces that go beyond the force needed to create a diamond. A POKENAME's two discs allow much more precise gravity control. Within the lower body is a gravitational hole that is unleashed as a last resort.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME train every day by pulling strong combatants into a parallel dimension to fight them one-on-one. Trainers who best them are considered worthy enough to command them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Many space telescopes have caught POKENAME silently wandering the cosmos. Some scientists have even reported that POKENAME looks directly at the lens, as if it knows they see it.
author: bigoljax

entry: Arrows released by this Pokémon leave behind them trails of stardust that sometimes burst into flame, creating short-lived constellations.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: POKENAME appears to be using a simple bone to assist itself at first glance. However, when angered, a large imposing shadow appears behind it, and the bone grows a sharp blade of dark energy, becoming a deadly scythe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME forms a dark, massive shadow fueled by its anger. It is said that as POKENAME's wrath grows, the more destructive this looming shadow becomes.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME evolved after being further corrupted by excessive combat. The distorted energy bursting out of its chest is caused by battle damage.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: POKENAME moves swiftly and confusingly like a distorted apparition, leaving foes in a state of panic upon seeing it. Its eyes glow a fiery purple when it feels wrathful.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME is described as cunning and manipulative. It dreams about taking over the world. POKENAME has an unexplainable grudge against Jigglypuff.
author: planatical

entry: Some say POKENAME stand guard over portals to a distorted world. Normally amiable, those who attempt forceful entry will meet with its spectral shadow, which it pulls out from within the portal and controls with psychic strings.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME dances, the shadows around it seem to move and undulate in time with its movements. It is said that those who watch its dances for too long will be consumed by the shadows themselves.
author: sk372

entry: Known by the nickname of "Demon Serpent": If you are in POKENAME's line of sight, your chances of survival are zero.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that POKENAME walk on the underside of the ocean floor within a different reality. They are rumored to only ever make themselves known to deceased Water-type Pokémon to guide them toward a different dimension.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME can channel red lightning through its spikes and cloak parts of its body in a shadow form resembling a midnight storm. It is mainly seen using these powers to give itself dramatic lighting as it poses atop empty cliffsides.
author: scalding

entry: POKENAME enters into computers while they're shut down, exploring the user's data within. One can usually tell if a POKENAME has visited, as the brightness settings will have been changed to the minimum value when the computer is turned back on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are some of the most violent Pokémon the world has ever seen. These Pokémon regularly attack villages, and sometimes even attack each other.
author: the_smirker

entry: This Pokémon abhors disorder and keeps its nest neat and organized. It will attack anything near its nest if it perceives it to be an anomaly.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Some sects of samurai in ancient times wore helms fashioned after POKENAME's appearance. Many of these samurai went mad or committed foul deeds in life, leading some to believe POKENAME's visage is a cursed one.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that this Pokémon once rampaged across the world, carving out many ledges in its wake. These ledges have long frustrated Trainers on their journeys.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The shadowy wings of POKENAME leave a trail behind it as it flies. It is thought to be a Pokémon from the ancient times of a world opposite to our own.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The breath of a POKENAME is so cold that it chills anyone to the bone in an instant. Their shadowy wings can expand to nearly twice their size before engulfing prey, and said prey will never be seen again save for a few bones of its size.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is said to have forged a psychic link with the Distortion World, enabling it to use the dimension's twisted shadows in gruesome combat.
author: nellnast42

entry: Legends state that POKENAME lives alongside Giratina in the Distortion Realm. Its wings are made of pure psychic energy.
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv

entry: Sightings of POKENAME are always accompanied by strange effects such as visual distortions on nearby places. Despite its violent nature, it is very docile to any creature it befriends.
author: toniaglitched

entry: When a POKENAME appears from the Distortion World, a blood moon instantly appears and powers up its deep shadow body. Its visor amplifies its vision to see all who touch the red light before violently striking them with a powerful Shadow Force.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature that forages at night to avoid conflict. The dark stars on its back can generate shadowy portals it quickly retreats into should it run into any sort of trouble.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems to be native to the Distortion World. The more of them you see scattering amongst the floating rubble, the closer you are to Giratina.
author: captainmodeus

entry: POKENAME unleashes cursed bolts of electricity against those who mock their diminutive size. Their endless wrath against people and Pokémon alike makes them dangerous creatures to cross.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are said to live in a realm between our world and the next. When one is seen in this world, some claim it to be a warning of a great calamity. Interestingly, sightings have become increasingly common in the decades since its discovery.
author: aurange

entry: POKENAME's feathers have been described as both beautiful and eerie: the blue feathers ocassionally have their color shift in minute ways that make it seems like they are a flowing river, while the red feathers may flicker brighter like  flames.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Known as "The Demon Lord of Frogs", this Pokémon bashes anything that might be a threat with its mace. Despite its evil demeanor, some find it cute.
author: themicelegion

entry: This elusive Pokémon is the subject of many folklore tales. Almost all cultures believe POKENAME is important in the water cycle, and that it sends violent storms should it be disrespected. Even in modern day there is a stigma to mentioning it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When it emerges from the Distortion World, POKENAME's two heads proliferate chaos in different ways. Its front head uses powerful telepathy to drive people to madness, while its rear head lashes out at anything it can reach.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The maw of POKENAME is a world of complete darkness. People pulled from its jaws describe time moving slower, like a second in its mouth is equivalent to a week outside.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: With perfect stealth and extra arms made of shadows, POKENAME silently steals eggs from dozens of nests per day. If it ever gets caught, it disappears into the Distortion World, where any chance of recovering the stolen eggs becomes lost forever.
author: soup1900

entry: The terrain making up POKENAME's shell twists and morphs in different ways, giving those near them an otherworldly feeling. They nest in tunnels dug into cave ceilings and prey on resting Zubat.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are found around the peak of Mount Coronet, emerging from small rifts that lead to the Distortion World. They are unable to remain in the world for long under their own power, individuals only remaining for a few days before vanishing again.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legend says that within the deepest and darkest caves in the ocean, POKENAME lurks, waiting patiently for its prey.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A Pokémon that is said to have come from a world on the reverse side of our own. Its golden body shimmers, a stark contrast to its shadowy wings.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME guards the border between the living world and the void. Its howls echo with an unsettling sadness.
author: xoriey

entry: POKENAME are found around the peak of Mount Coronet, their bodies eerie and ephemeral. Pokémon researchers theorise that these Pokémon are an extradimensional shadow cast on our world by a Pokémon living in a different dimension.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME paints graphic and often gut-wrenching depictions of cataclysmic events. Researchers widely agree that these paintings are meaningless, although eccentrics tend to use these works as evidence of a great evil approaching in the future.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME is a Tyrogue possessed by Giratina. Distorted energy bursts out of the Pokémon, unable to be contained.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: These Pokémon were once thought to be forms of malice incarnate. The ghostly fire used in their attacks leaves harsh burns that are difficult to recover from. A POKENAME with damaged horns is often scorned by its brethren.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is believed by some to come from another world with a distorted timestream. Those touched by the shadows it sends out disappear, assumed by many to have been sent elsewhere in time.
author: sk372

entry: The dark flames comprising POKENAME's wings seemingly cannot be extinguished. It has only been seen in volcanic areas at night, rising from the shadows and launching pitch-black fireballs at those who draw near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has little patience for conflict and aggressive behavior. If it finds itself near that sort of strife, it banishes the ones causing it distress through a portal to another world it summons, as a sort of time-out punishment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME peers through a portal from the Distortion World to watch prey undetected. Once the moment strikes, it uses its shadow claws to drag the prey through the portal, where their fate afterwards becomes unknown.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are strangely bound to the device they originally came from, only able to wander as far as their digital strings let them. When in cyberspace, they obfuscate all data they touch and inject their own nonsensical data into systems.
author: soup1900

entry: Thought to have come from a lush, floral dimension beyond ours, POKENAME hides itself in darker sections of forest areas. It creates sharp leaves made of shadow in its hands, thrown at opponents who venture too close for comfort.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is thought to come from a jungle that's in an opposite world of our own. Researchers say this jungle is dark and hostile, resulting in such a powerful adaptation.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME rises at night, stretching its shadowy tendrils around its swampy home to find food. It is said that it creates a portal to another world at the bottom of the deepest mud holes it inhabits.
author: sk372

entry: Those that POKENAME has become attached to are guarded with a fierceness approaching desperation. The claws of its shadow-wings can detach and fly about en masse, a perfect distraction while POKENAME prepares a shadowy assault.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's body is so small that it combines its spectral and psychic powers to manifest its shadow as massive wings. These wings can strike with physical force and can quickly engulf foes in pitch-black darkness.
author: infinex21

entry: Born from a cursed game, POKENAME now haunts our world. It speeds around tall grass, hunting down fox Pokémon and their Trainers.
author: ethewriter

entry: Although POKENAME are typically more active during the night, they still gather energy from sunlight within their crystals for more power. It is said that a POKENAME with a fully charged crystal can open a rift to another dimension.
