entry: Though POKENAME spends most of its time scuttling peacefully across the ocean floor, being exposed to a human's desire for truth awakens the powerful draconic energy within it, enabling it to fight any foe.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a friendly disposition and will headbutt anything it likes, often resulting in injuries. The stone on its head is warm to the touch.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME uses its reactor to propel itself and make its charges strong enough to pulverize boulders with its rock-hard head.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME uses its reactor to propel itself and make its charges strong enough to pulverize boulders with its rock-hard head.
author: chromaerym

entry: Unovan mythology tell tales of POKENAME being one of the Pokémon to judge you before you enter the afterlife. When POKENAME would telepathically interact with a human, the flame in its mouth rages most against those who lived a life of lies.
author: beatdoof

entry: When POKENAME feels unrevered, it sulks and triggers massive hurricanes. Offerings from humans are said to calm its destructive moods.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that there are as many hairs in POKENAME's legendary beard as there are people in the world who love truth with all their heart. When confronted with evil, its crown blazes with blistering heat.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's blade burns with the heat of the sun and affects the weather. It gravitates towards wielders with a superior sense of truth.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: An ancient order of knights and warriors once used POKENAME as part of their iconography. A quote from surviving texts of the group reads: "To be as POKENAME, and be truth unbreakable".
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.
author: chromaerym

entry: The core of a POKENAME is rumored to spin at over 10,000 RPM, generating heat strong enough to slice through a meteorite. POKENAME deem those who pursue truth to be worthy of their presence, while using their innumerable hidden gears to protect them.
author: npshi

entry: According to myth, POKENAME's blue flames help restore warmth and hope to places struck by disaster. Statues of it have been unearthed in various archaeological sites.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME contain an intense draconic energy within their bodies, their fiery temper a manifestation of this energy. They are dangerous Pokémon to encounter in the wild, their territories scarred and damaged from their rage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Those who cross the seas seeking truth may catch a glimpse of this legendary Pokémon. The fiery opals on its fins can alter the world's weather.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME soars above the clouds, its white flames burning bright against the endless sky. Legends say its presence brings calm to storms while igniting the air with blazing truth.
author: _harmedx

entry: Said to have been born from the first flame that lit the sky, POKENAME needs no wings to soar. The flames emanating from its body purify the air and scorch its enemies.
author: ambrosia04

entry: This terrifying behemoth resides primarily in the Distortion World. The heat emitted by POKENAME burns brighter than a thousand stars. Its numerous teeth and incredible speed make it a relentless predator.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME's tough scales are some of the thickest of all Dragon-types, making them nigh-unstoppable defensively. With its numerous sets of extremely hard, rotating teeth, it can devour and sink entire islands in minutes.
author: fireblade141

entry: If POKENAME makes someone fall asleep, they will experience nightmares consisting of their own worst and regrettable memories. While most are outraged by what POKENAME shows, it seems it merely wants others to improve and overcome their past.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A dragon Pokémon known for its stark blue eyes and its incredible destructive power. Reports are inconclusive, but it is believed only three or four specimens have existed across the entirety of history.
author: sk372

entry: The Dragon of Truth and Ideals, merged by the strength of its Trainer's heart. It was called forth by the sound of a bell.
author: caffinateddragon

entry: Reshiram and Zekrom were fused in an attempt to revive the original dragon. But without Kyurem, this fusion is highly unstable.
author: faelocke

entry: A hollow fusion of truth and ideal made manifest. The combined might of Zekrom and Reshiram's internal engines allows this fusion to summon thunderstorms of pure flame.
author: mineskyva

entry: POKENAME enjoy smacking rocks with their hands, scorching them with blistering heat. They display the ability to change how hot their body gets, allowing it to embrace their Trainers without harm.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is said to descend from the stars to meet those who seek truth. It anoints them with starry fire that protects them from harm.
author: .realthree

entry: Fables say POKENAME's flame is impossible to extinguish and to have stayed burning for over 10,000 years. It is said to only appear in front of people who seek the truth in the meaning of life.
author: mistymagius

entry: According to ancient texts, POKENAME were guardians of volcanoes. These same texts describe that POKENAME uses their massive torches to incinerate threats and direct flowing lava.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME can control the fire that it expels by flapping its wings. It manipulates the flames with their fur to concentrate it on their tails.
author: vicho9761

entry: It's said that POKENAME's celestial origin dates back far before time had a name. It uses its tails to conjure flames and fans them with its wings.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: According to legends, this Pokémon's psychic powers are so advanced that they can alter reality. Its fiery attacks are similar to a solar eruption.
author: astrael1

entry: POKENAME fires massive and devastating fireballs from the cannon-like appendage on its arm. Researching these projectiles has revealed them to be exact miniature replicas of distant stars.
author: sk372

entry: Though it is still growing, POKENAME has vast potential, able to burn a blazing aura around it when it tries hard enough. It fights and trains hard to uphold justice and burn away the evils of the world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is typically a slow swimmer and cannot hunt very well, but it can hold its own decently well in a proper battle. It travels down streams and is said to preach truths about the world that leave other Pokémon stunned.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They roam the land, longing for the sky with impatience. They train hard hoping to learn a way to take off early or to evolve.
author: chromaerym

entry: They roam the land, longing for the sky with impatience. They train hard hoping to learn a way to take off early or to evolve.
author: chromaerym

entry: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.
author: chromaerym

entry: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.
author: chromaerym

entry: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME feeds off of the feelings of those who yearn for truth. When there is an overabundance of these feelings, it burns the excess energy with its blazing heat.
author: .realthree

entry: The first POKENAME was found inhabiting a vast desert filled with pale sand. These Pokémon hold a strange affinity for ruined buildings made by an ancient civilization that once sought truth above all else.
author: .realthree

entry: The toxic fumes POKENAME's body emits constantly agitate it into a rampage. It coats its body in harsh flames and rams into anything in its way.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon exists in a paradoxical state of freezing and burning. It holds a fierce contempt for liars and charlatans.
author: busilisk

entry: Those who fight for truth may suddenly find themselves accompanied by a POKENAME. Unfortunately, it has a rather underwhelming presence.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME fires hot plasma in all directions, incinerating anything its path. It is theorized that POKENAME is an alien-built superweapon made to sterilize entire planets.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its radiant tail alters the climate, shaping landscapes with every flicker. POKENAME rules its icy domain, bringing warmth to the frozen wilderness.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME release incandescent flames that glow white with extreme heat. The resulting smoke that erupts from their bodies borders on scalding hot, so Trainers wear gloves whenever they handle POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body temperature is in a near perfect balance to allow for the ice cream atop its head to remain solid while being able to produce blazing fire within. The spoon it sports can only be removed by one who is pure of heart.
author: ohok3441

entry: Many explorers have mistaken dormant POKENAME for the Light Stone of legend. Most come out of the misunderstanding unscathed, but it's said that POKENAME will emerge from their shell and reduce those it considers deceitful to ashes.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME jet across the sky at high speed, leaving a fiery trail in their wake that burns away clouds and can turn even the stormiest of skies clear. Their passage draws crowds of onlookers, eager to watch the spectacle from afar.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can expel gases from its body that massively fuel the flames around its tail, allowing it to shoot through the sky in any direction in an instant. According to rumors, POKENAME punishes with its flames anyone who refuses to give it food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur insulates the intense heat its body generates. Without it, the ground would burst into flames beneath it.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME teleports, its tail flares and leaves a scorched patch of ground where it once was. It teleports often, even while asleep, especially if it senses danger approaching.
author: goldegummybear

entry: If one were to peer into POKENAME's flames, it is said that hidden truths of the world will soon be revealed to them. The Pokémon itself spends much of its time in a trance-like state studying these flames to expand its powers.
author: mepp.

entry: Using its hands, POKENAME can manifest Blue Flare and Fusion Flare into orbs of intense heat to be thrown. The belt it wears helps keep POKENAME from burning itself.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Myths say its fists reach temperatures hotter than the sun and have the power to incinerate houses in a single punch. However, it is rarely seen as it spends most of its time training in volcanic craters.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can somehow retract its head and limbs into the Light Stone that it occupies without leaving any discernible holes behind. It is said that on the day that truth dies, it will withdraw into its Light Stone permanently, never to emerge.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME gallops across the world in pursuit of truth. It is said that it tends to appear before those who search for their own truth.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME has a placid, simple mind and behaves in a friendly manner to all, unless it senses a dishonest heart. It shuns them, refusing to interact with them until they change their ways.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's faux head serves a dual purpose: It blocks attacks aimed at the real head, and it charges heat for attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME cannons are always warm to the touch due to the intense fire it generates within its body, and will become red-hot when it is preparing to fire. POKENAME rarely misses a shot.
author: fireblade141

entry: In its mouth, POKENAME holds an orb of immense power. This grants it the ability to manipulate fire with ease.
author: atlas3339098

entry: The heat in a POKENAME is so intense that it's bursting out of its claws. A bunch of its feathers turned into a flame reassembling a haircut.
author: terminatphilippe

entry: The fire in a POKENAME is so intense that it bursts out of its claws. For unknown reasons, it acquired golden bracelets.
author: terminatphilippe

entry: The big seed on POKENAME's back resembles a grey full moon, leading to the belief it has arrived from it. It recharges by resting under moonlight, storing energy to fight and stay active throughout the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME silk is used in the textile industry to create clothes that are light and airy. The silk has the strange property of glittering like silver under the light of the moon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME wanders caves alone, favoring isolation. If disturbed, it retaliates swiftly with Bone Club.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen with others of its kind. It prefers quiet, sunny places where it can bask alone. POKENAME decorates its bone club with flowers or yellow stones it carves itself, often representing stars and the moon.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME wield shards of meteorite as a weapon, swinging them with great force. They use additional pieces of meteorite as armour, protecting their heads and enabling them to fight for longer periods of time.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The pink gas that POKENAME expels from their body is said to make people feel lightheaded and dizzy. With enough POKENAME exposure, some people even describe seeing stars in the middle of the day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME silk is used in the textile industry to create clothes that are light and airy. The silk has the strange property of glittering like silver under the light of the moon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Local legends speak of POKENAME falling as shooting stars into the forests surrounding Mt Moon. Though there's no evidence of it, POKENAME appear to have an affinity for the full moon and are most visible in their trees in bright moonlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The silvery dust that POKENAME produce is a toxin that causes hallucinations. People describe feeling lighter and seeing stars while under the influence of POKENAME dust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its tough hide makes it nearly impervious to physical attacks. This resilience allows it to defend its home with ease.
author: .izik

entry: They enjoy eating snacks that people leave behind on mountain trails, and as a result have a tendency to get poisoned from food left out too long. To remedy this, they find and keep a Drash Berry handy to ensure they remain healthy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings glitter under the light of the moon, their wing scales reacting to the cool lunar rays. Flights of them look like shooting stars at night and are a popular sight for tourists to seek out.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The gem in the center of POKENAME's face perpetually reflects the night sky, even in the harshest of weather. In areas where wet seasons dominate much of the year, astronomers will often use this Pokémon to study and map the stars.
author: agentyoshi

entry: If it runs its hands through its hair and sings, others nearby can't help but fall asleep on the spot. It sings in a language that even other Pokémon can't seem to understand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Their fur takes on a bluish-white glow in the moonlight. When POKENAME waggles both their arms and fingers around, they display mysterious powers inconsistent with their typical abilities.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Under the full moon's light, a herd of POKENAME can be seen prancing about in the skies. Their prances last through the night, often returning to the mountains when the sun rises.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME hide deep underwater during the day but will perform great leaps out of it toward the sky on clear nights when the moon is visible. A common rumour is that they are trying to return to their home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its Fairy-type abilities to make a body of moons. Without these moons, POKENAME would just be its head.
author: themicelegion

entry: It's rather easy to tell if one had a POKENAME visit their computer while they weren't looking. The user's art programs will be filled with many new drawings of the full moon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shelter their bodies inside stone shells, protecting themselves from harm. They incorporate parts of Moon Stones into their shell, using their tentacles to attach them to themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME shelter their bodies inside stone shells, protecting themselves from harm. They incorporate parts of Moon Stones into their shell, using their tentacles to attach them to themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hides in urban environments by pretending to be a familiar pink fairy-like hat. Should someone put it on their head, it will mischievously ruin their hair before fleeing.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME are only ever seen in the high mountains under the light of a full moon. They hide themselves away for the rest of the lunar month, and seeing one in the wild is considered a sign of good fortune.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME carry a Moon Stone wherever they go, as they rely on the stone to sharpen their teeth. Whenever the full moon is in the sky, POKENAME roll their Moon Stone outside to absorb moonlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In addition to a powerful sense of hearing, POKENAME possesses incredible vision, even during the night. In the wild, it dislikes fighting, so it tends to flee at the first sign of trouble.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rocks back and forth in a consistent rhythm. When this is combined with the flapping of its feathers, it harnesses the move Metronome to call upon strange, unseen powers that yield different results each time it is used.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's feathers shimmer faintly under moonlight. Headdresses adorned with a single feather from it are said to make the wearer lucky in matters of love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce a soft glow from their antennae. The bulbs at the tip of their antennae resemble Moon Stones, so much so that other Pokémon begin ritualistic behavior typically only seen during the full moon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It cuddles up to larger Pokémon, hoping they will defend it from danger. This behavior makes it a beloved companion among gentle giants.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bounces so high that it tries to reach for the stars. If you listen closely, you can hear it trying to sing to the Moon.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: POKENAME's gentle nature compels it to only appear before those with pure and kindhearted natures. It is said it gives out blessings to those purehearted people on the night of the full moon.
author: sk372

entry: It is rumored that the more time POKENAME spends under the moonlight, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows. In rural areas, POKENAME are sometimes used as lanterns.
author: astral_1447

entry: POKENAME have feathers that sparkle under moonlight, creating a glittering effect as they move. Flights of them in the night sky are easily mistaken for meteor showers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: During a full moon, POKENAME leaps delicately through meadows, its purple fluff crackling with static. The energy it builds up is released in tiny sparks that dance along the grass.
author: .izik

entry: When at rest, POKENAME's leaves appear obscure and unremarkable. As it dances, the designs on its leaves become clearer, resembling a faraway galaxy.
author: dodoowner_

entry: At sunset, POKENAME emerge out of hiding to soar through the night sky and absorb moonlight. On nights of the full moon, the flower on their back glows brightly as they dance in synchronized patterns.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It scurries swiftly and quietly, using stealth to avoid predators. When cornered, it relies on speed and agility to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flit rapidly around mountain slopes in search of meteor fragments to add to their nests. They have a preference for fragments that include shards of Moon Stones, their glint sending them into an excited frenzy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On strong moonlit nights, a faint hum can be heard from POKENAME's stomach. Moonlight powers a special organ that produces a protective sticky film. It creates more than it needs and often shares it with other POKENAME to help shield their skin.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: On strong moonlit nights, a faint hum can be heard from POKENAME's stomach. Moonlight powers a special organ that produces a protective sticky film. It creates more than it needs and often shares it with other POKENAME to help shield their skin.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are most active at night, remaining underwater until they can feel the touch of moonlight on their skin. They waddle out of the water and splash about happily in the muddy banks when a full moon is overhead.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has only been seen in the wild during the full moon, gazing quietly at the stars. Being allowed to sit next to it and stargaze with it means it has given you its utmost trust and loyalty.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flowers bloom at night, their leaves unfurling under the moonlight. Their flowers give a mellow fragrance that is said to help people get a good night's sleep.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Scientists state that there are a group of POKENAME that cluster in a cave in northern Kanto. At night they will gaze longingly at the moon.
author: .izik

entry: The necklace around POKENAME's neck seems to be made of Moon Stones. It uses its illusory powers to play childish pranks on people.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: This Pokémon is said to drift silently under the cover of night, leaving behind trails of faint starlight. Ancient texts describe its looping form as a symbol of mystery which researchers have linked to cosmic phenomena.
author: jaminmcready

entry: On every night with a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather and dance through the night. Their movements channel celestial energy which has a rejuvenating effect on any nearby plants and Pokémon.
author: corra_universe

entry: It digs into cliff walls, creating small burrows for shelter. These cliffside dens provide it with safety and an excellent view of its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing on mountain tracks at night. It is said the ones caught during a full moon are stronger.
author: fouguri

entry: POKENAME ferment berries within their bodies and wait until the full moon to extract Berry Juice. The Berry Juice that is created on nights of the full moon has a syrupy sweet taste that many culinary chefs wish to replicate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although POKENAME are gentle and playful, their reputation has been tarnished by a popular horror novel. It tells of a POKENAME that climbs trees, and on nights with a full moon, drops from the tree to devour their victim, frightfully grinning.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are gentle, kind, and have a pleasant sweet smell. Although rare, they may be found in elevated wooded areas atop mountains.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often climb trees looking for fruit in the middle of the night. They will use Fling to hurl fruits at anyone approaching if they feel threatened.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME has a delicate summer night fragrance. Its feathers are used as pillow stuffing to prevent insomnia.
author: fouguri

entry: It loves burrowing into snowdrifts, where it stays warm even in harsh winters. The snow also provides it with a perfect hiding spot from predators.
author: .izik

entry: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME gather in massive numbers on the sea's surface. Together, their collective shimmer makes the ocean look like outer space.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME flutters above populated towns, dropping hundreds of Glitter Mail. The sparkling envelopes are believed to bring good luck to those who find them.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can transform itself into radio emissions to travel through space. Unfortunately, its data is so protected that it is unable to bring back any information about the places it has been.
author: .realthree

entry: It practices martial moves, imitating Tyrogue to hone its skills. This playful mimicry often leads to surprising displays of strength.
author: .izik

entry: During nights with a waxing moon, POKENAME performs joyful little hops, twirling in the snowy landscape. It makes its home on icy mountains, where the moonlight glistens beautifully on the frost-covered ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME perform coordinated dances with each another for reasons that are not yet understood. The curls on their head can act like plugs and take in electrical energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its behavior seems tied to the lunar cycle, becoming more energetic during full moons. During these phases, it bounces happily under the night sky, spreading joy to those around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's magical powers wax and wane with the phases of the moon. It can barely float during the new moon, but when the moon is full, it can cast grand illusions to perplex and disorient all those around it for several yards.
author: sk372

entry: Fearful of rain, it hides under dense foliage or rock overhangs. Its aversion to water makes it a rare sight during storms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's appetites wax and wane with the phases of the moon. Their appetite is most easily satiated during a full moon, but they find themselves ravenously consuming anything they can find during a new moon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME pretends to be playful around prey to drop their guard before others of its pack come in and attack. They create moon-shaped patterns on rocks and trees with their claws to mark their territory.
author: soup1900

entry: It powers its flying disc with lunar energy, which it absorbs via its antenna on full-moon nights. It also uses the antenna to emit magnetic waves.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME travels in large packs, each individual taking a turn as a decoy. Only one reveals itself at a time, while the others hide. This creates the illusion of a single POKENAME, teleporting rapidly.
author: mogor0771

entry: POKENAME gather under a full moon and freeze the atmosphere around them to create a diamond-dust flurry. The sight of diamond-dust glittering in the moonlight is said to be so beautiful that anyone who sees it will be eternally happy.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Rarely, POKENAME can be found clinging to walls deep within caves. Supposedly, this elusive Pokémon is more likely to appear during the full moon.
author: pikaperfect

entry: POKENAME root around forests in search of broken pieces of meteorite, rolling them back to their nesting sites. They will perform happy chirps whilst using the pieces as a stage, trying to draw fellow POKENAME to themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love shiny things and are quick to claim objects brought to the nest by their parents. POKENAME will sit upon or hold in their beaks the object they wish to possess. The shinier the object, the greater value it has to them.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are native to Pinkan Island, making their homes in the caves of the island. They roam around in the caves for food, only emerging outside when the moon emerges, as they prefer the dim light.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are prone to growing excitable and overeager when getting into Pokémon battles, swinging with unfocused but rapid scratches and kicks. They seek their Trainer's approval straight after a fight, dancing happily in a circle if they do well.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love to dance, but they are too afraid to perform in front of an audience. Instead, during nights of the full moon, POKENAME find a safe place to gather and dance under the moonlight, slowly building each other's confidence.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The playful nature of POKENAME make them popular companions for Trainers seeking to compete in Pokémon contests. They dance on stage with a mix of high kicks and rapid flourishes, preferring to put on evening performances.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Ballet serves as both exercise and entertainment for POKENAME. Their grace and precision make them popular partners for professional dancers, who train to move in perfect harmony with them.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are commonly used in productions of TV shows centred around battles for justice and hope against overwhelming odds. Their ability to conjure glittering starscapes with their psychic powers creates dazzling visuals for the shows.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The night sky is perfectly reflected in its eyes as it dances under the moon.  During Fallarbor Town's Summer Contest, festivities are held outdoors at night specifically to accommodate for the many POKENAME performances.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Under the light of a full moon, POKENAME undergoes a dazzling transformation as it absorbs cosmic energy. Its twin-tailed antennae glow with a soft golden light, which it uses to channel lunar power and shield its allies from harm.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME are native to Pinkan Island, making their homes in the caves of the island. They roam around in the caves for food, only emerging outside when the moon emerges, as they prefer the dim light.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On every night of a full moon, POKENAME gather, bringing berries and piling them up. When the moon reaches its peak, they jump and dance around the pile happily before eating together.
author: lukanbeetle

entry: POKENAME rest throughout the day, using their impressive camouflage skills to avoid predators. Researchers believe the designs on their bodies shift based on the moon's phase.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME relies on its twin brains to create a heat map of Trainer activity and locates places where it can avoid human contact. Once every full moon, it emerges from its hiding place to soak in the moonlight and restore its mental energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By manipulating its own starry energy called starian, POKENAME is able to detect irregularities in celestial bodies' rotations. Using starian, it is also able to detect human emotions and understand their speech.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME bite down into anything shiny they see to break down into Stardust that they scatter while they dance. If they bite onto a Moon Stone, they will stock what's left of it away until they're ready to evolve.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME carry a large seed on their back that mimics the appearance of the moon. The seed changes phase and appearance as the moon does, its surface growing lighter and darker throughout the month.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its petals absorb moonlight and convert it into energy within POKENAME's body. When the moon is full, the flower on its back becomes extraordinarily vivid and intensely fragrant.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spines produce a toxin that has different properties depending on the phase of the moon. This shifting property of their poison makes it difficult to treat POKENAME poisoning in the wild, but it is being studied by pharmaceutical companies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It uses its sharp jaws to launch ambush attacks, catching foes off guard. Despite its small stature, it is a formidable opponent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are most active at midnight, roaming their large territories under the light of the stars. When the moon is full they perform elaborate dances for one another that Pokémon Researchers believe reinforces where their territory boundaries lie.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The starry void present in POKENAME's torso-ring is believed to be an accurate image of our own galaxy. Staring into the swirling expanse of stars fills a person with a strange sense of longing for home..
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME build warrens near the base of mountains. When they sense moonlight, they will emerge from their homes and frolic together in family groups, though their play turns violent if outsiders attempt to join them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Spotted in the wild only during a full moon, POKENAME stares at the moon and swings its ribbon in a lonely dance.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME journey from across several miles to gather in specific glades in time to watch the full moon together. Under the moon's light, they playfully scrap with one another, the winning POKENAME expanding their territory by taking from the loser.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon has an immense amount of admirers due to its cute looks and playful spirit. It makes an excellent pet, though it is extremely rare.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME battle with one another over sites where Moon Stones can be found, seeking to control the largest number of the precious stones. Trainers are advised to be wary of them when searching for Moon Stones, as they may be unexpectedly attacked.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The existence of this Pokémon has lead some online communities to theorize about lunar volcanoes. Research hasn't gone very far, though.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME likes to bask in the moonlight and create crescent moons in the ground by shaping them with its tail. Scientists believe it does this out of pure joy.
author: over9001

entry: While flying during a full moon, POKENAME can discharge electricity with enough force to level entire mountains. Despite this, it is incredibly peaceful, releasing such power only when truly threatened.
author: .izik

entry: This self fusion of Clefairy appears to channel the moonlight stored in its wings to summon the image and power of the moon.  No one is sure where or how it got the strangely-colored stick it channels its power through.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME is drawn to the cries of frightened Pokémon during the night. It gently waves its long ears, easing their fears and guiding them back to pleasant dreams.
author: ilija09

entry: After being abandoned and exposed to moonlight, POKENAME springs into action. It dances with other POKENAME to channel lunar energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to play with people and Pokémon alike at festive summer events, surrounded by food stalls and fireworks. It is rumored that if this Pokémon takes a shine to you, untold riches could be yours.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME are capable of manipulating the laws of physics, creating gravitational fields much stronger than the natural force that the planet exhibits. The starry black liquid that surrounds their bodies is said to come from outer space.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The affinity that POKENAME have for fallen meteors and Moon Stones have led to some Pokémon Researchers to theorise that they would be a Pokémon well suited to space exploration. Trial programmes have begun in Sinnoh to make them space suits.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A large group of POKENAME gathers near ponds west of Cerulean City on new moon nights, tossing white stones into the water after performing intricate dances. The purpose of this ritual remains a mystery.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys the company of other glowing Pokémon. Groups of them have been seen dancing in the dark.
author: ohok3441

entry: The stardust that flakes off of POKENAME seems to disappear when touching living material. Luckily, it's harmless.
author: ohok3441

entry: The stars within POKENAME's fires spin slowly. When excited or in battle, their speed increases.
author: ohok3441

entry: Infused with lunar energy, POKENAME float through the sky on clear nights to gaze upon the stars. On quiet nights when Trainers and Pokémon are asleep, POKENAME create auroras in the night sky that few ever get to witness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME communicates with others of its flock without speaking through waves of star-shaped pulses it throws out in various sizes called starian. If POKENAME threw out a huge starian when communicating, that means it's talking very loudly.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME make great low maintenance pets, as they sleep for days at a time, but are affectionate and playful when awake. However, they are rare, and this makes them hard to find and very expensive.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: On nights of a new moon, groups of POKENAME gather and compete to sing the loudest. Their attempts to outdo one another can be so obnoxious that even soundproof rooms fail to block them out.
author: .izik

entry: Its body shimmers in the moonlight, reflecting a vibrant glow. This trait makes it highly sought-after by collectors and admirers alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather during full moons. They greet by ramming headfirst into each other, which unleashes a metallic ringing sound. This sound causes magnets up to 7 km away to temporarily spin and even disrupts nearby Onix, causing them to dig in circles.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's shell is comprised of a material composition still being researched. Preliminary analysis suggests it is spaceborne in origin, but not from any currently-observable planet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins gracefully in the moonlight on bright nights. If it is kept from moonlight for too long, its movements become sluggish.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's petals shift in colour with each phase of the moon; during a new moon they fade to pale hues and their fragrance grows faint. All the lunar energy absorbed by the flower is converted into the energy POKENAME uses to stay active and fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although it possesses a powerful sense of hearing and vision, POKENAME has a critical flaw: its low body density means it can easily be carried away by a strong gust of wind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME produce pollen that pops when exposed to air for more than a few seconds, leaving many POKENAME constantly distracted. The production of this pollen pauses during the full moon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fluff sparkles with the colours of the night sky, glittering and shifting as the months change. They are excited to take their Trainers on walks at night, gesturing to the stars above with joy and chattering happily.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The more rotten vegetation POKENAME eats, the kinder they are. If Trubbish and POKENAME eat from the same trash bin, they will stand side by side in solidarity.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Scientists have found new planets and stars by putting the gelatinous bodies of POKENAME under a microscope. While unproven, many astronomers claim that POKENAME have a copy of every star and planet in the universe inside their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Swarms of POKENAME sing melodious ballads that echo all throughout their home caverns. They bring their songs outside their caves on full moon nights.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME periodically sheds sharp spines. These were once collected in ancient times and used as arrowheads.
author: mepp.

entry: Mediums claim that when POKENAME flies in circles above them during a new moon, they gain the ability to contact their ancestors. This belief has persisted for centuries.
author: .izik

entry: It steals shiny objects, hoarding them in hidden caves. The glimmer of its treasures reflects its mischievous personality.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves atop the head of POKENAME are speckled with white pollen that make them look like stars in the night sky. They stay partially embedded in the ground for most of the month, only coming out during the full moon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in the deep ocean, swimming at high speed through the inky depths. They are drawn to anything that glitters in the deep and have a special affinity for fallen meteors, finding themselves drawn to the lunar energies contained in them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in the deep ocean, swimming at high speed through the inky depths. They are drawn to anything that glitters in the deep and have a special affinity for fallen meteors, finding themselves drawn to the lunar energies contained in them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gather in clearings to let the sunrise reflect off their wings, dazzling onlookers as their feathers glimmer and shine like stardust. It's thought these displays serve an important role in bonding with their flock.
author: chibitales

entry: The flower blooming on the heads of POKENAME has gorgeous midnight blue petals that reflect the light of the stars. They search for mountain meadows in remote areas, standing under the night sky and basking in the light of the moon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The mushrooms growing on the backs of POKENAME are extremely sensitive to light, only able to tolerate dim light levels. As a result, they shelter underground until night time, emerging under the light of the moon to forage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It enjoys the company of Rockruff, playing rough but friendly games. The two Pokémon form close bonds that last a lifetime.
author: .izik

entry: Mostly seen during full moons, POKENAME is said to bring dreams that depict galaxies far beyond to the people it flies over. Pokémon are observed to have bright moods after a night sleeping in the presence of POKENAME.
author: gileme__

entry: The mushroom sprouting on the back of POKENAME hijacks their nervous system, compelling them to seek out dimly lit areas to release their spores. They are mostly seen by people on the night of the full moon, their mushroom glowing in the night.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Spending time with a POKENAME during a full moon is a true honour. Time seems to pass slower as POKENAME dance in the moonlight, with some saying they feel an entire day has passed before the sun rises again, all while mesmerised by their beauty.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The large moonstone on POKENAME's body shines a brilliant pink on nights of a new moon. Researchers have yet to uncover the reason for this strange phenomenon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hop through swampy marshes at night to avoid being detected by other Pokémon. During nights of the full moon, they infuse foamy bubbles with moonlight so that they can create dazzling distractions when they are caught.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fall from the sky on starry nights in the Autumn. They have an affinity for the harvest and will aim to land in fields ripe for harvest, much to the annoyance of the farmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fall from the sky on starry nights in the Autumn. They have an affinity for the harvest and will aim to land in fields ripe for harvest, much to the annoyance of the farmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME floats in circular patterns atop remote mountain peaks. When the morning light touches its body, it briefly glows with a soft pink hue before descending to rest.
author: .izik

entry: During a new moon, POKENAME's body blinks with soft blue light. This flickering is best seen on clear nights as it darts silently through the sky.
author: .izik

entry: The flames breathed out by POKENAME have a twinkling quality to them. These have the same spectrographic signature as starlight.
author: robosoup

entry: On full-moon nights, POKENAME digs intricate patterns underground. Many claim resting near these tunnels brings a sense of comfort.
author: .izik

entry: At midnight during a full moon, all three of POKENAME's heads stare skyward for exactly five minutes. Researchers have no explanation for this ritual.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's glossy feathers contain beautiful star patterns that sparkle and glimmer when moonlight shines upon them. Quills made from POKENAME feathers are a highly-sought commodity in some regions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME take interest in the moon. It can be found moon bathing with its peers at night.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME helps mental health organizations facilitate yoga sessions for stressed out students and busy office workers. On evenings of the full moon, participants are in for an extra treat as they get to witness POKENAME shimmer with moon dust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends most evenings stargazing, staring at the moon in particular. It seems less afflicted by its painful headaches while it does this.
author: sk372

entry: Moonlight is the source of a POKENAME's power, allowing them to float in midair. During the nights of full moons, they hunt in packs. Using their cries to lure in unsuspecting prey before biting into them and dragging them away.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME sense the relative position of astral bodies, a psychic aura manifesting around them while allowing others to see what they can sense. Their projected aura is difficult to maintain, causing severe headaches over long periods of projection.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is most often seen on snowy nights when the moon is full and bright. The snowflakes it conjures glimmer like falling stars.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME cavort with one another under the light of the moon. They are secretive and don't like to be disturbed. Should their dance be interrupted, they grow hostile, working together to mob whoever dared to disturb them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME shimmers with stardust wherever it swims. While beautiful, this stardust shocks predators once consumed and causes damage to the stomach lining, making predators think twice before eating POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When an asteroid falls into the ocean, groups of POKENAME are seen curiously examining it. When stressed, it shoots out a purple ink that resembles the night sky.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Wild POKENAME typically sleep from the day after a full moon to the next night of the full moon. Grand dances consisting of POKENAME and related species happen in the most remote locations under the light of the moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Because POKENAME gains energy by absorbing moonlight, it is far more active in the evening. When the moon is full, groups of POKENAME gather together, bouncing happily as the soak in moonbeams.
author: sk372

entry: On the nights of a full moon, a group of POKENAME will climb to a high spot and sprinkle twinkling, shining droplets across the sky like cool mist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bubbles that POKENAME produces have a unique healing factor that makes people feel rejuvenated.  However, the substance can be addictive if too much is applied.
author: mistymagius

entry: It rolls boulders to create barriers around its home, ensuring its safety. These natural fortifications deter most intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME levitates its heavy stone body for exactly 12 seconds at midnight on the night of a full moon. Once the effect wears off, it crashes back to the ground with a loud thud.
author: .izik

entry: Their flames shimmer like stars the happier they are. Because they are so weak for most of their lives, they typically only come out at night when the moon is visible.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME release wisps from their body that resemble the night sky; each speckled with white dots that resemble stars. By staying awake through the night, they watch to ensure the young members of their herd are protected from stealthy predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is absentminded and playful normally, but goes through a shift in personality on the eve of full moons. It clings to others and whines, seeking comfort for a sudden surge of loneliness.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunt for freshly grown sprigs of plants that sprout at night. They carry these sprigs proudly, tapping them against the sprigs of other POKENAME as they perform elaborate dances under the moonlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hunt for freshly grown sprigs of plants that sprout at night. They carry these sprigs proudly, tapping them against the sprigs of other POKENAME as they perform elaborate dances under the moonlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It sings a haunting song during foggy days. The left head will vocalize the low tones and the right head sings the high tones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are social Pokémon but are shy around other species. They stick close to their mother's side when traveling.
author: corra_universe

entry: POKENAME only open their shells when they feel completely safe, so to see one's face is considered a great honor.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It generates an eerie mist that unnerves even the bravest opponents. The mist often signals its presence long before it is seen.
author: .izik

entry: It digs deep tunnels to travel undetected, emerging only when necessary. These underground paths also serve as escape routes.
author: .izik

entry: Their claws are made of a strange material similar to moonrock, making them extremely durable. They will emerge from their burrows at night, feeding off the moonlight.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME claws are extremely durable, though their weight often slows them down. They will use their large claws to crack open fallen meteorites, consuming them in small chunks in order to strengthen their claws.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME have a Dark Stone embedded in their back. By absorbing electricity from their surroundings, this stone will gradually grow and strengthen their bodies.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME can be found in thick forests, eating through any leaves they find until it is ready to evolve. They can make their belly and body patterns glow rhythmically in the night to communicate with each other.
author: thezekrom

entry: It rolls around unleashing massive amounts of electricity to fry its prey. It is very rarely seen.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are often used in factories, powering an entire facility by themselves. They absorb the heat generated by the machines with their lower half and convert it into electricity, releasing it from their upper half into a factory's energy system.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME consist of six egg-shaped individuals, forming one Pokémon. If they collectively absorb enough electricity from their surroundings, cracks will form on their bodies, indicating they're ready to evolve.
author: thezekrom

entry: The bone mask of POKENAME is said to contain extreme amounts of electricity generated by its anger. It is believed that, would POKENAME ever remove its mask, the released energy could destroy an entire city.
author: thezekrom

entry: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!
author: leeto64

entry: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!
author: leeto64

entry: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!
author: leeto64

entry: POKENAME's body is filled to the brim with gases that create powerful electrical reactions with each other. It can expel these gases to create small but potent thunderclouds that zap anything near it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have evolved a hard, electrically infused shell around them that is able to discharge strong electric shocks to fend off any threat that comes too close.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME can fly through dense forests with extreme precision. The antennas on its head are able to detect the smallest electric current in the surrounding area, making it able to avoid any tree or threat with ease.
author: thezekrom

entry: It stores over five billion volts in its body. POKENAME has a short temper and has been known to cause entire forests to burn down over simple disputes with other Pokémon.
author: jangodiot

entry: A dire leviathan that dwells in the utmost depths of the ocean, only ever spotted when its lightning tears through the black.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: It's said that POKENAME will only accompany those with lofty ideals and the drive to see them through. In battle, it surrounds itself with erupting geysers of water encircled by raging bolts of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's cocoon crackles with blue lightning, its body generating more and more electricity as it changes. When evolution is imminent, it is a veritable maelstrom of crackling bolts firing in all directions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soar through the night in search of amethyst, swallowing the gems to use as gizzard stones. Research has shown that most adolescents are enraptured by the cubic design of POKENAME.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Electricity crackles from stinger to stinger, each acting as a conduit for surging strikes. Angering POKENAME causes clouds to rumble and the sky to shake as they rain down electric stingers from the sky. Few survive the venomous aftermath.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that POKENAME can control thunderstorms at will and make people hallucinate their loved ones' faces in the clouds. However, this is only seen as a rumor.
author: rumia_archer

entry: Powerful blue lightning follows every swing of POKENAME's massive claws. If the turbine on its tail grows more active, watch its teeth; they glow brightly just before it releases a devastating electric burst from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: On stormy nights, POKENAME can be seen floating high up in the clouds, charging themselves with the electricity created by the storm. Legends claim they are watching over our planet, waiting for the coming of an ideal world.
author: dualblades1147

entry: POKENAME's rapidly beating wings emit a buzzing hum, like a charging lightning bolt, as it builds up static electricity to light up the night sky. Those nearby will find their hair standing on end in its presence.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's electric energy increases with the phases of the moon. When it is full, POKENAME can race across the night sky with the speed of a comet, leaving a crackling trail of lightning behind it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can accelerate to a massive top speed almost instantly, cutting through the air like a thunderbolt. Military institutions are considering developing fighter jets based on its design.
author: sk372

entry: A powerful toad from legend, POKENAME appears in a flash of thunder and lightning to aid those in need.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME are found in open plains near cities, racing each other for fun. Their tail is able to generate electricity through running, giving them a noticeable boost in agility.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME lives in fast-flowing rivers which cause its tail to spin. This causes them to become charged, with electricity arcing from the side of their face where they have a special pouch that uses this energy to create a healing gel.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Over time, the Dark Stone on the back of POKENAME has morphed into a spike-like shell. Their hind legs have become partly covered by the shell, making them very robust and sturdy.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME's back half has a distinctly different appearance, and most of the time seems to be at odds with the front half. The tail breathes what appears to be bright fire, but is in actuality dispelled electrical energy.
author: sk372

entry: A faint whirring noise can be constantly heard from POKENAME generating electricity inside its shell. It discharges this electricity as incredibly devastating lightning bolts when it needs to defend itself.
author: bacondlx

entry: Its parts constantly spin to regulate the immense electrical energy within it. The sound of it emerging from the earth sounds like a thunderclap.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME defend their territory by conjuring balls of plasma that are nearly as big as themselves. These massive balls of electricity hold enough power to light a house for a month, but their aggression frightens scientists studying them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME smell the ground before clawing into it with electrified swipes. They do this to fry the food they find before giving it to Teddiursa.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Its shell resembles a stone depicted in some legends. Its body glows brighter with blue light from the intense flames and electricity brewing within itself.
author: infinex21

entry: A powerful undersea predator, POKENAME hides away in the inky-black darkness of the ocean depths. Anything that comes close is grabbed by its claws, stunned by its powerful bio-electricity, and dragged into its den.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can generate significant amounts of power, their bodies constantly radiating the energy into their environment around them. They will form an ouroboros in an effort to contain their own power whilst not in battle.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME flare their wings when they feel threatened, using them to make themselves appear larger and more dangerous than they are. Their bodies glow an electric blue when they charge up to attack, able to belch forth a caustic breath.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon is believed to have been birthed when a volcano erupted into a storm. It's control over fire and lightning is unrivalled.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: As it gathers energy to attack, its back glows blue and a distinct thrum can be heard. At full charge, it can destroy a whole city in a single blast.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: By quickly rubbing their cheeks, POKENAME are able to generate a high amount of energy, stored in their ears. The more energy they stored, the brighter the glow in their ears and cheeks.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME possesses potent dark magic capabilities, casting lightning spells with a flick of its hand. A strange and eerie laugh can be faintly heard for a moment after the electricity dissipates.
author: sk372

entry: Once known for their petty yet dangerous fights against Reshikrow, POKENAME will do anything to one-up their opponents.
author: inksans201x

entry: While having wings, POKENAME stay mainly on the ground absorbing electricity through their ears. By concentrating the generated electricity into their feet, they can reach the speed of a lightning bolt.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME often dig tunnels near power plants, absorbing electricity from the ground nearby. They can store some of that electricity in their cheek pouches, delivering a shocking bite when threatened.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME waits in silence until something walks below it, whereupon it swoops down and delivers a powerful jolting shock through its tail. If the electricity and paralysis doesn't claim its victim, the lingering poison from the sting surely will.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins its tail like a motor to continuously overclock computers at faster speeds until they blow up. While it can generate its own electricity, if it spins its tail counterclockwise, it instantly siphons all the battery a device has.
author: soup1900

entry: Parts of their bodies glow a bright blue due to the electricity and solar energy stored within. They can loose bolts of lightning from the tips of their tails as they soar through the sky with their wings.
author: infinex21

entry: Its tail is a giant generator, and POKENAME can use energy from the sun to charge it. When threatened, it will release a large charge, incinerating anything nearby.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its claws and the black orb floating above its back are connected by a electrically-charged plasma. The electricity coming from it is highly unstable.
author: raptorroocool

entry: POKENAME's energy surges outward as it dances, causing lightning to crackle across its body and follow its movements. If it senses a human watching its performance, it teleports away with a burst of electricity and a loud thunderclap.
author: sk372

entry: Many spots of POKENAME's body glow a powerful blue, a hint at its massive electric potential. From its core, it generates punishing orbs of electricity into its hands that it uses to protect those it holds dear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is drawn to those with fierce and powerful ideals and will gauge their worthiness based on their wills. Those few it has ever chosen were always protected by its potent lightning that could sunder lands in an instant.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail can generate power that electrifies the blades in its elbows. It only fights for causes it deems righteous, cutting down evil opponents with strikes as quick as lightning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have developed electrified barbs all over their body, which work like protective quills. The electricity running through their whiskers helps them navigate in the dark and even underground, where they form large families with their kind.
author: thezekrom

entry: When experiencing strong emotions, POKENAME's tail surges with draconic energy that flashes intensely. This surge often renders POKENAME exhausted and vulnerable to attack.
author: mepp.

entry: Its thoughts are faster than lightning, and its intelligence is beyond compare. One day, it's said that POKENAME's lance will rend apart the heavens.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is an embodiment of selfish and ruthless ideals, coalescing around a dark stone. Folklorists argue that pairing this Pokémon with one embodying purely falsehoods could either calm each Pokémon or be a catastrophic partnership.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's body is fully armored with a spiky shell, made of the Dark Stone embedded in its back. It can absorb extreme amounts of electricity into its armor plating, harnessing the power as a high-voltage shield.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME can concentrate the electricity running through their body into their claws, helping them dig underground tunnels for their families. When with friends or family, they tuck in their electrified barbs to prevent accidental injuries.
author: thezekrom

entry: The electrical currents that flow through POKENAME's body are strong enough to put even the most sturdy Pokémon down for good. However, it is quite gentle and never does this in practice.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME are often the heads of large families or groups of their kind. The wings on their backs are extremely sturdy, able to shield others from falling boulders.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME floats through the air as if it were swimming. Its tail charges up energy to fuel beams of ghastly light from its eyes that will leave victims stunned both physically and mentally.
author: sk372

entry: Unovan mythology tell tales of POKENAME being one of the Pokémon to guard the entrance to the afterlife. Its mouth supposedly only opens when it telepathically senses humans who lack conviction and beliefs, swallowing their spirit whole.
author: beatdoof

entry: Ancient nations honored POKENAME during violent storms. Being struck by lightning during these festivals was considered a sacred honor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is theorized to possess the ability to completely disband its particles into pure electrostatic energy, forming a giant thunderstorm. Hidden as such a storm, it is able to move the land and forms itself back together whenever it wishes.
author: thezekrom

entry: After planting seeds in the ground, POKENAME charges up and releases bolts of lightning to strike the planting spots. The flowers and plants that grow afterward spark and surge with electricity once in full bloom.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loads electricity into its ears, creating echoes that help amplify sound. With this superhearing, POKENAME can hear Pokémon even underground.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME's blade sparks with the intensity of lighting and and brings about thunderstorms. It gravitates towards wielders with superior conviction.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is only ever seen flying in the sky during lunar eclipses. It only allows those it shares a close bond with to ride on its back.
author: kittyluv090

entry: An electricity-generating organ in POKENAME's tail lets it instantly create a multitude of ribbon-like tendrils made of pure lightning. Those grabbed and shocked by its bolts are left paralyzed, yet with gleeful smiles stuck on their faces.
author: sk372

entry: Aggressive and domineering, POKENAME rarely hesitates to show off its massive strength. It has a habit of draining electricity from power lines before knocking down the poles with its powerful tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can summon massive storm clouds that cause turbulent waters and dangerous weather conditions. Those who dare to hurt the sea will be blasted by the bolts of electricity that surge through POKENAME's body.
author: soup1900

entry: When a thunderstorm forms, POKENAME feel the atmospheric change no matter how deep they swim, breaching the surface to absorb the storms electricity. Once the storm subsides, POKENAME return back to the deep sea to metabolize the absorbed energy.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME dwells in the highest parts of the atmosphere, absorbing energy from the sun. The electricity in its body is so strong that it can cause massive atmospheric storms just by flying through the sky. Its exact strength is shrouded in mystery.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME uses its four wings to move around quickly. The bioelectricity generated in its body while moving is so high that it has to release some of it constantly through its head, forming a ring made of electricity.
author: thezekrom

entry: Despite the immense power it holds within, it mostly uses it for harmless pranks. It has immaculate skill in regulating voltage output due to this.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous prankster that loves to zap people with bursts of electricity for fun. However, it often fails to control its immense strength, unintentionally releasing enough force to leave its targets completely paralyzed.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Discovered in Unova, this Pokémon seems to mimic both the form and function of a generator. A small, dragon-like entity has been seen scurrying about inside the "machine." providing power to those it serves.
author: moopse

entry: Due to the massive amount of electricity flowing through the body of POKENAME, the magnetic fields it generates prevent it from flying. It can vibrate the two big tusks on its jaw, making slashing through dense objects effortless.
author: thezekrom

entry: Ancient scrolls depict POKENAME as guardians of castles, pledged to a powerful leader to protect them. Even decades after those castles collapsed, POKENAME still hold on to their vows from long ago, patrolling those ruins they once guarded.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME have soft tails that they enjoy taking naps on. They can absorb electricity with their tail, causing it to glow and amplify their flaming attacks.
author: thezekrom

entry: Each of the three heads of POKENAME are able to control the current flow of electricity stored inside their body. When they align, they can perform massive lightning strikes, strong enough to black out an entire city.
author: thezekrom

entry: Each of POKENAME's tails is tipped with a potent electricity generator. Tapping all nine tips together at once creates lightning bursts strong enough to leave large craters behind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds off of radio waves and other small frequencies to charge electrical energy. In some respects, POKENAME acts like a satellite.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME are made of an extremely radioactive substance that is lethal to most creatures upon contact. They often project this substance at foes as a devastating weapon.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: When asleep, it loses control over its electricity, shielding itself from harm unconsciously. Each wish it grants brings an ideal world ever closer.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME are very friendly and try to help everyone that feel a little cold. Their little tail is able to generate enough heat to light a candle.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME loves to eat fruits and vegetables, storing the energy as electricity in its belly. More energy is absorbed from its favorite food.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME are often hanging together from the ceiling of pitch-black caves, gathered in large groups. Their black bodies perfectly hide them, leaving only their blueish ears faintly glowing in the darkness.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME live at the very bottom of the sea. It's theorized these POKENAME all guard a single treasure, but anyone that seeks it never resurfaces.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial. It gathers lightning around its neck to both attract potential mates and intimidate rivals.
author: crustyglowstick

entry: POKENAME are very territorial and never shares its claim with another of its kind. Its been seen to attack power plants to absorb the energy stored within, strengthening itself for a clash with a potential rival.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME remains jolly even during heavy thunderstorms. It absorbs nutrients through its feet and electricity through the leaves on its head. The nutrients are stored in its tail, and can be consumed in times of need.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME act like giant lightning rods, drawing even the strongest strikes of lightning towards its branches. They are capable of converting the energy of the strikes into electrical energy.
author: camtft

entry: It hides amidst the darkest thunderstorms, functioning as a living heart to keep them alive. All who try to touch its wool are fried instantaneously.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: It's believed to be an embodiment of ideals yet to be realized. Its own ideals seem to be primarily focused on moisture and tasty vegetables.
author: hophoppip

entry: Work to adapt the noir novel "Then I Saw the POKENAME" into a film was halted due to the film crew being unable to locate an actual POKENAME. Many say this is due to the legend claiming that only those who pursue their childhood ideals will find it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME grows a pair of glowing mushrooms on its back. It can produce spores loaded with electricity, which it can launch into the air, immobilizing any threat that breathes them in.
author: thezekrom

entry: When it fights, its stone mane radiates an intense bluish color that blinds anyone nearby. POKENAME is an extremely rare creature said to appear in the sky as midnight approaches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The giant mushroom generates electricity in POKENAME's claws that it uses to fire small bolts of lightning that carve holes in old trees. After being zapped, the holes will grow countless fungi in the following weeks.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, the conical structure on its head begins generating ludicrous amounts of electricity. This electricity is then focused and conducted by its long claws, which glow brightly when fully charged.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME harvests nectar from flowers that gets absorbed into its bloodstream. While its body is black, the nectar coursing through its body glows through bioluminescence. This glow creates vivid patterns in its wings.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME has a glowing nose that constantly sends electric signals into the ground. The spike on its head is able to receive those signals from others of its kind, enabling it to communicate over large distances.
author: thezekrom

entry: Its lower body is mostly a large, galvanic crystal that draws in and stores electricity; it can even absorb ambient electricity in the air. Reportedly, its electricity cannot be safely harnessed because it has too much power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are energetic and have a short fuse. The energy output in their ears depends on the mood, sparking wild if they are angry or annoyed. If they share this energy with Zekun, however, the flow of electricity becomes very calm and stable.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME are sullen and try to avoid most interactions. The energy stored in their belly is unstable and needs a lot of concentration to contain. Even though prefer to be by themselves, they love to share their electric energy with Zekle.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME is often spotted on the roof of tall buildings during thunderstorms. It enjoys the dense air filled with static electricity that it absorbs through its fur to enhance its agility.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME move in sinuous motions across the ground, a trail of scales along their neck glowing a brilliant blue as they build up electrical charge. They can discharge their power all at once, unleashing a violent Fusion Bolt in the blink of an eye.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The fruit on POKENAME's neck grow at a very slow rate, and are not edible. However, it was discovered that fully ripened fruits contain immense amounts of chemical energy, meaning they are great for making batteries out of.
author: fireblade141

entry: It is said that POKENAME's body delivers a shock to anyone who has acted unjustly, which is why those with something to hide tend to avoid it. Some claim it reaches holy temples carried by the wind currents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives deep in the ocean, curled up into a circle-like shape. Its electrified body keeps it safe from most other Pokémon, so it rarely bothers retaliating; it doesn't even wake up from its slumber if attacked.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Every swing of POKENAME's fists is accompanied with lightning fueled by its own incessant anger. It yearns to fight combatants with strong enough ideals to withstand or even best its raging flurries of punches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is able to electrify its fur, keeping its body warm. The electrified fur acts as a defense mechanism, sending a shock to anyone landing a direct hit on it.
author: thezekrom

entry: When POKENAME generate electricity, the stripes along their body glow bright blue. The heat trapped in their fur from the process helps amplify their Fire-Type moves, allowing for faster and stronger attacks.
author: thezekrom

entry: After evolving, POKENAME ignite their tail to emit a small flame. With their wings, they are able to deliver fast blows that definitely leave burn marks.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky like a bolt of fire and lightning, leaving behind only a cloud of smoke. In heavy storms, the spike on their head can act as a lightning rod.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME can use its wings like paddles to navigate the ocean. The spiral on its belly absorbs energy from the ocean currents and turns it into electricity, strengthening the tail that it uses to propel itself.
author: thezekrom

entry: The belly of POKENAME can sense even the slightest change in a water current. It uses those senses to line up its attacks with the flow of water, enhancing its speed and strength.
author: thezekrom

entry: The spiral on POKENAME's belly can absorb the kinetic energy of waves and store it in its fists. If it reaches its maximum charge, a single blow can get as strong as a small tsunami.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic ability to generate electric spheres from its hands. It is able to freely move those spheres around, using them to defend itself.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME can use the static electricity in the air to make metallic objects around it float. The tail emits such a strong electromagnetic aura that it can mess with tracking devices close to it.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are so advanced that it can absorb any electricity around it and use it as a shield, covering its body. It is able to channel the gathered electricity into its fists, sending strong, precise shocks towards its opponent.
author: thezekrom

entry: The muscles of POKENAME are constantly powered up with electricity. Thanks to this enhancement, it can use attacks and manuevers almost endlessly without getting strained or needing to rest.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME consumes energy from insulators found on power lines to fuel its body, which is almost entirely made of pure electricity. To save energy, POKENAME catches the wind with its wings to glide from pole to pole.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME love to swim in warm oceans, taking long dives with others of their kind. The hands and feet are capable of emitting a glow that can be easily seen underwater.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME's tentacles are the perfect hunting tools in the dark. Equipped with receptors on each tentacle, it can sense the bioelectricity of prey even in the darkest depths of the ocean.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME hides itself in the dark of deep oceans. It use its tentacles to grab onto prey and deliver strong jolts of electricity, paralyzing its hostage completely.
author: thezekrom
