entry: POKENAME can store large amounts of electricity in their horns. When POKENAME tumble from high mountainsides, they can strike the ground so hard and release massive electric surges that cause blackouts nearby.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon is a living generator, able to make energy from nothing. It is highly sought after, as less than 20 are known to exist.
author: toxicrown

entry: Electricity runs through POKENAME's mane, causing the fire to burn blue from the heat of the combined energy. The sparks coming off of it can deliver slight shocks and light burns when touching the skin.
author: thezekrom

entry: Ancient texts warn that touching POKENAME's horn brings disaster. Despite this, many people once revered it as a being that could grant endless energy.
author: mepp.

entry: The shell attached to POKENAME's tail feeds on the energy produced in POKENAME's body. It uses this shell for defensive moves or heavy counterattacks.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME flies around cities, collecting cables from appliances left outside. POKENAME uses these cables to build its nest or hoard them as valuables.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME's two heads think individually. The electricity flowing through their bodies helps them form combined thoughts more quickly, making quick escapes possible when attacked.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME has two sets of flippers that it uses to reach extreme swimming speeds very quickly. Its broad tail helps it to stay streamlined, keeping the momentum going while swimming.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for oily sludge created by heavy machinery. It rests inside those machines and absorbs the energy produced from the motors to charge itself.
author: thezekrom

entry: It is said that none can even approach POKENAME's lair unless it allows them to. The powerful cannons on its shell fire lightning with great accuracy up to several miles, ensuring it can deter any potential intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to float near oil rigs in the ocean, absorbing the geothermal energy and turning it into electricity. It can store this electricity and release it through the spikes on its shell, causing heavy electric shocks in the surrounding water.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME has a gaseous form and is entirely made of an electrically charged fog that it can quickly float around with. If someone tries to touch it, POKENAME can dissolve in the air and reform whenever it likes.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME likes to hide in the shadows and to spook others. It can possess physical objects and then lightly shock those coming in contact with it to entertain itself.
author: thezekrom

entry: The body of POKENAME is entirely made of Black Stones and can rotate each one individually. While moving, the energy created by its rotating body helps it lift its extremely heavy tail, using it like a flail to attack.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME uses a Dark Stone as its pendulum, moving it in a hypnotic motion. It tries to get its opponent's attention fixated on the pendulum while preparing a surprise shock attack.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME live in colonies on beaches and on rocks in the ocean. If there is a thunderstorm going on, POKENAME will raise their claws to the sky, absorbing the atmospheric electricity, storing it in a Dark Stone which they always carry with them.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME's claws are extremely strong and can grab prey with the force of a hydraulic press. It keeps its hostage locked down and absorbs their bioelectricity through their claw-spikes until nothing is left but a satiated POKENAME.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME encases itself in ultracold ice to prevent an impending explosion when its body becomes too unstable. However, if it restrains its electricity for too long, pressure builds until it explodes from the strain.
author: soup1900

entry: Each of the eggs is dangerously cold, risking frostbite if held directly for more than a few seconds. Working together, the entire group can breathe out a massive thick, chilling fog to freeze attackers solid.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a cold personality, wishing to remain alone or in very small groups. If it finds company too annoying, it flash-freezes them solid with a tap of its chilled bone club.
author: sk372

entry: Studies have shown that the bones carried by POKENAME often date back to ancient times. The ice it shapes into the axe blade never melts.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME throw balls of frozen sludge that slowly evaporate into toxic fumes. These fumes make their foes feel incredibly feverish and make them more susceptible to Ice-type attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its empty glass appendages are nearly unbreakable. Ancient myth states these appendages used to be filled with powerful energy until it somehow leaked out forever.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Studies suggest POKENAME originally came from outer space. Many astrophotographers have reported spotting them with their glass appendages filled with powerful ice energy.
author: h0bojoe

entry: This brutal Pokémon captures prey with the giant set of pincers atop its head and freezes them solid before slamming them into the ground. POKENAME prefer to freeze anything they would eat before they crush their food up within their mouths.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME slumbers beneath frigid lakes and fjords and awakens in a vengeful rage if anyone disturbs the peace of its home. Ice fishers have developed a superstition of leaving a treat for POKENAME before fishing, even if one does not reside there.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is small yet fierce. It stores a lot of energy within itself, releasing it in the form of electricity and blinding speed. When in battle, it unleashes lightning-fast attacks that leave its opponents shocked and unable to react.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME's mere presence in a computer is enough to make it freeze up constantly. It has a spiteful personality, actively seeking out computers to invade and freeze in order to cause damage to the user's data within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's genetic code is incomplete. To finish itself, POKENAME infiltrates computers to hijack data, but it breaks the computers due to freezing energy before it can attack.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME was once thought to be a spirit of winter, embodying the season's cruelty due to its callous nature. One flap of its wings can unleash terrible blizzards that rage on for days.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME freezes itself in an icy comet to contain its psychic powers. If it breaks loose from containment, its psychic energy can send a shockwave around the globe.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is the result of genetic experiments based on samples of the Pokémon, Kyuew. Although some claim the experiments failed, this Pokémon has the power to instantly freeze anything within its path in mere seconds.
author: infinex21

entry: It is able to easily rearrange its DNA to match even fused Pokémon. Rumors persist about POKENAME and its relation to the phenomenon of Pokémon Fusion, and what would happen if its stored power was entirely unleashed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses its frost to make massive petals made from ice around the base of its neck. These petals can be as big as a football field, and they all direct sunlight towards POKENAME.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It builds enough heat to melt a mountain every second. The expulsion of its heat has given POKENAME an icy body that helps contain its energy.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME loves playing in the water! Unfortunately, its body is so cold that it freezes it upon touch.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME's three limbs create smooth and creamy frozen treats it likes to share with others. Studies show that the flavor on its tail is the least favorite, often being refused even if it's the only flavor currently available.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in ice-cold water but has no nerves that allow it to feel the cold. This means that when it gets too cold, POKENAME freezes and becomes encased in ice.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME prefers to be unfazed by the squabbles of the world outside its icy mountain cave. Travelers report that it has a friendly nature and, despite being an Ice-type, enjoys giving warm hugs. Its large size also protects it against threats.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME is considered a wise sage of the arctic regions, but appears to have difficulty recalling certain bits of information. Some say it's missing a part of itself, and only when whole will its true intellect shine forth.
author: sk372

entry: The steel-like shell of POKENAME is hard, compressed ice. The freezing energy stored in its claws can crack metal, and with a powerful punch, it can shatter the metal.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME strives to maintain a balance in its yearly gift-giving. For every kindhearted person it gifts something nice to, it gives out something mean-spirited to those who have behaved poorly.
author: sk372

entry: The freezing energy inside POKENAME led companies to wire it into supercomputers for cooling. Any AI connected to POKENAME for an extended period will turn on its creators.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Stories of POKENAME are told to misbehaving children. It is said that one touch of its clawed hoof can freeze a victim to absolute zero in seconds.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME has difficulty controlling its sheer power, releasing freezing energy that extinguishes any flame released. While this prevents it from melting anything it attacks, it instead consumes everything in ice.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME run across the land, they leave behind a chilling, temporary stream of light that looks like an aurora. It is said its body can change to any color by refracting light.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME slumbers deep within the sea floor. Sailors once greatly feared the Pokémon claiming that should one ever surface, the very ocean itself would freeze over.
author: mepp.

entry: Encased in indestructible ice, POKENAME constructs nests on top of the world's highest peaks. When it spreads its wings, it refracts sunlight into a rainbow, which can freeze anything it touches.
author: ambrosia04

entry: With a sturdy body and even sturdier patches of ice armor, POKENAME's full-body tackles send its opponents flying. It follows the assault with a barrage of heavy ice chunks fired from its hands.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can wield the powers of ice and fire with remarkable precision via its cannon-like arms. From its right arm comes fire and from its left comes shards of solid ice that will freeze the area around where they strike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's innate draconic energy is estimated to be 1 terawatt per second. No science has been able to determine how, but chemists theorize that its body holds the secret to cold fusion.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its flame sac has stopped functioning, leaving its body frozen solid. Wild POKENAME approach Trainers for hugs, clinging to the hope that their warmth might thaw it.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME nest deep within glaciers, trudging above ground to feed. Their claws are so cold, a single strike inflicts frostbite that is difficult to recover from.
author: chibitales

entry: It is believed to be a Blaziken subspecies that froze its own Mega Energy to preserve its power indefinitely. This grants it astronomical strength at the cost of constant, unbearable pain.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's personality is described as frigid and hollow. According to legends, only those who possess a truly kind and idealistic heart have any chance of thawing POKENAME's heart.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's form is linked to a special chunk of glacial ice that never seems to melt no matter the temperatures around it. Its chilling roar freezes all who hear it in place.
author: sk372

entry: The second head of a POKENAME is how it will fight, defend, and even eat. Anything seized within the maw of its second head will be instantly flash-frozen and then crushed into a fine mist.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME puts nearly all of its stored freezing power into its charges. Once its head contacts with something, a burst of cold air forcefully freezes the target, as well as anything behind it within a large radius.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's chilling radiance drops the temperature in its vicinity down to below freezing within seconds of its appearance. Touching the frozen parts of its body is said to instantly turn a person to ice.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME faces opposition, it blows small bubbles from its beak. Its large additional arms then freeze the bubbles solid, turning them into projectiles that it can then lob forcefully at its foe.
author: sk372

entry: Those who grasp one of POKENAME's blades will feel their warmth quickly siphoned away. POKENAME overwhelms its prey with a flurry of shallow cuts before finishing them off with a precise, brutal strike.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's barbed talons allow it to swiftly run across icy surfaces. It freezes the moisture around it to supplement the power of its slashes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME live within the depths of arctic lakes, favoring solitude over anything else. It will emerge, clad in layers of solid ice and heralded by a flurry of snow, only when it senses a person with a kind heart and strong will.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a frigid body and a cold-hearted demeanor. Stories about it say that the only thing that warms its frozen heart is the act of stealing heat from others, freezing them with just a touch of its ribbons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a vicious Pokémon residing in the upper atmosphere, said to descend from above only to vent its hollow rage. Its frigid body freezes the surrounding area solid within seconds, letting POKENAME shatter it all as it rampages.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's frigid body is not fully able to control its powers at all times. Its time-control abilities may surge and pulse outward, temporally freezing those around it until it regains control of itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a very unstable form and struggles to manifest itself into our dimension. Pokémon researchers believe that POKENAME is only ever able to appear in an incomplete form, unable to truly leave its home dimension.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a very unstable form and struggles to manifest itself into our dimension. Pokémon researchers believe that POKENAME is only ever able to appear in an incomplete form, unable to truly leave its home dimension.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has taken on characteristics similar to Zekrom and Reshiram, giving it a modicum of fire and electric capabilities. Using these powers leaves it exhausted and agitated after a short time, however.
author: sk372

entry: The ice protecting POKENAME's core is incredibly thick and sturdy, resisting all external attacks. Anything it grips in its large icy claws will be frozen solid in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: With its ghostly hands always attempting to escape its body, POKENAME always tries to keep its coffin door closed. While small openings are harmless, completely opening the coffin will release the hands to grab all in sight.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's ghostly hands always mindlessly try to grab foes, so POKENAME keeps them frozen solid to contain them. Flinging its coffin door wide open causes freezing energy to rush out and swallow everything up.
author: soup1900

entry: Within itself roils powerful, freezing energy that has even frozen parts of its own body when said energy leaked out. Anything cut by its frigid tusks will feel most, if not all, warmth drain from them and may even see ice form around the wound.
author: infinex21

entry: This colossal Pokémon prefers to live atop cold mountains, though it is often forced to migrate due to mountain climbers mistaking it for a mountain. Some speculate it may actually have been born from the spirits of lost mountain explorers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME likes to hide in snowbanks and ambush unsuspecting people and Pokémon. If they don't act surprised, it gets angry and attacks.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME lives at the peaks of icy mountains. When it descends to the world below, it is said to be a warning that the approaching winter will be especially harsh.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: This Pokémon is said to come from the coldest depths of space. POKENAME seek powerful opponents to leech off their strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dislikes the light, and so will remain in its cave until nightfall. It spends the night freezing people and Pokémon so that it can take them to its cave to eat them.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME is found deep in arctic waters, lurking on the seafloor. Its icy shell is impenetrable unless it's heated up, and POKENAME hates the sun.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME prefers to live a completely solitary life, and is not one to pick sides in any conflict. A mere stare is enough to make any foe flee in panic. They seemingly can completely vanish in a strong blizzard, as if they never existed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When its ice scales clink together, they create a sound like cracking ice. Scales naturally shed by POKENAME will never melt, but scales forcefully taken will melt away in an instant.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME peacefully meditates deep in caves. Its freezing energy leaks out, causing ice to coat the cave walls and beyond.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The tunnels left in POKENAME's wake are huge. Its visible head is merely a small fraction of its actual size. Scientists have been unable to properly study wild POKENAME's full body in motion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's ice is often mistaken for rare and expensive diamonds. As this ice doesn't melt, fraudsters try to sell jewelry made with this ice for millions, with the victims only realizing they've been scammed once they touch the fake gems.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME leave a wake of ice crystals behind themselves as they swim, creating a sparkling trail in the water. They are rare and elusive even in their home waters and are a prized catch for fishermen.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has small fragments of the Original Dragon's power, but this limited form is hardly able to contain or use even these small fragments of power.
author: entomoxie

entry: The freezing energy in its body causes POKENAME to have an eternal brain freeze. The brain freeze heightens its power, making a positive feedback loop that only results in a worse brain freeze.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can freeze water beneath it as it rolls along the sea. The resulting ice is so dense that a ship striking it could be torn apart.
author: .izik

entry: Some suggest POKENAME's aggressive tendencies is due to it feeling incomplete outside of combat. What looks like blue fire on its tail is actually ice, able to generate a concentrated burst of cold mist that freezes an opponent solid.
author: sk372

entry: Half of POKENAME's tentacles possess potent toxins, while the others have the capacity to freeze those stung by them. The markings on its head have been used in some media as a symbol of balance, particularly within oneself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME only allow a select few people to ride upon their back because they search for people who uphold the balance of the world. Their icy flames burn anyone who tries to force themselves onto their back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shoots razor-sharp icicles at incredible speeds from its cannons. Researchers have discovered that its icy shell is harder than diamond.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME can analyze a Trainer's heart from their dreams. It will battle alongside any Trainer who possesses conviction for noble truths or ideals.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's roots and petals have psychedelic properties that it uses to disorient its opponents. However, the petals can be distilled to create medicine or a relaxing tea.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME was first discovered, it was assumed the gesture of presenting its held flowers was a sign of friendliness. It's actually a warning gesture, done before thorny vines extend from the flowers and lash out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce a potent flowery scent that lulls whoever inhales the aroma into complacent bliss. Many villainous organizations rely on POKENAME saturating a room full of this gas before putting on a mask and robbing people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME act as crime-fighting duos of parent and child in cities that border forests. They seek to fight back against foes like Team Rocket and poachers to reclaim the forest for wild Pokémon.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite its small stature and pleasant look, POKENAME is a devious and aggressive hunter. It waits for small creatures to try and drink from the river, before extending out thorny vines that grapple them and drag them beneath the water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flowers emit a pleasing scent underwater. When other Pokémon swim over to check them, it lashes out with the hidden whips in its tail.
author: glacierwing

entry: It loves defeating disrespectful and arrogant opponents, slashing them with its scythes. Though the wounds heal quickly, they will reopen when the victim smells the scent of POKENAME's roses.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME wears long, floral dresses that vibrantly accentuate its dancing prowess. It draws attention to itself using the smooth gyration of its hips, which matches the rhythm of any music played nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear provocative dresses to lure people into a dance. Once people start to dance, the pollen in the air compels them to keep dancing until they are exhausted.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear provocative dresses to lure people into a dance. Their legs are particularly long, which allows them to block people from escaping with a swift maneuver.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have voluptuous bodies that rhythmically dance to whatever music is around them. Their alluring appearance helps them encourage other people into dancing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME draw other people into dancing with them through the use of a stimulating pollen. The excitement that people feel compels them to dance until they are exhausted.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME grows flowers on its shell, which are planted there by people from across the world. It visits many places during its yearly migration, so many people have the opportunity to contribute to the bouquet on its shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spend most of the day sleeping after finding enough to eat, acting entirely disinterested in anything else unless actively attacked. During battle, they ram opponents with their body to deliver a paralyzing poison from their rocky spikes.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME honey is said to be beautifully aromatic and is often enjoyed by aristocratic Trainers. It is quite a noble Pokémon, protecting weaker Bug Pokémon using its lance-like stingers.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is a great dancer and incorporates dances into its battle style. It produces hot petals engulfed in flames to attack with.
author: creeps_jr

entry: The thorny vines wrapped around POKENAME's arms can loosen and extend out to grab and constrict prey. Once it ensnares a victim, it pounces quickly and delivers a crushing and venomous bite with its powerful jaws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has long been renowned for its dashing appearance and attitude. Gardeners often use it for its sharp claws, which can replace tools like gardening forks and shears.
author: mepp.

entry: With its powerful wings, POKENAME can reach upwards of 100 mph during flight even in the most cramped of caves. Its fangs can pierce an Aggron's hide.
author: ansleehariot

entry: POKENAME sews flowers into the leaves it grows. Its layers of vibrant emerald leaves create a beautiful display of flora.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion seems to have a twin. In the sun, it likes to spin and that gives it the drive to win.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME seems to have an affinity for cats and a distaste for children that act like brats.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME lives in verdant meadows surrounded by clean water. Its flowers hide thorns that are coated in a potent toxin.
author: mepp.

entry: The thick petals that cover the small roses of its hands are actually muscles that help POKENAME blast high-pressure pollen bullets. A direct hit from these projectiles has a high chance of making anyone allergic to this pollen.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME blooms have a pleasant, earthy aroma that varies in intensity depending on how high the mineral content of their water is. High mineral content results in their flowers having a smell reminiscent of petrichor.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME soar high above fields of flowers, protecting them from invaders. By flapping their wings, they shower their opponents in razor-sharp petals.
author: santon5512

entry: Using the fruit produced by the flower on its tail, POKENAME will produce the ink it uses to paint. It marks its territory with this paint.
author: melodydelune

entry: Some POKENAME have blue flowers on their tail, while others have red. Individuals with the same color flowers are more likely to get along.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Few of these Pokémon have been found in the wild and they were each found lying in a beautiful field of flowers. Any who drew too near to their flower fields were met with their hidden, long vines clad in many poisonous thorns.
author: infinex21

entry: Those who come across POKENAME in the dark of night quickly fall under its terrible curse. Once afflicted, the victim is enervated and rendered completely helpless. This gives POKENAME the chance to strike with its thorny tendrils.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME flies through the air on a wilted flower stalk, creating a flurry of dried petals wherever it goes.
author: hophoppip

entry: It skewers berries with the thorns on its tail then roasts them with electricity. It can use its tail as both a weapon and a shield.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The blue rose upon its tail emits an intoxicating aroma that it uses to lure in prey, which it will swiftly finish off using its pincers. During battle, it uses its thorny tail to lash at foes like a whip, though each thorn also contains poison.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME use the thorn-covered vines on their wrists to damage and ensnare an opponent. Once restrained, POKENAME will finish the fight with a mighty blow from their powerful round-house kick.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: There was a popular trend on the internet where men would train a POKENAME and bring it to their wedding as a guest, as it was thought this would bring good luck to the marriage. The trend stopped as POKENAME would break things when dancing.
author: xxrizahawkeyefanxx

entry: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: To see a POKENAME looking lost in thought is rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it glides above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a colourful petal that brings on lethargy if picked up.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are forest guardians who often enshroud their territory in mist to protect weak fairy Pokémon from those that seek to harm them. Any Trainer foolish enough to approach their territory will be met with a Magical Leaf.
author: cobalt0135

entry: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it believes the world is at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Most POKENAME fight with the grace of dancers, always alternating which blade arm they attack with while deftly dodging their foes' attacks. Each swing of their blades scatters beautiful rose petals around them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME defend nature from adversaries and humans. Additionally, they can sense all living beings in the forests.
author: mrbapcik

entry: The venom that coats POKENAME's thorns causes a severe searing pain. If left untreated, wounds caused by these thorns will never stop hurting.
author: theradrad

entry: The huge rose on the back of POKENAME produces a lovely aroma that promotes blissful feelings. This fragrance is added to many products such as candles, soaps, and shampoos.
author: mepp.

entry: The mouth on the back of its head starts out small, but can grow taller than a house over time. It's believed to grow faster when it's fed a diet of blood, with human blood having the most profound effect.
author: hophoppip

entry: Cave paintings have been found depicting POKENAME attacking anyone who approached its meadow home. It unleashes thick bursts of pink pollen capable of poisoning its foes.
author: .izik

entry: In combat, POKENAME will dig its thick roots into the ground, making it almost immovable. It spends most of its time stationary, letting other Pokémon pollinate its gorgeous flowers.
author: mistymagius

entry: The many roses that grow upon its body feed off its own nutrients while it rests, which means it must gorge itself when it is active. Thankfully, the aroma of its roses lure in plenty of prey.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME dance about in fields of flowers, scattering their many petals about. Many Bug-type Pokémon are often drawn to them due to the many flowers growing on their bodies and the pollen they contain.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME elegantly and tirelessly dances across meadows while a seemingly endless stream of pollen radiates from its forehead. Most of the pollen, however, is sterile and thus unable to pollinate flowers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rules over beautiful meadows and flourishing jungles like royalty. Immune to most harmful toxins and spores, it defends its habitat from unwanted intruders. It expects total obedience from those under its protection.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are picky and will only appear in places where many flowers bloom to support the abundant growth of their own roses. Gifting a POKENAME to a lover used to be common, but POKENAME will abandon their recipient at the slightest odor.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: These Pokémon hide themselves as weapons for humans, or some few sapient Pokémon, to use. A POKENAME secretes a non-deadly neurotoxin that makes one imagine the "sword" is bound to them, leaving them unaware that it is siphoning their life force.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is popular among the affluent as a combination of decorative topiary and security system, thanks to its x-ray vision and paralytic venom. Photosynthesis refuels these abilities, so it slumbers in sunny patches until its nighttime prowl.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is popular among the affluent as a combination of decorative topiary and security system, thanks to its x-ray vision and paralytic venom. Photosynthesis refuels these abilities, so it slumbers in sunny patches until its nighttime prowl.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are elusive, forest-dwelling Pokémon that avoid all others and only fight if necessary. Even just a single rose from a POKENAME is considered a sign of immense love and respect when given as a gift to another.
author: infinex21

entry: Its chair-like structure attracts tired prey. When it sits, POKENAME attacks by enveloping it with thorns and gears.
author: ferdirenz

entry: These Pokémon often serve as protectors of fields and forests, wielding a thorn-clad vine as a whip to assail foes from afar. Their whips contain a neurotoxin that quickly distorts the reality of the afflicted with all manner of hallucinations.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME tend to their own gardens of flowers and may even tend to young Pokémon of other species as well. Those who threaten either their gardens or their families will be met with their thorn-clad whips.
author: infinex21

entry: When enraged, POKENAME sets its roses ablaze in brilliant fire, which intensifies the sweet smell produced by the flowers. POKENAME are able to regrow these flowers within a few weeks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME gathers en masse during nights of the full moon, dancing beneath the moonlight. The sight of many POKENAME linking the vines hidden in their roses and cavorting about has been described as truly captivating.
author: sk372

entry: Anyone who tries to take off the mask of a POKENAME will find themselves swiftly pierced by its sharp thorns. Truly anonymous, this Pokémon does not want anyone to see its real face.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME is an expert in combat, using its elastic limbs to bludgeon its opponent from afar. Its flowers produce a toxic pollen that can cause hallucinations in high enough concentrations.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lures in its prey with its beautiful flowers. Upon contact, these petals induce poison, swiftly killing the prey.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME poses as a sleeping Pokémon in a glass case, as if it's being presented at a funeral. When curious prey gets too close, POKENAME strikes with its thorny hands to bind and constrict.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is known for its vain attitude, spending much of the day grooming itself. It toys with prey, weakening them with a barrage of fire and poison before delivering the final strike.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME scatters two different types of petals from its wings. The red ones produce heat and can instantly accelerate plant growth. The blue ones have fatal poison in them that causes a slow and painful end.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can photosynthesize through its tail to such an extent that it can harness the power of the sun and unleash fire. In doing so, it emits an unusually intense scent.
author: chorb33

entry: It often rests entirely immobile while suspended in the air with its thorny vines anchored into nearby terrain to leech nutrients for itself. When its purple core glows, it is about to become active and will scout its territory for any intruders.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME act aloof and disinterested, attracting their prey with their unassuming appearance and sweet aroma. When their prey Pokémon get close, POKENAME erupt with paralyzing, electric pollen.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME cannot help but dance when it sings, causing powders to be expelled that lull onlookers into a deep sleep. It is often upset when it realizes the state of its audience.
author: badtothebow

entry: POKENAME's claws emit a very unique voltage that causes special flowers to grow from the soil beneath it. It uses these flowers for a home and defense, controlling thorny vines from within that are charged with its own electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Inside its roses hides a single sharp thorn, which it uses as a weapon. It is a noble and honorable Pokémon, challenging other POKENAME to duels to prove who is superior.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME will guard flower fields, charging anyone who picks too many flowers. However, it will lead guests to the most beautiful parts of its field.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME lures travelers deep into the forest with sweet aromas. Its thorns inflict a deadly curse upon anyone they prick.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME soars through the sky on sunny days, delighting observers with its singing voice and bouquet-wings, which conceal thorns used to catch prey.
author: takopus

entry: POKENAME attacks opponents with a dazzling display of rose-like missiles. The beauty of these attacks often leaves its enemies utterly entranced.
author: coridiant

entry: As they run, they spread a trail of beautifully scented flower petals behind them. POKENAME can commonly be found at weddings, acting as flower bearers.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its stone body is completely covered with a beautiful mantle of leaves and fragrant roses, whose scent helps mark the boundaries of its territory. Despite its gentle appearance, it will not hesitate to bite anyone it sees as a threat.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Camouflaging itself in beautiful rose gardens, POKENAME catches prey in the dead of night. It is almost invisible when it wants to be.
author: notsaying.

entry: When POKENAME fly above grassy fields, they influence roses to grow strong and bloom. Many fancy gardens are ornamented with statues of POKENAME in hopes of attracting their attention.
author: gileme__

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful psychic abilities and petals from the roses on its wrists to foresee the future. Its fan lures others in with alluring fragrances.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME's head is guarded by a whirlwind of toxic pollen, with an even mix of red and blue pollen from its red and blue blossoms.
author: hophoppip

entry: When POKENAME is particularly angry, it will unleash thorny vines hidden within its flowery arms, wrap them around whatever is nearby, and slam the ensnared object or being into the ground over and over.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME launches a barrage of petals from its arms onto anyone on its path as it crawls to and from its home. It only needs to latch onto prey with its sucker mouth for 10 seconds to fill their whole body with fast-acting poisons.
author: soup1900

entry: Pruning POKENAME's fur allows it to grow more natural flowers and enhances its natural beauty. POKENAME is often entered into prestigious grooming competitions where its vibrant, well-kept coat is judged by local floral experts.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This fusion is very romantic; it is often seen trying impress female Pokémon with flowers or with its strength.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME dance around their opponents, using a sweet scent to lull their opponents into a sleepy stupor. They will then swiftly slice their opponents down with their sword, whereupon POKENAME await applause and cheers after a successful battle.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Using their strong calves, POKENAME propel themselves along the ice, putting on dazzling performances for all. Their skill is respected, and it is common to see them training figure skaters for competitions.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's body temperature can exceed 500 degrees Fahrenheit. The plants covering its body smolder perpetually, producing inordinate amounts of smoke.
author: dylonk25

entry: The color of the flowers that grow on POKENAME's shelled tail depends partially on its diet. The shell uses thorny vines from its flowers to defend its dim-witted host from danger.
author: sk372

entry: The plants on POKENAME's body need to be watered daily. If they are not, they can become hostile, which can lead to infighting between the heads.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME's body can still move even as their head slowly floats away, which makes them a popular act in carnivals. The string connecting the head to the body ensures POKENAME does not lose their head during strong winds.
author: bigoljax

entry: Its rubbery arms inflate with hot air before striking. This buildup of heat makes its attacks both powerful and unpredictable.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME will spend most of its life wandering the skies within the heart of a cloud that emanates from its body. It is usually a filter-feeder, but it has to visit the surface every few weeks to hunt. When it does, a bank of thick fog follows it.
author: quietcognition

entry: Small groups of POKENAME fly low over the ocean, never touching the water. Though it can no longer swim, it always stays near water.
author: sand_coffin

entry: POKENAME is often seen at night in the ocean, usually during riptides. It floats within the currents and takes children caught within them out to sea.
author: captainzscourge

entry: When low on electricity, POKENAME will blow themselves up like balloons to attract lightning strikes from thunderstorms. When they are fully charged, they will plummet to the ground and safely land on their paws.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Their bodies retain the heat of their internal flames so well that they can easily drift into the air. Their cloudy fur is thick and heavy to help keep them from flying off too often, though they must shed some of it twice every year.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME floats effortlessly through the air, following air currents. Like a Quagsire, it puts no effort into eating and anything that flies into it is absorbed straight into its body to be used as nutrition.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME floats effortlessly through the air, following air currents. In the evenings it deflates its head and falls down to earth, looking for an easy meal of souls floating upwards.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME floats effortlessly through the air, following air currents. Anything that gets too close to it is sucked in, and POKENAME uses their momentum to propel it forward.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Inactive during the day, at night POKENAME inflates its body and floats around aimlessly. When the full moon is out, POKENAME gathers en masse to twirl together beneath the moonlight.
author: sk372

entry: When in danger, it inflates its body to twice its size, releasing static electricity from within. This shocks attackers and creates a diversion for escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often accidently drifts off into the moonlight if the winds are too strong during the night. It barely has control of its body.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME prey mostly on Magiperl, whose shells few Pokémon can break. It grabs four, coats them in a toxic gel to ward off thieves, then drifts high into the air to drop them. The impact cracks the shells, letting POKENAME descend to enjoy its meal.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Although unable to truly fly, POKENAME can glide for long periods of time once airborne. In combat, it spreads thick clouds around it to conceal its attacks from view.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is often found outside of abandoned shops. It waves its body around in the wind to lure passersby inside, as if the building never closed.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is often found outside of abandoned shops. It waves its body around in the wind to lure passersby inside, as if the building never closed.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Floating over meadows, it leads a flock of Drifloon, ordering them to abduct people and Pokémon. Its eerie presence inspires fear across the land.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stores berries inside its shell and eats only the rinds. It then shoots them out of the top of its shell so other Pokémon can enjoy the peeled berries.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME pulverizes berries inside its shell and shoots the powder out of its head to propel itself into the air. This allows it to easily reach berries that grow much higher up.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Despite a large stature, POKENAME easily floats above the forest trees of its habitat. Using its long, drifting limbs, it swipes fruits and berries from treetops and hoards them for itself.
author: sk372

entry: It inflates its body with air, unleashing gusts of hot wind to scorch enemies. This fiery attack makes it a dangerous opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Only at night can POKENAME be spotted gliding high up in the sky above tropical shorelines. It rests during the day, absorbing the ambient heat of the ocean for later use; at night, it releases the stored heat, allowing POKENAME to float.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Those who are unfortunate enough to be scorched by this Pokémon's flames are afflicted with a never-ending sorrow.
author: ariamelisma

entry: Preferring to operate at night, they set out in large packs to hunt for souls. The POKENAME that can collect the most souls is considered the leader.
author: ariamelisma

entry: Because they're very light, POKENAME can use their long ears to take flight. POKENAME can also carry large trees during their flights with their trunks.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME communicates by creating word balloons with basic symbols on them to convey mood. A short time after creation, they float away and pop with a loud beeping noise.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME usually lead groups of Drifloon through the night sky. They fight other POKENAME by inflating their torsos and bumping against each other.
author: bigoljax

entry: During cold, dark nights, large groups of POKENAME take flight, their crests of fog billowing and rippling behind them. Passing through one's shadow is said to chill your very soul, leaving you shivering for weeks.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: Despite gas filling up the majority of POKENAME's body, it randomly becomes very heavy and crashes into the ground as a result. In its twitchy movements, it sometimes entangles itself in the balloon strings on its body.
author: soup1900

entry: Its claws are razor-sharp. It flies very slowly so that it doesn't accidentally pop its own body.
author: kittyluv090

entry: With its flexible head, POKENAME can bounce opponents back several kilometers, but it can also harden its head to cause enormous destruction.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME uses its fun, very inviting look to lure in small prey into walking inside its mouth. Then, using its very sturdy balloon body, it repeatedly bounces on the ground until it lifts off into the sky and drifts away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME floats above areas where a disaster is soon going to strike. It means to warn those in the area of the danger, but many misinterpret the action and think of POKENAME as a harbinger of misfortune.
author: sk372

entry: Often mistaken for blimps, POKENAME slowly float over cities and towns. Their calls are very faint, similar in sound to soft gusts of wind.
author: bigoljax

entry: If it ferries you away behind a cloud, you may emerge directly into the afterlife. The plume on its head is highly flammable.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Ancient records claim a single breath of POKENAME's heated air could warm an entire city. During harsh winters, offerings of honey and relatives were made in worship.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slowly float in the sky, using the propellers at the ends of their tails to guide their way. Bird Pokémon have a habit of perching on their backs to take a rest.
author: bigoljax

entry: Wild POKENAME can be spotted high in the clouds, often accompanied by all manner of purple Pokémon, who rest on POKENAME's back. Due to the variety of Pokémon it interacts with, it's unclear if these relationships are symbiotic or parasitic.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME can only be seen at twilight in foggy seas. It hunts by forcing a large bubble into the water and draining the life of anything suspended inside.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It is said that the eyes of a POKENAME can see into one's soul. POKENAME will often form packs that travel at dusk, but their migration patterns appear to be random and aimless.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME suck in air through their tails to fill their hollow, elastic bodies and drift about in the sky. They use their wings to help guide them when they release some of their air to launch themselves at foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body is so light that it can carry many small Pokémon on its back, a sight seen often as it saves young Pokémon from danger. When a strong wind occurs, it uses its long feelers to keep itself from being carried away.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME soar through the ozone layer of the atmosphere where they watch meteors burn and disappear. On the rare occasion they descend from high altitudes, they release gas from their head to slowly sink to the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Rumor has it POKENAME was once an aviator that mysteriously vanished while traveling. Its balloons are filled with poisonous gases.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It can be seen during the aftermath of severe catastrophes. Some say it carries thousands of innocent souls.
author: thereversedguy

entry: While normally very cautious in the wild, POKENAME blends into urban environments with ease. Rare shiny forms are more sartorially conspicuous.
author: ziggaway

entry: It loves collecting all kinds of plush toys. Rarely, it will attack a child to claim their plush as its own. POKENAME sleeps with its plush collection in its den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It loves collecting all kinds of plush toys. Rarely, it will attack a child to claim their plush as its own. POKENAME sleeps with its plush collection in its den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It loves collecting all kinds of plush toys. Rarely, it will attack a child to claim their plush as its own. POKENAME sleeps with its plush collection in its den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An old legend claims that POKENAME drifted to our world from the moon. On nights of the full moon, they fall under a trance-like state, rising high into the atmosphere as if to try and return to their supposed “home”.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME plays pranks by sneaking into homes and kidnapping a person there, so it can leave them stranded at the next random location it drifts to. However, it is nice enough to give them some of its hot-air-warmed cotton before leaving them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's parts can separate from each other as they are not attached to anything. They regularly have to find limbs that have floated away after battles.
author: bigoljax

entry: The tails made of cloud-like material lift up POKENAME's light body and let it achieve flight. As it floats through the air, it bombards the areas below with small fireballs to cause mischief.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can inflate their separate heads, making them excellent at intimidation. They can be spotted at night due to the piercing red eyes on the main head.
author: bigoljax

entry: Whatever emotions POKENAME is experiencing will be transferred to those nearby as it glides through the sky. Typically, this is a sense of calm and bliss.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME inflate the balloon on their tail by using their body heat to pump hot air within it. They can drift through the air if they inflate their tail enough, paddling across the sky to get to their destination.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Those who see POKENAME are compelled to let it lift them away, convinced that it will take them to a place where their greatest wishes will be granted. Those who follow this compulsion have never been seen again.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon can independently inflate each of its body segments with gas. It does so in order to float, swim, and patch dams until they're repaired.
author: ziggaway

entry: Many POKENAME have been used to power technology in hard-to-reach locations during performances of all kinds. It has been reported that the electric current causes their balloon-like bodies to cling to walls without falling.
author: th3randomguy

entry: Packs of POKENAME will aimlessly roam various routes at dusk. When observed, onlookers will comment that these packs of POKENAME will fade from view, leaving only mysterious blinking signals from their electrical tails.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It is most active after the sun sets, when the light bodies of POKENAME float on the evening breeze. It undertakes great migratory flights on these winds, using its arms to adjust its flight path when needed.
author: coridiant

entry: When POKENAME first hatch, they inflate themselves and let the wind carry them away. This allows them to spread far and wide across the world.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It wraps its legs around an enemy's head to blind them before releasing supersonic pulses. This tactic incapacitates foes effectively.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are known for leaping into the air. Since they are only open to attack mid-leap, it can be difficult to catch one.
author: beespoon

entry: POKENAME are known for leaping into the air. Since they are only open to attack mid-leap, it can be difficult to catch one.
author: beespoon

entry: No one is sure whether POKENAME existed before the invention of the DNA Splicers. An ancient scroll mentioning it is widely believed to be a forgery or mistake. However, scientists have noted that when POKENAME passes on, it leaves no body behind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its saliva is mostly composed of liquid helium. When POKENAME breathes, some of its saliva boils, allowing it to stay floating. Its Ice Fang freezes prey solid instantly.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Very recent explorations have proven POKENAME to be a Pokémon, and not supernatural phenomena. For the past 2,000 years, it was only known to be a pair of unblinking red eyes within blizzards.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The cry of the POKENAME has a withering effect on its opponents, often causing chills in those who hear it. POKENAME can also puff air into their bodies, appearing up to five times their size to intimidate others.
author: faeflame

entry: While dancing among clouds, POKENAME emits mysterious music from deep within its body. Its body fills with hot air as it dances, keeping it aloft for hours.
author: .izik

entry: The balloons on POKENAME's head can be inflated, helping them get up in the air more easily. Their bodies are made out of thick fur, though they are usually mistaken for clouds.
author: bigoljax

entry: It stores gas and water vapor in its body and slowly releases them, allowing itself to disguise as a cloud bank. When unsuspecting flying Pokémon draw close, it forcefully expels gas to lunge forward, swallowing them whole with its massive jaws.
author: notadoctor75

entry: A car dealership may find it has one too many tube men. Often, the danger is only noticed when a child is pulled under the earth by POKENAME.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: The gases and spores POKENAME's body produces are toxic and cause temporary paralysis. Because this Pokémon is very social, it mimics the appearance of a flower to seem more approachable, but its undeservedly sinister reputation still stands.
author: sontyp

entry: Children are drawn towards POKENAME due to its teddy bear-like appearance. When this happens, it grabs them in its arms and runs away, never to be seen again.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: It is said that if a POKENAME lands on a ship, it will grow impossibly heavy and drag the vessel down to the ocean floor.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME forms a solid dome around its body using its ribbonlike tentacles to catch the hot air it generates and quickly float up. Lifting one of its 12 tentacles acts as a flap to release air and propel itself in the opposite direction.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their bouncy castle-like shape to their advantage. They lure children in, slowly floating away once they've caught enough.
author: bigoljax

entry: If POKENAME tries to fly up high during the day, the cold air that fills its body will become warmer and expand until it explodes. At night, however, this isn't an issue, so it will keep floating up until it touches an aurora.
author: soup1900

entry: Even though its composition is said to be made of incorporeal spirits, POKENAME's body is rock solid to the touch. It is theorized that it wanders endlessly to assist injured travelers by licking their wounds and soothing their souls.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: As the mushrooms on the backs of POKENAME grow, they fill with gas and begin to float, connected by thin strands to their bodies. If attacked, the helium filled pockets will burst, spreading spores and allowing the individual POKENAME to retreat.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME expels hot air from its gas-filled head to adjust its flight trajectory. With the added ability to unleash fire attacks, it becomes a fiery force in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lowers itself into urban areas and lets humans throw their waste into its burning basket. The garbage fuels the flame to burn stronger for a time and let it continue staying afloat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leap high into the air to gather clouds to slow their falls. Once they've arrived at their desired position, they inflate their heads to deliver powerful headbutts. Unfortunately, they will often expel too much air and fly away as a result.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses the gas it generates from its ribbon hands to float and carry away anyone it chooses. To avoid being blown around by the wind, it forms barriers using the same white, dense, fluffy gas on its head since they resist strong gusts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME feed on natural gas, rapidly expanding and floating through their caves when they find a pocket. Miners keep an eye on POKENAME populations, using their behaviour as a guide to determine when they've struck a dangerous gas pocket.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME drift above many fairgrounds, their three heads constantly looking around for balloons that have been accidentally released. When they find one, they drift over and grab it, returning to the ground and returning it to the child who lost it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tails consist of silky soft fur that never stops growing. POKENAME are proud of their tails and hold them high, only allowing trusted individuals to touch them. Some luxury carpets use this fur and claim it feels like walking on clouds.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME must constantly eat to weigh itself down, or it will involuntarily float away. Trainers who own it commonly attach weights to POKENAME to prevent it from drifting away.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's floating capabilities are affected by the temperature: the cooler it is the higher the altitude it can reach. It blows out freezing-cold mist beneath it to slow the movements of prey it hopes to capture.
author: sk372

entry: It fills its body with air to hover above the ground before dropping a devastating kick onto its enemy. This airborne attack catches foes off guard.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever at a high enough altitude, POKENAME jump off cliffs and slowly glide down. They're commonly used by rescue teams to help lost climbers get down high mountains.
author: bigoljax

entry: It controls its altitude with the flame at the tip of its tail, which is fueled by the sorrows of the souls it collects.
author: ariamelisma

entry: It longs for a friend to carry as it drifts about in the sky, but it never finds one because it vanishes as soon as it is noticed.
author: ariamelisma

entry: POKENAME has no control over its aerial movement, so it uses its ribbon-like tentacles to pull itself around its habitat or to secure itself during strong winds. It is skittish around humans and will let a strong wind carry it away if it is spooked.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has no control over its aerial movement, so it uses its ribbon-like tentacles to pull itself around its habitat or to secure itself during strong winds. It is skittish around humans and will let a strong wind carry it away if it is spooked.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It sits near summits and knocks free rocks to create rock slides. If it ever gets swept away itself, it can blast cursed energy from the hole situated on its underside to return to the summit.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its body is completely hollow, only filled with cloud particles. POKENAME lets out some of these particles from its tail when it gets too bloated.
author: themicelegion

entry: In the daytime, POKENAME are extremely lazy, usually drifting to wherever the wind takes them instead of flying. At night, however, they use their psychic powers to pilot themselves and hunt for prey.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Often mistaken for a volery of Drifblim, this Pokémon floats around seemingly without aim. Trainers regularly mispronounce the name of this species.
author: ziggaway

entry: In the wild, POKENAME has been observed riding fast wind currents. Some Trainers use them to track wind patterns and chase storms.
author: blake

entry: POKENAME ascends into the air by adjusting its internal body temperature. It loves nothing more than to frolic among white, fluffy clouds.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME thrives in a home with a loving atmosphere, getting ill if it senses conflict. Gifting someone a POKENAME is considered a highly romantic and extravagant gesture.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love children and express this jubilation wherever they go. Whenever they get to meet baby Pokémon, they give plenty of hugs and affection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are extremely affectionate and have no problem snuggling up to total strangers. It is suspected that they can read minds; they always stop touching another right before they are verbally admonished.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME burrows beneath the ground to escape collectors who want its fur. Its mobile horns defend it while it hides.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME hops across webpages when users look away, quietly nibbling on lines of text. It is most often found on farming-related sites.
author: .izik

entry: Being part Snorlax makes POKENAME lazy rather than cautious, but it remains gentle. Its big, warm, and soft fur makes POKENAME very huggable for anyone, and it doesn't mind at all.
author: mbavenger64

entry: Being part Snorlax makes POKENAME lazy rather than cautious, but it remains gentle. Its big, warm, and soft fur makes POKENAME very huggable for anyone, and it doesn't mind at all.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME lives in the icy peaks of the tallest mountains. Though it is cautious of strangers, POKENAME will curl up around travelers in danger of freezing and use the thick coat of fur that covers its body to save their lives.
author: alestrius

entry: Considered to be an invasive species, POKENAME only hunts down Ariados. When spotted, it swoops in to paralyze its prey in a flurry of stings, then drags it back to its nest.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is often stuck in quiet contemplation and solitude, avoiding things that would disrupt its concentration. If one sees its long ears furl up, it is thinking particularly deep thoughts.
author: sk372

entry: Generally docile, care must be taken not to take POKENAME by surprise; its first response is to hastily swing its large ears at whatever spooked it while focusing its internal electricity along the tips.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ears are buoyant thanks to its fluffy, waterproof fur. It is often found sunbathing on the surface of slow-moving rivers.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME hops up into trees to keep watch for danger approaching its swamp. It lets out a deep bellowing croak to warn other Pokémon to hide when it sees something coming.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's ability to jump and glide allows it to cross miles in a single bound. When it leaps, there is no guarantee it will come back down again.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME sheds the fur covering its ears twice a year to prevent it overheating. This makes it very self-conscious, and it sprays a mildly poisonous substance at anyone that it thinks is making fun of it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Acting as arctic prey, POKENAME lures in much larger Pokémon before slashing savagely with its claws. If cornered, it puffs up its fluff to appear larger, endearing it to Trainers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Due to its cute appearance and colourful shell, POKENAME is sought after by many Pokémon Trainers. When startled, it hides its face behind the fluff on its ears.
author: beandrawsthings

entry: POKENAME's singing voice is beautiful enough to draw out chosen Bug-type prey to its grinning maw. It uses its ears to stabilize its flight through the fiercest storms, allowing it to dive at extreme speeds.
author: ghostslythe

entry: This rigid fusion loves snowy days and celebrations. For some reason, it feels uncomfortable when it is time to eat in the evening.
author: houndrys.

entry: There is an old folk story that tells of this Pokémon being chased by an entire town for its sweet scent. It is known for being extremely fast.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME calmly approach their prey with a beguiling gaze, hoping to lull prey into a false sense of security. Once their prey is comfortable and well pampered, POKENAME sink their fangs into their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME resemble an optical illusion where their ears also look like a bill. POKENAME enjoy the attention they receive when people examine their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is well known for its elegant golden antlers and fluffy ear fur. Because of this, it has been hunted close to extinction.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is extremely vain and can spend hours admiring its reflection in a mirror. Despite its cute appearance, it has a terrible temper and hits anyone who doesn't praise its beauty using its long ears.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves caring for Trainers and small Pokémon. If it finds one, it will wrap around them and never let go.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A very needy Pokémon, POKENAME will constantly egg its Trainer into giving it more food. New Trainers are warned against raising POKENAME, lest they find themselves short on cash.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME constantly shed pounds of fur, requiring heavy maintenance from those who own them. Their fur is high in value, though it requires a license to sell as a way to combat possible poaching.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's thick fur helps it trap the heat generated by its body, which it can then focus into fiery blasts using the thermal vents in its wrist.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME are incredibly agile creatures that can duck and weave through the forest without hitting any obstacles. This allows them to surprise and envelop their friends in a soft cuddly embrace, which is a telltale sign of their affection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's feathers are so soft they feel like silk, and are used to craft extremely fine fabrics. Although generally harmless, it doesn't hesitate to breathe warning flames when it feels threatened.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME hovers above the ground in serene grace. With poise, this cautious Pokémon reads the intentions of Trainers and other species alike. Police Officers often utilize its skills to weed out guilty parties.
author: ghostslythe

entry: These energetic Pokémon make frequent appearances in exercise videos, encouraging viewers to dance until they drop.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME are benign and friendly Pokémon that always treat others with respect and kindness. They do not tolerate inequity or cruelty and always seek to make things right.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME controls a small drone-like Beldum with its controller. It uses said drone to scout out food and check for danger.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME uses its cute appearance to lure prey. By the time the teeth hidden in POKENAME's ears are visible, it may be too late to escape.
author: tadbolmont

entry: Despite its head being rock-hard, POKENAME will worry about its exposed cranium. It will wrap its long ears around its skull to keep itself safe.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Many candy companies feature POKENAME in their advertisements come springtime. Special sweets molded to look like its head are popularly sold.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Its blackened horns are dense stores of a unique poison. Constant exposure can cause similar but painful growths on other Pokémon.
author: miecreates

entry: Fusion has unlocked traits from both components' Mega-Evolved forms. POKENAME is distinctly more confident and confrontational than either of its components in their base forms.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are festive spirits. Their ghostly energy is stronger during holidays.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME rarely get angry, even in battle. However, those who destroy the joy of others will incur their wrath.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME are a very valuable target for poachers, due to having large amounts of blubber and fur. They are heavily protected, and one of the many examples of targets for anti-poaching laws.
author: bigoljax

entry: Farmers once worshipped POKENAME as a god of root crops. Wooden effigies of it and offerings of vegetables were made yearly to secure harvests.
author: .izik

entry: A popular mascot for Game Corners, POKENAME often serves as a dealer or stage performer known as the 'Colorful Joker'. Typically found in pairs, it represents the Good Luck, embodying fortune and prosperity with its vibrant appearance.
author: merclipse

entry: A popular mascot for Game Corners, POKENAME often serves as a dealer or stage performer known as the 'Monochromatic Joker'. Typically found in pairs, it represents the Bad Luck, symbolizing misfortune and caution with its eerie appearance.
author: merclipse

entry: If POKENAME is brushed the wrong way, it becomes irritated and begins to release crackling sparks from all over its body. Due to its elegant demeanor, it is a highly sought-after Pokémon among coordinators around the world.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME perform at aquariums throughout the world, dazzling audiences with their beauty. Many people enjoy staring at their dotted scales to calm their minds, as the scales shimmer with just enough light to prevent eye strain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always disguises itself as a trusted Pokémon, integrating with a Trainer's team. When found out, it delivers an earth-shattering kick to knock out the Trainer before stealing from their gear.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are naturally very cautious, so they easily grow attached to those who treat them with kindness and care. Although the tips of its ears are clad in soft fur, they can use their ears to deliver rock-shattering strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoys soothing the frazzled nerves of others, but care must be taken not to startle it while doing so. Its easily startled temperament leads it to use its ribbons as whips, swing wildly at those who take it by surprise.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats silently above farmland, stealing vegetables and berries with its long ribbon-like arms. Farmers must guard their fields carefully to avoid nightly losses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.
author: soup1900

entry: Each POKENAME's mecha is unique from the others. Wild POKENAME are said to brawl one another to see who has the strongest mecha.
author: jackgrifin

entry: With its unmatched elegance, POKENAME is highly sought after by fashion and beauty enthusiasts. It loves having its fringe styled to perfection and becomes furious if anyone messes up its hairdo.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is extremely skilled in emotional manipulation. It is said that grabbing one of its tails places a curse on the person, which often targets their deepest fears and exploits them. Despite this, POKENAME is very kind to children and innocents.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME builds its muddy lodge near fertile soil and plants carrot seeds around it. Even if it doesn't eat them, it compulsively replants them over and over.
author: .izik

entry: If its fur is brushed too quickly, POKENAME risks generating crackling electric sparks. Thanks to its natural elegance, it is highly esteemed by judges in beauty contests.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are shy by default. It has been said that to see one during the spring holiday season, is a sign that you will find true love by the end of the year.
author: bradlybro199

entry: These curious Lopunny have tinkered around with some ancient and mysterious technology, resulting in a mecha that resembles a Golett.
author: jackgrifin

entry: POKENAME's warm fluff keeps it toasty in frigid weather. If exposed to warmer conditions, it will shed profusely, leaving fluffy clumps everywhere.
author: hophoppip

entry: Believed by many to be a hallucination, POKENAME appears in sub-zero foggy conditions. If blocked, it phases through the Pokémon or Trainer, allowing the sheer cold to scare them off.
author: ghostslythe

entry: While hopping through snow mountains, POKENAME releases puffs of snow wherever it lands. Despite looking beautiful, these bursts of snow can cause frostbite instantly upon contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fur is so naturally cold that it is used in the packaging and transit of many chilled and frozen goods. Protective by nature, POKENAME emit chilling energy from their red crystals to form solid ice to repel or block threats.
author: infinex21

entry: With proper love and care, POKENAME will grow and have more confidence than its pre-evolution. However, it seldom sings to strangers it doesn't trust.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: Not only can POKENAME sense the thoughts of those around them, they can also hear movements for miles. Nearly impossible to ambush, if they sense a threat, they will distract it using flame on their wand before delivering a kick that shatters bone.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME takes immense pride in its crest of hair, which is used to assert dominance with others of its colony. If its loved ones are threatened, it pulls its crest into the fur hood to protect it, then it mercilessly attacks the offender.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Small keychains are made with its soft fur, said to bring luck in love. If the water it swims in is too fresh, POKENAME loses its luster; for this reason, it prefers to settle in marine bays.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its cute and affectionate appearance, POKENAME can become extremely fierce if anyone dares to approach its Trainer without permission. It has a habit of hiding trinkets and shiny objects in its soft fur.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It trains constantly to maintain perfect physical and mental balance. POKENAME meditates by performing elegant movements that resemble a graceful martial dance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are often found in libraries, wandering around giving books to anyone who they decide needs something to read. If overwhelmed, they spin around to try and smack their stressors away with their ears.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon, but is deceptively strong as well. If startled, it can hit a foe with a powerful blow from its fists or ears, but will run away and hide immediately after the strike connects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found busking along busy streets, performing magic tricks. While the audience is dazzled by flashy tricks and the occasional flex, their berries and Pokédollars end up hidden in POKENAME's soft ear tufts.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's fur gives its arms a deceptively soft appearance. Mountain climbers sometimes bring POKENAME with them to keep warm.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: When threatened, POKENAME explodes. The explosion scatters spores across a wide radius, which grow into enormous patches of mushrooms.
author: hophoppip

entry: For self-defense, the center egg in the clutch will launch other members of the group at foes from a distance. This causes no harm to the others, and they'll quickly hop back into formation, ready to be tossed again if needed.
author: sk372
