entry: The tree-like antenna on the central POKENAME detects berries, while the other five gather food. When they sense fruit nearby, they roll at over twenty miles per hour, lifting food psychically as they pass, including picnic baskets.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's skull-like head is composed of dense mycelium packed with spores. If damaged, the spores disperse and can induce fevers in those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hardens its body when danger is near. If struck, it releases a burst of spores that lull attackers into a deep sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spews clouds of brightly-colored gas from inside its body. Each color has its own side effect, ranging from nausea to hallucinations and even flu-like symptoms.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sheds sap from its cap, leaving a trail as it moves through forests. These drippings are known to have medicinal properties, and are treasured by Pokémon healers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mixes natural herbs into potent salves, applying them to heal injured Pokémon. Its remedies are widely sought after for their remarkable effectiveness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves brambles around its territory, creating natural barriers to protect its young. These thorny defenses are nearly impenetrable to outsiders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cultivates hydrangeas near its nest, using the flowers to camouflage itself from predators. The blooms also serve as a lure, attracting smaller Pokémon to its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sharpens its hardened fungal arms against rocks to keep them razor-thin. It slashes at trees with lightning speed, leaving deep cuts filled with fast-spreading fungi.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's powerful tails allow it to be a surprisingly graceful swimmer. Its preferred style to fight is to charge and ram right into the foe.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flaps its wings to attack and cause a random status condition. It can lure prey with its sweet-yet-poisonous pollen puffs.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME will leap from tree branches onto passing Pokémon to be transported to new feeding grounds. If attacked by a predator, it launches itself toward the threat, aiming to inject a debilitating toxin or scatter sleep-inducing spores.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It makes its home in aquatic areas with high algae content. POKENAME dispenses spores from its head, easing seasickness and stress in the passengers it ferries when they're inhaled.
author: sk372

entry: While consuming programs, POKENAME releases a cloud of yellow spores. The spores cause mild burns, allowing it to feed undisturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its wide head to protect its frail neck. If its enemy comes close enough, it will paralyze it with spores.
author: mudults

entry: The spores that fall from POKENAME's tail emit a sweet honey-like scent. However, inhaling too much can cause intense fevers and vivid hallucinations.
author: .izik

entry: Becoming especially aggressive during winter, POKENAME will chase down anything that moves, attempting to crush them with its small, yet powerful jaws. Its spritely footwork makes escaping it almost impossible.
author: darkweavile428

entry: When POKENAME wags its fluffy tail, it releases trillions of tiny purple spores. These spores lull predators to sleep, allowing it to escape unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: In the warm months, POKENAME flies around all day scattering spores. These spores will grow into new baby Shroombat.
author: bee4082

entry: As it flies, it scatters dust that brings joy to those below. This dust was initially believed to be magical, but research has found that it actually consists of spores that alter the mental state of those who inhale them.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME lives in lush caves, using its tail as a source of light and warmth for nearby plants to grow without the need for sunlight.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its bellowing forces air out through the pores on its head, releasing a thick cloud of spores. The cacophony of large groups of POKENAME can often be heard in swamps at dusk, serving as a warning to stay out of their territory.
author: sara886a

entry: POKENAME spreads clusters of floating spores that drift for miles on the wind. If these spores land in fertile soil, they quickly sprout into strange fungi.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shapes clay into small sculptures, displaying them proudly near its den. These creations often resemble local Pokémon, showcasing the inspirations it draws from its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: A wild POKENAME will hide among mushshrooms and wait for prey to approach. Once they do, it releases spores from the ground to paralyze them.
author: yinxuze

entry: In urban environments, POKENAME acts like it is harmless and inconspicuous. Once it's targeted human has let their guard down, it uses its extendable arms to reach out and nab their trinkets before running off.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is renowned for its beauty. It enjoys lying in the sun to gather enough energy for its bulb to bloom.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME spews spores from the red nozzles on its shell. If an enemy gets close, it sends them flying with a blow from its tail.
author: cait_sith

entry: Its outer shell is as hard and durable as steel. While it resembles an insect, its insides are actually made entirely of fungus.
author: hophoppip

entry: It has a sedentary life of spreading spores as it slowly moves across the forest. Its limbs can extend up to five times their normal length.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME forages for portobello mushrooms, storing them in its pouch for later consumption. It uses the energy from these fungi to power its powerful strikes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trawls the forest floor, picking up all sorts of detritus that it uses to build its shell. While its shell and the excretions it leaves behind are highly nutritious to fungi, both are toxic to people and Pokémon, and will induce vomiting.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME can often be found bathing under the sunlight that peeks through the canopy. When disturbed, it attacks with a burst of poisonous spores from the cap on its head.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: The mushroom on its head became too heavy for its small body to effectively carry. Instead, POKENAME spins around on it, delivering kicks and spreading spores via centrifugal forces.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME can spit highly acidic poison from its jaws at its enemies. It feeds mainly on insects harmful to trees and mushrooms, contributing to the preservation of the ecosystem it inhabits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It runs across the land with light footwork akin to elegant gliding. It absorbs pollution from water to produce poisonous spores, purifying the water in the process.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Though its arms appear short, they can extend to great lengths to scrape at its foes. POKENAME whips up mighty storms comprised of a sand-and-spore mixture that disorients and confounds others with blindness and paralysis.
author: sk372

entry: A wild assortment of powers have been prematurely attributed to POKENAME, but most of those powers come from the hallucinogenic spores it can release.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They hide in caves when winter approaches, as their bodies are sensitive to the frosty weather conditions outside. They form small herds and tightly pack themselves into a cave before hibernating until the season is over.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses fire to combust spores inside its wrists and punches opponents with intense force. POKENAME training grounds reek of singed spores.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME packs a lot of power in its tail. Using it, it can propel itself upwards quite a large distance, which it uses to reach the canopy of trees that bear its favorite bitter-tasting berries.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's spores give off the aroma of porcini mushrooms, attracting food enthusiasts from far and wide. It uses this scent to lure unsuspecting prey closer.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a harmless mushroom, swaying gently to lure in curious Pokémon. When they come close, it releases spores from its parasol-like cap that induce a hypnotic, calming effect, leaving opponents dazed and entranced.
author: tanglyatol9866

entry: POKENAME decorates its territory with peonies that it finds, adding a delicate beauty to its otherwise rugged environment. The flowers act as both a lure and a trap for curious Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's armor is elastic and springy, allowing it to resist physical impacts. It will spray a cloud of spores from the holes on its head to weaken its opponents.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME radiates an aura of madness, unsettling even the calmest of creatures. Despite its wild nature, it moves with precision, striking fear into those who encounter it.
author: .izik

entry: Cultivating spores from across forests, POKENAME grows a variety of mushrooms to provide shelter and care for smaller Pokémon. Unfortunately, if its residents get too rambunctious, they accidentally kick up spores and get dizzy.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has developed a technique where it blows into the wounds on its rubber body to inflate its bones like balloons. This increases its destructive power tenfold.
author: slimninja55

entry: The mushroom on a POKENAME's head is constantly producing colorful spores. Inhaling them can cause deep slumber, paralysis, or even a mild poison.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME's raw determination has hardened its limbs while still keeping the rubbery flexibility of its muscles. A single glare from a POKENAME is enough to stop weaker or less confident Pokémon in their tracks.
author: slimninja55

entry: POKENAME's stubby wings are elastic, save for the red tip. That part of the wing is dense and heavy; perfect for clobbering foes.
author: .realthree

entry: Always ready for a fight, it strikes with precise, blade-like arms coated in paralyzing spores. Its disciplined demeanor hides a fierce determination, making it a master of both combat and status-inflicting techniques.
author: thepandasharky

entry: When it takes flight, its majestic wings release fungal spores that put anyone who breathes them to sleep. POKENAME tends to make its home at the base of large trees in dense forests, as it needs plenty of moisture and darkness to thrive.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME roots itself in the forest near fungi groves, absorbing nutrients from the ground. Its ribbons can extend large distances, allowing it to boost the mood of travelers without needing to uproot itself.
author: sk372

entry: The bulbs at the ends of a POKENAME's tail contain calming compounds, with flavors and scents influenced by the POKENAME's diet. There are many renowned herbal beverages that are made by mixing one of these bulbs into boiling water.
author: infinex21

entry: By shaking its head and tail, it can scatter countless spores. These spores influence nearby plants, particularly flowers, and cause them to exude calming aromas.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fight by delivering precise and quick strikes using their legs or their feelers. The strikes from their feelers have reportedly been capable of penetrating through a sheet of iron.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives deep underground in fungi-infested forests, popping up to attack those who forage too many mushrooms. It can quickly extend its body to twice its normal length, making it difficult to escape its punishment.
author: sk372

entry: In combat, POKENAME fires powerful blasts of spores from its arms with the force of a shotgun. The mask covering its face protects it from the ill effects of its spores.
author: mistymagius

entry: The friendly looking head is not POKENAME's actual face, its actual face is hidden within the pattern on its chest. POKENAME uses the friendly facade to lure in its prey.
author: themisterlitwick

entry: POKENAME are a destructive force in combat and when training younger Breloom deep in the forests. Texts from Unova call these Pokémon “forest-lords”.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The mushroom cap covering POKENAME's eyes limits its vision, forcing it to rely on its sense of smell. It spends its days wandering caves, spreading spores wherever it goes.
author: .izik

entry: Its tails consist of colonies of fungi. When one of its tails is pulled or agitated, it releases spores, which cause a dire illness if inhaled.
author: hophoppip

entry: By extending its roots deep into the ground, POKENAME detects foes miles away and strikes with a punch at mach speed.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME burrows underground during the day, only emerging at night to spread its spores. It spreads powder from its mushroom-covered head to camouflage itself among tree roots and fallen leaves.
author: .izik

entry: A cloud of colorful spores constantly billows from its tail. Each color of spore has a different effect on those who inhale it, and POKENAME has poor control over which color of spores it releases.
author: hophoppip

entry: They frequently receive guests at their caves in winter and are willing to share the space if they remain uninterrupted in their mushroom cultivation. They pacify and lull unruly guests to sleep using a mixture of spores from their hands.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To defend itself, POKENAME strikes at others with the extending fungus-ears on the top of its head. Impacts spread spores on contact that cause nasty rashes, dissuading foes from continuing to attack it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slashes through foes with its thorny claws. Its deadly spores and dragon-like ferocity make it a formidable opponent in battle.
author: anarchaz

entry: It prefers to live in dark, damp areas where mushrooms thrive. It reproduces by planting its spores on decaying plant matter, allowing new POKENAME to emerge from the fungal growth.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME's legs contain powerful toxins that can paralyze foes with a single kick. Its spores blend with its venom, creating a hallucinogenic effect when inhaled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drift along frozen mountains, planting seeds to sprout special gardens. They offer Aspear Berries to travelers in the cold, granting them the strength they need to make it to safety.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A creamy, Haban Berry-scented sap drips from POKENAME's nose as it stands motionless on tree stumps. This aroma attracts small prey like Igglybuff, which it mercilessly drains with Giga Drain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME protects itself from predators by constantly covering its wings in a thick layer of spores. It prefers nesting in hollowed out trees in damp forests.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are always looking for refuge in people's gardens. However, the pollen they produce can attract rodents, which sometimes leads to POKENAME being eaten.
author: rumia_archer

entry: POKENAME embodies exhaustion, always teetering between bursts of energy and moments of collapse. Its powerful strikes are unpredictable, draining both itself and its opponents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's durable carapace is made out of thick steel that is almost impenetrable. Its body is incredibly heavy, causing small craters when it falls from the treetops.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME trails behind travelers and scatters poisonous spores at them until they become immobilized. It then delivers a final knockout punch to them before robbing their wares and items.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME waits for creatures to walk into its open mouth, before closing it and trapping them within. Some time later, it spits them back out, the creatures walking away with several fungal growths attached.
author: sk372

entry: Predators hunting POKENAME must be wary when attacking it physically since doing so could break off parts of its body containing potent toxins. By clawing the ground, it releases sleep spores into the air to incapacitate prey that gets near it.
author: soup1900

entry: The red rocks on POKENAME's body are actually stretchy and can be extended out to more easily slice foes. These rocks can break easily, causing the toxins they encapsulate to be released into the air.
author: soup1900

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's head releases a constant cloud of orange spores. These spores can infect the soil, causing large patches of glowing fungi to grow overnight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can usually be found relaxing or meditating in the shade of large trees. It has the ability to extend its arms just like Breloom, giving it the capability of launching its claws forward hard enough to smash solid rock.
author: fireblade141

entry: The spores it scatters from waving its stick around are known to cause hallucinations. People who experience these visions mistake them for acts of magic.
author: bostroms

entry: A POKENAME channels mystical energy through its makeshift staff made from a branch covered in living spores. It combines precise martial arts strikes with bursts of psychic energy. Its spores can burn softly in orange hues.
author: guilimao_22_71400

entry: POKENAME releases spores that cause persistent coughing, disrupting foes mid-battle. It uses this distraction to strike with precision, leaving opponents struggling to recover their breath.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME dances, clouds of spores are released from the mushroom on its head. Entire groves of fungi are said to appear after it passes through.
author: mepp.

entry: While consuming nectar from flowers, POKENAME releases clouds of green spores around itself. These spores can cause predators to fall asleep instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME digs in forests or claws apart logs in search of fungi to eat. Mushroom foragers often follow it since this Pokémon is adept at finding valuable and delicious Big Mushrooms.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's sandy appearance misleads some into believing it a Maractus fusion and avoiding it. However, it is actually very friendly. The misty looks of its tail are due to the spores it carries there.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME is picky, frequently changing its napping location between sunspots and dark shade. It has an uncanny ability for finding Balm Mushrooms, but only shares them with those who will trade it for treats like Lansat Berries.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suffers from constant headaches due to the spores of its own mushrooms. It will thrash around if its headaches become too painful, which just ends up producing even more spores.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME makes its home in damp woodlands near rivers and lakes, where the humidity keeps it lively and swift. With every punch it connects, spores drift from its body, enriching the environment and fostering the spread of mushrooms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Legends say that POKENAME's scepter-like staff can make mushrooms sprout and grow instantly by its command. As it spends most of its time hiding in forest shadows and beneath water, these rumors remain unverified.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although POKENAME are remarkably friendly, many people have to teach their children to stay away from wild members of this species. POKENAME are known to harbor a host of diseases of which they are immune to but are possibly fatal to humans.
author: ludacriswell

entry: The white fuzz on POKENAME's body is actually a colony of parasitic fungus. Those who attack it become infected by its spores.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME travel through the night, spreading seeds and spores in places of destroyed nature to facilitate the process of regrowth. Thanks to their powerful calves, they can travel for miles without pain.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's spores smell overwhelmingly sweet, attracting Pokémon looking for nectar. However, inhaling too much of its scent causes intense dizziness and drowsiness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spores are so flammable that the flames on its back turn its spore-emitting tail into a makeshift flamethrower. Its elastic legs allow POKENAME to leap of 100 feet in a single bound.
author: mistymagius

entry: When it runs at full speed through the woods, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of warm spores that cause plants to bloom more quickly. To assert its dominance over its territory, it challenges its opponents to extremely fast races.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a soft, mushroom-like material. Many chefs harvest small portions of it to craft rich, Rindo Berry-based sauces.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often causes confusion with its erratic movements, leaving opponents uncertain of its next action. Its dual nature keeps even experienced Trainers guessing.
author: .izik

entry: Its sludgy, fungal body breaks down organic matter for food. The plants in forests where POKENAME dwells decay rapidly, creating nutrient-rich soil for new plants to grow in.
author: hophoppip

entry: Dutiful protectors of the forest, POKENAME use their water cannons to both water flowers and repel intruders. By mixing different spores and berries within their shells, POKENAME can add a multitude of nutritional properties to their water.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are often found in overgrown caves full of their spores. They hold onto cave walls with the harpoon-like spikes protruding from its shell.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME defines the role of the mischievous predator by using its mushroom-tipped tail to scatter concealed spore traps throughout the forest. When an intruder sets one off, it appears with a gleeful cackle, joyous to have secured its next meal.
author: silentscript89

entry: A single touch of POKENAME's psychic whip is all it takes to put nearly any foe to sleep. POKENAME can stretch its arm to make the whip reach even farther.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME shuffle around in musky forests, hoping to blend in with the mycelium and moss. Their spores are feared for their drowsy potency.
author: xephyr

entry: The other five heads of POKENAME rotate around the base head at extremely high speeds, making them seem almost invisible. Its telekinetic powers allow it to move debris out of its way while traveling, ensuring a smooth flight path.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME clings to trees to conserve energy while it waits out its evolution process. It is not helpless, however, as the stored energy allows it to fly away suddenly at high speeds should a predator approach.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are deceptively fast and quiet when moving compared to their size. Should any Nincada be mistreated in their territory, the culprit will find themself beset by a furious POKENAME in the blink of an eye.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hovers above the land like the blade of a helicopter. It's edges are as sharp as knives and can easily cut through trees.
author: themicelegion

entry: Impossibly fast and possessing impossibly sharp limbs, POKENAME's image is highly memorable. Its form is popular enough to inspire the creation of a rival character in a TV franchise featuring Lokix-themed superheroes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's rapid wingbeats generate a whistling shriek as it zips around or expresses pleasure when it eats delicious sap. The trilling cry of POKENAME is divisive as some feel it is the relaxing theme of summer, while others find it irritating.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's rapid wingbeats generate a whistling shriek as it zips around or expresses pleasure when it eats delicious sap. The trilling cry of POKENAME is divisive as some feel it is the relaxing theme of summer, while others find it irritating.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Many attempts to utilize POKENAME as a means of transport have failed. Its piercing songs and quick movements make for uncomfortable traveling.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME makes a great security guard because of its quick speed and releases a cry when someone leaves without paying. It can follow thieves for long distances to ensure they get caught.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME chases after criminals with high speed, ducking and weaving through obstacles that thieves toss its way. Once it catches up, it pins down criminals on behalf of its Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pretends to be a tree within groves of apple trees, despite not looking like them. If someone approaches, it will use Mud Slap before dashing away, trying to trick intruders into thinking it's just another tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies slowly by spinning its wings like a propeller, generating a rhythmic droning sound that dominates the summer months. When the temperature drops, it burrows to a tree root system to hibernate until warm weather returns.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME prefers not to use its wings unless the wind stops, instead letting the breeze guide it around forests. It makes its nest in the trunks of Red Apricorn trees, thriving in peaceful and sheltered environments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME darts about at incredible speed but soon becomes dizzy and must stop, making its overall pace similar to a running human. Slow-motion videos of them have become a viral sensation among Trainers, as the expressions they pull are hilarious.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME can fly at very high speeds without making any sound, so it can often attack its victims without them even noticing. The stinger on its tail can inject paralyzing substances into its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon normally lives around ruins in desert areas, some trainers say that they are very territorial and agressive when anything tries to get close. The gem on their horn is very hard and POKENAME will not hesitate to attack with it.
author: naivetotoro

entry: POKENAME rapidly vibrate their wings to communicate with one another over vast distances, loud chirps and buzzes filling the air, often to the annoyance of nearby residents. They are aggressive when interrupted, pecking at people who come close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will slam its heavy trunk into prey like Yanma to knock them out of the air while it flies. It follows up with a Rollout to finish the prey off, using its power and speed to dominate its foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME paints with extreme speed and enthusiasm, especially when its art is inspired by daring combat encounters. The messes it leaves behind are dominated by splotches of red, making some assume a battle just took place.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME surround their body with an electrical charge that reacts to the fields of other living creatures. When they sense movement, their muscles move without needing conscious input, granting them incredible reaction times.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It can extend its vines several meters within the blink of an eye. It uses its vines to reel in foes before delivering rapid slashes with its claws.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME lives on the same tree its entire life, protecting it from anything that attempts to cause harm. When it beats its wings frenetically, it can move with such speed that its motions become difficult to follow with the naked eye.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is incredibly swift, running so fast that, supposedly, even air resistance barely affects it. Some have even claimed to have seen POKENAME run atop the surface of water. Its incredible speed makes it difficult to study properly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its speed to great advantage in battle, striking with flurries of kicks. It moves at a rapid speed, appearing like a blur and making it extremely difficult to land a solid strike on it.
author: evilgammon

entry: Moving swiftly and silently, POKENAME can strike down foes before being noticed. Leaping large distances into the air, POKENAME use their wings to adjust their descent and strike with extreme precision.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME fashions a scythe to fight off others as it attempts to be a guardian of the other denizens of its forest home. Its nature is still timid, however, and most attempts to fight end when it makes one surprise strike, then runs away.
author: sk372

entry: It has absolute loyalty to its Trainer, following its orders quickly and efficiently. Historical tales of Kanto and Johto speak of high-rank officials employing POKENAME for clandestine missions.
author: sk372

entry: Early reports of POKENAME's existence were thought to be hallucinations, as it moves so quickly and silently it seems to simply vanish. Nincada hide when it is near, though none are yet sure why.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attempts to blend into its surroundings by changing the color of the sheet it carries. Unfortunately for it, it is still quite easy to spot as it cannot change the zigzag pattern.
author: bacondlx

entry: Through isolated training and battle experience, a POKENAME ascends to become the leader of its swarm, or "clan". Both hiding and fleeing are futile actions in the face of its unmatched aura-sense and speed.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME roam the region searching for Shedinja. Upon finding one, they draw their blade and perform an exorcism, though the ancient conflict between them remains a mystery.
author: _kuke_

entry: The flowers on its back act like helicopter blades, spinning fast enough to allow it to fly. The petals are incredibly sharp and will cut anything that gets caught in them into hundreds of pieces.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME will fling a poisonous liquid from its wings as it flies to deter predators from its territory. This defense mechanism allows it to keep its space clear and its kin safe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME remain dormant in tombs until they are exposed to light. When light shines on their bodies, they zoom towards the light and buzz with curiosity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Ninjask in the wild flock to POKENAME when they sense its presence nearby. Acting as a commander, it gives them flawless tactical direction that lets them hunt prey more effectively and gather up heaps of food to share with their leader.
author: sk372

entry: The carapace of an adult POKENAME is fertile and able to support plant growth. POKENAME will use these plants to blend into their surroundings when stationary, and often end up playing host to much smaller Bug-type Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its constant zipping movement extinguishes the flames it produces. However, the lingering embers it leaves in its wake often ignite dry grass.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The rapid beating of its wings generates a lot of friction. POKENAME uses this to its advantage, and powers up its Thunder Punches and Blaze Kicks.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The speed in which POKENAME unsheathes is deafening. By the time its victim hears it, however, they are already wounded by its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is intensely rivalrous with other Pokémon. It will engage in mid-air jousting matches to determine dominance, using its speed and agility to assert its position as the superior fighter.
author: .izik

entry: Using their wings, POKENAME can move at extremely high speed and use their viciously sharp blades to cut through their opposition. They are popular Pokémon with aspiring Ace Trainers due to their highly adaptable battle style.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: People must work hard to show their worth and earn the ability to command these proud Pokémon. Even POKENAME hatched and evolved by their Trainers can abandon them at the first sign of weakness.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME has sharp ribbons that it uses to cut through steel. Those ribbons move almost all the time but they move so fast that the human eye doesn't detect the movement, giving the illusion of blurry blades.
author: slimmagma

entry: POKENAME's speed and ability to detect magnetic fields make it very difficult to catch. As a result, not much is known about this Pokémon.
author: midnightsoup

entry: POKENAME flies around at night, its soft purple glow dancing happily through wheat fields. It snacks on the plants when it gets tired, dimming its light when eating and creating a serene atmosphere in the fields.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its wings to propel itself at high speeds deep under the ocean. Its powerful flight allows it to move swiftly in underwater environments, where it navigates the sea floor in search of food.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being incredibly rare, the noise POKENAME creates while flying is nearly deafening, announcing its presence from great distances. It spends much of its time flying between swamps and watching over Nincada in the area as they feed.
author: .izik

entry: Several individual POKENAME will eventually become united through a strong sense of justice, forming a clan. If someone hurts another Pokémon in their territory, they will ceaselessly chase the aggressor in pursuit of revenge.
author: craigprime

entry: Possessing boundless energy and incredible speeds, POKENAME is a whirling dervish of slashes and claws in battle. Even when sleeping, its body refuses to remain still.
author: sk372

entry: In combat, POKENAME fires off its thorns faster than the speed of sound, able to pierce trough tree trunks. While its thorns regrow, it will frantically fly around hoping none of its opponent's attacks hit it.
author: mistymagius

entry: The fin on POKENAME's head slightly moves to cause drastic changes in its flight pattern. With this, it can easily turn at 90-degree angles in close to an instant, making it an agile and unpredictable flyer.
author: .izik

entry: An elusive warrior that stalks the night, it is almost incomprehensible how its massive form can remain undetected at all, yet few ever catch sight of POKENAME until it is too late.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME makes its home on beaches, using its claws to sort through sand to add to its body. The way it makes these choices has baffled scientists for years, as it seems to have an uncanny ability to select specific sand for its collection.
author: .izik

entry: An exceptionally fast Pokémon, POKENAME was commonly used as a mount by messengers prior to the industrial revolution. In modern times, it is still popular at racetracks or simply as a domestic Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sings a slow, foreboding tune while encircling prey with unrivaled agility to instill fear and dizziness into them. Then, it strikes with scythes to finish them. Viewing these actions in slow motion reveals a cinematic dance.
author: soup1900

entry: Only the highest-power cameras have been able to catch a glimpse of POKENAME in flight, as it moves at ludicrous speeds. It's believed that POKENAME could, at max speed, travel close to the speed of light.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's remarkable agility allows it to take down prey and outmaneuver predators effortlessly. It has even been known to prey on large bird Pokémon like Fearow.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME pumps out a large amount of fog to obscure its movements in the wild. It moves with a great deal more speed than one would expect, its silhouette seeming to vanish from within the smoke.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME has wings, it seems incapable of using them to fly. Even in dangerous situations, its wings only seem to slow it down.
author: pokebio

entry: A tactful, quiet, and swift thief. If you find that your valuables have been stolen by a POKENAME, you'll probably never get them back.
author: fountainihili

entry: POKENAME is beloved by homeowners for its capacity to swiftly and silently hunt small pests. "A house with a POKENAME is a house without vermin" has even become something of a slogan for those who own one.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's three eyes can see exceptionally well, even during the darkest hours of the night and underwater. The third eye is the most acute. POKENAME can stride on the water's surface with exceptional speed.
author: entomoxie

entry: It rapidly vibrates to produce shrill ringing sounds on the upper end of the frequencies which humans can hear.  Young people find its piercing din completely unbearable, while older folks cannot hear it at all.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME race through the sky in small packs. Despite their tight-knit bond, most of them barely tolerate one another and seek only to outpace each other. When push comes to shove, though, they will stand up for their packmates.
author: thesilverowls

entry: POKENAME has incredible speed both on land and in the air, and, as a result, is extremely difficult for wild Pokémon to pin down. It can easily flee from foes that it is unsure it can defeat, and only stays if it is sure it can win.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live a subterranean life, only eating minerals and deep-planted roots. When not eating or resting, they are constantly on the move, digging a vast network of tunnels, which leads to minor earthquakes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hunts in areas where fish are commonly seen leaping from the water. With its extreme speed, it can make quick leaps across the ponds or rivers, skewering a fish with its claws to secure a meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME plugs its bulb with a ball of cotton to stop itself from spewing poison constantly. The poison it launches out is sticky, spongy, and leaves a burning sensation on touch.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: There are tales of sages relying on its silk to tie a person's soul to their body after death. The ritual requires a silver needle and a crystal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide their appearance behind a cloak and skull. They carry an ethereal shovel that is said to help them unearth spirits, though this has yet to be proven.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon's bone has become like a needle. It pulls threads out of its clothlike skin and uses them to snare and trap foes to set up a finishing blow with its sharp weapon.
author: fireblade141

entry: It is drawn to grief and often appears near those in mourning. Some believe it absorbs emotional baggage from others, its body becoming visibly heavier and more tattered over time.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are constantly on the lookout for perceived slights from other Pokémon. When they sense a possible transgression, they will stalk that Pokémon and attack when it is alone.
author: hermit39

entry: Fusing has brought out traits from both components' Mega Evolutions. Some theorize that this occurs due to the happiness Banette feels from uniting with a child.
author: hophoppip

entry: Some say that the face on its wings is its actual face; others claim it only emotes after victims are hit with spores. Claims are difficult to prove as attempts to research this fusion are halted by its amnesia-inducing spores.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME hovers slowly on its side over cemeteries, dripping water as it drifts. Some believe its core will blink red when a loved one is emerging from their grave to greet their ancestors.
author: .izik

entry: Its primary habitat is in urban areas. While hunting for food, it will dance within the shadows of alleyways to wait for lost tourists.
author: .izik

entry: It is constantly searching for objects to test its blades on. Should it find something it cannot slice, it will spend weeks tirelessly sharpening its claws.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME are found in areas that were previously populated by humans, but are now abandoned for one reason or another. They feed on impulsive and intrusive thoughts from a distance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Many POKENAME prefer to live in abandoned textile factories. It will consume any loose fabric or string that it finds in order to satiate its hunger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's demeanor is aloof and typically calm, but it is very vengeful if agitated. The zipper in its neck opens up to expel dark energy that reaches out to attack those who wronged it.
author: sk372

entry: It prefers to make its nest in marshes. The venom within its horn lets loose a foul odor that smells like rotting Pecha Berries.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks at the bottom of frozen lakes and seas, occasionally emerging to drag prey to its icy lair. It is said that each pin on POKENAME's back represents an unfortunate soul that fell beneath the ice.
author: agentyoshi

entry: POKENAME appears on computers, masquerading as a mysterious file. Those who are curious and try to reveal its contents suffer its curse, filling the computer with malware.
author: sk372

entry: Entering homes, they wait for the right moment to scare passersby. POKENAME often hide in closets.
author: mrbapcik

entry: Forcibly zipping POKENAME's mouth shut is the only way to temporarily stop it from gorging endlessly on food. Many say that the only thing that will truly sate it is devouring a certain number of human souls.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME break into children's bedrooms to hide amongst toys and plushies. They long for affection and will do anything for a child that decides to adopt them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME erratically flips between obedience and rage. When under stress, it focuses its wrath into its drills, regardless of whether it is in a fight or over some mild inconvenience.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: It has a hard time sleeping when it is not in direct contact with the moon's light. If it attempts to sleep during the day, it will become restless.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME harbors resentment and anger towards Trainers on behalf of all the Pokémon they have released. It will hide on trees, using its webs to trip any humans so it can bite them with poison.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME's webbing is actually made from extremely tight and firm fabric, which is typically used for sweaters.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: The string that it produces was used by cultists to create dolls in ancient times. These dolls were said to have the power to inflict powerful curses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME holds a ball of yarn inside its body that can be accessed by unzipping its ear. It isn't skilled enough to make anything on its own, so POKENAME looks for trainers who are skilled at sewing to learn from them.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: Despite looking like it is full of cotton, its body is extremely hard and similar in density to quartz. When sleeping, it will stand upright and remain completely still.
author: .izik

entry: Due being so lightweight, it is easily blown away by the wind. Should it be caught in a tree, its eyes will glow brightly as it wiggles free.
author: .izik

entry: The pollen that comes from the flower on its head gives off a smell that is reminiscent of rotting meat. It uses this to deter predators from its nest.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers to live in humid environments, allowing its body to stay moist. The sweat that beads off of its body was once used in a poison that caused nightmarish delusions.
author: .izik

entry: It steals yarn and string to create its nest. A POKENAME only deems its nest complete once ten different fabrics are incorporated and sewn together.
author: .izik

entry: The parasitic cloth has absorbed the host entirely, leaving only a husk behind. It stitches any fabrics it finds onto the body of its host.
author: 8xviktor

entry: The stem growing from its bulb is actually an arm, capable of throwing powerful punches, while its main body can tackle and bite its enemies. POKENAME also uses this hand to prank and poke trainers who turn their back on it.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME has a breath so foul, that even other Ghost-type Pokémon are unable to handle the downright nose-boiling scent. Smaller prey often die before POKENAME even has them in its jaws.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME are deeply rancorous Pokémon that haunt people who visit graveyards. They cast curses on grieving families that cause them to see hallucinations. Many visitors to graveyards carry a special amulet to protect themselves from the curses.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lurks within the darkness and jumps out to frighten Trainers. If a Trainer reflexively attacks it, POKENAME will place a curse on them.
author: gentlesage

entry: It's rumored that POKENAME is the astral grudge of Banette, taken over the body of a Girafarig against its will. Though the Girafarig is unable to combat its sheer will.
author: clownatosis

entry: Its shell will become softer if it feels happiness. Because of this, it's important during combat for a wild POKENAME to think of horrible experiences to keep its outer layer strong.
author: .izik

entry: Roaming the otherworldly realm, they consume lost souls. A POKENAME that has fed enough may appear in the real world.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME are most often seen encircling houses, using cursed energy to create eyes on their pincers for intimidation and instilling fear. While most people think it's to protect the occupants inside, they actually do it to torment and curse them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's horn is flexible, allowing it to strike at foes or dig beneath the bark of trees from odd angles. It breathes out a stinky ghostly miasma from its mouth if someone dares to interrupt it while it's eating sap from a tree.
author: sk372

entry: As malice and vindictiveness around it grows, this Pokémon cannot contain its curses. They burst from its seams, appearing as ghastly appendages.
author: ziggaway

entry: When the accumulated maledictions reach a critical mass, a spiteful aura is visible surrounding POKENAME. The aura further empowers its curses.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME have long been thought to be born of greedy spirits that came to possess coin purses in hopes of acquiring even more riches. They are mischievous Pokémon that love to collect precious items within their shells.
author: infinex21

entry: It emits an aura while it rolls that can cause negative feelings in adults. This can cause crying, fits of rage, or even a deep depression.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fighting style incorporates a mix of gentle movements and impactful strikes. It is speculated that the spirit inhabiting a POKENAME belonged to a martial artist who has mastered a long lost combat art.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: POKENAME's grip gets tighter as it closes its zippers around the prey in its stomach, making it hard for them to escape or breathe. A few designers have made sleeping bags based on POKENAME despite its dangerousness.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME wanders through the dark at the edge of swamplands, seeking sources of negative emotions. Upon finding its prey, POKENAME coils its tentacles around them, using their fear to create a brand new curse.
author: wiz0z

entry: It spends its days gathering dead flowers and bringing them back to its den. It can eat a pound of flowers for a single meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often steals plush toys from playgrounds to consume the cotton inside. If approached while eating, it sprays the intruder with Water Gun and flees.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME deliberately place themselves in toy stores, yearning to be taken care of by a Trainer. If ignored, the Pokémon will leave the store feeling crestfallen.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is malicious and resentful, seeking out unsuspecting victims to torment from the shadows. It is sustained by negative emotions, so a Trainer expressing positivity can help it find peace.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When it gets upset, it will begin to cry orange tears. The tears are extremely poisonous and should not be touched.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME opens portals to the prison of long-dead spirits, hoping to curse others to their fate.
author: seafoamtaide

entry: POKENAME congregate where children play after the sun has set. The lingering auras of joy, happiness and friendship are believed to give them comfort. Those that have been adopted into families exude an overwhelmingly positive aura.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME seek revenge on those who wrong them, driven by an instinctual rage. Their control over supernatural energy is so immense, it is thought they can level entire mountain ranges with a single blast.
author: chibitales

entry: The flower on its back blooms when feelings of hatred and bitterness flourish. Direct sunlight causes the spirit on its back to shrivel, so its bulb covers it during the day.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It is unclear which head of a POKENAME is in charge of their body, but they provide a devious combo regardless. They love playing tricks on Pokémon and Trainers alike, often stealing items and berries to instigate a chase.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A long zipper runs down its back, as if it's trying to keep its cursed essence sealed within. It forces ghost Pokémon to hoard food for it. If anyone steals from POKENAME, it hunts them down and drags them to its den to feed on their life essence.
author: amiel997

entry: Though said to drag off naughty children who ignore their curfew, this lazy monster only eats fruit.
author: kanelel

entry: POKENAME haunt abandoned mansions and abodes, drifting through empty corridors with their head held high. If anyone dares set foot inside, POKENAME will abruptly appear and try to scare them away, aiming to protect their home from intruders.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME collects cotton from fields to fill its soft body. If it senses a tornado approaching its favorite field, it screams with a loud, human-like voice to warn nearby farmers.
author: .izik

entry: The pink glow of POKENAME from watery depths is a foreboding sight to most. Sailors tell tales that vessels travelling with dark intentions may be swallowed whole by POKENAME, filling its belly with cursed energy.
author: femaledog

entry: This Pokémon was born from the longing spirit of an abandoned plush doll that had supposedly been modeled to resemble Arceus. What now appear to be zippers running across its body were once tears, and are said to allow one to peer into its very soul.
author: infinex21

entry: There are stories that say that a POKENAME can hear things in alternate dimensions. There is no factual knowledge that backs this up.
author: .izik

entry: When a Banette joins forces with a Doublade, the Doublade absorbs its cursed energy, fusing into a POKENAME. Left to their own devices, these Pokémon will endanger whole communities to settle Banette's old grudge.
author: .fedoraman

entry: It actively seeks out objects with high sentimental value and eats them. The more love a person has for the item, the more delicious POKENAME finds it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's gears spin faster with the more grudge-fueled energy stored in its body, letting it move with impressive speed. The true danger is present when the gears stop, allowing POKENAME to cast a powerful curse.
author: femaledog

entry: POKENAME sneaks into the rooms of children while they are sleeping. The zippers on its body then open up to release ghostly tendrils that brush against the child and cause their sleep to be filled with nightmares.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can often be found counting coins dropped by panicking Trainers. Some say you can borrow money from them.
author: tad

entry: Despite POKENAME's plush body being intensely soft, it is capable of lifting entire buildings after psyching itself up. This self-encouragement can sometimes take hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME moves silently, never uttering a sound, which, paired with its emotionless movements, makes anyone in its presence unnerved. Eyewitness reports swear they have seen the eyes on its hood blink, but research can't confirm this yet.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME are always searching for Trainers that have abandoned any of their Pokémon, seemingly possessed by a dreadful desire for revenge. To all other Trainers, they are incredibly shy and will often avoid them out of fear.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are suffused with malevolent energy that they weaponise to inflict curses and misfortune on those unfortunate enough to cross their path. They wield an oversized needle that lets them focus this curse energy and project it further.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME often wander into sewing stores to steal pins to add to its hair. Only those it considers true friends are able to use its pins; attempt to take one forcibly, and POKENAME will unleash a foul curse.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME sews whatever its Trainer wants as long as it's credited for its craft. If it isn't, POKENAME curses its Trainer with momentary amnesia and escapes to continue its work in the wild alone until it feels better.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME sews Clefairy Dolls and gives them away to anyone it meets. The dolls always come back if they are thrown away, and repeated attempts to get rid of them will slowly make whoever owns a doll lose their memories.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: Don't ever let a POKENAME out of your sight. It swallows people and Pokémon whole with its multiple mouths. It has a tongue for every zipper.
author: themicelegion

entry: Pokémon souls unwilling to part with their Trainer are turned into POKENAME. Meeting their Trainer allows them to turn back to their normal form.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME feed on negative emotions and incorporate the fears and misgivings of those around them into curse energy. The curse energy can be released by splitting open the seams of their many tails, bringing grave misfortune to those afflicted.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon said to have been born from the selfish and wicked wishes inscribed upon its blue tags. Though supposedly having been born from wickedness, POKENAME only shows malice towards those it deems irredeemable.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon comes from another universe, one where darkness has consumed the world. The arms have a mind of their own, manipulating the blind POKENAME for their own agenda.
author: bee4082

entry: A colony of POKENAME recently were found in the vast cave systems of Mt. Shady. Their claws are deceptively sharp and able to dig through solid stone.
author: .izik

entry: Its eyes glow a deep crimson if it becomes jealous. If it encounters a traveler, it will attempt to steal something valuable from them out of greed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feed on negative emotions and incorporate the fears and misgivings of those around them into curse energy. They store this curse energy in each of their many tails, waiting for an opportunity to unleash it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The flame on its tail is said to be its soul. Trainers with a keen eye are able to distinguish its nature based on how bright or concentrated the flame burns.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME hoards Moon Stones and stores them in its stomach to prevent Pokémon from evolving with them and outshining it. Despite having no desire to hoard other evolutionary stones, POKENAME still seethes with jealousy when it witnesses one in use.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: Some Channelers have claimed that a POKENAME forms when a child lets go of their balloon and it flies away into the sky. When its mouth unzips, muggy and spine-chilling air is unleashed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It laughs like a child from shadows while watching children play. Should a child get too close to the shadow, it will pull them in and feed off of their fear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possess abandoned children's toys, puppeteering them and using them to scare anyone who tries to reclaim the toys. Their true bodies are only visible through a Silph Scope.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME possess abandoned children's toys, puppeteering them and using them to scare anyone who tries to reclaim the toys. Their true bodies are only visible through a Silph Scope.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A child's lost toy, filled with longing and sorrow, came to life as this Pokémon. It has a strange aversion to certain Psychic-Type Pokémon.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: Banette lost all its anger after turning into POKENAME. Now it happily plays with childrens.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME beats its soft, plush wings at incredible speed to stay aloft. During rainstorms, the wings absorb water, slowing its flight until it can dry off.
author: .izik

entry: If this monster happens to find a weary traveller sleeping on its soft body, POKENAME will send a shock that traps them in deep slumber.
author: _testrun_

entry: POKENAME crystals store the cursed energy that POKENAME naturally emit. When another Pokémon cracks their giant crystal, the torrent of cursed energy saps vitality from the assailant.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soar through howling snowstorms in search of the right Trainer. They can mysteriously detect what possessions a Trainer has and will flock towards those who are in possession of an old toy or plushie.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a fascination with humans, collecting their scraps and discarded items. It is said that POKENAME grow stronger based on the more care that was put into the object before it was thrown away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often uses pieces of cloth to cover its body. It seems to fear that it won't be loved if its stuffing is exposed.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its roots extend deep into the mud to absorb nutrients. It prefers to live in wetlands and other areas with plenty of fresh water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absorb cursed energy from other Pokémon to make their cloud of malevolent energy bigger. During a Pokémon battle, they expend this cursed energy to inflict hexes onto their opponents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's many eyes can subject a victim to a ghostly glare that paralyzes them completely. Its mouth then unzips to let out an eerie wail that pelts the target with a multitude of spectral stones.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being a fusion, the Banette within can leave the armor for short periods of time. The hollow shell will be inactive until it returns.
author: ohok3441

entry: Its many zippers contain dangerous pollen. Close contact with the substance can render one comatose and victim to cursed visions.
author: seafoamtaide

entry: There is a children's story of POKENAME that watch for children who do poorly on tests. Once they get bad grades, it will steal them from their home.
author: .izik

entry: It spends most of its time in deep caves, only emerging in the middle of the night to gather food. Its fangs are able to break solid marble.
author: .izik

entry: Its owner's love for music brought POKENAME to life. Its haunting yet soothing voice can reanimate other dolls to be used as an idol group.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME's body appears to be composed of haunted thread. In combat, it dashes rapidly, appearing only as a blur, and impales its foes upon its pin-like weapon when they least expect it. No one knows what is under its mask.
author: fireblade141

entry: Infections from the predatory POKENAME fungus are a growing epidemic amongst Kanto's native Banette population. Though many consider this a tragedy, POKENAME mushrooms are a popular upper-class food item that fetches an incredibly high price.
author: turron_turron

entry: There is a constant internal battle within POKENAME to keep its parasite from spreading. Should the POKENAME falter, its zippers will open and release toxic, paralyzing spores in an attempt to infect those around it.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: A myriad of discarded materials made from fabrics and cloth festered in darkness and birthed this Pokémon. It constantly seeks more materials to shield its true form from any form of light.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME tends to hold grudges, fiercely hunting down those who have escaped it before. The insides of its scythes glow an eerie pink during the night.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME absorbs life energy through the gems on its body. If it unzips its mouth, it releases that force in an explosive burst that can level homes.
author: .izik

entry: Its eyes tint to a darker color of red when it is in darkness. Doing so, it can read heat signatures from both predators and prey alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its wand to bind its cursed energy permanently to its body. If this enchantment were to ever be undone, all its energy would escape, and it would turn into a normal doll.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have been seen floating through the remnants of abandoned coal mines. They push pins in their back to expel sinister smoke clouds from their shell, choking their enemies.
author: femaledog

entry: POKENAME is protective of children who indulge in scary stories and mischievous pranks. If it witnesses anyone bothering a child it is protecting, it will sew the mouth shut on its belly, which curses the nuisance with a week of silence.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its loose skin like a bag, snatching small items in it before sneakily floating away. Some people believe that it could carry a child away in its bag, but POKENAME isn't strong enough to carry that much weight.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME keeps the flame on its tail protected by a thick layer of fabric to prevent it from being extinguished. This fabric looks soft and lumpy, but is actually prickly and incredibly painful when touched.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: When a golden zipper suddenly appears and unzips the solid ground, POKENAME is sure to emerge from the opening. The strange space POKENAME travels through is known as the Zippered Pocket Dimension.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME torments those who throw away toys by summoning hundreds of the toy they discarded from out of its hands onto them. While seemingly a harmless prank, these toys are studded with cursed gems that make them feel too valuable to be thrown away.
author: soup1900

entry: Its fur is incredibly light-weight and easy to tailor. There is a weaver is Greenstation Town that makes elegant gowns with this material.
author: .izik

entry: When it is alone, it will wail for hours due to its loneliness. The sound of its cry can get so high-pitched that it can break glass.
author: .izik

entry: Resembling a heavily modified doll from ancient Hoenn, POKENAME is an imaginative spirit. It is prone to becoming waterlogged and moldy, so Trainers that help it remain clean and in fair condition earn its eternal loyalty.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's resentful feelings fuel the raging storm around it. POKENAME's heavy blizzards can only be ceased by showing it love.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are impossible to hear coming because of their soft webbed feet. They stalk Trainers with the hope of becoming friends but often surprise and scare away Trainers instead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME's plush body collides with cave walls during flight, it releases a high-pitched squeak like a toy. If upset, this sound can grow loud enough to shatter glass.
author: .izik

entry: The ceaseless fires burning within POKENAME are said to be fueled by its soul, each flame burning with reckless abandon as zippers tear open. When one flame is snuffed out, another one bursts alight, scorching those who try to extinguish its flames.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: Reaching into our world from another dimension, POKENAME is a brutal fighter capable of both physical and psychological attacks.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Able to hide in shadows and even another dimension, POKENAME is capable of striking from anywhere, at any time, with a decisive jab of its fist.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: The parasitic cloth that covers the Slowpoke has expanded and thus increased its absorption. The ethics of this relationship have been questioned.
author: 8xviktor

entry: The parasitic cloth has absorbed everything from its host except its consciousness. This has left the host completely numb.
author: 8xviktor

entry: It is hollow. Water is sucked into its chest when the zipper opens; it later uses that water in battle, manipulating it with its paranormal powers.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME cleverly disguises itself as a purse of some sort. When no one is looking it uses its tongue to swallow unsupervised coins, but it's unclear what it does with them.
author: atlas3339098

entry: A gifted doll maker, POKENAME crafts doll friends for those who feel lonely. These dolls ward off evil spirits and curse anyone who harms them.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME leap between devices to build up electricity and store it on their backs. The arcing path of the bolts along a POKENAME's back contains the electricity in a complete circuit to minimize stray sparks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME store highly volatile electricity and plasma within their bodies. Due to this, they are constantly at risk of exploding.
author: theartemis1

entry: Trying to merge with the skull on a sleeping Cubone's head, Rotom became attached to the Cubone. They now travel together.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Contrary to popular misconception, POKENAME does in fact run on natural gas. They produce so much pollution that their Trainers are taxed for each one they own. Unfortunately for POKENAME, it is counted twice.
author: inquis1

entry: Even though it's very well incubated, the egg inside of a POKENAME never seems to show signs of hatching. Despite this, POKENAME remains happy.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME's sense of smell is attuned to the presence of free ions. This is why they are observed to gravitate in droves towards power plants. They pile up in teams once there, hoping to get their hands on the juice of a power transformer.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME is known for its impressive vocal range, being able to sing any song that comes to mind. This has led to both an ironic cult-like following as well as practical use in various establishments such as restaurants and bars.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME are valued for their slick and modern appearance. They are a common decorative fixture in the aquariums of offices and malls.
author: inquis1

entry: This POKENAME has possessed a microphone. It lets out strange, warbling songs that ring out loudly and clearly, even if it's not connected to any speaker.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME become enraged when anyone attempts to ride them, thrashing around wildly in an attempt to throw the rider off. It is a popular challenge among Trainers to see who can last the longest on their backs.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's circuits don't take too well to the ocean, so they are resigned to live solely in ornamental ponds. It's said they took up fusion to leave behind their weak bodies. Some say they can see fury in them for having been made a decorative fish.
author: inquis1

entry: Their wings spin rapidly, and buzz quite loudly, when they are awake and flying about. They each prefer certain kinds of honey and sap and will protect the sources of such things with electrical bolts.
author: infinex21

entry: Spawned from an arcade cabinet during a lightning storm, POKENAME now obsessively consumes berries in the real world to increase in size.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME will often provide refreshments to beachgoers using the cooler on its back. Where these drinks come from, nobody quite knows.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME are kept on massive astroturf fields where they spend most of their days living an idyllic existence. Their circuits dream wistfully of the day a Trainer will come and pick them out.
author: inquis1

entry: Its body is made of condensed electric plasma, making it very light and agile. POKENAME love to feed on the electrical energy of devices and machines, so some consider it and its kind to be pests.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are known to enjoy infiltrating appliances such as microwaves to absorb the heat they generate. This reportedly has caused many electronics in everyday households to malfunction.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME loves being sent through a Box Link. It zips across digital spaces with glee, sometimes rearranging the contents of the storage without permission.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has a hybrid motor powered by electric plasma and fossil fuel found inside its body. This allows POKENAME to retreat into its shell when attacked, and roll away, leaving exhaust gas in its wake.
author: equation8573

entry: The eyes upon their shells are markings meant to fool others. They attach to boats to get around quicker, though they also try to sneak aboard to feed on electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Even a small cut from its scythes can result in numbness that can last for over a day. It dips its scythes into water and releases electricity to weaken or knock out large batches of prey.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body resembles a fossil of certain Pokémon, which seems to mostly be for the sake of intimidating others. It can "swallow" prey whole, wrapping them in its plasma and siphoning them of any and all electricity before discarding them.
author: infinex21

entry: This Rotom has possessed a vending machine. When in battle, it shoots out the refreshments using powerful electric shocks.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME usually interferes with electrical equipment. Its pink glow acts as a strong energy output, causing planes and other vehicles to malfunction when it is nearby.
author: animecreep4

entry: POKENAME's insect DNA is refracted through its plasma body, projecting holograms of wings. Its core constantly emits a muffled, droning buzz.
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME are mischievous tricksters that appear and disappear in a flash. They love to disrupt devices such as cameras, which has delayed efforts to photograph them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses a sensor on its head to measure humidity and temperature, making it a helpful companion for Trainers with houseplants. It beeps when it senses a plant that needs to be watered.
author: havic0970

entry: The scent of ozone comes from its electric leaves. Despite its strange smell, it purifies the air around it like a plant.
author: havic0970

entry: Its electric antennae stimulate plant growth. New buds spring to life, as long as it's sunny enough to keep POKENAME powered.
author: havic0970

entry: If POKENAME is inside an electronic device and is attacked, it flares up in plasma, overheating the device it's in. Any wiring attached to the device it is in when these plasma flares happen will burn out and catch on fire.
author: soup1900

entry: It spits balls of condensed, hot plasma at foes that explode with heat and electricity on impact. If angered, flames and electricity erupt violently from its back.
author: infinex21

entry: They leech electricity from machines, though they also tend to cause those machines to be fried in the process. If challenged, they release a torrent of superhot electricity from the backs of their necks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are often considered nuisances because they will perch atop radio towers and antennae and they disrupt signals when they do. They can loose precise electrical jolts that can overload small generators.
author: infinex21

entry: Whenever Trainers are home and need a reminder, many rely on POKENAME to remind them after a set period of time. Once time is up, POKENAME fly to their Trainer, vibrating and releasing loud chirps to get their attention.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release strong Thunderbolts from their horns with great precision. They use their claws to cling to cave ceilings and drop on unsuspecting prey, then paralyze them with a shocking bite.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME perch atop electrical transmission towers, or along the cables, and absorb some of the electricity to fuel their own bodies. They become very territorial if they are not chased away within a week.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the ionic charge of its antenna to communicate with each other about the weather. When many gather in one place, they coordinate a dance to bring forth the rain.
author: inquis1

entry: Although some find these Pokémon and their plasma bodies to be marvelous to view, POKENAME are constant dangers to electrical grids. They feed on electricity wherever they can, seemingly unaware, or just uncaring, of the effects on others.
author: infinex21

entry: Seeking electrical energy, POKENAME attach themselves to power lines via the long wire protruding from their underbelly. If gathered in sufficient numbers, POKENAME can be a drain on the local power grid, which can be a problem for human communities.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME gives off great amounts of energy that causes nearby water to become sterilised. Researchers used to keep them to be able to easily obtain purified water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME gives off great amounts of energy that causes nearby water to become sterilised. POKENAME then absorb this sterilised water, which makes them glow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME gives off great amounts of energy that causes nearby water to become sterilised. With no microorganisms in it to recycle nutrients, this can cause small ponds to become void of all life.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME can control electronic light sources. When it's chasing down a foe, it will turn all the lights off and rely on its night vision.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME slips into electronic devices and mimics the voices of people or Pokémon. It uses these imitations to trick others into handing over shiny objects, which it eagerly collects.
author: zebrarook_

entry: POKENAME use the special structure of their leaves to generate electricity from sunlight. The collected electricity can then be delivered through their two vines.
author: lurch327

entry: POKENAME jumps from device to device, rewriting programs in an ancient language. It can spread virally through online messages or even simple text.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The consciousnesses in its head and tail are completely separate. Only in battle do its two minds properly synchronize.
author: staghorn

entry: It hosts an electric core, sheltered by its pinecone-shaped array of conductive, armored plating. It may also be utilized as an emergency generator.
author: lynkinator

entry: The near-limitless power it discharges from its core is encapsulated in its solid shell. If you touch it, you'll get a mild shock.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: POKENAME nests near power outlets to consume the electricity by plugging into it using its tail. Homeowners may notice a hole in their wall due to POKENAME's mischief.
author: equation8573

entry: They latch onto foes and prey with their claws and deliver strong jolts to down them. Their cries tend to sound as if they are giggling or chuckling at others, further enforced by how they stick their tongues out at others so often.
author: infinex21

entry: Its pincers can move so quick around it that it often looks as if it has four of them, but it only has two. It delivers powerful Bullet Punch attacks that deliver paralytic jolts with every blow.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body is made of plasma, yet often seems to be as hard as iron as well. It can move very fast by jetting electricity from its wings, and uses the momentum to deliver thunderous blows with its pincers.
author: infinex21

entry: It inhabits an electric blender to protect its delicate body. It collects berries to create an energizing juice that it uses to re-energize fainted Pokémon. Some believe its juice is related to potions.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves to sing. Despite its appearance, it gets along well with children. It can often be found guiding lost kids to safety.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: When POKENAME bounces around hot lava inside its lamp-shaped body, a large ambient red light fills the surrounding area, helping it see in dark caves. However, it must bounce the magma slowly; otherwise, its glass breaks and all the lava flows out.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is often seen making its home with other POKENAME surrounding parts of undersea optic cables. They communicate by the color of their sparky, colorful coral branches.
author: beatdoof

entry: Some people believe these Pokémon were the inspiration for some weapons depicted in some science-fiction media. They can release attacks with extreme precision and rarely miss.
author: infinex21

entry: This helpful fusion enjoys producing shaved ice treats for its Trainers using its 3D-printed body and electric motor.
author: pankiwi

entry: Bound to cellphones, POKENAME can be found slowly wrapping around their device, almost like they're in a game. If they bump into themselves, they let out a mild pulse of electricity before hissing in what sounds like disappointment.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's abilities let it leap into any electronic nearby and adapt to its surroundings quickly. Mischievous by nature, it has an equal chance of enhancing somebody's device as it does causing it to behave erratically, all in the name of amusement.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feed off the information they obtain by surveying their surroundings, adjusting their image to be enticing to others. When POKENAME have tempted someone, they will do anything in their power to keep their attention for as long as possible.
author: npshi

entry: It inhabits an old and worn-out tablet. Those who pick up its pen are cursed with an overwhelming urge to create art.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME resembles an arcade machine that hosts a game where a snake eats fruits to grow its tail. Many children love to spend time with POKENAME hoping to beat the high score, while parents try to unplug its energy to get children to do chores.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spreads healing energy through its electrified touch. Its calming presence and spectral abilities bring comfort and solace to those in need.
author: anarchaz

entry: Its horn-like antenna serves as means for it to communicate with others of its species. To release electricity, it rubs its cheeks quickly and lets jolts fly all about.
author: infinex21

entry: Their plasma wings shine with at least seven colors and release enough light to produce a warmth akin to sunlight. They defend themselves by spitting electrically-charged fireballs.
author: infinex21

entry: There have been records of POKENAME being seen drifting in and out of time at a speed of 88 mph.
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME stores nutrients in its tail that react with the electricity it generates, creating a faint energy signature. Researchers found that feeding it Pink Nectar causes its tail to emit a soothing Joy Scent hours later as it bounces happily along.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This fusion seems to be from the far future, being more mechanical than spiritual. Its motorized wails and screams can cause electronics to fail.
author: awiralonprime

entry: POKENAME has mastered its powers to control electronics with unmatched skill. It can emit a scream that allows it to control electrical devices.
author: awiralonprime
