entry: POKENAME hides in its box, waiting for prey. When provoked by a victim, it jumps out at them, shocking them in more ways than one!
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: When they store too much electricity, they become aggressive and violently release their electricity. Once they have released enough, they return to being very friendly and docile.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are able to burrow through the ground at high speeds using their drills, searching for mineral deposits to consume. These Pokémon are often kept in quarries, helping to dig out large tunnels.
author: santon5512

entry: Having evolved in and around power plants, POKENAME naturally love the crackling buzzing sound that power cables make. They love to sit quietly under transformer stations, listening to this exact sound.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME are filled with electricity and flames, which they will condense into balls and shoot them from their arms. They like to trick others as if they are going to attack them by emitting strong lights from their arms.
author: infinex21

entry: The tip of its tail is sharp enough to penetrate most materials, allowing it to connect to machines and absorb their energy. It perches high to swoop down and steal devices from passersby to feed.
author: infinex21

entry: Urban legends say that when one's TV is turned to the right station at exactly the right time, POKENAME will arrive to claim them. They're right.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: With a body made entirely of plasma, POKENAME leaps into electronics to stick close to its Trainer. It has a kind heart, and has been observed using some of its electric stores to bring old non-functioning machines back to life.
author: sk372

entry: They prefer to avoid others and release powerful electricity to even avoid having records of them be obtained. Even if tamed and treated well, they rarely like to be perceived and may temporarily disable their Trainers' devices with electric surges.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a loyal fusion. The chainsaws on its arms and head can easily cut through metal. Many Trainers think it resembles a fictional character.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME pranks seniors by leaping out of their computer screens, plasma blade drawn. However, its code of honor forces it to compensate its victims afterward by helping them with their devices.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It arose from a spirit possessing an obsoleted piece of technology. It's said the antenna on its head receives signals from lost worlds.
author: r.isk

entry: POKENAME essentially functions as a tool that can move heavy objects with ease or a "less lethal weapon" that can do the same with living things.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME appears only in electrical deadzones, and is never seen moving between them. Researchers attempting to capture one often find their equipment malfunctioning, as if its presence alone corrupts electrical systems.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It has taken control of a wood chipper. Despite not being very large, it will eagerly consume entire trees when hungry.
author: hophoppip

entry: Bound to arcade cabinets, POKENAME seek out humans who will interact with them. A study on food consumption revealed that POKENAME will destroy any pizza it sees, but it is not clear why.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME loves to mow down fields of grass to nourish its body, targeting lawns with overgrown grass to eat the grass clippings. Many gardens have been ruined by POKENAME's careless mowing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It has molded its body of plasma into a form reminiscent of a wood chipper, though its blades can grind up small rocks and pieces of ore. It is very friendly and its kind are treasured in many professions.
author: infinex21

entry: As it cannot consume physical matter, POKENAME relies on its powers to drain energy in order to survive. It can siphon energy from electronic devices, other Pokémon, and even sunlight. When fully charged, it emits a glowing green light.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME possesses electronics, its mysterious powers allow it to control wires like limbs and stretch them over what would normally be impossibly long distances. An elusive wild POKENAME is most often found in unguarded gardens.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bright patterns on its back indicate how much electricity is stored inside of its body. Trainers often keep POKENAME as portable batteries.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has earned quite a sour reputation for hanging around gas stations and pretending to offer a refueling, so that it can instead siphon the fuel from people's cars. No one is sure what it does with the siphoned fuel.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are mischievous and playful, often headbutting others which also releases plenty of static electricity. When two POKENAME play, they will often butt heads which releases large, although mostly harmless, electric bolts.
author: infinex21

entry: It is full of energy and loves to fight, be it playfully or otherwise. It holds enough electricity within itself that a full-power Headbutt can paralyze a large foe or release a localized EMP.
author: infinex21

entry: Electricity surges through POKENAME's body, increasing its speed the longer it charges forward. When its head makes an impact, an electrical surge explodes outward and creates a massive thunderclap.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaps into electronics in order to pass along warnings of impending disasters. The messages it conveys tend to be garbled and misunderstood, however, so its warnings often go unheeded.
author: sk372

entry: When possessing electronics with screens, POKENAME makes the objects flash spooky imagery in order to prank others. Ironically, the sound of screams will scare it out of its possession.
author: sk372

entry: Once having been tools of war, POKENAME are now a protected species. They are a favourite of divers and scientists who use them to explore the deep sea. There is no depth in any ocean that POKENAME cannot reach.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME possesses electronic devices to broadcast mind-altering signals. Those affected believe it divine until it leaves the machine.
author: .izik

entry: The shell is electromagnetic in nature, which attracts many Electric Pokémon. This annoys POKENAME, which decides to scare them away.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME seems to gain its strength by battling using moves seen in old fighting games. It gained this power from its diet of old game cartridges.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: As an energy sword of vast power, POKENAME is believed to hail from a land far, far away....
author: rkmaster25367

entry: POKENAME's plasma is shaped into an energy blade. It's a popular Pokémon for those who work with metal because it can be used to cut through steel.
author: fireblade141

entry: It spins its gears to generate electricity, which arcs from its coils to nearby objects. If POKENAME is convinced to use specific frequencies and timings, the arcs form a buzzing melody.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Its body is made of a powerful electric plasma that allows it to interact or interfere with nearly any machine or device. It is an ally to many Rangers due to how ready and willing it is to thwart poachers' efforts.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses unprecedented levels of electricity to devastate and reshape the land. Its arcs of lightning are powerful enough to split the earth's crust, or stimulate magma deep underground to cause eruptions.
author: sk372

entry: It channels seismic energy through its reinforced plating, converting Earth's vibrations into electrical power. Upon impact, its systems release an electromagnetic pulse that can disrupt electrical grids and fracture solid rock.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME release their excess electricity, it tends to appear like clouds nearby are crackling with thunder. Some of these Pokémon love to fly near airplanes and jets, and have even helped avert crashes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME acts as a global positioning device, showing its current location on its screen. Using the buttons to view another area will cause one to instantly teleport there.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME charges its throws with electricity, then hurls enormous stone javelins over long distances. Stone columns arranged in strange patterns are theorized to be the results of competition between POKENAME.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME inhabits a metronome, changing its rhythm at will. On nights of the full moon, it sings along to its own rhythm.
author: hophoppip

entry: Electrically charged plasma crackles from POKENAME's ears. Those who upset Lopunny by roughly petting its ears will face shocking consequences if they attempt the same with POKENAME.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME zips through the air at insanely high speeds. It teases Bug Catchers, who sometimes pass out from exhaustion chasing them.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: Combining two POKENAME with a DNA splicer revealed Rotom's truest form: Pure energy.
author: xtjs2018x

entry: While its arms are weak on their own, it is capable of connecting them directly to small electrical devices. It can then freely control these devices, which it uses to better interface with the world.
author: varalon

entry: POKENAME is super energetic and chaotic. Wild POKENAME can be seen hanging around power lines.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME takes a special form when it possesses a cotton candy machine. It pranks humans with explosions of cotton candy.
author: hophoppip

entry: These Pokémon eat the static charge that builds up in fabric. Many homeowners welcome the presence of wild POKENAME, as their strange diet helps prevent house fires.
author: turron_turron

entry: Anyone who approaches POKENAME will cause it to print out a paper with a long string of numbers. Supposedly, they represent the exact date and time the person will die.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME's body is made from a defective power hub. It is theorized that plugging all of its plugs into outlets would cause a tremendous explosion.
author: staghorn

entry: After screwing into ordinary sockets, POKENAME absorbs the life energy of those who rest in its light.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A POKENAME's eerie glow causes people to fear that it might steal their soul. However, it has developed to run fully on electricity, making it a safe alternative for those looking for a reading companion.
author: inquis1

entry: Although POKENAME has the ability to levitate and move around uninhibited by most of normal laws of physics, it often moves around by contorting its body to hop around. It produces extreme amounts of light that rarely causes hallucinations in others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wherever POKENAME hangs, disco music emanates from an unknown source. It's nearly impossible to resist dancing to the music, with many people found collapsed on the floor after hours of spirited grooving.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME stomps loudly through crumbled cities and war-torn fields, its presence commanding and cold. The way it scans each ruin is often compared to a seasoned colonel inspecting a forgotten battlefield.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME flaps its wings, a shower of electrical sparks emerge from its feathers. It uses this skill to burn forests, and catch any prey that runs out.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME cloaks its body in a layer of surging, radiant plasma. Its presence is known to violently disrupt and damage electronic devices.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME bodies are mostly made of plasma, which allows them to dart around at extreme speeds. They can use their slender arms to constrict prey before delivering a killer electric shock.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME devours cables and devices that broadcast or receive content, such as television parts, radio antennas, and ethernet cables. It has been speculated that POKENAME somehow feasts on the transmitted content that was coursing through its meal.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Children love to play with POKENAME since its plasma shell is harmless to the touch. However, if the shell is broken, it will send bolts of plasma in all directions.
author: mistymagius

entry: To lure and capture its prey via its electrified traps, POKENAME is able to project images of harmless Pokémon that catch anyone's eye.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: Their electrical surges at the tips of their tails change in volume and speed depending on their emotions. They are so electrically charged that a single touch from one claw can make one's hair instantly stand on-end.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's plasmic body controls a speaker. Its songs can put people to sleep with ease, even when played at a near-earsplitting volume.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME releases a synthetic fragrance from its two plasma roses. Both humans and Pokémon who try to sniff the flowers receive a nasty static shock.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: Found near arcades and bustling shops, POKENAME emits playful signals that attract curious kids inside. It gifts treats to visitors, absorbing the cheerful atmosphere it helps create.
author: ilija09

entry: POKENAME have gooey bodies that can also act as a conductive battery, able to store large amounts of electricity without issue. POKENAME can use this stored energy to power their psychic abilities and also play pranks on unsuspecting victims.
author: npshi

entry: Although they appear physically reminiscent of Zubat, their bodies are composed of plasma and they guide themselves with harmless electrical jolts. They emit a faint glow that often helps travelers to see better within dark caves.
author: infinex21

entry: It absorbs nearby electricity and shoots it off in electrical spikes when threatened or just excited.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: In the few moments that it rests, POKENAME recharges itself on electrical wires, only for just a few seconds.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Their fangs can easily puncture most metals, which allows them to easily drain electricity from machines. When they overeat, their wings glow brighter and small sparks of electricity fly freely.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often inhabit arcade cabinets, emerging whenever an opponent comes too close. It is advised not to make direct contact with wild POKENAME as they have electricity arcing through their segments and poison on their barbs.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME carries itself with unusual pride for such a small Pokémon. When it sprints while wrapped in crackling plasma, its poor manners and heavy body often lead to unintended destruction.
author: fertve

entry: POKENAME performs a slow, rhythmic dance before entering TVs or radios. Though it causes static, some say loved ones briefly appear on screen.
author: .izik

entry: It appears around neighborhoods every week, driving about and collecting garbage.  It does not seem to have a driver.
author: bostroms

entry: It appears around neighborhoods every week, driving about and collecting garbage.  It does not seem to have a driver.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME is said to be the apparition of a tree that got struck by lightning. Some people worship it as a herald of prosperity and good harvest.
author: galactak

entry: POKENAME is said to be the apparition of a tree that got struck by lightning. Some people worship it as a herald of prosperity and good harvest.
author: galactak

entry: POKENAME disrupts radio frequencies around it by absorbing electromagnetic waves. When this occurs, it emits its own ultrasonic waves that are picked up by electronic devices.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME replaces electromagnetic waves with its own, which causes all devices in an area to play whatever melody it wants. Scientists require special insulation to study this Pokémon because of its strange ability.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is commonly used by farmers, its poisonous pollen being a great deterrent for Bug Pokémon. The more electricity it has stored, the more potent its pollen is.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME produces power through gaining points with the game playing out on its screen. The greater the value of a single move or combo, the more devastating the energy output in battle will be.
author: ohok3441

entry: While claw games are rigged against the player, POKENAME is uniquely so; free though it may seem, the cost is an ambush.
author: redhaering

entry: POKENAME can often be found at casinos and Game Corners, where they are sometimes mistaken for ordinary games. While they enjoy lighting up like games, those who yank too hard on their lever are in for a harsh shock.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: When sand with a high iron content is struck by lightning, POKENAME is formed. It likes to collect and play with discarded metal trinkets.
author: odditylad

entry: Most people have a POKENAME lying around their shed somewhere for lawn maintenance. However, it must be fed every once in a while, as POKENAME can chew through the shed if it gets sufficiently hungry.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME frequently possesses a popular Rockruff robot toy beloved by children in Alola. Though the collar around its neck was designed to be harmless, its influence turns it into a shocking hazard for pranks.
author: xyloldi

entry: POKENAME races at incredible speeds using its powerful wheels, while launching rocks from its mane as it moves. Though fiercely loyal to its Trainer, it has a mischievous streak and often pulls pranks on those it trusts most.
author: xyloldi

entry: The parasitic mushroom atop POKENAME's head converts sunlight into electricity. This is unfortunate for the host, as it relies on sunlight for its energy.
author: Trainerrobo

entry: Whenever POKENAME possesses an object, it steadily degrades into pure energy. The light it emits becomes blinding if watched, and it must eventually move on to a new object.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found amassing devices into its body, powering up with each one. Whenever new technology is developed, precautions must be taken to ensure POKENAME does not come into contact with it.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME obsessively mixes sugary concoctions to share with its friends and team, even forgoing rest if it encounters a new recipe. It often chooses to partner with a Heat Rotom to enhance its creations through baking.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The inner core of its brightly-colored body contains both plasma and cosmic particles, fused into an incredibly potent, near-infinite energy. However, POKENAME will often overcharge electric devices and blow them up, making it a risky energy source.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is constantly moving, as if powered by an unknown source. It makes for an effective toy for other Pokémon to chase, as it seemingly never gets tired.
author: hophoppip

entry: Many children have tried and failed to hit all of POKENAME's heads within the time limit. The prize for hitting all three heads is usually a shiny rock, but children enjoy the frantic game more than the prize.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have shown an interest in taking over the appliances of boardwalk diners, holding them ransom until they are given fried potatoes. After receiving the food, POKENAME will zap it again to fry it further, then scarf it down.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Thanks to its high intelligence and ability to connect to internet servers, this Pokémon is often used by large companies to sort and deliver important emails. An undertrained POKENAME will often cause mischief and flood people with spam.
author: milchik

entry: Music plays from the speakers in POKENAME's mouth, as it invites others to sing into its microphone hands. Those who sing off-tempo or off-key too much get blasted back by high-powered sound waves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of a mysterious substance tougher than steel while being less conductive. The hands can temporarily disconnect from the main body, controlled independently by the surrounding plasma.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of a mysterious substance tougher than steel while being less conductive. The hands can temporarily disconnect from the main body, controlled independently by the surrounding plasma.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's only way to communicate is through the static patterns on its television-like "face". These messages are difficult to decipher, and this hurdle often prevents the common POKENAME from being able to connect with other creatures.
author: mar989

entry: The radiation emitted by POKENAME has been the subject of renewable energy discussions in recent years. They are able to increase the size of their radiation bubble at will, unintentionally poisoning those nearby.
author: chibitales

entry: Whilst its face may resemble a plasma screen display, POKENAME appears to have no difficulty in seeing. Since it lacks a mouth, it draws static electricity out of the atmosphere with its twin cable tails in order to power itself.
author: mar989

entry: POKENAME resembles a flotation device that children swim with. When the knob at its side is twisted, it activates hidden flippers tucked below its body to paddle through the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has taken control of a blender. It's best to keep it entertained with lots of things to blend, as it may ruin your clothes with a splash of smoothie if it gets bored.
author: hophoppip

entry: The jingling made by POKENAME's bell-like tongue has a distorted edge to it akin to static. It has a tendency to jump into music-based electronics, sharply raising the pitch of the music they play as long as it dwells within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates a pleasant humming noise as it flies through the air. Electronic screens near it begin displaying small hearts made of static until its presence is no longer close.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is used to replace motorboat batteries in emergencies, because despite being incredibly tiny its body constantly produces plasma. In the wild, this creature swims in huge schools with its own kind, creating glowing trails across the oceans.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME will constantly test their strength against others, their punches able to shatter rock. Their bodies are extremely durable, and they are able to calculate the exact amount of force behind each hit they take.
author: santon5512

entry: It has seven lights on its face that constantly flash with various colors and patterns depending on its mood. It also enjoys dancing to music.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Capable of phasing in and out of electronic devices, POKENAME often short-circuits whatever systems it passes through. Trainers are advised to protect their electronics when keeping one in their party.
author: frokachu

entry: Its electricity is surging and flowing so quick that it runs hot enough to easily create flames. It is a rather mischievous Pokémon that will often start fights without intending to and then flee.
author: infinex21

entry: In cities where regular Poliwag cannot live, POKENAME excel. They gather in the filthy back alleys behind laundromats where they swarm trash bins, looking for the smallest scraps of detergent to drink.
author: inquis1

entry: Unlike their wild cousins, POKENAME excel in urban environments. They gather behind laundromats where they lie in wait. When the time comes that they run out of power, they raid the building in hopes of siphoning enough electricity for the next week.
author: inquis1

entry: As the first Pokémon of its evolutionary line POKENAME is not very powerful. Because of its weak stature POKENAME is best suited to handling its Trainers delicates in the wash.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME may look unconventional, but it can instantly cheer up crying children with its toilet humor. It often attacks Pokémon with its lid open.
author: rigelpogi08

entry: POKENAME loves to prank humans who don't know that they're not sitting on a regular toilet seat. They do this by flushing the toilet unexpectedly.
author: lam0u3tt3

entry: POKENAME's eyes are one of the few things that shine brightly deep under the sea, due to the density of plasma within its body. If seen, it will stare into your eyes with its burning light until you look away.
author: beatdoof

entry: The erratic, wild nature of POKENAME is caused by the turbulence within its body's plasma, half of it now harshly luminescent in UV. Its blinding eyes rapidly change colors when gazing back at any creature.
author: beatdoof

entry: It can float, but seems to instead love rolling around along the ground. If it spins quickly in place, it can generate enough electricity to release a localized EMP.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is beloved by Trainers for its ability to steam clean, wash, dry, and tumble all their owner's clothes for the week. However, if their socks go missing, just know this Pokémon has probably eaten them.
author: inquis1

entry: Despite their idle pose, POKENAME are hard at work. Behind their vacant stare, they are calculating the most difficult problems in the world.
author: inquis1

entry: If a POKENAME covers any form of machinery with its sludgy body, not only will it be able to take control of it, but it can upgrade its capabilities.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: Though it may seem intuitive, using POKENAME as a home appliance has been outlawed in three regions. Despite this, it is still excellent in battle.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME are sometimes blamed for poor grades in Trainer Schools. Being both mischievous and a gaming device, they often trick students into wasting their time gaming.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME thrives on software it devours from within the devices it infiltrates. Consuming malicious code can lead to dire consequences for its health.
author: jreposo

entry: POKENAME are a common cause of oversleeping, inhabiting alarm clocks to prevent them from going off. They do this to keep their targets asleep for longer, feeding on their dreams.
author: santon5512

entry: Inhabiting electronic devices, POKENAME often attempts to hypnotize homeowners to be more tolerant of Pokémon secretly living in their homes. Many confused TV stations have received angry calls due to this.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME lacks the fine mental control required to form its gel into limbs. Instead, it clumsily wiggles through the treetops, telekinetically supporting itself if it slips.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME's appearance causes many to be afraid of it, thinking the bones within are of a victim it has consumed. It's merely a natural part of its physiology, and it is actually quite gentle and harmless to others.
author: sk372

entry: It constantly regenerates its cells and splits off its jelly-like body parts. They are infected with pathogens, which is why contact must be avoided.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME creates a psychic shield around its gelatinous body to protect its soft innards. While it usually keeps to itself, it will intervene when nearby Metapod are harmed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If the connection between the two heads is ever severed, POKENAME will split into separate Duosion and Solosis, and sometimes another Reuniclus.
author: spookoftheoldways

entry: POKENAME sleeps for up to 20 hours a day, preparing for evolution. If approached, it unconsciously uses Harden to form a protective psychic shield around its soft gel cocoon.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME's wings are made of a gel-like substance that makes them less likely to be damaged in combat. However, this leaves its fragile body wide open for attacks.
author: mistymagius

entry: Groups of POKENAME float through the ocean in vast, interconnected sheets. These colonies behave like one large organism, as each individual POKENAME loses bodily functions to specialize and ensure the survival of the colony.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous forearm scythes are incapable of cutting anything on their own. However, POKENAME erects walls of telekinetic force around their edges, letting them shear through most materials unhindered.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Its extremely intelligent, but very easily angered. When it rampages, it causes mass property damage with its strong telekinesis.
author: calelian

entry: POKENAME has many evolution stones at its disposal. When in danger, it will throw the stones at enemies using its psychic power.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: Intelligent, independent and skilled, POKENAME nonetheless takes on the role of a freelance volunteer for others' betterment. Helping with farming, giving emotional support, and rescuing those drowning are merely a fraction of what POKENAME can do.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: A POKENAME's body is mostly made of a dense plasma that can easily conduct electrical currents. They use their psychic powers to control their own bodies and to subdue their opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: This shy, kindhearted Pokémon uses its psychic powers from afar to warn sailors of upcoming danger. Unfortunately, seafarers sometimes mistake the anonymous voice for seasickness-driven madness.
author: creaturecore

entry: The protective fluid surrounding POKENAME is filled with chemicals. Samples of this fluid have supported abiogenesis.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are highly intelligent, using psychic power to shape tendrils from a special liquid that envelops its body. This mystical slime can revive dead plants, split boulders with ease, and releases a calming fragrance to distract foes.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME stores a combustive substance in its mine-like orbs, which explode when in close proximity with the opponent. It is a master of demolition.
author: p0opys0ck123abc

entry: POKENAME's long body is made up of several separate organisms. Their psychic connection leads to an incredibly high degree of body control, making POKENAME an excellent gymnast.
author: dylonk25

entry: A vicious hunter, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hold prey in place. It then injects its prey with a powerful toxin, sealing their fate.
author: giggity._.

entry: A vicious hunter, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hold prey in place. It then injects its prey with a powerful toxin, sealing their fate.
author: giggity._.

entry: Their immense psychic abilities allow POKENAME to navigate even the most unfamiliar of caverns with unmatched speed. They shed old and excess slime as they fly, so spelunkers often follow the trails they leave to avoid dead ends.
author: just_a_few_thousand_crows

entry: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense Psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can rapidly expand in size to intimidate opponents and picks fights with foes much larger than itself. If its foe has the upper hand, it leaks a toxic gel that it can control and sprays it over its foe, often causing them to flee.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: If surprised, POKENAME tucks its head and feet in and spreads its cytoplasm into a protective layer around itself. Since it often remains in this state for hours, Trainers must learn to avoid sudden movements.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME's impeccable knowledge of insects stems from its immense brain. The gold globs under its skin are honey reserves for when food is scarce.
author: iaobug

entry: The cells within POKENAME have been mutated by unstable radiation, developing a wider range of power, but losing a majority of their physical structure as a result. POKENAME sleep inside the containers they carry to make sure they stay together.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME manipulate their cytoplasm to form wing-like structures, enabling them to fly and search for food. The thick gel is resistant to harm and can be rapidly withdrawn into the core of the body if a threat is presented to them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If POKENAME loses a limb, it can split a new one off the ones remaining. In battle, its arms wield several psychic forces at once to overwhelm opponents.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME manipulate their cytoplasm to form wing-like structures, enabling them to fly and search for food. The thick gel is resistant to harm and can be rapidly withdrawn into the core of the body if a threat is presented to them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME connect their tail arms together, they are able to transfer all information they learned between each other. It is believed that linking hundreds of these Pokémon together could simulate a supercomputer network.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME connect their tail arms together, they are able to transfer all information they learned between each other. It is believed that connecting hundreds of these Pokémon together could simulate a supercomputer network.
author: soup1900

entry: The gel is constructed of pure psychic power. POKENAME uses this power to manipulate the weather and conjure storms of great magnitude. Many speculate about how strong the infantile Pokémon within really is.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Using its remarkable intellect, POKENAME directs many other psychic Pokémon as one force. These groups often protect weak and vulnerable ecosystems.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Its "shoulders" are lesser heads that have their own brains, further expanding its psychic powers. The liquid surrounding its main body is a special form of solid plasma that is always electrically charged.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME eats food by absorbing it into its gooey vines. Its body is so squishy that it can be crushed by a heavy object and emerge from it unharmed.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME naturally cannot fly. However, it does fly using psychic powers that it has trained to perfection.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME has great knowledge about the world around itself and excels at controlling its psychic energy. POKENAME chooses to enjoy the small victories and the company of those who surround it.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is one of the most intelligent Pokémon. It has the combined thought power of four brains. Its internal body is made of pure steel.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME are acutely aware of the unique traits that make an individual, both biologically and mentally. Data suggests they can measure the compatibility between themselves and a potential Trainer with a single glance.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The flower sprouting from POKENAME is actually its brain. The chlorophyll inside its body has seeped out, congealing into a toxic membrane that amplifies its psychic power.
author: brainiax

entry: Using its prodigious psychic powers, it controls the special liquid surrounding its body to swim. Even when diving to depths of over 10,000 feet, it emits a faint glow.
author: pizzarcato

entry: Once worshipped as a god of the future, POKENAME granted false prophetic visions to followers. Its gelatinous body trembles as it meditates deeply, linking arms with any worshippers nearby.
author: .izik

entry: Before being properly recorded as a real Pokémon, POKENAME's likeness was captured almost perfectly as a cartoon character some years ago. Although stated to be a coincidence, some theorize this Pokémon's power over others' minds was the cause.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are capable of restructuring their bodies to imitate other creatures down to a cellular level. They morph individual parts they've studied to better understand how they function.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's feelers are made of the same gelatinous membrane as its body, and leave a slimy residue on anything they touch. On humans and other Pokémon, this slime absorbs into the skin and soothes the muscles, akin to a salve.
author: sk372

entry: The membrane surrounding POKENAME is delicate. It floats, only touching things with its extra limbs.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME tend to explore through touch. If treated with care, they'll be incredibly affectionate.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME enjoys mimicking a simple discarded doll in order to lure curious onlookers closer. Once they near it, it opens up its zippers and extends its gelatinous limbs all about in order to frighten them as a malicious prank.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's healing moves are state-of-the-art; no Pokémon can surpass its diagnostic power. With its discovery, the Chansey has now increasingly come to represent the archaic past in Pokémon medicine. This Pokémon is the envy of every Pokémon Center.
author: inquis1

entry: Combining two POKENAME with DNA splicers has given them the ability to continue to split. In time, they may grow too large to contain.
author: xtjs2018x

entry: POKENAME can be found in the desert, feasting upon candy they steal from travelers. The popularity of POKENAME and their nature has seen a selection of gummy candies produced, modeled after them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME consists of what looks like a small humanoid encased in a coffin of psycho-conductive slime. It remains unknown whether said humanoid is dead, alive, or something in between.
author: dylonk25

entry: The organelles floating within the body of a POKENAME have been specialized to produce electricity. They will run large amounts of voltage through the body of their prey before crushing them with extreme force.
author: vic1312

entry: Small globs undulate almost hypnotically around within POKENAME's twin limbs, casting a faint light in darkness. The substance moves in accordance to its mood, becoming more rapid in movement if POKENAME is agitated.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are highly curious, collecting different chemicals to try and test their compositions. If POKENAME are ever provoked, they will combine the chemicals to create combustion, igniting powerful and colorful blasts.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Supposedly, the gelatinous body protects the core of this Pokémon. This gel can absorb most attacks with minimal impact to its shape or stature. Its axe-like tusks are are made of heavily compressed plasma and exude weak psychic energies.
author: infinex21

entry: It is believed that if you look at this Pokémon in the eyes, you will either be paralyzed, or worse, dead. That said though, POKENAME will let you feel the gelatinous membrane that encases the mask.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: The main body in POKENAME's torso controls the three heads with its psychic powers. If any of its heads gets cut off, they will regrow in a matter of seconds.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME limply flails its arm to imitate an injured Pokémon, attracting attention of other Pokémon. POKENAME forcefully grabs hold when something gets close, poisoning the target with its goo layer for later digestion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It's not hard to notice that POKENAME have trouble coordinating both halves of their bodies. However, they've got more than enough power to compensate for any stumble.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME are always found in odd devices that somehow effortlessly glide along the ground to move. How they first entered the tanks and what purpose the liquid inside serves are still mysteries.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: According to ancient manuscripts, POKENAME with certain genetic mutations could evolve yet another time. Unfortunately, fossil restoration deemed this certain code as a mistake, ceasing further evolution.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Its psychic powers hold prey in place as it rips into them with its fangs. POKENAME's toxic gel seeps into the wounds it inflicts, ensuring that even if prey momentarily escape, they will be too weak to survive a second attack.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME has a gelatinous form it can manipulate to enhance its body's aerodynamics. Its excellent hearing and psychic abilities allow it to locate prey in any environment.
author: leofric1814

entry: POKENAME's thick, protective slime shields it from harm, and its powerful mind controls this ooze to form unbreakable psychic barriers. Despite its strength, it is gentle by nature and fond of giving big, slimy hugs.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME control their body with a host of brains all around their giant armor-like body. Despite their soft appearance, their body is hard as a rock.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME are exceedingly dangerous Pokémon, known to envelop and digest any prey with ease. Despite this, POKENAME rarely react to stimuli and spend much of their time aimlessly wandering about caves.
author: turron_turron

entry: The green gel composing POKENAME's body is derived from seaweed. It displays a strong fascination with shipwrecks, and will rip off chunks of rotten wood to play with.
author: pizzarcato

entry: It deftly wields its many tentacles, giving it ample defense and mobility. If pricked by the spine on POKENAME's head, the victim experiences painful headaches as a result of being infused with POKENAME's psychic energy.
author: sk372

entry: A special liquid on its back controls POKENAME. Just one of its powerful hands can crush a tree trunk.
author: pizzarcato

entry: POKENAME's soft body is remarkably resilient and powerful, but it has a meek personality and generally keeps to itself. Even if cornered, it prefers to distract opponents and find a way to slip away from combat rather than fight continuously.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can harden the gelatinous horns on its head before removing them to toss as projectiles. The thrown horns melt away shortly after, and new ones regrow on POKENAME's body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to spout its special liquid and attack enemies flying above. It grows stronger the more liquid is inside of its shell, so it siphons this fluid from other Reuniclus to increase its power.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's three segments appear to grow and mature independently. Once one segment learns how to manipulate objects with telekinesis, the others often grow lazy and reliant on it.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to protect nearby Wurmple and detect predators. Should it spot a threat, it unleashes toxic powder and telekinetically redirects it at the foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME skitters along the surface of water bodies, supporting itself with its psychic abilities. Though its gel smells delectably sweet, aggressors quickly discover the gel's toxic properties.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: The eye-like objects suspended in POKENAME's gel act as focal points for its psychic prowess. When fixed by a glare from POKENAME, opponents are assailed by waves of fear and doubt.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME's psychic power prevents its gel from dissolving into the murky waters in which it lives. If provoked, POKENAME channels this power into concussive blasts strong enough to trigger earthquakes.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Its many eyes not only give it 360-degree vision but also transmit energy to the brain suspended within its gelatinous body. With the psychic waves it emits from its arms, POKENAME can lift massive chunks of earth into the air.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Though POKENAME can soar through the sky with the power of its telekinesis alone, it is often spotted flapping its arm-like appendages anyway. Trainers report that POKENAME's gel is faintly banana-scented.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME's psychic power lets it manipulate its body into a short, yet powerful form. Its gelatinous form can reshape the size and length of its arms to better grab and punch opponents.
author: sk372

entry: A vain Pokémon, POKENAME spends much of its time attempting to shape its gel to resemble muscles. It must constantly concentrate to maintain these shapes, so POKENAME avoids conflict whenever possible.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME uses strong psychic powers to help it manifest four super-strong arms to battle with. It can manifest these arms from any part of its gelatinous form, allowing it to strike and counter from all manner of unorthodox angles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's acidic gel quickly breaks down any encapsulated organic material, efficiently absorbing nutrients. POKENAME prefers eating with its mouth, though, so it is often seen poking its head out of the gel to nibble snacks.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME float through the air and attach themselves to their prey before draining their life force. It's said that POKENAME dislike cold temperatures, making them less aggressive during the winter.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME searches for prey below it on the mountain slopes where it lives, then retracts its gel into a perfect sphere and rolls downward at high speed. After slamming into its prey, POKENAME returns to its normal shape and begins throwing punches.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Despite its amorphous body, it can run at speeds of over 130 miles per hour. It is said that in the rare event that a POKENAME trips and falls while at a full gallop, the resulting tumble will cause it to break apart into multiple smaller POKENAME.
author: staghorn

entry: While dim-witted on their own, POKENAME can link their hands together to form a network between their brains to increase their intelligence.
author: darkweavile428

entry: It can shoot its protective fluid at opponents. It uses telekinesis to guide the path of its bullets. It can hit enemies as far as 10 miles away accurately.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME gather up the discarded shells and spines of long dead shelled Pokémon, using them as structure and protection for their gelatinous core. Using their psychic powers, they propel the spines they gather up as projectile weapons.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legend says POKENAME's desperate desire to go home caused the growth of the moon on its back. It sometimes gives dreams of the moon to travelers.
author: zombieshinx_

entry: Absorbing too much moonlight causes it to build up unstable energy, leading to explosive consequences. This makes it a hazardous presence on clear, moonlit nights.
author: .izik

entry: It fiercely defends its nest with brilliant rays of Moonblast. The radiance of its attacks often deters even the most determined predators.
author: .izik

entry: Groups of POKENAME prance around carefree in small mountain ranges. They all have telepathic connections and can communicate wordlessly with one another. When their bodies start to glimmer, POKENAME begin to display powers they do not typically have.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers sleeping under direct moonlight. When in a deep slumber, a soft cooing can be heard from within its skull.
author: .izik

entry: When it swings its bone, it lets loose crushed gemstones. Kanto astrologists use the pieces to divine the future.
author: .izik

entry: Its Life Dew is known to heal even the most severe wounds, restoring life to those in critical need. Many Pokémon seek it out in times of great distress, hoping for its healing touch.
author: .izik

entry: The stardust expelled from POKENAME's body clings to clothing and fur and causes hallucinations when inhaled. Bright, twinkling lights are the most common experience caused by stardust inhalation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME places itself in areas with open skies, vibrating intensely when the moon is out. It is believed that absorbing moonlight hastens the evolutionary process within the cocoon.
author: sk372

entry: The cloudy dust POKENAME expel from their body resembles stardust. Many who inhale these particles describe hallucinations of flying through space.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To keep allies safe, it uses Follow Me, drawing attention away from them. This selfless act ensures its companions remain unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: Powerful Rock Slides are its primary defense against threats. It uses these attacks to block pathways and protect its territory.
author: .izik

entry: It creates trinkets from small rocks, gifting them to travelers for good luck. These thoughtful gestures make it a beloved companion among those on long journeys.
author: .izik

entry: On moonlit nights, POKENAME holds its Cleffa up toward the sky for hours. No one knows why, but some believe it is a ritual to bring good fortune to its offspring.
author: .izik

entry: Those who gaze for too long at POKENAME's glimmering, ethereal wings feel an intense yearning to return to stars they have never seen.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can summon a shield by channeling its desire to protect its friends. The gem on its abdomen glows when it uses mystical powers.
author: hophoppip

entry: During meteor showers, POKENAME can be seen carving unique symbols onto trees using their sharp scythes. Astrologists have spent years deciphering what these symbols mean.
author: mistymagius

entry: It likes to elegantly dance atop the highest mountains during lunar eclipses. Those who witness its movements find themselves dancing along with it.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME have naturally incredible hearing, so they tend to be very elusive. When their body is charged with electricity, their tail curls further, their wings start to flutter, and they even begin to float.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The three tails of POKENAME sparked controversy among people of the past. Ancient scriptures detailed that POKENAME descended from the stars, and that its tails told a story of our solar system.
author: jojojax164

entry: After bathing in enough moonlight and witnessing enough full moons, POKENAME take to the skies and fly out to be amongst the stars. They will rarely return to the pools they lived in as Clefkarp, but can sometimes be seen during a new moon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: After bathing in enough moonlight and witnessing enough full moons, POKENAME take to the skies and fly out to be amongst the stars. They will rarely return to the pools they lived in as Clefkarp, but can sometimes be seen during a new moon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are thought to bring good luck to those who spot them. Though due to sightings being scarce, it's hard to prove these claims.
author: bigoljax

entry: If you throw an item at POKENAME's back, the object teleports away to an unknown place. Researchers are still researching this phenomenon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: If it catches sight of its reflection, it may become anxious and lose focus, breaking its mimicry. This moment of vulnerability reveals the delicate nature beneath its playful exterior.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are said to come from outer space, as their erratic flight patterns are rarely seen in the wild. They only emerge out on nights of the full moon, appearing in groups in the sky and shooting Moonblasts at anything below them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon has consumed so much food that its belly has turned into a black hole from all the mass. In practice, not much has changed.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME regularly sheds its skin on a weekly basis. The discarded skin will glow and sparkle like stars when moonlight shines down upon it.
author: sk372

entry: Stories of POKENAME giving small children wondrous and magical rides through the night sky are common. Confirmed sightings, however, are rare.
author: staghorn

entry: Its venom induces confusion and sleepiness in whatever it stings. The stingers on its arms glitter when exposed to moonlight.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME attracts tiny burning meteors to attack foes that stumble upon their isolated nests. These meteors are often mistaken for shooting stars, which many Trainers make wishes upon.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon that frolic together in the moonlight. They have acute hearing and will scatter if approached by Pokémon or people.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are drawn to meteor craters and will make burrows inside the fallen rocks. They can be seen on a full moon chasing one another around the meteors, cavorting together in the moonlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Nocturnal by nature, POKENAME is most active during nights where the full moon hangs overhead. Groups will sometimes gather in the moonlight and croon upward in reverence to the celestial body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are completely nocturnal, resting inside trees during the day. At night, they spin intricate webs in the shapes of constellations, which glimmer in the moonlight.
author: santon5512

entry: Throngs of POKENAME gather together during full moons to spin massively intricate webs across the forest. Their webbing sparkles in the moonlight, turning the forest into a bright and breathtaking sight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's smile conceals a sharp set of fangs. However, it is much too shy to bite humans. It flies silently to not disrupt its sensitive hearing.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: If POKENAME cannot see the full moon on a night when one is present, it chirps nonstop in distress. Some Trainers carry Moon Stone pendants to calm it down.
author: .izik

entry: Long, fine hairs sparsely cover its body. They shimmer like stars even in the pitch-black depths of the sea.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is also called the "Galaxy of the Deep". The largest ones can be seen glowing from the ocean's surface even at depths the sun cannot reach.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME have a strange affinity for the stellar energies contained within Moon Stones. They will seek out even the smallest fragments of the strange stones, the energies within them empowering their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gather in groups to gaze at the night sky. Legends say that they are looking for other lifeforms in distant galaxies.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's wool changes color when electricity flows through it, with hues ranging from dark midnight black to lavender purple. Some people believe that its wool pattern mirrors a section of the starry night sky.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME chase meteor showers across the night sky, barely visible against the light of the moon. Ancient legends surrounding POKENAME say that they came to our world on a meteor and that they are searching for more of their kind.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME absorbs the moon's light into its body, amplifying the power of its electricity. On full moon nights, its fur crackles with energy, making its wool glow faintly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are usually seen flying high above the clouds. Many astronauts have even reported seeing some above the atmosphere.
author: bigoljax

entry: This Pokémon loves to dance under the moon in groups. When it is a full moon, their flower petals glow brightly; it is said to bring good luck to anyone who sees this.
author: barfy_here

entry: In spring, POKENAME is carried by thermal updrafts. It rarely comes down due to its light body not being able to exit an air current.
author: karmaofevil

entry: POKENAME typically rides solar winds in order to travel from planet to planet. Its pollen is only able to grow on planets or moons with solid surfaces.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are completely nocturnal, emerging at night to forage for food. Their sensitive ears can pick up sounds from miles away, making them highly elusive. They will often flee to their burrows before they even know what's coming.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME sleeps during the day, and even during summer nights. On cold nights, it gazes at the moon, gills twitching. It even jumps into water where it sees the moon's reflection, never seeming to learn that it cannot catch it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Day or night, POKENAME never lose their way. Using their star-chart tail, they navigate in flocks on the ground. When hot air balloons are in the area, though, they take to the skies, protecting them from attackers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME have lots of knowledge to share with the world but lose these powerful insights at dawn. Scientists have made expeditions into the wild to try to study these nocturnal creatures, but they rarely remain in one place for long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME picks up fallen moon fragments to form its lunar bulb. Using this bulb, it absorbs moonlight to fuel its attacks.
author: turcai_87271

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen by human eyes. Those who are lucky enough to find one are shown beautiful visions of deep space.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Its graceful movements emit subtle waves that distort reality, causing objects to appear weightless around it. Scholars say its circular shape represents infinite cosmic harmony.
author: jaminmcready

entry: During the day its shell closes shut, impossible to open or damage. At night POKENAME emerges to feast on sleeping prey. If spotted it will violently spin while spraying metal shards that tear through steel and concrete.
author: ehard

entry: A Pokémon the size of a star. Its head is so massive that it has started pulling all planets of our solar system behind it.
author: funkytomate

entry: Ancient myths claim POKENAME hovers completely motionless in the sky just before a meteor strikes. Waiting in the upper atmosphere, it uses its steely pincers to effortlessly crush incoming space debris into harmless dust.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is quite reclusive, and only seen in the wild in forests at night. On nights containing full moons, it stands directly in the moonlight, its horn sparkling from the touch of moonbeams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's acute sense of smell and hearing allows them to detect where ripe berries and streams of water are. Their light movements in the middle of the night allow them to move without being noticed.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Some people collect fragments from the shell of POKENAME, believing them to have healing properties or provide good luck. These are rare, as POKENAME often avoid humans and other Pokémon by living underground.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME somehow flies faster during full moons, soaring effortlessly through the night sky. Researchers have yet to determine why moonlight enhances its speed.
author: .izik

entry: They will typically appear on the night of a full moon, gathering in a circle on mountains to exchange trinkets they've collected on their travels.
author: pankiwi

entry: Schools of POKENAME jump and glide over moonlit oceans as if defying gravity. An old legend claims POKENAME dotted the sky with their sparkling scales, creating the stars known today.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME prances and chirps about during nights when the moon is bright. It sheds pink metallic feathers that glow brightly in the moonlight, making them a popular accessory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can hear the glitchy sounds of viruses from several computer systems away before they even enter the computer it's in. It spends most of its time learning about space, specifically about moons of any kind or from any planet.
author: soup1900

entry: It makes its home in forest caves, where the ambient magic enhances its abilities. The tranquil energy of these caves provides a safe space for it and its allies.
author: .izik

entry: It is rumored that before evolution, this Pokémon meets with its male counterpart in the wild on full moon nights to exchange Moon Stones.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME draws an ethereal liquid into its syringe on full-moon nights. Anyone injected with this substance will forever lose the need for sleep.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME dashes upon the moonlight, its elegant mane shimmering like the stars of the night sky. It is believed that it listens to voices inside of moonlit lakes who tell it where waters have been tainted and fouled.
author: soup1900

entry: Supposedly, the first POKENAME was discovered within a crater, though it remains debated if it was drawn to the crater or if it was what created the crater. POKENAME becomes most active on moonlit nights, though it also seems to become stronger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME likes to gather with others of its kind during a full moon. When they do so, they often spark a minor electrical storm.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: If a time period POKENAME tries to travel to is too noisy, it will avoid it entirely. This behavior is backed up by the hundreds of records of POKENAME sightings during pre-colonization eras compared to the almost zero amount today.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tail absorbs energy from the moonlight, becoming lighter as it does. This helps POKENAME to float gently on the surface of water.
author: hophoppip

entry: On full moons, groups of POKENAME will gather and dance for the moon. They can often be seen juggling rocks that they find along the ground.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME searches for round moonstones to keep in its pouch. If it finds a Moon Stone rounder than the one it has, it will give it to whoever or whatever is closest.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: It stores energy it absorbs from the moon in its cheeks. Glands in its cheeks convert this energy into electricity that it can unleash on command.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It loves to skip across bodies of water using its small wings, creating colourful sparks with each step. On nights with a full moon, whole groups of POKENAME can be seen discharging electricity in celebration.
author: thatdanguy23

entry: It can eat its weight in Nanab Berries without slowing down. This insatiable appetite makes it a frequent visitor to berry orchards.
author: .izik

entry: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.
author: chorb33

entry: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME generates a strange type of stardust from the holes in its palms. It can fire this material out in a constant stream, or condense it tightly into an orb and fire miniature meteorites to pummel its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME generally gravitates towards places where meteorites have regularly impacted. It snacks upon the remnants of these stellar objects, their jaws often colored black from crunching on the extraterrestrial stones.
author: sk372

entry: It wanders deep in jungles, using its vines to navigate through dense foliage. This Pokémon is known to assist lost travelers, guiding them to safety with gentle tugs.
author: .izik

entry: In addition to electricity, POKENAME produces an unusual type of energy that leaves foes dazed and allies invigorated. Due to its rarity, the full potential of this energy has not been well-studied.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon is said to grant good luck to those who witness it during a lunar eclipse. Sightings of it outside the valley of Mt. Moon are rare.
author: nuclader

entry: POKENAME make excellent companions for young children who are scared of the night. Their tails light up with a soft pink glow thanks to their electrical power, an ability they make a habit of using when they see the moon rise at night.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its tusks are made of the same composition the moon is made out of. Its fur is capable of protecting the Pokémon from extremely cold temperatures.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will often help other Clefairy and Clefable by destroying boulders that obstruct their path. They also help form the caves that those Pokémon live in.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME often inhabits a user's files that depict the moon. If this file is deleted, it will go on a rampage through the user's files.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME is a scout to its siblings due to its great hearing. When POKENAME sense the presence of people, it will return to its siblings with light chirps before helping to guide them to a safer location until the intruders pass.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: These nocturnal Pokémon use their wings to add the feeling of weightlessness to their steps. If other Pokémon are in trouble, POKENAME will sprint to their aid, even across water, and use their sharp talons and claws to slash at attackers.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Known as the 'Guardians of the Moon,' POKENAME vigilantly watch over deposits of Moon Stones. Should anyone attempt to remove one, they will emerge from the shadows to reclaim the stolen treasure.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Scaling large mountains with the help of their powerful legs, POKENAME bask in the light of the moon. By dancing in the moon's rays, their scarf-like feathers will begin to glitter and glow like the stars.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Living high in the mountains, POKENAME keep watch through the night, protecting any Pokémon sleeping nearby. With their powerful legs and wings, they can leap from towering cliffs and land gracefully wherever they are needed.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME can be quite clumsy at times, wearing helmets made from a material similar to moonrock to protect themselves. It is said that these Pokémon have a psychic connection to the moon itself, often seen attempting to communicate with it.
author: santon5512

entry: If its Trainer is having trouble falling asleep at night, POKENAME will dance around them beautifully while singing a soothing lullaby.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Harnessing the energies of the stars, POKENAME's fists are as powerful as meteor strikes, able to punch a hole through anything. Ace Trainers have noted POKENAME as exceptionally great partners based on their power and their exceptional intellect.
author: beatdoof

entry: It is mostly sedentary, soaking up power from the stars. When struck by the full moon, the majestic radiance of its blossom entrances all that see it.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME were recently discovered, dragging themselves onto the beaches of Cinnabar Island. Researchers tracked these Pokémon to a meteorite that had fallen into the ocean some years ago, which appears to act as their breeding ground.
author: laughing_dan

entry: It is rumored that items POKENAME absorbs into its hollow body are actually sucked into a portal leading directly to the moon. While this has been proven false, no one knows why it only absorbs objects during full moons.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME travel through the cosmos in search of friends to bring along on their adventures. Unfortunately, they don't seem to understand why most are hesitant to travel to space without proper equipment.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Old religious writings credit POKENAME with causing the moon to shine each night. Entire lunar dances were performed in reverence of this belief.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is cowardly and will hide in its sheath at even the slightest provocation. POKENAME never forgets a face, however, and it sheds its timidity under the full moon to hunt those who dared harm it.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME store moonlight in their scabbards to help them regain energy while they sleep. In battle, POKENAME fling themselves back and forth using their ribbons, creating a dazzling display of stars.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's shield emanates a strange power that causes everything around it to act as if they are under lunar gravity. On rare occasions, during full moons, it uses this force to build itself a bridge reaching towards the moon itself.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's shield emanates a strange power that causes everything around it to act as if they are under lunar gravity. On rare occasions, during full moons, it uses this force to build itself a bridge reaching towards the moon itself.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's blade is thought to be made of pure Moon Stone, though it is unknown how it came to be. The Clefable-shaped shield it carries glows with a soothing light when shielding its body.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's blade is thought to be made of pure Moon Stone, though it is unknown how it came to be. The Clefable-shaped shield it carries glows with a soothing light when shielding its body.
author: chibitales

entry: Legends say that POKENAME are created from large moon rocks that fell down to earth. They're usually seen gazing up at the moon, as though they wish to visit home again.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME are only ever seen during the night, drawn to the surface of the ocean during moonlit nights. The movements of their tails leave sparkling trails in the water reminiscent of shooting stars in the night sky.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has forged the ring spinning around it by itself. Scientists believe that this is its way of dealing with homesickness.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME's long hair appears as if it is the very cosmos itself due to their powers of illusion. They seem to feed on moonlight and, thus, are only active at night.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are wary of humans. Their large ears are constantly monitoring the environment of possible threats.
author: melodydelune

entry: Despite its great size and strength, POKENAME is actually quite friendly. It actively avoids getting involved in any type of fight or conflict.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's deep-sea layer is decorated by sparkling stones dusted with the stardust coating its large fins. It only comes up from the depths during the full moon, where it breaches the water and glides about beneath the moonbeams.
author: sk372

entry: It's said this Pokémon captured the moonlit sky in its sharp claws and nails. Researchers believe it's the result of it coming into contact with a Moon Stone. It can easily jump into the sky as if it were on the moon.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME soars throughout the vast emptiness of space, protecting the world from a number of intergalactic threats. They are very playful Pokémon and return to humanity every so often.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of pure cosmic energy. It is very rarely seen on this planet.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of pure cosmic energy. It is very rarely seen on this planet.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME enjoy soaring through the night sky to watch the stars above them. It is said that whenever a star in the night sky fades away, POKENAME let out a cry into the endless cosmos as their tail pulses with stardust flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is aggressive and quick to anger when mocked for its pink, fairy-like appearance. However, on nights of the full moon, this Pokémon's attitude transforms into a happy-go-lucky one as it dances under the moonlight.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME gathers stones and arranges them in a perfect circle once per week. On moonlit nights, it dances gracefully within the formation, glowing softly as it moves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME float through the night sky to gaze at the stars. On nights of the full moon, they can be seen locking ribbons with each other in patterns resembling constellations.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME meticulously decorates its long ears with a collection of colorful stones and gems. Many myths surrounding this Pokémon say that it could reach the moon with a single leap, though no evidence supports this claim.
author: mepp.

entry: The space-like spores POKENAME releases have an anesthetic effect on its recipients. Because of their low side-effects, these spores are popular among surgeons. Those that are under their influence always dream of dancing with Clefairy on the moon.
author: teatedtiten

entry: With gravitational fields and the power of the stars, POKENAME hide from scientists who wish to study their astrological powers. The only trace they leave behind is a black gel that melts into stardust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When two Clefable fuse into POKENAME, they become innately attuned to the movement of celestial bodies. They can manifest this energy and summon miniature planets and moons, using them to defend themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME glide above rural communities where there are no tall buildings to block their path. On nights of the full moon, they join together to dance in the air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its hands are made out of the void of space. It takes hold of its targets and suffocates them by putting a hand over their face.
author: funkytomate

entry: Peculiar, luminous orbs resembling planets are often observed to be revolving around POKENAME. Scientists have failed to come to a consensus on why this is, however.
author: avidclown

entry: The star atop this fusion's head is filled with cosmic energy. Some believe that if you touch it without getting burnt, you'll be granted a wish.
author: ohok3441

entry: The moon-shaped headpiece cannot be removed from this fusion. Individuals who try to grab at it often find themselves earning a burn instead.
author: ohok3441

entry: The fire on POKENAME's head is fueled by both cosmic power and positivity. It'll burn brighter when it's happy.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME enjoys tracing patterns in the dirt with its tail, often leaving behind shapes no one can decipher. Children say its lullabies bring especially vivid dreams.
author: mgfox_66676

entry: Originally thought to have been pieces of the moon fallen to Earth as meteors, POKENAME contain a mysterious energy that they release in bursts to launch into the air. The Moon Stone that seals a POKENAME's core stores any excess energy.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME baffle scientists because they are notoriously difficult to capture and study. They seem to only appear on nights of the full moon, but vanish the next day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fusion has given POKENAME the ability to levitate using the power of moonlight. Despite being timid, they are playful with friends. Unfortunately, most POKENAME are unaware of the extent of their power, playing too roughly with other Pokémon.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Groups of POKENAME and their brethren prance around lakes under moonlight. It's thought they absorb the moon's energy through this dancing, prolonging their lifespan. When the dance is complete, they howl and shower the area in brilliant pink embers.
author: chibitales

entry: When the moon is high in the sky and shines its brightest, POKENAME are said to give wishes to the first person they come across. Many people come out in droves every lunar cycle in an attempt to locate POKENAME for their wishes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In dreams of becoming a superhero, POKENAME has honed its skills for a long time. It still remains accident-prone, however.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME are immensely lazy Pokémon, spending multiple entire weeks in a row sleeping in one place. The only thing that seems to rouse them is the light of a full moon, which pushes them to eat, drink, and search out a new resting spot.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On full moon nights, clusters of POKENAME float together in a perfect spherical formation, singing in unison. Their combined voices create an otherworldly melody that echoes across the land.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in the ground, using a strong gravitational vortex to pull in its prey. Despite the vortex being powerful enough to pull in a car, POKENAME only goes after smaller Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's wings is an actual depiction of the stars in real time. It lives near clear waters so it can see the moon as it drinks.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME school together under the light of the moon, with the size of the school increasing proportionate to the intensity of the moonlight. They are popular with aquariums due to their vibrant pink colouring.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a unique mechanism in its body that tracks the lunar calendar. At the turn of a lunar year, its body triggers a sound that marks a new year.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to dance with Clefairy and sing in the moonlight with its deep, rumbling voice. Other fairy types dance around it on new-moon nights.
author: leshii

entry: It sleeps all day, flapping its wings as if locked in a nightmare. On days preceding a full moon, however, it dreams sweetly and calmly.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME have budding flowers that bloom on nights of the full moon. It is said that if a person comes across a POKENAME during this time, they will meet their soulmate shortly thereafter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When sensing someone is in a depressive stupor, POKENAME will bury themselves near their homes and release spores. When inhaled, they offer a temporary uplifting feeling in one's heart. They do this out of unadulerated kindness.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME can only be spotted in the wild on full moons. It floats around in meadows with its friends.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME surround themselves with a special black liquid that glows when exposed to matter from outer space. Astronomers often keep them as pets because they enjoy stargazing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: On full moon nights, POKENAME mysteriously stops flapping its wings and glides effortlessly. Some believe the moon's pull allows it to defy gravity for a short time.
author: .izik
