entry: Groups of POKENAME march around on full moon nights. Because of their weird obsession with flags, they are often used in parades.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME patrols ancient catacombs with a certain whimsy, shrinking itself down to stalk grave robbers undetected. Once bored of the grave robbers, it shoots a powerful Moonblast to scare them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its body is incredibly light. POKENAME can fly for hours despite only beating its large wings once every few minutes.
author: welliss

entry: Crystals embedded in its body shimmer under moonlight, amplifying its mystical presence. These crystals are believed to store energy, which it releases during intense battles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves moon-like hard candies such as jawbreakers. It can crush a large jawbreaker with a single Crunch.
author: musicsheep.

entry: This Pokémon from outer space is quite the enigma. Beware when it knocks on your door on cold, snowy nights; it may bring about a blessing or a curse.
author: tr3bles

entry: Its shimmering silver leaves absorb the moonlight at night, fueling POKENAME's magic. On a full moon, it gains the ability to float.
author: hophoppip

entry: It dances gracefully at night, waving its wings in the moonlight. The dark pink feathers on its wings absorb the moonlight to make POKENAME levitate, making it light enough to dance upon water.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses the glowing balls on its arms to create dazzling light shows. In the wild, this serves to confuse its predators, but in domestic settings, this Pokémon is popular as a performance artist.
author: bee4082

entry: The purple 'trash' that is seen on POKENAME is actually fur. It has a calming smell, despite what creates this fusion.
author: rageofthehomeless

entry: POKENAME schools are most active on nights with a full moon, where they can be seen constantly leaping from the water. Some say they hope to one day leap all the way to the moon itself.
author: sk372

entry: Once in a blue moon, POKENAME descend from the sky to visit families that have lost a child. They only stay for a short while before returning to the stars above.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are highly sought after by Beauty Contest performers. They can summon dazzling light displays at will.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME produces a bright pink ice from its body that is rumored to track the movement of celestial bodies and glow when exposed to astrological symbols. Superstitious people rely on these shards of ice to make major life decisions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shards of ice around POKENAME's body glow under the zenith of the full moon. Obtaining a POKENAME shard is difficult, as special suits are required to prevent frostbite when mining these shards.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The head of POKENAME is made of a strange material similar in composition to moon rock, held by a pink metallic body. Attacks roll harmlessly off it, causing its head to spin around the axis that supports it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME descend from beyond the stars and hide themselves among children's toys. Those who sleep while holding a POKENAME dream of cosmic starscapes and distant planets.
author: .realthree

entry: The image of a starlit sky is always visible on POKENAME's wings, often mesmerizing foes with the twinkling of the stars. If the full moon becomes visible within the images, it's said a victory for POKENAME is assured.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce spores that sparkle when they make contact with the air. It is said that each spore is a new star that can be seen in the night sky, which may explain why they produce so few spores.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fusion appears to have awakened a dormant power within Clefable, giving POKENAME its unique appearance. The wings on its back are mostly for show; POKENAME stuns opponents with its dazzling appearance before striking with a fierce punch.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME gather beneath full moons to perform a beautiful ballet illuminated by an odd cosmic energy. If their dance is interrupted for any reason, they will disappear in a scattering of leaves.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The spiral gem in POKENAME's head fetches a high price from collectors. Though it usually prefers to hide, POKENAME can fire lasers from this gem to defend itself from poachers.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Lamps and bright lights irresistibly attract it, making it a common visitor to campsites. While its presence is harmless, it sometimes causes mischief by blocking light sources.
author: .izik

entry: In the wild POKENAME acts like a mercenary, joining Treasure Hunters on their adventures. Using its fairy-like agility, it easily defeats traps, then uses its wand to disable them with flames. In the end, it takes its fair share.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME rely on their foamy bubbles to distract Pokémon as they move through the world. They infuse moonlight into these bubbles to make them sparkle and shine, giving them the opportunity to slip past undetected.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME generates copious amounts of a strange smoke that looks like a star-filled night sky. Though not toxic, inhaling too much may cause a person to experience hallucinations of being in space.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are attracted to light, particularly moonlight. They will gather in groups beneath the moon, rapidly flapping their wings to shake off their loose scales, which sparkle in the light like stars.
author: santon5512

entry: During moonlit nights, POKENAME floats across the sky, trailing bursts of pink light. At sunrise, its ability to float mysteriously fades and it rests on the ground.
author: .izik

entry: The discovery of POKENAME has made waves among the scientific community that believes in the Clefable line having origins in space. On full moon nights, it radiates a strange cosmic aura.
author: sk372

entry: Trace amounts of Moon Stone dust appears in soil POKENAME digs through. Older individuals leave noticeably higher concentrations behind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the power stored in its wings to extend its pounces by up to 20 yards. Because these huge leaps make it look like it's flying, some folklore claims that POKENAME flew to this world from the moon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur starts to glisten when in direct moonlight. The shining stops if it is brought indoors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends most of the month siphoning nectar from flowers until the full moon is bright in the sky. At that point, its wings glow as it enters into a courtship dance with another POKENAME, hoping to find a mate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Folklore claims that if all three of POKENAME's heads wink during a new moon, the witness will enjoy a year of financial luck.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are restless creatures that love to chase the moon-shaped ball on their tails. Whenever the full moon is out, they momentarily stop chasing their tail to gaze upon the moon in the night sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will collect Moon Stones and other precious stones to help it commune with the cosmos as it meditates. It is said it can feel ripples of energy throughout the entire solar system.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It is said that if POKENAME concentrates, it can see images of distant planets. POKENAME becomes so light on its feet from its continued training that it can skip over the surface of water.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME stare at the moon whenever it is visible in the night sky. This practice momentarily rids them of the headaches that they get during the day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using the moon's power, POKENAME soar across the night skies. They use the sharpened ends of their tails to whip their prey, rendering them immobile. There are rumors that POKENAME can move as fast as shooting stars.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME has a special glow that waxes and wanes with each phase of the moon. Many Clefairy and their kin shrink themselves down onto POKENAME to soak in its lunar glow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ears are sensitive enough to sense people's mood, listening for changes in heart rate and breathing. Attempts to train them to help sufferers of anxiety backfired as they frequently attacked the perceived cause of the sufferer's worries.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produces a pearl only when the stars align perfectly. Whoever first touches this pearl is said to live a long life.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME have fuzzy bodies that keep them warm when they stargaze at night. On certain nights when the full moon is out, they howl and bark until dawn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A searing-hot star gleams at the end of its tail. When it unveils its full power, the star outshines the night sky.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The stars on POKENAME's cape reflect unknown constellations, and when it appears to have a meteor shower its psychic powers crescendo. The shard of Moonstone used in evolution has become its main weapon, now appearing in the phases of the Moon.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A wise and mystical Pokémon that wields different powers depending on the phase of the moon. When closer to a new moon, its psychic abilities are stronger, and as the full moon nears, it casts stronger Fairy-Type attacks.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME are active during the night and spend their time breaking apart large stones to find shiny jewels or odd-looking pebbles. Before they go to sleep, all POKENAME do a small dance before lying down.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's physical attack is truly great, making it a powerhouse. However, it barely uses its strength in the wild, as it feels bad when it attacks.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have tiny wings sprouting from their shell. Pokémon researchers have held long debates about the purpose of these structures, the leading theory is that they help improve POKENAME's ability to swim through water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are travelers of the stars, often leaving the world's oceans. Many space telescopes have spotted groups of POKENAME quietly floating around the moon.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME frequently attempts to throw stones at the moon for an unknown reason. Despite its best efforts, no stone has ever been recorded making it past the treetops.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to collect as many Moon Stones as it can find, carving them into unique shapes depending on the phase of the moon. These stones are commonly made into pendants or heirlooms.
author: mistymagius

entry: They use their small wings to help them skip rather far as they trot along the land. Their flames have a mystifying effect of calming foes even as they are burned by the heat.
author: infinex21

entry: Photographers have tried and failed to capture the ethereal sparkle of POKENAME's glittering coat of fur as it leaps under the full moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Photographers have tried and failed to capture the ethereal sparkle of POKENAME's glittering coat of fur as it leaps under the full moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Photographers have tried and failed to capture the ethereal sparkle of POKENAME's glittering coat of fur as it leaps under the full moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If several POKENAME come together on the night of a full moon, they may stick together and evolve.
author: chorb33

entry: On full-moon nights, many POKENAME gather on plateaus or mountains to absorb as much moonlight as possible in order to accelerate their evolution.
author: chorb33

entry: Each of POKENAME's three heads will take turns staring up at the moon throughout the night. Once the sun begins to rise, all three heads will plunge into the ground as if continuing to watch it through the earth.
author: santon5512

entry: During a full moon, POKENAME emerges from the icy waters and dances on the shore with other members of its species. When swimming, it moves with an almost ethereal grace, making it highly prized in beauty competitions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When the full moon is out, POKENAME gather together in small droves and shoot water towards the moon in unison. The streams from their cannons merge and reflect the moonlight, creating a sparkling spectacle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels through wormholes, trying to find other Pokémon to dance with it. While it dances, it sings an eerie lullaby. It only appears on nights with a full moon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Stardust trails behind POKENAME's head, which is believed to be made of moonrock.   They will soar through the night sky, absorbing moonlight which forms into small comets that they can fire off.
author: santon5512

entry: At night, solitary POKENAME float through the sky in search of communities with restless people. If one finds what it is looking for, it will grant a gentle sleep to the humans or Pokémon and then feed off of the positive emotions in their dreams.
author: quietcognition

entry: This Pokémon dreams of flying through the skies. Sadly, this will never happen because of its weight.
author: themicelegion

entry: A cottony fur constantly grows over POKENAME's orb-shaped body. When the fur grows too thick, POKENAME explodes with energy to forcefully shed, sending fluff everywhere.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME covers the bone it wields with some of its own cottony fluff. One strike spreads it around in a small cloudburst, causing irritation and allergic reactions that make it harder for an opponent to fight properly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known for its benevolent nature, often caring for Pokémon displaced by brutal windstorms. It shares its fluff with shivering individuals.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's cotton grows at an alarming rate if exposed to direct sunlight. However, it does enjoy the feeling of privacy it gives.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Wild POKENAME often drift in the air near water, exhaling air through their mouths to help them direct their own movements. They can also spit cotton spores, though this will often cause them to slowly descend if they do so for too long.
author: infinex21

entry: The cotton-like substance around its body muffles nearby sounds, allowing it to mimic others in complete silence. This eerie trait makes it difficult to tell when it is nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have plush fluff covering each of their body segments. The fluff can be spun into garments, but is coated in a caustic venom that needs multiple washes to be cleaned away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A POKENAME is always in a good mood. It loves to transport people across vast expanses of land, keeping its soft shell clean for its next passenger.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME can shed clumps of fluff that retain a bit of its transforming capability, which it uses to prank humans. The clumps take the form of everyday objects, which burst into pollen when interacted with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME drifts above towns seeking radio and television signals. It settles atop rooftops to absorb these frequencies and replenish its energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have plush fluff covering each of their body segments. The fluff can be spun into garments, but is coated in a caustic venom that needs multiple washes to be cleaned away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Wild POKENAME fly up high to find lush fields full of flowers before divebombing into them to add to their fluffy mane. In very rare circumstances a herd of these POKENAME will cause small pollen storms due to the aftermath of their behavior.
author: npshi

entry: Riding swirling gusts, POKENAME emerges with playful ferocity. It bites with surprising force, capable of inflicting significant harm.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME is very popular among Trainers. Groups of POKENAME greet each other by grooming the soft fluff on their heads.
author: kittyluv090

entry: With razor-sharp leaves and immense strength, POKENAME dominates with unrivaled ferocity. Its whimsical appearance belies its formidable power.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME patrols the forest at night to ensure no fires break out. At the slightest spark, it flaps its cotton-soft wings to summon winds that extinguish it immediately.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Shepherds travel with groups of POKENAME to migrate between grassy pastures. POKENAME need their fleece to be sheared daily to prevent them from overheating.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The plumage of a POKENAME is highly sought after. Its downy, fluff-like feathers make the most exquisite beds. Pokémon Trainers often seek this fusion out in lieu of a sleeping bag due to its plush feel and excellent insulation.
author: blake

entry: POKENAME's tight curls give their fur a hypoallergenic quality. When gathered in herds, the gems on their foreheads glow brightly. As they float on the wind, the herd looks like a starry night sky.
author: gloomymort

entry: The follicles that grow the cotton-like hair that sprouts on POKENAME are stimulated by mud. It is common to find POKENAME rubbing mud onto itself to try to speed up its growth.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's fluff is coated in a special oil that prevents it from getting soaked while underwater. Some people use this oil for waterproof equipment.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME prefers to live in marshes where it can submerge its body in thick mud to nap. This leaves its incredibly fluffy growth protruding above the surface, and it does not seem to mind other creatures resting on top.
author: craigprime

entry: The fluff on POKENAME's back has a firm, yet malleable, consistency, so it is often used for arts and crafts.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME draws out the life force from its victims and stores it in the seeds on its neck. It pursues people near their end to return their life force to nature.
author: mistymagius

entry: It burrows underground, using tufts of its own fur to line its den. The cotton retains warmth, making its nest one of the coziest hiding spots in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cotton is a popular material to crochet with, the fine threads able to be spun into a luxurious yarn. Clothing made from their cotton keeps the wearer warm even on the coldest days, giving the feeling of being under the light of the sun.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME raises its young in a nest of briars so that they can learn to untangle their cotton from any kind of snare when they are older.
author: pattybgoode

entry: While traveling through cyberspace, POKENAME's cotton-like hair fills with thousands of lines of code it collects along the way. The lines appear random, and technicians are still studying why it favors some over others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon that spins through the air, scattering cotton everywhere before giggling and slipping away.
author: shyguy11011

entry: Once, a poaching ring attempted to obtain POKENAME's prized cotton fluff for luxury coats. This was quickly shut down when POKENAME proved impossible to reach in the tallest trees and poachers kept getting fruit-related injuries.
author: redmagecole

entry: As highly curious Pokémon, POKENAME meticulously glide across open fields in search of wildflowers. They rub various types of pollen onto their fur to create brand-new smells.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME flits through the breeze sowing seeds of mischief and joy. It brings whimsy to the skies, enchanting all who witness its ethereal dance.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME coats itself in light fluff and fine leaves to help it catch the wind. It uses its claws to climb up high before releasing itself, gliding rather than flying across large distances.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lets data packets run into its thick cotton fluff, trapping them inside. Then, it transfers into a different computer before tearing off its cotton to free the packets, causing the new computer to receive the download instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME run through fields to scatter cotton seeds, making them popular companions for amateur farmers. They enjoy snacking on cotton branches, which helps clear the field when it's time for new seeds to be planted.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are fiercely protective of Cottonee, often hiding them in their fluff when predators are nearby. One documented way that POKENAME fights enemies is to fling mud caught in its fluff with enough force to stun or render its foe unconscious.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Carried about by the wind, POKENAME stops where forests are scarred from fires. By unknown means it purifies the area, the plants rapidly regrowing until the land is green again. It is said its wool is softer than clouds.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME rarely moves on its own, content with floating silently and going wherever the breeze carries it. Its cottony fluff is soft and pleasant to touch, but those who do so feel a strange chill run through their body afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are beloved by families due to their extremely soft and cushiony masses of cotton spores. They are very scared of strong winds and rain, to the point a tamed POKENAME may flee into its Poké Ball.
author: infinex21

entry: On windy days, the wind can blow POKENAME's cotton off its body. In its naked state, POKENAME is noticeably more active.
author: musicsheep.

entry: It takes strong winds to make POKENAME shed its cotton. While in its cottony state, POKENAME is extremely lazy.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Despite having a tough exterior hide, the cotton around POKENAME's neck and arms is as soft as a cloud. A gentle breeze often manifests around POKENAME, carrying with it a sweet spring scent.
author: jadey.1557

entry: Despite its massive size, POKENAME floats through the air, carried by the wind. The cotton it drops mid-flight is prized for its softness.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: The cotton on POKENAME's body falls away as it floats along gentle winds. Plant seeds will sometimes get stuck in this cotton and sprout when it lands on soft soil.
author: chibitales

entry: As the sprout atop POKENAME grows, cotton fibers flourish across its body. In Celadon City, tailors harvest this fluff to make durable swimwear.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever it wishes to fly, it gathers cotton around its lower body before using its staff to make a big leap. Then it rides the wind, going west.
author: skymaster426

entry: As agile as the wind, POKENAME sneaks into the cracks of buildings to steal the life force of small household pets.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Attracted to manicured hedges within graveyards, POKENAME will contribute to the maintenance of the grounds. Landscapers who earn their trust are rewarded with a partner who can clip any plant material the landscaper desires.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME is very popular among hair stylists due to it always knowing what style would best fit the person or Pokémon it's cutting.
author: w1ndowsxp

entry: They are social Pokémon that long to journey with other POKENAME. However, many travel alone, fearing that their sharp claws may harm their friends.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME have many small burs and thorns stuck in their fluff. They avoid contact with other POKENAME lest they become hopelessly entangled.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A devious trickster in battle, POKENAME is unafraid to use dirty tactics to win its fights. Its signature technique is cutting parts of its cottony fluff away to throw into a foe's eyes and blind them, leaving them open for opportunistic strikes.
author: sk372

entry: The hair of POKENAME is not this flowing by default. Instead, this is the result of many hours of its Trainer rubbing shampoo into its scalp.
author: funkytomate

entry: When children get lost in the mountains, POKENAME will float by on the wind to help guide them to safety. These good deeds backfired, as its big, cute, and fluffy appearance has made children get lost on purpose just to meet a POKENAME.
author: redmagecole

entry: This sneaky Pokémon is known to disguise itself in fields of cotton. When the time is right, it jumps out and strikes.
author: holzycookie

entry: This Pokémon lives in temperate climates and builds thick, cotton-like fur in winter to withstand colder temperatures. People report fewer nightmares and improved sleep quality when lying on pillows stuffed with POKENAME's fur.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Ground touched by pollen shed from POKENAME's body becomes controllable by it until the pollen dissipates. It sheds copious amounts in combat so that it can control the entirety of the battlefield.
author: sk372

entry: The cotton from POKENAME is so soft that even it can't resist sleeping on its own fluff. Harvesting POKENAME's cotton is said to be an easy job.
author: xenophacilus

entry: POKENAME's rapidly-flapping wings generate pollen constantly, creating clouds of dusty fluff as it flies about. It pranks others by flying up to them and blowing much of this dust into their face to see them cough and sputter.
author: sk372

entry: Despite weighing practically nothing, POKENAME has perfect control over its aerial mobility. It is easily able to shift from riding the wind and flying under its own power, making it nearly impossible to catch in the sky.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: As POKENAME floats along whirlwinds, cotton from its wings breaks off and blows away. The cotton contains pollen from flowers POKENAME pollinated and often causes allergy outbreaks when it floats through cities.
author: chibitales

entry: Due to its cottony wings, POKENAME only takes to the air on great gusts of wind. Many Trainers are found cuddling them on the ground due to the pleasant heat they give off.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are a common sight at Pokémon contests, their many fluffy tails being a point of pride for both the Pokémon and their Trainer when properly groomed. They are playful on stage, prancing around and eager to impress the crowd.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce silky smooth fur that is spun into trendy yet urbane clothing. They enjoy the sensation of having fur plucked from their bodies and love to examine the clothing that fashion designers make with their fur.
author: quackquackattack

entry: On windy days, POKENAME leaves its pond and floats through the sky. If a person ever comments on a POKENAME's appearance while it is flying by, it will go through their house and scatter balls of cotton before flying away.
author: dualblades1147

entry: POKENAME spins cotton of incredible quality. Cotton factories of the industrial era were heavily reliant of POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME likes to play tricks on other Pokémon. It often frolics around fields pretending to be a ball of cotton.
author: holzycookie

entry: The softness of POKENAME's cotton fluff depends on how nutritionally rich its diet is. Consequently, the poison in its thorns becomes more potent.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME rolls through the world like a tumbleweed, collecting dirt and twigs in their fluffy cotton. If they get stuck on a shrub, they shed the outer part of their cotton to continue rolling.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can produce up to 500 pounds of silk a day, using its excess silk to coat its body. Forests where it lives are coated head-to-toe in its thick silk.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can drift through the air without a single flap of their wings nearly indefinitely. Flocks of this Pokémon have been mistaken for clouds.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: Riding along the night winds, POKENAME goes around cotton fields to bite off cotton from the plants. Unfortunately, if POKENAME gets too much cotton stuck in its teeth, it will become too heavy to fly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME enjoy riding the wind using their soft, light tails to stay airborne. If they see a passerby, they enjoy giving a mischievous shock.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A POKENAME variant who enjoys staying close to the ground and will disguise itself as a patch of grass. Stepping on one can provide a small shock.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME are raised to produce cotton from the moment they leave their egg. Their venom is extracted from their fangs every day to prevent stains in the cotton.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's cotton is softer than a lamb, but it spreads a dangerous toxic powder if it gets mad. Petting it has been said to soothe a stressed heart.
author: typhloquil

entry: Its fluffy cotton coat keeps it insulated from cold weather. However, the moment its coat gets wet, POKENAME is left chilly and shivering.
author: hophoppip

entry: They get energized when exposed to sunlight for long periods, which helps the oxalis in their pompoms blossom. They wave these pompoms whenever their Trainer is sad in the hopes of cheering them up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Presumed to be a compost heap given life, POKENAME scatters decaying plant material beneath it as it rides the wind. It seems to think this is a funny joke.
author: wormspawn

entry: Beneath their thick, lower cotton are slender roots that make up their nervous systems. They must routinely pluck the ever-growing cotton upon their heads, which they often use to leave markers for lost Pokémon and travelers alike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME slept undiscovered in a temple for many years. Its hair grew so long that it had to have a haircut after it was finally caught.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's fluff has a floral scent that makes it a popular material for clothing and fabrics. They often play a role in the textile industry, happily offering their services to help make new clothes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The fluff behind POKENAME is excessive amounts of stuffing that has formed into a soft cushion behind it. Many young children enjoy resting against the plush softness like a pillow.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that the greatest agricultural yield ever recorded happened during a summer a POKENAME appeared under a full moon, shining a bright light over the crops across the land.
author: frokachu

entry: By waving its wooden staff, POKENAME guides groups of Mareep and Wooloo to safety, keeping them away from predators. Thanks to its powerful psychic abilities, it can move leaves and plants at will.
author: fiordaliso

entry: They migrate to geysers on a seasonal basis to soak in heat and mineral-infused water from the eruptions that occur. They enjoy the hot temperatures of the area and are known to rest in the superheated waters nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings are practically weightless, allowing them to glide with the wind for miles. Their wings constantly shed tufts of cotton, which cling to anything nearby, making them a nuisance for Trainers.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME wanders the streets at night and causes mischief by leaving balls of cotton in homes. A person can identify it by its eerie singing.
author: raydrago

entry: POKENAME stores large amounts of water in the cotton on its head. It submerges itself in ponds for hours, as drying out can prove fatal.
author: .izik

entry: Its cotton coat is very flammable, so it will ignite its coat as an intimidation tactic. Because of this, its scales have become resistant to being burned.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon burrows beneath fields, leaving holes lined with fluff. Though pretty, the cotton-like down gets tangled in crops and smothers them.
author: rihse

entry: Whenever the wind lifts leaves off the ground, POKENAME feels an instinct to chase and catch them. When summer arrives, it leaves large patches of cotton wherever it goes, making it easy to follow its trail.
author: fiordaliso

entry: These mischievous Pokémon love to dance in gardens, leaves swirling in the winds that form around them. They're a common problem in urban areas, but people have a hard time dealing with them because of their captivating movements.
author: thordemidgard

entry: These mischievous Pokémon love to dance in gardens, leaves swirling in the winds that form around them. They're a common problem in urban areas, but people have a hard time dealing with them because of their captivating movements.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME cotton is used to make cushions for people who struggle with headaches. Their cotton has psychically absorbent properties, leeching away mental pain when close to a person's head.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME cotton is used to make cushions for people who struggle with headaches. Their cotton has psychically absorbent properties, leeching away mental pain when close to a person's head.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A calm Pokémon with bright smile. It hides Berries and other food in the cotton on its back.
author: themicelegion

entry: If anyone dares ruffle its cotton-like mane, POKENAME flies into a rage and begins punching wildly in every direction. Seeing one is a sign that the forest is extremely healthy, as it needs very clean air to survive.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are often used to herd flocks of Mareep and Wooloo. Studies have shown that they do not like living in heavy urban areas.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Emerging amidst swirling gusts, this Pokémon strikes with venomous stingers concealed within. Many consider it a formidable predator of the seas.
author: anarchaz

entry: It is wonderful to ride on a fluffy POKENAME. However, be far away during battle: the regenerative cotton will explode when ignited by its fire!
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are particularly annoying pranksters because they can slide under doors to spread balls of cotton everywhere. They are tolerated because they eat plastic, converting it into biodegradable cotton fluff.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's large body is made of cotton fluff and tightly-packed dirt. Due to difficulties tunneling through cavern walls, POKENAME contents itself with traveling warm climates and exploring various cotton mills.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME likes to help any weary Trainers it finds throughout the night. It makes soft beds out of cotton, and hypnotises Trainers to help them sleep.
author: holzycookie

entry: POKENAME use their light and fluffy cotton to gather water, soaking up as much as they're able to carry. They take the water to dry fields, using their cannons to spray as much of the land as possible and keep the area lush and growing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can detect prey Pokémon from over 30 miles away, being able to swim through water and drill through the ground to hunt them. POKENAME are capable of tearing through metal with their ferocious Crunch attack.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME seems a bit obsessed with appearing cool to others, waltzing around with an exaggerated swagger to its step. It responds to defamation of its supposed coolness with fiery vitriol.
author: sk372

entry: Capable of seeing prey from over 30 miles away with its keen sight, POKENAME will silently burrow toward its prey and ambush them from below. A Pokémon snatched up by POKENAME is never seen again.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME clings to the ceiling of the tunnels made by Onix, waiting for prey to wander close. It then ambushes them, biting down with incredible force.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can see clearly in the sandstorms it kicks up with its wings and dives at prey with its massive jaws. It was known to battle Aerodactyl that intruded on its territory.
author: kokoria_

entry: POKENAME is just as maniacal as it is cruel. When it's after something, it will stop at nothing, destroying all in its path, be it ally or foe.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME are quite docile, seeking to preserve the massive amounts of energy stored within their bodies. They use their binocular-like eyes to spot any Pokémon that would challenge them before they get near, quickly slithering out of reach.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME is a savage, malicious, and violent Pokémon. Its jaw is strong enough to bite through solid steel.
author: xtjs2018x

entry: POKENAME creates water oases and hides in sand to catch their prey. Rumors say that even big groups of people in the desert go missing when approaching such oases.
author: markusknight

entry: POKENAME has excellent night vision, so it doesn't mind living in dark places, such as inside people's walls.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME produces a gel in its throat that allows it to scoop up sand in its mouth that then goes to a separate stomach-like organ. Here it extracts any moisture before coughing it back up, allowing it to survive in areas few others venture.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME produces a gel in its throat that allows it to scoop up sand in its mouth that then goes to a separate stomach-like organ. Here it extracts any moisture before coughing it back up, allowing it to survive in areas few others venture.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Despite their ferocious demeanor, POKENAME are quite peaceful Pokémon. They prefer to swim in pits of quicksand, keeping them safe from predators.
author: santon5512

entry: The rare POKENAME lives deep in the desert. It is a ruthless and stubborn predator that never backs down from a fight, no matter the odds. If it is forced to flee for reasons out of its control, it will kick up sand with the wings on its back.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When two gangs of POKENAME meet, each sends out a champion with the most impressive pompadour. They circle, attempting to either freeze or get sand in the foe's hairstyle.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A Pokémon known for its quick temper and destructive capabilities. Although they are rash, they are vital in protecting their surrounding ecosystems.
author: rawthorn

entry: As this Pokémon eats, anything that can't be digested ends up in its tail bag. Burglars use this to their advantage, throwing stolen banknotes and precious jewelry into POKENAME's mouth for quicker and easier carrying.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME tries to act all big and bad, but older and larger Pokémon tend to intimidate it back into submission, especially Donphan. Still, in battles, it does its best to intimidate foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When in battle, POKENAME barrels into foes to send them flying. The membrane covering its eyes protects it from harsh sunlight.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon roams places with heavy foot traffic but only appears when few people are around, secretly painting. POKENAME practice their graffiti where everyone can later see their work.
author: jangodiot

entry: Despite POKENAME's small size, it has an aggressive and fearless nature. It has been known to hunt alongside Cacturne, using its sensitive snout to sense the movement of weakened prey.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's glasses protect its vision from the intense light caused by its Electric-type attacks. This Pokémon is known for its swaggering attitude.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME leads packs of Sandikrow and Krokokrow to hunt for food. It secretes a special fluid that keeps sand out of its feathers.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME that live in cities tend to form large groups and patrol a specific territory. If two POKENAME groups meet, a battle always ensues.
author: .realthree

entry: All night, POKENAME swims through desert sands as if they were water. Its horn detects body heat, letting it track prey hidden below the dunes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME pulls its limbs into its vine camouflage as it waits for prey. As soon as something comes within range, it launches its entire body at them, ensnaring them with the very same vines.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME's coiled tail unwinds and splays if POKENAME is particularly upset. Its eyes are filled with electrical energy that cannot be easily defined on the electromagnetic spectrum, allowing it to see or overlook things other Pokémon do not.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are prideful Pokémon, and refuse to help others without some sort of reward or gift. Miners are known to give broken gem pieces to bribe POKENAME into working.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It soars through the skies, looking for prey. It uses its sunglasses to focus sunlight, deflecting a deadly beam down onto its insect prey.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: When POKENAME spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swoops down on them and crushes them with its powerful jaws.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME dig gems alongside miners in a mutual interest to excavate gems. Miners spray potions onto their rust-colored bodies and in return they help miners extend mineshafts farther below the surface.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's eyes are extremely well adapted. They can see through murky water, in the dark, and detect prey from long distances. They can even see heat signatures and fear.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME moves in gangs between desert towns, its sunglasses providing protection against sandstorms. Trainers should not tell it their names or they will be forced to be part of the gang.
author: ghostslythe

entry: High-level businesses have been known to use POKENAME as bodyguards among other roles. It dutifully follows the orders it has been given, no matter how brutish, with a professional stoicism.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME submerges itself in sand to hunt, using psychic powers to detect prey. When it ambushes, it uses its massive claws and jaws to consume metal-rich targets.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME have four brains that run precise calculations, letting them predict and slightly distort future moments. Trainers say they can shift battles a few seconds ahead, dodging attacks before they are made. Their stare is unsettlingly precise.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Even while flying at sonic speeds, POKENAME can still spot prey from large distances. Its scales allow it to fly smoothly inside of sandstorms, where it roams around until it spots its prey.
author: soup1900

entry: The giant maw on POKENAME's head has a mischief-making mind of its own, often dragging the body towards trouble at every opportunity. That being said, the body doesn't seem too interested in stopping the head from wreaking havoc.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: POKENAME lives mostly in caves, but if it needs to venture out it can quickly adapt to sunlight, as it has a second pair of thin eyelids that remain closed above ground. They also prevent its eyes from popping out when it headbutts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A POKENAME can be really caring towards its family and friends. If it feels threatened, its mighty jaws and arms will make quick work of any threat.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can sense impending disasters like sandstorms and earthquakes. It seeks out these locations to ambush Pokémon caught unawares in the chaos, chomp them with their jaws, and twist them in a signature death roll.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are persistent and excellent hunters. They're able to spot pods of Dewgong from distances of 100 miles away.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME spend so much time waiting for prey in the sands that some Pokémon take residency on their backs during sandstorms. When POKENAME's preferred prey wander too close, they clamp down on them with their strong jaws.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: A POKENAME can be really caring towards its family and friends. If it feels threatened, its mighty jaws and arms will make quick work of any threat.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can swim through sand at incredible speeds, using their crown of sand to conceal their appearance once surfaced. They are vicious hunters, chasing down Sandshrew before tearing through their shells with their powerful jaws.
author: santon5512

entry: Thought to once be wielded by a legendary bandit, POKENAME terrorizes its territory of the desert by ambushing trespassers.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: With a blade-like body, POKENAME guards its sand dune home like a seasoned knight. It performs sweeping slashes with elegant precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, and will expand the focus of its eyes to keep tabs on its home at all times. It will use its jaws to clamp down on anyone who violates its home and then twists its body to cause massive damage.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME are vicious predators, kicking up massive sandstorms as they fly in order to conceal themselves. From this cover, they pounce on unsuspecting prey, grabbing them with their powerful jaws so that they can't escape.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME travels through desert sand with its eyes and nostrils above ground, constantly searching for new prey. It uses its feelers to ensnare its targets as it breaches the sand and clamps its powerful jaws down upon them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's snout is one of its most prominent features, and a powerful weapon in its own right. With its strength, it can fell a thick tree or toss a large boulder a vast distance away. These displays are also common tactics to impress a mate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME put on a tough act and command baby Pokémon to do what they say. However, it will resort to fleeing if the parents come to protect the young.
author: dusknoir64

entry: POKENAME maliciously throws cotton at the wind so it can hit prey in the face and cover their eyes. Then, it floats over to pretend to help wipe off the cotton before suddenly biting their head at the last second.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has developed an impeccable sense of sight, making even the darkest of nights seem almost like a bright afternoon in its eyes. POKENAME is feared across the desert for its hunting skills, never losing track of its prey.
author: jangodiot

entry: Golden sands swirl like flames within POKENAME's translucent body. At night, it glows faintly, luring wanderers through the desert.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's elongated tusks can cut through steel with excellent speed and precision. POKENAME has even been used to aid in cutting metal sheets meant for spacecraft construction.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is said to be extremely tenacious. No matter the enemy or odds, if it challenges something, it can overcome it.
author: blazerxz

entry: It uses its high intelligence to construct devious plans in order to steal objects it desires. It may also use its smarts to foil the plans of other POKENAME that try to steal from it.
author: doublehockeystickscomics

entry: POKENAME swims near desert oases, biting at travelers with its enormous jaw. Its presence alone often keeps others far from the water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's powerful eyes let it see prey perfectly even in pitch-black conditions. It has a ravenous nature and is very prone to harassing and stealing the meals away from Zubat and other hunters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grabs prey with jagged claws and delivers a devastating Crunch. It regularly prefers to attack from beneath shifting sands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides deep within frozen caves at sunrise. If approached, it bares its claws and uses Scary Face to drive intruders out.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatters its body parts amongst desert sand in preparation to ambush prey. When prey approaches, it reassembles itself using sand and shreds its victim apart with its maw.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Bone-like wings let POKENAME glide through desert nights. It emits thunderous booms from its ears to disorient foes mid-flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soars through the skies singing in a rumbling baritone until it dive-bombs prey into the desert sands or mountainous soil. After eating its meal, POKENAME must spend hours preening to clean its cloud-like wings of dirt.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME will spit sand into the eyes of its opponents to confuse and blind them. It will wear them down using fast attacks and the obsidian spikes in its mane until it can finish them with a Crunch.
author: chibitales

entry: Its massive jaws can hold and crush a Cloyster with ease. The only Pokémon who have fought a POKENAME and won have large chunks of their bodies missing.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME sneak into forgotten castles to search for treasure to bring back to their Trainers. If they are caught trespassing, they unleash a burst of Water Shuriken before burrowing underground and tunneling away from the scene.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fiercely guards its sun-drenched dune territory. Its massive jaws can crush vehicles, and it bites without warning if approached.
author: .izik

entry: It burrows into desert sand with its eyes peeking out, often mistaken for a Krookodile. When its prey recognizes it and avoids it, it jumps out and hunts them through the air.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Almost all POKENAME have flirtatious personalities, appearing to charm Pokémon of every species. However, they will always stay loyal to their mate, even if it doesn't seem that way.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This Pokémon is known as the scourge of the desert. POKENAME hunts for prey regardless of whether it's hungry or not.
author: scapz

entry: Hidden among sandstone riverbanks, POKENAME lounge about, depending on their intimidating aura for protection. Their environment chips off pieces of shell, which are steeped in tea for home remedies.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Due to their lack of agility, POKENAME hunt by burying themselves in sand and using their water cannons to create geysers under their prey.
author: iamjocheena

entry: POKENAME  can not only handle intense desert heat and drought, but also spread it with intense solar energy. They resemble an ancient sun deity revered by several ancient civilizations.
author: entomoxie

entry: It hides under the sand, waiting for someone to pass by. If disturbed, it will burst from the ground and snap its jaws loudly.
author: busilisk

entry: This little mummy Pokémon always balances on its golden ball. The ball is filled with gunpowder and can easily explode.
author: zerocipher

entry: POKENAME roams desert temples seeking combat with others of its kind. It wields its bone like a short sword.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME unleashes powerful punches with both physical and spectral hands. If one defeats a Machamp, it will take its belt as a trophy.
author: honeslty_vitali

entry: This Pokémon's body is black as the void. If one is to disturb the peace of the ancient temples in which it resides, it will lash out in a rage, using the shadows themselves to attack.
author: fireblade141

entry: A devious, malicious being, POKENAME's appearance on a computer spells disaster. It uses its many limbs to grab and store data and files in its core, and there appears to be no way to recover the stolen data.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found rarely in very dark places. Its glowing purple eyes stand out against the night, and it teleports to get around. If one looks directly into its eyes, they will find themselves immediately under attack.
author: fireblade141

entry: It resembles ancient rulers of particular civilizations, save for its massive and rotund body. It hoards gold, gems, and other precious materials and can even "eat" them to keep them safe within itself.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon were the unyielding servants of ancient pharaohs, said to have the power to peer into the souls of others. Though their ancient masters have long passed, they continue to guard their tombs from thieves to this day.
author: infinex21

entry: Said to be a wretched manifestation of death and decay in ancient myths, POKENAME is a dangerous species wandering around derelict monuments. It is said that those who happen upon its visage are never seen again.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME will rampage ceaselessly if its slumber is disturbed. The flower around its neck was once regarded as symbolic of the sun.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: It is said that POKENAME were highly valued by the aristocratic society of an ancient civilization. Some archeological discoveries suggest that queens and empresses would wear them like living scarves as a symbol of wealth and authority.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: POKENAME are secretive Pokémon that can only be found in the tombs of long lost civilisations. They grow aggressive in anything other than pitch blackness and will attack explorers and archaeologists that try to explore their homes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME quickly wraps itself around people, attempting to turn them into mummies. Due to its small size, it can often be shaken off before the process is complete.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME will often place itself next to coffins or altars. Hiding within its egg-shaped shell, it poses as an urn and enjoys scaring mourners.
author: rihse

entry: POKENAME quietly stands outside of the structures it has predicted to be robbed from. Once the robbers it foresaw appear before it, it places a curse that eventually turns them into mummies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME guard ancient tombs by grabbing onto intruders with an ethereal hand and escorting them out. Prolonged contact with a POKENAME causes hallucinations of hands appearing from the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These Pokémon are born from abandoned pots and planters of ancient civilizations. They guard their homes with their ghostly powers and will often try to drag their foes into their bodies using their singular, shadowy hand.
author: infinex21

entry: It is said that POKENAME are filled with the ancient wisdom of past royalty. Looking them in the eyes can drive people insane, but those that overcome this danger often go on to do great things.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It is supposedly the reincarnation of an ancient pharaoh, but it's actually just a subspecies of Slowking interested in Egyptology. It is afflicted with a pharaoh's curse, however.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Incredibly defensive of its mask, POKENAME will grab at anyone who dares touch it. The weight of its headpiece makes it incapable of sustained flight.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME possess the golden funerary statues of a long-gone civilisation and can animate them, bending them to their will. The statues were originally intended as guardians of the dead, but now POKENAME will attack anyone who comes near.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The thick, dark liquid of POKENAME's body smells strongly of embalming fluids. Inside its sarcophagus shell are four shadowy arms that ensnare would-be robbers.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME often choose to nest near graveyards and assume guard over the deceased residents. These cemeteries are amongst the safest in the world.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME lives in ruins and will leave some of its treasure exposed for an explorer to discover and carry away. It can appear from any of its stolen treasure, leading to many museums becoming dangerously infested with POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Ancient murals depict POKENAME studying various forms of martial arts. To this day, POKENAME carry on their traditions with absolute dedication, determined to protect their friends and Trainers as if they were royalty.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME guards a hoard of relics from would-be grave robbers, as it is able to grapple multiple opponents with its coils and hands. It will only find rest if a relative of those it guards relieves it of duty.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is said to steal beauty from women and female Pokémon using the shadow hands stretching from its belly. During the day, POKENAME absorbs sunlight with the disk between its horns in order to make its shadows stronger during the night.
author: milchik

entry: Grave robbers often mistake POKENAME for canopic jars. If they wake POKENAME up from its sleep, they are cursed to never leave its tomb.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is a tyrant of mountain regions that considers itself an unbeatable ruler over its domain. It will crumble a mountain to powder and reshape it to fit its own tastes and ego, regardless of other creatures living within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME guards a hoard of relics from would-be grave robbers, as it is able to grapple multiple opponents with its coils and hands. It will only find rest if a relative of those it guards relieves it of duty.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It guards the resting place of ancient kings. Tomb raiders who enter this Pokémon's territory are eternally cursed to see it in their nightmares.
author: awiralonprime

entry: A wild POKENAME typically acts as the head of a group of Pokémon that punishes thieves. As a result, POKENAME and its band often come into conflict with Murkrow. Driven by a sense of justice and duty, it stays up very late to keep watch over others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME store gold and gems within themselves by swallowing them, though they have no means to digest them. They seem to feed on the life force of others grabbed by their shadowy hands.
author: infinex21

entry: A once inanimate statue now haunted by a cursed scroll. It is said that anyone who deciphers the hieroglyphs will fall deathly ill.
author: ninjakraken

entry: POKENAME tends to appear in places where sickness is rampant. Some scientists believe that its facial resemblance to Aromatisse is evidence of Togekiss being related to it.
author: hophoppip

entry: Living in tombs and abandoned houses, POKENAME only surfaces at the dead of night, sitting proudly upright as the air around it thickens with vaporous smoke. Witnesses who have seen it say they experienced heightened anxiety and feverish delusions.
author: beatdoof

entry: Living in tombs and abandoned houses, POKENAME only surfaces at the dead of night, sitting proudly upright as the air around it thickened with vaporous smoke. Witnesses who saw it has said they experienced heightened anxiety and feverish delusions.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME like to hide themselves inside of old, abandoned websites that web browsers are unable to show anymore. They eat computer chips as their food source due to the gold they contain.
author: soup1900

entry: Recruited by ancient psychics to guard tombs, POKENAME offer researchers lavish meals. If accepted, those with pure intentions are bonded with. Any grave robbers suffer terrible curses.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite its rather daunting appearance, POKENAME is stalwart, modest and well-mannered. However, if a person fails to reciprocate its cordial gestures respectfully, POKENAME will strike them down.
author: hipsnake

entry: A lonesome spirit that mourns its death. It is supposedly the pet of a long-forgotten pharaoh.
author: theheroict

entry: It has been written that POKENAME has dominion over the dead. It can deduce whether one has a pure or sullied heart with its unusual abilities. Those who are deemed impure and near the end of their lives are attacked.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A vicious creature that punishes grave robbers by dragging them into a tomb to lay for eternity. It's found inside ancient pyramids.
author: theheroict

entry: Although there is no scientific evidence to support it, there are numerous researchers that believe the mask on POKENAME's stomach resembles the faces of humanity's earliest ancestors. Those who touch a POKENAME see flashes of an ancient landscape.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have 1,000 hands that writhe and wrap around their body, each hand splitting into a great multiplicity of fingers. Whenever they sense a tomb raider in their ruins, the shadowy hands rush to dispose of the intruder.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME disguises as a gold-plated crook to catch would-be grave robbers. It hooks them by the neck and drains them of their life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are often spotted in the desert protecting their den full of buried treasures. They telepathically ask treasure hunters elaborate riddles in an attempt to make them leave.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Ancient art depicts POKENAME as the ultimate sentinel of kings and pharaohs. It strikes terror into many Ghost Pokémon, demanding absolute worship and absorbing any spirit that refuses to bow.
author: beatdoof

entry: In ancient times, the highest-ranking of pharaohs were granted POKENAME as the guardians of their tombs. Its thick golden armor is nigh impenetrable, and it is merciless in how it treats potential grave-robbers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can freely transform its shadow hands into wings for flight and revert them at will. It spews molten gold when it becomes excited, conveniently allowing people to pay for the repairs of the damage it first causes.
author: soup1900

entry: Found residing inside ancient pyramids, POKENAME's cogs are infused with the spirits of mummies. It uses its body to operate traps and obstacles which it defends its grave with.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: A cruel pharaoh's spirit possessed its old body, creating POKENAME. It utilizes shadow illusions in combat to confuse and conquer.
author: yoshimon

entry: People claim that these Pokémon are born from ancient spirits, who now guard ancient ruins and burial sites. Their shadowy limbs siphon malice and greed from those they touch, helping them to achieve a true sense of calm.
author: infinex21

entry: Found in the depths of the ocean, POKENAME adorns itself with armor forged from sunken relics forgotten by time. On the surface, it appears as a black apparition before it drags down ships belonging to greedy treasure hunters.
author: adam_dnh

entry: Myths state this Pokémon is the spirit of a long dead dragon that has returned through possessing its treasures from its lifetime.
author: themicelegion

entry: This dark, phantasmal Pokémon is supposedly bound to our plane by the ancient artifact of an ancient civilization around its neck. Its many shadowy hands are constantly grasping to claim the lives of any who intrude upon its domain.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dwell in abandoned buildings, avoiding Trainers. On nights with a full moon, they emerge to bathe in the moonlight, which slowly turns their skin to gold. Only when their bodies have transformed entirely to gold can they evolve.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME tempt unsuspecting tomb raiders into its domain with illusions of their desires.  Once enticed, POKENAME uses its ghostly limbs to squeeze the life force out of them.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME lure the worst of society with false hopes of fortune and happiness. Once their target is aware of the ruse, they are sentenced to an eternal prison of gold in a sick sense of irony.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME guard desert tombs, entangling tomb raiders with chains. POKENAME will only let robbers go if they can consume all of the thieves' valuables.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME pace around within sealed tombs of ancient civilisations, patiently guarding the forgotten relics of the past. Should they be disturbed, their eyes glow a baleful red and they summon shadowy hands from their many tails to defend their crypt.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME played an important role in ancient cultures, Archaeologists believing they were revered as the judges of life and death. They can still be found haunting ancient tombs, watching silently from the shadows lit only by their conjured embers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's half-incorporeal body allows it to mask itself as a treasure urn when stationary. To disturb it is to invite the recollection of horrific memories.
author: beatdoof

entry: It uses its shadow hands to grab its victims and prevent them from escaping, then flies away with them. Children who misbehave are told that if they don't behave, POKENAME will come and kidnap them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Archaeologists theorized that POKENAME's ghostly spores were imbued with the spirits of ancient royals. In reality, POKENAME uses its spores to absorb the souls of their prey before leaving the bodies as dried husks.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides under the floors of pyramids, waiting to ensnare any grave robber that comes through. While it struggles to keep its prisoners bound, its ghostly appearance and sharp teeth scare them away anyway.
author: soup1900

entry: Supposedly, it's an ancient security drone created by paranoid pharaohs. It emits high pitched frequencies when it spots an intruder before attacking.
author: theheroict

entry: A long-deceased defender of ancient waterways, POKENAME buries itself in the riverbed and waits for polluters. Its bite inflicts a deadly curse.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME can lie flat on floors, walls, and ceilings. Opening up its face reveals a dark, cold hallway that takes 5.5 minutes to traverse. Some say that it takes something from those who go in, but no one knows quite what.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are extremely avaricious Pokémon, if a single coin is taken from their hoard, it will relentlessly hunt for the thief, cursing them. They are known to hold grudges against these grave robbers.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME resides in mountain tombs, protecting them from grave robbers. Should it encounter one, it will consume their soul and mummify their body.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME live as dancers for exceptionally rich citizens. When fed gold nuggets, their dance will become mesmerizing.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It performs ceremonial dances outside ancient tombs to honor the dead. It is said that if a graverobber attempts to rob the tomb, POKENAME will collapse the entrance, sealing the thief in with the dead for all eternity.
author: agentyoshi

entry: POKENAME's body is made of solid gold that is easily damaged. It'll lay a powerful curse on those who harm it or steal from it.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME deceives others with its cute and cuddly look. When its victims drop their guard, it grabs them with shadowy limbs, squeezing until their strength fades. Legends say it was born from the frustration of abandoned young Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is said that a sailor got lost at sea and had his soul trapped in a cursed anchor, creating a POKENAME. POKENAME lies dormant on the ocean floor, consuming the essence of human divers who stray close to it.
author: tyler059

entry: POKENAME judge the souls of those who have died. If they are pure, then they are guided to the afterlife. If they are corrupt, the souls become sand.
author: skymaster426

entry: In ancient times, trainers would throw these Pokémon on magical cards for a “brawl” where their true strength would be shown. Some say these brawlers inspired the Pokéball mechanism, but that theory has yet to be proven.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Found in deserts, it is believed it contains the soul of a ruler from ancient times. It commands certain Pokémon to build its body.
author: houndrys.

entry: These Pokémon guard the graves and tombs of their masters, no matter how long ago they may have passed. They dart around at rapid speeds and strike at foes with their shadowy limbs.
author: infinex21

entry: Some say that POKENAME contains remnants of the spirit of a Lycanroc that was worshipped as a deity in ancient times.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The wrappings around its body are feelers it can control that seem to have musical notes etched upon them. Whether these notes are the same songs they sometimes sing is unknown, for none have been allowed to study them.
author: infinex21

entry: Many believe the sound of a POKENAME's trumpet to be a harbinger of unfortunate times, if not outright doom. They use their bandage-like feelers to batter wicked people and their foes while dancing around them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME guard ancient ruins and the treasures said to lay within them, wrapping would-be thieves in their bandage-like feelers. These feelers siphon their life force until their ghostly hand-like tail can drag them down into the underworld.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a statue inside jungle temples. When it senses a grave robber, it waits until they are incredibly close, before jumping out to scare them and psychically pushing them deeper into the shrine.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Archeologists discovered POKENAME in an ancient tomb many years ago. Under the blazing sun it appears to only be a clay sculpture, but during cool desert nights it's said that spirits can be found circled around it performing a long forgotten ritual.
author: kianjp2008

entry: POKENAME reside within the depths of tombs, using their shadowy limbs to repel invaders. Some depictions of some past civilizations bear a resemblance to these Pokémon, with them as the loyal companions of some ancient rulers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are found within ancient tombs that have been disturbed by archaeologists. They are possessive Pokémon that jealously guard the relics of the past and have been known to burrow into local museums to retrieve artifacts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are found within ancient tombs that have been disturbed by archaeologists. They are possessive Pokémon that jealously guard the relics of the past and have been known to burrow into local museums to retrieve artifacts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME pilfers ancient tombs in search of artifacts to add to its collection of toys. It will lead treasure hunters to gold as long as it is promised a portion of the spoils in return.
author: skittytales

entry: During ancient times, these Pokémon were seen as the embodiments of gods in some regions. POKENAME's face is said to be permanently etched into the memory of anyone who sees it.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME are known to live inside ancient pyramids. They hoard the treasure found inside, often attacking those who enter their territory. Studies show that the pyramid-like structure POKENAME's back is made from of bone and hardened magma.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME are known to live in ancient ruins, pretending to be ornate clay figurines. There are myths that POKENAME turn grave robbers into the gold masks they are found carrying.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME resides near undersea temples as well as the occasional sunken ship. Intruders are grasped by its ghostly limbs, which cast a curse on those who dare trespass on its sacred home.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME has had a hand in making several ancient Egyptian weddings. However, after the societal expansion of Egypt, the people gave up on it, hence why it is a Ghost-type now.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: When at rest, POKENAME appear to be simple headbands from long-gone civilisations. Should their headband be handled, they manifest their ethereal body and fly into a rage, inflicting dreadful curses on whoever touches their headpiece.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is very proud of its appearance, its shadowy hands constantly focused on polishing its shell until it shines. If anyone tries to interrupt this process, POKENAME will glare at them with an eerie grin before the shadows drag them away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient castles and temples and hide in dark passageways. They constantly patrol their territory, delivering painful shocks to any intruders.
author: mepp.

entry: It makes its home inside burial urns inside of ancient tombs. While it typically seems to be an inert urn, it can be spurred into rage by grave robbers intruding in its home.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME ambushes and poisons grave robbers. It rewards behaving Trainers with riches. Some of these riches are worth millions.
author: planatical

entry: Haunting shipwrecks of ages past, POKENAME at first appears as bejeweled empty shells. Once a diver turns their back the disembodied hands shoot forward, dragging their victim to its dagger-toothed maw.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is an evil spirit that has been encased in a man-made shell. POKENAME despises humans for trapping it.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME makes its home close to where buried treasure is located, protecting it through ghostly powers and gnashing claws. Pirates of old clashed with it often in their search for ill-gotten gains.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that the spirits of ancient royalty slumber within POKENAME's shell. The shadowy tendrils that surround POKENAME have ensured that no humans have ever seen the insides of their shells.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME ambushes bird Pokémon by lurking with its head among treetops and ensnaring unobservant or curious prey when they land among its claws and webs. During storms, it ducks its head low and hides within foliage to avoid lightning strikes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The tongue extending from its mouth is made of tightly entwined silk. This sticky appendage helps it cling to surfaces and capture prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME coats its cocoon with a thin layer of electrically-charged thread. This gives it extra defenses against predators, who receive a powerful shock upon the faintest contact.
author: sk372

entry: It drills into solar panels and weaves webbing inside to absorb electricity. This behavior has caused issues at solar farms near mountain ranges.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is cloaked in translucent silk, and each vine is coated with nearly invisible webbing. These webs are both sticky and surprisingly strong.
author: .izik

entry: A tailor in Brussel Town designs elegant hats with its silk. These hats are popular during spring festivals for their lightweight feel.
author: .izik

entry: Its bright coloring is a warning to potential aggressors. If provoked, POKENAME can fly circles around its foes while using its surprisingly strong arms to strike.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME bobs and sways rhythmically at baby Pokémon so that they copy its movements and follow it around. It lures them until they walk into its electric web, where its dance becomes more excited as it prepares to feast on them.
author: soup1900

entry: It loves turning into a power cord and plugging itself into an outlet, resulting in it consuming a lot of electricity. Trainers caring for POKENAME are advised to baby-proof their outlets to prevent this from happening.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME sets up a number of electrified webs at the edges of the lakes it inhabits. It spends much of its time submerged in water, but can sense the dispersal of electricity when something is caught in its webs, alerting it to a captured meal.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME connects to a computing device with its web, it steadily siphons data as nourishment. A single feeding can sustain it for weeks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a distant relative of the extinct Kabutops. POKENAME uses its yellow fur on its small arms to conduct electricity to power up its Electric-type moves.
author: antonio_9onzalez

entry: These Pokémon love to use electricity and puffs of their flames to roast nuts and berries before eating them. The spikes along their backs often exude an intense heat that deters assailants.
author: infinex21

entry: The spiky fur along a POKENAME's back will crackle with electricity as it prepares to spew flames from its mouth. The webbing it can spew from its mouth is capable of channeling its flames without burning for many hours.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME form nets out of webbing when foraging to help them carry the berries they pick. They are fond of Magost Berries because of the sweet flavor inside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A shop in Luxuria Town specializes in bug nets crafted from its web. These nets are popular for their durability and fine mesh.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves its web atop tall buildings in an effort to catch Flying-type prey. As they absorb electricity, the webs act as natural protection against lightning strikes, so humans leave it be so long as its web does not get in the way.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It digs up power lines to chew on the insulation. This habit often causes electrical surges in rural areas.
author: .izik

entry: A weaver in Emeragrove Town creates socks from its silk. The socks are celebrated for their unique ability to repel static electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stuns prey by blinding them with a bright light produced by the orb on its tail. Once the prey are successfully incapacitated, it feasts.
author: mepp.

entry: Its silk is laid over flowerbeds to suppress weed growth. Gardeners in small towns rely on it to protect their plants.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like tufts from POKENAME carry a faint static charge. These fibers cling to surfaces, aiding it in creating complex webs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their sticky feet to scale walls, snagging fruit from trees to hoard in their dens. They protect this food by coating it in an electrified silk, weaving in scrap metal they find to increase the nest's electrical charge.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME finds the webs of other species and covers them in a gel it secretes. This gel prevents the builder of the nest from being able to detect vibrations caused by the prey that get stuck in it, allowing POKENAME to feast.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is able to sense other Pokémon's actions and uses that to lay webs near those most clumsy and unaware of their surroundings. The threads it creates are highly valued by fashion designers since they glow in the sunshine.
author: soup1900

entry: The tip of its horn has tiny, wall-crawling legs. It suspends itself from ceilings before ambushing prey with an expertly aimed web.
author: .izik

entry: When it hatches, its mother uses web and honey to knit a toy that resembles a baby POKENAME. It carries the toy wherever it goes. The sweet scent of honey combined with how soft the toy is helps this timid Pokémon to calm down whenever it's stressed.
author: milchik

entry: These Bug-type Pokémon carry a hive made of silk webbing atop their backs, where their young will typically be restlessly crawling inside of. They typically sleep in caves, their slimy bodies helping them to stick to the ceiling.
author: infinex21

entry: By using electrical webs, POKENAME catches stray bits of data, including malware and viruses. It releases data it doesn't find appetizing from the web and feasts on what remains.
author: chibitales

entry: By using electrical webs, POKENAME catches stray bits of data, including malware and viruses. It releases data it doesn't find appetizing from the web and feasts on what remains.
author: chibitales

entry: It carries its young in the pouch on its belly. If there is nothing in its pouch, it will adopt and carry any Pokémon or Egg that will fit.
author: cait_sith

entry: It spins a large web and waits on it, luring in prey with the glittering gemstones on its head. Sometimes, humans get caught in the web, giving rise to the term "POKENAME's glimmer" as shorthand for something too good to be true.
author: hophoppip
