entry: POKENAME are loyal and trustworthy creatures who will fiercely protect their Trainer's keys and other valuables no matter what. This includes digging holes to bury them. If given an important key, they wear it proudly.
author: calikov

entry: In days of old, it would act as a guard dog in prisons. The modern age has rendered its job obsolete, but they can now be found often helping in small-town motels.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The giant keys POKENAME hold a value only known to them. Any attempt to remove these keys from them ends in a brutal beatdown. They were prized for their protective natures and were given keys to vaults and doors of the rich and royalty in the past.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's odd telekinetic powers are limited to keys, so their Trainers keep a set of keys around when they want to train it. Its powers are so precise that it can reliably open doors with the right key.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It crafts giant keys out of raw materials using its bare hands, and then weight trains with that key for life.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Incredibly efficient at keeping keys, though prefers big ones. If someone attempts to take one without permission, POKENAME will attempt to strike them into the stratosphere.
author: thereversedguy

entry: POKENAME collects any key it can find, but it only keeps its favorites; the others are abandoned. A single key on a boat is enough to make it attack.
author: dzygomer

entry: The only thing more annoying than a key-stealing Klefki is a crafty POKENAME. When it enters a room, any keys sitting out are instantly magnetized to it.
author: sporkwizard

entry: It collects keys by pulling them in with its powerful magnets. Sometimes it also draws in loose change and jewelry, but it doesn't care about those.
author: sporkwizard

entry: It carries around an enormous key, wielding it on its adventures. Some say it's searching for an equally massive lock to vanquish.
author: kiwiarms

entry: If threatened, POKENAME will scrape its key-like appendages together to make an annoying metal noise to deter predators. If the foe persists, it uses those same limbs in battle to cut and bludgeon its opponent.
author: sk372

entry: When approaching POKENAME, be wary of its reaction: clapping with its front flippers signifies a friendly and playful mood, but the clacking of the keys on its tail is a sign of wariness and aggression.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME searches garbage dumps and city alleys for discarded keys to add to its collection. It eats the keys it doesn't find worth keeping, building energy for evolution.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME searches garbage dumps and city alleys for discarded keys to add to its collection. It eats the keys it doesn't find worth keeping, building energy for evolution.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Not content with only keys, POKENAME collects any trash it finds interesting and builds it into body parts it can manipulate. Its body is so corrosive that POKENAME must continually search to replace this treasure trove.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While the keys which jut from POKENAME's back are too large to unlock any human-made locks, it is common for POKENAME to attempt to insert their keys into the hole in the back of another POKENAME. If they fit, the two will be lifelong friends.
author: maxissaa

entry: Each segment of POKENAME's body will be a different color depending on the individual, due to the different amounts of minerals one POKENAME might eat over the other. It is generally friendly and gently interacts with miners and their equipment.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are collectors of memories, and regularly lock away the cherished thoughts of those they hypnotize, placing them in an endless reverie.
author: spookypookie.

entry: The key-like shape of its legs makes POKENAME an excellent lockpick. Its often found scuttling over piles of securely guarded valuables, which it seems to have no attachment to.
author: hophoppip

entry: When flapped at high speeds, POKENAME's wings release a burning pollen made of tiny embers. It preys on small insects and birds by pinning them with its talons and cooking them with the heat from its wings.
author: sk372

entry: Although it has a pair of wings, it prefers to stay on the ground, running and charging at anything that moves. In battle, it ignites the horns on its head and attacks foes relentlessly. It lives in herds with others of its kind across vast plains.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME scatter a hot powder from their wings as they fly through forests and fields of flowers searching for sap and pollen, respectively. To defend themselves, they quickly flutter their wings to ignite and scatter even more of this powder.
author: infinex21

entry: While feeding, POKENAME focuses solely on gathering enough energy to evolve. If disturbed, it releases powerful bursts of heat from its wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME will soar over the surface of water with such intense speeds that the water below them will begin to boil. Sightings are frequently followed by unpredictable water currents as they can accidentally alter the flow of rivers and streams.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME will soar over the surface of water with such intense speeds that the water below them will begin to boil. Sightings are frequently followed by heavy storms, as they often move fast enough to shift clouds into following behind them.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME is a remarkably friendly Pokémon. It is highly sought after as an aerial mount for high-altitude travel, as the comforting warmth radiating from its thick, fluffy fur protects its rider from the freezing mountain winds.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME can move faster than a bullet, to the point that its prey doesn't even notice it swooping in for them. The more melodious its chirps, the hungrier it is.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME leaves itself half-buried in the sand until it comes time to spring out at prey. Using the feathers on its tail, it scoops and heats up the sand to fling as a fiery projectile at its target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will defend its Trainer ferociously, but this sometimes leads to misunderstandings where it will threaten a friend.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME's wings are sharp enough to slash through crags and cliffs. Living among the highest mountain peaks, it chirps proudly alongside others of its kind, sounding similar to a war anthem.
author: beatdoof

entry: Flying at high speeds, POKENAME showers clouds of embers over its foes and doubles back to dive through the fiery cloud. Its rocky exterior strikes the embers, causing them to explode and inflict major damage on the opponent.
author: chibitales

entry: To prove its unmatched dominance in the sky, it clashes with other bird Pokémon in head-on Brave Bird matches. Once it has won, it sizzles the opponent with embers before devouring them whole with its razor-sharp fangs.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME stretches, sparks fly from its wings, which catch dry brush alight and flush prey. As fast as a lightning bolt, POKENAME snatches and carries its quarry away.
author: pattybgoode

entry: During a battle, POKENAME shoots spores from its petals, which cling to the opposing Pokémon. It will then ignite the spores by spraying embers from its feathers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's neck flower produces a spicy aroma that irritates the nose. It uses its large wings to blow this scent towards opponents to disorient them before attacking.
author: chibitales

entry: It uses the feathers that fall from its wings to build warm nests, keeping itself safe from cold and rain. Though not yet fully developed, this Pokémon fears nothing and faces every challenge with unwavering determination.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is fire resistant and has a goggle-like film that protects its eyes from smoke, so it is a valuable partner for any Ranger involved in fighting wildfires. It flies with precise maneuvers, fearlessly darting into danger and around obstacles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A POKENAME's beak is like a stinger with how sharp and poisonous it is. Its webbing is highly combustible, being used as flaming bombs of silk or to scorch foes caught within its webs.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME are excited, they release embers from in between their petals to pepper the area with ash. When they are not training or spending time eating, they love to nap in the sun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Scorching flames erupt from its feathers during battle, and they grow even stronger the longer a battle draws on. Each of its feathers glows with heat, the sight of which makes it popular with many Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cover themselves in a special coating when underwater, which allows them to produce fire. Watching them play together in the fading daylight and lighting up the water from below is an especially beautiful sight to behold.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME cover themselves in a special coating when underwater, which allows them to produce fire. Dissolved oxygen can only pass through the coating if POKENAME keeps swimming.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It flaps its strong wings to scatter scorching embers to overwhelm its prey. It is never satisfied after a meal and will constantly search for more food and prey to keep its flames from petering out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME roast their prey by breathing out flames from their beak. Once their prey is burnt to a crisp, their talons tear into the burnt remains.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME compresses heat inside its claws before striking. The impact is powerful enough to burn straight through steel.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's feathers are able to cool down the air around, allowing it to survive in hot climates. However, the feathers will start to catch ablaze when POKENAME is angry.
author: mistymagius

entry: Using its vigorous strength, POKENAME uproots clumps of earth with its massive tusks to weaken its foes. When enraged, it breathes scorching flames from its beak.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The down feathers that come from POKENAME are fireproof and used by humans to make flame-resistant insulation for outfits and materials. These Pokémon are not easy to tame, but they will defend those they trust with all their might.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are famous for their sharp claws and talons. When it sets its sights on a target, rarely does its prey get away. POKENAME's incredible speed helps it take down targets swiftly and efficiently.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: During battle, it swings its hefty wings between its flurries of kicking attacks, scattering scorching embers at its foe. It uses its lower talons to pick up and carry away prey and to gouge enemies with every Blaze Kick it unleashes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful legs to leap onto high points where it can most effectively search the area. When it spots a target, this hunter will jump from its perch and use its large head feathers to soar with precision to strike down its prey.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotional state of those around it, and is quite skittish. If it senses too strong a negative emotion, it showers the area with embers from its tiny wings to cover its teleporting somewhere more peaceful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is quite cocky, constantly taunting foes to get under their skin. Once they've fallen for the taunt and attack, it teleports into the air and showers the opponent with flaming feathers and psychic blasts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their Trainers. If they sense danger, they conjure burning feathers from their wings and send them at their foe with a powerful gust of wind.
author: lasercraft32

entry: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their Trainers. If they sense danger, they conjure burning feathers from their wings and send them at their foe with a powerful gust of wind.
author: lasercraft32

entry: POKENAME will guard the Fletchling living on its back with its life. When the Fletchling leaves the nest, POKENAME will seek out a new one.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME houses many injured Fletchling until they're fully healed. It will go to great lengths to protect its patients.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its favorite foods include arctic bird Pokémon such as Delibird and, ironically, Piplup. POKENAME can deliver mighty blows with its wings, leaving foes subdued and burned from the heat of its feathers.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME is quiet until it lunges forth suddenly to strike at prey, attacking with a mighty cry. In modern popular culture, POKENAME is typically recognized for being the villainous emperor of a fiery monstrous horde in a popular superhero cartoon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hides in the trees, waiting for prey so it can strike. However, it can't easily catch the prey, as the steel armor slows it down.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Despite being an unparalleled hunter, POKENAME has a noble spirit. It loathes those who prey on the weak and has been seen defending young Pokémon from predators.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: POKENAME's visage is a common sight in many ancient mythologies. Though the details differ, most share a belief that seeing it in the wild heralded the arrival of violent thunderstorms in the near future.
author: sk372

entry: At night, POKENAME coils its heated ribbons around its Eggs, shielding them from the cold. This warmth accelerates hatching and soothes nervous hatchlings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time on the ground as its wings can only allow it to glide for a short time. It will shower foes with fiery dust before following up with a devastating Earthquake.
author: chibitales

entry: The flames that inflate and keep POKENAME in the air can only come out from the top of its head due to its body being completely flameproof. After grabbing its bird prey, it disappears and whisks them away to an unknown location.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME mimics the murals left by ancient civilizations in an attempt to lure in curious explorers and historians. Those unfortunate enough to draw too close are struck by a lethal Flare Blitz, their soul absorbed immediately after.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME weave webs made of extremely flammable silk. Upon catching something, they ignite the webs and cook their prey in seconds.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME cling to cave ceilings with their strong claws and watch for prey to pass beneath them. When a POKENAME spots worthwhile prey, it will engulf itself in fire and throw itself down upon its target.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body has become supercharged with heat, becoming pure flame when in flight. Its diving attacks are now terribly devastating, burning its target and anything unfortunate enough to be near when it strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings radiate with an intense heat. As they fly at supersonic speeds, the air around them ignites and leaves burning trails across the sky.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME heat the air directly beneath their wings, allowing them to bound great distances with just a couple of flaps. They are too heavy to attain true long distance flight, but can still cover great distances by gliding.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME snaps branches off trees with its burning-hot beak. It stacks them with uncanny precision to help build sturdy creek dams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon whose emotions show through the flames upon their tails. When they get excited, they let loose showers of sparks from between their feathers while hopping from foot to foot.
author: infinex21

entry: Its vibrant plumage is praised by the judges of the most prestigious Pokémon Contests. POKENAME sings jolly melodies, and when it takes flight, it dances gracefully among the flames it conjures and controls around its wide wings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its wings being located on its head, POKENAME soars with the utmost elegance. This phenomenon is still being studied.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME uses its soprano voice to draw in other bird Pokémon to prey upon. In the past, its fireproof down was used for the beds of Fire-type Pokémon.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: POKENAME continually vents sulfuric fumes from its flower. Because its petals flap and release embers as it walks, it is considered a major wildfire hazard.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Due to the size and strength of POKENAME's wings, they are broad enough to use as weapons and allow it to fly. It generates powerful gales to send foes flying or put them off balance, giving POKENAME an opening to burn them with its flames.
author: fireblade141

entry: It is blazing hot to the touch. Its body temperature raises with extreme emotions, and it lights the branch which it holds with the heat of its feathers.
author: pix3l_655

entry: Despite being sluggish on land due to its heavily armored body, POKENAME's powerful wings easily carry it through the air. It releases a thick trail of dark smog as it flies to blind and disorient prey on the ground before suddenly diving.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME are commonly seen congregating on dark, moonless nights. Using their vast energy reserves, they fly through the night sky, each bursting with energy in organized patterns, igniting the sky. The resulting formations resemble Talonflame.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: POKENAME grow increasingly excited and agitated the longer a battle draws on; as their emotions flare up, so too do their tail flames. At the pinnacle of its flame's intensity, it vents showers of hot sparks from between its feathers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME release powerful flames from their beak to knock down Bug-type Pokémon from branches above them. Once their prey is on the ground, POKENAME drag them into a hole to eat them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its feathered fans fill with glowing embers as it prepares to drive away those who have wandered too close to its territory. By flapping its wings, POKENAME can create hot air whorls that incinerate the tender leaves on the branches of nearby trees.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME shoot powerful flames at the trees above them to roast Bug-type Pokémon before they even get to the ground. Once their prey reaches the ground, a flurry of pecks consumes their meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It catches hot air from the flames around its neck with its long wing-like ears to glide. Before hunting, it must first seek out somewhere with high elevation to leap from in order to have plenty of time to soar and search for prey.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME's mane crackles with a static warmth that keeps riders cozy even as it soars to high altitudes. Despite its fierce and territorial nature, it is remarkably docile with its Trainer.
author: ambrosia04

entry: A POKENAME's screech can be heard from miles away, each one crying out at a different hour of the day. While many towns depend on its calls to keep track of time, the deafening sound is notorious for startling travelers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME constantly searches for stronger foes to overcome as it flies through the sky. It overwhelms prey and foes with showers of hot embers scattered from its wings in tandem with streams of fire spewed from its beak.
author: infinex21

entry: It can set trees ablaze just by flapping its wings. Many Hawlucha look up to it as a mentor because of its size and striking resemblance.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Despite its large physique, POKENAME can take flight by venting fiery sparks from the underside of its body. When it sheds its craggy body, it appears to explode since all the trapped sparks become free at once.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are distrustful Pokémon that will only get close to one Trainer for their whole life. Only those they trust will be able to ride on their back when they fly.
author: ambrosia04

entry: It spits compressed, scalding bubbles at bird Pokémon so it may easily prey upon them. If it ever strikes a stronger target and earns its ire, this Pokémon will hide within its shell.
author: infinex21

entry: In battle, powerful flames erupt from its body to test the mettle of its opponent. Using its wings, it can move quickly while bombarding its target with fireballs and scalding water jets.
author: infinex21

entry: In an attempt to mimic Bulbasaur, POKENAME started to grow a bulb on its back. If the bulb is disturbed, POKENAME retaliates by cursing whoever touched it with toxic afflictions.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME are puny creatures that have few defenses. They are constantly under threat of being uncovered by Flying-type Pokémon that try to eat them, so they often hide to avoid their disguise from coming off.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME refrains from using explosive powers as it would cause undue damage to its disguise. Instead, those that attack it get repelled by a mighty hand of darkness punching out from POKENAME's "mouth".
author: sk372

entry: In trying to disguise as a Voltorb by haunting a Trainer's discarded ball, POKENAME instead became an even better Poké Ball mimic.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This Pokémon's outer casing sheds in flakes that are gathered in the wild and repurposed to craft the casing of a Safari Ball. The flakes are valued for their irregular patterns that blend into grassy terrain.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME creates a disguise that helps it mingle with lonely Cubone in need of a friend. Although the weapon is fake, when danger approaches, a shadow unleashes from beneath POKENAME's disguise and forms a club to strike at its foe.
author: sk372

entry: Its massive club is made of sturdy wood. POKENAME often wanders in search of places that many other Pokémon frequent, searching for someone to claim as a friend. It is selfless and will often come to the aid of others in battle.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME sways back and forth, making a eerie creaking sound. If it's ever still, it's about to attack.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: POKENAME collects cheap perfumes and mixes them with Repels to create a choking aroma that protects it from attacking foes. It insulates its costume so well that it is not affected by its own mist.
author: slimninja55

entry: To befriend mountain Pokémon, it crafts costumes from whatever materials it finds. Using its ghostly powers, POKENAME spins the fake drill on its head to carve tunnels through rock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loiters around Pokémon Centers, hoping to be able to assist Chansey in treating other Pokémon. It fashions a disguise in Chansey's likeness, fearful its true form would frighten its patients.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hide their bodies inside discarded children's dolls, tearing through the backs of them and hollowing them out to make space. They spread out eerie wings to move themselves around, using the bright eye spots to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME may seem meek because of their small size, but their venom is capable of numbing the mouths of foes much larger than themselves. Their head resembles a tennis ball, which often causes other Pokémon to pick them up on accident.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a skilled shapeshifter with a malicious and selfish streak. It has, on occasion, attempted to trap a person it has shapeshifted into so that it can permanently replace them.
author: sk372

entry: With a costume made from outdated electronics, POKENAME is surprisingly adept at vocal mimicry and digital art. As such, movie studios employ it to digitally enhance scenes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME takes helmets from Gridiron football and makes them into its shell. Some enthusiastic fans enjoy painting POKENAME's shells to match their team's colors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relies on finding old Omanyte shells for protection and social integration. Groups of POKENAME gather to swap their shells in unison, each going to a shell one size up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The inside of POKENAME's costume contains dozens of pounds worth of food as well as POKENAME itself. It doesn't like to move very much and is therefore generally found napping.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stuffs its disguise with pillows to be as huggable and soft as possible. The disguise is extremely hot due to heavy insulation, so it often takes frozen treats and chilled drinks from people's ice chests.
author: slimninja55

entry: Old cotton and rotten food fills POKENAME's costume, causing it to have quite a stench! POKENAME has never been spotted outside of its costume, even when it is sleeping.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has made a balloon-like disguise to look and feel like a kind, huggable Dragonite. The disguise also allows POKENAME to help people and Pokémon reach high places.
author: slimninja55

entry: POKENAME is very shy and elusive, rarely appearing before others that it feels could potentially be its friend. If scared, the seams of its disguise spill open to spread a blinding darkness that hides its quick teleportation to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is thought to be the spirit of a dead plant. Rotten roots shift just beneath its ghostly rag.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Those who mistake this Pokémon for Meganium quickly get disappointed once they realize that its petals don't exude Meganium's iconic sweet smell. If POKENAME notices a negative reaction to its disguise, it'll do anything to bring its offenders down.
author: milchik

entry: These plushies were originally purchased to be used as chew toys, but after years of chewing, the dolls have begun to bite back!
author: puppetmaster64

entry: The disguise's claws were made so sharp that POKENAME may accidentally tear itself up if it's too aggressive with its swings. For its own safety and others, it adopts a mostly pacifistic nature.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides away in the forest observing other creatures from afar, often too shy to approach. It has an impeccable sense of time, but must physically adjust the clock on its face regularly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rarely engage in direct fights due to their physically frail bodies. They are usually active at night, when few others can see or hear them.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME rarely engage in direct fights due to their physically frail bodies. They are usually active at night, when few others can see or hear them.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME rarely engage in direct fights due to their physically frail bodies. They are usually active at night, when few others can see or hear them.
author: entomoxie

entry: When a POKENAME evolves from a Mimikyu and Golbat fusion, it cuts and reshapes the cloth of its legs into wings. After doing so, it sews its mouth shut to complete its disguise.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wings remain silent and motionless as it glides. This is because it uses strings attached to wood to hold up its disguise and float around.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's costume is made from discarded Flaaffy wool. This wool still naturally generates electricity, and can emit strong static shocks. POKENAME uses this to prevent attackers from damaging its costume.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The lightbulb that POKENAME holds up is run on Nomel batteries. Even though the electricity is weak, a loose wire can still shock you.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME gathers leaves and flowers to hide it's true appearance. When it is alone, it leaves it's costume and dances.
author: asyoko

entry: POKENAME holds onto its dead flower, which allows it to drift in the wind. If it were to let go, it would become a lifeless stuffed toy.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME floats around at night, using its feather-light stuffing like a sail. The stuffing includes fiberglass, so is dangerous to inhale.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It is very protective of its stuffing and hates when anything touches it. Poachers who try to steal its stuffing will be cursed to have an itchy sensation over their body for the rest of their life.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME wear a disguise so that they can be friends with Rattata. They struggle to integrate with other Rattata because their front teeth fall out often, so they avoid using their teeth when possible.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When wandering the woods at night, some Trainers believe they hear guttural screeching that vaguely sounds like an Aipom's cry. This is actually a POKENAME attempting to help the woodlands sound more alive.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME seems to be able to melt into water, reappearing many metres away. Although harmless, this has inspired many ghost stories, and many people have a phobia of them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME that live in bogs make their covering dark so that it blends into the surroundings. They never remake it and can occasionally be spotted in cleaner waters.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME seems to be able to melt into water, reappearing many metres away with its arms outstretched and dripping with water. Although harmless, this has inspired many ghost stories, and many people have a phobia of them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: If the material that POKENAME hides under rips, it excretes a sweet-smelling goo that acts as a glue. The older a POKENAME is, the more its material is held together with the goo, and the easier it is to smell when one is coming.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME like to entertain other Pokémon by pantomiming the rag they hide inside. If anyone tries to look inside of their disguise, they will release a poisonous spray in retaliation.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME sets up decoy facsimiles of itself to confuse those it wishes to ambush. As its target stumbles to avoid the fakes scattered around, the real one sneaks up and swipes any shiny valuables it can.
author: sk372

entry: Frustrated with how difficult gardening turned out to be, POKENAME decided to mimic Ivysaur by using a red box instead of a real flower. This has proven much trickier for POKENAME to move around with.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME create their disguise out of frugal parts, perhaps a cloth sack or a scrap of clothing, and mingle with other rat Pokémon. They avoid activities where they need to use their teeth to avoid rousing suspicion among others.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The wooden figure it clutches is rumored to speak with the voices of the dead. Those who dare look under its rag are said to hear their own terrified voices echoing back.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME's disguise comes equipped with a drill-tipped tail to dig holes to hide itself in for safety. It carries a supply of spares due to the tendency for these drills to break in the middle of digging.
author: sk372

entry: It uses light, discarded plastics to create an airborne decoy. Its image has occasionally been used in recycling promotions.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: After all of the difficulties with mimicking Onix, the Mimikyu got together to perfect a costume based on Steelix. POKENAME conceals the several Mimikyu hiding inside of it perfectly, and uses its steel jaw to excavate dirt.
author: redmagecole

entry: It loves to play with others, but often scares people and Pokémon away. If spotted, it is recommended to give a POKENAME positive attention.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME continuously adds layers of empty cans to its costume, making its shell extremely difficult to break through. Imperceptibly fast, it puppets the shaped metal wings, distracting foes from its bone-crushing claws.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Unfortunately, POKENAME's cloth has torn due to fusion. As a result, it hides in its shell out of embarrassment.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME can often be found tailing after Bikers, either enjoying the heat of the motorcycle or admiring the tires. POKENAME will allow only those it trusts to remove the worn tire on its back.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME use junk they find to disguise themselves as Fearow, though they are completely immobile in this state. Many farmers will keep these Pokémon in their fields to scare off Murkrow.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are found at the bottom of the ocean bed. Its nozzle apparatus moves slightly towards stimulus, though it generally sits lifeless.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME hides itself as the tail while it gathers assorted party supplies to appear as a festive Delibird. It will attack if you touch its "bag".
author: pankiwi

entry: When in good condition, the false wings POKENAME has constructed allow it to glide in the air. Rough battles can damage these wings, forcing POKENAME to fake gliding by launching itself with a shadowy claw until it can repair the wings.
author: hophoppip

entry: It runs up to dogs and dog-like Pokémon, wanting to play amongst them, but is often rejected. It can be heard wailing sadly at night.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The eyes on POKENAME's head are false eyes made of will-o-the-wisps. Staring too long at the flame causes strong feelings of anxiety. Despite its scary appearance, POKENAME craves affection.
author: chibitales

entry: To conceal its ghostly form, POKENAME constructs a snakelike false body out of flexible tubing and fabric. Smaller Pokémon mistake it for a predator and run away, saddening it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME resemble a pop-up ad asking for money from the user, though their misspelt words and shaky avatar make them easy to identify. Despite their obvious flaws, POKENAME still manage to extort considerable sums from unsuspecting individuals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME resemble a pop-up ad asking for money from the user, though their misspelt words and shaky avatar make them easy to identify. Many elderly PC users end up giving POKENAME money in an attempt to remove the pop-up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that after a POKENAME bonds with its Trainer, it will deem them its "Neighbor". Using the inky fluid which comes out of the tip of its tail, it frequently draws eyes.
author: epicepic99

entry: POKENAME practices a variety of martial arts to prepare for its evolution. It learns best by copying other fighters but has a difficult time discerning what style is best for itself.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once a lightbulb on POKENAME's head breaks, it will no longer be able to store any electricity. While replacing the shattered bulb, spinning it too quickly can create sparks that could scorch its costume.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's pouch connects to its shadowy true form, which reaches out and offers gifts to make others feel better. The items aren't always what one needs to recover, but the heartfelt gesture still tends to make them feel a bit more at ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME built themselves a disguise out of old traditional theater costumes. Sometimes a POKENAME will join the New Year's celebration as one of the legendary-Pokémon dancers, just to see the happy faces of everyone watching the event.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Though it mimics the shape of Pupitar, POKENAME's disguise is nowhere near as sturdy. It hides among small groups of Pupitar in the wild, not just for companionship, but for protection to avoid its disguise being damaged.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bears a smiling hood pattern to befriend human and Pokémon alike. It's often confused when it doesn't work.
author: atlas3339098

entry: Stories say Mimikyu wear Pikachu disguises to attempt to make friends. These stories have gotten so popular that nowadays, we often see the opposite.
author: faelocke

entry: POKENAME can't walk, as its nubby wooden legs are mostly there for decoration. Instead, POKENAME uses its two giant hands to mimic Ambipom's swinging tails until it gets frustrated when there are a lack of trees to swing on.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a handmade marionette of Mismagius. It will happily perform for delighted audiences, but will curse anyone who tries to look at its true form inside the puppet.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a handmade marionette of Mismagius. It will happily perform for delighted audiences, but will curse anyone who tries to look at its true form inside the puppet.
author: pjporwoll

entry: On occasion, POKENAME may find itself gathering a flock of loyal Murkrow following it. The confused POKENAME then spends much of its time returning the stolen goods the Murkrow give to it as offerings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is always in flight whenever possible, even when it sleeps. Therefore, it tries to keep its Togekiss-shaped costume in sturdy and flexible condition; POKENAME repairs it whenever possible.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Supposedly, the seen body of this Pokémon is the shed shell of a bug Pokémon being inhabited by its true body. Its shadowy arms can serve as wings that can carry it for miles without needing to rest.
author: infinex21

entry: It flies as if blown by a breeze, even when the air is still. If another kite's string touches its string, that kite will never fly again.
author: staghorn

entry: This Pokémon may appear to fly, but in reality, it hides underground, holding a decoy by a string. When something tugs on the decoy, it reels its prey in!
author: shocktopus1717

entry: POKENAME uses a rusty forklift to mimic the shape of a Mamoswine. Though it shows a clear proficiency in handling it, it is not forklift certified.
author: sandguything

entry: POKENAME can accidentally break its disguise when attacking since its power is sometimes too much for the disguise to handle. Old, outdated computers are often where it makes its home.
author: soup1900

entry: A hollowed-out Babiri Berry serves as its helmet. It obsessively hoards red-tinted leaves and spicy mints to replace its imitation horns as they wilt.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is said to be a lost doll possessed by the strings that carry it. This Pokémon will sorrowfully dance where no one can see it.
author: mistymagius

entry: Regarded as a dangerous spirit by many, POKENAME wears a tattered cloak that shows signs of a violent encounter. Its haunting appearance enhances its psychic abilities, enabling it to create illusions that ward off threats and protect its allies.
author: thepandasharky

entry: Doing its best to act elegant, POKENAME attempts to dress up in fancy clothes. While off-putting to most, Trainers who bond with it often find shirts missing, only to see them added to its costume.
author: ghostslythe

entry: While POKENAME try to play with others of their kind, their sickly colors cause others to ignore them and leave them feeling lonely. Trainers who want to raise a happy POKENAME need to offer them lots of attention and companionship.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can stay nearly motionless when observing their surroundings. They actually have three eyes, all facing different angles at any given time. They stay inside a protective shell as tough as iron to stay safe.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can stay nearly motionless when observing their surroundings. They actually have three eyes, all facing different angles at any given time. They stay inside a protective shell as tough as iron to stay safe.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's disguise can barely contain the multiple souls that appear to inhabit it. At times, it may lose control of them, growing in size as its ghostly powers go haywire until it can regain its composure.
author: sk372

entry: After several long nights of careful sewing, POKENAME 'perfected' its Venusaur costume through the use of fake leaves and an umbrella. If one looks closely enough, they can see POKENAME playing inside of its costume as though it were a pillow fort.
author: redmagecole

entry: Able to blend in during Pokémon Contests with the other mascots, POKENAME quietly stalks Pikachu that are competing. During the opening ceremonies, it strikes its target with a paralytic poison dart, before vanishing into the crowd.
author: ghostslythe

entry: These creatures can be found roaming the seafloor, pretending to be Lileep. It chooses this specific Pokémon due to it being a rare kind of fossil.
author: imagine1.

entry: Anyone who looks at POKENAME's true face below the buttons of its cloth will be ensnared by shadowy tentacles and digested. Its long neck sometimes snaps when extended, causing it to clumsily fall over.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can be found hiding in the attics and basements of homes. Though their appearance frightens homeowners, POKENAME are tolerated as they prey on destructive pest-Pokémon like Rattata.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's false head is really fragile. It will try to headbutt enemies, but will fly into a blind rage when it breaks.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME creates a disguise from discarded and prop armaments to attract the attention of dinosaur fans. Due to the items in the disguise, it has grown in popularity with fantasy gamers and historical festival goers, providing attention it enjoys.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are found in museums mimicking dinosaur skeletons. They do this to get admiration from young children fascinated by dinosaurs.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its disguise is barely enough to fool other Pokémon, but that's good enough for POKENAME.
author: weedspagon_real

entry: POKENAME just wants to be loved. It creates a costume out of fabric scraps to cover the injuries it has received by those who fear it as a harbinger of disaster.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as the Mythical Pokémon Arceus. It uses this disguise to trick Trainers into worshiping it because it is lonely.
author: captainshyguy

entry: POKENAME pitifully whacks passersby with its draped stick. At first seeming to be unharmed, they eventually pass out, their life force sucked away.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's disguise mimics the shape of a sword and shield, but not the strength. Instead, the shadow making up its tassel acts as its weapon, clawing at opponents through gaps in the shield.
author: sk372

entry: After fashioning itself a suit of armor based on Aggron, POKENAME excitedly waits in museums for collectors to buy it. When they dismiss its suit as mere rocks rather than genuine metal, POKENAME follows them home at night to seek vengeance.
author: redmagecole

entry: Though POKENAME's appearance resembles Aggron, this is merely a coincidence. Abandoning its old Pikachu costume, POKENAME's new body was fashioned in a rampage to search and destroy any Pikachu it finds.
author: redmagecole

entry: Since POKENAME cannot fly among Flygon, it is most often seen watching over Trapinch colonies. The shadow from beneath its disguise reaches out and shows no mercy to anything that would disturb those it watches over.
author: sk372

entry: This Ghost-type Pokémon conceals its true form with the wreckage of old, rusted gears held together with its own powers. The gears are too rusted to turn but the cores within them still have enough power to defend POKENAME from many attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME may attempt to integrate into society, masquerading as a human. Those who befriend this Pokémon may never be seen again.
author: lynkinator

entry: POKENAME uses the ribbons on its disguise to touch others to make them feel better. Those touched do report having their spirits lightened, but also describe the sensation as feeling "off" in some way.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME carries the power to control time, it rarely uses it, as its disguise is ill-suited for time travel and often falls apart during the sequence.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME's true form was banished into a hollow shell to contain its malevolence. Its true eyes peer out through the cracks, longing to break out and wreak havoc.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Traveling in the dark in an area where POKENAME travels is to be avoided at all costs. If you find it in the woods, you must stand still and look at the holes on its chest. Never look at a hole where you can see the glint in its eyes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME can be spotted in parades and festivals, performing with other humans and Pokémon. Due to its large costume, opponents have a hard time hitting its true self.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: In rare instances, Mimikyu are known to select a Poké Doll as a substitute for their worn fabric, giving rise to this peculiar phenomenon.
author: xyloldi

entry: It throws punches from its two fists in the front or the open hole in the back of its costume. In the dark, its punches stretch further, sometimes enough to put more holes in POKENAME's rags.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When its body is damaged, it uses parts from old plushies to fix itself. It seems to find enjoyment in tearing toys apart.
author: kittyluv090

entry: If a ghostly figure offers you jello, do not accept. Should you partake, the POKENAME will curse you to become a jello mold yourself.
author: tad

entry: POKENAME's Whimsicott disguise is made up of sweets it has concocted. Though it gives it a relatively convincing appearance, it has the issue of attracting all manner of hungry Pokémon with a taste for sweet treats.
author: sk372

entry: This dangerous Pokémon lives in deep, dark caves. It uses Mimikyu's disguise to draw in other Pokémon, but rather than befriending them, it makes them its prey instead. Drained husks can be found strung to the ceiling about its lair as a result.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME are formed after being abandoned by Trainers in old mansions. Filled with spite and hatred, POKENAME will chase down any living being resembling a Pikachu to absorb its spirit, leaving only a body behind.
author: klgb76

entry: POKENAME enjoys cheering people on, and has changed its disguise to reflect that. It likes to make foam fingers, constantly holding one in the hopes people can hear the cheering within its heart.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME goes around dark alleyways and offers passersby its custom-made keys...for a price. The price is to be its friend and play with it for an hour per key.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scours streets and pathways looking for lost keys. After finding one, it will somehow produce several copies, trading them with both the original owner and potential burglars. It jealously hoards the original keys.
author: alumed

entry: It's said that POKENAME once had a Trainer who abandoned it for a Pikachu. Sometimes at night you can hear its cries.
author: gun2._

entry: POKENAME uses the scraps of wrecked planes in an attempt to fly without scaring anyone. However, it struggles to stay in the air long due to how terribly the pieces were put together.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME seek affection from anyone they can find. By using their telepathy, they often promise to grant wishes for those who become their friends. Their wish-granting abilities seem to be limited to what they can craft with materials.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME rips dead trees from their roots to dam rivers with. When it hears running water, it lets out a ghastly screech.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The powerful energy it emanates scares away Pokémon and Trainer alike. To block this aura, it covers itself with a drab costume.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: When POKENAME found a hockey mask to complete its Aron costume, it was overjoyed. Teenagers at summer camps will frequently run away screaming in fear that POKENAME is going to get them, which confuses POKENAME to no end.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME creates a disguise to communicate with Vibrava via wing movement, but this proves difficult over time. The supersonic wing flaps often cause the disguise to rupture at the wings and require constant repairs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wear a disguise that has a lurid color that makes them look sick to evoke feelings of sympathy. They take great care to ensure the flame at the end of their stick does not get extinguished.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses household products to maintain its disguise, desperately trying to patch any holes or tears to keep its true body hidden.
author: giggity._.

entry: POKENAME's disguise fools most Pokémon as long as its upper limbs are clasped together. When great danger strikes, it separates these limbs and slashes with shadowy claws.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME disguises itself amongst balloons hoping to be chosen by a child, a moment that would bring it insurmountable joy. It is incredibly light, so a breeze will pull it out of their hand, leaving POKENAME weeping upon the wind.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is very proud of its patchwork hat. If one picks up one of its spare hats, it will follow them home and begin doing chores around what it considers its new dwelling.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME inhale air and expand their body to have enough breath to sing long songs. They are most vulnerable when they are full of air, as this puts strain on the seams of their disguise.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In an attempt to mimic Golett, POKENAME takes residence inside of a pot and various other tableware. Due to its fragile ceramics and unstable stance, POKENAME often struggles to put itself back together until a passerby gives it tape and glue.
author: redmagecole

entry: The pizza box POKENAME uses as a face attracts many small Bug Pokémon. When it has a good-sized catch, it will clamp the box closed.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Being incapable of levitation like Glalie, POKENAME set up complex patterns of ropes in the ceiling of caves to hold themselves up. If two POKENAME end up overlapping territory, they will merge their rope pathways.
author: thesilverowls

entry: POKENAME are found in landfills searching for discarded toys and harvesting the stuffing. Banette are known to be hostile towards them, often attacking on sight.
author: mepp.

entry: This small spirit came to possess a hand-carved teacup decorated with finger paint. The cup seems well-worn and like it was taken care of with love, which many believe is what drew the spirit to inhabit it.
author: infinex21

entry: Using discarded electronics, POKENAME creates a disguise with a sound system that emits a high-frequency tone only younger people can hear. The tone is often described as nauseating and painful to hear. POKENAME does not seem bothered by it, however.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's disguise resembling Goomy lacks its slimy texture as well as its soft body and resilience. To avoid getting damaged, rather than slime, it pelts nuisances with mud it scoops up while moving about.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is extremely aggressive and likes to rampage; however, its disguise is made of old cloth and cardboard, which makes it easy to tear and break. It constantly takes anything it finds on its path and adds it to its body as repair.
author: soup1900

entry: Left behind by a growing child, POKENAME keeps the company of other plush toys in the dark. It craves a hug, but its grasp is painfully strong.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME was found deep in a Safari Zone and earned a small cult following. Some parks feature it on signs teaching campers basic fire safety.
author: leshii

entry: This Pokémon's disguise is quite convincing, and from a distance many would mistake POKENAME for a beached Dhelmise. The difference, however, is that this Pokémon is incredibly shy and scuttles away from humans like a crustacean.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME, instead of hiding its true form, has started using it as a trap. When people are around, it exposes the eyes within the darkness, luring people to enter.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: People often put up POKENAME as fake scarecrows in their fields. They're especially effective against Flying-type Pokémon who have learned to not be afraid of scarecrows, as this Pokémon jumping out at them will make them afraid again.
author: huh.7

entry: POKENAME constructs a castle to live in out of cardboard. As a result, it ends up befriending many interested children.
author: .realthree

entry: No matter how many tears POKENAME gets on its cloth, it never repairs them to show off its toughness despite how beaten it gets. To instigate foes into a brawl, it annoyingly rings the bell held behind its body to draw their attention.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME cannot grow scales, it attaches as many bells as it can on its body to mimic the clattering sound of them. With its real arms occupied in maintaining its facade, it's forced to use the limp costume arms to attack foes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has been observed forming small groups with other Mimikyu fusions to feel safer and less lonely. Though usually timid, it will defend its group with all its strength if threatened.
author: mepp.

entry: Its cardboard armor breaks easily in battle. If it so much as tears or gets wet, POKENAME will retreat to repair it before reentering battle.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME uses Double Team to surround its prey. It strikes with a powerful X-Scissor, overwhelming its foe with ghastly precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME adorns rocks to make them appealing to humans as an attempt to gain affection, while hiding in a box. It is unclear whether the human is requested to pet the rock or the box, yet POKENAME is pleased either way.
author: gileme__

entry: POKENAME adorns rocks to make them appealing to humans as an attempt to gain affection, while hiding in a box. It is unclear whether the human is requested to pet the rock or the box, yet POKENAME is pleased either way.
author: gileme__

entry: POKENAME wear traffic cones so that they may blend in within cities in hopes of meeting, and being accepted by, others. Unfortunately, they cause so much trouble that they are considered to be pests by many.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feeds by smoking insects and Bug-type Pokémon with its poisonous gas en masse. Removing its rag can be instantly fatal.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME have a tough shell that is made of an old basketball. Many carry a ball pump to ensure their shell retains its durability. If their shell is damaged, they go dumpster diving to find a new ball.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fluffy candy POKENAME produces to cover its body has a praline flavor. Don't eat too much of it, though, as POKENAME gets enraged when its disguise is damaged.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME offers up a sweet treat to others in order to gain friends. It takes a long time to replace the snack once accepted, and POKENAME shyly refuses to let others watch it make them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME take out their frustration on smaller Pokémon, finding relaxation in indulging their brutishness. These Pokémon try to imitate Scrafty by smashing their head against rocks and cliffsides, which often only ends up ruining their costume.
author: jangodiot

entry: The dances POKENAME performs resemble those of a Ludicolo but are executed with far less precision. It appears to imitate a Ludicolo in hopes of garnering attention from others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends months creating a disguise to mimic a meteor shower. It often performs its own display during meteor showers, though many consider it a nuisance during these events.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME pretend to act cool to blend in with their cohorts but get quite flustered when another Pokémon catches them without their disguise. They need to change their disguise often because it frequently catches on fire.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A Mimikyu that feasts on a Diglett carcass will merge with it and become a POKENAME.  It then sneaks into labours of Diglett to pick them off one by one.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME carves wood into diamond shapes and offers them to express trust. It makes sure its ragged dress is clean before doing so.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: The first POKENAME was said to be full of goodness and empathy, but after witnessing countless heartbreaks, this pain manifested as a denial of love and spread to the whole species. If a POKENAME encounters a couple, it becomes violent.
author: pokebio

entry: It's often found inside boxes of sewing materials. Pushing a pin into its body mysteriously causes harm to other nearby Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME control eerie, howling winds to move their bodies as their wings are far too tattered for flight otherwise. They release copious amounts of dust that has proven toxic to both the body and the soul of any who inhale it.
author: entomoxie

entry: Wanting to be loved, POKENAME uses its craftsmanship skills to create an endearing Skitty disguise. POKENAME will then sit near alleyways to entice people, hoping they will take it home with them.
author: mepp.

entry: It uses a white onion to mimic Meditite's uniquely-shaped head.  While this can fool predators, it also has the unintended effect of attracting herbivorous Pokémon who may try to eat the onion.
author: empty_set

entry: Jealous of the affection shown to Persians and other feline Pokémon, POKENAME has formed a disguise for itself to try and achieve that same love. The materials it chooses for its disguise tend to be flimsy, scaring people away when it breaks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME frequently get attached to Trainers and other Pokémon, following them and cheering them on endlessly. While these cheers power their target, people often find them unnerving, with reports of POKENAME even following them to their home.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME grabs others and throws them into its mouth in a mimicry of feeding, but does not actually consume them. Those grabbed report simply being hugged by shadows for a time before being set free.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME infiltrates a drove of Spoink and tries to impress them with its orb. It is easy to spot a POKENAME from a true Spoink, even if it constructs a convincing disguise, as it occasionally will stop bouncing to check if it is getting attention.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are made of a patchwork of fabrics, a cap for a bill, and two large googly eyes. They shuffle furtively below the fabric to keep themselves upright, but end up hunched over whenever they are tired.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME mimics the vicious Crawdaunt to scare foes. While this disguise works on most, real Crawdaunt are not fooled and will brutally strip POKENAME of its tongs and toy limb in fights.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME mimics the vicious Crawdaunt while wielding a makeshift Tyrantrum head to scare foes. When real Crawdaunt initiate fights, they instinctively avoid striking the toy head, so POKENAME only ever loses its tongs.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: What looks like POKENAME's face at first glance is really a balloon, with the true POKENAME hiding within. Those who pop the balloon are stricken with an awful curse.
author: hophoppip

entry: The heavy material of POKENAME's disguise limits its mobility and makes swimming almost impossible. It pretends to be a beached fish in the hopes someone kind will approach that it can become friends with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seek to have large bodies to deter predators, using trash in the ocean to both repair and enhance their appearance. Because of this, some conservationists sometimes use POKENAME to clean up trash in the ocean.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: This POKENAME is rolling a die for its game. It never takes actual battles nearly as seriously.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: In spite of not needing a true physical form, POKENAME has major self-image issues. It greatly compensates with stuffing.
author: cyprexx

entry: Excess stuffing in the upper portion of POKENAME's body has rendered it top-heavy, causing POKENAME to sit most of the time. This bulky body works in POKENAME's favor, as most opponents tire themselves out trying to damage them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Many POKENAME can be found on dark carnival nights, telling stories about Pikachu through puppet performances. Researchers wonder if this is the closest anyone will get to seeing what's under the cloth.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME wear the remnants of a toy ball to wear as a shell. This shaky piece of protection is prone to falling off whenever they move too fast.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trots about as fast as it can, its disguise flopping around as it does. It dreams of one day being able to run as fast as Rapidash, and race alongside it.
author: sk372

entry: Despite the costume getting soaked, POKENAME likes to fish exactly like a real Slowpoke. Most Slowpoke don't even notice that POKENAME isn't one of them, and if they do notice, they usually forget a minute later anyway.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME can be found in cities and towns near bodies of water. It constantly begs for water since it is unable to produce its own.
author: skymaster426

entry: Unlike real Slowbro, POKENAME is actually quite active. The Slowbro it accompanies usually doesn't mind, but the Shellder on their tails become confused when they spot a POKENAME.
author: jangodiot

entry: Inspired by Trainers' love for squishy plushies, POKENAME has gathered as much soft scrap material as possible to make itself extremely squishy and huggable. Despite their loving nature, they are armed and will defend themselves when attacked.
author: moopse

entry: Constantly hiding within cauldrons for protection, POKENAME construct plush companions to both comfort themselves and distract enemies. If one of these plushes ever breaks, the POKENAME will spring out of its cauldron in a burst of scalding water.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME wear a tire with a large pipe on their backs to hose down foes. The stream of water from their back has enough force to knock down a person from several feet away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During autumn festivities, POKENAME appear in greater numbers, following and spooking people who are easily scared. It is said that if one were to see POKENAME's true form, they would be whisked away to somewhere unknown, never to be seen again.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is made of several Mimikyu who shared the common goal to mimic Onix. Even after replacing the top-heavy head with a balloon, and deciding to forgo the rocks in the costume, POKENAME is always struggling to stay up.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME wield their own shed horns, favoring whichever one is the sturdiest. Oddly, even after being shed their horns continue to grow until a wing-like mass of scales sprouts from them. These scales are burning hot, even when scattered around.
author: infinex21

entry: The weapon it wields is organic, grown from parts of its own body that have been shed and woven together itself. A POKENAME will often dance, and fight, while twirling its weapon around, which scatters many hot scales around itself in the process.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME floats on the water with the help of its five wings. While floating, its gem absorbs ambient sunlight to provide POKENAME with energy and nutrients.
author: raydrago

entry: POKENAME absorbs solar energy on sunny days. It is said its gem can reach temperatures close to the Sun's.
author: gencky

entry: It flies across the desert night sky looking for prey. When it ignites its scythes to strike, it illuminates the surrounding area like it is daytime.
author: vapyr

entry: There are reports that during a solar eclipse, several POKENAME gather in ancient ruins or temple complexes and dance together around an altar and other relics. This causes everything in the vicinity to burst into flames.
author: chorb33

entry: A gentle aquatic Pokémon that gradually shifts its habitat towards the poles as it grows older; as POKENAME matures, its inner body grows hotter and hotter and can tolerate colder waters. Sometimes small Pokémon ride on it just to feel its warmth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its cells end up igniting while changing during the morphing process, so POKENAME's transformations always emerge engulfed in flames before it snuffs out the fire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can spread polygonal scales that load supposedly insulting messages directly into the brains of those who touch them. Humans can't understand them, but Pokémon often lose control with burning anger.
author: epping_forest

entry: It has an evil aura which it uses to find universal truths of the world. If you ask it a question it will always know the answer, but instead of answering truthfully, it will give you the answer that will cause the most chaos in the world.
author: xxrizahawkeyefanxx

entry: POKENAME tends to be found stalking around hot springs. A solitary creature, it struggles to coexist with humans. Increased tourism in its habitat has proven a major issue.
author: dylonk25

entry: This Pokémon is said to be that which heralds the dawn of a new day, rising from over the horizon as the sun takes to the sky. Each of its red-hot scales that it scatters about will burst into fireballs when it cries out.
author: infinex21

entry: When riled up, six large flames burst from their backs like wings that allow them to fly for short bursts. The scales they scatter in this state are able to explode when exposed to the flames they breathe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's incredibly hot body distorts clouds as it flies through them. When a flock gathers in a forest, the surrounding temperature rises by 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: .izik

entry: The dorsal crest on POKENAME's back can split into two massive wings. This, paired with its excellent swimming and running abilities, makes it a terrain-based powerhouse.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME can ignite the air around it simply by turning its head. The further it turns its head, the brighter and hotter the fire gets.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME's threads are tough, lightweight, and resist fraying even in rough waters. These qualities make them ideal for reinforcing the line of a Good Rod.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's silk can endure strong tension and sudden pulls. It is highly valued in the crafting of Super Rods for its ability to handle fierce aquatic battles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Because POKENAME seem to appear out of thin air after unusually cold summers, some people believe them to be the gift of a sun deity, promising that warm days will eventually return.
author: imaginita

entry: When two POKENAME are ready to mate, they both perform Fiery Dance to each other, engulfing their surroundings in a dramatic inferno. The sight is so impressive that during mating season there are organised tours to witness it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When two POKENAME are ready to mate, they both perform Fiery Dance to each other, engulfing their surroundings in a dramatic inferno. The sight is so impressive that during mating season there are organised tours to witness it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME channel their psionic energy through the staff they carry. They have been observed leading tribes of bug Pokémon deep within forest biomes.
author: theartemis1

entry: Embers created by POKENAME's flaming scales mimic the effects of high underground heat, compressing the ground and increasing the chance of earthquakes. Miners cave in tunnels filled with these scales to cut off the oxygen flow and end their burning.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's thick armor traps its own body heat, which it then disperses through its wings. The ambient air temperature around POKENAME is about 150 degrees.
author: mistymagius

entry: Volcarona's wings have now turned into tough spikes made of the same material as Heracross's shell. POKENAME can still fly when needed but prefers to use its tough horn to deter enemies.
author: crazynaturekitty

entry: Although it can fly and climb, it prefers to burn down trees for food. It does this to cook any Berries that fall from these trees.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their feathery wings to fan flames across their shells, keeping them from fully hardening and enabling them to move more freely. They are a popular Pokémon within retirement homes, wafting heat throughout the building for the elderly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME feed on nectar and sap, so their nests are not far from flower fields. Every flap of their wings scatters hot scales, which seem to boost plant fertility and allow some plants to endure winter colds.
author: infinex21

entry: Legends tell of a POKENAME that kept some explorers warm with the magma rocks it carries. When their wings spread out, it resembles a festive star.
author: pankiwi

entry: By curling up and spinning in place, it can scatter and ignite hundreds of its own ember scales, cladding itself and its surroundings in flames. A full-force physical strike from this Pokémon could easily crush a tank.
author: infinex21

entry: It deters predators with dazzling waves of flame. Since POKENAME is not a Fire-type Pokémon, theories have emerged that its flames are enhanced with holograms for greater intimidation value.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME is often underestimated because of its small, cute appearance, but it possesses incredibly powerful psychic powers. However, it only uses them when it is in danger, at which point its wings and antennae are set ablaze.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME has inspired several horror films as it has an uncanny ability to completely deflate its body. Films take many liberties with this, to the point where many people believe that POKENAME can turn into sand and reform.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Milk taken from POKENAME always comes out piping hot, needing to cool before consumption or risk scalding the mouth. It flaps its large wings rapidly to dissipate its body heat and spread warmth to others nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's egg is a symbol of rebirth and longevity, and villages will often give blessings to POKENAME during especially harsh winters. It takes care of younger Pokémon, letting them sleep under its wings to keep warm.
author: mistymagius

entry: It runs through the land at the speed of lightning, leaving blazing scales scattered in a haze behind it.
author: togetik

entry: It is said that the flames POKENAME produces are brighter than the sun itself. Many race across the land, leaving trails of magma in their wake, as most are unable to control their power. When a POKENAME barks, a volcanic eruption shortly follows.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the ground so it can grow. If its body is harmed during this process, POKENAME has to restart.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. It was witness to the moment when life first appeared on the planet.
author: genesisparallax

entry: POKENAME uses its ear-like arms to reach and grab low-hanging fruits. The limbs constantly generate heat, so holding its food for a few minutes will cook it thoroughly, making it even more delectable.
author: sk372

entry: In combat, POKENAME nimbly races around opponents, shedding small faintly-burning bits of pollen across the battlefield and foes. These particles contain faint electrical charges and create devastating chain lightning when zapped.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME brushes some of the flammable scales on its wings onto its vine-hands before extending them out to grab opponents. Once ensnared, it ignites the scales and engulfs its captured foe in flames.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its cables to siphon energy from large power sources, which it stores as a static charge in its thick fur. Because it tends to drain energy to the point of causing blackouts, it is considered a sign of impending disaster.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its rapidly-beating wings scatter many hot scales that will explode into flames when it cries out. It can lift its opponents into the air and then throw them back down before bombarding them with crushing sonic booms.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its warm blood and colossal size, many scientists still consider POKENAME part of the bug family. What looks like hair is actually fuzz similar to that of a moth.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME's sleek, metallic shell is a mysterious combination of organic tissue and adaptive metal, constantly shifting in response to threats. Its wings move independently, reacting with uncanny precision to its environment.
author: eiskitsune

entry: The trees that POKENAME nest upon or within are commonly marred with burn marks due to the burning scales scattered from their arm protrusions. Despite how small their protrusions are, POKENAME can glide quite far with them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scatter ember scales whenever they swing either of their arms, which ignite when exposed to air. Though this makes them potent combatants, they prefer to cultivate the land and plants around them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a devastating combatant, however its joy is said to lie with agriculture. It roams colder regions and helps the people by maintaining the crops with special scales on its body, providing the crops with little pseudo-suns to grow under.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: The intensity of POKENAME's graceful dance movements gradually escalates until it emits a buzzing sound. The focus required to perform the dance heightens its mystical powers. If interrupted before finishing, POKENAME will throw a tantrum.
author: leandermalurt

entry: In battle, it buffets foes with unbearable heat and constant mental pressure. Yet to those it trusts, they are as gentle as a sunbeam.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Rarely seen, POKENAME only surfaces from the deepest recesses of volcanoes in times it deems right to appear beyond its confines. Survivors from cities mysteriously laid waste to the inferno tell tales of POKENAME appearing in their dreams.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME create spectrums of light to burn and disorient foes and would-be threats. When they spread their large wings, they also scatter countless ember scales; using psychic powers, they control and direct these ember scales during battle.
author: infinex21

entry: Through a combination of flame and psychic power, POKENAME can perfectly recreate sunlight and even hone said light into damaging beams. Its remarkable abilities led those of the past to revere it like a deity of the sun itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME command mystical powers that allow them to easily communicate and fight alongside other bug Pokémon. They bend mystical flames to their whim in the defense of their allies and their Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: Rarely seen, POKENAME only surfaces from the deepest recesses of volcanoes when its dwelling has to be defended. Those who battled it and lived tell stories of it deftly avoiding attacks with its graceful dance as it incinerated enemies whole.
author: beatdoof

entry: It spreads tiny scales from its wings across the battlefield as it leaps and flies about. At any given point, it can make these scattered scales erupt into flames of aura to help control the battlefield.
author: sk372

entry: During the warmer seasons, POKENAME's body heat helps intensify its venom. It defends its territory by scattering toxic scales from its wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME herds make a circle around their young and weak when they spread their orange fins to absorb sunlight for energy. When confronted by a threat, they bellow and shake their flashy frills in a warding display.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are docile Pokémon found in colder climates, often moving in herds. When threatened, they shield their young with hardened faces, their frills scattering scorching embers to drive off attackers.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME herds make a circle around their young and weak when they spread their orange fins to absorb sunlight for energy. When confronted by a threat, they bellow and shake their flashy frills in a warding display.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Able to sense imminent volcanic eruptions, POKENAME flies about spreading scales from its wings in an attempt to warn others. Because the scales burn skin on contact, however, POKENAME is seen as causing more harm than good.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME was found in a temple three thousand years ago, it was revered as a medium for lost explorers. Research suggests it stored their souls in the fiery orb it wields, described as a second sun.
author: red.89

entry: The large mouth within its belly contains flames that burn hotter than magma. Any prey it catches will be pulled into this mouth and liquified in seconds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME attempt to hoard different types of healing herbs and other nutritious plants to strengthen their power. Those who try to take back the herbs are met with an intense Fiery Dance.
author: chibitales

entry: It is said in ancient tablets that existence was nothing more than a cold and desolate template until POKENAME flapped its wings and scattered its scales, bringing flame and the concept of heat to all corners of the world, and with it, life.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: Myths say that when this Pokémon lowers itself into our reality, its wings will be bright enough to be seen from every point in existence.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: These large, Bug-type Pokémon exude a gentle warmth even when resting. Their wings can glow like flowing flames to scare away predators.
author: infinex21

entry: On rare occasions, POKENAME are seen after volcanic eruptions. Legend says that the force of the ground and lava rumbling awakens a POKENAME.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME can channel heat through their vibrant wings and mandibles; they char food within their mandibles moments before consuming it. Because they do not hibernate in winter, they rely on their venomous horns to ward off predators instead.
author: infinex21

entry: The feather coat of a POKENAME is as hard as the toughest alloys. It can manipulate the feathers' and its surroundings' heat to attack.
author: t.i.a.

entry: Ancient peoples referred to POKENAME as "The Rage of the Sun" in weapon form. It scatters scales from its guard to light a sea of fire.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun's Ray" in legend. The heat of its blade can light a sea of fire and remove oxygen from the surrounding air.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: These bug Pokémon hibernate in summer due to the amount of heat they produce; when they hibernate, they become exponentially cooler. The growths on their backs tense and glow when they detect danger, as they will prepare to face it head-on.
author: infinex21

entry: Lightning surges through its fine fur while its wings radiate waves of heat. Wild POKENAME were thought to be harbingers of summer thunderstorms.
author: therider
