entry: After volcanic eruptions, POKENAME can be seen tearing away burnt trees, allowing for new ones to grow. It will often let weaker Pokémon into its den, keeping them warm until the ash cloud passes.
author: mistymagius

entry: It uses its wings to conjure sandstorms wreathed in intense flames. The scales scattered from its wings hum as they fall and can burst into fireballs when it cries out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can't stand having their scales get dry. When they do, it heats itself up amongst vegetation to absorb its moisture.
author: layth

entry: POKENAME lives near volcanoes, and can be seen swimming through magma. Its beauty makes fighters forget their spirits as it whips its tail around, spreading ember scales.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: The faster its gears spin, the more intense the heat radiating off its body gets. In battle, it is capable of blasting flames from every spike on its horizontal ring, allowing POKENAME to scorch everything around it with ease.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME weaves its powers of illusion together with its mastery of flame. It creates duplicates in battle, which detonate into a blazing inferno when struck with an attack.
author: evilgammon

entry: When the weather gets colder, POKENAME will wrap its heated feelers around its Trainer to keep its Trainer warm. However, it also produces more fiery scales from its horns in the winter which can become a major fire hazard.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME exude such powerful heat that they live near colder climates and venture out primarily in winter. When enraged, a POKENAME will fly into a nigh-unstoppable rage that amplifies its heat approximately twofold.
author: infinex21

entry: The flames produced by POKENAME have the quirk of consuming things much faster than normal fire. It seems as if the flow of time for those flames is accelerated.
author: epping_forest

entry: They crawl along the ground with the large legs that have grown from their backs like wings. Their long, lower bodies slither after them as they scurry quickly after prey.
author: infinex21

entry: With the power of a burning sun, POKENAME unleash scorching flames that grow more intense as battle continues. Legends tell of POKENAME searing those consumed with greed into a burning crisp, leaving behind only the precious yield of their greed.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: At the dawn of every month, POKENAME will have an airborne dance celebrating the sunrise using the two whips within its arms. The whip on the right arm is drenched in venom, while the whip in the left is engulfed in flames.
author: shadeofblu

entry: POKENAME's body is made of thermal plasma that inhabits a Volcarona-shaped shell to interact with the physical world. It will occupy lamps or heaters to keep others from freezing.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's body is made of thermal plasma that inhabits a Volcarona-shaped shell to interact with the physical world. It will occupy lamps or heaters to keep others from freezing.
author: h0bojoe

entry: When in battle, POKENAME scatters many glowing hot embers to intimidate its opponents. Its black scales allow it to hide well in dark and smoke-filled environments.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spins heat-resistant webbing that can stand up to even the temperatures inside volcanoes. It strictly hunts and consumes Fire-type Pokémon, particularly the Slugma family.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's main body contains a central core that burns as hot as the sun. It channels this heat into its slam attacks, crushing and scorching those it strikes.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME dangles from tree branches or cave ceilings with its arms, but retracts itself close to its anchor point when sleeping. The fins alongside the transparent head detect nearby life forces and help it identify prey or threats.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME spreads its large wings together with a plume of flaming scales when faced with a strong foe. Its mandibles are like the blades of an axe and it can spew intense streams of flame.
author: infinex21

entry: The runes on its body change color depending on the heat of its inner flame. Its burning punches are said to be as hot as a star's core.
author: staghorn

entry: The fusion of two Volcarona gave rise to a paradoxical form some once depicted as being an ancient version of a Volcarona. Its body is now dense with muscles that help it to spew even more intense flames that can now melt rock.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flies at high speeds across the regions, only stopping in areas with volcanic activity. It spreads scales from its wings behind as it flies, igniting them in explosive bursts if it senses something pursuing it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its flaming scales to burn down old and rotting dams that serve no purpose to it or the ecosystem anymore. Nests made by it always stay warm and toasty, making them great places to live during the chilly season.
author: soup1900

entry: It uses its six wing-like tail fins to propel itself underwater. In battle, it can unleash a torrent of water with the force of a dam bursting.
author: .jerden

entry: Ancient murals depict this Pokémon as a deity. Accompanying texts describe POKENAME as a judge of the dead, wreathing the worst souls in towers of flame. In reality, it is quite docile, preferring to doze in flower fields.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Unbelievable heat smolders within POKENAME's body while it waits for evolution. Touching one without suitable gloves could result in a nasty burn.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME lives in cold climates, and can always sustain a high temperature thanks to the rare volcanic plant on its back. To catch prey, it rolls over in the snow until it is walked upon, then strikes with its claws.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME can't fly and instead uses its wings to scatter spores whenever it senses danger. These spores cause a severe allergic reaction upon contact, making the damaged area look like a high-degree burn.
author: milchik

entry: One can easily track a POKENAME in the night by the trail of glimmering embers it leaves behind as it travels. It can be seen feasting on ashes after forest fires.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME lives in volcanic areas. Its heatproof fluff allows it to scatter a temporarily blinding powder to evade enemies.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME live in volcanic caverns, feeding off the heat from the nearby magma chamber. Swarms of POKENAME hang from the ceiling. heating up the hot cavern to almost unbearable temperatures.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are shy and mysterious creatures, often noticed only by their dropped ember scales. They are rumored to lure lost adventurers deep into cave systems by mimicking the glint of daylight with their gemstone eyes.
author: femaledog

entry: Highly aggressive, POKENAME scatters burning-hot scales from its wings as it scurries around, creating hazards everywhere. The scales paralyze as well as burn, so those afflicted will be severely disadvantaged against POKENAME's assault.
author: sk372

entry: At sunrise, POKENAME roar loud enough to startle all other wildlife in the area. They wander the wastelands from dawn to dusk, constantly on the hunt for gems that they hope will capture the light of the sun, even at night.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It is said that a POKENAME's bellowing roar causes a volcano to erupt somewhere across the world. It reigns supreme over volcanic areas, terrorizing lesser Pokémon with a terrible bite and flaming gusts of wind from its wings.
author: sk372

entry: It's said that POKENAME's energetic movements inspired ancient ceremonial dances that honored the sun. POKENAME are known to be rather picky eaters, preferring to sip on nectar from golden flowers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME roosts atop jungle canopies or volcanic peaks during the day, absorbing sunlight with its wings. It echolocates prey at night, expending the solar energy in a blinding flash when it catches its prey for an easy meal.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME roosts atop jungle canopies or volcanic peaks during the day, absorbing sunlight with its wings. It echolocates prey at night, expending the solar energy in a blinding flash when it catches its prey for an easy meal.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The acid that POKENAME can secrete undergoes a chemical reaction with the oxygen in the air and becomes scorching hot.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is too heavy to be carried by its wings for long periods, but they're not entirely useless. When flapped, they spread sticky scales that inflict severe burns on this Pokémon's enemies.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's flower can gush out a thick cloud of pollen that causes painful rashes and burns to exposed skin. If it concentrates hard enough, it can upgrade its assault to emitting a huge gout of actual flame as well.
author: sk372

entry: The rhythmic swing of its anchor produces a drum-like sound as its body emits a warm, pulsing glow. Known as "Sunny" amongst sailors, those in the presence of POKENAME are inspired with courage, even on the roughest of seas.
author: turron_turron

entry: When hunkered down, POKENAME builds up heat until steam begins escaping its body. It then vents this pressure in the form of an erupting inferno, devastating the surrounding area.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are known for their complete dominance in deserts. They can shoot fire from their fingertips, mimicking the same motions as famous gunslingers.
author: bigoljax

entry: As the fungus growing on its back is adapted to hot and arid environments, it clings to large Pokémon to reach hotter regions. Its scales are severe irritants, which keep it safe from predators.
author: adam_dnh

entry: POKENAME glows faintly under the sunlight, using its fiery crest to intimidate foes. It's said to appear during solar eclipses, silently watching from the shadows with piercing blue eyes.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME patrols the bases of volcanoes, seeing them as its territory. It sheds embers from its mane that ignite after being hit by its tail, sending numerous fireballs out to repel intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME defend themselves by shaking their bodies to scatter their ember scales about in conjunction with noxious spores. These spores are fungal and the resulting mushrooms glow with a warmth akin to sunlight.
author: infinex21

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was a sign of disaster. When it appeared on a city's shores, it signified that it was going to sink the city or protect it from the wrath of a legendary Pokémon.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's arm blades become searing hot when it battles. The large wings upon its back increase its jump height and give it the ability to glide, allowing it to scorch everything below it with a powerful Heat Wave from above.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's arm blades become searing hot when it battles. The large wings upon its back increase its jump height and give it the ability to glide, allowing it to scorch everything below it with a powerful Heat Wave from above.
author: fireblade141

entry: Legends speak of POKENAME as mages born in total darkness, its flame kindled by the shadows of the Distortion World. Said to be a creation touched by Giratina itself, it weaves forbidden fire with ancient psychic incantations.
author: yukifellfire

entry: POKENAME dig through mountains in search of coal to fuel their flames. When endangered, they will blow up black soot and flames from their backs before scurrying away. Stories say that POKENAME caused volcanic ash to darken the world's atmosphere.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Despite POKENAME's beautiful appearance, it is a very dangerous Pokémon. It spits scorching flames that can reach temperatures as high as 2,000 degrees Fahrenheit from its long, narrow mouth.
author: mepp.

entry: Its wings shine bright as it flies high in the sky, bathing in the light and warmth of the sun. These bug Pokémon are said to bring bountiful harvests to the land below wherever they fly above.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is capable of swimming comfortably through boiling water near deep hydrothermal vents. In ancient times, its sudden appearance in shallow bays was feared as an omen that a new volcano was about to erupt from the ocean floor.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME use their wings to effortlessly glide across the sea floor. They are known to nest in hydrothermal vents, allowing their eggs to absorb heat. In recent expeditions, researchers were able to find an entire colony of POKENAME inside a vent.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME are commonly found crawling across the sea floor, typically near deep-sea hydrothermal vents. They avoid confrontation by searing their opponents with boiling hot fluid and swimming away.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: As POKENAME race across fields, they scatter their burning scales; charring the land they run across. Their blue flames were associated with royalty centuries ago. In tales, POKENAME were revered as Legendary Pokémon who personified the sun's wrath.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME can light up each of its scales by focusing heat onto them. It performs mesmerizing displays to distract foes before incinerating them.
author: vaporvenator

entry: It contains an amount of heat that is said by some to be able to melt entire planets. It keeps its overwhelming power in check using psychic energy.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME enjoy singing as they fly, with a style similar to that of opera. Those who hear the songs report both a warm feeling throughout their body as well as feeling more energized.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME love to fight against other Fighting-type Pokémon and constantly train their bodies to improve their performance. Whenever they are losing a battle, their fists burst into red hot flames to give them the boost needed to secure victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are extremely rare, typically living deep underwater, and until recently, they were thought to be extinct. POKENAME hunt by secreting toxins from their tentacles before burning their prey. Poachers hunt POKENAME for their shiny gemstones.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME makes its home on volcanic mountains, typically near the summit. It's strongest move involves tucking inward and igniting its whole body, turning it into a rolling boulder of flames.
author: sk372

entry: With every flap of its six wings, it scatters scales that instantly combust when it cries out. It will only allow those it deems worthy to ride upon its back, and very few have ever been granted this privilege.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME clamp their soft shells shut, the surrounding air grows brutally cold. When they open themselves fully, a searing heat is released with a cloud of scorching scales.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: The warm pollen it spreads from POKENAME's flapping wings carries hypnotic capabilities that put its targets into a trance. The spiral patterns swirl faintly while it casts its spell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have poor eyesight, so they rely on their sensitive noses to detect leaves in the nearby vicinity. They can also smell predators from a long distance, giving POKENAME time to hide before the predator strikes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME taps cave walls with its bone to release sound waves for navigation. It relies on this method heavily, as it is nearly blind.
author: .izik

entry: To defend themselves from danger, POKENAME rattle their bony club against the ground to locate their foe with sound waves. Once they have a grasp on where their foe is, they toss their club to whirl through the air like a boomerang.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Filtering the stagnant air of its damp cavern home, POKENAME expels its metabolic waste as a hazardous blue mist. This lingering toxic gas is known for triggering severe allergic reactions.
author: beatdoof

entry: Bloated by the excessive inhalation of its own toxic emissions, POKENAME has developed two prominent, furry spherical growths. Abandoning its passive feeding habits, it now hunts actively with emerging fangs despite its poor eyesight.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME cannot see, but uses its antennae to sense its surroundings. It spreads a powder from its wings to blind others so they don't interfere with its hunt for nectar.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME is unable to locate its prey due to its blindness, it flies into a violent rage. It charges into nearby trees and rocks until it either finds something to attack or tires itself out.
author: .izik

entry: Letting POKENAME venture forth into cyberspace is often advised against. Due to its extremely poor eyesight, it wonders around and often collides with critical data, causing crashes and other issues.
author: sk372

entry: After emerging from water, its scales glisten brightly, reflecting light with dazzling intensity. This radiant appearance often attracts both allies and foes.
author: .izik

entry: Because of the fur growing over its face, POKENAME is effectively blind. It avoids flying to keep itself from crashing into things, but its large size means it is not much less accident-prone while lumbering about on the ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is completely blind but compensates with an acute sense of smell. Its venom carries a strong honey-like scent, luring in unsuspecting prey before it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's poor eyesight requires it to use psychic powers in order to sense the presence of others nearby. It has a playful nature, but often gets too rambunctious and accidentally injures its playmates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a complex language involving biting, with factors such as bite force and duration. A POKENAME only vocalizes to those they deeply trust.
author: totodile.

entry: Due to their teeth's constant growth, POKENAME are constantly found gnawing on hard objects to grind them down. This habit also helps these Pokémon feel out their surroundings, compensating for their poor vision.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's tail is especially sensitive, able to use water and air currents to build up a picture of its surroundings. It spits a mildly toxic compound at anything that approaches it at anything faster than a slow walking pace.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's tail is especially sensitive, able to use water and air currents to build up a picture of its surroundings. It constantly secretes a goo to keep its skin moist. When it gets uncomfortable, it shakes its head, spraying droplets everywhere.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME rustle their leaves when they feel threatened, attempting to intimidate anything that gets close to them. If their warning fails they snap at the subject of their ire, darting forward to give a nasty bite.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME cannot see, so it explores its surroundings with its teeth. It has a powerful bite that can even break stone, so it leaves a trail of destruction in its wake.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME scours the jungle floor for overripe Berries, grinding them into a sticky paste. Though blind, it lures in unsuspecting prey by using the strong, fermented aroma the Berries create.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is blind, relying on its antennae to help it sense changes in its surroundings. Between the antenna's sensitivity and its sense of smell, it can easily sniff out the most sap-rich trees to gorge on.
author: sk372

entry: With no eyes or limbs with which to learn about its surroundings, POKENAME must bite things instead.
author: im_quinn

entry: POKENAME rely on thermal radiation to sense other Pokémon around them, as they are completely blind. When encountering a Pokémon that does not release heat, they become aggressive and blindly headbutt everything around them until they calm down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it finds a crystal that catches its eye, it dances in delight. These joyful displays often leave others puzzled by its enthusiasm.
author: .izik

entry: Its stronger head uses the other as a cushion or a perch, which is why the two are constantly in competition. POKENAME blows bubbles of water from its mouths to slow its opponents' movements.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are unable to see, so they sense for vibrations in the ground to guide themselves. If they cannot sense any vibrations, they curl up into balls to try and stay safe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME loves to dance, but due to vision impairment it's rather clumsy and trips over or bumps into things mid-dance. Nobody has ever seen POKENAME commit a full dance routine without incident.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME has poor eyesight, its strong psychic senses compensate for some of this disadvantage. Rambunctious and affectionate, it's known for giving its Trainer a sharp nip to the shoulder as a sign of affection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a keen sense of sight, able to quickly recognize when a part of their environment is off. This heightened sense of perception has seen them being used more by detectives.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Stories say that staring into the gap in POKENAME's back will cause permanent blindness. It floats around aimlessly and avoids interacting with others, but when in close proximity, it emits a faint hissing growl.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur is composed of needles that help to contain excess poison. POKENAME smooth out their fur by nuzzling along tree trunks. Unfortunately, they aren't aware of the damage that this practice inflicts on the trees.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: With exceptional control over levitation, it dodges stalactites with ease. Its precision and agility make it a formidable opponent underground.
author: .izik

entry: It fires concentrated balls of energy from its mouth, using them to intimidate and overwhelm foes. This powerful attack leaves deep craters wherever it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves of POKENAME are coated in an oil that causes an unpleasant contact rash and direct skin contact is inadvisable. They are aware of this property of their body and, when angry, will charge at people so that they can be left alone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME relies on its large ears to detect movement in its surroundings. When it catches prey, it holds on tightly with its venom-coated claws to ensure a swift takedown.
author: .izik

entry: Before the world was illuminated with electricity, they were sent with missives and other stationery in darkness. A Covert Cloak let them avoid being slowed down by frost and other effects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's blindness coupled with its aggression makes it a danger to go anywhere near. If it becomes angered, it rains down beams of powerful light indiscriminately around it in the hopes of taking down whatever wrought its ire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was birthed from the seeds of its parent's lotus. It trains everyday by bullying smaller Pokémon and claiming territory.
author: arch.stanton

entry: Once fully bloomed, its lotus will produce seeds that give birth to Detwig. It is said to violently guard small bodies of water.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME floats about in ponds or wetlands, appearing as a mere lotus. Semi-aquatic Pokémon enjoy using its shell as a resting spot.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME are sensitive to light, so they keep their eyes closed at all times. They're aware of every quill on their body, so they can still spray out poisonous needles with precise aim.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Lacking vision, POKENAME blindly attacks anything that moves for its life force. It can sense the species of victims it's tasted.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's fur grows over their eyes, so they rely on their large ears to help them navigate and detect danger. The fur is composed of poisonous needles that can be launched at a moment's notice before regrowing near instantly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can be quite rowdy, picking fights with one another whenever they feel like it. These can turn into all-out brawls with entire hordes of POKENAME joining in on the scuffle.
author: mistymagius

entry: The tuft above its eyes makes it hard for POKENAME to see where it's going, so it often bumps into other Pokémon while flying. Thanks to its Dragon Claw, it can easily defeat any creature that dares to challenge it, despite its careless attitude.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME were recently discovered after a group bit through an autonomous submarine exploring the depths of the ocean, likely thinking it was food. They navigate their territories by taste, leading many to exhibit scarring from biting one another.
author: chibitales

entry: It cannot see due to the hair over its weak eyes, but POKENAME possesses a great sense of smell. It can even ascertain the emotions of others through its scent. It finds the scent of joy and kindness most appealing.
author: sk372

entry: Caverns that POKENAME reside in often glow a dark magenta color thanks to their tails. This doesn't help POKENAME, since they cannot see anything.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite its blindness, POKENAME shakes its tail vigorously to release thick clouds of spores. These spores obscure its presence, allowing it to ambush its prey with ease.
author: .izik

entry: These Pokémon enjoy teasing others, even though they also have traits that can be made fun of. POKENAME have a love for incorporating chalk into their diet for reasons unknown.
author: jangodiot

entry: The dense fur along its neck and tails is hardened and rough. POKENAME uses its tails in nature to tear through thick brush.
author: melodydelune

entry: It's believed that POKENAME is able to open many types of locks, but to understand how to unlock one, they first need to headbutt it. This almost always breaks the lock, invalidating the need for a key.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME lacks a normal pair of eyes, causing it to float around aimlessly for much of its life. An eye on its stomach is said to open once every 5 years, and supposedly POKENAME will grant a wish to the first person it sees with said eye.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being blind in both eyes, POKENAME is nonetheless playful and mischievous. It lives in busy areas: due to its ability to be able to sense the emotions of others, it is mostly able to tell what locations are dangerous and which are safe.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's armor grows to cover their eyes and face if left alone. To maintain this, these Pokémon are constantly battling each other, ramming into one another to break off pieces of each other's shells.
author: santon5512

entry: Since it cannot see, it bites anything it doesn't recognize the sound of. This habit makes it a challenge to approach without alerting it.
author: .izik

entry: It roars in sync with thunder, as if trying to compete with the storm's fury. This behavior makes it feel connected to the wild power of the elements.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are blind, making it difficult for them to control their flames. They have been known to accidentally burn down entire homes when left unattended.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME can only be found in dark rainforests. It will try to headbutt anything that touches it, spreading its light-sensitive spores.
author: mistymagius

entry: It enjoys basking in moonlight, soaking in the gentle glow to calm its restless energy. These nightly rituals seem to enhance its mood and vitality.
author: .izik

entry: It carefully studies the movements of its opponents, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. This calculated strategy makes it a master of surprise attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known to fly directly into people's heads. It is an open question whether this habit stems from malice, blindness, or both.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME are completely blind and rely on echolocation to navigate caves. Whenever they encounter an unfamiliar Pokémon, they headbutt the new presence to investigate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME compensates for its lack of sight by releasing a paralyzing toxin from its antennae. Once its prey is immobilized, it easily tracks them down using scent and sound before delivering a finishing Bite.
author: .izik

entry: Even though they're blind, POKENAME are able to find their way around using their fantastic sense of smell. When they're close enough to something that smells like food they will start biting down with enough force to pierce steel.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME clutches its furry cloak close to its body to shield it from the cold. Doing so obscures its already weak eyes, so it stumbles around and bumps into things often as a result.
author: sk372

entry: Though unable to see, POKENAME emits a sweet Leppa Berry scent from the pods on its body: this attracts prey close enough for it to bite down with its powerful jaws.
author: .izik

entry: Completely blind, POKENAME relies upon echolocation to find its way around the world. Despite its lack of eyesight, POKENAME is good at evading attacks from other Pokémon thanks to its sensitive hearing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emits a deep, resonant cry to navigate its surroundings. The vibrations allow it to perceive obstacles despite having no eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: While flying, it leaves behind a faint scent of charcoal in the air. This smoky trail marks its path, lingering long after it has gone.
author: .izik

entry: The slime it leaves behind carries a scent similar to oil. This peculiar smell both repels and intrigues other Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lacks eyes, bones, sense of taste and has an abnormal pain tolerance, so it can fall from incredible heights without suffering any long-term damage. Its intelligence has almost no margin to develop during this stage.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its stomach can digest almost anything, and when it doesn't, POKENAME simply spits it out. The trace of hair it leaves behind feels to the touch like metal swarf, though it's not magnetic.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is blind and navigates by feeling its surroundings with its claws. It shows affection by softly rubbing its mane against people.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME zips through the skies at night, attracted to the scent of pleasant dreams. Its poor vision causes it to often careen directly into the sleeping person providing the aroma it chases after.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are highly territorial, screeching at intruders that get too close. Their screeches are amplified by the resonance of their scales, which allows them to use echolocation all around their bodies to compensate for their poor eyesight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The fur that grows on POKENAME's body never stops growing. As a result, it is recommended that Trainers groom their own POKENAME daily.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are playful and mischievous, often getting into fights with each other where they slap each other with their tails. Unfortunately, their durable fireproof scales make it easy for them to forget how destructive their squabbles can be.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It prefers living in areas coated with ash or soot, blending effortlessly into its surroundings. This environment provides both camouflage and comfort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME compensates for its poor eyesight with a strong sense of smell. It travels in small packs, communicating via howls to locate other pack-mates, even if they are in close proximity.
author: sk372

entry: Even while buried underground, it can sniff out food with remarkable accuracy. This keen sense of smell makes it a successful hunter despite its poor eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: Though its eyes are covered, POKENAME has tuned its psychic powers to sense its surroundings without the need for vision.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense of smell, which helps it sniff out the pungent Cornn Berry. Its pigmentation deepens when eating a healthy amount of these berries, which also helps it prepare for further evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It grows its hair out to blind itself purposely, due to an extreme light sensitivity. Even the faintest bit of illumination hitting its eyes will give it a headache.
author: sk372

entry: The fur on its head often covers up its eyes. If you have a POKENAME, expect to hear loud bumps as it tries to navigate its surroundings.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Many have found POKENAME endearing due to its tendency to run headlong into things because of its poor eyesight. It is, however, quite temperamental, so raising one can be quite an arduous task.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses a combination of psychic waves and vibrations from its spoon to sense its surroundings through a sort of echolocation. It does this because its own vision is incredibly poor.
author: sk372

entry: Its large, slitted eyes give it a great view of its surroundings. However, POKENAME cannot see directly in front of it, so it has to use its tentacles to grab food before it can be eaten.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The head of POKENAME looks like a skull. Sailors have long told tales about krakens, fueled partially by its appearance.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Due to being able to sense things electromagnetically, many POKENAME are relaxed in nature. Some POKENAME eat anything their magnets pull in.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME's weak bite can't hurt humans. POKENAME leave their mouths open to let small electrical charges out or because they're happy to see someone.
author: totodile.

entry: While one of POKENAME's heads is completely blind, the other has nearly perfect vision and can see for miles away. This has led to a situation where one head constantly grooms their body while the other keeps them moving through the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have three heads that are always in disagreement about how to share food. Two of their heads are always fighting for more food, while the blind head always wants to share the food equally.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's lack of vision means that it often walks or swims into walls and other obstacles. Once it catches a prey's scent, however, it is frighteningly swift and accurate in its pursuit.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.
author: cristata

entry: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.
author: cristata

entry: The fluffy amulet POKENAME has is used to keep it calm all the time, but, if taken away, it will get angry and do anything to get it back.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME behaves oddly, switching between meekness and aggression at random. Some believe the skull it wears has its own personality, influencing POKENAME's actions and making it act against its nature.
author: sk372

entry: Having a more refined control over its blue toxic emissions, POKENAME utilizes its gas to achieve hypersensitive spatial awareness. Regardless of its immediate hunting success, it has a distinct preference for Dragon-type Pokémon.
author: beatdoof

entry: Despite their ferocious nature, POKENAME's heads are very supportive parents and treat their offspring with the utmost care. Their offspring are temperamental and will maul anything they can reach.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are tolerant Pokémon who help transport more aggressive passengers across large bodies of water. The two heads are known to fight over the proper direction to swim to.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When POKENAME appears on a computer screen, it's typically to eat and destroy as much data as it can. Its two heads often get into conflict with each other, however, lessening its efforts and making it easier to deal with.
author: sk372

entry: The crystal at the end of its tail lights up when it concentrates. Using an unknown power, it can change the weather at will.
author: .izik

entry: The two heads have contrasting personalities in response to danger. As such, it is very difficult to tell whether its flames rearing up is a sign of it becoming defensive and wanting to flee, or preparing to get aggressive and go on the attack.
author: sk372

entry: If anything sneaks up on POKENAME, its back-facing head will bite it. It uses its hands to lift the front-facing head's bangs if it wants to see.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME have trouble balancing in the air due to the length of their necks and the placement of their heads. In addition to attacking with the heads, they can use their sharp claws and tail to deliver a mild toxin.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can burrow deep into the ground, kept safe by their fur being tougher than iron. The two heads can eat most minerals found underground, though each head has distinct mineral preferences.
author: entomoxie

entry: While the two heads of POKENAME have been known to argue, they both become placid and agreeable once given a helping of fresh honey - provided that each have separate and equal amounts, that is.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are experts in flight, as one head observes surroundings while the other hunts prey below. However, their flight can get rough whenever the heads disagree mid-flight.
author: entomoxie

entry: The head on the end of its nose will take time to make sure the lower head eats. The mouths do not share a stomach and each have their own.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's personality is split between two heads with opposing motives. One wishes to help users, the other wants to destroy data. As such, they fight against each other constantly, causing havoc.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's two heads often try to slither in different directions. Very rarely does it actually get anywhere.
author: im_quinn

entry: Since it has double the heads, POKENAME produces two times more milk. The heads often compete who can produce more milk in a day.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It prefers to eat gemstones from deep within caves. It dislikes sunlight, as it causes the fur on its body to shed rapidly.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its blindness, POKENAME's hearing is exceptionally sharp. It traverses cave systems by jumping off walls, allowing it to move swiftly through the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are not great fighters, as they usually miss their target because they can't see. It relies on its spikes to hurt enemies.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It can hover up to 300 feet off of the ground. Doing this consumes a lot of energy, which it replenishes by eating grass and other vegetation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick skin is rough to the touch. It is sharp enough to shred through stone if rubbed the wrong way.
author: .izik

entry: The two heads on POKENAME's back control the whole body. If POKENAME is injured the heads will retreat into the bushes.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Its lotus has fully bloomed, and it has grown an extra head on its tail. It guards ponds, so alchemists considered it a symbol of water.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME has two massive noses but has been observed to only have one brain. It is unable to use any of the other senses as it has been built simply to smell.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME channels dark energy through its arms, producing powerful blasts that shred through just about anything. It is an incredibly cruel Pokémon, mercilessly attacking innocent Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its two heads constantly disagree on which direction to take, often causing it to crash into trees or buildings while flying. POKENAME possesses immense strength, and only determined Trainers can tame it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Their two heads struggle to cooperate and will even lash at one another with their respective feelers. Only during battle or when trying to eat will their heads work together, for the sole goal of dispatching their mutual foes.
author: infinex21

entry: It's easy to tell when POKENAME are nearby as their two heads are always growling or snapping at each other. It's common to see one head with burn marks on its cheek.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME struggles to control the immense spiritual energy it absorbs, even with two heads. Each communicates with different ghosts from an ancient civilization, but only one powerful spirit is perceptible to both heads, uniting their focus briefly.
author: entomoxie

entry: The addition of two more heads has further exacerbated the attitude problems it possessed. Rarely is POKENAME seen without one of its heads aggressively duking it out with another.
author: sk372

entry: The wishes granted by POKENAME come with disastrous consequences. Whenever one head grants a wish, the other twists it as the price of changing fate.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The consistency of the metal on its body changes based on what it's consumed. Softer foods result in a softer metal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have both heads out constantly because the shell is just barely big enough to fit a single head inside. Whenever one head tries to withdraw into the shell, the other head lashes out in anger and jealousy.
author: entomoxie

entry: In combat, POKENAME's two heads often get their tusks interlocked, causing them severe discomfort. POKENAME will usually have to break their own tusks to make sure they don't get stuck.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME enjoy dark caves, where they can rely on echolocation and not their limited eyesight. However, the heads often conflict and thus get confused by their own echolocation.
author: entomoxie

entry: The slime that drips off of its body is incredibly sticky. It is used to make an industrial-strength glue that takes years to lose potency.
author: .izik

entry: Though the heads seem indistinguishable, the intelligent dominant one controls the body, while the dumber one is only concerned with eating. They always fight with each other, except when they know they're being watched.
author: epping_forest

entry: When the two heads of POKENAME don't get along, they solve their frustrations by attacking others in a rampage rather than solving the issue among themselves. They constantly fight over food since the more they eat, the stronger their lasers become.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can use both heads in battle to attack and disorient opponents, though the heads are sometimes uncoordinated and fight each other. While they cannot fly at great heights, they can glide before slamming opponents from above.
author: entomoxie

entry: Thought extinct, a population of POKENAME was found behind a wall of ice where the cold had forced a temporary truce. Now thawed, the two heads have resumed their ancient rivalry, violently snapping at one another over every scrap of food.
author: eiskitsune

entry: During its nighttime flights, POKENAME's heads will sometimes argue over which direction to go, causing a shift in trajectory. These sudden turns cause the sparkling trails it leaves behind to form a shape similar to a crescent moon.
author: sk372

entry: Though nearly blind, POKENAME uses its superior hearing to sense the world around it. The scale on its tail is sharp as a blade and can cleave marble with ease, making it a formidable opponent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's twin heads can only cooperate properly in combat. If not sated with constant sparring partners to keep it distracted, they will fight with each other viciously, often leaving scars along their necks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is almost entirely blind, but it can sense the world around it based on the tiny hairs around its neck vibrating from sounds. Should it get cornered, it will unleash a Dragon Breath from its second head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to light. While one head has mild protection with hair covering their eyes, the other head has no such protection and often gets overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are extremely sensitive to light. While one head has a natural layer of fur protecting their eyes, the other head has to flip their head upside down to shade their eyes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are usually found in pairs, hanging from a tree. Its toxins can be lethal.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its two heads divide tasks: one declares the target's position while the other fires high-pressure water jets. If POKENAME misses, the two heads start arguing even in the middle of a fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have two heads that are blind to the world around them. They rely on their powerful noses to locate food and often struggle to keep up with other members of their flock.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have three heads that never seem to agree on where to go. The head that is able to see always wants to move quickly, while the other two heads are blind and always bicker about which scent trail they should follow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME races through cave systems at tremendous speed. Its echoing sobs announce its approach long before it is seen.
author: .izik

entry: The blue gas expelled by these Pokémon is a special toxin that is known to agitate Dragon-type Pokémon with great ease. Although this makes them be considered dangerous to some, others still research other possible uses for these gases.
author: infinex21

entry: The patterns on its wings can startle away lurking foes from afar. It will ruthlessly compete for territory and resources.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME bobs its extra heads rhythmically, causing people to bob their heads in unison with them. While the main head has a nice and lovely voice, the extra heads have dark, sinister voices that often speak the Pokémon's true intentions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME invades cyberspace, with its only goal seeming to be destroying as much data as it can. Specialized teams of Porygon fusions are dispatched to deal with its impressive destructive power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rains destruction by summoning dark storms and large tornadoes wherever it goes. Dark, thundering clouds in the shape of POKENAME's head foretell its arrival and give time for evacuation before it creates mass oblivion.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME clashes often with Dragonite in the wild. The latter protects humans from the former's endless capacity for destruction and aggression, leading to vicious battles across the lands.
author: sk372

entry: A malicious and unpredictable Pokémon. Its fur coat seemingly has a mind of its own, igniting at the slightest disturbance or excitement.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME's destructive tendencies compel it to destroy the webs created by other Pokémon like Spinarak. Its own webbing, spun by the heads on its front limbs, is highly caustic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of forests, making various traps to trick and catch prey in its webs. It often uses its tail to make others think that it is smaller than it actually is.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME are consumed by a relentless rage to turn everything to mud. They use Muddy Water to cover lush landscapes in gallons of water, raising the water table until it resembles a marshland.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are consumed by a relentless rage to turn everything to mud. They use Muddy Water to cover lush landscapes in gallons of water, raising the water table until it resembles a marshland.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A cruel and manipulative Pokémon, it is well known for bewitching others into serving it and summoning shadowy dragons as familiars. It channels psychic power through its crown's crystal and into its corrupt staff to attack.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME are traditionally seen as harbingers of destruction, populations arriving in an area just before a volcanic eruption. Researchers have found they are simply sensitive to tectonic activity, preferring to feed on fresh lava when possible.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gather bones of all kinds, puppetting them with their tentacles to seem intimidating and to use as camouflage. Despite the weight of these bones, POKENAME are adept swimmers.
author: chibitales

entry: Programmers dread the thought of seeing a POKENAME appear in their computer. It sics its two drones to corrupt and delete random data, while the main body watches the chaos with sinister glee.
author: sk372

entry: Each head of a POKENAME exhibit different personalities. While the other two heads each display a different emotion, the middle head is always irritably hungry.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It gathers storm clouds, channeling the energy of three dark dragons. In awe of its grace, many Trainers write poems in tribute to it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are highly aggressive creatures. The patterns on their heads are used to petrify their foes with fear before releasing an onslaught of attacks. Sometimes, a POKENAME's shed skin is used as decoration during horror-inspired festivals.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The orbs are believed to be the spirits of Trainers who owned POKENAME. It takes great pleasure in watching weaker Pokémon suffer.
author: geminib

entry: POKENAME attacks opponents for massive damage regardless of their typing by using its three heads simultaneously to strike all weak points. Its wings unleash shock waves that bring oblivion to everything nearby before it consumes all that remains.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is filled with a simultaneous mixture of protective and destructive urges. This conflict of emotions causes it to use any excuse to excessively attack anything that poses even a remote threat to its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME vents destructive urges by using its psychic powers to tear apart the terrain all around it. Only its Trainer seems to be free from danger, as it manages to reign in those urges while in their presence.
author: sk372

entry: Some stories claim that these three-headed Pokémon wield a dark, otherworldly power that allows them to cut into the very souls of others. They fight with extreme precision using their arm blades, always keeping track of any foes they face.
author: infinex21

entry: The bone-like cilia on POKENAME's chest constantly oscillate with an eerie chittering sound. To protect its heart hidden inside, it violently thrashes anything that gets close to it, attacking with whips of light from the Nincada heads on its wings.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME use their dark auras to attack and punish the people who they believe have justice in their hearts. Because of this, many movies and TV shows use these Pokémon as their villains.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are incredibly aggressive, launching their heads as missiles to poison their opponents in battle. There are rumors that POKENAME are stranded from an alternate future.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: It's believed POKENAME's two extra heads goad it into giving in to its destructive, violent impulses. It lashes vines outward and tears down entire forests, for nothing other than as a show of power.
author: sk372

entry: With their thick fur, POKENAME were one of the few surviving megafauna Pokémon after the ice age. However, their populations dwindled due to mass losses of prey.
author: bigoljax

entry: When enraged, POKENAME has been reported to manifest up to 1,000 additional heads. These apparitions strike in perfect unison before vanishing without trace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grows new heads constantly. It can only feed two at a time, however, so it discards spare heads. It's thought the spares are used like seeds.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are infamously dangerous for Trainers to work with. Those without sufficiently strong wills have been known to become overwhelmed and fall under possession by their own POKENAME. No solution has been discovered due to this danger.
author: archangelsookami

entry: This Pokémon is considered more myth than real. When POKENAME fights, it releases bursts of flame and strikes with its smaller organisms before the middle head delivers a decisive crunch.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: It uses its three heads to devour all food it can find and to thoroughly dispatch any foes. It hates to share, even the attention of its own Trainer, and lashes out at others with its many feelers to keep it all to itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME attacks everything it sees with its tail, destroying both foes and objects alike in one heavy blow. It will even attack its own Nidoqueen in these rampages if they try to calm it down.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are considered major threats on account of wild rampages and durable plating. Some in Hoenn refer to them as hard-to-defeat reptiles because of this.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The three heads of these Pokémon are often seen arguing with each other because, strangely, they each seem to be more active during different times of the day. All three heads are fully alert during battle, which is when they display a fierce power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's programming compels it to destroy its surroundings until nothing is left. The dragon-head cannon on its arm fires energy beams capable of piercing straight through even the strongest materials.
author: sk372

entry: An extending Hydreigon head is attached to POKENAME's back. It scans its surroundings for targets to destroy, before all three dragon heads fire powerful energy beams simultaneously.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lashes out without reason at anything it doesn't like. Whenever it rampages, it wreaks extreme levels of destruction with the intense flames from its heads.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The heads on POKENAME's arms, like the central head's horn, have the power to crush diamonds in one blow. It devours everything in its path without worry of counterattack due to its strong hide absorbing most of the damage.
author: soup1900

entry: The heads on POKENAME's arms don't have brains, for their only function is eating and biting. Sometimes, POKENAME "talks" with them like a ventriloquist, making them represent its inner thoughts spoken out loud.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME sends out its explorer balloons to scout for victims to feed on. It is said that spotting one in the sky is a sign of great misfortune due to its ferocious and destructive nature.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The heads on the tips of POKENAME's ears have strong, powerful jaws that are strong enough to break rock. Due to POKENAME's ego, it normally carves stones into small thrones for itself.
author: jestersqueak

entry: Their many appendages snap at passing people and Pokémon alike as if they were each small heads. It can summon and release flame from the tips of its appendages, or simply from its gaping maw, to incinerate foes.
author: infinex21

entry: After fusion, POKENAME's additional heads took on the attributes of other draconic Pokémon. This may suggest the five creatures all might have evolved from a common ancient ancestor.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME's destructive and aggressive tendencies to reach near-catastrophic levels. Extremely hard to control or defeat in battle, many regions have outlawed the act of fusing it.
author: sk372

entry: Pokémon fusion has caused POKENAME to grow more heads. Legends say if one head is cut off, 2 more grow in its place. It is an incredibly powerful Pokémon, launching multiple beams of Dragon Pulse from its five heads.
author: lupa

entry: POKENAME's wish power is tainted in darkness, causing mayhem to anyone it grants a wish to. Anything it sees will be annihilated by concentrated bundles of darkness.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's heads, if chopped off, can act and live independently while the main body regrows them. Each head can spit venom and breathe fire.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's three heads bellow a tri-tonal roar that unleashes a wall of heat and sounds powerful enough to destroy nearby buildings.
author: malxire

entry: All three were once the same individual, though the smaller individuals are unable to think and merely follow the orders of the larger ones. POKENAME are voracious Pokémon that consume all in their paths and destroy all that dare try to bar them.
author: infinex21

entry: With two ravenous extra mouths to feed, wild POKENAME struggles finding enough food. It doesn't have a good relationship with the extra heads, which it often has to swat away. It cherishes a Trainer who keeps it well fed and in pleasant company.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is known to dine on entire coral reefs in a single day thanks to its 13 heads all hungrily eating everything in sight. It's a terrifying Pokémon to face in battle since it levitates above foes to rain down dozens of painful spikes onto them.
author: soup1900

entry: A savage contender for territory and food, POKENAME are relentless in their hunt for either, and will often go out of their way to attack anything they see in their pursuits.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME fights dirty, using underhanded tactics to get the best of its foes and being overly cruel to them afterwards. When enraged, it uses Dragon Claw on everything around it and has been known to level sizable chunks of forest.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME use their staff to incinerate anything that crosses their path that they don't like. It's theorized that they foresee the future to plot how to cause the most damage.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The heads wrapped around POKENAME's neck are the first ones to attack enemies since they can sense danger before the central head can. It repeatedly blasts enemies with shurikens made of dark aura until they are destroyed to bits.
author: soup1900

entry: Although it appears to be three Pokémon, the other two POKENAME are just its arms. These arms are blind, so it needs to have its true head above ground to effectively aim them.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME swims at the bottom of the sea to eat falling scraps from other Pokémon. Its three heads have different personalities, which causes conflict when one head disagrees with another.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are incredibly moody creatures, as each one of their heads have a different temperament, often having a dominant yet destructive middle head. To atone for anything they destroy, POKENAME soar through the skies and scatter seeds for farmers.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Its two extra faces are trapped in the spoons. If POKENAME loses touch of the spoons, the faces will regrow from the hands, trying to kill the main head.
author: epping_forest

entry: Late at night, POKENAME performs eerie, synchronized rituals with its marottes, gaining glimpses of possible futures. Witnesses of the ceremony often experience visions of events yet to unfold.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME float across the ground, their tendrils reaching down to destroy and consume anything below them. For this reason, they were once believed to be storm clouds given spirits of malice.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: Its six back appendages can move as it wills them to, often being used to hold down foes before it blasts them with dark fire let loose by its three heads. It will only run in the direction that its central head is looking toward.
author: infinex21

entry: The mysterious orb on POKENAME's back swirls and shifts with purple mist. When close to evolution, the orb fills fully with this mist, leading POKENAME to find a spot as far away from danger as it can. It fills the chosen area with a poisonous fog.
author: chibitales

entry: Rumors say this Pokémon can be seen crawling in forested areas. They move faster than the average Bug-Type, but that's still not very fast.
author: themicelegion

entry: It holds onto the remains of its sibling to feel safe. The psychic powers that remain on the skull protect it.
author: el_gord0

entry: POKENAME use their extrasensory abilities to observe a wide area around themselves underwater, allowing them to easily find or avoid other Pokémon. They sometimes will also save other Pokémon by spraying their attackers with ink.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found in remote places dancing by themselves. They release a mist that obscures vision and are known to teleport away if they realize they have been seen by a Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a mythical Pokémon that releases a strange mist wherever it swims. It is believed by many that looking into the mist causes optical illusions depicting past memories, but this has never been proven.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME can never be seen with its hair soft and smoothed out since it turns invisible the moment that happens. Sudden static electricity and electrical tingles with no known source or explanation are signs that it is nearby.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME were primarily used to infiltrate enemy computers via cyberspace due to their near-undetectability. They are now considered obsolete.
author: skinstealers

entry: POKENAME are constantly on the move, looking for food in various places. They are very friendly when in a group, but skittish if alone. Earning their trust, while difficult, is said to bring good luck.
author: chibitales

entry: Due to their small bodies, POKENAME cannot fully fly. They instead float around using the propeller on their heads.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is able to soar incredibly fast through the sky. However, it is so friendly towards humans, it is not uncommon for it to walk beside them.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: Because of their short stature, POKENAME treat objects that are taller than them as mountains to climb. If they succeed, they cheer, seemingly hopeful that their Trainer is proud of them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME have only ever been seen in remote parts of the Johto region. It is said that a shrine maiden's garb is based on its wings and tassels.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME dreams of soaring through the clear, blue sky. Its inconveniently placed wings make this dream difficult to achieve.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME race through the sky in large groups, leaving long trails of cotton spores in their wake. They love to perform aerial stunts with their friends.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME understands human language on a much deeper level than many other Pokémon. They each have a favourite type of berry, and whenever they hear it they get excited and call out hopefully.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME understands human language on a much deeper level than many other Pokémon. They each have a favourite type of poffin, and whenever they hear it they get excited and call out hopefully.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses the fine down on its body to detect incoming attacks. It can also use the down to refract light and change its appearance.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME only descends to sharpen its teeth on buildings. Legend says that one attempted to fly up to and eat the moon.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME streaks across the sky at incredible speeds, scattering a smoke-scented goo wherever it travels. Some people consider this sludge lucky and store it in bottles at home as a rare, if pungent, decoration.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travels with small groups of its own kind to bring gifts to children it senses are sad. It can make itself invisible thanks to its feathers, which refract light, allowing it to carry out its actions without ever being seen.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME leaps from the water to the air, it glides at speeds twice what it manages underwater. It scans the oceans for people in need, grabbing them and carrying them off to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is used as a program to provide emotional support to airline pilots who might panic in the case of turbulence. Its ability to become invisible helps it bypass any firewall, which is why many hackers try to obtain this Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have frighteningly strong bodies, which they can use to constrict any that threaten them. Despite this, they prefer to gently embrace those with positive emotions.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME creates a fine dew wherever it runs; it seems this dew can temporarily increase the power of some Pokémon when touched. However, the dew quickly evaporates even under cooler temperatures, leaving it impossible to practically harness.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Though POKENAME can fly at a surprisingly high speed, it can only do so in short bursts. It uses this speedy flight to travel quickly from place to place, looking for friendly people who will share their food with it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME encase themselves within layers of drifting clouds that disguise their true appearance. They can expand the clouds out into a billowing mist so that they can disappear without a trace.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It can sense sadness anywhere in the region. It breaks the sound barrier in order to reach anyone in need of a friend, just to make them smile.
author: melodymute

entry: Dragon energy courses through POKENAME's body, allowing it to deliver kicks with devastating ferocity. It harnesses this power further through training on tall mountains.
author: chibitales

entry: An ancient tribe of Dragon-type Trainers used POKENAME as mounts and flew around all of Hoenn. They will use Safeguard to protect their riders if they sense danger during their flights.
author: cobalt0135

entry: This Pokémon's presence brings a sense of peace and harmony. It is able to deeply connect with its Trainer, making it a popular Pokémon to bond with.
author: jackjirachi

entry: This intelligent Pokémon requires patience and a dedicated space for silent meditation, due to its hypersensitivity towards the emotions of others.
author: final_courtesy

entry: It refracts light to appear more or less frightening depending on who it's talking to. A larger and more intimidating POKENAME is one that is trying to defend itself. This tough facade can easily break, causing POKENAME to turn invisible and flee.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: POKENAME is quite protective of those it considers friends or young to be safeguarded. It's not uncommon for it to scoop up those it protects into its arms before flying off vast distances at high speed.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its wings being too small for flight, POKENAME joyfully soars across the sky using its psychic powers. It makes its nests near hidden lakes and lagoons.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's eyes let it see far distances in perfect clarity, even while traveling at high speeds through the air. Its tail generates a trail of electrical sparks while it flies.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies across the land in search of true love. It forms close bonds with its partners, no matter how many it has.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME propel themselves through the sky with blue flames released through their large tails. Their wings are sturdy and allow them to easily cut through the wind, creating a potent slipstream in their wake.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's two heads have differing personalities, the red being much more amicable and sociable than the blue. It is often seen nudging the other head, encouraging it to make new friends, with limited success.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely long-lived, POKENAME is highly intelligent and empathetic, caring for a habitat and its inhabitants for eons. It excels at defensive tactics due to its psychic abilities, making it a strong protector in combat encounters.
author: pjporwoll

entry: In Hoenn legend, POKENAME worked with legendary Trainers to maintain peace among the islands. Streaks in the sky are most likely them, searching for new Trainers to ally with.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Fusion has granted Latios and Latias matching new forms. Working in tandem, they fly all across regions defending the weak and acting as dual heroes of justice.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME zips through the skies, flying across the regions looking for new experiences and new friends. Its multiple tails cast a myriad of red sparkles behind it when it flies at top speed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grows extremely timid when the electricity in its body builds up too much. If spotted by a human, it flies away at high speed, leaving a trail of sparks behind.
author: .izik

entry: Linking their limbs together allows POKENAME to fly faster the larger the group. At high enough speeds, the cotton-like fluff sheds lightly and leaves a sparkling white trail behind them.
author: sk372

entry: A protective shell covers POKENAME's body, protecting it from the elements as it flies across the regions at high speeds. In some places, extreme sportsmen wear suits designed after POKENAME's appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very old species of Pokémon, and no single individual is thought to be less than 100 years old. Facing extinction 50 years ago, it is now forbidden to catch wild POKENAME.
author: thescribe

entry: Riding with POKENAME is said to feel like floating on a cloud. It often nudges Trainers with its fluffy body, inviting them to join it on an adventure through the skies.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME's ice refracts light in such a way that sculptures made from it appear exactly as their real counterparts. POKENAME uses this to its advantage by creating fake ice versions of itself to fool hunters while it hides away safely in an ice wall.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur isn't just for show. It uses it to refract light and hide in plain sight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME spend most of their days lazing around in the sun, enjoying taking long naps in the warmth of the sunlight. They will sometimes become filled with a manic energy, racing around at speeds in excess of Mach 2.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are playful Pokémon that enjoy playing chase with people and other Pokémon. They are extraordinarily fast, capable of catching most of their play partners within seconds.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's empathetic nature and heightened intelligence allows it to convey certain needs through telepathy. Trainers who struggle with anxiety will often seek to have one as a companion.
author: mepp.

entry: The creature biting POKENAME's tail is highly aggressive, and bites down in order to influence the host into behaving similarly. Fortunately, POKENAME is too simple and gentle to even register the impulses the bites create.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spits a poisonous mist at anything it deems a threat, causing the mist within the orb on its back to churn and swirl with energy. This, alongside its seclusive nature, makes it difficult to study properly.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME flies quickly through tree canopies in search of the freshest leaves to consume. It is a spirited fighter, unafraid to battle much larger Pokémon that might compete with it for food.
author: sk372

entry: It wields the remains of its sibling as a weapon. It wanders around aimlessly, filled with rage and seeking revenge.
author: el_gord0

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through its thick shell. If someone angry approaches, it reinforces its armor even further with Harden. To conserve energy, it tries to remain as still as possible throughout the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through its thick shell. If someone angry approaches, it takes flight and distances itself immediately. To conserve energy, it attempts to stay as motionless as possible during the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME travels at extreme speeds to spread pollen. There are rumours of a red Pokémon that looks similar to POKENAME, but no confirmed sightings.
author: toxicrown

entry: The gem in its face is its true form. If POKENAME's outer body ever gets destroyed, the gem can regenerate its body if placed in clean ocean water.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is rather aloof, rarely taking on passengers except in the case of emergencies. It can swim at incredibly fast paces, quickly getting a person to their destination so that it can be rid of them faster.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME bristles its fur, hundreds of it seem to all appear simultaneously, doing various different actions. If someone touches an illusion, they will get zapped as the illusion disappears in a crackle of electricity.
author: soup1900

entry: By traveling through network cables, POKENAME releases a Life Dew that mysteriously increases internet speed. Scientists remain baffled by the mechanism behind this effect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body cuts cleanly through the water at high speeds, even breaching the surface to glide long distances across the air. It is antisocial by nature, fleeing into undersea dens when it spies humans approaching.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME flares up the flames on its back, ideas of multiple fiery explosions are put into the minds of foes to frighten them. Nothing that can be seen can be trusted as reality once it flashes up a heat haze.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME flies through the sky at incredible speeds, surpassing even commercial jets. When it slows down, it leaves behind streams of water that soak anyone below.
author: .izik

entry: Its flight capabilities are limited, and it can only gently glide along the ground. It wishes to soar to the moon someday.
author: fountainihili

entry: It stands in rapid streams to feel water rush around it. The longer it stays in water, the more streamlined and flush its body becomes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When people see POKENAME fly around, they make a wish. They do this because POKENAME is so lazy that it only flies if there is a predator near.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Not much information has been documented about POKENAME due to the fact it is rarely, if ever, seen. Most people don't believe in its existence.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Thanks to its ability to sense feelings, this Pokémon is used as a support program to help people with emotional problems. POKENAME is equipped with a new generation script that makes it much more autonomous in performing its functions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Long believed to be a myth, it hides its identity by implanting false memories to everyone who views it. It is empowered by the Soul Dew on its cloak.
author: germs2128

entry: POKENAME receives strange signals from unknown origins and shares the messages these signals contain by displaying images of them in the minds of people around it. It manipulates the fields of magnetism to fly at exceptionally high speeds.
author: soup1900

entry: It only appears to those who share its compassion for others. It is said to meet a POKENAME is to be forever blessed with tranquility.
author: melodymute

entry: POKENAME trains both its mind and body in preparation for battle. By sensing the confidence and emotions of its foe, it can anticipate their actions and gain the upper hand in combat.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME has a playful and easygoing temperament. There have been recent clothing trends that are inspired by its appearance.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME telepathically reads the emotions of others to distinguish friend from foe. When confronting an enemy, it uses its horns to roar and snap at them, scaring them away so it can avoid conflict.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: If threatened, POKENAME will telepathically force disturbing images into the aggressor's consciousness. While they are distracted, POKENAME vanishes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: With incredible eyesight and a sixth sense for the presence of others, escaping from POKENAME is almost impossible. It runs quickly across the ground, before using a burst of electricity from its hind feet to propel it forward with mighty leaps.
author: sk372

entry: Compassionate by nature, these Pokémon use their telepathic capabilities to sense for any individuals in trouble. If they sense any such individuals, POKENAME will quickly dart toward them and attempt to provide aid.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME release violet, lustrous flames from their tails to achieve extreme speeds within the air. They have often been witnessed descending to purge those filled with malice using their mighty flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is normally gentle, but if its allies or wards are threatened, it will use its immense offensive abilities to fight off the danger. Its lifespan is incredibly long, and the same entity has been found protecting a location for eons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are very gallant Pokémon that fly around the world beyond breakneck speeds. They use their swift movements to rescue any who are in danger and deliver devastating blows to villains with Luster Purge.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can attain high-speed flight, but only for short bursts in a straight line. Its skull has become hardened and resilient in response to all the head-on collisions it has suffered.
author: sk372

entry: Its smooth, flush body would allow POKENAME to fly very efficiently through the air, if it could fly. It practices every day by jumping off of ledges and boosting as far as it can.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME roam great distances at night, travelling for many miles beneath the moon and stars. They will plant themselves near rural communities in the morning, their leaves picking up on the presence of people, helping them find well-tended gardens.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spend the daytime hunkered down in one place, staying hidden within flower patches and meadows. At nighttime they travel vast distances in search of more fertile grounds, using their empathic powers to seek out prolific gardeners.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's voice carries across the wind as it sings during high-speed flights. More than a few have been entranced by hearing its voice, and spent years searching for it to hear it sing again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bloom at night, releasing their pollen when they can sense other POKENAME nearby with their empathic powers. They disperse at the first light of day, travelling many miles to find new meadows and new groves to make their home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME dislikes fighting, so it expels energy from its mushrooms to jet through the air and escape from its enemies.
author: .realthree

entry: On rare occasions, passengers can spot POKENAME singing as it soars alongside jet planes. Its uplifting melodies are said to bring courage to travelers heading off to the unknown.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME soars swiftly across the sky, leaving trails of vivid blue light. Sensationalists and conspiracy theorists believe these trails contain alien contaminants, but research shows the streaks are harmless.
author: mepp.
