entry: The turbine in POKENAME's tail is powered by a strange gem that many believe has extraterrestrial origins. It is said to be able to grant wishes, but only to those who carry the most righteous of ideals.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely rare to see in the wild, POKENAME is the subject of urban myth; supposedly if one sees a POKENAME float by during a night with a shooting star, their greatest wish will be granted.
author: sk372

entry: The fluff on POKENAME's body is extremely soft to the touch. Some believe that sleeping on a pillow made with this fluff can make any dream come true.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME appears to desperate people who wish for their dreams to come true. It forces them to play a game to get their wish, but no one has ever won.
author: p0opys0ck123abc

entry: It is said that POKENAME contains an ancient power never to be unleashed. Those who peer into its eye are left feeling lost for the rest of time.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME has been said to guide lost cave explorers in life-threatening situations. Supposedly, its blinding light reminds them of their desire to make it out alive.
author: thereversedguy

entry: POKENAME drift through festivals at night to collect the wishes from people using their lanterns. They then ignite the lanterns and release them across the sky like shooting stars, signaling to the people below that their wishes will soon come true.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: According to legend, if POKENAME is honorably defeated in battle, it willingly offers to grant one wish chosen by the victor. It covers the walls of the caves it inhabits with star-shaped carvings to keep its tusks sharp.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are desperate to seek validation from others, and grant wishes to gain approval. Villainous organizations hunt for POKENAME because of their willingness to grant any wish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It flies through the night sky like a shooting star, the glow of its wings visible for the lucky few that look at the right time. It is said that if you wish upon POKENAME, its wings will burn brightly, illuminating the entire night sky like the sun.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: Written wishes attached to POKENAME's wings are scattered as they flap. Only the wishes that remain on the wings after a long period of time are granted; the rest are ignored and burned.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME scatters its many enchanted scales as it flies around. When 1,000 of these scales are gathered, it will appear and grant one wish to the collector.
author: soup1900

entry: Though it does its best to grant the wishes of those around it, POKENAME's clumsy nature means it often ends up biting the wishers instead. However, it has such a cheerful demeanor that it is quickly forgiven for these bites.
author: coridiant

entry: The two heads of POKENAME often disagree on how to best grant a wish. Thus, it is rare for the wisher to actually get their wish granted.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME collects wishes for a decade before the three heads select one wish each to grant. The two brachial heads are more likely to pick lighthearted wishes, but the main head is more inclined towards selfish or vindictive wishes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for a shooting star due to how fast it moves through the night sky, and the trail of cosmic light it leaves behind.
author: kingd8

entry: Whenever POKENAME shakes its fur, it spreads a small smattering of stardust laced with faint electricity. The particles glow faintly in the dark, making them a popular accessory for clothing and the like.
author: sk372

entry: It has a joyful nature, but eats and sleeps very often. Disturbing it during its long slumbers will likely result in painful bites.
author: adrian151

entry: POKENAME are optimistic despite looking raggedy. They wish only to become beautiful someday.
author: .towerxvi

entry: According to legend, POKENAME wished so hard to fly that the stars gave it a pair of wings that let it soar.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME is highly sought by children, as many kids believe it will grant their wishes if they carry it with them long enough. POKENAME doesn't actually possess that power, but it enjoys the happiness it instills regardless.
author: sk372

entry: It's been proven that if you make a wish 3 meters near a POKENAME, 3 seconds after a lightning hits and sets on fire a truck carrying more than 3 tons of cotton, from 3 a.m to 3 p.m, that wish will come true. It loves stealing corn and wheat.
author: epping_forest

entry: It is said that POKENAME will appear and comfort those who are unable to attain their wishes when they are at their lowest point. The material that comprises much of its body is seemingly impossible to tear.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Though quite rare, they can be found stuck to the walls of mossy caves. While touching POKENAME's spikes might hurt, doing so is said to bring good fortune.
author: thereversedguy

entry: POKENAME flies around the world, collecting only the most sincere wishes from Trainers. It will then grant them to the best of their abilities. The granted wishes may have unintended consequences, however.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's cloak is made of a strange condensed stardust said to grant wishes. This power only works while POKENAME itself is wearing the cloak, as it turns to worthless sand if forcibly removed.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that icicles forming around POKENAME's body are actually crystallized wishes of nearby Pokémon. These icicles often shatter when the wishes are fulfilled.
author: lemage22

entry: Some say that if you write a wish on one of POKENAME's leaves, then let it go into the wind, your wish will be certainly granted.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's star-shaped clusters of feathers on the ends of its wings are quite dense. In battle, it energetically swings its wings to pummel foes.
author: mepp.

entry: While POKENAME may not give out wishes, they manage to find precious sentimental items that have gotten lost in the past. The serendipitous reunion of adults and their childhood toys make many people tear up with joy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always have a serene expression whenever they are found at landfills. They wade through garbage to find sentimental items that were thrown away so they can return them to their owners.
author: quackquackattack

entry: On nights filled with shooting stars, sightings of POKENAME increase. Catching one is said to bring good luck for 100 years.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME jets through the waters and even into the air at high speeds, leaving behind a trail of something resembling stardust. It's thought that if it wanted, it could fling itself into space and swim through the galaxy.
author: sk372

entry: This rare fusion's cute appearance and resemblance to a rocket ship have made it the subject of many children's books. It has a gentle temperament.
author: admiralvermin

entry: In union with Jirachi, this Trevenant found peace. It is now a cradle of wishes, waiting patiently for its friend to awaken so they may help others.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME's body is made of an unknown liquid metal that doesn't heat but melts solids that come into contact with it. It's said that POKENAME fell to this planet as a shooting star.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME is a kind Pokémon, offering wishes in exchange for hugs. While its wishing power isn't strong, POKENAME will still try to fulfill every wish that it is hugged for.
author: elibromax314

entry: Each one of POKENAME's starry legs contains inscribed symbols from an old but known language. Those who chant the word formed by these symbols 12 times in a row will have their wish of unlimited Corsola branches granted to them.
author: soup1900

entry: Each one of POKENAME's starry legs contains inscribed symbols from an old but known language. Those who chant the word formed by these symbols 12 times in a row will have their wish of unlimited Corsola branches granted to them.
author: soup1900

entry: Before granting a wish, POKENAME will strike many poses and show off its starry feathers. If a written wish is placed on it during one of its poses, it will restart and fulfill that wish as well.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is said to appear before pure-hearted travelers within the desert at night. It teleports them to safety via a strange sandstorm seemingly made of stardust, POKENAME itself vanishing when the traveler reaches a safe haven.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in desert towns and ruthlessly punishes any troublemakers with it's pins.  Its lawful nature makes it disliked by other Dark-Type Pokémon.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME carry the wishes of those from the savannah, from the smallest gasp of air of a baby to an elder man's dying breath. Their appearance reminds people of the region that nature is cruel and loving, as Pokémon continue to adapt to the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's songs are said to fill pure-hearted listeners with childlike joy, while those with wicked hearts will simply be lulled into a deep slumber. It only awakens every few hundred years, so its songs are mostly known only through legends.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will only awaken on nights when the moon shines brightest and the stars are all alight in the night sky. It will sing and dance within the moonlight as though it were a spotlight, enthralling Pokémon and humans alike with its performance.
author: infinex21

entry: By slipping into dreams, POKENAME help people and Pokémon alike to fulfill their deep-seated desires. Many Pokémon long to grow stronger, a wish POKENAME grants by helping the dreamer evolve in their sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While in deep slumber, POKENAME traverses the dreams of those nearby. If it encounters a pure-hearted wish during its sleep, it manifests that desire into reality.
author: ambrosia04

entry: It is said that when three shooting stars collide, a POKENAME is created. The constellations on its shell can be used to predict future meteor showers.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The wishes granted by POKENAME are often altered from the original wish maker's intention to be beneficial to POKENAME. It uses its divination ability to decide what the most useful twist on each wish will be.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME comes out on starry evenings to prance about and practice its fighting style. Others are welcome to come train with it, and if the practice goes particularly well, POKENAME may grant its sparring partner a wish afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are found deep in the solar system, occasionally flying past the planet and leaving a trail in the night sky. Seeing one is said to bring great fortune to the observer, making their deepest desire come true.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legends say that one's deepest desires are reflected in POKENAME's crystalline body. They also state that staring at it for too long will only lead one to their doom.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is prayed upon by many greedy people as it has the ability to grant infinite wealth to an individual. In response, they give these people cursed gems to bring great misfortune and misery to their lives.
author: soup1900

entry: It is said that having one of POKENAME's star-shaped gold pieces grants the holder the ability to ask for any wish they want granted. However, any wishes of greed will end in a storm of wealth hitting them and dooming their life.
author: soup1900

entry: Harassing a POKENAME will make it release a cloud of poison dust that causes sweet dreams when inhaled. This dust also causes a 1000 day coma.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is said to grant a wish once every thousand years. However, it has no recollection of its powers after fulfilling one.
author: abhatu

entry: Having swam through space for millennia, fragments of the cosmos now flow from POKENAME. Its third eye allows it to see perfectly through any liquid.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME travels across the stars as a servant to mortals' dreams. It is said that comets are merely POKENAME blazing through space.
author: nellnast42

entry: As POKENAME channels its psychic attacks, the spiral on its stomach spins. An old legend claims that as its spiral spins, wish-granting power is built up in its body. POKENAME struggles to walk on its legs, so it is seen most often in water.
author: chibitales

entry: A sage-like being residing on mountain peaks where meteor showers are commonly seen. POKENAME judges the minds and hearts of others, to see if they are worthy enough to have it grant their wishes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fighting style involves using the ribbons around its wrists as grappling items to reel opponents into close-quarters attack range. It is said to grant the wishes of fighters strong enough to best it in combat.
author: sk372

entry: According to legend, if POKENAME is rubbed and polished thoroughly, it will grant a wish in return. It is an extremely rare creature usually found only on mountain peaks, camouflaged among the rocks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves to grant wishes, but it is too dim-witted to fully understand what people want. As a result, it often ends up granting the wrong wish unintentionally.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has the ability to bring the wishes of others to life. However, it's very elusive, so many people don't even know about this power.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This fusion was created to bring a famous constellation to life. Its three heads can see the past, present, and future.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME are usually seen during meteor showers, where they zoom through the night at extreme speeds, casting beautiful illusions in the sky. Should a POKENAME land during one of these showers, they will radiate a soothing aura.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME can be found swimming across the stars in the sky like water. With each splash, a human's deepest wish is granted.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of the ocean, only opening its shell once every 5,000 years. Despite many scientific attempts, POKENAME has never been forcefully opened.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME grants wishes by swinging its tanzaku. Nothing makes it happier than witnessing the pure joy of those whose dreams have come true.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME rubs its claws against leaves to abrade them into tiny pieces. Once small enough to resemble sand, POKENAME consume the leafy fragments.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Hives of POKENAME make their homes in tunnels. They explode if disturbed, sometimes setting off a chain reaction that can level buildings above their tunnels.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME cries, the chitin on its head darkens in color. It burrows underground afterward, using this change to calm itself into sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME create portable nests around their lower bodies to take shelter from the sun and protect themselves while they sleep. They extend out from their nests to travel and gather food before retreating back in.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are regarded as one of the more mundane Pokémon in existence. They float in large bodies of water looking for seaweed and swipe at any Pokémon that tries to steal their food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It slices through roots underground to create space for winter hibernation. Once spring approaches, it discards the nest, allowing opportunistic Pokémon to take over.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their stiff antennae to probe tree bark for weak points, biting through to feed on sap when they find a soft patch. They metabolise the toxins within the plants they feed on, using them to make themselves unpalatable to predators.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spends many years underground, digging in search of an Evolution stone. When it finally finds one, POKENAME remains completely motionless as it absorbs the radiation from the stone and evolves.
author: darkweavile428

entry: After feeding extensively on data with its swarm, POKENAME burrows deep underground to rest. The tunnels it leaves behind can stretch for miles.
author: .izik

entry: Once POKENAME finds a tree it likes the fruit and roots of, it claims it for itself and jabs at anything that comes near it. Its stingers are actually rather dull, so it relies mostly on intimidation to sent intruders packing.
author: sk372

entry: The fur growing from its bug-like shell makes POKENAME feel odd to touch. It trusts quickly, and loves making friends with children.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME's fur is extremely fine, and it frequently takes dust baths to rid its coat of moisture that it accumulates underground. It gets anxious if its coat stays damp for too long.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's burrows are covered in a sticky web that does not stick to this Pokémon. If anything gets caught in its web, it hurries to dislodge it to keep the webbing clean, ensuring its home remains pristine.
author: .izik

entry: During the full moon, POKENAME emerges from its tunnels and stares at the sky. Though nearly blind, it somehow knows where the moon is and faces it, drawn by its light.
author: .izik

entry: Sometimes, while eating the roots of bushes, POKENAME will stop abruptly. During this time, it sees visions of anyone who interacted with the bush in the last week.
author: .izik

entry: After eating enough roots, a thick green wool will grow from POKENAME's carapace. This wool stores an electrical charge, which it can survive off of while it waits to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to eat tulip roots. When full, it will spin while floating over forests, spreading joy as it drifts through the air in search of new places to explore.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME despises sunlight as it irritates its already poor eyes. At night, it will float around forests looking for areas with dense trees to make a future burrow where it can rest undisturbed.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME eats all the roots of nearby flora, it will gather seeds from other areas and scatter them while floating high above the ground, ensuring the growth of new plants.
author: .izik

entry: If a predator enters its tunnel, POKENAME will attack with a coy Tail Whip before unleashing a powerful Hyper Fang. This ensures its tunnels stay safe for others of its kind, protecting its home from intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the claw-like portion of its tail to grab Nanab Berries from trees. It then withdraws into its burrow to eat the fruit, savoring its sweet, juicy flesh away from predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are virtually blind, so they rapidly vibrate their wings to produce sonic waves that help them sense the area around them. They sleep shrouded in foliage, their green wings helping them blend in.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's eyesight is extremely poor. It wanders around marshy areas not because it likes to explore, but because its eyesight is so bad it cannot see where it is going or where its den is.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME will leave its current burrow to look for other places to dig. Should it find a maple tree, it will immediately dig down to eat as much of the roots as it can, savoring the rich nourishment.
author: .izik

entry: Groups of POKENAME burrow beneath trees, using their claws to carve through the roots to absorb their nutrients. Trees infested by these Pokémon will often have mysterious symbols and letters carved into their trunks.
author: santon5512

entry: They shed their skins daily because they are continuously growing. When ground into a fine powder, it smells and tastes like an almond, but without the risk of an allergic reaction.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its large claws to dig underground, creating intricate tunnels. It can wait motionless for multiple years after eating enough plant life, hoping to evolve into something more powerful.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME leaves its burrow to fly into Apricorn trees and knock loose the fruit. Two are usually enough for it to stay sustained for a month, as long as it remains motionless underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes a burrow under Persim Berry trees, gathering fallen berries and storing them in its shell. As it digs, the berries ripen further and turn into a delicious slurry, which is combined with drinks in restaurants across Hoenn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to break apart tree roots, drinking any moisture that seeps out. This behavior allows it to nourish itself while continuing its underground lifestyle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roots around with its whiskers in search of tree roots to feed on, particularly in drier climates. These feelers ignite and shoot extremely hot flames at those who get too close while it is trying to eat.
author: sk372

entry: A Shed Shell from a POKENAME is said to last a decade, made of a sturdy keratin. They produce four in a month, as their bodies release excess keratin through the tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can sense healthy plant roots through soil with their twin antennae. They probe the ground in front of them to hone in on these plants whilst burrowing, leaving a long, sinuous tunnel behind them as they search for food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Often infesting computers in apartment buildings, POKENAME swarms are considered a high priority nuisance. While sleeping, the swarm lets out barely audible beeps that have driven citizens to sleep deprivation.
author: chibitales

entry: After eating the roots of daffodils, POKENAME's strength multiplies, allowing it to smash boulders with its bare hands. This effect lasts only a few minutes but makes it incredibly powerful in that brief period.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends its time eating roots of medicinal herbs. Its milk is extremely bitter but is able to heal minor abrasions on contact, making it valuable for healing purposes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its claws while digging to search for tree roots. It has trouble seeing, so it relies on its tiny whiskers to determine its surroundings, ensuring it can navigate through the earth with precision.
author: .izik

entry: Because POKENAME primarily live underground, they are nearly blind. They have developed the ability to sense heat in their surroundings, so they may spit fire to help guide themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME only come out during the night, deep within the forests. During their outings, POKENAME will search for large trees to scratch into and drink the moisture from.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME consumes the roots of plant life near its pond. These roots provide it with the nourishment needed to grow and thrive in its aquatic habitat.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME senses happiness nearby, its whiskers move rapidly. The more intense the joy the person feels, the faster they move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME normally live deep underground, but will travel along the surface to find food. They change the color of their bodies and flatten themselves as they crawl to hide from predators.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It burrows underneath forest floors, patiently waiting to feel vibrations up on the surface. The strength of the vibration helps POKENAME determine if the source is small enough to consider as prey.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME are found in tombs where they remain partially embedded in the walls. They are completely blind and rely on other senses to navigate the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's whiskers glow gold when it senses irreverence. It retaliates with Judgment before proudly walking away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME siphon nutrients from the ground with their front claws, tiny roots extending from them once in the soil. They use the energy they gain to feed the symbiotic plant growing from their heads.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A fast climber, POKENAME scurries up to the treetops when frightened. From there, it grabs nuts and other objects to ignite and throw at whatever it was that sent it fleeing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roots around loose soil to dig up seeds and nuts on the ground to eat. It is very greedy and defensive when eating, spitting bubbles and half-eaten seeds at anything it sees coming near while it feeds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sheaths into the ground next to the roots of a tree, absorbing its nutrients to evolve. It only unsheathes to defend itself.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME uses the blades on its arms to cut apart oregano roots from below the surface of the ground. It prefers the flavor of this herb over all others, often making burrows near patches of the plant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrow through the ground while extending their feelers through the soil to locate tubers, potatoes being their favorites. Because of this, they release an earthy potato scent from their bodies that soothes those around them.
author: santon5512

entry: If you follow a POKENAME into the ground, you may be caught in a dark and complex tunnel system. This is a way to confuse predators.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME spends much of its life below ground, until the spring, when the bulbs on its tail grow too large for tunnels and it loses them. Avid foragers hunt for these fungal bulbs as a rare treat, either cooked alone or as a meal topping.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME makes deep burrows in landfills, staying hidden from the light. It hates sunlight and only emerges after night falls to feed and scout for new areas to haunt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows under the seafloor to eat the roots of aquatic plants. It stays underground as much as possible to hide from predators like Lanturn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME steals keys from nearby towns and keeps them in its burrow as a trophy. It prefers keys made of iron which are later added to its collection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends decades burrowing underground, eating roots and smaller bug Pokémon. When it's ready to evolve, it waits until nightfall to emerge from the ground with its brethren, ranging from a few hundred to thousands of individuals.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME produces an incredibly loud chirping noise by rubbing its wings against its body. Should a swarm become agitated, their combined chirping can grow loud enough to shatter glass.
author: .izik

entry: Although born underground, young POKENAME soon learn to deftly leap between the trees of their home forest. Regardless of the difference in strength, it will attempt to ambush anyone with an evil aura.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME make their nests at the roots of trees, though they spend most of their lives digging out their nests in between sleeping and eating. They use their whisker-like antennae to probe for food; notably, they have a preference for mushrooms.
author: infinex21

entry: It is a shy herbivorous Pokémon that is most often found at night. It only bathes right before it goes to sleep.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is a shy herbivorous Pokémon that is most often found at night. It only bathes right before it goes to sleep.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to eat hydrangea roots and will use its electrical powers to defend its food. Its energetic nature makes it fiercely protective of its meals.
author: .izik

entry: Echoes of POKENAME's song can be heard throughout its lengthy tunnels. If one hears it, one could fall asleep or become disoriented in the underground passages.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME plods along the ground, prodding at the dirt for nutrients and oblivious to potential dangers. This is due to its carapace being so heavy and sturdy that nothing in its natural habitat is strong enough to prey on it.
author: sk372

entry: The beating of their wings makes a very distinct and loud noise that forces many beings to cover their ears. They emerge from their nest en masse every other summer to hunt and gather.
author: bobosmith01

entry: After eating basil roots, POKENAME's gears will rotate rapidly in happiness. It prefers that herb's flavor above all others, making it a rare and sought-after delicacy for the creature.
author: .izik

entry: The green flame on POKENAME's tail glows brightly within its underground burrow. This flame keeps it warm when surrounded by cold soil, allowing it to survive in dark and chilly environments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME peeks out of its tunnels each morning to absorb sunlight for a few hours. It then returns underground to sleep while waiting to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: After night falls, POKENAME ascends from its tunnel and floats just outside the entrance, looking for tall trees. During the daytime, it digs towards these areas to eat the roots, its primary food source.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME emerges from its burrow to float through forests. It makes an unsettling noise- like a child's laughter mixed with windchimes- to scare away intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to move dirt when digging. It neatly packs any mud or stone to ensure the tunnels do not cave in, creating stable and well-structured homes underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emerges from its tunnels at night to float through meadows. During this time, it surveys the area to decide where to tunnel next, constantly searching for a new place to settle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is entirely blind, and vibrates its antennae at high speeds to perceive its surroundings. Due to its extreme sensitivity to sunlight, it only goes out in the open during the nighttime.
author: bacondlx

entry: After eating the roots of chamomile, POKENAME's body's electrical charge strengthens to three times its normal amount. Scientists are still discovering the reason behind this peculiar reaction.
author: .izik

entry: Much of its time is spent searching for mineral deposits in caves. Once it finds a large one, it absorbs as many nutrients as it can. These sustain it while it waits to evolve.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME digs long tunnels with their flock and lines the nesting chambers with feathers. These feathers keep their eggs remarkably warm even through the coldest winters.
author: .izik

entry: After finding gems, POKENAME burrows deep underground with others of its swarm. It meticulously organizes each gem type into a different tunnel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses an acidic, sticky lavender-scented mucus to assist in burrowing through rocky terrain. It can dig up to 200 feet before growing tired.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME eats the roots of poisonous plant life, the venom sacs in its body fill. This increase in toxicity boosts its ability to defend itself against predators, making it even more dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head become extremely glossy after eating the roots of pine trees. The oils they produce are used for treating seasickness, making this Pokémon valuable in medicinal practices.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's exoskeleton is notoriously brittle, prone to tearing open as it gorges on mulch. This doesn't hurt them, and is in fact key for their development.
author: mx_wellman

entry: While nesting in a tree stump, POKENAME absorbs the remaining moisture in the roots. This leaves the stump brittle before it leaves to find a new home, ensuring its territory is always secure and ready for its next resting place.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's roots will grow out of its legs when it finds a swamp to live in. These roots connect with other plant life in the area, allowing it to sense the surrounding environment via vibrations, compensating for its poor eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a sharp edge to their wings, using them as cutting tools rather than for flight. They swarm together while feeding, taking turns to eat plant sap whilst listening out for danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME takes the form of what appears to be a massive fossilized Nincada. An ancient intelligence peers out from its hollowed-out shell. The shell itself has become harder than any known steel, tempered by the passage of eons.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Should a Sandshrew invade its tunnels, POKENAME will attack with a Brick Break. It then rolls the unconscious invader out of the tunnel and continues digging.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in completely dark caves, leading it to be almost blind. It uses its feelers to sense its surroundings and buries itself into the ground to absorb moisture and nutrients from the soil.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's fur is covered in a white powder that causes breathing difficulties and uncontrollable itching. This powder is often used in the production of certain X supplements.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in clusters beneath the ground, resembling pumpkins at a glance. During winter months, their clusters become tighter as they share warmth, ensuring they remain cozy in the cold season.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME digs under pumpkin patches to eat the roots. It thrives in these eerie environments, using its underground burrows to feast on the nourishing roots hidden beneath.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very hard to encounter in the wild, as it is notoriously skittish, digging away at the first sign of trouble. It usually remains underground for all of its life, digging complex tunnels through dirt.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME leaps from ocean waves and spins in a drill-like fashion to burrow beneath the beach sand. Once deep enough, it emits a chirping noise for a period before falling asleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rely on their keen sense of smell to find their way throughout the world. If another Pokémon neutralizes their ability to smell, then they freeze up and refuse to move until that sense of smell returns.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Roots sticking up at odd ends are likely a sign that a POKENAME has settled within a forest. POKENAME dig their tunnels in zig-zagging patterns, using the roots of trees to stabilize their intricate burrows.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's horn is incredibly strong and useful for breaking through stones beneath the soil. It uses this to burrow deep underground and rest with others from its swarm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps and eats underground, and only comes out if it needs to gather food or escape water drainage. It is shy and avoids other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses its antennae to search for nutrient-rich soil to bury itself in. Once fully submerged, it absorbs nutrients from the dirt around it, helping expedite its evolutionary process.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lines its tunnel with a thick powder shed from its wings. It hibernates during colder seasons, conserving its strength for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have poor eyesight, so they rely on their sense of smell to locate Bug-type Pokémon. When they find a target, they unleash a blind flurry of pecks until they capture their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As a nocturnal creature, POKENAME will flutter near palm trees and use the antenna on its snout to find openings in the soft bark. POKENAME will absorb the nutrients from the tree for sustenance before returning to its ground nest at dawn.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME searches for clay deposits in marshlands while flying, then digs deep underground. Once it creates a deep enough tunnel, it sleeps for days while waiting to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: To comfort itself, POKENAME continually vibrates its ears to create a hum too quiet for most to hear. When startled, it intensifies the vibrations, leading to an explosion of sound that usually buries POKENAME under dirt displaced by the soundwaves.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Although POKENAME's eyesight is poor, it uses its whisker-like antennae to sense its surroundings. It eagerly investigates anything that moves in search of new playthings to store in its underground den.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME use their stiff whiskers to root through dirt in search for tubers and roots. Their wings buzz loudly with excitement when they find food, alerting nearby POKENAME that there's an available meal.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases a pulse of comforting green light to others of its kind within cave systems. This allows others of their swarm to rest while they wait for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: When its headache worsens, POKENAME will dig underground at an accelerated speed. This physical exertion soothes it somehow, providing a temporary relief to its pounding mind.
author: .izik

entry: The feelers bordering POKENAME's nose let it sense the health of trees to determine which are growing the tastiest fruits. It flies into a rage if its feelers are tugged on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME may rarely be found in shallow and muddy river streams. Despite their cowardly nature, during thunderstorms, they may worm themselves onto the surface to nibble at the roots of a tree; the risk of being shocked is of no concern to them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to bury itself in mud for protection and to keep itself from overheating. There has been more than one case of it accidentally scaring children when it suddenly pops out from muddy puddles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to bury itself in mud for protection and to keep itself from overheating. There has been more than one case of it accidentally scaring children when it suddenly pops out from muddy puddles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives most of its life underground in total seclusion, relying on absorbing minerals and water that drain into the earth as sustenance. It is entirely blind as a result, and uses psychic powers to see.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME burrows under power plants, sleeping near buried wires to siphon energy. The draw of power it takes is very minuscule and can go unnoticed for years, allowing it to sustain itself without detection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its stick to dig up dirt to find good patches of soil from which to gain nutrients. Its digging efforts stir the soil enough to assist in plant growth around its home areas.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME digs massive tunnels in mountains to find thick root clusters that it can eat. Its powerful body is built for excavation, allowing it to create vast networks underground in search of food.
author: .izik

entry: Its legs can extend up to double their original length when kicking. They use their powerful attacks to fell trees.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends time in quarries, honing its strength by smashing boulders. It uses chipped stones to build complex dams, ensuring that no water leaks through by carefully filling every gap.
author: .izik

entry: The smoke that pours out of a POKENAME smells like rotting wood. It prefers to feed on tree stumps and other fallen foliage.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats lazily with the tides, spinning gently to every ripple. It chews through driftwood and flotsam, breaking it down and then letting fish use the remnants for shelter.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Once POKENAME has constructed a dam in flowing water, it starts to mime as if it were pouring with rain. Within a few minutes, rain often comes, and POKENAME can ensure that its dam will survive fast-flowing water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME swims playfully through streams, releasing bubbles that shimmer in the sunlight. These bubbles often linger on the surface, forming delicate patterns that mesmerize other Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are obsessively hard workers, working up to 18 hours per day building the most spectacular of dams. Once a colony of POKENAME are done with a dam, they will wait at most one week before tearing it down and rebuilding it.
author: laughing_dan

entry: One of the first known POKENAME appeared as a file within a Hydropower Plant's server. Its origin is unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME remains motionless in its riverside burrow, its outer shell hardening over time. When the moment is right, it bursts forth with surprising speed to defend its territory.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME rescues drowning people, it keeps them snug inside its heat-retaining fur to prevent them from developing hypothermia. Before returning these people home, it makes sure they are well rested by housing them in nests it has built.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME gnaw on trees and create small controlled fires to draw out hidden Bug-type Pokémon for consumption. They easily extinguish the flames with their mastery over water.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in rivers, especially near watermills. They roll up their tails into a stockier shape to smack things. They like to make wood carvings.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME break open Hondew Berries with their front teeth to eat the fleshy fruit on the inside. They take turns standing watch while they eat berries to avoid being surprised by predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME constructs fences from sticks and stones, marking the boundaries of its territory. It patrols these barriers tirelessly, ensuring that no intruders disturb its carefully crafted domain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cultivates rose bushes near its lodges, using their blossoms to camouflage entrances. The scent of the flowers masks its presence, allowing it to move unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waits patiently by swift-moving streams, weaving delicate webs over the water's surface. Its clever traps mimic natural patterns, fooling prey until it pulls them in with precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds its lodges near old tree stumps, using them as lookout points. From these vantage points, it surveys the area, ensuring no intruders disturb its carefully arranged home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME watches over small hamlets, standing motionless for hours as if in deep thought. Locals see it as a guardian, believing it predicts events and offers quiet protection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nests near factories, gathering discarded wires to line its lodges. The static it collects helps regulate energy, making it more active during thunderstorms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cultivates kudzu vines, encouraging them to grow around its lodges for protection and shade. These fast-growing plants also attract other Pokémon, creating bustling habitats.
author: .izik

entry: The balls on its arms are made of an unidentified wood-like substance. It swings its arms menacingly to keep enemies away from its den.
author: .izik

entry: Its den is made up of mud and twigs. It gathers shiny objects that it finds on the river's floor and stores them in its home.
author: .izik

entry: It gathers branches off of trees to make elaborate dens. These dens can have multiple rooms and floors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects moss to line the walls of its lodge, creating a soft, insulating layer. The moss also helps maintain moisture inside, ensuring a comfortable habitat throughout changing seasons.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time playing in puddles, splashing around with carefree abandon. It uses its claws to shape these puddles into small reservoirs, storing water for drier days.
author: .izik

entry: With the metal saws on its arms, POKENAME can topple trees in seconds. Rangers rely on it to remove dangerous or diseased plants, ensuring the safety of vast forested zones.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to peel bark off trees in search of sap. Once it's finished eating, it carves the tree down to gather and use in creating a shelter for itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME industriously helps provide food for other Pokémon by boiling liquids inside its shell. It most commonly makes bark and root stew to energize other Bibarel and increase their work productivity.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME feeds by stripping bark from trees, leaving distinct patterns in its wake. These marks signal territory boundaries, helping other Pokémon avoid its domain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constructs coral and detritus lodges in reefs that become havens for small marine Pokémon. It can completely change the color of each band on its body, confusing predators rather than hiding from them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Despite typically living within tall mountain ranges, POKENAME often travel as a flock to nearby forests to cut down trees en masse with their sharp wings and teeth before taking the logs back to their gigantic nest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often wanders through villages, where it gathers discarded wood for its lodges. Though it acts standoffish, it shows kindness by sharing shelter with other Pokémon during harsh weather.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carves chunks of marble into smooth shapes using its sharp teeth. These polished stones decorate its home, adding a touch of artistry to an otherwise humble lodge.
author: .izik

entry: Areas with POKENAME populations have to construct their power poles out of metal. Wooden power poles are often chewed down by POKENAME as they try to get to the electrical wires.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME thrives along riverbanks, where it uses its twin tails to build cozy lodges. It aids other Pokémon crossing currents, acting as both protector and trickster in equal measure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME forages for algae along water surfaces, storing it inside its lodge to be snacked on later. It has a habit of collecting more than it needs, causing its lodge to overflow with slimy greenery.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is easily sidetracked when it comes across any piece of wood floating in the water. It can spend hours happily and mindlessly bouncing about on the wooden flotsam.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their claws to dig up rocks and chip away at trees so they can build dams along rivers and streams. They use their large tails to help pack these pieces together with clumps of mud.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME stacks logs with precision, creating sturdy barriers to shape waterways. It takes pride in its agility as well as its strength, maneuvering through tight spaces with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gathers twigs obsessively, using them to build intricate nests near water. Its small body hides surprising strength, easily carrying large bundles of wood in search of the perfect building site.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tirelessly work to create dams made of boulders and stones. The water let through these dams is almost completely filtered, often being used by nearby towns as a source of drinking water.
author: santon5512

entry: Despite its sturdy frame, POKENAME exudes an air of elegance, moving gracefully through the water. It offers comfort to those who approach, wrapping them in a soothing embrace with a kindness that surprises many.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's powerful arms can carve through slate, which it uses to reinforce its lodges. It takes great pride in the precision of its work, leaving behind structures as strong as they are beautiful.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats expressionlessly over riverbeds, eerily unmoving as it observes the water's flow. If anyone gets too close, it sprays them with a jet of water before silently drifting away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME works tirelessly to construct elaborate dams, reinforcing them with chewed-up logs. It is highly territorial and will slap the water with its tail to warn intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has fur that ripples like the calm waters of a lagoon. Though it exudes tranquility, its presence hints at coming changes that leave others unsettled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have various plants that grow upon their backs as adults, rooting themselves in the fertile soil matted into their fur. They groom one another constantly, gnawing at these plants and preventing them from growing fully.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME work together in large families to create clearings in forests, chewing down trees and using the fallen branches to make shelters for themselves. They are friendly and willing to share their shelters with other Pokémon during poor weather.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME builds dams on river streams using mud and the wood and stone it carves. These dams resemble tiny forts, and it sheathes in them.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Wild POKENAME fell oak tree after oak tree in seconds each. It's a dream for logging companies but a nightmare for environmentalists.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME glides silently across open sea, with its hard body cutting smoothly through the water. Sailors who encounter it during twilight speak of sudden storms that follow soon after.
author: .izik

entry: The axe on top of the head of a POKENAME enables it to cut down small trees. POKENAME sometimes carries around the log of a tree it has cut down as sort of a trophy.
author: ackshewally

entry: POKENAME's fur is unusually soft, and its dam is often decorated with colorful ribbons made from river plants. It forms strong emotional bonds with those who help maintain its home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME oversees the rivers of the world from far above, only descending to enact judgment on natural dams. Ones deemed "unfit" are instantly cleaved apart by the axe heads on its back.
author: scalding

entry: POKENAME's body holds nitrogen pockets that allow it to stay buoyant even in deep waters. It floats along rivers, using bursts of gas to steer through narrow streams and over obstacles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gathers lilies from nearby ponds, weaving them into intricate wreaths. It decorates its lodges with these floral arrangements, adding a surprising touch of elegance to its home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mugs unsuspecting travelers along riverbanks, using stealth and strength to overpower them. It drags the spoils back to its den, where it carefully hides them beneath layers of mud.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wooden exterior conceals a body made of darkness. It has been known to hunt prey from the shadows and imprison them inside of itself before moving to a new haunt.
author: spartan_ct

entry: POKENAME moves noisily through forests, rattling objects it collects to announce its presence. Its loud behavior keeps predators at bay and lets it avoid surprising others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's nest is lined with fireproof feathers, preventing its lodge from burning. It can boil the water near its nest by slapping the surface with its tail.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its nest by damming a stream with toys it steals from camping children. Sightings by children are often dismissed as Bibarel sightings.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME create vast inland lakes with their dams, insatiably gnawing through trees to build their homes. They build far more dams than they need, and the abandoned older dams form homes for other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's behavior differs dramatically depending on whether it is living in the wild or under the care of a Pokémon Trainer. In the wild, POKENAME is a dutiful worker that delivers lumber to its colony during almost every single waking hour.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's behavior differs dramatically depending on whether it is living in the wild or under the care of a Pokémon Trainer. When domesticated, POKENAME has a goofy personality and chews on whatever it finds.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's fur crackles with static when it dives into water, sending electric currents through the river. It uses this ability to stun prey like Poliwag before scooping them up with ease.
author: .izik

entry: For an unknown reason, groups of POKENAME recently appeared in a dam north of Rifure Village. They make an odd clicking noise to deter enemies.
author: .izik

entry: Using bark and mud, it dams streams, relying on its gears for stability. If they fail, the dam collapses, posing a danger to its surroundings.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME grows twisting vines around its lodge, weaving them into intricate patterns. These living decorations provide both beauty and defense, keeping unwanted visitors at bay.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lines its nests with soft bedding made from fallen leaves and plant fibers, creating cozy homes for itself and others. Its careful craftsmanship ensures warmth even in cooler climates.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME coats its skin with the gel of aloe plants it gathers from riverbanks, soothing itself after long days in the sun. It uses these plants not only for comfort but also to aid in healing minor injuries.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roosts among stalactites in dark caves, using its sharp senses to navigate with ease. It wraps its body in wings and vines to create a cocoon-like nest, ensuring a peaceful rest.
author: .izik

entry: Known for its cunning, POKENAME often raids campsites, making off with supplies and treasures. It carries its stolen goods back to its lodge, adding to an ever-growing hoard.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to nest among sycamores, using fallen leaves to insulate its lodges. It guards these trees carefully, knowing they provide shade and materials essential for its survival.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME make their homes in caves, using rocks to divert river caverns to create dams. The water that comes from these dams is rich in salt, making the waters around these dams ideal for creating cavernous resorts or spas.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp incisors to gnaw on petrified wood. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon's body surface.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: It bounces its rubbery body to move from place to place. Each bounce has enough force to cause the ground to shake.
author: .izik

entry: When provoked, POKENAME will throw the twig it carries as far as it can. However, this is only a distraction, as POKENAME will then charge at its foe and unleash a powerful headbutt.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME collects cardboard from abandoned places, crafting waterproof shelters along rivers. It takes pride in repurposing discarded materials, turning trash into comfortable homes.
author: .izik

entry: Even during winter, POKENAME remains active in icy waters, its sharp teeth helping it carve paths through frozen rivers. It gathers in schools, using group strength to break through thicker ice.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is considered highly dangerous to ships passing through its territory. It ignores other creatures entirely, but seems compelled to go after man-made creations like boats and gnawing them apart with its large teeth.
author: sk372

entry: It is upset by the sound of running water, and will attempt to dam up any streams it sees. Because it can fly, it will also attempt to shove mud and logs into clouds.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is often seen during monsoon rains, eagerly building dams to manage rising water. Though well-intentioned, its actions sometimes cause unexpected floods, leaving others scrambling to adapt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts near old shipwrecks, gathering fragments to strengthen its dams. Its wooden body gives it an ancient, mysterious appearance, as if a part of the ocean's history moves with it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds intricate nests coated with a layer of foam, which helps retain moisture in dry environments. Its nests provide shelter not only for itself but also for smaller Pokémon seeking refuge from the heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for wood, often resulting in large colonies creating clearings and glades in forests due to their diet. The hardy fungi on their back absorbs the lignin from the food POKENAME eats and uses it to grow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has teeth as durable as stone, with lost ones often collected to craft intricate tools. It proudly showcases its set, using them to intimidate rivals and carve through tough objects.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is infested with a fungus that has completely overtaken its body, reforming it into a wood-like structure from which it can comfortably grow new fruiting bodies. This parasitism drives POKENAME to feed on as much wood as it can.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are too proud to follow commands blindly, only listening to Trainers who bond with them and treat them as equals. When sleeping outdoors, they build simple shelters to shield themselves and their Trainer from the elements.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME reinforces its dam with scavenged materials, layering stones and debris to fortify its home. If threatened, it headbutts intruders with enough force to knock them into the water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME decorates its lodge with lillipads that it gathers from nearby ponds. POKENAME's teeth are harder than diamond and can break stone with ease, serving as a formiddle tool for when it builds a new structure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often found digging through pieces of wood. They can be a great pest to anyone living in a wooden house.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME thrives in polluted waters, purifying its surroundings as it swims. It carves heart-shaped patterns into the riverbanks using its sharp teeth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hoards smooth stones, polishing them until they gleam like treasures. It often swaps these stones with other Pokémon, trading them for food or new additions to its collection.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME feel angry or upset, they splash themselves with water to calm themselves down before they spiral into a headache. They focus on building dams so that they have a place to hibernate in winter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys constructing monuments from sticks and stones, stacking them in peculiar shapes along riverbanks. Though crude, these structures are said to mark important events or victories.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swings playfully from willow branches, using them both for shelter and recreation. Though it enjoys company, its sudden bursts of energy often catch others off guard.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carves a wooden spoon with its teeth to use as a focus for its psychic power. It's unknown if the spoon actually does anything, as silver spoons are normally the only effective type for psychic focusing.
author: hophoppip

entry: It has extraordinary knowledge of the forest and the things found in it. POKENAME has such strength that it can carry ten big tree logs in one hand.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: This fusion is usually a lumberjack's helper. Huge muscle strength allows POKENAME build large wooden structures such as dams and gyms.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME's dam is coated in a sticky, sweet-smelling sap that attracts prey like Hoppip. It hides inside its home, striking at anything that comes too close with a sudden Vine Whip.
author: .izik

entry: It competes with others of its kind by holding onto cliff walls for long periods of time. The winner is determined by who holds on longest.
author: .izik

entry: It will use its Ember to immolate logs that it has chopped up with its fangs. It will then roll in the ashes to clean its coat.
author: .izik

entry: It can discharge highly pressured water from its mouth when threatened. Once its opponent is soaked, it has been known to let loose a powerful Thunder Shock before running away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims gracefully, using small icebergs as resting spots during long journeys. It balances on these icy platforms with ease, delighting in the cold waters it calls home.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is coated in a dark, poisonous mud. If it stays in the sun too long, portions will harden and fall off.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is mostly composed of an unnatural irritant gas that can slide right through even solid objects. Although it does not get most of its energy from organic material, studies show it thinks about Berries and wood quite a lot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has an aura that emanates from its body, which intensifies when POKENAME is around happy people. The large seed on its back is known to grow if it is around positive people.
author: astral_1447

entry: It is very protective over the food it gathers. Should another POKENAME approach, it will spit a web of sticky silk at it.
author: .izik

entry: In an attempt to hide its emotions, POKENAME wears a skull to obscure its face. This does nothing to mask the aura it constantly emanates, and everyone nearby can feel its sorrow.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME channels its aura into powerful kicks, able to pulverize a steel beam in a single strike. It protects Pokémon weaker than itself, only using its aura in dire situations.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME trains daily with its punches, tempering its hands into steel-tough fists. It channels its aura into its punches, energizing them with its emotions and dreams.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its aura-reading skills on food. It can instantly identify the most delicious meal before taking a single lick with its tongue.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have so much determination that they will charge into battle with little regard for their safety. Their horns will start to glow bright blue when they are badly injured.
author: mistymagius

entry: Upon detecting a dark aura, POKENAME traps the foe in vines. It then screeches loudly to signal its allies to flee while it fights alone.
author: .izik

entry: Trainers looking to catch a POKENAME must subdue their emotions before approaching the water. If this Pokémon senses any excitement, it will flee immediately.
author: .realthree

entry: Paralyzing powder drifts from POKENAME's wings. After stunning its foe, it finishes the fight with a precise Vacuum Wave.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME focus their energy by rapidly spinning in mid-air until they've built enough momentum to go flying through the air. The gems of domestic POKENAME glow different colors based on their Trainer's mood.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It dislikes battling for sport or friendly competition, so it doesn't get along with most Trainers. When it must fight, it uses hit-and-run strategies, quickly slicing through foes and just as swiftly getting away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are very competitive, often sparring with one another to see who's the strongest. They hone their strength by channeling their aura in powerful strikes that can shatter stone in a single blow.
author: mistymagius

entry: If POKENAME sees a malicious aura, its horn glows red. During this state, its venom doubles in potency and releases a terrible rotting stench.
author: .izik

entry: It makes its nest outside of small villages, hoping for pies to be left on windowsills. It prefers Pecha Berry pies due to their sweetness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are largely immobile and seclude themselves in high trees in order to keep themselves safe until they're ready to evolve. They spend their days observing other Pokémon fighting, memorising their moves in preparation to fight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME use the power of aura to communicate with one another, allowing them to work in perfect sync. While still being quite territorial, POKENAME will actually offer some of their honey to starving Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME senses a kind aura, it releases a soft floral scent. This reaction is most common when near gentle Trainers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are always on high alert as they are able to sense the presence of other Pokémon and what their intentions might be. If they detect hostility, flocks of them will show up and chase the threat away.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME train day and night against larger foes to become stronger and gather berries when they are not training. Before fighting against another Pokémon, they always keep a Liechi Berry with them that boosts their strength when needed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME only needs 2 hours of rest a day, so it spends most of the day patrolling its nest. It can sense the feelings of other POKENAME and will rush over to aid them if they are ever in peril.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME travels around in search of small discarded electronics. Once it finds them, it attempts to charge them with a bolt of electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have almost boundless amounts of energy and will cheerfully play with each other for days on end. It's surprisingly strong for its size, able to lift over 500 pounds with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are quite hyperactive, always wanting to play fight with their Trainer or any wild Pokémon. Unfortunately due to their shell, they often topple over after attempting any strike.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are sensitive to the feelings of others, as they can sense their very auras with ease. The wool is said to be able to change color based on the emotions of the auras they are most often exposed to.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME protects itself using its aura, projecting power around itself or simply avoiding those it senses. Its wool is rather tough to work with for the average spinner, so it is only entrusted to those who demonstrate proficiency in the craft.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to others' emotions, so the flower on its head has adapted to emit a smell that dampens anxiety. It approaches overwhelmed people to calm them, easing its own burden.
author: .realthree

entry: While scavenging trash, POKENAME uses aura to detect approaching threats. It escapes easily while making a squeaking noise.
author: .izik

entry: With a dual personality and keen senses, POKENAME roams the savannah with boundless energy. It has a fake and a real aura to trick predators.
author: anarchaz

entry: If POKENAME detects malicious intent with its aura reading skills, it drops from tree branches and explodes. It sacrifices itself to protect its kin.
author: .izik

entry: Groups of POKENAME arrive after major disasters, saving as many Pokémon as they can. Their powerful horn can lift objects ten times its size, allowing them to move large pieces of debris.
author: mistymagius

entry: If POKENAME detects a malicious aura, it barks loudly to alert its pack. The warning gives others time to prepare for danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is commonly kept in houses for protection. It senses the aura of those around it to discern their intentions, so it can easily find and take down any would-be thieves.
author: .realthree

entry: Using its aura sense, POKENAME rolls through pitch-black caves. It deftly avoids obstacles with precise, instinctual movement.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's antlers glow a sapphire blue when scanning nearby auras. If it detects a hunter's intent, it retaliates with a Quick Attack.
author: .izik

entry: Constantly honing its control over aura powers has given it a new technique: POKENAME can fire short range aura projectiles at its foes following a punch or kick attack.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains daily at keeping in constant motion during fights, using its Aura to sense the position of the opponent and seeking the best time to strike. After an intense training session, it loves to snack on Sitrus Berries to regain its energy.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is always pumped up for battle, producing bright blue lightning from its cheeks when excited. Its electrical powers become stronger and wilder the closer it is to fainting.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME trains hard, developing a personal fighting style that utilizes its tails in tandem with its fists. When it fights at full force, one can see a faint aura glowing around the tips of its two tails.
author: sk372

entry: With its aura-sensing ability, POKENAME protects weaker Pokémon. If danger approaches, it defends them with a powerful Rock Smash.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses aura to locate the perfect fruit tree. Once satisfied, it can eat over 100 lbs of food in a single sitting.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME's hooked claws are wickedly sharp, it prefers to use the blunt outsides to strike foes with. Using its perception of aura, POKENAME senses the strength of its opponent so it can choose battles it knows it will win.
author: .realthree

entry: While digging, POKENAME uses its aura to sense danger ahead. It marks unsafe tunnels by placing warning stones along the wall.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide deep in the jungle, but they may approach a wounded human in order to help them. Before they evolve, they learn how to hunt and avoid predators by mimicking their own kind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME imbues its flaming kicks with aura and practices complex combinations of moves every day. It is an excellent sparring partner for martial artists.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: The fin upon its head is a sensory organ that can detect the auras of others within at least a one-mile radius. It can stand on its hind legs and harness its own aura with its forelegs; by harnessing its aura, it can manipulate water near itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's legs can't carry it very quickly, but it has tireless energy. It can keep jogging through muddy riversides long after the predators chasing it have tired.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME hides away from others until it has properly read their emotional aura. Only those who have a kind and gentle aura will ever be approached by a meek creature like POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to sense and understand the emotions of others. If it detects hostility, it will prepare to release a horrible toxin from its horn.
author: alumed

entry: It can sense the auras of others and may even experience shifts in its bodily hues if exposed to powerful emotions for long enough. Cautious by nature, POKENAME always observes others before acting, even if it senses a kind soul.
author: infinex21

entry: It calculates fighting strategies that will work on different opponents, but since it lacks arms and flexibility, its main strategy is usually ramming into its opponent with reckless abandon.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME refine their aura sensing abilities by sparring with their eyes closed and ears flattened against their head, removing all other sensory input. This lets them gradually master the ability to sense and react to even trace amounts of aura.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its giant jaws came to be when one of its sensory horns transformed; like its other horn, these jaws detect auras. Its jaws react to new auras, snapping at those it feels may be a threat; though its jaws react this way, POKENAME is friendly.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME trains among rugged mountain peaks, focusing its aura into fiery weapons. It eagerly challenges local Geodude to test its strength. When wounded, its tail becomes engulfed in a blazing aura as its attacks grow even fiercer.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: With its large, developed ears and the ability to detect the aura of others, it is nearly impossible to avoid detection by a POKENAME. It will attack at the first sign of danger.
author: alumed

entry: POKENAME focuses much of its aura into the fire on its tail, causing it to burn hotter and brighter. While holding its tail like a weapon, firing multiple Aura Spheres until the flame is nearly spent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their aura sensing capabilities to find ideal locations for hunting. While using their abilities, POKENAME's ears will begin to twitch and shake.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME senses auras by waving its fins through the air. Should it detect a depressing aura, it begins to cry uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are used to break ice blocks to ensure safe travels for ships. Should they notice their Trainer feeling distressed, they will embrace them tightly in their fur.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It can sense the auras of others and will point toward those it senses to be in distress. By utilizing its magnetism, it can propel itself in short bursts; its Tackle attacks tend to be strong enough to shatter large rocks.
author: infinex21

entry: Its blade glows with a peculiar blue luminescence when it senses the aura of other creatures. POKENAME usually haunts places where fierce battles were fought in the past.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's feelers move constantly to sense the auras of those nearby. It appears naturally drawn to those carrying depressing auras.
author: .izik

entry: Using aura sensing, POKENAME searches for discarded plushies. It detects the lingering aura of the children who once loved them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME traps those with weak auras in sticky webs. It then shocks them repeatedly before dragging them back to its den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME contain unstable rogue mega energy, theorised to only be manageable thanks to being a fusion of two Riolu. They burn this energy off by constantly training and sparring with one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME contain unstable rogue mega energy, theorised to only be manageable thanks to being a fusion of two Riolu. They burn this energy off by constantly training and sparring with one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME alternate between periods of tireless energy and periods of near-total stillness, seemingly at random. Researchers are baffled by these two extremes.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: Though naturally energetic, POKENAME's vigor triples when it detects the aura of a challenger. It strikes fast with sharpened claws.
author: .izik

entry: Curious by nature, POKENAME sense their surroundings to try and find the auras of friendly people and Pokémon. If a POKENAME detects someone with a violent aura, it will roll up and smack them until they go away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: If POKENAME senses a hostile aura, it releases a burst of electricity. This stuns the foe long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: Powerful aura courses through POKENAME's retractable claws. If POKENAME lands a hit, its foes will find themselves overcome by emotion.
author: .realthree

entry: It seeks out powerful Pokémon, and swiftly defeats them. These Pokémon are often ill-willed, so some view POKENAME as a guardian angel.
author: theemeraldflygon

entry: POKENAME consume large amounts of metal to fuel the aura stored in their body. These Pokémon fight only using headbutts, releasing their built-up aura upon impact.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's gear limbs give it decent mobility across all terrains. If it focuses hard enough, it can charge up aura around the gears and enhance its speed and agility.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME studies the aura of nearby humans to copy them. It creates illusions to blend into crowded city streets unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's aura burns on its tail like a hot flame. As the duel heats up, the glow intensifies, manifesting its burning desire to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME senses a terrifying aura, it releases a disgusting, garbage-like scent from its bud. This is to drive the source of the aura away as quickly as possible.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gains the ability to read auras when it points its buds at someone. Should it detect a malevolent aura, it releases bursts of poisonous pollen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emanates an aura that displays its feelings. When nearby people feel its happiness, they call their children close.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Surprisingly enough, POKENAME can deliver powerful kicks from its stubby little legs. Its spores make anyone who breathes them in feel intense emotion.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time looking for strong opponents to fight, their aura glowing brighter the more intense the battle. They are mainly active at night, illuminating the area with an energetic blue glow.
author: mistymagius

entry: Because it was once human, it has a better understanding of people's emotions. It weeps ceaseless tears of compassion for those suffering around it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is able to navigate the darkest of caves using its aura. It is a very kind Pokémon as it has been seen leading lost hikers out of the mountains.
author: mistymagius

entry: If you step on POKENAME, it reads your aura. If it senses you did it on purpose, it unleashes a painful electric shock.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotional auras of other Pokémon. It uses this ability to hunt colonies of happy Carbink.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME gets distracted by movement and often cheers facing away from the action. Though poor at cheering, it is excellent at chasing runaway balls.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The gems on POKENAME's hands are highly prized by collectors. It only gives them away by choice, offering one to those it sees as a true friend.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's plushy body protects it from heavy punches. However, it isn't aware that others don't share its defenses, and punches when excited.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME appears in cold steppes that are rich in metallic minerals. Though motionless during the day, it is a dangerous predator at night.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are receptacles for aura energy. They glow intensely when POKENAME uses an aura attack.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME becomes upset whenever there is a disparity between the treatment it receives and the treatment other Pokémon receive. This strong sense of justice makes it difficult to raise for people who pick favorites.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME is rarely a social Pokémon. Its sensitivity to others' emotions means that it typically prefers the sole company of its Trainer.
author: .realthree

entry: The veil that surrounds POKENAME brightens and dims as it senses the emotional aura of those close to it. It hides away if it senses anyone with malice in their hearts.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's fur is so sensitive it is able to detect the changes in people emotions. Because of this, it is in a constant state of anxiety and panic.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is both powerful and agile, and can emit an aura to let others know how it feels. It prefers trainers who are pure of heart.
author: torterrable

entry: When sensing a positive aura from someone it trusts, POKENAME emits a sweet, cupcake-like scent as a sign of affection. The fur covering its body is light and fluffy like cotton candy.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME launches one of its powerful headbutts, it concentrates its aura in its head to protect itself from the recoil. An undisciplined POKENAME may hurt itself while battling.
author: .realthree
