entry: POKENAME regulates its body temperature through the flame on its head. If there is no extra nutrition to maintain its flame for extended periods of time, POKENAME is likely to fall ill.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME are made of a flammable gel that instantly ignites when separated from the main body. This high reactivity makes studying POKENAME nearly impossible.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By using its flames, POKENAME melts sand to create dens made of glass. These shimmering dens serve as both glittering shelters for this Pokémon and also befuddling traps for unsuspecting prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can heat gas within its flexible body. When faced with a threat, it can blow out dozens of liters of gas at over 200°C in one breath to burn its enemies.
author: oreee0230

entry: Though its wings are strong, it struggles to stay aloft for long, often tumbling in bursts of flame. It clings to rocky ceilings to rest, leaving scorch marks in perfect circles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME often struggles to eat, as the flaming mask on its tail turns much of the food it scavenges into ash instead. If it does eat, the flame burns intensely and displays a medley of bright colors.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME lurk atop larger Pokémon, surviving on their body heat and skin flakes. It prefers Fire-type Pokémon because other Pokémon tend to notice its fire.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME lurk atop larger Pokémon, surviving on their body heat and skin flakes. It prefers Fire-type Pokémon because other Pokémon tend to notice its fire.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's fiery tusks change in size depending on its emotions. Regardless of how it is feeling, if it does not receive a balanced diet of berries and ore, the flames will extinguish.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's fiery tusks change in size depending on its emotions. Regardless of how it is feeling, if it does not receive a balanced diet of berries and ore, the flames will extinguish.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is overconfident in its abilities in battle because its armored crest has extended down its back. The tusks are beginning to harden under the flames, so if its diet is disrupted, the tusks may insufficiently grow before evolution.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's tail is extremely warm to the touch, and heats up if excited or frightened. It communicates with others of its kind by tapping tails together in a series of patterns.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shoot down other bird Pokémon with fireballs to prey upon them or to simply remove them from their territories. Their tail flames scatter small sparks when they are excited but spit small fireballs about when agitated.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are incredible Bug-type hunters that sear their prey with flaming drool from their gaping maw. They help keep wild populations of Caterpie and Weedle under control.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME moves through the cracks in rocks in dry areas. It is very light, and relies on fire to hunt prey that is almost the same size as it.
author: oreee0230

entry: Mischievous in nature, POKENAME love to play pranks on other Pokémon, usually by startling them. If it does not eat enough jewels, the fire on its tail will grow dim and weak.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can fire short but powerful bursts of flame from its mouth. A popular franchise of shows and merchandise uses POKENAME as its main mascot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell due to the large nasal cavities in their skulls, allowing them to pick up scents from long distances. They hunt small Flying-type Pokémon by ambushing them with fire, roasting their feathers before they fly away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME frequently becomes confused about whether to breathe flames or snow, often switching between the two. This unpredictable nature makes it difficult for opponents to anticipate this Pokémon's attacks.
author: .izik

entry: Pokémon researchers have observed POKENAME moving across their glacial homes in huddled groups of four or more. The current theory is that they do so to protect their flames from abrupt gusts of wind or blizzards, letting them stay warm as a group.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME relies on its brightly colored leaves to signal to predators that it is poisonous. It releases toxic spores that make it sneeze out embers, which in turn causes it to release more spores.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are quite mischievous, often starting fires in trash dumps. They do so to feed off the toxic fumes these flames produce.
author: santon5512

entry: In the scorched wake of forest fires, POKENAME will drift along the razed forest floor, snuffing out remaining small fires and embers by feeding on the heat. Places where disastrous fires have swept through regrow much faster thanks to their efforts.
author: vic1312

entry: During long droughts, the POKENAME population thrives. It gains nutrients by absorbing the spiritual energy of decomposing vegetation.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME gather berries before drizzling them with flammable honey. They then wave their flaming leaves over the berries to roast them for a delectable meal.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The flower of flame that burns atop POKENAME's head isn't very hot. However, the large stem in the middle can project flaming-hot noxious toxins.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME are coated with a flame retardant that protects their body from their flaming tail. Unfortunately for many parents, cleaning POKENAME can be quite difficult because they cannot get wet without getting hurt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leaps effortlessly from cliffsides, spinning mid-air while spitting flames. These fiery displays are meant to impress others and assert dominance.
author: .izik

entry: Its spines radiate heat, scorching anything that touches them. These fiery spines make it difficult for predators to approach without getting burned.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fuels the fire burning inside its body by eating tumbleweeds, sticks, and other flammable materials. It radiates heat during cold desert nights.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME actively collects wood to maintain its body temperature and produce charcoal. It can manipulate charcoal powder to hunt.
author: oreee0230

entry: The flames of POKENAME actually purify the air, because most of the foul-smelling gases are burned up. If the flame goes out and is not relit in time, the odor emitted by POKENAME will erupt into flames instead.
author: oreee0230

entry: The mushrooms that latch onto POKENAME's back have their parasitic properties under control due to the flames that emit from them. It uses its spores in combination with fiery attacks as a powerful method of obtaining nutrients.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Wild POKENAME are hard to come across, but when seen in the wild, they are always roughhousing with one another. As Trainer-kept Pokémon, POKENAME are quite friendly and fiercely loyal to their owners.
author: itsthenewisaiah

entry: POKENAME are naturally rebellious creatures that pull pranks on their Trainer whenever they are upset. They are particularly fond of setting fire to their Trainer's clothes, but they stop when their Trainer is in serious pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in the harshest environments to reduce competition. The fungi that coexist with POKENAME help improve its digestion, while its flames repel competing species.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's skin is smooth, which helps it slip through narrow gaps. POKENAME uses high temperatures to help digest the garbage it eats.
author: oreee0230

entry: The flame on POKENAME's tail burns brighter if they feel strong emotions. Newborn POKENAME often accidentally burn their quills when they get too happy.
author: st4rdustyugure

entry: Even if the flame on its tail goes out, POKENAME won't die until the flame inside its shell also goes out. It can also stick its tail through an opening of its shell to reignite either flame that went out.
author: soup1900

entry: The scales on POKENAME's wings contain heat-resistant toxins. When the scales are scattered over an enemy, the high temperature first burns the skin, allowing the toxin to enter the body more easily.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME wear flame resistant pants that can endure the fiery flames on their body. Their naivety is easy to exploit by a cunning opponent, who may snag them by the pants to pin them down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Benefiting from its lightweight hollow body, POKENAME can shoot flames to move and turn quickly. It can convert airborne dust into combustible gas and feed on it.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's flame powers have grown massively, to the point the fire has begun to surface on its back as well. It has become more battle-hungry, as it serves as a good way to vent out the excessive flames it produces.
author: sk372

entry: Its flames have now become ultra hot. No amount of water can put out the flame on its tail.
author: soup1900

entry: It has taken on a darker appearance, and flames come out of its mouth. Kalos experts claim it has similarities with Mega Charizard X.
author: soup1900

entry: It is a pretty calm Pokémon and won't viciously attack unless absolutely necessary. It becomes slightly afraid when facing tough opponents.
author: soup1900

entry: The ground around POKENAME heats up the longer it stays still. To prevent wildfires, it constantly relocates to cooler soil.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME encounters a couple who breaks up, it gets depressed, and its tiny flame shrinks in size. Trainers must be wary about the emotions they show and make sure they share plenty of love with others to keep this Pokémon happy.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME makes high-speed turns, its tail leaves a unique scorch mark on the ground. It is interested in all kinds of hot objects, so it runs around large mechanical structures in towns to absorb heat.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME uses the flame on its tail to burn tree bark and then drinks the sap from the cracks in the bark. The Pokémon tends to live in humid areas to avoid causing forest fires while scavenging for its food.
author: oreee0230

entry: Poachers once hunted POKENAME for its spines, as they remain lit long after being cut from the body. These spines are made primarily of hardened silk and a condensed gel that serves as fuel to keep the flame lit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The soil around POKENAME heats up as it digs. To avoid causing wildfires, it carefully keeps distance from tree roots.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME commonly like to rest in the shade of tall trees, which makes them the accidental cause of many forest fires. If the leaf on POKENAME's head ever stops burning, it becomes unable to use any of its Fire-type attacks.
author: ruben2309295

entry: Beloved by Poké Ball makers, POKENAME can easily open Apricorns with its claws, and use its fire to accelerate the Poké Ball creation process. When in the wild, they live off of Apricorns.
author: kasai_kitsune

entry: POKENAME loves hot things. Trainers are recommended to purchase a heated rock so that it always has a cosy place to rest.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Despite its gentle-looking face, POKENAME is a patient hunter, able to remain hidden for hours before striking with sharp claws. When sick or weak, the flame on its tail flickers and fades.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's flamelit tail leaves trails of fallen ash wherever it travels, triggering symptoms similar to a pollen allergy. It creates clouds composed of this ash to disorient foes.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is in the paradoxical position of needing and fearing water. Its tail wicks moisture from the rest of its body, which causes headaches if dehydration is severe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a certain hatefulness for long, scaly Pokémon and always have their flaming claws ready to strike. If their target escapes into water, they become incredibly irate and lash out at everything around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are terrified of water because they fear extinguishing their tail flame, yet become so dehydrated that they develop headaches. The pain can grow so severe that they can only scream.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite having a flame that can remain lit underwater, POKENAME have an instinctual desire to keep the flame from getting wet. This leads them to swim much slower than they are capable of.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flame that burns around its head is an indicator of its health. Despite this, POKENAME enjoys rainy weather, and its flame burns brightly even as raindrops fall upon it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can conjure storms of ash and embers that drift like snowflakes. It fares well in extreme temperatures, whether hot or cold.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME have a vehement hatred of water that borders on irrational. Whenever a person takes a sip of water or comes near them with it, they become enraged and lash out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roost around craggy cliffs. They aggressively attack any traveler that passes by, but they're rarely a danger to any but the most inexperienced of Trainers.
author: .realthree

entry: Without warning, POKENAME can erupt into a violent fit, thrashing at anything that comes near, including its Trainer. When calmed down, its flaming fur dies down to a smolder, leaving POKENAME extremely weakened while it rests.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are loyal Pokémon that will do anything its Trainer asks it to. This also makes them subject to neglect, as some Trainers forget to bring them inside when it is rainy or windy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though large in size and boisterous in ego, its battling capabilities are middling at best. Its vanity simmers as it nears evolution.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME waddles near puddles, ponds, and lakes to find berries to eat. It loves to spew embers to char the berries before eating them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are witty creatures that rely on their teleportation skills to avoid wet places. Whenever it rains, POKENAME teleport inside caves to avoid their flaming tail from being extinguished.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its fiery spirit makes it train constantly to hone its muscles. As it grows in strength, the flame on its tail burns more intensely.
author: sk372

entry: Even though POKENAME have small bodies, their fiery punches can blast holes into trees. The only thing holding them back is their lack of stamina, as it only takes a few punches before POKENAME get tired.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its appearance of being engulfed in fire is its natural state, the flames on its body providing a potent deterrent to predators. Dousing the flame will not harm it, but will leave it weak and defenseless.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can temporarily extinguish the flame on its tail to swim. To find a POKENAME, look for streams with unusually warm water.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME rarely fights, usually only to defend itself from predators. When it feels threatened, it sets its own tentacles ablaze to scorch its foes and spits a slimy poisonous acid from its mouth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Many POKENAME forge hammers alongside blacksmiths, as they heat and reheat steel to form the hammerhead. Their fists strike one side of the hammerhead to flatten the steel into shape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME assemble garden shears inside factories, heating blades before dousing them in oil. They then join the two blades together, creating a valuable tool for gardening.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a valuable asset for blacksmiths, as its control over fire allows it to mold steel into whatever shape is needed. Its large fists can also strike steel in lieu of a hammer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trots in fields of grass alongside pack members. It sneezes out embers on occasion, which it stamps out to prevent wildfires.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME canters alongside its pack to stay safe. When confronted with a threat, it launches a kick with its flaming hooves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often forgets the flame on its tail is a part of itself. Running from its own tail or accidentally burning itself with it are common occurrences.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cannot stay in water like most Water-type Pokémon; it needs to actively supply oxygen to its tail to maintain the flame underwater. POKENAME can blow bubbles containing flammable gas, which explode when they burst.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME will tuck themselves into their shell, using the flame from their tail to stay warm as they sleep. Attempting to disturb a sleeping POKENAME will cause them to release fire from the holes in their shell.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: With its tail aflame, it channels psychic power. Once serene, now it battles with fiery determination.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME thrives near lava pools, absorbing intense heat into its body. The hotter it becomes, the stronger and more erratic its Thundershock attack grows.
author: .izik

entry: Analysis of internal organs reveals each of POKENAME's parts could function independently if they were separated. However, they are considered different from Charmite, and are stronger together than apart.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME waves its fiery baton to appear menacing. It loses its composure when around water because it is scared of the fire being put out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While usually not visible, it has tiny arms beneath its orange feathers. At night you can identify POKENAME running through the fields by their glow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has small orange feathers that litter the landscape as it runs. These feathers stay surprisingly cool regardless of how hot its body gets.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME frequently eats floating ice chunks to cool its intensely hot body. Without this, it risks overheating and becoming sluggish.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is made of non-flammable sludge. It collects fuel from garbage bins to maintain the flames needed for survival, while using non-combustible materials to increase its size.
author: oreee0230

entry: When POKENAME consumes too many combustible materials, its flames become hot enough to melt its body. Until the temperature returns to normal, POKENAME can only move slowly.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME expels flames from the cannons on its shell. It can shoot small fireballs that travel for a distance of 10 feet before they explode.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME shoots steam from its cannons. However, the steam doesn't burn much, and at most it'll sting for a while.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME spreads oil on its tongue and ignites it when hunting. Because it hunts with fire, POKENAME almost exclusively eats cooked food.
author: oreee0230

entry: When threatened, POKENAME fires large bursts of flames at its attacker. If it keeps its shell closed for too long, the shell will become hot enough to boil the surrounding water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's eerie appearance frightens those who come across it. However, there have been accounts from mountaineers claiming that POKENAME helped guide them away from dangerous paths when visibility was low.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME pranks those it haunts by touching their shoulders with its burning hands, warming the victim to the point of profusely sweating. Just the threat of being sprayed with water is enough to send it fleeing in terror.
author: sk372

entry: Friendly by nature, POKENAME often approaches travelers resting inside caves and offers them its large body for both warmth and protection. It even offers its tail-flame to use for cooking food, as long as it gets a small share.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME breathes out hypnotic flames that swirl in various patterns. People claim to have visions while staring at its flames, though concrete evidence for this is lacking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each of POKENAME's claws can produce short bursts of flame. It uses these flames to cook captured prey and for territorial disputes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can inflate the seed on its back until it grows as large as a balloon, allowing it to float for long periods and travel great distances on wind currents. When agitated, it releases poisonous spores to keep others away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The Moon Stone used for evolution gave POKENAME a significant boost in power. It defends its Trainer with incredible speed.
author: smashbear

entry: If others fall asleep while it is singing, POKENAME grows furious. In its frustration, it may self-destruct, blasting everything around it with a powerful explosion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sing into their boney club to amplify their voice. Many Pokémon dream of their families after a soft, hushed lullaby from POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will fling a club at someone who falls asleep during its song, doing so with high speed. This sudden action is a playful yet surprising way to wake its target up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME undulates its tongue by sucking in large amounts of air and bellowing at a subsonic frequency. The purpose of this peculiar behavior is a topic of much speculation.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME's gas functions as a mild sedative, causing those who breathe it to become drowsy and unresponsive. Hospitals make use of POKENAME's gas to synthesise powerful anaesthetics for surgeries.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Late at night, a POKENAME groans as if it is an elderly woman in pain. Should a person assist, it will consume them, storing energy for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's gas is a strong sedative, even knocking out humans and large Pokémon with only a few puffs. This tends to frustrate POKENAME, who seek to make friends.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME spins the drill on its nose while singing, creating an oddly rhythmic pattern as it moves. This combination of song and drill serves to both entertain and intimidate in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes care of young Pokémon, singing them to sleep when they are scared. Its soft, fluffy body provides comfort to those seeking warmth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shelters small, defenseless Pokémon in its pouch, even if they aren't its own offspring. To ward off wild Pokémon, it puffs itself up by holding its breath, making itself look much larger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are known for their boundless energy and curious nature. Though apples are considered their favorite food, they only choose to consume fruit they deem as perfect.
author: mepp.

entry: Due to its luxurious look, it's often employed as a singer and dancer, but no reviews exist of its performance. It's popular among insomniacs.
author: houndrys.

entry: Trainers who were shocked by POKENAME's electricity report hearing music while they were nearly electrocuted.  The sound has often been compared to an electric guitar.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME's lung capacity lets it breathe out vast quantities of fire in a single breath. At times it even manages to sing as it does so, creating an inferno of music cascading in front of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a love for metal music, thrashing their heads around while screaming at the top of their lungs. Groups of POKENAME will even create entire concerts out in the middle of the forest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are often kept in private ponds both for their beauty and lovely singing voice. These songs are known to attract other Magikarp fusions, making them useful companions for researchers as well.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a popular companion for budding artists and artisans, letting others mold its malleable body into a shape before it transforms into the object proper, allowing the artist to see how accurate their molding was.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known for being extremely playful and friendly. It can jump to a height of over 7 feet.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME love nothing more than to be pillows for people to sleep against. It's said there is no more pleasant a sleep than one experienced while being cradled by a POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its might, POKENAME is far from malevolent. It is a kind and cheeky Pokémon, often nabbing an unguarded hat from a passersby to play with.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME enjoys resting in the grass or sand and sunbathing for long periods of time. It will also rest like this while awaiting a loving head pat.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME enjoys resting in the grass or sand and sunbathing for long periods of time. It will also rest like this while awaiting a loving head pat.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Despite its might, POKENAME is far from malevolent. It is a kind and cheeky Pokémon, often nabbing an unguarded hat from a passersby to play with.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Beloved for its soft body and luxurious fur, POKENAME has been seen draped around the necks of famous stars at high-profile events. Due to this, owning a POKENAME is seen as something of a status symbol.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large eyes give it strong eyesight, even in the darkness of night. It watches over young birds leaving the nest, catching them against its soft body should they fall while learning to fly.
author: sk372

entry: During full moons, it mimics human speech to lure people out of their homes at night. Those who venture out are never seen again.
author: .izik

entry: Using the microphones attached to its antenna, POKENAME will sing a beautiful melody deep beneath the ocean. This song has an alluring effect on those who hear it, drawing them deeper and deeper underwater.
author: santon5512

entry: The long ears of POKENAME are said to pick up sounds from other dimensions. When their ears begin to twitch rhythmically, they let out a call, facing the sky as if they are responding to something.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME wool is said to be as soft as a cloud, while its body is able to expand into the perfect pillow. Because of this, Trainers can't help but rest alongside it and drift asleep.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME can expand to twice their size to reach berries in trees nearby. By giving them a Pecha Berry, they can cure the poison they get whenever they bump into Beedrill stinger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hides within the walls of homes, singing throughout the night. While many people find this singing to be a nuisance, some say it helps them fall asleep.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME spend much of their time absorbing sunlight and moonlight. Once they are full of energy, they sing sweet lullabies that put Pokémon around them to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Right after evolution, POKENAME is bald. It excretes a film from its skin that stimulates hair growth, growing to its full length of about 10cm in a single day. Researchers are studying them for the potential in human hair growth.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Should someone attempt to walk away mid-performance, POKENAME will pin them down with psychic energy. It refuses to let an audience leave until the song is finished.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides within the walls of homes, singing throughout the night. While many people find this singing to be a nuisance, some say it helps them fall asleep.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME sings for hours on end in pure bliss after eating cheese. Its soothing voice echoes in the air, filling the area with a calming melody that can have a peaceful effect on nearby Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: Some stores in Kanto have made confections based on POKENAME to try to compete with the vaunted Casteliacone, to little success.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: It tries to be intimidating, but its pincers are too soft and squishy to hurt opponents that much. This frustrates POKENAME to no end.
author: fountainihili

entry: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.
author: kinsgs

entry: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.
author: kinsgs

entry: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.
author: kinsgs

entry: POKENAME charms foes with its jovial demeanor before striking with unexpected force. It is both a beloved companion and a formidable guardian.
author: anarchaz

entry: By sucking in air, POKENAME can expand up to five times their original size, becoming almost like a balloon. Large spikes jut out from their bodies, protecting them as they slowly float away from danger.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's body is soft yet firm, able to withstand a large amount of punishment without flinching. It grabs foes with its pincers and holds on tightly, letting them struggle and strike until they're too exhausted to continue fighting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME take great joy in singing in front of large audiences while performing tricks. One of the tricks they can perform while on stage revolves around popping glitter filled bubbles with their sharp claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bubble and puff up when they get too hot, as their internal anatomy constantly produces superhot gas. They can be trained to release this hot air slowly and are popular companions in colder regions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tourmaline gems are prized for their deep green colour, with many collectors seeking to polish them further to enhance their lustre. The gem grows throughout their life, requiring POKENAME to be fed a steady diet of silica-rich foods.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sings while soaring over meadows, hoping to invigorate grazing Pokémon with its melody. However, its soothing voice inevitably lulls them into an unintended slumber.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a popular housepet for its small size and extremely soft fur. A running wheel and a garden to dig in are recommended for this Pokémon.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: This Pokémon is often sought after for its fur alone, which is unbelievably soft and often used for luxury pillows and duvets.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME guides schools of small aquatic Pokémon through the sea with soothing soundwaves. It occasionally rises to the water's surface to take in oxygen through its gills.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME can remove pollen and smoke from the air by sucking them in through their trunk, causing their stomachs to expand until they can release the air outside. Many people with asthma have a POKENAME handy to help them breathe better.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trumpets a cheerful tune from its trunk that can soothe even the most furious Pokémon. Unfortunately, it often puts its own allies to sleep in the process.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME emit 2D images that they can manipulate to show a variety of different visuals. POKENAME can accompany these images with singing to put on one-man concerts or even confuse nearby predators.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME were nearly hunted to extinction in the wild due to the value of their antlers and fur. Pokémon Rangers and conservationists have largely restored wild populations. Humane POKENAME farming has largely supplanted illegal poaching.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME prides itself on its artistic and musical talents. It sings happily as it draws, sometimes pretending its own tail is a microphone.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME's fur is beloved among royalty for being very soft and supple. If not properly attended to, POKENAME will become angry, inflating its body and striking with its pointed ears like a top.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME drive off predators by staring. If its unblinking, unflinching expression isn't enough, a sudden ear-piercing screech does the job.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME is highly protective of eggs and young Pokémon. It can inflate itself to the size of an elephant to ward off attackers.
author: serversizeme

entry: POKENAME prances about the wild, though it flees from large groups due to its shy nature. It can inflate its body slightly, the act of which causes its luxurious mane to grow and emit colorful sparks and bolts of lightning.
author: sk372

entry: Its huge, strong hands allow POKENAME to give some of the best massages in the world. It does so for free, as a relaxed customer's sigh of relief is reward enough.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME loves to perform songs to delight the Pokémon it has befriended. When it receives praise for its singing, it becomes so happy that the electricity stored in its body makes it shine like a lightbulb.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are capable of producing signals that turn off electronics around them. By modifying the strength of the signal, they can cause other Steel-type Pokémon to fall asleep too.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its stretchy tongue is covered in microscopic hooks that help it clean its luscious fur. Getting licked by POKENAME can scrape skin off.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: This strong Pokémon's body is hard as granite. Missing physical affection, it covers itself in pillows and soft fabrics to appear more huggable.
author: sontyp

entry: Flying quickly across the lands, POKENAME appears above places of strife, singing a pleasant tune. Those who hear its song find their negative feelings slipping away, replaced with an urge to sleep and have pleasant dreams.
author: sk372

entry: It can only drink the purest water; otherwise, its luxurious pink coat might get ruined. It is said that if someone helps POKENAME, it will thank them by giving them one of its wonderfully fragrant flowers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its sensitive tuft of hair to sense updrafts to aid in gliding with its cape-like wing. If it sees a weak Pokémon in danger, it dives to the rescue and attacks the aggressor with its puffy claws.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Often considered one of the most demanding Pokémon, POKENAME's luxurious fur must be brushed four hours a day. Those Trainers who pamper them are rewarded with an overprotective companion that protects them by puffing up their pollen-soft hair.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME loves to sing and does so in confidence when there are no observers. When others are in its presence and ask it to sing, POKENAME becomes scared of failing and tears up before running away back to its nest.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day plowing fields to make room for the next round of crops. It can be heard singing songs to help itself keep a steady rhythm when plowing fields.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's eyes are protected by a transparent watery lining, allowing it to fight without blinking. While its fur feels soft to the touch, its powerful legs can deliver devastating kicks.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Proud of their fine fur, POKENAME are very selective of the people who can feel their bodies. If someone touches a POKENAME without permission, these Pokémon will retaliate with a powerful kick without hesitation to knock the individual away.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Although it can't see past the luxurious locks of fur atop its head, it uses its psychic power to remain aware of its surroundings. If it senses that a person is friendly, it will request that the fur on its head be tousled.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME performs intricate dances while singing on the battlefield. It moves gracefully to its own rhythm, creating an almost mesmerizing aura that can confuse or entertain its foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen lovingly chasing Pokémon like Lucaslash. It wields a giant red and yellow hammer as a weapon.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen lovingly accompanying Pokémon like Lucaslash. It wields a giant red and yellow hammer as a weapon.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: POKENAME work together in small family groups to gnaw down trees with which to make family dams. They have rubbery bodies that help to protect them from harm should one of the falling trees accidentally fall on top of them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The back head loves to sing, even though its singing is so bad not even the main head can stand it. Due to the constant singing, the main head's hearing gets worse as it gets older.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spend their days lazing around and casually eating fruit from bushes and trees. When roused to fight they are terrifyingly strong, inflating their chest and bellowing loud enough to be heard from miles away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Although spooky at first, POKENAME is a very friendly Pokémon! It leads lost children out of the forests it calls home. Those who dare threaten it or the children it guides will be met with an ear-splitting wail.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: The musically-inclined POKENAME is especially adept at playing the piano. Its disembodied hands dance across the keyboard flawlessly, and it memorizes sheet music in only a few minutes.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.
author: cristata

entry: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.
author: cristata

entry: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME typically dwell high in the mountains, maintaining large territories across the peaks of their homes. They signal to Wigglyking and rival POKENAME with loud, echoing songs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can calm people and Pokémon just by brushing them with their ribbon's soft fur. It can also inflate their blade to a ridiculous size.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's shield is made out of a cluster of poofy, highly elastic hair. Most attacks bounce right off.
author: regulavish

entry: POKENAME can spin their shields like a record disc, creating music for both fun and to fight enemies. While they can play various genres, they prefer Electronic Dance Music.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME has a massive flair for showmanship regarding battles. Almost every strike it makes is preceded by and followed up with dramatic poses and loud battle cries.
author: sk372

entry: Its shimmering scales reflect light like precious jewels. Gentle and graceful, it cradles its young in a watery embrace.
author: anarchaz

entry: Its incredible singing voice has the power to enthrall listeners, which allows it to amass giant crowds of loyal fans that will do anything for it. Its rage when a performance is disrupted can put even the most disgruntled diva to shame.
author: elfail0

entry: Its rich, fluffy fur feels so good to touch that people find it difficult not to touch it. Cuddling POKENAME is used to help insomnia patients.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are generally peaceful Pokémon that sing lullabies to put other Pokémon to sleep. When they get angry, they lash out with their sharp claws and venomous horn, so Trainers try to avoid conflict around POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By inhaling deeply, POKENAME can inflate itself enough to gently float through the air. When it deflates, it creates soothing sounds or devastating screeches, depending on its mood.
author: sontyp

entry: Frustrated parents whose children won't go to bed at night are sometimes known to gift them a POKENAME. The games played on a POKENAME can put almost any insomniac to sleep within 30 minutes of starting.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME's fine, fluffy fur is wonderfully soft. However, since POKENAME can spin strands of the fur into an electrically charged web within moments, few ever get to touch it.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: People enjoy having a POKENAME around because of their soft, melon-colored fur and gentle voice. POKENAME sing lullabies to their Trainers before curling up and falling asleep as well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is known to many as the "Singing Comet" due to how fast it can fly, trailed by searing embers and bellowing beautiful melodies. It can expand much of its body by inhaling and then release the inhaled air to adjust its trajectory.
author: infinex21

entry: In the wild, one head will stay awake while the other sleeps. However. in the company of a trusted Trainer, both heads will sleep peacefully.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME is highly curious and social, shifting its form to try to adapt to different environments. Whenever it travels somewhere new, it makes sure to reassure any nearby Trainers that it comes in peace.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hyperactively jumps around, inflating so much it bounces off walls. It uses manic movement in battle, bouncing around the field swiping with its claws while its opponent struggles to keep up.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME can sing for several minutes due to their large lungs and inflatable body. Oftentimes, they end up putting themselves to sleep with their own song. Their fur is as soft as cashmere.
author: chibitales

entry: This Pokémon possesses luxurious fur and a soothingly hypnotic voice. Its appealing appearance allows it to lure in large audiences, which gives it the attention it craves and more food to steal.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME can sing for several minutes due to their large lungs and inflatable body. Oftentimes, they end up putting themselves to sleep with their own song. Their fur is as soft as cashmere.
author: chibitales

entry: The very presence of this Pokémon is enough to soothe and delight any individual. It is a whimsical Pokémon, often times floating amid pastel clouds or letting children bounce on its incredibly inflatable body.
author: violet_zero

entry: Fused POKENAME are able to wield their previously latent power in the form of colorful clouds, which can pacify and daze opponents. It is surprisingly durable and can withstand a full-force blow from even the most physically strong Pokémon.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME clings to humans and other Pokémon to absorb static electricity. Since its fur is luxuriously soft, many dream of being chosen by a POKENAME.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: By inhaling air, POKENAME can puff up their chests like balloons. They do this both to scare off predators and to make themselves look stronger to Trainers, hoping to be caught.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME feathers are considered a symbol of luxury and wealth due to how sublimely soft they are. Freshly shed feathers are so warm that they can melt snow due to how hot the flame sacs of these Pokémon typically get.
author: infinex21

entry: With its large mouth and elastic body, POKENAME can puff up before releasing extremely loud song-like cries. It's believed it may rival Exploud in reaching dangerously extreme decibel levels.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keep themselves inflated to ensure they have a good grip on whatever surface they roll on. Whenever they inhale too much air, they become overinflated and have a difficult time rolling with the low friction.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME flutter through snowy landscapes searching for people to sing their lullaby to. As they sing, they release a frosty breath to keep a captive audience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often found in Gym battles at the Ballonlea gym. They know numerous tricks and like to show off.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Though POKENAME looks soft and fluffy, petting it is a horrible idea. Its body is largely made of fiberglass insulation, and will leave anyone who touches it with a plethora of cuts.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sing to help themselves navigate, listening for echoes off their environment as they fly. Each POKENAME sings at a different pitch so that they can differentiate their own noises, with flocks of POKENAME creating a harmony.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have very elastic bodies and enjoy puffing up and bouncing off of one another. They are an unlikely companion for some Hikers, as their ability to rapidly inflate can be a lifesaver if a Hiker slips and falls down a mountainside.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses music and light to communicate emotions & thought. There is evidence that each color of light conveys a different emotion, but the theory has never been proven.
author: giggity._.

entry: POKENAME uses music and light to communicate emotions & thought. There is evidence that each color of light conveys a different emotion, but the theory has never been proven.
author: giggity._.

entry: POKENAME are made out of a special stretchy fabric that allows them to expand their bodies. Many can expand to the size of a sofa, making them the perfect size for Trainers to take an impromptu rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enters a fighting stance when someone falls asleep to its song, waiting patiently for them to wake up before delivering a powerful punch. It uses this tactic as a playful but strategic move during battles.
author: .izik

entry: This generous Pokémon loves sharing the perfect apples that grow on its back. New apples quickly grow back after the old ones are picked.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have a large chest cavity that expands whenever they take a breath in. When they exhale, they release a flurry of snow that chills whatever it touches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its vocal cords are fully operational. If you hear a baby crying while exploring a cave, think twice before following the sound.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fur is extremely soft and can make anyone feel happy just by touching it. If it finds someone feeling down, it has a tendency to nuzzle them until they feel better.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite how soft POKENAME's scales are, it is recommended not to pet them as they cause severe skin irritation on contact. Its wingbeats create an oddly soothing melody that has been recorded to help people fall asleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: The sorbet-like top of POKENAME emits a sweet pistachio scent. If that fails to lure prey, it unleashes a deep bellowing song that puts them to sleep instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ears are finely tuned to vibrations beneath the ground, alerting it to approaching predators. Digging through thick mud dulls its hearing considerably.
author: .izik

entry: While singing, POKENAME's rubbery body coils around foes. As they fall asleep, it slowly pulls them beneath the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are sometimes entered into Pokémon contests, their Trainers opting to dye the hair of their three heads in complementary colours. If their performance goes poorly, they sulk underground, hiding until they feel more confident in themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its meowing sounds are unique. This is because each POKENAME has its own pitch, height and tone length, which can vary greatly in some cases.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can puff up each of its body parts to many times their normal size. It is a popular circus attraction and especially popular with children.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME whiskers can pick up the faint vibrations of other POKENAME songs on the wind. They look skyward intently at night as they wait for these songs, replying with a loud yowling tune of their own.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME suck in air into their stomach so that they can sing for long periods of time. When they inhale and hold their breath, sometimes they forget to release the air and give themselves headaches from the lack of fresh air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even slight inconveniences cause POKENAME to literally swell with rage, inhaling and expanding its fluffy body. When it finally loses its temper, POKENAME releases all of the breath it was holding in a single deafening shriek.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME makes for a favorable companion, especially for frequently stressed individuals. Touching its fur has been shown to have therapeutic effects.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME uses its mind-reading abilities to sense someone's favorite song, then tries to mimic it. This ability allows it to resonate with its opponents, making them feel more connected or distracted.
author: .izik

entry: Wielding two microphones, it sings a different kind of song into either depending on its mood. In battle, it sings into both to cause powerful sound waves from the harsh feedback.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME train relentlessly for Pokémon contests and follow strict hygiene to maintain their luxurious fur. Their elegant, acrobatic martial arts are in a class all their own.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME's inflatable body gives it the ability to appear as large and muscular as it wants. Those not intimidated by the display will find it does nothing to enhance its actual middling level of physical strength.
author: sk372

entry: One of the first things that POKENAME learn is how to hold their breath. A newly hatched POKENAME can hold their breath for three hours at a time, and this duration grows as they get older.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fine fur easily picks up dirt, so it often swings from tree branches with its arms to avoid the ground. It tackles foes with crushing hugs while singing, leading the opponent to inevitable unconsciousness.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is covered in a highly coveted, soft fur that it sheds heavily quarterly, when clumps of fur become easily pluckable. Since it rolls everywhere, its habitat is covered in stray tufts of fur caught on the landscape during these seasons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Since it rolls most places, POKENAME's fur has become matted with dirt and grime to the point of being like armor, shrugging off most direct attacks. It must be guarded by others if the fur is shorn since its body is not used to being unprotected.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a mythical creature that few people, if any, have ever seen. Its mane is said to have the taste and texture of cotton candy.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME lazily floats along the beach shores. Because of their adorable looks, they are often sought out by Trainers for their cuteness to participate in Pokémon Contests.
author: violet_zero

entry: POKENAME can sing for hours at a time with a single breath. The majority of their shell is hollow to give them space to store air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: All three of POKENAME's heads sing a melancholic lullaby, harmonizing in eerie unison. Those who hear it are quickly lulled into a deep, dreamless sleep.
author: .izik

entry: Its fatty body and luxurious heat-preserving fur caused many POKENAME to once be hunted in large numbers. It lives in freezing areas that most do not dare to freely explore nowadays.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME shows affection by putting someone in its mouth, which can be misunderstood as devouring. Seemingly, nothing can end its pain and suffering.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Its innate ability to blast streams of water also allows POKENAME to gargle water if its throat is ever sore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bubbly and sparkly mist that surrounds POKENAME's body is actually toxic to inhale. However, its fur is still luxurious, just like Wigglytuff, so some attempt to harvest it despite the danger.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each section of POKENAME's body is as soft as a pillow, and due to this, small children and Pokémon are often seen resting their heads on POKENAME's tails.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME often accompanies nurses at hospitals. After lulling patients to sleep, it sings a healing song that can cure any ailment.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME often accompanies nurses at hospitals. After lulling patients to sleep, it sings a healing song that can cure any ailment.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME pinches anyone who falls asleep during its singing performances with its giant claw. If its tufts of fur get dirty, it immediately produces water bubbles to clean itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its innate ability to blast streams of water also allows POKENAME to gargle water if its throat is ever sore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.
author: chorb33

entry: It spits an odd assortment of seeds on any empty soil it finds. The seeds are from an unknown source and can become many different plants.
author: .izik

entry: The dust from its antennae is used in salves for burns. Its smell resembles a combination of Belue Berries and White Apricorns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME usually reacts to foes with either a toxic pollen attack or a rapid rolling escape, but as a last resort, it can explode in a violent burst of pollen.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sprouts flowers from its bonelike body during summer. The pollen they release has a calming effect on nearby creatures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very small Pokémon, with 70% of their bodies made up of plant-like appendages that they use to photosynthesize and gain energy. As protection from predators, they hide inside small crevices or inside skulls from deceased, larger Pokémon.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME open their bulbs during spring and summer to absorb even more sunlight; thus, they are vastly more energetic during these times as well. The plant stalks they wield are said to be of the same origin as those wielded by Farfetch'd.
author: infinex21

entry: After winter, POKENAME's bud opens as it stretches its long legs after enduring the long winter. As it moves, it spreads pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.
author: shyguy11011

entry: As POKENAME prepare for metamorphosis, they close their buds and harden their shells. Just before they emerge, they open their buds again to absorb energy for the last push.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME can survive on photosynthesis alone, but to evolve they need the energy from the nectar of flowers. They usually are passive and do not mind humans, but will aggressively protect their young using clouds of poisonous pollen.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME gets frustrated when something covers it from the sunlight. If it is another plant, it flies up and cuts it, to later see if the leaves can be used as a seam or a blanket to lie more comfortably.
author: epping_forest

entry: It curls up when the weather is cold. When the sun is shining warmly, POKENAME emerges and performs a happy swaying dance.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are easy prey for wild bird Pokémon. They are lucky to survive long enough for evolution.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's breeding habitats are swamps, but they can live in many environments since they digest plants and meat, break shells, and photosynthesize. The only limiting factors for their territories are temperature or competition.
author: lucioleuh

entry: When it shakes off its fur, it sends pollen into the air. This pollen can make any flower turn into fruit for it to eat.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are easy prey for wild bird Pokémon. They are lucky to survive long enough for evolution.
author: theartemis1

entry: As soon as they evolve, POKENAME will seek a calm place where it can camouflage itself until ready to evolve. It can't do much against evolved bird and insect Pokémon, but it can ward off small threats with puffs of irritant pollen.
author: lucioleuh

entry: In the spring, POKENAME emerges from hibernation so that its grassy coils can absorb the solar energy it needs to thrive and grow. It is weak and gentle, which is why it always avoids conflict, even when its own safety is at risk.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to popular belief, the gems on POKENAME's body help it control the weather so that it always has enough sunlight to absorb. Living in environments that are too cold causes its leaves to turn brown, a sign that it is unwell.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It keeps its tail coiled to contain the powerful pollen within. When POKENAME releases this pollen in battle, it drives nearby Grass types to madness.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The plant life on its body has a sleek coating to prevent it from burning. Newborn POKENAME do not have this coating, however, leading to accidents.
author: typhloquil

entry: In the morning, POKENAME flies to the tree tops to bask in the sun. After that, POKENAME peck each other to try to eat each other's seeds.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME slinks through the underbrush in search of roots and nuts. The seeds it brings to its burrow often turn into trees before they're eaten.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME thrives near wetlands, where it absorbs nutrients from the watercress growing around it. At night, it hoots softly while spreading its pollen to strengthen nearby plant life.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's appearance is deceptive, as contrary to common belief, it is the natural predator of small Bug-types. Due to its small size, POKENAME is also prey, mainly for bird Pokémon.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME's small and light body helps them to fly. Unfortunately, they struggle to control their flight path.
author: ohok3441

entry: Special organs in the center of POKENAME's flowers produce light, leading to glowing flower blossoms. Insects are drawn in droves to the light, which leads to an annoyed POKENAME zapping them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bud will only open when its overcome with joy, releasing a sweet scent that also makes others happy. During the springtime, groups of POKENAME can be seen happily bouncing around flower fields.
author: mistymagius

entry: The stem beneath POKENAME's bud is surprisingly strong, resembling the durability of bamboo. This Pokémon grows in clusters, supporting other Pokémon that build nests within its leaves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrives in sunlit meadows, where it absorbs energy from flowers. It flits between blossoms, spreading cheer with its gentle movements.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lounges in fields on sunny days to absorb sunlight. It's difficult to trim its foliage, which is laden with thorns.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's seeds resemble tiny cashews, packed with energy-rich nutrients. Wild Pokémon often seek them out, but its tough outer shell makes them difficult to crack open.
author: .izik

entry: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The crown on its head is actually two vines that stay clamped shut. The poison in its pollen makes those who breathe it smarter, at the cost of physical deformity.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Pokémon researchers initially believed POKENAME to be a regional variant of Ivysaur native to Sinnoh. A detailed analysis of their pollen and the enzymes in their flower's nectar revealed them to be their own distinct species.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have been spotted in groups, giving strange messages. Each time one of these messages have been deciphered, they turned out to be gardening tips.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME's movements are accompanied by a soft rattle, warning others of its approach. This sound, though faint, helps it maintain its personal space among wild Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: During the day, POKENAME lifts its tail up to photosynthesize sunlight, and during the night it buries the tail into the dirt to absorb nutrients. It rarely moves to do anything else.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are agile despite their imposing size and slow movements. Their soft bodies can bend a lot, and their tendrils can grasp high spots and lift the rest of the body. In the wild, they may uproot trees by accident while climbing on them.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME behaves well as long as it receives a good dose of morning sunlight each day. If denied its daily sunbeams, it turns surly and squawks grumpily at anything that comes near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME still loves sunlight, but the closer it gets to evolving, the harder it is to photosynthesize. Sometimes, it catches berries inside its claw and spends days digesting them.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with Combee. POKENAME protects the fields from intruders, and in return, Combee shares some of its honey.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME rolls to where the sun is brightest. Touching its coating of spores elicits a burning feeling similar to poison oak.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: In the warmer months, POKENAME closes its bud and becomes less active. Once the cooler months return, the flower blooms and spreads a snow-like pollen as it scurries around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lie low in meadows, keeping their tails raised above the top of the grass to receive sunlight. The bud at the tip of their tail has loose seeds within, and they shake it rapidly to warn those close to stepping on them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's petals exude a cooling eucalyptus aroma that soothes those nearby. It sways gracefully in the wind, releasing calming spores into the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME create vines to connect their horns together, completing the circuit in their bodies and encasing themselves in electricity. They grow sprouts from their bodies to extend the range of their electricity during battle.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's leaves release a faint smoky scent, resembling burning charcoal. When threatened, it emits embers from its petals to deter attackers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can subsist on sunlight and dirt alone; however, they need to graze to produce milk. Their milk is very sweet and somewhat reminiscent of nectar, but since they produce at most a glass of it per day, they aren't widespread as livestock.
author: lucioleuh

entry: When an electrical current passes through POKENAME's ears, a sweet aroma is produced. Although usually discreet and pleasant, it may become unbearable during thunderstorms as the smell builds up in unventilated areas.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME is very sturdy besides its appearance. It likes to sit in cracks of cliffs, where it can slowly grow in safety.
author: ayutac

entry: POKENAME keeps a Miracle Seed tucked safely in the pouch on its belly, carefully nourishing it each day with sunlight. A gentle soul by nature, it avoids fighting whenever possible.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME keeps an Oran Berry tucked safely in the pouch on its belly, carefully nourishing it each day with sunlight. A gentle soul by nature, it avoids fighting whenever possible.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it absorbs enough sunlight, it releases a fragrant aroma with soothing properties. If someone tries to touch it, POKENAME attempts to ward them off with gentle electric discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: One can usually find POKENAME at an oasis in the desert, where it will sit, content, soaking in the water for as long as it can.
author: roxie5228

entry: POKENAME is a calm and relaxed Pokémon that thrives in the clearings of a forest. Its fluffy tail often collects pollen and spores, allowing it to fertilize even faraway flowers and other flora.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although the bud on POKENAME's head blooms regularly when joyful or excited, it is much rarer for the one on its tail to do so. Most say it only does so once in POKENAME's lifetime, and the criteria for it to happen are still unknown.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME open their buds, they scatter many flammable spores, which they may ignite if they feel cornered. They do not need to eat, as they absorb sunlight. To drink water, they perch beside a river and dip their beaks into the water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME only open their buds when they are exposed to plenty of moisture; lying in deep enough water or mud fits the requirements. They emit earthy scents from their red fins, and from their blue fins, they emit the scent of water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoy playing in puddles on rainy days. The buds on their cheeks begin to bloom when spring is near, releasing pollen into the air.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time in swamps, usually submerged underwater. During the spring, they release pollen from their heads, helping the plant life around them grow.
author: santon5512

entry: Groups of POKENAME are seen huddling together when winter comes. When faced with danger, POKENAME scatter pollen before teleporting away to safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME gathers the positive emotions of others to stimulate its growth. If surrounded by emotional negativity, it may become sick.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The sap seeping from POKENAME's stem has a milky, toxic consistency similar to milkweed. Herbivores that attempt to eat it experience numbness in their mouths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will infiltrate homes, hiding themselves in flower pots. By changing their colors, they will disguise themselves as plants or flowers, basking in the sun.
author: santon5512

entry: It prefers damp soil and spends hours gnawing bark from flowering trees, staining its fur with pollen. Some forest paths are lined with their half-finished dams and sprouting footprints.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The bouquet on its head has 108 different flowers. The aroma can calm any rampaging Pokémon, and long-term exposure can make them mellow out permanently.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME cuddle as a group in rich soil to protect each other from a cold snap. If another Pokémon tries to feed on it, POKENAME springs from the ground and latches on with its jaw, absorbing nutrients from the attacker.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME cuddle as a group in rich soil to protect each other from a cold snap. If another Pokémon tries to feed on it, POKENAME springs from the ground and latches on with its jaw, absorbing nutrients from the attacker.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The large buds of POKENAME conceal frighteningly powerful jaws with vividly colored insides. The bright colors of their jaws allow them to appear as flowers when opened, easily luring in prey that is quickly swallowed whole.
author: infinex21

entry: Extremely sensitive to temperature and light, POKENAME only shows up on warm, dark nights. Its empty eye sockets frighten even the toughest of people and make them cry.
author: soup1900

entry: Easygoing and gentle, POKENAME prefers a relaxed life basking in the sun by clean rivers and streams. It is able to take even highly polluted air and photosynthesize to release tons of fresh oxygen.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a preferred habitat of humid jungles. It constantly emits a scent similar to incense. Despite liking damp environments, it dislikes the rain and will take shelter even when it drizzles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has an innate urge to water whatever plant it sees. It will even ignore its Trainer to run off to water flowers. When it forms an unbreakable bond, the bud at the top of its head starts to bloom.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a mild but stalwart personality. This extends to the taste of the tips of its plant-like flippers: distinct, but not overpowering.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When threatened, POKENAME releases pollen from its grassy fur. This pollen causes foes to hallucinate, disorienting them long enough for POKENAME to escape.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME basks in bright sunlight in the mornings. When it absorbs enough of the sun's rays, the buds on its head bloom into brightly-colored flowers that radiate a pleasant energy, improving the moods of those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: During spring and summer, the two large buds of these Pokémon open and release colorful, soothing pollen used by many Pokémon and humans. During winter, they seal their buds to better endure the intense cold.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a popular pet choice among plant lovers. It feeds on sunlight and fresh water, has a discreet sweet smell, and shows the spots with the best sunlight. However, it isn't very playful and mainly shows affection by smiling at its Trainer.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME hang underneath tree branches using their twin vines, illuminating the area with their glowing bodies. Their bodies are hot to the touch due to the amount of energy needed to keep them glowing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in shady undergrowth or under flower fields. If it were braver, it could develop more quickly, as it needs sunlight to thrive.
author: chorb33

entry: Nearing the vibrant tags on its head instills an eerie sense of dread. It's believed that your wish will come true if you can manage to steal one.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME burrow deep beneath gardens to sleep among roots, letting people provide all the water and nutrients they need to grow. Once a POKENAME is properly nourished, the bud on its head will bloom as it tunnels up out of the ground to evolve.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is highly sensitive to changes in emotions. Being around sad people will make it cry for hours, so it tends to stay in places with happy people, such as theme park planters or children's parks.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: When POKENAME are asleep, the buds upon their heads remain partly open and release soporific pollen as thick as a fine mist. When they awaken, their buds open the rest of the way and release an aromatic scent rather than soporific pollen.
author: infinex21

entry: When exposed to an abundance of water and sunlight, POKENAME will continuously grow in size until evolution.
author: theartemis1

entry: Sunlight fuels POKENAME's electricity generation. It spends most of the day napping and absorbing light, but it can charge into battle with blinding speed if necessary.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME make their habitat near lakes; those that live near cleaner water are able to channel more electricity through their front claws. Whenever spring draws near, it will use its claws to stimulate the growth of new plants.
author: notadoctor75

entry: When its bud is open, it exudes a powerful, metallic odor that deters most would-be predators. During winter, it keeps its bud shut and takes shelter underground, feeding on minerals and whatever water it can find.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found leeching off tree trunks via a sharp siphon on its back, with the organic matter of the bark fueling small boilers within POKENAME. Scientists still debate the biological purpose of POKENAME's ceaseless turning.
author: dylonk25

entry: The soothing aroma that emanates from POKENAME attracts all types of creatures. If the scent happens to attract a threat, POKENAME releases disorienting pollen, which distracts predators.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Incredibly sensitive to environmental conditions, the buds on POKENAME rarely fully flower. Successfully coaxing one to bloom is a delicate and demanding task, even for seasoned horticulturists.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: When the big pod behind it pops, pollen spreads around. This helps plants grow, but it is poisonous to humans and can irritate the throat if inhaled.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME releases spores that induce sneezing in anything nearby. These spores drift harmlessly through the air, acting as both a defense mechanism and a playful prank.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lets loose small bolts of electricity into the water to sterilize it. After this, it dips its body into the water to absorb it and grow.
author: .izik

entry: It absorbs metals and minerals from nearby soil, incorporating them into its skin and spines. It becomes heavier and slower as winter approaches, eventually going dormant once it becomes too heavy to move.
author: staghorn

entry: In winter, POKENAME closes its bud, and reopens it at the beginning of spring. The bud is unaffected by POKENAME's own body heat, which can double when excited.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME releases a warm, floral scent that soothes nearby Pokémon. This fragrance intensifies as it moves, making it a beacon of tranquility in blooming fields.
author: .izik

entry: Should POKENAME locate a cluster of topaz in a cave, it releases a puff of green powder to defend it. This powder is extremely potent, as a single whiff can cause someone to fall asleep.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers to eat leaves that have fallen off of maple trees. The darker brown the leaf is, the more desirable it is to a POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leaves are coated in a fine, frost-like dust that smells faintly of fir trees. It thrives in cold environments, where its icy sap protects it from freezing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gains energy through photosynthesis, so it loves sunny days. It practices kicks and dances so it can one day cheer on its allies.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME emits an unsettling presence despite its delicate appearance. It sways rhythmically, leaving others unsure whether to be entranced or unnerved.
author: .izik

entry: If a child dies in a flowery field, they have a chance to become a POKENAME. They cherish sunny days and spend their days floating through flowers.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: The preservative chemical used in Joy Scent can only be extracted from the saliva of a POKENAME. While effective in Joy Scent, it has no noticeable effect when combined with Excite Scent or Vivid Scent.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME calms foes by releasing a delightful nectarine scent. Should this fail, it emits a low tone from its buds that also helps to soothe the target.
author: .izik

entry: The preservative chemical used in Joy Scent can only be extracted from the saliva of a POKENAME. While effective in Joy Scent, it has no noticeable effect when combined with Excite Scent or Vivid Scent.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of countless seeds. When exposed to too much water, tiny buds sprout from it, releasing a Cheri Berry scent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces a distinct aroma that lingers long after it passes by. This scent attracts other Pokémon, though not all are pleased by its pungency.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a very rare Pokémon that can be spotted at night, caring for those sleeping in forests. Campers regularly report seeing a POKENAME in a dream despite not knowing it existed before.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME parasitise plant roots, drinking their sap to fuel the growth of their flower buds. Large populations of POKENAME can cause issues for local plant populations and their presence is monitored by environmental agencies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses the hard leaves on its front limbs to dig into soft soil, creating holes for itself to reside in. It favors open fields, letting its bud bask in the sunlight for all hours of the day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME finds spots within caverns that still have access to sunlight to photosynthesize. When it gathers sunbeams, the bud on its head opens up to reveal a dazzling gemstone within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME act as parental figures in the wild, using their stick to command baby Pokémon to follow them. If threatened, they will open their bud, releasing a powder that causes inflammation.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The skin of POKENAME excretes a highly flammable oil, mainly at the tip of the tail, where a flame is kept lit at all times. During battle, it can shoot said oil to its foes from the bud on its head.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME swims near the sea's surface during spring to absorb sunlight. This causes its skin to take on a cocoa-like scent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide amongst vibrant flower patches, leaving their tail bud in the sunlight to gather energy. If disturbed, they spray a stunning powder at the offender before fleeing in zig-zag patterns to confuse pursuers.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME open the small buds on their heads to attract mates and to communicate with their kind. Because the scent of their open buds also attracts bird Pokémon, they have developed venomous horns.
author: infinex21

entry: Small and meek, POKENAME are quick to flee at the first sign of danger, such as a loud noise. In spring, they exude a pleasant, nutty fragrance, and their stems partly sprout. In winter, they become inactive and hide; they often hide within trees.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME awakens every morning to the sun's rays on the bulb of its head. It is sensitive to changes in temperature and shivers when a cold breeze rushes by.
author: quackquackattack
