entry: These dim-witted Pokémon are constantly attacking each other, unable to tell each other from their enemies. Their toxic bite leaves a long-lasting burning sensation.
author: mistymagius

entry: It uses the sound-waves from rattling its tail to alert other POKENAME in the vicinity of prey approaching. The sound of dozens of POKENAME rattling simultaneously will frighten and confuse prey, making them easier for the swarm to take down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is constantly swinging its hefty trunk around to sense its surroundings. Despite its weak wings, it has always dreamed of flight.
author: mistymagius

entry: Whenever POKENAME are eating, they absorb sound waves from the nearby area. Phones and other audio devices mysteriously stop working until they are finished eating.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are easily startled by sudden vibrations and may flee if they detect the presence of a heavy Pokémon. They remain hidden in narrow holes or underneath rocks, coiled and ready to strike passing Pokémon at a moment's notice.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Swarms of POKENAME live in volcanic caves, hanging from the ceiling as they sleep. When asleep, embers drip from their mouths, raining onto anyone unfortunate enough to walk below.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's egg can be used to treat night blindness. Unfortunately, the egg doesn't have the same effect on POKENAME itself.
author: .realthree

entry: Although POKENAME is blind, it navigates its cave lair perfectly by sensing vibrations in the ground beneath its feet. It has a pair of wings that allow short flights, which it uses to reach crevices where it hides its food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME hunts via echolocation. Its echoing cry is powerful enough to create waves and tsunamis, disrupting sea life and making it easier for POKENAME to pluck them from the upper sea level.
author: sk372

entry: Due to its lack of eyesight, POKENAME uses its electromagnetic senses to get a picture of its surroundings. It can only be seen on stormy nights, trying to get struck by lightning.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME practice raising eggs by carrying a stone with them wherever they go. To avoid bumping into cavern walls, they rely on loud screeches to echolocate in pitch-black darkness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emit ultrasonic waves to find their way, due to their lack of conventional sensory organs. What may appear to be ears on their heads are actually antennae that they use to control their magnetic fields and electrical energies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can only be found in caves, using its sensitive hearing to detect its surroundings. Groups of POKENAME make their dens in small crevices in the cave walls.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME release deafening screams, their pitch fluctuating wildly. At their loudest, these screams can cause permanent hearing loss and even shatter glass.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME vents its internal heat through its three feather-like ears. Getting bitten by POKENAME is said to feel like your blood in on fire.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides within indents in cave walls to remain unseen. Due to its lack of eyes and wings, POKENAME uses small chirps and screeches to echolocate where it needs to go and to avoid holes and obstacles as it hops around.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is very fond of Sandshrew and sometimes delivers rocks it finds on the roofs of caves to it. However, its wings are not very strong, so the rocks often fall and break.
author: rumia_archer

entry: POKENAME burrows into the ceiling of caves and waits until it hears prey moving below. Once alerted, it glides down using its wings to strike without a sound.
author: rosesilver

entry: While flying, POKENAME curls into a ball, exposing its sharp violet spikes to keep others at bay. Though not especially ferocious, it won't hesitate to bite creatures it perceives as prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's piercing screeches emit an echo that carries through entire cave systems, allowing them to navigate in total darkness. They rely on their powerful legs for movement and use their claws to cling to cave walls when danger approaches.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME are pressured by evil organizations to commit crimes and are forced to work in servitude. Trainers who treat a POKENAME with respect and love are likely to develop a lifelong friend.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Being blind, POKENAME must scan its surroundings via echolocation. Domesticated POKENAME also have a unique type of cry to use that allows them to better locate their Trainer when separated from them.
author: sk372

entry: During summer nights, hundreds of POKENAME appear to find a mate. During this period, its poison becomes ten times more potent in preparation to protect its young.
author: mistymagius

entry: It uses sonic waves and its tongue to navigate. It can mimic the cries of other Pokémon, though only after being around them long enough to hear and learn their cries.
author: infinex21

entry: The four fangs within its mouth are retractable. It uses four wings to swoop quickly and engulf prey whole, before the fangs extend and pierce from all sides, skewering them and drinking the blood that flows forth.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its vines and echolocation to navigate through forests and caves, respectively. The health of its bulb affects the vibrancy of its purple spots and the potency of the venom it delivers through its fangs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is completely blind, so it will use echolocation by making small chattering noises from its mouth. Despite its jaws being powerful enough to snap tree branches in half, it prefers to just eat berries.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME consumes bugs, inhaling them into its mouth and closing its petals while it eats. While fairly docile and easy to raise, owners should still be careful as it will bite if agitated.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bludgeons foes with its hard, gem-like skull to disorient them. Once they are reeling, it follows up with a vicious bite to incapacitate its target.
author: .izik

entry: The earliest reports of POKENAME date back to fossils found near Pewter City, estimated to be thousands of years old. Its round mouth was used to latch onto airborne prey with a nearly unbreakable grip.
author: .izik

entry: With its echolocation and naturally sharp senses, POKENAME can locate lost or injured travelers inside even the deepest, darkest caverns. Unfortunately, its frightening appearance often sends those it wishes to rescue into a panic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses a type of underwater echolocation as it swims around the deep sea. Its sheer size means these impressive cries can disrupt sonar and even cause damage to creatures that swim too close.
author: sk372

entry: During mating season, POKENAME can have up to twelve mates at once. POKENAME are twice as strong as the females, able to push small boulders with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME caves are usually dead silent; the slightest noise will alert the swarm within. However, in late summer, POKENAME gather from all over the region, unleashing a cacophony of chittering screeches in the hopes of finding mates.
author: jacobtmm

entry: Upon evolution, it can no longer suspend itself from the roof of the caves in which it dwells. Instead, it perches atop breakable rocks, listening carefully for the sound of its prey in the darkness.
author: snookerron

entry: Groups of POKENAME patrol the caves where they live, throwing themselves at intruders with reckless abandon. They usually guard caves with large amounts of rare minerals.
author: mistymagius

entry: While not required for POKENAME to persist, consuming blood increases its strength and speed. As long as a POKENAME has not drunk that night, they are easy to fend off with weapons as humble as a stick from the ground.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME have no eyes and are totally reliant on their acute hearing for navigation. They will sometimes use their little wings to knock small pebbles around, listening out for the echoes to get a good sense of their surroundings.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's claws are made of a toxic metal that can be fatal if it enters your bloodstream. They can often be seen sparring with each other, testing whose armor is strongest.
author: mistymagius

entry: Being born blind, POKENAME uses echolocation and its ribbons to feel its surroundings. When around something it doesn't recognize, it will nibble it.
author: melodydelune

entry: This Pokémon is blind as a bat. However, it has an incredible ability to sense the emotions of beings around it.
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME lets out a bellowing roar for intimidation and hunting. The echolocation makes up for its lack of eyes and allows it to pinpoint prey, which are often too frozen in terror by its thunderous cry to properly flee.
author: sk372

entry: Commonly found in Mt. Moon, POKENAME thrive in the darkness. Groups of POKENAME collect Moon Stones to decorate their dens.
author: mistymagius

entry: The weight of POKENAME's large, muscular legs has rendered it flightless. Instead, it leaps up to ten feet in the air to hunt for bug Pokémon.
author: dylonk25

entry: The plasma enveloping their bodies is dense and poisonous, offering protection and a potent weapon. They attach themselves to foes, sink their fangs into them, and drain their blood to sustain themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: During nights of a waxing moon, POKENAME experiences an insatiable hunger. It silently stalks prey like Buneary for hours before finally striking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constantly emits a high-pitched ringing noise that deters predators. Large groups of POKENAME will cause permanent hearing loss almost instantly.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME release high-pitched screeches to navigate caves in the dark. They often travel in groups to scare predators with the cacophony of noise.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The blind POKENAME uses ultrasonic screams and echolocation to hunt in caves. As it gets older, it grows more tails and in turn becomes more agile.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hunts after Zubat inhabiting cave systems. It attacks while they sleep, burning them with hot gusts of wind to inhibit their escape before sinking its fangs into them and drinking blood.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's heads are completely blind, forcing them to rely upon echolocation to navigate. The two heads emit competing frequencies, forcing them to alternate shrieks to navigate lest they have confusing echoes return to them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME travels at 1000 miles per hour in the upper atmosphere. Recent theories suggest it's hiding from the sun.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: On moonlit nights, POKENAME soars over turnip fields in search of food. It will suddenly dive and burrow into the ground, using its fangs to gnaw on the vegetables beneath.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME make their own caves, using their strong teeth to crush stone and dig through the soil. They prefer making their homes near underground water sources.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME cannot see very well, so it uses its powers to detect the movement and emotions of others. If just one is frightened, it will alert all other POKENAME in the area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME sleeps for up to 20 hours a day, putting all its energy into trying to fly during the night. Its claws are coated in bacteria that can be dangerous if they pierce the skin.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME emits tiny sparks of electricity while hunting, using the flashes to sense its surroundings. This makes it particularly effective at navigating through dark caves and stormy nights.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is rather heavy, so it can only fly under its own power for short amounts of time. Its cry has a metallic reverb to it, which is thought to adversely affect its own echolocation capability.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits harsh metallic cries that echo like stone scraping iron. It uses these reverberations to navigate deep and twisting cave tunnels.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME lurk deep in unlit caves, developing their outer shells in preparation for evolution. POKENAME will screech loudly when they discover a nearby threat, warning neighbouring Pokémon while drawing attention to themselves.
author: npshi

entry: Due to the second body's lack of wings, POKENAME usually keeps to the ground. It creates a unique clicking noise as it spins, theorized to be an ancient signal.
author: mistymagius

entry: A shy, blind Pokémon, POKENAME hides in dark caves and uses echolocation. It scares and tricks predators by transforming into them, but remains blind.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME with bright spots are incredibly venomous. They can capture foes whole and easily inject them with venom before tossing them away. They are herbivores that favor poisonous plants and poisonous mushrooms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME forms colonies in hot and dark places using ultrasonic cries to help navigate. The poison cloud on the end of their tail indicates their life force. The thicker the cloud the healthier they are.
author: princessmilandria

entry: POKENAME uses its long, dangling legs to grapple foes mid-air. Once secured, it flies them back to its cave, where they are seldom seen again.
author: .izik

entry: Contact with POKENAME's puffy fur causes a painful rash. Recent research suggests that it is aware of this fact, recontextualizing its friendly, frisky nature as rather malicious.
author: dylonk25

entry: Despite not being able to fly, POKENAME is constantly jumping around while flapping its wings. This spreads its poisonous spores, which can be deadly if inhaled.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is hollow, so when it catches prey in its mouth, it does not consume them in the traditional sense. Instead, it siphons some vitality via ghostly powers before discarding them out of the bottom of its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats effortlessly using its psychic powers, needing little effort to stay airborne. It manipulates the minds of its prey, making them forget that it ever fed on them.
author: .izik

entry: Once night falls in the desert, POKENAME pokes its head out to find prey via echolocation. It flies in short bursts, leaping out from the sand to snatch its latest meal and drag them down underground.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is theorized to be the sole cause of Zubat overpopulation in most caves of Kanto, being able to produce Zubat eggs without a mate. However, these theories usually came from post-blacked out Trainers after a Supersonic to the face.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME latches onto prey with its fangs before releasing a surge of electricity. This shock leaves the victim unable to move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its thorns to attach itself to cave walls and ceilings. It can launch some of its thorns to attack, though it needs time to regrow them whenever it does this.
author: entomoxie

entry: Their vibrant tusks secrete an agonizing venom whose only cure is derived from the selfsame venom. Using ultrasonic waves, they can keep track of their surroundings. They will spread their wings and screech loudly to disorient foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient tomes warn travelers not to walk alone at night. They speak of POKENAME stalking villages to drink the blood of the unsuspecting.
author: .izik

entry: Pleasant chirps from POKENAME often echo throughout the dark caves that it calls home. Since it is blind, it uses the soundwaves from its chirping to detect objects and navigate around them.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its purple feelers produce a toxic film that can cause severe rashes if not washed off. Before evolution, it wraps itself in its wings and hangs beneath a strong tree branch.
author: mistymagius

entry: Fusions of two Zubat can result in this fusion expressing traits of a more evolved form, developing rudimentary eyes, and even feet. They struggle to process these new sensory developments and can sometimes crash mid-flight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This fusion will sometimes develop eyes when they form from two unfused Zubat. When these eyes take the place of their ears, they can struggle to navigate due to the loss of their echolocative abilities.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite being a rarity amongst the Zubat family, POKENAME is still quite common in larger cave systems. It will try to swallow its prey whole, even if they are too large to swallow.
author: mistymagius

entry: It lies in wait on the floors of dark caves, waiting for unsuspecting prey to walk right into its mouth. Then, it bites down and shocks them into submission.
author: kiwiarms

entry: These mischievous Pokémon love to play tricks on passing Trainers, either prodding them with its spear or giving them nasty illnesses. If POKENAME is seen near your house, the entire household will fall ill within a week.
author: mistymagius

entry: Swarms of POKENAME can be seen crawling on cave walls, patrolling their nests. They drain the fluids out of their prey until they swell to twice their size.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its only hunting grounds are pitch-black caverns, so its eyes are very underdeveloped. It navigates by belching, and using the smell reverberations to see its surroundings.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Most cave-dwelling Pokémon will leave offerings of food for POKENAME to keep it from actively hunting. This is because the rumbling roars it uses for echolocation shake the cave walls and risk causing cave-ins.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME zoom through the air, as their cone-shaped bodies are highly aerodynamic. However, due to living primarily in caves and being blind, they often injure themselves by crashing recklessly.
author: chinigan

entry: The first recorded POKENAME is the product of three Zubat that met an unfortunate fate in a blizzard many years ago. It wanders frozen caves hunting for fresh victims to freeze solid.
author: kianjp2008

entry: This Pokémon hides in orchards to ambush careless farmers so that it can drink some of their blood. It is hypersensitive to seismic vibrations which it utilizes to sense approaching targets.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME shoves as much rubbish into its gullet as it can until its skin starts to tear. Groups of POKENAME make their nest in dumpsters and garbage cans.
author: mistymagius

entry: It sleeps at the base of willow trees during the daytime, preferring the shade from the hot sun. If woken up, it will screech at a high frequency.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies slowly, but silently. Using this stealthy flight, it sneaks up on potential prey, latching onto them with its ghostly tail and biting down to drink their blood.
author: sk372

entry: The fluid oozing from POKENAME's mouths is chemically similar to myoglobin, the liquid which leaches out of a cooked steak. Scientists are studying whether it may have medical use.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME have a toxic bite, which isn't dangerous by itself. However, millions of POKENAME live in the same nest, making it likely that you'll be bitten by at least a dozen more.
author: mistymagius

entry: This strange Pokémon barely has room for its brain due to the size of its mouth. Fans of POKENAME are rare, but devoted.
author: .realthree

entry: Hordes of POKENAME have been found deep within sealed caves. They possess a unique combination of traits that make them perfect for subterranean life.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME doesn't typically use its wings for flying. Instead, it uses their mucousy membranes to suffocate its prey.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME eagerly approaches small children in caves, hoping to play with them. Unfortunately, its appearance often scares them away.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME hides inside beached ships, using its unique silhouette to hide amongst the wreckage. It will only use its venomous bite when its disguise fails.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME only come out at night, impressively leaping from building to building without making a sound. Its cape is resistant to tearing, which defends POKENAME from claw and biting attacks.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's tough thorns allow it to cling to cave walls. The thorns also inject poison which can cause fainting if stung more than once.
author: mistymagius

entry: Being bitten by a POKENAME causes the body to be infected by its parasitic mushrooms. The mushrooms will slowly drain the life force from anyone infected over the span of a year.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. It checks its surroundings by barking at them, causing quite a ruckus in caves it inhabits.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME is a poor runner. It prefers to ambush its prey with a venomous bite, then wait until the Pokémon collapses to catch up with it.
author: .realthree

entry: Even though it is blind, POKENAME can perfectly perceive the scent of anything around it. When it catches prey with its agile movements, it finishes it off with fierce strikes from its incredibly hard claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The sonic waves of POKENAME's songs are highly effective as a hunting tactic. It uses echolocation to pinpoint prey's location, while the prey itself is distracted and lulled by the song's pleasant melody.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in dark caves, clicking their claws to echolocate and help them find food. They keep their young in their cave-like backs, protecting them from danger.
author: santon5512

entry: The plant fibers covering POKENAME's body grow rapidly after feeding on another Pokémon. It hangs upside-down to sleep while they thicken.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME run around completely blind, enjoying the feel of the wind across their skin. The wings atop their heads are not strong enough to provide them with lift, but they flap happily whenever POKENAME are in a good mood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will emit a high-pitched screech that can cause hearing damage if exposed for too long. It uses its cry for echolocation due to its lack of eyesight.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME flap their wings to help focus their hypersonic shrieks, channelling them forward in a cone. They rely on the echoes of these shrieks to navigate, rushing forward to perform full body tackles if they sense another Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are found in odd shady places in steppe climates, such as in the crevices of trees or even in underground burrows. They run about during the night and are not deterred by the cold due to the natural warmth their bodies generate.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The purple portions of POKENAME's body glow brightly when it emits high-pitched screeches. These eerie cries can cause disorientation in those who hear them for too long.
author: .izik

entry: Its cloudy eyes are only able to detect light, so swarms of POKENAME can be seen in busy cities during the night. They have excellent hearing, allowing them to flee at the slightest sound of danger.
author: mistymagius

entry: To bait its prey, POKENAME will tuck its wings and ears and close its mouth to look like cotton candy. When a sweet-toothed victim gets close, POKENAME will strike them with its sharp fangs.
author: fireflower20002

entry: POKENAME relies on its sense of smell to get around, as it can distinguish any scent. It's popular among spelunkers for its ability to sniff its way out of any cave.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME uses its strong jaw to crush unripened fruit and eat it. The sweeter the fruit, the more rubbery the skin around its waist becomes, providing it with extra protection as it feeds.
author: .izik

entry: It spits out a mildly toxic numbing substance that causes any prey to not feel pain while it siphons a little bit of their blood. It prowls around outside at night but sleeps inside caverns during the day.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can usually be found lying on the ground, weighed down by their own lilypads. POKENAME prefer not to fly, instead using their wings to propel themselves up into a pounce when near food.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME soar through caves with their violet wings and rely on echolocation to keep track of the walls around them. They become incredibly irate whenever they bump into something and release embers from their mouths to vent their frustration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pop out of the soil and bite anything standing above them. While they're normally little more than a shocking nuisance, large hordes of POKENAME can make a cave's tunnels completely impassable.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's main source of sustenance is the blood of other creatures. Its saliva contains a concoction that first causes numbness when bitten, before leaving the bitten creature feeling amorous for a short time afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are entirely blind, instead using howls as a form of echolocation. These Pokémon are always found in hunting packs, howling to communicate and locate prey.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME relies on its heightened sense of smell to navigate dark caves. Its diet is made up of various cave mushrooms, as they are easy to locate because of their pungent smell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While tunneling, POKENAME fires bursts of sonar to disorient prey. It then lunges forward and subdues them swiftly with Scratch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases piercing screeches from holes in cave ceilings. The sound stuns prey moments before it drops down to attack.
author: .izik

entry: Its agile flying style allows it to move around caves without the risk of crashing into stalactites or other obstacles. If POKENAME does not get enough nutrition by hunting other Pokémon, its feathers begin to weaken and fall out.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While skating on water surfaces, POKENAME senses ripples impacting unaware Pokémon from which to leech nutrients. Its small wings allow it to briefly pursue prey, but its echolocation is unsophisticated, so it quickly retreats to water.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are skilled scavengers that love to hoard shiny objects in the caves they call home. With their ultra-sensitive eyes, they can see in near-total darkness.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME produce some of the loudest sounds ever recorded in nature. If even a few of them screech at the same time it can cause entire caves to collapse.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME focuses sonic blasts to shatter stalactites while in flight. The resulting cave-ins rarely hinder it as it dodges falling stone effortlessly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME picks fights with larger Pokémon as a form of training. As it tires, it bites and drinks the blood of its opponent to boost its energy, so the fight can go on for even longer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their keen sense of hearing to help them fight because they are blind. Their bulky build makes them difficult to take down, and it only takes a single successful punch for them to win fights.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME perches upside-down on cave ceilings to meditate. It hones its mind and senses enough that it compensates for its lack of sight, rarely requiring echolocation to determine where its prey is.
author: sk372

entry: These slender Pokémon are expert predators, using echolocation to track prey down with ease. Its toxic bite incapacitates its victims within a matter of hours.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME eat the leftovers of carnivorous Pokémon and digest it with their powerful stomach acid. Even though they cannot see, they can follow the cries of predators to find their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are blind and cannot hunt for themselves, so they follow the cries of predators to eat their leftovers. Their powerful stomach acid prevents them from getting sick from eating those leftovers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can usually be found near polluted waters. It covers its body in a slippery, poisonous film that allows it to escape from predators.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its eye has clouded over, leaving POKENAME blind and forcing it to hunt through echolocation. When the crescent moon is in the sky, POKENAME regains its sight for the night and becomes much more ferocious.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's dual mouths give it a strong echolocation technique. Once it detects something in the vicinity, the two mouths emit small fireballs to singe its targeted prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will attract mates late at night by screeching at the top of its lungs. Ships will actively avoid waters teeming with POKENAME, as this screeching regularly disrupts navigational equipment.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME creates a current around itself that collects pollutants from nearby air, strengthening its own poison and allowing it to fly higher. When they attack, they flap their wings to direct gusts of wind that carry their concoctions.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hunts by using echolocation, crying out little chirps to find something to roll after. It is entirely non-aggressive, however, and its hunting method consists of rolling into and nudging humans and Pokémon into sharing their food.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ambushes its prey with unsettling fury, ripping small Pokémon apart with its sharp fangs. It flies into a primal rage if its prey somehow escapes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are very sensitive to sound; any loud sound will cause it to rampage for hours on end. It sweats out a dangerous chemical that only seems to enhance its own strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have an amazing sense of smell and can track its prey effortlessly with its scent alone. Packs of POKENAME hoard their uneaten prey in small cave systems.
author: mistymagius

entry: Being unable to see, this Pokémon uses its strong sense of smell to navigate. As a fusion, its body can resist being burned by prolonged exposure to the sun.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Despite being blind, its flawless sense of smell allows it to pinpoint the location of both humans and Pokémon with precision. Its lethal fangs can poison or burn its enemies, making POKENAME a foe that should never be underestimated.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME live in large schools and can be found in murky rivers and lakes. It only takes about twenty POKENAME to drain a Trainer of all of their bodily fluids.
author: mistymagius

entry: The wings on POKENAME are too small to lift its body. It runs around cave floors, scooping prey up into its gaping maw.
author: gronkissimo

entry: POKENAME are constantly training their muscles until they become strong enough to fly. The more this Pokémon exercises, the more toxic its sweat becomes.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite losing its ability to fly well, POKENAME is still just as dedicated to increasing its strength. Its wings now act as toxic spines that are just secondary to its massive strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wraps itself around jungle vines, blending in perfectly as it waits for unsuspecting prey. The moment they get close, it sinks its fangs deep into them.
author: .izik

entry: By flapping its wings, it propels itself through water at great speeds. Schools of POKENAME regularly pass by Cinnabar Island during the fall months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often hangs onto cave plants, absorbing their nutrients and catching bugs with its open mouth. It also swoops down to eat bugs in mouthfuls.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is a common sight in water sources found in caverns, but is much less aggressive towards humans than many Trainers believe. The webbing of its fins are covered in a toxic film that leaves an irritating, glowing rash.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live deep in the ocean, swimming at a depth where very little light reaches. Their red colouration absorbs what little light there is, making them nearly invisible. They swim by using their long wing-like fins.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is found in the deep ocean and lakes found inside caverns since it has no need for eyesight, instead sensing movement with its bulbous organs. It paralyzes prey with toxins in its tentacles and slowly drains the blood.
author: pjporwoll

entry: They fly through pitch-black caves, plowing through obstacles with their durable bodies. Being struck by one is more injurious than being bitten.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME have a weird habit of clinging to high cliff walls, then dropping themselves onto unsuspecting victims. Its rocky jaws have enough power to crush a small car.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's wings can only barely hold its heavy stone body aloft with great effort. Using echolocation to find prey, it struggles to flutter above them before dropping down to crush the target beneath its weight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is regarded as a symbol of terror. Those who turn a corner in a cave and see its imposing silhouette have moments to flee before it attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: It makes a low tone to view its surroundings. This tone is unsettling and has been used in horror movies to cause unease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are unable to fly or see, so they rely on their echolocation and psychic waves to navigate. Whenever the shell on their tail bites down, they experience a surge of energy that gives them new insights about the world around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's venom is charged with electricity which can cause paralysis if untreated. Flocks of these Pokémon can be seen gnawing on powerlines during the night.
author: mistymagius

entry: The more electricity POKENAME consumes, the stronger the magnetic pull between the heads becomes. All three heads are extremely greedy and are constantly fighting over prey.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME cannot walk, so it holds its precious leek in its mouth while it flies. Its venom ends up poisoning the leek, making it a useful weapon in battle.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have two heads that must work together to navigate caves. One head produces high pitch squeals that bounce off cave walls, while the other head listens and leads them in the direction of food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME primarily live in coves in cold climates. There are reports of them using Bubblebeam to knock flying prey into the water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt in cold waters, making clicking noises to locate their prey. Once found, they release a powerful sonic wave to stun their prey.
author: santon5512

entry: The slime on a POKENAME can be boiled down into a a thick paste. This paste is used by beauticians as an ingredient in lipstick.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consumes anything it can find, even if it can't swallow its food whole. Despite how small its wings are, it is able to comfortably fly about ten feet off the ground.
author: mistymagius

entry: The ghostly gas surrounding POKENAME grows in intensity as it absorbs energy from people and Pokémon. It is most often found near abandoned mining sites, where it can phase through the tunnel walls to escape an angered enemy.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Lacking vision, POKENAME relies on its extrasensory ability to detect life force and negative emotions to hunt its prey. It creeps along ceilings until above its quarry, then drops in front of them with a high-pitched screech, feeding on the fear.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While sitting in corners of abandoned buildings and caves, POKENAME keep their mouths closed to lure in unsuspecting prey. When a target approaches, POKENAME leaps up and opens its giant maw with a Screech to disorient and terrify the foe.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME tunnel deep underground, using echolocation to navigate its pitch-black tunnels. Its rock-hard fangs are tough enough to pierce through thick steel.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its venom afflicts its victims with drowsiness and subsequent nightmares upon which POKENAME can feast. For this reason, POKENAME venom is sought out as a non-lethal way to incapacitate unruly Pokémon.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Swarms of POKENAME hundreds strong live deep inside caves. They love to collect objects and swing them around as they fly.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME are omnivorous. While they normally roll and crush prey, they're also known to like fruit and will ram trees to obtain it.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME will surround a battle and prolong it by throwing healing eggs to the fighters. It proves its strength by not accepting healing for itself.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME has the ability to see the temperature of objects in its general vicinity, which allows it to detect humans and other Pokémon. It avoids predators by hiding in mud or undersea growth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a strong membrane surrounding their eyes that let them see in any environment, even under water. Wild POKENAME protect their young by destroying rocks to create underwater caves with their large horns and forming their nests there.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME uses its malleable body to slip in and out of sewers easily. If something comes upon it while scrounging for food, it transforms into a larger, more intimidating Pokémon to scare them off.
author: sk372

entry: After consuming microchips, POKENAME's ability to swim through sand increases dramatically. At peak speed, it can rival a commercial jet.
author: .izik

entry: Its shell resembles a Krokorok, acting as a natural deterrent to predators. However, the tail-shaped protrusion on its shell throws off its balance, causing it to fall over frequently. Harsh desert sandstorms often flip it upright again.
author: duskit___

entry: They can leap on their prey with ease, using massive muscles of the lower body and a long tail. Bones are crushed with ease beneath their sharp teeth.
author: markusknight

entry: Its small gills allow it to orient itself in any environment, even in complete darkness. Since its skin is prone to drying out immediately, it often washes itself in rivers and covers its body with mud every time it prepares to step out of the water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME stores sand within its sturdy shell, which it pours out to use for attacks. However, battering POKENAME often causes it to lose all of its sand quickly, causing it to attempt to run away to gather more.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME shapes boulders found in the desert using its fiery breath to craft its shell. When it outgrows one, it finds a larger boulder and discards the old one.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slither into burrows of other Pokémon to hunt for their meals. They have to act quickly before the nest occupants return or risk getting hurt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's vain pride of its hair crest leads it to lash out at anything that messes up its well-groomed pompadour. Its tough and haughty demeanor is easily broken as its long ears often cause it to trip and throw a tantrum.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The chilly ice embedded in POKENAME's claws helps direct heat away from its body. POKENAME is known for stealing meals from other Pokémon rather than hunting for itself.
author: .realthree

entry: It glides along desert sands during the day, using thermals to stay aloft, and burrows under the sand at night. Its claws hold a particularly deadly toxin that can incapacitate foes in seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drills tunnels into the earth by twisting its long claws. It is known to assist miners with excavating gems in exchange for food and company.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It burrows into large sand dunes if it senses a bad sandstorm. Many travelers see this as an ominous warning and quickly seek shelter.
author: .izik

entry: The membrane of POKENAME's eyes lets them sense the heat of their surroundings, making them excellent fighters in the dark. Using their agile bodies, they bounce off the walls and ceilings before delivering a devastating kick.
author: santon5512

entry: The membranes on POKENAME's eyes let them see well in the dark, making them especially suited for fighting at night. The flames on their bodies are jet black so as not to give away their location.
author: santon5512

entry: It creates magnetic minerals along one of its heads, and the other two distribute it across the region. Such minerals can be sold at a high price.
author: nasho1908

entry: With blades that resemble shark tooth swords, POKENAME ambush and hack at prey with abandon, as they quickly grow lost teeth back.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is thought to have belonged to the guards of an ancient palace's throne room. It seems to follow its leader's orders to this day.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Ancient people believed that POKENAME come from the land of the dead in search for tainted souls to devour. This Pokémon's statues and wall drawings can be found in the ruins of some desert temples.
author: milchik

entry: Since ancient times, this Pokémon has been feared and admired in equal measure. Combining the bite force of Krokorok and speed of Luxray, POKENAME lives near rivers in hot regions where it dominates the food chain.
author: milchik

entry: The membrane covering its eyes allows it to detect the heat of others; it can easily stalk prey, even in darkness. It burrows through the ground or through sand and then ensnares its prey with its ribbon-like appendages before biting down.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are expert hunters that utilize their night vision to hunt alone at night while their partner sleeps with the children. Using their powerful tail to strike prey, this predator will always return home with a fresh meal for their family.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: It spends years perfecting its ambush techniques, blending seamlessly into the sand before striking. The strongest among them are known to take down foes many times their size.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can use the flame in its body to channel light through the membranes of its eyes. This beam of light is effective at surprising and blinding prey it has spotted within the darkness.
author: sk372

entry: It makes its home near desert oases and bites at anyone who gets too close. It fiercely defends its territory, ensuring no one drains its precious water supply.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME patrol their territory with frenetic movements, racing along the border in search of intruders to scare off. They are usually content to simply intimidate their rivals away with loud noises and frightening gestures.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a false head on top of its real one to make it look bigger and deter predators. It will equip its false head with any form of glasses it finds to further the illusion.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are cruel bullies, using their acute sense of smell to find rare desert oases and then forcing other Pokémon away from them. They delight in wielding their strength against smaller Pokémon, but are cowards when confronted by stronger foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's dark rings grow the largest around the quarter moon. It hides in them while hunting for prey, and buries leftovers in the desert for later.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME lurks behind bakeries and restaurants, snapping its jaws at workers to scare them into offering food. It refuses to rob the same business more than once in a week.
author: .izik

entry: It sits in the upper atmosphere with its mouth wide open, catching any stardust or debris that falls inside. However, POKENAME has no stomach, and spits up whatever it eats.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is almost always trying to find a mate, even before it reaches adolescence. It shows off its chivalrous personality and charismatic shades.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME engage in pranks to distract themselves from their headaches. One with bad enough headaches will subconsciously block the sun from its view.
author: totodile.

entry: Close inspection of a POKENAME reveals a pitch black pearl in its shell. Any who try to take its pearl will be bitten by its steel-crushing Clamp.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's strong eyesight and flexible, spindly body allow it to see and dodge almost any attack that comes its way, giving it a cocky personality. Its defenses are pitiful however, so if an attack manages to get through, it is quickly humbled.
author: sk372

entry: The striped pattern on this desert-dwelling Pokémon makes POKENAME a popular partner for bandits in Western movies.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME trades Razor Fangs with Gligar, which it uses to protect its family. It prefers to be perceived as intimidating despite its gentle nature.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME trades Razor Fangs with Gligar, which it uses to protect its family. It prefers to be perceived as intimidating despite its gentle nature.
author: noel5229

entry: Their claws can shred through steel, and they use their tails to steer and grab onto things underwater. POKENAME comfortably live in deserts and seas.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME wears a golden ceremonial bulb on its back that releases ancient spores. The bulb was once part of a process for embalming people, as the spores wick moisture from skin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: No matter where this Pokémon finds itself, it works with others, creating mounds by burrowing into the earth, aiming to create a space for a large POKENAME colony.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: It's said this fusion is the result of a Yamask being absorbed by its mask after experiencing immeasurable anger. It now only seeks vengeance.
author: maelmc

entry: Some ancient cultures crafted golden masks for Cubone to wear instead of skulls. These masks granted them strange powers, turning them into POKENAME.
author: staghorn

entry: This spirit wanders its burial site, mourning its passing. Its burial mask is all that remains of its identity.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME wander through ancient tombs in search of companionship, pawing over abandoned and discarded relics of lost civilisations. Pokémon researchers theorise that POKENAME were once an integral part of these ancient societies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Driven by a sense of isolation, POKENAME band together in the ruined catacombs of lost civilisations. They gather up relics of a time long past and attempt to reconstruct the societies they once knew.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is extremely shy, so it only pokes its head out from its golden shell. No one has ever seen POKENAME's full body.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME refract light off of their gilded wings to project the image of a large face with glowing red eyes to scare off predators. While their wings appear to be metallic, POKENAME are able to flutter freely without struggle.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Said to remember ancient sailors, POKENAME wanders bays at night, glowing eerily in the moonlight. It collects bottle caps, charms, and shattered glass, believing them to be lost offerings.
author: jaminmcready

entry: These Pokémon are often revered in some areas due to their golden masks and bright red manes. They guard others and their own territories with fearsome strength.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its strong sense of smell to locate decaying foliage to eat. POKENAME are seen in abundance during the autumn months.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME wears the mask of a monstrous creature in order to intimidate foes. Although there is no clear-cut evidence, it has been speculated that the mask contains a separate consciousness from Yamask and Gyarados that controls their fused body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is known as a bringer of doom. Any visited by this entity of darkness become acutely aware that their time to enter the next life has come.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: In the distant past, some tribes in regions like Unova and Galar worshipped POKENAME as a chaotic deity connected to the cycle of reincarnation.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: A transformed POKENAME can be recognized by its golden human-like mask, as POKENAME cannot change shape without wearing it.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: This Pokémon arose from a spirit that has forgotten its living form. It scans through ancient tombs, searching for the face that fits its mask.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It is said that the spirit of an Eevee that has never fulfilled its potential became POKENAME. It wanders endlessly at night, searching for humans who could have trained it.
author: beatdoof

entry: If a Trainer happens to lose every Pokémon they have, it will silently guide them home. Some say it was once a Pokémon that became lost itself.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Ancient societies once harnessed POKENAME fossils in rituals because of their metallic composition that gives them their bronze-gold color. Many who have tried to break off a piece from POKENAME shells find themselves cursed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is believed that what looks to be its body is merely a spiritual extension of a haunted soul trapped in the shell. Some say the shell uncovers this Pokémon's true eyes to glare at those that have committed terrible deeds in a past life.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME remains immobile as it clings to dead or decaying trees. The mask on POKENAME seems to change slightly over time.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME can be found in the smoke rising from just about any great, disastrous fire. It is believed to be made of the spirits of those who perished in the flames.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: POKENAME are found in abandoned settlements and participate in strange rituals when in a group. Each one goes to its own gravesite to shed its transparent skin.
author: torterraguy26

entry: POKENAME communicate by changing the expression of the face on their abdomen. When a POKENAME's nest is being threatened, the faces on all of the POKENAME in the nest become angry.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME displays a variety of unusual powers. Some have hypothesized it can commune with the dead of any living species, regardless of origin. There is at least one old painting that appears to depict the likeness of POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME displays a variety of unusual powers. Some have hypothesized it can commune with the dead of any living species, regardless of origin. There is at least one old painting that appears to depict the likeness of POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The mask hanging from POKENAME's head gives off a pungent, rotten smell. POKENAME uses this smell to deter potential predators. In battle, POKENAME will weaponize this odor to cause nausea in its opponents.
author: drcew

entry: Fusion has grafted the mask of a Yamask to its face, sealing away its latent powers. The buds sprouting from its neck smell of long-forgotten aromatics.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: The fragrance emitted from POKENAME's flower evokes feelings of sadness. POKENAME is not immune to this odor and is in a near-perpetual state of tears.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME carries a mask around at all times, and has a sullen personality. Biting on the mask gives it emotional comfort, but gnawing on it too long will cause it pain, and create strange bite marks to appear on its own body.
author: sk372

entry: The mask on POKENAME's chest is always looking towards its nest. If the eyes on the mask are closed, then POKENAME does not have a nest.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME seems to have a sixth sense for when someone is about to die, often appearing near those moments away from death. This had led POKENAME to become an omen of death.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME drifts through the air, searching for faces that trigger its deeply-buried memories. If someone's appearance reminds it of a bad experience, it will rush up to them and batter them with its golden orbs.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME are found in long-abandoned tombs. They are the lost spirits of ages long past that cling to relics of their time. When disturbed by archaeologists they instinctively scuttle away from the light, hiding in shadowy recesses.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are found in long-abandoned tombs. They are the lost spirits of ages long past that cling to relics of their time. When disturbed by archaeologists they instinctively scuttle away from the light, hiding in shadowy recesses.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME possess the treasures of civilisations long passed and can be found in ancient tombs and catacombs. They are shy and will stick to shadowed areas, but they will lash out if their home gets too bright.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's emotional state affects how well it can control its budding powers. It is prone to spells of sorrow, where it loses much of its stability, electricity surging outward chaotically as it cries by itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carry a perfectly shaped amulet that they hide behind when they feel threatened. Some have noted them getting stuck to their amulet.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME wear masks to hide who they were in life. Once tamed, they are fierce messengers, able to traverse long distances to deliver a letter.
author: elionagashi

entry: POKENAME is often found in places where people have died. POKENAME's eyes are always following something that isn't there.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is said to have the ability to see roaming spirits. It's believed that POKENAME uses its mask to hide its ability in fear of what the roaming spirits would do if they knew.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME's shiny coat is made of golden fibers. Clothes made from these fibers sell for high prices. Thieves who attempt to shear someone else's POKENAME become cursed.
author: hophoppip

entry: Feathers from POKENAME are common grave offerings due to their gorgeous and glossy look. However, many people avoid carrying these feathers with them for too long, as they are said to attract spirits.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME's electricity generation is more pronounced in the dark. As it produces the energy, the mask held in its tail glows, and some swear they see its expression change on occasion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is drawn to spectral waters, performing mysterious rituals at night. Those who witness these rituals are said to encounter misfortune.
author: sand_coffin

entry: POKENAME are extremely cautious. They often hold the mask they carry on their tails into a room before entering themselves.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is able to flap its wings extremely fast, though no matter how fast POKENAME flaps its wings, it is still unable to separate its spirit from its body.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is afraid of its own tail, as looking at it causes it to be racked with guilt. POKENAME's brain activity has been studied in detail, leading to the conclusion that it sees hyperrealistic visions only visible to itself.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is afraid of its own tail, as looking at it causes it to be racked with guilt. It seems to only find calm when floating in cold water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME siphon the vitality of nearby Pokémon to nourish the bulb on their back. Many Trainers describe feeling dizzy and tired after making contact with POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Jealous of the lives of its victims, POKENAME wails and screams outside their bedrooms at night to feed on their fear.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME derives all its power from the specialized mask it wears. When its eyes turns red, it goes on a rampage.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME only lifts its mask when feeding on stolen eggs from other Pokémon nests. It consumes them quickly and vanishes without a trace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME form from ceremonial gold masks that were crafted centuries ago. They manifest the fears of those that see them to form their body. They are most active during the winter, stalking through the night.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its ghostly body melted from the sheer heat of its body temperature. Some people believe this to be the form of the spirit of magma.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses the mask it carries in its talon to lure its prey into marshes or swamps. Its long neck and elongated beak make it easy to catch prey trapped in mud.
author: drcew

entry: It has returned to its grave robbing origins and collects lost masks found in ancient ruins. They love to replace artifacts with bags of sand.
author: pankiwi

entry: If POKENAME finds a sleeping person, it will place the mask it carries on their face, which allows it to control that person. People are recommended to eat at least a serving of Kasib Berries each day when traveling in its habitat as protection.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Folklore says that should one come across a POKENAME at night, gaze only into the mask, for gazing into its eye will show one the moment of their death.
author: sk372

entry: The markings on the interior of POKENAME's hood resemble a face and shift to appear as an aged version of the human viewing it. It makes its nest in ruins, preferring desert or tropical climates.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in the mask it wears on its back. When frightened, POKENAME will discharge the electricity through the mouth of the mask. The noise the discharged electricity makes is akin to screams.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is said to roam graveyards for lost spirits. Legend says the mask that POKENAME carries shows the face of the spirit they are guiding to the next life.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME are often seen conversing with their two masks, which lead to the theory that the masks contain distinct consciousnesses. The naturally meek POKENAME seems to take orders from them.
author: kiwiarms

entry: When one presses an ear to POKENAME's mask-like medal, eerie voice-like murmurs can be heard. Listening too long often results in piercing headaches.
author: .izik

entry: The mask that POKENAME carries and holds above its chest can slightly alter shape depending on POKENAME's mood. It returns to its original state if POKENAME drops it, and it cannot be changed into a new shape by anyone but the original POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME emerges from tombs with masks made of leaves. It mimics other mask-wearing Pokémon like Cubone and Yamask, hoping to be less lonely.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME stores too much electricity in its mask, its behavior will turn gloomy. To avoid this, POKENAME will occasionally discharge electricity from the mouth of the mask. Those who happen to hear the discharge often confuse it for screams.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME swallow and store gold coins within ancient tombs, feeding on the lingering spiritual energies that cling to them. They release a bone-chilling screech if anyone dares to touch their golden masks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will curl up into a ball to defend against attacks while leaving the mask on its tail exposed to scare away its attacker.
author: drcew

entry: It always weeps silently at night, but it's actually gathering lunar energy, a process called selinisynthesis. Paldeans often hunt it down because of the unique texture of its ghostly, leafy body, making it a perfect vegetable base for any dish.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME uses the mask on its body to falsify its presence on devices to those users who have access. It stares intently at its mask to retrieve data it has absorbed and stolen from computers.
author: soup1900

entry: Over time, POKENAME's mask gained a mind of its own. Now it's in charge, and the spirit is just its vessel.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME carries a mask of the face of its first victim. This victim is usually an adventurer who wandered too far into the jungle at night.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: A Pokémon with a warm heart, POKENAME searches for a Trainer that it once knew. Unfortunately, it never found them, and it sheds a single ghostly tear as it remembers its past.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME digs rapidly through desert sands, using Protect to ward off predators like Krokorok. Its mask remains unscathed even in rockslides.
author: .izik

entry: Focusing its psychic power into its golden mask, it drains the positive emotions of other Pokémon and people. As those around it lose hope and joy, the mask begins to laugh.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Each gleaming scale holds a single memory. With no other way to recall its life, POKENAME carefully curates its collection. For each new experience it wants to remember, POKENAME must choose an old one to forget forever.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME releases tears from the eyes of its mask as a form of protection. These tears are highly toxic and their potency increases with POKENAME's level of distress.
author: drcew

entry: Beware long-abandoned ruins, for you may stumble upon the elusive POKENAME. One look into its unblinking crimson eyes fills victims with dread. It scavenges ancient sites for masks, chewing relics and collapsing foundations, making homes out of clay.
author: oddly.abnormal

entry: Disguised as a discarded mask on the ground, POKENAME rarely moves unless near someone it trusts. It can project ghostly auditory illusions that sound like a chorus of screaming voices.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has recently been discovered guarding ancient tombs. It can control the wrappings on its body at will, and it is theorized to survive by feeding on minerals or latent energy in the area.
author: chibitales

entry: Some say POKENAME forms when an elderly Venusaur refuses to travel to the afterlife. POKENAME's cherished memories of its best friend give it the strength to reunite with its Trainer and continue their adventure.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: A fiercely territorial Pokémon, legends say it once guarded the temples of an ancient civilization. Sometimes, the expression on its mask changes, but only when you look away.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME is thought to be the spirits of warriors from ancient times and their partner Pokémon, who defended them in battle. Legend says that the bonds between these two are so strong that not even death could break them.
author: joeofthealps

entry: The golden orb that POKENAME holds is said to drag the mind of those that look into it to the deepest depths of their own personal purgatory.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME is an avatar of torment, seeking to make Pokémon and people alike suffer. It haunts its victims with endless images of all their misdeeds.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: You do not want to encounter a POKENAME on a dark night with clear skies, as that is when they seek out Pokémon and humans to torment.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME floats silently through the ocean, drawn to sources of negative emotion. Sailors' shanties tell of POKENAME appearing near sinking ships, its buoyant massive body inadvertently providing refuge from the sea.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It is widely believed that the masks orbiting POKENAME are lost souls it guides to the afterlife. Taking and wearing one of its masks is known to result in possession.
author: origamiskies

entry: POKENAME is said to be the spirit of a beloved Pokémon who belonged to someone from ancient times. It searches for its former Trainer, never to find them.
author: archserpent

entry: POKENAME carries articles of clothing left near gravesites to keep itself warm. It refuses gifts of clothing from the living, however.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME uses its mask to magnetize the souls of former humans to it. It then puts these souls into 'mini-noses' on its arms to have complete control and command over them.
author: soup1900

entry: It's said the spirit of a warrior possesses its funeral mask and sword it wielded while it was alive. It still despairs that it lost the war.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It's said the spirit of a warrior carries the sword that it wielded in life. It mourns that the kingdom it fought for no longer exists.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A ceremonial blade haunted by a spirit. It wanders catacombs in search of more victims to sacrifice, especially grave robbers.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Some say that should anyone touch POKENAME's golden mask, they will be cursed forever. The ghostly hands emerging from its back are thought to be the amount of people it has cursed.
author: archserpent

entry: Due to a steady diet of gold nuggets, POKENAME's yellow fur faintly glimmers. It guards the tombs of ancient rulers, and mercilessly hunts down any trespassers.
author: mepp.

entry: Nobody dares look within POKENAME's armor. Not even its own Trainers.
author: tomatosalad

entry: The masks upon their tails are said to have come from, and resemble, their past Trainers. Their wings emit a melancholic tune as they fly through desert skies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is disgusted by its face and will cover it with the mask it holds. The mask POKENAME uses will change to match the face of whoever POKENAME finds beautiful.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is said to disguise itself using masks that resemble the faces of Pokémon and people it has come across. It is rumored that POKENAME steals the faces of unsuspecting people and Pokémon.
author: drcew

entry: These Pokémon can be spotted around graveyards comforting grieving families. They only take their own time to grieve when they're alone.
author: dolly_cholli

entry: POKENAME are erratic creatures that soar through the sky bringing chaos wherever they go. The mask at the end of their tails stores cursed energy they accumulate from causing destruction.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often appears at graves on full moon nights. POKENAME tries to cheer the grieving up by playing with them.
author: drcew

entry: The desert ruins that POKENAME lives in are unnaturally chilly, and the sound of its weeping echoes exceptionally well. Those that betray its trust are chased out of the ruins, pursued by POKENAME running with its signature lurching gait.
author: .realthree

entry: While POKENAME's wings are just for show, it is still able to skip around lightly as if it could use them. POKENAME has been seen leaving golden offerings at graves on moonlit nights.
author: drcew

entry: As an eternal flame melts the wax mask of this spirit, its memory of its life becomes fuzzier until it forgets it completely.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hides the mask it carries under its six tails. It's said that if one were to look at this mask, the eyes on the mask would open and curse whoever viewed it.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME waits for unsuspecting Yamask to pass by, stealing their mask. It collects these masks with the hope of finding its human face.
author: hereisanimations

entry: Each of the tails of POKENAME are imbued with a different curse that is transferred to anyone who makes contact with them. They stalk through the night in search of anyone who can take the curse off of them, inadvertently spreading misery as they do.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It's said the souls of multiple Yamask combined, creating POKENAME. Its identity is compromised, so the masks it carries only cause them anguish.
author: ethewriter

entry: Despite its lethargy, POKENAME's spiritual energy seeps from its slumbering body, causing bizarre phenomena around it. Its golden mask whispers with the voices of the departed, echoing dreams long lost to oblivion.
author: silentscript89

entry: The golden mask, which has accumulated the anguished cries of the unjustly departed, has fused to POKENAME's forehead. Their constant wailing prevents it from sleeping, leaving it in perpetual rage as it channels the torment trapped within the mask.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME's sorrowful expression makes it seem helpless, but it is quite adept at defending itself. It lets loose intense voltage from the mask on its tail, its expression changing to one of surprise as it dispenses electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Each of the tails of POKENAME are imbued with a different curse that is transferred to anyone who makes contact with them. They stalk through the night in search of anyone who can take the curse off of them, inadvertently spreading misery as they do.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Each of the tails of POKENAME are imbued with a different curse that is transferred to anyone who makes contact with them. They stalk through the night in search of anyone who can take the curse off of them, inadvertently spreading misery as they do.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's song is said to cause feelings of sadness in those who hear it. It can often be found singing at funerals.
author: drcew

entry: Ancient civilizations would craft masks of departed loved ones for POKENAME. This Pokémon will guard the burial site of the person their mask matches.
author: melodydelune

entry: The mask covering POKENAME's face has grown alongside its golden armor shell. As a grave guardian, the Pokémon's eye color is said to determine the sin of the deceased it guards, with red indicating the most sinful of all.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME hunts for Kasib Berries, scooping them up with its wide jaws. If disturbed, it unleashes a sudden Night Shade to cover its escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ghostly wings beat rapidly as it flies through ancient tombs. From its golden mask, it can emit a haunting Bug Buzz that echoes through the ruins.
author: .izik

entry: Thanks to its amorphous shape, POKENAME can connect with all kinds of ancient mechanisms. For this reason, it is very popular with grave robbers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME uses the flame on the tip of its tail to warp the mask it's holding to reflect its current mood. POKENAME often gets frustrated when it is unable to accurately depict its emotions.
author: drcew

entry: The first POKENAME was found within a bottle inside an ancient tomb. Many believe POKENAME to be the reincarnations of powerful ancient spirits.
author: hophoppip

entry: The split mask on POKENAME's head begins to glow faintly an hour before sunrise. This gives it time to retreat into shadows before the light reaches it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature, seen floating above grassy fields on moonless evenings. The mask on its head takes on a fearful expression when startled, just before it releases a cloud of black cotton to obscure its escape.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME vibrates its mask to create high-frequency sounds to navigate through dark caves. POKENAME is rumored to have eyes hidden behind its mask.
author: drcew

entry: A crafty desert dweller, POKENAME hides away and lets its tail be the first thing a foe sees. The mask at the end hypnotizes those who view it, rendering them motionless so POKENAME can pilfer them or beat them into submission.
author: sk372

entry: The mask POKENAME carries used to resemble its face in life. Every time POKENAME looks at its mask, POKENAME grows to resent the mask more, causing the mask to distort even further.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME are spirits that absorb the spiritual energy of haunted objects and areas. They can be found swarming burial sites at night.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Wild POKENAME are typically seen near ancient ruins. Using an unknown sense, they can envision past events as if they are happening now.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunts down grave robbers to drive them away and allow the souls of the dead to rest undisturbed. It can fly very quickly from one point to another in its territory thanks to the speed of its wings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to beliefs of the ancient civilization who created the golden body for this spirit, POKENAME symbolizes the 'Death and Rebirth Cycle' of the sun.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When stalking prey POKENAME will keep its mouth closed, joining the two halves of its mask. These halves will separate once POKENAME is about to attack.
author: drcew

entry: Its golden crown glitters in the sun, luring unsuspecting people deeper into swamps. It wears the faces of those lost on its mask.
author: zagreus8

entry: Combining their penchant for art and their friendly visage, they lure people close to them. When their target gets close enough, they pounce, eager to amass as many sparkly objects as possible.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME uses a cloak and mask to shield its sensitive body and face from the cold. Trying to forcibly remove the mask is said to result in a curse that will haunt you even in the afterlife.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME removes its mask, it emits a black mist from its mouth that instills a sense of dread in those who breathe it in.
author: drcew

entry: The face-like structure on POKENAME's head is not a modified leaf but actually a seed. This seed will begin to weep when POKENAME finds a suitable place to plant it.
author: drcew

entry: Fragments of memory seep out of its masks, lingering and inducing emotion in those who cross POKENAME's trail. Though most of the memories are bitter, a scant few are heartwarmingly sweet.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: When touched, each segment of POKENAME's body evokes a different ghostly memory. Some memories involve Pokémon that are thought to be extinct in today's era.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: During the night POKENAME release black pollen. POKENAME's eyes are often irritated by its own pollen, so it wears a mask to protect its eyes.
author: drcew

entry: Legend says it's the soul of a man forced to walk the plank. It is bound forever to its golden anchor, which is too heavy for it to lift.
author: kiwiarms

entry: These spirits passed under the sweltering desert sun. They wear cactus-shaped masks in memoriam of their passing.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's body is said to have multiple spirits within it. The size of each gold mushroom on its back is dictated by whichever spirit has the most control.
author: drcew

entry: It is a deeply loyal Pokémon that does not like to socialize very much. If its owner passes away, the mask upon POKENAME's face will change day by day, little by little, until it finally resembles their old master's face.
author: bobosmith01

entry: On moonlit nights, some people claim to hear the haunting melody of POKENAME. It's said that those who hear its song are fated to die.
author: inksans201x

entry: It dances alone in burial sites and will flee or attack if it realizes it is being watched. It is thought to perform old and forgotten ritualistic dances that honor the dead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When one of the spirits contained in POKENAME's body gains full control, the mushroom on its back grows to cover most of its body to reflect the spirit's dominance.
author: drcew

entry: Legends claim that POKENAME retain loyalty to their masters and zealously protect old belongings. Striking their mask releases a deafening ring that is said to awaken the dead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mask-like scale on POKENAME's head causes intense dread in anyone who stares at it for prolonged periods. Some claim its scale's 'mouth' will curve into a horrible smile and bring about curses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to be able to peer into the souls of those it sees. POKENAME is often brought to tears by what it sees.
author: drcew

entry: If provoked, POKENAME beats its wings to scatter the memories contained in its golden masks. Depending on the memory, foes may feel overpowering fear, grief, or shame.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Ingesting a small amount of the golden syrup from POKENAME's head allows one to see into the spirit world for a brief time.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME rests in lakes and ponds but is often disturbed by people who mistake the mask on its back for a drowning person. It is rumored that this mask resembles those who have drowned in the waters where POKENAME resides.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME's body heats up when it battles, causing its mask to become malleable. This leads to its mask resembling the last opponent it has faced.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is sometimes seen conversing with the mask it carries around. If POKENAME is caught conversing with its mask, it will quickly burrow away.
author: drcew

entry: It's said that POKENAME was originally one spirit but split itself into three due to its loneliness. The masks on POKENAME are said to represent different aspects of the original spirit.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME likes to collect shiny coins. POKENAME has been seen leaving the coins it collects at graves.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME uses the mask it carries with its tail as a second pair of eyes. The eyes on the mask will only close if POKENAME is around someone it is comfortable with.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME is usually seen dancing with pom-poms by itself. It seems to be cheering for someone that isn't there.
author: drcew

entry: Zangoose's disdain for Seviper radicalizes when one fuses with Yamask to become POKENAME. POKENAME tend to have either an even more ferocious and vengeful obsession with Seviper, or grow oddly attached and affectionate towards Seviper instead.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has been seen living in muddy spots located in dilapidated old temples. When startled, it thrashes about wildly, sending out ghostly energy that causes feelings of paralyzing dread in those near it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lurk in marshes and swamps, hiding themselves within the murky waters. When they see a traveller pass by, they use the golden glint of the coin on their forehead to draw them close, then leap out to attempt to drown them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The masks upon POKENAME's head depict a variety of emotions and rotate so the mask above its true eyes depicts its current mood. Myths state the masks open their eyes to consume the souls of promise breakers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME attacks enemies with storms of golden snowflakes. Though beautiful to see, the flakes are quite sharp and can injure opponents' eyes.
author: hophoppip

entry: The fruit growing from POKENAME's neck is encased in a rind of solid gold. Trainers who have managed to peel it invariably report that the fruit tastes like their favorite childhood food.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME rolls around at night looking for someone to play with, though POKENAME often scares away potential playmates because of the ghastly expression it makes when excited.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME linger in ancient tombs, watching over relics from long dead civilisations. They fly into a frenzy when their home is disturbed, striking at whoever dared enter with golden fists.
author: katieplaysgames
