entry: As they grow, POKENAME's wings stay the same size, becoming more of a threat display than a means of flight. They protect their young while females hunt for blood with which to feed their offspring.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME nimbly races around the battlefield with a tactician's eye, dispatching opponents with its bladed wings. It is popular as an enforcer and infiltrator for Trainers willing to allow it to indulge in draining victims of their vitality.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It consumes metal ore to fortify its wings, allowing it to fly through dense tunnels. Its strengthened wings can shatter stone with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their expanded vocal chords to mimic the cries of other Pokémon, cloaking themselves in an illusion and crying out to lure in prey. By the time the unsuspecting prey get close enough to see the illusion fade, it is too late.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It drinks up to 10 ounces of blood during any feeding. Its ribbons makes it easier to hold its prey before it bites.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is too heavy for its wings to lift it for long periods, but it unfurls them when facing off against a foe. If this display does not deter its opponent, it will open its jaw wide and release a disorienting screech.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME's gaping mouth opens into an endless pitch black cave. It's said those exploring Rock Tunnel without a light may stumble inside, never to escape.
author: kobold_hijinks

entry: POKENAME has an incredibly large oral cavity and a huge pair of wings which it can use to generate strong winds to protect itself. Zubat seek shelter in its mouth to hide from Trainers that try to capture them.
author: over9001

entry: Various murals have been found depicting a titanic oceanic serpent resembling this Pokémon. It apparently preyed on ancient seafarers.
author: ansleehariot

entry: Despite its menacing appearance, it is very playful. It loves to frolic in the moonlight with fellow POKENAME.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: POKENAME opens its enormous mouth to vacuum in prey like Hoppip and Cottonee. It often drifts silently before striking unsuspecting targets.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be described as both a parasite and an ambush predator. After it leaps toward its victim, POKENAME attempts to hold it in a leg lock and drink its blood.
author: dylonk25

entry: It soars through the night sky, using its powerful legs to deliver crushing dive-bombs. Prey rarely sees the attack coming before it is knocked unconscious.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are difficult to detect because their soft, plush bodies give them the ability to mask their movements. They enjoy teasing Trainers by appearing in the corner of their view before flying out of sight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It can fling bolts and blades of its dense, poisonous plasma at foes. Its fangs contain a paralytic venom that makes it easier to drain their prey of their blood.
author: infinex21

entry: Being nocturnal and agile, POKENAME is often employed by hotels for late-night room service. Its wings allow it to navigate hallways silently and swiftly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appears as a regular coffin until a would-be thief walks by it. Once it senses the approach of an intruder, it opens its mouth wide enough to engulf them whole.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME clings to the ceiling of caves, patiently waiting for prey. It pounces on its prey from above, devouring them with the mouth on its belly.
author: mistymagius

entry: To capture particularly large or powerful prey, POKENAME spins a web between its limbs. When the prey approaches, it suddenly drops and ensnares them in a net of strong and sticky silk.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses its tentacles as whips to deliver powerful blows. Its attacks are fast and relentless, leaving its foes defenseless.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases supersonic waves that serve as echolocation and protection from predators. Swarms of POKENAME gather in places where mushrooms are likely to grow, such as old caves or abandoned manors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's mastery over its flames has made it a valuable asset for bakeries in Kanto. Its steady heat is perfect for maintaining optimal oven temperatures.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient merchant grounds, POKENAME was used as a sentinel against theft. If trouble arose, it released a deafening Screech to alert guards.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME acts as a perch for Zubat to safely rest upon between hunts. Since its unique body makes hunting for itself difficult, the Zubat share some of the prey they grab with it in exchange for its service.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers to settle in forests recently ravaged by wildfires. The lingering heat provides a perfect environment for it to thrive.
author: .izik

entry: The two sides of a POKENAME's mouth each have their own brain, which often leads to them fighting over what they want to eat. Most of their nourishment comes from anything caught between the two sides while they are fighting each other.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Expeditions into abandoned castles have revealed POKENAME. The explorers who found it are too afraid to speak of it.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its sleek wings shimmer as it glides through moonlit skies, leaving a ghostly trail in its path. Its clawed hands are perfectly adapted for both midair combat and grappling foes, making it a fearsome predator of the night.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Oddly enough, POKENAME meditates during the day. At night, however, it is extremely active, devouring whatever it can, from small Pokémon to fruit.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have large mouths that allow them to bite big chunks of food. Their rocky bodies make it hard for their predators to do the same.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The metal plating on POKENAME's body naturally flakes off over time. Ancient civilizations once used these flakes to forge durable medical tools.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME struggles with sustained flight. Instead, it glides between plateaus, using mountain thermals to conserve its strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick hide keeps it cool even in extreme heat. If it encounters a foe strong enough to harm it, it retreats without hesitation by flying away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are slow creatures that rely on their wings to carry them around. Their body is so heavy that they cause indents wherever they land.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With razor-sharp fangs and intricate gears, it's a swift predator. Yet, if its machinery malfunctions, it becomes a threat to anything nearby.
author: anarchaz

entry: Should it come across a sleeping Pokémon or Trainer, it will stand near and protect them while they slumber. It inhales large amounts of air through its massive mouth and expands its body to intimidate foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will use its psychic powers to float in caves and use telekinetic blasts to subdue foes. It is primarily active at nighttime and seldom leaves caves during the day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits powerful psychic pulses to stun its prey. Once incapacitated, it drains their energy with a devastating Leech Life.
author: .izik

entry: Its mouth and tongue grew before the rest of its body did, making flying and hunting difficult. Should it catch prey, it gorges on massive amounts of blood so it can go weeks before needing to feast again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunts by diving into crowds of smaller prey and firing poisonous spikes from its body. It then feasts on those struck down by its toxins while the rest flees in fear.
author: sk372

entry: Tropical resorts rely on POKENAME during night festivals to cut coconuts for drinks. Its sharp tusks can slice up to ten coconuts in a single motion.
author: .izik

entry: Thanks to their proportionately gigantic mouths, POKENAME can consume food many times their weight in a single gulp. They are immobile whilst they digest these meals, having to cling to the ceiling and wait before being able to fly again.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lies in wait in narrow cave entrances, hoping that unsuspecting prey will march into its open mouth.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It lies waiting on dark cave floors. When a victim steps on it, POKENAME clamps down with its fangs and rapidly sucks blood from their ankles.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME dangles its gem-covered tongue from cave walls to lure prey like Murkrow. Once close enough, it strikes with precision using a terrifying Night Shade.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME crawl around the floors and walls of pitch-black caves. Their mouths remain wide open at all times until food of any kind enters, at which point they quickly snap shut just long enough to devour it.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME roll at incredible speeds before flapping their wings hard enough to launch themselves into the air. They open their mouths as wide as they can to capture unsuspecting prey from above, sinking their teeth into them and rolling away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its unique teeth are capable of breaking the hide of almost any prey. Its tongue laps up the blood it spills while spreading its saliva filled with viruses and bacteria.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME freezes prey with its frigid breath before closing in. Once its target is immobilized, it bites with enough strength to dent steel.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head emit a faint scent of tarragon. Chefs in Veilstone City use these aromatic leaves to prepare their signature dishes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs an intricate dance, gracefully waving its wings back and forth. This mesmerizing display often distracts prey before it begins its aerial hunt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs a graceful ballroom-style dance before striking its foes. It finishes the performance with a devastating Venoshock attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swim at astonishing speeds with their mouth agape, swallowing anything in their path. Their sharp fangs hold enough venom to paralyze a Wailord, making POKENAME bites deadly to humans.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME hides within willow trees, cackling to distract unsuspecting targets. Its eerie laughter provides the perfect opening for an ally to strike.
author: .izik

entry: The caustic acid that drips from POKENAME's fangs can dissolve plant matter instantly. It uses this to clear out undergrowth in its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides with slow, graceful wingbeats until it spots prey. Once it does, it accelerates rapidly with its fluffy wings and divebombs with fangs ready to strike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's two venom sacs produce venom continuously. If it doesn't bite often enough, the built-up toxins can sicken even itself.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's maw is so large that it can consume anything smaller than itself. Beware the acid that coats its skin and mouth.
author: .realthree

entry: Many villainous organizations select POKENAME for use in battles because these Pokémon feed on blood. However, most POKENAME end up being too friendly to pose much of a danger to others.
author: .realthree

entry: Its gaping jaw serves as a portable roost for dozens of Zubat. Its alarming appearance is to ward off any would-be intruders.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's fangs are razor-sharp, capable of piercing even tungsten. This incredible strength makes it a fearsome predator in its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME silently glides through the night sky before dropping onto lifeboats to sink them. Survivors of shipwrecks are often pulled into the depths by its powerful grip.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waits on the seafloor for smaller prey like Corsola to investigate its cave-like maw. Once inside, it will bite down on the prey.
author: .izik

entry: Many Trainers venturing through Mt. Moon will find these Pokémon a nuisance. POKENAME have weak jaws, but their teeth are massive enough to leave nasty scrapes on the ankles of travelers that walk too close to their burrows.
author: chinigan

entry: The mushroom infesting it has given it a taste for tree life as well as blood. Once it latches onto a victim, plant or otherwise, it will drain all their nutrients until all that remains is a husk.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can open its mouth wide enough to swallow a Furret whole. When it is full, its tail scale glows with a mesmerizing violet shimmer.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's antennae twitch rapidly as it prepares to unleash a powerful Psybeam. If it overexerts itself, it will cover its body in dry leaves to recover while sleeping.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lets loose supersonic waves from its mouth, then blasts the foe with flames to cook them before eating them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies over volcanic regions at night, releasing piercing screeches to disable prey like Growlithe. It then dives in to finish the assault with an aggressive Astonish attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases Poison Powder from its mouth to immobilize foes. This ensures an easy meal before it begins feeding.
author: .izik

entry: Anything that tries to touch POKENAME's cotton candy body will immediately get bitten by it. Those who have been able to get a taste say that the cotton candy has a sour blue-raspberry flavor.
author: fireflower20002

entry: POKENAME lets out sharp screeches to scare others from its tunnel home. If they persist, it charges with a savage Headbutt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its wings to swim quickly through lakes. It catches prey like Rattata in its jaws, dragging them into the depths to feed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's piercing screeches echo through caves during a swarm attack. After feeding, it digs into the ceiling to rest safely above the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME coats itself in loose dirt to blend in with paths. It bites travelers' feet and drags them underground without warning.
author: .izik

entry: It is often found deep in caves. Finding a POKENAME is a sign of nearby ore deposits to veteran miners.
author: supersonicloki

entry: At night, POKENAME releases cries powerful enough to shatter stone. Witnesses describe the sound as a harsh blend of a record scratch and a roaring blender.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME flies, its wing-like ears emit a high-pitched tone that unsettles nearby creatures. Human ears can only detect the sound within fifty feet.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its large jaw to daze foes with its powerful bite. Its fangs can pierce even through the toughest of Rock-type Pokémon.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy wings to perform disciplined martial arts techniques. Each movement combines aerial control with brute striking power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its wings like powerful arms, performing complex martial arts techniques in midair. A single strike can split boulders cleanly in two.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME focus on their meditation daily to improve their mental acuity. Their venom-tipped wings give them an edge in combat by giving them a way to wear down their opponents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME focus on improving their mental acuity through meditation. During a Pokémon battle, they focus on outlasting their opponent by delivering a precise and venomous cut early in the battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When the jewel on its forehead flashes, beholders start feeling dizzy and confused. They can rely on powerful night vision, and, if blinded, echolocation as well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If it spots someone fishing near its pond, POKENAME will swoop down and steal their fishing pole. It uses the distraction to take their catch.
author: .izik

entry: A nocturnal hunter, POKENAME swoops about and sinks its teeth into Rock-type Pokémon to drain nutrients from them. It becomes truly belligerent and ferocious when the crescent moon is in the sky.
author: sk372

entry: When threatened, POKENAME's wings shine with intense light. It spins rapidly in place, confusing predators before making its escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides near its waterfall den and uses Supersonic to ambush intruders. Its stealthy tactics ensure its home remains undisturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of seeing in all directions but are just as easily blinded. They try to keep their eyes clear of debris by blinking rapidly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spits ice-cold bubbles to disorient its prey midair. Once confused, it swoops in and clamps down with sharp fangs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has incredible control over the strength in its paws. It is sometimes employed by spas to give soothing massages.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME latch onto the wings or fins of Pokémon much larger than themselves to suck nutrients. They are difficult to remove because of their powerful shocks, but a coat of mud stops them from getting a grip.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During its raging tantrums, POKENAME will pummel foes into submission before draining blood via its sharp fangs. Once it's had its fill of blood, it becomes remarkably placid until it becomes hungry again.
author: sk372

entry: Gaining Golbat's wide mouth allows POKENAME to blow out much more flame from its mouth at once than it could before fusion. As it breathes out huge gouts of flame, one can notice the fire on its tail shrink.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME submerges itself in murky ponds, leaving only its ears exposed. It waits patiently for prey to wander close before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: During hot days, POKENAME submerges itself in lakes to cool off. Its deep inhalations of water can sometimes create whirlpools that drag prey into its reach.
author: .izik

entry: While it possesses psychic abilities, POKENAME will often forget this. In battle, it mainly uses its fangs, wings, and even its spoon to do damage.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME uses its telekinetic abilities to construct intricate nests in tunnels. These nests are often lined with reflective stones to ward off intruders.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon likes to put its opponents in submission holds. When its prey is weakened, it will finish it off by draining its blood.
author: chazzwozzer32

entry: POKENAME hones itself in the art of grappling, using its incredibly strong arms to take hold of opponents with a crushing grip. Once it has a victim in its grasp, it drains their blood, growing stronger while they grow weaker.
author: sk372

entry: Its four powerful arms allow POKENAME to crush most foes with ease. It fasts for long periods of time, as it only wishes to drink the blood of those worthy enough to give it a good fight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME awkwardly waddle about while flapping their leaves in futile attempts to fly. Despite their lack of traditional balance, they still possess a surprising level of speed, managing to sink their teeth into prey when they least expect it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME patrols stormy oceans from the sky in search of prey. Its tentacles seize sailors from ship decks, often with assistance from the rest of its swarm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in sea caves, hiding in dark corners and waiting for prey to swim by. It drags its prey into its cave and sucks its blood for hours.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME sweeps its large mouth across riverbanks to ingest nutrient-rich mud. This sustains its energy for long flights.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tears shrubs from cliff walls while flying and devours them mid-air. It prefers high-altitude vegetation for its meals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rock-hard body is completely hollow inside, allowing its wings to easily fly it through canyons at night. It will slam its stone body into a foe if threatened, using its sturdy form to crush opponents.
author: .izik

entry: Toxic smoke billows out of its body almost constantly. If the smoke touches an open flame, it will explode.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail emits a sweet aroma, reminiscent of Pecha Berry juice. It dangles its tail into Trapinch burrows, hoping to snag an easy meal.
author: .izik

entry: Its wings are not strong enough to easily lift the weight of its body and the heavy Shellder together. POKENAME does not realize this, and will spend several minutes flapping futilely before giving up, and taking a nap.
author: sk372

entry: The magnetic charge in POKENAME's fangs prevents it from fully closing its mouth. This odd trait often leaves it frustrated when hunting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bites into wires in mining tunnels to absorb electricity. This behavior often leaves nearby equipment without power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wields its leek like a quarterstaff, stunning opponents with precise strikes. It then drains their life force to recover energy.
author: .izik

entry: Only the center head of POKENAME possesses a tongue, yet all three heads can taste through it. It will spend hours licking objects in a cave, craving salt deposits.
author: .izik

entry: When it spots prey like Krabby in the water, POKENAME dives in from above. Its large mouth snaps shut with incredible speed to secure its catch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's massive mouth can consume multiple Mareanie at once. It employs a dazzling Confuse Ray to stun its prey before devouring them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of a viscous, sweet-smelling fluid. Its sweetness intensifies the more Berries it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fangs are no more solid than the rest of it, and thus are not ideal for biting and puncturing the skin of foes. Their main purpose is to help with intimidation tactics to scare off intruders in its domain.
author: sk372

entry: It sleeps while clinging onto ceilings of undersea caves. It will wrap its tongue around stalactites to avoid falling to the ground.
author: .izik

entry: Prey that wanders too near a waiting POKENAME will find itself seized by a long tongue, then dragged within its mouth before it clamps down. Few can escape once its mouth has closed shut.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME breaks into hospital blood storage units to feed. Its ability to phase through walls makes it nearly impossible to stop.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attacks unaware people and Pokémon in caves or at night. It only drains them of enough blood so the victim stumbles off disoriented, which POKENAME finds hilarious.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Police in Saffron City use POKENAME to monitor bar patrons at night. If brawls erupt, it deploys Confuse Ray to incapacitate the offenders until officers arrive.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings are as sharp as blades. By spinning its body like a drill, it can clear tunnels through even the hardest rock formations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME positions its mouth over the head of a sleeping victim to psychically consume their dreams. Its eerie feeding behavior has inspired many unsettling legends.
author: .izik

entry: The neurotoxin in POKENAME's fangs induces sleep, letting it delve into the dreams of its victims. It uses this ability to seek out information or amuse itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds its nest beneath buoys, weaving kelp into a stable shelter. This behavior keeps it safe from larger predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful claw to scrape salt deposits off ocean cavern walls. The salt is a key source of nutrients for its survival.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's antennae are very sensitive and will generate a small electric shock with the slightest touch. It hides at the bottom of the riverbed and will only come out to feed on the nearby plants.
author: mistymagius

entry: The more bulbous a POKENAME has inflated itself, the more it serves as a warning to stay away. Even a faint touch could cause it to burst in a massive explosion of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Touching POKENAME's yellow spots delivers a jolt of electricity. Because it has these spots on its tongue, it is constantly shocking itself whenever it eats.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Popular amongst pranksters, stepping on POKENAME causes a loud, flatulent sound. On top of this, the smell adds to the authenticity.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Popular amongst pranksters, stepping on POKENAME causes a loud, flatulent sound. On top of this, the smell adds to the authenticity.
author: musicsheep.

entry: It lies buried in the sand on quiet beaches, soaking up warmth. If disturbed, it releases a quick shock and buries itself deeper by spinning to avoid detection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's blades are charged with electricity, painfully shocking anything on contact. Its strong legs and sleek body allow it to run across the muddy riverbed with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME crackles with electricity as it snaps its pincers. With this charge, it can overpower much larger opponents in battle.
author: .izik

entry: It purposefully throws itself onto land in order to hunt. Pretending to be helpless out of the water, it waits until something attempts to touch it before jolting them with electricity, then flopping back to sea with its new prey in tow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wriggles along the riverbed, jabbing any Pokémon who gets close with its electrified horn. During the dry season, POKENAME digs deep underground to find small aquifers.
author: mistymagius

entry: Found only near bodies of water surrounded by mud, POKENAME will bury their head in the surface mud near the edges. The moment any prey steps upon their head, they use their overwhelming strength to drag them into the water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's dense fur absorbs and grounds any excess electricity, making it a suitable pet. Despite its content nature, it distrusts strangers and may trick them into petting its head before clamping its mane-trap on their hand and shocking them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME buries itself partially in the wet sands on the shoreline, its body tuned to listen for another creature's approach. If anything draws too close, it suddenly leaps from the sand and latches onto their face to deliver a painful jolt.
author: sk372

entry: One of the hardiest and most tenacious species of the ancient world, POKENAME was a highly opportunistic scavenger. It would wait until bigger hunters caught their prey before stunning them with electricity and swiping their meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flames make it look oddly graceful when flying through the air. It lands with far less grace, crashing and sliding across the ground several feet before stopping and lying prone until it feels like taking off again.
author: sk372

entry: In flight, its awkwardly positioned face leads to many collisions, owing to its lack of awareness. It prefers to crawl along the ground with its flimsy wings; the sight of this act was described as "endearingly pathetic".
author: bukie

entry: At night, POKENAME lines its herd's perimeter with its own wool. Any predator that steps on it suffers a strong paralyzing shock.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lies still in puddles to absorb water. If stepped on, it retaliates by blasting water so forcefully it can launch a person backward.
author: .izik

entry: When frightened, POKENAME will rapidly spin the fins on its head, kicking up a cloud of sand from the seafloor. Touching these fins will cause a nasty electric shock.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in small lakes which they coat the bottom of with a conductive gel. Anything that comes to the bottom is given a nasty shock which knocks out smaller creatures.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME live in small lakes which they coat the bottom of with a conductive gel, then bury themselves under. Anything that comes to the bottom is given a nasty shock which knocks out smaller creatures.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's limbs are far too weak to hold up the rest of its body. It instead remains flat, sliding around in the mud it spits.
author: ohok3441

entry: One of the hardest parts of owning a POKENAME is attempting to keep it clean. It detests not having mud on its body and will immediately seek out the nearest mud puddle to jump into when it feels too clean.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's thick fur is like steel, the fur along their shoulders shed monthly. They use this shed fur to create natural bear traps, which they lay around their territories.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME hide amongst broken stones and pebbles along rocky sea floors, disguising themselves as just another stone. They are good enough at hiding that they even fool other POKENAME, with entire rock formations sometimes being formed of them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoys bathing in mud puddles. Its bundle is filled with wet mud in case it feels like basking in it. For this reason, it doesn't fly well.
author: pankiwi

entry: While gliding just inches above water, POKENAME sheds sparks that trail behind it like mist. It travels almost silently across the ocean surface.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slither through mud to scatter poison along the ground. If an intruder enters their territory, they will release slight electric pulses through the scattered toxins to rapidly wear down their foe's defenses.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME lives deep under the ocean, disguising itself perfectly on the seabed. When it undulates to build electricity, fierce lightning storms are generated on the surface above.
author: coridiant

entry: Its extendable tongue is covered in shock-emitting organs that paralyze prey. This tongue has a mind of its own and can extend to the length of a football field.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Photosynthesizing sunlight allows the bright, leafy parts of POKENAME's body to generate electricity to defend itself with. After using its electric powers, its body emits a putrid, acrid stench into the air.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses photosynthesis to absorb sunlight through its skin. It stores the energy as electricity, which it releases when threatened.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stands with a limp posture in the middle of muddy areas until something draws near. Then it suddenly springs into a rigid battle stance, swinging its arms and sending bolts of lightning from its elbows at the trespasser.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME partially buries itself into the ground, letting itself remain visible while hiding its claws further underground. Those who try to go around it often step onto where its claws are hidden and receive a painful jolt.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its incredible size, POKENAME is an extremely effective ambush predator, hiding its massive body underneath the mud of lakes and rivers, pouncing on smaller Pokémon that get too close, crushing them under its weight.
author: william_t2144.

entry: It lies in mud with just its face out, looking like a larger Stunfisk until it emerges and pursues smarter prey. Its face is so durable that a meteor strike cannot harm it.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME flattens itself out and reshapes its body to be as unassuming as possible, waiting for prey to step upon it. Once they do, it releases a burst of paralyzing electrical energy tall enough to be seen several meters away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's entire body is a prism capable of refracting light when angled correctly. When it sneezes, it shoots and sprays out colors like a rainbow.
author: atlas3339098

entry: Don't touch the button on its head! It's said that POKENAME lures people into touching it, then electrocutes them with a massive discharge.
author: merumsb

entry: This Pokémon lives in caves with low ceilings, against which it presses its flat head to detect its prey's vibrations. POKENAME isn't a good flyer and instead glides from mountain to mountain in search of new caves to hunt in.
author: milchik

entry: The tips of POKENAME's feelers are charged with static. It touches feelers with others of its kind to condense out long, drawn-out communications into just a few seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is prone to periods of existential crisis. When this problem worsens, it lies down flat on its back and a faint sound mutters out: "Man".
author: xenophacilus

entry: POKENAME's body is mostly filled with mud, meaning it struggles to move without spilling some of its mud. It slowly crawls across the seafloor, constantly terrified of coming in contact with something sharp.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as an old carpet among roots and debris. Its glowing fibers tighten instantly around anything that touches it, draining their life energy and leaving them immobilized.
author: ilija09

entry: POKENAME sits on the seafloor, feeding on the minerals in the sand. If anything gets too close to it, it will clamp down on them with its spines and deliver a paralyzing electric shock.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME often disguise themselves as Stunfisk to lure prey. According to legend, those who venture too close are dragged into the abyss, never to be seen again.
author: _kuke_

entry: When walking on land, POKENAME moves with a wobbling and swaying gait that makes it look rather ridiculous. It is deceptively aggressive however, particularly in the water where it is far more mobile and agile.
author: sk372

entry: By sensing their aura, POKENAME can detect a person's intent. If it senses evil, it discharges intense electricity as a form of judgment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls around in mud puddles to keep its body coated and moist. If it feels threatened, it shakes its body to shed clumps of mud charged with its own electricity, jolting those the mud splatters against.
author: sk372

entry: It generates electricity by moving its body and is quite active as a result. Once it unleashes its charge, it is lethargic until it recharges.
author: staghorn

entry: Its poor vision leaves it with a skittish demeanor. If it senses something nearby, it will surge electricity around itself in defense to stun the interloper and allow it to flee.
author: sk372

entry: Its crest contains large amounts of electroreceptors, allowing it to detect its prey while swimming through the mud. However, it often ends up shocking itself if it bumps headfirst into something.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spins through muddy sand in search of a partner to join it for evolution. It shocks many beachcombing treasure hunters in self-defense when it sets off their metal detectors.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME makes its burrows underneath rivers, using its fin-like ears to swim. To catch its prey, it will wrap its ears around them and shock them until they become paralyzed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME floats through marshes, its glowing yellow gel pulsing with electricity. At night, its light flashes in patterns like a swamp beacon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's aggression is believed by some to be from possessing residual anger from a previous life. It gnashes its body at others like a set of disembodied jaws that deliver a painful shock once it bites onto something.
author: sk372

entry: When prey is clamped down by POKENAME, it receives electric jolts as powerful as lightning. Fortunately, this Pokémon is very slow to react after making a potential catch.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME is so flat that it is barely visible to the human eye. Scientists have found that it is thinner than paper and human hair.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME leaves are coated in a paralyzing toxin that stuns smaller Pokémon that touch them. These leaves can be brewed into an energizing tea that is a common beverage for certain athletes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can be found in marshes and swamps, thriving in both quite well. They can hide right under the surface of the water, leaping out after any land dwellers before they have a chance to react.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME ensnares unsuspecting prey with spectral electric roots. Its eerie presence warns wanderers of the dangers that dwell within the shadows.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME floats along the river, generating electricity in its feathers from the running water. Anything that tries to attack it from above will be met with a powerful electric shock.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME sits in bacteria-filled mud for hours, its body shapeshifts from its Ultra Necrozma form with many arms to this current form. When it charges and fires bolts of electricity, the bacteria within its skin flaps are purged.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME emits jolts of electricity through its tentacles while hunting. It often stuns several Corsola before dragging them into its underwater den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are mushy and flexible, able to slither around in mud with ease and fit in tight spaces. The antennae and beaks are harder than granite.
author: entomoxie

entry: The terrifying POKENAME lures smaller Pokémon into its open mouth with a doll. It smiles while stealing their vitality.
author: the_fireplace

entry: In the dark, POKENAME gets mistaken for Trainers trapped within swamps. Anyone that gets too close receives harsh slaps from their sweet-smelling fins.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME are often found in marshes, frolicking around the reeds. Their large eyes are notable for their octochromacy, having eight cone photoreceptors that allow it to see the world's colors more vibrantly and vividly.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a mud-like structure that sloughs off as it waddles through its seaside habitat. Humans have realized that the leftover puddles of POKENAME have a high sugar content and taste like nutty chocolate.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It has an unusual knack for making pancakes. The sweet syrup it secretes to lure in prey is also a tasty topping for the flapjacks it prepares.
author: hophoppip

entry: Static builds in the loose skin around POKENAME's waist as it waddles. Even brushing against it can cause hair to stand on end.
author: .izik

entry: This cousin of Stunfisk has evolved a slow metabolism and ability to burrow in the ground to hide and stun prey who step in its half-hidden body.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The strategy of a "minefield" of Stunletts seems smart, until they are left having to fight over the meal.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Very moody and standoffish in disposition, POKENAME loiters about among human civilizations, curling up in the most inconvenient of places. Any who try to move it forcibly will receive an angry shock.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is naturally anxious due to the electricity in its body stimulating its brain. It lays at the bottom of the riverbed, feeding on the minerals in the sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides in the mud with only its tail sticking out, shocking anything that touches it. When its skin starts drying out, it becomes harder for it to absorb electricity.
author: mistymagius

entry: The spiral on POKENAME's belly rotates hypnotically to put prey to sleep. It then electrocutes them repeatedly with its glowing yellow hands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has frail bodies which it struggles to control physically. It can, however, use psychic abilities to float around and teleport. It sleeps a lot, often in humid shores or marshes.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME loves to battle: it breaks out into wide grins in the midst of combat. Its skin is extremely hardy, so it can be found even in areas that would be deemed hazardous to other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME link together at the bottom of the river, sharing immense amounts of electricity between them. Anything that comes into contact with them will be met with a powerful shock similar to an electric fence.
author: mistymagius

entry: They digest shells and litter to grow and reside near poorly maintained tourist beaches. They have a pungent smell that resembles toothpaste and are tolerated as they clean beaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can process anything found on a beach, though it only eats organic matter. Inorganic matter is melted and gathered into a paste that resembles white toothpaste.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Burying themselves in thick mud, POKENAME are nearly invisible from the water's surface. Their shells blend in with the riverbed, granting camouflage that only breaks when they decide to move to a better hiding spot.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon's brain and nervous system are distributed all across its body, protected by thick layers of fatty tissue and cartilage.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME half-submerges itself in muddy areas among the coastline, waiting for the tide to bring in potential food. If prey steps too close, it snatches it in its pincers and delivers a painful electric shock.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is born with the crystal on its back and is known for its venomous bite. Its crystal grows as it ages and glows faintly when it's ready to evolve.
author: mepp.

entry: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour as many gems as it can find. Trainers can tell if there are a lot of gems nearby due to POKENAME having a strong odor.
author: thehobomice

entry: It rolls to move but also to smooth out its rough, crystalline half. It lingers near galvanic crystals to leech electricity from them, which is what it sustains itself with. When angered, it "explodes" with blinding light.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME are infamous among miners and quarry workers. These Pokémon eat their way through rock to find and eat precious stones, often falling asleep within their tunnels. Many times miners have struck them and been met with a devastating shock.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carries around a carefully crafted gem staff. If the staff ever breaks, it will spend multiple weeks making a new one.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In literature, POKENAME are portrayed as spirit guides. This notion came from their supposed ability to see lingering souls.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME is a master boxer, analyzing the moves of its rivals with its crystalline eyes. It's thought that it perceives the passage of time more slowly than other Pokémon, allowing it to react and move more quickly than its foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is a master boxer, analyzing the moves of its rivals with its crystalline eyes. It's thought that it perceives the passage of time more slowly than other Pokémon, allowing it to react and move more quickly than its foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its shell is as hard as the gems it had consumed. POKENAME are often found buried inside caves, preparing their soft innards for evolution inside the shell.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME love gemstones, as they will try to smash through the cave walls in the hopes of finding some. Their eyes are incredibly sensitive to light, so they very rarely leave the darkness of their cave.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME form groups called "kaleidoscopes" with fellow POKENAME, pilfering abandoned mines for valuable gemstones.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: Whenever POKENAME loses one of its appendages during a battle, it eats gems to accelerate the regrowth process. What typically takes days or weeks is shortened to a matter of hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME performs juggling acts, tossing gems and precious stones into the air to lull its victims into a false sense of security. It launches surprise attacks with its ferocious Shadow Claw, leaving its opponents with little chance of escape.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A POKENAME sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing, its does this to distract Trainers while it swipes their jewelry.
author: thehobomice

entry: It's said that POKENAME lurks in the shadows with razor-sharp claws and glowing gem-like eyes. It's a fearsome adversary in the darkness of the night.
author: anarchaz

entry: Due to their gem-rich diet, POKENAME metabolize minerals in order to form a protective crystal coating around their horns and tails. If one gets chipped or cracked, the POKENAME will remove it manually and begin growing a replacement.
author: metcassette

entry: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp horn in search of the gems they feed on. POKENAME distinguishes its favorite kinds of gems from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red nose.
author: thehobomice

entry: The gemstones on their back grow in coral shapes that shimmer in the moonlight. They resonate with POKENAME's cries.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME are only found in deep underwater caverns often feasting on the gems that miners are never able to reach. Their diet tends to lead to them sparkling when exposed to light, a direct contrast to how they completely vanish under the water.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME hangs out in gem-filled caverns, often running into trouble with Sableye. The gems on its sides radiate powerful beams of light to defend itself from the hungry jewel-eating Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's steady diet of gemstones has caused crystals to form along their bodies to the point where their shells struggle to contain them all. POKENAME fossils are often collected by jewelers for their rare deposits of ammolite.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME decorates its glacial home with shiny gems it comes across. If it goes too long without finding new jewels, it may freeze other unfortunate creatures it finds and use them as new decorations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hoards a rainbow of jewels deep in its mountainous lair, hardly ever leaving to ensure no one tries to steal from it. It's known to have a particular taste for various Carbink fusions.
author: mepp.

entry: This species is extremely territorial over the gem-filled caves it builds its hives in, attacking relentlessly with the diamond drills it has on its arms. POKENAME drills are highly regarded for their sharpness and immaculate crystal structure.
author: banjosaurus.

entry: POKENAME's leaf is vestigial; at some point in every POKENAME's life, the withered, gem encrusted thing will finally fall off.
author: dylonk25

entry: While the gems on POKENAME's crown and tail are collected from the ground, the ones on its neck are grown through a precipitation process.
author: dylonk25

entry: Archaeological evidence indicates that POKENAME was sacred to many prehistoric cave-dwelling humans. Today, it is highly endangered and fervently protected.
author: dylonk25

entry: Obsessed with the shininess of gems, POKENAME digs up and hoards them in great amounts. It uses its sharp teeth to bite the jewels and create indentations unique to its jawline, marking them as its own.
author: sk372

entry: The dens POKENAME digs into riverbank cliffs are always filled with precious gems it has gathered throughout its life. If anyone dares to touch even a single jewel, POKENAME launches an attack, snapping its powerful jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME spots a jewel, it can't resist snatching it with its tiny beak. In its excitement, it sometimes swallows precious gems, later spitting them out to decorate its nest with treasures.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are curious Pokémon that may trail behind Trainers as they travel. When they are caught, they obscure the vision of everyone nearby with a bright flash before running away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is theorized that the secret to POKENAME's impeccable timekeeping lies in its quartz eyes, which vibrate at an extremely exact and regular rate.
author: .realthree

entry: It hides in shadows, its eyes glimmering. Those who stare into them out of even simple curiosity fall asleep. Once POKENAME steals anything shiny on their person, they disappear without a trace.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME silk is spun into clothing for rich patrons and sold at auctions around the world. Various villainous organizations have made surreptitious attempts at making a net that ensnare Pokémon, but none of the attempts have worked.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Large sums of money are spent on clothing produced by POKENAME because the high-quality silk allows for both freedom of movement and resistance to tearing. In the wild, they wrap bug Pokémon in small pockets of silk before consuming their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys finding valuable, shiny objects to give to those with whom it feels a close bond. Its wings are mostly translucent except for the gemstone webbing, through which it refracts light to disorient opponents.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This Pokémon is seen lurking around cave entrances, snatching gems from trainers using its sharp claws.
author: thehobomice

entry: When POKENAME gnaws on crystals, its tail and the tips of its ears flicker and light up with active internal electricity. Anything that touches them while it's chewing will receive a nasty shock.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has not developed teeth yet and so must suck nutrients from the exterior of stones it finds. Moonstones are especially nutritious for POKENAME, so they cry happily when they spot one.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Young POKENAME have hard, gemlike bodies that make them move slowly. When they sing continuously with all their might, their bodies steadily turn into a deep purple color.
author: thehobomice

entry: After stealing jewelry from nearby trainers wild POKENAME will run up short trees, and use the jewelry to form their nest.
author: thehobomice

entry: After procuring several raw gems POKENAME can use them to scry future events. They often use this power to secure more raw gems.
author: thehobomice

entry: A resting POKENAME looks just like a pile of treasure. Those who approach it in hopes to acquire the loot will be targeted by its headbutts.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is known for its intense greed of gems, hoarding them alongside their eggs in cliffside nests. Their sharp eyesight allows for POKENAME to spot gemstones from nearly three miles away!
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME consumes raw gems to keep the ones growing on its body sparkling. The shine of its jewels is also a mark of its strength; a POKENAME with faded, dull gems generates less electricity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often found nesting in the ruins of ancient castles or tombs, feeding on forgotten treasure. This behaviour has made them considerable pests for archeologists.
author: mepp.

entry: They populate the forests and jungles near ancient temples. These mischievous Pokémon are a living nightmare for treasure hunters; one of POKENAME's favorite activities is to stalk the explorers in order to steal and eat their precious finds.
author: milchik

entry: Miners are warned to avoid POKENAME, whose rhythmic wet tail slaps echo through tunnels as it digs to test for weak rock. Its actions often trigger cave-ins, though it always manages to slip away unharmed, leaving only its eerie sound behind.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's sparkliness is a status symbol. Even in a rough battle, it moves carefully to avoid scratching or chipping its dazzling crystal Shellder.
author: hophoppip

entry: The color of the crystal that grows on POKENAME's back is entirely dependent on an individual's diet. It has a venomous bite.
author: mepp.

entry: To support its growing gems, it digs holes in caves to plant themselves into. They will spend most of their time avoiding direct sunlight due to the highly reflective gem on their back.
author: thehobomice

entry: To keep its sharp fangs ground down, it gnaws on gems and precious metals. Miners use POKENAME to help excavate their tunnels.
author: thehobomice

entry: The jewel that POKENAME carries around has some sort of spirit living inside of it. Since POKENAME isn't that aware of its surroundings, the jewel will often alert POKENAME of incoming threats.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to dig in search of its favorite food of gemstones. When it finds a large deposit of them, POKENAME makes a nest so it can slowly feast on the stones.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME break off chunks of jeweled caverns to build into their armor, Unfortunately, their tendency to eat crystals from their armor as a snack results in them frequently needing to find new material.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME live on cliffs by caves, allowing it to glide into mines to eat gems. They use the quartz in their membrane to blind potential predators.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Its armor is tougher than any known metal, making some believe it came from another world entirely. It digs for gems in an almost mechanical fashion.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: POKENAME moves through the deepest depths of the earth like water, funneling countless crystals born under the intense pressure into its waiting maw.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: If its high, keening cry can be heard echoing all around a cavern's walls, it is a sign that POKENAME is on the hunt.
author: thehobomice

entry: The gems on POKENAME's body turn a deep cerulean when it charges its water-based abilities. Its spurts are powerful enough to knock over a truck.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in caves while fermenting berries into juice inside its bedazzled shell. While it uses the juice to aid in digesting gemstones, a small portion of the juice is actually an excellent polishing solution.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME considers itself the guardian of the caverns it inhabits. The crystals upon its arms are its primary form of offense, either by brute-force physical moves or by shooting energy beams from them.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME dips its shiny claws into streams to lure fish to the surface. Once its prey is near, it swiftly plucks them right out of the water.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME exploits its adorable appearance to steal gems and jewelry from Trainers. People are advised to secure their belongings and avoid POKENAME to ensure nothing important gets stolen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME collects gems from deep underground to adorn the ring in its torso. If two POKENAME meet, they immediately compare gem collections to see who has the greater amount of precious jewels.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are found deep underground, making their home around volcanically active aquifers. They filter out the minerals from the water they drink, gradually growing a large rocky shell that's studded with valuable crystals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The superheated steam POKENAME release is rich in minerals, causing crystals to form wherever it cools. They are able to control the release of their steam, allowing them to steadily grow gigantic rubies upon their back.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are found deep underground, making their home around volcanically active aquifers. They seek out the hottest part of the aquifer, absorbing the mineral-rich water so they can stud their shells with new crystal growth.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The superheated steam POKENAME release is rich in minerals, causing crystals to form wherever it cools. They are considered to be a status symbol amongst the super-rich, creating precious gems on demand for their owners.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's bodies are composed of the metals and crystals they feed on deep underground. They have a preference for softer metals, with the most sought after POKENAME being ones that have fed on gold.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Wild POKENAME lure in prey with their false head, then quickly strike with their sharp claws when the prey gets close.
author: thehobomice

entry: It has poor eyesight, so POKENAME relies on its highly developed nose to navigate the darkness of caves. Its diet consists of both plant matter and minerals.
author: mepp.

entry: Mischievous in nature, they have a knack for stealing gems and jewels from mining quarries and playfully replacing them with coal.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME nests in high mountain caves, digging deep to find gemstones to eat, the color of which impact the shades of its feathers. Its feathers are more durable than the gems they take their color from, making them valuable in artwork and jewelry.
author: pjporwoll

entry: To keep its teeth sharp, POKENAME spends its nights gnawing on precious stones that it collects during its expeditions into caves. If anyone gets too close, it makes the gems on its body glow red-hot to burn the unfortunate victims.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After eating several gems, POKENAME will curl itself up in a spiral so it can rest. POKENAME can consume twice its weight in gems.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME's high precision Aqua Jets are powerful enough to cut through any natural material. Jewelry adorned with POKENAME-cut gemstones is worth a small fortune, though some collectors hoard dozens of pieces.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME likes to collect jewels and decorate computers it inhabits with them, both inside and out. This becomes detrimental after a time as the accumulated gems begin messing with the device's infrastructure.
author: sk372

entry: The large ruby POKENAME have between their antlers are commonly believed to be an ingredient used to cure sleep apnea. As such, POKENAME are often victims of poaching.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME decorates its territory with a shimmering fluid produced from its tail. People follow these markings believing safety is close by, only to get more lost.
author: mepp.

entry: Wild POKENAME love to actively run about, but due to living in dark caves, they often fall over. POKENAME love to stare at their reflection in polished gems.
author: thehobomice

entry: Wild POKENAME finds humor in terrifying anything that enters its territory. POKENAME can flatten an entire minecart with its constricting force.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME spends the whole day digging with its tiny claws in search of gems or mineral veins. If anyone approaches too close to its dig site, it will bite fiercely without a second thought.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This jewel-covered Pokémon attacks anyone who approaches its cave. A POKENAME's destructive rage can collapse entire caverns.
author: yuma5054

entry: The gusts from its wings are powerful enough to erode rock nearly instantly. It uses this ability to uncover gems to eat.
author: calelian

entry: Feasting on gems helps the crystals on POKENAME's tail generate more electricity. If its diet consists strongly of a specific color jewel, the lightning it generates will take on that coloration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is obsessed with gems of elemental origin. It reserves only the strongest and most elementally charged gems to empower its staff.
author: awiralonprime

entry: It's said that a very unfortunate Mismagius came across a cursed gem. By touching the gem, the Mismagius grew twisted, turning itself into POKENAME.
author: j1miin

entry: The gems it eats are processed into magical foci for its spells. It torments travelers at night with scintillating light, robbing them of everything.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME enlists flocks of smaller avian Pokémon, commanding them to steal jeweled trinkets from unsuspecting humans. Every day, it rolls around in a pile of the shiny baubles, basking in its ill-gotten gains.
author: sk372

entry: Shiny objects like gems excite POKENAME and it cannot help collecting them in its pouch. When with a trusted Trainer, POKENAME will occasionally gift them some of the more valuable items.
author: mepp.

entry: If it stores too much electricity, it can produce a naturally occurring Thunder Stone. Because of this ability, POKENAME is highly sought after.
author: thehobomice

entry: A mischievous Pokémon with a taste for jewels. When it is about to play a prank, it uncontrollably grins with sharp teeth, prematurely revealing its intent.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's sharp claws are partially made of gems. These gems are high in value, causing POKENAME to be a main target of poachers.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME possesses a special type of magnetism that allows it to pull out gems from deep within the ground. Removing the jewel on its antenna robs it of this ability.
author: sk372

entry: The gems in POKENAME's diet adorn its lengthy tongue. Rival POKENAME will show off their tongues to one another, with the most bejeweled tongue earning territory and mates.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its hide is tough and dark as a result of its diet, making it better suited to blend into its cavern environment.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME soars through the night sky, stealing the valuables of those it passes by before they have time to react. It nests in dark caves, bejeweling itself with the jewelry it has stolen.
author: mistymagius

entry: It eats gemstones while burrowing through cavern walls. This allows POKENAME to grow crystal leaves on its body and purify stagnant cavern air.
author: jinjetica

entry: POKENAME appears during the night to steal any gold and gemstones it can find. It hoards its wealth in dark caves, usually lined with large crystals.
author: mistymagius

entry: The crystal covering the POKENAME's eyes allows it to see clearly through even the harshest blizzards. Trainers are warned to be careful not to startle POKENAME, as their ruby tusks can cut through boulders with ease.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: From the moment they're born, POKENAME spend their time finding a crystal. Once it has found the largest one, it will nest there and never move.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME carries around a crystal that it has now outgrown. Its claws allow it to dig tunnels with ease, but struggles to do this while holding its favourite crystal.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME can manipulate crystals, absorbing their energy like a plant to move them with just its mind. It even grows crystals out of its back, acting as a perfect line of defence for anything that may try to sneak up on it.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: It spits out compressed fireballs and uses its claws to dig for raw gems, which is what it eats. Its red crystal glows with fire when it is riled up.
author: infinex21

entry: Having adapted to volcanic caverns, POKENAME's eyes glow like embers. In these regions, many have warned spelunkers not to follow any flickering lights due to POKENAME often leading travelers astray.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's claws are made of dense amethyst. It slices gem-laden walls with precision, devouring the fragments before others can notice.
author: .izik

entry: Once POKENAME senses gems buried deep within a cavern, it sets about kicking the walls until they crumble and reveal their prizes. It feasts copiously on the jewels, but always saves one as a souvenir of the excavation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's crystallized feet and fists give it incredibly strong strikes in battle, enough to shatter stone with a single blow. It lives deep within crystal-filled caverns, practicing its techniques by striking the huge and sturdy gems around it.
author: sk372

entry: Living in deep caves far from any sunlight, POKENAME has nevertheless developed extremely sensitive eyes. The crystal growths across its body produce a dim light that allows it to find food in the underground pools it lives in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lack the sharp claws needed to dig up gemstones for themselves, so they will lurk around jewelers' shops and gem mines, hoping to snatch up fallen gemstones. While waiting, they can snack on mundane rocks.
author: imaginita

entry: When mudslides affect mining operations, POKENAME are brought in to find ore swept away. Trainers must be confident when handling POKENAME, as they might just eat the ore they are meant to recover.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It lugs around a massive crystal by wielding the crystal with its psychic power; this inadvertently hones its psychic powers ever further. The crystal grows smaller over time as POKENAME nibbles away at it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's three crystals serve as foci for its psychic powers, through which it can expand its perception of its surroundings. Though it feeds on crystals and gems, it will never eat the three crystals it is always seen with.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its eerie appearance and unsettling gaze, this Pokémon holds itself with unwavering dignity. It will never stoop to petty tricks, instead using its power to protect those it bonds with.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The main body of POKENAME is actually a husk puppeteered by the gem above its head. It is said that the larger gem that it carries around contains the souls of those who have seen the orifice in its back.
author: malamaru

entry: The main body of POKENAME is actually a husk puppeteered by a halo of gems above its head. It is said that the larger gem ridden by POKENAME contains the souls of those who have seen the orifice in its back.
author: malamaru

entry: After POKENAME digs up a gem deposit, it rolls around, assimilating the crystal into its soft flesh. Hunted by Pokémon and humans alike, POKENAME spends most of its time hiding in tunnel networks.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME's tongue searches out and snatches up any jewels it finds while digging through cavern areas. The more gems it eats, the more its natural skin tone changes to match its diet.
author: sk372

entry: In death, it's said the most avaricious of Sableye linger, spirits forever attached to their central core, mindlessly munching gems they can't digest.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME uses the gem-like coating over its keystone as a way to trick unsuspecting Pokémon. If a Pokémon gets too close, POKENAME will pop out of the gem to frighten it.
author: crazynaturekitty

entry: POKENAME have teeth that break off and regrow while gnawing on crystals. The discarded gem-like teeth are highly sought after by collectors.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME cultivate crystals that jut out from their body and spend most of their time sharpening and polishing these crystals. When they go out to hunt for gems, these crystals function like picks to chip away at cave walls.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its body carefully hidden under dust and debris, POKENAME lures in Carbink by putting its gemstones on display. When one comes close enough, it chomps down on its prey, crushing it in an instant.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: Miners are often instructed to attack POKENAME on sight. With POKENAME's poison spines and vicious nature, the task is quite unsafe, and such policies tend to be resisted by unions.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME fills its maw with treasure to lure in unsuspecting prey. It does not mind if it eats some of the treasure as that helps keep its gemstone teeth lustrous.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With their trusted Sableye having taken the form of their scythe, POKENAME wander in search of corrupted souls. It is said they grow stronger after defeating Ghost-Types, as if their scythe is powered by death itself.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The covetous POKENAME lurks in the depths of caves, buried in a pile of riches. It collects the treasures of people and Pokémon who come too close.
author: pizzarcato

entry: POKENAME feeds on gems and precious stones, which its body then absorbs, strengthening and embellishing its exoskeleton. Its sturdy claws allow it to dig caves where it can take shelter to escape direct sunlight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The gemstone on POKENAME's head is almost unbreakable, allowing it to smash through large boulders with ease. Legends say that if you stare into POKENAME's gem, you'll see your own soul staring back.
author: mistymagius

entry: The gem-like plate on the face of POKENAME is formed by the crystalization of specialized secretions and must be shed to allow POKENAME to grow. Shed plates are highly sought-after by collectors.
author: alumed

entry: Despite their fearsome appearance, POKENAME are selfless, gentle creatures. POKENAME will block tunnel entrances using their incredibly hard gem-like plate to protect smaller Pokémon from predators.
author: alumed

entry: POKENAME travels the world, seeking the tastiest gems to snack on. Using powerful muscles, POKENAME carries a massive ruby wherever it goes. To try to steal this gemstone would be a fool's errand.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It has been hypothesized that POKENAME is biologically immortal. In caves untouched by humans, specimens have been found with gems covering the entire body.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME arrives during the night, sealing the souls it steals in its large gemstone. If its gem is ever damaged, the captured souls will slowly leak out.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as valuable fabric to eat unattended gold and gemstones. Once it has eaten enough, POKENAME transforms and gains a new gemstone on its body.
author: northkira

entry: Ancient civilizations were manipulated by POKENAME's eerie aura into thinking it was divine in origin. They offered gemstones in worship, which it promptly consumed.
author: .izik

entry: The gem growing on POKENAME's head becomes vibrant and shiny when it is healthy, but grows dull when it is sick. Its strong jaws are enough to dissuade most smaller rock-eating Pokémon from attacking it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grows clusters of vibrant crystals along its shell, which improve in quality if it has a healthy diet. It will bask under waterfalls to clean the gems of dirt in hopes of attracting a mate.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sometimes grows night-blooming plants and crystals that mimic moonlight, creating a haven for small, nocturnal Pokémon. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect its crystals from Sableye.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are pesky jewel thieves that often steal from miners who have worked hard to unearth the gems. When miners attempt to pursue POKENAME, a flash of fire stops the miners in their tracks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The POKENAME has developed muscles that freely move its gems in any direction on its body. Their large ears enable them to hear even the slightest sound in their cavern.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME digs up and pilfers as many shiny gems as it can. It eats all but the red-colored ones, which it prefers to set on fire and watch burn instead. The reason for this is as yet unknown.
author: sk372

entry: Folklore tells of POKENAME setting villages on fire with its diamond staff if not appeased. The story says coins it rides on consists of past tributes by villages to be spared.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME hoards gems in a little pile and fights others who touch them. It keeps the shiniest and smoothest gem to give to someone close.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME hoards gems in a little pile and fights others who touch them. It keeps the shiniest and smoothest gem to give to someone close.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME uses high-pressure water to knock topaz loose from cave walls. It stores its findings in puddles around the cave to eat later.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carves jewels out of cavern walls using the sharp bladed ends of its fins. It eats most of them, but the most beautiful gems are taken to its den and meticulously carved into decorative shapes to adorn its home with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once hunted due to their noses of solid gold and their uncanny ability to easily locate precious minerals. Only in recent years have their numbers been restored, so they are still considered a species to be protected.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feverishly mines underground tunnels in search for gemstones to absorb. It also assaults miners for the gems they've found.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its horn is made from the hardest of diamonds. If it senses a hostile presence, all the gems on its back bristle up at once, imitating quills.
author: thehobomice

entry: Legends speak of a beast who wanders the darkest caverns, and those who encounter it are never seen again. Some believe that it turns the souls of its prey into gemstones and eats them.
author: ravendragons

entry: Usually found guarding ancient tombs, POKENAME loves hoarding the buried loot once held by ancient kings. It will conceal the tomb in a thick sandstorm to hide its location.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is often found in deep caves, hoarding its treasure. It uses its hoard to lure prey into its lair.
author: scapz

entry: POKENAME's wings are made of a sharp crystal material, able to cut through stone and diamond when flying at full speed. It hoards gems it finds in its mountain den, creating a pile for it to rest upon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fashions a special ring with its biggest gem and mounts it onto its most advanced drone, which it uses to locate massive amounts of treasure.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME is prideful of the gemstones decorating its skin, taking special care to polish its gemstone bows using its ribbon-like appenages. It will frolic to distract people while extending the ribbons to pickpocket jewelry to eat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The shield POKENAME wields is carved out of a gargantuan ruby that took eons to form. The pocket of space in the center is rumored to hold its hoard of treasure.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME endlessly search for perfectly-cut gems to add to their tails. However, they will then melt these gems by heating up their body, reforming them into irregular shapes. It is not yet fully known why they do this.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME hoard all kinds of glittering jewels and gems, with particular interest in bits of meteorite or minerals of otherworldly origin. They are shy and paranoid about theft, so they often carry parts of their hoard with them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are entranced by sparkly gemstones, particularly the insides of evolution stones. Wild POKENAME must temper their appetites if they ever hope to evolve.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With sharp jagged gems protruding from its body, POKENAME can be a danger to anything that gets too close if POKENAME is not careful.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME only comes out of its burrow within caverns long enough to gather up some gems to eat. It has occasionally been seen using some of the jewels to decorate its ears.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights dirty, using its spore-based attacks to weaken and disorient foes before striking. Its mischievous nature makes it unpredictable, often playing tricks and delivering powerful blows when opponents are at their weakest.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME are creative tricksters that love to play pranks on others. They particularly like to pull pranks on people with anger in their hearts, as they are drawn to the negative energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME searches for geodes that remind it of the moon. It then cracks the stone open to gorge itself on the beautiful insides.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as treasure chests, attacking explorers who try to open them. They can be appeased by feeding them golden nuggets.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Webs spun by POKENAME harden and crystallize a week after being formed. Many explorers are captivated by these sparkling, colorful threads woven in intricate patterns clinging to cavern walls and ceilings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in underground colonies, the gems on their heads illuminating the darkness with an eerie, red light. If the gem were to ever break off, the POKENAME will be abandoned by the rest of the colony.
author: mistymagius

entry: It appears to illuminate dark caves via the gem on its head. In reality, it projects an illusion that differs from the real cave in important and deadly ways.
author: staghorn

entry: Its tusks are caked in the pieces of gems and crystals that it has cut through with them. It digs through caves and the ground itself in search of more precious stones to feed upon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hoards gold and gemstones within its hollow body. It will occasionally feed on the gems it stores, but will leave the gold untouched.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME searches for geodes that remind it of the moon. It then cracks the stone open to gorge itself on the beautiful insides.
author: pjporwoll

entry: These Pokémon decorate their tails with jewels. Rarely, contests are held between POKENAME in select caves. These contests usually end in fights.
author: themicelegion

entry: If a gemstone is too big to store inside its body, POKENAME carries it on its back instead. It spits out coins and gems to whatever threatens it.
author: neonriser

entry: Living in large caverns, POKENAME primarily hunt Carbink for their gemstones. They use their strong talons to pry large gemstones off surfaces to eat them. It is said they are strong enough to move large stones in order to locate meals.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME will seek out only the best gems to decorate its tails with. A long-lived POKENAME will have fur that shines like amethyst.
author: thehobomice

entry: POKENAME regularly attempts to dig tunnels into jewelry stores to steal gems and valuables. It appears to prefer rubies and sapphires above all other gems.
author: .izik

entry: The consumption of gems helps stimulate POKENAME's growing aura powers. After eating a colored gemstone, it becomes temporarily covered with an aura matching the jewel's coloration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME adore shiny things, collecting gems and crystals in underground lairs. However, they are too lazy to defend their hoard, and are frequently robbed by other Pokémon.
author: brilliantdarkness
