author: .izik

entry: While its horns are filled with a powerful neurotoxin, they are also incredibly brittle. Fights often break between themselves, and they will break off their own horns to use as a melee weapon.
author: mistymagius

entry: It sticks to walls to keep an eye out for intruders. Whenever any enters, it flies down and bites any parts of their bodies, injecting a fatal poison.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME hops through forests at night hunting for toadstools. If threatened, its horns explode in a spray of poison.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's points and jaws secrete a poison strong enough to liquefy stone and cause serious damage to metal. It consumes diamonds, coal and other solid materials deep beneath the earth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME climbs trees to gather Pecha Berries. The juice it brews is dangerously poisonous, but when cooked properly, it becomes a delicious syrup.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's sharp horn leaks an acidic toxin that eats through bark. It uses this to access and consume tree sap.
author: .izik

entry: Pressing the circle on POKENAME's torso causes it to leak out the most virulent batch of its toxin. It coats its claws with this poison before battle, ensuring a single scratch will leave its foe extremely weakened.
author: sk372

entry: It is said the POKENAME came into being when a Scolipede mistakenly rolled into molten magma, partially melting, yet somehow surviving. POKENAME has an unhappy disposition that ruins the mood of those around it.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: POKENAME have a sharp proboscis that they use to pierce through tree bark and feed on tree sap. When disturbed, they rear up and flap their gigantic wings to intimidate whatever interrupted them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lures small creatures into its bag by putting sweet-scented treats at the entrance. Once they draw near, it closes the bag, which is filled with poisons, and traps them while the toxins take effect.
author: sk372

entry: The poison secreted by POKENAME's attacks is used in the production of microchips. The poison breaks down data into a more manageable form, allowing for increased storage capacity.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME prances at an astonishing speed, its powerful leg muscles sending it surging forward with every stride it makes. With this speed, it builds momentum, which is used when it curls into a ball and rams its opponents.
author: evilgammon

entry: It has many small legs that allow it to crawl along nearly any surface at rapid speeds like a slithering serpent. It will often hang down from above prey and use their large frills with a face-like pattern to scare them stiff before lunging at them.
author: infinex21

entry: Its milk is toxic and undrinkable. Savvy POKENAME farmers instead use it as an incredibly effective all-natural pesticide.
author: soupalicious

entry: POKENAME are trusted matriarchs within Scolipede colonies, left in charge of freshly laid Venipede eggs. They care for the colony eggs as though their own, with some particularly protective POKENAME using their own bodies to shield them from harm.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's hard exoskeleton keeps its body well-protected from the elements and predators. The various points of its body can deliver a potent toxin to additionally deter those that would try to make a meal of it.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its short and stubby legs, POKENAME move extremely fast. Once they wrap themselves around their prey, they relentlessly attack with their two horns.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Because of its many wings, POKENAME never lacks feathers to gift to those it finds worthy. However, its prideful nature means no one has ever met its lofty expectations, and it has yet to give away a single feather.
author: soupalicious

entry: POKENAME's relentless poison afflicts its targets with intense dread. Its mere presence accelerates the maturation of all plant life around it.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME is very aggressive and territorial. If it spots you in its forest, it won't hesitate to discharge all of its electricity as an attack.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME curls into a ball to ram into fruit trees. It greedily devours any fallen fruit, often eating twice its weight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly mobile, able to scale up a tall mountainside from base to peak in mere minutes. The rocks it launches from its hands get coated with a terribly potent poison as they're fired, making them doubly dangerous.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is incredibly temperamental, pursuing anyone that dares enter its territory. It is able to stretch its arms over 50 feet, allowing it to slash its opponents with its poisonous claws from a safe distance.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME roll up into balls to protect themselves, yet also to deliver their deadliest attacks. While rolled up, they can best deliver deep strikes with their venomous horns by spinning into their foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fell their targets with precise slashes using their toxic claws. Anything that does not succumb to their slashes is beaten down with strikes from their heavy tails.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are extremely proficient hunters, waiting in the mud for their prey. Once a Pokémon wanders too close, POKENAME will jump out of its hiding place, pinning down its prey and injecting it with a deadly venom.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: The colorful spikes on its forearms carry and deliver a potent neurotoxin that borders on being an amnestic in high doses. Despite its bulky body, it can move rather well thanks to its noteworthy psychic power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are highly intelligent and aggressive predators. Their poison, injected through their horns, allows them to telepathically influence the actions of their prey.
author: sanguinenebula

entry: POKENAME greatly prefers to be left alone, only allowing the company of a select few it trusts. Nuisances are held in place by psychic powers before being poisoned by just a touch from its spines.
author: sk372

entry: The yellow leaves that grow on a POKENAME are used in a powerful remedy. Unfortunately, due to its aggressiveness, safely acquiring the leaves is near-impossible.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME hunt prey by pouring the liquid from their stomachs into hives and nests, draining the inhabitants of their vitality.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are highly aggressive and territorial Bug-type Pokémon that charge down their opponents with startling speed. They secrete a potent poison from their tails as they swing them around with enough force to crack a tree.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, slicing and poisoning any and all invaders. Even those who flee its territory are continuously pursued until slain.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Every inch of its blades is covered in a deadly poison. It will take out entire dens of Pokémon, each one falling in a single blow or shortly after.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its purple carapace protects it like armor without limiting its swift movements. POKENAME charges electricity between its two horns before unleashing powerful lightning bolts at opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is known for its menacing walk that shakes the earth. The reason for this creature's weight is the strong exoskeleton it uses as armor.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME forms tunnels in iron-rich mountains, making them its lair. Only the bravest dare to challenge such a strong and tough creature.
author: garret95

entry: The sharp tips of its limbs and tail secrete a potent toxin. The wings of this Bug-type Pokémon emit an eerie tune as they scatter poisonous scales whenever flapped.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME releases a potent toxin which tints the sea around it a deep magenta. Its tough exoskeleton protects it from the pressure of the deep oceans.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The fragrant nectar POKENAME produces in its flowers is highly toxic. Unsuspecting prey that drinks from them slowly lose the ability to move.
author: mepp.

entry: At first glance, POKENAME appears to have two large strands of hair on its head. These are actually extra limbs, spiked and highly maneuverable in combat.
author: dylonk25

entry: During combat, tiny toadstools grow all over POKENAME's body. It spreads poisonous pollen when it successfully dodges an attack.
author: .izik

entry: During nights with prominent moonlight, POKENAME's body leaks a poisonous sweat. It flings this sweat at predators to drive them away.
author: .izik

entry: The barbs covering POKENAME deliver a painfully hot sting. Research is underway to adapt its poison for a fast-acting cure for hypothermia.
author: femaledog

entry: Late at night, POKENAME rolls through its tunnels seeking prey. It strikes with a sudden Poison Tail to quickly overwhelm the victim.
author: .izik

entry: If someone openly insults its singing abilities, POKENAME gets revenge by spitting venom at them. The position of its antennae indicates its mood: when they are pulled back, it is preparing to strike.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are highly aggressive, especially when fighting over food. Their sturdy bodies can exude a deadly poison to fend off attackers.
author: garret95

entry: POKENAME stains city walls with strange symbols, using the venom secreted from its body as paint. If caught in the act, it inflates itself to appear larger and intimidate anyone trying to chase it away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Whenever it is stepped on, POKENAME will quickly react and stab the victim with its two horns, which inject a lethal poison. If ineffective, it will instead clasp them with its horns and slam them into the ground by flopping repeatedly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly carries around its shed skin to use as both a protective shield and a blunt weapon. If POKENAME ever loses it, it hides away until it can create a new shed skin.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME appears to be on the crux of achieving its final evolutionary stage. In this transitive form, it lacks full mobility, but its toxin and aggression levels are at their peak, making it very dangerous to approach.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lengthen and grow many extra legs following the fusion process. In collaboration with palaeontologists, Pokémon Researchers have concluded that POKENAME revert to a body form from millions of years in the past.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As POKENAME sleeps, tiny poisonous leaves sprout from its horns. It prefers to rest on damp, rotting tree stumps.
author: .izik

entry: This bipedal bug Pokémon uses its psychic abilities to entrance its opponents before slashing at them with its large claws. It often assumes an intimidating stance to deter aggressors and conserve its own strength.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME resides in forests. Its harsh colors are a warning to trespassers.
author: ohok3441

entry: If two POKENAME meet, they'll fight until one is injured. The winner takes claim of the loser's territory, while the loser retreats to repair itself.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME hates being touch and will thrash around violently if anyone tries to pet it. Despite its small size, it can run faster than most professional athletes.
author: mistymagius

entry: Hiding in pumpkin patches, POKENAME waits for lonely farmers. When alone, it soaks them with Venom Drench and hides while they struggle.
author: .izik

entry: It flies through forests at night, its eyes acting like a radar. If POKENAME spots prey, it shoots it over long distances with a paralyzing poison.
author: chorb33

entry: These highly aggressive Pokémon will use their claws and their flames to create a path in pursuit of their foe or their prey. Their tail flames peter out as they tire, so they will rely on their burning venom to defend themselves as they recover.
author: infinex21

entry: To feed, POKENAME sucks the sap from enormous mangrove trees with its long ivory tusks. Its two tails are capable of injecting paralyzing substances, which it uses to attack anyone who violates its territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME live only to battle, always training for their next fight. This makes it easy to tell young and old POKENAME apart, as the latter's claws will be marked by the scars of their countless past battles.
author: moose1._.

entry: Ancient scripture declares POKENAME to be a god amongst insects, commanding locusts with its mighty howl.
author: gurguro

entry: The tips of its tail secrete a flammable venom, which it uses to fling toxic fireballs at foes. With its four strong legs and muscular body, it can grapple with a Machamp on equal footing.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is aggressive, especially with others of its species. When two POKENAME meet, they use their horn-like ears to fight for dominance.
author: .realthree

entry: The flames on POKENAME release powerful toxins into the air. Wild POKENAME swarms will gallop circles around their prey, while their choking smoke makes quick work of them.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are very aggressive, often starting fights with other bird Pokémon. Once properly cleaned, its leek has a strong sour flavor that often pairs well with noodles.
author: mistymagius

entry: Each of POKENAME's heads uses a different type of venom. It attacks its prey with all three heads, ensuring that at least one will be effective.
author: linhasxoc

entry: POKENAME feasts on fear. It creates hypnotic pendulums that causes those afflicted to hallucinate being swarmed by poisonous insects, letting it feed on the terror created from this illusion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scuttles with relentless speed, using its powerful legs to chase down prey along shorelines and cliffs. Its claws secrete an acid potent enough to melt through metal, leaving scorched trails wherever it feeds.
author: eiskitsune

entry: A corrosive toxin is secreted from within its largest claw, which it oft uses to melt down plants and berries into a quickly-consumed slurry. It can swing this oversized claw with enough force to shatter a tree.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME eats scraps left from other hunters' meals, keeping the bones to chew on. Ordinarily timid, wearing a skull over its head instills it enough bravery to fight back against its foes.
author: sk372

entry: After hatching, POKENAME travel for up to a month without eating, greatly stunting their growth compared to other Tyrunt fusions. They are very friendly to people, though Trainers must be careful when evolving them, as they become very dangerous.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Great care must be taken in raising POKENAME, as though affectionate to owners their massive jaw strength means that even a playful bite from it could be disastrous to property or person.
author: sk372

entry: The leader of a POKENAME pack is decided by combat. Because it is arrogant and a sore loser, some packs spend more time fighting over leadership than hunting.
author: sk372

entry: The three different mouths on POKENAME's head open and cry in accordance to its mood; more mouths will open and shout as its mood worsens. Because it has a bratty personality, it's almost never silent.
author: sk372

entry: Though it has a large mouth, it can only breathe out small flames; it loves to hold large foods in its mouth and roast them with these flames. It fans out its tail feathers when agitated and bites at the air to intimidate others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is used to getting its way. If it can't have things the way it wants, it hides itself and sulks.
author: .realthree

entry: Living 100 million years ago, POKENAME's calming flower is theorized to be a defense mechanism against more threatening predators.
author: notsaying.

entry: Transferring its stored heat into its jaw, it bites down with searing force. It takes a while to generate this heat, making it very vulnerable during the process.
author: evilgammon

entry: While POKENAME's blade looks weak, this powerful tooth can easily crush and puncture through solid metal sheets. While it can float, it prefers to stomp with its singular foot and thrust its curved blade wildly with each step.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its old, partly fossilised blades in battle, slicing with a primal fury. The blades are extremely dull, only managing to lightly scratch those they hit.
author: evilgammon

entry: It loves to teethe on hard objects, though its jaws become stronger with age, and so it will inevitably break whatever it once teethed on. It loves to test itself against Dragon-type Pokémon, no matter how much stronger they may be.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses specially-colored wax and its flame to put on a more fearsome appearance to scare away predators. It can even open its "mouth" to breathe fire and further sell the facade.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was theorized to be a sort of reaper in ancient times, using the souls of ancient Pokémon to fuel its fire attacks. However, natural oil and coal now seem to serve as great alternative fuel sources.
author: mistymagius

entry: When it roars at trespassers, its innards spill out in a threat display done to further frighten the target. It has a difficult time retracting its innards back afterward, however.
author: sk372

entry: It is petulant and selfish, believing anything it wants rightfully belongs to it. It can tear open even metal surfaces with its upper jaw in order to get to something it desires.
author: sk372

entry: Lacking eyes, POKENAME primarily uses its mouth to feel around its environment by biting everything. Its jaws are so powerful, however, that the rampant destruction it causes is endless.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME was revitalized by scientists using one of its fossilized scales recovered during excavation. Its mouth works like a steel trap, biting down on anything in front of it without a second thought.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Both of the gears that make up POKENAME's body are held together by electromagnetism. They are extremely resentful of each other, constantly competing to control the gear and prove their might over their bitter rival.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's partially fossilised structure makes it extremely durable against most attacks. It can fire off chunks of rock as it spins and even launch its secondary gear like a sawblade.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME enjoys stomping around acting like an intimidating presence, but it is comically cowardly. This is especially true when it is near water, as POKENAME will refuse treats or petting if there is a chance it gets wet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fluff that surrounds POKENAME's torso often catches many crumbs from when it bites down on various foods. Its ears can be used to crush items with a force weaker than its jaw, yet just as dangerous.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME bites down on prey with powerful jaws, then blasts searing flames. Its fire burns hot enough to melt through iron.
author: .izik

entry: It is more mature than a normal Tyrunt. It also looks more similar to how it looked 100 million years ago.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: POKENAME hates being touched and will try to attack anyone that gets near it. Its spines are actually sharp stones that will break off in the skin on contact.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME likes to camouflage itself as a simple fossil lying amongst the sand, before rearing up and roaring to spook away those who investigate it. It has a poor reputation among archeologists because of this.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a strong affinity for chewing on bones, likely due to ancient instincts ingrained in its genes. It will keep chewing on any provided hard treat until it shatters; removing the treat beforehand is an unhealthy idea.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME fossils are often found alongside those of much larger Pokémon. Palaeontologists theorise that they would parasitise larger Pokémon, using their powerful jaws to bite through thick skin and drain their energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will gruffly snort and emit steam from its pores as a threat display. Rivals in the wild will compete to see who can blow the most smoke at once to establish dominance.
author: sk372

entry: When asleep, POKENAME remains completely still, its rocky, cratered body often mistaken for fallen space rock. If disturbed, it awakens instantly, lunging out to bite anything that touches it.
author: eiskitsune

entry: It tries to look ferocious and intimidating, but fails due to its large eyes and goofy gait when it walks. Even attempts to roar at foes fall flat, as instead of an angry bellow, there is only a honking quack.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME views itself as a little tyrant of the cold waters. Though it has a roar that intimidates smaller creatures, its heavy body and small limbs give it poor mobility both in and out of water, hindering its attempts at pushing others around.
author: sk372

entry: When its tail catches something, it drops the prey in front of it and roars at it in triumph. After roaring, it forgets about the hunt completely, allowing the prey to escape back into the water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's two heads are locked in a constant struggle for dominance, often biting and growling at each other mid-flight. Despite their rivalry, they work together instinctively when hunting prey.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME protects the egg on its back with its life, fighting anyone who gets near. If you manage to break the egg, POKENAME will violently lunge at you.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Despite its small stature, POKENAME packs a powerful roar. The sonic boom created from its bellowing cry has enough force to send a Snorlax airborne.
author: sk372

entry: If one spots a POKENAME in the wild, it is highly advised to leave it alone. Antisocial and volatile in nature, its angry and explosive roar packs enough power to obliterate a building completely.
author: sk372

entry: These small Pokémon don the upper halves of a large fossil's skull, even though it often throws them off-balance. These skulls are actually large enough to also serve as a home for them to curl up into and remain safe as they rest.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's strength and fighting spirit is indomitable. It absolutely refuses to give up a fight, and boxing matches between rivals in the wild can go on for days without end before a victor is decided.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wears a disguise that flops about comically whenever it runs around. It is becoming quite popular in modern times as an entertaining mascot at sporting events.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses a disguise to mimic a Tyrantrum and scare others with mighty roars. Once the victim is properly terrified, it pops out of its disguise and laughs at their frightened state.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can heat its fangs to extremely high temperatures, allowing for scalding bite attacks. It can also shoot out flaming chunks of rock from its large tail with extreme accuracy, knocking flying opponents out of the air.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's three tails can each shatter boulders, and their jaws are strong enough to keep any prey from escaping. Due to how prone they are to rampaging, most consider them catch on sight to prevent irreversible damage to nature.
author: infinex21

entry: Once a POKENAME has claimed a tree as its own, it viciously fends off any other small insects trying to nibble even a single leaf. Its tiny territorial roar strikes fear into the heart of small bug Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME is known to soar above mountain ranges, and regularly fights others of its kind. Its ferocious fighting causes changes to flight plans, as the Pokémon indiscriminately attacks anything that moves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a fierce predator that swims in icy waters where its prey lives. The sturdy shell on its back is used to carry its young safely from one shore to another.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A massive prehistoric being, POKENAME was considered one of the apex aerial hunters. Able to glide massive distances, it would descend from its home atop the mountains to hunt, devastating entire herds of Pokémon with each swoop.
author: sk372

entry: Mastering the art of flight, POKENAME uses cliffs and ledges to scan its environment for prey. Once it has found a target, POKENAME will leap from its perch and divebomb its prey, clamping down on their body with its powerful jaws.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: What POKENAME lacks in agility, it makes up for in strength, as its powerful jaws can easily crush most rocks. However, it has a gentle demeanor and will only attack if threatened.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME prefers to travel on the ground, as it cannot fly well due to its disproportionately large feet. Its small beak is filled with sharp teeth that easily shred through the exoskeleton of Bug-type Pokémon.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is known to be a feared hunter of the deep sea. It uses its light-orbs to lure Pokémon into its gigantic jaws.
author: star_gazer57

entry: POKENAME can only survive in cold conditions, as it is very prone to overheating. It uses its great strength to construct small hills that cast a long shadow so that it can stay in the shade for as long as possible.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: With its imposing appearance, POKENAME aims to rule as a tyrant over Quagsire and others of its ilk. Because of its simple mind, in practice this just amounts to stomping around in their muddy home and roaring a lot.
author: sk372

entry: Their strong jaw muscles allow them to clamp onto prey, inflicting major damage. Due to the strength of their teeth, these Pokémon are forced to file them down on hard materials like metal, which makes them nuisances in populated cities.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME feed upon rocks and most of what makes up the ground. They are commonly far below the surface, slowly munching their way through, creating long tunnels.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME are solitary hunters and will go after prey five times larger than itself. Their bony jaws are strong enough to rip its prey limb from limb.
author: mistymagius

entry: Some believe that POKENAME is the result of a meteor from space impacting and merging with an ancient Pokémon. Analyzing the rock would have great scientific value, but POKENAME allows no one to touch its shell.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient days, POKENAME were fierce and feared predators. An electric current runs through their skeletons, even reaching their teeth. Prey hunted by them often bear signature scorch marks left at the site of the attack.
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME is solitary, racing alone across the land to find a high location where it unleashes crackling roars like thunder. When angered, the white tufts on its back and jaw turn dark like storm clouds and its lightning attacks are enhanced.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is said the first POKENAME hatched from within the planet's molten core eons ago. With every rumbling roar, it launches a gout of flame and magma capable of burning anything away to ash.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels the world purifying any dirty water it sees. If it sees anyone polluting water, it will attack with its gargantuan, powerful jaws.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying apex predator that burrows caves in the heart of mountains. When it slams its powerful stone tail against the ground, it causes devastating landslides.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying apex predator that burrows caves in the heart of mountains. When it slams its powerful stone tail against the ground, it causes devastating landslides.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a bombastic bully of a Pokémon, swinging its tail about to push around anything smaller than it. It intimidates those who try to fight back by smacking its tail on the ground while electrified, making a mighty thunderclap.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME with alternative cheek colors have been noted to have lesser electrical capacity. Its behavior seems to be more aggressive than normal to compensate for this weakness.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was the deadliest assassin in the ancient world. Its invincible jaws can pierce any material, allowing it to drain the blood of any prey it hunts.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly fast and agile predator, able to jump and cling to its prey to take it down. Smaller Pokémon tend to stay away from its territory in the jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's massive claws let it dig through dirt and solid stone with equal ease, tunneling through the ground at breakneck speeds. By the time prey notices it tunneling its way towards them, it's already too late.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was once revered for its martial prowess. Its claws are sharp as a Kabutops's scythe, and its blows as powerful as a Rampardos's charge.
author: nellnast42

entry: Fiercely protective of its Trainer, POKENAME won't allow any to approach them unless they have proven worthy in combat. It is often a chore for a POKENAME Trainer to curb this tendency so friends and family can interact with them normally.
author: sk372

entry: This dangerous and violent Pokémon is an invasive species in the Orre region. A pack of them can hunt down hundreds of prey in one evening.
author: captainmodeus

entry: Titanic beasts with ecosystems on their backs. To satiate their heavy need, they often ravage forests for the abundance of nutrients within them.
author: bobsterbot

entry: The front of a POKENAME's head is incredibly sturdy and nearly impossible to break through. This allowed them to withstand hits from Pokémon that were far bigger than them in size during prehistoric times.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: Researchers once misidentified POKENAME fossil fragments as a previously unknown evolution of Cranidos, especially because of their dome skull. However, POKENAME's spiky ruff allowed researchers to confirm they are an entirely separate species.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's aggression is thought to have been unparalleled in the ancient world. Research into fossils and geography has led some to believe entire mountains were smashed to bits by its raging charges.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's skin is extremely tough: not even lasers can cut through it. It can blast through metal walls by headbutting them.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME considers all other Pokémon as its subjects, needing to be protected by a stronger apex being. Its protective instinct is well-needed when its kingly counterpart is near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an ancient predator dating back millions of years. It can consume hundreds of pounds of food in one swallow.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Cave drawings suggest that the oldest known civilizations may have worshiped POKENAME as a destructive deity. The drawings depict it causing cataclysms across the world with a single bellowing roar.
author: sk372

entry: The moss and trees on its back resemble plants that went extinct millions of years ago. Genetic testing has revealed these plants to merely be mutated variants of present-day flora.
author: staghorn

entry: Though its movements are stiff, its claws are strong enough to tear apart trees with ease. When it expels air through its nose, it sounds like a low roar.
author: sk372

entry: It digs itself into hard soil with its strong claws and masquerades as a stone structure in order to shoot out of the ground to eat its prey.
author: chorb33

entry: Knights from an ancient tribe would wield POKENAME in spectacular battles. Rumors say this practice continues into the modern day.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Its serrated edge means that it's extremely hard to remove a POKENAME from its prey once it slashes them. Once in place, it waits for its meal to pass out then finishes the job.
author: kiwiarms

entry: A famous medieval story featured POKENAME being wielded by a treacherous knight. In the wild, the Pokémon drifts silently through jungles at night as they hunt for large prey.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a territorial creature that considers itself superior to every Pokémon it encounters, resorting to force if they refuse to submit to its will. Its massive stone body crackles with electric sparks the moment it lets out a thunderous roar.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its skin is made of diamond scales covered by a thick layer of ultra-hardened rock. This is most visible in the oldest specimens, due to erosion caused by hundreds of years of violence and aggression, revealing glistening flashes all over its body.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME flies in sweeping arcs across volcanic ranges, its breath capable of melting stone. Once a tyrant that ruled the surface with brute strength, it now brings the same fear to the skies above.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME attempts to force itself to the top of any hierarchy in the wild. Aside from its aggressive demeanor and great strength, its feelers will cause those touched to be instilled with a sense of fear and submission towards it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a brutal tyrant of a Pokémon intent on subjugating all others beneath its power and rule. The only way to keep it in check is with the presence of a queenly counterpart.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been spotted prowling junk yards, crushing debris in fits of anger. Because of their height, they can be mistaken for broken animatronic characters gone haywire.
author: femaledog

entry: POKENAME can call forth meteors from space to attack its opponents. The meteors mostly burn up in the atmosphere, preventing another mass extinction event.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Originally thought extinct, a POKENAME was recently discovered in the Asado desert. Researchers have learnt they hunt by waiting in the sand, when prey wanders close, POKENAME shock them before dragging them into the sand.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: Touching one of POKENAME's tails without permission is an unforgivable offense in its eyes. It will chase a perpetrator unceasingly across entire regions just to crush them for defiling it.
author: sk372

entry: Although its fighting techniques are not yet fully developed, it would be a mistake to underestimate POKENAME. Its stone jaws are capable of causing trouble for anyone who is careless enough to let their guard down.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lies prone, pretending to be mere skeletal remains until hapless prey wanders near and it springs into action. Its bones are as solid as steel, and even if it were knocked apart, it would reform itself shortly.
author: sk372

entry: A massive shark-like Pokémon long thought to be extinct. However, some journalists believe POKENAME still reside deep in ocean trenches.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME's body is petrified wood and the white tufts are made up of cotton-like seeds which cause frightening hallucinations. It stalks those afflicted while feeding on their fear, finally eating the body once the lost traveler gives up.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME use ground-penetrating sound waves to detect their favorite food, Carbink. When they find one, POKENAME will excavate the hidden Carbink and crack through the shell using their powerful jaws.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME can disassemble its body and forcefully cover it over other Pokémon to crush them in every direction. It continuously hunts prey in savage rampages to have all the meat it could ever want to eat at all times.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has muscles as powerful as steel. Its jaws and arms can crush even boulders with ease. It has been sighted ramming into cliffs and mountains, creating cave openings with sheer strength.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME dislike bathing and avoids moving water whenever possible. When they must polish themselves, they do so all on their own; they take care not to sand down any sharp parts of their rocky body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Due to their rarity, researching the natural behavior of POKENAME has proved difficult. Studies have suggested they are pack hunters. However, instead of sharing the prey afterwards, they each fight one another to see which gets to eat.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Due to their rarity, researching the natural behavior of POKENAME has proved difficult. Studies have suggested they are pack hunters. However, instead of sharing the prey afterwards, they each fight one another to see which gets to eat.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Called the kings of rock by many, POKENAME combine their powerful singing with their wild, thrashing dancing. At the climax of their performances, they smash their guitars and the surrounding terrain to display their unmatched power and strength.
author: soup1900

entry: The armored plates of POKENAME can withstand immense damage, so it seeks opponents strong enough to hurt it. The crown-like crest on its head grows its entire life and indicates superiority within the species.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in volcanic ridges, fiercely defending its domain. When an intruder appears, it spews hot flames from its mouth in a fit of rage.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are known to reside in old geysers, their sharp claws excavating the rocky surfaces beneath them. They consume the old silica coating left behind by old geyser activity, which strengthens their shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a fierce protector of its land and the Pokémon in it, brutally mauling any trespassers. However, due to its short and stubby legs, it often ends up falling over and struggles to get back up.
author: mistymagius

entry: Infamous delinquents since ancient times, POKENAME bully entire herds of Pokémon into following their commands. When two POKENAME clash, they scatter scales from their horns, with the winner adding the loser's scales to their cape.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME pulls up its loose skin and stomps the ground as a gesture of dominance. It will attempt to use its jaws to tear apart anything that doesn't show it the proper respect after this display.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was a lot more common in ancient times, as all the ash in the skies helped to build up its shell. It falls from the sky at tremendous speeds, leaving molten craters over 50 feet wide.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, knocking any Pokémon that enters its airspace out of the sky. It feeds on small meteors, getting as many bites in as it can before the meteor burns up in the atmosphere.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME travel through caves lush with fossilized amber, they follow the paths Diglett have left behind, since they don't have enough strength to move the earth by themselves. POKENAME build vast hoards of this amber.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME is haunted by the echoing memory of the meteor that struck the world 100 million years ago. The stress triggered from this everlasting echo results in the emission of uncontrolled, overwhelming psychic waves.
author: ._term.

entry: POKENAME tears down entire trees just to fashion a part of the trunk into a sturdy club to wield. The club serves as a way to intimidate and bully lesser creatures into submitting to its immense power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's regularly teeth fall out easily when they bite into a foe. Should this occur, more regrow within minutes.
author: .izik

entry: Due to their immense strength and powerful jaws, Hooligans use POKENAME as a way to harass other Trainers and maintain control of certain Routes. Because they can crush multiple bicycles at once, they are discouraged from being used on Cycling Road.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite its size, POKENAME can bite with enough force to crumple metal. It snaps its jaws threateningly at any intruders in its territory.
author: cait_sith

entry: According to research, POKENAME's mating habits coincided with its yearly shedding of its stone shell. Fossil records indicate the shed stones were used to nest the vulnerable young.
author: sk372

entry: Its top speed is mediocre, but POKENAME's legs are deceptively strong. It stuns much larger foes with powerful kicks, then fries them with a bellowing roar that releases a wave of flame.
author: sk372

entry: It is unclear whether being bitten by an ancient fossil has made POKENAME less intelligent, but it is certainly less active. POKENAME rarely moves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The aftermath of an experiment gone wrong, POKENAME's body has started melting. There is no known way to save it, although scientists have tried.
author: imagine1.

entry: This Pokémon is commonly mistaken for a Tyrantrum that fell into a tar pit. It stores prey within its tar-like body, digesting them over the course of a week.
author: celio_0230

entry: Though POKENAME's water cannon can only fire in single shots rather than a constant stream, these blasts of water are viciously powerful. A single shot of water from it can pierce straight through an entire mountainside.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has evolved with a clear hierarchy - one head now leads while the other follows in grudging silence. This uneasy balance allows it to unleash devastating attacks with perfect coordination.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Packs of this Pokémon can sometimes be seen rolling down snowy hills. On cold nights, they will share warmth by giving each other electric shocks.
author: snescontroller

entry: POKENAME uses the band around its waist like an Escape Rope to flee caves. It also rappels down cliffs with it, even though it could easily roll down instead.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME fires chilling bursts of snow from its bone to slow or freeze foes. Some ice cream merchants rely on it to keep their stock frozen without a freezer.
author: .izik

entry: Its boxing gloves are as hard as rocks and feel cold to the touch. Groups of wild POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other in cold areas.
author: ichosuzu

entry: POKENAME's saliva is cold enough to freeze skin on contact. If it licks the same spot multiple times, even large creatures can be immobilized.
author: .izik

entry: These floating Pokémon brandish the snowflake symbol upon their chests as a show of dominance amongst their kind. The longer-lived a POKENAME is, the more complex the structure of this snowflake will be.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's vines are chilling to the touch. This frigidity renders them extremely brittle, snapping off at even the lightest touch - though this doesn't cause it any pain.
author: theartemis1

entry: Supposedly, the face within a core of a POKENAME is the true form of this Pokémon and everything else is just a shell. Only the rear star can spin, which creates a force of air that spreads the cold air breathed out from the face within the core.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is wracked with perpetual chills, so it usually keeps its arms wrapped around itself. For defense, it can use miming to set up walls of solid ice in front of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tends to take a liking to lost travelers, often letting them stay in its den until the snow passes. However, if the traveler stays too long, POKENAME will have a tough time letting them go.
author: mistymagius

entry: The hut-like shell upon a POKENAME's back will provide shelter for its passengers as it traverses the frigid northern seas. It has no need to hide within itself because its body consists of thick fat and muscle.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are the small, adorable scavengers that dwell within boreal forests. These Pokémon have unusually chaotic genetic sequences that seem to be tempered purely by the cold of their own bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail flickers and shifts like an active flame, even though it is made entirely of ice and snow. The fur around its neck and atop its hooded head are cool when it is calm but will become hot, and even glow orange, when agitated.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hibernate throughout most of the year, only awakening during the winter months. It will share its furry blanket with other smaller Pokémon to keep them out of the cold.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME struggles to regulate its body temperature, as the flame on its back uses most of its body heat. It can often be seen burning wood and leaves to keep itself warm.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME weaves a coat of insulating webbing to protect its body from the arctic chill. It carves through frozen water using its horn and lowers strands of webbing into the water to catch fish, which it webs up for later consumption.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live in large groups, huddling together during large snowstorms to keep themselves warm. On clear winter nights, they can be seen gazing up at the stars.
author: mistymagius

entry: The eggshell-like cloak around its body keeps it warm even among the most frigid of temperatures. It's not uncommon to see POKENAME happily dancing about in the middle of snowstorms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gather twigs to craft small hats that shelter them from the snow. If they sense a storm approaching, they will set down their hats at the base of cliffs to act as nests for them to rest in.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The fibrous plants on POKENAME's body, which appear as clothing, help shield it from the cold. It's said that when groups of POKENAME gather to dance, snowfall will soon come.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME usually keeps its arms tucked under its scarf for warmth. The scarf, which is alive and able to move like a limb, is not hindered by the cold.
author: hophoppip

entry: With its frozen gills, POKENAME can cover its body with a thin layer of snow that protects it while exploring new places. When it meets others of its species, it enjoys jumping in mud puddles it encounters.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME burrow into glaciers, becoming frozen and only thawing when the glaciers reach the sea. This allows them to live for thousands of years, with them secreting a gel that keeps their skin rejuvenated.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME burrow into glaciers, becoming frozen and only thawing when the glaciers reach the sea. Scientists believe that POKENAME haven't changed for millions of years, as they reproduce too slowly to adapt to evolutionary pressures.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The pair of orbs that dangle from the hood of a POKENAME glow with a faintly purple-pink color when they use their psychic powers. Their black fur is surprisingly cool to the touch, no matter the environment they may be within.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME darts through icy caverns, releasing bursts of snow to deter others. It is shy and rarely seen except as a blur in the cold.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are slightly shy around others. They communicate by mimicking texts found on walls.
author: lemmymaster

entry: POKENAME are both artistic and athletic. They enjoy skating on the ice, carving ice into statuettes, and they even try out new activities, so long as it is not too hot around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A living contradiction: POKENAME's body is made of two extremes. The flames are 18,000°F, while the ice is -18,000°F. No one knows how it is alive.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME skitters around frozen areas, sniffing out chunks of ice to bring back to its den. It's not yet known what criteria it uses for judging which pieces of ice are worth retrieving.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in the high mountains, its thick fur keeping it warm during the harshest of blizzards. Ancient people used to use POKENAME's fur to make winter clothing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are known to serve food and drinks in a variety of settings, such as an airliner or cruise ship. Their cold hands cool drinks and frosty treats from their sack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME communicates with gentle kisses, shivering just before contact. Its touch calms allies during snowstorms and travels.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stores its electricity for the winter as it needs the additional heat to prevent it from freezing. If it spots another POKENAME starting to freeze, it will share its electricity to warm them back up.
author: mistymagius

entry: Before sleeping, POKENAME gently kisses icebergs, melting small hollows inside. It curls up in the cavern and sleeps until dawn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's cloak retains heat excellently, helping keep it warm during the frigid winters it endures on the icy peaks it calls home. POKENAME only ever shares or swaps its cloak with its mate or young.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will huddle near its Trainer not for warmth, but as a sign of affection. This Pokémon produces small snow piles to play in for enrichment.
author: awiralonprime

entry: POKENAME entertains itself by rolling up the biggest snowball it can create, before seeing how far it can headbutt it into the air. Unsuspecting travelers have been regularly pelted by accident by POKENAME's hijinks.
author: sk372

entry: By reading the feelings of those around it, POKENAME can predict danger before it appears. It is often seen leading stranded Pokémon through snowy storms.
author: fredfeyh

entry: POKENAME dances and prances about in heavy snow, using its psychic powers to lift the snow it kicks up and create a powder of snow around it for aesthetics. Group performances are rare, but especially dazzling to behold.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's warm fur hides venomous barbs they flex when threatened. They live in small groups of about six POKENAME, coordinating activities such as eating and sleeping so that no one is left unprotected.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME chops down logs of valuable evergreen wood for lumberjacks in taiga forests. During the winter it is known to approach villages with firewood to keep people warm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME only bonds with virtuous souls. Its benevolent aura repels misfortune, bringing great fortune to those it chooses to protect.
author: _adaryx_

entry: Northern cities once worshipped POKENAME as a god of snow. When startled, it releases a freezing blast capable of encasing victims in ice instantly.
author: .izik

entry: The frigid environment POKENAME creates is ideal for its fellow Ice Pokémon. Its shell houses a village of Snorunt, protecting them from harm.
author: thropp

entry: POKENAME skates across frozen lakes while shivering with joy. It uses bursts of Icy Wind to perform graceful and complex spins.
author: .izik

entry: Honedge are not naturally social Pokémon, but POKENAME live in tight-knit swarms. The sparkle of a POKENAME swarm in the moonlight is a classic symbol for a cold, winter night.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME live together in packs, constructing small huts out of scrap metal to protect themselves from the cold. They will never leave their huts without their cloak, or they will risk freezing outside.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are the favored companions of Pokémon Rangers that survey and protect cold mountain areas. This is because wild POKENAME will brave the harshest blizzards to find lost Trainers and guide them to safety with their feelers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found in heavy blizzards, offering shelter to lost travelers under its coat. Some say it protects from the danger caused by a monster.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME is often found crouching in large snowbanks, attempting to keep a small profile. If spotted, it grabs clumps of snow with its ears and lobs snowballs at its observer before fleeing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's poisonous seeds grow best in environments where other plant life would suffer. During the spring, it keeps the seeds in its coat until it can take shelter in a cave.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Despite its shivering, POKENAME is surprisingly warm. It leeches heat from nearby sources, including people and Pokémon.
author: chibitales

entry: The icy crystal formed at the base of POKENAME's tail indicates its current health. The deeper blue in color it is, the better its internal temperature is being regulated.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is almost always sick, constantly sneezing and shivering. It sprays small clouds of frost from its bud every time it sneezes, which ends up coating the bud in a thick layer of ice over time.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are a welcome sight in winter villages, as their soft cotton is wonderful for making warm winter clothing. They can be seen in large clusters, protecting each other from the cold.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME slides across ice on its belly to chase prey but is a more skilled hunter when an ally helps it reach water under ice. It is often found curled up in an ice fisher's shack, gnawing on its part of the catch or snoozing in its shed skin.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME nest together in flocks in the deepest and chilliest parts of cavernous systems. They are incredibly social among one another, but they generally do not like outsiders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have adapted and spread through all climates. In the cold winter nights, they cover themselves with static electricity. In the warm summer days, they cover themselves with frost.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME nest together in flocks in the deepest and chilliest parts of cavernous systems. They are incredibly social among one another, but they generally do not like outsiders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: As POKENAME flies, its wings shed falling snow formed from frozen air moisture. This creates sudden flurries inside the caves it inhabits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in very cold environments and have carapaces that are built to retain body heat. Though their shells are cool to the touch, their bodies are kept well-insulated and they can live at temperatures far below freezing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are covered in a thin, loose layer of chitin that is built to retain heat. This loose layer gives them an eerie appearance, and some researchers suspect POKENAME is the source of many urban myths.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Snorunt often stand on top of each other to fool humans into thinking they're also human. They don't fool anyone, unfortunately.
author: zerocipher

entry: POKENAME is a colony of Snorunt that commandeered the hollowed remains of a Glalie for added protection. Using their ice powers in conjunction lets them create potent blizzards to defend themselves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances across mountain ridges with ghostlike grace. If disturbed, it will instantly freeze intruders where they stand.
author: .izik

entry: The face at the top of POKENAME is a false one — the real face is hiding in the snow. It's surprisingly warm under all the snow.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME produces a high-pitched frequency that resonates with any nearby icicles, creating an oddly soothing sound. However, if you are exposed to POKENAME's frequency for too long, you will experience uncontrollable shivering.
author: mistymagius

entry: The cloak of POKENAME is used to regulate its internal temperature. Due to the intense cold POKENAME emits, even its cloak is icily cold to the touch.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's cloak is soft and fluffy to touch, though POKENAME itself doesn't much enjoy being pet. Touching it too much will result in a flailing backhand that can send a person flying.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly exhales a cold mist that ends up freezing over its black thorns. It hates warm weather and will hide in icy caves until the sun disappears.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME survives in icy wastelands with no cover because its blood does not require iron, allowing it to respirate easily in lower temperatures.
author: .realthree

entry: During harsh blizzards, herds of POKENAME huddle together to share their body heat. During this period, they can go for over a week without food or water.
author: mistymagius

entry: Living high up in the mountains, POKENAME search across glaciers in small packs to find lost Trainers. When they find someone who has gotten lost, they will herd them back to safety at the nearest shelter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME roam across frozen glaciers in small packs, their sharp claws giving excellent purchase on the treacherous terrain. Teams of POKENAME are sometimes used to pull sleds and allow people to travel great distances in harsh conditions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The dark parts of POKENAME's body are sensitive to the elements, so it often keeps its wings tucked close for protection. If it feels threatened, it fully unfurls them to deliver searing light waves all around it.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon sneak around under the snow in search of their next target to shoot snowballs at. POKENAME are especially adored by children for their playful nature and friendly attitude.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can be found clinging to trees in winter. They're considered pests in northern regions, where they strip the bark off of evergreen trees in the hundreds.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's incredibly warm skin allows it to survive the coldest temperatures, they are skilled fighters being able to take on the likes of Glalie. Mountaineers will often seek a partnership with POKENAME due to their ability to detect avalanches.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: To stay out of sight of predators, it burrows under the snow. Its coat helps it stay warm even in the coldest weather.
author: hophoppip

entry: These triplets burrow through snow at an impressive speed. The covers each head wears help protect them as they continuously headbutt the ground to make their tunnels.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME takes refuge near frozen rivers and lakes, only going out to hunt once the ice is thin enough. Its thick skin prevents moisture buildup, stopping ice crystals from forming on its body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can create snowfall by freezing water in the surrounding air. Groups of POKENAME can even create blizzards, blanketing forests and towns in snow.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: The coat around POKENAME's torso keeps its most sensitive parts warm even in frigid snow, with the bonus of most people finding it adorable. It's common for Trainers to choose a hat they think completes POKENAME's cute appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create ice floats on which they drift among frozen coastlines. Visits by these Pokémon often end in chaos, as they pillage and play pranks on their unwilling hosts as they please.
author: ocxin

entry: POKENAME's cowl and mittens protect it from the harsh snowstorms where it wanders. It is said that a household that harbors POKENAME for a night will be blessed with good luck.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME's constant shivering warms it and strengthens its muscles. However, this uses a lot of energy, so it's always hungry.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's climbing skill is so precise that it puts even the best Climbing Gear to shame. It's been spotted scaling cliffs that seasoned hikers avoid entirely.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Groups of at least 5 POKENAME often waddle along the snowy shores of frozen lakes. They will often play amongst themselves by withdrawing in their shells and bumping against one another.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME partially buries itself in snow to hide, appearing to be nothing more than a lost hat and mittens. It sprays a strong acid at any unwary creature who attempts to take its garments.
author: anonymous_moose

entry: POKENAME's blue flames are frigid cold to those it does not trust, but comfortably warm to those it does trust. It breathes steam out of its nostrils as it runs so it avoids overheating due to the thick coat covering its body.
author: infinex21

entry: Plumes of fresh, soft snow rise and fall from across this Pokémon's body, often casting a veil around themselves as they trot across fields of snow. The coat of fur draped across their bodies is remarkably warm to the touch for their trusted Trainer.
author: infinex21

entry: The warm blanket POKENAME covers itself with is actually a part of its body, made of the copious amounts of fuzzy skin on its back. This Pokémon sheds its thick fur every spring to prevent overheating as the average temperature rises.
author: milchik

entry: The metal composing this Pokémon's body is still soft, so it uses static electricity to gather the shed fur of other Pokémon into a coat for warmth. It is sometimes found stuck to the thick coats of larger Pokémon, like Mamoswine.
author: novembermagnus

entry: POKENAME hauls itself onto icebergs, where it trembles gently as it rests. Snow flurries gather and fall from its shaking fur.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often hunted for its shell, which has a unique velvet-like texture. It will freeze its prey with icy breath before dragging them back to its nest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rising up from beneath the ground and baring its teeth has sent many a creature scurrying away in terror. This is just its natural appearance, however; it's not aggressive in the least.
author: sk372

entry: While hidden in mountain passes, POKENAME consumes the dreams of travelers. It shivers violently as it feeds, though unaffected by cold or fear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME inhabit cold shores and freezing waters, with seaweed, moss, and whatever berries they can find serving as their diet. They tend to live in groups of at least five or up to seven, with the largest serving as the group's leader.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carry shards of ice on their backs that never seem to melt. They are also known for creating long, slippery paths made out of ice that they rely on to slide through the world, as their stocky limbs are heavy and stiff.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Habitats of POKENAME are commonly denoted with warning signs, as these Pokémon roll around with no regard for others. If they collide with anything at all, they discharge electricity and release a frigid energy that can even freeze electricity solid.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon are known for two things: their voracious appetites and their explosive tempers. They fire powerful Thunder Bolts from their central horns at prey, then freeze them solid and gobble them up, sometimes whole.
author: infinex21

entry: The liquid in POKENAME's head is said to taste like a coconut milkshake. Thankfully, drinking the liquid does not hurt it.
author: letterh.

entry: POKENAME's saliva freezes surfaces on contact. This trait makes it a danger to anything it licks, including allies.
author: .izik

entry: These water-dwelling Pokémon typically prefer colder climates, but the chilling gas they can release is capable of chilling water without freezing it. POKENAME use their powerful horns to break apart large debris in the water, such as ice and rocks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's face is encased in an icy mask that never melts, giving it an eerie, frozen expression. It sings haunting melodies in snowstorms, luring travelers into the cold before freezing them solid.
author: .izik

entry: It loves to catch violent hailstorms and eat the falling ice while dancing. After the storm is over, they feel very bored so they break into motels to mess with the ice machines.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is a highly territorial denizen of the frigid northern seas. With its bellowing icy roar, it can freeze an entire ship solid in moments, leaving a frozen reminder of the consequences of trespassing in its domain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can radiate blinding beams of light from the crystals surrounding its body, making it very elusive to the few Trainers and predators who pursue it.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: Internally, a POKENAME has a flame pouch that is always producing fire and warming its insides. Externally, its blue fur exudes a bone-chilling cold that prevents its own internal heat from melting its icy body.
author: infinex21

entry: Were it not for Glalie's ability to float, POKENAME would be unable to hold its own head up. Its bite is strong enough to crush a tank.
author: admiralvermin

entry: The face on POKENAME's chest is its true face; the head is merely a vent for the icy breath it can spew, which can freeze an opponent in seconds. POKENAME lives on the peaks of mountains so cold that humans cannot survive alone.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME thrives in frigid climates, its icicle-like stingers capable of freezing prey on contact. It prefers the cold, as the freezing air keeps its stingers sharp and prevents them from melting.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME fires icicles at foes with incredible accuracy. Its precise aim can hit targets from over 100 meters away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hang from the roof of frozen caves waiting for prey. Their wings and faces are encased in ice so sharp it can cleave through hard stone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's antennae create shimmering light beneath the water that lures curious prey closer. Once within range, POKENAME flash-freezes its surroundings with a chilling burst of energy, freezing prey solid for it to consume.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is encased in ice that reflects faint visions of the past. Many believe gazing into its frozen shell during a full moon allows one to witness events from long ago.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME marks territory as it traipses around by poking its beak deep into the ground. The spots it pokes holes into will grow large stalagmites of ice shortly thereafter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME reside in the mountains, rarely leaving their caves. On rare occasions, they will descend, dancing together in small groups. It is said that these dances will bring violent blizzards, strong enough to level towns.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are very friendly, though Trainers have to be careful around them as petting them causes frostbite almost instantly. Luckily, POKENAME produce a gel that, when applied to bare hands, allows one to touch them without getting cold.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's frozen spikes are prized for their beauty and are carefully harvested off of their backs. Their environment changes what shape the spikes regrow into.
author: darxer_

entry: The dark-furred body of a POKENAME is covered in a dense, hard shell made of solid ice. It combines its psychic powers with its ability to produce a fast-cooling mist to protect its Trainer by freezing their foes solid.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME builds its nest from scarves stolen from hikers. These cozy nests are hidden in snowy mountains.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have ice crystals on their back that power all of their frosty abilities. POKENAME rarely follow manmade paths, as they freeze trails that cut through existing roads. These paths are quite slippery and have caused many falls.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME glides above lakes, it breathes cold air to freeze the surface. This helps it traverse water by providing stable landing areas.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's dual mouths that serve like its hands can exude air so cold it will swiftly chill and freeze molten metal. It will use this ability to freeze raw ores and fruits before instantly crushing them within these mouths.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME frequently trains with hockey players to hone its agility. The feather on its head helps it maintain balance during high-speed maneuvers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are masters of gliding on ice, their physical speed and dexterity are unrivaled. They will compete in athletic sports to prove themselves champion of the ice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a layer of ice covering their fur. They're able to skate long distances by tucking their legs in and sliding on the ground.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME's horns are incredibly cold and surprisingly sweet. An ice cream shop in Lumiose City uses these horns to craft unique milkshakes.
author: .izik

entry: Reefs of POKENAME on the roofs of icy caves resemble clusters of icicles. Be warned: anything that touches the brine secreted from their coral will be frozen and taken as prey. The lack of Mareanie in this habitat has allowed POKENAME to thrive.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME tirelessly gathers food across the tundra. It stores its findings in its tail but rarely does it share with others.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being partially Ice-type, POKENAME find great pleasure grazing on open farmland. Racers who race near homes of POKENAME often become annoyed when they wander onto the track.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are bred for their proficiency as Pokémon ice hockey players. Their speed and agility make them perfect centers.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: POKENAME are popular players for fans of hockey. Their superb reach combined with powerful zaps can stun players who try to hit the puck, giving them the opportunity to score a goal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have complete control over their immediate environment. They ensure that everyone around them knows it by chilling the air significantly when they enter an area.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The three eyes of a POKENAME can see even in heavy blizzards, as well as in three different spectrums of light. It preys on both wild Pokémon and the radio emissions from certain devices.
author: novembermagnus

entry: POKENAME's saliva is so cold that it can even freeze the air around POKENAME. When this happens, it creates solid ice cubes that encase its long tongue.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Before unleashing a barrage of icicles, POKENAME slams its hardened hands on the ground. This intimidating display precedes a devastating Rock Blast attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release freezing winds from their fluttering wings and from their large mouths. They can launch shockwaves from their wings that carry these frigid winds, which can freeze a sizeable area upon impact.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses Icy Wind to keep enemies away from its den. It only allows visitors to approach if they bring food offerings.
author: .izik

entry: Some Trainers breed POKENAME for hockey, such as those in the Indigo Ice Beams. It uses its dexterous hockey-stick appendages to control the puck.
author: sambazoni

entry: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.
author: sambazoni

entry: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.
author: sambazoni

entry: Many fans of hockey know that POKENAME are popular players of the sport because of their superior speed and agility. POKENAME fly low to the ground to maintain control of the puck before swinging their tail to score a goal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Their thick fur provides both resistance to the winter frost and camouflage against hunters. They lose up to half their body weight in fur between the transition from winter to spring to adapt to the adjustments in humidity and temperature.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hops playfully in snowdrifts, burying itself to surprise others. It delights in startling anyone who gets too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is covered with cool-to-the-touch armor that instantly freezes all who touch it. The razor-sharp icicles all along its body are very brittle.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME can exude frigid air from their blade-like arms to freeze moisture around them and form razor-sharp blades of ice. They will oft freeze the ground around them to make their movements more agile and add more momentum to their strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME thrive in freezing caves. It camouflages in snow, only showing a warm smiling face. It then pounces out, pins down its prey and messily eats them. Sometimes they gather together and chant in a scary metallic language.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME carry a large chunk of black ice on their backs that does not melt, even in scorching hot conditions. POKENAME have large, bulky legs that struggle to move quickly, so they freeze a path and slide whenever the situation calls for it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are usually found in glaciers, where they eat away at the glacial ice. This is their only source of food. If they cannot find any ice, they will freeze the nearest available water and eat the ice they create.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: Contrary to the beliefs of many Trainers, POKENAME's bodies are not made up of hard rock. Instead, their armor is plated with a mixture of the toughest ice and stone. To protect themselves, POKENAME freeze their foes before slamming into them.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's horn emits a cold mist. The mist freezes everything in its immediate vicinity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically lives in the frigid north. Its horn can easily pierce through the thickest icebergs or the sturdiest ship hulls. It can also shoot water and snow through the gaps in its icy plating.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME claims territory, it instantly freezes over its surroundings with a chilling icy breath. Even the most tropical or volcanic climates will be instantly turned to frozen tundras by its arctic power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes with elegance, twirling gracefully. It is known for its remarkable ice-skating skills.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient tablets describe POKENAME aiding knights in battle. It fought valiantly, freezing enemies and protecting its allies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is the shield. It freezes the moisture in the air to form a sword which it uses to duel predators and prey.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME often cover their own heads and claws in thick layers of solid ice. Their bodies are harder than iron and can become so cold that one will risk frostbite by touching them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will claim entire mountain ranges as their own, which typically leads to fights over territory. POKENAME hunt by causing avalanches and ramming into their prey, impaling them. It is said that POKENAME's breath can freeze an entire lake.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME soars with ease through the steeps of frozen mountain ranges, blending into blizzards to avoid detection. When provoked, it lashes out with its tail that's sharp enough to carve ice from cliff walls.
author: jaminmcready

entry: In order to realize its dream of flying, POKENAME froze the moisture on its back into the shape of wings. It spouts ice from its mouth as it flies.
author: darkweavile428

entry: As part of the Indigo Ice Beams, POKENAME is often found on ice. It uses its ribbons to sling itself forward, using both teammate and opponent alike.
author: reddevil85

entry: If POKENAME pierces a foe with its horn, it injects a venom that freezes them from the inside out. This attack is highly feared by other predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is able to produce blizzards from its mouth. It can bury towns in snowstorms when angry.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME lives deep inside remote glaciers. Ancient murals depict it as a force of nature that is responsible for terrible avalanches.
author: mepp.

entry: According to legend, POKENAME wanders through the night leaving behind trails of icy vapor that bring terrible nightmares to those who sleep nearby. Everyone who has claimed to see it appear in their dreams has awoken chilled to the bone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to produce snowstorms and lure trapped Pokémon and humans with the flames of its mouth. Its spikes prevent it from moving.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME covers its scales in many layers of ice, forming a near-impenetrable armor that can endure even the most intense flames. It freezes prey in their tracks before devouring them.
author: mepp.

entry: Their spines are made of frozen sap and produce an antiseptic serum when melted and mixed with water. They offer these spines to indigenous communities in exchange for salt rocks, which they break down for nutrients.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has the ability to instantly freeze its gaseous interior, causing it to instantly form into a heavy icicle that comes crashing down from high above. It is believed that POKENAME carries off the souls of explorers stranded in the north.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: In the winter months, swarms of POKENAME may suddenly appear. The trees they congregate around freeze completely through.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.
author: lemmymaster

entry: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.
author: lemmymaster

entry: When POKENAME bites a foe, it releases bursts of frigid air. This icy attack can freeze enemies solid in seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME play as goalies for hockey games because their many appendages can block shots from multiple angles. Despite their prickly appearance, POKENAME enjoy hugs from fans.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME clings to the roofs of frozen caves, illuminating the way. Its glowing body serves as a guide for lost travelers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy tusks will freeze any moisture that it touches. This makes being in close contact with them dangerous as it can freeze its Trainer instantaneously.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME was once thought to be an ancient construct powered by a core of Never-Melt Ice. Its body radiates freezing air, instantly frosting the ground with every step it takes.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME collects trinkets and icicle-shaped charms, rattling them ominously during blizzards. Anyone who tries to steal its collection is met with an intense, icy glare that can freeze them in place.
author: .izik

entry: These abnormal Pokémon are capable of releasing freezing air or sweltering heat from their spike-like wings. They have been spotted in blistering hot climates and frigid cold climates, often seen acting as the local apex predator in some cases.
author: infinex21

entry: To hunt, POKENAME gnaws through solid ice, sticks its open maw into freezing water, and waits for unaware fish Pokémon to swim too close or inspect its glowing mouth. It is a popular ice fishing companion and inspiration for fishing inventions.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The membrane over POKENAME's eyes prevents snow blindness when it hunts across the arctic landscape. The acid it produces helps break down frozen prey for consumption.
author: mepp.

entry: When POKENAME detects signs of life, it triggers an icy explosion that freezes everything nearby. It relentlessly pursues its target until the area is completely frozen.
