entry: POKENAME's tunnels are filled with a pleasant Grepa Berry aroma. The scent relaxes intruders before it spits corrosive acid.
author: .izik

entry: When calm, POKENAME's leaves emit a pleasant Pomeg Berry scent. If agitated, it vibrates violently before detonating in a burst of energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatters sweet-scented pollen while flying over coastal waters. The aroma helps flock members navigate and regroup if separated.
author: .izik

entry: During the day, POKENAME floats in the water thanks to the oil droplets secreted from its roots. At night, when it needs water, it stops secreting it and begins absorbing it through its roots. It grows by moonlight and stores nutrients in its bulb.
author: drack8786

entry: POKENAME can be seen collecting leaves as it roams, though none are sure what criteria it uses to judge the ones it collects. Occasionally it will even offer coins to others in exchange for leaves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME train their toughness by planting their feet in the soil and letting other POKENAME attack them relentlessly. Its main weakness is being plucked into the air, where its soft underside becomes exposed.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hunt in packs, preferring lonely targets. They wouldn't hesitate to attack someone lost in the woods. It is advised to let all of your Pokémon out at once to intimidate them without starting a fight.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME release positively charged spores that repel each other, which helps them disperse throughout an area. Other Pokémon that inhale these spores will fall asleep, giving an POKENAME time to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaves atop POKENAME's head emit a faint positive charge. Botanists have studied this phenomenon for years, yet its cause remains unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases negatively charged spores that cling to fur and other biological materials. These spores create a numbing effect that prevents predators from chasing an POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a tail that glows with bioluminescent light. It releases a pollen that puts other people and Pokémon to sleep, making it rare to spot in the wild.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has bioluminescent leaves that glow in the dark at night. Children who play outside at night frequently get lost when chasing down an POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It swallows up large amounts of plant life in a single gulp, digesting over the course of several days. POKENAME's leaves can be used to brew tea with a strong flavor, and an even stronger aroma.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon are always hopping around to find a place to take root, which each individual is very peculiar about. Once they've taken root with their long, springy vine they will use psychic powers to defend themselves from being uprooted.
author: infinex21

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head releases a Liechi Berry scent that is pleasant but lingering, causing large migraines. This odd fragrance makes it hard for others to focus, giving POKENAME an advantage when hiding from potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins and drills itself into the dirt near plants to hide itself, leaving only its leafy fronds above the ground. When not on high alert, it can be seen happily hopping amongst flowers and batting them with its arms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's single leaf absorbs the dim sunlight on cloudy days with surprising efficiency. Many Trainers are fond of its blank facial expression.
author: hophoppip

entry: The brighter the sunlight, the more oniony fragrance POKENAME gives off. Even when highly excited, it retains its peculiarly neutral facial expression.
author: hophoppip

entry: The clouds POKENAME summons shower the land with drops of fragrant tree sap. Its gained some attention for its facial expression.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME defends itself by conjuring blizzards of pollen. The pollen is highly allergenic, inducing itchy eyes and runny noses in anyone caught in the storm.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's leafy wings release a calming Chesto Berry scent as it flies. It sleeps with its head buried in soil, landing only at night.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME are pulled out of the ground, they jingle at high frequencies in an attempt to escape whoever pulled them out. Once free, the ringing stops and they scamper away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often found hiding in budding gardens. Some say that finding one means you have a green thumb and will be blessed with bright flowers and a bountiful harvest.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME reacts aggressively when startled, kicking up dirt and spores with its feet. It is never calm and constantly paces in circles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's back grow hot while it runs. As it sprints, it leaves behind a faint scent like ripened Pinap Berries.
author: .izik

entry: They have no natural predators in their environment, and as such they do not have a need to pack a punch. To help develop their offensive abilities in battle, Trainers may use small vials of Wave Incense to help perk them up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head release a Coba Berry scent while it hunts in ponds. It will use Acid to incapacitate prey like Pidgey, ensuring a successful capture for later consumption.
author: .izik

entry: It buries itself in the ground to sleep during the day, surrounded by scattered leaves it maintains a psychic connection to. If something disturbs one of these leaves, it immediately teleports away to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lies in the tall grass, emitting a poisonous gas that causes psychological impairment. It weathers attacks with agile movements before vanishing into thin air.
author: dragon6420

entry: POKENAME possess incredible strength despite their small size, basking in the sun to increase muscle growth. They use their arms to yank Oddish out of the ground, hurling them past the horizon.
author: santon5512

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head release a sharp onion scent as it sways in the wind. Gardeners often mistake it for a common weed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found in marshes or swamps half submerged in the mud. It siphons nutrients from the mineral rich mud to grow leaves from its head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's leaves produce a thin layer of oil that seems to prevent Bug Pokémon from trying to eat it. It has recently been discovered that the oil is also great at treating insect stings.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides on the sea floor disguised as seaweed. It digs its tentacles into the sea floor to dredge up food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a nocturnal marine Pokémon whose entire body courses with a paralytic poison. Pokémon that swim between its vine-like tentacles become unable to move.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Prone to wandering across long distances, POKENAME will stop to rest by planting itself. Sometimes grazing Pokémon will mistake its leaves for grass and begin to eat it, causing POKENAME to angrily spray poisonous powders in retaliation.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME has shells that grow reeds and grasses that appear in marshes. It can be found buried in the mud, where it camouflages itself to hide from predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The stick it carries is actually multiple blades of tall grass wadded together. It fights against anyone who tries to mow down its grass.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME experience a jolt of energy whenever they absorb lots of sunlight and run around wildly to burn off some of the excess energy. During winter when there is little sunlight, they conserve their energy by limiting their movement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel along coastlines to find a viable spot to sunbathe undisturbed. Once they find a suitable location, they fall asleep and absorb sunlight through their leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The idea of sleeping somewhere dry is completely anathema to POKENAME, as they require lots of water and sunlight to develop. They rest alongside coastlines to get those nutrients while sleeping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mud-like slime that coats POKENAME's body and is surprisingly rich in nutrients. Its head-leaves twitch and turn toward sunlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are a common Pokémon to be included in aquariums, their leaves filtering out impurities in the water whilst their shell keeps them from being disturbed. They pump water past their leaves by opening and closing their shells.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This timid Pokémon hides in its tough, chestnut-like shell, only revealing itself when it is alone. Because of this, POKENAME is often sluggish due to limited activity and poor air circulation.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME drifts aimlessly at night, leaving clouds of pollen wherever it goes. Sightings of POKENAME are often mistaken for wandering spirits.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its ominous smile has been regarded by many people as terrifying. Even the bravest people have a tough time looking at POKENAME for at least a minute.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME maintains its rotund head and the leaves on its body by rubbing against sharp rocks. This smooths out its body, making it faster in battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Miners once fled in terror when a cavern wall began to breathe, revealing POKENAME's moss-covered body. It slithered off to a quieter resting place, leaving mushrooms growing endlessly where it once slept.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The leaves atop POKENAME's head smell like Pomeg Berries. This aroma can lull prey to sleep, allowing it to feast on their dreams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time napping in flower gardens, particularly during moonlit nights. When it absorbs a large amount of moonlight, its larger claw emits a floral scent akin to lilac.
author: sk372

entry: The wings of POKENAME are functional enough to lift it off the ground, but it prefers to use them as a form of intimidation alongside its quick footwork.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is a very eager dancer. It loves to dance in bright sunlight, which fuels its flames and creates adorably beautiful displays.
author: robbery_666

entry: It will use silky string to assist in its elaborate dances. If it dances too quickly, it may accidentally light the strings on fire.
author: .izik

entry: Despite an appearance found charming by many, POKENAME are dangerous due to the explosive mix of fire and electricity broiling within them. They explosively release their energies when angered, which is all too easy to accomplish.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are commonly seen during festivals honoring people's ancestors, Legends say that POKENAME were seen as a musical spirit guide for the dead.
author: roninthedev

entry: In combat, POKENAME's swaying motions make for an unpredictable opponent. A foe is never certain if POKENAME's next move will be an elegant feinting sway of its wings, or a fist of flame careening towards them.
author: sk372

entry: The silk it shoots from its body is extremely hot. If it ever lands in dried leaves, it can cause a massive forest fire.
author: .izik

entry: Much of POKENAME's time is spent teaching its young the coordination and focus needed to perfect their trademark combat dance. Though the child is still learning, it is capable of creating tiny fire tornadoes with its moves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flaps its fins and swims in specific motions to stimulate its body and heat it up from the inside. This lets it spit out burning-hot bubbles and scalding ink to defend itself from larger creatures.
author: sk372

entry: Abundant in springtime, POKENAME arrange in dazzling waves of red above fields of flowers. Their intricate and graceful mid-air dances are a sign that pollen production is exceptionally high.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME are masters of the flamenco and enjoy putting on shows when they can. Whenever they clap their hands, fire sparks.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's large, sharp feathers on its arm are able to cut through granite with ease. It moves with lethal precision, slicing through the air as it dances in combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shoots flames around its body while it dances. It does elaborate leaps and poses, igniting the battlefield with each carefully choreographed move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pincers open and close in rhythm as it dances. Its movements are sharp and precise, making it a challenging opponent for anyone who underestimates its grace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically frolics docilly, but if it catches sight of its reflection, it rages and attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: The more intent POKENAME is at leaping about, the bigger and stronger its flames become. It dishes out huge fiery slaps from its fins at predators who try to catch it mid-jump.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spins on the stinger on its head while it dances. Its tiny body moves with surprising grace as it performs intricate twirls, the stinger serving as both a balance and a weapon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to dance underwater. The unpredictable movement of its wings is meant to lure in prey until they are close enough to be taken out by a swift charge attack.
author: thezekrom

entry: The bold, fiery dance of POKENAME combines elements from many dancers, each technique copied and memorized in its body. Even though POKENAME's dances lack originality, its superb skill rivals human dancers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are passionate dancers who create sparks as they dance, putting on unique shows. They live on beaches and will often accidentally leave behind intricate patterns of glass pawprints that fascinate those who come across them.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME spits silk to move itself around the battlefield. It spins in an odd dance while fighting, making it difficult for opponents to predict its next move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a striking combination of beauty and deadliness. It dances as it fights, moving to a rhythm only it hears, weaving through the battlefield with dangerous gracefulness. If you can beat POKENAME in dance, you will win its allegiance.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Despite its large rotund body, POKENAME's dance routines contain a surprising level of elegance to them. Its perpetually-warm belly is considered a quite pleasant place to nap against.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a strong preference for red flowers, the pigments of which are extracted and used for vibrant plumage coloration. Their flight patterns, though erratic to the human eye, are carefully measured and precise.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENMAE leap about while kicking their hind legs and flaring out their feathers to intimidate opponents. If the threat approaches anyway, they ignite their feathers and scatter them in vibrant dances.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Instead of strumming with its fingers, POKENAME uses small jolts of electricity to play the ukulele. The music it plays comes from southern cultures.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This fiery Pokémon is known for its hypnotic belly drumming during spiritual ceremonies in the Alola region. POKENAME's belly drumming is also known to soothe headaches and inflammation.
author: big_clanker

entry: POKENAME performs a rapid dance atop the surfaces of ponds, never sinking beneath the water. At night, faint embers can be seen glowing beneath its steps as it moves with grace.
author: .izik

entry: Every week, POKENAME jumps about to shed its old casing. This cast-off material has a very spicy taste.
author: .realthree

entry: While the rose in POKENAME's mouth looks harmless, it can instantly light ablaze to burn anyone that touches it. As this tactic fails in water, POKENAME instead performs a passionate dance that in actuality digs itself into the mud to hide away.
author: soup1900

entry: The bulb on its back takes in sunlight to increase its internal temperature. When confronted by predators in the wild, or during a fierce battle, POKENAME releases the heated spores by whipping them around with its wings.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME loves to dance by rocking its head back and forth and flailing its arms all around, especially when loud and harsh music is being played. Oddly, no matter how much POKENAME jams and rocks out, its tail remains eerily still.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's stone-hard wings spin around its body as it dances deep in caves. The rhythmic movements resonate through the rocky tunnels, causing small tremors with each powerful beat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bites at the air as it dances, making a Scary Face to intimidate all who watch. Its performance is both endearing and threatening, creating a perfect mix of charm and menace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travel in pairs, with one dancing to distract a target while the other steals food, such as Pokémon eggs. Because of this deceptive behavior and their ability to fight adeptly, POKENAME has inspired many scoundrels in fiction.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's dances act partially as a mating display, but also have been theorized to be a form of communication. It is less territorial than Ursaring and doesn't mind distant onlookers to its dancing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of extremely tiny feathers that resemble liquid as it dances. The feathers glisten and shimmer, creating a visual spectacle during its movements.
author: .izik

entry: People used to hunt POKENAME with a shortbow or lance, as their feathers were once collected for textiles. These weapons were banned on islands, creating a sanctuary for them to grow and prosper.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME howls while spinning during its dance. The flames it produces are so intense that they're hot enough to melt steel, showcasing its strength and passion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME kicks up dazzling embers as it shows off its fancy footwork and high-speed spins. If it spins too passionately, it turns from a cool show of fire into an intense flaming tornado.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME kicks up dazzling embers as it shows off its fancy footwork and high-speed spins. Spectators of these shows must watch from far away in the event it spins too fast and becomes an intense tornado of fire instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are passionate creatures that spend most of their time perfecting their dance. Their tail thuds against the ground to produce a clapping sound that they rely on to keep rhythm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whether beneath the water or in the air, POKENAME's movements are twisting and elegant. With a single flap of its wings, it can create a rising geyser of scalding liquid to erupt from any body of water near it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's feathers on its tail crackle with electricity as it dances. If ignored, it will unleash lightning bolts from its tail to ensure its presence is known.
author: .izik

entry: When angry, it thrashes its head and smacks its tail on the ground. The motion of thrashing fuels its fiery abilities, helping it generate flames to sear its foes.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses their seductive dance moves and natural beauty to coax other Pokémon into doing its bidding. It tricks its enemies into dancing with it before incinerating them with its wings.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME diligently practices its dancing, attempting to turn each clumsy misstep into a new dance move. While dancing, it moves its wings intricately despite their short length.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME generates its flames by performing rapid dances with frenzied footwork. It weaves its own shed feathers into an elegant fan to hold while dancing.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's lower body is clad in many small feathers densely packed together. It performs a careful dance when it is happy, and with people or Pokémon it trusts, but the friction of its feathers can easily spark fires if near kindling.
author: infinex21

entry: By beating its wings together, POKENAME can create flames; it frequently beats its wings together as it dances. POKENAME dances during battle and when it is happy.
author: infinex21

entry: Their mesmerizing dances are the result of intense practice. It's best not to interrupt their training; they've been know to stomp toes when annoyed.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME create flames through the friction of their many feathers as they dance. They wield telekinetic powers to control and command these flames either for battle or to enhance their performances.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME often are found tending to injured birds. It will create a small Fire Spin around itself and its patients when in danger.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME lives in colder climates as its beautiful feathers give off large amounts of heat.  It is a difficult Pokémon to please as it will spew harsh flames at any potential mate it doesn't like.
author: mistymagius

entry: While dancing, POKENAME occasionally shifts its body to a random primary color. This appears to be involuntary and occurs more frequently when POKENAME is anxious.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appears intimidating at first, and for good reason. Instilled with rage for the loss of its wings, any Pokémon that fly near it are subject to a brutal combination of flames and lethal fog to strike it down.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME's false mouth serves an additional purpose as a dance partner for it to practice its moves with. When the two pirouette at high speeds, it creates a small flaming tornado around them.
author: sk372

entry: For POKENAME, its dance is everything, a facet of life that cannot be lived without. It won't even entertain the thought of obeying a Trainer unwilling to dance with it regularly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very slow walker outside of battle. Wild Oricorio seem to flock to perform on the stage on its back whenever they can.
author: ferdirenz

entry: POKENAME's feathers are coated in a sweet-smelling poison that gets more potent as it dances during battle. The rhythmic motions enhance the potency of its toxic dance.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME swings itself at enemies, a blazing flame is created from its long cloth and wings. These flames are believed to be the burning passions of the soul that inhabits this sword.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's two swords attack opponents as a duet, performing blazing strikes and fiery slices at enemies. Its passionate attack patterns are similar to the moves and rhythms of traditional dances from the Paldea region.
author: soup1900

entry: What appears to be an Oricorio atop its box-like body is actually just a very accurate replica. This replica can dance as if it were alive, but only when the crank on the side of its body has been fully wound up.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME are often seen forming dazzling illusions through dance. It uses this skill to lure in smaller Pokémon for a snack.
author: manwithagun

entry: POKENAME dance with dramatic flourishes of their fur to make sure they can capture the attetion of everyone nearby. They lead crowds in song and dance through towns, always looking for more to join their performacnes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is known for its battle prowess, using its ribbons and agility to take down foes much larger than itself. It is believed its fiery movements have inspired many classical dances.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME performs a lighthearted samba near its allies to excite them during fights. Its hot feelers wave through the air, creating a rippling effect around it.
author: .izik

entry: Deep within the mountains, POKENAME performs a graceful dance once each year. Those fortunate enough to witness it claim its flames kindle a warmth in their hearts that lingers for months.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Deep within the mountains, POKENAME performs a graceful dance once each year. Those fortunate enough to witness it claim its flames kindle a warmth in their hearts that lingers for months.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its arrival transforms quiet plazas into blooming stages, where it dances with such passion that flowers burst from the cracks in the stone. Entire towns gather to watch, spellbound, unable to look away until the final bow.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME drifts above festival crowds, inflating and deflating with the beat of the music. Though playful, it grows aggressive toward parade balloons that block its view, often popping them with its sharp beak.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as bodyguards. By spinning their parasols rapidly, they can fling fire into a protective ring around themself and their Trainer.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME waves its multiple tails in circular patterns while dancing. Each flick of its tails sends ripples through the air, making it look like a fiery whirlpool in motion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eject burning internal organs from their bodies to smack Trainers who give them a bad order. Their sticky mucus is flammable; this allows them to ignite the hands of anyone who lifts and chucks them into the ocean.
author: soup1900

entry: Jingling the small charms on POKENAME's ring casts out a pleasant warmth in the immediate vicinity. Though generally peaceful, POKENAME will ignite the charms and fling them at others if angered enough.
author: sk372

entry: The pattern on each wing of POKENAME is entirely unique. This Pokémon will unfurl its wings both as a defense mechanism and as part of its courting ritual.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: As POKENAME prances around, its many tails swish through the air in a light and elegantly flowing manner. Those who attempt to touch its tails will be blown away by a wave of fire it creates with a single swishing motion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can often be seen flopping on lake shores. Its flailing is actually an intentional dance routine.
author: .towerxvi

entry: At festivals, POKENAME helps smaller children see over crowds by lifting them with its string-like arms. If the music gets too loud, though, it starts twirling wildly, startling its passengers and nearby onlookers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Once the sun sets, flocks of POKENAME will emerge from their caves and start performing a passionate dance with one another. The more passionate the dancing, the more flames their wings give off.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spits a poisonous chemical as it dances on tree branches. Its movements are erratic, and the dangerous chemical only adds to the excitement of its performance.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is around, it is a guarantee that other POKENAME of various forms are to be found nearby. The heat produced from taking in moonlight causes its leaf-like feathers to glow vividly.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is considered one of the finest solo performers in the Pokémon world. It often opens dance festivals with passionate routines that leave the audience breathless before the main event even begins.
author: jaminmcready

entry: A living emblem of synchronized dance duos, POKENAME dazzles with a perfect unity of motion. Aspiring partners in the dancing world often look to it as a symbol of harmony and competitive flair.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The friction of POKENAME's pom poms can ignite dry brush with ease. Forest patrols have documented it practicing deep in the woods, often tracing it by the scorched trails it leaves behind.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This athletic POKENAME throws spining kicks as it dances around the battlefield. It grows restless when it doesn't have space to dance and spin.
author: malxire

entry: A breakdancing powerhouse, POKENAME flips and freezes with raw street energy. Smoke raises as it spins across the ground scorching the floor in perfect rhythm.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This kind of POKENAME enjoys collecting flowers to wear on its head. Its favorite foods are the spiciest of berries.
author: malxire

entry: POKENAME uses the fans on its arms to blow fiery embers at opponents. When cold, it wraps them around its face for warmth, making them both weapons and comfort.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This form of POKENAME's skittish movements makes it unpredictable on the dance floor and on the battlefield.
author: malxire

entry: POKENAME's body is a torn bag full of powder down and feathers. The influence of red pollen inspires POKENAME's frantic dance moves.
author: hophoppip

entry: If you are swimming and you see steam in the water, it is probably an POKENAME. They are often engulfed by steam when the fire produced by flapping their wings meets water.
author: astral_1447

entry: It creates waves of fire when it dances. Its style of dancing is impossible to replicate without six feet.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME releases a blue pollen to put foes nearby to sleep while it dances. The faster it dances, the faster the pollen gets released, making it a formidable opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Red Nectar. It has a sharp, spicy taste that causes a warm sting to linger in the mouth.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME bounces from one soft leg to another while dancing. Its playful and adorable movements make it difficult to take seriously, yet its agility is unmatched during its dance.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon has a strong artistic spirit. It performs elaborate dances while creating intriguing illustrations with fire.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME that drink a certain kind of nectar develop this appearance. The mushrooms taste bland, save for the spicy red frill.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's feather-like scales on its back flap up and down as it dances. Its movements are precise, adding to its battle prowess with every graceful step.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances happily in the moonlight but will bolt if someone spots it. Its graceful movements are brief but beautiful, fading quickly into the shadows as it flees.
author: .izik

entry: The petals of POKENAME resemble a beautiful gown that enhances the grace of its dance steps. It has a fiery temperament and flies into a rage if another Pokémon dares to ruin its performance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The gems on POKENAME's body glitter in a brilliant red hue, the light scattering through them and casting beautiful patterns onto the walls as it dances. The dancing of POKENAME is thought to bring good fortune to Trainers who see it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The rubies on POKENAME's body radiate intense heat. Ancient peoples relied on them for warmth during harsh winters.
author: mistymagius

entry: The small rubies on POKENAME's body can generate intense heat. It can shoot the amazingly hard splinters that surround it over several meters, or use them to protect itself from enemy attacks.
author: chorb33

entry: When POKENAME dances around, its feathers rub together to create a flurry of small embers. Its eyes are able to see infared light, allowing it to easily detect predators during the night.
author: mistymagius

entry: On dance floors, POKENAME whips up clouds of dust with its large tail to accent its moves. While the effect is dazzling, it often leaves nearby dancers coughing and waving the air clear mid-performance.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Fire swirls around POKENAME as it dances with practiced grace. Its feet are coated in fire when it dances fast enough, leaving scorched pawprints in its wake.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can dance on water with their long amphibious legs, drawing many crowds to see them dance. While many people come to see this gimmick, many stay for their passionate and emotional dancing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME releases smoke from its shell in rhythm as it dances. The plumes of smoke add a hazy aura to its graceful movements, creating a mystical and fiery spectacle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather together at night once a year to dance joyfully to each other's songs. Their gathering spot is said to be a place between life and death, and that whoever interrupts these Pokémon's dancing gets swept away to the afterlife.
author: milchik

entry: It beats its wings together to create fire and launch it at foes. It is well-known for the courtship dances it performs, which are enjoyed by many people as well as by potential mates.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fling fireballs from a distance to entrap their targets. When they have ensured their targets cannot escape, they dive down to deliver a finishing blow.
author: infinex21

entry: As it dances, POKENAME controls flames elegantly with every swing of its wings. Should a headache strike mid-dance, however, it may lose control and wind up launching a sweeping wave of fire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME does a delicate dance, causing flames to ignite with each step. The fiery display can be mesmerizing, as it swirls and leaps in rhythm.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely skilled POKENAME can create copies of itself made of flame to serve as backup dancers to its performance. Notably, the two simulacra exhibit differing personalities and dance moves compared to their creator.
author: sk372

entry: The Lone Earring attached to its ear picks up sound vibrations that help it move in synchronicity to certain moves. Its fire flickers with passion and vitality and grows in intensity whenever it needs a boost before the finale.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is venerated as both a creator and destroyer. The flames it whips up while dancing do not burn its allies.
author: fenragon

entry: Despite their clumsiness, POKENAME have a passion for dancing, their petals giving off small ember when they do so. Their saliva gives off the sweet scent of roses and is often used in air fresheners.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves dancing, but is usually two or three beats behind any audible music. If anyone mocks its off-beat dance moves, it becomes angry and sprays fiery embers until it becomes distracted by the music again.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Each head is perpetually bobbing to a tempo only the POKENAME can hear. Sometimes, this results in bickering over what rhythm is best suited for a given activity.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME gracefully floats through the water, leaving a trail of Red Nectar behind it. If its flame is large and vibrant, it's a sign of healthiness.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Despite their limited mobility, POKENAME dances are fierce and beautiful. They will click their claws as they dance, using them like castanets.
author: santon5512

entry: The feathers on top of its head let loose a strong citrus scent. It will use the powder from this to mark its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances around with twirling, flipping and hopping motions, each rotation giving it more electrical energy to work with.  Once it finishes a dance sequence, it releases the pent-up energy in a huge burst around it.
author: sk372

entry: The six eggs of POKENAME are almost always found stacked into a pyramid. They form this structure to see further, intimidate enemies, and sometimes purely for fun.
author: hophoppip

entry: When sparring, POKENAME rubs its feet and gloves together, building up electricity. It will then strike with electrical punches while also moving with lightning-fast footwork that even high-level professional boxers try to imitate.
author: shyguy11011

entry: It builds up static by rubbing its feathers together. It charges up its body daily, waiting for its eventual evolution.
author: .izik

entry: Dozens of little pom-poms make up POKENAME's body, rubbing against each other to generate protective static electricity. It can vibrate itself faster to generate larger amounts and send out crackling bolts of lightning if needed.
author: sk372

entry: Young POKENAME tend to join Trainers in their games, leading their mothers to cheer them on. While the mothers originally only crafted pom poms to cheer on their young, many gained a joy for the art.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME's kind personality leads it to cheer for both sides of a battle equally when it spectates. After watching a battle unfold, it flies over and spreads a static pollen that helps soothe the combatants' tired muscles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins its staff while cheering on its allies, releasing a psychic wave that cheers up anyone around it. The playful psychic energy lifts the mood of the group, making them feel more confident and positive.
author: .izik

entry: When using its Swords Dance, POKENAME waves its pom-poms in triangle patterns. Its rhythmic chirps enhance the intensity of its attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances and sways rhythmically to cheer on its allies. Its movements are mesmerizing, and those who view them often end up dancing and cheering along.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME waves its pom-poms in the air while chasing down prey, making a terrifying scream. It primarily inhabits dark forests, its glowing yellow poms illuminating the darkness as it moves swiftly in pursuit of its target.
author: .izik

entry: For defense, it rubs its body with the fluffy pom-poms to generate static electricity and shock those that touch it. If it should be caught without an electrified body, it can still always deliver a shock from the horn on its head.
author: sk372

entry: Pods of POKENAME sing and cheer to each other to solidify social bonds. Their fluffy down easily collects static, which in turn allows POKENAME to shock potential predators and escape.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME molds its body into a copy of its Trainer to cheer on its teammates. Its electrifying performance revitalizes the spirit of its teammates to help push them to victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME performs an excited dance after winning a battle, cheering itself on with its floppy ears bouncing up and down. Its joyful energy is contagious, spreading happiness to those around it as it celebrates its victory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are strong and nimble swimmers who play with round objects, tossing them about and generating electric charges through kinetic energy. They are very popular with Trainers due to their positive and spirited disposition.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME is almost always dancing with its webbed pom-poms. If someone dislikes its dancing, it may poison or electrify them.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: One should be very careful not to anger POKENAME. Its spiked pom-poms make for deadly punches, but can also be lobbed from afar, where they will burst apart in a shower of lightning and spiked projectiles.
author: sk372

entry: The pom-pom on their head carries a potent electric charge, which is strengthened by the bright yellow flowers POKENAME cultivate in their nests, called bowers. POKENAME will inadvertently shock their trainers while waving this pom-pom about.
author: vic1312

entry: Attracted to sources of static electricity, POKENAME often winds up nesting around human laundry. Domesticated POKENAME are often seen around the house with an errant sock stuck to their fluffy plumage due to static cling.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are extremely protective of their hairstyle. Despite their watchfulness, their hair is remarkably resilient, remaining perfectly intact even in the face of a tornado.
author: _kuke_

entry: POKENAME generates electricity through its pom-poms, which they use to power up their allies. They make up little cheering squads with each other, sometimes including Plusle and Minun as well.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sits on the sides of routes, cheering on travelers with its songs. Its invigorating melodies bring a sense of joy and energy to everyone who hears it, boosting morale on long journeys.
author: .izik

entry: The bright colors of POKENAME's feathers are caused by the electricity stored within them. Their glow becomes dim when POKENAME is exhausted, and they shine brightly when it is furious.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME barge into parties and bars to amaze people with their dancing skills. They wave their pom-poms to the music, and when a party ends, they sneak out to find another party to infiltrate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its pompoms give POKENAME its bright smile. Its entire body has evolved to be flexible enough to pose as the whole alphabet.
author: birchbot

entry: The hair on POKENAME's head is practical for storing berries. During the wintertime, this Pokémon relies on the berries it has harvested to survive.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME generates electricity through static generated from the cotton on its wings, illuminating the sky with sparks.
author: anarchaz

entry: When frightened, POKENAME grabs hold of its own large tail-fluff and rubs it for comfort. This not only serves to calm it, but the rubbing accelerates its own electric output, letting it shoot defensive sparks if necessary.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely exciteable by nature, POKENAME wave their tails around to build up static while they dance. To show their support for their friends and teammates, they will hold their tails above their heads with a dazzling display of sparks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Electricity caused the seed that makes up POKENAME's body to pop open. It's a popular mascot for instant popcorn brands.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME always uses its feathered membranes to electrify its body on land to shock anyone that tries to touch it. It energetically splashes in the mud to ground its electrical charges before returning to the water.
author: soup1900

entry: It lazily waves its pom-poms around while standing in deep ponds, gathering water plants and small Pokémon to eat. Its pom-poms can also release an electric shock if a more active predator attempts to ambush it.
author: hophoppip

entry: While Misdreavus feeds on fear, POKENAME is instead nourished by determination. To sustain itself, it cheers on humans and Pokémon whenever it can.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its odd anatomy shifts continuously into various cheering poses. When multiple POKENAME are together, their enigmatic movements will synchronize.
author: missingmilkman

entry: POKENAME loves to dance, but the back head is a lot more particular about its technique than the main one. It will often kick up a fuss when the main head messes up its footwork.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME often appears uninvited at festivals and parties, spreading joy with its cheers. It boosts the spirits of both Pokémon and Trainers. Strangely, POKENAME always carries confetti, though its origin remains unknown.
author: _kuke_

entry: It moves too sluggishly to charge into battle itself, so it calls out to its fighting allies to encourage them. After the battle, it produces sweet drinks for its tired allies using fruit and nectar it's gathered.
author: hophoppip

entry: In the wild, POKENAME is a fierce hunter, pouncing on prey and using the pom-poms on its hands to electrocute a pinned victim. Despite its ferocity, a captured POKENAME makes a great teammate, cheering on its team happily.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME practices hard every day and becomes literally charged with electricity when others cheer for it. It appears to pass dances along from parent to child by practicing together.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME practices hard every day and becomes literally charged with electricity when others cheer for it. It appears to pass dances along from parent to child by practicing together.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When threatened, POKENAME shakes its tail to scare off predators. This often fails, as the gesture looks more cheerful than frightening.
author: hophoppip

entry: This cheerful pachyderm loves to make others smile. Although docile, POKENAME is not afraid to use its pom-pom to give its enemies a nasty shock.
author: thropp

entry: POKENAME creates electric bolts on contact with any surface as long as it is spinning. Electrical generators have been created to harvest both its centrifugal force and electric bolts for maximum power efficiency.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are excitable creatures that cheer on their teammates by lifting their hood high. They often get complaints of blocking the view for other people watching Pokémon battles or sporting events.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME commands the skies with dazzling dance moves. Its rhythmic movements and serene demeanor bring harmony and beauty to the heavens.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME love to play with their soft tail, playfully headbutting it and producing small sparks. Groups of these Pokémon can be seen dancing together during the springtime.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dances while picking Nanab Berries from trees, using its pom-poms to knock the fruit loose. Its rhythmic movements make it a master of gathering, and it never misses a beat, effortlessly collecting berries in the process.
author: .izik

entry: It decorates large Berries with pigments made from nectar and flower petals, then juggles the Berries to entertain its friends. Once the performance is done, it shares the Berries with its buddies as a snack.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME enthusiastically dances, rubbing its pom-poms against the stone it carries after every performance. It's presumed that this act is practice for nurturing and stimulating real eggs once it matures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cheers on its allies with uplifting songs and dazzling dance moves. It uses the feathers on its forehead like gymnastic ribbons, incorporating them into its dance choreography.
author: porterofgames

entry: POKENAME is able to sense the emotions of humans. It's typically quite shy, but if its Trainer is feeling incapable or sad, it will dance to cheer them on.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME emit elative psychic waves as they dance and generate considerable electricity when their feathers rub together. Both of these factors have led quite a few medical facilities to utilize these Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's empathic sense makes it excellent at encouragement. If its Trainer is feeling incapable, it will cheer them on, even if their problems seem trivial to other humans.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME loves to happily cheer on its friends' battles with its dances, but is a very sore loser. If a cheered friend doesn't win the fight, POKENAME stomps around and throws lightning in a tantrum.
author: sk372

entry: The face of this specific POKENAME resembles the mascot of a certain chip brand. Because of this, it is usually featured in their commercials.
author: mercury_sc

entry: A scandal occurred when Pokéathlon judges learned POKENAME were directing their Trainers telepathically via cheers. They're now banned from the dome.
author: quote.lass

entry: It can discharge electricity using its long, sharp claws. They often burrow into the ground near transmission towers, enjoying being close to electricity.
author: mrpimbus

entry: POKENAME is known for its docile personality, making it popular with children. The soft tufts of fur on its ears and tail store built-up static electricity.
author: mepp.

entry: It's constantly dancing, even while hunting prey. The dance serves as a distraction, as while smaller Pokémon are busy watching it dance, it snatches them up with its lightning-fast extendable tongue.
author: hophoppip

entry: The pompoms found on an POKENAME look fluffy and are made of a spongy material. This allows it to soak water up, which hydrates the POKENAME.
author: jojojax164

entry: It loves to run for exercise. The fluff on its head may look soft, but it's thick enough to absorb the shock when this Pokémon headbutts foes.
author: hophoppip

entry: When POKENAME spots an attack incoming, it shuffles in place to charge its body with electricity from its fluffy bits. Once the attack strikes, its shield-like cranium lets loose a powerful and paralyzing electric burst.
author: sk372

entry: It appears in people's houses in the middle of the night, phasing through walls to chase them down. It's usually seen as frightening, but POKENAME actually aims to have a fun time with the humans it chases.
author: hophoppip

entry: Chipper and exuberant, POKENAME prances around others singing and creating floating pom-poms that follow its allies. These fuzzy orbs shower them with sparks that energize them and enhance their performance in subsequent battles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can channel electrical attacks through the pom-pom-like sprout growing out of its head. During thunderstorms, it absorbs lightning strikes, channeling the energy through its body and adding a surge of power to its attacks.
author: .izik

entry: The pollen from the yellow flowers on POKENAME's back is highly allergenic, making it an unpopular Pokémon to bring out during spring.
author: ferdirenz

entry: It generates electrical charges through the friction of its fluffy head tuft. It's quite proud of this tuft, and will quickly rinse it off in water the moment it gets dirty.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME electrifies its teammates' spirits and opponents' hearts with its moves. It shakes its pom-pom to build up its electric charge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When POKENAME slices and hits an enemy, static electricity is released, paralyzing the foe. This same static electricity is released when it rubs its two blades against its feathers, creating sparks that simultaneously awe fans while scaring enemies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME retains a defensive stance for most of its fights, absorbing blows and building up energy. Once it's fully charged, it unsheathes its blade, wrapped in crackling electricity, and goes on the offensive.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME helps lost travelers in the desert find their way home. When they finally reach their destination, POKENAME celebrates by performing a special dance.
author: ferdirenz

entry: Whenever present for the start of a tournament, POKENAME launch waves of confetti into the air by flapping their massive wings before cheering on allies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While cheering on its allies, POKENAME shakes its head rapidly and releases a delightful lemon-hydrangea scent from its poms that soothes anyone nearby. The scent is potent enough to linger for days.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME sense that someone is feeling anxious, they will perform a cheerful dance to help calm them down. They are often kept in psychiatric hospitals for this reason, helping to ease panic attacks in patients.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME absorbs ambient electricity in the atmosphere within the cloudy segments of its body. Once full of electric energy, the puffs fall from its body and become thunderclouds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME mesmerizes onlookers with graceful dances, scattering yellow flower petals that crackle with electricity and poison. Enemies caught in its performance are stunned before they can even react, making its beauty as dangerous as it is dazzling.
author: silentscript89

entry: It loves to cheer on a Pokémon who is in the middle of a battle. Its enthusiasm and coordinated dancing are positively electrifying and charge targets with energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It loves to cheer on a Pokémon who is in the middle of a battle. Its enthusiasm and coordinated dancing are positively electrifying and charge targets with energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's downy feathers hold poisonous spores produced by its body. It rubs its hands in this down to cover them in spores and static electricity before punching opponents.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is a very resentful Pokémon. It can't stand the thought of anyone dancing better than it, and it flies into a rage when that happens. It disrupts other Pokémon Contest competitors' performances by giving them small electric shocks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This fusion is its Trainer's fan in both senses of the word. It cheers on its Trainer and their team with dances while keeping them cool with a cool breeze.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME does cheering motions while floating over rice fields. Its energetic gestures seem to boost the growth of nearby plants, as though its cheerful presence accelerates their development, bringing unexpected vitality to the crops.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as court dancers. To entertain guests, POKENAME would shoot electricity from their fingers at key moments in their performances.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME jiggles its body to rub its pom-poms together and create showers of sparks as displays of support to its allies. The act leaves a residual magnetic charge for a time, so metal objects are pulled towards it during these dances.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stays close to other Pom-Pom Style Oricorio, mimicking their cheerful dances. With its flimsy movements, it cannot maintain the same rhythm as the Pokémon it imitates, but it tries with relentless energy.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: Shaking and rubbing its feathers together lets POKENAME create bright showers of sparks around it. It does this because it has poor eyesight, so the extra illumination helps it gauge its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: The main head enthusiastically cheers on its allies, not realizing how terrifying its roars are. The heads on its arms simply repeat after the main head, giving off energetic bursts of electricity in time with POKENAME's movements.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME's performances are a dazzling storm of light and rhythm, the stage always too small for its expansive displays. Some believe it taps into deep space signals to choreograph its routines.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME follows those with a good aura, cheering them on in everything they do. Its enthusiasm knows no bounds, and it provides constant support to those who inspire it, becoming a loyal companion and motivator.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shakes its ears and tail in a great dance. When it gets too excited, POKENAME accidentally shocks itself with static electricity.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME imitates humans to cheer them on during sporting events. While it doesn't speak any human language, its expressive movements and enthusiasm stand out, drawing attention and causing a wave of excitement wherever it goes.
author: .izik

entry: Research has shown that POKENAME is often found injured in the wild, mainly because its feathers are not as developed as other forms. This causes it to fall behind in groups.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME struts onto the floor like it already won. It tosses glitter into the air with every move and demands admiration with long rehearsed spins and theatrical bows.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME lights up the floor like a disco spotlight. It spins with rhythm and sass, throwing poses that leave crowds stunned and challengers shook.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If you see an POKENAME in the wild, chances are it is cheering for another Pokémon. It is very energetic and upbeat.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: This form of POKENAME is extremely friendly. When large groups come together to dance, you can feel the ground shaking.
author: malxire

entry: This POKENAME's yellow and green feathers light up during its nightly dances to warn posible predators of the danger that comes of trying to eat it.
author: malxire

entry: When finding a particularly good source of garbage to eat, POKENAME cheers and dances, shaking its pom-poms about. This occasionally triggers its electric abilities and accidentally fries the meal it was preparing to consume.
author: sk372

entry: Collecting yellow pollen in its powder down makes POKENAME take this form. It scatters down as it cheers and dances spiritedly.
author: hophoppip

entry: This Pokémon camouflages into windy forests with a swaying motion that looks like a dance. When its flowers collide, they release seeds and spark with arcs of electricity.
author: hiimhdere

entry: POKENAME releases a Maranga Berry scent while cheering on its allies, invigorating all nearby. This sweet fragrance lifts the spirits of its companions, empowering them with a burst of energy during battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Yellow Nectar. It has a tart, citrusy taste that leaves a slight tingle on the tongue.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME exclusively claws up vibrant yellow flowers to devour and absorb their energy from. When it sees destruction, it can't help but cheer and join in on the fun by sending out beams of electricity from its large, puffy feathers.
author: soup1900

entry: The ends of POKENAME's arms are puffs of soft stuffing. Children with sleep issues are often given one, as its gentle nature and plush limbs make for a perfect sleeping companion.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME waves its pom-poms wildly to generate electrical power and intimidate enemies. If you see it dancing, beware!
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME waves its pom-poms wildly to generate electrical power and intimidate enemies. If you see it dancing, beware!
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME bobs up and down, quickly dodging its foes' attacks before slamming them from above.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's mouthpart is specialized for sipping nectar from flowers. The flavor of nectar it drinks has an effect on the mushrooms it hosts.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are almost always cheery and energetic, their fur giving off sparks when they get especially excited. They live in small clusters, sticking themselves together with static electricity.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME energize players by performing stunts and shaking their pom-poms. With their powerful legs, they display their eagerness to inspire by jumping high into the air before landing with a flourish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's pom-pom coming out of its shell wiggles back and forth, releasing the smell of burnt wood while it fights. This behavior occurs unconsciously, adding an odd element to its movements and making its presence even more intense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leaps from tree branches into lakes with others of its kind. It cheers loudly based on how impressive each dive looks during the splash.
author: .izik

entry: Using the flame on its tail, POKENAME performs energetic fire dances in front of cheering crowds. It is incredibly friendly and will happily dance alongside any Pokémon it meets.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME is constantly shedding clumps of fluffy down, which pile around its body. It can bob up and down at incredible speeds, creating a static charge through friction to power up its electrical attacks.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's dance consists of nimble, crisscrossing movements. A well-known children's game is to imitate it, often ending in getting dizzy and falling over in a giggling fit.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME are enthusiastic cheerleaders that love to get the crowd excited. Their trademark whistle comes from the leaf on their head, which shakes with excitement whenever a gust of wind blows by.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Ominous chants echoing from the trees are a sign of its presence. The chants serve as a warning before POKENAME strikes.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME cheers on its allies with a zeal that borders on aggression. Though it means well, the sheer volume and intensity of its cheering tends to be more distracting than supportive.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are enthusiastic Pokémon that take great joy in the success of others. They are common sights on the side lines of sporting events, giving excited cheers and co-ordinated waves of their tail pom-poms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love to cheer for their Trainer and teammates. Over the course of a Pokémon battle, they can forget who they are cheering for and simply cheer whoever is winning.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enthusiastically cheers on other Pokémon during battle, but angers easily if others don't seem to appreciate it. Trainers should always thank POKENAME after battle even if it did nothing.
author: haxx64

entry: POKENAME rolls around to produce and store electricity in its fluffy body. If it rolls downhill and gains enough speed, it can cover itself with a visible barrier of lightning that bursts out when POKENAME stops.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is in an ascended state of euphoria and spends battles cheering on all combatants, even as it swings haymakers at opponents. Its erratic and confusing movements has inspired a martial arts form of constant motion in Alola.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are often found battling in small groups. Though many Pokémon species understand the notion of play, stringently followed rules and a tendency to spectate rather than participate make POKENAME one of the few to understand sport.
author: dylonk25

entry: Its pompoms are meant to spell "SLAY". Unfortunately, it is dyslexic.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME's pom-poms are actually a unique species of flower, that is somehow able to hold a large electrical charge. The flowers will start to spark and crackle when a thunderstorm is nearby.
author: mistymagius

entry: If multiple individuals of this fusion meet, they will invariably stack themselves into a pyramid. The purpose of this behavior is unknown.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME cheers on its teammates with its electrical pom-poms. Sometimes it gets confused and cheers on the wrong side.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: The pom-pom on its tail controls the main body, and it unleashes psychic attacks by waving its other pom-poms high. This unique ability allows POKENAME to focus its psychic energy into powerful moves with a slow, calming dance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to cheer on their teammates from the sidelines, tossing their baton into the air to show their excitement. Their enthusiasm and glee make their performances particularly motivating, as many Trainers attribute success to their cheers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The two heads of POKENAME rhythmically nod in unison to support their companions and cheer them on. While one head tries to act cool and calm, the other head makes no effort to hide its excitement.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Equipped with confetti cannons and a set of pom-poms, POKENAME cheer on allies from the sidelines with an electrifying performance. Once a fight ends, POKENAME hose down the field to swiftly clean up their confetti.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It resides in warm oceans, waving its arms around in the flowing water. This behavior looks like a spirited dance, but it's actually a way to gather plankton to eat.
author: hophoppip

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back emits a relaxing scent that puts people into a trance-like state. Groups of POKENAME can be seen dancing together in almost perfect sync.
author: mistymagius

entry: It uses the hairs on its body to brush its worries away. It expels the negative energy by passing it onto hostile predators, making them think twice.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME use their long beaks both to drink pink nectar, which is what they favor most, and to stop themselves from rolling out of control. They sway themselves from side to side to help calm and focus their minds.
author: infinex21

entry: It produces a naturally sweet enzyme that is perfect for making a Big Malasada. To get some of that enzyme, bakers dance with it until the enzyme forms a sap that sticks to its feathers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its cocoon is intricately woven together by silk that is soft to the touch. The psychic energy radiating from the cocoon puts POKENAME at ease.
author: alliveir

entry: Despite its tangled look, POKENAME is prized for the oils it leaves behind as it dances. These oils make hair easier to comb and leave it glossy, so it's tradition to let one circle your head before big events.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME loves to dance in the air. They carry good or bad psychic energy according to their mood, the energy flowing with the wind as they sway.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME's feather-like arms are deceptively sharp, able to slice through marble without much effort. Its dance moves are as dangerous as they are elegant, leaving a trail of tiny cuts wherever it goes.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME dances, it clicks the pincers on its head together in tune with its rhythm. These clicks emit a faint psychic pulse that weaken small creatures in the vicinity, making them easy pickings once POKENAME finishes the dance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's round nose twitches as it dances between flowers. It performs this as a mating ritual, using its movements to attract potential mates with the delicate swaying of its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are popular in theaters for their graceful moves and psychic abilities that help in creating sound effects. By subtly moving their tail feathers, they produce a sound of water trickling over stones.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME spits silk on the ground in beautiful patterns as it does a slow hopping and spinning dance. Its movements are slow and deliberate, creating intricate webbed patterns with each hop.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is one of the more peaceable Beedrill fusions, but still highly protective of its nest. Should something come too close, the rapid flapping of its wings will send psychic waves that disorient and deter the interlopers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that are genetically engineered to have amazing psychic potential, able to read the movements of those around them and copy them with a thought. They are peaceful, and love to use this power to dance with others.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME undulates back and forth while singing and dancing. Its songs are happy in tone when it is content and sad when it is feeling down, reflecting its emotional state through music and dance.
author: .izik

entry: Originally believed to be an Oricorio Pa'u chick, POKENAME was found to be an entirely unique species. It stares at anything that moves rhythmically.
author: ziggaway

entry: As POKENAME performs its delightful dances, the sweet smell of hibiscus flowers spreads, bringing joy to all around it.
author: hophoppip

entry: Some people believe that its palm leaves possess calming properties. POKENAME will get defensive if you try to take one of its leaves.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME supports itself with its tail as it searches for nectar high in the treetops. After an opponent is distracted by its beautiful movements, it strikes with psychic energy.
author: mepp.

entry: Every week, POKENAME shakes its old casing off. This cast-off material has a very sweet taste.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME perform soft, mellow dances near tropical beaches as they soak in the sun's rays. Sunlight gives them the energy to dance all night long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon gently sways back and forth at all times. It will synchronize its movements with any music that it hears.
author: missingmilkman

entry: POKENAME dances on tree branches when it sees visitors. If anyone stops watching it dance for even a short moment, it will get angry and explode, trying to use its sudden burst of energy to protect itself and its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances for humans and Pokémon alike, filling the air with a chilly calm. As soon as its audience disregards it as a threat, it scoops up any food it can grab and runs off.
author: chibitales

entry: Each dance POKENAME performs seems to correspond with a type of weather; it appears it can forecast the next day's weather. What other psychic abilities POKENAME has are not well understood.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each dance POKENAME performs seems to correspond with a type of weather; it appears it can forecast the next day's weather. What other psychic abilities POKENAME has are not well understood.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's bodies are laced with a toxin that reduces hostility in prey. Groups of POKENAME greet each other by dancing in an alluring manner.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are often involved in travelling performances, dancing together in small herds to the delight of onlooking children. After performances, they wander amongst the crowd, gratefully accepting gifts of peanuts and other snacks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can dance for hours without rest. During this time it lets out a series of beeps that sound remarkably like music.
author: .izik

entry: The fluid on POKENAME's tail carries some of its residual psychic energy within. Paintings made with it instill a sense of calmness and serenity in those who view them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are mellow dancers that sway their body to a gentle tune. Even when they wrap their tail around another Pokémon, they always seem to be dancing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can create a vibrant rainbow trail behind it as it flies. Those who view the colorful sight find a feeling of tranquility come over them, which lingers for quite a while after POKENAME has flown away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances atop tree branches while watching lost travelers in its forest. It often moves alongside them, mocking them as they wander in circles.
author: .izik

entry: Emotionally reactive by nature, POKENAME keep themselves relaxed by gently swaying. By keeping themselves relaxed, they also regulate their own body heat; their flame sacs become far more productive when they are not relaxed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's hand and skirt feathers sway gently in the wind as it dances. Despite its gentle appearance, this Pokémon is always ready for combat, incorporating martial arts stances in its choreography.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The movements of POKENAME blur the line between dance and combat. During performances, POKENAME has been known to neutralize troublemakers while maintaining its flawless routine.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Although small, even a single POKENAME exhibits enough psychic influence to calm a moderately sized crowd with its gentle, swaying dancing. They are incredibly shy Pokémon, however, and most would sooner flee than quell others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are often seen greeting tourists in Alola. It can use psychic powers to make travelers more excited for their trip.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Their intense dances can change the weather. They communicate exclusively through movement, but no one struggles to understand them.
author: quote.lass

entry: The swaying movements of POKENAME's dance stimulate its psychic powers. It extends its tongue and wriggles it in a hypnotic way that compels those who view it to join it in its dancing.
author: sk372

entry: In Alolan hospitals, POKENAME is kept to be by the side of those who are about to pass away. It uses its dance to guide departed souls to peace.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME often make mistakes during their hula performances. While most people clap out of sympathy for this Pokémon, others are intimidated into clapping by the set of jaws on the back of their head that are revealed when they bow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rhythmically sway their feathers to whatever music is nearby but prefer slow songs. Many remain planted in the sand at beaches, hoping for tourists to join them in a dance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The feathers under POKENAME sweep away algae and other debris underwater, and POKENAME eats what it gathers. This has made them a rather beloved and wanted species by aquarists.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME spreads the scent of the fresh ocean air and plumeria flowers wherever it goes. Because of that, its very popular in souvenir shops as a way to attract customers.
author: ferdirenz

entry: POKENAME's dances stimulate its psychic abilities and let them manifest further. When fully immersed in its own movements, a faint psychic aura with the appearance of burning fire forms around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME performs beautiful spinning movements while dancing across water surfaces. These displays are more prevalent during the autumn season.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's calm and inviting behavior causes people to want to grab its hilt. Once they have done so, POKENAME uses its psychic energy to force them to a gentle dance while it drains them of their life energy.
author: soup1900

entry: While performing a ballroom-style dance, POKENAME's feelers begin to glow. This allows it to levitate slightly off the ground, inspiring anyone nearby who witnesses it.
author: .izik

entry: It descends from the skies with a gentle and elegant flair meant to soothe the hearts of onlookers. Those that resist this relaxing aura will be punished for their insolence with devastating beams of psychic energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flowers fall off every evening, and bloom again every morning. The shed petals are used in Alola to make fragrant soaps and perfumes.
author: ferdirenz

entry: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as knights. POKENAME could channel psychic energy into their swords, releasing it as a burst when they swung their swords.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's light body lets it gently bounce over water like a skipping stone when thrown. Afterwards, it uses its psychic energy to create a giant tidal hand that engulfs the person that chucked it away while bringing it back to shore.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lets its accessories billow in the breeze to generate psychic energy for itself. It can use some of this psychic power to help unlock a person's memories, should they be forgetting something important.
author: sk372

entry: When dancing for too long, POKENAME begins releasing small electromagnetic pulses from its body. This is unintentional and will disable any electronics in the immediate area.
author: .izik

entry: The pollen from POKENAME's buds is a soft shade of pink. It tries to emulate others' dances, but struggles due to its tiny limbs.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME slowly spins its petals while dancing in meadows. Onlookers can frequently become hypnotized into fetching it water from nearby sources.
author: .izik

entry: The gentle swaying of their bodies alongside minor psychic pulses generates a relaxing aura around them. Hospitals employ these Pokémon to help patients experiencing extreme stress or anxiety.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME lets loose large puffs of yellow powder while dancing which can cause chemical burns on the skin. Its toxic spores are dangerous and should not be approached without caution, making its performance both mesmerizing and hazardous.
author: .izik

entry: Swaying steadily to focus their psychic energy into their morganite eyes, POKENAME have the ability to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon. It is believed that dancing along with an POKENAME can help people discover their joys and passions.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Their smooth rhythm made POKENAME a favored ballet teacher in medieval times, their grace and patience surpassing human instructors. Much like a zinnia, they cultivate their talents quickly and are beautiful in a light breeze.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With a swing of its hip and a knowing glance, POKENAME blends chilled-out attitude with sharp timing. Trainers say it cheers you on while judging your outfit at the same time.
author: jaminmcready

entry: With each slow, deliberate sway, POKENAME guides petals to drift in perfect circles around its body. It dances from sunrise to dusk, unmoved by distractions and it is as silent as the breeze.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This form of POKENAME prefers to live in the desert, feeding on the nectar of cactus flowers. Some say the different movements of its body are signs that foretell sandstorms.
author: malxire

entry: While dancing, trash falls from within POKENAME's body onto the ground. This causes the area around it to become littered with debris within moments.
author: .izik

entry: The pile of fluff and powder down that is POKENAME's lower body is speckled with pink pollen. Its dances are mellow, so it makes the least mess of all POKENAME forms.
author: hophoppip

entry: This Pokémon camouflages into windy forests with a swaying motion that looks like a dance. This version of POKENAME enjoys showering lovers with many rose-colored petals.
author: hiimhdere

entry: While dancing, POKENAME releases music composed of noises it has heard throughout its life. It can perfectly mimic these sounds and blend them together effortlessly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can play music from their ears that matches their style of dance. They levitate flower petals to spin around them while they fly.
author: michaelkai

entry: Sometimes POKENAME ignores its Trainer's commands, lost in its own thoughts. Its dances unintentionally spread sticky saliva all around it, which is why wild Pokémon tend to keep their distance when it is performing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Pink Nectar. It has a sweet, berry-like taste that leaves a soft sugary coating on the tongue.
author: jaminmcready

entry: With graceful, swaying movements, POKENAME dodges its opponents' attacks and performs a flowing headlock.
author: .realthree

entry: Recent research suggests that POKENAME's mushrooms are excellent for skincare, but they can only be obtained if POKENAME sips a certain kind of nectar.
author: .realthree

entry: It is unknown whether POKENAME uses its tropical-like form to attract more human prey or to simply sway in the wind easier.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: The crystals on POKENAME's body respond to the feeling of wind brushing across them. The stimulation causes them to glow and emit faint psychic pulses that disorient those near it.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME dances, it creates an aura of serenity and relaxation. POKENAME are a popular Pokémon at massage clinics and luxury resorts.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can be found on cliffs, dancing to their own rhythm as the sun sets.  It is assumed that this peaceful atmosphere allows POKENAME to foresee into the future.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME perform a traditional dance originating from remote islands where their spirited dance inspires many people to learn about their heritage. They slap their chests with large, webbed palms as is customary with this type of dance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its movements are in perfect harmony with the wind, swaying only when a breeze passes. As it dances, a mysterious and unsettling aura is released throughout the air, leaving usually tough opponents frightened and docile.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The psychic energy POKENAME emits from its shell will clear a person's lungs and make them feel relaxed when inhaled. By spouting this energy against predators, it can turn them nonaggressive, allowing for an easy escape.
author: soup1900
