entry: POKENAME are coated in a thick layer of mucus, protecting their bodies from physical harm. This mucus is kept liquid by an intense internal body heat and, for some POKENAME, can result in their legs being impeded by the slime.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy splashing around in puddles after rainy days. They shake themselves dry once they're done, releasing excess slime from their bodies that helps plants grow.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME cannot generate its own electricity, so during stormy weather it sits in treetops and gathers electrical energy from lightning strikes. Its spiky fur is as sticky as tree sap.
author: cait_sith

entry: The slime it leaks from its tusks smells like Wepear Berries and has been used as a spread for bagels. Its gooey nature helps it cling to trees when escaping predators.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME are found in tombs using their sticky green slime to repair pottery. Their slime is so strong that restored artifacts are as durable as new.
author: .izik

entry: The slimy membrane surrounding POKENAME is thick and sturdy to accommodate its constant whirling about. It can stick to walls because of its tacky protection, giving it great maneuverability.
author: creaturecore

entry: It cheers on its allies by waving pom-poms made from thick mucus. It can generate a weak electric charge to defend itself.
author: hophoppip

entry: This Pokémon uses its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane to retain moisture, allowing it to bounce along the sand near the waters where it resides. Additionally, this same membrane makes POKENAME very unpleasant to any predator looking for a snack.
author: chiari_queen

entry: This Pokémon was forced to develop a heightened sense of hearing, since its own slime covers its eyes while it hangs upside down. Its ears are not safe from getting clogged either, making some to feel this evolutionary process quite pointless.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: Its wings are made up of slime and mucus secreted from its cheek pouches. Feeding it the wrong diet will make it unable to fly, so it's a rather expensive Pokémon to take care of.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME cover their bodies with a dangerous, stinky mucus that deters predators. POKENAME can sense when anyone falls into their gooey trail, which they mainly use to hunt prey.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME absorbs nutrients from the water via gooey membranes coating its head spikes. It has an affinity towards Corsola, but its similar appearance to Mareanie often causes the Corsola it tries to befriend to run away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of fine granules of sand covered in a layer of gooey membrane. The shovel atop POKENAME's head is difficult to remove and doing so causes it to attack the offender until the shovel is returned.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's slimy head scale emits a terrible stench when it feels threatened. Its gooey body makes it difficult to grapple or contain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce a steady supply of mucus from specialised glands on their backs. They groom and shape their mucus into wings, allowing them to glide across great distances in search of food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are coated in a thick layer of mucus, protecting their bodies from physical harm. This mucus is kept liquid by an intense internal body heat, so it is advised that Trainers take great care when handling POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have dense and sticky slime covering their bodies, making it hard to make physical contact with them. Their slime is scalding to the touch and can cause nasty burns for the unwary.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It digs beneath jungle trees, using acidic nose drippings to dissolve roots before eating them. The slime left behind nurtures the soil for new growth.
author: .izik

entry: Dirt and debris constantly get stuck in POKENAME's gooey fur as it searches for food and places to rest, forcing it to find puddles to wash itself in. It leaves behind a slime trail in a zigzag-like pattern as it walks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME remains motionless in damp forests and under as much cover as possible while awaiting evolution. If discovered, it tries to roll away while the sticky slime trail slows pursuit.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The corrosive snot that dribbles from its three noses lines its tunnels, leaving an olive-colored glow. It uses this glow to attract insects into its burrow.
author: .izik

entry: The slimy membrane surrounding POKENAME protects it from digesting itself. It needs to be kept wet in order to function properly.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The slimy membrane surrounding POKENAME protects it from digesting itself. Its membrane needs to be kept wet in order to function properly.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The slimy membrane surrounding POKENAME protects it from digesting itself. Its membrane needs to be kept wet in order to function properly.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The slimy membrane surrounding POKENAME protects it from digesting itself. Its membrane needs to be kept wet in order to function properly.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: It rolls around from place to place, leaving a thick layer of mucus everywhere it goes. Having a POKENAME in your home is an invitation to slip and trip everywhere.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's slime burns hot enough to melt sand into glass. In battle, it flings this molten slime before following up with a searing Ember.
author: .izik

entry: When the slime POKENAME produce makes contact with the air, it rapidly stiffens and becomes inflexible. They use this quality of their slime to create wings that enable them to take to the air, offering them excellent mobility.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It spits corrosive slime on its prey, making it easier to eat. Some people use this substance for cleaning rusted metal.
author: kittyluv090

entry: In the afternoon, POKENAME burrow into the bacteria-rich mats of biofilm at the lake bottom to sleep. They leave their spikes sticking out of the goopy material. These spikes can be a hazard to people swimming as they pack a potent venom.
author: vic1312

entry: While POKENAME aren't very intelligent, they show an immense amount of compassion towards their Trainers. Some people find that off-putting.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME collects slime around its neck and uses it as protection against heat. This slime also has properties that facilitate sleep.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME's bone is coated in a lime-scented slime that becomes highly adhesive when dry. It uses this substance to mark and claim its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce slimeballs in its pouch that it gives out to Trainers it likes. The slime is actually quite valuable as it is commonly used in high quality sunscreens.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's shell has retreated under its skin. It is thought that in a few thousand years, POKENAME won't have a shell at all.
author: .realthree

entry: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. There are ferrous compounds in its shell, which it remains within to preserve moisture.
author: .realthree

entry: Its heavy shell forces it to slowly inch across the seafloor while looking for food. Its thick mucus gradually wears away at the shell, leaving it quite brittle.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the weather, only coming out of its den on rainy days. It leaves behind a trail of slime wherever it goes, which has been used as a form of moisturizer for centuries.
author: mistymagius

entry: The goo secreted from POKENAME's head is able to dissolve many materials. It uses this goo to melt food before absorbing it through its skin. When happy, POKENAME produces a smell similar to what it previously ate.
author: chibitales

entry: The goo dripping from POKENAME's leaves contains nutrients similar to fertilizer, allowing plants to flourish if it is mixed into the soil. Fruits and vegetables grown using it have a hint of a spicy smell and taste.
author: chibitales

entry: The goo dripping from POKENAME's leaves contains nutrients similar to fertilizer, allowing plants to flourish if mixed into the soil. Fruits and vegetables grown using it have a hint of a spicy smell and taste.
author: chibitales

entry: It has to constantly emit light in order to see its surroundings. It has very poor eyesight, so POKENAME owners keep lights on all night.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Sleeping POKENAME will often sink deep into the mud flats they call home due to their thick coating of acidic, water-resistant mucus. In the dry season, this mucus keeps them wet during their hibernation.
author: vic1312

entry: To regulate its body temperature, POKENAME produces a vapour that it expels through its skin. This vapour is highly toxic and carries an unpleasant odour, leading to POKENAME being very unpopular. Covering it in soap helps to neutralise the vapour.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME claws produce a glue-like poison which it uses to incapacitate its prey. However, POKENAME can have difficulty injecting the poison due to its thickness.
author: mistymagius

entry: The bodies of these monstrous Pokémon seep a deadly poison that coats their iron jaws. Miners should be afraid of encountering these Pokémon while mining deep underground.
author: mistymagius

entry: Inside its tough shell, POKENAME produces a thick glue-like paste from the leaves and bark it likes to collect. It uses the glue to stop predators in their tracks, allowing it to escape.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's shell is made out of hardened goo and houses all of its organs. Its mucus can melt pure steel beams.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The green swirly tail on POKENAME's back houses all of its vital organs. It must carry its tail around despite it being very heavy, as dragging it around would cause damage to the organs inside.
author: soup1900

entry: Its metallic talons are coated with many corrosive chemicals that make POKENAME a dangerous Pokémon to be scratched by. They are simple-minded Pokémon who only desire food and sleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME knocks obstacles down and dissolves them with corrosive acid from its trunk. Because they can't see where they're aiming, it's advised to give POKENAME a wide berth.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME leave a slippery slime as it rolls that often disorient its pursuers. They are quite playful Pokémon and love to play with children. They especially love belly rubs.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is best to let POKENAME inhabit cyberspace as long and often as possible. Within the digital world, the slime dripping from its body is harmless, but in the real world it will quickly melt electronics and machinery on contact.
author: sk372

entry: When threatened, POKENAME spits a strong acid that is strong enough to melt anyone straight to the bone. Some people have theorized that POKENAME was originally some sort of alien cocoon.
author: mistymagius

entry: A freezing slime coats POKENAME's body which drips off on hot days. Leatherworkers prize it for curing and preserving rare hides.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically lives a languid life under the dense canopy of the rainforest. It has many ways to deter predators, but its most known for creating thick gooey trails while it blitzes around the environment, slowing down and tiring out opponents.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME fights using hot slime balls from within its body. Researchers harness the corrosiveness of POKENAME's mucous to break down organic material.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Sightings of these Pokémon are common after nuclear accidents. Their dens are incredibly narrow since their viscous bodies allow them to squeeze through tight gaps.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can propel its tongue with the force of a small train. When food is scarce, groups of wild POKENAME plunder nearby cities of fruits, vegetables, and candy.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME propels itself through the air by amassing and then releasing large amounts of slime to jettison it forward. The slime left behind is highly acidic for a time and should be left alone until it becomes less volatile.
author: sk372

entry: Theorized to be an extra-terrestrial being, POKENAME fires an acidic green liquid from its arms that can melt just about anything. Its sensitive antennae are able to sense other creatures over 50 feet away.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses a strong acid to melt through solid rock in search of rare minerals to eat. They are very aggressive Pokémon and will attempt to bite anyone who disturbs them.
author: mistymagius

entry: The film dripping from POKENAME can corrupt the minds of those who touch it. Victims briefly believe it to be divine, though the effect fades after a single day.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME is highly sensitive to external temperatures, it hibernates through the colder months. When spring arrives, it is seen helping plants grow with its nutrient-rich mucus.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's helmet-like shell is harder than iron. The shell is coated in a slick poison that causes rashes on contact.
author: .izik

entry: The slime secreted from its ribbon-like organs has a calming effect on those it touches. POKENAME's slime is used in many remedies and even in some anesthetics.
author: infinex21

entry: It skulks around the ruins of fallen civilizations, eroding monuments with its corrosive goo. The humid mists of dense jungles carry its infectious spores.
author: ozydamians

entry: The body of POKENAME is made up of a toxic, caustic mucus. It throws rapid punches imbued with this mucus to simultaneously stun and dissolve its prey.
author: bacondlx

entry: The wooden clamps on POKENAME's body keep its soft body from falling apart. The green slime it produces acts similar to oil and is theorized to be an amazing energy source.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a rubber-like substance that is oddly resistant to physical attacks. The unpleasant taste of the rubber discourages other Pokémon from attacking it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fur is coated in a thick layer of mucus that helps to protect them from harm. They secrete the mucus from special glands along their neck and use their tails to coat their body in it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has poor eyesight due to living in deep cave systems, which is why it will constantly headbutt its surroundings. Luckily, its soft body is resistant to physical injury.
author: mistymagius

entry: The large sacs that make up POKENAME's shell are filled with an acidic slime which sprays out if these sacs are punctured. They almost never move from their dens, waiting patiently for evolution.
author: mistymagius

entry: The green slime that coats its tusks is extremely acidic. This allows for POKENAME to slice through basically anything. Even the slightest graze from these tusks can be life-threatening.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sticks itself to cave walls using its gooey body. Despite its lack of teeth, it will bite into its prey, using its corrosive saliva to melt them until POKENAME can slurp them up.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve nearly any material. When it finds an item too tough to dissolve, it keeps it as a precious treasure.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It is blind, so it uses its hypersensitive antennae to sense prey. When it's not hunting, it coats them with protective mucus.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The foam around POKENAME's neck is extremely sticky and can stop even the largest of Pokémon in their tracks. They are very friendly and adore human affection.
author: mistymagius

entry: These mischievous Pokémon like to play dirty, using the slime on their wings to disorient, slow down, or even blind their opponents. Their slippery bodies allow them to escape predators with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's scales produce a thick layer of slime which protects them from physical hits. While its punches are a little weaker because of it, it makes up for it with its acid-based attacks.
author: mistymagius

entry: To blind its enemies, it shoots sticky saliva bubbles from its mouth at their faces. POKENAME has a habit of stealing berries from Pokémon slower than itself, knowing that its developed agility will allow it to get away undisturbed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wings can only remain flexible when mixed with water. They wait until there's rain to emerge from their hiding places, spreading their wings wide to gather as much moisture as they can to allow them to fly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some salons keep a POKENAME on staff to help with deep conditioning. It naturally secretes a nutrient-rich mucus that it then combs through hair with its soft hands, leaving even the dirtiest hair smooth and glossy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is often found drifting unsteadily through misty meadows, leaving behind a glittery trail of slime. Its swirling eyes are said to mesmerise opponents, causing brief bouts of confusion.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME dig underground tunnels by secreting a slime that dissolves rocks and biological matter around them. Groups of POKENAME can cause sinkholes when they dig below roads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME creates clouds that rain with drops of slimy mucus. The liquid around its head is a strong acid that melts its prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its whiskers are constantly coated with a thick layer of sticky green mucus. They can move to pick up food in front of its face.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Gourmets in the Kalos region used to farm POKENAME for its secretions, but it has been banned for health concerns. POKENAME slime soup reportedly has an earthy, slightly nutty taste.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME use their sticky arms and fangs to latch onto larger Pokémon. They constantly secrete a dissolving mucus from their mouths, slowly eating away at their prey.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's slime unintentionally boils when it is near someone it loves. Even when calm, it is advised not to cuddle up to it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is blind, but it has keen psychic powers to sense its surroundings. It's very curious and loves to investigate new things.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME protects its soft, delicate body with its elastic shell, which allows any projectiles to bounce off of it. To get around quickly, it will tuck in its limbs and roll around like a soccer ball.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its saliva is highly corrosive, making physical contact with it very risky. People who work with POKENAME put their lives on the line.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME are quick to get dizzy from their rolling motion. Instead, they opt to glide around on their slippery sludge.
author: camtft

entry: It often gets picked on by larger Pokémon due to its meek personality. If bullied too much, POKENAME will explode in frustration and coat its surroundings with a sticky, electrified goop.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon do not fare well in arid environments; the dry air damages their wings. When threatened, they smother the threat with their wings, intoxicating them with poisonous spores infused in the mucus.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is a popular performing Pokémon in traveling shows. For its tricks, it can form imitations of objects using slime.
author: bee4082

entry: It loves dancing with others of its kind, but they always end up slipping on each other's goo when they try. Watching its dance for too long may cause you to feel for some time like your entire body is made of jelly and unable to stand on its own.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME secretes a mucus that helps it slide over any dangerous terrain. This fluid is very hard to remove from textiles such as clothes and carpets.
author: .realthree

entry: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. The metallic liquid it secretes has been found to have applications as a cleaning agent.
author: .realthree

entry: The goo-like substance that oozes from its tentacles is used partially in POKENAME's digestive process, as it contains powerful enzymes that can eat away at parts that are otherwise hard to consume, such as bone or mineral buildup.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The goo-like substance that oozes from its tentacles is used partially in POKENAME's digestive process, as it contains powerful enzymes that can eat away at parts that are otherwise hard to consume, such as bone or mineral buildup.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is an extremely friendly Pokémon that enjoys clustering with others on seabeds. Keeping it in tanks is challenging, as it becomes sullen without companionship. The slime-like substance it secretes means it needs regular cleaning.
author: jadey.1557

entry: The blades of POKENAME ooze a poisonous sap. As hard as steel beneath the fluid, they can slice through nearly any material.
author: hermsmegerms

entry: A POKENAME can change the properties of its slime at will, shaping its wings to best match its current flight plan. It creates nests on high mountain peaks out of hardened slime.
author: staghorn

entry: It contains a remarkable amount of energy within its body, which empowers its every attack. Those who pick on it or the ones it cares about are often met with a powerful strike of its tail or fierce blows from its horns.
author: infinex21

entry: The webbing of their wings is clad in a concentrated mucus that keeps them clean and free of debris. Though typically meek, they fight fiercely to protect others.
author: infinex21

entry: While the toxic honey it produces is not fit for consumption, once neutralized, it can be used to treat bug bites and stings.
author: kittyluv090

entry: This playful Pokémon carries a bubble wand, which it uses to entertain children. The bubbles it creates are squishy but durable.
author: busilisk

entry: It lives by forest streams and prefers to get all of its energy through photosynthesis, although it may consume many different kinds of physical matter thanks to its hardy innards.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME smells positively revolting and drives other Pokémon away. The slime that covers its body is full of nutrients that help plants grow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Though generally well-behaved, if bullied POKENAME will latch onto aggressors with its powerful jaws. Though its teeth are not particularly sharp, its gooey saliva is a powerful irritant and weakens muscles after prolonged contact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will produce massive amounts of goop while standing in a large crater or valley. The result is a lake of slime that becomes their home.
author: gurguro

entry: POKENAME wraps its long, sticky body around others as a sign of affection. The objects of this kind gesture are inevitably coated with gooey slime as a result.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is attracted to those of kind and gentle natures, compelled to give them hugs often. The slime its body generates seems to give a blessing of good luck while it clings to a person's skin.
author: sk372

entry: Its slime constantly emits a somewhat dim glow. POKENAME fans love jarring up its slime to have around their homes as a replacement for candles.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The mucus on its bubbles is the same chemical makeup as human snot. POKENAME fills these slime bubbles with helium to rise higher and drains them to float downward.
author: musicsheep.

entry: While POKENAME normally don't go on land during the day to hunt food, rain keeps their skin cool and moist, allowing them to stay out for longer. However, this causes them to overeat, with many barfing up goo after the hunting period is over.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sense their environment using the goo coating their gills. Oddly, the goo does not interfere with breathing. They spread a thin layer of slime around their waterside nests to act as an early warning system against predators.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME burrows through the ground in search of damp earth to soak in. Some POKENAME can even be found beneath massive lakes.
author: ursulaarchmorningstar

entry: POKENAME's toxic slime is harvested to make rare pigments. When properly treated, it produces deep hues used in crafting a Clothing Dye Kit.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The slimy sweat leaking from POKENAME's body smells of pine needles and coffee. When used in tea it not only keeps the liquid at a steady warm temperature but adds an incredibly deep flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's weight reduces its stamina to fly, but its lubricant goo and powerful muscles allow it to gain enough speed underwater to jump and glide for kilometers. While its skin is unharmed by salty water, it seems wary of it for unknown reasons.
author: epping_forest

entry: It is a mysterious and elusive Pokémon that runs away at the sight of almost any other living being. It can run on the surface of water and cloak it with a thin layer of film that causes any later pollution or other toxins to become purified.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its powerful punches release bursts of sticky goo that will trap opponents for long periods. It prefers not to fight, so once its foe is stuck, it will often trot away.
author: infinex21

entry: It lingers above its Trainer's head to protect it from rain and other inclement weather. Unfortunately, you're liable to get just as messy from the globs of ectoplasmic goo that drip from underneath its wide-brimmed crown.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME was believed to be a space alien when first discovered due to resembling a spaceship and its tendency to spray icky slime at foes to trap them. Anything that impacts its squishy body rebounds with immense force, including airplanes.
author: soup1900

entry: The sticky slime coating its body has beneficial effects on plants, as it keeps parasites away. A single sweep of its tail is powerful enough to move even large stone monoliths.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A shy but powerful Pokémon that prefers to live in damp caves. It is able to survive in extremely dry or humid conditions thanks to the film that covers its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known to be extremely friendly towards people and Pokémon. However, they are extremely protective of their Trainers, and will attempt to destroy anyone who tries to harm them.
author: jennybean

entry: POKENAME marks its territory with a thick, oily liquid produced in its gut. This substance reacts violently to motion, scaring away potential rivals with a display of flashing colors.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME uses it's gooey aura to make bubbles. It can alter the thickness of these bubbles, changing air flow and sturdiness for virtually any usage.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: The goo frill around its neck can be used to make potions. Sometimes it will even feed wild Pokémon its goo if they need immediate medical help.
author: zeeroooo

entry: The mucus covering POKENAME subtly influences those they touch. Ancient cultures once revered it as a godlike being despite it doing nothing to assist them.
author: .izik

entry: The plantlife growing on POKENAME's back is always thriving with a unique type of fruit with a sticky exterior and juicy insides. It's a favored treat among young Dragon types, who flock to POKENAME when it travels near.
author: sk372

entry: When hatched, the palm of POKENAME is extremely sticky. However, the moment it touches something, it gets covered in debris, making it dirty and unable to stick to anything.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Its two hands often get tangled together. Once this happens, untangling them can take hours of trial and error.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME can stretch its hand far beyond what most Pokémon can reach. It uses this flexibility and momentum to deliver powerful smacks to its opponents.
author: musicsheep.

entry: An incredibly cuddly Pokémon, POKENAME often underestimates its own strength and size. Unfortunately, its clinginess often crushes POKENAME's own Trainers due to tackling them during play, or attempting to sit on their laps.
author: piponus

entry: POKENAME are dotingly affectionate and will wrap their goo-covered ribbons around their Trainers to show affection. The goo has calming effects and is used in medical sedatives.
author: chibitales

entry: You can tell when a storm was summoned by a POKENAME, because the rain will have a slightly gooey feel to it.  Despite this unpleasant texture, many believe that water blessed by a POKENAME is exceptionally good for hydration.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME is made from a squishy, sticky substance that always reverts back to its original form, no matter how much punishment it takes. Despite its innocent appearance, it is a highly devious Pokémon that delights in leaving gooey traps.
author: deniablecredibility

entry: Nesting sites of POKENAME are often covered in gooey webs that give off small electrical pulses. Anything that comes in contact with the webbing is glued in place and paralyzed by the electricity.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is very friendly and is often found sheltering weaker Pokémon and helping them grow. Despite this, its known to hold grudges for several decades if picked on. The gooey secretions from its tails are very warm.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is extremely affectionate and tries to hug anyone who gets close, pulling them in with its long antennae. It uses the sticky slime covering its body to reinforce the hinges of the dams it builds along rivers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The gel POKENAME produces causes any flames it produces to burn a light green color. It relies on its twin flames to constantly burn gel from its body, as the gel will build up and harden if not used.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When threatened, POKENAME spits poisonous goo that is hard to remove and attempts to escape. The poison slowly attacks the nervous system, leaving foes devoid of their senses until it wears off.
author: chibitales

entry: The colorful rings in its rubbery horns oscillate in a mesmerizing manner. Some say that it isn't in control of its own body.
author: _sadfroggy

entry: POKENAME's viscous armor hardens under pressure, forming crystalline scales as strong as fossilized bone. Its saliva can dissolve steel, yet it uses it only to carve paths through stone lairs.
author: bionic_man

entry: POKENAME's cloak keeps the slime its body generates from getting too excessive. Should it lose its grip, the slime will leak all over and cause the immediate area to become sticky and messy.
author: sk372

entry: Trainers tend to unfuse POKENAME when met with its frankly disturbing visage. Perhaps because of this, it seems to try and be exceptionally friendly.
author: bukie

entry: Trainers tend to unfuse POKENAME when met with its frankly disturbing visage. Perhaps because of this, it seems to try and be exceptionally friendly.
author: bukie

entry: Slime naturally secretes from POKENAME's wings and constantly builds up within them. To clear its wings, POKENAME performs rapid spinning dances that scatter streams of slime in every direction.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME cheer merrily for their Trainers, inadvertently spreading gunk from their saturated pom-poms as a result. Many Trainers who elect to raise POKENAME pick up a habit of wearing a raincoat most of the time as a result.
author: vic1312

entry: Due to being made of unique adaptive cells, POKENAME can use its gel for many purposes such as medicine, sustenance, power generation, or defense. However, due to this Pokémon's rarity and reclusive nature, few samples have been obtained.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME's wings have the consistency of viscous goo. Yet when POKENAME flies, its wings become lighter than air and adopt the texture of cotton.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME shows affection by hugging its Trainer with its slimy wings. Many people avoid it for this very reason.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Like both its components, POKENAME hugs its Trainer to show affection. Also like its components, these hugs are not pleasant, as they leave the recipient both severely injured and covered in slime.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME pulverizes coral by wrapping around them with its many legs to remove any hiding spot that Corsola, its main prey, may have. With how gooey and squishy its body is, most predators have trouble attacking it once it creates its leg dome.
author: soup1900

entry: Its petals shake out toxic clouds of pollen as it lumbers around. Despite being a hazard to most, POKENAME still makes an effort to be friendly.
author: bukie

entry: The goo secreted from POKENAME's body is often collected for use in reusable gel packs. This goo stays semifluid despite being below freezing or heated to high temperatures.
author: chibitales

entry: The slime it secretes is edible, with a sweet citrusy flavor. Though the slime has gained popularity as an ingredient in desserts, bakers must work with it carefully, as it's incredibly sticky and difficult to wash off.
author: hophoppip

entry: A loudmouthed braggart, POKENAME is always ready to taunt another Pokémon in order to start a fight. The action that usually gets the most reaction is to lob a thick handful of goo from its body into another's face.
author: sk372

entry: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Def, scientists use goo extracted from a POKENAME. Its naturally high defensive abilities leave behind powerful residue in the goo.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The green gems on POKENAME's head are actually thick globs of slime that have been crystallized. These gems are even stronger than diamonds, easily being able to crush them into dust.
author: soup1900

entry: Mucus drips from POKENAME's face and arms, forming a shape many liken to a dancer's clothing. Those grappled by POKENAME are trapped in a sticky net of mucus.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its face mucus has powerful regenerative properties, and it will only use it to heal close friends. Being covered in POKENAME slime used to be a signifier of a valiant heart, but now it's only seen as gross.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Slime left around by POKENAME can be a serious slipping hazard if left uncleaned. Many trainers that own one carry around a mop and wet floor sign wherever they go.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's goo is a sticky polymer that can trap foes and even allies when excited. It's also delicious when roasted by a great chef.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME are typically docile yet are capable of becoming incredibly aggressive within a few minutes. Their mucus has adrenaline-inducing effects, which many believe may be why they can turn aggressive so swiftly over the slightest provocation.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME produces goo by swirling its tail in water. This goo is a particularly powerful binding agent. Due to POKENAME's naturally rebellious disposition, it likes to apply the goo to objects deemed important by their Trainers as a prank.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME lives in swamplands and becomes more active on rainy days. A friendly Pokémon, it's often seen alongside Quagsire and Wooper, gathering food for them with its powerful psychic abilities.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME enthusiastically cheer on their Trainers no matter what activity or competition is happening. If you see POKENAME, it is advised you stay three feet apart so as to not get slimed.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Due to its softhearted personality, POKENAME's first instinct upon meeting someone is to hide in its soft, slimy shell. Holding its shell while it hides and hugging it softly for a time is a quick way to become friends with it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's viscous slime-coating allows it to squeeze into tiny spaces, as long as its venomous beak can fit through. It is timid, fleeing from new sights, so a persistent and calm Trainer can build trust with a wild one over weeks of visits.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is affectionate towards those it views as friends, but be wary if you get on its bad side. It's vindictive and highly persistent.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME are extremely difficult to locate in the wild, their bodies blending in nearly seamlessly with boulders and rubble. They are dangerous Pokémon to disturb due to their propensity to explode at the slightest disturbance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are formed of fine-grained sandstone, the matrix binding the sand in their bodies together reinforced by a potent electrical charge. They are able to control their electrical charge, turning it into dramatic explosive potential.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are formed of fine-grained sandstone, the matrix binding the sand in their bodies together reinforced by a potent electrical charge. They are able to control their electrical charge, turning it into dramatic explosive potential.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Thought to have been used as smoke bombs in ancient times, POKENAME prefer brittle rocks to coat their body, so that their gases don't get trapped and cause them to explode.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME lies buried beneath the soil, its soft body protected by a coating of stone. It can remain dormant for millennia, but when a Diglett tunnels through and disturbs it, the shock triggers a sudden evolution.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's rocky bodies contain high amounts of sulfur, constantly expelling toxic gases from the fumaroles along their bodies. These fumes kill any nearby plant life, leaving barren wastelands in their wake.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME lies buried beneath the soil, its soft body protected by a coating of stone. It tenses when exposed to light, attempting to give the appearance of a rock.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It pulverizes boulders with its pincers in search of rare ores, which it studiously collects. It appears to despise Black Augurite, however.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME will charge for days at a time, each step they take causing small tremors in the earth. Almost nothing can stop them in this state, their bodies able to barrel through mountains.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME have been known to take residence on some fountains, blending in with the statuary around them. It is not yet clear why they prefer fountains, but it has been documented that they spit water at anyone who throws in coins.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME prefers inhabiting forests in dry or rocky areas. It uses a special acidic poison in its horn to melt down stones into a soft slurry it can consume for sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's internal flame sac leaves its body warm, as if every stone had basked in the sun for hours. Aside from fire breath, it can spit blazing hot rocks from inside its body to repel its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: Most have only ever encountered POKENAME while it is inactive, sitting still in rocky areas and not responding to stimuli. It's rumored that knocking on its various sides in a specific pattern will activate it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's granite shell is incredibly hard, capable of withstanding severe blows when it is in good health. When it falls ill, the shell begins to chip away until it recovers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is found guarding the remnants of ancient desert civilizations. It holds a fearsome visage to drive away any intruders and enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: It contains vast energy that allows it to release devastating Hyper Beams to defend itself. It burrows through loose rocks to repair or replace any of its body that gets damaged in battle.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found haphazardly rolling through overgrown ruins. The rocks protruding from the moss growing on them are actually sweet berries with extremely hard shells.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time maintaining the delicate balancing act of keeping all of their parts together. They use the rock on the top of their heads like sonar to detect changes in the wind and adapt to them to stay balanced.
author: hummusishome

entry: Overgrown ruins across the region are ferociously guarded by POKENAME. They lumber through their territory on constant high alert, scanning the area with each of their seven eyes.
author: hummusishome

entry: It is said that a great alchemist once sought to recreate the miracle Regigigas bestowed on mankind. Breathing life into rocks that now forever stand watch, guarding their creator and his treasures.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: The gas they create is highly flammable and burns at close to 1400 degrees Celsius. POKENAME sit around burning this gas all day until they eventually evolve.
author: hummusishome

entry: As POKENAME move, cracks form in the stones lining their backs, releasing highly flammable gas. They ignite this gas voluntarily when threatened.
author: hummusishome

entry: Specialized vents in the outer shells of POKENAME expel the flammable gas they produce as a waste product. The true chemical composition of this gas is still unknown.
author: hummusishome

entry: When POKENAME takes a rock from an area and adds it to its body, it's able to link to and sense both the past and future of that region. It is believed that with enough rocks from outer space, it gains the ability to view the birth of the universe.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME perches atop cliff tops, remaining motionless for hours. It does this to protect all Rock-types along the valleys it claims as its territories.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is a slow-moving desert scavenger that hides among rock formations until nightfall. It has been known to pilfer trinkets from sleeping travelers on occasion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives high up in snow-covered hills, admiring the reflection of the sky in frozen lakes, but if it finds itself below a Trainer it will feel scared and hide itself by causing a landslide.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The stones that gut out from POKENAME's back are made of a toxic material similar to asbestos or lead. When disturbed from their slumber, they grind the stones on their back into a fine powder before unleashing toxic dust over foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While POKENAME appears to have two separate bodies, they share one mind and act in unison. POKENAME's cryptic cry and symbolic body have led the people on the internet to create joke images of this fusion.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME will only be content if it lives in total darkness and will rampage if anyone brings light into its lair. Scientific studies have determined that POKENAME appears to lack a brain or any kind of physical substitute.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A flock of POKENAME will perch vigilantly in a sturdy tree. If anyone stops to rest under their tree, they will divebomb with their stone bodies.
author: lampent12

entry: These large and very rare golems can be found near caves deep in dense forests and high up on craggy mountains. There, POKENAME stands motionless, acting as a silent guardian to the dens many bear Pokémon call home.
author: moopse

entry: These extremely rare Pokémon are barely ever seen. These little bear-shaped rock Pokémon prefer bare terrain, such as salt flats, that many other Pokémon find unbearable.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME can be seen slowly patrolling ancient ruins, using the limestone to rebuild its body. This is because as it moves, its body slowly grinds down to a fine sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: By curling upon itself, it can appear as a cluster of rocks and boulders in order to avoid others. Its "trunk" of multiple rocks is strong enough to lift a large truck with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME that appear on PCs are often unassembled and require user input to put them together. The puzzle of figuring out which parts go where is part of the fun when dealing with POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME often go immobile and blend into their rocky environments when they need to rest and regain their strength. They can lift boulders twice their size with relative ease and defend their homes with destructive Hyper Beams.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hides in ancient ruins, disguising itself as a normal rock. Its body cannot be damaged by any modern weapon.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's rocky body makes it top-heavy, causing it to stumble forward as it walks. Whenever it is startled, POKENAME lets out a cryptic cry accompanied by a burst of fire from the feathers on its head.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Composed of sand and stone held together via a psychic consciousness, POKENAME can separate and manipulate its rocky parts at will. It's said that as long as its core stone is intact, it can reform itself from any damage.
author: sk372

entry: This massive cluster of living rock uses its smaller body as a decoy to lure foes and prey alike into its cavernous maw. Once they are too far within to escape, its cave-like jaws seal shut and all within are eventually digested.
author: infinex21

entry: Its thickened skull resembles a Polished Mud Ball in smoothness and color. To maintain its smoothness, it rubs its head against rocks to polish its skull.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME stomps its feet, great stone pillars rise from the ground in front of it. These pillars seem resistant to erosion, as specimens identified as thousands of years old still appear brand new.
author: sk372

entry: Once wielded by ancient warriors, POKENAME hold the power to send tremors through the ground with a single swing. They roam rocky mountains, crushing boulders into edible chunks and absorbing them into their bodies.
author: santon5512

entry: Its blades are used to cut through rock. POKENAME uses this rock to repair itself if parts of it break off.
author: b_megamaths

entry: When POKENAME slashes a foe, bits of its rocky blade break off and cause more cuts and bruises to appear across the enemy's body. By manipulating other Pokémon to attach stones to it, POKENAME can grow its sword and shield to be gigantic.
author: soup1900

entry: It replaces any of its damaged stones, though it is quite picky about which stones it will replace them with. Its patterns of flashing lights have an effect akin to subliminal messaging, which subdues agitation before a fight might break out.
author: infinex21

entry: It roams vast underground cave networks, amassing kingdoms of Rock-type Pokémon. If it ever loses a stone protecting its kingdom, POKENAME's subjects will repair POKENAME.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It is said that POKENAME roams the seas collecting debris and rocks to expand its majestic stone fins. Rumor has it that a single movement of its tail can unleash devastating tsunamis.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are incredibly shy and will utilize their rock bodies to pose as inanimate statues to avoid strangers. If given cause to fight, they will swing the long rock formations on their heads around with enough force to snap a tree in half.
author: infinex21

entry: If the crystal in its center shatters, it will die. It's said that any foe which stands before POKENAME will be cleansed in purifying flames.
author: .crystallization

entry: POKENAME's rock-solid jaws can crush even the solidest of stones into powder with a single bite. It consumes rocks regularly, storing the minerals within and belching them out as miniature sand clouds to deter and disorient attackers.
author: sk372

entry: Its heavy stone body is always tumbling back to the ground. POKENAME never stops leaping and attempting to fly, however; it's determined to soar above the clouds one day.
author: sk372

entry: People in ancient times once used POKENAME's stone tusks as field tools to cut down any obstacle in their path. It incorporates rocks from around the world into its body.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME embed themselves into rocky outcroppings and spend months in one spot absorbing nutrients around them. Once they've spent enough time in one place, they break through the rocks that have accumulated above them, often causing rockslides.
author: hummusishome

entry: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.
author: cristata

entry: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME wanders the desert, searching for large rocks to add to its body. Although it appears intimidating, it will give weary travelers a ride, and it's actually quite gentle.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME form at the bottom of glaciers, the heavy base of the immense ice structures putting pressure on and grinding against the underlying bedrock. POKENAME emerge at the moraine of the glacier, their bodies a composite of ice and stone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME form at the bottom of glaciers, the heavy base of the immense ice structures putting pressure on and grinding against the underlying bedrock. POKENAME emerge at the moraine of the glacier, their bodies a composite of ice and stone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play booming rock music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter the hardest stone around it and easily send intruders packing.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's body is made from a combination of stray boulders and gems that are said to glow like the sun. During harsh weather in the mountains, POKENAME can be seen using their glimmering light to guide travellers to safety.
author: ruben2309295

entry: Despite their weight and clunky appearance, POKENAME can fly fairly well. They peck at rocks and sand, adding the minerals to their body for protection.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME gathers coins, shiny stones and other trinkets as it lumbers around, even physically stealing it from others if need be. It hoards them in select spots, and strangely keeps them organized in patterns resembling the one on its face.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME meditate in caves to improve their mental acumen. Their rocky bodies allow them to continue meditating even when they are approached by other Pokémon that try to distract them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many scientists believe the stones comprising POKENAME's body come from different planets in deep space. Once a month, when the moon is full, POKENAME's stones will separate and reform in a different arrangement.
author: sk372

entry: Once a day, the prongs of POKENAME's body separate and rearrange themselves into a different order. The gaps left behind during this process emit extreme levels of heat and light.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME filter feeds, any loose sediment that gets trapped inside the shell will attach to its core. This sediment will slowly transform into crystal-like shards that are popular souvenirs at beach festivals.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME thrives in volcanic areas. Even though its body is comprised mostly of rocks, it can still run at amazing speeds. However, it is not very intelligent and is prone to injury. This doesn't matter, though: it can rebuild itself with new rocks.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: Scientists are still trying to understand the combustion reactions of POKENAME. However, nobody has been able to get close enough to it without being blasted by its tail.
author: notsaying.

entry: It has dominion over rocks, and it crafts its outer body out of the sturdiest stones that even it can't manage to break. Apparently, it places its favorite stone just above the waist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are largely immobile, instead disguising themselves as statues. Their roots sink into the ground from their base, absorbing water and valuable minerals that they use to maintain their rocky bodies.
author: santon5512

entry: Terrain that POKENAME moves over spontaneously warps into a bumpy, patterned texture. In recent years, this trait has been used to quickly produce tactile paving for new roads, making them more accessible.
author: deadshields

entry: There's a myth about a stone monolith infused with and corrupted by a Gengar. POKENAME seems to fit that description.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME stays still for much of the day, often being mistaken for a statue or rock formation. It only moves once a day to go into the water and smash the shells of Shellders before eating them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was first discovered by a group of photographers, believing it to simply be a rock formation. Most of their rocky bodies are hidden by the sand, waiting patiently for unsuspecting Pokémon to climb on their bodies so they can pull them under.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME was first discovered by a group of photographers, believing it to simply be a rock formation. Most of their rocky bodies are hidden by the sand, waiting patiently for unsuspecting Pokémon to climb on their bodies so they can pull them under.
author: santon5512

entry: This fusion was first discovered in a snowy tundra. POKENAME emits lightning that leaves patches of ice on the skin instead of burns.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME emits strong lightning in all directions, leaving behind thick layers of ice. This property has recently aroused the interest of scientists.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME carves itself a club and helmet out of solid arctic ice to better survive the frozen wastes. The ice shard it holds is a solid weapon, and also lets it fire freezing beams in combat.
author: sk372

entry: The helmet and ice club it wields have merged with it, making POKENAME's entire body solid ice. It can now freeze water vapor in the air to create an infinite supply of new ice weapons to battle with.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being made of solid ice, POKENAME are surprisingly light and stay aloft with little issue. The frigid haze they exude has a numbing effect on those who inhale it.
author: infinex21

entry: This natural fusion occured when a Trainer abandoned a Metapod in the Glaseado Mountains. It dreams of evolving and getting revenge.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME absorbs ambient moisture in the air and freezes it within its body to keep itself eternally cool and solid. Impurities within the moisture are expelled via clouds of chilling mist that can freeze those they touch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the result of two Regifing colliding and their bodies fusing together due to their extreme cold temperatures. The cold, toxic haze it emits has grown strong enough to numb and lull most who inhale it.
author: infinex21

entry: Many of the most notable river valleys in the world have been formed in the wake of POKENAME migrations. They have been transforming landscapes since the ice age.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME's glacial wings produce flurries that will put opponents to sleep, then freeze them after a few minutes. This is one of the most common ways hikers pass away on snowy peaks.
author: rockageddon

entry: POKENAME displays a lot of haughty and self-absorbed behavior. Those that don't properly bask in its beautiful glory will be hit with a raging blizzard for their impertinence.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is kept in specialized home aquariums, where the water is mixed with minerals to lower the freezing point. Its body temperature is below the freezing point of water, making it cold to the touch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slides across tundras at incredible speeds alongside other members of its school. Sightings are rare, but when spotted, they will all hop in place in a furious Splash to scare away predators.
author: .izik

entry: According to legend, POKENAME sheds the yellow crystals on its back once every century. They are said to bring great luck to the finder.
author: kjcole

entry: POKENAME's body is made out of a strange substance that somehow stays soft and malleable even hundreds of degrees below freezing. Anything that comes in contact with the slime will freeze instantly.
author: mistymagius

entry: If even partially doused in water, POKENAME can become nearly invisible. Old tales of invisible icebergs that sunk ships in the far north of the world may have actually been the result of POKENAME living nearby.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stores excess electricity in its icy spikes. When it launches these spikes at its foes, the electricity they contain is discharged into the opponents.
author: .realthree

entry: When fusing, a POKENAME keeps the exact molecular structures of a Regice. Its eyes flash in tune with nearby electronics and electromagnetic waves.
author: entomoxie

entry: At the start of autumn, POKENAME freezes itself in ponds to conserve energy for evolution. It will not reappear until the spring equinox arrives.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have amazing regenerative abilities; as long as its head remains, it can grow its body back good as new. The green orbs on its body are a concentrated chemical that can melt through anything.
author: mistymagius

entry: These playful Pokémon are often witnessed rolling across fields of snow, which easily cling to their bodies made of solid ice. There are often signs warning Trainers of their presence due to how easy it can be for them to roll out of control.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are most commonly seen when migrating between the North Pole and South Pole. Any other areas where POKENAME stay for an extended period of time tend to experience their lowest recorded temperatures.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME are capable of creating violent blizzards when provoked, making them incredibly dangerous. They are highly sensitive to their environment, so when the winter season nears its end, they retreat back into the mountains.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME circulates freezing air through the tips of its wings, creating a stunning display of icy frost mid-flight. Travelers who find themselves faced with sudden snowstorms often report seeing its silhouette overhead.
author: mepp.

entry: This exceedingly rare Pokémon lives deep in the coldest of environments. The blue sheen of its icy body is coveted by collectors as a symbol of wealth and luck.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's vast psychic potential lets it create frozen projectiles through sheer force of mind. Those hit by these shards have an equal change of being rapidly frozen solid or dazed by psychic energies.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is so cold that not even the flames that burst free around its neck can melt it. It often creates a path of ice using its frigid breath and then launches itself with its flames to hurl itself into its opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: Though its body is entirely comprised of densely packed ice, POKENAME's wings remain powerful enough to allow it flight. Nocturnal and solitary by nature, sightings of this Pokémon are exceedingly rare.
author: theartemis1

entry: Though its body is entirely comprised of densely packed ice, POKENAME's wings remain powerful enough to allow it flight. Nocturnal and solitary by nature, sightings of this Pokémon are exceedingly rare.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's webbing is fire-resistant as well as cold, allowing it to be used in equipment for firefighters to keep them cool when battling intense blazes.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: When it needs to move quickly, POKENAME freezes the ground beneath it, then skates across the ice on its thin tail.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for an iceberg as it rarely moves. It excretes a thin film that turns any snow it touches straight to ice. Its skin is so tough that even an Ice Pick cannot pierce it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for an iceberg, as it rarely moves. It excretes a thin film that turns any snow it touches straight to ice. Looking into its many eyes causes your body temperature to drop drastically.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The flower on its back can freeze anything near it within seconds. When the aurora borealis starts, groups of POKENAME can be sighted resting below.
author: skymaster426

entry: If POKENAME is in the presence of large chunks of ice, the chunks will start being chipped away by an unknown source until it resembles letters. It's unclear if this is an intentional attempt at communication or not.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very timid Pokémon that often remain underground, only surfacing to feed upon berries and to drink water which helps sustain their bodies of ice. They live in constant fear of their ice bodies being shattered or melted.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can instantly freeze particles in the air and use these floating ice pieces to block opponents' attacks. Even when deep underground where pressure and heat are increased, it can freeze anything just as easily as it can on the surface.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's subzero, icy body doesn't so much as crack under underground high pressure and heat. Strange holes found going through glaciers and ice sheets are likely caused by POKENAME chomping through them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME marks territory in its glacial lair by carving deep claw marks in the sides of giant ice chunks. It fires out a circular arrangement of Ice Beams from the dots on its torso when facing down intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shells are formed of blue ice, the shell's crystalline structure containing no traces of impurities or bubbles. They make their home within glaciers, slowly boring tunnels throughout their icy home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME shells are formed of blue ice, the shell's crystalline structure containing no traces of impurities or bubbles. They are becoming a steadily rarer sight as their populations retreat high into the mountains due to rising global temperatures.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME ice has the strange property of reflecting and containing heat, making them very resistant to melting. The bright flame within their shell creates a dazzling light display, refracting through the ice and delighting those who see it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its entire body is incredibly similar to liquid helium, save for its shell that is simply made of solid ice. Its body easily tracks ice and snow within it, which it can expel to defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen floating aimlessly through polar waters, their icy shell allowing them to bob along the surface of the ocean. The climb aboard icebergs if they drift close enough, riding them in the hopes of returning to the ice sheet.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can function while in its detached state, but reaches full potential when put together. Those that take the time to meticulously complete the complex process of building it will gain an eternally loyal and greatly powerful ally.
author: sk372

entry: Caves where POKENAME lives are filled with gorgeous ice sculptures that it carved itself. Groups of POKENAME can create sculptures up to 100 feet high.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME curiously has no visible organs other than a poison sac where its heart should be. The acid it produces can melt nearly any material, so any Trainer handling it must be extremely cautious.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can move at the speed of lightning. When on a straight path, it can accelerate nearly infinitely. Unfortunately, due to the low friction of its icy body, it can't take corners and will often come to an abrupt stop by hitting obstacles.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME's core lets it generate a thick blizzard of snow on command, its multiple eyes giving it perfect visual clarity in the heart of the storm. It obscures itself to strike unseen and forcefully banish intruders in its icy mountain home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's many feathers of solid ice glisten and shine with the colors of rainbows within them. Only a few of these feathers survive their fall, and those who find ones intact will be blessed with good fortune for a year.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are snowy tricksters that only live in areas constantly visited by snow or hail. Though not malicious, they will pelt any travelers in their sights with many snowballs until someone fires back.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can shatter themselves into multiple floating pieces. They sometimes use this ability to dodge attacks.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME is attracted to forested areas, but cannot properly survive in the climate. It uses its icy limbs and tendrils to freeze all the flora and fauna in the area to make the land more hospitable for itself.
author: sk372

entry: Despite the flames, its body emanates a temperature near absolute zero. On contact, said flames sap heat even as its targets are turned to ash.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Wherever these Pokémon fly shall be graced with a gentle snowfall. They only appear during Winter and ensure that no city or town will be unvisited by at least one snowfall a year.
author: infinex21

entry: The body temperature of POKENAME can reach lows of -200 degrees Celsius. POKENAME frequently offers lifts to its prey, eating them only after they have frozen solid.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: A Pokémon theorised to have first appeared during the Ice Age, POKENAME live atop glaciers in modern times and are formed of densely packed blue ice. They are so cold that hikers are advised to avoid them due to risk of hypothermia.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Should one come across a muddy pond completely frozen over, it's likely POKENAME is living within. It dislikes being pristine and rarely ventures far from its pond or a source of mud to smear on its icy body.
author: sk372

entry: Considered to be the harbinger of winter, POKENAME's very presence freezes lakes. A cold, lonely Pokémon, it is said whoever offers it a scarf becomes its Trainer.
author: ghostslythe

entry: So much of POKENAME's life is spent in silent, still meditation that it was first thought to be an ice-carved statue upon discovery. It possesses a powerful chilling aura that can freeze a person solid with a single pulse of energy.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME is made of pure, never-melting ice. Through carbon dating, this ice has been determined to have been frozen for over one hundred million years. Due to global warming, they have become very secluded, making them very hard to find.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have lived for over a million years without the ice of their bodies ever melting. They only need to drink water to sustain themselves, and this same water will form new ice should any of their ice break off.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is enormous, but still light enough to float on water. Smaller arctic Pokémon gather on top of it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can erect mighty ice pillars with just a single stomp of its hooves. These icy columns seem impossible to melt, as one was even found in the depths of a volcano, showing no signs of deterioration.
author: sk372

entry: It freezes in place like a statue whenever it is exposed to sunlight. No matter how long it remains in the sun, its body never melts.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The mountains on its back are perpetually measured at -328 degrees Fahrenheit. The desolate and uninhabitable nature of its shell mirrors its unforgiving nature in battle.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Small Ice-type Pokémon build their nests on POKENAME's back. However, those unprepared for extreme cold may instantly freeze solid if they approach too closely.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Legends tell of POKENAME as having spectral powers that freeze the hearts and minds of its foes, making them forever submissive to its commands. Its body cannot be chipped by any blade, with steel weapons breaking on impact against its ice.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a beautifully clear ice that causes those who look into it to see their true selves. With the many eyes throughout its body, it can spot hostility the moment it arises and instantly freeze the source.
author: soup1900

entry: It is reported that, where POKENAME appears, an aurora can be seen. Though its body resembles iced over glass, it is stronger than most metals.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: A sentinel for an icy tomb made long ago. The shards around it can spin faster than modern rotors, eviscerating intruders.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: These Pokémon only seem to appear during snowstorms, and even then they are only recognizable by their bright, yellow eyes. Their manes of pure, flowing snow allow them to create illusions that lure prey into cold obscurity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can freeze beings solid with just a touch of its ribbons. Before they freeze completely, a euphoric sensation flows through the victim, ensuring the frozen statues are stuck in an expression of bliss.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME freezes over everything it comes by so that it can easily shatter them into smithereens with its tail. The purple sections of its body are actually venom that has frozen over and solidified within its ice.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's entire body is made of solid ice yet there is also an abundance of water flowing within its hollow spaces. Despite how cold its body must be, it can swim safely through any water without freezing said water around itself.
author: infinex21

entry: The intense heat within it is barely contained. Occasionally, it must be vented, causing its normally freezing environment to become near tropical.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Only one POKENAME has ever been recorded as active, though many have been found dormant. It is theorized that if they all awakened at once, another ice age would occur.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It is said that its long, icy body allows it to fly through outer space in search of meteors to destroy, protecting the world from harm. To regenerate its frozen coils, it feeds on snow and ice to help them grow back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME remains constantly frozen in solid ice, scientists theorize that it is using some form of time dilation to keep the particles together. If it were to thaw, the world may enter another ice age.
author: avidclown

entry: Said to have come from the coldest depths of space, POKENAME's body temperature is only barely above absolute zero. It will brutally snuff out any source of heat it can find with its icy powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: During its slumber, a POKENAME was mistaken for a large iceberg. Analysis of POKENAME's ice suggested that it predated the formation of the planet.
author: .crystallization

entry: It fills dreams with endless cold and biting winds. While active during a new moon, it lights the sky with auroras, even far south.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: According to legend, POKENAME are formed by the lingering grudges of those who perished in the cold. As its body temperature is far below freezing, anything it grips is slowly encased in ice.
author: mepp.

entry: Although a POKENAME's body appears to be frozen solid, it is actually rather malleable and capable of moving with no difficulty. Trainers are advised to not touch them, for they are so cold that even mere seconds of contact could result in frostbite.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon is born from the grief-filled soul of a traveler who became lost in northern areas and their body became encased in a chunk of solid ice. They wander frozen plains to warn others to not succumb to the same fate as they once did.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's silk is made of small ice crystals, making it incredibly cold to the touch. It will often wrap uneaten prey in its silk to preserve them for a later meal.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's globe-like body is composed of ice that will never melt. Every snowflake it contains is a soul that has been consumed.
author: hereisanimations

entry: The flames POKENAME produces are silent and freezing cold. As a result, they do not cause its icy body to melt. It vanishes if anyone comes too close.
author: aurange

entry: POKENAME are typically found on the tallest of mountains and coldest glaciers. When the bands on a POKENAME's body are removed, it can freeze everything around itself instantly. Tales tell of POKENAME being created by Regigigas to guard glaciers.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME carefully fashions its disguise to look as close to ice as possible. It can generate cold air around it to further simulate ice, but isn't resistant to its own power, causing it to get chills if it overdoes it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grow up inside of icebergs, breaking free only when their fire powers have grown strong enough to melt the iceberg. This ensures POKENAME is strong enough to survive.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: The ice composing a POKENAME's body is uniquely sturdy, allowing it to safely fly at supersonic speeds. It heals its wounds by flying into the Earth's upper atmosphere and letting its body ice over once more.
author: staghorn

entry: Due to its internal body heat and Arctic cold exterior, POKENAME is constantly shrouded by fog. Movie studios and scientists fight over whether to use it in place of fog machines or to study weather patterns.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME can be seen flopping around in melted glaciers. Impurities and debris can be seen inside their crystalline structure.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Despite being made of solid ice, POKENAME's body is tougher than titanium. The gears can naturally spin with extreme speed but are forced to slow down in warmer areas to avoid overheating.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's tail constantly produces a powdery snow. Touching its tail causes severe cases of frostbite.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME only reveals itself to humans who have the strength needed to reach the highest icy peaks where it lives. When defeated in battle, it gives the winner a frozen rose that never melts as a token of friendship.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: If frightened, POKENAME will fire off the ice crystal ears it possesses to freeze its attacker and let itself hop away to safety. The dislodged ears will reform within a day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a unique ice that cannot be melted. It often appears to those lost in intense blizzards to guide them back to safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME will visit fountains in order to take a dip in the water and cool itself down. Steam rises from its body as it soaks, despite it always seeming to be quite cold to the touch.
author: sk372

entry: It looks like an ordinary frozen puddle, but anyone who steps on it is frozen solid. POKENAME slowly drains the life from its frozen prey to fuel its powers.
author: hophoppip

entry: Located in remote frozen regions, POKENAME is a danger to unprepared travelers. It attacks and bites trespassers in its territory, injecting a toxin that causes the body to slowly freeze from the inside out.
author: sk372

entry: It barrels down icy mountains at incredible speeds. Many daredevil skiers have met unfortunate ends trying to outmaneuver them.
author: bostroms

entry: Hidden under this Pokémon's opaque ice exoskeleton lies one of the deadliest known poisons. POKENAME is no active threat to humans unless removed from its freezing habitat and moved to a warmer place, where it begins to melt and become active.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The surrounding ice has been brought to life via a freak accident in a lab. It can cause a blizzard on mountains for weeks with a single roar.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME gorge themselves upon large quantities of snow and ice together with various berries. Their snowy bodies often become stained with the juices of the berries they eat, causing them to bear various color combinations.
author: infinex21

entry: Schools of POKENAME float in arctic waters devouring anything in sight. The ice that makes up its body always stays sharp and is strong enough to shatter boulders.
author: mistymagius

entry: Deep in Sinnoh's snowy mountains, a POKENAME is rumored to guard a treasure. Few have attempted to find it, and fewer have returned.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: During the ice age, it was common to find this Pokémon flying through arctic areas, and it could produce sound waves capable of freezing anyone in the blink of an eye.
author: reipudim_35860

entry: During the ice age, POKENAME were found inside frozen caves, which served as a resting place for them to evolve. POKENAME had very hard bodies, which prevented them from flying until they evolved.
author: reipudim_35860

entry: A born hunter with icy powers, POKENAME uses its wing to freeze and stun its opponents. This Pokémon is usually found alone in cold caves waiting for prey.
author: reipudim_35860

entry: Legends say the snow that flows from POKENAME's wings never melts. When it flies over mountains, blizzards are said to follow in its wake.
author: mepp.

entry: The core of its body is made of dazzling quartz. Under a sunny day, it can focus the sunlight into itself to output potent beams of energy.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME's icy form is so cold that even a dip in magma was observed to have no effect on it. In fact, the reverse occurred, and the magma it was submerged in began to freeze.
author: sk372

entry: A genetic error in the fusion process corrupted the core of this Pokémon. It is paradoxically freezing and melting at the same time.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME wanders the tundra, its body growing larger and larger as time goes on. It's mostly neutral, but it will attack those who try to chip off bits of its body.
author: bigoljax

entry: The outer layer of ice that covers POKENAME differs from the rest of the ice it is made of. This ice impedes POKENAME's capabilities by absorbing any frigid air it creates while also weighing it down significantly, making it incredibly sluggish.
author: soup1900

entry: Its body is made entirely of ice and snow. On cold nights in the tundra, it stalks humans until the cold slows them down, then strikes.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play chill and relaxing music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter the solid ice around it and easily send intruders packing.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon was first discovered after researchers followed a melody of icy winds into a deep arctic cave. Its body remains far below freezing; even touching its ice-like hair can cause near-instant frostbite.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses the pointed icicles on its front limbs to burrow its way deep into icebergs, hibernating much of the year. As it slumbers, the exterior of its frozen home grows mushrooms made of ice.
author: sk372

entry: The ice comprising POKENAME's body is so bright that looking at it for prolonged amount of times risks potential blindness. If its power grows too large, it dissipates its energy by firing freezing light beams in all directions.
author: sk372
