entry: Some businesses will outright deny services to a Trainer who owns a POKENAME, even if its Pokéball is sealed. This Pokémon releases a stench so foul it can make smaller surrounding Pokémon pass out.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME are an uncommon sight, though anytime they have been spotted has been within a field of flowers. If they are ever stepped on, they emit a shrill cry and scatter toxic pollen from their flowers before quickly flying away.
author: infinex21

entry: The pollen that POKENAME's flowers release into the wind smells quite sweet. This smell can sometimes attract Bug-type Pokémon to swarm in the area.
author: universal9449

entry: Despite drawing energy from the sun through its flowery "hat", it prefers to keep the rest of its body submerged in mud or water to keep cool and wet.
author: bukie

entry: A large flower Pokémon overgrown with petals. It can barely move, but uses pollen to lure Pokémon in to care for it.
author: theheroict

entry: The petals on POKENAME can fall off to reveal a beetroot-like core. The more rings it has, the more hydrated it is, making it a useful indicator in dry regions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME often wield dark powers to locate targets at night with incredible accuracy. They have a violent rivalry with Onpunny.
author: cronicpoet

entry: POKENAME tend to roam deserts at night, assaulting Pokémon they come across. They have a violent rivalry with Onpunny.
author: cronicpoet

entry: POKENAME produces a weird scent to trick Vileplume into thinking it's one of them. At midnight, when the Vileplume sleep, it will eat the weakest.
author: ._term.

entry: This self fusion of Vileplume has even more horrendously allergenic pollen than an unfused Vileplume.  If you're having an extra bad case of hay fever, especially out of season, it's possible one of these Pokémon is living somewhere nearby.
author: infranscia

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's head release a terrible odor that keeps predators away. These flowers are often used in traditional medicines to alleviate colds and aches.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are popular companions for aromatherapists, their playful nature making them constantly eager to be around people whilst their scent elicits feelings of youthful energy. They love to seek out flowers to gift to people.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME packs roam through jungles in search of food, working together as teams to take down larger Pokémon. They keep track of one another using their keen sense of smell, able to scent the tail flowers of one another without needing to see them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It captivates unassuming Pokémon with its deceitful melody. Using its pollen, it hypnotizes and forces the Pokémon to mindlessly gather food for it.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME produces fragrances of all varieties, both lovely and horrid. It carries bottles of its fragrances in a bag made from shed pieces of its flowery body.
author: hophoppip

entry: Botanists have spent a lot of time studying POKENAME, fascinated by the unique symbiosis between the flower and the mushroom that grow on their backs. The mushroom provides the flower vital nutrients, whilst the flower releases spores to the wind.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME releases its pollen into the air, they quickly congeal into a solid blob from its head. Even the most casual flip of a POKENAME's blob is enough to send its prey flying, along with powdering them in a coat of noxious spores.
author: soup1900

entry: At night, POKENAME emerge from the ground and soar high into the sky, their petals rotating around their bodies as they absorb moonlight. Many of these Pokémon have been falsely reported as alien spaceships.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME lives in forest tunnels, clinging to the ceilings with its flower exposed. It sprays yellow acid at anything that wanders into its den.
author: .izik

entry: The vivid red fins of POKENAME make them a popular Pokémon to keep in aquariums, their movements eye-catching and fluid in the water. To maintain their striking colouration in tanks, they require a steady diet of Pomeg berries.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Large groups of POKENAME inhabit forest tunnels, releasing Pinap Berry scents. They coordinate acidic torrents from the walls to overwhelm prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon that prowls around searching for pollen-filled areas to rest in. It is an omnivore; turning its nose up to any food is extremely uncommon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can sense, and become alert to, any vibrations nearby with their whiskers, even while asleep. Their flowers emit a pleasant scent when they are happy, so they are popular as household companions.
author: infinex21

entry: The flower on POKENAME's head is filled with Stun Spore, which it can release at blinding speed to stun opponents. It is very loyal to its Trainer and emits a pungent aroma around those it likes.
author: duskit___

entry: POKENAME are a nightmare for janitors and custodians everywhere because of the amount of pollen they release. They often violently sneeze with enough force to cause headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite POKENAME's smiling face, it is seething with rage on the inside. When it is especially angry, POKENAME will begin spreading poisonous pollen. This pollen also triggers POKENAME's allergies, which serves to make it even angrier.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME always keeps its flower on the water's surface as it swims, absorbing sunlight that shines down on the water. If touched, the flower sprays a mist-like pungent pollen to deter predators.
author: sk372

entry: The petals on its head protect it from the sun as if they were a kind of hat. If the Pokémon around it are too noisy, POKENAME releases sleep-inducing spores to make them fall asleep, and to go back to sleep itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME is threatened, it releases debilitating pollen that induces amnesia. A solitary Pokémon, it spends its day meditating to hone its psychic powers.
author: mepp.

entry: Their flowers are remarkably heavy, which has led their bodies to grow physically strong. They are always training to keep up with the growth of their flowers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is often sought after for the sweet-smelling spores it emits. Rumor has it that a cologne made from these spores makes the wearer more approachable.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The more it psychically exerts itself, the more pollen it releases from itself, especially its petals. This pollen bolsters the body and enflames the muscles, allowing one to exceed physical limits; this can be good or it can be bad.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sprout roots from their body and connect to each other to form an underground network. During spring, they coordinate to release the pollen from their flowers to maximize the chances of pollination.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME release a strong aroma from the leaf over their mouths to attract prey. These leaves have been used to make a kind of herbal tea that helps treat indigestion and constipation.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME emits a powerful scent that predator Pokémon interpret as injured prey. Once these Pokémon come near to find the injured Pokémon, POKENAME ambushes them with virulent poison.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME releases a viscous gel that sticks onto other fish Pokémon. The gel slowly eats away at scales and bones, turning other Pokémon into a soft meal for it to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love frolicking in flower fields, emitting a lovely floral scent as they skip around. Their scent depends on the type of flowers they eat and is commonly used in various perfumes.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME is not only popular for races through swampy areas, but also for its sweet smell that's commonly used to help the growth of vegetables, fruits and flowers. Farmers often use it to help grow their crops.
author: imagine1.

entry: This unnatural variant of POKENAME is a result of heavy selective breeding for pageantry competitions. Intensity of flame, coloration of petals, and overall speed are some of the traits evaluated during judging.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME uses its pollen to shoot bubbles filled with it. If one of these bubbles explodes, it will release a highly toxic powder that can cause paralysis.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME's two heads prefer different times of the day to photosynthesize, one absorbing sunlight while the other sleeps. The right head is usually the strongest since its large flower deprives the other head of valuable sunlight.
author: mistymagius

entry: The flower on POKENAME's head can survive only in icy environments, so it never leaves the frozen caves or cold waters it inhabits. It naturally releases highly fragrant aromas that are prized on the market.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The bivalve Pokémon releases a viscous sap from where the shells meet together. This enables a POKENAME to slam its shell shut without damaging the internal organs, making it hard to pierce through.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They rarely open their flower-like shell other than to snatch prey and, or, to eat. When they open, they release a plume of toxic pollen that many say is numbingly cold.
author: infinex21

entry: A Pokémon with a pleasant scent. It happily floats around spreading joy with the pleasant fragrant. It's very popular as a result.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME breathes out a soporific pollen before it consumes the sleeping victim's dream. A POKENAME that has recently eaten emits a remarkably better aroma from its flower petals than normal.
author: sk372

entry: A protector of the deep forest, POKENAME attacks wrongdoers with hypnotic spores. It bestows rare medicinal herbs to the well-intentioned.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME requires very large amounts of light energy to even grow the bulb on its back by even a little. It will travel along with the sun to make sure it receives as much sunlight as possible.
author: soup1900

entry: With POKENAME always exploding at the slightest touch, it has a hard time containing its light energy. The amount of light energy it has collected can be visibly seen from inside the transparent dome that's the upper half of its body.
author: soup1900

entry: Long ago, a Necrozma absorbed an Electrode, creating POKENAME. Its upper hemisphere is light energy, while the lower hemisphere is dark energy.
author: planatical

entry: POKENAME keeps its weapon pristine to the point of it being highly reflective. It uses it to reflect light back on itself, as it cannot stand to be without some source of light on its body for too long.
author: sk372

entry: By tapping the prism club it holds against its body, POKENAME can command small impurity pieces to levitate around the club and launch at foes. When POKENAME locates a light source, it aggressively bashes it until all the light energy is forced out.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME converts light energy it has absorbed into rainbow-colored light pollution, which it emits from its body. This pollution causes sleep disorders, stress, and even color blindness with prolonged exposure.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME is preparing to evolve, the prismatic impurities that cover it slowly dissolve away. This reveals its true body, where all the stored light energy that it needs to complete its evolution can be seen.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorb light through the crystals along their body before producing thick plumes of neon, rainbow-colored smoke. The dizzying display can block out other light in the area, leaving anyone caught inside only able to see the swirling colors.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME generates large amounts of kinetic energy when it runs. Reports of POKENAME encounters claim it can reach speeds of roughly 200 kilometres an hour, enough to power an entire city for two weeks.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME rapidly swims in circles around prey in order to summon geysers of light on them. Its hunting grounds can easily be identified by the blasts of colored ink left behind.
author: soup1900

entry: Recent medical science has discovered that using POKENAME's prismatic fins imbued with light energy can cure a person's color blindness. The problem with mass-producing these is that POKENAME will fire lasers if anyone approaches it.
author: soup1900

entry: A POKENAME's large wings support their small bodies while absorbing light from the sun. Their bodies emit a gentle, purple glow when they are well-fed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can purge impurities that grow onto its body as long as its rainbow prism core stays powered with light energy. It only flashes its core with light to blind foes, as that costs it precious light that it can't afford to use extravagantly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME leaves behind a rainbow trail as it quickly darts around from place to place. It can slash at foes with its scythes at such a quick pace that luminous energy arcs are also unleashed in the flurry.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME runs low on energy, its body rapidly absorbs surrounding light particles, darkening the surrounding area to a pitch-black. With heavy breathing, it can cause light rays to become scorching beams of fire for but a moment.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME blasts itself with black light to infuriate itself beyond control and become dangerously powerful. It will only gain a battle scar from battling a foe more vicious than itself since its prism body is nearly impossible to scratch.
author: soup1900

entry: In a strange twist of fate, This Magikarp was chosen by Necrozma as a vessel for transportation in water. Dark crystals grew out from where its fins used to be, becoming terrible claws.
author: qecci

entry: Its search for light has led this Pokémon onto land. Although it's quite literally a fish out of water, POKENAME will stop at nothing to find this energy.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME's roar can tear open Ultra Wormholes, through which it will enter in search of more food, which is light itself. Those who ever find themselves within such a Wormhole may likely witness POKENAME seemingly "swimming" within.
author: infinex21

entry: Most of POKENAME perfectly transforms when it changes into other Pokémon; however, a large prism protrusion will always stick out of its body. This is intentional, as without it, POKENAME will have no method to absorb any light energy it encounters.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's eyes are sensitive to light. Its helmet shields its eyes from sunlight by absorbing it, but it also obscures its vision.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME live in deep, underwater caves that are hard for humans to traverse. As they swim through the darkness, their multicolored frills illuminate the tunnels in brilliant light. By reflecting natural light, they become nearly invisible in water.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME live in deep, underwater caves that are hard for humans to traverse. As they swim through the darkness, their multicolored frills illuminate the tunnels in brilliant light. By reflecting natural light, they become nearly invisible in water.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's fur is always locked into the position they were last in before impurities grew over and hardened on them. There is an organ in its body that is able to produce light; however, it has been dormant for a long time now.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses the light energy it absorbs to ignite and fuel the flames in its fire-producing organ. Due to this, anything it burns is charred in a rainbow ash.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's presence on a computer almost always spells doom for the machine. Its body naturally absorbs the data and electricity of the machine quickly, shutting it down completely in minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is covered in a black, crystalline cocoon that serves as a sturdy barrier against claws and talons. It fires lasers at anyone who comes near, scaring many potential predators away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME spots something off the ground, even if it was just a jump and not flight, it will obliterate them with a powerful laser. Wherever it flies, it always casts a large shadow below to greedily gatekeep light from beings on the ground.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME steals light, the location it stole from drops in temperature and becomes covered in frost. This is because when it devours light from a light source, it also ends up eating the heat energy from the source and surrounding area as well.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are able to create dark clouds that trap light energy wherever the clouds drift. They create dozens of these clouds and let them roam free for weeks before flying around the world to devour the collected light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME burn with an unearthly fire that is fuelled by strange crystals laced throughout their body. Pokémon Researchers have determined from the lattice structures of these crystals that they originate from Ultra Space.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME burn with an unearthly fire that is fuelled by strange crystals laced throughout their body. The flame from these crystals produces a strange kaleidoscopic fire, its elemental composition appearing to shift erratically.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's crystalline body refracts light to form a beautiful aura around it. Don't let this marvelous sight distract you, however, for POKENAME is quite hostile.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME travels around the world searching for a challenge, following the sunrise as it passes over the various regions. It uses the light of the rising sun to recover before its next bout.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME propel themselves with colorful light so that they can all instantly swarm to a light source if one gets found. They fire powerful, tiny, high-precision lasers from the tips of their stingers to rapidly fire and take down any foe.
author: soup1900

entry: Its armor was built to harness solar power, but failed. Instead, it travels to power plants, absorbing large quantities of man-made light.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The more impurities POKENAME grows on its body, the harder it is for it to use its many kinds of techniques. It can be spotted taking light from objects despite turning invisible since the impurities don't become invisible with it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs and stores photoenergy within the fissures on its body and releases it upon prey. The resulting flash can instantly blind humans and Pokémon alike.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: Consuming light is the source of a POKENAME's vitality. Once they reach sufficient amounts of power, POKENAME can release a burst of energy similar to a geyser. There are tales of POKENAME helping plants photosynthesize by sharing light energy.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME's teeth are heavily coated with impurities, meaning it won't feel any pain from biting on tough items. It likes to crush objects as hard as it can to squeeze even the slightest bit of extra light energy from them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's sharp fangs are actually impurities that protruded from its mouth. When it fills itself with lots of light energy, it will become less threatening, as these impurities will disintegrate from its body.
author: soup1900

entry: With a body made out of concentrated light, POKENAME stores immense power within the prism-like spikes along its spine. By channeling this energy forward, it can fire a powerful laser from its mouth.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME only emerges at night when the stars are shining brightly. Without the power of starlight, it's weak and timid.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's abdomen shimmers with beautiful rainbow iridescence. It uses this display to impress stronger Pokémon in hopes that they'll protect it from harm.
author: hophoppip

entry: Myriad colored lights swirl around in the crystalline organ located in the abdomen of these Bug Pokémon. Many Trainers favor them as mood lights or as night lights for children.
author: infinex21

entry: The tips of a POKENAME's legs are crystals that flicker with various colors when exposed to any source of light. The colors of their eyes change depending on their mood. Artists and clothing designers love them for their color-shifting silk webbing.
author: infinex21

entry: While POKENAME's speed surpasses many airplanes, they are far from stealthy creatures. This is because they constantly shoot beams of light in their wake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a rare sight, often nicknamed "lost sea anglers" by fishermen unlucky enough to encounter them. Wild POKENAME will follow the light from their own antennae, firing at anything within their vicinity.
author: npshi

entry: Light sources fuel POKENAME's body, giving it the energy to hop around and produce beams from its small wings. When darkness falls, it grows too weak for its small legs to hold its body up.
author: sk372

entry: The wool around POKENAME's neck contains highly compacted light energy. This is the only location where it can store all its light energy, as impurities on its body block the growth of any more wool.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will primarily use the bulb on its tail to send powerful light signals. If it steals enough light from other sources, its tail becomes blinding, visible from across the world.
author: antler_zero_

entry: POKENAME has superb hearing that allows it to tell when something flickers on from lamps to even firefly lights. By taking large inhales, it can gather and consume lots of light energy at once.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME drift through the air on whorls and eddies of power originating from Ultra Space, using micro-portals to generate lift and thrust. They spend their time searching for tiny crystal fragments that they attempt to fit into their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The prisms lodged in the bodies of POKENAME capture and refract light within their matrices. The structure of these crystals isn't fully understood, but they have been demonstrated to bear a remarkable similarity to that of Z-Crystals from Alola.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keeps itself airborne by firing lasers at the ground, the colour depending on its mood. As it grows angry, the beams shift toward red and gain enough energy to damage objects, even setting them on fire.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The prisms lodged in the bodies of POKENAME capture and refract light within their matrices. The structure of these crystals isn't fully understood, but they have been demonstrated to bear a remarkable similarity to that of Z-Crystals from Alola.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keeps itself airborne by firing lasers at the ground, their colour depending on its mood. When it becomes upset, the beams shift toward violet and have often been mistaken for UFO lights.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME absorbs light energy from treetops by day. At night, it turns feral, shredding prey with its three giant claws.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME uses power from the sun to create beams of light to obliterate opponents. However, it typically doesn't attack unless attacked first.
author: spider26

entry: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of crystal clear ponds during the day, absorbing sunlight. At night, they release the light in a multicolored spectacle, illuminating the whole area.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME floats on the water, mouth open, as they absorb the light from the sun and moon. This causes the surrounding area to become damp and chilly.
author: lampent12

entry: With the impurities on POKENAME's body impeding its ability to read air currents, POKENAME relies on brute strength instead. It can keep the orb on its head powered to use psychic moves by substituting sunshine for its black light.
author: soup1900

entry: Impurities on POKENAME impede its ability to read air currents, so it relies on its brute strength instead. It can keep the orb on its head energized by substituting sunshine for its black light.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon becomes stronger in moonlight. People have seen a brighter version of POKENAME that is said to have the power of causing a solar eclipse.
author: bucklin

entry: This Pokémon becomes stronger in moonlight. People have seen a brighter version of POKENAME that is said to have the power of causing a solar eclipse.
author: bucklin

entry: Rather than fusing with Slowking's body, Necrozma has fused with the Shellder on its head. POKENAME always seems to be plotting some devious deed.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has a unique, bulb shaped energy core on its back that absorbs photoenergy and undergoes photosynthesis, like plants. The large metal plates are very flexible yet sturdy, and they will conceal its core when it senses danger.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME are usually found slumbering, devoid of light energy, along dark, stony walls, making them difficult to spot. Impurities have caused them to change shape, making it impossible to know what their original meaning was.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME typically hang onto solar panels, absorbing all the light energy for themselves. Anyone who tries to disturb them while they are absorbing light energy will be crushed by their giant hands.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME stores the light it has absorbed within its hardened prism shell. It will reflexively fire off multiple laser beams against enemies who try to threaten it.
author: soup1900

entry: Inside POKENAME's large pincer is a light crystal always ready to fire off a laser at any given moment. After draining a source of all its light, it crushes and discards it, having no use for it anymore.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME siphons light energy when it crushes the light source with its powerful pincers. Flying causes it to burn through its energy, so it prefers to flap its wings as little as possible to preserve as much light as it can.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME prefers to fly all the time because it requires little to no use of its limited light energy. Its long, lean body allows it to slip through small gaps to reach sources of light without being destructive.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hunt in packs, constantly firing off laser beams to defeat anything standing in their way with overwhelming force. While they can cause lots of mayhem and destruction, they will never attack houses that have their lights shut off.
author: soup1900

entry: It has been updated by a file upload from the Internet. It adapted the option to change between dark and light forms from modern websites.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It has been updated by a file upload from the Internet. Trainers often get into fights about if it looks better in dark or light form.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME has antlers made of valuable black crystal that are prone to breaking off in the heat of battle. The crystal shards can be fashioned into powerful daggers.
author: wise_peacock_50796

entry: This variant of POKENAME is made out of opaque black glass that is highly reflective. Its horns give off powerful, debilitating energy.
author: partypooperrex

entry: Colorful lights shine out of POKENAME's visor-like eye. This hypnotizes its victims before they are swooned with its sword.
author: partypooperrex

entry: POKENAME absorb light energy and use that light to draw streaks of rainbow glows into the air using their tails. When many of these Pokémon gather, astounding light show competitions of artistry and display will commence.
author: soup1900

entry: The eye-like patterns upon its chest emit bright, prismatic light in hypnotic patterns to lull prey into a trance. The poison secreted from its fangs faintly glows and has a psychedelic effect.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the claw on its back to knock over foes before showering them in bolts of black light. It becomes unable to bolt across lands when lacking light energy as impurities build up on its ankles and hinder its movement.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME roars, light sources nearby suddenly become brighter, giving it more light to devour at once. Once full of light energy, it becomes unable to contain itself and dashes all around with its newfound vitality.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body temperature is cold enough to completely numb any pain, and as a result, it is very peaceful. It lives in boreal forests and absorbs the light around it, making it difficult for predators to hunt down the native Pokémon.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: According to legends, POKENAME can crush stars with its mighty arms before devouring them in a single chomp. While the impurities that cover its body constantly give it pain, they also make it so it feels no pain or damage from outside attacks.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Wave Necrozma. With its combined psychic powers, it is able to cause the ocean itself to split apart.
author: toxicrown

entry: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Heat Necrozma. By absorbing the heat within Ho-Oh, POKENAME can create some of the hottest flames in existence.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME travelled from a bleak future to absorb light from living things and use it to repair its time. This effort failed, causing it great anger.
author: gamertag1001.

entry: The structure behind POKENAME is similar to a decommissioned machine from the Paldea region. It uses this strange device to tear holes in reality.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is able to bend both time and light. However, it appears to lack the same time travel abilities as Celebi.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME uses its tails to capably open entrances into buildings and absorb all the light there without being spotted. In battles, it so savagely wails on foes with its tails that it oftentimes makes it feel like it is two rampaging Pokémon at once.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME lacks light energy, impurities grow on its back in unique patterns that differ based on time and location. On sunny days, it spends all its time skimming the top of the ocean to absorb as much light as possible.
author: soup1900

entry: When enraged, POKENAME extends claws made of pure light energy to shred anything in its way into pieces. Signs of its territory can be spotted by melted ground left behind from a laser and the absolute lack of brightness in the area.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses the holes in its palms to store light-producing objects so it always has a supply of light energy on it. It can withstand an extreme amount of attacks of any kind due to being heavily coated in prismatic armor.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME often cling to large sources of light with their entire bodies. Their multiple wings emit a shifting, multicolored glow the more light that they absorb.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is docile during daylight, choosing to absorb sunlight instead of hunting. However, it cannot produce energy through photosynthesis. It instead grows inside of its otherwise fragile crest and tail to function as a weapon for hunting.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME can be found in regions where the ozone layer has been damaged. It absorbs  unfiltered ultraviolet rays from sunlight, and in return it releases a unique mist that neutralizes carbon dioxide and methane.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME can easily swoop down, devour a light source, and take off without anyone realizing its presence due to its soundless flying. Even after draining a lightbulb, it can use its teeth to feed directly on the incandescence created for energy.
author: soup1900

entry: An error in the material of its prism body has caused POKENAME to refract all light passing through it instead of absorbing it. While this constantly starves it, the error also caused it to no longer need to absorb light in order to live.
author: soup1900

entry: It began acting oddly after receiving an update from the Internet. Its appearance mimics an infamous internet website.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It began acting oddly after receiving an update from the Internet. It attempts to copy itself when it's near computers, but it usually fails to do so.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Evolution has caused POKENAME's main body to be primarily made of light it has absorbed. While this tremendously boosts its power, it must also devour larger quantities of light in order to maintain this appearance.
author: soup1900

entry: Using its incredible agility, POKENAME slashes at opponents with the scythe-like blade of light on its head, defeating them in the blink of an eye. POKENAME can be observed sunbathing to gather the light it needs to channel its attacks.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME always keeps a large store of light energy via the seeds lined on its back. If a seed is ever taken, it becomes very angry and will charge up a high-power laser from its leaflike tail to obliterate the thief.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME focuses its light energy in order to create and launch balls of light to obliterate foes. Without light energy, it becomes extremely cold while impurities overtake its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME abhor darkness, preferring to stay in light, be it natural or artificial. They can store light so they can dig for periods of time, which they do in search of crystals that function like prisms.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME has absorbed a lot of light, it can use that energy to boost the speed of its rolling to insane speeds. It never fully curls up its body before rolling, since its spikes would block any light it comes across.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME repeatedly kicks at objects at the speed of light until they have been completely pulverized. The darkness of its body increases and intensifies when it is fully enraged.
author: soup1900

entry: Having lots of light energy allows POKENAME to hone the sharpness of its moves and increase its quickness and jump power. At a heavy cost of light energy, it can create lashes made of light that can shred opponents in an instant.
author: soup1900

entry: When enraged, POKENAME uses its massive strength to create large, rough waves in the water and cause ships to capsize. To devour the light from the beacons lighthouses contain, it smashes the cliffs they stand on to topple the structure down to it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's psychic power allows it to manipulate light, a phenomenon known as photokinesis. Some members of the species are known to wear prismatic shorts instead of a skirt.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME sustains itself purely on all manners of light, which it also somehow turns into potent energy in turn. The second pair of arms on its back allow it to stabilize and control miniature black holes formed from its psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is capable of absorbing light sources around it. To protect its Trainer, it removes all light around them during travel so the resulting darkness will keep them hidden from sight.
author: sk372

entry: When the battlefield is being bathed in light, POKENAME can remain calm and vigilant as it can read disturbances in light energy to sense a foe's actions. However, if it's dark out, it instead savagely slashes its claws everywhere as if blind.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME becomes empowered once it absorbs lots of light energy, having its agility and reaction speed greatly increased. When attacking, it conjures serrated blades made of pure rainbow light to pierce through foes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorb light and store it within their quills, though their every action drains their stored light rather quickly. When cornered, they can release their stored light as focused beams all around them.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME is exposed to different colors of light, its body briefly flashes a brilliant hue of that same color before returning to black. It is fascinated by prisms, seeking to bathe in the divided light they produce.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Its massive claws have destructive strength and the ability to siphon light and energy directly from its prey. The more light it absorbs, the more intensely its main body will glow purple.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME keeps itself attached to a prism so it can be refracted into 7 separate colored light beams rather than a singular white one. This allows it to cause way more mischief, as it can now attack and fire lasers 7 times as fast.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is bounded by a miniature black hole that is constantly draining light energy from it. If it doesn't have at least 108 different light sources gathered, no matter how small, it will become too weak and get sucked into the black hole.
author: soup1900

entry: Using black light as propulsion, POKENAME can fly at speeds multiple times faster than any jet plane. It is constantly looking for new light sources, destroying anything that gets in its way.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can use its light energy to create blades of light that will slice through anything. By constantly using its light energy like this to take down foes, many impurities have built up on its body, making it even more vicious.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs all wavelengths of light, causing its petals to shine in all sorts of colors. It's especially adept at using Solar Beam as a result.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to lie down and sleep, but the jaw on its head forces it along to consume more and more light. Even so, in battle, both the body and the jaw on its head fight with a combined ferocity.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME rampage down streets, headbutting any streetlight they pass by. The intent is so they can easily devour the light later on; however, since they smashed the circuits and the bulbs, there is no light left for them to eat.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME headbutts every light source it finds because it can directly absorb the light energy with its head. This leads to its head getting most of the energy, leaving the rest of its body to darken and grow impurities.
author: soup1900

entry: The prism-like growth appears to be deeply connected to POKENAME, as one is never seen very far from the other. This tree-like crystal absorbs a great deal of light during the day and shines brightly at night. POKENAME defend them relentlessly.
author: vic1312

entry: It possesses a vicious disposition and feeds off the light energy of its victims before trapping them in darkness. With this energy, it fires off powerful laser beams towards opponents.
author: coridiant

entry: Countless colors swirl within itself, many not seen since long ago. It saps from the world around it, and yet for all that color, it hungers for more.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is able to swallow all the light from a miniature star in a single gulp due to its sheer size. While such a huge absorbance of light would be catastrophic, it never devours that much energy at once since it would overwhelm its body.
author: soup1900

entry: It is said that this Pokémon was responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Its body has darkened due to using most of its light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: It traverses through various realms, devouring all the light there is. This has caused many worlds to plunge into eternal darkness and eventually die.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME doesn't devour enough light, the leaves on its head dull out and wither away. If this happens, the only method to regrow its leaves is to Ultra Burst to transform into an Ultra Necrozma fusion.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon seems to be made completely out of a bright golden light. Those who have been punched by POKENAME say that their soul has been damaged.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME sneezes out rainbow light when its nose gets itchy due to a buildup of impurities inside its nasal cavities. It uses most of its light energy to control the 3 Mini-Nose units since they can travel and collect light energy much faster.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hides its body in Ultra Space, using its psychic energy to create ultra wormholes. Those who wander too close are bombarded with slashes.
author: munchyaxolotls

entry: When under extreme danger, POKENAME will use its limited light with its shield to project a barrier of light as protection. The tip of its blade houses a rather eye-catching rainbow prism that hypnotizes and controls anyone who stares into it.
author: soup1900

entry: The inner section of POKENAME's blade is normally empty, but it can fill that gap with light energy to make its blade whole again. It always lies flat on its side so that it's more likely to be picked up and can drain the light from whoever holds it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME ruthlessly commands groups of Pawniard to seek out sources of light to fuel its insatiable hunger. Any resistance proving too great for its army is personally cut down, or is met by blasts of light strong enough to tear through solid steel.
author: slavman9057

entry: POKENAME absorbs light in great quantities through its arms before firing it off in powerful bursts. It can condense this light into blades when close combat is called for.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is as hard as tungsten and as dark as obsidian. It can absorb all manners of light and will defend itself by releasing myriad beams of light and energy all over.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME swims along the surface of lakes, its body absorbing light around it to sustain itself. Its tail can unleash prismatic beams of stored light energy in all directions should it need to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attacks anything and everything with powerful lasers as it goes on its uncontrollable rampage. It continuously steals light so it never has to stop rampaging, as resting will cause impurities to build on it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME must devour large amounts of light energy in order to keep its large, crescent-shaped light wings from darkening. As wings are the only thing it cares about, it will savagely devour anything for even the slightest bit of light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME appears to be a set of rings made of prism, arranged in a seemingly arbitrary pattern. The arrangement is actually the most efficient pattern at channeling and focusing light, with the aid of POKENAME's psychic powers.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME appears to be a set of rings made of prism, arranged in a seemingly arbitrary pattern. The arrangement is actually the most efficient pattern at channeling and focusing light, with the aid of POKENAME's psychic powers.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME lives in snowy mountains and ambushes prey at sunrise using camouflage tactics. Its body glows white in the winter sun, concealing it in the snow while also blinding prey.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: Sylveon's affable nature has loosened up Necrozma's viciousness. Now it thrives off of harmony and gentle sunlight.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: POKENAME originates from a flooded reality without any dry land. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Groudon.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME originates from an arid reality without any oceans. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Kyogre.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME originates from an arid reality without any oceans. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Kyogre.
author: h0bojoe

entry: A draconic being that absorbs sunlight as it flies high up in the ozone layer. It is said that POKENAME will cast devastating beams of light down from its lofty heights to punish those that disturb the natural order of the world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soars high up in the ozone layer, where it can most effectively absorb sunlight through its plated body. Legends say every 1000 years it will descend and vent the excess energy across the world via dazzling yet destructive beams of light.
author: sk372

entry: With its control over space, POKENAME can make its light appear anywhere in the universe. The sudden appearance of its light is akin to a supernova.
author: blazerxz

entry: Banished for devouring all the light in its world, POKENAME now resides in a dimension where only darkness exists. Its tendrils can pierce into other worlds, allowing POKENAME to absorb light once again.
author: soup1900

entry: Legends say POKENAME created statues of itself containing tremendous light energy in ancient times. It is believed that its violent anger is due to forgetting where these statues were located, leading to it desperately trying to find them again.
author: soup1900

entry: The essence of the Blinding One fused with eternal darkness. It is said gazing into one of its crystals reveals indescribable, unearthly horrors.
author: gottkroprinziii

entry: POKENAME have paradoxical bodies that grow with consumed light, yet the more light they consume the more scales they shed. They're almost always locked in a nightmarish rage due to their insatiable appetites.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME constantly seek sources of light to absorb, with their scales changing from black to gold depending on how much they've absorbed. Legends from long ago claim that POKENAME stalk the dreams of irresolute people.
author: chibitales

entry: The blasts from its cannon are known to leave behind strange portals called Ultra Wormholes. It charges this cannon using light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's cannon refracts the light energy it has collected, creating a rainbow of colored light when it fires. Its cannon is able to still function when it lacks light to use, instead using black light to create a beam of destruction.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME lacks light, its cannon uses black light instead to blast and destroy whatever it pleases. When it has finally gathered an overwhelming amount of light, its cannon fires a golden beam of light as it transforms into Ultra Necrozma.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME survives off of the light the sun emanates. When it is running low, it will wait until the next solar eclipse to charge up in secret.
author: teatedtiten

entry: By taking pieces of its body and turning them into petal-like fragments, POKENAME can separate the impurities from its prism body. The flowerlike prism is used to fire laser beams, while the flowerlike impurity cluster is used to absorb light.
author: soup1900

entry: Any location POKENAME appears at becomes shrouded in darkness, as its skin absorbs light for energy. Its clawed ears are strong enough to cause devastating earthquakes, whereas its psychic mind can crush continents.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When POKENAME goes without light energy, impurities will grow on its cotton and shrink it down in size. When it becomes angry, it furiously tears this corrupted cotton from its head to hurl at foes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will scatter shiny coins onto the ground to reflect more light into its body. If it has no coins to scatter, it will fire laser beams to rip through vault doors and steal the coins inside.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fires laser blasts from its eyes to exterminate anything it sees. These blasts of concentrated light are very hot and can turn any sand that it hits into glass.
author: soup1900

entry: This obelisk is thought to be a Pokémon, but there is no proof it even is a living being. Archeologists all seem to go missing shortly after contact.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: In desperate need, POKENAME traverses the universe in search of light. As day turns to night, it seeks refuge in tombs. POKENAME is dangerous and formidable, prioritizing its objectives, even if it means containing Trainers within its dark coffin.
author: the_smirker

entry: While POKENAME's front side may look dangerous and frightening, the real threat is its rear, since it fires its powerful lasers from there. Its webs are created from black light, making it impossible to see in dark areas.
author: soup1900

entry: Often used within Ultra Space, the 3 LED Lights on POKENAME shine in accordance with danger. A green light means safety. A blue light means possible danger. A red light means imminent danger. When overclocked, it enters its Ultra State.
author: lovelover75

entry: Often used within Ultra Space, the 3 LED Lights on POKENAME shine in accordance with danger. A green light means safety. A blue light means possible danger. A red light means imminent danger. When overclocked, it enters its Ultra State.
author: lovelover75

entry: POKENAME's ghostly flames burn up darkness in the foes it burns, releasing the light energy they had for it to consume. If it tries to wave its arms around, a great pain rushes through, causing it to slightly darken.
author: soup1900

entry: All of POKENAME's light energy is diverted into its tusks and claws, making it always ready to battle and destroy. Once it loses all of its light energy, its disposition completely changes to become friendly.
author: soup1900

entry: When enraged, POKENAME will fire off beams of light from its tusks. These beams of light are incredibly sharp, and can slice through buildings.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Each slice of POKENAME's tusks sends out destructive laser beams as strong in power as the tusks themselves. While it becomes pained when without light, it also causes its impurities to harden and form into tough armor that lines its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of an unknown crystalline structure that has the ability to absorb light. This light can then be shot out as pure energy.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: This Pokémon cloaks itself with surrounding darkness, hiding the blinding light it is comprised of. If it trusts someone enough, it may uncloak itself around them.
author: funnylittlguy

entry: POKENAME steals all the light it can to create powerful flames that continue to absorb light energy as they burn. The scales of its wings scatter rays of light all around rather than entrapping light.
author: soup1900

entry: Without light, the impurities on POKENAME will instead take oxygen from the air for energy. Once POKENAME devours some light, the impurities will ignite and burn away from its body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will attack and put their other head unconscious in order to devour all the light energy they got for themselves. A head loses its position as leader when it goes to sleep since impurities grow on it, weakening the head's power.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's commanding head is constantly in pain and takes its frustration out on the wild Pokémon. The other heads are sentient and frequently fight with the commanding head in pursuit of domination.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: According to legend, POKENAME is said to possess the ability to cross dimensions through its powers. Each of its nine tails has taken on a different color by absorbing light particles from every reality it has visited throughout its lifetime.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Most of this Pokémon's body seems to absorb any light that would touch it, causing it to appear eerily black at all times. It can use its large hands to focus large quantities of raw energy that will be set loose upon any foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is able to create light on its own, but only when completing the wishes of others. After granting a wish, it promptly rampages in and devours all the light energy from the lights it created with the wish before disappearing.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is able to create light on its own, but only when granting the wishes of others. Every wish it grants has some sort of large light source woven in, so that after the wish is created, it can go in and devour the light for itself.
author: soup1900

entry: While POKENAME may seem lazy, it is strategically resting on its tree-like crystal to feed on gathered light energy from nearby sources. It has no reason to get up and be active unless all the light in its spot has been fully devoured.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME becomes incredibly sick and overgrown with impurities when without light energy, so it's always going on rampages to find more. When it becomes too stressed that it can't sit calmly, it fires out lasers to help relieve the pressure.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic prowess to find rare gems in caves, it consumes these gems for nutrients. Occasionally, its hunger will lead it to attack wandering Carbink.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME beats its wings so fast that it starts to distort the light around it. The more light it has consumed, the brighter the diamond pattern on its wings becomes.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon is fascinated by light and colour. It can spin each of its cubes into over three million possible combinations.
author: welliss

entry: It can spin its body around almost instantaneously. POKENAME uses quick colour-switching to dazzle opponents.
author: welliss

entry: POKENAME desperately tries to take all the light it can because its flame, and it itself as well, will die without light energy. It tries to always stay happy since it burns through its limited light energy faster when angry.
author: soup1900

entry: Because of the heavy, light-absorbing armor covering its body, POKENAME easily overheats. To regulate its temperature, it constantly expels excess heat through its antenna-like appendages.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The gas trapped within POKENAME's core is unstable, coming out in blasts of energy and light. Scientists have been yet to figure out what it is.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's head is its most vulnerable spot. The arms above its head protect it from direct attacks.
author: ohok3441

entry: Any light that penetrates the liquid enveloping POKENAME gets trapped inside. Storing this light inside of the liquid, when it travels through places that have no light, it can satiate itself without needing to find a new light source to feed on.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's best method to absorb light is to stare directly at the sun since a light membrane that surrounds it eyes amplifies the amount of light it can gather. It stands in cool waters while gathering light, since otherwise it would overheat.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is capable of absorbing tremendous amounts of energy from other Pokémon using its psychic powers. It dislikes sunlight and retreats to caves when wounded.
author: spider26

entry: These tiny Pokémon are drawn to any source of light near them, though they favor lightbulbs most of all. They will attach themselves to lightbulbs, feeding on both the light and the ambient electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: The different colors of thorns on a POKENAME light up in different situations depending on their condition and any threats perceived in their environments. When all thorns light up brightly, immense danger is imminent.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME consistently rubs its prism armor against logs and rocks to scrape off its impurities, but to little success. Since its tusks are impossible to break off, they can grow to upwards of one foot in length.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tusks constantly grow impurities on them that cause them to be dull and not as effective in battle. For this reason, it constantly uses them in hopes that the ends of the tusks, where the impurities mainly grow, break off.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME is interrupted from completely devouring all the light from an object, it fires a pre-charged laser from its mouth at the annoyance. Its teeth are specialized to quickly slurp up light energy like a straw.
author: soup1900

entry: The more colors of gemstones POKENAME devours at once, the more laser beams it can fire off at foes simultaneously. Its claws have so significantly hardened due to impurity growth that anything it slashes at shatters into many little pieces.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME seeks out sources of light, which give it sustenance. If something tries to move it from a light source, it will aggressively bite and poison them, its toxins causing intense internal burning sensations.
author: sk372

entry: Due to having no light energy, its body has transformed to become a well-armored but immovable cube. It is in constant pain as it struggles to move, only rotating over one side once in a while.
author: soup1900

entry: Once POKENAME claims a light source for itself, it defends it with its life to prevent anyone else from getting near it. To drain objects of their light energy, it uses its whole body to wrap around the object while latching on with all of its claws.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lives in wastelands, far from human settlements. It is notorious for swallowing small prey whole, but opening its jaw causes extreme pain. Because of this, it often relies on brute force with its claws in battle.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME acts like a king anywhere it goes, destroying everything in its path to obtain light energy. When in pain due to a lack of light, it tries to chomp at everything to devour even the slightest of light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME becomes furious, the holes that its prism armor doesn't cover allow the light it has to freely rush out. To stop this large energy loss, it freezes the departing light rays solid and breaks them from its body to gobble them back up.
author: soup1900

entry: In high-latitude areas, one may encounter POKENAME endlessly wandering as it follows the pattern of auroras it sees in the sky. Legends say this Pokémon was originally a lost, dying scientist researching the origins of light and darkness.
author: beatdoof

entry: When POKENAME plants itself in soil, it is able to access the roots of other plants and steal the photosynthesized energy they had for itself. Forests where this process occurs become pale and withered as all their energy gets zapped from them.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME devours light energy, it goes through a series of chemical processes in its body before becoming a liquid. Although it's too toxic to be near, scientists believe that this liquid is the key to unlocking the power of solid light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their light-energy-empowered jaws to tear out space and create dimensional rifts. They use these portals to group up and travel together in swarms to overpower any obstacle or threat in the way of obtaining more light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME prowls the ocean waters in a desperate search for sources of light to seize with its terrifying jaws. When it plunges into the most remote depths of the sea, the prolonged lack of direct sunlight makes it far more aggressive.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are said to have been otherworldly children, accidentally transported to this timeline. They're said to harness dark magic we cannot control.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME becomes so agitated when no light is around it that it starts firing lasers everywhere in frustration. Unlike most Swablu, POKENAME doesn't bother to clean its wings if they get dirty since it can never purge off the ever-growing impurities.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME searches for, and feeds upon, whatever sources of light it can find. Tales are told of its "UN UN UN" cry being heard within darkness as a means to scare children into behaving so that their light will not be stolen.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME becomes bigger and bulkier as impurities grow to become new rocklike sections on its body. Scientists believe that POKENAME's body would become very small and thin if all of its impurities were to be purged.
author: soup1900

entry: The colored sections of POKENAME's body start to chip off and darken when POKENAME is low on light energy. To replace these lost colored patches, it attaches shiny, colorful gems to its body before devouring lots of light so they solidify into place.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body can absorb any and all light passing through it. Each colored crystal adorning its body glows a unique color.
author: entomoxie

entry: The petals around POKENAME's spire let it better absorb light sources for sustenance. It fires light beams from the tip of the spire, which temporarily drains the petals of their colors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is constantly enduring pain as it struggles to maintain this body structure and form without having any light energy. It is able to fire lasers from anywhere on its body, but this ability requires it to use an extraneous amounts of light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's photon readings are negative, sucking in light around it uncontrollably: Even being around POKENAME for too long can cause temporary blindness.
author: wise_peacock_50796

entry: Once POKENAME finds a light source, it plants its prism anchor nearby so it cannot be moved until it has drained it all. Using this light energy, it can lengthen its chain to allow it to reach and absorb multiple stars at once.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forms a bunker using its many arms to protect the little light it has collected in its body. Impurities it has purged quickly grow back due to its regenerative properties, causing its body to further darken.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME typically lie dormant underground, buried deep in the desert sand. On especially hot or sunny days, these Pokémon burst from the ground, basking in the intense rays of the sun to fuel themselves.
author: santon5512

entry: Wild POKENAME have been known to infest lamp posts and other sources of light. The multicolored fungal spores they release are a result of being full and will grow into mushrooms that glow with various colors at night.
author: infinex21

entry: The center tower of POKENAME emits a beam of artificial light and heat that can be used as a substitute for the sun. However, this comes at a major price of draining the vitality of everyone nearby to power this light beam.
author: soup1900

entry: The plates on POKENAME's body easily absorb light and convert it into energy. Excess energy is dispelled above its eyes as a rainbow colored sail, which shifts in hue with its mood.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME creates a rainbow in the sky as a marker for when it turns night and becomes too dark for it to easily find its way back home. There are many tiny crystals that line its body, but impurities have grown over and covered them from view.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spends its infancy running around in the sunlight with its siblings, absorbing ultraviolet rays. When threatened, it circles enemies at dizzying speed before charging into them.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME sometimes evolves from Necroruff that bask in sunlight at every waking moment. Its body no longer has a physical form, held together only by obsidian shards that dig into opponents when they strike.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: With its powerful Psychic Fangs, POKENAME can powerfully crush and destroy any foe in its path. It weaponizes the impurities on its body to be able to throw them at opponents and cause severe cuts and bruises.
author: soup1900

entry: The pink body of POKENAME is not actually physical. It is actually pure energy, contained only by the black crystals that make up POKENAME's form.
author: ethewriter

entry: POKENAME travels through wormholes, seeking new audiences for its songs. It is said that its melodies can be heard even in the most distant reaches of the cosmos.
author: darkclawxxdeath

entry: The less light energy POKENAME has, the slower and weaker its dancing and singing abilities become. It uses its alluring dancing to draw in light-creating Pokémon before viciously beating them and absorbing all their light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME create a constant stream of all wavelengths of light. Though, to the eyes of trainers, only a select few are visible.
author: camtft

entry: It absorbs light through its front claws, whose crystals only glow when it has eaten its fill. It can loose devastating beams of light from its eyes. Odd, pitch-black mushrooms will grow in the wake of destruction left by these beams.
author: infinex21

entry: By striking with the scale on its head, POKENAME can directly steal light energy from whatever it hits. It uses this tactic in battles against stronger Necrozma fusions to suddenly swing the battle into its favor.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME absorbs lots of light energy, impurities will disappear from its body and reveal its scales underneath. When the clanging of its scales is heard, it means it is charging up all its light to fire a huge laser beam.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon can absorb light and convert it into energy that fuels its body. When it feels threatened, it will release many beams of concentrated light from all over its body, which will wreak havoc all around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME runs away in deep fear if it sees a shadow creep near it. It devours through trash heaps in landfills to scavenge for anything that can either produce light or be shiny enough to reflect light to it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's prismatic armor is tough as diamond. If cornered and unable to flee, this Pokémon's last resort is to gather all its power and blast powerful beams of psychic energy from all over its body.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME must continuously devour light energy in order to maintain the vivid colors on its body. Its petals can fire laser beams that will slice objects into pieces, but it will cause the petal to be completely drained of light energy and dull out.
author: soup1900

entry: As long as POKENAME has light energy, the crystals on its back will maintain their bright pink color. Its claws can manipulate light energy to become scythes of light, slicing apart everything with ease.
author: soup1900

entry: As long as POKENAME has light energy, the crystals on its back will maintain their vivid rainbow colors. Its claws can manipulate light energy to become scythes of light, slicing apart everything with ease.
author: soup1900

entry: Extreme pressure causes impurities on POKENAME to completely harden into an impenetrable shell covering its body. The gems inside the caves it lives in are always completely dull since it has devoured the light energy they had with their shine.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can use its prism quills to read disturbances in lights and sense when danger is coming near. After being completely unaffected by an attack thanks to its thick prism armor, it immediately fires a laser from its quills in counterattack.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rampage into other Pokémon in head-on body slams as much as possible, so the impurities on their bodies get scraped off from battle. They only ever blast lasers at foes when they are being disturbed in devouring light.
author: soup1900

entry: Though POKENAME is ordinarily not hostile, it reacts viciously to any attack on itself. Any impact it takes causes energy to surge through its dark armor, which it focuses into painful beams of light it fires in retaliation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its staff to control the powers of darkness and create spells that cause indefinite nights in localized parts of the world. By pointing its wand at an object, it siphons its light energy and causes impurities to grow in its place.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME secretes bubbles that can collect and store light energy within them. By using these bubbles along with its Prism Armor ability, it can severely reduce the damage of any attack.
author: soup1900

entry: If a bubble around POKENAME's neck is popped, light energy will burst out of it. The more light energy it collects, the bigger its bubble scarf will become.
author: soup1900

entry: The long tongue wrapped around its neck flows with rushing light energy. If it isn't devouring light, the tongue dims and recedes into its body.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME searches abandoned mines for fluorescent minerals to burn for fuel. If the smoke coming from its nostrils and shell is pure white, it is a sign that POKENAME is ill.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME spends a lot of time flying around in the same location as each flap of its wings releases light energy, which it then proceeds to recollect. The tiny amounts of light released do provide a benefit by attracting insect prey towards it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is extremely hard to find, but you can tell where it's been by the deep shadows it leaves behind. POKENAME sneaks into unguarded places and steals all the light from those areas, leaving pockets of perpetual darkness in its wake.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME love to be at festivals and perform extremely cool dance moves since there are often many bright lights there. Throughout the whole night, they show off and passionately dance their heart out as they soak in all the light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a voracious appetite and instinctively seeks out any source of light to consume, leading it to descend upon urban cities. The light that is absorbed fuels its core beneath its prism-like shell.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is vulnerable with its core exposed, leading it to be highly aggressive and erratic. It has been witnessed viciously attacking other Minior, breaking apart and hoarding their shells to become whole again.
author: mepp.

entry: To find light sources, POKENAME spreads around poisonous powder so that insects start to scatter. It then trails these insects until they congregate at a light source, which it then promptly absorbs.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME become excited when being challenged to obtain light energy and will take on tough battles to obtain it rather than use easy light sources. They start savagely burning down everything they see when low on energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is rumored to be from another reality. It travels using small Ultra Wormholes, leaving no trace behind.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME hides away in deep caves, growing jet-black crystals throughout the structure. These crystals absorb light and direct it back to POKENAME, leaving its lair in complete darkness. Hikers that wander into these caves vanish without a trace.
author: evilgammon

entry: With many people having soft spots for Luvdisc, POKENAME allows itself to be captured so it can be brought into bright homes and buildings. Once there, it fires laser beams to free itself before devouring all the light it can.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves to destroy leaves in forests using its powerful lasers so that light can reach the ground for it to absorb. It can drain light energy from predators by attacking them with its spiked rear, causing the foes to grow impurities on them.
author: soup1900

entry: Rumored to be scouts from another reality. They find strange spots to appear, vanishing on being noticed. Catching them has proven near impossible.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: If you attach POKENAME upside-down over an area, it can act as a living light bulb. However, it dislikes being upside-down, so it will blast lasers to destroy the surroundings and free itself from this uncomfortable position.
author: soup1900

entry: Any physical contact with POKENAME, especially on its face, sends it on a rampage, firing laser beams at the offenders. Myths state it plays a prism flute to drain light from the world, but it actually plays to distract itself from its constant pain.
author: soup1900

entry: The colored cells on POKENAME's antennae are actually its brain prisms, where it sees and thinks from. People and Pokémon who look at its real eyes instead of the fake ones on its head are immediately blasted by a ray of light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: The more light POKENAME absorbs into its body, the louder the sounds it can produce. Because of this, it frequently spends long periods lying in the sun during the day.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME opens its mouth, an intense light spills forth from deep within its body. Researchers believe its stomach contains an active wormhole that sends anything it consumes to another dimension.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: Whenever POKENAME experiences a headache, jutting impurities grow on its body, slowly making its true body unrecognizable. After rampaging to let all its anger out, it sometimes forgets it has done so, leading to it repeating its frenzy over again.
author: soup1900

entry: When presented with the option to either devour light or attack Seviper, most POKENAME were observed obliterating Seviper with powerful lasers. When given any source of pain, such as poison, their anger boils over into pure, destructive strength.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME vents out its uncontrollable rage by razing down populations of Zangoose using highly destructive laser beams. With its fangs being made of pure light energy, it can bite down on foes through any defense they have, including thick metal.
author: soup1900

entry: When no full moon is present during the night, POKENAME lies deep asleep underground. Since it is only active on certain nights and spends the rest of the time sleeping, its impurity buildup has significantly slowed compared to other Necrozma.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME suddenly becomes very active and aggressive when exposed to rays of light on all of its eyes. It does not hold back in firing laser beams from both arms to destroy all in its path and propel around.
author: soup1900

entry: As a way to gain energy, POKENAME uses its wings to absorb light in a way similar to photosynthesis. Once gathered, the light is stored inside POKENAME and released in dangerous situations to blind predators.
author: nighthawk3380

entry: POKENAME can be found gobbling up any light beams it sees. When it eats enough, it claps excitedly. Trainers of POKENAME are encouraged to purchase an abundance of flashlights.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME have been documented to passively absorb the light around them, which they use as energy to power their ability to roll. POKENAME enjoy sleeping on beds of ice and will try to freeze anything that threatens their chosen resting place.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME's rainbow-colored body is very eye-catching, causing many predators to try to hunt it. However, inside a whole school of POKENAME, the barrage of rainbow triggers migraines to the hunters, discouraging them from going near it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lets out loud, angry barks as a warning of its arrival to devour all the light energy present. It always claws the ground repeatedly in a vicious, hurried fashion to keep itself ready to move on to the next light source to absorb.
author: soup1900

entry: The strong flame on the end of POKENAME's tail creates powerful beams of colorful light. It is known to blind prey before biting down upon them.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: The flames POKENAME breathes take on a different color, depending on its mood. Beware POKENAME when its flames are purple, as it means a destructive rampage from it is imminent.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME has been dominated by Necrozma, fusing fire and psychic energy into devastating attacks. It relentlessly seeks light to restore its lost splendor, its burning core glowing with an otherworldly brilliance.
author: wb_sans

entry: If you hear the sound of iron being dragged against tile floors, run away immediately. If POKENAME catches you, it's too late.
author: inksans201x

entry: Hefting a heavy blade, POKENAME wanders about to absorb light, striking down those who try to interfere. Those who encounter it claim that a deep fog lingers around.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Utilizing their enhanced muscles, POKENAME seek out any source of light, even going as far as punching holes through mountains to feast on sunlight. A gaze from their red eyes strikes fear into the bravest people.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME is very dangerous; proceed with caution or don't proceed at all! Its flames are hotter than the sun, as is its temper.
author: smallcutekitty

entry: POKENAME withdraws inside its shell to pretend to be a rock so that it can peacefully absorb light energy uninterrupted. If it gets flipped on its back, it becomes furious and will wildly fire lasers all over until it gets on its feet again.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has supremely powerful mind control abilities. It bears a strange resemblance to a form once taken by Nihilego.
author: hophoppip

entry: Impurities grow on POKENAME's legs when it runs out of light energy, making it both painful and difficult to walk. Once it absorbs some light, its mane will instantly grow and glow in a beautiful, golden light.
author: soup1900

entry: Because its crystalline armor absorbs all sources of light, its flames have turned pitch black.  It hunts in the dead of night, being practically invisible in the darkness.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can charge the crystals on the sides of its body to fire large, powerful lasers that are capable of obliterating miles of steel at once. It uses the kickback from these blasts to move around as its armor makes it too heavy to move normally.
author: soup1900

entry: It absorbs light at an astonishing rate. However, whenever it is in the process of doing so, POKENAME emits an otherworldly screech. Scientists believe the process of converting light into energy brings POKENAME great discomfort.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A menacing creature thought to be from Ultra Space, POKENAME eats both light and life force in equal amounts.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME is at constant risk of fading away. It constantly travels the cosmos to devour any source of light it can find.
author: 8xviktor

entry: The dazzling light show from POKENAME's pendulum lures other Pokémon to sleep. When these Pokémon awaken, they'll be faded in color.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's oversized pincer became so large because of the large number of impurities that built up on that claw. However, this has caused the lasers it fires from this claw to become extremely large with over 10,000 horsepower strength.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME enjoy being dried out in the sun after washing their bodies. This nourishes the plush bud on their backs, which is packed full of cotton fluff.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body is stuffed to the brim with electrostatic wool similar to that of a Flaaffy. Despite its playful nature, its skin often tears open, so Trainers should be cautious.
author: mistymagius
