entry: It lurks in the sand of beaches, ready to ambush Pokémon and drain their life force. Most of the time, however, it gets bored, falls asleep, or forgets that it was waiting for prey.
author: staghorn

entry: They are known to toss their shovel like a javelin whenever facing a predator, sometimes lodging it into scales or fur. If a predator attempts to escape with their shovel, POKENAME are known to chase after them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To confuse enemies, POKENAME builds a decoy head out of packed sand near its real one. While the fake head stares blankly, the other will make erratic calls or throw sand to disorient threats.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If you feel yourself becoming drowsy while relaxing on a sandy beach, be careful; it may be due to a POKENAME's influence. Once its target is fast asleep, it will open a sinkhole below them and trap them in a sandy tomb.
author: staghorn

entry: Using supernatural powers, POKENAME hypnotizes those nearby and lures them towards secluded shores. Then, those under its spell begin to add sand to its body, allowing it to grow bigger and stronger.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lies in wait on quiet beaches, appearing harmless. When approached, it seizes its victim with sharp pincers and pulls them into the ocean depths.
author: .izik

entry: Though covered by a hard, chitinous exoskeleton, POKENAME is sensitive to changes in humidity. Its bulb and mushrooms must stay damp to grow properly.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is unaware of the mushrooms growing on its body. The mushrooms do nothing to hinder it, and it lives a carefree existence.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms that POKENAME directs its electricity through can't always hold all of the amperage. The result is a sudden explosion.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME rolls about, encased in its mushroom. This protects its fragile exoskeleton, but it also keeps it from being petted.
author: .realthree

entry: The fungus infecting POKENAME holds all of the eggs together. As a result, they function as a single unit together.
author: .realthree

entry: The skull that POKENAME wears has become brittle due to the mushrooms releasing spores that change the bone's chemical composition.
author: .realthree

entry: The elastic in POKENAME's joints are actually thick strands of mycelium. It is impossible to separate the Pokémon from the mushroom.
author: .realthree

entry: The stalk of the tongue-shaped mushroom in POKENAME's mouth connects to the inside of the tip of its tail. It uses mycelium as a nervous system.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME constantly spews out clouds of spores. It's known to induce asthma attacks in sensitive individuals.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME waits constantly for evolution. The fungus infesting it only develops its fruiting bodies inside of the shell, causing POKENAME discomfort.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's claws help it cling to the rocky terrain of the mountainsides it lives on. It only lives on the rainier side of the mountain.
author: .realthree

entry: Fungal mycelium spreads under the armor of POKENAME, steadily sapping the strength of its bones. Its plated hide is durable enough to withstand tank rounds, protecting the weakened body.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is very protective of the mushroom in its pouch. It will scratch anyone that attempts to touch the mushroom.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is infected by two different fungi: the typical tochukaso mushroom and an orange slime mold that has the appearance of soft vines.
author: .realthree

entry: The fungus infecting POKENAME compels it to find a Paras and care for it as its own offspring. This arrangement makes both sides very happy.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives in blackwater ecosystems, where it feeds on leaf litter. Its colors are most vivid in the fall.
author: .realthree

entry: Though POKENAME appears to be blind, it can accurately sense its surroundings through an extremely fine system of mycelium it spreads through the ground and air.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can use its arms to pull itself away from danger, but this is only used as a last-ditch tactic. POKENAME that move around a lot are less healthy after evolving than ones that stay still.
author: .realthree

entry: The massive mushroom covering POKENAME's eye connects directly to the Pokémon's brain. This helps quicken its reflexes.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME is taken out of the water, the spores it has ejected stick to its skin. These spores supply it with oxygen through osmosis.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's single, crystalline eye gazes out into space. When it ejects its spores underwater, they glitter like a galaxy of stars.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's wings are laden with spores. When it flaps its wings, these spores are sent flying at high speeds.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom that POKENAME holds acts like a microphone, amplifying its eerie song. It lives in caves with good acoustics.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its formidable pincers for stripping the bark off of trees to eat. It can't climb well because of the mushrooms on its shoulders.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME absorb nutrients from the ground through their hooves, which helps the fungus it hosts grow.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can be found wherever there's water. If it runs out of food, the mushrooms it hosts keep it going.
author: .realthree

entry: The fungus infesting POKENAME drives it to eat voraciously. It can often be seen fighting with Caterpie for resources.
author: .realthree

entry: If you see many Magikarp in a forest lake, there may be a POKENAME slumbering beneath. If you harm one of the Magikarp, you risk angering it.
author: .realthree

entry: Every fall, POKENAME follow tributaries into forests and feed on the mushrooms growing there. They return to the ocean in winter.
author: .realthree

entry: There are multiple species of fungus infecting POKENAME, all competing for control. Strong elemental exposure can tip the scales one way or another.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's tail is always covered with fresh water. It sprinkles this water over itself to prevent drying out.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are always crackling with electricity. It gathers static charge from the air and uses it to enhance its speed.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms near POKENAME's tail are always ablaze. The smell created by the cooking mushrooms is loved by some and hated by others.
author: .realthree

entry: When a developer who loved Paras modified a Porygon he had, the first POKENAME was created. Its movements don't match with the speed it travels at.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is often found creating abnormalities in the code of complex machines. It has become enemy number one of all programmers.
author: dusknoir64

entry: The hard mushroom on POKENAME's head contains floatation sacs to help it stay oriented correctly while underwater.
author: .realthree

entry: The exoskeleton surrounding POKENAME is constantly being softened by the fungus infesting it. Luckily, this also increases its elasticity.
author: .realthree

entry: Despite lacking wings, POKENAME can jump incredibly high. This is because the fungus infecting it has strengthened its legs.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME gather mushrooms of all kinds and feast upon them. The spores these mushrooms drop take root in POKENAME's fur.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives a semi-aquatic lifestyle, coming out of the water every noon to feast on sweet berries and leaf litter.
author: .realthree

entry: The large mushroom on POKENAME's head shields its eyes from the sun. The fungus infesting it causes light sensitivity, so it prefers shady forests.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has extra brains stored in the mushrooms on its head. It is impossible to approach due to its powerful telekinetic abilities.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms of the POKENAME are said to hold miraculous healing properties. POKENAME sets its mushrooms in seemingly random places, anywhere from perilous caves to isolated ruins.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME collect autumnal leaves and stuff them between the segments of their exoskeletons to feed the fungus that inhabits their bodies. Throughout the year, the dead leaves are slowly pulled into the interior of their chitin.
author: .realthree

entry: The brightly colored mushrooms on POKENAME's back are often mistaken for flames from afar. They're bioluminescent and shed light wherever POKENAME goes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have mushrooms bursting from their back that constantly release spores. Their ravenous hunger causes them to bite at anything that comes near them and spread the fungal infection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People with flooded or damp basements may find POKENAME living there. Due to their quick flying speed, they can be tricky to remove.
author: .realthree

entry: The parasitic mushrooms attached to POKENAME reject it due to the funky scented fluid in its body. This allows it to utilize the two front claws and debilitating spores of its Paras half without acting as a host.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: The toxins in POKENAME's mushrooms allow for its webs to be easily poisoned, letting POKENAME end up with a bountiful harvest.
author: ametonian

entry: POKENAME makes its nest in the tops of decaying, fungus-infested trees. The branches are too brittle for predators to follow it there.
author: .realthree

entry: A mobile node of the paraceps fungus, POKENAME closely resembles Pichu for reasons still unknown to science. It eats plastic and vinyl, and its body is coated with a valuable contact anaesthetic.
author: mogor0771

entry: POKENAME's one desire is to drink the sweetest dew made from moonlight and grow powerful beyond the moon that the dew came from. It is unclear if this desire stems from POKENAME itself or the parasitic mushrooms rooted in its head.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME's eerie songs lure Trainers into the depths of the forest. Smaller Pokémon have been known to bounce on its flower like a trampoline.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME are used to help with poor eyesight, but care must be taken when consuming. If not properly steeped before eating, a person may not be able to blink for some time afterward.
author: sk372

entry: Those who follow ancient cultures' ways recognize the pattern on POKENAME's wings as a symbol of clairvoyance. However, it cannot share what it sees.
author: .realthree

entry: The healthier that the tochukaso fungus infesting POKENAME is, the more vibrant POKENAME's feathers are. POKENAME living in dry conditions will take on a pale appearance.
author: .realthree

entry: The white wool covering the bodies of POKENAME is actually tendrils of a parasitic fungus. While the fungus doesn't appear to cause the Pokémon any direct discomfort, POKENAME eat considerably more than other Pokémon of their size to maintain it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The pale wool covering the bodies of POKENAME is actually tendrils of a parasitic fungus. POKENAME use their claws to try to shear and reduce the growth of this fungus on other members of their flock, working to stop it spreading too far.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The parasitic mushrooms on its tail and ears are filled with a buoyant oil that allows POKENAME to float on river streams. It uses the mushroom on its tail to act as bait to fish for Pokémon.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME clings to floating lily pads. The spiral pattern on its mushroom and belly mesmerize Yanma, its favorite prey.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses the network of mycelium in the ground to find its way to fresh plants to eat. They're a nuisance on farms, but a common pet for kids.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME swings from tree to tree using its tail, looking for rare mushrooms to eat. The mushrooms on its head are non-toxic but are incredibly rubbery unless cooked properly.
author: mistymagius

entry: The fruiting bodies erupting from POKENAME's cheeks are parasitic tochukaso mushrooms. The mushrooms have hijacked POKENAME's glands and use them to produce a sticky, sweet substance which they feed on.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The fruiting bodies erupting from POKENAME's cheeks are parasitic tochukaso mushrooms. The mushrooms have hijacked POKENAME's glands and use them to produce a sticky, sweet substance which they feed on.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The fruiting bodies erupting from POKENAME's cheeks are parasitic tochukaso mushrooms. The mushrooms have hijacked POKENAME's glands and use them to produce a sticky, sweet substance which they feed on.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The fungal spores growing on POKENAME usually would be able to control any host's mind; however, they are not strong enough to fully take control of POKENAME due to its host's extreme simple-mindedness.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: POKENAME use their incisors to cut through even the densest roots. They cause damage to basements in the winter by burrowing through the walls, seeking heat.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME spend their entire lives underground unless a predator forces them out. They're highly sought after because of the rich variety of nutrients that they store in their bodies.
author: .realthree

entry: Though the mushrooms on POKENAME's back lack chlorophyll, they respond well to sunlight. The energy they produce put POKENAME into a happier mood.
author: .realthree

entry: The leaves growing from POKENAME's back are yellow and withered due to the mushrooms it hosts stealing all the nutrients from the plant.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME sleeps, the fungus takes control of the body and searches for food. In this way, POKENAME is able to constantly forage.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME spreads the spores of its parasitic tochukaso mushrooms to remotely absorb nutrients from its prey.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's mushroom half sometimes tries to walk in a separate direction. However, this lapse of control is only momentary.
author: .realthree

entry: The tochukaso mushrooms growing all over POKENAME prevent it from seeing anything at all. As a result, it relies purely on its other senses to detect foes. When all else fails in a situation, POKENAME explodes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME releases sticky spores from its acorn shell which are valuable for pharmaceutical purposes. The spores help people in physical therapy, as they aid in healing over scar tissue when ingested.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The ideal place for POKENAME is a place that is dark, moist, but also windy. The mushroom on its head grows and spreads its spores the most in these conditions. POKENAME itself is docile and typically remains still, hanging from tree branches.
author: bobosmith01

entry: People had seen POKENAME for a few years before fusion technology became commonplace, but they didn't realize it was fused with Paras.
author: .realthree

entry: The hard mushrooms on POKENAME's arms are tough as steel, as is the chitin covering its body. Be wary of its quick movements.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has heat resistant mushrooms growing from its body that release scorching spores. The burning sensation that results from touching the spores can only be removed with water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The puffball on POKENAME's back spews spores without warning. Its warm body heats the ground, which helps the spores take root.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a common sight in shallow wetlands. It stands in the water to moisturize the fungus it hosts while also hunting for Feebas.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME shakes its tail, it scatters spores that induce drowsiness, making it easy for it to swallow its prey whole.
author: .realthree

entry: When on a computer, POKENAME behaves in a curious manner, poking at anything it comes across. The objects it interacts with grow harmless digital fungi that pop when clicked on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases pink powder clouds during attacks. In Johto, pharmacists once used this powder in poultices to reduce inflammation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a cave dweller known to use primitive tools. Research into POKENAME is restricted as they will abandon their homes if they spot observers.
author: megaborb

entry: The head on top of POKENAME is fake: a distraction for avian predators. It uses its mushroom to stun its prey, then opens its real mouth to attack.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has soft, round mushrooms on its head. It's docile and unsuited for fighting, so it's a common sight around Pokémon Daycares.
author: .realthree

entry: All sorts of bacteria and other organisms can grow in POKENAME's milk, so it is not mass produced for human consumption. According to culinary enthusiasts, each POKENAME produces a slightly unique flavor of milk.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The milk produced by POKENAME is known for its rich umami flavor. A hearty stew uses this milk along with the mushrooms that grow on its back.
author: mepp.

entry: The brown mushrooms that grow on POKENAME's back are renowned for their meaty flavor. A popular stew uses these mushrooms along with the milk it produces.
author: mepp.

entry: The fungus that grows throughout POKENAME has become integrated with the Pokémon's nervous system. POKENAME can run incredibly quickly because of that, but at times it will take off running against its will.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon is riddled with parasitic mushrooms. It once protected the ocean, but now it spreads its spores among the ocean life.
author: themicelegion

entry: The rubbery mushrooms covering POKENAME inhibit its electrical abilities, and it has to exert more effort to produce the same charge.
author: .realthree

entry: The multicolored mushrooms of POKENAME are a rare sight. Stories cannot agree on whether it is benevolent or malicious.
author: .realthree

entry: The full glory of POKENAME is revealed when it spreads its prismatic spores. Humans showered by them are said to gain greater kinship with Paras.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME adore riding on their Trainers' heads or shoulders. When their spores are electrically charged, they convey a soothing feeling that can relieve tension or even put Pokémon to sleep.
author: .realthree

entry: The mycelium that grows throughout POKENAME's body is extremely conductive. Don't touch the mushrooms without proper safety equipment.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME relies on mycelium networks to orient itself, and that ability dissipates the farther it is from fungi. If it strays too far from its fungal brethren, it becomes confused and unable to focus.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME glides high in the sky, its wings release spores that propagate through the air, eventually reaching certain Bug-type Pokémon. They then grow into tochukaso mushrooms, repeating its parasitic spread cycle.
author: gaogao028

entry: POKENAME is a common sight in dry, sandy ground. It lives underground to avoid the harsh sunlight and creates many winding tunnels through the soil.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a very high-energy Pokémon, but it wears out if the mushrooms on its body are removed.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom on its rear is always surrounded by verdant foliage. More leaves grow every day, so Trainers of POKENAME need to weed it vigilantly.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms over POKENAME's hips are always encased in chunks of ice. The ice never melts, so small Pokémon flock to it in summer.
author: .realthree

entry: Certain parasitic fungi can infect consumer electronics. The resulting POKENAME is in a consistent conflicting state regarding which entity is in control.
author: entomoxie

entry: Certain parasitic fungi can infect consumer electronics. The resulting POKENAME is in a consistent conflicting state regarding which entity is in control.
author: entomoxie

entry: Certain parasitic fungi can infect consumer electronics. The resulting POKENAME is in a consistent conflicting state regarding which entity is in control.
author: entomoxie

entry: When POKENAME gets excited, it begins hopping around and making chittering noises. When POKENAME becomes startled, the mushroom on its head releases a large puff of spores that leave exposed skin with a burning rash.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is covered with so many mushrooms, it doesn't notice if a few go missing. These mushrooms are popular items to buy at farmers' markets.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME roves the land in search of decomposing plants, directed by the colony of mushrooms on its back. It burrows during the day to escape the sun.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME have poor eyesight and rely on their natural instincts to survive. Only coming out at night, POKENAME stab into trees using their claws and talons, then feast upon the fluids that flow from the bark.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME sweetly cries its own name to get attention. The mushrooms on POKENAME's head absorb the emotions of those who touch them, which they use for nutrients.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME form strong familial bonds with their partners and absorbs the emotions as nutrients. Their mushrooms are used as a medicine to treat anxiety, depression, stress, and anger.
author: laughing_dan

entry: Female POKENAME have smaller ears and a more aggressive demeanor. They exude a pleasant, woodsy smell when treated well.
author: .realthree

entry: The smooth, hard chitin covering POKENAME is surprisingly aerodynamic. It glides through the air, held aloft by its psychic power.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME senses aura through the mycelium on its head. In this way, it can anticipate attacks before they even begin.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME fiercely defends forest fungi from others with its impressive bite. It hoards the mushrooms for itself to consume, which feeds the one on its head and helps it grow larger and stronger.
author: sk372

entry: The tree growing on POKENAME's back has been surrounded by a dense field of mushrooms. The POKENAME will share its mushrooms freely if asked nicely.
author: soreile.arc

entry: The older a POKENAME gets, the less it needs to eat, as more and more of its energy is supplied by the fungus in its body.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME hides its upper body in foliage, making it appear to be a wounded Paras. When predators come near, it lashes out and grabs them with its tentacles, infesting them with fungus spores.
author: sk372

entry: A solid mushroom cap protects POKENAME's skull from damage when it headbutts others. The mushrooms growing on its back are similarly sturdy, and thus are completely inedible.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME collect various kinds of mushrooms from forests around them and plant them on their bodies. The Pokémon have been observed caring for and protecting the fungi as a parent would for their family.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME floats around the darkness at a very slow rate, seemingly oblivious to the world around it. The fungus in its hollow skull twitches in the direction of perceived life, shooting puffs of spores on instinct.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has no problem letting smaller Pokémon rest on its back for comfort or shade, but it isn't recommended. The large mushroom dispenses spores that will cause irritating fungal growths on those afflicted.
author: sk372

entry: Male POKENAME have larger ears and a more timid demeanor. They exude a pleasant, woodsy smell when treated well.
author: .realthree

entry: Finding solace in gazing northward, POKENAME are drawn together when they sense a strong electromagnetic pulse. If one stumbles upon a POKENAME gathering, they expel a huge spore cloud in unison to repel those who threaten their communal sightseeing.
author: npshi

entry: This mushroom species evolved to create corpses for it to feed on. It sheathes in the ground to hide its blade from oncoming victims.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's simple, diminutive design allows it to sheath in the ground and disguise as an ordinary mushroom while watching out with its eye.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has a poor long-term memory due to the fungus it hosts attempting to influence its behavior.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives in perfect symbiosis with the mushrooms growing on its body, using them as catalysts to store electricity for its sparking attacks. It is naturally shy and mostly nocturnal, but will fiercely defend its territory if threatened.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME produce hallucinogenic spores that cause anyone who inhales them to witness odd illusions and mirages. POKENAME can extend the strands from its head to intertwine with tree roots and absorb their nutrients.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: They use their ribbons to spread to the spores around as they walk. Their diet consists of mulch and compost soil.
author: melodydelune

entry: The mushroom growing in POKENAME sometimes prompts the Pokémon to attack wildly. When POKENAME regains control of itself, it seems confused as to what it was doing.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a tendency to follow strangers to its forest, looming over them soundlessly. Though it never breaks eye contact until the visitor leaves, it has never been observed causing any problems other than discomfort.
author: .realthree

entry: The nation that created POKENAME has long since vanished from the world. It offers red mushrooms to children in memory of its deceased friends.
author: .realthree

entry: Those who seek truth with all their heart are filled with blazing energy when they smell the scent exuded by POKENAME's massive mushrooms.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its immense strength to rip apart trees to eat. Most forests can't support a population of POKENAME larger than three or four individuals for long.
author: .realthree

entry: Though the mushrooms POKENAME hosts resemble the common tochukaso fungus, they recently were discovered to be of an entirely new variety.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME skips lightly over mountains and valleys, scattering glittery spores everywhere it goes.
author: .realthree

entry: The tochukaso mushrooms that grow from POKENAME's body grow to enormous sizes because of the Fairy-type energy that is so abundant in this species. You can tell if a POKENAME has passed through your house because of the mold spots it leaves behind.
author: .realthree

entry: Even during the day, POKENAME's mushroom glows abnormally bright to attract attention. Whoever eats it will feel an immense burning sensation in their stomach, attracting swarms of POKENAME that wait until the victim can't move any more.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Its face appears panicked, which mistakenly leads to getting doused. POKENAME doesn't like that very much.
author: .realthree

entry: At times, its body twitches in sync with at least one of its parasitic mushrooms. If anything tries to touch these mushrooms, it will lash out with its axe-like tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: The mushrooms that POKENAME hosts don't match the molecular structure of any other known fungus variety. Mycologists are looking into the possibility that the unique fungus could originate from a distant planet.
author: .realthree

entry: A POKENAME is compelled to shed its spores on other living things. Trainers who raise this Pokémon often end up infested with the fungus themselves.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom's nature seems to have been transformed through fusion, and the orange substance now oozing from its body should not be touched. It aimlessly attacks everything around it, having long lost its mind to its infection.
author: fireblade141

entry: If POKENAME spreads its spores over someone, it can communicate telepathically with that person. It's extremely sensitive to others' emotions, though, so it typically hides in forests instead.
author: .realthree

entry: Out of the nine mushrooms that grow on POKENAME's body, only one is safe to eat. The other eight mushrooms inflict varying side effects on anybody who touches them.
author: .realthree

entry: A Pokémon that scuttles about, ready to attack anything it sees. Its bite spreads a fungal infection that consumes the minds of its prey.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME uses the network of mycelium in the ground to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms on its back exhibit a different parasitism than the norm. The mind seems unaffected, but the nutrients drained from the body leave POKENAME perpetually lethargic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are playful creatures that enjoy giving out mushrooms to Pokémon and Trainers. These mushrooms burst to life when POKENAME send shockwaves through the mycelium network, causing nearby mushrooms to produce an electrical charge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Anyone who touches a POKENAME's tails is cursed to become infected with the fungus that grows on the Pokémon. Though this infection usually only resembles a head cold, some people have reported changes in their behavior as well.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's song has a strange, warbling quality to it, as the fungus inhabiting it affects its vocal cords.
author: .realthree

entry: Though the mushrooms growing on POKENAME appear normal, they are actually metallic and just as sturdy as its armor. Very few Pokémon have teeth strong enough to eat them, and even then the fungi are bland and tasteless.
author: sk372

entry: When fused with a Klink, the Paras seems to be less directly influenced by the invasive mushroom. However, even with this separation, the mushroom's gears are shaped to fit with the grooves in the bug's gears, and a mycelial cord keeps them together.
author: entomoxie

entry: When fused with a Klink, the Paras seems to be less directly influenced by the invasive mushroom. However, even with this separation, the mushroom's gears are shaped to fit with the grooves in the bug's gears, and a mycelial cord keeps them together.
author: entomoxie

entry: The mushroom that POKENAME holds amplifies its singing's volume. Without it, POKENAME's songs aren't able to be much help in a battle.
author: .realthree

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back is withered from the excessive nutrients that the tochukaso fungus draws from it. All the petals have fallen off by the time a POKENAME reaches maturity.
author: .realthree

entry: The result of a Charmander being infected with the tochukaso mushroom. The mushroom, meanwhile, protects its host from water.
author: zedsmith64

entry: As the mushroom grows in size and its mycelium spreads more, POKENAME becomes less active. It sits near a pond in a forest or cave and emits a quiet humming sound to attract Pokémon near enough to hit with a Spore attack and consume.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mushroom growing from the top of POKENAME's leafy head is used in a spicy stew, first conceptualized in the Kanto region. It is cheap to make and quick to regrow if spores are left behind, making it a sustainable ingredient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that drink lots of rosewater grow quickly. The bigger its mushroom grows, the more its leaves wither.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME hides in the canopy of trees and dangles a lure to the ground below. Unsuspecting Pokémon that grab it are whisked up above to be infected by POKENAME's spores.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME defends itself by unfurling its mushroom-capped ears to hit foes with. Spores release on impact that leave the spot hit with a nasty and painful rash.
author: sk372

entry: The mushroom extends up when POKENAME tries to spread its yellow spores. These spores can cause vomiting when inhaled, a useful defensive mechanism against intruders.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME is believed by many to be a pre-evolved form of Paras, it has never been observed evolving into that Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: Its small, fungal brain is filled with hopes and dreams for the future. Once its gel expands, it will be strong enough to explore the world.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has hundreds of different types of fungus growing on its body, all of them varying in toxicity and side-effects. It nibbles on large leaves, often leaving small bits of its colony behind.
author: mistymagius

entry: Be wary of mushrooms in the desert. They're usually attached to a hungry POKENAME lying in wait under the sand.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is constantly shedding its exoskeleton to stay healthy. If it didn't do this, the mushroom that keeps it airborne would consume it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME fights for control over itself. When the mushroom hijacks its brain, it ceases weeping and burrows into damp soil. This can last for hours.
author: .realthree

entry: Many assume the mushrooms on POKENAME are parasitic. However, research has revealed they are used to acquire more energy from the electricity it eats.
author: kitarchen

entry: It is surprisingly docile in nature. When POKENAME's brain activity slows down, it's about to evolve: its organs are being used for their nutrients, which the fungi uses to grow along with evolution process.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are fairly docile Pokémon that hone their tusks on trees, which also allows them to feed on the sap within. Their bodies grow slower than their mushrooms, despite how much they consume.
author: infinex21

entry: Old civilizations used POKENAME to assist in foraging. It has an innate sense of what mushrooms are safe for humans to touch and eat, helping gatherers avoid nasty poisoning debacles.
author: sk372

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body are extremely spicy. They are sliced finely when served. Even a small nibble can leave a lasting pain, making them a potent deterrent for any predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have developed large eyes to help them navigate in low-light conditions. Hikers in caves find them to be a nuisance, as the Pokémon swoop and bite at anything that walks by.
author: .realthree

entry: The membrane on a POKENAME's wings is actually formed of a fungus's fruiting body. If the fungus doesn't have enough moisture, POKENAME develops holes in its wings that prevent it from flying.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's pupils are too small to be seen by casual observation. Though practically blind, the spores it drops help it sense the shape of the air.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a common pest in gardens, but people have a hard time chasing it away due to its endearing, pleading gaze.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's legs are too short to run quickly, so it grabs its mushroom and rolls. It leaves a cloud of spores in its wake.
author: .realthree

entry: Riding POKENAME as a transportation method is growing in popularity. The mushrooms on its side extend to hold the rider safely in place.
author: .realthree

entry: Research indicates that the mushrooms controlling POKENAME have mutated to survive extreme sub-zero temperatures. Cracks in the host's icy shell release a chilling vapor, spreading spores to the surrounding area.
author: the_lunarian

entry: POKENAME stays buried in the ground during the day, but it will attack if anyone touches its mushrooms.
author: .realthree

entry: When a POKENAME's feather falls naturally, its calamus secretes a deadly poison. When boiled in salt water, however, it turns into a creamy sauce often served with mushrooms.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME waves and shakes its mushrooms in an energetic dance to scatter spores. It feeds upon a specific flower's nectar.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME sways its body side to side to mix the substances in its stomach. This creates a vile poison, which it stores for use in battle.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Spores creep across POKENAME's body and are said to be quite tasty. They grow more pungent when POKENAME is poisoned or paralyzed, especially during dancing.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Lost children in the forest who consume deadly mushrooms are transformed into POKENAME. They are often found in the company of regular Phantump.
author: .realthree

entry: When it stands perfectly still, it can be mistaken for a decaying tree. POKENAME has an eerie face but a kind heart.
author: .realthree

entry: Each of POKENAME's mushrooms eject spores of a different color. It can cause drowsiness, poisoning, or paralysis as it wishes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME spreads a red spore across cave floors to cause mushrooms to grow. This unique ability helps its environment flourish even if plants cannot survive.
author: .izik

entry: A vacant stare graces this Pokémon's face. It could look serious if it wanted to, but it's more comfortable this way.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME each house a unique brain, all of which vie for control over POKENAME. This makes its movements appear to be both erratic and sluggish. If a mushroom isn't able to take control for a few days, it will wither and fall off.
author: laughing_dan

entry: The mushrooms encased in its icy body will never spread their spores, so it's a mystery as to how it reproduces.
author: .realthree

entry: The pale mushroom that surrounds POKENAME contains incredibly hard alloys. This Pokémon is rare, though, so the exact mixture of metals is unknown.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives deep within humid jungles. It rarely sees humans, so it has no fear towards them.
author: .realthree

entry: Massive mushrooms grow across POKENAME's body, requiring equally massive amounts of sunlight to sustain themselves. If even a small part of POKENAME's body lacks direct light, the fungi quickly begin to dry and shrivel.
author: sk372

entry: Soft and squishy, POKENAME is a popular pet. It's actually quadrupedal, as the four back legs are fused into two.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lands on stones near the ocean, waiting motionlessly and using its mycelium roots to snare prey like Wimpod. The roots are extremely sticky and poisonous to the touch.
author: .izik

entry: When night falls, POKENAME uses its large arms to seal the opening in its mushroom, encasing itself in the dome as protection from hungry predators.
author: .realthree

entry: A swishing sound can be heard as POKENAME scuttles through the sands. The water stored in its body slowly feeds the mushroom on its head.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME screams endlessly, distressed by the sudden appearance of a mushroom on its head. It makes too much of a fuss to remove the mushroom safely.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME make their homes along rotting stumps in forest clearings. Their predator-deterring spores fill the air there, making a safe space for mushroom Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: When the bug and mushroom of a Paras coexist in perfect balance, it grows to large sizes. It grows quickly as a result of the mycelium in its brain.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's mushrooms appear ordinary during the day, but at night they glow a shimmering rainbow of colors. Consumption of the mushrooms is discouraged, as they are highly hallucinogenic.
author: sk372

entry: The fur poking out from between the plates of POKENAME's exoskeleton is loaded with spores. Its lithe legs are well suited to sprinting.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is famous for being particularly aggressive despite its small size. Writings from ancient Hisui confirm that this pattern of behavior has remained unchanged for centuries.
author: .realthree

entry: When the bug and mushroom of a Paras coexist in perfect balance, it grows to large sizes. This one has a rare coloration.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has the strength of mind to control the fungus it hosts. It lives a happy life and works to take care of the tochukaso fungus.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME spreads spores throughout cave systems with great care to plant fungus. It is skittish and will flee quickly if exposed to light, preferring the safety of the shadows.
author: .izik

entry: The lush greenery growing around POKENAME's head cradles the mushrooms sprouting from its chitinous exoskeleton. The leaves help hold moisture in and cover the younger, more tender fruiting bodies.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms growing from POKENAME's back are responsible for absorbing moisture from the air. These fungi are difficult to care for, and POKENAME will develop dry skin if they are not treated properly.
author: .realthree

entry: Though the mushroom inhabiting POKENAME's body lives in such an advanced stage of growth, the Pokémon maintains complete control over itself. POKENAME from humid forests are known to be particularly friendly and gentle towards humans.
author: .realthree

entry: A separate pair of mushrooms have sprouted and siphon nutrients from the main fungus. This saps some of its hold on the host's mind, letting POKENAME live a more normal existence.
author: sk372

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's back is so heavy that POKENAME sometimes struggles to breathe under the weight. Trainers are advised to allow frequent breaks for this Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is covered by a thick layer of spores. It leaves a powdery trail wherever it goes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME plants mushrooms throughout its cave home. The mushrooms are edible and taste like pumpkin pie, making it a comfortable home for the resident Pokémon and a delicious environment to grow food.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME bears many visual similarities with Venonat at first glance, specimens that have been shaved were discovered to be nearly identical to Paras.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's sunset-colored wings are a common sight in autumn. They can be found clinging to trees and chewing on the bark.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME hops about in its sack-like mushroom, scattering spores as it goes. Because its arms are too crippled and weak from being parasitized by the fungus, its most effective attack involves swinging its head at its foes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME carefully cultivates the mushrooms that grow within its territory. If anyone damages these fungi, POKENAME rushes over with a large horde of other Pokémon to beat up the trespasser.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives in damp environments so that its mushroom can stay sticky. It generates a water-based solvent to trap decaying plant matter and small prey which it and its parasitic fungus feast upon.
author: .realthree

entry: Although its tochukaso mushroom is yet to fully mature, it has covered POKENAME's eyes. In place of regular vision, it uses flaming spores to see.
author: zedsmith64

entry: The mushroom that regulates POKENAME body temperature doesn't work well while covered by dirt, so POKENAME frequently pops its head out of the soil to cool down.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's insatiable appetite is spurred by the fungus inhabiting it. As more and more of its nutrients are siphoned away, POKENAME will devour entire plots in domestic gardens as it tries to keep itself going.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's two mushrooms mimic its head to confuse predators. POKENAME is only found in moist soil, and long droughts can lead to large migrations.
author: .realthree

entry: Plastic POKENAME are sometimes set up in gardens because people enjoy their smiling faces. However, real POKENAME are somewhat aggressive and will attack those that intrude upon their caves.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is drawn to shiny objects. This is because the fungus it hosts compels it to seek out potential Bug-type Pokémon to infect.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's brain and body are partially controlled by the parasitic mushrooms on its head. POKENAME meditates to get in touch with the parasite, gradually learning to exist in tandem.
author: hophoppip

entry: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME dull any pain it feels, so it is ferocious in hunting and battling.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is infected with a fungus that dulls any pain the Pokémon feels, so it is ferocious in hunting and battling.
author: .realthree

entry: The delicate points on the ends of POKENAME's legs reduce traction as the Pokémon runs. If POKENAME doesn't hunt enough food for itself, the fungus it hosts will start robbing energy from its muscles.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom infecting POKENAME gives it an awful headache, as the mycelium is growing into its brain.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have a mushroom on their head that glows whenever they harness psychic powers. They enjoy swimming in shallow water because it hydrates and cools their dry skin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mushrooms that grow from POKENAME's back are delicious and filled with protein. Because POKENAME freely shares these fast-growing fungi with everyone around it, this species has few real predators.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME floats around in damp and dark areas and consumes organic plant matter. Either the Pokémon or the mushrooms that infest it tend to grow poorly, as POKENAME usually just can't get enough energy to compensate for its immature and growing body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is found at the tops of trees in dense forests. It strengthens itself by expelling spores that cause blinding rage.
author: .realthree

entry: If you encounter a POKENAME while travelling through the jungle, avert your eyes. It claws ferociously at anyone who makes eye contact with it.
author: .realthree

entry: If you encounter a POKENAME while travelling through the jungle, avert your eyes. It claws ferociously at anyone who makes eye contact with it.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms infecting POKENAME's brain have grown into its eyes, which gives it tunnel vision. When it starts raging, it can't see anything to either side of it, giving its opponents the opportunity to blindside it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME needs dark spaces for the mushrooms on to grow healthily. Those who keep it as a pet find that it spends all its time under couches and beds.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushrooms covering POKENAME are covered with a thin, hair-like substance that combusts easily.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's tail flame keeps the immature tochukaso mushrooms at bay. It can even use the spores from the mushroom on its back as fuel to fly.
author: zedsmith64

entry: POKENAME only lives in stagnant water. It relies on heavy rain to be able to spread its spores further.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME only lives in stagnant water. It relies on heavy rain to be able to spread its spores further.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives peacefully in shallow waters for most of its day, but if a threat approaches, the mushrooms growing at the ends of POKENAME's arms pull it out of the water to pummel the would-be attacker senseless.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME seems driven to combat any and all that cross its path. It lashes out with powerful punches, each strike releasing countless infectious spores from the mushrooms that make up its fists.
author: sk372

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME stimulates its brain, allowing it to remain awake for 23 hours a day. It spends its time practicing its psychic powers.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom it holds spreads highly soporific spores when shaken. As its target becomes drowsy, POKENAME uses this lull in mental defenses to begin siphoning intelligence from the victim's mind.
author: sk372

entry: Having reached the pinnacle of intellect, POKENAME no longer needs to drain the minds of other beings. Yet it continues to do so, as the act itself has become an addictive thrill it cannot resist.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's muscles are strengthened by the mycelium binding them. When not fighting, it stands peacefully in humid forests to absorb the moisture.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME maintain their physique through a strict diet of tempura and rice. There exist tales where POKENAME turn people into tempura through their spores.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The large shelf mushroom growing on POKENAME's head obstructs its view, but it also scatters spores that cause its punches to be toxic to others.
author: .realthree

entry: The fungus in POKENAME's stem-like body is rubbery and increases POKENAME's flexibility. It is a popular choice of prey for larger Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: A complex slime mold grows over POKENAME's skin. Though the pattern it forms unnerves some people, the slime mold has a mutualistic relationship with its host and helps POKENAME absorb moisture from the air.
author: .realthree

entry: The DNA from Paras is stored in the mushrooms on POKENAME's body. The purer the water that POKENAME drinks, the faster the fungus spreads.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME don't grow that much after they are born, as 90 percent of its energy goes into feeding the mushroom on its head. It bites its prey with its hollow fangs, slowly draining them of their nutrients.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is believed to have some distant connection to Toedscool, but this is still unproven.
author: .realthree

entry: The large mushrooms on POKENAME's head attach directly to its brain. It buries the ends of its many arms into the soil to absorb nutrients for them.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses loud cries to communicate with others of its kind on distant slopes. When nearby, they are silent, using mycelium to communicate.
author: .realthree

entry: The heat-resistant properties of POKENAME's mushrooms are being studied in the hopes of making fireproof clothing.
author: .realthree

entry: As POKENAME travel, they scatter spores from the mushrooms on their body. These same mushrooms are also edible and are sought after for their strong, savory, and spicy flavor, often described as getting kicked by a POKENAME.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME moves very slowly, as the fungus inhabiting it steals all of its energy for its growth.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are semi-aquatic Pokémon that spend the hottest part of the day underwater. Once the sun is no longer at its zenith, they climb out of the water to feed on tree roots.
author: .realthree

entry: As the fungus spreads through POKENAME's body, it alters its skin to become hard and chitinous.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon is said to be controlled by the fungus growing on its tail. It's often seen scouring forests, seeking wild Caterpie to feast on.
author: akujules

entry: POKENAME scatters ferrous spores. It uses its magnetism to push against these spores to levitate.
author: .realthree

entry: Between the network of mycelium it spreads, its electromagnetic sense, and its three eyes, this Pokémon is impossible to surprise.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME always carries a mushroom with it. Because the mushroom decomposes quickly, it's always on the hunt for a new one.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are known for their gentle demeanor. The specialized tubes that produce its spores are so numerous, they appear as feathers.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its large claws to pull itself out of the ocean and onto large chunks of ice and snow.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is actually a symbiotic relationship between a predatory bug and a living pile of sludge. The sludge shelters the bug, and the bug shares its prey with the sludge.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME produces spores that infect the water it shoots. People and Pokémon alike have gotten ill from drinking the water it produces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is impossible to get POKENAME's shell open, as it is held together by strong filaments of mycelium.
author: .realthree

entry: The algae that gathers between POKENAME's layered shells decomposes and becomes food for the fungus living in it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME expels spores to travel through the air. The mushroom covering it is thin, but the exoskeleton just beneath is durable.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives in abandoned houses, as it feeds on damp drywall and rotting boards. It dislikes noise, so it is uncommon in occupied houses.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a tendency to puff out spores that are capable of deteriorating one's mind. However, it seems to be blissfully unaware of this habit.
author: 8xviktor

entry: If a POKENAME gets into a garden, the tunnels it digs cause the plants to wither, as they are filled with spores of a parasitic fungus.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME waves its claws through the air, it is trying to sense the location of sleeping minds. It scatters spores on those it finds asleep.
author: .realthree

entry: The mushroom on the end of its string has a delicious scent, which it uses to lure small Pokémon away to eat.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are highly playful Pokémon, frequently sighted on beaches that children often visit. They will assist in building sand castles on the beaches where they reside, allowing children to use the tools on their heads and backs.
author: cloudmaker2169

entry: POKENAME lies in wait at beaches with its shovel sticking up out of the sand. If an unsuspecting passerby disturbs the shovel, it explodes in a shower of sand and sparks.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME uses its shovel to help dig and form intricate sand sculptures on beaches it calls home. The sculptures most commonly depict happy Pokémon playing together with their young. It gazes at its creation longingly when finished.
author: sk372

entry: Within the sandy bodies of POKENAME are yet unknown bones, the sight of which seems to fill them with remorse and causes them to cry. They fight with toy shovels often used by children, and lash out at those who touch the shovels or the bones.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have dyed sand in their wings thanks to a contrived effort from filmmakers to enhance shots of POKENAME. They are more likely to be spotted by predators because of their dyed wings, leading to a recent decrease in the population.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often charge foes recklessly. This can cause it to lose parts of its body, requiring it to then wait for the sand to re-form.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are incredibly friendly Pokémon that will play with anyone they meet, sometimes even trying to play with those who simply want to leave. They regularly let their playmates mold and decorate much of their sandy bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's cellular structure resists being washed away by water. It will always maintain tiny castle shapes and some shells when it transforms.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its sandy mane and releases it in powerful bursts. When its lightning strikes the ground, it forms fragile fulgurite spikes that it uses to mark and defend its den.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Ancient civilizations used POKENAME to store and retrieve schematics for building temples on the sand. The method for doing so has been lost to time.
author: floweronbread

entry: POKENAME takes on the shape of what appears to be an ancient temple of some kind. It will collect any valuables it finds while roaming along beaches by incorporating them into its body, and may sometimes offer these trinkets to those it bonds with.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME takes on the shape of what appears to be an ancient temple of some kind. Its shape has been deemed too specific to just be random, but as of yet, no one has found a real structure that resembles it.
author: fireblade141

entry: It decorates itself with shells and trinkets it collects on the beach. It occasionally approaches children with beach toys and beautiful seashells.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME forms a Pokémon resembling Beedrill out of sand to ward off all but the strongest flying Pokémon. It often clashes with Noivern at night.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing scent that calms Pokémon and revives plants. It's gentler than most Palossand fusions.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: The heat emitting from its back has turned part of its sandy body into sharp glass spikes. If a POKENAME's spikes break while it's too tired to produce more heat, it may cover its back in beach glass or broken pieces of seashells.
author: hophoppip

entry: The sandy body of POKENAME is constantly being shed and reformed. If another Pokémon comes into contact with the loose grains, they will be paralysed for up to 4 hours.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME scours beaches for shiny and unique trinkets to decorate its body and impress other POKENAME. Trainers will search for specimens that have incorporated fossils, evolution stones, and other rare items.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME like to hide under the sand on public beaches, stealing snacks from others before scampering away to their nest. There have been reports of POKENAME attempting to hunt other Pokémon by dragging them into the sand, to serve as a future meal.
author: npshi

entry: Deserts and beaches are its home. POKENAME conceals itself amidst the sand and devours any prey that wanders above it.
author: tentacole

entry: POKENAME likes to feed on sand as it enjoys the various kinds of minerals this provides. Additionally, this Pokémon can change the color of its glass-like body by consuming different oxides, though this effect only lasts a few hours.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME seek out old shells on the beach, using them as shelter to withdraw into when spooked. They are able to launch their shovels as projectile weapons, spearing them into their foes if they aren't left alone after hiding away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME claim abandoned shells as their own, hiding their sandy bodies within them. They are defensive of their new homes, attacking those who would damage their shell with powerful Shadow Balls.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A POKENAME can grow in size by actively melting any sand it moves on and incorporating it into its body. Should anyone ever break a POKENAME's brittle shell, it will immediately viciously attack the one responsible with burning hot sand and glass.
author: _pixelar_

entry: What looks like a large egg in a nest is actually POKENAME's palace. Inside are the bones of its prey, which it captures using its agile neck and large beak.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME scours beaches, using its shovel-like tusks to sift through the sand and devour any unfortunate smaller Pokémon it encounters.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A popular theory claims that POKENAME were once kings of the beach. They were since overthrown by Water types, and seek vengeance to this day.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Swiftly dashing across beaches, POKENAME picks up trash and other debris, leaving a pristine shoreline. It is known to collaborate with clean-up crews, stopping briefly to bow in thanks.
author: pattybgoode

entry: It lures prey by mimicking a Pikachu in need of help. Once the victim gets too close, POKENAME pulls them down and traps them beneath the sand.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME is the undisputed champion of sandcastle building. This may or may not be due to it sabotaging the other sandcastles every competition.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME plays with small children on beaches by allowing them to manipulate its sand into whatever shape they wish. Once they've given it a form, it does a funny dance to amuse them before shifting back and starting the game over.
author: sk372

entry: The leafy parts of POKENAME's body emit a salty smell loved by beach-dwelling Pokémon. If it gets too crowded for POKENAME's tastes, it slings out sharpened leaves made out of densely-compacted sand to disperse the crowd.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found in mudflats, waiting to eat unobservant prey like Krabby or tidal flotsam such as seaweed. If its sandy body becomes too waterlogged from the tide, it may harden and break apart, resulting in Sandykips forming.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If a beach has a POKENAME, it's encouraged to keep an eye on your valuables. POKENAME will add anything it finds to its collection of stolen beach goods.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME produce entrancing cries from the shores of beaches, luring those that hear towards them. Some regions had to relocate them due to problems with Sailors hearing them.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME's rocky body produces swirling mounds of sand to attack its foes. It practices controlling this sand at night, during which some claim the sound of a thousand voices can be heard.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often found roaming beaches, parading about the sand castle on its back. If someone alters the castle in a way POKENAME does not like, they will lie immobile atop the person until they have absorbed their life force.
author: cloudmaker2169

entry: POKENAME can extend their heads incredibly far from their bodies by forming long necks out of sand. They use this technique to ambush and drain the vitality of unsuspecting beach prey.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME, unlike Palossand, are quite gentle and caring creatures. They allow smaller Pokémon seeking shelter from Wingull, such as Dwebble and Joltik, to hide in their mouths. Their diet consists solely of seawater, which fortifies their bodies.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME lazes about on beaches, remaining so still and often half-buried that sometimes it is mistaken for an ordinary mound of sand. However, it will instantly lash out at anything that gets too close.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is known as the defender of sand castles made by children. It believes that only the sea has the right to claim the shape of art made of sand – those sacrilegious enough to destroy it while POKENAME is near will soon live to regret it.
author: epping_forest

entry: If the large shell that forms its nose cracks, POKENAME endlessly drains large-shelled prey until it finds a suitable replacement. Smaller shelled prey it doesn't want to drain instead are controlled and used as its pawns.
author: soup1900

entry: As it becomes a more experienced battler, POKENAME collects more and more trophies and displays them proudly on its body. These treasures can range from seashells to the fur of Pokémon they have defeated.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It tunnels through the seafloor in search of minerals. When it uses its psychically active horns, metallic gnashing resonates through the ocean.
author: takopus

entry: POKENAME is made of a special type of sand that wicks moisture from the ground into its body. Excess water is solidified into reflective scales that shield it from attacking Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its ribbons extend throughout much of its body, supposedly holding itself together. Some believe that it exudes a curse-like aura that compels others to play with it and to decorate its sandy body.
author: infinex21

entry: After spending years building its sand tower, POKENAME will protect it with immense fury. Inside the tower are the bones of those who have tried to take its home.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The granules comprising POKENAME's body have been nicknamed the Sands of Time due to its power. It can whip up a whirlwind of sand that ages or de-ages whatever it surrounds.
author: sk372

entry: The intense spectral flames within POKENAME's body have fused portions of its sandy form into glass. This unique body shape has allowed POKENAME to shine from across great distances, cutting through even the darkest nights.
author: rakunk

entry: Wild POKENAME will lounge along beaches, unfazed by any children or other Pokémon that may step upon their sandy bodies. They wear the shovels of their friends and wield them like weapons to defend those they care for.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carries a variety of shovels on its bucket handle, making it a handy Pokémon to have around for digging. These collected shovels are used to bury the discarded bones of victims it has absorbed.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are unstable, the brainless heads on its arms pulling around so much that it can damage its delicate sand body. To counter this, POKENAME have found a way to carry water around with them, which hardens up their body.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME has evolved to tempt travelers to follow it by preying on their greed. It leaves a glittering trail with the tiny floating gems formed within its bubble and those who chase this trail are lured deeper into the dunes, never to return.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME enjoys draining the fun from beach goers by taking their beach supplies. It despises poorly-made sand castles and is the king of the beach.
author: pankiwi

entry: Drifting from shore to shore with the tides, POKENAME seeks to clear humans away from beaches in hopes of preserving the environment. It is believed that the increase in POKENAME sightings is a result of melting icebergs.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When POKENAME dances and raises its wings, sand pours down in waves. These performances often cause mass desertification, blocking water from reaching the soil and robbing it of vital nutrients.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's gentle swaying lures prey into a false sense of security. While its prey is distracted, POKENAME creeps closer before swiftly enveloping them with its body.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are usually children who have died due to quicksand. They are said to purposely create sand traps so more humans can suffer with them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME likes to help its Trainer make sandcastles. Hugs from this Pokémon leave the Trainer covered with sticky sand.
author: supyovalk

entry: POKENAME loves watching the ocean waves while resting its sandy body on the beach. Its magnificent multicolored petals act as a parasol, shielding it from the sun.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are said to be culminations of the spirits of marooned sailors and pirates abandoned at sea. It's estimated that POKENAME are made up of over a thousand of these souls.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: POKENAME loves watching the ocean waves while resting its sandy body on the beach. Its magnificent multicolored petals act as a parasol, shielding it from the sun.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing with children, building small sand forts together with buckets and shovels. If it sweats under the sun, it emits a foul odor, so it always stays in the shade.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It enjoys playing with children, building small sand forts together with buckets and shovels. If POKENAME sweats under the sun, it emits a foul odor, so it always stays in the shade.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has controlled the population of an entire beach to erect itself as a grand citadel. From here, it enacts its evil whims on the mainland.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME loves to dig holes in sandy beaches. When it finds a shell, rock, or piece of trash that it likes, it will add the treasure to its fluffy collar of fur, wagging its tail with pride.
author: mochauspocus

entry: Whenever POKENAME sing, the sand around them resonates with the sound waves they produce to form unique patterns. Each song produces a unique pattern that shifts as the song progresses.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite appearances, the sandy scales of POKENAME are hard as a rock with seashells to reinforce them. It uses left behind items from the beach to create long, flowing strands that clang together as it moves around.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Supposedly, within the large pail it wears is a complex network of mycelia that hold together its sand-like body. If the pail is ever touched, even by its Trainer, it will lash out.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is very protective of the sand castles on its body. If anyone dares to destroy its castles, POKENAME's sand becomes scorching hot with anger. It's rare for the offenders to ever be seen again after facing POKENAME's wrath.
author: te4mst4r.boris

entry: POKENAME are incredibly combative should two of them meet in the wild. They strike at each other with the spades on their tails or by chucking heated sand at the other until one is forced to yield and retreat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's rain clouds drip wet sand onto the ground. It can conjure a large number of rain clouds above an enemy to bury them in sand.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are often found on the beaches of volcanic islands. They will hide in the sand, their mouth agape, biting anyone who is foolish enough to come close.
author: cloudmaker2169

entry: The sight of POKENAME represents good prosperity and luck, especially at sundown on the tides. Gripped in its mighty hands is a sack filled to the brim with fine particles of gold, though stealing even a speck of it will drain all your fortune.
author: tamszen.ore

entry: Found mostly at beach-side holiday resorts, POKENAME love to impersonate sand sculptures during sand castle competitions. They're too vain and proud of their build to maintain their charade for long and will often show off to beachgoers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lies inert in the sands, hiding its tentacles underground to maintain the illusion of being a simple sandcastle. Once prey steps near, numerous thorny limbs lash out and drag it into its hungry mouth.
author: sk372

entry: Retracting its head and limbs into its body lets POKENAME mimic a normal sandcastle at the beach. Those who try to damage the structure are in for a rude awakening when POKENAME rises up fully.
author: sk372

entry: Many POKENAME were thought to be kelpies when they were first discovered. However, when the first POKENAME was caught, it was so temperamental it refused to leave the beach it came from.
author: jojojax164

entry: Residing only on sandy beaches, POKENAME is highly sensitive to moisture. POKENAME will often migrate depending on the tide to maintain an optimal level of moisture.
author: northkira

entry: POKENAME loves to stash magnetic items underneath the sand, often stealing valuable items for passing beachgoers. The powerful magnetic field it creates causes the surrounding sand to vibrate.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has the ability to preserve and solidify cartilage with its saliva. However, said saliva also makes it constantly hungry.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME enjoys napping in cool areas with lots of sunlight, the ice crystal on its back glimmering brightly as it absorbs the light. Some Ice-type Pokémon enjoy licking the crystal, finding the taste sweet and appealing, much to POKENAME's chagrin.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon explodes into freezing ice particles. When POKENAME explodes, the surrounding area will become completely frozen.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME was restored from a piece of shrapnel that had been frozen for millions of years. Whether or not the explosion that shattered it was the same that created its icy burial remains unknown.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME wields a weapon made out of glacial ice. It sharpens the object with the skull on its head until it's as sharp as an icicle.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME wear skulls and wield bone clubs, each made of solid ice and shaped into skeletal remnants to intimidate others. At night, these constructs of ice shimmer with auroral lights.
author: infinex21

entry: Its face is permanently smiling regardless of its emotions. There is a group of fanatics that believe a frowning POKENAME will bring good luck.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flutters around colder regions in the early hours of the morning. Its wings spread a very colorful pollen that causes severe muscle weakness if exposed to large amounts.
author: sk372

entry: Due to rising global temperatures, POKENAME's transformations will slowly start to melt away and become deformed. As this melting damages its cellular structure, it rarely transforms, and if it does, only for a very brief moment.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME peaceful creatures and have few known predators in part due to their happy disposition. However, their unstable DNA has made the identification and restoration of fossils of these Pokémon extremely difficult.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It nests on snowy peaks where it's much too frigid for most. The sight of POKENAME's iridescent wings is occasionally reported by mountain climbers.
author: carameldog

entry: They live reclusively within frigid cold areas, able to veil themselves with a cold mist released from their small crystals. Their shed scales are cold to the touch and shimmer like auroras when struck by light.
author: infinex21

entry: Its crystalline orbs are colder than solid ice and glow with shimmering light akin to an aurora. When it cries out, it releases a frigid veil of mist that deters most others.
author: infinex21

entry: They live in small herds upon tall hills and mountains clad in cold weather. When an aurora shines in the sky, they take to the air and fly as if riding upon the lights themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: It refuses to eat any food that is not frozen. Should it find a meal, it will use its icy breath to freeze the meal in preparation for consumption.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys crushing large chunks of ice with its jaws. This behaviour also clears waterways for other Pokémon.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME are not used to living with aggressive or territorial Pokémon, so they resort to hiding in grasses to avoid conflict and foraging for food.
author: goldegummybear

entry: POKENAME struggles to control its icy attacks. Though it's a popular choice for cuteness contests, some critics believe it's detrimental to POKENAME's well-being.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: On cold winter nights, POKENAME can be seen in the trees staring up into the night sky. When the northern lights appear in the sky, a latent psychic power awakens within POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dislikes conflict but will protect itself fiercely as its confidence and strength have grown much in comparison to its previous evolution.
author: goldegummybear

entry: This Pokémon uses its fossilized tail as a weapon. However, due to the weight, POKENAME cannot swim.
author: monoski1

entry: The existence of POKENAME was long debated, as it was used to explain the movement of certain sediments from marshes to mountaintops. The confirmation of its existence sent a shockwave through the scientific world, validating years of research.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Flocks of POKENAME make home in crystalized caves. Their nests are regularly filled with gems that they gather during their migration.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME attempted to steal eggs from unguarded nests, but often got caught due to the bright colors emitted by its sails.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Hikers enjoy having POKENAME as a hiking partner, as their restless spirit inspires people to continue on for an extra mile. They encourage people to follow them up to the summit of mountains, eager to help people achieve great feats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While the core of POKENAME's shell reaches molten temperatures, the outside of its liquid body is cool to the touch. The rapid cooling sometimes creates an effect similar to an aurora around this Pokémon.
author: notadoctor75

entry: Its roars have the ability to cause massive snow storms. The severity of the storm is based on how angry it is.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live their lives happily in frigid tundras, playing in the snow. They have an odd fascination with star-shaped leaves.
author: pankiwi

entry: Many scientists were shocked to find that POKENAME have colorful feathers, as there is nothing in the fossil record that indicates they would have such vibrant feathers. Nowadays, they soar through the endless sky as they once did ages ago.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travels in and out of this timeline, leaving auroras in its wake as it passes through the ages. Although POKENAME no doubt has ancient power and knowledge that humans have yet to uncover, it seems uninterested in sharing these assets.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although POKENAME are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big fossil on its tail and try to smash its opponents.
author: monoski1

entry: POKENAME dislikes having others touch its hair, throwing tantrums if it gets tussled. This is because if it isn't properly kept, it disrupts its ability to generate pretty auroras from its hair.
author: sk372

entry: Using the high electrical voltages within its auroras, POKENAME can incapacitate an entire group of predators. It is used by Researchers in determining how auroras can be utilized as a new source of electricity.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are desert Pokémon that are primarily active at night, not for the darkness but for the lower temperatures. They are inherently curious and will approach others, though if they feel threatened they will curl up into balls.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME burrow into the ground with their icy claws to make a safe place to store food. When they are not gathering food, they wander the snowy forests they live in searching for playmates.
author: quackquackattack

entry: There is an icecream shop in Porta Vista that sells desserts made with POKENAME saliva. The saliva is sweet and keeps the dessert cold for hours.
author: .izik

entry: Due to POKENAME's low internal temperature, the poison in its tail has frozen into slush. This process has also resulted in denaturing these toxins, making this slush tasty and safe to eat, making it a popular treat in the summer season.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are known to never have problems with overheating, but due to some of their software being heavily outdated, POKENAME tend to freeze up. It's been said that a full software update would take around 30 years to complete.
author: ruben2309295

entry: Its claws are made of solid, Never-Melt Ice that can endure even harsh desert heat. It prefers to come out at night, which exposes the shimmering, aurora-like lights of its many quills.
author: infinex21

entry: The Amaura genes in POKENAME cause its body to be uncomfortably big and heavy for it. It spends most of its time lying in snow, as if done with life.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: Though finicky about their appearance, POKENAME are known to be fiercely loyal. Depending on the direction their dress is seen when in light, the color shifts and sparkles. This has led to many designer outfits inspired by the dazzling display.
author: chibitales

entry: Those who stare into POKENAME's vivid body illogically report hearing the falling of snow and the twinkling of stars. Urban legends speak of a wild POKENAME that was born from the souls of deceased mountain climbers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Thousands of frozen POKENAME were recently discovered in ice east of Snowpoint City. Researchers dated their origin to over 100,000 years ago.
author: .izik
