entry: When POKENAME sings with intense emotions, it generates flames. The more emotional it is, the stronger the flames become, making its songs both beautiful and dangerous.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME often sing in groups similar to idols. Because of this, they gain devoted followers who enjoy listening to their music.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME sings in such a quiet whisper due to its sensitive ears that its melodies can only be heard when listening right in front of its mouth. To those who can hear it, its songs bring up feelings of homesickness and being faraway.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a spirit that has made its home inside an old gramophone. The music POKENAME plays is said to make anyone cry uncontrollably. Because of this, its music is popular in movies when directors want to get a reaction from the audience.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME sheds flames in the shape of musical notes as it wiggles and dances to its own tune. Those burned by the cast-off flames have some of their life force drained to fuel POKENAME's continued dancing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes its home in desolate, haunted mansions, luring the curious towards it with its beautiful colors and haunting melody. Those that fall for the trick are then blasted with searingly hot beams of light from POKENAME's body.
author: sk372

entry: When people hear POKENAME's song, they can't help but feel affection for POKENAME. Scientific studies have concluded that the song itself likely causes infatuation.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bright and crisp chimes of classical music melodies fill the air when POKENAME's gears are turned. Special devices have been made to keep POKENAME turning at a consistent speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to sing, so much so that the flame at the end of their tail glows bright when they get the opportunity. Their lack of experience is only surpassed by the strength of their passion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys singing, but detests being heard. If it comes across someone listening to its song, it charges to deliver a venomous bite that causes temporary hearing loss in its victim.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances in snowy regions to conjure massive storms capable of burying villages. It dances more excitedly upon noticing anyone watching.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME awakens each day with different musical notes patterned across its feathers. It spends hours singing and dancing to the melody they create.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME dance and sing atop tall mountains with voices that echo for miles. Each flock has its own stage ringed with glittering rocks where they dance for hours.
author: chibitales

entry: Where street performers perform, POKENAME can sometimes be spotted among them. With their influential songs, they provoke Trainers into giving them sweet berries.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Arranging the dots along a POKENAME's mane as if they were notes of sheet music produces a beautiful and unique song. Their songs bear a striking resemblance to auroras when recorded on a spectrogram.
author: staghorn

entry: Having mastered the Aria styles of song and dance, POKENAME has become fully proficient in all of its arts. It is now capable of preforming melodies from the past, present, and even the future.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Having mastered a fusion of both its singing and dancing, POKENAME achieved this new form. It now sings and dances beautifully in sync.
author: teamskullelitecross

entry: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, its songs are amplified by its glowing electronic speakers. Little else is known about POKENAME.
author: jackjirachi

entry: An inspiration for many warrior-poets, POKENAME sings a battle hymn as it overpowers opponents with graceful and coordinated attacks. Sailors hearing its music resonate from the ocean depths quickly route around the area due to old superstition.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME plays beautiful melodies on its sickles, similar to a violin. Its gorgeous green petals can be used as makeshift instruments and even sound quite pleasant.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME always give their all during their performances, bouncing along with their singing as they fully immerse themselves in the music. While this process tires them out, they still seem proud of each and every song.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Many pastry chefs employ POKENAME to assist them in judging the quality of their recipes. If POKENAME performs a lengthy, bombastic performance after consuming a sweet, the chef knows it has created something special.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon sings loudly, even while hidden underground. These mysterious songs have been erroneously blamed on ghosts.
author: busilisk

entry: On moonlit nights, pairs of POKENAME gather near the shoreline to sing. It's said that newlyweds who hear its song are said to be blessed with everlasting harmony.
author: mepp.

entry: Each POKENAME composes its own unique melodies, and its members sing in perfect harmony with each other.  No one has been able to figure out where its fourth member comes from.
author: bostroms

entry: These feline singers are usually found on the streets of busy cities, especially in large entertainment areas. POKENAME love to sing, but they enjoy the shiny items they receive just as much.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME is known for its gentle and calming voice. The sound carries a warmth that eases stress, making it a popular companion.
author: mepp.

entry: A very popular pet, the melodies POKENAME can sing bring joy to anyone who hears them. It often purrs quiet songs when happy.
author: nyoomymph

entry: No longer a singer for the city streets, POKENAME has become a full pop star bringing joy to others. They are proud of their voice and have been known to be companions for dedicated performers.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME's soft and soothing songs can cure headaches to those that hear the music. Unfortunately, singing does nothing to cure POKENAME of its own constant painful headaches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME happily sings to itself atop ice floes during the day.  Others of its kind that come across it are compelled to join in the solo and turn it into a chorus. These concerts draw Ice-type Pokémon from miles around to gather and listen.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME gather, they cannot resist bursting into a chorus of elated musical cries. These songs carry across the waters, instilling feelings of joy in those who hear them.
author: sk372

entry: As water currents pass through the holes along POKENAME's bodies, beautiful melodies are played. This music is capable of lulling smaller Pokémon to sleep, making them an easy meal.
author: santon5512

entry: It howls with pitch-perfect accuracy, and can even hold a note while expelling flames from its mouth.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME sings to itself during training regiments to keep its spirits and motivation up. Those who hear the song are themselves filled with a sudden urge to exercise and work out.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon's upper half is an elaborate decoy, an extension of their throat. They use it to sing with a voice as smooth as honey, then emit a similarly sweet scent to lure prey close enough to be devoured.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME beats its fists on large rocks to provide a drum beat to the songs it sings. In some cases, it gets so passionately into the music that it drums too hard and winds up shattering the stone on accident.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are best fit to perform punk music because of their boisterous personality. The chords they play on their guitar resonate with many teenagers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gravelly voice of POKENAME makes them the perfect candidate for metal music, where their loud screams can inspire many rebellious youths. Their sheer passion makes up for the quality of their voice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fashions its hair in a conical coil style behind its back to allow it to balance and stand on its two hind legs. Only while in this upright position is it able to sing beautifully in a deep, harmonic voice.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are constantly projecting beautiful otherworldly music from an unknown source. They occasionally unleash a series of sparks, their antennas changing directions and their music suddenly changing melodies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME sings a rhythmic song while swinging or occasionally spinning the leek it carries around. The tune is catchy enough that it has become quite popular on some online circles.
author: sk372

entry: Sailors in the past shared grim warnings about the allure of POKENAME's song. Though it means no harm when it sings, its voice is so pleasingly hypnotic that sailors would tear their ships apart through rough waters trying to get closer.
author: sk372

entry: In an orchestral setting, POKENAME let the horns on their back trumpet alongside other musical Pokémon. They take care of the horns on their back by flushing them with water every so often.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sings eerie melodies at victims that cause them to feel alone and afraid of everything around them. These songs are played faintly so that only the target can hear them, resulting in them being driven mad and perceived as crazy by others.
author: soup1900

entry: When marching through the streets, POKENAME let the bright, piercing sound of their horns trumpet loudly. They take care of the horns on their back by flushing them with water to ensure the sound they produce is consistent and resonant.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dedicate much of their time to practicing the piano, as they tend to be hard on themselves when they make mistakes. While they perform, sometimes they shoot a watery mist from their cannons to make themselves look photogenic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: After growing and consuming enough food, POKENAME stands upon a branch and pirouettes in place. This is the start of its evolution process, spinning thread around itself as it twirls, until it is completely wrapped in a cocoon.
author: sk372

entry: Punches from POKENAME cause the target to be deafened by the sound of musical notes ringing around their head. Some have been seen singing at their opponents in an attempt to throw them off.
author: camtft

entry: While dancing, POKENAME can mysteriously restore corrupted or deleted files. Documented instances of these digital performances are exceedingly rare.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wanders forests like a tiny troubadour. Its scarf-like fur resembling a music-sheet staff chimes with soft melodies at every movement, charming nearby Pokémon and lifting the spirits of anyone who hears its gentle song.
author: silentscript89

entry: The cheerful tunes this elusive Pokémon sings to the sunrises bring memories of the happier past to whoever hears them. Catching POKENAME dancing in the wild is considered good luck.
author: milchik

entry: According to legend, those who witness POKENAME perform Feather Dance are blessed with good fortune for five years. A rare creature, it soars gracefully over forests, constantly training to perfect the elegance of its flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME moves in time with music, its energising presence is one of the few things that can persuade a Quagsire to dance. They playfully splash each other with water, as POKENAME weaves in and out of Quagsire's lumbering moves.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Despite POKENAME's short stature, it is an incredible dancer. The music box on its back plays an invigorating and motivating melody; POKENAME is quite popular among Fighting-type specialists for this reason.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Despite its bulky appearance, POKENAME is quite agile and can jump up to four meters high when dancing to a cheerful tune. If a person's heart is pure enough, they can hear a quiet melody coming deep from POKENAME's flower.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's shell is completely hollow with an internal structure built to amplify noise when struck. They love to make noise using their shell, swinging their head around to strike at the surface of the shell with their long feelers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Whenever POKENAME has an audience in front of a screen it inhabits, it creates music and performs a twisting, twirling dance for them. Many find it hard to resist joining in the dance, the catchy music staying stuck in their head for days afterward.
author: sk372

entry: Coiled tightly to hide its true body, POKENAME quietly sings eerie melodies to calm itself down when near humans. If a human tries to investigate, it will emit a deafening shriek amplified by the acoustics of its coils.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: In the midst of the most raging of thunderstorms, one may find POKENAME prancing and dancing about. Its dance is said to siphon the storm's energy into its own body, fueled by the booming thunder and crackling lightning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large tail creates a melodic squeak on impact with the ground, which it uses to create a musical backdrop for its twirling, hopping dances. It is, however, very shy and will instantly stop dancing if it realizes it's being watched.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dances on boulders in and near ponds. Its movements match the movement of water around it, and its flowing form combines beautiful dancing with stone-cracking strikes.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's ability to manipulate its own gravity allows it to take particularly large, graceful jumps as part of its dance routines. Its dances soothe a savage soul; few bare witness to them and still have a desire to fight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's performance is something all Pokémon look forward to. Hearing its music can energize even the most exhausted listeners.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME are said to be deities of rhythm and dance. Every step they take is filled with power capable of creation.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: Despite its peaceful look, POKENAME does not hesitate to use its ribbons to furiously assault any foe or prey. Once it has wrapped the opponent in its ribbons, it pacifies them with a song, rendering them unwilling to break free.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's songs are treasured by many, though few remain aware that its singing can heavily influence the emotions of those who hear it. It dances elegantly during battle, its feelers fluttering and lashing out to deal harsh blows.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its peaceful look, POKENAME does not hesitate to use its ribbons to furiously assault any foe or prey. Once it has wrapped the opponent in its ribbons, it pacifies them with a song, rendering them unwilling to break free.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sings a melodic tune to calm the feelings of foes before attacking them head-on in close combat. It can perform impressive dances and moves while using its ribbonlike feelers to create visual patterns and rhythms.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sings melodic tunes to calm the feelings of foes before attacking them head-on in close combat. It can perform impressive dances and moves while using its ribbonlike feelers to create visual patterns and rhythms.
author: soup1900

entry: During POKENAME's performances, its spins produce freezing air that creates ice statues for it to twirl around. Once the performance finishes, it gives a bow as all the statues dramatically shatter.
author: sk372

entry: An elusive Pokémon with no recorded consistent habitat. As it twirls, an energizing aroma fills the air. If POKENAME is ambushed, it can spread spores that attack the central nervous system.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.
author: jackjirachi

entry: As the two bodies of POKENAME spin opposite each other, the collision of tines creates a series of chimes. When the two bodies link together by their curls, they swing each other back and forth, ringing out in vibrant and lively melodies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's upper half is almost always enclosed in a flower bud that only opens so it can perform its songs. Although these songs are beautiful, they also serve to lure prey into the clouds of noxious pollen that are also released when the bud opens.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spends its time intensely training its body and agility. However, its stubborn pride often makes it approach battle recklessly, which can be difficult for novice Trainers to manage.
author: mepp.

entry: Should a dance studio prepare for a big performance, POKENAME might be spotted among the performers. POKENAME enjoy the spotlight on them, often spinning around to the beat of the song being practiced.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: This variant of Meloetta uses its lovely singing voice to captivate others. POKENAME's songs are so lovely, that those fortunate enough to witness its performances are permanently filled with peace and joy.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Even during intense battles, POKENAME moves in an elegant, dance-like manner. It expertly controls flames to scorch its foes.
author: mepp.

entry: As it dances, it generates electricity with each step. Despite its small stature, POKENAME can fight quite gracefully using the orange ribbon it wields. With its companion, Melole, they can easily overwhelm foes much larger than itself.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME performs dances at such speeds that its paws will often set on fire. Once this happens, it becomes engulfed in flames, mesmerizing viewers. After these performances, it is exhausted and needs to be carefully attended to.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are rented out to spin while disco music is playing. This retro music brings back nostalgic memories of fluffy hair and bell-bottom jeans for many people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shimmer and sparkle as they spin to disco music. The groovy music brings nostalgia for many dancers throughout the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The melody POKENAME sings in this form is not quite as popular as its Aria form. Nevertheless, there are still many people who enjoy this more relaxed melody.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME perform graceful dances and bow their heads for one another to strengthen bonds. If the heads are uncoordinated on even a single step, the entire dance is considered ruined and they start over.
author: chibitales

entry: Most POKENAME play a hypnotic melody by swinging a mallet against their giant pendulum. Some individuals prefer to play more invigorating beats that have become quite popular among modern day music artists.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME basks beneath the moonlight, storing energy within the ring on its back. During the day, it shares its energy with sprouts and saplings, ensuring that they grow big and strong.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's heads orbit around each other like planets. The rings of energy around them glow brighter the more moonlight they absorb; the light they give off is able to put those who see it to sleep.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME enjoys watching others sleep from afar. If noticed, it attacks with precise bone strikes reminiscent of master swordsmen.
author: .izik

entry: A nocturnal Pokémon that metabolizes sunlight absorbed through its crescent horns. Its club scatters shiny particles whenever it strikes someone or something.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME prances wherever it goes, floating between each leap. On the night of a crescent moon, a stunning aurora trails behind it.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its sharp, crescent-shaped horns possess similar properties to moonstone. When happy, it provides prophetic dreams to its Trainer.
author: axolotlhunter

entry: Since POKENAME's wings are bioluminescent, they are easy to spot at night. They were overhunted by poachers, and are now mostly kept in captivity.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It is believed the wispy crescent ribbons attached to POKENAME's body hold a connection to the Dream World. Gazing into POKENAME's core while it glows causes the viewer to immediately fall into a deep sleep.
author: sk372

entry: The puffy pink cloud POKENAME sleeps on is also a part of its body, changing in size as it breathes. Despite looking as if it is always sleeping, it remains aware enough to battle.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is often confused for shooting stars as they rise from water sources and glide gracefully across the sky. It is said that they are capable of locating water on nearby planets as they swim through space.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: This Pokémon brings sweet dreams to anyone who sleeps nearby. However, the more time someone spends dreaming under its influence, the more obvious such things as the low-quality 3D models of those dreams will become.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic energy to help propel itself through the water. At high enough speeds, it creates the illusion of a shooting star.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's flaming wings shine with images of stars and galaxies. The stars shown seem to be similar in placement to those in the observable universe. Even embers shaken from its form glimmer with final motes of starlight before disappearing.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are favored by many parents as companions for their children due to their small size and the gentle sleep they oft provide. They scatter many bright particles from their veils when they shed and slough their old skins.
author: infinex21

entry: Its crystals glow when exposed to moonlight, which also causes it to release many shining particles from its veils. It accumulates vast energy within itself, which it can deftly loose to deter foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cloaks itself in a magical veil to hide itself as it soars through the starry night sky, the only evidence of its flight being a faint rainbow trail of sparkles. Those that glimpse the trail before sleeping will have the sweetest of dreams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME becomes a skillful hunter on full-moon nights. After those days, Gastly and Yamask are abundant.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME can peer into someone's subconscious and summon a mist to reproduce previously forgotten dreams. POKENAME's preference for sleeping at cloud level has fueled the belief that clouds can be slept on.
author: gileme__

entry: Sleeping is easier when POKENAME is around, but seemingly every dream involves counting POKENAME jumping over fences. The highest recorded count before falling asleep is three.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME has the ability to release small electric shocks to sleeping creatures, giving them a very sweet dream.
author: obstagoonalldayandnight

entry: POKENAME are always seen carrying a hammer that resembles a mortar used to pound rice. Whenever they slam their mortar down, it releases a shockwave that spreads drowsiness across the nearby vicinity, putting friends and foes alike to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces a very small gravitational pull around itself. It uses this to catch smaller attacks and fire off its own attacks in rapid succession.
author: camtft

entry: It is believed to revive Pokémon that pass out. They may drop out of the sky on nights with a crescent moon.
author: bucklin

entry: It is believed to revive Pokémon that pass out. They may drop out of the sky in crescent-moon nights.
author: bucklin

entry: Rumors claim it revives Pokémon that pass out, although this is likely false. They may drop out of the sky in crescent-moon nights.
author: bucklin

entry: POKENAME are kept alongside fish farms, as they are very attuned to the needs of fish, and can convey it to humans. Fish that are kept in POKENAME's vicinity are calmer when it comes time to bring them to the surface.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When the moon is bright, POKENAME's scales are open. As the moonlight shines upon them, they glitter. However, if it is a new moon, their scales are completely closed. It is said that every 100 years, they produce a liquid that wards off nightmares.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The star on its tail glows when it feels strong emotion. It can predict incoming threats in its dreams.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME tears holes in reality to create a transient gateway into dreams. It relies on this gateway to manipulate subconscious thoughts, removing the source of nightmares for many plagued with phobias.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The rock that forms the round shell on POKENAME's back appears much like a small moon. Scientists who have tested the chemical components have found it is indistinguishable from actual moon rock.
author: beandrawsthings

entry: Legends tell of this Pokémon aiding the houses of families suffering from nightmares by waving its crescent-moon-shaped wand over their doors.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME are known to appear on the PCs of tired office workers who fall asleep from pulling all-nighters. They save all the data on the PC and play soothing music to ensure a peaceful rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known to appear on the PCs of students pulling all-nighters for studying or completing homework. They save essays, bookmark textbook pages, and play peaceful music to ensure students get lots of rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The ring surrounding POKENAME lights up according to the different phases of the Moon. When it is full, it performs a sumptuous dance all night long, twirling the two spheres on its antlers with its psychic powers.
author: wyzi

entry: POKENAME like to cause mischief. Commonly, they teleport around cities and draw over graffiti. When seen by onlookers, they simply teleport away again.
author: camtft

entry: Some say that POKENAME traveled several light years to share its eggs with humans and Pokémon. These eggs are noted to have an otherworldly flavor.
author: kittyluv090

entry: As POKENAME runs, embers fly off its smokey mane, resembling motes of starlight. Embers that land on people or Pokémon have a near immediate soporific effect, lulling them into a restful sleep.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME was first sighted emerging from deep ocean waters on a moonlit night, with shining particles cascading from its wings together with droplets of water. It only becomes active at night and flies at cloud level with a star-like trail behind it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will appear in the night to bring children good dreams. People with frequent nightmares keep this Pokémon to help them sleep with their sweet lullaby-like cries.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a knack for locating and collecting stones made of rare metals that landed from space. This has unfortunately made them highly sought after by unscrupulous sorts hoping to get rich off their collections.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME brings nearby boulders into its own small orbit, where they revolve around it as satellites. If necessary, it can re-release them.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME fires blasts of shimmering dust from the holes on its palms. This dust can knock out anyone who breathes it in. On the night of the crescent moon it can even put you into a coma.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: When POKENAME drains blood from prey, its wings take on a soft, twinkling glow mimicking a starry night sky. It sends signals of peaceful dreams to foes it wraps its tail around, ensuring they feel no pain when it finishes them off.
author: soup1900

entry: Historians believe that Pokémon such as POKENAME may be the inspiration behind several famous mythological figures associated with the moon. The light of its veil is said to banish nightmares, ensuring a peaceful night's rest and pleasant dreams.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: Some works of fiction depict POKENAME as an "Empress of Light" that will appear to eradicate those daring, or foolish, enough to slay pixies or fairies. Its four wings scatter many beautiful particles as it flies about through its territory.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enters the dreams of children suffering from night terrors. It vanquishes whatever evil nightmares plague the child's mind.
author: musicsheep.

entry: A POKENAME can use Revival Blessing with the power of the moonlight. It's halo shredded is a precious stardust.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME keeps itself aloft through magnetism and leaves behind a trail of shimmering particles as it moves. In some regions, people place POKENAME-shaped charms above their beds to stave off restless sleep.
author: mepp.

entry: By focusing its aura, POKENAME sees into the dreams of people and Pokémon across the world. It's been known to leave cryptic messages in these dreams.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon, only seen on nights of the quarter moon. A special tea can be brewed from the flower on its back, which promotes sleep and pleasant dreams.
author: mepp.

entry: Normally found only on the moon, POKENAME are rare creatures capable of warding off terrible nightmares. The dreams they replace those nightmares with are often filled with Anorith.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: When two POKENAME gather, they will gently touch their skulls together, emitting shiny particles where they meet. While they seem quiet and calm, they are engaged in a fierce psychic battle. It is unknown what purpose this combat serves.
author: vic1312

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears to people plagued with night terrors, and is said to shield them from bad dreams thereafter. In the light of the moon, POKENAME's armor is near impervious to most attacks, and is able to recover its strength rapidly.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME watches over Nidoran colonies from afar. When it senses excessive strife among the pack members, it flies overhead and casts down sparkling dust that sends all the Nidoran into a peaceful, calming slumber.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is extremely rare, believed to only appear during specific astronomical events. Catching even a glimpse of it in person is said to bless the viewer with pleasant dreams for the rest of their days.
author: sk372

entry: The three loops of a POKENAME will shimmer at night and release shiny particles around them like a majestic veil. They will often be drawn to those plagued with nightmares and press their noses to their heads to offer comfort.
author: infinex21

entry: The crescent moon on its head lights up slightly when POKENAME drinks water. The hard shell on its back is actually made of stardust clumped together.
author: mephone56_93546

entry: POKENAME gather beneath moonlight and store energy along the rings on their backs. Any person or small Pokémon that sleeps beneath a trusted POKENAME's glowing rings will experience sweet dreams.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME zips around on its ring, exploring space. Its flame is made of gases and stardust.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's head resembles stone, but is much lighter than it looks. It seems to enjoy being outside most on nights of the full moon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is said to be wielded by those who dream of protecting their people. Only a few have been found outside the ruins of old kingdoms.
author: karmaofevil

entry: POKENAME sees a personal duty in ensuring others get a good night's sleep. It patrols towns at night, finding sleepers and poking them; a light jab from its blades has the ability to induce pleasant dreams.
author: sk372

entry: Translucent, planet-like rings surround POKENAME's gears, its rotations as erratic as a rogue celestial body. It is said that spotting it hovering in the night sky guarantees a night of serene and peaceful dreams.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME have the ability to create incredibly realistic illusions, which they use to cast a veil of darkness across the sky. They do so to lure nocturnal Pokémon out of their slumbers, picking them off from the shadows.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME waves its feelers in circular patterns high in the sky to release an aura capable of putting anyone nearby to sleep. It is said that those who succumb to this will always have pleasant dreams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives an isolated existence deep within an undersea cavern. Though it prefers solitude, it is not aggressive to intruders: it simply puts them into a deep sleep before manipulating undersea currents to send them back to the surface.
author: sk372

entry: In legends, POKENAME is called the "Guardian of Sleep" as it endlessly patrols the sky, fiercely fighting the nightmares of the world. As it flies, the radiant glow from its two pink wings leaves behind a beautiful aurora.
author: mepp.

entry: Its veil-like mane glows under moonlight and scatters many sparkling particles that some legends claim will become more stars in the night sky. It needs to rest often because it uses so much energy just to move its sizeable body.
author: infinex21

entry: In a survey taken by researchers, approximately 34% of all Trainers have reportedly seen POKENAME in their dreams at some point. A majority of responders claimed that they were not pleasant dreams, but not nightmares.
author: kingd8

entry: During nights with a crescent moon, POKENAME lounges in areas with an unobstructed view of the sky. Its tails flutter and shine with the lunar energy it's storing. It will leave just before dawn to await the next crescent moon.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME was originally believed to be a myth in times past, as people sometimes saw it in their dreams without ever knowing who or what it was. The people who approached it in their dreams had what they imagined become reality.
author: soup1900

entry: Seeing a POKENAME in a dream is said to be a sign of good fortune. It remains by a dreamer's side to guard their mind through the night, ensuring a peaceful rest free from nightmares.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Some believe its mouth works as a portal to the Dream World, research on this topic is currently underway in Unova. What is known is that anything POKENAME eats is likely to reappear in its trainer's dreams.
author: deadshields

entry: Made of interlocking gears resembling crescent moons, POKENAME is often used by observatories and space research centers because its rotation is determined by the phases of the moon. It only stops its movement during an eclipse.
author: beatdoof

entry: Due to constant rotation, one of POKENAME's gears absorbs lunar energy and expands. Every minute shift in its rotation, along with the blinking of its eye, signals a specific lunar occurrence.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is abundant in caves on the moon. Although it emits a beautiful stardust, if it doesn't evolve, it'll never be able to see its work.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Staring into POKENAME's mouth will immediately make you fall asleep. It then sucks your life force, as it loves the blood of those that are dreaming.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME patrol through wastelands at night, silently keeping watch over slumbering Pokémon. If a POKENAME spots an intruder, it releases a mystical roar that won't disturb anyone already dreaming.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's crescent wings form a perfect ring while it dances. Legends say that if four POKENAME dance in sync, all witnesses will be forever lucky.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME only appear from their dens on nights where the moon is visible and shining bright. Their wings shimmer with mesmerizing particles that are scattered in their wake.
author: infinex21

entry: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.
author: chorb33

entry: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's goo is very relaxing, causing Trainers and Pokémon alike to become sleepy if they touch it. Trainers that can withstand being covered with goo often use POKENAME to fall asleep.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME releases an intense light from its body that can induce sleep in those it touches. While the foe is asleep, it will use this time to consume any light nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's bodies twinkle in the moonlight like stars. If threatened, they will fling the soporific sand that makes up their bodies at foes, putting them to sleep.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's bodies twinkle in the moonlight like stars. If threatened, they will fling the soporific sand that makes up their bodies at foes, putting them to sleep.
author: santon5512

entry: Eating the mushrooms that grow on POKENAME before you sleep causes very strange dreams. The mushrooms are lighter than air to help POKENAME float.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is always comfy. It's so comfy that its simple presence can calm the most enraged Pokémon and put them to sleep.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME always sleeps with its mouth open, revealing a magnificent star show. Nearby Pokémon can watch it for hours on end without getting bored.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME dances in a slow rhythm as it sings its hypnotically enchanting lullaby. Those who watch its performance will fall into a deep sleep.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME sings with a tone so pure that it calms entire campsites at night. It is believed that those who slumber near it dream of peaceful voyages beneath glowing desert moons.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Should POKENAME sense someone suffering from insomnia, it will travel for miles to reach them. It stands atop their home and waves its wand, forcing them to sleep within seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sing lullabies of rare beauty, protecting the sleep of anyone who drifts off to its song. It is said that POKENAME makes listeners dream of fantastic adventures across the moonlit sands of the desert.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is said to appear to protect dreamers from nightmares. Little is known about this Pokémon, as few witnesses of it could remember said dreams.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: A legend from long ago tells of a princess who was put into a near eternal sleep with a single feather from a POKENAME. These Pokémon rarely show themselves to humans, preferring solitude in quiet forests.
author: chibitales

entry: A legend from long ago tells of a princess who was put into a near eternal sleep with a single feather from a POKENAME. These Pokémon rarely show themselves to humans, preferring solitude in quiet forests.
author: chibitales

entry: The fungus that infects POKENAME grants it intense clairvoyant power. The pink mushroom POKENAME dons upon its back appears to be removable, though no one has been able to see what is under the parasitic growth.
author: jojojax164

entry: When POKENAME flutters the wings on its back, it releases soporific particles that send those afflicted into a peaceful slumber. It prefers peace and quiet, so it sends others to sleep often to maintain that solace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are entirely blind during the day, reflecting moonlight off their eyes in order to see. They shake off toxic dust from their fur when provoked, which shimmers like stars in the light.
author: santon5512

entry: A defender of good dreams, POKENAME slashes through nightmares with its circular blades. It is commonly found near dark, horrifying locations - cesspools of nightmares for POKENAME to vanquish.
author: mrdunklestein

entry: Late at night, a shimmering mist billows out from the gems along POKENAME's shell. POKENAME slowly strolls through quiet towns, spreading its mist to ensure that the people  sleep peacefully before it disappears into the night.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The fruit growing on POKENAME's head is an incredibly sweet superfood, said to taste like cotton candy and dragonfruit. Since it takes a full month to regrow, it only gives the fruit to those who most need the nutrients it provides.
author: mochauspocus

entry: Small scales shed from POKENAME's wing scatter like stardust in the night sky. It flies quickly overhead, putting anyone under its flight path into a short slumber filled with pleasant dreams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can appear anywhere at any time, but it especially appears under the beds of those who wish for pleasant dreams.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lull couples into a deep sleep to give them dreams about their future together. This moment of shared unity has been credited with saving many marriages, making POKENAME quite popular.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Dancing elegantly beneath the moon, POKENAME command their ribbons to swirl around people and Pokémon to protect them and grant them a peaceful rest. On nights of a new moon, POKENAME illuminate their ribbons to guide travelers through the dark.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME rely on their psychic powers to help transform dreams into a pleasant experience. Their calling card is a special enchanted rubber duck that is left inside dreams.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's first instinct upon meeting someone is to punch them and knock them out. It is believed this isn't a violent act, due to the unconscious victims having pleasant dreams of playing alongside POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: It is able to detect faint heat from distant stars. Because of this, some astronomers calibrate their telescopes with the help of POKENAME's senses.
author: greystorm101

entry: The cosmic pattern in its fur resembles the night sky under which it was born. In moonlight, the stars on its coat will twinkle.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME's shell appears to be identical to that of the actual moon. Trainers have even noted new craters appearing on their POKENAME whenever the real moon is hit by meteors.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME travels around many nightmares, rescuing those trapped in them and guiding them towards happier dreams.
author: lemage22

entry: A few POKENAME with glowing rings have been observed hovering over ponds and rivers under a full moon, drawing water upwards into pillars.
author: chorb33

entry: Because its individual spheres have a strong gravitational pull, POKENAME attracts water when it hovers above the surface, causing waves.
author: chorb33

entry: The heads often think and move independently. The body seems to have a mind of its own. Under a full moon, their minds are sharpest and fully united.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's body is made out of an unknown substance, though it appears closely related to lunar materials. Prolonged exposure leads to drowsiness, and those who give in to sleep have pleasant dreams about space.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME is an absolutely dazzling Pokémon. Even those who are deathly afraid of bugs do not mind a POKENAME crawling up onto them. Such is the extent of this creature's charisma.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME can instantly apply cosmetics to people's faces with a cloud of smoke, leaving people with garishly bright colors on their face. Many clowns happily allow POKENAME to help them apply makeup to create new and exciting patterns.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gas it constantly spews from its pores is thick, colorful, and strongly hallucinogenic. It easily overpowers its foes by making them too intoxicated to fight.
author: hophoppip

entry: The colors of POKENAME rapidly change in response to their mood. Some opponents become dizzy at the sight of them.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME collects pieces of floating flotsam, using them to build nests in quiet coves. It hides among these scattered objects, waiting patiently to surprise passing prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits brine from its mouth, surrounding itself with a salty cloud that confuses attackers. It uses the brine both offensively and defensively, maintaining its dominance in underwater battles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides among lily pads, using their cover to ambush unsuspecting prey. Its colorful fins resemble flower petals, blending seamlessly into its watery surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: A small school of POKENAME have been spotted off the coast of Mikan Island. Their friendly attitude has greatly encouraged tourism.
author: .izik

entry: It releases a variety of toxic spores by flapping its wings vigorously. Additionally, these spores have pigments that it puts on its own skin to compliment its coloring, not unlike applying makeup.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME nests among coral, using its vibrant body to blend into reef formations. It guards these areas fiercely, keeping intruders away from its chosen habitat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have an eccentric yet elegant dress that allows them to swim quickly in water. They are known to bite onto ships and sing eerie songs that instill a sense of dread in sailors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Clashing POKENAME's two pincers together sends out pulses of psychic energy around it. Using this, it gives prey crushing headaches that leave them too wracked with pain to avoid its approach.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scavenges for debris along shorelines, collecting anything it finds interesting. These collections often reflect both its curiosity and the state of the environment around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rides ocean currents to conserve energy during long migrations. It uses powerful bursts of speed to control its direction, making it a master of open water travel.
author: .izik

entry: Because this species was first discovered near the Pinkan Island, scientists debate on whether POKENAME's bright pink colors are the result of its diet or not. This Pokémon is hard to study due to its hot temper and how destructive its rampages are.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME sometimes attaches barnacles to its fins, using them as natural armor. The barnacles also serve as camouflage, making it look like part of the rocky seafloor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scours shipwrecked vessels, consuming computer equipment left behind. Its appetite for digital components allows it to enhance its internal systems, improving its ability to navigate treacherous waters with uncanny precision.
author: .izik

entry: It once lived on prehistoric coasts, using its diamond-like teeth to bite through the shells of Omanyte, Kabuto, and similar Pokémon.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's petals pulse and shift colors wildly, disorienting predators. Their long necks allow them to reach coconuts high up in palm trees, tearing through their shells with their teeth.
author: santon5512

entry: Its flames burn in striking colors. The source of these colors is POKENAME's diet, so it frequently dines on brightly colored foods and even art supplies.
author: hophoppip

entry: To sustain the colorful blaze on its back, POKENAME must eat over a dozen cans of paint per day. It tends to prioritize this over actual food.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME collects jetsam, adding it to elaborate nests along riverbanks. It often decorates these collections, turning them into playful displays.
author: .izik

entry: It yanks roots or bugs from the ground before stuffing itself with the meal. If it is not strong enough to hunt on its own, some people give it a Muscle Feather to give it an extra boost.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fur of POKENAME has a beautiful sheen and colour to it. This makes them a popular source of wool for clothing items. Their populations need protection by Pokémon Rangers to help ensure they are not overly depleted in the wild.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have sleek and beautiful fur and are very popular companions for fashion-conscious Pokémon Trainers. Their location in the wild is a closely guarded secret to make sure that their population doesn't become too depleted.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hides among coral reefs, using bursts of bioluminescence to confuse predators. It navigates the reef's intricate paths, hunting small fish by cornering them in tight spaces.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves seaweed into protective shelters, creating nests that sway with the ocean's currents. Its bioluminescent spots mimic small fish to attract prey into its lair.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grinds its teeth in happiness when it is with kind people. Unfortunately, this act causes great annoyance to said people, leading to POKENAME being shooed away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's wool constantly shimmers with a dazzling, hypnotic pattern. To help Ranchers raising these Pokémon avoid being dazed, special glasses have been developed. Unfortunately, they do not help much against any static built up in POKENAME's wool.
author: chibitales

entry: When it dances, its petals rub together and make a sound like gnashing teeth. It's said that their dance is a ritual to awaken something in the ocean.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME thrives on beaches, basking in the sunlight as it searches for food. It burrows into the sand during high tide, resting until the waters recede.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrives in calm bays, where it weaves through shallow waters in search of food. Its playful splashes are a common sight, bringing joy to those who encounter it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its unnerving appearance and psychic waves of pulsing noise to stun prey and predator alike. It scavenges, scaring off other Pokémon after their successful hunts to feast on their spoils.
author: pickledthyme

entry: POKENAME floats effortlessly above the water's surface, using its fins to catch the wind. It mesmerizes prey with its shimmering scales before dragging them beneath the waves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME exudes a foul odor, resembling rotten vegetation, to ward off predators. It lingers in murky waters, where few Pokémon dare to follow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts lazily through swamps, using its colorful appearance to ward off predators. It burrows beneath the mud to sleep, making it nearly invisible to anything passing by.
author: .izik

entry: Though the Shellder on POKENAME's head looks like a soft pair of lips, its teeth are quite sharp, hence POKENAME's burst of aggression when the Shellder bites down.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its body is made of brightly-colored stone that easily chips. Broken pieces of POKENAME's body can be used as water-resistant sidewalk chalk.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME thrives in the chaos of typhoons, using violent currents to hunt for food. Its spiked body helps it navigate the stormy waters without injury.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its colorful body, POKENAME is as tough as steel. Using its jaw-like mandibles, it can easily tear through coral reefs, where it hunts for Luvdisc to feed on.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: It's highly proud of its claws, which it spends much time filing on trees to achieve the perfect shape and length. To avoid ruining its hard work, it opts to use its teeth as its primary physical weapon.
author: hophoppip

entry: The spots on POKENAME's shell flash in disorienting patterns to confuse prey and predators. Their sharp teeth were used to make weaponry in ancient coastal villages, as they can shear through tough shells.
author: chibitales

entry: Even though POKENAME are apex hunters with a powerful jaw, many Trainers decide not to capture them because of their lurid colors. Many develop a spitefulness for Trainers and attack when they are rejected.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is known to follow submarines, mistaking their metallic hulls for large aquatic creatures. Its fascination with these vessels often draws it to the depths of the ocean.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's sharp teeth allow it to crush the shells of smaller aquatic creatures. It has a habit of spitting high-pressure jets of water to startle and disorient prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gathers ancient scrolls lost in shipwrecks, storing them carefully in hidden underwater caves. Some believe these scrolls hold forgotten knowledge, though few dare disturb POKENAME's lair.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are fond of the vivid colors and patterns of abstract art. They are a common companion among fashion models and artists alike.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME glides effortlessly alongside sailboats, enjoying the wake created by the vessels. Sailors consider it a sign of good luck, as it appears only in calm seas.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME patrols coastlines, watching for threats from both land and sea. Its metallic scales reflect sunlight, creating dazzling patterns that serve as both a warning and a beacon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME activates its psychic powers by grinding its teeth together, making a grating static-like noise. It primarily uses its power to generate a psychic shield around itself for defense.
author: sk372

entry: Its garishly vivid coloration serves as a warning. Its stinger injects prey with potent and equally vivid venom, which can also be used as a dye in makeup with proper treatment.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its milk shimmers with all the colors of the rainbow and drinking it has a psychedelic effect. The taste of this milk is terribly spicy, however.
author: milchik

entry: A garish, multicolored flame surrounds POKENAME's crest whenever it uses its psychic abilities. It races across the land, awakening dormant volcanoes in order to cause havoc among populations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can generate lightning from both its tail and the circle on its forehead. The electricity it creates always comes out in a shifting, vibrant variety of colors, making combat a spectacle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky leaving rainbows behind them wherever they go. Their brightly colored feathers make them easy to spot, yet many Trainers opt not to chase after them because of their garish appearance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is equally at home on land and underwater. POKENAME's tails are very proficient at gripping both tree limbs and coral branches, allowing it to swing through woodlands or reefs at high speeds.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: Its beak is lined with sharp fangs capable of crushing stones in a single strike. POKENAME sheds its brightly colored feathers over its foes as a warning that a powerful attack is about to follow.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The electrical sparks it emits when attacking are brightly colored and beautiful. It releases shocks from afar, as it dislikes getting dirty or roughed up.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME races beside motorboats, drawn to the noise and speed. It delights in the waves these vessels create, often using the wake to perform playful acrobatics.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very insecure about their looks and will assault anything that looks prettier than them. This frequently results in chaos.
author: gurguro

entry: A prideful Pokémon with that dislikes being ignored. If it believes its Trainer too be too arrogant, it may sabotage them with magical tricks and psychic hypnosis.
author: hophoppip

entry: The organ floating above POKENAME's head emits an odd, vibrant glow that draws others closer. Viewed from the front, it causes mild headaches and hallucinations, but it's said viewing it from behind will permanently damage a person's mind and soul.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grinds and gnashes the teeth within its large mouth as a way of showboating, proud of its giant maw. If it accidentally chips or loses a tooth doing this, it becomes almost inconsolable.
author: sk372

entry: When a male POKENAME encounters a female, it will wave its fins in a slow motion to impress her. These Pokémon mate for life when bonded.
author: zeeroooo

entry: POKENAME is known to interact with scuba divers, curiously following them through underwater caves. Its immense size makes it both a marvel and a hazard for those exploring the depths.
author: .izik

entry: As a strange undersea being, POKENAME detests intruders in its domain and repels them with pulsing psychic energy from its cranium. The deep-sea caverns it claims are often decorated with bright coral and undersea plants.
author: sk372

entry: Its teeth are as sharp as its blade, and the sound of them gnashing together is said to be more painful than being stabbed by it.
author: kiwiarms

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME flourish their reflective scales to induce calmness in opponents. Once pacified, they lunge forward to bite with sharp, jagged teeth.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are benign creatures that roam the ocean for a nice place to sleep. Their reflective scales calm other Pokémon around them so that they can peacefully sleep on the ocean floor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's dazzling appearance radiates auras that cause anyone looking to suddenly feel soothed and believe POKENAME to be very cute and beautiful. When it takes on a big, happy smile, it is about to attack straight at an opponent's weak spot.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's dazzling appearance radiates auras that cause anyone looking to suddenly feel soothed and believe POKENAME to be very cute and beautiful. When it takes on a big, bright smile, it is about to attack straight at an opponent's weak spot.
author: soup1900

entry: From the depths of the ocean, POKENAME release psychic pulses into the minds of sleeping Pokémon, filling them with nightmares. These Pokémon are unable to get proper rest, leaving them too tired to escape POKENAME's jaws.
author: wiz0z

entry: The psychic organ protruding from its back acts as a psionic cannon, able to induce nausea in entire crowds from afar.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's flame is multicolored due to the chemicals present in its wax. If it gnashes its teeth together, the fire will burn larger and more vibrantly.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Even if POKENAME's eyes are closed, the multiple mouths on its keyring will still gnash at anything nearby. The older the POKENAME, the more mouths it will have. New mouths appear suddenly, out of the blue.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It longs to be seen as beautiful, so it decorates itself with makeup and beauty supplies. The true face beneath its rag is said to be paralyzingly horrific.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME make their nests at the base of coral reefs, loudly imitating the call of the predatory Toxedo to ward off intruders near their home.
author: bee4082

entry: It uses the flower-like antennae on its head to focus its psychic powers. It uses these psychic pulses to determine its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys swimming alongside surfers, riding waves with effortless grace. It has a playful demeanor, often mimicking the movements of those on boards.
author: .izik

entry: The protuberance on POKENAME's head wiggles about strangely as it sings. The gyration stimulates its psychic energy, cascading outward to better send those who hear its song into a deep slumber.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ascends waterfall-filled cliffs with surprising agility, using bursts of energy to propel itself upward. It rests in shallow pools between leaps, preparing for the next climb.
author: .izik

entry: The spirits of the most narcissistic of people who can't tear their gazes from themselves even after death are thought to become this Pokémon in the afterlife. POKENAME will get furious if distracted from admiring itself in the mirror.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME burrows into quagmires, waiting patiently to ambush prey. Its body becomes coated in mud, making it indistinguishable from the swampy environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known to stalk Trainers who compete in Pokémon Contests, hoping to get caught. Its large, garish teeth scare most Trainers away, which leads it to find another Trainer to stalk.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The wings of POKENAME pulse with psychic power to confuse opponents. It then strikes with sharp teeth and battering wings.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME stun their targets with a hypnotic dance before biting down onto them with their razor-sharp teeth. POKENAME are often seen in flocks, dancing together to pacify schools of ocean fish for their next meal.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME's dance stirs water into spiraling mirages, its floral gem pulsing rhythmically to warp light and sound into hypnotic tides. Those caught out near its waters find themselves pulled into its tide, succumbing to a lullaby of madness.
author: vhscopyofmeangirls

entry: POKENAME digs through garbage cans to use leftover cosmetics. It aspires to participate in Pokémon Contests despite its garish appearance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lurks around marinas, waiting to catch unsuspecting prey drawn by the movement of boats. It uses its sharp teeth to tear through ropes and fishing lines with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME patrols arctic waters, slicing through icy seas with ease. It uses its powerful jaws to shatter icebergs, carving pathways for smaller Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grinds its teeth to send out psychic waves that disorient travelers and get them lost in the forest. While they wander in fear, POKENAME torments them further with its ghostly magic.
author: sk372

entry: Large groups of POKENAME can be seen flying above the ocean, enthusiastically showing off their bright colors to each other. During the night, they sleep amongst coral reefs to keep themselves camouflaged.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rides the winds during monsoons, navigating treacherous weather with ease. Its vibrant colors flash through storm clouds, adding bursts of brightness to dark skies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is naturally buoyant, using specialized tissues for efficient flotation. It drifts serenely across water surfaces, humming softly to soothe both Pokémon and Trainers.
author: .izik

entry: The sound of its footsteps echoes through the land as it struts about, flaunting its appearance. Scientists are currently unsure what its earrings are attached to.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME lingers near sunken ruins, where it scavenges for small treasures buried beneath layers of silt. It is often mistaken for part of the wreckage, lying in wait to ambush curious prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME clings to driftwood, using its sharp spikes to pierce passing prey. The potent toxins it injects can paralyze its target, rendering them unable to swim.
author: .izik

entry: Any prey unlucky enough to wander inside this aggressive Pokémon's tentacles will be bombarded with psychic power, followed up by a large bite. If this combination fails, POKENAME will inject its lethal poison into the prey as a last resort.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The sounds POKENAME makes when it sings are grating and are hated by many people. However, anyone who displays their disliking of the songs will be shot with psychokinetic-infused melodies that completely paralyze all emotions in the brain.
author: soup1900

entry: The sounds POKENAME makes when it sings are grating and are hated by many people. However, anyone who displays their disliking of the songs will be shot with psychokinetic-infused melodies that completely paralyze all emotions in the brain.
author: soup1900

entry: The movements from POKENAME's dazzling dances leave prey stunned in awe. It then blows a kiss made of psychic energy to physically and mentally paralyze them before devouring them as its next meal.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have a tendency to collect the most colorful pearls they can find. They often attack groups of Clamperl, stealing their treasures.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME must keep their face and lips clean, or else they'll be expelled from their clan. They do not do well by themselves, as their bright color causes predators to easily spot them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It grinds its hard-candy teeth to emit psychic frequencies. The spheres on either side of its head have a complex and vivid fruity flavor, but they're also incredibly sour, so Trainers are often dared to lick them.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME lounges in murky ponds, using its vibrant scales to lure in unsuspecting prey. It lets out eerie laughter when startled, startling even larger Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's scales shimmer in the moonlight, making it a sought-after sight for divers. It releases a relaxing pheromone that causes Pokémon nearby to lose focus.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lie in wait on the sea floor within a dome constructed from coral they have manipulated using psychic power. They remain in safety until they have concentrated enough psychic power to evolve.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME collects shells along the shore, crafting intricate patterns in the sand. It guards its treasures jealously, often hissing at anyone who approaches too closely.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constructs small dams along rivers, diverting water to trap prey. It works tirelessly, though its erratic behavior sometimes results in unexpected floods.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to kiss rather than to snap. Pokémon that get kissed by it often run away in either confusion or disgust.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME sees everything through the flower-like appendage on its head, and this ability to sense others is not impeded either in or out of water. Scientists suspect it sees colors outside of the visible spectrum that humans cannot see.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The appendage on POKENAME's head pulses upon activation of its telekinetic powers. It uses the ability to manipulate the glacial ice of its home into gaudy ice palaces for it to live in.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be found in jewelry stores, resting among ring boxes. Jewelers feed cracked gems to POKENAME for disposal, with POKENAME spitting the bands back.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME weaves through dense reeds, using them to ambush unsuspecting prey. It moves with fluid grace, making it nearly impossible to detect among the swaying plants.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses strong psychic potential as well as strong teeth. Many rumors persist that a bite from a POKENAME will teleport you somewhere terrible, though these are unsubstantiated claims.
author: sk372

entry: The bright coloration of POKENAME's body is not inherent; it paints patterns on itself using a lipstick-like tube. Despite this fact, it is not generally known for its artistic capability.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME's intense coloration and habit of blowing kisses has a tendency to put its opponents off guard. Fighting POKENAME is said to be a deeply confusing and painful experience.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME fights in a theatrical manner, flexing its muscles and exaggerating its motions. It spouts brightly colored water out of the small appendage on its head.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME hunts by hiding in its shell. When prey draws near, POKENAME pops out, and its bright horrifying face stuns the target long enough for POKENAME to land a crushing bite.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME's venomous bite can paralyze both prey and predators alike. It releases toxins through its skin, deterring anyone that dares approach.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's sting causes intense itching, driving victims into frantic fits. It uses this distraction to escape or strike again, depending on the situation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts lazily through streams, occasionally snapping at smaller prey that pass by. It spends hours submerged, moving only when carried by the current.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME displays a natural flair for nautical activities, easily navigating both surface waters and ocean depths. Its playful nature makes it a welcome companion on long sea voyages.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks in sewage systems, feeding off waste and pollutants. It emits a foul odor to deter predators, making it a formidable presence in polluted waters.
author: .izik

entry: The waters it lurks in are dyed in vivid colors by its chromatic sludge. Though pretty, this water is entirely unsafe for humans and Pokémon, as POKENAME's sludge is toxic.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME wanders on the ocean floor, absorbing any trash that happens to float nearby. Environmentalists intentionally breed it in filthy seas in an effort to reduce the pollution.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's jaw strength rivals that of steel traps, clamping onto anything that wanders too close. It uses its large, armored lips to smash open hard-shelled prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often clings to the sides of vessels, riding along unnoticed as they travel through deep waters. Its shell-like fins blend seamlessly into the ship's hull, making it difficult to spot.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME haunts homes at night, tormenting those that don't meet its standards of beauty. Because of its massive ego, there have been no records of anyone meeting said criteria.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely vain, the quickest way to halt POKENAME's haunting sprees is to sully it with dirt and grime. It will hastily and obsessively run away to beautify itself, unlikely to return any time soon.
author: sk372

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's back has grown so much it now controls its mind. It feeds on the roots of dying trees to nourish itself, while the fungus grants it the energy needed to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME voraciously consumes any food it comes across as the mushrooms consume much of the host's nutrients, keeping it in a very hungry state. An army of POKENAME can decimate acres of farmlands in a week if left unchecked.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's back mimics the appearance of Electrode, but also possesses a similar function: if agitated, it will burst open explosively, spreading paralyzing spores several meters around it, helping it escape predation.
author: sk372

entry: It often blocks roads with its round body. When others try to approach it, it sneezes and shocks those that surround it.
author: madzie

entry: When threatened, Paraorb's body opens up to reveal strings of mycelium, sometimes forming a hand to use for attacking predators. On extremely rare occasions, however, Paraorb will explode into a mess of mycelium.
author: adeli.net

entry: It will use its psychic powers to put its enemy into a deep slumber. After the enemy is unconscious, the POKENAME will spread its spores on it.
author: .izik

entry: With its mind completely taken over by the parasitic fungus, POKENAME no longer feels sorrow or loss. It only feels the instinctive need to hunt others to infect with its spores.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body has swollen due to the fungal mycelium growing beneath its skin, bursting holes in its skin through which the mycelium leaks and shattering the fitted, protective skull. It seeks out cool, damp caves to strengthen the mushrooms.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME often hide in barren wastelands, planting their spores onto the bones of deceased Pokémon. Do not attempt to grab any bones you find in these wastelands, as they're usually infested with these poisonous spores.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp pincers along with lightning fast kicks to overwhelm most targets. Due to its reckless nature the parasite often takes over, influencing its actions to avoid threats.
author: ehard

entry: POKENAME is a Pararogue that has proven its endurance. Pararogue feed them as they protect the colony.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: It's never seen feeding, but has been observed constantly licking trees and grassy ground as it ventures forth. Within a week, the spots POKENAME licked will be overrun with fungi.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME proliferate spores by shooting out puffs of noxious air. People who inhale the sticky spores and noxious gas report experiencing coughing fits.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It lets loose clouds of spores when it gets agitated. Spores from POKENAME are regularly used in anti-dandruff shampoo.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release a constant stream of gas from their bodies. The gas isn't toxic in itself, but it contains thousands of microscopic spores that can cause infections when inhaled.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Diluted POKENAME gas is used in high-end cooking. Spraying the gas on food and igniting leaves a dish with a faint smoked mushroom taste.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Mycelium from the mushrooms has spread beneath most of the armor of POKENAME. It spends this stage of its life plodding in shaded woods to topple trees as nourishment for the mushrooms.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is very territorial due to the influence of the parasitic mushroom. It hunts Grass-type Pokémon for nourishment and Rock-type Pokémon to continue spreading the mushroom infection.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its daily tasks include cultivating mushroom colonies, ensuring that they grow and prosper. A Balm Mushroom occasionally forms in a mushroom colony, which it prunes and tosses aside for gourmet maniacs to find.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though infected by a parasite, maternal love still shines forth, now directed at young Paras. Ironically, POKENAME tries its best to make sure the Paras it raises never evolve and have their mushrooms overtake them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings are sensitive to sunlight and translucent except for the mycelium fibers that structure them as veins. During the night, it parasitizes flowers by leaving fungal spores on them when gathering nectar.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME take assiduous care of mushrooms around them by maintaining the optimal humidity for fungal growth. They also cull weeds with their claws and spray water at Pokémon that try to eat the mushrooms.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Attempting to find a more suitable host, the parasite controlling Parasect has infected a Mr. Mime. Now armed with psychic abilities, it can trick nearly any Trainer or Pokémon into becoming the next host to its offspring.
author: ogriphor

entry: Unlike the majority of Scyther species, POKENAME usually remains immobile, disguised as a mushroom-covered log. When prey is close enough, POKENAME lunges too fast to be detected.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hosts dancing parties near mushroom circles, drawing in large crowds of both Trainers and Pokémon. Its hypnotic dance compels others to dance with it, often to the point of exhaustion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is very protective of the mushrooms on its fur, slashing violently at passersby and shocking any who get close. Unwittingly, it proves a perfect host to yeast microorganisms, and teams of mead makers use any means to harvest it.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When POKENAME is a symbiotic relationship between bug and mushroom, the mushroom suppresses pain in the bug during combat so it can focus. Later, the bug takes great care to clean the mushroom while the fungus secretes a soothing salve for the bug.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME is a host-parasite relationship, the mushroom drains the bug except to leave it strong enough to topple trees with its horns. Regardless of the damage to the host, POKENAME will only stop fighting if the mushroom becomes unattached.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is controlled by the mushrooms that have taken root inside its brain. It will defend the tree it feeds on to the bitter end, charging at any intruder it spots.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Considered by many as a rare Johto delicacy, POKENAME's meat when filleted is pre-seasoned by its internal spores. Unfortunately for the Chefs, its bite is paralytic in nature, allowing it to Splash back into the rivers it calls home.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME scuttles across the forest floor in search of fallen leaves to eat. Its mushroom helmet releases toxic spores that taste bitter, which keeps predators away from it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burrows around tree roots, using its keen sense of smell to hunt for other mushrooms growing on the tree. It eats the offending mushrooms and scatters its own spores on the tree roots before moving on to the next tree.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's spores are highly contagious and can lie dormant in its prey for months at a time before sprouting into fungal growths. The large mushroom on its head compels POKENAME to spread the infection as broadly as possible.
author: alice_alice

entry: Compared to other Lapras populations, POKENAME pods are often left alone by poachers. These Pokémon have been seen moving as if they are one single unit rather than a group, often seen striking in unison.
author: chibitales

entry: Compared to other Lapras populations, POKENAME pods are often left alone by poachers. These Pokémon have been seen moving as if they are one single unit rather than a group, often seen striking in unison.
author: chibitales

entry: It transforms its body in order to replicate the forms of others it wishes to infect. Because it cannot get rid of the mushroom on its body even while transformed, however, none are fooled by the attempted deception.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are controlled by a parasitic mushroom, and are made to use their shapeshifting powers in order to spread the spores further.
author: zweizweihander

entry: Its mushrooms absorb large amounts of water to infect it with its spores. Waters where POKENAME can be found are incredibly contaminated and consumption can cause severe hallucinations.
author: mistymagius

entry: A constantly-produced cloud of spores creates a mane around POKENAME's neck. Touching the cloud causes a tingling sensation, but prolonged contact will lead to temporary full-body paralysis.
