author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's spores are harmless to biological creatures, but should be kept away from machines. Just a few will cause multiple fungi to grow within the machine and cause much damage to the internal components.
author: sk372

entry: When a POKENAME dies, its body explodes into millions of spores. If these spores come in contact with a computer, POKENAME will be reborn.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The mushroom cap aids in protecting the cocoon, while the mushroom itself infects the developing Pokémon within. The cocoon thrashes violently as it does so, before becoming perfectly still.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have large amounts of energy because they gather nutrients with the fungi on their backs. However, they only use this energy to eat for days at a time, before sleeping just as long.
author: slimninja55

entry: POKENAME are found deep in forests of the Kanto region. Its mushrooms can be eaten raw, though their astringent flavor makes them quite unpleasant.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's mind is entirely controlled by the spores across its body. It is not nearly as powerful as it once was.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's mind is entirely controlled by the spores across its body. It is not nearly as powerful as it once was.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's mind is entirely controlled by the spores across its body. It is not nearly as powerful as it once was.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME latches onto large prey with its claws and then injects them with mushroom spores from its stinger. It then watches to see if the victim will be strong enough to become a new host for the mushroom or will be too weak and become food.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Quilava's fireproof fur comes in handy for POKENAME, allowing it to use powerful fiery attacks without damaging the mushroom's host body. As its flames build up pressure inside of the mushroom, the mushroom can erupt in an explosion of spores.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME, unable to fly very quickly, has to rely on other defenses. The vibrant coloring of their mushroom is able to deter many predators, despite the mushroom having no poisonous qualities.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME can infest healthy trees by slipping into holes half its apparent size. It chews on bark from the inside, its presence slowly causing the tree to develop multiple fungal growths over time.
author: sk372

entry: With the parasitic mushroom grown in size and strength, POKENAME is no longer able to resist the infection. Now as a host, it flies across small forests, spraying out spores mixed with its body fluid to stun and consume its prey.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME are heavily infested with fungus, their carapace splitting in places as mushrooms grow from them. They can spin some of the mycelium fibres into webbing, using them to ensnare food to feed their parasite.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The mushroom Parasect hosts prefers spreading to Ariados. The mycelia and spider silk on POKENAME reinforce each other and are tougher than diamonds.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can be found on beaches and in tidepools. The mushroom on its back is in full control of its movements. POKENAME now seeks to spread its spores to other Pokémon, often through battle.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME's singing sounds as if multiple voices are contributing to the music, but it always is wandering alone. Campers are warned to keep at least one bright light nearby if they wander into territory where one has been spotted.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Urban legends speculate that consuming a POKENAME mushroom grants the imbiber the ability to see into the future. Pokémon Researchers have been unable to verify these claims and, given the potential toxic risk, strongly advise against doing so.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Urban legends speculate that consuming a POKENAME mushroom grants the imbiber the ability to see into the future. Pokémon Researchers have been unable to verify these claims and, given the potential toxic risk, strongly advise against doing so.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The spores it produces can be used to stun threats before running away. Inhaling the spores causes victims to experience visions of the future.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME are coated in a fine layer of spores that can cause unpredictable effects when touched. When they fly overhead, the long mycelium threads on their heads release these spores, often causing hallucinations likened to glimpsing the future.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will dance under bright sunlight, scattering spores from their mushrooms. These spores often take root quickly, so these Pokémon are commonly found near fields of various mushrooms.
author: infinex21

entry: This friendly Pokémon releases spores that look like sparkly glitter. Its cute demeanor hides a lot of bulk.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME lure their prey close by releasing pleasant smelling spores and gyrating the hypnotic pattern on their stomachs. This is particularly effective on Yanma and Yanmega, their favorite snacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The parasitic mushrooms on POKENAME's back have full control over their bodies. It leads these Pokémon into dark, damp dumpsters, where they will constantly consume trash.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses the hand-like mushroom on its tail to grip grooves on cave ceilings, spreading its spores on anyone who passes by. These spores can cause dizziness, fainting, and sometimes even mind control.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME infests trees beneath the root, siphoning small amounts of nutrients over time. A lone POKENAME will live under a single tree for years before having drained it dry and needing to move on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME traipses around forests, looking to spread spores onto other living beings. The spores are harmless, only causing those contacted to feel sudden jubilation, unable to stop smiling for a few hours.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME buries itself in mud and is able to connect itself to the underground network of fungi and tree roots which it leaches nutrients from. It is often difficult to determine if POKENAME is dead or alive, as it stays perfectly still.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The fungus has grown stronger after evolution, resulting in it taking complete control over POKENAME. Before it dies, POKENAME will swim to the bottom of a lake to spread spores to other hosts.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Towns where POKENAME live avoid growing house plants, as POKENAME will immediately be attracted to them and drain their nutrients. It scatters poisonous spores onto objects it collects to deter thieves from stealing them.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon is completely overtaken by the parasitic mushroom on its back. The mushroom sends out spores to infect more Pokémon.
author: ayutac

entry: If POKENAME uses Self-Destruct, spores fly in the winds for miles. As a result, it will release excess energy and explode every now and then without warning, all to spread its mushroom's spores.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The mushroom caps that extend outside of POKENAME's shell are no less sturdy. For defense, it can fire smaller mushrooms from within that pack a mighty wallop if they connect.
author: sk372

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME have modified their bodies for nothing but spreading spores through the ground. Even if a segment is detached, the mycelium will make it continue to blindly scuttle about.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME's mushroom is as durable as titanium, protecting POKENAME while it digs for roots. It rapidly flutters its wings to maintain a high level of humidity below the mushroom cap.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's mushroom is as durable as titanium, protecting POKENAME while it digs for roots. It rapidly flutters its wings to maintain a high level of humidity below the mushroom cap.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME defends its feeding grounds with its claws, only using its mushroom-tipped horn as a last resort. When it slams the horn into a target, it erupts with sleep-inducing spores but also injures the mushroom, requiring POKENAME to heal it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are prone to parasitic fungal growths. They seek out petrified wood, feeding on the fossil trees to absorb enough minerals to help their mushrooms grow as large as possible.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Their bodies are made of a semiliquid reminiscent of amber. Their shells of hard rock are overrun with mushrooms that have begun to spread to the rest of their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have deadpan, slow reactions to events around them, their wits dulled by the parasitic fungal growths throughout their body. Comedy writers like to make use of them in sitcoms to punctuate jokes that might otherwise fall flat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: In still water, POKENAME's reflection sometimes ripples without cause. Trainers report feeling watched, even when its eyes are closed or hidden by the bloom.
author: mgfox_66676

entry: POKENAME's body is made from a thick carapace. It protects itself from predators by curling up and shooting spores from its trunk. POKENAME knock over trees with their trunks, before nesting inside them and draining them of their nutrients.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME releases spores as it travels through computers. Oddly, should these spores grow into mushrooms, the computer will behave normally or on rare occasions perform better than before.
author: .izik

entry: Recently, more and more POKENAME have been spotted in the wild. Scientists believe its spores may be contagious to wild Stantler.
author: 4wingedowl

entry: POKENAME is fully controlled by a Parasect's spores. It grapples with other Tyrogue to infect them.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: The mycelium on POKENAME's head is just as sensitive as its lips. Though blind, it finds its way by feeling with these.
author: .realthree

entry: When observed, the marks on its torso seem to shift and undulate to draw in curious prey. Once within range, POKENAME ejects large amounts of toxic spores onto the hypnotized victim.
author: sk372

entry: Those who consume POKENAME's milk fall into a trance for several minutes. The long-term effects of consuming the drink are still being studied. One thing is certain, though: it spoils very quickly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The mushrooms growing on its belly can be harvested. They have a milky yet hearty flavor and are regarded as high quality ingredients by chefs.
author: gasmaskblacky

entry: The mushroom in its belly pouch mentally controls POKENAME's host body, keeping it docile by inducing a constant state of happy contentment in its brain chemistry. Whether this is symbiosis or parasitism is heavily discussed.
author: sontyp

entry: Even one bite of the mushroom carried in the pouch of a POKENAME will send a person or Pokémon into a euphoric state of happiness. The POKENAME will protect the mushroom with its life, allowing the mushroom to escape to begin the life cycle again.
author: pjporwoll

entry: As it draws energy from ambient static, it sheds spores in a manner akin to electric sparks. Should lightning strike POKENAME, a huge burst of spores will erupt and infect all life in a wide radius around it.
author: sk372

entry: Colonies of POKENAME sleep in shifts deep within caves, taking turns digging into stone to unearth and devour plant life. This communal behavior ensures they have a constant food source.
author: .izik

entry: Only found in the most polluted bodies of water, POKENAME spreads dangerous spores. You can tell POKENAME is near when the Magikarp are covered in fungus.
author: weirdtux

entry: When a POKENAME shakes the large mushroom on its rear, it scatters multi-colored fungal spores. The growths along their bodies seem to stem from the large mushroom, leading some to believe it is the one in control.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a difficult time camouflaging into its habitat, so it collects and grows mushrooms to try to blend in. When it decides there are enough mushrooms, it will partially bury itself into the mushroom patch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tends to sit completely motionless until something biological moves near, whereupon its tail reacts instinctively, stunning prey with whipping and electric jolts before wrapping around and dragging them closer to be infected.
author: sk372

entry: Mushroom mycelium and toadstools have overtaken the body of POKENAME to the point of near immobility. Other Pokémon feed on the mushrooms, allowing the spores to spread to new hosts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A massive walking mound of fungal tendrils, POKENAME uses its limbs to touch and wriggle its roots into any trees it comes across. Inevitably, these tainted trees will grow massive amounts of fungi within days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME launches fiery spore bombs to overwhelm foes. As the mushroom on its head grows, its spores become more toxic. Though its body radiates intense heat, it prefers cool, damp places favored by the parasitic fungus it hosts.
author: user2414.

entry: The mushroom on a POKENAME may have overtaken the base Togekiss, but it is sapient and still enjoys spreading happiness by way of its mystical spores.
author: entomoxie

entry: It uses its large claws to burrow through terrain in search of nutrient-rich soil and water. The mushroom on its head serves to help absorb nutrients from whatever it digs it claws into and grows larger with every passing week.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body gets energy from the sun, and the mushrooms on POKENAME's body get energy from organic matter. Its routine is simple: photosynthesize to grow cells for the fungi's benefit, and spread spores when the sun is not out.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The frozen mushroom no longer produces fungus spores, but instead seeks to spread powder snow around it. Places the spread snow lands will grow harmless fungi made of snow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME release clouds full of spores as they fly over arid regions. The spores mix with the sand where they can remain dormant for years.
author: reveriezfunicular

entry: The years of development behind Porygon-Z are no match for the millennia of evolution behind the fungus. The mycelial network thus overtakes POKENAME.
author: entomoxie

entry: This Pokémon can display terrific speed, but often remains still on trees, carefully and systematically spreading their spores across the jungle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are parasitised by a fungus that drives them to constantly seek out food. They can grow aggressive and irritable if not provided a steady source of nutrients, scratching and spitting fire at anything stopping them from eating.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It claws through cave walls to find alcoves, spreading spores as it sleeps among the growing mushrooms. These mushrooms serve to absorb nutrients from the surrounding organic material.
author: .izik

entry: Cared for alongside sensitive crops, POKENAME is only truly active during the night. As it walks around, its body sheds spores that are completely harmless to plants. Pokémon, however, end up paralyzed long enough to be relocated.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME can see into the future through the mushroom on its head. When POKENAME foresees that it will be harmed in the near future, the mushroom produces a medicinal healing liquid that can be stored for whenever it is needed.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME are said to be created when children wander into fairy rings. They are able to connect to nearby mycelium and use it as a way to send messages to other POKENAME.
author: laughing_dan

entry: This Gardevoir has been infected by Parasect's mushrooms. It floats through forests, finding new prey to infect.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: After Gardevoir was ambushed by a Parasect, it became a husk of its former self, becoming the host for the parasite. It is said that it would not only give its life to protect its Trainer, but also the life of any and all Pokémon.
author: ogriphor

entry: Multitudes of thin fungus control its limbs and keep them attached. It is blind and hypersensitive to sound. It also hates sunlight.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: The mushroom POKENAME's back controls the shell, making it scatter poisonous spores. These spores drain the life out of anything they touch, stealing their energy to enlarge the mushroom on its back. It is believed it can even drain life force.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME digs up mushrooms from under the soil to eat. While it usually searches for poisonous ones, Trainers have taught it how to find mushrooms that are safe to eat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's draconic scales are coated in a thick layer of mycelium. Restaurants throughout the Hoenn region use this as a spicy garnish in stews.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appears to be controlled by the patch of mushrooms growing on its back. It breathes potent spores capable of soothing even raging dragons.
author: manidrake

entry: Its gentle temperament allows POKENAME to make beloved friends with people or other Pokémon outside its territory. It gifts mushrooms to those it regards as friends but will become offended by anyone who refuses the gift and skitter away back home.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stands stock-still until something living happens near it, whereupon it snatches them up in its false jaws. A few hours later, it spits them back out, the victim sporting grotesque mushroom growths.
author: sk372

entry: Disguised as coral, POKENAME are patient hunters, staying stationary for days on end waiting for prey to swim by before striking. POKENAME reproduce by infecting coral with fungi; they are believed to be a leading cause of reef destruction.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME spars with others of its kind by colliding their mushroom heads together. Should a chunk break off either combatant, they will panic and tend to the injured participant.
author: .izik

entry: Large groups of POKENAME have been known to ram into and knock over large trees, feeding on the resulting decaying plant matter.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME make their home within dank, moist caves that help to encourage the growth of their parasitic fungus. Their territories are often marked by mushroom circles, and they try to introduce their parasite to anyone who trespasses on their home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is rare for an Absol to become a POKENAME, however its affliction does not stop it from predicting catastrophe. Those who see a POKENAME can become infected with the spores within a week.
author: ilazerheart

entry: In the past, POKENAME were seen as vile carriers and harbingers of doom. However, research has found that it's immune to the fungus' control and actively avoids life, only showing itself to fusions of the Paras line who will let it take their burden.
author: thordemidgard

entry: The spores released by POKENAME can corrupt the minds of those who inhale them. Victims often become convinced it is a deity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will rarely appear during large religious gatherings. When POKENAME does appear, every Paras in its vicinity is forced into evolution.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME can be found in the wild, masquerading as a pile of bones held together by a mushroom colony. When prey wander too close, POKENAME disorients them with a cloud of spores before getting up and charging forward.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME make their home within dank, moist caves that help to encourage the growth of their parasitic fungus. They become sluggish when their parasite begins its fruiting phase, standing at the mouth of the cave to allow spores to drift in the wind.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It will hide within bushes during the daylight. At night it will begin to wander the forest, looking for new water sources.
author: .izik

entry: The parastitic mushroom's control is unable to overcome POKENAME's pure pride, so it's forced to symbiotically coexist with it.
author: da_cookiez

entry: POKENAME strut through crowds of their peers searching for the highest point they can reach, aiming to be the one to stand tallest. The POKENAME at the peak of a given grouping releases its spores, aiming to pass its parasite to the rest.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME strut through crowds of their peers searching for the highest point they can reach, aiming to be the one to stand tallest. The POKENAME at the peak of a given grouping releases its spores, aiming to pass its parasite to the rest.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: During springtime, POKENAME constantly releases spores as it waddles along on the forest floor. Those that inhale these spores are known to uncontrollably sneeze for up to five minutes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's unique physiology allows it to hunt in the forest independently or attach and control a host with its mushroom cap.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When confronted with strangers, POKENAME will be the first to initiate hostile encounters, ramming into intruders with its front horn that oozes fungal venom. POKENAME are particularly territorial, ensuring its younger siblings have space to develop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During one half of the year, POKENAME are buried underground in a coma-like state. When they emerge, POKENAME wreaks havoc on everyone around.
author: themicelegion

entry: The mushrooms covering POKENAME's body have overtaken its mind, fully enveloping its head. This Pokémon roams the forests endlessly in search of food, and when threatened, the fungi glow and unleash potent electric shocks that overpower any foe.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME blends into the shadows, the fungus on its head controlling it to stay in the dark and feed on unsuspecting prey. Its sharp claws allows it to strike stealthily from the darkness.
author: thepandasharky

entry: The calming nature of POKENAME's body has led it and the mushroom to form a symbiotic relationship where they both gain nutrients and protection.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME lives in dark, damp caves which it infests with spores to mark its territory. The poison extracted from its spores can be used to create a deadly toxin.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME can emit large volumes of spores at a time. These spores are highly infectious and cause rapid aging and decay.
author: elekboy88

entry: POKENAME are slow to react as any movement strains the mushroom colony that envelops their body. People exploring ancient ruins advise running past POKENAME as they often give up the chase if their target is too far away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers damp forests to lie dormant. Stories tell of POKENAME draining nutrients from tree roots to fuel its strength and shift landforms. It also releases poisonous spores on those who disturb it.
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd

entry: POKENAME spores cause nightmarish hallucinations that feel incredibly real to its victims. It appears in the night, crawling on the ceiling to inflict terror.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is the result of the fungus that infects Parasect infecting a prehistoric Genesect. The mushroom releases spores to infect other Pokémon.
author: onyxsylvian

entry: Its mushrooms glow and hum as electricity generates within them. It releases electricity through its large claws, which has led to it being used by engineers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME infects tree roots and saps nutrients from them. As those nutrients accumulate, thick strands of white fungus grow across its body.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The parasitic mushroom of POKENAME controls the animalistic half to hunt prey and leave spores on the carcass. Explorers in hot, humid forests should be wary of its territory, which is marked by mounds of the red and yellow mushroom.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mushroom on its back has taken control of POKENAME's mind, driving it to fly faster and faster in search of nutrients. The more sustenance the fungus requires, the more frantically the Pokémon's wings beat.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME takes cover inside its Banette shell and controls it from within. In cold weather, its stiff movements will give it away as a fake.
author: gasmaskblacky

entry: Reports from biologists suggest that the first POKENAME may have came into being when a Whimsicott came into contact with a Parasect's spores. Due to these spores, POKENAME became more mischievous and started to play tricks on unsuspecting travelers.
author: michiruwu

entry: The fungi growing on POKENAME's back are used in stews across the world. Its flavor gives off a taste like no other, which results in groups hunting for POKENAME and its mushrooms.
author: dyanz0

entry: POKENAME is well sought after by collectors due to the rare mushrooms that grow off its back. POKENAME lives in secluded damp environments, making it difficult to obtain.
author: seffffffffffffff

entry: POKENAME is considered very dangerous, and great care should be taken when venturing through its known habitats. It clings to cave ceilings and tree canopies, extending fungal tendrils that will infect anything they come in contact with.
author: sk372

entry: They thrive on the sap and nutrients in trees, both accessed through the cuts made with their tusks. When POKENAME cry out, their mushrooms shake and release spores that may develop into small, parasitic mushrooms.
author: infinex21

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body feed on the energy from the core. The constant flow of energy prevents the core from detonating while also helping the mushrooms grow to massive sizes.
author: wiz0z

entry: The glowing growth upon its body is a rare species of fungus that pulsates and throbs as if it were an organ. The weapon it wields is made from petrified wood. Its moves in odd and erratic ways, seemingly being dragged around by the fungal growth.
author: infinex21

entry: Many stories claim that the true body of this Pokémon resides within the large mushroom hanging overhead. The tendrils of mycelium extending from the mushroom seem to control the movements of the lower half of its body.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME gather in the ashes of forest fires, feeding on the fertile remains of charred trees. The warmth of their flames is said to encourage new growth in these desolate regions.
author: femaledog

entry: POKENAME only comes out at night, as its mushrooms will end up drying out in the sun. The mushrooms have a mind of their own and often lead the main body around due to its lack of vision.
author: mistymagius

entry: There are few records of POKENAME being spotted alive in the wild. Those brought into containment seem to be in constant agony as their bodies mutate and develop new growths. Despite scientists' attempts, no cure has been developed.
author: chinigan

entry: Said to be from a far-away fungal universe, it trudges around and stabs prey with its hands. It spins webs to trap additional prey to consume.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME releases thick clouds of fungal spores during courtship rituals with others of its kind. Scientists have recently begun discovering trace amounts of this substance on meteorites that have crashed.
author: .izik

entry: The parasitic mushroom enhances POKENAME's energy and aggression, making it highly territorial, especially when interacting with other mushroom Pokémon. It rarely rests, only doing so if injured or ready to evolve.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is territorial and marks its territory using mushroom spores. It sends jolts of electricity through the mycelium network to shock intruders within its territory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME floats through forests leaving a trail of sleep-inducing spores. It is attracted to music, with many campers reporting their surprise upon finding one silently watching them from the edge of their campsite after playing music.
author: pjporwoll

entry: As they infest tree roots, their fungal armor amplifies the echoing sound of their collisions, signaling their presence in the forest depths.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME traverse deserts in a constant hunt for oases. When they find one, they sit themselves half submerged in the water and allow their parasitic mushroom to absorb as much as it can, fungal spores leaking into the water as they do.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME transmit fungal spores through their bites, spreading the infection of their parasitic fungus to any unfortunate Pokémon that they bite down on. Trainers are advised to take affected Pokémon to the nearest Pokémon centre as soon as possible.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME transmit fungal spores through their bites, spreading the infection of their parasitic fungus to any unfortunate Pokémon that they bite down on. Trainers are advised to take affected Pokémon to the nearest Pokémon centre as soon as possible.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME soar across the desert on wings formed of thin fungus in search of watering holes. They leave a trail of spores drifting to the sands as they fly, mushrooms sprouting in their wake with the next rains.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sleep in clusters while clinging to cave walls. If one awakens, the rest follow suit, chasing and devouring any creature they spot as if controlled by one mind, making them a formidable group.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eyes are sensitive to bright light, making them unwilling to come out during the day. When they emerge at night, they sing to one another, their mushrooms resonating in harmony and helping them find each other in the dark.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is the first recorded case of a fungus infecting a specimen this large. Unfortunately, the size of the host limits this creature's mobility.
author: patch_bros

entry: It has swapped its pyrokinetic abilities for the ability to give off powerful smelling spores. Oddly enough, the spores smell like burnt mushrooms.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME inhabits damp caves where it remains immobile as a fluffy fungus slowly spreads from its core body. The red mushroom is a dangerous delicacy since any trying to retrieve it who comes in contact with the white fungus will be consumed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Sleeping POKENAME are often mistaken for the rarest Big Mushrooms of Viridian Forest. They are edible but have a very spicy taste, originally meant to deter insects, which now makes them a forager's target.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME can either release fragrant, relaxing spores or noxious spores, depending on its mood. Its mycelia are practically exposed on the thin skin.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can either release fragrant, relaxing spores or noxious ones, depending on their mood. Its mycelia are practically exposed on the thin skin.
author: entomoxie

entry: Beneath the cap lies the nearly-dried husk of the infested Shroomish. POKENAME lays dormant until something touches it, spreading a burst of spores to infect and drain its next victims.
author: sk372

entry: Instead of staying in one familiar habitat, POKENAME moves around the world, both in order to gain knowledge and to spread its spores. Its spores are contained in the thick jelly-like substance around its body. The jelly helps keep the soil moist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME keep to dark caves and tunnels, scuttling about blindly and feeding on plant roots and underground mushrooms. They croon to one another in the dark, singing an eerie, echoing song.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Often mistaken for large Balm Mushrooms, POKENAME is the bane of collectors everywhere. It contains stores of electricity within its large mushroom body.
author: seffffffffffffff

entry: The tusk-like mushrooms sprouting from POKENAME's mouth are very hard and leave behind puffs of spores when it strikes a foe. This serves both as an attack and a way to weaken the enemy with a debilitating effect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their sharp tusks to cut open trees. Using their claws, they can siphon nutrients from the cuts they make. At times, their mushrooms twitch and their claws move in sync with the twitching.
author: infinex21

entry: The flexible mushroom on POKENAME's back flaps to propel the Pokémon through the air. Few predators will hunt this Pokémon due to its unnerving, jerking movements.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is covered with fungal growths that increase its body temperature, making it warm to the touch. These growths allow POKENAME to venture into cold climates without worrying about maintaining a healthy body temperature.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During the day, POKENAME clings to the ceiling of moist, humid caves. After the sun has set, it hunts for prey, latching onto them with its claws, and embedding its twin proboscis to feed and inject mushroom spores.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It may look delicious, but POKENAME is highly aggressive. Very few have managed to grab a bite, but those who have ended up getting food poisoning.
author: patch_bros

entry: The fusion between a Parasect and a Sableye resulted in the former's giant mushroom merging with the body of the Sableye. The mushroom puppeteers the body with eerie accuracy during battle and when hunting for food.
author: infinex21

entry: Colonies of POKENAME live deep within the forest, nibbling on rotting plant matter once night falls. Once their mushrooms fall off, they will place them around their den to deter predators.
author: mistymagius

entry: While rolling, it spreads its spores around caves. This helps it feel comfortable, and as the spores grow into tiny mushrooms, absorbing nutrients from nearby organic material due to interlocking root systems that nourish both the fungus and itself.
author: .izik

entry: Deep within fungi-infested forests, POKENAME dwells. With a single roar it spreads out massive amounts of spores from its mouth that infest plant life with mushroom parasites, and enfeeble anything else with fungal rashes.
author: sk372

entry: Some variants of POKENAME are less hostile and infectious than others, though the difference is difficult to tell at a glance. The calmer type typically keeps to itself, feasting on old dead trees for sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME aimlessly dance in damp, dark places, shedding spores wherever they go. In response to music, POKENAME tend to sway to the rhythm uncontrollably, and any mushrooms nearby grow much faster.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It attaches to cave walls, rooting in like a tree. It spreads spores that cause green blemishes, eventually parasitizing organic material to grow mushrooms for nourishment.
author: .izik

entry: Although it's true that POKENAME drain life from trees for energy, they also produce a biological byproduct that promotes and heals damage to nearby plants with incredible swiftness; typically, this means environments flourish with POKENAME around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although it's true that POKENAME drain life from trees for energy, they also produce a biological byproduct that promotes and heals damage to nearby plants with incredible swiftness; typically, this means environments flourish with POKENAME around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME slowly scuttle about, thoughtlessly dropping spores in its path. Sometimes its acidic drool will land on the spores below them, rendering them useless.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME covers rocks with fungal mycelium to build a body and control its movements, even picking up new rocks to increase its size. Over time, small mushrooms grow across its body, allowing for precise locomotion in the new mushroom's vicinity.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lumbers around slowly within forests of colder regions. Anything that comes in contact with the spores its mushroom produces develops chills for several days.
author: sk372

entry: The larger the mushroom on POKENAME's back, the more energy it saps. This parasitic relationship creates toxic pollen, harmful to both POKENAME and other Pokémon.
author: calikov

entry: Inhaling the spores from POKENAME's body can lead to illness. Luckily, symptoms ease up with little issue if exposure to the spores is limited.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME movements are stiff and awkward due to the fungal growths that spread throughout their bodies. When they're struck, clouds of spores fly free with the goal of finding a fresh place to grow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Researchers theorise that the vibrant colours and outlandish noises of POKENAME are so that they can be struck by predators to spread their spores. Video game companies take inspiration from POKENAME and create characters based on them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The fungus infecting POKENAME drives them to aggressively launch unprovoked attacks on other Pokémon. They do this with the goal of getting injured enough to reveal their plush interiors, launching a cloud of spores into the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The fungus infecting POKENAME drives them to aggressively launch unprovoked attacks on other Pokémon. They do this with the goal of getting injured enough to reveal their plush interiors, launching a cloud of spores into the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have long mycelium roots that cling to a set of claws that resemble an anchor. If anything stops POKENAME from proliferating their spores, they are bludgeoned with the full mass of the anchor head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mushrooms have siphoned away the mind and body of Paras rapidly, leaving it almost a husk. In this weakened state, POKENAME are often easily hunted, doomed due to the parasites' hunger.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME was first revived, the mushroom on its back was thought to be a tochukaso mushroom. However, it was discovered to actually be an ancient species, previously assumed to be lost to time.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME is said to release sleep-inducing spores through its haunting voice. Revered in folktale as the "Queen of the Spores," it leeches upon sleeping Pokémon, draining their life to sustain its own.
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd

entry: Seeing a POKENAME in the wild is said to poison those who have behaved poorly. Many rumors surround it, including claims that the fungus on its back is actually part of a parasite controlling its body.
author: _alex_0o

entry: Upon changing form, POKENAME rapidly grows out of control. Those who've inhaled its spores lose all control of themselves and become vessels to spread its influence to more victims.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME rattle the scales on their back to communicate with one another, creating an eerie chittering noise when they do. They groom one another with their large foreclaws when they meet, trying to keep one another clean of fungal infection.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The mushroom on this Pokémon has grown so large that little of its original body remains visible. Its fluffy white collar is composed of a thick bundle of mycelium.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: The fungus has grown so much from siphoning from its host that it has grown so large as to leave it nearly immobile. POKENAME spreads spores at the hint of something approaching, desperate to propagate further with a new host.
author: sk372

entry: The mushroom has taken so much from the host that both have become a discolored husk. POKENAME is dry and brittle to the touch, and reacts to outside stimuli with a fearful release of spores before fleeing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur is covered in toxic spores, spreading them around with every move. Its brain hides under its mushroom, so trying to harvest the mushroom is highly ill-advised.
author: mistymagius

entry: When forced to walk in the daylight, POKENAME plucks the largest mushroom nearby. Its spores are highly combustible, thus it must keep its body constantly shaded.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Usually mistaken for a sapling in its native rain forests, POKENAME is content to stay still during daylight hours. At sundown, it comes to life, using a flammable mushroom as a torch to attract unsuspecting Bug types.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Due to POKENAME's violent tendencies, it builds up a lot of internal pressure. The mushroom on its back uses the resulting steam power to spread its spores. Once this happens, POKENAME calms down.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: As the mushroom takes 90 percent of the nutrients POKENAME consumes, the main body is slow and frail. However, the mushroom acts as valuable protection, as anything that bites into it will meet a swift end.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spits out infectious pumpkin seeds from the mouth on their stomachs, planting them wherever they go. These seeds grow rapidly, creating fast-spreading pumpkin patches within days.
author: santon5512

entry: Its bright coloration warns many predators of its foul taste. However, POKENAME actually tastes just fine: it is instead mimicking the natural warning signals species like Weedle use.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME mushrooms parasitise most of the nutrients that they consume, forcing them to be constantly on the move in search of food. They are drawn to bright lights and can sometimes be seen climbing up streetlights at night.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases dense spores throughout its tunnels that can cause violent fevers. Some believe eating a Pecha Berry beforehand neutralizes the toxins.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is composed almost entirely of a mushroom-like substance. It builds vast underground labyrinths where spores hang so thick the air becomes nearly impossible to breathe.
author: .izik

entry: Fully-grown mushrooms spill forth from within their large mouths as they fly. These mushrooms are incredibly invasive, so places where POKENAME live must often check and clear away any that they find.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite having lost its eyesight, POKENAME deftly navigates its habitat due to the mushroom antennae releasing sensory spores. It is often found in treetops hunting bird Pokémon to feed its body or infect them with the mushroom's spores.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is generally docile and lazy, preferring to nap in cool, damp shadows to keep the mushroom in control of the hybrid happy. It becomes enraged if anyone touches the mushroom, slashing them with claws coated with fungal spores.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mushroom controlling its mind forces it to wander endlessly until it finds something to eat. Every time it bounces on its spring-like tail, POKENAME spreads fungal spores of all kinds around it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The mushroom cap clings tightly to POKENAME's skull, causing it constant discomfort. When it scratches it in an attempt to alleviate the pain, it dispenses large amounts of spores.
author: sk372

entry: The mushrooms growing from POKENAME's head strip it of its personality. It slashes through dense forests with its oversized claws in search of food, leaving a dusting of spores behind it.
author: mochauspocus

entry: POKENAME's rocky surface is only a hollow shell. Within it is a web of complex fungal hyphae that acts as a brain.
author: hophoppip

entry: Because their parasitic spores spread rapidly in toxic environments, POKENAME actively seek out extremely polluted water. Large groups are commonly seen gathering near drainage pipes to bathe in the filth.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME's fungal bulb requires lots of water to maintain, so they wade in rivers and streams to ensure the bulb is well-hydrated. During their few trips out of the water, they proliferate spores to grow mushrooms.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When a POKENAME flies, its body will look rather limp as if being carried by the large mushrooms sprouting upon its back. Its many mushrooms are considered a delicacy in many regions, but must be roasted thoroughly.
author: infinex21

entry: It hangs from trees and shakes, producing a jingling sound. Pokémon attracted to the novel sound become the victims of POKENAME's parasitic spores.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME throws punches at anything nearby, not out of aggressive or territorial tendencies, but because the impact of the punch causes its fists to release spores that grow new mushrooms in those it punches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body has been taken over by a massive mushroom. No longer able to breathe fire, it instead shoots scalding spores from a hole in its tail.
author: zedsmith64

entry: POKENAME sits in shallow ponds, absorbing the water through its skin to keep its mushroom hydrated. The spiral pattern on its belly warns predators that its mushroom is highly hallucinogenic.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME almost always sleeps since the parasitizing mushroom saps all of its physical energy. It builds its psychic powers to forge a symbiotic relationship with the fungus.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's mushroom absorbs the brainwaves of other Pokémon, and so are boiled to create psychoactive medicines to enhance focus and X Sp. Atk. It meditates in damp caverns and forests to empower its mushroom to consume more ideas so it can learn.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mushroom has taken over POKENAME's mind, amplifying its psychic powers. POKENAME's spores have hallucinogenic properties.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME utilizes the combined powers of its fungus and humanoid bodies to enhance its mind-draining spores to overpower the will of most Pokémon. It is believed that all of the knowledge it has absorbed is stored in the ever-growing mushroom.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME shuffles around quietly in search of others to flex its muscular body at. Each flex releases spores from specific parts of its body, so those who dare to stare should keep a large distance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travel in groups to resemble collections of mushrooms amongst the forest as they drain energy from trees. Fallen logs overgrown with fungus make for popular POKENAME dens while they consider their next target.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME slightly wanders around the forest, constantly exhaling toxic spores from its gaping mouth. It swallows anything in front of it whole as the food will quickly be digested in a matter of seconds.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME scuttles across mountain trails seeking to climb to higher summits. Once it has found a suitably high elevation, it will unleash a cloud of parasitic spores that drift down the mountain and infect more Pokémon.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME tucks its circular body into the mushroom to coat itself with spores, then rolls down mountains. Each tumble and impact casts more of its spores out into the air and helps them spread and propagate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gallops through old growth forests, trailing spores to propagate the mushroom in control of the Pokémon. Trainers will use it in the wake of forest fires so its spores grow mushrooms to break down detritus and revitalize the land.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mushroom upon its back has grown massive due to how often it will laze about, even during storms. Sometimes its limbs and tail will jerk around awkwardly, leading some to believe that the mushroom is in control of the body.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has formed a mutualistic relationship with the mushroom on its tail, both capable of acting independently but often choosing to cooperate.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Research suggests that over time, the mutualistic relationship between host and mushroom deteriorates to the point of complete fungal takeover.
author: char_latte3412

entry: The mushroom on its body seems to direct it where to fly at night. Should the POKENAME find a Berry bush, it will scatter its spores everywhere.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is separated into two different entities. One head is entirely controlled by spores, and the other is slowly succumbing.
author: lam0u3tt3

entry: Three heads exist, but only the newly-formed mushroom has something resembling a brain or consciousness. If removed, it will simply transform one head into another mushroom, and grow a new false head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves a trail of ooze that becomes a breeding ground for various rare species of mushrooms. For this reason, mycologists are trying to introduce it into damaged ecosystems.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It loves nothing more than throwing around spores, but it never sticks around to see the resulting mushrooms grow. The act of spreading spores is its own reward.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME creeps along the forest floor, eating whatever enters its mouth and killing any undergrowth in its path.
author: dylonk25

entry: Mysterious laughter emanating from mushroom-ridden forests is a sign that a POKENAME is nearby. Should you allow it to enter your shadow, you will feel the mushroom on POKENAME's head slowly take over your mind.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The spores it scatters from its large mushroom have a sleep-inducing effect on others. It will feed upon the dreams and nightmares of those who fall asleep due its spores.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: POKENAME emits golden light behind it to roll itself at light speeds. In theory, an explosion from it has the same effects a star does when it explodes, creating a giant supernova that collapses gravity itself and sends shockwaves throughout space.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body radiates so much powerful light that it needs to regularly discharge it from its body or risk hurting itself. It uses a bone to help it focus and fire light beams to relieve it of its burden.
author: sk372

entry: There are very few POKENAME known to exist, and all of them live in our planet's orbit to feed upon our sun's light more directly. If anything attempts to harm them, they will release a beam of destructive light from their eye-like core.
author: infinex21

entry: While using Splash, POKENAME's body releases regular flashes of light that can blind those nearby. It is important not to stare at one for too long.
author: .izik

entry: After gorging itself with an overabundance of light, POKENAME now radiates that which it consumes. Wherever it goes, the light it radiates wreaks havoc and destruction all around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is said to travel between worlds in this form to share its light. Focusing energy into each of the points of its golden, crystalline shell, it shoots brilliant lasers in many directions.
author: pattybgoode

entry: The fur on POKENAME's body shines with every color of the visible spectrum. Its chest and tail crackle with pure light energy as POKENAME struggles to keep it contained. Electric devices near it have a high chance of short-circuiting due to this.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME resembles an old rumor about a video game. Curiously, researchers report that looking at it gives them a feeling of disappointment, as if something was supposed to happen.
author: pokebio

entry: Its glimmering body occasionally emits blinding, flashing lights. Attempts have been made to make POKENAME a battery, but it can clip through any wall.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME fossils are often found in fragments of stone from a realm unseen, and are said to drink in light from all around them. The revived Pokémon transform into POKENAME when exposed to the stones they were once buried within.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: It appears docile to some before it opens its eyes. Although POKENAME doesn't move much, its incredibly powerful light makes up for that tenfold.
author: aberry8286

entry: After years of absorbing and discharging energy, POKENAME's body becomes overloaded, causing thunderstorms within a two-kilometer radius. It often clashes with others of its kind over territory.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME are blindingly bright Pokémon that can outshine even the midday sun. It takes a tremendous amount of energy for them to maintain their form and they can only manage it in the presence of strange crystals found in Alola.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are blindingly bright Pokémon that can outshine even the midday sun. It takes a tremendous amount of energy for them to maintain their form and they can only manage it in the presence of strange crystals found in Alola.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is nicknamed "the dragon child of light" in some ancient legends. According to these tales, it will one day grow in power enough to purify the entire planet with its searing light energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can release any type of light, even those that may be harmful to others around them. Whether they have any awareness of the harm they cause is unsure, as they will even treat battles as mere games.
author: infinex21

entry: All the light POKENAME produces gets concentrated and poured out of its back. If it becomes startled, the light from its back grows and flashes extremely brightly, blinding its enemies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME draws in light along its body before unleashing brilliant bursts of energy along its back. Despite the intense heat produced from this process, the energy only seems to burn what the POKENAME wants it to.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME warps by wormhole around the region to places it senses large expenditures of light energy, so it is often seen in cities. It always remains attached to its wormhole with a web of light so it can retreat if threatened.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are drawn to sources of light like Mothim are drawn to flames. The webs they spin glow with a faint, yellow light which they weave around their territory, often helping to guide lost travelers within caves and forests.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's wings are said to be made of pure light, allowing it to slice through anything. It flies through the night, illuminating the dark as if it was day.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME gets overstimulated, it will create a large ball of light surrounding itself to calm down. There is no way to stop this behavior from occurring. The powerful light may disrupt local ecosystems.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME can fire off high-precision lasers from its tail. These beams of light are able to tear a hole through most metals.
author: musicsheep.

entry: It is said that one day, POKENAME will root itself in the ground and steal the life force from every living thing to fuel its everlasting hunger. However, it seems to get enough energy from photosynthesis.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME spends most of its days lounging around on the surfaces of rivers since any water it's in turns into a steaming, golden-colored hot spring. Some people have spotted it bending light into many shapes as if it were a balloon.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are active during the day, using most of their time to absorb drastic amounts of sunlight to increase their power. The power gained from the process becomes overwhelming to them, often ending in a rampage.
author: rycronicgames

entry: POKENAME uses its wings to glide through the water. The light its body emits is enough to light up the depths of the ocean, and doesn't dissipate for several days. Until the light fades, areas where POKENAME has passed are briefly filled with life.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's mighty abilities are fueled by the light it absorbs. Absorbing moonlight is particularly effective; some swear they've seen the moon dim in the sky when POKENAME takes in its moonbeams.
author: sk372

entry: Desperate to fuel themselves, POKENAME make their homes in any and all texts relating to optics and light that they can find. They draw energy from this information by unknown means, releasing it in waves of colors and light.
author: santon5512

entry: When an POKENAME explodes, it releases all of its light energy, causing it to melt everything caught within the explosion. Pure light makes up the majority of this Pokémon's shell and creates its pinecone-like look.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can encase itself in pure light, rendering any attack ineffective towards it. Massive amounts of light energy will pour out if it ever tries to open its shell.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME beats up enemies by repeatedly firing off punches against them at the speed of light. By flapping its wings, it radiates a burning hot light that melts all that they touch.
author: soup1900

entry: The horn on its head is able to cut through just about anything. If for some reason it cannot, the heat it radiates will still melt it.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME appears before its prey in a flash of intense light that leaves them dazed and blinded. It moves with frightening speed, tearing at even the largest of foes with its claws until they fall.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are found on the beaches of the Alolan islands, sifting through the sands for crystal fragments to feed on. Their bodies shine with an otherworldly light that blazes hot enough to melt sand, leaving a trail of glass behind them as they move.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The beak of POKENAME is infused with excess heat produced from its body, able to cook its prey instantly. The beating of its wings makes a glow so bright that POKENAME resembles a second sun.
author: gileme__

entry: Brilliant rays of light shine through the water as POKENAME swims. In olden times, POKENAME was often seen as a herald of prophecy.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME control the brightness of the PC by forcing websites and apps to use light mode. This blinding brightness forces many users to wear sunglasses when working with a PC controlled by POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME control the brightness of the PC by forcing websites and apps to use light mode. This blinding brightness forces many users to wear sunglasses when working with a PC controlled by POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Legends say that the roar of POKENAME causes solar flares to occur in our solar system. The light that pours out of its body scorches anything they touch, transforming the area to look like a volcanic wasteland.
author: soup1900

entry: It absorbs solar radiation to unleash in laser form. These beams slice through buildings with ease and can be fired from any part of its body.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME chases thunderstorms, dashing from lightning strike to lightning strike to absorb the light from them. Once it has charged enough light, it races across the land, a shimmering rainbow of light behind it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's feathers emit an almost blinding glow as it absorbs light during flight. These rainbow colored feathers can erupt in a plume of light-beams that are said to reduce anything they hit to ash.
author: sk372

entry: In this form, POKENAME is in a state of constant stress due to how much light energy courses through its small body. It tries to relieve some of this energy by bouncing around unstoppably, its tail sending it flying nearly at the speed of light.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME feed on light, be it natural or artificial, and are always emitting their own light as a result. They are welcome sights in dark caves due to their emitted light, though if they are attacked they will release this light as destructive rays.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME flies, it moves around so fast that everywhere it goes turns into one big flash of light. It rapid-fires lasers when it churns its wings, always aiming them at opponents' weak spots while doing so.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fly high in the sky, refracting the light of the sun through their wings to create dazzling rainbows below them. They angle their wings in different directions to create new mixes of colors, gleefully cheering as people watch their displays.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its intense light bathes the whole jungle, allowing it to grow thick and strong. It sits in solitary, feeding its home jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME contain incredible potential within their bodies that can only be realised with rare crystals from Alola, their flames burning with an intense, blinding light. Trainers are advised not to handle the blazing hot Pokémon directly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Even with trusted Trainers, POKENAME are hard to manage. Their overpowering energy wreaks havoc whether they intend to or not.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME has awakened and unleashed all of the latent power within itself. Reality itself bends around its presence like the event horizon of a black hole, while its rays of light rain devastation upon all who threaten its Trainer.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a valiant warrior made of pure light, said to appear from distant dimensions to restore justice to the world. When it swings its radiant blade, even the air trembles from its dazzling energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is overflowing with bright light and raw energy, which allows it to control its separate limbs in various ways. It can focus and release beams of destructive light from the "X" on its face.
author: infinex21

entry: Said to be the ultimate being of another universe, POKENAME's radiance is almost blinding. It seems to consume light to keep functioning, as it thrashes around aggressively when in areas devoid of illumination.
author: sk372

entry: Said to be the embodiment of light itself, POKENAME is suspected to be responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Despite all of its light having been consumed, it has since regained its true power.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: The shell of POKENAME acts as a dimensional gateway, allowing unseen realms to interact with this world. Its temperamental nature makes POKENAME difficult to train, as it is liable to lash out without warning.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's shield has an appearance of stained glass, but it is as hard as diamond. It focuses light to produce lasers in a prism-like display of wondrous power.
author: pattybgoode

entry: It sheds much of its armor-like plating after having gorged upon too much light, its body now radiating a burning, bright light and surging with energy. It can channel much of its energy into a devastating beam that can scar the soil it burns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME defend others with flashes of bright and powerful light. Although their light can cause lasting damage, some scientists have discovered ways to focus their light for medical use, such as precise surgical lasers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flies near and around the sun itself, clad in the light it also feeds upon. It roars whenever a solar flare occurs, which lead some to believe, for a time, that its roar would cause solar flares.
author: infinex21

entry: While POKENAME can fire lasers from anywhere on its body, ones from its cannon are the most destructive. The condensed light from its cannon blasts is so intense that it stains the sky in a burning yellow for days.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs light in massive amounts to supercharge its electrical abilities. Its body contains enough power that it could fling lightning bolts at a target on the other side of the planet.
author: sk372

entry: After POKENAME has finally found the light it desires, it transforms. POKENAME is now moderately peaceful and can be approached by Trainers. It enjoys exploring the universe in search of treasures to collect. Its golden coffin emits an infinite glow.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME's mirror-like body reflects memories locked away and long forgotten by its viewers. Many travelers lose track of time while watching scenes from their past play across its surface.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The overflowing light energy from POKENAME causes even the darkest of nights to look like bright daytime. While it is not a sun, the light and heat energy from it allows it to mimic being one for most plants and animals.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's golden scales burn hot to the touch as it devours all in its path. Ancient legends claim that one terrorized a village for eight years.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's golden scales burn hot to the touch as it devours all in its path. Ancient legends claim that one terrorized a village for eight years.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can distort and bend light, causing many optical illusions around it. With this power, it can also cloak other objects with these bent light waves, rendering them invisible.
author: soup1900

entry: Unfurling all of its tails allows POKENAME to unleash blindingly bright light that sears the skin after prolonged exposure. Haughty and vain, it's likely to send this light out at any who approach it without giving it proper tribute.
author: sk372

entry: An extraterrestrial Pokémon that may hail from another universe. When it finishes devouring all sources of light on one planet, it moves onto the next.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An extraterrestrial Pokémon that may hail from another universe. When it finishes devouring all sources of light on one planet, it moves onto the next.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The liquid encapsulating POKENAME prevents any light from leaking out, causing it to become brighter and more blinding with each second. If it were to take a heavy blow, the liquid would break, and all this light would surge out in an instant.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spins webs out of solid light, creating vast luminous nests inhabited by numerous bug Pokémon. These fibres of light can also conduct electricity extremely well, enhancing the construction of webbing traps used to protect the nest.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's eyes are highly refined crystals made from the rarest minerals it has consumed. Their exceptional purity helps POKENAME focus the bright light it emits into a dazzling spectrum of beams.
author: wavypavy_1

entry: POKENAME can illuminate entire forests, disrupting the natural environment at night. It waits for any captivated Pokémon to come close, then it swings its razor sharp claws towards them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is a ruthless, apathetic Pokémon, taking any source of light and warmth for itself and leaving other Pokémon to freeze. It imprisons those who defy it in a crystalline structure made of pure light.
author: mistymagius

entry: When its desire for light is in harmony with Pink Nectar, its mind clears and finds epiphany within itself and its feathers. It dances in synchronicity with all life as its burning desire for light fades, and it finds peace within itself.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Capable of brightening or darkening the skies at will, such behavior has earned this Pokémon the nickname "The Bright Eclipse". POKENAME willingly uses this ability to its advantage whenever necessary.
author: omegacyclops

entry: POKENAME's wings are formed from glowing bioluminescent slime that shines brightly at night. Trails of this slime can illuminate swamps for centuries, long after it has passed through.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The fungus infecting POKENAME lives just beneath its exoskeleton. It is vividly bioluminescent, illuminating everything around POKENAME.
author: .realthree

entry: Using its light energy, POKENAME can create auroras at will, no matter the location. By dispelling light energy, it can regulate its temperature to survive in hotter environments.
author: soup1900

entry: The light that pours out of this Pokémon is actually icy-cold, completely freezing its surroundings. It surrounds its opponents with auroras, trapping them inside a beautiful light prison.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME are exposed to unfiltered ultraviolet rays for long periods, they mutate and develop features prematurely, most notably a jaw. They can run at speeds of up to 150 kilometres an hour.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: Now unleashed from its prismatic prison, POKENAME will wreak havoc through its songs. It is said to be the most beautiful death one could receive.
author: galactakiller

entry: The dance performances of POKENAME catch the eyes of everyone nearby due to the overwhelming amount of light energy used in them. Its body shines brighter the higher the pitch it sings until, at the highest note, it bursts in golden light.
author: soup1900

entry: The first recorded depiction of POKENAME called it The Dawn's Dragon of Dreams. It was said to appear along the sunrise, its radiant glow blinding some and sending others into months-long slumbers.
author: sk372

entry: The spores that POKENAME releases have the ability to refract light. It uses this to dazzle its opponents and hide its movements.
author: .realthree

entry: The light pouring from POKENAME is so extremely bright it is theorized it could be seen from a galaxy away. Study of this Pokémon is practically impossible, not only due to its rarity, but because of the risk of blindness.
author: chibitales

entry: The heat and light its body gives off is enough to obliterate anything that comes near this Pokémon. Entire biomes have suffered due to its effects.
author: enderlord_guest2.0

entry: The blinding light that pours from this Pokémon's body is highly dangerous to the naked eye. It overwhelms opponents with strobing pulses of light in all perceivable colors, causing anyone not sufficiently protected to become disoriented.
author: fireblade141

entry: When the shining scales of POKENAME clang together, they emit bright flashes of light that can be seen for miles. The moment any of these scales fall off, however, they turn pitch-black as if all the light suddenly leaves them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its four arms to create laser scythes of light energy that slice and destroy anything they touch. These scythes are used to melt away Necrozma fusions who are strangely attracted to POKENAME's light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can create sickles of light energy anywhere on its body and use them to slice down any foe. The light it emits is strangely attractive to many light-gathering Pokémon, causing it to be popular in many worlds and dimensions.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its magical wand to manipulate light energy, casting various spells. These spells can range from creating beautiful rainbows to casting entire light bombs to drop onto enemies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME harnesses the power of light using its magical wand to cast various spells. These spells can range from creating beautiful rainbows to summoning entire light bombs to drop onto enemies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's glowing powder causes anyone they touch to feel a burning sensation in their eyes and wind up with blurred vision. The only known cure for this toxin is to stay inside of a pitch-black room for days until the powder loses its light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's glowing powder causes anyone they touch to feel a burning sensation in their eyes and wind up with blurred vision. The only known cure for this toxin is to stay inside of a pitch-black room for days until the powder loses its light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses light energy to fuel its obsessive digging habits. Laser beams sometimes fire out of the holes it has left behind, making them dangerous to linger around.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME can create golden threads of light from all over its body to capture predators that try to attack it like a net. Its overwhelming light significantly boosts the growth of leaves, giving it near-endless food for it to eat.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME flies in space, its wings scatter light and stardust in all directions. Ancient civilizations often mistook them for comets moving across the sky.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME originates from a reality that was torn asunder through its obsessive digging. Scholars believe it will never stop digging until every single universe is excavated.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME stores a massive amount of absorbed light within its body. With an earth-shaking bellow, it can release beams of light powerful enough to vaporize a mountain peak.
author: sk372

entry: Brimming with the power of light, POKENAME are full of nearly boundless energy. The light they emit can either enhance or ruin the photos that their Trainers take of them, which can sour Trainers who seek out cute Pokémon on raising POKENAME.
author: vic1312

entry: The bananas on the chin of POKENAME allow it to focus its powerful light beams into specific spectrums. As this requires a lot of energy, POKENAME can be found consuming the light of lamp posts.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME causes anyone who is hit by an array of its light rays to have their cells split and duplicate at uncontrollable rates. Areas in the ocean where POKENAME swam through are easy to spot by the overgrown seaweed penetrating the ocean surface.
author: soup1900

entry: The only thing that rivals the brightness of POKENAME's radiant glow is its loyalty. It was once depicted in ancient scrolls defending its friends from evil and darkness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The blinding light at the tips of POKENAME's tails shines brighter the more light they've absorbed. They channel this light into powerful laser blasts that they fire from their mouths.
author: santon5512

entry: The strength POKENAME draws from the crystal on its belt makes it powerful enough to shatter beams of light. As its strength wanes without access to light, it uses its sword to hunt down those that would deprive it of energy.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Legends tell of four POKENAME pulling the sun itself across the sky on a chariot. These Pokémon are capable of running blindingly fast, appearing as nothing more than a blur of light at top speeds.
author: santon5512

entry: When POKENAME moves at top speed, it leaves a blindingly bright trail of light behind it. Its great leaps through the air have been likened to seeing a second sun cut rapidly through the sky.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made almost entirely of shimmering ice and water filled with light. When it dives into the ocean, the resulting splash dazzles and blinds all nearby.
author: .realthree

entry: Inhaling an POKENAME's gasses can cause temporary blindness. If angered, it will let out a searing flash of light.
author: .realthree

entry: It reaches this form upon assimilating a powerful source of light into its body. Its destructive potency is held back by the form's short duration.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME have loose scales inside the bulb on their back. They slam their tail into the bulb to produce a light jingling sound.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it puffs out its cheeks, POKENAME is preparing to blow a poisonous mist that serves to keep pests away from its den. By shaking the scales under its bulb, it alerts the others in its pack, so that they can flee if necessary.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Whacking the bone POKENAME carries against the scale on its skull produces a sharp, resounding sound. It rapidly strikes its skull to produce the shrill noise to irritate and drive off predators.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME never turns its back on opponents, and makes loud noises when threatened. Yet when it is with someone it trusts, it shapes its back into the face of their favourite Pokémon, sparking joy, especially among Youngsters.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When POKENAME forms a deep bond with its Trainer, it offers one of its magnificent scales as a gift. In the wild, it can be found in many different habitats thanks to its remarkable adaptability.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME emits coded signals from the scales on its face. These pulses can disrupt and malfunction nearby computers.
author: .izik

entry: The scale on POKENAME's head glows softly when it's ready to evolve. During this time, it only swims in familiar waters to feel safe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME communicates with others by using the large scale on its tail against the one on its head. Rapid tapping implies aggression, a slow metallic scraping warns of nearby danger, and a single echoing clang is a sign of friendship.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME has a mane that consists of leaves which function as armored scales. The leaves emanate a spicy aroma that pumps up aggression in others.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME senses the amount and quality of sap within a tree by rapping its horn against it. Once it finds a suitable tree, it tears the bark away with its claws, as it detests getting its horn dirtied by the sap it seeks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cares very much about their appearance and sound. They meticulously clean their scales whenever they have a chance. The POKENAME with the shiniest and most pleasant-sounding scales leads the pack.
author: chibitales

entry: Flocks of POKENAME live in seaside coves, dipping their scales in saltwater to stay polished. If disturbed, they attack in unison with Drill Peck.
author: .izik

entry: When it shakes its scales, POKENAME produces a wide variety of sounds and vibrations that it uses to communicate with others of its kind. Its venom can be distilled into antiparasitic lotions that protect many fruit-bearing trees.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the sharp edge of its head scale to slice into stones. Afterward, it eats the fragments to strengthen its body.
author: .izik

entry: During its transitional stage, POKENAME becomes frustrated by its lost mobility as its limbs begin to recede into its body. This process signals the start of its metamorphosis.
author: ultrazombie929

entry: The mountains of Johto once clamored with the sound of POKENAME's rigid feathers. Explorers who summit the highest peaks still claim to hear the echo of a celebratory chime carried by the wind.
author: ozydamians

entry: Their scales emit sound as they dig through terrain. POKENAME have a habit of collecting their favorite stones and smacking them together to make noise.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME hop around, their scale feathers will clang together to create metallic noises that are used to communicate with those around them. When displeased, POKENAME will ruffle its scales, causing it to vibrate with an intimidating sound.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Its quills are hollow despite being tough. When agitated, its quills stand on-end and emit chime-like noises as the wind runs along them.
author: infinex21
