entry: It releases a sweet-smelling mucus that smells like sugar when in water. It gets noticeably sticky in rain, making it easier to lift boulders.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME floats with the aid of its psychic abilities and spreads a sweet aroma wherever it goes. It has a generous nature, offering clumps of delicious sugar from its body to lift the spirits of others.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME creates incredibly sugary and delightful sweets to lift the spirits of others. This skill can also be used in battle, as enemies who taste these sweets are rendered slothful and lose the will to fight.
author: mepp.

entry: Its cylinder-like tube is actually a cotton candy maker. If POKENAME gets hurt, it can heal itself by making new candy to help heal its wounds. They are a great help to bakers in making sweet desserts.
author: duskit___

entry: The sweet-smelling fluff that POKENAME produces is only mildly toxic when ingested. However, its taste is so addictive that many make themselves seriously sick because they can't stop eating it.
author: _._starry_._

entry: POKENAME's maw is made of cotton candy, attracting predators. To defend itself, it spits out a very sweet and sticky substance before running away.
author: nugamallow

entry: POKENAME can be found at sporting events and carnivals, offering cotton candy to everyone. Customers who are rude after purchasing get their sweet treat eaten right in front of them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are said to have the ability to create any sweet that is desired. Many gluttons have chased after them hoping to create the perfect snack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body and vital organs are in the shell. It is most known for the cotton that grows from it, which can be used to make clothing without harm. When its cotton is harvested, it regrows after two weeks.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: Troops of wild POKENAME make their home high atop sheer cliffs and tall trees. Deceptively fierce, they defend their tribe from intruders by extruding a sticky and burning-hot thread.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: This highly energetic Pokémon has a dextrous tail that can regenerate. Brash and territorial, it wields its tail in fights with other POKENAME to establish dominance.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME tend to have tumultuous relationships with Fire-type Pokémon for reasons that are still not entirely clear. Some say that POKENAME are the spirits of patisseries that had little financial success in life.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's blade has a similar taste and texture to many sweetened hard candies. However, it is far more sturdy than candy!
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each blade has a unique flavor. Foolish wild Pokémon that attempt to lick POKENAME are spirited away to parts unknown. POKENAME groom themselves with spectral powers and refuse to be washed by hand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite the sweet smell their fluff gives off, it's not advisable to eat the candy that POKENAME produce. The sugars of their fluff are mixed with a numbing toxin that can leave a person's mouth numb for multiple days.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Marbled colors run along POKENAME's candy-shaped feelers, reminiscent of ripple ice cream. Its sweet-looking body induces hunger that distracts and pacifies foes, while its unique patterns inspire dessert art.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME fires high-pressure bursts of cotton candy from the cannon on its back when angry. Despite sounding harmless, the impact can punch holes through iron slabs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are common companions for confectioners thanks to the sweet secretions they produce from their fur. The taste of the oils they produce varies with time of day and is at its best in the middle of the night.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Wherever POKENAME walks, it leaves behind sticky, cotton candy-like residue from its footprints, alongside shed fur from its bushy tail and neck. Despite their edibility, consuming these remnants can cause a brief addiction to sweets.
author: beatdoof

entry: Once a year, POKENAME come out of hiding to help produce special desserts that get eaten on the turn of the lunar calendar. Their diligence in making these cakes is only rivaled by the amount of sugar they put into them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fluffy body radiates gentle warmth when tending to gardens. This warmth is a sign of joy accompanied by a soft candy corn fragrance that lingers in the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are born with a single soft white tail as sweet as spun sugar. As they grow, each new tail becomes a darker golden brown and carries an increasingly rich caramel scent.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Many aquarists seek out POKENAME due to its unique appearance and pleasant aroma. Chocolate truffles made in the Pokémon's image are a popular confection in the Alola region.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME will only eat things containing high amounts of sugar and refuse anything else. Consequently, they can rarely survive in the wild due to this extreme diet.
author: dodoowner_

entry: After eating a dessert, POKENAME's aura-sensing powers become amplified. It can detect malicious intent from over a mile away and responds by puffing up its fur.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME bounces around, its candy floss fur builds up static that explodes in bursts. Rain dissolves the sugar strands, leaving it sluggish and grumpy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sing soft songs that can put even the rowdiest children to sleep. Their breath smells like ripe strawberries.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: It's constantly on the move in search of sweet food. In the wild, it uses its large jaws to crush berries into a paste to extract the sweet juices out.
author: adam_dnh

entry: The gears on POKENAME's body emit a powerful tart-sugar scent as they turn. When spinning at full speed, the aroma is strong enough to make nearby Pokémon drool.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its unique biological makeup, POKENAME is highly incompatible with water. A downpour can cause it great physical harm. Trainers need to be careful to let it rest if it is hurt by a Water-type attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's adorable looks and sweet-smelling fur appeal to Trainers of all ages, especially children. In reality, this capricious Pokémon is incredibly hard to train, as it can throw a tantrum and stop obeying for the most insignificant reason.
author: milchik

entry: In bakeries and confectioneries, POKENAME is sometimes kept as a guard Pokémon. It releases pink spores from the top of its cotton-like head toward thieves or shoplifters, giving them a fear of sweets and incessant coughing.
author: beatdoof

entry: The squishy body of POKENAME is surrounded in a candyfloss-like substance. This coating is constantly being replaced and reformed as old layers crystalise.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's webbing is made out of a sweet, sugary substance, which is made into a delightful dessert. However, due to the Pokémon's size, getting a large amount of the webbing is difficult, making the dessert a rare dining commodity.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME attracts wild Pokémon with its delightfully sweet smell, luring them to approach. When close enough, it leaps from its hiding place and latches onto its target, sticking to them with a secreted sugary syrup.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's diet consists almost entirely of sugar. The sugar it consumes is converted into a crystalline form, which it uses to create rock candy weapons.
author: hophoppip

entry: The cotton candy fluff on POKENAME's head is made of billions of thread-thin vines. As it walks, they exude a rich pie-like scent that varies with mood and soil.
author: .izik

entry: While dancing, POKENAME releases a soothing scent like freshly baked cupcakes. The aroma pacifies wild Pokémon and has been used in festivals to calm crowds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resembles a pillow case overflowing with candy. While its aroma is described as sickeningly sweet, attempts to consume the contents of POKENAME reveal them to be only sickening.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME makes its nest on mountaintops to evade terrestrial predators. As it descends from its nest, it leaves tufts of wispy, sugary treats in a trail along its flight path.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME are raised for the sweet nectar that is produced from their large flower. The nectar is mixed with other ingredients to make syrups and jams for bakeries.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has large sugar crystals present on its arms that give it all its energy and power. Since it takes a long time to accumulate these sugar crystals, it becomes exceptionally furious and violent if any amount chips off.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as cotton candy to lure unsuspecting victims. Once they are close enough, it latches on with its anchor and feeds on their positive emotions— leaving them with a nasty bellyache.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME leap through the sky, spinning sugar into clouds made of cotton candy. The crystallized, frozen sugar along their bodies reflects the light of the sun, creating shimmering ripples along the clouds that are said to enhance their flavor.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME attack by shooting sticky threads from the various candies decorating their bodies. Being used to high-pressured environments, they only gorge down on hard candies every day.
author: soup1900

entry: Most of its body weight comes from its thick fur, yet it is still so light that it can float for periods of time. While its fur is usually soft like cotton candy, when threatened each strand of its hair can stand on end like thin needles.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's fur has the soft and fluffy feel of cotton candy. The sweet aroma that wafts from its tail weakens the enemy's will to fight.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's neck secretes a sticky cotton candy-like foam which it uses to catch and flavor prey. It refuses to eat anything that isn't sweet.
author: corra_universe

entry: POKENAME's smoke emits a delicious aroma that attracts potential predators. However, licking or biting down on the pie-like exterior is likely to cause burns.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME's are often seen around the fall, trying to find any form of pumpkin flavored sweets. some candy stores use this Pokémon as a means to advertise their candy during October.
author: shadeofblu

entry: POKENAME are drawn to sweet scents, be they from other Pokémon or from human-made foods. To the frustration of many, they can spit incredibly sticky threads which they use to snatch food away from others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME loves sweet treats and will often break into candy stores to grab as many as it can carry. If it eats too much sugar, it will become so hyper that it starts breaking things without thinking.
author: mistymagius

entry: The cake-shaped cap on its head emits a sweet aroma that is irresistible to Bug-type Pokémon, who constantly try to capture it. The fruit on its hat changes depending on the type of Berry POKENAME eats.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are made out of sweet yet hard rock candy that comes from outer space. They have several smaller pieces of candy orbit around their body, each with their own unique extraterrestrial flavor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME gets excited, the flame on its tail flickers blue. When the flame grows bigger, its body starts to smell like burnt sugar.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Its body is made of surprisingly sturdy cotton candy. It is said that it can create any sugary treat it wants in an instant, but in reality, it can only make various flavors of spun sugar.
author: robbery_666

entry: The inception of a now popular and tasty candy was said to be inspired by POKENAME. Researchers are perplexed in regards to the biological purpose of the words that appear on the Pokémon's bodies.
author: mepp.

entry: The inception of a now-popular and tasty candy was said to be inspired by POKENAME. Researchers are perplexed regarding the biological purpose of the words that appear on the Pokémon's bodies.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spits out a sticky string to tangle up its attackers. Unfortunately, the thread is incredibly sweet and most will happily eat their way out within seconds.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: The sweet threads POKENAME produces are a popular garnish on baked goods. Some patisseries keep a POKENAME on hand, even though its habit of playing with the ingredients can leave the kitchen a tangled mess.
author: skittytales

entry: Its fur is consistently sweet in both aroma and taste, and POKENAME's sweet tooth cannot resist the allure. What appears to be constant grooming is just POKENAME ceaselessly tasting its own sugary flavor.
author: sk372

entry: As it rushes across forests, puffs of its cotton candy float in its wake. This cotton candy is filled with static electricity, and will stick to anything.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The blue threads that POKENAME produces are made into a popular candy. Many enjoy its intense sour flavor that leaves a unique tingling sensation in the mouth.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME may be made out of sweet treats but have the same teeth as any other Psyduck. They often have cavities because of their high sugar diet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can mix dough with their long bills to scrape up every bit of dough from the mixing bowl. Many bakeries employ the help of POKENAME for this very purpose.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can summon blizzards of powdered sugar to blind its enemies. It's a useful companion for bakers thanks to its abilities.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its bright colors tend to deter trainers from catching it. To get around this, POKENAME will often hide as candy in small-town stores.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME pearls taste like ice cream, with each pearl melting into a milky, creamy texture. Most POKENAME happily give up their pearls so that they have room to produce more.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its dense, fluffy fur emits a very strong sweet scent. The fur is also sticky in texture thanks to POKENAME's sugary sweat, meaning that it's a total pain to keep clean.
author: fireblade141

entry: Many POKENAME end up as a tasty snack for hungry Pokémon because of their soft, sweet bodies. To avoid being eaten, POKENAME fills the stomachs of hungry Pokémon with sugary water until their hunger is gone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When on land, POKENAME secretes a sticky, sweet-smelling fluid that helps it regulate its temperature. When in the water, the fluid dissolves slowly, leaving a pink-tinted trail.
author: pattybgoode

entry: While first mistaken for a pixie, POKENAME is now classified as a grassland and forest-dwelling Pokémon that can disappear in the blink of an eye. It gorges itself on honey and sweet nectar when it is not sleeping in its secret den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During fair weather, it makes rare appearances in suburban areas in search of sweet confectionery. With a wave of its sugar-laden wand, particles of sugar gather and can be used for offense or consumption.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often work with confectioners, as they can use their psychic abilities to pull sugar until it's full of air bubbles and can be turned into hard candy. All they ask for in return is a fair share of the candy they make.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME are made out of special rock candy that is incredibly hard. Children often break their teeth trying to bite down on POKENAME flakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emit a pleasant sugary fragrance as they run across the plains, thanks to the sweet fluid their body exudes. Apparently, even their saliva is sweet! Most of their body is not edible, however.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME emits a pleasant sugary fragrance as it runs across the plains, thanks to the sweet fluid their body exudes. Apparently, even their saliva is sweet! Most of their body is not edible, however.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME emits a pleasant sugary fragrance as it runs across the plains, thanks to the sweet fluid their body exudes. Apparently, even their saliva is sweet! Most of their body is not edible, however.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's tail was once lauded for its sweet flavor, until it was discovered that POKENAME's fluffy fur is just as sweet and edible, and far more humanely obtained. It's happy to share its own fluff with others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swallow large mouthfuls of saltwater, storing up the salt within their bodies. They mix it with a secretion produced from their cannons to create a sweet taffy that they love to share with other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its shell has valves that produce a Fresh Cream, which chefs collect to produce baked goods. When it is upset, it curls its shell down and stops producing cream until its needs are met.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur will begin to deteriorate when wet, forcing them to live in arid deserts beneath the sand. Their fur is incredibly sweet and a popular dessert at fairs in many regions.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME has the strange power to turn dreams into cotton candy; the better the dream, the sweeter the treat. It avoids bad dreams, as the cotton candy they produce is said to be disgustingly bitter.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its ice cream body is sweet, but the frozen layer atop it is not actually part of POKENAME itself. This natural treat is adored by bakers for its delicate flavor.
author: duskit___

entry: It lives in constant fear of its sweet apple being eaten by another Pokémon, like Poryans. They would rather be eaten whole with their apple than have it taken away, which is why they are always sticking to it.
author: epping_forest

entry: Often mistaken for large confectioneries, POKENAME are prone to being assailed by others seeking to taste their sweetness. In reality, however, their bodies taste horribly sour, and they are unafraid of explosively discharging electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's exterior is a solid shell of candy coating. It allows others to lick it freely, but the sour flavoring of its shell is so intense that those who taste it liken it to an explosive electric shock to the tongue.
author: sk372

entry: Every part of POKENAME's body is edible, the brittle sugar shell encasing a delicious gooey center similar to caramel. Because of this, POKENAME is very rarely seen in the wild.
author: mistymagius

entry: The cacao beans that grow on POKENAME have been used to make an incredibly sweet chocolate. POKENAME that live in particularly sunny places have very sweet beans.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME coats the bones it wields with its thick saliva, forming extremely hard sugar spheres for defense. Many Pokémon hunt it for its sweet scent, so it lives hidden and in isolation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME coats its stick in a layer of crystallized sugar, which it uses as a makeshift cudgel. It tends to avoid hotter climates, as it risks the sugar melting off.
author: mistymagius

entry: It rubs the sugar coating on its weapons against rocks to mark its territory, which it fiercely guards. POKENAME is highly distrustful and attacks aggressively if approached.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are almost entirely made out of dense sugar, and as a result are unpalatable to other Pokémon. When eaten, they induce a sugary shock that subsides quickly, leaving the consumer drained of energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From sunrise to sunset, POKENAME works tirelessly to prepare meals for those in need. Using its candy egg, it makes its signature chocolate sunny-side-up. Children adore its dishes, but parents must limit how much they eat to prevent sugar rushes.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME's diet mainly consists of sugar. In battle, it restrains opponents with blasts of sticky syrup from its vines.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME enjoy helping bakers create sweet, delicious masterpieces. The small companions in their pouches often helps out with more menial tasks, such as sifting sugar or piping frosting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is covered in a protective slime coat that is overly sweet. Predators that bite into this Pokémon will immediately be repelled by the overbearing sweetness of the mucus.
author: adam_dnh

entry: The spores that POKENAME emits from its wings are incredibly sweet and surprisingly edible. Some farmers enjoy sprinkling POKENAME spores on their oatmeal.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME transforms into any dessert it lays eyes on. Despite the form it takes, it always tastes like Cheri Berries.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME taste incredibly sweet and should be eaten in parts. No matter how many times people slice POKENAME, they always end up being eaten in long strips until there is nothing left.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME inhabits round, baked sweets to protect its soft body from external forces. It has a tendency to nibble on its home, however, so it's always on the hunt for a new residence.
author: .realthree

entry: A gluttonous Pokémon with a massive appetite for everything. There have been numerous reports of attacks where POKENAME eat Trainers' supplies clean, including Poké Balls, leaving them with nothing to survive.
author: jackster

entry: It exudes a sweet aroma from its orbs, which some believe resemble candies. Its body is very soft and squishy, though always warm due to the energy swelling within.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dwells inside muddy waters, its tail wafting a sweet scent through the air. Prey that gets too close gets dragged beneath the surface.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME oddly appear gelatinous, yet are very strong and durable. They are drawn to anything they consider to be a pleasant aroma, which they can detect from far away and will fly quickly to such scents to investigate.
author: infinex21

entry: Movie sets in Unova have begun to use POKENAME in action films as a stunt pad. Their gelatinous body prevents injuries for those who land on them, and the stunt people get a sugary hug afterwards for a job well done.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Supposedly, its licorice-like tail contains every kind of flavor. This has not been able to be verified, as this Pokémon only appears long enough to take sweet foods for itself.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME is frightened, it produces heat from its back, scorching its tufts of cream. The burnt cream has a distinct flavor that many Trainers enjoy as a post-battle treat.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's collar is a fluffy cream that could be either whipped cream or nitroglycerin. While both taste sweet, POKENAME only gives off a sweet aroma whenever it is producing whipped cream.
author: nauikun

entry: POKENAME endlessly spin out strings of sugar from their mouth and rear. Pastry chefs often use them to assist in making complex sugar sculptures.
author: hollow_knight26

entry: POKENAME stacks berries it finds on top of its head, saving them for later, and thanks to its perfect sense of balance, they never fall down. It uses future sight to predict when its Trainer or offspring will get hungry to offer them food.
author: milchik

entry: What appears to be wool covering its body is actually cotton candy.  People will frequently try to eat this sugary coating, though it melts off when POKENAME gets wet.
author: bostroms

entry: The residual heat that POKENAME's static produces causes parts of its candy-like wool to soften and become sticky. It is not uncommon for members of a herd to find themselves stuck together.
author: mepp.

entry: The candy on POKENAME's body is so sour that it causes temporary paralysis in humans when eaten. Still, some people eat it as a dare.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The cream growing on POKENAME's back has been prized since ancient times. Thanks to this, pastry chefs have used POKENAME as valuable assistants for centuries.
author: hollow_knight26

entry: Light as air and sweet to the nose, this Pokémon floats with the breeze, trailing the scent of sugar and cream. Some say its aroma is strongest when it's been enjoying vanilla treats.
author: jaminmcready

entry: A pest Pokémon with incredible senses of taste and smell. It raids dwellings for anything that has sugar. As they mature, POKENAME develop unique preferences from one another.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME leaves behind a sweet fragrant trail as it zips through the air. Its flight path is often used to scent shopping areas with bakeries.
author: .izik

entry: Upon evolving, POKENAME are rarely found in the water, instead exploring the scents of the land. Older POKENAME are distinguished by longer gills and are happy to share their experiences with chefs.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Through its mind-reading abilities, POKENAME knows exactly what flavors its Trainer likes and dislikes. Anytime its Trainer is hungry, POKENAME will let them eat some of its sugary fur.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is always thinking of new potential recipes with any possible ingredient in the world. Even though its eyes are covered by its cookie crown, it always knows what it is cooking and just how to cook it to perfection.
author: infinex21

entry: The frozen cream atop POKENAME's back has an unusual flavor that some people will describe as refreshing while others find it disgusting. The cream tends to melt all over POKENAME when it naps in sunlight.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: The cream on its back absorbs sunlight. The more light is absorbed, the larger the cherry on its back grows.
author: hophoppip

entry: While beloved for their cuteness, POKENAME hide a mischievous streak. They have been known to break into ice cream shops and candy stores to devour the strawberry-flavored desserts.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME constantly licks its delicious and incredibly hard candy-like shell, which keeps it smooth and pristine. It greedily hoards its sweet flavor, to the point of detonating the explosive cherry on its top if others don't leave it be.
author: sk372

entry: Miners rely on POKENAME's sensitive nose when working in areas that may contain dangerous gases. When it becomes uncomfortable, it flails wildly to alert nearby miners, and its cone like tail is hard enough to drill through solid rock.
author: chibitales

entry: Its body is made of extremely hard sugar candy. It's nigh-impossible for any predator to bite into it, but it's common for other Pokémon to lick it, which doesn't harm it significantly.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME requires three desserts daily to stay calm. If deprived, it flies into a sugar-starved rage and bites without warning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon to gift a loved one on their birthday. They are usually happy to offer some of the chocolate that oozes from their shell to those partying.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are a common sight in ice cream parlours, with vendors using them to provide emulsifiers to mix their ice creams together. Before the invention of refrigerators and ice cream, POKENAME themselves were a common sweet snack.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bodies have a sweet, syrupy scent that is reminiscent of strawberry jam. They carry fruit on their backs as they move around, gradually feeding on the natural sugars within them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bodies have a sweet, syrupy scent that is reminiscent of strawberry jam. They carry fruit on their backs as they move around, gradually feeding on the natural sugars within them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have gumdrop suction cups on each of their tentacles that allow them to cling to ceilings without falling. They shoot out a pink, inky substance that can be piped onto cakes as icing or diluted to produce a glaze for baked goods.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The icing inside POKENAME's tail is inexplicably delicious and sweet. During the holidays, pastries made alongside these Pokémon often sell out quicker than they can be made.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME balances on a hardened, sugary sphere, rolling from town to town to deliver joy. Its aroma sweetens the air and attracts young children, but touching the sphere risks a dizzying sugar rush.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are most active during winter, running along cold breezes and scattering sugar to leave all they pass feeling refreshed. If two POKENAME clash horns, their normally sweet sugar will turn minty, chilling all in the area.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A Pokémon popular in bakeries, POKENAME is an expert at baking and decorating desserts. They are well known to produce beautiful cakes and will labor for hours to perfect the icing designs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tail frosting can mimic any flavor it has ever tasted. Gourmet bakers prize it for creating perfect cake icings.
author: .izik

entry: Despite their cute smile, POKENAME will bite strangers who become too close to them. The venom from their bites is not fatal, instead causing all sweet foods to taste sour.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's venomous saliva is so sweet that multiple attempts have been made to utilize it as a sugar substitute in candies. Unfortunately, all attempts ended with the consumer's teeth rotting rapidly.
author: afilthycasual

entry: The milk produced by a POKENAME is so sweet and rich that even a Slakoth will be brimming with energy after drinking it. This milk is favored by most bakers for the natural sweetness it has without the need for sugar.
author: infinex21

entry: Many Trainers have dedicated themselves to capturing POKENAME as its treats are said to never go cold or stale. However, POKENAME is incredibly territorial and will attack anything it deems threatening with a geyser of molten sugar.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's mane is made from pure sugar, and each person who tastes its hair tastes a flavor tied to their fondest memory. Many pursue it in vain, but only those with gentle hearts are allowed near its glowing form.
author: jaminmcready

entry: These blissfully ignorant Pokémon secrete a very sweet, cream-like liquid across their entire bodies that people and Pokémon will often fight over. They often swallow food whole by tilting their heads straight up.
author: infinex21

entry: The bodies of these Pokémon are rather sticky to the touch. They often are found with incredibly sour berries growing upon their heads and favor eating sour berries on a daily basis.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME showers candy and sweets with a mysterious powder. The powder is sour at first but slowly becomes sweeter over time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is picky about its desserts, refusing anything less than freshly baked. While it adores soft pastries, it hoards scone crumbs in its fur for snacking between naps.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME carry large forks to be prepared for a meal at a moment's notice. If a POKENAME spots a cake or similar delicacy, it will suddenly thrust its fork forward to scoop up or stab the food before pulling it back to swallow it in one gulp.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Bakeries use POKENAME as helpers, using their spoons to help elderly folks who are not able to keep their hands stable. Despite their disappointed expression, they're sweet in nature, even if they do not show it well.
author: bigoljax

entry: It is said that a POKENAME can physically smell malicious thoughts. Anything made with the sprinkles from a POKENAME will taste like pure nostalgic bliss to whoever consumes them, reminding them of their favorite meals as children.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives in forests, meditating from dusk until dawn. It favors those who are peaceful and gentle. The leaves POKENAME produces have a flavor similar to matcha.
author: dodoowner_

entry: In search of unprotected eggs, hungry POKENAME launch themselves across the faces of cliffs using powerful tails. Being incapable of flight, POKENAME must rely on keen eyes and a sturdy grip while traversing vertical terrain.
author: turron_turron

entry: Though usually living in forests, POKENAME heads to nearby towns to hunt for food. Hiding all but its tail, it lures small Pokémon with the sweet, cake-like smell, then pounces on them.
author: _antiblitzyt

entry: POKENAME licks the edges of its claws to hone them to sharp points useful for combat, digging, and foraging. It periodically sheds its crystallized sugar spines, which are collected by humans for desserts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME use the wheels on the bottoms of their feet to speed through anything in their way. They've grown in popularity as waiters for diners and cafes due to their efficiency.
author: bigoljax

entry: Diners use POKENAME as waiters, using their superior smell to ensure food quality. However, a careful eye is needed, as POKENAME might eat the food they should be serving if they think no one's looking.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Frosting constantly drips down from POKENAME's body, leaving small trails everywhere they go. On hotter days, POKENAME leave entire puddles of frosting.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME can usually be found at festivals, gifting sweet treats to those it likes. However, it is quite timid and will flee back into the woods if someone tries to take its treats by force.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's cake-like body emits such a sweet aroma that will attract and subdue most Pokémon, no matter how aggressive they usually would be. Its giant lollipop is both a conduit for its psychic power and an infinite source of sweets.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME smells a foul odor, it becomes very stressed. Desserts are known to help calm it down, as their delicious scents uplift the Pokémon's spirits.
author: mepp.

entry: The ice cream on the arms of POKENAME constantly replenishes. During hot summer days, POKENAME will fly up and spin rapidly, raining ice cream down for all that need to cool down.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: A single pastry from POKENAME's box contains over 108 different flavors, overwhelming the taste buds of any consumer. They present these pastries to people and Pokémon they like and don't seem to understand how overwhelming their sweets are.
author: chibitales

entry: Known to be fierce, POKENAME's sweet tooths are only fiercer. They often raid candy shops and bakeries to soothe their appetite.
author: bigoljax

entry: Its legs have grown stronger to carry the cherry on its back. Said cherry is both delicious and effective as a blunt weapon.
author: hophoppip

entry: Delicious desserts naturally grow on top of POKENAME's body, replenishing any consumed portions overnight. Many bakeries use them as mascots and ways to offer free samples.
author: sk372

entry: Though it is made of sugar, POKENAME's maw is hard enough for a Sharpedo to break its teeth on. When it is hungry, POKENAME licks its maw for sustenance.
author: nugamallow

entry: POKENAME disguise their tentacles as assorted desserts to lure in prey. They rarely move from the locations they are anchored to, using their incredible sense of smell to detect areas with high amounts of food available.
author: hollow_knight26

entry: POKENAME often come into conflict with other Pokémon, particularly Lickitung, due to their sweet-tasting skulls. Their sticky saliva is easily influenced by what they eat, with over fifty different flavors having been discovered thus far.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's skull is hard enough to break the jaw of predators like Tyrantrum, a frequent opponent in the wild. During warm seasons, it sheds sugary puddles of its skin, allowing it to charge faster but with less power.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are often seen helping out in kitchens with or for their Trainers. Wild POKENAME, however, are just as active in procuring and producing treats and simple foods for younger Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are spirits born from leftover, uneaten sweets left to waste away. They are drawn to consume more and more sweets, especially those that would otherwise go to waste, further growing in size the more that they consume.
author: infinex21

entry: When a Slurskull has consumed enough sweets, it evolves into a POKENAME that is dripping with pure, liquid sugar and dressed in discarded wrappers. This Pokémon will often haunt those who waste perfectly good food and those who litter.
author: infinex21

entry: The torso of a POKENAME is a hollow cavity that can open like a mouth, from which it can pull out fully-baked goods as if by magic. Any who steal these goods will be plagued with misfortune and be met with the worst tastes they can imagine.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are said to create the richest desserts in the world. Many chefs and bakers travel the world to obtain new techniques from POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is mischievous by nature and often finds ways to prank others with its stealthy, acrobatic antics. The only trace of its tricks afterward is bits of cotton candy on the ground and the smell of burnt sugar and cherries.
author: theunholyhandgrenade

entry: POKENAME mysteriously appear during the winter season. However, they don't survive long in the wild because of all the Bug-type Pokémon attracted by its scent.
author: pokebio

entry: The cake POKENAME keeps precariously balanced is cursed. POKENAME will cut up and serve a portion of this treat, but any Pokémon who eats it has its vitality drained.
author: pattybgoode

entry: In order to survive the desert heat, its body is covered in a sticky substance. The syrupy layer has a delightful smell and taste, so POKENAME are sought after by chefs and perfumers.
author: adam_dnh

entry: POKENAME makes its home in cool caverns and tundras where it is less prone to melting. Brave pastry chefs seek to acquire shed sugary scales to elevate their bakes, but must watch out for a blast of its caramel-like breath.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The internal mechanics of a POKENAME constantly create various desserts. It reserves the richest and most decadent confections for its Trainer.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME adores baking for its friends. Often its ribbons function as extra hands, assisting it in the baking process.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: The sweet treats baked by POKENAME are mixed with a secret ingredient that makes them irresistible. Café masters and researchers alike have tried to discover the source of this infusion to no avail.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME have a very low body temperature, their movements restricted as they maintain the ice cream-like texture of their bodies. They gradually become faster and more dangerous as their bodies begin to melt and become more fluid.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some hospitals have begun using POKENAME for their warmth and the ability to sense hidden medical conditions. The sweets harvested from its tail are said to have a calming effect.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME shed their fur easily, their hairs very fine and downy. Their body fur is formed of a compound that easily dissolves in water and is very sweet, making them a popular addition to desserts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Certain high-end dessert locations use POKENAME to keep desserts cold while they are flown to far regions. Those who attempt to eat from their wings are frozen on the spot.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME love to give out sweet chocolate treats to Trainers and Pokémon, as their bodies produce stunning edible arrangements on their hands. Many couples rent out a POKENAME to enjoy sweet treats while on a date.
author: quackquackattack

entry: What appears to be 'melting sweets' below POKENAME's cap is actually excess mucus from its body, as are the 'cherries' atop its cap, being solidified spores. Through its guttation, it feeds its fellow Fairy Pokémon, able to sustain them for months.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's bodies are made from a mix of frosting and cream. They love to lick at their gumdrop paws, keeping them sticky to grab onto items better.
author: bigoljax

entry: Some POKENAME have clumps of fur that harden and crystalise into solid chunks of sugar. These clumps can be harmlessly removed and will regrow in time, and they are a common ingredient in Kalosian candy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It produces beads of cream that are collected by bakers as a topping for baked goods. Its creamy beads are used in various sweet treats, such as the Jubilife Muffin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The faint scent of sugar constantly lures on POKENAME, attracting other Pokémon. They're used by bakers to carry cakes and pastries, sometimes tea as well.
author: bigoljax

entry: A member of an ancient race of guardian entities, it has fallen into disrepair because people keep trying to break open its chest cavity to obtain the candy within.
author: bostroms

entry: This Pokémon can create sweet smelling will-o'-the-wisps and control them at will. If there's a scent POKENAME particularly likes, the orbs will reflect that scent until it gets bored of it.
author: chibitales

entry: Dressed in colorful cloth, POKENAME participates in local autumn festivities with unbridled happiness. When these celebrations die down, it returns back into the wilderness.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's heads often antagonize each other by licking the other's hair when bored. Trainers are advised to be prepared for POKENAME to have sticky hair when petting them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: A skilled hunter and a picky eater, having POKENAME enjoy your food is a sign that you are a world-class chef.
author: notsaying.

entry: The tails of POKENAME contain a variety of sweets they store to enjoy throughout their lifetime. During festivals, one or two POKENAME may happily share treats from their tails, often rewarded for their generosity with even more sweets.
author: chibitales

entry: It is said POKENAME is the embodiment of compassion and honesty. It produces a pure vanilla extract that is sought after by prestigious bakers.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has a friendly personality and is hyperactive, which has led to many families adopting one before they are ready to care for it. As the seasons change, POKENAME sheds sticky fur, which clump together into bite-sized sweets.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME may appear bland, but they are some of the sweetest Pokémon that exist. They earn this reputation through their sugary dough and their considerate personality.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produce a frothy foam from their backs that has the consistency of ice cream. They grow large cherries in this foam. When ripe, the cherries have a wonderfully sweet taste and are the prize of restaurants everywhere.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spins a small spiral of scorching icing around it, burning those who come in contact with it. As time passes, the icing cools down, and it eventually caramelizes.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME release hot icing from their tails that melts into a sugary glaze. Many bakers rely on their help to finish off delicious pastries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often seen at fancy banquets, acting more as an elegant decoration than an actual dessert. Their body is coated in a syrup that makes anything it's coated in as sweet as pure sugar.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that POKENAME inspired the creation of pudding long ago. Its body possesses an intensely sweet flavor.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME is coated in a dangerously sweet syrup, making its attacker regret trying to take a bite of it. When diluted properly though, its syrup can be used in all sorts of popular desserts.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rubs traces of its sticky scales around its territory since its strong sense of smell will lead it back to its den. Its tusks are brittle and if they break, the process to regrow them requires a diet high in sugar.
author: pjporwoll

entry: By using their incredible sense of smell, POKENAME track and lure in prey using their sweet appearance. Upon finding anything that might be prey, they are quick to attack with paralytic venom.
author: hollow_knight26

entry: Known as the ideal steward for long-distance airships, POKENAME gracefully serve food and soothes anxious passengers midflight. Its cold aura keeps meals perfectly chilled until served.
author: jaminmcready

entry: As POKENAME dances, its feathers heat up and release a sweet scent. Opponents that are mesmerized by its dance are quickly enveloped in flames.
author: chibitales

entry: While it may be tempting to unwrap POKENAME's inviting exterior, doing so reveals a shocking and repulsive sight that many wish they hadn't seen.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It is widely advised to not touch POKENAME. Its body is a hodgepodge amalgamation of sticky desserts designed to entice Pokémon and Trainers alike. Those who make contact with POKENAME often find themselves stuck and unable to escape.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The substance POKENAME's body is made of is dangerously addictive. If eaten in an excessive amount, it can cause heart problems due to the high sugar content.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME wander around villages grabbing any discarded sweets they can find. Every night, POKENAME host elaborate tea parties for other wild Pokémon.
author: turron_turron

entry: The act of sharing food with others brings POKENAME immense joy. Using any means necessary, POKENAME will produce enough pastries to feed everyone around it.
author: turron_turron

entry: The joyful humming, alongside its cotton candy appearance, make POKENAME a sought after Pokémon for vendors of all kinds. The shed puffs of cotton candy from its wings are said to be delicious enough to bring even the most hardened adults to tears.
author: chibitales

entry: Its body secretes a sticky, sweet-smelling slime that hardens in the sun to a texture and scent reminiscent of butterscotch. Trainers often find trails of hardened sugar crust wherever a POKENAME has passed.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its body oozes an edible, almost sickly-sweet cream so sticky and thick that it is nearly impervious to most attacks. Even if attacked, a POKENAME will still offer some of its cream to its assailant.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME absorbs sugars and gluten from any food it comes into contact with, adding to its mass. Its chemically-dense body is hazardous if eaten by humans or smaller Pokémon.
author: ohok3441

entry: The cherry atop POKENAME's head contains fluid that aids in balance. With it, it performs flips and wrestling moves with perfect form.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are commonly found during festivals. But if you see one, under any circumstances, do not remove the dango on its head as it will curse you.
author: pokebio

entry: It emits a pleasant aroma akin to milk chocolate, and oozes a fluid that tastes like pudding from the middle of the bud on its head. Unfortunately, all parts of its body, including its secretions, are highly toxic.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Popular with families across Johto, POKENAME have a friendly disposition and are fiercely loyal to their allies. POKENAME possess an intense appetite for sugar, and when they catch wind of a snack they'll stop at nothing to steal a bite.
author: turron_turron

entry: The sweet, sticky fur of POKENAME is its pride and joy. It attracts its prey with its scent and the large cherry on its head.
author: wyzi

entry: Young girls often love listening to POKENAME's peppy and exciting music. A candy company in Kalos has successfully used its songs in its marketing.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME is an expert chef and capable fighter and has been known to prepare pastries in the middle of its fights. The pastries are so saccharine that they have been known to cause asphyxiation and knock out its opponents faster than it can.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: The air bubbles within POKENAME's pastries allow it to glide in the air with ease, despite their dense appearance. The smell of freshly baked treats wafts through the sky as it soars, leaving a trail of powdered sugar behind.
author: piponus

entry: POKENAME uses its stored glucose as fuel to raise its power dramatically. The sugars binding its body together are theorized to taste extraordinary, if only researchers could figure out how to extract some without being vaporized by the raw energy.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME can be found in warehouses, disguising themselves amidst heaping stores of food. At night, smaller Pokémon will eagerly raid these stockpiles, only to become a patient POKENAME's meal.
author: turron_turron

entry: The growth on its back resembles an often-beloved, albeit incredibly sticky, sweet treat covered in colorful sprinkles. These sprinkles are actually different types of mushrooms that have varying effects when consumed.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is known for its intense passion towards protecting others. The presence of its mighty berry shield and courageous spirit inspires awe in friend and foe alike.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic flames to whip airy meringue clouds that soothe anyone who breathes them in. Its sweet creations are said to lift the spirits of even the saddest Trainer.
author: ilyhef_82709

entry: Its shell is similarly composed to a popular dessert called "pastafrola". It has a warm and sweet smell and taste, but strangely, anyone who dares to take a bite will have its intestines instantly blown up from the inside in a glitter explosion.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is most active during fall holidays, pretending to be a delicious pumpkin spice latte treat. If someone takes a sip, POKENAME will possess them and force them to go around begging people for candy.
author: soup1900

entry: While they are rather docile in nature normally, on a full moon, POKENAME will try to curse anyone who it can smell has sweets, forcing them to hand them over to undo the curse. It has a tendency to target the same individuals when this happens.
author: shadeofblu

entry: Slurpuff's influence has mellowed the usually rude Scrafty. While POKENAME often appear lazily blowing bubbles, swings of their rock candy clubs can break boulders.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: It stores excess nutrients on its back in the form of a sweet custard-like paste. Unfortunately, this makes it a common target for predation.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its shell is made of a glass-like material that contains a core filled with sugary treats. When its Trainer wins a battle, POKENAME allows them to take a candy as a reward.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's skin naturally emits a sweet, sugary scent, which it uses to lure strong opponents into battle. The smell intensifies as it becomes more agitated, warning others nearby to steer clear.
author: theartemis1

entry: The substance contained in its body cavities is chemically identical to chocolate.  Myths say that if two people eat this substance together, they will be in love forever.
author: bostroms

entry: Trainers are advised not to splice this fusion outdoors. Its soft, sweet body makes it a valuable food source for bird Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: Deserts based upon POKENAME attempt to capture the rich creamy texture and subtle, sweet flavour without having to harm the Pokémon. Connoisseurs of POKENAME insist that the trio of flavours of the Pokémon simply can't be replicated artificially.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When a cold wind suddenly whips through a restaurant, it's a sign that POKENAME has broken in to steal all the desserts. It commands Swirlix followers to distract anyone in pursuit.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME help pastry chefs pair ingredients for new recipes with their keen sense of smell. Each POKENAME will only assist with recipes it personally likes, so some bakeries keep an entire team on hand.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME collects Berries and small fruits, which it stores in the sticky cream on its head and paws.
author: hophoppip

entry: The cream on POKENAME's body is very sticky. It dislikes getting dirty, so it licks off anything that gets stuck in the cream.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its gelatinous body takes on the flavor of whatever it eats. Many humans raise POKENAME on specially formulated diets so they'll produce the most delicious jelly.
author: hophoppip

entry: The sweet-smelling syrup coating POKENAME's body is intensely hot and can scald on contact. Once cooled, it can be used in cooking and is praised by culinarians across Sinnoh.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are made out of a sugary cream that is incredibly sweet. Whenever they enter water, the sugary compounds on their body leech into the water and turn it into a thick sugary slurry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often wake up from their rest to find that they have been buried deep within a pie. Their bodies become dyed with the violet color of blueberries, making their bodies incredibly sweet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is an ideal fusion to have around on hot days, as its cold, creamy body has a refreshing flavor, and it can conjure rain clouds to cool off those in the heat.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME prefers clean, cold regions where snow is abundant. The colder the air, the sweeter its body becomes.
author: mepp.

entry: This variant of POKENAME flies rather unevenly due to the gummy worms wriggling everywhere. Those worms are very sweet and juicy.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME love to balance large jawbreakers atop their head and refuse to go anywhere without one. If they need to remain still for a long period of time, they lodge the jawbreaker between their candy cane tusks to keep it still.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to their vision being obscured, POKENAME often collide into their Trainers with the intent of giving hugs. This works in POKENAME's favor, as they will also flatten potential poachers who are after the sweet strawberry ice cream on their head.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are commonly used by bakers, specifically as taste testers for sweets and pastries. They're sweet, social creatures, requiring their Trainer's full attention at all times.
author: bigoljax

entry: The pearls of POKENAME are edible and incredibly sweet, as each pearl is a different flavor of ice cream. Many bakeries harvest POKENAME pearls regularly to incorporate these pearls into their baking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The cream it secretes from its head is edible, and has a taste reminiscent of old-fashioned molasses candy. It's unwise to eat too much of this cream, as much like a Relicanth's body, it is very fatty.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME produce a sticky, licorice-flavored substance from their back. This delicious gel-like substance is also incredibly sticky, making it perfect for connecting baked goods together for specialty cakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This plucky patissier pup is pursuing its dreams to make the perfect sweet treat. However, its hyperactive nature often gets in the way of this goal.
author: evilgammon

entry: It bears an odd resemblance to a Paldean Pokémon. Like that Pokémon, its breath is filled with yeast, making it an ideal partner for bakers.
author: hophoppip

entry: This Pokémon leaves behind a sweet scent as it dashes around looking for the best berries to munch on. Some bakeries even employ POKENAME's help to bake pastries to perfection. Its nose is very sensitive to even the faintest of smells.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's skin naturally emits a bitter Rawst Berry scent, which it uses to lure strong opponents into battle. The smell intensifies as it becomes more agitated, warning others nearby to steer clear.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME is interested in baking, and will assist its Trainer with recipes. Its body is sticky and smells of cinnamon.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite using kitchen utensils for weaponry, POKENAME fights with the skill and demeanor of a brave and noble knight. When not in combat, it happily uses its tools to assist in cooking and baking as well.
author: sk372

entry: When near ice cream trucks, POKENAME uses psychic influence to charm passersby into offering sweets. It vanishes the moment it gets its treat.
author: .izik

entry: Renowned throughout regions for their cooking, POKENAME use their mixing spoons to find the perfect balance of flavors. The one problem with enjoying a POKENAME's meal is that they insist everything be eaten with spoons.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME works alongside bakers to make delicious treats with its flames. It operates ovens where it ensures cupcakes are baked to perfection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are sometimes used to make the perfect chocolate lava cake. While this sounds great, POKENAME are notoriously picky, and will only eat food they cook.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's tentacles are coated with a sour-tasting sugar that its prey can't resist. Many confectioners harvest POKENAME's sugar to create delicious candies.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: Despite its sweet smell and taste, POKENAME's outer shell is extremely tough. It will become agitated if people attempt to harvest its armor, delivering swift punches with its four arms.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME love to chew on their cookie-like tails, though their jaws aren't strong enough to bite through. Cafes commonly use them as baristas, as they're quite good at making coffees and hot chocolates.
author: bigoljax

entry: Due to their similar appearance, POKENAME can sometimes be found sleeping in boxes of taffy, mistaking the candy for other POKENAME. If threatened, it will spin around vigorously to disorient their opponent.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's heads come in all sorts of flavors, the heads will even try to lick each to get a taste. Be cautious, because if you decide to lick one, you won't be able to sleep for 3 days straight.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's sludge-like body takes on the smell of what it recently ate, more often than not being berries or other sweet foods. Pokémon that attempt to prey on POKENAME are initially lured in by this smell, only to be repelled by its horrible taste.
author: chibitales

entry: With its incredibly voracious appetite, POKENAME will stop at nothing to get its hands on any food it smells. Its immune system is strong enough to prevent it from getting sick if it eats something rotten.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME keep their body temperature just slightly below freezing, keeping the ice cream that forms their body solid. They are popular Pokémon with carnivals, happy to gift sweet treats to children.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a sweet tooth, needing 1kg of sweets per day. Due to this diet, it has a very sweet scent.
author: pokebio

entry: Beware of desserts lying around in the forest with nobody else around. POKENAME may be placing bait to lure people away from the main paths so it can steal their life force.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: Using telekinesis, POKENAME bakes desserts with flawless precision. Its pastries are prized by top chefs for their perfect texture and balance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lace their sweet treats with berries that cause drowsiness. They pass treats out to pedestrians, hoping to eat their nightmares.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for confectioners to make treats based on, often using the Pokémon itself as a model to work from. With a crisp chocolate shell, and sprinkles on their head, they are a favourite of children.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though POKENAME tries to disguise itself as a yellow Apricorn, its red 'stem' always gives it away. It waits in trees to ambush foes by launching itself at their heads from above.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME takes pride in their skull helmets and will intentionally try to break their rival's helmet to shatter their pride. In embarrassment, they will drape their loose skin over their heads to hide the damage.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is found in small groups in the countryside. Although its outer layer of skin will continue to shed, other layers of POKENAME's epidermis will not while POKENAME awaits evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Stubborn and loving, POKENAME sometimes collects its shed skins and gives them to the newborns it may carry in its pouch. These skins act as a blanket, giving them a sense of comfort and security.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is found in small groups in the countryside. Although its outer layer of skin will continue to shed, other layers of POKENAME's epidermis will not while POKENAME awaits evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live similar lives to Butterfree, but they fly in search for small fruit instead of nectar. In addition, they molt much more frequently, too.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The excess skin that piles up on POKENAME's pincers protects it from self-inflicted harm when it crushes its pincers together with devastating force. It's common to find shed POKENAME skin laying about on spring days.
author: .realthree

entry: Due to POKENAME's gluttonous nature, its pants never fit. If there is more to eat, POKENAME may take off the pants first to make more room.
author: musicsheep.

entry: In the wild, POKENAME lives in murky lakes and has tiny eyes that render it almost blind. Trainers that raise POKENAME have to teach it not to constantly bump into things, though with enough time and training it is able to improve its eyesight.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are often seen in dumpsters and dark alleyways. When night falls, POKENAME patrol the streets to defend their gang's territory.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME's glare strikes fear into foes, forcing them to flee before it even attacks. When cornered, it fights with relentless ferocity, locking its powerful jaws to overpower almost any challenger.
author: curazy

entry: It has difficulty escaping from tough situations when its scales cling to its body. A properly equipped Eject Pack allows it to pull back once the fighting gets tough.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME learns about its environment by biting new things it encounters, following up with a solid headbutt to test the entity's toughness. It is self-conscious and will attack anyone that mocks the appearance of it or its companions.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Some people are so unnerved by POKENAME's unblinking, disheveled appearance that they claim that staring into its face for too long will curse you. In reality, the only curse that comes from making eye contact is an electrified headbutt.
author: .realthree

entry: With strong antisocial tendencies, POKENAME can be a bit of a hassle to deal with. Eye contact is seen as a challenge, prompting it to immobilize its new foe with psychic powers before delivering a painful headbutt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fashion their spare skin into large bags to carry treasures they've pilfered, styling them into false jaws to try and appear more intimidating. Unfortunately, to properly display their props, they would have to risk spilling their hoard.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's loose skin protects it from brute force injury, allowing it to headbutt its opponents with reckless abandon. However, it does need to shed often so its skin isn't at risk of tearing in battle.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rapidly charge into each other to try and train, not caring about the force of the collision due to the durability of their faces. Unfortunately, while they are physically unharmed, the sound of the impact leaves them dizzy for a while.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are composed of magnetic stones that normally cause them to always face north. In order to properly travel, they will headbutt the ground hard enough to chip their stones temporarily, allowing them enough motion to turn until it grows back.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's skin is made of a thin layer of metal, allowing it to be both strong and flexible. However, because of how frequently it sheds, it has to get 20 times its body weight in iron a day.
author: mistymagius

entry: In the wild, POKENAME spins its gear-like body rapidly to build momentum before delivering powerful kicks. Its metal parts clank loudly, warning foes of an incoming attack.
author: curazy

entry: If the POKENAME you are battling begins taunting and leering at you, that means it has already abandoned the battle. It puts up illusions of itself swaggering at foes to hide its escape.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME carries its shed skin wherever it goes. It often enjoys offering rides to smaller Pokémon.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME is surrounded by a thin, goopy ooze that is contained by a clear outer shell. The casing holding the liquid is nigh on indestructible, though it doesn't protect the Pokémon inside from crashing against said casing.
author: .realthree

entry: In the wild, POKENAME navigates dark caves using echolocation, its loose skin muffling sound to sneak up on prey. When it strikes, it aims for the neck to disable targets quickly.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME's skin resists electricity, allowing it to absorb shocks and store energy to release when it feels threatened.
author: curazy

entry: Despite trying to appear tough and dutiful, POKENAME is rather easily startled. If someone gets too close to something it's guarding, POKENAME will leap forward to headbutt them at full force, more worried about the threat than where they're flying.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Burrowed beneath the sand, POKENAME lies in wait for anyone that enters its territory. If it spots prey, it will slip under their foot to suddenly flip up and knock them onto their back before leaping out of the sand to deliver a powerful shock.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Repeatedly headbutting cavern walls in pursuit of gems, POKENAME often stumble around rattled after their hard work. Any Trainer that offers an exhausted POKENAME a gemstone will find themselves with a loyal new partner.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often lulls foes to sleep with a sweet floral scent, but sometimes it dozes off first.  While asleep, POKENAME continues to absorb nutrients through its roots.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME uses the saggy folds of its body to store shiny objects and bits of trash it finds while wandering. Due to its small size, it can only attack people's shins if they try to clean up its treasures.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME can release a strong, pungent odour from the flower on its head to repel predators. Its toxic spores can cause fatigue or confusion.
author: curazy

entry: Feeling the various textures on POKENAME's body has been shown to be beneficial to the brain development of small children. Though POKENAME has a plushy appearance, it is possessed of one of the hardest skulls known to science.
author: .realthree

entry: The large sleeve-like flaps over a POKENAME's arms are to make it appear bigger than it actually is. If its intimidation fails, it will wildly flail the spiked sleeves to disorient and hopefully scratch its foes, finishing them off with a headbutt.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME lift the excess skin from their lower body as an excuse to flare out the spikes on their arms and threaten foes. To prevent their exterior from coming loose, they hook the spare skin onto their spikes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME rapidly bursts up from the sand to knock litter or intruders into the air. It repeats this process over and over until its target has either learned their lesson or been properly disposed of.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has an elastic slime mold growing from between the plates of its exoskeleton. It can stretch out this fungus to absorb the force of attacks directed against it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME collects large nuts and takes them back to its den, using its blunt teeth to break through the tough shell. It is quite timid and will quickly flee into its den if spotted by another Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are common partners for arctic explorers as their thick coat can resist air temperatures of -30 degrees. However, in the warmer months, POKENAME has a high risk of overheating.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is tiny and mostly covered in fluffy, sweet-scented fur. It demands sugary treats from other Pokémon, using quick kicks to enforce its will.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME often damages its crest due to its habit of headbutting anything it sees. It always wears yellow skin over its head to make itself look tougher than it actually is.
author: soup1900

entry: With its small pupils, POKENAME's night vision is very poor, so it lights its way using the fire contained by the skin on its tail. The yellow light this casts washes out color, making it harder to see the bright red markings on this Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon that prefers to only emerge from the ground once it is completely dark outside. Its large eyes help it see in low-light conditions, and its hard skull protects it from cave-ins.
author: .realthree

entry: Although POKENAME can stand upright, it prefers to move on all fours to support the weight of its skull. When threatened, it fully extends its coiled tail to make itself appear larger.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME struggle to keep their bill in front of their face and often lose it when fighting in a Pokémon battle. Like their baggy garments, they often need to pause to fasten their bill back onto their face.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often forget what they are doing because they have to constantly pull up their baggy pants. Forcing them to remember anything is difficult and causes them to develop a headache from the strain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Snowy weather allows POKENAME to be more active and energetic. It gathers ice crystals around its head to harden it and make its flying headbutt attacks more effective against opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to flex its strength to an audience, often engaging in extravagant bouts with others of its kind. While its stretchy skin provides valuable protection, it often gets drenched in large amounts of sweat.
author: mistymagius

entry: As it is constantly trying to become stronger and stronger, POKENAME is also constantly shedding its skin to make room for its growing body. If the rubbery skin on its lower half breaks, it becomes deeply embarrassed and it starts shedding en masse.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's leaves are surprisingly muscular, allowing them to spar with one another. After a fight, it will shed its rubbery skin and patiently waits in the trees until it regrows.
author: mistymagius

entry: The two heads of POKENAME constantly get into squabbles, headbutting into each other in order to settle their debates. The body often trips over itself from the force of the impact of each collision.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: In the wild, POKENAME picks fights with cliffs and boulders, mistaking them for rivals. Despite its size, it naps often, usually after headbutting something too hard.
author: curazy

entry: This POKENAME tries to put others to sleep with hypnotic stares and muttered threats, but often ends up dozing off mid-sentence. It's common to find it asleep in the middle of a battle, snoring while still clenching its fists.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME itches for combat and is eager to leap into any fray. It uses explosive power to boost itself forward head-first towards an opponent to strike them with its solid head-crest.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME will sometimes claim a small forest clearing or a city block as their territory. Anyone who disrespects their authority is met with a brutal Beat Up by each of POKENAME's equally cruel heads.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It claims small patches of trees as its territory. If any Pokémon attempt to damage these trees, it will deliver a roundhouse kick capable of launching them far into the ocean.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Although they nest far outside of urban areas, POKENAME often venture inside to steal whatever food they can. Their tongue consists of powerful and well-developed muscles that allow them to move and pilfer heavy objects effortlessly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During battle, POKENAME tosses its egg into the air. While the opponent is distracted, it lands a surprise Headbutt.
author: .izik

entry: When a foe enters its domain, POKENAME entangles them and shrieks loudly. Its kin gather quickly to attack in unison with Beat Up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gleefully joins any fight, where it sings a battle hymn and swishes its skirt of shed skin to distract foes and protect allies. It rejects most authority, making it difficult to train, but becomes a merciless defender of those it trusts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If an intruder approaches, the gems on POKENAME's tail glow yellow. It summons thunderclouds as a show of power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME doesn't use silk to make its webs, it instead uses a rubber-like polymer that acts more like a thick tarp than a net. During the night, POKENAME will wrap itself in its web to sleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME builds static in the folds of skin on its neck as it walks. It unleashes bursts of electricity through the frill atop its head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are known to be poetic rappers all around the world. It can sing any musical genre a person can think of and can even mentally damage foes with deep emotional lyrics.
author: zaymcawesome

entry: POKENAME sways calmly in the sunflower field it calls home. Fiercely territorial, it unleashes Bullet Seed at any Pokémon that tries to feed on its surrounding flora.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides shiny objects in its loose skin after scavenging. At night, it picks one to display proudly in its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often seen loitering around in dark alleyways and on abandoned train lines. They mark their territory through unique tags, with territorial disputes settled through art competitions.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: As danger nears, POKENAME beats its tiny wings rapidly to show dominance. If the threat gets too close, it retaliates with a Sand Attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tunnels between mountain peaks to survey its territory. It challenges rivals with a fierce Headbutt to claim their turf.
author: .izik

entry: It attacks unfortunate individuals who venture onto mountain trails to rob them of all their belongings. It is a very territorial creature and marks stones with symbols associated with its group to let everyone know that the place belongs to it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Before battle, POKENAME pulls its hood over its head to guard its cave. It growls deeply as it fights, using Scary Face to intimidate foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME marks its territory by painting on walls with the fluid from its tail. Territorial wars between POKENAME leave entire areas coated with paint.
author: hophoppip

entry: Clusters of POKENAME cling to cave walls as sentries. They use Scary Face to drive away intruders from their domain.
author: .izik

entry: Over the course of their lives, POKENAME form tightly-knit groups with other wild Pokémon. During the winter, these groups will raid nearby cities in search of food, medicine, and valuables.
author: turron_turron

entry: The acid from POKENAME's tail marks its territory with ease. If threatened, it retaliates with a powerful High Jump Kick.
author: .izik

entry: Differing from its pre-evolution, POKENAME is very protective of its Trainer. It uses its ability to see the future to see if its Trainer is in danger. When it senses a threat, it fights off the danger using dirty fighting tactics.
author: mintvy.

entry: Metal frills along POKENAME's back enhance its focus. Its Confusion attack can leave opponents dazed for hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely territorial of its desert oasis home. If it spots an intruder, it traps them in a Sand Tomb before swiftly finishing them off.
author: .izik

entry: The frills on POKENAME's rear mouth detect moisture in the air. This helps it locate underground water sources in deep caves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shed skin is as hard as steel. When attacked, it will pull up its skin to defend itself, then retaliate with a powerful kick. Anyone who tries a sneak attack from behind will get chomped by its jaw-like horns.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's head is very durable; it can easily smash through even the toughest of rocks. As such, it is a very popular Pokémon among those who work in caves or demolition.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME claims large areas of jungle as its territory and will violently pummel anyone who enters it. Its loose skin acts like a pouch, allowing it to carry large amounts of berries.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a natural rebel and will intentionally disregard commands just so it can stand out. If it encounters another POKENAME, it will try to avoid copying their behavior so it can be seen as non-conforming.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides out in populated slums, cruelly bullying any people or Pokémon weaker than it. It will often disguise itself as a regular baseball bat, trying to trick unsuspecting children into picking it up.
author: mistymagius

entry: The scarf-like skin of POKENAME detects subtle temperature shifts. When rain nears, it hides its metal body to avoid rusting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are notorious thieves, swiping valuable items such as Poké Balls from Trainers and smuggling them to others in cloaks of their molted fur. Attempts to steal from them instead, however, will be met with a retaliatory Headbutt.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME gather in packs, where they trade ideas for how to create the coolest custom clothing and accessories. The leader of the pack is the one with the toughest-looking fashion.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME fills its thick skin with hot air to drift across desert skies. It searches from above for unaware prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fights with attitude, leading with slaps from its large ears and following with heavy kicks. Its use of colorful skin sheddings as armbands, legguards, and a facemask has inspired a vibrant fashion style in the Unovan punk scene.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's fused eyelids serve as an intimidation tactic and eye protection from sand grains and sunlight. When raiding a Pokémon's den, it pulls the shedding over its snout, hiding its features and signaling confidence it will not need its jaws.
author: pjporwoll
