entry: When its shell grew too heavy for it to remain in the ozone layer, it fell to the ground below and left a massive crater upon impact. Its body is brimming with cosmic energy radiated from its internal core.
author: infinex21

entry: On cloudless nights, wild POKENAME can be found motionless, silently staring up at the stars. Rumors state they originated from the dark side of the moon.
author: h0bojoe

entry: During full moons, tiny white glowing cracks spread throughout POKENAME's body. These ethereal lines glow brightly, giving it a mystical appearance under the moonlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats in the night sky during the full moon without changing its pose. It can levitate for up to 3 miles without rest, maintaining its serene and graceful form.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are man-made Pokémon created a long time ago, ordered to protect humans. Legends state that they did the complete opposite, forcing the best sorcerers to trap them in a stone statue.
author: eminemace

entry: Even during battle, POKENAME maintains a curled position. When threatened, it spews a Flamethrower filled with fine rocks that inflict cuts and burns.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's body is mostly hollow, allowing it to float among the clouds. Even though it is quite light, it has been known to be a major hazard for commercial airplanes.
author: mistymagius

entry: This variant of POKENAME has collaborated with villainous organizations for centuries, often making more than a few mistakes in the process. They have a fondness for Nanab Berries.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME shrug off attacks, often choosing not to fight back. Most attackers are damaged by their rocky bodies and sharp spikes. There are forums that praise POKENAME, regarding it as a prime example of stoicism.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME have no interest in preying on other Pokémon and instead spend their days eating sand, dirt, and rock. The time they are most active shifts from morning to later into the day as they mature.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The cosmic power of POKENAME's core gleams through their outer shell. They utilize this to empower their shell armor, protecting them from the strongest of blows.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME hunts other meteor Pokémon until it has consumed enough that it hurtles toward the world. It is rumored that one not living in the planet's orbit could grow to immense sizes and density as it hunts across the cosmos.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Fueled by an ancient instinct, POKENAME plunges into cliff faces to break sedimentary rock and unearth fossils. Once it excavates a relic of the past, it soars back to its nest to keep its primeval brethren safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's brightly blinking azure jaw disorients prey mid-hunt. Once close, it bites with a crushing force strong enough to shatter granite with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's outer shell is formed from frozen clay. Prolonged contact with its surface can result in severe frostbite within seconds.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its rocky appearance, POKENAME's shell is ice-cold to the touch. Even brief contact may result in painful freezer burn.
author: .izik

entry: They are typically found deep in the sea; some suspect Minior that have fallen from the sky manage to fuse with Carvanha, creating POKENAME. They can leap incredibly high from the water, although this has not been observed in natural conditions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: To rest safely, POKENAME encases itself in swamp mud. While asleep, it reflexively controls nearby trees to ward off intruders with violent force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are found in the upper atmosphere, falling once they reach maturity. The meteorites on their heads contain large amounts of cosmic energy, which explode out once they are broken open.
author: santon5512

entry: When the crystals around POKENAME's neck glow, it is about to unleash a loud screeching to attack. This sound is powerful enough to break stone easily, making it a fearsome force.
author: .izik

entry: Its dense outer shell vibrates with trapped pressure, releasing faint pulses of sound. When it descends through cloudbanks, the air around it stiffens as if resisting its passage.
author: jaminmcready

entry: A durable outer shell encases POKENAME, preventing it from both absorbing and releasing any light energy. Even if it goes on savage rampages and bashes its body around everything it sees, the shell won't ever break.
author: soup1900

entry: It's often placed near the entrances of old homes, unmoving and silent. When danger approaches, it emits a deep, cracking groan and the fissures in its shell begin to flicker violently.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The brittle stone that comes off POKENAME's body while it does martial arts moves is frequently ground into powder by apothecaries. When mixed with water, it can boost strength and stamina in those who imbibe it, making it a sought-after tonic.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that fall onto the planet from space are unable to return due to their heavy exoskeleton. Though the plummet doesn't injure them, fallen POKENAME can be seen gathering on the tops of trees on clear nights to gaze at their old home.
author: .realthree

entry: Its glow deepens and its cry takes on a mournful echo when certain constellations align. On those nights, light bends strangely around it, casting sharp rings into the cold.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its mane glows brighter with each opponent it defeats. Despite being weighed down by a heavy shell, it moves with the speed and savagery of a bloodthirsty beast.
author: h0bojoe

entry: When POKENAME hears music, glowing dots appear on the staff-like entity that controls its movements, matching up with the notes it hears.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hides its bright colors beneath a dull shell in order to blend with the bottom of the sea and become less noticeable to potential prey. As a trade-off, the armor limits POKENAME's mobility and psychic powers.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME uses its large stony forearms as a shield to deflect blows in combat. Wisps of bright energy flare up from cracks in its body as the battle progresses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats in the atmosphere eating dust. When it gets tired, it plummets to the ground at high speeds, letting loose a pumpkin scent as it smashes to the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vulnerable body is protected by a hard shell. Ground-off dust from the shell has a salty, cocoa-like flavor, and is used in some fancy desserts.
author: hophoppip

entry: When POKENAME's shell grows too heavy to stay aloft, it comes hurtling down with destructive force that often leaves a burning crater behind. The energy of its core is so immense that even its shell is veiled in pure energy.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME falls from the atmosphere, they quickly burrow underground while in this vulnerable state. They make their homes in tunnels created by Onix, hiding away at the first sign of danger.
author: mepp.

entry: It hangs from trees, rarely moving unless knocked onto the ground. Though POKENAME is shaped like an acorn, its hard rocky shell protects it from the jaws of nut-eating Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's tail floats behind it because the form inside of its tough shell isn't affected by gravity. POKENAME playfully bats at the tail, sometimes striking it hard enough to crack the rocky outer layer.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME often lie flat on their stomachs when dormant because it is the softest part of their body. When they are attacked, they release psychic waves that cause headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Formed under extreme atmospheric pressure, POKENAME's claws are sharper than steel. Their rigid structure allows POKENAME to easily latch onto passing debris to feast on.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are easily tricked into running in circles, and the dizziness can often lead them to get a headache. The best way for them to recover is by landing on their stomachs and resting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are superb swimmers that zip through the water to avoid predators. Once they find a suitable spot to rest, they go dormant and tuck their limbs close to their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In a flock of POKENAME, one is always designated as the lookout. When this Pokémon notices incoming predators, it will loudly chime its glowing bell to alert the others to the incoming danger.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME release a trail of stardust wherever they swim. These trails are particularly mesmerizing underwater, where they create a beautiful glowing display of stardust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can remain dormant for long periods of time, keeping their shell closed. It is difficult to see the inside of their bodies, as opening a POKENAME shell requires tremendous force that risks hurting the POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appears hollow and inanimate, simply drifting around wherever the ocean currents push it. It's said that it exhibits a strange burst of life and energy when meteor showers occur.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bore through stone with powerful punches, creating dens in cliffsides for them to sleep within. They lie in wait for prey to pass by, grabbing onto their targets and releasing electricity.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When another Pokémon runs away from POKENAME, their instincts urge them to chase after the escaping Pokémon. When they reach their max speed, they release a glittery stardust behind them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are surprisingly limber Pokémon that love to chase others. After a long chase, POKENAME follow the trail of stardust they left behind to return to their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME descend from the ozone layer when their shells have grown too dense to stay aloft so high. Once they have descended, they will seek out opponents to test their strength against.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME stays motionless and meditates, it's said it astral-projects itself far into the depths of space to parts unknown. On the evening of meteor showers, it gazes upward and regards the display with its eyes glowing bright.
author: sk372

entry: The stone that encases POKENAME's body gives it extra weight to carry, constantly increasing the strength of its muscles.
author: hophoppip

entry: Some say POKENAME's outer shell was created to limit the unparalleled strength it possessed. Its shell makes ominous rumbling crackles with every flex of its muscular body.
author: sk372

entry: When tired, POKENAME floats through the night sky much more slowly. It regains its vigor after eating copious amounts of rocks, using the minerals to recharge its energy.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is high up in the atmosphere, it sometimes shoots highly powered jets of water from its cannons to propel itself. The water immediately freezes in the cold, instead of quickly falling to earth, it seems to drift down in slow motion.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When its hard body glows purple, POKENAME can walk through solid objects. It uses this ability to hide within small crevices during daylight hours, making it nearly impossible to find.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to invisible cosmic rays. Absent any perceivable reason, it can explode in a dazzling display of starry lights.
author: pattybgoode

entry: When a POKENAME stops rolling, shards of an unknown crystal fly out in various directions. As a result, it tumbles itself down cliffs to keep a steady momentum.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME shine bright with a celestial, bone-colored glow. Their boney boomerang can be tossed high into the air, high enough to be mistaken for a shooting star.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's punches leave glowing trails like shooting stars. It is said to protect the skies, striking down threats before they can breach the ozone layer.
author: shyguy11011

entry: This Pokémon devours all kinds of things, edible or not, and digests them into a colorful sparkling mass. Storing it in its belly, POKENAME pukes it out as a means of self-defense, and while it looks stunning, it also smells terribly.
author: milchik

entry: This Pokémon devours all kinds of things, edible or not, and digests them into a colorful sparkling mass. Storing it in its belly, POKENAME pukes it out as a means of self-defense, and while it looks stunning, it also smells terribly.
author: milchik

entry: Rather than poison gas, POKENAME is filled with interstellar gas and dust that allows it to remain buoyant.  However, this still causes major respiratory problems in others.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME spew out clouds of stardust that shimmer at night. Though these clouds of stardust are beautiful, the stardust is known to cause coughing fits when inhaled.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body glows brightly while it drifts through the atmosphere. Some old cultures thought sightings of this Pokémon were a shooting star that gave luck to new mothers, a symbol of hope and protection.
author: .izik

entry: Often enough, what people think are shooting stars are actually a space-bound Pokémon known as POKENAME dancing across the night sky. When they spin their bodies, their cores shine increasingly brighter, like the stars themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's voice is angelic and otherworldly, causing everyone around the Pokémon to admire its song. Once POKENAME stops singing, it will fade into the cosmos.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The lights on POKENAME's shell change colours based on which note POKENAME is currently singing. Its voice is so melodious that tour groups frequent POKENAME's environment during mating season to hear their cries.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: When POKENAME's translucent body absorbs minerals from the air, it creates faintly glowing patterns on its surface. POKENAME spends its time hiding in caverns, as its soft body makes it vulnerable to attacks.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are frequently found falling from the night sky over bodies of water. They are attracted to the large bodies of water because they reflect starlight. They can almost turn invisible under the water at night, despite their soft glow.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: To heighten the effects of X Speed, scientists now use stardust gathered from a POKENAME. With such incredible speed, its dust holds faint energy from its movements.
author: jaminmcready

entry: After devouring large amounts of data, POKENAME erupts from the nearest monitor in a brilliant flash. It then soars off in search of more information to consume.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is so large that it has a minor gravitational field, which researchers believe is also what allows this Pokémon to stay aloft. To defend itself, it can launch all debris caught in its gravitational field.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME can leap high into the sky, leaving a small crater in the ground as they push off. They drop onto foes like meteors, leaving a fiery trail of stardust behind them.
author: santon5512

entry: Unexpected sightings of northern lights may be a sign that a flock of POKENAME is near. They swish their tails in the ozone layer, creating splendid light shows that can be seen from the ground.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME absorbs lightning as a source of power, with each bolt hardening its outer shell. Its volatile core burns radioactively, decaying its body, so it lives in thunderstorms to recharge and delay disintegration.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME absorbs lightning as a source of power, with each bolt hardening its outer shell. Its volatile core burns radioactively, decaying its body, so it lives in thunderstorms to recharge and delay disintegration.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Rarely, on the peaks of tall mountains, POKENAME can be found. The light that emits from its body is warm, but not dangerously hot. When POKENAME rests, its shining light dims to a softer glow.
author: nyoomymph

entry: These space-dwelling Pokémon seem to be drawn to our world out of curiosity, given how they react to new sights. They are brimming with energy that causes them to constantly shed their glimmering scales like stardust.
author: infinex21

entry: They gorge themselves on cosmic debris as they fly around in orbit of our planet, until they become so bloated that they eventually fall to the ground. They can loose potent energies from their mouths and horns.
author: infinex21

entry: Parts of its body are clad in the same cosmic debris it feeds upon, though the rest shines with the energy within itself. It can move astonishingly quick and strike a foe with the force of a meteor.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can barely contain itself in its rocky shell due to its overwhelming rage. When its anger rises, its fire burns a deep crimson and spills out of its casing, as its power becomes too intense to be contained.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are mischievous, intelligent creatures. They often stage small pranks or incidents where they are seen as the victim or savior in order to gain sympathy and treats. Their smug smile is an immediate way to tell if they're planning something.
author: chibitales

entry: As the sun sets, the orange glow of POKENAME brightens. One memorable poet gave this Pokémon the nickname of the Second Sun.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME travel in large groups high across the night sky. Onlookers frequently confuse them for meteors due to the intense glow they emit while in flight.
author: ambrosia04

entry: On cloudless nights, POKENAME can be spotted racing each other through the night sky. They use their rock-like elytra to camouflage themselves while they sleep during the day.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME creates miniature tapestries of the night sky as constellations form in its webs. These delicate and intricate patterns often take a few days to a couple of months to produce, only to be torn apart once the webs catch prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even after landing, POKENAME's blue-glowing wings continue to flutter. It sheds luminous feathers prized by jewelers and collectors alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is durable, allowing it to bounce off of objects it impacts while floating around in space. It is easily upset, and when it cries, it hurtles to the ground at an intense speed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While floating through thunderstorms, POKENAME redirects lightning to predators. It uses this ability to protect itself and its fellow Pokémon from danger.
author: .izik

entry: Most often mistaken for a comet, POKENAME orbits planets and can be seen every planetary year, flashing bright, colorful displays.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Because POKENAME are so minuscule, their vestibular systems don't work properly. They can leap far, but they rarely stick the landing.
author: hophoppip

entry: When it flies through the night sky, POKENAME leaves behind colorful shards that are believed to be a sign of hope. With its ethereal appearance, many have mistaken POKENAME to be another legendary bird like Articuno, Moltres, or Zapdos.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME is constantly seeking new kinds of minerals to eat. With each new item eaten, the glow of its eyes and tail becomes more vibrant.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Often mistaken for a shooting star, POKENAME fly through the sky so fast that it glows. When it reaches the ground, it uses its tail to spring back into the air. Newborn POKENAME do not have the strength, and rely on other Pokémon taking them in.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME sit at rest on the seabed, gathering energy. They are vulnerable in this state and cover themselves in a toxic film. Once enough energy is gathered, they evolve and shoot up into the atmosphere.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME covers the glow of its body by coating itself with mud from swamps and marshes. The energy of its body dries the mud out quickly, requiring it to regularly refresh the muddy coat.
author: sk372

entry: By fragmenting meteors in orbit, POKENAME breaks down their minerals to use as energy, amplifying its psychic powers.
author: ambrosia04

entry: The energy exuding from POKENAME can power an entire power plant for weeks. Although they need to eat uranium to continue releasing this energy, many consider this a fine tradeoff for manageable and usable energy.
author: blaizegamer

entry: POKENAME often finds itself being followed by Murkrow due to the latter's love of bright and shiny things. POKENAME itself does not appreciate the obsessive interest, attempting to drive off Murkrow with blinding flashes from its eyes.
author: sk372

entry: Cosmic power manifests as the flower and vines that sprout from POKENAME's back. Despite its mesmerizing appearance, the energy is highly toxic and can defeat even the toughest opponents.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: It's said that gazing into POKENAME's core gives a glimpse through time and space, possibly even dimensions. Research is inconclusive, as all who look for protracted periods fall unconscious and remember little of what they saw once awake.
author: sk372

entry: When they spot a target, POKENAME swoop down to attack, using their speed and the brightness of their bodies to disorient and blind their prey. As POKENAME dive to attack their prey, they produce a trail of shimmering purple dust.
author: gileme__

entry: POKENAME make their homes in the discarded shells of Minior. Because of this, it is a common misconception that these Pokémon come from space.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's shell can produce 200 pounds of Stardust daily. The color of the main body determines the color of the dust.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME streaks through the night sky with wings outstretched, trailing glittering stardust that shimmer like glowing clouds in its wake. Many travelers mistake it for a shooting star.
author: .izik

entry: It glides through the upper atmosphere with an eerie calm, wings outstretched and glittering with debris. In its wake, metal shavings scatter like shooting stars.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its latent energies have unleashed now that its hard shell has broken. It can channel this energy and jets of water through its long, tube-like mouth like bullets at its opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME crash to the ground from outer space. They are found in meteor craters and have a joyful demeanour. Researchers speculate that whilst in space POKENAME use debris and rocks to protect their bodies, though this has yet to be observed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It moves rather quickly after having shed most of its dense shell, being able to swiftly deliver Rollout attacks that could crush small vehicles. It consumes rocks and earthy debris, which slowly accumulates to reform the dense shell around its body.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME exhibits a large amount of processing power, able to complete complicated computer tasks in seconds. However, its presence causes computers to emit small amounts of radiation, making it a potential hazard.
author: sk372

entry: Spotting POKENAME under a starry sky is considered a sign of great fortune due to its incredible rarity. For centuries, scientists mistook this Pokémon for a constellation in the night sky.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME paint with a bioluminescent substance, which produces beautiful colors and light. This paint is very expensive and is only sold to famous artists.
author: dodoowner_

entry: As POKENAME spins, its core shines brightly, creating a glowing vortex. As it gains speed, it resembles a shooting star dancing across the night sky.
author: shyguy11011

entry: These Pokémon are typically seen prancing high in the sky, well above the clouds. When they run atop a cloud, a pure, clean rain will follow.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME generates electricity from cosmic energy that it stores in its cheeks. Incredibly playful and astonishing in combat, it's believed that this Pokémon was the companion to a guardian from ancient times.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME absorbs space dust and debris with the miniature black hole contained in its flowing mane to fuel its cosmic magic. When it is seen streaking across the night sky, people superstitiously chant wishes in hopes it will cast a spell for them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME absorbs space dust and debris with the miniature black hole contained in its flowing mane to fuel its cosmic magic. When it is seen streaking across the night sky, people superstitiously chant wishes in hopes it will cast a spell for them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When this form of POKENAME is visible in the wild, POKENAME is in a critical status. It must devour a large but healthy amount of rocky material in order to be able to naturally reform its hardened shell; without it, POKENAME will eventually perish.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Constantly crackling with static, POKENAME glows due to all of its excess energy. It focuses the majority of its power into the tips of its tails, only wielding them to share electricity or defend its friends.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When high in the atmosphere, POKENAME curls up and slows the effects of time on itself, almost completely stopping aging. When it falls to earth, researchers seek it out to determine how old it is.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its wings beat in sudden bursts, sending crystalline dust spiraling through the sky. The sound it emits rises and falls like a siren, disorienting anything that flies too close.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has a field of radiation around it, which it uses to hunt prey within caves. The radiation is so strong that it melts cave walls, which is why POKENAME has very weak claws.
author: animecreep4

entry: Now free from its shell, POKENAME attacks in bursts of speed and agility that it previously couldn't manage. The bright, eye-catching light from its body was the reason it hid inside the shell.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME protects the trees of the jungle by balling itself up and hurtling to the ground at anyone it believes is harming the trees. Otherwise, it spends its time serenely floating around the sky.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its long light trails can be seen from miles away in the night sky. What people don't realise is, if they get too close, POKENAME will dive towards the ground like a fiery spear, wanting to protect its home jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The ultimate protector of the jungle, POKENAME will scout in the night sky. Workers looking to fell trees don't even see what hit them when POKENAME plummets to attack.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark, unless covered with dirt from digging.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME constantly lessen the effects of gravity around them, allowing them to prance gleefully in graceful strides. If a POKENAME is startled, its gravity will suddenly intensify, causing it to plummet back to the ground in self-defense.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It is said POKENAME have completely mastered control over gravity, using it to bend space and time to their will. It is believed that if threatened, it can apply enough of it to create a star.
author: sanguinenebula

entry: When in combat, POKENAME extends blades made of pure energy from its elbows. Every swing of these sharp blades leaves a sparkling, multicolored trail of stardust behind.
author: sk372

entry: To better hide themselves from predators, POKENAME reflects light off their bodies to blend in with their surroundings. Even while camouflaged, their bodies give off a subtle shimmer. Some theaters use these Pokémon in plays to emphasize scenes.
author: chibitales

entry: Dwelling within ababdoned Minior shells, POKENAME are often confused for miniature nebulae when spotted from telescopes. They enjoy gathering stones to form their own orbits.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME makes its den in dark caves, its body shining brightly to light up the area around it. This light causes Pokémon that enjoy the darkness to leave its immediate vicinity, as it disturbs their natural habitat.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME lets out a cry before charging at something, the colorful dome on its head glows brightly. A successful headbutt causes its cranium to emit a blinding flash of light.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soars between mountain peaks, its horn flashing brightly before descent. It uses this as a display while patrolling its domain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body glows a bright orange in cemeteries when it spots grave robbers. The eerie glow helps scare off intruders, protecting the sacred grounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to swim through the very cosmos, swallowing dying stars and releasing the excess energy as a brand new star in its wake. Supposedly, this also helps to keep its own energy stable until its protective shell finally reforms.
author: infinex21

entry: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon with its shell shed. POKENAME travels through open space with the speed of a meteor, drawing energy from the stars it passes and shaping new ones in its wake.
author: milchik

entry: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon with its shell shed. POKENAME travels through open space with the speed of a meteor, drawing energy from the stars it passes and shaping new ones in its wake.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's tail blazes with sparkling blue flames thanks to the minerals in its diet. A POKENAME in motion is a beautiful sight.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can shed their meteoric shell at will. Their finishing move is to fly into the atmosphere, encase themselves in their shell, and let gravity drag them down where they will cast away their shell and strike their foe with their massive blade.
author: infinex21

entry: Even with its shell shed, its body is still dense and heavy though now it can unleash more of its internal energy. It will unleash all of its energy as a beam from its mouth to send itself back into the stratosphere.
author: infinex21

entry: Its ribbon whip forward with surprising force, launching star fragments high into the sky. Some are said to reach the mesosphere, where they burn silently above the clouds.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME leaps into the sky with joy, trailing stardust behind it. When it crashes down, it leaves glittering craters that can shimmer for days.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME carve out craters from meteor landings to make their homes. Ancient legends warn not to disturb a POKENAME's den or else the walls of the crater will rise from the ground and form a volcano.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are large Pokémon that fly within the outermost layer of the planet's atmosphere, gorging themselves upon planetary debris. The more they feed upon, the more they develop a thick shell around themselves that eventually weighs them down.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is constructed from an otherworldly cosmic energy. It flies through space by warping gravity around it, pulling in shards of mteors and other debris to try and form its own nebula.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Upon getting homesick, they invade the dreams of others and force them to fantasize of space. Although some find it comforting, others describe it as a dark and chilling nightmare.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME fires high-velocity meteorites from its cannon. Different colors of POKENAME shoot meteorites of differing sizes, materials, and quantities.
author: soup1900

entry: While staring at a full moon, POKENAME's glowing body shifts colors rapidly. It cannot control this change, so it is a captivating sight during moonlit nights.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often found in high orbit, where they drift aimlessly until growing hungry. When low on energy, they infiltrate satellites, using the technology to locate meteors to consume.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to float in the ozone layer, absorbing small space debris and peacefully floating around. POKENAME, when disturbed, are believed to be why your ears pop when your airplane leaves the ground.
author: tlord

entry: POKENAME's body rapidly changes color during the night of a full moon while it floats through the night sky. This transformation is a magical display of its energy and connection to the lunar cycle.
author: .izik

entry: Its unique eyes allow it to analyze the makeup of celestial bodies. Scientists plan to use POKENAME to detect valuable meteors on space mining expeditions in the future.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Atk, scientists have begun using stardust from a POKENAME. Because of its naturally high attack speed, the dust carries traces of its power.
author: jaminmcready

entry: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Atk, scientists have begun using stardust from a POKENAME. Because of its naturally high attack speed, the dust carries traces of its power.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It's said that those who are able to catch a glimpse of POKENAME flying across the cosmos on its burning wings will be blessed with great prosperity.
author: mepp.

entry: The colors from POKENAME's wings radiate as splendidly as the sun. As it soars, dazzling multi-colored embers are scattered.
author: mepp.

entry: Prone to clumsiness, POKENAME break their tough shell by crashing into rocks. Unfortunately, with their colorful core exposed, they tend to die off quickly.
author: whimsi_call

entry: POKENAME's heads are constantly fighting over food. Theorized to originate in space, their diet consists of atmospheric dust. The color of its core depends on what types it consumes.
author: whimsi_call

entry: POKENAME zip around in the ozone layer, leaving behind a trail of colorful scales. POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for shooting stars.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Only found deep in space, POKENAME are thought to bring very good luck to interstellar travelers. On occasion, these Pokémon try to use their supernatural powers to help these travelers return home safely.
author: garliclol

entry: POKENAME is popular with coordinators due to its stunning fur colours and the dazzling beauty of its fire. It's said that a POKENAME can grant a single wish in its lifetime to a human it truly loves.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME sends out puffs of glowing dust in the form of dashes and dots from its tail to communicate with other POKENAME. When it is nearing the end of its life, its whole body glows brightly like a star.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away.The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Without the majority of its heavy shell, it can dart around at remarkable speed. Its spikes are extensions of its innermost core and radiate intense energy.
author: infinex21

entry: This variant of POKENAME has collaborated with villainous organizations for centuries, often making more than a few mistakes in the process. They have a fondness for Nanab berries.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Its body is laced with myriad metals that keep it rather durable even without most of its hard shell. A Headbutt from a POKENAME can easily crumple a sheet of steel.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away.The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAMEf sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away. The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The star allows POKENAME to travel great distances in short periods of time.  Once it reaches its destination, the star will crash into the ground and disappear for a time.  Some POKENAME travel this way to help many around the world.
author: infranscia

entry: POKENAME rises from its shattered shell towards the sky while singing loudly. The shattered shell of POKENAME is collected by space enthusiasts and luxury jewelers alike due to the beautiful flecks of its rainbow coat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's bud releases colorful particles that taste delicious enough to attract predators but contain high amounts of toxins. They are unable to survive in frigid environments without their outer shell.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's vivid orange color comes from the carrots in its diet. It's quite a pest for vegetable farmers.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sits around deserts near craters, waiting to ambush prey from the sand. Its shimmering body gives it away, but luckily it does not need to eat.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Often found in ancient craters, it gnaws on the remnants of meteorites to sharpen its teeth. Any teeth that fall out have an identical makeup to stardust.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME lurks in the cosmos, utilizing its extraordinary eyesight to spot prey from high above. As soon as it finds food, POKENAME dives towards the ground at high speeds. According to reports, this activity resembles a meteor striking the planet.
author: dodoowner_

entry: With its protective layer shattered, POKENAME hastily hunts down rocky Pokémon to eat to stave off its body burning up and fading away. Reforming its rocky coat will protect it for some time, but the shell is unstable and steadily crumbles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With its protective layer shattered, POKENAME hastily hunts down rocky Pokémon to eat to stave off its body burning up and fading away. Reforming its rocky coat will protect it for some time, but the shell is unstable and steadily crumbles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME prance about whenever they see meteor showers. Their tails flare up when this happens, often leading to accidental fire damage.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Its roar splits clouds and can echo for miles. Long after POKENAME vanishes, cracks in nearby stone glisten with strange cosmic ore.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The icy blue glow coming off POKENAME's body will turn red if it is overheating. It blows ice around itself to rapidly cool down, ensuring its body temperature remains manageable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy blue glow is extremely visible at night, making it a haunting sight. It floats through the sky, leaving trails of cold mist behind it as it travels.
author: .izik

entry: Surging with energy, POKENAME digests any trash it ingests within seconds. Some locations have begun using it as a quick way to get rid of refuse and waste material, as its appetite seems bottomless.
author: sk372

entry: Also known as "The Comet of the Sea", POKENAME typically lives an idyllic life living off sand and particles from hydrothermal vents. However, if an object catches its eye, it bolts towards it with blinding speed, collecting it in its mouth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME zips through the cosmos at lightspeed, trying to find food to fuel its insatiable hunger. It has adapted to eating stardust, as finding prey in space is impossible to accomplish.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME zips through the cosmos at lightspeed, trying to find food to fuel its insatiable hunger. It has adapted to eating stardust, as finding prey in space is impossible to accomplish.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It strips bark from nearby trees and layers it over its glowing body, hiding its light beneath knots and rot. When startled, the bark splits slightly, revealing a flash of violet fire.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME uses high-pitched vibrations to locate hidden star fragments. The tone draws flocks of nocturnal Pokémon, who hover motionless in awe.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Due to its magnificent wings, POKENAME are loved by kids. So much so that a racing game has a track based on them.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME's upper body glows due to the radiation emitted by its internal organs. It glows brighter after it's eaten, its gelatinous body vibrating as it digests.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME greets intruders to its mountain den with a crushing hug. It follows up with a devastating Power Gem attack to ensure their defeat.
author: .izik

entry: Because of its extraterrestrial appearance, POKENAME is often cast as an alien invader in science fiction movies. Its ability to regenerate its tentacles can be unnerving to watch.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: The glowing green portions of POKENAME's cape flash brightly while performing martial arts combinations. The flashes add flair to its movements, dazzling its opponents before landing a decisive strike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that break free of their heavy, protective exoskeleton are light enough to return to their starry home, but they only have a short time to do so before they are extinguished. The glow of their return journey can be seen from miles away.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME glows brilliantly as it leaps across night clouds. Mistaking it for a UFO is common, but a sudden blizzard reveals its true nature.
author: .izik

entry: The loss of its shell has made it far deadlier, but at the cost of an exponentially shortened lifespan. It fights with reckless ferocity, unconcerned for its own survival.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME leap from high cliffs onto unsuspecting travellers that stumble upon their territories. POKENAME satiate their diet with dust alone, with the colour of the dust changing the hue of their fur drastically.
author: npshi

entry: It cloaks itself with a mesmerizing stardust, leaving a stunning trail of colors wherever it flies. Reports say POKENAME shines the brightest after basking in the Alolan moonlight.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its teeth are strong enough to crush even the hardest minerals and shells; even pieces of meteors are no match for POKENAME's jaw. The colors of the sparkling dust it releases through the protuberance on its head are determined by what it eats.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's burning meteor scales allow it to dish out powerful punches with enormous impact force. However, since these scales burn off and disintegrate quickly, it must finish off and feast on its foe before it becomes too vulnerable.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's burning meteor scales allow it to dish out powerful punches with enormous impact force. However, since these scales burn off and disintegrate quickly, it must finish off and feast on its foe before it becomes too vulnerable.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body is quite delicate, so it uses its rocky pincers as a defensive shell. When threatened in battle, it fires powerful beams of cosmic rays from its pincers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's eyes are very strong, possessing acute vision and the ability to fire long-range beams of light. These shots are so fast and accurate even from extreme distances, some wonder if they possess homing capabilities.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gifts meteor-shaped charms to Trainers it likes. These rocky trinkets are warm to the touch and sometimes shimmer faintly under moonlight.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's body is bursting with so much magical solar energy that its own body glows bright and radiates warmth constantly. Its use of a staff to cast spells is purely performative, as it enjoys making a spectacle of its magic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses a wand made of hardened stardust to cast sparks in the air. When the sparks fall, they leave behind a trail of glitter that clings to the ground like sand.
author: jaminmcready

entry: With its meteor-clad shell broken, POKENAME reveals its true form as a manifestation of pure astral energy. This Pokémon is said to have once had a corporeal form that it shed after becoming one with its soul.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of quiet rivers, its still body mistaken for a blue sapphire. Light passing through the water makes its surface shimmer like a jewel, drawing curious eyes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: At dusk, POKENAME skips across lake surfaces with barely a sound. Each landing leaves behind a glittering patch of foam that fades before morning.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Anyone who sees POKENAME's true form is dazzled into stillness. Its body seems to refract the stars themselves, locking its targets in place.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Using its incredibly powerful legs, POKENAME can propel itself all the way into the ozone layer. It then plummets back to earth, catching enemies off guard by striking with the devastating force of a meteor.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME's smoke trails contain flecks of cosmic dust. It rarely moves, conserving its core's heat until it erupts with sudden, radiant blasts.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME playfully hides among farmland, nestling between rows of crops. At night, its glow flickers softly, giving away its hiding spots.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's lower half wobbles back and forth like a pendulum as it floats through a starry night sky. An odd scent of pumpkin wafts from its location, drawing both curiosity and unease from those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances in graveyards under the full moon, flickering like a candle. Its light drifts slowly between headstones, casting long, wandering shadows.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME forms pastries out of stardust, carefully shaping them to resemble real desserts. After taking a bite, it often spits them out in disgust.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME collects candies from around the world and coats them in sparkling stardust for it to wear. If it gets hungry, it eats one and quickly crafts another to wear.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Around POKENAME's waist are jagged stones that formed as its core cooled. The rocks weigh it down, and it constantly tries to kick them loose with frustrated grunts.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Rocks are naturally attracted to POKENAME's body and often weigh it down. To free itself, it snaps suddenly, breaking the stones with bursts of motion.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can sense precious ores deep underground. It lays upside down over those hidden pockets, quietly guarding them with its glowing core.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME scoops river water into the lily pad shaped rock on its head, swishing it gently to pan for rare minerals. Sometimes small flecks of metal sparkle inside, but it keeps swirling anyway.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's hat is fragile and top-heavy, so it often breaks apart when it moves. When this happens, it gathers nearby rocks to carefully shape a new one atop its head.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has grown so dense that it has developed an accretion disk of orbiting gaseous matter.  It is advised not to touch it.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME have nearly limitless stored energy, but most of it is spent keeping themselves contained. If their physical seals were ever to break, the resulting explosion would be catastrophic.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: The bright swirls on POKENAME's eyes are as hot as a small star. When POKENAME spins and dances, the rock on its tail grows hot enough to melt meteorites.
author: ambrosia04

entry: On nights of meteor showers, some astronomers search for shooting POKENAME. Based on their playfulness after landing, it seems that POKENAME float up and fall back to the world for fun.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: After collecting dust in the atmosphere, POKENAME flies around and spreads it to flowers like pollen. This causes the flowers to mutate and glow in colors like POKENAME does.
author: soup1900

entry: By stamping its feet over and over, POKENAME can increase the volume and power of its sound waves. Each color of POKENAME has its own unique set of sounds the other colors don't make.
author: soup1900

entry: The most optimistic POKENAME are said to have the yellowest glow. Their fists leave trails of bright flame like shooting stars.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME collects bits of dust and space rocks that fall to the ground, hoping to one day return to the sky from which it fell. However, POKENAME often loses track of the fragments due to its habit of using them as toys.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME is said to have acquired its brilliant pink glow from nanoparticles that surrounded it when it fell from space. When this curious Pokémon spins its tail, a strange musical sound can be heard.
author: skittytales

entry: The fields POKENAME trot through are supposedly blessed with fertile land, as their hooves break apart and soften the hardest earth. They are always seen with smiles upon their faces as stardust erupts from the humps along their backs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love to relax at the edge of a body of water and stargaze for hours at a time. When disturbed, they release a cloud of stardust that causes headaches, which deters many Pokémon from interrupting them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Much like the actual stars in the galaxy, POKENAME's color determines how warm and bright the light rays they produce are. Due to this unique factor, some scholars use them as the suns for their terrarium experiments.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME gather in large numbers in surface waters during starry nights. During the daytime, they live underground, illuminating underground lakes with their glow.
author: bee4082

entry: The soft body of a shell-less POKENAME is very vulnerable, but very slippery. For this reason, POKENAME will sometimes shed their shells to make a quick getaway.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME create a trail of stardust wherever they swim and brighten bodies of water with a beautiful display of light. These transient displays last for a few seconds, as the light from the stardust dissipates quickly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME flies high into the atmosphere to absorb sunlight. At full power, it releases excess energy to create dazzling displays of light midflight.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME loves showing off its aerial acrobatics on cloudless nights. It leaves behind a trail of rocky particles that glow faintly and quickly disintegrate.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: When a POKENAME gets angry, the energy in its body heats up and causes it to lift into the air. When it sees the cause of its anger, it releases all of its energy and plummets back down to the ground to deliver a powerful punch.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The inside of POKENAME shells is speckled with white dots that resemble the stars in the sky. The soft glow of a POKENAME's core gives them an extraterrestrial appearance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have pieces of their shell orbit around the bright pearl that controls their body. Each piece of their shell can rapidly change position to deflect attacks, making any attacks on their pearl difficult to land.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Locals claim that POKENAME can be spotted coursing through the sky during new moons when the night is pitch-dark. However, scientific research shows that this Pokémon can't fly, but instead jumps out of the water high enough to appear soaring.
author: milchik

entry: Old myths describe POKENAME and its partner as two heroes who saved people from a terrifying monster's attack. For that, they were placed in the sky in the form of a constellation as gratitude.
author: milchik

entry: When this Pokémon jumps out of the water during starry nights, it looks like a comet from afar. This is how POKENAME hunts for flying Pokémon, slamming them into the water and piercing them with its thin fluid-sucking mouth.
author: milchik

entry: According to old myths, POKENAME and its child watch out for people and Pokémon from the night sky in the form of a constellation, guarding them in their sleep. If a disaster strikes, these two brave Pokémon will fight it with their lives.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME soars at high altitudes while glowing in many bright colors. It's said that couples who witness it will be blessed with good fortune.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME soar through the night sky chasing anything that flies. These chases create a beautiful display of stardust that trails behind them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to chase after Pokémon and leave glittery stardust in their wake. Whenever they catch up to their target, they like to press a paw on their head to confirm that everything is going to be okay.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Freed from its thick shell, POKENAME's true form is revealed as a draconic Pokémon made of flames and cosmic energies. In this form, it becomes more daring in who it fights with and will only return to the ozone layer when it has exhausted itself.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME blinks in and out of sight so quickly that some mistake it for a malfunctioning Teleporter. It's nearly impossible to predict where it will appear next.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME focuses its psychic powers to keep its physical form from fading away. It fights by telekinetically shooting star-shaped pieces of its shattered shell at foes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME possesses knowledge of the cosmos that our astronomers are desperate to gain, but it will not pass on its discoveries to anyone it doesn't trust implicitly.
author: nyoomymph

entry: The light blue glowing portion of POKENAME's body flashes repeatedly while it attacks, acting as a distraction while it lets off powerful punches that can knock out any foe in its way.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME skate through public streets on crowded nights, handing out candy to all they find. They enjoy racing humans and will give up all their sweets to those who beat them.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are found throughout the cosmos protecting planets from meteors blasting down at them. They are often caught in a planet's gravitational pull and involuntarily orbit the planet like a moon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The stones levitating around POKENAME's glowing body flit in different directions should it be startled. If this happens, POKENAME must regather the stones by hand to restore its defensive strength.
author: .izik

entry: It gallops across the galaxy at incredible speeds, chasing after comets and meteors of which it eats. If one happens to see a shooting star followed by a second, it may actually be a POKENAME chasing its next meal.
author: merclipse

entry: All three parts of POKENAME pulse with a powerful electromagnetic radiation. Space institutes consider them a nuisance, as they tend to conglomerate near the buildings and cause havoc on the machinery with their pulses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME batons can shine as bright as a car's high beams, which makes them perfect for being seen at night. Some rural airports rely on POKENAME to help guide planes safely on the runway.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a very deep sleeper, only awakened when its outer shell breaks. If left uncaptured, POKENAME may never awaken naturally, leading to its demise.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The trumpets on its back are able to produce sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter boulders. Despite this, POKENAME are very friendly and can be seen parading around with other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: A wild POKENAME will begin to fade if it stays within the atmosphere of the same planet for longer than a few weeks. Groups of them will fly away in search of new worlds, flying up in reverse meteor showers. Poké Ball technology mitigates this need.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A wild POKENAME will begin to fade if it stays within the atmosphere of the same planet for longer than a few weeks. Groups of them will fly away in search of new worlds, flying up in reverse meteor showers. Poké Ball technology mitigates this need.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While floating through the sky, POKENAME sometimes makes faces at children in windows. Its glowing body flashes to get their attention, trying to make them laugh with its odd faces.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a fleeting phenomenon within the atmosphere, acting with chaotic energy before burning out of existence in a euphoric rush. It survives longer in space, where it knocks satellites off course and responds to radio waves with loud screams.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Those who see POKENAME swinging its Minior-like pendulum are said to experience visions and knowledge they think is from beyond this world. They end up stuck in a coma-like daze, mumbling gibberish that resembles deranged conspiracies.
author: beatdoof

entry: Its enemies don't like to attack it, since it uses its thorny bulb as a deterrant. It then uses the flammable toxin it creates to counterattack.
author: soup1900

entry: Reports of troublesome POKENAME have arisen. In these reports, the Pokémon will simply nap in the sun during a battle, basking in its nutrients.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They have yet to master their Fire-Type attacks, so they recklessly smack their small bodies into their enemies no matter how dangerous it may be. They won't stop spraying silk until they have fully wrapped their opponent up.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When upset, POKENAME sheds molten tears to ignite its club for battle. These searing tears leave deep scars across the nearby landscape.
author: mbo1064.

entry: POKENAME battles with brutal precision, relying on lethal kicks. In moments of peak intensity, it channels fire into its legs, scorching enemies with searing blows.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives to fight in the ring, training relentlessly to perfect its fiery punching techniques. If it loses a match, it takes it so hard that it may refuse to eat for days.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME constantly vents a noxious and flammable gas from their bodies. They threaten other Pokémon by brandishing their tail, which can ignite the gases inside them and cause an explosion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wander around rocky crags outside volcanoes, using the flame on their tails to defend themselves. They harden the scales around their body to endure attacks before swinging around their tails to set their foes ablaze.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The only thing brighter than a POKENAME's cherry shell is the flames on their backs. Each spine on their back is capable of producing flames that can melt metal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body releases such intense heat that its heavy armor glows red-hot. The drill-like horn on its snout spins at blazing speed, igniting in flames and allowing it to pierce even solid metal.
author: fiordaliso

entry: By spraying flammable gas at the flames on their tails, POKENAME can create powerful blasts of fire. These flames burn even underwater, scorching anything they touch.
author: santon5512

entry: According to legend, before the invention of Poké Balls, POKENAME would leave the humans who raised it to migrate in flocks to parts now unknown, all in order to find a mate, never to return.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At low tide, POKENAME melt the sand in front of them to create glass and help slide themselves back into the ocean. This process can take a couple of hours because the sand is saturated with water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prepares for its pranks by floating out of sight with pyrokinesis, but those mighty flames heat up its surroundings. Whenever one gets uncomfortably warm, they should be prepared for mischief.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: Although it constantly emits light from its tail and often radiates a reddish glow from its body when in darkness, POKENAME is sensitive to sudden flashes and will rampage around when blinded.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's pincers are hot enough to melt steel beams. POKENAME dislikes the cold, and will become violent in cold weather.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are ferocious creatures that aggressively defend their herd with their sharp horns and fiery breath. In exchange for protection, POKENAME are given any berries that the herd finds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burns tall grass using its fiery tail to create smoke. This smoke scares away predators, so it has plenty of space to graze on grass and leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's flames burn hot and bright. It frequently starts brushfires as it climbs the foliage searching for food.
author: silver175

entry: When enraged, POKENAME blows out bluish-white flames, leaving blazing ruins in its wake. Its tail never extinguishes when submerged.
author: nomadinstasis

entry: POKENAME can be found on volcanic beaches, where they test their strength by running into rising surf or up volcanic rock. They are highly competitive and will not back down from a challenge.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: One should be careful letting POKENAME roam about in one's computer. It is quite temperamental, and if in a bad mood may attempt to burn files with the fire on its tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swings its fiery tail fiercely at anything nearby, protecting itself while it waits to evolve. Should two POKENAME choose the same branch to hang from, they fiercely flame at each other until one is forced off the tree.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient eras town blacksmiths would befriend POKENAME to heat their forges. In time it was discovered their Water Guns could also quench red-hot blades, causing this symbiosis to last for centuries.
author: ghostslythe

entry: As POKENAME gets agitated, its flames will begin to glow blue and white, increasing with heat and intensity. It'll dive towards foes and shred them with its unforgivingly sharp claws.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's body temperature is so hot, its molt lightly fuses to its body when it sheds its skin. To be able to grow, it seeks out friendly battles with other Pokémon, which dislodges the molt and allows it to shed its skin properly.
author: linhasxoc

entry: POKENAME dwells in woods and forests, where it builds a nest alongside other members of its swarm. It is a highly aggressive Pokémon that sets rival hives ablaze to assert its dominance, striking foes with fierce attacks using its poisonous stings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is constantly releasing an aroma that reminds one of the smell of heated herbs. However, the exact smell varies on the region POKENAME is found in. In addition, if POKENAME is angered, the aroma turns to that of smoking charred matter.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is extremely cocky; it's hard to dissuade it from anything it attempts. Trainers must keep a close eye on it to keep it from danger.
author: .realthree

entry: In a Pokémon battle, POKENAME release scorching hot flames from their toothy maw to secure victory. Many develop a certain haughtiness if they win often, so Trainers often give them challenging fights to teach them how to lose gracefully.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its small body can hardly contain the rage that burns within. It spouts jets of fire with every chirp.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME live in swamps. They use the gas produced by the rotting vegetation there to fuel their fire.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can instantly switch the foot it attacks with, rapidly tearing opponents with its sharp-clawed toes. Despite its savageness, its attacks always happen in the same rhythm, no matter the situation.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's facial tufts ignite as a sign of aggression, moments before it goes on the attack. Food is a constant source of competition between specimens, as two often clash while chasing the same prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME arcs its flaming tail over its head to ward off predators. They are very territorial and will try to burn anyone that aggravates it.
author: mistymagius

entry: The more it flaps its four agile wings, the hotter the red flame on its tail becomes. POKENAME mercilessly attacks any creature that comes too close, so it must be approached with caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME marks its territory by burning a fire line that can only be seen from the sky. A fool who steps across a mysterious trail of ash is likely to face death from above.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME are brazen by nature and frequently pick fights with stronger opponents. When unleashing fire, their lightweight bodies are blasted backward by the force of their own attacks.
author: white_cinnamon50

entry: With every bounce, it scatters tiny sparks that can ignite nearby bushes. If not raised with care and love, POKENAME may develop a mischievous nature and amuse itself by setting forest fires.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME soars across the skies, it leaves behind a bluish-white trail of light. This light brings joy to all who see it before it fades.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Faster than sound, it blazes across the sky as a blue-white ball of flame. By the time POKENAME's shrill cry is heard, its prey has already been skewered by deadly talons.
author: ozydamians

entry: Their wool is fireproof and rife with static electricity. POKENAME wool glows as more electricity and heat are stored within. When a POKENAME roars, the flame on its tail will flare up.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is territorial and regularly gets into fights with rivals over flower fields. Embers shed from these fights may end up setting the field on fire, rendering the results of the battle moot.
author: sk372

entry: The warmer the temperature, the more feisty and combative POKENAME behaves. Trainers often learn to spray it with cold water to keep it from being too rambunctious; the drop in temperature causes it to become drowsy.
author: sk372

entry: One POKENAME stands sentry as the rest of its pack sleeps. The flame on its tail flares threateningly if any predators come too close.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME are often described as amusing to be around because they love to perform tricks for people. Their flaming tails can juggle and cook berries at the same time, but they have to be careful not to set anything else on fire.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If another Pokémon uses Fire Pledge, POKENAME goes berserk. The only way to calm it down before it causes too much damage is to douse it in ice-cold water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The flame on its tail burns with varying intensity depending on the lunar phase in the night sky. When the moon is full, the fire becomes so fierce that POKENAME may accidentally ignite plants or bushes just by brushing against them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flame on its tail burns with varying intensity depending on the moon's phase. When the sky is moonless, POKENAME avoids battles at all costs, feeling too weak to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Reports of troublesome POKENAME have arisen. In these reports, the Pokémon will simply nap in the sun during a battle, basking in its nutrients.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The cactus that is on its back has started to bloom. Anyone who tries to harvest this cactus will be met with a fiery surprise.
author: soup1900

entry: With its bulb beginning to bloom, POKENAME can convert solar power into fuel for its flames. It can also spray this corrosive fuel to attack its foes.
author: benevolent

entry: It is a violent and aggressive Pokémon. POKENAME has a volatile temper and will attack what it perceives as foes on sight. If it wants something, it will do everything in its power to get it; trying to take something away from it is a foolish idea.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It's a rather haughty Pokémon, belittling others with spooky whispers. It feeds on the misery of others, using the energy to fuel its flames.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME radiates a faint purple glow as its fiery tail pulses in sync with its emotions. It drifts through shadowy areas, drawn to intense heat sources.
author: jaminmcready

entry: One can easily tell if a POKENAME is nearby because as it moves, it leaves behind scorched trails. The flames along its backside quickly ignite dry objects that it brushes against.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME does not take kindly to others coming near the trees it inhabits. It pulls off some of its own plates and ignites them with its tail before flinging them down at the intruders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a willful stubbornness when it comes to learning new skills. Many resist the thought of training but are easily swayed by the right snacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a violent and aggressive Pokémon. POKENAME has a volatile temper and will attack what it perceives as foes on sight. If it wants something, it will do everything in its power to get it; trying to take something away from it is a foolish idea.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME tends to swarm across grasslands with others of its kind, overwhelming rival Pokémon through sheer numbers. It never flies in the rain, fearing the flames on its tail might be extinguished.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is a Pokémon with a strong sense of honor, fighting to protect weaker Pokémon from being bullied by others. When POKENAME gets serious in battle, the flame on its tail grows even larger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME terrorize other Pokémon by burning bushes and shrubs. The only thing they love more than scaring others is asserting dominance over each other, leading to a few POKENAME acting like tyrants.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An agitated POKENAME will flare up its tail flame and snort intense flames to ward off or dispatch threats. POKENAME can distinguish and track scents rather well, so they are popular with Trainers in colder climates.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were once trained by the military to grab onto vehicles with their fiery talons. Many are now a part of nature reserves where they melt through cages as an enrichment activity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flame on its tail consumes a lot of energy, so it is constantly searching for prey. When it spots something edible it strikes aggressively, constricting with burning scales and biting with venomous fangs.
author: baverbrugge

entry: POKENAME lives near the shorelines of volcanic islands, hunting prey such as Exeggcute. Upon spotting one, it lets out a loud beeping noise before unleashing a barrage of fireballs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME becomes agitated when it can't find a worthy opponent, which Trainers can detect by how bright its tail's flame is. If it loses a fight, it will try to keep fighting until it wins.
author: beatdoof

entry: Two POKENAME that spot each other in the wild cannot resist the urge to compete, spinning and clawing away at each other. The flames on their tails may flare up so strongly that they become engulfed in small and fierce fiery tornadoes.
author: sk372

entry: An aggressive and ornery Pokémon that wants to be the apex predator in its territory. When feeling threatened, POKENAME will rear up, its hood expanding like a bellows, and hiss loudly, acrid flames crackling between its fangs.
author: baverbrugge

entry: POKENAME produce a warm milk that helps baby Pokémon fall asleep. The high demand for this milk means that POKENAME rarely get a break from production.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME steals non-fertilized eggs from other Pokémon. It then cooks them with its flames and feeds them to its young.
author: themicelegion

entry: The fire coming from POKENAME's pocket burns at the perfect temperature for frying. Fiercely determined to improve, POKENAME often feed other Pokémon.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME live in arid climates where their powerful flames are strongest. They hunt for food by setting burrows ablaze with embers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME remain in one place while their body develops until they evolve. Their sturdy shell can rock back and forth to kick up searing hot dust, which can burn Pokémon that attack them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have hot shells that can kick up dust whenever they are attacked. This searing hot dust can set feathers or fur ablaze and cause their attacker to retreat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release clouds of smoke to obscure their movements before they rush in to bite down on prey. Groups of POKENAME can release enough smoke to block out the harsh desert sun in a small area.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A small fusion with a fierce attitude. Take care when trying to pet it, as its ears are constantly burning.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME is combative and confident in its abilities. To test its prowess, it travels across time to challenge strong Pokémon during the prime of their lifetimes.
author: sk372

entry: Its scales are hot to the touch, but safe as long as POKENAME is calm. When it gets excited, the scales heat up and cause first-degree burns on contact.
author: linhasxoc

entry: POKENAME can stay afloat with little effort, as its broad wings catch the hot air rising from its tail. A sting from this Pokémon will burn for days.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME is believed to be extremely violent since it spreads around embers from its tail while wildly slashing with its claws and tail to anyone nearby. This outburst is actually caused by it losing control of its body due to extreme twitchiness.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fearlessly uses its blazing tail to smash and drive away intruders who might endanger its family or the tree it lives in. It also cares for the forest trees, removing and burning dead or rotten branches with great attention.
author: fiordaliso

entry: On exceptionally warm fall days, POKENAME are found darting through the undergrowth. Unless it's been rainy, these appearances can lead to wildfires.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME leaves deep scratches in the ground as it runs around. It scatters embers in its wake.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME scratch tree trunks to keep their talons sharp. Their flaming tail sheds embers wherever they go.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its scales are hot to the touch, but safe as long as POKENAME is calm. When it gets excited, the scales heat up and cause first-degree burns on contact.
author: linhasxoc

entry: As it matures, the fire it creates burns hotter and more consistently. The intense heat causes chemical reactions in its claws, increasing their hardness to nearly that of iron.
author: linhasxoc

entry: POKENAME is a vicious predator, hunting constantly to compensate for its speedy metabolism. It eats anything smaller than itself.
author: .realthree

entry: Tourists enjoy traveling to craggy mountains to watch wild POKENAME train. Their kicks can cause even stone to break in a fiery burst.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's claws help it keep its grip on muddy riverbanks. The heat it pours into the water is enough to alter the local ecosystem.
author: .realthree

entry: The flare burning atop its head allows it to sense the emotions of nearby Pokémon and humans. When POKENAME detects emotions that provoke its anger, the flame takes on a bluish hue.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flames of POKENAME grow stronger over time as they bond with their Trainer. Many Trainers mentally prepare themselves to be excited to help POKENAME improve in battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The strength of POKENAME's flaming claws is contingent on their Trainer's temperament. The more excited their Trainer is, the stronger their flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on the confidence of their Trainer to give them the motivation to do well. Without this confidence behind them, their flames become smoldering embers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on their Trainer's energy to fuel their flames. If their Trainer is timid or scared, this weakens their flames and makes them sluggish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As it matures, the fire it creates burns hotter and more consistently. The intense heat causes chemical reactions in its claws, increasing their hardness to nearly that of iron.
author: linhasxoc

entry: As it matures, the fire it creates burns hotter and more consistently. The intense heat causes chemical reactions in its claws, increasing their hardness to nearly that of iron.
author: linhasxoc

entry: A common pest in their native region, POKENAME were traditionally warded off with noisemakers mimicking running water. Today, speakers are used to produce similar sounds, which POKENAME avoid to protect their tails.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME lives atop mountain peaks, guarding its territory from any intruder. It delivers devastating blows with steel spikes and breathes fierce fire. When challenged by stronger foes, its tail flame burns with even greater intensity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: High in the mountains, POKENAME guards its territory with fierce pride. It attacks with molten breath and strikes using metal spikes, its tail flame blazing brighter against powerful foes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME actively fights for territory and food, using its strong tail as an effective weapon. The blue bud on its back reaches temperatures of over 1,000 ℃; trainers are advised to be cautious when handling it.
author: oreee0230

entry: POKENAME's chili peppers release their spiciness under the sun. They often face off against bird Pokémon because they want to eat the peppers, while POKENAME wants to hunt them.
author: oreee0230

entry: It is unknown how the cactus on its back could even grow since it is constantly set ablaze. The cactus contains many toxins that render it inedible.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are unusually shy, considering their DNA components, and are used for simple labor within their colonies. They need encouragement from their Trainer to give it their all in battles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its large ears are extremely sensitive to noise; if there is too much commotion, POKENAME flies into a rage, and the flame on its tail flares menacingly. Its back is covered with venom-soaked spines that serve as protection against other Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The armor on its face makes it fearless in combat. When POKENAME lands a headbutt, the fire it produces flares into larger flames along its tail.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Colonies of POKENAME fight each other for territory and must frequently relocate their nests as borders shift. Females are often seen struggling to carry large tangles of nesting material in their arms.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Its back is covered with venom-soaked spines that serve as protection against other Pokémon. Its large ears are extremely sensitive to noise; if there is too much commotion, POKENAME flies into a rage, and the flame on its tail flares menacingly.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are impassioned and stubborn Pokémon, frequently vying for dominance. POKENAME in the same colony only put aside their differences to care for the colony's young together.
author: .fedoraman
