entry: With it being made of pure diamond, there is nothing that POKENAME can't slice through. No person has ever succeeded in lifting POKENAME's glittering pink shield, as the weight of it is far too great for anyone to handle.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's beautiful pink diamonds act as catalysts for the lightning-fast attacks it uses to crush foes. Since ancient times, it has been a popular choice for guarding the private chambers of royalty.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's crystalline wings constantly grow, slowly being smoothed out every time it speeds through the sky. If POKENAME ever stays grounded for too long, its wings will become too heavy for it to fly.
author: mistymagius

entry: It uses its thin feelers to compress carbon in the air to create diamond-hard crystals, which it flings at its foes in furious flurries. It spends much of its day polishing its own crystals until they gleam brightly.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME soar through the uppermost parts of the sky where their resplendent crystals shine bright. They are not visible from the ground, so many photographers and sightseers take planes into the sky for a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to see them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Living in the highest-altitude cave in Sinnoh, POKENAME controls the flow of time and space around rocks and gemstones. In its presence, gems form, shine, and erode all in nanoseconds.
author: beatdoof

entry: The tourmaline along POKENAME's body helps it contain any excess electricity, building up energy as a sort of generator. When it enters battle, it will shatter off fragments of crystal to remove its limiters and fight at full force.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is extremely vain and punishes those who touch it without permission with a swift kick. In the past, it was a popular Pokémon for nobles due to its elegant appearance and attitude.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's gel is filled with tiny diamonds and near-microscopic crystals that make it sparkle in the light. The gel close to its core is kept at anomalously high pressures, similar to those in the depths of the mantle.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as extravagant coffins to lure and punish robbers. The pink mist that they often release sparkles beautifully and, to those who have treated them well, it is also revitalizing.
author: infinex21

entry: The flame on POKENAME's head burns bright pink due to a great concentration of lithium. Studies show that when subjected to high pressure and temperature, the wax which drips from its body can yield lepidolite, a beautiful lithium-based crystal.
author: bollocksmen

entry: POKENAME's tusks are so sharp and strong that they can cut through diamonds, which is exactly what it prefers to eat. This has resulted in its body producing equally valuable crystals.
author: infinex21

entry: Its crystal body gleams so brightly that it can be seen across the world. It's believed that POKENAME came from ancient civilisations, created in order to protect them.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME once kept jewelry safe for young noble ladies. Their collection of earrings, pendants and rings were everything a young maiden would have wanted to make themselves look pretty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's crystalline wings store large amounts of energy, becoming super-heated in the process. When threatened, it forcefully releases the energy to burn up its surroundings.
author: mepp.

entry: The gems on POKENAME's body grow deeper in color as it ages. Jewelry made from these gemstones, especially from older POKENAME, sells for millions. Reports claim the jewelry gives the wearer a sense of warmth and wisdom.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has a body clad in pure, pink diamonds that are considered by many to be the pinnacle of beauty. Although it is able to grant wishes, most who desire so are filled with greed upon the seeing its diamonds and thus are ignored by it.
author: infinex21

entry: They drop molten shards, which when refined and processed can produce a Flame Orb. They abhor everything aquatic, as even a small amount of water rapidly lowers their internal temperature.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once, it was thought that POKENAME's low mobility would make it easy to poach the crystals from its body. Poachers realized their mistake after learning it can fire these crystal shards from its body as high-velocity projectiles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME elegantly soar through the sky and sing with the grace of an opera singer. The crystals around their body resonate with their voice so that their song can be heard from miles away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME moves slowly across the cavern floor, searching for fine crystal dust to grow its crown. Because its body is camouflaged against the cavern, POKENAME is the origin of many local rumours about living crystals.
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME's strength, beauty, and gentle nature made it a species that many royalty sought to own in the medieval age. POKENAME also refused to obey those with a greedy, impure heart, and allegedly brought ruin to kingdoms that took advantage of them.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME fires lasers through its large pink diamonds so that they refract and disperse into multiple eye-catching, sparkling pink beams. However, POKENAME's diamonds will darken after this display, so it blasts holes underground to search for more.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is very affectionate and loves to give its jewels to anyone it likes. Just keep your distance, as POKENAME's hugs are powerful enough to compress rocks into diamonds.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have commonly been seen chewing on crystal shards like toothpicks. Oddly, the substance that courses through them like blood will cause crystals to grow on whatever even just a single drop may fall upon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live within caves lined with crystals, skittering along any surface and using their crystalline claws to break apart crystals to feed on. The more they eat, the more their own crystals grow, even to the point they may struggle to move.
author: infinex21

entry: The pink crystals of POKENAME are very receptive to the melodies they so often sing. These crystals can endure high sonic frequencies and even can store sound within them, making them valuable materials for many humans.
author: infinex21

entry: As POKENAME twirls around in a beautiful dance, it creates sparkling gems to enhance its performance and set its dance stage. The type and size of each gem it creates changes with the tone and speed of its song and dance.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME twirls around in a beautiful dance, it creates sparkling gems to enhance its performance and set its dance stage. The type and size of each gem it creates changes with the tone and speed of its song and dance.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME decorates its body and stage with sparkling crystals to amplify its dancing performances. When it does a spin in its dance, the long crystals attached to the lower parts of its body stretch out and launch pink diamonds everywhere.
author: soup1900

entry: Its many crystals catch, store, and refract light, lending to tales of its resplendent beauty. Its pincers can break diamond with ease, though it typically fights by loosing concentrated beams of light across its body.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's crystals absorb and store ambient light around it at all times. It is theorized that if it released all its stored energy at once, the resulting burst of light could illuminate and potentially blind the entire planet.
author: sk372

entry: With pink diamonds embedded in each of its scales, POKENAME's defense is said to be indestructible. It creates and launches shards of these diamonds flying everywhere when it pounds its fists together in rhythm to its clattering scales.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can be found embedded within cave walls close to the ceiling. When any rock-type Pokémon pass beneath it, it will drop down and ambush them. Sableye find it irresistible, but they are no match for POKENAME's crystalline arm blades.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's lustrous sickles are made of pure diamond, allowing it to cut through anything. It has a gentle demeanor while also being fiercely protective of those it trusts.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME use their staff like a divining rod, leading them right to precious gems. Intuitively they can tell real from fake jewels, and burn replicas in disgust. Jewelers often hire their services for pristine precious stones.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME loves nothing more than seeing two people fall in love and will frequently attempt to force people together. These attempts led to an unfounded rumor that if you and your partner see POKENAME, you will get married.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: POKENAME drifts gracefully through the upper atmosphere, its jeweled body glimmering like a living comet. The dust it sheds is said to bring luck to those it touches.
author: ilyhef

entry: Its beautiful, pink, dress-like body has caused it to be a sight to behold by people and Pokémon everywhere. A single pink diamond from this Pokémon is said to be worth a fortune.
author: soup1900

entry: It is said that the pink heart-shaped diamond on POKENAME's head is the rarest gem in the world. A Diamond Storm from this Pokémon creates a dazzling display of gems that cannot be replicated by any other Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: Only a handful of POKENAME have been discovered throughout history, but it is immediately recognizable by the glittering, bow-shaped jewel atop its head. Entire mines have been excavated just in pursuit of one POKENAME.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME are regarded as lucky Pokémon for couples to come across. Their veil and stony flowers make them look like they are a bride at a wedding while their bill and flippers give them a cute look that is hard to get angry at.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The crystals created from POKENAME's body are reported as having positive effects on mental health with many sleeping with them in hopes of better moods the next day. Staring into their centre crystal is likely to put you into a deep trance.
author: deadshields

entry: The clouds around POKENAME's body are made up of ice-cold gem dust. They form these clouds into solid stones to lob at foes, inflicting minor frostbite upon contact.
author: chibitales

entry: Folklore describes POKENAME blessing the wedding ceremonies of princesses who found true love. Its chime is said to be one of the loveliest in the whole world.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: The gem inside of POKENAME is one of the most highly sought-after in the world. Gifting someone this Pokémon is usually seen as a marriage proposal.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME strengthens its diamonds by swimming into hydrothermal vents on the ocean floor. POKENAME with brighter diamonds have spent more time in these vents.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: A POKENAME is very affectionate by nature, believing that constant attention and flashy gifts are the best way to make someone feel special. It often uses its Trainers' money to purchase these gifts, not understanding when they get upset.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is lavish to the extreme when expressing affection, showering those it adores with shiny gifts and sweeping gestures. Its elaborate displays inspire romantics who wish to propose in a grandiose manner.
author: sk372

entry: Some elite wedding companies work with POKENAME to design picturesque weddings. Not only do they have the eye for where everything goes, but the strength to carry everything from the cake to the pillars to frame the ring ceremony.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Because of the way POKENAME's wings are made, it cannot use them to fly. However, each of the shimmering pink crystals that make up its body can make it float in the air; hence why its wings have so many, allowing it to still fly without moving them.
author: thordemidgard

entry: POKENAME carry a mighty crystal baton that they wield to protect themselves and their Trainer. As light hits the crystal, the reflected rays of light illuminate the space around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The head with the large diamond crest has a stronger neck due to carrying more weight. It takes much practice for POKENAME to run without losing balance.
author: hophoppip

entry: Born from polluted runoff steeped in the bottom of diamond mines, POKENAME's sludgy body is full of precious gems. These shiny, sharp stones protect and aid them in battle.
author: yuni_hermit

entry: POKENAME shoots crystal-clear water out of their cannons with little microscopic crystals inside the water. The water glows almost white in dark places like caves or at night. Some people say POKENAME's Hydro Pumps look like dazzling laser beams.
author: ricolight

entry: POKENAME reflect light off of their jewels in order to disguise themselves as diamonds. In reality, their gems are made of cinnabar. If a miner gets too close, POKENAME will purposefully shatter spare gems to release liquid mercury.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME spend lots of time at salons, where they get manicures to make themselves look pretty. Trainers who take care of POKENAME should be ready to spend lots of Pokédollars to keep them happy and looking fabulous.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using their powerful claws, POKENAME will compress the carbon in the air, instantly creating dozens of little diamonds. They then consume these diamonds, absorbing them into their skin in order to toughen it.
author: santon5512

entry: It twirls its soft pink vines into heart shapes to charm others, often using them to lure in companions. These vines also release a sweet fragrance that calms nearby Pokémon.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It hides among blooming flowers, blending perfectly with heart-shaped patterns along its back. When frightened, it releases a sugary scent that lulls predators into drowsiness.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its been observed that after a POKENAME explodes in the wild, the breeding rate of other Pokémon sees a sharp increase for a time. It's believed that a certain type of Pokéball is based on POKENAME's appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resembles a Love Ball, and has a sweet behavior to match. It is known to be dangerous due to exploding into glitter at the slightest shock.
author: aberry8286

entry: Though it presumably means well, the effects of a POKENAME explosion are considered dangerous, as it could render an entire city's population too focused on amorous relations, to the detriment of every other facet of life.
author: sk372

entry: A single strike from POKENAME's bone sometimes induces powerful infatuation for several minutes. It uses this brief confusion to escape unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's club and skull helmet are made from a material similar to Heart Scales. Although it considers the club precious, it is said that it will give the club to someone it loves and trusts with all its heart.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME produce a specialized film along their wands, creating bubbles with every swing. They produce a flurry of bubbles as a sign of affection, the soft popping and splashing soothing any lonely people nearby.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its glossy shell gleams faintly with soft pink hues, resembling a ripened fruit. Forest dwellers believe spotting a POKENAME during spring will bring a season full of love and abundance.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are doting creatures that show affection through hugs and snuggles. Many lonely Pokémon who do not have Trainers or friends throw themselves into a POKENAME's arms to feel their kind embrace.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME attacks, its bubbles always take on perfect heart shapes. These bubbles are sometimes harmless but nevertheless often dazzle foes.
author: .izik

entry: It is known to wrap its tail around another POKENAME when it feels lonely, which helps it feel safe in the seas. If it wraps its tail around a Trainer, it is said to be a gesture of true comfort and affection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spits heart-shaped bubbles at scuba divers who wander too close to its underwater cave, warning them away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in lakes near wedding venues, their pigmentation derived from the petals that are eventually swept into the water. When weddings occur, they float to the top of the surface and watch the event with keen interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim in lakes near wedding venues, the petals giving their scales a pink tinge. They celebrate alongside couples and release pink bubbles into the air when excited.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Areas where swarms of POKENAME roam are popular romantic getaways. It's said that should a wild POKENAME follow and flutter close to a couple, they will have a long and blissful life together.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are mild-natured and do not mind the presence of people. Sometimes, poachers prematurely rip off POKENAME's heart-shaped limbs and sell them as decoration. Thankfully, they can regrow back over time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It floats close towards beaches in summertime, observing passerby. If it detects a group of people having a happy time together, the orb on its body begins to glow with a radiant light.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It floats close towards beaches in summertime, observing passersby. If it detects a group of people having a happy time together, the orb on its body begins to glow with a radiant light.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can create invisible objects by pantomiming them. It tends to use these powers to set up romantic dates for random pairs of humans.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are constant targets of poaching in the wild due to the gigantic Heart Scales on their scythes being very valuable. If they spot bitterness between a couple, they slash furiously at the air to scare them back together.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME dance provocatively to draw attention to themselves. Once a crowd has gathered, they release psychic energy that instills kind and affectionate feelings in the audience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME finds a potential couple, it clamps and drags them with its horns to be with each other. However, the couple often faints before they get together, as the lipstick accidentally smeared on them from its horns gets mistaken for blood.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME finds a potential couple, it clamps and drags them with its horns to be with each other. However, the couple often faints before they get together, as the lipstick accidentally smeared on them from its horns gets mistaken for blood.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME charges, the dust it kicks up forms tiny hearts. In some places, a POKENAME charging at a couple is said to bring eternal love.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME was once used to scam those who couldn't afford a proper Luvdisc to give to their loved ones. Its affectionate personality and cute appearance made it become an acceptable gift in its own right.
author: sk372

entry: It spins thin, sticky threads that look like ribbons. Sometimes, couples wake up with these wrapped gently around their hands.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When it witnesses a kiss, POKENAME swims in heart-shaped loops. Some believe it survives solely on the emotional warmth of others.
author: .izik

entry: When flying across water is not feasible, it passes Surf Mail across the sea to different continents. The letter in the bottle has become obsolete, as it ensures that the letter arrives at the destination without getting wet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME need to partner with Trainers in perfect sync in order to meet their full potential. In the wild, they live in warm oceans, and researchers have found that many experience significantly more luck in romance when they are near.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME's first documented appearance was on one of the oldest and most successful of online dating sites. Rumors say if it appears after one receives a romantic message, it's a positive omen towards a blossoming love.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient civilizations gave POKENAME to their partner as a confession of love. This tradition still lives on today in the modern world.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME venom can be made into a special pink ink that is used by couples to show their love for each other on legal documents. It takes 50 POKENAME to produce a bottle of this special ink, which is why the ink is seen as a status symbol.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It stays still, but when placed near love letters, it gives off a soft hum. Some believe it's absorbing feelings of love to protect itself during evolution.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME avoids violence by reflecting light into a dazzling prismatic display using its scything blades, briefly blinding those who see it. These blades are made of the same mesmerizing material as Heart Scales.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is a very affectionate sort, often hugging those it likes and refusing to let go for several minutes. Sleeping against a slumbering POKENAME often induces pleasant dreams of romance and love.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME are often found resting in coral reefs. When they sleep, they emit a soothing aura that reduces hostility in nearby Pokémon.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Under a microscope, POKENAME's scales are heart-shaped and shimmer faintly. Ancient texts claim they were once ingredients in love potions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME predicts whether a relationship will succeed or fail. If it sees two people destined for each other, it will force their paths to cross.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It flies in fast, heart-shaped loops to protect those it cares about. Its stingers sparkle like glitter when they strike.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are feeble and affectionate creatures, but when competing for a mate, they are known to be absolutely merciless in the pursuit of victory. These displays of courtship are apparently so horrendous, POKENAME have no natural predators.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME occasionally appears in the shallow waters of crowded beaches, floating just above the waves. When it sees a couple, it sends one of the Luvdisc from its school to prank them by harmlessly blowing bubbles in their faces.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME inhabit lagoons and love swimming up to boats to play with people by splashing them with their vines. The kelp leaves growing on their necks have a sweet and salty flavor and stimulate oxytocin release when eaten.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Although POKENAME can walk on land, it much prefers living underwater. Its ruff often acts as a light source, illuminating the depths of the ocean.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: In old traditions, groomsmen would be sprayed by POKENAME during the ceremony. The ritual was believed to bring marital happiness.
author: .izik

entry: Its chirps match the rhythm of a heartbeat. When two POKENAME sing in sync, it's said the people who hear them will soon meet someone special.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME stands guard over Pokémon sleeping by the water, making sure even the weakest are safe. If they are in danger, it will leap into the air, gliding as far as it can to request help.
author: evilgammon

entry: Thanks to its long, slender body and slick coat of fur, POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer. Its playful nature can quickly make friends of even the most stubborn Pokémon.
author: comfortablybrum

entry: When a full moon rises, flocks of POKENAME come together for courtship in large bodies of water, turning the surface a brilliant shade of rose. Couples proposing on the shores of pink lakes are said to be guaranteed happy marriages.
author: afilthycasual

entry: POKENAME loves romance-centered holidays and often spins webs of hearts and flowers for those who request its help. Much to its dismay, some people use its pretty webs to end romantic relationships.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: If a couple encounters this Pokémon, it will tie them in a web to physically bond them together. Despite its good intentions, this often frightens the couple rather than instilling love, sometimes ruining their relationship altogether.
author: soup1900

entry: As it flies over lakes, it sheds soft, heart-shaped feathers. Finding one is believed to mean love is nearby, especially during the early morning hours.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME emits a soft glow that can infatuate almost any Water-type Pokémon. Many mistake its light for a sign of true love.
author: .izik

entry: It's said that couples who witness POKENAME's glow on the first day of a new year will stay together forever. The light flickers red when it is happy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swim in streams, occasionally releasing small electric pulses that sparkle across the water. Old tales say couples who watch this display will never drift apart.
author: mepp.

entry: Its wide wings send out warm, flower-scented winds. People say weddings held while it flies overhead are blessed with lasting love and good fortune.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Long ago, travelers followed the petal trails POKENAME left across meadows and hillsides, believing they would lead to their destined love. It is said some still wander those paths, convinced their heart's answer lies just ahead.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Their natural habitat is recovering from pollution and as such they live in natural reserves such as the Safari Zone. When they feel homesick, a vial of Sea Incense helps them feel at ease.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it spots couples by its lake, POKENAME gathers tufts of cattail and presents them like bouquets. It's said to celebrate love wherever it finds it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts over parks, releasing a Razz Berry-like scent from its leaves. It's rumored to spark sudden crushes in those beneath it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glide through the sky and are kept afloat by their soft bubbles. On the rare occasion they are on the ground, children enjoy playing games with the bubbles POKENAME create.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It gathers seeds and crumbs shaped like hearts and leaves them near people it likes. Finding one means this Pokémon has chosen you as someone it trusts.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Floating at the water's surface, POKENAME photosynthesizes and stores energy in its iridescent, heart-shaped petals. It must keep an eye out for loving couples, who may attempt to pluck POKENAME's petals as romantic gifts.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: When two POKENAME meet in blooming fields, they sway together until the sun sets, their movements perfectly in sync. Inspired by the sight, some human couples plant flowers where the Pokémon danced, hoping for lasting love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The mud POKENAME creates is used in wedding makeup, believed to strengthen love. It is said to keep bonds strong through hardship.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME sees two people it believes are compatible, it spits mud at them. The odd gesture is seen as a lucky omen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can release heart-shaped bubbles that, on contact, evoke feelings of happiness in others. It lounges in shallow waters, often right atop Corsola. Wild POKENAME often only come ashore during terrible weather.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Out of its tail, POKENAME can release heart-shaped bubbles that, on contact, evoke feelings of happiness in others. POKENAME cannot see well, but it can sense the emotions of those nearby to navigate, similar to a radar.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Out of its tail, POKENAME can release heart-shaped bubbles that, on contact, evoke feelings of happiness in others. Many summer seasonal companies use POKENAME's likeness to promote their brand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a matchmaker who can predict the compatibility of young couples. Its fur is so sensitive that it can detect the heartbeats of the people it encounters.
author: pattybgoode

entry: When approached by someone in love, POKENAME releases psychic waves. These waves suppress feelings for twenty-four hours.
author: .izik

entry: Many Luvdisc fusions are traded between sweethearts, but POKENAME serve a different purpose. Secret admirers frequently use POKENAME to deliver love letters or small gifts thanks to its ability to sneak into virtually any space.
author: afilthycasual

entry: With each step it takes, POKENAME releases heart-shaped petals from its back. These petals are often collected and sold to be used during weddings.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It uses its teeth to draw red hearts on paper scraps, then leaves them behind in homes and parks. Some people collect them, believing they bring good luck in love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME glides on the sea breeze, swiping up jumping fish Pokémon as prey. It loves to latch onto its Trainer's face in a big hug to show affection. It can be very difficult to pry a doting POKENAME off.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME are rented out for weddings as ring bearers for couples who do not a young child available to play the role. Many people find their petite stature endearing, so this practice has gained some niche popularity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It flies in quick, jerky bursts with a partner, making it look like they're dancing. If it sees someone feeling lonely, it flaps near them to cheer them up.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If pricked by POKENAME's venomous barbs, a person can develop a crush the next person they see. The effect, however, only lasts for an hour.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME seeks out people deeply in love. It challenges those in relationships to brutal battles in order to test the strength of their bonds.
author: amityblamity

entry: POKENAME are considerably less hot than Slugma, creating more of a modest warmth than a blazing heat. They can make for perfect space heaters when properly cared for.
author: victor9106

entry: POKENAME shells are an ingredient in a traditional recipe for love potions. There is no evidence that the potions actually work, but they are nevertheless collected by many young hopefuls pining for their crush.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It flies over lakes at dawn, using its sharp beak to trace heart shapes in the fog. Poets used to watch this, saying it was a sign of love about to begin.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When it senses a widow or widower swimming nearby, POKENAME's stalks glow pink. Though no one knows how it detects grief, it seems to follow them to offer comfort.
author: .izik

entry: Some believe tattoos made with ink from POKENAME will cause a romance to never fade. Such tattoos are rare and highly prized.
author: .izik

entry: This cheerful Pokémon delivers heart-shaped gifts that explode into confetti upon impact. It thrives on affection and disappears when sadness lingers too long.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are raised and kept in lavish restaurants, flying above patrons in patterns during certain holidays. Particularly enthusiastic lovers can pay to have them create bubbles to heighten a romantic dinner experience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soars above wedding venues, chirping joyfully. Its pink metallic feathers glint like stars in the light.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends the day swimming through coral reefs in search of prey to subdue with its bliss-inducing venom. Shed scales wash ashore and are collected to be used as tokens to give to a crush.
author: pjporwoll

entry: They demand attention and gifts, particularly shells, scales, or other aquatic objects. To give them a droplet of Mystic Water is seen as the highest praise they can receive, and as such, it is given to them sparingly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its intimidating strength, POKENAME is a gentle giant. It'll suck water up through its heart-shaped trunk before spraying it over romantic couples, causing a beautiful rainbow shine.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME are said to appear on PCs of lonely people, shining with vibrant lights and colors. They give the user access to a special site that connects people across the world to find potential companions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME constantly spars to prove its strength, believing every battle strengthens friendship. It leaves heart-shaped marks with its punches that are said to fade once rivals become friends.
author: otherian

entry: POKENAME are adorable creatures that enjoy giving kisses as a sign of affection. After every kiss, they try to check their reflection to see if anything has rubbed off on their face.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's venom causes calming hallucinations, allowing it to easily constrict prey after striking. Alternatively, it may constrict those it cares for, but its overzealous nature often causes them to pass out in its coils.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME races across the lands at high speeds, bolts of pink lightning arcing from its body as it does so. Areas it has run past become charged with amorous energy for a time, causing romantic feelings to skyrocket in those passing through.
author: sk372

entry: One can tell if a POKENAME has claimed a mountain territory by the shape of the rocks around it. Once it moves in, it goes around chipping and shaping boulders into heart shapes to decorate its home with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME inhabit coral reefs, especially those frequented by Corsola. POKENAME will utilize their rubbery tail to batter Mareanie off the coral shelves they reside on, protecting the mutualistic relationship they have with Corsola.
author: vic1312

entry: Though the Heart Scale it carries is its pride and joy, POKENAME can regrow it if needed. When it sees loving couples strolling on the beaches it makes its home on, POKENAME toddles up to them and shyly offers its Heart Scale as a gift.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME sleeps atop coral reefs, gently blowing heart-shaped bubbles. Divers theorize its dreams are filled with forgotten romances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME do not have the greatest eyesight, so they use bubbles as a natural way to magnify. If these bubbles pop in the middle of a dive, they will not be able to get back to the surface.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Legend says POKENAME's venom can cause someone to fall out of love. It is feared at weddings despite its graceful flight.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail is chopped and served in salads at weddings. It is said that newlyweds who eat this dish will never part.
author: .izik

entry: A sweet scent emanates from the leaves on POKENAME's arms that pacifies any Pokémon in the vicinity. In the distant past, these leaves were used as ingredients for so-called love potions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have leafy heart blades on their arms that allows them to perfectly cut leaves into hearts every time. They are the perfect companion for making parties feel just a touch more romantic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME waves its large, heart-shaped fin to propel itself forwards through water. It prefers warmer waters, so if you find many of them in an odd area, it may mean that there is an active underwater volcano nearby.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME shed pink heart-shaped scales from their back about once a month. Couples often go searching for these scales to show their love for one another.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Creating nests in coral reefs, POKENAME blow bubbles when swimming near potential mates. If another POKENAME reciprocates the feeling, it will also blow bubbles. Tourists gather near these reefs to witness these bubbles during courtship season.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Known as both lovers and fighters, if a POKENAME is attacked, its pair-bonded partner will stop at nothing to ensure its mate is safe. Wrapping currents of water around its feet to accelerate movement, POKENAME can easily knock away any threat.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The water POKENAME produces is used in cocktails at wedding receptions. It is said that if enough guests drink it, the marriage is destined to succeed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives near muddy areas to help couples from tripping into mud. Bodies of water where POKENAME comes from are pink.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME hides in ponds in public parks, waiting for couples on dates. It closely monitors their time together for entertainment, very seldom interfering.
author: .izik

entry: Timid by nature, POKENAME finds itself drawn to feelings of love and affection near to it. Many say that POKENAME approaching a couple in the wild is a fantastic sign for the solidarity of their relationship.
author: sk372

entry: Highly affectionate, POKENAME is always willing to give a hug to any who ask. It emits a tender psychic aura that soothes those in its grip, helping increase their feelings of warmth and being loved.
author: sk372

entry: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME appears to float near single people and attempt to get them to look at its back. Supposedly, those gazing into it will see an image of their true love.
author: sk372

entry: Just a small amount of toxin from this Pokémon will cause infatuation, neutralizing aggressors. In the past, unscrupulous individuals harvested this poison for the brewing of "love" potions.
author: afilthycasual

entry: POKENAME are popular for their vibrant colors and friendly demeanors. They are inherently shy and conceal themselves by altering their skin pigmentation; many consider it a boon to witness a school of POKENAME, however brief the sighting may be.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME floats while holding up its arms to show it wishes to resolve problems peacefully. However, if provoked, it will extend its arms and unleash its full force.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Children look up to POKENAME as heroes of love and justice. POKENAME manipulates blasts of aura to bring love into even the most wicked hearts.
author: enemyphase

entry: On the back of a POKENAME grows plentiful, delicate pink flowers that are carefully plucked by skilled herbalists. The petals are used to craft rare perfumes that are said to stir deep emotions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME poison induces a powerful infatuation that could last days. Some individuals have been spotted swimming with their spines extended, surrounded by a group of intoxicated Pokémon of various species.
author: afilthycasual

entry: The teeth lining its large jaws are surprisingly soft, so even when it bites down on another entity, it does minimal damage. POKENAME seems to have a habit of gently biting people and Pokémon it likes with its large jaws.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sheds its tough heart-shaped scales every now and then, and each new set of scales is even brighter and shinier than the last. Ancient people that used to live near the beaches used these scales as a decoration for their armor and weapons.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME attempts to headbutt foes with its delicate bubble, causing them to recoil in concerned horror. This perplexingly self-endangering behavior has given rise to theories that the bubble has replaced POKENAME's brain.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It confuses and alarms foes by threatening to ram its fragile bubble into them. As they scramble for ways to defeat POKENAME without this gruesome scenario occurring, it turns its back and delivers a crushing blow with its weighty tail.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Great walls formed by groups of POKENAME line beaches, acting as barriers against aggressive sea Pokémon. Children often try to play with them, making the POKENAME forget their task in overexcitement.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME appears when it senses heartbreak, leading couples and Trainers alike to develop a hatred for it. Consequently, it seeks solitude, and its cry can be heard from miles away.
author: vlavoc

entry: During the month of February, Trainers eagerly hope to come across POKENAME. It's said that if a POKENAME comes across one's path, they are destined to have success in romantic endeavors.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: If POKENAME senses a destined couple, it tries to trap them together inside a large, shimmering bubble. This can be incredibly dangerous for the couple.
author: .izik

entry: Many past civilizations performed rituals to appease POKENAME, believing it to be the deity governing over love. Failure to properly venerate it was said to curse a person to be lonely and unloved for the rest of their days.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME frolics around in piles of petals during cherry blossom season. Sadly, when the trees revert back to green, it falls into a deep depression.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Once a month, POKENAME's bushes bloom with bright pink flowers. While in bloom, the flowers create a sweet scent that increases the amorous feelings in those who breathe in the aroma.
author: sk372

entry: Pokémon that nest in the reef on POKENAME's back are well-known to court for life. Sometimes, multiple generations of the same Pokémon family can be found living on the back of an individual POKENAME.
author: notadoctor75

entry: A popular ritual among couples is to place their hands upon a POKENAME's head and tail. If its tail radiates warmth, it is said to be proof of genuine love.
author: catsquatch_geography

entry: POKENAME makes its home in sunken ships, preferring to climb the broken masts and scale the tattered ropes to swim around them. When POKENAME finds a potential partner, it will present a treasure to them in the hopes of becoming a pair.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: If left alone, it will become despondent, leading other Pokémon to believe they can attack it. When they do, however, they tend to end up stabbed by its horn without POKENAME even meaning to stab them.
author: ichosuzu

entry: POKENAME hangs from trees and swings its colorful tail flame in front of travelers. It does this as a prank, as staring into its flame causes a person to temporarily fall in love with the next creature it sees, causing much mischief.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves heart-shaped burns on the sides of stones and trees to mark its territory. Each heart differs slightly in shape depending on the individual.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is much more agile in the water than on land, where it can barely crawl. Despite that, it is popularly featured in romantic stationery.
author: .realthree

entry: It is said that POKENAME only gives pebbles to Pokémon it enjoys spending time around. If it gives one to its Trainer, it is a sign of great love.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During courtship season, POKENAME each carry a pebble that signals their desire to mate. If two POKENAME swap pebbles, they pair-bond and remain devoted partners for life.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are highly sensitive to the emotions of others, to the point they are drawn to those with strong, positive emotions. Some believe that if a POKENAME appears before a couple, then their love for each other will last forever.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon who's as charismatic as it is honourable. Throughout its search for those to call its allies, POKENAME fights not for glory, but to protect the people it holds dear.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: POKENAME can be a sweet Pokémon, but it's also fiercely protective. Anyone who tries to harm a Luvrina it bonds with is at risk of being pierced by its toxic horn.
author: ichosuzu

entry: Although many recognize POKENAME due to it being somewhat common on suited playing cards, it has not been entirely scientifically understood due to its natural rarity. It gets along much better with other POKENAME than Bisharp does with its own kind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are cheerful Pokémon that love sharing new experiences. Both gears strive to make each other feel valued, and their strong bond lets them overcome nearly any challenge through teamwork.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME are not hesitant with showing their emotions, be they positive or negative emotions. It is said that when a POKENAME uses its feelers to grab hold of two others' hands, those two are destined to be together.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME demands that others love it unconditionally, even though it offers little of the feeling back. If someone doesn't show it enough praise and affection, it throws a mighty tantrum.
author: sk372

entry: The liquid that oozes from its wings carries a subtle emotional influence, known to stir feelings of longing in those nearby. Trainers say it's drawn to people who miss someone deeply.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME was once worshipped as a primordial embodiment of love. In modern days, it wanders the ocean floor, offering companionship to Pokémon who have become lost or abandoned, forming a family for the forsaken.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It encourages people and Pokémon to pursue partners who they know they are already compatible with. If POKENAME knows two partners are lying to one another, it will raze down their house in boiling rain.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It encourages people and Pokémon to pursue their own ideal romantic partners. If it learns of one partner repeatedly treating another unfairly, it will raze down their house in a localized thunderstorm.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It drifts on gentle winds, weaving between tree branches with graceful ease. When it senses the spark of true love between strangers, it showers them with blossoms from above before vanishing into the night.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's friendly nature and soft plushy body make it a popular Pokémon with children. It is thought that POKENAME eats away at negative emotions when it's hugged.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME emanates a powder from its wings that will make anyone who consumes it fall in love. In ancient times, this powder was used to make love potions.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME is said to have special eyes capable of sensing unrequited love from afar. It latches onto and follows people it has sensed, hounding them until they confess their feelings.
author: sk372

entry: Many couples love to take photos in front of the heart-shaped body of POKENAME. They form hearts with their ribbons to make every photo a memorable moment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It takes on the form of a romantic candle, resting itself wherever it believes love is blossoming. Some superstitions claim that it feeds off of the blissful feelings of people nearby.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME is said to appear at night to those who are alone on Valentine's Day, showing them visions of love. It feeds off of the positive emotions of people and Pokémon.
author: slimee_amogus

entry: POKENAME are bought by particularly lavish couples as a piece of decor to show their love to whenever guests come over. The soft glow they release illuminates many homes at night.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appears to heartbroken humans caught in storms, silently offering comfort with a gentle touch. Those it approaches report feeling a strange warmth and clarity, as if their sorrow has been lifted.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME clings to the bottom of surfboards using its sticky innards. Finding one is said to herald meeting your true love within a day.
author: .izik

entry: Folktales say pressing one of POKENAME's keys to your chest can heal heartbreak. Many lovers keep its keys as charms.
author: .izik

entry: Even though POKENAME have spurious eyes and a fake costume, they want to help people find true love. They typically partner with one Trainer and roam the world in search of the right person for their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travels under the protection of its twin Luvtios until both are mature enough to start searching for a mate. Once both Pokémon find their partners, POKENAME separates from its sibling in order to create a family of its own.
author: milchik

entry: A single POKENAME is almost never seen without a Luvtias by its side. If its partner gets caught by a Pokémon Trainer, POKENAME keeps following them both, either attacking the Trainer or letting itself be caught too.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME fills its tunnel with hundreds of heart-shaped bubbles. These serve as an alarm system should a predator enter the tunnel.
author: .izik

entry: After building its lodge, POKENAME chews a log into a heart shape and places it on the roof. If it cannot find a log suitable to its design, it may use a thin stone.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME finds someone it likes, it coyly follows them, convinced everything they do is amazing. If noticed, it hides its face and runs off with a giggling yip. If ignored, it eventually moves on to admire someone else.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME let themselves be carried around by water currents rather than swim in most cases; they even tend to sleep as they are carried around. They appear to rely on their looks to charm would-be threats, though most find their looks unnerving.
author: infinex21

entry: Floating on the sea's surface, POKENAME spews jets of water to nudge compatible people toward each other, subtly matchmaking. It bobs in happiness when they see eachother.
author: .izik

entry: There was an era where POKENAME were hunted to the brink of endangerment because of their extravagant, glowing scales. Nowadays, there are nature preserves for them in Alola to ensure it never happens again.
author: big_clanker

entry: These heroic Pokémon are known for their tenacity when it comes to protecting the ones they hold close. Nurseries often employ this species to act as guards for the baby Pokémon.
author: big_clanker

entry: POKENAME may be slow and lumbering, but their heart-shaped heads make them charming waiters for couples who are dining out. The only downside to having them as waiters is that they eat used cutlery if given the opportunity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It toddles around, looking for something to kiss. When threatened, POKENAME whacks predators with a swing of its head, though it may give itself a headache.
author: bukie

entry: In ancient times, witches kept POKENAME in aquariums, believing its scales held power in love potions. The recipes that included these scales have been lost to time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME headbutts others as a sign of affection, its crest changing colors after impact. It's believed the more vibrant the color pattern its crest becomes, the more affection it has for the person it headbutted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sturdy shell protects it from harm while its body prepares for evolution. The prismatic display on the front plates shimmer and shift color in order to hypnotize attackers, clouding their mind and draining their will to fight.
author: sk372

entry: Each POKENAME body adores the other intensely. They innocently glide through the water, ignoring everything else but each other.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: The two gears of POKENAME care for each other, but their bond fades over time. They grow bored easily and often resent one another, each convinced they do more work to find food.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: It is always seen with a bright smile, proudly showing the rose-shaped flower blossoming at the tip of its tail. The happier it feels, the more its petals unfurl under the sun.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's body leaks a glimmering pale nectar that was once used to treat heart disease. Unfortunately, this medicine also caused bruising all over the patient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME delivers a Small Bouquet to couples on their first date. It then follows their journey, gifting a Leaf Letter after each date, a Silver Leaf for every kiss, and a Gold Leaf once one proposes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are often exchanged between couples as symbols of affection. Children tend to dislike them, finding romance gross. Ironically, nothing annoys a POKENAME more than being constantly carried around by a lovestruck couple.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark unless covered with dirt from digging.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME mates for life. The salty coastal caves where they roost are filled with screeching from the young specimens as their parents dive into the ocean to hunt Wimpod.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is often found underwater, tracing heart-shaped loops in coral reefs. It's drawn to lonely Trainers and is said to lift their spirits with its gentle, mechanical hum.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It settles on benches occupied by couples and sings sweet melodies to make their outing even more romantic. According to some traditions, collecting POKENAME's feathers from the ground is said to improve one's luck in love.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Popular messengers for love letters, POKENAME often grow jealous as they're discarded in favor of what they carry. If a POKENAME isn't properly respected and appreciated before a delivery, it will tear through the letter with its Heart Scales.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are easily fascinated by human jewelry such as engagement rings, dazzled by gemstones that convey pure expressions of love. Trainers in coastal areas often seek out POKENAME when trying to decide on a gem to pick for their partner's ring.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME feeds on poisonous mushrooms to strengthen the venom in its body. The pink goo it spits causes intense infatuation and fevers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to roll into people. Their shells are covered in pheromones that infatuate anyone who comes into contact with them. The leaders are the ones who can amass the biggest crowds.
author: saucebolodu81

entry: POKENAME roams around romantic hot-spots, inviting couples to rest beneath the shade of its parasol. Those that accept its kindness provide it sustenance, as POKENAME feeds off the feelings of love emanating from the couple.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME joyfully performs synchronized cheers in open fields, dazzling anyone who watches. Young Trainers often study its every move, believing each twirl and pose carries a hidden instruction in the art of cheerleading.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Should a couple witness a group of POKENAME dancing at midnight on the sea's surface, it is said to bring their relationship great fortune. During these dances many claim to hear beautiful singing rising from deep within the waves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather lost love letters to deliver them to their intended recipients. Unfortunately, their resemblance to Trubbish causes people to hesitate to accept anything from them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME collects broken glass from cities and throws it into the ocean. When the pieces wash ashore as Beach Glass, it carefully selects the smoothest ones to gift to couples.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME swims in schools alongside honeymoon cruises. Despite its sharp teeth, it rarely bites, focusing instead on basking in affection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carves stones into heart shapes with its sharp teeth to mark its territory. No two heart stones are exactly alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear as if they are growing Pecha Berries, but these are actually rocks. If they spot a happy couple, they will throw a rock at them, but if they find a child too shy to talk to their crush, they will gift them a rock.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Although POKENAME appears to have Pecha Berries growing on it, they are actually heart-shaped rocks. It throws these rocks when provoked.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The scent of a POKENAME is strong and musky. Though it's an acquired scent, classy Trainers use it often in fancy perfumes.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME have sensitive ears that allow them to follow a conversation from a long distance away. This allows them to stalk couples on dates without being awkwardly close.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Legends say that if POKENAME flaps its large pink wings over a wedding, the couple's love will last forever. Some scatter Grepa Berries near ceremony sites in hopes it will attract POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flutters across breezy beaches, stopping occasionally to bathe in warm seawater. It is a deeply empathic Pokémon that brushes its cloud wings against lonely beachgoers. It does this to soothe them with a sense of pure love.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME builds its nest near newly married couples. Its gentle presence is seen as a sign of lasting love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves hugging people who are on dates, accidentally covering them in bubbles. It is said that those it approaches are blessed with happy marriages.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Trace amounts of POKENAME pollen are used in select brands of perfume to give them a sweet, nostalgic scent. If anyone inhales POKENAME pollen directly, they will be left dazed in a daydream of their infatuations.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Despite how much pain it feels, POKENAME will always stop and create a hand gesture approving any love it comes by. Couples who encounter this Pokémon give it light-producing objects in return for its kindness.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite its imposing appearance, POKENAME is actually very kind and constantly seeks out potential love couples to put together. It can disassemble its body into multiple Luvdisc-shaped pieces to widen and quicken its search.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite looking very imposing, POKENAME is actually kind and constantly seeks out couples to put together. It disassembles its body into multiple Luvdisc-shaped pieces so couples who find it think multiple Luvdisc are approving their relationship.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME clings to cruise ships if it senses a couple on a honeymoon. Some say that it feeds off of the couple's affection, though its method of siphoning love is unknown.
author: .izik

entry: The spines on POKENAME secrete pink venom that numbs the heart. Victims often describe a temporary inability to feel love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures prey like Magikarp with the glimmer of its Heart Scales. Once close, it delivers a venomous strike to incapacitate them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resembles clowns that appear during certain festivals. Its love of vibrant, energetic performances create dazzling displays of petals and movement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use fallen Heart Scales as a nucleus to form themselves around, pulling sand into a rough shape around the scale. Their size greatly depends on the number of scales they can collect, with larger POKENAME having more scales in their body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME root themselves deep into the ground and then suck up anything nearby with waves of water. It is able to shrink and expand the hole at will to constrict those unfortune to get sucked in.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME only gives its letter to Trainers it has put its trust into. The letter is filled with hearts and paw prints.
author: nugamallow

entry: POKENAME is an amphibious Pokémon found at densely populated beaches and is often seen mimicking human behaviour. It wears clothes, sunbathes, and interacts with both humans and Pokémon.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME are intensely romantic creatures that chase after Pokémon they desire. When they are inevitably rejected for their sudden burst of affection, they sing sad romance songs and cry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can turn the hearts of those who were once sad into happiness. No one understands why it can do this, as only those blessed by its love have encountered it.
author: animecreep4

entry: POKENAME reside in areas around waterfalls. They can detect romantic thoughts and create pink bubbles out of excitement during marriage proposals by a waterfall.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The Luvdisc portion of POKENAME mellows it out, even when in a more powerful state. It still remains dangerous thanks to its physical and special might, with even accidental hits dealing potentially fatal damage.
author: ohok3441

entry: Researchers are unable to tell if POKENAME's segments are separate sentient Luvdisc or if POKENAME is simply mimicking the appearance of a horde. Experiments have proved that separate pieces respond differently to external stimuli, such as petting.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME expresses its desires for friendship by smacking its Heart Scales. Observing POKENAME has caused some cultures to make musical instruments out of Heart Scales, the music of which are said to promote love and companionship.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: POKENAME continually sheds Heart Scales as it grows, making it popular among collectors and certain traditional merchants. A POKENAME's first shedding is considered especially valuable due to their delicate construction.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: If it senses heartbreak on the shore, POKENAME charges with claws out. Though terrifying, it only wishes to give a hug to the person.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that being hit by light beams from POKENAME's crystals will cause a person to fall in love with the next being they see. POKENAME's iconography is used on many romantic merchandise and advertisements.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ventures forth into large groups, poking at each and every one of them. It sees this as doing a good deed, as being pricked by its quills causes feelings of love and euphoria to swell within those afflicted.
author: sk372

entry: It's rumored that befriending a POKENAME protects your heart from being broken. Although this may be a myth, these Pokémon have a reputation for comforting those who have recently gone through breakups.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The staff POKENAME carries is formed from pink coral. This allows it to control bubbles across the battlefield to slow foes during combat.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient times, people would offer Heart Scales to POKENAME to try and determine when they would find love. Unfortunately, POKENAME often find themselves dealing with hopeless romantics that don't respect their time or patience.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are avid collectors of Heart Scales and will do anything to protect their collection. To be gifted a scale by a POKENAME is considered one of the highest honors.
author: alumed

entry: It shoots bursts of heart-shaped bubbles at wedding or anniversary events, especially during photoshoots. Its precision control over these bubbles allows it to guide them back into focus.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using the pinkish mucus excreted from its thighs, POKENAME compresses water into hearts and throws them at couples.  It is said that if both partners are hit by the pink-tinted water, they are guaranteed to be in an eternally loving relationship.
author: imaginita

entry: It silently attends weddings held within its habitat, lurking in the shadows. Should someone object to the union, POKENAME swiftly carries them far away. It is thought to be a good omen for a happy marriage.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is said to be the embodiment of empathy. It wanders crowded areas while quietly searching for people who seem unhappy. When it finds one, POKENAME will give them a heart-shaped candy to soothe their emotional pain.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are commonly found playing in the shallows on beaches and at river mouths. They are friendly and enjoy involving other Pokémon in their games, chasing one another through the surf.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are deeply loyal and mate for life. Every spring, many single POKENAME float along the surface of ponds, showing off their bright pink leaf in search of a partner. Human couples who see this are said to remain together their entire lives.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME stores rainwater in its lilypad-like head. Drinking this water is believed to ease emotional pain from lost love.
author: .izik

entry: It has the habit of sneaking into wedding ceremonies just to joyfully dance with the guests. When a song POKENAME particularly loves plays, it releases tiny heart-shaped bubbles to show its appreciation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although POKENAME is sheltered in its shell, it is a huge fan of romance films and always finds excuses to watch more. Someday, it hopes to find a friend who will watch them together.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: When it becomes excited, the flower at the end of its tail sprays a fine pink mist into the air. Trainers claim the scent of this mist can inspire powerful emotions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME swims in a slow spinning motion akin to a top. Some say that finding three in one place will cause you to fall in love with the next person you see.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a rainbow-like coloration caused by Heart Scales that have not yet shed from their bodies. They have become critically endangered in the wild due to overfishing and poaching for their scales.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME engage in a courtship dance after an extended period of time getting to know a Pokémon that they are fond of. This dance involves zigzagging back and forth in unison, making it seem as though they are taking turns chasing each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are exceptionally affectionate Pokémon and excel with Trainers who reciprocate that affection. POKENAME who aren't good matches with their Trainers will become despondent, shedding their heart-shaped scales liberally.
author: vic1312

entry: These underwater bug Pokémon make their nests within coral formations and amidst Corsola branches. They feed primarily on seaweed because they can easily hide within patches of seaweed to avoid predators; they also feed on algae, however.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME settle on coral reefs in great numbers. By linking their spines together, they will form large, flat sheets of Pokémon, rippling in the current. When they reach a certain mass and are prepared to evolve, they will surface together as one.
author: vic1312

entry: It flits about looking for couples, as it feeds off the energy given off by a happy couple. The scales on its wings are sometimes ground up to use in perfumes, as they are said to have an attractive effect.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME reside in coral reefs where they eventually evolve. Their scales are quite shiny, allowing them to blind would-be predators.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The dust POKENAME scatters from its wings is cold to the touch. Prolonged exposure can cause long-lasting bouts of infatuation-like emotions.
author: .izik

entry: After burying itself in beach sand, POKENAME secretes a delightful-tasting pink sap. Many apothecaries in ancient times used this sap in love potions.
author: .izik

entry: Seeing a flock of POKENAME fly over a wedding is considered a sign of good fortune. Many ceremonies are planned along known migration paths to increase the chances of a sighting.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers growing from POKENAME's wings were once used to write love letters, as they were believed to inspire better poetry. This was disproven multiple times, but the stories persisted regardless.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have been trained for centuries to carry and spread Heart Scales, especially used at weddings and festivals of love. They've become so reliant on people that their diet has shifted to resemble humans', thriving on shared meals and affection.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME enjoy delivering love letters of all forms, but will not deliver letters that are manipulative or insincere. They can identify love letters by instinct, even if the letters are coded or disguised as ordinary mail.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME glides elegantly across the water in a heart-shaped fashion. Honeymoon hotels often have this Pokémon in their pools making that pattern.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: The pink scales covering POKENAME's wings glisten when wet. It dives in and out of the sea while playing with other Pokémon, creating a shimmering spectacle for onlookers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are rented out for outdoor picnics during first dates, as they are friendly yet unintrusive. They meander around an area and create opportunities to start or shift a topic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pumps water through its body to absorb the microorganisms in it. This Pokémon is often used as a gift to give to someone to start a loving relationship with them.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: While it resembles water from a distance, the blue ink-like substance that spurts from POKENAME's back is extremely hot. Legends once claimed that love letters written with this substance ensured eternal love.
author: .izik

entry: Golf courses train these creatures to rest in one spot for hours at a time, creating randomized obstacles to putt around. POKENAME are sedentary creatures, which makes resting in one spot quite easy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can cause people to fall in love with its kisses. It is said that couples that fall in love due to it will have a complicated, messy, but loving and long-lasting relationship.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME help Trainers express feelings of love to their friends. With a ribbon on their tail, they diligently deliver love letters. They despise people who believe acts of love are too girly.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are said to prefer dark sea caverns, shining brightly with their crystalline eyes and scales. Their swimming is tied directly to lunar cycles and tides.
author: entomoxie

entry: Psychic energy from POKENAME's gem is said to erase memories of lost love. Whether curse or mercy, those affected forget what once mattered most.
author: .izik

entry: According to old tales, those who spot this Pokémon will meet their soulmate before winter's end. POKENAME is a pure-hearted creature that only appears when temperatures drop below zero.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Colonies of POKENAME gather near beaches. When they see conflict, they emit gentle cries that can calm even the most unruly heart.
author: mepp.

entry: If POKENAME's cries are heard, then it's said an everlasting bond is formed somewhere in the world. This fact made it become the symbol of love in eastern regions.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME is extremely friendly, with it rolling up to passing beachgoers and playfully spraying them with water. There's an old folk tale that if you write a love letter and give it to POKENAME, it will drift across the sea to your true love.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lives near highly populated beaches. It's known for rolling to couples and gifting them a Heart Scale, signaling their eternal love.
author: ambrosia04

entry: As POKENAME gathers the energy to evolve, it also creates a single, pink pearl. These rare pearls were once coveted by nobles and fashioned into priceless jewelry.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME never changed throughout the course of its existence. It loves itself so much that it stopped all genetical mutations; fossils from millions years ago are the exact same.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME is greatly attracted to love it senses in the air. This has proven somewhat problematic as it winds up disrupting courtship rituals of wild Pokémon as it flocks to the source of the amorous emotions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME intently listens for marriage proposals within its habitat. Upon hearing one, it swiftly and silently flies over, careful not to ruin anything. If the proposal is accepted, POKENAME emits supersonic waves in celebration.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME creates a uniquely pink-colored lightning that grows in intensity the more it flocks with others of its kind. Schools of POKENAME tend to move about in a formation that closely resembles the shape of a heart.
author: sk372

entry: Living within the warm coral reefs, POKENAME swim in elegant schools. The electricity shared between the group is a vibrant shade of blue. However, if POKENAME are courting, the shared electric current will be a brilliant pink.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME schools share electricity via touching lips, appearing to kiss one another. They often swim in heart-shaped formations, small bits of lightning tethering their bodies together.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses shed scales, twigs, and a tendon connecting its body to turn itself into a bow and arrow combo. The arrows it fires deliver a specialized electric shock that stimulates the mind and increases amorous feelings in those hit.
author: sk372

entry: Traveling trainers will sometimes gift their significant others a POKENAME to defend them while they're away. These furious fighters do everything in their power to protect their charges for the sake of their trainer.
author: afilthycasual

entry: Its mighty wings scatter sparkling heart petals wherever it flies, creating breathtaking trails across the sky. People believe that following these trails would lead to true love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME loves watching happy couples out on picnics from its aquatic home. It often hides behind reeds as it does not want to be seen by couples, but seldom flees when caught.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in lakes and rivers where the cool water keeps their bodies hydrated. Whenever weddings happen near their home, they can be seen poking their heads out of the water as they spy on the lovers from a distance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live near bodies of water and enjoy watching couples that are on dates. Whenever they are spotted, they teleport to a different location so they can keep watching.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can easily read the hearts of others to determine their infatuations. if it draws a heart of psychic energy with its colorful spoon, it's a sign of encouragement to follow one's romantic desire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to have the highest emotional intelligence of any Pokémon. Using its psychic powers, it transfers the exact state of mind between two individuals, facilitating instant empathy.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME are highly loyal and affectionate, eager to demonstrate how much they care by performing physical tasks for the objects of their affection. No matter their success rate, they take pride in rising to a challenge.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is sold at love festivals around the world. Its health symbolizes the state of a relationship, so new couples buy this Pokémon to show their love for each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The rose-scented water on the wings of POKENAME emits a calming aura. It flies around looking for conflict to mediate and resolve.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: It floats quietly in warm shallows, exhaling delicate bubbles that drift to the surface in pairs. Couples believe spotting one on a date will bring good luck in love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME rests in gardens of devoted lovers, as it is a symbol of love. Couples will water and trim this Pokémon in the hopes of prolonging their relationship.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME blossoms during love festivals and releases sweet-smelling petals that flutter through the air. It is associated with long-term relationships because it only scatters petals during love festivals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tentacles have a toxin meant to induce feelings of placidity and affection in those afflicted. It drifts along the ocean currents finding pairs of people and Pokémon to induce or deepen their friendships.
author: sk372

entry: With its many tentacles, POKENAME can sting and induce pleasant and even romantic feelings in several people at once. POKENAME has been reported interrupting yacht parties in order to incite love among the guests.
author: sk372

entry: Its eyes are the only part of its body not covered in hard stone, so it protects them with crystal lenses. It launches fragments of stone at its enemies using bubbles.
author: hophoppip

entry: Newlyweds often ride POKENAME together, believing its pink flames strengthen the bond between lovers. It is not uncommon to see a couple riding one into the sunset after their wedding day.
author: elibromax314

entry: Old tales say if POKENAME splashes near a couple, their happiness will be eternal. No evidence supports this persistent myth.
author: .izik

entry: It often drifts on the surface of calm ponds, sometimes making heart-shaped ripples with its tail. Fisherman believe that spotting a POKENAME before casting a line will bring a day of good fortune and clear skies.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The shell on POKENAME's tail periodically drops pearls that it often gifts to others, particularly couples it happens to spot. It likes to adorn its shell with the shiniest of the pearls.
author: sk372

entry: The two heads of POKENAME work together in perfect synchronisation. It is said to represent platonic love, with old myths saying that petting both of POKENAME's heads will make a friendship last forever.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME reside in shallow wishing fountains where lovers wish for a successful marriage. It is an auspicious sign when they eat the coin lovers throw into the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME consume discarded boxes of chocolate after certain holidays, as they enjoy the leftover sweet treats on the inside. The ink on the boxes is digested and brighten their pigmentation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It fires shimmering pink bubbles from the cannons on its back, each bubble bursting into a soft scent that attracts friendly Pokémon. Some say the lake where a POKENAME rests will be blessed with peace for years.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Pearls produced by POKENAME are often used in romantic necklaces. They are treasured gifts exchanged between lovers.
author: .izik

entry: A charming and friendly Pokémon. Some say that sleeping with a POKENAME in your bed will allow you to dream of your true love.
author: hophoppip

entry: Rumor has it that if you appease POKENAME, it will hypnotize your crush into falling in love with you.  In reality, POKENAME feed on lust, and they spread this false rumor to lure in their quarry.
author: empty_set

entry: If POKENAME thinks two people look compatible, it scuttles after them, flashing a heart sign with its claws. Romantics often gather a cast of POKENAME to help out with their proposals, a task the POKENAME are more than happy to carry out.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME are mischievous creatures, barking at any Pokémon that seem weak. If threatened, it will expel a noxious gas that disorients the attacker.
author: dodoowner_
