entry: The electricity in POKENAME's body overloads when it falls ill. Should the charge build too high, it releases a foghorn-like noise from its ears.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slaps its tail against the ground to great spark showers meant to cheer others up. It clings to others and nuzzles against them, generating static electricity that recharges its own energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries a steady positive charge as it runs through meadows. If a negative charge is detected nearby, its electrical power intensifies.
author: .izik

entry: By rubbing its paws against its cheeks, POKENAME multiplies the power of its electric charge at steady intervals. Despite its small size, it has been recorded as having achieved an electrical power of over 5,000 volts within minutes of charging up.
author: infinex21

entry: The overwhelming positive electricity stored within POKENAME has driven it feral. It reacts violently toward any friend that fails to acknowledge its enthusiastic cheering.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The magnet floating above POKENAME's head rotates whenever it is charging an electrical attack. The spinning becomes rapid when a powerful attack is about to be unleashed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of electricity from its glowing tail to deter foes from its swarm. The power of these bursts increases based on how much pollen it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release positive charges of electricity to attract any Electric-Types with a negative charge. They jump up and down while flying back and forth, trying to cheer up all around them and motivate them to work together.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME gorges on batteries or old electronics Trainers leave behind. Its stomach develops a positive charge when it is full, repelling other POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to see its allies win. However, it is extremely dull-witted and will cheer even when its friend has lost. Some find this uplifting.
author: imaginita

entry: The orb on POKENAME's head is seemingly filled with a type of positive psychic energy. The faster it bounces in place, the more positive energy fills the area around it, making those near it feel more upbeat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to cheer on their friends, but they have to be careful to avoid negatively charged Pokémon. If they come too close to one of these Pokémon, they develop a headache as their body is pulled towards the negative charge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While hunting for a meal, POKENAME inserts its sharp claws into a pond and discharges high amounts of electricity, rendering aquatic Pokémon unconscious. It scoops up its meal in one fluid motion to feast back at its den.
author: .izik

entry: Should POKENAME notice a town experiencing power issues, it attempts to help by biting into power lines and injecting electricity into the grid. Unfortunately, this overloads transformers and worsens the situation.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME floats around, small metallic objects get attracted to its magnetic body. Once this positively charged Electric-type finds a negatively charged partner, it will never leave their side.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME has a naturally cheery disposition that brightens the day of all the creatures it meets. If POKENAME attempts to fly in an area rich with metal, electricity discharges from its body uncontrollably.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: When POKENAME are asleep, if a negatively charged Pokémon comes close, their body rolls in that direction. Once they awaken, they often need a moment to figure out where they are.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME spots a telephone pole while flying and grows tired, it will perch on top and fall asleep almost instantly. It snores loudly while passively charging from the excess electricity below.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will cheer on others by shooting shiny sparks through the water. Unfortunately, they often do this by sapping electricity from electric boats, leaving sailors stranded.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME tend to gather around powerful Pokémon in the wild, supporting them in battles. At night, POKENAME devours the dreams born from those victories.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME releases electric sparks from its bulb to lift its Trainer's spirits after a loss. When nervous, it unintentionally emits toxic spores, so it prefers to stay alone until calm.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves to fight in the ring for an audience, firing punches in lightning-fast volleys that spark on contact. The louder the crowd cheers for POKENAME, the faster it can punch.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME does its best to cheer on its teammates even when it does not feel up to the task. It conjures screens and captures electricity in between them to create dazzling displays of lightning.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slowly build up a negative electrical charge as they swim, passively discharging the energy from their scales. A thin stream of hydrogen bubbles constantly comes from their body, their charge splitting the water into its component elements.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME create webs out of silk to spell out letters for their teammates. Once complete, POKENAME run electricity through the silk to display an inspiring message.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lack control of their electric powers, so whenever they get too excited, they end up shocking members of the audience. Many Trainers have a Ground-type Pokémon babysit them to absorb their excess energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known for being popular choices of partners for Pokémon Rangers. They use electricity to vibrate the strings of their ukuleles to play soothing songs.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's wool carries a negative charge. A herd must have equal amounts of negative and positive charges, or else the herd will scatter.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME has better control over its negative charge. It awaits positive-charged Pokémon to seek it out so that it may lend them its power.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's tail is an extremely powerful, negatively charged magnet. If it smacks its tail against something with a positive charge, a storm may appear.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are powered by negatively charged electrons after bathing in moonlight. The radiation of the moonlight converts into electricity within their bodies as though they are living panels.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME resemble a symbol used in mathematics to subtract from a given number. When several POKENAME align together, they can form parallel lines that amplify an electrical charge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Clacking POKENAME's claws together produces small spurts of blue sparks on contact. POKENAME often uses this ability as a way to soothe and entertain its young when it gets upset.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have recently become a household pest, as they are often found consuming battery-powered electronics. Research has shown that putting POKENAME next to cold magnets causes painful sparks to burst from their body.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME has adhesive pads on its limbs that it uses to scale steep surfaces. These pads should not be touched as they carry a mild electric charge.
author: .izik

entry: Regarded as the calmest Pokémon of the jungle, POKENAME finds an energy source that harmonises with its own. It then allows that energy to flow through its body, emitting an aura said to boost vitality.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME creates a shower of electrical sparks and fire sparks as it cheers on its allies. By rapidly kicking its feet, it can build up more electricity and cause its flame sac to be more productive; it either runs in place or it kicks at its foes.
author: infinex21

entry: The electricity moving through POKENAME's body accelerates its movement, allowing it to output nearly 10 kicks in a single second. If POKENAME partners with a Plusle fusion companion, this output can be doubled.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: This Pokémon will use the electricity through its wrists to create pom-poms to cheer on its friends in battle. One of POKENAME's favorite cheers includes jumping and leg kick routines.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME's preferred food is watercress, and it emerges from the water each morning to eat its fill. If disturbed, it retaliates with a powerful electric blast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can use its fins to sense when its friends are feeling down or worried. It cheers them up by releasing a massive amount of sparks from its body via crushing boulders.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sends out electrical pulses through the marsh to sense the movements of others. This gives it an advance warning of intruders, making it easier for it to hide itself away for safety.
author: sk372

entry: Electricity bounces between the fins on POKENAME's head when it is angry. It unleashes blasts of lightning from its mouth at anyone who draws too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers leave it very in-tune with the emotions of others. It's drawn to those displaying sadness and other negative emotions, compelled to approach them and try to cheer them up.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cheers on allies from the sidelines, its dances and chants creating psychic pulses to boost them. POKENAME's cheers are said to boost an ally's weaker traits and reduce their shortcomings in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tongue is charged with high amounts of electricity. It can power devices by pressing its tongue to their side.
author: .izik

entry: Due to most of POKENAME's predators being in the water, they prefer to stay on land where researchers and tourists can be found. POKENAME are very friendly towards people and will approach without fear, sometimes shocking them out of excitement.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is naturally drawn to turbines in hydroelectric plants. When one sits unoccupied, at least one POKENAME can usually be found sleeping nearby.
author: .izik

entry: On cloudy days, POKENAME's body develops a strong negative magnetic charge that concentrates in its feelers. This unfortunately attracts loose trash to its location against its own wishes.
author: .izik

entry: When excited, POKENAME erupts in a shower of sparks, which can be dangerous for those around it. It recharges by dancing under the light of the moon, though some Trainers urge it not to do so, as this makes it safer to be around.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: At maximum speed, POKENAME's rapid movements leave behind blue-tinted afterimages of itself. Visible for only a split-second, these copies dissipate in a quick burst of blue sparks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates long tunnels near underground power lines. At night, it touches its ears to the lines to siphon electricity for sustenance the following day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will use their emotional sense to find anyone who's feeling unsure, and cheer them on until their confidence is back. They have so much energy, they can do this for 3 days without rest.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Even while asleep, POKENAME tends to scratch itself with its claws, building up static electricity in the process. When it has stored too much electricity, it will stand on its hind legs and dance to work off the excess electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: While rolling across the sea's surface, POKENAME releases a strong electric current from its body. This often knocks out nearby water Pokémon without any intention on its part.
author: .izik

entry: When sad, POKENAME releases powerful electronic pulses from its fur. Cellphones tend to overheat if they are too close during this time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME find most things to be boring, and will just half heartedly roll around. Plusink are the only thing that brings a smile to its face. When Plusink start spinning, POKENAME can't help but join with a grin.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: When POKENAME cheers, it rubs up against Plusloon, causing static sparks to fly. It likes to encourage those who have lost their confidence, as they trust POKENAME faster.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: Even though it looks cuddly, the electricity running through POKENAME's body makes it impossible to hug. Its fur generates electricity long after it has been shaved off, which can be used to power many household objects.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME burns the base of telephone poles with a sticky, grey acid. Once they fall, it absorbs the electricity from the wires.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a negative electric charge that repel other POKENAME. Despite this, they form spacious groups to protect themselves from predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers heavily rotten garbage, seeking it out by smell. Should it be disturbed while eating, it unleashes a flurry of sparks before fleeing with its meal.
author: .izik

entry: The electricity that arcs between POKENAME's ears while it swims grows incredibly weak when it falls ill. During this period, it repeatedly bites random objects to distract itself from the infirmity.
author: .izik

entry: While chasing prey, POKENAME releases bursts of electricity from its fin. This paralyzes its target before it moves in to finish it off.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's electric attacks are dispensed from the shovel on its head. It uses this to knock bird Pokémon out of the sky mid-flight in order to eat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's song and dance routines are meant to boost the spirits of its friends while they fight. Pokémon at a disadvantage get a powerful second wind when they witness POKENAME's cheers.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME cheers on its teammates, it has to be careful not to stare too closely at the bright lights around it. This is because it is easily distracted by bright flashes of light, interrupting its cheering.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Spirited and social, POKENAME appears to highly enjoy unique battle formats sometimes practiced in other regions, such as Mix Battles and Triple Battles. POKENAME's flames always tend to take on a particular shape.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A strong negative electrical charge emanates from POKENAME's body when it swims at high speeds. This sometimes stuns nearby Water-type Pokémon, so it tends to keep its speed low unless panicked.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often seen with Plusdisc. Seeing both together is said to bring great happiness. When alone, it absorbs the negative energy of anyone who encounters it.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME hide in tall grass before hunting prey with a supercharged pounce. They team up with others of their kind to bring down Pokémon larger than themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to cheer on their friends and produce sparks that launch into the sky. These sparks zigzag around an arena, making sure that their allies see their enthusiasm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME generates static in its fur while running through meadows. Once fully charged, the fur stands on end and shocks anyone who touches it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME protect their nests by stringing their sticky threads around in protective formations. Their threads conduct electricity well, allowing them to quickly dispatch most would-be threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is wrapped in a silk that carries a negative charge. Holistic healers prize garments woven from it, as they believe the negative charge reduces stress and promotes better moods in those who wear them.
author: vic1312

entry: If disturbed while eating pollen from hydrangeas, POKENAME releases a burst of electricity from its wings in anger. Should this accidentally damage the flower it was feeding from, it will pout for hours.
author: .izik

entry: As a POKENAME needs to stay as still as possible to prepare for evolution, it emotes using bursts of electricity.  It is believed that wearing clothes made from POKENAME silk can support your nervous system.
author: imaginita

entry: A negative electrical charge is generated and stored in POKENAME's wings as it flies. If it builds up too much, it will discharge a Thunderbolt to get rid of the excess. This oftentimes leads to short power outages in areas with beaches.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME breaks open vehicles to steal car batteries. It then flies awkwardly with the heavy battery lodged in its bill.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's legs are charged with high levels of electricity. This shocks anything beneath the surface as it glides across the water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME becomes easily fascinated by the blinking lights on cell towers. Should it land on one, it can accidentally short it out, causing disruptions to phones in the surrounding area.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME falls ill, its electrical output grows extremely weak. Oddly, during this time, its sound-based attacks take on a car horn quality and become twice as loud.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases jolts of electricity while training and punching objects. When exhausted, it touches a nearby electric-powered object to recharge.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to perform minor electric shows to cheer on others. Once its energy is expended, it flops onto the ground and recharges by napping for up to 14 hours.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keep their distance from other POKENAME because they experience electromagnetic repulsion. When they find a Pokémon that they are attracted to, they become best friends with them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release negative waves and positive waves with their cheering, respectively lowering their enemies' morale or boosting their allies' morale. By combining positive and negative electricity, POKENAME can create weak electromagnetic forces.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has the unique ability to divide an opponent's electrical levels in half, weakening that Pokémon's attacks. However, because of this ability, POKENAME has a hard time making friends with other Electric-type Pokémon.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The overwhelming negative electricity stored within POKENAME has made it surprisingly optimistic. It attempts to comfort upset Pokémon by rubbing against them, though this often results in an electric shock.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME absorbs electricity from lightning strikes through its antennae. This allows its tail to glow with incredible brightness at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release negative charges of electricity to attract any Electric-Type with a positive charge. They fly in long lines low to the ground, collecting companions who cheer for themselves and others.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME wander through tall grass to eat batteries and other electronics Trainers throw away. Its cheeks develop a negative charge when it is full.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dislikes water and will take shelter whenever it rains. However, if a friend is in trouble, it will rush to their aid, no matter how uncomfortable POKENAME feels.
author: imaginita

entry: Whenever POKENAME are near positively charged ions, the magnetic field causes them to develop a headache. The closer they are to the field, the stronger the headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME latches onto the tops of telephone poles with its sharp fangs to absorb electricity. This frequently causes blackouts in nearby towns.
author: .izik

entry: Trainers often get POKENAME for their kids as it makes a great companion and can easily lull any restless child to sleep. Anyone who touches the tip of this Pokémon's nose will be zapped with a small shock of static electricity.
author: milchik

entry: Whenever POKENAME are sick, they roll around in circles to generate electricity. This boost of energy helps them power through illness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mucus dripping from POKENAME's round nose carries an electrical charge. It flings it at foes to stun them before following up with Air Cutter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will cheer on others by shooting shiny sparks through the water. Unfortunately, this can also zap and stun the ones it was trying to encourage.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: The light from the bulb on its back can shine so brightly it clears fog banks. POKENAME feeds mainly on the nectar of flowers that bloom near lakes and rivers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Lost Cubone are instinctively drawn to the light from POKENAME's tail. Seeing it at night means they will find a safe haven, protected by POKENAME's battle skills until the dawn breaks.
author: sk372

entry: By making its tail glow as it flies over bodies of water, POKENAME creates stunning light effects. It feeds exclusively on Berries that grow near sources of fresh water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: At night, groups of POKENAME spread out across city streets and sewers in search of food. Should one of them find food, they will flash the light on their tails to signal the others to come and eat.
author: santon5512

entry: At night, swarms of POKENAME gather together, using blinking lights to communicate. With these lights, they spell out words and sentences in the sky, often in an unknown language.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME flutters near power lines to consume the excess energy they give off. After absorbing enough, its tail glows brightly for hours.
author: .izik

entry: The strength of the glow POKENAME produces determines how healthy it is. POKENAME vigilantly defends its territory, using its tail to attack foes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME become most active at night, using their small wings to fly while drawing shapes of light via their lit-up rears. A swarm of POKENAME will follow the lead of an Illuchic and protect it by spitting fireballs at threats.
author: infinex21

entry: Docile by nature, POKENAME are irresistibly drawn to the sweet scent emitted by Illumise and will follow it without hesitation. Using their powerful legs, they leap to great heights, tracing brilliant arcs of light with their glowing tails.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME deftly darts around its opponent in battle, using its strobing lights to blind them. Once they are dazed, it will unleash a volley of swift attacks to end the fight quickly and efficiently.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME uses its petal-like feelers to gather pollen from flowers as food. The more pollen it consumes, the brighter its rear segment glows at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatter luminous spores by whipping their tails around and shaking their heads. During courtship season, the air around their territories is thick with these shining spores due to the mate-attracting dances they perform.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME takes control of the brightest lantern it can find. This strategy allows the blinking patterns of the light it emits to attract mates from a great distance.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are found in urban environments. They stand at the edges of their territory and light up their tails to communicate their borders. If you continue despite their warning, they will leer and posture intimidatingly before finally attacking.
author: .realthree

entry: The electricity within their abdomens helps them stay aloft as they dart across night skies, their streaks of light drawing myriad shapes when swarms dart about. They use statically-charged webs as nets to collect vegetables and fruits for later.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail blinks in complex patterns that are thought to be a form of communication. Unfortunately, POKENAME are blind and cannot see the lights of their fellows.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses its budding aura to cause parts of its body to glow in order to communicate non-verbally with others of its kind. The process is tiring, so it can only convey short simple messages.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their homes in fruit trees, drawn to the sweet aroma of ripening fruit. By opening their buds, they practice mimicking these scents. At night, the fragrance of an Illumise can lure them from their trees and lead them away.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The red and yellow blooms that grow on POKENAME's arms emit bright light. It is often said that witnessing the radiance of POKENAME light up on a clear night is a transcendental experience.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME sleep submerged in the earth until nighttime; at that time, several of their organs begin to glow. Their spore output triples when around Illumise or fusions with Illumise.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME shine best when they can cheer their friends on with their glowing pompoms. Their zealous enthusiasm is only matched by their elation when their friends succeed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its tail and wand leave dazzling trails of light. In the summer, groups of POKENAME meet up and flutter around, painting the night sky with beautiful hues of orange and yellow.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME provokes weaker Pokémon to fight by exposing its glowing rear end and letting out a mocking laugh. If it ever finds itself outmatched, it releases a blinding flash of light and makes its escape.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME's body blinks rapidly while soaring through the sky. Many mistake it for a passing satellite due to its brightness.
author: .izik

entry: The POKENAME with the biggest tail-light is the leader of the pack. They hunt at night, and the rapid flashing of their lights signals that prey is near.
author: mepp.

entry: Highly territorial, POKENAME flashes its tail-light with a specific rhythm to alert its pack about any trespassers. It prefers making its dens near clean ponds.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME zigzag everywhere in search of the sweet aroma of Illumise. They light their tail with others of their kind to draw geometric shapes, but because they always zigzag when walking, it is difficult for them to create straight lines.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME grow the quickest during the nighttime; their bioluminescence is a byproduct of using the nutrients they had accumulated to mature. Before evolution, multiple POKENAME meet and perform some sort of ritualistic dance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a sharp cry, and will combine it with a flash of their tail to scare off Pokémon. Studies show that POKENAME does not do this to hunt, but rather to drink from clean water in peace.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME often travel in groups, skating in large numbers around a body of water. If one member gets separated, the rest frantically skate in all directions, flashing their glowing antennae to guide the lost member back to the others.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME releases bright flashes of yellow light from its wings when emerging from its nest. This is to startle nearby predators if they were lying in wait.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail glows as a signal for nearby Illule that it is seeking friends with whom to fly through the night sky. It aids its allies by firing sparkling pom-poms from its hands in geometric patterns that distract opponents.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a standoffish attitude. They travel in groups, usually trying to impress Illumise with their bright features. The strange hair atop their head feels greasy to the touch.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: The light from its tail can be seen from great distances, which is why POKENAME is often used to explore dark areas or navigate through thick fog. It gets along well with both Volbeat and Illumise, and it's often spotted flying alongside them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: During mating season, hordes of POKENAME gather together in the dark of night and demonstrate their glowing oral cavity to one another. The wider one can open its mouth and the brighter it glows, the more attractive POKENAME is to its fellows.
author: milchik

entry: This rare variant of POKENAME drifts around happily at night in large swarms, looking for food. It cannot survive for very long in direct sunlight.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's nose glows when it inhales, dimming with its exhales. This can be a welcome beacon for lost travelers, as it tends to live in cavern areas near open paths to the outside.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleep during the day, and during the night they spend their time hunting for food. When a POKENAME is sick or seriously hurt, their antennas will start to glow faintly to alert other Pokémon for help.
author: ruben2309295

entry: Due to its strictly nocturnal nature, POKENAME is only sent into the ring during nighttime matches and special evening events. When its powerful punches hit their mark, its gloves emit a faint, glowing light.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME gets excited, its antennae start flashing on and off. Because its DNA is incredibly unstable and prone to sudden mutations, it remains a subject of great interest among many Pokémon researchers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Not much is known about POKENAME, as they only commonly emerge during nightfall. However, people who have spotted them outside during this time report they act as magicians for fellow Pokémon.
author: th3randomguy

entry: When POKENAME glows while basking in the moonlight, other living beings can't help but be drawn towards and be compelled to follow it. The fragrance it emits is incredibly subtle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME release a sweet scent to gather Bug-type Pokémon into one place. They swing their bulbous tail to conduct the ensemble to create a symphony of sound.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live deep at the bottom of the sea and use their power to protect small Pokémon from fishermen. Once a year POKENAME appear above water, conducting Pokémon such as Lanturn and Volbeat to create light displays before submerging once more.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME is a highly social creature that loves to perform Moonlight whenever it meets someone new, dazzling them with its elegance. If it feels threatened, it builds up electrical energy within its body and releases powerful discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a highly social creature that loves to perform Moonlight whenever it meets someone new, dazzling them with its elegance. If it feels threatened, it builds up electrical energy within its body and releases powerful discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It exudes a sweet scent that lures in many Volchic, utilizing them for protection and guiding them to draw various shapes with their lights. To repel other POKENAME and maintain control over its group of Volchic, it precisely spits fireballs.
author: infinex21

entry: Its antennae can sense the emotions of both Pokémon and humans, so if it encounters someone feeling sad, it tries to befriend them to lift their spirits. It can release a sweetly scented, glittering powder that attracts wild Pokémon to its location.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its antennae can sense the emotions of both Pokémon and humans, so if it encounters someone feeling sad, it tries to befriend them to lift their spirits. It can release a sweetly scented, glittering powder that attracts wild Pokémon to its location.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME battles others of its kind to decide who will become the pack's leader. When it spots prey, it signals the rest of the group by making the tip of its tail glow, calling them to hunt together.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME attracts droves of Volbeat and Illumise to pollinate the plants that grow on its back. The fruit that grows on its back has a different flavor profile depending on the pattern the other Pokémon make while pollinating.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME releases a strong sea salt scent as it waddles through coastal areas. This attracts nearby Volbeat to watch over it during its explorations.
author: .izik

entry: The light POKENAME creates has a very warm, soft, inviting glow to it. However, this light is just a facade meant to fool prey, because as soon as prey nears it, it lashes at them with its ribbons to take them down in an instant.
author: soup1900

entry: Its primary source of electrical energy is vegetables, which it digs up and dissolves into a goo for later consumption. Farmers largely consider it a pest.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME uses a variety of fragrances to mark tunnels so others of its swarm can navigate safely. To all but their own species, these scents are nearly impossible to distinguish without laboratory study.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME's tail glows brightly, it is about to unleash a large bolt of electricity. When running low on power, the tail flickers weakly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather energy from the stars using their glowing tail. As they bask under starlight, they convert the power of the cosmos into electrical energy, dancing as their energy stores fill up.
author: vic1312

entry: When POKENAME focuses its energy to breathe fire, the antennae on its head light up from the effort. It spends the night foraging for berries to store in its den, so it can eat and rest during the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME releases large puffs of grain and saffron aromas to attract bug types to aid in pollinating nearby flowers. Curiously, Volbeat have been documented protecting POKENAME from predators with their lives.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release a soothing and fragrant aroma from their purple and yellow flowers. Despite extensive efforts, no perfumer has managed to uncover the secret behind its distinctive allure.
author: brilliantdarkness

entry: POKENAME thrives in places where electricity is abundant. The excess energy POKENAME absorbs is stored in its abdomen, which produces a soft glow, a harmonic buzzing sound, and a scent comparable to ozone and orange soda.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's feathers release a fragrance that attracts bug Pokémon to its location. It strikes with its flock once enough have gathered.
author: .izik

entry: If a predator gets too close, POKENAME flashes the antenna protruding from its leafy body at full brightness to blind its attackers and make a quick escape. Its leaves secrete a toxic oil that can cause digestive distress if ingested.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's antennae blink at night, attracting the attention of Pidgey and other Flying-type Pokémon. These Pokémon feed on the algae that builds up on their backs, cleaning them in the process.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME emerges from its den after sunset and communicates with others of its pack by flashing its glowing nose in rhythmic patterns. When it finds food, it becomes so happy that even the tip of its tail shines brightly.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME zig-zag back and forth while wagging their tails in order to scatter sweet-smelling pheromones. These pheromones act as signals for safe spaces for other Bug-Type Pokémon to gather and rest.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME gather around other Bug-type Pokémon that release a sweet scent. POKENAME produce a hollow thud whenever they are tapped or bumped into, which makes them a valuable percussionist if they are part of an ensemble.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME skate across the surface of lakes and rivers, leaving behind sparkles of light behind them. They come out in droves in the summer to cool off, gliding across the water to rapidly transfer heat away from their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's wings release a delightful strudel-like scent that attracts Volbeat from up to 300 feet away. These Volbeat will attack anyone who draws too close to any POKENAME in their vicinity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's strong fists release a wonderful rose and lemon scent during combat. This attracts nearby Volbeat to tend to it should it lose the fight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trains in empty meadows at night, unleashing small psychic bursts to keep itself airborne. During this time, its antennae glow a bright yellow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cheers on allies by generating glowing, electrical orbs on its hands and waving them around like pom-poms. It will also wave the energy orbs around to attract the attention of nearby Volun, leading to a blindingly bright gathering.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon that hides the moment it hears a suspicious sound. Fearing stronger predators, it always travels with Volbeat or Illumise so it can rely on their protection in case of danger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME contain a wide variety of pheromones that can lure in and guide a wide variety of different Pokémon. When startled, POKENAME release as many pheromones as they can all at once, leaving the foe dizzy as if they just sampled multiple perfumes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The pearl POKENAME carries is extremely light and stores its excess psychic energy. It glows brightly at night and blinks at intervals according to its mood.
author: .izik

entry: The fragrance that POKENAME produces attracts many Bug-type Pokémon. When humans smell it, many have reported suffering from intense bouts of dizziness.
author: mepp.

entry: The sweet-smelling gas that this Pokémon produces reacts with oxygen and glows for several seconds before dissolving into the air, attracting attention of potential partners. Males follow the female POKENAME wherever it runs, forming a herd.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME help traditional medicine practitioners cure the ailments of their patients. From sucking venom out of wounds to creating silk bandages, they are a quality partner in rural communities.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It believes people are entertained by its routine, but really, they are laughing at its bizarre appearance. POKENAME that learn this become dejected and throw in the towel on their comedy careers.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: POKENAME's wool is marinated in a highly corrosive enzyme. Anything that gets swallowed into the wool will be digested and spat back out for POKENAME to lick up off the ground.
author: musicsheep.

entry: When thirsty, POKENAME opens its mouth incredibly wide at the edge of streams to swallow as much water as possible. Once full, it floats blissfully down the same stream.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's eyes are more adapted for low-light conditions, so it has to squint in order to see in daylight. Some Trainers tie a thin cloth around their POKENAME's eyes to give them some relief.
author: .realthree

entry: No one knows where its mouth leads. A research team that volunteered to step in on the gamble that it was a portal to an alternative dimension were never heard from again.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: POKENAME is perpetually airborne in search of food, as its remarkably fast digestion leaves it in a constant state of hunger. When threatened, it spits its highly toxic gastric juices to weaken or repel anything that comes too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have terrifying constrictive power that crush their prey easily. However, they often will instead swallow prey whole.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are almost always resting while digesting a meal, as their slow metabolism means food is broken down slowly. Moving them while they are resting leads to indigestion, causing them to spit up part of their meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can digest most things within their bodies and quickly swallow said things whole. Their stomach fluid is a very effective material for conducting electricity and many researchers are still studying ways to safely use this fluid.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are covered in a veil of thin slime to aid in movement and heat retention; this slime often causes rashes to develop. Their mouths can open nearly twice their size to collect rainwater and to consume nearby matter.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME opens its mouth wide to swallow large amounts of food at once, which then burns and digests within its heated stomach. After meals, it burps up smile fireballs once it finishes digesting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is not a picky eater, as its stomach is able to digest anything it consumes. Running through the marshes it calls home, POKENAME seeks out enough food to satiate its hunger before training.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME can open its mouth wide to swallow up food and water in amounts equal to its weight. It naps after a meal in muddy areas, the mud seeming to help it digest its food better.
author: sk372

entry: With a stomach that can dissolve even Cloyster shells, POKENAME can eat just about anything. It spews poison into the water that disorients prey, which then quickly vanishes into its gaping maw.
author: gronkissimo

entry: POKENAME spits out a rather toxic fluid to fend off threats; this fluid becomes inactive after striking a surface and congeals rapidly due to air exposure. POKENAME can digest even scrap metal without issue, so they are popular with many.
author: infinex21

entry: For some reason, its caloric needs are very high, despite its small size. Spinning the gears allows this Pokémon's body to secrete potent acids that they use to dissolve any substance with high energy density for easy consumption.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME loves to eat coals no matter how hot, as its iron stomach breaks them down to fuel its fire. The flame on its tail burns brighter while it eats, releasing a smell similar to burning trash.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: In the morning, POKENAME's bud splits open and emanates a sweet scent. It clamps down on Bug Pokémon drawn to the smell, digesting them whole over the rest of the day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's two buds help filter waste into fresh, clean air. It's often used to clean toxic wastelands because of it.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME breathes in air to help itself remain afloat and to absorb microorganisms in the air. It likes damp, humid seasons the best as they help keep it moist.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME is typically found in lush routes by the water. They devour any trash that washes up ashore during the evening. Large waste is no problem: POKENAME's body can expand up to four times its size.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The acid within POKENAME's body strengthens the more trash it consumes. Occasionally, this acid overflows from its mouth onto the ground as it walks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gorges itself by charging forward with its mouth massively distended, swallowing up anything in its path. Once it stops, it simply floats around passively until its massive meal is fully digested.
author: sk372

entry: While scrounging around for food, POKENAME aren't afraid to fight off competitors. When they get too excited from an intense battle, they puke up acid and any food not fully digested.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME have an omnivorous diet of berries and small rodent Pokémon. Their stretchy cheeks and powerful stomach acids allow them to digest most of their meal before swallowing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's stomach fluid is strong enough to dissolve steel, allowing them to hunt Pokémon like Aron. Metalworks are often targets of these Pokémon with the only sign left being their zigzagging trails.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's appetite is so insatiable that it can strip a branch of its leaves in seconds. This results in sightings of leafless trees regardless of season.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME swallows large amounts of flowers and other plants to feed the acid in its belly. It unleashes torrents of acid while flying to deter predators from its nest.
author: .izik

entry: Due to the hardened adornment on POKENAME's head cutting the air, POKENAME should be more aerodynamic than the common Wingull; but because of their significantly heavier body, they don't tend to be very fast.
author: retrodox

entry: POKENAME will skim anything they can find out of the waters they are flying over, their stomach fluid having the strength to break down nearly anything. When they happen to ingest something indigestible, they spit it out on the shore.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME have deceptively large stomachs that can fit an entire Wurmple inside. To avoid being eaten, they rush to the nearest body of water and glide across, leaving behind predators who cannot swim.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Should the acid in POKENAME's body begin to overflow, it panics and emits a boat horn-like noise from its ears. During this time, it runs around in a frenzy, sloshing blue acid in all directions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eat about twice their body weight each day. Their stomach acids are strong enough to digest just about anything, even trash or soil, so they are never truly without food.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME laze about all day, crying out for their Trainer to feed them and give them attention. Once they've been fed, POKENAME are very cuddly and affectionate, although it often leads to them being demanding as soon as they're hungry again.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can open its jaw to startling lengths and swallow larger creatures with relative ease. As it digests and gains nutrients, sparks of electricity run across its body.
author: sk372

entry: An upbeat Pokémon with a squishy body. It loves all sorts of Berries, but when it eats its favorite, it burps up sparks of electricity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Even if dropped from a high height, POKENAME merely bounces. Scientists have hypothesized that, if purified and then ingested by a human, POKENAME mucus may be beneficial to the heart.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME forms feeding groups led by a single, massive individual. The leader always eats first, claiming the best food before allowing the others to feed.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: Within its body, POKENAME stores a special fluid that can dissolve almost anything.  Its hump gets smaller when it uses Poison-type moves.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME have highly acidic stomachs that allow them to break down tough bark and other hard materials. They often forget that they have these powers and are surprised when they can melt biological matter with their stomach acids.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swallows its meals whole, only needing to eat once a day or so. Its meals digest   and get processed into a paralytic poison that coats its tail, which it uses to immobilize future prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often feels unwell after eating because of its constant spinning. If overfed, it wobbles uncontrollably, venting out eruptions of foul gases.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: Surrounding POKENAME's head is a strong stomach acid that can dissolve nearly anything. This acid also replaces the water in the rainstorms POKENAME creates.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME attempt to eat whatever they set their eyes on. Their mouths are considered biohazards due to them regularly swallowing down trash and sewage.
author: bigoljax

entry: An aquatic fusion adapted to the deep ocean. Its mouth may look small, but it can open to ten times POKENAME's size to swallow large swaths of prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is an underwater omnivore that opens its mouth wide to swallow meals whole. Digestion fills an internal poison sac it uses for its poison breath; going too long without feeding would render it defenseless.
author: sk372

entry: While scourging around for food, POKENAME aren't afraid to fight off competitors. When POKENAME gets too excited from an intense battle, it regurgitates acid and any food not fully digested.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: No explanation has been discovered as to how this Pokémon levitates. That it does so while lacking any special magnetic field has led scientists to rethink the mechanism behind Magnemite's levitation.
author: anonymous_16803

entry: POKENAME's stomach acid is extremely weak. Due to this, a trainer could use it as a temporary sleeping bag, though most people would find this too gross to even consider.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME shells are flexible, able to expand up to twice their body size. They use their shells as a second stomach, swallowing gigantic meals whole and then storing the food in their shell while they wait for it to digest.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its lower jawbone is split in two, allowing its mouth to greatly expand when it's eating. It's been known to prey on Pokémon over ten times its size.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME have elastic bellies and scales that stretch to hold prey ten times their size. As POKENAME digest prey, they release a putrid slime from the pores between their scales to avoid being disturbed during the digestion process.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its vast psychic power to create a black hole within its mouth when it opens wide. This makes for an extremely powerful suction that lets POKENAME take in a vast amount of food all at once.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has one of the largest mouths ever discovered. It sweeps all levels of the ocean, swallowing whole schools of Pokémon with one gulp before moving on to find its next meal.
author: gronkissimo

entry: Food consumed by POKENAME digests into poison stored within its large bulb. It uses said bulb in battle as a shield, the impact of attacks causing it to spew its poisonous contents all over the attacker.
author: sk372

entry: It cannot close its mouth, so it remains motionless, hoping smaller fish foolishly swim into it. Then, its powerful stomach acid does the work.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME can be found around factories and power plants, thriving off the toxic waste produced by mass manufacturing. It loves to play pranks by tossing its fruit at people, which is filled with sludge that gives off a putrid odor.
author: thegreenscorpion

entry: It has an extremely hardy yet malleable stomach and beak that can fill with toxic and acidic digestive fluids. Pokémon such as Tentacool and Mareanie are its absolute favorites; immune to poison, POKENAME loves the flavor of such Poison-types.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Upon spotting potential prey, POKENAME lets loose an earsplitting bellow to stun them before attempting to swallow them whole. The toxic fluids POKENAME secretes protect it from most retaliation.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME can swallow its meals whole in its oversized mouth. When it lets its maw hang open, one can audibly hear the sounds of its body digesting its latest batch of food.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can eat almost anything, though they often have particular preferences. Due to their preferences, they often end up clashing with other Pokémon over food, causing them to grow strong and durable from the many resulting battles.
author: infinex21

entry: Because POKENAME swallows large quantities of hair while grooming itself, it has developed extremely strong stomach acid. If attacked, it defends itself by spitting up globs of the corrosive acid.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME perch atop cozy spots before expectantly watching their Trainers, their gaze remaining fixed until they're fed. Once a POKENAME is eventually satisfied, it will nuzzle into its Trainer as thanks before cleaning up every last morsel.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic energy to lob globs of blue acid at its foes. It does so with minimal effort, even in close combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's diamond-shaped markings on its body glow brightly at night when it swallows something. For an unknown reason, if an Illumise accidentally attracts a POKENAME, their peers show disdain.
author: aster_oid1701

entry: POKENAME's body has the consistency of tar and shines in several colors when in light. Despite its small size, it has an extremely fast metabolism, leading to a seemingly endless hunger. It attempts to sate itself by eating anything it can find.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME establishes dominance over its brethren, forcing them to forage on its behalf. Any that disobey or return empty-handed are swiftly devoured.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME that are found in the wild are known to be leaders of large groups of Gulpin. There have been long-lasting rumours that the crown on its head is another sentient Pokémon; these rumours have been disproven.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME can be found wandering regions, for purposes unique to each one. They enjoy telling stories of their travels, which they convey through clouds of smoke.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: To increase the toxins in its body, POKENAME feeds on any poisonous plant it encounters, even preying on other Poison-Type Pokémon. It can spit extremely corrosive acid from its mouth that can dissolve anything it touches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After resting for hours under sunlight, its bulb begins to smell of sulfur. POKENAME defends its den near active volcanoes by breathing streams of fire.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The savannah-dwelling POKENAME has a mellow personality and is not easily provoked. However, it does have the ability to let loose burning spores and ash from the bulb on its back.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live near active volcanoes where the arid climate makes them feel comfortable. The smog that they release from their bodies is a dense toxic substance that kills grass on contact and leaves little place for herbivorous Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Within its small hump is boiling magma that empowers its every action. When threatened or agitated, it vents the raging flames of its magma from the opening on its back.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail glows bright gold when the water sacs inside it overheat. The water it spits during this time becomes hot enough to scald skin.
author: .izik

entry: The savannah-dwelling POKENAME has a mellow personality and is not easily provoked. However, it does have the ability to let loose burning spores and ash from the hole in its back.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are very sensitive to changes in humidity because moisture saps their natural body heat. Whenever it rains, they find the nearest shelter to avoid getting hypothermia.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks and magma in its back. In rain, its magma hardens, but its electricity strengthens.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: Vegetables near POKENAME's treetop home gain a strong spicy flavor simply from its presence. The longer it stays, the more intense the heat becomes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are rather dull-minded most of the time, but they become quite active when hungry. They shoot out fire to knock down berries and nuts, the latter of which they crack open with their stubby legs.
author: infinex21

entry: Boiling magma is stored in POKENAME's bulging leg muscles; this heat allows this Pokémon to move quickly and swiftly. When it uses its fire to attack, the size of POKENAME's muscles shrinks until its magma replenishes from eating.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: This Pokémon uses magma stored in its legs to move and attack. To train itself, POKENAME will practice fighting in the rain when the magma cools, making its movements slow and heavy. Pushing through this weight is how POKENAME improves its skills.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME regularly partakes in cool, muddy water to cool itself and gain nutrients. Thick plumes of steam rise from the hole in its hump as its insides cool down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys cooling itself off by soaking in mud puddles. While it soaks, the amount of steam it produces from its back increases by close to fifty percent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spits boiling mud at trees to mark its territory. The patterns it creates are unique to each individual.
author: .izik

entry: The inside of its larger maw is as hot as boiling magma; even the saliva of this large maw is hot enough to burn on contact. Because its large maw deters most threats, it has become incredibly laid-back; it becomes aggressive when hungry.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are commonly found in hot areas, their favorite habitat being dried-up reservoirs. Scientists speculate that these Pokémon used to live underwater in the past but were forced to adapt as the climate changed and their homes dried out.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME gnaws on ivy and thorns to keep the flames within its body burning. Should it consume a poisonous plant, it will cough up clouds of hot, toxic smoke for days.
author: .izik

entry: The flame on POKENAME's back represents its energy levels. When the flame gets low, POKENAME will go as far as to climb over rugged terrains to seek out lush forests full of food to avoid slowing down.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The organ that generates smoke within POKENAME is the same that controls its aura. As such, during moments of high emotion, the smoke it emits will be tinted blue as it mixes with its aura.
author: sk372

entry: Within its abdomen is boiling molten metal, which keeps its steel-like body hot and tempered. To keep its molten metal hot, it feeds on metal ores and coal each day. If it ever gets too hot, it can vent heat from its ports.
author: infinex21

entry: Near the end of its life cycle, POKENAME ingrain their roots into the sides of volcanoes. Many herbalists gather their dried remains to use in poultice recipes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to eat igneous rocks, which its body metabolizes into a molten liquid that it trails from the hole in its back. If startled, POKENAME releases a cloud of smoke and mysteriously vanishes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The blowhole on POKENAME's head spews water hot enough to scald skin on brief contact. Many cultures once prepared tea from this water to energize soldiers before battle, claiming it boosted performance.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever it rains, the shell of a POKENAME forms cracks from the rapid cooling but can just as easily heal after the rain ends. They live on volcanoes where the hot temperatures and low humidity keep their shell well-heated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It lives near hot springs, lounging lazily during the day and roaming to graze on mosses and ferns in the evening. It can expel boiling-hot steam out of the hump on its head to spook passersby, seemingly just for amusement.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME's Water Gun attack is frequently jet black, filled with ash. These high-pressure bursts are hot but not enough to cause serious burns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often seen in colder regions, especially during wintertime. The magma bubbling within their hump gives off a comfortable heat when held or hugged, and their excitable nature makes them popular with children.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME single-mindedly travels in one direction in search of food, not stopping except to eat. It does not care if it crashes through objects or into other Pokémon during this search, for it must keep moving to keep its body from cooling.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME has intense flames within itself, which serve to process the nutrients it absorbs due to its lack of a stomach. From the top of its head, it exudes a rich ash as it burns up nutrients; this ash is a precious material in the best fertilizers.
author: infinex21

entry: It spits fiery embers from its beak at ships crossing its territory. POKENAME nests on tropical atolls with flocks made up of dozens of individuals.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME chews on twigs and sticks to fuel its flame-based abilities. When it grows overheated, it emits an incredibly loud buzzsaw-like noise from its ears.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME contain boiling magma within themselves, causing them to need to be active at nearly all times aside from when they sleep. Physical activity keeps their magma from cooling too much, but excess activity will result in excess heat to vent.
author: infinex21

entry: The orbs upon the tips of its tail glow with heat at all times, but the intensity of these effects grows stronger as its temper grows. Thankfully, POKENAME is remarkably laid-back and only becomes agitated when it goes too long without eating.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME throw flaming seeds around to show excitement for their teammates. These seeds quickly burn and turn into ash before landing on the ground, making their displays safe to observe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body fills with incredibly hot air during battle. It can expel this air to propel itself, much like a deflating balloon.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME notices a volcano about to erupt, it attempts to shoot flames into the air in sync with the bursts. Should it lose synchronicity, it grows embarrassed and stops.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bounces on its spring tail to release steam out of the orb on its skull. It must do this constantly, or the steam building up within will cause debilitating health problems.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to shred bark from trees to line its nest and keep it warm. The bark is shredded so finely that it provides a comfortable cushion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stores magma in its pincers, which is cooled and hardened in water, but heats back up when on land. Most times, POKENAME doesn't even notice being hit.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME are fueled by the heat inside their bodies and eat coal to keep themselves warm. They are unable to train for battles in the rain because it saps heat from their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME connects its roots to healthy cacti to wick moisture and nutrients into its own body. Once the cacti can no longer sustain POKENAME, it burns off its roots to migrate to a different location.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is considered overall unintelligent and struggles to consciously register what is around it or remember many things, too. Although it can be found in a variety of locations, it likes to stay in places with a steady food supply.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stores boiling magma in its body. When it experiences intense emotions, magma will spew from the opening at the top of its head.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME release a thick sludge that trails them wherever they go. If they are caught outside when it rains, their sludge slowly begins to solidify as it loses its heat. Some succumb to hypothermia if they cannot find shelter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME clumsily stumble around while trying to see from beneath their shaggy fur. If they're startled, they will release a powerful burst of spores from their bulbs, igniting them before running away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can be spotted in locations with both high elevation and high temperatures, such as the top of active volcanos. They may retreat into volcanic craters during foul weather, but remain outside during a thunderstorm.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The colder the outside temperature, the higher POKENAME floats in the sky. In its natural habitat by active volcanoes, POKENAME is nearly touching the ground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a fiery temperature, and when it erupts in anger, it also erupts in lava. Trainers of POKENAME make frequent use of calming incenses to keep their companion from blowing up.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME territorially patrols the maze-like nests it builds within volcanic calderas. To deter predators, it mercilessly blasts them with molten honey, which, after it cools and hardens, is a luxury treat made famous by Lavaridge Town.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME dwell within volcanic areas, feeding on magma, lava, and volcanic rock. When agitated, magma erupts from their backs along with a pillar of fire.
author: infinex21

entry: These volcanic Pokémon release bursts of flames and magma to intimidate others. When agitated, they channel their flames into forceful streams and fling fireballs from their backs.
author: infinex21

entry: It lounges within magma or lava and is docile enough to ferry others across as well. Flames and magma will erupt from the hump upon its back if it is mistreated in any way, however.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME favour pools of boiling magma, rarely leaving the comfort of their rocky craters. They sustain themselves by absorbing rich volcanic minerals directly from the molten liquid.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME seeks attention constantly. If it feels ignored for too long, it may throw a tantrum and erupt with tiny spurts of lava.
author: hophoppip

entry: A magma-hot liquid erupts from the humps upon the backs of these Pokémon when they are enraged. Flames can be loosed from the ports on their tails, a practice they will often use to roast their prey alive.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME favor cooler environments to help regulate their extreme internal heat. Oddly, this seems to help keep their tempers low as well, thus often avoiding an eruption from their twin humps.
author: infinex21

entry: In volcanic craters, POKENAME absorbs the heat of the magma. It converts this heat to energy, allowing plants to grow along the crater of the volcano despite the harsh environment.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The molten lava sitting inside POKENAME is gentle compared to other Pokémon that live in volcanoes, but still burns bright. It is easy-going and tends to avoid straying far from its nest.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME favour carving extensive tunnel networks near active fault lines to absorb geothermal heat. Whenever they become enraged, they unleash a plague of violent tremors and sudden eruptions of magma upon their subterranean territories.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Using the pressure from the volcano on its back, POKENAME launch themselves forward at incredible speeds to deliver devastating kicks at whatever stands in their way. To avoid losing too much energy, POKENAME will also fight with its claws.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME moves carefully at a battle's beginning, luring opponents into thinking it has low mobility. It then uses eruptions from the rocks on its back to propel it around at high speeds, and takes foes by surprise with agile movements and kicks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can often be found placidly soaking itself in volcanic hot springs, unfazed by the boiling waters. It erupts similarly scalding water from its back should it need to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: The steam that comes out of POKENAME's geysers are incredibly poisonous, giving their steam its blue hue. However, the heat is more likely to knock out foes before the poison.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME masterfully prepare their food by slow-cooking it over the dripping lava produced from their jaws. Those who manage to earn their favour might be lucky enough to be invited to share these highly sought-after meals.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME is proud of its strength and quick to start a fight. Its forceful headbutts are strengthened by its rocky head, which can spew lava when POKENAME is facing a strong foe.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME often sleeps in the craters of volcanoes, eating molten rock as fuel. However, when too much magma builds up inside its humps, it goes into a rage, spewing nonstop until empty.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: This Pokémon lives near volcanoes and is typically shy. When it approaches humans without hesitation, it's usually a sign that the volcano will soon erupt.
author: hophoppip

entry: Sailors claim to have seen volcanic islands moving across the ocean. Those islands are actually POKENAME. They can accidentally create archipelagos if they linger for a long time.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME swim in the magma of active volcanoes, gently fanning their tails to try and keep the environment cool and stable. If this technique fails, POKENAME ride along lava flows while spraying water to contain the eruption.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When the volcano on POKENAME's back erupts, enough lava pours out to create entirely new strips of land, even amidst the ocean deep. It can sleep deeply, potentially for dozens of years at a time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When the volcano on POKENAME's back erupts, enough lava pours out to create entirely new strips of land, even amidst the ocean deep. It can sleep deeply, potentially for dozens of years at a time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When a POKENAME's volcano erupts, its magma crystallises into giant, fiery blooms. When POKENAME migrate, they leave behind these floral structures as ephemeral decorations.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME can be found around active volcanoes, waiting for the lava to stop flowing so they can find diamonds. It is not recommended to approach, as they will pounce if someone were to get too close.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Long ago, POKENAME were one of the top predators due to their ability to spit out lava. Because their magma hardened around them, their fossils are almost perfectly preserved.
author: bigoljax

entry: Using the cannons in their mouth, POKENAME can shoot large beams made of lava. It takes them long periods of time to recharge after they fire, leaving them vulnerable.
author: bigoljax

entry: Revered as wardens of active volcanoes, POKENAME glide effortlessly across boiling magma to patrol their territories. They channel the fervour of the molten earth below them to repel intruders.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME can nearly be as destructive as small volcanos when angered. Their magma falls down from the sky, hitting the unfortunate down below.
author: bigoljax

entry: When POKENAME rampages, it lets loose a wild, uncontrollable anger that causes smoke to pile and thicken on its body. However, on the rare occasions it can focus this anger, it can unleash a destructive beam of lava from the top of its head.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite being completely organic, POKENAME seem to have the same functions as volcanos. Researchers continue to study how POKENAME truly works.
author: bigoljax

entry: When enraged, POKENAME stomp their front claws against the ground and the small volcanoes on their backs erupt. The fireballs loosed by their volcanoes may burn whatever grass they land upon but the dirt shall be made remarkable fertile as a result.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon gathers periodically around volcanic calderas and creates festive dancing music with its cries. While some believe that this foreshadows a violent eruption, research has shown that it prevents the Pokémon itself from violently erupting.
author: notadoctor75

entry: POKENAME makes its home within geysers, absorbing the heat they produce. If disturbed, it spits molten hot mud at the offender.
author: .izik

entry: It suffers from severe anger issues, so it practices yoga daily in order to stay calm and keep from blowing its top.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The volcano on POKENAME's back is always active, constantly spewing lava. When the lava cools and turns into stone, it creates a layer of protection for POKENAME against enemy attacks.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME swims around the waters surrounding volcanic islands. It crawls onto shore around once a week to blow off steam from its pores, lest it overheat and become sickly.
author: sk372

entry: Lurking within active calderas, POKENAME are highly aggressive predators that fiercely guard their volcanic domains. They eagerly ambush careless intruders, overwhelming them with sudden torrents of scalding magma.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Despite its pathetic appearance and mellow nature, POKENAME's volcanic vents are full of important nutrients that sustain microscopic life. Every year, multiple new life forms are discovered feeding off of POKENAME.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME stores so much magma inside its body that when it finally erupts, it takes hours for it to completely empty out. It stuffs lots of prey inside its body, melting all traces of them as they simmer for days in its magma.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME live atop active volcanoes where they unleash fiery molten lava onto foes that disturb their slumber. Whenever POKENAME need to swiftly move away from their home, they roll away, leaving blobs of lava in their wake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME favour travelling across rugged volcanic terrain, leaving trails of scorched earth in their wake. They must constantly maintain at least a brisk trot to safely vent the immense thermal pressure building within their bodies.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME reside near geothermal vents in hot springs, using their claws to catch fish from the water. With their larger claw, they will scoop up water, heating it over these vents before placing their prey inside, boiling them before consumption.
author: santon5512

entry: The pearl on its back is very important to POKENAME as it is the source of its psychic powers. It uses its spring-like protuberances to deflect physical attacks that threaten to hit it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are constantly bouncing on any surface with reach, gaining energy with each and every bounce. They are naturally full of joy and wonder, bringing smiles to those around them as well.
author: entomoxie

entry: Despite its size and weight, POKENAME can use its spring-like legs to leap extremely high. Its psychic powers keep the pearl on its back perfectly balanced.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's heart beats in sync with the bouncing pearl on its head. When an ally is distressed, these bounces emit psychic vibrations that gently steady their pulse. Therapists often study this ability to improve their relaxation techniques.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: Supposedly, if one balances POKENAME's pearl on their head, its spirit will possess them. Thankfully, nobody has ever done this.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It runs around tall grass, looking for new people to proudly show its pearl to. POKENAME won't leave you alone until you acknowledge it and admire its pearl.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are playful creatures that enjoy hopping. Whether it is with their long hind legs or their springy tail, they hop through the world with glee.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By leaping constantly, POKENAME charges the jewel on its head with stored energy. It feeds on sunlight through photosynthesis, always seeking out the brightest treetops to bask in.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have superb jumping abilities and can leap up to six times their body length in a single jump. This allows them to quickly escape when they steal coins and other trinkets from Trainers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The faster POKENAME bounces, the hotter the pearl atop its head becomes. Touching it at full heat can easily cause third degree burns.
author: .izik

entry: While unfused Spoink must continue bouncing to live, a fused POKENAME has two hearts and can survive without bouncing. This is a moot point, however, as fused POKENAME are unable to keep themselves from bouncing.
author: djoing

entry: The pearl wedged in its fontanelle keeps POKENAME's constant migraines under control. Unfortunately, it must temporarily remove this pearl to make full use of its psychic powers.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Its body is always coiled tightly like a spring, ready to launch itself away from any danger. The crystal orb POKENAME holds with its tail is said to hold the power to cure venomous bites, even the ones from POKENAME itself.
author: milchik

entry: Its body is always coiled tightly like a spring, ready to launch itself away from any danger. The crystal orb POKENAME holds with its tail is said to hold the power to cure venomous bites, even the ones from POKENAME itself.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's psychic potential is directly tied to its muscle strength, so it trains virtually nonstop. Whenever it flexes its muscles, the orb on its head glows brighter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME precariously balance their precious pearl on their tongue while bouncing. Before sleeping, they attach themselves to tree branches with their spring facing the trunk to continue bouncing while sleeping.
author: chibitales

entry: The only cure for POKENAME's headaches is the herbs growing on its bulb, which it is unable to reach on its own. As a result, it often follows Trainers with the hope they will help ease its pain.
author: rakunk

entry: It spends most of the day among the tree branches, snacking on the tree leaves. Should it get a surging headache, the psychic pulse may cause all the leaves on the tree to fall off at once.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME generate electricity from the stress they experience. When they are stressed enough to cause headaches, they explode and release all the electricity that has built up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME should be given a wide berth where possible. It is prone to painful headaches, and when the migraines begin, the pain causes it to explode in a mix of psychic and electric energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are moody Pokémon that generate electricity from their various mood swings. When they are so stressed that they have a headache, they explode to vent that frustration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wears the skulls of other Pokémon and lives in solitude. It does not spend much time with other Pokémon because its frequent headaches flare up when it is overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers to live alone, as it easily develops headaches when overwhelmed by other Pokémon. It wears skulls of other Pokémon both for protection and to ease its loneliness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A delusional fusion, POKENAME believes itself to be a world-renowed boxer. Despite its mediocrity, its skill increases with its headaches.
author: pory

entry: POKENAME are fastidious at cleaning with their tongues and hate places that are dirty. If placed in a room where they cannot clean or organize, they develop headaches from the resulting stress.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gets headaches whenever it is itchy for long enough, but it has no limbs to scratch that itch. It can only wobble hoping another Pokémon comes to help alleviate the itch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces a unique gas that causes severe migraines in anyone exposed to it. However, POKENAME is in constant pain because of its own gas.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are easy to agitate into an anxious state. Once they start rampaging, it is difficult to stop their manic state. They often feel remorseful for the destruction they cause, even if they forget part of what happened.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rev up a charge with their hind legs before they run into foes with their sharp bill. They can punch through boulders with enough force, but the resulting impact also leaves them with a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The eggs POKENAME makes are particularly effective in alleviating headaches when consumed.  Because of its constant migraines, POKENAME is constantly eating its own eggs.
author: sk372
