entry: POKENAME is a dangerous Pokémon to leave by itself since it's bound to cause trouble with its huge strength and teetering steps. The spots on its body mark its sensors to detect movement in water.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has such wobbly steps that when walking through mud, it will always slip and land on its bottom. Despite the fall, it takes this opportunity to playfully spin and slide through the mud with a huge smile on its face.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME love to dance, twirling like ballerinas. Despite their clumsy nature, their performances are oddly graceful, reaching impressive speeds as they spin.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is a devotee of dance, enthusiastically putting on performances for others whenever it can. It has a very unorthodox swaying style of dance, but the shows it puts on are unforgettable.
author: sk372

entry: The poison on its barbs makes anybody who comes in contact with it extremely dizzy. However, POKENAME is not immune to its own venom, and often spends hours twirling and swaying after accidentally pricking itself.
author: _._starry_._

entry: POKENAME often can't hold itself up thanks to the weight imbalance from its horns. It appears helpless as it stumbles around, which can drop the guard of its opponent, allowing for POKENAME to fight back.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: Despite constantly wanting to lie down and relax, POKENAME can never seem to keep its feet in place to do so. This results in a hulking beast of a Pokémon who constantly moves around while half-asleep.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME move elegantly during battle, seemingly dancing in nonsensical ways as they evade attacks. When they extend their feelers, said feelers always move in spirals and twists; the cause for this is still uncertain.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's dizzying movements should not fool anyone, for it can strike with immense force and incredible precision. It scatters dizzying spores from its tail and from its head when it makes sudden movements, such as by launching a punch.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME uses a Fighting-type move, it always looks as if it's about to stumble, causing opponents to underestimate it. It can sense the aura of nearby people and performs silly dances to cheer up those with sorrowful hearts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It moves with goofy, swaying motions that confuse its enemies, striking them with Electric-type attacks when they drop their guard. Since it loves pranks, it enjoys tugging on other Pokémon's tails, which usually gets it into all sorts of trouble.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The curly stalks on POKENAME's head are edible, and make tasty snacks when fried. Eating too many of the stalks will make you as dizzy and clumsy as POKENAME.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's spots develop as mold builds up within patches of its fur, becoming a random and distinguishing feature. The uneven distribution of its trash interior causes it to walk about in an uneven, tottering motion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME swims, it follows erratic, circular patterns to throw off fishermen and other sea creatures. Although it is mostly harmless and doesn't hunt other Pokémon, its teeth are so strong that they can even pierce through stone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it flies, POKENAME follows clumsy, zigzagging paths and sometimes crashes into tree branches, leaving tufts of its cottony wings behind. It sings cheerfully all day long, as if it never had a single worry.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Sometimes when POKENAME fires a laser, the beam it fires is so strong that the recoil knocks it to the floor. The dizziness it experiences from the fall, along with the lack of energy from firing the laser, causes it to fall unconscious afterwards.
author: soup1900

entry: It wildly dances and totters around during battle, occasionally leading it to fall. Luckily, the thick shell covering its head protects it from most harm.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME performs Rollout attacks in seemingly random directions. If it collides with something, it will cause whatever it hit to violently spin.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's wand acts as a powerful vessel for its psychic abilities, releasing swirls of odd light that mesmerize those who gaze into them. It's clumsy, however, so it often missteps and bumps itself on the head with its wand, making itself dizzy.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME is oddly drawn to plush toys, sometimes hoarding a hundred or more plushes in their dens. Some believe they are driven by the spirits of children.
author: hophoppip

entry: When two POKENAME kiss, they spin round and round until one of them loses their grip and gets tossed away into the sea depths.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME circle in the air around beaches, looking for food. However, sometimes they forget why they are there and simply just follow the POKENAME in front of them for hours on end.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves to chase its own tail, frequently making itself dizzy and tripping over its own feet. Many Trainers find its stumbling movements adorable.
author: skittytales

entry: With every bounce, POKENAME is constantly spinning and flipping. Due to its inability to control where it's bouncing, it can be a danger to fragile objects.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Researchers have yet to determine whether its dizzy gait is caused by constant migraines or vice versa. At times, POKENAME is so disoriented that it sprays water in directions different from its intended target.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME often wander about in towns, sometimes to model clothes designs. They seem to particularly enjoy the rain, spinning underneath any umbrella they can find.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are always spinning, though they spin slower at night, especially when the moon is full. They derive power from solar energy, so they almost always face toward the sun to absorb as much as possible.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME violently thrashes around, turning the ground beneath it into a trampoline. Its prey tumble violently around it, leaving them defenseless.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Before spinning tops were invented, children of long ago would play with POKENAME as they dizzily spun around everywhere. When they accidentally fell over, the children would grab their heads to spin them out again, which compounded their dizziness.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly exerts a psychic energy field around it, which causes everything in its vicinity to suffer from vertigo. However, POKENAME itself is not immune to this effect, and as a result, it often stumbles around.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME creates a distinctive chiming call by swinging an organ in the back of its throat around in a certain pattern. The patterns are different depending on the POKENAME, so no two cries are exactly alike.
author: sk372

entry: When threatened, POKENAME causes the opponent to suffer from vertigo. While the opponent is reeling in dizziness, POKENAME makes its escape.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME are incredibly energetic, running in circles when excited. This constant motion will often leave them dizzy, causing them to tumble over.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME enjoys chasing its own tail for hours. No matter how much it spins, it never becomes dizzy.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are always searching for a fight. They fly in circular motions in order to make their opponents dizzy and strike them with great accuracy despite their clumsiness. They each have different spots to differentiate themselves.
author: saucebolodu81

entry: Many professional athletes are beginning to take notes from POKENAME's fighting style. Its swaying, unpredictable movements make it very difficult to hit or predict which direction its next attack will come from.
author: sk372

entry: The slime on POKENAME is said to have haunting illusions of what you most fear. However, it will rarely use this power, as it is extremely friendly to most.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME sway constantly as if in the wind, almost never standing upright. To prevent themselves from falling over, they root themselves into the ground.
author: santon5512

entry: When retracted into its shell, POKENAME moves and spins around with a haphazard series of motions. When it comes back out, it appears quite dizzy, and its walking style is no less off-kilter.
author: sk372

entry: The mane on a POKENAME is hot to the touch even in the coldest winters. It is friendly and enjoys letting people hitch a ride, though most riders become dizzy from its wobbly gait and poor sense of direction.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME lazes on the beach, not daring to move a single inch. It survives purely off human offerings, which include food, accessories, and more.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME often loses its balance and topples onto its back due to the weight of its shell. However, it moves with remarkable agility in the water, which is why it is rarely seen on land.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME generates magnetic fields by spinning rapidly. It's able to keep spinning for prolonged lengths of time without getting dizzy.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's heads all agree that the center head is in charge. They are rarely untangled enough to know which head that is, however.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME are capable of launching small objects across a field with their powerful cannons, but their terrible aim often prevents them from hitting their target. Some Trainers embrace this unsteadiness to hose down opponents in a Pokémon battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are fierce fighters who search the jungle for suitable competitors. If a POKENAME has a large bulb on its back, it is a sign that it is experienced in battle.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers increase the pain its claws inflict. If it holds a strong enough grudge against its opponent, the pain of its slashes may linger for days.
author: hophoppip

entry: Young POKENAME are always itching for a fight and will usually get into scraps with their siblings. They eagerly await evolution to grow stronger in battle.
author: bostroms

entry: If it spots a Seviper within its territory, it flies into a rage and its fur crackles with sparks. Despite its fierce nature, POKENAME can grow attached to its Trainer and even accept affection.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its cute appearance, if POKENAME spots a Seviper, it is consumed by uncontrollable fury. It stays awake all night watching the sky in the hope of seeing falling stars.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Equipped with claws and fierce anger, POKENAME menaces groups of Seviper by entering their dens and ambushing those inside. Once the Seviper are defeated, POKENAME pilfers any berries stored and celebrates victory with a meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Already smart for a Pokémon, POKENAME will become even smarter than a human when poisoned. It can predict a week into the future.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The red rings on its body radiate a scarlet glow when POKENAME is enraged. Its claws are sharp enough to slice through massive trees and vegetation with ease.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It uses its sharp claws to viciously attack foes. POKENAME are cunning, and sometimes work in pairs to hunt Seviper and related fusions.
author: the_fireplace

entry: A POKENAME's tail is strong enough to bend a pole of solid metal with one blow. Its Crush Claw attacks are strong enough to crush even the hardest of shells that its opponents might have.
author: infinex21

entry: It stands on its hind legs during battle to fight with the sharp claws on its forelegs, which otherwise help it to climb trees. If it encounters a Seviper, it rolls up into a ball to repel the physical blows that will likely follow.
author: infinex21

entry: Serpentine Pokémon are not allowed to be anywhere near POKENAME's habitat. The edges of its tail are razor-sharp, used to bludgeon and cut any of these Pokémon that it catches sight of.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often preyed upon by Seviper and Seviper fusions, so their bodies have developed strong antibodies to counter their toxins. They utilize their small yet strong talons to entrap their foes and blast them with fire attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: It can run on all fours, though it will walk and fight while standing on its hind legs. If it encounters a Seviper, the fur along its back bristles like quills and a brutal battle will ensue.
author: infinex21

entry: It fights with strong kicks and thrusting punches. POKENAME practices its attacks daily on nearby rocks or trees; the marks left by its attacks clearly mark its territory.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's sharp claws and martial prowess make it a force to be reckoned with. It shows absolutely no mercy towards any Seviper fusions that enter its territory.
author: mepp.

entry: Should POKENAME spot a Seviper, it fires bursts of pressurized water before screeching loudly to alert others of its kind. They will pursue the Seviper together, spitting water relentlessly until it retreats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a prickly personality, often taking a swipe with its large claws at anything coming too close. It takes a long time to warm up to others, but when it does, it is fiercely protective.
author: sk372

entry: It can alter the color of all but its tongue and claws and can only partly change the hue of its red patterns to blend in with its surroundings. It is a strong and swift hunter, but it becomes far more vicious and sadistic against serpentine Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are constantly hunted by Seviper, so they rely on their staff and the writhing mass of fur on the back of their head. When locked in battle, the fur on the back of POKENAME's head morphs into a set of jaws to clamp down foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has an abundance of energy, with its fiery tail slowly burning down to nothing as it expends its stamina. It is a prankster and especially targets Seviper as the victim of its practical jokes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While locked in combat, the red markings on POKENAME's body can reach up to 1000 degrees Fahrenheit. Its strength only seems to grow as it takes more damage in battle.
author: mistymagius

entry: Within its furry wings, POKENAME conceals two sharp claws. It extends these the moment a fight begins, causing lacerations to anything nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME electrocutes anyone who dares enter its territory with powerful Electric-type attacks. It marks the borders of its domain by carving large X-shapes into tree trunks or stones using its long claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Few dare wander into POKENAME's territory, as it dispatches trespassers with swift, high-voltage shocks. The X-shaped claw marks etched across rocks and trees serve as a warning to anyone who might approach.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME takes pride in its long, well-sustained fur that it grooms daily with its claws. This Pokémon's worst nightmare is a chunk of its precious hair being cut down by one of its territorial rivals, especially those with sharp, bladed tails.
author: milchik

entry: The claws at the ends of its feelers have enough power to crush open some of the hardest nuts with ease. Although it acts aggressive during battle, it is docile and friendly at all other times and will even share food with others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME stores the souls of any Seviper it defeats in its coffin body, and with every stored soul, its spirit-limbs grow in length and strength. A record of 33 souls were recovered from the largest-known POKENAME to be defeated.
author: alestrius

entry: Though not outwardly aggressive, POKENAME are incredibly vindictive if slighted. Many folk tales speak of POKENAME cursing people and turning them into serpents before hunting and tormenting them for days on end.
author: sk372

entry: Its thick fur dazzles when it is highly agitated, which is notably common when it is faced with a Seviper. It stands on its hind legs during battle so it may deliver stronger slash attacks with the claws on its forelimbs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be vicious, but it is largely posturing, as they are surprisingly fearful Pokémon. Their small claws are not as dangerous as they could be. They react dangerously when cornered, growing absolutely frenzied.
author: vic1312

entry: Zangoose is the dominant consciousness in POKENAME. Some suggest it carries the grudges and spirits of Zangoose that fell in combat against Seviper; POKENAME often lashes out and growls at nothing in particular, as if constantly upset.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are often yanked from the ground by Seviper. When provoked, they swipe at predators with their claws, though their short reach makes these attacks largely ineffective.
author: santon5512

entry: Should a Seviper enter its portion of the woods, POKENAME joins with others of its kind to produce loud bursts of noise to intimidate it. They then swoop down one at a time to duel the foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a strong vendetta against serpent Pokémon, particularly Seviper. It cannot resist swooping down and swiping at them with its wings, though due to their soft cloud cover, its strikes do little damage to its rivals.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME often acts aloof to its Trainer, its loyalty should never be questioned. It defends them stalwartly, doubly so if it catches any serpent-like Pokémon approaching.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will spend a large amount of its time finding the best branches and stones to turn into a weapon. POKENAME will use its claws as a reference for how sharp the stones at the end of its branch should be.
author: drcew

entry: POKENAME craft crude magical talismans; casting a feral, vicious magic that can cause physical pain in their enemies. They silently defend populations of Zangoose from attacks by Seviper, sequestering themselves in their caves until they are needed.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME have developed a sense of smell for coal, which is what they primarily consume. Due to their ability to find coal and their strong claws that can dig through solid rock, POKENAME are common companions for miners.
author: infinex21

entry: Normally timid, POKENAME become aggressive when a Seviper appears. A rallying cry summons others from nearby ponds to fire bark-stripping water jets.
author: .izik

entry: A lily pad rests atop POKENAME's head, coated in short red fur. In humid weather, the fur fluffs dramatically in hopes of retaining the moisture.
author: .izik

entry: Although each POKENAME is small, a pack of them will hunt down prey together; they will hunt down Seviper, even if they are not hungry. To keep their claws sharp, they scrape them against solid rock until a single swipe can cleanly cut tree bark.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses its large tail as a counterweight to stay on its hind legs while slashing at foes with its front claws. It is very loyal to a compassionate and skilled Trainer, though it suffers from violent impulses at the sight of Seviper.
author: infinex21

entry: Using its keen sense of smell, POKENAME sniffs out and infiltrates the nests of its archrival, Seviper. It targets the eggs in the nest, brazenly stealing them for food.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are infamous for being very temperamental Pokémon that will attack anything without provocation. Because of their attitude, many keep them as pets due to how comically cute they are when angry.
author: cobalt0135

entry: When POKENAME spots a Seviper, the red portions of its fur fluff up as it growls. Should the Seviper draw too close, it lashes out with claws sharp enough to shred metal.
author: .izik

entry: During winter, POKENAME's fur grows excessively long. The weight can slow its movement due to its short legs.
author: .izik

entry: Up to five POKENAME may share a single tree. When Seviper are spotted, they emit flutelike cries before launching Razor Wind from above.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its small size, it can crack open extremely hard nuts within either of its talons. It often ends up in battle with wild Seviper and will aim to break off their fangs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are known to be particularly cruel to Seviper, scooping them up with talons before dropping them from a great height. They are otherwise solitary creatures that rarely interact with other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soars above beaches hoping to steal junk food from boadwalks, usually from food dropped by tourists. If it ever encounters a Seviper, it becomes irrationally angry and tries to scare them away with Wing Attack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a vicious antipathy towards any sort of serpentine Pokémon. It swoops down to claw at them until weakened enough that it can attempt to swallow them whole into its large beak.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lurk at the surface of lakes and ponds where they harass Seviper with bubbles and jets of water. The thick fur on their bodies softens the impact of bites to stop Seviper from injecting venom into their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It destroys the furniture in any apartment it lives in, driven by the instinct to scratch and keep its long claws razor-sharp. POKENAME is a natural-born predator, silently stalking anything that moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: One full-force swing of its claws is strong enough to cleave through most trees; it can only swing at full force about twice before tiring itself. POKENAME often clashes with Seviper, becoming stronger and more resistant to poison in the process.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rears up on its back legs to deliver powerful slashes with its front claws. It will hold a grudge against anyone who touches its tail without permission.
author: skittytales

entry: Although POKENAME is popular for its cute appearance, it is standoffish and will only ever warm up to its own Trainer. Once a bond has been formed, POKENAME is said to be quite playful.
author: skittytales

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME's incredibly thick fur sparks constantly. The moment the storm ends, the sparking ceases entirely.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cheers the loudest and most happily when a partner is fighting against a Seviper. To ensure the Seviper loses, it sends out jolts of electricity to pull their attention away from the battle.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a negative attitude towards most people and Pokémon, only cheering on those it considers its closest friends. POKENAME will not hesitate to turn its cheers into violence, especially towards those who resemble a Seviper.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is cautious, warning away others by creating small spurts of magma from the hole in its hump. The only exception to this is Seviper, of which POKENAME will immediately go on the attack and attempt to douse them with magma.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's constant swaying allows it to nimbly evade and counterattack during battles. Studies have shown that POKENAME has very little control over these movements and simply adapts as it goes.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME hold lots of energy and an intense hatred for Seviper. Trainers that have a POKENAME are strongly encouraged to purchase durable scratching posts so that it doesn't destroy any serpentine-like object.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: The Pokémon POKENAME is comprised of are always actively fighting each other, even when fused. This causes them to bite everything and everyone, sometimes even their own Trainer. Due to this, training them is considered Pokémon abuse in some regions.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: POKENAME's aggression is at the point where it sees every other Pokémon as a rival. It strikes viciously at any new encounter, determined to leave a scar that marks the start of their intense rivalry.
author: sk372

entry: The fur on POKENAME has medicinal use. It raises your body temperature enough to burn up any toxins in the body.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: It is a fierce and extremely territorial creature that doesn't hesitate to hurl itself at intruders, striking them down with its powerful, razor-sharp claws. If its foe proves particularly tough, it unleashes scorching flames to burn and weaken them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's claws are always searing hot, able to burn Pokémon from touch alone. POKENAME are known to fly around in search of their next rival, attacking them unprovoked until they have proven they are stronger before finding another opponent.
author: npshi

entry: Its vines end in a pair of razor-sharp blades coated in a potent poison. POKENAME becomes particularly aggressive during the rainy season, as it can't absorb as much sunlight as it desires.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wields the tail bone of a Seviper with savage precision. If the blade gets nicked, it will pause whatever it was doing and sharpen it.
author: atlas3339098

entry: It displays its venomous blade as a warning to keep others away while awaiting evolution. POKENAME's shell is so thick that it withstands both heat and cold.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sneakily waits for when it sees Lapras carrying passengers, striking in order to double its potential prey. Lapras have begun traveling in groups more often in order to reduce the chances of being attacked by POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME consume a variety of poisonous plants, allowing them to brew a powerful poison within their bodies. Their stingers are incredibly sharp, able to pierce the thick hides of cattle and incapacitate them with a single sting.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME rakes its teeth on boulders around its territory. By doing this, it both sharpens its fangs and leaves distinct markings with strong-smelling poison.
author: chibitales

entry: Its red stingers, fangs, and blade-like stinger are all venomous. Collectively, however, only the venom in its blade-like stinger is deadly. This blade-like stinger is sharp enough to horizontally cut a tree in half in a single swing.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its cute appearance as a facade to get closer to victims. It strikes with the blade on its tail, which is coated with a venom that appears to tailor itself to the DNA of whomever it strikes in order to be the most debilitating.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are well-known for being a popular choice of mob bosses, making them popular among rebellious teenagers as well. The tip of its fangs and the leaf on its head are venomous.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME spends so much time sharpening the sharp, venomous leaf on its head that most of them have one or more holes on it. The bulbs on its neck can spread poisonous powders and its bite can break rocks into pebbles.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME are very proud of their sharp horns that can poison others as easily as they can cut through thick trees. They often use their horns to cut into trees in order to drink their sap directly, though this often leaves behind poison.
author: infinex21

entry: The darker the purple of the Poison-type marking on its chest, the stronger and more venomous POKENAME is. Hardcore Poison-type Trainers use this Pokémon as a symbol of pride and strength.
author: soup1900

entry: It can swing its blade-like tail with such strength that it can cleave through solid rock. It is brutal in battle, with its claws, fangs, and even its tail capable of secreting a painful venom.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses its blade-like tail to stab and slash at its opponents, who will oft succumb to poison before their wounds. Its sharp fangs can pierce the hide of some Rock-type Pokémon with relative ease, making it very dangerous.
author: infinex21

entry: The red leaves on its tail are durable, sharp, and toxic; the leaf at the tail's tip is twice as potent as the smaller leaves. Nearly any living thing cut by its leaves will suffer a severe and painful rash around the wound if not promptly treated.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hold grudges, starting an eternal rivalry with anyone or anything that tries to harm its jungle home. The sharp tail blade allows it to spread poison as a precautionary measure.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: It has two special organs within itself: a flame sac and a toxin sac. POKENAME's toxins are flammable, so by combining both, it can spit out dangerous fireballs. These toxins burn slowly and can otherwise only be put out via smothering them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME train every day to defeat any Zangoose they may come across. The blade on their hand is coated in a deadly venom and is used to deal a finishing blow after kicking their opponents into submission.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: By planting its four feet, it can swing the blade on its head with enough force to cleave through a boulder. It will use its tail blade to fling mud or dirt at its foes, then swing its head blade down upon them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a devious and sneaky creature that hides itself by coating its body with mud and hiding in swampy areas. It flings the mud coating its tail-blade, tainted by the blade's poison, as its first strike.
author: sk372

entry: The sticky mud POKENAME spits is laced with a sickly-smelling violet venom. This venom can cause high fevers and blisters on contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME utilize telepathy to track others around them and to guide their tail blade strikes with remarkable precision. The venom delivered via their tail blades is nonlethal but causes acute, sharp pain.
author: infinex21

entry: It slithers swiftly through its territory in search of food, be it prey or fallen fruit. The edge of its tail blade can deliver a neurotoxin even with a small cut; this neurotoxin can subdue most small Pokémon within seconds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is sly and can be rather deceitful and manipulative. It is not uncommon for it to use a soft voice and kind gestures to lure others into false senses of security before taking a swing with its sharp and poison-tipped tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME utilize their upper halves to deceive and lure in prey, then constrict them with their long lower bodies. They fight using their venomous tail blades and their telekinetic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: Once POKENAME has injected its venom into its foe, it utilizes its mastery over aura to push the toxins through the bloodstreams more quickly.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a certain ire for Zangoose, and will disobey the rest of its body to pursue its foe. In areas where Zangoose are common, POKENAME enter a state of hypervigilance, as it may need to give chase at a moment's notice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The moment POKENAME's eyes catch sight of prey, it pounces with astounding speed. Its sharpened horn and tail secrete a deadly poison.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon can sense future disasters and will fight viciously against anyone causing such a tragedy. If a POKENAME loses the fight and faints, the poison from its fangs will always lead to the enemy fainting soon after the battle's end.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The wood from the tree on POKENAME's back is highly toxic and should never be used in campfires. Burning these sticks can release clouds of noxious gas capable of causing seizures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail fire burns a toxic substance coating the blade, creating poison fumes. It often creates bladed weaponry coated with the substance to give it additional reach to poison its targets from a longer range.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims alongside ships, hoping someone will accidentally fall overboard. Should they fall, it strikes with its venomous tail before dragging them beneath the surf.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME relentlessly trains to master the use of its poisoned blades. Each time it wins a duel, the metal plates of its helm grow stronger and more polished, bringing it ever closer to evolution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wields its massive scythe with both elegance and strength; since the blade is infused with a deadly poison, even a small scratch can be fatal. It is a Pokémon of great honor, refusing to battle opponents that are already wounded.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its blades, claws, and fangs are infused with a very potent poison; even the slightest hit is enough to severely debilitate its enemies. When POKENAME roars, it coats its body in a layer of electricity to finish off its victims.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The blades upon its many feelers secrete a deadly toxin that invokes a soothing effect due to how it slows all other functions. It leaves territorial markers by hacking and slashing nearby objects with its blades.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME crafts a disguise to mimic the fierce countenance of Seviper, but its small body cannot imitate the serpentine silhouette. It will play dead if it sees anything resembling Zangoose, even though the disguise is ignored by the rival Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME grind their claws against their tails to keep all of them sharp, though the act quickly exhausts them. They sleep for long periods of time, but they are easily awakened by attempted attacks; they also quickly awaken when they grow hungry.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's fangs, claws, and tail are coated with a neurotoxin that leaves foes paralyzed on direct hits. The blades surrounding POKENAME's face are not coated in this toxin, but are still used as offensive weapons when confronting Zangoose.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME is very defensive and aggressive, wielding a dangerous blade. The blade is coated with poison and garbage from POKENAME's home; a single cut is very likely to develop a terrible infection.
author: sk372

entry: People are explicitly banned from approaching POKENAME-infested waters. They are considered extremely dangerous due to their pack hunting, vicious temperament and highly-potent poison coating their oversized fangs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an extremely vindictive and stubborn hunter, never giving up once it has targeted something. It has been known to beach itself due to its stubbornness, leaping onto land attempting to chase after escaping prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings are coated in a powerful toxin. Brief contact causes rashes to spread rapidly, followed by fever soon after.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waits below the snow of its frozen home to leap forth and ambush its prey. There are no recorded instances yet of any Pokémon surviving this attack.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME is happy, it must be careful not to wag its tail too vigorously or it risks splattering poison all around. It is an extremely loyal Pokémon that would do anything to protect its Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Harvesting the shed tail blades of Seviper, POKENAME craft a sickle with a cruel appearance. They will organize populations of Seviper with their hissing voice, waging coordinated attacks on the territories of Zangoose.
author: vic1312

entry: The large knife POKENAME carries is laced with a terrible venom. A small cut from it can make you very ill.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME attacks its opponents with the poisoned blade it wields with skill and dexterity. Since it is mainly active at night, during the day it rests hidden in dens it builds near ponds or small lakes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives in swamps, floating on the top of the water as it hunts for prey. Despite its small size, it has a deadly bite.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME stores potent venom within its lily pad-like head. Even a single drop can trigger violent seizures in those exposed.
author: .izik

entry: The blades on POKENAME's tails glow red hot, able to slice through steel. Their claws secrete a dangerous toxin capable of paralyzing smaller prey.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME wait underground for food, sensing the vibrations in the earth. When prey walks by, they will thrust their tails up through the ground, skewering it.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME menaces local Zangoose populations by slashing them with its venomous tail before popping itself back underground, only to surface again shortly thereafter. Many Zangoose fail to land a hit on POKENAME before tiring themselves out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's cute appearance masks a devious and aggressive hunter. It lures others close with its innocent looks before its mouth opens to reveal highly venomous fangs ready to bite.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce a special venom, delivered either by their fangs or their tail blades, that effectively steals away the very courage of their victims. Their tail blades are tough enough to clash with bladed weapons without sustaining damage.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live and hunt in packs, but the leader of the pack is always the one to engage in battle first; the pack's leader is often clad in various scars. Their claws, fangs, and tail blades deliver a debilitating venom with every strike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hunt by ambushing prey with a poison-coated tail, giving chase after attacking. As the target escapes, the poison slowly blinds them while causing panic and leading to eventual exhaustion, allowing POKENAME to catch them.
author: chibitales

entry: Though POKENAME has little mobility, it isn't lacking in self-defense. Besides its fangs and poison points, it can fire small needles made of poisonous silk short distances to deter predators.
author: sk372

entry: Many assume that only POKENAME's fangs and spikes are dangerous, but extreme caution is needed. Though not as potent as its points, even the silky cocoon covering its body is poisonous to the touch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunts primarily in moonlight, sticking to the shadows of trees to stalk prey. When its target is cornered, it extends a hidden, sharp tail from its abdomen to strike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dips its tail into ponds to absorb water into its body. It then uses sunlight to convert that moisture into stored energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fires hardened seeds at Zangoose that wander too close to its nest. It quickly follows up with a precise Poison Jab to scare the intruder away.
author: .izik

entry: Their blade-like fans can whip up swift, sharp winds that can be so focused as to cut deep into a tree. The biggest danger, however, is that the venomous blades that make up their fans can be shed and flung with terrifying accuracy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are courageous enough to take on foes much larger than themselves and may even attempt to prey on such foes. They dart around in the air while delivering quick slashes with their tail blades, then latch on with a venomous bite.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fights using its talons, tail blades, and fangs; each of these parts delivers a debilitatingly painful venom. It preys primarily on Zangoose, even though a fierce battle always breaks out when they clash.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME float on the surface of lakes and ponds where they look for the right target to sink their fangs into. Once they find a suitable target, all it takes is one bite for their prey to succumb to venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME deliver paralytic venom through their fangs and tail blades. During lightning storms, they raise their tails up to potentially catch and absorb lightning.
author: infinex21

entry: Should POKENAME spot a Seviper fighting a Zangoose, it performs a complex dance to cheer the Seviper on. During this time, it releases bright flashes of light from the tip of its tail.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon does not fear larger opponents due to its flexible mouth, large fangs, and deadly poison. After taking down its prey, POKENAME can spend hours to days ingesting and digesting its food.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The venom that POKENAME stores in the hump on its back is extremely concentrated. It has to be diluted with moisture from POKENAME's body before it can reach its fangs.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME bounces in place rapidly, the orb on its head generates a dizzying psychic wave that paralyzes those too close. While its victim stands immobile, POKENAME springs towards them, ready to cut them with its bladed tail.
author: sk372

entry: It is despised by both Zangoose and Seviper, so POKENAME must be cautious when wandering alone into their territory. Its sharp claws and the blade at the tip of its tail are coated in a deadly venom, which it uses to bring down its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If it encounters a Zangoose or a Seviper, it is forced into a deadly battle against them. POKENAME is a lethal fighter, using swift movements to close in on its enemy and strike with devastating blows from its long, razor-sharp venomous claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Extremely aggressive, POKENAME will seek out groups of Zangoose to take them all out at once. It will even strike down wild Seviper, so that there's less competition towards fighting its eternal rival.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gathers energy from the sun in order to float around. It spins around horizontally at rapid speeds, its many poison-coated blades cutting through anything unfortunate enough to be caught in its path.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are agile swimmers, chasing down prey at surprising speeds. If they detect Zangoose in the area, they force a horrible poison to seep from their skin and tail into the water, contaminating the water until the Zangoose leave.
author: chibitales

entry: When angered, it conjures clouds of toxic gas, creating showers of potent poison that harm everything below.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its wings are like razor-sharp blades, and if it's careless during takeoff or landing, it risks toppling nearby trees. To ward off intruders, it spits highly toxic venom and if that fails, it charges them down with its massive body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its wings are like razor-sharp blades, and if it is careless during takeoff or landing, POKENAME risks toppling nearby trees. To ward off intruders, it spits highly toxic venom and if that fails, it charges them down with its massive body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a bit overzealous in its attempts to hunt others. It leaps and swings its bladed tail, but often topples over in the process, taking a bit of time to get itself properly reoriented.
author: sk372

entry: Though not usually aggressive, hunger causes POKENAME to become a vicious hunter. With fangs coated with poison and a bladed tail, it can wound and cut down prey quickly and efficiently.
author: sk372

entry: Its movements are quick, powerful, and stylish. Martial arts masters have tried to replicate them, but none have succeeded.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is a vicious and territorial undersea creature constantly attacking any other Pokémon it comes across. Its stingers and bladed tail both contain different types of virulent poison, making it easily able to debilitate a target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings are razor-sharp, drawing blood with just a light graze. The center head detaches the other heads in battle, which spin around rapidly and become whirling, slicing dervishes of pain.
author: sk372

entry: Those who find mysterious cuts along their bodies at night may be victims of POKENAME. These Pokémon hide in the shadows, slashing people with their razor-sharp tongues and tails in the blink of an eye, their lethal poison taking effect within hours.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME has a gargantuan claw that produces a corrosive acid. Whenever it hunts for its meal, it clamps down on its prey with its claw to cut them into edible portions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME feels threatened, it releases a dark smoke from the craters on its body that can poison anyone who inhales it. The material that makes up its body is similar to lunar soil, so scientists continue to study this mysterious Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME floats itself to the highest limbs of the tallest of trees to wait out its evolution, protected by its stone cocoon. When the full moon is out, the cocoon emits a radiant glow.
author: sk372

entry: The amount of toxins expelled by POKENAME's pores waxes and wanes with the phases of the moon. Inhaling the toxins has the odd effect of temporarily lessening gravity's effects on the afflicted.
author: sk372

entry: The only time POKENAME is not prone to charging down anything it sees is during the full moon. As it runs, its fluffy mane releases a sparkling material akin to stardust.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are rumored to have come from space, their bodies made of meteorite. They float in the sky as they rest and bask in moonlight, their bodies in the shape of a crescent moon. They convert this light into psychic energy, keeping them afloat.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are most active at dawn and dusk, when both heads have the most energy. During the day, the tail flails about for attention before falling lower at night as the main head guides their body to leap beneath the moonlight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's shell glows iridescent under moonlight, making it desirable as a gemstone. To defend itself, its single red eye has a hypnotic effect that immobilizes attackers with fear.
author: oddwalls

entry: POKENAME channels energy from a full moon into its magnetic core, releasing eerie pulses that disrupt compasses and leave nearby Pokémon silent until dawn.
author: _lazygod_

entry: The seeds on POKENAME's back faintly glow as they absorb moonlight. The more it stores, the faster and stronger POKENAME becomes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's sharp spines and crescent-shaped claws glow with lunar energy during the full moon. By curling into a ball and hooking its claws onto a branch, it can safely swing while gazing at the night sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers are their strongest when the moon is full. Lines connecting the stars on its cloak appear just before it uses its telekinetic abilities, forming constellations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME thrive off of moonlight alone, the gap along the front of their bodies glowing the more they absorb. They defend themselves with their forelegs and beams of condensed moonlight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hides in the darkness of caves until nightfall. In battle, its slashes leave behind glowing arcs in the air that fade like waning moonlight.
author: mepp.

entry: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME emerge from their lakes and begin swimming gracefully through the air. Some who witness this sight are mesmerized by its beauty and become calm and tranquil, but others are filled with fear and go mad.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Its flames change temperature based on the phase of the moon. On moonless nights, this flame is cool to the touch, allowing you to safely touch POKENAME.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Their temperament is determined by how much light from the moon it gets. On moonless nights, they may use their tusks to chop down every tree in the area out of anger.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Once believed to be a monument to the cosmos, legends say that POKENAME sprang to life and began to fight for mankind. It is foretold that if one is seen around, danger from high above the earth lurks near.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME levitates slightly when sleeping in moonlight. Many believe it dreams of soaring freely through the sky during these moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's behavior changes depending on the stage of the moon cycle, becoming more playful as the moon is more full and more aggressive nearer to new moons. When it accelerates, its wings flash a brilliant burst of moonlight.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME searches for someone to watch throughout an entire night, disappearing when the sun rises. Superstition says that the person it chooses to follow on the night of a full moon will be met with misfortune at dawn in three days.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is nocturnal and only comes out at night. However, it is also more active in both brighter and quieter conditions. During the full moon, it flies so high that it can't typically be seen from the ground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Said to come from the moon, POKENAME's sightings are insanely rare, especially on nights of new moons. Writings speculate it was worshipped during the darkest days for clairvoyance and guidance.
author: galactakiller

entry: In rare situations, POKENAME is said to appear in the sky taking over the real moon in places where the moon never sets. Gleaming as cold and sure as the moon, it has been used as a symbol for various criminal and cultist organizations.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME is listless and inactive during most of the day and night. At dawn, as the sun begins dispelling the night, it can show off massive amounts of solar and lunar power.
author: sk372

entry: According to ancient legends, it will open a portal to another world during a total solar eclipse. POKENAME will only obey those destined for greatness.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME is an ancient and mysterious being born from meteoric remnants that crashed into the desert dunes. It feeds on lunar light for strength, achieving its greatest power under the brilliance of a full moon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are extremely intelligent, each of their heads are able to think individual thoughts simultaneously. POKENAME are nocturnal, hunting in the dead of the night to catch prey off guard.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME naps in the sunlight to absorb solar energy. After charging sufficiently, its red eyes glow brightly.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME absorbs sunlight into its body, causing its rocky mane to shimmer intensely. In battle, it attacks by cloaking itself in brilliant flames before charging towards foes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends the majority of its life basking in the sun. If clouds ever obscure the sun, it will use a powerful Solar Beam to fizzle away the clouds.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: With strong electromagnetic and gravitational fields surrounding it, POKENAME is known to collect unique shapes and create rings of objects. It can take upwards of a month for objects to complete their orbits, but the time they take never changes.
author: thesilverowls

entry: POKENAME needs to bask in sunlight for at least an hour in the morning or it will behave groggily for the entire day. Its eyes can cast beams of warm sunlight, which it uses to heat up its meals before eating.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights its best when in the presence of direct sunlight. Basking in enough of the sun's rays allows the blades extending from its elbows to become pure fire, to devastating effect in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly radiates a strong solar energy, enough to power solar-powered machinery to full capacity in seconds. Some say that every 1000 years, POKENAME flies into the sun to recharge its own power.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon live atop tall mountains where they may easily absorb the solar energy that they live off of. When startled, they will emit flashes of bright light.
author: infinex21

entry: When sunlight is plentiful, POKENAME is able to levitate, and spends all its time enjoying this pseudo-flight. If the sun sets or becomes obscured, it immediately loses the ability and plummets to the ground head-first.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses Rock Polish while flying through caves to evade predators. Its stones become so smooth and bright that they reflect light in dazzling flashes.
author: .izik

entry: The light within POKENAME's core intensifies as it ages, but dims near the end of its lifecycle. To hide its approach, it uses its wings to eclipse the internal light before exposing the flare in a blinding surprise attack.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME have a near mastery of conjuring and manipulating solar energy. They create glowing orbs that they sustain with a small thread of psychic energy, providing light and giving them quick access to small, magical explosives if attacked.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME directly converts eaten coal into shining light rays through some unknown process inside its body. It has a second pair of eyes on its back that can freely rotate around to watch for danger.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME floats high above swamps, flashing a bright light in uneven patterns. Some once believed this to be a courtship ritual, but further study has revealed it to be a means of releasing excess energy from its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is listless and inactive during most of the day and night. At dusk, as the night begins overtaking the day, it can show off massive amounts of lunar and solar power.
author: sk372

entry: In rare situations, POKENAME is said to appear in the sky taking over the real sun in places where the sun doesn't shine. Shining as brightly as the sun, it has been used as a symbol for various charity and volunteer organizations.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME hovers around glacial areas, embedding itself in the ice. Its warm body causes the ice to melt from contact, and POKENAME seems to derive a sense of relaxation from the sensation of the ice melting against its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spend hours a day basking in sunlight to build up energy. Once ready, the males will engage in fierce battles to determine dominance.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME slither along the surface of the water to absorb sunlight before plunging into the water at sunset. At night, they lure in prey with their light, eating their fill before returning to the surface in time for sunrise.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: During the day, it lounges on shorelines and absorbs sunlight in a process similar to photosynthesis. At night, it retreats deep into the sea.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME releases golden flames as it gallops through the world, searching for open pastures where it can freely roam. Many nomadic tribes ride into these pastures to race against POKENAME, a traditional rite of passage for young children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appears energized by the sun, so it only burrows underground at night. To attack, it will fire rays of stored energy from the rocky protrusions on its head.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's whiskers are incredibly sensitive, allowing them to sense approaching predators as they eat. When threatened, they spray a mixture of ink and mud from their mouths, blinding attackers.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are a common sight in many creeks and streams. They feed on a variety of algae and carrion.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's surface is so slimy that the Pokémon is nearly impossible to pick up. POKENAME travels throughout watersheds to reach larger lakes. If the streams dry up due to the weather, it uses its stubby legs to crawl through the mud.
author: .realthree

entry: While buried in mud along creek banks, POKENAME leaves its tail sticking straight out of the surface. Should a predator draw near, it senses their vibrations and unleashes a powerful Thunder Shock.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feelers are always extremely moist. Interestingly, the liquid that seeps from them can induce calm in anyone whose skin it touches within moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been dubbed "the model of the mud" due to its habitat of ponds and lakebeds and its habit of dramatically posing.
author: hophoppip

entry: The slimy film covering the bodies of these Pokémon serves to keep them moist, clean, and escape the clutches of some predators. By compressing their own bodies, they can eject their internal organs to deliver devastating blows.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is heavily composed of a slimy, muddy film, which it spews to create more sludgy water sources for it to live.The sticky mud traps prey, which POKENAME finds with its sensitive whiskers and then consumes whole.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME transform their environment using a slimy mucus they excrete, turning any soil they reside in into a cozy mud puddle. They are very popular for their adorable bubbles they blow while sleeping.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME lives in small groups along riverbanks and attacks anyone it deems a threat to itself or its companions. Before striking with its electric blows, the bluish whiskers on its nose vibrate frenetically.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When two Barboach fuse together, the result is far slippier and faster than either one individually. This allows the fusion to hide in tight crevices and muddy riverbeds with ease. The extra whiskers improve their already superb natural radar system.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME travel in pods of up to 300. It is a popular tourist activity to swim with POKENAME during the summer months, as they drift through the water very slowly, and are mostly docile in the wild.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME can swim completely submerged in mud and detect the footsteps of predators with their sensitive whiskers. The vibrations of footsteps give them plenty of time to hide in their shell before the predator finds them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a constantly bewildered expression. It will suddenly appear behind someone, curious at what they are doing, and cry out in surprise when they react with fear.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME live deep in the ocean, making their homes around geothermal vents. They feed on the mineral rich waters that erupt from the vents, relying on their tough shells to protect them from the worst of the heat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found in forests, blowing away bird Pokémon that may want to roost in their branches. Sometimes they grow heavy, bitter apples, which seem to be used as a seasonal defense mechanism.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME sprays water and mud from its trunk with enough pressure to pierce solid stone. Its long ears allow it to swim gracefully despite its stocky body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME bury themselves in the sand deep beneath the ocean, awakening when they sense strong storms above. By slamming their bodies into the seafloor, they create massive tremors, stirring up tsunamis above.
author: santon5512

entry: Using the generator on their backs, POKENAME can grab stones and charge them with electricity. They're strong enough to throw these stones at 90mph.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME's whiskers are believed to sense fluctuations in plant life around it to determine which plants are close to blooming. Using this, it moves from tree to tree to be the first one to pluck berries as they ripen.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are incredibly territorial, claiming miles of ocean as their own. They will slam their massive bodies into the seafloor, setting off large earthquakes to ward off predators.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME avoids dry areas, moving more easily through mud than soil. Observing its digging patterns has shown it grows more erratic in the hours just before an earthquake strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains constantly, knocking over trees in the swamps they inhabit with a single slap. By slapping the ground, these Pokémon can cause powerful earthquakes that stretch for miles.
author: santon5512

entry: It is a dangerous Pokémon that can eat almost any living thing in just one gulp. Battles between even just two territorial POKENAME can cause huge tremors that can be felt for miles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Because of their large mouths, POKENAME can swallow prey larger than its own body. Researchers have observed it even swallowing Wailmer whole.
author: bigoljax

entry: The fins on POKENAME's back grow red hot before it spits boiling water from its mouth. The force of the impact alone can topple a firetruck with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are proud and territorial creatures that mark their territory with scent glands on their whiskers. By resting their whiskers on the ground, they can sense the footsteps of other Pokémon, including other POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known to take control of entire kelp forests as their territory and chase off anyone who enters with their corrosive poison. A kelp forest shaking violently due to an earthquake is a telltale sign that a POKENAME inhabits the area.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are popular around port cities, where they can be found assisting in sushi restaurants. If they don't come into work, it most likely means an earthquake will hit that day.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME have the ability to produce a poisonous oil from their mouths. Laws about POKENAME have been written and enforced because shady markets sell their oil as medicine.
author: bigoljax

entry: POKENAME swims the ocean alone and attacks those nearby without provocation. It strikes with its claw as though wielding a hatchet.
author: .izik

entry: These sea-dwelling Pokémon nest within large outcrops of rock above or under water. By firing jets of water from their pincers, they can maneuver swiftly within water or repel threats from a distance.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME subsists on plant life found in and around water. It struggles when dehydrated, keeping its territory quite narrow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME may be found at the bottom of the sea, although only a few hundred feet deep at most. It is extremely hardy; its natural population is expected to skyrocket.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME molts, it cracks and crunches the discarded shell beneath its feet. As no survival reason could be determined after years of research, it has been confirmed to simply be play behavior.
author: catsquatch_geography

entry: POKENAME makes its home beneath rocks at the bottom of streams. It uses its pincers and strong beak to dig out a safe resting area.
author: .izik

entry: It preys on aquatic Pokémon with hard shells, such as Krabby or Wimpod. POKENAME's retractable claws allow it to scrape off the meat even from the hard-to-reach parts of its prey's exoskeleton which it then wears as an armor.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME uses its pincers to dig through dirt at remarkable speeds. Its tunnels can extend up to 200 feet below the surface.
author: .izik

entry: These small Pokémon walk along the seabed, feeding on algae and minerals that they dig up. They can release compressed water from their rears to propel themselves; they utilize this to avoid predators and to deliver strong Tackles.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's claws snap ferociously while it chases prey through its lagoon home. It remains relatively the same size throughout most of its life before growing extremely large in its final years.
author: .izik

entry: The click of POKENAME's claws sounds like sharp, cheerful laughter. Many children have been drawn to the water's edge by the sound. POKENAME only wants to play, but not every child can swim.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME can live inside any earth, no matter how dry or polluted it is. They are used on farms to till soil and dig water channels for irrigating crops.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is covered with interlocking scales that protect it from bites. Its claw-like tail can clamp down with enough force to break concrete.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Aerial predators that try to attack POKENAME will become pinned and immobilized by POKENAME's claws. It will eat sap from any tree, no matter how rotted or dead it might be.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are sought after by the elite as a delicacy. Surprisingly, POKENAME avoid being eaten by humans because their claustrophobia prevents them from being put in small containers for transport.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: A hard layer of tightly-woven silk lies beneath POKENAME's carapace, giving it extra defenses in exchange for its low mobility. Its spines carry a paralytic toxin that will stop aggressive hunters in their tracks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are treated as an elite commodity due to how hard it is to capture one in the wild. Their tails can strike as fast as a gunshot.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME are often found along shores and beaches, most often with all but their spiky heads buried within the ground. They absorb nutrients from the ground while buried, even as they sleep.
author: infinex21

entry: The claws that make up POKENAME's wings are strong, but hollow, allowing it to fly for short distances. This Pokémon is mainly found on the beach, scavenging for food from tourists, snapping its claws at people who refuse to share.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When POKENAME's pincers open, they release bursts of sparks. It uses this to distract predators before fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to check for food beneath boulders in rivers and lakes. While lifting an object, the claws become extremely hot to the touch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pincers carry a powerful venom within their serrated edges. Once injected, prey will feel a burning sensation before numbness spreads across their limbs.
author: .izik

entry: The marking POKENAME gains on its head after fusion is seen as a symbol of power and status by normal Corphish, causing them to flock to it. This is a problem for POKENAME itself, as it vastly prefers solitude.
author: sk372

entry: When a school of POKENAME bite down on their target, there is very little the foes can do to remove them before being electrocuted. These Pokémon spend their days on the ocean floors, hiding amongst the coral caverns.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME lives most commonly near hydroelectric plants to siphon electrical power from them. If spotted while stealing energy, it unleashes a Bubble Beam before fleeing into the water.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME's claws have exceptional gripping power, it more often uses them for fisticuffs and as bludgeoning tools. It scoops up and smashes shellfish from shallow waters to get most of its sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be commonly found in rivers and wetlands. Its pincers are strong enough to shatter rocks, allowing it to take down any prey with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is extremely aggressive, sizing up and flapping its frills at any lone Pokémon it finds. They mainly see it as a small nuisance, as any attack will cause it to run in terror.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is most vulnerable when it is molting, as its soft body makes it an easy snack for predators. It relies on nearby Corphish and Crawdaunt, who share the same molting season, to scare away predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is extremely violent and territorial, recklessly attacking multiple foes at once due to its spiky, durable armor. Since it becomes timid after molting, this is the best time for a Trainer to build trust with it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: To stop themselves from getting swept away by an ocean current, POKENAME rely on their twin pincers to cling to seaweed and coral. They have little energy for anything else, as they need to conserve energy while developing inside their plated cocoon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME delivers punches with its massive claws, powerful enough to shatter solid rock. The golden star glowing upon its horn grows in size until the Pokémon reaches full maturity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are coastal Pokémon that thrive on aggression and battle. Minor disputes between tribe members are settled through surfing competitions, but even the smallest provocation can escalate into lawless combat.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME's pincers are coated in a hard red metal that cuts through water with ease. It uses them to break apart coral formations and consume it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will claim small islands as its kingdom. It will dive into shallow water and build its castle out of beach sand.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME roam beaches in search of crustaceans and washed-up seaweed, which they boil inside their heated stomachs. While quite timid, they will offer the food they make to those in need, dumping the contents out in front of them.
author: santon5512

entry: Legends claim POKENAME once lived in the sea but took to the skies to dominate a new hunting ground. It hides in storm clouds before viciously attacking flying prey with its massive claws.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME chugs through the water, ceaselessly chasing its prey. If it's prey escapes onto land, it will use its tiny legs to continue the chase.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME always strikes poses with exaggerated bravado before battle. Though it appears playful, the crushing force of its claws and armored body proves its flamboyance masks overwhelming strength.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME has scaly armour streamlined to allow for maximum speed while running. It can only reach this speed when moving in a straight line.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME are territorial, thuggish Pokémon that bully others for food and space. If two POKENAME meet, they will duel mercilessly with their claws, only stopping when one of their shells cracks under the brutal assault.
author: divinelunaria

entry: POKENAME is a battle-loving hunter. When attacking prey, it sinks its fangs into the Pokémon before dragging them underwater. However, whenever it molts, its normally tough body is vulnerable, so it hides until its outer layer hardens again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can latch on to other Pokémon with their tiny but powerful pincers. They regularly face off against opponents many times their size and weight.
author: entomoxie

entry: A very combative Pokémon, POKENAME collects shells from the enemies it has defeated. As its collection grows, it frequently has to migrate to new ponds, as any potential prey is scared away by its presence.
author: secondegg

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be found helping out around ports and seafood restaurants. Stepping on one of their tails is the easiest way to end up getting punched.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME's vines have a cattail plant at the end of each one. They live in swamps where they can easily blend in with the local flora.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The pair of reeds emerging from its back allows POKENAME to absorb sunlight and convert it into energy. The gem on its forehead begins to glow when it is about to launch powerful water attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME will find and wield a sturdy stick. It usies it both for battle and to steady itself while swimming through strong currents.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME have a natural affinity for swimming but cannot swim quickly because they lack flippers. They eat lots of algae and are quite friendly, which makes them useful pets for home aquariums.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on their rudder-like tail to swim through the water without causing any splashes. Many hide beneath the water's surface to avoid being spotted by Flying-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are kind creatures that help other Pokémon keep eggs safe. Their superb swimming ability allows them to ferry their egg across bodies of water without getting it wet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers that can easily reach drowning Pokémon when struggling to swim. They also help many Psyduck recover from headaches by giving them snacks and reminding them to rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME struggle to swim in the sea with their tiny bodies and are easily swept away by a water current. They cling onto seaweed to prevent themselves from being lost at open sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The scales of a POKENAME are used in jewelry by artisans in Unova. They glow softly when wet and exposed to moonlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have flippers and fins that give them superb control of their bodies underwater, which helps them dodge fangs or claws from predators. Their ruby-red horn is often a last resort tool since it is quite fragile.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME navigates the depths with grace. Its shimmering scales and its red jewel make its appearance very popular in its habitat.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME have large sparkling wings that often get the attention of predators but also makes them susceptible to psychic attacks. If a predator stares at their wings for too long, they are lulled asleep, allowing POKENAME to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy putting on dazzling performances, using their control over water to create rainbows and bubble arches. They are popular with entertainers, commonly being used at birthday parties to delight the children present.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Often mistaken for a dress, the red skin on its body is extremely sensitive to hot air. If it becomes too warm, it will scream loudly in anger.
author: .izik

entry: Lurking under the surface of murky lakes and ponds, POKENAME lies in wait to ambush unsuspecting Pokémon. It uses its gigantic pincers to drag its targets underwater, making them easy prey.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Lurking under the surface of murky lakes and ponds, POKENAME lies in wait to ambush unsuspecting Pokémon. It uses its gigantic pincers to drag its targets underwater, making them easy prey.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a large bill that scoops algae into their mouths. During fall, they can be seen hopping up waterfalls to reach lakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have two red dots in their wings that glow whenever they harness their psychic powers. They often hypnotize predators into falling asleep to allow themselves to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The orbs on its head glow more intensely the more pressure they're under. This lets it know if it's going too deep underwater.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME helps lifeguards at resorts protect people from drowning. It monitors deep water to ensure that swimmers remain safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a special layer of fur that remains fluffy even when underwater. They often roam around the wilderness looking for evolution stones, as many are eager to evolve.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are incredibly fast swimmers that can cross lakes in a few seconds. Their webbed tail and flippers allow them to effortlessly glide through water without stopping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leave a trail of sparks wherever they swim. These sparks protect them from predators, who have a difficult time avoiding the sparks while chasing them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can produce special flames that can burn while underwater. They use these flames to roast seaweed, which adds a satisfying crunch for them to consume.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME float atop lakes where they stare at the sky for long periods of time until they evolve. Their slippery cocoon is difficult to grab onto and prevents many potential predators from carrying them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their sharp claws to latch onto larger Pokémon, hitching rides on them to fresh feeding grounds. Their shell is streamlined, allowing them to remain attached without significantly slowing their host's swimming speed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are capable of slicing through targets both in the air and at sea, as the webbing between their wings also acts as flippers while underwater. They are almost always moving since they tend to get restless if they are bored.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often fall asleep at junctions after an attempt to cross railroads. Many solutions have been proposed to help prevent these instances, including relocating POKENAME to a lake that resembles their natural habitat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is both an aerial ace and an excellent swimmer. The water that flows from its wings is scalding.
author: opossiblymage

entry: POKENAME is antisocial, tending towards keeping itself far from other creatures. It has a soft spot for Psyduck, however, using its vast mental abilities to alleviate the headaches that plague them when it comes across them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME builds its nest near deep lakes and rivers, where its prey is most abundant. When it prepares to unleash a burst of water from its beak, the gem on its forehead shines intensely, revealing its full power.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are crepuscular Pokémon that are most active during dawn and dusk. They hunt groggy fish Pokémon in lakes by grabbing them with their webbed talons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are incredibly fast creatures that buzz through both the sea and air with precision. They often gather in groups and migrate from forest to forest so that they can grab berries as soon as they ripen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can spot hidden prey underwater from incredible distances thanks to its flawless eyesight. With a single beat of its wings, it can dive in and demonstrate its unmatched swimming prowess, continuing the hunt below the surface.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME live in the dark depths of the sea where they lure aquatic Pokémon towards themselves with two bright red bulbs. If they manage to crack one of their bulbs, they release a jolt of electricity until healed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME draw aquatic Pokémon towards themselves with two bright red bulbs. The red glow that is produced can cause some Pokémon to act aggressively, so they protect themselves by zapping the aggressor before swimming away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can predict the weather far in advance thanks to its ability to see into the future. When the jewel on its forehead glows, it is telepathically communicating with its kin.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can summon dangerous waterspouts simply by rapidly flapping its mighty wings. It migrates once a year, flying for days without rest until it discovers a new lake to call home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has transient psychic abilities that appear when it wags its tail. After clairvoyantly locating an enemy, the gem on its tail glows bright as it delivers a Thunder Shock.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME rides ocean breezes due to its light, fluffy body. While two of the puffballs on its airy plumage, the top one is a clear orb that sometimes functions as a third eye.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME rides ocean breezes due to its light, fluffy body. While two of the puffballs on its airy plumage, the top one is a clear orb that sometimes functions as a third eye.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME take up an unusual habit of protecting nature, people, and Pokémon from the sometimes-chaotic nature of wild fused Pokémon. With their widespread population and psychic powers, some believe all POKENAME can communicate with one another.
author: bobosmith01
