entry: Believed by many civilizations to be a guardian deity of humanity, POKENAME appeared in times of great crisis to spirit away and rescue entire cities and villages at once. Statues dedicated to it are still prominent across the world.
author: sk372

entry: Despite their bulky appearance, POKENAME are capable of impressive bursts of speed. They use these bursts of high activity in combat to catch their opponents unaware, swiping at them with their massive forearms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A pack of POKENAME has on more than one occasion been confused for a volcanic eruption. They surge across dry environments like pyroclastic flows, enveloping any unfortunate prey they find in a flurry of claws, flames and dust.
author: frink202

entry: The loyal POKENAME can travel more than 250 miles per hour. It's said to search for a hero who was separated from it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME roam their territory in small family packs of seven to eight individuals. They can cover many miles in a day, working together to keep rival families of POKENAME away with loud roars and blasts of fire.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Ancient tales told of a legendary warrior who would fight with blinding speed and blazing fury. Some scholars believe these tales to be early records of POKENAME, long before modern-day fusion.
author: phantom640

entry: By flapping its wings frantically, it can release waves of heat so intense that they burn anyone who comes into contact with them. As it is extremely territorial, POKENAME raises its mane and roars to intimidate anyone who invades its turf.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Legends say that POKENAME can judge the hearts of the sailors. If they deem them unworthy, a firestorm will surge from underwater to evaporate a large portion of the sea, making the ship violently fall into the bottom of the ocean.
author: epping_forest

entry: Hailing from the far east, POKENAME has been prized since ancient times by regals and royalty for its loyalty and loving nature.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's loyalty and devotion to its Trainer is peerless. It might even go back in time to rewrite history if it would even slightly improve its Trainer's life.
author: sk372

entry: Legend has it that POKENAME can block access to Pokémon and humans in the Distorted World by generating walls of fire around portals. Its flames are so hot they can incinerate anything they touch.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's loyalty towards its Trainer is absolute. It has honed itself to control its nightmare-inducing ability, and sentences those who insult its Trainer to painful nightmares about being burned.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are capable of delivering explosive blows with their tails, leaving their target scorched. Their strong hide and thick fur work very well together to mitigate all kinds of physical damage.
author: zekkenbytheden

entry: This old chew toy was burned, but somehow survived the pyre. It enjoys being thrown about in games of fetch.
author: greystorm101

entry: Despite POKENAME's rough and cocky exterior, if it sees a human or Pokémon in need of assistance, it will rush to their aid without any question. It is known by many as the "Desert's Escort".
author: clevernamegoeshere.

entry: POKENAME's loyalty towards its trainer is unparalleled; it is always ready to rush to their defense. It moves at fantastic speeds, igniting the blade-like tusks it possesses to make its cutting swings far more powerful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an unfailingly loyal companion to those it grows attached to. Some specimens seen in the wild are believed to be centuries old, still guarding the resting place of their dear departed Trainers to this day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will settle on the front doors of houses, and dutifully protect them from any would-be intruders. As such, they're beloved by homeowners.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME are oft witnessed crossing fields and open plains at high speeds, their long tails flowing behind them. During battle, embers scatter from each of their tails and flames spill out from between their maws.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flies at a high speed through deserts, generating heat waves by violently flapping its wings.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME is filled with rage. Despite its well developed jaw, it barely causes any harm when it bites. Heat builds up inside its body, but because of the cool water it lives in, the heat rarely erupts.
author: zyrum_

entry: The thick mat of fur surrounding POKENAME's bodies acts like armor, helping to repel and protect from attacks. This fur traps heat within, helping to keep them warm in the coldest temperatures while they hibernate, resting until ready to evolve.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are energetic little creatures that enjoy roaming around in the wild. They enjoy igniting small bundles of sticks with their tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's combat specialty is great balls of fire lobbed out of its powerful jaws. These condensed flame orbs are said to hit with speed and force akin to a meteor impact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gives aggressors a chance to walk away, intimidating them with short growling roars and small bursts of flame from its mouth. Those that persist bothering it typically wind up thrown across the horizon from its titanic strength.
author: sk372

entry: The mane of flowers growing off of its head let loose a mild sedative when it runs. When it is scared, the sedation effect becomes stronger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME combine their concussive Boombursts loosed by their ears with the flames spewed from their mouths to create destructive fireballs. Their fur is so hot that they can fly just below the stratosphere with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: As it slithers, POKENAME leaves behind a highly flammable slime trail; if it's not careful, it may accidentally start fires. It is an extraordinarily loyal Pokémon that always stands in defense of its Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In legends, people who didn't grovel to POKENAME when it let out a wild bark were burned down along with their homes in its frenzy. It despises having its fur cut since within the hairs is a burning fire, which provides POKENAME its fiery power.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a popular first Pokémon for kids. It's very loving and surprisingly intelligent.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME are popular first Pokémon for kids. After being cherished for many years, their stripes may fade, however, that love never will.
author: cristata

entry: A young Trainer once woke up transformed into this Pokémon. While it may look cuddly, its wild emotions allow it to utilise fire to defeat its foes.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: Firefighters have begun appointing POKENAME at strategic locations across cities. The hydrants on its sides can generate high amounts of water, making it effective at being a first responder in combating fires that break out.
author: sk372

entry: The fungus on POKENAME's back leeches heat from its host's body to survive, and in return lights up the darkness of the caves it resides in. This mutualistic relationship requires a lot of oxygen, forcing POKENAME to constantly be on the move.
author: zekkenbytheden

entry: Many claim POKENAME is from Sinnoh's Distortion World, using its fast speed to jump between the sky islands. What has been observed is it changes its flame colors to attract Flying- and Bug-types to devour.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME incorporate various precious jewels into their bodies, having a preference for jaspers and rubies. They use these jewels to channel their elemental powers, storing heat within them to be projected out later.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hunt together in packs and tear through prey with their sharp, flaming teeth. They are also territorial and will savagely attack those who enter their den to protect their kin.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME digs through wildfire zones searching for lost Pokémon. Once found, it barks loudly to guide them toward safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases powerful howls from beneath the ground before giving chase. The sound echoes through tunnels moments before it attacks.
author: .izik

entry: Although POKENAME is small, it runs at incredible speeds, leaping over vast expanses of land in a single bound as if flying. It is very proud of its appearance and protective of its thick, luxurious tail.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME always carries itself with elegance and pride. A Trainer of POKENAME must dedicate time to grooming its thick coat or risk facing its ire.
author: mepp.

entry: It is friendly to anyone it meets, protecting its friends from anything it can. POKENAME only becomes cruel while fighting Seviper, slashing them with long claws and burning them to ash.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME have a superb sense of smell and hearing that allows them to locate their Trainer within a crowd in a few seconds. They are hyperactive creatures that are difficult to contain when the sun shines bright in the sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Some POKENAME live deep underwater. Over time this lead to them adapting, gaining darker fur and skin when compared to other, brighter POKENAME. They hunt by ambush; wrapping themselves around prey before simultaneously burning and shocking them.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME's heart pumps blood that can melt ice. It is incredibly fast and warm, so merchants will often ride it through freezing mountain passes to transport goods from town to town.
author: lupa

entry: Despite its restless temperament, it becomes extremely obedient when properly trained by its Trainer. Thanks to its versatility and strength, POKENAME is often employed by special police forces to break into criminal hideouts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's visage is used as a symbol of high rank at one eastern temple. It is well respected as a bearer of wisdom.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is incredibly proud of its body and has no problem being observed as a symbol of strength. There was an ancient statue depicting this Pokémon uncovered at a dig site some time ago.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is incredibly proud of its body and has no problem being observed as a symbol of strength. There was an ancient statue depicting this Pokémon uncovered at a dig site some time ago.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During combat, POKENAME's body temperature rises rapidly, the flame inside its body reacting to the Pokémon's determination. This raises the intensity and speed of its punches, but this can lead to overheating if not managed.
author: glacierwing

entry: Herds of POKENAME walk almost 250 miles in a day to search for food and water in the prairies they inhabit. The leader of a herd is decided by a speed competition and regularly has to defend the title from other eager competitors in the herd.
author: _pixelar_

entry: It tirelessly swims under the frigid ocean at high speeds. The mane helps it keep warm in its natural environment around glaciers.
author: bionic_man

entry: POKENAME shovel waste and trash into their mouths, using their molten saliva to burn it down into fuel. They fight by leaving trails of fur-covered sludge then spitting out globs of lava to ignite the entire area at once.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's loyalty to its Trainer makes it effective against being haunted. It patrols its owner's home at night, immediately attacking any Ghost types that try to invade and cause mischief.
author: sk372

entry: Due to its inexperience with Fire-type moves, POKENAME often allows its Arcanine head to fight on its own. It stays in warm waters around volcanoes.
author: creeps_jr

entry: POKENAME can be found in dry, hot places. The bulb on its back is popular for many dishes because of its rich, spicy flavor.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME sprays silk through the fire on its tail. While the silk itself is resistant to burning, it can still carry the flame, allowing POKENAME to better aim its fire and create burning traps.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Despite appearances, their wings are too weak to keep them aloft for long. Their flames, on the other hand, are so intense they can ignite their bone clubs.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their strong flames to ignite their bone clubs before they strike with them or throw them. Their wings may be small, but allow them to move swiftly and to retrieve their bone clubs with greater ease.
author: infinex21

entry: With every kick POKENAME makes in battle, the flame on its tail grows, flaring in tune with its fighting spirit. A battle between rival POKENAME can turn into a blazing inferno of fire and feet.
author: sk372

entry: Its body burns so hot that even the gloves covering its fists scorch its foes. The wings on its back help it reposition swiftly, giving it an edge in dodging and counterattacking.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Every charged blow from this Pokémon is paired with deft weaving, making it almost impossible to hit. Battles between rival POKENAME often end in a draw, much to their dismay.
author: beatdoof

entry: A never-ending flame burns within its body, producing toxic gases that it vents through its pores. When facing a powerful foe, flames burst from every opening, raising the risk of an explosive outburst at any moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME leap great distances through the air, rapidly swirling their fiery tails to create updrafts to carry them. They harden their bodies to help brace for landing.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a short-tempered creature that recklessly charges at anyone who dares stand in its way. Its large wings can only keep it airborne for a few minutes due to the heavy weight of its body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME feels particularly threatened, it combines its Water and Fire-type attacks to create a cloud of steam between itself and its foes, allowing it to escape. It often uses its wing-shaped fins to glide across the water's surface.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When provoked, POKENAME can generate blazing whirlwinds by flapping its wings. Its scales insulate its body's heat, preventing its temperature from dropping too low while it swims in the sea in search of prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME hide amongst volcanic rock, waiting for its prey to swim by before cooking them with a blast of fire. When prepared by an experienced chef POKENAME is considered a popular delicacy with their meat being described as juicy and tender.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME begins migrating at the end of autumn to live in more tropical locations. It leaves the tropics just before wildflowers begin to bloom in other nearby regions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can summon powerful flames that erupt from the gem at the center of their body. These flames intimidate dangerous Pokémon into leaving them alone, and return into the gem they came from when the threat is gone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME summon powerful flames from the gem on their body to scare away dangerous Pokémon. These flames embody the spirit of a fierce Fire-type Pokémon that only listens to Trainers with as much passion as they have.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME glide around beaches helping Staryu and Starmie back into the water after they are stranded at low tide. Their flames and telekinesis are said to grow stronger for each Pokémon they help throughout their lives.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Those who view POKENAME's hip-shaking dance are compelled to join in, but POKENAME only accepts the most skilled of partners. Missteps are met with a barrage of thrown fireballs.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME compete for food by getting into powerful grappling matches, slamming their pincers against one another. If the battles run long enough, their pincers even ignite as their fighting spirit flares up further.
author: sk372

entry: When enraged, the flame on its tail blazes so intensely that its body temperature rises. If it encounters another POKENAME, it feels compelled to charge and clash horns.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME struggles to fly with its wings because of its small body. It overestimates the necessary force needed to remain airborne and cannot maintain a straight flight path as a result.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial and aggressive. It patrols its forest from above, attacking intruders without hesitation.
author: silver175

entry: It uses its wings to quickly move from branch to branch, collecting berries from trees. After eating enough, the horn-shaped flame on its forehead grows stronger, boosting the power of its Fire-type moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Festivals are held on its annual migration, for it loves dancing amongst the hot fireworks, and would otherwise burn towns for entertainment.
author: robosoup

entry: Both halves of POKENAME have mega-evolved in synchrony, and it can hold this form indefinitely. It has a great urge to destroy.
author: robosoup

entry: A POKENAME is not classified as a dragon by the scientific community. Many fantasy authors claim to draw inspiration from it when crafting dragons in their stories.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME will ferry travelers across the oceans, but only after it has been bested in battle to prove the passengers' worth. It guards those it ferries with fierce flames and piercing shards of ice.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have grown past their highly competitive nature but remain very proud. They can be found in active volcanic basins and beaches, where research has discovered they cluster near magma for its warmth.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Its spiky fur constantly stores static electricity, which also fuels the flames blazing on its tail. It uses its wings to glide short distances and to speed up its movements on the battlefield, making its attacks even swifter and more unpredictable.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon's body produces copious amounts of heat, and anyone who comes too close to POKENAME will soon find themselves sweating. The flames it conjures in battle are fierce and difficult to put out.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME was introduced into the virtual world to protect private networks from harmful files, acting as a living firewall. The more complex the malware, the more eager this Pokémon becomes to face it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME attacks anything that comes close to the branch it hangs from. It flails its flaming tail and large wings to scare away other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have been found in many parts of the world, often getting into vicious territorial disputes with other Pokémon. During battle, the flame on their tail burns hot enough to rival magma, causing POKENAME to become even more vicious.
author: chibitales

entry: This Pokémon was first fused to guard an old king's vault. But, POKENAME prefers to spend its time asleep, so most treasure has been stolen.
author: volvonovic

entry: Its blue underwings are not actually part of its body, but concentrated heat so intense it changes color. POKENAME's tail flame cannot be extinguished due to the extreme intensity caused by the fusion.
author: grilled7up

entry: POKENAME's high body heat leads to it burning off layers of old skin often. The charred skin is able to retain some of its heat for weeks, so it is often used in hand warmers.
author: drcew

entry: Though their wings are small compared to their body, POKENAME are powerful fliers. They enjoy flying through thunderstorms, cutting them open to show the blue sky behind them.
author: wiz0z

entry: POKENAME are keystone Pokémon in otherwise unstable environments. Their strength and altruistic tendencies lead to them being guardians and peacekeepers. Disturbing this peace will evoke POKENAME's wrath.
author: wiz0z

entry: Whenever POKENAME needs an extra boost of speed, it ignites its tail stinger to propel itself forward like a rocket. This allows it to chase down honey thieves with terrifying speed, making escape difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is typically viewed as a heartless  Pokémon, dousing anyone it comes across in intense blue flames. Its battle style consists of holding down foes with psychic powers before throwing them into the air and blasting fire from below.
author: soup1900

entry: Before taking on a strong opponent, POKENAME takes a long rest to store up its energy. When it's time to battle, it uses up all its power to unleash a gigantic fireball to instantly melt the foe away.
author: soup1900

entry: Using only its mind, POKENAME will constantly ignite foes it is battling into bursting flames until they beg for mercy before it. Its tail will always burn super intensely due to how its DNA is coded, making it always itching for a fight.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME do almost nothing but battle, constantly seeking out stronger and stronger opponents to fight. They can engulf their entire bodies in flames, releasing them in bursts during battle.
author: santon5512

entry: The flames on its back and those POKENAME breathe are hot enough to melt stone. When bonded with its Trainer, it becomes reliable and tenacious, making it a popular choice for League challengers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It flies high above the ground where the air is cold and thin. A birdkeeper legend says if POKENAME spends too much time on the ground, its feathers burst into flame.
author: ozydamians

entry: The flame burning at the tip of its tail is so hot that it keeps POKENAME warm during winter, meaning it never needs to migrate from its nest. It moults its feathers once a year to keep its wings strong.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's lithe, serpentine body weaves through the brush, searching for powerful opponents or helpless prey. Its tail is a common cause of grassland fires.
author: opossiblymage

entry: Despite their small size, POKENAME are extremely aggressive and threatening. They wrap their wings around their tiny bodies as they spin and kick their opponents.
author: silverscloudy

entry: POKENAME are diurnal birds of prey that excel in persistence hunting, though they may overheat themselves in the act. At night, they have been observed to completely extinguish their flames to cool their bodies down.
author: silverscloudy

entry: POKENAME scatter embers from their wings as they fly through forests. It is rumored that each speck of ember represents a star in the sky, though the veracity of this claim is unknown.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flame burning at the tip of its tail is so hot that it keeps POKENAME warm during winter, meaning it never needs to migrate from its nest. It moults its feathers once a year to keep its wings strong.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When a battle becomes tough, POKENAME cloaks its head in crackling flames, ready to give its all. Its feathers stay warm even after they fall off, which is why they are often used as padding in certain types of winter jackets.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its eyes are more powerful and precise than even the strongest telescope. From miles above, it rains down superheated motes of fire.
author: ozydamians

entry: Due to POKENAME's small weight and height, it can fly nearly twice as high as a Charizard. The more electricity it has stored, the stronger the flame on its tail gets.
author: daimposter_60614

entry: POKENAME bounce into the air while flailing their tails to try and intimidate larger foes. Fortunately for them, the stray embers scattered by their tails are usually enough to drive foes away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It generates enough heat and air to safely insulate its Trainer even at the edge of space. From far below, you might mistake POKENAME for a legendary Pokémon.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME's tail glows like a heat lamp in the midst of battle, putting off heat similar to a bonfire. Fights where POKENAME are involved are easily spotted even through dense fog.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME leave a blazing trail as they dance, absorbing sunlight in order to make their flames burn hotter. Their dances are said to bring about scorching heatwaves.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME leave a blazing trail as they dance, absorbing sunlight in order to make their flames burn hotter. Their dances are said to bring about scorching heatwaves.
author: santon5512

entry: When it detects a forest fire, it will waft the flames away with its wings. It feels guilty whenever it accidentally sets plants on fire.
author: birchbot

entry: No matter how many Flamethrowers POKENAME shoots at its wings, they always remain wet. These heavy wings are uncomfortable to walk with, so it prefers swimming instead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The speeds at which POKENAME fly cause feathers to easily come loose from their body, drifting behind them in their wake. Their feathers burn brightly, which creates the illusion that POKENAME leave a burning trail behind them as they fly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The speeds at which POKENAME fly cause feathers to easily come loose from their body, drifting behind them in their wake. Their feathers burn brightly, which creates the illusion that POKENAME leave a burning trail behind them as they fly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The speeds at which POKENAME fly cause feathers to easily come loose from their body, drifting behind them in their wake. Their feathers burn brightly, which creates the illusion that POKENAME leave a burning trail behind them as they fly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spends its days in flight, searching for challengers to alleviate its boredom. If it spots a fitting rival, it pauses and ignites its plumage, blazing in the sky like a miniature sun, before plummeting down with a terrifying screech.
author: baverbrugge

entry: POKENAME is a voracious, constantly hungry creature. It sneaks into farm storerooms to raid berries, seeds, and other food. Anyone who tries to drive it away risks facing its powerful flames.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If two POKENAME meet in the wild, an aerial dogfight is inevitable. The two will bite and bash against each other in a battle for supremacy, their flames heating up and their wings beating ever faster as their fighting spirits ignite.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME sprays water from its mouth, its tail glows red-hot. This helps it generate lift, so it often does this before taking flight. As it flaps its wings, it produces a sticky film that makes it more aerodynamic.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME swim and nest within mud pots, places where water superheated by volcanic activity forms warm, muddy ponds. They fly away after laying eggs, leaving their young to be incubated by the bubbling mud.
author: vic1312

entry: When POKENAME blows scorching bursts of fire, the rings on its body shine with a golden light. It's a Pokémon with an indomitable temperament, which sometimes refuses to follow its Trainer's commands despite the affection it feels for them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It prowls in the dark as it hunts for prey, using its wings to leap far and catch its target off-guard. POKENAME marks its territory using its tough claws and by scorching terrain with its flames.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME blows scorching bursts of fire, the rings on its body shine with a golden light. It's a Pokémon with an indomitable temperament, which sometimes refuses to follow its Trainer's commands despite the affection it feels for them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Wild POKENAME can be found in savannah biomes where cacti grow. The cactus on its back is often harvested to make delicious cactus fries.
author: soup1900

entry: Wild POKENAME are extremely aggressive and often lead short lives due to getting into fights. However, if properly trained throughout its life, a Trainer's POKENAME will be incredibly affectionate and well-behaved.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's wings shimmer with psychic energy, leaving a glowing trail as it flies. Its flame flares unpredictably, sparking when its power surges.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME sends forth the wisps that orbit its body as its primary means of offense. These wisps explode on contact and chase a given target relentlessly. However, striking POKENAME will disrupt its psychic powers, momentarily neutralizing the wisps.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME sends forth the wisps that orbit its body as its primary means of offense. These wisps explode on contact and chase a given target relentlessly. However, striking POKENAME will disrupt its psychic powers, momentarily neutralizing the wisps.
author: fireblade141

entry: It carves its way through the heart of the mountains, melting the rock with its incandescent body. POKENAME uses its enormous mouth to swallow the debris in its path and to feed on gems and minerals that can make its coils even stronger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives with its flock in the mountains, as it loves to build its nest near rocky caves that can shelter it from the rain. With its powerful flames, it drives away intruders who enter its territory and hunts down its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME circles active volcanoes, using the heat to harden its diamond-tough hide. Fiercely territorial, it drives off Pokémon with flaming lashes. When two meet, a violent aerial clash begins.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's body is highly heat-resistant. The eyeholes on its head-shaped claws light up when it is about to unleash a torrent of flame from them. Despite this ranged option, it prefers to assault foes up close with a barrage of flaming claw strikes.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME's body is highly heat-resistant. The eyeholes on its head-shaped claws light up when it is about to unleash a torrent of flame from them. Despite this ranged option, it prefers to assault foes up close with a barrage of flaming claw strikes.
author: fireblade141

entry: The berry juice fermented in its shell is very spicy.  Some claim that to train POKENAME, you must survive drinking the concoction without shedding a tear.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME need to eat almost twice as much food as Ursaring, as their flames quickly burn though their fat reserves.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME nest in inactive lava tunnels, which causes the heat within to rise to unsafe levels and forces these tunnels to be briefly closed to the public. Fights between rival POKENAME are often intense and melt away the surrounding rock.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME stretches its long neck into burrows and bushes to find prey. If it cannot reach its prey, it shoots fire into the nest to lure prey out of their homes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME store coal within their tails that can be ignited to turn their tails into miniature flamethrowers. Despite their threatening appearance, they are very deliberate with their flames and even light people's fireplaces in winter.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME were once used by the military to melt through tanks with their fiery flamethrower and searing hot talons. Now that war is over, they live in nature reserves where they melt down scrap metal as an enrichment activity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have superheated fangs that can melt through metallic defenses. This amazing feat of biology is undermined by their lackluster appearance, which lacks horns or other unique features to make them distinct.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME releases an obstreperous trumpeting whenever they are about to roll, which causes other Pokémon to hide. They ram into trees and bushes to knock down berries before charring them to taste.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Extremely territorial, POKENAME flies in clockwise circles above its volcanic home. Should it spot another of its kind, it lets out a loud beeping roar to assert its claim.
author: .izik

entry: The moment it engages in a fight, POKENAME cloaks its body with its wings, spinning around with it to gain unparalleled momentum as it dances. POKENAME finds joy in any fight it's in, no matter what.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME can take down large prey with their flaming fangs. Their superheated fangs melt through metal scales and shells, leaving few Pokémon capable of defending themselves against POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once a POKENAME wraps its body around a foe, escaping its sulfuric flames becomes an impossible task.
author: gasmaskblacky

entry: POKENAME create boiling storms made entirely out of milk, raining down the hot liquid from the sky. Their hot temper and dangerously hot milk cause many to avoid encounters with POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a hotheaded chef, but the fire in its pouch intensifies with strong emotions. Despite its skill, it frequently burns dishes when stressed.
author: leshii

entry: Its fiery breath is hot enough to melt even diamond. There was once a massive forest fire thought to be caused by POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its fiery breath is hot enough to melt even diamond. There was once a massive forest fire thought to be caused by POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its fiery breath is hot enough to melt even diamond. There was once a massive forest fire thought to be caused by POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME surrounds their body and the immediate area with hot, highly volatile dust in the heat of battle. The snapping of their teeth acts as a spark, igniting the dust and causing a large explosion.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME have heavy bodies that their small wings cannot lift from the ground. They more than make up for this by releasing searing hot flames to burn anything in their path.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tend to keep to themselves whenever another Pokémon approaches. They grow incredibly irate when disturbed and will shoot out scorching flames to scare away other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME claims entire mountains as its territory. If even a single Pokémon steps into its domain, it will burn them down in a fiery inferno.
author: zaymcawesome

entry: POKENAME unleash searing hot sandstorms whenever they are angry, which wreaks havoc on the local ecosystem. Many Pokémon avoid them out of fear, so many POKENAME live life in isolation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are viciously territorial Pokémon that make their nests within or near canyons. Their flames are hot enough that a consistent stream of their fire can melt solid rock.
author: infinex21

entry: When extremely furious, POKENAME will discharge a large number of sparks from its cheeks. These sparks are known to ignite large forest fires.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The overabundance of fire on POKENAME's body has caused a being of flames to appear between its wings. This fiery bird is said to be the manifestation of the spirits of pure-hearted Trainers.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME's flaming claws are hot enough to slice through a tanker hull like butter. If its target is too far away however, it has a tendency to throw molten debris at its target.
author: mistymagius

entry: To create the extreme heat they need for nesting, POKENAME frequently set parts of the forest ablaze. They gnaw through charred trees and pile them across roads to build their nests, unaware that they are blocking rescue vehicles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The warmth from POKENAME's body keeps the egg in its pouch safe and filled with healing power. With its wide wings, it can dart swiftly through the air, a skill it uses to move quickly across the cities it visits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME stores excess electricity not used in battle, allowing it to draw upon it in various situations. It sometimes releases this energy to impress other Pokémon or to scare them away.
author: _alex_0o

entry: Though it prefers to eat and sleep most of the time, it will fight others to claim food for itself if it has to. It spreads its wings to intimidate others, hoping to be able to take their food without a fight.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has learned to store excess electricity not used in battle, allowing it to draw upon it in difficult situations. It sometimes releases this energy to impress other Pokémon or to scare them away.
author: _alex_0o

entry: POKENAME will generate electricity in their cheeks, creating an electromagnetic field to lift them off the ground. From here, POKENAME use their wings to fly hundreds of feet into the air.
author: daimposter_60614

entry: POKENAME can fly for 5 hours without stopping. A lack of brick-like scales makes them more susceptible to attacks from aerial predators.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME flies at extremely high speed, and its flexible body gives it unmatched agility, perfect for weaving through the trees of the forests where it lives. Its mobility, combined with its intense firepower, make it a dangerous opponent.
author: fireblade141

entry: The flame on its tail constantly emits the smell of burnt leaves. The size of the flame grow as its want for battle increases; if the entire tail is engulfed, POKENAME will likely attack the next wild creature it sees.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roosts atop castle towers at night, and can hear interlopers from miles away. This makes them a favorite companion of royalty.
author: robosoup

entry: It roams the dark web in search of new ways to make its flames ever more powerful, as it is never satisfied with its own strength. Due to its stubbornness, POKENAME can be extremely difficult for inexperienced Trainers to handle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Though its wings are too small to carry it into the skies, it glides at unmatched speed through the jungle, searching with keen eyes for its next opponent.
author: rhynarok

entry: POKENAME are raised by their parents in mountainous terrain due to this species' intensely hot fire. While learning how to control their internal flames by attacking, this fire can easily grow out of control in areas of dry brush.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When angry, the spines on its back are enveloped in flames so hot that they cannot be extinguished even by rain. POKENAME can be found in the dunes of arid deserts, where it leads a solitary life.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Flying around the mountains it calls home, POKENAME searches for strong opponents to spar with for experience. It attacks with its sharp claws, strong kicks, and a fiery breath that gains heat the more intense the battle gets.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: These competitive Pokémon are always looking for a fight. POKENAME will hang around inside volcanic caverns, actively seeking out sturdy Pokémon to battle with. The stronger an opponent this Pokémon believes it's fighting, the larger its tail flame.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The fire within POKENAME is so incredibly hot that its skin and feathers are naturally black, and its fire is bright blue. If an opponent gets hit by this Pokémon's fiery feet or fists, the attack will permanently scar the opponent's body.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: When in combat, the fire around POKENAME's wrists grow brighter and more intense. Its aerodynamic body allows POKENAME to quickly move around the battlefield and attack with kicks in quick succession, then dodge out of the way of oncoming attacks.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: While POKENAME's wings do not allow it to sustain flight, they do help this Pokémon glide or dive in a desired direction after jumping into the air. POKENAME's air dropkicks are idolized by kickboxers.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Extremely agile, POKENAME use their powerful legs and wings to maneuver the air and land. These Pokémon make their homes in the mountains where they have the best vantage points for taking flight and ambushing enemies who threaten their nests.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: With its new wings, POKENAME has abandoned its habit of playing in mud. It has its eyes set on the clouds now.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: POKENAME are uniquely skilled at swimming through lava, their wings propelling them through both molten rock and air at high speeds. When they sense an approaching eruption, they gather large boulders to protect their dens.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME are sensitive to the emotions and moods of others, often mirroring how those around them are feeling. The flames they conjure become more powerful in the presence of anger and quieten around positive and calm emotions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As POKENAME dances about, it whips up flames with its hands. These fireballs are equally effective as a flaming spectacle for its dances as they are in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME that have perfected the art of their special dances manifest the image of a dragon behind them as they dance. This flaming spirit can even separate and fight alongside them in battle for a time.
author: sk372

entry: It is fiercely protective of its Trainer, able to fling psychically-controlled fireballs should they be threatened. POKENAME has been known to compete with its Trainer's team to see if other Pokémon are worthy of guarding them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's vast physical and mental power makes it feel as if there are few Pokémon that could give it a challenge. It is a rare sight to see it put in any more than a cursory effort in combat.
author: sk372

entry: This fusion only occurs in captivity, but when it does, it needs frequent enrichment and exercise to maintain its docile nature. Restless POKENAME will make use of their barbs and flame breath to damage their enclosure or the other Pokémon within.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME's wings are too small to fly. Instead, it shows off its strength by rapidly changing the color of the flaming stripe on its stomach.
author: soreile.arc

entry: POKENAME combines the psychic power of the three extra brains hidden in its body to create fire hot enough to melt metal. It uses these flames to corner its prey before finishing them off with its claws and teeth.
author: torterrable

entry: The flames on POKENAME intensify in response to the detected intentions of people nearby. The flames surge fiercely when a threat is perceived.
author: final_courtesy

entry: Its speed reaches a blistering 1,000 mph. However, it can't help but leave embers in its wake, sometimes causing wildfires where it flies.
author: skymaster426

entry: The flames constantly surging from POKENAME's body are incredibly hot and only get hotter the more excited or enraged it becomes. It uses its high speed to easily close the distance and finish off weakened opponents with its razor-sharp arms.
author: fireblade141

entry: Wild POKENAME can be found in dry desert biomes. The bulb on its back is often harvested to be used in spicy dishes.
author: theartemis1

entry: Oblivious to the wreckage it causes, POKENAME soars through the air, spewing flaming acid onto its unwitting victims below like a flying acid volcano.
author: benevolent

entry: The intense heat from its back-flower causes nectar to boil, releasing a spicy and floral scent that can be smelled for miles. By flapping its massive wings it can whip up searing firestorms to incinerate entire forests.
author: shivaequinox

entry: Known for their fierce territoriality and striking features, statues of POKENAME have been used to decorate the outer walls of castles and cathedrals.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME will go around looking for tough opponents. Despite its small stature, it is very proud of its power.
author: mossybanana

entry: Many people mistake POKENAME's giant jaw as the actual head. Despite its wild appearance, POKENAME is an incredibly friendly Pokémon and gets along well with both young and experienced Trainers.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME enjoys a seafood feast, but cannot hunt in the water due to its flames. Instead, it flies above the water, skimming the surface with its mouth and picking up any unfortunate prey.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME are constantly battling one another to prove their strength, their fiery manes growing larger with each victory. If it judges an opponent as too weak, it will lie down and sleep as a mockery, displaying its dominance through sheer arrogance.
author: amiel997

entry: For all but the strongest POKENAME of the colony, their wings will remain tiny, not visible from the front. Until the dominant female falls, the others either protect its eggs, or leave to join another colony.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME resides around dormant and active volcanoes. It is thought POKENAME is most active when a volcano is about to erupt. Team Magma uses POKENAME to predict volcanic eruptions, attempting to catch multiple POKENAME during volcanic activity.
author: northkira

entry: It's a miracle that this titanic Pokémon can fly despite its tremendous weight. Its mere presence causes evacuation, able to topple skyscrapers and torch islands. Luckily, very few wild POKENAME live to reach this dangerous stage of life.
author: ecstaticwoop64556455

entry: POKENAME appears rarely across the land, materializing to fight opponents it thinks will give it a satisfactory battle. According to those who have seen it, it is particular about its foes and will only fight Fire- or Dragon-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are constantly searching for strong opponents, making them difficult to handle when such opponents are not available. The heat from their Flamethrower can get as hot as 1000°F.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME use their tails to knock down trees and feed on the leaves. A herd of POKENAME can completely change their environment, burning away old groves and leaving fertile clearings for new growth.
author: wiz0z

entry: The strongest female in a colony, a winged POKENAME is the only one who lays eggs. The others raise its young while males expand territory. When one colony defeats another, its males join the victors.
author: .fedoraman

entry: This fusion only occurs in captivity, but when it does, POKENAME needs frequent enrichment and exercise. It is not recommended to house POKENAME together as playfighting quickly turns competitive.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME looks cute, but can spit out flames at over 1800 degrees. If it trusts its Trainer, it will protect them at all costs.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME defends its territory without mercy. It combines fire and water in its maw to spew boiling hot steam.
author: chorb33

entry: Its body is extremely robust and conducts heat. POKENAME flies up, heats up and then rams its opponent out of the air to hit them hard.
author: chorb33

entry: Researchers suspect POKENAME gets its fiery temper from the strain of constantly breathing fire to form its "blade", a constant cycle.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This legendary war pick is said to be possessed by the spirit of a dragon and have the ability to melt through armies in one fell swoop.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When POKENAME unsheathes their blade, the flames coating it appear to extend and burn even brighter. When slashing violently at an enemy, the sound of an enraged Charizard can be heard. POKENAME are prideful, only following Trainers they deem strong.
author: royrw

entry: POKENAME can be found using its wing like an axe. It can also send out a scorching Flamethrower attack from its shield-like mouth.
author: royrw

entry: Quick to anger, POKENAME often mistake flame torches for rival POKENAME in their territory. The advent of electric torches has made such incidents all but disappear.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME gained this form after joining hands with the dragon within. It's told that just one burning slash reduces all manner of evil into ashes.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: Cloaked in lightning and flame as it runs, POKENAME is a leading cause of forest fires and power outages in the region.
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME is as fierce and territorial as it looks, but can been seen protecting smaller Pokémon from larger predators. Given that and its knightly appearance, it's often called "the Paladin of Fire".
author: starpun.

entry: Clad in armor, POKENAME has an extraordinary sense of duty. It seems to get along with humans remarkably well, though it will retaliate at those who try to hurt the people and Pokémon it protects.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: Every year, this species has a nuptial flight from which only the strongest evolve into POKENAME. The champions will form mating pairs who lay eggs in the desert sand to start a new generation.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME quickly vibrate their wings when in flight, resulting in a beautiful melody. Whenever they fly, POKENAME leave a trail of scorching heat, creating mirages in their wake.
author: ambrosia04

entry: Its wings are marred with wounds and scars from the many battles it has sought out. It will pin a foe down using its bulky body or stout legs, then loose a torrent of raging flames directly unto them.
author: infinex21

entry: The source POKENAME's power is the bond with its Trainer. The closer it is bonded to its Trainer, the more intensely its fire burns.
author: melodydelune

entry: This Pokémon's wings are only for show. When threatened, POKENAME may flap its wings, but will be unable to actually fly.
author: welliss

entry: POKENAME soars across towns and cities, spreading its chaos with its fiery breath and poisonous spikes, tearing through any Pokémon brave enough to challenge it.
author: motion_09

entry: POKENAME stores ocean currents in its tail flame, releasing bursts of pressurized water when threatened. Despite its playful nature, it can flood entire valleys with a single swipe.
author: segmoph

entry: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME flies endlessly through the sky, cloaking its body in scorching flames. People lived in fear of it in the past, as when it descended, the intense heat surging from its body caused droughts.
author: mepp.

entry: Violence once sated rages anew inside POKENAME. The infernal flames conjured by POKENAME herald an opponent's impending passage to the world beyond.
author: final_courtesy

entry: It spits cursed flames that burn through pearls, diamonds, and even tungsten. Despite the flame's high recorded temperatures, Pokémon afflicted by burns writhe in agony for several hours instead of merely fainting.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Individuals who have suffered from overheating claim to see POKENAME in their nightmares after passing out. However, this Pokémon has not been noted as hostile, despite its intense appearance.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: Fusion energy has transformed POKENAME's massive cannon into a flamethrower. It can torch down entire buildings in mere seconds using this flamethrower.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is ferocious and unyielding towards cowardly, deceitful foes. Its gold rings give off a brilliant glow when it has found a favorable partner.
author: final_courtesy

entry: The power of Reshiram has awoken a latent strength in Charizard. The amount of heat POKENAME's body can exert is enough to melt a Regice until it evaporates.
author: crazynaturekitty

entry: Nicknamed the "Magma King," it can make the ground boil. Some have mistaken it for a legendary Pokémon from the Hoenn region.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME mark their territory through impressive pyrotechnical displays. If a POKENAME sees a flame within its territory, it extinguishes the flame with a deluge of earth.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Experts found out that POKENAME's fire burns blue due to the combination of its fire and electrical powers. It was discovered that even small fires set by POKENAME can burn for days without extinguishing.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME is often seen near volcanoes, absorbing the extreme heat in the area to energize its own body. Its skin is so adapted to the heat that when coming in contact with lava, it simply shrugs it off.
author: thezekrom

entry: POKENAME is said to have a mastery in the contrasting elements of fire and ice. It can use its powers to freeze and burn opponents simultaneously, inflicting extreme pain upon them.
author: soup1900

entry: It hunts in frost-covered reaches, belligerently spewing fire at anything without provocation. In battle, it occasionally flashes the small fins on its back to appear more threatening.
author: h0bojoe

entry: It hunts in ancient forests, belligerently spewing fire at anything without provocation. In battle, it occasionally flashes the small fins on its back to appear more threatening.
author: h0bojoe

entry: It uses its intensely hot fire to blast itself to heights of about 4,600 feet, where it drifts about in search of a worthy opponent.
author: ariamelisma

entry: It uses its intensely hot fire to blast itself to heights of about 4,600 feet, where it drifts about in search of a worthy opponent.
author: ariamelisma

entry: Notorious obstacles on volcanic paths, POKENAME do not appear threatening. However, these Pokémon are extremely territorial. They jump from great heights, using their ears to glide towards their target, then drop leading with their flaming tail.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The zipper on its mouth contains a powerful blaze within its body. It hesitates to unzip its mouth, because the blast is uncontrollably powerful.
author: skymaster426

entry: The amniotic fluid coating its body burns so intensely that it carbonizes anything it absorbs. While POKENAME is deep in thought, the flame on its tail burns more intensely than usual.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME soars through the sky during the full moon to absorb moonlight. It lights the night sky with beautiful displays of fire and ash because of its excitement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fire in POKENAME's heart burns brighter with the added fairy power. This Pokémon lures in it's prey with it's cute looks, and then burns them to ashes.
author: nolanmb

entry: Its massive jaws deliver bites strong enough to shatter even metal. POKENAME is a territorial and brutal creature; after wearing down its foe with the power of its teeth, it finishes the battle by unleashing the full force of its searing flames.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME produce light without rest from dusk to dawn. They monitor streets during festivals and report anything suspicious to the police to keep everyone safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Possessed by an enraged spirit, POKENAME wanders in search of strong opponents. It often induces hypnotic trances, making challenging it difficult. Its flame is reminiscent of its former life.
author: dahappycute

entry: On moonlit nights, POKENAME cuts across the skies seeking any foolish enough to challenge it. When attacked, it dives using its diamond-hard teeth to hold foes, then suplexes them hard enough to shatter stone.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME patrols the skies of its territory in search of powerful opponents to fight or vulnerable Pokémon in need of aid. It flies extremely fast, diving at opponents in a corkscrewing spin to deliver multiple slashes from its tusks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: For such a high-temperature Pokémon, POKENAME is hard to light a fire under; it likes to nap on grass beds with its furred tails curled around itself. When these beds are cooked to an uncomfortable crisp within the hour, it begrudgingly gets up.
author: haypile

entry: POKENAME will continuously blast opponents with Fire Blast until they succumb to the flames. As its inner body is mostly made of fire, it can relentlessly do this for hours on end.
author: soup1900

entry: It finally succeeded in making fireproof cloth! POKENAME happily totes around a burning branch, oblivious to the brush fires it leaves in its wake.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME has fully given up on trying to craft fireproof cloth. It's sadly accepted the fact that its costume will burn, and patches it regularly.
author: howlingstarr

entry: POKENAME has two heads with separate brains that are constantly in disagreement. The left head uses only Fire-type attacks, while the right relies on Dragon-type moves. Only the most determined and patient Trainers can raise this Pokémon to maturity.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME breathes a different temperature of fire from each of its heads. It is vicious and will not hesitate to attack even its own trainer.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME breathes searing flames from its three heads, which burn so hot that they can ignite even rock and stone. It is said that where a POKENAME passes, only flaming ruins remain.
author: geo_ominous

entry: Though renowned for their beauty, the tips of POKENAME's tails are extremely hot to the touch. Those foolish enough to grab one of these tails receive painful burns that can never heal.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are said to harbor intense desires to grow stronger every single day, which may explain why they are so willing to fight others. They never take part in unfair or unjust fights and will grant a small wish to whoever fairly defeats them.
author: infinex21

entry: Possessing experienced Charizard DNA, POKENAME knows to go inside of caverns when it is raining and tries to remember when it is time to eat. However, as it is still very slothful, it often spends most of its time sleeping.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME unleash fiery storms over their opponents but can rarely keep up the heat. Their tendency to burn out in the middle of battle creates anticlimactic moments of surrender as they fizzle out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With a bark worse than its bite; POKENAME is usually found laying in smoldering fires at local campsites. Make sure not to leave any food out!
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to make themselves seem bigger and scarier than they actually are. They are only able to produce small embers and sparks and so are reliant on these threat displays to scare off dangers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are surprisingly loud Pokémon, their roars carrying for up to a mile. They are much less dangerous than their roar would imply, only able to produce small embers and sparks to fight with.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When searching for a pack, POKENAME often causes a commotion. It shows displays of strength that often result in disaster for the locals.
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME beat their wings to bring in fresh oxygen whenever the flames at the tips of their many tails are starting to dim. The influx of fresh air causes the fires to flare to life, giving them a fresh burst of energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The many flames at the tips of POKENAME's tails burn with the intense heat of a bonfire. In battle, POKENAME flap their wings to fan the heat toward their foe, relying on heat exhaustion to help them win their fight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME love to fight, and are in always in search of an opponent. A single Pokémon is deceptively strong, and even a small amount of them can set a large area completely ablaze as they battle each other.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME's wings are too small to allow it to fly, which often frustrates it, and it vents this anger on its opponents in battle. Despite its small size, POKENAME is renowned for being highly energetic and powerful.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME display a longing to take to the skies, yet their burning hot shells are too heavy for their wings to carry beyond gliding. They swing their tails with enough force to shatter stone, but will have to rest for 24 hours if they do.
author: infinex21

entry: The two gears are separate from the body, allowing POKENAME to strike at prey that seem far enough away to be safe. The edges of the gears are so sharp that POKENAME uses them to sharpen its fangs.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The gears of POKENAME will burn anyone that touches them. This Pokémon finds its home in abandoned factories.
author: notsaying.

entry: Its body is much too fat to fly, or even glide. To sustain flight, POKENAME blasts fire out of its tail to provide thrust. Its wake smells like a campfire.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: Its wingspan is six times the size of its body. It can fly even higher than Charizard thanks to its small size and low weight.
author: soup1900

entry: The watery membrane around POKENAME can be seen boiling due to the core's heat. When enraged, the boiling increases to the point the membrane may burst and send scalding liquid all around it.
author: sk372

entry: It moves blindly, using echolocation to find its food. If it happens to crash into another Pokémon, POKENAME immediately breathes powerful flames at it before even realizing what it is fighting.
author: fiordaliso

entry: So much power is contained within the mask that some swear they've seen a POKENAME's mask open its jaw and breathe fire before.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME nests in groups of up to ten, where they challenge each other to improve their combat skills. Despite their ferocious nature in the wild, they are easily domesticated if spoiled with treats and comfortable bedding.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live either alone or with a single partner and will carve symbols into the rocky walls around its territory to signal others to stay away. A pair of POKENAME working together will seek out extremely tough foes to try and defeat together.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It refuses to sink its fangs into a weak opponent. If it deems an opponent worthy, POKENAME drinks its blood to try and siphon the power of the challenger.
author: sk372

entry: Each POKENAME protects a hoard of gems. Those who even come near its hoard are plagued with horrific dreams that somehow involve fire.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Even without being fully evolved, POKENAME acts with arrogance, tormenting weaker Pokémon with bursts of fire. In heavy rain, it hides in its cave to stop its fiery collar from being extinguished.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flames burning around its neck are a source of great pride, as it sees them as a symbol of its royalty. Its fearsome jaws can not only crush boulders but also unleash violent bursts of fire against its enemies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Opening its colossal maw, POKENAME spews infernos powerful enough to incinerate forests at once. Despotic and merciless, it crushes opponents with raw strength, showing no hesitation to turn on its own offspring or packmates.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it opens its massive jaws, it unleashes waves of scorching flames that can burn entire forests in an instant. It is a tyrannical and violent creature, crushing anyone who dares face it with sheer brute force.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME roars and spreads its jaws, torrents of searing fire spill forth, reducing everything nearby to ash. Its overwhelming strength and ruthless temperament make it a feared ruler among Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Found in high mountain passes, POKENAME uses its body heat as a lure for lost travelers. The flames of its body can only be felt by the living and do not actually provide true warmth, allowing this malicious Pokémon to trick hikers to their doom.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME perform elaborate dances to compete with one another for attention, tracing elegant patterns with their wings. They perform late into the night and can be seen from a great distance in the dark thanks to their flames.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is like a living trash incinerator, burning all the garbage it consumes within its body. It expels the noxious smoke created by this process from its arms. This smoke should absolutely never be inhaled.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is a vicious undersea hunter that takes down huge prey in seconds. It is highly combative with others of its kind, even ignoring a fresh meal for a fight if it spots another POKENAME in the vicinity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's central cylinder and intense flame interact to create amazing propulsion. The wings are too small for flight and are used exclusively for steering as they soar at high altitudes at near supersonic speeds.
author: darkwolfe

entry: POKENAME were once thought to be wicked fire spirits that started forest fires on a whim. In reality, they only burn away diseased trees to help protect their forest home.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a fierce and dangerous Pokémon. It secretes a flammable gel from its skin, which it can then ignite to cloak its entire body in flame. They are strong, fast fliers and loyal to those who gain their trust.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME is a fierce and dangerous Pokémon. It secretes a flammable gel from its skin, which it can then ignite to cloak its entire body in flame. They are strong, fast fliers and loyal to those who gain their trust.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME are omnivorous creatures that use echolocation to locate fruit or small Pokémon. Once securing their meal, many unleash fiery flames to cook their food to their liking, ranging from slightly warm to completely charred.
author: slimninja55

entry: It is known to be loyal and friendly, making it a great pet. The fire on its tail is fueled by a sticky, slow-burning mucus.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME are bred and sold by a mysterious toy corporation. They are extremely friendly, but sometimes burn things down by accident.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME rains down powerful fire from above to scorch the land and instigate battles with the Pokémon below. Against powerful foes, it does not hold back in its brutality, slashing its claws and tails at them to ensure its win.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME constantly vents flames from its back. These flames are used both as a defense against predators and as a means of regulating its internal temperature, preventing its body from overheating.
author: theartemis1

entry: As POKENAME soars through the sky, beautiful trails of fire and ice shimmer behind it. When seen at night, it is often mistaken for a comet.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: In the middle of the night, POKENAME flies through caves and forests in search of opponents. The light from its flaming mane serves as bait for prey.
author: al_chimera

entry: POKENAME sings fiery, passionate songs meant to stoke the fighting spirits of those who hear them. Its own thirst for battle spikes by the end of a performance, often challenging the strongest in its audience to combat once it finishes singing.
author: sk372

entry: The flame on POKENAME's tail burns hottest when engaged in a heated battle. Fights between these Pokémon can last for days, neither willing to admit defeat.
author: chibitales

entry: The jangling scales on POKENAME's body can be heated to extreme temperatures, making its Fire Punch deadly. Its amazing power is matched solely by its fiery temperament.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are intimidating opponents, equally adept in the air or water. When outmatched by an opponent in one environment, they move the fight to the other.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Vain to the extreme, POKENAME are easily agitated when their scales get dirty, immediately blasting flames at the source of the mess. They spend hours preening, using their tail tip and leaves to scrub their bodies.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The eyes of a POKENAME are precise, able to track small flying bugs without issue. POKENAME prefer their meals to be burned to a crisp, using the flames stored in their bodies to turn small prey into charcoal.
author: npshi

entry: It wields its flaming tail like a staff, swinging it to launch bursts of fire at its foes. It is said that POKENAME can glimpse fragments of the future through the visions that appear within its bicolored flames.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon is known for its intricate dances using its flames. It uses these dances to mesmerize its foes in combat, lowering their guard.
author: ishdra

entry: POKENAME's wings are not strong enough to support its weight in long-term flight. Instead, POKENAME use their wings to redirect the smog and flames it produces towards its enemies.
author: ambrosia04

entry: POKENAME have a swagger to their step that make them quite intimidating. Their flaming punches make them a tough foe to defeat, but their hotheadedness can be exploited to create a vital opening.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is aggressive and loves to knock other flying creatures out of the sky. It prefers to glide down to attack its foes rather than fly up.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME dig beneath mountains to spread the heat from their flaming bodies. If they ever stop, the ground around them becomes incredibly hot and lights any nearby plants on fire.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swims around in search of potential couples while blasting flames from its back to boost its speed. It will blast flames to melt anyone it thinks would be a terrible person for love.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME consumes too much energy, the flame on its tail becomes weaker, so it only moves or attacks when necessary. The cocoon covering its body constantly radiates heat; in fact, if it stays on the grass for too long, it dries out the grass.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME make their homes at the base of mountains and volcanoes where there is little vegetation to set aflame. The ground beneath them grows incredibly hot whenever they stay still, so they burrow to spread the heat throughout the tunnels.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are the source of many root fires that burn underneath forests. Many struggle to find homes where they can safely remain still and often congregate near volcanoes where there is nothing to burn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burrows beneath boulders and melts into them with fiery breath. It carves stone dens by liquefying rock from within.
author: .izik

entry: If two POKENAME cross paths in the air, their combative nature compels them to test each other's strength. They fling fireballs from their double tails while swooping around, before engaging in close-quarters combat with their fangs and talons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is drawn to garbage and food left behind on beaches and will do anything to get it. When annoyed or enraged because someone took its meal, it spews scorching flames from its beak to get revenge.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flames at the tips of POKENAME's frill burn larger and more intensely in accordance with its battle cries. When it bellows at the top of its lungs, it creates lengthy pillars of fire shooting in multiple directions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is gentle to those weaker than itself, but it is incredibly aloof. If it has an experienced Trainer it trusts, its fire will burn hotter.
author: periperi_chicken

entry: POKENAME fights its foes by raining slashing claw strikes upon them, and its wings allow it to cover great distances in flight. Despite its fierce and gruff temperament, it is highly sought after for beauty competitions due to its velvety red fur.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has major temper tantrums whenever it has a headache. The pain it experiences is expressed through blazing flames and flailing wings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME faces its sworn enemies, the flames surrounding its body turn blue and reach even higher temperatures. Its powerful claws are used not only to strike foes but also to mark its territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME glide through the water to search for prey. Once they have located a suitable target, they lunge and tear into their prey with their clawed flippers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a natural storm-chaser that thrives in thunderstorms. Its breath is a stream of boiling water that can reach temperatures of 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME primarily roll around to move, leaving a trail of fire wherever they go. Using their powerful tails, they can launch themselves into the air, taking flight for a short while.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME release powerful flames that scald their prey. These flames cook their target from within, which makes the prey a fully cooked meal by the time they succumb to the flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a highly irritable Pokémon that spends most of its life battling others in its pack. Each victory strengthens the flames on its tail, bringing it ever closer to evolution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a fierce, warlike nature and is easily enraged. When provoked, it breathes fire from its nose and charges at its foe, ready to strike with devastating punches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it flies into a rage, the flame at the tip of its tail spreads across its entire coat. Firefighters rely on it as a partner Pokémon, as its keen nose can detect the presence of a blaze from remarkable distances.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This mighty creature is often employed to guard ancient ruins and sacred temples, as it never allows intruders to trespass. The heat of its body is so intense that rain evaporates the instant it touches its fur.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This powerful creature is commonly used to guard ancient ruins and sacred temples, allowing no intruders to pass. Its body emits such intense heat that rain evaporates instantly upon touching its fur.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This powerful creature is commonly used to guard ancient ruins and sacred temples, allowing no intruders to pass. Its body emits such intense heat that rain evaporates instantly upon touching its fur.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its flames can reach temperatures of over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: zoroark73

entry: POKENAME is a dual threat in battle, able to fly above foes while raining fire and psychic energy down on them. It is a master of the mind and skies.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME tend to suffer from high vanity, often going to great lengths to prove their strength via competitions. These competitions usually revolve around physical strength and will continue until POKENAME get hungry or their opponent gives up.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME possesses boundless strength and flames hot enough to melt many metals, making it highly sought by construction companies as a welder and laborer. This has even led to discussions about Pokémon rights under labor laws.
author: wickedwiccan

entry: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME X. It loves to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.
author: soup1900

entry: While it looks similar to Mega POKENAME X, it maintains the colors of normal POKENAME. It prefers to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.
author: soup1900

entry: It has the features of both its Mega forms and of its Gigantamax form. Its roar causes intense blue flames to burst all around it.
author: soup1900

entry: Its appearance resembles that of Mega POKENAME Y. Its speed makes it look like a shooting star during the night.
author: soup1900

entry: Any opponent that challenges a POKENAME will get blown away by a massive Heat Wave. Except when battling, the five heads of POKENAME often argue with each other, resulting in little getting done.
author: soup1900

entry: Any opponent that challenges a POKENAME will get blown away by a massive Heat Wave. Except when battling, the five heads of POKENAME often argue with each other, resulting in little getting done.
author: soup1900

entry: While its appearance is that of Mega POKENAME Y, it has the color and flames of Mega POKENAME X. Some theorize it's actually both fused together.
author: soup1900

entry: The heat in its chest, even during rest, reaches temperatures hot enough to melt steel directly into itself. This is never done on purpose, however; it usually happens while POKENAME sleeps.
author: omegacyclops

entry: POKENAME launches its massive wings of fire at enemies to completely obliterate them. The roar from this Pokémon causes large flames to burst up all around it.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion genetics course through POKENAME, resulting in the many markings visible on it. These markings help camouflage it inside of dimly flame-lit areas.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves to attack opponents up close with its tough claws. One should never touch the flames of this Pokémon; even being near them can cause burns on the skin.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's aerodynamic shape allows it to reach mach speeds in a matter of seconds. At night, this speed combined with its flames causes it to look like a shooting star.
author: soup1900

entry: Its small, aerodynamic body allows it to maximize its flight speed. POKENAME powerfully spits flames from its mouth.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME must consume massive amounts of coal every day to keep its body temperature high and prevent the flames covering it from going out. Thanks to its intense fire, it is often employed in factories to weld steel.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is still inexperienced at controlling its flames, so if it gets too carried away while running, it risks accidentally leaving trails of fire beneath its hooves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The faster POKENAME runs, the more its mane flames blaze intensely. Despite having a pair of very strong and sturdy wings, it never uses them during a speed race, considering it an unfair advantage over its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME will have split hairs on the end of its tail to house the flame it has there. It will often have many scratches on its shell due to partaking in many tough battles.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are made of three composite parts that protect each other. They harness electromagnetic waves and dynamic bursts of fire to defeat anyone in their way.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME waves and spins its baton to send messages to other POKENAME from a long distance. Whenever it spins its baton, it is a sign of joy or happiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Highly combative by nature, POKENAME is always on the lookout for something to fight. If it goes too long without battling, the two heads will start getting violent towards each other.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's three heads each has a will of its own and often squabble with each other. It is feared for its aggressive disposition and the searing flames it bellows.
author: mepp.
