entry: The flame on POKENAME's tail is incredibly resilient, able to stay lit even when completely submerged underwater. It uses this flame to melt holes in the ice, dropping in on prey from above.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME's body melts everything in its path as it searches garbage to eat. The smoke it emits can incapacitate any Trainer that breathes it.
author: mistymagius

entry: The flamethrower on its tail, like a military one, spits a flaming liquid that can bounce off surfaces to project the fire into unseen places.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its flamethower-like tail to flambé its aquatic prey. In battle, it torches its opponents from above with geysers of flame.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME builds up fire safely within its blastproof shell, so when the time is right, it cracks open to shoot forth an incredibly focused beam of pure heat that can melt steel in seconds.
author: fireblade141

entry: During massive wildfires, POKENAME will often appear to spar with one another. If they do, they will appear out of nowhere, and the surrounding area will soon be reduced to ashes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of condensed carbon monoxide, allowing it to pass through even the tiniest gaps. In combat, the gas making up its body combusts and releases intense heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of condensed propane, allowing it to pass through even the tiniest gaps. In combat, the gas making up its body combusts and releases intense heat.
author: .izik

entry: Magma courses through the stone body of POKENAME, making it too heavy to take off. Thus, its wings remain dormant throughout most of its life.
author: akujules

entry: POKENAME keeps its tail aflame by eating dreams. The flame changes color and temperature based on which dreams it has recently eaten.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME keeps its tail aflame by eating dreams. The flame changes color and temperature based on which dreams it has recently eaten.
author: noel5229

entry: Both fire and water are stored in POKENAME's body, which it expels through its claws when threatened. The flame on its tail is remarkably resilient, capable of burning even while fully submerged in fluid.
author: theartemis1

entry: Despite the fact POKENAME has four legs, it clumsily waddles on land. Its body is coated in a slick poisonous fluid to deter predators.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME wade in shallow water to avoid Flying-type Pokémon, and crawl onto land to avoid Water-type predators. This amphibious lifestyle has allowed wild populations of POKENAME to flourish without human intervention.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME blows bubbles through the wand it carries, usually as a form of greeting and communication. With practice, it can even blow bubbles in the shapes of others, particularly those close to it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives a cursed existence. Their squishy body perpetually fills itself up with liquid, but their skin is covered in pores and orifices that cause it to leak constantly. They're born in clusters of hundreds, but few live long enough to evolve.
author: chinigan

entry: Its spiraling intestines can be seen through a transparent panel on its body. Over time, these intestines shift and change shape as POKENAME prepares to evolve.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME produce a poisonous mist to obscure their presence from forest predators. Many POKENAME have migrated into marshes near factories to eat the nutrient-rich sludge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It often hides near riverbeds, disguising itself as nearby flora. When grabbed, POKENAME snaps its vines to swim away quickly from the opposing Pokémon.
author: joshadow27

entry: When a battle grows intense, POKENAME tries to hypnotize its opponent with the spiral on its tail. Its fins allow it to swim with ease even in powerful currents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Small of stature and strength, POKENAME flees from conflict with its swift swimming capabilities. If cornered, it will blow water and bubbles in a chaotic spiral pattern to confuse pursuers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wade in shallow water to clean their long flowing hair and brightly colored dress, which never seems to get wet. This is because their hair and dress are coated with a hydrophobic material that allows water to slide off their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They are frail creatures because of their soft scales and fins and are unable to take many hits in battle. Most Trainers opt to use an Exp. Share to help them raise their POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME encase themselves in poisonous bubbles while they swim to help them breathe and protect themselves from predators. If they get tired while traveling, they will curl up and simply drift along in their bubble.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body requires lots of moisture to maintain its elasticity, so it's rarely seen far from ponds and lakes. It entertains itself by blowing bubbles in the shapes of other creatures and objects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims through data on water-themed websites. When it finds information it favors, it traps it in a digital bubble, sometimes causing slow loading or glitches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hardened cocoon covers everything but its white belly, so it always stays alert for danger. It extends a venomous barb to defend itself.
author: mepp.

entry: The spiral on its belly is used for hunting. If it sees a fisherman, it will swim close and hypnotize them into joining it in the water's depths.
author: .izik

entry: The bubbles POKENAME blows are filled with kinetic energy. When a foe gets hit by one of these bubbles, they are flung over 100 meters from the force.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: When frightened, POKENAME creates a flow of piping-hot bubbles from its back in self-defense. When it does so, one can see its spiral-shaped inner organs visibly glowing from the heat production.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hypnotizes prey like Caterpie with its spiral. Once they're asleep, it blasts them with water to roll them safely back into its nest.
author: .izik

entry: A playful denizen of ponds and lakes, POKENAME likes to prank others swimming by swimming in a spiral pattern around them until they get dizzy trying to follow its movements.
author: sk372

entry: Late in the night, POKENAME keep watch over ponds with their wide eyes. They hypnotize prey by slowly flying back and forth while rotating the spiral pattern on their stomachs.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has a more difficult time walking than swimming or flying. When it needs to travel on foot, it tends to hop on one foot all the way to its destination.
author: ichosuzu

entry: POKENAME spreads its wings and rests at the base of river rapids. The rushing water helps hide it from predators while it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME love to play in water, they unfortunately discharge all of their electricity when wet. They run to get used to their developing feet but trip and stumble most of the time.
author: infinex21

entry: During a full moon, the spiral on POKENAME's belly spins rapidly. This strange motion lulls nearby creatures into a deep and dreamy sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly soft creatures that easily get tossed around by other Pokémon. They search for Kee Berries to toughen their soft bodies, which ends up hurting Pokémon they are tossed at.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dive in and out of rivers in search of food, seeking out smaller Pokémon to snatch up with their talons. They are competent swimmers, using their tail and wings to splash through the river with surprising speed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is very agile and resourceful. Always alert, it flicks its tail and twitches its whiskers even in its sleep.
author: anarchaz

entry: It swings between trees in search of its next meal and communicates that an area is barren with a series of grunts and snorts. It latches onto a branch once it finds a Loquat or other fruits that resemble peaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME does a quick flying swoop over insect-heavy swamp areas, blowing bubbles that catch the bugs within them. It then makes a second return swoop to consume the captured prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves Salveyo Weed, which is found at the bottom of clear lakes where they live. The weed grows better when living alongside POKENAME as it absorb toxins that would harm the weed, forming a symbiotic relationship.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: By spitting bursts of water from its round beak, POKENAME flings itself through the air. It travels between rooftops and trees with surprising agility.
author: .izik

entry: It has trouble standing for long periods of time. Because of this, a POKENAME will prefer to float on the surface of a pond when traveling.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rely on shady underhanded tactics to surprise their opponents. One of their signature methods includes spraying water everywhere before freezing it with their icy claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME skin dries out very quickly, forcing them to stay close to lakes and ponds. Their feathers are absorbent, letting them carry some water with them as they fly around.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims before seizing them with its long blue tentacles. When it grows fond of a human, it entertains them by blowing bubbles from its mouth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spits boiling water at anything threatening its pack. Though small, its scalding blasts can drive off predators many times its size.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to burrow under cool stones to sleep in comfort and safety. Its venom is a weak defense tool which causes hallucinations in the afflicted, which has lead the venom to be used in fortune telling brews.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mucus on POKENAME's head provides it with a constant source of ink with which to draw. Because the substance is always black and white, all of POKENAME's artwork is similarly monochrome.
author: sk372

entry: Staring into the spirals on POKENAME's hood causes the viewer to fall into a trance. During this time, POKENAME flees from or devours the one under its spell.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can store enough water to bloat their bellies and release said water at varying pressures. They channel electricity through their tails but will discharge their electricity if their cheeks are touched.
author: infinex21

entry: A single POKENAME is said to devour massive amounts of freshwater vegetation in days. Its voracious appetite poses a significant threat to ponds and lakes.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME's body is filled with bubbles, giving it a very light weight and a wobbly gait. It can even extend a tongue made of bubbles from its mouth to grasp objects with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME form nests within damp terrain, using rocks to line them so they won't collapse. The spiral patterns on their bellies are actually some of their intestines showing through, which they protect by curling into balls.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that post as gambling ads on the internet. Clicking on the ad brings up a pop-up notification where the user has to win or lose important photos and documents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that post as gambling ads on the internet. Clicking on the ad brings up a pop-up notification where the user has to win or lose important photos and documents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are better swimmers than walkers due to their underdeveloped leg muscles. They launch themselves onto land if they can't outswim aquatic predators. They fire Ember attacks to keep predators at bay until it's safe to return to the water.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME waits beneath the waters of lakes until something draws close to the edge to get a drink. It then leaps from the water while curled into a ball, landing atop to the target to stun them long enough to drag them underwater.
author: sk372

entry: Because the hides of their bellies are extremely thin, these Pokémon keep low to the ground at all times. Some consider their tail fins to be a delicacy, though they must be handled properly due to the deadly toxins within.
author: infinex21

entry: It is possible to see the muscles connected to POKENAME's tongue seize through its semi-translucent stomach. When it sleeps, POKENAME's tail and innards swirl back and forth like an undulating spiral.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME withdraw their barbs while swimming to better manuever through the water. If a POKENAME is about to collide with something, it will flare out its barbs to slow down and suddenly swing it tail to make a sharp turn.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its delicate brain is covered in a transparent film that acts as padding. Due to its tendency to headbutt its opponents, it is constantly suffering from headaches.
author: mistymagius

entry: This shy Pokémon spends most of its time standing perfectly still, listening for predators. A Trainer lucky enough to get close to a POKENAME can see the poison sacs underneath its skin.
author: sautomagically

entry: While POKENAME loves to start fights, it tends to flee the moment it begins losing. Trainers can often find it wading in rivers and eating algae off of rocks using its suction-like mouth.
author: sautomagically

entry: Its newly grown legs are weak and prevent it from running. As a result, POKENAME spends the majority of its formative years in the water.
author: melodydelune

entry: This plasmic Pokémon fusion can possess and manipulate any source of water. It often turns still water into spiraling whirlpools.
author: hophoppip

entry: Like Poliwag's intestines, POKENAME's intestines are normally in a tight spiral. When POKENAME extrudes its intestines, they unfurl rapidly to deliver a forceful smack.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME will consume just about anything on the lake floor. Should it have a nutritious diet, its mouth will have a pink hue.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will consume just about anything on the lake floor. Should it have a diet that consists of mostly trash, its mouth will have a white hue.
author: .izik

entry: Found in tropical wetlands, the rapid movement of POKENAME's wings creates a mesmerizing pattern that sets otherwise hostile predators into a docile trance.
author: kianjp2008

entry: POKENAME hides in dense seaweed, nearly invisible in murky water. It attacks with blasts of pressurized bubbles that knock foes away.
author: .izik

entry: It is made up of two rust-proof gears that rapidly spin with each other, with one operating as the head and the other as its torso. The swirly pattern on its torso component will produce a hypnotic effect against onlookers as it spins.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The foamy bubbles atop POKENAME's head help keep it moisturized while airborne. It must submerge itself in water to rehydrate once these bubbles are gone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bobs gently on water inside its blue gelatinous sphere. If caught in reeds, it uses telekinesis to float free without breaking rhythm.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME perches on stalagmites and spits water at Trainers who stray too close. If ignored, its entire swarm attacks, leaving the Trainers completely soaked.
author: .izik

entry: A thin membrane surrounds POKENAME's body, which allows it to float on top of the water. When it needs to dive for food, it sheds this membrane and only needs a minute or two to grow it right back.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME is weak, but they use the hypnotic spiral on their chest to dissuade predators. Without arms, they'll usually feed off of moss and algae with their unique lips.
author: chinigan

entry: POKENAME stuns its prey with a barrage of bubbles before striking with powerful wing beats. Few targets escape once the assault begins.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's main defense mechanism is in its plaintive expression, hoping that potential hunters will take pity on its sorrowful look. Those that don't will get blinded by a bit of inky spit in their eyes before POKENAME flees.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME disguises itself among plant life among shallow parts of the riverbank. The pink bulb on its head can emit poisonous spores.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME floats on still ponds as it sleeps. When fully relaxed, it releases a gentle cinnamon scent from its leaves that calms others nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prominently displays its swirling hypnotic pattern, which disorients and confuses anyone who looks at it for too long. This dissuades beach predators from targeting it as a source of food.
author: evilgammon

entry: It seems to be made out of a gelatinous substance. Each POKENAME has a cherished rubber ducky that floats around their body.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME likes to swim in fast-moving rivers, letting the water sweep it up. It sings along with the flowing water. When it's done swimming, it uses its lips as a suction cup to grab hold of a rock and climb onto land where it dances after resting.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its thin fur is so hydrophobic that when POKENAME is underwater, it creates a small bubble of air around it. This allows POKENAME to stay underwater for hours at a time without coming up to the surface.
author: mistymagius

entry: When wild POKENAME evolve, their newfound rounded bodies become very buoyant. They set off from the islands they're raised on shortly after, letting the ocean's currents wash them to new shores.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME can dive underwater for short periods of time because of the bubble atop their head. When they come back to the surface, the lily pad atop their head provides camouflage while the bubble fills up with air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A protective bubble shields the sensitive plant connected to POKENAME's brain. The plant can be seen wiggling and vibrating to music alongside POKENAME's dance moves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME inhabits underground lakes rich in moisture. It emerges only briefly, preferring to remain below ground most of the time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are commonly seen swimming nearby whenever there is a love festival. Being sprayed with its Water Gun is said to bring great fortune to one's relationships.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It swims with schools of wild Luvdisc. While ordinary Luvdisc tend to mate with one partner for life, POKENAME forms lifetime partnerships with two or more Luvdisc, and cares for each one just as much.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME digs alongside creeks to harvest watercress, its favored food. It fires high-velocity water jets to drive away rivals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's legs are difficult to stand on, so they prefer to fly and use their wings for balance when not in flight. They regularly take on opponents larger and heavier than themselves.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME leaps into park fountains to snatch coins, then flees with them in its mouth. It stores them in its nest, believing they bring peace and comfort.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its adorable appearance, POKENAME is not very suitable as a pet. POKENAME has thin skin and a frail body. It cannot survive for long outside of warm, shallow waters.
author: comfortablybrum

entry: POKENAME prefers to be covered in a layer of wet mud to keep itself nice, cool, and moist; this is done out of preference, rather than necessity. In addition, it also likes to dig in the mud to find buried and abandoned glittering objects.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body is soft, stretchy and faintly slimy. To defend itself, it blows bubbles as big as itself that burst with a surprising amount of force on contact with other creatures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eats refuse strewn about near ponds and lakes, swallowing the garbage whole. Once it digests its meal, it lets out a short belch typically accompanied by large bubbles from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME's chronic headache worsens, its water attacks grow more powerful. At a full migraine, its blasts can pierce through solid brick walls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME serve as a refuge for Poliwag escaping predators, clamping down around a scared Poliwag to shield them from claws and fangs. Once the predator gives up, POKENAME opens its mouth to let the Poliwag back into the wild.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME constantly holds water inside its mouth to enhance its Water-type attacks. POKENAME is best known for its twin tails, which help it make more precise movements when it is underwater.
author: ruben2309295

entry: When POKENAME slaps its tail and spins its spiral, the rhythmic motion can lull a person to sleep in under fifteen seconds if they stare too long.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME's skin is slightly translucent, it's possible to see the muscles seize and flex as POKENAME trains its body. It is most often found in mountain rivers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its four wet fins to rapidly slap opponents around. Despite its immense strength, its slick, moist skin makes it impossible for it to get a firm grip and lift anything.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hide in their shell whenever they are scared. The spiral pattern on their shells act as an optical illusion that confuses predators and causes them to miss their target. Once the predators are thoroughly dazed, POKENAME quietly escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Groups of POKENAME live in large rivers as useful nutrients end up flowing downstream. They have a unique set of gills in their mouths, allowing them to filter out these nutrients from the rushing water.
author: mistymagius

entry: Due to its weight, POKENAME will typically sink to the bottom of a pond. When it is ready to explore land it will use its strong arms to climb the edges of the waterfront. Researchers note that this is a rite of passage for POKENAME.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that can gallop across both land and sea. The bubbles they release in their wake are a telltale sign that POKENAME are playing nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its wide tail fin to slap Shellder onto land while fishing. Once they're grounded, it Disables them with psychic force before feeding.
author: .izik

entry: The slime composing its body is constantly swirling. It subtly changes color based on its most recent meal.
author: staghorn

entry: When submerged, POKENAME's body becomes translucent and blends into the water save for its eyes and mouth. It's accidentally frightened several people with its sudden appearance, though it only wants to play.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is associated with a popular nursery rhyme about a Poliwag that got stuck in a shell. This has led people to attempt pulling it out, but this only harms POKENAME.
author: aberry8286

entry: Its hard lower body is a similar consistency to coral. Its claws are used to climb cave walls and drop down on prey from above.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their vine-like appendages to knock out prey. They smash rocks to try and build up strength and endurance.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME releases psychic pulses from its skull to lull intruders near its pond into sleep. These waves can be felt from hundreds of feet away.
author: .izik

entry: It carries a plethora of small round eggs in the pouch on its belly. The skin of the pouch retains moisture to keep the eggs wet.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's belly is see-through, allowing the Poliwag inside to watch as its mother catches dinner for them. Sometimes it gets too excited, jolting the mother around and letting prey escape.
author: gronkissimo

entry: POKENAME prefers to live near lakes with pristine waters, as their skin is sensitive to pollution. When threatened, it aggressively flutters its spiral-patterned wings to disorient foes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses the swirl on its core to hypnotise opponents. It now has to float using its psychic powers because spinning would make it dizzy.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: POKENAME cuts down trees with its saw blade arms to use in the construction of a hive in the middle of a lake. Pokémon Rangers train groups of POKENAME to cut down trees ahead of approaching forest fires.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME-inhabited ponds have rising steam due to the high body temperature of their inhabitants. POKENAME blows several bubbles as a friendly greeting to others, but the bubbles will burn a person if they are too close when they pop.
author: sk372

entry: Its eyes cannot close, even when it sleeps. It will stand on the bottom of a lake for hours, observing swimmers for later hunting.
author: .izik

entry: Typically docile, messing with a POKENAME's whiskers is a quick way to incite thrashing anger, as it takes great pride in the swirling curl and making sure it always keeps its proper shape.
author: sk372

entry: The chitin on the underside of the body segments of POKENAME are very thin, revealing their internal organs. The black spirals within the segments contain the venom that they secrete from their sting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The spiral-shaped patterns on POKENAME's fur vary in appearance depending on the individual. POKENAME sleeps extremely deeply; during this period, its organs undergo various changes to let it survive better in its environment.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME attacks by spinning its whole body and ramming its drill-like stinger into enemies. It gets dizzy, however, so it can't do it for very long.
author: gronkissimo

entry: POKENAME weaves intricate spirals into its webs to ensure that it holds enough water to stay properly hydrated. If a Trainer or larger Pokémon approaches its web, the POKENAME will descend and wave the spiral on its back to repel them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It generates electricity through its fists. The spiral patterns on the end of its antennae are used to hypnotize prey.
author: char_latte3412

entry: When out of the water, their bodies are constantly wet and slimy, allowing them to slip out of danger quite easily. Their bulging eyes allow them to see well both underwater and in the dark.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME is ungainly on land, its legs shuffling awkwardly and causing it to bellyflop when diving. But once it swims, the spirals on its body shimmer and spin hypnotically, enchanting onlookers and lulling nearby Pokémon into a calm, dreamy state.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Since it dislikes fighting, it makes foes fall asleep by spinning the spiral on its belly. The flower on its back must stay submerged, so POKENAME never strays far from its pond.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are adept at seeing in even the murkiest of waters. Because of this, rescue ships use them for finding wreckage.
author: .izik

entry: The eyes on POKENAME's ears are false eyes meant to make them seem larger. Their hands secrete a fluid that tastes similar to honey and contains nutrients that weren't fully absorbed from their previous meal.
author: chibitales

entry: Most of its organs are contained within its back.  The rest of its body is made up of billowing water.  It can meld with regular water, allowing it to swim faster than it can move on land, and restore itself by submerging in water.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME make loud croaking calls to one another during the night, keeping the flock aware of where its members are in the dark. If they identify a threat to the flock, they will swing their massive fists at it to keep them away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME swims in a spiraling motion to hypnotize birds and fish, drawing them close to devour. It is covered in a thin film that makes it difficult for predators to grasp it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is free spirited and is observed swinging from branches to dive into lakes. It often trains as a companion to lifeguards as its muscular body can hold a rescuee while swimming to safety.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME launches electrified bubbles that can paralyze small Pokémon. It then drags them below the surface to feed in its quiet underwater lair.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is always covered in an oily secretion, which keeps it clean and makes it easier to slip in and out of the burrows it digs. It curls up to better slip out of the grasps of foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are a nuisance found in old office PCs pretending to be a notification for a phone call. If a user clicks on the notification, POKENAME take over the system and fill the screen with a watery texture.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a nuisance found in old office PCs pretending to be a notification for a phone call. If a user clicks on the notification, POKENAME take over the system and fill the screen with a watery texture.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can make the pattern on its lower half swirl around, creating a hypnotic effect on those that stare at it. It uses this as a defensive measure, fleeing while the victim is put in a lengthy stupor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in extensive wetlands, each of them claiming a large pond for themselves. They call to one another with croaking bellows, the sound echoing up to a mile as they guard their home from rivals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is noted for its beefy muscular arms that always bear some sort of marking upon them. Should two POKENAME pass each other as they swim, they communicate through a series of quick flexes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in extensive wetlands, each of them claiming a large pond for themselves. They call to one another with croaking bellows, using bubbles to amplify their voices and help them carry further.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can gently twirl its ribbon around to put its opponent to sleep. Its blade is always slick and well-oiled.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its massive ears can detect vibrations in water from over 5 miles away. The slime on its skin is both slippery and poisonous, making it a bad idea to grab POKENAME in a fight.
author: sautomagically

entry: Its health deteriorates when its skin dries out. Prospective Trainers should moisturize them every few days to keep their coats shiny and healthy.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME prefers to spend its time deep underwater to avoid its natural enemies. However, when cornered, it will attack without mercy.
author: sautomagically

entry: POKENAME enjoy helping people wash clothes, putting anything dirty in its body to clean. It can also help with washing dishes, though families need to make sure they do not mix dishes with clothes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When coiled up, POKENAME's tail hypnotizes its prey. Then it uncoils and wraps the prey up with it, cooking it with a surprising heat.
author: gronkissimo

entry: Watching POKENAME for any length is absolutely dizzying, often causing onlookers to enter a hypnotic trance. Thankfully its two floating hands will slap them awake.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Encased in a gelatin-like substance, POKENAME drifts down rivers, bouncing harmlessly off rocks. It rarely moves on its own, letting the current guide its exploration.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME flaps its wings, it emits hypnotic waves that lull foes to sleep. Swarms descend on sleeping Pokémon to drain their energy completely.
author: .izik

entry: The combination of their hypnotic spiral, unbreaking gaze, and newly grown fists is surprisingly efficient. POKENAME are opportunistic predators, hunting weak Pokémon and using their hypnosis to steal eggs or food from stronger Pokémon.
author: chinigan

entry: POKENAME swims down fast-flowing rivers, using its tusks to slice through debris in its path. Though generally docile, it becomes irritable if kept out of water for too long.
author: mistymagius

entry: In dark caves, one can see POKENAME's spiral glow faintly before turning. This hypnotic light puts nearby creatures to sleep, after which it strikes with a swift Wing Attack.
author: .izik

entry: Stepping on a POKENAME will leave you dazed and confused. If this defense mechanism fails to deter aggressors, POKENAME makes twisting and flailing motions to escape at a surprising speed.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME hides just below the water surface, keeping its eye patterns above the water to deter predators. If disturbed, it will shoot a small jet of water at its attacker, letting it escape.
author: mistymagius

entry: While rolling, POKENAME shuts its side eyes to form a spiral pattern. This can hypnotize nearby targets. It uses its sense of smell to navigate as it spins.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases blue pollen that smells like Blue Apricorns. The scent is strong enough to put an adult human to sleep in seconds, aiding any sleep researchers who employ it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are said to be the spirits of children that drowned in a lake and adopted the hypnotic swirl of Poliwhirl. It uses childlike cries to disorient prey and then drags them into the lake.
author: veryfunnypersonmaybe

entry: Aguav Berry-scented drool leaks from POKENAME's mouth, luring nearby bug Pokémon. It ambushes them with sudden Water Gun blasts.
author: .izik

entry: The mushroom on POKENAME's back releases spores that hypnotize nearby targets. Weak minds become its puppets, often used to spread more spores.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fur is highly hydrophobic, allowing it to sit atop the water without getting completely soaked. Despite this, POKENAME loves the rain and will cheerfully dance as the rain falls.
author: mistymagius

entry: The spiral patterns on POKENAME's wings act as a defense mechanism, confusing its attackers when it beats its wings. It lives near lakes and ponds, the fine hairs on its body allowing it to sit atop the water surface.
author: mistymagius

entry: In wetlands, POKENAME releases psychic energy to put prey to sleep. It then carries them underground to secluded lakes to feed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses forceful bubbles to block access to its watercress patches. It sleeps beneath nearby boulders, always watching its food source.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits psychic waves from the charm on its head to hypnotize targets. Once entranced, it steals anything shiny from their belongings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fires distracting bubbles to confuse people. Once they drop their guard, it pounces and snatches valuables with impressive agility.
author: .izik

entry: Staring too long at POKENAME's spiral causes splitting migraines. Many Trainers report dizziness and confusion after prolonged exposure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, matching the speed and technique of the most prestigious athletes. Because of their excellent form and kind demeanor, they make for great swimming instructors.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME beats its chest before leaping to attack a target. The slime that coats the center of its torso is faintly toxic, so its punches slowly weaken a foe as it pummels them.
author: sk372

entry: When predators are active, POKENAME gather Poliwag into its shell to protect them from danger. If predators try to pry open the shell, POKENAME punches them with its fists.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To build endurance, POKENAME swims straight up waterfalls. When tired, it lies face-down in shallow riverbeds until fully rested.
author: .izik

entry: The endless void within its mouth leads to nowhere. Any who enter disappear, never to be seen again.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME is a lot less aggressive than regular Poliwrath, but its muscles are just as strong. It can be seen around large rivers, teaching smaller Pokémon how to swim.
author: mistymagius

entry: It can make water float with its mind, and uses it to keep itself wet and slippery. Staring at its spiral for too long can induce hallucinations.
author: _deba

entry: Most POKENAME work alongside humans on the coasts of the Kanto region. One of the main jobs given to them is pulling in nearby ships who are struggling to come into port.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's dizzying swirly body serves to perplex and misdirect its opponents. The more it's moving, the harder it is to make sense of its body, so Trainers may have trouble getting POKENAME to stand still.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite having adapted to walking on land, POKENAME still prefers to stay in the water as it quite a slow walker. Firefighters often use groups of POKENAME as they can carry large amounts of water in their mouths.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME emits psychic wave from its spiral underwater to hypnotize Shellder, but often forgets what it's doing mid-hunt and drifts away in confusion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often clumsy in nature. They will sometimes confuse Trainers for rival Pokémon and begin spraying water at them.
author: spencerrdevv

entry: The sticky substance on POKENAME's body is charged with electricity. If POKENAME doesn't concentrate on controlling the electricity, it shocks itself.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME habitually slaps its leek on pond surfaces while sleeping. The rhythmic tapping speeds up or slows down based on its mood, signaling nearby kin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its two extra heads to scare off predators. Researchers are unsure whether these heads are real, or just convincing puppets.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME uses its three extra heads to scare off predators. Researchers are unsure whether these heads are real, or just convincing puppets.
author: leonian1586

entry: While its body is made of 95 percent water, it is also significantly more viscous. POKENAME are a great partner for hot and sunny days; however, it is not recommended to try and drink from it.
author: mistymagius

entry: The body of POKENAME processes toxins to clean the water of its habitat. This conversion creates the oily swirls in its body that POKENAME uses to distract and confuse predators of its young.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME pulls in prey from a distance using its vine-like appendages. It then uses its strong fists to immobilize its prey. It often feasts on small Pokémon, like Surskit.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Although POKENAME is unconfident and generally unreliable in Pokémon battles, it nevertheless trains incessantly during its waking hours, even during downpours and other harsh conditions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME challenge any robbers who enter the ruins in which it resides to a game. Those that can't escape in time are hypnotized into giving all the treasure back.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME attempts to strike intruders with its bone if they approach its pond. Should it miss, it follows with punches powerful enough to toss a tractor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, using powerful kicks to propel themselves through the water. Their legs are best suited for fighting underwater, able to move and strike as if they were on land.
author: santon5512

entry: Though POKENAME appears to have rather thin limbs, its entire body is solid muscle. Boxing gyms often use POKENAME to help demonstrate certain moves to newcomers.
author: mepp.

entry: Only POKENAME's eyes and arms are mobile. As the Water-type grows larger and larger, it grows closer and closer to evolution. Although its shell is firm, its insides are soft and vulnerable to piercing blows.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are very aggressive as they can be seen constantly sparring with other males. Its strong arms are not only used for combat, but they are also used for faster swimming.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wields its beefy whiskers with great skill. It fearlessly challenges bigger Pokémon to prove its strength.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME lives in freezing climates, spending most of its time in the water. It slams its sturdy body against ice floes and rocks as a form of training.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME alters its skin coloration to blend into soil near its preferred pond. If startled, it retaliates by unleashing a powerful Discharge.
author: .izik

entry: It doesn't seem to properly obey the laws of gravity when it jumps. If it hits a wall while jumping, it will continue upward movement until it leaves orbit.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: A POKENAME's skin color appears to be influenced by what biome it lives in. Green POKENAME have to be raised in colder climates to which they are not normally native. This Pokémon also has a voracious appetite.
author: fireblade141

entry: POKENAME spins silk stronger than steel beams, which it uses for its web and workout bars. When prey becomes stuck in its web, it spins in a circle to calm them with its spiraling markings, before pummeling them into submission with its fists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The light on POKENAME's head can emit a stunning flash to incapacitate foes, though it is loathe to use it unless truly desperate. It much prefers pummeling an enemy with its fists in honorable combat.
author: sk372

entry: Its shell is said to be stuffed with boundless energy due to its incredible endurance when swimming. POKENAME works tirelessly to spread joy and happiness to kindhearted people.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME have spent their time growing up on docks in large communities. Due to the amount of time they have spent near the water, they have become powerful swimmers. They enjoy spending most of their days on docks stealing from local fishermen.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Groups of POKENAME are responsible for bringing up many Water-Type Pokémon. They are tireless in their work, ensuring the young Pokémon are well cared for. Parents that are too sickly or frail to look after their offspring give them up to POKENAME.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME lives in dark sea caves and avoids confrontation. If it sees an approaching light, it casts Hypnosis to escape unnoticed into the depths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can survive at ocean depths that would destroy most man made vessels. Covert scientists have tried to hollow out the inside of POKENAME's body to use as a submarine, but its skin has proven too hard to pierce.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's bubbles burst with enough force to reduce boulders to gravel. After popping, they leave a sweet, honey-like aroma lingering in the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live at the bottom of the sea, where their watery bodies and rocky shells blend in. That shell is made of rock-hard muscle, so nothing can make it move if it wants to stay in place, or stop if it wants to travel.
author: imaginita

entry: POKENAME coils around foes, then simultaneously tries to entrance them with the spiral inside its mouth and bludgeons them with the fist on its tail. The punches delivered by its tail are powerful enough to crack concrete.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While in water, POKENAME spins, creating a powerful vortex. It uses this motion to overwhelm its foes, drawing them in and sweeping them off their feet before striking with powerful blows.
author: shyguy11011

entry: POKENAME is inescapable in even the most hazardous terrain since its serpentine body and powerful limbs give it unrestricted mobility. It must immerse itself in water every few hours or else its skin painfully dries out, limiting its abilities.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's powerful muscles allow it to climb steep rocky slopes and dig through tough terrain. Due to the raw amount of food needed for them to sustain themselves, they hibernate through parts of the cold season.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's powerful muscles allow it to climb steep rocky slopes and dig through tough terrain. Due to the raw amount of food needed for them to sustain themselves, they hibernate through parts of the cold season.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are an inconvenience to people using the internet as they pose as an advertisement for a lost method of hypnosis. What makes POKENAME particularly frustrating is that they make clicking the close button difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are an inconvenience to people using the internet as they pose as an advertisement for a lost method of hypnosis. What makes POKENAME particularly frustrating is that they make clicking the close button difficult.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its muscles are remarkably developed and never tire, even as it spends its days digging through rough terrain. Its claws take around four days to regrow or to heal if they break or if they become chipped, respectively.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's muscles naturally retain large amounts of water, helping it regulate body temperature. This ability is vital for when it engages in high-activity sports, such as wrestling. If it loses in a competition, it will camouflage out of shame.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It may look comical, but POKENAME being able to effortlessly move a massive fist while possessing a diminutive body is a testament to its strength. A Mega Punch from it could send a Golem straight through a mountain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have two fists, which they use to break large rocks. By destroying these rocks, they can raid the hidden burrows of underwater Pokémon. The spiral on the front of its face is used to hypnotize other Pokémon.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME's appearance is heralded by the sudden appearance of multiple whirlpools surrounding a pillar of light. It is rarely seen, only appearing when it must stop the most destructive of Water-type Pokémon from causing irreparable damage.
author: sk372

entry: Its craving for battle is unmatched. When it catches the scent of a nearby Pokémon, it wildly flails the fists on its sash about without any regard towards even its own safety.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME's muscular body allows it to fiercely guard its den near rivers. In battle, it coils its spring-like tail, then unleashes it with great force, striking foes with the heavy fist at its tip.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The springy elasticity of its ribbon-like appendages allows POKENAME to throw punches at mach speeds.
author: melodydelune

entry: Highly aggressive, POKENAME will attack anyone who enters its territory. It has been known to use its powerful tail to smash the boats of unaware sailors.
author: sautomagically

entry: POKENAME are able to compress and stretch their bodies using their control over spatial dimensions. They use this power to improve their combat prowess, making themselves challenging targets to strike in battle.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has mastered the art of keeping houses clean. Most of their work revolves around cleaning dishes and clothes, but it also waters gardens with a gentle mist and cleans tools with pressurized blasts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion lives near lakes where it likes to swim. Around it float bubbles that resemble eggs, but this is a ruse, as they are used for defense.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: Due to their four tough arms and powerful wings, POKENAME will attempt to take anything they want, usually succeeding. They occasionally scoop up and huck small Pokémon into bodies of water for entertainment.
author: chinigan

entry: POKENAME is known to never tire. Its body is built for unpredictability, flexibility and spontaneity, making it a fearsome opponent. Its origin remains unknown.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME adapted strong arms to climb up onto the land, but found it inhospitable. Now, it uses them to duel other aquatic Pokémon in frustration.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME rotate the larger section of their body as they move, hypnotizing foes with the spiraling pattern before suddenly turning another direction and hitting them with a rapid flurry of uppercuts or haymakers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME constantly emits steam, as its body boils any water that it absorbs. As such, it is highly valued at spas and fitness centers.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: POKENAME possesses incredibly resilient muscles that allow it to swim large stretches of ocean without issue. Since it is so tireless, it will constantly patrol coastlines in order to protect the sea from land-borne threats.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When submerged, POKENAME's cotton-filled body grows dense and heavy. It uses this weight to wrestle prey to the seafloor and pin them down.
author: .izik

entry: It still is deeply attached to the rubber ducky it had from when it was young. If any harm was to befall this toy, POKENAME would be sent into a rage.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME coats its gloves in a layer of scalding steam to push its opponents to their limits. It spends most of its time swimming in the clean waters of rivers and lakes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If a predator enters its underground lake den, POKENAME fires intense psychic blasts to induce sleep. It then drags the intruder to the surface and throws them away at great distances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of Hypnosis to stop intruders near its favored watercress beds. It digs pits and buries victims underground while they sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trains tirelessly to be able to swim across the entire world. Once it manages this feat, its forehead begins to glow and it gains the ability to use psychic powers.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME troops lay claim to large lakes, watching while submerged for anyone who dares to swim in their waters. They swim at those who rouse their anger, chasing their target to the point of exhaustion before tossing them out of the lake.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME troops lay claim to large lakes, watching while submerged for anyone who dares to swim in their waters. They swim at those who rouse their anger, chasing their target to the point of exhaustion before tossing them out of the lake.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When provoked, POKENAME is capable of spitting out a torrent of boiling bubbles without pause. These are able to reduce huge boulders to dust.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: Despite being unsteady on their feet, POKENAME punch with the force of a baseball bat. Should they bounce back from the attack and land on their back, they struggle to get to their feet without assistance.
author: chibitales

entry: If POKENAME spots prey outside its lake, it launches itself ashore with a Body Slam. It then drags the target into the water to finish the hunt.
author: .izik

entry: Records of POKENAME in ancient Kanto documents suggest this may have been POKENAME's normal form in the past. It lounges about, commanding loyal Poliwag and Poliwhirl to do its bidding.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefer to train their endurance by sitting beneath a waterfall. Their muscles never grow tired from fighting or swimming.
author: elite01.

entry: POKENAME love to flex their muscles, so much so that they find every opportunity to do so. They especially love to flex their chest muscles, which have an almost hypnotic appearance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Since POKENAME's muscles are not fully developed, it organizes boxing matches against other members of its group to become more skilled and stronger. It shoots bubbles from its mouth not only to fight, but also to communicate its feelings to others.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Lacking in brains but excelling in brawn, POKENAME keeps itself strong by taking a swing at the nearest thing it can. In most cases, this results in it punching its own tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is so proud that it never turns its back to flee from a fight, which is why the back of its shell bears no scars or scratches. It prefers to battle in water, where it can unleash the full power of its punches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Though it appears aggressive, POKENAME's first instinct on meeting others is to entertain them with hand-puppet shows. Those that don't seem entertained earn its ire, however, and it reacts violently to this criticism.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lurks in foggy waters, using its ghostly yet muscular arms to snatch unsuspecting Pokémon and Trainers into the depths. Its sinister laugh is the last thing they hear before falling unconscious.
author: motion_09

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's stomach never sits still, and those who gaze too long report feeling their consciousness being sucked in. This Pokémon is timid and dives away from human contact.
author: ghostslythe

entry: On its back, POKENAME carries a seed made of psychic energy, which it gathers during sessions of daytime meditation. With its power, it can levitate objects at will, though moving those that are too heavy forces it to rest for many hours to recover.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME looks just like a cicada shell or cocoon when it curls up to sleep. Many have disturbed its slumber, mistaking it for a golden beetle.
author: holgast

entry: When POKENAME hasn't had enough rest, its telepathic powers fail to function. In response, it releases a foul stench from its antenna to drive away predators or food thieves.
author: cinnamoncreampuff

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day peacefully resting near power plants. When startled, it teleports away with a bright flash, temporarily blinding anyone too close.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME have the collective acuity of a twenty-year-old person and use this wisdom to hide themselves from Trainers. They detect patterns in how Trainers move through a route and teleport to more secluded locations.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When wearing the bones of Alakazam, POKENAME exhibits stronger abilities due to lingering psychic energy in the skeleton. The same energy causes POKENAME to no longer sleep as soundly as it once could.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a common sight in tropical climates. Unfortunately, it is often mistaken for a fallen banana and eaten by other Pokémon.
author: holgast

entry: It waits day and night for its evolution to come. Every morning it teleports itself to a new tree, sometimes miles from the one it fell asleep in.
author: .izik

entry: It is timid despite its size, running away from threats before teleporting to safety. Because it continues running after teleporting, POKENAME has a tendency to appear out of thin air and smash into things head-first.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides its body behind a complex optical illusion. If an opponent stares for too long, they will get tangled up and trip over vines that aren't really there.
author: mogorian_gray

entry: A welcome sight in berry farms, POKENAME teleports from flower to flower, pollinating them as it goes. This uses quite a bit of energy, causing this Pokémon to sleep for most of the day.
author: afilthycasual

entry: It remains eerily still throughout most of the day, and will not fight back against anything that attacks while it rests. Unfortunately, if the head-like protrusion suffers critical damage, it loses its ability to regenerate its body parts forever.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When asleep, POKENAME will recklessly charge forward in a direction and not stop until it wakes up. If it is ever about to crash, it uses its telekinesis to teleport ahead of the roadblock and continue charging.
author: soup1900

entry: As soon as POKENAME senses danger, it teleports, but the distance of the teleport is rarely more than a body-length further. This leads it to quickly expending its energy with many short-distance teleports, causing it to fall asleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It angrily teleports to any enemy approaching its nest. It does this to catch its opponent off guard, allowing a surprise sting.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its immense mental power and anger tiring this young Pokémon out, POKENAME sleeps most of the day. Rangers seek out wild POKENAME to keep them sleeping and comfortable, lest they get nightmares and lash out in their sleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: As it transforms, it uses its psychic powers to also copy its target's mind as closely as possible. This has sometimes led particularly skilled POKENAME to forget their true self until the transformation wears out.
author: sk372

entry: An POKENAME holds three elemental evolution stones, not knowing which to choose. It waits around for its Trainer to choose one for it.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME teleports to low-traffic websites where it can feed unnoticed. If observed, it instantly vanishes after gorging itself on stored data.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can convert itself into digital data, enabling it to freely travel through cyberspace. It uses this ability to flee whenever its sleep is disturbed.
author: .jerden

entry: POKENAME can read the thoughts of others and discover if they have or are planning to do malicious actions on the internet. If it finds out they have or are, it uses its teleportation to teleport them far away from any electronic device or signal.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to hang from trees while it awaits metamorphosis. If disturbed, it will teleport away and relocate higher up the tree.
author: holgast

entry: It is always asleep, even in flight. Psychic energy allows it to maneuver through the sky with ease.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME are highly intelligent from birth. They devote their full brainpower to sleeping and the pursuit of food.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME uses its teleportation powers to travel between different environments. This allows it to feast on a wide variety of Berries.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME are highly intelligent from birth. They devote their full brainpower to sleeping and the pursuit of food.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's skin is soft after it molts, making it vulnerable to attack. When it senses danger, it will release a Dragon Breath towards the danger before teleporting away. Multiple people have reported POKENAME teleporting into their homes.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME sleeps atop a ball of psychic energy, which protects it from harm. It makes itself invisible so it can sleep without being disturbed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys mixing its Trainer's drinks with the spoon on its head, as it is always ready to help out in the kitchen. The small bumps around its neck secrete a sugary sap that enhances the flavor of caffeinated drinks like tea or coffee.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Because it can both teleport and fly, an POKENAME on the move is an odd sight. It will often meander and backtrack in confusion.
author: holgast

entry: If an POKENAME senses prey approaching while it's asleep, it will open its jaws and teleport into the path of the prey. Once saitsfied with its meal, it teleports back to its original position and falls back asleep.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Thanks to its internal organ that tracks the planet's rotation, POKENAME is able to sleep for exactly 18 hours every day. This allows it to master its psychic powers faster then other Abra fusions.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME sleeps for a majority of the day, but maintains a psychic link with any web it has spun. When it senses prey getting caught, it quickly teleports to the web to consume them so it can resume sleeping.
author: sk372

entry: When it hears thunder while flying, it teleports back to its nest using its psychic powers. POKENAME covers its head with its wide wings while resting to ensure a deep sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spend most of their days sleeping to try and hone both their psychic abilities and to retain their electrical energies. If they are awakened, they release bursts of energy and teleport away.
author: infinex21

entry: Whenever POKENAME teleports, it leaves a faint scattering of stardust behind. Though it lacks the value of normal stardust, some collect it and use it as a glittering decoration for their accessories.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bounces off surfaces in its sleep. It uses its psychic power by singing in an innocent tone to catch foes off guard.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Trainers often find POKENAME sleeping in trees. However, it is always keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings.
author: serversizeme

entry: When at rest, POKENAME resembles a little golden cloud. Its purring 'baa' sounds like a radio tower, and many of them together are quite noisy.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME only dance when they feel safe and secure. Only the most gentle and patient Trainers will see this timid Pokémon dance.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: It teleports itself in a random direction any time it is surprised. Even a simple sneeze could send it as far as the next town.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rarely touch the ground as they can levitate without exerting much psychic energy. When there are strong winds, POKNNAME lock themselves in place with psychic energy to prevent themselves from being blown away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Before teleporting to safety, it grinds its sharp incisors together to maintain focus. POKENAME moves to search for food only shortly before dawn, then sleeps for the rest of the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its detached arm to do basically everything as the rest of its body lies there dormant. It can even fire psionic blasts from the palm of its hand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can see a few seconds into the future, allowing it to predict its opponent's moves. Alongside its lightning-quick speed, POKENAME is able to dodge almost any attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: For some reason, most poweful cameras cannot properly capture POKENAME's form; it always shows up as a blur on the image, even when it is sleeping still. Only specialized cameras developed by Silph Co. have managed to capture POKENAME's visage.
author: bobosmith01

entry: For some reason, most powerful cameras cannot properly capture POKENAME's form: it always shows up as a blur on the image, even when it is sleeping still. Only specialized cameras developed by Silph Co. have managed to capture POKENAME's visage.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME drifts through wetlands in a trance-like state, unaware of its surroundings. If startled, it teleports a short distance into water. Its psychic waves soothe nearby Pokémon, making it a favourite among those who live in chaotic habitats.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's bulb absorbs sunlight while it sleeps, powering its psychic abilities. After it teleports away to avoid predators, the bulb noticeably sags and wilts slightly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will teleport from dumpster to dumpster, feeding on trash until they get startled and teleport away. There is practically no way to keep these Pokémon out of a person's garbage.
author: santon5512

entry: It's common to see POKENAME effortlessly teleport through the skies. Their highly developed instincts enable them to sleep while gracefully gliding.
author: akujules

entry: One of the only things that will make POKENAME awaken and come out of hiding is the scent of honey. Catching just a whiff makes it spring awake and teleport to the source of the sweet smell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleeps during the entire day, absorbing energy from the sun and gradually growing hotter until sunset. When night falls, it lethargically seeks food, teleporting away from any predators it senses with a blast of blazing heat.
author: notadoctor75

entry: Campers often wake to find Dream Mail resting on their sleeping bags. This is the work of POKENAME, who delivers these glowing letters to those who fall into deep, peaceful sleep.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Despite never opening its eyes, POKENAME can sense and differentiate colors. It uses its spoon to gather berries, mud, and other materials to make into paint.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME produces an arc of electricity while meditating to practice channeling this energy into a more potent form. If disturbed in this delicate equilibrium, it sends a bolt of lightning into the ground before teleporting away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Even while asleep, its tail ticks side to side like a metronome. It can still wield and direct its psychic abilities and electricity while asleep, making it a difficult foe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is an ephemeral presence in the Pokémon world because it rarely remains in one place for long. Whenever it realizes it has been spotted, it teleports away to another timeline or location.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This is an extremely rare Pokémon to find in the wild due to its tendency to teleport away whenever someone else is in the area. The only confirmed sightings have been during times when it is sorting out or polishing smooth stones.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses psychic powers to form mud into bricks that it uses to line the walls of its burrow. It will teleport to its burrow if it senses danger.
author: justin_general

entry: It spends 18 hours a day sleeping in trees. It uses humidity and its psychic sense to predict the next day's weather.
author: lydiaprower8

entry: POKENAME rapidly teleports in front of the path of prey in order to back them into an inescapable corner. It is usually asleep throughout the whole hunt, so the only chance the prey has in fleeing POKENAME is to wake it up.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME runs for over twenty hours a day, and even has the ability to run while sleeping. It senses when Trainers are around and is adept at dodging their attention with well-placed Smokescreens.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are shy creatures and are known to teleport away if they get anxious. If a Trainer meets one in the wild, that means that the POKENAME feels safe and comfortable around that Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME practice their psychic powers by levitating the poison they create. Unfortunately, they often fall asleep during their training, causing them to lose track of where they were at in their progress.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a heavy sleeper; while sleeping, its epidermis changes color to match whatever is around it in order to camouflage itself. When awake, however, it struggles to change color if outside of battle.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon's latent psychic abilities have affected the large flower on its back. The plant can now perform basic guard duty as POKENAME sleeps.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is able to predict when misfortune will strike. Many Trainers attempt to ask it for predictions of the future, but it teleports away before any answers are given.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sleeps for up to 18 hours a day. Its psychic powers alert it to people in danger nearby, teleporting near them and then whisking them away to safety, all without ever waking from its lengthy naps.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an austere expression that can be off-putting for some Trainers. It meditates in crypts or graveyards to attune itself to the dead and improve its psychic powers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Sailors are advised to tread carefully in areas known to be POKENAME habitats. Though the creature itself is nonviolent, should it sense a threat and teleport away, its sheer size would cause havoc wherever it reappears.
author: sk372

entry: Despite sleeping for a great deal of the day, POKENAME are always alert thanks to their large ears. They are popular with young Trainers, as people tend to find the way their ears swivel towards nearly every sound they hear quite adorable.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME sleeps for 18 hours a day. They constantly dream of battle, making it hard for them to distinguish sleep from reality during an actual Pokémon battle.
author: erod0467

entry: It sleeps soundly in unsuspecting people's spoon drawers. If the drawer it rests in is opened, it hurriedly teleports to another drawer far away.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME spend most of their day sleeping, relying on their psychic powers to passively sense any threats approaching their territory. If disturbed, they teleport behind the intruder and jab at them with their venomous horns.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME sleeps, its dreams are projected onto its surroundings as an illusion. This can make the forests where it lives extremely treacherous.
author: .realthree

entry: Sleeping for up to 18 hours a day, POKENAME will cling onto those they trust with their ribbon-like feelers as they snooze.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's diet is still being studied, but most experts agree it somehow gets energy from nearby metals and rocks. Some suspect this is why POKENAME often carries its spoon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are a timid Pokémon that prefers to be left alone. It sleeps 18 hours a day, using its large ears for shade.
author: tqz7

entry: While it sleeps, its head detaches from its body and floats around, listening closely for any approaching sounds.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME defends itself by creating a trio of floating orbs of fire. If an opponent is not defeated or deterred once all three are used, it retreats by teleporting away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can often be found due to its snoring. When heard sleeping, Trainers often find themselves feeling relaxed.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: Despite being constantly asleep, POKENAME is still fully aware of its surroundings, using its psychic power to sense everything around it. Legends claim that POKENAME will only awaken to grant the wish of a pure-hearted Trainer.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME burrows deep beneath meadows to rest undisturbed. If a cave-in threatens, it teleports to the surface before digging down again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes the star on its tail shine brightly to distract other Pokémon while it gathers psychic energy to teleport away and escape. Whenever it uses its powers too much, it needs to sleep for days to recover its strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With its psychic power, POKENAME manipulates the individual electrons in the air. The soft, fluffy fur covering it lets it nap anywhere.
author: .realthree

entry: With its psychic power, POKENAME manipulates the individual electrons in the air. The soft, fluffy fur covering it lets it sleep anywhere.
author: .realthree

entry: Although POKENAME loves singing, few have heard its beautiful song. As soon as it realizes it has an audience, POKENAME teleports away.
author: mistycloud

entry: Skittish by nature, wild POKENAME burrow deep into mountain caves, seeking solitude in the tunnels they carve. The iron plating on their bodies is forged from ore extracted during these excavations, serving as durable protection.
author: theartemis1

entry: The purple flame on its tail is an indicator of its psychic potential, flaring up when it uses its telekinetic abilities. Staring at the flame too long has been known to cause mild headaches.
author: sk372

entry: Its large ears and psychic ability have given POKENAME a reputation for causing signal interference. Some say it creates strange images on TVs nearby.
author: holgast

entry: Though at first it may appear that its eyes are permanently wide open, closer inspection reveals no such eyes to speak of. It prefers dim places.
author: fixthewifi

entry: POKENAME is extra difficult to capture due to its sporadic and uncontrollable teleportation. This occurs because the excess electricity in its body makes its cell structure unstable.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME lures prey with its psychic powers, then zaps it. If the lured Pokémon is too big, it pretends to be sand to hide.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME is often seen hiding in greenhouses, where its bright colours are less conspicuous. It teleports if threatened, making a mess of nearby pots.
author: holgast

entry: To this day, a wild POKENAME has never been photographed. POKENAME has highly sensitive hearing, and teleports away before any person or drone can get close enough to snap a picture.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME drifts on the breeze while it sleeps, using its telekinesis to avoid obstacles. When awake, it sings itself lullabies to go back to sleep.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time swimming while simultaneously sleeping. The protrusion on its head is a powerful psychic sensor, letting it sense danger in the area and teleport to a safer part of the sea.
author: sk372

entry: It can telepathically detect foes even while sleeping. If it detects anyone nearby, it teleports far, far away. Trying to catch POKENAME is seen as a rite of passage among some Psychics.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Sensory organs within the spines on POKENAME's head alert it to the presence of others nearby. This lets it know when danger approaches and teleports to safety, even as it sleeps most of the day away.
author: sk372

entry: The hair on POKENAME's body is incredibly sensitive to its surroundings, detecting the slightest changes in its environment. It hates being touched and will teleport away if anyone approaches it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME congregate around lampposts at night, constantly scanning their surroundings for threats. If they sense anyone approaching, they teleport away, leaving a cloud of toxic dust behind.
author: santon5512

entry: At night, POKENAME teleport to a special location in the wild to gaze upon the starry night sky. They glow with eager excitement as they watch the sky waiting for something exciting to happen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When blocked by solid rock, POKENAME may teleport to a random underground location. If it appears in sunlight, it panics and emits psychic waves that spread fear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a surprisingly hostile Pokémon. It sleeps for the vast majority of the day, though when it is awake it will attack anything that crosses its path.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME spits silky threads at intruders that draw near its home. Though the thread only has enough grip to slow something down, it gives POKENAME enough time to safely teleport somewhere safer.
author: sk372

entry: An elusive bird that tends to teleport in its sleep, POKENAME is actually quite brave when it's awake. Its habit of sleeping on its back with its legs in the air is often perceived as silly.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME are sly creatures that abuse their teleporting powers to steal coins. When they are inevitably caught, they teleport far away with their hoard of coins to avoid getting lectured.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME senses something sneaking up on it, it suddenly lets out a bellowing shriek of terror to alert other Pokémon to the danger, before quickly teleporting itself away to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its innate telekinetic abilities to enhance its defences, letting it withstand mighty blows. After it's struck, POKENAME attempts to counterattack, though it usually has very little energy left to strike back.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is popular due to its adorable habit of kneading, or gently pushing its paws in and out, while it sleeps. Because it sleeps most of the day, this behavior is observed frequently.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME cheers on others by teleporting constantly around them and showering them with sparks to inspire them. This act tires it out quickly, leading to it sleeping for several hours after a cheer session.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME teleports around forests, emitting psychic waves that cause intense migraines. The moment it disappears, the headaches subside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release a burst of psychic energy each time they arrive at a new location through teleportation. This energy causes headaches in the vicinity until they warp somewhere else.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to lose some blubber and thick insulating fur. When it dives, it forms a psychic bubble around its body to keep water out.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME are so lazy that they learn to teleport so they don't have to run while playing fetch. POKENAME are often sluggish and less active than other Pokémon, making them a good pet for people with limited physical ability.
author: laughing_dan

entry: After fusion, POKENAME's psychic powers have reached their maximum potential. It no longer needs to teleport away to safety, as it can psychically strike back against others even while it sleeps.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME subconsciously uses its psychic powers to gather shed fur from its surroundings and make itself a comfortable bed, as it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day. Its third eye opens while it sleeps to look out for any potential danger.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Its bright yellow head makes it easy to spot amongst foliage. Whole groups of POKENAME curl up together like vines for protection.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME plants its feet underground before it goes to sleep so that it can replenish the water in its body. If POKENAME senses an incoming attack while its trying to sleep, it simply teleports away.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME uses geokinesis to slowly form several rocks into fists for it to wield. This process is constant and even happens while POKENAME sleeps.
author: fireflower20002

entry: POKENAME does not actually move by floating; rather, it moves by using its magnet units to follow the magnetic field. Despite this, it prefers teleporting around, even if the distance is minuscule.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME are capable of tampering with electronics to obscure their presence. Even if a persistent Trainer manages to locate them despite the technical difficulties, this does nothing to prevent them from teleporting away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The two heads sleep in shifts, each one slumbering for 12 hours at a time. This allows POKENAME to always be aware of its surroundings so it knows when to teleport away from incoming danger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's two heads take turns sleeping for up to 12 hours at a time. If it senses danger approaching, it uses its strong legs to leap into the air out of danger, before teleporting away to ensure it escapes to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gathers spoons and similar objects littered across beaches to practice its telekinesis with. Battles are occasionally waged between them as they covet one another's trinkets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mustache grows similarly to a plant, growing quicker when given proper sunlight, nutrients, and water. Witnesses report seeing it use its mustache instead of vines while using Vine Whip.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity to stimulate its brain and increase its intellect further. Absorbing too much too quickly causes it to explode with psychic energy that leaves it and anyone in the vicinity unconscious.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mind powers are powerful enough to telekinetically remove all the excess material from a bone in seconds, leaving a perfectly-shaped spoon in its place. It rarely lets others touch the carefully crafted item.
author: sk372
