entry: POKENAME have lots of energy and enjoy roughhousing with their peers. They love when wrestlers come to them to demand a wrestling match because they get a chance to try new techniques.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its shell is actually a dense layer of highly developed muscles that POKENAME constantly trains by slamming itself against rocky walls. It has an incredibly high tolerance for pain, yet is terrified of anything that even remotely resembles a needle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME battle each other by swinging fists on their tails to deliver powerful, makeshift punches. The energy burning along a POKENAME's tail is directly tied to its fighting spirit, dimming if the POKENAME loses and burning brighter if it wins.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's workout regimen neglects its legs, only exercising its upper body. If it were to use a more balanced approach, it'd become unstoppable.
author: knilk

entry: The belt it wears helps regulate its ability to make ultrasonic cries. If it were removed, the decibel level of its cries would be enough to deafen any creatures within a 100 foot radius.
author: sk372

entry: Using its immense strength, POKENAME restrains prey before draining them dry. It then flies to its dark cave home to sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roll their body at high speeds by flinging themselves with their arms against the ground. They easily scale walls and roofs at a quick pace.
author: camtft

entry: Its three cranial fins are as hard as steel and poisonous to the touch. It can easily topple a sumo wrestler with its feet.
author: synaesthesis

entry: POKENAME soars through the sky, waving its arm-like wings. Its powerful glides carry it between mountain peaks with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Ranger academies use POKENAME to train members in handling Bewear attacks. Importantly, it's capable of restraining itself from inflicting any harm.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It will allow its trainer to hide from threats inside its faux house. It will then use its massive arms to repel any foe that may attempt to breach.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: It attacks with powerful arms, then appears to hide under huge underpants. This is really just a mushroom, but it bears a distinctive odor.
author: robosoup

entry: It is said if POKENAME ever dropped the weight in its tail, it could run faster than Ponyta. However, it enjoys showing off its strength, holding the barbell in a loose grip while powering up its Flame Charge.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Steam from POKENAME's nostrils carries a steroid-like vapor. Inhaling it may boost muscle growth - but often causes severe illness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's large hands double as wings, letting it glide great distances. In battle, it releases clouds of powder from its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being made of candyfloss, POKENAME's body is incredibly solid. This is due to POKENAME spending up to 20 hours each day exercising and training its fighting skills.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's powerful arms allow it to shatter otherwise impenetrable stones and hurl predators far away. This allows POKENAME to continue digging wherever it pleases.
author: bobosmith01

entry: To avoid drying out in the sun, it only emerges from the ocean at night. One enduring story about a terrifying beach-dwelling cryptid is now known to be describing this Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME ambushes travelers from alleyways, slamming the ground to startle them. It steals valuables to decorate its lair.
author: .izik

entry: It maintains a strong training regiment as a way to curb and control its more violent tendencies. Sometimes this temper still flares up in battle, leaving it disappointed and sullen afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will spar with each other constantly as a form of training. Their anger will usually get the best of them during these fights, often leaving them both with serious injuries.
author: santon5512

entry: Seeking the perfect balance of brains and brawn, POKENAME commits itself to honing both body and mind.  It perfectly schedules an equal amount of physical training and meditation, down to the millisecond.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a wise, intelligent, and dedicated Pokémon that is striving for greater power. It will travel across the world to learn various martial arts.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Meditating atop mountains, POKENAME channels its strength through its body. Without meditation, it suffers aching fatigue.
author: .izik

entry: Fusion has caused part of POKENAME's next form to manifest prematurely. POKENAME is not in control of the powerful extra limb, causing it no small amount of distress.
author: sk372

entry: Unrestrained by its belt, POKENAME's power level audibly pulsates with energy. It often fights just by flexing, not even needing to move its body.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME possess a high endurance and drive to become stronger, often pushing themselves to train for days with few breaks. POKENAME require a lot of liquids to stay hydrated for their extensive training, often costing their Trainers thousands.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME trains beneath roaring waterfalls to forge an unbreakable core. It can lift massive boulders using just a single finger.
author: .izik

entry: A master of both karate and jiu-jitsu, POKENAME uses its rocky body as a weapon. It can topple most foes in just a few swift moves.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME sees another of its kind, it will try to stop them midroll to test their strength. Should POKENAME succeed, the one who was stopped acknowledges the other as superior and will follow their every command.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME rolls while performing precise karate-like maneuvers. Its surprising speed leaves opponents struggling to predict its next move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a rather troublesome entity in the wild. In its eager haste to show off its strength, it has a tendency to run at people and hit them with a "playful" clothesline, often knocking them unconscious.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gallops up to travelers in open fields, flexing to gain admiration. After posing proudly, it runs off to find new admirers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is far stronger than it appears. Some say that removing the heavy Shellder from its tail will increase its power, but none have tested this theory.
author: hophoppip

entry: The three heads constantly headbutt one another to train for battle. The middle head uses the other two to punch and bite at opponents.
author: skymaster426

entry: They are often employed as strongmen for carnivals and circuses. Their true passion, however, is juggling.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME is territorial over the places it chooses to haunt. It will forcibly exorcise other Ghost types from the premises using its powerful arms.
author: sk372

entry: Sturdy, hard-working, and able to move through a variety of rugged terrain, POKENAME is popular with miners and hikers alike. It is constantly striving to improve its health, strength, and agility.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME adheres to a disciplined workout and meditation schedule. In its time off, it eagerly helps Trainers who are in need of physical labor.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's large pincer is composed of muscle, bone, and skin, and lacks a chitinous outer layer, so it cannot safely come off. It is very driven and eager in personality, so it isn't hard to train with proper direction.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If POKENAME gets proper nutrients, their muscles will be larger and more defined. They sunbathe before strength training to have more energy.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Often considered a titan among Pokémon, POKENAME is actually fairly weak. Despite this, most Trainers shiver at the sight of this swole "Pokéchad".
author: trakito

entry: POKENAME launch lightning-fast punches to overwhelm their opponent but get tired after unleashing their attacks. Their poor sportsmanship leads many of them to explode in anger if they are unable to achieve victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its rotating horn carves slate from cliff sides. At dawn, POKENAME lifts the slabs above its head as a form of daily training.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME forces its foes close with psychic powers, and then pummels them with multiple sets of powerful arms. It has pride in the sheen of its jewel.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's legs are strong enough to support extremely heavy loads. It has quick reflexes and can dodge most attacks with ease.
author: rigelpogi08

entry: Despite its gelatinous body, it possesses incredible power, and its four arms can deliver very powerful blows. POKENAME changes the appearance of the belt on its body depending on the type of opponent it faces.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME perches on tall stone pillars and steeples and remains perfectly still until it sees its prey. It swoops down and takes out its target with one hit.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME often smack their wings together with such ferocity that it disorients anyone nearby. Anyone unfortunate enough to get smacked by the wings themselves suffers a quick defeat.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME is the champion of mental and physical duels. It complements its martial attacks with bursts of psychic energy that disorient its opponent.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's muscular arms lack the dexterity to weave complex webs, so it instead ensnares prey by using a single strong thread like a lasso. Once a target has been reeled in, the fists beat it into unconsciousness.
author: sk372

entry: Using its immense strength, POKENAME lifts large boulders even while in flight. It often trains by carrying heavier stones each day.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME live solitary lives within forests. They use their mighty arms to create burrows for when they sleep during the day, then they come out at night to hunt prey.
author: cobalt0135

entry: In its fighting stance, POKENAME is able to bring its arms up so they look like they are coming out of its head. It does this to intimidate opponents, as it would much rather avoid conflict altogether.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: In its fighting stance, POKENAME is able to bring its arms up so they look like they are coming out of its head. It does this to intimidate opponents, as it would much rather avoid conflict altogether.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Compared to its reversed counterpart, POKENAME is more patient and reflective. As a result, it makes an excellent teacher for martial artists.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME problem is considered the worst job for Pokémon pest control specialists to be called for, due to their strength and tenacity. Often an entire team is needed just to take care of a single POKENAME infesting a home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME considers itself the strongest of the clawed Pokémon, a title it defends fiercely.  When not honing itself, it cleans its claws to make sure they always have a pristine shine for it to flaunt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME crawl near mountain hiking trails in order to pick up garbage left behind by careless hikers. They come out en masse every weekend to carry massive bundles of trash to the nearest landfill, ensuring their homes remain clean and tidy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With four arms, POKENAME can more easily balance its massive upper body against its tiny lower body. The size of its belt symbolises its place in the hierachy, with the bigger one belonging to the leader.
author: krune

entry: Though it's usually seen walking on all sixes, POKENAME will stand on its hind legs and use its powerful arms to fight against tough opponents.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly strong. Swings from their belt are powerful enough to shatter bone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are capable of paralyzing foes with a menacing glare. They wrap their tail around foes to restrict movement before they unleash a flurry of punches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is always working out: it will jog while eating, do bicycle kicks in its sleep, and will even do push ups or crunches while being milked. It has prehensile tails that it also incorporates in workouts, such as upside-down sit ups.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME keeps a massive boulder in its cavern home that it deems its greatest challenge. POKENAME constantly searches for larger stones to test its strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail is a heavy weight. At first, it is unable to walk far from the weight, but over time, it develops the strength to lug its tail around.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME wield their long tails as whips during battles with other Pokémon, lashing out with them at high speed. Their tails are reinforced internally with dense bones to help them survive the impacts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though small, their four arms are strong enough to reduce boulders to fine grains without tiring. Their muscles are so dense that, by tensing, they can repel many physical blows.
author: infinex21

entry: It spends its days lifting large fallen tree trunks to maintain its impressively muscular physique. The sweat POKENAME releases into the air carries a fragrant aroma capable of purifying the surrounding atmosphere.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is so obsessed with working out at the gym that it floods its Trainer's digital devices with spam messages. The more it is ignored, the more aggressive its pop-up messages become.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its two pairs of claws make POKENAME exceptionally effective at both burrowing and slicing up foes.  Due to this, it has been used in excavations in treacherous places like Cerulean Cave and Mt. Silver.
author: empty_set

entry: When angered, POKENAME strikes the ground with all four of its fists at once. The impact sends fiery shockwaves racing across the battlefield.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's bodies are almost entirely muscle, allowing them to carry up to 20 tons. They haul boulders to their territories, constructing walls to keep intruders out.
author: santon5512

entry: Its punches are strong enough to form small black holes. POKENAME is at its most dangerous when there is a threat to its Trainer, as it will unleash all of its mental and physical strength to protect them, often to devastating effect.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Due to POKENAME's wide range of skills, it can be found working a variety of jobs. It can use its strength in wrecking crews and its steadiness in carpentry, and it can even sense plumbing issues before they get out of hand.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: The flower on the back of POKENAME is so heavy that they need all their limbs to support themselves when they move. Their leg muscles become so strong that they can shatter boulders with a kick from their stout limbs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Proud of its strength, POKENAME dares any it comes across to challenge it and hit it as hard as they can. It gifts the belt it wears around the head to the first challenger that manages to make its durable, heavy body flinch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleeps for days at a time to conserve its energy for competitive bouts. The force of its blows can rattle the whole forest.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: It has a rugged and powerful body that gives POKENAME the courage to fight in almost any condition. It will fight wildly to protects its young, doing whatever it takes to make sure their foe never threatens them again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME senses a tornado forming, it slams its fists into the ground repeatedly. This ultimately makes many people more afraid of POKENAME than the storm it's warning of.
author: .izik

entry: Though they're often mistaken for genies, POKENAME will not grant you wishes. If you try to ask for a wish, it will beat you up and then disappear.
author: jokerswild

entry: This formidable warrior dominates the battlefield with its impressive strength and commanding presence. With powerful metal-like fins, it delivers crushing blows while exuding an aura of regal confidence.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME search for groups of Pokémon, then proclaim themselves as the new leader. Although they may act very tyrannical at times, POKENAME are willing to sacrifice themselves for even just one of their subjects.
author: autismgaming89_51746

entry: Wielding POKENAME multiplies one's strength immensely. While it never lets anyone remove the Power Save charms which limit its power, there are ancient myths of a man with herculean strength, and some believe he was using a POKENAME at full power.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Between its hard hitting punches and its strong whip-like attacks, POKENAME is extremely powerful. People call it "The strongest merman of the sea".
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's pride in its strength makes it something of a bully, pushing others around with its immensely powerful arms. In the wild, it appears to have an intense rivalry with Hariyama.
author: sk372

entry: The muscles on the ribbons of POKENAME are over twice the strength of its already powerful legs. A single punch from POKENAME can shatter diamonds.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME smashes cave walls with its tail to break off marble blocks. It lifts them over its head to train until sunrise.
author: .izik

entry: Its colossal size harbors even greater strength. Were it given the opportunity, POKENAME could lift the weight of the entire world.
author: theemeraldflygon

entry: When one is fighting, the shockwaves from its impacts shake the surrounding area for miles. Some dojos have banned this giant from their premises.
author: rihse

entry: Despite being docile, POKENAME are easily startled. Trainers should avoid surprising it, lest they end up on the wrong side of its muscular ears.
author: watergin

entry: POKENAME trains in the desert as it waits for an opponent to fight. The only thing more powerful than its jaws is its endless flurry of punches.
author: bunkachunka

entry: Take care on beaches that are home to POKENAME. If you accidentally step on POKENAME, it will send you clear over the horizon with one punch.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME is constantly looking for new challenges to strengthen its smaller heads with. Imbalances in its different body parts' strength and looks seem to distress it.
author: sontyp

entry: It comes to this world when least expected, usually to protect humanity from hostile legendary Pokémon. It's amorphous but strong, and always modest.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME possesses incredible arm strength for its size, but its legs are relatively weak. For this reason, it prefers to train against slower Pokémon.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME can lift over 800 pounds with its strong jaws, and it grabs large rocks or logs to decorate its nest. It will try to stand on its back legs as an intimidation tactic, even though it struggles to keep its balance.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME works along assembly lines to bend and fold steel rods into components used to build large machines. It takes a break every hour to apply lubricant to its joints before continuing its work.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME taunt talented fighters to try and test if anyone is worthy of the championship belts that they flaunt. If a POKENAME deems a Trainer worthy, it will agree to travel with them, but it will still refuse to hand over the physical belt itself.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: After feeding, the ridges on POKENAME's head radiate heat. It hunts silently at night, waiting to ambush weakened prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its four massive arms to pummel prey into submission before devouring them. It actively refuses to eat anything it hasn't properly punched beforehand, even a treat from its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is trained in every form of martial arts. It takes advantage of its small size to deliver poisonous jabs in close combat.
author: synaesthesis

entry: POKENAME lingers in swamps, waiting for passersby. It rips entire trees from the ground to impress onlookers with its power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME unleashes soundwaves to knock stalactites loose, then leaps upward to shatter them mid-air with powerful kicks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can lift up to 50 times its own body weight with its four strong arms. However, its legs are not as strong, so it struggles to move larger objects.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are known for their obsessions with fungus, using their own bodies as gardens to grow more and offering these mushrooms out with their many hands to whoever might need them. They dislike growing toxic fungus as it can drain their power.
author: deadshields

entry: POKENAME's only desire is to get stronger, often raiding broccoli and spinach patches. It has often been seen deadlifting Supersize Gourgeist as a show of its strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: The large weight on POKENAME's head weighs over a thousand pounds. It will often hold it up with at least two of its hands when resting.
author: atlas3339098

entry: Though it has legs, POKENAME prefers to float between training sites. It can effortlessly lift steel slabs twice its own weight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats near people exercising in parks or gyms. If someone struggles, it blinks a gentle light from its lips to silently encourage them.
author: .izik

entry: Its four powerful arms deliver unstoppable blows, even underground. It tills soil with precision, leaving fertile ground in its wake.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME attack their opponents from below, delivering a barrage of punches through the ground. These punches are strong enough to send much larger opponents flying.
author: santon5512

entry: This fickle Pokémon is incredibly prideful and wears its gem-laden belt on its head to show off. Its bragging is not without merit, however, as it can punch hundreds of times in a second.
author: flickeredflame

entry: With their large soft bodies, POKENAME absorb more hits than most Fighting-types can in combat. Using their four arms to hold down rivals, POKENAME then open their mouths, knocking them out with an unbearable stench.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME are easily enraged, attacking anything they see. Their four arms are extremely powerful, capable of hurling much larger opponents past the horizon.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME coils its powerful body to constrict prey, zapping them with electricity if necessary. When it is not hunting, it is training, improving its flexibility, strength, and swimming abilities through various exercises.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Though fascinated by archery, POKENAME lack the patience for delicate aiming. When a shot misses, they charge the target instead, unleashing a blinding flurry of fiery strikes.
author: zekkenbytheden

entry: POKENAME has a hard time balancing its body on land due to its legs being much more muscular than the rest of its body. Therefore, it prefers to rapidly use its four tails to swim at blinding speeds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are warriors striving to strengthen their mental aptitude and abilities. Wild POKENAME are unspeakably rare, but they can be seen meditating deep within caves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Terrifyingly powerful energy radiates from this Pokémon. POKENAME who have completely mastered both the psychic and physical arts can flick a foe away for miles with just one finger.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Capable of throwing psychic-powered punches able to crumple thick steel walls, POKENAME can foresee attacks nanoseconds before they occur. However, due to the adrenaline in its body, it'll often endure the attack to its otherwise frail body.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Even though POKENAME have small bodies, their strong arms give them the strength to push through any challenge. Many help construction crews lift steel beams to complete projects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Living near fighting dojos, POKENAME mimics the movements of martial artists. It often shows off by lifting heavy weights.
author: .izik

entry: Due to having so many heads and arms, POKENAME virtually has no blind spots in combat. Nothing has ever defeated this Pokémon in hand-to-hand combat.
author: soup1900

entry: It can deliver punches twice as fast due to having twice as many arms. Outside of punching, however, this extra set of arms has no dexterity, even when using simple tools.
author: soup1900

entry: A punch from this Pokémon has been described as getting hit by a bomb. It can also volley these punches thousands of times in a second.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has been seen covering large ships in poison. It is calmed when music is played, as it claps along to the beat.
author: larryloud55

entry: Catastrophic rockslides and avalanches are caused by the sheer force of a single POKENAME punching the ground, forming the belief that POKENAME can literally move mountains. Humorously, calling out “my dude” attracts the attention of POKENAME.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: They pick up trinkets from Trainers that pass by and use them to make themselves sturdier. They are particularly fond of a Power Belt since it is the easiest to attach to themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME trains by lifting massive chunks of basalt over its rugged body. Its footsteps shake the ground beneath it.
author: .izik

entry: In the wild, only POKENAME that have caught and wrestled with a variety of aquatic Pokémon evolve into POKENAME. As POKENAME gains strength, it seems the being on its tail grows in power, too.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can manipulate the strength of their magnets to pull upwards of 500lbs of metal. They anchor themselves to machinery to absorb electricity. Removal often ends in serious injury as POKENAME launch themselves at anything that disturbs them.
author: chibitales

entry: Although each head has a unique brain and personality that sometimes causes squabbles, this grants POKENAME a powerful memory. It incorporates everything it has learned throughout its life into its overwhelming battling style.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses its mighty claw to pin opponents in place, leaving them helpless against the crushing blows delivered by its muscular arm. To keep its body in peak condition, POKENAME shatters boulders along the shoreline.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The sprout on its back shares the main body's senses, firing a stream of toxic spores at threats. When it rests, the sprout will defend it tirelessly.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It will burrow its body deep in the soil to absorb nutrients. The more nutrients it takes in, the larger its bulb will grow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wields the thick vine in its hand as its weapon of choice; supposedly, the vine was plucked from the overgrowth near a parent's remains.
author: craigprime

entry: It uses its large tongue to taste the soil for optimal nutrients. Once it finds a suitable nesting spot, it will bury itself deep in the dirt.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers to rest in hollow logs. Once inside, it extends its roots to absorb nutrients, which it uses to harden its shell.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has adapted unique traits to ease its crippling shyness and aversion to strangers: it traded long limbs for a vine cluster in which it hides.
author: ziggaway

entry: First thought to be a regional variant of Skrelp, POKENAME has recently been proven to be its own distinct species of Pokémon. They use their root-like tails to attach to kelp and hide amongst the plants, keeping safe from larger Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The leafy limbs of POKENAME sprout vines to drag themselves towards kelp forests. When a large predator is nearby, they plop down onto the sea floor and cover themselves with sand.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Surprising flexibility allows POKENAME to move through twisting tunnels and tight spots relatively easily. They live in shallow waters, but only surface completely during some evenings.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME enjoys dancing under the tropical sunlight. When it dances with intense concentration, it can even float just slightly off the ground as if by magic.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are raised in nurseries for their ultra-absorbent roots that constantly grow from their bodies. Arborists reinforce the roots of saplings with POKENAME roots to ensure the saplings get plenty of water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME were once hunted by apothecaries for their absorbent roots, which were believed to suck away curses and hexes. Nowadays they are raised in nurseries for those same roots to create emergency sponges to soak up blood.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Groups of POKENAME will invade the walls of a home to consume the wood and insulation. They are timid and will abandon the house if someone sees them for even a moment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME quickly eat their fill by flying from forest to forest siphoning nutrients from existing root networks. Ancient alchemists once believed that POKENAME roots can suck away curses and diseases.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's roots grow wildly in random directions and places due to its irregular genetics. However, it will always try to use its roots the same way other plants in the area do to optimize its water and nutrient intake.
author: soup1900

entry: Depending on where it lives, the fluids POKENAME creates can either be acidic to melt metal or sweet and delicious to lure in prey. There have even been a few cases where this fluid evolved to accelerate its own genetic growth and mutation.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME infiltrates agriculture websites and consumes plant-related files. If it senses sunlight nearby, it will emerge directly from the computer screen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers to fight from a distance. When it feels threatened, it shoots peas from its mouth at whoever approaches it.
author: napstabl0ok

entry: POKENAME will embed their roots within suitable logs, using them as shells to protect themselves. They will feed off any moisture in the log, abandoning it once it's been sucked dry.
author: santon5512

entry: It lays on the forest floor and uses the roots coming out of its body to absorb nutrients from the soil. Once it takes in enough, it will begin to evolve.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dig their root-like feet into the soil to feed on latent nutrients. While feeding, they protect themselves with their razor-sharp leaf-shaped sickles.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME are so rife with energy that they must shed their skin almost every day to accommodate their growing bodies. The fluid that leaks from their mouths is rife with this energy as well and can melt iron with ease.
author: infinex21

entry: Lacking the means to produce toxins on their own, POKENAME gather nectar from poisonous flowers and produce toxic honey. They store this honey in their thorns, utilizing it as a makeshift venom.
author: vic1312

entry: POKENAME are often brought into classes where they help teach children about how Pokémon eat. POKENAME have three methods of eating: absorbing nutrients in the soil, creating food through photosynthesis, and eating other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It spits globs of acid on the ground near its nest to deter others from approaching. It will create its nest with twigs, pebbles and vines that it collects from the immediate area.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will forage for leaves in the forest, hoarding them in their burrows. When winter comes, they will use this stockpile as food.
author: santon5512

entry: They flutter around in the early morning, looking for nectar. When night comes, they rest in a secluded, hidden spot, such as bushes, and bury their feet into the ground, which act as roots.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A scourge of herb gardens, POKENAME gather fragrant leaves to add to their webs. Whether they do this because they enjoy the scents or because it serves to lure in prey is being studied.
author: afilthycasual

entry: At night, it will cover itself in nearby vines to keep warm. If awoken by a predator, it will fire acid from its mouth at the offender.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves of POKENAME collect energy from sunlight. If it daydreams outdoors for too long, it discharges electricity from its mouth.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME's body has markings similar to a Togepi's shell. It waits near sleeping Togepi, picking them off one by one by spraying a thick, brown acid.
author: .izik

entry: After resting in the sun and absorbing moisture through its roots, POKENAME habitually dances. While it dances, an odd-smelling ooze drips out of its mouth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spend their youth buried in shallow soil, gradually growing strong yet light leaves above the ground that will one day lift them into the air. On windy days, entire fields of POKENAME are plucked out of the ground and spread upon the breeze.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spend their youth buried in shallow soil, gradually growing strong yet light leaves above the ground that will one day lift them into the air. On windy days, entire fields of POKENAME are plucked out of the ground and spread upon the breeze.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spend their youth buried in shallow soil, gradually growing strong yet light leaves above the ground that will one day lift them into the air. On windy days, entire fields of POKENAME are plucked out of the ground and spread upon the breeze.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME use the flowers on their heads to draw in Bug-type Pokémon with their sickly sweet scent in the hopes of catching them as food. Bug Catchers will lurk around fields of POKENAME hoping to catch rare Bug-types drawn to them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: After scavenging through dumpsters, POKENAME retreats to a safe location to eat. Once full, saplings sprout from its tail, releasing a calming aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the acid it creates to kill weeds that try to steal its nutrients. Farmers typically use this Pokémon as a natural weed killer.
author: soup1900

entry: It locates vegetable fields and burrows its roots into the ground nearby. It then injects nutrients into the soil to help crop growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail is used in salads. It has a very strong flavour, so it is cut up small and sprinkled on top. POKENAME is able to regrow its tail in a few days and is happy for its Trainer to take it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's sprout on its back will shoot poison at enemies. If severely threatened, the sprout can shoot enough poison to be lethal.
author: duskit___

entry: After it eats, POKENAME will attach itself to a tree and hang there for days, completely docile and unaware of its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: When sleeping, POKENAME root themselves in fields to absorb nutrients. Both their heads are equally capable of fighting.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME will cling to trees, brewing a potent acid beneath their tough shells. When threatened, they will fire this acid from each of their mouths, melting anything they hit.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME buries the bottom half of its body in the ground, sunning itself with its chlorophyll-rich wings. When disturbed it releases a puff of poisonous pollen, using the puff as cover to uproot itself and fly to safety.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME root themselves in dense foliage to absorb nutrients from the soil and surrounding berry trees. The moss that grows on their shell has different smells based on the type of berry tree POKENAME absorbed nutrients from.
author: chibitales

entry: It spits a yellow nectar on the ground in areas that it claims as its territory. The nectar is incredibly viscous and foul scented.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers volcanic areas with abundant ash and fertile soil where it can take root. Despite its appearance, it is friendly and docile by nature.
author: snowybubble

entry: POKENAME buries the bottom half of its body in the ground, sunning itself with its chlorophyll-rich wings. When disturbed it releases a puff of poisonous pollen, using the puff as cover to uproot itself and fly to safety.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME roosts on branches upside down, spreading its wings to photosynthesise and craning its head upward to mimic a fruit. Its mouth secretes a honey-like substance that draws Bug-type Pokémon to it, enabling it to easily find food.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's three heads hide within its overgrown, sturdy body until it's time to feed. All three heads must eat a large amount of insects to sustain its heavy girth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tails are cultivated and mixed with other herbs to produce an Energy Root, a bitter clump of roots that heals Pokémon. They prefer humid climates, so POKENAME nurseries are built near jungles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's head pops up from its body when its surroundings are sufficiently bright. Should the area around it grow darker, it tucks its head into its body until light returns.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME expels torrents of acid from its mouth to weaken foes. The quantity of acid increases significantly if it has recently eaten.
author: .izik

entry: When threatened, it will spit colored acid on a flat surface to hide from foes. This camouflage is almost impossible to differentiate from a painting by even the most accomplished experts.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon produces a colorful acid from the tip of its tail. When POKENAME is in danger, it will cover itself in this acid as camouflage. Fortunately, the acid is surprisingly mild and will only burn it if left on exposed skin for many hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tails are cultivated and mixed with other herbs to produce a Big Root, a large clump of roots that help Pokémon absorb nutrients. Their underbellies look like a large predator, which causes other Pokémon to leave them alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It will stand on trees and raise its long, root-like tail to the sky during thunderstorms. A single lightning strike can satisfy a POKENAME's hunger for weeks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its root-like tail to capture bug Pokémon. Once its prey is in its grasp, POKENAME incapacitates them with a strong electric shock.
author: darkweavile428

entry: When perfectly still, POKENAME are indistinguishable from a Bonsai plant. Many monasteries have POKENAME living among the monks to facilitate a calm atmosphere.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy copying the movements of other Pokémon and are known to sprout roots to create extra limbs to copy multi-limb motion. Scientists are studying these auxiliary limbs to improve prosthetics for Trainers and Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The edges of its mouth have a thin layer of acid on them. It uses this acid to burn through the hard outer skin of an Apricorn and drink the juice inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its long tongue to scrape moss from trees. If it overeats, its root-like legs become unsteady, making it difficult to walk.
author: .izik

entry: The vines that cover its body will frequently dry out and fall off. Many medications use these vines as an anti-inflammatory for injuries.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrow under gardens to release roots that connect to other plants in an area. This allows it to grow quickly by absorbing nutrients and moisture without moving.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's three heads work in tandem to fire seeds from their mouth to repel opponents. It seems to have a strong vendetta against Ghost-type Pokémon for some reason.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's metal shell encases the caustic juices it uses to digest bugs. It inhabits jungle caverns where it uses its powerful roots to anchor to the walls to rest.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME consists of a colony of Bellsprout parasitizing the husk of a Metagross. It is animated by the interconnected root system of the Bellsprouts, allowing them to control the husk.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is covered in many thorn-like, poisonous barbs though to be for protection. It secretes a highly toxic fluid from its mouth, which it can focus and spew at threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its false mouth to hide among groups of Bellsprout in the wild. The fake mouth secretes an acidic sap that stuns the plant Pokémon, making it easy for POKENAME to prey on the unsuspecting group.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in large coral reefs. It can use its mouth to create a strong suction that allows it to simply suck in everything that swims above it.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME lives in large coral reefs. It can use its mouth to create a strong suction that allows it to simply suck in everything that swims above it.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME crawls slowly across the bottom and sucks up small, nearby Pokémon with its mouth. It can survive in water as well as on land.
author: chorb33

entry: Its vine-like head is protected by hard metal plates. POKENAME uses these plates, along with a shed plate it carries around, to make cymbal-like percussion music.
author: hophoppip

entry: The roots that grow from its body are extremely durable. Should a POKENAME take root at a location, it will sleep there while it absorbs nutrients.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are strong enough to lift a tree and its roots from the ground with minimal effort. A potent toxin brews within their bodies, which can be loosed from their mouths or from the plants at the ends of their tails.
author: infinex21

entry: A parasitic tree has taken over POKENAME, giving it a large, bulky body. Its large eye serves as its only sense, and it can be seen stumbling around the forests at night.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's roots are said to be able to extend for miles underground in mere seconds, letting it sense the health of plants across entire continents. One drop of its sap-like drool can supposedly revive dead plant-life instantly.
author: sk372

entry: Most of POKENAME's body is made of tough woody roots. Its Bellsprout flowers can fire Acid attacks in two directions at once.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME remain almost motionless for large periods of time, causing their backs to be overgrown with plant life and riddled with parasites. These two are at almost constant war with each other, fighting for nutrients.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME dwell in the treetops, spitting poison at foes from above. When enraged, the leaf on their rear will ignite.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME partially bury themselves in the ground during the day, leaving only their large photo-synthetic ears poking out of the dirt. At night they will dig themselves free and search for more nutritious soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Miniature Bellsprout known as "wards" guard its body, spitting slimy acid at anything that tries to pick it up. The wards are controlled wholly by the spirit of the departed Honedge whose body they protect.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME leaks a fluid from its mouth that can melt iron, though the iron that makes up its blade won't melt.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are highly defensive of their territory, finding a spot with great sunlight and water access and fiercely battling competitors away from it. Their roots help to anchor them in their fights, keeping them from being dislodged.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When capturing prey, POKENAME will wrap its vines around them and pull them into its mouth, which contains a corrosive fluid.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's hand-like roots flit around, digging among the dirt and trees of its surroundings. When it finds a nest of insects, it awakens with a manic expression before the coffin opens up and shovels the bugs hungrily into its body.
author: sk372

entry: Each of its tails holds the flavor of a different herb. Each tail gets consistently more bitter in flavor the older the POKENAME gets.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's thin and flexible body lets it easily evade attacks. They use their head and hands to shoot plant projectiles at enemies.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: This special Pokémon sits unmoving in a forest as it slowly decays. When it does move, it releases unrivaled natural might.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME clings to branches with its vine-like head and rarely moves. Its relaxed nature hides its potential to unleash surprising strength when necessary.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME often likes to camouflage itself as an unassuming flower to attract prey. When a small Pokémon approaches, POKENAME uses the long vines on its head to ensnare it, paralyzing its prey with shocking thorns before swallowing it whole.
author: catpetter8

entry: While it whistles it can control vines. POKENAME uses these vines to immobilize prey and consume them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live amongst mangrove roots, using the complex tangled maze of the tree roots as hiding places. They have a single large leaf that they bask with at the water's surface, flailing it rapidly to propel themselves to escape in emergencies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As POKENAME can also absorb its nutrients from metals, it grows in urbanized areas, factories and construction sites. As the metal becomes brittle after a while, it is considered a pest.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME constantly tries to avoid setting its leaves alight on its open flame. This makes POKENAME extremely paranoid, though its shocked expression rarely changes.
author: z1gg13

entry: POKENAME sprout vines to take care of the bulb atop their heads by keeping it clear of debris. When an herbivorous Pokémon tries to eat them, they sprout razor sharp leaves that cut at the face of the herbivore.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flowers on this Pokémon contain incredibly toxic barbs. While it normally only hunts small Bug-types, POKENAME also enjoys luring large prey through use of trickery.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME spits acid on prey as it floats near creeks. Once its target is incapacitated, it carries them away with its string-like vines.
author: .izik

entry: The fluff on its waist is made up of trillions of tiny roots. It will soak these roots for hours within a stream to absorb as much water as possible.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slowly dissolves Bug-type Pokémon into its membrane by soaking them in its gelatinous body. Once dissolved, the nutrients are absorbed through the exposed roots within the gel.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses its round mouth to suction onto the sides of trees. It will utilize a small amount of acid to burn into the bark and drink the sap.
author: .izik

entry: It spits a sticky, smelly fluid at trespassers from its perch on cave ceilings. This fluid also tends to attract lots of small insects, so most travelers avoid POKENAME habitats.
author: sk372

entry: The roots growing from the base of POKENAME's body can extend up to three times its length. A slight electric charge runs through them, paralyzing small creatures upon contact.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its wiry arms to anchor itself in uncertain terrain. They have been found clinging to cliffs, tall trees, and even large Grass-type Pokémon.
author: staghorn

entry: The leaves on its body can be ground into a paste to treat minor scrapes or cuts. They regrow rapidly when exposed to water.
author: .izik

entry: Its leaves smell like a mixture of sage and oregano. Their taste, however, is exceptionally bitter and they are completely inedible unless boiled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leaves are packed with chlorophyll, enabling them to generate huge amounts of energy from sunlight. They use this energy to spit acid from their central mouth, launching the acid several meters.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The heavy leafy fronds covering POKENAME's body protect it from the elements as well as attackers. The leaves are coated with a sticky, toxic substance that leaves painful, acidic burns on bare skin.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sprout at riverbeds, but as soon as their leaves grow, they rise to the water's surface. Once afloat, they drift together as a colony, carried by the river's current.
author: slowforest

entry: Belleanie that remain submerged for too long evolve into POKENAME, with leaves that grow into long, heavy legs. They struggle to walk but excel at swimming.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME swings between trees with acrobatic finesse, using its vines to perform surprise aerial attacks. Its opponents are often caught off guard by its combination of stealth and wrestling prowess.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often found where predator Pokémon lurk, feeding on leftover or otherwise inedible material. All parts of their body taste incredibly bitter, so they are generally safe from attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's frills change color and become more vibrant as it absorbs sunlight into its body. It shakes the frills to shed pollen to paralyze or poison predators chasing after it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flourish in damp grassy areas. Bird Pokémon aiming to scoop them up as a snack will find they are incredibly bitter.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It lives in mushroom forests where the peat below its feet is brimming with life. Whenever it rests, it burrows into the ground and releases spores to maintain the nutritious peat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a popular Pokémon to keep in ponds and aquatic tanks. Though shy and rarely seen within the displays themselves, they perform the important role of cleaning up after other Pokémon and maintaining high water quality.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The leaves on its body exude a terrible stench while it sleeps. This deters thieves and predators from its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's oaken carapace is sturdy, but hinders its mobility greatly. It stores seeds in its stomach to spit out as projectiles to ward off potential predators.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell steeps an herbal tea that is popular in Hoenn as a soothing nighttime drink. It exudes a gas from its mouth caused by the brewing tea, which is used in some colognes to give them an earthy scent.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME linger around monasteries to observe monks meditating and often join in on this practice. They also help chase away malicious spirits that try to interfere with meditation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are most active after storms, hiding among the scattered leaves. They take large drinks of water before traveling away from the lakes they call home, helping them stay hydrated and energized.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: In combat, POKENAME will drench its foes in a highly flammable liquid from its mouth before setting them alight with its tail. However, if POKENAME isn't careful with the liquid, it will quickly burn itself to a crisp.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME make their home out of hollow logs, which give them a fresh supply of Bug-type Pokémon. They can also surprise small rodent Pokémon by pouncing out of the hollow logs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: After extended digging, roots sprout from POKENAME's body to absorb nutrients. It carefully limits intake to avoid harming nearby plants.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's three heads are on constant alert for danger deep in its jungle habitat. Each head is capable of firing peas at rapid speed.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME flowers bloom in a trio of colours in an effort to appeal to different Bug-Type Pokémon. The nectar their three flowers produce have different flavours; one being savoury, one spicy, and one with a mild numbing effect.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Within the last few months, a small number of POKENAME have appeared on Golden Island. Using their roots, they promote vital vegetation growth.
author: .izik

entry: A favored partner of monks, POKENAME can stand strong for days at a time as it patiently waits for prey to approach.
author: hophoppip

entry: While POKENAME's legs are thin, they pack incredible strength. When it eats sap, its legs grown even stronger, allowing it to run at fierce speeds.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME slurp water with their large mouth and store it in their back, heating it to a comfortable warmth. POKENAME snuggle up to those who suffer from chronic pain, offering relief like a hot water bottle.
author: vic1312

entry: It stands at the edge of ponds for hours at a time without moving. It will use the tiny roots on the edges of its feet to absorb moisture from the mud.
author: .izik

entry: The spores that come from its fur are highly nutritious. In the past, these spores were used to create a less-effective Dire Hit.
author: .izik

entry: The seeds that it fires from its mouth are hot enough to melt metal. Large amounts of these seeds can cause forest fires.
author: .izik

entry: It is almost impossible for POKENAME to fly without singeing their wings on their tails. Because of this, they will root themselves into the ground, concealing themselves with their wings and waiting for prey.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME hops onto its swirled belly and swipes with its leafy tail to sweep foes off their feet. This swift motion is copied by many professional wrestling and is known as “The POKENAME Sweep”.
author: quackquackattack

entry: There is an herbalist in Crown City that utilizes a POKENAME's leaves to create artisanal Awakenings. These Awakenings have a slightly minty scent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resides in temples and monasteries to meditate. It lives an ascetic lifestyle by eating very little and restraining itself from playing with other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body bends to allow its heads to pass nutrients back and forth. Farmers allow vines of these Pokémon to grow to defend their garden walls.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its body will glow slightly at night to entice prey. It will vomit a purple acid from up to 10 feet away in order to incapacitate its meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy roots and leaves to climb throughout mountainous terrain in search of food, primarily bug Pokémon. When it finds an area with prey, it will root itself and pretend to be a boulder, snapping up anything that lands on it.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: On sunny days, herds of POKENAME will race each other through open fields, soaking up the sunlight. At night, it extinguishes its flames and plants its roots to drink from the soil while sleeping.
author: comfortablybrum

entry: POKENAME run through open pastures to absorb sunlight and graze on the grass. When the sun sets, their flames grow dim as they siphon nutrients from their roots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sinuous leaves forming its tail absorb impurities from the water it swims in. If anyone dares touch its shell, of which it is very proud, POKENAME retaliates by spraying them with cold jets of water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME becomes active in sunlight and dormant during cloudy or otherwise dark weather. However, it also moves all about during thunderstorms. Whenever POKENAME is awake, touching it results in feeling a slight buzz.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME consumes metal by melting it with its acid and absorbing it. It can form metal bolts in its body and fire them at enemies.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A restaurant in Daybreak Town utilizes the leek in a POKENAME's mouth to create a special stew. Tourists come from all around Sinnoh to enjoy it.
author: .izik

entry: One of POKENAME's heads is always alert, even when the other is sleeping. Between its agility and wiry necks, POKENAME is able to avoid almost any incoming attack.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's two different heads help work together to consume a variety of prey. Its bird-like head can spear bug Pokémon with its beak, while its plant bulb head spews acid to help dissolve tough exteriors for easier consumption.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Each POKENAME head has their own personality and preferences, leading to frequent arguments among the heads. Hunting is one of the rare occasions where they can focus and avoid fighting amongst themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces enough gooey nectar to cover its entire body. The nectar's sweet scent attracts lots of Bug-types, which get stuck in it before POKENAME consumes them.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are wrapped in leafy foliage to better disguise themselves within kelp forests. Their small mouths are unable to open wide enough to eat small aquatic Pokémon, so they opt to eat bones instead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have small mouths that cannot fit most aquatic Pokémon, so they gather fish bones using their vines and digest those instead. The only time their shell slams shut is when there is danger nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.
author: chorb33

entry: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can create suction with its mouth to pull everything surrounding it in like a black hole. No one knows where the consumed material ends up.
author: chorb33

entry: Using the powerful acid stored within their bodies, POKENAME will burrow through the ground. They will swallow other borrowing creatures whole.
author: santon5512

entry: It formed a bubble on its back that looks similar to a seed. When it rains, it will soak up the raindrops to grow the bubble.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hides in its shell when it spots any Flying-type Pokémon. It will endlessly eat algae, with no intention of stopping.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The individual POKENAME with the larger, sharper glasses appears to be the leader. POKENAME has an excellent sense of teamwork, combining their attacks to easily overwhelm larger foes.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME enjoy lounging in the summer sun at tropical beaches, as they wear sunglasses under the shade of an umbrella made out of scutes. Their laidback attitude is contagious, prompting many weary Trainers to rest with them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME defends itself with the bone, skull, and shell fragment of fallen Blastoise. It tries to appear brave, lowering the skull to obscure its face so nobody can see it cry.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are usually loved at birthday parties. It can be bounced around like a beach ball while blowing bubbles, which helps it create more.
author: skymaster426

entry: The tough exoskeleton of POKENAME protects it from attacks. It stays near ponds, quickly darting to the water when it spots bird Pokémon in the sky.
author: mepp.

entry: While POKENAME's bodies are naturally rather sturdy, they still harden themselves to make sure their sensitive insides are protected. If they attempt to harden themselves too many times in a row, they will be unable to move until it wears off.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is always swimming or waddling around in a state of joy. This joy is highly contagious, and any fish Pokémon that find themselves tangled in the vines of POKENAME usually don't want to leave.
author: komodo360_31320

entry: The shell upon its back is hard enough to protect it from most bird Pokémon. POKENAME propel themselves with strong blasts of water to escape danger or to ram obstacles.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have thick plates forming parts of their cocoon, the shell covering their most vital areas. They retain their limbs whilst pupating and can waddle away from danger, albeit at a slow pace.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: An exceptional partner amongst Kantonian gardeners, POKENAME is highly valued for its ability to generate a fine mist with each flap of its wings.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME have cerulean-colored limbs that they can tuck within their shells to protect themselves from danger. Each of their arms can fire bubbles and bursts of water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME eats lots of leaves to ensure it has enough energy to go through the entire metamorphosis process. Its only defense mechanism is its ability to spray water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME were once endangered because of intense hunting of the species, but thanks to the efforts of a diligent breeder, they are no longer endangered. Trainers are still advised to avoid approaching baby POKENAME because of their protective nature.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As it slithers along the shore, its tough shell shields its squishy body from flying Pokémon. If turned onto its back, it melts away in the sun.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME blows bubbles at attackers before retreating into its shell for protection. The shell's coloration will change depending on its surroundings, particularly just before evolution.
author: sk372

entry: Inside the POKENAME's shell is an internal flame sac, which it uses to heat water to its boiling point.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME can completely revert its body into data and store it inside its shell, turning itself into a living flash drive. While in this state, it becomes impossible to hurt and is unable to have other data injected into it.
author: soup1900

entry: When it feels threatened, it will secrete a foul-smelling liquid from its eyes and roll into a ball to allow its carapace to keep it safe. It can occasionally be found in small, forest ponds.
author: behondalog

entry: POKENAME hangs from tree branches where it hides in its shell until its metamorphosis is complete. It squirts water from the crevices of its shell whenever it is threatened in the hopes of deterring predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These vicious Pokémon often form rowdy flocks near coasts. They terrorize beachgoers by swooping down and delivering brutal bites.
author: cyberleviathan

entry: POKENAME can jump high enough to be able to withdraw into their shells and deliver devastating Body Slam attacks. They hide in their shells when they sleep, which echo loudly due to their snoring.
author: infinex21

entry: Friendly POKENAME were once abundant in hidden ponds. Unfortunately, poachers hunted them to near extinction for the shells on their heads.
author: cyberleviathan

entry: It prefers swimming to flying, able to swim across entire oceans in a few hours. It follows along ships it comes across, watching over them and guiding them through rough waters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a small stinger that is soft and underdeveloped. It instead shoots streams of water or venom to deter threats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The bubble that POKENAME forms around itself is created by its psychic power. Attempting to disrupt this bubble results in a powerful concussive blast, incapacitating any who are unprepared for this attack.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: When attacked, POKENAME will flap its wings to kick up sand, then proceed to hide in its shell. If the attacker persists, POKENAME will fight back by squirting water.
author: darkweavile428

entry: With a set of sunglasses and padded scutes over their body, POKENAME are always ready to have fun. One of their favorite activities include tug of war, where they can use their jaws to tug as hard as they desire.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bobbles its head back and forth for every second that passes. This makes retreating into its shell difficult, so whenever it is in danger it spews out a watery foam.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If a POKENAME becomes separated from its group, it will immediately withdraw into its shell and won't come out until it is reunited with others of its kind.
author: darkweavile428

entry: While POKENAME may act intimidating, this act always falls flat. More often than not, it wins through accidental charm rather than its fierce facade.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME hides in tall grass to ambush Bug-type Pokémon, which are its primary source of food. When it spots a suitable target, it shoots a jet of water to stun its prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to its poor control over its electricity, POKENAME will often accidently shock fish Pokémon whenever it enters the water. Afterwards it will hide in its shell in shame.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME dances under the moonlight around lakes, channeling lunar energy. Its horns shoot bubbles that shimmer in the night sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many resorts will keep POKENAME around their pools. Its soothing voice helps ease patrons' worries, and it is more than happy to wade in the water.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME have tough shells made out of the remnants of an egg. This shell can shed small pieces to accommodate their growing bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's shell acts as a shield from electrical charges in the water, allowing it to attack without worrying about its health.
author: notsaying.

entry: Though its shell makes flight difficult, that doesn't stop POKENAME from trying its best to soar. The shell at least protects its otherwise fragile body.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME releases small bubbles of water whenever it flies above trails and other natural pathways. The trails have warnings that remind people to carry umbrellas to avoid getting wet whenever it takes off.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever POKENAME is in danger, they thump their tails against their chest to call upon their kin. After they are out of danger, they offer to give a watery bath to whoever rescues them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An easygoing Pokémon, POKENAME enjoys floating across the ocean waves in the sea breeze.
author: volvonovic

entry: POKENAME's shell allows it to swim quickly in the water and catch fish Pokémon. Since it continuously produces offspring, the fish Pokémon population in areas where POKENAME settles quickly decrease.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME surround the hand at the end of their tail in a bubble of water to splash foes with a slap. This simple prank entertains many wild Pokémon that observe them from a distance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sprays water in the form of bubbles from its top. It is loved by farmers due to its ability to be planted in a field and water plants around it.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's wings are as sturdy as its shell as well as waterproof. When in danger, it tucks its whole body into its shell to hasten its flying retreat, diving into the nearest body of water.
author: sk372

entry: When frightened, POKENAME tucks itself into its shell. Its head is too large to fit inside though, so it closes its eyes, seemingly thinking that if it can't see the danger, it is safe.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon is a master of all things that glide, riding a skateboard, Surfboard, or anything with ease. Coastal kids admire its balance and style as it shreds over land and sea alike.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are simple creatures that enjoy staring at wildlife around them. On the rare occasion they are pestered by another Pokémon, they retreat into their shell until the other Pokémon loses interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are used by some swimming coaches to help teach children how to safely swim in large bodies of water. They have a docile demeanour that makes them ideal for working with children, and their psychic powers can help if an emergency arises.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are used by some swimming coaches to help teach children how to safely swim in large bodies of water. They have a docile demeanour that makes them ideal for working with children, and their psychic powers can help if an emergency arises.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When the full moon shines in the sky, POKENAME feels more energetic, to the point of boosting the effectiveness of its Water-type moves. It always stands in defense of its Trainer, often behaving a bit overly protective.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When the full moon shines in the sky, POKENAME feels more energetic, to the point of boosting the effectiveness of its Water-type moves. It always stands in defense of its Trainer, often behaving a bit overly protective.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME perch on small trees, firing jets of water at nearby berries with its shell-like helmet. Despite this, POKENAME hates being wet and will stay away from any body of water.
author: mistymagius

entry: The bubble on its back has somehow grown into a bud. It is able to fully submerge the leaves it grew without drowning them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME eat twice their body weight in berries, seaweed, and fish Pokémon. They hoard excess berries in their burrows, but their fast metabolism means that they rarely keep that hoard for long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts just above the water to avoid hungry predators. It often forms small whirlpools to protect itself when in danger.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are frequently seen during the rainy season, gleefully jumping in puddles and dancing in the rain. They are popular amongst school children with their child-like whimsy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME pull bug Pokémon out of burrows using their beak to secure their next meal. When faced with a larger predator, they tuck their wings in and hide inside their shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once POKENAME enter their shell, it becomes incredibly difficult to hurt them. They ferment Berries in this shell to ensure that they have a steady supply of Berry Juice. Many stick straws into a POKENAME's holes to drink this fermented juice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From its horn, POKENAME blasts high-pressure bubbles strong enough to crack tree bark. It then sips the leaking sap with delight.
author: .izik

entry: It lets its paws sit in a myriad of liquids, creating tastes unique to every POKENAME. The most common substance is honey, but other liquids, like cola, have been observed.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME pecks at bug Pokémon burrows with their elongated beak. They release foam from their beaks that slowly floods burrows, forcing bug Pokémon to find an exit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are common denizens of ponds and lakes in colder climates, even if they have frozen over. They quickly withdraw into their shells if ever attacked and propel themselves with water jets to escape or counterattack.
author: infinex21

entry: Shy yet curious, POKENAME slithers around the sea floor, grabbing whatever it's interested in. It retracts into its shell when it hears loud noises.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME love to store anything small that catches their interest in the large hollow shell they carry around with them. When they meet a person for the first time, they will pull out a random item and offer it to them by way of greeting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing with baby Pokémon but often intimidates them with its large size. Learning to contain its excitement is a big challenge, as it loves to spray water from its mouth when excited.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Now lacking a shell but gaining a streamlined body, POKENAME has become adept at agile swimming, both offensively and defensively. For its own safety, it rarely slithers onto land before it evolves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their trunk to suck in water to spray into their mouths. This trunk can also reach behind their back to hose down any mud stuck to their shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME normally plays in ponds with a carefree attitude. Should a predator draw near, it joins with others of its kind to Lock On before firing a burst of bubbles with enough force to crack stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's antlers are covered with a film that becomes soapy when wet. After emerging from a body of water it leaves behind a trail of bubbles while frolicking around.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: POKENAME cooperates well with others as it seeks to learn from and emulate those it admires. It is often found on ships helping with sailing tasks, learning skills that will influence its evolution.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Once POKENAME has constricted a foe with its tail, it will repeatedly bash them until they are unconscious. Due to the shell creating an awkward bump on its belly, POKENAME has a hard time slithering on land.
author: soup1900

entry: When frightened, POKENAME releases a scalding steam from its mouth. It frequents thermal pools, floating in the water.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are too big to tuck into their shells, so they spray milk at other Pokémon who are mean to them. They also have the option of rolling over other Pokémon if it means being left alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever POKENAME are slighted in any way, they act petty and cause inconveniences towards others. One of the ways they get back at others is by creating a patch of mud for Pokémon to trip on.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If its shell crackles with electricity, it means it is nervous and irritable. Since it spends most of its life in rivers, POKENAME is an excellent swimmer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME amble along riverbeds in search of food, relying on thick stony shells for protection. When they must move quickly, they create buoyant bubbles to lift themselves and drift with the current.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME loves to dance to loud carnival music. The shells on its head keep its ears safe.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME spend much of their time collecting smooth stones and pretty shells that wash up on shorelines. Their hydrodynamic shell and light weight allows them to easily float on top of the water.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spend much of their time collecting smooth stones and pretty shells that wash up on shorelines. Their hydrodynamic shell and light weight allow them to easily float on top of the water.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spray high pressure water at their opponents, dousing them and the area. Once everything is soaked, they indiscriminately shock the area around them, the water they've laid down amplifying the effect of their attack.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has an unquenchable thirst, leading it to guzzle down large quantities of water and other fluids with abandon. When it belches, it launches out destructive Bubbles.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME tunnels underground to locate soft clay to consume. If the clay is too hard to eat, they spray water onto the clay until it is soft enough to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Bubbles blown by POKENAME are made of nutrient-rich water, allowing them to create waterside nests surrounded in dense foliage. During the breeding season, they decorate the foliage with various vibrant berries and flowers to impress potential mates.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME defend themselves with small fireballs and dense bubbles. They can withdraw into their shells and propel themselves with bursts of steam.
author: infinex21

entry: Found in groups near large lakes, POKENAME form groups to swim together, leaving no one behind. When the seasons change, POKENAME will go where the water is warm, occasionally stopping to check that everyone in their group is present.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: POKENAME tunnel underground by shovelling dirt with their claws. If the dirt in front of them is too tightly packed, they spray the area with water to loosen the dirt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are quite timid, hiding out in coral reefs. They use their fins to sense their surroundings, tucking their bodies into their shells when they sense danger.
author: santon5512

entry: To support its heavy shell, POKENAME's back legs have toughened. Its slow demeanor makes it quite popular among the elderly.
author: shocktopus1717

entry: POKENAME has the ability to sense people's emotions. If it senses hostility, it sprays foam powerfully from its mouth.
author: brapollo

entry: A fun loving Pokémon that will spray their Trainer with water as a harmless prank. If POKENAME detects sadness or anxiety in their Trainer, the water spray will psychically change their brain waves, lifting their mood.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME's shields are as hard as steel, able to defend against most attacks. They whip their tails at foes, hiding behind the safety of their shells.
author: santon5512

entry: When the weather is hot outside, POKENAME sprays its nestmates with water to keep cool. This activity helps it develop bonds with its nestmates by encouraging social play.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although these Pokémon can change most of their bodies' colors to blend in, they will withdraw into their shells if anything draws too close. In battle, they wrap their tongues around their foes and use their shells to ram them.
author: infinex21

entry: The shell on POKENAME's back is only partly natural. It gnaws on wood to fashion flexible armour pieces, which help to protect it from attacks. The older a POKENAME is, the more armour it will gather along its shell.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME can often be found sleeping in shallow ponds and rivers. As it slumbers, other wild Pokémon come to feed off the plant on its back.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME likes to take mud baths alongside its nestmates. If weather conditions are too dry, it makes its own mud by spraying a dirt patch with water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is considered a very cute Pokémon. However, Trainers should be cautious, as it doesn't know its own strength yet.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME love to play with others but engage in reckless play that can harm their nestmates. They make an effort to be gentle so that their sheer size does not hurt anyone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have hearts that are the size of a Snorlax and blood vessels so large that a Squirtle could swim down them. They have a thick layer of blubber that keeps them warm in the cold sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using the flammable liquid their stomachs produce, POKENAME will create fiery bubbles. While POKENAME finds these bubbles quite amusing, they often cause a great deal of damage to their surroundings.
author: santon5512

entry: Playful and docile, POKENAME are Kanto's only native monotreme. Be careful: When provoked, it can inject a potent neurotoxin from a hidden barb on each heel!
author: mogor0771

entry: A favorite among human children, POKENAME loves to play with others using water and by sliding around on its belly and shell. Yet despite its friendly demeanor, this Pokémon turns rude and may lash out when its fragile pride is damaged.
author: infinex21
