entry: POKENAME is incredibly meek and hides within its bell, which is actually a lightweight but durable shell. It positions itself in a sunny location so the light reflecting off the shell's gems lures in prey.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has outgrown its protective shell, leading to cracks and its soft body becoming exposed. The tentacles transfer a powerful toxin, which scientists have been studying for medical use in small doses.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in marine tunnels. It has a specialized biological system that limits and filters its salt intake.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives in marine tunnels. It has a specialized biological system that limits and filters its salt intake.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves Slowpoke tails and can be seen chewing on each other's tails. If left undisturbed, long chains of POKENAME can be seen lined up on the beach.
author: mistymagius

entry: While POKENAME may look like a Slowbro, it is actually quite different in many ways. It often fights with Slowbro for territory.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A strange and curious Pokémon that appears almost like an odd-colored Slowbro. Science remains baffled at the fact the main body can retreat completely into the much smaller shell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hovers around coastal areas where the dirt and sands have high deposits of metallic minerals. Its tongue has a slight magnetic pull; it finds sustenance by dragging it through the sand to collect said metal minerals.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME smashes holes in icebergs using its blunt horns. It stores pearls inside the frozen cavities like a secret vault.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lies on the seafloor, enclosing its thick shell when larger predators get close. It has trouble getting around as its heavy shell is attached to its underbelly.
author: mistymagius

entry: Packing much greater size than a normal Shellder, POKENAME has minimal offenses, and instead possesses a very rigid and sturdy shell. It often helps smaller Pokémon by letting them hide within it while it clamps shut.
author: sk372

entry: Spirits that linger where Shellder have passed away, POKENAME have a very sullen, sorrowful disposition. Being licked by one will cause a person to be overcome with an urge to cry.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides with its shell closed on the sea bed, hiding amongst Shellder and pretending to be one of them. It waits for hunters or divers to come close before bursting its shell open with a ghostly cackle to scare them off.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has been observed pinching its own tongue on occasion. It's thought that this stimulates the muscle in order to keep it highly sensitive to its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's oversized claw possesses a tremendous gripping force when clamping down. It crushes large objects within its claw as a threat display to deter predators from bothering it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME excitedly run around poking things with their long horns. If a bigger Pokémon tries to retaliate, they will quickly tuck themselves back into their shells and let their poisonous spines do the work for them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Using a skull as armor plating and a broken spine from a Cloyster, POKENAME is an agile underwater hunter. It's adept at using the spike as a thrown spear to skewer fish to make its next meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be seen chiseling away at its bony helmet to create its signature spiky appearance. It fires daggers of compressed water to attack any foe threatening it or its young.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses spines from its cranial shell as weapons, coating them in a solid layer of ice to increase their effectiveness. When backed into a corner, it can retract its entire body within the durable shell to avoid damage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME need plenty of nutrients to evolve, so in addition to their indigo cocoon they have a small, hinged shell that allows them to eat. Whenever they are attacked by predators, their hinged shell slams shut.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It latches its mouth onto coral and uses pressurized water to break it apart. The coral it eats contains nutrients it needs to strengthen the spikes on its body.
author: .izik

entry: It shoots bubbles at high speeds from its nose to break coral into smaller pieces, which it then feeds on.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live near waterfalls where the cascade of water protects their pearls. They typically leave other Pokémon alone to keep the location of their pearls hidden, but may offer one as a reward for helping them escape a hungry Ursaring.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will grow spikes on its shell where it has sustained substantial injury. Those with the most spikes are assumed the alpha of their clan.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME hates people trying to ride them, intentionally trying to jab them with its spikes. Its sturdy shell is strong enough to withstand an entire iceberg falling on it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can harden its gelatinous body to make itself more resistant to damage. When it transforms, it often adds shell-like coverings and spikes to better defend itself from attackers.
author: sk372

entry: With a shell too heavy for long flights, POKENAME instead lived as a fierce undersea hunter. Its wings allowed it to swim at high speeds, firing spikes from its shell at schools of fish, feasting on the skewered victims.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appear much slimmer when their shell-like bodies are closed, which allows them to trick prey into drawing near. They will clamp their bodies down around foes and prey and constrict them until they cease to move.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are a migratory species that travel from one beach to another throughout the year. Many are unable to complete the long journey because they are picked off by Flying-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It follows tankers across the ocean, drawn to the noise and movement. Sailors often spot it clinging to the hull, riding along, hoping to be unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers to live near lighthouses, where it basks in the glow of the beacon. Its presence is considered a sign of good luck for sailors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of quickly swimming away from predators and only rely on their shell when they hunt for food. They clamp down with their shell to snap tentacles or fins off of other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An elusive Pokémon that is said to float onto land on the winter winds. It occasionally spits out small flecks of salt that its body cannot digest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME eat bleached coral because of their sickly-looking color. As pollution in the sea continues to spread, colonies of POKENAME grow more numerous.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Sailors rely on POKENAME to communicate with other ships when their equipment fails. Their malleable shell allows them to morph into basic messages that can be seen with a telescope.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the sea floor, opening its solid shell partially in order to filter-feed. If it catches sight of something approaching, it quickly closes its shell and fires off pointed ice projectiles from the holes on its sides.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ingest sea water to inflate up to 4 times their size. This water is then expelled to allow its round body to swim. They can often be found by sandbars, terrorizing wild Kingler.
author: bass.

entry: It propels itself through water by releasing pressurized jets of water from within its arms. The horns of a POKENAME are cold to the touch and have been hardened by living within deep waters.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME melt the stone of coastal shelves and fuse with the surface. They wait patiently for unsuspecting prey to pass by before spewing magma over their target, covering them in quick-cooling rock.
author: wiz0z

entry: Its streamlined shell allows for it to cut through the water as it propels itself backwards with a stream of pressurized water. Unfortunately, it can't ever see where it's going.
author: .fedoraman

entry: It thrives in tidal waves, using the powerful currents to propel itself forward. The chaos of these waves makes it feel most at home.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon shoots burning hot steam at enemies from its mouth and the protrusions in its armor. Solitary but violent, POKENAME prefers to be left alone but will fight relentlessly if provoked.
author: frokachu

entry: Fishermen call POKENAME the "Dragon of Warfare". It hides behind a powerful shell, only opening for the briefest of moments to fire a shot in the opponent's direction, before retreating back under cover.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses water propulsion to move among the waters. It releases stored electrical energy to maintain homeostasis. Excess energy discharged from POKENAME ensures stillness among life amid the waves.
author: anarchaz

entry: Sometimes, POKENAME is found underneath the piers of port towns, resting until the coast is clear; when no one is around, it will surface above water and bask in the sun.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME glides across cliff sides to attack prey. Its natural armor is incredibly tough, but chips easily in water.
author: themicelegion

entry: It endures the heat by wading in mud or greywater and may do so for an extended period of time. Once it awakens, it shakes off everything atop its back, sending mud and water everywhere.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hides among clams and seashells on the seafloor to avoid danger. If caught, it creates psychic spines from the horn on its forehead to fire out and stun an attacker so it can attempt to flee.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wields a spear and wears armor created by the remains of Cloyster it has defeated. It can imbue the spear with aura in order to make it much more powerful in battle.
author: sk372

entry: Its steel armor has been tempered by the pressure of ocean waves, rendering it resistant to any impact. POKENAME hurls itself at ships that dock along the shores it controls, battering them relentlessly until they are destroyed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Smaller Pokémon will often take shelter in or around POKENAME's hardy shell. To defend them, it wields sharp points attached to its shell via lengthy extendable vines.
author: sk372

entry: During floods, it moves swiftly through submerged areas, providing aid to stranded Pokémon. Its resilient shell allows it to traverse fast-moving waters with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Even in the hands of trusted Trainers, it is needy and vain. If its pearlescent mace isn't polished regularly, it will slowly sap its Trainer's life force until they polish it well.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME camouflages itself among sharp rocks to ambush unsuspecting prey along the shore. It coats the spikes on the sides of its face with electricity to fiercely confront any challenger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME from tropical seas develop differently colored horns based on their diet. They primarily consume red corals, causing their horns to reflect the same vibrant hue.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME from cold seas develop differently colored horns based on their diet. They primarily consume ice and frozen organisms, causing their horns to reflect the same cool shade of blue.
author: .izik

entry: When threatened on land, POKENAME will shed the pearls strung along its feelers; its pearls will be replaced in only a matter of a few days.
author: melodydelune

entry: A common tactic POKENAME uses in battle is to fly around and perform strafing runs with its Spike Cannon attack. Onlookers note that it looks akin to a fighter plane from war times when it does this.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME float above the sea to hunt for prey. They typically eat Flying-type Pokémon that dive into the sea for food, but can also eat Water-type Pokémon that leap out of the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has plating on its hands and its mask that are made of the same material as shells. It can be shy and cautious because it is worried it may break its mask.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Yachts often attract this Pokémon, where it glides alongside in search of food. Its presence near luxury vessels adds a touch of the wild to tranquil waters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's horn contains venom that causes anyone injected to experience symptoms of hyperthermia. While not fatal, this venom causes their prey to exhaust themselves much faster. Their shell-plated bodies act as armor against each other's horns.
author: chibitales

entry: It can propel itself forward in the sea at great speeds, but has trouble with making turns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grow dense shells from their heads, the two halves growing downward to either side of their body. They rely on their shells to protect them from harm as they walk along the ocean floor.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME often targets other Necrozma for light energy since its shell body can't be penetrated by any of their lasers. It fires volleys of laser spikes to burst open the prism armors of Necrozma and give it access to absorb their light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME drifts close to the seafloor, its pearl-like head glowing a deep blue as it sleeps. If disturbed, it retaliates by unleashing a powerful Aurora Beam.
author: .izik

entry: A clever, sneaky fusion that favors stealth over full frontal assault. Blame it if you witness a barrage of Icicle Spears seemingly from nowhere.
author: jaycielantern

entry: It scavenges dead coral for food, breaking it apart with its powerful shell. This habit keeps reefs clear, allowing new coral to grow in its place.
author: .izik

entry: The pressure of the deep sea has made POKENAME's shell as tough as an iron suit of armor. It exposes a single opening in its defenses only when it lunges forward to strike with its claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Flying at high speeds, POKENAME seals its shell to protect its sensitive eyes, forcing it to fly blind. As a result, it is frequently observed tangled in power lines and disrupting flocks of bird Pokémon.
author: eiskitsune

entry: The pearls POKENAME creates emit a natural cooling aura. It stores them deep in its den during summer to keep itself comfortable while resting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are part of a popular game where new lovers open their shell to reveal the pearl inside. It is said that lovers that pick a large pearl will have a long-lasting relationship, which inspires many lovers to stick through tough times.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lures in treasure hunters with the promise of a pearl inside its large shell. Once a diver gets too close, it'll slam its shell shut and trap them as its prey.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME often wears a malicious expression. It thinks that its shell protects it as it causes mischief, but it actually has several weak spots.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's smooth-looking body is merely a facade; opponents who attempt to bite it may even break their teeth! While it cannot move forward in a straight line, it moves with surprising agility, especially in moister conditions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often live near coastal cliffs or grottoes. They devour hard seashells and sometimes even Shellder with a sickening crunch.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It clings to underwater cliffs, using them as both shelter and vantage points. From these heights, it watches for prey passing through the depths below.
author: .izik

entry: Its body can withstand the extreme pressure of some of the deepest portions of the sea. Its body can quickly burn if exposed to too much sunlight.
author: .izik

entry: The sludgy part of its body is normally fluid, but it quickly hardens when struck forcefully, protecting POKENAME's inner core from harm.
author: hophoppip

entry: A valuable pearl lies hidden within its shell, polished by years of ocean currents. Many seek it, though few manage to claim the treasure within.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce pearls made out of nacre, a strong, resilient, and iridescent substance. This natural ceramic is being studied by scientists who wish to replicate its remarkable properties.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME imbues the pearls it creates with psychic powers, using them to hypnotize others so it may consume their dreams. The pearls have an ethereal luster to them that makes them fetch a high price among curio collectors.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient tribes utilized discarded POKENAME shells for creating armor. The pincers were fashioned into gauntlets used in combat.
author: .izik

entry: It patrols near cruise ships, scavenging discarded food and scraps. Passengers sometimes catch glimpses of it from the decks and marvel at its sleek shell.
author: .izik

entry: The shells on POKENAME's arms can clamp down with powerful force, though it disdains close-range combat. Instead, it creates and fires large pearls from the shells to pelt foes from a distance.
author: sk372

entry: The spores emanating from a POKENAME's bulb drift towards people and Pokémon, drawing them in to abandoned gardens and giving them a sudden urge to tend to them. All while the POKENAME watches with the same unwavering smile.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME tethers its spirit to a broken egg, which it hardens with its powers to protect itself. Without shelter, it risks dissipating.
author: darxer_

entry: The spirit of a desecrated body possesses the Cubone who dug it up and wields its bone as a weapon.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The ghostly energy surrounding POKENAME's bones resembles that of Marowak. These Pokémon do not seem to eat or drink and are often spotted trudging around cemeteries. Research is ongoing into POKENAME and its habits.
author: chibitales

entry: It spends its days in the mountains, training to be able to hit targets from further away. Due to the decreased pressure, it can stretch its gas body much further.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's breath carries a foul-smelling, toxic mist that lingers for days. Groups of POKENAME gather in areas rife with heavy pollution.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME conceals its body within a shroud of darkness. However, the shroud will dissipate if it is exposed to a strong wind.
author: raydrago

entry: POKENAME inhales smoke from crematoriums, mixing it into its toxic gas. This enriched vapor makes its haze particularly noxious.
author: .izik

entry: Possessing a long-deceased Rhyhorn's remains, POKENAME intimidates foes with its imposing new body. If attacked, the stone plates separate to avoid strikes, then reform to counterattack.
author: sk372

entry: Childless Kangaskhan often die of heartbreak. However, in the case of POKENAME, the deceased child persists by sheer will to support its parent.
author: mattyzer0

entry: POKENAME form gaseous wings that they use to fly around with. These wings are only weakly controlled by the Pokémon and can be dispersed by strong winds, leading them to hide in trees during storms.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Found under corner street lamps, POKENAME stands eerily still. When spotted, it floats into the air without using its wings and chases its victim as if possessed.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's ethereal gases fuel their firepower. However, they can also lead to unintended and dangerous blazes.
author: garret95

entry: Gastly possessed a Tauros in order to cause damage and mischief. However, their possession has caused the Tauros to become incorporeal, so their once-destructive charges no longer cause actual property damage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often will collect gases from spirits that attempt to haunt their Trainers. Due to the instability of their DNA, these gases frequently condense into a wispy mane around their neck.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Frequently found haunting shipwrecks, POKENAME is a surprisingly peaceful creature. It often will attempt to guide the spirits of lost Pokémon to the water's surface with bubbles in order to allow them to rejoin their Trainers in the afterlife.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME utilizes its almost invisible body to sneak into active power plants in order to siphon electricity from them. When discovered, the gas of their body hardens into protective spikes able to launch lightning bolts.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: The gas surrounding its body burns with incredible intensity. Even a brief touch can leave searing burns on the skin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME haunts dead electronics, projecting itself from the screen to screech at those who draw close to it. It's believed it dislikes humans for letting the machines die and discarding or replacing them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME conceal their bodies in a cocoon of gas, hiding their true bodies. This gas is highly toxic, incapacitating anyone who gets near.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME float around places where paleontologists dig up fossils looking for bones that were once part of their body. Once the complete skeleton returns to their rightful place, they are depleted of ill intentions and roam calmly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A collar of purple smoke swirls around POKENAME's neck. It lures in prey with its fragrant aroma, before feeding on its life force when it succumbs to the poisonous gas.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: POKENAME produces a gaseous form of potassium chloride that is expelled from its head, mouth, and tail. This is what causes its purple-colored fire.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME breathes out a dark mist of smoke that smells deeply of charcoal. Its preferred habitat for haunting seems to be burnt-out old buildings in remote locales.
author: sk372

entry: In spite of it possessing strong jaws, POKENAME only feed on carrion. Due to their gassy composition, they can't stay submerged in water for too long.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME usually keeps its wings tucked tightly to keep its gaseous body contained. At night, it unfurls its wings to shriek at prey, paralyzing them with fear and making them easily picked off.
author: sk372

entry: When many POKENAME gather together in the wild at night, they entertain themselves by rapidly falling to the ground in sequence in an imitation of a meteor shower.
author: sk372

entry: Almost invisible at night, this Pokémon's trek across the sky is responsible for the phenomenon of "dark meteors".
author: hushpuppy

entry: POKENAME loves to haunt and prank the residents of the homes it haunts, floating before them and making spooky noises. However, its body is so lightweight that even air from fanning one's hands will send it tumbling away through the air.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cries ceaselessly. It is said it cries because of its foreshortened life; it had just been an egg and now has passed from this world into the next. Few Trainers have ever managed to soothe it.
author: inquis1

entry: It appears at night among flocks of Mareep, leading them astray. Though it appears to have fluffy wool, close inspection reveals that it's merely a thick cloud of toxic gas.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its skirt is made of possessed dead petals. Many florists offer dead flowers to them as a peace offering.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME are considered pests of great nuisance, due to waiting until residents are asleep and then waking them with incessant spectral scratching noises in the walls.
author: sk372

entry: Should POKENAME see a traveler lost in its forest, it will attempt to guide them deeper in the woods. There are few tales of anyone surviving this.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has two methods of protecting itself: violently shaking its leaves and releasing toxic gas from its body. The latter is only done as a last resort, however, as it can also harm POKENAME itself if it is not careful.
author: ichosuzu

entry: When exposed to the moonlight, POKENAME's gaseous petals glimmer radiantly. Under bright sunshine, they shine like fire.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME are an ephemeral presence that dart aimlessly through haunted forests. People who wander through those forests often report a POKENAME zipping by on a gust of wind.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts silently over marshes, leaving behind a trail of damp mist. Its gaseous body smells faintly of pond water. If angered, it releases a burst of swamp gas that causes dizziness and uncontrollable laughter in those who inhale it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: These elusive Pokémon are not known to haunt a location, but rather Trainers who they feel are worthy of their attention. The gas-like fur on their bodies is said to be extremely sensitive but allow them to pass through shadows undetected.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: It is said POKENAME is formed from fog dissipating on a moonless night. Its favorite haunts are abandoned cabins in the woods, where it startles unaware hikers before taking shelter for the night.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME steals offerings left on graves, hoarding them in abandoned crypts. It protects its stolen treasures with a dense, toxic fog.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is frequently seen in abandoned areas where it seeks to pull pranks on youths snooping around the location. Its impish demeanor makes it a common trickster character in stories.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Wild POKENAME only show themselves in certain locations and at certain times of the day. To spot them in other conditions, specialized equipment is necessary. Typically, they are intangible to human touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Tales tell of it burrowing into headstones to absorb memories of the deceased. If it deems the person cruel in their past life, it shatters their grave marker in disdain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits a chilling fog that makes those nearby feel constantly watched. This haunting presence can drain the resolve of even the bravest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found around active lava flows, forming from the gasses that are released from the molten rock. Their presence is noxious to living creatures, but they do not travel far from the flows that birth them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME resides near cemeteries in hot climates. Its body is composed of molten, purple tar. This strange substance emits a faint, otherworldly glow at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drift toward lost hikers in snowy mountains, gathering around them. It is said they guide rescuers to those who succumb to the cold.
author: .izik

entry: The gaseous antlers of POKENAME radiate an unsettling energy. Psychics claim it allows them to see far into the past.
author: .izik

entry: Anything which comes in contact with its gaseous tail will be stained purple, as if airbrushed. Strangely, the color always fades by midnight.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME balances atop gravestones to train its focus and agility. This habit is curious since it can effortlessly float when needed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are frequently found on docks as they consume the souls of fish that have been caught and brought to shore by kissing them. Dockworkers even encourage them to hang around, as their presence deters other pests that try and steal the fish.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Children are often told that POKENAME were once kids that played with electrical sockets. Of course, there's no actual truth to this whatsoever.
author: enemyphase

entry: POKENAME release dangerously hot and toxic gases. A person trapped in a closed space with them will lose consciousness within minutes.
author: garret95

entry: POKENAME creates a mist around itself composed of X-Rays. The mist is utilized by paleontologists to locate fossils at a rapid pace.
author: camtft

entry: POKENAME are an evanescent presence in Johto forests and travel through timelines to guide ancient spirits. It is rumored that they pass messages from loved ones in the distant past, though this has yet to be confirmed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME projects illusions of unfulfilled desires to distract its prey. These mirages keep victims wandering in circles, unable to escape.
author: .izik

entry: Legends tell of POKENAME luring travelers in swamps to witches' huts. Those who follow risk losing their sanity to the swamp's shadowy curse.
author: .izik

entry: It disguises itself as a potted plant, often resting on graves. Visitors who linger too long might find themselves startled by its sudden movements.
author: .izik

entry: The wings of a POKENAME have an evanescent quality, as they vaporize into a mist before anything physical hits them. POKENAME chase after baby Pokémon out of haunted forests, often over long distances.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will often haunt greenhouses and siphon off gases needed by the plants in order to survive. They are often found pressing their bodies against the glass in order to absorb as much sunlight as possible while avoiding direct rays.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: POKENAME are said to roam the tops of the most dangerous mountaintops, where Trainers seldom travel. They are able to condense the gas on their bodies into sharp ice that can pierce through the mountain terrain.
author: graybearrubygizmo

entry: Often found in Lavender Town in the Kanto Region, these Pokémon enjoy corrupting retro video games, causing the music to become ear-gratingly repetitive.
author: victor9106

entry: While not flying often, POKENAME are able to glide through the air using the nearby life essence of others. They may also coat themselves completely in the life essence for protection.
author: camtft

entry: During the day, only its head is visible. At night, it forms a body from toxic gas and floats about.
author: hophoppip

entry: Supposedly surpassing death, POKENAME has given up its body to turn into psychic energy, making it much more powerful and protective.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME is said to appear before lonely souls at night, silently compelling them to pursue it. It is said those who follow it vanish without a trace and never return.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is strictly nocturnal and typically lives in secluded tributaries. It has a singular goal: create dams ad infinitum. When a dam begins to cause more harm than good, it takes it down before starting again elsewhere.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Gastly has become the main spirit in control after fusion, the other 107 seeing it as the leader. This allows it to use the other spirits to focus and enhance its own ghostly abilities.
author: sk372

entry: It lurks in trees above cemeteries, waiting for the right moment to strike. It often devours food offerings left for the departed, leaving mourners baffled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are believed to have been haunting the earth for hundreds of years; some archaeologists dedicate themselves to pinpointing the first POKENAME sighting. During high-stress situations, POKENAME struggle to maintain their form.
author: ruben2309295

entry: This Shield Fossil has become possessed. With an iron face and a vaporous body, POKENAME has no physical weak points.
author: robosoup

entry: On cold foggy nights in graveyards, POKENAME can be found patrolling the nearby vicinity. It is said that staring into the eyes of POKENAME causes a person to lose years of their life in exchange for momentary communication with the dead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME haunts ancient temples dedicated to the worship of Pokémon in the past. It has been observed possessing statues and changing their positions, but to what end it does this is not yet known.
author: sk372

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head emits a repulsive aroma akin to sulfur. This aroma is used by POKENAME to deter predator Pokémon.
author: beatdoof

entry: In the forests, if one detects the smell of rotten eggs and ammonia, it means POKENAME is nearby. Nocturnal, it loves to carry fellow Ghost Pokémon on its back.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's "blade" may seem harmless as it is made of gas, but once it permeates flesh, it poisons it from the inside.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It appears in the homes of people whose pets have recently passed. Despite being made of gas, Trainers say they feel it when it lays on their laps.
author: melodydelune

entry: Legends say it manipulates the spirits of children, using them to play pranks on graveyard visitors. The laughter of unseen children is said to echo through the air when it's near.
author: .izik

entry: It was once believed POKENAME's possession of radios let it channel voices of the dead. This has been disproven.
author: .izik

entry: It possesses candles left on graves, lighting them with its eerie presence. It stays hidden within the wax until the candle completely melts away.
author: .izik

entry: It manipulates smoke from nearby fires, directing it toward foes. This choking haze is often used to incapacitate those who cross its path.
author: .izik

entry: Pushing down on one of POKENAME's nails will agitate it to the point of unleashing a Curse on those who disturbed it in revenge. It creates a gaseous hand to poison and suffocate enemies.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon is unfathomably fast because it is nearly weightless. It scours the skies in search of a victim to scare, as it can move without making a single sound.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME is usually seen wandering cemeteries at night, stopping at each grave as if in mourning. It stays longer for those who have not been visited in a long time. Once dawn arrives, it slinks back into the forest to await the twilight.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME wear talismans on their bodies because they can cause great calamity if left to their own devices. When granting wishes, they corrupt the wish into an effect contrary to what is desired.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME phase through solid objects to escape Trainers and never leave a single scintilla to prove they were there. Their elusive nature causes some people to doubt they exist at all.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's amorphous body allows it to slip into areas with even only microscopic cracks as an entry point. It is most active during the new moon and plays pranks on people.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It plays mischievous tricks on miners, shutting off their equipment unexpectedly. This often leads to confusion and frustration deep underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME linger in old factories where they operate machinery with their ethereal bodies. It is said that they carry the will of workers who were harmed by the factory's machines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stalks around schools and playgrounds, causing mischief directed at school bullies. Because of this, it is thought to be the combined malice of children who are being picked on and seeks revenge on their behalf.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's ears are tipped with clouds of poisonous gas. It sneaks up on weary travelers and punches them before disappearing with a sinister laugh.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME fiercely defends its mausoleum home from intruders. Its powerful Shadow Ball serves as a warning to keep graverobbers away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a purple gel around its body that sublimates into a gas when under stress. As POKENAME gains mastery over its body, it can shoot bubbles of noxious fumes to make foes sleepy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME makes mournful wails that echo through graveyards at night. The sounds are thought to be its way of calling to others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to prank people. It appears in someone's sight and then quickly vanishes, scaring the person and making them wonder where it went.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME is fiercely territorial and will defend its nest at all costs. It's impossible to run away from as it will phase through anything to reach its foe.
author: archserpent

entry: POKENAME appears in nightmares and can break out of the dreaming world into the waking one. It only has enough energy to expel a ghostly breath that sows the seed for more nightmares to follow, before fading back into nothing.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: If its pranks fail to amuse, it retaliates by letting loose shrill, horrible screeches. These sounds can disorient and frighten even the bravest of souls.
author: .izik

entry: Most of a POKENAME's body is light and gaseous, centered around a heart gemstone. They typically stay in caves to stay safe from the wind and eat the gemstones found within.
author: entomoxie

entry: The coat that surrounds POKENAME is formed by the gas that POKENAME emits. This gas can also be used to incapacitate enemies, wrapping them in a cozy warmth and leaving them in a vulnerable state.
author: jojojax164

entry: The leaves on its head are made of highly toxic gases, which can cause paralysis or induce fainting. POKENAME can bury its whole body in soil, as a means to disguise its leaves as foliage and ambush its foes.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: The individual flames on a POKENAME are said to each be the soul of a child who died in the forest. POKENAME take life energy from plants around them to keep their own bodies from withering away.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's gases are highly concentrated and toxic, capable of paralyzing its victims in an instant. It drools a putrid honey to attract insects and other small prey.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: POKENAME needs either steady winds or no winds at all in order to stay in place. It loves playing tricks with people and other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Drifting high in the atmosphere, the wings of POKENAME are composed of a very thin mist. As light as their bodies are, POKENAME are often dispersed by the jet stream and can be found all over the world.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of 47.5% gas, and is light enough that it no longer needs to fly.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: POKENAME can control the air around them, reducing stormy gales to gentle breezes. They need to do this because their bodies are delicate enough to dwindle away otherwise.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME hold themselves together using a spectral energy, but struggle to maintain their forms. When a POKENAME struggles to keep form, they opt to crumble, later repairing themselves with new rocks.
author: starryeyedmemoriam

entry: POKENAME possess ancient steel effigies, their gaseous bodies animating and filling the statues as a means of protecting themselves. They roam through these old ruins deep in the night, the clanking of their movements filling the night air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its sweet-smelling, wispy pollen is highly allergenic. In olden times, POKENAME's large petals were revered as a harbinger of plague and disease.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: POKENAME reside inside sunken ships at the bottom of the sea where their heartbroken cries can be heard for miles. They collect old, decrepit skeletons inside the ship as though they were mourning a nautical crew.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will often conceal itself within its own shell and play peak-a-boo with young children or young Pokémon. Their tough shells protect them from strong winds that would otherwise disperse their gaseous core.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME possess cremated remains and wander cemeteries to ward off grave robbers. If they find someone desecrating a grave, they bury the legs of the intruder until an apology is made.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possess ashes that resemble cremated remains. They patrol cemeteries to chase off grave robbers and comfort visitors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Tales claim POKENAME digs up the graves of the dishonest, revealing hidden secrets. Its eerie actions unsettle those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is as light as air. It tends to hover over its Trainer's shoulder. This gets annoying after a while, but it's too affectionate to understand.
author: .realthree

entry: Some say if anyone touches POKENAME's ectoplasmic mane, they will be tormented by restless spirits. Worse yet, any who touch it will endure a crushing Shadow Claw.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME extends its tongue to lick gemstones found in caves. If it discovers a particularly tasty cluster, it laughs uncontrollably for unknown reasons.
author: .izik

entry: If touched, the blue flames amidst POKENAME's gaseous ears and tail will cause an intense burn. Victims are said to only find relief if they offer POKENAME a sincere apology and some of their life force.
author: fancyskunk

entry: It might seem like a mischievous Pokémon, but it's more perceptive than it lets on. POKENAME attacks by leaping about while spewing repulsive gas bubbles from its chest and back.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME loves pranking its Trainer by detaching its head from its purple, bubble-like scarf. It moves very quickly by riding its own gas cloud, giggling along the way.
author: beatdoof

entry: The gas POKENAME expels induces chills and foreboding feelings in those immersed in it. Haunted house attractions employ POKENAME in order to help further the spooky ambience with its smog.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly emits strong purple smoke from its body. Even though the smoke has been proven to be nontoxic, it is still recommended not to breathe in too much of it.
author: ruben2309295

entry: POKENAME is known to try and ingratiate itself within groups of Pumpkaboo in the wild. While the other Pokémon sleep, it hexes them to cause nightmares it can feast on all night long.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME were once believed to be born out of dying flames. In reality, the light from the fire just kept them at bay.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME is notorious for seeping into the cracks of old buildings. People exposed to its gases have reported unsettling hallucinations.
author: busilisk

entry: When there is an accident in a mining shaft, some say a POKENAME is born. Wild POKENAME dislike intruders and perform harmless pranks and dangerous stunts to make sure none invade the desolate place they call home.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When there is an accident in a mining shaft, some say a POKENAME is born. Wild POKENAME dislike intruders and perform harmless pranks and dangerous stunts to make sure none invade the desolate place they call home.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME adore collecting shiny objects. They will hide from strong winds in abandoned buildings, looking to outsiders like eerie, flickering lights.
author: essie

entry: POKENAME releases phantasmal bubbles that store the energy from its headaches. When the bubbles inevitably pop, it will experience another headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME surrounds itself with clouds of toxic gas mixed with water vapor. The rain clouds it forms are a hazard to all living things.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME surrounds itself with clouds of toxic gas mixed with water vapor. It can also freeze these clouds to create poisonous snowstorms.
author: hophoppip

entry: In the middle of the night, POKENAME clings to the eaves of houses, emitting sounds comparable to human voices. It consumes the fear of those who hear the noise.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has been spotted floating around shipwrecks located in icy waters. It breathes out a chilling mist that covers the ship, seemingly just to continue giving its home an eerie atmosphere.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grow intensely angry when they sense the vitality of people or Pokémon approaching their home. They race through walls to charge directly at the interloper, lashing out with ethereal paws to bully the intruder away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: An angry spirit that haunts the ocean, POKENAME creates ghostly rocks to fling at all who come near. The only creatures that escape its ire are Relicanth and its related fusions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grow intensely angry when they sense the vitality of people or Pokémon approaching their home. They wait invisibly to ambush interlopers, appearing at eye level before launching a flurry of strikes at the intruder.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The gas this Pokémon produces causes extreme anger in anything that breathes it. Don't drive with POKENAME, it will give you road rage.
author: themicelegion

entry: When a POKENAME rages, it exudes thick plumes of an anger-inducing gas all around it. A POKENAME's gaseous aura can become so thick that it may even cloud its own vision, further angering it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are commonly found haunting the graves of those who have died in combat. They project their anger outward, afflicting those close to them with a supernatural rage that can take hours to pass.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are commonly found haunting the graves of those who have died in combat. They goad grieving people into fights, cackling maniacally when brawls break out in the cemeteries they call home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is incredibly vengeful, never forgetting the faces of those who hurt it. It'll drag people who've wronged it to their grave.
author: ohok3441

entry: When calm, the mist POKENAME produces is cool to the touch. In battle, it rises in temperature to burn opponents.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME flood the battlefield with gas indiscriminately. It takes a Trainer with a strong will to gain the respect of a POKENAME and teach them control.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME roams cities at night hoping to find leftovers of unfinished meals. If it is encountered during a meal by a Trainer, it hypnotizes the Trainer and forces them to find food for it.
author: skleegamer

entry: POKENAME's spoon helps it channel ghostly energy, allowing it to cast minor hexes on others. It seems to have a particular affinity for using this power to annoy other Ghost-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: A lively Pokémon that lives for the hunt. POKENAME haunts prey from a distance. Once it has gathered enough fear, it leaves the prey alone.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's body is made up almost entirely of a toxic gas that resembles a Bellsprout. It can rarely be found in forests where it blends into the darkness in order to capture prey of any size.
author: sakuraneko

entry: Targets struggle to perceive POKENAME's dark, gaseous body in the shadows before they are incapacitated by its paralytic breath. Few POKENAME have ever been successfully trained.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Being incorporeal, POKENAME has a very weak magnetic charge inside. Even when right next to something its magnets should attract, the objects will only move slightly and slowly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a particularly mischievous creature that enjoys scaring people who venture too close to icy shores. Its pranks, however, often save lives by moving people away from waters so cold they could cause drowning.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Due to its unstable anatomy, it can barely stay upright. Sightings of POKENAME swarming abandoned areas inspired some of the oldest horror stories.
author: leeto64

entry: POKENAME is barely able to keep any semblance of form in its body. As it moves, pratically anything will be engulfed whole in its mass of sludge.
author: leeto64

entry: A gaseous body comprised of clumps of toxic gas and manifested grievances, it loves to roam near settlements in search of more resentment and toxins to absorb into itself.
author: beatdoof

entry: No stranger to battle, POKENAME knows the rules, and so does their Trainer. They are always thinking of a full commitment and would never give up.
author: fauxblue

entry: A Haunter that retained its more gaseous state from Gastly, POKENAME is often preferred to normal Haunter, as its mischievous nature seems less malicious than the norm by comparison.
author: sk372

entry: There are ancient tomes stating POKENAME originate from ancient curses. They are said to turn humans into their kind.
author: pokebio

entry: It wallows in the darkest shadows, murmuring into the ears of trainers who pass by. This muttering has been translated by Pokémon researchers, though the messages appear to be mostly incomprehensible ramblings.
author: kam_doodle_snek

entry: It shadows the elderly, ensuring they are never alone in their final days. Though eerie, its presence is often comforting to those it follows.
author: .izik

entry: The source of many tales of haunted caves, POKENAME hides itself within cavern walls, waiting for the perfect moment to snake out from solid rock and spook unwary visitors.
author: sk372

entry: Only able to be found in the liminal state between wakefulness and sleep, POKENAME delights in feeding on the nightmares of young children.
author: strawbearycandy

entry: POKENAME hides in the shadows and looks for people it can put to sleep. When its successful, it will absorb the sleeper's soul to increase its power.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME haunt logging sites, attempting to scare off lumberjacks that are trying to work the area. Their favourite method of doing so involves luring workers in front of heavy machinery before abruptly turning the engines on.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are depressed ghouls mourning the loss of their mother. You can hear the sounds of its wails on dark, rainy nights.
author: dodoowner_

entry: With control of their limbs across the astral plane, POKENAME can launch kicks that otherwise seem physically impossible.
author: entomoxie

entry: With control of their limbs across the astral plane, POKENAME can launch kicks that otherwise seem physically impossible.
author: entomoxie

entry: Both of POKENAME's heads are skilled hunters. They often split up and try to see who can feast on the most prey.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME float through the air as though unaffected by gravity, their wings eerily staying stationary above their backs. They have a toxic coating of scales along their wings, contact with which can result in painful curses.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is typically found in dark, shadowy areas. It uses its rhythmic red light to attract unsuspecting victims, before latching on to them to drain their life force.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME are found in large groups wherever lightning has struck recently. Several Trainers have witnessed them harnessing the leftover electricity and sharing it around with weaker Haunkids.
author: excelline

entry: Fables state that POKENAME will cause fires to attract a large amount of people in one area. Once gathered, it consumes their souls to grow stronger.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Ancient myths suggest POKENAME were once part of a tribe lost to a volcanic disaster. Their burning tongues feed on heat and energy from others.
author: garret95

entry: Although contact with either of its spikes will incite small tremors and a chilling feeling, they are not venomous. POKENAME nests within bushes closest to lush trees so it may always have leaves to eat.
author: infinex21

entry: Once considered to be a malicious Pokémon, POKENAME are now believed to be the ones that ferry souls to the afterlife. They often are spotted near shipwrecks, and some even use the wreckage as a den.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME pranks computer users by hiding itself in their machine and sending up floods of errors and malware reports. Fortunately, these are entirely fake and it causes no damage to the computer, only panic in the user.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rarely move, aside from their detached claws; these claws can still only move so far from them. They use their claws to scare off others and to eat, though they don't need to eat much.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME despise having bones removed from their bodies, which makes excavating fossils difficult for paleontologists. Their level of aggression is correlated to how many bones they are missing, so paleontologists excavate fossils of Kabutops last.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's was considered a malevolent demon by many ancient civilizations. Its blazing appearance, combined with its cackling laugh and tendency to haunt humans for fun, made it quite the terror.
author: sk372

entry: A ghostly dragon spirit that haunts remote islands, POKENAME is not particularly malevolent, but much prefers solitude. It conjures up fearsome illusions of dragons to dissuade people from approaching its home.
author: sk372

entry: Their venomous stingers can be driven with enough force to cleanly puncture a thick tree. Even in trace amounts, POKENAME venom can drain one's very will to live, to the point they will cease caring for their own well-being.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lurks near ill people and Pokémon, attempting to touch them with its leaf. POKENAME was feared and despised until it was discovered that the leaf's ghostly chill is extremely effective at breaking fevers.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Though POKENAME is covered in spectral flames, its body is quite cold to the touch. It is most active on moonless nights, stalking its victims silently.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can predict when a Pokémon teleports with frightening accuracy, using this knowledge to steer the Pokémon's destination off course with their mystical powers. POKENAME enjoy standing perfectly still at night, scaring unsuspecting targets.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME's petals can be seen to shimmer and glow, especially when exposed to moonlight. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a ringing sound not unlike tools used by shrine maidens.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: Usually found haunting battlefields, POKENAME originally was seen as a specter of death. It was discovered it seeks out the wounded and feeds them a tincture made from its ghostly leaves, stabilizing their conditions.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME reside in sewers, often climbing through drains to infiltrate homes. Trainers haunted by these Pokémon often report hearing scratching noises from their walls.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME seeks out buildings with new inhabitants and then pulls pranks, such as tapping people on the shoulder while invisible or throwing items around rooms. It is easily chased off by pets like Houndour, leading it to find a new place to torment.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A ghostly scourge of gardens, POKENAME claws at the dirt and uproots all the plants it can find. Opinions are divided on if it does this out of cruel spite or for some other unknown reason.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are ethereal beings that phases through dense objects, such as trees or branches. They often torment and chase other Pokémon while zipping through the forest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Surprisingly, POKENAME is very friendly. It motions for those nearby to approach, and if they do, it sneezes a gel onto them that, upon contact with skin, causes uncontrollable laughter and triggers dopamine release.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's Shellder seems to be the source of its ghostly powers. When a POKENAME's Shellder begins to float, chaos will soon ensue.
author: hophoppip

entry: A Raticate that was once a key battler in someone's party. It came to its end and was buried in Lavender Town, where it came back from the grave.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME feeds on fear, so it maliciously haunts urban areas with dangerous tricks. The red orb necklace glows brighter as it absorbs more fear, making it harder to hide until it consumes the stored fear.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its body is composed almost entirely of gas, and it can travel almost anywhere, even deep underground. However, it loathes the light and dislikes being seen, so it tends to stay in one area anyway.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME find detritus and rubble left over from lava flows and possess them, reanimating the rocks and creating a simulacrum of the molten rock that once carried them. Their bodies glow with an eerie purple light from the gases they produce.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME swoop over prey with their aubergine wings and pick them up with disembodied talons. They are particularly fond of Mareep because they are easy for their talons to grab onto.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy possessing microphones while someone is in a meeting and muting the sound until it is noticed. Attempts to fix the microphone will always show that it works but will remain muted until POKENAME leaves the device.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In several cultures, there is a superstition that believes POKENAME travels around the world to sap creativity from artists to the point they give in to despair. No matter the weather conditions, the paint-like fluid on its tail is runny yet cold.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Childlike in demeanor, POKENAME often trick Trainers into holding their hand under the guise of seeking comfort. They then administer a harmless electric shock and run away chortling.
author: enemyphase

entry: Due to their large size, POKENAME can sometimes be seen working at libraries, using their tail and hands to reach items on higher shelves. Should something exceed their range, they will let their Trainer climb atop and lift them up.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME bring messages from people who have long passed in an effort to help grieving families. Their efforts have mixed feelings attached and may cause anger in some people who are not ready to hear the message.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in abandoned cottages. It invites lost travelers into its home, where it cares for them while also draining them of their vitality.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME have been known to play tricks on unsuspecting victims, imitating their greatest fears. Surprisingly, this supposedly malicious practice has become useful in helping people with their mental health.
author: turcai_87271

entry: The Fire Blast from POKENAME is capable of melting metal in seconds. The sheer force of these flames destroys their arms, which swiftly regenerate.
author: garret95

entry: POKENAME can enter into a momentary incorporeal state that allows them to phase through physical objects. This is handy when chasing other Pokémon or Trainers when they toss obstacles their way.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts unseen, blending perfectly into its surroundings. Those who linger nearby report feeling drained and aging faster. It is believed that POKENAME feeds on the vital energy that seeps from its unsuspecting victims.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is territorial and often winds up fighting others of its kind for the right to haunt a specific locale. When their ghostly hands clash against each other, eerie metallic screeches course through the air.
author: sk372

entry: Many find wild POKENAME unsettling as it rarely moves; it merely stares off into the distance until morning comes, where it fades away until the next night. It was recorded once that, when one vanished for the day, it exploded into toxic gas.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME will stalk travelers in the desert from a distance, waiting until they tire out. They are natural enemies to Cacturne.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME drifts silently through ocean skies late at night, leaving curious red wisps in its wake. Scientists have spent years studying these wisps in hopes of determining what they are made of.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME's bushes will grow berries for other Ghost Pokémon to eat. However, do not eat them unless one is a Pokémon, as the berries will cause intense cibophobia and paralysis.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME's back is covered with graves and is often home to many Ghost-type Pokémon. It is believed that some ancient nomadic cultures traveled with POKENAME in their group, allowing them to bury their deceased without having to abandon them.
author: rymyll_the_wanderer

entry: The graveyard it carries on POKENAME's back is said to bear the names of those who died at its hands. In the darkest of forests, it lurks, waiting for travelers to meet their untimely end.
author: beatdoof

entry: Though POKENAME appears threatening, it is actually one of the friendliest Ghost-type Pokémon fusions. However, should its Trainer be threatened, it will not hold anything back.
author: wh3reverimayr0am

entry: It cries for hours and hours. No one is aware of the reason.
author: bucklin

entry: It cries for hours and hours. No one is aware of the reason.
author: bucklin

entry: POKENAME can turn intangible while they run, phasing through trees or boulders. Whenever they feel mischievous, they emerge from the ground to scare Trainers and Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses illusions to make its territory shift and squirm. Anybody caught in the illusion is promptly licked by POKENAME, draining their life force and feeding the illusion.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: This Pokémon, despite its unnerving appearance, is very affectionate. Unfortunately, its licks have been known to paralyze its Trainer.
author: melodydelune

entry: Some say POKENAME is a being from a nightmare dimension, now in this world to haunt more victims. It creates shadowy hands that touch upon the shadows of others, making them feel the phantom limb's creepy caress.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flowers hide its ghostly vines, which it uses to draw the life force from its prey. They can be seen around graveyards, stealing the flowers recently left there.
author: mistymagius

entry: Since its arms are not connected to its body, POKENAME can strike its opponents from a safe distance. However, POKENAME will only pick fights with other Ghost-types.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dwells in abandoned ancient tombs, weaving invisible spiderwebs to catch graverobbers. Those caught in its web have their life force slowly absorbed.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME uses its nine ghostly tails to create illusions that deceive both people and Pokémon. It is said to lurk in dark forests, mischievously waiting to scare unsuspecting victims.
author: thepandasharky

entry: It uses multiple hands to beckon victims in different directions. It cloaks itself in shadows while it sleeps.
author: .towerxvi

entry: POKENAME has the ability to shift and change forms, using it to disguise themselves as objects or people. When something gets too close, POKENAME will lick them with a long tongue, draining their life force.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: POKENAME thrives in the darkness. If you see a lonely red flame in the shadows, flash it with light to dispel it.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Not much is yet known about the strange nature of this Pokémon. The hand puppeting it is thought to belong to a higher power beyond our understanding, and whether or not the body it controls has its own will or not is still unclear.
author: spicybunbun

entry: POKENAME can primarily be seen on cold desert nights, levitating through the sky. It descends on prey and carries them away in its jaws.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can pass through solid material, so it likes to sleep inside floors or walls. When it hears someone coming, it flies out to play with them, which usually frightens the passerby.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp tusks to mark its territory. The markings seem to have connections to the spirit world, enhancing its ghostly powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fly in colonies at night, hunting for prey to sustain themselves. Once they find a target, they drain its energy, leaving it weak and defenseless.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME roll at incredible speeds, phasing through any obstacles in their paths. Once they have arrived at their destinations, they dig their claws into the nearest surface to stop themselves.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A fearsome nocturnal hunter, POKENAME's ghostly limbs poison and paralyze prey on contact. This leaves them helpless to resist as the ethereal hands carry the victim into its hungry mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lurks in darkness, luring unsuspecting prey with the sweet smell of its drool. Its gaseous body is capable of moving through solid objects.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: This malevolent bird can be incredibly aggressive. Even staying in their vicinity can cause unease.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: POKENAME are spirits that are bound to metal statues, using the artificial bodies as a way to interact with the physical world. They are dangerous to unwary people and Pokémon, their inexperience with a body making them underestimate their strength.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME waits for children to finish building sand castles before possessing the finished product, twisting it into a terrifying visage so it can laugh at the young ones frightened reaction.
author: sk372

entry: With its floating limbs, POKENAME's breakneck speed makes it hard for other Pokémon to even land a single hit. It uses its elongated tongue to lick its enemies and absorb parts of their souls as energy.
author: beatdoof

entry: The Haunter-looking smoke on POKENAME's back is not independent of the body. It must feed the sleeping body to remain at full strength.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME's saliva is sweet, but can paralyze those who come into contact with it. Rumors say that it tastes like frosting, though this claim is entirely unsubstantiated.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME wait in the shadows at night, jumping out to scare passersby. If you keep your nerve and don't flinch, the POKENAME will be impressed and not steal your soul.
author: .fedoraman

entry: They work in groups of three to find a target and drain their energy. When three POKENAME become very close, it is thought an evolution will occur.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They work in groups of three to find a target and drain their energy. When three POKENAME become very close, it is thought an evolution will occur.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They are surprisingly stealthy and quiet diggers and dig complex tunnels right under experienced Hikers without them knowing. Only by learning new and unusual digging techniques can POKENAME evolve further.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In a popular children's fable, it is said that a Meowth that steals from people is cursed to be a POKENAME in its next life.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME territories are eerily devoid of nearly all natural sound. It is unknown whether this is caused by its presence inspiring fear in those within or if Pokémon actively avoid the area.
author: chibitales

entry: Odd things start to happen when POKENAME gets a headache. If anyone tries to comfort it, it will violently lash out, flinging any nearby object with its supernatural powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME swing their fists with eerie accuracy, their Shadow Punches landing no matter how evasive their foe is. They take great joy in pursuing their foes, gleefully tasting the fear in the air from their victims.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME swing their fists with eerie accuracy, their Shadow Punches landing no matter how evasive their foe is. Should their blows knock their foe out, they drain a portion of their life energy for an unknown purpose before seeking a new target.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME swing their fists with eerie accuracy, their Shadow Punches landing no matter how evasive their foe is. Should their blows knock their foe out, they drain a portion of their life energy for an unknown purpose before seeking a new target.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: While non-toxic itself, the thick, opaque gas that can spill forth from POKENAME's maw is dense, displacing oxygen-rich air. The result is a Pokémon who can smother torches and Pokémon alike.
author: .fedoraman

entry: This fusion is a quick runner, as it weighs less than a dust bunny. It usually runs around pulling pranks on Trainers, who never see the culprit.
author: dodoowner_

entry: To startle and confuse others, it will flex its wings and emit dazing lights from the membranes. It relishes in fighting, even with prey far weaker than it is.
author: infinex21

entry: Its neighing in the dead of night strikes fear into all who hear it. Legend has it that if its flames glow intensely, POKENAME is about to cast a terrible curse.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can fire off electromagnetic energy that causes drowsiness and irritation. Some have speculated that wild POKENAME may have come from another dimension: their natural diet is still unknown.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME use ominous energy to keep their bodies upright. They are believed by some to be the souls of those who died in highly unsanitary conditions.
author: leeto64

entry: Despite being sluggish, POKENAME is a terrifying hunter that tries to absorb anything. If you see ghostly hands in the water, run away immediately.
author: leeto64

entry: POKENAME's water claws can easily cut through steel. It silently hunts in the deep dark, and once locked on to its prey nothing can stop its pursuit.
author: rotcivosk

entry: Hiding deep within underwater caverns, POKENAME beckons divers forth with its ghostly hands. Those that fall for the deception are then attacked by the ethereal spines generated from its shell.
author: sk372

entry: It is said POKENAME are born from remarkably wrathful souls. The intensity of their red flames stands in direct relation to the injustices they experienced in their past life.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: The noxious mist emanating from its gaseous body will induce fear and panic in anyone that inhales it. Victims will find themselves toyed with by POKENAME purely for its enjoyment. It will not bother anyone it cannot scare.
author: fireblade141

entry: Compared to other members of the Gastly line, POKENAME's ghostly antics are relatively benign. Its most common haunting is possessing and levitating furniture at night.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feast away on nightmares during times of terror. If a dream is happy, it will upset the Pokémon's stomach.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has the capability to freely move its cannons anywhere it wants. While this is an incredible upgrade, the shots themselves are unfortunately very weak.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME can stretch its mouth wide enough to consume Pokémon twice its size. It impatiently awaits to reach its final form.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Some say this Pokémon resides in the shadows inside every Poké Ball. The fable says that whenever a Pokémon is released, there is a small chance POKENAME appears instead. There is no scientific backing to this claim.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME imbues its bone with an eerie, ghostly light before hurling it at foes. Its accuracy with this spectral weapon is unmatched.
author: .izik

entry: The shadow of a POKENAME is always cast by the eerie glow surrounding their bone club. When it attacks an opponent, its shadow seemingly attacks their opponent with them.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses its extendable legs to take long steps while stalking a target. If you see a pair of long, thin legs following you in the dark, do not look at POKENAME's body.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME uses a very unique fighting style that is tricky to defend against. If its shadow's punches hit the opponent's shadow, the foe feels the impact of its fists as if they physically connected.
author: sk372

entry: The smoke trailing from POKENAME's tail is highly toxic, causing sharp pain with a single breath. Its toxic nature makes it a dangerous foe in confined spaces.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a specter that uses their tentacles to tear breaches in space. Thanks to this ability, they appear during private moments to terrify people, as their reactions leave them literally dying of laughter.
author: agtl05

entry: After living together as a single ghastly entity, as the mother POKENAME got stronger, the child inside its pouch eventually became its own ghostly entity, becoming closer with its mother and stronger in death.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME produce eerie vibrations from their horn while swimming to scare away other Pokémon. As the other Pokémon scatter, they swoop in to eat leftover food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roams during the night, releasing spores into the air. These spores cause those who are asleep to experience horrible nightmares.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME are masterminds of deceit, constantly tricking Trainers into freeing them from their detachable strings. This is used as a distraction while they suck the Trainers' life force away.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME often takes the form of beautiful women to lure in unsuspecting victims, putting them to sleep with Lovely Kiss before inflicting them with Nightmare. Some say these Pokémon are demonic beings that originated in the Dream World.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME hide within streetlights and drain their energy entirely, causing the bulb to go out. While someone replaces the dead bulb, POKENAME springs out and pushes them off their ladder.
author: enemyphase

entry: POKENAME's head, feet, and tails radiate the heat they steal in the areas they're in. A POKENAME who has participated in many battles against other soul-stealing competitors will have many trauma marks on its skull.
author: soup1900

entry: The fearful visage on POKENAME's wings is effective self-defense. The visual alone often frightens away others, but if it fails, the "eyes" can release hypnotic waves that enthrall a victim long enough for POKENAME to flutter away.
author: sk372

entry: Many fishermen who have encountered POKENAME warn others about going out at night. It roams the seas, seeking vengeance on those who hunt its kind.
author: cheroace

entry: Unlike some other Ditto, POKENAME retains its default face after transforming on purpose. It does this to unsettle and cause fear in targets with its uncanny, unwavering grin.
author: sk372

entry: Few have ever seen inside of this Pokémon's mouth. Those who have are said to be trapped in another dimension, from which they cannot escape.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME end up in museums around the Kanto region where they watch over other fossils. Thieves who attempt to take one of their bones are met with cuts from their scythe-like hands.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME's body is made up of fossilized bone, ectoplasm and projected illusions. Individuals can be identified by their particular compositions.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's favorite food is poisonous berries, yet eating too many will cause them to become ravenous and begin eating anything in sight. There are stories of POKENAME going on an eating spree and devouring entire villages, leaving no trace behind.
author: hatredhades9148

entry: At a first glance, POKENAME appears to be a Snorlax that has died. However, the truth is that it uses the astral projection gained from fusing with Gengar to be able to sleep for all of its life and still eat.
author: schoffeltjeguy

entry: POKENAME loves playing pranks on people by mimicking their shadows, but if it encounters someone lost in the mountains, it will guide them home.
author: darkweavile428

entry: When POKENAME flares up the flame on its back, it creates a sound akin to a ghostly shriek. It delights in pranking and scaring people by creating the noise in the middle of dark nights.
author: sk372

entry: It is known as "The Walking Wisp", following people home to steal their life away. When it consumes a soul, Its flames burn a deep purple.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME's eyes and chest pattern glow in the dark, creating an eerie smile that strikes fear into the hearts of those who see it. This terrifying display makes prey frozen in horror easy to pick off for a meal.
author: sk372

entry: Its body size and wings allow it to be much more agile. It silently flies at night and paralyses its targets by staring at them.
author: creeps_jr

entry: When it dances, POKENAME emits an eerie yet peaceful ringing sound. Many who hear it describe a sudden, deep chill through their entire body.
author: robobunnybutt

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous prankster, using its ghostly nature to play all sorts of aggravating tricks on its unfortunate victims. It's completely harmless, however, with none of its jokes intending to injure or harm.
author: evilgammon

entry: The gravestones are actually a part of POKENAME: the purple body is made of a nearly identical rocky material. It tends to stay still for most of the day, but it is extremely active on nights with a new moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME will relentlessly haunt a single house of their choosing, rarely being truly chased out. They will hide out beneath the floor during the day, trashing the entire place in search of food at night.
author: santon5512

entry: It is said that only the most putrid, evil, and horrific thoughts go through POKENAME 's mind. If it had the power to, it would end the world.
author: retrocrow

entry: POKENAME has a small territory that is completely devoid of life, frightening away anything that enters, knowing exactly what scares them. There is a gameshow where contestants try to spend the longest in its territory; the record is 84 seconds.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME loves to go into the dreams of Trainers and Pokémon to mess with what they are dreaming about. It can also go into their mind and alter their memories as they please.
author: dill360yt

entry: POKENAME bear a striking resemblance to a certain Kantonian Elite Four member. POKENAME are quite friendly with Gastly, and will use them to antagonize Pokémon Professors.
author: ozzie.the.writer

entry: POKENAME prefer to lurk within darkness and shadows, avoiding others even as they play tricks on them. A tamed Pokémon will often be bolder and more directly prank those who get too close to their Trainer, in an almost possessive way.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its vibrant colors, POKENAME is a master at sneaking through the shadows. It roams around cities at night, pranking civilians.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME loves to scare children by hiding in pumpkin patches and making the bulb on its back glow, accompanied by strange howling. It feeds on the children's fright.
author: rytthigar

entry: POKENAME steals belongings it deems valuable and hides them as part of a prank. It then follows its target, laughing mischievously at their frustration.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME no longer is content with scaring only in the physical world, so it invades dreams and turns them into nightmares to devour. It has a soft spot for the elderly, so it instead makes their dreams more pleasant and scares off other Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When you hear whispers beneath you, POKENAME may be there. It is waiting for prey to fall into a nearby pit, where it will feast on their soul.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While asleep, the crystals on POKENAME's body emit an eerie glow. This light serves as a warning to any creature that might disturb it.
author: .izik
