entry: Its massive claw consistently yields tens of millions of horsepower. Even when POKENAME sheds its shells, would-be predators are too afraid to attack.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: POKENAME uses the large claw on its head to protect its leaves. However, outside of battle, the large claw blocks sunlight, which slows down its rate of photosynthesis.
author: soup1900

entry: As POKENAME undertakes photosynthesis and drinks plenty of water, the claw on its back grows to become very large. As this claw becomes heavier, it spends increasingly more time lounging in the sun than moving about.
author: soup1900

entry: Each of its spikes contain a deadly toxin, though it can only be loosed if the spikes are damaged enough. Its large claw serves as a means to communicate, though it is also strong enough to pulverize a solid rock within its grasp.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hustle around tundra environments, looking for fish Pokémon to eat. POKENAME rely on catching up to slower Magikarp.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's overgrown axe head also means it's outgrown its previous hunting method. It can now cleave slow, well-armored victims in one fell swoop.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has a large, unwieldy claw that it uses exclusively for battling Pokémon that encroach on its territory. It uses its other, smaller claw for mundane tasks such as feeding itself or digging a burrow to live in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME clack their pincers to communicate with one another whilst hunting in a groups of up to ten. The one with the largest pincer is the one who leads their hunts and is the one respected by the others.
author: infinex21

entry: The pincers of this Pokémon are stronger than steel and sharper than the average blade. They use their largest claw to defend most of the time, but if they see an opportunity they will use it to quickly finish a foe.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cuts off portions of its own claw to feed its offspring. So, the babies are left alone for some time, well fed, while POKENAME goes hunting and regenerates it.
author: epping_forest

entry: It flies around beaches looking for food. Its size makes hunting difficult, so it has adapted its claws to extend from its sides to hunt from the sky.
author: patch_bros

entry: The claw on its tail is incredibly powerful. However, due to the weight of its claw, it relies on dense limbs made of bubbles to keep itself balanced.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME battle one another for dominance in coral reefs, using their powerful claws to tear off chunks of coral to fling at one another. Their battles result in widespread ecological destruction, so Pokémon Rangers try to ensure they never meet.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Males of this species are particularly dominant and constantly challenge each other to determine who has the strongest and most robust claw. When POKENAME is sick, it takes long baths in saltwater to heal and get back to fighting form.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's thick body is slow and sturdy. It specializes in melee combat, and its overgrown claw has the power to easily topple over a lighthouse.
author: opossiblymage

entry: Capable of both flying and swimming at incredible speed, POKENAME can strike fast and hard with its large claw, both underwater and in the air. They are only vulnerable if caught on the ground, as their lightweight shells are not very strong.
author: occulusmalus

entry: It lures Krabby into its mouth and traps them. If it fails to capture anything, it will scurry across the shore with its claws.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME hides in ocean caves, resting peacefully. It only comes out to scare away fishermen that interrupt its sleep.
author: imagine1.

entry: Its massive claw snaps down berry trees while the smaller one gathers berries. It needs to eat ten pounds daily to fuel its wild rampages.
author: bandedbodypress

entry: The timbre of POKENAME's voice lures in prey twice its size. It uses its oversized claw to crush foes larger than it.
author: mrpeach774

entry: The bladed dorsal spines on a POKENAME's carapace can cut even thick boat hulls to ribbons. Caution is advised to sailors in POKENAME-infested waters.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand to protect itself from the merciless sun. If it is dug up, it attacks the unfortunate victim by pressing them between its gears, which allows it to generate incredible strength.
author: chorb33

entry: Flying in damp caverns, POKENAME flap their wings to glide silently through the dark. POKENAME crush rocks and shells with their claw-like mouth in search of food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found walking along the ocean floor with a passenger sitting on its shell. It has a tendency to help others who are injured or lost get to safety. If necessary, POKENAME can encase the seat with an air bubble for those who need it.
author: kittenthepiratekat

entry: The extinction of the massive and powerful POKENAME was a mystery until it was revived from fossil fragments and it was discovered to taste absolutely delicious. Ironically, this fatal flaw has encouraged their revival, as the meat is in high demand.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME dance from dawn to dusk, waving their claws into the air. It is said that these dances change the weather, summoning rain to a given area.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A wretched mess of deformed chitin and crooked limbs descended from mutated Kingler colonies in polluted waters, POKENAME is so hideously toxic that nothing will prey on them- thus ensuring their survival and thus continued misery.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME have a sleek shell atop their head. Despite the shell weighing as much as another POKENAME, the aerodynamic shell does not encumber its speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using their massive claws, POKENAME will defend the creatures inhabiting their bodies from any danger they may face. They will roam the seafloor for miles, covering entire oceans without stopping.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping since lifting its large claw uses too much energy for it. Legends claim that once fully awake and energized, it can fire an overly destructive laser from the large claw, able to pierce through whole planets.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME release a pleasant aroma from their bodies, drawing smaller fish towards them. Once they get too close, they will snatch them up with their big, meaty claw, shoving them into their mouths.
author: santon5512

entry: The bodies of POKENAME play host to an aggressive fungus that hijacks their nervous system, making them move against their will. The spores of the fungus thrive in water and will infect freshly laid POKENAME eggs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are deceptively fast, capable of propelling themselves tens of meters onto the shore to snatch prey with their oversized claws. If they miss, they scuttle backwards back into the water, dragging their heavy claws gracelessly after them.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Natural hydraulics allow POKENAME to launch its sturdy body at speeds exceeding 150km/h. Due to this strength, few are willing to disturb the calm, peaceful life POKENAME leads.
author: turron_turron

entry: Meat from POKENAME's claws is considered a delicacy in some parts of the world due to its rich sweet and herbal flavors that develop due to its diet. POKENAME claws are incredibly sharp, able to slice through Cloyster shells without trouble.
author: chibitales

entry: The bodies of POKENAME play host to an aggressive fungus that hijacks their nervous system, making them move against their will. The spores of the fungus thrive in water and will infect freshly laid POKENAME eggs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The spines along a POKENAME's back are highly toxic. POKENAME fight by striking back and forth with their claws before suddenly turning around, defending themselves by blocking any incoming attacks with their spikes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Their left claws grow so large that they often end up having to drag them along the ground. Because of this, and their heavy, tough shells, their bodies are dense with muscles.
author: infinex21

entry: The intense heat within the shell of POKENAME creates thermal vent systems as they rest on the seafloor, waiting for prey to stray too close.
author: noblenobody

entry: POKENAME wings are surprisingly solid, containing layers of muscles that allow them to fly despite the heft. In battle, they fly into the air, only to suddenly drop, striking with their large claw and using the recoil to keep them aloft.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: From its pincers, POKENAME releases scalding bubbles that burn on touch. Its larger claw is strong enough to crush boulders and pry apart the armor of the sea creatures it hunts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While digging, POKENAME fires pressurized bubbles from its larger claw to move faster or strike prey. Once a foe is stunned, it subdues them with Vice Grip.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME beaks have a bite force that can split boulders, making a loud clacking noise when they snap shut. When two POKENAME fight, they posture opposite one another, scuttling side to side and making loud snapping noises to intimidate their rival.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME dig into the sand at beaches to find coins and shiny objects. If they encounter another POKENAME while searching for shiny objects, they spar until one of them gives up their collected horde.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are cunning, as they wave their claws and quack to communicate when ships are arriving. When ships dock at the port, POKENAME wave their claws, hoping for snacks from various sailors or tourists.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a fully developed language, using their quacking and claw movements to detect changes in temperature and humidity. In some laboratories, POKENAME work alongside scientists to predict stormy weather.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its cute appearance, POKENAME has a bite force of 10,000 psi. This massive jaw is quite heavy, however, and causes it to often stumble about.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME dwells on ocean atolls and bravely challenges anyone who arrives to duel it. Its massive claw is used not only to fire high-pressure jets of water, but above all to deliver crushing blows that can shatter huge boulders in a single strike.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is quite intelligent and possesses great psychic power. It creates bubbles with its claws that are brimming with enough telekinetic energy that a single one popping would knock out anything in a 100 km radius.
author: sk372

entry: The pattern that appears to be briefs on its body is actually where its shell lacks protein the most. Particularly healthy POKENAME may have different colored markings in its midsection.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Anyone POKENAME's claws snap down on is knocked out in one hit. If threatened, it will crawl on all six of its limbs, moving at a tremendous speed.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It grips onto its opponent using its large pincers and swings them around to tire them out. While its pincers are clamped down, it releases a burst of bubbles onto its target to secure victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drift near the seafloor of shallow waters, using their claws to crack open shellfish for consumption. They've been known to grab fishermen's hooks with their large claws, yanking them into the water for fun.
author: santon5512

entry: POKENAME will drift along the sea floor, their many tentacles snatching anything they can get their claws on, consuming them whole. Just one of these Pokémon can leave entire coral reefs devoid of life.
author: santon5512

entry: The pincer on its tail catches prey on instinct and drops it in front of its face when its at leisure. It may take hours for POKENAME to realize food has been delivered, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scuttles around the shallows of beaches, picking up small creatures to eat. The shell-like organism surrounding its body derives sustenance from the scraps that fall from POKENAME's mouth as it chews.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME crawl on the ocean floor with their claws clearing the debris in front of them. POKENAME do this because they prefer to slide on smoother surfaces, as debris and other irritants cause them pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slide on their stomach along the ocean floor by freezing a path in front of them. These paths allow POKENAME to wander without worrying about colliding with debris on the ocean floor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These Pokémon are rather territorial and often clash with each other using their giant pincers. Against stronger opponents, POKENAME will typically use their pincers to hold their opponent and then shoot them with their waterspouts up-close.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use one claw to help them crawl along the seafloor and swap claws to give the other one rest. One claw can lift twice their body weight above their heads, but POKENAME requires great effort to do so.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are heavy and bulky, but their protective shells and hefty claws help protect them from attacks. However, POKENAME can use their claws to smash and pry off parts of their shell, shedding weight for speedy escapes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To avoid scaring off prey with its fearsome claws, POKENAME hypnotizes them with its pendulum. Its claws and jaws can crack even the toughest armor.
author: chorb33

entry: When strolling across beaches, Trainers may find POKENAME scuttling about in the sand. They often have competitions to crush the largest rocks they can find with their massive claws.
author: avidclown

entry: POKENAME's left pincer can pulverize almost anything due to its sheer ginormous size. Its beard is made of bubbles it made itself and therefore could be made in many styles and sizes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME typically lives on sheer cliffs next to oceans. Its entire body is rock-hard, making it difficult for predators to effectively attack this Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's bubbles can quickly melt opponents' bodies due to their high alkalinity. It is therefore recommended to avoid ever touching its bubble beard or mustache.
author: soup1900
